Title: MƆL 1
Content:
Ewiade ɛbɔlɛ nwo edwɛkɛ
1Mɔlebɛbo ne Nyamenle bɔle anwuma nee aze. 2Ɛnee azɛlɛ ye ɛnzɔho ɛhwee, yɛɛ debie biala ɛnle zolɛ; awozinli ɛheda buma ne anye, na Nyamenle Sunsum ne luolua nzule ne anye. 3 Na Nyamenle zele kɛ, “Wienyi ɛrɛla”; na wienyi rale. 4Nyamenle nwunle kɛ wienyi ne le kpalɛ, na ɔdele wienyi ne ɔvile awozinli ne anwo. 5Nyamenle vɛlɛle wienyi ne “Alehyenlɛ” yɛɛ ɔvɛlɛle awozinli ne “Aledwolɛ”. Akee aleɛ dwole na aleɛ hyenle. Ɛhye a le kenle ne mɔɔ lumua la.
6 Na Nyamenle zele kɛ, “Anwomanyunlu ɛrɛla ɛrade nzule ne mɔ avinli.” 7Na Nyamenle yɛle anwomanyunlu na ɔvale ɔdele nzule ne mɔ mɔɔ wɔ anwuma la ɔvile azɛlɛ ye ɛdeɛ ne mɔ anwo. 8Na ɔvɛlɛle anwomanyunlu “Anwuma.” Aleɛ dwole na aleɛ hyenle; kenle ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nwiɔ la ɛne.
9Na Nyamenle zele kɛ, “Nzule mɔɔ wɔ ewiade la ɛhɔ ɛleka ko ɛye ɛleka resee ɛdo ɛkɛ.” Na ɔyɛle zɔhane. 10Nyamenle vɛlɛle ɛleka resee ne “Azɛlɛ”, yɛɛ ɔvɛlɛle nzule ne mɔ mɔɔ hɔle ɛleka ko la “Nyevile”. Na Nyamenle nwunle kɛ ɔle kpalɛ. 11Na Nyamenle zele kɛ, “Ɛbɔ ɛrɛla azɛlɛ ye azo; ndile nee mbaka mɔɔ so ma, yɛɛ nzoleɛ mbaka mɔɔ ma wɔ bɛ nzoleɛ ne mɔ anu la, ko biala nee ye ɛsaso ɛrɛla.” Na ɔyɛle zɔhane. 12Ndile nee mbaka ngakyile kɔsɔɔti mɔɔ so ma, yɛɛ nzoleɛ mbaka mɔɔ ma wɔ bɛ nzoleɛ ne mɔ anu la, ko biala nee ye ɛsaso, fifile azɛlɛ ye azo. Na Nyamenle nwunle kɛ ɔle kpalɛ. 13Aleɛ dwole na aleɛ hyenle; kenle ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nsa la ɛne.
14Na Nyamenle zele kɛ, “Ahɛnlaneɛ ɛrɛla anwomanyunlu anwuma lɔ, ɛrade alehyenlɛ nee aledwolɛ avinli, na bɛyɛ sɛkɛlɛneɛ mɔɔ kile ɛlobɔ, kenle, nee ɛvolɛ a, 15na bɛda anwomanyunlu anwuma lɔ bɛmaa wienyi ɛrɛla azɛlɛ ye azo.” Na ɔyɛle zɔhane. 16Na Nyamenle yɛle anwuma ahɛnlaneɛ mgbole nwiɔ ne, ɔyɛle kpole kpalɛ ne, sɛnzɛne ne, kɛ ɔda alehyenlɛ nu; akee ɔyɛle kpole ekyi ne, siane ne, kɛ ɔda aledwolɛ nu. Ɔyɛle nwɔlɔra noko. 17Ɔyɛle ɛhye mɔ ɔzieziele anwomanyunlu anwuma lɔ kɛ bɛda bɛmaa wienyi ɛrɛla azɛlɛ ye azo. 18Ɔyɛle kɛ bɛda alehyenlɛ nee aledwolɛ nu, amaa bɛade wienyi ne bɛavi awozinli ne anwo. Na Nyamenle nwunle mɔɔ yeyɛ la kɛ ɔle kpalɛ. 19Aleɛ dwole na aleɛ hyenle; kenle ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nna la ɛne.
20Na Nyamenle zele kɛ, “Nzule nu anyewɔzo abɔdeɛ ngakyile muala ɛrɛla, na nloma mɔɔ tu dua anwomanyunlu la ɛrɛla.” 21Yemɔti Nyamenle bɔle nyevile nu abɔdeɛ mgbole anwo ɛzulolɛ muala nee nzule nu anyewɔzo abɔdeɛ biala nee bɛ ɛsaso, nee nloma kɔsɔɔti nee bɛ ɛsaso. Na Nyamenle nwunle kɛ ɔle kpalɛ. 22Nyamenle yilale bɛ muala na ɔzele kɛ, “Bɛlɔ, bɛyɛ dɔɔnwo bɛyi azule nee nyevile,” na ɔzele nloma noko kɛ, “Bɛdabɛ bɛda, bɛyɛ mɔnwo mɔnwo wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo.” 23Aleɛ dwole na aleɛ hyenle; kenle ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nnu la ɛne.
24Akee Nyamenle zele kɛ, “Anyewɔzo abɔdeɛ ɛrɛla azɛlɛ ye azo, biala nee ye ɛsaso: nlankɛ nee ninyɛne mɔɔ twenle bɛ nwo aze la amuala nee nanemgbole, ko biala nee ye ɛsaso.” Na ɔyɛle zɔhane. 25Na Nyamenle bɔle azɛlɛ ye azo nanemgbole, ko biala nee ye ɛsaso: nlankɛ nee ninyɛne mɔɔ twenle bɛ nwo aze la amuala, ko biala nee ye ɛsaso. Na Nyamenle nwunle kɛ ɔle kpalɛ.
26Akee Nyamenle zele kɛ, “Bɛmaa yɛyɛ sonla kɛ yɛdayɛ yɛ ɛsaso yɛmaa ɔzɔho yɛ, na yɛmaa bɛnlea azule nee nyevile nu fɛlɛ, nloma mɔɔ wɔ anwomanyunlu, nyɛmoa nee nanemgbole nee debie biala mɔɔ twenle ɔ nwo aze wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo la anwo zo.” 27 Yemɔti Nyamenle bɔle sonla kɛ ɔdaye ye ɛsaso la; ɔdaye Nyamenle mumua ne ye ɛsaso a ɔnleanle ɔbɔle sonla a. Ɔbɔle bɛ nrenya nee raalɛ. 28Na Nyamenle yilale bɛ, na ɔzele kɛ, “Bɛlɔ, bɛyɛ mɔnwo mɔnwo, bɛyi azɛlɛ ye na bɛzie azɛlɛ ye. Eza bɛzie azule nee nyevile nu fɛlɛ, anwomanyunlu nloma nee azɛlɛ ye azo abɔdeɛ biala mɔɔ die ɛnwomenle la.” 29Na Nyamenle zele kɛ, “Bɛnlea, meva mbaka muala mɔɔ so ma nee baka biala mɔɔ ma wɔ ye nzoleɛ nu, mɔɔ wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo la amuala memaa bɛ kɛ bɛli. 30Meva ndile muala noko memaa debie biala mɔɔ lɛ ngoane wɔ ye nuhua: azɛlɛ ye azo nane kɔsɔɔti nee anwomanyunlu nloma nee ninyɛne mɔɔ twenle bɛ nwo aze la amuala kɛ bɛli.” Na ɔyɛle zɔhane. 31Na Nyamenle nwunle kɛ debie biala mɔɔ yeyɛ la le kpalɛ kpole. Aleɛ dwole na aleɛ hyenle; kenle ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nsia la ɛne.

Title: MƆL 2
Content:
1Ɛnee kɛ Nyamenle zile bɔle anwuma nee aze, nee ninyɛne mɔɔ wɔ nu la amuala la ɛne. 2 Kenle nsuu ne azo, Nyamenle wiele ye gyima ne yɛ bɔkɔɔ na ɔliele ye ɛnwomenle wɔ kenle nsuu ne azo, na ɔyele ɔ sa ɔvile gyima mɔɔ yeyɛ la amuala anwo. 3 Yemɔti Nyamenle yilale kenle ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nsuu ne la azo, na ɔyɛle ye kenle nwuanzanwuanza, ɔboalekɛ kenle zɔhane a ɔvale ɔliele ye ɛnwomenle, ɔyele ɔ sa wɔ gyima mɔɔ ɔbɔ ewiade la ɔyɛle la anwo a. 4Ɛnee kɛ Nyamenle zile bɔle anwuma nee aze la ɛne.
Yidɛn tola ne
Mekɛ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle bɔle anwuma nee azɛlɛ ye la, 5ɛnee baka biala ɛngyi azɛlɛ ye azo, yɛɛ ndile biala ɛtɛfifile, ɔluakɛ ɛnee Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle ɛtɛmanle ezule ɛtɛtɔle azɛlɛ ye azo, yɛɛ ɛnee sonla ɛnle zolɛ na yeazo zolɛ ɛya. 6Noko ɛnee nzule vi azɛlɛ bo finde bu azɛlɛ ne azo amuala tɛloo.
7 Na Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle vale ndɛtɛlɛ nwonle sonla na ɔliele ngoane ɛnwomenle ɔguale ɔ bonyi nu, na sonla nyianle ngoane.
8Akee Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle hyele tola wɔ Yidɛn, wɔ aduduleɛ nehane, na ɔmanle sonla ne mɔɔ yebɔ la dɛnlanle ɛkɛ. 9 Na Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle manle mbaka kɔsɔɔti mɔɔ le ngɛnlɛma nee mɔɔ bɛdi a ɔyɛ boɛ la fifile; ɔmanle ngoane baka ne yɛɛ baka ne mɔɔ maa ɛkola ɛnwu kpalɛ nee ɛtane la ɔdaye bɛfifile tola ne anu.
10Azule la Yidɛn na ɔse ɔdoɔloa tola ne anu. Azule ne dwu tola ne anu a, ɔkpakye nna. 11Bɛfɛlɛ azule ne asa ɛhane ne mɔɔ lumua la Paehyɔn; ɔse ɔdua Havelaa azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ ezukoa nvutuke wɔ zolɛ la azo. 12Ɛkɛ ne azɛlɛ ne azo ezukoa nvutuke ne le tagyee. Baka evuanlɛ bie mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye “Bedɛleɔn” nee bolɛ bie mɔɔ sonle bolɛ, mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye “Ɔnekese” la wɔ ɛkɛ ne azɛlɛ ne azo. 13Azule ne asa ɛhane ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nwiɔ la, bɛfɛlɛ ye Gaehyɔn; ɔse ɔdua Kɛhye (Sudan) azɛlɛ ne azo. 14Mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nsa la, bɛfɛlɛ ye Taegelese; ɔse ɔdua Aselea maanle ne aduduleɛ, yɛɛ mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nna la, bɛfɛlɛ ye Yufileti.
15Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle manle sonla hɔdɛnlanle Yidɛn tola ne anu kɛ ɔyɛ nu egyinli na ɔziezie ɛkɛ. 16Ɔzele ye kɛ, “Ɛkola ɛdi bakama biala mɔɔ wɔ tola ye anu la bie, 17na kpalɛ nee ɛtane ɛnwunlɛ baka ne, yemɔ mmadi ye ma ne bie, ɔluakɛ kenle ko ne mɔɔ ɛkɛli bie la, ɛbawu.”
18Akee Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle zele kɛ, “Ɔnle kpalɛ kɛ menwɔmaa sonla angomekye kɛdɛnla; mebabɔ ye ɛsaso boavolɛ meamaa ye.” 19Yemɔti Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle vale ndɛtɛlɛ yɛle ɛbɔ nu nane kɔsɔɔti nee nloma mɔɔ tu dua anwomanyunlu la amuala bie. Ɔvale bɛ ɔrɛlɛle sonla kɛ ɔtoto bɛ aluma, na duma biala mɔɔ sonla vale donle abɔdeɛ ko biala la, yemɔ a bɛvale bɛvɛlɛle ye a. 20Sonla totonle nyɛmoa ne mɔ aluma ngoko ngoko, ɔtotonle nloma mɔɔ tu dua anwomanyunlu la aluma yɛɛ ɔtotonle nanemgbole mɔɔ wɔ ɛbɔ nu la aluma. Na ɔdaye sonla ɛdeɛ, yeannyia ye ɛsaso boavolɛ biala.
21Yemɔti Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle manle sonla lafele kpole bie na ɔyele ɔ nvenle foa bowule ko na ɔvale nwonane ɔduale ɔ bo zo ne. 22Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle vale bowule ne mɔɔ ɔyele la ɔyɛle sonla raalɛ na ɔvale ye ɔrɛlɛle nrenya ne. 23Na nrenya ne zele kɛ,
Ɛhye le me mbowule nu bowule,
ɔle me nwonane nu nwonane;
bɛbavɛlɛ ye “Raalɛ”,
ɔboalekɛ ɔvi sonla nrenya nu a ɔrale a.
24 Yemɔti a nrenya fi ɔ ze nee ɔ nli anwo na ɔfa ɔ nwo ɔbɔ ɔ ye anwo kyengye, na bɛ mu nwiɔ bɛbɔ nu bɛyɛ nwonane ko a.
25Ɛnee nrenya ne nee ɔ ye ne lɛ bɛ nwo zɔ, noko bɛnze nwolɛ nyiane.

Title: MƆL 3
Content:
Sonla anzosesebɛyɛlɛ
1 Ɛwɔlɛ le mɛlɛbɛla tɛla ɛbɔ nu nane biala mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle bɔle la. Ɔbizale raalɛ ne kɛ, “Yemɔti Nyamenle ɛze bɛ kɛ, ‘Bɛmmadi mbakama mɔɔ wɔ tola ye anu la biala bie’ ɔ?”
2Raalɛ ne buale ɛwɔlɛ ne kɛ, “Yɛkola yɛdi mbakama mɔɔ wɔ tola ye anu la biala bie; 3na Nyamenle zele yɛ kɛ, ‘Bɛmmadi baka ne mɔɔ gyi tola ne avinli lɔ la ma ne bie, eza bɛmmafa bɛ sa bɛka ye anrɛɛ bɛkɛwu.’ ”
4Ɛwɔlɛ ne hanle hilele raalɛ ne kɛ, “Bɛnrɛwu. 5Nyamenle ze kɛ saa bɛdi baka ne ma ne bie a bɛ nye babuke na bɛayɛ kɛ ɔdaye Nyamenle la, na bɛanwu mɔɔ le kpalɛ, bɛannwu mɔɔ le ɛtane la.”
6Yemɔti mɔɔ raalɛ ne nwunle kɛ baka ne ma ne le kɛnlɛma, na bɛdi a ɔle kpalɛ, na ɔwɔ kɛ sonla di bie na ɔnwu nrɛlɛbɛ la, ɔdele bie ɔlile, na ɔdele bie ɔhɔmanle ɔ hu lile. 7Ɛkɛ ne ala bɛ mu nwiɔ bɛ nye dele na bɛnwunle kɛ bɛlɛ bɛ nwo zɔ; bɛkpomgbale feege nya bɛwowale bɛ nwo.
8Nzinlii mɔɔ aleɛ ne bɔle ɔ nloa aze la, bɛdele Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle agyakɛ abo kɛ ɔlɛkpɔsa tola ne anu, na bɛnriandile bɛhɔveale tola ne anu mbaka ne mɔ anu, amaa yeannwu bɛ. 9Na Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle vɛlɛle nrenya ne na ɔbizale ye kɛ, “Ɛwɔ nienwu?”
10Nrenya ne buale kɛ, “Mendele ɛ gyakɛ abo wɔ tola ne anu, na ɛnee mesulo, ɔboalekɛ melɛ me nwo zɔ, yɛɛ menveale a.”
11Nyamenle bizale ye kɛ, “Nwane a hanle hilele wɔ kɛ ɛlɛ ɛ nwo zɔ a? Ɛnee wɔli bakama ne mɔɔ menduale wɔ kɛ ɛmmadi bie la bie ɔ?”
12Nrenya ne buale kɛ, “Raalɛ ne mɔɔ ɛvale ye ɛmanle me la, yemɔ a vale manle me a, yɛɛ menlile a.”
13Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle bizale raalɛ ne kɛ, “Duzu debie a wɔyɛ la?”
Raalɛ ne buale kɛ, “Ɛwɔlɛ ne bɛlɛbɛlale me, lile me adwenle yɛɛ menlile bie a.”
Nyamenle bua ndɛne
14Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle zele ɛwɔlɛ ne kɛ, “Ɔlua ɛhye mɔɔ wɔyɛ la ati, munzule ɛha wɔ wɔ nyɛmoa nee nanemgbole kɔsɔɔti avinli. Ɔvi ɛnɛ mɔɔ kɔ la ɛbahwenle ɛ ko aze na wɔali ndɛtɛlɛ kɔkpula mekɛ mɔɔ ɛkɛwu la. 15 Mebava ɛkpɔlɛ meado wɔ nee raalɛ ne, nee ɛ ra nee raalɛ ne ara avinli. Raalɛ ne ara bagelegele ɛ ti na ɛdawɔ wɔaha ɔ gyakɛ anzi.”
16Akee ɔzele raalɛ ne kɛ, “Mebamaa wɔade nyane kpalɛ wɔ awolɛ nu; ɛbade nyane wɔ wɔ ralɛ ɛwolɛ nu, noko ɛ nwo balɔ ɛ hu na yeazie wɔ.”
17Na ɔzele Adam kɛ, “Kɛmɔ wɔdie ɛ ye aneɛ na wɔli bakama ne mɔɔ menzele wɔ kɛ ɛmmadi la bie la ati, ɔlua ɛ ti, munzule ɛha azɛlɛ ye; ɛtɛwule a ɛbavɛ na wɔanyia aleɛ wɔali. 18Mbaka nee ndile mɔɔ anwo le mbowule la bafifi azɛlɛ ye azo, noko ɛbɔ nu ala a ɛbadidi a. 19Ɛbahwi ɛ ti anwo na wɔanyia aleɛ wɔali, kɔkpula mekɛ mɔɔ ɛkɛzia ɛkɛhɔ azɛlɛ ye anu bieko la, ɔluakɛ nuhua yɛɛ ɛvi ɛrale a; ɛle ndɛtɛlɛ na ɛbazia wɔahɔ ndɛtɛlɛ nu.”
20Ɛhye anzi, nrenya ne donle ɔ ye duma na ɔvɛlɛle ye Yive, ɔboalekɛ ɔle menli kɔsɔɔti bɛ nli. 21Akee Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle kpomgbale nane nwoma adɛladeɛ manle Adam nee ɔ ye Yive wulale.
Bɛvoa Adam nee Yive bɛvi tola ne anu
22 Akee Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle zele kɛ, “Bɛnlea, kɛkala sonla ɛyɛ kɛ yɛ nuhua ko la, yenwu kpalɛ nee ɛtane. Saa yɛannea ye boɛ a ɔbali ngoane baka ne ɔdaye ye ma ne bie na yeadɛnla ngoane nu dahuu.” 23Yemɔti Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle voanle ye vile Yidɛn tola ne anu kɛ ɔhɔ ɔhɔyɛ azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ ɔvi nu ɔrale la azo egyinli. 24Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle voanle sonla vile tola ne anu, na ɔvale tease abɔdeɛma nee dadeɛ mɔɔ ɛlɛsɔ na ɔpɛnepɛne ɔ nwo ɛleka biala la ɔrazinzale Yidɛn tola ne aduduleɛ adenle ne mɔɔ kɔ ngoane baka ne anwo la.

Title: MƆL 4
Content:
Keen nee Ebɛle
1Adam nee ɔ ye Yive lale, na Yive vale ɛkolɛ na ɔwole ralɛ nrenya. Bɛdonle ye Keen. Yive edwɛkɛ a le kɛ, “Ɔlua Ɛdɛnkɛma moalɛ zo mewo ralɛ nrenya.” 2Nzinlii Yive wole Keen anzi ralɛ nrenya, na bɛdonle ye Ebɛle. Ebɛle ɛnee sie mboane, yɛɛ Keen yɛ egyinli. 3Mekɛ hɔle bie la, Keen vale ye egyinli ne anu aleɛ ne bie bɔle azu manle Ɛdɛnkɛma. 4 Ebɛle noko hyele mboane mralɛ mɔɔ ye mboane ne mɔ bie lumuale wole bɛ la, na ɔvale bɛ nee bɛ ɛleka mɔɔ ɛlɔ kpalɛ la ɔbɔle azu ɔmanle Ɛdɛnkɛma. Ɛdɛnkɛma anye zɔle Ebɛle azubɔdeɛ ne, 5na ɔ nye anzɔ Keen azubɔdeɛ ɛdeɛ ne. Ɛhye manle Keen ati zile aze na ɛya hunle ye kpole. 6Ɛdɛnkɛma bizale Keen kɛ, “Duzu ati a ɛ nyunlu ɛyɛ kpundikpundi na wɔva ɛya ɛ? 7Asoo saa ɛyɛle ye boɛ a, anrɛɛ ɛ nyunlu ɛnrɛra anyia? Na wɔanyɛ ye boɛ la, ɛtane ɛhɔ ɛ nwo nzia; ɔkpondɛ kɛ ɔfo ɛ nwo zo, na wɔmɔ yɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ ɛfo ɔ nwo zo a.”
8 Ɛhye anzi Keen zele ɔ diema Ebɛle kɛ, “Maa yɛhɔ ɛbɔ nu.” Bɛhɔle la, Keen holole ɔ diema Ebɛle anwo zo na ɔhunle ye.
9Na Ɛdɛnkɛma bizale Keen kɛ, “Ɛ diema Ebɛle wɔ nienwu?”
Keen buale kɛ, “Menze, mame a menea me diema ne anwo zo a?”
10Ɛdɛnkɛma bizale ye kɛ, “Duzu debie a wɔyɛ la? Ɛ diema ne mogya ne mɔɔ gua azɛlɛ ne anwo la ɛlɛsu avɛlɛ me. 11Wɔbɔ munzule kɛ wɔha ɛ diema ne mogya wɔgua, wɔmaa azɛlɛ ye ɛmeme a. 12Ɔvi ɛnɛ mɔɔ kɔ la, debie biala mɔɔ ɛkɛlua ye azɛlɛ ye azo la ɛnrɛyɛ kpalɛ ɛnrɛmaa wɔ ɛlɛ; ɛkɛdɔ ɛ bɔ nu na mgbɔsamgbɔsa adɔ ɛ nwo wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo.”
13Na Keen hanle hilele Ɛdɛnkɛma kɛ, “Me ndeanlɛ ne bo me nwo zo. 14Wɔye me sa wɔvi azɛlɛ ye mɔɔ medidi zolɛ la anwo; wɔvoa me wɔvi ɛ nye zo. Mebadɔ ɛbɔ nu, na eza mgbɔsamgbɔsa adɔ me nwo wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo; saa awie biala nee me yia a, ɔbahu me.”
15Na Ɛdɛnkɛma zele ye kɛ, “Kyɛkyɛ, ɔnle zɔhane! Awie biala mɔɔ kɛhu Keen la, bɛbali ye nzenralɛ fane nsuu bɛazie ɔ bo zo.” Na Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛle Keen nzonlɛ, amaa awie biala mɔɔ nee ye kɛyia la angu ye. 16Akee Keen vile Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu na ɔhɔdɛnlanle Nɔɔdo wɔ Yidɛn tola ne aduduleɛ.
Keen abo zo amra
17Keen vale ɔ ye na ɔ ye wole ralɛ nrenya, bɛdonle ye Yinɔko. Keen kyekyele suakpole ko na ɔvale ɔ ra ne duma ɔdole zolɛ. 18Yinɔko wole ralɛ nrenya, bɛfɛlɛ ye Ayelade; Ayelade wole Mɛhugyeeyɛle. Mɛhugyeeyɛle wole Mɛtuhyeeyɛle, yɛɛ Mɛtuhyeeyɛle wole Leemɛke. 19Leemɛke gyale mraalɛ nwiɔ; bɛfɛlɛ ko Eda, yɛɛ bɛfɛlɛ ko Zela. 20Eda wole Gyeebale, mɔɔ ɔ bo zo amra a yɛle ndanlɛ azua lale nu la yɛɛ eza bɛlɛ nyɛmoa. 21Gyeebale adiema nrenya a le Dwubale. Dwubale abo zo amra a le menli mɔɔ vale getaa nee fulutu bɔle edwɛne a. 22Raalɛ Zela wole Tubale Keen, mɔɔ ɔ bo zo amra a vale mbulalɛ nee kɔbele yɛle ɛyazonlɛ nee konle ninyɛne la. Ɔ diema raalɛ a le Neeyama.
23Leemɛke zele ye mraalɛ ne mɔ kɛ,
“Eda nee Zela, bɛdie me aneɛ; me ye mɔ, bɛdie mɔɔ melɛka la:
Mehu kpavolɛ bie mɔɔ bɔle me, bodale me la.
24Saa mɔɔ kɛhu Keen la bɛkɛli ye nzenralɛ fane nsuu a,
ɛnee mɔɔ kɛhu medame Leemɛke la, bɛkɛli ye nzenralɛ fane abulasuu nee nsuu.”
Sɛte nee Yinɔhye
25Adam nee ɔ ye wole ralɛ nrenya bieko. Ɔ ye hanle kɛ, “Nyamenle ɛmaa me ralɛ nrenya ɛmaa meva mezie Ebɛle, mɔɔ Keen hunle ye la abo zo.” Na ɔdonle ye Sɛte. 26Sɛte wole ralɛ nrenya na ɔdonle ye Yinɔhye. Mekɛ ne anu menli bɔle ɔ bo kɛ bɛsonle Ɛdɛnkɛma.

Title: MƆL 5
Content:
Adam abo zo amra
(1 Edk 1.1-4)
1 Adam nee ɔ bo zo amra awolɛndoazo ne ɛne. (Mekɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle bɔle sonla la, ɔbɔle ye kɛ ɔdaye ye ɛsaso. 2Ɔbɔle bɛ nrenya nee raalɛ, ɔyilale bɛ na ɔvɛlɛle bɛ “Sonla Dasanli.”) 3Adam lile ɛvolɛ ɛya ko abulasa la, ɔwole ye ɛsaso ralɛ nrenya na ɔdonle ye Sɛte. 4Sɛte awolɛ ne anzi, Adam dɛnlanle aze lile ɛvolɛ ɛya mɔtwɛ, na ɔwole mralɛ mrenya nee mraalɛ. 5Adam lile ɛvolɛ ɛya ngɔnla abulasa, na ɔwule.
6Sɛte lile ɛvolɛ ɛya ko ɛvolɛ nnu la, ɔwole ralɛ nrenya, ɔdonle ye Yinɔhye. 7Yinɔhye awolɛ ne anzi, Sɛte lile ɛvolɛ ɛya mɔtwɛ ɛvolɛ nsuu bokale ye ɛvolɛ ne anwo, na ɔwole mralɛ mrenya nee mraalɛ. 8Sɛte lile ɛvolɛ ɛya ngɔnla ɛvolɛ bulu nee nwiɔ, na ɔwule.
9Yinɔhye lile ɛvolɛ abulahɔnla la, ɔwole Kinan. 10Ɔwole Kinan la, ɔdɛnlanle aze ɛvolɛ ɛya mɔtwɛ ɛvolɛ bulu nee nnu, ɔwole mralɛ mrenya nee mraalɛ. 11Yinɔhye lile ɛvolɛ ɛya ngɔnla ɛvolɛ nnu, na ɔwule.
12Kinan lile ɛvolɛ abulasuu la, ɔwole Mahalalile. 13Ɛhye anzi ɔdɛnlanle aze ɛvolɛ ɛya mɔtwɛ ɛvolɛ abulanla, ɔwole mralɛ mrenya nee mraalɛ. 14Kinan lile ɛvolɛ ɛya ngɔnla ɛvolɛ bulu, na ɔwule.
15Mahalalile lile ɛvolɛ abulasia nee nnu la, ɔwole ralɛ nrenya Gyɛlɛde. 16Ɛhye anzi ɔdɛnlanle aze ɛvolɛ ɛya mɔtwɛ ɛvolɛ abulasa, ɔwole mralɛ mrenya nee mraalɛ. 17Mahalalile lile ɛvolɛ ɛya mɔtwɛ ɛvolɛ abulahɔnla nee nnu, na ɔwule.
18Gyɛlɛde lile ɛvolɛ ɛya ko abulasia nee nwiɔ la, ɔwole Yinɔko. 19Ɛhye anzi ɔdɛnlanle aze ɛvolɛ ɛya mɔtwɛ, ɔwole mralɛ mrenya nee mraalɛ. 20Gyɛlɛde lile ɛvolɛ ɛya ngɔnla abulasia nee nwiɔ, na ɔwule.
21Yinɔko lile ɛvolɛ abulasia nee nnu la, ɔwole Mɛtusɛla. 22Ɛhye anzi Yinɔko dɛnlanle aze ɛvolɛ ɛya nsa, ɔwole mralɛ mrenya nee mraalɛ. Mekɛ ɛhye anu Yinɔko nee Nyamenle luale. 23Yinɔko lile ɛvolɛ ɛya nsa abulasia nee nnu. 24 Yinɔko nee Nyamenle luale na yeanwu, ɔminliminlinle, ɔboalekɛ Nyamenle vale ye hɔle.
25Mɛtusɛla lile ɛvolɛ ɛya ko abulatwɛ nee nsuu la, ɔwole Leemɛke. 26Ɛhye anzi ɔlile ɛvolɛ ɛya nsuu abulatwɛ nee nwiɔ, ɔwole mralɛ mrenya nee mraalɛ. 27Yemɔti Mɛtusɛla lile ɛvolɛ ɛya ngɔnla abulasia nee ngɔnla, na ɔwule.
28Leemɛke lile ɛvolɛ ɛya ko abulatwɛ nee nwiɔ la, ɔwole ralɛ nrenya. 29Ɔhanle kɛ, “Nyamenle ɛmaa munzule ɛha azɛlɛ ye. Ɔlua zo ɛnɛ yɛyɛ zolɛ egyinli a yɛnwu nyane kpalɛ. Noko kakula ɛhye bamaa yɛ nyanenwunlɛ ne aha aze.” Ɛhye ati ɔdonle ye Nowa. 30Ɛhye anzi ɔlile ɛvolɛ ɛya nnu abulahɔnla nee nnu, ɔwole mralɛ mrenya nee mraalɛ. 31Leemɛke lile ɛvolɛ ɛya nsuu abulasuu nee nsuu, na ɔwule.
32Nowa lile ɛvolɛ ɛya nnu la, ɔwole mralɛ mrenya nsa: Hyɛm, Ham, yɛɛ Gyeefɛte.

Title: MƆL 6
Content:
Sonla amumuyɛyɛlɛ
1Mekɛ mɔɔ akee menli bɔle ɔ bo kɛ bɛso dɔɔnwo wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo, na bɛwole mralɛ mraalɛ la, 2anwomanyunlu menli bie nwunle kɛ menli amra mraalɛ ne mɔ anwo yɛ fɛ; yemɔti bɛvale mɔɔ bɛdabɛ bɛkulo la bɛgyale bɛ. 3Na Ɛdɛnkɛma zele kɛ, “Menrɛmaa sonla ɛnrɛdɛnla aze dahuu, ɔluakɛ ɔle nwonane. Ɔvi ɛnɛ mɔɔ kɔ la sonla ɛnrɛli ɛvolɛ mɔɔ bo ɛya ko abulanwiɔ la.” 4 Mekɛ zɔhane anu, yɛɛ nzinlii bɔbɔ, anwomanyunlu menli zɔhane nee mralɛ mraalɛ ne mɔ wole mralɛ. Na bɛmɛ bɛ mra a le menli kakanyinlima ne mɔ mɔɔ mɔmoane ne bɛliele duma la.
5Akee Ɛdɛnkɛma nwunle kɛ sonla amumuyɛyɛlɛ ne ɛyɛ kpole kpalɛ wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo, na ɛtane ngome ɛyi ye adwenle nee ye ahonle nu tɛkɛɛ. 6Na ɔyɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma nyane kɛ yebɔ sonla yedo azɛlɛ ye azo a. Ɔyɛle ye nyane somaa, 7na ɔhanle kɛ, “Mebɔ sonla mɔɔ mebɔ la abo zo bɔkɔɔ wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo. Mesɛkye debie biala mɔɔ mebɔ la, sonla, nane, ninyɛne mɔɔ twenle bɛ nwo aze la, yɛɛ nloma muala. Menlu me nwo bɔbɔ kɛ mebɔ bɛ a.” 8Noko Nowa ɛdeɛ, Ɛdɛnkɛma hulole ye.
Nowa
9-10Nowa abusua ɛlɔnwɔne ne ɛne. Nowa le sonla mɔɔ di pɛlepɛle a, ɔ nwo annyia ngehanleɛ wɔ ye awolɛndoazo ne mekɛ zo. Ɔ nee Nyamenle bɛ avinli ande ɛlɛ. Ɔwole mrenya nsa, Hyɛm, Ham, yɛɛ Gyeefɛte. 11Na ɔrale kɛ ɛnee akee asɛɛ sonla ko bɔbɔ ɛnle azɛlɛ ye azo mɔɔ di boɛ wɔ Nyamenle anyunlu a; sonla ɛhunlɛ, asayɛlɛ, amumuyɛ nee basabasayɛlɛ ɛlie ebia wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo ɛleka biala. 12Na Nyamenle nwunle kɛ amgba, ɛtane ngome ɛyi ewiade ye, ɔluakɛ ɛnee awie biala bɔ ɛbɛla ɛtane biala mɔɔ ɔdaye ɔkulo la.
13Na Nyamenle zele Nowa kɛ, “Mezi pi kɛ mesɛkye ewiade ye nee nuhua menli ne amuala, ɔluakɛ bɛva basabasayɛlɛ, sonla ɛhunlɛ, asayɛlɛ, yɛɛ amumuyɛ bɛyi ewiade ye tɛkɛɛ. 14Yemɔti fa gɔfa baka bobɔ ɛlɛnemgbole; kyɛ nuhua ekpumgbunli ekpumgbunli na fa bilewu ka nuhua nee nwolɛ amuala. 15Kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ ɛyɛ ye la ɛne: maa ɛlɛne ne tendenle ɛyɛ mita ɛya ko abulasa nee nsa, ye tɛtɛlɛ ɛyɛ mita abulanwiɔ nee nwiɔ na ye anwumahɔlɛ ɛyɛ mita bulu nee nsa. 16Tu ɛlɛne ne azo, na maa adenle mɔɔ le bɛ sa waa nwiɔ la ɛla ɛlɛne ne abɛta ne anwuma nee ɛlɛne ne azo ɛdulɛ ne avinli. Bobɔ ye nzɛzo nsa na pɛ ye anlenkɛ ne to ɔ kɛnra azo. 17Ɔluakɛ mebamaa ezule kpole bie adɔ toonwo abu aze, yeazɛkye debie biala mɔɔ die ɛnwomenle mɔɔ wɔ aleɛabo la amuala; debie biala mɔɔ wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo la bawu. 18Na wɔmɔ, me nee wɔ bayɛ ngyekyeleɛ. Ɛ nee ɛ mra mrenya, nee ɛ ye, yɛɛ ɛ mra mrenya mraalɛ ne mɔ bavo ɛlɛne ne anu. 19-20Ɛbava nane biala nee debie biala mɔɔ twenle ɔ nwo aze la, nloma nee abɔdeɛ mɔɔ wɔ aleɛabo la amuala, ko biala nyinli nee belɛ, wɔahɔ ɛlɛne ne anu, amaa bɛanwu. 21Ɛbava aleɛ kɔsɔɔti bie wɔazie na bɛ nee nane nee nloma ne mɔ ali.” 22Nowa yɛle ɛhye mɔ na ɔyɛle debie biala mɔɔ Nyamenle zele ye la.

Title: MƆL 7
Content:
Azuyilɛ ne
1Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Nowa kɛ, “Ɛ nee wɔ sua nu amra amuala bɛvo ɛlɛne ne anu, ɔluakɛ menwu kɛ ɛ ngomekye ala a ɛdi pɛlepɛle wɔ ewiade ye amuala anu a. 2Fa nane ko biala mɔɔ anwo te la, nyinli nee belɛ nsuu, nuhua mɔɔ anwo ɛnde la, yemɔ fa nyinli nee belɛ ala. 3Fa nloma bɛdabɛ noko, ko biala nyinli nee belɛ nsuu. Sesa ɛhye mɔ amuala kɔ ɛlɛne ne anu, amaa nzinlii bɛanyia bɛ ɛsaso wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo amuala. 4Ɔluakɛ ɛnɛ anwo zo kenle nsuu, mebamaa ezule kpole bie adɔ nɔɔzo nee ewiazo kenle abulanla, azɛkye ninyɛne mɔɔ mebɔ la amuala.” 5Nowa yɛle debie biala mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma zele ye la.
6Nowa lile ɛvolɛ ɛya nsia la yɛɛ azuyilɛ ne rale a. 7 Ɔ nee ɔ ye nee ɔ mra mrenya nee bɛ mraalɛ ne mɔ hɔvole ɛlɛne ne anu, amaa azuyilɛ ne anva bɛ. 8Bɛvale nane nee nloma mɔɔ anwo te nee mɔɔ anwo ɛnde la, nee debie biala mɔɔ twenle ɔ nwo aze la, ko biala nyinli nee belɛ 9bɛhɔle ɛlɛne ne anu, kɛmɔ Nyamenle zele ye ala la. 10Ɛhye anzi kenle nsuu, azuyilɛ ne vale azɛlɛ ye.
11 Nowa lile ɛvolɛ ɛya nsia la, ye siane ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nwiɔ na ye kenle bulu nee nsuu ne azo, azule mgbole mɔɔ deda azɛlɛ ye azo la nee azɛlɛ ye abo nzule ne mɔ amuala gulule nu dukuele; na anwuma ezule noko dukuele, 12ɔdɔle bilididi nɔɔzo nee ewiazo toonwo kenle abulanla, ɔbule aze na ɔyɛle azɛlɛ ye azo faanwo. 13Kenle ko ne mɔɔ ezule ne dukuele la, Nowa nee ɔ ye nee ɔ mra mrenya ne mɔ, Hyɛm, Ham, yɛɛ Gyeefɛte nee bɛ mraalɛ nsa ne, 14nee nane ngakyile biala nee ye ɛsaso, nyɛmoa nee bɛ ɛsaso, debie biala mɔɔ twenle ɔ nwo aze wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo nee ye ɛsaso vole ɛlɛne ne anu. 15Ɔvale abɔdeɛ ngakyile ne mɔ mɔɔ die ɛnwomenle la ko biala, nyinli nee belɛ, 16kɛmɔ Nyamenle zele ye la ɔvole ɛlɛne ne anu. Na Ɛdɛnkɛma dole ɛlɛne ne anlenkɛ ne anu.
17Azuyilɛ ne hɔle zolɛ toonwo kenle abulanla, nzule ne yile kpole kpalɛ manle ɛlɛne ne tulule. 18Nzinlii nzule ne yile kpole na ɛlɛne ne luale nzule ne anye. 19Nzule ne hɔle zolɛ yɛle kuma, monlɔmonlanle awoka ndendenle ne mɔ mɔɔ wɔ aleɛabo la amuala. 20Nzule ne monlɔmonlanle awoka ne mɔ na ɔhɔle anwuma kɛyɛ mita nsuu. 21Abɔdeɛ biala mɔɔ wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo la, nloma, nyɛmoa, nanemgbole nee ngɛkɛba, yɛɛ menli kɔsɔɔti wule. 22Azɛlɛ resee zo debie biala mɔɔ die ɛnwomenle la wule, kokye anga. 23Ɛdɛnkɛma zɛkyele debie biala mɔɔ die ɛnwomenle mɔɔ wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo la, sonla, nane, debie biala mɔɔ twenle ɔ nwo aze, yɛɛ nloma. Nowa nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ ɛlɛne ne anu la ala a hale a. 24Ɔlile kenle kɔkɔlɛ ɛya ko abulanlu kolaa na nzule ne abɔ ɔ bo kɛ ɔsesa.

Title: MƆL 8
Content:
Azuyilɛ ne awieleɛ
1Nyamenle arɛle anvi Nowa nee nane nee nyɛmoa ne mɔ mɔɔ Nowa nee bɛ wɔ ɛlɛne ne anu la; ɔmanle anwoma bie vɛlɛle, na azule ne bɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɔsesa. 2Ɔzile nzudenle ne mɔ mɔɔ azɛlɛ bo nzule ne mɔ dua nu bu azɛlɛ ye azo la, ɔmanle maanle nu dele na ezule ne gyakyile ɛdɔlɛ. 3Akee nzule ne sesanle ngyikyi ngyikyi, na ɔkali kenle ɛya ko abulanlu la, ɛnee yesesa kpalɛ. 4Na siane nsuu ne anu, kenle ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ bulu nee nsuu la, ɛlɛne ne ranwenle Arelalate awoka ne mɔ ko azo. 5Nzule ne hɔle zolɛ sesanle, na ɔkadwu siane bulu ne kenle ne mɔɔ lumua la azo la, ɛnee awoka ne mɔ ati ɛvindevinde.
6Ɛhye anzi kenle abulanla ne azo, Nowa dukuele ɛlɛne ne nvɛnzɛlɛ ne mɔ ko, 7na ɔzoanle kɔkɔsɛlɛ. Kɔkɔsɛlɛ dule hɔle na yeanzia yeamba; ɔdule ɔkpɔsale ɔbɔle ahɔnlɔma toonwo ɔhɔkpulale mekɛ mɔɔ nzule ne wiele sesa bɔkɔɔ la. 8Eza Nowa zoanle abubule ɔdaye noko kɛ ɔhɔnlea saa nzule ne ɛsesa a; 9na abubule ne annyia ɛleka andɛnla, ɔluakɛ ɛnee nzule dɔɔnwo tɛbɔ aze. Ɔziale ɔhɔle ɛlɛne ne anwo, na Nowa dendenle ɔ sa hyele ye vale ye hɔle ɛlɛne ne anu. 10Nowa hendɛle kenle nsuu bieko na ɔzoanle abubule ne bieko. 11Ye nɔsolɛ nu, abubule ne ziale rale; ɔkara la ɔlɛ ɔlivi nya amolɛ ɔ nloa anu. Ɛhye manle Nowa nwunle kɛ nzule ne ɛwie sesa. 12Eza Nowa hendɛle kenle nsuu na ɔzoanle abubule ne bieko; ɛnɛ ɛdeɛ, abubule ne anzia amba.
13Nowa lile ɛvolɛ ɛya nsia ɛvolɛ ko la, kenle ne mɔɔ lumua siane ko ne anyunlu la, ɛnee nzule ne ɛwie sesa bɔkɔɔ. Nowa kpale ɛlɛne ne aze, ɔnleanle maanle nu na ɔnwunle kɛ akee azɛlɛ nwo ɛyɛ resee. 14Siane nwiɔ ne anu kenle ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ abulanwiɔ nee nsuu la ɛnee akee azɛlɛ nwo ɛyɛ resee kpalɛ.
15Na Nyamenle zele Nowa kɛ, 16“Ɛ nee ɛ ye nee ɛ mra nee bɛ mraalɛ ne mɔ bɛvi ɛlɛne ne anu bɛdwu aze. 17Fa debie biala mɔɔ ɛnwomenle wɔ ye nu la finde: nloma, nane nee debie biala mɔɔ twenle ɔ nwo aze la, amaa bɛanyia adenle bɛalɔ, bɛadɛlɛ azɛlɛ ye azo amuala.” 18Yemɔti Nowa nee ɔ ye nee ɔ mra nee bɛ mraalɛ ne mɔ vi ɛlɛne ne anu dwule aze. 19Bɛvindele nane nee nloma ne mɔ amuala, nee debie biala mɔɔ twenle ɔ nwo aze la, ko biala nee ye ɛsaso hɔle ye ekpunli ekpunli.
Nowa bɔ azu
20Nowa zile azukponle manle Ɛdɛnkɛma. Akee ɔhyele nane nee nloma ne mɔ mɔɔ anwo te la biala anu ko, ɔhunle bɛ na ɔyelale bɛ ɔbɔle azu wɔ azukponle ne azo ɔmanle Nyamenle. 21Nowa azu ne zɔle Ɛdɛnkɛma anye, na ɔzele kɛ, “Ɔvi ɛnɛ mɔɔ kɔ la menrɛdoa sonla nyɛleɛ menrɛmaa munzule mɔɔ le zɛhae la ɛnrɛha azɛlɛ ye bieko; menrɛzɛkye ewiade abɔdeɛ muala, kɛmɔ meyɛ la bieko. Meze kɛ sonla yemɔ, ye ngakula nu amuala ɛnee ye adwenle nee ye ahonle nu le bile. 22Noko suzuamgba ala mɔɔ ewiade tɛbɔ ɛkɛ la, bɛkɛlua, bɛkɛbu. Mekɛ biala maanle nu babɔ wuluwulu yɛɛ ɛyɛlɛ bara, wawaa nee fɔsɛlɛ bara, yɛɛ bɛkɛnyia alehyenlɛ nee aledwolɛ.”

Title: MƆL 9
Content:
Nyamenle nee Nowa ngyekyeleɛ ne
1 Nyamenle yilale Nowa nee ɔ mra ne mɔ na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛwo mralɛ dɔɔnwo na bɛ bo zo amra ɛyi azɛlɛ ye azo. 2Nane, nloma, ninyɛne mɔɔ twenle bɛ nwo aze nee fɛlɛ muala bazulo bɛ; meva bɛ muala mewula bɛ sa nu. 3Meva debie biala mɔɔ ɛnwomenle wɔ ye nu wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo la memaa bɛ kɛ bɛli. Kɛmɔ menvale mbaka nee ndile memanle bɛ kɛ bɛli la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ meva nane nee nloma nee fɛlɛ muala memaa bɛ a. Meva debie biala memaa bɛ. 4 Debie ko ala a metua bɛ kɛ bɛmmadi a, yemɔ a le nane mɔɔ mogya ne tɛbɔ nu la, ɔboalekɛ mogya ne anu a ye ngoane wɔ a. 5Awie biala mɔɔ kɛhu sonla, awie biala mɔɔ kɛhu ɔ diema, yɛɛ nane biala mɔɔ kɛhu sonla la, mebabiza ye mealie mogya ne wɔ ye ɛkɛ. 6 Nyamenle nleanle ɔdaye ye ɛsaso a ɔbɔle sonla a, ɛhye ati awie biala mɔɔ kɛhu sonla la bɛkɛhu ɔdaye.
7 “Bɛwo mralɛ dɔɔnwo, na bɛmaa bɛ nwo ɛzo wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo.”
8Akee Nyamenle zele Nowa nee ɔ mra ne mɔ kɛ, 9“Nea, me nee wɔ nee ɛ bo zo amra, 10tease abɔdeɛ biala, nloma, nyɛmoa nee azɛlɛ ye azo nane biala mɔɔ nee wɔ vi ɛlɛne ne anu dwule aze la yɛ ngyekyeleɛ. 11Me nee wɔ yɛ ngyekyeleɛ kɛ, ɔvi ɛnɛ mɔɔ kɔ la azuyilɛ ɛnrɛzɛkye abɔdeɛ muala bieko, yɛɛ azuyilɛ mɔɔ bazɛkye azɛlɛ ye la ɛnrɛra bieko. 12Sɛkɛlɛneɛ mɔɔ wɔ ngyekyeleɛ ɛhye anwo na ɔbala me nee ɛdawɔ nee tease abɔdeɛ biala avinli la a le kɛ, 13mebado me nyangondonle ne wɔ anwomanyunlu, na yemɔ yɛɛ bayɛ ngyekyeleɛ ne mɔɔ me nee ewiade amra ɛkyekye la anwo sɛkɛlɛneɛ a. 14Mekɛ biala mɔɔ maanle nu kɛmunla na nyangondonle kɛdo la, 15mebahakye ngyekyeleɛ ne mɔɔ me nee wɔ nee abɔdeɛ muala ɛkyekye la kɛ azuyilɛ ɛnrɛzɛkye ewiade abɔdeɛ ne mɔ amuala bieko ɛlɛ. 16Mekɛ biala mɔɔ nyangondonle kɛdo anwomanyunlu la, mebahakye zɛhae damɛnlangoate ngyekyeleɛ ye mɔɔ me nee azɛlɛ ye azo abɔdeɛ muala ɛkyekye la. 17Ngyekyeleɛ mɔɔ me nee aleɛabo tease abɔdeɛ muala ɛkyekye la anwo sɛkɛlɛneɛ ɛne.”
Nowa nee ɔ mra mrenya ne mɔ
18Nowa amra ne mɔ mɔɔ vi ɛlɛne ne anu dwule aze la a le Hyɛm, Ham, yɛɛ Gyeefɛte. (Ham ara a le Keena). 19Nowa amra mrenya nsa ɛhye mɔ anu a menli mɔɔ wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo la amuala kpokpoti vi a.
20Nowa le ɛyazonlɛnli. Ɔdaye a ɔlumuale ɔzonle ɛya na ɔyɛle vanye egyinli a. 21Ɔnlonle nwanye ne bie na ɔbole, ɔkpale ɔ nwo na ɔhɔlale ye ndanlɛ sua ne anu. 22Ham, mɔɔ ɔ ra a le Keena la, hɔnwunle kɛ ɔ ze lɛ ɔ nwo zɔ la, ɔvindele ɔhɔhanle ɔhilele ɔ mediema nwiɔ ne. 23Hyɛm nee Gyeefɛte vale ɛdanlɛ guale bɛ bati, na bɛhɔle bɛ nzi bɛ nzi toonwo bɛvale ɛdanlɛ ne bɛhɔguale bɛ ze anwo, amaa bɛannwu kɛ bɛ ze lɛ ɔ nwo zɔ. 24Nowa anye zo tetele ye na ɔdele mɔɔ ɔ ra nrenya ekyi ne ɛyɛ la, 25ɔhanle kɛ,
“Munzule ɛha Keena!
Ɔbayɛ ahanra nu kanra yeamaa ɔ mediema ne mɔ dahuu.
26Ɛdɛnkɛma me Nyamenle ne ɛyila Hyɛm.
Keena bayɛ Hyɛm kanranli dahuu.
27Nyamenle ɛmaa Gyeefɛte abo zo ɛdɛlɛ!
Ɔ bo zo amra nee Hyɛm abo zo amra ɛdɛnla!
Keena bayɛ Gyeefɛte kanranli.”
28Azuyilɛ ne anzi Nowa lile ɛvolɛ ɛya nsa abulanlu. 29Nowa lile ɛvolɛ ɛya ngɔnla abulanlu, na ɔwule.

Title: MƆL 10
Content:
Nowa amra mrenya ne mɔ abo zo amra
(1 Edk 1.5-23)
1Nowa amra mrenya Hyɛm, Ham, yɛɛ Gyeefɛte nee bɛ bo zo amra awolɛndoazo ne mɔ ɛne: Azuyilɛ ne anzi Nowa amra ne mɔ wole mralɛ mrenya.
2Gyeefɛte amra mrenya a le: Gomɛ, Meegɔgo, Meedae, Gyeevan, Tubale, Mihyɛke, yɛɛ Taelase. Bɛ bo zo amra a bɛfa bɛ aluma bɛfɛlɛ bɛ la. 3Gomɛ abo zo amra a le menli mɔɔ wɔ Ahyekinaze, Relaefate, yɛɛ Togama la. 4Gyeevan abo zo amra a le menli mɔɔ wɔ Yilaehya, Sepeen, Saepelɛse, yɛɛ Wulodese la. 5Bɛ bo zo amra a le bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdede ɛnweanloa nee mɔɔ dede nyevile ne anu bɔra ne mɔ azo la. Menli ɛhye mɔ amuala le Gyeefɛte abo zo amra. Bɛdɛnlɛdɛnlanle ye mbusua ekpulike ekpulike, asolo ekpulike ko biala maanle nee ye ɛdendɛlɛ.
6Ham amra mrenya a le Kɛhye, Yigyibiti, Lebea, yɛɛ Keena. Bɛ bo zo amra a bɛfa bɛ aluma bɛfɛlɛ bɛ la. 7Kɛhye abo zo amra a le menli mɔɔ wɔ Siba, Havelaa, Sabeta, Releeyamaa, yɛɛ Sabetika la. Releeyamaa abo zo amra a le menli mɔɔ wɔ Hyiba nee Didan la. 8Kɛhye wole Nemelɔdo. Yemɔ a ɔle sonla mɔɔ lumuale yɛle katakyie wɔ ewiade ye anu a. 9Ɔlua Ɛdɛnkɛma moalɛ zo Nemelɔdo yɛle bɔvolɛ kpole kpalɛ, yemɔti a bɛva bɛyɛ mgbanyidwɛkɛ kɛ “Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛmaa ɛyɛ bɔvolɛ kpole kɛ Nemelɔdo la.” 10Alumua ne ɛnee Ɛlɛke, Akade, yɛɛ Kaleni, azuamgbole nsa ɛhye mɔ mɔɔ wɔ Babelonia maanle nu la amuala boka Nemelɔdo maanle ne anwo. 11Ɔvi maanle zɔhane anu ɔhɔle Aselea ɔhɔkyekyele azuamgbole Nenɛvɛ, Rilihɔbo Ɛɛ, Keelaa, 12yɛɛ Relɛsɛn, mɔɔ wɔ Nenɛvɛ nee suakpole Keelaa avinli la. Keelaa le suakpole mɔɔ ɛlie duma a.
13Yigyibiti abo zo amra a le menli mɔɔ wɔ Ledea, Anam, Lɛheebe, Nafetu, 14Patulusu, Kaselu, yɛɛ Kiliti, mɔɔ Filisitiama vi bɛ nuhua la.
15Keena ara nrenya kpanyinli a le Saedɛn. Nzinlii ɔwole Hɛte, bɛ bo zo amra a bɛfa bɛ aluma bɛfɛlɛ bɛ la. 16Keena abo zo amra ne bie mɔ a le Gyibɛsema, Amɔlema, yɛɛ Gɛgahyema. 17Havaema, Akaema, Saenaema, 18Avadema, Zɛmalema, yɛɛ Heematema. Keena abusua ekpulike ekpulike ne mɔ dɛlɛle, 19manle Keenama ɛweɛne ne anloa dwule Saedɛn nyiakɛ mɔɔ kɔ Gilaa mɔɔ zua Gaza la, eza ɔdɛlɛle ɔhɔle aduduleɛ ɔhɔdwule Sodɔm, Gomɔla, Ademaa, yɛɛ Zɛboyem mɔɔ zua Leehya la. 20Menli ɛhye mɔ amuala le Ham abo zo amra. Bɛdɛnlɛdɛnlanle ye mbusua ekpulike ekpulike, asolo ekpulike ko biala maanle nee ye ɛdendɛlɛ.
21Gyeefɛte adiema kpanyinli Hyɛm ɔdaye ɔ bo zo amra a le Hibuluma amuala. 22Hyɛm amra mrenya ne mɔ a le Yilam, Ahyɛ, Apakyehyade, Lɛɛde, yɛɛ Ɛlam. Bɛ bo zo amra a bɛfa bɛ aluma bɛfɛlɛ bɛ la. 23Ɛlam abo zo amra a le menli mɔɔ wɔ Ɛɛze, Hɛle, Gitɛ, yɛɛ Mɛhyɛke la. 24Apakyehyade ara a le Hyila, yɛɛ Hyila ara a le Yibɛ. 25Yibɛ wole mrenya nwiɔ, bɛfɛlɛ ko Pilɛge, ɔluakɛ ye mekɛ zo a ewiade amra anu kpakyekpakyele a, yɛɛ bɛfɛlɛ ko ne Dwɔketan. 26Dwɔketan abo zo amra a le menli mɔɔ wɔ Alemodade, Hyilɛfe, Heezameevɛte, Gyilaa, 27Hadɔlam, Yuzale, Dekelaa, 28Ɔbale, Abemeeyɛle, Hyiba 29Ofɛ, Havelaa, yɛɛ Dwobabe la. Ɛhye mɔ amuala le Dwɔketan abo zo amra. 30Bɛ azɛlɛ mɔɔ bɛdɛnlanle zolɛ la tɛlɛ vi Mihya kɔdwu Sifaa wɔ aduduleɛ maanle ne awoka ne mɔ anu. 31Hyɛm abo zo amra ɛne. Bɛdɛnlɛdɛnlanle ye mbusua ekpulike ekpulike, asolo ekpulike ko biala maanle nee ye ɛdendɛlɛ.
32Nowa amra ne abo zo amra, kɛmɔ bɛ mbusua ekpulike ekpulike ne mɔ de la ɛne. Azuyilɛ ne anzi bɛdele bɛkpondenle ewiade na bɛkyekyele maanle maanle bɛdɛnlɛdɛnlanle nu. Maanle ko biala anu amra le abusua ekpulike ko.

Title: MƆL 11
Content:
Babelɔn Tawa ne
1Alumua ne ɛnee ewiade amra amuala ka aneɛ ko, yɛɛ bɛ ɛdendɛlɛ le ko. 2Na bɛvi aduduleɛ bɛdule bɛ bo la, bɛradwule Babelonia azɛlɛ sɛsɛ bie azo na bɛdɛnlanle ɛkɛ. 3Nzinlii bɛhanle bɛhilele bɛ nwo ngoko kɛ, “Bɛrɛla! Bɛmaa yɛva ɛva yɛgua belekese, na yɛdo yɛmaa bɛyɛ ketekete.” Amgba bɛguale ɛva belekese bɛdonle bɛmanle bɛyɛle ketekete na bɛvale bɛmɛ bɛyɛle awolɛ, yɛɛ bɛnyianle bilewu mɔɔ bɛfa bɛasosɔ ayia ne mɔ azo la. 4Akee bɛzele kɛ, “Bɛmaa yɛkyekye suakpole ko na yɛzi tawa tendendenlenle ko mɔɔ kɔkpula Nyamenle ne ako abo nehane la, amaa yɛalie duma na yeamkponde azɛlɛ ye azo.”
5Ɛdɛnkɛma dwule aze rakpɔlale suakpole ne mɔɔ bɛkyekye nee tawa tendendenlenle ne mɔɔ sonla ɛzi la. 6Na ɔhanle kɛ, “Bɛnlea, kɛkala, bɛle menli ko, yɛɛ bɛ aneɛ le ko; ɛhye le mɔɔ kenle bie bɛbayɛ la mɔlebɛbo. Ɔnrɛhyɛ, bɛbahola bɛayɛ debie biala mɔɔ bɛkɛze kɛ bɛyɛ la. 7Bɛmaa yɛhɔkpɔtɔ bɛ ɛdendɛlɛ ne, amaa bɛande bɛ nwo aneɛ bieko.” 8Yemɔti Ɛdɛnkɛma manle bɛkpondenle bɛhɔle azɛlɛ ye azo ɛleka biala, na bɛgyakyile suakpole ne ɛkyekyelɛ. 9Bɛvɛlɛle suakpole ne Babelɔn, ɔboalekɛ ɛkɛ ne a Ɛdɛnkɛma manle menli ne aneɛ yɛle ngakyile ngakyile na ɔmanle bɛkpondenle azɛlɛ ye azo amuala a.
Hyɛm abo zo amra
(1 Edk 1.24-27)
10Hyɛm abo zo amra ɛne. Azuyilɛ ne anzi ɛvolɛ nwiɔ, mɔɔ ɛnee Hyɛm ɛli ɛvolɛ ɛya ko la, ɔwole ralɛ nrenya na ɔdonle ye Apakyehyade. 11Ɛhye anzi, Hyɛm dɛnlanle aze ɛvolɛ ɛya nnu na ɔwole mralɛ mrenya nee mraalɛ.
12Apakyehyade lile ɛvolɛ abulasa nee nnu la, ɔwole ɔ ra nrenya Hyila. 13Ɛhye anzi, Apakyehyade dɛnlanle aze ɛvolɛ ɛya nna ɛvolɛ nsa, na ɔwole mralɛ mrenya nee mraalɛ.
14Hyila lile ɛvolɛ abulasa la, ɔwole ɔ ra nrenya Yibɛ. 15Ɛhye anzi, Hyila dɛnlanle aze ɛvolɛ ɛya nna ɛvolɛ nsa, na ɔwole mralɛ mrenya nee mraalɛ.
16Yibɛ lile ɛvolɛ abulasa nee nna la, ɔwole ɔ ra nrenya Pilɛge. 17Ɛhye anzi, Yibɛ dɛnlanle aze ɛvolɛ ɛya nna abulasa, na ɔwole mralɛ mrenya nee mraalɛ.
18Pilɛge lile ɛvolɛ abulasa la, ɔwole ɔ ra nrenya Riliwu. 19Ɛhye anzi, Pilɛge dɛnlanle aze ɛvolɛ ɛya nwiɔ ɛvolɛ ngɔnla, na ɔwole mralɛ mrenya nee mraalɛ.
20Riliwu lile ɛvolɛ abulasa nee nwiɔ la, ɔwole ɔ ra nrenya Silɛge. 21Ɛhye anzi, Riliwu dɛnlanle aze ɛvolɛ ɛya nwiɔ ɛvolɛ nsuu, na ɔwole mralɛ mrenya nee mraalɛ.
22Silɛge lile ɛvolɛ abulasa la, ɔwole ɔ ra nrenya Neehɔ. 23Ɛhye anzi, Silɛge dɛnlanle aze ɛvolɛ ɛya nwiɔ, na ɔwole mralɛ mrenya nee mraalɛ.
24Neehɔ lile ɛvolɛ abulanwiɔ nee ngɔnla la, ɔwole ɔ ra nrenya Tilaa. 25Ɛhye anzi, Neehɔ dɛnlanle aze ɛvolɛ ɛya ko ɛvolɛ bulu nee ngɔnla, na ɔwole mralɛ mrenya nee mraalɛ.
26Tilaa lile ɛvolɛ abulasuu kolaa na yeawo ɔ mra mrenya Ebilam, Neehɔ, yɛɛ Hɛlan.
Tilaa abo zo amra
27Tilaa, mɔɔ wole Ebilam, Neehɔ, yɛɛ Hɛlan la abo zo amra ɛne: Hɛlan wole Lɔɔto. 28Hɛlan wule kolaa na ɔ ze Tilaa awu. Ɔwule ɔdaye ye maanle nu, suakpole ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Yule mɔɔ wɔ Babelonia maanle nu la azo. 29Ebilam gyale Sɛleeyae, yɛɛ Neehɔ gyale Melekaa, mɔɔ ɔ ze a le Hɛlan la. Hɛlan a wole Yesakaa a. 30Sɛleeyae yɛle mota; yeanwo ralɛ.
31Tilaa vale ɔ ra nrenya Ebilam, ye anlɔnra Lɔɔto, mɔɔ ɔ ze a le Hɛlan la yɛɛ ɔ ra Ebilam aye Sɛleeyae na bɛvile bɛ sua zo Yule, mɔɔ wɔ Babelonia maanle nu la kɛ bɛkɔ Keena azɛlɛ zo. Noko mɔɔ bɛhɔdwule Hɛlan la, bɛhale ɛkɛ ne bɛdɛnlanle. 32Ɛkɛ ne a Tilaa wule a; ɔlile ɛvolɛ ɛya nwiɔ ɛvolɛ nnu.

Title: MƆL 12
Content:
Nyamenle fɛlɛ Ebilam
1 Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Ebilam kɛ, “Ɛvi wɔ maanle ye anu tu, ye ɛ nwo fi ɛ ze sua nu nee ɛ nwo amra avinli, na kɔ azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ mebahile wɔ la azo. 2Mebayila wɔ, meamaa wɔayɛ sonlakpole, ɛ bo zo amra adɛlɛ ayɛ maanle kpole, na ɛ nwo ayɛ aso.
3 Mebayila bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛyila wɔ la,
Na meamaa munzule ado mɔɔ kɛzuzu munzule kɛmaa wɔ la;
Na ɔlua ɛ nwo zo nyilalɛ aha maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti mɔɔ wɔ ewiade la.”
4Yemɔti Ebilam hɔle, kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛze ye la; na Lɔɔto nee ye hɔle. Ebilam lile ɛvolɛ abulasuu nee nnu la, yɛɛ ɔvile Hɛlan a. 5Na ɔvale ɔ ye Sɛleeyae, ɔ diema nrenya ara Lɔɔto, yɛɛ bɛ nwo ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti mɔɔ bɛlɛ, nee menli mɔɔ bɛnyia bɛ wɔ Hɛlan la amuala, na bɛzile nu kɛ bɛkɔ Keena azɛlɛ zo.
Bɛhɔdwule Keena azɛlɛ zo la, 6Ebilam telele zolɛ hɔle Moli oku baka ne abo wɔ Hyikɛm. Mekɛ ne anu ɛnee Keenama wɔ azɛlɛ ne azo. 7 Akee Ɛdɛnkɛma yele ɔ nwo hilele Ebilam, na ɔzele ye kɛ, “Mebava azɛlɛ ɛhye meamaa ɛ bo zo amra.” Yemɔti Ebilam zile azukponle wɔ ɛkɛ ne manle Ɛdɛnkɛma, mɔɔ ɛye ɔ nwo ɛhile ye la. 8Akee ɔvi ɛkɛ ne ɔhɔle boka bie mɔɔ wɔ Bɛtɛle aduduleɛ la azo na ɔbɔle aseseɛ wɔ ɛkɛ ne. Ɛnee Bɛtɛle ɛha ye adɔleɛ yɛɛ Eyae wɔ ye aduduleɛ. Ɔzile azukponle wɔ ɛkɛ ne ɔmanle Ɛdɛnkɛma na ɔzonlenle ye. 9Na Ebilam zɔle ye adendulɛ ne azo, ɔhɔle ɔ nyunlu wɔ Keena nyiakɛ afoa nu.
Ebilam wɔ Yigyibiti
10Akee ɛhɔne zile Keena azɛlɛ zo. Yemɔti Ebilam hɔdɛnlanle Yigyibiti, ɔluakɛ ɛhɔne ne mɔɔ zile azɛlɛ ne azo la le kpole kpalɛ. 11Mɔɔ ɔka ekyii na Ebilam adwu Yigyibiti maanle ne anu la, ɔzele ɔ ye Sɛleeyae kɛ, “Meze kɛ ɛle raalɛ mɔɔ anwo yɛ fɛ a. 12Saa Yigyibitima nwu wɔ ala a, bɛbanwu kɛ me ye a le wɔ; bɛbahu me na bɛagyakyi wɔ. 13Yemɔti anrɛɛ ka kɛ ɛle me diema raalɛ, amaa wɔmɔ ti, bɛanlea me boɛ, na bɛangu me.” 14Mɔɔ Ebilam dwule Yigyibiti la, Yigyibitima nwunle kɛ raalɛ ne anwo yɛ fɛ kpalɛ. 15Yemɔti mɔɔ Yigyibiti belemgbunli ne mgbanyima ne mɔ nwunle ye la, bɛhanvole ye bɛhilele belemgbunli ne. Bɛravale raalɛ ne bɛhɔle belemgbunli ne sua nu. 16Na ɔlua yemɔ ɔ ti belemgbunli nee Ebilam lile ye kɛnlɛma; ɔmanle ye mboane, nlankɛ, asoaso nyinli nee mbelɛ, mraalɛ nee mrenya sonvolɛma, yɛɛ afunlumu mɔ.
17Noko Ebilam aye Sɛleeyae ati, Ɛdɛnkɛma manle ewule nzane bie radɔle Yigyibiti belemgbunli ne sua nu. 18Yemɔti belemgbunli ne vɛlɛle Ebilam na ɔbizale ye kɛ, “Duzu debie a wɔyɛ la? Duzu ati a wɔanga wɔangile me kɛ ɔle ɛ ye ɛ? 19Duzu ati a ɛhanle kɛ ɛ diema raalɛ a, mɔɔ anrɛɛ ɛmaa meava ye meayɛ me ye ɛ? Ɛ ye ne ɛne, fa ye na ɛ nee ye bɛhɔ.” 20Na Yigyibiti belemgbunli ne manle ye menli ne dole ye nee ɔ ye adenle zo, na ɔvale mɔɔ ɔnyianle la amuala ɔhɔle.

Title: MƆL 13
Content:
Ebilam nee Lɔɔto avinli tete
1Na Ebilam vale ɔ ye, yɛɛ Lɔɔto nee debie biala mɔɔ ɔlɛ la vile Yigyibiti, na ɔhɔle Keena nyiakɛ. 2Ebilam yɛle sukuavolɛ kpole kpalɛ, ɔlɛ nyɛmoa, dwɛtɛ fufule, yɛɛ ezukoa nvutuke. 3Na ɔluoluale nyiakɛ lɔ toonwo ɔhɔdwule Bɛtɛle, ɛleka mɔɔ ɔlumuale ɔbɔle ye aseseɛ ne la, wɔ Bɛtɛle nee Eyae avinli. 4Ɔhɔle ɛleka ne mɔɔ ɔlumuale ɔzile ye azukponle ne la, na ɔzonlenle Ɛdɛnkɛma.
5Lɔɔto noko mɔɔ nee Ebilam hɔle la, ɔdaye ɔnyianle mboane, mbɔnkye, nlankɛ, yɛɛ ndanlɛ azua. 6Yemɔti ɔrale kɛ ɛnee akee bɛ mu nwiɔ bɛnzo azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ bɛde zolɛ la azo. Ɔluakɛ bɛ mu nwiɔ bɛ anwonyia ne mɔ ɛyɛ mgbole yɛɛ eza bɛ nwo ɛzo. 7Yemɔti ɔngyɛ ɛnee kpolera ɛdɔ bɛ mu nwiɔ bɛ menli mɔɔ nea bɛ nyɛmoa ne mɔ la avinli. (Mekɛ ne anu ɛnee Pɛlɛzema nee Keenama wɔ azɛlɛ ne azo.)
8Ebilam zele Lɔɔto kɛ, “Mmamaa yɛmaa kpolera tɔ yɛ mu nwiɔ yɛ avinli, anzɛɛ wɔ menli nee me menli mɔɔ nea yɛ nyɛmoa ne mɔ la avinli, ɔboalekɛ yɛle abusua ko. 9Azɛlɛ tɛtɛtɛlɛlɛ a la yɛ nyunlu lɔ la. Te ɛ nwo. Saa ɛkɔ bɛne zo a, mebahɔ fema zo, yɛɛ saa ɛkɔ fema zo noko a, mebahɔ bɛne zo.”
10 Lɔɔto dole ɔ nye nleanle azɛlɛ ne na ɔnwunle kɛ Dwɔdan Bɔnza ne anu, toonwo mɔɔ kɔdwu Zowaa la lɛ nzule dɔɔnwo kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma tola ne anu nee Yigyibiti azɛlɛ zo la. (Mekɛ ne anu ɛnee Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛtɛsɛkyele azuamgbole Sodɔm nee Gomɔla.) 11Na Lɔɔto vale Dwɔdan Bɔnza na ɔvale ɔ ti ɔbɔle aduduleɛ ɔdele ɔ nwo ɔvile Ebilam anwo. 12Ebilam dɛnlanle Keena azɛlɛ zo, na Lɔɔto hɔdɛnlanle azuamgbole ne mɔ mɔɔ wɔ Bɔnza ne anu la bie mɔ azo na akee ɔdule ɔhɔdɛnlanle Sodɔm. 13Sodɔmma le amumuyɛ; bɛyɛle ɛtane mgbole bɛtiale Ɛdɛnkɛma.
Ebilam tu ahɔ Hibulɔn
14Mɔɔ Lɔɔto dele ɔ nwo vile Ebilam anwo la, Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Ebilam kɛ, “Gyinla ɛleka mɔɔ ɛwɔ la, na maa ɛ nye zo nea ɛbɔ nu afoa nu, nyevile nu afoa nu, yɛɛ aduduleɛ nee adɔleɛ afoa nu, 15 ɔluakɛ mebava azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ ɛ nye dua ye la amuala meamaa wɔ nee ɛ bo zo amra, meamaa yeayɛ bɛ ɛdeɛ bɔkɔɔ. 16Mebamaa ɛ bo zo amra azo kɛ ɛnwea, mɔɔ bɛnrɛhola bɛ tia a. 17Dwazo na kpɔsa kɔ azɛlɛ ne ati nee ɔ bo, kpɔsa nwu azɛlɛ ne tɛtɛlɛ nee ye tendenle, ɔluakɛ mebava meamaa wɔ.” 18Yemɔti Ebilam dudule ye ndanlɛ sua ne na ɔhɔdɛnlanle Mameli oku mbaka ne mɔ mɔɔ wɔ Hibulɔn la anwo. Na ɛkɛ ne, ɔzile azukponle ɔmanle Ɛdɛnkɛma.

Title: MƆL 14
Content:
Ebilam die Lɔɔto ngoane
1Arelemgbunli nna ɛhye mɔ, Babelonia Belemgbunli Ameleefɛle, Ɛleesaa Belemgbunli Aleyɔko, Yilam Belemgbunli Kɛdɔleewomɛ, yɛɛ Goyem Belemgbunli Taedale, 2nee arelemgbunli nnu bie nyianle konle. Arelemgbunli nnu ne mɔ a le Sodɔm Belemgbunli Bila, Gomɔla Belemgbunli Bɛhya, Adomaa Belemgbunli Hyaenabe, Zɛboyem Belemgbunli Hyɛmibɛ, yɛɛ Bila anzɛɛ Zowaa belemgbunli ne. 3Arelemgbunli nnu ɛhye mɔ vale bɛ ɛlɔnema bɔle nu wɔ Sedem Bɔnza, mɔɔ ɛnɛ bɛfɛlɛ ye Nyevile Wulera la. 4Ɛnee arelemgbunli nnu ɛhye mɔ wɔ Belemgbunli Kɛdɔleewomɛ abo, bɛzonle ye toonwo ɛvolɛ bulu nee nwiɔ. Ye ɛvolɛ bulu nee nsa ne anu, bɛdele atua. 5Ye ɛvolɛ bulu nee nna ne anu Belemgbunli Kɛdɔleewomɛ nee arelemgbunli mɔɔ ɔ nee bɛ lɛ konle nu agɔnwolɛyɛlɛ la vale bɛ ɛlɔne hɔhanle Relɛfeeyemma mɔɔ wɔ Ahyetɛlo Kaneeyem, Zuzemma mɔɔ wɔ Ham, yɛɛ Yimemma mɔɔ wɔ Hyeevi Keleateeyem la senle dwɛɛ lile bɛ nwo zo konim. 6Eza bɛhanle Hɔlaema mɔɔ wɔ Yidɔm awoka ne mɔ azo la senle, na bɛvoanle bɛ toonwo bɛhɔdwule Ɛlepɛlan, mɔɔ wɔ ɛsɛlɛ ne anloa la, 7na bɛziale bɛ nzi bɛrale Keedɛhye mɔɔ ɛnee bɛfɛlɛ ye Ɛnemehyepate la, bɛrahanle Amalɛkema nee Amɔlema mɔɔ de Heezazɔn Teemaa la senle, bɛlile bɛ muala bɛ nwo zo konim.
8-9Na Sodɔm, Gomɔla, Ademaa, Zɛboyem, yɛɛ Bila arelemgbunli vale bɛ ɛlɔnema dwazole na bɛ nee Yilam Belemgbunli Kɛdɔleewomɛ, Babelonia Belemgbunli Ameleefɛle, Ɛleesaa Belemgbunli Aleyɔko, yɛɛ Goyem Belemgbunli Taedale ɛlɔnema ne bɔle ye zo wɔ Sedem Bɔnza. Bɛle arelemgbunli nnu yɛɛ bɛ nee arelemgbunli nna ɛlɛko a. 10Sedem Bɔnza ne anu le bilewu ahuma ngome, yemɔti mɔɔ Sodɔm nee Gomɔla arelemgbunli nriandi ahɔ la, bɛhɔfolofolole ahuma ne bie mɔ anu, na arelemgbunli mɔɔ hale la nriandile hɔle awoka ne mɔ azo. 11Yemɔti ɛlɔnema ne sesale Sodɔmma nee Gomɔlama ninyɛne ne kɔsɔɔti nee bɛ aleɛ hɔle. 12Eza bɛhyele Lɔɔto, mɔɔ le Ebilam adiema nrenya ne ara nrenya ne, mɔɔ ɛnee de Sodɔm la, na bɛvale ye nee ɔ nwo ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti bɛhɔle.
13Na awie ko mɔɔ vile ɛsalɛ la nriandile rahanle hilele Hibulunli Ebilam. Ebilam ɛnee de ɛleka bie mɔɔ bikye Amɔlenli Mameli oku mbaka ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛyɛ ɛzonlenlɛ wɔ bɛ bo la. Mameli amediema mrenya a le Ɛhyekɔlo nee Enɛ, yɛɛ bɛmɛ nsa bɛle Ebilam konle nu agɔnwolɛma. 14Ebilam dele kɛ bɛhye ye awozoa ne nuokɛ bɛ nee ye ɛlɛkɔ la, ɔvale ye menli ɛya nsa bulu nee mɔtwɛ ne mɔɔ wɔ ye sua nu ɛkɛ mɔɔ yetete bɛ wɔ konle nu la, na ɔ nee bɛ voanle arelemgbunli nna ne toonwo ɔhɔdwule Dan. 15Ɔhyɛle ye ɛlɔnema ne anu na ɔvale bɛ ɔhɔle ye kpɔvolɛma ne anwo zo nɔɔzo, ɔtetale bɛ na ɔvoanle bɛ toonwo ɔhɔdwule Hobaa, wɔ Dɛmasekɛse sɔlɔ. 16Akee ɔvale ninyɛne ne amuala, ye busuanli Lɔɔto nee ɔ nwo ninyɛne, mraalɛ ne mɔ nee menli mɔɔ bɛhyele bɛ nuokɛ la amuala ɔziale ɔrale.
Mɛlekezɛdɛke Yila Ebilam
17Mekɛ mɔɔ Ebilam vi konle ne mɔɔ ɔlile Belemgbunli Kɛdɔleewomɛ nee arelemgbunli mɔɔ nee ye lua la anwo zo konim la anloa ziale rale la, Sodɔm belemgbunli ne hɔyiale ye wɔ Hyeevi Bɔnza, (mɔɔ eza bɛfɛlɛ ye “Belemgbunli Bɔnza” la). 18 Na Seelɛm Belemgbunli Mɛlekezɛdɛke rɛlɛle ye kpanwo nee nwanye. Mɛlekezɛdɛke le Anwuma Anwuma Nyamenle ne sɛlɛvolɛ. 19Na ɔyilale Ebilam ɔzele kɛ, “Ebilam, Anwuma Anwuma Nyamenle ne, mɔɔ bɔle anwuma nee aze la ɛyila wɔ. 20Ayɛlɛyelɛ ɛha Anwuma Anwuma Nyamenle ne mɔɔ ɛye wɔ kpɔvolɛma ne ɛmaa wɔli bɛ nwo zo konim la.” Na Ebilam hyɛle debie biala mɔɔ ɔnyianle la anu bulu na ɔdule ɛkpɔ ko ɔmanle Mɛlekezɛdɛke.
21Na Sodɔm belemgbunli ne zele Ebilam kɛ, “Fa menli ne mɔ maa me, na fa ninyɛne ne mɔ yɛ wɔ ɛdeɛ.”
22Ebilam zele Sodɔm belemgbunli ne kɛ, “Meha ndane mehile Ɛdɛnkɛma, Anwuma Anwuma Nyamenle ne mɔɔ bɔle anwuma nee aze la, 23kɛ menrɛva nyɛma anzɛɛ mgbɔlaboa zo nyɛma mɔɔ le wɔ ɛdeɛ la, na wɔanyia adenle wɔaha kɛ, ‘Medame a memaa Ebilam ɛnyia ɔ nwo a.’ 24Menrɛva ɛhwee kɛ mɔɔ me ɛlɔnema ne ɛli la, yɛɛ menli mɔɔ nee me hɔle la afoa nu ɛdeɛ ne ala. Yemɔti maa Enɛ, Ɛhyekɔlo, yɛɛ Mameli ɛva bɛ afoa nu ɛdeɛ mɔɔ wɔ nu la.”

Title: MƆL 15
Content:
Ngyekyeleɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle nee Ebilam yɛle la
1Ɛhye mɔ anzi, Ebilam dele Ɛdɛnkɛma edwɛkɛ ne wɔ ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ nu kɛ, “Ebilam, mmasulo, na mebabɔ ɛ nwo bane. Wɔ ahatualɛ bayɛ kpole kpalɛ.”
2Ebilam hanle kɛ, “O Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle, duzu yɛɛ ɛbava wɔamaa me a, ɔluakɛ menlɛ ralɛ, yɛɛ sonla mɔɔ kɛkala bali me agya la a le Ɛleyizɛ mɔɔ vi Dɛmasekɛse la. 3Ɛtɛmanle metɛwole; kanranli mɔɔ bɛwo ye me sua nu ɛke la a bali me agya a.”
4Na Ebilam dele kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛlɛtendɛ ahile ye bieko kɛ, “Nrenya ɛhye ɛnrɛli wɔ agya. Ɛdawɔ ɛ kunlu ralɛ nrenya a bali wɔ agya a.” 5 Akee Ɛdɛnkɛma vale ye vindele na ɔzele ye kɛ, “To ɛ nye anwomanyunlu na nea saa ɛkɛhola nwɔlɔra ne mɔ tia a. Zɔhane ala yɛɛ ɛ bo zo amra bayɛ a.”
6 Ebilam liele Ɛdɛnkɛma lile, na ɛhye manle ɔzɔle Ɛdɛnkɛma anye na ɔliele ye ɔdole nu.
7Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Ebilam kɛ, “Medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma mɔɔ nee wɔ vi Yule mɔɔ wɔ Babelonia la rale kɛ mefa azɛlɛ ɛhye meamaa wɔ kɛ wɔ ɛdeɛ ɔ la.”
8Na Ebilam bizale kɛ, “O Awulae Nyamenle, na kɛ menwɔzi menwɔyɛ na meanwu kɛ azɛlɛ ne bayɛ me ɛdeɛ ɛ?”
9Ɛdɛnkɛma buale kɛ, “Fa ɛnlankɛ mɔɔ ɛli ɛvolɛ nsa, abɔnkye belɛ mɔɔ ɛli ɛvolɛ nsa, boane nyinli mɔɔ ɛli ɛvolɛ nsa, abubule yɛɛ mɔlɔnoma kakula bɛla.” 10Ebilam sesale bɛ rale, ɔhunle bɛ ɔkpukekpukele bɛ nu nwiɔ nwiɔ, na ɔvale ko biala ebule ɔdole ye ebule ko ne anwo. Nloma ne mɔ ɛdeɛ, yeamkpukekpuke bɛ nu nwiɔ nwiɔ. 11Saa nloma mɔɔ di nane funli la ba nwolɛ a, ɛnee yevoa bɛ.
12Sɛnzɛne ne ɛlɛkɔ ahɔdɔ la, nafelɛ kpole vale Ebilam, na awozinli kpole anu ɛzulolɛ bie rahedale ɔ nwo zo. 13Na Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Ebilam kɛ, “Nwu ye wienyi kɛ ɛ bo zo amra badu adenle ahɔ azɛlɛ bie mɔɔ ɛnle bɛ ɛdeɛ la azo na bɛahɔyɛ ahanra wɔ ɛkɛ. Bɛbasisi bɛ toonwo ɛvolɛ ɛya nna, 14 na nzinlii mebadea maanle ne mɔɔ bɛbahɔzonle ye la, na bɛbava anwonyia dɔɔnwo bɛavi maanle zɔhane anu bɛahɔ. 15Wɔmɔ ɛdeɛ, ɛbava anzonudwolɛ wɔahɔ wɔ ɛkɛla nzi. Ɛbanyi wɔayɛ kpanyinli kpalɛ na wɔawu. 16Ɛ bo zo amra awolɛndoazo fane nna ne azo amra bazia ara ɛke, ɔluakɛ Amɔlema amumuyɛ ne ɛtɛwiele munli di mɔɔ metea bɛ a.”
17Mɔɔ sɛnzɛne ne dɔle na maanle nu yɛle awozinli la, senle siase mɔɔ ɛlɛkpu esike nee tɛkɛ mɔɔ ɛlɛsɔ gbolamgbolam la razenle nane ebule ebule ne mɔ avinli. 18Na kenle ko ne Ɛdɛnkɛma nee Ebilam yɛle ngyekyeleɛ. Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Ebilam kɛ, “Meva azɛlɛ ɛhye memaa ɛ bo zo amra. Azɛlɛ ne vi Yigyibiti ɛweɛne zo kɔdwu Azukpole Yufileti ne anloa. 19Kinama, Kinaezema, Kademma, 20Hɛtema, Pɛlɛzema, Relɛfeeyemma, 21Amɔlema, Keenama, Gɛgahyema, yɛɛ Gyibɛsema azɛlɛ ne mɔ amuala boka nwolɛ.”

Title: MƆL 16
Content:
Heega nee Yehyemeeyɛle
1Ebilam aye Sɛleeyae anwo ralɛ. Ɔlɛ ye Yigyibitinli sonvolɛ raalɛ bie, bɛfɛlɛ ye Heega. 2Na Sɛleeyae hanle hilele Ebilam kɛ, “Nea, Ɛdɛnkɛma ammaa meanwo. Yemɔti ɛ nee me sonvolɛ raalɛ ne ɛhɔla. Wɔannea a ɔkɛyɛ kɛ yemɔ ɔbawo mralɛ yeamaa me.” Na Ebilam diele ɔ ye Sɛleeyae ane. 3Yemɔti mɔɔ Ebilam lile ɛvolɛ bulu wɔ Keena azɛlɛ zo la, ɔ ye Sɛleeyae vale ye Yigyibitinli sonvolɛ raalɛ ne manle ɔ hu yɛle ɔ ye. 4Ebilam nee Heega lale, na ɔnrenzɛle. Na mɔɔ Heega nwunle kɛ yenrenzɛ la, ɛnee akee ɔmbu ɔ menle raalɛ ne bie.
5Na Sɛleeyae zele Ebilam kɛ, “Abule mɔɔ ɛbu me la ɛbu ɛdawɔ. Menvale me sonvolɛ raalɛ memanle wɔ kɛ ɛ nee ye bɛla, na yenwu kɛ yenrenzɛ la, akee yeyɛ mɔɔ ɔwowɔ me nye mbaka a! Ɛdɛnkɛma ɔdaye ɔbua yɛ mu nwiɔ ndɛne!”
6Ebilam buale ye kɛ, “Ayi, wɔ sonvolɛ raalɛ ne wɔ ɛ sa nu, debie biala mɔɔ fɛta la fa yɛ ye.” Yemɔti Sɛleeyae hilele Heega abodelɛ, na ɔnriandile.
7Ɛdɛnkɛma soanvolɛ hɔdole ye wɔ ɛsɛlɛ ne azo nzubula bie mɔɔ wɔ Hyulu adenle zo la anwo, 8na ɔbizale ye kɛ, “Sɛleeyae sonvolɛ raalɛ Heega, nienwu a ɛvi wɔra ɛke a, yɛɛ nienwu ɛleka a ɛlɛkɔ a?”
Ɔbuale ye kɛ, “Melɛnriandi meavi me menle raalɛ Sɛleeyae anwo.”
9Ɛdɛnkɛma soanvolɛ ne zele ye kɛ, “Sia kɔ ɛ menle raalɛ ne anwo lɔ na kɔyɛ bɛlɛvolɛ maa ye.” 10Eza Ɛdɛnkɛma soanvolɛ ne zele ye kɛ, “Mebamaa ɛ bo zo amra azo mɔɔ awie biala ɛnrɛhola bɛ tia a. 11Nea, ɛlɛnrenzɛ, ɛbawo ralɛ nrenya na wɔado ye duma, Yehyemeeyɛle; ɔboalekɛ Nyamenle ɛde wɔ nyane ɛzunlɛ ne. 12Ɔbayɛ nrenya mɔɔ ye subane bayɛ kɛ asoaso mɔɔ bɛtɛtetele ye la. Ɔbahyi awie biala, yɛɛ awie biala bahyi ye, na ɔ nee ɔ nwo amra biala ɛnrɛdɛnla.”
13Na Heega hanle kɛ, “Asoo amgba menwu Nyamenle anyunlu na metɛte aze?” Na ɔvɛlɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma mɔɔ nee ye dendɛle la, “Nyamenle mɔɔ nwu me la.” 14Zɔhane ati bɛvɛlɛle nzubula ne Biyɛleehaelɔe (Ɔ bo a le “Teasenli ne mɔɔ nwu me la Bula.”) Ɔwɔ Keedɛhye nee Bilɛde avinli.
15 Heega nee Ebilam wole ralɛ nrenya na Ebilam donle ye Yehyemeeyɛle. 16Mɔɔ Heega wole Yehyemeeyɛle la, ɛnee Ebilam ɛli ɛvolɛ abulatwɛ nee nsia.

Title: MƆL 17
Content:
Ngyekyeleɛ ne nzonlɛ a le mrenyanu nzonlɛyɛlɛ
1Mekɛ mɔɔ Ebilam lile ɛvolɛ abulahɔnla nee ngɔnla la, Ɛdɛnkɛma yele ɔ nwo hilele ye na ɔzele ye kɛ, “Medame a mele Nyamenle Bedevinli ne a; di me mɛla zo na mmamaa ɛ nwo nyia ngehanleɛ biala. 2Me nee wɔ bayɛ ngyekyeleɛ, yɛɛ mebamaa ɛ bo zo amra azo dɔɔnwo kpalɛ.” 3Na Ebilam dule dɔle ɔ nyunlu mutule nu, na Nyamenle zele ye kɛ, 4“Me nee wɔ ɛyɛ ngyekyeleɛ ne; ɛbayɛ maanle maanle dɔɔnwo bɛ ze. 5Bɛnrɛvɛlɛ wɔ Ebilam bieko, bɛbavɛlɛ wɔ Ebileham, ɔluakɛ meyɛ wɔ maanle maanle dɔɔnwo bɛ ze. 6Mebamaa wɔanyia ɛ bo zo amra dɔɔnwo. Ɛ bo zo amra bazo somaa ayɛ maanle maanle, na bie mɔ ayɛ arelemgbunli.
7 “Me nee wɔ nee ɛ bo zo amra bayɛ ngyekyeleɛ mɔɔ baha awolɛndoazo ne mɔ amuala la, na yeayɛ ngyekyeleɛ mɔɔ bɛntulu ye ɛlɛ a. Mebayɛ wɔ Nyamenle na meayɛ ɛ bo zo amra noko Nyamenle. 8 Na mebava azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ ɛlɛkpɔsakpɔsa zolɛ la meamaa wɔ nee ɛ bo zo amra. Bɛbava Keena azɛlɛ ne kɔsɔɔti bɛayɛ bɛ ɛdeɛ, na mebayɛ bɛ Nyamenle.”
9Nyamenle zele Ebileham kɛ, “Wɔmɔ, ɔwɔ kɛ ɛdawɔ nee ɛ bo zo amra kɔsɔɔti di me ngyekyeleɛ ne azo. 10 Ngyekyeleɛ mɔɔ wɔ me nee ɛdawɔ nee ɛ bo zo amra yɛ avinli, mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛdi zolɛ la ɛne: Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛyɛ nrenya biala mɔɔ wɔ bɛ avinli la mrenyanu nzonlɛ. 11-13Ɔvi ɛnɛ mɔɔ kɔ la, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛyɛ nrenya biala mɔɔ bɛkɛwo ye na ɔkɛli kenle mɔtwɛ la mrenyanu nzonlɛ. Saa bɛwo ye wɔ wɔ sua nu o, kanranli mɔɔ wɔva wɔ ezukoa wɔdɔ wɔvi ɛyɛvolɛ bie ɛkɛ ne la o, kanranli mɔɔ bɛwo ye wɔ wɔ sua nu ɛkɛ ne la o, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛyɛ ye mrenyanu nzonlɛ. Ɛhye a bahile kɛ bɛlɛdi me ngyekyeleɛ ne azo a. Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛyɛ bɛ mrenyanu nzonlɛ wɔ awolɛndoazo muala anu, amaa me ngyekyeleɛ ye nzonlɛ aha bɛ nwonane nu yeayɛ ngyekyeleɛ mɔɔ bɛntulu ye ɛlɛ a. 14Nrenya biala mɔɔ anyɛ ye mrenyanu nzonlɛ la ɛtulu me ngyekyeleɛ ne; ɔwɔ kɛ bɛye ye bɛfi me menli ne avinli.”
15Nyamenle zele Ebileham kɛ, “Ɛ ye Sɛleeyae noko, mmafɛlɛ ye Sɛleeyae bieko. Ye duma a le Sɛla. 16Mebayila ye, na yeayɛ maanle maanle bɛ nli. Ɔ bo zo amra bie mɔ bayɛ arelemgbunli.”
17Ebileham dule dɔle mutule nu zelele na ɔbizale ɔ nwo kɛ, “Asoo nrenya mɔɔ ɛli ɛvolɛ ɛya la bahola awo ralɛ? Asoo Sɛla mɔɔ ɛli ɛvolɛ abulahɔnla la bawo ralɛ?” 18Na ɔhanle ɔhilele Nyamenle kɛ, “Anrɛɛ ɛmanle Yehyemeeyɛle zɔle ɛ nye.”
19Nyamenle zele ye kɛ, “Kyɛkyɛ, ɛ ye Sɛla bawo ralɛ nrenya na ɛbavɛlɛ ye Ayezeke. Mebali me ngyekyeleɛ ne azo meamaa ye nee ɔ bo zo amra mɔɔ bɛntulu ye ɛlɛ a. 20Yehyemeeyɛle ɛdeɛ, mede mɔɔ wɔha la. Nea, meyila ye na mebamaa ɔ sa zo ada, bɛ nwo azo dɔɔnwo. Ɔbayɛ arelemgbunli bulu nee nwiɔ bɛ ze, na mebamaa yeayɛ maanle kpole kpalɛ. 21Noko Ayezeke mɔɔ Sɛla bawo ye ɛvolɛ bieko kabezɛ la, yemɔ yɛɛ me nee ye bakyekye me ngyekyeleɛ ne a.” 22Nyamenle wiele tendɛ la, ɔgyakyile Ebileham ɛkɛ ɔhɔle anwuma.
23Akee, Ebileham vale ɔ ra Yehyemeeyɛle nee ahanra mrenya mɔɔ bɛwole bɛ ye sua nu ɛkɛ, nee mɔɔ ɔvale ye ezukoa ɔdɔle la amuala na ɔyɛle bɛ mrenyanu nzonlɛ, kɛmɔ Nyamenle hanle hilele ye la. 24Mɔɔ bɛyɛ Ebileham mrenyanu nzonlɛ la, ɛnee yeli ɛvolɛ abulahɔnla nee ngɔnla. 25Ɛnee Yehyemeeyɛle ɛli ɛvolɛ bulu nee nsa yɛɛ bɛyɛle ye mrenyanu nzonlɛ a. 26Kenle ko ne ala a bɛyɛle Ebileham nee ɔ ra Yehyemeeyɛle mrenyanu nzonlɛ a. 27Kenle ko ne ala, mrenya mɔɔ wɔ sua nu ɛkɛ ne la, bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwole bɛ ɛkɛ nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdɔle bɛ ahanra la, bɛyɛle bɛ kɔsɔɔti mrenyanu nzonlɛ.

Title: MƆL 18
Content:
Bɛfa ralɛ nrenya bɛabɔ Ebileham ɛwɔkɛ
1Kenle ko ewiazo mɔɔ ɛnee maanle nu yɛ wuluwulu, na Ebileham de ye ndanlɛ sua ne anuhɔlɛ ne wɔ Mameli oku mbaka ne mɔ abo la, Ɛdɛnkɛma yele ɔ nwo hilele ye. 2Ɔkpogyale ɔ nye zo la, mɔɔ ɔnwunle ye la a le kɛ, menli nsa gyigyi ɔ nyunlu nehane. Ɔnwunle bɛ la, ɔvi ye anuhɔlɛ ne ɔnriandile ɔhɔyiale bɛ, ɔbɔle ɔ ti aze ɔmanle bɛ, 3na ɔzele kɛ, “Me menle mɔ, saa bɛyɛ na ɔkɛyɛ boɛ a, ɛnee bɛmmapɛ nu wɔ me anuhɔlɛ ɛke bɛkɔ. 4Bɛmaa membɛlɛ bɛ nzule ekyi bɛnrinzi bɛ gyakɛ anwo, na bɛlie bɛ ɛnwomenle ekyii wɔ mbaka ye abo. 5Mekava kpanwo ekyi noko mearɛlɛ bɛ, meamaa bɛakpula bɛ sa na akee bɛahɔ. Ɔluakɛ bɛra bɛ sonvolɛ sua nu.”
Bɛzele ye kɛ, “Yɛ, kɛmɔ wɔha la.”
6Ebileham ziale wolole ye ndanlɛ sua ne anu ndɛndɛ na ɔhɔzele Sɛla kɛ, “Ka ɛ nwo suzu esamo kpalɛ ekyi yɛ kpanwo.” 7Eza ɔnriandile ɔhɔle nlankɛ ne mɔ anu ɔhɔhyele ekyi ko mɔɔ ɛlɔ, na ɔle kpalɛ la ɔmanle ye sonvolɛ ne hunle ye, biale ye na ɔzenle. 8Akee ɔvale meleke, bɛta, yɛɛ ɛnlankɛ ralɛ ne mɔɔ bɛze la ɔhɔziele menli nsa ne anyunlu kɛ bɛkpula bɛ sa, na ɔgyinlanle bɛ nwo ɛkɛ ne ɔnleanle ɔmanle bɛlile.
9Menli nsa ne bizale ye kɛ, “Ɛ ye Sɛla wɔ nienwu?”
Ɔbuale kɛ, “Ɔwɔ ndanlɛ sua ne anu.”
10 Na ko zele ye kɛ, “Mebazia meara ɛ nwo ɛke ɛvolɛ bieko kabezɛhae wɔ nyenyesuo mekɛ ne anu, na ɛ ye Sɛla bawo ralɛ nrenya.”
Ɛnee Sɛla wɔ ndanlɛ sua ne anu anlenkɛ ne anloa, wɔ bɛ nzi ɛkɛ na ɔlɛtie edwɛkɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛka la. 11Ebileham nee ɔ ye Sɛla ɛyɛ mgbanyinli kpalɛ, na Sɛla bɔbɔ ɛdeɛ, ɛnee yebo ralɛwolɛ zo. 12Yemɔti Sɛla zelele na ɔbizale ɔ nwo kɛ, “Asoo kɛkala mɔɔ mewie ɛrelera yɛ, na me hu ɔdaye yeyɛ ɛrelera la, yɛɛ akee mebalie me nye a?”
13Na Ɛdɛnkɛma bizale Ebileham kɛ, “Duzu ati a mɔɔ meha la ati Sɛla ɛzele, na yeha kɛ, ‘Asoo kɛkala mɔɔ mewie ɛrelera yɛ la yɛɛ mebawo ralɛ nrenya a?’ 14 Debie biala ɛnyɛ se ɛmmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma. Mekɛ ne dwu a mebazia meara, ɛvolɛ bieko kabezɛhae, na Sɛla bawo ralɛ nrenya.”
15Kɛmɔ ɛnee Sɛla sulo la ati, ɔzale na ɔhanle kɛ, “Meanzele.”
Ɛdɛnkɛma zele ye kɛ, “Kyɛkyɛ, ɛzelele.”
Ebileham kpa Sodɔm ati kyɛlɛ
16Akee menli ne mɔ dwazole kɛ bɛkɔ, na bɛvale bɛ ti bɛbɔle Sodɔm. Ebileham nee bɛ dudule agyakɛ kɛ ɔkazɔho bɛ. 17Na Ɛdɛnkɛma hanle kɛ, “Ɔnle kɛ mefa mɔɔ mebayɛ la mefea Ebileham, 18ɔboalekɛ Ebileham abo zo amra bayɛ maanle kpole, na maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti mɔɔ wɔ ewiade la balua ɔ nwo zo anyia nyilalɛ. 19Mekpa nu meye ye, amaa yeanlea yeamaa ɔ mra nee ye sua nu amra alua Ɛdɛnkɛma adenle ne azo, na bɛayɛ menli mɔɔ le tenlene na bɛdi pɛlepɛle a, amaa meava debie biala mɔɔ meva mebɔ Ebileham ɛwɔkɛ la meamaa ye.”
20Akee Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Ebileham kɛ, “Sodɔm nee Gomɔla ɛtane ne ɛyɛ kpole, yɛɛ bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ anwo ngehanleɛ akee ɛzo somaa. 21Yemɔti mekɔ ɛkɛ meahɔnlea saa mɔɔ bɛlɛkeha bɛatia ye la amuala le zɔhane a. Saa ɔnle zɔhane noko a eza mebanwu ye.”
22Yemɔti Ebileham hale Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu ɛkɛ ne gyinlanle, na menli nwiɔ ne mɔɔ ɛha la telele zolɛ kɛ bɛkɔ Sodɔm. 23Na Ebileham hwenle bikyele Ɛdɛnkɛma na ɔhanle kɛ, “Asoo amgba ala ɛbazɛkye tenlenema wɔaboka amumuyɛma ne anwo? 24Saa ngyengyene nu bie ala ɛnyia menli abulanlu mɔɔ di boɛ la wɔ ɛkɛ ne a, asoo ɛnrɛnlea menli abulanlu ne ati na ɛnrɛgyakyi sua ne ɛzɛkyelɛ? 25Munzule ɛhɔ ɛbɔ nu, kɛ ɛkɛyɛ debie mɔɔ le zɛhae, na ɛkɛhu tenlenema ɛkɛboka amumuyɛma, na ɛkɛmaa tenlenema kɛwie ye kɛ amumuyɛma la. Ɛhye ɛmbɔnle ɛ nwo! Asoo azɛlɛ ye amuala ndɛnebuavolɛ ɛnrɛli pɛlepɛle?”
26Ɛdɛnkɛma buale ye kɛ, “Saa menyia menli abulanlu mɔɔ le tenlenema la wɔ suakpole ne azo a, bɛdabɛ bɛ ti, menrɛzɛkye suakpole ne.”
27Ebileham buale ye kɛ, “Mmafa me nwo ɛya kɛ metɛgyi me gyakɛ anu me nee me Awulae tɛtendɛ a; medame mɔɔ mele ndɛtɛlɛ nee nzonle la. 28Saa ɔba ye kɛ menli abulanlu ne, amuanrɛɛ nuhua nnu ɛnli munli a, asoo ɛbazɛkye suakpole ne, kɛmɔ wɔannyia nnu ne wɔanzɔ zolɛ la?”
Ɛdɛnkɛma buale ye kɛ, “Saa menyia menli abulanla nee nnu a, menrɛzɛkye suakpole ne.”
29Eza ɔbizale ye kɛ, “Na saa bɛle abulanla ala ɛ?”
Ɛdɛnkɛma buale kɛ, “Menli abulanla ne ati, menrɛzɛkye suakpole ne.”
30Akee Ebileham hanle kɛ, “O Awulae, mmafa me nwo ɛya, na maa menga ɛhye. Saa ɛnwu abulasa ɛkɛ ɛ?”
Ɛdɛnkɛma buale ye kɛ, “Saa menwu menli abulasa wɔ ɛkɛ a, menrɛzɛkye suakpole ne.”
31Ebileham hanle kɛ, “Mebodo wɔ kɛ kɛkala metɛgyi me gyakɛ anu me nee wɔ tɛtendɛ a. Na saa ɛnyia abulanwiɔ ɛ?”
Ɛdɛnkɛma buale kɛ, “Saa menyia menli abulanwiɔ a, bɛ ti, menrɛzɛkye suakpole ne.”
32Na Ebileham hanle kɛ, “O Awulae, mmafa me nwo ɛya, na maa menga kokye ɛhye. Na saa ɛnwu bulu wɔ ɛkɛ ne ɛ?”
Ɛdɛnkɛma buale kɛ, “Saa menwu bulu wɔ ɛkɛ a, menli bulu ne ati, menrɛzɛkye suakpole ne.” 33Ɛdɛnkɛma nee Ebileham wiele tendɛ la, ɔhɔle. Na Ebileham ziale hɔle sua nu.

Title: MƆL 19
Content:
Sodɔmma ɛtaneyɛlɛ ne
1Nyamenle soanvolɛma nwiɔ ne dwule Sodɔm nɔsolɛ nu; ɛnee Lɔɔto de Sodɔm anlenkɛ kpole ne anloa. Mɔɔ Lɔɔto nwunle bɛ la, ɔdwazole ɔhɔyiale bɛ, ɔbutule bɛ nyunlu mutule nu 2na ɔzele kɛ, “Me menle mɔ, mesɛlɛ bɛ, bɛ nee bɛ sonvolɛ ɛhɔ sua nu, bɛhɔnrinzi bɛ gyakɛ anwo na bɛla, na aleɛbahye bɛadwazo ndɛ bɛahɔ.”
Bɛbuale ye kɛ, “Kyɛkyɛ, yɛda gua ye azo nɔe.”
3Na Lɔɔto anye bolole kpalɛ ɔzɛlɛle bɛ, yemɔti bɛhakyile bɛ nwo bɛ nee ye hɔle sua nu. Lɔɔto manle ye sonvolɛma ne donle kpanwo mɔɔ mgbɔvonle ɛnle nu la, ɔdole bɛ ɛkponle na bɛlile.
4Na mɔɔ ɔdwule mekɛ mɔɔ bɛkala la, Sodɔm suakpole ne azo mrenya ngakula nee mgbanyinli, bɛ muala kɔsɔɔti, ko bɔbɔ anga amozi, bɛrale bɛrabɛnrale bɛyiale sua ne mɔɔ bɛwɔ nu la. 5Bɛvɛlɛle Lɔɔto na bɛbizale ye kɛ, “Menli mɔɔ razokoɛle wɔ nɔsolɛ ye la wɔ nienwu? Fa bɛ finde ɛke maa yɛva bɛ.”
6Lɔɔto vindele, ɔdole anlenkɛ ne anu na ɔdoale bɛ alie nwo lɔ 7ɔhɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Me mediema mrenya, mebodo bɛ, bɛmmayɛ amumuyɛ ɛhye. 8 Bɛdie, melɛ me mra mraalɛ nwiɔ mɔɔ ɛnze nrenya fee a. Bɛmaa menva bɛ membɛlɛ bɛ, na bɛ nee bɛ ɛyɛ debie biala mɔɔ bɛdabɛ bɛkulo la. Menli ɛhye mɔ ɛdeɛ, bɛmmayɛ bɛ ɛhwee, ɔluakɛ bɛle me nyɛvolɛ, yɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ menea bɛ boɛ.”
9Na bɛzele ye kɛ, “Dwazo ɛkɛ ne! Wɔmɔ ɛdawɔ mumua ne ɛle ɛyɛvolɛ wɔ suakpole ye azo. Wɔmɔ ɛbahakyi yɛ kɔme nu ndɛnebuavolɛ. Yɛ nee wɔ bali ye ɛsesebɛ bɔbɔ yɛadɛla menli ɛhye mɔ.” Akee bɛholole Lɔɔto anwo zo na bɛyɛle kɛ bɛkabu anlenkɛ ne. 10Na menli nwiɔ ne dole bɛ sa hwenle Lɔɔto hɔle bɛ nwo ɛkɛ ne wɔ sua ne anu, na bɛdole anlenkɛ ne anu. 11 Akee bɛmanle menli mɔɔ ɛrayi anlenkɛ ne anloa la amuala anye zinle; ngakula o, mgbanyinli o, biala ɛnnwu debie, yemɔti bɛlile nvuovua bɛkpondɛle anlenkɛ ne.
Lɔɔto fi Sodɔm
12Nɔe ne ala, menli nwiɔ ne zele Lɔɔto kɛ, “Ɛlɛ awie wɔ ɛke ɔ? Ka kile ɛ mra mrenya, ɛ mra mraalɛ nee bɛ hu mɔ anzɛɛ awie biala mɔɔ ɛze ye suakpole ye azo la maa bɛvi suakpole ye azo bɛye bɛ nwo, 13ɔluakɛ yɛsɛkye suakpole ye, ɔboalekɛ bɛ ɛtaneyɛlɛ ne ɛyɛ kpole yɛɛ bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ anwo ngehanleɛ ɛdwu Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu, na yezoa yɛ kɛ yɛrazɛkye suakpole ye.”
14Yemɔti Lɔɔto vindele nɔe ne hɔdunwuele ɔ mra mraalɛ ne mɔ bɛ hu mɔ mɔɔ baragya bɛ la, na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛdwazo, bɛvi suakpole ye azo bɛye bɛ nwo, ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛlɛba arazɛkye suakpole ye.” Noko bɛdwenlenle kɛ ɔlɛbɔ nzɛmedɛ.
15Aleɛbahye ne, Nyamenle soanvolɛma ne mɔ zele Lɔɔto kɛ, “Ka ɛ nwo dwazo, fa ɛ ye nee ɛ mra mraalɛ nwiɔ ne mɔɔ wɔ ɛke la nriandi, anrɛɛ bɛ muala bɛkɛdɔ nzonle wɔ suakpole ye ndeanlɛ nu.” 16 Noko Lɔɔto hwenlehwenlenle ɔ bo aze, yemɔti menli ne mɔ zɔle ye nee ɔ ye nee ɔ mra mraalɛ ne mɔ asa na bɛ nee bɛ rale suakpole ne kandiba, ɔluakɛ ɛnee Ɛdɛnkɛma se bɛ anwunvɔne. 17Na mɔɔ bɛ nee bɛ dwule suakpole ne kandiba la, bɛ nuhua ko zele kɛ, “Bɛnriandi bɛlie bɛ ngoane. Bɛmmato bɛ nye bɛ nzi, yɛɛ bɛmmagyinla ɛleka biala wɔ bɔnza ne anu. Bɛnriandi bɛhɔ awoka ne mɔ azo lɔ, anrɛɛ bɛkɛha esike nu.”
18Lɔɔto hanle kɛ, “O, kyɛkyɛ, me menle, 19bɛnlea, bɛ sonvolɛ ye ɛzɔ bɛ nye, na bɛze ye anwunvɔne kpole ɛhye bɛlie ye ngoane. Noko menrɛhola nriandi dwu awoka ne mɔ azo lɔ, anrɛɛ munzule ne kɛdo me adenle nu kɛmaa menwɔwu. 20Suakpole ye mɔɔ zua ɛke ala la bikye mɔɔ menriandi mekɔ zolɛ a ɔle kpalɛ a, yɛɛ eza ɔle ekyi. Bɛmaa menriandi mengɔ ɛkɛ ne na mebanyia ngoane.”
21Ɔbuale ye kɛ, “Menwu wɔ anwunvɔne ɛhye noko, menrɛzɛkye sua zɔhane mɔɔ wɔha ye edwɛkɛ la. 22Ka ɛ nwo nriandi kɔ ɛkɛ. Ɔboalekɛ saa ɛtɛdwule ɛkɛ ne a menrɛyɛ ɛhwee.” Zɔhane ati bɛvɛlɛle sua zɔhane Zowaa
Sodɔm nee Gomɔla ɛzɛkyelɛ
23Mɔɔ Lɔɔto dwule Zowaa la, ɛnee sɛnzɛne ne ɛdudu. 24Na Ɛdɛnkɛma manle sɔlefe nee senle vi anwuma dɔle kɛ ezule guale Sodɔm nee Gomɔla azo. 25 Na ɔzɛkyele azuamgbole zɔhane mɔ, bɔnza ne anu amuala, nee menli mɔɔ wɔ azuamgbole ne mɔ azo la amuala, yɛɛ debie biala mɔɔ fifile azɛlɛ ne azo la. 26Na Lɔɔto aye ne mɔɔ ɛnee li ɔ nzi la dole ɔ nye ɔ nzi, na ɔhakyile ngyenle mpila.
27Ebileham dwazole nwonlomɔ mangyee ne ala na ɔhɔgyinlanle ɛleka mɔɔ ɔgyinlanle Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu la. 28Ɔdole ɔ nye Sodɔm nee Gomɔla na ɔnleanle azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ la bɔnza ne anu la amuala azo, na ɔnwunle kɛ maanle ne mɔɔ ɛlɛyela la esike ne ɛdwazo bolonwonwo kɛ tɔlɔra senle. 29Ɛnee kɛ Nyamenle zile zɛkyele azuamgbole zɔhane mɔ mɔɔ wɔ bɔnza ne anu la ɛne. Noko ɔhakyele Ebileham, yemɔti ɔyele Lɔɔto ɔvile nu wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɔsɛkye azuamgbole mɔɔ Lɔɔto dɛnlanle zolɛ la.
Mowabema nee Amɔnoma abo
30Ɛnee Lɔɔto sulo kɛ ɔkɛdɛnla Zowaa, yemɔti ɔ nee ɔ mra mraalɛ nwiɔ ne dule vile Zowaa na bɛhɔdɛnlanle bolɛ bɔne bie anu wɔ awoka ne mɔ anu. 31Na ralɛ raalɛ kpanyinli ne zele ekyi ne kɛ, “Yɛ ze ɛyɛ kpanyinli, yɛɛ nrenya biala ɛnle azɛlɛ ye azo mɔɔ nee yɛ kɛla, kɛmɔ bɛyɛ ye ewiade amuala la. 32Bɛla, maa yɛnloa egya nwanye yɛmaa ɔbo, na yɛ nee ye ɛla, amaa yɛ nee ye anyia mralɛ yɛazie yɛ gyakɛ anu.” 33Yemɔti kenle ko ne nɔe ne bɛmanle bɛ ze nwanye bɛmanle ɔbole na ralɛ raalɛ kpanyinli ne nee ye hɔlale. Ɔbole kpole somaa, yemɔti yeannwu kɛ ɔ ra raalɛ ne zile ralale na yeayɛ ye ɛdwazolɛ nu.
34Aleɛ hyenle la, ralɛ raalɛ kpanyinli ne zele ekyi ne kɛ, “Nea, nɔe me nee egya lale. Maa yɛmaa ɔnlo nwanye ɔbo bieko ɛnɛ nɔe na ɛ nee ye ɛhɔla, na ɔlua ɔ nwo zo yɛanyia mralɛ.” 35Yemɔti kenle ko ne nɔe ne bɛmanle bɛ ze nlonle nwanye bole, na ralɛ raalɛ ekyi ne doale ye nee ye hɔlale. Noko bɛ ze annwu ye, ɔluakɛ ɔbole somaa. 36Zɛhae adenle zo yɛɛ Lɔɔto amra mraalɛ nwiɔ ne nee bɛ ze nrenzɛle a. 37Ralɛ raalɛ kpanyinli ne wole ralɛ nrenya na ɔdonle ye Mowabe. Ɔ bo zo amra a le Mowabema mɔɔ wɔ ɛkɛ ne ɛnɛ nee ɛnɛ la. 38Ekyi ne noko wole ralɛ nrenya na ɔdonle ye Bɛnamae. Ɔ bo zo amra a le Amɔnoma mɔɔ wɔ ɛkɛ ne ɛnɛ nee ɛnɛ la.

Title: MƆL 20
Content:
Ebileham nee Abemɛlɛke
1Ebileham vi ɛleka mɔɔ ɔde la ɔhɔle Keena nyiakɛ na ɔhɔdɛnlanle Keedɛhye nee Hyulu avinli, eza ɔhɔdɛnlanle Gilaa. 2 Na Ebileham zele kɛ, “Sɛla le me diema raalɛ.” Yemɔti Gilaa Belemgbunli Abemɛlɛke zoanle manle bɛhɔvale Sɛla bɛrale ye sua nu. 3Na Nyamenle rahanle Abemɛlɛke ɛlalɛ kɛ, “Nea, raalɛ ne mɔɔ wɔhɔva ye la ati, wɔwu wɔwie; ɔluakɛ ɔle awie aye.”
4Ɛnee Abemɛlɛke ɛtɛfale ɔ sa ɛtɛkanle ye, yemɔti ɔzɛlɛle kɛ, “Awulae, menze nwolɛ bie na mmaku yɛ. 5Ɔdaye nrenya ne yɛɛ ɔhanle ɔhilele me kɛ ɔ diema raalɛ a, yɛɛ ɔdaye raalɛ ne ɔdole zolɛ kɛ ɔ diema nrenya ɔ. Me ti anu wienyi, yɛɛ metɛfale me sa metɛkanle ye.”
6Na Nyamenle buale ye kɛ, “Meze kɛ ɛ ti anu wienyi, yɛɛ medame yɛɛ menzɔle wɔ mɔɔ wɔannyia adenle wɔanyɛ ɛtane wɔantia me a, yemɔti a meammaa wɔanva ɛ sa wɔanga ye a. 7Yemɔti fa nrenya ne aye ne kɔmaa ye. Ɔle Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ, ɔbazɛlɛ yeamaa wɔ, na wɔanyia ngoane. Na saa wɔanva raalɛ ne wɔangɔ a, ɛnee nwu ye kɛ ɛdawɔ nee wɔ menli ne kɔsɔɔti bawu.”
8Yemɔti Abemɛlɛke dwazole nwonlomɔ mangyee ne ala na ɔvɛlɛle ye sonvolɛma ne amuala na ɔhanle edwɛkɛ ne amuala ɔhilele bɛ. Na ɛzulolɛ hanle menli ne mɔ. 9Akee Abemɛlɛke vɛlɛle Ebileham na ɔbizale ye kɛ, “Duzu debie a wɔva wɔyɛ yɛ la? Duzu ɛtane yɛɛ meyɛ metia wɔ, mɔɔ wɔva munzule kpole ɛhye wɔra me nee me maanlema anwo zo a? Wɔyɛ mɔɔ bɛnyɛ la wɔmaa me. 10Duzu a ɛnee ɛlɛdwenle nwolɛ mɔɔ yemɔti ɛyɛle deɛ ɛhye a?”
11Ebileham buale kɛ, “Menyɛle ye zɔhane, ɔboalekɛ ɛnee medwenle kɛ ɛke amra ɛnzulo Nyamenle fee, na me ye ati bɛkɛhu me. 12Yeanga ye zɔhane, nɔhalɛ, eza ɔle me diema. Ɔle me ze ara raalɛ, na me nee ye ɛnvi ɛkolɛ ko anu, yɛɛ ɔrayɛle me ye a. 13Mekɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle maanle mendule egya sua nu kɛ menlɔ nu la, menganle mengilele ye kɛ, ‘Ɔwɔ kɛ ɛyɛ nyɛleɛ ɛhye ɛmaa me; ɛleka biala mɔɔ yɛkɛhɔ la, ka kɛ ɛ diema nrenya a le me.’ ”
14Akee Abemɛlɛke vale mboane, nlankɛ, yɛɛ ahanra mrenya nee mraalɛ manle Ebileham, na ɔvale ɔ ye Sɛla ɔmanle ye. 15Abemɛlɛke zele Ebileham kɛ, “Nea, me azɛlɛ ne a ɛ nye dua ye la; tɛnla ɛleka biala mɔɔ ɛkulo la.” 16Akee ɔzele Sɛla kɛ, “Nea, meva dwɛtɛ fufule ngoko apenle memaa ɛ diema nrenya ne. Ɔle wɔ ɛbialɛ ezukoa kɛ ɛnli fɔlɛ, na ɛdi benle wɔ awie biala anyunlu.”
17-18Ɔlua mɔɔ Abemɛlɛke yɛle la ati, Ɛdɛnkɛma manle Abemɛlɛke aye nee ye sonvolɛ mraalɛ mɔɔ wɔ sua nu ɛkɛ ne la amuala pɛle awolɛ. Na Ebileham zɛlɛle Nyamenle manle Abemɛlɛke. Na Nyamenle yɛle Abemɛlɛke nee ɔ ye ayile na eza ɔyɛle sonvolɛ mraalɛ mɔɔ wɔ sua nu ɛkɛ ne la ayile, ɔmanle bɛ awolɛ dukuele.

Title: MƆL 21
Content:
Ayezeke awolɛ ne
1Ɛdɛnkɛma rakpɔlale Sɛla, kɛmɔ ɔhanle ala la, na ɔyɛle mɔɔ ɔvale ɔbɔle ye ɛwɔkɛ la ɔmanle ye. 2 Na Sɛla nrenzɛle na ɔwole ralɛ nrenya ɔmanle Ebileham wɔ ye mrelera nu, wɔ mekɛ ne mɔɔ Nyamenle nee ye dendɛle nwolɛ la. 3Ebileham donle ralɛ nrenya ne mɔɔ ɔ ye Sɛla wole manle ye la, Ayezeke. 4 Ayezeke lile kenle mɔtwɛ la, Ebileham yɛle ye mrenyanu nzonlɛ, kɛmɔ Nyamenle zele ye la. 5Ɛnee Ebileham ɛli ɛvolɛ ɛya yɛɛ ɔwole ɔ ra Ayezeke a. 6Na Sɛla hanle kɛ, “Nyamenle ɛmaa ɛzelekɛ ɛdɔ me nwo. Awie biala mɔɔ kɛde me nganeɛ la nee me bazele.” 7Na ɔvale ɔzɔle zolɛ kɛ. “Nwane ala bɔbɔ yɛɛ anrɛɛ kɛhola kɛze Ebileham kɛ Sɛla banloa ngakula nyɛfonlɛ a? Noko akee mɔɔ yeyɛ ɛrelera la mewo ralɛ nrenya memaa ye.”
8Kakula ne nyinli, na kenle ko ne mɔɔ ɔpɛle nyɛfonlɛ la, ɔ ze Ebileham dole nwolɛ ɛkponle kpole bie.
Bɛvoa Heega nee Yehyemeeyɛle
9Kenle ko Sɛla nwunle kɛ Yigyibitinli Heega ara Yehyemeeyɛle, mɔɔ ɔ nee Ebileham wole ye la ɛlɛsi Ayezeke amgbu. 10 Yemɔti ɔzele Ebileham kɛ, “To raalɛ akɛlɛ ne nee ɔ ra nrenya ne adenle zo, ɔluakɛ akɛlɛ ɛhye ara nrenya ne nee me ra Ayezeke ɛnrɛbɔ nu ɛnrɛli agya ko.” 11Ebileham anye anlie ɛhye anwo fee, ɔluakɛ ɔ ra nrenya a le kakula ne. 12 Na Nyamenle zele Ebileham kɛ, “Mmadwenle ɛ ra nrenya ne nee wɔ akɛlɛ raalɛ ne anwo. Di edwɛkɛ biala mɔɔ Sɛla ɛha ɛhile wɔ la azo, ɔluakɛ ɛ bo zo amra vi Ayezeke anu a bara a. 13Mebamaa ɛ ra nrenya ne mɔɔ akɛlɛ raalɛ ne ɛwo ye la noko ada ayɛ maanle, ɔboalekɛ ɔle ɛ ra.”
14Yemɔti Ebileham dwazole nwonlomɔ mangyee ne ala na ɔvale aleɛ nee nzule nwoma kodoku ko ɔmanle Heega vale dole ɔ kɔme zo, na ɔdole ye nee ɔ ra ne adenle zo. Heega hɔle na ɔhɔluoluale Biyɛhyiba fienemgbole ne anu. 15Ye nzule ne wiele la, ɔgyakyile ɔ ra ne ɔdole aziakɛ bie abo. 16Akee ɔhɔdɛnlanle amozi moa kɛyɛ mita ɛya ko, na ɔhanle ɔhilele ɔ nwo kɛ, “Menrɛhola me ra ye anyunlu nea wɔ ye ewule nu.” Heega de ɛkɛ ne la ɛnee yehakyi ɔ nzi yezi kakula ne, na kakula ne bɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɔsu.
17Nyamenle dele kakula ne ane, na Nyamenle soanvolɛ vi anwuma vɛlɛle Heega na ɔbizale ye kɛ, “Heega, duzu a ɛlɛgyegye wɔ a? Mmasulo, ɔluakɛ Nyamenle ɛde kakula ne ane wɔ ɛleka mɔɔ ɔwɔ la. 18Dwazo, kɔmaa kakula ne zo na nea ye boɛ kpalɛ, ɔluakɛ mebamaa yeayɛ maanle kpole.” 19Akee Nyamenle bukele ɔ nye, na Heega nwunle bula bie mɔɔ nzule wɔ nu la, na ɔhɔle nwolɛ ɔhɔzale bie ɔguale ye nwoma kodoku ne anu ɔmanle ɔyile na ɔnloanle ɔ ra ne bie. 20Na Nyamenle boale kakula ne manle ɔnyinle. Ɔdɛnlanle fienemgbole ne anu na ɔbenle ɛda ɛdolɛ nu. 21Ɔdɛnlanle Pɛlan fienemgbole ne anu, na ɔ nli gyale Yigyibiti raalɛ maanle ye.
Ebileham nee Abemɛlɛke ngyehyɛlɛ ne
22 Mekɛ ne anu Belemgbunli Abemɛlɛke nee Faekɔlo, ye safohyenlema kpanyinli ne mɔɔ nea ye ɛlɔnema ne anwo zo la, hɔle Ebileham ɛkɛ hɔzele ye kɛ, “Nyamenle boa wɔ wɔ debie biala mɔɔ ɛkɛze kɛ ɛyɛ la anu. 23Zɔhane ati fa Nyamenle ka ndane kile me kɛ, ɛnrɛbɛlɛbɛla me, anzɛɛ me mra, anzɛɛ me bo zo amra mɔɔ bara la amuala, na kɛmɔ meli nɔhalɛ memaa wɔ la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ ɛbayɛ wɔamaa me nee azɛlɛ ye mɔɔ wɔra zolɛ la azo amra a.”
24Na Ebileham zele kɛ, “Mebɔ ɛwɔkɛ zɔhane.”
25Ebileham hanle nzule bula bie mɔɔ Abemɛlɛke sonvolɛma ne liele vile ɔ sa nu la anwo edwɛkɛ hilele ye. 26Na Abemɛlɛke zele kɛ, “Menze ahenle mɔɔ yɛle zɔhane debie la. Wɔanga wɔangile me, yɛɛ metɛtele ye ɛlɛ kɛ ɛnɛ.” 27Akee Ebileham vale mboane nee nlankɛ manle Abemɛlɛke, na bɛ mu nwiɔ bɛyɛle ngyehyɛlɛ na bɛhyele ɔ bo. 28Ebileham yele mboane mbelɛ nsuu vile ye mboane ne anu ziele ahane. 29Na Abemɛlɛke bizale Ebileham kɛ, “Mboane mbelɛ nsuu ɛhye mɔɔ wɔkpa nu wɔye wɔzie ahane la abo a le duzu?”
30Ebileham buale kɛ, “Die me sa nu mboane nsuu ɛhye fa di daselɛ, kɛ medame yɛɛ membɔle bula ɛhye a.” 31Ɛhye ati bɛvɛlɛle ɛleka ne Biyɛhyiba, ɔboalekɛ ɛkɛ ne yɛɛ bɛ mu nwiɔ bɛlile amonle a.
32Yemɔti bɛyɛle ngyekyeleɛ ɛhye wɔ Biyɛhyiba, na Abemɛlɛke nee Faekɔlo, ye safohyenlema kpanyinli ne mɔɔ nea ye ɛlɔnema anwo zo la ziale hɔle Filisitia. 33Ebileham luale “Tamaleseke” baka wɔ Biyɛhyiba ɛkɛ, na ɔzonlenle Ɛdɛnkɛma, Damɛnlangoate Nyamenle ne wɔ ɛkɛ ne. 34Na Ebileham dɛnlanle Filisitia maanle nu hyɛle kpalɛ.

Title: MƆL 22
Content:
Nyamenle se Ebileham ɛva Ayezeke ɛbɔ azu
1Ɛhye mɔ anzi Nyamenle zɔle Ebileham nleanle na ɔzele ye kɛ, “Ebileham!” Na Ebileham liele zolɛ, “Mewɔ ɛke.”
2 Ɔzele ye kɛ, “Fa ɛ ra nrenya ne, ɛ ra kokye Ayezeke, mɔɔ la wɔ ahonle nwo la, na kɔ Molaya azɛlɛ zo kɔyela ye bɔ azu wɔ awoka ne mɔ ko mɔɔ mebahile wɔ la azo maa me.”
3Yemɔti Ebileham dwazole nwonlomɔ mangyee ne ala na ɔzieziele ye asoaso ne, ɔvale ye sonvolɛma nwiɔ yɛɛ ɔ ra Ayezeke; akee ɔpepɛle ɛyɛne ne mɔɔ ɔfa yeayela azubɔdeɛ ne la, na ɔhɔle ɛleka ne mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛha kɛ ɔhɔ la. 4Bɛzile nu na ye kenle nsa ne azo, Ebileham nwunle ɛleka ne kɛ ɔwɔ moa moa nehane. 5Ebileham zele ye sonvolɛma nwiɔ ne kɛ, “Bɛ nee asoaso ne ɛhendɛ ɛke, na me nee kpavolɛ ye yɛkɔ nehane yeahɔzonle na yɛara.”
6Akee Ebileham vale ɛyɛne ne zoale ɔ ra Ayezeke na ɔdaye ɔvale senle ne nee dadeɛ ne. Na bɛ mu nwiɔ bɛzile nu kɛ bɛkɔ. 7Ayezeke vɛlɛle ɔ ze Ebileham, “Egya!”
Na ɔliele zo, “Me ra nrenya, mewɔ ɛke.”
Ayezeke bizale ye kɛ, “Senle ne nee ɛyɛne ne ɛne, na boane ralɛ ne mɔɔ yɛkayela ye yɛabɔ azu ne la wɔ nienwu?”
8Ebileham buale kɛ, “Me ra nrenya, Nyamenle ɔdaye ɔbava boane ralɛ holɛ ko mɔɔ yɛbayela yɛabɔ azu ne la yeamaa yɛ.” Na bɛ mu nwiɔ bɛluale nwolɛ bɛhɔle.
9 Mɔɔ bɛhɔdwule ɛleka ne mɔɔ Nyamenle hanle nwolɛ edwɛkɛ hilele Ebileham la, Ebileham zile azukponle wɔ ɛkɛ ne, ɔvale ɛyɛne ne ɔguale zolɛ, na ɔkyekyele ɔ ra Ayezeke ɔdole azukponle ne azo, wɔ ɛyɛne ne azo. 10Akee Ebileham dole ɔ sa vale dadeɛ ne kɛ ɔku ɔ ra ne. 11Na Ɛdɛnkɛma soanvolɛ vɛlɛle ye vile anwuma, ɔse, “Ebileham, Ebileham!”
Ebileham liele zolɛ, “Mewɔ ɛke!”
12Ɛdɛnkɛma soanvolɛ ne zele ye kɛ, “Mmafa ɛ sa ɛka kakula ne anzɛɛ mmayɛ ye debie. Ɔluakɛ kɛkala, menwu kɛ ɛsulo Nyamenle, ɔboalekɛ wɔanva ɛ ra kokye ne wɔanyɛ me abokɛ.”
13Na Ebileham manle ɔ nye zo na ɔnwunle kɛ, ɔ nzi ɛkɛ ne ala, boane nyinli kpole ko mɔɔ ye mɛne ne mɔ ɛmaa yetosa aziakɛ bie anu la gyi ɛkɛ. Ebileham hɔyele boane nyinli ne, ɔgyakyile ɔ ra ne na ɔvale boane ne ɔyelale ye, ɔbɔle azu ne. 14Yemɔti Ebileham vɛlɛle ɛleka ne, “Ɛdɛnkɛma bahile.” Na kɛkala bɔbɔ menli ka kɛ, “Wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Boka ne azo, ɔdaye ɔbahile.”
15Ɛdɛnkɛma soanvolɛ ne eza vɛlɛle Ebileham vi anwuma bieko, 16na ɔzele ye kɛ, “Ɛdɛnkɛma se, ‘Meka medame mumua ne me nwo kɛ, ɛhye mɔɔ wɔyɛ, na wɔanva ɛ ra nrenya kokye ne wɔanyɛ me abokɛ la, 17 mebayila wɔ na meamaa ɛ bo zo amra ayɛ dɔɔnwo kɛ anwomanyunlu nwɔlɔra nee ɛnweazo anwea. Ɛ bo zo amra bali bɛ agbɔvolɛ nwo zo konim na bɛazie bɛ, 18 na ɛ bo zo amra anwo zo yɛɛ maanle maanle mɔɔ wɔ ewiade la balua anyia nyilalɛ a, ɔboalekɛ wɔdie me ne.’ ” 19Yemɔti Ebileham ziale rale ye mgbavolɛ ne mɔ anwo ɛkɛ ne, na bɛ muala bɛziale bɛhɔle Biyɛhyiba. Na Ebileham dɛnlanle Biyɛhyiba.
Neehɔ abo zo amra
20Ɛhye mɔ anzi bɛhanle bɛhilele Ebileham kɛ, “Melekaa ɛwo mralɛ ɛmaa ɛ diema nrenya Neehɔ. Bɛ aluma ɛne: 21Ɛɛze a le kpanyinli a, ɔ diema nrenya a le Bɛɛze, Alam ɔ ze Kɛmuwɛle, 22Kɛsɛde, Heezo, Peledahye, Gyedelafe, yɛɛ Bɛtuwɛle.” 23Bɛtuwɛle a wole Relɛbɛka a. Ngakula mɔtwɛ ɛhye yɛɛ Melekaa wole bɛ manle Ebileham adiema nrenya Neehɔ a. 24Ye mgbɔnla Wulumaa ɔdaye noko ɔwole Tiba, Geeham, Teehahye, yɛɛ Meeyaka.

Title: MƆL 23
Content:
Sɛla ɛwu na Ebileham tɔ azɛlɛ azie ye
1Sɛla dɛnlanle aze lile ɛvolɛ ɛya ko, ɛvolɛ abulanwiɔ nee nsuu. 2Ɔwule Hibulɔn (Keleate Aaba), wɔ Keena maanle nu, na Ebileham zunle ye.
3Mɔɔ Sɛla wule la, Ebileham gyakyile funli ne ɛkɛ ne hɔle Hɛtema ɛkɛ ne na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, 4“Mele ɛyɛvolɛ a mede bɛ avinli ɛke a; bɛmaa me azɛlɛ mendɔ menyɛ me azie menzie me funli wɔ zolɛ.”
5Hɛtema buale ye kɛ, 6“Yɛmenle, tie mɔɔ yɛka la. Ɛle belemgbunli kpole a ɛwɔ yɛ avinli a. Ɛdawɔ neɛnlea yɛ nla ne mɔ na sie wɔ funli ne wɔ nla biala mɔɔ ɛkulo la anu. Yɛ nuhua biala ɛnrɛva ye nla ɛnrɛyɛ wɔ abokɛ, yɛɛ awie biala ɛnrɛgyegye wɔ wɔ funli ne ɛzielɛ nu.”
7Ebileham dwazole bɔle ɔ ti aze manle Hɛtema mɔɔ lɛ azɛlɛ ne la, yɛle bɛ mo 8na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Saa bɛkulo kɛ mesie me funli ne a, ɛnee mesɛlɛ bɛ, bɛzɛlɛ Zohaa ara Yifolɔn 9bɛmaa ɔva ye bolɛ bɔne ne mɔɔ wɔ Makepilaa la ɔmaa me. Ɔwɔ ye azɛlɛ ne abo lɔ. Metɔ meadua ye kakɛ wɔ bɛdabɛ bɛ nyunlu ɛke, na meava meayɛ azie.”
10Ɛnee Yifolɔn de Hɛtema ne avinli, na ɔbuale Ebileham ɔmanle Hɛtema mɔɔ yiale ɛkɛ ne la kɔsɔɔti dele. Ɔse, 11“Me menle, kyɛkyɛ, tie mɔɔ meka la. Mefa azɛlɛ ne memaa wɔ, yɛɛ bolɛ bɔne ne mɔɔ wɔ zolɛ la le wɔ ɛdeɛ. Mefa memaa wɔ, wɔ me menli ye mɔɔ ɛyia ɛke la amuala anyunlu. Fa sie wɔ funli ne.”
12Na Ebileham dwazole bɔle ɔ ti aze wɔ Hɛtema anyunlu, 13na ɔhanle ɔhilele Yifolɔn, ɔmanle Hɛtema mɔɔ ɛrayia ɛkɛ ne la amuala dele bie kɛ, “Mesɛlɛ wɔ, tie medame noko. Metua azɛlɛ ne kakɛ. Die, na maa menzie me funli ne wɔ zolɛ.”
14Yifolɔn buale Ebileham kɛ, 15“Me menle, tie me. Azɛlɛ mɔɔ bɛtɔ ye dwɛtɛ fufule ɛya nna la le duzu wɔ yɛ mu nwiɔ yɛ avinli? Wɔmɔ kɔzie wɔ funli ne wɔ ɛkɛ.” 16Ebileham kponlenle zolɛ na ɔzuzule dwɛtɛ fufule ne ɔmanle Yifolɔn, ɔmanle Hɛtema mɔɔ rayiale ɛkɛ ne la amuala nwunle ye. Ɔle dwɛtɛ fufule ɛya nna, kɛmɔ gualilɛma ɛzuzudeɛ ne mɔɔ bɛfa bɛsuzu bɛ ezukoa la kile la.
17Yemɔti Yifolɔn azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ wɔ Makepilaa, bolɛ bɔne ne mɔɔ wɔ zolɛ, yɛɛ mbaka kɔsɔɔti mɔɔ wɔ zolɛ la 18rayɛle Ebileham ɛdeɛ, kɛ ɔdaye ye agyadeɛ ɔ, wɔ Hɛtema mɔɔ rayiale la kɔsɔɔti anyunlu.
19Ɛhye anzi akee Ebileham hɔziele ɔ ye Sɛla wɔ bolɛ bɔne ne mɔɔ wɔ Makepilaa mɔɔ wɔ Mameli aduduleɛ la anu, wɔ Keena azɛlɛ zo. 20Hɛtema vale azɛlɛ ne manle Ebileham yɛle ye ɛdeɛ kɛ ɔva ɔyɛ azie.

Title: MƆL 24
Content:
Bɛgya raalɛ bɛamaa Ayezeke
1Akee Ebileham yɛle kpanyinli kpalɛ, ɔyɛle ɛrelera nwosonwoso. Ɛdɛnkɛma noko ɛyila ye wɔ debie biala anu. 2Na Ebileham zele ye sonvolɛ ne mɔɔ le kpanyinli tɛla sonvolɛma mɔɔ wɔ sua nu ɛkɛ, na eza ɔnea ninyɛne mɔɔ wɔ sua nu ɛkɛ ne la amuala azo la kɛ, “Fa ɛ sa fula me ɛzɔlɛ nu. 3Mekulo kɛ ɛfa Ɛdɛnkɛma, Nyamenle ne mɔɔ bɔle anwuma nee aze la ɛka ndane kɛ, ɛnrɛgya Keenama mɔɔ mede bɛ avinli la amra mraalɛ ne mɔ bie ɛnrɛmaa me ra nrenya ne, 4na ɛkɛhɔ me maanle nu wɔ me nwo amra anu, na ɛkɛhɔgya raalɛ ɛkɛmaa me ra Ayezeke.”
5Sonvolɛ ne bizale ye kɛ, “Na saa ngyengyene nu bie ala raalɛ ne se kɛ ɔnrɛra ɛke a, ɛnee memanva ɛ ra nrenya ye mengɔ maanle ne mɔɔ ɛvi nu ɛrale la anu ɔ?”
6Ebileham buale ye kɛ, “Nea boɛ na wɔanva me ra nrenya ne wɔanzia wɔangɔ maanle zɔhane anu. 7Ɛdɛnkɛma, Nyamenle ne mɔɔ wɔ anwuma, mɔɔ yele me vile egya sua nu nee azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ me kotoa nyɛma la zolɛ la azo, na ɔdendɛle ɔhilele me, ɔbɔle me ɛwɔkɛ kɛ, ‘Ɛ bo zo amra yɛɛ mebava azɛlɛ ɛhye meamaa bɛ’ la, bamaa ye soanvolɛ alumua ɛ nyunlu, na wɔagya raalɛ wɔ ɛkɛ ne wɔarɛlɛ me ra ye. 8Na saa raalɛ ne se kɛ ɔ nee wɔ ɛnrɛra a, ɛndo ndane ne mɔɔ melɛmaa wɔaha la; noko mmafa me ra nrenya ne ɛsia ɛkɔ lɔ.” 9Yemɔti sonvolɛ ne vale ɔ sa vulale ɔ menle Ebileham ɛzɔlɛ nu na ɔhanle ndane ɔhilele Ebileham wɔ edwɛkɛ ɛhye anwo.
10Akee sonvolɛ ne vale ɔ menle afunlumu ne mɔ anu bulu na ɔzile nu ɔhɔle. Ɔvale ahyɛlɛ ninyɛne dɔɔnwo mɔɔ ɔ menle ne ɛnlea ɛkpa nu ɛyeye la, na ɔhɔle Mɛsɔpɔteemea maanzinli nu suakpole ne mɔɔ Neehɔ dɛnlanle zolɛ la azo. 11Ɔhɔdwule sua ne kandiba la, ɔmanle afunlumu ne mɔ hotohotole suakpole ne bane ne anzi wɔ bula ne azo. Ɛnee aleɛ ɛlɛmua nwolɛ na yedwu mekɛ mɔɔ mraalɛ ne mɔ sesa nzule a. 12Na sonvolɛ ne zele kɛ, “O Ɛdɛnkɛma, me menle Ebileham Nyamenle, maa menli konim ɛnɛ kenle ye. Mesɛlɛ wɔ, kile ɛhulolɛ kpundii mɔɔ ɛlɛ wɔ me menle Ebileham anwo la. 13Megyi bula ye azo ɛke, yɛɛ menli mɔɔ wɔ suakpole ɛhye azo la amra mraalɛ ɛbɔ ɔ bo kɛ bɛba bɛarasesa nzule. 14Maa kakula raalɛ ne mɔɔ menwɔze ye kɛ, ‘Mesɛlɛ wɔ, ka wɔ dwora ne aze maa meno wɔ nzule ne bie,’ na ɔkɛbua me kɛ, ‘No bie, na maa memaa wɔ afunlumu ne mɔ bie bɛnlo’ la, ɛyɛ sonla ne mɔɔ ɛdawɔ wɔkpa nu wɔye ye wɔmaa Ayezeke la. Ɛhye bamaa meanwu kɛ wɔhulo me menle ne kpole kpalɛ.”
15Sonvolɛ ne anloa ampe, yɛɛ Ebileham adiema nrenya Neehɔ nee ɔ ye Melekaa bɛ ra nrenya Bɛtuwɛle ara raalɛ Relɛbɛka zo dwora ɔ kɔme zo ravindele ɛkɛ ne a. 16Kakula raalɛ ne anwo yɛ fɛ; ɔle bɛlɛra mɔɔ nrenya ɛtɛfale ye ɛlɛ a. Ɔhɔle nzubula ne anloa ɔhɔzale nzule na ɔvole. 17Sonvolɛ ne nriandile hɔyiale ye na ɔzele ye kɛ, “Mesɛlɛ wɔ, maa meno nzule ne mɔɔ wɔ wɔ dwora ne anu la bie.”
18Bɛlɛra ne buale kɛ, “Me menle, no bie.” Na ɔhanle ye dwora ne aze, ɔlɛle ye ɔ sa nu ɔmanle ɔnlonle nzule ne bie. 19Bɛlɛra ne manle sonvolɛ ne nzule ne bie nlonle na ɔwiele la, ɔhanle kɛ, “Mekaza nzule ne bie mearɛlɛ wɔ afunlumu ne mɔ noko, kɔkpula kɛ bɛ muala bɛkɛnlo bie la.” 20Ɛkɛ ne ala ɔwolale mɔɔ ɔzo la ɔguale kyɛnze ne mɔɔ bɛgua afunlumu ne mɔ nzule nu la anu. Ɔnriandile ɔhɔle nzubula ne anloa ɔhɔzale nzule ne bie ɔrɛlɛle afunlumu ne mɔ amuala ɔmanle bɛnlonle. 21Nrenya ne nleanle Relɛbɛka koonwu na ɔyɛle kɛ ɔnea saa Ɛdɛnkɛma gyi ɔ nzi wɔ ye adendulɛ ne anu a.
22Mɔɔ afunlumu ne mɔ wiele nzule no la, sonvolɛ ne vale ezukoa nvutuke ngɛba mɔɔ ye bolɛ yɛ se la zɔle bɛlɛra ne abonyi na ɔvale nwiɔ noko ɔguale ɔ sa. 23Na ɔzele kɛ, “Ɛ ze a le nwane? Ka kile me. Asoo ɛ ze lɛ sua wɔ ɛkɛ ne mɔɔ yɛkola yɛbasokoɛ nu a?”
24Relɛbɛka buale kɛ, “Neehɔ nee ɔ ye Melekaa bɛ ra nrenya Bɛtuwɛle ara raalɛ a le me.” 25Ɔvale ɔzɔle zolɛ kɛ, “Yɛlɛ ndile nee nya nya mɔɔ nane di a, yɛɛ eza yɛlɛ sua mɔɔ bɛbala nu a.”
26Sonvolɛ ne bɔle ɔ ti aze zonlenle Ɛdɛnkɛma 27zele kɛ, “Ayɛlɛyelɛ ɛha Ɛdɛnkɛma, me menle Ebileham Nyamenle ne. Ɔ rɛle ɛtɛfile ye ɛwɔkɛ mɔɔ ɔbɔle me menle, nee ye ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne mɔɔ ɔkulo ye la. Na mame, Ɛdɛnkɛma ɔdaye mumua ne yelie me gyɛlɛɛnye yeva me yera me menle anwo amra sua nu.”
28Akee Relɛbɛka nriandile hɔhanle edwɛkɛ ne hilele ɔ nli awuke nu amra. 29Relɛbɛka lɛ ɔ diema nrenya ko, bɛfɛlɛ ye Leeban. Na Leeban nriandile doale sonvolɛ ne wɔ nzubula ne anloa lɔ. 30Mɔɔ Leeban nwunle bɛ bonyi nee bɛ sa ngɛba ne mɔ mɔɔ nrenya ne ɛva ɛziezie Relɛbɛka na ɔdele edwɛkɛ mɔɔ ɔ diema raalɛ ne hanle ye wɔ nwolɛ amuala la, ɔhɔle sonvolɛ ne anwo lɔ na ɔhɔdole ye kɛ ɔgyi ye afunlumu ne mɔ anwo ɛkɛ, wɔ nzubula ne anloa. 31Ɔzele ye kɛ, “Wɔmɔ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛyila wɔ a, bɛla. Mmagyinla ahane nehane. Ɔluakɛ meziezie ɛleka memaa wɔ nee wɔ afunlumu ne mɔ.”
32Yemɔti nrenya ne rale sua nu; Leeban zianyinle ye afunlumu ne mɔ na ɔmanle bɛ ndile nee nya nya. Ɔmanle nrenya ne nee ye menli mɔɔ ɔ nee bɛ lua la nzule bɛnrinzinle bɛ gyakɛ anwo. 33Akee bɛmanle bɛ debie kɛ bɛli. Na nrenya ne zele kɛ, “Saa metɛbɔle me amaneɛ ne a, menrɛli debie.”
Leeban zele kɛ, “Bɔ wɔ amaneɛ ne.”
34Nrenya ne zele kɛ, “Mele Ebileham sonvolɛ. 35Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛyila me menle kpole kpalɛ, yɛɛ yeyɛ sonlakpole. Yemaa yenyia mboane nee nlankɛ dɔɔnwo; yenyia ezukoa nvutuke nee dwɛtɛ fufule dɔɔnwo. Ɔlɛ ye sonvolɛ mrenya nee mraalɛ, yɛɛ afunlumu nee asoaso. 36Me menle aye Sɛla yɛle kpanyinli kpalɛ la, ɔwole ralɛ nrenya. Na ralɛ nrenya zɔhane yɛɛ me menle ne ɛva debie biala mɔɔ ɔlɛ la ɛmaa ye a. 37Me menle ɛmaa meha ndane, ɔse, ‘Mmagya Keenama mɔɔ mede bɛ avinli la mbɛlɛra ne mɔ bie ɛmaa me ra nrenya ne. 38Kɔ me maanle nu, me ze sua nu, medame me nwo amra anu, na kɔgya raalɛ maa me ra nrenya ne.’ 39Membizale ye kɛ, ‘Na saa raalɛ ne se kɛ ɔnrɛra ɛ?’ 40Na ɔbuale me kɛ, ‘Ɛdɛnkɛma mɔɔ mesonle ye la bamaa ye soanvolɛ nee wɔ ahɔ na yeamaa ɛ nwo ayɛ moavolɛ, na wɔagya raalɛ wɔ me nwo amra avinli, wɔ egya sua nu, wɔamaa me ra nrenya ne. 41Saa ɛyɛ ye zɔhane na bɛanva raalɛ ne bɛammaa wɔ a, yemɔ ɛnee ɛndo ndane ne mɔɔ wɔha la.’
42“Ɛnɛ ala a membandwule nzubula ne anwo a, na menganle kɛ, ‘O Ɛdɛnkɛma, me menle Ebileham Nyamenle, saa amgba ala me adendulɛ ye kɛyɛ saleɛ a, 43ɛnee kɛkala mɔɔ megyi nzubula ye anloa la, maa kakula raalɛ mɔɔ kɛra kɛ ɔbaza nzule, na menwɔze ye kɛ: Mesɛlɛ wɔ, maa me wɔ nzule ne ekyi meno,’ 44na ɔkɛze me kɛ, ‘Banlo bie, na maa menza bie memaa wɔ afunlumu ne mɔ la ɛyɛ raalɛ ne mɔɔ ɛdawɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma wɔye ye kɛ mengya ye memaa me menle ara nrenya ne la.’ 45Me nloa ampe bɔbɔ, yɛɛ Relɛbɛka ravindele ɛkɛ ne a, ɔzo ye dwora ɔ kɔme zo kɛ ɔbaza nzule. Ɔzale nzule ne la, menzele ye kɛ, ‘Mesɛlɛ wɔ, maa meno bie.’ 46Ɛkɛ ne ala ɔhanle ye dwora ne aze na ɔzele kɛ, ‘No bie, na eza mebaza bie meamaa wɔ afunlumu ne mɔ noko anlo.’ 47Akee membizale ye kɛ, ‘Nwane ara raalɛ a le wɔ?’ Ɔzele me kɛ, ‘Mele Neehɔ nee ɔ ye Melekaa bɛ ra nrenya Bɛtuwɛle ara raalɛ.’ Yemɔti menvale ngɛba menzɔle ɔ bonyi na menvale bie menguale ɔ sa. 48Akee membɔle me ti aze na menzonlenle Ɛdɛnkɛma, na menyele Ɛdɛnkɛma, me menle Ebileham Nyamenle ne ayɛlɛ, kɛ yeva me yelua adenle kpalɛ zo yemaa menyia raalɛ wɔ me menle anwo amra anu memaa ɔ ra nrenya ne a. 49Zɔhane ati, saa bɛkɛkponle na bɛkɛli nɔhalɛ bɛkɛmaa me menle ne ɛdeɛ a, ɛnee bɛha. Saa bɛnrɛkponle noko a, eza bɛha, amaa meanwu me bɛne nee me fema.”
