Fa ngyenle gua nu maa ɔ nye ɛde na ɔyɛ nwuanzanwuanza. 36Ti bie motomoto na fa bie sie Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne mɔɔ gyi Ndanlɛ Sua ne anu la anyunlu, ɛleka mɔɔ mebayia wɔ la. Nwu ye kɛ ɛyɛlɛ ɛhye le nwuanzanwuanza. 37Ninyɛne mɔɔ ɛbava wɔayɛ ɛyɛlɛ ɛhye la, bɛmmafa bie bɛyɛ ɛyɛlɛ ne bie bɛdabɛ bɛfa. Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛnwu kɛ ɔle debie nwuanzanwuanza mɔɔ bɛdu bɛzie ahane bɛmaa medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a. 38Awie biala mɔɔ kɛyɛ ye ko ne ala bie kɛyɛ ɔ nwo la, bɛye ye bɛvi ye menli ne avinli.”

Title: ADE 31
Content:
Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne dwinvolɛma
(Ade 35.30—36.1)
1Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi kɛ, 2“Nea, meye Yulae ara nrenya Bɛzalii, mɔɔ ɔ nlenya a le Huuli mɔɔ vi Dwuda abusua ekpunli ne anu la, 3na meva Nyamenle Sunsum ne meyi ye tɛkɛɛ. Memaa ye nrɛlɛbɛ nee ndelebɛbo, adwenle nee adwinli ngakyile muala anwo adwenle, 4mɔɔ ɔkola ɔfa ezukoa nvutuke, dwɛtɛ fufule, yɛɛ kɔbele ɔdi adwinli, 5ɔsiezie awolɛ nwo, ɔse mbaka, na ɔdi adwinli ngakyile biala a. 6Eza meye Ahesamake ara nrenya Oholeabe noko mɔɔ vi Dan abusua ekpunli ne anu la kɛ ɔ nee ye ɛyɛ gyima. Eza memaa dwinvolɛma gyɛne gyɛne adwenle kpole, amaa bɛahola debie biala mɔɔ meze wɔ kɛ ɛyɛ la yɛ. 7Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne, Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne nee anwunvɔnezelɛ ebia ne mɔɔ dua zolɛ la, yɛɛ Ndanlɛ Sua ne anu ɛziezielɛ ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti, 8ɛkponle ne nee nwolɛ ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti, ɛyɛlɛ ɛyelalɛ azukponle ne, 9ɛyelalɛ azubɔlɛ azukponle ne nee nwolɛ ninyɛne, kyɛnze ne mɔɔ bɛwowo bɛ sa nee bɛ gyakɛ anwo nuhua nee ɔ bo ne, 10Aalɔn nee ɔ mra mrenya ne mɔ sɛlɛvolɛ adɛladeɛ ngɛnlɛma ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛbawula bɛazonle la, 11ɛkpokpalɛ nwole ne, yɛɛ Ɛleka Nwuanzanwuanza ne ɛyɛlɛ evuanlɛ ne; ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ kɔsɔɔti, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛyɛ bɛ kɛ mɔɔ meze wɔ la.”
Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ne
12Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi kɛ, 13“Ka kile Yizilayɛma kɛ: Bɛzie me Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ne, ɔboalekɛ ɔle sɛkɛlɛneɛ ɔmaa bɛ nee medame wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bara la amuala kɛ medame, Ɛdɛnkɛma a mede bɛ nwo meyɛ bɛ me menli a. 14Bɛzie Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ne, ɔboalekɛ ɔle nwuanzanwuanza. Awie biala mɔɔ anzie Kenle ne la, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛku ye. Awie biala mɔɔ kɛyɛ gyima wɔ nu la, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛye ye bɛfi ye menli avinli. 15Kenle nsia yɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛfa bɛyɛ gyima a, na kenle ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nsuu ne la le Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle, bɛdu bɛzie ɛkɛ bɛmaa me. Awie biala mɔɔ kɛyɛ gyima kenle ko ne la, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛku ye. 16Ɔwɔ kɛ Yizilayɛma sie kenle ɛhye mekɛ biala, bɛkile kɛ ɔle ngyekyeleɛ mɔɔ bɛntulu ye ɛlɛ la anwo sɛkɛlɛneɛ. 17Ɔle sɛkɛlɛneɛ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ mɔɔ wɔ Yizilayɛma nee medame yɛ avinli a, ɔboalekɛ medame, Ɛdɛnkɛma, menvale kenle nsia membɔle anwuma nee aze, ye kenle nsuu ne azo, mengyakyile gyima menliele me ɛnwomenle.”
18Mɔɔ Nyamenle wiele tendɛ kile Mosisi wɔ Saenae Boka ne azo la, ɔvale awolɛ ndɛbandɛba nwiɔ ne mɔɔ Nyamenle mumua ne ɛva ɔ sa ɛrɛlɛsɛka ɛhɛlɛ mɛla ne mɔ zolɛ la ɔmanle Mosisi.

Title: ADE 32
Content:
Ezukoa nvutuke ɛnlankɛ nyinli ne
(Mɛla 9.6-29)
1 Mɔɔ menli ne nwunle kɛ Mosisi akee ɛhyɛ somaa wɔ boka ne azo na ɔmba la, bɛ muala bɛhɔle Aalɔn anwo ɛkɛ bɛhɔzele ye kɛ, “Maa ɔyɛ ndɛndɛ maa yɛ nyamenle maa ɔli yɛ nyunlu, ɔluakɛ Mosisi ɛhye, mɔɔ yemɔ a le sonla mɔɔ yele yɛ vile Yigyibiti azɛlɛ zo la, yɛnze mɔɔ kɛkala ɛzi ɔ nwo zo a.”
2Na Aalɔn zele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛyeye ezukoa nvutuke asomadeɛ mɔɔ wɔ bɛ ye mɔ, bɛ mra mrenya, nee bɛ mra mraalɛ ne mɔ anzo nu la bɛrɛlɛ me.” 3Yemɔti menli ne amuala yeyele ezukoa nvutuke asomadeɛ mɔɔ wɔ bɛ nzo nu la manle Aalɔn. 4Ɔliele nvutuke asomadeɛ ne mɔ wɔ bɛdabɛ mumua ne bɛ sa nu na ɔholole ɔguale ɛnlankɛ nyinli ananze ɔmanle bɛ.
Menli ne hanle kɛ, “O Yizilayɛ, yɛ nyamenle ne mɔɔ yele yɛ vile Yigyibiti la, yemɔ ɛne!”
5Mɔɔ Aalɔn nwunle ɛhye la, ɔzile azukponle wɔ ɛnlankɛ nyinli ne anyunlu ɛkɛ, na ɔbɔle ye nolo ɔhanle kɛ, “Ɛhyema yɛbali ɛvoyia kpole yeawula Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlunyia.” 6Aleɛ hyenle nwonlomɔ mangyee ne la bɛbɔle ɛyelalɛ azu na bɛvale anzonudwolɛ azubɔdeɛ bɛrale. Akee menli ne dɛnlanle aze lile nlonle na bɛzile agole.
7Na Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi kɛ, “Maa ɔyɛ ndɛndɛ tolo kɔ, ɔluakɛ wɔ menli ne mɔɔ ɛyele bɛ ɛvile Yigyibiti azɛlɛ zo la ɛyɛ ɛtane na bɛkpo me. 8Adenle ne mɔɔ mengilele bɛ kɛ bɛlua nu la, bɛanlua nuhua; bɛgua ɛnlankɛ nyinli ananze na bɛzonle ye, bɛbɔ azu bɛmaa ye na bɛha kɛ, ‘O Yizilayɛ, yɛ nyamenle ne mɔɔ yele yɛ vile Yigyibiti azɛlɛ zo la, yemɔ ɛne!’ 9Menwu kɛ menli ne le dapele, 10yemɔti gyakyi me maa menkpokpo me ɛya ne mengua bɛ nwo zo, membɔ bɛ bo zo bɔkɔɔ. Na wɔmɔ, mebayɛ wɔ maanle kpole.”
11Na Mosisi bodole Ɛdɛnkɛma, ye Nyamenle ne kɛ, “O Ɛdɛnkɛma, duzu ati a wɔva wɔ menli mɔɔ ɛdawɔ wɔva tumi nee anwosesebɛ wɔye bɛ wɔvi Yigyibiti azɛlɛ zo la anwo ɛya kpole zɛhae a? Duzu ati a ɔwɔ kɛ Yigyibitima ka ye kɛ, ɛvale adwenle ɛtane a ɛyele bɛ ɛvile Yigyibiti a, kɛ ɛ nee bɛ ba wɔarahu bɛ wɔ awoka ye azo na wɔabɔ bɛ bo zo wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo a? 12Gua wɔ edwɛne azule nu; mmakakyi wɔ adwenle ɛmaa munzule to bɛ. 13Kakye wɔ sonvolɛma, Ebileham, Ayezeke, yɛɛ Gyekɔbo mɔɔ ɛdawɔ mumua ne ɛhanle ndane ɛbɔle bɛ ɛwɔkɛ kɛ, ‘Mebamaa bɛ bo zo amra azo kɛ anwomanyunlu nwɔlɔra, azɛlɛ ɛhye amuala mɔɔ meva mebɔ ɛwɔkɛ la, mebava meamaa bɛ bo zo amra, na ɔbayɛ bɛ agyadeɛ wɔ melɛ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ’ la.” 14Yemɔti Ɛdɛnkɛma hakyile ye adwenle. Yeammaa munzule ne mɔɔ ɔdwenlenle nwolɛ la amba menli ne anwo zo.
15Akee Mosisi vale awolɛ ndɛbandɛba nwiɔ ne mɔɔ bɛhɛlɛ mɛla ne mɔ wɔ bɛ nyunlu nee bɛ nzi la vi boka ne azo tolole rale. 16Nyamenle mumua ne a zele awolɛ ndɛbandɛba ne mɔ a, yɛɛ ɔdaye mumua ne a ɔhɛlɛle mɛla ne mɔ wɔ zolɛ a.
17Mɔɔ Dwɔhyua dele menli ne mɔ ane kɛ bɛlɛteɛdea nuhua la, ɔhanle ɔhilele Mosisi kɛ, “Mete konle nganeɛ wɔ azokoɛleɛ lɔ.”
18Na Mosisi hanle kɛ, “Ɛdeanlɛ ne ɛnle ɛdeanlɛ mɔɔ kile konimlilɛ yɛɛ ɔngile kɛ bɛli bɛ nwo zo konim. Mete edwɛndolɛ ala.”
19Mɔɔ Mosisi bikyele azokoɛleɛ ne na ɔnwunle ɛnlankɛ nyinli ananze ne nee nwolɛ agolezilɛ ne la, ye ahonle futule kpole kpalɛ. Ye ɛya ne bole ɔ nwo zo manle ɔvuandinle awolɛ ndɛbandɛba ne mɔ mɔɔ Mɛla Bulu ne wɔ zolɛ la ɔguale boka ne abo aze ɔbubule bɛ. 20Ɔvale ɛnlankɛ ananze ne mɔɔ bɛyɛ la, ɔvale senle ɔholole, ɔdinle ɔmanle ɔyɛle motomoto kɛ munlutu, na ɔvale ɔguale nzule ne mɔɔ bɛno la anu ɔmanle Yizilayɛma nlonle. 21Mosisi bizale Aalɔn kɛ, “Na duzu ɛweɛleɛ a menli ne vale yɛle wɔ mɔɔ yemɔti wɔmaa bɛyɛ ɛtane kpole ɛhye a?”
22Na Aalɔn zele ye kɛ, “Me menle, mmafa me nwo ɛya. Ɛdawɔ ɛze kɛ ɛtane ala a wɔ menli ne adwenle nu a. 23Bɛhanle bɛhilele me kɛ, ‘Maa yɛ nyamenle maa ɔli yɛ nyunlu, ɔluakɛ Mosisi ne mɔɔ yele yɛ vile Yigyibiti azɛlɛ zo la, yɛnze mɔɔ ɛzi ɔ nwo zo a.’ 24Na menganle mengilele bɛ kɛ, ‘Awie biala ɛva ye nvutuke anwoneɛ biala mɔɔ ɔlɛ la ɔmaa me.’ Yemɔti bɛvale bɛmanle me; menvuandinle menguale senle nu na ɛnlankɛ ɛhye a vindele nu a.”
25Na Mosisi nwunle kɛ menli ne ɛbɔ atondo, ɔluakɛ Aalɔn ɛmaa bɛbɔ atondo na nyiane akee ɛlɛku bɛ wɔ bɛ kpɔvolɛma anyunlu. 26Yemɔti ɔgyinlanle azokoɛleɛ ne anuhɔlɛ kpole ne anloa na ɔdeanle nu ɔhanle kɛ, “Awie biala mɔɔ wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma afoa la ɛrɛla.” Na Livaema ne kɔsɔɔti pianle bɛ nwo hɔle ye afoa. 27Na ɔhanle ɔhilele bɛ kɛ, “Kɛ Yizilayɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle ne se la ɛne, ‘Awie biala ɛva ye dadeɛ ne ɛhɔ azokoɛleɛ ye ɛleka biala, ɔvi anuhɔlɛ ɔhɔ anuhɔlɛ na ɔhu awie biala, ɔ diema, ɔ gɔnwo, yɛɛ menli mɔɔ ɔ nee bɛ zua la.’ ” 28Livaema ne yɛle mɔɔ Mosisi hanle la, na bɛhunle menli kɛyɛ apenle nsa kenle ko ne. 29Na Mosisi hanle kɛ, “Ɛnɛ, awie biala ɛva ɔ ra nrenya nee ɔ diema mogya ɛnlua ɔ nwo ɛwula ɔ nwo sɛlɛvolɛ wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛzonlenlɛ nu, amaa Ɛdɛnkɛma awola ye nyilalɛ agua bɛ nwo zo.”
30Aleɛ hyenle la Mosisi zele menli ne kɛ, “Bɛyɛ ɛtane kpole. Yemɔti mesia meahɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anwo lɔ wɔ boka ne azo. Wɔannea a mebahola meali bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ anwo mgbɔdalɛ.” 31Yemɔti Mosisi ziale hɔle Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛkɛ na ɔhanle kɛ, “Nɔhalɛ, menli ne ɛyɛ ɛtane kpole kpalɛ. Bɛdabɛ bɛva ezukoa nvutuke bɛyɛ bɛ nyamenle bɛzonle ye. 32 Mebodo wɔ, fa bɛ ɛtane ne kyɛ bɛ. Saa ɛfa ɛkyɛ bɛ na ɔnrɛyɛ boɛ a, ɛnee pɛ me duma nu wɔ buluku ne mɔɔ ɛhɛlɛle ye nu la anu.”
33Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi kɛ, “Ahenle ne mɔɔ ɛyɛ ɛtane ɛtia me la, yemɔ yɛɛ mebaye ye duma meavi buluku ne anu a. 34Na kɛkala, sia kɔva menli ne kɔ ɛleka ne mɔɔ mehile wɔ la. Me soanvolɛ bali ɛ nyunlu. Noko akee kenle mɔɔ mebara la, mebadea menli ne mɔ wɔ bɛ ɛtane ne ati.”
35Na Ɛdɛnkɛma vale ewule nzane deanle menli ne, ɔboalekɛ bɛhyele Aalɔn mialera nu bɛmanle ɔyɛle ɛnlankɛ nyinli ananze ne.

Title: ADE 33
Content:
Ɛdɛnkɛma se Yizilayɛma ɛvi Saenae Boka
1Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi kɛ, “Fa menli ne mɔɔ ɛ nee bɛ vi Yigyibiti azɛlɛ zo ɛra la fi ɛke kɔ azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ menganle ndane menvale membɔle Ebileham, Ayezeke, nee Gyekɔbo ɛwɔkɛ kɛ, mebava meamaa bɛ bo zo amra la azo. 2Mebamaa Nyamenle soanvolɛ ali bɛ nyunlu, na meavoa Keenama, Amɔlema, Hɛtema, Pɛlɛzema, Haevaema, yɛɛ Gyibɛsema. 3Bɛhɔ azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ kye aleɛ la azo; na mame, me nee bɛ ɛnrɛhɔ, anrɛɛ menwɔbɔ bɛ bo zo wɔ adenle nu, ɔluakɛ bɛle menli mɔɔ anzo yɛ se a.”
4Mɔɔ menli ne dele amaneɛ ɛtane ɛhye la, bɛlile nyane, bɛanva bɛ anwoneɛ ne mɔ bɛanziezie bɛ nwo bieko. 5Ɔluakɛ ɛnee Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛha ɛhile Mosisi kɛ, “Ka kile Yizilayɛma kɛ, ‘Bɛle menli anzosesebɛma mɔɔ saa me nee bɛ tudu agyakɛ ekyii bɔbɔ a, mebabɔ bɛ bo zo a. Yemɔti bɛyeye bɛ anwoneɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛva bɛziezie bɛ nwo la, amaa meanwu kɛ mesi meayɛ bɛ la.’ ” 6Yemɔti mɔɔ Yizilayɛma ne vile Saenae Boka la bɛyeyele bɛ anwoneɛ ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti.
Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne
7Saa Yizilayɛma yɛ azokoɛleɛ biala a Mosisi sie Ndanlɛ Sua ne maa ɔ nee azokoɛleɛ ne avinli twe; na ɔvɛlɛle ye Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyianu Ndanlɛ Sua. Awie biala mɔɔ kpondɛ kɛ ɔbiza Ɛdɛnkɛma debie la kɔ Nyianu Ndanlɛ Sua ne mɔɔ wɔ azokoɛleɛ ne kandiba la anu. 8Mekɛ biala mɔɔ Mosisi kɛze kɛ ɔkɔ Ndanlɛ Sua ne anu la, menli ne kɔsɔɔti dwazo gyinlegyinla bɛ ndanlɛ azua ne nlenkɛ ne mɔ anloa nea ye toonwo ɔkɔwolo nu. 9Kɛ Mosisi wolo Ndanlɛ Sua ne anu la, ɛnee amungu mpila ne ɛdwu aze ɛragyinla Ndanlɛ Sua ne anlenkɛ ne anloa, na Ɛdɛnkɛma adendɛ ahile Mosisi wɔ amungu ne anu. 10Saa menli ne mɔ nwu kɛ amungu mpila ne gyi Ndanlɛ Sua ne anlenkɛ ne anloa a, ɛnee bɛ kɔsɔɔti bɛdwazo bɛgyinlegyinla bɛ nlenkɛ ne mɔ anloa bɛlɛsonle. 11Ɛdɛnkɛma luale adenle zɛhae anu dendɛle hilele Mosisi, kɛmɔ sonla si tendɛ kile ɔ gɔnwo ala la. Saa Mosisi sia ba azokoɛleɛ ɛkɛ ne bieko a, ye sonvolɛ kpavolɛ ne, Nɛn ara nrenya Dwɔhyua ɛnvi Ndanlɛ Sua ne anu fee.
Ɛdɛnkɛma bɔ ɛwɔkɛ kɛ ɔ nee ye menli ne balua
12Mosisi hanle hilele Ɛdɛnkɛma kɛ, “Nɔhalɛ, wɔze me kɛ, ‘Di menli ɛhye ati fa bɛ kɔ azɛlɛ zɔhane azo’ noko ahenle mɔɔ baboka me la, ɛtɛkanle. Wɔze me kɛ ɛze me kpalɛ kpalɛ, yɛɛ eza mezɔ ɛ nye. 13Yemɔti mesɛlɛ wɔ, saa mezɔ ɛ nye ɛdeɛ a, ɛnee kile me wɔ ndenle ne mɔ, amaa meazonle wɔ na meazɔ ɛ nye dahuu. Eza kakye kɛ maanle ɛhye le wɔ menli.”
14Ɛdɛnkɛma zele kɛ, “Me nee wɔ bahɔ, yɛɛ mebamaa ɛ nzo nu adwo wɔ.”
15Mosisi buale ye kɛ, “Saa ɛ nee yɛ ɛnrɛhɔ ɛdeɛ a, ɛnee mmamaa yɛfi ɛke. 16Ɔluakɛ, kɛ ɔkɛyɛ na bɛanwu kɛ medame nee wɔ menli ne yɛsɔ ɛ nye ɛ? Wɔ ɛlualɛ mɔɔ ɛ nee yɛ lua la yɛɛ maa menli nwu ngakyile mɔɔ wɔ yɛ nee menli gyɛne gyɛne mɔɔ wɔ aleɛabo la avinli a.”
17Na Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi kɛ, “Edwɛkɛ kpɔkɛ ko ɛhye mɔɔ wɔha la ati, me nee bɛ bahɔ, ɔluakɛ meze wɔ kpalɛ kpalɛ, yɛɛ wɔzɔ me nye.”
18Mosisi bodole ye kɛ, “Mesɛlɛ wɔ, kile me wɔ anyunlunyia ne.”
19 Ɛdɛnkɛma buale ye kɛ, “Mebamaa me wienyi kpole ne ada ɛ nwo zo, na meado me duma ‘Ɛdɛnkɛma’ ne kpaanu meahile wɔ. Mebayɛ menli mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ meyɛ bɛ boɛ la boɛ, na meaze menli mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ mese bɛ anwunvɔne la anwunvɔne. 20Noko akee ɛnrɛnwu me nyunlu, ɔluakɛ awie biala ɛnrɛnwu me nyunlu na ɔnrɛdɛnla ngoane nu. 21Nea, bodane bie wɔ me foa ko ɛke mɔɔ ɛbagyinla zolɛ a. 22Mekɛ mɔɔ me anyunlunyia ne kɛze kɛ ɔpɛ nu la, mebava wɔ meawula bodane ne kuma bie anu, meava me sa meaheda zolɛ kɔkpula kɛ menwɔpɛ nu menwɔze la. 23Akee mebaye me sa, ɛbanwu me kɔme anzi, na me nyunlu ɛdeɛ, ɛnrɛnwu ye.”

Title: ADE 34
Content:
Awolɛ ndɛbandɛba ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nwiɔ
(Mɛla 10.1-5)
1Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi kɛ, “Se awolɛ ndɛbandɛba nwiɔ mɔɔ le kɛ alumua ɛdeɛ ne mɔ la. Mebahɛlɛ edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ mengɛlɛle wɔ alumua ɛdeɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ ɛbubule bɛ la azo la wɔ zolɛ. 2Boɔboa ɛ nwo na ɛhyema nwonlomɔ maa menwu ɛ nyunlu wɔ Saenae Boka ye azo. 3Ɛ nee awie biala mmaba. Ɔnle kɛ bɛnwu awie biala wɔ boka ye anwo ɛleka biala, yɛɛ mboane nee nlankɛ mmakɔ adidi wɔ boka ne abo.” 4Yemɔti Mosisi zele awolɛ ndɛbandɛba nwiɔ kɛ alumua ɛdeɛ ne mɔ ala la. Na kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma zele ye la, ɔdwazole nwonlomɔ ne na ɔvale awolɛ ne mɔ ɔhɔle Saenae Boka ne azo.
5Na Ɛdɛnkɛma dwule aze amungu ne anu, ɔragyinlanle ɔ nwo ɛkɛ na ɔbɔle ye duma Ɛdɛnkɛma ne. 6 Ɛdɛnkɛma akee zenle ɔ nyunlu ɛkɛ na ɔhanle kɛ, “Medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a, Ɛdɛnkɛma mɔɔ mele anwunvɔnezelɛ nee atiakunlukɛnlɛma Nyamenle, menva ɛya mgbane mgbane, yɛɛ ɛhulolɛ kpundii nee nɔhalɛlilɛ ɛyi me tɛkɛɛ. 7Me ɛhulolɛ kpole ne keda apenle apenle nwo zo. Mefa amumuyɛ, mɛladonlɛ, yɛɛ ɛtane mekyɛ; noko ɛhye ɛngile kɛ menrɛdea bɛ. Mebava bɛ ze mɔ ɛtane ne mɔ meadea bɛ mra nee bɛ nlɔnra toonwo yeahɔdwu awolɛndoazo nsa nee nna ne azo.”
8Na Mosisi bɔle ɔ ti aze ndɛndɛ na ɔzonlenle. 9Na ɔhanle kɛ, “O Awulae, mebodo wɔ, Awulae, menli ne le dapele bɔbɔ ɛdeɛ, noko mesɛlɛ wɔ, saa me nyunlu ɛra anyia wɔ ɛ nyunlu a, ɛnee ɛ nee yɛ ɛhɔ, fa yɛ munzule nee yɛ ɛtane ne mɔ kyɛ yɛ, na fa yɛ yɛ wɔ menli.”
Bɛkyekye Ngyekyeleɛ ne bieko
(Ade 23.14-19; Mɛla 7.1-5; 16.1-17)
10Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi kɛ, “Nea, me nee Yizilayɛma kyekye ngyekyeleɛ. Mebayɛ nwanwane ninyɛne mɔɔ bɛtɛyɛle bie wɔ aleɛabo anzɛɛ maanle biala anu ɛlɛ la, wɔ wɔ menli ne kɔsɔɔti anyunlu. Na menli ne mɔɔ ɛwɔ bɛ avinli la amuala banwu nwanwane ninyɛne mgbole mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛ la, ɔluakɛ debie mɔɔ mebamaa wɔayɛ la yɛ ɛzulolɛ.
11“Di mɔɔ meka meahile wɔ ɛnɛ la azo. Mebavoa Amɔlema, Keenama, Hɛtema, Pɛlɛzema, Haevaema, nee Gyibɛsema wɔ ɛ nyunlu. 12Nea boɛ na maanle ne mɔɔ ɛlɛkɔ nu la, ɛ nee menli ne anyɛ ngyekyeleɛ biala, anrɛɛ ɛkɛzua ɛ nwo ɛhane. 13 Bubu bɛ azukponle ne mɔ, tudu bɛ ɛzonlenlɛ mpila ne mɔ, na pepɛ bɛ bozonle raalɛ Ahyela sɛkɛlɛneɛ ne mɔ gua.
14“Ɔnle kɛ ɛsonle nyamenle gyɛne biala, ɔluakɛ medame Ɛdɛnkɛma mɔɔ me duma a le Nungule la, mele Nyamenle mɔɔ twe nungule a. 15Ɛ nee menli mɔɔ wɔ maanle ne anu la mmayɛ ngyekyeleɛ biala, amaa saa bɛdi bɛ awozonle ɛzonlenlɛ tuutuu ne na bɛabɔ azu bɛamaa bɛ awozonle ne mɔ a, bɛando ɛsalɛ bɛanvɛlɛ wɔ kɛ ɛraboka bɛ, na sɔnea ara ɛ nwo zo kɛ ɛli bɛ awozonle azubɔlɛ aleɛ ne bie. 16Wɔannea a eza bɛ mra mrenya bagya bɛ mra mraalɛ ne bie mɔ, na bɛ mra mrenya ne mɔ noko ali awozonle ɛzonlenlɛ tuutuu, amaa bɛ mra mrenya ne mɔ noko ali awozonle ɛzonlenlɛ tuutuu azonle bɛ awozonle ne mɔ.
17 “Bɛmmagua awozonle ananze biala bɛmaa bɛ nwo na bɛsonle bɛ.
18 “Bɛzie Angye Ɛvoyia ne na bɛli, kɛmɔ meha mehile bɛ la. Bɛli Ɛvoyia ne kenle nsuu wɔ siane Ebebe ne anu, ɔboalekɛ siane zɔhane anu a bɛvile Yigyibiti a.
19“Belamunli ralɛ nrenya biala, yɛɛ ɛnlankɛ nee boane biala ara nyinli mɔɔ bɛkɛlumua bɛkɛwo ye la le me ɛdeɛ. 20Noko akee ɛkola ɛfa boane ralɛ nyinli ɛsie asoaso ralɛ nyinli abo zo. Saa ɛnrɛzie ɔ bo zo a, ɛnee bu ɔ kɔme. Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛkpɔne bɛ belamunli mralɛ mrenya kɔsɔɔti.
“Biala mmafa ɔ sa mgbane finde me nyunlu. 21 Bɛyɛ gyima kenle nsia, na kenle nsuu ne azo, saa ɛyazonlɛ anzɛɛ ɛbuhenle o, bɛlie bɛ ɛnwomenle.
22“Saa bɛbɔ ɔ bo kɛ bɛte hwiiti a, bɛli Bɛyɔba Ɛvoyia ne, yɛɛ saa ɛvolɛ awieleɛ ma nloa ɛboɔboalɛ ne wie a, bɛli Kpɔda Bo Ɛdɛnlanlɛ Ɛvoyia ne.
23“Ɛvolɛ biala bɛ mrenya ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti ɛrazonle medame Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne fane nsa. 24Ɔluakɛ mebadu menli mɔɔ wɔ maanle maanle mɔɔ wɔ bɛ nyunlu la na meamaa bɛ maanle ne adɛlɛ. Saa ɛvolɛ biala bɛsonle medame Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne fane nsa ne a, bɛ azɛlɛ ne ɛnrɛvi bɛ sa ɛlɛ.
25“Bɛmmafa nane mɔɔ bɛku ye bɛabɔ azu bɛamaa me la bɛboka kpanwo mɔɔ mgbɔvonle wɔ nu la bɛbɔ azu ne bɛmaa me. Saa bɛdi Akpabɛnwo Ɛvoyia ne azubɔdeɛ ne a, bɛmmamaa bie ka aleɛ kye zolɛ.
26“Ɛvolɛ biala ma mɔɔ bɛkɛlumua bɛkɛde la, bɛva bɛrɛlɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne.
“Bɛmmato boane anzɛɛ abɔnkye ralɛ biala wɔ ɔ nli nyɛfonzule nu bɛdi.”
27Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi kɛ, “Kɛlɛ edwɛkɛ ɛhye, ɔluakɛ edwɛkɛ ɛhye azo a mebalua me nee wɔ nee Yizilayɛma akyekye ngyekyeleɛ ɛhye a.” 28Mosisi nee Ɛdɛnkɛma dɛnlanle ewiazo nee nɔɔzo toonwo kenle abulanla. Yeanli debie yɛɛ yeanno nzule. Ɔhɛlɛle ngyekyeleɛ edwɛkɛ ne, Mɛla Bulu ne wɔ awolɛ ndɛbandɛba nwiɔ ne azo.
Mosisi vi Saenae Boka ne azo dwu aze
29 Mɔɔ Mosisi vale awolɛ ndɛbandɛba nwiɔ ne mɔɔ Mɛla Bulu ne wɔ zolɛ la vi Saenae Boka ne azo dwule aze la, ɛnee ɔ nyunlu ɛlɛta nwohyee, ɔboalekɛ ɛnee ɔ nee Nyamenle ɛdendɛ, noko ɛnee Mosisi ɛnze kɛ ɔ nyunlu ɛlɛta. 30Na mɔɔ Aalɔn nee Yizilayɛma kɔsɔɔti nwunle kɛ Mosisi anyunlu ɛlɛta la, bɛzulole kɛ bɛkɛbikye ye. 31Mosisi vɛlɛle bɛ, Aalɔn nee mgbanyima ne mɔ ziale rale ɔ nwo ɛkɛ, na Mosisi nee bɛ dendɛle. 32Nzinlii Yizilayɛma amuala hwenle bikyele ye. Na Mosisi vale mɛla ne mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma vale manle ye wɔ Saenae Boka ne azo la manle bɛ. 33Mɔɔ Mosisi nee bɛ wiele tendɛ la, ɔvale ɛdanlɛ ɔhedale ɔ nyunlu. 34Mekɛ biala mɔɔ Mosisi kɛhɔ Nyianu Ndanlɛ Sua ne anu kɛ ɔ nee Ɛdɛnkɛma kadendɛ la, ɔye ɛdanlɛ ne ɔ nyunlu kɔkpula kɛ ɔkɛvinde la. Saa ɔfinde na ɔlɛka edwɛkɛ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma zele ye la a, 35Yizilayɛma nwu kɛ Mosisi anyunlu ɛlɛta. Mosisi eza fa ɛdanlɛ ne keda ɔ nyunlu kɔkpula mekɛ mɔɔ ɔkɛhɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne anu bieko kɛ ɔ nee Ɛdɛnkɛma kadendɛ la.

Title: ADE 35
Content:
Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ne anwo ngyehyɛlɛ
1Mosisi yiale Yizilayɛma kɔsɔɔti na ɔhanle ɔhilele bɛ kɛ, “Debie mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma se bɛyɛ la ɛne: 2 Bɛva kenle nsia bɛyɛ bɛ gyima, na kenle nsuu ne le Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle. Ɔle kenle nwuanzanwuanza mɔɔ bɛdu bɛzie ɛkɛ bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma a. Awie biala mɔɔ kɛyɛ gyima kenle ko ne la, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛku ye. 3Senle bɔbɔ, bɛmmawuda bie bɛ azua nu wɔ Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ne.”
Ndanlɛ Sua Nwuanzanwuanza ne azubɔdeɛ ninyɛne
(Ade 25.1-9)
4Mosisi hanle hilele Yizilayɛma kɔsɔɔti kɛ, “Debie mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma se bɛyɛ la ɛne: 5Awie biala ɛbɔ azu ɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma. Awie biala mɔɔ ɔdaye ɔkulo la ɛva azubɔdeɛ ɛrɛlɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma: azubɔdeɛ mɔɔ le kɛ ezukoa nvutuke, dwɛtɛ fufule, yɛɛ kɔbele; 6mboane enrinli buluwu, buluwu nee kɔkɔlɛ afonla, nee kɔkɔlɛ; lenen ɛdanlɛ nyɛma, ɛdanlɛ mɔɔ bɛva mbɔnkye enrinli bɛnwo; 7mboane nyinli nwoma mɔɔ bɛwula bɛ ayile kɔkɔlɛ, nee mbɔnkye nwoma; akasea mbaka; 8kɛnlaneɛ nwole; ninyɛne mɔɔ bɛfa bɛyɛ ɛkpokpalɛ nwole nee ɛyɛlɛ evuanlɛ; 9kanɛlea nee ezukoa awolɛ ngakyile mɔɔ bɛfa bɛbobɔ Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli ne ɛzonlenlɛ tɛladeɛ ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye yifɔdo nee akɛnrazo aguzo ne mɔ anu la.
Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne anwo ninyɛne
(Ade 39.32-43)
10“Menli mɔɔ ze adwinli di wɔ bɛ nu la ɛrayɛ debie biala mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛha la. 11Ndanlɛ Sua ne, debie mɔɔ bɛfa bɛwowa ɔ kunlu nee ɔ nzi, ye nzosɔnu ne mɔ, ye ɛgyinlanlɛ felɛmo ne mɔ, ye ndaboa mɔɔ bɛfa bɛbeɛbea nu, ye mbaka sika nee bɛ adiabo ne mɔ; 12Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne nee ye mbaka ne mɔ, ye nduazo ne nee mgbɛnu ndanlɛ ne; 13ɛkponle ne, ye mbaka ne mɔ, nee nwolɛ ahyɛnze ne mɔ; kpanwo mɔɔ bɛfa bɛbɔ azu bɛmaa Nyamenle; 14ahɛnlaneɛ ne mɔ, kɛnlaneɛ baka ne, ahɛnlaneɛ ninyɛne ne mɔ, nee nwolɛ nwole; 15ɛyɛlɛ ɛyelalɛ azukponle ne nee ye mbaka ne mɔ, ɛkpokpalɛ nwole ne; ɛyɛlɛ evuanlɛ ne; Ndanlɛ Sua ne anlenkɛ ne anloa ɛdanlɛ ne; 16azukponle ne mɔɔ bɛyela azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ zolɛ, nee ye kɔbele kɛlakɛlɛ ne, ye mbaka ne mɔ nee nwolɛ ninyɛne; kyɛnze kuloonwu ne mɔɔ bɛwowo bɛ sa nee bɛ gyakɛ anwo nu la nee ɔ bo ne; 17alie ne anwo ɛwowalɛ ndanlɛ ne mɔ, ye mbaka sika ne mɔ nee bɛ adiabo ne mɔ; alie ne anwo anuhɔlɛ ɛdanlɛ ne, 18Ndanlɛ Sua ne nee alie ne anwo bane ne adakola ne mɔ nee mɛkaleɛ ne mɔ, 19yɛɛ sɛlɛvolɛma adɛladeɛ nwuanzanwuanza ne mɔ mɔɔ Aalɔn nee ɔ mra mrenya ne mɔ bawula azonle wɔ Ɛleka Nwuanzanwuanza ne la.”
Menli ne fa bɛ azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ ara
20Akee Yizilayɛma kɔsɔɔti vile Mosisi anwo ɛkɛ. 21Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ sunsum manle bɛ anwosesebɛ la, yeyele bɛ ahonle nu vale bɛ azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ rɛlɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma kɛ bɛva bɛzi Nyianu Ndanlɛ Sua ne. Bɛvale debie biala mɔɔ hyia wɔ ye ɛzonlenlɛ nu nee ninyɛne mɔɔ bɛfa bɛnwo sɛlɛvolɛma adɛladeɛ ne mɔ la bɛrale. 22Awie biala, mraalɛ nee mrenya mɔɔ kulo la vale anwoneɛ, bɛ bonyi nu ngɛba, asomadeɛ, mgbɔdelera nee ngɛba, bɛ kɔme nu ndweabane, nee ezukoa nvutuke anwoneɛ ngakyile radole ehono bɔle azu manle Ɛdɛnkɛma. 23Awie biala mɔɔ lɛ mboane enrinli buluwu anzɛɛ buluwu nee kɔkɔlɛ afonla anzɛɛ kɔkɔlɛ, lenen nyɛma kɛnlɛma, mbɔnkye enrinli, yɛɛ mboane anzɛɛ mbɔnkye nwoma mɔɔ bɛwula bɛ ayile la vale rale. 24Awie biala mɔɔ lɛ dwɛtɛ fufule anzɛɛ kɔbele azubɔdeɛ la vale rabɔle azu manle Ɛdɛnkɛma. Awie biala noko mɔɔ lɛ akasea baka mɔɔ bɛfa bɛyɛ gyima ne anwo debie biala a ɔyɛ boɛ la vale rale. 25Mraalɛ mɔɔ ze ninyɛne nwo la yɛle ɛdanlɛnwolɛ nyɛma buluwu, buluwu nee kɔkɔlɛ afonla, nee kɔkɔlɛ, yɛɛ lenen nyɛma rale. 26Mraalɛ noko mɔɔ kola la vale mbɔnkye enrinli nwonle nyɛma. 27Mgbanyima ne mɔ vale kanɛlea awolɛ nee ezukoa awolɛ gyɛne gyɛne rale kɛ bɛva bɛbobɔ ɛzonlenlɛ tɛladeɛ ne nee akɛnrazo aguzo ne mɔ anu, 28eza bɛvale ninyɛne evuanlɛ, nwole mɔɔ bɛfa bɛsɔ kɛnlaneɛ, nee mɔɔ bɛfa bɛyɛ ɛkpokpalɛ nwole la, yɛɛ ɛyɛlɛ evuanlɛ bɛrale. 29Yizilayɛma kɔsɔɔti, mraalɛ nee mrenya mɔɔ lɛ ɛhulolɛ la yeyele bɛ ahonle nu vale bɛ azubɔdeɛ rɛlɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma manle bɛvale bɛyɛle gyima ne mɔɔ ɔzele Mosisi kɛ ɔyɛ la.
Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne dwinvolɛma
(Ade 31.1-11)
30Mosisi hanle hilele Yizilayɛma kɛ, “Bɛnlea, Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛnlea nu ɛye Yulae ara nrenya Bɛzalii, Huuli anlɔnra ne mɔɔ vi Dwuda abusua ekpunli ne anu la, 31na yeva Nyamenle Sunsum ne yeyi ye tɛkɛɛ, yemaa ye anwosesebɛ nee ndelebɛbo, adwenle nee adwinlililɛ ngakyile kɔsɔɔti, 32mɔɔ bɛfa ezukoa nvutuke, dwɛtɛ fufule nee kɔbele bɛdi la, 33anwoneɛ ɛyɛlɛ, awolɛ nee mbaka ɛzelɛ, nee adwinli ngakyile biala anwo nrɛlɛbɛ. 34Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛmaa ye anwosesebɛ kɛ ɔhile ɔdaye nee Ahesamake ara nrenya Oholeabe mɔɔ vi Dan abusua ekpunli ne anu la. 35Yemaa bɛ nrɛlɛbɛ mɔɔ bɛkola bɛfa bɛdi adwinli biala, anwoneɛ nee awolɛ zo ɛhɛlɛlɛ, ninyɛne nu ɛnwolɛ, nee mboane enrinli buluwu, buluwu nee kɔkɔlɛ afonla, nee kɔkɔlɛ, yɛɛ lenen nyɛma ngɛnlɛma ndanlɛ ɛnwonlɛ. Yemɔti bɛkola bɛyɛ gyima ngakyile biala.

Title: ADE 36
Content:
1“Bɛzalii, Oholeabe, nee awie biala mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛmaa ye adwinlililɛ nwo nrɛlɛbɛ nee ndelebɛbo, na ɔze kɛ bɛsi bɛsi Ndanlɛ Sua Nwuanzanwuanza la ɔwɔ kɛ yɛ debie biala, kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛhile la.”
Menli ne fa ahyɛlɛ ninyɛne dɔɔnwo ara
2Mosisi vɛlɛle Bɛzalii, Oholeabe, nee dwinvolɛ biala mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛmaa ye adwinlililɛ nwo nrɛlɛbɛ na ɔlɛ ɛhulolɛ kpalɛ la kɛ bɛbɔ gyima ne abo. 3Mosisi vale azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ Yizilayɛma ɛva ɛra kɛ bɛva bɛzi Ndanlɛ Sua nwuanzanwuanza ne la kɔsɔɔti manle bɛ. Menli ne hɔle zolɛ vale azubɔdeɛ ninyɛne rɛlɛle Mosisi nwonlomɔ biala. 4Yemɔti dwinvolɛma mɔɔ ɛnee ɛlɛyɛ gyima ne la hɔle ekpunli ngoko 5hɔbɔle Mosisi amaneɛ kɛ, “Ninyɛne mɔɔ menli ne ɛlɛfa ara la akee bo gyima mumua ne mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛhile kɛ yɛyɛ la azo.”
6Yemɔti Mosisi manle bɛbɔle nolo wɔ azokoɛleɛ ne kɛ, “Nrenya anzɛɛ raalɛ biala mmafa Ndanlɛ Sua nwuanzanwuanza ne ɛzilɛ nwo azubɔdeɛ bieko ba.” Yemɔti menli ne anva bieko amba. 7Ninyɛne mɔɔ ɛnee bɛ nee bɛ ɛra la bo gyima ne azo.
Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyianu Ndanlɛ Sua ne ɛzilɛ
(Ade 26.1-37)
8Dwinvolɛma ne mɔɔ ze gyima kpalɛ kpalɛ la amuala vale mgbɛnu ndanlɛ bulu hyehyɛle Ndanlɛ Sua ne; bɛvale ndanlɛ mɔɔ bɛva lenen nyɛma kɛnlɛma, mboane enrinli buluwu, buluwu nee kɔkɔlɛ afonla, nee kɔkɔlɛ bɛnwo na bɛnwo abɔdeɛ mɔɔ lɛ ndɛbalɛ la bɛgua nu la a bɛzile sua ne a. 9Ndanlɛ ne mɔ amuala sɛ mgbole, ko biala tendenle le mita bulu nee nwiɔ yɛɛ ye tɛtɛlɛ le mita nwiɔ. 10Bɛvale nnu bɛbɔle nwolɛ bɛkpomgbale ye mumua ko, yɛɛ eza bɛvale nnu ne noko bɛbɔle nwolɛ bɛkpomgbale. 11Bɛvale ɛdanlɛ buluwu bɛkpomgbale bɛbɔle ahotosalɛ bɛsosɔle mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nwiɔ ne la a. 12Bɛbɔle ahotosalɛ abulanlu bɛsosɔle alumua ɛdeɛ ne mɔɔ bɛbɔle bɛ nwolɛ la anloa na eza bɛabɔ abulanlu bɛasosɔ amozi ɛdeɛ ne noko mɔɔ bɛbɔle bɛ nwolɛ la anloa. Mgbɛnu ndanlɛ fane nwiɔ ne anloa ahotosalɛ ne mɔ, ko biala nee ɔ gɔnwo anye bɔ zo. 13Bɛyɛle ezukoa nvutuke nzosɔnu abulanlu bɛvale bɛsosɔle mgbɛnu ndanlɛ fane nwiɔ ne ahotosalɛ ne mɔ bɛmanle ɛdanlɛ ne yɛle mumua ko.
14Bɛvale mgbɛnu ndanlɛ mɔɔ bɛva mbɔnkye enrinli bɛnwo la azinli bulu nee ko bɛbɔle bɛ nwolɛ bɛvale bɛhedale Ndanlɛ Sua ne azo. 15Bɛ muala bɛ mgbole sɛ, ko biala tendenle le mita bulu nee nsa, yɛɛ ye tɛtɛlɛ le mita nwiɔ. 16Bɛvale azinli nnu bɛbɔle nwolɛ bɛkpomgbale, yɛɛ bɛvale nsia ne noko bɛbɔle nwolɛ bɛkpomgbale. 17Bɛbɔle ndanlɛ azinli ahotosalɛ abulanlu bɛsosɔle alumua ɛdeɛ ne anloa, yɛɛ bɛvale abulanlu noko bɛsosɔle amozi ɛdeɛ ne noko anloa. 18Bɛvale kɔbele bɛyɛle nzosɔnu abulanlu bɛsosɔle ndanlɛ nwiɔ ne bɛyɛle ye debie mumua ko. 19Akee bɛvale mboane nee mbɔnkye nwoma mɔɔ bɛwula ye ayile la bɛhedale sua ne azo.
20Bɛvale akasea mbaka felɛmo bɛgyinlanle Ndanlɛ Sua ne. 21Felɛmo ko anwumahɔlɛ le mita nna yɛɛ ye tɛtɛlɛ le mita foa ko nee ekyi. 22Bɛmanle ko biala ɛsalɛ nwiɔ, amaa bɛfa bɛ bɛabobɔ nwo a yeayɛ boɛ. 23Bɛgyinlanle felɛmo abulanwiɔ wɔ nyiakɛ afoa nu, 24yɛɛ bɛvale dwɛtɛ fufule bɛyɛle adiabo abulanla bɛzieziele bɛ zolɛ. Felɛmo ko biala lɛ adiabo nwiɔ mɔɔ sosɔ ɔ sa ne mɔ anu a. 25Bɛgyinlanle felɛmo ne abulanwiɔ wɔ sɔlɔ afoa nu, 26yɛɛ bɛziele bɛ adiabo abulanla zo. Felɛmo ko biala lɛ adiabo nwiɔ. 27Adɔleɛ afoa nu, bɛyɛle nlenkɛ felɛmo nsia, 28yɛɛ bɛyɛle nwiɔ wɔ ye mgbɛnezo nwiɔ ne mɔɔ wɔ ɔ nzi la. 29Mgbɛnezo felɛmo nwiɔ ne, bɛbɔle bɛ nwo anwuma toonwo ɔdwule aze. Bɛyɛle felɛmo nwiɔ zɛhae wɔ sua ne mgbɛnezo nwiɔ ne azo. 30Yemɔti felɛmo ne mɔ le mɔtwɛ yɛɛ dwɛtɛ fufule adiabo bulu nee nsia, felɛmo ko biala gyi adiabo nwiɔ azo.
31Bɛzele akasea mbaka mɔɔ bɛfa bɛbeɛbea nu la bulu nee nnu, Ndanlɛ Sua ne tɛbanu ko ɛdeɛ nnu, 32ye tɛbanu ko noko ɛdeɛ nnu, yɛɛ ɔ nzi adɔleɛ afoa nu ɛdeɛ nnu. 33Baka ne mɔɔ bea Ndanlɛ Sua ne bane ne mɔ avinli la vi bane nwo kɔkpula bane nwo, yɛɛ ɔbea felɛmo ne mɔ avinli. 34Bɛvale ezukoa nvutuke bɛfɔlele felɛmo ne mɔ anwo, na bɛava ezukoa nvutuke ngɛba bɛasosɔ bɛ, amaa bɛava mbaka ne mɔ mɔɔ beɛbea avinli mɔɔ ezukoa nvutuke fɔle nwolɛ la bɛawulowula nu.
35Bɛvale mboane enrinli buluwu, buluwu nee kɔkɔlɛ afonla, nee kɔkɔlɛ yɛɛ lenen nyɛma kɛnlɛma bɛnwonle ngbɛnu ɛdanlɛ ne na bɛnwonle abɔdeɛ mɔɔ lɛ ndɛbalɛ la bɛguale nu. 36Bɛzele akasea mbaka nna, bɛvale ezukoa nvutuke bɛfɔlele nwolɛ, bɛvale bie nzosɔnu bɛsosɔle bɛ na bɛvale mgbɛnu ɛdanlɛ ne bɛhendanle bɛ. Akee bɛyɛle dwɛtɛ fufule adiabo nna na bɛvale mbaka ne mɔ bɛzieziele zolɛ. 37Bɛvale ɛdanlɛ kɛnlɛma mɔɔ bɛva mboane enrinli buluwu, buluwu nee kɔkɔlɛ afonla, nee kɔkɔlɛ yɛɛ lenen nyɛma kpalɛ bɛnwo na bɛnwo nuhua la bɛkpomgbale ɛdanlɛ bɛhendanle Ndanlɛ Sua ne anlenkɛ ne anloa. 38Ɛdanlɛ ɛhye, bɛzele mbaka nnu bɛvale nzosɔnu bɛsosɔle bɛ, bɛvale ezukoa nvutuke bɛfɔlele bɛ ti nee mbaka mumua ne mɔ anwo na bɛyɛle kɔbele adiabo nnu bɛvale ye mbaka ne mɔ bɛzieziele zolɛ.

Title: ADE 37
Content:
Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne ɛbobɔlɛ
(Ade 25.10-22)
1Bɛzalii vale akasea ndaboa bobɔle Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne. Ye tendenle le mita ko, ye tɛtɛlɛ le mita foa ko nee ekyi, yɛɛ ye anwumahɔlɛ le mita foa ko nee ekyi. 2Ɔvale ezukoa nvutuke tagyee ɔfɔlele ɔ kunlu nee nwolɛ na ɔvale ezukoa nvutuke ɔdole ɔ nloa kɛba ɔyiale. 3Ɔvale ezukoa nvutuke ɔyɛle ngɛba nna mɔɔ bɛbava mbaka bɛawulowula nu bɛazoa la ɔsosɔle ye mgbɛnezo nna ne, nwiɔ wɔ ye tɛbanu yɛɛ nwiɔ wɔ ye tɛbanu. 4Ɔvale akasea mbaka ɔzele mbaka mɔɔ bɛfa bɛsoa la na ɔvale ezukoa nvutuke ɔfɔlele nwolɛ 5na ɔvale ɔwulowulale ngɛba ne mɔ mɔɔ wɔ Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne tɛbanu nee ye tɛbanu la anu. 6Ɔvale ezukoa nvutuke tagyee ɔyɛle ɛlɛka ne ati. Ye tendenle le mita ko yɛɛ ye tɛtɛlɛ le mita foa ko nee ekyi. 7Ɔbolole ezukoa nvutuke tagyee ɔyɛle abɔdeɛ nwiɔ mɔɔ ko lɛ ndɛbalɛ nwiɔ la. 8Ɔvale bɛ ɔzieziele tile ne ati nee ɔ ti. Ɔvale bɛ ɔfoamonle zolɛ ɔmanle bɛ nee tile ne yɛle debie ko. 9Abɔdeɛ nwiɔ ne mɔɔ lɛ ndɛbalɛ la anye bɔ zo, na bɛ ndɛba ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛdɛlɛdɛlɛ nu la keda tile ne azo.
Ɛkponle ne mɔɔ bɛfa kpanwo azubɔdeɛ bɛgua zo bɛmaa Nyamenle la Ɛbobɔlɛ
(Ade 25.23-30)
10Bɛzalii eza vale akasea ndaboa bobɔle ɛkponle. Ye tendenle le asɛɛ mita nwiɔ, ye tɛtɛlɛ le asɛɛ mita foa ko, yɛɛ ye anwumahɔlɛ le mita foa ko nee ekyi. 11Ɔvale ezukoa nvutuke ɔfɔlele nwolɛ na ɔvale bie ɔdole ɔ nloa ɔyiale. 12Ɔdole ɔ nloa kɛba mɔɔ ye tɛtɛlɛ kɛyɛ ɛsalɛ ɛrɛlɛsɛka nsa na ɔvale ezukoa nvutuke ɔfɔlele nwo. 13Ɔyɛle ngɛba mɔɔ bɛfa mbaka bɛwulowula nu na bɛazoa la nna ɔsosɔle ɔ bati nna ne, ɛleka mɔɔ ɔ gyakɛ ne mɔ wɔ la. 14Ɔvale ngɛba ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛbava mbaka ne bɛawulowula nu bɛazoa la ɔsosɔle ɔ nloa kɛba ne. 15Ɔvale akasea ndaboa ɔzele mbaka ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛbava bɛazoa ɛkponle ne la na yeava ezukoa nvutuke yeafɔle nwolɛ. 16Ɔvale ezukoa nvutuke tagyee ɔyɛle ɛkponle ne ahyɛnze ne mɔ, agbɛlɛte, ahanrɛlɛ, dwora ne mɔ, nee ahyɛnze kuloonwu mɔɔ bɛfa nwanye azubɔdeɛ bɛgua nu bɛye ɛdɛne, nee mɔɔ bɛfa ɛyɛlɛ evuanlɛ bɛgua nu la.
Kɛnlaneɛ baka ne ɛyɛlɛ
(Ade 25.31-40)
17Ɔvale hamenle ɔbolole ezukoa nvutuke tagyee ɔyɛle kɛnlaneɛ baka ne abo ne nee ye baka mumua ne; ɔvale bie ɔyɛle ndotolo nee ye nya ne mɔ, na ɔvale bɛ muala ɔbɔle nu ɔyɛle bɛ debie ko.
18Kɛnlaneɛ baka ne lɛ ngane nsia, nsa wɔ ye foa ko yɛɛ nsa noko wɔ ye foa ko. 19Ngane nsa ne mɔɔ wɔ foa ko nee foa ko la, bɛyɛ ahɔpo mɔɔ lɛ nduazo na bɛyɛ bɛ kɛ alemɔndo ndotolo mɔɔ ɛkpuke na yeye nya la bɛziezie zolɛ. 20Kɛnlaneɛ baka mumua ne, bɛyɛ ahɔpo nna mɔɔ lɛ nduazo na bɛyɛ bɛ kɛ alemɔndo ndotolo mɔɔ ɛkpuke la bɛziezie zolɛ. 21Nya ɛdɛkɛ ko wɔ ngane nwiɔ biala abo. 22Nya ne mɔ, ngane ne mɔ, nee kɛnlaneɛ baka ne, bɛvale ezukoa nvutuke tagyee mɔɔ bɛva hamenle bɛbolo la bɛyɛle bɛ debie ko. 23Ɔyɛle kɛnlaneɛ baka ne anwo ahɛnlaneɛ nsuu, yɛɛ ɔvale ezukoa nvutuke tagyee ɔyɛle nwolɛ dabekɛ nee ahyɛnze ndɛbandɛba. 24Ɔvale ezukoa nvutuke tagyee kilo abulasa nee nnu a ɔyɛle kɛnlaneɛ baka ne nee nwolɛ ninyɛne ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti a.
Ɛyɛlɛ ɛyelalɛ azukponle ne ɛbobɔlɛ
(Ade 30.1-5)
25Ɔvale akasea ndaboa ɔbobɔle azukponle mɔɔ bɛyela ɛyɛlɛ wɔ zo la. Ye tɛbanu ne mɔ amuala sɛ, ye tendenle le asɛɛ mita foa ko, ye tɛtɛlɛ le asɛɛ mita foa ko, yɛɛ ye anwumahɔlɛ le asɛɛ mita ko. Bɛyɛle bɛmanle ɔ nee ɔ bati nna ne azo kpokpɔkoo ne mɔ nee ye yɛle debie ko. 26Ɔvale ezukoa nvutuke tagyee ɔfɔlele zolɛ, ye tɛbanu nna ne mɔ, nee ɔ bati kpokpɔkoo ne mɔ anwo, na ɔvale bie ɔdole ɔ nloa kɛba ɔyiale. 27Ɔvale ezukoa nvutuke ɔyɛle ngɛba mɔɔ bɛbava mbaka mɔɔ bɛfa bɛsoa la bɛawulowula nu la ɔsosɔle ezukoa nvutuke ne mɔɔ ɔvale ɔdole ɔ nloa la abo wɔ ye tɛbanu nee ye tɛbanu. 28Ɔvale akasea ndaboa a ɔzele mbaka ne mɔɔ bɛbava bɛazoa la na yeava nvutuke yeafɔle nwolɛ.
Ɛkpokpalɛ nwole ne nee ɛyɛlɛ ne ɛyɛlɛ
(Ade 30.22-38)
29Ɔyɛle ɛkpokpalɛ nwole nwuanzanwuanza ne nee ɛyɛlɛ evuanlɛ ne kɛnlɛma kpalɛ kɛ mɔɔ menli mɔɔ yɛ ninyɛne evuanlɛ la kɛyɛ ala la.

Title: ADE 38
Content:
Azukponle ne mɔɔ bɛyela azubɔdeɛ wɔ zo la ɛbobɔlɛ
(Ade 27.1-8)
1Ɔvale akasea ndaboa ɔbobɔle azukponle mɔɔ bɛyela azubɔdeɛ wɔ zolɛ la. Ye tɛbanu ne mɔ amuala sɛ. Ye tendenle le mita nwiɔ nee ekyi, ye tɛtɛlɛ le mita nwiɔ nee ekyi, yɛɛ ye anwumahɔlɛ le mita ko nee ekyi. 2Ɔyɛle debie kpokpɔkoo kɛ mɛne la wɔ ɔ bati nna ne mɔ azo ɔmanle bɛ nee azukponle ne yɛle debie ko, na ɔvale kɔbele ɔfɔlele nwolɛ kɔsɔɔti. 3Eza ɔyɛle azukponle ne anwo ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti: mbuakɛ, azofi, ahyɛnze, faka, nee senlevalɛ ahyɛnze. Ɔvale kɔbele a ɔyɛle ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ kɔsɔɔti a. 4Ɔvale kɔbele ɔnwonle kɛlakɛlɛ na ɔvale ɔdole azukponle ne anloa kɛba ne abo wɔ asɛɛ ye avinli. 5Ɔyɛle mbaka mɔɔ bɛfa bɛsoa la anwo ngɛba nna ɔsosɔle ye mgbɛnezo nna ne. 6Ɔvale akasea ndaboa ɔzele mbaka mɔɔ bɛfa bɛsoa la, ɔvale kɔbele ɔfɔlele nwolɛ, 7na ɔvale ɔwulowulale azukponle ne anwo ngɛba ne mɔ mɔɔ wɔ ye tɛbanu nee ye tɛbanu la anu kɛ bɛbava bɛazoa. Bɛvale ndaboa a bɛbobɔle azukponle ne a, yɛɛ ɔ kunlu le tokule.
Kɔbele kyɛnze ne ɛyɛlɛ
(Ade 30.18)
8Ɔvale mraalɛ mɔɔ sonle Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyianu Ndanlɛ Sua ne anlenkɛ ne anloa la neanleɛ ne mɔ ɔyɛle kɔbele kyɛnze nee ɔ bo ne.
Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne anwo bane ɛlielɛ
(Ade 27.9-19)
9Akee kɛ bɛzile bɛliele Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne anwo bane la ɛne. Ye nyiakɛ afoa nu, bɛvale ndanlɛ azinli mɔɔ bɛva lenen nyɛma kɛnlɛma bɛnwo la bɛwowale nwolɛ. Ndanlɛ ne mɔ ko tendenle le mita abulanla nee nna. 10Bɛ mbaka ne mɔ le abulanwiɔ, yɛɛ bɛ adiabo ne mɔ noko le abulanwiɔ. Bɛvale kɔbele a bɛyɛle adiabo ne mɔ a. Bɛ nzosɔnu ne nee mɛkaleɛ ne mɔ, bɛvale dwɛtɛ fufule a bɛyɛle a. 11Ye sɔlɔ afoa nu ɛdeɛ ne le kɛ ye nyiakɛ afoa nu ɛdeɛ ne ala la. 12Ye adɔleɛ afoa nu ndanlɛ ne, ko biala tendenle le mita abulanwiɔ nee nwiɔ. Bɛ mbaka ne mɔ le bulu, yɛɛ bɛ adiabo ne mɔ noko le bulu. Mbaka ne nzosɔnu ne mɔ nee mɛkaleɛ ne mɔ, bɛvale dwɛtɛ fufule a bɛyɛle a. 13Ye aduduleɛ afoa nu, ɛleka mɔɔ anlenkɛ ne la la, ye tɛtɛlɛ le mita abulanwiɔ nee nwiɔ. 14-15Anlenkɛ ne foa ko mgbɛnu ɛdanlɛ ne le mita nsia nee ekyi. Bɛ mbaka nsa, yɛɛ bɛ adiabo nsa. Ye foa ko ne noko kɛ de ala la ɛne. 16Bɛvale ndanlɛ mɔɔ bɛva lenen nyɛma kɛnlɛma bɛnwo la a bɛwowale alie ne kɔsɔɔti anwo a. 17Bɛvale kɔbele a bɛyɛle mbaka ne adiabo ne mɔ a, na mbaka ne mɔ nzosɔnu ne mɔ, nee mɛkaleɛ ne mɔ, bɛvale dwɛtɛ fufule a bɛyɛle a. Bɛvale dwɛtɛ fufule bɛfɔlele mbaka ne mɔ ati zo. Akee bɛvale dwɛtɛ fufule bɛbolole bɛ ndenrɛndenra bɛsosɔle mbaka ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛnra yia alie ne anwo la amuala. 18Alie ne mɔɔ bɛlie nwo la anlenkɛ ne anu ɛdanlɛ ne, bɛvale mboane enrinli buluwu, buluwu nee kɔkɔlɛ afonla, nee kɔkɔlɛ yɛɛ lenen nyɛma kɛnlɛma a bɛnwonle a, yɛɛ bɛvale agbuyia bɛnwonle ɔ nloa. Ye tendenle le mita ngɔnla, yɛɛ ye anwumahɔlɛ le mita nwiɔ kɛ mɔɔ bɛvale bɛliele nwolɛ la. 19Bɛ mbaka ne mɔ le nna; bɛvale kɔbele a bɛyɛle bɛ adiabo nna ne a. Bɛvale dwɛtɛ fufule bɛyɛle bɛ nzosɔnu ne mɔ, yɛɛ eza bɛvale dwɛtɛ fufule bɛfɔlele mbaka ne mɔ ati zo; ye mɛkaleɛ ne mɔ noko le dwɛtɛ fufule. 20Ndanlɛ Sua ne adakola ne mɔ nee mɔɔ solo alie ne anwo yia la, bɛvale kɔbele a bɛyɛle a.
Ninyɛne mɔɔ bɛvale bɛyɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne anu la
21Ninyɛne mɔɔ bɛvale bɛyɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne anu, ɛleka mɔɔ awolɛ ndɛbandɛba nwiɔ ne mɔɔ bɛhɛlɛ Nyamenle Mɛla Bulu ne wɔ zo la wɔ la, bɛmɛ ɛne. Mosisi a hanle kɛ bɛhɛlɛ bɛ dodo a, yɛɛ Livaema mɔɔ sɛlɛvolɛ Aalɔn ara Yetamaa a nea bɛ nwo zo la a hɛlɛle a.
22Yule ara nrenya Bɛzalii, Huuli anlɔnra ne mɔɔ vi Dwuda abusua ekpunli ne anu la yɛle debie biala mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma hanle kɛ bɛyɛ la. 23Ye boavolɛ Ahesamake ara nrenya Oholeabe mɔɔ vi Dan abusua ekpunli ne anu la le dwinvolɛ mɔɔ kola kɛlɛhɛlɛ anwoneɛ zo, ɔdolɔdolɔ ninyɛne ɔmaa bɛnea zolɛ bɛyɛ anzɛɛ bɛnwo, ɔfa mboane enrinli buluwu, buluwu nee kɔkɔlɛ afonla, nee kɔkɔlɛ ɔnwo ndanlɛ ngɛnlɛma.
24Ezukoa nvutuke mɔɔ bɛvale bɛhyɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma kɛ bɛva bɛzi Ndanlɛ Sua ne la anloa to tone nu kilo apenle, kɛmɔ bɛ ezukoa awolɛ ne mɔ si de la. 25 Bɛdianle menli ne na bɛ dodo kɛ zile yɛle la, dwɛtɛ fufule mɔɔ bɛnyianle ye wɔ bɛ lɔ la to tone nu kilo apenle nsa, ɛya nna abulasa, kɛmɔ ɛleka nwuanzanwuanza ne nzuzuleɛ bolɛ ne kile la. 26Ezukoa ne bolɛ kile menli ne mɔɔ bɛdianle la dodo, ko biala duale “hyikɛle” foa ko, bie andua bie andɛla bie. Menli mɔɔ ɛli ɛvolɛ abulanwiɔ mɔɔ kɔ la kɔsɔɔti le apenle ngoko ɛya nsia nee nsa, ɛya nnu abulanlu. 27Dwɛtɛ fufule ne, bɛvale nuhua tone nu kilo apenle nsa, ɛya nna bɛyɛle Ndanlɛ Sua nwuanzanwuanza ne mgbɛnu ndanlɛ mbaka ne mɔ adiabo ne mɔ; baka ko biala adiabo ne to tone nu kilo abulasa nee nna. 28Dwɛtɛ fufule ne, tone nnu kilo abulasa ne mɔɔ hale la, Bɛzalii vale yɛle mɛkaleɛ nee mbaka ne mɔ nzosɔnu na ɔvale bie ɔfɔlele mbaka ne mɔ ati. 29Kɔbele mɔɔ bɛvale bɛhyɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma la to tone nu kilo apenle nwiɔ, ɛya nna abulanwiɔ nee nnu. 30Bɛzalii vale ɛhye yɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne anlenkɛ ne mbaka ne mɔ adiabo ne mɔ, kɔbele azukponle ne nee zolɛ kɛlakɛlɛ ne, yɛɛ azukponle ne anwo debie biala. 31Ɔvale bie ɔyɛle mbaka mɔɔ bɛvale bɛliele sua ne alie ne anwo la adiabo nee nlenkɛ ne adiabo ne mɔ, Ndanlɛ Sua ne adakola ne mɔ, yɛɛ alie ne anwo adakola ne mɔ.

Title: ADE 39
Content:
Sɛlɛvolɛma adɛladeɛ ne ɛnwonlɛ
(Ade 28.1-14)
1Bɛvale mboane enrinli buluwu, buluwu nee kɔkɔlɛ afonla, nee kɔkɔlɛ nyɛma bɛnwonle adɛladeɛ ngɛnlɛma kpalɛ mɔɔ sɛlɛvolɛ wula fa sonle wɔ Ɛleka Nwuanzanwuanza ne, kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma hilele Mosisi la bɛmanle Aalɔn.
2Bɛvale lenen nyɛma kɛnlɛma, mboane enrinli buluwu, buluwu nee kɔkɔlɛ afonla, kɔkɔlɛ, yɛɛ akɔlɛnlome bɛnwonle ɛzonlenlɛ tɛladeɛ ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye yifɔdo la. 3Bɛvale hamenle bɛbolole ezukoa nvutuke na bɛpepɛle bɛ ndenrɛndenra bɛvale bɛbokale lenen nyɛma kɛnlɛma ne, mboane enrinli buluwu ne, buluwu nee kɔkɔlɛ afonla ne, yɛɛ kɔkɔlɛ ne bɛnwonle ɛdanlɛ ne. 4Bɛnwonle ndanlɛ ndenrɛndenra nwiɔ bɛsosɔle ɛzonlenlɛ tɛladeɛ yifɔdo ne abati nee ɔ bati. 5Bɛvale ninyɛne ko ne ala bie bɛnwonle akyeso bɛzɔle yifɔdo ne bɛmanle ɔ nee ye yɛle debie ko, kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma hanle hilele Mosisi ala la. 6Bɛzele kanɛlea awolɛ ne mɔ na bɛvale ezukoa nvutuke bɛtotole bɛ nloa. Bɛdɔle alagye bɛhɛlɛle Gyekɔbo amra bulu nee nwiɔ ne aluma wɔ zo. 7Bɛvale bɛbobɔle ɛzonlenlɛ tɛladeɛ ne abati nee ɔ bati ndanlɛ ndenrɛndenra nwiɔ ne azo. Ɛhye mɔ gyigyi ɛkɛ maa Yizilayɛ mbusua ekpunli bulu nee nwiɔ ne, kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛha ɛhile Mosisi la.
Akɛnrazo aguzo ne ɛnwonlɛ
(Ade 28.15-30)
8Bɛvale ninyɛne mɔɔ bɛvale bɛnwonle ɛzonlenlɛ tɛladeɛ yifɔdo ne la ko ne ala bie bɛnwonle akɛnrazo aguzo ne na bɛnwonle nuhua kɛnlɛma kɛ yifɔdo ne anu ɛdeɛ ne la. 9Ɔ nloa nna ne amuala sɛ, bɛbɔle ɛdanlɛ ne nwo nwiɔ bɛnwonle. Ye tendenle le waa ko yɛɛ ye tɛtɛlɛ le waa ko. 10Bɛsolole ezukoa awolɛ mɔɔ sonle bolɛ la ɛhonlone nna zolɛ: ɛhonlone ne mɔɔ lumua la, bɛvale wulubi, topaze, yɛɛ ganɛte; 11ɛhonlone ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nwiɔ la, bɛvale ɛmelade, safaya, yɛɛ daemɔn; 12ɛhonlone ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nsa la, bɛvale tɛkɔese, agate, yɛɛ ameteze; 13yɛɛ ɛhonlone ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nna la, bɛvale bɛlele, kanɛlea, yɛɛ gyasepa. Bɛvale ezukoa nvutuke bɛtotole ɛhye mɔ kɔsɔɔti anloa. 14Awolɛ bulu nee nwiɔ ne, ko biala bɛhɛlɛle Gyekɔbo amra mrenya ne mɔ ko duma zo, yɛɛ bɛgyi ɛkɛ bɛmaa Yizilayɛ mbusua ekpunli bulu nee nwiɔ ne. 15Bɛvale ezukoa nvutuke tagyee bɛyɛle ndweabane na bɛbɛkale ye kɛ nyɛma la bɛguale akɛnrazo aguzo ne azo. 16Bɛyɛle ezukoa nvutuke ndolebɛnloa nwiɔ nee ezukoa nvutuke ngɛba nwiɔ. Bɛvale ngɛba nwiɔ ne bɛsosɔle akɛnrazo aguzo ne anwuma mgbɛnezo nwiɔ ne, 17bɛvale ezukoa nvutuke ndweabane nwiɔ ne bɛwulowulale ngɛba nwiɔ ne anu, 18bɛvale ɔ ti nwiɔ ne bɛsosɔle ndolebɛnloa nwiɔ ne na bɛvale bɛsosɔle ɛzonlenlɛ tɛladeɛ yifɔdo ne ndanlɛ ndenrɛndenra nwiɔ ne mɔɔ wɔ ɔ bati nee ɔ bati la. 19Bɛyɛle ezukoa nvutuke ngɛba nwiɔ bɛsosɔle akɛnrazo aguzo ne anloa nwiɔ ne mɔɔ wɔ aze la akunlu ne mɔɔ gua ɛzonlenlɛ tɛladeɛ yifɔdo ne azo la; 20eza bɛyɛle ezukoa nvutuke ngɛba nwiɔ bɛsosɔle ɛzonlenlɛ tɛladeɛ yifɔdo ne abati nwiɔ ne anyunlu aze wɔ tɛladeɛ ne ayia zo nee akyeso kɛnlɛma ne anwuma. 21Bɛvale nyɛma buluwu bɛsosɔle akɛnrazo aguzo ne nee ɛzonlenlɛ tɛladeɛ ne ngɛba ne mɔ na bɛbɔle bɛ kpɔkɛ, amaa akɛnrazo aguzo ne amkpɔne aze na yeazinze akyeso ne azo fɔɔnwo.
Sɛlɛvolɛma adɛladeɛ bie mɔ ɛnwonlɛ
(Ade 28.31-43)
22Tɛladeɛ kpole ne mɔɔ bɛwula bɛgua ɛzonlenlɛ tɛladeɛ ne azo la, bɛvale mboane enrinli buluwu kɔsɔɔ a bɛnwonle a. 23Bɛvale ɛdanlɛ mɔɔ bɛnwo la bɛzɛle ɔ kɔme ne anu, amaa bɛwula a yeande. 24-26Ɔ bo ne mɔɔ bɛbu la, bɛvale lenen nyɛma kɛnlɛma, mboane enrinli buluwu, buluwu nee kɔkɔlɛ afonla, yɛɛ kɔkɔlɛ bɛnwonle bɛ ahunguma kɛ akutue la bɛhendɛhendanle ɔ nloa toonwo ɔyiale na bɛvale ezukoa nvutuke tagyee dɔne bɛdidile bɛ avinli, kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma hanle hilele Mosisi la.
27Bɛvale lenen nyɛma kɛnlɛma bɛnwonle anwuma adɛladeɛ bɛmanle Aalɔn nee ɔ mra mrenya ne mɔ, 28bɛvale lenen nyɛma bɛnwonle abɔtile, ahyɛlɛ, aze adɛladeɛ; 29eza bɛvale lenen nyɛma kɛnlɛma, mboane enrinli buluwu, buluwu nee kɔkɔlɛ afonla, yɛɛ kɔkɔlɛ bɛnwonle tabule mɔɔ bɛnwo nuhua, mɔɔ bɛfa bɛkye bɛ avinli la, kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma hanle hilele Mosisi la. 30Bɛvale ezukoa nvutuke tagyee bɛbolole ye ɛdɛbaa na bɛhɛlɛle zolɛ, “Bɛdu bɛzie ɛkɛ bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma”, na bɛvale bɛbɔle belemgbunli abɔtile nwuanzanwuanza ne azo. 31Bɛvale ɛdanlɛ nyɛma buluwu bɛzɔle ye bɛvale bɛhendanle abɔtile ne anyunlu, kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛha ɛhile Mosisi la.
Gyima ne awieleɛ
(Ade 35.10-19)
32Akee bɛwiele Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne si bɔkɔɔ. Yizilayɛma ne yɛle debie biala, kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma hanle hilele Mosisi ala la. 33Bɛvale Ndanlɛ Sua ne nee nwolɛ debie biala bɛrɛlɛle Mosisi, ye nzosɔnu ne mɔ, ye felɛmo ne mɔ, meɛbeanu ne mɔ, ye mbaka azika ne mɔ, nee bɛ adiabo ne mɔ; 34zolɛ ɛhedalɛ mboane nyinli nee mbɔnkye nwoma ne mɔɔ bɛwula bɛ ayile, nee mgbɛnu ɛdanlɛ ne; 35Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne mɔɔ awolɛ ndɛbandɛba ne mɔ gua nu la, ye mbaka ne mɔ nee ɔ ti ne; 36ɛkponle ne nee nwolɛ ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti, nee kpanwo ne mɔɔ bɛfa bɛbɔ azu bɛmaa Nyamenle la; 37ezukoa nvutuke tagyee kɛnlaneɛ baka ne, ye ahɛnlaneɛ ne mɔ, nwolɛ ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti, nee ahɛnlaneɛ ne mɔ nwole ne, 38ezukoa nvutuke azukponle ne, ɛkpokpalɛ nwole ne, ɛyɛlɛ evuanlɛ ne, Ndanlɛ Sua ne anlenkɛ ne anu ɛdanlɛ ne; 39kɔbele azukponle ne nee kɔbele kɛlakɛlɛ ne, ye mbaka ne mɔ, nee nwolɛ debie biala, kyɛnze ne mɔɔ bɛwowo bɛ sa nee bɛ gyakɛ anwo nuhua la nee ɔ bo ne; 40alie ne anwo banelielɛ ndanlɛ, bɛ mbaka azika nee bɛ adiabo ne mɔ, bane ne mɔɔ bɛliele la anlenkɛ ne anu ɛdanlɛ ne nee nwolɛ nyɛma, Ndanlɛ Sua ne adakola ne mɔ; 41yɛɛ adɛladeɛ nwuanzanwuanza ngɛnlɛma ne mɔ mɔɔ sɛlɛvolɛma, Aalɔn nee ɔ mra mrenya ne mɔ bawula wɔ Ɛleka Nwuanzanwuanza ne la. 42Yizilayɛma yɛle gyima ne amuala, kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma hanle hilele Mosisi ala la. 43Mosisi nleɛnleanle bɛ kɔsɔɔti na ɔnwunle kɛ bɛyɛ bɛ, kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛha ɛhile ye la. Yemɔti Mosisi yilale bɛ.

Title: ADE 40
Content:
Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne ɛhyehyɛlɛ nee ye ɛbukelɛ
1Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi kɛ, 2“Alumua siane ne, ye kenle ne mɔɔ lumua la, kyehyɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne. 3Fa Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne sie nu, na fa mgbɛnu ɛdanlɛ ne wa ɔ nyunlu. 4Fa ɛkponle ne sie nu na fa nwolɛ ninyɛne ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti gua zolɛ. Eza fa kɛnlaneɛ baka ne sie nu na fa ahɛnlaneɛ ne mɔ siezie zolɛ. 5Fa ezukoa nvutuke azukponle ne mɔɔ bɛbakpu ɛyɛlɛ zolɛ la sie Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne anyunlu na fa Ndanlɛ Sua ne anlenkɛ ne anu ɛdanlɛ ne kenda ɛkɛ. 6Fa azukponle ne mɔɔ bɛbava bɛayela azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ la sie Ndanlɛ Sua ne anuhɔlɛ kpole ne, 7na fa kyɛnze ne mɔɔ bɛbawowo bɛ sa nee bɛ gyakɛ anwo nuhua la sie Ndanlɛ Sua ne nee azukponle ne avinli na gua nzule nu. 8Fa alie ne anwo bane ne anwo ndanlɛ ne mɔ wowa nwo, na fa ɛdanlɛ wa ye anlenkɛ ne anu.
9“Akee fa ɛkpokpalɛ nwole ne kpokpa Ndanlɛ Sua ne nee nuhua debie biala, tu bɛ maa Ɛdɛnkɛma na bɛkɛyɛ nwuanzanwuanza. 10Bieko, fa nwole kpokpa azukponle ne nee nwolɛ debie biala, tu bɛ maa Ɛdɛnkɛma na bɛkɛyɛ nwuanzanwuanza kpalɛ. 11Eza pe adenle ko ne ala anu tu kyɛnze ne mɔɔ bɛwowo bɛ sa nee bɛ gyakɛ anwo nu la maa Ɛdɛnkɛma.
12“Akee fa Aalɔn nee ɔ mra mrenya ne mɔ bɛla Ndanlɛ Sua ne anlenkɛ ne anloa na fa nzule bia bɛ. 13Fa sɛlɛvolɛ adɛladeɛ ne mɔ wulowula Aalɔn, kpokpa ye nwole na tu ye sie ahane maa me, amaa yeazonle me kɛ ɔle sɛlɛvolɛ. 14Fa ɔ mra mrenya ne mɔ noko bɛla na fa anwuma adɛladeɛ ne mɔ wulowula bɛ. 15Akee kpokpa bɛ nwole, kɛmɔ ɛkpokpale bɛ ze ala la, amaa bɛazonle me kɛ bɛle me sɛlɛvolɛma. Ɛkpokpalɛ ɛhye bamaa bɛayɛ sɛlɛvolɛma dahuu.”
16Mosisi yɛle debie biala, kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma zele ye la.
17Yemɔti bɛvile Yigyibiti la, ye ɛvolɛ nwiɔ ne anu, ye siane ne mɔɔ lumua la, kenle ne mɔɔ lumua la azo, bɛhyehyɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne. 18Mosisi hyehyɛle Ndanlɛ Sua ne. Ɔlumuale ɔzieziele adiabo ne mɔ, ɔgyinlegyinlanle felɛmo ne mɔ, ɔvale meɛbeanu mbaka ne mɔ ɔbobɔle nwo, na ɔkpɔnlɔkpɔnlanle ye azika ne mɔ. 19Ɔdɛlɛle zolɛhedalɛ ndanlɛ ne mɔ anu ɔhedale Ndanlɛ Sua ne azo na ɔvale nwolɛ ɛwowalɛ ɛdeɛ ne mɔ ɔwowale nwo, kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma zele ye ala la. 20Akee ɔvale awolɛ ndɛbandɛba nwiɔ ne ɔguale Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne anu. Ɔvale Ɛlɛka ne mbaka ne mɔ ɔwulowulale ye ngɛba ne mɔ anu na ɔvale ɔ ti ne ɔduale zolɛ. 21Akee ɔvale Ɛlɛka ne ɔziele Ndanlɛ Sua ne anu na ɔvale mgbɛnu ɛdanlɛ ne ɔwale ɔ nyunlu, kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma zele ye la.
22Ɔvale ɛkponle ne ɔziele Ndanlɛ Sua ne anu sɔlɔ afoa nu wɔ mgbɛnu ɛdanlɛ ne anyunlu, 23na ɔvale kpanwo ne mɔɔ bɛva bɛbɔ azu bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma la ɔguale zolɛ, kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma zele ye la. 24Ɔvale kɛnlaneɛ baka ne ɔziele Ndanlɛ Sua ne anu nyiakɛ afoa nu ɔmanle ɔ nee ɛkponle ne bɛ nye bɔle zo; 25na ɛkɛ ne, wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu, ɔsosɔle ahɛnlaneɛ ne mɔ, kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma zele ye ala la. 26Ɔvale ezukoa nvutuke azukponle ne ɔziele Ndanlɛ Sua ne anu mgbɛnu ɛdanlɛ ne anyunlu 27na ɔyelale ɛyɛlɛ evuanlɛ wɔ zolɛ, kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma zele ye ala la. 28Ɔvale Ndanlɛ Sua ne anlenkɛ ne anu ɛdanlɛ ne ɔhendanle ɛkɛ, 29na ɔvale azukponle ne mɔɔ bɛfa bɛyela azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ la ɔziele Ndanlɛ Sua ne anuhɔlɛ ne anloa. Ɔvale ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ nee ma azubɔdeɛ ɔbɔle azu wɔ zolɛ, kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma zele ye ala la. 30Ɔvale kyɛnze ne mɔɔ bɛwowo bɛ sa nee bɛ gyakɛ anwo wɔ nuhua la ɔziele Ndanlɛ Sua ne nee azukponle ne avinli na ɔguale nzule nu. 31Mosisi, Aalɔn, yɛɛ ɔ mra mrenya ne mɔ wowole bɛ sa nee bɛ gyakɛ anwo ɛkɛ 32mekɛ biala mɔɔ bɛlɛkɔ Ndanlɛ Sua ne anu anzɛɛ bɛlɛsia bɛara azukponle ne anwo la, kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi ala la. 33Mosisi wowale Ndanlɛ Sua ne nee azukponle ne anwo na ɔvale ɛdanlɛ ɔhendanle ye anuhɔlɛ kpole ne anu. Na Mosisi wiele gyima ne yɛ.
Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne azo amungu ne
(Ɛdi 9.15-23)
34 Akee amungu hedale Ndanlɛ Sua ne azo, na Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlunyia ne yile sua ne tɛkɛɛ. 35Ɛhye ati Mosisi angola Ndanlɛ Sua ne anu wolo. Ɔboalekɛ amungu ne ɛva sua ne, yɛɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlunyia ne ɛyi sua ne tɛkɛɛ. 36Wɔ bɛ adendulɛ ne anu, mekɛ biala mɔɔ amungu ne kɛmaa ɔ nwo zo kɛvi Ndanlɛ Sua ne azo la Yizilayɛma tu bɛ bo kɔyɛ azokoɛleɛ wɔ ɛleka fofolɛ. 37Saa amungu ne ɛtɛyele ɔ nwo wɔ ɛkɛ ne a, bɛtɛnla azokoɛleɛ ɛkɛ ne, bɛndu bɛ bo.
38Ɔluakɛ wɔ bɛ adendulɛ ne anu bɛnwunle kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma amungu ne keda Ndanlɛ Sua ne azo wɔ alehyenlɛ nu, na aledwolɛ nu noko a, ɛnee ɔle senle.

Title: SƐLƐ MUKENYE
Content:
Mukenye
Sɛlɛvolɛma buluku ne anu yɛɛ mɔmoane Yizilayɛma ɛzonlenlɛ ngyehyɛlɛ ne nee Nyamenlezonlenlɛ nwo nyɛleɛ yɛɛ sɛlɛvolɛma mɔɔ nleanle manle bɛlile ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔ azo la anwo edwɛkɛ wɔ a.
Debie titile mɔɔ buluku ne gyi zolɛ la a le Nyamenle nwuanzanwuanzayɛlɛ ne nee adenle mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ ye menli ne dua nu sonle ye na bɛbɔ bɛ ɛbɛla amaa bɛ nee “Yizilayɛma Nyamenle nwuanzanwuanza ne” bɛ avinli ande la.
Edwɛkɛ mɔɔ menli ze ye kpalɛ wɔ buluku ne anu la wɔ mgbakyelɛ bulu nee ngɔnla, ngyehyɛnu bulu nee mɔtwɛ (19.18). Gyisɛse hanle kɛ yemɔ a ɔle mɛla mɔɔ le kpole mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nwiɔ la: “Kulo ɛ gɔnwo kɛ ɛdawɔ ɛ nwo la.”
Mɔɔ wɔ nu la
Azubɔdeɛ nee azubɔlɛ nwo mɛla 1.1—7.38
Aalɔn nee ɔ mra ne mɔ sɛlɛvolɛ ɛwulalɛ 8.1—10.20
Nyamenlezonlenlɛ nu anwondelɛ nee evinliyɛlɛ nwo mɛla ne mɔ 11.1—15.33
Mgbɔdalɛ Kenle ne 16.1-34
Ɛbɛla mɔɔ anwo te nee ɛzonlenlɛ kpalɛ nwo mɛla 17.1—27.34

Title: SƐLƐ 1
Content:
Nane mumua ɛyelalɛ azubɔlɛ
1Ɛdɛnkɛma dendɛle ye Ndanlɛ Sua ne anu vɛlɛle Mosisi na ɔzele ye kɛ, 2“Tendɛ kile Yizilayɛma, na ka kile bɛ kɛ: Saa bɛ nuhua bie fa ye azubɔdeɛ ara Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu a, ɔva ye ɛnlankɛ ne anzɛɛ boane ne anzɛɛ abɔnkye azubɔdeɛ ne ɔvi ɔdaye ye tunli ne anu. 3Saa ɔfa ɛnlankɛ yeabɔ ɛyelalɛ azu a, ɔwɔ kɛ ɔfa nyinli mɔɔ anwo ɛnlɛ dɛne la. Ɔwɔ kɛ ɔfa ɔbagyinla Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne anuhɔlɛ ne, amaa Ɛdɛnkɛma alie ɔdaye mumua ne ado nu. 4Ɔwɔ kɛ ɔfa ɔ sa ɔto ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ ne ati zo, na bɛkɛlie bɛkɛdo nu kɛ ɔle ahenle ne ati mgbɔdalɛ. 5Akee ahenle ne ɛhu ɛnlankɛ ne wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu ɛkɛ na Aalɔn amra sɛlɛvolɛma ne ɛva mogya ne ɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma, na bɛdo bɛgua azukponle ne mɔɔ gyi Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne anlenkɛ ne anloa la anwo amuala. 6Akee ahenle mɔɔ lɛ azubɔdeɛ ne la ɛye nane ne nwoma na ɔbia ye. 7Aalɔn amra sɛlɛvolɛma ne ɛwuda senle wɔ azukponle ne azo na bɛziezie ɛyɛne ne mɔ mɔɔ wɔ senle ne anu la. 8Bɛva nane azinli ne mɔ, tile ne nee ɛnlome ne bɛgua ɛyɛne ne mɔɔ wɔ senle ne anu la azo wɔ azukponle ne azo. 9Akee ahenle ne ɛva nzule ɛnrinzi nane ne akunlu ninyɛne ne nee ye ndwɛlɛ ne mɔ anwo. Na sɛlɛvolɛ ne ɛyela ɔ muala wɔ azukponle ne azo kɛ ɔle ɛyelalɛ azubɔlɛ. Azubɔlɛ zɛhae mɔɔ bɛfa senle bɛbɔ la evuanlɛ sɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anye.
10“Saa sonla ne ahyɛlɛdeɛ ne le ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ mɔɔ vi ɔdaye ye mboane anzɛɛ mbɔnkye nu a, ɔwɔ kɛ ɔfa nyinli mɔɔ anwo ɛnlɛ dɛne la. 11Ɔwɔ kɛ ɔku ye wɔ azukponle ne sɔlɔ wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu, na Aalɔn amra sɛlɛvolɛma ne to ye mogya ne gua azukponle ne anwo amuala yia. 12Ɔwɔ kɛ ɔpepɛ ye azinli azinli ɔboka ɔ ti ne nee ye ɛnlome ne, na sɛlɛvolɛ ne siezie bɛ pɛpɛ wɔ ɛyɛne ne mɔɔ wɔ senle ne anu la azo wɔ azukponle ne azo. 13Akee ɔva nzule ɔnrinzi nane ne akunlu ne nee ye ndwɛlɛ ne mɔ anwo. Sɛlɛvolɛ ne ɛva bɛ muala na ɔyela bɛ wɔ azukponle ne azo. Ɛhye le ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ mɔɔ bɛfa senle a bɛbɔ a, na ye evuanlɛ sɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anye.
14“Saa ahenle ne azubɔdeɛ ne mɔɔ ɔfa yeamaa Ɛdɛnkɛma la le nloma ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ a, ɛnee ɔwɔ kɛ ye azubɔdeɛ ne yɛ abubule anzɛɛ mɔlɔnoma mralɛ. 15Sɛlɛvolɛ ne bava ara azukponle ne anwo, ahwi ɔ ti anu mogya ne, na yeayela anloma ne wɔ azukponle ne azo. Ɔwɔ kɛ ɔmaa ye mogya ne twi gua azukponle ne foa ko. 16Akee sɛlɛvolɛ ne fa anloma ne toku ne nee ɔ kunlu ninyɛne ne amuala, na ɔto ɔgua azukponle ne foa ko wɔ ye aduduleɛ ɛleka mɔɔ bɛgua nzonle ne la. 17Ɔwɔ kɛ sɛlɛvolɛ ne sɔ anloma ne andɛba ne mɔ na ɔsua anloma ne anu nwiɔ, ɔngyia kɛ ɔkɛhyɛ nu nwiɔ sɛsɛ. Akee ɔyela ye wɔ azukponle ne azo wɔ ɛyɛne ne mɔɔ wɔ senle ne anu la azo. Ɔle ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ mɔɔ bɛfa senle a bɛbɔ a, na ye evuanlɛ sɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anye.

Title: SƐLƐ 2
Content:
Ma azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ
1“Saa awie fa ma ara kɛ ɔfa yearabɔ azu yeamaa Ɛdɛnkɛma a, ɔwɔ kɛ ɔpe ɔyɛ ye esamo. Ɔwɔ kɛ ɔgua ɔlivi nwole zolɛ na ɔgua ɛyɛlɛ evuanlɛ nu, 2na ɔfa ɔbɛlɛ Aalɔn amra sɛlɛvolɛma ne. Akee ɔwɔ kɛ sɛlɛvolɛ ne fula esamo ne mɔɔ nwole nee ɛyɛlɛ evuanlɛ ne bie wɔ nu la ɔ sa ko, kɛ ɔle ahenle ne afoa nu ɛdeɛ, na ɔyela yemɔ wɔ azukponle ne azo. Ɔle azubɔdeɛ mɔɔ bɛfa senle a bɛbɔ a, na ye evuanlɛ sɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anye. 3Esamo ne mɔɔ kɛha la le Aalɔn nee ɔ mra ne mɔ ɛdeɛ. Ɔle ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ mɔɔ bɛva bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma na nwolɛ te kpole kpalɛ a.
4“Saa awie fa ma azubɔdeɛ ara na ɔle debie mɔɔ bɛdo ye wɔ fonlomo nu a, ɛnee ɔwɔ kɛ ɔyɛ angye belɛde mɔɔ bɛva esamo nee nwole a bɛyɛ a, anzɛɛ kpanwo ndɛbandɛba ngukulungukulu mɔɔ mgbɔvonle ɛnle nu na bɛgua nwole zolɛ la.
5“Saa azubɔdeɛ ne le ma azubɔdeɛ mɔɔ bɛloa ye kɛ tata wɔ kyɛnze nu a, ɔwɔ kɛ ɔyɛ esamo mɔɔ mgbɔvonle ɛnle nu na bɛva nwole bɛfɔtɔ la. 6Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛbubu nu na bɛgua nwole zolɛ; ɔle ma azubɔdeɛ.
7“Saa azubɔdeɛ ne le ma azubɔdeɛ mɔɔ bɛdo ye wɔ kyɛnze nu a, ɛnee ɔwɔ kɛ ɔyɛ debie mɔɔ bɛva esamo mɔɔ bɛva nwole bɛfɔtɔ la. 8Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛfa ma azubɔdeɛ mɔɔ bɛva ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ bɛyɛ la bɛbɛlɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma. Saa bɛ nee bɛ ba a bɛva bɛmaa sɛlɛvolɛ ne na sɛlɛvolɛ ne ava ahɔ azukponle ne anwo. 9Akee sɛlɛvolɛ ne bava bie ahile kɛ bɛva bɛra kɛ ɔle azubɔdeɛ, na yeayela ye wɔ azukponle ne azo, kɛ azubɔdeɛ mɔɔ bɛva senle bɛbɔ la, na ye evuanlɛ sɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anye. 10Aleɛ ma azubɔdeɛ ne mɔɔ kɛha la le Aalɔn nee ɔ mra ne mɔ ɛdeɛ. Ɔle ma ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ mɔɔ bɛva bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma a, na nwolɛ te kpole kpalɛ.
11“Ɔnle kɛ bɛfa mgbɔvonle bɛwula ma azubɔdeɛ biala mɔɔ bɛfa bɛarɛlɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma la anu. Ɔluakɛ ɔnle kɛ bɛyela mgbɔvonle anzɛɛ wolɛ biala kɛ ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma. 12Bɛkola bɛfa bɛ ma mɔɔ bɛkɛlumua bɛkɛnyia ye la bɛbɛlɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma kɛ bɛ azubɔdeɛ ɔ, noko ɔnle kɛ bɛfa bɛkɔ azukponle ne azo kɛ ɔle ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ. 13Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛfa ngyenle bɛgua bɛ ma azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ amuala anu. Ɔnle kɛ bɛmaa ngyenle mɔɔ kile bɛ nee bɛ Nyamenle ne ngyekyeleɛ ne la kpa bɛ ma azubɔdeɛ nu. (Bɛva ngyenle bɛboka bɛ azubɔdeɛ biala.) 14Saa bɛfa ma mɔɔ bɛlumua bɛde la azubɔdeɛ bɛarɛlɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma a, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛ ma azubɔdeɛ ne yɛ ma amolɛ mɔɔ bɔ zo mɔɔ bɛbu anzɛɛ bɛde la; bɛhyehye ye ekyii na bɛgelegele nu. 15Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛgua nwole zolɛ na bɛfa ɛyɛlɛ evuanlɛ bɛgua zolɛ. Ɔle ma azubɔdeɛ. 16Sɛlɛvolɛ ne bayela ma ne mɔɔ bɛgelegele nu la bie. Ɔle ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ ɔmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma.

Title: SƐLƐ 3
Content:
Anzonudwolɛ azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ
1“Saa awie fa ɛnlankɛ nyinli anzɛɛ belɛ azubɔdeɛ arabɔ anzonudwolɛ azu a, ɔwɔ kɛ ɔfa ɛnlankɛ mɔɔ anwo ɛnlɛ dɛne la a ɔfinde Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu a. 2Ɔwɔ kɛ ɔfa ɔ sa ɔto nane ne ati zo, na ɔku ye wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne anyunlu. Aalɔn amra sɛlɛvolɛma ne bado ye mogya ne agua azukponle ne anwo amuala ayia. 3Akee ɔyeye nane ne akunlu ne anwo ɛnlome kɔsɔɔti, 4ye ɛzizira nwiɔ ne nee nwolɛ ɛnlome ne mɔɔ wɔ ɔ nze nu yɛɛ ye ɛbolɛ nwo ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti ɔvi ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ ne mɔɔ bɛfa bɛamaa Ɛdɛnkɛma la anu. 5Aalɔn amra mrenya ne mɔ bayela bɛ wɔ ɛyɛne ne mɔɔ wɔ azukponle ne azo la azo. Ɔle azubɔdeɛ mɔɔ bɛfa senle a bɛbɔ a, na ye evuanlɛ sɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anye.
6“Saa awie fa boane nyinli anzɛɛ belɛ azubɔdeɛ arabɔ anzonudwolɛ azu a, ɔwɔ kɛ ɔfa boane mɔɔ anwo ɛnlɛ dɛne la. 7Saa ɔfa boane ralɛ a yeabɔ azu ne a, ɛnee ɔva ye ɔrɛla Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu, 8ɔva ɔ sa ɔdo nane ne ati zo, ɔhu ye wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne anyunlu. Aalɔn amra sɛlɛvolɛma ne mɔ bado ye mogya ne agua azukponle ne anwo amuala ayia. 9-10Akee ɔyeye ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ ne akunlu ɛnlome ne, ɔpɛ ɔ dua ne mɔɔ ɛlɔ mɔɔ kɔne ɔ nzi bowule ne azo la, ɔyeye ɛnlome mɔɔ wɔ nane ne akunlu ninyɛne ne mɔ anwo, ye ɛzizira nwiɔ ne nee nwolɛ ɛnlome ne mɔɔ wɔ ɔ nze nu la amuala, yɛɛ ye ɛbolɛ nwo ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti ɔvi ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ ne mɔɔ bɛfa bɛamaa Ɛdɛnkɛma la anu. 11Sɛlɛvolɛ ne ɛyela bɛ wɔ azukponle ne azo kɛ aleɛ ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ ɔmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma.
12“Saa ahenle ne azubɔdeɛ ne le abɔnkye a, ɔva ɔhɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu 13na ɔva ɔ sa ɔdo abɔnkye ne ati zo, na ɔhu ye wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne anyunlu. Aalɔn amra ne mɔ bado ye mogya ne agua azukponle ne anwo amuala ayia. 14-15Akee ɔyeye nane ne akunlu nee nwolɛ ɛnlome ne kɔsɔɔti, ye ɛzizira nwiɔ ne nee nwolɛ ɛnlome mɔɔ wɔ ɔ nze nu la, yɛɛ ye ɛbolɛ nwo ninyɛne ne mɔ amuala ɔvi ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ ne mɔɔ bɛfa bɛamaa Ɛdɛnkɛma la anu. 16Sɛlɛvolɛ ne ɛyela bɛ wɔ azukponle ne azo kɛ aleɛ ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ mɔɔ bɔ evuanlɛ la. Nane ne ɛnlome ne amuala le Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛdeɛ. 17Ɔwɔ kɛ ɛhye yɛ mɛla mɔɔ wɔ ɛkɛ ne dahuu wɔ bɛ awolɛndoazo kɔsɔɔti anu, wɔ ɛleka biala mɔɔ bɛde la; ɔnle kɛ bɛdi nane ɛnlome anzɛɛ mogya.”

Title: SƐLƐ 4
Content:
Ɛtaneyɛlɛ mɔɔ ɛnyelɛ ɛnla nwo la anwo azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ
1Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi kɛ, 2“Ka kile Yizilayɛma kɛ, saa awie anye ɛnla nwolɛ na ɔyɛ ɛtane, ɔyɛ ninyɛne mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛze kɛ bɛmmayɛ la bie, 3na saa ahenle le sɛlɛvolɛ mɔɔ bɛkpokpa ye nwole la yɛɛ ɛyɛ ɛtane ɛva evinli ɛha menli ne a, bɛmaa ɔva ɛnlankɛ nyinli edonraa mɔɔ anwo ɛnlɛ dɛne la ɔyɛ azubɔdeɛ ɔmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma wɔ ye ɛtane ne mɔɔ yeyɛ la anwo. 4Ɔwɔ kɛ ɔfa ɛnlankɛ ne ɔba Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne anuhɔlɛ ne, ɔfa ɔ sa ɔto ɛnlankɛ ne ati zo, na ɔku ye wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu. 5Sɛlɛvolɛ ne bava ɛnlankɛ ne mogya ne bie ahɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne anu. 6Akee ɔbava ɔ sa ɛrɛlɛsɛka yeabɔ mogya ne anu na yeakponde ye Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu ɛkɛ wɔ mgbɛnu ɛdanlɛ ne mɔɔ wɔ nwuanzanwuanza ɛleka ne la anyunlu fane nsuu. 7Sɛlɛvolɛ ne bava mogya ne bie aha ɛyɛlɛ evuanlɛ ɛyelalɛ azukponle ne mɔɔ wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne anu la abati kpokpɔkoo ne mɔ azo, na yeawola mɔɔ kɛha la yeagua ɛyelalɛ azukponle ne mɔɔ wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne anuhɔlɛ ne la abo ne anwo. 8Akee ɔbayeye ɛnlankɛ ne akunlu ɛnlome ne amuala, ɛnlome ne mɔɔ wɔ ɔ kunlu ninyɛne ne mɔ anwo la, 9ye ɛzizira nwiɔ ne nee nwolɛ ɛnlome ne mɔɔ wɔ ɔ nze nu la, yɛɛ ye ɛbolɛ nwo ninyɛne ne amuala. 10Ɔwɔ kɛ ɔyela ɛhye mɔ amuala wɔ ɛyelalɛ azukponle ne azo, kɛmɔ bɛyela anzonudwolɛ azubɔdeɛ nane ne mɔ ɛdeɛ ne bɛbɔ azu la. 11-12Akee ɔbava ɛnlankɛ mumua ne: ye nwoma, ye nane ne, ɔ ti, ye ndwɛlɛ, ɔ kunlu ninyɛne nee ye ebinli ne yeavinde yeahɔ ɛleka bɔkɔbɔkɔ wɔ azokoɛleɛ ne kandiba ɛleka mɔɔ bɛgua nzonle ne la yeahɔgua bɛ ɛyɛne zo yeayela bɛ.
13“Saa Yizilayɛ maanlema kɔsɔɔti andwenle nwolɛ na bɛannwu ye la ati bɛyɛ ɛtane na bɛdi fɔlɛ kɛ bɛyɛ ninyɛne mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛze bɛ kɛ bɛmmayɛ la bie, 14na saa bɛmaa bɛnwu bɛ ɛtane ne mɔɔ bɛyɛ la a, bɛ muala bɛbabɔ nu bɛava ɛnlankɛ nyinli edonraa ko bɛayɛ ɛtane azubɔdeɛ na bɛava bɛara Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne anyunlu. 15Mgbanyima mɔɔ wɔ ezuavolɛ ne avinli la bava bɛ sa agua ɛnlankɛ nyinli ne ati zo wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu ɛkɛ, na akee bɛahu ɛnlankɛ ne. 16Akee Sɛlɛvolɛ ne bava ɛnlankɛ ne mogya ne bie ahɔ Ndanlɛ Sua ne anu, 17na sɛlɛvolɛ ne ava ɔ sa ɛrɛlɛsɛka abɔ mogya ne anu akponde ye wɔ mgbɛnu ɛdanlɛ ne anyunlu wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu fane nsuu. 18Sɛlɛvolɛ ne bava mogya ne bie aha azukponle ne mɔɔ gyi Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne anu la abati kpokpɔkoo ne mɔ azo, na yeawola mɔɔ kɛha la yeagua ɛyelalɛ azukponle ne mɔɔ gyi Ndanlɛ Sua ne anuhɔlɛ ne la abo ne anwo. 19Ɔbayeye ɛnlankɛ ne akunlu ɛnlome ne amuala na yeayela ye azukponle ne azo. 20Kɛ bɛzile bɛyɛle ɛnlankɛ ne mɔɔ bɛvale bɛyɛle ɛtane azubɔdeɛ ne la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛyɛ ɛhye noko a. Akee sɛlɛvolɛ ne bayɛ nzɛlɛlɛ ali bɛ ti mgbɔdalɛ, na bɛbava bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ bɛahyɛ bɛ. 21Sɛlɛvolɛ ne bava ɛnlankɛ ne avinde ahɔ azokoɛleɛ ne kandiba na yeayela ye wɔ ɛkɛ, kɛmɔ ɔyelale alumua ɛdeɛ ne la. Ɔle ezuavolɛ ne ɛtane azubɔdeɛ.
22“Saa maanle kpanyinli bie andwenle nwolɛ na ɔyɛ ɛtane, na ɔdi fɔlɛ kɛ yeyɛ ninyɛne mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ye Nyamenle ne ɛze kɛ bɛmmayɛ la bie, 23na saa bɛmaa ɔnwu ye ɛtane ne mɔɔ yeyɛ la a, ɔwɔ kɛ ɔfa abɔnkye nyinli mɔɔ anwo ɛnlɛ dɛne la ɔba kɛ ɛtane azubɔdeɛ. 24Akee ɔfa ɔ sa ɔto abɔnkye ne ati zo, na ɔku ye wɔ ɛleka mɔɔ bɛku ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ la wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu Ɔle ɛtane azubɔdeɛ. 25Akee sɛlɛvolɛ ne ɛva ɔ sa ɛrɛlɛsɛka ɛva ɛtane azubɔdeɛ ne mogya ne bie na ɔva ɔpepe ɛyelalɛ azukponle ne abati kpokpɔkoo ne mɔ azo, na ɔwola mogya ne mɔɔ kɛha la ɔgua ɛyelalɛ azukponle ne abo ne anwo. 26Ɔbayela nane ne anu ɛnlome ne amuala wɔ azukponle ne azo, kɛmɔ bɛfa anzonudwolɛ azubɔdeɛ bɛabɔ azu a bɛyɛ ye la Yemɔti sɛlɛvolɛ ne bayɛ nzɛlɛlɛ ali ye ɛtane ne anwo mgbɔdalɛ amaa ye, na bɛkɛva ye ɛtane ne bɛkɛhyɛ ye.
27“Saa koahweabane bie andwenle nwolɛ na ɔyɛ ɛtane, na ɔdi fɔlɛ kɛ yeyɛ ninyɛne mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛze kɛ bɛmmayɛ la bie, 28na saa bɛmaa ɔnwu ye ɛtane ne mɔɔ yeyɛ la a, ɔwɔ kɛ ɔfa abɔnkye belɛ mɔɔ anwo ɛnlɛ dɛne la ɔbabɔ azu wɔ ye ɛtane ne mɔɔ yeyɛ la anwo. 29Ɔwɔ kɛ ɔfa ɔ sa ɔto ɛtane azubɔdeɛ ne ati zo na ɔku ye wɔ ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ ɛleka ne. 30Sɛlɛvolɛ ne bava ɔ sa ɛrɛlɛsɛka ava mogya ne bie apepe ɛyelalɛ azukponle ne abati kpokpɔkoo ne mɔ azo, na yeawola mɔɔ kɛha la yeagua azukponle ne abo ne anwo. 31Ɔbayeye azubɔdeɛ ne akunlu ɛnlome ne amuala, kɛmɔ bɛyɛ anzonudwolɛ azubɔdeɛ la, na akee yeayela ye wɔ azukponle ne azo. Ye evuanlɛ sɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anye. Sɛlɛvolɛ ne bayɛ nzɛlɛlɛ ali ye ɛtane ne anwo mgbɔdalɛ amaa ye, na bɛkɛva bɛkɛhyɛ ye.
32“Saa ahenle fa boane ralɛ ara kɛ ɛtane azubɔdeɛ a, ɔwɔ kɛ ɔfa belɛ mɔɔ anwo ɛnlɛ dɛne la. 33Ɔwɔ kɛ ɔfa ɔ sa ɔto azubɔdeɛ ne ati zo na ɔku ye wɔ ɛleka mɔɔ bɛku ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ la. 34Sɛlɛvolɛ ne bava ɔ sa ɛrɛlɛsɛka ava azubɔdeɛ ne mogya ne bie na yeava yeapepe ɛyelalɛ azukponle ne abati kpokpɔkoo ne mɔ azo, na yeawola mɔɔ kɛha la yeagua azukponle ne abo ne anwo. 35Ɔbayeye azubɔdeɛ ne akunlu ɛnlome ne amuala, kɛmɔ bɛyeye boane ralɛ ne mɔɔ bɛfa bɛyɛ anzonudwolɛ azubɔlɛ azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ ɛdeɛ ne la. Sɛlɛvolɛ ne bayela ye wɔ azukponle ne azo yeaboka azubɔlɛ ninyɛne mɔɔ bɛyela bɛamaa Ɛdɛnkɛma la anwo. Akee sɛlɛvolɛ ne bayɛ nzɛlɛlɛ ali mgbɔdalɛ amaa ahenle ne wɔ ye ɛtane ne mɔɔ yeyɛ la anwo, na bɛkɛva bɛkɛhyɛ ye.

Title: SƐLƐ 5
Content:
Ɛtaneyɛlɛ mɔɔ hyia ɛtane azubɔdeɛ la
1“Saa awie yɛ ɛtane mɔɔ kile kɛ bɛvɛlɛ ye kɛ ɔrali daselɛ wɔ mɔɔ ɔnwunle ye nee mɔɔ ɔdele wɔ edwɛkɛ mɔɔ zile bagua nu na ɔdi nwolɛ daselɛ la anwo, na yeanga a, ɔdaye ɔ ngome ye ɛtane zo ye.
2“Anzɛɛ saa awie annwu ye na ɔ nwo ka debie mɔɔ anwo ɛnde la, saa nane bie funli o, saa ɛnlankɛ funli o, saa ngɛkɛba mɔɔ tu la bie funli o, na saa nzinlii ɔnwu ye a, ɔdi fɔlɛ; evinli ɛha ye.
3“Anzɛɛ saa ɔ nwo ka awie mɔɔ anwo ɛnde la, saa duzu debie yɛɛ manle evinli hanle ahenle ne bɔbɔ a, saa ɔnze na nzinlii ɔnwu ye a, ɔdi fɔlɛ.
4“Anzɛɛ saa awie buke ɔ nloa di amonle kɛ ɔdi ɛtane anzɛɛ ɔyɛ boɛ a, amonle ɛtane biala mɔɔ ahenle ne kɛli la, saa ɔnze bɔbɔ na nzinlii ɔnwu ye a, ɔdi ko biala anwo fɔlɛ.
5“Saa awie di fɔlɛ wɔ ɛhye mɔ biala anwo a, ɔwɔ kɛ ɔka ye ɛtane ne mɔɔ yeyɛ la wɔ bagua nu, 6na ɔfa fɔlɛlilɛ azubɔdeɛ ɔbɛlɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma wɔ ɛtane ne mɔɔ yeyɛ la anwo. Ɔwɔ kɛ ɔfa boane ralɛ belɛ anzɛɛ abɔnkye belɛ ɔyɛ ɛtane azubɔdeɛ, na sɛlɛvolɛ ne yɛ nzɛlɛlɛ di ɔ ti mgbɔdalɛ wɔ ye ɛtane ne anwo.
7“Na saa ahenle ne ɛnlɛ bie la ati ɔnrɛhola boane anzɛɛ abɔnkye fa a, ɔwɔ kɛ ɔfa abubule anzɛɛ mɔlɔnoma nwiɔ ɔyɛ fɔlɛlilɛ azubɔdeɛ ɔmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma. Nloma nwiɔ ne ko bayɛ ɛtane azubɔdeɛ na ko ayɛ ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ. 8Ɔwɔ kɛ ɔfa ɔbɛlɛ sɛlɛvolɛ ne na sɛlɛvolɛ ne alumua ava ɛtane azubɔdeɛ ne abɔ azu; ɔbahyiba anloma ne ati yeabu ɔ kɔme noko ɔnrɛde ye ɔnrɛvi zolɛ. 9Akee ɔbava ɛtane azubɔdeɛ ne mogya ne bie yeakponde azukponle ne foa ko, na yeahwi mogya ne mɔɔ kɛha la yeagua azukponle ne abo ne anwo. Ɔle ɛtane azubɔdeɛ. 10Akee sɛlɛvolɛ ne bava mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nwiɔ la abɔ ɛyelalɛ azu, kɛmɔ mɛla ne kile la. Sɛlɛvolɛ ne bayɛ nzɛlɛlɛ ali ɔ ti mgbɔdalɛ amaa ye wɔ ye ɛtane ne mɔɔ yeyɛ la anwo, na bɛkɛva bɛkɛhyɛ ye.
11“Na saa ahenle ne angola abubule nwiɔ ne anzɛɛ mɔlɔnoma nwiɔ ne fa a, ɛnee ɔwɔ kɛ ɔfa esamo kilo nwiɔ ɔyɛ ɛtane azubɔdeɛ. Ɔnle kɛ ɔfa nwole ɔgua nu anzɛɛ ɔfa ɛyɛlɛ evuanlɛ biala ɔgua zolɛ, ɔluakɛ ɔle ɛtane azubɔdeɛ. 12Ɔwɔ kɛ ɔfa ɔbɛlɛ sɛlɛvolɛ ne, na sɛlɛvolɛ ne avula ɔ sa ko, na yeayela ye wɔ azukponle ne azo yeaboka ɛyelalɛ. azubɔdeɛ mɔɔ le Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛdeɛ la anwo. Ɔle ɛtane azubɔdeɛ. 13Akee sɛlɛvolɛ ne bazɛlɛ ɔ ti mgbɔdalɛ amaa ye wɔ ye ɛtane ne mɔɔ yeyɛ la anwo, na bɛbava bɛahyɛ ye. Esamo ne mɔɔ kɛha la le sɛlɛvolɛ ne ɛdeɛ, kɛmɔ ma azubɔdeɛ de la.”
Abozozielɛ azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ
14Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi kɛ, 15“Saa awie anye ɛnla nwolɛ na ɔyɛ ɛtane kɛ yebu ɔ nye yegua ye diedi gyima zo, mɔɔ fane Ɛdɛnkɛma ninyɛne nwuanzanwuanza ne mɔ anwo a, ɔwɔ kɛ ɔfa fɔlɛlilɛ azubɔdeɛ ɔbɛlɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma. Ɔwɔ kɛ ɔfa boane nyinli mɔɔ anwo ɛnlɛ dɛne, na ɛdawɔ ɛkɛnlea ɛkɛpɛ ye bolɛ wɔ dwɛtɛ fufule nu, kɛmɔ bɛdi ye wɔ ɛleka nwuanzanwuanza ne la; ɔle fɔlɛlilɛ azubɔdeɛ. 16Eza ɔwɔ kɛ ɔsie mɔɔ ɔyɛle a yeanyɛ ye boɛ wɔ ninyɛne nwuanzanwuanza ne mɔ anwo la abo zo, na ɔfa mɔɔ ɔ nee ye rale la ngyɛnu nnu ɛkpɔ ko ɔboka nwolɛ ɔmaa sɛlɛvolɛ ne; na sɛlɛvolɛ ne bava boane azubɔdeɛ ne ayɛ nzɛlɛlɛ ali mgbɔdalɛ amaa ye, na bɛkɛva ye ɛtane bɛkɛhyɛ ye.
17“Saa awie anye ɛnla nwolɛ na ɔyɛ ninyɛne mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛze kɛ bɛmmayɛ la bie a, yeyɛ ɛtane, yɛɛ ɔdi fɔlɛ, na ye ɛtane zo ye. 18Ɔwɔ kɛ ɔfa boane nyinli mɔɔ anwo ɛnlɛ dɛne, na ɛdawɔ wɔnlea wɔpɛ ye bolɛ mɔɔ nee ɛtane azubɔdeɛ bolɛ sɛ la ɔbɛlɛ sɛlɛvolɛ ne. Na sɛlɛvolɛ ne bayɛ nzɛlɛlɛ ali ɔ ti mgbɔdalɛ amaa ye wɔ ye ɛtane ne mɔɔ ɔ nye ɛnla nwolɛ na yeyɛ la anwo, na bɛkɛva bɛkɛhyɛ ye. 19Ɔle fɔlɛlilɛ azubɔdeɛ, ɔluakɛ ɔdi fɔlɛ wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu.”

Title: SƐLƐ 6
Content:
1 Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi kɛ, 2“Saa awie yɛ ɛtane na ɔbu ɔ nye ɔgua ye diedi gyima zo ɔtia Ɛdɛnkɛma na ɔbɛlɛbɛla ɔ diema wɔ agyinlanulilɛ anzɛɛ awobazielɛ nwo, anzɛɛ ɔwua ye, anzɛɛ ɔsisi ɔ diema, 3anzɛɛ yenwu debie mɔɔ ɛminli la na ɔkeda zolɛ ɔbɔ adalɛ, ɔka nwolɛ ndane, wɔ debie biala mɔɔ menli yɛ nwolɛ ɛtane la anu, 4saa awie yɛ ɛtane na ɔdi nwolɛ fɔlɛ a, ɔwɔ kɛ ɔfa deɛ ne mɔɔ ɔwuale la bie, anzɛɛ ɔsisile awie ɔvale, anzɛɛ deɛ ne mɔɔ bɛvale bɛwulale ye lɔ awoba, anzɛɛ asedeɛ ne mɔɔ ɔvale la bie ɔsie ɔ bo zo. 5Anzɛɛ debie biala mɔɔ yeha nwolɛ ndane adalɛ nu la, ɔwɔ kɛ ɔsie ɔ bo zo na ɔfa deɛ holɛ ko ne ngyɛnu nnu ɛkpɔ ko ɔboka nwolɛ ɔmaa ahenle ne mɔɔ deɛ ne le ye ɛdeɛ la, wɔ kenle ko ne mɔɔ ɔfa ye fɔlɛlilɛ azubɔdeɛ ne yeahɔ la. 6Akee ɔwɔ kɛ ɔfa boane nyinli mɔɔ anwo ɛnlɛ dɛne, na wɔnlea wɔpɛ ye bolɛ la ɔyɛ fɔlɛlilɛ azubɔdeɛ ɔbɛlɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma. 7Sɛlɛvolɛ ne bayɛ nzɛlɛlɛ ali ɔ ti mgbɔdalɛ wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛkɛ, na bɛkɛva debie biala mɔɔ sonla yɛ a ɔdi fɔlɛ la bɛkɛhyɛ ye.”
Nane mumua ɛyelalɛ azubɔlɛ
8Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi kɛ, 9“Ka kile Aalɔn nee ɔ mra ne mɔ kɛ: Mɛla mɔɔ wɔ ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ nwo la ɛne. Ɔwɔ kɛ ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ ne da azukponle ne azo anyevinle ne nɔe ne toonwo alehyenlɛ, yɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ azukponle ne azo senle ne sɔ bɔ ye. 10Sɛlɛvolɛ ne bawula ye lenen tɛladeɛ tendenle ne nee ye lenen nika ne, na yeavula ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ ne nzonle ne mɔɔ wɔ azukponle ne abo la yeazie azukponle ne foa ko. 11Akee ɔbakpa ye adɛladeɛ ne mɔ yeagua, yeava adɛladeɛ gyɛne yeawula, na yeava nzonle ne yeahɔ azokoɛleɛ ne kandiba ɛleka mɔɔ le bɔkɔbɔkɔ la. 12Ɔwɔ kɛ senle ne mɔɔ wɔ azukponle ne azo la boa nuhua dahuu. Ɔnle kɛ ɔnu. Ɔwɔ kɛ sɛlɛvolɛ ne fa ɛyɛne wula nu nwonlomɔ biala na ɔsiezie ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ ne boɛ wɔ zolɛ, na ɔyela anzonudwolɛ azubɔdeɛ ɛnlome ne. 13Ɔwɔ kɛ senle ne mɔɔ wɔ azukponle ne azo la boa nuhua mekɛ biala; ɔnle kɛ ɔnu.
Ma azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ
14“Mɛla mɔɔ wɔ ma azubɔdeɛ nwo noko la ɛne. Aalɔn amra ne mɔ bava azubɔdeɛ ne amaa Ɛdɛnkɛma wɔ azukponle ne anyunlu ɛkɛ. 15Bɛ nuhua ko bavula ma azubɔdeɛ ne mɔɔ bɛdi bɛyɛ ye esamo na nwole nee ɛyɛlɛ evuanlɛ wɔ nu la ɔ sa ko, na yeayela ye wɔ azukponle ne azo. Ye evuanlɛ sɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anye. 16Aalɔn nee ɔ mra mrenya ne mɔ bali mɔɔ kɛha la. Ɔnle kɛ bɛfa mgbɔvonle bɛwula nu na bɛali, yɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛdi ye ɛleka mɔɔ te la. Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne alie ne anwo a ɔwɔ kɛ bɛdi zɔhane aleɛ ne a. 17Ɔnle kɛ bɛfa mgbɔvonle bɛwula nuhua na bɛado. Meva memaa bɛ kɛ ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ mɔɔ le nwuanzanwuanza kpalɛ kpalɛ, kɛ ɛtane azubɔdeɛ nee fɔlɛlilɛ azubɔdeɛ la. 18Aalɔn abo zo amra mrenya biala kola di bie. Meyɛ ɛhye mɛla mɔɔ wɔ ɛkɛ ne dahuu, wɔ awolɛndoazo biala anu na ɔfane ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ mɔɔ bɛva bɛrɛlɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma la anwo. Awie biala mɔɔ anwo kɛha bie la anwo kɛde saanwu.”
19Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi kɛ, 20“Azubɔdeɛ mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ Aalɔn nee ɔ mra mrenya ne mɔ fa bɛlɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma wɔ kenle mɔɔ bɛkɛkpokpa ye nwole kɛ ɔle sɛlɛvolɛ la ɛne. Ɔwɔ kɛ ɔfa esamo kilo ko ɔyɛ ma azubɔdeɛ dahuu biala. Ɔbava foa ko nwonlomɔ na yeava foa ko ne nɔsolɛ. 21Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛfa nwole bɛfɔtɔ na bɛdoa ye wɔ bulalɛ ɛyɛba fulonvule nu. Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛfɔtɔ ye kpalɛ na bɛbɔ ye ngyikyi ngyikyi bɛdoa kɛ ma azubɔdeɛ mɔɔ ye evuanlɛ sɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anye la bɛbɛlɛ ye. 22Sɛlɛvolɛ ne mɔɔ bɛbaye ye wɔ Aalɔn amra mrenya ne mɔ anu bɛamaa yeali ye agya la babɔ zɔhane azu ne amaa Ɛdɛnkɛma, kɛmɔ meyɛ ye mɛla na ɔla ɛkɛ ne dahuu la. Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛyela bɛ muala. 23Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛyela sɛlɛvolɛ biala ma azubɔdeɛ. Ɔnle kɛ bɛdi.”
Ɛtane azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ
24Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi kɛ, 25“Ka kile Aalɔn nee ɔ mra ne mɔ kɛ, mɛla mɔɔ wɔ ɛtane azubɔdeɛ nwo la ɛne: Ɛleka mɔɔ bɛku ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ ne la, ɛkɛ ne ala yɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛku ɛtane azubɔdeɛ ne a, wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu. Ɔle nwuanzanwuanza kpalɛ kpalɛ. 26Sɛlɛvolɛ ne mɔɔ kɛbɔ ɛtane azu ne la ɔwɔ kɛ di ye wɔ ɛleka mɔɔ te la, wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne alie ne anwo. 27Debie biala mɔɔ anwo kɛha azubɔdeɛ ne nane ne bie la anwo bade nwuanzaanwu. Saa bɛkponde ye mogya ne bie wɔ tɛladeɛ nu a, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛkpo tɛladeɛ ne mɔɔ bɛkponde ye nu la wɔ ɛleka mɔɔ te la. 28Siase ne mɔɔ bɛkɛdo ye nu la, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛbɔ ye. Na saa bɛto ye wɔ kɔbele siase nu a, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛtwi nu na bɛfa nzule bɛnrinzi nu. 29Nrenya biala mɔɔ wɔ sɛlɛvolɛma ne anu la kola di bie Ɔle nwuanzanwuanza kpalɛ kpalɛ. 30Noko ɔnle kɛ bɛdi ɛtane azubɔdeɛ biala mɔɔ bɛkɛva ye mogya ne bie bɛkɛhɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne anu kɛ bɛkazɛlɛ mgbɔdalɛ wɔ ɛleka nwuanzanwuanza ne la bie. Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛyela ye.

Title: SƐLƐ 7
Content:
Abozozielɛ azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ
1“Abozozielɛ (fɔlɛlilɛ) azubɔdeɛ nwo mɛla ne ɛne; ɔle nwuanzanwuanza kpalɛ kpalɛ. 2Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛku ye wɔ ɛleka mɔɔ bɛku ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ ne la, na bɛto ye mogya ne bɛgua azukponle ne anwo amuala bɛyia. 3-4Akee bɛyeye ɔ kunlu ɛnlome ne amuala, ɔ dua dɔlera ne, ɔ kunlu ninyɛne ne mɔ anwo ɛnlome ne, ye ɛzizira nwiɔ ne nee nwolɛ ɛnlome ne mɔɔ wɔ ɔ nze nu la, yɛɛ ye ɛbolɛ ne anwo ninyɛne ne mɔ, bɛyɛ azubɔdeɛ. 5Sɛlɛvolɛ ne bayela ɔ muala wɔ azukponle ne azo abɔ azu amaa Ɛdɛnkɛma. Ɔle fɔlɛlilɛ azubɔdeɛ. 6Nrenya biala mɔɔ wɔ sɛlɛvolɛma ne anu la kola di bie Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛdi ye wɔ ɛleka mɔɔ te la. Ɔle nwuanzanwuanza kpalɛ kpalɛ.
7“Abozozielɛ azubɔdeɛ ne le kɛ ɛtane azubɔdeɛ ne ala la, yɛɛ bɛ mu nwiɔ bɛ nwo mɛla le ko. Sɛlɛvolɛ ne mɔɔ fa ayɛ mgbɔdalɛ azubɔdeɛ ne la ɛdeɛ ɔ. 8Sɛlɛvolɛ biala noko mɔɔ kɛbɔ ɛyelalɛ azu ne la a lɛ azubɔdeɛ nwoma ne a. 9Ma azubɔdeɛ biala mɔɔ bɛdo ye fonlomo nu nee mɔɔ bɛloa ye kyɛnze anzɛɛ fulonvule nu la le sɛlɛvolɛ ne mɔɔ kɛva kɛbɔ azu ne la ɛdeɛ. 10Na azubɔdeɛ biala mɔɔ bɛva nwole bɛfɔtɔ anzɛɛ mɔɔ le reserese la le Aalɔn amra ne mɔ ɛdeɛ. Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛkyɛ ye bɛ ti pɛpɛ.
Anzonudwolɛ (Agɔnwolɛyɛlɛ) azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ
11“Anzonudwolɛ azubɔdeɛ mɔɔ bɛfa bɛabɔ azu bɛamaa Ɛdɛnkɛma la anwo mɛla ɛne: 12Saa ahenle fa ba kɛ ɔfa yeayɛ mo a, ɛnee ɔwɔ kɛ ɔfa kpanwo ngyikyi mɔɔ mgbɔvonle ɛnle nu na bɛva nwole bɛfɔtɔ la, kpanwo ngyikyi ndɛbandɛba ngukulungukulu mɔɔ mgbɔvonle ɛnle nu na nwole wɔ nwolɛ la, yɛɛ belɛde mɔɔ bɛva esamo kpalɛ mɔɔ bɛva nwole bɛfɔtɔ bɛyɛ la. 13Ɔwɔ kɛ ahenle fa kpanwo ndɛbandɛba mɔɔ mgbɔvonle wɔ nu la boka ye anzonudwolɛ azubɔdeɛ ne anwo ɔbabɔ azu ne. 14Ɔbava kpanwo ndɛbandɛba ɛhye mɔ ko yeaboka azubɔdeɛ ko biala anwo kɛ ɔle azubɔdeɛ yeamaa Ɛdɛnkɛma. Ɛhye le sɛlɛvolɛ ne mɔɔ to anzonudwolɛ azubɔdeɛ mogya ne gua azukponle ne anwo yia la ɛdeɛ. 15Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛdi anzonudwolɛ azubɔdeɛ ne mɔɔ bɛva bɛbɔ azu bɛyɛ mo la amuala kenle ko ne. Ɔnle kɛ bɛgyakyi bie bɛsie ɛkɛ ne bɛmaa aleɛ kye zolɛ.
16“Na saa azubɔdeɛ ne le ɛwɔkɛyelɛ azubɔdeɛ anzɛɛ azubɔdeɛ mɔɔ ahenle ɛyeye ɔ kunlu ɛva ɛra la a, yemɔ bɛli azubɔdeɛ ne kenle ko ne ala, na saa bie ka ɛdeɛ a, bɛkola bɛdi wɔ ye alehyenlɛ nu. 17Noko saa bie ka na ɔdi kenle nsa a, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛyela ye. 18Saa azubɔlɛ aleɛ ne bie ka, ɔdi kenle nsa na bɛdi a, ɔnle kɛ bɛdie ahenle mɔɔ nee azubɔdeɛ ne rale la bɛto nu, yɛɛ ɔnle kɛ bɛfa ye kɛ ɔvale debie bɔbɔ ɔrale. Ɔle munzule debie, yɛɛ mɔɔ kɛli bie la, ɛtane ne zo ɔdaye. 19Nane mɔɔ kɛha debie mɔɔ anwo ɛnde la, ɔnle kɛ bɛdi Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛyela ye.
“Awie biala mɔɔ anwo te la kola di nane ne bie. 20Na saa evinli ɛha awie na ɔfa ɔdi anzonudwolɛ azubɔdeɛ ne mɔɔ bɛva bɛbɔ azu bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma la bie a, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛye ye bɛfi ye menli ne avinli. 21Zɔhane ala yɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛyɛ awie biala mɔɔ anwo kɛha debie mɔɔ anwo ɛnde la, saa sonla o, nane o, anzɛɛ kyibadeɛ biala, na ɔkɛli anzonudwolɛ azubɔdeɛ ne mɔɔ bɛva bɛbɔ azu bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma la aleɛ ne bie la a. Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛye sonla zɔhane bɛfi ye menli ne avinli.”
22Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi kɛ, 23“Ka kile Yizilayɛma kɛ, ɔnle kɛ bɛdi nane ɛnlome, saa ɛnlankɛ o, boane o anzɛɛ abɔnkye o. 24Bɛkola bɛfa nane mɔɔ ɔdaye ɔ ngome ɔkɛwu anzɛɛ nane kpole bie kɛhu ye la ɛnlome bɛyɛ sua nu ninyɛne bie mɔ; noko ɔnle kɛ bɛdi ye fee. 25Awie biala mɔɔ kɛli nane mɔɔ bɛva bɛbɔ ɛyelalɛ azu bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma la ɛnlome la, bɛye ye bɛvi ye menli ne avinli. 26 Eza ɔnle kɛ bɛdi mogya biala fee. Saa ɔle anloma anzɛɛ nane mɔɔ wɔ wɔ sua nu bɔbɔ la a, ɔnle kɛ bɛdi ye mogya 27Awie biala mɔɔ kɛli mogya la, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛye ye bɛfi ye menli ne avinli.”
28Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi kɛ, 29“Ka kile Yizilayɛma kɛ: Ɔwɔ kɛ awie biala mɔɔ bɔ anzonudwolɛ azu amaa Ɛdɛnkɛma la fa ye azubɔdeɛ ne bɛlɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma. Ye anzonudwolɛ azubɔdeɛ ne mɔɔ bɛva bɛbɔ azu ne la, 30ɔwɔ kɛ ɔdaye mumua ne ɔfa nuhua ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ ne ɔ sa nu ɔbɛlɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma. Ɔwɔ kɛ ɔfa nane ne ɛnlome ne nee ɔ kɛnra azo ne a ba a, amaa bɛado ɔ kɛnra azo ne ehono bɛabɔ ehono azu bɛamaa Ɛdɛnkɛma. 31Sɛlɛvolɛ ne bayela ɛnlome ne wɔ azukponle ne azo, na ɔ kɛnra azo ne le Aalɔn nee ɔ mra ne mɔ ɛdeɛ. 32Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛfa nane ne ɛzɔlɛ fema ne mɔɔ bɛkɛdu la bɛmaa sɛlɛvolɛ ne kɛ azubɔdeɛ mɔɔ vi anzonudwolɛ azubɔdeɛ ne anu la. 33Ɛzɔlɛ ɛhye le sɛlɛvolɛ ne nee Aalɔn amra ne mɔ mɔɔ to anzonudwolɛ azubɔdeɛ mogya ne gua azukponle ne anwo la ɛdeɛ. 34Ɔluakɛ nane ne akɛnra azo ne nee ɛzɔlɛ ne mɔɔ bɛkɛdu la, melie mevi Yizilayɛma ɛkɛ, mevi bɛ anzonudwolɛ azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ anu, na meva memaa Sɛlɛvolɛ Aalɔn nee ɔ mra ne mɔ na meyɛ ye kɛ dahuu biala ɔle bɛ ɛdeɛ. 35Ɔle Aalɔn nee ɔ mra ne mɔ ɛdeɛ mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛfa bɛmaa bɛ, bɛye bɛfi ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛfa bɛabɔ azu bɛamaa Ɛdɛnkɛma la anu a. Mekɛ mɔɔ bɛdule bɛ bɛmanle Ɛdɛnkɛma kɛ bɛle ye sɛlɛvolɛma la yɛɛ bɛdule ɛhye bɛziele ɛkɛ bɛmanle bɛ a. 36Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛle ye mɛla wɔ kenle mɔɔ bɛkpokpale bɛ nwole la kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ Yizilayɛma fa maa bɛ dahuu wɔ awolɛndoazo muala anu.”
37Ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ, ma azubɔdeɛ, ɛtane azubɔdeɛ, fɔlɛlilɛ azubɔdeɛ, ɛnluanlɛ anzɛɛ anwotumaa yɛɛ anzonudwolɛ azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ anwo mɛla 38mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma hyehyɛle manle Mosisi wɔ Saenae Boka, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɔzele Yizilayɛma kɛ bɛva bɛ azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ bɛrɛlɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma la ɛne. Mekɛ ne anu ɛnee bɛwɔ Saenae fienemgbole ne anu.

Title: SƐLƐ 8
Content:
Aalɔn nee ɔ mra ne mɔ sɛlɛvolɛ ɛwulalɛ
(Ade 29.1-37)
1Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi kɛ, 2“Fa Aalɔn nee ɔ mra ne mɔ, adɛladeɛ ne mɔ nee ɛkpokpalɛ nwole ne mɔɔ bɛfa bɛtu sonla bɛmaa Nyamenle la, ɛnlankɛ nyinli mɔɔ bɛfa bɛayɛ ɛtane azubɔdeɛ, mboane nyinli nwiɔ ne, yɛɛ akee kpanwo mɔɔ mgbɔvonle ɛnle nu la kɛndɛne ko ne. 3Boɔboa menli ne kɔsɔɔti anloa wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne anlenkɛ ne anloa.”
4Mosisi yɛle mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma zele ye la, na menli ne amuala rayiale Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne anlenkɛ ne anloa. 5Na Mosisi hanle hilele menli ne kɛ, “Debie mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛze me kɛ menyɛ la ɛne.”
6Akee Mosisi vale Aalɔn nee ɔ mra ne mɔ rale, na ɔvale nzule ɔbiale bɛ. 7Ɔvale Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli tɛladeɛ ɔwulale Aalɔn, na ɔvale tabule ne ɔhyele zo, ɔvale tɛladeɛ aguzo ne ɔkpolole ye, ɔvale yifɔdo ne ɔwulale ye na ɔvale ye akyeso ne mɔɔ bɛnwo ye kɛnlɛma bie la ɔhyele zolɛ. 8Akee ɔvale akɛnrazo aguzo ne ɔwulale ye na ɔvale “Yulem” ne nee “Tɛmem” ne ɔguale nu. 9Akee ɔvale ɛdanlɛ abɔtile ne ɔbɔle ye na ɔvale ezukoa nvutuke ɔbɔle abɔtile ne anyunlu, kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi la, ɔle belemgbunli kyɛlɛ mɔɔ anwo te a.
10Akee Mosisi vale ɛkpokpalɛ nwole ne na ɔvale bie ɔguale Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne azo, nee debie biala mɔɔ wɔ sua ne anu la azo, ɔdule bɛ muala ɔmanle Nyamenle. 11Ɔvale bie ɔkpondenle azukponle ne anwo fane nsuu, ɔvale bie ɔkpondenle ahyɛnze nee ninyɛne mɔɔ bɛfa bɛyɛ gyima wɔ azukponle ne azo la anwo ɔdule bɛ ɔmanle Nyamenle. 12Ɔwolale bie ɔguale Aalɔn ati zo, na ɔdule ye ɔmanle Nyamenle. 13Mosisi vale Aalɔn amra mrenya ne mɔ rale, ɔwulale bɛ sɛlɛvolɛ adɛladeɛ, ɔvale ndabule ne mɔ ɔhyehyele zo na ɔzoale bɛ ahyɛlɛ, kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma zele la.
14Akee ɔvale ɛnlankɛ nyinli ɛtane azubɔdeɛ ne ɔrale, na Aalɔn nee ɔ mra ne mɔ vale bɛ sa guale ɛnlankɛ ne ati zo. 15Mosisi hunle ye na ɔvale mogya ne, ɔvale ɔ sa. ɛrɛlɛsɛka ɔbɔle nu na ɔvale ɔpepenle azukponle ne abati kpokpɔkoo ne mɔ mɔɔ gyigyi zolɛ la azo ɔyiale, ɔvale ɔnluanle azukponle ne, na akee ɔwolale mogya ne mɔɔ hale la ɔguale azukponle ne abo ne anwo, ɔdule ɔmanle Nyamenle ɔyɛle mgbɔdalɛ nzɛlɛlɛ ɔmanle ye. 16Akee Mosisi yeyele azubɔdeɛ ne akunlu ɛnlome ne, ye ɛzizira nwiɔ ne nee ye ɛbolɛ ne nee nwolɛ ninyɛne ne amuala, na ɔyelale bɛ wɔ azukponle ne azo. 17Na ɛnlankɛ ne nane ne, ye nwoma ne nee ɔ kunlu ninyɛne ne mɔ amuala, Mosisi yelale bɛ wɔ azokoɛleɛ ne kandiba, kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma zele la.
18Akee Mosisi vale boane nyinli ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ ne rale, na Aalɔn nee ɔ mra ne mɔ vale bɛ sa guale ɔ ti zo. 19Mosisi hunle boane ne na ɔdole ye mogya ne ɔguale azukponle ne anwo amuala ɔyiale. 20Bɛbiale boane ne bɛwiele la, Mosisi yelale boane ne ati ne nee nane azinli ne mɔɔ bɛpepɛ la nee ɔ kunlu ɛnlome ne. 21Akee bɛvale nzule bɛnrinzinle nane ne ndwɛlɛ ne nee ɔ kunlu ninyɛne ne mɔ anwo na Mosisi yelale boane mumua ne amuala wɔ azukponle ne azo, kɛ ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ. Ɔbɔ evuanlɛ, na ɔle azu mɔɔ bɛfa senle bɛbɔ bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma, kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi la.
22Akee Mosisi vale boane nyinli ko ne, mɔɔ le sɛlɛvolɛwulalɛ boane ne rale, na Aalɔn nee ɔ mra ne mɔ vale bɛ sa guale boane nyinli ne ati zo. 23Mosisi hunle boane ne na ɔvale ye mogya ne bie ɔhanle Aalɔn anzo fema ne ati, ɔ sa fema kokotile yɛɛ ɔ gyakɛ fema kokotile ne mɔ azo. 24Akee bɛvale Aalɔn amra ne mɔ bɛrale, na Mosisi vale mogya ne bie hanle bɛ nzo fema ne mɔ ati, bɛ sa nee bɛ gyakɛ fema ahohotile ne mɔ azo na akee ɔdole mogya ne ɔguale azukponle ne anwo amuala ɔyiale. 25Akee Mosisi vale nane ɛnlome ne, ɔ dua dɔlera ne, ɛnlome ne mɔɔ wɔ ɔ kunlu ninyɛne ne mɔ anwo la, ye ɛbolɛ nwo ninyɛne, ye ɛzizira nwiɔ ne nee nwolɛ ɛnlome ne, yɛɛ nane ne ɛzɔlɛ fema ne. 26Akee Mosisi yele angye kpanwo tɛtɛlɛ ko, angye belɛde mɔɔ nwole wɔ nu la ko, yɛɛ kpanwo ɛdɛbaa kulukulu ko, wɔ angye kpanwo kɛndɛne ko ne mɔɔ gyi Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu ɛkɛ la anu na ɔvale ɔguale nane ɛnlome ne nee ɛzɔlɛ fema ne azo, 27na ɔvale ɔwulale Aalɔn nee ɔ mra ne mɔ asa anu, na ɔdole ninyɛne ne mɔ ehono, kɛ ɔle ehono azubɔdeɛ ɔmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma. 28Akee Mosisi liele ninyɛne ne bɛ sa nu na ɔvale ɔbokale ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ ne ɔyelale bɛ muala wɔ azukponle ne azo, kɛ sɛlɛvolɛwulalɛ azubɔdeɛ mɔɔ bɛfa senle bɛbɔ ye azu evuanlɛ bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma. 29Na Mosisi vale azubɔdeɛ ne akɛnra azo ne dole ye ehono kɛ ɔle ehono azubɔdeɛ ɔmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma; Mosisi afoa nu ɛdeɛ mɔɔ wɔ azubɔlɛ boane ne anu la a le ɛhye, kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma zele la.
30Akee Mosisi vale nwole ne na ɔvale mogya ne mɔɔ wɔ azukponle ne azo la bie ɔkpotole nuhua na ɔvale ɔkpondenle Aalɔn anwo nee ye adɛladeɛ ne mɔ anu. Ɔvale bie ɔkpondenle ɔ mra ne mɔ anwo na ɔvale bie ɔkpondenle bɛ adɛladeɛ ne mɔ anu. Yemɔti ɔbɔle Aalɔn nee ye adɛladeɛ yɛɛ ɔ mra mrenya ne mɔ nee bɛ adɛladeɛ ne mɔ nu ɔdule bɛ ɔmanle Nyamenle.
31Na Mosisi zele Aalɔn nee ɔ mra ne mɔ kɛ, “Bɛdo nane ne wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ye anuhɔlɛ lɔ, na bɛli bɛboka kpanwo ne mɔɔ wɔ kɛndɛne ne mɔɔ sɛlɛvolɛwulalɛ azubɔlɛ ninyɛne ne mɔ wɔ nu la, kɛmɔ menzele bɛ la kɛ, ‘Aalɔn nee ɔ mra ne mɔ a bali a.’ 32Nane ne nee kpanwo ne mɔ mɔɔ kɛha la bɛyela bɛ. 33Bɛmmabɔ bɛtɛla Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ye anuhɔlɛ ne dedee kenle nsuu, kɔkpula mekɛ ne mɔɔ bɛfa bɛadu bɛ bɛamaa Nyamenle la kɛwie la, ɔluakɛ bɛfa kenle nsuu a bɛadu bɛ bɛamaa Nyamenle a. 34Kɛmɔ yɛyɛ ye ɛnɛ la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛhyehyɛ kɛ bɛyɛ mgbɔdalɛ nzɛlɛlɛ bɛmaa bɛ a. 35Bɛdɛnla Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne anuhɔlɛ ne nɔɔzo nee ewiazo kenle nsuu, bɛyɛ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛze bɛ la, anrɛɛ bɛkɛwu, ɔluakɛ zɔhane ala yɛɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛze me a.” 36Na Aalɔn nee ɔ mra ne mɔ yɛle ninyɛne mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma luale Mosisi anwo zo zele bɛ la kɔsɔɔti.

Title: SƐLƐ 9
Content:
Aalɔn bɔ azu amaa Nyamenle
1Kenle mɔtwɛ ne azo, Mosisi vɛlɛle Aalɔn nee ɔ mra mrenya ne mɔ nee Yizilayɛ mgbanyima; 2na ɔzele Aalɔn kɛ, “Fa ɛnlankɛ nyinli edonraa ko yɛ ɛtane azubɔdeɛ na fa boane nyinli ko yɛ ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ maa Ɛdɛnkɛma. Ɔnle kɛ nane nwiɔ ne biala anwo nyia dɛne. 3Na ka kile Yizilayɛma kɛ, ‘Bɛva abɔnkye nyinli bɛyɛ ɛtane azubɔdeɛ; bɛva boane edonraa nee ɛnlankɛ edonraa mɔɔ bɛ nwo ɛnlɛ dɛne, na bɛli ɛvolɛ ngoko la bɛyɛ ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ, 4yɛɛ akee boane nyinli ko nee ɛnlankɛ nyinli kpole ko bɛyɛ anzonudwolɛ azubɔdeɛ, na bɛva ma azubɔdeɛ mɔɔ bɛva nwole bɛfɔtɔ la bɛboka nwo bɛbɔ azu bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma. Ɔluakɛ ɛnɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma baye ɔ nwo ahile bɛ.’ ”
5Na bɛvale ninyɛne mɔɔ Mosisi zele bɛ kɛ bɛsesa la bɛrale Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne anyunlu. 6Na Mosisi zele kɛ, “Debie mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛze bɛ kɛ bɛyɛ la ɛne, na Ɛdɛnkɛma baye ye anyunlunyia ne ahile bɛ.” 7Mosisi zele Aalɔn kɛ, “Kɔ azukponle ne anwo, fa wɔ ɛtane azubɔdeɛ ne nee wɔ ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ kɔ, na bɔ mgbɔdalɛ nzɛlɛlɛ azu maa ɛ nwo nee menli ne, kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛze wɔ la. Na fa menli ne mɔ azubɔdeɛ ne bɔ mgbɔdalɛ azu maa bɛ.”
8Yemɔti Aalɔn hɔle azukponle ne anwo na ɔhunle ɔdaye ye ɛtane azubɔdeɛ ɛnlankɛ ne. 9Ɔ mra mrenya ne mɔ vale mogya ne rɛlɛle ye, na ɔvale ɔ sa ɛrɛlɛsɛka ɔbɔle nu na ɔvale ɔpepenle azukponle ne abati kpokpɔkoo ne mɔ azo, na ɔwolale mogya ne mɔɔ hale la ɔguale azukponle ne abo ne anwo. 10Ɔyelale nane ɛnlome ne, ye ɛzizira ne mɔ, ye ɛbolɛ nee nwolɛ ninyɛne ne mɔ wɔ azukponle ne azo kɛ ɛtane azubɔdeɛ, kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi la. 11Azubɔdeɛ ne nane ne nee ye nwoma ne, ɔyelale bɛ wɔ azokoɛleɛ ne kandiba.
12Akee Aalɔn hunle ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ ne; ɔ mra mrenya ne mɔ vale mogya ne hɔmanle ye, na ɔdole ɔguale azukponle ne anwo amuala ɔyiale. 13Bɛvale ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ ne azinli azinli ne mɔɔ bɛpepɛ la nee ɔ ti ne bɛrɛlɛle ye, na ɔyelale bɛ wɔ azukponle ne azo. 14Akee ɔnrinzinle ɔ kunlu ne nee ye ndwɛlɛ ne mɔ anwo na ɔyelale bɛ ɔbokale ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ ne anwo wɔ azukponle ne azo.
15Akee Aalɔn vale menli ne azubɔdeɛ ne, ɔhunle abɔnkye ɛtane azubɔdeɛ ne, na ɔvale ɔbɔle azu wɔ menli ne ɛtane ti, kɛ mɔɔ ɔyɛle alumua ɛtane azubɔdeɛ ne la. 16Eza ɔbɔle ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ azu ne, kɛmɔ ngyehyɛlɛ ne kile la. 17Ɔbɔle ma azubɔdeɛ azu ne na ɔyelale ye wɔ azukponle ne azo ɔbokale nwonlomɔ ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ ne anwo. 18 Ɔhunle ɛnlankɛ nyinli ne nee boane nyinli ne ɔbɔle anzonudwolɛ azu ne ɔmanle menli ne. Aalɔn amra mrenya ne mɔ vale mogya ne rɛlɛle ye, na ɔdole ɔguale azukponle ne anwo amuala ɔyiale. 19Ɛnlankɛ ne nee boane nyinli ne mɔ akunlu ɛnlome ne, boane ne adua dɔlera ne, ɛnlome ne mɔɔ wɔ bɛ kunlu ninyɛne ne mɔ anwo, bɛ ɛzizira ne mɔ nee ninyɛne mɔɔ wɔ bɛ ɛbolɛ ne mɔ anwo, mɔɔ bɛyeyele la, 20bɛvulale bɛ kɔsɔɔti bɛguale azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ akɛnra azo ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛdudule la azo bɛrɛlɛle ye, na Aalɔn yelale nane ɛnlome ne wɔ azukponle ne azo. 21Na nane ne mɔ akɛnra azo ne mɔ nee bɛ ɛzɔlɛ fema ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛdudule la, Aalɔn dole bɛ ehono na ɔvale ɔbɔle ehono azu ɔmanle Ɛdɛnkɛma, kɛmɔ Mosisi zele la.
