22Akee Aalɔn manle ɔ sa zo wɔ menli ne anwo zo na ɔyilale bɛ, na ɔvi ɛleka mɔɔ ɔvale ɛtane azubɔdeɛ ne, ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ ne nee anzonudwolɛ azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ ɔbɔle azu la ɔdwule aze. 23Na Mosisi nee Aalɔn hɔle Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne anu, na bɛvindele bɛrayilale menli ne, na Ɛdɛnkɛma manle menli ne kɔsɔɔti nwunle ye anyunlunyia ne. 24Na senle vi Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛkɛ ne rayelale ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ ne nee nane ɛnlome ne mɔɔ wɔ azukponle ne azo la. Menli ne amuala nwunle ye la, bɛdeɛdeanle nuhua na bɛbutubutule bɛ nye aze.

Title: SƐLƐ 10
Content:
Needabe nee Abaehu ɛtane ne mɔɔ bɛyɛle la
1Na Aalɔn amra mrenya ne mɔ nwiɔ, Needabe nee Abaehu vale bɛ dwora ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛfa bɛkpu ɛyɛlɛ la na bɛguale senle nu, bɛvulale ɛyɛlɛ bɛguale nu, na bɛvale senle mɔɔ ɛnle nwuanzanwuanza la bɛvindele Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛanze bɛ zɔhane la. 2Na senle vi Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛkɛ ne rayelale bɛ, na bɛwule ɛkɛ ne ala wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu. 3Na Mosisi zele Aalɔn kɛ, “Ɛdɛnkɛma se, ‘Mekile meamaa menli mɔɔ bikye me la anwu kɛ mele nwuanzanwuanza, na meamaa menli ne amuala anwu me anyunlunyia ne.’ ” Na Aalɔn andɛ ɔ nloa anu.
4Mosisi vɛlɛle Aalɔn awuvuanyi Ɛzeɛle amra Maehyeeyɛle nee Ɛlezeefan na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛrɛla bɛraye bɛ mediema ne mɔ bɛvi ɛleka nwuanzanwuanza ye bɛhɔ azokoɛleɛ ne anzi lɔ.” 5Yemɔti bɛrale na bɛravale bɛ wɔ bɛ adɛladeɛ ne mɔ anu bɛvindele azokoɛleɛ ne anzi lɔ, kɛmɔ Mosisi ɛha la.
6Na Mosisi zele Aalɔn nee ɔ mra mrenya Ɛlieza nee Yetamaa kɛ, “Bɛmmamaa bɛ ti enrinli kendɛhenda nwolɛ yɛɛ bɛmmasuosua bɛ adɛladeɛ nu bɛkile kɛ bɛlɛdi nyane, anrɛɛ bɛkɛwu, na bɛkɛmaa bɛkɛva menli mɔɔ ɛrayia ɛke la amuala anwo ɛya. Noko bɛ mediema Yizilayɛma amuala kola su bɛ wɔ senle ɛhye mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛva ɛyela bɛ la ati. 7Eza bɛmmabɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ye anuhɔlɛ ne bɛtɛla, anrɛɛ bɛkɛwu, ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma nwole ne mɔɔ ɔvale ɔkpokpale bɛ la wɔ bɛ nwo.” Na bɛyɛle, kɛmɔ Mosisi hanle la.
Sɛlɛvolɛma mɛla
8Na Ɛdɛnkɛma dendɛle hilele Aalɔn kɛ, 9“Mmano nza nwanye anzɛɛ nza ɛsesebɛ. Ɛdawɔ o, anzɛɛ ɛ mra mrenya ne mɔ o, bɛmmano nza kolaa na bɛahɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne anu, anrɛɛ bɛkɛwu. Ɛhye bayɛ mɛla ala ɛkɛ dahuu amaa wɔ awolɛndoazo kɔsɔɔti. 10Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛnwu mɔɔ le nwuanzanwuanza la na bɛnwu mɔɔ anwo ɛngyia la; ɔwɔ kɛ bɛnwu mɔɔ anwo te la na bɛnwu mɔɔ anwo ɛnde la. 11Eza ɔwɔ kɛ bɛkilehile Yizilayɛma mɛla ne mɔ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛlua Mosisi anwo zo ɛva ɛmaa bɛ la amuala.”
12 Mosisi zele Aalɔn nee ɔ mra mrenya nwiɔ ne mɔɔ ɛha la, Ɛlieza nee Yetamaa kɛ, “Bɛva ma azubɔdeɛ ne mɔɔ bɛyelale bɛbɔle azu bɛmanle Ɛdɛnkɛma la abo ne mɔɔ ɛha la, bɛmmafa mgbɔvonle bɛwula nu, na bɛli wɔ azukponle ne anwo ɛkɛ, ɔluakɛ ɔle nwuanzanwuanza kpalɛ kpalɛ. 13Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛdi ye wɔ ɛleka mɔɔ te la, ɔboalekɛ ɔle ɛdawɔ nee ɛ mra mrenya ne mɔ afoa nu ɛdeɛ, mɔɔ vi ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ ne mɔɔ bɛvale bɛmanle Ɛdɛnkɛma la anu. Ɔluakɛ zɔhane yɛɛ bɛze me a. 14 Na nane ne akɛnra azo ne mɔɔ bɛdo ye ehono la nee ye ɛzɔlɛ ne mɔɔ bɛva bɛbɔ azu ne la, bɛli wɔ ɛleka mɔɔ te la Ɛdawɔ, ɛ mra ne mɔ, yɛɛ ɛ mra mraalɛ ne mɔ a ɔwɔ kɛ di a Ɔluakɛ bɛva bɛmaa kɛ ɛdawɔ nee ɛ mra mrenya ne mɔ afoa nu ɛdeɛ mɔɔ vi Yizilayɛma anzonudwolɛ azubɔdeɛ azubɔlɛ ne anu la 15Nane ɛzɔlɛ ne mɔɔ bɛfa bɛabɔ azu ne nee nane ne akɛnra azo ne mɔɔ bɛdo ye ehono la, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛfa bɛboka ɛnlome ne mɔɔ bɛyela la anwo bɛto ye ehono, kɛ ehono azubɔdeɛ wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu, na akee yeayɛ ɛdawɔ nee ɛ mra ne mɔ ɛdeɛ dahuu, kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma zele la.”
16Akee Mosisi bizebizale abɔnkye ne mɔɔ bɛvale bɛyɛle ɛtane azubɔdeɛ ne la anwo edwɛkɛ kpalɛ, na ɔnwunle kɛ bɛyelale ye. Ɔvale Aalɔn amra mrenya ne mɔ mɔɔ ɛha la, Ɛlieza nee Yetamaa anwo ɛya na ɔbizale bɛ kɛ, 17“Duzu ati a bɛanli ɛtane azubɔdeɛ ne wɔ ɛleka nwuanzanwuanza ne ɛ? Ɔboalekɛ ɔle debie nwuanzanwuanza kpalɛ kpalɛ mɔɔ bɛvale bɛmanle bɛ, amaa bɛazoa menli ne ɛtane ne mɔ na bɛahɔyɛ nwolɛ mgbɔdalɛ nzɛlɛlɛ wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu. 18Bɛnlea, bɛanva ye mogya ne bɛamba ɛleka nwuanzanwuanza ne akunlu. Yemɔti anrɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛdi ye wɔ ɛleka nwuanzanwuanza ne, kɛmɔ menzele la.”
19Aalɔn buale Mosisi kɛ, “Nea, ɛnɛ bɔbɔ mɔɔ bɛva bɛ ɛtane azubɔdeɛ nee bɛ ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ bɛra Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu la, nea mɔɔ ɛzi me nwo zo la. Saa menlile ɛtane azubɔdeɛ ne ɛnɛ a, anrɛɛ ɛnee ɛnea a, ɔkɛzɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anye ɔ?” 20Mɔɔ Mosisi dele ɛhye la, ɔ kunlu dwole.

Title: SƐLƐ 11
Content:
Nane mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛdi la
(Mɛla 14.3-21)
1Akee Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi nee Aalɔn kɛ, 2“Bɛha bɛhile Yizilayɛma kɛ, Ninyɛne mɔɔ lɛ ngoane kɛ nane nane, mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛdi la, bɛmɛ ɛne: 3Debie biala mɔɔ bɛkpakye ye ndwɛlɛ taboa ne anu nwiɔ na ɔkpu ɔkposa la, bɛli. 4-6Noko ɛhye mɔ mɔɔ kpu kposa anzɛɛ bɛkpakye bɛ ndwɛlɛ ndaboa ne mɔ anu la, ɔnle kɛ bɛdi. Ɔnle kɛ bɛdi afunlumu, abotokila, yɛɛ asoaso, ɔboalekɛ bɛkpu bɛkposa ɛdeɛ, noko bɛamkpakye bɛ ndwɛlɛ ndaboa ne mɔ anu. Bɛ nwo ɛnde. 7Bɛmmadi kpolike, ɔboalekɛ bɛkpakye ye ndwɛlɛ ndaboa ne anu ɛdeɛ, noko ɔmkpu ɔmkposa. Ɔ nwo ɛnde ɛmmaa bɛ. 8Bɛmmadi bɛ nane ne yɛɛ bɛmmafa bɛ sa bɛka bɛ avunli bɔbɔ, ɔluakɛ bɛ nwo ɛnde ɛmmaa bɛ.
9“Bɛkola bɛdi fɛlɛ biala mɔɔ wɔ azule nu na ɔlɛ ɔ nzi ngyɛnengyɛne na ɔ nwo lɛ abonle la. 10Na fɛlɛ biala mɔɔ wɔ azule nu na ɔnlɛ ɔ nzi ngyɛnengyɛne na ɔ nwo ɛnlɛ abonle la, bɛmmadi. Bɛ nwo ɛnde ɛmmaa bɛ; bɛle kyibadeɛ. 11Mekɛ biala bɛle kyibadeɛ; bɛmmadi yɛɛ bɛmmafa bɛ sa bɛka bɛ avunli. 12Debie biala mɔɔ wɔ azule nu mɔɔ ɛnlɛ ɔ nzi ngyɛnengyɛne anzɛɛ ɔ nwo ɛnlɛ abonle la le kyibadeɛ maa bɛ.
13-19“Nloma ɛhye mɔ noko le kyibadeɛ maa bɛ. Bɛmmadi bie: kɔleɛ, ɛkpɔtɛ, bɔngɔ, sanzia, kyɛnyema nee ye ɛsaso, kɔkɔsɛlɛ biala nee ye ɛsaso, soholo, kpadule, akoso, azuazuanloma, ahweanga, yɛɛ akpanlɛ.
20“Kɛkɛba biala mɔɔ lɛ ndɛbalɛ na ɔtia egyakɛ nna azo la le kyibadeɛ maa bɛ. 21Noko kɛkɛba biala mɔɔ lɛ ndɛbalɛ na ɔtia egyakɛ nna azo, na eza ɔlɛ egyakɛ nwiɔ bieko wɔ ɔ nzi egyakɛ ne mɔ azo, mɔɔ ɔkola ɔfa ɔwulu la, bɛkola bɛdi. 22Yemɔti bɛkola bɛdi abɛbɛ nee ye ɛsaso, kɛlatua nee ye ɛsaso, yɛɛ bɛnyebɛnye nee ye ɛsaso. 23Na ngɛkɛba mɔɔ ɛha mɔɔ lɛ ndɛbalɛ nee egyakɛ nna la kɔsɔɔti le kyibadeɛ.
24-28“Awie biala mɔɔ kɛva ɔ sa kɛha nane ɛhye mɔ bie funli la, evinli baha ye toonwo nɔsolɛ nu: nane biala mɔɔ lɛ ndwɛlɛ ndaboa mɔɔ bɛamkpakye nu noko ɔkpu ɔkposa, yɛɛ nane biala mɔɔ lɛ ɛweɛlɛ na ye ndwɛlɛ nna la, ɔwɔ kɛ awie biala mɔɔ kɛzɔ bie funli nu la kpo ye adɛladeɛ ne mɔ, noko evinli ne mɔɔ ɛha ye la bawoa ɛkɛ ne toonwo nɔsolɛ nu.
29-30“Ninyɛne mɔɔ kola fo anwuma mɔɔ anwo ɛnde na ɔnle kɛ bɛdi la a le ɛhye mɔ: abotokila, kila, kekelebetile nee ye ɛsaso, ɛbɔlɔme, ɛlɛnrɛne, bonze, awudabɛ anzɛɛ ahulukpu, yɛɛ bɔmɔnra. 31Bɛ nwo ɛnde ɛmmaa bɛ; awie biala mɔɔ kɛva ɔ sa kɛha bie funli la, evinli baha ye toonwo nɔsolɛ nu. 32Saa bie wu, na debie biala mɔɔ ɔkɛdɔ zolɛ la, saa baka o, ɛdanlɛ o, nwoma o, kodoku o, debie biala mɔɔ bɛfa bɛyɛ debie a ɔyɛ boɛ la, ɛnee deɛ zɔhane, evinli ɛha ye; ɔwɔ kɛ bɛwula ye nzule nu, na nwolɛ ɛnrɛde toonwo nɔsolɛ na nwolɛ ade. 33Saa bie funli tɔ ɛyɛba anzɛɛ dwora nu a, ɛnee evinli ɛha ye; ɔwɔ kɛ bɛbɔ ɛyɛba ne anzɛɛ dwora ne. 34Aleɛ biala mɔɔ bɛdi a ɔyɛ boɛ, na bɛkɛwola ɛyɛba ne anzɛɛ dwora ne anu nzule bɛkɛgua zolɛ la, ɛnee evinli ɛha ye. Nzule bɔbɔ mɔɔ wɔ dwora anzɛɛ ɛyɛba ne anu mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛno la, ɛnee evinli ɛha ye. 35Debie biala mɔɔ bie funli ɛleka bie bɔbɔ kɛdɔ zolɛ la, ɛnee evinli ɛha ye; saa fonlomo o, anzɛɛ mokyea o, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛbubu ye. Bɛ nwo ɛnde, yemɔti bɛ nwo ɛnde ɛmmaa bɛ 36Noko akee nzubula anzɛɛ nzule mɔɔ se la, bɛmɛ, evinli ɛnga bɛ. Na debie biala mɔɔ anwo kɛha bɛ avunli la, ɛnee evinli ɛha ye. 37Saa bie funli tɔ ma mɔɔ bɛkɛlua la azo a, evinli ɛnga ye. 38Na saa bɛgua nzule ma ne azo na bie funli foa ko bie tɔ zolɛ a, nwolɛ ɛnde ɛmmaa bɛ.
39“Saa nane biala mɔɔ bɛdi la bie wu na ɛdawɔ mɔɔ ɛkɛva ɛ sa ɛkɛha ye la, evinli baha wɔ toonwo nɔsolɛ nu. 40Awie mɔɔ kɛli nane funli ne bie la, evinli baha ye toonwo nɔsolɛ nu; yɛɛ eza ɔwɔ kɛ ɔkpo ye adɛladeɛ ne mɔ, yɛɛ evinli baha ye toonwo nɔsolɛ nu.
41“Debie biala mɔɔ kola fo anwuma wɔ ewiade ye anu la le kyibadeɛ maa bɛ. Ɔnle kɛ bɛdi. 42Debie biala mɔɔ twenle ɔ nwo aze anzɛɛ nane ekyi biala mɔɔ tia ndwɛlɛ nna azo anzɛɛ lɛ egyakɛ dɔɔnwo, debie biala mɔɔ kola fo anwuma wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo la, bɛmmadi, ɔluakɛ bɛle kyibadeɛ. 43Ɔnle kɛ bɛdi ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ anzi, bɛdi bie na bɛyɛ kyibadeɛ. Eza ɔnle kɛ bɛtoa bɛ bɛmaa evinli ka bɛ. 44 Ɔluakɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne a. Bɛmaa bɛ nwo ɛde nwuanzaanwu, ɔluakɛ mele nwuanzanwuanza. Ɔnle kɛ bɛfa debie biala mɔɔ kola fo anwuma na eza ɔtwenle ɔ nwo aze wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo la bɛgua bɛ nwo evinli. 45Ɔluakɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma mɔɔ menyele bɛ menvile Yigyibiti azɛlɛ zo a, amaa meayɛ bɛ Nyamenle. Yemɔti bɛmaa bɛ nwo ɛde nwuanzaanwu, ɔluakɛ mele nwuanzanwuanza.”
46Ɛhye a le mɛla mɔɔ fane nane, nloma nee debie biala mɔɔ lɛ ngoane na ɔwɔ nzule nu nee debie biala mɔɔ kola fo anwuma wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo la anwo a. 47Mɛla ne kile ninyɛne mɔɔ anwo te nee mɔɔ anwo ɛnde, nee debie biala mɔɔ lɛ ngoane mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛdi nee mɔɔ ɔnle kɛ bɛdi la.

Title: SƐLƐ 12
Content:
Ɛwofoɔ ɛnluanlɛ
1Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi kɛ, 2“Ka kile Yizilayɛma kɛ, saa raalɛ fa ɛkolɛ na ɔwo ralɛ nrenya a, evinli baha ye kenle nsuu, kɛ asɛɛ ɔhɔle amozi la. 3Kenle mɔtwɛ ne azo bɛbayɛ kakula ne mrenyanu nzonlɛ. 4Akee raalɛ ne bahɔ zolɛ ahyi evinli ne kenle abulasa nee nsa yeavi ye ɛdane yeawie. Mekɛ ne anu, ɔnle kɛ ɔfa ɔ sa ɔka debie biala mɔɔ anwo te la, yɛɛ ɔnle kɛ ɔkɔ ɛleka nwuanzanwuanza ne, kɔkpula mekɛ ne mɔɔ ɔfa yeanlua ɔ nwo la.
5“Saa raalɛ wo raalɛ a, evinli baha ye dapɛne nwiɔ kɛ sonla mɔɔ ɛhɔ amozi la, na yeahyi evinli ne kenle abulasia nee nsia na yeawie ye ɛdane fi.
6“Saa raalɛ wo na ɔwie ɛdane ne mɔ fi a, saa ɔwole nrenya o, ɔwole raalɛ o, ɔwɔ kɛ ɔfa boane edonraa mɔɔ ɛli ɛvolɛ ko la ɔyɛ ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ yɛɛ mɔlɔnoma ekyi ko anzɛɛ abubule ɔyɛ ɛtane azubɔdeɛ na ɔfa ɔbɛlɛ sɛlɛvolɛ ne wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne anuhɔlɛ ne. 7Sɛlɛvolɛ ne bava ye azubɔdeɛ ne abɔ azu amaa Ɛdɛnkɛma, na yeayɛ ɔ ti mgbɔdalɛ nzɛlɛlɛ. Ɔyɛ ɛhye ɔwie a, ɛnee akee ɔ nwo ɛde ɛvi mogya ne mɔɔ dule ye la anwo. Awie mɔɔ kɛwo ralɛ nrenya anzɛɛ ralɛ raalɛ la mɛla a le ɛhye.
8“Saa ɔnrɛhola boane fa a, ɛnee ɔwɔ kɛ ɔfa abubule nwiɔ anzɛɛ mɔlɔnoma ngyikyi nwiɔ; bɛfa ko bɛbɔ ɛyelalɛ azu bɛmaa ye na bɛfa ko ne noko bɛyɛ ɛtane azubɔdeɛ. Sɛlɛvolɛ ne bayɛ mgbɔdalɛ nzɛlɛlɛ amaa ye, na ɔ nwo ade.”

Title: SƐLƐ 13
Content:
Nwonane nu ewule nwo mɛla
1Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi nee Aalɔn kɛ, 2“Saa debie nwu awie, anzɛɛ hanlɛ tu ye anzɛɛ saa nyila bie nwu ye na ɔkakyi kokobɛ wɔ ahenle anwo a, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛfa ye bɛkɔ Aalɔn anzɛɛ ɔ mra sɛlɛvolɛma ne mɔ bie ɛkɛ, 3bɛmaa sɛlɛvolɛ ne nea ewule ne mɔɔ ɛha ahenle ne la Saa ɔba ye kɛ enrinli ne mɔɔ wɔ ɛleka mɔɔ ewule ne wɔ la ɛyɛ fufule, na ye hanlɛ ne anyunlu ɛyɛ kuma a, ɛnee kokobɛ ɔ; sɛlɛvolɛ ne neɛnlea ye wie a, ɔto duma kɛ ahenle ne anwo ɛnde. 4Na saa ɛleka mɔɔ ewule ne wɔ la le fufule na hanlɛ ne ɛnle kuma, eza enrinli mɔɔ wɔ nu la ɛtɛyɛle fufule a, sɛlɛvolɛ ne bamaa bɛawula sonla ne mɔɔ ewule ne ɛha ye la sua nu kenle nsuu. 5Kenle nsuu ne dwu a, sɛlɛvolɛ ne banleɛnlea ahenle ne anwo bieko; saa sɛlɛvolɛ ne nea na ewule ne anloa ɛha aze na ɔtɛtɛlɛle a, eza ɔbamaa bɛawula ahenle ne sua nu kenle nsuu bieko. 6Kenle nsuu ɛhye noko dwu a, sɛlɛvolɛ ne banleɛnlea wuleravolɛ ne anwo bieko; saa deɛ ne mɔɔ yɛle ahenle la anyunlu ɛbulubulu na ɔtɛtɛlɛle a, sɛlɛvolɛ ne bado duma kɛ ahenle anwo te na debie ala a nwunle ye a. Ahenle ne bakpo ye adɛladeɛ ne mɔ, ɛnee ɔ nwo ɛde. 7Na saa deɛ ne mɔɔ nwunle ahenle la tɛlɛ nzinlii, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɔvale ɔ nwo ɔhilele sɛlɛvolɛ ne la anzi a, eza ɔwɔ kɛ ɔfa ɔ nwo ɔkɔkile sɛlɛvolɛ ne bieko. 8Sɛlɛvolɛ ne banleɛnlea ɔ nwo bieko na saa deɛ ne mɔɔ ɛyɛ ye la ɛdɛlɛ a, sɛlɛvolɛ ne bado duma kɛ ahenle ne anwo ɛnde; kokobɛ ɛdila ye.
9“Kokobɛ tila awie a, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛfa ahenle ne bɛkɔ sɛlɛvolɛ ne ɛkɛ. 10Sɛlɛvolɛ ne banleɛnlea ahenle anwo kpalɛ, na saa debie fufule bie ɛnwu ahenle anwo, ɛmaa ye enrinli ne ɛyɛ fufule, na hanlɛ ne kpolo nzule a, 11ɛnee ɔle kokobɛ kokolabi wɔ ahenle anwo. Sɛlɛvolɛ ne bado duma kɛ ahenle ne anwo ɛnde. Ɔngyia kɛ ɔkɛmaa bɛkɛwula ahenle sua nu, ɔluakɛ ɔ nwo ɛnde. 12Na saa kokobɛ ne mɔɔ ɛdila ahenle la ɛkponde ɔ nwo, ɛmaa ewule ne ɛgua ye, ɛbɔ ye ɔ ti zo toonwo yedwu ɔ gyakɛ taboa ne anwo, mɔɔ sɛlɛvolɛ ne kola nwu ye la a, 13sɛlɛvolɛ ne banleɛnlea nu kpalɛ. Saa ɔba ye kɛ ewule ne ɛva ɔ nwo amuala a, sɛlɛvolɛ ne bado duma kɛ ahenle ne anwo te wɔ ewule ne anwo, ɔluakɛ ɔ muala ɛyɛ fufule; ɔ nwo te. 14Na saa hanlɛ mɔɔ kpolo nzule la bie wɔ ahenle ne ɛleka bie a, ɛnee ɔ nwo ɛnde. 15Sɛlɛvolɛ ne banlea hanlɛ ne mɔɔ kpolo nzule la na yeado duma kɛ ahenle anwo ɛnde. Hanlɛ mɔɔ kpolo nzule la ɛnle debie kpalɛ, ɔle kokobɛ. 16Na saa hanlɛ ne mɔɔ kpolo nzule la anyunlu to na ɔyɛ fufule a, ɛnee ɔwɔ kɛ ahenle kɔ sɛlɛvolɛ ne ɛkɛ. 17Sɛlɛvolɛ ne banleɛnlea ahenle ne anwo, na saa ewule ne anyunlu ɛyɛ fufule a, sɛlɛvolɛ ne bado duma kɛ ahenle anwo te; ɔ nwo te bɔkɔɔ.
18“Saa nyila nwu awie na ye hanlɛ ne kɔ, 19na saa debie fufule nwu ɔ bo zo ne anzɛɛ hanlɛ anyunlu kɔkɔlɛ nee fufule tu ɔ bo zo ne a, bɛva bɛhɔhile sɛlɛvolɛ ne. 20Sɛlɛvolɛ ne banleɛnlea ahenle ne hanlɛ ne kpalɛ, na saa hanlɛ ne ɛyɛ kuma na enrinli mɔɔ wɔ nu la ɛyɛ fufule a, sɛlɛvolɛ ne bado duma kɛ ahenle ne anwo ɛnde; kokobɛ ɛdila ye na yevinde hanlɛ ne anu. 21Na saa sɛlɛvolɛ ne neɛnlea ye na ɔnwu kɛ enrinli mɔɔ gyigyi nu la ɛnle fufule yɛɛ hanlɛ ne ɛnle kuma, na eza ɔ nyunlu ɛbulubulu a, sɛlɛvolɛ ne bamaa bɛawula ye sua nu kenle nsuu. 22Saa hanlɛ ne tɛlɛ a, sɛlɛvolɛ ne bado duma kɛ ɔ nwo ɛnde; ewule ɛha ye. 23Na saa hanlɛ ne andɛlɛ a, ɛnee deɛ ne mɔɔ nwunle ye la abo zo hanlɛ ɔ. Sɛlɛvolɛ ne bado duma kɛ ɔ nwo te.
24“Saa awie yelɛyela na ye ɛyelalɛ nganlɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ ɛlɛtwi nzule la anyunlu yɛ fufule anzɛɛ kɔkɔlɛ nee fufule a, 25sɛlɛvolɛ ne ɛnleɛnlea ye. Saa enrinli ne mɔ mɔɔ wɔ nganlɛ ne anu la ɛyɛ fufule na hanlɛ ne anyunlu le kuma a, ɛnee kokobɛ ɔ; ɛyelalɛ hanlɛ ne a ɛhakyi a. Na sɛlɛvolɛ ne bado duma kɛ ahenle anwo ɛnde; ɔle ewule kokobɛ. 26Na saa sɛlɛvolɛ ne neɛnlea ye na ɔnwu kɛ enrinli ne mɔ ɛtɛyɛle fufule, nganlɛ ne mɔ anyunlu ɛnle kuma na bɛ nyunlu ɛbulubulu a, sɛlɛvolɛ ne bamaa bɛawula ye sua nu kenle nsuu. 27Kenle nsuu ne dwu a, sɛlɛvolɛ ne eza banleɛnlea ye bieko. Saa nganlɛ ne mɔ ɛlɛtɛlɛdɛlɛ a, sɛlɛvolɛ ne bado duma kɛ ahenle anwo ɛnde; kokobɛ ɛdila ye. 28Na saa nganlɛ ne mɔ andɛlɛdɛlɛ na bɛ nyunlu ɛbulubulu a, ɛnee ɛyelalɛ nganlɛ ne mɔ yɛɛ ɛnwunwu a. Sɛlɛvolɛ ne bado duma kɛ ahenle anwo te, ɔluakɛ ɛnee ɛyelalɛ nganlɛ ne mɔ ahapenle ɔ.
29“Saa nrenya anzɛɛ raalɛ nyia ewule wɔ ɔ ti zo anzɛɛ ɔ kɛsa anu a, 30sɛlɛvolɛ ne banleɛnlea ewule ne, na saa ye nganlɛ ne mɔ anyunlu le kuma na enrinli mɔɔ gyigyi nu la le akɔlɛnlome, na bɛle ndenrɛndenra a, sɛlɛvolɛ ne bado duma kɛ ahenle anwo ɛnde. Azenra ɛdila ye, na ɔle ewule kokobɛ mɔɔ ɛdila ɔ ti anzɛɛ ɔ kɛsa a. 31Na saa sɛlɛvolɛ ne neɛnlea ewule ne na nganlɛ ne mɔ anyunlu ɛnle kuma na enrinli bile ɛngyigyi nu a, sɛlɛvolɛ ne bamaa bɛawula ahenle mɔɔ azenra ne ɛdila ye la sua nu kenle nsuu. 32Kenle nsuu ne azo sɛlɛvolɛ ne eza banleɛnlea ewule ne na saa azenra ne mɔ ɛtɛtɛlɛdɛlɛle, na enrinli mɔɔ gyigyi nu la ɛtɛyɛle akɔlɛnlome, na azenra ne mɔ anyunlu ɛnle kuma a, 33sɛlɛvolɛ ne bamaa ahenle akpa ɔ ti na bɛawula ye sua nu kenle nsuu bieko; ɛleka mɔɔ azenra ne mɔ bie wɔ la, bɛnrɛkpa ɛkɛ ne enrinli ne. 34Kenle nsuu ne dwu a, sɛlɛvolɛ ne banleɛnlea azenra ne mɔ, na saa azenra ne mɔ ɛtɛtɛlɛdɛlɛle na bɛ nyunlu ɛnle kuma a, ɔbado duma kɛ ahenle ne anwo te. Ɔbakpo ye adɛladeɛ ne mɔ ala, ɛnee ɔ nwo ɛde. 35Na saa azenra ne mɔ tɛlɛdɛlɛ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee yenlua ɔ nwo yewie la a, 36sɛlɛvolɛ ne banleɛnlea ye, na saa azenra ne mɔ ɛdɛlɛdɛlɛ a, ɛnee ɔngyia kɛ sɛlɛvolɛ ne kɛkpondɛ kɛnwu kɛ enrinli akɔlɛnlome gyi nu; ahenle anwo ɛnde. 37Na saa ɔdaye ɔnea na azenra ne mɔ anyunlu ɛnwosonwoso, na enrinli bile ɛfifi zolɛ a, ɛnee azenra ne mɔ ɛhɔ, ahenle anwo te. Yemɔti sɛlɛvolɛ ne bado duma kɛ ahenle anwo te.
38“Saa debie fufule pepe raalɛ anzɛɛ nrenya nwo a, 39sɛlɛvolɛ ne banleɛnlea deɛ zɔhane na saa deɛ ne mɔɔ ɛpepe ahenle anwo la ɛnle fufule nwohyee kpalɛ a, ɛnee ahenle anwo yɛɛ ɛnyia dɛne a, na ɔ nwo te.
40“Saa nrenya bie ati avinli enrinli tu a, ɛnee ɔ ti zo a ɛdu a na ɔ nwo te. 41Saa ɔ nwoma azo enrinli ne tudu kɔ a, ɛnee ɔ nwoma azo a ɛdu a na ɔ nwo te. 42Na saa ewule kɔkɔlɛ nee fufule bie finde ɛleka mɔɔ ɛdu la a, ɔ ti avinli o, ɔ nwoma azo o, ɛnee kokobɛ yɛɛ ɛlɛfinde ahenle ati zo anzɛɛ ɔ nwoma azo a. 43Sɛlɛvolɛ ne banleɛnlea, na saa ewule ne mɔɔ ɛvinde ɔ ti zo ɛleka mɔɔ ɛdu anzɛɛ ɔ nwoma azo ɛleka mɔɔ ɛdu la le kɔkɔlɛ nee fufule kɛ asɛɛ kokobɛ ɛlɛfinde ɔ nwo la a, 44ɛnee ɔle kokobɛvolɛ; ɔ nwo ɛnde. Ɔwɔ kɛ sɛlɛvolɛ ne to duma kɛ ɔ nwo ɛnde, ye ewule ne wɔ ɔ ti zo.
45“Awie mɔɔ kokobɛ kɛdila ye la, ɔwɔ kɛ ɔwula adɛladeɛ mɔɔ ɛtete la na ɔgyakyi ɔ ti enrinli ne ɔgua zolɛ, mɔɔ ɔntoli nu a. Ɔwɔ kɛ ɔkeda ɔ nloa sɔlɔ ne azo na ɔlua a, ɔtea nuhua kɛ, ‘Me nwo ɛnde o, me nwo ɛnde!’ 46Saa ewule ne mɔɔ wɔ ɔ nwo la ɛtɛkɔle a, ɔ nwo ɛnrɛde ɛlɛ. Kɛmɔ ɔ nwo ɛnde la ati, ɔwɔ kɛ ɔte ɔ nwo ɔkɔtɛnla kpɔda bie abo wɔ azokoɛleɛ ne kandiba.
Debie mɔɔ kɛbɔ adubue la anwo mɛla
47“Saa tɛladeɛ mɔɔ bɛva dwɛsɛ nyɛma anzɛɛ mboane enrinli nyɛma bɛnwo la anu bɔ adubue, 48saa bɛnwu bie wɔ ndanlɛ nyɛma mɔɔ bɛzinlezinla la anu, anzɛɛ nwoma nu anzɛɛ debie biala mɔɔ bɛva nwoma bɛyɛ la anu, 49na saa adubue ne anye le asuomenle anzɛɛ kɔkɔlɛ wɔ ɛdanlɛ ne, nyɛma ne, nwoma ne anzɛɛ debie mɔɔ bɛva nwoma bɛyɛ la anu a, ɛnee ewule kokobɛ ɔ. Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛfa bɛkile sɛlɛvolɛ ne. 50Sɛlɛvolɛ ne banleɛnlea ewule ne, na yeamaa bɛawula deɛ ne mɔɔ ewule ne wɔ nu la sua nu kenle nsuu. 51Kenle nsuu ne dwu a, eza yeanleɛnlea ewule ne na saa ewule ne ɛdɛlɛ tɛladeɛ ne, ndanlɛ nyɛma anzɛɛ nwoma ne anu, anzɛɛ debie biala mɔɔ bɛva nwoma bɛyɛ la anu a, ɛnee ewule ne le kokobɛ nzane; deɛ ne anwo ɛnde. 52Sɛlɛvolɛ ne bamaa bɛayela tɛladeɛ ne. Saa ewule ne wɔ mboane enrinli anzɛɛ dwɛsɛ ɛdanlɛ nu o, ndanlɛ nyɛma nu o, nwoma nu o anzɛɛ debie biala mɔɔ bɛva nwoma bɛyɛ la anu o, ewule ne le kokobɛ nzane; ɔwɔ kɛ bɛgua ye senle nu bɛyela ye.
53“Na saa sɛlɛvolɛ ne neɛnlea ewule ne na ɔtɛtɛlɛdɛlɛle ɛdanlɛ anzɛɛ nwoma ne anu a, 54sɛlɛvolɛ ne bamaa bɛakpo deɛ ne mɔɔ ewule ne wɔ nu la na bɛawula ye sua nu kenle nsuu bieko. 55Kenle nsuu ne anzi, sɛlɛvolɛ ne banleɛnlea deɛ ne anu ɛleka mɔɔ anrɛɛ ewule ne wɔ la, na saa ɛleka mɔɔ anrɛɛ ewule ne wɔ la anye angakyi a, ɛnee ewule ne anzande bɔbɔ ɛdeɛ, noko deɛ ne anwo ɛnde. Saa kokobɛ ne abo zo ne tɛbɔ ɛdanlɛ ne anzɛɛ nwoma ne akunlu o, ɔ nzi o, bɛgua ye senle nu bɛyela ye. 56Na saa sɛlɛvolɛ ne neɛnlea deɛ ne anu ɛleka mɔɔ ewule ne woale a bɛkpole la na yedu a, ɔbapɛ ɛleka holɛ ko ne yeavi ɛdanlɛ, nwoma anzɛɛ ndanlɛ nyɛma ne anu. 57Saa ewule ne finde ɛleka fofolɛ a, ɛnee ɔkile kɛ ɔlɛtɛlɛ. Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛgua deɛ ne mɔɔ ewule ne wɔ nu la senle nu bɛyela ye. 58Tɛladeɛ, ndanlɛ nyɛma, anzɛɛ nwoma mɔɔ kɛbɔ adubue na bɛkɛkpo na adubue ne anzia amba bieko la, bɛkpo ye bieko, ɛnee deɛ ne anwo ɛde.”
59Ɛnee mɛla mɔɔ fane ewule kokobɛ mɔɔ wɔ dwɛsɛ anzɛɛ mboane enrinli ndanlɛ nu, ndanlɛ nyɛma, nwoma anzɛɛ debie biala mɔɔ bɛva nwoma bɛyɛ la anu, nee kɛ bɛkɛzi bɛkɛnwu kɛ deɛ ne anwo te anzɛɛ nwolɛ ɛnde la, yemɔ ɛne.

Title: SƐLƐ 14
Content:
Sonla mɔɔ nwonane nu ewule ɛha ye na yede kpɔkɛ la ɛnluanlɛ
1Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi kɛ, 2 “Kokobɛvolɛ mɔɔ anwo kɛza la ɛnluanlɛ nwo mɛla a le ɛhye: Kenle ko ne, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛfa ye bɛbɛlɛ sɛlɛvolɛ ne. 3Sɛlɛvolɛ ne nee ye bavinde ahɔ azokoɛleɛ ne kandiba na yeanleɛnlea ɔ nwo. Na saa kokobɛ ewule ne ɛhɔ a, 4sɛlɛvolɛ ne bamaa bɛabɔ ahenle ne mɔɔ bɛnua ye la ati bɛava nloma mɔɔ anwo te la nwiɔ anyewɔzo, sida baka, boane kɔkɔlɛ enrinli, yɛɛ nyinlanyinla. 5Sɛlɛvolɛ ne bamaa bɛahu nloma ne mɔ ko wɔ siase mɔɔ nzule amolɛ wɔ nu la anu. 6Akee ɔbava anloma ko ne mɔɔ anye wɔ zolɛ la, sida baka ne, boane kɔkɔlɛ enrinli ne nee nyinlanyinla ne yeabɔ bɛ anloma ne mɔɔ bɛhu ye la mogya ne anu, 7na yeakponde ye ahenle ne mɔɔ bɛnua ye la anwo fane nsuu, na akee yeado duma kɛ ɔ nwo ɛde, na yeadwula anloma anyewɔzo ne yeamaa yeahɔ. 8Akee ahenle mɔɔ bɛnua ye la bakpo ye adɛladeɛ, yeakpa ɔ nwo enrinli kɔsɔɔti na yeabia; ɛnee ɔ nwo ɛde. Ɛhye anzi ɔbara sua zo, noko ɔnrɛhɔ ye ndanlɛ sua ne anu. Ɔbala alie nwo toonwo kenle nsuu. 9Kenle nsuu ne azo ɔbakpa ɔ ti bieko, yeakpa ɔ kɛsa, ɔ nye anzi nee ɔ nwo enrinli biala. Ɔbakpo ye adɛladeɛ ne mɔ na yeabia, ɛnee akee ɔ nwo ɛde.
10“Kenle mɔtwɛ ne azo, ɔwɔ kɛ ɔfa mboane nyinli nwiɔ mɔɔ anwo ɛnlɛ dɛne la, boane belɛ ko mɔɔ ɛli ɛvolɛ ko na ɔ nwo ɛnlɛ dɛne la, ma azubɔdeɛ mɔɔ bɛdi bɛyɛ ye esamo na bɛva ɔlivi nwole bɛfɔtɔ la kilo nsa, yɛɛ ɔlivi nwole toba foa ko ɔbɛlɛ sɛlɛvolɛ ne. 11Akee sɛlɛvolɛ ne bava ahenle mɔɔ bɛnua ye la nee ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ ahɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne anuhɔlɛ ne. 12Sɛlɛvolɛ ne bava mboane nyinli ne mɔ ko nee ɔlivi nwole toba foa ko ne ayɛ fɔlɛlilɛ anzɛɛ abozozielɛ azubɔdeɛ, abɔ ehono azu amaa Ɛdɛnkɛma. 13Akee ɔbahu boane ne wɔ ɛleka mɔɔ bɛku ɛtane azubɔdeɛ ne nee ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ la, wɔ ɛleka nwuanzanwuanza ne. Ɔluakɛ fɔlɛlilɛ azubɔdeɛ ne le kɛ ɛtane azubɔdeɛ ne la, na ɔle sɛlɛvolɛ ne ɛdeɛ; ɔle debie mɔɔ le nwuanzanwuanza kpalɛ kpalɛ a. 14Sɛlɛvolɛ ne bava fɔlɛlilɛ azubɔdeɛ ne mogya ne bie aha ahenle mɔɔ bɛnua ye la anzo fema ne ati, ɔ sa fema kokotile ne azo, yɛɛ ɔ gyakɛ fema kokotile ne azo. 15Akee sɛlɛvolɛ ne bawola ɔlivi nwole toba foa ko ne bie agua ɔdaye sɛlɛvolɛ ne ɔ sa bɛne ne anu, 16na yeava ɔ sa fema ɛrɛlɛsɛka yeabɔ nwole ne mɔɔ wɔ ɔ sa bɛne ne anu la anu yeava yeakponde Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu ɛkɛ ne fane nsuu. 17Nwole ne mɔɔ kɛha sɛlɛvolɛ ne asa anu la, ɔbava bie yeaha ahenle mɔɔ ɔlɛnua ye la anzo fema ne ati, ɔ sa fema kokotile ne azo, yɛɛ ɔ gyakɛ fema kokotile ne azo wɔ ɛleka mɔɔ ɔvale fɔlɛlilɛ azubɔdeɛ ne mogya ne ɔpepenle la. 18Akee nwole ne mɔɔ kɛha sɛlɛvolɛ ne asa anu la, ɔbava yeakpokpa ahenle mɔɔ bɛnua ye la ati zo. Ɛhye anzi, akee sɛlɛvolɛ ne bayɛ mgbɔdalɛ nzɛlɛlɛ amaa ye, wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu.
19“Sɛlɛvolɛ ne akee babɔ ɛtane azubɔdeɛ azu ne ayɛ mgbɔdalɛ nzɛlɛlɛ amaa ahenle mɔɔ bɛnua ye la wɔ evinli mɔɔ hanle ye la anwo. Ɛhye anzi, ɔbahu ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ ne. 20Sɛlɛvolɛ ne babɔ ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ nee ma azubɔdeɛ azu ne mɔ wɔ azukponle ne azo. Zɛhae debie yɛɛ sɛlɛvolɛ ne bayɛ yeava yeayɛ mgbɔdalɛ nzɛlɛlɛ yeamaa ahenle ne na ahenle anwo ade saanwu a.
21“Na saa ahenle le ehyianli na ɔnrɛhola ninyɛne ne mɔ sesa a, ɛnee ɔbava boane nyinli ko yeayɛ fɔlɛlilɛ azubɔdeɛ mɔɔ bɛbado ye ehono bɛabɔ azu bɛayɛ mgbɔdalɛ nzɛlɛlɛ bɛamaa ye la, ma azubɔdeɛ mɔɔ bɛdi bɛyɛ esamo la kilo ko mɔɔ bɛva nwole bɛfɔtɔ la, yɛɛ ɔlivi nwole toba foa ko. 22Eza ɔwɔ kɛ ɔfa abubule nwiɔ anzɛɛ mɔlɔnoma nwiɔ, nuhua biala mɔɔ ɔkɛhola ye fa la; bɛbava ko bɛayɛ ɛtane azubɔdeɛ na bɛava ko bɛayɛ ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ. 23Kenle mɔtwɛ ne azo yɛɛ ɔbava bɛ yearɛlɛ sɛlɛvolɛ ne na bɛanlua ye a. Ɔbava yearagyinla Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne anuhɔlɛ ne; 24sɛlɛvolɛ ne balie fɔlɛlilɛ azubɔdeɛ boane ne nee nwole toba foa ko ne yeado bɛ ehono kɛ ɔle ehono azubɔdeɛ ɔmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma, na ɔle sɛlɛvolɛ ne ɛdeɛ. 25Akee ɔbahu fɔlɛlilɛ azubɔdeɛ boane ne, na yeava ye mogya ne bie yeaha ahenle mɔɔ bɛnua ye la anzo fema ne ati nee ɔ sa fema kokotile nee ɔ gyakɛ fema kokotile ne mɔ azo 26Akee sɛlɛvolɛ ne bawola nwole ne bie ɔdaye ɔ sa bɛne ne anu 27na yeava ɔ sa fema ɛrɛlɛsɛka yeava nwole ne mɔɔ wɔ ɔ sa bɛne ne anu la bie yeakponde Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu ɛkɛ ne fane nsuu. 28Sɛlɛvolɛ ne bava nwole ne mɔɔ wɔ ɔ sa bɛne ne anu la bie aha ahenle mɔɔ bɛnua ye la anzo fema ne ati, ɔ sa fema kokotile nee ɔ gyakɛ fema kokotile ne mɔ azo, wɔ ɛleka mɔɔ bɛvale fɔlɛlilɛ azubɔdeɛ mogya ne bɛpepenle la. 29Nwole ne mɔɔ baha sɛlɛvolɛ ne asa anu la, ɔbava yeakpokpa ahenle mɔɔ bɛnua ye la ati zo, yeayɛ mgbɔdalɛ nzɛlɛlɛ yeamaa ye wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu. 30Akee sɛlɛvolɛ ne bava abubule anzɛɛ mɔlɔnoma ne mɔ, kɛmɔ ahenle mɔɔ bɛnua ye la kɛhola kɛva la. 31Ɔbava ko yeayɛ ɛtane azubɔdeɛ na yeava ko ne yeayɛ ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ yeaboka ma azubɔdeɛ ne anwo. Na sɛlɛvolɛ ne bayɛ mgbɔdalɛ nzɛlɛlɛ wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu amaa ahenle mɔɔ bɛnua ye la. 32Ɛnee sonla mɔɔ kokobɛ ɛdila ye na ɔ nwo ɛza, na ɔnrɛhola azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ sesa la mɛla ɛdeɛ ne ɛne.”
Sua nu nzenzemile
33Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi nee Aalɔn kɛ, 34“Saa bɛdwu Keena azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ mefa meamaa bɛayɛ bɛ ɛdeɛ la azo, na memaa ewule kokobɛ tɔ awuke bie anu, wɔ azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ bɛde zolɛ kɛ bɛ ɛdeɛ la azo a, 35ɔwɔ kɛ ahenle mɔɔ lɛ sua ne la baka kile sɛlɛvolɛ ne kɛ, ‘Ɔyɛ me kɛ ewule bie ɛdɔ me sua nu ɛkɛ.’ 36Sɛlɛvolɛ ne bamaa bɛayeye sua holɛ ko ne anu ninyɛne ne amuala kolaa na yeahɔ yeahɔnlea ewule ne. Saa bɛanyɛ ye zɔhane a, sɛlɛvolɛ ne baze kɛ debie biala mɔɔ wɔ sua ne anu la anwo ɛnde. Saa bɛyeye ninyɛne ne bɛsie a, akee sɛlɛvolɛ ne bahɔnlea sua ne anu. 37Ɔbanleɛnlea ewule ne, na saa ewule holɛ ko ne wɔ sua ne bane ne mɔ bie anwo, na ɔ nye le asuomenle nee kɔkɔlɛ, na ɔ bo le kuma a, 38sɛlɛvolɛ ne bavinde ara sua ne anlenkɛ ne anloa, na yeado sua ne anu dedee kenle nsuu. 39Sɛlɛvolɛ ne bara bieko wɔ kenle nsuu ne azo na yearanlea. Saa ewule ne ɛdɛlɛ sua ne bane ne mɔ anwo a, 40sɛlɛvolɛ ne bamaa bɛayeye awolɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ wɔ sua ne bane ne mɔ mɔɔ ewule ne ɛha bɛ la anu na bɛahɔdo bɛ bɛagua fovolɛ zo wɔ suakpole ne kandiba. 41Akee sɛlɛvolɛ ne bamaa bɛakpokpo sua ne anu bane ne mɔ anwo bɛayia na bɛahɔdo bɛagua fovolɛ zo wɔ suakpole ne kandiba, 42na bɛava awolɛ fofolɛ bɛawulowula bane ne mɔ anu, bɛatanlitanli sua ne bane ne na akee bɛada sua ne bieko.
43“Saa bɛyeye awolɛ ne mɔ, bɛtudu sua ne bane ne mɔ anwo, bɛtanlitanli ye fofolɛ, bɛta nwolɛ, na ewule ne sia ba bieko a, 44sɛlɛvolɛ ne bahɔ ahɔnlea sua ne bieko, na saa ewule ne ɛdɛlɛ a, ɛnee ɔle ewule kokobɛ nzane mɔɔ ɛha sua ne a; sua ne anwo ɛnde. 45Ɔbamaa bɛabubu sua ne, na bɛavulovula nuhua awolɛ, mbaka nee ndɛtɛlɛ ne mɔ amuala bɛahɔgua fovolɛ zo wɔ suakpole ne kandiba. 46Ɔba ye zɛhae a awie biala mɔɔ kɛwolo sua ne anu, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛdo nu la, evinli baha ye na ɔ nwo ɛnrɛde toonwo nɔsolɛ. 47Awie mɔɔ kɛla sua zɔhane anu la, ɔwɔ kɛ ɔkpo ye adɛladeɛ ne mɔ, yɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ awie mɔɔ kɛdɛnla ɛkɛ ne kɛli debie la ɔdaye ɔkpo ye adɛladeɛ ne mɔ.
48“Na saa sɛlɛvolɛ ne baneɛnlea sua ne anu na ewule ne ɛtɛtɛlɛle, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛda sua ne akunlu fofolɛ la a, ɔbaha yeado gua kɛ sua ne anwo te, ɔluakɛ ewule ne ɛhɔ. 49Sua zɛhae ɛnluanlɛ nu, ɔwɔ kɛ ahenle mɔɔ lɛ sua ne la sesa ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ: nloma ngyikyi nwiɔ, sida baka nee boane kɔkɔlɛ enrinli, yɛɛ nyinlanyinla. 50Akee ɔbahu nloma ne mɔ ko wɔ ɛyɛba mɔɔ nzule amolɛ wɔ nu la anu, 51na yeava sida baka ne, nyinlanyinla ne nee boane kɔkɔlɛ enrinli ne yeaboka anloma ne mɔɔ anye wɔ zolɛ la anwo yeabɔ anloma ne mɔɔ bɛhunle ye la mogya ne mɔɔ wɔ ɛyɛba ne anu la anu, na yeava yeakponde sua ne anu fane nsuu. 52Zɛhae yɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ ɔyɛ na ɔfa anloma ne mɔɔ anye wɔ zolɛ la, boane kɔkɔlɛ enrinli ne nee nyinlanyinla ne ɔnua sua ne a. 53Akee ɔbadwula anloma ne mɔɔ anye wɔ zolɛ la yeamaa yeahɔ; na yeayɛ mgbɔdalɛ nzɛlɛlɛ yeamaa sua ne; ɛnee sua ne anwo ɛde bɔkɔɔ.”
54Ewule kokobɛ ngakyile biala anwo mɛla ɛne: senra, 55ndanlɛ anzɛɛ adɛladeɛ nu adubue nee sua nu nzenzemile, 56nyila, nganlɛ anzɛɛ nzɔlɔsɔlɔ. 57Ɛhye a bahile kɛ ahenle anzɛɛ deɛ ne mɔɔ ewule ɛhye mɔ bie ɛha ye la anwo te anzɛɛ anwo ɛnde a. Ewule kokobɛ nwo mɛla ɛne.

Title: SƐLƐ 15
Content:
Nwonane nu nzuvinli ɛhwinlɛ
1Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi nee Aalɔn kɛ, 2“Ka kile Yizilayɛma kɛ, ‘Saa nide vi awie mrenyanu finde a, ɛnee ahenle anwo ɛnde. 3Mɛla mɔɔ wɔ mrenyanu nidehwinlɛ nwo la ɛne: saa ahenle mrenyanu tɛtwihwi nide ne anzɛɛ saa nide ne pɛ bɔbɔ a, ahenle anwo ɛnde. 4Ɛkpa biala mɔɔ sonla mɔɔ ye mrenyanu twi nide la kɛla zolɛ anzɛɛ debie biala mɔɔ ɔkɛdɛnla zolɛ la anwo ɛnde. 5Awie biala mɔɔ kɛva ɔ sa kɛha ahenle zɔhane ɛkpa la, ɔwɔ kɛ ɔkpo ye adɛladeɛ na ɔbia ɔ nwo, yɛɛ ɔwɔ evinli nu toonwo nɔsolɛ. 6Awie biala mɔɔ kɛdɛnla debie biala mɔɔ sonla ne mɔɔ ye mrenyanu twi nide la ɛdɛnla zolɛ la azo la, ɔwɔ kɛ ɔkpo ye adɛladeɛ ne mɔ na ɔbia; yɛɛ ɔwɔ evinli nu toonwo nɔsolɛ. 7Awie biala mɔɔ anwo kɛha sonla mɔɔ ye mrenyanu twi nide la, ɔwɔ kɛ ɔkpo ye adɛladeɛ na ɔbia, yɛɛ ɔwɔ evinli nu toonwo nɔsolɛ. 8Saa awie mɔɔ ye mrenyanu twi nide la to nyɛlɛ awie mɔɔ anwo te la anwo a, ahenle mɔɔ bɛdole nyɛlɛ ne ɔ nwo la anwo ɛnde. Ɔwɔ kɛ ɔkpo ye adɛladeɛ ne mɔ na ɔbia, yɛɛ ɔ nwo ɛnrɛde toonwo nɔsolɛ nu. 9Ebia biala anzɛɛ asoaso nzi ebia mɔɔ sonla mɔɔ ye mrenyanu twi nide la kɛdɛnla zolɛ la anwo ɛnde. 10Yemɔti awie biala mɔɔ kɛva ɔ sa kɛha debie biala mɔɔ ɔdɛnlanle zolɛ la evinli baha ye toonwo nɔsolɛ; yɛɛ awie mɔɔ kɛzoa debie zɛhae bie la, ɔwɔ kɛ ɔkpo ye adɛladeɛ na ɔbia, yɛɛ ɔ nwo ɛnrɛde toonwo nɔsolɛ. 11Awie biala mɔɔ sonla mɔɔ ye mrenyanu twi nide la anrinzi ɔ sa anwo na ɔ nwo kɛha ye la, ɛnee evinli ɛha ye. Ɔwɔ kɛ ɔkpo ye adɛladeɛ ne mɔ na ɔbia, yɛɛ ɔ nwo ɛnrɛde toonwo nɔsolɛ. 12Dwora biala mɔɔ ahenle mɔɔ ye mrenyanu twi nide la kɛva ɔ sa kɛha ye la, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛbɔ ye. Saa dwora ne le baka dwora a, yemɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛkpuda nu kpalɛ kpalɛ.
13“ ‘Saa awie mɔɔ ye mrenyanu twi nide la te kpɔkɛ a, ɔwɔ kɛ ɔtia kenle nsuu, na akee ɔkpo ye adɛladeɛ ne mɔ na ɔbia azudenle nu anzɛɛ ɔfa nzule amolɛ ɔbia na ɔ nwo ade. 14Kenle mɔtwɛ ne azo, ɔwɔ kɛ ɔfa abubule nwiɔ anzɛɛ mɔlɔnoma nwiɔ ɔkɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne anuhɔlɛ ne, na ɔfa ɔmaa sɛlɛvolɛ ne. 15Sɛlɛvolɛ ne bava abɔ azu; ɔbava ko yeayɛ ɛtane azubɔdeɛ na yeava ko ne yeayɛ ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ, na yeayɛ mgbɔdalɛ nzɛlɛlɛ yeamaa ye wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu wɔ ye mrenyanu ewule ne anwo.
16“ ‘Saa nrenya nwo ba a, ɛnee evinli ɛha ye. Ɔwɔ kɛ ɔbia, yɛɛ ɔ nwo ɛnrɛde toonwo nɔsolɛ. 17Debie biala, tɛladeɛ, nwoma anzɛɛ ɛdanlɛ biala mɔɔ nlanzule ne bie kɛpe nuhua la, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛkpo, yɛɛ nwolɛ ɛnrɛde toonwo nɔsolɛ. 18Saa nrenya nee raalɛ da na ɔ nwo ba a, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛ mu nwiɔ bɛbia, yɛɛ bɛ nwo ɛnrɛde toonwo nɔsolɛ.
19“ ‘Saa raalɛ kɔ ɛwazɛne nu a, evinli baha ye toonwo kenle nsuu. Awie biala mɔɔ anwo kɛha ye la anwo ɛnrɛde toonwo nɔsolɛ. 20Debie biala mɔɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɔwɔ ɛwazɛne nu la ɔkɛla zolɛ anzɛɛ ɔkɛdɛnla zolɛ la anwo ɛnde. 21-23Awie biala mɔɔ anwo kɛha ye ɛkpa anzɛɛ debie biala mɔɔ ɔkɛdɛnla zolɛ la, ɔwɔ kɛ ɔkpo ye adɛladeɛ ne mɔ na ɔbia, yɛɛ ɔ nwo ɛnrɛde toonwo nɔsolɛ. 24Saa nrenya fa raalɛ mɔɔ wɔ ɛwazɛne nu la a, ɛnee raalɛ ne anwo evinli ne bie ɛha ye. Evinli ne baha ye toonwo kenle nsuu, yɛɛ ɛkpa biala mɔɔ ɔkɛla zolɛ la anwo ɛnde.
25“ ‘Saa raalɛ tudu mogya kenle dɔɔnwo, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɔnle ɛwazɛne nu, anzɛɛ saa ɔka ɛwazɛne nu a, mekɛ dodo mɔɔ mogya ne tɛtu ye anzɛɛ ɔtɛbɔ ɛwazɛne nu la, ɔ nwo ɛnde. Evinli ɛha ye, kɛmɔ saa ɔwɔ ɛwazɛne nu a ɛnee ɔwɔ evinli nu la. 26Ɛkpa biala mɔɔ ɔkɛla zolɛ, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ mogya ne tɛtu ye la le kɛ mekɛ mɔɔ ɔwɔ ɛwazɛne nu la, yɛɛ debie biala mɔɔ ɔkɛdɛnla zolɛ la anwo ɛnde; ɔle kɛ ɔwɔ ɛwazɛne nu la. 27Awie biala mɔɔ anwo kɛha ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ biala la anwo ɛnde. Ɔwɔ kɛ ɔkpo ye adɛladeɛ ne mɔ na ɔbia, yɛɛ ɔ nwo ɛnde toonwo nɔsolɛ. 28Na saa ɔ nwo pɛ a, ɔwɔ kɛ ɔtia kenle nsuu kolaa na ɔ nwo ade. 29Kenle mɔtwɛ ne azo, ɔwɔ kɛ ɔfa abubule nwiɔ anzɛɛ mɔlɔnoma nwiɔ ɔbɛlɛ sɛlɛvolɛ ne, wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne anuhɔlɛ ne. 30Sɛlɛvolɛ ne bava abɔ azu; ɔbava ko yeayɛ ɛtane azubɔdeɛ na yeava ko yeayɛ ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ. Sɛlɛvolɛ ne bayɛ mgbɔdalɛ nzɛlɛlɛ amaa ye wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu, wɔ evinli ne mɔɔ ɛha ye la anwo.
31“ ‘Zɛhae yɛɛ ɛbayɛ wɔava wɔade Yizilayɛma anwo wɔ evinli mɔɔ kɛha bɛ la anwo a, amaa bɛanva evinli bɛanga me Ndanlɛ Sua ne mɔɔ gyi bɛ avinli la na bɛawu.’ ”
32Ɛhye a le mɛla mɔɔ wɔ ɛkɛ ne maa nrenya mɔɔ ye mrenyanu twi nide anzɛɛ ɔ nwo kɛra, 33anzɛɛ raalɛ mɔɔ wɔ ɛwazɛne nu, anzɛɛ nrenya mɔɔ kɛva raalɛ mɔɔ wɔ ɛwazɛne nu na ɔ nwo ɛnde la a.

Title: SƐLƐ 16
Content:
Mgbɔdalɛ Nzɛlɛlɛ kenle ne
1Aalɔn amra mrenya nwiɔ ne ewule ne anzi, Ɛdɛnkɛma dendɛle hilele Mosisi. Aalɔn amra mrenya nwiɔ ne wule, ɔboalekɛ bɛhwenle bɛbikyele Ɛdɛnkɛma somaa. 2 Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi kɛ, “Ka kile ɛ diema nrenya Aalɔn kɛ ɔmmaba Ɛleka Nwuanzanwuanza ne mɔɔ wɔ mgbɛnu ɛdanlɛ ne akunlu Anwunvɔnezelɛ Ebia ne mɔɔ dua Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne azo la anwo dahuu. Saa ɔyɛ ye zɔhane a, ɔbawu, ɔluakɛ mebaye me nwo meahile wɔ amungu ne mɔɔ wɔ Anwunvɔnezelɛ Ebia ne azo la anu. 3Kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ Aalɔn si ba Nwuanzanwuanza Ɛleka ne la ɛne: Mekɛ biala mɔɔ ɔba la, ɔva ɛnlankɛ nyinli ko ɔyɛ ɛtane azubɔdeɛ yɛɛ boane nyinli ko ɔyɛ ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ ɔrabɔ azu.
4“Ɔwɔ kɛ ɔbia, na ɔwula ye sɛlɛvolɛ adɛladeɛ ne mɔ: Lenen tɛladeɛ bubu nwuanzanwuanza ne, lenen akyeso ne, yɛɛ lenen abɔtile ne.
5“Akee Yizilayɛ maanlema ne bava mbɔnkye nyinli nwiɔ bɛamaa yeava yeayɛ ɛtane azubɔdeɛ yɛɛ boane nyinli ko bɛamaa yeava yeayɛ ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ. 6Aalɔn bava ɛnlankɛ nyinli ne abɔ ɔdaye ye ɛtane nwo azu, na yeayɛ mgbɔdalɛ nzɛlɛlɛ yeamaa ɔ nwo nee ye sua nu amra. 7Akee ɔbava mbɔnkye nwiɔ ne yeahɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne anuhɔlɛ ne. 8Ɔbagua mbɔnkye nwiɔ ne ati nzeleba, yeaye ko yeamaa Ɛdɛnkɛma na ko ne noko ahɔ Azazɛle ɛkɛ ne. 9Aalɔn bava abɔnkye ne mɔɔ hɔle Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛkɛ ne la amaa Ɛdɛnkɛma na yeava yeabɔ ɛtane azu. 10Ko ne mɔɔ hɔle Azazɛle ɛkɛ ne la, bɛbava ye anyewɔzo bɛamaa Ɛdɛnkɛma na yeayɛ mgbɔdalɛ nzɛlɛlɛ yeagua zolɛ, amaa bɛava bɛahɔ fienemgbole ne anu bɛahɔgyakyi ye bɛamaa Azazɛle.
11“Saa Aalɔn fa ɛnlankɛ nyinli ɛtane azubɔdeɛ ne bɔ azu maa ɔ nwo, na ɔyɛ mgbɔdalɛ nzɛlɛlɛ ɔmaa ɔ nwo nee ye sua nu amra ɔwie a, ɔbahu ɛnlankɛ nyinli ne yeabɔ ɛtane azu yeamaa ɔ nwo. 12Akee ɔbava kyɛnze mɔɔ bɛfa bɛkpu ɛyɛlɛ la yeavula samɛnlankɛ wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma azukponle ne azo, na eza yeavula ɛyɛlɛ evuanlɛ mɔɔ bɛnlu ye ekyii la ɔ sa nwiɔ yeara mgbɛnu ɛdanlɛ ne akunlu wɔ Nwuanzanwuanza nu Nwuanzaanwu Ɛleka ne. 13Ɛkɛ ne, ɔbava ɛyɛlɛ ne yeagua senle ne anu wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu, amaa ɛyɛlɛ ne esike ne aheda Anwunvɔnezelɛ Ebia ne mɔɔ dua Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne azo la azo, amaa yeannwu ye na yeawu. 14Akee ɔbava ɔ sa ɛrɛlɛsɛka yeabɔ ɛnlankɛ ne mogya ne anu yeakponde Anwunvɔnezelɛ Ebia ne anyunlu ɛkɛ ne fane nsuu.
15“Akee Aalɔn bahu ɛtane azubɔdeɛ abɔnkye ne yeabɔ azu wɔ Yizilayɛma ati, na yeava ye mogya ne yeahɔ mgbɛnu ɛdanlɛ ne akunlu na yeakponde ye wɔ Anwunvɔnezelɛ Ebia ne azo nee ɔ nyunlu ɛkɛ, kɛmɔ ɔyɛle ɛnlankɛ nyinli ne mogya ne la. 16Zɛhae yɛɛ ɔbayɛ yeayɛ mgbɔdalɛ nzɛlɛlɛ yeade Nwuanzanwuanza Nu Nwuanzaanwu Ɛleka ne nee Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne anwo a, kɛmɔ ɔgyi Yizilayɛma avinli na bɛva bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ nee bɛ mɛladonlɛ bɛgua bɛ nwo evinli bɛha ye la. 17Saa ɔkawolo Nwuanzanwuanza Nu Nwuanzaanwu Ɛleka ne yeahɔyɛ mgbɔdalɛ nzɛlɛlɛ ne a, ɔnle kɛ awie biala kɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne anu kɔkpula kɛ ɔkɛwie mgbɔdalɛ nzɛlɛlɛ ne yɛ ɔkɛmaa ɔ nwo, ye sua nu amra nee Yizilayɛma kɔsɔɔti la. 18Ɔwie a, akee ɔbavinde yeahɔ azukponle ne mɔɔ gyi Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu ɛkɛ ne la anwo, yeahɔyɛ mgbɔdalɛ nzɛlɛlɛ yeamaa azukponle ne, na yeava ɛnlankɛ ne nee abɔnkye ne mogya ne mɔ bie yeapepe ɔ bati kpokpɔkoo ne mɔ azo yeayia. 19Ɔwɔ kɛ ɔfa ɔ sa ɛrɛlɛsɛka ɔbɔ mogya ne anu ɔkponde azukponle ne fane nsuu ɔnua ye, na ɔte nwolɛ ɔfi Yizilayɛma evinli ne anwo.
Abɔnkye ne
20“Saa Aalɔn wie Nwuanzanwuanza Nu Nwuanzaanwu Ɛleka ne, Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne nee azukponle ne mɔ ati mgbɔdalɛ nzɛlɛlɛ ne yɛ a, akee ɔbava abɔnkye ne mɔɔ bɛtɛkunle ye la yeamaa Ɛdɛnkɛma. 21Ɔbava ɔ sa nwiɔ yeagua abɔnkye ne ati zo, na yeaha Yizilayɛma amumuyɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛyɛ, bɛ mɛladonlɛ nee ɛtane mɔɔ bɛyɛ la amuala yeagua abɔnkye ne ati zo, na yeagyakyi ye yeamaa awie mɔɔ bɛboa bɛye ye la ava ye ahɔ fienemgbole ne anu lɔ. 22Abɔnkye ne bazoa bɛ ɛtane ne nee bɛ amumuyɛ ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti ahɔ ɛleka solokoko wɔ fienemgbole ne anu, ɛleka mɔɔ awie biala ɛnle la.
23“Akee Aalɔn bara Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne anu, yearaye ye lenen adɛladeɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ ɔbahɔ Nwuanzanwuanza Nu Nwuanzaanwu Ɛleka ne la ɔwulale la yeagua, na akee ɔvi ɛkɛ ne yeavinde; 24na yeava nzule yeabia wɔ ɛleka mɔɔ te la, yeava ɔdaye ye adɛladeɛ ne mɔ yeawula, yeavinde na yearabɔ ye ɛyelalɛ azu ɛdeɛ ne. Ɔwie a eza ɔbɔ ɛyelalɛ azu wɔ menli ne ati na akee ɔyɛ mgbɔdalɛ nzɛlɛlɛ ɔmaa ɔ nwo, na ɔyɛ bie ɔmaa menli ne amuala. 25Ɔyela ɛtane azubɔdeɛ ne akunlu ɛnlome ne wɔ azukponle ne azo. 26Ahenle mɔɔ hɔgyakyile abɔnkye ne manle ɔhɔle Azazɛle ɛkɛ ne la bakpo ye adɛladeɛ ne mɔ na yeabia kolaa na yeara azokoɛleɛ ne. 27 Akee bɛbazoa ɛnlankɛ ne nee abɔnkye ne mɔɔ bɛvale bɛyɛle ɛtane azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ, mɔɔ bɛ mogya a bɛvale bɛhɔle Nwuanzanwuanza Nu Nwuanzaanwu Ɛleka ne bɛhɔyɛle mgbɔdalɛ nzɛlɛlɛ ne la bɛahɔ azokoɛleɛ ne kandiba, na bɛayela bɛ nane, nwoma nee bɛ kunlu ninyɛne ne mɔ amuala. 28Ahenle mɔɔ kɛyela bɛ la, ɔwɔ kɛ ɔkpo ye adɛladeɛ ne mɔ na ɔbia kolaa na yeara azokoɛleɛ ne.
Mgbɔdalɛ Nzɛlɛlɛ Kenle ne ɛzielɛ
29 “Akee ɔbayɛ mɛla mɔɔ wɔ ɛkɛ ne dahuu ɔmaa bɛ a; siane nsuu ne kenle bulu ne azo, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛkye ɛhɔne mɔɔ bɛdabɛ o, nyɛvolɛ mɔɔ nee bɛ de la o, biala ɛnyɛ gyima a. 30Ɔluakɛ kenle ɛhye anu yɛɛ bɛyɛ bɛ ti mgbɔdalɛ nzɛlɛlɛ, bɛanlua bɛ, bɛade bɛ nwo bɛavi bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ anwo, na bɛ nwo ayɛ bɔkɔbɔkɔ wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu a. 31Ɔle Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle mɔɔ hyia maa bɛ a, na ɔwɔ kɛ bɛkye ɛhɔne kenle zɔhane. Ɛhye le mɛla mɔɔ wɔ ɛkɛ ne dahuu a. 32Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli ne mɔɔ bɛkɛwula ye, bɛkɛdu ye bɛkɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma na ɔkɛgyinla ɔ ze agyakɛ anu la a bayɛ mgbɔdalɛ nzɛlɛlɛ ne a. Ɔbawula lenen adɛladeɛ nwuanzanwuanza ne mɔ a yeayɛ nzɛlɛlɛ ne a. 33Ɔbayɛ mgbɔdalɛ nzɛlɛlɛ yeamaa Ɛleka Nwuanzanwuanza ne, ɔbayɛ bie yeamaa Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne nee azukponle ne, na yeayɛ bie yeamaa sɛlɛvolɛma ne nee menli ne amuala. 34Ɛhye bayɛ mɛla mɔɔ bɛntulu ye ɛlɛ la amaa bɛ, amaa bɛava kenle ko wɔ ɛvolɛ biala anu bɛayɛ mgbɔdalɛ nzɛlɛlɛ bɛamaa Yizilayɛma amuala, wɔ bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ ati.” Na Mosisi yɛle mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma zele ye la amuala.

Title: SƐLƐ 17
Content:
Mogya le ngoane
1Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi kɛ, 2“Ka kile Aalɔn nee ɔ mra mrenya ne mɔ nee Yizilayɛma amuala kɛ: Ngyehyɛlɛ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛyɛ la ɛne. 3Saa Yizilayɛnli biala ku ɛnlankɛ, boane anzɛɛ abɔnkye wɔ azokoɛleɛ ɛkɛ ne, anzɛɛ azokoɛleɛ ne kandiba lɔ, 4na yeanva yeamba Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne anuhɔlɛ ne, yeambɔ azu yeammaa Ɛdɛnkɛma wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anyunlu a, ɛnee yedo mɛla kɛ yeha mogya yegua. Sonla zɔhane, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛye ye bɛfi Nyamenle menli ne avinli. 5Ɛhye kile kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ Yizilayɛma fa bɛ azubɔlɛ nane ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛku bɛ wɔ ɛleka gyɛne gyɛne la bɛlɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma. Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛfa bɛmaa sɛlɛvolɛ ne wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne anuhɔlɛ ne na bɛku bɛ kɛ anzonudwolɛ azubɔdeɛ bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma. 6Sɛlɛvolɛ ne bado ye mogya ne agua Ɛdɛnkɛma azukponle ne anwo ayia wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne anuhɔlɛ ne, na yeayela ye ɛnlome ne yeabɔ azu evuanlɛ yeamaa Ɛdɛnkɛma. 7Zɔhane ati ɔnle kɛ awie biala ku nane bɔ azu maa mbɔnkye awozonle ne mɔ na bɛbɔ tuutuu ɛbɛla mgbane biala. Ɛhye bayɛ mɛla amaa bɛ mekɛ biala, wɔ bɛ awolɛndoazo muala anu.
8“Eza ka kile bɛ kɛ: Yizilayɛnli biala, anzɛɛ ɛyɛvolɛ biala mɔɔ wɔ bɛ avinli mɔɔ kɛbɔ ɛyelalɛ azu anzɛɛ kɛbɔ azu ngakyile biala, 9na yeanva yeamba Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne anuhɔlɛ ne, yeambambɔ azu ne yeammaa Ɛdɛnkɛma la, sonla zɔhane, bɛbaye ye bɛavi Nyamenle menli ne avinli.
10“Saa Yizilayɛnli biala, anzɛɛ ɛyɛvolɛ biala mɔɔ wɔ bɛ avinli la di mogya a, mebahyi sonla zɔhane mɔɔ di mogya la, na meaye ye meavi ɔdaye ye menli avinli. 11 Ɔluakɛ nwonane ne ngoane wɔ mogya ne anu, yɛɛ meva memaa kɛ bɛva bɛbɔ azu wɔ azukponle ne azo bɛyɛ mgbɔdalɛ nzɛlɛlɛ bɛmaa bɛ, ɔluakɛ mogya ne a maa mgbɔdalɛ ne di munli a, ɔboalekɛ ngoane wɔ nu. 12Yemɔti meha mehile Yizilayɛma kɛ, ‘Bɛ nuhua biala mmadi mogya, yɛɛ ɔnle kɛ ɛyɛvolɛ mɔɔ wɔ bɛ avinli la di mogya.’
13“Eza ɔwɔ kɛ Yizilayɛnli biala anzɛɛ ɛyɛvolɛ biala mɔɔ wɔ bɛ avinli mɔɔ di ɛbɔlɛ ku nane nee nloma mɔɔ bɛdi la, twi mogya ne gua na ɔfe ɛnwea ɔkeda zolɛ. 14Ɔluakɛ abɔdeɛ biala ngoane wɔ ye mogya ne anu. Yemɔti meka meahile Yizilayɛma kɛ, ‘Awie biala mmadi abɔdeɛ biala mogya. Ɔluakɛ nane biala ngoane a le ye mogya ne. Mɔɔ kɛli bie la bɛbaye ye bɛavi menli ne avinli.’
15“Awie biala mɔɔ kɛli nane mɔɔ ɔdaye ɔ ngome yewu anzɛɛ nanemgbole bie ɛtete ye la, saa ɔle Yizilayɛnli o, ɔle ɛyɛvolɛ o, ɔwɔ kɛ ɔkpo ye adɛladeɛ ne mɔ na ɔbia, yɛɛ ɔ nwo ɛnrɛde toonwo nɔsolɛ, ɛnee bɔ zo mɔɔ ɔ nwo ɛde a. 16Na saa yeamkpo ye adɛladeɛ ne mɔ, yeambia ɔ nwo a, ɔdaye ye ɛtane zo ye.”

Title: SƐLƐ 18
Content:
Raalɛ nee nrenya ɛyɛlɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle tua la
1Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi kɛ, 2“Ka kile Yizilayɛma kɛ: Mame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne a. 3Ɔnle kɛ bɛyɛ nyɛleɛ ne mɔɔ Yigyibitima mɔɔ ɛnee bɛde bɛ avinli la yɛ la bie. Eza ɔnle kɛ bɛyɛ nyɛleɛ mɔɔ Keenama mɔɔ melɛfa bɛ meara bɛ avinli la yɛ la bie. Ɔnle kɛ bɛdi menli zɔhane amaamuo zo. 4Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛdi me mɛla ne mɔ azo, na bɛsie me ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔ, bɛdi zolɛ. Medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne a. 5 Yemɔti ɔwɔ kɛ bɛdi me mɛla nee me ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔ azo Yemɔ yɛɛ saa bɛyɛ a, bɛkɛnyia ngoane a: Medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a.
6“Ɔnle kɛ bɛ nuhua biala nee ɔ nwo amra ne bie yɛ raalɛ nee nrenya. Medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a. 7Ɔnle kɛ awie fa ɔ nli na ɔgua ɔ ze anyunlu aze. Ɛ nli mɔɔ wole wɔ ɔ, ɔnle kɛ ɛgua ɔ nyunlu aze. 8Ɔnle kɛ ɛfa ɛ ze aye biala. Ɛyɛ ye zɔhane a, wɔgua ɛ ze anyunlu aze. 9 Ɔnle kɛ ɛfa ɛ diema raalɛ mɔɔ ɛ nee ye bɛ ze nee bɛ nli ko, anzɛɛ asolo ɔ ze anzɛɛ ɔ nli la. 10Ɔnle kɛ ɛfa ɛ ra nrenya ara raalɛ anzɛɛ ɛ ra raalɛ ara raalɛ. Ɔluakɛ bɛ anyiemgba le wɔ anyiemgba. 11Ɔnle kɛ ɛfa ɛ ze aye ara raalɛ, mɔɔ ɛ ze a ɛwo ye la; ɔle ɛ diema raalɛ. 12 Ɔnle kɛ ɛfa ɛ ze adiema raalɛ; ɔle ɛ ze anwo sonla mɔɔ bikye ye a. 13Ɔnle kɛ ɛfa ɛ nli adiema raalɛ; ɔle ɛ nli anwo sonla mɔɔ bikye ye a. 14Ɔnle kɛ ɛfa ɛ ze adiema nrenya aye. Ɔle ɛ nli. 15 Ɔnle kɛ ɛfa ɛ ra nrenya aye; ɔle ɛ ra nrenya aye, ɔnle kɛ ɛbɔ ye anyiemgba. 16 Ɔnle kɛ ɛfa ɛ diema nrenya aye, ɛbɔ ɛ diema nrenya ne anyiemgba. 17 Ɔnle kɛ ɛfa raalɛ na eza ɛfa ɔ ra raalɛ; mmafa ɔ ra nrenya ara raalɛ anzɛɛ ɔ ra raalɛ ara raalɛ. Ɛyɛ ye zɔhane a, ɛnee wɔgua raalɛ ne anyunlu aze. Bɛ muala bɛle mraalɛ mɔɔ bikye wɔ a, ɛ nwo amra ɔ. Nyɛleɛ zɛhae le amumuyɛ ɛbɛla. 18Eza ɔnle kɛ ɛfa ɛ ye adiema raalɛ ɛyɛ ɛ ye ahola wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛ ye de ngoane nu la.
19 “Ɔnle kɛ ɛfa raalɛ mɔɔ wɔ ɛwazɛne nu la. 20Eza ɔnle kɛ ɛfa ɛ gɔnwo aye na ɛgua ɛ nwo evinli. 21 Ɔnle kɛ bɛtu bɛ mra ne mɔ anu biala bɛsie ahane bɛmaa kɛ bɛyela ye bɛbɔ azu bɛmaa bozonle Molɛke. Bɛyɛ ɛhye a, ɛnee bɛbɔ bɛ Nyamenle ne anyiemgba. Medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a. 22 Ɔnle kɛ nrenya fa ɔ gɔnwo nrenya; ɔle munzule debie. 23 Eza ɔnle kɛ bɛ nee nane biala da, bɛfa ye na bɛgua bɛ nwo evinli, yɛɛ ɔnle kɛ raalɛ biala maa adenle maa nane fa ye; ɔle ɛtane kpole.
24“Bɛmmayɛ ɛhye mɔ anu biala bie na bɛgua bɛ nwo evinli, ɔluakɛ zɔhane ninyɛne yɛɛ maanle maanle mɔɔ melɛtu bɛ wɔ azɛlɛ ne azo meava meamaa bɛ la yɛle vale zɛkyele bɛ nwo a. 25Bɛyɛle zɔhane bɛvale bɛzɛkyele azɛlɛ ne, amaa ɔlua zo mendeanle azɛlɛ ne, yɛɛ azɛlɛ ne ɛlɛtu menli mɔɔ de zolɛ la a. 26Na bɛmɛ, bɛli me mɛla ne nee me ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔ azo, bɛdabɛ anzɛɛ bɛ nyɛvolɛ mɔɔ bɛ nee bɛ de la o, bɛ biala mmabɔ munzule ɛbɛla ɛhye mɔ bie. 27Ɔluakɛ zɛhae munzule ninyɛne yɛɛ menli mɔɔ de azɛlɛ ne azo la yɛle vale zɛkyele azɛlɛ ne a. 28Saa bɛyɛ bie a azɛlɛ ne bakpo bɛ, kɛmɔ ɔkpole maanle maanle mɔɔ lumuale dɛnlanle zolɛ la. 29Ɔluakɛ awie biala mɔɔ kɛbɔ munzule ɛbɛla ɛhye mɔ bie la, bɛkɛye ye bɛkɛvi Nyamenle menli ne avinli. 30Yemɔti bɛli me edwɛkɛ zo, na bɛmmayɛ nyɛleɛ ɛtane ne mɔ bie, na bɛbu munzule amaamuo ne mɔɔ menli mɔɔ lumuale azɛlɛ ne azo la bule la bie. Bɛmmayɛ ye zɔhane bɛgua bɛ nwo evinli. Medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne a.”

Title: SƐLƐ 19
Content:
Bɔkɔbɔkɔyɛlɛ nee pɛlepɛlelilɛ nwo mɛla
1Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi kɛ, 2 “Ka kile Yizilayɛma amuala kɛ: Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛmaa bɛ nwo te, ɔluakɛ Medame, Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle, mele nwuanzanwuanza. 3 Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛ nuhua biala di ɔ ze nee ɔ nli eni, na bɛsie me Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ne mɔ. Medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne a.
4 “Bɛmmagyakyi me bɛkɔsonle awozonle na bɛyɛ ananze mmonle biala bɛmaa bɛ nwo. Medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne a.
5“Saa bɛfa anzonudwolɛ azubɔdeɛ bɛabɔ azu bɛamaa medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a, bɛmaa ɔvi bɛ ahonle nu, amaa mealie bɛ meado nu. 6Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛdi azubɔdeɛ ne amuala kenle ko ne ala, anzɛɛ bɛwie ye di wɔ ye alehyenlɛ nu. Mɔɔ kɛha na ɔkɛli kenle nsa la, bɛgua ye senle nu bɛyela ye. 7Saa ɔdi kenle nsa na bie tɛbɔ ɛkɛ ne na bɛdi a, ɔle munzule; menrɛlie menrɛdo nu. 8Ahenle noko mɔɔ lile la, ye munzule zo ye, ɔboalekɛ yegua debie nwuanzanwuanza mɔɔ le Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛdeɛ la anwo evinli. Sonla zɔhane, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛye ye bɛfi Nyamenle menli ne anu.
9 “Saa bɛbu bɛ ɛya nu bɛyɔba ne a, bɛmmabu toonwo bɛkɔ ɛya ne anloa kpalɛ, yɛɛ bɛbu a, ɔ bo zo ɔ bo zo ne mɔ, bɛmmasia bɛ nzi bɛkɔsesa. 10Bɛtete bɛ vanye ma a, bɛmmatete dedee bɛmaa ɔka mbaka mgbane ne ala, yɛɛ mɔɔ kɛtete kɛgua la, bɛmmasesa. Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛgyakyi bie zolɛ bɛmaa ehyianvolɛma nee nyɛvolɛ. Medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne a.
11 “Bɛmmawua, bɛmmadi ndunlumi, yɛɛ bɛmmabɔ adalɛ bɛkile bɛ nwo ngoko. 12 Eza bɛmmafa me duma bɛka adalɛ ndane bɛgua bɛ Nyamenle ne duma ne anwo evinli. Medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a.
13 “Bɛmmasisi bɛ gɔnwo mɔ yɛɛ bɛmmawua bɛ. Bɛbɔ awie ɛkpa a ɔnle kɛ ye ɛkpabɔdeɛ ne anzɛɛ ye ahatualɛ ne ka bɛ nwo ɛkɛ ne toonwo aleɛ kye zolɛ. 14 Ɔnle kɛ bɛwa mɔɔ anzo ɛdi la amonle, anzɛɛ bɛfa koti bɛto mɔɔ anye ɛzi la adenle nu. Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛsulo bɛ Nyamenle ne; medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a.
15 “Ɔnle kɛ bɛbua mgbɔvodɛne. Ɔnle kɛ bɛbua bɛtia ehyianli na bɛbua bɛmaa sonlakpole. Bɛbua bɛ gɔnwo mɔ ndɛne wɔ adenle kpalɛ nu. 16Ɔnle kɛ bɛduolua bɛ gɔnwo mɔ akɔme nu bɛkeha awie mɔ anwo edwɛkɛ mɔɔ ɛnle nɔhalɛ la, yɛɛ bɛmmadi daselɛ adalɛ bɛtia bɛ gɔnwo bɛmaa ɔminli ye ngoane. Medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a.
17“Bɛmmafa bɛ gɔnwo anwo edwɛkɛ bɛsie bɛ kunlu; bɛ nee ye ɛha, anrɛɛ bɛkɛli ɔ nwo ɛzonle. 18 Bɛmmadi nzenralɛ anzɛɛ bɛmmafa bɛdabɛ bɛ menli ne mɔ amra mrenya anwo edwɛkɛ bɛsie bɛ kunlu. Bɛhulo bɛ gɔnwo mɔ kɛ bɛdabɛ bɛ nwo; medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a.
19 “Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛdi me mɛla ne mɔ azo. Ɔnle kɛ bɛmaa nyɛmoa gyɛne fola bɛ nyɛmoa. Ɔnle kɛ bɛdua ma ngakyile nwiɔ wɔ ɛya ko ne ala anu, yɛɛ ɔnle kɛ bɛfa ninyɛne ngakyile nwiɔ bɛnwo tɛladeɛ bɛwula.
20“Saa nrenya nee kanranli raalɛ mɔɔ awie ɛyia ye na bɛtɛkpɔnenle ye anzɛɛ bɛtɛmanle ye fanwodi la da a, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛtu menli bɛmaa bɛneɛnlea nu kpalɛ. Ɔnle kɛ bɛku bɛ, ɔboalekɛ raalɛ ne ɛnli ɔ ti anwo. 21Ɔwɔ kɛ nrenya ne fa boane nyinli yɛ fɔlɛlilɛ azubɔdeɛ maa Ɛdɛnkɛma wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne anuhɔlɛ ne, 22na sɛlɛvolɛ ne yɛ mgbɔdalɛ nzɛlɛlɛ maa ye wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu, wɔ ye ɛtane ne mɔɔ yeyɛ la anwo; na bɛkɛva ye ɛtane ne mɔɔ yeyɛ la bɛkɛhyɛ ye.
23“Saa bɛdwu Keena azɛlɛ zo, na bɛdua bɛ mbakama ngakyile ne mɔ na ɔso a, bɛbu nzoleɛ ne kɛ ɔle kyibadeɛ, bɛmmadi zolɛ aleɛ toonwo ɛvolɛ nsa. 24Ɛvolɛ nna ne azo, mbaka ne mɔ azo ma ne amuala anwo bade saanwu; bɛva bɛbɔ ayɛlɛyelɛ azu bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma. 25Na ye ɛvolɛ nnu ne azo bɛkola bɛdi nzoleɛ ne bie. Ɛhye bamaa mbaka ne mɔ azo dɔɔnwo amaa bɛ; medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne a.
26 “Bɛmmadi nane biala mɔɔ mogya ne gyi nu la. Ɔnle kɛ bɛye ngonyia anzɛɛ bɛbɔ ayɛne ɛbɛla biala. 27 Ɔnle kɛ bɛkpa bɛ nzo tɛbanu enrinli anzɛɛ bɛkpa bɛ kɛsa. 28Ɔnle kɛ bɛbodɛboda bɛ nwo bɛkile bɛ nyanelilɛ wɔ awie mɔɔ ɛwu la ati anzɛɛ bɛbobɔ ngonlɛ biala; medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a.
29 “Bɛmmamaa bɛ mra mraalɛ bɔ tuutuu ɛbɛla bɛgua bɛ nyunlu aze, anrɛɛ tuutuulilɛ kɛva azɛlɛ ne na amumuyɛ kɛyi ye tɛkɛɛ. 30 Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛsie me Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ne mɔ na bɛdi me ɛleka nwuanzanwuanza ne eni; medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a.
31“Bɛmmabiza bɛ nwo wɔ menli mɔɔ tendɛ nwomenle nloa azo la anzɛɛ nyɛnema ɛkɛ. Bɛmmakpondɛ bɛ bo zo bɔbɔ na evinli aha bɛ; medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne a.
32“Bɛnwu kpanyinli a bɛli ye eni, bɛdwazo enililɛ nu bɛmaa mɔɔ ati zo ɛdu la na bɛzulo bɛ Nyamenle ne; medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a.
33 “Saa ɛyɛvolɛ bie batɛnla bɛ azɛlɛ ne azo a, bɛmmayɛ ye ɛtane. 34Ɛyɛvolɛ mɔɔ bɛ nee ye a lua la bɛyɛ ye kɛmɔ bɛkɛyɛ bɛdabɛ bɛ nuhua bie ala la. Eza bɛhulo ye kɛ bɛdabɛ bɛ nwo la. Ɔluakɛ ɛnee bɛdabɛ bɛle nyɛvolɛ wɔ Yigyibiti azɛlɛ zo; medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne a.
35“Ɔnle kɛ bɛdi ndunlumi wɔ debie ɛzuzulɛ nu. 36Bɛmaa bɛ tone ne mɔ ɛgyinla sɛsɛ. Bɛmmawua debie ɛzuzulɛ nu; medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne mɔɔ yele bɛ vile Yigyibiti la. 37Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛsie me mɛla ne nee me ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔ boɛ na bɛdi zolɛ; medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a.”

Title: SƐLƐ 20
Content:
Anzosesebɛ nwo kakɛdualɛ
1Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi kɛ, 2“Ka kile Yizilayɛma kɛ: Yizilayɛnli biala anzɛɛ ɛyɛvolɛ biala mɔɔ de Yizilayɛma avinli, mɔɔ kɛva ɔ ra kɛbɔ azu kɛmaa bozonle Molɛke la, bɛhu ye. Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ maanle ne anu la ɛzi ye awolɛ ɛhu ye. 3Medame mumua ne mebava me nye meawula sonla zɔhane anyunlu, na meaye ye meavi ɔdaye ye menli avinli. Mebayɛ ɛhye, ɔboalekɛ yeva ɔ ra yebɔ azu yemaa bozonle Molɛke, yegua me Ɛzonlenlɛ Ɛleka nwuanzanwuanza ne anwo evinli na yezɛkye me duma. 4Na saa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛde maanle ne anu la ye bɛ nye kɛ asɛɛ bɛannwu kɛ yeva ɔ ra yebɔ azu yemaa bozonle Molɛke na bɛangu ye a, 5mebava me nye meazie ahenle nee ye mbusuafoɔ anyunlu, na meaye bɛ nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdoale ye bɛhɔbɔle tuutuu ɛbɛla mgbane ne wɔ bozonle Molɛke abo la amuala meavi bɛ menli avinli.
6“Saa awie kɔbiza ɔ nwo wɔ sonla mɔɔ tendɛ nwomenle nloa azo la ɛkɛ, anzɛɛ ɔkɔ bayivolɛ bie ɛkɛ ɔkɔbiza ɔ nwo anzɛɛ ɔ nee bɛ kɔbɔ tuutuu ɛbɛla a, mebava me nye meazie ɔ nyunlu na meaye ye meavi ye menli ne avinli. 7Zɔhane ati bɛmaa bɛ nwo ɛde saanwu, ɔluakɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne a. 8Bɛli me mɛla ne mɔ azo na bɛyɛ; medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma mɔɔ memaa bɛ nwo te a.
9 “Awie biala mɔɔ kɛwa ɔ ze anzɛɛ ɔ nli amonle la, bɛhu ye. Yewa ɔ ze nee ɔ nli amonle, yemɔti ye mogya gua ɔdaye ɔ ti zo.
10 “Saa nrenya fa ɔ gɔnwo aye a, bɛhu nrenya ne nee raalɛ ne bɛ mu nwiɔ. 11 Awie mɔɔ nee ɔ ze aye kɛla la ɛbɔ ɔ ze anyiemgba; bɛhu nrenya ne nee raalɛ ne bɛ mu nwiɔ. Bɛ mogya gua bɛ ti zo. 12 Saa awie fa ɔ ra nrenya aye a, bɛhu nrenya ne nee raalɛ ne. Bɛbɔ munzule, bɛ mogya ne gua bɛ ti zo. 13 Saa nrenya fa ɔ gɔnwo nrenya a, bɛdabɛ bɛ mu nwiɔ bɛbɔ munzule; bɛhu bɛ, yɛɛ bɛ mogya gua bɛdabɛ bɛ ti zo. 14 Saa nrenya gya raalɛ na eza ɔfa ɔ ye ɔ nli a, ɔle amumuyɛ ɛbɛla. Bɛgua bɛ senle nu bɛyela bɛ, amaa zɛhae amumuyɛ ɛbɛla ne azi aze wɔ bɛ avinli. 15 Saa nrenya nee nane da, ɔfa ye a, bɛhu ye, na bɛhu nane ne. 16Saa raalɛ twe bikye nane bie na ɔmaa ɔfa ye a, bɛhu raalɛ ne nee nane ne; bɛ mogya ne gua bɛ ti zo.
17 “Saa nrenya fa ɔ diema raalɛ mɔɔ le ɔ ze ara anzɛɛ ɔ nli ara a, bɛ mu nwiɔ bɛgua bɛ nyunlu aze. Ɔle anyiemgba debie, yemɔti ɔwɔ kɛ bɛye bɛ bɛfi bɛ mediema ne mɔ anu. Nrenya ne ɛbɔ ɔ diema raalɛ ne anyiemgba, yemɔti ye amumuyɛ ne zo ye. 18 Saa nrenya nee raalɛ mɔɔ wɔ ɛwazɛne nu la da, ɔfa ye a, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛtu bɛdabɛ bɛ mu nwiɔ bɛfi menli ne avinli, ɔboalekɛ bɛgua bɛ nwo evinli.
19 “Ɔnle kɛ nrenya fa ɔ nli adiema raalɛ anzɛɛ ɔ ze adiema raalɛ. Ɔyɛ ye zɔhane a, ɛnee yeva ɔ nwo sonla; bɛdabɛ bɛ mu nwiɔ bɛ munzule doa bɛ. 20 Saa nrenya nee ɔ wuvuanyi aye da a, ɛnee yebɔ ɔ wuvuanyi ne anyiemgba. Ɔ nee raalɛ ne bɛ mu nwiɔ bɛ ɛtane zo bɛ; bɛnrɛwo ralɛ ɛlɛ na bɛawu. 21 Saa awie fa ɔ diema nrenya aye a, ɔle evinli yɛɛ eza yegua ɔ diema nrenya ne anyunlu aze; bɛnrɛwo ɛlɛ na bɛawu.
22“Yemɔti bɛli me mɛla ne nee me ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti azo na bɛyɛ, amaa azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ me nee bɛ ɛlɛkɔ zolɛ la anye bɛ. 23Eza bɛmmadi menli mɔɔ bɛmɛ bɛ ti melɛtu bɛ la maamɛla ne mɔ azo; ɔluakɛ bɛyɛle ɛhye mɔ amuala, yemɔti a mengyile bɛ a. 24Na bɛmɛ, meha mehile bɛ kɛ, ‘Bɛbava azɛlɛ ne, yɛɛ mebava meamaa bɛayɛ bɛ ɛdeɛ bɔkɔɔ. Ɔle azɛlɛ mɔɔ kye aleɛ a.’ Medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne mɔɔ mekpa nu meye bɛ mevi menli kɔsɔɔti anu a. 25Yemɔti, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛnwu ngakyile mɔɔ wɔ nane mɔɔ anwo te nee nane mɔɔ anwo ɛnde la, anzɛɛ nloma mɔɔ anwo te nee nloma mɔɔ anwo ɛnde la avinli la. Ɔnle kɛ bɛdi nane anzɛɛ anloma anzɛɛ debie biala mɔɔ azɛlɛ ne ye maa bɛ na meze bɛ kɛ nwolɛ ɛnde la bie na bɛgua bɛ nwo evinli. 26Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛmaa bɛ nwo te maa me, ɔluakɛ medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, mele nwuanzanwuanza, yɛɛ meye bɛ mevi menli kɔsɔɔti avinli mezie ahane, kɛ bɛle me ɛdeɛ mekɛ biala.
27“Nrenya anzɛɛ raalɛ biala mɔɔ tendɛ nwomenle nloa azo anzɛɛ le bayivolɛ la, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛku ye. Bɛzi bɛ awolɛ bɛhu bɛ, na bɛ mogya gua bɛdabɛ bɛ ti zo.”

Title: SƐLƐ 21
Content:
Sɛlɛvolɛma nwuanzanwuanzayɛlɛ
1Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi kɛ, “Tendɛ kile Aalɔn amra sɛlɛvolɛma ne na ka kile bɛ kɛ ɔnle kɛ bɛ biala gua ɔ nwo evinli. Saa awie wu a, ɔnle kɛ bɛ biala kɔ funli ne anwo, 2kyesɛ sonla ne mɔɔ ɛwu la bikye ye kpalɛ kpalɛ: ɔ nli, ɔ ze, ɔ ra nrenya anzɛɛ raalɛ, ɔ diema nrenya 3anzɛɛ ɔ diema raalɛ mɔɔ ɛtɛkɔle agyalɛ na ɔnze nrenya la, yemɔ, ɔkola ɔkɔ nwolɛ. 4Saa ɔle kunli bɔbɔ a ɔnle kɛ ɔgua ɔ nwo evinli wɔ ye menli ne anyunlu.
5 “Ɔnle kɛ bɛkpa bɛ ti anzɛɛ bɛ kɛsa, yɛɛ ɔnle kɛ bɛbobɔ ngonlɛ biala. 6Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛmaa bɛ nwo te maa bɛ Nyamenle; ɔnle kɛ bɛgua bɛ Nyamenle ne anwo evinli. Ɔluakɛ bɛmɛ yɛɛ bɛbɔ ɛyelalɛ azu bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma na eza bɛbɔ aleɛ azu bɛmaa bɛ Nyamenle ne a. Yemɔti ɔwɔ kɛ bɛmaa bɛ nwo te. 7Ɔnle kɛ bɛgya raalɛ tuutuunli anzɛɛ raalɛ mɔɔ awie ɛva ye ɛlɛ la. Eza ɔnle kɛ bɛgya raalɛ mɔɔ ɔ hu ɛbɔ ye ewole la, ɔluakɛ sɛlɛvolɛ biala anwo te maa ye Nyamenle ne. 8Ɔwɔ kɛ ɛtu ye ɛsie ahane ɛmaa Nyamenle, ɔluakɛ ɔdaye a ɔfa aleɛ ɔbɔ azu ɔmaa wɔ Nyamenle ne a; ɔwɔ kɛ ɔ nwo te maa wɔ, ɔluakɛ medame, Ɛdɛnkɛma, mɔɔ mete ɛ nwo la, mele nwuanzanwuanza. 9Sɛlɛvolɛ ara raalɛ biala mɔɔ kɛzɛkye ɔ nwo kɛbɔ tuutuu ɛbɛla biala la ɛgua ɔ ze anyunlu aze. Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛto ye senle nu bɛyela ye.
10“Sɛlɛvolɛ ne mɔɔ bɛkɛgua nwole ɔ ti zo kɛ yemɔ a ɔle kpanyinli wɔ ɔ mediema ne mɔ anu, na bɛdu ye bɛzie ahane bɛmaa Nyamenle kɛ yemɔ a ɔwɔ kɛ ɔwula Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli adɛladeɛ ne mɔ la, ɔnle kɛ ɔgyakyi ɔ ti enrinli ɔgua zolɛ mɔɔ ɔntoli a, yɛɛ ɔnle kɛ ɔsuosua ye adɛladeɛ nu ɔkile kɛ ɔlɛdi nyane. 11-12Bɛdu ye bɛzie ahane bɛmaa ye Nyamenle ne, yemɔti ɔnle kɛ ɔfi me ndanlɛ sua nwuanzanwuanza ne anu ɔfinde ɔkɔ ɛleka mɔɔ funli wɔ la ɔkɔgua ɔ nwo evinli ɔmaa bie ka ye Nyamenle ne ɛleka nwuanzanwuanza ne. Saa ɔ ze anzɛɛ ɔ nli bɔbɔ a wule a, ɔnle kɛ ɔkɔ ɛkɛ; medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a. 13Ɔwɔ kɛ ɔgya raalɛ mɔɔ ɛnze nrenya la. 14Saa ɔkagya raalɛ a ɔnle kɛ ɔgya raalɛ mɔɔ le kunlanvolɛ anzɛɛ ɔ hu ɛbɔ ye ewole, anzɛɛ raalɛ mɔɔ awie ɛva ye ɛlɛ, anzɛɛ tuutuunli. Ɔwɔ kɛ ɔgya ɔdaye ye abusua ekpunli ne anu amra ne mɔ bie mɔɔ ɛnze nrenya fee la. 15Saa yeanyɛ ye zɔhane a ɔ mra mɔɔ ɔbawo bɛ la, biala anwo ɛnrɛde, ɔluakɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma mɔɔ mete ɔ nwo a.”
16Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi kɛ, 17“Ka kile Aalɔn kɛ ɔvi ɛnɛ mɔɔ kɔ la, wɔ bɛ awolɛndoazo ne mɔ amuala anu, ɔ bo zo amra ne anu biala mɔɔ anwo lɛ dɛne la ɛnle kɛ bikye me kɛ ɔfa aleɛ yeabɔ azu yeamaa ye Nyamenle. 18Ɔluakɛ awie biala mɔɔ anwo lɛ dɛne la, ɔnle kɛ ɔbikye me; anyenzinliravolɛ anzɛɛ abubura, anzɛɛ sonla mɔɔ anahɛlɛ ɛtete ye, anzɛɛ ye agbɔkɛ ne mɔ bie wale bo zolɛ, 19anzɛɛ nrenya mɔɔ agyakɛ anzɛɛ asa ɛbu, 20awie mɔɔ le afu, anzɛɛ ɔle adwola kɛ motia, anzɛɛ awie mɔɔ anye ɛyɛ na ɔnnwu aze kpalɛ, anzɛɛ mɔɔ senra, nzɔlɔsɔlɔ anzɛɛ fonvoamgbɔde ɛgua ye anzɛɛ bɛza ye, 21na ɔle Sɛlɛvolɛ Aalɔn abo zo amra ne bie la anwo lɛ dɛne. Ɔnle kɛ ɔbikye me kɛ ɔbɔ ɛyelalɛ azu yeamaa Ɛdɛnkɛma Suzuamgba ala mɔɔ ɔ nwo lɛ dɛne la, ɔnle kɛ ɔbikye me kɛ ɔfa aleɛ yeabɔ azu yeamaa ye Nyamenle ne. 22Ɔkola ɔdi ye Nyamenle ne aleɛ nwuanzanwuanza nee aleɛ nwuanzanwuanza kpalɛ ne bie, 23noko ɔnle kɛ ɔbikye mgbɛnu ɛdanlɛ ne anzɛɛ azukponle ne, ɔboalekɛ ɔ nwo lɛ dɛne. Ɔyɛ ye zɔhane a ɛnee yeva evinli yeha ɛleka nwuanzanwuanza ne, ɔluakɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma mɔɔ memaa bɛ nwo te a.”
24Yemɔti Mosisi dendɛle hilele Aalɔn nee ɔ mra mrenya ne mɔ nee Yizilayɛma amuala.

Title: SƐLƐ 22
Content:
Azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ le nwuanzanwuanza
1Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi kɛ, 2“Ka kile Aalɔn nee ɔ mra mrenya ne mɔ kɛ bɛnlea ninyɛne nwuanzanwuanza ne mɔ mɔɔ Yizilayɛma ɛdu ɛzie ahane ɛmaa me la boɛ, amaa bɛanzɛkye me duma; medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a. 3Ka kile bɛ kɛ, wɔ awolɛndoazo kɔsɔɔti anu, saa evinli ka bɛ bo zo amra ne anu bie, na ɔzo ɔluolua ninyɛne nwuanzanwuanza ne mɔ mɔɔ Yizilayɛma ɛdu ɛzie ahane ɛmaa me la anwo a, bɛbaye sonla zɔhane bɛavi me nye zo. Medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a.
4“Aalɔn abo zo sonla biala mɔɔ le kokobɛvolɛ anzɛɛ anwo twihwi nzule la ɛnlɛ adenle ɛnli aleɛ nwuanzanwuanza ne mɔ bie, kyesɛ ɔ nwo ɛza na ɔ nwo ɛde. Eza awie mɔɔ kɛva ɔ sa kɛha funli anzɛɛ awie mɔɔ anla boɛ la, evinli ɛha ye. 5Awie mɔɔ kɛva ɔ sa kɛha nane mɔɔ twenle ɔ nwo aze, anzɛɛ kɛva ɔ nwo kɛha awie mɔɔ evinli ɛha ye la, saa duzu a ɔyɛle o, saa duzu ewule a hanle ye o, ɔdaye noko evinli ɛha ye. 6Awie biala mɔɔ evinli kɛha ye wɔ ndenle zɛhae mɔ bie anu la anwo ɛnrɛde toonwo aledwolɛ, yɛɛ ɔnle kɛ ɔdi aleɛ nwuanzanwuanza ne bie, kyesɛ ɔbia kolaa. 7Saa sɛnzɛne ne tɔ a ɛnee bɔ zo mɔɔ ɔ nwo ɛde a; nzinlii akee ɔkola ɔdi aleɛ nwuanzanwuanza ne bie, ɔboalekɛ aleɛ mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ ɔdi la ala ɛne. 8Debie mɔɔ ɔdaye ɔ ngome ɔkɛwu anzɛɛ nanemgbole bie kɛtete ye la, saa bɛfa bɛ sa bɛka ye a, ɛnee evinli ɛha bɛ Medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a.
9“Yemɔti bɛli me mɛla zo na anrɛɛ bɛkɛli ɛzonle na bɛkɛwu kɛ bɛvonle me mɛla ne a; medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma mɔɔ maa bɛ nwo te a.
10“Ɔnle kɛ awie biala mɔɔ ɛmboka sɛlɛvolɛma abusua ekpunli ne anwo la di aleɛ nwuanzanwuanza ne bie. Sɛlɛvolɛ biala ɛyɛvolɛ mɔɔ ɔ nee ye de anzɛɛ ye sonvolɛ mɔɔ yebɔ ye ɛkpa la, ɔnle kɛ ɔdi aleɛ nwuanzanwuanza ne bie. 11Na saa sɛlɛvolɛ bie tɔ kanra a, ɔle ye agyadeɛ. Ɔkola ɔmaa ye kanranli ne di aleɛ nwuanzanwuanza ne bie, yɛɛ ngakula mɔɔ bɛkɛwo bɛ wɔ ye awuke ne anu la kola di bie. 12Saa bɛgya sɛlɛvolɛ bie ara raalɛ bɛkɔ abusua ekpunli gyɛne nu a, ɔnle kɛ ɔdi aleɛ nwuanzanwuanza ne mɔɔ bɛva bɛbɔ azu la bie. 13Na saa sɛlɛvolɛ ne ara raalɛ ne le kunlanvolɛ anzɛɛ ɔ hu ɛbɔ ye ewole, na ɔnlɛ ralɛ, na yezia yera ɔ ze sua nu a, ɔle kɛ mɔɔ ye ngakula nu ɔde la; ɔkola ɔdi ɔ ze aleɛ ne bie Noko awie gyɛne ɛdeɛ, ɔngola ɔnli bie.
14“Saa awie ɛnze na ɔdi aleɛ nwuanzanwuanza ne bie a, ɔwɔ kɛ ɔtua deɛ nwuanzanwuanza ne kakɛ ɔmaa sɛlɛvolɛ ne na eza ɔkyɛ deɛ ne bolɛ ne anu nnu, ɔtua ko ɔboka nwolɛ. 15Ɔnle kɛ sɛlɛvolɛma ne maa evinli ka ninyɛne nwuanzanwuanza ne mɔ mɔɔ Yizilayɛma ɛva ɛra, ɛmaa bɛva bɛbɔ azu bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma la. 16Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛnea ninyɛne ne mɔ boɛ, amaa bɛanli ninyɛne nwuanzanwuanza ne mɔ bie, bɛandwe munzule nee fɔlɛlilɛ bɛammaa bɛ nwo; ɔluakɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma mɔɔ mete bɛ nwo a.”
17Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi kɛ, 18“Ka kile Aalɔn nee ɔ mra ne mɔ nee Yizilayɛma kɛ: Saa Yizilayɛnli bie anzɛɛ nyɛvolɛ mɔɔ wɔ Yizilayɛ la bie fa ye ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ ara Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu a, saa ɛwɔkɛyelɛ anzɛɛ ahunlunyele azubɔdeɛ, na ɔkulo kɛ ɔsɔ ɛnyelɛ a, 19ɛnee ɔva ɛnlankɛ, anzɛɛ boane anzɛɛ abɔnkye nyinli mɔɔ anwo ɛnlɛ dɛne la. 20 Ɔnle kɛ bɛfa debie biala mɔɔ anwo lɛ dɛne la, ɔluakɛ bɛyɛ ye zɔhane a Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛnrɛlie ɛnrɛdo nu. 21Saa awie babɔ anzonudwolɛ azu yeamaa Ɛdɛnkɛma, kɛ ɔfa yeaye ye ɛwɔkɛ anzɛɛ ɔfa yeabɔ ahonle fufule nu azu, na ɔlɛ nane mɔɔ vi ye nlankɛ anzɛɛ ye nyɛmoa ne mɔ anu a, ɔwɔ kɛ nane ne di munli, mɔɔ ɔ nwo ɛnlɛ dɛne biala, amaa bɛalie ye bɛado nu. 22Nane mɔɔ anye ɛzi, nane mɔɔ ɛbubu, nane mɔɔ anwo ɛdudu anzɛɛ nane mɔɔ anwo twihwi nzule anzɛɛ nane mɔɔ anwo ɛgua asa anzɛɛ ɛlɔ ngɛkɛba la, ɔnle kɛ bɛfa bɛbɛlɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma anzɛɛ bɛfa bie ɛleka biala bɛyela bɛbɔ azu wɔ azukponle ne azo bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma. 23Ɛnlankɛ anzɛɛ boane mɔɔ ye foa ko ɛleka bie wale bo zolɛ anzɛɛ le ezinraa bo zolɛ la, bɛkola bɛfa bɛyɛ ahonle fufule nu ahyɛlɛ azubɔdeɛ, na saa bɛfa bɛaye ɛwɔkɛ a, yemɔ bɛnlie. 24Bɛmmafa nane biala mɔɔ bɛza ye anzɛɛ bɛbɔ ɔ ndɔma anzɛɛ bɛde ɔ ndɔma la bɛbɛlɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, anzɛɛ bɛfa bɛbɔ azu wɔ bɛ azɛlɛ ne azo ɛleka biala.
25“Nane biala mɔɔ bɛkɛnyia ye bɛkɛvi ɛyɛvolɛ ɛkɛ ne la, bɛmmafa bɛyɛ aleɛ azubɔdeɛ bɛbɛlɛ me. Kɛmɔ bɛpepɛle bɛ na bɛahu bɛ la, bɛ nwo lɛ dɛne; bɛfa bɛba a menrɛlie.”
26Na Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi kɛ, 27“Saa ɛnlankɛ, boane anzɛɛ abɔnkye wo fofolɛ a, ɔwɔ kɛ ɔboa ɔ nli anwo ɛkɛ kenle nsuu. Ɔvi kenle mɔtwɛ ne azo mɔɔ kɔ la, saa bɛfa bɛbɔ ɛyelalɛ azu bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma a ɔkɛlie. 28Saa nane ralɛ ne ɔ nli le ɛnlankɛ anzɛɛ boane a, ɔnle kɛ bɛku ralɛ ne nee ɔ nli kenle ko ne ala. 29Saa ɔba ye kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛbɔ moyɛlɛ azu bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma a, bɛyɛ ye zɔhane, amaa bɛalie bɛ bɛado nu. 30Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛdi azubɔdeɛ ne kenle ko ne ala. Ɔnle kɛ bɛgyakyi bie bɛmaa aleɛ kye zolɛ; medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a.
31“Yemɔti ɔwɔ kɛ bɛdi me mɛla ne mɔ azo; medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a. 32Ɔnle kɛ bɛsɛkye me duma. Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛmaa me duma ne anwo te wɔ bɛdabɛ Yizilayɛma bɛ avinli; medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma mɔɔ maa bɛ nwo te a. 33Medame a menyele bɛ menvile Yigyibiti azɛlɛ zo na merayɛ bɛ Nyamenle a; medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a.”

Title: SƐLƐ 23
Content:
Nyamenlezonlenlɛ Ɛvoyia ne mɔ
1Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi kɛ, 2“Ka kile Yizilayɛma kɛ, Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛvoyia ne mɔ, mɔɔ le medame me ɛvoyia ne mɔ mɔɔ le nwuanzanwuanza la a le ɛhye mɔ. 3 Bɛbayɛ gyima kenle nsia; kenle nsuu ne le Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛfa bɛdie bɛ ɛnwomenle a Ɔle kenle mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛyia nu bɛyɛ ɛzonlenlɛ nwuanzanwuanza Ɔnle kɛ bɛyɛ gyima biala wɔ nu. Ɔle Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle wɔ ɛleka biala mɔɔ bɛwɔ la. 4Akee Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛvoyia ne mɔ mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛfa bɛsonle ye la ɛne, bɛ mekɛ dwu a ɔwɔ kɛ ɛbɔ ye nolo ɛkile bɛ.
Akpabɛnwo nee Angye Ɛvoyia ne
(Ɛdi 28.16-25)
5 “Siane ne mɔɔ lumua ɛvolɛ ne anu la, ye kenle ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ bulu nee nna la nɔsolɛ nu, le Ɛdɛnkɛma Akpabɛnwo. 6 Kenle bulu nee nnu ne le Angye Ɛvoyia maa Ɛdɛnkɛma. Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛdi kpanwo mɔɔ mgbɔvonle ɛnle nu la kenle nsuu. 7Kenle ne mɔɔ lumua la, bɛbayia nu bɛazonle; bɛmmayɛ gyima ɛsesebɛ biala. 8Bɛbava azubɔdeɛ bɛara bɛamaa bɛayela bɛabɔ azu bɛamaa Ɛdɛnkɛma toonwo kenle nsuu. Kenle nsuu ne azo bɛbayia nu bɛazonle; bɛnrɛyɛ gyima ɛsesebɛ kenle ko ne.
9-10“Saa bɛba azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛlɛfa amaa bɛ la azo na bɛbu bɛ abɛlɛ a, bɛva mɔɔ bɛkɛlumua bɛkɛbu la bɛhɔmaa sɛlɛvolɛ ne. 11Sɛlɛvolɛ ne bado bɛ azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ ehono abɔ ehono azu amaa Ɛdɛnkɛma, amaa bɛazɔ ɔ nye. Sɛlɛvolɛ ne babɔ azu zɔhane Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ne ye alehyenlɛ nu. 12Kenle mɔɔ bɛbɔ bɛ alumua bɛyɔba ehono azu ne la, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛfa boane nyinli mɔɔ ɛli ɛvolɛ ko na ɔ nwo ɛnlɛ dɛne biala la bɛbɔ ɛyelalɛ azu bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma. 13Ma azubɔdeɛ mɔɔ boka nwo la, ɔwɔ kɛ ɔyɛ esamo kilo nwiɔ mɔɔ bɛva nwole bɛfɔtɔ la. Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛfa bɛbɔ ɛyelalɛ azu bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma, ye evuanlɛ sɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anye. Nza azubɔdeɛ ne noko ɔwɔ kɛ yɛ nwanye litili ko. 14Mekɛ ne anu ɔnle kɛ bɛdi kpanwo anzɛɛ ma ngyehye, ma amolɛ anzɛɛ ma ndondo, kɔkpula mekɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛva bɛ azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ bɛkɛrɛlɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma la. Ɛhye le mɛla maa bɛ wɔ awolɛndoazo kɔsɔɔti anu wɔ ɛleka biala mɔɔ bɛwɔ la.
Bɛyɔba Ɛvoyia ne
(Ɛdi 28.26-31)
15 “Akee bɛdia dapɛne nsuu; bɛdia bɛvi Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ne mɔɔ bɛvale bɛ alumua bɛyɔba ne bɛbɔle ehono azu ne la alehyenlɛ nu. 16Saa bɛtia bɛfi Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ne alehyenlɛ nu a, ɔle kenle abulanlu; akee bɛbɔ ma fofolɛ bɛyɔba azu bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma. 17Bɛva kpanwo ahunguma nwiɔ mɔɔ bɛva esamo kilo nwiɔ a bɛyɛ la bɛvi sua nu bɛrɛla bɛrabɔ ehono azu bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛfa mgbɔvonle bɛwula esamo ne anu na bɛado, na bɛva bɛyɛ ma mɔɔ lumua la azubɔdeɛ bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma. 18Akee bɛva mboane nsuu mɔɔ ko biala ɛli ɛvolɛ ko na bɛ nwo ɛnlɛ dɛne la, ɛnlankɛ egyegyebaa ko, yɛɛ mboane nwiɔ bɛrɛla. Bɛbava bɛayɛ ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ bɛaboka ma nee nwanye azubɔlɛ ninyɛne ne mɔ bɛayela bɛ bɛabɔ azu bɛamaa Ɛdɛnkɛma; ye evuanlɛ sɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anye. 19Eza bɛbava abɔnkye nyinli ko bɛayɛ ɛtane azubɔdeɛ, yɛɛ mboane nyinli nwiɔ bɛayɛ anzonudwolɛ azubɔdeɛ. 20Sɛlɛvolɛ ne bava bɛ muala aboka kpanwo ne mɔɔ le bɛyɔba mɔɔ lumua la nee mboane nyinli nwiɔ ne anwo yeado bɛ ehono yeabɔ azu yeamaa Ɛdɛnkɛma. Bɛle ahyɛlɛdeɛ mɔɔ sonle bolɛ maa sɛlɛvolɛma ne yɛɛ ɔle azubɔdeɛ nwuanzanwuanza ɔmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma. 21Kenle ko zɔhane ɔwɔ kɛ bɛbɔ nolo, bɛyia bɛyɛ nzɛlɛlɛ; ɔnle kɛ awie biala yɛ gyima ɛsesebɛ. Ɛhye le mɛla mɔɔ wɔ ɛkɛ ne dahuu, wɔ awolɛndoazo muala anu, wɔ ɛleka biala mɔɔ bɛwɔ la.
22 “Saa bɛbu bɛ azɛlɛ ne azo bɛyɔba ne a, ɔnle kɛ bɛbu toonwo bɛkɔkpula ɔ nloa, yɛɛ ngoko mɔɔ kɛha nu la, ɔnle kɛ bɛsia bɛkɔbu. Bɛgyakyi bɛ bɛmaa ehyianvolɛma nee nyɛvolɛ; medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne a.”
Ɛvolɛ Fofolɛ Ɛvoyia ne
(Ɛdi 29.1-6)
23Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi kɛ, 24“Ka kile Yizilayɛma kɛ, ‘Siane nsuu ne kenle ne mɔɔ lumua la, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛdie bɛ ɛnwomenle. Ɔle ngakyelɛ ɛnwomenlelielɛ kenle mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛbɔ aweɛne ndendenle bɛfa bɛmaa menli ne bayia nu yɛ nzɛlɛlɛ a. 25Ɔnle kɛ awie biala yɛ gyima ɛsesebɛ; yɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛbɔ ɛyelalɛ azu bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma.’ ”
Mgbɔdalɛ Kenle ne
(Ɛdi 29.7-11)
26 Na Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi kɛ, 27“Siane nsuu ɛhye ala kenle bulu ne le mgbɔdalɛ nzɛlɛlɛ kenle. Ɔle mekɛ mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛyia nuhua bɛyɛ nzɛlɛlɛ a. Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛkye ɛhɔne na bɛfa ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ bɛbɛlɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma. 28Ɔnle kɛ bɛyɛ gyima biala kenle ko ne, ɔluakɛ ɔle mgbɔdalɛlilɛ kenle mɔɔ bɛyɛ mgbɔdalɛ nzɛlɛlɛ bɛmaa bɛ wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne anyunlu a. 29Awie biala mɔɔ angye ɛhɔne demua ne la, bɛbaye ye bɛavi Nyamenle menli ne avinli. 30Awie biala noko mɔɔ kɛyɛ gyima kenle zɔhane la, mebazɛkye ye meavi ye menli ne avinli. 31Ɔnle kɛ bɛyɛ gyima biala kenle ko ne; ɔle mɛla mɔɔ wɔ ɛkɛ ne dahuu, wɔ bɛ awolɛndoazo muala anu. 32Ɔbayɛ bɛ Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle mɔɔ hyia a, yɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛkye ɛhɔne. Siane ne kenle ngɔnla ne azo nɔsolɛ nu, toonwo kɔkpula ye alehyenlɛ nu nɔsolɛ yɛɛ bɛbabɔ ɛhɔnehyelɛ ne abo a, yɛɛ Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ne bɔ ɔ bo toonwo kɔkpula alehyenlɛ ne nɔsolɛ nu.”
Kpɔda Bo Ɛdɛnlanlɛ Ɛvoyia ne
(Ɛdi 29.12-40)
33 Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi kɛ, 34“Ka kile Yizilayɛma kɛ: Siane nsuu ne kenle bulu nee nnu ne azo, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛdi Ɛdɛnkɛma Kpɔda Bo Ɛdɛnlanlɛ Ɛvoyia ne, yɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛdi ye kenle nsuu. 35Kenle ne mɔɔ lumua la, bɛbava bɛayɛ ɛzonlenlɛ; ɔnle kɛ bɛyɛ gyima ɛsesebɛ. 36Kenle nsuu ne anu, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛfa azubɔdeɛ bɛba bɛmaa bɛyela bɛbɔ azu bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma. Kenle mɔtwɛ ne azo, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛyia nu bɛyɛ nzɛlɛlɛ na bɛbɔ ɛyelalɛ azu bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma; ɔle ɛzonlenlɛ nyianu kpole, ɔnle kɛ bɛyɛ gyima ɛsesebɛ.”
37(Ɛhye mɔ a le Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛvoyia ne mɔ mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛbɔ bɛ nolo kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛyia nu bɛsonle, na bɛbɔ ɛyelalɛ azu bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma a. Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛfa ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ, ma azubɔdeɛ, azubɔlɛ ngakyile, yɛɛ nza azubɔdeɛ, ko biala nee ye kenle, bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma. Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛdi ɛvoyia ɛhye mɔ 38bɛboka Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ne mɔ anwo, na bɛfa bɛ ahyɛlɛdeɛ ngakyile ne mɔ, bɛ ɛwɔkɛyelɛ azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ, yɛɛ bɛ ahonle fufule nu azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma.)
39“Siane nsuu ne kenle bulu nee nnu ne azo, mɔɔ ɛnee bɛbu bɛ bɛyɔba ne la, bɛbali Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛvoyia ɛhye kenle nsuu. Kenle ne mɔɔ lumua la bɛbava bɛalie bɛ ɛnwomenle bɛayia nu bɛayɛ nzɛlɛlɛ, yɛɛ kenle mɔtwɛ ne ɔdaye bɛbava bɛalie bɛ ɛnwomenle bɛayia nu bɛayɛ nzɛlɛlɛ. 40Kenle ne mɔɔ lumua la bɛva bɛ mbaka kpalɛ ne mɔ azo ma, bɛpepɛ mrɛlakɛ, bɛbubu mbaka mɔɔ lɛ nya kpalɛ la ngane nee azule nloa mbaka buzubuzu ne mɔ nya ne bie bɛli ɛvoyia ne na bɛmaa bɛ nye ɛlie toonwo kenle nsuu wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu. 41Bɛli ɛvoyia ɛhye kenle nsuu wɔ ɛvolɛ ne anu bɛwula Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlunyia. Ɔle mɛla mɔɔ wɔ ɛkɛ ne dahuu maa awolɛndoazo muala a. Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛdi ɛvoyia ɛhye wɔ siane nsuu ne anu. 42Bɛdabɛ Yizilayɛma kɔsɔɔti bɛbadɛnla kpɔda bo dedee kenle nsuu, 43amaa bɛ bo zo amra anwu kɛ memanle Yizilayɛma dɛnlanle kpɔda bo wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ menyele bɛ menvile Yigyibiti azɛlɛ zo la. Medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne a.”
44Yemɔti Mosisi yele Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛvoyia ne mɔ dole Yizilayɛma anyunlu.

Title: SƐLƐ 24
Content:
Ahɛnlaneɛ ne mɔ boɛ ɛnleanlɛ
(Ade 27.20-21)
1Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi kɛ, 2“Maa Yizilayɛma ɛva nwole anye bɔkɔbɔkɔ mɔɔ bɛhwihwi bɛvi ɔlivi ma nu la bɛrɛla bɛmaa ɛva ɛgua ahɛnlaneɛ ne mɔ anu, amaa bɛagyinla zolɛ dahuu. 3Aalɔn banlea ayɛ ahɛnlaneɛ ne mɔ boɛ na yeasosɔ bɛ nɔsolɛ biala, amaa bɛagyinla zolɛ toonwo alehyenlɛ. Ɔbazɔ yeazie mgbɛnu ne anzi, wɔ Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne mɔɔ gyi Nwuanzanwuanza Nu Nwuanzaanwu Ɛleka ne la anyunlu. Ɛhye le mɛla dahuu maa awolɛndoazo muala. 4Aalɔn banlea ahɛnlaneɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ gyigyi ezukoa nvutuke tagyee kɛnlaneɛ baka ne azo la boɛ, na yeamaa bɛazɔ bɛagyinla zolɛ dahuu wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu ɛkɛ ne.
Kpanwo ne mɔɔ bɛva bɛbɔ azu bɛmaa Nyamenle la
5 “Fa esamo kilo bulu nee nwiɔ fɔtɔ to kpanwo ahunguma bulu nee nwiɔ. 6Gua bɛ ɛhonlone nwiɔ, nsia nsia, wɔ ezukoa nvutuke tagyee ɛkponle ne azo. 7Fa ɛyɛlɛ evuanlɛ gua ɛhonlone ko biala anwo fa kile kɛ ɔle aleɛ mɔɔ bɛva bɛbɔ azu bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma a. 8Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle biala, Aalɔn banlea ava kpanwo agyinla Yizilayɛma agyakɛ anu asolo bɛ ɛhonlone nwiɔ wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu. Ɛhye le ngyekyeleɛ mɔɔ kyekye Yizilayɛma dahuu a. 9Kpanwo zɔhane mɔ le Aalɔn nee ɔ mra mrenya ne mɔ ɛdeɛ, yɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛdi ye wɔ ɛleka mɔɔ le nwuanzanwuanza la, ɔboalekɛ ɔle azubɔdeɛ mɔɔ bɛyela bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma la anu bie Ɔle nwuanzanwuanza kpalɛ kpalɛ na dahuu ɔle sɛlɛvolɛma ne mɔ ɛdeɛ.”
Ndeanlɛ mɔɔ fɛta la anwo ndonwo
10-11Nrenya bie wɔ Yizilayɛma avinli, ɔ ze le Yigyibitinli, yɛɛ ɔ nli le Yizilayɛnli. Bɛfɛlɛ ɔ nli Hyɛlomete. Hyɛlomete ɔ ze a le Debelae, mɔɔ vi Dan abusua ekpunli ne anu la. Ɔrale kɛ kenle ko nrenya ne nee Yizilayɛnli bie nyianle butule; nrenya ne bɔle Nyamenle sasa, na bɛhyele ye bɛhɔmanle Mosisi. 12Bɛvale ye bɛziele kɛ bɛkendɛ edwɛkɛ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma baha wɔ nwolɛ la.
13Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi kɛ, 14“Bɛva ahenle ne mɔɔ bɔle sasa ne la bɛvinde azokoɛleɛ ne kandiba lɔ, na bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdele ye sasabɔlɛ ne la, biala ɛva ɔ sa ɛdo nrenya ne anwoma azo ɛli daselɛ, na akee ɛlɔne ne amuala ɛzi ye awolɛ ɛhu ye. 15Akee ka kile Yizilayɛma kɛ: Awie biala mɔɔ kɛbɔ ye Nyamenle sasa la, ɔdaye ye ɛtane zo ye. 16Awie mɔɔ kɛbɔ Nyamenle sasa la, bɛbahu ye. Menli ne amuala bazi ye awolɛ ahu ye. Saa ɔle ɛyɛvolɛ o, ɔle Yizilayɛnli o, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛku ye kɛ yebɔ Nyamenle sasa a.
17“Awie biala mɔɔ kɛhu sonla la, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛku ye, 18yɛɛ awie biala mɔɔ kɛhu awie ayɛmoa la, ɔbazie ɔ bo zo. Ngyehyɛlɛ ne a le kɛ, bɛfa ngoane bɛsie ngoane bo zo.
19“Saa awie boda ɔ gɔnwo a, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛboda ye bie, kɛ ɔzile ɔbodale ye ala la. 20Ɛbu awie bowule a, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛbu ɛdawɔ wɔ bowule nu, ɛtu awie anye a, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛtu ɛ nye, yɛɛ ɛtu egyele a, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛtu ɛ gye. Kɛ ɛkɛzi ɛkɛboda ahenle la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛboda ɛdawɔ noko a. 21Awie mɔɔ kɛhu ayɛmoa la, ɔwɔ kɛ ɔsie ɔ bo zo, yɛɛ awie mɔɔ kɛhu sonla la, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛku ye. 22 Mɛla ko ala a wɔ ɛkɛ maa Yizilayɛnli nee ɛyɛvolɛ mɔɔ de Yizilayɛma avinli la a, ɔluakɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne a.”
23Yemɔti Mosisi hanle mɛla ne amuala hilele Yizilayɛma amuala. Bɛvale nrenya ne mɔɔ bɔle sasa ne la bɛhɔle azokoɛleɛ ne kandiba ne na bɛzile ye awolɛ. Yizilayɛma yɛle mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma luale Mosisi anwo zo hanle hilele bɛ la.

Title: SƐLƐ 25
Content:
Ɛvolɛ ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nsuu la
(Mɛla 15.1-11)
1 Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi wɔ Saenae Boka kɛ, 2“Ka kile Yizilayɛma kɛ: Saa bɛdwu azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ mefa meamaa bɛ la azo a, azɛlɛ ne banyia ye ɛnwomenlelielɛ mekɛ, bɛava bɛali Ɛdɛnkɛma eni. 3Bɛbava ɛvolɛ nsia bɛazo bɛ ɛya, bɛaziezie bɛ vanye mbaka ne mɔ na bɛade zolɛ ma. 4Ɛvolɛ ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nsuu la le azɛlɛ ne ɛnwomenlelielɛ mekɛ; ɔle Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛnwomenlelielɛ mekɛ. Ɔnle kɛ bɛso ɛya yɛɛ ɔnle kɛ bɛsiezie bɛ vanye mbaka ne mɔ. 5Ɔnle kɛ bɛbu bɛyɔba biala mɔɔ ɔdaye ɔ ngome ɔkɛvinde bɛ ɛya ne mɔ anu la, yɛɛ ɔnle kɛ bɛtete bɛ vanye mbaka ne mɔ azo ma ne mɔ. Ɔwɔ kɛ azɛlɛ ne die ye ɛnwomenle bɔkɔɔ. 6Azɛlɛ ne ɛnwomenlelielɛ ne ati, aleɛ bavinde azɛlɛ ne azo. Bɛnrɛzo ɛya bɔbɔ ɛdeɛ wɔ mekɛ ne anu, noko aleɛ bavinde azɛlɛ ne azo yeamaa bɛdabɛ, bɛ sonvolɛ mrenya nee mraalɛ, bɛ ɛkpama nee bɛ nyɛvolɛ mɔɔ nee bɛ de la amuala anyia bie ali wɔ ɛvolɛ ne anu. 7Eza bɛbanyia aleɛ bɛamaa bɛ nlankɛ nee bɛ nyɛmoa, yɛɛ nane ngakyile noko mɔɔ wɔ ɛbɔ nu la banyia bie ali.
Abozozielɛ ɛvolɛ ne
8“Akee bɛbadia ɛvolɛ nsuu nsuu fane nsuu, mɔɔ ye dodo le ɛvolɛ abulanla nee ngɔnla la. 9Na soa maa bɛhɔbɔ aweɛne tendenle ne wɔ ɛvolɛ zɔhane siane nsuu ne kenle bulu ne azo, wɔ maanle ne anu amuala; kenle ne le mgbɔdalɛ kenle. 10Ɛhye kile kɛ bɛbadu ɛvolɛ abulanlu ne bɛazie ɛkɛ, na bɛabɔ ye nolo kɛ awie biala di ɔ ti anwo wɔ maanle ne anu. Ɔle ɛvolɛ mɔɔ nuhua yɛɛ awie biala mɔɔ ɔ gɔnwo debie wɔ ye ɛkɛ ne awoba la, ɔbaye yeamaa ye a. Awie mɔɔ bɛdɔnenle ye kanra la noko bazia ahɔ ye abusua sua nu kɛ ɔnle kanranli bieko. 11Ɔle ɛvolɛ abulanlu ɛvoyia ɔmaa bɛ. Saa ɔdwu zo a, bɛnlua, bɛmbu yɛɛ bɛntete ma mɔɔ wɔ bɛ vanye mbaka ne mɔ azo la. 12Ɔle ɛvolɛ abulanlu ɛvoyia; ɔwɔ kɛ ɔyɛ nwuanzanwuanza ɔmaa bɛ. Yemɔti bɛbali debie biala mɔɔ kpɔkɛ ne kɛye kɛmaa bɛ la.
13“Wɔ ɛvolɛ abulanlu ɛvoyia ɛlilɛ ɛhye anu, awie biala mɔɔ ye agyadeɛ wɔ awoba la, ɔwɔ kɛ ɔ sa ka ye. 14Yemɔti saa ɛtɔ debie wɔ ɛ gɔnwo ɛkɛ anzɛɛ ɛtɔne debie wɔamaa ɛ gɔnwo a, mmamaa nzisi ba nu. 15Saa ɛya yɛɛ bɛka nwolɛ edwɛkɛ a, bɛzuzu nwolɛ bɛnlea kɛ toonwo mɔɔ ɔkadwu ɛvolɛ abulanlu ɛvoyia ne anloa la, nzoleɛ nyɛ yɛɛ bavinde nu a, yɛɛ ɛvolɛ biala nzoleɛ ne anloa bado ɛzɛ kolaa na bɛadɔne anzɛɛ bɛadɔ ɛya ne. 16Saa ɛvolɛ mɔɔ ɛha kolaa na ɛvolɛ abulanlu ɛvoyia ne adwu la zonle a, ɔwɔ kɛ deɛ ne bolɛ kɔ ɔ nyunlu, saa mɔɔ ɛha noko la anzo a, ɔwɔ kɛ deɛ ne bolɛ ka aze, ɔluakɛ ma dodo mɔɔ ɔbanyia ye la yɛɛ ahenle ne ɛlɛtɔne amaa wɔ a. 17Ɔnle kɛ bɛsisi bɛ nwo; ɔwɔ kɛ bɛsulo Nyamenle, ɔluakɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne a.
Anwongyelelɛ mɔɔ wɔ ɛvolɛ nsuu ne ɛlilɛ nu la
18“Zɔhane ati bɛli me mɛla ne mɔ azo; bɛzie me ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔ na bɛyɛ, amaa bɛ nwo adɔ bɛ wɔ azɛlɛ ne azo 19Azɛlɛ ne bamaa bɛ nzoleɛ dɔɔnwo, bɛbali bɛ ko ayi, na bɛ nwo adɔ bɛ.
20“Wɔannea a bɛ bie babiza kɛ, ‘Na ɛvolɛ ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nsuu la anu, yɛnrɛlua yɛɛ yɛnrɛbu la, ɛnee kɛ ɔkɛyɛ na yɛali debie ɛ?’ 21Medame, Ɛdɛnkɛma, mebamaa me nyilalɛ ara bɛ nwo zo wɔ ɛvolɛ ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nsia ne la anu, amaa bɛanyia aleɛ mɔɔ sa bɛ di la dedee ɛvolɛ nsa. 22Ɛvolɛ mɔtwɛ ne azo bɔbɔ mɔɔ ɛnee bɔ zo mɔɔ bɛlɛso bɛ ɛya ne mɔ la, bɛbanyia aleɛ bɛali toonwo yeahɔdwu ɛvolɛ ngɔnla ne anu; yemɔ anu bɔbɔ, bɛbanyia aleɛ dɛba bɛali.
Agyadeɛ abozozielɛ
23“Ɔnle kɛ bɛtɔne azɛlɛ biala bɔkɔɔ, ɔluakɛ azɛlɛ ne le Nyamenle ɛdeɛ; yɛɛ bɛle nyɛvolɛ nee adendulɛma mɔɔ nee me de a.
24“Kanza ɛtɔ azɛlɛ ne amuala bɔbɔ a, ɔwɔ kɛ adenle da ɛkɛ ne mɔɔ maa azɛlɛ menlema kola tɔ bɛ azɛlɛ ne mɔ die bɛ debie la. 25Saa ɛ diema bie kyia na ɔ nwo kyele ye maa ɔtɔne ye agyadeɛ ne foa ko ɔmaa wɔ a, ɔ nwo sonla kola bakpɔne deɛ ne mɔɔ ɔ diema ne ɛdɔne ye la. 26Saa ahenle ɛnlɛ awie mɔɔ kola kpɔne ye agyadeɛ ne maa ye, na nzinlii ɔ nwo yɛ boɛ, na ɔnea na ɔkɛhola ye deɛ ne kpɔne a, 27ɛ nee ye bɛsese bɛnwu ɛvolɛ dodo mɔɔ deɛ ne ralile ɛ sa nu la, na maa ɔdua kakɛ mɔɔ ɛha ɔ nzi la, na ɔlie ye debie. 28Na saa ahenle ɛnlɛ ezukoa mɔɔ ɔkola ɔdie ye debie a, yemɔ ɛnee ahenle mɔɔ deɛ ne li ɔ sa nu la ɛmaa ɔli ɔ sa nu toonwo ɔhɔdwu ɛvolɛ abulanlu ɛvoyia ne. Ɛvolɛ abulanlu ɛvoyia ne ɛlilɛ nu yɛɛ ɔ sa baha ye agyadeɛ ne na yeahɔ zolɛ a.
29“Saa awie tɔne ye sua mɔɔ wɔ suakpole mɔɔ bɛlie nwolɛ bane la azo a, eza ɔkola ɔkpɔne ye debie wɔ ɛvolɛ ko ne ala anu. Saa ɔnyia ɛvolɛ a, ɔkola ɔkpɔne ye debie. 30Saa ɛvolɛ mumua ko dwu na yeamkpɔne ye sua ne a, yemɔ ɛnee sua ne, kɛmɔ ɔwɔ suakpole mɔɔ bɛhye nwolɛ la azo la ati, ɔyɛ ahenle mɔɔ dɔle la nee ɔ bo zo amra ɛdeɛ bɔkɔɔ, wɔ awolɛndoazo muala anu. Ɛvolɛ abulanlu dwu a, bɛnrɛziane ye bɛnrɛmaa ɔ menle. 31Na azua mɔɔ wɔ namunamu mɔɔ bɛtɛkyele nwolɛ la azo la, saa awie tɔ bie a, ahenle kola kpɔne ye mekɛ biala, yɛɛ saa ɛvolɛ abulanlu ɛvoyia ne dwu a, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛsiane ye bɛmaa ɔ menle. 32Noko wɔ Livaema azuamgbole ne mɔ azo, Livaema ne kola kpɔne bɛ azua ne mɔ mekɛ biala. 33Na saa Livaenli bie le ehyianli somaa la ati yeangola ye sua ne kpɔne a, ɛnee saa ɛvolɛ abulanlu ɛvoyia ne dwu a, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛsiane ye debie bɛmaa ye. Ɔluakɛ Livaema azua ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛlɛ, wɔ bɛ azuamgbole ne mɔ azo la a le bɛ agyadeɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛ, wɔ bɛ mediema Yizilayɛma avinli a. 34Adidileka mɔɔ la Livaema azuamgbole ne mɔ anwo, mɔɔ bɛ muala bɛdidi zolɛ la, yemɔ ɔnle kɛ awie tɔne bie, ɔluakɛ ɔle bɛ agyadeɛ dahuu.
Ehyianvolɛ bosea ɛbɔlɛ
35 “Saa ɛ diema yɛ anwunvɔne na ɔngola ɔ nwo nea a, nea ye. Bu ye kɛ ɔle ɛyɛvolɛ anzɛɛ adendulɛnli yɛɛ ɔ nee wɔ de a. 36Mmadie ye nzinwo anzɛɛ mmasoa ye ɛnlomboɛ; wɔmɔ sulo wɔ Nyamenle, amaa ɛ diema ne ahola ɔ nee wɔ adɛnla. 37Mmabɔ ye bosea na ɛdie nwolɛ nzinwo anzɛɛ mmatɔne aleɛ mɔɔ ɛfa wɔamaa ye la ɛdie nvasoɛ. 38Mame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne mɔɔ nee bɛ vi Yigyibiti azɛlɛ zo rale kɛ mebava Keena azɛlɛ ne meamaa bɛ na meayɛ bɛ Nyamenle la a.
Ahanra ɛgyakyilɛ
39 “Saa ɛ diema bie mɔɔ bikye wɔ la yɛ anwunvɔne, na ɔtɔne ɔ nwo ɔmaa wɔ a, mmamaa ɔsonle wɔ kɛ kanranli. 40Maa ɔ nee wɔ ɛdɛnla kɛ wɔ ɛkpanli anzɛɛ ɛyɛvolɛ Ɔbazonle wɔ toonwo ɛvolɛ abulanlu ɛvoyia ne adwu, 41na akee ɔvi ɛ nwo ɛkɛ ne yeahɔ. Ɔkɔ a ɔ nee ɔ mra a kɔ a; ɔbahɔ ye abusua nu nee ɔ ze mɔ awuke nu. 42Ɔluakɛ bɛle me sonvolɛma mɔɔ me nee bɛ vi Yigyibiti azɛlɛ zo rale a. Ɔnle kɛ bɛtɔne bɛ ahanra. 43Ɔnle kɛ ɛfa atisesebɛ ɛsie ye; ɔwɔ kɛ ɛsulo Nyamenle. 44Mɔɔ fane ahanra mraalɛ nee mrenya mɔɔ bɛbanyia bɛ la anwo, bɛkola bɛtɔ ahanra mraalɛ nee mrenya wɔ maanle maanle gyɛne ne mɔ mɔɔ zuozua bɛ la anu. 45Eza bɛkola bɛtɔ bɛfi nyɛvolɛ anzɛɛ adendulɛma mɔɔ nee bɛ de la anu anzɛɛ nyɛvolɛ mbusua mɔɔ wɔ azɛlɛ ne azo bie la anu, na bɛfa bɛ bɛyɛ bɛ agyadeɛ. 46Bɛkola bɛfa bɛyɛ agyadeɛ bɛmaa bɛ mra mrenya kɛ bɛle bɛ ɛdeɛ bɔkɔɔ. Bɛkola bɛyɛ ɛhye mɔ ahanra bɔkɔɔ; na bɛ mediema Yizilayɛma ɛdeɛ, bɛmmafa atisesebɛ bɛsie bɛ.
47“Saa ɛyɛvolɛ bie anzɛɛ adendulɛnli bie mɔɔ nee bɛ de la nyia ɔ nwo, na bɛ diema bie mɔɔ bikye ye la yɛ anwunvɔne na ɔtɔne ɔ nwo ɔmaa ye, anzɛɛ ɛyɛvolɛ ne busuanli bie a, 48mɔɔ yedɔne ɔ nwo yewie la bɛkola bɛkpɔne ye; ɔ mediema ne mɔ ko ɛhɔkpɔne ye. 49Ɔ wuvuanyi, ɔ nli anzɛɛ ɔ ze adiema ara, anzɛɛ ɔ nwo sonla biala mɔɔ wɔ ye abusua ne anu la kola kpɔne ye; anzɛɛ saa nzinlii ɔdaye ɔnyia ezukoa a, ɔkola ɔkpɔne ɔ nwo. 50Saa ɔkakpɔne ɔ nwo anzɛɛ awie yɛɛ kakpɔne ye a, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛsese bɛnwu ɛvolɛ dodo mɔɔ ɛha na bɛali ɛvolɛ abulanlu ɛvoyia ne la, na bɛtua nwolɛ kakɛ biala bɛmaa ahenle mɔɔ dɔle ye la. Ɛvolɛ dodo biala mɔɔ ɔlile wɔ ahenle mɔɔ dɔle ye la sua nu la, bɛbasese ye kɛ ɔle ɛkpanli. 51Saa bɛsese na ɛvolɛ dodo mɔɔ wɔ ɔ nyunlu la wale a, bolɛ ne mɔɔ bɛduale ye ɔ ti la bie yɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛsese bɛfa bɛkpɔne ye a. 52Na saa ɛvolɛ mɔɔ ɛha la anzo na bɛali ɛvolɛ abulanlu ɛvoyia ne a, yemɔ bɛbasese, na ɛvolɛ dodo mɔɔ yeli wɔ ahenle mɔɔ dɔle ye la asa anu la yeava nwolɛ ɛkpabɔdeɛ ne bie yeadua yeakpɔne ɔ nwo. 53Mekɛ mɔɔ ɔ nee ye de la, ɛnee ɔle kɛ ɛkpanli mɔɔ bɛbɔ ye ɛkpa ɛvolɛ ɛvolɛ la. Ɔnle kɛ bɛgyinla bɛnea ye bɛmaa ɔyɛ ye amumuyɛ. 54Saa bɛangola ye kpɔne wɔ adenle ɛhye mɔ biala azo a, yemɔ ɛnee ɛvolɛ abulanlu ɛvoyia ne dwu a ɔwɔ kɛ ɔdaye nee ɔ mra ne mɔ amuala nyia bɛ ti. 55Ɔluakɛ mame, Yizilayɛma amuala le sonvolɛma. Bɛle me sonvolɛma mɔɔ me nee bɛ vi Yigyibiti azɛlɛ zo rale a: medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne a.”

Title: SƐLƐ 26
Content:
Tieyɛ nwo nyilalɛ
(Mɛla 7.12-24; 28.1-14)
1 Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi kɛ, “Bɛmmayɛ mmonle nee ananze yɛɛ bɛmmasi mpila biala, yɛɛ bɛmmase bolɛ bɛsie ye bɛ azɛlɛ ne azo kɛ bɛbɔ bɛ ti aze bɛamaa bɛ, ɔluakɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne a. 2Bɛzie me Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ne mɔ, na bɛli ɛleka nwuanzanwuanza ne mɔɔ bɛsonle me la eni. Medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a.
3 “Saa bɛdi me mɛla ne mɔ azo na bɛyɛ me ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔ a, 4yemɔ ɛlobɔ ne dwu a, mebamaa ezule adɔ na azɛlɛ ne aye aleɛ dɔɔnwo amaa bɛ, na kpɔkɛ nu mbaka amaa bɛ nzoleɛ. 5Bɛ bɛyɔba bara dɔɔnwo, yeahɔdwu vanye ma ɛdelɛ, na bɛade vanye ma toonwo yeahɔdwu mekɛ mɔɔ bɛfa bɛdua aleɛ la. Bɛbanyia aleɛ bɛali bɛ ko ayi, na bɛ nwo ayɛ twetwe wɔ bɛ azɛlɛ ne azo.
6“Mebamaa bɛ nzo nu adwo bɛ wɔ azɛlɛ ne azo, na bɛalie bɛ ɛnwomenle, yɛɛ awie biala ɛnrɛha bɛ ɛzulolɛ. Mebaye nane mɔɔ ɛnle kpalɛ la amuala wɔ azɛlɛ ne azo yɛɛ konle ɛnrɛzi maanle ne anu. 7Bɛbavoa bɛ kpɔvolɛma na bɛahu bɛ muala. 8Bɛ nuhua nnu bɔbɔ bahola aha menli ɛya agua ɛbɔ nu, yɛɛ bɛ nuhua ɛya bahola aha apenle bulu agua ɛbɔ nu; na bɛbahu bɛ kpɔvolɛma amuala. 9Mebanlea bɛ nwo zo kpalɛ na meamaa bɛawo mralɛ dɔɔnwo, na bɛ nwo azo, na meamoa me ngyekyeleɛ ne mɔɔ me nee bɛ kyekyele la azo.
10“Bɛbali bɛ aleɛ mɔɔ bɛvale bɛziele dɛba la, bɛbaye dɛba ne bɛavinde na bɛava fofolɛ bɛazie. 11Me nee bɛ badɛnla yɛɛ menrɛkpo bɛ ɛlɛ. 12 Me nee bɛ balua, meayɛ bɛ Nyamenle, na bɛayɛ me menli. 13Medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne, mɔɔ menyele bɛ menvile Yigyibiti azɛlɛ zo a, amaa bɛanyɛ Yigyibitima ahanra. Meye bɛ kɔme kpomgbolo ne memaa bɛnyia bɛ ti.
Anzosesebɛ nwo ndeanlɛ
(Mɛla 28.15-68)
14“Na saa bɛandie me ne, bɛanyɛ mɔɔ meze bɛ la, 15saa bɛbulu me mɛla ne mɔ azo, na bɛkpo me ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔ, na yemɔti bɛnrɛyɛ mɔɔ meze bɛ la amuala, na bɛtulu me ngyekyeleɛ ne a, 16mɔɔ mebava meayɛ bɛ la ɛne: Mebamaa ɛzulolɛ kpole bie araheda bɛ nwo zo, meamaa ewule mɔɔ maa nwonane wie la, nee ebunlu fufule aha bɛ, azi bɛ nye na yeahu bɛ. Bɛbalua ma na bɛnrɛnyia bie, ɔluakɛ bɛ kpɔvolɛma barali. 17Mebava me nye meawula bɛ nyunlu, meamaa bɛ kpɔvolɛma ali bɛ nwo zo konim. Menli ne mɔɔ kyi bɛ la bazie bɛ, na bɛbanriandi wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ awie ɛndoa bɛ la.
18“Na saa ɛhye mɔ anzi na eza bɛnrɛdie me ne a, akee mebahwi bɛ ɛza fane nsuu wɔ bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ ati. 19Mebazɛkye bɛ adubɛnwo anwosesebɛ biala; ezule ɛnrɛdɔ, na bɛ azɛlɛ ne bahwie ayɛ ketekete kɛ bolɛ. 20Bɛbavɛ mgbane, ɔluakɛ bɛ azɛlɛ ɛnrɛhye aleɛ yɛɛ ɛbɔ nu mbaka ɛnrɛzo.
21“Saa bɛkɔ zolɛ na bɛandie me ne, na bɛkpo me a, mebamaa ewulenzane mɔɔ anu yɛ se tɛla bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ fane nsuu la adɔ bɛ nwo. 22Mebatulu nanemgbole anwo ɛzulolɛ wɔ bɛ avinli, meamaa bɛahu bɛ mra, bɛazɛkye bɛ nlankɛ, amaa bɛ nwo ayɛ ekyi na bɛ ndenle ne mɔ azo adɔ mgbane.
