Mekɛ ɛhye amuala ɛnee aweɛne ne la zo. 10Na Dwɔhyua zele menli ne mɔ kɛ bɛmmatea, yɛɛ bɛmmaka edwɛkɛ biala kɔkpula mekɛ mɔɔ ɔkɛha ɔkɛhile bɛ kɛ akee bɛdea nu la na bɛadea nu. 11Yemɔti ɔmanle menli ne mɔ vale Ɛdɛnkɛma Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne bɔle suakpole ne anwo mgbɔlɔka yiale na bɛziale bɛhɔle bɛ azokoɛleɛ ne bɛhɔlale.
12-13Aleɛ hyenle la Dwɔhyua dwazole nwonlomɔ mangyee ne ala, na sɛlɛvolɛma ne nee ɛlɔnema ne mɔ diale kilikili bɔle Gyɛleko sua bɔdenle ne mgbɔlɔka yiale, kɛmɔ bɛyɛle ye wɔ kenle ne mɔɔ lumua la: ɛlɔnema ne ekpunli ko lumua, sɛlɛvolɛma nsuu ne mɔɔ ɛlɛbɔ mɛne aweɛne ne mɔ la doa bɛ, sɛlɛvolɛma ne mɔɔ zo Ɛdɛnkɛma Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne la doa zo, yɛɛ akee ɛlɔnema mɔɔ ɛha la noko bɛdabɛ bɛli bɛ nzi. Mekɛ ɛhye amuala, ɛnee aweɛne ne la zo zɛhae ala. 14Kenle ɛhye tɔ zolɛ kenle nwiɔ, bɛbɔle suakpole ne mgbɔlɔka bɛyiale na bɛziale bɛhɔle bɛ azokoɛleɛ ne. Bɛyɛle ɛhye toonwo kenle nsia.
15Kenle nsuu ne azo bɛdwazole aleɛbahye ne na bɛhɔbɔle suakpole ne mgbɔlɔka, kɛmɔ bɛyɛ ye dɛba ne ala la, fane nsuu. Kenle ko ɛhye ala yɛɛ bɛdiale kilikili bɛbɔle suakpole ne mgbɔlɔka fane nsuu a. 16Fane nsuu ne azo, mɔɔ sɛlɛvolɛma ne wule aweɛne ne mɔ anu la, Dwɔhyua zele menli ne kɛ, “Bɛdea nu, ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛva suakpole ye ɛmaa bɛ! 17Bɛzɛkye suakpole ne nee debie biala mɔɔ wɔ zolɛ la bɔkɔɔ bɛva bɛbɔ azu bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma. Tuutuunli Releehabe nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ ye sua nu ɛkɛ ne la ala a bɛgyakyi bɛ a, ɔboalekɛ ɔvale yɛ menli ne mɔɔ yɛzoanle bɛ la ɔveale. 18Na bɛmɛ, ɔnle kɛ bɛfa debie biala mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛsɛkye ye la. Saa bɛfa debie a, bɛkɛmaa munzule kɛra Yizilayɛma anwo zo wɔ bɛ azokoɛleɛ ne. 19Debie biala mɔɔ bɛva dwɛtɛ fufule, ezukoa nvutuke, kɔbele anzɛɛ bulalɛ bɛyɛ la, bɛva bɛzie ɛkɛ bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma. Bɛva zɔhane ninyɛne ne mɔ bɛhɔgua Ɛdɛnkɛma gya ne anu.”
20Zɔhane ati sɛlɛvolɛma ne bɔle bɛ aweɛne ne mɔ anu. Menli ne dele ala la, bɛdeanle nu kpole ko, ɛnee bane ne mɔɔ bɛhye ye suakpole ne anwo la ɛde ɛgua aze, gɔɔ. Na Yizilayɛ ɛlɔnema ne nyianle adenle hɔle suakpole ne azo na bɛhonle bɛvale. 21Bɛhunle awie biala mɔɔ wɔ suakpole ne azo la, mrenya nee mraalɛ, ngakula nee mgbanyinli. Eza bɛhunle nlankɛ, mboane, yɛɛ asoaso muala.
22Dwɔhyua akee zele menli nwiɔ ne mɔɔ lumuale hɔkpɔlale azɛlɛ ne la kɛ, “Bɛhɔ tuutuunli raalɛ ne sua nu bɛhɔva ye nee ye mbusua ne bɛvinde, kɛmɔ bɛ ɛwɔkɛ ne mɔɔ bɛbɔle ye la se la.” 23Zɔhane ati mgbavolɛ nwiɔ ne hɔvale Releehabe nee ɔ ze nee ɔ nli, ɔ mediema mrenya nee ɔ nwo amra ne amuala rale. Bɛvale bɛ muala bɛhɔziele ɛleka kpalɛ mɔɔ bikye Yizilayɛma azokoɛleɛ ne la. 24Akee bɛdole senle suakpole ne azo bɛyelale ye boka debie biala mɔɔ wɔ zolɛ la. Ninyɛne mɔɔ bɛva ezukoa nvutuke, dwɛtɛ fufule, kɔbele anzɛɛ bulalɛ bɛyɛ la, bɛvale bɛ muala bɛraguale Ɛdɛnkɛma gya ne anu. 25 Noko Dwɔhyua liele tuutuunli Releehabe nee ye mbusua ne mɔ ngoane, ɔboalekɛ ɔvale Yizilayɛma nwiɔ ne mɔɔ bɛzoanle bɛ Gyɛleko la ɔveale. (Ɛnɛ nee ɛnɛ ala Releehabe abo zo amra tɛbɔ Yizilayɛ azɛlɛ zo.)
26 Mekɛ ne anu Dwɔhyua bɔle kɔkɔ mɔɔ anu yɛ se la kɛ, “Awie ko biala mɔɔ kɛbɔ mɔdenle kɛ ɔkyekye suakpole Gyɛleko bieko la, Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛdua ye kakɛ.
Mɔɔ kɛwula suakpole ne abo aze la,
ɔ ra nrenya kpanyinli ne ɛwu.
Mɔɔ kɛdua suakpole ne anuhɔlɛ mgbole ne mɔ ɛbonle la,
ye nrenya kazima ne ɛwu.”
27Na Ɛdɛnkɛma nee Dwɔhyua luale, na ye nganeɛ hɔle maanle ne anu ɛleka biala.

Title: DWƆ 7
Content:
Ekan ɛtane ne mɔɔ ɔyɛle la
1Ɛdɛnkɛma mɛla ne mɔɔ ɔlile ɔmanle Yizilayɛma kɛ awie biala mmafa ɔ sa ka debie biala mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛsɛkye ye wɔ Gyɛleko la, bɛanli zolɛ. Nrenya bie mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Ekan la donle mɛla ne. Ɛdɛnkɛma vale Yizilayɛma anwo ɛya kpole. (Ekan le Zila angabɛnzo. Ɔ ze a le Kaamae yɛɛ ɔ nlenya a le Zabedae. Ɔbɔ Dwuda abusua ekpunli ne bie.)
2Dwɔhyua zoanle menli bie vi Gyɛleko kɛ bɛhɔ Eyae, sua bie mɔɔ wɔ Bɛtɛle aduduleɛ afoa nu na ɔbikye Bɛteevɛn la kɛ bɛhɔli busia bɛnlea kɛ azɛlɛ ne si de la. Menli ne mɔ hɔle na bɛziale bɛrale. 3Bɛrale la bɛzele Dwɔhyua kɛ, “Ɔngyia kɛ menli ne amuala kɔ kɔfɛ mgbane. Ɔnle sua kpole, eza menli mɔɔ wɔ zolɛ la anzo biala.” 4Yemɔti Yizilayɛ ɛlɔnema kɛyɛ apenle nsa ala a hɔle Eyae a, na bɛannyia gyinlagyakɛ. Bɛnriandile bɛvile Eyae. 5Eyaema voanle Yizilayɛma vile sua ne anuhɔlɛ kpole ne anloa na bɛvoanle bɛ toonwo bɛhɔdwule Hyɛbalem boka ne azo lɔ, bɛ sa hanle Yizilayɛma anu abulasa nee nsia bɛhunle bɛ wɔ boka ne ndololeɛ nu. Yizilayɛma anwo bubule bɛ na bɛzulole.
6Dwɔhyua nee Yizilayɛ mgbanyima ne mɔ tetele bɛ adɛladeɛ ne mɔ bɛvale bɛhilele nyane mɔɔ ɛha bɛ la, na bɛdule bɛguale mutule nu wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne anyunlu, na bɛguale ɛkɛ ne toonwo nɔsolɛ nu; eza bɛvulale ɛnwea bɛguale bɛ ti zo bɛhilele kɛ bɛlɛdi nyane. 7Na Dwɔhyua hanle kɛ, “O, Awulae Nyamenle! Duzu ati yɛɛ wɔva yɛ wɔra azule Dwɔdan ye anzi ɛke, na wɔye yɛ wɔmaa Amɔlema kɛ bɛhu yɛ ɛ? Duzu ati yɛɛ yɛandɛnla Dwɔdan ne anzi lɔ a? 8O, Awulae, kɛkala mɔɔ Yizilayɛma ɛnriandi ɛvi bɛ kpɔvolɛma anyunlu la, duzu edwɛkɛ yɛɛ menga a? 9Keenama nee awie biala mɔɔ wɔ maanle ye anu la bade yɛ nwo edwɛkɛ. Bɛbarabɔ bɛayia yɛ na bɛabɔ yɛ bo zo bɔkɔɔ! Na duzu yɛɛ ɛkɛyɛ na wɔalie wɔ duma kpole ne wɔazie aze ɛ?”
10Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Dwɔhyua kɛ, “Dwazo! Duzu ati a ɛla ye mutule nu zɛhae ɛ? 11Yizilayɛma ɛyɛ ɛtane. Bɛdo me mɛla ne mɔɔ menvale memanle bɛ la. Bɛva ninyɛne ne mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛsɛkye bɛ la bie. Bɛwuale, bɛbɔle nwolɛ adalɛ na bɛva bɛvea bɛ ninyɛne nu. 12Ɛhye ati yɛɛ bɛangola bɛangyinla bɛ kpɔvolɛma anyunlu a. Bɛnriandile, ɔboalekɛ bɛdabɛ mumua ne, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛsɛkye bɛ! Me nee bɛ ɛnrɛlua bieko kyesɛ bɛsɛkye ninyɛne ne mɔɔ bɛzele bɛ kɛ bɛmmafa na bɛandie bɛvale la. 13Dwazo! Maa menli ne ɛde bɛ nwo na bɛrɛla me nyunlu ɛke. Bɛziezie bɛ nwo bɛrɛla me nyunlu ɛke ɛhyema, ɔboalekɛ medame, Yizilayɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle ne, melɛ ɛhye meka meahile bɛ: ‘Yizilayɛma, ninyɛne mɔɔ menganle kɛ bɛzɛkye bɛ la bie mɔ vea bɛ nwo ɛkɛ! Bɛnrɛhola bɛ kpɔvolɛma anyunlu gyinla ɛlɛ, kyesɛ bɛminli ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ abo zo.’ 14Zɔhane ati se bɛ kɛ, nwonlomɔ bɛbara ye abusua ekpunli ekpunli. Abusua ekpunli ko mɔɔ menwɔye ye la anu amra bara ye mrɛladane nu. Ɛrɛladane ko mɔɔ menwɔye ye la anu amra bara ye awuke awuke; awuke ko noko mɔɔ menwɔye ye la anu amra bara ye ngoko. 15Sonla mɔɔ bɛkɛhye ye kɛ ninyɛne ne mɔ bie wɔ ye ɛkɛ ne la, bɛbayela ye nee debie biala mɔɔ ɔlɛ la. Ɔluakɛ yemaa anyiemgba ɛha Yizilayɛma, yɛɛ eza yedo me mɛla ne.”
16Aleɛ hyenle nwonlomɔ mangyee ne la, Dwɔhyua vale Yizilayɛma ne rale, ɔvale bɛ abusua ekpunli ekpunli ɔvindele Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu na bɛyele Dwuda abusua ekpunli ne. 17Akee ɔmanle abusua ekpunli ne anu amra rale ye mrɛladane nu, na ɔbɔle Zila asa azo ne. Dwɔhyua manle Zila asa azo ne ragyinlanle ye awuke awuke nu, na ɔbɔle Zabedae awuke nu amra. 18Zabedae vale ye awuke nu amra ne rale ngoko ngoko, na ɔbɔle Ekan, mɔɔ ɔ ze a le Kaamae na ɔ nlenya a le Zabedae la. Kaamae le Zila alɔnra yɛɛ ɔvi Dwuda abusua ekpunli ne anu. 19Na Dwɔhyua zele ye kɛ, “Me ra nrenya, ka nɔhalɛ ne na fa anyunlunyia maa Ɛdɛnkɛma mɔɔ le Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne, na ye ye ayɛlɛ; to mɔɔ wɔyɛ la kpaa nu. Ka mɔɔ wɔyɛ la kile me. Mmafa ɛfea me.”
20Ekan buale kɛ, “Nɔhalɛ, meyɛ ɛtane metia Ɛdɛnkɛma mɔɔ le Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne. Mɔɔ menyɛle la ɛne: 21ninyɛne mɔɔ yɛhonle yɛvale la menwunle anwuma tɛladeɛ kɛnlɛma bie mɔɔ bɛyɛle ye wɔ Babelonia la, dwɛtɛ fufule mɔɔ ye ɛnlomboɛ to kɛyɛ tone nu kilo nwiɔ, ezukoa nvutuke kpɔma ko mɔɔ kɛyɛ kilo foa ko la, na me nye bolole bɛ. Yemɔti menvale. Mevu meyɛ me ndanlɛ sua ne abo, na dwɛtɛ fufule ne a li ɔ bo kpalɛ a.”
22Zɔhane ati Dwɔhyua zoanle menli manle bɛhɔle Ekan ndanlɛ sua ne anu na bɛhɔnwunle ninyɛne ne kɛ yevu yeyɛ, na dwɛtɛ fufule ne li ɔ bo kpalɛ. 23Bɛvale ninyɛne ne mɔ bɛrale Dwɔhyua nee Yizilayɛma anyunlu, na bɛguale bɛ wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu ɛkɛ ne. 24Dwɔhyua nee Yizilayɛma zɔle Zila angabɛnzo Ekan nu, bɛvale dwɛtɛ fufule ne, tɛladeɛ ne, yɛɛ ezukoa nvutuke ne; akee bɛvale Ekan amra mrenya nee mraalɛ, ye nlankɛ, mboane, asoaso, yɛɛ ndanlɛ sua ne nee debie biala mɔɔ ɔlɛ la bɛhɔle Ngyegyelɛ Bɔnza ne anu. 25Akee Dwɔhyua bizale Ekan kɛ, “Duzu ati a wɔva ngyegyelɛ ɛhye wɔdo yɛ nwo ɛ? Ɛdɛnkɛma bava bie ado ɛ nwo ɛnɛ.” Na Yizilayɛma zile Ekan awolɛ manle ɔwule. Eza bɛzile ye sua nu amra amuala awolɛ bɛhunle bɛ na bɛyelale bɛ nee debie biala mɔɔ bɛlɛ la. 26Bɛhuohuanle awolɛ edukue kpole kpalɛ ɔ nwo zo; ɔtɛbɔ ɛkɛ ne ɛnɛ nee ɛnɛ ala. Yemɔti bɛfɛlɛ ɛkɛ ne Ngyegyelɛ Bɔnza.
Na Ɛdɛnkɛma akunlu dwole fɔɔnwo.

Title: DWƆ 8
Content:
Eyae ɛvalɛ nee ye ɛbɔlɛ
1Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Dwɔhyua kɛ, “Fa wɔ ɛlɔnema ne kɔ Eyae. Mmasulo yɛɛ mmamaa wɔ ahonle tu. Mebamaa wɔali Eyae belemgbunli ne anwo zo konim; ye menli, ye suakpole ne, nee ye azɛlɛ ne amuala bayɛ wɔ ɛdeɛ. 2Kɛ ɛyɛle Gyɛleko nee ye belemgbunli ne la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ ɛbayɛ Eyae nee ye belemgbunli ne a. Na ɛnɛ ɛdeɛ, ninyɛne nee nlankɛ ne mɔ le bɛ ɛdeɛ. Bɛboɔboa bɛ nwo na bɛbu bɛ nzi bɛhɔ bɛ nwo zo arɛlevilɛ nu na bɛva sua ne.”
3Zɔhane ati Dwɔhyua boɔboale ɔ nwo kɛ ɔ nee ye ɛlɔnema ne amuala kɔ Eyae. Ɔyele menli mɔɔ ze konle nye zo la apenle abulasa na ɔmanle bɛhɔle nɔe ne ala. 4Ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛhɔvea suakpole ne anzi lɔ; bɛmmakɔ moa biala, na bɛva bɛzie bɛ nyunlu kɛ bɛfa suakpole ne. 5Me nee me ɛlɔnema ne yɛbaye yɛ nyunlu. Na saa suakpole ne azo amra finde kɛ bɛbadoa yɛ bɛ nee yɛ aho a, yɛbanriandi yɛazia, kɛmɔ yɛyɛle ye alumua ne la. 6Bɛbadoa yɛ na bɛ muala bɛbavi sua ne azo. Bɛbaha kɛ yɛle avoanvoanle na yɛlɛnriandi, kɛmɔ alumua ne yɛyɛle la; 7na bɛmɛ bɛavinde arɛlevilɛ nu bɛarava suakpole ne. Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne baye sua ne amaa bɛ. 8Saa bɛfa sua ne a, bɛyela ye, kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma hanle la. Ɛnee kɛ mese ɛne!” 9Zɔhane ati Dwɔhyua guale bɛ adenle zo, na bɛhɔveale Bɛtɛle nee Eyae avinli, mɔɔ di kɔ Eyae adɔleɛ la. Dwɔhyua nee ye menli ne mɔ hɔlale azokoɛleɛ ɛkɛ ne kenle ko ne nɔe ne.
10Nwonlomɔ mangyee ne Dwɔhyua dwazole vɛlɛvɛlɛle ye ɛlɔnema ne. Akee ɔdaye yɛɛ Yizilayɛ mgbanyima ne mɔ lile ɛlɔnema mɔɔ ɛha la ati na bɛguale adenle zo kɛ bɛkɔ Eyae. 11Ɛlɔnema ne nee Dwɔhyua vale suakpole ne anuhɔlɛ kpole ne adenle zo, na mɔɔ bɛbikyele suakpole ne bie la, bɛzokoɛle ye ɛbɔ nu afoa nu, ɛleka bie mɔɔ bɔnza anu kuloonwu bie la bɛ nee Eyae avinli la. 12Ɔvale menli kɛyɛ apenle nnu na ɔmanle bɛhɔveale suakpole ne adɔleɛ wɔ Eyae nee Bɛtɛle avinli. 13Kɛ bɛhyehyɛle ɛlɔnema ne anu la ɛne: bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛbaho konle mumua ne la a le menli mɔɔ wɔ suakpole ne ɛbɔ nu afoa nu la, yɛɛ ɛlɔnema mɔɔ zua alumua ɛlɔnema ne la a le bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ suakpole ne adɔleɛ afoa nu la. Dwɔhyua ɛdeɛ ɔlale bɔnza ne anu nɔe ne. 14Mekɛ mɔɔ Eyae belemgbunli ne nwunle Dwɔhyua menli ne la, ɔhanle ɔ nwo ndɛndɛ ne ala na ɔvale ye ɛlɔnema ne amuala kɛ bɛ nee Yizilayɛma baho wɔ Dwɔdan Bɔnza ne anu, ɛnee ɔnze kɛ ɛlɔnema babu ɔ nzi. 15Dwɔhyua nee ye ɛlɔnema ne yɛle kɛ asɛɛ bɛho bɛgua, na bɛbɔle ɔ bo kɛ bɛnriandi bɛahɔ ɛsɛlɛ ne azo lɔ. 16Eyae belemgbunli ne vɛlɛle menli mɔɔ wɔ Eyae la kɔsɔɔti kɛ bɛraboka bɛ nwo bɛmaa bɛvoa Yizilayɛma. Mekɛ mɔɔ bɛdoa Dwɔhyua la ɛnee Dwɔhyua nee ye ɛlɔnema ne ɛlɛnriandi ahɔ moa moa kpalɛ. 17Nrenya ko biala mɔɔ wɔ Eyae anzɛɛ Bɛtɛle la vindele hɔbokale ɛlɔnema ne mɔɔ ɛlɛfoa Yizilayɛma la anwo, na suakpole ne dɔle mgbane na eza bɛgyakyile ye anuhɔlɛ ne mɔ nwo.
18Akee Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Dwɔhyua kɛ, “Tende wɔ atwɛ ne wɔ Eyae; mebaye sua ne meamaa wɔ.” Na Dwɔhyua dendenle atwɛ ne mɔɔ ɔlɛ ye ɔ sa nu la wɔ Eyae. 19Ɔmanle ɔ sa zo ala la, Dwɔhyua menli ne mɔɔ hɔle nzia ne la dwazole ndɛndɛ na bɛvale ɛnriandilɛ bɛrale suakpole ne azo bɛravale. Na bɛdole senle suakpole ne azo. 20Eyaema dole bɛ nye bɛ nzi la, bɛnwunle kɛ senle ɛdɔ bɛ sua ne azo na ye esike ɛdwazo bolonwonwo zɛhae. Zɔhane ati ɛnee akee bɛnnwu ɛleka mɔɔ bɛnriandi bɛabɔ bɛ ti a, ɔboalekɛ Yizilayɛma ne mɔɔ nriandile hɔle ɛsɛlɛ ne azo la akee ɛzi ɛgyinla kɛ bɛ nee bɛ ko. 21Dwɔhyua nee ye ɛlɔnema ne nwunle kɛ Yizilayɛma ɛhendeɛ ne mɔ ɛva suakpole ne na bɛdo senle wɔ zolɛ la, bɛhakyile bɛ nye na bɛbɔle ɔ bo kɛ bɛku bɛ kpɔvolɛma ne. 22Yizilayɛma mɔɔ wɔ suakpole ne azo la rabokale konle ne anwo. Eyaema nwunle kɛ bɛha Yizilayɛma avinli bɔkɔɔ; na Yizilayɛma hunle bɛ muala. Ko bɔbɔ anvi ɛsalɛ 23kɛ Eyae belemgbunli ne ala. Bɛhyele ye bɛvale ye bɛrɛlɛle Dwɔhyua.
24Yizilayɛma hunle Eyae ɛlɔnema ne mɔɔ voanle bɛ wɔ ɛsɛlɛ ne azo la, na akee bɛziale bɛhɔle suakpole ne azo bɛhɔhunle bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ ɛkɛ ne la amuala. 25-26Dwɔhyua dendenle ye atwɛ ne wɔ Eyae la, yeando ye aze toonwo ɔhɔkpulale kɛ bɛhunle awie biala mɔɔ wɔ suakpole ne azo la. Bɛhunle awie biala mɔɔ wɔ Eyae la, mrenya nee mraalɛ kɔsɔɔti, na bɛ muala bɛlua apenle ngoko bulu nee nwiɔ. 27Yizilayɛma ne vale nlankɛ nee ninyɛne mɔɔ bɛnyianle bɛ wɔ suakpole ne azo la, kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Dwɔhyua la. 28Dwɔhyua yelale Eyae na ɔmanle ɔyɛle suadu. Ɛnɛ nee ɛnɛ, ɛkɛ ne tɛde suadu. 29Ɔhendanle Eyae belemgbunli ne wɔ baka kpole bie azo na ɔgyakyile ye ɛkɛ ne toonwo nɔsolɛ. Sɛnzɛne ne kadɔ la Dwɔhyua manle bɛhɔyele funli ne, na bɛvuandinle ye bɛdole Eyae suakpole ne anuhɔlɛ kpole ne anyunlu. Bɛhuanle awolɛ edukue kpole kpalɛ ko bɛhedale funli ne azo, na ɛnɛ nee ɛnɛ ala ɔtɛbɔ ɛkɛ ne.
Bɛkenga mɛla ne wɔ Yibale Boka
30 Akee Dwɔhyua zile azubɔlɛ ɛkponle manle Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne wɔ Yibale Boka ne azo. 31Ɔyɛle ye kɛ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma sonvolɛ Mosisi hyehyɛle manle Yizilayɛma la. Ɔwɔ Mosisi mɛla ne anu kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ ɔyɛ “azukponle mɔɔ bɛva awolɛ mɔɔ bɛanva bulalɛ a bɛkpukekpukele la a bɛzile la.” Yemɔ azo yɛɛ bɛyelale nane ne bɛbɔle azu bɛmanle Ɛdɛnkɛma, na eza bɛbɔle anzonudwolɛ nwo azu a. 32Ɛkɛ ne yɛɛ mɔɔ ɛnee Yizilayɛma amuala ɛlɛnea ye la, Dwɔhyua hɛlɛle Mosisi mɛla ne mɔɔ ɔde aze la ɔhɛlɛle la wo awolɛ ne mɔ azo a. 33 Yizilayɛma amuala, bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛle nyɛvolɛ na bɛwɔ bɛ avinli nee bɛdabɛ Dwuuma amuala, bɛ nee bɛ mgbanyima nee mbɔlɔba mgbanyinli nee ndɛnebuavolɛma gyinlanle ye ɛhonlene nwiɔ wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne foa nee ye foa, na bɛnleanle Livae sɛlɛvolɛma ne mɔɔ zoale la. Menli ne foa ko anzi kɔ Gɛlaezem Boka yɛɛ foa ko noko anzi kɔ Yibale Boka. Ɛdɛnkɛma sonvolɛ Mosisi zele bɛ kɛ saa mekɛ ne dwu na bɛdie nyilalɛ a bɛgyinla ye zɔhane. 34Dwɔhyua akee gengale mɛla ne amuala, boka nyilalɛ nee amowa kɔsɔɔti, kɛmɔ bɛhɛlɛ ye wɔ Mɛla Buluku ne anu la. 35Dwɔhyua gengale Mosisi mɛla ne mɔ ngoko ngoko hilele Yizilayɛma kɔsɔɔti, mrenya nee mraalɛ, ngakula, yɛɛ nyɛvolɛ mɔɔ wɔ bɛ avinli la amuala.

Title: DWƆ 9
Content:
Gebɛyɔnoma bɛlɛbɛla Dwɔhyua
1Arelemgbunli mɔɔ wɔ Dwɔdan ne anzi mɔɔ di kɔ adɔleɛ azua ne mɔ mɔɔ gua awoka ne mɔ azo, nee mɔɔ gua awoka ne mɔ abo, nee mɔɔ gua Mɛdetɛlenia Nyevile ne anloa nee ye ɛbɔ nu mɔɔ kɔkpula Lɛbanɔn la dele Yizilayɛma konimlilɛ ne mɔ; arelemgbunli ɛhye mɔ a le Hɛte, Amɔle, Keena, Pɛlɛze, Haevae, yɛɛ Gyibɛse arelemgbunli ne mɔ. 2Bɛ muala bɛbɔle nuhua bɛvale adwenle ko kɛ bɛ nee Dwɔhyua nee Yizilayɛma kaho.
3Na Gebɛyɔnoma mɔɔ le Haevae asa azo la dele mɔɔ Dwɔhyua vale hilele Gyɛlekoma nee Eyaema la, 4bɛyiale nu bɛbɔle adwenle, bɛwulale aleɛ wɔ ahodoku mɔɔ ɛtete la anu, na bɛvale nza bɛguale nwanye ahodoku mɔɔ ɛyɛ dɛba na bɛteta nu la anu, na bɛvale bɛzoale bɛ asoaso ne mɔ. 5Bɛwulale adɛladeɛ mɔɔ ɛtete kpasakpasa nee mgbɔlaboa dɛba mɔɔ ɛtete na bɛsosɔ bɛ la. Aleɛ mɔɔ bɛvale bɛziale bɛ nwo la le reresee na eza bie mɔ ɛbɔ adubue. 6Akee bɛhɔle Yizilayɛma azokoɛleɛ ne wɔ Gelegale na bɛhɔzele Dwɔhyua nee Yizilayɛma kɛ, “Yɛvi moa kpalɛ a yɛra a. Yɛkulo kɛ bɛ nee yɛ yɛ ngyehyɛlɛ.”
7 Na Yizilayɛma bizale bɛ kɛ, “Duzu ati a yɛ nee bɛ ɛyɛ ngyehyɛlɛ a? Ɔkɛyɛ kɛ bɛde yɛ nwo ɛke ala bie.”
8Bɛbuale Dwɔhyua kɛ, “Yɛra kɛ yɛbazonle wɔ.”
Dwɔhyua bizale bɛ kɛ, “Bɛvi nienwu? Bɛmɛ a le nwane mɔ?”
9Na bɛhanle bɛhilele Dwɔhyua kɛ, “Yɛmenle, yɛvi moa kpalɛ a yɛra a, ɔboalekɛ yɛde Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne anwo edwɛkɛ. Yɛde mɔɔ ɔyɛle ye wɔ Yigyibiti la amuala, 10nee mɔɔ ɔvale ɔhilele Amɔle arelemgbunli nwiɔ ne mɔɔ wɔ Dwɔdan ne anzi mɔɔ di kɔ aduduleɛ la. Arelemgbunli ɛhye mɔ a le Saehɔn, mɔɔ le Hɛhyebɔn belemgbunli ne nee Ɔɔgo mɔɔ le Beehyan belemgbunli ne mɔɔ dɛnlanle Ahyetalo la. 11Yɛ mgbanyima ne mɔ nee maanle ne anu amra amuala ɛzoa yɛ kɛ yɛva aleɛ yɛzia yɛ nwo na yɛrayia bɛ, na yɛha yɛhile bɛ kɛ yɛle bɛ ngɛkɛlɛ, na ɛ nee yɛ ɛyɛ ngyehyɛlɛ. 12Nea yɛ kpanwo ne mɔ; yɛtu yɛ bo wɔ yɛ maanle nu la ɛnee bɛle wuluwulu. Noko nea kɛ bɛzi bɛyɛ reresee bie a; bɛbɔ adubue! 13Mɔɔ yɛgua nwanye ne wɔ nwoma ahodoku ɛhye mɔ anu la, ɛnee bɛle fofolɛ, noko nea kɛ bɛzi bɛkpukekpuke bɛmaa yɛteta nu bie a! Adenle ne mɔɔ wale la ati yɛ adɛladeɛ nee yɛ mgbɔlaboa ɛwie yɛ nwo tete.”
14Yizilayɛma ne liele nyɛvolɛ ne mɔ aleɛ ne bie lile wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛambiza Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛandie ɔ nloa edwɛkɛ la. 15Dwɔhyua nee Gebɛyɔnoma ne yɛle anzonudwolɛ ngyehyɛlɛ mɔɔ bamaa bɛadɛnla ngoane nu a. Yizilayɛma mgbanyinli ne mɔ hanle ndane kɛ bɛkɛli ngyehyɛlɛ ne azo.
16Bɛyɛle ngyehyɛlɛ ne la ye kenle nsa yɛɛ Yizilayɛma ne mɔ dele kɛ amuanrɛɛ menli ne de bɛ nwo ɛkɛ ne ala a. 17Yemɔti Yizilayɛma zile nu kɛ bɛkɔ ɛleka mɔɔ bɛwɔ la na ye kenle nsa ne azo bɛdwule azua ne mɔ mɔɔ menli zɔhane mɔ vi zolɛ rale la azo. Azua ne mɔ a le Gebɛyɔn, Kɛfaela, Biyɛlo, yɛɛ Keleate Gyialem. 18Noko Yizilayɛma angu bɛ, ɔboalekɛ bɛ mgbanyima ne mɔ ɛva Ɛdɛnkɛma mɔɔ le Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne ɛha ndane ɛyɛ ngyehyɛlɛ. Zɔhane ati Yizilayɛma amuala dendɛle bɛ nzo abo tiale bɛ mgbanyima ne mɔ wɔ ɛhye anwo. 19Mgbanyima ne mɔ zele kɛ, “Yɛva Ɛdɛnkɛma mɔɔ le Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne duma yɛha ndane yɛhile bɛ. Yemɔti bɛmmamaa yɛfa yɛ sa yɛka bɛ. 20Ɔlua yɛ ɛwɔkɛ mɔɔ yɛbɔ bɛ la ati, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛnyia bɛ ti. Saa yeanyɛ ye zɔhane a Nyamenle badea yɛ.” 21Na mgbanyima ne mɔ zuzule kɛ, “Bɛmaa bɛnyia bɛ ti na bɛzoa ɛyɛne nee nzule bɛmaa yɛ.” Yemɔti menli ne kponlenle na bɛmanle Gebɛyɔnoma zonlenle bɛ.
22Dwɔhyua manle bɛvɛlɛle Gebɛyɔnoma na ɔbizale bɛ kɛ, “Kɛmɔti yɛɛ bɛbɛlɛbɛla yɛ kɛ bɛvi moa a bɛrale a, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛzua yɛ nwo ɛke ala la ɛ? 23Mɔɔ bɛyɛ la, Nyamenle ɛbua bɛ ewule fɔlɛ ɛwie. Bɛ menli ne mɔ bayɛ ahanra dahuu azoa ɛyɛne nee nzule ahɔ me Nyamenle ne sua nu.”
24Bɛbuale kɛ, “Yɛyɛle ye zɔhane, ɔboalekɛ yɛnwunle kɛ ɔle nɔhalɛ kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne zele ye sonvolɛ Mosisi kɛ ɔva azɛlɛ ne amuala ɔmaa bɛ na bɛhu menli mɔɔ wɔ zolɛ la. Zɔhane ati ɛnee ɛzulolɛ kpalɛ kpalɛ ɛha yɛ; yɛsulo kɛ bɛkɛhu yɛ bɛkɛbɔ yɛ bo zo. 25Kɛkala, yɛwɔ bɛ sa nu; mɔɔ bɛdabɛ bɛnea a ɔle kpalɛ la, bɛva bɛyɛ yɛ.” 26Zɔhane ati Dwɔhyua bɔle bɛ nwo bane na yeammaa Yizilayɛma adenle yeammaa bɛangu bɛ. 27Na ɔyɛle bɛ ahanra ɔmanle bɛzoale ɛyɛne nee nzule bɛmanle Yizilayɛma na bɛvale bie bɛhɔle ɛleka mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma azukponle ne wɔ la. Ɛnɛ nee ɛnɛ ala bɛtɛdi zɔhane gyima ne wɔ ɛleka mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma kɛhile kɛ bɛzonle ye la.

Title: DWƆ 10
Content:
Bɛli Amɔlema anwo zo konim
1Gyɛlusalɛm Belemgbunli Adonaezidɛke dele kɛ Dwɔhyua ɛho ɛva Eyae, yebɔ sua ne bɔkɔɔ na yehu ye belemgbunli ne, kɛmɔ ɔyɛle Gyɛleko nee ye belemgbunli ne la. Eza ɔdele kɛ Gebɛyɔnoma nee Yizilayɛma ɛyɛ anzonudwolɛ ngyehyɛlɛ na ɔlua zolɛ Gebɛyɔnoma nee bɛ a de a. 2Ɛhye manle Gyɛlusalɛm belemgbunli ne zulole kpole, ɔboalekɛ Gebɛyɔn le suakpole mɔɔ zolɛ belemgbunli ne di munli a; ɔle kpole ɔtɛla Eyae yɛɛ eza ye menli ne mɔ ze konle nye zo kpalɛ. 3Yemɔti Adonaezidɛke vale nrɛlaleɛ hɔmanle Hibulɔn Belemgbunli Hoham, Gyaamutu Belemgbunli Paelam, Leekehye Belemgbunli Gyafaya, yɛɛ Ɛgelɔn Belemgbunli Dibɛ kɛ, 4“Gebɛyɔnoma nee Dwɔhyua yɛɛ Yizilayɛma ɛyɛ anzonudwolɛ ngyehyɛlɛ. Zɔhane ati bɛraboa me bɛmaa me nee Gebɛyɔnoma ɛhɔho.” 5Yemɔti Amɔle arelemgbunli nnu ɛhye mɔ, Gyɛlusalɛm, Hibulɔn, Gyaamutu, Leekehye, yɛɛ Ɛgelɔn bɔle nu bɔle yiale Gebɛyɔn na bɛtetale ye kɛ bɛ nee Gebɛyɔnoma ko.
6Gebɛyɔnoma zoanle manle bɛhɔzele Dwɔhyua wɔ Gelegale azokoɛleɛ ne kɛ, “Yɛmenle, mmaye yɛ ɛmaa! Bɛla ndɛndɛ baboa yɛ na die yɛ ngoane. Amɔle arelemgbunli mɔɔ wɔ awoka ne mɔ azo lɔ la ɛbɔ nu ɛra nee yɛ baho.”
7Na Dwɔhyua nee ye ɛlɔnema ne amuala, nee ye menli mɔɔ ze konle nye zo kpalɛ la zile nu vi Gelegale hɔle. 8Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Dwɔhyua kɛ, “Mmasulo bɛ na meva konimlilɛ memaa wɔ dɛbadɛba. Bɛ nuhua ko bɔbɔ ɛnrɛhola ɛ nyunlu gyinla.” 9Zɔhane ati Dwɔhyua nee ye ɛlɔnema ne zile nu nɔe ne; bɛvi Gelegale bɛgyi zolɛ toonwo bɛhɔdwule Gebɛyɔn na bɛhɔlile Amɔlema nvunu. 10Amɔlema nwunle Yizilayɛ ɛlɔnema ne la, Ɛdɛnkɛma manle ɛzulolɛ hanle bɛ na bɛ nye zo danle bɛ. Yizilayɛma hunle bɛ dɔɔnwo wɔ Gebɛyɔn ɛkɛ ne na bɛdoale bɛ ndinlizo, bɛlua Bɛte Hɔlɔn Boka ne ndololeɛ nu adenle zo toonwo bɛrale Azika nee Makidaa. 11Mekɛ mɔɔ Amɔlema nriandi Yizilayɛma wɔ Bɛte Hɔlɔn Boka ne ndololeɛ nu la, Ɛdɛnkɛma manle ezuawolɛ mgbole dɔle guale bɛ nwo zo toonwo bɛdwule Azika. Ezuawolɛ mgbole zɔhane mɔɔ dɔle la hunle Amɔlema dɔɔnwo dɛlale mɔɔ Yizilayɛma mumua ne hunle bɛ la.
12Kenle ko ne mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma vale konimlilɛ ne manle Yizilayɛma la, Dwɔhyua nee Ɛdɛnkɛma dendɛle. Wɔ Yizilayɛma amuala anyunlu, Dwɔhyua zele kɛ,
“Sɛnzɛne, mmatu ɛ bo ɛfi Gebɛyɔn,
Siane, gyinla koonwu wɔ Ayegyalɔn Bɔnza.”
13 Na sɛnzɛne ne gyinlanle yɛɛ siane ne andu ɔ bo hɔkpulale kɛ Yizilayɛma asa homonle bɛ kpɔvolɛma ne anwo zo la. Bɛhɛlɛ ɛhye wɔ Gyahya Buluku ne anu. Sɛnzɛne ne gyinlanle anwomanyunlu na yeandɔ kenle ko ne. 14Kenle zɔhane, bie ɛtɛsile ɛlɛ, yɛɛ ɔnrɛzi ɛlɛ, kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛle tieyɛ manle dasanli. Ɛdɛnkɛma ɔdaye a ɔhonle ɔmanle Yizilayɛma a.
15Ɛhye anzi, Dwɔhyua nee ye ɛlɔnema ne ziale hɔle bɛ azokoɛleɛ ne wɔ Gelegale.
Dwɔhyua kye Amɔle arelemgbunli nnu ne
16Amɔle arelemgbunli nnu ne nriandile la, bɛhɔveale bolɛ bɔne bie anu wɔ Makidaa. 17Awie mɔ nwunle bɛ na bɛhɔhanle bɛhilele Dwɔhyua kɛ, “Yɛnwu kɛ Amɔle arelemgbunli nnu ne vea bolɛ bɔne bie anu wɔ Makidaa.” 18Na Dwɔhyua zele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛhundo awolɛ mgbole bɛnyi bɔne ne. Bɛmaa menli ɛzinza ɛkɛ ne 19na bɛmɛ, bɛmmatɛnla ɛkɛ. Bɛdoa bɛ kpɔvolɛma ne na bɛbu bɛ nzi bɛ nee bɛ ɛho; bɛmmamaa bɛkɔ bɛ azua ne mɔ azo. Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne ɛye bɛ ɛmaa kɛ bɛli bɛ nwo zo konim.” 20Dwɔhyua nee Yizilayɛ ɛlɔnema ne hunle Amɔlema dɔɔnwo kpalɛ, mɔɔ asɛɛ bɛ bo zo ɛbɔ bɔkɔɔ a. Menli mɔɔ bɛ sa anga bɛ la a le bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛziale bɛhɔveale suakpole ne azo la. 21Akee Dwɔhyua menli ne mɔ ziale rale ɔ nwo ɛkɛ ne wɔ Makidaa azokoɛleɛ ne.
Awie biala ɛnle maanle ne anu mɔɔ dendɛle tiale Yizilayɛma a.
22Akee Dwɔhyua zele kɛ, “Bɛdukue bɔne ne na bɛva arelemgbunli nnu ne bɛrɛla ɛke.” 23Zɔhane ati bɛdukuele bɔne ne na bɛvale Gyɛlusalɛm, Hibulɔn, Gyaamutu, Leekehye, yɛɛ Ɛgelɔn arelemgbunli ne mɔ bɛvindele. 24Bɛvale bɛ bɛrɛlɛle Dwɔhyua. Dwɔhyua vɛlɛle Yizilayɛ ɛlɔnema ne amuala na ɔzele bɛ safohyenlema ne mɔɔ nee bɛ a hɔle la kɛ bɛva bɛ gyakɛ bɛtietia arelemgbunli ne mɔ akɔme zo. Na bɛyɛle ye zɔhane. 25Akee Dwɔhyua zele safohyenlema ne kɛ, “Bɛmmasulo yɛɛ bɛmmamaa bɛ nwo bubu bɛ. Bɛgyinla ye mrenya zo na bɛmaa bɛ nwo ɛyɛ se, ɔluakɛ ɛhye yɛɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma bava ayɛ bɛ kpɔvolɛma mɔɔ bɛ nee bɛ baho la a.” 26Nzinlii akee Dwɔhyua hunle arelemgbunli ne mɔ na ɔhendɛhendanle bɛ wɔ mbaka nnu azo; bɛhendanle zolɛ toonwo nɔsolɛ. 27Mɔɔ sɛnzɛne ne ɛlɛkɔ ahɔdɔ la, Dwɔhyua manle bɛyeyele avunli ne mɔ na bɛvuandinle bɛ bɛguale bɔne ne mɔɔ ɛnee bɛvea nu la anu. Bɛhundole awolɛ mgbole bɛduale bɔne ne, na ɛnɛ nee ɛnɛ ala ɔtɛbɔ ɛkɛ.
Dwɔhyua ko ava Amɔle maanle ne dɔɔnwo
28Kenle ko ne Dwɔhyua honle vale Makidaa na ɔhyele ye belemgbunli ne ɔhunle ye nee awie biala mɔɔ wɔ suakpole ne azo la; ko bɔbɔ anga. Ɔyɛle Makidaa belemgbunli ne kɛ mɔɔ ɔyɛle Gyɛleko belemgbunli ne la.
29Ɛhye anzi, Dwɔhyua nee ye ɛlɔnema ne vi Makidaa hɔle Lebena na ɔ nee Lebenama hɔhonle. 30Ɛdɛnkɛma manle Yizilayɛma lile konim na bɛvale suakpole ne na bɛhyele belemgbunli ne noko. Bɛangyakyi sonla ko bɔbɔ; bɛhunle bɛ muala. Na Dwɔhyua yɛle belemgbunli ne kɛ mɔɔ ɔyɛle Gyɛleko belemgbunli ne la.
31Ɛhye anzi, Dwɔhyua nee ye ɛlɔnema ne vile Lebena hɔle Leekehye. Bɛbɔle bɛyiale suakpole ne na bɛtetale ye bɛ nee menli mɔɔ wɔ zolɛ la honle. 32Ye kenle nwiɔ ne azo Ɛdɛnkɛma manle Yizilayɛma lile Leekehyema anwo zo konim. Kɛmɔ bɛyɛle ye wɔ Lebena la, bɛangyakyi sonla ko bɔbɔ. Bɛhunle awie biala mɔɔ wɔ suakpole ne azo la. 33Belemgbunli Hɔlam mɔɔ vi Gizɛ la rale kɛ ɔbaboa Leekehyema, na Dwɔhyua bɛlɛle ye nee ye ɛlɔnema ne aze na ɔhunle bɛ muala; ko bɔbɔ anga.
34Bieko, Dwɔhyua nee ye ɛlɔnema ne vile Leekehye hɔle Ɛgelɔn; bɛbɔle bɛyiale ye na bɛtetale ɔdaye noko. 35Bɛhonle bɛvale ye wɔ kenle ko ne ala na bɛhunle awie biala kɛ mɔɔ bɛyɛle ye wɔ Leekehye la.
36Ɛhye anzi, Dwɔhyua nee ye ɛlɔnema ne vile Ɛgelɔn na bɛhɔle Hibulɔn, wɔ awoka ne mɔ azo lɔ; bɛtetale ye bɛ nee sua ne azo amra honle 37na bɛvale. Bɛhunle belemgbunli ne nee awie biala mɔɔ wɔ suakpole ne azo la; bɛzɛkyele azua mɔɔ bikye suakpole ne la. Dwɔhyua zɛkyele suakpole ne bɔkɔɔ kɛ mɔɔ ɔyɛle Ɛgelɔn la. Sonla ko bɔbɔ anga.
38Akee Dwɔhyua nee ye ɛlɔnema ne ziale bɛ nzi hɔtetale Dibɛ ɔ nee sua ne azo amra honle. 39Ɔvale sua ne na ɔhyele ye belemgbunli ne. Eza ɔvale azua mɔɔ zuozua suakpole ne la. Bɛhunle awie biala mɔɔ wɔ azua ne mɔ azo la. Dwɔhyua yɛle Dibɛ nee ye belemgbunli ne kɛ mɔɔ ɔyɛle Hibulɔn yɛɛ Lebena nee bɛ arelemgbunli ne mɔ la.
40Dwɔhyua honle vale maanle ne amuala. Arelemgbunli mɔɔ wɔ maanle ne anu awoka ne mɔ azo, nee mɔɔ wɔ aduduleɛ ndololeɛ ne mɔ anu, nee mɔɔ wɔ adɔleɛ awoka ne mɔ azo, nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ nyiakɛ maanle ne mɔ anu la amuala; yeanvavi sonla ko bɔbɔ; ɔhunle awie biala, kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne zele kɛ bɛyɛ la. 41Dwɔhyua honle vale maanle maanle ne mɔ; ɔbɔle ɔ bo ɔvile Keedɛhye Baanɛya wɔ nyiakɛ nehane ɔhɔkpulale Gaza mɔɔ bikye nyevile ne anloa la, nee Gohyɛn azɛlɛ ne sɔlɔ, ɔhɔkpulale Gebɛyɔn. 42Dwɔhyua lile arelemgbunli ɛhye mɔ amuala anwo zo konim, ɔvale bɛ azɛlɛ ne, ɔboalekɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne, honle manle Yizilayɛma. 43Ɛhye anzi, Dwɔhyua nee ye ɛlɔnema ne akee ziale rale bɛ azokoɛleɛ ne wɔ Gelegale.

Title: DWƆ 11
Content:
Dwɔhyua di Gyeeben nee ye ɛlɔne nu agɔnwolɛma anwo zo konim
1Mekɛ mɔɔ Belemgbunli Gyeeben mɔɔ vi Heezɔ la dele Yizilayɛma konimlilɛ ne mɔ la, ɔdule ɛbɔfoɔ ɔmanle ɔhɔle Belemgbunli Dwobabe mɔɔ wɔ Meedɔn la ɛkɛ. Ɛbɔfoɔ eza hɔle Hyemelɔn belemgbunli ne nee Akehyafe belemgbunli ne mɔ ɛkɛ; 2ɛbɔfoɔ ne bie mɔ hɔle arelemgbunli mɔɔ wɔ maanle ne sɔlɔ awoka ne mɔ azo, Dwɔdan Bɔnza ne anu wɔ Galeli Tandane ne nyiakɛ, awoka ne mɔ abo nee ɛnweanloa toonwo asɛɛ Dɔɔ la amuala ɛkɛ ne. 3Ɛbɔfoɔ ne bie mɔ noko hɔle Keenama mɔɔ wɔ aduduleɛ nee adɔleɛ la, Amɔlema, Hɛtema, Pɛlɛzema, yɛɛ Gyibɛsema mɔɔ de Hɛmɔn Boka ne ndololeɛ nu wɔ Mezepa azɛlɛ zo la ɛkɛ ne. 4Na arelemgbunli ɛhye mɔ amuala vale bɛ ɛlɔnema mɔɔ bɛ somaa kɛyɛ kɛ ɛnweazo anwea la rale. Bɛlɛ bɛ mgbɔnwɔ nee konle ehwili dɔɔnwo. 5Bɛ muala bɛbɔle nu bɛrayɛle azokoɛleɛ wɔ Milɔm Azule kɛ bɛ nee Yizilayɛma baho.
6Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Dwɔhyua kɛ, “Mmasulo bɛ. Ɛhyema bekezɛ ɛnee memaa Yizilayɛma ɛhu bɛ muala. Ɛbabubu mgbɔnwɔ ne mɔ ndwɛlɛ na wɔayela bɛ konle ehwili ne mɔ.” 7Zɔhane ati Dwɔhyua nee ye ɛlɔnema ne hɔle bɛ nwo zo arɛlevilɛ nu wɔ Milɔm Azule na bɛ nee bɛ honle. 8Ɛdɛnkɛma manle Yizilayɛma lile konim. Yizilayɛma voanle bɛ toonwo bɛhɔdwule Mezelɛfo Meeyem nee Saedɛn, toonwo bɛhɔdwule Mezepa Bɔnza ne anu wɔ aduduleɛ nehane. Na bɛhonle toonwo Yizilayɛma wiele bɛ kpɔvolɛma ne amuala ku. 9Dwɔhyua yɛle bɛ kɛ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma zele ye ala la; ɔbubule bɛ mgbɔnwɔ ne mɔ ndwɛlɛ na ɔyelale bɛ konle ehwili ne mɔ.
10Akee Dwɔhyua ziale ɔ nzi ravale Heezɔ na ɔhunle belemgbunli ne. (Mekɛ ne anu ɛnee Heezɔ amra a yɛ se kpole kpalɛ wɔ maanle ne mɔ anu a.) 11Bɛhunle awie biala; ko bɔbɔ anga, na bɛyelale suakpole ne.
12Dwɔhyua vale azuamgbole ne mɔ amuala, ɔhunle arelemgbunli ne mɔ, ɔhunle menli mɔɔ wɔ zolɛ la amuala, kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma sonvolɛ Mosisi zele la. 13Yizilayɛma anyela azua mɔɔ wɔ awoka ngyikyi ne mɔ azo la, Heezɔ ala a Dwɔhyua yelale ye a. 14Yizilayɛma ne vale ninyɛne mɔɔ anwo hyia nee nyɛmoa mɔɔ wɔ azuamgbole ne mɔ azo la. Na bɛhunle awie biala; ko bɔbɔ anga. 15Kɛmɔ Nyamenle zele ye sonvolɛ Mosisi kɛ ɔyɛ la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ Mosisi hanle hilele Dwɔhyua kɛ ɔyɛ a, yɛɛ Dwɔhyua noko lile zolɛ. Ɔyɛle debie biala mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi kɛ ɔyɛ la.
Maanle mɔɔ Dwɔhyua honle vale la
16Dwɔhyua vale azɛlɛ ne amuala, azɛlɛ mɔɔ wɔ awoka ne mɔ azo nee bɛ ndololeɛ nu, maanle ne sɔlɔ nee ye nyiakɛ, Gohyɛn azɛlɛ ne nee azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ la ye nyiakɛ, nee Dwɔdan Bɔnza ne kɔsɔɔti. 17-18Azɛlɛ ne anloa vi Halake Boka wɔ nyiakɛ afoa nu mɔɔ bikye Yidɔm la toonwo ɔdwu Beeyalegade sɔlɔ wɔ Lɛbanɔn bɔnza ne mɔɔ la Hɛmɔn Boka la nyiakɛ. 19Suakpole mɔɔ nee Yizilayɛ yɛle anzonudwolɛ ngyehyɛlɛ la a le Gebɛyɔn, ɛleka mɔɔ Haevaema de la. Mɔɔ hale la, bɛluale konle nu a bɛhanle bɛ aze a. Dwɔhyua nee arelemgbunli mɔɔ wɔ azɛlɛ ne azo la honle hyɛle, noko ɔhyele bɛ kɔsɔɔti ɔhunle bɛ. 20 Ɛdɛnkɛma a yɛle bɛ zɔhane manle bɛ nee Yizilayɛma honle, amaa ɔlua zo bɛabua bɛ fɔlɛ, bɛahu bɛ, bɛabɔ bɛ bo zo bɔkɔɔ mɔɔ anwunvɔnezelɛ biala ɛnle nu a. Kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi kɛ ɔyɛ la ɛne.
21Mekɛ ɛhye anu ala Dwɔhyua hɔle hɔzɛkyele kakanyinlima ekpunli bie mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ bɛ Anakema mɔɔ wɔ maanle ne anu awoka ne mɔ azo la. Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ Hibulɔn, Dibɛ, Anabe yɛɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ Dwuda awoka ne mɔ azo nee Yizilayɛ maanle ne anu la, Dwɔhyua hunle bɛ muala na ɔzɛkyele bɛ azuamgbole ne mɔ. 22Anakema sonla ko bɔbɔ anga Yizilayɛ azɛlɛ zo. Ekyi bie a hale Gaza, Gate, yɛɛ Ahyedɔdo a.
23Dwɔhyua vale azɛlɛ ne amuala, kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi la. Dwɔhyua vale azɛlɛ ne manle Yizilayɛma kɛ bɛ ɛdeɛ ɔ na bɛdɛnla zolɛ. Ɔhyɛle nu ngyebangyeba ɔmanle Yizilayɛ mbusua ekpunli ekpunli ne mɔ.
Akee Yizilayɛma liele bɛ ɛnwomenle na bɛgyakyile konle.

Title: DWƆ 12
Content:
Arelemgbunli mɔɔ Mosisi lile bɛ nwo zo konim la
1 Mekɛ ne anu ɛnee Yizilayɛma ɛho ɛva azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ la Dwɔdan aduduleɛ la, ɔvi Anɔn Bɔnza ɔlua Dwɔdan Bɔnza ne anloa toonwo ɔkɔdwu azɛlɛ ne sɔlɔ wɔ Hɛmɔn Boka. Arelemgbunli nwiɔ yɛɛ bɛlile bɛ nwo zo konim a. 2Ko a le Saehɔn, mɔɔ le Amɔle belemgbunli ne mɔɔ ɛnee de Hɛhyebɔn la. Geleade azɛlɛ ne foa ko boka ye belemgbunli maanle ne anwo, ɔvi Alowɛ (mɔɔ la Azule Anɔn Bɔnza la anloa) nee suakpole ne mɔɔ wɔ bɔnza zɔhane avinli la, toonwo ɔkɔkpula Azule Gyeebɔko mɔɔ la Amɔlema ɛweɛne zo la. 3Dwɔdan Bɔnza, ɔvi Galeli Tandane ne nyiakɛ, ɔkɔ Bɛte Gyɛhyemo (mɔɔ la Nyevile Ngyenle anzɛɛ Nyevile Wulera ne aduduleɛ) toonwo mɔɔ kɔgua ye Pesega Boka ne abo la boka Belemgbunli Saehɔn maanle ne anwo.
4Eza bɛlile Belemgbunli Ɔɔgo mɔɔ wɔ Beehyan la anwo zo konim. Belemgbunli Ɔɔgo le menli bie mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ bɛ Relɛfeeyemma mɔɔ ɛnee bɛ bo ɛdu la anu ko. Ɔɔgo lile ye ebia ne wɔ Ahyetalo nee Ɛdelɛyae. 5Hɛmɔn Boka, Salika, yɛɛ Beehyan azɛlɛ ne amuala kɔgua Gɛhyɛ nee Meeyaka ɛweɛne ne mɔ azo, Geleade azɛlɛ ne foa ko mɔɔ kɔkpula Belemgbunli Saehɔn mɔɔ wɔ Hɛhyebɔn la azɛlɛ ne ɛweɛne zo la amuala boka Belemgbunli Ɔɔgo maanle ne anwo.
6 Ɛdɛnkɛma sonvolɛ Mosisi nee Yizilayɛma a lile arelemgbunli nwiɔ ɛhye mɔ anwo zo konim a. Na Ɛdɛnkɛma sonvolɛ Mosisi vale bɛ azɛlɛ ne mɔ manle Wulubɛn nee Gaade mbusua ekpunli ne mɔ kɛ bɛva bɛyɛ bɛ ɛdeɛ.
Arelemgbunli mɔɔ Dwɔhyua lile bɛ nwo zo konim la
7Dwɔhyua nee Yizilayɛma noko lile arelemgbunli mɔɔ wɔ Dwɔdan adɔleɛ azɛlɛ ne azo la anwo zo konim, ɔvi Beeyalegade mɔɔ wɔ Lɛbanɔn Bɔnza ne anu la, kɔdwu Halake Boka ne azo wɔ nyiakɛ afoa nu mɔɔ bikye Yidɔm la. Dwɔhyua hyɛle azɛlɛ ne manle Yizilayɛ mbusua ekpunli ekpunli ne mɔ na ɔmanle ɔyɛle bɛ ɛdeɛ bɔkɔɔ. 8Azɛlɛ ɛhye la awoka ne mɔ azo, ɔlua adɔleɛ awoka ngyikyi ne mɔ azo, Dwɔdan Bɔnza nee ye awoka ngyikyi ne mɔ, aduduleɛ ndololeɛ ne anu ɔba ɛsɛlɛ ne mɔɔ wɔ nyiakɛ la azo. Menli mɔɔ anrɛɛ de azɛlɛ ɛhye azo la a le Hɛtema, Amɔlema, Keenama, Pɛlɛzema, Haevaema, yɛɛ Gyibɛsema. 9Yizilayɛma lile arelemgbunli mɔɔ wɔ azuamgbole ɛhye mɔ azo la anwo zo konim: Gyɛleko, Eyae (mɔɔ zua Bɛtɛle la), 10Gyɛlusalɛm, Hibulɔn, 11Gyaamutu, Leekehye, 12Ɛgelɔn, Gizɛ, 13Dibɛ, Gidɛ, 14Hɔɔma, Ɛlade, 15Lebena, Adulam, 16Makidaa, Bɛtɛle, 17Tapua, Hifɛ, 18Efɛke, Lahyalɔn, 19Meedɔn, Heezɔ, 20Hyemelɔn Milɔn, Akehyafe, 21Teeyanake, Mɛgedo, 22Kidɛhye, Dwɔkenɛyam (mɔɔ wɔ Kamɛle la), 23Dɔɔ (mɔɔ wɔ ɛnweanloa la), Goyem (mɔɔ wɔ Galeli la) 24yɛɛ Tɛza. Bɛ muala bɛlua arelemgbunli abulasa nee ko.

Title: DWƆ 13
Content:
Azɛlɛ mɔɔ ɛha mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ Yizilayɛma die la
1Dwɔhyua akee ɛli ɛvolɛ dɔɔnwo na yeyɛ kpanyinli kpalɛ. Ɛdɛnkɛma zele ye kɛ, “Wɔnyi, wɔli ɛvolɛ dɔɔnwo, noko azɛlɛ dɔɔnwo tɛbɔ ɛkɛ mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛfa bɛyɛ bɛ ɛdeɛ a. 2Azɛlɛ zɛhae mɔ tɛbɔ ɛkɛ: Filisitiama nee Gɛhyɔnoma azɛlɛ ne amuala, 3nee Evem azɛlɛ ne (mɔɔ vi azudenle Saehɔn ne anloa wɔ Yigyibiti aduduleɛ, ɔlua ɛbɔ nu ɔkɔdwu Ɛkelɔn ɛweɛne zo, mɔɔ bɛfa ye kɛ ɔle Keenama azɛlɛ la; Filisitia arelemgbunli nnu dɛnlanle Gaza, Ahyedɔdo, Ahyekɛlɔn, Gate, yɛɛ Ɛkelɔn). 4Keenama azɛlɛ ne amuala yɛɛ Mɛɛla (mɔɔ le Saedɛnema azɛlɛ la) toonwo mɔɔ kɔdwu Efɛke wɔ Amɔlema ɛweɛne zo; 5Gibale azɛlɛ ne, Lɛbanɔn azɛlɛ ne amuala mɔɔ di kɔ aduduleɛ, ɔvi Beeyalegade wɔ Hɛmɔn Boka ne nyiakɛ ɔfinde Heemate Ademgbolezo; 6 Saedɛnema mɔɔ de awoka ne mɔ azo la azɛlɛ ne, ɔvi Lɛbanɔn awoka ne mɔ anu mɔɔ kɔdwu Mezelɛfo Meeyem la amuala. Medame mebadu bɛ muala meavi azɛlɛ ne azo na meava meamaa Yizilayɛma. Ɔwɔ kɛ ɛkyɛ azɛlɛ ne ɛmaa Yizilayɛma, kɛmɔ meha mehile wɔ kɛ ɛyɛ la. 7Kyɛ azɛlɛ ɛhye maa mbusua ngɔnla ne nee Manasɛ abusua ekpunli ne foa ko ne maa ɔyɛ bɛ ɛdeɛ bɔkɔɔ.”
Azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ la Dwɔdan Aduduleɛ la ɛhyɛlɛ
8 Wulubɛn nee Gaade mbusua ekpunli ne mɔ nee Manasɛ abusua ekpunli foa ko ne asa hanle azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ wɔ Azule Dwɔdan ne aduduleɛ la. Mosisi a vale manle bɛ a. 9Bɛ azɛlɛ ne tɛlɛ dwu Alowɛ (wɔ Anɔn Bɔnza ne anloa) nee suakpole ne mɔɔ wɔ bɔnza ne avinli la, nee Midɛba boka ne mɔɔ azo le sɛsɛ la toonwo mɔɔ kɔdwu Daebɔn la. 10Ɔkɔ toonwo ɔkɔdwu Amɔnoma ɛweɛne zo yɛɛ azuamgbole mɔɔ Amɔle belemgbunli Saehɔn ziele bɛ la. Belemgbunli zɔhane dɛnlanle Hɛhyebɔn. 11Geleade, Gɛhyɛ, yɛɛ Meeyaka azɛlɛ ne, Hɛmɔn Boka, yɛɛ Beehyan mɔɔ kɔ Salika la, 12Belemgbunli Ɔɔgo, mɔɔ ɔ ngome a ɔhale Relɛfeeyem menli ekpunli ne anu, na ɔlile belemgbunli wɔ Ahyetalo nee Ɛdelɛyae la belemgbunli maanle ne boka nwolɛ. Mosisi lile menli ɛhye mɔ anwo zo konim na ɔvoanle bɛ. 13Noko Yizilayɛma anvoa Gɛhyɛma nee Meeyakama; kɛkala bɔbɔ bɛtɛte Yizilayɛma avinli.
14 Mosisi anva azɛlɛ ammaa Livae abusua ekpunli ne. Kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi la, bɛ afoa nu ɛdeɛ a le azubɔlɛ ninyɛne ne mɔɔ bɛyela bɛabɔ azu bɛamaa Yizilayɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle ne la anu bie.
Wulubɛn azɛlɛ ɛdeɛ ne
15Mosisi vale azɛlɛ ne manle Wulubɛn abusua ekpunli ne, kɛmɔ bɛ mrɛladane ne mɔ de la kɛ ɔle bɛ ɛdeɛ. 16Bɛ azɛlɛ ne anloa pɛ Alowɛ (wɔ Anɔn Bɔnza ne anloa) nee suakpole ne mɔɔ wɔ bɔnza ne avinli la, nee azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ wɔ boka azo sɛsɛ ne mɔɔ bikye Midɛba la azo. 17Hɛhyebɔn nee azuamgbole ne mɔ mɔɔ gua boka azo sɛsɛ ne azo: Daebɔn, Beemo-beeyale, yɛɛ Bɛte Beeyalemiyɔn amuala boka nwolɛ. 18Akee Gyeehaze, Kidɛmo, Mɛfeeyate, 19Keleateeyem, Sebema, Zɛlɛte Hyeehaa mɔɔ wɔ bɔnza ne anzi boka ne azo la, 20Bɛtepiyɔ. Pesega Boka ne ndololeɛ nu nee Bɛte Gyɛhyemo; 21azuamgbole mɔɔ wɔ boka azo sɛsɛ ne azo la amuala, nee Belemgbunli Saehɔn mɔɔ le Amɔlenli ne mɔɔ dɛnlanle Hɛhyebɔn la belemgbunli maanle ne amuala. Mosisi lile Belemgbunli Saehɔn anwo zo konim, ɔlile Medean arelemgbunli mɔɔ le Yivae Rilikɛm, Zuuli, Huuli, yɛɛ Riliba noko anwo zo konim. Menli ɛhye mɔ nleanle azɛlɛ ne manle Belemgbunli Saehɔn. 22Biyɔ mɔɔ bɔ menli munzule la ara Beelam ɔdaye ɔboka menli mɔɔ Yizilayɛma hunle bɛ la anwo. 23Azule Dwɔdan ne a le Wulubɛn abusua ekpunli ne adɔleɛ ɛweɛne a. Azuamgbole nee azua ngyikyi ɛhye mɔ a bɛvale bɛmanle Wulubɛn abusua ekpunli ne anu amra kɛ bɛva bɛ bɔkɔɔ a.
Gaade azɛlɛ ɛdeɛ ne
24Mosisi eza vale azɛlɛ ne bie manle Gaade abusua ekpunli ne kɛ bɛva. 25Bɛ azɛlɛ ne fa Gyeezɛ nee Geleade azuamgbole ne mɔ amuala, Amɔnoma azɛlɛ ne foa ko toonwo kɔkpula Alowɛ wɔ Relaba aduduleɛ afoa nu. 26Azɛlɛ ne eza bɔ ye wɔ Hɛhyebɔn, ɔtɛlɛ ɔkɔ Releemate Mezepa nee Bɛtonem, ɔvi Meehaneeyem ɔkɔ Lodiba ɛweɛne zo. 27Wɔ Dwɔdan Bɔnza ne anu noko, Bɛte Hɛlam, Bɛtenemela, Sɛko, yɛɛ Zeefɔn boka nwolɛ. Ɛhye mɔ a le Belemgbunli Saehɔn mɔɔ wɔ Hɛhyebɔn la belemgbunli maanle ne mɔɔ ɛha la a. Bɛ adɔleɛ ɛweɛne ne a le Azule Dwɔdan ne mɔɔ kɔkpula Galeli sɔlɔ la. 28Azuamgbole nee ngyikyi mɔɔ bɛvale bɛmanle Gaade abusua ekpunli ne kɛ bɛva la ɛne.
Manasɛ Aduduleɛ azɛlɛ ɛdeɛ ne
29Mosisi eza vale azɛlɛ ne bie manle Manasɛ abusua ekpunli foa ko ne mɔɔ ɛha la kɛ bɛ ɛdeɛ ɔ. 30Bɛ azɛlɛ ne tɛlɛ dwu Meehaneeyem nee Beehyan, ɔfa Belemgbunli Ɔɔgo mɔɔ de Beehyan la maanle ne, yɛɛ Gyeeyɛɛ namunamu abulasia ne amuala. 31Geleade azɛlɛ ne foa ko, Ahyetalo, yɛɛ Ɛdelɛyae mɔɔ le Beehyan Belemgbunli Ɔɔgo azuamgbole wɔ ye maanle ne anu la boka nwolɛ. Bɛvale ɛhye mɔ amuala bɛmanle Manasɛ abusua ekpunli foa ko ne mɔɔ le ɔ ra Meekɛ asa azo la.
32Mekɛ mɔɔ Mosisi wɔ ɛsɛlɛ ne azo wɔ Mowabe la yɛɛ ɔhyɛle azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ wɔ Gyɛleko aduduleɛ nee Dwɔdan la a. 33 Na Mosisi anva azɛlɛ biala ammaa Livae abusua ekpunli ne. Ɔzele bɛ kɛ Yizilayɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle ne a le bɛ agyadeɛ a.

Title: DWƆ 14
Content:
Dwɔdan Adɔleɛ azɛlɛ ne ɛhyɛlɛ
1Akee kɛ bɛzile bɛhyɛle Keena azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ wɔ Dwɔdan Adɔleɛ bɛmanle Yizilayɛma la ɛne. Sɛlɛvolɛ Ɛlieza nee Nɛn ara Dwɔhyua yɛɛ Yizilayɛ mbusua ekpunli ekpunli ne anu mgbanyima mɔɔ gyigyi bɛ ti la a hyɛle azɛlɛ ne manle Yizilayɛma a. 2 Kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi la, bɛguale azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ la Dwɔdan Adɔleɛ la anwo nzeleba a bɛhyɛle a. 3-4 Azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ la Dwɔdan Aduduleɛ la, Mosisi hyɛle manle Yizilayɛma mbusua ekpunli nwiɔ nee foa ne dɛba. (Dwosefi abusua ekpunli ne bɛhyɛle nu nwiɔ: Manasɛ yɛɛ Yifelaem.) Livae abusua ekpunli ne ɛdeɛ, Mosisi manle bɛmanle bɛ azuamgbole nee azɛlɛ mɔɔ bɛdidi zolɛ, bɛsie bɛ mboane nee nlankɛ zolɛ la kɛ bɛdɛnla zo, na bɛammaa bɛ azɛlɛ kpalɛ biala. 5Yizilayɛma hyɛle azɛlɛ ne, kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma hanle hilele Mosisi la.
Bɛva Hibulɔn bɛmaa Kalɛbe
6 Kenle ko Dwuda abusua ekpunli ne anu amra ne bie mɔ rale Dwɔhyua anwo ɛkɛ ne wɔ Gelegale. Na Kalɛbe mɔɔ ɔ ze a le Gyɛfɛni mɔɔ le Kinɛzenli la zele Dwɔhyua kɛ, “Ɛze mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma hanle wɔ Keedɛhye Baanɛya hilele Nyamenle sonvolɛ Mosisi, mɔɔ fane me nee ɛ nwo la. 7 Menlile ɛvolɛ abulanla la yɛɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma sonvolɛ Mosisi zoanle me kɛ mevi Keedɛhye Baanɛya membɛla maanle ɛhye anu memanli azɛlɛ ye azo busia menea a. Menyɛle ye zɔhane na menvale nwolɛ edwɛkɛ nɔhalɛ nu mengɔmanle ye. 8Menli mɔɔ nee me hɔle la manle yɛ menli ne mɔ ahonle dule. Noko nɔhalɛ nu, menyɛle tieyɛ memanle Ɛdɛnkɛma me Nyamenle ne. 9 Na Kɛmɔ menyɛle zɔhane la ati, Mosisi bɔle me ɛwɔkɛ kɛ me nee me mra yɛbanyia azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ mengɔle zolɛ la kɛ ɔle yɛ ɛdeɛ. 10Na kɛkala, nea, Ɛdɛnkɛma hanle edwɛkɛ ɛhye hilele Mosisi la ye ɛvolɛ abulanla nee nnu ɛne. Mekɛ ne anu ɛnee Yizilayɛma lua ɛsɛlɛ ne azo, yɛɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛmaa medɛnla ngoane nu toonwo yeradwu ɛnɛ; kɛkala meli ɛvolɛ abulatwɛ nee nnu. 11Kɛkala bɔbɔ, me nwo tɛyɛ se kɛ mekɛ mɔɔ Mosisi zoanle me la. Me nwo tɛyɛ se wɔ konle nee debie biala ɛyɛlɛ nu. 12Yemɔti fa azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ wɔ awoka ne mɔ azo lɔ la maa me. Ɛdɛnkɛma vale bɔle me ɛwɔkɛ wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ me nee me menli ne yɛrale la. Yɛhanle yɛhilele wɔ kɛ menli kakanyinli bie mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ bɛ ‘Anakema’ la wɔ maanle ne anu, na bɛdede azuamgbole mɔɔ bɛlie nwolɛ bane la azo. Ɛdɛnkɛma baboa me yeamaa meavoa bɛ, kɛmɔ ɔdaye yeha la.”
13Dwɔhyua yilale Gyɛfɛni ara Kalɛbe na ɔvale suakpole Hibulɔn ɔmanle ye kɛ ye agyadeɛ ɔ. 14Kɛkala, Hibulɔn tɛde Kalɛbe abo zo amra ɛdeɛ. Gyɛfɛni le Kinɛzenli. Kalɛbe yɛle tieyɛ manle Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne. 15Hibulɔn duma dɛba a le Aabasuazo (Aaba anrɛɛ le sonla mɔɔ anwo yɛ se kpole kpalɛ wɔ Anakema anu).
Na anzonudwolɛ akee rale maanle ne anu.

Title: DWƆ 15
Content:
Azɛlɛ mɔɔ bɛvale bɛmanle Dwuda la
1Dwuda abusua ekpunli ne nyianle azɛlɛ ɛhye: ɔwɔ mɔɔ kɔne nyevile nu la na ɔdwu Zen ɛsɛlɛ ne anloa wɔ ye nyiakɛ kpalɛ ɔkɔkpula Yidɔm ɛweɛne zo. 2Ye nyiakɛ ɛweɛne ne vi Nyevile Ngyenle ne nyiakɛ ebolo ne anloa ɔkɔ aze. 3Ɔvi Akelabem Bɔnza ne nyiakɛ ɔkɔ toonwo ɔkɔdwu Zen, ɔlua Keedɛhye Baanɛya nyiakɛ, ɔpɛ nu Hɛzelɔn, ɔfo ɔkɔ Edaa, ɔbele ɔkɔ Kaakaa, 4ɔkɔ Azemɔn, ɔlua azudenle ne mɔɔ wɔ Yigyibiti ɛweɛne zo la anloa toonwo ɔkɔgua ye Mɛdetɛlenia Nyevile ne anloa. Ɛnee Dwuda azɛlɛ ne, ye nyiakɛ ɛweɛne ne ɛne.
5Aduduleɛ ɛweɛne ne a le Nyevile Ngyenle ne, ɔkɔ toonwo ɔkɔdwu tandane ne anu ebolo ne mɔɔ Dwɔdan ne se gua nu la anloa.
Sɔlɔ ɛweɛne ne bɔ ɔ bo wɔ ebolo ɛhye anu, 6ɔlua Bɛte Hɔgela, ɔfa ye boka tɛtɛlɛ ne mɔɔ keda Dwɔdan Bɔnza ne azo la anwo. Akee ɔfa ye ɛkɛ ne ɔkɔ ye anwuma, ɔkɔdwu Bohan Bolɛ ne anwo (Bohan le Wulubɛn ara), 7ɔvi Ngyegyelɛ Bɔnza ɔkɔ Dibɛ, na yeabele ye ɛbɔ nu yeavinde Gelegale ɛleka mɔɔ nee Adɛmem anye bɔ zolɛ la, wɔ bɔnza ne nyiakɛ. Akee ɔlua Ɛnhyimɛhye azule ne anloa, ɔdwu Ɛnlogɛle. 8Akee ɛweɛne ne dua Henɛm Bɔnza wɔ boka ne mɔɔ bɛkyekyele Gyibɛsema suakpole Gyɛlusalɛm zolɛ la nyiakɛ. Ɛweɛne ne akee kɔdua boka ne azo wɔ Henɛm Bɔnza ne adɔleɛ, ɔkɔsɔ Relɛfeeyem Bɔnza ne sɔlɔ. 9Ɔvi ɛkɛ ne ɔkɔ Nɛfetowa Nzubula ne mɔ azo, ɔdwu azuamgbole ne mɔɔ bikye Yifolɔn Boka la. Ɔbele ɛkɛ ne ɔkɔ Beeyala (anzɛɛ Keleate Gyialem) 10na ɔfa ye wɔ Beeyala adɔleɛ ɔkɔ Siyɛ wɔ awoka ne mɔ azo lɔ, ɔlua Gyialem Boka (anzɛɛ Kyɛsalɔn) ne sɔlɔ, ɔtolo ɔkɔ Bɛte Hyimɛhye, ɔpɛ nu Temena. 11Ɛweɛne ne akee lua boka ne azo wɔ Ɛkelɔn sɔlɔ, ɔbele ɔkɔ Hyekɔlɔn, ɔpɛ nu Beeyala Boka, ɔdwu Gyamenea, ɔkɔgua ye wɔ Mɛdetɛlenia Nyevile ne anloa. 12Mɛdetɛlenia Nyevile ne a le adɔleɛ ɛweɛne ɛdeɛ ne a. Ɛweɛne ɛhye mɔ anu yɛɛ Dwuda abusua ekpunli ne anu amra dɛnlanle a.
Kalɛbe ko ava Hibulɔn nee Dibɛ
(Maa 1.11-15)
13Kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Dwɔhyua la, ɔvale Dwuda abusua ekpunli ne azɛlɛ ne bie ɔmanle Kalɛbe mɔɔ le Gyɛfɛni mɔɔ ɔdaye ɔbɔ Dwuda abusua ne bie la ara ne. Kalɛbe nyianle Hibulɔn, suakpole ne mɔɔ le Enake ɔ ze Aaba ɛdeɛ la. 14Kalɛbe dule Enake abo zo amra ne wɔ suakpole ne azo. Bɛmɛ a le Hyihyae, Ahaeman, yɛɛ Talemae nee bɛ sua nu amra. 15Ɔvi ɛkɛ ne la ɔ nee Dibɛ amra hɔhonle. (Suakpole ɛhye, anrɛɛ bɛfɛlɛ ye Keleate Sifɛ.) 16Kalɛbe hanle kɛ, “Nrenya biala mɔɔ kɛhola kɛho kɛva Keleate Sifɛ la, mebava me ra raalɛ Akesa meamaa yeagya ye.” 17Kalɛbe adiema nrenya Kinaze ara Ɔteneɛle a honle vale suakpole ne a, yemɔti Kalɛbe vale ɔ ra raalɛ Akesa manle ɔgyale ye. 18Kenle mɔɔ bɛdie ye atɔfolɛ la, Ɔteneɛle zele ɔ ye kɛ ɔbiza ɔ ze ɔmaa ɔmaa ye azɛlɛ. Akesa vi ye asoaso ne azo dwule aze, na Kalɛbe bizale ye deɛ mɔɔ ɔkpondɛ la. 19Ɔbuale ye kɛ, “Mekpondɛ azɛlɛ mɔɔ nzule dɔɔnwo wɔ zolɛ la, ɔboalekɛ azɛlɛ mɔɔ wɔva wɔmaa me la di nzule nwo ehyia.” Yemɔti Kalɛbe vale ɛleka bie mɔɔ nzubula dɔɔnwo wɔ la manle ye wɔ azɛlɛ ne sɔlɔ nee ye nyiakɛ.
Dwuda azuamgbole ne mɔ
20Azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ Dwuda abusua ekpunli ne nyianle ye yɛle bɛ ɛdeɛ la ɛne: 21Azuamgbole mɔɔ wɔ azɛlɛ ne nyiakɛ kpalɛ mɔɔ le bɛ ɛdeɛ la a le azuamgbole ne mɔ mɔɔ bikye Yidɔm ɛweɛne ne azo la. Bɛmɛ a le Kabezii, Yidɛ, Gyega, 22Kaenaa, Daemona, Adeeda, 23Kidɛhye, Heezɔ, Yetenan, 24Zefe, Tilɛm, Bɛyeelo, 25Heezɔ Hadata, Kɛlio Hɛzelɔn (anzɛɛ Heezɔ), 26Emam, Hyima, Moleeda, 27Heezaa Gada, Hɛhyemɔn, Bɛtepilɛte, 28Heezaa Hyuale, Biyɛhyiba, Bezeyotaya, 29Beeyala, Ayem, Ezɛm, 30Ɛletolade, Kyɛsele, Hɔɔma, 31Zekelage, Mademana, Sansana, 32Lɛbeeyo, Hyelehem, Eyen, yɛɛ Relemɔn: bɛ muala bɛle azuamgbole abulanwiɔ nee ngɔnla, nee bɛ namunamu mɔɔ zuozua bɛ la.
33Azuamgbole mɔɔ wɔ maanle ne anu awoka ngyikyi ne mɔ azo la a le Ɛhyeteeyɔlo, Zola, Ahyena, 34Zanowa, Ɛnganem, Tapua, Yinam, 35Gyaamutu, Adulam, Soko, Azika, 36Hyaleeyem, Gɛdila, yɛɛ Gɛdiloteeyem: bɛ muala bɛle azuamgbole bulu nee nna, nee bɛ namunamu mɔɔ zuozua bɛ la.
37Eza Zinan, Hadahya, Megedalegade, 38Daelian, Mezepa, Dwɔketii, 39Leekehye, Bɔzokate, Ɛgelɔn, 40Kabɔn, Laaman, Ketelehye, 41Gɛdilo, Bɛtedeegɔn, Neeyama, yɛɛ Makidaa: azuamgbole bulu nee nsia, nee namunamu mɔɔ zuozua bɛ la boka nwolɛ.
42Akee Lebena, Yitɛ, Ahyan, 43Yefeta, Ahyena, Nɛzebe, 44Kiyaela, Akezebe, yɛɛ Malihya: azuamgbole ngɔnla, nee bɛ namunamu boka nwolɛ.
45Ɛkelɔn nee ye azua nee namunamu, 46yɛɛ azuamgbole nee namunamu mɔɔ bikye Ahyedɔdo, ɔvi Ɛkelɔn toonwo mɔɔ kɔgua Mɛdetɛlenia Nyevile ne anloa la boka nwolɛ.
47Ahyedɔdo nee Gaza nee bɛ namunamu toonwo mɔɔ kɔkpula azule ne mɔɔ la Yigyibiti ɛweɛne zo, ɔkɔ Mɛdetɛlenia Nyevile ne anloa la boka nwolɛ.
48Wɔ awoka ne mɔ azo, Hyeemɛ, Gyatɛ, Soko, 49Dana, Keleate Sifɛ (anzɛɛ Dibɛ), 50Anabe, Ɛhyetɛmowa, Enim, 51Gohyɛn, Hɔlɔn, yɛɛ Gaelo: azuamgbole bulu nee ko, nee namunamu mɔɔ zuozua bɛ la boka nwolɛ.
52Alabe, Dumaa, Ɛhyan, 53Gyeenɛm, Bɛte Tapua, Afika, 54Hɛmeta, Hibulɔn, yɛɛ Ziyɔ: azuamgbole ngɔnla nee bɛ namunamu boka nwolɛ.
55Meeyɔn, Kamɛle, Zefe, Gyɛta, 56Gyɛzɛli, Dwɔkedɛyam, Zanowa, 57Keen, Gebɛya, yɛɛ Temena: azuamgbole bulu nee bɛ namunamu boka nwolɛ.
58Halehɛle, Bɛtezuli, Gidɔ, 59Meeyala, Bɛtano, yɛɛ Ɛletɛkɔn: azuamgbole nsia, nee bɛ namunamu boka nwolɛ.
60Keleate Beeyale (anzɛɛ Keleate Gyialem) nee Laba: azuamgbole nwiɔ, nee bɛ namunamu, bɛ muala bɛboka nwolɛ.
61Akee wɔ ɛsɛlɛ ne azo, Bɛte Alaba, Meden, Sɛkeeka, 62Nebehyan, Ngyenle Suakpole, yɛɛ Ɛngidae: azuamgbole nsia, nee namunamu mɔɔ zuozua bɛ la boka nwolɛ.
63 Na Dwudama angola andu Gyibɛsema wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm. Ɛnɛ nee ɛnɛ ala Gyibɛsema nee Dwudama a de a.

Title: DWƆ 16
Content:
Azɛlɛ mɔɔ bɛvale bɛmanle Yifelaem nee Manasɛ Adɔleɛ amra la
1Azɛlɛ mɔɔ bɛvale bɛmanle Dwosefi abo zo amra ne la, ye nyiakɛ ɛweɛne ne bɔ ɔ bo wɔ azule Dwɔdan ne anloa wɔ Gyɛleko afoa nu, ɔvi Gyɛleko nzubula ne mɔ aduduleɛ ɔkɔ ɛsɛlɛ ne azo. Ɔla ɛkɛ ne, ɔvi Gyɛleko, ɔlua awoka ne mɔ anu ɔkɔdwu Bɛtɛle. 2Ɔvi Bɛtɛle ɔkɔ Lɛɛze, ɔfa Atalo Ada, ɛleka mɔɔ Akaema dɛnlanle la. 3Akee ɔfa adɔleɛ, ɔlua Gyafelɛte afoa nu ɔkɔkpula Aleze Bɛte Hɔlɔn, ɔvi ɛkɛ ne ɔlua Gizɛ ɔkɔgua Mɛdetɛlenia Nyevile ne anu.
4Dwosefi abo zo amra, mɔɔ le Yifelaem abusua ekpunli ne nee Manasɛ Adɔleɛ amra, nyianle azɛlɛ ɛhye yɛle bɛ ɛdeɛ.
Yifelaem
5Azɛlɛ mɔɔ bɛvale bɛmanle Yifelaem abusua ekpunli ne la ɛne: bɛ ɛweɛne ne mɔ bɔ ɔ bo wɔ Atalo Ada ɔkɔ aduduleɛ, ɔdwu Sɔlɔ Bɛte Hɔlɔn, 6na ɔvi ɛkɛ ɔkɔgua Mɛdetɛlenia Nyevile ne anloa. Makemita wɔ bɛ sɔlɔ. Ye aduduleɛ ɛweɛne ne bele kɔ Teeyanate Hyaelo afoa nu, ɔtɛla ye ɔkɔ Gyanowa aduduleɛ afoa nu. 7Akee ɛweɛne ne wɔne ɔ ti aze ɔvi Gyanowa ɔkɔ Atalo nee Neeyala, ɔdwu Gyɛleko na ɔwie wɔ Dwɔdan ne anloa. 8Ɔdwu Tapua a ɛweɛne ne fa adɔleɛ na ɔkɔ Kana Azule ne anloa, toonwo ɔkɔgua Mɛdetɛlenia Nyevile ne anloa. Yifelaem abusua ekpunli ne, azɛlɛ mɔɔ bɛvale bɛmanle bɛ la ɛne. 9Bɛvale azua nee namunamu mɔɔ wɔ Manasɛ ɛweɛne zo la noko bɛmanle Yifelaem abusua ekpunli ne. 10 Noko bɛanvoa Keenama mɔɔ de Gizɛ la, yemɔti Keenama nee Yifelaemma ɛdɛnla toonwo a yeradwu ɛnɛ a, na bɛmaa Keenama yɛ gyima kɛ bɛle ahanra.

Title: DWƆ 17
Content:
Manasɛ Adɔleɛ
1Bɛpɛle Dwɔdan Adɔleɛ azɛlɛ ne bie bɛmanle Dwosefi ara kpanyinli Manasɛ abusua ekpunli ne anu amra ne bie mɔ. Geleade ɔ ze Meekɛ le Manasɛ ara nrenya kpanyinli, yɛɛ ɔle katakyie wɔ ɛlɔne avinli. Yemɔti bɛvale Geleade nee Beehyan mɔɔ wɔ Dwɔdan Aduduleɛ la bɛmanle ye. 2Bɛvale Dwɔdan Adɔleɛ azɛlɛ ne bie bɛmanle Manasɛ abusua ekpunli ne anu amra mɔɔ hale la: Ebayizɛ, Hilɛke, Aseleɛle, Hyikɛm, Hifɛ, yɛɛ Hyemaeda. Ɛhye mɔ le Dwosefi ara Manasɛ abo zo amra yɛɛ bɛle abusua ne anu mgbanyinli mɔɔ gyigyi bɛ ze mɔ awuke ne mɔ ati a. 3Zilɔfɛhade le Hifɛ ara, Geleade alɔnra ɔ, yɛɛ ɔle Manasɛ ara Meekɛ angabɛnzo. Zilɔfɛhade anwo mralɛ mrenya. Mraalɛ ngome a ɔwole a; bɛmɛ a le Mala, Nowa, Hɔgela, Melekaa, yɛɛ Tɛza. 4 Bɛhɔle sɛlɛvolɛ Ɛlieza nee Nɛn ara Dwɔhyua nee mgbanyima ne mɔ ɛkɛ ne na bɛzele kɛ, “Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi kɛ ɔmaa yɛ nee yɛ mediema mrenya ne mɔ azɛlɛ ne bie.” Zɔhane ati, kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma hanle la, bɛmanle bɛ azɛlɛ kɛ bɛ mediema mrenya ne mɔ ala la. 5Yemɔti a Manasɛ nyianle ɛkpɔ bulu bokale Geleade nee Beehyan mɔɔ wɔ Dwɔdan Aduduleɛ la anwo a, 6ɔluakɛ bɛmanle ɔ bo zo amra mrenya nee mraalɛ azɛlɛ. Geleade azɛlɛ ne, bɛvale bɛmanle Manasɛ abo zo amra ne mɔɔ hale la.
7Manasɛ azɛlɛ ne ɛweɛne vi Ahya kɔkpula Mekemita wɔ Hyikɛm aduduleɛ. Ɔdwu ɛkɛ a ɛweɛne ne wɔne ɔ ti nyiakɛ na ɔfa Ɛntapua maanle ne ɔboka nwolɛ. 8Tapua azɛlɛ ne le Manasɛ ɛdeɛ, noko Tapua sua ne mɔɔ wɔ Manasɛ ɛweɛne zo la, yemɔ ɔle Yifelaem abo zo amra ɛdeɛ. 9Akee ɛweɛne ne wɔne ɔ ti aze dwu Azule Keena ne anloa. Azuamgbole mɔɔ wɔ azule ne nyiakɛ la le Yifelaem amra ɛdeɛ, noko bɛwɔ Manasɛ azɛlɛ zo. Manasɛ ɛweɛne ne kɔ azule ne sɔlɔ na ɔkɔwie Mɛdetɛlenia Nyevile ne anloa. 10Yifelaem la azɛlɛ ne nyiakɛ, yɛɛ Manasɛ la ye sɔlɔ. Mɛdetɛlenia Nyevile ne a le bɛ adɔleɛ ɛweɛne a. Ahya la azɛlɛ ne sɔlɔ mɔɔ kɔ ye adɔleɛ la, yɛɛ Yesakaa, la sɔlɔ mɔɔ kɔ ye aduduleɛ la. 11Yesakaa nee Ahya bɛ azɛlɛ ne, zolɛ yɛɛ Bɛte Hyan nee Yebelɛyam wɔ a, noko bɛle Manasɛ ɛdeɛ. Zɔhane ala yɛɛ azua nee namunamu mɔɔ zuozua bɛ la de a. Eza Dɔɔ (mɔɔ wɔ ɛnwea ne anloa), Ɛndɔɔ, Teeyanake, Mɛgedo, yɛɛ azua nee namunamu mɔɔ zuozua bɛ la le Manasɛ ɛdeɛ. 12 Manasɛma angola andu menli mɔɔ wɔ azuamgbole ɛhye mɔ azo la, yemɔti Keenama dɛnlanle ɛkɛ. 13Nzinlii bɔbɔ mɔɔ Yizilayɛma anwo yɛle se kpalɛ la bɛandu Keenama ne amuala. Bɛmanle Keenama ne yɛle gyima manle bɛ.
Yifelaem nee Manasɛ Adɔleɛ biza alie azɛlɛ dɔɔnwo
14Dwosefi abo zo amra ne zele Dwɔhyua kɛ, “Duzu ati yɛɛ wɔva azɛlɛ ne ɛkpɔ ko ala a wɔmaa yɛ a? Ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛyila yɛ ɛmaa yɛ nwo ɛzo kpalɛ.”
15Dwɔhyua buale bɛ kɛ, “Saa bɛ nwo ɛzo na Yifelaem awoka ne mɔ azo ɛyɛ ekyi ɛmaa bɛ a, ɛnee bɛhɔ Pɛlɛzema nee Relɛfeeyemma azɛlɛ ne azo, bɛhɔzo kpɔkɛ ne bie bɛziezie ɛkɛ ne bɛva.”
16Bɛbuale ye kɛ, “Awoka ne mɔ azo azɛlɛ ne le ekyi maa yɛ. Keenama noko mɔɔ wɔ fienemgbole ne anu la lɛ konle mbulalɛ ehwili, yɛɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛde Bɛte Hyan nee azua mɔɔ zuozua ye la nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛde Gyɛzɛli Bɔnza ne anu la amuala dedɛ konle mbulalɛ ehwili.”
17Dwɔhyua zele Yifelaem nee Manasɛ Adɔleɛ amra ne kɛ, “Nɔhalɛ, bɛ nwo zonle yɛɛ bɛ nwo yɛ se. Azɛlɛ ne, bɛbanyia mɔɔ bo ko la. 18Awoka ne mɔ anu lɔ azɛlɛ ne bayɛ bɛ ɛdeɛ. Ɔle kpɔkɛ ɛdeɛ, noko bɛhɔva bɛzo, bɛvi ɔ ti bɛhɔkpula ɔ bo na bɛva bɛyɛ bɛ ɛdeɛ. Keenama lɛ konle mbulalɛ ehwili, eza bɛ nwo yɛ se ɛdeɛ, noko bɛbavoa bɛ bɛavi ɛkɛ ne.”

Title: DWƆ 18
Content:
Azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ hale la ɛhyɛlɛ
1Yizilayɛma honle vale azɛlɛ ne la, nzinlii bɛ muala bɛyiale Hyaelo na bɛzile Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Ndanlɛ Sua ne. 2Ɛnee Yizilayɛ mbusua ekpunli nsuu wɔ ɛkɛ mɔɔ bɛmɛ bɛtɛmanle bɛ azɛlɛ ne bie a. 3Zɔhane ati Dwɔhyua zele Yizilayɛma kɛ, “Kenlenzu a bɛkɔ na bɛahɔva azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma, mɔɔ le bɛ nlenya mɔ Nyamenle ne, ɛva ɛmaa bɛ la a? 4Bɛye abusua ekpunli ko biala anu menli nsa bɛmaa me. Mesoa bɛ wɔ maanle ne anu meamaa bɛahɔkpɔla azɛlɛ ne amuala, bɛahɔyɛ ɛleka mɔɔ bɛkulo kɛ bɛtɛnla la nzonlɛ na bɛazia bɛara. 5Bɛbahyɛ azɛlɛ ne anu nsuu bɛamaa bɛ: Dwuda badɛnla ye ɛdeɛ ne azo wɔ nyiakɛ, na Dwosefi adɛnla ye sɔlɔ. 6Ye nsuu ne mɔɔ bɛkɛhyɛ ye la, bɛhɛlɛ ko biala anwo edwɛkɛ bɛrɛlɛ me na menwɔbiza Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛ Nyamenle ne menwɔmaa bɛ. 7Livaema, bɛmɛ bɛnrɛnyia azɛlɛ ne bie, ɔboalekɛ bɛ ɛdeɛ a le kɛ bɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma sɛlɛvolɛma. Na Gaade, Wulubɛn, yɛɛ Manasɛ Aduduleɛ amra, bɛmɛ bɛ sa ɛha bɛ azɛlɛ ɛdeɛ ne mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma sonvolɛ Mosisi vale manle bɛ dɛbadɛba la wɔ Dwɔdan Aduduleɛ lɔ.”
8Dwɔhyua akee zele menli mɔɔ bɛyele bɛ bɛmanle ye la kɛ, “Bɛhɔ azɛlɛ ne amuala azo na bɛhɛlɛ nwolɛ edwɛkɛ wɔ ngɛlata zo bɛrɛlɛ me. Mebagua nzeleba wɔ Hyaelo ɛke meabiza Ɛdɛnkɛma nwolɛ edwɛkɛ meamaa bɛ.” 9Ɔhanle ɛhye la akee menli ne guale adenle zo. Bɛhɔkpɔlale azɛlɛ ne amuala na bɛhilele kɛ bɛzi bɛhyɛ nu nsuu ne la wɔ kɛlata zo. Bɛhɛlɛle azua ne mɔ amuala aluma na bɛziale bɛrale Dwɔhyua anwo ɛkɛ ne wɔ Hyaelo azokoɛleɛ ne. 10Dwɔhyua guale nzeleba bizale nwolɛ manle bɛ, ɔhyɛle azɛlɛ ne ɔmanle mbusua ekpunli nsuu ne mɔ mɔɔ hale la.
Bɛngyaman azɛlɛ ɛdeɛ ne
11Bɛngyaman abusua ekpunli ne a bɛlumuale bɛmanle ye azɛlɛ ne bie a. Bɛ azɛlɛ ne la Dwuda nee Dwosefi mbusua ekpunli ne ɛdeɛ ne mɔ avinli. 12Azɛlɛ ne sɔlɔ ɛweɛne ne bɔ ɔ bo wɔ Dwɔdan ne anloa, ɔlua boka ne ndololeɛ nu wɔ Gyɛleko anwuma, ɔse ye adɔleɛ ɔlua awoka ne mɔ azo ɔkɔ ɛsɛlɛ ne azo lɔ wɔ Bɛteevɛn. 13Ɛweɛne ne akee wɔne ɔ ti aze, ɔlua Lɛɛze (mɔɔ eza bɛfɛlɛ ye Bɛtɛle la) nyiakɛ, ɔtolo ɔkɔ Atalo Ada, ɔfinde Aleze Bɛte Hɔlɔn boka ne nyiakɛ. 14Ɛweɛne ne eza bu ɛleka bie finde awoka ne mɔ adɔleɛ afoa nu, ɔfa nyiakɛ ɔkɔ Keleate Beeyale (anzɛɛ Keleate Gyialem) mɔɔ le Dwudama azɛlɛ la. Bɛngyaman azɛlɛ ne adɔleɛ ɛweɛne ne ɛne. 15Nyiakɛ ɛweɛne ne bɔ ɔ bo wɔ Keleate Gyialem kandiba ɔkɔ Nɛfetowa nzubula ne mɔ azo. 16Akee ɔlua boka ne mɔɔ awie gyi zolɛ a ɔnwu Henɛm Bɔnza ne anu la abo, wɔ Relɛfeeyem Bɔnza ne sɔlɔ. Akee ɔfa nyiakɛ, ɔlua Henɛm Bɔnza ne anu, ɔlua Gyibɛse boka ne nyiakɛ, ɔfinde Ɛnlogɛle. 17Akee ɔkakyi ɔ nye ɔfa ɛbɔ nu, ɔlua Ɛnhyimɛhye, ɔkɔ Gɛlaelo mɔɔ nee Adɛmem bɛ nye bɔ zolɛ la. Ɛweɛne ne akee kɔ Bohan Bolɛ ne anwo (Bohan le Wulubɛn ara), 18ɔlua boka ne abati mɔɔ anye bɔ Dwɔdan Bɔnza ne azo la, ɔtolo ɔkɔ bɔnza ne anu; 19ɔkɔfa Bɛte Hɔgela boka ne sɔlɔ na ɔkɔgua ye wɔ Nyevile Ngyenle ne sɔlɔ ebolo ne anu, ɛleka mɔɔ Azule Dwɔdan ne bɔ nyevile ne anu la. Ɛnee nyiakɛ ɛweɛne ne ɛne. 20Azule Dwɔdan ne a le aduduleɛ ɛweɛne ne a. Azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ Bɛngyaman abusua ekpunli ne nyianle ye yɛle bɛ ɛdeɛ la ɛweɛne ne ɛne.
21Azuamgbole mɔɔ le Bɛngyaman abusua ekpunli ne anu amra ɛdeɛ la a le Gyɛleko, Bɛte Hɔgela, Yimɛke, Kizeze, 22Bɛte Alaba, Zɛmaleeyem, Bɛtɛle, 23Evem, Pɛla, Ɔfela, 24Kifalamonae, Ɔfenae, yɛɛ Giba: azuamgbole bulu nee nwiɔ, nee namunamu mɔɔ zuozua bɛ la. 25Azuamgbole ɛhye mɔ noko wɔ ɛkɛ: Gebɛyɔn, Leema, Biyɛlo, 26Mezepa, Kɛfaela, Moza, 27Rilikɛm, Yɛpii, Talala, 28Zila, Hyilɛfe, Gyibɛse (anzɛɛ Gyɛlusalɛm), Gebɛya, yɛɛ Keleate Gyialem: azuamgbole bulu nee nna, nee namunamu mɔɔ zuozua bɛ la. Azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ Bɛngyaman abusua ekpunli ne anu amra nyianle ye yɛle bɛ ɛdeɛ la ɛne.

Title: DWƆ 19
Content:
Semɛyɔn azɛlɛ ɛdeɛ ne
1Azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nwiɔ la, bɛvale bɛmanle Semɛyɔn abusua ekpunli ne anu amra. Bɛ azɛlɛ ne wolole Dwuda abusua ekpunli ne ɛdeɛ ne anu. 2 Biyɛhyiba, Hyiba, Moleeda, 3Heezaa Hyuale, Beela, Yizɛm, 4Ɛletolade, Bɛtɛle, Hɔɔma, 5Zekelage, Bɛte Maekabo, Heezaa Susa, 6Bɛte Lɛbeeyo, yɛɛ Hyaluhɛn boka nwolɛ: bɛle azuamgbole bulu nee nsa, nee bɛ namunamu mɔɔ zuozua bɛ la.
7Eza Eyen, Relemɔn, Yitɛ, yɛɛ Ahyan: azuamgbole nna, boka azua mɔɔ zuozua bɛ la; 8yɛɛ azua mɔɔ zuozua azuamgbole ne mɔ toonwo kɔdwu Beeyala Biyɛ (anzɛɛ Releema) mɔɔ wɔ azɛlɛ ne nyiakɛ la. Azɛlɛ mɔɔ Semɛyɔn abusua ekpunli ne nyianle ye kɛ bɛ ɛdeɛ la ɛne. 9Kɛmɔ Dwuda azɛlɛ ne yɛle kpole bole zolɛ la ati, bɛvale bie bɛmanle Semɛyɔn abusua ekpunli ne.
Zɛbulɛn azɛlɛ ɛdeɛ ne
10Azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nsa la hɔle Zɛbulɛn abusua ekpunli ne ɛkɛ. Azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ bɛnyianle la tɛlɛ dwu Sɛlede. 11Ɛweɛne ne vi ɛkɛ ne ɔfa adɔleɛ ɔkɔdwu Maliale, Dabɛhyɛte, yɛɛ azule ne mɔɔ la Dwɔkenɛyam la anloa. 12Sɛlede foa ko nehane noko ɛweɛne ne fa aduduleɛ kɔdwu Keselo Teebɔ ɛweɛne zo, ɔkɔ Dabɛla na ɔdwu Gyafaya. 13Ɔvi ɛke ɔfa aduduleɛ ɔkɔ Gate Hifɛ nee Ɛtekeezen, ɔbele ɔkɔ Nia afoa nu, ɔdwu Relemɔn. 14Ye sɔlɔ ɛweɛne ne noko fa Hanatɔn na ɔkɔwie Yefetahɛle Bɔnza. 15Azua ɛhye mɔ a wɔ zolɛ a: Kata, Nahalale, Hyemelɔn, Yedala, yɛɛ Bɛtelɛhɛm. Bɛ muala bɛle azuamgbole bulu nee nwiɔ, yɛɛ namunamu mɔɔ zuozua bɛ la. 16Azuamgbole ɛhye mɔ nee azua ne mɔ wɔ azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ Zɛbulɛn abusua ekpunli ne nyianle yɛle bɛ ɛdeɛ la azo.
Yesakaa azɛlɛ ɛdeɛ ne
17Azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nna la hɔle Yesakaa abusua ekpunli ne ɛkɛ. 18Ye tɛtɛlɛ vale azua ɛhye mɔ: Gyɛzɛli, Kɛsɛlo, Hyunɛm, 19Hafalaem, Hyayɔn, Aneehalate, 20Relabete, Kehyeɔn, Yibɛze, 21Relɛmɛte, Ɛnganem, Ɛnhada, yɛɛ Bɛtepazɛɛze. 22Ɛweɛne ne eza dwu Teebɔ, Hyeehazuma, yɛɛ Bɛte Hyimɛhye, ɔkɔwie Dwɔdan ne anloa. Azuamgbole ne mɔ le bulu nee nsia, yɛɛ namunamu zuozua bɛ. 23Azuamgbole ɛhye mɔ nee bɛ namunamu mɔɔ zuozua bɛ la wɔ azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ Yesakaa abusua ekpunli ne nyianle la azo.
Ahya azɛlɛ ɛdeɛ ne
24Azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nnu la hɔle Ahya abusua ekpunli ne ɛkɛ. 25Ye kpole vale azua ɛhye mɔ: Hɛlekate, Heelae, Bitɛn, Akehyafe, 26Alam Mɛlɛke, Emade, yɛɛ Mehyale. Ye adɔleɛ ɛweɛne ne dwu Kamɛle nee Hyaehɔ Lebena. 27Ɛweɛne ne lua aduduleɛ wɔ Bɛtedeegɔn, ɔkɔ Zɛbulɛn nee Yefetahɛle Bɔnza, na ɔfa anwuma ɔdwu Bɛtɛmɛke nee Nayeyɛle, ɔfa ye sɔlɔ ɔdwu Keebulu, 28Yibolɔn, Rilihɔbo, Hamɔn, yɛɛ Kana, na ɔwie Saedɛn. 29Ɛweɛne ne akee fa ye wɔ Saedɛn ɛkɛ, ɔbele ɔkɔ Releema, ɔkɔ suakpole Taya mɔɔ bɛlie nwolɛ bane la; akee ɔbele ɔkɔ Hosa na yeahɔwie Mɛdetɛlenia Nyevile ne anloa. Azua ɛhye mɔ wɔ zolɛ: Mahalabe, Akezebe, 30Ɛmma, Efɛke, yɛɛ Rilihɔbo: azuamgbole abulanwiɔ nee nwiɔ, nee namunamu mɔɔ zuozua bɛ la. 31Azuamgbole ɛhye mɔ nee bɛ namunamu ne mɔ wɔ azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ Ahya abusua ekpunli ne nyianle la azo.
Nafetalae azɛlɛ ɛdeɛ ne
32Azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nsia la hɔle Nafetalae abusua ekpunli ne lɔ. 33Ye ɛweɛne ne vi Hilɛfe kɔ oku baka kpole bie mɔɔ gyi Zeeyananem la anwo, ɔpɛ nu ɛkɛ ɔdwu Adamaenikɛbe nee Gyamenea, ɔkɔ Leekɛm na yeahɔwie Dwɔdan ne anloa. 34Ɛkɛ ne, ɛweɛne ne bele kɔ adɔleɛ toonwo ɔdwu Azeno Teebɔ, ɔvi ɛkɛ ne ɔkɔ Hɛkɔko, ɔkɔkpula Zɛbulɛn nyiakɛ; Ahya wɔ adɔleɛ, yɛɛ Dwuda wɔ aduduleɛ wɔ Dwɔdan afoa nu. 35Azuamgbole mɔɔ yɛ se mɔɔ bɛlie nwolɛ bane la a le Zedem, Zɛɛ, Hamate, Relakate, Kyenɛlɛte, 36Adama, Releema, Heezɔ, 37Kidɛhye, Ɛdelɛyae, Ɛnheezɔ, 38Yelɔn, Megedalɛle, Hɔlɛm, Bɛtanate, yɛɛ Bɛte Hyimɛhye: azuamgbole bulu nee ngɔnla, yɛɛ namunamu mɔɔ zuozua bɛ la. 39Azuamgbole ɛhye mɔ nee bɛ namunamu ne mɔ wɔ azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ Nafetalae abusua ekpunli ne nyianle la azo.
Dan azɛlɛ ɛdeɛ ne
40Azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nsuu la hɔle Dan abusua ekpunli ne ɛkɛ. 41Azua ɛhye mɔ rale bɛ azɛlɛ ne azo: Zola, Ɛhyeteeyɔlo, Yɛhyimɛhye, 42Hyeeyalebem, Ayegyalɔn, Yetela, 43Yilɔn, Temena, Ɛkelɔn, 44Ɛletɛki, Gebɛtɔn, Beeyalate, 45Gyihɛde, Bɛneebilake, Gatelemɔn, 46Meegyaakɔn, yɛɛ Relakɔn nee Dwɔpa azɛlɛ ne amuala. 47 Mekɛ mɔɔ Danema azɛlɛ ne vile bɛ sa la, bɛdoale Leeyehyema bɛ nee bɛ hɔhonle. Danema vale sua ne, bɛhunle menli ne na bɛvale ɛkɛ ne bɛyɛle bɛ ɛdeɛ. Bɛdɛnlanle ɛkɛ na bɛhakyile sua ne duma Leeyehye ne na bɛvale bɛ nlenya Dan duma bɛdonle sua ne. 48Azuamgbole ɛhye mɔ nee bɛ namunamu ne mɔ wɔ azɛlɛ mɔɔ Dan abusua ekpunli ne nyianle ye la azo.
49Mɔɔ Yizilayɛma hyɛle bɛ azɛlɛ ne wiele la, bɛmanle Nɛn ara Dwɔhyua azɛlɛ ne bie kɛ ɔva ɔyɛ ye ɛdeɛ. 50Kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma hanle la, bɛvale suakpole mɔɔ ɔdaye ɔbizale la bɛmanle ye. Yemɔ a le Temenate Sila. Ɔwɔ Yifelaem awoka ne mɔ azo. Ɔhyele suakpole ne fofolɛ na ɔdɛnlanle ɛkɛ ne.
51Sɛlɛvolɛ Ɛlieza nee Nɛn ara Dwɔhyua nee mgbanyinli mɔɔ gyigyi Yizilayɛ mbusua ekpunli ekpunli ne mɔ ati la vale awolɛ guale nzeleba bizale Ɛdɛnkɛma kɛ bɛzi bɛhyɛ azɛlɛ ne la, wɔ Hyaelo. Bɛyɛle ɛhye wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne anlenkɛ ne anyunlu bɛhyɛle azɛlɛ ne. Adenle mɔɔ bɛluale nu bɛhyɛle azɛlɛ ne la ɛne.

Title: DWƆ 20
Content:
Azuamgbole mɔɔ le ɛvealeka la
1 Akee Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Dwɔhyua kɛ 2ɔha ɔhile Yizilayɛma kɛ, “Bɛva azuamgbole ne bie mɔ bɛyɛ ɛvealeka, kɛmɔ menzele me akɛlɛ Mosisi kɛ ɔha nwolɛ edwɛkɛ ɔhile bɛ la. 3Saa awie anye ɛnla nwolɛ na ɔku sonla a ɔkola ɔnriandi ɔkɔfea ɛkɛ ne, amaa mɔɔ kpondɛ ye ali ye nzenralɛ ahu ye bie adua la asa anga ye. 4Ɔkola ɔnriandi ɔkɔ azuamgbole ne mɔ bie azo ndɛnebualɛ ɛleka ne mɔɔ wɔ sua ne anuhɔlɛ kpole ne anloa la, na ɔkile edwɛkɛ mɔɔ ɛzi la anu ɔkile mgbanyima ne. Akee bɛbamaa ye ɛleka wɔ sua ne azo, amaa yeadɛnla ɛkɛ. 5Saa sonla ne mɔɔ di nzenralɛ ne la toa ye ba sua ne azo a, bɛmmaye ahenle ne mɔɔ hunle sonla ne la bɛmaa. Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛbɔ ɔ nwo bane, ɔboalekɛ tɛ ɔ nye fuu a ɔhunle ahenle a, yɛɛ yeanva ɛya a ɔhunle ye a. 6Ɔbadɛnla sua ne azo toonwo kɔkpula kɛ bɛkɛli ye edwɛkɛ bagua nu, na mekɛ ne anu sonla ne mɔɔ le sɛlɛvolɛ kpanyinli la kɛwu la. Ɛnee akee ɔkola ɔsia ɔkɔ ye sua zo, ɛleka mɔɔ ɔde mɔɔ ɔnriandile ɔrale la.”
7Yemɔti wɔ Dwɔdan Adɔleɛ, bɛvale Kidɛhye mɔɔ wɔ Galeli mɔɔ wɔ Nafetalae awoka ne mɔ azo la, Hyikɛm mɔɔ wɔ Yifelaem awoka ne mɔ azo la, yɛɛ Hibulɔn mɔɔ wɔ Dwuda maanle nu la. 8Wɔ Dwɔdan Aduduleɛ noko, bɛvale Bizɛ mɔɔ wɔ Wulubɛn azɛlɛ zo wɔ ɛsɛlɛ ne mɔɔ wɔ Gyɛleko aduduleɛ la, Releemɔto mɔɔ wɔ Geleade mɔɔ wɔ Gaade azɛlɛ zo la, yɛɛ Golan mɔɔ wɔ Beehyan mɔɔ wɔ Manasɛ azɛlɛ zo la. 9Azuamgbole ɛhye mɔ a bɛvale bɛyɛle ɛvealeka ne mɔ bɛmanle Yizilayɛma amuala nee nyɛvolɛ mɔɔ bɛ nee bɛ de la a. Awie biala mɔɔ ɔ nye ɛnla nwolɛ na ɔkɛhu sonla la kola kɔ ɛkɛ ɔmaa bɛbɔ ɔ nwo bane wɔ ahenle mɔɔ kpondɛ kɛ ɔku ye bie ɔtua la asa anu. Bɛngola bɛngu ye, kyesɛ bɛli ye edwɛkɛ bagua nu na yeli fɔlɛ.

Title: DWƆ 21
Content:
Livae azuamgbole ne mɔ
1Livae abusua ekpunli ne anu mgbanyinli hɔle sɛlɛvolɛ Ɛlieza, Nɛn ara Dwɔhyua, nee mgbanyinli mɔɔ gyigyi Yizilayɛ mbusua ne mɔ ati la ɛkɛ 2 wɔ Hyaelo mɔɔ wɔ Keena azɛlɛ zo la, na bɛzele bɛ kɛ, “Ɛdɛnkɛma luale Mosisi anwo zo zele kɛ bɛmaa yɛ azuamgbole bɛmaa yɛdɛnla zolɛ, yɛɛ azɛlɛ mɔɔ yɛ nee yɛ nyɛmoa yɛbadidi zolɛ la, wɔ bɛ azɛlɛ ne mɔ azo.” 3Yemɔti ɔlua Ɛdɛnkɛma edwɛkɛ ne azo, Yizilayɛma manle Livaema azuamgbole nee nwolɛ azɛlɛ mɔɔ bɛbadidi zolɛ la wɔ bɛ azɛlɛ ne mɔ azo.
4Livae abusua ekpunli ne anu amra mɔɔ lumuale nyianle bie la a le Kohate asa azo ne. Abusua ekpulike ɛhye le sɛlɛvolɛ Aalɔn abo zo amra, yɛɛ bɛmanle bɛ azuamgbole bulu nee nsa wɔ Dwuda, Semɛyɔn, nee Bɛngyaman azɛlɛ ne mɔ azo. 5Kohate asa azo mɔɔ hale la nyianle azuamgbole bulu wɔ Yifelaem, Dan, nee Manasɛ Adɔleɛ azɛlɛ ne mɔ azo.
6Gɛhyɔn asa azo nyianle azuamgbole bulu nee nsa wɔ Yesakaa, Ahya, Nafetalae, nee Manasɛ Aduduleɛ azɛlɛ ne mɔ azo.
7Mɛlɛlae asa azo nyianle azuamgbole bulu nee nwiɔ wɔ Wulubɛn, Gaade, nee Zɛbulɛn azɛlɛ ne mɔ azo.
8Bɛguale nzeleba kolaa na Yizilayɛma ava azuamgbole ɛhye mɔ nee nwolɛ azɛlɛ mɔɔ bɛdidi zolɛ la amaa Livaema, kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma luale Mosisi anwo zo hanle la.
9Azuamgbole mɔɔ bɛvale bɛ wɔ Dwuda nee Semɛyɔn azɛlɛ ne mɔ azo bɛmanle 10Aalɔn abo zo amra mɔɔ le Kohate asa azo ne mɔɔ bɔ Livae abusua ekpunli ne bie la aluma ɛne: bɛmɛ a bɛlumuale bɛnyianle azuamgbole ne mɔ bie a. 11Bɛnyianle Aaba (Aaba le Anake ɔ ze), ɛnɛ bɛfɛlɛ sua ne Hibulɔn; ɔwɔ Dwuda maanle nu awoka ne mɔ azo, yɛɛ nwolɛ adidileka. 12Na ɛnee bɛva suakpole ne kpɔkɛ ne nee namunamu mɔɔ zuozua ye la bɛmaa Kalɛbe mɔɔ le Gyɛfɛni ara ne dɛbadɛba kɛ ye ɛdeɛ ɔ.
13Bɛvale azuamgbole ɛhye mɔ nee Hibulɔn (Hibulɔn le ɛvealeka), 14Gyatɛ, Ɛhyetɛmowa, 15Hɔlɔn, Dibɛ, 16Eyen, Gyɛta, yɛɛ Bɛte Hyimɛhye nee nwolɛ adidileka; bɛle azuamgbole ngɔnla. Bɛvale bɛ wɔ Dwuda nee Semɛyɔn maanzinli ne mɔ anu. 17Bɛmanle bɛ azuamgbole nna wɔ Bɛngyaman maanzinli nu: bɛmɛ a le Gebɛyɔn, Giba, 18Anato, yɛɛ Alemɔn, nee nwolɛ adidileka. 19Azuamgbole bulu nee nsa, nee nwolɛ adidileka yɛɛ bɛvale bɛmanle sɛlɛvolɛma ne a. Sɛlɛvolɛma ne le Aalɔn abo zo amra.
20Livae abusua ekpunli ne anu amra mɔɔ le Kohate asa azo mɔɔ hale la nyianle azuamgbole ne bie wɔ Yifelaem maanzinli nu. 21Bɛle azuamgbole nna. Bɛmɛ a le Hyikɛm nee nwolɛ adidileka, ɔwɔ Yifelaem awoka ne mɔ azo (ɔle ɛvealeka), Gizɛ, 22Kebezeeyem, yɛɛ Bɛte Hɔlɔn nee azɛlɛ mɔɔ bɛdidi zolɛ la. 23Wɔ Dan maanzinli nu, bɛnyianle azuamgbole nna: Ɛletɛki, Gebɛtɔn, 24Ayegyalɔn, yɛɛ Gatelemɔn, nee nwolɛ adidileka. 25Manasɛ Adɔleɛ maanzinli nu noko, bɛnyianle azuamgbole nwiɔ: Teeyanake nee Gatelemɔn, nee nwolɛ adidileka. 26Kohate asa azo ɛhye mɔ nyianle azuamgbole bulu, nee azɛlɛ mɔɔ bɛdidi zolɛ la.
27Livae abusua ekpunli ne anu amra mɔɔ le Gɛhyɔn asa azo ne nyianle azuamgbole nwiɔ: Golan mɔɔ wɔ Beehyan (ɔle ɛvealeka) nee Bɛɛhyetɛla, nee nwolɛ azɛlɛ mɔɔ bɛdidi zolɛ la. 28Yesakaa maanzinli nu, bɛnyianle azuamgbole nna: Kaehyɔn, Dabɛlate, 29Gyaamutu, yɛɛ Ɛnganem, nee azɛlɛ mɔɔ bɛdidi zolɛ la. 30Ahya maanzinli nu, bɛnyianle azuamgbole nna: Mehyale, Abedɔn, 31Hɛlekate, yɛɛ Rilihɔbo, nee nwolɛ adidileka. 32Nafetalae maanzinli nu, bɛnyianle azuamgbole nsa: Kidɛhye mɔɔ wɔ Galeli (ɔle ɛvealeka), nee nwolɛ adidileka, Hamotu Dɔɔ, yɛɛ Kaatan, nee nwolɛ adidileka. 33Gɛhyɔn asa azo ne noko nyianle azuamgbole bulu nee nsa, nee nwolɛ adidileka.
34Livae abusua ekpunli ne anu amra mɔɔ hale la a le Mɛlɛlae asa azo ne. Bɛnyianle azuamgbole nna wɔ Zɛbulɛn maanzinli nu: Dwɔkenɛyam, Kaata, 35Demena, yɛɛ Neehalale, nee nwolɛ adidileka. 36Wɔ Wulubɛn maanzinli nu, bɛnyianle azuamgbole nna: Bizɛ, Gyeehaze 37Kedɛmo, yɛɛ Mɛfeeyate, nee nwolɛ adidileka. 38Gaade maanzinli nu noko, bɛnyianle azuamgbole nna: Releemɔto mɔɔ wɔ Geleade (ɔle ɛvealeka), nee nwolɛ adidileka, Meehaneeyem, 39Hɛhyebɔn, yɛɛ Gyeezɛ, nee nwolɛ adidileka. 40Yemɔti Mɛlɛlae asa azo ne nyianle azuamgbole bulu nee nwiɔ.
41-42Azɛlɛ mɔɔ Yizilayɛma ne nyianle ye la, azuamgbole mɔɔ Livaema nyinle wɔ nu la amuala le abulanla nee mɔtwɛ, nee nwolɛ adidileka.
Yizilayɛma fa azɛlɛ ne ayɛ bɛ ɛdeɛ
43Yemɔti Ɛdɛnkɛma vale azɛlɛ ne amuala manle Yizilayɛma, kɛmɔ ɔvale ɔbɔle bɛ nlenya mɔ ɛwɔkɛ la. Akee mɔɔ bɛ sa hanle ye la, bɛdɛnlanle ɛkɛ ne kpɔkpɔ. 44Ɛdɛnkɛma manle bɛ anzonudwolɛ wɔ bɛ azɛlɛ ne azo, kɛmɔ ɛwɔkɛ ne mɔɔ ɔbɔle bɛ nlenya mɔ la se la. Bɛ kpɔvolɛma ne anu ko bɔbɔ angola bɛ nyunlu gyinla, ɔboalekɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma manle bɛlile konim wɔ bɛ muala bɛ nwo zo. 45Ɛdɛnkɛma lile ɛwɔkɛ biala mɔɔ ɔbɔle Yizilayɛma la azo.

Title: DWƆ 22
Content:
Dwɔhyua maa mbusua mɔɔ vi aduduleɛ la ahɔ
1Akee Dwɔhyua vɛlɛle Wulubɛn, Gaade, yɛɛ Manasɛ Aduduleɛ mbusua ekpunli ne mɔ manle bɛyiale. 2Ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛyɛ ninyɛne mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma sonvolɛ Mosisi hanle kɛ bɛyɛ la amuala bɛwie, eza bɛdie me nloa edwɛkɛ bɔkɔɔ. 3Mekɛ ɛhye amuala, kenle ko bɔbɔ ɛnle ɛkɛ mɔɔ bɛhakyile bɛ nzi bɛzile bɛ mediema Yizilayɛma a. Bɛli Ɛdɛnkɛma, bɛ Nyamenle ne edwɛkɛ zo. 4Kɛkala, Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne ɛmaa Yizilayɛma anzo nu ɛdwo bɛ, kɛmɔ ye ɛwɔkɛ ne se la. Yemɔti bɛhɔ sua nu, wɔ azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ bɛ sa ɛha ye la azo, wɔ Dwɔdan aduduleɛ lɔ. Ɛdɛnkɛma sonvolɛ Mosisi a vale manle bɛ a. 5Bɛnlea boɛ na bɛli mɛla ne mɔɔ Mosisi ɛva ɛmaa bɛ la azo. Bɛhulo Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne, bɛyɛ ye ɛhulolɛdeɛ, bɛli ye mɛla ne mɔ azo, bɛli nɔhalɛ bɛmaa ye, na bɛva bɛ ahonle nee bɛ ɛkɛla muala bɛzulo ye.” 6-8Dwɔhyua yilale bɛ na ɔvale ɔzɔle zolɛ kɛ, “Bɛlɛ anwonyia dɔɔnwo a bɛlɛsia bɛahɔ bɛ nzi a: nyɛmoa, dwɛtɛ fufule, ezukoa nvutuke, kɔbele, bulalɛ, yɛɛ adɛladeɛ dɔɔnwo. Ɛhye mɔ le ninyɛne mɔɔ bɛnyianle bɛ wɔ bɛ kpɔvolɛma ne ɛkɛ a. Bɛ nee bɛ mediema ne mɔ ɛhyɛ mɔɔ bɛnyia ye la.” Akee ɔmanle bɛ adenle ɔmanle bɛhɔle.
Mosisi vale Dwɔdan aduduleɛ azɛlɛ ne bie manle Manasɛ abusua ekpunli ne foa ko yɛɛ foa ko ne mɔɔ hale la, Dwɔhyua ɛmaa bɛ nee mbusua ekpunli ekpunli mɔɔ hale la azɛlɛ wɔ Dwɔdan adɔleɛ.
9Yemɔti Wulubɛn, Gaade, yɛɛ Manasɛ Aduduleɛ mbusua ekpunli ne mɔ ziale hɔle bɛ maanle nu. Bɛgyakyile Yizilayɛma mɔɔ hale la wɔ Hyaelo, wɔ Keena azɛlɛ zo, na bɛbɔle ɔ bo kɛ bɛkɔ bɛdabɛ bɛ maanle nu wɔ Geleade. Azɛlɛ ɛhye a Ɛdɛnkɛma luale Mosisi anwo zo vale manle bɛ a.
Bɛsi azukponle wɔ Azule Dwɔdan ne anloa
10Mekɛ mɔɔ Wulubɛn, Gaade, yɛɛ Manasɛ Aduduleɛ amra dwule Gɛlaelo, mɔɔ ɛnee bɛtɛbɔ Dwɔdan adɔleɛ afoa nu la, bɛzile azukponle kpole kɛnlɛma ko wɔ azule ne anloa. 11Awie hɔhanle hilele Yizilayɛma mɔɔ hale la kɛ, “Bɛdie, Wulubɛnema, Gaadema, nee Manasɛ Aduduleɛ amra ɛzi azukponle bie wɔ Gɛlaelo, mɔɔ nee Keena anye bɔ zolɛ la wɔ Dwɔdan adɔleɛ nehae.” 12Mɔɔ Yizilayɛma ne dele ɛhye la, bɛ muala bɛyiale Hyaelo na bɛyɛle kɛ bɛ nee aduduleɛ mbusua ekpunli ekpunli ne mɔ kaho.
13Yizilayɛma zoanle sɛlɛvolɛ Ɛlieza ara Fenɛhaze wɔ Wulubɛn, Gaade, yɛɛ Manasɛ Aduduleɛ mbusua ne mɔ anwo ɛkɛ wɔ Geleade. 14Mgbanyinli bulu a nee Fenɛhaze hɔle a, abusua ekpunli ko biala anu sonla ko, yɛɛ yemɔ a ɔle abusua ne kpanyinli a. 15Bɛrale Wulubɛn, Gaade, yɛɛ Manasɛ Aduduleɛ mbusua ekpunli ne mɔ ɛkɛ wɔ Geleade maanzinli nu. 16 Bɛgyinlanle Ɛdɛnkɛma menli ne mɔ amuala agyakɛ anu bɛbizale bɛ kɛ, “Duzu munzule debie a bɛyɛ bɛtia Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne la? Saa bɛzi azukponle ɛhye bɛmaa bɛ nwo a ɛnee bɛkpo Ɛdɛnkɛma! Bɛkpo kɛ bɛnrɛdoa ɔ bo zo bieko! 17 Bɛkakye ɛtane mɔɔ yɛyɛle wɔ Piyɔ la. Mekɛ ne anu Ɛdɛnkɛma vale ewule nzane a deanle ɔdaye ye menli ne a. Ɛnɛ nee ɛnɛ ala yɛtɛnwu nwolɛ amaneɛ. Ɛtane zɔhane, yɛyɛ bie yɛvɛ! 18Yemɔti ɛnɛ noko eza bɛkpo kɛ bɛnrɛdoa ye ɔ? Saa bɛkpo Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛnɛ a, ɛhyema ɔbava Yizilayɛnli biala anwo ɛya. 19Saa bɛnea na bɛ azɛlɛ ne ɛnle ɛleka mɔɔ bɛtɛnla bɛsonle Nyamenle a, ɛnee bɛrɛla Ɛdɛnkɛma azɛlɛ ye azo, ɛleka mɔɔ ye Ndanlɛ Sua ne wɔ la na bɛralie yɛ azɛlɛ ne bie. Bɛmmasi azukponle bɛboka Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛ Nyamenle ne ɛdeɛ ne anwo. Bɛmmako bɛtia Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛɛ bɛmmamaa yɛte atua. 20 Bɛhakye Zila ara Ekan. Yeanli mɛla ne mɔɔ fane ninyɛne mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛsɛkye bɛ la azo la, ɔmanle Yizilayɛma amuala nyianle nwolɛ ndeanlɛ. Tɛ Ekan angome a wule wɔ ye ɛtane ne mɔɔ ɔyɛle la ati a.”
21Wulubɛn nee Gaade nee Manasɛ Aduduleɛ amra buale mbusua mgbanyinli mɔɔ vi adɔleɛ rale la kɛ, 22“Tumivolɛ Kokye ne ala a le Nyamenle a! Yemɔ a ɔle Ɛdɛnkɛma a! Tumivolɛ Kokye ne ala a le Nyamenle a! Yemɔ a ɔle Ɛdɛnkɛma a! Ɔze deɛ mɔɔ yemɔti yɛyɛle ɛhye la, na yɛmaa bɛdabɛ noko bɛanwu ye! Saa yɛanli nɔhalɛ yɛammaa Ɛdɛnkɛma na yɛhakyi yɛ nzi yɛzi ye, yɛde ɔ nwo atua a, ɛnee bɛhu yɛ! 23Saa yɛdule Ɛdɛnkɛma anloa yɛdole yɛɛ yɛzi yɛdayɛ yɛ ti anwo azukponle mɔɔ yɛyela azubɔdeɛ wɔ zolɛ anzɛɛ yɛfa yɛabɔ aleɛ ɛnyianlɛ anzɛɛ agɔnwolɛyɛlɛ azu a, ɛnee Ɛdɛnkɛma ɔdaye ɔdua yɛ kakɛ. 24Ɔnle zɔhane! Yɛyɛle, ɔboalekɛ yɛsulo kɛ kenle bie bɛ bo zo amra baze yɛ bo zo amra kɛ, ‘Duzu a wɔ bɛ nee Ɛdɛnkɛma avinli a? 25Ɔvale Dwɔdan ɔyɛle ɛweɛne ɔdole yɛ nee bɛmɛ Wulubɛn nee Gaade amra avinli. Bɛ nee Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛnlɛ ngitanwolilɛ biala.’ Ɛnee akee wɔannea a bɛ bo zo amra bamaa yɛmɛ yɛ bo zo amra ne mɔ agyakyi Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛzonlenlɛ. 26Yemɔti yɛanzi azukponle ne kɛ yɛyela nane anzɛɛ yɛbɔ azu wɔ zolɛ, 27na yɛyɛle, amaa yeayɛ sɛkɛlɛneɛ yeamaa yɛ menli ne nee bɛ menli ɛdeɛ ne, nee awolɛndoazo mɔɔ bara la kɛ, nɔhalɛ nu, yɛfa yɛ azubɔdeɛ yɛkɔ yɛmaa bɛyela bɛ na yɛbɔ azu, yɛɛ yɛfa yɛ mediemayɛlɛ azubɔdeɛ yɛkɔsonle Ɛdɛnkɛma wɔ ye Ndanlɛ Sua Nwuanzanwuanza ne anyunlu. Ɛhye ɛnrɛmaa bɛ bo zo amra ne ɛnrɛha kɛ yɛ nee Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛnlɛ ngitanwolilɛ. 28Yɛ adwenle a le kɛ, saa ɔba ye zɔhane a, yɛ nwo amra ne kɛhola kɛha kɛ, ‘Bɛnlea! Yɛ nlenya mɔ zile azukponle mɔɔ le kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛdeɛ ne la. Bɛanzi ye kɛ bɛfa bɛayela ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ anzɛɛ bɛfa bɛabɔ azu, na ɔle sɛkɛlɛneɛ ɔmaa yɛ menli ne nee bɛ menli ɛdeɛ ne.’ 29Nɔhalɛ, yɛnrɛhola yɛnrɛzi azukponle kɛ yɛfa yɛayela ninyɛne wɔ zolɛ yɛabɔ azu anzɛɛ yɛabɔ aleɛnyianlɛ anzɛɛ agɔnwolɛyɛlɛ azu na yɛakpo Ɛdɛnkɛma anzɛɛ yɛagyakyi ye ɛdoalɛ. Yɛnrɛzi azukponle gyɛne biala yɛnrɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛ Nyamenle ne, kyesɛ mɔɔ gyi Ɛzonlenlɛ Ndanlɛ Sua ne anyunlu la ala.”
30Sɛlɛvolɛ Fenɛhaze nee mbusua mgbanyinli ne dele mɔɔ Wulubɛn, Gaade, yɛɛ Manasɛ Aduduleɛ amra hanle la, akee bɛ kunlu dwole. 31Fenɛhaze zele bɛ kɛ, “Kɛkala, yɛnwu kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma nee yɛ a lua a. Bɛtɛkpole ye, bɛlie Yizilayɛma ngoane, bɛammaa Ɛdɛnkɛma andea yɛ.”
32Akee Fenɛhaze nee mbusua mgbanyinli ne mɔ vile bɛ mediema Wulubɛn nee Gaade amra anwo ɛkɛ ne wɔ Geleade na bɛhɔle Keena; bɛhɔdole Yizilayɛma mɔɔ ɛha la na bɛbɔle bɛ amaneɛ bɛhilele bɛ. 33Yizilayɛma ne akunlu dwole na bɛyele Nyamenle ayɛlɛ. Bɛanli konle nwo adwelie bieko kɛ bɛkɔ bɛahɔzɛkye azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ Wulubɛn nee Gaade amra de zolɛ la.
34Wulubɛn nee Gaade amra zele kɛ, “Azukponle ɛhye le daselɛ maa yɛ muala kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ala a le Nyamenle a.” Yemɔti bɛvɛlɛle ye “Daselɛ.”

Title: DWƆ 23
Content:
Dwɔhyua nee Yizilayɛma di nrɛlaleɛ
1Mekɛ ne hɔle bie la, Ɛdɛnkɛma bɔle Yizilayɛma anwo bane wɔ bɛ kpɔvolɛma mɔɔ ɛbɔ ɛyia bɛ la asa anu. Mekɛ ne anu ɛnee Dwɔhyua ɛyɛ kpanyinli, 2yemɔti ɔvɛlɛle Yizilayɛma amuala, bɛ mgbanyima, bɛ mbusua mgbanyinli, ndɛnebuavolɛma, nee bɛ mbɔlɔba ne mɔ amuala na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Kɛkala, akee meyɛ kpanyinli. 3Bɛdabɛ bɛnwu debie mɔɔ bɛmɛ bɛ ti Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne ɛva ɛyɛ maanle maanle ɛhye mɔ la. Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne a ɛho ɛmaa bɛ a. 4Mehyɛ azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ maanle maanle mɔɔ yɛtɛtule bɛ la de zolɛ la, nee maanle maanle mɔɔ ɛbɔ ye Azule Dwɔdan aduduleɛ toonwo mɔɔ kɔgua Mɛdetɛlenia Nyevile ne anu mɔɔ meli bɛ nwo zo konim la memaa bɛ, memaa abusua ekpunli ko biala ɛnyia bie. 5Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne bamaa maanle maanle zɔhane mɔ agua ndwɛlɛ aze na yeavoa bɛ, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛmɛ bɛkɛze kɛ bɛko bɛahɔ bɛ nyunlu la. Bɛ azɛlɛ ne bayɛ bɛ ɛdeɛ, kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma vale bɔle bɛ ɛwɔkɛ la. 6Yemɔti bɛnlea boɛ na bɛli debie biala mɔɔ bɛhɛlɛ ye wɔ Mosisi Mɛla ne anu la azo. Bɛmmabu bɛ nye bɛgua ye kpɔkɛ ko bɔbɔ azo. 7Akee menli ɛhye mɔ mɔɔ de bɛ avinli la, bɛ nee bɛ mmatu fane biala, bɛmmabɔ bɛ awozonle ne mɔ aluma, bɛmmafa bɛ bɛka ndane, bɛmmasonle bɛ yɛɛ bɛmmabɔ bɛ ti aze bɛmaa bɛ. 8Bɛli nɔhalɛ bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma, kɛmɔ bɛyɛ toonwo yeradwu ɛnɛ la. 9Ɛdɛnkɛma voanle maanle mgbole mgbole mɔɔ anwo yɛ se la wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛzele kɛ bɛba bɛ nyunlu la. Maanle maanle zɔhane mɔ anu menli, ko bɔbɔ angola bɛ nyunlu gyinla. 10 Bɛmɛ, bɛ nuhua ko biala kola maa menli apenle gua ndwɛlɛ aze, ɔboalekɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne a ɛlɛko amaa bɛ a, kɛmɔ ye ɛwɔkɛ ne se la. 11Zɔhane ati bɛnlea bɛ nwo boɛ na bɛhulo Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne. 12Saa bɛanli nɔhalɛ na bɛ nee menli mɔɔ bɛandu bɛ, na bɛ nee bɛ a de la yɛ ko, bɛgya bie a, 13ɛnee bɛnwu ye kɛ, Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne ɛnrɛdu menli ɛhye mɔ wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛ nee bɛ kɛnyia konle la. Menli zɔhane anwo bayɛ ɛzulolɛ kɛ ɛhane anzɛɛ kuma la amaa bɛ; na nyane mɔɔ bɛbanwu ye la bayɛ kɛ bɛlɛ empele bɛlɛbila bɛ nzi kuma nu anzɛɛ bɛlɛ mbowule bɛlɛwowɔ bɛ nye zo la. Na ɛhye bahɔ zolɛ toonwo kɔkpula kɛ bɛ muala bɛkɛwie azɛlɛ kpalɛ ɛhye mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne ɛva ɛmaa bɛ la azo.
14“Akee me ewule mekɛ asɛɛ ɛdwu. Bɛ nuhua ko biala ze ye wɔ ye ahonle nu na ɔdie ɔto nu kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne ɛva ninyɛne kpalɛ ne mɔɔ ɔvale ɔbɔle bɛ ɛwɔkɛ la ɛmaa bɛ. Ɛwɔkɛ biala mɔɔ ɔbɔle la yeli zolɛ; kokye anga nu. 15Na kɛmɔ yeli ɛwɔkɛ biala mɔɔ ɔbɔle yɛ la azo la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ ndeanlɛ biala mɔɔ fɛta la ɔbava yeadea bɛ a. 16Saa bɛanli mɛla ne mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne ɛva ɛmaa bɛ la azo, na bɛsonle anzɛɛ bɛyeyɛ awozonle a, yemɔ, ɔbava ɛya na yeadea bɛ. Na bɛ nuhua ko bɔbɔ ɛnrɛha azɛlɛ kɛnlɛma ye mɔɔ yeva yemaa bɛ la azo.”

Title: DWƆ 24
Content:
Dwɔhyua tendɛ ahile Yizilayɛma wɔ Hyikɛm
1Dwɔhyua manle Yizilayɛ mbusua ekpunli ekpunli ne mɔ amuala yiale Hyikɛm. Ɔvɛlɛle mgbanyima ne mɔ, mbusua mgbanyinli nee, ndɛnebuavolɛma ne mɔ, yɛɛ Yizilayɛ mbɔlɔba kɔsɔɔti ɔmanle bɛrayiale Nyamenle duma nu wɔ Hyikɛm. 2 Dwɔhyua zele menli ne amuala kɛ, “Kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne se la ɛne: ‘Mekɛ bie mɔɔ ɛraze ɛhɔ la bɛ nlenya mɔ dɛnlanle Azule Yufileti anzi lɔ na bɛzonlenle awozonle. Bɛ nlenya mɔ zɔhane anu ko a le Ebileham nee Neehɔ bɛ ze Tilaa. 3 Na menyele bɛ nlenya Ebileham menvile azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ la Azule Yufileti ne anzi lɔ la azo, na mengilele ye Keena azɛlɛ ye amuala. Memanle ɔ sa zo dale. Memanle ɔwole Ayezeke, 4 na Ayezeke wole Gyekɔbo nee Yisɔ. Menvale Yidɔm azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ la awoka ne mɔ azo lɔ la memanle Yisɔ kɛ ɔva ɔdɛnla zolɛ, na bɛ nlenya Gyekɔbo nee ɔ mra ne mɔ hɔle Yigyibiti. 5Nzinlii menzoanle Mosisi nee Aalɔn, na mengyegyele Yigyibitima kpole kpalɛ. Na menyele bɛmɛ menvile ɛkɛ; 6 menyele bɛ nlenya mɔ menvile Yigyibiti, na Yigyibitima vale ɛlɔnema mɔɔ dede mgbɔnwɔ zo nee konle ehwili nu la doale bɛ ndinlizo. Mɔɔ bɛ nlenya mɔ dwule Ndɔ Nyevile ne anloa la 7bɛzunle bɛvɛlɛle me kɛ memboa bɛ, na menvale awozinli mendole bɛ nee Yigyibitima avinli. Memanle nyevile azɛlɛkye bule guale bɛ nwo zo na bɛwule. Bɛze mɔɔ menvale menyɛle Yigyibitima la.
“ ‘Bɛdɛnlanle ɛsɛlɛ ne azo bɛhyɛle dɔɔnwo. 8 Akee menvale bɛ membale Amɔlema azɛlɛ zo wɔ Dwɔdan aduduleɛ. Amɔlema nee bɛ honle, noko memanle bɛlile Amɔlema anwo zo konim. Bɛvale Amɔlema azɛlɛ ne, na mɔɔ bɛkɛze kɛ bɛkɔ bɛ nyunlu la ɛnee melɛsɛkye bɛ kpɔvolɛma ne meamaa bɛ. 9 Akee Zepɔ ara Balake, mɔɔ le Mowabe belemgbunli ne, ɔdaye ɔ nee bɛ rahonle. Ɔmanle Biyɔ ara Beelam dele na ɔzɛlɛle ye kɛ ɔhye bɛ sili. 10Na meandie Beelam, yemɔti ɔyilale bɛ; adenle ɛhye azo yɛɛ mempenle menliele bɛ ngoane wɔ Balake asa anu a. 11 Bɛpɛle Azule Dwɔdan ne bɛrale Gyɛleko. Gyɛlekoma nee bɛ honle; zɔhane ala yɛɛ Amɔlema, Pɛlɛzema, Keenama, Hɛtema, Gɛgahyema, Haevaema, yɛɛ Gyibɛsema noko nee bɛ honle a. Na memanle bɛlile bɛ muala bɛ nwo zo konim. 12 Mekɛ mɔɔ bɛ nee Amɔle arelemgbunli nwiɔ ne ko la, membɔle bɛ ɛlɔnema ne asande, amaa bɛadu bɛ ɛkɛ ne. Tɛ bɛ anwosesebɛ anzɛɛ asɛɛ bɛze konle nye zo la ati ɔ. (Bɛ konle dadeɛ nee bɛ ɛda ne mɔ anyɛ ɛhwee.) 13 Memanle bɛ azɛlɛ mɔɔ tɛ bɛ a bɛbule ye ɛhoayelɛ la, nee azuamgbole mɔɔ tɛ bɛ a bɛkyekyele la. Kɛkala, bɛde zolɛ yɛɛ bɛlɛdi vanye ma nee ɔlivi ma wɔ mbaka mɔɔ tɛ bɛ a bɛluale la azo.’ ”
14Dwɔhyua vale zɔle zolɛ kɛ, “Ye zɔhane ati bɛli Ɛdɛnkɛma eni na bɛzonle ye nɔhalɛ nu. Awozonle ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛ nlenya mɔ zonlenle bɛ wɔ Mɛsɔpɔteemea nee Yigyibiti la, bɛgua bɛ lɔ na bɛzonle Ɛdɛnkɛma angomekye. 15Saa bɛ kunlu ɛndwo kɛ bɛkɛzonle ye a, ɛnee ɛnɛ demua ye, bɛhile mɔɔ bɛkɛzonle ye la, awozonle ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛ nlenya mɔ zonlenle bɛ wɔ Mɛsɔpɔteemea la anzɛɛ saa Amɔlema mɔɔ bɛ azɛlɛ zo a bɛde la awozonle ne mɔ a. Na mame, me nee me sua nu amra, yɛbazonle Ɛdɛnkɛma.”
16Yizilayɛma ne buale kɛ, “Yɛnrɛgyakyi Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛnrɛzonle awozonle fee! 17Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛ Nyamenle ne a yele yɛ nlenya mɔ nee yɛdayɛ vile ahanra ɛzonlenlɛ nu wɔ Yigyibiti a, yɛɛ yɛnwunle nwanwane ninyɛne mɔɔ ɔyɛle la. Ɛdɛnkɛma bɔle yɛ nwo bane wɔ maanle maanle mɔɔ yɛluale bɛ avinli yɛrale la asa anu. 18Mɔɔ yɛba maanle ye anu la, Ɛdɛnkɛma lumuale yɛ nyunlu, ɔvoanle Amɔlema mɔɔ de ɛke la amuala. Yemɔti yɛdayɛ yɛbazonle Ɛdɛnkɛma; yemɔ a ɔle yɛ Nyamenle a.”
19Dwɔhyua zele menli ne mɔ kɛ, “Bɛnrɛhola Ɛdɛnkɛma sonle! Ɔle Nyamenle Nwuanzanwuanza yɛɛ ɔnrɛva bɛ ɛtane ɔnrɛhyɛ bɛ. Ɔngulo ahola ɛzilɛ, 20yemɔti saa bɛgyakyi ye na bɛkɔsonle nyamenle gyɛne biala anzɛɛ awozonle a, ɔbahakyi ɔ nzi yeazi bɛ na yeadea bɛ. Ɔnvane ɔ nwo kɛ yeyɛ kpalɛ yemaa bɛ ɛlɛ, ɔbazɛkye bɛ.”
21Yizilayɛma ne hanle hilele Dwɔhyua kɛ, “Yɛmɛ, yɛtua yɛ nzo! Yɛbazonle Ɛdɛnkɛma.”
22Dwɔhyua zele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛdabɛ bɛdi daselɛ kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ala a bɛbazonle ye a.”
Bɛbuale ye kɛ, “Ɛhɛe, yɛdi daselɛ.”
23Dwɔhyua zele bɛ kɛ, “Ɛnee bɛvuandi awozonle ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛlɛ la bɛgua, na bɛvua bɛhile Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne kɛ bɛbali nɔhalɛ bɛamaa ye.”
24Menli ne zele Dwɔhyua kɛ, “Yɛbazonle Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛ Nyamenle ne. Yɛbali ye mɛla ne mɔ azo.”
25Kenle ko ne Dwɔhyua nee menli ne yɛle ngyehyɛlɛ wɔ Hyikɛm na ɔvale mɛla ɔmanle bɛ kɛ bɛli zolɛ. 26Dwɔhyua hɛlɛle mɛla ne mɔ wɔ Nyamenle Mɛla Buluku ne anu. Akee ɔvale bolɛ ko ɔdole oku baka kpole ne mɔɔ gyi Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛleka Nwuanzanwuanza ne la abo, 27na ɔzele Yizilayɛma amuala kɛ, “Bolɛ ɛhye bayɛ yɛ daselɛ. Yede edwɛkɛ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛha ɛhile yɛ la amuala. Zɔhane ati ɔbayɛ daselɛ yeatia bɛ kɛ bɛkɛho bɛkɛtia bɛ Nyamenle ne a.” 28Na Dwɔhyua manle menli ne mɔ hɔle, awie biala ziale hɔle ɔdaye ye sua zo.
Dwɔhyua nee Ɛlieza ewule
29Ɛhye anzi, Ɛdɛnkɛma sonvolɛ Dwɔhyua, Nɛn ara ne wule. Ɔlile ɛvolɛ ɛya, ɛvolɛ bulu. 30 Bɛziele ye wɔ ɔdaye ye azɛlɛ ɛdeɛ ne azo wɔ Temenate Sila, wɔ Geeyahye Boka ne sɔlɔ, wɔ Yifelaem maanzinli nu awoka ne mɔ azo.
31Mɔɔ ɛnee Dwɔhyua de aze la, Yizilayɛma zonlenle Ɛdɛnkɛma, ye ewule ne anzi, mɔɔ ɛnee mgbanyinli ne mɔ mɔɔ nwunle debie biala mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛle manle Yizilayɛma la de aze la, menli ne hɔle zolɛ zonlenle Ɛdɛnkɛma.
32 Yizilayɛma vale Dwosefi mbowule vile Yigyibiti rale, na bɛraziele ye wɔ Hyikɛm wɔ azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ Gyekɔbo dɔle wɔ Heemɔ amra mrenya ne mɔ lɔ la azo. Heemɔ le Hyikɛm ɔ ze, na bɛdɔle azɛlɛ ne dwɛtɛ fufule ɛya. Azɛlɛ zɔhane, Dwosefi abo zo amra a vale a.
33Aalɔn ara Ɛlieza wule na bɛziele ye wɔ Gebɛya. Gebɛya le sua wɔ Yifelaem maanzinli nu awoka ne mɔ azo. Ɛkɛ ne azɛlɛ ne, bɛvale bɛmanle ɔ ra Fenɛhaze.

Title: MAA MUKENYE
Content:
Mukenye
Maanlebuvolɛma buluku ne le adawu ngakyile mɔɔ vi Yizilayɛma tetedwɛkɛ nu wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee maamɛla zo ɛlilɛ ɛnle maanle ne anu, ɔvi mekɛ mɔɔ bɛhonle bɛvale Keena maanle ne bakpula mekɛ mɔɔ bɛhyehyɛle belemgbunlililɛ nwo maamɛla la. Adawu ɛhye mɔ fane menli bie mɔɔ le katakyiema mɔɔ honle liele bɛ maanle ne na ɔlua zolɛ bɛfɛlɛ bɛ “Maanlebuvolɛma” la anwo. Menli ɛhye mɔ anu dɔɔnwo le ɛlɔne nu safohyenlema; bɛnle ndɛnebuavolɛma, kɛmɔ edwɛkɛkpɔkɛ ne abo kile la. Bɛ nuhua ko mɔɔ ye nyɛleɛ ti ɔliele duma kpole la a le Samesɛn. Bɛhɛlɛ ye gyima mɔɔ ɔlile la amuala wɔ mgbakyelɛ 13-16.
Ɛzukoalɛdeɛ kpole kpalɛ mɔɔ yɛfa ye wɔ buluku ne anu la a le kɛ, Yizilayɛma ɛkpazilɛ vi nɔhalɛ mɔɔ bɛdi bɛmaa Nyamenle la, yɛɛ mekɛ biala mɔɔ bɛanli nɔhalɛ bɛammaa Nyamenle la, ɛnee munzule ɛdo bɛ. Mɔɔ yɛ ɛzulolɛ tɛla ɛhye bɔbɔ la a le kɛ, mekɛ biala mɔɔ Yizilayɛma anli nɔhalɛ ammaa Nyamenle na anwubɛnyunlu kɛdo bɛ la, saa bɛnu bɛ nwo na bɛsia bɛtoa ye bieko a, Nyamenle die bɛ ngoane.
Mɔɔ wɔ nu la
Edwɛkɛ mɔɔ sisile toonwo hɔkpulale Dwɔhyua ewule 1.1—2.10
Yizilayɛ maanlebuvolɛma 2.11—16.31
Edwɛkɛsisilɛ ngakyile 17.1—21.25

Title: MAA 1
Content:
Dwuda nee Semɛyɔn mbusua ekpunli ne mɔ ko ava Adonaebizɛke
1Dwɔhyua wule la, Yizilayɛma bizale Ɛdɛnkɛma kɛ, “Nwane yɛɛ ɛlumua ɛhɔteta Keenama ɔ nee bɛ ɛho a?”
2Ɛdɛnkɛma buale kɛ, “Dwuda yɛɛ balumua a; bɛnlea, meye maanle ne memaa ye.”
