3Na Dwuda zele ɔ diema Semɛyɔn kɛ, “Maa yɛhɔ maanle ne mɔɔ bɛva bɛmaa yɛ la anu yɛ nee Keenama ɛhɔho, na yɛwie a medame noko me nee wɔ ahɔ wɔ maanle ɛdeɛ ne mɔɔ bɛva bɛmaa wɔ la anu.” Yemɔti Semɛyɔn nee 4Dwuda hɔle, na Ɛdɛnkɛma yele Keenama nee Pɛlɛzema manle bɛ, na bɛbɔle menli apenle bulu abo zo wɔ Bizɛke. 5Bɛhɔle Belemgbunli Adonaebizɛke anwo zo wɔ Bizɛke, bɛ nee ye honle na bɛlile Keenama nee Pɛlɛzema anwo zo konim. 6Adonaebizɛke nriandile, na bɛvoanle ye dedee bɛhyele ye, na bɛpepɛle ɔ sa nee ɔ gyakɛ ahohotile ne mɔ. 7Na Adonaebizɛke hanle kɛ, “Arelemgbunli abulasuu mɔɔ bɛpepɛle bɛ sa nee bɛ gyakɛ ahohotile la yɛɛ ɛnee sesa me aleɛ ɛkponle bo mgbokpoloka a; mɔɔ menyɛle la yɛɛ Nyamenle ɛyɛ me bie ɛzie ɔ bo zo a.” Na bɛ nee ye hɔle Gyɛlusalɛm; ɛkɛ ne yɛɛ ɔwule a.
Dwuda abusua ekpunli ne di Gyɛlusalɛm nee Hibulɔn anwo zo konim
8Dwudama nee Gyɛlusalɛmma honle na bɛbole Gyɛlusalɛmma bɛvale sua ne. Bɛhunle menli mɔɔ wɔ zolɛ la na bɛyelale suakpole ne. 9Nzinlii Dwudama hɔle na bɛ nee Keenama mɔɔ gua awoka ne mɔ azo, awoka ne mɔ ndololeɛ nu, yɛɛ azɛlɛ fɛɛnye ne azo la hɔhonle. 10Na Dwudama hɔtetale Keenama mɔɔ wɔ Hibulɔn mɔɔ ɛnee bɛfɛlɛ ye Keleate Aaba la, na bɛlile Hyihyae, Ahaeman, yɛɛ Talemae asa azo ne mɔ anwo zo konim.
Ɔteneɛle di suakpole Dibɛ anwo zo konim
(Dwɔ 15.13-19)
11Bɛvi ɛkɛ ne la Dwuda nee ye ɛlɔnema hɔtetale Dibɛ. Duma mɔɔ dɛba ne bɛfa bɛfɛlɛ Dibɛ la a le Keleate Sifɛ. 12Na Kalɛbe hanle kɛ, “Awie biala mɔɔ kɛteta Keleate Sifɛ na ɔkɛli konim la menwɔva me ra raalɛ Akesa menwɔmaa ɔkɛgya ye.” 13Na Kalɛbe adiema kakula ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Kinaze la ara nrenya Ɔteneɛle hɔhonle vale sua ne, na Kalɛbe vale ɔ ra raalɛ Akesa manle ɔgyale ye. 14Wɔ atɔfolɛlielɛ ne anu, Ɔteneɛle zele ɔ ye kɛ ɔbiza ɔ ze ɔlie azɛlɛ. Zɔhane ati Akesa vi ye asoaso ne azo dwule aze, na Kalɛbe bizale ye kɛ, “Duzu a ɛkpondɛ a?” 15Ɔbuale kɛ, “Maa me ahyɛlɛdeɛ. Kɛmɔ wɔva nyiakɛ azɛlɛ azo resee ne wɔmaa me la ɛnee maa me ɛleka mɔɔ nzule wɔ la.” Na Kalɛbe vale sua ne sɔlɔ nee nyiakɛ nzubula ne mɔ manle ye.
Dwuda nee Bɛngyaman mbusua ekpunli ne mɔ konimlilɛ
16Kinanli ne mɔɔ Mosisi gya ɔ ra raalɛ la abo zo amra nee Dwudama vi suakpole Gyɛleko, suakpole mɔɔ mrɛlɛ nee mrelehyia ngome la azo, na bɛhɔle azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ ɛhwie, mɔɔ zua Ɛlade la azo na bɛ nee menli ne hɔdɛnlanle. 17Dwuda nee ɔ diema Semɛyɔn hɔle Zifate na bɛhɔlile Keenama mɔɔ wɔ ɛkɛ ne la anwo zo konim na bɛbɔle sua ne bɔkɔɔ. Yemɔti bɛvɛlɛle suakpole ne Hɔɔma. 18Dwuda eza vale Gaza nee azua mɔɔ zuozua ye, Ahyekɛlɔn nee azua mɔɔ zuozua ye, nee Ɛkelɔn nee azua mɔɔ zuozua ye la. 19Ɛdɛnkɛma lile Dwuda anzi manle ɔvale maanle ne mɔɔ gua awoka ne mɔ azo la amuala, noko yeangola menli mɔɔ wɔ fienemgbole ne anu la tu, ɔluakɛ bɛlɛ mbulalɛ ehwili mɔɔ bɛfa bɛko la. 20Kɛmɔ Mosisi hanle la, bɛvale Hibulɔn bɛmanle Kalɛbe, na ɔdule Anake amra mrenya nsa ne ɛkɛ. 21 Bɛngyaman asa azo ɛdeɛ ne, bɛandu Gyibɛsema mɔɔ wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm la; yemɔti Gyibɛsema nee Bɛngyamanema ɛdɛnla toonwo a yeradwu ɛnɛ a.
Yifelaem nee Manasɛ mbusua ekpunli ne mɔ di Bɛtɛle anwo zo konim
22-23Yifelaem abusua ekpunli ne noko hɔtetale Bɛtɛlema, na Ɛdɛnkɛma lile bɛ nzi. Dwosefi asa azo ne mɔ lumuale zoanle menli kɛ bɛhɔli busia bɛnlea kɛ Bɛtɛle azɛlɛ ne si de la. (Dɛba ne ɛnee bɛfɛlɛ suakpole ɛhye Lɛɛze). 24Busiama ne nwunle kɛ nrenya bie vi suakpole ne azo ɛvinde ɛlɛba. Bɛzele nrenya ne kɛ, “Yɛsɛlɛ wɔ, kile yɛ suakpole ne azo adenle ne na yɛbayɛ wɔ boɛ.” 25Nrenya ne hilele bɛ suakpole ne azo adenle. Bɛhunle ezuavolɛ ne kɔsɔɔti na bɛgyakyile nrenya ne nee ɔ ye nee ɔ mra. 26Nrenya ne akee hɔle Hɛtema maanle nu, ɔhɔkyekyele sua bieko na ɔdonle ye Lɛɛze, na ɛnɛ nee ɛnɛ ala kɛ bɛfɛlɛ sua ne la ɛne.
Menli mɔɔ Yizilayɛma andu bɛ la
27 Manasɛ abusua ne anu amra andu menli mɔɔ wɔ Bɛte Hyan nee namunamu mɔɔ zuozua ye la, yɛɛ bɛandu menli mɔɔ wɔ Teeyanake nee ye namunamu, Dɔɔ nee ye namunamu, Yebeleam nee ye namunamu, yɛɛ Mɛgedo nee ye namunamu ne mɔ anu amra. Na Keenama hɔle zolɛ nee bɛ dɛnlanle maanle ne anu. 28Mekɛ mɔɔ Yizilayɛma abo zo dɛlɛle la, bɛhyele Keenama ɛkpolekɛ zo bɛmanle bɛyɛle akɛlɛ gyima, na bɛandu bɛ.
29 Yifelaem abusua ekpunli ne anu amra noko andu Keenama mɔɔ wɔ Gizɛ la. Keenama dɛnlanle Gizɛ ɛkɛ ne ala.
30Zɛbulɛn abusua ekpunli ne anu amra andu menli mɔɔ wɔ Ketelɔn la. Eza bɛandu Neehalɔnoma. Bɛ nee Keenama ne dɛnlanle na bɛmanle bɛyɛle akɛlɛ gyima.
31Ahya abusua ekpunli ne anu amra andu menli mɔɔ wɔ Ako la anzɛɛ Saedɛnema. Bɛandu Ahelabema, Akezebema, Hɛlebama, Efɛkema, yɛɛ Rilihɔboma. 32Ahya abusua ekpunli ne anu amra dɛnlanle Keenama mɔɔ de maanle ne anu la avinli. Bɛandu bɛ.
33Nafetalae abusua ekpunli ne anu amra andu menli mɔɔ wɔ Bɛte Hyimɛhye la yɛɛ bɛandu Bɛtanatema. Nafetalaema nee Keenama mɔɔ de azɛlɛ ne azo la dɛnlanle na bɛmanle Bɛte Hyimɛhyema nee Bɛtanatema yɛle akɛlɛ gyima manle Yizilayɛma.
34Amɔlema voanle Dan abusua ekpunli ne anu amra manle bɛhɔle azua mɔɔ gua awoka ne mɔ azo la azo, ɔluakɛ bɛammaa bɛ adenle bɛammaa bɛamba azɛlɛ fɛɛnye ne azo. 35Amɔlema bɔle mɔdenle kɛ bɛtɛnla Hilɛse Boka ne azo wɔ Ayegyalɔn nee Hyeeyalebem, na Yifelaem abo zo amra asa homonle bɛ nwo zo na bɛmanle bɛyɛle akɛlɛ gyima.
36Yidɔmma ɛweɛne ne vi Akelabem anwuma, ɔlua Silaa ɔkɔ ye sɔlɔ lɔ.

Title: MAA 2
Content:
Ɛdɛnkɛma soanvolɛ wɔ Bokem
1Ɛdɛnkɛma soanvolɛ vi Gelegale hɔle Bokem. Ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Menyele bɛ menvile Yigyibiti azɛlɛ zo, me nee bɛ rale azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ menvale membɔle bɛ mgbanyima ɛwɔkɛ la azo. Menganle kɛ, ‘Menrɛtulu ngyekyeleɛ ne mɔɔ me nee bɛ kyekyele la ɛlɛ, 2 yɛɛ bɛdabɛ noko bɛ nee menli mɔɔ de azɛlɛ ye azo la mmayɛ ngyehyɛlɛ biala, na bɛbubu bɛ azukponle ne mɔ.’ Noko bɛanli me mɛla ne azo. Bɛdabɛ bɛnlea bɛ nyɛleɛ mɔɔ bɛyɛ la. 3Zɔhane ati mese, menrɛvoa menli ɛhye mɔ. Bɛbayɛ bɛ nwo ɛlɔne, na bɛ awozonle ne mɔ bayɛ ngane amaa bɛ.” 4Mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma soanvolɛ ne hanle edwɛkɛ ɛhye hilele Yizilayɛma la, bɛdukuele nu bɛzunle. 5Na bɛvɛlɛle ɛleka zɔhane Bokem, na bɛbɔle azu wɔ ɛkɛ ne bɛmanle Ɛdɛnkɛma.
Dwɔhyua ewule
6Dwɔhyua manle menli ne mɔ hɔle la, Yizilayɛnli biala ziale hɔvale ye azɛlɛ ɛdeɛ ne mɔɔ le ye agyadeɛ la. 7Wɔ Dwɔhyua mekɛ zo menli ne zonlenle Ɛdɛnkɛma, yɛɛ ye ewule ne anzi bɛhɔle zolɛ bɛzonlenle Ɛdɛnkɛma wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ mgbanyima mɔɔ Dwɔhyua wule gyakyile bɛ la de aze la, ɔluakɛ bɛ muala bɛnwunle gyima kpole mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛli ɛmaa Yizilayɛma la. 8Na Ɛdɛnkɛma sonvolɛ Dwɔhyua, Nɛn ara ne lile ɛvolɛ ɛya ko, ɛvolɛ bulu na yeawu. 9Bɛziele ye wɔ ɔdaye ye azɛlɛ zo wɔ Temenate Sila wɔ Yifelaem maanzinli nu, Geeyahye boka ne sɔlɔ. 10Na awolɛndoazo zɔhane anu amra amuala wule, na awolɛndoazo fofolɛ mɔɔ ɛnze Ɛdɛnkɛma anzɛɛ ɛnze gyima mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛli ɛmaa Yizilayɛma la dwazole.
Yizilayɛma gyakyi Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛzonlenlɛ
11-12Yizilayɛma bɔle munzule ɛbɛla tiale Ɛdɛnkɛma. Bɛkpole Ɛdɛnkɛma, mɔɔ le bɛ ze mɔ Nyamenle ne, mɔɔ yele bɛ vile Yigyibiti azɛlɛ zo la, na bɛzonlenle awozonle Beeyale ne mɔ. Bɛlile nyamenle gyɛne bie mɔ anzi, bɛzonlenle menli mɔɔ ɛbɔ bɛ ɛyia la nyamenle ne mɔ. Bɛbɔle bɛ ti aze bɛmanle bɛ, na Ɛdɛnkɛma vale ɛya kpole. 13Bɛkpole Ɛdɛnkɛma na bɛzonlenle Beeyale ne mɔ nee mmonle Asetate ne mɔ. 14Yemɔti Ɛdɛnkɛma vale Yizilayɛma anwo ɛya kpole. Ɔmanle ɛlɔne ratetale bɛ, bole bɛ, wuale bɛ ninyɛne, na ɔyele bɛ ɔmanle bɛ kpɔvolɛma mɔɔ ɛbɔ ɛyia bɛ la. Na Yizilayɛma yɛle anwunvɔne somaa wɔ bɛ sa nu. 15Kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma kɔkɔ ne mɔɔ ɔbɔle bɛ, nee ye ndane ne mɔɔ ɔhanle ɔdole zolɛ la se la, mekɛ biala mɔɔ Yizilayɛma kɛhɔ konle nloa la, Ɛdɛnkɛma ko tia bɛ wɔ bɛ munzule ɛbɛla ne ati, na bɛnwunle amaneɛ kpole.
16Nzinlii akee Ɛdɛnkɛma manle Yizilayɛma nyianle menli lile bɛ ti na bɛliele bɛ bɛvile nwule ne mɔ asa anu. 17Noko bɛandie menli mɔɔ lile bɛ ti la aneɛ. Bɛanli nɔhalɛ bɛammaa Ɛdɛnkɛma. Bɛhɔlile nyamenle gyɛne bie mɔ anzi na bɛzonlenle bɛ. Bɛanva adenle ne mɔɔ bɛ mgbanyima ne mɔ luale nu zonlenle Ɛdɛnkɛma la anu. Bɛ ze mɔ lile Ɛdɛnkɛma mɛla ne mɔ azo, na bɛmɛ, bɛanli zo fee. 18Mekɛ biala mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma kɛmaa bɛ sonla kɛ ɔli bɛ ti la, ɔ nee ye dua na ɔdie Yizilayɛma ɔfi bɛ kpɔvolɛma asa anu, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ahenle mɔɔ li bɛ ti la de aze la. Ɔluakɛ ɔyɛ na bɛkile bɛ nyane nee abodelɛ na bɛse kɛ bɛsu a ɛnee ɔyɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma alɔbɔlɛ. 19Noko mekɛ biala mɔɔ ahenle mɔɔ li bɛ ti la kɛwu la, ɛnee bɛzia bɛ nzi bɛlɛbɔ bɛ munzule ɛbɛla ne bieko, na bɛyɛ bɔbɔ bɛmaa ɔtɛla dɛba ne mɔɔ bɛ ze mɔ yɛle la. Bɛtoɔdoa nyamenle gyɛne gyɛne, bɛsonle bɛ, na bɛbɔ bɛ ti aze bɛmaa bɛ. Bɛangyakyi bɛ ninyɛndane nee anzosesebɛ ne mɔ ɛyɛlɛ. 20Ɛdɛnkɛma vale Yizilayɛma anwo ɛya na ɔzele kɛ, “Kɛmɔ menli ɛhye mɔ ɛtulu me ngyekyeleɛ ne mɔɔ me nee bɛ ze mɔ kyekyele, na bɛandie me ne la, 21menrɛli bɛ nyunlu menrɛdu menli mɔɔ ɛha azɛlɛ ne azo mɔɔ Dwɔhyua wule gyakyile bɛ ɛkɛ ne la, 22amaa meava meazɔ Yizilayɛma meanlea kɛ bɛkɛli medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, me mɛla zo, kɛmɔ bɛ ze mɔ lile zolɛ la anzɛɛ bɛnrɛyɛ.” 23Zɔhane ati Ɛdɛnkɛma gyakyile maanle maanle zɔhane mɔ wɔ azɛlɛ ne azo. Yeandu bɛ ɛkɛ ne ala, yɛɛ yeanva bɛ yeanwula Dwɔhyua tumi ne abo.

Title: MAA 3
Content:
Maanle maanle mɔɔ hale azɛlɛ ne azo la
1Ɛdɛnkɛma manle maanle maanle bie mɔ hale azɛlɛ ne azo, amaa yeava bɛ yeazɔ Yizilayɛma mɔɔ ɛtɛnwunle konle ɛlɛ wɔ Keena la yeanlea. 2Ɔyɛle ɛhye kɛ ɔfa yeahile Yizilayɛma awolɛndoazo ne mɔ konle deɛ holɛ, na bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛtɛnwunle konle ɛlɛ la anwu kɛ konle si de la. 3Maanle maanle ne mɔ ɛne: Filisitia arelemgbunli nnu ne, Keenama amuala, Saedɛnema, yɛɛ Haevaema mɔɔ gua Lɛbanɔn Boka ne azo la, ɔvi Beeyale Hɛmɔn Boka toonwo mɔɔ kɔdwu Heemate Ademgbolezo la. 4Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛle ɛhye mɔ amuala kɛ ɔfa yeazɔ Yizilayɛma yeanlea saa bɛkɛli mɛla ne mɔ mɔɔ ɔluale Mosisi anwo zo ɔvale ɔmanle bɛ ze mɔ la azo a. 5Yemɔti Yizilayɛma nee Keenama, Hɛtema, Amɔlema, Pɛlɛzema, Haevaema, yɛɛ Gyibɛsema dɛnlanle, 6na bɛgyale menli ne mɔ amra mraalɛ, na bɛdabɛ noko bɛvale bɛ mra mraalɛ bɛmanle menli ne mɔ amra mrenya gyale bɛ; na Yizilayɛma zonlenle menli ne mɔ nyamenle ne mɔ.
Ɔteneɛle
7Yizilayɛma arɛle vile Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne. Bɛbɔle munzule ɛbɛla bɛtiale Ɛdɛnkɛma na bɛzonlenle awozonle Beeyale nee Ahyela ananze ne mɔ. 8Yemɔti Ɛdɛnkɛma vale Yizilayɛma anwo ɛya kpole kpalɛ. Ɔsɛmanle bɛ ɔwulale Kuhyan Relehyateeyem, mɔɔ le Mɛsɔpɔteemea belemgbunli ne asa anu. Na Yizilayɛma zonlenle Kuhyan Relehyateeyem toonwo ɛvolɛ mɔtwɛ. 9Na Yizilayɛma zunle vɛlɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma, na Ɛdɛnkɛma yele Kinaze ara Ɔteneɛle, mɔɔ le Kalɛbe adiema kakula la manle ɔliele bɛ. 10Ɛdɛnkɛma Sunsum ne dwule Ɔteneɛle anwo zo, na ɔholale ɔziele Yizilayɛma. Ɔvale konle ɔdoale Kuhyan Relehyateeyem, na Ɛdɛnkɛma yele Kuhyan Relehyateeyem, mɔɔ le Mɛsɔpɔteemea belemgbunli ne manle ye na ɔlile ɔ nwo zo konim. 11Na akee anzonudwolɛ rale maanle ne anu ɛvolɛ abulanla. Na Kinaze ara Ɔteneɛle wule.
Yihɛde
12Yizilayɛma ɛtane mɔɔ yɛle la akee bole zolɛ wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu. Zɔhane ati Ɛdɛnkɛma kpogyale Mowabe Belemgbunli Ɛgelɔn asa zo. 13Ɛgelɔn nee Amɔnoma nee Amalɛkema bɔle nu na bɛvale konle bɛdoale Yizilayɛma, bɛhanle bɛ senle dwɛɛ, na bɛvale Gyɛleko mɔɔ ɛkɛ ne le mrɛlɛ nee mrelehyia ngome la. 14Na Yizilayɛma zonlenle Mowabe Belemgbunli Ɛgelɔn ɛvolɛ bulu nee mɔtwɛ.
15Yizilayɛma zunle vɛlɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma. Na Ɛdɛnkɛma yele Yihɛde, mɔɔ le Gila ara nrenya ne mɔɔ asa le bɛne, mɔɔ vi Bɛngyaman abusua ekpunli ne anu la manle ɔliele bɛ. Yizilayɛma duale adwule manle Yihɛde kɛ ɔva ɔhɔmaa Mowabe Belemgbunli Ɛgelɔn. 16Yihɛde bɔle dadeɛ anye nwiɔ, mɔɔ ye tendenle kɛyɛ mita foa ko la, na ɔvale ɔkyekyele ye ɛzɔlɛ fema ne anwo na ɔwulale ye tɛladeɛ ne ɔguale zolɛ. 17Akee ɔvale adwule ne ɔhɔmanle Mowabe Belemgbunli Ɛgelɔn. Ɛgelɔn le sonla belane kpalɛ. 18Mɔɔ Yihɛde vale adwule anzɛɛ ahyɛlɛdeɛ ne manle ye la, ɔmanle menli mɔɔ zoale ninyɛne ne rale la ziale bɛ nzi hɔle. 19Na yemɔ ɔvale ɔ ti ɔbɔle ɛleka mɔɔ bɛse awolɛ ananze ne mɔ la. Ɛkɛ ne bikye Gelegale. Na Yihɛde eza ziale ɔ nzi hɔle Belemgbunli Ɛgelɔn ɛkɛ ne ɔhɔzele ye kɛ, “ Nana, maa menga wɔ nrɛlaleɛ bie mɔɔ ɔnle kɛ awie te bie la mengile wɔ.”
Belemgbunli ne zele ye sonvolɛma ne mɔ kɛ, “Bɛvinde bɛmaa ɔha yɛ ngome.” Na bɛ muala bɛvindele.
20Akee ɔhale belemgbunli ne angome wɔ ye ekpumgbunli ɛdeɛ ne anu. Ye ekpumgbunli ɛdeɛ ne wɔ sua ne ati zo, na ɛkɛ ne le fɔɔnwo zɛhae. Yihɛde hɔle ɔ nwo ɛkɛ hɔzele ye kɛ, “Melɛ Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ melɛbɛlɛ wɔ.” Belemgbunli ne vi ye ebia ne anu dwazole, 21na Yihɛde nee ye yɛle kyɛlɛ, na ɔvale ɔ sa bɛne ɔhwenle dadeɛ ne wɔ ye ɛzɔlɛ nwo ɔwɔle belemgbunli ne akunlu. 22Dadeɛ ne nee ye fia ne amuala wolole ɔ kunlu; yeandwe dadeɛ ne, na nwonane ne mɔɔ ɛyɛ ɛnlome ngome la vole zolɛ. Dadeɛ ne ati vindele ye ɛzɔlɛ avinli wɔ ɔ nzi. 23Yihɛde akee vindele; ɔtotole anwuma ekpumgbunli ne nlenkɛ ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti anu, 24na ɔhɔle. Nzinlii belemgbunli ne sonvolɛma ne rale, na mɔɔ bɛnwunle kɛ bɛtoto nlenkɛ ne mɔ anu la bɛdwenlenle kɛ, “Kabezɛ ɔlɛsɔho ɔ gyakɛ.” 25Akee bɛzule bɛ sa toonwo ɔhɔdwule mekɛ mɔɔ bɛnea a kabezɛ yewie na yevinde la, na bɛhɔdukuedukuele nlenkɛ ne mɔ. Na nea, belemgbunli ne a la azɛlɛ ne anwo la; yewu!
26Mekɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛkendɛ bɛamaa belemgbunli ne avinde la ɛnee Yihɛde ɛhɔ dɛbadɛba; yepɛ nu ɛleka mɔɔ awolɛ ananze ne mɔ wɔ la, yenriandi yehɔ Siayela. 27Mɔɔ ɔdwule sua ne mɔɔ gua Yifelaem awoka ne mɔ azo la azo la, ɔwule aweɛne nu na Yizilayɛma vindele doale ye na ɔvale bɛ ɔdule ɔdenrɛle kɛ bɛkɔ konle. 28Ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛdoa me, ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛye bɛ kpɔvolɛma, mɔɔ le Mowabema ne ɛmaa bɛ.” Yemɔti bɛ nee ye hɔle bɛhɔduale Mowabema adenle wɔ Dwɔdan ne anloa ɛleka mɔɔ bɛkola bɛwudwu bɛpɛ la. Bɛammaa awie ko bɔbɔ ampɛ nu. 29Bɛhunle Mowabema mɔɔ anwo yɛ se la kɛyɛ apenle bulu; kokye bɔbɔ anvi bɛ sa. 30Kenle ko zɔhane Yizilayɛma lile Mowabema anwo zo konim. Na anzonudwolɛ rale maanle ne anu ɛvolɛ abulatwɛ.
Hyamega
31Sonla bieko mɔɔ dwazole Yihɛde anzi lile Yizilayɛma ati la a le Enate ara Hyamega. Ɔdaye noko ɔvale baka mɔɔ bɛfa bɛka nlankɛ la ɔhonle ɔhunle Filisitiama ɛya nsia na ɔliele Yizilayɛma.

Title: MAA 4
Content:
Dɛbola nee Balake
1Yihɛde ewule ne anzi, Yizilayɛma bɔle bɛ munzule ɛbɛla ne bieko tiale Ɛdɛnkɛma. 2Ɛdɛnkɛma yele bɛ manle Gyeeben mɔɔ le Keena belemgbunli ne mɔɔ di ebia wɔ Heezɔ la. Safohyenlema Kpanyinli mɔɔ ɛnee nea belemgbunli ne ɛlɔnema ne anwo zo la bɛfɛlɛ ye Sesɛla; ɔdɛnlanle Halohyɛte, mɔɔ wɔ menli mɔɔ ɛnle Dwuuma la maanle nu la. 3Na Yizilayɛma zunle vɛlɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma, ɔluakɛ Sesɛla lɛ mbulalɛ ehwili mɔɔ bɛfa bɛko la ɛya ngɔnla, na ɔvale ɔhilele Yizilayɛma nyane toonwo ɛvolɛ abulanwiɔ.
4Mekɛ ne anu ɛnee Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ raalɛ bie mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Dɛbola mɔɔ ɔ hu bɛfɛlɛ ye Lapedo la a le Yizilayɛma ndɛnebuavolɛ a. 5Ɔta ɔtɛnla “Dɛbola” arɛlɛ bo. Arɛlɛ zɔhane gyi Releema nee Bɛtɛle mɔɔ gua Yifelaem awoka ne mɔ azo la avinli. Ɛkɛ ne yɛɛ saa Yizilayɛma bie mɔ nyia edwɛkɛ a bɛkɔ bɛmaa ɔsiezie ɔmaa bɛ a. 6Kenle ko ɔzoanle ɔmanle bɛhɔvɛlɛle Abenoam mɔɔ vi Kidɛhye mɔɔ wɔ Nafetalae la ara nrenya Balake na ɔzele ye kɛ, “Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne se menze wɔ kɛ, ‘Kɔ kɔboɔboa wɔ ɛlɔnema ne anloa wɔ Teebɔ Boka ne azo. Ye menli apenle bulu fi Nafetalae nee Zɛbulɛn mbusua ekpunli ne mɔ anu. 7Na mebamaa Safohyenlema Kpanyinli Sesɛla, mɔɔ nea Gyeeben ɛlɔnema ne azo la ava ye ɛlɔnema nee ye konle mbulalɛ ehwili ne mɔ arayia wɔ azule Kaehyɔn ne anloa na meamaa wɔali ɔ nwo zo konim.’ ”
8Balake buale ye kɛ, “Saa ɛ nee me kɛhɔ ɛdeɛ a, menwɔhɔ, na saa ɛ nee me ɛnrɛhɔ ɛdeɛ a, menrɛhɔ.”
9Dɛbola zele ye kɛ, “Me nee wɔ kɛhɔ; noko akee, ɛnrɛnyia ɛ nyunlu wɔ konimlilɛ ne anzi, ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma baye Sesɛla amaa raalɛzinli.” Na Dɛbola dwazole na ɔ nee Balake hɔle Kidɛhye. 10Balake vɛlɛle Zɛbulɛn nee Nafetalae mbusua ekpunli ne mɔ anu amra menli apenle bulu na ɔvale bɛ ɔlile ɔ nzi ɔrale Kidɛhye. Dɛbola nee ye a hɔle a.
11Mekɛ ne anu ɛnee Kinanli Hiba nee Kinama mɔɔ ɛha la avinli ɛtete, na yehɔbɔ ye nzeseɛ wɔ moa moa, baka kpole bie mɔɔ gyi Zeenanem, mɔɔ zua Kidɛhye la abo. Kinama le Hobabe, mɔɔ le Mosisi aye ne adiema nrenya la abo zo amra.
12Mɔɔ Sesɛla dele kɛ Abenoam ara Balake ɛboɔboa ɛlɔnema anloa wɔ Teebɔ Boka ne azo la, 13ɔvale ye konle mbulalɛ ehwili ɛya ngɔnla ne nee ye ɛlɔnema kɔsɔɔti mɔɔ wɔ Halohyɛte, mɔɔ wɔ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la maanle nu la, na ɔ nee bɛ rale azule Kaehyɔn ne anloa.
14Na Dɛbola zele Balake kɛ, “Bɛdwazo bɛhɔ, ɔluakɛ ɛnɛ kenle ye, Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛye Sesɛla ɛmaa bɛ. Ɛdɛnkɛma li bɛ nyunlu.” Zɔhane ati Balake vale ye ɛlɔnema apenle bulu ne lile ɔ nzi vi Teebɔ Boka ne azo tolole rale aze. 15Na Ɛdɛnkɛma manle Balake hanle Sesɛla nee ye ɛlɔnema nee ye konle mbulalɛ ehwili ne mɔ senle dwɛɛ, na bɛhunle bɛ bie mɔ. Sesɛla vi ye konle mbulalɛ ehwili ɛdeɛ ne anu dwule na ɔvale ɔ gyakɛ ɔzɔle zolɛ. 16Balake voanle Sesɛla ɛlɔnema ne nee konle mbulalɛ ehwili ne mɔ ndinlizo toonwo ɔhɔdwule Halohyɛte, mɔɔ wɔ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la maanle nu la, na bɛ kɔsɔɔti bɛzenle ye dadeɛ ne anloa; sonla ko bɔbɔ anga.
17Sesɛla guale ndwɛlɛ aze la, ɔvale ɔ ti ɔbɔle Kinanli Hibɛ aye Gyeeyɛle ndanlɛ sua ne anwo, ɔluakɛ ɛnee anzonudwolɛ wɔ Heezɔ Belemgbunli Gyeeben nee Kinanli Hibɛ awuke nu amra avinli. 18Gyeeyɛle vindele yiale Sesɛla na ɔzele ye kɛ, “Yɛmenle, mmasulo, bɛla; bawolo me ndanlɛ sua ye anu.” Amgba Sesɛla hɔwolole sua ne anu, na Gyeeyɛle vale ndanlɛ hedale ɔ nwo zo. 19Sesɛla zele Gyeeyɛle kɛ, “Mesɛlɛ wɔ, nzuhɔne ɛlɛku me! Maa me nzule ekyi meno.” Na Gyeeyɛle dule meleke nwoma kodoku ko azo manle ɔnlonle, na eza ɔhedale ɔ nwo zo bieko. 20Sesɛla zele Gyeeyɛle kɛ, “Gyinla ndanlɛ sua ne anlenkɛ ne anloa. Saa awie biala babiza kɛ, ‘Awie wɔ ɛke ɔ?’ a, se ye kɛ, ‘Kyɛkyɛ.’ ”
21Ɛvɛlɛ ngome manle Sesɛla lafele botoo zɛhae. Na Hibɛ aye Gyeeyɛle vale ndanlɛ sua mbaka adakola ne mɔ ko nee hamenle, ɔyɛle nyaa ɔvale Sesɛla ati ɔdole aze bɛtɛɛ, na ɔbɔle ye takola nu kyengye ɔbetanle azɛlɛ ne anwo. Na Sesɛla wule. 22Mɔɔ Balake lɛ ɛnriandilɛ ɛlɛkpondɛ Sesɛla la, Gyeeyɛle yiale ye na ɔzele ye kɛ, “Bɛla, ahenle mɔɔ ɛkpondɛ ye la, mebahile wɔ.” Balake hɔle Gyeeyɛle ndanlɛ sua ne anu, na ɔnwunle kɛ Sesɛla ɛwu, na takola lɛ ye ketekete beta azɛlɛ ne anwo.
23Kenle zɔhane Nyamenle manle Yizilayɛma lile Keena Belemgbunli Gyeeben anwo zo konim. 24Yizilayɛma asa homonle Keena Belemgbunli Gyeeben anwo zo toonwo hɔkpulale kɛ bɛhunle ɔdaye noko la.

Title: MAA 5
Content:
Dɛbola nee Balake edwɛne ne
1Akee Dɛbola nee Abenoam ara nrenya Balake dole edwɛne ɛhye kenle ko ne:
2Bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ!
Yizilayɛ mgbanyima dele bɛ kunlu,
menli ne yeyele bɛ kunlu honle.
3Bɛmɛ arelemgbunli, bɛdie!
Bɛmɛ maanle mgbanyima, bɛgyele bɛ nzo.
Mebado edwɛne, meabɔ agole
meamaa Yizilayɛma Nyamenle ne.
4Ɛdɛnkɛma, mekɛ mɔɔ ɛvile Siyɛ,
na ɛyele ɛ nwo Yidɔm azɛlɛ zo la,
azɛlɛ kpusule, ezule dɔle,
yɛɛ ezule vi amungu ne anu zonyinle.
5 Awoka ne mɔ kpusule wɔ Saenae Ɛdɛnkɛma,
Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne anyunlu.
6Anate ara Hyamega mekɛ zo,
Gyeeyɛle mekɛ zo,
adendulɛma kpole ademgbole,
bɛbule ahane ahane.
7Yizilayɛma amuala guale ɛbɔ nu,
azua kɔsɔɔti dɔle mgbane,
hɔkpulale kɛ Dɛbola dwazole
kɛ Yizilayɛ ɔ nli.
8Yizilayɛma nyianle bɛ nyamenle gyɛne la
yɛɛ konle vale bɛ aze a.
Ɛlɔnema apenle apenle abulanla,
nuhua ko bɔbɔ anva enyinlike na yeayɛ atwɛ.
9Me ahonle la Yizilayɛ safohyenlema anwo,
bɛmɛ a bɛdule bɛ nwo bɛmanle menli ne a.
Ayɛlɛyelɛ ɛha Ɛdɛnkɛma.
10Bɛmɛ mɔɔ bɛtɛnla asoaso fufule zo,
na bɛtɛnla asoaso mbia fondonloo zo,
nee bɛmɛ mɔɔ bɛdua aze la, bɛbɔ nolo!
11Bɛdie edwɛne mɔɔ bɛlɛto ye bula ne mɔ azo,
bɛlɛka Ɛdɛnkɛma konimlilɛ nwo edwɛkɛ,
Yizilayɛ ɛlɔnema konimlilɛ nwo edwɛkɛ ɔ.
Akee Ɛdɛnkɛma menli ne to ɛlɔnwɔne
tia kilikili kɔ bɛ sua zo nlenkɛ mgbole nloa.
12Dwazo, Dɛbola, dwazo!
Dwazo na kpakye ɛ ne nu to edwɛne!
Dwazo, Abenoam ara Balake,
fa wɔ menli ne mɔɔ wɔhye bɛ nuokɛ la kɔ.
13Akɛnrasesebɛma dwazole ye mrenya zo,
Ɛdɛnkɛma menli ne diale ye mrenya zo,
kɛ bɛ nee katakyie ne kaho.
14Bɛvi Yifelaem bɛrale bɔnza ne anu,
bɛdoale wɔmɔ Bɛngyaman nee ɛ nwo amra,
safohyenle mgbanyinli vi Meekɛ rale,
yɛɛ Zɛbulɛn konle nu mgbanyima rale.
15Yesakaa mgbanyima nee Dɛbola rale,
na Yesakaa lile nɔhalɛ manle Balake.
Bɛ muala bɛlile ɔ nzi bɛhɔle bɔnza ne anu.
Noko Wulubɛn abusua ekpunli ne lile abunwiɔ,
bɛangola bɛambɔ kpɔkɛ kɛ bɛkɛhɔ.
16Duzu ati a bɛ nee mboane ne mɔ hale amozi a?
Bɛtie mboaneneavolɛma mɔɔ ɛlɛfɛlɛ bɛ mboane la ɔ?
Wulubɛn abusua ekpunli ne ɛli abunwiɔ,
bɛangola bɛanzi kpɔkɛ kɛ bɛkɛhɔ.
17Gaade abusua ekpunli ne dɛnlanle Dwɔdan Aduduleɛ,
Dan abusua ekpunli ne hale nyevile ne anloa,
Ahya abusua ekpunli ne noko dɛnlanle ɛnwea ne anloa,
na bɛhale nyevile ne anloa.
18Na Zɛbulɛn abusua ekpunli ne vale bɛ ngoane dole nzeleba,
Nafetalae abusua ekpunli ne yɛle zɔhane ala wɔ konle ne anu.
19Arelemgbunli rale rahonle;
Keena arelemgbunli honle wɔ Teeyanake,
wɔ Mɛgedo azule ne anloa;
noko dwɛtɛ fufule ɔ, bɛannyia bie.
20Anwuma nwɔlɔra honle,
bɛlua anwomanyunlu nehane la,
ɛnee bɛ nee Sesɛla ɛlɛko.
21Kaehyɔn azuyilɛ ne pianle bɛ hɔle,
Azule Kaehyɔn ɔ, ye ɛzenlɛ nu yɛ se.
Akee mebava anwosesebɛ meaho meahɔ me nyunlu.
22Akee mgbɔnwɔ ne mɔ lɛ ɛnriandilɛ rale,
bɛsisi bɛ ndwɛlɛ aze zɛhae ala.
23Ɛdɛnkɛma soanvolɛ ne zele ɔ, “Abule ɛbu Milɔzo,
abule ɛbu menli mɔɔ wɔ zo,
ɔboalekɛ bɛambamboa Ɛdɛnkɛma,
bɛambamboa Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛantia katakyiema.”
24Nyilalɛ ɛha Gyeeyɛle ɛdɛla mraalɛ kɔsɔɔti,
Kinanli Hibɛ aye ne.
Nyilalɛ ɛha ye ɛdɛla mraalɛ mɔɔ de ndanlɛ azua nu la.
25Sesɛla zɛlɛle nzule, na Gyeeyɛle manle ye meleke.
Ɔmanle ye meleke kpalɛ wɔ dwora kɛnlɛma nu.
26Ɔdole ɔ sa ɔvale ndanlɛ sua takola,
ɔvale hamenle ɔ sa fema nu;
ɔbɔle takola ne ɔmianle Sesɛla ati,
ɔgelegelele ɔ ti, ɔbɛtɛle ɔ nwoma.
27Sesɛla anwo golole ye, ɔdɔle aze,
ɔlale kɛnlanana wɔ Gyeeyɛle agyakɛ anu.
Ɔgolole ɔguale Gyeeyɛle agyakɛ anu,
ɔgolole ɔguale, ɔwule.
28Sesɛla ɔ nli nleanle nvɛnzɛlɛ nu,
ɔgyinlanle nvɛnzɛlɛ ne anzi ɔbizale kɛ,
“Duzu ati a ye konle ehwili ne mɔ ɛhyɛ zɛhae ɛ?
Duzu ati a yɛnde ye konle ehwili ne mgbɔnwɔ ne mɔ nganeɛ ɛ?”
29Ye mraalɛ mgbanyima ne buale ye,
ɔdaye mumua ne ɔzele ɔ nwo kɛ,
30“Kabezɛ tɛ anwonyia a bɛkpondɛ bɛahyɛ bɛamaa bɛ nwo a,
nrenya ko raalɛ ko anzɛɛ nrenya ko mraalɛ nwiɔ.
Ndanlɛ mɔɔ sonle bolɛ mɔɔ bɛkpondɛ bɛamaa Sesɛla,
nee me kɔme zo aguzo ngɛnlɛma nwiɔ
mɔɔ bɛkpondɛ bɛarɛlɛ me.”
31O Ɛdɛnkɛma, maa menli mɔɔ kpɔ wɔ la abo zo ɛbɔ,
na maa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkulo wɔ la ɛda
wienyi kɛ mangyee sɛnzɛne.
Na anzonudwolɛ rale maanle ne anu ɛvolɛ abulanla.

Title: MAA 6
Content:
Gedɛyɔn
1Yizilayɛma eza yɛle ɛtane tiale Ɛdɛnkɛma, na Ɛdɛnkɛma manle Medeanema ziele bɛ ɛvolɛ nsuu. 2Medeanema asa homonle Yizilayɛma anwo zo kpalɛ. Yizilayɛma zulole Medeanema manle ɔhɔdwule kɛ bɛhyele bɛ nwo ɛhane, bɛsisile ɛvealeka dɔɔnwo wɔ awoka ne mɔ azo, na bɛvunvunle mbɔne wɔ awolɛ nu bɛveale nu. 3Ɔluakɛ mekɛ biala mɔɔ Yizilayɛma kɛlua aleɛ na ɔkɛyɛ kpalɛ la, ɛnee Medeanema nee Amalɛkema nee Aduduleɛ ɛsɛlɛ ne azo amra ɛva konle ɛdoa bɛ. 4Bɛbɔ bɛ nwo atɛnlase wɔ ɛya ne mɔ anu na bɛsɛkye debie biala toonwo bɛkɔkpula Gaza. Bɛfa nuhua debie biala, nlankɛ, mboane, yɛɛ asoaso, na bɛmaa ɔka Yizilayɛma ne kpoholokpo. 5Ɔluakɛ saa bɛse kɛ bɛba a bɛfa bɛ nlankɛ nee ndanlɛ azua a bɛba a. Bɛ somaa maa bɛyɛ menyemenye kɛ abɛbɛ la. Menli nee afunlumu mɔɔ kɛra maanle ne anu la, awie ɛngola bɛ tia. Saa bɛba a bɛsɛkye debie biala mɔɔ wɔ ɛya ne mɔ anu la. 6Yizilayɛma ɛnnyia gyinlagyakɛ wɔ Medeanema anyunlu. Zɔhane ati bɛzunle bɛvɛlɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma kɛ ɔboa bɛ.
7Mɔɔ Yizilayɛma zunle vɛlɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma kɛ ɔboa bɛ, ɔlie bɛ wɔ Medeanema asa anu la, 8Ɛdɛnkɛma manle ye kpɔmanvolɛ vale ye nrɛlaleɛ rɛlɛle bɛ kɛ, “Kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma mɔɔ le Yizilayɛma Nyamenle ne se la ɛne: Menyele bɛ menvile akɛlɛzonlenlɛ nu na menvale bɛ menvile Yigyibiti. 9Menliele bɛ menvile Yigyibitima nee menli mɔɔ sisile bɛ la asa anu, na mendule bɛ, menvale bɛ azɛlɛ ne memanle bɛ. 10Na menzele bɛ kɛ, ‘Mame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne a, bɛmmasonle Amɔlema nyamenle ne mɔ biala.’ Noko bɛandie me ne.”
11Na Ɛdɛnkɛma soanvolɛ radɛnlanle baka kpole bie abo wɔ Ɔfela. Baka ɛhye le Dwowahye, mɔɔ le Ebayizɛ abo zo amra ne mɔ bie la ɛdeɛ. Mekɛ ne anu ɛnee Ebayizɛ ara Gedɛyɔn vea nwanyeyɛlɛ sua ne anu ɛlɛwozo atoko. 12Na Ɛdɛnkɛma soanvolɛ ne yele ɔ nwo hilele ye na ɔzele ye kɛ, “Nrenya katakyie, Ɛdɛnkɛma nee wɔ lua.”
13Gedɛyɔn zele ye kɛ, “Yɛmenle, mesɛlɛ wɔ, saa Ɛdɛnkɛma nee yɛ a lua a ɛnee duzu ati a ɛhye mɔ kɔsɔɔti ɛsisi yɛ nwo zo a? Ye nwanwane nyɛleɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ egya mɔ hanle nwolɛ edwɛkɛ hilele yɛ kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma a yele bɛ vile Yigyibiti la wɔ nienwu? Kɛkala Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛkpo yɛ na yeye yɛ yemaa Medeanema.”
14Na Ɛdɛnkɛma soanvolɛ ne hakyile ɔ nye zele ye kɛ, “Anwosesebɛ totohyia ɛhye mɔɔ kɛkala wɔnyia ye la, fa kɔ kɔlie Yizilayɛma fi Medeanema asa anu. Mame medame a mezoa wɔ a.”
15Na Gedɛyɔn buale ye kɛ, “Awulae, mesɛlɛ wɔ, kɛ menwɔzi menwɔyɛ na mealie Yizilayɛma ɛ? Nea, wɔ Manasɛ abusua ekpunli ne anu, me nlenya mɔ ala a ɛnle awie a, yɛɛ wɔ egya sua nu, medame ala a mele ekyi kpalɛ a.”
16Na Ɛdɛnkɛma soanvolɛ ne zele ye kɛ, “Me nee wɔ bahɔ. Ɛbahu Medeanema kɔsɔɔti kɛ asɛɛ bɛle sonla kokye ala.”
17Na Gedɛyɔn zele ye kɛ, “Saa mezɔ ɛ nye ɛdeɛ a, ɛnee kile sɛkɛlɛneɛ kɛ amgba ɛdawɔ yɛɛ ɛ nee me ɛlɛtendɛ la. 18Mesɛlɛ wɔ, mmafi ɛke ɛkɔ, kɔkpula mekɛ mɔɔ menwɔva me aleɛ ahyɛlɛdeɛ menwɔrɛlɛ wɔ la.”
Ɛdɛnkɛma soanvolɛ ne zele ye kɛ, “Mebahendɛ toonwo kɔkpula mekɛ mɔɔ ɛkɛzia ɛkɛra la.”
19Na Gedɛyɔn hɔle sua nu hɔhunle abɔnkye donle subue; ɔvale esamo ɔdonle kpanwo mɔɔ mgbɔvonle ɛnle nu la. Ɔyeyele nane ne ɔguale kɛndɛne nu na ɔvale subue ne ɔguale siase nu, na ɔvale ɔhɔmanle Ɛdɛnkɛma soanvolɛ ne mɔɔ de baka ne abo la. 20Na Nyamenle soanvolɛ ne zele ye kɛ, “Yeye nane ne nee kpanwo ne gua bolɛ ɛhye azo, na wola subue ne gua zolɛ.” Na Gedɛyɔn yɛle ye zɔhane. 21Akee Ɛdɛnkɛma soanvolɛ ne vale ye kpɔma ne mɔɔ ɔlɛ la ati hanle nane ne nee kpanwo ne, na senle vi bolɛ ne anu zɔle yelale nane ne nee kpanwo ne. Na Ɛdɛnkɛma soanvolɛ ne minliminlinle ɔ nye zo.
22Akee Gedɛyɔn liele lile kɛ amgba Ɛdɛnkɛma soanvolɛ ɔ, na ɔzele kɛ, “O, Awulae Nyamenle! Me nee Ɛdɛnkɛma soanvolɛ yɛ nye ɛyɛ nna.”
23Na Ɛdɛnkɛma zele ye kɛ, “Ka wɔ ahonle to azule nu. Mmasulo, na ɛnrɛwu.” 24Akee Gedɛyɔn yɛle azukponle manle Ɛdɛnkɛma na ɔvɛlɛle ye “Ɛdɛnkɛma le anzonudwolɛ.” Na ɛnɛ nee ɛnɛ ala, ɔtɛgyi Ɔfela. Ɔfela le Ebayizɛma sua zo.
25Kenle ko ne nɔe ne Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Gedɛyɔn kɛ, “Fa ɛ ze ɛnlankɛ nyinli ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nwiɔ mɔɔ ɛli ɛvolɛ nsuu la, bubu ɛ ze mɔ azukponle ne mɔɔ bɛzile bɛmanle Beeyale la, na pɛ bozonle raalɛ Ahyela sɛkɛlɛneɛ baka ne mɔɔ gyi nwolɛ la to. 26Akee fa awolɛ siezie bɛ gyɛlɛɛnye na si azukponle wɔ ezukue ɛhye azo maa Ɛdɛnkɛma wɔ Nyamenle ne. Fa Ahyela baka ne mɔɔ ɛbapɛ la wuda senle na yela ɛnlankɛ nyinli ne fa bɔ azu maa Ɛdɛnkɛma.” 27Zɔhane ati Gedɛyɔn yele ye sonvolɛma ne mɔ anu bulu manle bɛyɛle, kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma zele ye la; noko kɛmɔ ɛnee ɔsulo ye sua nu amra ne nee ezuavolɛ ne somasoma la ati, kɛ ɔkɛbɔ azu ne ewiazo la, ɔbɔle ye nɔɔzo.
28Nwonlomɔ mangyee ne mɔɔ ezuavolɛ ne vi nla nu dwazole la, bɛnwunle kɛ bɛbubu Beeyale azukponle ne, bɛpɛ Ahyela baka ne mɔɔ gyi nwolɛ la, na bɛva ɛnlankɛ ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nwiɔ ne la bɛbɔ azu wɔ azukponle ne mɔɔ bɛzi la azo. 29Na bɛbizebizale bɛ nwo ngoko kɛ, “Ɛnee nwane yɛɛ ɛli gyima zɛhae a?” Bɛbizebizale dedee la, bɛdele kɛ Dwowahye ara Gedɛyɔn yɛɛ ɛli gyima mɔɔ le zɛhae la. 30Ezuavolɛ ne zele Dwowahye kɛ, “Fa ɛ ra nrenya ne finde maa yɛhu ye, ɔluakɛ yebubu Beeyale azukponle ne na eza yepɛ Ahyela baka ne mɔɔ gyi nwolɛ la.”
31Na Dwowahye zele menli ne mɔɔ ɛra ɔ nwo zo la kɛ, “Bɛbagyinla Beeyale agyakɛ anu ɔ? Anzɛɛ bɛbalie ɔ ti ɔ? Awie biala mɔɔ kɛzi ye ɛbolɛ kɛ ɔdie Beeyale ati la bɛbahu ye na aleɛ ahye. Bɛbubu Beeyale azukponle ne, saa ɔle nyamenle a, bɛmaa ɔdaye ɔlie ɔ nwo.” 32Ɛhye ati ɔvi kenle ko zɔhane bɛdonle Gedɛyɔn, Gyɛlɛbeeyale, ɔboalekɛ Dwowahye zele kɛ, “Bɛmaa Beeyale ɛho ɛmaa ɔ nwo”, kɛmɔ Gedɛyɔn ɛbubu ye azukponle ne ɛgua la.
33Akee Medeanema nee Amalɛkema nee Aduduleɛ ɛsɛlɛ zo amra ne mɔ amuala boɔboale bɛ nloa, bɛpɛle Azule Dwɔdan ne, na bɛyɛle bɛ azokoɛleɛ wɔ Gyɛzɛli Bɔnza ne anu. 34Na Ɛdɛnkɛma Sunsum ne dwule Gedɛyɔn anwo zo. Ɔwule aweɛne nu na Ebayizɛma kɔsɔɔti dwazole doale ye. 35Ɔzoanle menli wɔ Manasɛ, na bɛ kɔsɔɔti bɛralile ɔ nzi. Eza ɔzoanle menli wɔ Ahya, Zɛbulɛn, yɛɛ Nafetalae, na bɛ kɔsɔɔti bɛbɔle nu bɛ nee ye hɔyiale.
36Na Gedɛyɔn hanle hilele Nyamenle kɛ, “Saa ɛse ɛdua me nwo zo wɔalie Yizilayɛma amgba a, 37ɛnee melɛfa dwɛsɛ meagua ɛleka mɔɔ bɛwozo ma ne la. Saa aleɛ kye na ɛbɔlɛ wɔ dwɛsɛ ne azo, na bie ɛnle azɛlɛ ne anwo a, ɛnee menwu kɛ amgba ɛdua me nwo zo wɔalie Yizilayɛma, kɛmɔ ɛdawɔ wɔha la.” 38Na ɔyɛle zɔhane. Aleɛ hyenle na Gedɛyɔn hwinle dwɛsɛ ne anu la, ɛbɔlɛ mɔɔ guale aze la yi kanrɛlɛ. 39Na Gedɛyɔn zɛlɛle Nyamenle kɛ, “Mmafa me nwo ɛya. Maa menga edwɛkɛ kpɔkɛ ko bieko. Mesɛlɛ wɔ, maa menva dwɛsɛ ne menyɛ sɔnea ko bieko. Nzinlii ɛdeɛ ye, mmamaa dwɛsɛ ne doa; maa ɔyɛ resee, na maa ɛbɔlɛ ɛloa azɛlɛ ne anwo.” 40Na kenle ko ne nɔe ne, Nyamenle yɛle ye kɛmɔ Gedɛyɔn kpondɛ la. Aleɛ hyenle la ɛnee dwɛsɛ ne le resee, na ɛbɔlɛ ɛloa azɛlɛ ne anwo.

Title: MAA 7
Content:
Gedɛyɔn di Medeanema anwo zo konim
1Gedɛyɔn nee ye ɛlɔnema ne amuala dwazole kenle ko aleɛbahye na bɛhɔdɛle Hɛlɔdo Nzubula ne azo. Medeanema azokoɛleɛ ɛdeɛ ne wɔ Gedɛyɔn ɛdeɛ ne sɔlɔ, wɔ Moli Boka ne foa ko bɔnza ne anu.
2Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Gedɛyɔn kɛ, “Wɔ ɛlɔnema mɔɔ meye Medeanema meamaa bɛ la zonle somaa. Saa bɛzonle somaa a bɛbaze kɛ bɛdabɛ bɛ anwosesebɛ a bɛva bɛli konim a, yemɔti bɛnrɛli me eni; bɛbamemaa bɛ nwo zo. 3 Zɔhane ati kpakye nuhua wienyi ka kile bɛ kɛ, ‘Awie biala mɔɔ nea a ɔ nwo ɛnva ye ɛngɔ la ɛzia ɛhɔ sua nu.’ ” Gedɛyɔn zɔle bɛ nleanle na bɛ nuhua apenle ngoko abulanwiɔ nee nwiɔ ziale, na ɔhale apenle bulu.
4Eza Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Gedɛyɔn kɛ, “Ɛlɔne mɔɔ ɛha la tɛso somaa. Fa bɛ kɔ Azule ne anloa na medame mebakpa nu meaye bie meamaa wɔ. Bɛ nuhua biala mɔɔ menwɔze wɔ kɛ, ‘sonla ɛhye kɔ bie’ la, ɛ nee ye ɛhɔ. Awie biala mɔɔ menwɔze wɔ kɛ ‘ɔngɔ bie’ la, ɛ nee ye mmakɔ.” 5Yemɔti Gedɛyɔn vale ɛlɔnema ne hɔle nzubula ne azo. Ɛdɛnkɛma zele ye kɛ, “Menli mɔɔ kɛva bɛ tafinlima kɛnlo nzule ne kɛ twea ɛlɛno nzule la, kpa bɛ ngome sie ahane. Bɛdabɛ noko mɔɔ bɛkɛhoto kolaa na bɛanlo nzule ne la, kpa bɛ sie foa ko.” 6Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛvale bɛ sa bɛvenle nzule ne bɛnlonle la amuala le ɛya nsa ala. Menli mɔɔ hale la amuala hotole kolaa na bɛanlo nzule ne. 7Na Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Gedɛyɔn kɛ, “Menli ɛya nsa ne mɔɔ vale bɛ sa venle nzule ne nlonle la, bɛmɛ yɛɛ mefa bɛ mealie Yizilayɛma a; memaa bɛali Medeanema anwo zo konim. Yemɔti menli mɔɔ ɛha la, maa biala ɛzia ɛhɔ sua nu.” 8Gedɛyɔn liele bɛ konle ninyɛne ne mɔ, na ɔmanle bɛziale bɛhɔle sua nu, na ɔhale menli ɛya nsa ne ala. Ɛnee Medeanema azokoɛleɛ ne ɛha Gedɛyɔn nee ye ɛlɔnema ne aze wɔ bɔnza ne anu.
9Kenle ko ne nɔe ne Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Gedɛyɔn kɛ, “Dwazo na ɛ nee wɔ ɛlɔnema ɛhɔ Medeanema anwo zo. Wɔli konim wɔwie. 10Saa ɛsulo noko a, ɛnee ɛ nee wɔ sonvolɛ Pula bɛhɔbu bɛzia 11na bɛbade mɔɔ menli ne ɛlɛka la. Ɛhye bamaa wɔazi ahonle ɛ nee bɛ ahɔho.” Yemɔti Gedɛyɔn nee Pula hɔle Medeanema azokoɛleɛ ne kandiba. 12Medeanema, Amalɛkema, yɛɛ Aduduleɛ ɛsɛlɛ ne azo amra ne mɔ ɛyɛ menyemenye kɛ azonlɛ la wɔ bɔnza ne anu, yɛɛ afunlumu mɔɔ bɛlɛ la zonle kɛ ɛnweazo anwea.
13Mɔɔ Gedɛyɔn hɔdwule la, ɔdele kɛ nrenya bie ɛlɛka ɛlalɛ mɔɔ yeha la yeahile ɔ gɔnwo. Ɔse, “Ayi, meka ɛlalɛ la ɛnee kpanwo mɔɔ bɛva abɛlɛ bɛyɛ la ɛhundo ɛra Medeanema azokoɛleɛ ɛke na yeratia yɛ ndanlɛ azua ne mɔ anu ko yegologolo ye yegua bɔkɔɔ.”
14Ɔ gɔnwo ne buale kɛ, “Ɛlalɛ ɛhye abo ɛngile debie gyɛne biala. Kpanwo ne kile Yizilayɛnli Dwowahye ara nrenya Gedɛyɔn konle dadeɛ ne. Nyamenle ɛkpogya ɔ sa zo yemaa yeli Medeanema nee yɛ ɛlɔnema ne anwo zo konim.”
15Mɔɔ Gedɛyɔn dele ɛlalɛ ne nee ɔ bo ɛhilelɛ ne la, ɔyeyɛle Nyamenle. Akee ɔziale ɔhɔle Yizilayɛma azokoɛleɛ lɔ na ɔzele ye ɛlɔnema ne kɛ, “Bɛdwazo, ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛye Medeanema pemgbenleamgbe ne ɛmaa bɛ.” 16Ɔhyɛle ye ɛlɔnema ɛya nsa ne anu ekpunli nsa na ɔvale aweɛne nee dwora mɔɔ tɛkɛ zia nu la ɔmanle awie ko biala. 17Akee ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Awie biala ɛnlea me. Debie biala mɔɔ menwɔyɛ la, bɛyɛ bie. Saa yɛdwu bɛ azokoɛleɛ ne kandiba na debie biala mɔɔ menwɔyɛ la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ bɛdabɛ noko bɛyɛ a. 18Saa me nee me ekpunli ɛdeɛ ne yɛwu yɛ aweɛne ne mɔ anu a, bɛdabɛ noko bɛwu bɛ ɛdeɛ ne mɔ anu bɛdeɛdea nu kɛ, ‘Ɛdɛnkɛma nee Gedɛyɔn bɛ ɛdeɛ ɛne!’ ”
19Gedɛyɔn nee ye ɛlɔnema ɛya nsa ne mɔɔ hale la dwule menli ne mɔ azokoɛleɛ ne kandiba asɛɛ alevinli mu nwiɔ avinli. Ɛnee bɔ zo mɔɔ sinzavolɛma fofolɛ mɔɔ bahakyi dɛba ne mɔ la ɛra ɔ. Akee bɛwule bɛ aweɛne ne mɔ anu na bɛbobɔle dwora ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛdedɛ la. 20Ɛlɔnema ekpunli nwiɔ ne noko yɛle zɔhane ala. Bɛlɛ bɛ tɛkɛ ne mɔ bɛ sa bɛne ne mɔ anu, yɛɛ aweɛne ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛlɛwu nuhua la wɔ bɛ sa fema ne mɔ anu, na bɛdeɛdeanle nuhua kɛ, “Ɛdɛnkɛma konle dadeɛ ko, Gedɛyɔn konle dadeɛ ko!” 21Awie biala andu ɔ bo anvi ɛleka mɔɔ ɔgyi la, noko kpɔvolɛma ɛlɔne ne deɛdeanle nuhua na bɛguale ɛbɔ nu. 22Mekɛ mɔɔ Gedɛyɔn ɛlɔnema ɛya nsa ne ɛlɛwu bɛ aweɛne ne mɔ anu la, Ɛdɛnkɛma manle kpɔvolɛma ne mɔ pɛle bɛ nwo honle na bɛhunle bɛ nwo. Bɛnriandile toonwo bɛhɔle Bɛte Hyeta wɔ Zalɛtan afoa nu nehane, bɛtelele zolɛ bɛhɔdwule Ebɛle Mɛhɔla mɔɔ zua Tabate ɛweɛne zo la.
23Na bɛvɛlɛle Yizilayɛma mɔɔ wɔ Nafetalae nee Ahya nee Manasɛ la, na bɛbelele bɛzile Medeanema zo. 24Gedɛyɔn zoanle menli manle bɛhɔbɔle azua mɔɔ gua Yifelaem awoka ne mɔ azo la amaneɛ kɛ, “Bɛtolo aze bɛ nee Medeanema ɛraho. Bɛzia bɛ wɔ Azule Dwɔdan ne nee azudenle ne mɔ anloa toonwo bɛhɔkpula Bɛtebɛla. Bɛmmamaa bɛ adenle bɛmaa bɛpɛ.” Yemɔti Yifelaemma ravale azudenle ne mɔ amuala nee Azule Dwɔdan ne. 25Bɛvoanle bɛ toonwo bɛhyele Medean mgbanyima nwiɔ, mɔɔ le Ɔlɛbe nee Ziibi. Bɛhunle Ɔlɛbe wɔ Ɔlɛbe Bodane ne azo, yɛɛ bɛhunle Ziibi wɔ Ziibi nwanyeyɛlɛ sua ne anu na bɛvale adile nwiɔ ne, Ɔlɛbe nee Ziibi adile ne mɔ bɛrɛlɛle Gedɛyɔn. Mekɛ ne anu ɛnee Gedɛyɔn wɔ Azule Dwɔdan ne anzi mɔɔ di kɔ aduduleɛ la.

Title: MAA 8
Content:
Medeanema anwo zo konimlilɛ mɔɔ li amozi
1Yifelaem ɛlɔnema ne bɔle Gedɛyɔn somolɛ kɛ, “Duzu amaamuo ɛtane a wɔva wɔbu yɛ la. Duzu ati a ɛ nee Medeanema kaho mɔɔ wɔambɔ yɛ amaneɛ a?” Na bɛhwile ɔ nyunlu kpalɛ.
2Na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Mɔɔ meyɛ la nee mɔɔ bɛyɛ la ɛnrɛzɛ. Ekyi bɔbɔ mɔɔ bɛmɛ Yifelaemma bɛyɛ la sɔ ɛnyelɛ tɛla mɔɔ me ɛlɔnema ne amuala ɛyɛ la. 3 Ɔlua Nyamenle tumi zo, bɛhu Medean mgbanyima nwiɔ ne, Ɔlɛbe nee Ziibi. Na duzu bɔbɔ yɛɛ meyɛ mɔɔ nee ɛhye sɛ a?” Ɔhanle ɛhye la, bɛ ɛya ne dwole.
4Gedɛyɔn nee ye menli ɛya nsa ne rale Azule Dwɔdan ne anloa na bɛpɛle. Ɛnee bɛvɛ, noko bɛvoanle bɛ kpɔvolɛma ne ndinlizo. 5Yemɔti ɔzele menli mɔɔ wɔ Sɛko la kɛ, “Mesɛlɛ bɛ, bɛmaa ɛlɔnema mɔɔ me nee bɛ lua la kpanwo bɛmaa bɛli, ɔluakɛ asɛɛ bɛwie wu. Melua Medean arelemgbunli nwiɔ ne, mɔɔ le Ziba nee Zɛlemɛna ɛhyelɛ.”
6Na Sɛko mgbanyima zele ye kɛ, “Ziba nee Zɛlemɛna mumua ne ɛ sa ɛzɔ bɛ nu wɔhye bɛ yɛɛ yɛmaa wɔ ɛlɔnema aleɛ a?”
7Gedɛyɔn zele kɛ, “Bɛ mo. Saa Ɛdɛnkɛma maa me sa sɔ Ziba nee Zɛlemɛna nu a, bɛmɛ Sɛkoma, mebava fienemgbole nu mbowule mbaka meabila bɛ toonwo bɛ nzi akpakyekpakye.” 8Ɔvi ɛkɛ la, Gedɛyɔn nee ye ɛlɔnema ne hɔle Pɛnuwɛle na ɔhɔzɛlɛle bɛdabɛ noko aleɛ. Na Pɛnuwɛlema noko buale ye, kɛmɔ Sɛkoma buale ye ala la. 9Na ɔzele Pɛnuwɛlema kɛ, “Melɛkɔ, na saa mesia meba anzonudwolɛ nu a, mebabubu bɛ tawa ne meagua.”
10Ɛnee Ziba nee Zɛlemɛna nee bɛ ɛlɔnema ne wɔ Kakɔ. Ɛlɔnema ɛwolaa ne, bɛ nuhua apenle ngoko bulu nee nnu ala a hale a, ɔluakɛ bɛ nuhua apenle ngoko ɛya ko abulanwiɔ ɛdɔ dadeɛ nloa. 11Gedɛyɔn vale Noba nee Dwobɛha aduduleɛ adenle ne azo na ɔhɔle bɛ kpɔvolɛma ɛlɔne ne anwo zo arɛlevilɛ nu. 12Ziba nee Zɛlemɛna nriandile; ɔvoanle bɛ toonwo ɔhɔhyele Medean Arelemgbunli Ziba nee Zɛlemɛna, na ɔbɔle bɛ ɛlɔnema ne asande.
13Mɔɔ Dwowahye ara Gedɛyɔn vi konle ne anloa sia ara la, ɔluale Hilɛse awoka ne mɔ avinli. 14Ɔhyele kpavolɛ bie mɔɔ vi Sɛko la na ɔbizale ye edwɛkɛ, na kpavolɛ ne hɛlɛle mgbanyima titile abulasuu nee nsuu ne mɔɔ gyi bɛ ti la aluma manle ye. 15Gedɛyɔn akee rale Sɛko mgbanyima ne mɔ ɛkɛ. Ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛnlea, Ziba nee Zɛlemɛna ɛne! Bɛmɛ bɛ ti a bɛzile me amgbu kɛ, ‘Ziba nee Zɛlemɛna mumua ne, wɔhola bɛ kye na wɔaze yɛ kɛ yɛmaa wɔ ɛlɔnema aleɛ, ɔluakɛ bɛwie wu?’ la.” 16Ɔhyele suakpole Sɛko azo mgbanyima ne mɔ na ɔvale fienemgbole nu mbowule mbaka ɔlile bɛ nwo gyima ɔhilele bɛ debie. 17Eza ɔbubule Pɛnuwɛle tawa ne ɔguale na ɔhunle suakpole ne azo mrenya kɔsɔɔti.
18Akee ɔbizale Ziba nee Zɛlemɛna kɛ, “Menli mɔɔ bɛhunle bɛ wɔ Teebɔ la kɛ bɛsi bɛde ɛ?”
Bɛbuale ye kɛ, “Kɛmɔ ɛde la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ bɛ ko biala de a; ko biala zɔho belemgbunli ra.”
19Gedɛyɔn zele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛle me mediema fɔɔnwo mɔɔ me nee bɛ vi ɛkolɛ ko anu a. Meka Ɛdɛnkɛma kɛ saa bɛangu bɛ a, anrɛɛ medame noko menrɛhu bɛ.” 20Na ɔzele ɔ ra nrenya kpanyinli ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Gyita la kɛ, “Dwazo ku bɛ!” Noko kpavolɛ ne andwe ye dadeɛ ne, ɔluakɛ ɔle kakula, yɛɛ ɔsulo.
21Na Ziba nee Zɛlemɛna zele Gedɛyɔn kɛ, “Ɛdawɔ mumua ne ku yɛ, ɔluakɛ kɛ nrenya si de la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ ye anwosesebɛ de a.” Yemɔti Gedɛyɔn hunle Ziba nee Zɛlemɛna, na ɔyeyele agudeɛ mɔɔ bɛyɛ ye kɛ siane ɛbule mɔɔ gugua bɛ afunlumu ne mɔ akɔme la.
22Akee Yizilayɛma ne zele Gedɛyɔn kɛ, “Ɛdawɔ di yɛ nwo zo kpanyinli. Ɛ ra nee wɔ anlɔnra noko zɔhane ala. Ɔluakɛ wɔlie yɛ wɔvi Medeanema asa anu.”
23Gedɛyɔn buale kɛ, “Menrɛli bɛ nwo zo kpanyinli, yɛɛ me ra noko zɔhane ala. Ɛdɛnkɛma a bali bɛ nwo zo kpanyinli a.” 24Akee Gedɛyɔn zele bɛ kɛ, “Mesɛlɛ bɛ debie ko; ninyɛne mɔɔ bɛnyianle la awie biala ɛyeye asomadeɛ mɔɔ wɔ nu la ɛmaa me.” (Ɔluakɛ Medeanema wula ezukoa nvutuke asomadeɛ, ɔboalekɛ bɛle Yehyemeeyɛle abo zo amra.)
25Bɛzele ye kɛ, “Yɛ kunlu fufule nwohyee, yɛfa bɛ muala yɛamaa wɔ.” Bɛdɛlɛle ɛdanlɛ azɛlɛ ne anwo na awie biala yeyele ye ezukoa asomadeɛ mɔɔ ɔnyianle la guale zolɛ. 26Bɛdilale ɔ nloa la ɔdole asɛɛ kilo abulanwiɔ; ninyɛne ngɛnlɛma mɔɔ bɛfa bɛsiezie sua nu, ndweabane, arelemgbunli ndanlɛ ngɛnlɛma mɔɔ Medean arelemgbunli hedale, nee afunlumu ne mɔ akɔme ndweabane, bɛmɛ bɛmboka nwolɛ. 27Gedɛyɔn vale ezukoa nvutuke ne yɛle ananze ziele ye sua ne anu wɔ ye sua zo Ɔfela. Yizilayɛma kɔsɔɔti kpole Nyamenle na bɛzonlenle ananze ne. Na ɛhye yɛle ɛhane manle Gedɛyɔn nee ye sua nu amra.
28Yemɔti Yizilayɛma lile Medeanema anwo zo konim bɔkɔɔ. Medeanema angola bɛ nwo kputi bieko. Na akee menli ne dɛnlanle anzonudwolɛ nu ɛvolɛ abulanla, ɔhɔdwule mekɛ mɔɔ Gedɛyɔn wule la.
Gedɛyɔn ewule
29Akee Dwowahye ara Gedɛyɔn hɔdɛnlanle ɔdaye ye sua zo. 30Gedɛyɔn wole mralɛ mrenya abulasuu, ɔluakɛ ɔgyale mraalɛ dɔɔnwo. 31Ɔlɛ ye mgbɔnla wɔ Hyikɛm. Ɔ nee ye wole nrenya ko, na ɔdonle ye Abemɛlɛke. 32Gedɛyɔn yɛle ɛrelera nwosonwoso na yeawu. Bɛziele ye wɔ ɔ ze Dwowahye nla ne anu wɔ Ɔfela. Ɔfela le Ebayizɛ abo zo amra sua zo.
33Gedɛyɔn wule ala la yɛɛ Yizilayɛma ati hakyile bieko a. Bɛkpole Nyamenle na bɛzonlenle Beeyale ne mɔ na bɛvale Beeyale-bilete bɛyɛle bɛ nyamenle. 34Yizilayɛma ne angakye kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne a liele bɛ vile bɛ kpɔvolɛma asa anu wɔ adenle biala anu a. 35Eza bɛangile ahunlunyele biala bɛammaa Gedɛyɔn abo zo amra wɔ moalɛ mɔɔ ɔvale ɔboale bɛ la anwo.

Title: MAA 9
Content:
Abemɛlɛke
1Gedɛyɔn ara Abemɛlɛke hɔle Hyikɛm wɔ ɔ nli amediema ne mɔ ɛkɛ, nee ɔ nli anwo amra amuala ɛkɛ, na ɔzele bɛ kɛ 2bɛbizebiza Hyikɛm ezuavolɛ ne kɛ, “Boni yɛɛ bɛkulo a? Bɛkulo kɛ Gedɛyɔn amra abulasuu ne kɛzie bɛ anzɛɛ sonla kokye ala a kɛzie bɛ a? Eza bɛhakye kɛ bɛ mogya ko ne ala bie a le me.” 3Ɔ nli amediema ne mɔ vale mɔɔ ɔhanle ɔhilele bɛ la hɔbɔle Hyikɛm ezuavolɛ ne amaneɛ. Na bɛ kɔsɔɔti bɛ kunlu dwole fɔɔnwo kɛ Abemɛlɛke ala a sie bɛ a, ɔluakɛ bɛhanle kɛ, “Yɛdayɛ ko ne ala bie a le ye.” 4Na bɛvale dwɛtɛ fufule abulasuu wɔ Beeyale-bilete bozonle sua ne abo bɛmanle ye, na ɔvale ɔbɔle kpamgbanvolɛma bie ɛkpa ɔmanle bɛdoale ɔ bo zo. 5Ɔ nee bɛ hɔle ɔ ze awuke nu wɔ Ɔfela na ɔhunle ɔ mediema ne mɔ, mɔɔ le Gedɛyɔn amra mrenya abulasuu ne kɔsɔɔti wɔ bolɛ ko azo; ɔhale Dwotam, mɔɔ le Gedɛyɔn ara kazima ne angomekye, ɔluakɛ ɔnriandile ɔveale. 6Hyikɛm ezuavolɛ ne nee Bɛtemelo ezuavolɛ ne kɔsɔɔti bɔle nu na bɛvale Abemɛlɛke bɛziele bɛ belemgbunli wɔ oku baka ne mɔɔ gyi Hyikɛm la abo.
7Mɔɔ Dwotam dele ɛhye la, ɔhɔle Gɛlaezem Boka ne azo na ɔdeanle nu ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛmɛ Hyikɛm amra, bɛdie me, na Nyamenle adie bɛdabɛ. 8Kenle ko mbaka kɔsɔɔti hɔle ayia kɛ bɛkaye bɛ nuhua ko bɛazie ye bɛ belemgbunli. Bɛzele ɔlivi baka kɛ, ‘Di yɛ belemgbunli.’ 9Na ɔlivi baka zele bɛ kɛ, ‘Saa menwɔli bɛ belemgbunli a, ɛnee ɔwɔ kɛ megyakyi ma ne mɔɔ meso memaa bɛfa bɛyɛ nwole bɛwula menli nee awozonle ne mɔ anyunlunyia la ɛzolɛ, na meanyia adenle meakpɔsa bɛ nwo zo.’ 10Mbaka ne mɔ hɔzele feege baka kɛ, ‘Bɛla bali yɛ belemgbunli.’ 11Na feege baka zele bɛ kɛ, ‘Saa menwɔli bɛ belemgbunli a, ɛnee ɔwɔ kɛ megyakyi me ma fɛlɛko ne mɔɔ meso la.’ 12Eza mbaka ne mɔ hɔzele vanye baka kɛ, ‘Bɛla bali yɛ belemgbunli.’ 13Na vanye baka zele bɛ kɛ, ‘Saa menwɔli bɛ belemgbunli a, ɛnee ɔwɔ kɛ megyakyi nwanye ne mɔɔ maa awozonle nee menli anye die la ma ne ɛzolɛ.’ 14Akee mbaka ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti zele mbowule baka kɛ, ‘Wɔmɔ, bɛla bali yɛ belemgbunli.’ 15Na mbowule baka zele mbaka ne mɔ kɛ, ‘Saa nɔhalɛ nu, bɛ kunlu fufule nwohyee, bɛkulo kɛ medi bɛ belemgbunli a, ɛnee bɛravea me alubo ye anu; saa bɛanyɛ ye zɔhane a, senle vi me mbowule ye anu bazɔ ayela Lɛbanɔn sida mbaka kɔsɔɔti.’
16“Yemɔti, ɛnee bɛdabɛ bɛnea a, nɔhalɛ nu, ɔle kpalɛ kɛ bɛva Abemɛlɛke bɛzie belemgbunli a? Anzɛɛ bɛdabɛ bɛnea a amaamuo kpalɛ a bɛbu bɛmaa Gedɛyɔn nee ye awuke nu amra la, anzɛɛ gyima kpole ne mɔɔ ɔlile ɔmanle bɛ la, nwolɛ amaamuo a bɛbu la ɔ? 17Bɛhakye kɛ egya honle bɛ ti na ɔvale ye ngoane ɔdole nzeleba ɔliele bɛ ɔvile Medeanema asa anu. 18Noko ɛnɛ bɛho bɛtia egya, bɛhu ɔ mra abulasuu ne amuala wɔ bolɛ ko azo, na bɛva Abemɛlɛke, mɔɔ le akɛlɛ ralɛ la bɛzie Hyikɛm belemgbunli, 19ɔboalekɛ ɔle bɛ nwo sonla. Saa bɛdabɛ bɛnea bɛ ti anu, na bɛli nɔhalɛ kɛ bɛwula Gedɛyɔn nee ye awuke nu amra anyunlunyia ɛnɛ ɛdeɛ a, ɛnee Abemɛlɛke ati, bɛli fɛlɛko na ɔdaye noko ɔli fɛlɛko wɔ bɛ ti. 20Na saa tɛ ye zɔhane ɛdeɛ a, ɛnee senle vi Abemɛlɛke anu ɛzɔ ɛyela Hyikɛm nee Bɛtemelo amra, na senle noko vi Hyikɛm nee Bɛtemelo ezuavolɛ ne anu ɛzɔ ɛyela Abemɛlɛke.” 21Na Dwotam nriandile hɔle Biyɛ, ɔhɔdɛnlanle ɛkɛ, ɔluakɛ ɔsulo ɔ diema Abemɛlɛke.
22Abemɛlɛke ziele Yizilayɛma ɛvolɛ nsa. 23Na Nyamenle manle mgbonde dɔle Abemɛlɛke nee Hyikɛm amra avinli na bɛdele Abemɛlɛke anwo atua. 24Ɛhye zile, amaa Gedɛyɔn amra abulasuu ne mogya agua Abemɛlɛke nee Hyikɛm amra mɔɔ zile ye adua manle ɔhunle bɛ la ati zo. 25Na Hyikɛm ezuavolɛ manle menli hɔdɛle Abemɛlɛke wɔ awoka ne mɔ azo, na bɛzale adendulɛma mɔɔ vale adenle ne azo la bɛliele bɛ ninyɛne. Na bɛrabɔle Abemɛlɛke amaneɛ.
26Na Yibɛde ara nrenya Geeyale nee ɔ mediema ne mɔ dule radɛnlanle Hyikɛm, na Hyikɛm amra vale bɛ rɛle wulale ye nu. 27Bɛ kɔsɔɔti bɛhɔle bɛ vanye ɛya ne mɔ anu bɛhɔtetele vanye ma bɛrayɛle nwanye bɛvale bɛdole ɛkponle kpole bie. Bɛhɔle bɛ nyamenle sua ne abo bɛlile, bɛnlonle na bɛlile Abemɛlɛke ngoamɛ, bɛhehanle ɛtane ɛtane bɛtietiale ye. 28Geeyale zele kɛ, “Abemɛlɛke a le nwane, yɛɛ yɛmɛ Hyikɛm ezuavolɛ, duzu menli a le yɛ mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ yɛsonle ye a? Anzɛɛ tɛ Gedɛyɔn ara ye nee ye abɔlɔba Zibɛle a zonlenle Heemɔ mɔɔ kyekyele Hyikɛm la ɛlɔnema la ɔ? Duzu ati bɔbɔ yɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ yɛsonle Abemɛlɛke a? 29Me kunlu a anrɛɛ menli ɛhye mɔ kɔsɔɔti wɔ me bo, anrɛɛ metu Abemɛlɛke ebia ne azo. Anrɛɛ menwɔze Abemɛlɛke kɛ, ‘Boɔboa wɔ ɛlɔnema ne anloa na finde maamgbole nu maa yɛho.’ ”
30Mekɛ mɔɔ Zibɛle, mɔɔ nea suakpole ne azo la dele edwɛkɛ mɔɔ Yibɛde ara Geeyale hanle la, ɛya hunle ye kpole kpalɛ. 31Ɔzoanle menli ɔmanle bɛhɔbɔle Abemɛlɛke amaneɛ wɔ Alɛma. Ɔse, “Nea, Yibɛde ara Geeyale nee ɔ mediema ne mɔ ɛra Hyikɛm. Bɛlɛmaa ezuavolɛ ne akpamo bɛamaa bɛadu wɔ. 32Yemɔti ɛnɛ nɔe, ɛ nee wɔ ɛlɔnema bɛrazia adenle nu. 33Na ye alehyenlɛ nu, mɔɔ maanle nu kɛtete la wɔahɔnwinwi bɛ wɔ suakpole ne azo; na saa Geeyale nee menli mɔɔ nee ye lua la se kɛ bɛba bɛ nee wɔ araho a, wɔadua bɛ kakɛ, kɛmɔ ɔfɛta la.”
34Abemɛlɛke nee ye ɛlɔnema ne dwazole nɔe ne; bɛhyɛle bɛ nwo ekpunli nna na bɛhɔziale Hyikɛm kandiba ne. 35Geeyale hɔgyinlanle suakpole ne anlenkɛ kpole ne anloa. Abemɛlɛke nee ye ɛlɔnema ne vi ɛleka mɔɔ bɛvea la vindele. 36Geeyale nwunle ɛlɔne ne la ɔzele Zibɛle kɛ, “Nea, menli vi awoka ne mɔ azo ɛlɛtolo ara!”
Zibɛle zele ye kɛ, “Awoka ne mɔ azo ɛlawolɛ ne mɔ a ɛyɛ ɛ nye zo kɛ menli a.”
37Geeyale zile zolɛ bieko kɛ, “Nea, menli vi avinli nehane ɛlɛba. Ekpunli bieko noko vi oku baka ne mɔɔ bɛbɔ menli munzule wɔ ɔ bo la anwo ɛlɛba.”
38Akee Zibɛle zele ye kɛ, “Wɔ mgbole ne mɔɔ ɛka la wɔ nienwu? Tɛ wɔmɔ a ɛhanle kɛ, ‘Abemɛlɛke a le nwane, mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ yɛsonle ye la?’ Menli mɔɔ ɛgolole bɛ nwo la a ɛlɛba la. Finde tɛtɛlɛ nu lɔ ɛ nee bɛ ɛhɔho.” 39Na Geeyale lile Hyikɛm ezuavolɛ ne ati na bɛ nee Abemɛlɛke honle. 40Geeyale dɔle ɛbɔ nu; Abemɛlɛke belele zile ye zo. Menli ne anu somaa bodɛbodale wɔ suakpole ne anlenkɛ kpole ne anloa. 41Akee Abemɛlɛke dɛnlanle Alɛma. Zibɛle voanle Geeyale nee ɔ mediema ne mɔ; yeammaa bɛandɛnla Hyikɛm bieko.
42Aleɛ hyenle la Hyikɛm ezuavolɛ yɛle kɛ bɛfinde bɛahɔ konle ne anloa bieko. 43Abemɛlɛke dele la ɔhyɛle ye ɛlɔnema ne anu ekpunli nsa na bɛhɔziale Hyikɛm amra. Mɔɔ ɔnwunle kɛ bɛvi suakpole ne azo bɛye bɛ ti la, bɛhɔnwinwinle bɛ na bɛhunle bɛ kɔsɔɔti. 44Abemɛlɛke nee ye ekpunli ɛdeɛ ne hanle bɛ nwo ndɛndɛ hɔvale suakpole ne anlenkɛ kpole ne. Ekpunli nwiɔ ne noko hɔnwinwinle menli ne mɔ wɔ konle ɛleka ne na bɛhunle bɛ kɔsɔɔti. 45Abemɛlɛke nee suakpole ne azo amra honle toonwo aledwolɛ. Ɔhunle menli mɔɔ wɔ zolɛ la kɔsɔɔti na ɔvale suakpole ne; ɔbɔle ye tɔɔ na ɔvale ngyenle ɔkpondenle zolɛ.
46Mɔɔ mgbanyima mɔɔ wɔ Hyikɛm aranemgbole ne anu la dele mɔɔ ɛzi la, bɛnriandile bɛhɔveale Beeyale-bilete ɛzonlenlɛ sua ne anu. 47Awie hɔhanle hilele Abemɛlɛke kɛ menli mɔɔ wɔ Hyikɛm aranemgbole ne anu la ɛboɔboa bɛ nloa wɔ bozonle sua ne abo. 48Yemɔti Abemɛlɛke vale ye ɛlɔnema lile ɔ nzi hɔle Zalemɔn Boka ne azo. Ɔvale akuma ɔpɛle baka ko ngane ne mɔ ko ɔdole ɔ kɔme zo na ɔzele ye ɛlɔnema ne kɛ, “Deɛ ɛhye mɔɔ bɛnwu kɛ meyɛ la, awie biala ɛmaa ɔ nwo ɛyɛ ndɛ ɔyɛ bie.” 49Yemɔti awie biala pɛle baka ɛhane ko na bɛlile Abemɛlɛke anzi bɛvale bɛhɔguale aranemgbole ne anloa na bɛdole senle nu, na bɛdabɛ mrenya nee mraalɛ kɛyɛ apenle, mɔɔ wɔ Hyikɛm aranemgbole ne anu la kɔsɔɔti dɔle nzonle.
50Akee Abemɛlɛke hɔle Tibɛze, bɛhɔbɔle bɛyiale ye na bɛhonle bɛvale. 51Aranemgbole bie wɔ Tibɛze suakpole ne azo, yemɔti menli ne mɔ, mraalɛ nee mrenya, nriandile hɔveale zolɛ anwuma. 52Abemɛlɛke hɔle aranemgbole ne anwo na ɔvole ɔhɔle kɛ ɔkado senle wɔ ye anlenkɛ ne anu. Ɔfo la, 53 raalɛ bie gyakyile ɛdibolɛ totohyia bie dole ɔ ti zo manle ɔ ti kpukele. 54Abemɛlɛke vɛlɛle ye sonvolɛ ne mɔɔ soa ye konle ninyɛne ne la kɛ, “Ka ɛ nwo, twe wɔ dadeɛ ne ku me ndɛndɛ, anrɛɛ menli kɛze kɛ, ‘Raalɛzinli a hunle ye a.’ ” Amgba noko kpavolɛ ne wɔle Abemɛlɛke dadeɛ hunle ye. 55Na mɔɔ Yizilayɛma nwunle kɛ Abemɛlɛke ɛwu la, bɛ kɔsɔɔti bɛziale bɛhɔle bɛ sua zo.
56Zɛhae adenle zo a Nyamenle vale duale Abemɛlɛke kakɛ wɔ munzule ɛbɛla ne mɔɔ ɔbɔle ɔtiale ɔ ze, kɛ ɔhunle ɔ mediema abulasuu ne la a. 57Eza Nyamenle manle Hyikɛm amra munzule ne mɔɔ bɛbɔle la bɔle bɛ ti. Ɛhye kile kɛ Dwotam mɔɔ le Gedɛyɔn ara ne amonle mɔɔ wale bɛ la ɛdila.

Title: MAA 10
Content:
Tola
1Abemɛlɛke wule la sonla mɔɔ dwazole kɛ ɔbalie Yizilayɛma la a le Pua ara Tola. Ɔ nlenya a le Dodo, mɔɔ vi Yesakaa abusua ekpunli ne anu la. Ɔvi Hyeemɛ mɔɔ wɔ Yifelaem awoka ne mɔ azo la. 2Ɔziele Yizilayɛma ɛvolɛ abulanwiɔ nee nsa. Ɔwule na bɛziele ye wɔ Hyeemɛ.
Gyeeyɛɛ
3Tola wule la, Gyeeyɛɛ mɔɔ vi Geleade la dwazole. Ɔdaye ɔziele Yizilayɛma ɛvolɛ abulanwiɔ nee nwiɔ. 4Ɔwole mrenya abulasa yɛɛ ɛnee bɛlɛ asoaso abulasa. Eza bɛlɛ azuamgbole mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ bɛ Gyeeyɛɛ namunamu la abulasa wɔ Geleade maanle ne anu. Na ɛnɛ nee ɛnɛ ala bɛtɛfɛlɛ bɛ zɔhane ala. 5Gyeeyɛɛ wule na bɛziele ye wɔ Keemɔn.
Gyɛfeta
6Eza Yizilayɛma yɛle ɛtane tiale Ɛdɛnkɛma. Bɛzonlenle Beeyale ne mɔ nee Ahyela ne mɔ. Bɛzonlenle Selea, Saedɛn, Mowabe, Amɔn, yɛɛ Filisitia awozonle ne mɔ bɛgyakyile Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛzonlenlɛ. 7Ɛdɛnkɛma vale ɛya na ɔyele Yizilayɛma ɔmanle Filisitiama nee Amɔnoma. 8Bɛlile Yizilayɛma anwo zo konim na bɛziele Yizilayɛma mɔɔ wɔ Amɔle azɛlɛ zo wɔ Dwɔdan aduduleɛ mɔɔ wɔ Geleade maanle nu la, na bɛyɛle bɛ kpɔdekpɔde dedee ɛvolɛ bulu nee mɔtwɛ. 9Amɔnoma pɛle Dwɔdan ne na bɛ nee Dwuda abusua ekpunli ne, Bɛngyaman abusua ekpunli ne, yɛɛ Yifelaem abusua ekpunli ne mɔ rahonle. Na Yizilayɛma akee wiele anwunvɔne yɛ.
10Yizilayɛma zunle vɛlɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma kɛ, “Yɛyɛ ɛtane yɛtia wɔ, ɔboalekɛ yɛkpo wɔmɔ mɔɔ ɛle yɛ Nyamenle la, na yɛzonle Beeyale ne mɔ.”
11Na Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Yizilayɛma kɛ, “Na meanlie bɛ meanvi Yigyibitima, Amɔlema, Amɔnoma, yɛɛ Filisitiama asa anu ɔ? 12Saedɛnema, Amalɛkema, yɛɛ Meeyɔnoma sisile bɛ na bɛzunle bɛvɛlɛle me la, meanlie bɛ meanvi bɛ sa nu ɔ? 13Noko bɛkpo me na bɛzonle nyamenle gyɛne, yemɔti menrɛlie bɛ bieko. 14Bɛhɔ na bɛhɔzu bɛvɛlɛ bɛ nyamenle ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛnyia bɛ la na bɛmaa bɛlie bɛ bɛvi bɛ amaneɛnwunlɛ nu.”
15Na Yizilayɛma zɛlɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma kɛ, “Yɛyɛ ɛtane. Debie biala mɔɔ ɛkulo la fa yɛ yɛ. Na ɛnɛ kenle ye ɛdeɛ, yɛsɛlɛ wɔ, die yɛ.” 16Akee bɛkpole bɛ nyamenle ne mɔ na bɛzonlenle Ɛdɛnkɛma. Na Yizilayɛma anwubɛnyunlu ne yɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma nyane nee ɛya.
17Amɔn ɛlɔnema ne boɔboale bɛ nloa na bɛyɛle bɛ azokoɛleɛ wɔ Geleade. Yizilayɛma noko boɔboale bɛ ɛlɔnema ne anloa na bɛhɔdɛle Mezepa mɔɔ wɔ Geleade la. 18Na Geleade mgbanyima nee menli ne bizebizale bɛ nwo ngoko kɛ, “Na nwane bɔbɔ yɛɛ di yɛ ti alumua ahɔdo Amɔnoma anwo etu a? Awie biala mɔɔ kɛzi ye ɛbolɛ kɛlumua la, sonla zɔhane yɛɛ kɛzie Geleadema amuala a.”

Title: MAA 11
Content:
1Gyɛfeta le Geleade ɛlɔnenli ko mɔɔ ze konle nye zo kpalɛ a. Ɔ nli le tuutuunli. Gyɛfeta ɔ ze a le Geleade. 2Geleade aye ne noko ɔdaye ɔwole mralɛ mrenya. Mɔɔ ɔ ye amra mrenya ne mɔ nyinli la, bɛdule Gyɛfeta bɛvile awuke ne anu na bɛzele ye kɛ, “Ɛnli agya wɔ yɛ ze sua nu ɛke, ɔluakɛ asolo ɛ nli.” 3Gyɛfeta vi ɔ mediema ne mɔ avinli dule hɔle Tɔɔbo azɛlɛ zo. Ɔvale ɔ nwo ɔbɔle menli agbamgbanvolɛ bie, na ɔ nee bɛ kpɔsale wuowuale awie mɔ.
4Mekɛ ne hɔle bie la, Amɔnoma vale konle doale Yizilayɛma. 5Mɔɔ ɛhye zile la, Geleade mgbanyima hɔle Tɔɔbo hɔvale Gyɛfeta rale. 6Bɛzele ye kɛ, “Bɛla bali yɛ ti maa yɛ nee Amɔnoma ɛhɔho.”
7Na Gyɛfeta zele Geleade mgbanyima kɛ, “Na tɛ bɛmɛ a bɛhyile me na bɛdule me bɛvile egya awuke nu la. Duzu ati yɛɛ saa akee edwɛkɛ ɛdo bɛ a ɛnee bɛra bɛbakpo me bo zo a?”
8Geleade mgbanyima zele Gyɛfeta kɛ, “Ɛhye ala ati yɛɛ yɛra yɛbakpo ɛ bo zo a, amaa wɔali yɛ ti na yɛ nee Amɔnoma ahɔho, na wɔali Geleade amuala kpanyinli.”
9Gyɛfeta zele Geleade mgbanyima ne kɛ, “Saa bɛ nee me sia kɔ kɛ me nee Amɔnoma ɛhɔho, na Ɛdɛnkɛma maa medi konim a, mebali bɛ belemgbunli.”
10Geleade mgbanyima buale Gyɛfeta kɛ, “Yɛkponle zolɛ, Ɛdɛnkɛma di daselɛ; debie biala mɔɔ wɔbiza la, yɛbayɛ.” 11Yemɔti Gyɛfeta nee Geleade mgbanyima hɔle. Menli ne ziele ye belemgbunli na bɛyɛle kɛ ɔli bɛ ti. Gyɛfeta hanle ye edwɛkɛ muala hilele menli ne mɔ wɔ Mezepa wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu.
12Akee Gyɛfeta zoanle manle bɛhɔbizale Amɔn belemgbunli ne kɛ, “Duzu semunli yɛɛ me menli ne ɛze wɔ, mɔɔ yemɔti wɔra ɛbadoa bɛ ɛ nee bɛ aho a?”
13Amɔn belemgbunli ne buale Gyɛfeta soanvolɛma ne kɛ, “Semunli ne a le kɛ, mɔɔ Yizilayɛma vi Yigyibiti rale la, bɛvale me azɛlɛ, ɔvi Azule Gyabɛke ne anloa toonwo ɔkɔgua Azule Dwɔdan ne anloa. Saa bɛkpondɛ anzonudwolɛ a, ɛnee bɛva me azɛlɛ ne bɛmaa me.”
14Gyɛfeta eza zoanle menli bieko wɔ Amɔnoma belemgbunli ne ɛkɛ ne kɛ, 15“Kɛ Gyɛfeta se la ɛne: Yizilayɛma anva Mowabema azɛlɛ yɛɛ bɛanva Amɔnoma azɛlɛ. 16Bɛvi Yigyibiti la, bɛluale fienemgbole ne anu bɛhɔpɛle Ndɔ Nyevile ne na bɛravindele Keedɛhye. 17 Yizilayɛma zoanle menli manle bɛhɔzele Yidɔm belemgbunli ne kɛ, ‘Yɛsɛlɛ wɔ, maa yɛ adenle maa yɛpɛ nu wɔ wɔ maanle ne anu.’ Na Yidɔm belemgbunli ne amkponle. Eza bɛzoanle menli wɔ Mowabe belemgbunli ne ɛkɛ, na ɔdaye noko yeammaa adenle. Yemɔti Yizilayɛma dɛnlanle Keedɛhye. 18 Nzinlii Yizilayɛma vale fienemgbole ne anu bule hoanenle Yidɔm nee Mowabe. Bɛravindele Mowabe foa ko mɔɔ di kɔ aduduleɛ la, na bɛyɛle bɛ azokoɛleɛ wɔ Azule Aanɔn ne anzi lɔ. Bɛangɔ Mowabe, ɔluakɛ Azule Aanɔn ne a le Mowabe ɛweɛne a. 19 Akee Yizilayɛma zoanle menli manle bɛhɔle Amɔle belemgbunli Saehɔn mɔɔ ɛnee de Hɛhyebɔn la ɛkɛ ne hɔzele ye kɛ, ‘Yɛsɛlɛ wɔ, maa yɛ adenle maa yɛpɛ nu wɔ wɔ maanle ne anu yɛhɔ yɛ maanle nu.’ 20Ɛnee Saehɔn ɛnlie Yizilayɛma ɛnli biala, yemɔti yeammaa bɛ adenle. Ɔboɔboale ye ɛlɔnema anloa, na ɔhɔdɛle bɛ wɔ Gyeehaze, na ɔ nee bɛ honle. 21Na Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne, yele Saehɔn nee ye ɛlɔnema manle Yizilayɛma lile bɛ nwo zo konim. Yemɔti Yizilayɛma vale Amɔlema azɛlɛ ne kɔsɔɔti. 22Bɛvale azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ vi Azule Aanɔn ne anloa toonwo hɔdwule Azule Gyabɛke ne anloa. 23Yemɔti kɛkala, Ɛdɛnkɛma mɔɔ le Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne yɛɛ nee Amɔlema ɛho ɛlie bɛ maanle ne ɛmaa ye menli, Yizilayɛma a. Na duzu tumi yɛɛ wɔmɔ ɛdawɔ ɛlɛ ye mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ ɛsa yɛ ɛdie a? 24Duzu ati yɛɛ bɛnrɛhɔva bɛ maanle ɛdeɛ ne mɔɔ bɛ nyamenle Kimɔhye ne ɛva ɛmaa bɛ la ɛ? Ɔluakɛ azɛlɛ biala mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma, yɛ Nyamenle ne ɛva ɛmaa yɛ la, sinli bɔbɔ, yɛnrɛgyakyi nu. 25 Anzɛɛ bɛdwenle kɛ bɛle kpalɛ bɛtɛla Zepɔ ara nrenya Balake mɔɔ di belemgbunli wɔ Mowabe la ɔ? Kenle ko bɔbɔ ɔ nee Yizilayɛma ɛtɛpelele debie biala anwo anzɛɛ ɔ nee bɛ ɛtɛkonle. 26Ɛvolɛ ɛya nsa mɔɔ ɛze ɛhɔ, mɔɔ Yizilayɛma radɛnlanle Hɛhyebɔn nee namunamu mɔɔ zuozua ye, Alowɛ nee namunamu mɔɔ zuozua ye, yɛɛ azuamgbole mɔɔ gua Azule Aanɔn bɛne nee fema la, duzu ati yɛɛ bɛangɔndu bɛ bɛanlie azɛlɛ ne a? 27Metɛfonle bɛ, yemɔti ɔle nvonleɛ kɛ bɛkɛva konle bɛkɛdoa me a. Ɛdɛnkɛma, mɔɔ le Ndɛnebuavolɛ ne, ɛnɛ kenle ko ye babua manzonle mɔɔ la Yizilayɛma nee Amɔnoma avinli la.” 28Noko Amɔn belemgbunli ne anli Gyɛfeta nrɛlaleɛ ne anwo bie.
29Akee Ɛdɛnkɛma Sunsum ne dwule Gyɛfeta anwo zo. Ɔluale Geleade nee Manasɛ, na ɔtelele zolɛ ɔhɔle Mezepa mɔɔ wɔ Geleade la. Ɔvi Mezepa la ɔhɔvole Amɔnoma akɔme zo. 30Na Gyɛfeta bɔle ɛwɔkɛ wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu kɛ, “Ɛdɛnkɛma, saa ɛmaa medi Amɔnoma anwo zo konim, 31na mesia meara sua nu, na awie biala mɔɔ kɛlumua kɛvi me sua nu ɛkɛ ne kɛvinde kɛ ɔbayia me la le wɔ ɛdeɛ. Mebava ye meayɛ ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ meabɔ azu meamaa wɔ.”
32Gyɛfeta pɛle azule ne na ɔhɔtetale Amɔnoma ɔ nee bɛ honle, na Ɛdɛnkɛma yele bɛ wulale ɔ sa nu. 33Ɔbɔle ye Alowɛ ɔzɛkyele bɛ toonwo ɔhɔdwule Menete afoa nu, azuamgbole ala abulanwiɔ, toonwo ɔhɔkpulale Ebɛle Kɛlamem. Ɔhunle menli ne dɔɔnwo, na Yizilayɛma lile Amɔnoma anwo zo konim.
Gyɛfeta ara raalɛ ne
34Akee Gyɛfeta ziale rale ye sua zo Mezepa, na nea, ɔ ra raalɛ ne bɔle akɛya, zile agole vi awuke ne anu vindele kɛ ɔkayia ɔ ze adenle. Ɔ ze ara ala ɛne. Ɔnlɛ ralɛ nrenya anzɛɛ ralɛ raalɛ bieko ɔmboka ɔ nwo. 35 Gyɛfeta nwunle ɔ ra raalɛ ne la, ɔsuosuanle ye tɛladeɛ mɔɔ ɔwula la anu na ɔhanle kɛ, “Me ra raalɛ! Duzu ati a wɔde me ɛbolɛ kpole zɛhae ɛ? Mebɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛwɔkɛ mɔɔ hyia a, yɛɛ metwe mesia a ɔnyɛ boɛ.”
36Ɔ ra raalɛ ne buale ye kɛ, “Egya, saa wɔbuke ɛ nloa wɔbɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛwɔkɛ a, ɛnee fa me yɛ deɛ mɔɔ vi ɛ nloa anu vindele la, ɔluakɛ kɛkala, Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛli Amɔnoma mɔɔ le wɔ kpɔvolɛma la nzenralɛ ne ɛmaa wɔ.” 37Na ɔzɛlɛle ɔ ze kɛ, “Debie ko ala a mesɛlɛ wɔ a, na yemɔ a le ɛhye: maa me siane nwiɔ maa me nee me gɔnwo mɔ yɛhɔ awoka ne mɔ azo lɔ na mengɔnzu me belamunli nu alɔbɔlɛ ewule.” 38Ɔ ze kponlenle siane nwiɔ ne azo na ɔzele kɛ ɔhɔ. Ɔ nee ɔ gɔnwo mɔ hɔle awoka ne mɔ azo, na ɔhɔzunle ɔ nwo kɛ yeannwu nrenya yeanwo ralɛ na yeawu a. 39Siane nwiɔ ne dwule la ɔziale ɔrale ɔ ze anwo ɛkɛ ne, na ɔ ze vale ye yɛle mɔɔ ye ɛwɔkɛ ne se la. Ɛnee ɔ ra raalɛ ne ɛnze nrenya fee.
Na ɔrayɛle maamɛla wɔ Yizilayɛ maanle nu 40kɛ ɛvolɛ biala dwu a Yizilayɛ mraalɛ kɔsu Geleadenli Gyɛfeta ara raalɛ ne kenle nna.

Title: MAA 12
Content:
Gyɛfeta nee Yifelaemma
1Yifelaemma boɔboale ɛlɔnema anloa. Bɛpɛle Azule Dwɔdan ne bɛhɔle Zeefɔn bɛhɔbizale Gyɛfeta kɛ, “Duzu ati a bɛrazenle bɛ nee Amɔnoma hɔhonle na bɛambɔ yɛ amaneɛ bɛammaa yɛ nee bɛ angɔ ɛ? Yɛyela bɛ sua ye yɛagua bɛ ti zo.”
2Gyɛfeta zele bɛ kɛ, “Me menli ne nee Amɔnoma nyianle konle. Mendole ɛsalɛ menvɛlɛle bɛ la bɛambanlie me. 3Mɔɔ menwunle kɛ bɛnrɛlie me bɛnrɛvi Amɔnoma asa anu la, yɛɛ menvale me ngoane mendole nzeleba a. Mempɛle azule ne mendoale Amɔnoma na Ɛdɛnkɛma yele bɛ manle me. Duzu ati yɛɛ ɛnɛ bɛdwazo kɛ akee bɛ nee me baho a?” 4Gyɛfeta boɔboale Geleade ɛlɔnema kɔsɔɔti anloa. Bɛ nee Yifelaemma honle na bɛlile bɛ nwo zo konim. (Yifelaemma ka kɛ, “Geleadema mɔɔ wɔ Yifelaem nee Manasɛ la le Yifelaemma mɔɔ ɛde atua na bɛnriandi bɛvi bɛ maanle nu a.”) 5Amaa Yifelaemma annyia adenle annriandi la, Geleadema hɔziale Azule Dwɔdan ne anloa, ɛleka mɔɔ bɛpɛ azule ne la. Saa Yifelaemenli nriandi badwu ɛkɛ ne na ɔse kɛ, “Bɛpɛ me azule” a, ɛnee Geleadema ne biza ye kɛ, “Ɛle Yifelaemenli ɔ?” Saa ɔse kɛ, “Kyɛkyɛ” a, 6ɛnee bɛse ye kɛ, “Ka edwɛkɛkpɔkɛ ‘Hyebɔlɛte.’ ” Saa ɔka a ɔse, “Sebɔlɛte,” ɔluakɛ Yifelaemenli ɛnze edwɛkɛkpɔkɛ zɔhane ka. Kɛ bɛnwu kɛ ɔle Yifelaemenli la ɛnee bɛhu ye wɔ Dwɔdan ne anloa ɛkɛ ne ala. Mekɛ zɔhane anu bɛhunle Yifelaemma apenle ngoko abulanla nee nwiɔ
7Gyɛfeta ziele Yizilayɛma ɛvolɛ nsia. Na Geleadenli Gyɛfeta wule na bɛziele ye wɔ ye sua zo Geleade.
Yebezan, Yilɔn, yɛɛ Abedɛn
8Gyɛfeta wule la, Yebezan mɔɔ vi Bɛtelɛhɛm la a ralile Yizilayɛma ati a. 9Ɛnee ɔlɛ mralɛ mrenya abulasa yɛɛ mralɛ mraalɛ abulasa. Ɔvale ɔ mra mraalɛ ne mɔ ɔmanle abusua ekpulike gyɛne nu mrenya agyalɛ na yeahɔgya abusua ekpulike gyɛne nu mraalɛ yeamaa ɔ mra mrenya ne mɔ. Ɔdaye noko ɔlile Yizilayɛma ati ɛvolɛ nsuu. 10Yebezan wule na bɛziele ye wɔ Bɛtelɛhɛm.
11Yebezan wule la, Yilɔn mɔɔ vi Zɛbulɛn abusua ekpunli nu la a lile Yizilayɛma ati a. Ɔlile bɛ ti ɛvolɛ bulu. 12Yilɔn mɔɔ vi Zɛbulɛn abusua ekpunli ne anu la wule na bɛziele ye wɔ Ayegyalɔn wɔ Zɛbulɛn maanzinli nu.
13Yilɔn wule la, Helɛle mɔɔ vi Paeleetɔn la ara Abedɛn a lile Yizilayɛma ati a. 14Ɔwole mrenya abulanla yɛɛ ɔnyianle nlɔnra abulasa mɔɔ hanle asoaso abulasuu a. Ɔlile Yizilayɛma ati ɛvolɛ mɔtwɛ. 15Na Abedɛn wule. Bɛziele ye wɔ Paeleetɔn mɔɔ wɔ Yifelaem azɛlɛ zo, wɔ Amalɛke maanle nu la awoka ne mɔ azo.

Title: MAA 13
Content:
Samesɛn awolɛ ne
1Eza Yizilayɛma yɛle ɛtane bieko tiale Ɛdɛnkɛma. Yemɔti Ɛdɛnkɛma vale bɛ wulale Filisitiama abo ɛvolɛ abulanla. 2Mekɛ ɛhye anu ɛnee nrenya bie wɔ Zɔla, bɛfɛlɛ ye Manowa. Ɔvi Dan abusua ekpunli ne anu. Ɔ ye le mota; ɔtɛwole ɛlɛ. 3Ɛdɛnkɛma soanvolɛ yele ɔ nwo hilele raalɛ ne na ɔzele ye kɛ, “Wɔmɔ, ɛle mota; ɛtɛwole ralɛ ɛlɛ. Ɛbava ɛkolɛ na wɔawo ralɛ nrenya. 4Yemɔti nea boɛ. Mmano nwanye anzɛɛ nza ɛsesebɛ biala. 5Mmadi debie biala mɔɔ nwolɛ ɛnde la. Ɔluakɛ ɛbanrenzɛ wɔawo ralɛ nrenya. Mmafa dadeɛ dɛma ɛka ɔ ti enrinli, ɔluakɛ kenle ko ne ala mɔɔ bɛkɛwo ye bɛkɛdo aze la, bɛbadu ye bɛazie ahane bɛamaa Nyamenle kɛ ɔle ‘Tusiemaa-Nyamenle’ ralɛ. Na yemɔ yɛɛ ɔbalie Yizilayɛma yeavi Filisitiama asa anu a.”
6Raalɛ ne rabɔle ɔ hu amaneɛ kɛ, “Nyamenle sonla ɛye ɔ nwo ɛhile me. Ɔ nwo yɛ ɛzulolɛ na ɔ nyunlu zɔho Nyamenle soanvolɛ. Meambiza ye ɛleka mɔɔ ɔvi la, yɛɛ ɔdaye noko yeambɔ ye duma yeangile me. 7Na ɔzele me kɛ, ‘Nea, ɛbava ɛkolɛ na wɔawo ralɛ nrenya; yemɔti mmano nwanye anzɛɛ nza ɛsesebɛ, yɛɛ mmadi debie biala mɔɔ nwolɛ ɛnde la, ɔluakɛ kakula ne le “Tusiemaa-Nyamenle” ralɛ mɔɔ kile kɛ ɔle Nyamenle ɛdeɛ, ɔvi ye awolɛ nu kɔkpula ye ewule nu.’ ”
8Na Manowa zɛlɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma kɛ, “O Ɛdɛnkɛma, mesɛlɛ wɔ, maa Nyamenle sonla ne mɔɔ ɛzoanle ye la ɛrɛla bieko, na ɔrahile yɛ kɛ yɛzi yɛyɛ kakula ne mɔɔ bɛbawo ye la.”
9Nyamenle diele Manowa nzɛlɛlɛ ne. Na mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee raalɛ ne wɔ ye ɛya nu la, Nyamenle soanvolɛ ne ziale rale ɔ nwo ɛkɛ ne bieko. Ɛnee ɔ hu Manowa ɛnle ɔ nwo ɛkɛ. 10Yemɔti raalɛ ne vale ɛnriandilɛ hɔbɔle ɔ hu amaneɛ kɛ, “Nea, nrenya ne mɔɔ ɛkenle yele ɔ nwo hilele me la ɛra bieko.”
11Manowa dwazole lile ɔ ye anzi, na bɛradole nrenya ne la ɔzele ye kɛ, “Wɔmɔ a ɛhanle edwɛkɛ ne ɛhilele raalɛ ye la ɔ?”
Nrenya ne buale kɛ, “Ɛhɛe, medame ɔ.”
12Manowa bizale ye kɛ, “Saa wɔ edwɛkɛ ne yɛ nɔhalɛ a, ɛnee duzu a ɔwɔ kɛ kakula ne yɛ a, yɛɛ duzu ɛbɛla a ɔwɔ kɛ ɔbɔ a?”
13Ɛdɛnkɛma soanvolɛ ne zele Manowa kɛ, “Edwɛkɛ biala mɔɔ meha mehile raalɛ ne la maa ɔli zolɛ. 14Debie biala mɔɔ bɛva vanye ma bɛyɛ la, ɔmmafa bie ɔka ɔ nloa. Eza ɔmmano nwanye anzɛɛ nza ɛsesebɛ biala, yɛɛ ɔmmadi debie biala mɔɔ nwolɛ ɛnde la. Ɛhye mɔ kɔsɔɔti mɔɔ meha la ɔwɔ kɛ ɔdi zolɛ.”
15-16Ɛnee Manowa ɛnze kɛ nrenya ne le Ɛdɛnkɛma soanvolɛ, yemɔti ɔzele ye kɛ, “Mesɛlɛ wɔ, kendɛ ekyii maa yɛva abɔnkye yɛbu akposi ekyi yɛmaa wɔ.”
Ɛdɛnkɛma soanvolɛ ne zele Manowa kɛ, “Saa ɛkye me ɛsie ɛke bɔbɔ a, menrɛli wɔ aleɛ ne. Na saa ɛkulo a, ɛnee yela nane ne bɔ azu maa Ɛdɛnkɛma.”
17Manowa bizale Ɛdɛnkɛma soanvolɛ ne kɛ, “Kɛ bɛfɛlɛ wɔ ɛ, amaa saa wɔ edwɛkɛ ne yɛ nɔhalɛ a yɛawula wɔ anyunlunyia?”
18 Na Ɛdɛnkɛma soanvolɛ ne zele ye kɛ, “Duzu ati a ɛkulo kɛ ɛnwu me duma a? Ɔle duma ɛzulolɛ bie.”
19Na Manowa vale abɔnkye ne nee nwolɛ aleɛ ne bɔle azu wɔ bolɛ zo manle Ɛdɛnkɛma, mɔɔ yɛ nwanwane ninyɛne la. 20-21Mɔɔ azubɔlɛ senle ne kpogyale ɔ nwo zo bolonwonwo wɔ azukponle ne azo la, Manowa nee ɔ ye nwunle kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma soanvolɛ ne lua nuhua ɛlɛkɔ anwuma, na bɛ nye hale ɔ nwo. Ɛzulolɛ manle bɛbutubutule bɛ nye aze, na Manowa nee ɔ ye annwu Ɛdɛnkɛma soanvolɛ ne bieko. Na Manowa nwunle kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma soanvolɛ ɔ.
22Manowa zele ɔ ye kɛ, “Yɛnwu Nyamenle! Yɛbawu”
23Na ɔ ye buale ye kɛ, “Saa Ɛdɛnkɛma kɛhu yɛ a, anrɛɛ yeanlie yɛ sa nu azubɔdeɛ ne; anrɛɛ ɔnrɛhile yɛ ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ anzɛɛ ɔnrɛha ɛhye mɔ amuala ɔnrɛhile yɛ.”
24Raalɛ ne wole ralɛ nrenya na bɛdonle ye Samesɛn. Kakula ne nyinle, na Ɛdɛnkɛma yilale ye. 25Na Ɛdɛnkɛma Sunsum ne manle ye anwosesebɛ. Mekɛ ne anu ɛnee ɔde Dan abusua ekpunli ne azokoɛleɛ ne, wɔ Zɔla nee Yehyeteɔlo avinli.

Title: MAA 14
Content:
Samesɛn nee Temena bɛlɛra ne
1Kenle ko Samesɛn hɔle Temena, na ɔnwunle Filisitia bɛlɛra bie. 2Ɔziale ɔhɔle sua nu la ɔbɔle ɔ ze nee ɔ nli amaneɛ kɛ, “Menwu Filisitia bɛlɛra bie na me ahonle ɛva ye, yemɔti bɛhɔgya ye bɛmaa me.”
3Ɔ ze nee ɔ nli zele ye kɛ, “Anzɛɛ raalɛ biala ɛnle yɛ abusua ekpulike ɛdeɛ ye anu mɔɔ ɛgya ye a ɔyɛ boɛ, mɔɔ yemɔti ɛkɔ menli mɔɔ ɛnze Nyamenle la avinli wɔahɔgya raalɛ a?”
Samesɛn zele ɔ ze kɛ, “Bɛgya ye bɛmaa me, ɔluakɛ me ahonle ɛva ye kpalɛ.”
4Samesɛn ɔ ze nee ɔ nli ɛnze kɛ ɛhye mɔ kɔsɔɔti Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛɛ ɛlɛyɛ a, ɔluakɛ ɛnee Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛlɛkpondɛ adenle yealua nu yeadua Filisitiama kakɛ. Mekɛ zɔhane anu ɛnee Filisitiama a sie Yizilayɛma a.
5Yemɔti Samesɛn nee ɔ ze nee ɔ nli hɔle Temena. Bɛdwule Temena la Samesɛn hɔkpɔsale Temena vanye ɛya ne mɔ anu, na ɔnwunle kɛ awenade ekyi bie ɛlɛkpo nee ye ayia. 6Ɛkɛ ne ala Ɛdɛnkɛma Sunsum ne dwule ɔ nwo zo. Ɔvale ɔ sa mgbane ɔtetele awenade ne kɛ asɛɛ abɔnkye ralɛ bie la. Noko ɛhye mɔɔ ɔyɛle la yeanga yeangile ɔ ze nee ɔ nli.
7Akee ɔhɔle na ɔ nee raalɛ ne hɔlile adwelie, na Samesɛn anye liele. 8Yeangyɛ biala yɛɛ Samesɛn hɔgyale bɛlɛra ne a. Mɔɔ ɔlua adenle ne anu ɔlɛkɔ la, ɔdole ɔ nye ɔnleanle awenade funli ne, na ɛnee awenade funli ne ɛlɔ wolɛ. 9Ɔvale ɔ sa ɔbule wolɛ ndɛlamoa ne bie, na mɔɔ ɔ gyakɛ wɔ zolɛ la ɛnee ɔlɛdi. Ɔvale bie ɔhɔmanle ɔ ze nee ɔ nli, na bɛdabɛ noko bɛlile. Noko yeanga yeangile bɛ kɛ ɔbule wolɛ ndɛlamoa ne ɔvile awenade funli nu.
10Samesɛn ɔ ze hɔle raalɛ ne sua zo, na Samesɛn dole ɛkponle wɔ ɛkɛ. Ɛhye le amaamuo mɔɔ mgbavolɛ ne mɔ ɔyɛ a bu a. 11Mɔɔ menli ne mɔ nwunle ye la bɛyele mgbavolɛ abulasa bɛmanle ye kɛ ɔ nee bɛ ɛlua. 12Na Samesɛn zele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛmaa mengye bɛ agyebɛ ko. Saa bɛkola ɔ nloa ye wɔ kenle nsuu ye mɔɔ yɛfa yɛado ɛkponle ye la anu a, menwɔmaa bɛ adɛladeɛ fufule abulasa yɛɛ ɛvoyialilɛ adɛladeɛ abulasa; 13na saa bɛangola ɔ nloa ye a, ɛnee ɔwɔ kɛ bɛdabɛ noko bɛmaa me adɛladeɛ fufule abulasa yɛɛ ɛvoyialilɛ adɛladeɛ abulasa.”
Na bɛzele ye kɛ, “Gye wɔ agyebɛ ne maa yɛdie.”
14Na Samesɛn gyele bɛ zɛhae,
“Debie mɔɔ bɛdi la vi mɔɔ di debie la anu rale.
Debie fɛlɛko vi mɔɔ anwo yɛ se la anu rale.”
Kenle kɔkɔlɛ nsa ɛnee awie biala ɛtɛkolale agyebɛ ne anloa ye.
15Ye kenle nna ne azo bɛzele Samesɛn aye ne kɛ, “To ɛ hu agyiba maa ɔye ye agyebɛ ne anloa anrɛɛ yɛyela wɔ nee ɛ ze awuke nu amra amuala. Bɛva yɛ bɛra ɛke kɛ bɛbabɔ yɛ anyiemgba ɔ?”
16Na Samesɛn aye ne zunle ɔ hu akɔme nu zele kɛ, “Ɛkpɔ me, ɛngulo me. Wɔgye me menli ne agyebɛ na wɔanga ye nyelebɛnloa ne wɔangile me.”
Samesɛn zele ɔ ye kɛ, “Duzu ati yɛɛ menga mengile wɔ a? Nea, egya nee ɔmɔ bɔbɔ, metɛkanle metɛkilele bɛ.” 17Ɔ ye zunle ɛhye anwo toonwo kenle nsuu ne mɔɔ bɛvale bɛdole ɛkponle ne la dwule. Kenle nsuu ne azo mɔɔ ɛnee akee ɛzunlɛ ne ɛyɛ ye abodelɛ la, ɔhanle agyebɛ ne nyelebɛnloa ɔhilele ye. Na ɔdaye noko ɔhanle ɔhilele ye menli ne. 18Kenle nsuu ne azo, suakpole ne azo amra hanle nyelebɛnloa ne hilele Samesɛn kolaa na sɛnzɛne ne adɔ. Bɛyele ɔ nloa zɛhae,
“Duzu a yɛ fɛ tɛla wolɛ a?
Duzu a anwo yɛ se tɛla awenade a?”
Samesɛn buale bɛ kɛ,
“Saa bɛanva me ɛnlankɛ bɛangɔ ɛyazonlɛ a,
anrɛɛ bɛnrɛnwu me agyebɛ ne anzi ɛlɛ.”
19Na Ɛdɛnkɛma Sunsum ne dwule ɔ nwo zo kpole bie. Ɔhɔle Ahyekɛlɔn ɔhɔhunle sua ne azo amra abulasa, na ɔyeyele bɛ nwo ɛvoyialilɛ adɛladeɛ ne mɔ ɔrɛlɛle menli mɔɔ yele ye agyebɛ ne anloa la. Ɔvale ɛya kpole, na ɔziale ɔhɔle ɔ ze sua zo. 20Na bɛvale Samesɛn aye ne bɛmanle mɔɔ kyekyele agyalɛ ne abo la gyale ye.

Title: MAA 15
Content:
1Mekɛ guale nu ekyii, mɔɔ ɛnee bɛlɛbu abɛlɛ la, Samesɛn vale abɔnkye hɔle kɛ ɔkakpɔla ɔ ye. 2Ɔzele kɛ, “Mekɔ me ye anwo wɔ ye sua kunlu ɛkɛ.”
Na ɔ ye ɔ ze ammaa ye adenle. Ɔzele ye kɛ, “Mendwenlenle kɛ ɛngulo ye bieko, yemɔti menvale ye memanle ɛ gɔnwo ne. Ɔ diema raalɛ ekyi ne anwo yɛ fɛ tɛla ye. Mesɛlɛ wɔ, gya yemɔ.”
3Samesɛn zele kɛ, “Ɛnɛ ɛdeɛ, saa mebu Filisitiama amaamuo ɛtane a, awie biala mmafu me.” 4Yemɔti Samesɛn hɔhyele ɛzonlɛ ɛya nsa; ɔvale nwiɔ biala adua ɔbɔle bɛ kpɔkɛ na ɔvale tɛkɛ ɔkyekyele dualɛ biala mɔɔ yebɔ bɛ kpɔkɛ la. 5Akee ɔvale senle ɔsosɔle tɛkɛ ne mɔ na ɔgyakyile ɛzonlɛ ne mɔ ɔmanle bɛhɔle Filisitiama abɛlɛ ɛya avule ne mɔ anu. Bɛhɔyelale abɛlɛ mɔɔ bɛbu bɛhua nee mɔɔ bɛtɛbule, nee ɔlivi ɛya avule ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti. 6Filisitiama ne bizale kɛ, “Ɛnee nwane yɛɛ ɛbɔ ɛbɛla ɛhye a?” Na bɛdele kɛ Samesɛn ɔ, ɔluakɛ ɔ ye ɔ ze ne mɔɔ vi Temena la ɛva ɔ ye ɛmaa ɔdaye Samesɛn ɔ gɔnwo ɛgya ye. Na Filisitiama rale na bɛrayelale ɔ ye nee ɔ ze.
7Na Samesɛn zele bɛ kɛ, “Saa amaamuo zɛhae yɛɛ bɛbu ɛdeɛ a, ɛnee meka, meka kɛ, saa metɛyɛle bɛ bie metɛsiele ɔ bo zo a, menrɛla.” 8Ɔhɔle bɛ nwo zo na ɔhunle bɛ bie mɔ dɔɔnwo. Akee ɔhɔle na ɔhɔdɛnlanle bolɛ bɔne bie anu wɔ Yitam bodane ne azo.
Samesɛn di Filisitiama anwo zo konim
9Akee Filisitiama raziale Dwuda, na bɛvale konle bɛdoale Lihaema. 10Na Dwudama bizale bɛ kɛ, “Duzu ati yɛɛ bɛva konle bɛradoa yɛ a?”
Bɛbuale kɛ, “Yɛra kɛ yɛbahye Samesɛn, na mɔɔ yeva yeyɛ yɛ la, yɛdayɛ noko yɛayɛ ye bie.” 11Na Dwudama apenle nsa hɔle Yitam bodane ne bɔne ne mɔɔ Samesɛn wɔ nu la anu na bɛzele ye kɛ, “Ɛnze kɛ Filisitiama a sie yɛ ɔ? Na ɛhye noko mɔɔ wɔhɔhwe wɔra la abo a le duzu?”
Samesɛn zele bɛ kɛ, “Amaamuo mɔɔ bɛbule bɛmanle me la yɛɛ menlea zolɛ mebu bie memaa bɛ a.”
12Na bɛzele ye kɛ, “Yɛra kɛ yɛbakyekye wɔ yɛahɔmaa Filisitiama.”
Samesɛn zele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛha ndane kɛ bɛmɛ bɛdabɛ mumua ne bɛnrɛhu me.”
13Bɛzele ye kɛ, “Nɔhalɛ, yɛnrɛhu wɔ. Yɛkyekye wɔ yɛahɔwula bɛ sa nu ala.” Akee bɛhyele ye na bɛvale samgbe nyɛma amolɛ nwiɔ bɛkyekyele ye na bɛ nee ye vi bolɛ bɔne ne anu hɔle.
14Mɔɔ bɛ nee ye radwule Lihae la, Filisitiama vale ɛwudolɛ nriandile rayiale ye. Na Ɛdɛnkɛma Sunsum ne dwule ɔ nwo zo kpole kpalɛ, na ɔtetele samgbe nyɛma amolɛ nwiɔ ne mɔɔ bɛvale bɛkyekyele ɔ sa la kɛ asɛɛ dwɛsɛ mɔɔ senle ɛdɔ nu la. 15Na ɔ nye bɔle asoaso awudwelɛ bowule amolɛ zo, na ɔvale ɔhunle menli apenle. 16Na Samesɛn zele kɛ,
“Meva asoaso awudwelɛ bowule
mehuohua bɛ ɛdukue ɛdukue;
meva asoaso awudwelɛ bowule
mehu menli apenle.”
17Mɔɔ ɔwiele tendɛ la, ɔvuandinle awudwelɛ bowule ne mɔɔ ɔlɛ la ɔdole; na bɛvɛlɛle ɛleka mɔɔ ɔdɔle la Releemate Lihae. (Ɔ bo a le Awudwelɛ Bowule Boka.)
18Akee nzuhɔne hunle ye kpole kpalɛ, na ɔzɛlɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma kɛ, “Wɔlua wɔ sonvolɛ nwo zo wɔlie wɔ menli ye ngoane. Na nzuhɔne ɛlɛku me yeamaa meadɔ donvula wɔ menli mɔɔ ɛnze Nyamenle la asa anu ɔ?” 19Na Nyamenle manle nzule vi azɛlɛ bo vindele kuma bie anu manle ye wɔ Lihae. Samesɛn nlonle bie na ye ahonle gyinlanle na ɔ nwo yɛle se. Yemɔti bɛdonle nzule ne “Hakɔli”. Na ɛnɛ nee ɛnɛ ala ɔtɛbɔ Lihae.
20Samesɛn lile Yizilayɛma ati ɛvolɛ abulanwiɔ wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee bɛwɔ Filisitiama abo la.

Title: MAA 16
Content:
Samesɛn wɔ Gaza
1Samesɛn hɔle Gaza. Ɔnwunle raalɛ tuutuunli bie na ɔ nee ye hɔlale. 2Bɛhanle bɛhilele Gazama kɛ, “Samesɛn ɛra ɛke.” Aledwolɛ ne amuala bɛbɔle bɛyiale sua ne na bɛ bie mɔ hɔdɛle ye wɔ suakpole ne anlenkɛ kpole ne anloa. Bɛyɛle ngungoonwu na bɛzele kɛ, “Bɛmaa yɛdɛ toonwo alehyenlɛ na yɛ sa baha ye yɛahu ye.” 3Samesɛn lale toonwo alevinli mu nwiɔ avinli. Ɔdwazole ɔhɔle suakpole ne anlenkɛ kpole ne anloa. Ɔkpusule anlenkɛ kpole ne ɔdule ye nee ye fɛlɛmo ne, boka mbulalɛ ne mɔ amuala ɔdole ɔ kɔme zo na ɔvale ɔhɔle boka ne mɔɔ nee Hibulɔn anye bɔ zolɛ la azo.
Samesɛn nee Dɛlaela
4Ɛhye anzi, Samesɛn nwunle raalɛ bie mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Dɛlaela la wɔ Sɔlɛke Bɔnza na ɔhulole ye. 5Filisitia mgbanyima hɔnwunle Dɛlaela na bɛzele ye kɛ, “To Samesɛn agyiba na nwu deɛ holɛ ko ne mɔɔ maa ye anwosesebɛ kpole zɛhae la, nee adenle mɔɔ yɛdua zolɛ a yɛkɛkyekye ye, na yɛkɛbɛlɛ ye aze la, na yɛ nuhua ko biala kɛmaa wɔ dwɛtɛ fufule apenle ko ɛya ko.”
6Yemɔti Dɛlaela zele Samesɛn kɛ, “Yɛmenle, kile me deɛ holɛ ko mɔɔ maa wɔ anwosesebɛ kpole ɛhye la, nee adenle mɔɔ bɛdua zolɛ a bɛkɛhola wɔ kyekye na bɛabɛlɛ wɔ aze la.”
7Samesɛn zele ye kɛ, “Saa bɛfa ɛda nyɛma amolɛ nsuu mɔɔ bɛtɛrɛlɛle ye fee la bɛkyekye me a me nwo bagolo me, na me anwosesebɛ ne bayɛ kɛ nrenya gyɛne biala anwosesebɛ la.”
8Filisitia mgbanyima rɛlɛle Dɛlaela ɛda nyɛma amolɛ nsuu mɔɔ bɛtɛrɛlɛle bɛ fee la, na ɔvale ɔkyekyele ye. 9Mɔɔ ɔyɛ ɛhye la, ɛnee menli vea sua ne ekpumgbunli ne bie anu ɛlɛkendɛ. Na ɔzele Samesɛn kɛ, “Samesɛn, Filisitiama ɛva wɔ aze!” Na Samesɛn tetele ɛda nyɛma ne anu kɛ dwɛsɛ mɔɔ senle ɛha ye la. Yemɔti bɛanwu deɛ mɔɔ maa ye anwosesebɛ ne la.
10Dɛlaela zele Samesɛn kɛ, “Wɔyɛ me koasea, wɔanga nɔhalɛ wɔangile me. Ka kɛ bɛkɛzi bɛkɛyɛ na bɛahola wɔ kyekye la kile me.”
11Ɔzele ye kɛ, “Saa bɛfa samgbe nyɛma fofolɛ mɔɔ bɛtɛfale bɛtɛyɛle debie biala la bɛkyekye me a, me nwo bagolo me, na me anwosesebɛ ne bayɛ kɛ nrenya gyɛne biala anwosesebɛ la.”
12Yemɔti Dɛlaela vale nyɛma fofolɛ kyekyele ye na ɔzele ye kɛ, “Samesɛn, Filisitiama ɛva wɔ aze!” Ɛnee menli vea ye suakunlu ɛkɛ ɛlɛkendɛ. Na Samesɛn tetele nyɛma ne anu kɛ asɛɛ ɔle melahyinli nyɛma la.
13Na Dɛlaela zele Samesɛn kɛ, “Sumunli kɛ de la, me nwo ala a ɛgolo a. Ɛnga nɔhalɛ ɛngile me. Ka kɛ bɛkɛzi bɛkɛyɛ na bɛahola wɔ kyekye la kile me.”
Na ɔzele ye kɛ, “Me enrinli ne mɔɔ bɛbobɔ ye agbɔkɛ nsuu mɔɔ hendɛhenda me ti zo la, saa ɛbɛka bɛ muala ɛbɔ nu, ɛfa pini ɛbɔ nu, ɛbɔ ye kpɔkɛ ɛmia nu a, me nwo bagolo me, na me anwosesebɛ ne bayɛ kɛ nrenya gyɛne biala anwosesebɛ la.”
14Yemɔti ɔlafele la, Dɛlaela vulale enrinli ne mɔɔ hendɛhenda ɔ ti zo la, ɔbɛkale ɔmanle ɔmianle ketekete na ɔvale pini ɔbɔle nu, na ɔzele ye kɛ, “Samesɛn, Filisitiama ɛva wɔ aze!” Na ɔvi nafelɛ nu ɔdwazole, ɔdule pini ne na ɔtulutulule ɔ ti ne.
15Dɛlaela zele ye kɛ, “Ɛnee kɛ ɛsi ɛka kɛ ɛkulo me ɛ, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛhulolɛ ne ɛnvi wɔ ahonle nu la? Wɔgolo me nwo fane nsa. Ɛleka mɔɔ wɔ anwosesebɛ kpole ne vi la ɛtɛkanle ɛtɛkilele me.” 16Na ɔhɔle zolɛ ɔbizale ye alehyenlɛ biala ɔmanle akee ɔyɛle Samesɛn abodelɛ mɔɔ ɛnee ɔ kunlu a anrɛɛ yewu bɔbɔ. 17Na ɔhanle nɔhalɛ ne kɔsɔɔti ɔhilele ye kɛ, “Dadeɛ dɛma ɛtɛkanle me ti enrinli ɛlɛ, ɔluakɛ mele ‘Tusiemaa-Nyamenle’ ralɛ mɔɔ bɛdule me bɛziele ɛkɛ bɛmanle Nyamenle kolaa na bɛawo me a. Kenle ko ne mɔɔ dadeɛ dɛma kɛha me ti enrinli la, kenle zɔhane, me anwosesebɛ ne kɛvi me nu; me nwo bagolo me, na menwɔyɛ kɛ nrenya gyɛne biala la.”
18Dɛlaela nwunle kɛ akee Samesɛn ɛha nɔhalɛ kɔsɔɔ ne ɛhile ye la, ɔzoanle ɔmanle bɛhɔbɔle Filisitia mgbanyima ne amaneɛ kɛ, “Bɛrɛla na akee yeha nɔhalɛ ne mɔɔ vea la.” Filisitia mgbanyima ne vale ɛwɔkɛbɔlɛ ezukoa ne lɛle bɛ sa nu rale. 19Ɔmanle Samesɛn lale ɔ gyakɛ azo na ɔbobole ye ɔmanle ɔlafele. Ɔvɛlɛle nrenya bie ɔmanle ɔrakpale ɔ ti enrinli totɔkɔɔ nsuu ne. Akee ɔbɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɔnwonlonwonlo ye. Na Samesɛn anwo golole ye, na ye anwosesebɛ ne vile ye nu. 20Dɛlaela zele ye kɛ, “Samesɛn, Filisitiama ɛva wɔ aze!” Ɔvi nafelɛ nu ɔdwazole na ɔhanle kɛ, “Mefinde meahɔkpundi me nwo, kɛmɔ meyɛ ye dɛba ne ala la.” Ɛnee ɔnze kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛhwe ɔ nwo ɛvi ɔ nwo. 21Filisitiama ne hyele ye dudule ɔ nye na bɛ nee ye hɔle Gaza. Bɛvale kɔbele nwɔnzɔnwɔnzɔ bɛguale ye na bɛmanle ɔhyibale abɛlɛ melahyinli, ɔdinle abɛlɛ wɔ efiade ɛkɛ ne. 22Na ɔ ti enrinli ne mɔɔ bɛkpale la bɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɔfifi bieko.
Samesɛn ewule ne
23Akee Filisitia mgbanyima yiale kɛ bɛbɔ azu bɛamaa bɛ bozonle Deegɔn ne na bɛalie bɛ nye. Bɛzele kɛ, “Yɛ nyamenle ne ɛye yɛ kpɔvolɛ Samesɛn ɛmaa yɛ.” 24-25Menli ne anye liele kpole kpalɛ, na bɛzele kɛ, “Bɛva Samesɛn bɛrɛla bɛmaa yɛva ye yɛlielie yɛ nye.” Bɛvale Samesɛn bɛvile efiade ne bɛrale, na bɛziele ye wɔ sua ne mpila nwiɔ ne avinli, na bɛvale ye bɛlieliele bɛ nye. Mɔɔ menli ne nwunle ye la, bɛyeyɛle bɛ bozonle ne bɛzele kɛ, “Yɛ nyamenle ne ɛmaa yɛli yɛ kpɔvolɛ ne mɔɔ ɛbɔ yɛ maanle ye ɛhu menli dɔɔnwo la anwo zo konim.” 26Samesɛn zele kpavolɛ ne mɔɔ lɛ ɔ sa la kɛ, “Maa mensosɔ sua ye mpila nwiɔ ne mɔɔ lɛ ye la anu na mendudu mengisa bɛ.” 27Na ɛnee menli, mrenya nee mraalɛ nee Filisitia mgbanyima ɛyi sua ne tɛkɛɛ. Sua ne ati zo bɔbɔ, mrenya nee mraalɛ kɛyɛ apenle nsa gua zolɛ yɛɛ bɛlɛnea debie mɔɔ Samesɛn ɛlɛyɛ la a.
28Akee Samesɛn vɛlɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma na ɔhanle kɛ, “O Awulae Nyamenle, mesɛlɛ wɔ ko ɛhye ala. Kakye me, O Nyamenle, na maa me anwosesebɛ maa menzenra Filisitiama ye wɔ me nye nwiɔ ye mɔɔ bɛdudu la anwo.” 29Yemɔti Samesɛn sosɔle sua ne avinli mpila nwiɔ ne anu, ɔvale ye anwosesebɛ ne amuala ɔhomonle zolɛ, ɔ sa fema ne lɛ ko anu yɛɛ bɛne ne noko lɛ ko anu. 30Na ɔzele kɛ, “Maa me nee Filisitiama ye ɛwu.” Ɔvale ye anwosesebɛ kɔsɔɔti ɔtiale mpila nwiɔ ne. Sua ne bule guale mgbanyima nee menli mɔɔ wɔ nu la amuala anwo zo. Yemɔti menli mɔɔ ɔhunle bɛ wɔ ye ewule nu la zonle tɛla menli mɔɔ ɔbɔ ɔ bo amuala la yehu bɛ la.
31Ɔ mediema mrenya nee ye mbusua ne ravale ye funli ne hɔziele ye wɔ ɛleka mɔɔ bɛziele ɔ ze Manowa la wɔ Zɔla nee Ɛhyeteeyɔlo avinli. Ɔlile Yizilayɛma ati ɛvolɛ abulanwiɔ.

Title: MAA 17
Content:
Maeka mmonle ne mɔ
1Nrenya bie wɔ sua ne mɔɔ gua Yifelaem awoka ne mɔ azo la azo. Bɛfɛlɛ ye Maeka. 2Ɔhanle ɔhilele ɔ nli kɛ, “Wɔ dwɛtɛ fufule apenle ko ɛya ko ne mɔɔ bɛwuale, mɔɔ ɛwale ɔ bo zo amonle a medame mendele ye me nzo nu la, meka meahile wɔ kɛ, ɔwɔ me lɔ. Medame a menvale a.”
Na ɔ nli zele kɛ, “Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛyila wɔ, me ra nrenya.” 3Na Maeka yele dwɛtɛ fufule apenle ko ɛya ko ne manle ɔ nli. Na ɔ nli zele kɛ, “Mefa me sa nu ezukoa ɛhye meyɛ azubɔdeɛ memaa Ɛdɛnkɛma wɔ me ra ne ati, amaa yeaze ananze na yeaholo yeagua nwolɛ; yemɔti mesiane ye memaa wɔ.” 4Maeka zianenle ezukoa ne manle ɔ nli la, ɔ nli dele nuhua ɛya nwiɔ manle dwɛtɛ fufule dwinvolɛ; ɔmanle ɔzele ananze, na ɔholole dwɛtɛ fufule ne ɔguale nwolɛ, na bɛvale bɛziele Maeka sua ne anu.
5Maeka ɛhye lɛ ye amonle sua. Ɔyɛle mmonle nee ɛzonlenlɛ tɛladeɛ ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye “yifɔdo” la bie, na ɔyele ɔ mra mrenya ne mɔ ko kɛ ɔdendɛ ye nyamenle ne anloa azo. 6 Mekɛ ne anu ɛnee belemgbunli biala ɛnle Yizilayɛ maanle ne anu. Awie biala ɔdaye ɔbɔle ye ɛbɛla mɔɔ ɔnea a ɔle kpalɛ la.
7Mekɛ ne anu ala ɛnee kpavolɛ bie vi Bɛtelɛhɛm mɔɔ wɔ Dwuda la ɛrazokoɛ ɛkɛ. Kpavolɛ ne le Livaenli. 8Ɔvi Bɛtelɛhɛm ɔdule kɛ ɔkakpondɛ ɛleka fofolɛ yeadɛnla. Ɔkɔ na ɔhɔdwule Yifelaem awoka ne mɔ azo azua ne mɔ ko azo la, ɔhɔle Maeka awuke ne anu. 9Maeka bizale ye kɛ, “Ɛvi nienwu sua zo?”
Na ɔbuale ye kɛ, “Mele Livaenli, mevi Bɛtelɛhɛm mɔɔ wɔ Dwuda la, na meluolua nu kɛ mekpondɛ ɛleka meadɛnla.”
10Na Maeka zele ye kɛ, “Maa yɛdɛnla ɛke; yɛ selɛ nee me sɛlɛvolɛ. Ɛvolɛ biala mebadua wɔ dwɛtɛ fufule ngoko bulu. Mebamaa wɔ adɛladeɛ na meali ɛ nloa anu ndɔnie.” 11Na Livaenli ne kponlenle zolɛ kɛ ɔ nee ye kɛdɛnla. Kpavolɛ ne yɛle kɛ ɔ mra ne mɔ ko ala la. 12Na Maeka yɛle Livaenli ne ye sɛlɛvolɛ wɔ ɔdaye Maeka ye awuke nu ɛkɛ. 13Akee Maeka hanle kɛ, “Kɛkala, akee menwu kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma bamaa meakpazi, ɔboalekɛ menyia Livaenli sɛlɛvolɛ.”

Title: MAA 18
Content:
Maeka nee Dan abusua ekpunli ne
1Mekɛ ne anu ɛnee belemgbunli biala ɛnle Yizilayɛ maanle ne anu. Eza mekɛ ne anu ala ɛnee Dan abusua ekpunli ne anu amra ɛnlɛ bɛ ti anwo azɛlɛ ɛnde zolɛ na bɛlɛkpondɛ bie bɛadɛnla zolɛ; ɔluakɛ Yizilayɛ abusua ekpunli ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti lɛ bie. Bɛmɛ ala yɛɛ bɛnlɛ bie a. 2Yemɔti Danema yele mrenya akɛnrasesebɛ nnu wɔ Zɔla nee Ɛhyeteeyɔlo na bɛzoanle bɛ kɛ bɛhɔli busia bɛhɔkpɔla azɛlɛ ne na bɛyɛ bie anyenle. Bɛzele soanvolɛma ne kɛ, “Bɛhɔ na bɛhɔnlea bɛkpondɛ azɛlɛ.” Bɛhɔle sua ne mɔɔ gua Yifelaem boka ne azo la azo. Bɛhɔle Maeka sua nu na bɛhɔzokoɛle ye. 3Mɔɔ bɛwɔ Maeka sua nu ɛkɛ ne la, bɛdele Livae kpavolɛ ne ɛdendɛlɛ. Bɛhwenle bɛbikyele ye na bɛbizale ye kɛ, “Nwane a nee wɔ rale ɛke a? Duzu yɛɛ ɛlɛyɛ ye wɔ ɛke a? Duzu gyima yɛɛ ɛdi ye wɔ ɛke a?”
4Ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Maeka nee me ɛhyehyɛ kɛ menyɛ ye sɛlɛvolɛ na ɔdua me kakɛ.”
5Bɛzele kpavolɛ ne kɛ, “Yɛsɛlɛ wɔ, biza Nyamenle, saa yɛ adendulɛ ye kɛyɛ saleɛ kɛmaa yɛ a.”
6Na sɛlɛvolɛ ne zele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛhɔ anzonudwolɛ nu. Ɛdɛnkɛma anye wɔ bɛ nwo zo wɔ bɛ adendulɛ nu.”
7Akee menli nnu ne zile nu hɔle Leeyehye. Bɛnwunle kɛ menli ne de anzonudwolɛ nu. Bɛde ye kɛ Saedɛnema de ye la. Bɛde anzonudwolɛ nu yɛɛ bɛ nloa beta bɛ ti anwo. Bɛ nee awie biala ɛnlɛ manzonle yɛɛ bɛngyia ɛhwee biala mɔɔ wɔ ewiade ye anu la anwo. Anwonyia a, bɛlɛ bie. Bɛ nee Saedɛnema avinli twe, yɛɛ bɛ nee awie biala ɛnlɛ ngitanwolilɛ. 8Mɔɔ menli nnu ne ziale hɔle Zɔla nee Ɛhyeteeyɔlo la, bɛ mediema ne mɔ bizale bɛ kɛ, “Duzu kolakola a bɛ nee ye rale a?” 9Bɛzele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛdwazo bɛmaa yɛhɔteta bɛ, ɔluakɛ yɛhɔnwu azɛlɛ ne kɛ ɔle azɛlɛ mɔɔ kye aleɛ a. Bɛha bɛ nwo. Bɛmmamaa yɛtɛnla ɛke yɛfonla yɛ nwo. Bɛmaa yɛhɔ na yɛhɔva azɛlɛ ne. 10Saa bɛkɔ a, bɛbanwu kɛ menli ne le menli mɔɔ ɛndwenle awie mɔ anwo a. Azɛlɛ ne tɛlɛ. Ɔle azɛlɛ mɔɔ debie biala anwo ɛngyia zolɛ a. Nyamenle yɛɛ ɛye ɛmaa yɛ a.”
11Na Dan abusua ekpunli ne anu amra ɛya nsia vale bɛ konle ninyɛne vi Zɔla nee Ɛhyeteeyɔlo zile nu hɔle. 12Bɛkɔ la, bɛhɔzokoɛle Keleate Gyialem adɔleɛ afoa nu wɔ Dwuda. Ɛhye ati a ɛnɛ nee ɛnɛ ala bɛtɛfɛlɛ ye Dan Azokoɛleɛ la. 13Bɛvile ɛkɛ ne bɛhɔle sua ne mɔɔ gua Yifelaem awoka ne mɔ azo la azo na bɛhɔle Maeka awuke nu.
14Akee menli nnu ne mɔɔ hɔlile Leeyehye azɛlɛ ne azo busia la zele bɛ mediema ne mɔ kɛ, “Asoo bɛze kɛ azua ɛhye mɔ, mmonle ngyikyi, ananze mɔɔ bɛze nee mɔɔ bɛholo dwɛtɛ fufule bɛgua nwolɛ la, nee nwolɛ ɛzonlenlɛ tɛladeɛ wɔ ko anu ɔ? Yemɔti bɛdwenle mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛyɛ la anwo.” 15Zɔhane ati bɛhɔle Maeka awuke ne anu. Bɛhɔdole Livae kpavolɛ ne na bɛbizale ye kɛ ye gyima ne si kɔ zolɛ la. 16Dan ɛlɔnema ɛya nsia ne mɔɔ dedɛ konle ninyɛne la hale suakpole ne anlenkɛ kpole ne anzi nehane hendɛle. 17Menli nnu ne mɔɔ hɔlile busia ne la bɔle hɔle sua ne anu. Bɛsesale ananze ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛze nee mɔɔ bɛholo dwɛtɛ fufule bɛgua nwolɛ, mmonle ngyikyi ne mɔ, yɛɛ ɛzonlenlɛ tɛladeɛ ne amuala. Mekɛ ɛhye noko ɛnee sɛlɛvolɛ ne nee ɛlɔnema ɛya nsia ne mɔɔ dedɛ konle ninyɛne la gyi anlenkɛ kpole ne anloa nehane.
18Mɔɔ menli ɛhye mɔ bɔle hɔle Maeka awuke ne anu hɔsesale ananze ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛze, nee mɔɔ bɛholo dwɛtɛ fufule bɛgua nwolɛ, mmonle ngyikyi ne mɔ, nee ɛzonlenlɛ tɛladeɛ ne la, sɛlɛvolɛ ne bizale bɛ kɛ, “Duzu debie a bɛlɛyɛ la?”
19Bɛzele ye kɛ, “Yɛ koonwu. Ka ɛ nloa to nuhua na bɛla maa yɛhɔ. Bayɛ selɛ nee yɛ sɛlɛvolɛ. Ɛnea a ɛnee ɔle kpalɛ kɛ ɛkɛyɛ Yizilayɛ mbusua ekpunli ne mɔ ko nee bɛ awuke awuke ne mɔ anu amra sɛlɛvolɛ anzɛɛ ɛkɛyɛ sonla ko awuke nu sɛlɛvolɛ ɔ?” 20Sɛlɛvolɛ ne ahonle dɔle ye azule nu. Ɛhye ati ɔvale ɛzonlenlɛ tɛladeɛ ne nee mmonle ngyikyi ne nee ananze ne mɔ na ɔ nee menli ne hɔle.
21Bɛmanle bɛ ngakula ne mɔ, nee nyɛmoa, nee bɛ nwo ninyɛne ne mɔ lumuale bɛ nyunlu, na akee bɛzile nu kɛ bɛkɔ. 22Mɔɔ bɛhɔle moa bie kpalɛ la, menli mɔɔ zuozua Maeka la dele bɛ kunlu na bɛdule bɛdoale Danema ne. 23Bɛdeɛdeanle nu bɛvɛlɛle bɛ, na Danema hakyile bɛ nye na bɛzele Maeka kɛ, “Duzu a gyegye wɔ mɔɔ yemɔti wɔva ɛlɔne ɛhye wɔkpo yɛ a?”
24Maeka zele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛva me nyamenle ne mɔ mɔɔ medame meyɛ, nee me sɛlɛvolɛ mɔɔ melɛ la bɛlɛkɔ, na ɛnee bɛdabɛ bɛnea a duzu a ka me sa nu a? Kɛmɔti a bɛbiza me kɛ, ‘Duzu a gyegye wɔ a?’ ”
25Na Danema ne zele ye kɛ, “Mua ɛ nloa! Mmayɛ ɛmaa ahonle futu, na anrɛɛ ɛdawɔ nee wɔ awuke nu amra amuala kɛdɔ.” 26Na Danema dule denrɛle. Maeka nwunle kɛ ɔ nee bɛ ɛnrɛhola ko la, ɔziale ɔ nzi koonwu ɔhɔle sua nu.
27Mɔɔ Danema vale ninyɛne mɔɔ Maeka ɛyɛ nee ye sɛlɛvolɛ ne la, akee bɛhɔvole Leeyehyema anwo zo. Leeyehyema ɛnze nwolɛ bie, yɛɛ bɛ nye ɛnla. Yemɔti bɛhunle menli ne kɔsɔɔti na bɛyelale sua bɔdenle ne. 28Leeyehyema annyia dievolɛ biala, ɔluakɛ bɛ nee Saedɛnema avinli twe, yɛɛ bɛ nee awie biala ɛnlɛ ngitanwolilɛ.
