Danema kyekyele suakpole ne fofolɛ na bɛdɛnlanle zolɛ wɔ bɔnza ne mɔɔ zua Bɛtelihɔbo la anu. 29Na bɛvale suakpole ne mɔɔ anrɛɛ bɛfɛlɛ ye Leeyehye la bɛdonle bɛ nlenya Dan, mɔɔ bɛwole ye wɔ Yizilayɛ la. 30Danema ne vale Maeka ananze nyamenle ne mɔ ziele yɛle bɛ ɛdeɛ. Na Mosisi ara nrenya Gɛhyɔn ara Dwɔnatan nee ɔ mra mrenya ne mɔ yɛle Dan abusua ekpunli ne sɛlɛvolɛma hɔkpulale mekɛ mɔɔ bɛvale maanle ne donvula la. 31Yemɔti bɛziele Maeka ananze nyamenle ne mɔ na bɛzɔle mekɛ dɔɔnwo, kɛmɔ ɛnee Nyamenle Sua ne wɔ Hyaelo la.

Title: MAA 19
Content:
Livaenli ne nee ye mgbɔnla ne
1Mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee Yizilayɛma ɛnlɛ belemgbunli la, Livaenli bie dule adenle hɔle Yifelaem awoka ne mɔ azo. Ɔvale mgbɔnla wɔ Bɛtelɛhɛm mɔɔ wɔ Dwuda la. 2Ye mgbɔnla ne wulowulale ɔ sa aze, na ɔziale ɔhɔle ɔ ze sua zo Bɛtelɛhɛm mɔɔ wɔ Dwuda la ɔhɔziele ɔ nwo aze siane nna. 3Ɔ hu dwazole kɛ ɔkakpo ɔ bo zo, yeahɔha ɛdendɛlɛ kpalɛ yeahile ye na ɔ nee ye azia. Ɔvale ye sonvolɛ ne nee asoaso nwiɔ ɔ nee bɛ hɔle ɔ ye ɔ ze sua zo. Ɔdwule la ɔ ye vale ye rale ɔ ze sua nu. Ɔ ye ɔ ze nwunle ye la ɔvale fɛlɛkolilɛ ɔhɔyiale ye adenle. 4Ɔ ye ɔ ze ne liele ye na ɔ nee ye dɛnlanle kenle nsa, bɛlile bɛnlonle. 5Ye kenle nsa ne azo bɛdwazole nwonlomɔ mangyee ne na Livaenli ne boɔboale ɔ nwo kɛ ɔkɔ. Raalɛ ne ɔ ze zele ye kɛ, “Kpula ɛ sa kolaa na wɔahɔ.”
6Yemɔti bɛ mu nwiɔ bɛdɛnlanle aze bɛkpulale bɛ sa na bɛnlonle. Akee raalɛ ne ɔ ze zele nrenya ne kɛ, “Maa yɛla na die ɛ nye.”
7Livaenli ne nyianle nwolɛ kɛ ɔkɔ la, ɔ ye ɔ ze ne yɛle toonwo manle ɔlale bieko. 8Aleɛ hyenle bieko mɔɔ ɛnee nrenya ne ɛli kenle nnu la, ɔdwazole ndɛ kɛ ɔkɔ, na ɔ ye ɔ ze ne zele ye kɛ, “Di debie maa sɛnzɛne ne ɛkpali ekyii na wɔahɔ.” Eza bɛ mu nwiɔ bɛlile debie.
9Na mɔɔ nrenya ne nee ye mgbɔnla ne nee ye sonvolɛ ne nyianle nwolɛ kɛ bɛkɔ la, ɔ ye ɔ ze ne zele ye kɛ, “Sɛnzɛne ne asɛɛ ɛdɔ; mesɛlɛ wɔ, da. Aleɛ ɛdwo. Die ɛ nye na ɛhyema nwonlomɔ mangyee ne ala ɛkɛhɔ na wɔadwu sua nu.”
10Nrenya ne amkponle kɛ ɔkɛla bieko. Yemɔti ɔzile nu na ɔradwule Gyibɛse kandiba, ɔdaye, yɛɛ ye sonvolɛ ne nee ye mgbɔnla ne, yɛɛ ye asoaso nwiɔ mɔɔ mbia wɔ zolɛ la. 11Mɔɔ bɛbikyele Gyibɛse la, ɛnee mekɛ ne ɛhɔ dɔɔnwo. Na ye sonvolɛ ne zele ye kɛ, “Bɛmaa yɛmakyi Gyibɛsema suakpole ɛhye azo yɛkpondɛ ɛleka yɛhyea.”
12-13Ɔ menle ne zele ye kɛ, “Yɛnrɛmakyi suakpole biala mɔɔ ye ezuavolɛ ne ɛnle Yizilayɛma la azo; yɛpɛ nuhua yɛahɔ Gebɛya. Bɛla maa yɛhɔ yɛ nyunlu na yɛhɔla Gebɛya anzɛɛ Releema.” 14Yemɔti bɛpɛle nuhua bɛhɔle. Sɛnzɛne ne dɔle bɛ wɔ mɔɔ ɛnee bɛbikye Gebɛya, mɔɔ wɔ Bɛngyaman abusua ekpunli ne maanle nu la, 15na bɛvole suakpole ne azo kɛ bɛkala. Bɛhɔdɛnlanle suakpole ne gua kpatawienyi ne azo, ɔluakɛ awie biala anva bɛ angɔ ye sua nu.
16Nrenya kpanyinli bie mɔɔ vi ɛbɔ nu ɛlɛba sua zo nɔsolɛ nu la ravindele bɛ nwo zo. Nrenya ne vi sua bie mɔɔ gua Yifelaem awoka ne mɔ azo la azo yɛɛ yeradɛnla Gebɛya a. Gebɛyama le Bɛngyaman abo zo amra. 17Nrenya kpanyinli ne nwunle ɛyɛvolɛ ne na ɔbizale ye kɛ, “Ɛvi nienwu, yɛɛ ɛkɔ nienwu?”
18Ɛyɛvolɛ ne zele ye kɛ, “Yɛvi Bɛtelɛhɛm mɔɔ wɔ Dwuda la; yɛse yɛahɔ Yifelaem awoka ne mɔ azo lɔ; ɛkɛ ne a mevi a. Mengɔle Bɛtelɛhɛm mɔɔ wɔ Dwuda la yɛɛ mese meahɔ me sua zo a. Na yɛnnyia awie biala ɛnva yɛ ɛngɔ sua nu. 19Yɛlɛ asoaso ne mɔ anwo ndile nee aleɛ; yɛlɛ kpanwo nee nwanye mɔɔ medame, me mgbɔnla ye nee me sonvolɛ ye yɛdi yɛanlo la. Yɛnrɛhyia debie biala anwo.”
20Na nrenya kpanyinli ne zele kɛ, “Akoaba. Maa yɛhɔ sua nu. Ɔnle kɛ ɛda gua kpatawienyi ye azo.” 21Na ɔvale ye ɔ nee ye hɔle sua nu. Ɔmanle asoaso ne mɔ aleɛ. Akee nyɛvolɛ ne mɔ wowole bɛ gyakɛ anwo, na bɛlile na bɛnlonle.
22 Na mekɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛdi debie na bɛ nye ɛlie la, arɛlevilɛ nu ala, suakpole ne azo mrenya bie mɔɔ fa bɛ gɔnwo mɔ mrenya la rabɔle yiale sua ne na bɛbɔle anlenkɛ ne anu ndinlizo. Bɛzele nrenya kpanyinli ne kɛ, “Fa nrenya ne mɔɔ wɔ wɔ sua ne anu la finde maa yɛ nee ye ɛyɛ nrenya nee nrenya.”
23Na awuke menle ne vindele doale bɛ na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Me mediema, adenle ɛnle ɛkɛ. Bɛmmayɛ amumuyɛ. Nrenya ye le me sokoɛvolɛ. Bɛmmabɔ munzule ɛbɛla biala. 24Bɛnlea, me ra raalɛ mɔɔ ɛnze nrenya fee yɛɛ nrenya ne mgbɔnla noko wɔ ɛke. Bɛmaa menva bɛ membɛlɛ bɛ na bɛyɛ bɛ debie biala mɔɔ bɛkulo la. Na nrenya ɛhye, bɛmmayɛ mɔɔ bɛnyɛ la bɛkile ye.” 25Noko menli ne mɔ amkponle. Yemɔti nrenya ne vale ye mgbɔnla ne vindele rɛlɛle bɛ. Bɛfulofunlanle ye, bɛ nee ye lale bɛ ti ngoko toonwo alehyenlɛ. Aleɛbahye ne mɔɔ maanle nu ɛlɛba aratete la, bɛgyakyile ye kɛ ɔhɔ.
26Raalɛ ne rapɛle finle nrenya kpanyinli ne sua ne mɔɔ ɔ hu la nu la anlenkɛ ne anloa, na ɔlale ɛkɛ ne toonwo maanle nu tetele wienyi. 27Nwonlomɔ ne ala ɔ hu dwazole dukuele anlenkɛ ne kɛ ɔkɔ. Na nea, ye mgbɔnla ye a bea anlenkɛ ye anloa na ɔ sa gua anuhɔlɛ ɛkɛ ne la. 28Ɔzele ye kɛ, “Dwazo maa yɛhɔ.” Na raalɛ ne anga ɔ nwo. Nrenya ne vale ye dole ye asoaso ne azo na ɔzile nu ɔhɔle ye sua zo. 29 Ɔdwule sua nu la, ɔvale dadeɛ ɔdudule ye mgbɔnla ne funli ne abɛsa abɛsa. Akee ɔhyɛle ye nwonane ne anu bulu nee nwiɔ, na ɔvale ɔhɔle Yizilayɛ maanle ne anu amuala. 30Na bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnwunle zɛhae debie la hanle kɛ, “Debie zɛhae, bie ɛtɛsile ɛlɛ; yɛɛ ɔvi mekɛ mɔɔ yɛ mgbanyinli, Yizilayɛma vi Yigyibiti azɛlɛ zo rale la, yɛtɛtele bie ɛlɛ kɛ ɛnɛ kenle ye ala. Bɛnlea bɛdwenle nwolɛ na mɔɔ bɛka la bɛha.”

Title: MAA 20
Content:
Yizilayɛma boɔboa bɛ nwo ahɔho
1Akee Yizilayɛma kɔsɔɔti, ɔvi Dan mɔɔ kɔ Biyɛhyiba nee Geleade la yɛle ko na bɛrayiale nu wɔ Mezepa wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma duma nu. 2Na Yizilayɛ mbusua ekpunli ekpunli ne mɔ anu mgbanyinli rale Nyamenle menli ne nyianu ne bie. Ɛlɔnema mɔɔ dua aze fa dadeɛ ko la le apenle ngoko ɛya nna. 3Bɛngyaman abusua ekpunli ne noko dele kɛ Yizilayɛma ɛhɔ ayia wɔ Mezepa.
Na Yizilayɛma ne bizale kɛ, “Bɛha kɛ ɔyɛle mɔɔ munzule ɛhye ɛzi la bɛhile yɛ.” 4Na Livaenli ne, mɔɔ ɔ ye a bɛhunle ye la yele ɔ nloa kɛ, “Membale Gebɛya mɔɔ wɔ Bɛngyamanema maanle nu la; me nee me mgbɔnla a rale a, kɛ yɛbala ɛkɛ. 5Na Gebɛyama dwazole me nwo zo; bɛbɔle bɛyiale sua ne mɔɔ mela nu la kɛ bɛku me, na bɛ nee me mgbɔnla ne lale dedee bɛmanle ɔwule. 6Na menvale funli ne mempepɛle nu bulu nee nwiɔ, na mengyɛle memanle Yizilayɛ mbusua ekpunli ekpunli bulu nee nwiɔ ne. Ɔluakɛ bɛyɛ mɔɔ bɛnyɛ la, na bɛbɔ munzule wɔ Yizilayɛ maanle ye anu. 7Bɛmɛ Yizilayɛma mɔɔ bɛyia ɛke la, bɛdabɛ bɛdwenle ɛhye anwo na bɛva nwolɛ adwenle.”
8Na menli ne kɔsɔɔti yɛle ko na bɛzele kɛ, “Yɛ nuhua biala, saa ɛde ndanlɛ sua bo o anzɛɛ ɛde sua nu o, ɛndu ɔ gyakɛ. 9Debie mɔɔ yɛyɛ Gebɛyama la ɛne: yɛgua nzeleba yɛaye menli yɛamaa bɛahɔdoa Gebɛyama bɛ nee bɛ ahɔho. 10Yizilayɛ abusua ekpunli ko biala anu, menli ɛya ko biala, yɛbaye nuhua bulu, apenle ko biala, yɛbaye nuhua ɛya ko, yɛɛ apenle bulu biala, yɛbaye nuhua apenle ko na bɛahɔlielie aleɛ bɛarɛlɛ menli mɔɔ ɛlɛko atia Gebɛya mɔɔ wɔ Bɛngyaman maanle nu la, wɔ munzule mɔɔ yebɔ yetia Yizilayɛ la.” 11Yemɔti Yizilayɛma amuala yɛle ko boɔboale bɛ nloa, na bɛhɔtetale sua ne kɛ bɛ nee sua ne azo amra ko.
12Yizilayɛ mbusua ekpunli ekpunli ne mɔ zoanle menli wɔ Bɛngyaman maanle ne anu amuala manle bɛhɔbizale bɛ kɛ, “Duzu amumuyɛ ɛbɛla a bɛbɔ la? 13Bɛye menli zɔhane mɔ mɔɔ wɔ Gebɛya, mɔɔ bɔle munzule ɛbɛla ne la bɛrɛla bɛmaa yɛhu bɛ, na yɛkpa munzule ɛhye yɛvi Yizilayɛ maanle ye anu.” Na Bɛngyamanema andie bɛ mediema Yizilayɛma ne ane. 14Bɛngyamanema vi bɛ azuamgbole ne mɔ azo rale Gebɛya kɛ bɛ nee Yizilayɛma baho. 15Bɛngyamanema apenle ngoko abulanwiɔ nee nsia a vi azuamgbole ne mɔ azo rabɔle Gebɛyama ɛya nsuu mɔɔ bɛyele bɛ la anwo zo a. 16Menli ɛhye mɔ, nuhua ɛya nsuu le bɛne yɛɛ ko biala kola to totoabɔ bɔ sonla ti enrinli ko mɔɔ ɔnli mgba a. 17Na Yizilayɛma mɔɔ ɛha la boɔboale menli apenle ngoko ɛya nna mɔɔ ze konle nye zo kpalɛ kpalɛ la anloa.
Bɛ nee Bɛngyamanema ko
18Yizilayɛma hɔle Bɛtɛle hɔbizale Nyamenle kɛ, “Yizilayɛ mbusua ekpunli ekpunli ne, nuhua boni yɛɛ ɛlumua ɛhɔteta Bɛngyamanema nee bɛ ɛho a?”
Ɛdɛnkɛma zele bɛ kɛ, “Dwuda abusua ekpunli ne a dumua ahɔ a.”
19Nwonlomɔ ne, Yizilayɛma ne hɔdɛle Gebɛya kandiba. 20Na bɛvale konle bɛdoale Bɛngyamanema wɔ ɛleka mɔɔ nee suakpole ne anye bɔ zolɛ la. 21Bɛngyamanema ɛlɔne ne vi Gebɛya vindele, na toonwo mɔɔ sɛnzɛne ne kadɔ la ɛnee bɛhu Yizilayɛma apenle ngoko abulanwiɔ nee nwiɔ. 22Noko Yizilayɛma zile ahonle. Eza bɛhɔdɛle ɛleka ko ne ala mɔɔ alumua ne bɛhɔdɛle la. 23Yizilayɛma ne hɔle Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu hɔzunle zɛlɛle toonwo nɔsolɛ; na bɛbizale Ɛdɛnkɛma kɛ, “Eza yɛva konle yɛhɔdoa yɛ mediema Bɛngyamanema ne bieko ɔ?”
Ɛdɛnkɛma buale kɛ, “Bɛ nee bɛ ɛhɔho.”
24Yemɔti ye kenle nwiɔ ne azo, Yizilayɛma eza hɔtetale Bɛngyamanema ne bieko. 25Bɛngyamanema noko vi Gebɛya rayiale bɛ nee bɛ honle, na bɛhunle Yizilayɛma menli mɔɔ ze konle nye zo kpalɛ la anu apenle ngoko bulu nee mɔtwɛ. 26Na Yizilayɛ ɛlɔnema ne kɔsɔɔti hɔle Bɛtɛle hɔzunle. Bɛhɔle Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu; bɛhyele ɛhɔne kenle ko ne toonwo nɔsolɛ. Bɛbɔle naneyelalɛ azu na bɛbɔle anzonudwolɛ azu bɛmanle Ɛdɛnkɛma. 27-28Mekɛ ne anu ɛnee Nyamenle Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne wɔ ɛkɛ, na Aalɔn ara nrenya Ɛlieza ara Fenɛhaze a le sɛlɛvolɛ a. Na Yizilayɛma bizale Ɛdɛnkɛma bieko kɛ, “Eza yɛva konle yɛhɔdoa yɛ mediema Bɛngyamanema bieko ɔ, anzɛɛ yɛgyakyi?”
Ɛdɛnkɛma buale kɛ, “Bɛhɔ bieko, ɔluakɛ ɛhyema mebaye Gebɛyama meamaa bɛ,”
29-30Yemɔti ye fane nsa ne azo, Yizilayɛma manle ɛlɔnema bɔle Gebɛya yiale, kɛmɔ bɛyɛ ye dɛba ne ala la. Bɛhɔtetale Bɛngyamanema wɔ ɛleka mɔɔ nee Gebɛya anye bɔ zolɛ la. 31Bɛngyamanema ne vile bɛ suakpole ne azo kɛ bɛkadoa Yizilayɛma bɛ nee bɛ aho. Bɛbɔle ɔ bo kɛ bɛkuhu Yizilayɛma ne wɔ ndenle mgbole ne mɔ mɔɔ kɔ Bɛtɛle nee Gebɛya la anu. Bɛhunle Yizilayɛma kɛyɛ abulasa. 32Bɛngyamanema edwɛkɛ a le kɛ, “Yɛha bɛ yɛgua ɛbɔ nu, kɛmɔ alumua ne yɛyɛle la.”
Yizilayɛma noko adwenle a le kɛ, “Bɛmaa yɛnriandi yɛmaa bɛdoa yɛ na yɛhwe bɛ yɛvi suakpole ne azo yɛhɔ ndenle mgbole ne mɔ anu.” 33Na Yizilayɛma ne guale ndwɛlɛ aze nriandile hɔle Beeyaleteemaa. Yizilayɛma mɔɔ ɛnee ɛbu ɛzia Gebɛya la vi bɛ nzia ɛleka ne wɔ Gebɛya aduduleɛ vindele. 34Yizilayɛma apenle bulu ne mɔɔ lile busia ne la hɔtetale Gebɛya. Konle ne anu yɛle ɛsesebɛ kpalɛ. Noko ɛnee Bɛngyamanema ne ɛnze kɛ bɛho bɛdɔ ala ɛne. 35Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛlɛle bɛ aze wɔ Yizilayɛma anyunlu. Kenle ko ne Yizilayɛma hunle Bɛngyamanema apenle ngoko abulanwiɔ nee nnu, menli ɛya ko mɔɔ le ɛlɔnema mɔɔ ze konle nye zo kpalɛ kpalɛ la. 36Akee Bɛngyamanema liele dole nu kɛ bɛho bɛdɔ bɔkɔɔ.
Kɛ Yizilayɛma zile lile konim la
Yizilayɛma ne guale ndwɛlɛ aze, ɔluakɛ bɛdie ɛlɔnema ne mɔɔ ɛbu ɛvea Gebɛya la anwosesebɛ ne bɛdi. 37Menli ne vi nzia ɛleka ne ravole Gebɛya. Bɛkpondenle suakpole ne azo ɛleka biala na bɛhunle awie biala. 38-39Yizilayɛ ɛlɔnema somaa ne nee ɛlɔnema mɔɔ ɛbu ɛvea Gebɛya la lile ziele kɛ saa bɛnwu kɛ esike ɛdwazo bolonwonwo wɔ suakpole ne azo a, ɛnee bɛhakyi bɛ nye bɛ nee Bɛngyaman ɛlɔnema ne ɛho. Mekɛ ne anu ɛnee Bɛngyamanema ne ɛlumua ɛhu Yizilayɛma abulasa na bɛlɛka kɛ, “Amgba yɛlɛka bɛ senle bieko, kɛmɔ yɛyɛle ye alumua konle ne anu la.” 40Noko mɔɔ Bɛngyamanema kado bɛ nye bɛ nzi la ɛnee esike ɛva bɛ suakpole ne na yedwazo bolonwonwo, yedwu nyamenle ne ako abo nehane. 41Akee Yizilayɛma hakyile bɛ nye. Bɛngyamanema anwo vɔle, ɔluakɛ bɛnwunle kɛ akee bɛwie wu ala ɛne. 42Yemɔti bɛguale ye bɛ nzi na bɛguale ɛbɔ nu wɔ fienemgbole ne anu, noko akee bɛ nwo anza nu. Yizilayɛma ɛlɔne ne mɔɔ vi suakpole ne azo ɛlɛba la nwinwinle bɛ avinli ɛkɛ ne. 43Bɛngyamanema ne dɔle donvula, na Yizilayɛma voanle bɛ ndinlizo bɛtiale bɛ dwɛɛ bɛvi Noha toonwo Gebɛya aduduleɛ lɔ. 44Bɛngyaman ɛlɔnema apenle ngoko bulu nee mɔtwɛ ne mɔɔ ze konle nye zo kpalɛ kpalɛ la dɔle amolɛ nu. 45Mɔɔ hale la guale ɛbɔ nu vale bɛ ti bɔle Relemɔn awolɛ ne mɔ anu lɔ wɔ fienemgbole ne anu. Nuhua apenle nnu dɔle amolɛ nu wɔ ndenle mgbole ne mɔ anu. Bɛzile bɛ zo toonwo bɛhɔdwule Gaedɔm, na bɛhunle bɛ nuhua apenle nwiɔ. 46Yemɔti Bɛngyamanema mɔɔ dɔle amolɛ nu kenle ko ne la le apenle ngoko abulanwiɔ nee nnu. Bɛle menli mɔɔ ze konle nye zo na bɛlɛ duma kpalɛ kpalɛ a.
47Bɛ nuhua ɛya nsia nriandile hɔle Relemɔn bodane ne azo wɔ fienemgbole ne anu lɔ, na bɛhɔdɛnlanle ɛkɛ ne siane nna. 48Yizilayɛma ne ziale kpole Bɛngyamanema ne; bɛhunle menli nee nyɛmoa mɔɔ bɛnwunle bɛ la kɔsɔɔti na bɛtotole senle wɔ azua mɔɔ bɛnwunle bɛ la kɔsɔɔti azo.

Title: MAA 21
Content:
Mraalɛ mɔɔ Bɛngyaman abusua ekpunli ne anu amra gyale bɛ la
1Akee Yizilayɛma ne hanle ndane wɔ Mezepa kɛ, “Yɛ nuhua ko bɔbɔ ɛnrɛva ɔ ra raalɛ ɛnrɛmaa Bɛngyamanenli agyalɛ ɛlɛ.” 2Na menli ne rale Bɛtɛle radɛnlanle aze wɔ Nyamenle anyunlu na bɛzunle bɛyele awolɛ. 3Bɛzele kɛ, “O Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle, duzu ati yɛɛ ɛhye ɛzi a, kɛ Yizilayɛ mbusua ekpunli ekpunli ne mɔ anu ko ɛnɛ kɛvi nu a?”
4Aleɛ hyenle la menli ne dwazole ndɛ yɛle azukponle, bɛyelale nane bɛbɔle azu, eza bɛbɔle anzonudwolɛ azu. 5Na Yizilayɛma ne bizale kɛ, “Yizilayɛ mbusua ekpunli ekpunli ne boni yɛɛ amba Ɛdɛnkɛma nyianu ne bie a?” Ɔluakɛ ɛnee bɛha ndane kpole bɛdo zolɛ kɛ, awie ko biala mɔɔ amba Ɛdɛnkɛma nyianu ne bie wɔ Mezepa la, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛku ye. 6Na Yizilayɛma ne lile nyane wɔ bɛ mediema Bɛngyamanema ati na bɛzele kɛ, “Ɛnɛ Yizilayɛ ɛminli ye mbusua ekpunli ekpunli ne mɔ anu ko. 7Kɛ ɔkɛyɛ na yɛanyia mraalɛ yɛamaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛha la agya ɛ? Ɔluakɛ yɛli amonle yɛha ndane wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu kɛ yɛnrɛva yɛ mra mraalɛ yɛnrɛmaa bɛ agyalɛ ɛlɛ.”
8Na bɛbizale kɛ, “Yizilayɛ abusua ekpunli ne boni anu amra a bɛ muala bɛamba Ɛdɛnkɛma nyianu ne wɔ Mezepa a?” Na bɛnwunle kɛ awie ko bɔbɔ vi Gyeebɛhye Geleade amba nyianu ne. 9Mɔɔ bɛdianle menli ne mɔ la, bɛnwunle kɛ Gyeebɛhye Geleadema ko bɔbɔ amba. 10Yemɔti ɛlɔne ne mɔɔ yiale la yele bɛ nuhua apenle ngoko bulu nee nwiɔ mɔɔ anwo yɛ se kpalɛ la na bɛzele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛhɔ Gyeebɛhye Geleade, bɛhɔhu awie biala, mraalɛ nee mbɛda kɔsɔɔti. 11Bɛhu mrenya ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti nee raalɛ biala mɔɔ ɛnwu nrenya la.” 12Bɛnyianle mbɛlɛra mɔɔ ɛtɛnwunle mrenya ɛlɛ la ɛya nna wɔ Gyeebɛhye Geleade, na bɛ nee bɛ hɔle Hyaelo mɔɔ wɔ Keena la.
13Akee Yizilayɛma amuala vale nrɛlaleɛ hɔmanle Bɛngyamanema mɔɔ wɔ Relemɔn bodane ne azo lɔ la kɛ bɛva bɛ nwo edwɛkɛ bɛhyɛ bɛ. 14Bɛngyamanema ziale rale sua nu. Yizilayɛma vale mraalɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛangu bɛ wɔ Gyeebɛhye Geleade la manle bɛ, noko bɛ kɔsɔɔti bɛannyia bie.
15Yizilayɛma lile Bɛngyamanema anwo nyane, ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛkpakye Yizilayɛ mbusua ekpunli ekpunli ne mɔ avinli. 16Akee nyianu ne anu mgbanyima ne zele kɛ, “Bɛngyaman abusua ekpunli ɛdeɛ ne, bɛhu mraalɛ mɔɔ wɔ nu la kɔsɔɔti. Kɛ ɔkɛyɛ na yɛanyia mraalɛ yɛamaa mrenya mɔɔ ɛha la agya ɛ?” 17Na bɛzele kɛ, “Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛnyia menli di Bɛngyamanema mɔɔ ɛha la agya. Ɔnle kɛ abusua ekpunli zɔhane abo tu Yizilayɛ maanle ye anu. 18Noko akee yɛngola yɛnva yɛ mra mraalɛ yɛmmaa bɛ agyalɛ.” Ɔluakɛ Yizilayɛma ɛha ndane kɛ, “Munzule ɛha awie biala mɔɔ kɛva ɔ ra raalɛ kɛmaa Bɛngyamanenli kɛgya la.”
19Yemɔti bɛhanle kɛ, “Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛvoyia ne mɔɔ bɛdi ye wɔ Hyaelo la ɛdwu. Hyaelo wɔ Bɛtɛle sɔlɔ, wɔ Bɛtɛle nee Hyikɛm ademgbole ne aduduleɛ afoa nu wɔ Lɛbona nyiakɛ.” 20Na bɛzele Bɛngyamanema kɛ, “Bɛhɔzia vanye ɛya ne mɔ anu. 21Saa Hyaelo mbɛlɛra ba kɛ bɛbazi agole wɔ ɛvoyialilɛ ne anu a, bɛvinde na awie biala ɛhye ko ɛva ye ɛyɛ ɔ ye, na ɔ nee ye ɛhɔ Bɛngyaman maanle nu. 22Na saa bɛ ze mɔ anzɛɛ bɛ mediema mrenya babiza nwolɛ edwɛkɛ a, bɛbaze bɛ kɛ, ‘Bɛkponle zolɛ bɛmaa yɛ. Ɔluakɛ yɛangye bɛ donvula wɔ konle nu, yɛɛ tɛ bɛdabɛ noko yɛɛ bɛvale bɛ bɛmanle yɛ a, yemɔti bɛnli fɔlɛ.’ ”
23Na Bɛngyamanema ne yɛle ye zɔhane. Biala nyianle raalɛ hyele ye wɔ agolezilɛ ne anu. Bɛ nee bɛ ziale hɔle bɛ azua ne mɔ azo; bɛhɔkyekyele bɛ azua ne mɔ na bɛdɛnlanle aze. 24Mekɛ ne anu Yizilayɛma ne noko ziale hɔle hɔbokale bɛ mbusua ekpunli ekpunli ne mɔ nee bɛ sua nu amra anwo, na bɛhɔle bɛ gyima zo.
25 Mekɛ ne anu ɛnee belemgbunli biala ɛnle Yizilayɛ maanle ne anu; awie biala bɔle ɛbɛla biala mɔɔ ɔdaye ɔkulo la.

Title: WULU MUKENYE
Content:
Mukenye
Anyelielɛ adawu ɛhye mɔɔ fane Wulutu anwo la zile mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee Yizilayɛ maanle ne anu le begyebegye, kɛmɔ bɛhɛlɛ ye wɔ Maanlebuvolɛma buluku ne anu la. Wulutu vi Mowabe maanle nu na Yizilayɛnli a gyale ye a. Mɔɔ ɔ hu wule la Wulutu lile nɔhalɛ kpole bie manle ɔ hu ɔ nli ne na ɔvale ɔ nwo ɔmanle Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne. Ye awieleɛ a le kɛ, ɔnyianle ɔ hu anwo amra ne mɔ bie gyale ye, na ɔlua agyalɛ ɛhye azo, Devidi mɔɔ yɛle Yizilayɛma belemgbunli kpole la yɛle Wulutu angabɛnzo.
Adawu mɔɔ wɔ Maanlebuvolɛma buluku ne anu la kile amaneɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle menli ne nwunle ye wɔ mekɛ biala mɔɔ bɛhakyile bɛ nzi bɛzile bɛ Nyamenle ne la. Wulutu buluku ne noko kile nyilalɛ mɔɔ awie mɔɔ ɛnle Yizilayɛnli la nyianle ye wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɔvale ɔ nwo ɔmanle Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne na ɔrayɛle ye menli ne mɔ anu ko la.
Mɔɔ wɔ nu la
Nawome nee Wulutu sia ahɔ Bɛtelɛhɛm 1.1-22
Wulutu yia Bowaze 2.1—3.18
Bowaze gya Wulutu 4.1-22

Title: WULU 1
Content:
Yilemɛlɛke nee ye abusua ne tu ahɔ Mowabe
1-2Mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee maanlebuvolɛma a bu Yizilayɛ maanle ne la, ɛhɔne kpole bie zile maanle ne anu. Zɔhane ati nrenya bie mɔɔ vi Bɛtelɛhɛm mɔɔ wɔ Dwuda maanle nu na ɔbɔ Ɛfelate abusua ne bie la vale ɔ ye nee ɔ mra mrenya nwiɔ mɔɔ ɔlɛ bɛ la lɔle nu hɔle Mowabe maanle nu. Bɛfɛlɛ nrenya ne Yilemɛlɛke, bɛfɛlɛ ɔ ye Nawome yɛɛ ɔ mra mrenya nwiɔ ne noko aluma a le Maalɔn yɛɛ Kaeleɔn. Bɛhɔle Mowabe maanle nu bɛhɔdɛnlanle ɛkɛ ne. 3Na Nawome ɔ hu Yilemɛlɛke wule manle ɔhale ye nee ɔ mra mrenya nwiɔ ne. 4Mgbavolɛ nwiɔ ɛhye gyale Mowabe mraalɛ; bɛfɛlɛ ko Ɔpa yɛɛ bɛfɛlɛ ko Wulutu. Kɛyɛ ɛvolɛ bulu anzi 5Maalɔn nee Kaeleɔn bɛdabɛ noko bɛwule na ɔhale Nawome angome; ɔ hu ɛwu yɛɛ ɔ mra mrenya nwiɔ ne noko ɛvi ɔ sa.
Nawome nee Wulutu sia ahɔ Bɛtelɛhɛm
6Mekɛ guale nu la Nawome dele ye wɔ Mowabe ɛkɛ ne kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛlo ye menli Yizilayɛma na yemaa bɛnyia aleɛ dɔɔnwo. Zɔhane ati ɔ nee ahunlanvolɛ mraalɛ nwiɔ ne boɔboale bɛ nwo kɛ bɛvi Mowabe bɛsia bɛahɔ Dwuda. 7Yemɔti ɔ nee ahunlanvolɛ mraalɛ nwiɔ ne vile ɛleka mɔɔ bɛde la na bɛzile nuhua kɛ bɛsia bɛahɔ Dwuda maanle nu. Na mɔɔ bɛdwule adenle nu la 8Nawome zele ahunlanvolɛ mraalɛ ne mɔ kɛ, “Bɛzia, awie biala ɛhɔ ɔ nli sua nu. Ɛdɛnkɛma nee bɛ ɛdɛnla gyɛlɛɛnye, kɛmɔ bɛ nee me nee menli mɔɔ ɛwu ɛhɔ la dɛnlanle la. 9Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛmaa bɛnyia mrenya bɛgya, na bɛkyekye awuke.”
Akee ɔvale bɛ ɔbɔle ye ɛbolɛ, ɔyɛle bɛ atuu na ɔhɛlale bɛ. Na bɛdukuele nu bɛzunle. 10Ahunlanvolɛ mraalɛ ne mɔ zele Nawome kɛ, “Kyɛkyɛ, yɛ nee wɔ kɔ ɛleka mɔɔ ɛvi la.”
11Nawome zele bɛ kɛ, “Me mra mraalɛ, bɛzia. Duzu ati a bɛ nee me kɔ a? Asoo mebawo mralɛ mrenya bieko na bɛarayɛ bɛ hu mɔ? 12Me mra mraalɛ, bɛzia bɛhɔ, ɔluakɛ meyɛ kpanyinli, mebo agyalɛhɔlɛ zo. Na saa melɛ anyelazo bɔbɔ yɛɛ megya nrenya na ɛnɛ nɔe ala meawo mralɛ mrenya a, 13asoo ɛhye ati bɛkɛhendɛ toonwo bɛkɛmaa bɛkɛyɛ mgbanyinli? Ɛhye ati bɛnrɛhɔ agyalɛ ko ɔ? Kyɛkyɛ, me mra mraalɛ, ɔyɛ se ɔmaa me na ɔmaa medi nyane wɔ bɛ ti, kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛmaa menwu me nyunlu totohyia zɛhae a.”
14Na bɛzunle bieko kpole kpalɛ; Ɔpa metanle ɔ hu ɔ nli ne, ɔyɛle ye atuu na ɔziale ɔhɔle. Na Wulutu ɛdeɛ, yeamkponle kɛ ɔkɛzia. 15Na Nawome zele Wulutu kɛ, “Nea, ɛ hola ɛzia ɛhɔ ye sua zo ɔkazonle ye abusua bozonle ne mɔɔ ɔsonle ye dɛba la. Ɛdawɔ noko toa ye ɛ nee ye bɛhɔ.”
16Wulutu zele ye kɛ, “Mmafoa me kɛ mengyakyi wɔ mengɔ anzɛɛ menzia na memmatoa wɔ. Ɔluakɛ me nee wɔ yɛkɔ ɛleka mɔɔ ɛlɛkɔ la, mebadɛnla ɛleka mɔɔ ɛkɛdɛnla la. Wɔ menli bayɛ me menli, na wɔ Nyamenle ne ayɛ me Nyamenle. 17Ɛleka mɔɔ ɛkɛwu ɛkɛla la, ɛkɛ ne yɛɛ medame mebawu meala a. Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛdua me kakɛ ɛgua me bie zo kɛ menwɔgyakyi wɔ menwɔzia a, kyesɛ ewule na akpakye yɛ mu nwiɔ yɛ avinli!”
18Mɔɔ Nawome nwunle kɛ Wulutu ɛzi ye ɛbolɛ kɛ ɔ nee ye kɔ la, yeandɛ ɔ nloa anu bieko.
19Yemɔti bɛ mu nwiɔ bɛzile nuhua na bɛrale Bɛtelɛhɛm. Na mɔɔ bɛradwule la sua ne azo kpudwule, na mraalɛ ne mɔ zele kɛ, “Nawome ɛhye ɔ?”
20Nawome zele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛmmafɛlɛ me Nawome bieko; bɛvɛlɛ me Maala. Ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma nee me ɛli ye ɛnwonle zo kpalɛ kpalɛ. 21Mekɔ la ɛnee megyi boɛ, na Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛmaa meva me sa mgbane mezia mera. Duzu ati a bɛkɛvɛlɛ me Nawome a, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma annwu me ɛralɛ nu na Nyamenle Tumivolɛ ne asa ɛyɛ ɛnlomboɛ wɔ me nwo zo la?”
22Ɛnee Nawome nee ɔ ra ne aye Mowabenli Wulutu bɛ ɛralɛ ne mɔɔ bɛziale bɛvi Mowabe maanle nu bɛrale Bɛtelɛhɛm la kɛ yɛle la ɛne. Mekɛ ne anu ɛnee Yizilayɛma aleɛ ma bie mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye baale la ɛbolo na bɛbɔ ɔ bo kɛ bɛte.

Title: WULU 2
Content:
Wulutu yɛ gyima wɔ Bowaze ɛya nu
1Nawome ɔ hu Yilemɛlɛke lɛ ye busuanli bie mɔɔ ɛnyia ɔ nwo kpole kpalɛ la wɔ ɛkɛ. Bɛfɛlɛ ye Bowaze. 2 Na Mowabenli Wulutu zele Nawome kɛ, “Mebodo wɔ, maa mengɔ ɛya ne mɔ anu lɔ na awie mɔɔ kɛnwu me anwunvɔne la mealuolua ye ɛya ɛdeɛ ne anu saa menwɔnyia mgbɛpɛlɛ bie a.”
Nawome zele ye kɛ, “Me ra raalɛ, kɔ.”
3Yemɔti Wulutu hɔle kɛ ɔkakpondɛ mgbɛpɛlɛ wɔ menli bie mɔ anzi. Na ɔrale kɛ amuanrɛɛ ɛya ne mɔɔ ɔhɔle nuhua la le Bowaze mɔɔ le Yilemɛlɛke busuanli la ɛdeɛ.
4Bowaze vi Bɛtelɛhɛm rale na ɔrayɛle ye gyimayɛvoma ne mo ɔzele kɛ, “Ɛdɛnkɛma nee bɛ ɛdɛnla.”
Bɛliele zolɛ kɛ, “Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛyila wɔ.”
5Akee Bowaze bizale ye sonvolɛ ne mɔɔ nea gyimayɛvoma ne anwo zo la kɛ, “Bɛlɛra ɛhye vi nienwu?”
6Kpavolɛ ne mɔɔ nea gyimayɛvoma ne anwo zo la buale kɛ, “Mowabe bɛlɛra ne mɔɔ nee Nawome vi Mowabe maanle nu rale la ɛne. 7Ɔrazɛlɛle me kɛ, ‘Mekpa wɔ kyɛlɛ, maa menluolua wɔ gyimayɛvoma ye anzi saa menwɔnyia mgbɛpɛlɛ bie a.’ Ɔrale sumunli nwonlomɔ ye na ɔtɛdiele ye ɛnwomenle bɔbɔ. Kɛkala bie yɛɛ yehɔdɛnla kpɔda ne abo lɔ ekyii a.”
8Akee Bowaze zele Wulutu kɛ, “Me ra raalɛ, tie mɔɔ meka meahile wɔ la kpalɛ. Mmakɔ ɛya gyɛne nu ɛkɔkpondɛ mgbɛpɛlɛ, yɛɛ mmafi ɛya ɛhye anu noko ɛkɔ fofolɛ nu. Ɛ nee me sonvolɛ mraalɛ ne mɔ ɛwoa ɛke ala. 9Di bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛte ma ne la anzi kpalɛ na toa bɛ kɔ ɛleka mɔɔ bɛkɔ la. Meha mehile mgbavolɛ ne mɔ kɛ awie biala mmafa ɔ sa ka wɔ. Saa nzuhɔne ɛlɛku wɔ a, kɔ ɛleka mɔɔ nzule ne wɔ la na no mɔɔ mgbavolɛ ne mɔ ɛhɔza ɛra la bie.”
10Wulutu dule dɔle Bowaze agyakɛ anu na ɔzele kɛ, “Mele ɛyɛvolɛ, na duzu ati a wɔyɛ ahunlunyele kpole ɛhye wɔmaa me a?”
11Na Bowaze buale ye kɛ, “Mɔɔ wɔyɛ wɔmaa ɛ hu ɔ nli, ɔvi mekɛ mɔɔ ɛ hu wule, nee kɛ wɔzi wɔgyakyi ɛ ze nee ɛ nli, ɛvi wɔ maanle nu wɔra menli mɔɔ ɛnze bɛ la avinli la, bɛha ye kɔsɔɔti bɛhile me. 12Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛyila wɔ wɔ mɔɔ wɔyɛ la anwo; Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛlo wɔ molozo na Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne mɔɔ wɔravea ɔ ndɛba abo la ɛva wɔ ɛzie boɛ.”
13Wulutu zele ye kɛ, “Yɛmenle, wɔlo me somaa. Wɔkyekye me rɛle na wɔdendɛ wɔhile me kɛ wɔ sonvolɛ raalɛ a le me wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ memboka wɔ sonvolɛ mraalɛ ne mɔ anwo la.”
14Ɔdwule aleɛlilɛ mekɛ la Bowaze vɛlɛle ye kɛ, “Bɛla, bali debie; anrɛɛ fa wɔ kpanwo ne bɔ subue ye anu.” Yemɔti Wulutu dɛnlanle gyimayɛvoma ne mɔ anwo ɛkɛ ne na Bowaze manle ye abɛlɛ ngyehye manle ɔlile, ɔ ko yile, bie hale. 15-16Mɔɔ Wulutu dwazole kɛ ɔkakpondɛ mgbɛpɛlɛ bieko la Bowaze zele ye gyimayɛvoma ne kɛ, “Bɛmaa ye adenle bɛmaa ɔluolua aziakɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛkyekye la avinli ɔsesa mgbɛpɛlɛ; anrɛɛ bɛmmatendɛ ye bɛgua ɔ nyunlu aze. Eza anrɛɛ bɛhwehwe mɔɔ bɛkyekye la bie bɛmaa ye.”
17Yemɔti Wulutu woale ɛya ne anu kpondɛle mgbɛpɛlɛ toonwo aleɛ muanle nwolɛ. Ɔwozole mɔɔ ɔnyianle ye la ɛnee ɔle asɛɛ kilo bulu. 18Wulutu vale mɔɔ ɔnyianle ye la hɔle sua zo na ɔvale ɔhilele Nawome. Eza Wulutu vale aleɛ mɔɔ ɔlile la bie hɔmanle Nawome. 19Nawome bizale ye kɛ, “Nienwu a ɛnɛ ɛhɔsesale wɔ mgbɛpɛlɛ ne a? Nienwu a ɛlile gyima ɛhye a? Nyamenle ɛyila ahenle mɔɔ yɛle wɔ nyele ɛhye la.”
Wulutu zele Nawome kɛ, “Nrenya ne mɔɔ ɛnɛ mengɔle ye ɛya nu la bɛfɛlɛ ye Bowaze.”
20 Nawome buale ɔ ra ne aye ne kɛ, “Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛyila ye kɛ ɔdwenle menli mɔɔ ɛwu ɛhɔ nee anyewɔzoamra anwo la. Nrenya ne le yɛ nwo sonla. Ɔle sonla mɔɔ di agya a ɔyɛ boɛ a.”
21Mowabenli Wulutu zele kɛ, “Eza bɔbɔ ɔhanle ɔhilele me kɛ mendɛnla ye sonvolɛ mraalɛ ne mɔ anwo ɛkɛ kɔkpula mekɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛwie ye bɛyɔba ne bu la.”
22Nawome zele Wulutu kɛ, “Me ra raalɛ, ɔle kpalɛ kɛ ɛ nee ye sonvolɛ mraalɛ ne mɔ kɛyɛ gyima; saa ɛluolua awie ɛya nu a bɛkɛyɛ wɔ mgbane mgbane.” 23Yemɔti Wulutu woale Bowaze sonvolɛ mraalɛ ne mɔ anwo ɛkɛ ne ɔsesale mgbɛpɛlɛ wɔ ɛya ne anu toonwo ma ɛdelɛ ne pɛle nu. Na akee ɔdɛnlanle aze wɔ ɔ hu ɔ nli ne anwo ɛkɛ.

Title: WULU 3
Content:
Wulutu kpondɛ kunli
1Akee Nawome zele Wulutu kɛ, “Me ra raalɛ, ɔwɔ kɛ memaa bɛgya wɔ, amaa wɔanyia awie ɛ nee ye adɛnla. 2Ɛze ɔ? Bowaze mɔɔ ye sonvolɛ mraalɛ a ɛ nee bɛ yɛ gyima la le yɛ hu mɔ busuanli. Ɛnɛ nɔsolɛ ɔbakpogya ma wɔ ɛleka mɔɔ bɛkpogya ye ala la. 3Zɔhane ati nrinzi ɛ nwo, siezie ɛ nwo, na kɔ ɛleka mɔɔ bɛkpogya ma ne la; na anrɛɛ mmamaa ɔnwu wɔ kɔkpula mekɛ mɔɔ ɔkɛli debie na ɔkɛnlo nwanye la. 4Yɛ ɛleka mɔɔ ɔbala la nzonlɛ kpalɛ, na saa ɔda a, kɔye ɔ gyakɛ anwo ɛdanlɛ ne na da ɔ gyakɛ anu ɛkɛ, na ɔbahile wɔ debie mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ ɛyɛ la.”
5Na Wulutu zele ye kɛ, “Mɔɔ wɔha la, mebayɛ.”
6Yemɔti Wulutu hɔle ɛleka mɔɔ bɛkpogya ma ne la na ɔhɔyɛle kɛmɔ ɔ hu ɔ nli ne zele ye la. 7Bowaze wiele debie di na ɔvale nwanye ekyi ɔhanle ɔ nloa na ɔ nye liele la, ɔhɔlale ye ma ne azo lɔ. Wulutu yɛle nyaa nyaa hɔyele Bowaze agyakɛ anwo ɛdanlɛ ne na ɔlale ɔ gyakɛ anu ɛkɛ ne.
8Kɛyɛ alevinli mu nwiɔ avinli yɛɛ Bowaze bɔle mgbatike dwazole a. Na ɔdole ɔ nye la ɔnwunle kɛ raalɛ bie la ɔ gyakɛ anu ɛkɛ. 9Na ɔbizale kɛ, “Ɛdawɔ nwane a ɛla ɛkɛ ne la?”
Wulutu buale ye kɛ, “Yɛmenle, medame, wɔ sonvolɛ raalɛ Wulutu ɔ. Ɛle me hu kɔliagya mɔɔ wɔmɔ a ɔwɔ kɛ ɛnea me a; yemɔti gya me.”
10Bowaze zele ye kɛ, “Me ra raalɛ, Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛyila wɔ. Akee wɔhile kɛ ɛlɛ subane kpalɛ wɔdɛla alumua ne kɛ wɔandoɔdoa mgbavolɛ sukoavolɛma anzɛɛ ehyianvolɛma la. 11Kɛkala, me ra raalɛ, mmasulo; debie biala mɔɔ wɔbiza la, mebayɛ meamaa wɔ, ɔluakɛ awie biala mɔɔ wɔ sua ye azo la ze kɛ ɛle raalɛ mɔɔ lɛ subane a. 12 Ɔle nɔhalɛ kɛ mele kɔliagya, megya wɔ a ɔyɛ boɛ, noko ahenle mɔɔ di agya mumua ne la wɔ ɛkɛ. 13Zɔhane ati boa ɛke ɛnɛ nɔe, na saa aleɛ kye na kɔliagya ne se kɛ ɔkɛgya wɔ a, ɛnee ye kpalɛ nu ɔ; maa ɔgya wɔ. Na saa ɔnrɛgya wɔ noko a, ɛnee kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma de aze la, menwɔgya wɔ. Wɔmɔ da na nwonlomɔ.”
14Yemɔti Wulutu lale ɔ gyakɛ anu ɛkɛ ne na ɔdwazole nwonlomɔ mangyee ne ala mɔɔ ɛnee maanle nu ɛtɛtetele la kɛ ɔkɔ. Bowaze zele ye kɛ, “Mmamaa awie biala te kɛ raalɛ rale ɛleka mɔɔ bɛkpogya ma ye la.” 15Eza ɔzele ye kɛ, “Fa wɔ ɛdanlɛ ne mɔɔ gua ɛ nwo zo la bɛla na tɛlɛ nu.” Wulutu dɛlɛle ye ɛdanlɛ ne anu, na Bowaze zule ma kilo abulanwiɔ guale nuhua na ɔkyekyele ɔzoale ye. Na Wulutu hɔle sua nu. 16Wulutu dwule sua nu la, ɔ hu ɔ nli ne bizale ye kɛ, “Me ra raalɛ, kɛ ɔde ɛ?”
Wulutu hanle debie biala mɔɔ nrenya ne ɛyɛ ɛmaa ye la hilele ye. 17Na ɔvale ɔzɔle zolɛ kɛ, “Ɔzele me kɛ, ‘Menrɛmaa ɛnrɛva ɛ sa mgbane ɛnrɛhɔhile ɛ hu ɔ nli.’ Yemɔti ɔzule ma kilo abulanwiɔ ɔmanle me.”
18Na Nawome zele ye kɛ, “Me ra raalɛ, sie ɛ nwo diinyi kɔkpula mekɛ mɔɔ yɛkɛnwu edwɛkɛ ne guabelɛ la. Ɔluakɛ nrenya ne ɛnrɛla, kɛ ɔkɛyɛ biala la, ɔwɔ kɛ ɔnwu edwɛkɛ ne guabelɛ ɛnɛ kenle ko ye ala.”

Title: WULU 4
Content:
Bowaze gya Wulutu
1Bowaze hɔle suakpole ne anlenkɛ kpole ne anloa, ɛleka mɔɔ ɔyɛ a bɛyia la na ɔdɛnlanle aze. Yeangyɛ biala yɛɛ kɔliagya ne mɔɔ Bowaze lile ye edwɛkɛ la rale ɛkɛ ne a. Bowaze zele ye kɛ, “Ayi, bɛla badɛnla aze.” Na ɔradɛnlanle aze. 2Bowaze vɛlɛvɛlɛle suakpole ne azo mgbanyima bulu na ɔmanle bɛradɛnlanle aze wɔ ɛkɛ ne. 3Akee ɔzele kɔliagya ne kɛ, “Nawome vi Mowabe ɛra, na yeyɛ kɛ ɔtɔne yɛ busuanli Yilemɛlɛke azɛlɛ ne. 4Yemɔti medwenle nwolɛ kɛ meka meahile wɔ kɛ tɔ azɛlɛ ne maa menli mɔɔ wɔ ɛke nee mgbanyima mɔɔ mehɔvɛlɛvɛlɛ bɛ la ɛli nwolɛ daselɛ. Saa ɛkɛlie azɛlɛ ne a ɛnee die, saa ɛnrɛlie noko a ɛnee ka kile me maa menwu ye, ɔluakɛ awie bieko ɛnle ɛkɛ ne kɛ wɔmɔ yɛɛ mame.”
Na nrenya ne mɔɔ di agya ne la zele Bowaze kɛ, “Mebalie azɛlɛ ne.”
5Bowaze zele ye kɛ, “Saa ɛtɔ azɛlɛ ne na ɛdie ɛfi Nawome asa anu a, ɛnee ɔwɔ kɛ ɛgya Wulutu, Mowabenli kunlanvolɛ ne, amaa mɔɔ lɛ azɛlɛ ne la duma amminli ye agyadeɛ ne anwo.”
6Kɔliagya ne zele Bowaze kɛ, “Saa zɔhane ɛdeɛ a ɛnee mekpɔlɔkpɔla me sa anwo wɔ debie biala anwo. Ɔluakɛ ɔkɛgyegye me mra ne mɔ agyalilɛ. Yemɔti memaa wɔ nwolɛ adenle. Tɔ azɛlɛ ne na mame, menrɛdɔ.”
7 Mekɛ ne anu ɛnee Yizilayɛma amaamuo ne mɔ ko mɔɔ fane agyadeɛ ɛdɔnenlɛ nee agyalilɛ nwo la a le ɛhye: saa ɔba ye kɛ bɛtɔne agyadeɛ bie a, ahenle mɔɔ ɛlɛtɔne deɛ ne la ye ɔ gyakɛ mgbɔlaboa maa ahenle ne mɔɔ ɛlɛtɔ agyadeɛ ne la. Bɛyɛ ɛhye bɛfa bɛdi daselɛ kɛ ahenle mɔɔ anrɛɛ lɛ agyadeɛ ne la ɛye ɔ sa nwolɛ bɔkɔɔ.
8Yemɔti kɔliagya ne yele ye mgbɔlaboa ne na ɔzele Bowaze kɛ, “Kɔdɔ fa.” 9Bowaze zele mgbanyima nee menli mɔɔ wɔ ɛkɛ ne la amuala kɛ, “Bɛdabɛ bɛdi daselɛ kɛ ɛnɛ kenle ye, medɔ debie biala mɔɔ anrɛɛ le Yilemɛlɛke ɛdeɛ la, nee debie biala mɔɔ le Kaeleɔn nee Maalɔn ɛdeɛ la amuala mevi Nawome asa anu. 10 Bieko, ɛnɛ Mowabenli Wulutu mɔɔ anrɛɛ le Maalɔn aye la le me ye, amaa yeawo mralɛ wɔ agyadeɛ ne mɔɔ melie la duma nu, na mɔɔ ɛwu ɛhɔ la duma amminli ɔ mediema avinli anzɛɛ ye sua zo; bɛ muala bɛdi ɛhye mɔ anwo daselɛ ɛnɛ.” 11 Na bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛyiale ɛkɛ ne la amuala nee mgbanyima ne mɔ hanle kɛ, “Ɛhɛe, yɛdi nwolɛ daselɛ. Yɛsɛlɛ kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛmaa raalɛ ne mɔɔ ɛlɛba wɔ sua nu la ɛyɛ kɛ Relahyɛle nee Liya mɔɔ bɛ kunlu mralɛ a kyekyele Yizilayɛ maanle ye la. Nyamenle ɛmaa ɛkpazi wɔ Ɛfelate na ɛyɛ mandimase wɔ Bɛtelɛhɛm ɛke. 12 Ngakula mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma bava amaa ɛdawɔ nee ɛ ye kakula ɛhye la ɛmaa wɔ sua nu ɛyɛ gbudugbudu kɛ Dwuda nee ɔ ye Teemaa ara Pɛlɛze sua nu la.”
Bowaze nee ɔ bo zo amra
13Na Bowaze vale Wulutu yɛle ɔ ye na ɔ nee ye hɔdɛnlanle. Ɛdɛnkɛma manle ɔvale ɛkolɛ na ɔwole ralɛ nrenya. 14Mraalɛ mɔɔ wɔ suakpole ne azo la zele Nawome kɛ, “Yɛyɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma mo; ɛnɛ yemaa wɔnyia anlɔnra nrenya. Yɛsɛlɛ kɛ ɔnyia duma kpole wɔ Yizilayɛ. 15Ɛ ra ne aye ne mɔɔ kulo wɔ la ɛyɛ mɔɔ hyia wɔ tɛla mralɛ mrenya nsuu bɔbɔ la ɛmaa wɔ. Kɛkala yemaa wɔ ralɛ nrenya mɔɔ bamaa wɔ sua nu ayɛ gbudugbudu na yeazɔ wɔ, wɔ wɔ mrelera nu a.” 16Na Nawome liele kakula ne bɔle ye ɛbolɛ, na ɔliele ye ɛnleanlɛ ɔdole ɔ nwo zo.
17Mraalɛ mɔɔ wɔ kpalɛ ne azo la noko hanle hilele menli kɛ, “Bɛwo ralɛ nrenya bɛmaa Nawome.”
Bɛdonle kakula ne Obɛde. Obɛde wole Gyɛsi mɔɔ wole Belemgbunli Devidi la.
18-22Akee Pɛlɛze abusuandoazo ne, bɛmɛ ɛne: Pɛlɛze wole Hɛzelɔn, Hɛzelɔn wole Relam, yɛɛ Relam wole Amenadabe. Amenadabe wole Nahyɔn, Nahyɔn wole Salemɔn, Salemɔn wole Bowaze, Bowaze wole Obɛde, Obɛde wole Gyɛsi, yɛɛ Gyɛsi wole Belemgbunli Devidi.

Title: 1 SAM MUKENYE
Content:
Mukenye
Samoɛle buluku ne mɔɔ lumua la kile kɛ Yizilayɛ maanle ne zile hakyile, ɔvi maanlebuvolɛma anwo zo toonwo ɔradwule mekɛ mɔɔ belemgbunlililɛ rale la. Ngakyile ɛhye mɔɔ rale Yizilayɛma ɛbɛlabɔlɛ nu la luale menli nsa anwo zo: Samoɛle, maanlebuvolɛ titile mɔɔ li amozi la; Sɔɔlo, Yizilayɛ belemgbunli mɔɔ lumua la, yɛɛ Devidi. Devidi mgbavolɛ nu ɛbɛlabɔlɛ ne le kɛ Samoɛle nee Sɔɔlo ɛdeɛ ne ala la kolaa na yearali belemgbunli.
Bodane mɔɔ buluku ne gyi zolɛ la le kɛ mɔɔ tetedwɛkɛ mɔɔ wɔ Ngyekyeleɛ Dɛba ne anu la gyi zolɛ la na ɔkile kɛ, saa sonla di nɔhalɛ maa Nyamenle a ɔwie ye boɛ; Nyamenle anwo anzosesebɛyɛlɛ nee munzule a lua a. Bɛhanle ɛhye wienyi wɔ Awulae nrɛlaleɛ ne mɔɔ bɛvale bɛmanle sɛlɛvolɛ Yilae wɔ mgbakyelɛ nwiɔ nee nsa ne anu la kɛ, “Mebali menli mɔɔ di me eni la eni, na meakpo bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkpo me la.”
Buluku ne kile menli adwenle mɔɔ ɛngya wɔ belemgbunlililɛ nwo la. Menli ze kɛ Awulae mumua ne a le Yizilayɛ belemgbunli ne a, na kɛmɔ menli ne bɛdabɛ bɛbizale la ati, Awulae yele belemgbunli manle bɛ. Debie mɔɔ hyia ɛsesebɛ wɔ nu la a le kɛ, belemgbunli ne nee Yizilayɛma kɔsɔɔti woale Nyamenle belemgbunlililɛ nee ye ndɛnebualɛ bo (2.7-10). Wɔ Nyamenle Mɛla ne mɔ abo, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛdi nɔhalɛ nee pɛlepɛle bɛmaa awie biala, saa sukoavolɛ o, ehyianvolɛ o.
Mɔɔ wɔ nu la
Samoɛle yɛ Yizilayɛ maanle ne buvolɛ 1.1—7.17
Sɔɔlo di belemgbunli 8.1—10.27
Mekɛ ekyi bie mɔɔ lumua Sɔɔlo belemgbunlililɛ ne anyunlu la 11.1—15.35
Devidi nee Sɔɔlo 16.1—30.31
Sɔɔlo nee ɔ mra ne mɔ ewule 31.1-13

Title: 1 SAM 1
Content:
Ɛlekana nee ye abusua ne wɔ Hyaelo
1Nrenya bie mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Ɛlekana la woale ɛkɛ, ɔvi Yifelaem abusua ekpunli ne anu. Ɔdɛnlanle sua ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Releema, mɔɔ wɔ Yifelaem awoka ne mɔ azo la azo. Bɛfɛlɛ ɔ ze Gyɛloham. Gyɛloham ɔ ze a le Ɛlaehu; Ɛlaehu ɔ ze a le Tohu; Tohu ɔ ze a le Zɛfe. 2Ɛlekana gyale mraalɛ nwiɔ. Bɛfɛlɛ ko Hana yɛɛ bɛfɛlɛ ko Pɛnena. Pɛnena bɔle ɛdane na Hana anwo ralɛ. 3Ɛvolɛ biala Ɛlekana vi Releema kɔ Hyaelo. Ɛkɛ ne a sɛlɛvolɛ Yilae amra mrenya nwiɔ ne, Hɔfenae nee Fenɛhaze yɛ bɛ sɛlɛvolɛ gyima ne a. Ɛlekana kɔ ɛkɛ ne ɛvolɛ biala kɔsonle na ɔbɔ azu ɔmaa Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma. 4Mekɛ biala mɔɔ Ɛlekana kabɔ azu la, ɔtu ye azubɔdeɛ ne anu ɛkpɔ ko ɔmaa ɔ ye Pɛnena na ɔmaa ɔ mra mrenya nee mraalɛ ne mɔ biala ɛkpɔ ko. 5Ɔkulo Hana kpalɛ noko ɛkpɔ ko ala a ɔfa ɔmaa ɔdaye a, ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ammaa yeanwo ralɛ. 6Dahuu ɔ hola Pɛnena si ye amgbu na ɔfa ye mota ɔse ye, ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ammaa yeannyia ɛkolɛ yeanwo ralɛ. 7Nyɛleɛ ɛhye hɔle zolɛ ɛvolɛ biala; mekɛ biala mɔɔ bɛkɛhɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu kɛ bɛkazonle la Pɛnena ta Hana anye zo ɔmaa ɔsu toonwo mɔɔ aleɛ bɔbɔ ɔnli bie a. 8Saa ɔba ye zɛhae a ɔ hu Ɛlekana biza ye kɛ, “Hana, duzu ati a ɛlɛsu a? Duzu ati a ɛnrɛli debie a? Duzu ati a dahuu ɛwɔ nyane nu a? Anzɛɛ me nwo ɛnlɛ nvasoɛ ɛmmaa wɔ ɛndɛla mralɛ mrenya bulu ɔ?”
Hana nee Yilae
9-10Kenle ko bɛwiele debie di wɔ Hyaelo la, Hana dwazole. Ɛnee ye adwenle ɛzɛkye dɔɔnwo, na ɔvale nyane nee alɔbɔlɛ ɔzunle kpole kpalɛ, na ɔbɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɔsɛlɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma. Mekɛ ne anu ɛnee sɛlɛvolɛ Yilae de ɔ bo zo ne wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anlenkɛ ne anloa. 11 Na Hana bɔle ɛwɔkɛ kɛ, “Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, to ɛ nye nea me, wɔ sonvolɛ; mehyia na kakye me; mmamaa ɛ rɛle fi me. Mebɔ ɛwɔkɛ kɛ saa ɛmaa menyia ɛkolɛ mewo ralɛ nrenya a menwɔdu ye nee ye ɛbɛlabɔlɛ muala menwɔmaa wɔ, na ye enrinli ko bɔbɔ, bɛnrɛde bɛnrɛdo aze.”
12Mekɛ mɔɔ Hana gua zolɛ ɛlɛsɛlɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma la, ɛnee Yilae ɛlɛnea ɔ nloa. 13Hana andendɛ na ɛnee ɔlɛsɛlɛ ɔ ti anu la ati, ɔ nloa ala a ɔbukebuke a, yemɔti Yilae bule ye kɛ sonla bie mɔɔ ɛbo nza la. 14Yemɔti Yilae zele ye kɛ, “Duzu ati a wɔbo zɛhae ɛ? Gyakyi nzanlonlɛ na yɛ ɛ nye gyɛlɛmgbɛɛnye”
15Hana zele ye kɛ, “Me menle, mele raalɛ mɔɔ me adwenle ɛha ɛbɔ nu a. Metɛnonle nwanye anzɛɛ nza ɛsesebɛ biala; me nyane edwɛkɛ a melɛka meahile Ɛdɛnkɛma a. 16Mmadwenle kɛ wɔ sonvolɛ raalɛ, mele sonlamgbane; melɛ tendenle ye amuala, me nyane nee me anwubɛnyunlu ala yɛɛ melɛye meado Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu a, ɔluakɛ meyɛ anwunvɔne.”
17Na Yilae zele ye kɛ, “Kɔ anzonudwolɛ nu; wɔ nzɛlɛlɛ ne mɔɔ wɔva wɔdo Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne anyunlu la, ɔyɛ ye zɔhane ɔmaa wɔ.”
18Hana buale kɛ, “Maa wɔ sonvolɛ raalɛ ye ɛzɔ ɛ nye dahuu.” Akee Hana hɔle sua nu, ɔlile debie na ɔgyakyile ɔ nwo alɔbɔlɛ ɛyɛlɛ.
Samoɛle awolɛ nee ye Ɛdɛnkɛma asa anu ɛduwulalɛ
19Alehyenlɛ ne anu, ye aleɛbahye ne Ɛlekana nee ye sua nu amra ne dwazole ndɛndɛ na bɛzɛlɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma. Akee bɛziale bɛhɔle bɛ sua zo Releema. Ɛlekana nwunle ɔ ye Hana, na Ɛdɛnkɛma hakyele ye. 20Yemɔti yeangyɛ biala yɛɛ Hana vale ɛkolɛ a; ɔwole ralɛ nrenya na bɛdonle ye Samoɛle, ɔluakɛ Hana se, “Menzɛlɛle ye Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛkɛ.”
21Eza mekɛ ne dwule kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ Ɛlekana nee ye sua nu amra kɔ Hyaelo kɔbɔ bɛ ɛvolɛ azu ne na ɔtua ye ɛwɔkɛbɔlɛ ɔmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma. 22Hana angɔ bie. Ɔzele ɔ hu kɛ, “Mekendɛ, saa kakula ne pɛ nyɛfonlɛ na ɔ nwo kputi a mebava ye meahɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu, na ɛkɛ ne yɛɛ ɔbadɛnla dahuu a.”
23Ɛlekana buale ye kɛ, “Nɔhalɛ, yɛ mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ ɛyɛ la; tɛnla sua nu kɔkpula mekɛ mɔɔ kakula ne kɛpɛ nyɛfonlɛ na ɔ nwo kɛkputi la. Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛmaa wɔ ɛwɔkɛ ne ɛyɛ zɔhane.” Yemɔti Hana dɛnlanle sua nu na ɔlile kakula ne adane.
24Mɔɔ kakula ne pɛle nyɛfonlɛ na ɔ nwo kputile la, Hana vale ɛnlankɛ nyinli mɔɔ ɛli ɛvolɛ nsa la, esamo kilo bulu yɛɛ nwanye nwoma kodoku ko na ɔvale kakula dɛkɛɛ ne ɔhɔle Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu wɔ Hyaelo. 25Mɔɔ bɛhunle ɛnlankɛ ne bɛwiele la, bɛvale kakula ne bɛhɔmanle Yilae. 26Hana zele ye kɛ, “Yɛmenle, asoo ɛkakye me? Nɔhalɛ, mame a mele raalɛ ne mɔɔ ragyinlanle ɛ nyunlu zɛlɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma la. 27Menzɛlɛle ye kɛ ɔmaa menwo ralɛ, na Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛyɛ me ɛbizalɛdeɛ ɛmaa me. 28Yemɔti medu ye memaa Ɛdɛnkɛma. Mekɛ dodo mɔɔ ɔdi ye wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo la, ɔle Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛdeɛ.”
Na ɔyeyɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma wɔ ɛkɛ ne.

Title: 1 SAM 2
Content:
Hana nzɛlɛlɛ ne
1 Hana zɛlɛle zele kɛ:
“Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛmaa me nye ɛlie;
Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛmaa me anwosesebɛ kpole!
Na yemaa mezele me kpɔvolɛma,
me nye ɛlie somaa, ɔboalekɛ wɔboa me.
2“Awie ɛnle nwuanzanwuanza kɛ wɔmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma angome ala,
awie ɛnle ɛkɛ kɛ ɛ ngomekye ala;
boavolɛ biala ɛnle ɛkɛ kɛ wɔmɔ yɛ Nyamenle ne ala.
3Bɛmmaka mgbole ko;
bɛmmatu bɛ nloa anu ko.
Ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma le Nyamenle mɔɔ ze debie biala a,
ɔbu nyɛleɛ biala anwo mgbonda.
4Anwosesebɛ ɛda ne mɔ ɛbubu,
menli mɔɔ le bɛtɛɛ la nyia anwosesebɛ dahuu.
5Menli mɔɔ anrɛɛ lɛ ye di la ɛnɛ di ɛkpa na bɛali,
menli mɔɔ ɛhɔne ku bɛ la ɛnɛ ɛnzu ɛhɔne.
Mota raalɛ ne ɛwo awoba nsuu,
na mɔɔ ɛwo somaa la asa ɛhondo aze.
6Ɛdɛnkɛma a ku a yɛɛ ɔdaye a ɔmaa ngoane a;
ɔmaa menli kɔ mɔwuamra sua zo,
na ɔfa bɛ ɔsia ɔba file zo.
7Ɔmaa bie mɔ di ehyia na bie mɔ nyia bɛ nwo,
ɔbɛlɛ bie mɔ aze na ɔkpogya bie mɔ zo.
8Ɔye ehyianvolɛma ɔfi bɛ nyane nu,
ɔye anwunvɔnema ɔfi bɛ amaneɛnwunlɛ nu.
Ɔyɛ bɛ arelemgbunli agɔnwo mɔ
na ɔmaa bɛdi bɛ eni dɔɔnwo.
Azɛlɛ ye adiabo ne le Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛdeɛ;
zolɛ yɛɛ yezie ewiade a.
9“Ɔsinza menli mɔɔ di nɔhalɛ maa ye la,
na ɔmaa amumuyɛma minli esike nu,
ɔluakɛ tɛ sonla ɔdaye ye anwosesebɛ yɛɛ ɔfa ɔdi konim a.
10Bɛbazɛkye Ɛdɛnkɛma kpɔvolɛma;
ɔbadea bɛ nu wɔ anwuma anwuma lɔ.
Ɛdɛnkɛma babua aleɛabo amra ndɛne.
Ɔbamaa ye belemgbunli ne anwosesebɛ,
ɔbamaa ye belemgbunli ne ali konim.”
11Akee Ɛlekana ziale hɔle Releema na kakula Samoɛle hale Hyaelo wɔ sɛlɛvolɛ Yilae anwo ɛkɛ ne na ɔzonlenle Ɛdɛnkɛma.
Yilae amra mrenya ne mɔ
12Nvasoɛ biala amba Yilae amra ne mɔ anwo zo. Bɛambu Ɛdɛnkɛma bie. 13Amaamuo mɔɔ sɛlɛvolɛ ne fa bu menli ne la a le kɛ, saa bɛlɛbɔ azu bɛamaa awie a, sɛlɛvolɛ ne sonvolɛ ne ba wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ azubɔdeɛ ne gyi senle zo la, na ɔfa faka agye nsa 14ɔwula ɛzɛne anzɛɛ siase anzɛɛ danesɛne ne mɔɔ gyi senle ne azo ɛlɛwu gbodogbodo la anu; debie biala mɔɔ faka ne nee ye kɛvinde la le sɛlɛvolɛ ne ɛdeɛ. Ɛhye yɛɛ bɛvale bɛyɛle Yizilayɛma wɔ Hyaelo a. 15Eza saa bɛbava nane ɛnlome bɛayela bɛabɔ azu a ɛnee sɛlɛvolɛ ne sonvolɛ ne base ahenle mɔɔ nee azubɔdeɛ ne ɛra kɛ bɛva bɛbɔ azu ne la kɛ, “Sɛlɛvolɛ ne ɛnrɛlie nane mɔɔ bɛdo la, yemɔti fa amolɛ ne bie maa mengɔmaa ye na ɔdaye yeadondo.”
16Saa ahenle mɔɔ lɛ azubɔdeɛ ne la se ye kɛ, “Maa bɛlumua bɛyela nane ɛnlome ne kolaa na wɔava dɔɔnwo biala mɔɔ ɛdawɔ ɛkulo la” a, sonvolɛ ne se ye kɛ, “Kyɛkyɛ, fa maa me kɛkala, saa tɛ ye zɔhane a medame mebava bie.”
17Yemɔti Yilae amra ne mɔ ɛtane ne yɛle kpole bole zolɛ wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anye zo, ɔboalekɛ bɛambu Ɛdɛnkɛma azubɔlɛ ninyɛne ne mɔ bie.
Samoɛle wɔ Hyaelo
18Kakula nrenya Samoɛle wulale “Lenen” ɛzonlenlɛ tɛladeɛ aguzo. 19Ɛvolɛ biala saa ɔ ze nee ɔ nli kɔ kɛ bɛkabɔ bɛ ɛvolɛ azu ne a, ɔ nli kɔmaa ye tɛladeɛ ekyi ko mɔɔ yenwo ye woladapi la. 20Saa bɛwie a Yilae yila Ɛlekana nee ɔ ye na ɔse Ɛlekana kɛ, “Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛmaa ɛ nee ɛ ye ɛhye ɛbɔ ɛdane ɛva ɛzie ko ye mɔɔ wɔdu wɔzie ɛkɛ wɔmaa ye la agyakɛ anu.”
Akee saa bɛwie a bɛsia bɛkɔ bɛ sua zo.
21Ɛdɛnkɛma lole Hana manle ɔnyianle mralɛ mrenya nsa bieko nee mralɛ mraalɛ nwiɔ. Kakula Samoɛle kawie nyi la ɛnee yebe Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛzonlenlɛ nu.
Yilae nee ɔ mra mrenya ne mɔ
22Akee Yilae ɛyɛ kpanyinli. Ɔdele ɛbɛla mɔɔ ɛnee ɔ mra ne mɔ ɛlɛbɔ amaa Yizilayɛma la amuala. Eza ɔdele kɛ ɔ mra ne mɔ nee mraalɛ mɔɔ sonle Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛdanlɛ Sua ne anlenkɛ ne anloa la da. 23Na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Duzu ati yɛɛ bɛbɔ ɛbɛla zɛhae a? Awie biala baka bɛ munzule ɛbɛla mɔɔ bɛlɛbɔ la kile me. 24Me mra, kyɛkyɛ, bɛgyakyi nyɛleɛ ɛhye. Ɔle munzule ɛbɛla, ɔle dumanzɛkyelɛ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma menli ne ɛlɛbɔ ye nolo wɔ bɛ avinli a. 25Saa sonla fo ɔ gɔnwo a, Nyamenle a di ɔ ti edwɛkɛ maa ye a, na saa sonla fo Ɛdɛnkɛma a ɛnee nwane a di ɔ ti mgbɔdalɛ a?”
Noko Yilae amra ne mɔ andie bɛ ze aneɛ, ɔluakɛ ɛnee ɔle Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛhulolɛ kɛ ɔku bɛ.
26 Kakula Samoɛle ɛdeɛ, ɔnyinle na ɔzɔle Ɛdɛnkɛma nee menli anye.
Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ mɔɔ tia Yilae awuke nu amra la
27Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ bie vale Ɛdɛnkɛma nrɛlaleɛ rɛlɛle Yilae kɛ, “Ɛdɛnkɛma se, ‘Mekɛ mɔɔ bɛ nlenya Aalɔn nee ye abusua ne wɔ akɛlɛ ɛzonlenlɛ nu wɔ Yigyibiti belemgbunli ne abo la, menyele me nwo mengilele bɛ. 28 Menyele ye abusua ɛdeɛ ne menvile Yizilayɛ mbusua ekpunli ne mɔ amuala anu kɛ bɛmɛ yɛɛ bɛyɛ me sɛlɛvolɛma, bɛzonle wɔ azukponle ne anwo, bɛyela ɛyɛlɛ bɛbɔ azu na bɛwula Yifɔdo bɛrɛla me nyunlu a. Eza memanle bɛ adenle kɛ bɛva azukponle ne azo azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ Yizilayɛma kɛva kɛra la bie. 29Duzu ati yɛɛ bɛkɛyɛ adidikpoku wɔ azubɔlɛ nane nvɛyeba kpalɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ me menli ne kɛva kɛmaa me la anwo na ɛkɛli ɛ mra ne mɔ eni ɛkɛdɛla me a? 30Zɔhane ati, medame, Yizilayɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle, mese: membɔle ɛwɔkɛ kɛ wɔ abusua ne nee ɛ bo zo amra bayɛ me sɛlɛvolɛma dahuu ɛdeɛ na kɛkala, mese wɔ kɛ ɔnrɛyɛ zɔhane bieko. Mebali menli mɔɔ di me eni la eni; na menrɛbu bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkpo me la ɛhwee. 31Tie, mekɛ ɛlɛba mɔɔ mebahu mgbavolɛ mɔɔ wɔ wɔ abusua ne anu la nee ɛ bo zo amra amuala a, amaa bɛ nuhua ko bɔbɔ anyɛ ɛrelera. 32Ɛbali nyane na anyebolo badɔ ɛ nwo wɔ nyilalɛ mɔɔ mebava meamaa Yizilayɛma mɔɔ ɛha la anwo, noko, wɔ sua nu amra ɛdeɛ, sonla ko bɔbɔ ɛnrɛyɛ ɛrelera ɛlɛ. 33Mebagyakyi ɛ bo zo amra ne anu ko mɔɔ ɔbazonle me kɛ me sɛlɛvolɛ. Ɔ nye bazi na yeaminli anyelazo muala, yɛɛ ɛ bo zo amra mɔɔ ɛha la kɔsɔɔti bawu dadeɛ nloa. 34 Saa ɛ mra mrenya nwiɔ ne, Hɔfenae nee Fenɛhaze gulu nu wu kenle ko a yɛɛ ɛkɛnwu kɛ edwɛkɛ biala mɔɔ meha la bayɛ zɔhane a. 35Mebaye sɛlɛvolɛ mɔɔ bali nɔhalɛ amaa me na yeayɛ debie biala mɔɔ menwɔze ye kɛ ɔyɛ la. Mebamaa ye nlɔnra mɔɔ dahuu bazonle me wɔ belemgbunli ne mɔɔ mebaye ye la abo a. 36Ɛ bo zo amra mɔɔ kɛha la bahɔ sɛlɛvolɛ zɔhane ɛkɛ ahɔzɛlɛ ezukoa nee aleɛ, na bɛabodo ye kɛ ɔmaa bɛboa ye na bɛanyia debie bɛali.’ ”

Title: 1 SAM 3
Content:
Ɛdɛnkɛma ye ɔ nwo ahile Samoɛle
1Mekɛ mɔɔ kakula Samoɛle wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛzonlenlɛ ndetelɛ bo wɔ Yilae ɛkɛ ne la, ɛnee nrɛlaleɛ mɔɔ vi Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛkɛ ne ba, nee ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ anzo biala. 2Kenle ko nɔɔzo, Yilae mɔɔ ɛnee anye ɛyɛ la, la ye sua ne anu; 3ɛnee bɛtɛnuanle Nyamenle kɛnlaneɛ ne na Samoɛle la Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu, ɛleka mɔɔ Nyamenle Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne gyi la. 4Na Ɛdɛnkɛma vɛlɛle Samoɛle kɛ, “Samoɛle, Samoɛle!” Samoɛle liele zolɛ, “Yɛmenle! Mewɔ ɛke!” 5Ɔnriandile ɔhɔle Yilae anwo ɛkɛ ne na ɔhanle kɛ, “Ɛvɛlɛle me, mera.”
Na Yilae zele ye kɛ, “Metɛfɛlɛle wɔ na kɔla.” Yemɔti Samoɛle ziale hɔlale.
6-7Ɛdɛnkɛma vɛlɛle Samoɛle bieko. Ɛnee Samoɛle ɛtɛnwunle Ɛdɛnkɛma deɛ holɛ, ɔboalekɛ ɛnee Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛtɛtendɛle ɛtɛkilele ye ɛlɛ. Yemɔti ɔdwazole ɔhɔle Yilae ɛkɛ na ɔhanle kɛ, “Ɛvɛlɛle me, mame ɛne!”
Na Yilae buale ye kɛ, “Me ra, metɛfɛlɛle wɔ, sia kɔla.”
8Ye fane nsa ne azo Ɛdɛnkɛma vɛlɛle Samoɛle. Eza ɔdwazole ɔhɔle Yilae anwo ɛkɛ ne na ɔhanle kɛ, “Ɛlɛfɛlɛ me, mera.”
Na Yilae nwunle kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛɛ ɛlɛfɛlɛ kakula ne a. 9Yemɔti Yilae zele Samoɛle kɛ, “Kɔ kɔla na saa ɔfɛlɛ wɔ a ka kɛ, ‘Ɛdɛnkɛma, tendɛ, wɔ sonvolɛ ɛlɛtie.’ ” Yemɔti Samoɛle ziale hɔlale.
10Ɛdɛnkɛma ragyinlanle ɛkɛ ne na kɛmɔ ɔyɛ ye dɛba ne ala la, ɔvɛlɛle Samoɛle bieko, “Samoɛle, Samoɛle!”
Samoɛle liele zolɛ, “Tendɛ, wɔ sonvolɛ ɛlɛtie.”
11Akee Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Samoɛle kɛ, “Mebahile Yizilayɛma debie na awie biala mɔɔ kɛde la anwo bawozo ye. 12Kenle zɔhane, edwɛkɛ biala mɔɔ meha ye wɔ Yilae abusua ne anwo la bayɛ zɔhane, ɔvi ɔ bo yeahɔ ye awieleɛ. 13Melumua meha mehile ye kɛ mebadea ye abusua ne ndeanlɛ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ la, ɔboalekɛ ɔ mra ne mɔ dendɛle ɛtane tiale Nyamenle mɔɔ ɔdaye Yilae ɔze a, noko yeandua bɛ. 14Zɔhane ati meka meka kɛ, Yilae abusua ne, azubɔlɛ anzɛɛ azubɔdeɛ biala ɛnrɛmaa ndeanlɛ mɔɔ la bɛ nwo zo la ɛnrɛzi aze ɛlɛ.”
15Samoɛle lale; ɔdwazole nwonlomɔ ne la ɔdukuedukuele Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne nlenkɛ ne mɔ. Ɛnee Samoɛle sulo kɛ ɔkɛha mɔɔ ɔnwunle ye la ɔkɛhile Yilae. 16Yilae vɛlɛle Samoɛle kɛ, “Me ra Samoɛle!”
Samoɛle liele zolɛ, “Mewɔ ɛke.”
17Yilae bizale ye kɛ, “Duzu edwɛkɛ a Ɛdɛnkɛma hanle hilele wɔ a? Mmafa ɛfea me. Debie biala mɔɔ wɔde la saa ɛfa ɛfea me a Nyamenle badua wɔ kakɛ yeagua wɔ bie zolɛ” 18Yemɔti Samoɛle anva debie biala anvea ye; ɔhanle debie biala mɔɔ ɔnwunle ye nee mɔɔ ɔdele la ɔhilele ye. Na Yilae zele ye kɛ, “Ɔdaye a ɔle Ɛdɛnkɛma a; ɔyɛ debie biala mɔɔ ɔdaye ɔnea a ɔle kpalɛ la.”
19Samoɛle dule zolɛ; Ɛdɛnkɛma nee ye luale na ɔmanle edwɛkɛ biala mɔɔ Samoɛle hanle la yɛle nɔhalɛ. 20Yemɔti Yizilayɛma kɔsɔɔti, ɔvi maanle ne ati mɔɔ kɔdwu ɔ bo la nwunle kɛ amgba Samoɛle le Ɛdɛnkɛma kpɔmanvolɛ. 21Ɛdɛnkɛma hɔle zolɛ yele ɔ nwo hilele wɔ Hyaelo; ɛkɛ ne a ɔyele ɔ nwo ɔhilele Samoɛle na ɔdendɛle ɔhilele ye a. Na mɔɔ Samoɛle hanle la, Yizilayɛma kɔsɔɔti diele.

Title: 1 SAM 4
Content:
Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne ɛvalɛ
1Mekɛ ne anu, Filisitiama boɔboale bɛ ɛlɔnema anloa kɛ bɛ nee Yizilayɛma baho. Yemɔti Yizilayɛma noko dule bɛ bo kɛ bɛ nee bɛ kaho. Yizilayɛma yɛle azokoɛleɛ wɔ Ɛbɛnizɛ yɛɛ Filisitiama noko yɛle bɛ azokoɛleɛ wɔ Efɛke. 2Filisitiama tetale Yizilayɛma na bɛhonle ɛsesebɛ bɛlile Yizilayɛma anwo zo konim; bɛhunle Yizilayɛma apenle nna wɔ konle ne anu. 3Yizilayɛ ɛlɔnema mɔɔ hale la ziale rale bɛ azokoɛleɛ ne la, bɛ mgbanyima ne bizale kɛ, “Duzu ati a ɛnɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛmaa Filisitiama ɛli yɛ nwo zo konim a? Bɛmaa yɛhɔ Hyaelo yɛhɔva Ɛdɛnkɛma Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne yɛrɛla ɛke, amaa yearadɛnla yɛ avinli na yealie yɛ yeavi yɛ kpɔvolɛma tumi ne abo.” 4 Yemɔti bɛzoanle menli bɛmanle bɛhɔle Hyaelo bɛhɔvale Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne mɔɔ Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma de ye ebia nu wɔ tease abɔdeɛ ne mɔ avinli anwuma la rale. Yilae amra mrenya nwiɔ ne, Hɔfenae nee Fenɛhaze boka nwolɛ a bɛrale a.
5Mekɛ mɔɔ bɛ nee Ɛdɛnkɛma Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne dwule azokoɛleɛ ɛkɛ ne la, Yizilayɛma ne wudole kpole bie manle azɛlɛ kpusule. 6Mɔɔ Filisitiama dele ɛwudolɛ kpole ne la, bɛzele kɛ, “Na ɛwudolɛ kpole ɛhye mɔɔ vi Hibuluma azokoɛleɛ ne ba la abo a le duzu?” Na bɛdele kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne ɛdwu azokoɛleɛ ɛkɛ ne. 7Ɛzulolɛ kpole hanle bɛ; na bɛzele kɛ, “Nyamenle bie ɛra bɛ azokoɛleɛ ɛkɛ. Yɛwie bɔkɔɔ. Debie zɛhae bie ɛtɛsile yɛ nwo zo ɛlɛ. 8Yɛwie! Nwane a kɛhola kɛlie yɛ kɛvi nyamenle anwo ɛzulolɛ ɛhye mɔ asa anu a? Bɛmɛ a bɛhunle Yigyibitima bɔkɔɔ wɔ fienemgbole ne anu la. 9Yemɔti Filisitiama, bɛzi ahonle. Bɛho kɛ mrenya na anrɛɛ yɛkɛyɛ ahanra yɛkɛmaa Hibuluma kɛ mɔɔ ɛnee bɛle bɛmaa yɛ la. Yemɔti bɛho bɛhile kɛ bɛle mrenya.”
10Na Filisitiama honle ɛsesebɛ lile Yizilayɛma anwo zo konim bɛmanle bɛguale ndwɛlɛ aze. Bɛbiale Yizilayɛma mogya takaa; bɛhunle Yizilayɛ ɛlɔnema ne anu apenle ngoko abulasa. 11Bɛvale Nyamenle Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne donvula na bɛhunle Yilae amra mrenya nwiɔ ne.
Yilae ewule ne
12Nrenya bie mɔɔ vi Bɛngyaman abusua ekpunli ne anu la vi ɛlɔne ne anloa nriandile hɔdwule Hyaelo kenle ko ne. Nyane mɔɔ ɛnee ɔlɛdi la manle ɔsuosuanle tɛladeɛ mɔɔ ɔwula la anu na ɔvale ndɛtɛlɛ ɔyɛle ɔ ti zo. 13Mɔɔ nrenya ne dwule suakpole ne azo la ɛnee Yilae de ebia nu wɔ adenle ne foa ko na ɔ nye gyi adenle zo, ɔluakɛ ɛnee ye adwenle kɔsɔɔti gyi Nyamenle Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne azo. Mɔɔ nrenya ne bɔle ye amaneɛ ne wiele la, ɛzulolɛ kpole hanle ezuavolɛ ne na bɛdeɛdeanle nuhua. 14Yilae dele alɛra ne mɔɔ menli ne ɛlɛyɛ la, ɔbizale kɛ, “Alɛra ɛhye abo a le duzu?” Nrenya ne nriandile rale Yilae anwo ɛkɛ na ɔvale amaneɛ ne ɔbɔle ye. 15Ɛnee Yilae ɛli ɛvolɛ abulahɔnla nee mɔtwɛ; akee yeyɛ ɛrelera na ɔ nye ɛyɛ, yemɔti ɔnnwu debie kpalɛ. 16Na nrenya ne zele Yilae kɛ, “Ɛnɛ kenle ko ye ala yɛɛ mevi ɛlɔne ne anloa menriandi mera a.”
Yilae bizale ye kɛ, “Me ra, kɛ konle ne zile wiele ye ɛ?”
17Nrenya ne buale ye kɛ, “Yizilayɛma ɛgua ɛbɔ nu wɔ Filisitiama anyunlu, konle ne sinli nyunlu yɛle ɛzulolɛ; ɛ mra nwiɔ ne, Hɔfenae nee Fenɛhaze ɛdɔ amolɛ nu, bɛhu yɛ ɛlɔnema ne bɔkɔɔ, yɛɛ bɛva Nyamenle Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne donvula.”
18Yilae dele amaneɛ ne mɔɔ fane Nyamenle Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne anwo la, ɔvi ebia ne mɔɔ ɔde nu la anu ɔdɔle aze alɛnranyunlu wɔ anlenkɛ kpole ne foa ko; ɔ kɔme bule na ɔwule. Ɔluakɛ ɛnee yeyɛ ɛrelera na ɔ nwo ɛyɛ ɛnlomboɛ. Yilae ziele Yizilayɛma ɛvolɛ abulanla.
Fenɛhaze aye kunlanvolɛ ne ewule
19Yilae ara Fenɛhaze aye ne ɛnee ɛva ɛkolɛ na ɔka ekyii ye awolɛ mekɛ dwu. Mɔɔ ɔdele kɛ bɛva Nyamenle Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne donvula na ɔ hu ɔ ze Yilae nee ɔ hu Fenɛhaze ɛwu la, ɔwole mgbemgbene nu. 20Mekɛ mɔɔ ɔkpondɛ yeaha bɛ sa nu la, mraalɛ mɔɔ ɛlɛdie ye awolɛ la zele ye kɛ, “To wɔ ɛbolɛ azule nu na wɔwo ralɛ nrenya.” Na yeangyea ɔ nye bɔbɔ yɛɛ yeambua. 21Ɔdonle kakula ne Ayekabɔdo, na ɔhanle kɛ, “Yizilayɛ ɛminli ye anyunlunyia ne,” ɔluakɛ bɛva Nyamenle Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne donvula yɛɛ ɔ hu nee ɔ hu ɔ ze ɛwu. 22Ɔzele kɛ, “Nyamenle anyunlunyia ne ɛvi Yizilayɛ, ɔboalekɛ bɛva Nyamenle Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne donvula.”

Title: 1 SAM 5
Content:
Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne wɔ Filisitiama avinli
1Mekɛ mɔɔ Filisitiama vale Nyamenle Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne la, bɛ nee ye vi Ɛbɛnizɛ hɔle Ahyedɔdo. 2Bɛvale bɛhɔwulale bɛ bozonle Deegɔn ne amonle sua ne anu na bɛziele ye Deegɔn amonle ne anwo ɛkɛ. 3Ye alehyenlɛ nu nwonlomɔ mangyee ne mɔɔ Ahyedɔdoma dwazole la, bɛnwunle kɛ Deegɔn ananze ne anye ɛbutu aze wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne anyunlu. Na bɛdenrɛle ye bɛziele ɔ bo zo ne bieko. 4Aleɛ hyenle bieko la, nwonlomɔ mangyee ne mɔɔ bɛdwazole la ɛnee Deegɔn anye ɛbutu aze wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne anyunlu na ɔ ti nee ɔ sa nwiɔ ne ɛbubu ɛgua anlenkɛ ne anloa na yeha ye kungunluminzi ne ala. 5Ɛhye ati ɛnɛ nee ɛnɛ ala Deegɔn ahɔmenle nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsonle Deegɔn la kɔ ye amonle sua ne anu wɔ Ahyedɔdo a bɛntia ɛleka mɔɔ ɔdɔle la.
6Ɛdɛnkɛma duale Ahyedɔdoma kakɛ na ɔhanle bɛ ɛzulolɛ kpole. Ɔvale ewule mutulemutule ɔduale Ahyedɔdoma nee maanlema mɔɔ zua bɛ la kakɛ. 7Ahyedɔdoma nwunle kɛ ninyɛne ɛlɛsi ado ahɔ la, bɛzele kɛ, “Ɔnle kɛ Nyamenle Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne boa yɛ nwo ɛke bieko. Ye tumi ne bo yɛ nee yɛ bozonle Deegɔn bɔbɔ anwo zo.” 8Yemɔti bɛzoanle bɛmanle bɛhɔvale Filisitia arelemgbunli ne mɔ na bɛzele bɛ kɛ, “Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne kɛ bɛyɛ ye la bɛyɛ ye. Ɔboa yɛ nwo ɛke bieko a ɔnrɛyɛ boɛ.”
Bɛbuale kɛ, “Bɛye ye ɛke bɛhɔ Gate.” Yemɔti bɛvale Ɛlɛka ne bɛhɔle suakpole Gate azo. 9Ɛdɛnkɛma duale suakpole ne azo amra kakɛ. Ɔhanle bɛ ɛzulolɛ, ɔmanle mutulemutule zanenle suakpole ne azo amra, ngakula nee mgbanyinli kɔsɔɔti. 10Yemɔti bɛyele Nyamenle Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne ɛkɛ bɛhɔle Ɛkelɔn. Ɛkelɔnoma nwunle Nyamenle Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne la, bɛzunle bɛdeɛdeanle nu bɛzele kɛ, “Bɛva Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne bɛra kɛ bɛbahu yɛ kɔsɔɔti.” 11Yemɔti bɛzoanle bɛmanle bɛhɔvale Filisitia arelemgbunli ne mɔ na bɛzele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛye Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne ɛke; bɛva bɛhɔzie ɔ bo zo dɛba ne wɔ Yizilayɛ, amaa yeangu yɛ nee yɛ mbusuafoɔ.” Ahunlundetelɛ hanle suakpole ne azo amra kɔsɔɔti, ɔboalekɛ ɛnee Nyamenle ɛmaa bɛ nwo ɛhyele bɛ kpalɛ. 12Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛanwu la nyianle mutulemutule, na menli ne zunle manle ɔyɛle alɔbɔlɛ na bɛvɛlɛle bɛ awozonle ne mɔ kɛ bɛralie bɛ.

Title: 1 SAM 6
Content:
Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne ɛzianenlɛ
1Ɛdɛnkɛma Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne lile siane nsuu wɔ Filisitia maanle nu. 2Filisitiama vɛlɛvɛlɛle bɛ ahɔmenle nee menli mɔɔ bɔ menli munzule la na bɛbizale bɛ kɛ, “Ɛdɛnkɛma Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne kɛ yɛyɛ ye ɛ? Bɛha deɛ holɛ ko mɔɔ saa yɛfa yɛahɔzie ɔ bo zo dɛba ne a yɛva yɛboka nwolɛ la bɛhile yɛ.”
3Bɛzele kɛ, “Saa bɛfa Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne bɛahɔzie ɔ bo zo ne a ɛnee bɛmmafa ye mgbane bɛkɔ. Wɔ adenle biala anu, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛfa mgbɔdalɛ azubɔdeɛ bɛboka nwolɛ, amaa bɛanyia bɛ ti na bɛanwu debie mɔɔ yemɔti sumunli kɛ de la yedua bɛ kakɛ kpole ɛhye la.”
4Menli ne bizale kɛ, “Ɛnee duzu mgbɔdalɛ azubɔdeɛ a yɛva yɛhɔmaa ye a?”
Ahɔmenle ne mɔ buale kɛ, “Bɛdabɛ arelemgbunli nnu ne, bɛbɔ ko biala ati bɛva ezukoa nvutuke ngunguma mɔɔ zɔho mutulemutule yɛɛ ko noko mɔɔ le kɛ kila la bɛgua Ɛlɛka ne anu, ɔluakɛ ewule nzane ne hanle menli ne nee arelemgbunli ne mɔ noko. 5Yemɔti bɛyɛ mutulemutule ne nee ahila ne mɔ mɔɔ zɛkyele bɛ maanle ne la ananze bɛwula Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne anyunlunyia, na wɔannea a ɔkɛgyakyi bɛ nee bɛ awozonle ne mɔ nee bɛ maanle ne kakɛdualɛ. 6Duzu ati a bɛyɛ anzosesebɛ, kɛmɔ Yigyibiti belemgbunli nee Yigyibitima yɛle la ɛ? Bɛhakye kɛ Nyamenle zile dole bɛ agyiba na nzinlii ɔyɛle bɛ koasea ɔmanle Yizilayɛma vile Yigyibiti la. 7Yemɔti bɛbobɔ ehwili ko na bɛziezie nlankɛ mbelɛ nwiɔ mɔɔ bɛtɛfale bɛtɛyɛle gyima ɛlɛ la; bɛva ehwili ne bɛhenda bɛ na bɛha bɛ mra ne mɔ bɛwula tunli nu. 8Akee bɛva Ɛdɛnkɛma Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne bɛzie ehwili ne azo, na bɛva ɛlɛka ne mɔɔ bɛgua ezukoa nvutuke mgbɔdalɛ azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ nu la bɛzie ye foa ko; bɛha nlankɛ ne mɔ bɛmaa bɛ ngome bɛva ehwili ne bɛdɔ adenle zo. 9Na akee bɛnlea saa ɔsia ɔkɔ Bɛte Hyimɛhye sua zo a ɛnee Yizilayɛ Nyamenle yɛɛ ɛmaa ewule nzane ne ɛdɔ yɛ nwo a. Saa yeangɔ ɛkɛ ne a ɛnee ɔkile kɛ nzia nee nzia yɛɛ ɛyia nu a.”
10Menli ne yɛle, kɛmɔ bɛhanle bɛhilele bɛ ala la. Bɛvale ehwili ne bɛhendanle nlankɛ mbelɛ nwiɔ ne na bɛhanle bɛ mra ne mɔ bɛwulale tunli nu. 11Bɛvale Ɛdɛnkɛma Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne bɛziele ehwili ne azo, bɛvale ɛlɛka ne mɔɔ mutulemutule nee kila ananze ne mɔ wɔ nu la noko bɛziele zolɛ. 12Nlankɛ ne mɔ bɔle bɛ ti Bɛte Hyimɛhye adenle zo, bɛammakyi ɛleka biala. Bɛkɔ la ɛnee bɛ ɛzunlɛ ne la zolɛ. Filisitia arelemgbunli ne doale bɛ toonwo bɛdwule Bɛte Hyimɛhye ɛweɛne zo.
13Mekɛ ne anu ɛnee Bɛte Hyimɛhyema ɛlɛte hwiiti (ma bie mɔɔ le kɛ awule la) wɔ bɔnza bie anu. Arɛlevilɛ nu bɛkpogyale bɛ ti zo la bɛnwunle Ɛdɛnkɛma Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne na bɛlile fɛlɛko. 14Ehwili ne hɔle Dwɔhyua mɔɔ vi Bɛte Hyimɛhye ɛkɛ ne la ɛya avule ɛdeɛ ne anu na ɔhɔgyinlanle bolɛ kpole bie anwo. Menli ne mɔ zianyinle nlankɛ ne na bɛbubule ehwili ne bɛyɛle ɛyɛne bɛyelale nlankɛ ne mɔ bɛbɔle azu bɛmanle Ɛdɛnkɛma. 15Livaema ne dwulale Ɛdɛnkɛma Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne nee ɛlɛka ne mɔɔ ezukoa nvutuke ananze ne mɔ wɔ nu la aze, na bɛvale bɛziele bodane ne azo. Kenle ko ne Bɛte Hyimɛhyema vale ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ bɔle azu manle Ɛdɛnkɛma. 16Filisitia arelemgbunli nnu ne nwunle ɛhye la, bɛziale bɛhɔle Ɛkelɔn kenle ko ne ala.
17Filisitiama vale ezukoa nvutuke mutulemutule ananze ne yɛle azubɔdeɛ yɛle bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ anwo mgbɔdalɛ manle Ɛdɛnkɛma: Ahyedɔdo ɛdeɛ ko, Gaza ɛdeɛ ko, Ahyekɛlɔn ɛdeɛ ko, Gate ɛdeɛ ko, yɛɛ Ɛkelɔn noko ɛdeɛ ko. 18Zɔhane ala yɛɛ bɛyɛle ezukoa nvutuke kila ananze nnu ne mɔ a; azuamgbole nnu ne mɔɔ arelemgbunli nnu ne dede zolɛ mɔɔ bɛlie nwolɛ bane nee mɔɔ bɛtɛdiele nwolɛ bane la ko biala ɛdeɛ ko. Bodane ne mɔɔ bɛziele Ɛdɛnkɛma Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne zolɛ la, ɛnɛ nee ɛnɛ ala tɛbɔ Dwɔhyua mɔɔ vi Bɛte Hyimɛhye la ɛya nu di mɔɔ zile la anwo daselɛ.
19Ɛdɛnkɛma manle Bɛte Hyimɛhye menli abulasuu wule, ɔboalekɛ bɛnleanle Ɛdɛnkɛma Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne anu. Na menli ne vale ɛzunlɛ lile nyane, ɔboalekɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛmaa menli ɛzɛkye bɛ avinli.
Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne wɔ Keleate Gyialem
20Yemɔti Bɛte Hyimɛhyema hanle kɛ, “Nwane a kɛhola Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle Nwuanzanwuanza ɛhye anyunlu gyinla a? Yɛɛ ɔvi yɛ ɛke a ɛnee nwane ɛkɛ ne yɛɛ ɔkɔ a?” 21Yemɔti bɛzoanle menli wɔ Keleate Gyialem bɛhɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Filisitiama ɛziane Ɛdɛnkɛma Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne ɛra. Bɛrɛla bɛrava bɛhɔ.”

Title: 1 SAM 7
Content:
1 Yemɔti Keleate Gyialemma ravale Ɛdɛnkɛma Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne na bɛ nee ye hɔle Abenadabe mɔɔ de boka ne azo la sua nu. Bɛdule ɔ ra Ɛlieza bɛziele ɛkɛ bɛmanle Ɛdɛnkɛma na bɛzele ye kɛ ɔnlea zolɛ.
Samoɛle sie Yizilayɛ
2Ɛdɛnkɛma Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne woale Keleate Gyialem hyɛle kpalɛ, ɔlile ɛvolɛ kɛyɛ abulanwiɔ. Mekɛ ɛhye anu, Yizilayɛma kɔsɔɔti vale ɛzunlɛ zɛlɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma moalɛ.
3Samoɛle zele Yizilayɛma kɛ, “Saa bɛfa bɛ ahonle kɔsɔɔti bɛazia bɛara Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛkɛ ne a ɛnee bɛkpo bɛ maanle gyɛne nu nyamenle ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti nee bɛ bozonle raalɛ Asetate ananze ne ɛzonlenlɛ. Bɛdu bɛ nwo kɔsɔɔti bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma na bɛzonle ɔ ngomekye na ɔkɛlie bɛ ɔkɛvi Filisitiama asa anu.” 4Yemɔti Yizilayɛma vuandinle Beeyale ne mɔ nee Asetate ananze ne mɔ guale na bɛzonlenle Ɛdɛnkɛma angomekye.
5Akee Samoɛle zele Yizilayɛma kɛ, “Bɛ kɔsɔɔti bɛhɔyia Mezepa na mebazɛlɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma meamaa bɛ.” 6Yemɔti bɛhɔyiale Mezepa; bɛguale nzule aze bɛmanle Ɛdɛnkɛma na bɛhyele ɛhɔne kenle ko ne na bɛzele kɛ, “Yɛyɛ ɛtane yɛtia Ɛdɛnkɛma.” (Mezepa ɛkɛ ne yɛɛ Samoɛle dɛnlanle ziele Yizilayɛma a.)
7Mɔɔ Filisitiama dele kɛ Yizilayɛma ɛyia nu wɔ Mezepa la, Filisitia arelemgbunli ne mɔ vale ɛlɔnema kɛ bɛkadoa bɛ bɛ nee bɛ aho. Yizilayɛma dele nwolɛ bie na ɛzulolɛ hanle bɛ. 8Bɛzele Samoɛle kɛ, “Kɔ zolɛ sɛlɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛ Nyamenle ne maa ɔlie yɛ ɔvi Filisitiama asa anu.” 9Samoɛle hunle boane ralɛ mɔɔ tɛno nyɛfonlɛ la yelale ye mumua ne bɔle azu manle Ɛdɛnkɛma. Akee ɔzɛlɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma kɛ ɔboa Yizilayɛma na Ɛdɛnkɛma diele ye nzɛlɛlɛ ne. 10Mekɛ mɔɔ Samoɛle wɔ zolɛ ɔlɛbɔ azu ne la, Filisitiama rale Yizilayɛma anwo zo, na ɛkɛ ne ala Ɛdɛnkɛma kpakyele ɛsɛnlɛmanye guale Filisitiama anwo zo manle bɛ nye zo danle bɛ, na bɛvale sulosulo bɛbɔle asande bɛguale ɛbɔ nu. 11Yizilayɛma vi Mezepa vindele na bɛbelele bɛzile Filisitiama zo toonwo bɛhɔdwule Bɛtekaa. Bɛhunle awie biala mɔɔ bɛdole ye adenle nu la.
12Akee Samoɛle vale bolɛ kpɔnlanle Mezepa nee Hyɛn avinli na ɔvɛlɛle ye “Ɛbɛnizɛ” na ɔzele kɛ, “Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛboa yɛ toonwo a, yeradwu ɛnɛ a.” 13Yemɔti Yizilayɛma lile Filisitiama anwo zo konim na Filisitiama anva bɛ edwɛkɛ andoa bɛ bieko wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ Samoɛle de aze la. 14Yizilayɛma liele azuamgbole mɔɔ bɔ ye Ɛkelɔn kɔdwu Gate mɔɔ Filisitiama lile bɛ nwo zo konim vale la amuala. Yemɔti Yizilayɛma asa hanle bɛ maanle ne kɔsɔɔti. Na anzonudwolɛ rale Yizilayɛma nee Keenama avinli.
15Samoɛle ziele Yizilayɛ maanle ne toonwo ɔhɔle ewule nu. 16Ɔde aze la ɛvolɛ biala ɔkpɔsa bɛ nwo zo; ɔkɔ Bɛtɛle, Gelegale nee Mezepa na ɔsiezie manzonle manzonle mɔɔ wɔ azuamgbole ɛhye mɔ azo la amuala. 17Ɔwie a akee ɔsia ɔkɔ ye sua zo Releema na ɔkɔtoto ɛkɛ ne noko boɛ. Ɔzile azukponle wɔ Releema ɔmanle Ɛdɛnkɛma.

Title: 1 SAM 8
Content:
Yizilayɛma kpondɛ belemgbunli
1Mɔɔ Samoɛle yɛle ɛrelera la, ɔyɛle ɔ mra mrenya ne mɔ maanlebuvoma wɔ Yizilayɛ. 2Bɛfɛlɛ ɔ ra nrenya kpanyinli ne Dwowɛle yɛɛ bɛfɛlɛ ekyi ne Abaegya; bɛyɛle maanlebuvoma wɔ Biyɛhyiba. 3Noko bɛanva bɛ ze agyakɛ. Bɛ nye bolole ezukoa, bɛliele ndoloboa na bɛbule bɛ nye bɛguale pɛlepɛlelilɛ zo.
4Yizilayɛ mgbanyinli yiale; bɛhɔnwunle Samoɛle wɔ Releema. 5 Na bɛzele ye kɛ, “Nea, wɔyɛ kpanyinli yɛɛ ɛ mra ne mɔ noko anva ɛ gyakɛ. Yemɔti ye sonla maa ɔli yɛ belemgbunli, kɛmɔ maanle gyɛne gyɛne ne mɔ yɛ ye la.” 6Bɛhanle ɛhye la, yeanyɛ Samoɛle fɛ. Yemɔti ɔzɛlɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma, 7na Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Samoɛle kɛ, “Edwɛkɛ biala mɔɔ menli ne kɛha kɛhile wɔ la, tie. Tɛ wɔmɔ yɛɛ bɛkpo wɔ a; mame yɛɛ bɛkpo me kɛ ɛnɛ menle bɛ belemgbunli bieko a. 8Sumunli kɛ menyele bɛ menvile Yigyibiti la, bɛhakyi bɛ nzi bɛzi me na bɛzonle nyamenle ngakyile ngakyile; mɔɔ bɛyɛle bɛmanle me la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ bɛlɛyɛ bɛamaa wɔ a. 9Yemɔti, wɔmɔ tie bɛ. Noko bɔ bɛ kɔkɔ ɛsesebɛ, na maa bɛnwu adenle mɔɔ bɛ belemgbunli ne balua nu azie bɛ la.”
10Samoɛle hanle edwɛkɛ biala mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma hanle la hilele menli mɔɔ se bɛkpondɛ belemgbunli la. 11Samoɛle hilele nuhua hilele bɛ kɛ, “Kɛ bɛ belemgbunli ne bazi azie bɛ la ɛne. Ɔbayɛ bɛ mra mrenya ne mɔ ye ɛlɔnema mɔɔ bie mɔ baha ye konle ehwili ne mɔ, bie mɔ baha ye mgbɔnwɔ, na bie mɔ noko anriandi ali ye konle ehwili ne mɔ anyunlu. 12Ɔbayɛ bie mɔ ɛlɔnema apenle nwo zo safohyenlema, yɛɛ bie mɔ noko bayɛ ɛlɔnema abulanlu nwo zo safohyenlema. Bɛ mra mrenya ne mɔ bayɛ ye ɛyazonlɛma, bie mɔ babu ye ɛya ne mɔ anu bɛyɔba ne, na bie mɔ ayɛ ye konle ehwili ne mɔ anwo ninyɛne nee adu. 13Bɛ mra mraalɛ ne bie mɔ bayɛ sakyeɛ evuanlɛ amaa ye, bie mɔ bado ye aleɛ na bie mɔ ado ye kpanwo. 14Ɔbava bɛ ɛya avule, bɛ vanye ɛya avule, yɛɛ bɛ ɔlivi ɛya avule kpalɛ ne mɔ yeamaa ye sonvolɛma. 15Ɔbahyɛ awie biala abɛlɛ nee ye vanye ma ne mɔ anu bulu yeadu ɛkpɔ ngoko yeamaa ye suakunlu mgbanyima nee ye sonvolɛma. 16Ɔbamaa bɛ sonvolɛ mrenya nee mraalɛ kpalɛ ne mɔ, bɛ nlankɛ nee bɛ asoaso kpalɛ ne mɔ ayɛ gyima amaa ye. 17Ɔbahyɛ awie biala nyɛmoa ne mɔ anu bulu yeadu ɛkpɔ ko, na bɛdabɛ mumua ne, ɔbayɛ bɛ ye ahanra. 18Kɛmɔ bɛdabɛ bɛzie bɛ belemgbunli la saa mekɛ zɔhane dwu a bɛbahwi monle, noko Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛnrɛdie bɛ ɛzunlɛ.”
19Menli ne mɔ andie Samoɛle ane na bɛzele kɛ, “Kyɛkyɛ; yɛkpondɛ belemgbunli, 20amaa yeayɛ kɛ maanle maanle mɔɔ ɛha la, na yeazie yɛ, yeali yɛ nyunlu ɔ nee yɛ ahɔ konle.” 21Samoɛle diele bɛ edwɛkɛ ne amuala na ɔbɔle Ɛdɛnkɛma amaneɛ. 22Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Samoɛle kɛ, “Kɛmɔ bɛdabɛ bɛbiza la, yɛ ye zɔhane na ye belemgbunli maa bɛ.” Akee Samoɛle zele Yizilayɛma kɔsɔɔti kɛ awie biala ɛhɔ ye sua zo.

Title: 1 SAM 9
Content:
Sɔɔlo yia Samoɛle
1Nrenya sukoavolɛ bie wɔ ɛkɛ. Bɛfɛlɛ ye Kehye, ɔvi Bɛngyaman abusua ekpunli ne anu. Ɔ ze a le Abayɛle. Abayɛle ɔ ze a le Zilɔ, Zilɔ ɔ ze a le Bɛkɔla, yɛɛ Bɛkɔla ɔ ze a le Afaya. 2Kehye wole ralɛ nrenya na ɔdonle ye Sɔɔlo. Wɔ Yizilayɛ maanle ne anu, nrenya biala anwo ɛnyɛ fɛ nee Sɔɔlo ɛnzɛ. Ɔle nrenya tendenle ɔtɛla awie biala.
3Sɔɔlo ɔ ze Kehye asoaso ne bie mɔ minlinle. Yemɔti Kehye zele Sɔɔlo kɛ, “Fa sonvolɛma ne mɔ ko na ɛ nee ye ɛhɔ bɛhɔkpondɛ asoaso ne mɔ.” 4Bɛhɔluoluale Yifelaem awoka ne mɔ azo nee mbɔnza ne mɔ anu nee Hyalehya maanzinli ne anu, na bɛannwu bɛ. Bɛhɔkpondɛle bɛ wɔ Hyeeyalem azɛlɛ zo, na bɛannwu bɛ. Eza bɛhɔkpondɛle bɛ wɔ Bɛngyaman azɛlɛ zo, na bɛannwu bɛ. 5Mɔɔ bɛdwule Zɛfe maanle nu la, Sɔɔlo zele ye sonvolɛ ne mɔɔ ɔ nee ye lua la kɛ, “Maa yɛzia yɛhɔ sua nu na anrɛɛ egya akee kɛdwenle yɛ nwo kɛdɛla asoaso ne mɔ.”
6Na sonvolɛ ne zele ye kɛ, “Nyamenle sonla bie wɔ suakpole ɛhye azo. Awie biala di ye eni, ɔluakɛ edwɛkɛ biala mɔɔ ɔkɛha la yɛ zɔhane. Maa yɛhɔ ɔ nwo ɛkɛ, wɔannea a ɔkɛhola ɔkɛhile yɛ ɛleka mɔɔ yɛkɛnwu asoaso ne mɔ la.”
7Sɔɔlo bizale ye kɛ, “Saa yɛkɔ a, duzu debie yɛɛ yɛbava yɛamaa ye a? Yɛnlɛ aleɛ biala wɔ yɛ bɔlɛ nu, yɛɛ yɛnlɛ debie biala mɔɔ yɛfa yɛamaa ye a.”
8Sonvolɛ ne buale ye kɛ, “Melɛ dwɛtɛ fufule ekyi ko; mebava meamaa ye, na yeahile yɛ ɛleka mɔɔ yɛkɛnwu asoaso ne mɔ la.”
9-11Sɔɔlo buale ye kɛ, “Wɔ adwenle ne le kpalɛ, maa yɛhɔ.” Yemɔti bɛhɔle suakpole ne mɔɔ Nyamenle sonla ne wɔ zolɛ la azo. Mɔɔ bɛfo boka ne bɛahɔ sua ne azo la, bɛ nee mbɛlɛra bie mɔɔ ɛlɛkɔ azule la yiale. Bɛbizale mbɛlɛra ne mɔ kɛ, “Sonla ne mɔɔ nwu Nyamenle ɛhulolɛdeɛ la wɔ ɛkɛ ɔ?”
(Mekɛ ne anu, wɔ Yizilayɛ maanle nu ɛnee bɛfɛlɛ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma “Sonla mɔɔ nwu Nyamenle ɛhulolɛdeɛ la.” Yemɔti mekɛ biala mɔɔ awie kpondɛ abiza Nyamenle edwɛkɛ la ɛnee ɔse, “Maa yɛhɔ sonla ne mɔɔ nwu Nyamenle ɛhulolɛdeɛ la” ɛkɛ.)
12-13Mbɛlɛra ne mɔ buale bɛ kɛ, “Ɛhɛe, ɔwɔ ɛkɛ; kɛ ɔdwu suakpole ye azo ala la ɛne. Bɛsa bɛ gyakɛ anu ekyii a bɛbado ye. Saa bɛdwu sua ne azo ala a, bɛbanwu ye kolaa na yeahɔ azubɔlɛ ne, ɔboalekɛ menli ne babɔ azu wɔ azukponle ne mɔɔ wɔ boka ne azo la azo. Menli mɔɔ bɛdo ɛsalɛ bɛvɛlɛ bɛ la bahendɛ toonwo kɔkpula mekɛ mɔɔ ɔkɛyila aleɛ ne azo la na bɛali. Saa bɛka bɛ nwo a, bɛbado ye yeahyɛ kolaa na yeahɔ boka ne azo kɛ ɔkali debie.” 14Yemɔti Sɔɔlo nee ye sonvolɛ ne hɔle sua ne azo. Mɔɔ bɛfo suakpole ne azo ala la, bɛ nee Samoɛle yiale kɛ ɔlɛkɔ boka ne azo, ɛleka mɔɔ bɛkazonle la.
15Kenle mɔɔ aleɛ kye a Sɔɔlo kɛra la, Ɛdɛnkɛma yele hilele Samoɛle kɛ, 16“Ɛhyema, bekezɛ ala, mebamaa nrenya bie mɔɔ vi Bɛngyaman abusua ekpunli ne anu la ara ɛ nwo ɛke. Kpokpa ye nwole kɛ ɔli belemgbunli ɔzie me menli Yizilayɛma. Ɔbalie bɛ yeavi Filisitiama asa anu. Menwu bɛ amaneɛnwunlɛ ne amuala yɛɛ mede bɛ ɛzunlɛ ne mɔɔ bɛlɛsu bɛabiza moalɛ la.”
17Mɔɔ Samoɛle anye bobɔle Sɔɔlo la, Ɛdɛnkɛma zele ye kɛ, “Nrenya ne mɔɔ menganle ye edwɛkɛ la, yemɔ ɛne. Yemɔ yɛɛ ɔbazie me menli Yizilayɛma a.” 18Na Sɔɔlo bikyele Samoɛle wɔ suakpole ne anuhɔlɛ kpole ne anloa na ɔbizale ye kɛ, “Nienwu a sonla ne mɔɔ nwu Nyamenle ɛhulolɛdeɛ la wɔ a?”
19Samoɛle buale ye kɛ, “Mame a mele sonla ne mɔɔ nwu Nyamenle ɛhulolɛdeɛ la a. Dumua me nyunlu wɔ ɛleka mɔɔ bɛlɛbɔ azu ne la, ɔluakɛ ɛnɛ bɛ nee me bado ɛsalɛ, na aleɛ kye a wɔ edwɛkɛ biala mɔɔ ɛ nee ye rale la mebabua wɔ nwolɛ na meamaa wɔahɔ. 20Wɔ asoaso ne mɔ mɔɔ ɛnɛ kenle nsa minlinle la, mmadwenle nwolɛ na bɛnwu bɛ. Na nwane yɛɛ Yizilayɛma ɛlɛkpondɛ ye ɛsesebɛ a? Ɛdawɔ ɔ, wɔmɔ nee ɛ ze sua nu amra.”
21Sɔɔlo buale kɛ, “Mevi Bɛngyaman abusua ekpunli ne anu. Abusua ɛhye a le Yizilayɛ mbusua ekpunli ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti anu ekyi kpalɛ a, yɛɛ me sua nu amra fɔɔnwo ne noko ɛnlɛ duma fee wɔ Bɛngyaman abusua ekpunli ne anu. Duzu ati a ɛkɛva amaneɛ ɛhye ɛkɛbɔ me ɛ?”
22Akee Samoɛle vale Sɔɔlo nee ye sonvolɛ ne wolole sua ne anu, ɛleka mɔɔ menli kɛyɛ abulasa mɔɔ bɛdo ɛsalɛ bɛvɛlɛ bɛ la ɛyia la. Ɔmanle bɛdɛnlanle menli ne anyunlu wɔ ɛkponle ne ati. 23Samoɛle zele ahenle mɔɔ donle aleɛ ne la kɛ, “Fa nane ne mɔɔ menvale memanle wɔ kɛ ɛva ɛzie ahane la bɛla.” 24Yemɔti mɔɔ donle aleɛ ne la vale ndwɛlɛ ne mɔ nee ɔ kɔme zo nanenvoka ne mɔ bie raziele Sɔɔlo anyunlu, na Samoɛle zele kɛ, “Nea, mɔɔ bɛvale bɛziele wɔ la ɛne. Di, menvale menziele wɔ, amaa mekɛ ne dwu a ɛ nee menli mɔɔ bɛdole ɛsalɛ bɛvɛlɛle bɛ la ali.”
Yemɔti Sɔɔlo nee Samoɛle dole ɛsalɛ kenle ko ne. 25Mɔɔ bɛvi ɛzonlenlɛ ɛleka ne bɛhɔle sua nu la, bɛzieziele dabelɛ wɔ sua ne ati zo bɛmanle Sɔɔlo, 26na ɔlale ɛkɛ ne.
Samoɛle kpokpa Sɔɔlo nwole ahile kɛ ɔle belemgbunli
Aleɛbahye ne Samoɛle vɛlɛle Sɔɔlo na ɔzele ye kɛ, “Dwazo; maa mengɔgua wɔ adenle.” Sɔɔlo dwazole na ɔ nee Samoɛle vindele gua ne azo. 27Mɔɔ bɛdwule sua ne kandiba la, Samoɛle zele Sɔɔlo kɛ, “Ka kile wɔ sonvolɛ ne kɛ ɔlumua yɛ nyunlu.” Sonvolɛ ne lumuale na Samoɛle zele Sɔɔlo kɛ, “Kendɛ ekyii maa menga edwɛkɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛha la mengile wɔ.”

Title: 1 SAM 10
Content:
1Akee Samoɛle vale dwora mɔɔ nwole wɔ nu la, ɔwolale ɔguale Sɔɔlo ati zo, ɔvole ɔ nvoka anwo na ɔzele kɛ, “Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛye wɔ kɛ ɛzie ye menli Yizilayɛma. Ɛbazie bɛ na wɔalie bɛ wɔavi bɛ kpɔvolɛma asa anu. Na ɛhye a le sɛkɛlɛneɛ mɔɔ bahile kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛye wɔ kɛ ɛzie ye menli ne la a. 2Saa ɛvi me nwo ɛke ɛnɛ a, ɛ nee mrenya nwiɔ bayia Relahyɛle sɛka ne anwo wɔ Zɛleza mɔɔ wɔ Bɛngyaman maanzinli nu la. Bɛbaze wɔ kɛ asoaso ne mɔ mɔɔ ɛhɔle bɛ ɛkpondɛlɛ la, bɛnwu bɛ, yemɔti ɛ ze ɛndwenle bɛ nwo bieko na wɔmɔ yɛɛ akee ɔlɛdi ɛ nwo nyane a, na ɔbiza ɔ nwo kɛ, ‘Na me ra ne, duzu a menyɛ a?’ 3Ɛvi ɛkɛ ne a ɛbahɔ toonwo wɔahɔdwu baka bie anwo wɔ Teebɔ. Ɛkɛ ne, ɛ nee mrenya nsa bayia kɛ bɛlɛ bɛ azubɔdeɛ bɛlɛkɔ Bɛtɛle bɛahɔbɔ azu bɛamaa Nyamenle. Ko lɛ mbɔnkye mralɛ nsa, ko lɛ kpanwo ahunguma nsa, yɛɛ ko noko lɛ nwoma kodoku mɔɔ nwanye wɔ nu la. 4Bɛbabiza wɔ ahye na bɛamaa wɔ kpanwo ne nwiɔ, na anrɛɛ die. 5Akee ɛbadwu Nyamenle Boka, wɔ Gebɛya, ɛleka mɔɔ Filisitiama azokoɛleɛ ne wɔ la ademgbole ne mɔɔ fa kɔ sua ne azo la anu, ɛbanwu Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma ekpunli bie mɔɔ vi boka ne azo azukponle ne anwo ɛlɛtolo ara la na bɛlɛka Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ, bɛsi agole na bɛbɔ getaa kpole, akɛya, fulutu, yɛɛ ɛto. 6Na arɛlevilɛ nu ala, Ɛdɛnkɛma Sunsum ne badwu ɛ nwo zo kpole bie na ɛ nee bɛ aha Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ ne na wɔayɛ sonla ngakyile. 7Saa sɛkɛlɛneɛ ɛhye mɔ sisi a, debie biala mɔɔ Nyamenle kɛze wɔ kɛ ɛyɛ la, yɛ. Ɔluakɛ Nyamenle nee wɔ a lua a. 8Ɛbalumua me nyunlu wɔ Gelegale, na mebarayia wɔ ɛkɛ na mearabɔ ɛyelalɛ nee anzonudwolɛ azu. Anrɛɛ kendɛ me ɛkɛ ne kenle nsuu kɔkpula kɛ menwɔrahile wɔ deɛ mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ ɛyɛ la.”
9Mɔɔ Sɔɔlo vile Samoɛle anwo ɛkɛ ne na ɔkɔ la, Nyamenle manle ye ahonle nee ye subane hakyile; edwɛkɛ biala mɔɔ Samoɛle hanle hilele ye la yɛle zɔhane kenle ko ne ala. 10Mɔɔ Sɔɔlo nee ye sonvolɛ ne dwule Gebɛya la, bɛ nee Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma ekpunli bie yiale. Arɛlevilɛ nu Nyamenle Sunsum ne dwule Sɔɔlo anwo zo kpole bie, na ɔ nee bɛ zile agole na bɛhanle Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ ne. 11Menli mɔɔ ze ye dɛba la nwunle kɛ ɔ nee Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma ne mɔ ɛlɛka Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ ne la, bɛbizebizale bɛ nwo ngoko kɛ, “Duzu edwɛkɛ a ɛzi Kehye ara ye anwo zo a? Ɛnee Sɔɔlo ɔdaye noko yeyɛ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ ɔ?” 12 Nrenya ko mɔɔ vi ɛkɛ ne la zele kɛ, “Na Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma ɛhendeɛ ne mɔ ɛ, bɛnea a ɛnee bɛ ze mɔ a le nwane mɔ?” Yemɔti ɔrayɛle ɛrɛlɛ kɛ, “Na Sɔɔlo ɔdaye noko ɔboka Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma anwo ɔ?” 13Mɔɔ Sɔɔlo wiele ye agole ne si, na ɔwiele Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ ne ka la, ɔhɔle azukponle ne anwo wɔ boka ne azo.
14Sɔɔlo awuvuanyi ne nwunle Sɔɔlo nee ye sonvolɛ ne; ɔbizale bɛ kɛ, “Nienwu a bɛhɔle a?”
Sɔɔlo buale kɛ, “Yɛhɔle asoaso ne mɔ ɛkpondɛlɛ. Mɔɔ yɛkpondɛle bɛ toonwo na yɛannwu bɛ la, yɛhɔle Samoɛle anwo lɔ.”
15Sɔɔlo awuvuanyi ne bizale ye kɛ, “Mesɛlɛ wɔ, duzu edwɛkɛ a Samoɛle hanle hilele wɔ a?”
16Sɔɔlo zele ɔ wuvuanyi ne kɛ, “Yɛhɔle la, ɔkpakyele nu wienyi ɔzele yɛ kɛ bɛnwu asoaso ne mɔ.” Na mɔɔ fane ye belemgbunlililɛ ne anwo mɔɔ Samoɛle hanle la, Sɔɔlo ambɔ zolɛ.
Bɛzie Sɔɔlo belemgbunli
17Akee Samoɛle vɛlɛle Yizilayɛma amuala manle bɛrale Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛzonlenlɛ ayia wɔ Mezepa; 18ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne se la ɛne, ‘Menyele bɛ menvile Yigyibiti na menliele bɛ menvile Yigyibitima nee maanle maanle mɔɔ sisile bɛ la asa anu. 19Mele bɛ Nyamenle mɔɔ die bɛ fi bɛ ngyegyelɛ nee bɛ ngyianlɛ muala anu a. Noko ɛnɛ bɛkpo me na bɛze me kɛ, memaa bɛ belemgbunli.’ Yemɔti bɛ kɔsɔɔti bɛrɛla bɛrayia Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu ɛke, bɛgua ye mbusua ekpunli ekpunli nee mbusua ekpulike ekpulike, kɛmɔ ko biala dodo de la.”
20Akee Samoɛle manle mbusua ekpunli ekpunli ne mɔ rale ngoko; bɛguale nzeleba la Ɛdɛnkɛma yele Bɛngyaman abusua ekpunli ne. 21Samoɛle manle Bɛngyaman abusua ekpunli ne anu amra ne rale ye awuke awuke, na nzeleba ne bɔle Meetelae awuke nu amra. Mrenya mɔɔ wɔ Meetelae awuke nu la rale na bɛyele Sɔɔlo mɔɔ ɔ ze a le Kehye la. Bɛkpondɛle Sɔɔlo, na bɛannwu ye, 22yemɔti bɛbizale Ɛdɛnkɛma kɛ, “Awie bieko tɛbɔ ɛkɛ ɔ?”
Ɛdɛnkɛma zele kɛ, “Sɔɔlo vea ninyɛne edukue ne anzi nehane.”
23Na bɛnriandile bɛhɔhyele ye bɛrale. Ɔragyinlanle bɛ avinli la ɛnee ɔwale ɔtɛla awie biala mɔɔ wɔ ɛkɛ ne la. 24Na Samoɛle zele menli ne kɔsɔɔti kɛ, “Sonla ne mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛye ye ɛmaa bɛ la ɛne, bɛnwu ye ɔ? Awie biala ɛnle menli ye avinli mɔɔ nee ye sɛ a.” Na menli ne kɔsɔɔti deanle nuhua kɛ, “Belemgbunli ne ɛnyi ɛhyɛ.”
25Akee Samoɛle hanle belemgbunli dibilɛ nee ye gyima hilele menli ne. Ɔhɛlɛle ɛhye mɔ buluku nu, na ɔvale ɔdole ɛleka nwuanzanwuanza wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu. Akee Samoɛle manle menli ne kɔsɔɔti hɔle bɛ azua nu. 26Sɔɔlo ɔdaye noko ɔhɔle ye sua zo Gebɛya. Menli mɔɔ anwo yɛ se na Nyamenle asa wɔ bɛ nwo zo la nee ye hɔle. 27Na menli kpamgbanvolɛma bie zele kɛ, “Duzu debie kpaziwɔkɛ bɔbɔ yɛɛ sonla ɛhye kɛhola kɛyɛ kɛmaa yɛ a?” Bɛkpole ye, bɛammaa ye ahyɛlɛdeɛ biala, noko Sɔɔlo andɛne bɛ zo.

Title: 1 SAM 11
Content:
Sɔɔlo di Amɔnoma anwo zo konim
1Akee Neehahye, Amɔnoma belemgbunli ne vale ɛlɔnema hɔbɛnrale yiale Gyeebɛhye mɔɔ wɔ Geleade maanle nu la. Na Gyeebɛhyema zele Neehahye kɛ, “Ɛ nee yɛ ɛyɛ anzonudwolɛ ngyehyɛlɛ na yɛkɛzonle wɔ.”
2Neehahye zele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛnwu ye kɛ, mekponle zolɛ me nee bɛ ayɛ ngyehyɛlɛ ne la, ɛnee bɛlie bɛdo nu bɛmaa medu awie biala anye fema ne, amaa yeayɛ anyiemgba yeaha Yizilayɛma kɔsɔɔti.”
3Gyeebɛhye mgbanyima zele ye kɛ, “Maa yɛ kenle nsuu maa yɛzoa menli wɔ Yizilayɛ maanle ye anu amuala. Na saa yɛannyia awie mɔɔ kɛlie yɛ la a, yɛkɛva yɛ nwo yɛkɛmaa wɔ.”
4Soanvolɛma ne mɔ rale Gebɛya, sua ne mɔɔ Sɔɔlo de zolɛ la azo. Bɛvale amaneɛ ne bɛbɔle ezuavolɛ ne na bɛ muala bɛzunle bɛyele awolɛ. 5Mekɛ ne anu ala ɛnee Sɔɔlo nee ye nlankɛ vi ɛyazonlɛ ɛlɛba sua nu. Na ɔbizale kɛ, “Duzu a ɛlɛgyegye menli ne mɔɔ yemɔti bɛlɛsu a?” Na bɛvale Gyeebɛhye amaneɛ ne bɛbɔle ye. 6Mɔɔ Sɔɔlo dele amaneɛ ne la, ɛkɛ ne ala Nyamenle Sunsum ne dwule ɔ nwo zo, na ye ahonle futule mɔɔ ɔyɛ ɔ nwo ɛhwee a ɔnyɛ boɛ a. 7Ɔhyele nlankɛ nwiɔ ɔpepɛle bɛ nzokanzoka ɔmanle soanvolɛma vale hɔle Yizilayɛ maanle ne anu amuala na ɔhanle kɛ, “Awie biala mɔɔ andoa Sɔɔlo nee Samoɛle, ɔ nee bɛ angɔ konle ne la, kɛ bɛbapepɛ ye nlankɛ ne mɔ nzokanzoka la ɛne.”
Ɛdɛnkɛma anwo ɛzulolɛ dɔle menli ne anwo zo, yemɔti bɛ kɔsɔɔti bɛrale. 8Sɔɔlo boɔboale bɛ nloa wɔ Bizɛke; menli mɔɔ vi Yizilayɛ la le apenle ngoko ɛya nsa yɛɛ menli mɔɔ vi Dwuda la le apenle ngoko abulasa. 9Na bɛzele soanvolɛma mɔɔ vi Gyeebɛhye rale la kɛ, “Bɛhɔ bɛhɔze bɛ menli ne kɛ, ‘Ɛhyema, toonwo mɔɔ ɔkadwu sɛnzɛngyinla la ɛnee bɛlie bɛ bɛvi munzule biala anu.’ ” Mɔɔ soanvolɛma ne mɔ vale amaneɛ ɛhye rabɔle Gyeebɛhyema la, ɔyɛle bɛ fɛ somaa. 10Na bɛzele Neehahye kɛ, “Ɛhyema yɛbava yɛ nwo yeamaa wɔ. Debie biala mɔɔ ɛkulo la, fa yɛ yɛ.”
11Aleɛ hyenle nwonlomɔ mangyee ne la Sɔɔlo hyɛle ye ɛlɔnema ne mɔ anu ekpunli nsa. Bɛhɔholole Amɔnoma anwo zo wɔ bɛ azokoɛleɛ ne; bɛhuhunle bɛ toonwo sɛnzɛngyinla. Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛvile ɛsalɛ la anye zo danle bɛ, bɛbɔle asande mɔɔ bɛ nuhua nwiɔ bɔbɔ angola ampɛ anli ɛleka ko a.
12Akee menli ne hanle hilele Samoɛle kɛ, “Nwane mɔ a hanle kɛ, ‘Sɔɔlo ɛnli yɛ nwo zo belemgbunli’ la? Bɛva bɛ bɛrɛla bɛmaa yɛhu bɛ.”
13Sɔɔlo zele kɛ, “Bɛmmaku awie biala ɛnɛ, ɔluakɛ ɛnɛ a le kenle mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛlie Yizilayɛ ɛzie aze a.” 14Na Samoɛle zele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛmaa yɛ kɔsɔɔti yɛhɔ Gelegale yɛhɔzi zolɛ bieko kɛ Sɔɔlo le yɛ belemgbunli.” 15Yemɔti bɛ kɔsɔɔti bɛhɔle Gelegale bɛhɔziele Sɔɔlo belemgbunli wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu. Bɛbɔle anzonudwolɛ azu bɛmanle Ɛdɛnkɛma wɔ ɛkɛ ne. Na Sɔɔlo nee menli ne kɔsɔɔti lile fɛlɛko.

Title: 1 SAM 12
Content:
Samoɛle nrɛlaleɛ ne
1Akee Samoɛle zele Yizilayɛma kɔsɔɔti kɛ, “Mɔɔ bɛzele me kɛ menyɛ la, meyɛ mewie. Memaa bɛ belemgbunli kɛ ɔzie bɛ. 2Kɛkala, bɛnyia belemgbunli mɔɔ bali bɛ ti a. Akee meyɛ kpanyinli; me ti zo ɛyɛ nwohyee. Eza bɛnlea, me mra mrenya ne mɔ wɔ bɛ avinli. Sumunli me mgbavolɛ nu, meli bɛ ti toonwo a yeradwu ɛnɛ a. 3Mame ɛne; saa meyɛ ɛtane metia bɛ a, bɛha ye wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma nee bɛ belemgbunli ye mɔɔ yeye yemaa bɛ la anyunlu ɛke. Meva awie ɛnlankɛ anzɛɛ meva awie asoaso ɔ? Meli awie ndunlumi ɔ? Mesisi awie anzɛɛ mekpuokpua awie ɔ? Melie awie ndoloboa ɔ? Ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ kɔsɔɔti, saa meyɛ nuhua bie a, bɛha na menwɔzie ɔ bo zo.”
4Menli ne buale kɛ, “Ɛtɛdile yɛ ndunlumi, ɛtɛkpuokpuanle awie biala, ɛtɛsale awie biala ɛtɛdiele ye debie.”
5Samoɛle buale kɛ, “Ɛdɛnkɛma nee belemgbunli ne mɔɔ yeye yemaa bɛ la di daselɛ ɛnɛ demua ye kɛ menli fɔlɛ wɔ debie biala anwo.”
Bɛbuale kɛ, “Ɛhɛe, Ɛdɛnkɛma di daselɛ.”
6 Na Samoɛle zele menli ne kɛ, “Ɛdɛnkɛma mɔɔ yele Mosisi nee Aalɔn manle bɛvale bɛ mgbanyima bɛvile Yigyibiti azɛlɛ zo la di daselɛ. 7Bɛyɛ koonwu bɛgyinla ɛkɛ, bɛmaa menzɛlɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma memaa bɛ wɔ nyɛleɛ mɔɔ ɔyɛle ɔliele bɛ nee bɛ mgbanyinli la anwo. 8 Mɔɔ Gyekɔbo nee ɔ bo zo amra hɔle Yigyibiti na Yigyibitima yɛ bɛ kpɔdekpɔde la, bɛzunle bɛvɛlɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma na ɔzoanle Mosisi nee Aalɔn ɔmanle bɛhɔyele bɛ bɛvile Yigyibiti bɛ nee bɛ rale azɛlɛ ɛhye azo. 9 Noko bɛ rɛle vile Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne, yemɔti ɔyele bɛ ɔmanle Filisitiama nee Mowabe belemgbunli ne nee Sesɛla mɔɔ nea suakpole Heezɔ ɛlɔnema ne anwo zo la, na ɔmanle bɛ nee bɛ mgbanyima ne mɔ honle bɛlile bɛ nwo zo konim. 10 Bɛzunle bɛvɛlɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛzele kɛ, ‘Yɛyɛ ɛtane, ɔboalekɛ yɛkpo Ɛdɛnkɛma na yɛzonle Beeyale nee Asetate ananze ne mɔ. Die yɛ fi yɛ kpɔvolɛma asa anu, na yɛbazonle wɔ.’ 11Na Ɛdɛnkɛma yele Gedeɔn (Gyɛlɛbeeyale); nzinlii ɔyele Balake nee Gyɛfeta, yɛɛ akee medame Samoɛle, ɔmanle yɛ nuhua ko biala raliele bɛ vile bɛ kpɔvolɛma asa anu, na bɛdɛnlanle anzonudwolɛ nu. 12 Na mɔɔ Amɔn Belemgbunli Neehahye vale konle radoale bɛ la, bɛkpole Ɛdɛnkɛma kɛ ɔnle bɛ belemgbunli bieko na bɛzele me kɛ, ‘Maa yɛ belemgbunli maa ɔzie yɛ.’
13“Bɛ belemgbunli ne ɛne; bɛdabɛ a bɛbizale a, yɛɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛye ye ɛmaa bɛ a. 14Saa bɛdi Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne eni, bɛsonle ye, bɛtie ɔ ne, bɛdi ye mɛla ne mɔ azo, na bɛ nee bɛ belemgbunli ne toa ɔ bo zo ɛdeɛ a, debie biala bahɔ zolɛ fɔɔnwo amaa bɛ. 15Na saa bɛandie Ɛdɛnkɛma ane na bɛbulu ye mɛla ne mɔ azo a, ɔ nee bɛ nee bɛ belemgbunli ne bali. 16Yemɔti awie biala ɛzie ɔ nwo diinyi, na ɔnlea nwanwane debie mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma bayɛ la. 17Bɛ muala bɛze kɛ yɛwɔ wawaa mekɛ nu. Mebazɛlɛ ye meamaa yeamaa maanle nu ahulu na ezule adɔ. Saa ɛhye si a, bɛbanwu kɛ bɛyɛ ɛtane kpole bɛtia Ɛdɛnkɛma kɛ bɛdabɛ bɛbizale bɛliele belemgbunli a.”
18Yemɔti Samoɛle zɛlɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma, na kenle ko ne ala maanle nu hulule na ezule dɔle. Na menli ne kɔsɔɔti zulole Ɛdɛnkɛma nee Samoɛle. 19Na bɛzele Samoɛle kɛ, “Yɛmenle, bodo Ɛdɛnkɛma wɔ Nyamenle ne maa yɛ, amaa yeangu yɛ. Ɔluakɛ yɛnwu ye wienyi kɛ, ɛye ɛtane gyɛne gyɛne mɔɔ yɛyɛ la ɛsie ahane a, mɔɔ yɛyɛ la akee bo zolɛ kɛ yɛdayɛ yɛbizale kɛ ɔmaa yɛ belemgbunli a.”
20Na Samoɛle zele menli ne kɛ, “Bɛmmasulo; bɛbɔ munzule bɔbɔ ɛdeɛ, noko bɛmmakpo kɛ bɛnrɛdoa Ɛdɛnkɛma abo zo. Bɛva bɛ ahonle kɔsɔɔti bɛzonle ye. 21Bɛmmadi adalɛ nyamenle ne mɔ mɔɔ ɛnrɛhola ɛnrɛlie bɛ ngoane la anzi, ɔluakɛ bɛdabɛ mumua ne bɛnlɛ ngoane. 22Ɔlua ye duma kpole ne ati, Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛnrɛkpo ye menli, ɔboalekɛ ɔdaye ye ɛhulolɛ zo yɛɛ yeva bɛ yeyɛ ye menli a. 23Na mame, Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛkpa ɛgua kɛ menwɔyɛ ɛtane kɛ menrɛzɛlɛ menrɛmaa bɛ a. Mebahilehile bɛ nɔhalɛ adenle ne nee mɔɔ le kpalɛ kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛyɛ la. 24Bɛyɛ tieyɛ bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma na bɛva bɛ ahonle muala bɛzonle ye nɔhalɛ nu. Bɛhakye ninyɛne mgbole mɔɔ yeyɛ yemaa bɛ la. 25Na saa bɛandie na bɛyɛ ninyɛndane a, ɔbazɛkye bɛ nee bɛ belemgbunli ne bɔkɔɔ.”

Title: 1 SAM 13
Content:
Bɛ nee Filisitiama honle
1Sɔɔlo lile ɛvolɛ... la yɛɛ ɔralile belemgbunli a na ɔziele Yizilayɛ maanle ne ɛvolɛ... nee nwiɔ. 2Sɔɔlo yele Yizilayɛma anu apenle nsa; ɔvale apenle nwiɔ ɔ nee bɛ woale Mekemahye yɛɛ Bɛtɛle mɔɔ wɔ awoka ne mɔ azo la. Ɔvale apenle ko ne ɔmanle Dwɔnatan vale bɛ hɔle Gebɛya mɔɔ wɔ Bɛngyaman maanzinli nu la. Na menli mɔɔ hale la Sɔɔlo manle bɛziale bɛhɔle sua nu.
3Dwɔnatan hunle Filisitia ɛlɔnema ne mɔɔ wɔ Giba la safohyenle kpanyinli ne. Ɛhye kpondenle Filisitia maanle ne anu. Sɔɔlo zoanle menli manle bɛhɔwule aweɛne tendenle nu wɔ maanle ne anu amuala bɛvɛlɛle Hibuluma kɛ bɛhɔ konle. 4Yizilayɛma kɔsɔɔti dele kɛ Sɔɔlo ɛhu Filisitiama safohyenle kpanyinli ne mɔɔ nea bɛ ɛlɔnema ne anwo zo la, na Filisitiama ɛyɛ Yizilayɛma anwo ɛlɔne, yemɔti bɛ kɔsɔɔti bɛrabokale Sɔɔlo wɔ Gelegale.
5Filisitiama boɔboale bɛ nwo kɛ bɛ nee Yizilayɛma kaho. Bɛvale ɛlɔnema mɔɔ ka konle ehwili la apenle ngoko abulasa, ɛlɔnema mɔɔ ka mgbɔnwɔ la apenle nsia, yɛɛ ɛlɔnema mɔɔ dua aze la kɛyɛ kɛ ɛnweazo ɛnwea. Bɛrayɛle azokoɛleɛ wɔ Mekemahye, wɔ Bɛtehavɛn aduduleɛ afoa nu. 6Bɛmianle bɛ nwo bɛ nee Yizilayɛma honle kpalɛ. Mɔɔ Yizilayɛma nwunle kɛ konle ne ɛyɛ ɛsesebɛ ɛmaa bɛ la, bie mɔ nriandile hɔveale mbɔne nu, awolɛ nu, adokule nu, bula nu nee sɛka nu. 7Bie mɔ pɛle Azule Dwɔdan ne hɔle Gaade nee Geleade maanle ne mɔ anu.
Ɛnee Sɔɔlo tɛbɔ Gelegale na ɛzulolɛ ɛha menli mɔɔ nee ye lua la amuala. 8 Samoɛle hilele Sɔɔlo kenle nsuu kɛ ɔbara; mɔɔ Sɔɔlo hendɛle Samoɛle toonwo kenle nsuu na yeamba Gelegale la, ye menli ne bɔle ɔ bo kɛ bɛbɔ asande. 9Yemɔti Sɔɔlo zele menli ne kɛ, “Bɛva ɛyelalɛ nee anzonudwolɛ azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ bɛrɛlɛ me.” Na ɔbɔle ɛyelalɛ azu. 10Ɔwiele azu ne bɔ ala la yɛɛ Samoɛle yele ɔ nyunlu a. Sɔɔlo hɔyiale ye na ɔyɛle ye akɔaba. 11Na Samoɛle bizale ye kɛ, “Duzu debie a wɔyɛ la?”
Sɔɔlo buale kɛ, “Kɛmɔ kenle ne mɔɔ ɛhilele la dwule na wɔamba, na menli ne kpondɛ abɔ asande, na Filisitiama noko ɛboɔboa bɛ nwo wɔ Mekemahye azokoɛleɛ ne la, yɛɛ menzele kɛ, 12‘Ɔnrɛhyɛ na Filisitiama arateta yɛ wɔ Gelegale ɛke bɛ nee yɛ aho, yɛɛ metɛsɛlɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma moalɛ biala;’ yemɔti menlile me ti anwo membɔle ɛyelalɛ azu ne.”
13Na Samoɛle zele Sɔɔlo kɛ, “Wɔli edwɛkɛ ɛtane. Wɔanli Ɛdɛnkɛma wɔ Nyamenle ne mɛla mɔɔ ɔmanle wɔ la azo; anrɛɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma kɛmaa wɔ nee ɛ bo zo amra kɛzie Yizilayɛ maanle ne dahuu, 14 na kɛkala, wɔ belemgbunlililɛ ne ɛnrɛhɔ zolɛ bieko. Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛnyia sonla mɔɔ ɔdaye ɔkulo la, yeye ye kɛ ɔzie ye menli ne, ɔboalekɛ wɔdu ɔ nloa wɔdo.”
15Samoɛle vile Gelegale hɔle Gebɛya mɔɔ wɔ Bɛngyaman abusua ekpunli ne maanle nu la. Sɔɔlo dianle ye ɛlɔnema mɔɔ nee ye lua la; bɛkɛyɛ ɛya nsia. 16Na Sɔɔlo nee ɔ ra Dwɔnatan nee menli mɔɔ nee ye lua la dɛnlanle Giba mɔɔ wɔ Bɛngyaman abusua ekpunli ne maanle nu la; yɛɛ Filisitiama dɛnlanle bɛ azokoɛleɛ ne wɔ Mekemahye. 17Filisitia ɛlɔnema ne hyɛle bɛ nwo ekpunli nsa. Ekpunli ko hɔle Ɔfela, wɔ Hyuale maanle nu, 18ko hɔle Bɛte Hɔlɔn, yɛɛ ko ne noko hɔle ɛweɛne ne mɔɔ nee Zɛboyem Bɔnza ne nee fienemgbole ne anye bɔ zolɛ la azo, na bɛwuale Yizilayɛma bɛkpokpole bɛ bɔkɔɔ.
19Mekɛ ne anu ɛnee dwinvolɛma mɔɔ fa mbulalɛ di adwinli la bie ɛnle Yizilayɛ maanle ne anu, ɔboalekɛ Filisitiama amkponle Hibuluma ammaa bɛanyɛ bie na bɛava bɛ nee bɛ aho. 20(Yemɔti Yizilayɛnli biala mɔɔ kpondɛ kɛ ɔsi ye funduazɛlɛ gye anzɛɛ koanlɛ anzɛɛ akuma anzɛɛ ɛdedadeɛ la kɔ Filisitiama ɛkɛ ne kɔtua ezukoa kolaa na bɛazi bɛamaa ye. 21Bɛsi akuma anzɛɛ bɛyɛ ɛnlankɛ empele ko boɛ a bɛdie dwɛtɛ ekyi ko; yɛɛ saa bɛsi funduazɛlɛ gye anzɛɛ koanlɛ a bɛdie dwɛtɛ ngyikyi nwiɔ.) 22Yemɔti kenle ne mɔɔ konle ne zile la, ɛnee Sɔɔlo ɛlɔnema ne biala ɛnlɛ konle debie biala kɛ Sɔɔlo nee ɔ ra Dwɔnatan ala.
23Filisitiama manle menli hɔzinzale adenle ne mɔɔ la Mekemahye awoka ne mɔ avinli la.

Title: 1 SAM 14
Content:
Dwɔnatan ahonle ɛzilɛ kpole ne
