6Bɛbuale ye kɛ, “Nrenya bie rayiale yɛ na ɔzele yɛ kɛ, ‘Bɛzia bɛhɔze belemgbunli ne mɔɔ zoanle bɛ la kɛ: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, ɛnee ɛnea a Nyamenle ɛnle Yizilayɛ ati yɛɛ ɛlɛkɔ Ɛkelɔn bozonle Beeyalezibɛbe ɛkɛ wɔahɔbiza ɛ nwo a? Zɔhane ati, anwonyane ne mɔɔ ɛbɔ wɔ la, ɛnrɛde kpɔkɛ, ɛbawu.’ ”
7Belemgbunli ne bizale bɛ kɛ, “Kɛ nrenya ne mɔɔ hanle ɛhye mɔ hilele bɛ la si de ɛ?”
8Bɛbuale ye kɛ, “Nrenya ne wula enrinli ɛdanlɛ tɛladeɛ na nwoma akyeso hye ye avinli.”
Belemgbunli ne zele kɛ, “Yilaegya mɔɔ vi Tehyebe la ɔ.”
9Na Belemgbunli zoanle ye safohyenlema ne anu ko manle ɔvale menli abulanlu kɛ bɛhɔva Yilaegya bɛrɛla. Safohyenle ne nee ye ɛlɔnema ne hɔdole Yilaegya wɔ boka bie azo na ɔzele ye kɛ, “Nyamenle sonla, belemgbunli se yɛrava wɔ yɛrɛla.”
10 Yilaegya buale ye kɛ, “Saa mele Nyamenle sonla a ɛnee senle vi anwuma ɛrayela wɔ nee wɔ ɛlɔnema abulanlu ne.” Ɛkɛ ne ala senle vi anwuma rayelale safohyenle ne nee ye ɛlɔnema abulanlu ne.
11Belemgbunli ne eza zoanle safohyenle fofolɛ nee menli abulanlu bieko. Ɔdaye noko ɔzele Yilaegya kɛ, “Nyamenle sonla, belemgbunli se yɛrava wɔ yɛrɛla kɛkala.”
12Na Yilaegya buale kɛ, “Saa mele Nyamenle sonla a ɛnee senle vi anwuma ɛrayela wɔ nee wɔ ɛlɔnema abulanlu ne.” Na ɛkɛ ne ala Nyamenle senle ne vi anwuma rayelale safohyenle ne nee ye ɛlɔnema abulanlu ne.
13Fane nsa ne azo eza Belemgbunli ne zoanle safohyenle bieko nee ye ɛlɔnema abulanlu. Safohyenle ɛhye mɔɔ tɔ zo nsa la hɔdule dɔle Yilaegya agyakɛ anu na ɔzɛlɛle ye kɛ, “O Nyamenle sonla, mebodo wɔ, maa menyia me ti na nwu me menli abulanlu ye anwunvɔne. 14Nea, senle vi anwuma rayelale alumua safohyenlema nwiɔ ne nee bɛ ɛlɔnema abulanlu abulanlu ne. Noko mesɛlɛ wɔ, nwu me anwunvɔne na maa menyia me ti.”
15Nyamenle soanvolɛ ne zele Yilaegya kɛ, “Mmasulo. Dwazo ɛ nee ye bɛhɔ.” Yemɔti Yilaegya dwazole na ɔ nee ye bɛhɔle belemgbunli ne ɛkɛ, na ɔzele ye kɛ, 16“Kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma se la ɛne, ‘Kɛmɔ wɔzoa menli kɛ bɛhɔ Ɛkelɔn bozonle Beeyalezibɛbe ɛkɛ bɛhɔbiza ɛ nwo la, ɛnee ɛnea a Nyamenle ɛnle Yizilayɛ ɔ? Zɔhane ati ɛvi wɔ anwonyane ne anu ɛnrɛdwazo, ɛbawu.’ ”
17Yemɔti kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma luale Yilaegya anwo zo hanle la, Belemgbunli Ehazaya wule na ɔ diema Dwɔlam lile ebia ne. Ehazaya ɛnee ɛnlɛ ɔ ra nrenya yɛɛ ɔlile ɛvolɛ nwiɔ wɔ ebia ne azo. Ɔ ze a le Dwuda belemgbunli Gyɛhɔhyafate.
18Debie biala mɔɔ Belemgbunli Ehazaya yɛle la bɛhɛlɛ bɛ muala wɔ Yizilayɛ Arelemgbunli, Tetedwɛkɛ Mbuluku ne mɔ anu.

Title: 2 ARL 2
Content:
Bɛva Yilaegya bɛhɔ anwuma.
1Mekɛ dwule kɛ akee Ɛdɛnkɛma bafa Yilaegya wɔ ahumuakyima nu kɔ anwuma. Yilaegya nee Yilaehya vi Gelegale zile nu, 2na Yilaegya zele Yilaehya kɛ, “Mebodo wɔ, kendɛ ɛke na Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛzoa me wɔ Bɛtɛle.”
Yilaehya buale kɛ, “Meka tease Ɛdɛnkɛma nee ɛdawɔ kɛ menrɛkpɔkye me nwo menrɛvi ɛ nwo ɛlɛ.” Yemɔti bɛ mu nwiɔ bɛhɔle Bɛtɛle.
3Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma asa azo bie mɔ mɔɔ wɔ Bɛtɛle la razele Yilaehya kɛ “Asoo ɛze kɛ ɛnɛ demua ye Ɛdɛnkɛma barava ɛ menle ye ahɔ ɔ?”
Yilaehya buale kɛ, “Ɛhɛe, meze; noko bɛmɛ bɛmua bɛ nloa.”
4Yilaegya zele Yilaehya kɛ, “Mebodo wɔ, kendɛ ɛke na Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛzoa me wɔ Gyɛleko.”
Yilaehya buale kɛ, “Meka tease Ɛdɛnkɛma nee ɛdawɔ kɛ menrɛkpɔkye me nwo menrɛvi ɛ nwo ɛlɛ.” Yemɔti bɛ mu nwiɔ bɛhɔle Gyɛleko.
5Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma asa azo bie mɔ mɔɔ wɔ ɛkɛ ne la razele Yilaehya kɛ, “Asoo ɛze kɛ ɛnɛ demua ye Ɛdɛnkɛma barava ɛ menle ye ahɔ ɔ?”
Yilaehya buale bɛ kɛ, “Ɛhɛe, meze, bɛmɛ bɛyɛ koonwu.”
6Yilaegya zele Yilaehya kɛ, “Mebodo wɔ, kendɛ ɛke na Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛzoa me wɔ Azule Dwɔdan ne anloa.”
Yilaehya buale kɛ, “Meka tease Ɛdɛnkɛma nee ɛdawɔ kɛ menrɛkpɔkye me nwo menrɛvi ɛ nwo ɛlɛ.” Yemɔti bɛzile nu bɛhɔle. 7Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma asa azo ne mɔ anu abulanlu doale bɛ na bɛgyinlanle amozi ekyi wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ Yilaegya nee Yilaehya gyi azule ne anloa la. 8Yilaegya yele ye ɛdanlɛ ne mɔɔ gua ɔ nwo zo la, ɔbɛkale na ɔvale ɔfinle azule ne anu. Azule ne kpakyele nwiɔ, pianle hɔle foa ko nee foa ko. Ɔyele azɛlɛ resee ɔdole ɛkɛ ne na bɛpɛle bɛhɔle ɔ nzi lɔ. 9Mɔɔ bɛpɛle bɛhɔle azule ne anzi lɔ la, Yilaegya akee zele Yilaehya kɛ, “Biza me debie mɔɔ menyɛ memaa wɔ la kolaa na bɛarava me bɛahɔ.”
Yilaehya buale kɛ, “Mebodo wɔ, maa menyia wɔ sunsum ne mɔnwo.”
10Yilaegya zele kɛ, “Wɔbiza debie ɛsesebɛ kpalɛ. Noko saa bɛbava me bɛahɔ na ɛnwu me ɛhɔlɛ nu a, ɛbanyia mɔɔ wɔbiza la, na saa wɔannwu me a, yemɔ ɛnrɛnyia ye.”
11Mɔɔ bɛtendɛ la ɛnee bɛ gyakɛ wɔ zolɛ, na arɛlevilɛ nu ala senle ehwili mɔɔ senle mgbɔnwɔ ɛlɛtwe ye la rakpakyele bɛ avinli, na anwoma kpole ne manle Yilaegya zo ɔ nee ye hɔle anwuma. 12 Yilaehya nwunle ye na ɔdeanle ɔvɛlɛle Yilaegya kɛ, “Egya! Egya! Yizilayɛ konle ehwili ne nee menli mɔɔ ka mgbɔnwɔ ne mɔ la, bɛmɛ ɛhye o!” Na yeannwu ye bieko.
Nyane ngome manle Yilaehya yele ɔdaye mumua ne ye tɛladeɛ mɔɔ ɔwula la na ɔdele nu nwiɔ. 13Ɔvale Yilaegya aguzo ne mɔɔ wɔlɔle guale aze la na ɔziale ɔ nzi. Ɔradwule Azule Dwɔdan ne anloa, 14ɔvale Yilaegya aguzo ne mɔɔ guale aze la ɔfinle azule ne anu na ɔzele kɛ, “Yilaegya Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle ne wɔ nienwu?” Na ɛkɛ ne ala azule ne kpakyele nwiɔ na ɔpɛle ɔrale ɔ nzi nehae. 15Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma asa azo mɔɔ vi Gyɛleko la nwunle ye na bɛhanle kɛ “Yilaegya sunsum ne ɛdwu Yilaehya anwo zo.” Na bɛrayiale ye na bɛbɔle bɛ ti aze bɛmanle ye. 16Bɛzele ye kɛ, “Nea, yɛdayɛ mɔɔ yɛwɔ ɛke la yɛle menli kpukputili abulanlu. Maa yɛhɔkpondɛ ɛ menle ne. Ɔkɛyɛ kɛ Nyamenle Sunsum ne vale ye hɔle anwuma la, yehɔgyakyi ye yedo boka bie azo anzɛɛ bɔnza bie anu.”
Yilaehya buale bɛ kɛ, “Kyɛkyɛ, bɛmmakɔ.”
17Bɛamkponle na bɛdinle zolɛ kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛkɔkpondɛ ye. Ɛhye manle Yilaehya ati zile aze na ɔzele bɛ kɛ bɛhɔ. Bɛzoanle menli abulanlu ne bɛmanle bɛhɔkpondɛle ye dedee kenle nsa. Noko bɛannwu ye. 18Na bɛziale bɛrale ɔ nwo ɛkɛ wɔ Gyɛleko. Ɛnee ɔlɛkendɛ bɛ wɔ ɛkɛ, na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Se menzele bɛ kɛ bɛmmakɔ.”
Yilaehya nwanwane sɛkɛlɛneɛ ne mɔ
19Menli bie mɔɔ wɔ Gyɛleko la hɔhanle hilele Yilaehya kɛ, “Yɛmenle, kɛmɔ ɛdawɔ ɛnwu ye la, suakpole ye le kɛnlɛma noko nzule ne ɛnle kpalɛ yɛɛ ɔmaa nrenzɛvolɛ ko kpɔne.”
20Yilaehya zele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛva dwora fofolɛ na bɛgua ngyenle nu bɛrɛlɛ me.” Bɛvale bɛrɛlɛle ye. 21Ɔvale ɔhɔle nzubula ne mɔɔ bɛsa la anloa na ɔvuandinle ngyenle ne ɔguale nu, na ɔzele kɛ, “Ɛdɛnkɛma se: Meyɛ nzule ye nzukpa. Ɔvi ɛnɛ mɔɔ kɔ la, awie no bie a ɔnwu yɛɛ ɔmkpɔne ɛkolɛ bieko.” 22Ɔvi mekɛ zɔhane nzule ne ɛyɛ nzukpa toonwo a yeradwu ɛnɛ a, kɛmɔ Nyamenle manle Yilaehya hanle la.
23Yilaehya akee hɔle Bɛtɛle. Mɔɔ ɔlua adenle nu ɔlɛkɔ la, ngakula mrenya bie vi sua ne azo vindele ragolole ɔ nwo kɛ, “Atizo kpawee, ɛvi ɛke kɔ!”
24Yilaehya hakyile ɔ nwo nleanle bɛ na ɔvale Ɛdɛnkɛma ɔwale bɛ amonle; na ɛkɛ ne ala bɛdi mbelɛ nwiɔ vi kpɔkɛ ne anu vindele ratetele bɛ nuhua abulanla nee nwiɔ anu.
25Yilaehya vi ɛkɛ ne la ɔhɔle Kamɛle Boka na nzinlii ɔziale ɔhɔle Samɛlea.

Title: 2 ARL 3
Content:
Yizilayɛma nee Mowabema konle ne
1Mɔɔ Gyɛhɔhyafate nyianle ɛvolɛ bulu nee mɔtwɛ wɔ Dwuda ebia ne azo la, yɛɛ bɛvale Ehabe ara Dwɔlam bɛziele Yizilayɛ belemgbunli wɔ Samɛlea a. Dwɔlam lile ebia ne ɛvolɛ bulu nee nwiɔ. 2Yeambɔ ɛbɛla ne mɔɔ ɔ ze nee ɔ nli bɔle la bie ɛdeɛ, noko ɔyɛle ɛtane ɔtiale Ɛdɛnkɛma. Ɔbubule ɔ ze sua ne mɔɔ ɔzile ɔmanle bozonle Beeyale la; 3noko ɔyɛle ɛtane ne mɔɔ Belemgbunli Gyɛlɔbowam mɔɔ ɔ ze a le Nibate la yɛle a ɔmanle Yizilayɛma kɔsɔɔti yɛle ɛtane la bie. Yeandwe ɔ nwo yeanvi nwolɛ.
4Mowabe Belemgbunli Mihya gyima mɔɔ yɛ la a le mboane ɛzielɛ. Ɛvolɛ biala ɔwɔ kɛ ɔfa mboane mralɛ apenle ngoko ɛya ko, yɛɛ mboane nyinli apenle ngoko ɛya ko anwo enrinli ɔkɔmaa Yizilayɛ belemgbunli ne. 5Na mɔɔ Belemgbunli Ehabe wule la, Mowabe belemgbunli ne dele atua wɔ Yizilayɛ belemgbunli ne anwo zo. 6Yemɔti Belemgbunli Dwɔlam vale ɛlɔnema vile Samɛlea na ɔboɔboale Yizilayɛma amuala anloa. 7Akee ɔvale nrɛlaleɛ ɔmanle bɛhɔmanle Dwuda Belemgbunli Gyɛhɔhyafate kɛ, “Mowabe belemgbunli ne ɛde atua; yemɔti baboa me maa me nee ye ɛhɔho.”
Belemgbunli Gyɛhɔhyafate buale kɛ, “Menwɔhɔ. Mewɔ ɛke memaa wɔ yɛɛ me menli nee me mgbɔnwɔ muala le wɔ ɛdeɛ. 8Nienwu a yɛpe yeahɔ a?”
Dwɔlam buale kɛ, “Yɛpe Yidɔm fienemgbole ne anu.”
9Yemɔti Belemgbunli Dwɔlam nee Dwuda nee Yidɔm arelemgbunli zile nu hɔle. Bɛdiale bɛbɔle mgbɔlɔka dedee kenle nsuu la ɛnee akee bɛnnyia nzule. Nzule mɔɔ wɔ bɛ bɔlɛ nu la ɛwie bɔkɔɔ, menli bɔbɔ ɛnnyia bie ɛnno na yeayɛ bɛ nyɛmoa mɔɔ zo bɛ ninyɛne la. 10Na Yizilayɛ belemgbunli ne zele kɛ, “Aa! amgba Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛvɛlɛ yɛdayɛ arelemgbunli nsa ye wɔ ɛke kɛ ɔbaye yɛ yeamaa Mowabema ahu yɛ! ”
11Gyɛhɔhyafate bizale kɛ, “Na Ɛdɛnkɛma kpɔmanvolɛ biala ɛnle ɛke ɛleka bie mɔɔ yɛkola yɛdua ɔ nwo zo yɛbiza Ɛdɛnkɛma ɔ?”
Yizilayɛ belemgbunli ne sonvolɛma ne mɔ ko buale kɛ, “Hyeefate ara Yilaehya wɔ ɛke. Yemɔ yɛɛ anrɛɛ boa Yilaegya wɔ ye gyima ne ɛyɛlɛ nu a.”
12Gyɛhɔhyafate zele kɛ, “Ɔle Ɛdɛnkɛma kpɔmanvolɛ bɔkɔɔ”. Yemɔti Dwuda, Yizilayɛ nee Yidɔm arelemgbunli nsa ne hɔle ɔ nwo ɛkɛ.
13Yilaehya bizale Yizilayɛ belemgbunli ne kɛ, “Duzu yɛɛ ɛkpondɛ wɔ me ɛkɛ ne a? Toa ɛ ze nee ɛ nli Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma ne mɔ kɔbiza bɛ.”
Dwɔlam buale kɛ, “Kyɛkyɛ, Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛɛ ɛye yɛdayɛ arelemgbunli nsa ye ɛmaa Mowabema kɛ bɛhu yɛ a.”
14Yilaehya zele ye kɛ, “Meka Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma mɔɔ mesonle ye la kɛ, saa tɛ Dwuda Belemgbunli Gyɛhɔhyafate nidi ti a anrɛɛ menrɛbikye wɔ bɔbɔ na meanlea ɛ nyunlu. 15Bɛvɛlɛ awie mɔɔ bɔ getaa la bɛmaa me.”
Mɔɔ ahenle ne bɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɔbɔ getaa ne ala la yɛɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma Sunsum ne dwule Yilaehya anwo zo a, 16na ɔzele kɛ, “Kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma se la ɛne: Mebamaa azudenle ye mɔɔ ɛsesa la ayi. 17Ɛdɛnkɛma se bɛnrɛde kɛ anwoma ɛlɛtu anzɛɛ ezule ɛlɛtɔ noko azule ne mɔ bayiyi, amaa bɛanyia bie bɛanlo na bɛ nlankɛ nee bɛ nyɛmoa anyia bie anlo. 18Ɛhye le debie ekyi wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anye zo. Eza ɔbaye Mowabema yeamaa bɛ 19na bɛbali bɛ nwo zo konim bɛava bɛ azuamgbole mɔɔ bɛbɔ bɛ nwo bane nee sua biala mɔɔ hyia la. Bɛbabu baka kpalɛ biala bɛado aze, bɛasisi bɛ azudenle kɔsɔɔti na bɛava awolɛ bɛazɛkye bɛ azɛlɛ kpalɛ biala mɔɔ bɛlɛ la.”
20Aleɛ hyenle nwonlomɔ, kɛyɛ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛfa bɛyɛ nzɛlɛlɛ la, nzule vi Yidɔm afoa nu rabule azɛlɛ nwo kɔsɔɔti faanwo.
21Mɔɔ Mowabema dele kɛ arelemgbunli nsa ne ɛra nee bɛ baho la, bɛvɛlɛle awie biala mɔɔ kola konle tɛladeɛ wula la, ngakula nee mgbanyinli kɔsɔɔti na bɛzieziele bɛ kɛ bɛhɔ konle ne anloa. 22Mɔɔ bɛdwazole nwonlomɔ ne, na sɛnzɛne ne kpɔgyale ɔ nwo zo ekyii la, bɛnwunle kɛ nzule ne mɔɔ nee bɛ nye bɔ zo la anye ɛyɛ kɔkɔlɛ kɛ mogya. 23Na bɛhanle kɛ, “Nea mogya ngome. Yɛ kpɔvolɛ ɛlɔnema nsa ne ɛpɛ bɛ nwo ɛho ɛhuhu bɛ nwo. Mowabema e, bɛmaa yɛhɔve bɛ ninyɛne ne mɔ.”
24Noko mɔɔ bɛhɔdwule Yizilayɛma azokoɛleɛ ne la, Yizilayɛma dwazole Mowabema ne anwo zo bɛhanle bɛ senle bɛmanle bɛguale ndwɛlɛ aze. Yizilayɛma belele zile bɛ zo na bɛhuhunle dɔɔnwo wɔ adenle nu. 25Yizilayɛma hɔvole Mowabema azuamgbole ne mɔ azo bɛbɔle bɛ na bɛzɛkyele bɛ azɛlɛ kpalɛ biala mɔɔ bɛlɛ la. Bɛsesale awolɛ bɛguale azɛlɛ mɔɔ kye aleɛ la azo bɛzɛkyele bɛ, bɛsisile azudenle mɔɔ bɛlɛ la na bɛbubule mbaka kpalɛ ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti bɛmanle ɔhale awolɛ ne mɔɔ wɔ Kɛɛ Hɛlɛse la ala. Menli mɔɔ to totoabɔ la ratetale suakpole ne na bɛhonle bɛvale ɔdaye noko.
26Mɔɔ Mowabe belemgbunli ne nwunle kɛ akee konle ne ɛtele bɛ sa zo la, ɔvale menli ɛya nsuu mɔɔ ze dadeɛ nu ko kpalɛ kpalɛ la kɛ ɔfa bɛ yealua Yidɔmma avinli yeahɔ; bɛyɛle biala, noko bɛangola. 27Yemɔti ɔvale ɔ ra nrenya kpanyinli ne mɔɔ di ye agya la, ɔmanle bɛyelale ye bɛbɔle azu wɔ azukponle ne bane ne anwo. Ɛhye manle Yizilayɛma ahonle dule; munzule kpole zile Yizilayɛma anwo zo; ɔlua zo bɛhwenle bɛ nzi na bɛziale bɛhɔle bɛ maanle nu.

Title: 2 ARL 4
Content:
Yilaehya boa kunlanvolɛ raalɛ anwo anwunvɔne bie
1Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma asa azo ne mɔ anu sonla ko mɔɔ ɛwu la aye hɔzele Yilaehya kɛ, “Me hu ɛwu. Kɛmɔ ɛdawɔ ɛze la, ɛnee ɔsulo Nyamenle kpole kpalɛ, noko kɛkala, awie mɔɔ yɛtua ye kakɛ la ɛra kɛ ɔbava me mra mrenya nwiɔ ne yeahɔzie nu awoba.”
2Yilaehya bizale ye kɛ, “Duzu a ɛkpondɛ kɛ meyɛ memaa wɔ a? Duzu a ɛlɛ ye wɔ sua nu a? Ka mɔɔ ɛlɛ ye la kile me.”
Kunlanvolɛ raalɛ ne zele ye kɛ, “Menlɛ ɛhwee. Yeha me nwole buakɛ ko.”
3Yilaehya zele ye kɛ, “Finde kɔ, kɔzɛlɛzɛlɛ mbuakɛ mgbane dɔɔnwo wɔ ɛ gɔnwo mɔ ɛkɛ ne 4Akee kɔ na ɛ nee ɛ mra ne mɔ bɛdo bɛ nwo anlenkɛ nu na bɔ ɔ bo kɛ ɛwola nwole ne wɔagua mbuakɛ ne mɔ anu; ko biala mɔɔ kɛyi la ɛnee wɔye wɔzie ahane.”
5Yemɔti raalɛ ne hɔle na ɔ nee ɔ mra ne mɔ hɔdole bɛ nwo anlenkɛ nu, yɛɛ mɔɔ ɔbubu nwole ne la ɛnee bɛlɛtwe bɛkɔsie na bɛfa mbuakɛ fofolɛ bɛba. 6Mbuakɛ ne mɔ yiyile la ɔbizale bɛ kɛ saa buakɛ bieko tɛbɔ ɛkɛ ne a. Na ɔ mra ne mɔ ko buale kɛ, “Bieko ɛnle ɛkɛ.” Na ɛkɛ ne ala nwole ne abo pɛle. 7Raalɛ ne hɔle Yilaehya ɛkɛ ne hɔbɔle ye amaneɛ na Yilaehya zele ye kɛ, “Kɔdɔne nwole ne fa bie tua wɔ kakɛ ne na ɛ nee ɛ mra ne mɔ bɛva mɔɔ ɛha la bɛnlea bɛ nwo.”
Yilaehya nee raalɛ sukoavolɛ ne mɔɔ vi Hyunɛm la
8Kenle ko Yilaehya hɔle Hyunɛm na raalɛ sukoavolɛ bie mɔɔ wɔ ɛkɛ ne la vɛlɛle ye manle ɔrakpulale ɔ sa. Ɛhye ati kenle biala mɔɔ ɔkɛva ɛkɛ ne adenle zo la, ɔmakyi ɛkɛ ne ɔdi debie. 9Raalɛ ne hanle hilele ɔ hu kɛ, “Yɛmenle, menwu kɛ nrenya ye mɔɔ ba ɛke dahuu la le Nyamenle sonla mɔɔ anwo te a. 10Maa yɛzi sua ekpumgbunli ekyi ko wɔ sua ye ati zo lɔ na yɛva ɛsokpa, ɛkponle, ebia nee kɛnlaneɛ yezie nuhua amaa kenle biala mɔɔ ɔkɛra ɛke la yeahɔla ɛkɛ.”
11Kenle ko Yilaehya hɔle Hyunɛm na ɔhɔle ye sua ne anu kɛ ɔkadenrɛ ɔ nwo. 12Na ɔvɛlɛle ye sonvolɛ Gɛheezae na ɔzele ye kɛ, “Fɛlɛ Hyunɛm raalɛ ne maa me.” Mɔɔ raalɛ ne rale la, 13ɔzele Gɛheezae kɛ, “Ka kile raalɛ ye kɛ yevɛ yɛ nwo somaa. Duzu yɛɛ ɔkpondɛ kɛ yɛyɛ yɛmaa ye a?” Ɛkɛhulo kɛ yɛkɛnwu belemgbunli anzɛɛ safohyenlema kpanyinli ne yɛkɛmaa wɔ ɔ?
Raalɛ ne buale kɛ, “Me tɛnlabelɛ nu le kpalɛ, mewɔ medame me maanle nu.”
14Yilaehya bizale Gɛheezae kɛ, “Ɛnea a duzu a ɔwɔ kɛ yɛyɛ yɛmaa ye a?”
Gɛheezae zele ye kɛ, “Ɔnlɛ ralɛ nrenya yɛɛ ɔhu noko ɛyɛ kpanyinli.”
15Yilaehya zele kɛ, “Fɛlɛ ye maa me.” Raalɛ ne ragyinlanle sua ne anlenkɛ ne anloa, 16 na Yilaehya zele ye kɛ, “Ɛvolɛ bieko bekezɛ ɛnee ɛvia ralɛ nrenya.”
Raalɛ ne buale kɛ, “Yɛmenle, Ɛle Nyamenle sonla, mmabɛlɛbɛla me.”
17Na kɛmɔ Yilaehya hanle ala la, raalɛ ne nrenzɛle na ɔwole ralɛ nrenya wɔ nyenyensuo mekɛ ne anu. 18Mɔɔ kakula ne dule zo ekyii la, kenle ko ɔ nee ɔ ze, nee ɔ ze ɛkpama ne hɔle ye ɛya nu lɔ kɛ bɛkade bɛyɔba. 19Na ɔzele ɔ ze kɛ, “O me ti, me ti.” Ɔ ze zele ye sonvolɛ ne kɛ, “Dwu ye kɔmaa ɔ nli.” 20Sonvolɛ ne vale kakula ne hɔmanle ɔ nli. Raalɛ ne vale kakula ne dole ɔ gyakɛ azo na ɔkadwu sɛnzɛngyinla la, kakula ne wule. 21Raalɛ ne vale funli ne hɔdole Nyamenle sonla ne ɛsokpa ne azo na ɔdole anlenkɛ ne anu ɔvindele. 22Akee ɔzele ɔ hu kɛ, “Maa me sonvolɛma ne mɔ ko nee asoaso maa mengɔ Nyamenle sonla ne ɛkɛ ne ndɛndɛ menzia membɛla.”
23Ɔ hu bizale ye kɛ, “Duzu ati a ɛkɔ Nyamenle sonla ne ɛkɛ ne ɛnɛ ɛ? Ɛnɛ ɛnle ɛnwomenlelielɛ kenle yɛɛ siane ɛtɛfile.”
Raalɛ ne buale kɛ, “Tɛ debie ɔ.” 24Akee ɔvole asoaso ne azo na ɔzele ye sonvolɛ ne kɛ, “Maa nane ne ɛhɔ ndɛndɛ. Mmamaa ɔto ye ɛnriandilɛ ne anu, kyesɛ mese wɔ kɛ ɛdo nu.” 25Yemɔti ɔzile nu na ɔhɔle Nyamenle sonla ne ɛkɛ wɔ Kamɛle Boka.
Mɔɔ Yilaehya nwunle kɛ raalɛ ne ɛlɛba la, ɔzele Gɛheezae kɛ, “Nea nehane, Hyunɛm raalɛ ne a ɛlɛba la. 26Nriandi kɔyia ye na biza ye kɛ, ‘Kɛ ɛ nwo de ɛ? Ɛ hu te kpɔkɛ ɔ? Ɛ ra ne te kpɔkɛ ɔ?’ ”
Na ɔzele Gɛheezae kɛ, “Yɛ muala yɛte kpɔkɛ.” 27Na mɔɔ ɔdwule Yilaehya anwo ɛkɛ ne wɔ boka ne azo la ɔhotole ɔbɔle ɔ ti aze, ɔzɔle Yilaehya agyakɛ. Gɛheezae rale kɛ ɔbahwe ye ahane na Yilaehya zele ye kɛ, “Gyakyi ye na nyane kpole ɛha ye, yemɔ a Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛva ɛvea me mɔɔ yeanga yeangile me la.”
28Raalɛ ne zele ye kɛ, “Me menle, menzele wɔ kɛ ɛmaa menwo ralɛ nrenya ɔ? Se menganle mengilele wɔ kɛ ɛmmabɛlɛbɛla me.”
29Yilaehya zele Gɛheezae kɛ, “Ka ɛ nwo na die me kpɔma ye kɔ. Saa ɛ nee awie yia a, mmabiza ye ahye, yɛɛ saa awie biza wɔ ahye a mmagyinla ɛdie zolɛ, na fa me kpɔma ye kɔdo kakula ne anwoma azo.”
30Raalɛ ne zele Yilaehya kɛ, “Meka Ɛdɛnkɛma nee ɛdawɔ kɛ menrɛgyakyi wɔ ɛlɛ.” Yemɔti bɛ mu nwiɔ bɛdwazole bɛhɔle. 31Gɛheezae lumuale bɛ nyunlu vale kpɔma ne hɔdole kakula ne anwoma azo, noko kakula ne anzu yɛɛ yeanga ɔ nwo. Zɔhane ati ɔziale kɛ ɔkabɔ amaneɛ na ɔyiale ye la, ɔzele Yilaehya kɛ, “Kakula ne andunwue.”
32Yilaehya dwule sua nu ɛkɛ ne la ɔnwunle kɛ kakula ne ɛwu na bɛdo ye wɔ ye ɛsokpa ne azo. 33Yemɔti ɔwolole sua ne anu, ɔdole anlenkɛ ne anu na ɔhale ye nee kakula ne ala na akee ɔzɛlɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma. 34 Akee ɔhɔvole ɔdenrɛle ɔ nwo wɔ kakula ne funli ne azo, ɔvale ɔ nloa ɔkpulale kakula ne anloa, ɔvale ɔ nye ɔbutule kakula ne anye zo, ɔvale ɔ sa ɔguale kakula ne asa azo. Ɔbutule ɔ nwo zo zɛhae la kakula ne anwo yɛle wuluwulu. 35Ɔdwazole ɔkpɔsale sua ne anu ekyii na eza ɔhɔbutule kakula ne anwo zo bieko. Kakula ne nwuasinle fane nsuu na ɔbukele ɔ nye. 36Akee Yilaegya vɛlɛle Gɛheezae kɛ ɔvɛlɛ Hyunɛm raalɛ ne ɔmaa ye. Ɔvɛlɛle ye na ɔrale la, Yilaehya zele ye kɛ, “Die ɛ ra ne, yede kpɔkɛ.” 37Raalɛ ne radule dɔle ɔ gyakɛ anu ɛkɛ, ɔbɔle ɔ ti azɛlɛ nwo na ɔdwazole ɔvale ɔ ra ne ɔhɔle.
Nwanwane sɛkɛlɛneɛ nwiɔ bieko
38Ɛhɔne zile maanle ne anu, azɛlɛ ne azo, na Yilaehya rale Gelegale. Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma asa azo ne bie mɔ radɛnlanle ɔ nwo ɛkɛ na ɔzele ye sonvolɛ ne kɛ, “Fa ɛzɛne kpole ne sie senle zo na to aleɛ maa Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ asa azo ne mɔ.” 39Bɛ nuhua ko dwazole hɔle kɛ ɔkatete nwolɛ nya nya, na ɔnwunle vanye nyinli bie la ɔtetele ye nya ne dɔɔnwo na ɔrapepɛle ɔguale aleɛ ne anu. Ɛnee ɔnze kɛ awa nyinli nya ɔ. 40Na bɛyeyele bɛmanle bɛ kɛ bɛli. Bɛdi la bɛdeanle nu kɛ, “O Nyamenle sonla, debie mɔɔ ku sonla la wɔ nu.” Yemɔti bɛanli. 41Na Yilaehya zele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛva aleɛ ne bɛrɛlɛ me.” Ɔvale aleɛ ne ɔguale siase ne anu na ɔzele kɛ, “Bɛyeye bie bɛmaa bɛli.” Na ɔyɛle kpalɛ bɔkɔɔ mɔɔ bɛdi a bɛnwu a.
42Mekɛ bie noko, nrenya bie vi Beeyale-Hyalehya vale kpanwo ahunguma abulanwiɔ yɛɛ abɛlɛ mɔɔ bɔ zo mɔɔ bɛlɛbu zolɛ la kodoku nu rɛlɛle Yilaehya. Na Yilaehya zele ye sonvolɛ ne kɛ, “Fa maa Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma asa azo ne mɔ maa bɛli.” 43Ye sonvolɛ ne bizale kɛ, “Asoo ɛhye kɛza menli ɛya ko ye di.”
Yilaehya zile zolɛ bieko kɛ, “Fa maa menli ne maa bɛli na Ɛdɛnkɛma se: Bɛbali, bɛ ko ayi, bie aha.” 44Yemɔti ɔvale ɔmanle bɛlile na bie dɔɔnwo hale kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma hanle ala la.

Title: 2 ARL 5
Content:
Neeman anwo ɛza
1 Nrenya bie, bɛfɛlɛ ye Neeman; ɔle safohyenle kpanyinli mɔɔ nea Selea ɛlɔnema ne anwo zo a. Selea belemgbunli ne bu ye kpalɛ eza ɔkulo ye edwɛkɛ, ɔboalekɛ ɔlua Neeman anwo zo Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛmaa Seleama ɛli Yizilayɛma anwo zo konim. Neeman le katakyie, noko ɔle kokobɛvolɛ. 2Bɛ nee Yizilayɛma konle konle ne mɔ ko anu, Seleama hɔle Yizilayɛma anwo zo na bɛhyele kakula bɛlɛra bie bɛhɔle bɛ maanle nu, na bɛyɛle kɛ ɔzonle Neeman aye ne. 3Kenle ko kakula bɛlɛra ne zele ɔ menle raalɛ ne kɛ, “Saa me menle kɛhɔ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ ne mɔɔ wɔ Samɛlea la anwo lɔ a, anrɛɛ ɔbayɛ ye kokobɛ ne ayile.” 4Neeman dele edwɛkɛ ne la ɔdaye noko ɔhɔle belemgbunli ne ɛkɛ na ɔhɔhanle mɔɔ kakula bɛlɛra ne hanle la, ɔhilele ye. 5Na Belemgbunli ne zele kɛ, “Ɛnee kɔ ɛ. Mekɛlɛ kɛlata meamaa wɔahɔmaa Yizilayɛ belemgbunli ne.”
Yemɔti Neeman vale dwɛtɛ fufule apenle ngoko abulasa, ezukoa nvutuke apenle nsia yɛɛ ɛvoyialilɛ adɛladeɛ ngakyile bulu na ɔzile nu ɔhɔle. 6Na belemgbunli ne vale kɛlata manle ye kɛ ɔva ɔhɔmaa Yizilayɛ belemgbunli ne. Kɛlata ne se, “Saa ɛ sa ka kɛlata ɛhye a, ɛnee nwu ye kɛ medame yɛɛ mezoa me Safohyenlema Kpanyinli ne ɛ nwo ɛkɛ a, amaa wɔayɛ ye kokobɛ ne ayile.”
7Yizilayɛ belemgbunli ne asa hanle kɛlata ne na ɔgengale la, nyane ngome manle ɔsuosuanle ye tɛladeɛ ne mɔɔ ɔwula la anu na ɔzele kɛ, “Na mele Nyamenle ɔ, mɔɔ mekola meku sonla eza metunwue ye mɔɔ yemɔti, bɛva nrenya ɛhye bɛrɛlɛ me kɛ menyɛ ye kokobɛ ayile a? Ɛhye kile kɛ konle ala yɛɛ ɔfa yearadoa me a.”
8Na mɔɔ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ Yilaehya dele edwɛkɛ ne nee kɛ belemgbunli ne zile suosuanle ye tɛladeɛ mɔɔ ɔwula la anu la, ɔzoanle ɔmanle bɛhɔzele ye kɛ, “Na duzu ati yɛɛ wɔsuosua wɔ tɛladeɛ ne anu a? Maa ɔrɛla me nwo ɛke amaa yeanwu kɛ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ wɔ Yizilayɛ.”
9Yemɔti Neeman dɛnlanle ye konle ehwili ne anu na ɔ nee ye mgbɔnwɔ ne mɔ amuala hɔgyinlanle Yilaehya sua nu ɛkɛ ne anuhɔlɛ ne. 10Na Yilaehya zoanle ye sonvolɛma ne mɔ ko manle ɔrazele ye kɛ, “Kɔbia Azule Dwɔdan ne anu fane nsuu na ɛ nwo baza na wɔ nwonane ne ayɛ kɛ ye dɛba ne ala la.” 11Neeman vale ɛya na ɔzele kɛ, “Medwenle kɛ ɔfinde yeara, yearagyinla yeavɛlɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ye Nyamenle ne, na yeava ɔ sa yeawɔza me ewule ne azo yeayɛ me kokobɛ ne ayile. 12Na Azule mgbole mɔɔ le kɛ Abana nee Fapa mɔɔ gua Dɛmasekɛse la ɛnle kpalɛ ɛndɛla azule mɔɔ wɔ Yizilayɛ la ɔ? Duzu ati a mengɔmbia bɛmɛ anu mende kpɔkɛ ɛ?” Yemɔti ɔhakyile ɔ nwo kɛ ɔkɔ.
13Na ye sonvolɛma ne mɔ hɔle ɔ nwo ɛkɛ ne na bɛzele ye kɛ, “Yɛmenle, saa Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ ne zele wɔ kɛ ɛyɛ debie ɛsesebɛ bie a anrɛɛ ɛnrɛyɛ ɔ? Duzu ati yɛɛ akee ɛnrɛhɔdɔ Azule ne anu fane nsuu ne na ɛnrɛde kpɔkɛ ɛ?” 14Na Neeman hɔle Dwɔdan ne anloa na ɔdɔle nu fane nsuu kɛmɔ Yilaehya zele ye la, na ɔdele kpɔkɛ bɔkɔɔ. Ye nwonane ne yɛle kɛnlɛma kɛ adɔma nwonane la. 15Yemɔti ɔziale ɔrale Yilaehya ɛkɛ ne na ɔhanle kɛ, “Kɛkala, akee menwu kɛ Nyamenle ɛnle ɛleka biala kɛ Yizilayɛ ala; zɔhane ati, yɛmenle, die me sa nu ahyɛlɛdeɛ.”
16Yilaehya buale kɛ, “Meka tease Nyamenle ne mɔɔ mesonle ye la kɛ, menrɛlie ahyɛlɛdeɛ biala.”
Neeman hanle biala, na Yilaehya anlie ahyɛlɛdeɛ ne. 17Na Neeman zele ye kɛ, “Saa ye zɛhae ɛdeɛ a ɛnee mebodo wɔ, maa me adenle maa menva ɛke ɛnwea mɔɔ mgbɔnwɔndua nwiɔ kɛhola ye soa la mengɔ, ɔluakɛ ɔvi ɛnɛ mɔɔ kɔ la, menrɛva ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ menrɛmaa kɛ bɛva bɛbɔ azu yɛɛ menrɛbɔ azu menrɛmaa nyamenle biala kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ala. 18Na ɛhye yɛɛ mesɛlɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma a, saa me nee me belemgbunli ne yɛkɔ Selea bozonle Rileemɔn amonle sua ne anu na mebɔ me ti aze mesonle ye bie a, ɔva ɔhyɛ me.”
19Na Yilaehya zele ye kɛ, “Kɔ anzonudwolɛ nu.” Na Neeman hɔle.
Mɔɔ Neeman hɔle moa ekyii la, 20Yilaehya sonvolɛ Gɛheezae, hanle kɛ, “Nea, me menle ɛgyakyi Seleanli Neeman; yeanlie ninyɛne mɔɔ ɔ nee bɛ rale la anu ko bɔbɔ. Meka tease Ɛdɛnkɛma kɛ, menriandi meadoa ye meahɔlie debie wɔ ye ɛkɛ.” 21Yemɔti ɔnriandile ɔdoale Neeman. Neeman dole ɔ nye na ɔnwunle kɛ awie lɛ ɛnriandilɛ doa ye la, ɔvi ye ehwili ne anu ɔdwule ɔhɔyiale ye na ɔbizale ye kɛ, “Edwɛkɛ bie ɔ?”
22Gɛheezae buale kɛ, “Tɛ edwɛkɛ bie ɔ, edwɛkɛ biala ɛnle ɛkɛ. Na me menle ɛzoa me kɛ membaze wɔ kɛ, ‘Ɛyele ɛ nwo ɛkɛ ne ala la yɛɛ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma asa azo ne mɔ mɔɔ wɔ Yifelaem awoka ne mɔ azo lɔ la anu nwiɔ rale a. Yemɔti fa dwɛtɛ fufule apenle nsa yɛɛ ɛvoyialilɛ adɛladeɛ ngakyile nwiɔ maa memaa bɛ.’ ”
23Neeman buale kɛ, “Die dwɛtɛ fufule apenle nsia kɔmaa bɛ.” Ɔgyinlanle zo kɛ ɔlie, na ɔwulale dwɛtɛ fufule ne wɔ ahodoku nwiɔ anu ɔkyekyele na ɔvale ɛvoyialilɛ adɛladeɛ ngakyile nwiɔ ɔbokale nwolɛ ɔvale ɔzoale ye sonvolɛma nwiɔ kɛ bɛva bɛ nee Gɛheezae ɛhɔ. 24Bɛhɔdwule boka ne mɔɔ Yilaehya wɔ zo la abo la, Gɛheezae liele ninyɛne ne na ɔvale ɔhɔguale ye sua ne mɔɔ ɔda nu la anu na ɔmanle menli ne mɔ ziale. 25Akee ɔziale ɔhɔle sua nu na Yilaehya bizale ye kɛ, “Gɛheezae, ɛhɔle nienwu?”
Gɛheezae buale kɛ, “Meangɔ ɛleka.”
26Na Yilaehya zele ye kɛ, “Me sunsum nee wɔ a hɔle a. Mɔɔ nrenya ne vi ye ehwili ne anu dwule aze kɛ ɔbayia wɔ la ɛnee mewɔ ɛkɛ. Ɛnea a ɛnee mekɛ mɔɔ bɛfa bɛdie ezukoa, adɛladeɛ, ɔlivi nee vanye egyinli, mboane nee nlankɛ, yɛɛ sonvolɛ mrenya nee mraalɛ la a le ɛhye ɔ? 27Zɔhane ati Neeman kokobɛ ne badila wɔ nee ɛ bo zo amra dahuu.” Gɛheezae vindele la ɛnee kokobɛ ne ɛdila ye, ɔ nwo ɛyɛ nzelabenle.

Title: 2 ARL 6
Content:
Akuma tile ne mɔɔ dule minlinle la ɛnwunlɛ
1Kenle ko Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma asa azo ne mɔɔ Yilaehya a nea bɛ nwo zo la hanle hilele ye kɛ, “Ɛleka mɔɔ yɛde la le ekyi maa yɛ. 2Maa yɛ adenle maa yɛhɔ Dwɔdan ne anloa lɔ yɛhɔpɛ mbaka yɛrabu awuke yɛdɛnla nuhua.”
Na Yilaehya zele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛhɔ.”
3Bɛ nuhua ko zele Yilaehya kɛ, “Yɛbodo wɔ, maa yɛhɔ.” Na ɔkponlenle zolɛ 4ɔ nee bɛ hɔle. Bɛrale Dwɔdan ne anloa na bɛpɛle mbaka dɔɔnwo. 5Mɔɔ bɛgua zo bɛlɛpɛ mbaka ne la, nuhua ko akuma ɛdeɛ ne ati dule dɔle azule ne anu, na ɔdeanle nu kɛ, “Aa, me menle, yɛvɛnenle akuma ne.”
6Yilaehya bizale ye kɛ, “Nienwu a ɔdɔle a?”
Nrenya ne hilele ye ɛleka mɔɔ ɔdɔle la. Yilaehya pɛle baka ekyi ko vuandinle dole azule ne anu na akuma tile ne tulule. 7Yilaehya zele ye kɛ, “Tende ɛ sa fa.” Na nrenya ne vale.
Bɛli Selea ɛlɔnema anwo zo konim
8Mekɛ bie mɔɔ ɛnee Selea belemgbunli ne zo konle doa Yizilayɛma la, ɔ nee ye mgbanyima yiale nuhua na bɛvale adwenle bɛhilele ɛleka mɔɔ bɛbayɛ bɛ azokoɛleɛ ne la. 9Na Yilaehya zoanle manle bɛhɔdinle Yizilayɛ belemgbunli ne aze amaa yeangɔ ɛleka mɔɔ bɛwɔ la. 10Na Yizilayɛ belemgbunli ne noko manle menli mɔɔ wɔ ɛkɛ ne afoa nu la lale bɛ nwo zo. Ɛhye hɔle zo fane dɔɔnwo manle Yizilayɛma nyianle bɛ ti.
11Ɛhye manle Selea belemgbunli ne adwenle zɛkyele dɔɔnwo manle ɔvɛlɛle ye mgbanyima ne na ɔbizale bɛ kɛ, “Bɛ nuhua boni a wɔ Yizilayɛ belemgbunli ne anzi a?”
12Mgbanyima ne mɔ ko buale kɛ, “Nana, yɛ nuhua biala ɛnle ɔ nzi na Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ Yilaehya ne mɔɔ wɔ Yizilayɛ ɛkɛ ne la yɛɛ edwɛkɛ mɔɔ ɛkɛvea wɔ sua ne akunlu bɔbɔ ɛkɛha la, ɔka ɔkile Yizilayɛ belemgbunli ne a.”
13Belemgbunli ne zele kɛ, “Bɛhɔkpondɛ ye bɛnwu ɛleka mɔɔ ɔde la na menzoa menli memaa bɛhɔhye ye.”
Bɛhɔle na bɛrahanle bɛhilele ye kɛ ɔde Dotan. 14Yemɔti belemgbunli ne manle ɛlɔnema mɔɔ tɛnla mgbɔnwɔ zo nee mɔɔ tɛnla ehwili nu ko la dɔɔnwo nee ɛlɔnema dɔɔnwo kpalɛ rale nɔɔzo na bɛrabɔle bɛyiale suakpole ne. 15Mɔɔ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ ne sonvolɛ ne dwazole nwonlomɔ mangyee ne na ɔtudu agyakɛ la, ɔnwunle kɛ ɛlɔne ɛva sua ne. Na ɔbizale Yilaehya kɛ, “O, me menle, na duzu yɛɛ yɛkɛyɛ a? Yɛwu bɔkɔbɔkɔ.”
16Yilaehya zele ye kɛ, “Mmasulo, ɛlɔnema mɔɔ nee yɛ lua la zonle tɛla bɛ.” 17Akee ɔzɛlɛle kɛ, “Ɛdɛnkɛma, buke me sonvolɛ ye anye maa ɔnwu debie.” Ɛdɛnkɛma diele nzɛlɛlɛ ne na ɔbukele kpavolɛ ne anye na ɔnwunle kɛ ɛlɔnema mɔɔ de senle mgbɔnwɔ zo nee senle ehwili nu la ɛbɔ ɛyia Yilaehya na bɛ somaa ɛva boka ne amuala.
18Mɔɔ Selea ɛlɔnema ne dule kɛ bɛba bɛ nwo zo la, Yilaehya zɛlɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma kɛ, “Mesɛlɛ wɔ, bili menli ɛhye mɔ anye zo.” Yemɔti ɔbilile bɛ nye zo, kɛmɔ Yilaehya zɛlɛle ala la. 19Yilaehya hɔle bɛ nwo ɛkɛ na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Ayi mɔ, bɛminli. Tɛ adenle ne ɛne yɛɛ tɛ suakpole ne mɔɔ bɛkɔ zo la ɛne. Bɛdoa me na me nee bɛ ɛhɔ ahenle mɔɔ bɛkpondɛ ye la ɛkɛ ne.” Na ɔlile bɛ nyunlu ɔ nee bɛ hɔle Samɛlea.
20Bɛdwule Samɛlea ala la Yilaehya zɛlɛle bieko kɛ, “O Ɛdɛnkɛma, maa bɛ nye zo ɛtete bɛ na bɛnwu ɛleka mɔɔ bɛwɔ la.” Yemɔti Ɛdɛnkɛma manle bɛ nye zo tetele bɛ na bɛnwunle kɛ bɛwolo bɛra Samɛlea suakpole ne azo.
21Mɔɔ Yizilayɛ belemgbunli ne nwunle Selea ɛlɔnema ne la, ɔbizale Yilaehya kɛ, “Egya, mengu bɛ ɔ? Mengu bɛ ɔ?”
22Yilaehya buale kɛ, “Saa ɛhyele bɛ donvula wɔ konle nu bɔbɔ a anrɛɛ ɛnrɛhu bɛ. Yemɔti mmaku bɛ. Maa bɛ debie bɛli, maa bɛ nzule bɛnlo na gyakyi bɛ maa bɛhɔ bɛ menle anwo lɔ.”
23Yemɔti belemgbunli ne manle bɛdole bɛ ɛkponle kpole bie. Bɛlile debie bɛ ko yile na bɛnlonle nza la, akee ɔmanle bɛ adenle bɛziale bɛhɔle Selea belemgbunli ne ɛkɛ. Ɔvi mekɛ zɔhane Seleama anli bɛ edwɛkɛ ambɔ Yizilayɛma anwo zo ɛralɛ bieko.
Selea teta Samɛlea
24Nzinlii mɔɔ mekɛ guale nu ekyii la, Selea belemgbunli Bɛneheedade boɔboale ye ɛlɔnema amuala anloa na ɔhɔtetale Samɛlea. Ɔvale ye ɛlɔnema ne ɔnwinwinle Samɛlea mɔɔ ɛnee awie biala ɛnnyia adenle ɛnvi suakpole ne azo ɛnvinde yɛɛ awie ɛngɔ zolɛ. 25Ɔlua ɛhye ati aleɛ wiele na ɛhɔne rale suakpole ne azo manle bɛdɔle asoaso tile dwɛtɛ fufule abulatwɛ yɛɛ bɛ anweɛ nyinli ngyikyi bie mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye “Kaabe” la ɛkyɛ nu nna a bɛtɔ ko dwɛtɛ fufule nnu.
26Kenle ko Yizilayɛ belemgbunli ne lua suakpole ne bane ne sinli nyunlu ɛlɛtudu agyakɛ la, raalɛ bie vɛlɛle ye hanle kɛ, “O Nana, boa me.”
27Belemgbunli ne buale kɛ, “Saa Ɛdɛnkɛma amboa wɔ a ɛnee kɛ mame mesi meboa wɔ memaa ɔyɛ boɛ ɛ? Menlɛ awule yɛɛ menlɛ nwanye. 28Duzu debie a ɛkpondɛ kɛ meyɛ memaa wɔ a?”
Raalɛ ne buale kɛ, “Ɛkenle bie raalɛ ɛhye zele me kɛ menva me ra nrenya ne memaa yɛhu ye yɛli wɔ demua ne na kenle fofolɛ yɛahu ɔdaye noko ye ɛdeɛ ne yɛali. 29 Yemɔti yɛhunle me ra nrenya ne yɛdonle yɛlile. Akee ye alehyenlɛ nu menzele ye kɛ ɔhu ɔ ra nrenya ne ɔmaa yɛdo yɛli a, ɔse ɔnrɛyɛ, yeva ɔ ra ne yehɔvea.”
30Mɔɔ Belemgbunli ne dele ɛhye la, ɛya ngome manle ɔsuosuanle ye tɛladeɛ ne mɔɔ ɔwula la anu. Na menli mɔɔ bikye ɛkɛ ne la nwunle kɛ ɛnee ɔwula ɛrele tɛladeɛ wɔ ɔ bo. 31Na ɔzele kɛ, “Saa ɛnɛ kenle ye meammaa bɛanye Hyeefate ara Yilaehya ati ne bɛanvi zo a, Nyamenle ɛdua me kakɛ ɛgua me bie zo.” 32Na ɔzoanle sonla kɛ ɔhɔva Yilaehya ɔrɛlɛ ye.
Mekɛ ne anu ɛnee Yilaehya nee mgbanyima bie mɔɔ ɛra ye ɛkpɔlalɛ la gua ɛlɛdi adwelie wɔ ye sua ne anu. Na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛnlea, kɔdiawu ne ɛzoa kɛ bɛrahu me. Saa ɔdwu ɛke a bɛdo anlenkɛ ne anu bɛzua ɔ nzi kpundii; bɛmmamaa ɔwolo ɔba ɛke. Belemgbunli mumua ne li ɔ nzi ɛlɛba.” Yilaehya hanle ɛhye kolaa na sonla ne mɔɔ belemgbunli ne zoanle ye la ara. 33Ɔ nloa ampe bɔbɔ yɛɛ belemgbunli mumua ne yele ɔ nyunlu a, na ɔzele kɛ, “Ngyegyelɛ ɛhye vi Ɛdɛnkɛma. Duzu ati a ɔwɔ kɛ eza mekendɛ dedee ɛ?”

Title: 2 ARL 7
Content:
1Yilaehya buale kɛ, “Tie edwɛkɛ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛha la. Ɔse, Ɛhyema kabezɛ ala, bɛbadɔne abɛlɛ ɛdɔkɛ kilo nsa anzɛɛ baale kilo nsia dwɛtɛ fufule ko wɔ Samɛlea ɛke.”
2Na belemgbunli sonvolɛ ne mɔɔ nee ye lua la zele Yilaehya kɛ, “Ɛhye, yemɔ tafela. Saa Ɛdɛnkɛma mumua ne tukuedukue anwuma nvɛnzɛlɛ bɔbɔ a, ɔnrɛzi zɔhane ɛlɛ.”
Yilaehya buale kɛ, “Ɛ nye banwu ye na ɛnrɛli bie.”
Selea ɛlɔnema nriandi avi Samɛlea
3Menli nna bie mɔɔ kokobɛ ɛdila bɛ la ɛnee de Samɛlea suakpole ne anuhɔlɛ kpole ne anzi. Na bɛhanle bɛhilele bɛ nwo ngoko kɛ, “Duzu ati a yɛtɛnla ɛke dedee yɛawu ɛ? 4Saa yɛse kɛ yɛkɔ suakpole ne azo lɔ a, ɛhɔne wɔ lɔ, yɛbawu; yɛɛ saa yɛde ɛke noko a ewule ko ne ala ɔ. Zɔhane ati bɛmaa yɛhɔ Selea ɛlɔnema ne azokoɛleɛ lɔ. Saa bɛnwu yɛ anwunvɔne a, yɛ ti ngoane ɔ, saa bɛku yɛ noko a, ɔ muala wie ewule ko ne ala.” 5Yemɔti mɔɔ maanle nu ɛlɛdudu la bɛdwazole kɛ bɛkɔ Seleama azokoɛleɛ ne. Bɛhɔdwule ɛkɛ ne la bɛnwunle kɛ awie biala ɛnle ɛkɛ. 6Ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma manle Selea ɛlɔnema ne dele ɛnelɛ kpole bie mɔɔ kile kɛ ɛlɔne ɛva bɛ aze a. Ɛnelɛ ne zɔho konle ehwili dɔɔnwo nee mgbɔnwɔ nee ɛlɔne kpole bie agyakɛ abo. Yemɔti bɛhanle bɛhilele bɛ nwo ngoko kɛ, “Bɛnlea kɛ Yizilayɛ belemgbunli ɛhɔbɔ Hɛte nee Yigyibiti arelemgbunli ɛkpa yemaa bɛva bɛ ɛlɔne bɛra yɛ nwo zo a.” 7Na nɔsonɔso ne ala bɛguale ndwɛlɛ aze bɛgyakyile bɛ ndanlɛ azua, bɛ mgbɔnwɔ nee bɛ asoaso ne mɔ bɛ nzi kɛ bɛ gyakɛ anzi ndinli kɛlie bɛ ngoane.
8Mɔɔ menli nna ne mɔɔ kokobɛ ɛdila bɛ la radwule azokoɛleɛ ne la bɛwolole ndanlɛ sua ko anu, bɛnyianle debie bɛlile na bɛnlonle, bɛvale dwɛtɛ fufule, ezukoa nvutuke, yɛɛ adɛladeɛ bɛvindele bɛhɔveale. Bɛziale bɛrale bieko na bɛwolole ndanlɛ sua fofolɛ nu, na bɛvale ninyɛne bɛvile ɛkɛ bɛhɔveale. 9Na akee bɛzele kɛ, “Yɛnyɛ ye boɛ; ɛnɛ kenle ye nee edwɛkɛ fɛlɛko lua. Saa yɛfea zolɛ toonwo ɔdwu alehyenlɛ a, yɛbanyia ndeanlɛ. Zɔhane ati bɛmaa yɛhɔbɔ belemgbunli mgbanyima ne mɔ sua nu amra amaneɛ. 10Yemɔti bɛrale na bɛhanle bɛhilele anlenkɛ kpole sinzavolɛma ne kɛ: Yɛhɔle Seleama azokoɛleɛ lɔ na yɛnwunle kɛ awie biala ɛnle ɛkɛ. Anloma nee akɔlɛ bɔbɔ, yeande bie nganeɛ kɛ bɛ mgbɔnwɔ nee bɛ asoaso ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛhendɛhenda bɛ la a yɛnwunle bɛ a, yɛɛ bɛ ndanlɛ azua ne mɔ noko bɛanyɛ bɛ ɛhwee.”
11Anlenkɛ Kpole sinzavolɛma ne bɔle edwɛkɛ ne nolo na bɛhɔhanle edwɛkɛ ne wɔ belemgbunli suakunlu ɛkɛ. 12Na belemgbunli dwazole nɔe ne na ɔzele ye mgbanyima ne mɔ kɛ, “Bɛdie, bɛze mɔɔ Seleama ne ɛyɛ la ɔ? Bɛze kɛ ɛhɔne ɛlɛku yɛ, yemɔti bɛ nye fuu bɛvi bɛ azokoɛleɛ ne bɛhɔvea fienemgbole ne anu lɔ; bɛ adwenle a le kɛ, yɛvi suakpole ye azo yɛbavinde na bɛarahye yɛ na bɛava suakpole ye.”
13Ye mgbanyima ne mɔ ko zele ye kɛ, “Ewule ɛbɔ sua ye ɛwie; yemɔti ɔsi ɛkɛ ne ko ne ala. Bɛmaa yɛzoa menli yɛmaa bɛva mgbɔnwɔ mɔɔ ɛha la anu nnu bɛhɔnlea ye bɛ nye zo.” 14Yemɔti bɛyele menli nwiɔ mɔɔ tɛnla mgbɔnwɔ zo ko la na belemgbunli zoanle bɛ kɛ bɛhɔnlea. 15Menli nwiɔ zɔhane dinle Seleama toonwo hɔdwule Dwɔdan ne anloa, na bɛnwunle kɛ, ye ndɛndɛ mɔɔ bɛkpondɛ la ati, Seleama nriandi ahɔ la ɛnee bɛlɛwɔlɔwɔlɔ bɛ adɛladeɛ na bɛfuandi bɛ konle ninyɛne bɛgua. Na soanvolɛma ne ziale rabɔle belemgbunli amaneɛ. 16Na menli ne vindele na bɛhɔfonyianle Seleama ndanlɛ azua ne mɔ anu bɛsesale bɛ debie biala. Yemɔti bɛdɔnenle abɛlɛ ɛdɔkɛ kilo nsa yɛɛ baale kilo nsia dwɛtɛ fufule ngoko, kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma hanle ala la.
17Ɔrale ye zɛhae la, belemgbunli ne yɛle kɛ safohyenle ne mɔɔ nee ye lua la ɛhɔnlea suakpole ne anlenkɛ kpole sinzavolɛma ne anwo zo, na menli ne tietiale ɔ nwo zo manle ɔwule kɛmɔ Yilaehya hanle dole ɛkɛ ne, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɔ nee belemgbunli bɛrale ɔ nwo zo la. 18Ɔluakɛ mɔɔ Yilaehya zele belemgbunli kɛ, “Bɛbadɔne abɛlɛ ɛdɔkɛ kilo nsa yɛɛ baale kilo nsia dwɛtɛ fufule ngoko ɛhyema kabezɛ wɔ Samɛlea ɛke la,” 19safohyenle ne buale ye kɛ, “Saa Ɛdɛnkɛma mumua ne tukuedukue anwuma nvɛnzɛlɛ bɔbɔ a ɔnrɛzi zɔhane ɛlɛ.” Na Yilaehya zele ye kɛ, “Ɛ nye banwu ye na ɛnrɛli bie.” 20Na ɔyɛle zɔhane. Menli ne tietiale ɔ nwo zo wɔ anlenkɛ kpole ne anloa manle ɔwule.

Title: 2 ARL 8
Content:
Hyunɛm raalɛ ne sia ara
1 Mekɛ bie Yilaehya hanle hilele raalɛ ne mɔɔ ɔ ra ne wule a ɔdunwuele ye la kɛ, “Dwazo na ɛ nee wɔ sua nu amra amuala bɛlɔ nu bɛhɔ ɛleka biala mɔɔ bɛkola la na Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛlɛmaa ɛhɔne ara azɛlɛ ye azo ɛvolɛ nsuu.” 2Yemɔti raalɛ ne hɔle, kɛmɔ Yilaehya hanle la, na ɔ nee ye sua nu amra bɛhɔle Filisitiama maanle nu bɛhɔlile ɛvolɛ nsuu.
3Ɛvolɛ nsuu ne awieleɛ, raalɛ ne vi Filisitiama maanle nu ziale rale sua nu na ɔhɔle kɛ ɔkanwu belemgbunli wɔ ye sua ne nee ye azɛlɛ ne mɔ anwo. 4Mekɛ ne anu ɛnee belemgbunli nee Yilaehya sonvolɛ Gɛheezae ɛlɛdi adwelie na yebiza ye kɛ, “Ka ninyɛne mgbole mɔɔ Yilaehya ɛyɛ la amuala kile me.” 5Na mɔɔ Gɛheezae anloa wɔ zolɛ ɔlɛka menli mɔɔ wule na Yilaehya dunwuele bɛ la anwo edwɛkɛ yeahile belemgbunli ne la, yɛɛ raalɛ ne mɔɔ ɔ ra wule a Yilaehya dunwuele ye la ravindele ɛkɛ kɛ ɔbaha ye sua nee ye azɛlɛ nwo edwɛkɛ a. Na Gɛheezae zele kɛ, “Nana, me menle, raalɛ ne mɔɔ melɛdi ye edwɛkɛ la yemɔ ɛne, yɛɛ ɔ ra ne mɔɔ wule a Yilaehya dunwuele ye la noko ɛne.”
6Belemgbunli ne bizale raalɛ ne edwɛkɛ ne na raalɛ ne dole mɔɔ Gɛheezae hanle la azo. Yemɔti belemgbunli yele kpanyinli ko dole ɔ nwo zo na ɔzele ye kɛ ɔnlea ɔmaa raalɛ ne asa ɛha ye debie biala, na bɛye ezukoa biala mɔɔ bɛnyianle ye wɔ ye azɛlɛ ne azo wɔ ɛvolɛ nsuu ne anu la bɛmaa ye.
Yilaehya nee Selea Belemgbunli Bɛneheedade
7Akee Yilaehya rale Dɛmasekɛse. Selea Belemgbunli Bɛneheedade ɛnee ɛnde kpɔkɛ na bɛhanle bɛhilele ye kɛ, Yilaehya ɛra ɛkɛ. 8Belemgbunli zele Hazeeyɛle kɛ, “Fa ahyɛlɛdeɛ, na kɔyia Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ ne, na maa ɔbiza Ɛdɛnkɛma saa menwɔde kpɔkɛ a.” 9Yemɔti Hazeeyɛle vale Dɛmasekɛse ninyɛne dɔɔnwo wulowulale bɛ ahodoku nu zoale afunlumu abulanla na ɔvale ɔhɔyiale Yilaehya kɛ, “Wɔ dehelɛ, Belemgbunli Bɛneheedade ɛnde kpɔkɛ, na yezoa me kɛ membambiza saa ɔkɛde kpɔkɛ a.”
10Yilaehya buale kɛ, “Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛye ɛhile me kɛ ɔbawu noko kɔze ye kɛ, ɔbade kpɔkɛ bɔkɔɔ.” 11Akee Yilaehya nleanle Hazeeyɛle anyunlu dedee ɔmanle Hazeeyɛle ati zile aze, na Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ ne zunle. 12Na Hazeeyɛle bizale ye kɛ, “Duzu ati a me menle akee ɛlɛsu a?”
Yilaehya buale kɛ, “Ɔboalekɛ menwu ɛtane mɔɔ ɛbali wɔamaa Yizilayɛma la. Ɛbado senle wɔ bɛ aranemgbole ne mɔ anu, wɔahuhu bɛ mgbavolɛ nee ngakula kɔsɔɔti, na wɔatulutulu mraalɛ mɔɔ ɛva ɛkolɛ la anyalɛ.”
13Hazeeyɛle zele kɛ, “Medame, na mele duzu? Twea ralɛ mɔɔ le kɛ medame mɔɔ mendo ɛhwee la, mefa nienwu na meayɛ ɛhye?”
Yilaehya buale kɛ, “Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛye ɛhile me kɛ wɔmɔ yɛɛ ɛbali belemgbunli wɔ Selea a.”
14Hazeeyɛle vi Yilaehya anwo ɛkɛ ne hɔle na belemgbunli ne bizale ye kɛ, “Duzu edwɛkɛ a Yilaehya hanle hilele wɔ a?”
Hazeeyɛle buale ye kɛ, “Ɔzele me kɛ, ɛbade kpɔkɛ.” 15Noko aleɛ hyenle la, Hazeeyɛle vale kundu bɔle nzule nu vale hedale belemgbunli ne ati zo manle ye ɛbolɛ kpunle toonwo ɔwule.
Na Hazeeyɛle lile Selea ebia ne.
Dwuda Belemgbunli Gyɛhɔlam
(2 Edk 21.1-20)
16Yizilayɛ Belemgbunli Ehabe ara Dwɔlam lile ɛvolɛ nnu wɔ Yizilayɛ ebia ne azo la yɛɛ Gyɛhɔhyafate ara Gyɛhɔlam bɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɔdi belemgbunli wɔ Dwuda a. 17Ɔlile ɛvolɛ abulasa nee nwiɔ la yɛɛ bɛvale ye bɛziele belemgbunli a. Ɔlile ebia ne ɛvolɛ mɔtwɛ wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm. 18Ɔvale Yizilayɛ arelemgbunli agyakɛ na ɔbɔle Ehabe sua nu amra ɛbɛla ne bie, ɔluakɛ ɛnee ɔgya Ehabe ara raalɛ. Na ɔyɛle ɛtane ɔtiale Ɛdɛnkɛma. 19Noko ɛnee ɔnle Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛhulolɛ kɛ ɔkɛzɛkye Dwudama, ɔboalekɛ yebɔ ye akɛlɛ Devidi ɛwɔkɛ kɛ ɔ bo zo amra a bali ebia ne dahuu a.
20Gyɛhɔlam mekɛ zo, Yidɔmma dele atua kɛ bɛnle Dwudama abo bieko; bɛdabɛ bɛziele bɛ belemgbunli na bɛlile bɛ ti anwo.
21Yemɔti Gyɛhɔlam vale ye ɛlɔnema mɔɔ fa ehwili ko la hɔle Zeeyɛ na nɔe ne bɛdwazole bɛhanle Yidɔmma mɔɔ ɛnee ɛbɔ ɛyia bɛ la senle manle bɛnriandile bɛhɔle bɛ azua nu. 22Noko akee Yidɔmma dele atua; bɛli bɛ ti anwo toonwo a yeradwu ɛnɛ a. Lebenama bɛdabɛ noko bɛdele atua wɔ mekɛ ko ne ala anu.
23Nyɛleɛ mɔɔ Gyɛhɔlam yɛle nee gyima mɔɔ ɔlile la bɛhɛlɛ bɛ muala wɔ Dwuda Arelemgbunli Tetedwɛkɛ Mbuluku ne mɔ anu. 24Yemɔti Gyɛhɔlam hɔle ayile nu na bɛwulale ye mrɛlatɛlɛ nu wɔ ɔ ze mɔ dehelɛ alaleɛ ne wɔ Devidi suakpole zo, na ɔ ra Ehazaya lile ebia ne.
Dwuda Belemgbunli Ehazaya
(2 Edk 22.1-6)
25Yizilayɛ Belemgbunli Dwɔlam, Ehabe ara ne lile ɛvolɛ bulu nee nwiɔ wɔ ebia ne azo la yɛɛ bɛvale Gyɛhɔlam ara Ehazaya bɛziele belemgbunli wɔ Dwuda a. 26Ehazaya lile ɛvolɛ abulanwiɔ nee nwiɔ na yeabɔ ɔ bo kɛ ɔdi belemgbunli yɛɛ ɔlile belemgbunli ɛvolɛ ko pɛ wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm. Bɛfɛlɛ ɔ nli Atalaya; ɔle Yizilayɛ Belemgbunli Ɔmelae anlɔnra. 27Ɔdaye noko ɔvale Belemgbunli Ehabe sua nu amra agyakɛ. Ɔyɛle ɛtane ɔtiale Ɛdɛnkɛma, kɛmɔ Ehabe sua nu amra yɛle la, ɔluakɛ ɔdaye mumua ne ɔle azebia wɔ Ehabe sua nu.
28Ehazaya nee Yizilayɛ Belemgbunli Dwɔlam vale konle doale Selea Belemgbunli Hazeeyɛle wɔ Releemɔto mɔɔ wɔ Geleade la, na Dwɔlam bodale kpole bie wɔ konle ne anu. 29Dwɔlam ziale rale Gyɛzɛlii kɛ ɔbayɛ ɔ nwo ayile, na Dwuda Belemgbunli Ehazaya (Gyɛhɔlam ara ne) rakpɔlale ye.

Title: 2 ARL 9
Content:
Bɛkpokpa Gyihu nwole kɛ ɔle Yizilayɛ belemgbunli
1Yilaehya vɛlɛle Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma asa azo ne mɔ anu ko na ɔzele ye kɛ, “Boɔboa ɛ nwo na fa nwole toba ko ye kɔ Releemɔto mɔɔ wɔ Geleade maanle nu la. 2Saa ɛdwu ɛkɛ ne a kpondɛ Gyɛhɔhyafate ara Gyihu, mɔɔ le Nemehyae anlɔnra ne. Ɛnwu ye a fa ye kɔ ahane, awie bie sua kunlu, 3wola nwole toba ko ne gua ɔ ti avinli na se ye kɛ, Ɛdɛnkɛma se, ‘Meyɛ wɔ Yizilayɛma belemgbunli.’ Akee ɛvi sua ne anu finde na nriandi bɛla, mmasisi aze fee.”
4Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ asa azo ne hɔle Releemɔto.
5Ɔhɔle la ɛnee safohyenlema ne mɔ ɛyia nu ɛlɛfa adwenle, na kpavolɛ ne zele kɛ, “Safohyenle, me nee wɔ nrɛlaleɛ ɛra.”
Gyihu bizale ye kɛ, “Yɛ nuhua boni a ɛlɛtendɛ wɔ ahile ye a?”
Kpavolɛ ne zele kɛ, “Yɛmenle, ɛdawɔ ɔ?”
6Yemɔti Gyihu dwazole na ɔ nee ye hɔle sua ne anu. Kpavolɛ ne wolale nwole toba ko ne guale ɔ ti zo na ɔzele ye kɛ, “Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne se, ‘Meyɛ wɔ Yizilayɛ belemgbunli kɛ ɛzie Ɛdɛnkɛma menli ne. 7Ɛbahu ɛ menle Ehabe nee ɔ bo zo amra, amaa meanyia adenle meazenra Gyɛzɛbɛle kɛ ɔhunle Ɛdɛnkɛma kpɔmanvolɛma ne mɔ, na ɔhanle me sonvolɛma mogya ɔguale a. 8Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛku Ehabe abo zo amra kɔsɔɔti, na meaminli Ehabe sua nu mrenya alehelɛ nee ngɛkɛlɛ kɔsɔɔti mɔɔ wɔ Yizilayɛ la abo zo. 9Mebayɛ Ehabe sua nu kɛ menyɛle Nibate ara Gyɛlɔbowam nee Ahaegya ara Beeyahya azua nu la. 10Awie ɛnrɛzie Gyɛzɛbɛle, ahwea yɛɛ bali ye nwonane wɔ Gyɛzɛlii a.’ ” Kpavolɛ ne hanle ɛhye wiele la ɔdukuele anlenkɛ ne na ɔnriandile ɔhɔle.
11Gyihu vindele rale ɔ gɔnwo mɔ anu la, bɛbizale ye kɛ, “Ɔle bɛtɛɛ ɔ? Duzu a ɛzɛlɛ ɛhye kpondɛ wɔ wɔ ɛkɛ a?”
Gyihu zele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛdabɛ bɛze sonla ne nee ye ɛdendɛlɛ dɛba ko ye.”
12Bɛzele ye kɛ, “Mɔɔ wɔha la ɛnle nɔhalɛ. Ka mɔɔ ɔhanle la kile yɛ.”
Ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Ye edwɛkɛ a le kɛ, Ɛdɛnkɛma se, ‘Meyɛ wɔ belemgbunli mɔɔ bazie Yizilayɛma a.’ ”
13Ɛkɛ ne ala Gyihu agɔnwo safohyenlema ne yeyele bɛ adɛladeɛ ne mɔ guale ɔ gyakɛ anu kɛ ɔtietia zolɛ. Akee bɛbɔle aweɛne ndendenle nu na bɛzele kɛ, “Bɛyɛ Gyihu belemgbunli!”
Bɛhu Yizilayɛ Belemgbunli Dwɔlam
14-15Ɔrale ye zɛhae la akee Gyihu nyianle adwenle kɛ ɔku Belemgbunli Dwɔlam, mɔɔ ɛnee ɛboda na ɔwɔ Gyɛzɛlii la. Ɔbodale konle ne mɔɔ ye ɛlɔnema nee Selea Belemgbunli Hazeeyɛle ɛlɔnema ne honle wɔ Releemɔto mɔɔ wɔ Geleade la anu. Gyihu hanle hilele ɔ gɔnwo mɔ safohyenlema ne kɛ, “Saa bɛgyi me nzi a ɛnee awie biala mmawolo ɔ bo kɔ Gyɛzɛlii kɔka kile menli mɔɔ wɔ Gyɛzɛlii la. Awie biala ɛwoa Releemɔto ɛke.” 16Akee Gyihu vole ye konle ehwili ne anu na ɔzile nu kɛ ɔkɔ Gyɛzɛlii. Ɛkɛ ne a ɛnee Belemgbunli Dwɔlam wɔ ɛlɛyɛ ɔ nwo ayile na Dwuda Belemgbunli Ehazaya ɛhɔ ye ɛkpɔlalɛ a.
17Sinzavolɛ bie ɛnee gyi Gyɛzɛlii tawa ne azo na ɔnwunle Gyihu nee ye ɛlɔne ne mɔɔ ɛlɛba la. Ɔzele kɛ, “Menwu kɛ menli bie ɛlɛba.”
Dwɔlam zele kɛ, “Maa sonla mɔɔ ze ɛkpɔnwɔ ka la ɛhɔyia bɛ na ɔbiza bɛ saa bɛlɛba ye anzonudwolɛ nu a.”
18Yemɔti sonla vole ɛkpɔnwɔ zo yiale Gyihu na ɔbizale ye kɛ “Belemgbunli se membambiza bɛ saa bɛlɛba ye anzonudwolɛ nu a.”
Gyihu zele ye kɛ, “Se di me nzi. Anzonudwolɛ a le duzu?”
Sinzavolɛ ne manle belemgbunli dele kɛ, “Ahenle mɔɔ bɛzoanle ye la ɛdwu menli ne anwo lɔ, noko mennwu kɛ ɔlɛba.” 19Eza belemgbunli zoanle sonla fofolɛ na ɔdaye noko ɔyiale Gyihu nee ye ɛlɔne ne na ɔbizale bɛ saa bɛlɛba ye anzonudwolɛ nu a. Na Gyihu zele ye kɛ, “Se di me nzi. Anzonudwolɛ a le duzu?”
20Sinzavolɛ ne eza manle belemgbunli dele kɛ ahenle mɔɔ bɛzoanle ye la ɛdwu noko ɔmba. Akee ɔzele kɛ, “Ahenle mɔɔ nee ɛlɔne ne ɛlɛba la zɔho Gyihu, ɔluakɛ ɔlɛka ye konle ehwili ne kpole kpalɛ.”
21Belemgbunli Dwɔlam zele kɛ, “Bɛva me konle ehwili ne bɛrɛlɛ me.” Ɔvole nu yɛɛ Dwuda Belemgbunli Ehazaya ɔdaye ɔvole ye ɛdeɛ ne anu na bɛzile nu bɛhɔyiale Gyihu. Bɛyiale ye wɔ Neebɔto mɔɔ vi Gyɛzɛlii la egyinli ne anloa. 22Dwɔlam bizale Gyihu kɛ, “Ɔle bɛtɛɛ ɔ?”
Na Gyihu buale ye kɛ, “Kɛ ɔsi ɔyɛ bɛtɛɛ ɛ, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛ nli Gyɛzɛbɛle ɛva ye ayɛne nee awozonle ɛzonlenlɛ nu tuutuulilɛ ɛbɛla ɛyɛ maanle ye totɔɔ zɛhae la?”
23Dwɔlam deanle nu, “Ehazaya! Maamɔvo ɛbɛla a le ɛhye.” Na ɛkɛ ne ala ɔhakyile ye ehwili ne anye kɛ ɔnriandi yeahɔ. 24Na Gyihu vale ye anwosesebɛ hwenle ye ɛda ne anu dole wɔle Dwɔlam. Ɛda ne liele ye kutue bo na ɔhanle ye ahonle. Dwɔlam golole guale ye ehwili ne anu. 25Gyihu zele ye boavolɛ Bedekaa kɛ, “Kɔvuandi ye to Neebɔto azɛlɛ ne azo. Ɛkakye mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma hanle tiale ɔ ze Ehabe la. Mekɛ ne anu ɛnee yɛ mu nwiɔ yɛ nee ye a lua a. Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Ehabe kɛ, 26 ‘Anoma ɛmanle menwunle Neebɔto nee ɔ mra mogya, yemɔti mebadea wɔ wɔ azɛlɛ ɛhye ala azo.’ Zɔhane ati bɛmaa ye zo bɛhɔdo ye azɛlɛ ne azo, kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma hanle ala la.”
Bɛhu Dwuda Belemgbunli Ehazaya
27Dwuda Belemgbunli Ehazaya nwunle ye zɛhae la ɔnriandile na ɔvale ɔ ti ɔbɔle Bɛte Heegan. Gyihu kpole ye na ɔ sa hanle ye wɔ Gɛɛ Boka ne anye anwo na ɔhanle kɛ, “Bɛhu ɔdaye.” Na bɛdole ye ɛda bɛhunle ye wɔ ye konle ehwili ne anu. Gɛɛ Boka ne bikye Yebelɛyam suazo. Ehazaya nriandile hɔle Mɛgedo na ɛkɛ ne yɛɛ ɔwule a. 28Ye mgbanyima ne vale ye funli ne dole ehwili nu hɔle Gyɛlusalɛm na bɛhɔdole ye wɔ ɔ nlenya anwo ɛkɛ wɔ Devidi suakpole zo. 29Ehazaya kali Dwuda ebia ne la ɛnee Dwɔlam ɛli ɛvolɛ bulu nee ko wɔ Yizilayɛ ebia ne azo.
Bɛhu Belemgbunli Raalɛ Gyɛzɛbɛle
30Gyihu rale Gyɛzɛlii. Ɛnee Gyɛzɛbɛle ɛde mɔɔ ɛzi la ati ɔdole ɔ nye anzi na ɔyɛle ɔ ti kɛnlɛma bie na ɔ nye gyi nvɛnzɛlɛ ne anu ɔlɛnea gua ne azo lɔ. 31Gyihu dwule anuhɔlɛ ɛkɛ ne ala la, ɔbizale ye kɛ, “Gyihu maamɔvo, kɔdiawu mɔɔ ɔbɔ ye ɛbɛla kɛ Zemelae mɔɔ ɔku ɔ menle a! Ɛrale ye anzonudwolɛ nu ɔ?”
32Gyihu manle ɔ ti zo nleanle ye wɔ nvɛnzɛlɛ ne anu na ɔbizale kɛ, “Nwane mɔ a wɔ me nzi a?” Ɛkɛ ne ala suakunlu ɛkɛ ne sonvolɛma nwiɔ anzɛɛ nsa wulale bɛ ti nvɛnzɛlɛ ne mɔ ko anu nleanle Gyihu anyunlu. 33Gyihu zele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛvuandi raalɛ ne bɛde ye aze.” Na amgba noko bɛvuandinle ye bɛdele ye aze. Ɔkpukele na ye mogya bɔle guale bane ne nee mgbɔnwɔ ne mɔ anwo, na bɛtietiale ɔ nwo zo 34bɛhɔle sua nu ɛkɛ. Gyihu hɔlile debie na ɔnlonle na akee ɔzele kɛ, “Bɛnlea bɛye raalɛ musuɔfoɔ ne bɛhɔzie ye, ɔluakɛ ɔle belemgbunli ra.” 35Bɛhɔle bɛkava ye bɛahɔzie ye la bɛannwu ɛhwee kɛ ɔ ti kanrɛlɛ ne, ɔ gyakɛ yɛɛ ɔ sa adaakɛ ne mɔ ala. 36 Bɛziale bɛrabɔle Gyihu amaneɛ na ɔzele kɛ, “Ɛdɛnkɛma a luale ye sonvolɛ Yilaegya anwo zo hanle dole ɛkɛ a. Ɔse, ‘Ahwea bali Gyɛzɛbɛle nwonane wɔ Gyɛzɛlii suazo, 37na Gyɛzɛbɛle funli bayɛ kɛ ewula la wɔ Gyɛzɛlii guabile zo, amaa awie annwu ye sonla holɛ na yeaze kɛ, Gyɛzɛbɛle a la ɛke la.’ ”

Title: 2 ARL 10
Content:
Bɛhu Ehabe abo zo amra amuala
1Ehabe abo zo amra mɔɔ wɔ Samɛlea la le abulasuu. Yemɔti Gyihu hɛlɛle ngɛlata hɔmanle menli mɔɔ nea Samɛlea suakpole ne la mgbanyima nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ Ehabe abo zo amra ne bie mɔ nee bɛ de la kɛ 2“Saa bɛ sa ka kɛlata ne a ɛnee kɛmɔ bɛmɛ a bɛnea Ehabe abo zo amra ne anwo zo na eza bɛlɛ konle ehwili, mgbɔnwɔ, konle ninyɛne nee aranemgbole la 3bɛbɔ mɔdenle ala bɛnlea bɛye nuhua ko mɔɔ bɛdabɛ bɛkulo ye la bɛzie ye belemgbunli na akee bɛho bɛlie ɔ ti.”
4Ɛzulolɛ hanle Samɛlea mgbanyima na bɛhanle kɛ, “Arelemgbunli mgbole nwiɔ bɔbɔ angola Gyihu anyunlu gyinla na yɛmɛ.” 5Yemɔti kpanyinli ne mɔɔ nea belemgbunli awuke ne azo, mgbanyima ne mɔ yɛɛ menli mɔɔ nea Ehabe abo zo amra ne la bɔle nu zoanle manle bɛhɔzele Gyihu kɛ, “Yɛwɔ ɛ bo, yemɔti yɛbayɛ debie biala mɔɔ ɛkɛze yɛ la. Yɛnrɛzie awie biala belemgbunli, yɛ mɔɔ ɛdawɔ ɛnea a ɔle kpalɛ la.”
6Gyihu eza hɛlɛle bɛ bieko na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Saa bɛgyi me nzi na bɛyɛ bɛ adwenle kɛ bɛkɛli mɔɔ menwɔha la azo a, ɛnee ɛhyema bekezɛ ala, bɛva Ehabe abo zo amra ne mɔ adile bɛrɛlɛ me wɔ Gyɛzɛlii ɛke.”
Ehabe abo zo amra abulasuu ne wɔ mgbanyima mɔɔ wɔ sua ne azo la asa anu, bɛlɛtete bɛ. 7Mɔɔ bɛ sa hanle Gyihu kɛlata ne wɔ Samɛlea la, mgbanyima ne mɔ hunle Ehabe abo zo amra abulasuu ne amuala, bɛvale bɛ adile ne mɔ bɛguale ahɛndɛne nu na bɛvale bɛhɔmanle Gyihu wɔ Gyɛzɛlii.
8Mɔɔ bɛhanle bɛhilele Gyihu kɛ bɛva Ehabe abo zo amra ne mɔ adile bɛra la, ɔzele kɛ bɛhuohua bɛ edukue nwiɔ wɔ suakpole ne anlenkɛ kpole ne anloa na bɛgyakyi bɛ ɛkɛ bɛmaa aleɛ ɛhye zo. 9Aleɛ hyenle nwonlomɔ la Gyihu hɔle anlenkɛ kpole ne anloa na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Mame yɛɛ mengyehyɛle mengunle Belemgbunli Dwɔlam a. Bɛnli nwolɛ ɛzonle; medame a medi nwolɛ ɛzonle a. Na ɛhye mɔ noko nwane a hunle bɛ a? 10Ɛhye kile kɛ, edwɛkɛ biala mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma hanle wɔ Ehabe nee ɔ bo zo amra anwo la bayɛ nɔhalɛ. Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛyɛ mɔɔ ɔluale ye kpɔmanvolɛ Yilaegya anwo zo ɔhanle la.” 11 Akee Gyihu hunle Ehabe abo zo amra mɔɔ wɔ Gyɛzɛlii la amuala, ye sonvolɛma, ɔ gɔnwo mɔ, yɛɛ ye sɛlɛvolɛma. Ko bɔbɔ, bɛangyakyi ye.
Bɛhu Belemgbunli Ehazaya anwo amra
12Kenle ko Gyihu vile Gyɛzɛlii kɛ ɔkɔ Samɛlea. Ɔlua adenle zo la ɔradwule ɛleka bie mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye, “Mboaneneavolɛma Azokoɛleɛ” la, 13na ɔyiale Dwuda Belemgbunli Ehazaya anwo amra bie mɔ na ɔbizale bɛ kɛ, “Bɛmɛ a le nwane mɔ?”
Bɛbuale ye kɛ, “Yɛle Ehazaya anwo amra. Yɛkɔ Gyɛzɛlii yɛahɔyɛ Belemgbunli Raalɛ Gyɛzɛbɛle anwo amra nee ye mbusua ne gyakɔ.” 14Gyihu zele ye ɛlɔnema mɔɔ ɔ nee bɛ lua la kɛ, “Bɛhye bɛ.” Bɛhyele bɛ na bɛ nee bɛ hɔle kuma bie mɔɔ zua azokoɛleɛ ne la anloa bɛhɔhunle bɛ muala. Bɛlua menli abulanla nee nwiɔ. Bɛangyakyi ko bɔbɔ.
Bɛhu Ehabe anwo amra mɔɔ ɛha la amuala
15Gyihu zile nu bieko kɛ ɔkɔ. Ɔlua adenle zo la Rilikabe ara Dwɔnadabe rayiale ye. Gyihu bizale ye ahye na ɔzele ye kɛ, “Wɔmɔ, yɛ mu nwiɔ yɛ adwenle le ko. Ɛkɛgyinla me nzi ɔ?”
Dwɔnadabe buale kɛ, “Ɛhɛe, megyi ɛ nzi.”
Gyihu zele ye kɛ, “Saa ɔle zɔ a ɛnee soma me sa nu ɛ!”
Bɛzomanle bɛ sa nu na Gyihu manle ɔravole ye ehwili ne anu. 16Na ɔzele ye kɛ, “Bɛla maa yɛhɔ na nea kɛ mezi meva me nwo amuala memaa Ɛdɛnkɛma la.” Na bɛ mu nwiɔ bɛdɛnlanle ehwili ne anu bɛhɔle Samɛlea. 17Bɛdwule ɛkɛ ne la, Gyihu hunle Ehabe anwo amra ne mɔɔ hale la amuala; yeangyakyi ko bɔbɔ. Ɛhye yɛɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma hanle hilele Yilaegya kɛ ɔbazi a.
Bɛhu bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsonle Beeyale la amuala
18Akee Gyihu vɛlɛle Samɛlea ezuavolɛ ne manle bɛyiale na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Belemgbunli Ehabe zonlenle bozonle Beeyale ekyii bie, na mame Gyihu, mebazonle ye kpole kpalɛ. 19Zɔhane ati bɛvɛlɛvɛlɛ Beeyale ahɔmenle ne mɔ, bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsonle ye la kɔsɔɔti nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛye ngonyia la amuala, bɛmmamaa bie ka amozi, ɔluakɛ melɛ azu kpole bie mebɔ memaa Beeyale. Mɔɔ kɛva ɔ nwo kɛvea la bɛkɛhu ye.” (Gyihu vale nrɛlɛbɛ dole nwolɛ yɛle amaa ɔ sa aha bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsonle bozonle Beeyale la na yeahu bɛ.) 20Akee Gyihu zele kɛ, “Bɛhile kenle bɛmaa yɛzonle Beeyale yɛli ye eni.” Bɛbɔle edwɛkɛ ne nolo. 21Gyihu manle bɛvale nrɛlaleɛ ne bɛhɔle Yizilayɛ maanle ne anu amuala na bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsonle Beeyale la amuala anloa yiale. Biala fee anga amozi. Bɛ muala bɛhɔle Beeyale bozonle sua ne anu bɛmanle sua ne yile, ɔvi ɔ ti ɔhɔdwule ɔ bo. 22Akee ɔzele ahenle mɔɔ nea adɛladeɛ ne mɔ azo la kɛ ɔva adɛladeɛ ne mɔ ɔvinde na ɔhyɛ ɔmaa menli mɔɔ ɛra bazonle bozonle ne la. Yemɔti bɛvale adɛladeɛ ne bɛrɛlɛle menli ne. 23Akee Gyihu nee Dwɔnadabe wolole sua ne anu. Ɔzele menli mɔɔ ɛra bazonle Beeyale la kɛ, “Bɛnleɛnlea nuhua saa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsonle Ɛdɛnkɛma la bie wɔ yɛ avinli a. Bɛmaa ɔha yɛdayɛ mɔɔ yɛsonle bozonle Beeyale la angome.” 24Akee Gyihu hɔle kɛ ɔkabɔ azu ne na yeayela nane ne yeamaa Beeyale. Mekɛ ne anu ɛnee yemaa menli abulatwɛ ɛzia na yeze bɛ kɛ, “Ɛdawɔ mɔɔ ɛkɛmaa menli mɔɔ meva bɛ mewula bɛ sa nu la bie kɛvi ɛsalɛ la bɛbahu wɔ.”
25Mɔɔ Gyihu vale nane ne mɔɔ bɛyela ye bɛabɔ azu bɛamaa Beeyale la manle bɛ wiele la, ɔvindele na ɔrazele menli mɔɔ ɛzia la kɛ, “Bɛhɔ nuhua bɛhɔhu awie biala mɔɔ wɔ ɛkɛ ne la. Bɛmmamaa ko bɔbɔ fi ɛsalɛ.” Ɛkɛ ne ala ɛlɔnema ne wolole bozonle sua ne anu na bɛhunle awie biala mɔɔ wɔ ɛkɛ ne la na bɛhwenlenle bɛ avunli aze bɛvindele. Akee bɛwolole bɛhɔle ɛleka mɔɔ bozonle ne ananze ne wɔ la, 26na bɛdule sika ne mɔɔ bɛkpɔnla ye ɛkɛ ne la bɛvindele bɛrayelale ye. 27Yemɔti bɛyelale Beeyale sika ne, bɛyelale ye bozonle sua ne na bɛvale ɛkɛ ne bɛyɛle ɛfo. Ɛnɛ bɔbɔ ala ɔtɛde zɔhane.
28Ɛnee kɛ Gyihu yɛle mɔɔ ɔholale ɔdule Beeyale ɛzonlenlɛ bo wɔ Yizilayɛ maanle nu la ɛne. 29 Noko Gyihu andwe ɔ nwo anvi Gyɛlɔbowam ninyɛndane ne mɔ anwo. Ɔdaye noko ɔmanle Yizilayɛma zonlenle nlankɛ ananze mɔɔ bɛva ezukoa nvutuke bɛyɛ la, kɛmɔ Gyɛlɔbowam yɛle wɔ Bɛtɛle nee Dan la. 30Na Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Gyihu kɛ, “Kɛmɔ wɔyɛ mɔɔ sɔ me nye na wɔyɛ Ehabe sua nu amra, kɛmɔ mekpondɛ la ati, mebɔ wɔ ɛwɔkɛ kɛ ɛ bo zo amra bali Yizilayɛ ebia ne bie toonwo yeahɔdwu awolɛndoazo nna ne azo.” 31Noko Gyihu annea ɔ nwo boɛ, yeanli Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne mɛla ne azo nɔhalɛ nu, yeangyakyi ɛtane ne mɔ mɔɔ Gyɛlɔbowam yɛle a ɔmanle Yizilayɛma yɛle ɛtane la anzi ɛlilɛ.
Gyihu Ewule
32Mekɛ ne anu Ɛdɛnkɛma bɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɔpɛ Yizilayɛ azɛlɛ ne foa ko yeagua. Selea Belemgbunli Hazeeyɛle honle vale Yizilayɛ maanle ne, 33ɔbɔle ye Dwɔdan aduduleɛ afoa nu ɔvale Geleade nee Beehyan azɛlɛ ne amuala, ɔdwule Alowɛ wɔ Azule Annɔn ne anloa. Azɛlɛ ɛhye azo a Gade, Wulubɛn nee Manasɛ Aduduleɛ mbusua ekpunli ne mɔ de a. 34Akee gyima mɔɔ hale mɔɔ Gyihu yɛle nee ye nyɛleɛ ne amuala, bɛhɛlɛ bɛ wɔ Yizilayɛ Arelemgbunli Tetedwɛkɛ Mbuluku ne mɔ anu. 35Belemgbunli Gyihu hɔle ayile nu na bɛwulale ye mrɛlatɛlɛ nu wɔ Samɛlea. Ɔ ra Gyɛhowahaze a lile ebia ne a. 36Gyihu lile Yizilayɛ belemgbunli ɛvolɛ abulanwiɔ nee mɔtwɛ. Ɔdɛnlanle Samɛlea a ɔlile ebia ne a.

Title: 2 ARL 11
Content:
Dwuda Belemgbunli Raalɛ Atalaya
(2 Edk 22.10—23.15)
1Dwuda Belemgbunli Raalɛ Atalaya dele kɛ bɛhu ɔ ra Ehazaya la, ɔmanle bɛhunle belemgbunli ne anwo amra kɔsɔɔti. 2Ehazaya ara nrenya ekyi ko ala a vile nu a. Yemɔ a le Dwowahye. Ehazaya adiema raalɛ Gyihɔhyɛba a vale kakula ne veale a. Gyihɔhyɛba ɔ ze a le Belemgbunli Gyɛhɔlam. Ɔvale kakula Dwowahye nee ahenle mɔɔ nea ye la ɔveale Ɛzonlenlɛ sua ne ekpumgbunli ne mɔ ko anu na ɔdaye ɔnleanle bɛ. Yemɔti Atalaya asa anga ye angu ye. 3Gyihɔhyɛba nleanle kakula ne ɛvolɛ nsia wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee ɔvea Ɛzonlenlɛ sua ne anu la. Mekɛ ne anu ɛnee Atalaya a ɛlɛdi belemgbunli wɔ Dwuda a.
4Ehazaya wule la, ye ɛvolɛ nsuu ne azo, sɛlɛvolɛ Gyɛhɔyada zoanle manle bɛhɔvale belemgbunli sinzavolɛma, nee belemgbunli sua nu sinzavolɛma ne mɔ bɛrale Ɛzonlenlɛ sua ne anu. Ɔ nee bɛ yɛle ngyehyɛlɛ na ɔmanle bɛlile amonle bɛhyele ɔ bo wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu, na akee ɔvale Belemgbunli Ehazaya ara nrenya Dwowahye ɔhilele bɛ, 5na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Mɔɔ mekpondɛ kɛ bɛyɛ la ɛne: Bɛhyɛ bɛ nuhua ekpunli nsa. Ekpunli ko ne mɔɔ bara gyima Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ne la ɛhyɛ bɛ nwo nsa. Ko ɛzinza belemgbunli sua nu ɛkɛ, 6ko ɛhɔzinza Sɛɛ Anlenkɛ Kpole ne, na ko ne mɔɔ kɛha la ɛgyinla sinzavolɛma ne anzi wɔ anuhɔlɛ kpole ne anloa. 7Ekpunli nwiɔ ne mɔɔ ɛmba gyima Ɛnwomenlelielɛ kenle ne la bahɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu ahɔzinza belemgbunli ne. 8Bɛzinza Belemgbunli Dwowahye kpalɛ kpalɛ. Bɛhwe bɛ dadeɛ ne mɔ na ɛleka biala mɔɔ ɔkɔ la bɛli ɔ nzi. Awie biala mɔɔ kɛze kɛ ɔba bɛ nwo ɛkɛ ne la, bɛhu ye.”
9Safohyenlema ne yɛle tieyɛ manle Sɛlɛvolɛ Gyɛhɔyada na bɛvale bɛ ɛlɔnema ne bɛrale, bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle gyima nu Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ne nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ gyima nu la amuala. 10Sɛlɛvolɛ ne vale Belemgbunli Devidi atwɛ ne mɔ nee bɛ sa nu enyinlike ne mɔ manle bɛ. Ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ ɛnee wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu. 11Akee ɔmanle sinzavolɛma ne hwenle bɛ dadeɛ ne mɔ na bɛgyinlanle ketee wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne sɔlɔ nee nyiakɛ nee azukponle ne anwo kɛ bɛsinza belemgbunli ne.
12Akee Gyɛhɔyada vale Dwowahye vindele, ɔzoale ye belemgbunli kyɛlɛ ne na ɔvale mɛla buluku ne mɔɔ maa ye belemgbunlililɛ ne di munli la ɔmanle ye. Akee bɛguale nwole wɔ Dwowahye ati zo na bɛziele ye belemgbunli. Menli ne bɔle bɛ sa nu na bɛdeanle nuhua kɛ, “Belemgbunli ɛnyi ɛhyɛ!”
13Belemgbunli Raalɛ Atalaya dele sinzavolɛma ne nee menli ne alɛra mɔɔ bɛlɛyɛ la, ɔhɔle menli ne mɔ anwo ɛkɛ wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu 14na ɔkamaa ɔ nye zo la, ɔnwunle kɛ belemgbunli fofolɛ gyi sua ne mpila ne mɔ ko anwo, kɛmɔ amaamuo ne se la. Safohyenlema ne nee menli mɔɔ bɔ aweɛne ndendenle ne mɔ la gyigyi ɔ nwo ɛkɛ, na menli ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti anye ɛlie, na bɛlɛbɔ aweɛne zɛhae ala. Ɛkɛ ne ala Atalaya vale ɛya suosuanle ye tɛladeɛ mɔɔ ɔwula la anu na ɔdeanle nu kɛ, “Maamɔlɛ! Maamɔlɛ! Ɛhye le maamɔvo ɛbɛla.”
15Gyɛhɔyada angulo kɛ bɛkɛhu Atalaya wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ sua ne anu, yemɔti ɔzele safohyenlema ne mɔ kɛ, “Bɛva ye bɛlua sinzavolɛma ɛhonlone ne mɔ avinli bɛvinde, na awie biala mɔɔ kɛyɛ kɛ ɔbalie ye la, bɛhu ye.” 16Bɛhyele ye ɛkɛ ne ala bɛvale ye bɛluale Ɛkpɔnwɔ Anlenkɛ Kpole ne anu bɛhɔle suakunlu ɛkɛ ne na bɛhunle ye.
Gyɛhɔyada kakyihakyi ninyɛne
(2 Edk 23.16-21)
17Sɛlɛvolɛ Gyɛhɔyada manle Belemgbunli Dwowahye nee menli ne nee Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛle ngyehyɛlɛ na bɛkyekyele ɔ bo kɛ bɛkɛyɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɔdaye ye menli. Eza ɔmanle belemgbunli nee menli ne yɛle ngyekyeleɛ. 18Akee menli ne amuala hɔle Beeyale bozonle sua ne anwo na bɛbubule ye bɛguale. Bɛbubule ye azukponle ne nee ye ananze ne mɔ amuala na bɛhunle Beeyale kɔmenle Matan wɔ azukponle ne mɔ anyunlu.
Gyɛhɔyada vale sinzavolɛma manle bɛrazinzale Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne. 19Akee ɔdaye, safohyenlema ne, belemgbunli sinzavolɛma ne, yɛɛ suakunlu ɛkɛ ne sinzavolɛma ne lile belemgbunli ne anyunlu nee ye vi Ɛzonlenlɛ sua ne anu hɔle belemgbunli sua nu. Menli ne amuala doale bɛ. Dwowahye vale Sinzavolɛma Anlenkɛ Kpole ne anu a hɔdɛnlanle ye belemgbunli ebia ne anu a. 20Menli ne amuala anye liele. Bɛhunle Atalaya la, suakpole ne azo guale diinyi. Bɛhunle ye wɔ belemgbunli suakunlu ɛkɛ ne.
21Dwowahye kali belemgbunli la ɛnee yeli ɛvolɛ nsuu.

Title: 2 ARL 12
Content:
Dwuda Belemgbunli Dwowahye
(2 Edk 24.1-16)
1Gyihu dɛnlanle Yizilayɛ ebia ne azo ɛvolɛ nsuu la yɛɛ bɛvale Dwowahye bɛziele Dwuda belemgbunli a, na ɔdɛnlanle Gyɛlusalɛm ɛkɛ ne ɔlile ebia ne ɛvolɛ abulanla. Bɛfɛlɛ ɔ nli Zaebaya. Ɔvi Biyɛhyiba.
2Wɔ ye ɛbɛla ɛbɔlɛ nu ɔyɛle mɔɔ sɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anye la, ɔboalekɛ sɛlɛvolɛ Gyɛhɔyada hilehilele ye. 3Noko akee bɛanzɛkye awozonle ɛzonlenlɛ ɛleka ne mɔ; menli hɔle zo bɔle azu na bɛkpunle ɛyɛlɛ wɔ ɛleka zɔhane mɔ.
4 Kenle ko Dwowahye vɛlɛle sɛlɛvolɛma ne mɔ na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, anrɛɛ bɛzie ezukoa ne mɔɔ menli batua maa bɛbɔ azu, adwule mɔɔ menli ne tua ye dahudahu, nee ezukoa mɔɔ menli ne yeye bɛ ahonle nu fa kyɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma la bie. 5Sɛlɛvolɛ ko biala ɔdaye ɔbava ezukoa mɔɔ menli mɔɔ ɔnea bɛ nwo zo la kɛva kɛrɛlɛ ye la yeazie. Zɛhae ezukoa mɔɔ bɛbazie la, yemɔ yɛɛ bɛbava bɛayɛ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne ɛleka mɔɔ kɛzɛkye la boɛ a.
6Noko mɔɔ Dwowahye lile ɛvolɛ abulanwiɔ nee nsa wɔ ebia ne azo la ɛnee sɛlɛvolɛma ne ɛtɛyɛle Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anwo gyima biala. 7Yemɔti ɔvɛlɛle sɛlɛvolɛ Gyɛhɔyada nee sɛlɛvolɛma mɔɔ ɛha la, na ɔbizale bɛ kɛ, “Duzu ati a bɛnyɛ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne boɛ a? Ɔvi ɛnɛ mɔɔ kɔ la, bɛ biala ɛnzie ezukoa mɔɔ kɛrali ɔ sa nu la bieko. Bɛva bɛrɛla amaa bɛava bɛayɛ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne ɛleka mɔɔ ɛlɛsɛkye la boɛ.” 8Sɛlɛvolɛma ne kponlenle ɛhye azo na eza bɛliele bɛdole nu kɛ tɛ bɛmɛ a ɔwɔ kɛ bɛyɛ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne boɛ a.
9Zɔhane ati sɛlɛvolɛ Gyɛhɔyada bobɔle ɛlɛka, ɔfitile ɔ ti zo na ɔvale ɔziele azukponle ne anwo mɔɔ kɛ ɛwolo Sua ne anu ala la ɛnee ɔgyi fema zo ɛkɛ. Sɛlɛvolɛma mɔɔ kɛrayɛ gyima wɔ nlenkɛ ne mɔ anloa la fa ezukoa biala mɔɔ bɛkɛnyia ye wɔ menli mɔɔ rale ɛzonlenlɛ la lɔ la gua ɛlɛka ne anu. 10Saa ezukoa ne so ɛlɛka ne anu a, ɛnee belemgbunli kɛlɛhɛlɛvolɛ ne nee Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli ne banea maa bɛtia bɛwulowula ye ahodoku nu. 11Bɛwie a bɛkɛlɛ mɔɔ bɛnyianle la bɛwula buluku nu na bɛfa ezukoa ne bɛmaa sonla ne mɔɔ nea Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne gyima zo la, yɛɛ ɔdaye noko ɔfa ɔtua kapentama, menli mɔɔ si sua la, 12menli mɔɔ gua belekese nee menli mɔɔ kpukekpuke awolɛ la kakɛ a. Ɔfa bie ɔtɔ mbaka mgbole nee awolɛ mɔɔ bɛfa bɛayɛ sua ne boɛ la na ɔtua sua ne anwo kakɛ biala. 13Bɛnva ezukoa ne bie bɛndua dwɛtɛ fufule ahɔpo, ahyɛnze kuloonwu, aweɛne anzɛɛ ahɛnlaneɛ nwo ninyɛne, anzɛɛ debie biala mɔɔ bɛva dwɛtɛ fufule anzɛɛ ezukoa nvutuke bɛyɛ la kakɛ. 14Bɛvale ye kpokpoti bɛduale sua ne gyimayɛvoma nee ninyɛne mɔɔ bɛkɛdɔ kɛ bɛfa bɛayɛ sua ne boɛ la kakɛ. 15 Menli mɔɔ nea gyima ne azo la lile nɔhalɛ kpalɛ manle ɔrale kɛ ɛnee ɔngyia bɔbɔ kɛ awie kɛvɛlɛ bɛ kɛ bɛrabu mgbonda. 16 Ezukoa mɔɔ bɛkɛva bɛkɛdua azubɔdeɛ kakɛ, anzɛɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛva bɛkɛyɛ ɛtane nwo azubɔdeɛ la, yemɔ bɛnva bɛmba Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu. Ɔle sɛlɛvolɛma ne mɔ ɛdeɛ.
17Mekɛ ne anu Selea Belemgbunli Hazeeyɛle vale konle doale suakpole Gate azo amra na ɔlile bɛ nwo zo konim. Ɔyɛle ye adwenle kɛ ɔkateta Gyɛlusalɛmma noko. 18Na Dwuda Belemgbunli Dwowahye sesale azubɔlɛ ninyɛne mɔɔ ɔ nlenya mɔ, Gyɛhɔhyafate, Gyɛhɔlam nee ɔ ze Ehazaya ɛboɔboa bɛ nloa ɛva ɛzie ɛkɛ ɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma, yɛɛ ɔdaye Dwowahye ye azubɔlɛ ninyɛne, ezukoa nvutuke mɔɔ wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne nee belemgbunli suakunlu ɛkɛ ne gya nu la amuala kɔsɔɔti manle bɛhɔmanle Belemgbunli Hazeeyɛle, na Belemgbunli Hazeeyɛle vale ye ɛlɔnema ne vile Gyɛlusalɛm hɔle.
19Debie biala mɔɔ Belemgbunli Dwowahye yɛle la bɛhɛlɛ bɛ wɔ Dwuda Arelemgbunli Tetedwɛkɛ Mbuluku ne mɔ anu.
20-21Belemgbunli Dwowahye safohyenlema ne hɔle ɔ ti akpamo, na nuhua nwiɔ, Hyemɛyate ara Dwozaka yɛɛ Hyomɛ ara Gyɛhozabade, hyele ye hunle ye wɔ sua bie mɔɔ gyi kuma ne mɔɔ bɛduale ye wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm aduduleɛ la azo la anwo wɔ Sela adenle zo. Na bɛziele ye wɔ arelemgbunli azie ne mɔɔ wɔ Devidi Suakpole zo la azo. Ɔ ra Amazaya a lile ebia ne a.

Title: 2 ARL 13
Content:
Yizilayɛ Belemgbunli Gyɛhowahaze
1Belemgbunli Dwowahye lile ɛvolɛ abulanwiɔ nee nsa wɔ Dwuda ebia ne azo la yɛɛ Gyihu ara Gyɛhowahaze bɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɔdi belemgbunli wɔ Yizilayɛ a. Ɔdɛnlanle Samɛlea a ɔlile belemgbunli ne a, yɛɛ ɔlile belemgbunli ɛvolɛ bulu nee nsuu. 2Ɔyɛle ɛtane ɔtiale Ɛdɛnkɛma. Ɔvale Nibate ara Gyɛlɔbowam agyakɛ na ɔmanle Yizilayɛma kɔsɔɔti yɛle ɛtane. Yeangyakyi ye ninyɛndane ne ɛyɛlɛ. 3Ɛdɛnkɛma vale Yizilayɛma anwo ɛya, ɔlua zo ɔyele bɛ ɔmanle Selea Belemgbunli Hazeeyɛle nee ɔ ra Bɛneheedade manle bɛlile bɛ nwo zo konim wɔ mekɛ biala mɔɔ bɛkɛnyia konle la. 4Nzinlii Gyɛhowahaze zunle vɛlɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma, na ɔdiele ye, ɔboalekɛ ɛnee akee Seleama ɛlɛsisi Yizilayɛma somaa. 5Ɛdɛnkɛma manle Yizilayɛma nyianle awie lile bɛ ti na bɛhonle bɛliele bɛ nwo bɛvile Seleama asa anu. Yemɔti akee Yizilayɛma anzo nu dwole bɛ kɛ dɛba ne la. 6Noko bɛangyakyi ɛtane ne mɔ mɔɔ Gyɛlɔbowam manle Yizilayɛma yɛle la ɛyɛlɛ, na bɛhɔle zolɛ bɛbɔle zɔhane ɛbɛla ne mɔ; yɛɛ bɛ bozonle raalɛ Ahyela ananze ne noko woale Samɛlea.
7Ɛnee Gyɛhowahaze ɛnlɛ ɛlɔnema mɔɔ ko maa ye kɛ ɛlɔnema mɔɔ tɛnla mgbɔnwɔ zo ko la abulanlu, menli mɔɔ fa ehwili ko la bulu yɛɛ ɛlɔnema mɔɔ dua aze la apenle bulu ala. Ɔboalekɛ ɛnee Seleama ɛhu Yizilayɛ ɛlɔnema ne amuala; bɛdinle bɛ kɛ sianlɛ.
8Bɛhɛlɛ nyɛleɛ mɔɔ Belemgbunli Gyɛhowahaze yɛle, ninyɛne mɔɔ ɔyɛle, nee ye akɛnrasesebɛ mɔɔ ɔyɛle la amuala wɔ Yizilayɛ Arelemgbunli Tetedwɛkɛ Mbuluku ne mɔ anu. 9Ɔhɔle ayile nu na bɛwulale ye mrɛlatɛlɛ nu wɔ Samɛlea. Ɔ ra Gyɛhowahye lile ebia ne ziele Yizilayɛma.
Yizilayɛ Belemgbunli Gyɛhowahye
10Belemgbunli Dwowahye lile ɛvolɛ abulasa nee nsuu wɔ Dwuda ebia ne azo la yɛɛ Gyɛhowahaze ara Gyɛhowahye bɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɔdi belemgbunli wɔ Yizilayɛ a. Ɔdɛnlanle Samɛlea a ɔlile belemgbunli ne a na ɔlile ebia ne ɛvolɛ bulu nee nsia. 11Ɔdaye noko ɔyɛle ɛtane ɔtiale Ɛdɛnkɛma. Yeandwe ɔ nwo yeanvi Belemgbunli Gyɛlɔbowam nyɛleɛ ɛtane ne mɔ mɔɔ vale Yizilayɛma hɔle munzule nu la anwo. 12Debie biala mɔɔ Belemgbunli Gyɛhowahye yɛle nee ye anwosesebɛ mɔɔ ɔhilele wɔ Yizilayɛma nee Dwuda Belemgbunli Amazaya bɛ konle ne anu la, bɛhɛlɛ bɛ kɔsɔɔti wɔ Yizilayɛ Arelemgbunli Tetedwɛkɛ Mbuluku ne mɔ anu.
13Gyɛhowahye hɔle ayile nu na bɛwulale ye mrɛlatɛlɛ nu wɔ Samɛlea alehelɛ alaleɛ ne na ɔ ra Gyɛlɔbowam a lile Yizilayɛ ebia ne a, na bɛvɛlɛle ye Gyɛlɔbowam mɔɔ tɔ zo nwiɔ.
Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ Yilaehya ewule
14 Anwonyane mɔɔ rale Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ Yilaehya ɛhunlɛ la bɔle ye. Na mɔɔ ɔla anwonyane ne anu la, Yizilayɛ Belemgbunli Gyɛhowahye rakpɔlale ye. Ɔnwunle Yilaehya la ɔzunle na ɔzele kɛ, “O egya, egya! Yizilayɛ konle ehwili ne nee menli mɔɔ ka mgbɔnwɔ ne mɔ la, bɛmɛ ɛhye o!”
15Yilaehya zele ye kɛ, “Fa ɛda nee nwolɛ mbaka bɛla.” Gyɛhowahye vale rale. 16Yilaehya zele ye kɛ, “Sua wɔ ɛda ne.” Na Gyɛhowahye zuale ɛda ne. Yilaehya vale ɔ sa guale belemgbunli ne asa azo. 17Akee ɔzele ye kɛ, “Buke nvɛnzɛlɛ ne mɔɔ di kɔ aduduleɛ la.” Belemgbunli ne dukuele nvɛnzɛlɛ ne. Akee Yilaehya zele ye kɛ, “To wɔ ɛda ne.” Gyɛhowahye dole ɛda ne ala la Yilaehya deanle nu, “Wɔmɔ a ɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛda ne mɔɔ ɔbava yeali Seleama anwo zo konim la. Ɛ nee Selea baho wɔ Efɛke toonwo kɔkpula kɛ ɛkɛbɔ bɛ bo zo bɔkɔɔ la.”
18Akee Yilaehya zele belemgbunli ne kɛ, “Fula ɛda mbaka ne mɔ.” Na Gyɛhowahye vulale. Yilaehya zele belemgbunli ne kɛ, “Fa ɛda mbaka ne mɔ fi azɛlɛ nwo.” Na belemgbunli ne vale finle azɛlɛ nwo fane nsa na ɔgyakyile. 19Yilaehya vale ɔ nwo ɛya na ɔzele kɛ, “Anrɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ ɛfi ye aze fane nnu anzɛɛ nsia; anrɛɛ ɛnee wɔzɛkye Seleama wɔwie ala ɛne, mɔɔ bɛ bo zo ɔwɔ kɛ minli bɔkɔɔ a. Kɛkala ɛdeɛ, ɛbali Seleama anwo zo konim fane nsa ala.”
20Yilaehya wule na bɛziele ye.
Ɛvolɛ biala Mowabe ɛlɔnema ba Yizilayɛma anwo zo arɛlevilɛ nu wɔ nyenyensuo mekɛ. 21Kenle ko Yizilayɛma hɔle kazie nrenya bie mɔɔ ɛwu la, bɛnwunle kɛ Mowabe nwule ɛlɔnema ɛlɛba bɛ nwo zo. Yemɔti bɛvuandinle funli ne bɛdole Yilaehya nla ne anu na bɛnriandile bɛhɔle. Funli ne dɔle Yilaehya mbowule ne azo ala la ɔdunwuele na ɔdwazole ɔgyinlanle.
Yizilayɛma nee Seleama konle ne
22Selea Belemgbunli Hazeeyɛle di ye belemgbunli ne la ɔmanle Yizilayɛma anwo hyelele bɛ kpalɛ wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ Gyɛhowahaze a di belemgbunli wɔ Yizilayɛ la. 23Na Ɛdɛnkɛma nwunle bɛ anwunvɔne. Yeammaa adenle yeammaa bɛanzɛkye Yizilayɛma. Ɔboale bɛ, ɔboalekɛ ɔ nee Ebileham, Ayezeke nee Gyɛkɔbo lɛ ngyekyeleɛ. Yemɔti ɔ rɛle ɛtɛfile ye menli ne.
24Mɔɔ Selea Belemgbunli Hazeeyɛle wule la, ɔ ra Bɛneheedade a lile belemgbunli a. 25Na Yizilayɛ Belemgbunli Gyɛhowahye lile Bɛneheedade anwo zo konim fane nsa na ɔliele Yizilayɛ azuamgbole mɔɔ Seleama honle vale wɔ Belemgbunli Gyɛhowahaze mekɛ zo la. Gyɛhowahye ɔ ze a le Gyɛhowahaze.

Title: 2 ARL 14
Content:
Dwuda Belemgbunli Amazaya
(2 Edk 25.1-24)
1Mɔɔ Gyɛhowahaze ara Gyɛhowahye lile ɛvolɛ nwiɔ wɔ Yizilayɛ ebia ne azo la, yɛɛ Dwowahye ara Amazaya bɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɔdi belemgbunli wɔ Dwuda a. 2Amazaya bɔ ye belemgbunlililɛ ne abo la ɛnee yeli ɛvolɛ abulanwiɔ nee nnu, yɛɛ ɔlile ebia ne ɛvolɛ abulanwiɔ nee ngɔnla wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm. Ɔ nli a le Gyɛhowaden mɔɔ vi Gyɛlusalɛm la. 3Ɔyɛle mɔɔ sɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anye la, noko yeanwie ɔ nlenya Devidi agyakɛ fa. Ɔyɛle mɔɔ ɔ ze Dwowahye yɛle la bie. 4Yeanzɛkye ɛleka ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛsonle awozonle la, yemɔti ɛnee menli kpu ɛyɛlɛ bɔ azu wɔ ɛleka ɛleka zɔhane mɔ.
5Mɔɔ belemgbunli tumi ne amuala ralile ɔ sa nu la, Amazaya manle bɛhunle safohyenlema ne mɔɔ hunle ɔ ze la. 6 Noko akee yeangu bɛ mra ne mɔ, na ɔlile Ɛdɛnkɛma mɛla ne mɔɔ ɔvale ɔmanle Mosisi la azo. Mɛla ne se; “Ɔnle kɛ awovolɛma ɛtane ti bɛku mralɛ; yɛɛ ɔnle kɛ mralɛ ɛtane ti bɛku awovolɛma. Awie biala ɔdaye ɔwɔ kɛ di ye ɛtane mɔɔ ɔkɛyɛ la anwo ɛzonle.”
7Amazaya hunle Yidɔm ɛlɔnema apenle bulu wɔ Ngyenle Bɔnza. Eza ɔhonle ɔvale Selea suakpole ne na ɔhakyile sua ne duma ɔvɛlɛle ye Dwɔketii. Duma ɛhye ala a ɛnɛ nee ɛnɛ bɛtɛfa bɛtɛfɛlɛ suakpole ne a.
8Akee Amazaya zoanle manle bɛhɔzele Yizilayɛ Belemgbunli Gyɛhowahye kɛ, “Bɛla maa yɛ mu nwiɔ yɛva yɛ kɛnra yɛbɔ zo.” 9Na Belemgbunli Gyɛhowahye manle bɛvale mualɛ ɛhye bɛhɔmanle ye, “Kenle ko kolokolonyɛma bie mɔɔ wɔ Lɛbanɔn awoka zo la vale nrɛlaleɛ manle bɛhɔmanle sida baka bie kɛ, ‘Fa ɛ ra raalɛ ne maa memaa me ra nrenya ɛgya ye. Na Lɛbanɔn nane kpole bie ratietiale kolokolonyɛma ne azo.’ 10Akee tie, Amazaya, kɛmɔ wɔli Yidɔmma anwo zo konim la ati yɛɛ ɛlɛtu ɛ nloa anu a. Maa ɛ kunlu ɛdwo ɛ nyunlu mɔɔ wɔnyia ye la anwo na tɛnla wɔ ɛleka bie. Duzu ati a ɛtwehwe munzule wɔamaa ɛ nwo nee wɔ menli ne ɛ?”
11Noko Amazaya andie, yemɔti belemgbunli Gyɛhowahye vale ɛlɔnema nee bɛ hɔhonle wɔ Bɛte Hyimɛhye mɔɔ wɔ Dwuda la.
12Gyɛhowahye lile Dwudama anwo zo konim na Amazaya ɛlɔnema ne guale ɛbɔ nu; biala nriandile hɔle ye sua zo. 13Gyɛhowahye hyele Amazaya, na akee ɔhɔvole Gyɛlusalɛm, ɔbubule suakpole ne bane ne foa ko, ɔvi Yifelaem Anlenkɛ kpole ne anloa ɔhɔkpulale Muleɛ Anlenkɛ kpole ne anloa. Ye tendenle le kɛyɛ mita ɛya nwiɔ. 14Gyɛhowahye zoale dwɛtɛ fufule nee ezukoa nvutuke biala mɔɔ ɔ sa dɔle zo, Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu ninyɛne nee belemgbunli sua nu gya ne anu ninyɛne ne mɔ amuala hɔle Samɛlea. Eza ɔhyele menli ɔhɔle.
15Debie biala mɔɔ Gyɛhowahye yɛle, ye anwosesebɛ nee kɛ ɔzile ɔ nee Dwuda Belemgbunli Amazaya honle la, bɛhɛlɛ bɛ muala wɔ Yizilayɛ Arelemgbunli Tetedwɛkɛ Mbuluku ne mɔ anu. 16Belemgbunli Gyɛhowahye hɔle ayile nu na bɛwulale ye mrɛlatɛlɛ nu wɔ Samɛlea alehelɛ alaleɛ ne. Ɔ ra Gyɛlɔbowam a lile ebia ne a na bɛvɛlɛle ye Gyɛlɔbowam mɔɔ tɔ zo Nwiɔ.
Dwuda Belemgbunli Amazaya ewule
(2 Edk 25.25-28)
17Yizilayɛ Belemgbunli Gyɛhowahye hakyile ɔ nwo la, ye ɛvolɛ bulu nee nnu anzi ɛnee Dwuda Belemgbunli Amazaya tɛdi ye ebia ne. 18Debie biala mɔɔ Amazaya yɛle la bɛhɛlɛ bɛ muala wɔ Dwuda Arelemgbunli Tetedwɛkɛ Mbuluku ne mɔ anu.
19Menli bie wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm, bɛhɔle Belemgbunli Amazaya ati akpamo kɛ bɛku ye. Amazaya dele nwolɛ bie na ɔnriandile ɔhɔle Leekehye. Noko ye kpɔvolɛma ne doale ye lɔ hɔhunle ye. 20Bɛvale ye funli ne bɛdole ɛkpɔnwɔ zo bɛrale Gyɛlusalɛm na bɛziele ye wɔ ɔ nlenya mɔ anwo ɛkɛ wɔ Devidi Suakpole zo. 21Akee Dwudama vale ɔ ra Yuzaya mɔɔ ɛnee ɛli ɛvolɛ bulu nee nsia la ziele Dwuda belemgbunli. 22Yuzaya nee Yilatema honle, ɔvale sua ne na ɔkyekyele ye fofolɛ. Ɛhye zile mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee ɔ ze ɛwu la.
Yizilayɛ Belemgbunli Gyɛlɔbowam mɔɔ tɔ zo nwiɔ
23Amazaya lile ɛvolɛ bulu nee nnu wɔ Dwuda ebia ne azo la yɛɛ bɛvale Gyɛhowahye ara Gyɛlɔbowam bɛziele Yizilayɛ belemgbunli wɔ Samɛlea a. Ɔlile ebia ne ɛvolɛ abulanla nee ko. 24Ɔyɛle ɛtane ɔtiale Ɛdɛnkɛma; ɔvale ɔ nlenya Gyɛlɔbowam agyakɛ. Ɔyɛle ninyɛndane ne mɔɔ ɔ nlenya yɛle a ɔmanle Yizilayɛma kɔsɔɔti yɛle ɛtane la bie. 25Ɔhonle ɔliele azuamgbole mɔɔ Yizilayɛma minlinle bɛ wɔ konle nu la amuala; ɔvi Heemate Ademgbolezo mɔɔ wɔ sɔlɔ toonwo kɔdwu Nyevile Wulera ne anloa wɔ nyiakɛ nehane. Ɛhye a Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne luale ye kpɔmanvolɛ Dwona, Ametae ara ne anwo zo hanle wɔ Gate Hifa la.
26Ɛdɛnkɛma nwunle kɛ Yizilayɛma anzosesebɛ ɛmaa bɛlɛnwu amaneɛ kpole, yɛɛ awie ɛnle ɛkɛ mɔɔ ɔboa bɛ a. 27Noko ɛnee ɔnle Ɛdɛnkɛma adwenle nu kɛ ɔbɔ bɛ bo zo yeazɛkye bɛ bɔkɔɔ, yemɔti ɔluale Belemgbunli Gyɛlɔbowam mɔɔ tɔ zo Nwiɔ la anwo zo ɔliele bɛ.
28Debie biala mɔɔ Gyɛlɔbowam mɔɔ tɔ zo Nwiɔ la yɛle, ye anwosesebɛ wɔ konle nu, nee kɛ ɔzile ɔliele Dɛmasekɛse mɔɔ kɔkpula Heemate mɔɔ wɔ Yizilayɛ la, bɛhɛlɛ bɛ kɔsɔɔti wɔ Yizilayɛ Arelemgbunli Tetedwɛkɛ Mbuluku ne mɔ anu. 29Belemgbunli Gyɛlɔbowam mɔɔ tɔ zo Nwiɔ la hɔle ayile nu na bɛwulale ye mrɛlatɛlɛ nu wɔ Yizilayɛ arelemgbunli alaleɛ ne. Ɔ ra Zɛkalaya lile ebia ne.

Title: 2 ARL 15
Content:
Dwuda Belemgbunli Yuzaya
(2 Edk 26.1-23)
1Gyɛlɔbowam mɔɔ tɔ zo Nwiɔ la lile ɛvolɛ abulanwiɔ nee nsuu wɔ Yizilayɛ ebia ne azo la, yɛɛ Amazaya ara Yuzaya bɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɔdi belemgbunli wɔ Dwuda a. 2Ɔlile ɛvolɛ bulu nee nsia la yɛɛ bɛvale ye bɛziele Dwuda belemgbunli a, yɛɛ ɔdɛnlanle Gyɛlusalɛm ɔlile belemgbunli ɛvolɛ abulanlu nee nwiɔ. Bɛfɛlɛ ɔ nli Gyɛkɔlaya; ɔvi Gyɛlusalɛm. 3Yuzaya vale ɔ ze Amazaya agyakɛ na ɔzɔle Ɛdɛnkɛma anye. 4Noko yeammaa bɛanzɛkye ɛleka ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛsonle awozonle la, yemɔti menli ne hɔle zo kpunle ɛyɛlɛ wɔ ɛleka zɔhane mɔ na bɛbɔle azu wɔ ɛkɛ.
5Ɛdɛnkɛma manle ewule kokobɛ dilale Yuzaya toonwo ɔhɔle ewule nu. Yemɔti ɔdɛnlanle sua gyɛne nu, ɔyele ɔ sa wɔ maanle ne ɛbulɛ nwo. Ɔ ra Dwɔtam yɛle ɔ ze gyima ne manle ye na ɔziele maanle ne.
6Gyima biala mɔɔ Yuzaya lile, nee nyɛleɛ mɔɔ ɔyɛle la bɛhɛlɛ bɛ muala wɔ Dwuda Arelemgbunli Tetedwɛkɛ Mbuluku ne mɔ anu. 7Belemgbunli Yuzaya hɔle ayile nu na bɛwulale ye mrɛlatɛlɛ nu wɔ Devidi Suakpole zo alehelɛ alaleɛ ne.
Yizilayɛ Belemgbunli Zɛkalaya
8Yuzaya lile ɛvolɛ abulasa nee mɔtwɛ wɔ Dwuda ebia ne azo la yɛɛ Gyɛlɔbowam mɔɔ tɔ zo Nwiɔ la ara Zɛkalaya ralile Yizilayɛ belemgbunli a. Ɔdɛnlanle Samɛlea, yɛɛ ɔlile ebia ne siane nsia ala. 9Ɔvale ɔ ze mɔ agyakɛ ɔbɔle ɛbɛla ɛtane ɔtiale Ɛdɛnkɛma. Yeandwe ɔ nwo yeanvi Nibate ara Gyɛlɔbowam ɛbɛla ne mɔɔ ɔbɔle a ɔmanle Yizilayɛma yɛle ɛtane la anwo. 10Gyeebɛhye ara Hyalɛm vuale ɔ ti; ɔ sa hanle ye wɔ Yebelɛyam ɔhunle ye na ɔlile ebia ne.
11Debie biala mɔɔ Zɛkalaya yɛle la bɛhɛlɛ bɛ muala wɔ Yizilayɛ Arelemgbunli Tetedwɛkɛ Mbuluku ne mɔ anu.
12Yemɔti ɛwɔkɛ ne mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɔle Belemgbunli Gyihu kɛ, “Ɛ bo zo amra bali Yizilayɛ ebia ne bie toonwo yeahɔdwu awolɛndoazo nna ne azo” la, yɛle nɔhalɛ.
Yizilayɛ Belemgbunli Hyalɛm
13Yuzaya lile ɛvolɛ abulasa nee ngɔnla wɔ Dwuda ebia ne azo la yɛɛ Gyeebɛhye ara Hyalɛm bɔle belemgbunlililɛ bɔ wɔ Yizilayɛ a. Ɔdɛnlanle Samɛlea ɔlile belemgbunli siane ko. 14Geedae ara Mɛnahɛm vi Tɛza rale Samɛlea rahunle ye na ɔlile ebia ne.
15Debie biala mɔɔ Hyalɛm yɛle nee ye maamɔvo ɛbɛla ne, bɛhɛlɛ bɛ muala wɔ Yizilayɛ Arelemgbunli Tetedwɛkɛ Mbuluku ne mɔ anu. 16Mɔɔ Mɛnahɛm vi Tɛza kɔ la ɔzɛkyele Tapua bɔkɔɔ na ɔhunle menli mɔɔ wɔ zolɛ la amuala, ɔtulutulule mraalɛ mɔɔ ɛlɛnrenzɛ bɔbɔ la anyalɛ, ɔboalekɛ bɛanli bɛamboa ye.
Yizilayɛ Belemgbunli Mɛnahɛm
17Yuzaya lile ɛvolɛ abulasa nee ngɔnla wɔ Dwuda ebia ne azo la yɛɛ Geedae ara Mɛnahɛm ralile Yizilayɛ belemgbunli ebia ne a. Ɔdɛnlanle Samɛlea na ɔlile ebia ne ɛvolɛ bulu. 18Ɔyɛle ɛtane ɔtiale Ɛdɛnkɛma. Ɔvale Nibate ara Gyɛlɔbowam agyakɛ, ɔbɔle ye ɛbɛla ɛtane ne mɔɔ manle Yizilayɛma amuala yɛle ɛtane la bie. 19Belemgbunli Tegelate Paelisɛ vi Aselea ralile Yizilayɛma nvunu, ɔvale konle ɔdoale bɛ. Mɛnahɛm vale dwɛtɛ fufule kilo apenle ngoko abulasa nee nna manle Paelisɛ, amaa yeaboa ɔdaye Mɛnahɛm wɔ ye maanle ne ɛbulɛ nu. 20Mɛnahɛm liele ezukoa ne vile Yizilayɛ sukoavolɛma ɛkɛ ne. Ɔmanle ko biala duale dwɛtɛ fufule abulanlu. Yemɔti Tegelate Paelisɛ nee ye ɛlɔnema ne ziale hɔle bɛ sua zo.
21Debie biala mɔɔ Mɛnahɛm yɛle la bɛhɛlɛ bɛ kɔsɔɔti wɔ Yizilayɛ Arelemgbunli Tetedwɛkɛ Mbuluku ne mɔ anu. 22Ɔhɔle ayile nu na bɛwulale ye mrɛlatɛlɛ nu, na ɔ ra Pɛkahaya lile ebia ne.
Yizilayɛ Belemgbunli Pɛkahaya
23Yuzaya lile ɛvolɛ abulanlu wɔ Dwuda ebia ne azo la yɛɛ Mɛnahɛm ara Pɛkahaya bɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɔdi belemgbunli wɔ Yizilayɛ a. Ɔdɛnlanle Samɛlea, yɛɛ ɔlile ebia ne ɛvolɛ nwiɔ. 24Ɔyɛle ɛtane ɔtiale Ɛdɛnkɛma. Ɔvale Nibate ara Gyɛlɔbowam agyakɛ, ɔbɔle ye ɛbɛla ɛtane ne mɔɔ manle Yizilayɛma yɛle ɛtane la bie. 25Na Relɛmalaya ara Pikaa, Mɛnahɛm ɔdaye ye safohyenle ne vuale ɔ ti na ɔvale Geleadema abulanlu ɔhɔhunle belemgbunli ne wɔ Samɛlea suakunlu ɛkɛ ne na ɔlile ebia ne.
26Debie biala mɔɔ Pɛkahaya yɛle, nee ye nyɛleɛ, bɛhɛlɛ bɛ kɔsɔɔti wɔ Yizilayɛ Arelemgbunli Tetedwɛkɛ Mbuluku ne mɔ anu.
Yizilayɛ Belemgbunli Pikaa
27Yuzaya lile ɛvolɛ abulanlu nee nwiɔ wɔ Dwuda ebia ne azo la yɛɛ Relɛmalaya ara Pikaa bɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɔdi belemgbunli wɔ Yizilayɛ a. Ɔdɛnlanle Samɛlea na ɔlile belemgbunli ɛvolɛ abulanwiɔ. 28Ɔyɛle ɛtane ɔtiale Ɛdɛnkɛma. Ɔvale Nibate ara Gyɛlɔbowam agyakɛ, ɔbɔle ye ɛbɛla ɛtane ne mɔɔ manle Yizilayɛma yɛle ɛtane la bie.
29Wɔ Belemgbunli Pikaa mekɛ zo, Aselea Belemgbunli Tegelate Paelisɛ vale ɛlɔne rahonle vale Ayedwɔn, Ebɛle Bɛte Meeyaka, Gyanowa, Kidɛhye, yɛɛ Heezɔ nee Galeli, Geleade nee Nafetalae maanzinli ne mɔ amuala, na ɔhyele menli ne bie mɔ nuokɛ ɔhɔle nlɔnu wɔ Aselea.
30Belemgbunli Yuzaya ara Dwɔtam lile Dwuda ebia ne ɛvolɛ abulanwiɔ la, Yila ara Hohyia vuale Yizilayɛ Belemgbunli Pikaa ati na ɔhunle ye ɔlile ebia ne. 31Debie biala nee nyɛleɛ biala mɔɔ Pikaa yɛle la bɛhɛlɛ bɛ wɔ Yizilayɛ Arelemgbunli Tetedwɛkɛ Mbuluku ne mɔ anu.
Dwuda Belemgbunli Dwɔtam
(2 Edk 27.1-9)
32Relɛmalaya ara Pikaa lile ɛvolɛ nwiɔ wɔ Yizilayɛ ebia ne azo la yɛɛ Belemgbunli Yuzaya ara Dwɔtam bɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɔdi belemgbunli wɔ Dwuda a. 33Dwɔtam bɔ belemgbunlililɛ bo la ɛnee yeli ɛvolɛ abulanwiɔ nee nnu, yɛɛ ɔdɛnlanle Gyɛlusalɛm ɔlile belemgbunli ɛvolɛ bulu nee nsia. Ɔ nli a le Zeedɔko ara raalɛ Gyɛluhya. 34Ɔvale ɔ ze Yuzaya agyakɛ na ɔzɔle Ɛdɛnkɛma anye. 35Noko bɛanzɛkye ɛleka ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛsonle awozonle la, yemɔti menli hɔle zo kpunle ɛyɛlɛ wɔ ɛkɛ bɔle azu. Dwɔtam a zile Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne Sɔlɔ Anlenkɛ kpole ne a.
36Debie biala nee nyɛleɛ biala mɔɔ Dwɔtam yɛle la bɛhɛlɛ bɛ wɔ Dwuda Arelemgbunli Tetedwɛkɛ Mbuluku ne mɔ anu. 37Belemgbunli Dwɔtam mekɛ zo yɛɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma lumuale manle adenle manle Selea Belemgbunli Rilizen nee Yizilayɛ Belemgbunli Pikaa vale konle radoale Dwudama a. 38Dwɔtam hɔle ayile nu na bɛwulale ye mrɛlatɛlɛ nu wɔ Devidi suakpole zo alehelɛ alaleɛ ne na ɔ ra Ehaze lile ebia ne.

Title: 2 ARL 16
Content:
Dwuda Belemgbunli Ehaze
(2 Edk 28.1-27)
1Pikaa lile ɛvolɛ bulu nee nsuu wɔ Yizilayɛ ebia ne azo la yɛɛ Dwɔtam ara Ehaze bɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɔdi belemgbunli wɔ Dwuda a. 2Ɔlile ɛvolɛ abulanwiɔ la yɛɛ ɔbɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɔdi belemgbunli a. Ɔdɛnlanle Gyɛlusalɛm ɔlile belemgbunli ɛvolɛ bulu nee nsia. Yeanva ɔ nlenya Devidi agyakɛ; ɛhye ati ɔyɛle ɛtane ɔtiale Ɛdɛnkɛma ye Nyamenle ne. 3Ɔvale Yizilayɛ arelemgbunli agyakɛ, yɛɛ ɔbɔle bɛ ɛbɛla ɛtane ne bie. Ɔbɔle munzule ɛbɛla ne mɔɔ menli mɔɔ ɛnee de azɛlɛ ne azo la bɔ la bie, na ɔvale ɔdaye ɔ ra nrenya ɔyelale ye ɔzɔle amonle. Ɛbɛla ɛtane zɛhae a manle Ɛdɛnkɛma dule menli zɔhane mɔ wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ Yizilayɛma ba azɛlɛ ne azo la. 4Ɔbɔle azu wɔ awozonle ɛzonlenlɛ ɛleka ne mɔ mɔɔ wɔ awoka zo, nee mbaka bo na ɔkpunle ɛyɛlɛ wɔ ɛkɛ.
5 Selea Belemgbunli Rilizen nee Yizilayɛ Belemgbunli Pikaa yɛle Gyɛlusalɛm anwo ɛlɔne na bɛratetale Ehaze, noko bɛangola ye. 6(Mekɛ ne anu Yidɔm belemgbunli ne rahonle liele Yilate. Bɛdule Dwudama mɔɔ wɔ zolɛ la na Yidɔmma dɛnlanle ɛkɛ. Ɛnɛ nee ɛnɛ bɛtɛte ɛkɛ.) 7Ehaze zoanle menli wɔ Aselea Belemgbunli Tegelate Paelisɛ ɛkɛ ne kɛ, “Mele wɔ sonvolɛ nee ɛ ra nrenya. Bɛla balie me fi Selea nee Yizilayɛ arelemgbunli ne mɔ mɔɔ zo konle doa me la asa anu.” 8Ehaze vale dwɛtɛ fufule nee ezukoa nvutuke mɔɔ wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu nee belemgbunli ne gya nu la yɛle ahyɛlɛdeɛ hɔmanle Aselea belemgbunli ne. 9Tegelate Paelisɛ diele Ehaze modolɛ ne na ɔvale ye ɛlɔnema ɔrale Dɛmasekɛse ɔrahonle ɔvale suakpole ne, ɔhunle Belemgbunli Rilizen na ɔhyele menli ne bie mɔ nuokɛ ɔ nee bɛ hɔle Kɛɛ.
10Belemgbunli Ehaze hɔle Dɛmasekɛse kɛ ɔkayia Belemgbunli Tegelate Paelisɛ la, ɔnwunle azukponle ne mɔɔ ɔwɔ ɛkɛ ne la na ɔmanle bɛyɛle bie kɛ yemɔ ala la bɛhɔmanle Sɛlɛvolɛ Yulaya. 11Yemɔti Sɛlɛvolɛ Yulaya zile azukponle ne bie mɔɔ le kɛ ɛhendeɛ ne la pɛpɛ. Ɔzile ɔwiele na Ehaze vi Dɛmasekɛse azia ara. 12Ehaze ziale rale la ɔnwunle kɛ bɛwie azukponle ne si, 13yemɔti ɔyelale nane azubɔdeɛ nee ma azubɔdeɛ wɔ zolɛ na ɔguale nwanye azubɔdeɛ nee anzonudwolɛ azubɔdeɛ mogya wɔ zolɛ. 14 Kɔbele azukponle ne mɔɔ bɛdu bɛzie ɛkɛ bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma la gyi azukponle fofolɛ ɛhye nee Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne avinli, na Ehaze manle bɛyele ye ɛkɛ bɛhɔziele azukponle fofolɛ ne sɔlɔ. 15Akee ɔzele Yulaya kɛ, “Fa me azukponle kpole ɛhye, yela nwonlomɔ ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ nee nɔsolɛ ma azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ, yɛɛ belemgbunli nee menli ne ɛyelalɛ nee ma azubɔlɛ ninyɛne ne mɔ wɔ zolɛ. Wola nane mɔɔ bɛkɛva bɛkɛbɔ azu la mogya ne gua zo. Na gyakyi kɔbele azukponle ne maa me na meabiza wɔ zolɛ.” 16Na sɛlɛvolɛ Yulaya yɛle, kɛmɔ belemgbunli ne zele la.
17 Belemgbunli Ehaze dudule kɔbele ehwili ngyikyi ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛfa bɛyɛ gyima wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu la, na ɔyeyele ahyɛnze ne mɔ mɔɔ gyigyi nuhua la. Eza ɔmanle angola ne mɔɔ gyi kɔbele nlankɛ bulu nee nwiɔ zo la zo ɔziele ye bolɛ bama zo. 18Akee ɔmaa Aselea belemgbunli ne anye alie la, Ehaze eza dudule sɛlɛdwee ne mɔɔ bɛbo ye wɔ ɛleka mɔɔ belemgbunli ne tɛnla wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu la na ɔmanle bɛduale anuhɔlɛ ne mɔɔ belemgbunli ala a fa nu ba Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu la.
19Debie biala mɔɔ Belemgbunli Ehaze yɛle la bɛhɛlɛ bɛ wɔ Dwuda Arelemgbunli Tetedwɛkɛ Mbuluku ne mɔ anu. 20 Ehaze hɔle ayile nu na bɛwulale ye mrɛlatɛlɛ nu wɔ Devidi Suakpole zo alehelɛ alaleɛ ne. Ɔ ra Hɛzikaya lile ebia ne.

Title: 2 ARL 17
Content:
Yizilayɛ Belemgbunli Hohyia
1Belemgbunli Ehaze lile ɛvolɛ bulu nee nwiɔ wɔ Dwuda ebia ne azo la, yɛɛ Yila ara Hohyia bɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɔdi belemgbunli wɔ Yizilayɛ a. Ɔdɛnlanle Samɛlea na ɔlile ebia ne ɛvolɛ ngɔnla. 2Ɔyɛle ɛtane ɔtiale Ɛdɛnkɛma noko yeangɔ ɔ nyunlu dɔɔnwo kɛmɔ Yizilayɛ arelemgbunli mɔɔ lumua ɔ nyunlu la yɛle la. 3Aselea Belemgbunli Hyalemanizɛ vale konle doale ye. Hohyia manle ɔ sa zo na ɔduale adwule ɔmanle Hyalemanizɛ ɛvolɛ biala. 4Ɛvolɛ ko bie anu, Hohyia andua ye adwule ne ammaa Aselea belemgbunli ne. Ɔvale nrɛlaleɛ ɔmanle bɛhɔmanle Yigyibiti Belemgbunli Soo kɛ ɔraboa ye. Hyalemanizɛ dele la, ɔmanle bɛhyele Hohyia bɛdole efiade.
Samɛlea ɛbɔlɛ
5Akee Hyalemanizɛ vale ɛlɔne rale Yizilayɛma anwo zo na ɔhɔtetale Samɛlea. Ye ɛvolɛ nsa ne azo, 6mɔɔ ɛnee Hohyia ɛli ɛvolɛ ngɔnla wɔ Yizilayɛ ebia ne azo la, Aselea belemgbunli ne honle vale Samɛlea na ɔhyele Yizilayɛma bie mɔ nuokɛ ɔhɔle Aselea maanle nu. Ɔmanle bie mɔ dɛnlanle Aselea suakpole ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Heela la azo nee Azule Heebɔ ne anloa wɔ Gozan maanzinli nu. Ɔvale bie mɔ noko ɔhɔguale Midea azuamgbole ne mɔ azo.
7Samɛlea bɔle, ɔboalekɛ Yizilayɛma yɛle ɛtane tiale Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne mɔɔ liele bɛ vile Yigyibiti belemgbunli ne abo na ɔ nee bɛ vi Yigyibiti rale la. Bɛzonlenle awozonle, 8bɛzukoale bɛyɛle ninyɛne mɔɔ menli mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma dule bɛ azɛlɛ ne azo la yɛ la bie. Ɛdɛnkɛma dule menli mɔɔ wɔ azɛlɛ ne azo la wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ Yizilayɛma ba la. Eza bɛlile amaamuo mɔɔ bɛ arelemgbunli ne mɔ hyehyɛle manle bɛ la angome azo. 9Yizilayɛma yɛle ninyɛne mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne ɛngulo la. Bɛsisile awozonle azua wɔ azuamgbole, azua azua nee namunamu zo. 10 Bɛyɛle bɛ bozonle raalɛ Ahyela ne ananze na bɛvale awolɛ bɛsisile mpila bɛzieziele ananze ne mɔ zolɛ, wɔ awoka zo nee mbaka bo. 11Bɛkpunle ɛyɛlɛ wɔ ɛleka ɛhye mɔ, na bɛyɛle ninyɛne mɔɔ menli mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma dule bɛ la yɛle la bie. Bɛyɛle ninyɛndane bɛmanle Ɛdɛnkɛma vale ɛya, 12na bɛkpole Ɛdɛnkɛma mɛla ne mɔɔ se bɛmmasonle awozonle la.
13Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛmaa ye soanvolɛma nee kpɔmanvolɛma ɛrahakye Yizilayɛma nee Dwudama fane dɔɔnwo kɛ, “Bɛgyakyi ninyɛndane ɛyɛlɛ, na bɛli me edwɛkɛ nee me ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ wɔ Mɛla ne mɔɔ menvale memanle bɛ nlenya mɔ, na menluale me sonvolɛ kpɔmanvolɛma anwo zo menvale membɛlɛle bɛ la azo.” 14Noko bɛandie, yɛɛ bɛanli zolɛ. Bɛyɛle anzosesebɛ, kɛmɔ bɛ nlenya mɔ yɛle la; bɛanlie Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne bɛanli. 15Bɛkpole ye mɛla ne mɔ, bɛanli ngyekyeleɛ ne mɔɔ ɔ nee bɛ nlenya mɔ kyekyele la azo yɛɛ bɛambu ye kɔkɔbɔlɛ ne mɔ bie. Bɛzonlenle mmonle mɔɔ nvasoɛ biala ɛnle zo la na bɛdabɛ mumua ne bɛyɛle mgbane. Bɛlile maanle maanle mɔɔ zuozua bɛ la amaamuo zo, na bɛyɛle anzosesebɛ wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Mɛla ne mɔɔ ɔvale ɔmanle bɛ kɛ bɛmmasukoa bɛyɛ mɔɔ menli zɔhane mɔ yɛ la bie la anwo. 16 Bɛbulule Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne mɛla mɔɔ ɔvale ɔmanle bɛ la kɔsɔɔti azo, na bɛvale ninyɛne bɛholole bɛguale nlankɛ nyinli ananze nwiɔ bɛzonlenle bɛ.
