Eza bɛyɛle bɛ bozonle raalɛ Ahyela ne ananze, na bɛzonlenle anwomanyunlu ninyɛne nee bozonle Beeyale. 17 Bɛvale bɛ mra mrenya nee mraalɛ bɛmanle bɛyelale bɛ bɛbɔle azu bɛmanle awozonle, bɛbizale bɛ nwo wɔ menli mɔɔ tendɛ nwomenle nloa zo nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛtwe adunyi la ɛkɛ, na bɛvale bɛ mekɛ kɔsɔɔti bɛyɛle mɔɔ ɛnzɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anye la, na bɛmanle Ɛdɛnkɛma vale ɛya. 18Ɛdɛnkɛma vale Yizilayɛma anwo ɛya kpole na ɔbɔle bɛ bo zo. Yeangyakyi bie kɛ Dwuda abusua ekpunli ne ala. 19Noko Dwudama bɔbɔ anli Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne mɛla ne mɔ azo. Bɛzukoale bɛbule amaamuo ne mɔɔ Yizilayɛma hɔvale rale la bie. 20Na Ɛdɛnkɛma kpole Yizilayɛ abo zo amra ne kɔsɔɔti, ɔyele bɛ ɔmanle bɛ kpɔvolɛma deanle bɛ atisesebɛ nu ɔhɔdwule kɛ akee bɛ bo zo bɔle bɔkɔɔ la.
21Mekɛ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma dele Dwudama vile Yizilayɛma anwo la, Yizilayɛma yɛle Nibate ara Gyɛlɔbowam bɛ belemgbunli. Gyɛlɔbowam manle bɛkpole Ɛdɛnkɛma na ɔmanle bɛyɛle ɛtane kpole kpalɛ. 22Yizilayɛma lile Gyɛlɔbowam anzi na bɛhɔle zolɛ bɛyɛle ɛtane ne mɔ mɔɔ ɔyɛle la bie, 23manle Ɛdɛnkɛma akee zɛkyele bɛ na ɔyele bɛ ɔvile ɔ nye zo, kɛmɔ ɔluale ye sonvolɛ kpɔmanvolɛma anwo zo ɔhakyele bɛ kɛ ɔbayɛ la. Yemɔti bɛhyele Yizilayɛma bie mɔ nuokɛ bɛ nee bɛ hɔle nlɔnu wɔ Aselea. Ɛkɛ ne yɛɛ bɛde kɛkala a.
Aseleama tɛnla Yizilayɛ
24Aselea belemgbunli ne vale menli vile azuamgbole Babelɔn, Kuutu, Yeva, Heemate, yɛɛ Sifaveeyem azo na ɔmanle bɛradɛnlanle Samɛlea azuamgbole ne mɔ azo. Menli mɔɔ vi azua ɛhye mɔ azo la radɛnlanle Samɛlea azuamgbole ne mɔ azo kpɔkpɔ. 25Alumua ne mɔɔ bɛradɛnlanle maanle ne anu la bɛanzonle Ɛdɛnkɛma, yemɔti ɔmanle awenade rahyehyele bie mɔ. 26Bɛmanle Aselea belemgbunli ne dele kɛ menli mɔɔ yeva bɛ yeragua azɛlɛ ne azo la ɛnze ɛkɛ ne nyamenle ne mɛla ne mɔ anloa kyi, yemɔti nyamenle ne ɛmaa awenade ɛlɛkyehye bɛ ahu bɛ. 27Na belemgbunli ne zele kɛ, “Bɛmaa sɛlɛvolɛma ne mɔ mɔɔ yɛhyele bɛ yɛ nee bɛ rale la anu ko ɛhɔ ɛhɔdɛnla lɔ na ɔhilehile bɛ azɛlɛ ne azo nyamenle ne mɛla ne mɔ.” 28Yemɔti Yizilayɛnli sɛlɛvolɛ ko bie mɔɔ bɛdule ye bɛvile Samɛlea la ziale hɔdɛnlanle Bɛtɛle na ɔhilehilele menli ne kɛ bɛsi bɛsonle Ɛdɛnkɛma la.
29Noko menli mɔɔ hɔdɛnlanle Samɛlea la hɔle zolɛ yɛle bɛ mmonle na bɛvale bɛ bɛziele awozonle azua mɔɔ Yizilayɛma sisile la anu. Maanle ko biala yɛle ye amonle ɛdeɛ ne mɔɔ bɛsonle ye wɔ bɛ sua zo lɔ la. 30Babelɔnoma yɛle bɛ bozonle Sɛko Bino ananze; Kuutuma yɛle bɛ bozonle Nɛgale ananze; Heematema yɛle bɛ bozonle Ahyaema ananze; 31Yevama yɛle bɛ bozonle Nebehaze nee Taatake ananze; yɛɛ Sifaveeyemma yelale bɛ mra bɔle azu manle bɛ awozonle Adelamɛlɛke nee Anamɛlɛke. 32Menli ɛhye mɔ zonlenle Ɛdɛnkɛma noko bɛyele bɛ bie mɔ bɛyɛle bɛ ahɔmenle bɛmanle bɛhɔbɔle azu wɔ mmonle azua ne mɔ anu. 33Yemɔti bɛzonlenle Ɛdɛnkɛma bɔbɔ ɛdeɛ, noko eza bɛzonlenle bɛ awozonle ne mɔ, kɛmɔ bɛ maanle ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛvi nuhua bɛrale la amaamuo ne mɔ de la.
34 Kɛkala bɔbɔ bɛtɛbu bɛ amaamuo dɛba ne. Bɛnzonle Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛɛ bɛnli ye mɛla nee ye ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ ɔvale ɔmanle Gyekɔbo, mɔɔ nzinlii ɔdonle ye Yizilayɛ la, abo zo amra ne la azo. 35 Ɛdɛnkɛma nee bɛ yɛle ngyekyeleɛ na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛmmasonle awozonle biala, bɛmmabɔ bɛ ti aze bɛmaa bɛ, anzɛɛ bɛkoto bɛ, anzɛɛ bɛbɔ azu bɛmaa bɛ. 36 Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛyɛ tieyɛ bɛmaa medame Ɛdɛnkɛma mɔɔ menvale tumi kpole menyele bɛ menvile Yigyibiti la. Bɛbɔ bɛ ti aze bɛmaa me na bɛbɔ azu bɛmaa me. 37Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛdi me mɛla ne mɔ nee me edwɛkɛ mɔɔ mehɛlɛ memaa bɛ la azo. Bɛmmasonle awozonle biala, 38yɛɛ bɛmmamaa bɛ rɛle fi ngyekyeleɛ mɔɔ me nee bɛ kyekyele la. 39Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛyɛ tieyɛ bɛmaa medame, Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne, na mebalie bɛ meavi bɛ kpɔvolɛma asa anu.” 40Noko menli zɔhane mɔ andie na bɛhɔle zolɛ bɛyɛle mɔɔ tete ne ɛnee bɛ amaamuo kile la.
41Yemɔti menli zɔhane zonlenle mmonle, na ɛnɛ nee ɛnɛ ala bɛ bo zo amra tɛyɛ zɔhane debie ko ne ala.

Title: 2 ARL 18
Content:
Dwuda Belemgbunli Hɛzikaya
(2 Edk 29.1-2; 31.1)
1Belemgbunli Hohyia lile ɛvolɛ nsa wɔ Yizilayɛ ebia ne azo la yɛɛ bɛvale Ehaze ara Hɛzikaya bɛziele belemgbunli wɔ Dwuda a. 2Ɔlile ɛvolɛ abulanwiɔ nee nnu la yɛɛ ɔbɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɔdi belemgbunli a. Ɔdɛnlanle Gyɛlusalɛm a ɔlile ebia ne a, yɛɛ ɔlile ɛvolɛ abulanwiɔ nee ngɔnla wɔ ebia ne azo. Ɔ nli a le Zɛkalaya ara raalɛ Abaegya. 3Ɔvale ɔ nlenya Devidi agyakɛ na ɔzɔle Ɛdɛnkɛma anye. 4 Ɔzɛkyele awozonle ɛzonlenlɛ ɛleka ne mɔ, ɔbubule awolɛ mpila ne mɔ na ɔzɛkyele bozonle raalɛ Ahyela ne ananze ne mɔ. Eza ɔbubule kɔbele ɛwɔlɛ ne mɔɔ Mosisi yɛle mɔɔ bɛvɛlɛle ye Nehɛhyetan la, ɔluakɛ ɛnee menli kɔkpu ɛyɛlɛ wɔ ɛkɛ ne sonle ye. 5Hɛzikaya vale ɔ rɛle wulale Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne anu. Dwuda annyia belemgbunli bieko mɔɔ le kɛ ɔdaye la, yɛɛ bie anlumua ɔ nyunlu mɔɔ le kɛ ɔdaye la. 6Ɔlile nɔhalɛ ɔmanle Ɛdɛnkɛma, yeandu ye edwɛkɛ zo ɛlɛ. Ɔlile mɛla ne mɔ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma vale manle Mosisi la azo kpalɛ. 7Yemɔti ɛnee Ɛdɛnkɛma nee ye lua yɛɛ ɔkpazile wɔ debie biala mɔɔ ɔyɛle la anu. Ɔdele Aselea belemgbunli ne anwo atua na ɔkpole kɛ ɔkɛboa belemgbunli ne abo.
8Belemgbunli Hɛzikaya nee Filisitiama honle, ɔlile bɛ nwo zo konim na ɔzɛkyele bɛ azuamgbole nee ngyikyi kɔsɔɔti. Gaza nee ye namunamu ne mɔ boka azua mɔɔ ɔzɛkyele bɛ la anwo.
9Hɛzikaya lile ɛvolɛ nna wɔ Dwuda ebia ne azo, mɔɔ ɛnee Belemgbunli Hohyia ɔdaye yeli ɛvolɛ nsuu wɔ Yizilayɛ ebia ne azo la, Aselea Belemgbunli Hyalemanizɛ rale Yizilayɛma anwo zo, ɔtetale Samɛlea na bɛduale bɛ adenle. 10Ɔkanyia ɛvolɛ nsa la yɛɛ Samɛlea bɔle a. Ɛnee Hɛzikaya ɛli ɛvolɛ nsia wɔ ye ebia ne azo yɛɛ Hohyia ɛli ɛvolɛ ngɔnla. 11Aselea belemgbunli ne hyele Yizilayɛma bie mɔ nuokɛ hɔle Aselea na ɔmanle bie mɔ hɔdɛnlanle Heela, bie mɔ dɛnlanle Azule Heebɔ ne anloa wɔ Gozan maanzinli nu, yɛɛ bie mɔ noko dɛnlanle Midea azuamgbole ne mɔ azo.
12Samɛlea bɔle, ɔluakɛ Yizilayɛma anyɛ tieyɛ ammaa Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne. Bɛbulule ngyekyeleɛ ne mɔɔ ɔ nee bɛ yɛle la azo, na bɛdule bɛ gye wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma mɛla ne mɔɔ ɔvale ɔmanle Mosisi la anwo. Bɛandie ye yɛɛ bɛanyɛ tieyɛ bɛammaa ye.
Aseleama nwunlonwunla Gyɛlusalɛmma
(2 Edk 32.1-19; Aye 36.1-22)
13Belemgbunli Hɛzikaya lile ɛvolɛ bulu nee nna wɔ ebia ne azo la, Aselea Belemgbunli Sɛnakɛlebe rale azuamgbole mɔɔ bɛlie nwolɛ bane mɔɔ wɔ Dwuda la amuala anwo zo, ɔ nee bɛ honle ɔlile bɛ kɔsɔɔti bɛ nwo zo konim. 14Hɛzikaya zoanle manle bɛvale nrɛlaleɛ bɛhɔmanle Sɛnakɛlebe mɔɔ ɛnee wɔ Leekehye la kɛ, “Meyɛ ɛtane, mekpa wɔ kyɛlɛ, mmaba ɛ nyunlu bieko na menwɔdua ezukoa biala mɔɔ ɛdie la.” Aselea belemgbunli ne buale kɛ Hɛzikaya ɛradua dwɛtɛ fufule kilo apenle bulu yɛɛ ezukoa nvutuke kilo apenle ko ɛmaa ye. 15Hɛzikaya kpokpole Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu nee suakunlu ɛkɛ ne gya nu dwɛtɛ fufule kɔsɔɔti, 16ɔwokewokele ezukoa nvutuke mɔɔ bɛholo bɛgua Ɛzonlenlɛ sua ne nlenkɛ ne mɔ anwo la nee mɔɔ ɔdaye mumua ne ɔmanle bɛholole bɛguale nlenkɛ felɛmo ne mɔ anwo la na bɛvale ɔ muala bɛhɔmanle Sɛnakɛlebe.
17Aselea belemgbunli ne akee vale ɛlɔne ekpunli kpole kpalɛ ko vi Leekehye kɛ bɛ nee Hɛzikaya kaho wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm. Safohyenle mgbanyinli nsa a lile ɛlɔnema ne ati a. Bɛdwule Gyɛlusalɛm la, bɛhɔvale ɛleka mɔɔ menli mɔɔ nwo ndanlɛ la yɛ bɛ gyima la adenle ne. Adenle zɔhane zua kuma ne mɔɔ bɛvu na nzule dua nuhua vi sɔlɔ nzule ne anu ba la. 18Akee bɛzoanle kɛ bɛhɔvɛlɛ Hɛzikaya na Hɛzikaya mbɔlɔba nsa vindele kɛ bɛkayia bɛ. Bɛmɛ a le Belekaya ara Yilayakem mɔɔ nea suakunlu ɛkɛ ne la, Hyɛbena mɔɔ le kɔɔto kɛlɛhɛlɛvolɛ ne yɛɛ Esafe ara Dwowaa mɔɔ yemɔ a nea suakunlu ɛkɛ ne ngɛlata zo la. 19Na safohyenle mgbanyinli ne mɔ ko zele bɛ kɛ, Aselea belemgbunli ne kpondɛ kɛ ɔnwu deɛ holɛ ko mɔɔ si Hɛzikaya ahonle la. 20Ɔbizale kɛ, “Ɛnee bɛdwenle kɛ bɛfa bɛ nloa a bɛko a? Saa bɛte Aselea belemgbunli anwo atua a nwane bɔbɔ yɛɛ kɛlie bɛ a? 21Bɛ nye la kɛ Yigyibiti baraboa bɛ, na yemɔ bɔbɔ, ɔle baka bie mɔɔ ɛngyɛ na yeabu la. Ɛkomo zolɛ a ɔbabu yeawɔ ɛ sa akunlu. Menli mɔɔ fa bɛ rɛle wula Yigyibiti belemgbunli ne anu la kɛ wie ye la ɛne.”
22Aselea safohyenle ne eza zɔle zo kɛ, “Anzɛɛ bɛka bɛahile me kɛ bɛ rɛle wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne anu ɔ? Tɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma azua ne yɛɛ ye azukponle ne mɔ a Hɛzikaya ɛmaa bɛbubu bɛ na yeze Dwudama amuala nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ Gyɛlusalɛm ɛke la kɛ azukponle ne mɔɔ wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm ɛke la azo ala a ɔwɔ kɛ bɛbɔ azu na bɛsonle la ɔ? 23Megyinla Aselea belemgbunli ne agyakɛ anu me nee bɛ ayɛ ngyehyɛlɛ. Saa bɛkɛnyia nwolɛ menli dodo ne a anrɛɛ memaa bɛ mgbɔnwɔ apenle nwiɔ kɛkala. 24Bɛdabɛ mumua ne, bɛndwu Aselea safohyenlema anu kakula kpalɛ bɔbɔ ɛleka bie, noko bɛ nye la kɛ Yigyibitima kɛva konle ehwili nee menli mɔɔ ka mgbɔnwɔ la kɛrɛlɛ bɛ. 25Anzɛɛ bɛdwenle kɛ medame me ti anwo yɛɛ meli mera mebadoa bɛ me nee bɛ aho, wɔ bɛdabɛ bɛ maanle ye anu a, na Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛnze nu? Ɛdɛnkɛma ɔdaye mumua ne a zele me kɛ menva konle mendoa bɛ na menzɛkye maanle ne a.” 26Na Yilayakem, Hyɛbena, yɛɛ Dwowaa hanle hilele safohyenle ne kɛ, “Yɛmenle, yɛsɛlɛ wɔ ka Arelameeyeke kile yɛ na yɛte. Mmaka Hibulu ɛmaa menli mɔɔ gua bane ye ati zo ɛke la te mɔɔ ɛlɛka la.”
27Safohyenle ne zele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛdwenle kɛ bɛ ngome nee bɛ belemgbunli ne ati yɛɛ me menle zoanle me kɛ memanga edwɛkɛ ɛhye mɔ mengile bɛ a, na menli mɔɔ gua bane ne ati la ɛmboka nwolɛ? Metendɛ meahile menli mɔɔ gua bane ne ati la bɛdabɛ noko, ɔluakɛ bɛ muala bɛbali bɛ ebinli, bɛanlo bɛ miene.”
28Akee safohyenle ne dwazole gyinlanle na ɔvale Hibulu aneɛ ɔhanle ye kpole kpalɛ kɛ, “Bɛdie mɔɔ Aselea belemgbunli ne ɛlɛka ahile bɛ la. 29Ɔlɛkakye bɛ kɛ bɛmmamaa Hɛzikaya bɛlɛbɛla bɛ. Hɛzikaya ɛnrɛhola ɛnrɛlie bɛ, 30yɛɛ bɛmmamaa ɔdi bɛ adwenle kɛ bɛva bɛ rɛle bɛwula Ɛdɛnkɛma anu. Bɛmmadwenle kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma kɛlie bɛ, anzɛɛ ɔkɛzi Aselea ɛlɔnema aze kɛ bɛmmako bɛfa bɛ. 31Bɛmmatie Hɛzikaya. Aselea belemgbunli ne se bɛvi suakpole ne azo bɛvinde bɛrabɔ bɛ ti aze bɛmaa ye. Bɛyɛ ye zɔhane a ɔbamaa bɛ adenle yeamaa awie biala ɔdaye yeali ye vanye mbaka zo ma, nee ye feege mbaka ma, na bɛanlo bɛdabɛ bɛ bula nu nzule, 32kɔdwu mekɛ mɔɔ Aselea belemgbunli ne kɛnyia nwolɛ ɔkɛva bɛ ɔkɛhɔgua maanle mɔɔ ye azɛlɛ ne le kɛ bɛ ɛdeɛ ye la anu la. Ɛkɛ ne, vanye ɛya avule mɔɔ bamaa bɛ nwanye bɛanlo nee abɛlɛ mɔɔ bɛbava bɛayɛ kpanwo la anwo ɛngyia. Ɔlivi mbaka wɔ ɛkɛ, yɛɛ ɔlivi nwole nee wolɛ ɛbu. Saa bɛyɛ mɔɔ ɔlɛka yeahile bɛ la a bɛlɛ bɛ ti, bɛnrɛwu. Bɛmmamaa Hɛzikaya yɛ bɛ koasea ɔmaa bɛdwenle kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma kɛlie bɛ. 33Maanle maanle dɔɔnwo awozonle angola anlie bɛ anvi Aselea belemgbunli ne asa anu. 34Menli zɔhane wɔ nienwu kɛkala, Heemate awozonle anzɛɛ Aapade? Sifaveeyem, Hina, yɛɛ Ayeva awozonle hale nienwu? Asoo bɛ bie holale liele Samɛlea? 35Kenlenzu a awozonle mɔɔ wɔ maanle maanle ɛhye mɔ anu la bie holale liele bɛ maanle vile yɛ Maanle Maanle Kpanyinli ne asa anu a? Na ɛnee akee duzu yɛɛ maa bɛdwenle kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma kɛhola kɛlie Gyɛlusalɛm a?”
36Menli ne mɔ yɛle ngungoonwu, kɛmɔ Belemgbunli Hɛzikaya zele bɛ la. Bɛambuke bɛ nloa. 37Na Yilaya, Hyɛbena, yɛɛ Dwowaa vale nyane suosuanle bɛ adɛladeɛ ne mɔ anu na bɛhɔhanle mɔɔ Aselea Safohyenle ne hanle la bɛhilele belemgbunli ne.

Title: 2 ARL 19
Content:
Belemgbunli ne biza Ayezaya adwenle
(Aye 37.1-7)
1Belemgbunli Hɛzikaya dele edwɛkɛ ne la, nyane ngome manle ɔsuosuanle ye tɛladeɛ ne mɔɔ ɔwula la anu, ɔvale ɛrele tɛladeɛ ɔwulale na ɔhɔle Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu. 2Ɔzoanle Yilayakem, mɔɔ nea belemgbunli suakunlu ɛkɛ ne la, Kɔɔto kɛlɛhɛlɛvolɛ Hyɛbena, nee sɛlɛvolɛ mgbanyinli bie mɔ wɔ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ Ayezaya mɔɔ ɔ ze a le Emɔzo la anwo ɛkɛ. Bɛdabɛ noko bɛwulale ɛrele adɛladeɛ a bɛhɔle a. 3Nrɛlaleɛ mɔɔ bɛ nee ye hɔle la a le kɛ, “Belemgbunli Hɛzikaya se yɛraze wɔ kɛ, ɛnɛ le nyanelilɛ kenle; abule ɛbu yɛ, anyiemgba ɛha yɛ. Yɛyɛ kɛ raalɛ mɔɔ ɛvo awolɛ zo na ɔ nwo ɛbɛlɛ ye na ɔngola ɔ nwo twe la. 4Aselea belemgbunli ne ɛzoa ye safohyenlema kpanyinli ne yemaa yerabɔ tease Nyamenle ne aholoba. Medie medi kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle dele mɔɔ ɔhanle la. Yemɔti sɛlɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma wɔ Nyamenle ne kɛ ɔdie zɛhae aholobabɔlɛ ne na ɔdua menli mɔɔ bɔle aholoba ne la kakɛ, na sɛlɛ Nyamenle maa ye menli ekyi ne mɔɔ ɛha la.”
5Ayezaya dele Belemgbunli Hɛzikaya nrɛlaleɛ ne la, 6ɔmanle bɛvale mualɛ bɛhɔmanle ye kɛ, “Ɛdɛnkɛma se ɛmmamaa Aseleama nwunlonwunla wɔ kɛ ɔdaye Ɛdɛnkɛma ɔnrɛhola wɔ die. 7Ɛdɛnkɛma bamaa Aselea belemgbunli ne ade nrɛlaleɛ bie mɔɔ bamaa yeazia yeahɔ ye maanle nu a, na Ɛdɛnkɛma bamaa bɛahu ye wɔ ɛkɛ ne.”
Aseleama nwunlonwunla Hɛzikaya bieko
(Aye 37.8-20)
8Aselea safohyenlema kpanyinli ne dele kɛ ye belemgbunli ne ɛvi Leekehye na yera Lebena ɔ nee ɛkɛ ne amra ɛlɛko, yemɔti ɔhɔle ɛkɛ ne kɛ ɔ nee ye kava adwenle. 9Nrɛlaleɛ radole Aseleama kɛ, Yigyibiti ɛlɔnema mɔɔ Sudan Belemgbunli Tɛheeka a li bɛ ti la ɛlɛba aradoa bɛ nee bɛ aho. Aselea belemgbunli ne dele ɛhye la ɔvale kɛlata ɔmanle bɛhɔmanle Dwuda Belemgbunli Hɛzikaya 10kɛ, “Saa wɔ nyamenle ne mɔɔ wɔva ɛ rɛle wɔwula ye nu la ɛze wɔ kɛ me sa ɛnrɛha wɔ a ɛnee mmamaa ɔyɛ wɔ fɛ somaa. 11Wɔde mɔɔ Aselea belemgbunli fa yɛ azuamgbole mɔɔ ɔkulo kɛ ɔsɛkye bɛ la. Ɛdwenle kɛ ɛkɛvi ɛsalɛ ɔ? 12Me mgbanyima a zɛkyele azuamgbole Gozan, Hɛlan, yɛɛ Rilizɛfe na ɔhunle Bɛtɛdɛnema mɔɔ de Telasaa la, noko bɛ awozonle ne mɔ biala angola anlie bɛ. 13Arelemgbunli mɔɔ wɔ Heemate, Aapade, Sifaveeyem, Hina, yɛɛ Ayeva la wɔ nienwu?”
14Belemgbunli Hɛzikaya liele kɛlata ne wɔ menli mɔɔ bɛzoanle bɛ la asa anu ɔgengale. Akee ɔhɔle Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu na ɔvale kɛlata ne ɔdole Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu ɛkɛ. 15Na ɔzɛlɛle kɛ, “O Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle mɔɔ ɛde wɔ Belemgbunli ebia nu wɔ abɔdeɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ lɛ ndɛbalɛ la azo anwuma a, ɛdawɔ ala a, ɛle Nyamenle mɔɔ sie arelemgbunli maanle maanle mɔɔ wɔ aleɛabo la a. Ɛdawɔ a ɛbɔle azɛlɛ ye nee anwuma a. 16Na Ɛdɛnkɛma, ɛdawɔ nea mɔɔ akee ɛlɛsisi yɛ nwo zo a. Tie edwɛkɛ mɔɔ Sɛnakɛlebe ɛlɛkeha agua ɛdawɔ tease Nyamenle ne ɛ nyunlu aze a. 17Ɛdɛnkɛma, yɛ muala yɛze kɛ Aselea belemgbunli ɛzɛkye maanle maanle dɔɔnwo, ɛbɔ bɛ bo zo, 18ɛyela bɛ awozonle mɔɔ ɛnle ɛhwee na bɛle ananze mɔɔ menli ɛva mbaka nee awolɛ ɛyɛ la. 19Ɛdɛnkɛma, yɛ Nyamenle, die yɛ fi Aseleama asa anu, amaa ewiade maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti anwu kɛ ɛdawɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ala a ɛle Nyamenle a.”
Nrɛlaleɛ mɔɔ Ayezaya vale rɛlɛle belemgbunli la
(Aye 37.21-38)
20Akee Ayezaya zoanle manle bɛhɔzele Belemgbunli Hɛzikaya kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne ɛbua ye nzɛlɛlɛ ne anwo. Ɔse, “Mede wɔ nzɛlɛlɛ ne mɔɔ fane Aselea Belemgbunli Sɛnakɛlebe anwo la. 21Na kɛ medame Ɛdɛnkɛma mese la ɛne: Sɛnakɛlebe, Gyɛlusalɛm suakpole ye azo amra ɛmbu wɔ bie na bɛsele wɔ. 22Nwane a ɛdwenle kɛ wɔgolo ɔ nwo wɔyɛ ye aholoba la? Wɔambu medame, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle Nwuanzanwuanza ne bie. 23Wɔzoa wɔ menli wɔmaa bɛradu bɛ nloa anu bɛhile me kɛ wɔva wɔ konle ehwili dɔɔnwo wɔli Lɛbanɔn awoka mgbole nwo zo konim. Ɛdule ɛ nloa anu kɛ ɛbubule ɛkɛ ne sida mbaka mgbole mɔɔ wowale, nee sepelɛse mbaka ngɛnlɛma ɛguale na ɛwolole ɛhɔle ɛkɛ ne kpɔkɛmile nu. 24Ɛvale ɛdule ɛ nwo kɛ ɛbɔle bula ɛnlonle nuhua nzule wɔ maanle gyɛne nu, yɛɛ wɔ ɛlɔnema vale bɛ gyakɛ venle Azule Naele ne manle ɔwele resee. 25Asoo ɛtɛtele kɛ mengyehyɛle ɛhye mendole ɛkɛ ne dɛba dɛba yɛɛ kɛkala memaa yeyɛ zɔhane a? Memanle wɔ anwosesebɛ kɛ ɛva ɛbutubutu azuamgbole mɔɔ bɛbɔ nwolɛ bane la anye aze ɛyɛ bɛ azuadu. 26Memanle menli mɔɔ ɛnee wɔ azua zɔhane mɔ azo la asa anu tutole na bɛzulole. Bɛyɛle kɛ ɛya nu ndile anzɛɛ ndile mɔɔ ɛfifi sua ti zo mɔɔ aduduleɛ anwoma wuluwulu ɛlɛbɔ bɛ la.
27“Noko meze ɛ nwo edwɛkɛ biala, meze mɔɔ ɛyɛ nee ɛleka mɔɔ ɛkɔ la. Me nwo ɛya mɔɔ wɔva la meze. 28Wɔ ɛya kpole ne nee wɔ adubɛnwo ne anwo edwɛkɛ ɛdwu me nzo nu. Kɛkala, mebava koba meazɔ ɛ bonyi, meava kɔleɛ meatosa ɛ kɔmenzia na meahwili wɔ mealua ɛleka mɔɔ ɛpenle ɛrale la meahɔ.”
29Akee Ayezaya zele Hɛzikaya kɛ, “Mɔɔ bazi la anwo sɛkɛlɛneɛ a le ɛhye. Ɛvolɛ ɛhye nee ɛvolɛ bieko ɛbali ma mɔɔ bɛ ngome bɛfifi la, na ye ɛvolɛ nsa ne azo yemɔ bɛbazo ɛya, bɛalua, bɛabu, bɛalua vanye mbaka na bɛali zolɛ ma. 30Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ Dwuda na bɛ nwo kɛvi nu la bakpazi kɛ mbaka mɔɔ bɛ ndinli dwu azɛlɛ bo la na bɛazo ma. 31Menli wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm nee Boka Zayɔn azo mɔɔ anwo bavi nu a, ɔboalekɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛbɔ kpɔkɛ kɛ ɔmaa ɛhye azi.
32“Mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛha mɔɔ fane Aselea belemgbunli ne anwo la ɛne. Ɔse, ‘Ɔ gyakɛ ɛnrɛtia suakpole ɛhye azo yɛɛ ɔnrɛdo ɛda ko bɔbɔ ɔnrɛbɔ awie wɔ sua ye azo. Ɛlɔnema mɔɔ dedɛ bɛ sa nu enyinlike la ɛnrɛbikye suakpole ye na bɛaze kɛ bɛkuohua ɛnwea bɛala ɔ nzi bɛahɔ suakpole ye anwo nzia. 33Adenle ne mɔɔ ɔpenle nu ɔrale la, nuhua ala yɛɛ ɔbape yeahɔ a. Suakpole ye ɛdeɛ, ɔnrɛhola zolɛ fo. Medame, Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a. 34Mebalie suakpole ɛhye ati, meawowa ye wɔ me ti, ɔboalekɛ menvale membɔle me akɛlɛ Devidi ɛwɔkɛ.’ ”
35Kenle ko ne nɔe ne Ɛdɛnkɛma soanvolɛ hɔle Aseleama azokoɛleɛ ne hɔhunle ɛlɔnema ne anu apenle ngoko ɛya ko abulatwɛ nee nnu. Aleɛ kahye la ɛnee bɛwu bɛgua ɛkɛ. 36Akee Aselea Belemgbunli Sɛnakɛlebe hwenle ɔ nzi na ɔziale ɔhɔle Nenɛvɛ. 37Kenle ko ɔwɔ ye bozonle Nezelɔko amonle sua ne anu la, ɔ mra mrenya ne mɔ anu nwiɔ, Adelamɛlɛke nee Hyalizɛ rahunle ye na bɛnriandile bɛhɔle Arelalate. Ɔ mra ne mɔ ko mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Yisaahadɔn la lile ebia ne.

Title: 2 ARL 20
Content:
Belemgbunli Hɛzikaya anwondolɛ nee ye kpɔkɛdelɛ
(Aye 38.1-8,21-22; 2 Edk 32.24-26)
1Mekɛ ne anu anwonyane bɔle Belemgbunli Hɛzikaya manle ɔhale ye nee ewule. Na Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ Ayezaya, Emɔzo ara ne, rakpɔlale ye na ɔzele ye kɛ, “Ɛdɛnkɛma se ɛtoto wɔ sua nu ɛke boɛ na ɛnrɛde kpɔkɛ, ɛbawu.”
2Hɛzikaya hakyile ɔ nye bane nwo na ɔzɛlɛle kɛ, 3“Ɛdɛnkɛma, mebodo wɔ, kakye kɛ meyeye me ahonle nu mezonle wɔ nɔhalɛ nu yɛɛ mebɔ mɔdenle biala kɛ menwɔyɛ debie biala mɔɔ ɛkpondɛ kɛ meyɛ la.” Na ɔbɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɔsu.
4Ayezaya vindele kɛ ɔkɔ, noko mɔɔ ɔhɔdwule suakunlu ɛkɛ ne alie ne anwo la Ɛdɛnkɛma zele ye 5kɛ ɔzia ɔhɔ Hɛzikaya mɔɔ sie Ɛdɛnkɛma menli ne la anwo ɛkɛ ɔhɔze ye kɛ, “Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, ɛ nlenya Devidi Nyamenle ne, mede wɔ nzɛlɛlɛ ne, menwu wɔ monle mɔɔ wɔhwi la. Mebayɛ wɔ ayile na ɛnɛ anwo zo kenle nsa, ɛbahɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu. 6Mebamaa wɔadɛnla aze ɛvolɛ bulu nee nnu bieko. Mebalie wɔ nee Gyɛlusalɛm suakpole ye meavi Aselea belemgbunli ne asa anu. Ɔlua me ɛwɔkɛ ne mɔɔ membɔle me sonvolɛ Devidi, nee me duma ne ati, mebalie sua ɛhye ati.”
7Akee Ayezaya zele belemgbunli ne sonvolɛma ne kɛ, bɛdi feege ma bɛrado ye nyila ne azo bɛmaa ɔkpuke. 8Belemgbunli Hɛzikaya bizale kɛ, “Duzu sɛkɛlɛneɛ yɛɛ bahile kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma bayɛ me ayile na ɛnɛ anwo zo kenle nsa meahɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu a?”
9Ayezaya buale kɛ, “Ɛdɛnkɛma bamaa wɔ sɛkɛlɛneɛ yeahile kɛ ɔbali ye ɛwɔkɛ zo. Boni yɛɛ ɛkulo a; ɛkɛhulo kɛ ɛlawolɛ ye mɔɔ wɔ kpolike anlenkɛ ye anloa la kɛhɔ ɔ nyunlu egyakɛ bulu anzɛɛ ɔkɛzia ɔ nzi egyakɛ bulu?”
10Hɛzikaya zele kɛ, “Ɔnyɛ se kɛ ɛlawolɛ ne kɛhɔ ɔ nyunlu egyakɛ bulu a; maa ɔzia ɔ nzi egyakɛ bulu.”
11Ayezaya zɛlɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma, na Ɛdɛnkɛma manle ɛlawolɛ ne hwenle ɔ nzi egyakɛ bulu wɔ kpolike ne mɔɔ Belemgbunli Ehaze zile la anloa.
Soanvolɛma mɔɔ vi Babelonia rale la
(Aye 39.1-8)
12Mekɛ zɔhane ala anu Babelonia Belemgbunli Mɛlodake Baladan, mɔɔ ɔ ze a le Baladan la dele kɛ Belemgbunli Hɛzikaya anwo dole ye, yemɔti ɔvale kɛlata nee ahyɛlɛdeɛ ɔzoanle kɛ bɛva bɛhɔmaa ye. 13Hɛzikaya liele menli mɔɔ bɛzoanle bɛ la gyɛlɛɛnye na ɔvale ye anwonyia muala, ye dwɛtɛ fufule, ezukoa nvutuke, ninyɛne evuanlɛ, nee ye ɛlɔne ninyɛne ɔhilele bɛ. Debie biala ɛnle ɛkɛ mɔɔ yeanva yeangile bɛ a. Ɔvale debie biala mɔɔ wɔ ye belemgbunli maanle ne anu la ɔhilele bɛ. 14Na Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ Ayezaya hɔle Belemgbunli Hɛzikaya ɛkɛ ne hɔbizale ye kɛ, “Menli ɛhye mɔ vi nienwu a rale a, yɛɛ bɛ amaneɛ se duzu?”
Hɛzikaya buale kɛ, “Bɛvi Babelonia a bɛrale a.”
15Ayezaya bizale kɛ, “Yɛɛ duzu debie a bɛnwunle ye wɔ suakunlu ɛkɛ a?”
Belemgbunli ne buale kɛ, “Mengilele bɛ debie biala. Meanva ɛhwee meanvea bɛ.”
16Ayezaya zele belemgbunli ne kɛ, “Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma se 17mekɛ bara mɔɔ bɛbarahwe debie biala mɔɔ wɔ suakunlu ɛke, nee debie biala mɔɔ wɔ mgbanyima ɛgyakyi wɔ la bɛahɔ Babelonia a. Bɛnrɛgyakyi wɔ ɛhwee. 18Ɛdawɔ ɛ bo zo amra fɔɔnwo ne, bɛbahye bie mɔ nuokɛ, bɛaza bɛ bɛamaa bɛazonle Babelonia belemgbunli suakunlu ɛkɛ.”
19Belemgbunli Hɛzikaya dele ɛhye abo kɛ ɔ nwo badɔ ye, ɔ nzo nu adwo ye wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɔde aze la, yemɔti ɔbuale kɛ, “Nrɛlaleɛ mɔɔ ɛ nee ye vi Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛkɛ ne ɛra la ɛnle ɛtane.”
Hɛzikaya belemgbunlililɛ ne awieleɛ
(2 Edk 32.32-33)
20Debie biala mɔɔ Belemgbunli Hɛzikaya yɛle, ye akɛnrasesebɛ gyima mɔɔ ɔlile nee kɛ ɔzile ɔmanle bɛdule kuma bɛmanle nzule luale nu rale suakpole ne azo la, bɛhɛlɛ bɛ muala wɔ Dwuda Arelemgbunli Tetedwɛkɛ Mbuluku ne mɔ anu. 21Hɛzikaya hɔle ayile nu na ɔ ra Manasɛ lile ebia ne.

Title: 2 ARL 21
Content:
Dwuda Belemgbunli Manasɛ
(2 Edk 33.1-20)
1Manasɛ lile ɛvolɛ bulu nee nwiɔ la yɛɛ bɛvale ye bɛziele Dwuda belemgbunli a. Ɔlile ebia ne ɛvolɛ abulanlu nee nnu wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm. Ɔ nli a le Hafezeba. 2Ɔyɛle ninyɛne mɔɔ menli mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma dule bɛ azɛlɛ ne azo wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle menli ne ba la bie na ɔyɛle ɛtane ɔtiale Ɛdɛnkɛma. 3Ɔziale ɔsisile awozonle azua ne mɔ mɔɔ ɔ ze Hɛzikaya manle bɛbubule bɛ la. Ɔsisile azukponle wɔ azua ne mɔ anu kɛ bɛva bɛzonle bozonle Beeyale ne na ɔyɛle bozonle raalɛ Ahyela ne ananze, kɛmɔ Yizilayɛ Belemgbunli Ehabe yɛle la. Manasɛ eza zonlenle nwɔlɔra ne mɔ. 4Ɔsisile awozonle azukponle wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛha kɛ nuhua yɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛsonle ye la anu. 5Ɔsisile azukponle mɔɔ ɔfa ɔsonle nwɔlɔra ne mɔ la wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne alie nwiɔ ne anwo ɛkɛ. 6Ɔhunle ɔ kunlu ralɛ nrenya ɔyelale ye ɔbɔle azu. Ɔkpale munzule, ɔyele ngonyia na ɔhɔle menli mɔɔ tendɛ nwomenle nloa zo, nyɛne nee menli mɔɔ bɔ menli munzule la anwo ɔhɔbizebizale ɔ nwo. Ɔyɛle ɛtane kpole ɔtiale Ɛdɛnkɛma na ɔmanle ɔvale ɛya. 7Ɔvale bozonle raalɛ Ahyela ne ananze ne ɔziele Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu ɛleka mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Devidi nee ɔ ra Sɔlɔmɔn kɛ, “Wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm ɛke Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ɛhye anu yɛɛ mekpa nu meye ye wɔ Yizilayɛ mbusua ekpunli bulu nee nwiɔ ne anu, kɛ ɔle ɛleka mɔɔ bɛsonle me a.” 8Ɛdɛnkɛma zele kɛ, “Saa Yizilayɛma kɛyɛ tieyɛ kɛmaa me na bɛkɛli me Mɛla ne kpokpoti mɔɔ me sonvolɛ Mosisi vale manle bɛ la azo a, anrɛɛ menrɛmaa bɛnrɛdu bɛ bɛnrɛvi azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ menvale memanle bɛ nlenya mɔ la azo.” 9Noko Dwudama anyɛ tieyɛ ammaa Ɛdɛnkɛma, yɛɛ Manasɛ bɔbɔ akee manle menli ne yɛle ɛtane kpole bole mɔɔ maanle maanle mɔɔ ɛnee de azɛlɛ ne azo la yɛle la azo. Ɛdɛnkɛma dule menli zɔhane wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ Yizilayɛma ba la.
10Ɛdɛnkɛma luale ye sonvolɛ kpɔmanvolɛma ne mɔ anwo zo hanle kɛ, 11“Belemgbunli Manasɛ ɛbɔ munzule mgbole mgbole ɛhye mɔ, yeyɛ amumuyɛ yedɛla mɔɔ Keenama yɛle bɔbɔ la, yeva ye awozonle ɛzonlenlɛ yemaa Dwuda amuala ɛyɛ ɛtane. 12Yemɔti medame, Yizilayɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle, mebava munzule kpole mearado Gyɛlusalɛm nee Dwudama anwo zo, amaa yeayɛ awie biala mɔɔ kɛde la azibɛnwo. 13Mebadea Gyɛlusalɛm, kɛmɔ mendeanle Samɛlea la, nee kɛmɔ menvale menyɛle Yizilayɛ Belemgbunli Ehabe nee ɔ bo zo amra la. Mebabɔ Gyɛlusalɛm tɔɔ meahu menli mɔɔ wɔ zolɛ la amuala, meakpoɔkpoa zolɛ bɔkɔɔ kɛ bɛkpoa ewula la. 14Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛbavi ɛsalɛ la menrɛkpo bɛ bo zo. Mebaye bɛ meamaa bɛ kpɔvolɛma meamaa bɛali bɛ nwo zo konim na bɛava bɛ ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti. 15Mebayɛ ɛhye meamaa me menli ne, ɔboalekɛ bɛyɛ ɛtane bɛtia me, yɛɛ sumunli kɛ menyele bɛ nlenya mɔ menvile Yigyibiti toonwo mɔɔ yeradwu ɛnɛ la ɛya ala a bɛka me a.”
16Manasɛ hunle menli dɔɔnwo mɔɔ ɛnze nwolɛ bie la ɔmanle Gyɛlusalɛm gua bile ne mɔ azo yɛle mogya ngome. Ɔyɛle ɛhye na eza ɔmanle menli ne zonlenle awozonle, bɛzɔle mmonle, na bɛyɛle ɛtane bɛtiale Ɛdɛnkɛma.
17Debie bieko mɔɔ Manasɛ yɛle nee ye ɛtane ne mɔ mɔɔ ɔyɛle la, bɛhɛlɛ bɛ wɔ Dwuda Arelemgbunli Tetedwɛkɛ Mbuluku ne mɔ anu. 18Manasɛ hɔle ayile nu na bɛwulale ye mrɛlatɛlɛ nu wɔ suakunlu ɛkɛ ne tola ne anu. Tola ne le Ɛza ɛdeɛ. Na Manasɛ ara nrenya Emɔn lile ebia ne.
Dwuda Belemgbunli Emɔn
(2 Edk 33.21-25)
19Emɔn lile ɛvolɛ abulanwiɔ nee nwiɔ la yɛɛ bɛvale ye bɛlile belemgbunli a. Ɔlile ebia ne ɛvolɛ nwiɔ wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm. Ɔ nli a le Mɛhyɛlɛmɛte mɔɔ ɔ ze a le Hɛlɛse la. Ɔvi Dwɔtoba sua zo. 20Ɔvale ɔ ze Manasɛ agyakɛ na ɔyɛle ɛtane ɔtiale Ɛdɛnkɛma. 21Ɔzukoale ɔyɛle ɔ ze nyɛleɛ ne bie na ɔzonlenle ɔ ze awozonle nee mmonle ne mɔ mɔɔ ɔzonlenle bɛ la bie. 22Ɔkpole Ɛdɛnkɛma, ɔ nlenya mɔ Nyamenle ne, na ɔkpole kɛ ɔnrɛli Ɛdɛnkɛma mɛla zo.
23Emɔn safohyenlema ne hɔle ɔ ti akpamo na bɛhunle ye wɔ suakunlu ɛkɛ ne. 24Akee menli mɔɔ wɔ Dwuda la hunle menli mɔɔ hunle Emɔn la, na bɛvale Emɔn ara nrenya Dwosaya bɛziele belemgbunli.
25Debie biala mɔɔ Emɔn yɛle la bɛhɛlɛle bɛ wɔ Dwuda Arelemgbunli Tetedwɛkɛ Mbuluku ne mɔ anu. 26Bɛziele Emɔn wɔ ɔdaye ye nla nu wɔ Ɛza tola ne anu na ɔ ra Dwosaya lile ebia ne.

Title: 2 ARL 22
Content:
Dwuda Belemgbunli Dwosaya
(2 Edk 34.1-2)
1Dwosaya lile ɛvolɛ mɔtwɛ ala la yɛɛ bɛvale ye bɛziele Dwudama belemgbunli a. Ɔlile ebia ne ɛvolɛ abulasa nee ko wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm. Ɔ nli a le Adaya mɔɔ vi Bɔzokate la ara raalɛ Gyɛdaeda. 2Dwosaya yɛle mɔɔ sɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anye la. Ɔvale ɔ nlenya Devidi agyakɛ na ɔlile Nyamenle Mɛla ne mɔ azo kpalɛ kpalɛ.
Bɛnwu Mɛla Buluku ne
(2 Edk 34.8-28)
3Belemgbunli Dwosaya lile ɛvolɛ bulu nee mɔtwɛ wɔ ebia ne azo la ɔzoanle ye Kɔɔto kɛlɛhɛlɛvolɛ ne, Azalaya ara Hyeefan, mɔɔ ɔ nlenya a le Mɛhyɛlam la wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu kɛ, 4“Kɔ Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli Helekaya ɛkɛ kɔbiza ezukoa dodo mɔɔ sɛlɛvolɛma mɔɔ wɔ anlenkɛ ne anloa la ɛnyia ye ɛvi menli ne mɔ lɔ la. 5Na ka kile ye kɛ ɔva ezukoa ne ɔmaa menli mɔɔ nea Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne boɛyɛlɛ zo la, na bɛva bɛdua 6kapentama, menli mɔɔ si sua la, menli mɔɔ gua belekese la, nee menli mɔɔ kpuke awolɛ la, bɛva bie bɛdɔ mgbunla nee awolɛ mɔɔ bɛfa bɛayɛ sua ne boɛ la. 7Menli mɔɔ nea gyima ne azo la di nɔhalɛ bɔkɔɔ, yemɔti ɔngyia kɛ bɛkɛze bɛ kɛ bɛrayɛ mgbonda.”
8Hyeefan vale belemgbunli ne nrɛlaleɛ ne hɔle na Helekaya hanle hilele Hyeefan kɛ, yenwu Mɛla Buluku ne wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu. Helekaya vale buluku ne manle Hyeefan gengale. 9Akee Hyeefan ziale hɔle belemgbunli ɛkɛ ne na ɔhanle kɛ, “Wɔ sonvolɛma ne ɛva Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu ezukoa ne ɛmaa menli mɔɔ nea sua ne boɛyɛlɛ zo la. 10Na melɛ buluku bie mɔɔ Helekaya ɛva ɛmaa me la wɔ ɛke.” Na ɔgengale ɔhilele belemgbunli ne.
11Belemgbunli ne dele edwɛkɛ mɔɔ wɔ buluku ne anu la, ɔ rɛle bɔle na ɔsuosuanle ye tɛladeɛ ne mɔɔ ɔwula la anu, 12na ɔmanle bɛvɛlɛle sɛlɛvolɛ Helekaya, Hyeefan ara Ahaekam, Maekaya ara Akebɔ, Hyeefan ɔdaye mumua ne, yɛɛ belemgbunli sinzavolɛ Asaya, na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, 13“Bɛbɔ me ti nee Dwudama amuala ati bɛhɔbiza Ɛdɛnkɛma buluku ɛhye anu ngilehilelɛ ne anu. Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛva yɛ nwo ɛya, ɔboalekɛ yɛ nlenya mɔ anli mɔɔ buluku ɛhye ka la azo.”
14Yemɔti sɛlɛvolɛ Helekaya, Ahaekam, Akebɔ, Hyeefan, yɛɛ Asaya hɔle Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ raalɛ bie mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Hɛleda, mɔɔ de Gyɛlusalɛm sua fofolɛ zo la anwo ɛkɛ bɛhɔbizale. (Raalɛ ne ɔ hu a le Tekeva ara Hyalɛm, mɔɔ ɔ nlenya a le Haahase la. Hyalɛm a nea Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu adɛladeɛ ne mɔ azo a.) Bɛhilehilele mɔɔ ɛzi la anu bɛhilele raalɛ ne, 15na raalɛ ne zele bɛ kɛ, bɛzia bɛhɔ belemgbunli ne ɛkɛ na bɛhɔze ye kɛ, 16Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Mebadea Gyɛlusalɛm nee menli mɔɔ wɔ zolɛ la amuala, kɛmɔ bɛhɛlɛ ye wɔ buluku ne mɔɔ belemgbunli ɛgenga la anu la. 17Bɛkpo me na bɛbɔ azu bɛmaa awozonle. Bɛva bɛ nyɛleɛ bɛha me ɛya kpole kpalɛ. Ɛya mɔɔ meva ye wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm anwo la, ɛnrɛwie ɛlɛ. 18Dwuda belemgbunli ne mɔɔ zoanle wɔ kɛ ɛrazɛlɛ me ɛmaa ye la, ka kile ye kɛ: Kɛ medame, Yizilayɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle mese la ɛne: Ɛdele edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ bɛhɛlɛ ye wɔ buluku ne anu 19na ɛdele kɛ mezi medendɛ metia ɛke, kɛ mebamaa yeadɔ mgbane na bɛazɛkye menli ne amuala la ati ɛvunle ɛ nwo na ɛbɛlɛle ɛ nwo aze wɔ me nyunlu, ɛsuosuanle wɔ tɛladeɛ mɔɔ ɛwula la anu, na ɛzunle. Medame noko mede wɔ nzɛlɛlɛ ne. 20Yemɔti, nea, ɛnrɛnwu, ndeanlɛ ne mɔɔ mebadea Gyɛlusalɛm la ɛnrɛra zolɛ toonwo ɛkɛwu. Mebamaa wɔawu anzonudwolɛ nu, wɔahɔla ɛ ze mɔ akunlu.”
Menli ne mɔ ziale rale Belemgbunli Dwosaya ɛkɛ na bɛrahanle ye nrɛlaleɛ ne bɛhilele ye.

Title: 2 ARL 23
Content:
Dwosaya sɛkye awozonle ɛzonlenlɛ
(2 Edk 34.3-7,29-33)
1Belemgbunli Dwosaya yieyiale Dwuda nee Gyɛlusalɛm mgbanyima ne mɔ 2na bɛ muala bɛhɔle Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu. Sɛlɛvolɛma, Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma, nee menli ne mɔ amuala, sukoavolɛma nee ehyianvolɛma amuala boka nwolɛ a bɛhɔle a. Akee belemgbunli ne gengale ngyekyeleɛ buluku ne mɔɔ bɛnwunle ye wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu la hilele bɛ 3ɔgyinlanle mpila ne anwo na ɔvuale ɔhilele Ɛdɛnkɛma kɛ ɔbayɛ tieyɛ yeamaa ye, ɔbali ye mɛla ne mɔ azo, na yeayɛ debie biala mɔɔ ngyekyeleɛ ne kile kɛ bɛyɛ la, kɛmɔ bɛhɛlɛ ye wɔ buluku ne anu la. Na menli ne kɔsɔɔti bɛdabɛ bɛbɔle ɛwɔkɛ kɛ bɛkɛli ngyekyeleɛ ne azo.
4 Akee Belemgbunli Dwosaya zele Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli Helekaya, sɛlɛvolɛma mɔɔ boa ye, yɛɛ sinzavolɛma mɔɔ wɔ gyima nu wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne nlenkɛ ne mɔ anloa la kɛ bɛhwe debie biala mɔɔ bɛfa bɛsonle bozonle Beeyale, bozonle raalɛ Ahyela, yɛɛ anwumaneamra ne mɔ mɔɔ wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu la bɛvinde. Belemgbunli vale bɛ kɔsɔɔti hɔle Gyɛlusalɛm kandiba mɔɔ kɔne Azule Kedelɔn ne anloa la na ɔyelale bɛ, na ɔmanle bɛvale bɛ nzonle ne bɛhɔle Bɛtɛle. 5Ɔyele sɛlɛvolɛma mɔɔ Dwuda arelemgbunli vale bɛ manle bɛbɔle azu wɔ awozonle azua mɔɔ wɔ Dwuda nee Gyɛlusalɛm la anu la amuala ali. Sɛlɛvolɛma ɛhye mɔ bɔle azu manle bozonle Beeyale ne, sɛnzɛne ne, siane ne, yɛɛ nwɔlɔra nee anwumaneamra kɔsɔɔti.
6Ɔyele bozonle raalɛ Ahyela ananze ne ɔvile Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu ɔvale ɔhɔle Gyɛlusalɛm kandiba wɔ Azule Kedelɔn ne anloa, ɔhɔyelale ye na ɔpele ɔmanle ɔyɛle motomoto, na ɔvale ɔkpondenle ye wɔ menli mgbanema nla zo wɔ maanle azie ne azo. 7Belemgbunli Dwosaya eza manle bɛzɛkyele ɛleka mɔɔ bɛzieziele bɛmanle tuutuuma wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu la. (Ɛkɛ ne yɛɛ mraalɛ ne mɔ nwo adɛladeɛ mɔɔ bɛfa bɛsonle bozonle raalɛ Ahyela ne la a.) 8Ɔmanle bɛ nee sɛlɛvolɛma mɔɔ wɔ Dwuda maanle ne anu la amuala rale Gyɛlusalɛm na ɔzɛkyele azukponle biala mɔɔ bɛyɛle maanle ne anu, ɔvi Giba mɔɔ kɔdwu Biyɛhyiba la. Eza ɔmanle bɛbubule azukponle ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛsisile bɛmanle mmonle ne mɔ mɔɔ ɛnee wɔ anlenkɛ kpole ne mɔɔ Dwɔhyua, mɔɔ le suakpole ne azo neavolɛ ne zile la anloa la. Mmonle zɔhane, saa ɛlɛwolo suakpole ne azo anuhɔlɛ kpole ne anu a ɛnee ɔwɔ bɛne zo. 9Sɛlɛvolɛma zɔhane mɔ mɔɔ rale la yeammaa bɛanyɛ gyima wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne mɔɔ wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm la anu, noko bɛmanle bɛ adenle bɛmanle bɛlile kpanwo ne mɔɔ mgbɔvonle ɛnle nu mɔɔ bɛkɛva bɛkɛmaa sɛlɛvolɛma la bie.
10Belemgbunli Dwosaya eza zɛkyele Tofɛte amonle sua ne mɔɔ wɔ Henɔm Bɔnza ne anu la, amaa awie anyela ɔ ra raalɛ anzɛɛ nrenya wɔ ɛkɛ ne ambɔ azu ammaa bozonle Molɛke. 11Eza ɔyeyele mgbɔnwɔ ne mɔ mɔɔ Dwuda arelemgbunli ɛdu ɛzie ɛkɛ ɛmaa sɛnzɛne ne ɛzonlenlɛ la. Ɔmanle bɛyelale ehwili ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛfa bɛyɛ ɛzonlenlɛ ne la. (Ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ ɛnee wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne alie kpole ne anlenkɛ kpole ne anloa mɔɔ kɔne ɛleka mɔɔ abɔlɔba kpanyinli Neetan Milɛke de la.) 12Azukponle ne mɔ mɔɔ Dwuda arelemgbunli ɛsisi wɔ suakunlu ɛkɛ ne azua ne mɔ ati zo ɛleka mɔɔ Belemgbunli Ehaze dɛnlanle la, Belemgbunli Dwosaya bubule bɛ. Eza ɔbubule nuhua ne mɔ mɔɔ Belemgbunli Manasɛ sisile wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne alie nwiɔ ne anwo la. Ɔbubule azukponle ne mɔ anu ngyikyi ngyikyi na bɛvuandinle bɛguale Kedelɔn bɔnza ne anu. 13Dwosaya eza zɛkyele azukponle ne mɔɔ Belemgbunli Sɔlɔmɔn zile wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm aduduleɛ, wɔ Ɔlivi Boka ne nyiakɛ kɛ bɛva bɛzonle Saedɛn bozonle raalɛ Asetate, Mowabe bozonle Kimɔhye, nee Amɔn bozonle ne la.
14Belemgbunli Dwosaya manle bɛbubule awolɛ mpila ne mɔ na bɛzɛkyele bozonle raalɛ Ahyela ananze ne. Ɔvulale menli avunli mbowule ɔraguguale ɛleka mɔɔ anrɛɛ mmonle ɛhye mɔ gyigyi la.
15Belemgbunli Dwosaya manle bɛbubule ɛzonlenlɛ sua bie mɔɔ Belemgbunli Gyɛlɔbowam, Nibate ara ne zile wɔ Bɛtɛle la. Gyɛlɔbowam ɛhye a manle Yizilayɛma kɔsɔɔti yɛle ɛtane la. Dwosaya bubule azukponle ne, ɔbubule ye awolɛ ne mɔ anu na ɔmanle bɛpele ye motomoto. Eza ɔmanle bɛyelale Ahyela ananze ne. 16Dwosaya nleɛnleanle nu na ɔnwunle kɛ sɛka bie mɔ wɔ boka ne azo lɔ. Ɔmanle bɛzale avunli zɔhane mɔ mbowule na ɔyelale bɛ wɔ azukponle ne azo. Ɔvale ɛhye ɔzɛkyele azukponle ne ɔmanle mɔɔ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ ne hanle ye dɛba wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ Belemgbunli Gyɛlɔbowam ɛnee gyi azukponle ne anyunlu la yɛle nɔhalɛ. 17Dwosaya nwunle nla bie. Na ɔbizale kɛ, “Nwane nla a wɔ nehane la?”
Bɛtɛlema buale kɛ, “Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ ne mɔɔ vi Dwuda rahanle ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ mɔɔ ɛnɛ wɔva wɔyɛ azukponle ɛhye la nla ɔ.”
18Belemgbunli ne zele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛgyakyi ye ɛkɛ. Bɛmmafa bɛ sa bɛka ye bɛtu ye mbowule.”
Yemɔti bɛanza ye mbowule ne yɛɛ bɛanza Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ ne mɔɔ vi Samɛlea la noko mbowule ne.
19Belemgbunli Dwosaya bubule azukponle nee azua mɔɔ Yizilayɛ arelemgbunli ɛsisi wɔ azuamgbole ne mɔ azo na bɛfa bɛsonle awozonle la. Ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ a manle Ɛdɛnkɛma vale ɛya la. Mɔɔ ɔvale ɔyɛle Bɛtɛle azukponle ne mɔ la bie a ɔvale ɔyɛle azukponle ne mɔ mɔɔ ɛha la a. 20Ɔhunle ahɔmenle ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti wɔ bɛ azukponle ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛfa bɛyɛ bɛ ɛzonlenle la azo na ɔyelale menli mbowule wɔ azukponle ne mɔ azo. Akee ɔziale ɔhɔle Gyɛlusalɛm.
Dwosaya di Akpabɛnwo Ɛvoyia ne
(2 Edk 35.1-19)
21Belemgbunli Dwosaya akee yɛle kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛdi Akpabɛnwo Ɛvoyia ne bɛfa bɛwula Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne anyunlunyia, kɛmɔ bɛhɛlɛ ye wɔ ngyekyeleɛ buluku ne anu la. 22Ɔvi mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee ndɛnebuavolɛma a bu Yizilayɛ maanle ne toonwo mɔɔ radwule Dwuda nee Yizilayɛ arelemgbunli mekɛ zo la, bɛtɛdile Akpabɛnwo Ɛvoyia zɛhae bie ɛlɛ. 23Mɔɔ Dwosaya lile ɛvolɛ bulu nee mɔtwɛ wɔ ebia ne azo la yɛɛ ɔmanle bɛlile ɛvoyia ne bieko wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm a.
Ngakyile bie mɔ mɔɔ Dwosaya yɛle la
24Amaa menli ne ahola ali mɛla ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛhɛlɛ wɔ buluku ne mɔɔ Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli Helekaya nwunle ye wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu la azo la, Belemgbunli Dwosaya manle bɛdule menli mɔɔ tendɛ nwomenle nloa azo nee menli mɔɔ bɔ menli munzule la wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm nee Dwuda maanle ne anu, na bɛzɛkyele sua nu mmonle nee awozonle ɛzonlenlɛ nee debie biala mɔɔ Nyamenle kyi na bɛsonle ye la. 25Arelemgbunli mɔɔ lumuale Dwosaya anyunlu la, biala ɛnle ɛkɛ mɔɔ yeyele ye ahonle nu zonlenle Nyamenle kpalɛ kɛ ɔdaye Dwosaya la. Ɔvale ye adwenle nee ye anwosesebɛ ɔlile Mosisi Mɛla ne azo, yɛɛ sumunli kɛ ɔvile ɛkɛ ne la belemgbunli biala ɛtɛbale mɔɔ nee ye sɛ a.
26Noko akee Belemgbunli Manasɛ ɛtane mɔɔ yɛle tiale Ɛdɛnkɛma la ati Ɛdɛnkɛma vale Dwuda anwo ɛya kpole, na ɛya zɔhane ɛtɛdwole.
27Ɛdɛnkɛma zele kɛ, “Mɔɔ meva meyɛ Yizilayɛma la zɔhane ala yɛɛ mebava meayɛ Dwudama a. Mebaye Dwudama meavi me nye zo, mebakpo Gyɛlusalɛm suakpole ne mɔɔ medame mekpa nu meye la, ɔ nee Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne mɔɔ mese ɛkɛ ne a le ɛleka mɔɔ bɛzonle me la.”
Dwosaya belemgbunlililɛ ne awieleɛ
(2 Edk 35.20—36.1)
28Debie biala mɔɔ Belemgbunli Dwosaya yɛle la bɛhɛlɛ bɛ muala wɔ Dwuda Arelemgbunli Tetedwɛkɛ Mbuluku ne mɔ anu. 29Mɔɔ Dwosaya a di belemgbunli la Yigyibiti Belemgbunli Niko vale ye ɛlɔnema rale Azule Yufileti ne anloa kɛ bɛbaboa Aselea belemgbunli ne. Belemgbunli Dwosaya yɛle kɛ ɔsi Yigyibiti ɛlɔnema ne aze wɔ Mɛgedo, na konle zɔhane anu yɛɛ Belemgbunli Niko hunle ye a. 30Ye safohyenle mgbanyinli ne mɔ vale ye dole konle ehwili nu na bɛ nee ye rale Gyɛlusalɛm bɛrawulale ye mrɛlatɛlɛ nu wɔ ɔdaye ye nla mɔɔ ɔpɛle la anu.
Dwudama yele Dwosaya ara Dwowahaze, bɛkpokpale ye nwole na bɛziele ye belemgbunli.
Dwuda Belemgbunli Dwowahaze
(2 Edk 36.2-4)
31Dwowahaze lile ɛvolɛ abulanwiɔ nee nsa la yɛɛ bɛziele ye Dwuda belemgbunli a, yɛɛ ɔdɛnlanle ebia ne azo siane nsa wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm. Ɔ nli a le Gyɛlɛmaya mɔɔ vi Lebena la ara raalɛ Hamutale. 32Ɔvale ɔ nlenya mɔ agyakɛ na ɔyɛle ɛtane ɔtiale Ɛdɛnkɛma. 33Ye belemgbunlililɛ ne bɔle aze wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ Yigyibiti belemgbunli Niko hyele ye wɔ Relebela mɔɔ wɔ Heemate azɛlɛ zo la, na ɔmanle Dwudama duale adwule dwɛtɛ fufule kilo apenle nsa ɛya nna yɛɛ ezukoa nvutuke kilo abulasa nee nna manle ye. 34Akee Belemgbunli Niko manle bɛvale Dwosaya ara Yelayakem bɛziele Dwuda belemgbunli ɔlile Dwosaya agya. Ɔhakyile Yelayakem duma ɔyɛle ye Gyɛhɔyakem. Belemgbunli Niko vale Dwowahaze hɔle Yigyibiti, na ɛkɛ ne a ɔwule a.
Dwuda Belemgbunli Gyɛhɔyakem
(2 Edk 36.5-8)
35Belemgbunli Gyɛhɔyakem dele adwule manle menli ne duale, kɛmɔ biala ezukoa gyinlabelɛ de la, amaa yeanyia ezukoa mɔɔ sa adwule ne mɔɔ Yigyibiti ɛde ɛmaa Dwudama kɛ bɛdua la tua.
36Gyɛhɔyakem lile ɛvolɛ abulanwiɔ nee nnu la yɛɛ ɔyɛle Dwuda belemgbunli a, yɛɛ ɔlile ebia ne ɛvolɛ bulu nee ko wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm. Ɔ nli a le Pɛdaya mɔɔ vi Wulumaa la ara raalɛ Zɛbaeda. 37Ɔvale ɔ nlenya mɔ agyakɛ na ɔyɛle ɛtane ɔtiale Ɛdɛnkɛma.

Title: 2 ARL 24
Content:
1Mɔɔ Gyɛhɔyakem di belemgbunli la, Babelonia Belemgbunli Nɛbukadenɛza ravale Dwudama aze, ɔholole bɛ nwo zo, ɔmanle Gyɛhɔyakem dole ɔ nloa aze kɛ ɔwɔ ɔ bo na ɔzonlenle ye ɛvolɛ nsa. Nzinlii Gyɛhɔyakem dele atua kɛ ɔnrɛzonle ye bieko. 2Ɛdɛnkɛma manle Babelonia, Selea, Mowabe, nee Amɔn ɛlɔnema rale Gyɛhɔyakem anwo zo na bɛzɛkyele Dwuda bɔkɔɔ, kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma luale ye sonvolɛma, kpɔmanvolɛma ne anwo zo hanle kɛ ɔbayɛ la. 3Ɛdɛnkɛma a manle ɛhye zile a, amaa ɔlua ɛtane ne mɔ mɔɔ Belemgbunli Manasɛ yɛle la ati, yeaye Dwudama yeavi ɔ nye zo bɔkɔɔ.
4Ɛtane kpole ko bɔbɔ mɔɔ Manasɛ yɛle la a le menli mɔɔ ɛnze nwolɛ bie na ɔmanle bɛhunle bɛ la. Ɛdɛnkɛma fa Manasɛ ɛtane kyɛ ye wɔ ɛhye anwo a ɔnrɛyɛ boɛ.
5Debie biala mɔɔ Gyɛhɔyakem yɛle la bɛhɛlɛ bɛ muala wɔ Dwuda Arelemgbunli Tetedwɛkɛ Mbuluku ne mɔ anu. 6Gyɛhɔyakem hɔle ayile nu na ɔ ra Gyɛhɔyakɛn lile ye agya, dɛnlanle ebia ne azo.
7Yigyibiti belemgbunli nee ye ɛlɔnema ne vi bɛ maanle ne anu anvinde bieko, ɔboalekɛ ɛnee Babelonia belemgbunli a sie maanle maanle mɔɔ ɛnee wɔ Yigyibiti abo la a, ɔvi Azule Yufileti ne anloa mɔɔ kɔgua Yigyibiti ɛweɛne zo la.
Dwuda Belemgbunli Gyɛhɔyakɛn
(2 Edk 36.9-10)
8Gyɛhɔyakɛn lile ɛvolɛ bulu nee mɔtwɛ la yɛɛ ɔralile Dwuda belemgbunli a. Ɔdɛnlanle ebia ne azo siane nsa wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm. Ɔ nli a le Ɛleneetan mɔɔ vi Gyɛlusalɛm la ara raalɛ Nɛhɛhyeta. 9Gyɛhɔyakɛn vale ɔ ze agyakɛ na ɔyɛle ɛtane ɔtiale Ɛdɛnkɛma.
10Ɔradɛnlanle Dwuda ebia ne azo la yɛɛ Babelonia ɛlɔnema mɔɔ Belemgbunli Nɛbukadenɛza safohyenlema a li bɛ ti la rabɛnrale yiale Gyɛlusalɛm kɛ bɛ nee ye ko a. 11Mekɛ mɔɔ ɛlɔnema ne bɛnrale yiale Gyɛlusalɛm la yɛɛ Nɛbukadenɛza mumua ne rale Gyɛlusalɛm a, 12na Belemgbunli Gyɛhɔyakɛn, nee ɔ nli, ɔ mra, ye safohyenlema, nee suakunlu mgbanyima ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti dole bɛ nloa aze manle Babeloniama ne. Ɛnee Nɛbukadenɛza ɛli ɛvolɛ mɔtwɛ wɔ Babelonia ebia ne azo la yɛɛ ɔrahyele Gyɛhɔyakɛn nuokɛ 13ɔ nee ye hɔle Babelɔn a. Ɔzoale Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu nee suakunlu ɛkɛ ne ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti ɔhɔle. Kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma hanle dole ɛkɛ ne la, Nɛbukadenɛza bubule ezukoa nvutuke dwora ne mɔ mɔɔ Belemgbunli Sɔlɔmɔn manle bɛyɛle mɔɔ bɛfa bɛsonle wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu la amuala. 14Nɛbukadenɛza hyele menli mɔɔ wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm la nuokɛ, arelemgbunli mra mrenya nee menli titile mɔɔ wɔ suakpole ne azo la amuala na ɔ nee bɛ hɔle; bɛlua menli apenle bulu. Eza ɔvale dwinvolɛma nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛze bɛ sa anloa gyima la kɔsɔɔti ɔhɔle na ɔgyakyile bɛdabɛ mɔɔ ehyia ɛwie bɛ ti enrinli tudu wɔ Dwuda maanle ne anu la.
15Nɛbukadenɛza hyele Gyɛhɔyakɛn, ɔ nli, ye mraalɛ, ye mgbanyima nee menli titile mɔɔ wɔ Dwuda la nuokɛ ɔ nee bɛ hɔle Babelɔn. 16Nɛbukadenɛza eza dule menli mɔɔ anwo hyia la kɔsɔɔti vile maanle ne anu, ɔ nee bɛ hɔle Babelonia. Bɛlua menli apenle nsuu, yɛɛ menli mɔɔ ze gyima la apenle ko; dwinvolɛma boka nwolɛ. Menli ɛhye mɔ amuala le menli mɔɔ te kpɔkɛ na bɛkola bɛkɔ konle nloa a.
17Nɛbukadenɛza vale Gyɛhɔyakɛn awuvuanyi Matanaya yɛle Dwuda belemgbunli na ɔdonle ye Zɛdikaya.
Dwuda Belemgbunli Zɛdikaya
(2 Edk 36.11-12; Gyɛ 52.1-3)
18Zɛdikaya lile ɛvolɛ abulanwiɔ nee ko la yɛɛ ɔralile Dwuda belemgbunli a. Ɔlile ebia ne ɛvolɛ bulu Lebena la ara raalɛ Hamutale. 19Belemgbunli Zɛdikaya yɛle ɛtane tiale Ɛdɛnkɛma, kɛmɔ Belemgbunli Gyɛhɔyakem yɛle la. 20Ɛdɛnkɛma vale menli mɔɔ wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm nee Dwuda la anwo ɛya kpole kpalɛ na ɔyele ɔ nye wɔ bɛ nwo zo.

Title: 2 ARL 25
Content:
Gyɛlusalɛm ɛbɔlɛ
(2 Edk 36.13-21; Gyɛ 52.3-11)
1 Zɛdikaya dele Babelonia Belemgbunli Nɛbukadenɛza anwo atua. Yemɔti Nɛbukadenɛza vale ye ɛlɔnema rabɛnrale yiale Gyɛlusalɛm kɛ bɛ nee menli mɔɔ wɔ ɛkɛ ne la baho. Ɛhye zile mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee Zɛdikaya ɛli ɛvolɛ ngɔnla siane bulu, kenle bulu wɔ ebia ne azo la. Nɛbukadenɛza ɛlɔnema ne yɛle bɛ azokoɛleɛ wɔ suakpole ne kandiba, bɛpɛle ahuma na bɛhyele ɛhane bɛlale nu. 2Bɛyɛle ɛhye toonwo Zɛdikaya lile ɛvolɛ bulu nee ko wɔ ebia ne azo. 3Ɛvolɛ zɔhane siane nna ne anu kenle ngɔnla ne azo, mɔɔ akee ɛhɔne ɛmaa Gyɛlusalɛm amra ɛwie debie yɛ, na bɛnlɛ ɛhwee bɛnli la 4 yɛɛ Babeloniama bule suakpole ne bane ne hɔle sua ne azo a. Ɛnee Babelonia ɛlɔnema ɛbɛnra ɛyia suakpole ne ɛdeɛ, noko Dwuda ɛlɔnema ne amuala holale nriandile hɔle nɔe ne. Bɛvale arelemgbunli tola ne anu bɛhɔvale anuhɔlɛ kpole ne mɔɔ wɔ suakpole ne bane nwiɔ ne ayia zo la, bɛvale Dwɔdan Bɔnza ne adenle zo bɛnriandile. 5Noko Babelonia ɛlɔnema ne voanle Belemgbunli Zɛdikaya hɔhyele ye wɔ fienemgbole bie mɔɔ bikye Gyɛleko la anu, na ye ɛlɔnema ne bɔle asande. 6Bɛvale Zɛdikaya bɛhɔmanle Belemgbunli Nɛbukadenɛza; ɛnee ɔwɔ suakpole bie mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Relebela la azo, na ɛkɛ ne yɛɛ ɔbuale Zɛdikaya fɔlɛ a. 7 Bɛmanle Zɛdikaya gyinlanle nleanle ɔ mra mrenya ne mɔ ɛhunlɛ nu, na akee Nɛbukadenɛza manle bɛzinle ɔ nye, bɛguale ye nwɔnzɔnwɔnzɔ na bɛ nee ye hɔle Babelɔn.
Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne ɛzɛkyelɛ
(Gyɛ 52.12-23)
8Mɔɔ Belemgbunli Nɛbukadenɛza lile ɛvolɛ bulu nee ngɔnla siane nnu, kenle nsuu wɔ Babelɔn ebia ne azo la, ye Safohyenlema Kpanyinli ne, Nɛbuzaladan, mɔɔ yemɔ a tu belemgbunli ne folɛ la ravole Gyɛlusalɛm. 9Ɔyelale Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne, belemgbunli suakunlu nee menli mɔɔ anwo hyia Gyɛlusalɛm la azua ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti. 10Akee ye ɛlɔnema bubule Gyɛlusalɛm bane ne mɔ guale aze. 11Na Nɛbuzaladan vale menli mɔɔ hale suakpole ne azo mɔɔ ze gyima, nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛva bɛ nwo bɛmaa Babeloniama la amuala hɔle Babelonia. 12Ɔgyakyile Dwudama mɔɔ yɛ anwunvɔne, na bɛnlɛ ɛhwee la ɛkɛ kɛ bɛyɛ gyima wɔ vanye egyinli ne mɔ anu.
13 Babeloniama akee bubule kɔbele mpila ne mɔ, nee kɔbele ehwili ne mɔ mɔɔ wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu la, nee kɔbele angola kpole ne, na bɛvale bɛ muala bɛhɔle Babelɔn. 14 Eza bɛsesale sofi ne mɔ, ahyɛnze ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛgua azukponle ne azo nzonle ne wɔ nu, ninyɛne ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛfa bɛka ahɛnlaneɛ ne mɔ anu bɛnua anzɛɛ bɛsɔ la, dwora ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛfa bɛsɔ azubɔlɛ mogya ne, dwora ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛfa bɛyela ɛyɛlɛ, nee kɔbele debie biala mɔɔ bɛfa bɛyɛ gyima wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu la bɛhɔle. 15Debie biala mɔɔ bɛvale ezukoa nvutuke, anzɛɛ dwɛtɛ fufule a bɛyɛle, dwora nee ahyɛnze mralɛ anu kuloonwu, nee ahyɛnze ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛfa bɛfa senle la, bɛvale bɛ muala bɛhɔle. 16Kɔbele adile ne mɔ mɔɔ Belemgbunli Sɔlɔmɔn manle bɛyɛle bɛduoduale kɔbele mpila ne mɔ azo, ehwili ne mɔ, nee angola kpole ne, bɛyɛ ɛnlomboɛ somaa mɔɔ bɛsuzu a ɔnyɛ boɛ a. 17Mpila nwiɔ ne zɔho bɛ nwo, ko biala anwumahɔlɛ le mita mɔtwɛ, yɛɛ ye kɔbele tile ne anwumahɔlɛ le mita ko nee ekyi. Wɔ adile ne mɔ azo bɛyɛ debie bie mɔɔ bɛnwo ye kɛ avonle la zolɛ, na bɛyɛ debie mɔɔ le kɛ akutue la bɛgua zolɛ. Bɛvale kɔbele a bɛyɛle bɛ muala a.
Bɛva menli mɔɔ wɔ Dwuda la bɛhɔ Babelonia
(Gyɛ 52.24-27)
18Babelonia Safohyenlema Kpanyinli ne, Nɛbuzaladan eza hyele Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli Sɛlaya, ye boavolɛ Zɛfanaya, nee Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu sonvolɛma nsa ne mɔɔ anwo hyia la. 19Wɔ suakpole ne azo noko, ɔhyele Safohyenle Kpanyinli ne mɔɔ nea ɛlɔnema ne anwo zo la, menli nnu bie mɔɔ boka bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛtu belemgbunli folɛ na bɛtɛbɔ sua ne azo la, safohyenle kpanyinli boavolɛ ne mɔɔ nea ɛlɔnema ninyɛne zo, yɛɛ menli abulasia bie mɔɔ anwo hyia la. 20Nɛbuzaladan vale bɛ hɔmanle Babelonia belemgbunli ne wɔ Relebela, 21mɔɔ wɔ Heemate maanzinli nu la. Babelonia belemgbunli ne manle bɛbobɔle bɛ na bɛhunle bɛ.
Yemɔti bɛhyele menli mɔɔ wɔ Dwuda la nuokɛ bɛ nee bɛ hɔle nlɔnu.
Dwuda Amɛnlado Gɛdalaya
(Gyɛ 40.7-9; 41.1-3)
22Belemgbunli Nɛbukadenɛza vale Ahaekam ara Gɛdalaya, mɔɔ ɔ nlenya a le Hyeefan la yɛle Dwuda amɛnlado, kɛ ɔnlea bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ nee bɛ angɔ Babelonia la anwo zo. 23Mɔɔ Dwuda ɛlɔnema nee bɛ safohyenlema mɔɔ anva bɛ nwo ammaa Babeloniama la dele la bɛvale bɛ nwo bɛhɔbɔle Gɛdalaya wɔ Mezepa. Safohyenlema ne mɔ a le Nɛtanaya ara Yehyemeeyɛle, Kalia ara Dwoheenan yɛɛ Tanehumɛte ara Sɛlaya mɔɔ vi Nɛtofa, yɛɛ Gyɛzanaya mɔɔ vi Meeyaka la. 24Gɛdalaya zele ɛlɔnema ne kɛ, “Mebɔ bɛ ɛwɔkɛ kɛ ɔngyia biala kɛ bɛkɛzulo Babelonia belemgbunli ne. Bɛdɛnla ɛke bɛbɔ bɛ ɛbɛla na bɛzonle Babelonia belemgbunli ne na bɛ nzo nu kɛdwo bɛ.”
25Noko wɔ ɛvolɛ zɔhane anu, siane nsuu ne anu, Nɛtanaya ara Yehyemeeyɛle mɔɔ ɔ nlenya a le Yilaehya, na ɔbɔ Dwuda belemgbunli ne abusua ne bie la vale menli bulu lile ɔ nzi hɔle Gɛdalaya anwo zo hɔhunle ye wɔ Mezepa. Eza ɔhunle Yizilayɛma nee Babeloniama mɔɔ nee Gɛdalaya wɔ ɛkɛ ne la. 26Akee Yizilayɛma kɔsɔɔti, sukoavolɛma nee ehyianvolɛma, nee bɛ safohyenlema ne amuala nriandile hɔle Yigyibiti, ɔboalekɛ ɛnee bɛsulo Babeloniama.
Bɛye Gyɛhɔyakɛn bɛvi efiade
(Gyɛ 52.31-34)
27Bɛhyele Dwuda Belemgbunli Gyɛhɔyakɛn nuokɛ bɛ nee ye hɔle nlɔnu la ye ɛvolɛ abulasa nee nsuu, siane bulu nee nwiɔ ne anu kenle abulanwiɔ nee nsuu ne azo yɛɛ Babelonia Belemgbunli Yivelemɛlodake nwunle Gyɛhɔyakɛn anwunvɔne na ɔmanle bɛyele ye bɛvile efiade a. Ɛvolɛ ne anu ala a bɛvale Yivelemɛlodake bɛziele Babelonia belemgbunli a. 28Ɔdendɛle kɛnlɛma ɔhilele Gyɛhɔyakɛn na ɔmanle ye gyinlabelɛ mɔɔ enililɛ wɔ nwo la ɔdɛlale arelemgbunli mɔɔ bɛhyele bɛ nuokɛ bɛhɔle nlɔnu wɔ Babelonia la. 29Yemɔti bɛmanle Gyɛhɔyakɛn yele ye efiadedolɛ adɛladeɛ ne mɔ na ɔ nee Babelonia belemgbunli ne dɛnlanle ɛkponle ko anwo lile debie wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee ɔde ngoane nu la. 30Alehyenlɛ biala mɔɔ ɔkɛkpusu ɔ ti na ɔdua zolɛ la, bɛmanle ye ninyɛne mɔɔ ɔkɛhyia nwolɛ la anwo ezukoa.

Title: 1 EDK MUKENYE
Content:
Mukenye
Edwɛkɛsisilɛ Ndoɔdoazo mbuluku ne mɔ ka edwɛkɛ mɔɔ sisile mɔɔ bɛhɛlɛ wɔ Samoɛle nee Arelemgbunli mbuluku ne mɔ anu la bieko wɔ ndenle gyɛne zo.
Ninyɛne titile nwiɔ yɛɛ yɛnwu bɛ wɔ Yizilayɛ Arelemgbunli Tetedwɛkɛ nwo wɔ Edwɛkɛsisilɛ Ndoɔdoazo Mbuluku ne mɔ anu a.
1. Ɔkile kɛ saa munzule sisile Yizilayɛ nee Dwuda arelemgbunli maanle ne mɔ anu bɔbɔ a, Nyamenle lile ye ɛwɔkɛ ne mɔɔ ɔbɔle maanle ne la azo na ɔluale ye menli ne mɔɔ wɔ Dwuda la anwo zo ɔlile ye ngyehyɛlɛ ne azo. Amaa nɔhalɛ mɔɔ wɔ ɛhye anu la avinde la, mbuluku ne mɔ kɛlɛvolɛ ne twe adwenle kɔgyinla Devidi nee Sɔlɔmɔn mɔdenlebɔlɛ nee ɛkpazilɛ, nee Gyɛhɔhyafate, Hɛzikaya yɛɛ Dwosaya bɛ nzenzaleɛ ngɛnlɛma ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛyɛle la azo, nee menli mɔɔ lile nɔhalɛ manle Nyamenle la anwo zo.
2. Ɔkilehile Nyamenle ɛzonlenlɛ ne abobɔlɛ wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu, yɛɛ sɛlɛvolɛma nee Livaema ɛziezielɛ nwo ngyehyɛlɛ mɔɔ bɛluale zolɛ bɛzonlenle la anu fɔɔnwo. Sɔlɔmɔn a zile Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne a, noko buluku ne kile kɛ Devidi a vale Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne ɛzilɛ nee nuhua ɛzonlenlɛ ngyehyɛlɛ ne rale a.
Mɔɔ wɔ nu la
Awolɛndoazo aluma 1.1—9.44
Sɔɔlo ewule 10.1-14
Devidi belemgbunlililɛ 11.1—29.30
1 Ngyegyelɛ nee ɛkpazilɛ 11.1—22.1
2 Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne ɛzilɛ nwo anwoboɔboalɛ 22.2—29.30

Title: 1 EDK 1
Content:
Ɔvi Adam anwo zo kɔdwu Ebileham anwo zo
(Mɔl 5.1-32; 10.1-32; 11.10-26)
1Adam wole Sɛɛte: Sɛɛte wole Yinɔhye: Yinɔhye wole Kinan; 2Kinan wole Mahalali; Mahalali wole Gyilɛde; 3Gyilɛde wole Yinɔko; Yinɔko wole Mɛtusɛla; Mɛtusɛla wole Leemɛke; 4Leemɛke wole Nowa; Nowa wole Hyɛm, Ham yɛɛ Gyeefɛte.
5Gyeefɛte amra a le: Gomɛ, Meegɔgo, Meedae, Gyeevan, Tubale, Mihyɛke, yɛɛ Tilase. Bɛ bo zo amra a ɛnɛ bɛfa bɛ aluma bɛfɛlɛ bɛ la. 6Gomɛ abo zo amra a le Ahyekinazema, Relefatema, yɛɛ Togamama. 7Gyeevan abo zo amra a le Yilaehyama, Sipenima, Sepolɔsoma, yɛɛ Wuloduma.
8Ham amra a le: Kɛhye, Yigyibiti, Lebeya, yɛɛ Keenan. Bɛ bo zo amra a ɛnɛ bɛfa bɛ aluma bɛfɛlɛ bɛ la. 9Kɛhye abo zo amra a le Sibama, Havelama, Sabetama, Releemama, yɛɛ Sabetikama. Releemama abo zo amra a le Hyibama nee Didanema. 10(Kɛhye wole Nemelɔdo yɛɛ Nemelɔdo a lumuale yɛle katakyie wɔ aleɛabo a.) 11Yigyibiti abo zo amra a le Ledeama, Anamma, Lɛheebemma, Nafetuma, 12Patelusoma, Kaseluma, yɛɛ Kilitima. (Menli ɛhye mɔ anu a Filisitiama vi rale a.) 13Keenan ara kpanyinli a le Saedɛn. Ɔ diema a le Hɛte. Bɛ bo zo amra a ɛnɛ bɛfa bɛ aluma bɛfɛlɛ bɛ la. 14Keenan abo zo amra a le Gyibɛsema, Amɔlema, Gɛgahyema, 15Haevaema, Akaema, Saenaema, 16Avadema, Zɛmama, yɛɛ Heematema.
17Hyɛm amra mrenya a le Yilam, Ahyɛɛ, Apakyehyade, Lɛde, Ɛlam, Ɛɛze, Hɛle, Gitɛ, yɛɛ Mihyɛke. Bɛ bo zo amra a ɛnɛ bɛfa bɛ aluma bɛfɛlɛ bɛ la. 18Apakyehyade wole Hyila, yɛɛ Hyila wole Yibɛ. 19Yibɛ wole mralɛ mrenya nwiɔ. Bɛfɛlɛ ko Pilɛge (ɔboalekɛ, ye mekɛ zo a ewiade amra avinli kpakyekpakyele a.) Ko ne noko bɛfɛlɛ ye Dwɔketan. 20Dwɔketan abo zo amra a le Alemodadema, Hyilɛfema, Heezameevɛtema, Gyilama, 21Hadɔlamma, Yuzalema, Dekelaema, 22Yibalema, Abemeeyɛlema, Hyibama, 23Ofɛma, Havelama, yɛɛ Dwobabema.
24Abusua ɛlɔnwɔne ne mɔɔ vi Hyɛm anwo zo badwu Ebilam anwo zo la ɛne: Hyɛm, Apakyehyade, Hyila, 25Yiba, Pilɛge, Liwu, 26Silɛge, Nahɔ, Tilaa, 27yɛɛ Ebilam mɔɔ nzinlii bɛvɛlɛle ye Ebileham la.
Yehyemeeyɛle abo zo amra
(Mɔl 25.12-16)
28Ebileham amra mrenya nwiɔ: Ayezeke yɛɛ Yehyemeeyɛle. 29Bɛ abusua ɛlɔnwɔne ne ɛne: Yehyemeeyɛle ara kpanyinli a le Nɛbeeyo; akee Kida, Adebili, Mebesam, 30Mehyema, Dumaa, Masa, Hɛdae, Tima, 31Gyita, Nafehye, yɛɛ Kidɛmaa. Bɛ muala bɛle Yehyemeeyɛle abo zo amra.
32Ebileham ɛnee lɛ ye mgbɔnla, bɛfɛlɛ ye Kɛtula. Ɔ nee ye wole mrenya nsia: Zemelan, Dwɔkehyan, Midan, Medean, Yehyebake, yɛɛ Hyua. Dwɔkehyan amra a le Hyiba yɛɛ Didan. 33Medean amra mrenya a le Yifaa, Yifɛ, Heenɔko, Abaeda, yɛɛ Ɛledeeyaa. Ɛhye mɔ amuala le Kɛtula abo zo amra.
Yisɔ abo zo amra
(Mɔl 36.1-19)
34Ebileham ara nrenya a le Ayezeke; Ayezeke amra mrenya a le Yisɔ nee Yizilayɛ. 35Yisɔ amra mrenya a le Ɛlaefaze, Wuluwɛle, Gyiyɛhye, Gyeelam, yɛɛ Kɔla. 36Ɛlaefaze amra mrenya a le Timan, Oma, Zifae, Geetam, Kinaze, Temena, yɛɛ Amalɛke. 37Wuluwɛle amra mrenya a le Neehate, Zila, Hyama yɛɛ Mezaa.
Menli mɔɔ kyekyele Yidɔm la
(Mɔl 36.20-30)
38-42Siyɛ amra mrenya a le Lotan, Hyobale, Zebɛyɔn, Enaa, Daehyɔn, Yizɛ, yɛɛ Daehyan.
Lotan amra mrenya a le Hɔlae nee Homam. (Lotan adiema raalɛ a le Temena.)
Hyobale amra mrenya a le Alevan, Manahate, Yibale, Hyifae, yɛɛ Onam.
Zebɛyɔn amra mrenya a le Ayeya nee Enaa. Enaa ara nrenya a le Daehyɔn. Daehyɔn amra mrenya a le Hamelan, Ɛhyeban, Yetelan, yɛɛ Kilan.
Yizɛ amra mrenya a le Belehan, Zeeyavan, Gyeeyakan.
Daehyan amra mrenya a le Ɛɛze yɛɛ Ɛlan.
Yidɔm arelemgbunli
(Mɔl 36.31-43)
43-50Arelemgbunli mɔɔ lile ebia wɔ Yidɔm kolaa na Yizilayɛma anyia arelemgbunli la ɛne:
Biyɔ ara Bila, ɔvi Denehabaa.
Zila mɔɔ vi Bɔzela la ara Dwohabe
Huhyam mɔɔ vi Timan.
Heedade mɔɔ ɔ ze a le Bidade, ɔvi Evete (ɔlile Medeanema anwo zo konim wɔ Mowabe).
Samela mɔɔ vi Maselika
Hyeeyɛle mɔɔ vi Rilihɔbo mɔɔ wɔ Azule Yufileti anloa la.
Akebɔ ara Beeyale Heenan
Heedade mɔɔ vi Peeyae. (Bɛfɛlɛ ɔ ye Mɛhɛtabɛle. Mɛhɛtabɛle ɔ nli a le Meezahabe ara raalɛ Meetelɛde.)
51Abusua mbia mɔɔ ɛnee wɔ Yidɔm la, menli mɔɔ lile la a le Temena, Aleva, Gyitɛte, 52Ɔhɔlebaama, Yila, Paenɔn, 53Kinaze, Timan, Mebezaa, 54Magedeɛle, yɛɛ Yilam.

Title: 1 EDK 2
Content:
Dwuda abo zo amra
1Gyekɔbo (Yizilayɛ) wole mralɛ mrenya bulu nee nwiɔ. Bɛmɛ a le Wulubɛn, Semɛyɔn, Livae, Dwuda, Yesakaa, Zɛbulɛn, 2Dan, Dwosefi, Bɛngyaman, Nafetalae, Gaade, yɛɛ Ahya.
3Dwuda amra mrenya a le Ɛɛ, Onan, yɛɛ Hyila. Ɔ nee Batehyua mɔɔ le Keenanli la ara raalɛ a wole bɛ a. Dwuda ara kpanyinli Ɛɛ yɛle amumuyɛ, na ɔlua zolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma hunle ye. 4Dwuda eza nee ɔ ra nrenya aye Teemaa noko wole Pɛlɛze yɛɛ Zila. Dwuda amra mrenya ne mɔ le nnu.
5Pɛlɛze wole mrenya nwiɔ: Hɛzelɔn yɛɛ Hamɛle. 6Zila wole mrenya nnu. Zemelae, Yitan, Himan, Kalekɔlo, yɛɛ Dɛda. 7 Kaamae ara Ekaa hwenle munzule kpole rɛlɛle Yizilayɛma, ɔluakɛ debie biala mɔɔ bɛkɛva bɛkɛbɔ azu bɛkɛmaa Nyamenle la ɛnee yehɔwua. 8Yitan ara nrenya a le Azalaya.
Belemgbunli Devidi abusua ɛlɔnwɔne ne
9Hɛzelɔn wole mralɛ mrenya nsa. Bɛmɛ a le Gyɛlamii, Relam, yɛɛ Kalɛbe.
10Abusua ɛlɔnwɔne ne mɔɔ vi Relam anwo zo badwu Gyɛsi anwo zo la ɛne: Relam, Amenadabe, Neehyɔn (ɔle Dwuda abusua ne anu mandimase kpalɛ) 11Salemɔn, Bowaze, 12Obɛde, yɛɛ Gyɛsi.
13Gyɛsi wole mrenya nsuu: Yilayabe a le kpanyinli a. Mɔɔ doɔdoa zolɛ la a le Abenadabe, Hyama, 14Nɛtanɛle, Reladeeyae, 15Ozɛm, yɛɛ Devidi. 16Eza ɔwole mralɛ mraalɛ nwiɔ. Bɛmɛ a le Zɛluaya nee Abegeli.
Gyɛsi ara raalɛ Zɛluaya wole mrenya nsa. Bɛmɛ a le Abehyae, Dwowabe, yɛɛ Asahɛle. 17Gyɛsi ara raalɛ Abegeli gyale Gyitɛ, mɔɔ le Yehyemeeyɛle abo zo sonla la na ɔ nee ye wole ralɛ nrenya, bɛdonle ye Ameesa.
Hɛzelɔn abo zo amra
18Hɛzelɔn ara Kalɛbe gyale Azuba na ɔ nee ye wole ralɛ raalɛ, bɛfɛlɛ ye Gyɛleyo. Ɔdaye noko ɔwole mrenya nsa. Bɛmɛ a le Gyihyɛ, Hyobabe, yɛɛ Adɔn. 19Azuba wule la, Kalɛbe gyale Yifelate na ɔ nee ye wole nrenya ko, bɛfɛlɛ ye Huuli. 20Huuli ara a le Yulae yɛɛ ye anlɔnra a le Bɛzali.
21Hɛzelɔn lile ɛvolɛ abulasia la, ɔgyale Meekɛ ara raalɛ mɔɔ le Geleade adiema ne. Ɔ nee ye wole nrenya ko, bɛfɛlɛ ye Sigɛbe. 22Sigɛbe wole nrenya ko, bɛfɛlɛ ye Gyeeyɛɛ. Gyeeyɛɛ ziele azuamgbole abulanwiɔ nee nsa wɔ Geleade maanle nu. 23Na Gihyɔ nee Ɛlam amra honle vale maanle ne anu azua abulasia; Gyeeyɛɛ nee Kinate namunamu ne mɔ nee azua mɔɔ bikye ɛkɛ ne afoa nu la amuala boka nwolɛ. Menli mɔɔ ɛnee wɔ azua ɛhye mɔ azo la amuala le Meekɛ mɔɔ ɔ ra a le Geleade la abo zo amra. 24Hɛzelɔn wule la, ɔ ra Kalɛbe gyale Ɛfelate mɔɔ le ɔ ze aye kunlanvolɛ ne. Bɛwole nrenya ko, bɛfɛlɛ ye Ahyɔɔ; yemɔ a ɔwole Tɛkowa mɔɔ kyekyele sua ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Tɛkowa la a.
Gyɛlamii abo zo amra
25Gyɛlamii mɔɔ le Hɛzelɔn ara kpanyinli ne wole mrenya nnu. Bɛmɛ a le Relam, yemɔ a ɔle kpanyinli a, yɛɛ akee Bunaa, Ɔlɛn, Ozɛm, yɛɛ Ahaegya. 26-27Relam wole mrenya nsa: bɛmɛ a le Meeyaze, Gyeemen, yɛɛ Yikɛ. Gyɛlamii eza gyale raalɛ bieko, bɛfɛlɛ ye Atala. Ɔ nee ye wole nrenya ko, bɛfɛlɛ ye Onam. 28Onam wole mrenya nwiɔ: Hyameeyae nee Gyeeda. Hyameeyae noko wole mrenya nwiɔ: Needabe nee Abaehyɔ.
29Abaehyɔ gyale raalɛ bie mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Abeheli na ɔ nee ye wole Aaban nee Molede. 30Abaehyɔ adiema Needabe wole mrenya nwiɔ: Silɛde nee Apeeyem. Silɛde anwo ralɛ nrenya na yeawu. 31Apeeyem ara a le Ayehyae; Ayehyae wole Hyihyan yɛɛ Hyihyan wole Aaleeyae.
32Hyameeyae adiema Gyeeda wole mrenya nwiɔ. Bɛmɛ a le Gyitɛ nee Dwɔnatan. Gyitɛ anwo ralɛ nrenya na yeawu. 33Dwɔnatan wole mrenya nwiɔ: Pilɛte nee Zeeza. Ɛhye mɔ amuala le Gyɛlamii abo zo amra.
34Hyihyan anwo nrenya. Ɔwole mraalɛ ngome. Na ɛnee ɔlɛ ye sonvolɛ bie mɔɔ vi Yigyibiti la, bɛfɛlɛ ye Gyaaha. 35Na Hyihyan vale ɔ mra mraalɛ ne mɔ ko manle Gyaaha gyale, ɔ nee ye wole nrenya ko, bɛfɛlɛ ye Ateeyae. 36Abusua ɛlɔnwɔne ne mɔɔ vi Ateeyae anwo zo kɔdwu Yilaehyama anwo zo la a le ɛhye: Ateeyae, Neetan, Zeebade, 37Ɛfelale, Obɛde, 38Gyihu, Azalaya, 39Hilɛze, Ɛliesa, 40Sesemae, Hyalɛm, 41Gyɛkamaya, yɛɛ Yilaehyama.
Kalɛbe abo zo amra bie mɔ
42Gyɛlamii adiema Kalɛbe ara nrenya kpanyinli ne, bɛfɛlɛ ye Mihya. Mihya wole Zefe mɔɔ wole Malihya, mɔɔ le Hibulɔn ɔ ze ne. 43Hibulɔn wole mrenya nna: Kɔla, Tapua, Rilikɛm, yɛɛ Hyima. 44Hyima ara a le Releeham yɛɛ ye anlɔnra a le Dwɔkowam. Rilikɛm mɔɔ wole Hyameeyae la adiema a le Hyima. 45Hyameeyae a wole Meeyɔn a, yɛɛ Meeyɔn a wole Bɛtezɛ a.
46Kalɛbe lɛ ye mgbɔnla bie, bɛfɛlɛ ye Yifaa. Ɔ nee ye wole mrenya nsa. Bɛmɛ a le Hɛlan, Maza, yɛɛ Geezɛze. Hɛlan ɔdaye ɔwole nrenya ko, bɛfɛlɛ ye Geezɛze.
47(Nrenya bie mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Gyadeeyae la wole mrenya nsia. Bɛmɛ a le Religɛm, Dwotam, Gihyan, Pilɛte, Yifaa, yɛɛ Hyeeyafe.)
48Kalɛbe lɛ ye mgbɔnla bieko, bɛfɛlɛ ye Meeyaka. Ɔ nee ye wole mrenya nwiɔ. Bɛmɛ a le Hyibɛ nee Tɛheena. 49Nzinlii Meeyaka wole mrenya nwiɔ bieko. Bɛmɛ a le Hyeeyafe mɔɔ kyekyele sua ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Mademana la; yɛɛ Hyiva, mɔɔ ɔdaye noko ɔkyekyele Makebina nee Gebɛya azua ne mɔ la.
Kalɛbe eza lɛ ɔ ra raalɛ ko, bɛfɛlɛ ye Akesa.
50Menli ɛhye mɔ noko le Kalɛbe abo zo amra:
Huuli a le Kalɛbe nee ɔ ye Yifelate ara nrenya kpanyinli a. Huuli ara nrenya Hyobale a kyekyele Keleate Gyialem a. 51Ɔ ra nrenya ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nwiɔ mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Salema la a kyekyele Bɛtelɛhɛm a, yɛɛ ɔ ra nrenya ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nsa la, bɛfɛlɛ ye Hɛlɛfe. Yemɔ a ɔkyekyele Bɛtegeeda a.
52Hyobale mɔɔ kyekyele Keleate Gyialem la abo zo amra a le menli mɔɔ de Haloyi la yɛɛ Mɛnuhotu ezuavolɛ ne foa ko. 53Mbusua ekpulike ɛhye mɔ mɔɔ wɔ Keleate Gyialem la bɛdabɛ bɛle Hyobale abo zo amra: Yetelama, Putima, Hyumanema, yɛɛ Mehyelama. (Menli mɔɔ vi Zola nee Ɛhyeteewolo la bɔ abusua ɛhye bie.)
54Salema a kyekyele Bɛtelɛhɛm a. Ɔ bo zo amra a le Nɛtofatema, Atolo Bɛte Dwowabema, yɛɛ Zolama. Menli ɛhye mɔ bɔ Manahate abusua ne bie.
55(Mbusua ɛhye mɔ noko mɔɔ ɛlie duma wɔ mɛla ɛhɛlɛlɛ nee bɛ ɛhilehilelɛ nu la dɛnlanle Gyeebɛze: bɛmɛ a le Taelatema, Hyemɛyama, yɛɛ Sukatema. Bɛle Kinama mɔɔ vi Heemate na bɛwolole bɛhɔgyale Rilikabe mraalɛ a.)

Title: 1 EDK 3
Content:
Belemgbunli Devidi amra
1-3Devidi amra mrenya mɔɔ ɔwole bɛ wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɔwɔ Hibulɔn la, bɛmɛ ɛne, ɛbɔ ye ɔ ra nrenya kpanyinli ne anwo zo:
Amenɔn, ɔ nli a le Ahenɔwam mɔɔ vi Gyɛzelii la
Daneɛle, ɔ nli a le Abegeli mɔɔ vi Kamɛle la.
Abesalɛm, ɔ nli a le Meeyaka, mɔɔ le Belemgbunli Talemae mɔɔ vi Gihyɛ la ara raalɛ ne.
Adonaegya, ɔ nli a le Hagete.
Hyɛpataya, ɔ nli a le Abaeta.
Yetelɛyam, ɔ nli a le Ɛgela.
4 Bɛwole bɛmɛ nsia ne amuala wɔ Hibulɔn, wɔ ɛvolɛ nsuu nee foa ne mɔɔ ɛnee Devidi di belemgbunli wɔ ɛkɛ ne la anu.
Devidi lile ɛvolɛ abulasa nee nsa wɔ ebia ne azo wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm. 5 Ɔwole mralɛ mrenya dɔɔnwo wɔ ɛkɛ ne.
Ɔ ye Batehyiba, mɔɔ le Ameɛle ara raalɛ ne wole mralɛ mrenya nna. Bɛmɛ a le Hyemɛya, Hyobabe, Neetan, yɛɛ Sɔlɔmɔn.
6Devidi wole mrenya ngɔnla bieko. Bɛmɛ a le: Yebehaa, Yelaehyua, Yilefɛlɛte, 7Noga, Nɛfɛge, Gyafaya, 8Yilaehyama, Yilayada, yɛɛ Yilefɛlɛte. 9Ɛye ɛhye mɔ ɛsie ahane a, Belemgbunli Devidi eza nee ye mgbɔnla ne mɔ wole mralɛ mrenya dɔɔnwo. Ɔwole ralɛ raalɛ ko, bɛfɛlɛ ye Teemaa.
Belemgbunli Sɔlɔmɔn abo zo amra
10Belemgbunli Sɔlɔmɔn abo zo amra ɛne, selɛ nee ɔ ra: Sɔlɔmɔn wole Rilihɔbowam, Rilihɔbowam wole Abaegya, Abaegya wole Esa, Esa wole Gyɛhɔhyafate, 11Gyɛhɔhyafate wole Gyɛhɔlam, Gyɛhɔlam wole Ehazaya, Ehazaya wole Dwowahye, 12Dwowahye wole Amazaya, Amazaya wole Ɛzaya, Ɛzaya wole Dwotam, 13Dwotam wole Ehaze, Ehaze wole Hɛzikaya, Hɛzikaya wole Manasɛ, 14Manasɛ wole Emɔn, yɛɛ Emɔn wole Dwosaya. 15Dwosaya wole mrenya nna. Bɛmɛ a le Dwoheenan, ɔ ra kpanyinli ne, Gyɛhɔyakem, Zɛdikaya, yɛɛ Dwowahaze. 16Gyɛhɔyakem wole mrenya nwiɔ. Gyɛhɔyakɛn yɛɛ Zɛdikaya.
Belemgbunli Gyɛhɔyakɛn abo zo amra
17Belemgbunli Gyɛhɔyakɛn mɔɔ Babeloniama hyele ye nuokɛ hɔle nlɔnu la abo zo amra ɛne: Gyɛhɔyakɛn wole mrenya nsuu. Bɛmɛ a le Hyealeteɛle, 18Malekaelam, Pɛdaya, Hyɛneza, Gyɛkamaya, Hohyama, yɛɛ Nɛdabaya. 19Pɛdaya wole mrenya nwiɔ, Zɛlɛbabɛle nee Hyemɛyae. Zɛlɛbabɛle wole Mɛhyɛlam nee Hananaya, yɛɛ raalɛ ko, bɛfɛlɛ ye Hyɛlomete. 20Eza ɔwole mrenya nnu: Hahyuba, Ohɛle, Bɛlikaya, Hasadaya, yɛɛ Dwuhyabe Hɛsɛde.
21Hananaya wole mrenya nwiɔ, Pɛlataya nee Gyɛhyaya. Gyɛhyaya wole Relɛfaya, Relɛfaya wole Aanan, Aanan wole Obadaya, Obadaya wole Hyɛkanaya, 22Hyɛkanaya wole nrenya ko, bɛfɛlɛ ye Hyɛmaya, yɛɛ ɔlɛ nlɔnra nnu. Bɛmɛ a le Hatɛhye, Yigɛyale, Balaya, Nialaya, yɛɛ Hyeefate. 23Nialaya wole mrenya nsa: Ɛleyoyinae, Hɛzikaya, yɛɛ Azelaekam. 24Ɛleyoyinae wole mrenya nsuu: Hodavaya, Yilayahyebe, Pɛlaya, Akɛbe, Dwoheenan, Dɛlaya, yɛɛ Aneenae.

Title: 1 EDK 4
Content:
Dwuda abo zo amra
1Dwuda abo zo amra ne bie mɔ ɛne: Pɛlɛze, Hɛzelɔn, Kaamae, Huuli, yɛɛ Hyobale. 2Hyobale ara a le Riliaya, Riliaya wole Gyeehate, Gyeehate wole Ahumae nee Leehade mɔɔ bɛ bo zo amra a wɔ Zola la.
3-4Huuli a le Kalɛbe nee ɔ ye Yifelate amra mrenya ne mɔ anu kpanyinli a, yɛɛ ɔ bo zo amra a kyekyele Bɛtelɛhɛm a. Huuli amra mrenya nsa: Yitam, Pɛnuwɛle, yɛɛ Yizɛ. Yitam wole mrenya nsa: Gyɛzelii, Yehyema, yɛɛ Yedebahye. Eza ɔwole ralɛ raalɛ ko, bɛfɛlɛ ye Hazɛlɛponae. Pɛnuwɛle a kyekyele suakpole Gidɔ a, yɛɛ Yizɛ a kyekyele Huhya a.
5Ahyɔɔ, mɔɔ wole Tɛkowa mɔɔ kyekyele Tɛkowa la gyale mraalɛ nwiɔ, Hila nee Neeyala. 6Ɔ nee Neeyala wole mrenya nna: Ahuzam, Hifɛ, Timɛnae, yɛɛ Heeyahahyetalae. 7Ahyɔɔ nee Hila wole mrenya nsa: Zilɛte, Yezaa, yɛɛ Ɛtenan.
8Kɔɔzo a wole Anubu nee Zobiba a. Bɛ nla ne vi Hɛlɛm ara Ahaahɛle abusua ekpulike ne anu.
9Nrenya bie wɔ ɛkɛ, bɛfɛlɛ ye Gyeebɛze. Bɛdi ye eni kpole wɔ ɔdaye ye abusua ne anu bɛtɛla awie biala. Ɔ nli donle ye Gyeebɛze, ɔluakɛ ɔwo ye la ɔdele nyane kpole kpalɛ. 10Na Gyeebɛze zɛlɛle Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne kɛ, “Yila me, Nyamenle, na maa me azɛlɛ kpole. Ɛ nee me ɛlua na ye me fi munzule mɔɔ kɛmaa menwɔde nyane la anu.” Na Nyamenle diele ye nzɛlɛlɛ, ɔyɛle mɔɔ ɔkpondɛ la ɔmanle ye.
Mbusua bie mɔ noko aluma
11Hyuhya adiema Kalɛbe wole nrenya ko, bɛfɛlɛ ye Mihɛ. Mihɛ wole Ɛhyetɔn, 12yɛɛ Ɛhyetɔn wole mrenya nsa: Bɛteleefa, Pasia, yɛɛ Tɛhena. Tɛhena a kyekyele suakpole Neehahye a. Menli ɛhye mɔ abo zo amra dɛnlanle Rilika.
13Kinaze wole mrenya nwiɔ, Ɔteneɛle nee Sɛlaya. Ɔteneɛle ɔdaye ɔwole mrenya nwiɔ, Heetate nee Miyonotae. 14Miyonotae wole Ɔfela.
Sɛlaya wole Dwowabe, mɔɔ kyekyele Dwinvolɛma Bɔnza la. Awie biala mɔɔ wɔ sua ɛhye azo la le dwinvolɛ.
15Gyɛfɛni ara Kalɛbe wole mrenya nsa: Ayelu, Yila, yɛɛ Neeyam. Yila a wole Kinaze a.
16Gyɛhalɛli wole mrenya nna: Zefe, Zaefa, Taelea, yɛɛ Asali.
17-18Ɛzela wole mrenya nna: Gyitɛ, Milɛde, Yifɛ, yɛɛ Gyalɔn. Milɛde gyale Yigyibiti belemgbunli ara raalɛ, bɛfɛlɛ ye Bitaya. Ɔ nee ye wole ralɛ raalɛ, Meleam, yɛɛ mrenya nwiɔ, Hyameeyae nee Yehyeba. Yehyeba a kyekyele Ɛhyetɛmowa a. Milɛde eza gyale raalɛ bie mɔɔ vi Dwuda abusua nu la, na ɔ nee ye wole mrenya nsa. Bɛmɛ a le Gyilɛde, mɔɔ kyekyele Gidɔ la; Hibɛ mɔɔ kyekyele Soko la, yɛɛ Gyakuteɛle. Ɔdaye ɔkyekyele sua ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Zanowa la.
19Hodaya gyale Neeham adiema raalɛ. Bɛ bo zo amra a le abusua ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Gaam la. Bɛdɛnlanle sua ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Kiyaela la azo. Eza bɛ bie mɔ a le Meeyaka abusua ne mɔɔ bie mɔ dɛnlanle Ɛhyetɛmowa sua zo la.
20Hyaemɔn wole mrenya nna: Amenɔn, Relena, Bɛneheenan, yɛɛ Taelɔn.
Yehyae wole mrenya nwiɔ. Bɛmɛ a le Zohɛte nee Bɛnzohɛte.
Hyila abo zo amra
21Hyila le Dwuda amra mrenya ne mɔ ko. Ɔ bo zo amra bie mɔ a le Ɛɛ, mɔɔ kyekyele Likaa; Leeyada, mɔɔ kyekyele Malihya la. Abusua ɛhye, lenen ndanlɛ a bɛnwo a; bɛdɛnlanle Bɛte Ahyebia. 22Bie mɔ noko a le Dwokem nee menli mɔɔ dɛnlanle sua ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Koziba la azo la, yɛɛ Dwowahye nee Sɛlafe, mɔɔ bɛmɛ bɛgyale Mowabe mraalɛ na bɛhɔdɛnlanle Bɛtelɛhɛm la. (Ɛhye mɔ le tetedwɛkɛ mɔɔ ɛhyɛ kpalɛ a.) 23Bɛwɔ belemgbunli ne gyima nu bɛnwo mbuakɛ nee dwora bɛmaa belemgbunli ne. Bɛdɛnlanle Nɛtaem nee Gɛdɛla.
Semɛyɔn abo zo amra
24Semɛyɔn wole mrenya nnu: Nɛmuwɛle, Gyeemen, Gyɛlebe, Zila, yɛɛ Hyeeyɛle. 25Hyeeyɛle ara a le Hyalɛm: ye anlɔnra a le Mebesam, yɛɛ ye angabɛnzo a le Mehyema. 26Akee abusua ɛlɔnwɔne ne ndoazo ɛne: Mehyema wole Hamuwɛle, Hamuwɛle wole Zakɛ, yɛɛ Zakɛ wole Hyemɛyae. 27Hyemɛyae wole mrenya bulu nee nsia yɛɛ mraalɛ nsia, noko ɔ mediema mrenya nee ye abusua ne anu amra anwo dɔɔnwo biala. Zɔhane ati Semɛyɔn abusua ekpunli ne andɛlɛ kɛ Dwuda abusua ekpunli ne la.
28 Ɔvi mekɛ zɔhane toonwo mɔɔ badwu Belemgbunli Devidi anwo zo la, Semɛyɔn abo zo amra dɛnlanle azua ɛhye mɔ azo: Biyɛhyiba, Moleeda, Heezaahyuale, 29Belehaa, Yizɛm, Tolade, 30Beetuwɛle, Hɔɔma, Zekelage, 31Bɛte Maakabo, Heezaasusem, Batebelae, yɛɛ Hyeeyaleeyem. 32Eza bɛdɛnlanle ɛleka nnu bieko. Ɛleka ne mɔ a le Yitam, Eyen, Relemɔn, Tokɛn, yɛɛ Ahyan, 33nee namunamu mɔɔ wɔ ɛkɛ ne toonwo kɔdwu sua ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Beeyalate la nyiakɛ mɔɔ di kɔ adɔleɛ la. Bɛ abusua ɛlɔnwɔne ne nee ɛleka mɔɔ bɛdɛnlanle la tetedwɛkɛ mɔɔ bɛva bɛzie toonwo la, yemɔ ɛne.
34-38Menli ɛhye mɔ a le bɛ mbusua ne mɔ mgbanyinli a: Mɛhyobabe, Gyamelɛke, Amazaya ara Dwohyaa, Dwowɛle, Gyihu (Dwohyebaya mɔɔ ɔ ze a le Sɛlaya na ɔ nlenya a le Aseɛle la a wole ye a), Ɛleyoyinae, Gyeyakoba, Gyɛhyohaya, Asaya, Adeɛle, Gyɛsemeɛle, Bɛnaya, Zaeza (Aalɔn mɔɔ ɔ bo zo amra a le Gyɛdaya, Hyemelae yɛɛ Hyɛmaya la ara Hyaefae a wole ye a.) Bɛ abusua ne hɔle zolɛ dɛlɛle la ati, 39bɛdɛlɛle bɛhɔle adɔleɛ toonwo asɛɛ Gidɔ bɛkpondɛle adidileka bɛmanle bɛ nyɛmoa wɔ bɔnza ne mɔɔ bɛhye sua ne nu la aduduleɛ.
40Bɛnyianle azɛlɛ kpalɛ mɔɔ kye aleɛ na bɛ nyɛmoa didi zolɛ a ɔyɛ boɛ la; azɛlɛ ne tɛlɛ, ɛkɛ ne le sulokoko, yɛɛ anzonudwolɛ wɔ ɛkɛ. Menli mɔɔ ɛnee wɔ ɛkɛ ne la vi Ham.
41Dwuda Belemgbunli Hɛzikaya mekɛ zo, menli mɔɔ bɛbobɔ bɛ aluma wɔ ɛke la hɔle Gilaa na bɛhɔzɛkyele menli mɔɔ wɔ ɛkɛ ne la ndanlɛ azua nee bɛ kpɔda ne mɔ. Bɛvoanle menli mɔɔ wɔ zolɛ la, na bɛdɛnlanle ɛkɛ ne kpɔkpɔ, ɔboalekɛ ɛkɛ ne le kpalɛ maa bɛ nyɛmoa ne mɔ. 42Semɛyɔn abusua ekpunli ne anu menli ɛya nnu bɛdabɛ bɛhɔdɛnlanle Yidɔm aduduleɛ. Yehyae amra ne mɔ a vale bɛ hɔle a. Bɛmɛ a le Pɛlataya, Nialaya, Relɛfaya, yɛɛ Ɛzeɛle. 43Bɛhunle Amalɛkema mɔɔ hale ɛkɛ ne la, na ɛkɛ ne yɛɛ bɛde toonwo yeradwu ɛnɛ a.

Title: 1 EDK 5
Content:
Wulubɛn abo zo amra
1 Gyekɔbo ara nrenya kpanyinli ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Wulubɛn la abo zo amra ɛne. (Kɛmɔ ɔvale ɔ ze mraalɛ ne mɔ ko la ati, ye awolɛ kpanyinli gyinlabelɛ ne bɔle ye, na bɛvale zɔhane gyinlabelɛ ne bɛmanle Dwosefi. 2 Noko Dwuda abo zo amra a yɛle menli mgbole na bɛlile mbusua ekpunli ekpunli ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti belemgbunli a.) 3Gyekɔbo ara kpanyinli Wulubɛn wole mrenya nna: Heenɔko, Paluu, Hɛzelɔn, yɛɛ Kaamae.
4-6 Dwowɛle abo zo amra, ɔvi awolɛndoazo kɔdwu awolɛndoazo la ɛne: Hyɛmaya, Gɔɔgo, Hyemɛyae, Maeka, Riliaya, Beeyale, yɛɛ Biyɛla. Aselea Maanle Maanle Belemgbunli Tegelate Paelizɛ hyele Biyɛla mɔɔ ɛnee gyi Wulubɛn abusua ekpunli ne ati la, na ɔdule ye ɔvile maanle ne anu.
7Wulubɛn abusua ekpunli ne ngɛlata kile kɛ menli ɛhye mɔ lile abusua mgbanyinli: Gyiyayɛle a lumuale a, yɛɛ Zɛkalaya, 8yɛɛ Biyɛla, mɔɔ le Ezaze ara na ɔle Hyima anlɔnra la. Ɔvi Dwowɛle abusua nu. Abusua ɛhye bɔle ye nzeseɛ wɔ Alowɛ, bɛdɛnlanle ɛkɛ ne bɛhɔle ye sɔlɔ afoa nu toonwo bɛhɔdwule Nibo nee Beeyale Miyɔn. 9Ɛnee bɛlɛ nyɛmoa dɔɔnwo wɔ Geleade azɛlɛ zo, yemɔti bɛvale azɛlɛ ne toonwo bɛhɔdwule Azule Yufileti ne anloa mɔɔ di kɔ aduduleɛ afoa nu ɛsɛlɛ ne azo la.
10Belemgbunli Sɔɔlo mekɛ zo, Wulubɛn abusua ekpunli ne hɔholole Heegama anwo zo, bɛhunle bɛ bɛvale bɛ azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ di kɔ Geleade aduduleɛ la, na bɛdɛnlanle bɛ ndanlɛ azua ne mɔ anu.
Gaade abo zo amra
11Gaade abusua ekpunli ne anu amra dɛnlanle Wulubɛnema sɔlɔ wɔ azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Beehyan la azo; bɛdabɛ bɛbɔle ye ɛkɛ ne bɛhɔle ye aduduleɛ toonwo bɛhɔdwule Saleka. 12Dwowɛle abusua ne a le abusua titile mɔɔ wɔ ekpunli ɛhye anu a, yɛɛ Hyeefam abusua ne a le abusua titile mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nwiɔ a. Gyeenae nee Hyeefate a zole mbusua ne mɔɔ ɛha la a. 13Menli mɔɔ hale abusua ekpunli ne anu la le mbusua ekpulike nsuu. Bɛmɛ a le Maekeɛle, Mɛhyɛlam, Hyiba, Dwoleeyae, Gyeekan, Zaya, yɛɛ Yibɛ. 14Bɛ muala bɛle Hulae ara Abeheli abo zo amra; bɛ mgbanyima a le ɛhye mɔ: Abeheli, Hulae, Gyalowa, Geleade, Maekeɛle, Gyɛhyehyae, Gyaado, Bɛɛze, 15Ehae mɔɔ ɔ ze a le Abedeɛle na ɔle Gunae anlɔnra la a le mbusua ekpulike ne mɔ kpanyinli a. 16Bɛdɛnlanle Beehyan nee Geleade nee azua mɔɔ wɔ ɛkɛ ne afoa nu la azo, yɛɛ Hyɛlɔn azɛlɛ zo. 17(Tetedwɛkɛ ɛhye mɔ, bɛboɔboale bɛ nloa, na bɛhɛlɛle wɔ Dwuda Belemgbunli Dwotam nee Yizilayɛ Belemgbunli Gyɛlɔbowam mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nwiɔ la mekɛ zo.)
Mbusua ekpunli ekpunli mɔɔ wɔ aduduleɛ la ɛlɔnema
18Wɔ Wulubɛn, Gaade nee Manasɛ Aduduleɛ maanlema anu, ɛlɔnema mɔɔ wɔ nu la le apenle ngoko abulanla nee nna, ɛya nsuu abulasia. Bɛhilehilele bɛ dadeɛ nee ɛda konle nye zo kpalɛ, yɛɛ bɛze kɛ bɛsi bɛfa bɛ sa nu enyinlike bɛwowa bɛ nwo wɔ konle nu la. 19Bɛ nee Heegama mɔɔ wɔ Gyitɛ, Nɛfehye, yɛɛ Nodabe la nyianle konle. 20Bɛvale bɛ rɛle bɛwulale Nyamenle anu na bɛzɛlɛle ye kɛ ɔboa bɛ. Na Nyamenle diele bɛ nzɛlɛlɛ na ɔmanle bɛlile Heegama nee bɛ boavolɛma anwo zo konim. 21Bɛhonle bɛvale bɛ kpɔvolɛma afunlumu apenle ngoko abulanlu, mboane apenle ngoko ɛya nwiɔ abulanlu, asoaso apenle nwiɔ, yɛɛ bɛhyele menli apenle ngoko ɛya nuokɛ. 22Bɛhunle bɛ kpɔvolɛma ne anu dɔɔnwo, ɔboalekɛ ɛnee konle ne le Nyamenle konle. Na bɛdɛnlanle maanle zɔhane anu toonwo ɔhɔdwule mekɛ mɔɔ bɛhyele Yizilayɛma nuokɛ bɛhɔle nlɔnu la.
Menli mɔɔ wɔ Manasɛ Aduduleɛ la
23Menli mɔɔ wɔ Manasɛ Aduduleɛ la dɛnlɛdɛnlanle Beehyan azɛlɛ zo wɔ sɔlɔ afoa nu toonwo bɛ nloa dwule Beeyale Hɛmɔn, Sinɛɛ, yɛɛ Hɛmɔn Boka, na bɛlɔle kpole kpalɛ. 24Bɛ mbusua mgbanyinli ɛne: Yifɛ, Yehyae, Yilayɛle, Azeleɛle, Gyɛlɛmaya, Hodavaya, yɛɛ Gyaadeɛle. Bɛle safohyenlema mɔɔ di munli a, yɛɛ bɛgyigyi bɛ mbusua ne mɔ ati kpundii.
Bɛdu mbusua ekpunli ekpunli mɔɔ wɔ aduduleɛ la bɛvi bɛ maanle nu
25Noko menli ne anli nɔhalɛ ammaa bɛ nlenya mɔ Nyamenle ne. Bɛkpole ye na bɛzonlenle maanle maanle mɔɔ Nyamenle dule bɛ la awozonle ne mɔ. 26Zɔhane ati Nyamenle manle Aselea Maanle Maanle Belemgbunli Pɛɛle (mɔɔ eza bɛfɛlɛ ye Tegelate Paelizɛ la) lile maanle ne nvunu na ɔhonle ɔvale bɛ. Ɔdule Wulubɛnema, Gaadema, yɛɛ Manasɛ Aduduleɛ amra ɔvile maanle ne anu ɔmanle bɛhɔdɛnlanle Heelaa, Heebɔ, yɛɛ Hɛla, nee Azule Gozaa ne anloa kpɔkpɔ.

Title: 1 EDK 6
Content:
Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli abusua ekpulike ɛlɔnwɔne ne
1Livae wole mralɛ mrenya nsa: Gɛhyɔn, Kohate, yɛɛ Mɛlɛlae. 2Kohate wole mrenya nna: Amelam, Yezaa, Hibulɔn, yɛɛ Ɛzeɛle. 3Amelam wole mrenya nwiɔ: Aalɔn nee Mosisi. Eza ɔwole raalɛ ko, bɛfɛlɛ ye Meleam.
Aalɔn wole mrenya nna: Needabe, Abaehu, Ɛlieza, yɛɛ Yitamaa.
4Ɛlieza abo zo amra, ɔvi awolɛndoazo kɔdwu awolɛndoazo la a le ɛhye: Fenɛhaze, Abaehyua, 5Bɛkae, Ɛzae, 6Zɛlahaya, Mɛlayo, 7Amalaya, Ahaetɛbe, 8Zeedɔko, Ahaemaaze, 9Azalaya, Dwoheenan, 10Azalaya (mɔɔ yɛle gyima wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne mɔɔ Belemgbunli Sɔlɔmɔn zile wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm la anu la), 11Amalaya, Ahaetɛbe, 12Zeedɔko, Hyalɛm, 13Helekaya, Azalaya, 14Sɛlaya, yɛɛ Gyɛhozadake. 15Belemgbunli Nɛbukadenɛza dule Gyɛhozadake nee menli bie wɔ Dwuda nee Gyɛlusalɛm na Ɛdɛnkɛma manle bɛvale bɛ bɛhɔle nlɔnu.
Livae abo zo amra ne bie mɔ
16 Livae wole mrenya nsa: Gɛhyɔn, Kohate, yɛɛ Mɛlɛlae. 17Mrenya nsa ɛhye, ko biala wole mralɛ mrenya. Gɛhyɔn wole Lebenae nee Hyemɛyae, 18Kohate wole Amelam, Yezaa, Hibulɔn, yɛɛ Ɛzeɛle; 19yɛɛ Mɛlɛlae wole Maalae nee Muhyae.
20Gɛhyɔn abo zo amra, ɔvi awolɛndoazo kɔdwu awolɛndoazo: Lebenae, Gyeehate, Zema, 21Dwowaa, Yedo, Zila, yɛɛ Gyiatɛlae.
22Kohate abo zo amra, ɔvi awolɛndoazo kɔdwu awolɛndoazo: Amenadabe, Kɔla, Asɛ, 23Ɛlekeena, Yibayasafe, Asɛ, 24Teehate, Yulayɛle, Ɛzaya, yɛɛ Hyeewɛle.
25Ɛlekeena wole mrenya nwiɔ: Ameesae nee Ahaemo. 26Ahaemo abo zo amra, ɔvi awolɛndoazo kɔdwu awolɛndoazo: Ɛlekeena, Zofae, Neehate, 27Yilayabe, Gyɛloham, Ɛlekeena.
28Samoɛle wole mrenya nwiɔ: Dwowɛle a le kpanyinli a, yɛɛ Abaegya a le kakula a.
29Mɛlɛlae abo zo amra, ɔvi awolɛndoazo kɔdwu awolɛndoazo: Maalae, Lebenae, Hyemɛyae, Ɛza, 30Hyemɛya, Hagaya, yɛɛ Asaya.
Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua nu edwɛndolɛma
31Menli mɔɔ Belemgbunli Devidi vale Ɛdɛnkɛma Sua nu ɛzonlenlɛ edwɛndolɛ nwo ngyehyɛlɛ ne wulale bɛ sa nu wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛvale Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne bɛziele aze la ɛne: 32Menli ɛhye mɔ hakyihakyile bɛ nwo yɛle edwɛndolɛ gyima ne wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne anu toonwo ɔhɔdwule mekɛ mɔɔ Belemgbunli Sɔlɔmɔn zile Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm la. 33Menli mɔɔ yɛle gyima ne la nee bɛ mra ne mɔ ɛne:
Kohate sua nu amra: Kpanyinli mɔɔ lile edwɛndolɛma ne ati la a le Dwowɛle ara Himan. Ye abusua ɛlɔnwɔne ne kɛ kɔ ye la ɛne. Himan, Dwowɛle, Samoɛle, 34Ɛlekeena, Gyɛloham, Yilayɛle, Towa, 35Zɛfe, Ɛlekeena, Neehate, Ameesae, 36Ɛlekeena, Dwowɛle, Azalaya, Zɛfanaya, 37Teehate, Asɛ, Yibayasafe, Kɔla, 38Yezaa, Kohate, Livae, Gyekɔbo.
39Himan adiema Esafe a le edwɛndolɛma ekpunli ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nwiɔ la kpanyinli a. Ye abusua ɛlɔnwɔne ne ɛne: Esafe, Bɛlikaya, Hyemɛya, 40Maekeɛle, Beeyasaya, Malekaegya, 41Ɛtenae, Zila, Adaya, 42Yitan, Zema, Hyemɛyae, 43Gyeehate, Gɛhyɔn, Livae.
44Yitan mɔɔ vi Mɛlɛlae sua nu la a le edwɛndolɛma ekpunli ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nsa la kpanyinli a. Ye abusua ɛlɔnwɔne ne ɛne: Yitan, Kehyae, Abedae, Malɛke, 45Hahyabaya, Amazaya, Helekaya, 46Amezae, Beenae, Hyeemɛ, 47Maalae, Muhyae, Mɛlɛlae, Livae.
48Bɛyele bɛ mediema Livaema mɔɔ hale la kɛ bɛmɛ bɛyɛ ɛzonlenlɛ gyima mɔɔ ɛha Nyamenle Ndanlɛ Sua ne anu la.
Aalɔn abo zo amra
49Aalɔn nee ɔ bo zo amra a bɔle ɛyelalɛ nee ɛyɛlɛ evuanlɛ ɛkpunlɛ azu wɔ azukponle ne mɔ azo na bɛyɛle Nwuanzanwuanza Nu Nwuanzaanwu Ɛleka ne gyima ne a. Bɛluale Nyamenle sonvolɛ Mosisi ngyehyɛlɛ ne azo bɛyɛle mgbɔdalɛ nzɛlɛlɛ bɛmanle Yizilayɛma amuala. 50Aalɔn abo zo amra ne mɔ ɛne: Ɛlieza, Fenɛhaze, Abaehyua, 51Bɛkae, Ɛzae, Zɛlahaya, 52Mɛlayo, Amalaya, Ahaetɛbe, 53Zeedɔko, yɛɛ Ahaemaze.
Ɛleka mɔɔ Livaema dɛnlanle la
54Ɛleka mɔɔ bɛdɛnlanle la nee bɛ ɛweɛne ne mɔ ɛne: Aalɔn abo zo amra mɔɔ le Kohate abusua nu amra la a lumuale nyianle azɛlɛ ne bie a. 55Bɛnyianle Hibulɔn azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ wɔ Dwuda la nee azɛlɛ mɔɔ bɛdidi zolɛ la, 56na ɛya ɛya nee namunamu mɔɔ bikye suakpole ne la bɛvale bɛmanle Gyɛfɛni ara Kalɛbe. 57-59Bɛvale azuamgbole ɛhye mɔ bɛmanle Aalɔn abo zo amra ne mɔ: Hibulɔn, Lebena nee azɛlɛ mɔɔ la nwolɛ la amuala, Gyatɛ, Ɛhyetɛmowa nee nwolɛ azɛlɛ mɔɔ bɛdidi zo la; Haelɛn nee azɛlɛ mɔɔ bɛdidi zolɛ la, Dibɛ nee azɛlɛ mɔɔ bɛdidi zolɛ la, Ahyan, yɛɛ Bɛte Hyimɛhye nee azɛlɛ mɔɔ bɛdidi zolɛ la. 60Bɛngyaman abusua ekpunli ne maanzinli ne anu, bɛvale Giba, Alɛmɛte, yɛɛ Anato nee azɛlɛ mɔɔ bɛdidi zolɛ la bɛmanle bɛ. Azuamgbole mɔɔ Kohate abusua ne anu amra nyianle la le bulu nee nsa. 61Kohate abo zo amra mɔɔ hale la, bɛguale nzeleba na bɛhyɛle azuamgbole bulu mɔɔ wɔ Manasɛ Adɔleɛ la bɛmanle bɛ. 62Bɛvale azuamgbole bulu nee nsa bɛvile Yesakaa, Ahya, Nafetalae, yɛɛ Manasɛ mɔɔ wɔ Beehyan la azɛlɛ ne mɔ azo na bɛhyɛle bɛmanle Gɛhyɔn abusua ɛlɔnwɔne ne anu amra. 63Zɔhane ala yɛɛ bɛvale azuamgbole bulu nee nwiɔ bɛvile Wulubɛn, Gaade, yɛɛ Zɛbulɛn azɛlɛ ne mɔ azo bɛmanle Mɛlɛlae abo zo amra ne a. 64Yemɔti Yizilayɛma vale bɛ azuamgbole nee azɛlɛ mɔɔ bɛdidi zolɛ la manle Livaema. 65(Bɛguale nzeleba a bɛhyɛle Dwuda, Semɛyɔn yɛɛ Bɛngyaman azuamgbole ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛbobɔ bɛ aluma la bɛmanle bɛ a).
66Kohate abo zo amra ne bie mɔ nyianle azuamgbole mɔɔ wɔ Yifelaem azɛlɛ zo la bie. 67Bɛmanle bɛ azuamgbole mɔɔ le ɛvealeka la ɛhye mɔ: Hyikɛm mɔɔ wɔ Yifelaem awoka ne mɔ azo, Gizɛ, 68Dwokemɛyam, Bɛte Hɔlɔn, 69Ayegyalɔn, yɛɛ Gate Relemɔn. 70Kohate abusua ɛlɔnwɔne ne anu amra mɔɔ hale la nyianle Manasɛ Adɔleɛ, Enɛ, yɛɛ Baelɛyam azɛlɛ ne mɔ foa ko nee nwolɛ azɛlɛ mɔɔ bɛdidi zolɛ la.
71Manasɛ abusua ekpunli foa ko ne azɛlɛ ne bie eza hɔle Gɛhyɔn abusua ne ɛkɛ. Azua ne mɔ a le Golan mɔɔ wɔ Beehyan, yɛɛ Ahyetalo, nee azɛlɛ mɔɔ bɛdidi zolɛ la.
72Yesakaa abusua ekpunli nu amra noko nyianle Kidɛhye, Dabɛlate, 73Releemɔto yɛɛ Enɛm, nee azɛlɛ mɔɔ bɛdidi zolɛ la.
74Ahya abusua ekpunli ne anu amra nyianle Meehyale, Abedɔn, 75Hukɔko, yɛɛ Rilihɔbo, nee azɛlɛ mɔɔ bɛdidi zolɛ la.
76Nafetalae abusua ekpunli ne anu amra nyianle Kidɛhye mɔɔ wɔ Galeli, Hamɔn, yɛɛ Keleateeyem, nee azɛlɛ mɔɔ bɛdidi zolɛ la.
77Mɛlɛlae abo zo amra mɔɔ hale la nyianle Zɛbulɛn abusua ekpunli nu amra azɛlɛ ne bie. Bɛmɛ a le Relemɔno, yɛɛ Teebɔ, nee bɛ namunamu.
78Wulubɛn abusua ekpunli ne azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ di kɔ Azule Dwɔdan ne aduduleɛ wɔ Gyɛleko anzi lɔ la, bɛnyianle Bizɛ mɔɔ wɔ boka azo sɛsɛ ne azo la, Gyaaza, 79Kidɛmo, yɛɛ Mɛfeeya, nee azɛlɛ mɔɔ bɛdidi zolɛ la.
80Gaade abusua ekpunli ne azɛlɛ ne bɛnyianle Releemɔto mɔɔ wɔ Geleade, Meehaneyem, 81Hɛhyebɔn, yɛɛ Gyeezɛ, nee azɛlɛ mɔɔ bɛdidi zolɛ la.

Title: 1 EDK 7
Content:
Yesakaa abo zo amra
1Yesakaa amra mrenya nna: Tola, Pua, Gyahyɛbe, yɛɛ Hyemelɔn. 2Tola amra a le Ɛzae, Relɛfaya, Gyɛleɛle, Gyaameeyae, Yebesam, yɛɛ Hyɛmuwɛle. Bɛmɛ a bɛgyi bɛ ze Tola sua nu amra ati a. Bɛ mekɛ zo ɛnee bɛ nwo yɛ ɛzulolɛ kpole kpalɛ wɔ konle nu. Wɔ Belemgbunli Devidi mekɛ zo ɛnee bɛ dodo le menli apenle ngoko abulanwiɔ nee nwiɔ, menli ɛya nsia. 3Ɛzae ara a le Yezilahaya, yɛɛ Yezilahaya amra mrenya nna: Maekeɛle, Obadaya, Dwowɛle, yɛɛ Yehyaya. Bɛ muala bɛdi mgbanyinli wɔ bɛ awuke nu. 4Wɔ bɛ awolɛndoazo ne anu, kɛmɔ bɛ ze mɔ mbusua ekpulike ne mɔ de la, bɛlɛ ɛlɔnema ekpunli ekpunli mɔɔ kɔ konle a. Bɛ dodo le apenle ngoko abulasa nee nsia, ɔluakɛ bɛgyale mraalɛ dɔɔnwo, yɛɛ bɛwole mralɛ dɔɔnwo. 5Abusua ekpulike ekpulike mɔɔ wɔ Yesakaa abusua ekpunli ne anu la, bɛ muala bɛle mrenya apenle ngoko abulatwɛ nee nsuu mɔɔ anwo yɛ ɛzulolɛ kpole kpalɛ wɔ konle nu a.
Bɛngyaman nee Dan abo zo amra
6Bɛngyaman amra mrenya nsa: Bila, Bikɛ, yɛɛ Gyɛdeyeeyɛle.
7Bila wole mrenya nnu: Ɛzebɔn, Ɛzae, Ɛzeɛle, Gyɛlemo, yɛɛ Ayelae. Menli nnu ye, bɛle mbusua mgbanyinli wɔ bɛ abusua ɛlɔnwɔne ne mɔ anu, yɛɛ bɛdi munli wɔ konle nu. Bɛ bo zo amra le menli apenle ngoko abulanwiɔ nee nwiɔ menli abulasa nee nna.
8Bikɛ amra mrenya ngɔnla: Zɛmaela, Dwowahye, Ɛleyizɛ, Ɛleyoyinae, Ɔmelae, Gyɛlemo, Abaya, Anato, yɛɛ Alɛmɛte. 9Bɛ bo zo amra, kɛmɔ bɛ ze mɔ abusua ɛlɔnwɔne ne kile la, bɛlua mrenya apenle ngoko abulanwiɔ, ɛya nwiɔ mɔɔ kola kɔ konle nloa a.
10Gyɛdeyeeyɛle wole nrenya ko, bɛfɛlɛ ye Belehan. Belehan wole Gyiyɛhye, Bɛngyaman, Yihɛde, Kɛmeeyana, Zitan, Tahyehye, yɛɛ Ahaehyeehaa. 11Ɛhye mɔ amuala le Gyɛdeyeeyɛle abo zo amra kɛmɔ bɛ ze mɔ abusua ɛlɔnwɔne ne mɔ de la. Bɛlɛ ɛlɔnema apenle ngoko bulu nee nsuu, ɛya nwiɔ mɔɔ kola kɔ konle nloa a. 12Hyɛpem nee Hɛpem bɛ ze a le Ɛɛ. Huhyem ɔ ze a le Ehɛ.
Nafetalae abo zo amra
13Nafetalae wole mrenya nna: Gyaazeɛle, Gunae, Gyizɛ, yɛɛ Hyalɛm. (Bɛ nana a le Belehaa)
Manasɛ abo zo amra
14Manasɛ amra mrenya nwiɔ: ɔ nee ye mgbɔnla ne mɔɔ vi Alam la a wole bɛ a. Bɛmɛ a le Aseleɛle yɛɛ Meekɛ mɔɔ wole Geleade la. 15Meekɛ gyale mraalɛ manle Hɛpem nee Hyɛpem. Ɔ diema raalɛ a le Meeyaka yɛɛ ɔ ra nrenya mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nwiɔ la a le Zilɔfɛhade. Zilɔfɛhade wole mraalɛ ngome.
16Meekɛ aye Meeyaka wole mralɛ mrenya nwiɔ na ɔdonle bɛ Pilɛhye yɛɛ Hyilɛhye. Pilɛhye amra mrenya a le Yulam nee Releekɛm, 17yɛɛ Yulam ara nrenya a le Bidan. Bɛ muala bɛle Meekɛ ara Geleade abo zo amra. Meekɛ ɔ ze a le Manasɛ.
18Geleade adiema raalɛ Hamolɛkɛte wole mrenya nsa: Ayehyɔdo, Ebayizɛ, yɛɛ Mahelaa. 19(Hyɛmaeda amra mrenya a le Ahayan, Hyikɛm, Lekehae, yɛɛ Anayam.)
Yifelaem abo zo amra
20Yifelaem abo zo amra abusuandoazo ne ɛne: Hyutilaa, yɛɛ Bɛlɛde, Teehate, Ɛliada, Teehate, 21Zeebade, Hyutilaa, Yizɛ, yɛɛ Ɛlɛyade. Yizɛ nee Ɛlɛyade a menli mɔɔ wɔ Gate la hunle bɛ wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛhɔle kɛ bɛkawua Gatema nlankɛ la. 22Bɛ nlenya Yifelaem zunle bɛ mekɛ dɔɔnwo ne ala, na ɔ mediema mrenya ne mɔ rakyekyele ɔ rɛle. 23Na ɔ nee ɔ ye hɔle nla nu bieko la, ɔ ye nrenzɛle na ɔwole ralɛ nrenya. Ɔdonle ye Bɛlaya, ɔluakɛ munzule ɛzi ye abusua ne anu.
24Yifelaem ara raalɛ Hyiila a kyekyele Aleze nee Sɔlɔ Bɛte Hɔlɔn nee Ɛzɛn Hyiila a.
25Yifelaem lɛ ɔ ra nrenya ko, bɛfɛlɛ ye Rilifaa. Rilifaa abo zo amra a le Rilihyɛfe, Tilaa, Teehan, 26Leedan, Amehɛde, Yilaehyama, 27Nɛn, yɛɛ Dwɔhyua.
28Maanle mɔɔ bɛvale bɛdɛnlanle nu bɔkɔɔ la a le Bɛtɛle nee azua mɔɔ zuozua ye, Neeyalan aduduleɛ afoa nu, Gizɛ adɔleɛ afoa nu nee azua mɔɔ zuozua bɛ, yɛɛ Hyikɛm nee Aya nee azua mɔɔ zuozua bɛ la.
29Eza bɛ nee Manasɛma ɛweɛne zo, bɛziele azuamgbole Bɛte Hyan, Teeyanake, Mɛgedo, yɛɛ Dɔɔ nee azua mɔɔ zuozua bɛ la.
Ɛnee Gyekɔbo ara Dwosefi abo zo amra ne ɛleka mɔɔ dɛnlanle la, bɛmɛ ɛne.
Ahya abo zo amra
30Ahya abo zo amra ɛne: Yemena, Yehyeva, Yehyevae, Bɛlaya, yɛɛ bɛ diema raalɛ Sɛla.
31Bɛlaya amra mrenya nwiɔ: Hibɛ yɛɛ Malekeɛle mɔɔ wole Bɛzeeyete la.
32Hibɛ amra mrenya nsa: Gyafelɛte, Hyomɛ, yɛɛ Hotam. Bɛ diema raalɛ a le Hyua.
33Gyafelɛte amra mrenya nsa: Peesake, Bemehale, yɛɛ Ahyevate.
34Gyafelɛte adiema Hyomɛ amra mrenya nsa: Wuloga, Gyɛhɛba, yɛɛ Ɛlam.
35Gyafelɛte adiema nrenya Hotam amra mrenya nna: Zofa, Yemena, Hyilɛhye, yɛɛ Emale.
36Zofa abo zo amra ɛne: Suwa, Haanɛfɛ, Hyuwale, Bilae, Yemela, 37Bizɛ, Hɔɔdo, Hyama, Hyelehya, Yetelan, yɛɛ Biyɛla.
38Gyitɛ abo zo amra a le Gyɛfɛni, Pesepa, yɛɛ Ala, 39yɛɛ Ɛla abo zo amra a le Alaa, Haneɛle, yɛɛ Relezea.
40Menli ɛhye mɔ amuala le Ahya abo zo amra. Bɛle mbusua mgbanyinli wɔ bɛ ze mɔ abusua ekpulike ne mɔ anu. Bɛ nwo yɛ ɛzulolɛ kpole kpalɛ wɔ konle nu; bɛle mgbanyinli mɔɔ di munli a. Ahya abo zo amra mɔɔ kɔ ɛlɔne nloa la le mrenya apenle ngoko abulanwiɔ nee nsia.

Title: 1 EDK 8
Content:
Bɛngyaman abo zo amra
1Bɛngyaman ara nrenya kpanyinli a le Bila. Mralɛ mrenya mɔɔ doɔdoa zolɛ la a le Ahyebɛle, Ahɛla, 2Noha, yɛɛ Releefa.
3Bila amra mrenya ne mɔ ɛne: Adaa, Gila, Abaehɛde, 4Abaehyua, Neeyaman, Ahowa, 5Gila, Hyɛfufan, yɛɛ Hulam.
6-7Yihɛde amra mrenya ɛne: Neeyaman, Ahaegya, yɛɛ Gila mɔɔ le Hɛgelam, mɔɔ wole Ɛza nee Ahaehɛde la. Yihɛde amra mrenya ne mɔ le mbusua mgbanyinli wɔ bɛ ze mɔ awuke nu wɔ Giba. Nzinlii bɛdule bɛ ɛkɛ ne na bɛhɔdɛnlanle Manahate. Ɛza ɔ ze Gila nee Ahaehɛde a lile bɛ ti manle bɛdule bɛhɔle a.
8-9Hyeehaleeyem bɔle ye mraalɛ nwiɔ mɔɔ ɛnee ɔgya bɛ la ewole. Bɛmɛ a le Huhyem nee Beeyala. Akee ɔhɔdɛnlanle Mowabe, ɔgyale Hodɛhye na ɔ nee ye wole mrenya nsuu. Bɛmɛ a le Dwobabe, Zaebea, Mihya, Malekam, 10Gyiyɛze, Sakaya, yɛɛ Mɛɛma. Bɛ muala bɛyɛle mbusua mgbanyinli.
11Hyeehaleeyem nee ɔ ye dɛba ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Huhyem la wole mrenya nwiɔ: Abaetɛbe nee Ɛlepeeyale.
12Ɛlepeeyale wole mrenya nsa: Yibɛ, Maehyam, yɛɛ Hyimɛde. Hyimɛde a kyekyele azuamgbole Ono nee Lɔɔdo nee azua ngyikyi mɔɔ zuozua bɛ la a.
Bɛngyaman abo zo amra mɔɔ wɔ Gate nee Ayegyalɔn la
