Ɔdɛnlanle Hibulɔn ɔlile ebia ne ɛvolɛ nsuu yɛɛ ɔdɛnlanle Gyɛlusalɛm ɔlile ebia ne ɛvolɛ abulasa nee nsa. 28Ɔyɛle nwosonwoso na yeawu, ɔnyianle ɔ nwo yɛɛ bɛlile ye eni. Ɔ ra Sɔlɔmɔn a lile ye agya a. 29Belemgbunli Devidi anwo edwɛkɛ nee ye nyɛleɛ biala mɔɔ ɔyɛle la, bɛhɛlɛ bɛ wɔ Nyamenle Kpɔmanvolɛma Samoɛle, Neetan, yɛɛ Gaade Mbuluku nsa ne anu. 30Mbuluku ne mɔ kile kɛ ɔzile ɔlile ye belemgbunli ne, tumi mɔɔ ɔnyianle ye, nee debie biala mɔɔ zile ɔ nwo zo, nee mɔɔ zile Yizilayɛma nee maanle maanle mɔɔ zuozua bɛ la anwo zo la.

Title: 2 EDK MUKENYE
Content:
Mukenye
Edwɛkɛsisilɛ Buluku ne mɔɔ tɔ zo nwiɔ la sɔ Edwɛkɛsisilɛ Buluku ne mɔɔ lumua la azo. Ɔbɔ ɔ bo wɔ Belemgbunli Sɔlɔmɔn ebialilɛ ne mɔlebɛbo, ɔka nwolɛ edwɛkɛ toonwo ɔkɔdwu Sɔlɔmɔn ewule nu. Saa ɔka sɔlɔ mbusua ekpunli ekpunli ne mɔ mɔɔ Gyɛlɔbowam lile bɛ ti manle bɛdele Sɔlɔmɔn ara Rilihɔbowam anwo atua la anwo edwɛkɛ na ɔwie a, akee buluku ne gyinla nyiakɛ belemgbunli maanle ne, mɔɔ le Dwuda, anwo edwɛkɛ zo, ɔka toonwo ɔkɔdwu mekɛ mɔɔ Gyɛlusalɛm bɔle la; ɛnee yeha ɛvolɛ ɛya nnu abulatwɛ nee nsia na bɛawo Kelaese ne.
Belemgbunli Sɔlɔmɔn ara nrenya a le Rilihɔbowam, yɛɛ yemɔ a ɔlile ɔ ze Sɔlɔmɔn agya a.
Mɔɔ wɔ nu la
Sɔlɔmɔn ebialilɛ ne 1.1—9.31
1 Mɔlebɛbo ne 1.1-17
2 Bɛzi Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne 2.1—7.10
3 Awieleɛ ne 7.11—9.31
Sɔlɔ mbusua ekpunli ekpunli ne atuadelɛ ne 10.1-19
Dwuda arelemgbunli 11.1—36.12
Gyɛlusalɛm ɛbɔlɛ 36.13-23

Title: 2 EDK 1
Content:
Belemgbunli Sɔlɔmɔn sɛlɛ abiza nrɛlɛbɛ
(1 Arl 3.1-15)
1Devidi ara Sɔlɔmɔn agyakɛ dwule aze na ɔ sa yiale ye belemgbunli maanle ne. Ɛdɛnkɛma ye Nyamenle ne nee ye luale na ɔmanle ɔyɛle sonlakpole.
2Belemgbunli Sɔlɔmɔn dendɛle hilele Yizilayɛma amuala: safohyenlema mɔɔ nea ɛlɔnema apenle apenle nee ɛya ɛya nwo zo, ndɛnebuavolɛma, Yizilayɛ maanle mgbanyima ne mɔ, yɛɛ mbusua mgbanyinli. 3Sɔlɔmɔn lile bɛ ti na ɔ nee menli ne hɔle Gebɛyɔn, ɔluakɛ ɛkɛ ne yɛɛ Ndanlɛ Sua ne mɔɔ bɛsonle Nyamenle wɔ nu, mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma sonvolɛ Mosisi zile wɔ fienemgbole ne anu la wɔ a. 4(Belemgbunli Devidi ɛnee ɛva Nyamenle Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne ɛvi Keleate Gyialem ɛra Ndanlɛ Sua ne mɔɔ yezi yemaa ye wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm la anu.) 5Eza kɔbele azukponle ne mɔɔ Huuli ara Yulae ara Bɛzalii zile ziele Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne anyunlu wɔ Gebɛyɔn la tɛbɔ ɛkɛ. Na Sɔlɔmɔn nee menli ne amuala zonlenle Ɛdɛnkɛma wɔ ɛkɛ. 6Sɔlɔmɔn hunle nyɛmoa apenle, yelale bɛ bɔle azu wɔ kɔbele azukponle ne mɔɔ gyi ɛleka mɔɔ bɛsonle la anyunlu ɛkɛ ne la azo manle Ɛdɛnkɛma.
7Kenle ko ne nɔe ne, Nyamenle yele ɔ nwo hilele Sɔlɔmɔn na ɔzele ye kɛ, “Biza debie mɔɔ menyɛ memaa wɔ la.”
8Sɔlɔmɔn buale Nyamenle kɛ, “Wɔhile ɛhulolɛ kpole mɔɔ ɛmbɔ aze ɛlɛ la wɔ me ze Devidi anwo na wɔva me wɔzie belemgbunli wɔzie egya agyakɛ anu. 9O Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle, maa wɔ ɛwɔkɛ ne mɔɔ ɛbɔle egya Devidi la ɛyɛ zɔhane, ɔluakɛ wɔva me wɔzie menli mɔɔ zonle kɛ ɛnwea la belemgbunli. 10Zɔhane ati maa me nrɛlɛbɛ nee ndelebɛbo maa menva menzie menli ɛhye mɔ, ɔluakɛ awie biala ɛnrɛhola wɔ menli pemgbenleamgbe ɛhye mɔ anwo zo nea.”
11Nyamenle buale Sɔlɔmɔn kɛ, “Kɛmɔ ɛhye a wɔ wɔ ahonle nu, na wɔambiza agyadeɛ, anwonyia, enililɛ, anzɛɛ wɔanze me kɛ mengu menli mɔɔ kpɔ wɔ, na wɔambiza ngoane tendenle bɔbɔ, na wɔbiza kɛ ɛkpondɛ nrɛlɛbɛ nee ndelebɛbo wɔava wɔazie me menli ne mɔɔ ɛdi bɛ nwo zo belemgbunli la, 12meva nrɛlɛbɛ nee ndelebɛbo ne memaa wɔ. Mebamaa wɔ anwonyia nee agyadeɛ, na eza wɔanyia duma kpole mɔɔ arelemgbunli mɔɔ li ɛ nyunlu nee mɔɔ bavinde ɛ nzi la ɛnrɛnyia bie ɛlɛ a.”
Belemgbunli Sɔlɔmɔn tumi nee anwonyia
(1 Arl 10.26-29)
13Yemɔti Sɔlɔmɔn vile Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne anyunlu na ɔrale Gyɛlusalɛm. Na akee ɔziele Yizilayɛ maanle ne kɔsɔɔti. 14Sɔlɔmɔn boɔboale konle ehwili nloa na ɔnyianle menli mɔɔ ka mgbɔnwɔ la; ɔnyianle konle ehwili apenle ko ɛya nna, yɛɛ menli mɔɔ ka mgbɔnwɔ la apenle ngoko bulu nee nwiɔ, na ɔyele bɛ ɔziele azuamgbole ne mɔ mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛsie konle ehwili zolɛ la azo, yɛɛ eza bie woale belemgbunli ne anwo ɛkɛ ne wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm. 15Belemgbunli Sɔlɔmɔn manle ezukoa nvutuke nee dwɛtɛ fufule bule kɛ awolɛ la wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm, na ɔmanle sida mbaka bule kɛ Hyifɛla sikamɔ mbaka la. 16Sɔlɔmɔn mgbɔnwɔ mɔɔ ɔlɛ la, ye gualilɛma tɔ bɛ fi Mɛzelae nee Selesea, 17yɛɛ bɛtɔ ye konle ehwili ne mɔ bɛfi Yigyibiti. Bɛtɔ konle ehwili ko dwɛtɛ fufule ɛya nsia yɛɛ ɛkpɔnwɔ ko dwɛtɛ fufule ɛya ko abulanlu, na bɛazia bɛadɔne bɛ bɛamaa Hɛte nee Selea arelemgbunli.

Title: 2 EDK 2
Content:
Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne ɛzilɛ nwo anwomoalɛ
(1 Arl 5.1-18)
1Akee Sɔlɔmɔn yɛle ye adwenle kɛ ɔsi Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua mɔɔ bɛsonle Ɛdɛnkɛma wɔ nuhua la na yeabu ɔdaye ye awuke. 2Ɔyele menli apenle ngoko abulasuu mɔɔ bazoa sua nwo ninyɛne a, ɔyele menli apenle ngoko abulatwɛ mɔɔ bakpukekpuke awolɛ wɔ awoka ne mɔ azo a, yɛɛ ɔyele menli apenle nsa ɛya nsia mɔɔ banlea gyima ne azo a.
3Akee Sɔlɔmɔn vale nrɛlaleɛ hɔmanle Taya Belemgbunli Helam kɛ, “Kɛmɔ ɛ nee me ze Devidi bɛzile bɛyɛle mɔɔ ɛmanle bɛpɛle sida mbaka bɛrɛlɛle ye bɛmanle ɔzile ye sua ɔdɛnlanle nu la, ɛ nee medame noko ɛyɛ ye zɔhane ala. 4Nea, mesi sua meamaa bɛazonle Ɛdɛnkɛma me Nyamenle ne wɔ nu. Mebadu sua ne meazie ɛkɛ meamaa ye na bɛayela ɛyɛlɛ mɔɔ bɔ evuanlɛ la bɛamaa ye, na yɛava yɛ kpanwo nwuanzanwuanza azubɔdeɛ ne yeamaa ye dahuu. Yɛbayela nane yeabɔ azu wɔ ɛkɛ ne nwonlomɔ nee nɔsolɛ, Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ne, nee Siane Fofolɛ Ɛvoyialilɛ, yɛɛ ɛvoyia ngakyile mɔɔ ɛha la ɛlilɛ nu. Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛ Nyamenle ne a ɛhyehyɛ na yeyila zolɛ yemaa Yizilayɛma kɛ bɛyɛ ye zɔhane dahuu a. 5Sua ne mɔɔ mesi la bayɛ kpole kpalɛ, ɔluakɛ yɛ Nyamenle ne le kpole tɛla nyamenle kɔsɔɔti. 6Na nwane a kɛhola kɛzi sua kɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma a, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ anwuma nehane, anwuma anwuma nehane bɔbɔ le ekyi maa ye la? Mame bɔbɔ a le nwane mɔɔ mesi sua meamaa ye a? Kyesɛ ɛleka mɔɔ bɛyela ɛyɛlɛ la ala na meahola meazi. 7Zɔhane ati kpondɛ dwinvolɛ mɔɔ kola fa ezukoa nvutuke, dwɛtɛ fufule, kɔbele, yɛɛ bulalɛ yɛ gyima la maa me. Ɔwɔ kɛ ɔyɛ sonla mɔɔ kola nwo arelemgbunli ndanlɛ kɔkɔlɛ, kɔbenle nee buluwu mɔ la, na eza bɛtete ye mɔɔ ɔkola ɔgua ananze mɔ la. Sonla zɔhane nee dwinvolɛma mɔɔ me ze Devidi ɛye bɛ na bɛ nee me wɔ Dwuda nee Gyɛlusalɛm la a badɛnla ayɛ gyima a. 8Eza nwa me sida mbaka, sepelɛse nee dwunepa mbaka mɔɔ vi Lɛbanɔn kpɔkɛ ne anu la. Ɔluakɛ meze kɛ wɔ menli ne a ze mbakabulɛ nye zo kpalɛ wɔ Lɛbanɔn nehane a. Me menli baraboka wɔ menli ne mɔɔ bu mbaka ne la anwo, 9na bɛakpondɛ mbaka dɔɔnwo bɛamaa me, ɔluakɛ sua ne mɔɔ mesi la le kpole, na ɔyɛ ɛzulolɛ. 10Mebamaa wɔ menli ne mɔɔ bu mbaka ne la abɛlɛ tone nu tɔno apenle nwiɔ, baale tɔno apenle nwiɔ, nwanye litili apenle ngoko ɛya nna, yɛɛ ɔlivi nwole litili apenle ngoko ɛya nna.”
11Taya Belemgbunli Helam hɛlɛle kɛlata hɔbuale Sɔlɔmɔn kɛ, “Kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma kulo ye menli ne la ati, yezie wɔ belemgbunli kɛ ɛnlea bɛ nwo zo. 12Ayɛlɛyelɛ ɛha Yizilayɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle ne mɔɔ bɔle anwuma nee aze, mɔɔ ɛmaa Belemgbunli Devidi ɛwo ralɛ nrenya mɔɔ ze nrɛlɛbɛ, mɔɔ lɛ adwenle nee ndelebɛbo, mɔɔ bazi Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua amaa Ɛdɛnkɛma na yeabu ye belemgbunli awuke a. 13Medu Hulam mɔɔ le dwinvolɛ nrɛlɛbɛvolɛ 14na ɔ nli le Dan abo zo sonla, na ɔ ze vi Taya la kɛ ɔrɛla. Ɔze kɛ bɛsi bɛfa ezukoa nvutuke, dwɛtɛ fufule, kɔbele, bulalɛ, bolɛ nee mbaka bɛdi adwinli la. Ɔkola ɔdi adwinli ɔgua arelemgbunli ndanlɛ buluwu nee kɔkɔlɛ nee fufule nu. Ɔkola ɔse ninyɛne ngakyile dɔɔnwo, yɛɛ ɔbahola yeali adwinli biala mɔɔ ɛkɛva ɛkɛhile ye la. Maa ɔ nee wɔ dwinvolɛma nee dwinvolɛma mɔɔ yɛle gyima manle ɛ ze Belemgbunli Devidi la ɛyɛ gyima. 15Zɔhane ati maa bɛva hwiiti, baale, nwole yɛɛ nwanye ne mɔɔ ɛlile bɛ edwɛkɛ la bɛrɛlɛ yɛ. 16Yɛbapɛ mbaka dodo biala mɔɔ ɛkpondɛ wɔ Lɛbanɔn la, na yeakyekye bɛ avile yeava yɛalua nyevile nye yɛara Dwɔpa, na wɔarava wɔahɔ Gyɛlusalɛm.”
Bɛbɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne ɛzilɛ bo
(1 Arl 6.1-38)
17Belemgbunli Sɔlɔmɔn manle bɛdianle nyɛvolɛ mɔɔ wɔ maanle ne anu la amuala, kɛmɔ ɔ ze Devidi yɛle la. Bɛnyianle menli apenle ngoko ɛya ko abulanlu nee nsa, menli ɛya nsia. 18Ɔyele nuhua apenle ngoko abulasuu kɛ bɛzoa ninyɛne mɔɔ bɛfa bɛazi sua ne la, nuhua apenle ngoko abulatwɛ kɛ bɛkpukekpuke awolɛ wɔ awoka ne mɔ azo na nuhua apenle nsa ɛya nsia ne ɛnlea bɛ nwo zo ɛmaa bɛyɛ gyima ne.

Title: 2 EDK 3
Content:
1Mekɛ ne anu ɛnee Sɔlɔmɔn ɔ ze Belemgbunli Devidi ɛziezie ɛleka mɔɔ bɛbazi Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne la ɛwie. Ɛleka ne wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm, wɔ Molaya Boka, ɛleka mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma yele ɔ nwo hilele Devidi mɔɔ Gyibɛsenli Alɔna (Ɔnan) ɛnee wozo ye ma ne la. Belemgbunli Sɔlɔmɔn bɔle sua ne ɛzilɛ bo 2wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee yeli ɛvolɛ nna wɔ ebia ne azo la, ye siane nwiɔ ne azo. 3Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne mɔɔ Belemgbunli Sɔlɔmɔn zile la tendenle le mita abulanwiɔ nee nsuu yɛɛ ye tɛtɛlɛ le mita ngɔnla. 4Ekpumgbunli ne mɔɔ bɛdua nu bɛwolo sua ne anu la tɛtɛlɛ le mita ngɔnla kɛ sua mumua ne tɛtɛlɛ la, yɛɛ ye anwumahɔlɛ le mita abulanlu nee nna. Sɔlɔmɔn vale ezukoa nvutuke tagyee fɔlele sua ne anu amuala. 5Bɛvale sida mbaka bɛzɛle sua ne anye yɛɛ bɛholole ezukoa nvutuke tagyee bɛguale mbaka ne mɔɔ bɛvale bɛzɛle sua ne anye la azo na bɛlile mrɛlɛ nee nwɔnzɔnwɔnzɔ adwinli bɛguale zolɛ. 6Belemgbunli Sɔlɔmɔn vale awolɛ ngɛnlɛma mɔɔ sonle bolɛ nee ezukoa nvutuke mɔɔ ɔhɛlale ɔvile Paveeyem la zieziele Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu. 7Ɔholole ezukoa nvutuke ne ɔguale sua ne bane ne mɔ, aakɔ ne mɔ, sua ne nwolodo ne bane ne mɔ, nee nlenkɛ ne mɔ anwo. Ɔmanle bɛlile adwinli mɔɔ le kɛ abɔdeɛ mɔɔ lɛ ndɛbalɛ la bɛguale sua ne bane ne mɔ anwo. 8Sua ne akunlu ɛleka ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Nwuanzanwuanza Nu Nwuanzaanwu la tendenle le mita ngɔnla yɛɛ ye tɛtɛlɛ le mita ngɔnla kɛ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua mumua ne tɛtɛlɛ la. Ezukoa nvutuke mɔɔ ye ɛnlomboɛ kɛyɛ tone nu tɔno abulanwiɔ la yɛɛ bɛholole bɛguale Nwuanzanwuanza Nu Nwuanzaanwu Ɛleka ne bane ne mɔ anwo a. 9Bɛvale ezukoa nvutuke gelamo ɛya nnu abulasuu bɛyɛle agbɛlɛko, yɛɛ anwuma ekpumgbunli ne mɔ noko, bɛholole ezukoa nvutuke bɛguale bɛ bane ne mɔ anwo.
10Belemgbunli eza manle ye dwinvolɛma ne vale mbulalɛ yɛle abɔdeɛ mɔɔ lɛ ndɛbalɛ la nwiɔ na bɛholole ezukoa nvutuke bɛguale nwolɛ, na bɛvale bɛziele Nwuanzanwuanza Nu Nwuanzaanwu Ɛleka ne. 11-13Bɛziele bɛ mɔɔ ɛnee bɛ mu nwiɔ bɛfoamo nwolɛ na bɛ nye kɔ anuhɔlɛ lɔ la. Ko biala lɛ ndɛbalɛ nwiɔ, ndɛbalɛ ko biala le mita nwiɔ nee ekyi; bɛdɛlɛdɛlɛ bɛ ndɛba ne mɔ anu; ko andɛba yia ɔ gɔnwo ɛdeɛ zo wɔ sua ne avinli sɛsɛ, yɛɛ bɛ ndɛba ngoko ne mɔ mɔɔ ɛha la, ko ɛdeɛ kpula ye tɛbanu bane ne. Ɛhye kile kɛ bɛ ndɛba ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛdɛlɛdɛlɛ nu la nee Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne tɛtɛlɛ mɔɔ kɛyɛ mita ngɔnla la sɛ. 14Bɛvale lenen ɛdanlɛ, ɛdanlɛ buluwu, ɛdanlɛ kɔkɔlɛ, yɛɛ ɛdanlɛ bie mɔɔ anye le buluwu nee kɔkɔlɛ afonla, mɔɔ bɛnwo abɔdeɛ mɔɔ lɛ ndɛbalɛ bɛgua nuhua la bɛyɛle mgbɛnu bɛpɛle Nwuanzanwuanza Nu Nwuanzaanwu Ɛleka ne.
Kɔbele mpila nwiɔ ne
(1 Arl 7.15-22)
15Belemgbunli ne manle bɛyɛle kɔbele mpila nwiɔ mɔɔ ko anwumahɔlɛ le mita bulu nee nnu nee foa ko la na ɔziele bɛ wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anyunlu. Ko biala lɛ ɔ ti mɔɔ ye anwumahɔlɛ le mita nwiɔ nee ekyi a. 16Bɛnwonle debie bie mɔɔ le kɛ nwɔnzɔnwɔnzɔ la bɛguale mpila ne mɔ ati ne mɔ azo na bɛvale kɔbele debie ahunguma mɔɔ le kɛ akutue la ɛya ko bɛguale zolɛ. 17Bɛvale mpila ne mɔ bɛzieziele Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anuhɔlɛ ne: ko gyi nyiakɛ, bɛfɛlɛ ye Gyeeken, yɛɛ ko gyi ye sɔlɔ, bɛfɛlɛ ye Bowaze.

Title: 2 EDK 4
Content:
Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anwo ninyɛne
(1 Arl 7.23-51)
1Belemgbunli Sɔlɔmɔn manle bɛyɛle kɔbele azukponle mɔɔ ye tɛtɛlɛ nee ye tendenle sɛ la. Ye tɛbanu ko biala le mita ngɔnla, yɛɛ ye anwumahɔlɛ le mita nna nee foa ko. 2Eza ɔyɛle kɔbele angola kpole ko, ɔ kunlu kuloonwu le mita nwiɔ nee ekyi, ye sinlinyunlu le mita nna nee asɛɛ foa ko, yɛɛ ye bolomolo le mita bulu nee nsa nee ekyi. 3Bɛguale debie bie mɔɔ le kɛ nlankɛ nyinli la dɔɔnwo ɛhonlone nwiɔ wɔ angola ne anloa. Bɛvale bɛ bɛbokale angola ne bɛguale bɛ kokye, yɛɛ ɛhonlone ko wɔ ko azo. 4Angola ne gyi kɔbele nlankɛ nyinli bulu nee nwiɔ azo. Nsa anye kɔ sɔlɔ, nsa anye kɔ adɔleɛ, nsa anye kɔ nyiakɛ, yɛɛ nsa anye kɔ aduduleɛ; angola ne keda bɛ nwo zo na bɛ ti nwenle zo. 5Angola ne ɛzamo le kɛyɛ mita ngyɛnu nna ɛkpɔ nsa, yɛɛ ɔ nloa le kɛ kɔpo, na bɛbele ye alie nwo bɛmaa yezɔho kɛ aloa ndotolo mɔɔ ekpuke la. Angola ne di nzule litili kɛyɛ apenle ngoko abulasia. 6Eza noko bɛyɛle ahyɛnze kuloonwu bulu, na bɛvale bɛ nnu nnu bɛzieziele Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne sɔlɔ nee nyiakɛ. Bɛfa ahyɛnze ne mɔ bɛnrinzi nane azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ ɛleka ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛbayela bɛabɔ azu la anwo. Nzule ne mɔɔ wɔ angola ne anu la yɛɛ sɛlɛvolɛma ne fa bia a.
7-8Bɛyɛle ezukoa nvutuke kɛnlaneɛ mbaka bulu, kɛmɔ bɛhilele la, yɛɛ bɛyɛle ɛkponle bulu, na bɛvale bɛzieziele Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua mumua ne anu. Kɛnlaneɛ mbaka nnu nee ɛkponle nnu gyigyi foa ko, yɛɛ eza kɛnlaneɛ mbaka nnu nee ɛkponle nnu gyigyi foa ko. Eza bɛyɛle ezukoa nvutuke dwora ɛya ko.
9Bɛyɛle alie nwo ko bɛmanle sɛlɛvolɛma ne angome, wɔ awuke ne akunlu, yɛɛ bɛyɛle kpole kpalɛ ko wɔ awuke wienyi ne anu. Nlenkɛ mɔɔ duodua anuhɔlɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ wɔ alie nwo nwiɔ ne avinli la, bɛholole kɔbele bɛguale nwolɛ. 10Angola ne gyi Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne nyiakɛ aduduleɛ afoa nu.
11-16Hulam eza yɛle mbuakɛ, sofi nee dwora mɔ. Ninyɛne mɔɔ ɔbɔle Belemgbunli Sɔlɔmɔn ɛwɔkɛ kɛ ɔkɛyɛ wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anwo la, ɔwiele bɛ muala yɛ. Bɛmɛ a le:
Mpila nwiɔ ne
Adile nwiɔ ne mɔɔ bɛyɛ bɛ kɛ ahyɛnze bɛduoduale mpila
ne mɔ azo la
Deɛ nwɔnzɔnwɔnzɔ ne mɔɔ bɛnwonle bɛguale mpila adile
ne mɔ azo la
Ninyɛne ɛya nna ne mɔɔ le kɛ akutue mɔɔ bɛguale bɛ
ɛhonlone nwiɔ nwiɔ wɔ mpila adile ne mɔ azo la
Ehwili bulu ne
Ahyɛnze akunlu kuloonwu bulu ne Angola ne
Nlankɛ nyinli bulu nee nwiɔ ne mɔɔ angola ne gyi zolɛ la
Mbuakɛ ne, sofi ne, yɛɛ faka ne mɔ.
Hulam mɔɔ le dwinvolɛ mɔɔ di munli la a yɛle ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ amuala a. Ɔvale kɔbele mɔɔ bɛdu nuhua la a ɔyɛle a, kɛmɔ Belemgbunli Sɔlɔmɔn zele kɛ bɛva ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ amuala bɛyɛ gyima wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu la.
17Belemgbunli ne manle bɛyɛle ninyɛne ne mɔ amuala wɔ dwinvolɛma gyima ne mɔɔ wɔ Sɛko nee Zɛlɛda avinli la, wɔ Dwɔdan Bɔnza. 18Bɛyɛle ninyɛne dɔɔnwo kpalɛ, yemɔti awie angola anzuzu annwu kɔbele dodo mɔɔ bɛvale bɛyɛle la ɛnlomboɛ.
19Belemgbunli Sɔlɔmɔn eza manle bɛvale ezukoa nvutuke bɛyɛle ninyɛne bɛzieziele Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu. Bɛmɛ a le azukponle ne nee ɛkponle ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛgua kpanwo ne mɔɔ bɛva bɛbɔ azu bɛmaa Nyamenle la zo la; 20akee kɛnlaneɛ mbaka ne mɔ nee ahɛnlaneɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛva ezukoa nvutuke kpalɛ a bɛyɛ na bɛsɔ wɔ Nwuanzanwuanza Nu Nwuanzaanwu Ɛleka ne, kɛmɔ bɛhilele la, 21ndotolo mɔɔ bɛva bɛziezie sua ne anu, ahɛnlaneɛ, mbaka mɔɔ bɛfa bɛsɔ ahɛnlaneɛ, 22mbaka mɔɔ bɛfa bɛnua ahɛnlaneɛ, ahyɛnze akunlu kuloonwu, ɛyɛba mɔɔ bɛyela ɛyɛlɛ wɔ nu, yɛɛ ahyɛnze mɔɔ bɛfa bɛfula samɛnlankɛ la. Bɛvale ezukoa nvutuke kpalɛ a bɛyɛle ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ a. Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne findezo nlenkɛ ne mɔ nee Nwuanzanwuanza Nu Nwuanzaanwu Ɛleka ne anlenkɛ ne, bɛholole ezukoa nvutuke bɛguale nwolɛ.

Title: 2 EDK 5
Content:
1 Mɔɔ Belemgbunli Sɔlɔmɔn wiele Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anwo gyima biala di la, ɔvale ninyɛne mɔɔ ɔ ze Devidi ɛdu ɛzie ɛkɛ ɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma la: dwɛtɛ fufule, ezukoa nvutuke, nee ninyɛne mɔɔ ɛha la amuala ɔhɔziele Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne ekpumgbunli ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛfa ninyɛne bɛsie nu la anu.
Bɛva Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne bɛra Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu
(1 Arl 8.1-9)
2 Akee Belemgbunli Sɔlɔmɔn dole ɛsalɛ vɛlɛle mbusua ekpunli ekpunli ne mɔ mgbanyinli, Yizilayɛ mgbanyima, mbusua mgbanyinli mɔɔ gyigyi bɛ ze mɔ awuke ti la manle bɛ muala bɛrayiale Gyɛlusalɛm, kɛ bɛkava Ɛdɛnkɛma Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne wɔ Devidi Suakpole zo, Zayɔn bɛ nee ye ara Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu.
3Menli ne amuala rayiale mekɛ mɔɔ bɛbali Kpɔda Bo Ɛdɛnlanlɛ Ɛvoyia ne la wɔ siane nsuu ne anu. 4Mɔɔ mgbanyima ne mɔ amuala wiele yia la, akee Livaema ne hɔmanle Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne zo 5na bɛ nee ye rale Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu. Eza sɛlɛvolɛma ne nee Livaema ne mɔ yeyele Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne, bɛdudule nwolɛ debie biala na bɛvale bɛraguale Sua ne anu. 6Belemgbunli Sɔlɔmɔn nee Yizilayɛma amuala yiale Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne anyunlu ɛkɛ na bɛhunle mboane nee nlankɛ dɔɔnwo kpalɛ mɔɔ bɛngola bɛ tia la bɛbɔle azu. 7Akee sɛlɛvolɛma ne vale Ɛdɛnkɛma Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne raziele ɛleka mɔɔ bɛziezie bɛmaa ye wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu, wɔ Nwuanzanwuanza Nu Nwuanzaanwu Ɛleka ne, wɔ abɔdeɛ nwiɔ ne mɔɔ lɛ ndɛbalɛ la abo. 8Kɛmɔ ɛnee abɔdeɛ nwiɔ ne mɔɔ lɛ ndɛbalɛ la ɛdɛlɛdɛlɛ bɛ ndɛba ne mɔ anu la ati, bɛ ndɛba ne mɔ hedale Ɛlɛka ne nee mbaka mɔɔ bɛvale bɛzoale la amuala azo. 9Na mbaka ne mɔ noko wowale, yemɔti saa sonla gyi Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu na ɔto ɔ nye Nwuanzanwuanza Nu Nwuanzaanwu Ɛleka ne a, ɔnwu mbaka ne mɔ ati. Sonla gyi alie nwo a, ɔnnwu mbaka ne mɔ. (Mbaka ne mɔ tɛbɔ ɛkɛ ne ɛnɛ nee ɛnɛ ala.) 10 Ɛhwee ɛnle Ɛlɛka ne anu kɛ awolɛ ndɛbandɛba nwiɔ ne mɔɔ Mosisi vale guale nu wɔ Hɔlɛbe la. Hɔlɛbe a Ɛdɛnkɛma nee Yizilayɛma yɛle ngyekyeleɛ ne a, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɔyele bɛ ɔvile Yigyibiti la.
Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlunyia ne
11-14Sɛlɛvolɛma mɔɔ rale la amuala dule bɛ nwo manle Ɛdɛnkɛma, bɛandwenle bɛ ekpunli ngakyile ne mɔ anwo. Akee Livae edwɛndolɛma mɔɔ le Esafe, Himan, nee Gyɛdutɛn, nee bɛ mbusuafoɔ ne mɔ amuala wulowulale adɛladeɛ fufule. Edwɛndolɛma ɛhye mɔ gyinlanle azukponle ne aduduleɛ afoa nu, bɛdedɛ sɔnwosɔnwo nee getaa, yɛɛ sɛlɛvolɛma ɛya ko abulanwiɔ ɛlɛbɔ aweɛne ndendenle. Aweɛnebɔlɛ ne, sɔnwosɔnwobɔlɛ ne, nee ninyɛne mɔɔ ɛha la nee edwɛndolɛ ne kɔ zolɛ pɛpɛ, na bɛyele Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ kɛ,
“Bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ, ɔboalekɛ ɔle kpalɛ,
yɛɛ ye ɛhulolɛ ɛmbɔ aze ɛlɛ.”
Mɔɔ sɛlɛvolɛma ne vi Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu ɛlɛfinde la, arɛlevilɛ nu ala, amungu nwohyee rayile sua ne na ɔmanle Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlunyia dale hilele kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma wɔ ɛkɛ. Na sɛlɛvolɛma ne angola bɛ gyima ne di bieko.

Title: 2 EDK 6
Content:
Sɔlɔmɔn tendɛ ahile menli ne
(1 Arl 8.12-21)
1Na Belemgbunli Sɔlɔmɔn zɛlɛle kɛ,
“Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛha kɛ ɔbadɛnla awozinli kabii nu.
2Kɛkala, mezi Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua kpole ɛhye memaa wɔ
kɛ ɛleka mɔɔ ɛbadɛnla dahuu a.”
3Akee belemgbunli ne hakyile ɔ nye menli ne anwo na ɔzɛlɛle Nyamenle nyilalɛ ɔmanle bɛ. Mekɛ ɛhye amuala, ɛnee Yizilayɛma amuala gyi nzisi. 4 Na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛye Yizilayɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle ne ayɛlɛ! Ɔluakɛ yeva ye tumi ne yeli ye ɛwɔkɛ ne mɔɔ ɔbɔle me ze Devidi la azo. Ɔzele ye kɛ, 5‘Sumunli kɛ menyele me menli ne menvile Yigyibiti azɛlɛ zo la, metɛneanle Yizilayɛ mbusua ekpunli ekpunli ne mɔ anu metɛtule suakpole ko metɛmanle me nwo kɛ bɛzi sua wɔ ɛkɛ ne na me duma ɛla zolɛ, eza metɛneanle nu metɛtule awie ko kɛ ɔli belemgbunli ɔnlea me menli Yizilayɛma anwo zo. 6Noko kɛkala, menlea nu meye Gyɛlusalɛm kɛ ɛkɛ ne yɛɛ bɛzonle me a, yɛɛ meye Devidi kɛ ɔli belemgbunli ɔzie me menli Yizilayɛma.’ ”
7Sɔlɔmɔn hɔle zo hanle kɛ, “Me ze Devidi a hyehyɛle kɛ ɔsi Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua yeamaa bɛazonle Yizilayɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle ne wɔ nu a. 8Na Ɛdɛnkɛma zele ye kɛ, ‘Ɔle kpalɛ kɛ wɔdwenle nwolɛ kɛ ɛsi sua wɔamaa me a. 9Noko akee tɛ wɔmɔ yɛɛ ɛsi sua wɔamaa me a. Ɛ ra nrenya, ɛdawɔ ɛ kunlu ralɛ nrenya yɛɛ bazi sua ne amaa me a.’
10“Kɛkala, Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛli ye ɛwɔkɛ ne azo. Medame yɛɛ meli egya agya meli Yizilayɛ belemgbunli a, yɛɛ mezi Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua kɛ bɛzonle Yizilayɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle ne wɔ nu. 11Meva Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne mezie Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu. Nuhua yɛɛ awolɛ ndɛbandɛba ne mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma nee Yizilayɛma ngyekyeleɛ ne mɔɔ bɛyɛle la wɔ zolɛ la wɔ a.”
Sɔlɔmɔn nzɛlɛlɛ ne
(1 Arl 8.22-53)
12Akee Sɔlɔmɔn ragyinlanle azukponle ne anyunlu ɛkɛ ne wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ Yizilayɛma amuala wɔ ɛkɛ ne la, na ɔdɛlɛle ɔ sa nu ɔzɛlɛle. 13(Mekɛ ne anu ɛnee Sɔlɔmɔn ɛva kɔbele ɛbo sɛlɛdwee wɔ alie nwo ɛkɛ ne avinli. Sɛlɛdwee ne anwumahɔlɛ le asɛɛ mita ko nee foa yɛɛ ye tɛtɛlɛ nee ye tendenle sɛ; biala le mita nwiɔ nee ekyi. Ɔvole sɛlɛdwee ne azo mɔɔ awie biala nwu ye la na akee ɔhotole, ɔmanle ɔ sa zo anwuma.) 14Akee ɔzɛlɛle kɛ, “O Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle, nyamenle biala nee wɔ ɛnzɛ wɔ anwuma anzɛɛ aze ɛke, mɔɔ di ye ngyekyeleɛ mɔɔ ɔ nee ye ngɛkɛlɛ kɛkyekye la azo, na ɔkile ye ɛhulolɛ ne mɔɔ ɛmbɔ aze ɛlɛ la wɔ ye ngɛkɛlɛ mɔɔ kɛyeye bɛ ahonle nu kɛyɛ tieyɛ kɛmaa ye la anwo a. 15Wɔli wɔ ɛwɔkɛ mɔɔ ɛbɔle me ze Devidi la azo na wɔlua wɔ tumi zo wɔmaa ɛnɛ debie biala ɛyɛ zɔhane. 16 Yemɔti, O Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle, mesɛlɛ wɔ, di wɔ ɛwɔkɛ mɔɔ ɛha la azo, ɛwɔkɛ ne mɔɔ ɛbɔle me ze Devidi kɛ saa ɔ bo zo amra di wɔ mɛla ne mɔ azo na bɛyɛ tieyɛ bɛmaa wɔ kɛmɔ ɔdaye Devidi ɔyɛle la a, dahuu bɛ bie bali belemgbunli azie Yizilayɛma la. 17Yemɔti, O Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle, maa mɔɔ wɔha la biala ɛyɛ nɔhalɛ, kɛmɔ ɛvale ɛbɔle me ze Devidi ɛwɔkɛ la.
18 “Na asoo amgba ɛdawɔ Nyamenle ɛ nee menli badɛnla ewiade ye anu? Anwuma nehane tɛtɛtɛlɛlɛ ne bɔbɔ, ɛnzo lɔ, na akee Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ekyi ɛhye mɔɔ mezi la yɛɛ ɛbazo nu a? 19Noko akee, Ɛdɛnkɛma me Nyamenle, tie wɔ akɛlɛ nzɛlɛlɛ nee ye modolɛ na yɛ mɔɔ mebiza la maa me.
20“Mesɛlɛ wɔ, buke ɛ nye na sinza Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ɛhye nɔɔzo nee ewiazo. Wɔbɔ ɛwɔkɛ kɛ ɛke yɛɛ bɛzonle wɔ a, yemɔti saa medame wɔ sonvolɛ, mekakyi me nye Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ɛhye anwo na mesɛlɛ a, anrɛɛ tie me. 21Saa medame wɔ sonvolɛ o, anzɛɛ wɔ menli Yizilayɛma o, saa biala kakyi ɔ nye Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ye anwo na ɔsɛlɛ a, anrɛɛ tie ye wɔ wɔ sua nu anwuma lɔ. Saa ɛtie yɛ a eza fa yɛ ɛtane ne mɔ kyɛ yɛ.
22“Saa awie fo ɔ gɔnwo na bɛ nee ye ba wɔ azukponle ye anyunlu wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ye anu kɛ ɔraha ndane ɔza ɔ ne a, 23tie bɛ wɔ anwuma lɔ, twe mɔɔ di fɔlɛ la anzo kɛmɔ ɔfɛta la, na yileyila mɔɔ di benle la.
24“Saa wɔ menli Yizilayɛma yɛ ɛtane tia wɔ na ɛmaa bɛ kpɔvolɛma di bɛ nwo zo konim, na nzinlii bɛsia bɛtoa ɛ bo zo, na bɛba Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ye anu bɛbakpa wɔ kyɛlɛ kɛ ɛva bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ ɛhyɛ bɛ a, 25tie bɛ wɔ anwuma lɔ, fa bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ kyɛ bɛ na fa bɛ sia bɛla azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ ɛvale ɛmanle bɛ la azo.
26“Saa wɔ menli ne yɛ ɛtane tia wɔ na ɛmaa ezule gyakyi ɛdɔlɛ kɛ ɛfa wɔadea bɛ, na bɛnu bɛ nwo, na bɛkakyi bɛ nye Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ye anwo bɛsɛlɛ wɔ a, 27tie bɛ wɔ anwuma lɔ, fa wɔ menli Yizilayɛma ɛtane ne mɔ kyɛ bɛ, kilehile bɛ maa bɛli boɛ na tɔ ezule gua azɛlɛ ye mɔɔ wɔva wɔmaa bɛ kɛ bɛ ɛdeɛ ɔ la azo.
28“Saa ɛhɔne ba azɛlɛ ye azo, anzɛɛ ahumu nee ngɛkɛba sɛkye bɛ aleɛ, saa bɛ kpɔvolɛma fa konle batoa bɛ, bɛbɛnra bɛ azuamgbole bɛyia mɔɔ awie ɛngola ɛnvi sua zo ɛnvinde la, anzɛɛ ewule nzane bie tɔ bɛ avinli, anwonyane biala mɔɔ kɛbɔ bɛ la, 29nzɛlɛlɛ biala anzɛɛ modolɛ biala mɔɔ bɛ nuhua ko biala anzɛɛ wɔ menli Yizilayɛma amuala kɛbɔ nu, kɛva bɛ nyane ngakyile ne mɔ kɛdende bɛ sa wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ɛhye anwo kɛzɛlɛ la, 30tie bɛ wɔ anwuma lɔ, ɛleka mɔɔ ɛde la, na fa bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ kyɛ bɛ. Ɛ ngomekye yɛɛ ɛze sonla ahonle nu a, yɛ maa awie biala kɛmɔ bɛ nzɛlɛlɛ ne mɔ se la, 31amaa bɛazulo wɔ na mekɛ biala bɛayɛ tieyɛ bɛamaa wɔ wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛde azɛlɛ ye mɔɔ ɛvale ɛmanle bɛ nlenya mɔ la azo la.
32“Zɔhane ala yɛɛ saa ɛyɛvolɛ mɔɔ ɛnle Yizilayɛnli la te wɔ nganeɛ wɔ ninyɛne mgbole mɔɔ wɔyɛ, wɔ tumi nee wɔ ɛlolɛ, na ɔvi ye maanle nu moa moa ɔba kɛ ɔbazonle wɔ wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ye anu a, 33tie ye wɔ anwuma lɔ, ɛleka mɔɔ ɛde la na yɛ debie biala mɔɔ ɔkpondɛ la maa ye. Ɛhye bamaa menli kɔsɔɔti mɔɔ wɔ aleɛabo la anwu wɔ na bɛazulo wɔ, kɛmɔ wɔ menli Yizilayɛma ɛnwu wɔ na bɛsulo wɔ la. Eza bɛbanwu kɛ amgba ɔwɔ kɛ bɛsonle wɔ wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ɛhye mɔɔ mezi memaa wɔ la anu.
34“Saa wɔ menli ne kɔ kɛ bɛ nee bɛ kpɔvolɛma kaho na adenle biala mɔɔ ɛkɛva zo ɛkɛzoa bɛ la, saa bɛkakyi bɛ nye wɔ suakpole ɛhye mɔɔ ɛdawɔ wɔkpa nu wɔdu wɔmaa ɛ nwo la azo nee Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ye mɔɔ mezi memaa wɔ la anwo na bɛsɛlɛ a, 35tie bɛ nzɛlɛlɛ nee bɛ modolɛ wɔ anwuma lɔ na gyinla bɛ nzi maa bɛli konim.
36“Kɛmɔ ɛtane ɛmkpa sonla nwo la, saa wɔ menli ne yɛ ɛtane tia wɔ, maa ɛfa bɛ nwo ɛya na ɛmaa bɛ kpɔvolɛma di bɛ nwo zo konim, kye bɛ donvula kɔ nlɔnu wɔ maanle gyɛne nu moa moa anzɛɛ amozi ɛke ala bie, 37na bɛto bɛ nwo aze wɔ maanle ne mɔɔ bɛhye bɛ bɛhɔ nu la anu, na bɛnu bɛ nwo bɛsɛlɛ wɔ kɛ, ‘Ɛdɛnkɛma, yɛvo wɔ, yɛyɛ ninyɛne mɔɔ ɛnfɛta la yɛtia wɔ’, 38na bɛnu bɛ nwo wɔ maanle ne mɔɔ bɛhye bɛ bɛhɔ nu la anu, bɛyeye bɛ munli nu bɛkakyi bɛ nye wɔ bɛ azɛlɛ ye mɔɔ ɛvale ɛmanle bɛ ze mɔ la azo, nee suakpole ne mɔɔ wɔdu wɔmaa ɛ nwo la anwo, nee Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ye mɔɔ mezi memaa wɔ la anwo a, 39tie bɛ nzɛlɛlɛ nee bɛ modolɛ wɔ anwuma lɔ, ɛleka mɔɔ ɛde la, gyinla bɛ nzi na fa wɔ menli ne mɔɔ ɛvo wɔ la ɛtane ne mɔ kyɛ bɛ.
40“O me Nyamenle, maa ɛ nye ɛrɛla yɛ nwo zo na tie yɛ nzɛlɛlɛ mɔɔ yɛkɛyɛ wɔ ɛke la. 41 Dwazo, O Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle, na ɛ nee wɔ Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne mɔɔ kile wɔ tumi kpole ne la ɛwolo Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu na bɛlie bɛ ɛnwomenle wɔ ɛkɛ ne na bɛdɛnla ɛkɛ ne dahuu. Yila wɔ sɛlɛvolɛma wɔ debie biala mɔɔ bɛyɛ la anu na maa wɔ menli anye ɛlie kɛ ɛle kpalɛ ɛmaa bɛ a. 42O Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle, mmakakyi ɛ nzi ɛsi wɔ belemgbunli ne mɔɔ wɔkpokpa ye la. Kakye wɔ ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne mɔɔ ɛnyianle ye wɔ wɔ akɛlɛ Devidi anwo la.”

Title: 2 EDK 7
Content:
Bɛtu Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne bɛamaa Nyamenle
(1 Arl 8.62-66)
1 Belemgbunli Sɔlɔmɔn wiele nzɛlɛlɛ ne yɛ la, senle vi anwuma rayelale ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ ne nee azubɔdeɛ mɔɔ ɛha la, na wienyi kpole bie mɔɔ kile Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlunyia la rayile Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne. 2Sɛlɛvolɛma ne angola Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu wolo, ɔboalekɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlunyia ne ɛyi ɛkɛ ne. 3 Mekɛ mɔɔ Yizilayɛma nwunle senle ne kɛ ɔvi anwuma yerayela azubɔlɛ ninyɛne ne mɔ nee Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlunyia ne mɔɔ ɛyi Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne la, bɛbutubutule bɛ nye aze na bɛyeyɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma, bɛyɛle ye mo kɛ, “Ɔle kpalɛ, ɔluakɛ ye ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne wɔ ɛkɛ ne dahuu.” 4Akee belemgbunli ne nee menli ne amuala bɔle azu manle Ɛdɛnkɛma. 5Belemgbunli Sɔlɔmɔn vale nlankɛ apenle ngoko abulanwiɔ nee nwiɔ yɛɛ mboane apenle ngoko ɛya ko abulanwiɔ a bɔle azu ne a. Yemɔti belemgbunli nee menli ne amuala dule Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne manle Nyamenle. 6Sɛlɛvolɛma ne gyinlanle ɛleka mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛgyinla la, Livaema ne noko gyinlanle bɛ bo zo ne na bɛvale edwɛnedolɛ nwo ninyɛne mɔɔ Belemgbunli Devidi vale manle bɛ la bɛdole edwɛne bɛyeyɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma kɛ, “Ye ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne wɔ ɛkɛ ne dahuu.” Sɛlɛvolɛma ne bɔle aweɛne ndendenle nu na menli ne amuala dwazole gyinlanle.
7Akee Sɔlɔmɔn dule Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anyunlu alie ne anwo avinli ɛkɛ ne manle Nyamenle, na ɔbɔle nane mumua ɛyelalɛ, ma ɛyelalɛ, nee anzonudwolɛ azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ ɛnlome azu wɔ ɛkɛ, ɔboalekɛ ɛnee ɛyelalɛ azubɔlɛ ninyɛne ne, ma azubɔdeɛ ne, nee nane ɛnlome azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ ɛnzo kɔbele azukponle ne mɔɔ Sɔlɔmɔn zile la azo.
8Sɔlɔmɔn nee Yizilayɛma lile Kpɔda Bo Ɛdɛnlanlɛ Ɛvoyia ne kenle nsuu. Menli dɔɔnwo vi Heemate Ademgbolezo, wɔ maanle ne sɔlɔ toonwo mɔɔ kɔkpula Yigyibiti ɛweɛne zo, wɔ maanle ne nyiakɛ la rale. 9Bɛvale kenle nsuu bɛdule Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne bɛmanle Nyamenle yɛɛ bɛvale kenle nsuu noko bɛlile ɛvoyia ne. Ye kenle mɔtwɛ ne azo bɛyɛle nzɛlɛlɛ bɛvale ayia ne bɛrale awieleɛ. 10Ye alehyenlɛ nu, siane nsuu ne kenle abulanwiɔ nee nsa ne azo, Sɔlɔmɔn manle menli ne amuala hɔle bɛ azua nu. Bɛlile fɛlɛko wɔ nyilalɛ dɔɔnwo mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛva ɛyila Devidi nee Sɔlɔmɔn nee ye menli Yizilayɛma la anwo.
Nyamenle ye ɔ nwo ahile Sɔlɔmɔn bieko
(1 Arl 9.1-9)
11Mɔɔ Belemgbunli Sɔlɔmɔn wiele Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne si, ɔbule ye awuke ne na ɔwiele debie biala mɔɔ ɔhyehyɛle la yɛ la, 12akee Ɛdɛnkɛma yele ɔ nwo hilele ye kenle ko nɔɔzo na ɔzele ye kɛ, “Mede wɔ nzɛlɛlɛ ne, yɛɛ meva Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ɛhye kɛ nuhua yɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛbɔ azu bɛmaa me a. 13Saa memaa ewia pe mɔɔ ezule ɛndɔ, anzɛɛ meye abɛbɛ kɛ bɛzɛkye bɛ aleɛ, anzɛɛ saa meye ewule nzane meto me menli ne anwo, 14na saa me menli ne mɔɔ bɛfa me duma a bɛfɛlɛ bɛ la bɛlɛ bɛ nwo aze, sɛlɛ na bɛkpondɛ me bo zo, na bɛgyakyi bɛ ninyɛndane ne mɔ ɛyɛlɛ a, yemɔ mebadie bɛ wɔ anwuma lɔ, na meava bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ meahyɛ bɛ, na meamaa bɛ azɛlɛ ne ahye aleɛ. 15Akee mebavede me nye meanlea Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ɛhye kpalɛ na meabuke me nzo meadie nzɛlɛlɛ biala mɔɔ bɛbayɛ ye wɔ ɛke la. 16Ɔluakɛ kɛkala, meva Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ɛhye na medu ye mezie ɛkɛ memaa me nwo mekɛ biala kɛ nuhua yɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛsonle me a. Me nye nee me ahonle bawoa ɛkɛ ne mekɛ biala. 17Na wɔmɔ, saa ɛ nee me dua, kɛmɔ ɛ ze Devidi nee me luale la, na ɛyɛ mɔɔ meze wɔ la amuala, ɛdi me mɛla nee me ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔ azo a, 18 menwɔmaa wɔ belemgbunlililɛ ne kɛgyinla, kɛmɔ me nee ɛ ze Devidi kyekyele la kɛ, ‘Ɛ bo zo amra ala a bali Yizilayɛ ebia ne dahuu a.’ 19Na saa ɛdawɔ nee wɔ menli ne bɛanli me mɛla ne mɔ mɔɔ meva memaa bɛ la azo, na bɛsonle nyamenle gyɛne gyɛne a, 20yemɔ mebadu bɛ meavi azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ meva memaa bɛ la azo, na meakpo Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ɛhye mɔɔ medu memaa me nwo kɛ nuhua a ɔwɔ kɛ bɛsonle me la, na meamaa yeayɛ ɛrɛlɛ nee ɛfenle wɔ menli kɔsɔɔti anloa anu.
21“Ɔbazi menli kɔsɔɔti mɔɔ barapɛ nu ɛke la anwo kɛ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ɛhye mɔɔ bɛdi ye eni la ɛra ye zɛhae a, na bɛabiza kɛ, ‘Duzu ati a Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛyɛ azɛlɛ ye nee Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ye zɛhae a?’ 22Na bɛbabua kɛ, ‘Ɔboalekɛ bɛkpole Ɛdɛnkɛma, bɛ ze mɔ Nyamenle ne mɔɔ yele bɛ vile Yigyibiti azɛlɛ zo rale la, na bɛdoale nyamenle gyɛne gyɛne bie mɔ bɛbɔle bɛ ti aze bɛmanle bɛ na bɛzonlenle bɛ; yemɔti yɛɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛmaa munzule ɛhye ɛdo bɛ a.’ ”

Title: 2 EDK 8
Content:
Ninyɛne mɔɔ Sɔlɔmɔn yɛle la
(1 Arl 9.10-28)
1Belemgbunli Sɔlɔmɔn vale ɛvolɛ abulanwiɔ a zile Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne na ɔbule ɔdaye ye awuke ne a. 2Sɔlɔmɔn eza kyekyele azuamgbole ne mɔ mɔɔ Belemgbunli Helam vale manle ye la fofolɛ, na ɔmanle Yizilayɛma bie mɔ hɔdɛnlanle zolɛ. 3Sɔlɔmɔn hɔhonle vale Heemate nee Zoba. 4Ɔkyekyele Palemela (Tademɔ) wɔ fienemgbole ne anu, yɛɛ ɔkyekyele azuamgbole mɔɔ bɛfa ninyɛne bɛkɔsiezie zolɛ la wɔ Heemate maanle ne anu. 5Ɔkyekyele Sɔlɔ Bɛte Hɔlɔn nee Aleze Bɛte Hɔlɔn (ɔliele biala anwo bane na ɔvale mbulalɛ ɔguguale bɛ nlenkɛ mgbole ne mɔ anzi). 6Ɔkyekyele Beeyalate nee azuamgbole mɔɔ ɔdaye Sɔlɔmɔn ɔfa ye ninyɛne ɔkɔsiezie zolɛ, azuamgbole mɔɔ ɔfa ye konle ehwili ɔkɔsiezie zolɛ, azuamgbole mɔɔ menli mɔɔ ka konle ehwili la wɔ zolɛ, yɛɛ azuamgbole mɔɔ menli mɔɔ ka mgbɔnwɔ la wɔ zolɛ la. Akee ɔyɛle debie biala mɔɔ ɔhulole kɛ ɔkɛyɛ wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm, Lɛbanɔn, yɛɛ ye maanle ne anu ɛleka biala la. 7-8Hɛtema mɔɔ hale maanle ne anu, Amɔlema, Pɛlɛzema, Haevaema nee Gyibɛsema mɔɔ hale, mɔɔ Yizilayɛma angu bɛ la nee bɛ bo zo amra kɔsɔɔti, Sɔlɔmɔn manle bɛyɛle gyima kɛ bɛle ahanra, yɛɛ zɔhane ala a ɛnɛ nee ɛnɛ bɛtɛyɛ a. 9Noko Yizilayɛma ɛdeɛ, Sɔlɔmɔn ammaa bɛanyɛ mialera nu gyima kɛ ahanra. Ɔyɛle bɛ ye ɛlɔnema, ye mgbanyima nee safohyenlema mɔɔ nea ye konle ehwili nee mgbɔnwɔ ɛhanlɛ ɛlɔnema anwo zo a. 10Belemgbunli Sɔlɔmɔn mgbanyima mɔɔ nea ye gyima ne mɔ azo la le ɛya nwiɔ abulanlu.
11Sɔlɔmɔn vale Yigyibiti belemgbunli ne ara raalɛ ne mɔɔ ɛnee yegya ye la rale Devidi suakpole zo wɔ sua ne mɔɔ yezi yemaa ye la anu. Ɔzele kɛ, “Ɔnle kɛ me ye tɛnla awuke ne mɔɔ Yizilayɛ Belemgbunli Devidi ɛbu la anu, ɔluakɛ ɛleka biala mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne ɛhɔ ɛlɛ la le nwuanzanwuanza.”
12Sɔlɔmɔn bɔle ɛyelalɛ azu wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma azukponle ne mɔɔ yezi ye wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anyunlu ɛkɛ ne la azo manle Ɛdɛnkɛma. 13 Ɔbɔle ɛyelalɛ azu ne kɛmɔ Mosisi Mɛla ne kile kɛ bɛyɛ ye kenle ko biala la: Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ne, Siane Fofolɛ Ɛvoyia ne nee ɛvoyia nsa ne, Angye Ɛvoyia ne, Bɛyɔba Ɛvoyia ne, yɛɛ Kpɔda Bo Ɛdɛnlanlɛ Ɛvoyia ne. 14Kɛmɔ ɔ ze Devidi hyehyɛle la, Sɔlɔmɔn hyɛle sɛlɛvolɛma gyima ne manle bɛ. Eza ɔhyɛle Livaema ne mɔ mɔɔ bado ayɛlɛyelɛ edwɛne aboa sɛlɛvolɛma ne la gyima ne ɔmanle bɛ, kɛmɔ kenle ko biala gyima ne si de la. Ɔhyɛle nlenkɛ mgbole sinzavolɛma ɔmanle ekpunli ko biala nwunle nlenkɛ mgbole mɔɔ bɛbazinza la, kɛmɔ Nyamenle sonla Devidi hyehyɛle dole ɛkɛ ne la. 15Bɛangakyi debie biala mɔɔ Belemgbunli Devidi hyehyɛle mɔɔ fane sɛlɛvolɛma nee Livaema ne mɔ anwo la, yɛɛ bɛangakyi debie biala mɔɔ fane gya nwo ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔ anwo la. Bɛyɛle debie biala pɛpɛ.
16Akee Sɔlɔmɔn wiele Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne si. Ɔwiele debie biala, ɔvi sua ne aze ɛwulalɛ toonwo ɔhɔdwule ye awieleɛ.
17Sɔlɔmɔn akee hɔle Ɛzeɔngibɛ yɛɛ Yilate mɔɔ wɔ Yidɔm nyevilenloa wɔ Akaba Ebolo ne anu la. 18Belemgbunli Helam manle ye sonvolɛma mɔɔ ze nyevile nye zo kpalɛ la vale meli rɛlɛle Sɔlɔmɔn. Bɛ nee Sɔlɔmɔn sonvolɛma vale meli hɔle Ofɛ, na bɛhɔnyianle ezukoa nvutuke mɔɔ bo kilo apenle ngoko bulu nee nnu la bɛrɛlɛle Sɔlɔmɔn.

Title: 2 EDK 9
Content:
Hyiba Belemgbunli Raalɛ ne kpɔla Sɔlɔmɔn
(1 Arl 10.1-13)
1 Hyiba belemgbunli raalɛ ne dele duma kpole ne mɔɔ Sɔlɔmɔn ɛnyia ye la nganeɛ, yemɔti ɔrale Gyɛlusalɛm kɛ ɔbado Sɔlɔmɔn abɛla mgbole kpalɛ. Ɔvale menli dɔɔnwo ɔlile ɔ nzi, ɔvale afunlumu mɔɔ zozo ninyɛne evuanlɛ mɔɔ bɛfa bɛto aleɛ, ezukoa nvutuke dɔɔnwo kpalɛ, yɛɛ awolɛ mɔɔ sonle bolɛ la ɔrale. Ɔradole Sɔlɔmɔn la, ɔbizebizale ye edwɛkɛ dodo biala mɔɔ ɔdaye ɔkɛhola la. 2Sɔlɔmɔn yeyele bɛ kɔsɔɔti anloa, ko bɔbɔ ɛnle ɛkɛ ne mɔɔ hyele ye ekyii a. 3Hyiba belemgbunli raalɛ ne nwunle Sɔlɔmɔn nrɛlɛbɛ ne na ɔnwunle ye belemgbunli awuke mɔɔ yebu la. 4Akee ɔnwunle aleɛ mɔɔ bɛdi wɔ sua nu ɛkɛ nee ye mgbanyima ne mɔ tɛnlabelɛ nu, kɛ ye sonvolɛma si sonle ye, ye nzasuvolɛma ne adɛladeɛ mɔɔ bɛwula, nee ɛyelalɛ azu mɔɔ Sɔlɔmɔn bɔ wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu la, ɔzinle ɔ nwo na ɔ nwo bubule ye.
5Na Hyiba belemgbunli raalɛ ne hanle hilele Sɔlɔmɔn kɛ, “Ayi, bɛle nɔhalɛ bɔkɔɔ. Edwɛkɛ mɔɔ fane ɛ nwo nee wɔ nrɛlɛbɛ ne anwo, mɔɔ mendele wɔ me maanle nu lɔ la le nɔhalɛ bɔkɔɔ. 6Saa mese kɛ alumua ne mendele la menliele menlile a, ɛnee mebɔ adalɛ; meradwu ɛke la yɛɛ melie meli a. Nɔhalɛ, mɔɔ bɛhanle bɛhilele me la ɛndwu mɔɔ medame meranwu ye me nye zo la foa ko bɔbɔ. 7Wɔ mraalɛ anwo ɛyɛ moavolɛ, wɔ sonvolɛma ati ɛyɛ boɛ kɛ dahuu bɛtie wɔ, bɛsonle wɔ, na bɛte wɔ nrɛlɛbɛ edwɛkɛ ne mɔ a. 8Ayɛlɛyelɛ ɛha Ɛdɛnkɛma wɔ Nyamenle ne kɛ yehulo wɔ na yemaa bɛva wɔ bɛzie Yizilayɛ belemgbunli ebia ne azo la. Kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma kulo Yizilayɛma na ɔkulo kɛ bɛtɛnla ɛkɛ dahuu la ati yɛɛ yemaa bɛva wɔ bɛzie belemgbunli a, amaa wɔava pɛlepɛlelilɛ wɔazie bɛ.”
9Akee ɔhyɛle Belemgbunli Sɔlɔmɔn ninyɛne: ezukoa nvutuke mɔɔ bo tone nu kilo apenle nna yɛɛ ninyɛne evuanlɛ mɔɔ bɛfa bɛto aleɛ la dɔɔnwo nee awolɛ mɔɔ sonle bolɛ la. Hyiba belemgbunli raalɛ ne ninyɛne evuanlɛ mɔɔ ɔvale ɔrahyɛle Sɔlɔmɔn la bo ahyɛlɛdeɛ biala mɔɔ sumunli kɛ ɔralile ebia ne la bɛva bɛhyɛ ye la azo.
10(Yeanga ɛhye mɔ angome, Belemgbunli Helam sonvolɛma ne nee Belemgbunli Sɔlɔmɔn sonvolɛma ne mɔ mɔɔ nee ezukoa nvutuke vi Ofɛ rale la vale dwunepa mbaka dɔɔnwo nee awolɛ mɔɔ sonle bolɛ la dɔɔnwo rale. 11Sɔlɔmɔn vale mbaka ne yɛle sika sosɔle Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne nee belemgbunli sua ne na ɔvale bie ɔyɛle getaa mgbole nee ngyikyi ɔmanle edwɛndolɛma. Mekɛ zɔhane anu, ɛnee awie ɛtɛnwunle zɛhae dwunepa mbaka ye bie ɛlɛ wɔ Dwuda maanle ne anu.)
12Belemgbunli Sɔlɔmɔn noko hyɛle Hyiba belemgbunli raalɛ ne ninyɛne dɔɔnwo, eza debie biala mɔɔ belemgbunli raalɛ ne bizale ye la, ɔvale ɔmanle ye. Akee Hyiba belemgbunli raalɛ ne nee ye menli mɔɔ doa ye la ziale hɔle bɛ maanle nu wɔ Hyiba.
Belemgbunli Sɔlɔmɔn anwonyia ne
(1 Arl 10.14-25)
13Ɛvolɛ biala Belemgbunli Sɔlɔmɔn asa ka ezukoa nvutuke tone nu kilo apenle ngoko abulanwiɔ nee nsa, 14adwule mɔɔ ɔdie ɔfi gualilɛma lɔ nee nvasoɛ mɔɔ ɔnyia ɔfi gualilɛ nu la ɛmboka nwolɛ. Akee Areleebea arelemgbunli nee maanzinli zo neavolɛma fa ezukoa nvutuke nee dwɛtɛ fufule bɛlɛ ye. 15Belemgbunli Sɔlɔmɔn yɛle bɛ sa nu enyinlike mgbole ɛya nwiɔ na ɔmanle bɛholole ezukoa nvutuke kilo nsuu bɛguale ko biala anwo, 16eza ɔmanle bɛyɛle bɛ sa nu enyinlike ngyikyi ɛya nsa na bɛholole ezukoa nvutuke kilo nsa bɛguale ko biala anwo. Ɔvale bɛ muala ɔziele sua ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Lɛbanɔn Kpɔkɛmile la anu.
17Belemgbunli ne eza manle bɛzele belemgbunli ebia kpole ko. Ɔmanle bɛvale ɛzɛlɛ bɛbobɔle foa ko na bɛholole ezukoa nvutuke kpalɛ bɛguale foa ko. 18Ebia ne lɛ kpolike nsia mɔɔ bɛfo kolaa na bɛadɛnla zolɛ a, yɛɛ ɔlɛ ɛleka mɔɔ bɛtɛnla zolɛ a bɛfa bɛ gyakɛ bɛsiezie a. Bɛholole ezukoa nvutuke bɛguale kpolike ne mɔ nee mɔɔ bɛfa bɛ gyakɛ bɛsiezie zolɛ la amuala anwo. Ebia ne lɛ ɔ sa nwiɔ mɔɔ bɛfa bɛ sa bɛgua zolɛ a, yɛɛ awenade ananze nwiɔ gyigyi ɔ sa nwiɔ ne azo. 19Awenade ananze bulu nee nwiɔ noko gyigyi kpolike ne mɔ azo, kpolike ko biala ati nee ɔ ti lɛ awenade nwiɔ. Belemgbunli ebia mɔɔ le zɛhae la bie ɛnle belemgbunli maanle biala anu.
20Belemgbunli Sɔlɔmɔn dwora mɔɔ ɔno nu la amuala le ezukoa nvutuke, yɛɛ dwora mɔɔ wɔ sua ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Lɛbanɔn Kpɔkɛmile la anu la le ezukoa nvutuke tagyee. Sɔlɔmɔn mekɛ zo ɛnee bɛnva dwɛtɛ fufule bɛnyɛ ɛhwee. 21Belemgbunli Sɔlɔmɔn lɛ ye meli mɔɔ nee Helam sonvolɛma kɔ Sepeen a. Ɛvolɛ nsa biala meli ne mɔ vi Sepeen ba. Bɛba a bɛfa ezukoa nvutuke, dwɛtɛ fufule, ɛzɛlɛ, motimo, yɛɛ ahomu bɛba.
22Belemgbunli Sɔlɔmɔn nwunle nrɛlɛbɛ na ɔnyianle ɔ nwo ɔdɛlale arelemgbunli kɔsɔɔti. 23Aleɛabo arelemgbunli pelele kɛ bɛkɛnwu Sɔlɔmɔn anyunlu nee ye nrɛlɛbɛ ne mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛva ɛmaa ye la. 24Ko biala mɔɔ rale la rahyɛle Sɔlɔmɔn ninyɛne mɔɔ bɛva dwɛtɛ fufule nee ezukoa nvutuke bɛyɛ la, adɛladeɛ, alufuanlɛ, ninyɛne mɔɔ bɛfa bɛto aleɛ, mgbɔnwɔ, yɛɛ mgbɔnwɔndua. Ɛhye hɔle zolɛ ɛvolɛ biala.
25 Belemgbunli Sɔlɔmɔn ɛnee eza lɛ mgbɔnwɔ tunli apenle nna mɔɔ ɔsie mgbɔnwɔ nu a, ɔlɛ konle ehwili dɔɔnwo, yɛɛ menli mɔɔ ka mgbɔnwɔ la apenle ngoko bulu nee nwiɔ. Ɔvale bie mɔ ɔhɔle azuamgbole mɔɔ ye konle ehwili ne mɔ wɔ zolɛ la azo, yɛɛ bie mɔ noko wɔ ɔ nwo ɛkɛ ne wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm. 26 Ɔziele arelemgbunli kɔsɔɔti, ɔvi Azule Yufileti ne anloa wɔ Filisitiama azɛlɛ zo toonwo ɔhɔguale Yigyibiti ɛweɛne zo. 27Na Sɔlɔmɔn manle dwɛtɛ fufule bule yɛle kɛ awolɛ la wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm, yɛɛ sida mbaka bule kɛ Hyifɛla sikamɔ mbaka. 28Bɛ nee mgbɔnwɔ mɔɔ Sɔlɔmɔn lɛ la vi Yigyibiti nee maanle dɔɔnwo anu a ba a.
Sɔlɔmɔn ebialilɛ ne anwo edwɛkɛ sikalɛ
(1 Arl 11.41-43)
29Ninyɛne bieko mɔɔ Sɔlɔmɔn yɛle nee ye nyɛleɛ, ɔvi mɔlebɛbo ne kɔdwu awieleɛ ne la, bɛhɛlɛ bɛ kɔsɔɔti wɔ Nyamenle Kpɔmanvolɛ Neetan Tetedwɛkɛ Buluku ne, Ahaegya mɔɔ vi Hyaelo la Nyamenle Nrɛlaleɛ Buluku ne, yɛɛ Nyamenle Sonla Yedo Ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ Buluku ne mɔ anu. Yedo buluku ne eza ka Nibate ara Gyɛlɔbowam mɔɔ lile ebia wɔ Yizilayɛ la anwo edwɛkɛ. 30Sɔlɔmɔn dɛnlanle Gyɛlusalɛm na ɔziele Yizilayɛ maanle ne amuala ɛvolɛ abulanla. 31Sɔlɔmɔn hɔle ayile nu na bɛwulale ye mrɛlatɛlɛ nu wɔ ɔ ze Devidi Suakpole zo, na ɔ ra Rilihɔbowam lile ebia ne.

Title: 2 EDK 10
Content:
Sɔlɔ mbusua ekpunli ekpunli ne mɔ te atua
(1 Arl 12.1-20)
1Rilihɔbowam hɔle Hyikɛm. Ɛkɛ ne a ɛnee Yizilayɛma kɔsɔɔti ɛbɔ gua ɛlɛkendɛ ye azie ye belemgbunli a. 2Ɛnee Nibate ara Gyɛlɔbowam mɔɔ ɛnriandi Belemgbunli Sɔlɔmɔn la wɔ Yigyibiti. Na mɔɔ ɔdele edwɛkɛ ne la ɔvi Yigyibiti ɔziale ɔrale. 3Na sɔlɔ mbusua ekpunli ne mɔ zoanle manle bɛhɔvale ye na ɔ nee bɛ hɔle Rilihɔbowam anwo ɛkɛ bɛhɔzele ye kɛ, 4“Ɛ ze Sɔlɔmɔn sisile yɛ kpole kpalɛ na ɔzoale yɛ adesoa ɛnlomboɛ. Yemɔti nea na te mɔɔ ɛ ze kyekyele zoale yɛ la azo maa yɛ nwo ɛdɔ yɛ na yɛkɛzonle wɔ.”
5Rilihɔbowam zele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛhɔ na ɔdi kenle nsa a bɛzia bɛradie nwolɛ mualɛ.” Yemɔti menli ne ziale hɔle.
6Rilihɔbowam vale edwɛkɛ ne dole ye mgbanyima mɔɔ boale ɔ ze Sɔlɔmɔn wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɔde aze la anyunlu na ɔbizale bɛ kɛ, “Duzu folɛ a bɛtu me wɔ ɛhye anwo na meava meabua menli ne a?”
7Bɛzele ye kɛ, “Saa ɛkile ahunlunyele ɛmaa menli ne, ɛmaa bɛ nye die, na ɛka ɛdendɛlɛ kpalɛ ɛkile bɛ a, bɛbazonle wɔ dahuu.”
8Na Rilihɔbowam anva mgbanyima ne mɔ folɛdulɛ ne na ɔ nee mgbavolɛ mɔɔ anrɛɛ ɔ nee bɛ tu na ɛnɛ bɛyɛ ye folɛdulɛma la vale adwenle. 9Ɔbizale bɛ kɛ, “Menli ne se mende bɛ ɛvɛlɛ zo ekyii na kɛ bɛ adwenle se bɛ ɛ? Duzu mualɛ a menva memaa bɛ a?”
10Bɛbuale ye kɛ, “Ka kile bɛ kɛ, ‘Me sa amozi ɛrɛlɛsɛka ne bɔbɔ le kpole tɛla egya anze. 11Saa egya zoale bɛ adesoa ɛnlomboɛ a, mame, mebazoa bɛ adesoa mɔɔ tɛla egya ɛdeɛ ne. Egya vale nɛnemile a bole bɛ a, na mame, mebava empele mɔɔ anloa yɛ nyane kɛ nyamenleakɛlɛ ɛbɔlɛ la a meabila bɛ a.’ ”
12Kenle nsa ne dwule la, Gyɛlɔbowam nee menli ne kɔsɔɔti rayiale Rilihɔbowam, kɛmɔ ɔhanle ɔhilele bɛ ala la. 13Na Belemgbunli Rilihɔbowam dendɛle ɛya zo hilele bɛ, ɔkpole mgbanyima ne mɔ folɛdulɛ ne. 14Belemgbunli Rilihɔbowam dendɛle, kɛmɔ mgbavolɛ ne mɔ zele ye la na ɔhanle kɛ, “Egya zoale bɛ adesoa ɛnlomboɛ, na mame, mebava bie meaboka nwolɛ. Egya vale nɛnemile a bole bɛ a, na mame, mebava empele mɔɔ anloa yɛ nyane kɛ nyamenleakɛlɛ ɛbɔlɛ la a meabila bɛ a.”
15Yemɔti belemgbunli andie menli ne mɔ edwɛkɛ biala, ɔluakɛ Nyamenle a hyehyɛle manle ɔrale ye zɔhane a, amaa Ɛdɛnkɛma edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ ɔluale Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ Ahaegya mɔɔ vi Hyaelo la anwo zo ɔhanle ɔhilele Nibate ara Gyɛlɔbowam la ayɛ nɔhalɛ.
16 Mɔɔ Yizilayɛma ne nwunle kɛ belemgbunli ne ɛnrɛdie bɛ edwɛkɛ biala la, bɛhanle bɛhilele ye kɛ, “Duzu kyɛfoa a yɛlɛ ye wɔ Devidi ɛkɛ a? Yɛ nee Gyɛsi ara ɛnli agya. Yizilayɛma, awie biala ɛhɔ ye sua nu. Devidi, fa ɛ nwo!”
Yemɔti Yizilayɛma dele atua 17na Rilihɔbowam lile Yizilayɛma mɔɔ wɔ Dwuda maanle nu la angome anwo zo belemgbunli.
18Akee belemgbunli ne zoanle Adɔnelam mɔɔ nea maanle gyimayɛlɛ zo la wɔ Yizilayɛ, na menli ne zile ye awolɛ hunle ye. Belemgbunli Rilihɔbowam nwunle ye zɔhane la, ɔhanle ɔ nwo waa ɔvole ye konle ehwili nu ɔnriandile ɔhɔle Gyɛlusalɛm. 19Yemɔti Yizilayɛma ɛyɛ Devidi abo zo amra ne anwo ɛlɔne toonwo a yeradwu ɛnɛ a.

Title: 2 EDK 11
Content:
Hyɛmaya Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ ne
(1 Arl 12.21-24)
1Mɔɔ Rilihɔbowam dwule Gyɛlusalɛm la, ɔboɔboale Dwuda nee Bɛngyaman mbusua ekpunli ekpunli ne anu amra ɛlɔnema apenle ngoko abulatwɛ anloa kɛ bɛ nee Yizilayɛma kaho, na bɛamaa Rilihɔbowam ali maanle ne amuala azo belemgbunli. 2Na Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Nyamenle sonla Hyɛmaya kɛ, 3“Ka kile Sɔlɔmɔn ara Rilihɔbowam mɔɔ sie Dwuda nee Yizilayɛ kɔsɔɔti mɔɔ wɔ Dwuda nee Bɛngyaman maanzinli ne mɔ anu la kɛ, Ɛdɛnkɛma se, 4‘Bɛmmakɔ bɛ nee bɛ mediema ne mɔ kɔko. Awie biala ɛzia ɛhɔ ye sua zo, ɔluakɛ medame a meyɛ ɛhye a.’ ” Yemɔti bɛdiele Ɛdɛnkɛma ane, na bɛ nee Gyɛlɔbowam angɔngo.
Rilihɔbowam bɔ azuamgbole ne mɔ anwo bane
5Rilihɔbowam dɛnlanle Gyɛlusalɛm na ɔkyekyele azuamgbole ɛhye mɔ ɔbɔle nwolɛ bane wɔ Dwuda. 6Ɔkyekyele Bɛtelɛhɛm, Yitam, Tɛkowa, 7Bɛtezɛ, Soko, Adɛlam, 8Gate, Malihyaa, Zefe, 9Adoleeyem, Leekehye, Azika, 10Zɔla, Ayegyalɔn, yɛɛ Hibulɔn. Azuamgbole ɛhye mɔ a bɛbɔle nwolɛ bane wɔ Dwuda nee Bɛngyaman maanzinli ne mɔ anu a. 11Ɔmanle bɛbɔle aranemgbole ne mɔ anwo bane kpalɛ na ɔyele menli mɔɔ nea zolɛ a, na ɔvale aleɛ, nwole, nee nwanye ɔhɔziele ɛkɛ ne. 12Ɔvale atwɛ nee bɛ sa nu enyinlike ɔhɔle azuamgbole ɛhye mɔ biala azo, amaa bɛ nwo ayɛ se. Na ɔlile ye belemgbunli ne wɔ Dwuda nee Bɛngyaman maanzinli ne mɔ anu ala.
Sɛlɛvolɛma nee Livaema ba Dwuda
13Sɛlɛvolɛma nee Livaema mɔɔ wɔ Yizilayɛ la amuala vi ɛleka ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛdede la rale Belemgbunli Rilihɔbowam anwo ɛkɛ wɔ Dwuda. 14Livaema vile ɛleka mɔɔ bɛdede la na bɛgyakyile bɛ nwo ninyɛne bɛrale Dwuda nee Gyɛlusalɛm, ɔboalekɛ Yizilayɛ Belemgbunli Gyɛlɔbowam nee ɔ bo zo amra yele bɛ gyima nu kɛ bɛnle Ɛdɛnkɛma sɛlɛvolɛma bieko. 15 Gyɛlɔbowam ɔdaye ɔyele ye sɛlɛvolɛma mɔɔ nea ɛleka ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛyɛ bɛ mbɔnsam ninyɛne ne mɔ nee ɛleka mɔɔ bɛsɔ bɛ nlankɛ ananze mmonle mɔɔ ɔdaye yeyɛ la. 16Na bɛdabɛ mɔɔ ɛnee bɛyeye bɛ ahonle nu kɛ bɛsonle Yizilayɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle ne la vi Yizilayɛ mbusua ekpunli ekpunli ne mɔ anu hɔle Gyɛlusalɛm hɔbɔle azu manle Ɛdɛnkɛma, bɛ ze mɔ Nyamenle ne. 17Bɛmanle Dwuda maanle ne gyinlanle na bɛmanle Sɔlɔmɔn ara Rilihɔbowam nyianle gyinlagyakɛ ɛvolɛ nsa, ɔluakɛ wɔ ɛvolɛ nsa ne anu, bɛvale Devidi nee Sɔlɔmɔn agyakɛ na bɛyɛle mɔɔ Devidi nee Sɔlɔmɔn yɛle la bie.
Rilihɔbowam awuke nu amra
18Rilihɔbowam gyale Meehalate. Devidi ara nrenya Gyɛlemo ara raalɛ ɔ. Ɔ nli a le Yilayabe ara raalɛ Abeheeli yɛɛ ɔle Gyɛsi anlɔnra. 19Rilihɔbowam nee ye wole mralɛ mrenya nsa, Gyiyɛhye, Hyamaleeya, yɛɛ Zeeham. 20Nzinlii ɔgyale Abesalɛm ara Meeyaka na ɔ nee ye wole Abaegya, Ateeyae, Zaeza, yɛɛ Hyɛlomete. 21Ɛnee Rilihɔbowam kulo Meeyaka tɛla ye mraalɛ ne mɔ nee ye mgbɔnla ne mɔ amuala. Ɔgyale mraalɛ bulu nee mɔtwɛ yɛɛ ɔvale mgbɔnla abulasia. Ɔwole mralɛ mrenya abulanwiɔ nee mɔtwɛ yɛɛ mralɛ mraalɛ abulasia. 22Rilihɔbowam hulole ɔ nee ɔ ye Meeyaka ara Abaegya dɛlale ɔ mra mrenya ne mɔ amuala na ɔyɛle kɛ yemɔ yɛɛ anrɛɛ ɛli ye agya a, na ɔyɛle ye adwenle kɛ ɔsie ye belemgbunli. 23Ɔvale nrɛlɛbɛ ɔmanle ɔ mra mrenya ne mɔ gyima wɔ Dwuda nee Bɛngyaman maanzinli ne mɔ anu, na ɔkpondenle bɛ wɔ azuamgbole ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛbɔ nwolɛ bane la azo. Ɔmanle bɛ debie biala mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛ sa ka ye la na ɔgyigyale mraalɛ ɔmanle bɛ.

Title: 2 EDK 12
Content:
Yigyibitima fa Dwuda aze
(1 Arl 14.25-28)
1Mɔɔ Rilihɔbowam belemgbunlililɛ ne gyinlanle zo na ɔnyianle gyinlagyakɛ la, ɔkpole Ɛdɛnkɛma Mɛla ne mɔ na ɔmanle Yizilayɛma kɔsɔɔti kpole Ɛdɛnkɛma. 2Kɛmɔ bɛanli nɔhalɛ bɛammaa Ɛdɛnkɛma la ati, mɔɔ Rilihɔbowam lile ɛvolɛ nnu wɔ Dwuda ebia ne azo la, Yigyibiti Belemgbunli Hyaehyake ratetale Gyɛlusalɛm. 3Ɔvale ɛlɔnema mɔɔ ka konle ehwili la apenle ko ɛya nwiɔ yɛɛ ɛlɔnema mɔɔ ka mgbɔnwɔ la apenle ngoko abulasia a ɔrale a. Na menli mɔɔ ɔ nee bɛ vi Yigyibiti rale: Lebeyama, Sɛkema, nee Sudanema, bɛmɛ, awie ɛnze bɛ nloa. 4Ɔhonle ɔvale Dwuda azuamgbole ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛbɔ nwolɛ bane la toonwo ɔradwule Gyɛlusalɛm.
5Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ Hyɛmaya rale Belemgbunli Rilihɔbowam nee Dwuda mgbanyima ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti mɔɔ ɛnee Hyaehyake ati bɛyia Gyɛlusalɛm la anwo ɛkɛ na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Ɛdɛnkɛma se, ‘Bɛkpo me, yemɔti medame noko mekpo bɛ memaa Hyaehyake.’ ”
6Ɛkɛ ne ala, belemgbunli ne nee ye mgbanyima ne mɔ nlunle bɛ nwo na bɛhanle bɛ nloa edwɛkɛ kɛ bɛyɛ ɛtane na bɛhanle kɛ, “Ɛdɛnkɛma di pɛlepɛle.”
7Mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma nwunle kɛ menli ne ɛnlu bɛ nwo la, ye edwɛkɛ ne zile Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ Hyɛmaya anwo zo bieko kɛ, “Menli ne ɛnlu bɛ nwo, yemɔti menrɛbɔ bɛ bo zo, mebalie bɛ. Gyɛlusalɛm ɛnrɛnwu me ɛya ne amuala, noko Hyaehyake baho ava ye. 8Bɛbayɛ ahanra bɛamaa Hyaehyake, amaa bɛanwu ngakyile mɔɔ wɔ me ɛzonlenlɛ nee maanle gyɛne gyɛne nyamenle ne mɔ ɛzonlenlɛ nu la.”
9Na Yigyibiti Belemgbunli Hyaehyake rale Gyɛlusalɛmma anwo zo; ɔravale Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu ezukoa nee ninyɛne nee belemgbunli suakunlu ɛkɛ ne gya nu ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti ɔhɔle; ɔvale debie biala. Eza ɔsesale bɛ sa nu enyinlike ne mɔ mɔɔ Belemgbunli Sɔlɔmɔn vale ezukoa nvutuke yɛle la ɔhɔle. 10Belemgbunli Rilihɔbowam vale kɔbele yɛle bie ziele bɛ bo zo, na ɔvale ɔwulale sinzavolɛma mɔɔ sinza belemgbunli ɛkɛ ne la mgbanyima ne mɔ asa anu. 11Mekɛ biala mɔɔ belemgbunli ne ɛlɛkɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu la, sinzavolɛma ne basoa di ɔ nyunlu kɔ eza bɛsoa bɛba, na akee yeava yeahɔzie bɛ bo zo ne wɔ sinzavolɛma sua ne anu. 12Kɛmɔ ɔnlunle ɔ nwo la ati, Ɛdɛnkɛma yele ye ɛya kpole ne ɔ nwo zo, yeangu ye, na eza Dwuda maanle ne anu yɛle kpalɛ.
Rilihɔbowam belemgbunlililɛ ne anwo edwɛkɛ sikalɛ
13Belemgbunli Rilihɔbowam dɛnlanle Gyɛlusalɛm a lile ye ebia ne a. Ɔlile ɛvolɛ abulanla nee ko la yɛɛ ɔbɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɔdi belemgbunli a, yɛɛ ɔlile ebia ne ɛvolɛ bulu nee nsuu. Gyɛlusalɛm yɛɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛkpa nu ɛye ɛvi Yizilayɛ mbusua ekpunli ekpunli ne mɔ anu kɛ yemɔ ala a ɔle suakpole mɔɔ ye duma ɛla zolɛ a. Bɛfɛlɛ Rilihɔbowam ɔ nli Neeyama. Ɔ nli le Amɔnonli. 14Ɔyɛle ɛtane ɔtiale Ɛdɛnkɛma, ɔboalekɛ ɔkpole Ɛdɛnkɛma.
15Rilihɔbowam nyɛleɛ mɔɔ ɔyɛle, ɔvi mɔlebɛbo ne mɔɔ kɔdwu awieleɛ ne la, bɛhɛlɛ bɛ muala wɔ Nyamenle Kpɔmanvolɛ Hyɛmaya nee Nyamenle Sonla Yedo Tetedwɛkɛ Mbuluku ne mɔ anu. Ɛnee mekɛ biala konle wɔ Dwuda Belemgbunli Rilihɔbowam nee Yizilayɛ Belemgbunli Gyɛlɔbowam avinli. 16Belemgbunli Rilihɔbowam hɔle ayile nu na bɛwulale ye mrɛlatɛlɛ nu wɔ Devidi Suakpole zo; ɔ ra nrenya Abaegya a lile ebia ne a.

Title: 2 EDK 13
Content:
Abaegya nee Gyɛlɔbowam konle ne
(1 Arl 15.1-8)
1Belemgbunli Gyɛlɔbowam lile ɛvolɛ bulu nee mɔtwɛ wɔ Yizilayɛ ebia ne azo la yɛɛ Abaegya bɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɔdi belemgbunli wɔ Dwuda a. 2Ɔdɛnlanle Gyɛlusalɛm a ɔlile ebia ne a, yɛɛ ɔlile ebia ne ɛvolɛ nsa. Ɔ nli a le Yulayɛle mɔɔ vi Gebɛya la ara raalɛ Maekaya.
Konle zile Abaegya nee Gyɛlɔbowam avinli. 3Abaegya vale ɛlɔnema mɔɔ ze ko la apenle ngoko ɛya nna, na Gyɛlɔbowam vale ɛlɔnema apenle ngoko ɛya mɔtwɛ mɔɔ ze ko la rayiale ye. 4Abaegya gyinlanle Zɛmaleeyem Boka, wɔ Yifelaem awoka ne mɔ azo na ɔzele kɛ, “Gyɛlɔbowam nee Yizilayɛma amuala bɛdie me! 5Bɛdabɛ bɛze ye wienyi kɛ Yizilayɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle ne vale Yizilayɛ belemgbunlililɛ ne manle Devidi nee ɔ bo zo amra, na ɔ nee ye yɛle ngyekyeleɛ kɛ bɛbali ebia ne wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ la. 6Noko Nibate ara Gyɛlɔbowam, mɔɔ le Devidi ara Sɔlɔmɔn sonvolɛ la, dwazole ɔ nwo zo na ɔdele ɔ menle anwo atua. 7Menli agbamgbanvolɛ bie bɛdabɛ noko bɛhɔlile ɔ nzi na bɛkpole Sɔlɔmɔn ara Rilihɔbowam wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ Rilihɔbowam le kakula na ye adwenle ɛtɛtinle na yeahola yeagyinla bɛ nloa la. 8Kɛkala, bɛyɛ bɛ adwenle kɛ kɛmɔ bɛ nwo zonle na bɛdedɛ bɛ ezukoa nvutuke nlankɛ ananze ne mɔ mɔɔ Gyɛlɔbowam ɛyɛ ɛmaa bɛ kɛ bɛ nyamenle la ati, bɛ nee Devidi abo zo amra ne mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma belemgbunli maanle ne wɔ bɛ sa nu la baho. 9Bɛvoa Ɛdɛnkɛma sɛlɛvolɛma ne mɔ mɔɔ le Aalɔn abo zo amra la, nee Livaema kɔsɔɔti na bɛdabɛ bɛye bɛ sɛlɛvolɛma kɛ maanle gyɛne gyɛne ne mɔ yɛ ye la. Awie biala mɔɔ kɛhola kɛva ɛnlankɛ nyinli ekyi ko anzɛɛ mboane nyinli ngyikyi nsuu kɛrabia ɔ nwo la ɛnee bɛyɛ ye sɛlɛvolɛ mɔɔ ɔko bɛ nyamenle ne mɔ mɔɔ ɛnzɔho ɛhwee la anyunlu a.
10“Na yɛmɛ, Ɛdɛnkɛma a le yɛ Nyamenle a, yɛɛ yɛtɛkpole ye. Yɛlɛ sɛlɛvolɛma mɔɔ kɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu maa yɛ na bɛle Aalɔn abo zo amra a, yɛɛ yɛlɛ Livaema mɔɔ boa bɛ a. 11Bɛbɔ ɛyelalɛ azu bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma nwonlomɔ nee nɔsolɛ biala na bɛkpu ɛyɛlɛ evuanlɛ, bɛfa kpanwo nwuanzanwuanza ne bɛgua ezukoa nvutuke ɛkponle ne azo, bɛnea ezukoa nvutuke kɛnlaneɛ mbaka ne mɔ azo, amaa ahɛnlaneɛ mɔɔ gyigyi zo la ada nɔsolɛ biala. Ɔluakɛ yɛyɛ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛ Nyamenle ne ɛze yɛ la, na bɛmɛ, bɛkpo ye. 12Bɛnlea o, na Nyamenle nee yɛ a lua a, yɛɛ yemɔ yɛɛ li yɛ ti a. Ye sɛlɛvolɛma ne babɔ bɛ aweɛne ndendenle ne mɔ anu bɛamaa konle ne atia bɛ. O Yizilayɛma, bɛ nee bɛ ze mɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle ne mmako, ɔluakɛ bɛnrɛhola ɔ nyunlu gyinla.”
13Mekɛ ne anu ɛnee Gyɛlɔbowam ɛzoa ɛlɔnema ɛmaa bɛbu Dwuda ɛlɔnema ne anzi, ɛhye ati ɛnee Dwuda ɛlɔnema ne ɛha avinli, Yizilayɛma wɔ bɛ nyunlu nee bɛ nzi. 14Na mɔɔ Dwudama nwunle kɛ konle ne ɛzi bɛ nyunlu nee bɛ nzi la, bɛzunle bɛvɛlɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma, na sɛlɛvolɛma ne mɔ bɔle bɛ aweɛne ndendenle ne mɔ anu. 15Akee Dwudama bɔle bubu na Nyamenle manle Gyɛlɔbowam nee Yizilayɛ ɛlɔnema ne lile akoatɔ wɔ Abaegya nee Dwuda ɛlɔnema anyunlu. 16Yizilayɛ ɛlɔnema ne guale ɛbɔ nu, na Nyamenle yele bɛ manle Dwudama. 17Abaegya nee ye ɛlɔnema ne hunle Yizilayɛma dɔɔnwo kpalɛ; kenle ko ne Yizilayɛma mɔɔ dɔle la le menli apenle ngoko ɛya nnu mɔɔ ze konle nye zo kpalɛ la. 18Yemɔti Dwuda lile Yizilayɛma anwo zo konim kenle ko ne, ɔboalekɛ bɛvale bɛ rɛle bɛwulale Ɛdɛnkɛma, bɛ ze mɔ Nyamenle ne anu.
19Abaegya voanle Gyɛlɔbowam na ɔhonle ɔvale azuamgbole: Bɛtɛle nee ye namunamu, Gyɛhyeena nee ye namunamu, yɛɛ Yifolɔn nee ye namunamu boka nwolɛ. 20Gyɛlɔbowam amkpazi bieko ɛlɛ wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ Abaegya de aze la, na Ɛdɛnkɛma manle anwonyane bɔle ye na ɔwule.
21Abaegya tumi ne akee yɛle kpole. Ɔgyale mraalɛ bulu nee nna na ɔwole mralɛ mrenya abulanwiɔ nee nwiɔ yɛɛ mralɛ mraalɛ bulu nee nsia. 22Abaegya gyima mɔɔ hale la, ye nyɛleɛ nee ɔ nloa edwɛkɛ, bɛhɛlɛ bɛ muala wɔ Nyamenle Kpɔmanvolɛ Yedo Tetedwɛkɛ Buluku ne anu.

Title: 2 EDK 14
Content:
Belemgbunli Esa di Sudanema anwo zo konim
1Belemgbunli Abaegya hɔle ayile nu na bɛwulale ye mrɛlatɛlɛ nu wɔ Devidi Suakpole zo, na ɔ ra Esa lile ebia ne. Wɔ Belemgbunli Esa mekɛ zo maanlema ne anzo nu dwole bɛ ɛvolɛ bulu. 2Esa yɛle mɔɔ le kpalɛ la na ɔzɔle Ɛdɛnkɛma ye Nyamenle ne anye. 3Ɔbubule azukponle gyɛne gyɛne ne mɔ nee ɛleka ne mɔ mɔɔ menli mɔɔ ɛnze Nyamenle la sonle la. Ɔbubule bɛ awozonle mpila sɛkɛlɛneɛ ne mɔ na ɔpɛle bɛ bozonle raalɛ Ahyela sɛkɛlɛneɛ baka ne ɔdole. 4Ɔhyehyɛle kɛ Dwudama kɔsɔɔti ɛzonle bɛ ze mɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle ne, na bɛli ye mɛla nee ye ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔ azo. 5Eza ɔbubule ɛleka ne mɔ mɔɔ menli mɔɔ ɛnze Nyamenle la sonle wɔ Dwuda azuamgbole ne mɔ azo la amuala na ɔbubule bɛ azukponle ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛkpu ɛyɛlɛ zolɛ la. 6Ɔkyekyele azuamgbole wɔ Dwuda na ɔmanle bɛbɔle nwolɛ bane, ɔluakɛ ɛnee maanle ne lɛ anzonudwolɛ. Yeango konle biala wɔ ɛvolɛ zɔhane mɔ anu, ɔboalekɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma manle ye anzonudwolɛ. 7Na ɔzele Dwudama kɛ, “Bɛmaa yɛkyekye azuamgbole ɛhye mɔ na yɛlie nwolɛ bane yɛyia, yɛmaa bɛ nlenkɛ mgbole mɔɔ mbulalɛ gugua bɛ nzi, na yɛsisi tawa mɔɔ bɛgyinla zolɛ bɛsinza la. Azɛlɛ ye tɛde yɛ ɛdeɛ, ɔboalekɛ yɛyɛ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛ Nyamenle ne kpondɛ la. Yɛyɛ mɔɔ ɔkpondɛ la, yɛɛ ɔdaye noko yemaa yɛ anzonudwolɛ.” Yemɔti bɛkyekyele azuamgbole ne mɔ na bɛkpazile. 8Ɛnee Esa lɛ ɛlɔnema apenle ngoko ɛya nsa mɔɔ vi Dwuda a. Bɛlɛ bɛ sa nu enyinlike nee atwɛ, yɛɛ Bɛngyaman maanzinli nu amra apenle ngoko ɛya nwiɔ abulatwɛ mɔɔ bɛdabɛ noko bɛdedɛ atwɛ nee bɛ sa nu enyinlike nee ɛda a. Bɛ muala bɛ ze konle nye zo kpalɛ.
9Sudanenli bie mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Zilaa la vale konle radoale Belemgbunli Esa. Ɔlɛ ɛlɔnema mgbe yɛɛ konle ehwili ɛya nsa, na bɛrale toonwo bɛradwule Malihyaa. 10Belemgbunli Esa hɔyiale bɛ, na bɛvale konle ne bɛbɔle zo wɔ Zɛfata bɔnza ne mɔɔ wɔ Malihyaa la anu. 11Na Belemgbunli Esa zɛlɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma ye Nyamenle ne kɛ, “O Ɛdɛnkɛma, awie biala ɛnle ɛkɛ mɔɔ kola boa, kɛ ɛdawɔ ala yɛɛ ɛkɛgyinla tumima nee koahweabanema avinli a. Boa yɛ, O Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛ Nyamenle, ɔluakɛ wɔmɔ yɛɛ yɛ rɛle wɔ wɔ nu a, yɛɛ wɔ duma nu a yɛra yɛbadoa menli pemgbenleamgbe ɛhye mɔ yɛ nee bɛ aho a. O Ɛdɛnkɛma, wɔmɔ a ɛle yɛ Nyamenle a. Mmamaa dasanli di ɛ nwo zo konim.”
12Yemɔti Ɛdɛnkɛma lile Sudanema anwo zo konim, na ɔmanle bɛ kpɔvolɛma ne guale ndwɛlɛ aze wɔ Belemgbunli Esa nee Dwuda ɛlɔnema anyunlu. 13Esa nee ye ɛlɔnema ne voanle bɛ toonwo hɔdwule Gilaa, na bɛhunle Sudanema amuala. Ko bɔbɔ anga, ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma nee ye ɛlɔnema lile bɛ nwo zo konim. Dwuda ɛlɔnema ne zoale ninyɛne dɔɔnwo mɔɔ bɛnyianle bɛ wɔ konle ne anu la hɔle. 14Bɛzɛkyele azuamgbole mɔɔ zuozua Gilaa la amuala, ɔluakɛ ɛnee menli ne ɛzulo Ɛdɛnkɛma kpole kpalɛ. Bɛsesale ninyɛne dɔɔnwo wɔ azuamgbole ɛhye mɔ azo, ɔluakɛ ɛnee ninyɛne wɔ azua ne mɔ azo kpalɛ. 15Eza bɛhɔyiale mboaneneavolɛma bie, bɛhunle bɛ na bɛzoale bɛ mboane ɛwolaa ne nee bɛ afunlumu ne mɔ bɛhɔle. Akee bɛziale bɛrale Gyɛlusalɛm.

Title: 2 EDK 15
Content:
Esa kakyihakyi ninyɛne
1Nyamenle Sunsum ne dwule Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ Azalaya anwo zo. Azalaya ɔ ze a le Odɛde. 2Na ɔhɔyiale Belemgbunli Esa na ɔzele ye kɛ, “Wɔmɔ Esa, yɛɛ Dwudama nee Bɛngyamanema amuala, bɛdie me. Ɛdɛnkɛma nee bɛ lua, kɛmɔ bɛ nee ye lua la. Saa bɛkpondɛ ɔ bo zo a, bɛkɛnwu ye, na saa bɛkpo ye a, ɔbakpo bɛ. 3Mekɛ tendenle mɔɔ ɛraze ɛhɔ la ɛnee Yizilayɛma ɛnzonle nɔhalɛ Nyamenle ne. Bɛnlɛ sɛlɛvolɛma mɔɔ kilehile bɛ a, yɛɛ bɛnlɛ mɛla. 4Na saa munzule to bɛ a yɛɛ bɛsu bɛfɛlɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne, bɛkpondɛ ɔ bo zo na bɛnwu ye a. 5Mekɛ zɔhane mɔ anu awie biala annyia anzonudwolɛ angɔ amba. Ɔluakɛ ɛnee ngyegyelɛ dɔɔnwo wɔ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛde maanle maanle ne mɔ anu la anwo zo. 6Bɛ nuhua kpakyekpakyele, maanle honle tiale maanle, suakpole honle tiale suakpole, ɔluakɛ ɛnee Nyamenle ɛva ngyegyelɛ ɛrado bɛ avinli. 7Na wɔmɔ, si wɔ ahonle! Mmamaa ɛ sa nu to, ɔluakɛ ɛbanyia ahatualɛ wɔ wɔ gyima nwo.”
8Mɔɔ Belemgbunli Esa dele Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ Azalaya Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ ne la, ɔzile ahonle na ɔmanle bɛyeyele mmonle mɔɔ wɔ Dwuda nee Bɛngyaman maanzinli ne mɔ anu la amuala, nee azuamgbole mɔɔ yeho yeva bɛ wɔ Yifelaem awoka ne mɔ azo lɔ la amuala azo. Akee ɔyɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma azukponle ne mɔɔ wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anyunlu ɛkɛ ne la boɛ.
9Ɛnee menli dɔɔnwo vi Yifelaem, Manasɛ, nee Semɛyɔn maanzinli ne mɔ anu wɔ Yizilayɛ ɛdu ɛradoa Belemgbunli Esa, ɔluakɛ bɛnwunle kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ye Nyamenle ne nee ye lua. Belemgbunli Esa boɔboale bɛ kɔsɔɔti nee Dwudama nee Bɛngyamanema amuala anloa. 10Ɔmanle bɛyiale nu wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee yeli ɛvolɛ bulu nee nnu wɔ ebia ne azo la, ye siane nsa ne azo. 11Kenle ko ne bɛbɔle azu bɛmanle Ɛdɛnkɛma. Ninyɛne mɔɔ bɛnyianle bɛ wɔ bɛ konle ne mɔ anu la, bɛvale nuhua nlankɛ ɛya nsuu nee mboane apenle nsuu bɛbɔle azu ne. 12Na bɛyɛle ngyehyɛlɛ kɛ bɛfa bɛ ahonle nee bɛ ɛkɛla muala bɛazonle Ɛdɛnkɛma, bɛ ze mɔ Nyamenle ne. 13Bɛkyekyele ɔ bo kɛ awie biala mɔɔ anzonle Yizilayɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle ne la, saa ɔle kakula o, kpanyinli o, raalɛ o, nrenya o, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛku ye. 14Bɛvale ɛnelɛ kpole bɛdeɛdeanle nu, bɛbɔle aweɛne ndendenle nee ɛweɛne na bɛvale Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛlile amonle, 15na Dwudama amuala anye liele kpole wɔ ɛhye anwo. Ɔluakɛ bɛvale bɛ ahonle muala a bɛhanle ndane bɛlile amonle ne a. Bɛvale bɛ ɛhulolɛ kɔsɔɔti bɛzonlenle Ɛdɛnkɛma, na Ɛdɛnkɛma liele bɛ dole nu na ɔmanle bɛ nzo nu dwole bɛ wɔ adenle biala anu.
16Belemgbunli Esa dule ɔ nli Meeyaka ebia zo kɛ ɔnle ɛhyenlema bieko, ɔboalekɛ ɛnee yeyɛ bozonle raalɛ Ahyela bɛkyi ananze ne yezie ɔ nwo ɔsonle ye. Esa bubule bozonle raalɛ Ahyela ananze ne, ɔpele na ɔhɔyelale ye wɔ azudenle Kedelɔn ne anloa. 17Yeanzɛkye ɛleka ne mɔ mɔɔ menli mɔɔ ɛnze Nyamenle la sonle la, noko Belemgbunli Esa lile nɔhalɛ manle Ɛdɛnkɛma wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɔde ngoane nu la. 18Ɔvale ɔ ze ahyɛlɛ ninyɛne mɔɔ bɛdu bɛzie ɛkɛ bɛmaa Nyamenle la, nee ɔdaye ye ahyɛlɛ ninyɛne ne mɔ amuala, dwɛtɛ fufule, nee ezukoa nvutuke yɛɛ ahyɛnze kɔsɔɔti ɔrale Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu. 19Na konle bieko anzi toonwo Belemgbunli Esa lile ɛvolɛ abulasa nee nnu wɔ ebia ne azo.

Title: 2 EDK 16
Content:
Yizilayɛma amaneɛnwunlɛ
(1 Arl 15.17-22)
1Belemgbunli Esa lile ɛvolɛ abulasa nee nsia wɔ ebia zo la, Yizilayɛ Belemgbunli Beeyahya vale konle doale Dwudama, na ɔbɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɔkyekye Releema, amaa yeadua adenle mɔɔ awie ɛngɔ awie ɛmba Dwuda la. 2Yemɔti Esa vale dwɛtɛ fufule nee ezukoa nvutuke wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne gya nu nee belemgbunli suakunlu ɛkɛ ne manle bɛhɔmanle Selea Belemgbunli Bɛneheedade wɔ Dɛmasekɛse, na ɔzele ye kɛ, 3“Maa yɛyɛ konle nu agɔnwolɛyɛlɛ ngyehyɛlɛ, kɛmɔ yɛ ze mɔ yɛle la. Melɛfa dwɛtɛ fufule nee ezukoa nvutuke ɛhye mɔ mearɛlɛ wɔ, amaa wɔazɛkye agɔnwolɛyɛlɛ ne mɔɔ la wɔ nee Yizilayɛ Belemgbunli Beeyahya avinli la, na Yizilayɛ belemgbunli ne aye ye ɛlɔnema mɔɔ wɔ me maanle ye anu la ahɔ.”
4Bɛneheedade kponlenle Belemgbunli Esa nzuzulɛ ne azo na ɔzoanle ɛlɔnema ɔmanle bɛhɔtetale Yizilayɛ azuamgbole ne bie mɔ. Bɛhonle bɛvale Yidwɔn, Dan, Ebɛle Bɛte Meeyaka, yɛɛ azuamgbole mɔɔ wɔ Nafetalae mɔɔ bɛsie konle ninyɛne zolɛ la. 5Beeyahya dele ɛhye anwo bie la, ɔgyakyile Releema ɛkyekyelɛ nee nwolɛ gyima biala. 6Na Belemgbunli Esa vale Dwudama amuala manle bɛhɔzoale awolɛ nee ndaboa mɔɔ Beeyahya lɛ ɛlɛkyekye Releema la, na ɔvale ɔrakyekyele Giba nee Mezepa.
Nyamenle Kpɔmanvolɛ Haneenae
7Mekɛ zɔhane anu ala, Nyamenle sonla Haneenae rale Dwuda Belemgbunli Esa ɛkɛ ne razele ye kɛ, “Kɛmɔ ɛvale ɛ rɛle ɛwulale Selea belemgbunli ne anu na wɔanva ɛ rɛle wɔanwula Ɛdɛnkɛma wɔ Nyamenle ne anu la ati, Selea belemgbunli ne ɛlɔnema ɛnriandi wɔ ɛwie ala ɛne. 8Na ɛnee Sudan nee Lebeya ɛnlɛ ɛlɔnema pemgbenleamgbe nee konle ehwili yɛɛ menli mɔɔ ka mgbɔnwɔ la dɔɔnwo ɔ? Noko kɛmɔ ɛvale ɛ rɛle ɛwulale Ɛdɛnkɛma nu la, ɔyele bɛ ɔmanle wɔ. 9Ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma fa ɔ nye bɔ ewiade ye anwo mgbɔlɔka, na ɔfa tumi ɔdie bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdi nɔhalɛ bɛmaa ye la. Wɔli kɔnwɔne edwɛkɛ wɔ ɛhye anu, yemɔti ɔvi ɛnɛ mɔɔ kɔ la konle ɛnrɛkpa ɛ nwo ɛlɛ.” 10Belemgbunli Esa vale Nyamenle sonla ne anwo ɛya kpole kpalɛ wɔ mɔɔ ɔhanle la anwo, na ɔmanle bɛhyele ye, bɛdole ye efiade, na bɛbɔle ye kpanwu. Eza ɔvi mekɛ zɔhane anu ala, Belemgbunli Esa bɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɔyɛ menli ne bie mɔ asa.
Esa belemgbunlililɛ ne awieleɛ
(1 Arl 15.23-24)
11Bɛhɛlɛ Belemgbunli Esa gyima mɔɔ ɔlile, ɔvi mɔlebɛbo ne mɔɔ kɔdwu awieleɛ ne la wɔ Dwuda nee Yizilayɛ Arelemgbunli Tetedwɛkɛ Buluku ne anu. 12Ɔlile ɛvolɛ abulasa nee ngɔnla wɔ ebia zo la, ɔ gyakɛ hunle ye. Ye ewule ne anu yɛle se, noko wɔ ye anwonyane ne anu, yeamkpondɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma abo zo, na ɔbizale moalɛ ɔvile ninsinlima ɛkɛ. 13Belemgbunli Esa hɔle ayile nu wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee yeli ɛvolɛ abulanla nee ko wɔ ebia ne azo la. 14Bɛwulale ye mrɛlatɛlɛ nu wɔ bolɛ nla bie mɔɔ ɔdaye ɔpɛle ɔmanle ɔ nwo wɔ Devidi Suakpole zo la anu. Bɛdole ye ngɛnlamo funli ɛlɛka bie mɔɔ bɛva alufuanlɛ ngakyile mɔɔ menli mɔɔ ze ɔ nye zo la boɔboale yɛle la anu na bɛhuanle sendɔlɔra kpole bie bɛvale bɛhakyele ye.

Title: 2 EDK 17
Content:
Gyɛhɔhyafate di belemgbunli
1Belemgbunli Esa ara Gyɛhɔhyafate lile ɔ ze agya dɛnlanle ebia ne azo, na ɔboɔboale ɔ nwo kpalɛ wɔ Yizilayɛma ati. 2Ɔvale ɛlɔnema ɔhɔguale azuamgbole mɔɔ bɛbɔ nwolɛ bane wɔ Dwuda la amuala azo. Ɔvale ɛlɔnema ekpunli ekpunli ɔkpondenle Dwuda maanle ne anu yɛɛ Yifelaem azuamgbole mɔɔ Belemgbunli Esa honle vale bɛ la azo. 3Ɛdɛnkɛma nee Gyɛhɔhyafate luale, ɔboalekɛ ɔbɔle ɔ ze Esa ɛbɛla ne mɔɔ ɔlumuale ɔbɔle la bie, yeandoa bozonle Beeyale ne mɔ abo zo. 4Ɔzonlenle ɔ ze mɔ Nyamenle ne na ɔlile ye mɛla ne mɔ azo. Yeanyɛ ye kɛmɔ Yizilayɛma yɛle la. 5Zɔhane ati Ɛdɛnkɛma manle maanle ne gyinlanle wɔ ye mekɛ zo, na Dwudama amuala rahyɛle ye ninyɛne. Ɔnyianle ɔ nyunlu na ɔnyianle anwonyia dɔɔnwo noko. 6Ɔgyinlanle kpundii wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛzonlenlɛ nu, yɛɛ eza ɔzɛkyele ɛleka ne mɔ mɔɔ menli mɔɔ ɛnze Nyamenle la sonle la, na ɔdule bɛ bozonle Ahyela ne abo wɔ Dwuda maanle ne anu.
7Mɔɔ Gyɛhɔhyafate lile ɛvolɛ nsa wɔ ebia ne azo la, ɔzoanle ye mgbanyima Bɛneheli, Obadaya, Zɛkalaya, Nɛtaniile, yɛɛ Maekaya kɛ bɛhɔhilehile wɔ Dwuda azuamgbole ne mɔ azo. 8Ɔmanle Livaema ngɔnla ɛhye mɔ nee bɛ hɔle: Hyɛmaya, Nɛtanaya, Zɛbadaya, Asahɛle, Hyɛmaelamo, Gyɛhɔnatan, Adonaegya, Tobaya, yɛɛ Tobadonaegya. Sɛlɛvolɛma Yilaehyama yɛɛ Gyɛhɔlam, nee Livaema ne hɔle. 9Bɛvale Ɛdɛnkɛma Mɛla Buluku ne bɛhɔle na bɛhilehilele wɔ Dwuda maanle ne anu amuala. Bɛhɔle Dwuda suakpole biala azo na bɛhilehilele menli ne.
Gyɛhɔhyafate kpoleyɛlɛ
10Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛzulolɛ dɔle maanle maanle mɔɔ zuozua Dwuda la amuala anwo zo, yemɔti bɛanva konle bɛandoa Gyɛhɔhyafate. 11Filisitiama bie mɔ bɔbɔ vale ahyɛlɛ ninyɛne rɛlɛle Gyɛhɔhyafate. Eza bɛrɛlɛle ye dwɛtɛ fufule. Arelabema rɛlɛle ye mboane apenle nsuu ɛya nsuu yɛɛ mbɔnkye nyinli apenle nsuu ɛya nsuu. 12Na Gyɛhɔhyafate hɔle zo yɛle kpole, ye tumi yɛle kpole. Ɔsisile aranemgbole wɔ Dwuda amuala, ɔkyekyele azuamgbole mɔɔ bɛfa konle ninyɛne bɛsiezie zolɛ la, 13yɛɛ ɔlɛ konle ninyɛne dɔɔnwo kpalɛ wɔ Dwuda azuamgbole ne mɔ azo.
Ɔlɛ ɛlɔnema mɔɔ ze ko kpalɛ la wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm. 14Bɛ dodo, kɛmɔ bɛ ze mɔ mbusua ne mɔ de la ɛne: wɔ Dwuda, Adena le safohyenle kpanyinli mɔɔ nea ɛlɔnema apenle ngoko ɛya nsa mɔɔ ze ko kpalɛ la anwo zo. 15Mɔɔ doa Adena la a le Gyihɔheenan, ɔdaye noko ɔnea ɛlɔnema apenle ngoko ɛya nwiɔ abulatwɛ anwo zo, 16yɛɛ mɔɔ tɔ zo nsa la a le Zekelae ara Amasaya (mɔɔ ɛdu ɔ nwo ɛmaa kɛ ɔsonle Ɛdɛnkɛma la). Ɔnea ɛlɔnema apenle ngoko ɛya nwiɔ mɔɔ ze ko kpalɛ la anwo zo. 17Wɔ Bɛngyaman maanzinli nu, nrenya katakyie Yilayada a le safohyenle kpanyinli a, ɔnea ɛlɔnema apenle ngoko ɛya nwiɔ mɔɔ ze ɛda to na bɛdedɛ enyinlike la anwo zo. 18Mɔɔ doa ye la a le Gyɛhozabade, ɔlɛ ɛlɔnema apenle ngoko ɛya ko abulatwɛ mɔɔ konle ti bɛboɔboa bɛ nwo bɛwie la. 19Menli ɛhye mɔ amuala wɔ belemgbunli ne gyima nu. Ɛye bɛmɛ ɛsie ahane a, eza belemgbunli ne lɛ ɛlɔnema wɔ Dwuda azuamgbole mɔɔ bɛbɔ nwolɛ bane la amuala azo.

Title: 2 EDK 18
Content:
Nyamenle Kpɔmanvolɛ Maekaya bɔ Ehabe kɔkɔ
(1 Arl 22.1-28)
1Dwuda Belemgbunli Gyɛhɔhyafate akee nyianle ɔ nwo kpole kpalɛ na ɔnyianle ɔ nyunlu kpalɛ wɔ menli nyunlu. Akee ɔ nee Yizilayɛ Belemgbunli Ehabe yɛle agyalɛ ngyehyɛlɛ. 2Mekɛ guale nu la ɔhɔle kɛ ɔkakpɔla Ehabe wɔ Samɛlea. Ehabe noko hunle mboane nee nlankɛ dɔɔnwo zonle Gyɛhɔhyafate nee ye menli mɔɔ ɔ nee bɛ rale la ɛyɛvolɛ, na ɔlile ye adwenle kɛ ɔmaa bɛhɔteta Releemɔto mɔɔ wɔ Geleade la. 3Belemgbunli Ehabe zele Dwuda Belemgbunli Gyɛhɔhyafate kɛ, “Kɛ ɔde ɛ, ɛ nee me kɛhɔ ɛkɛmaa yɛkɛhɔteta Releemɔto mɔɔ wɔ Geleade la ɔ?”
Gyɛhɔhyafate buale kɛ, “Medame a le ɛdawɔ. Me menli le wɔ menli. Yɛ nee wɔ kɛhɔ konle ne.” 4Na akee ɔzele Yizilayɛ belemgbunli ne kɛ, “Maa yɛlumua yɛbiza yɛdie Ɛdɛnkɛma anloa edwɛkɛ kolaa.”
5Yizilayɛ belemgbunli ne manle bɛvɛlɛvɛlɛle Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma ne mɔ amuala na bɛrayiale, bɛ dodo le ɛya nna. Na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Yɛkadoa menli mɔɔ wɔ Releemɔto mɔɔ wɔ Geleade la yɛ nee bɛ ahɔho. Yɛhɔ anzɛɛ yɛmmakɔ ɔ?”
Bɛzele ye kɛ, “Kɔ, ɔluakɛ Nyamenle baye sua ne amaa Nana.”
6Na Belemgbunli Gyɛhɔhyafate mɔɔ vi Dwuda rale la bizale kɛ, “Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ bieko ɛnle ɛkɛ mɔɔ yɛbiza ye yɛtie Ɛdɛnkɛma anloa edwɛkɛ a ɔyɛ boɛ ɔ?”
7Yizilayɛ Belemgbunli Ehabe zele Gyɛhɔhyafate kɛ, “Ko bieko tɛbɔ ɛkɛ mɔɔ yɛkola yɛbiza ye yɛtie Ɛdɛnkɛma anloa edwɛkɛ a. Yemɔ a le Yemela ara Maekaya; na mekyi ye kɔkɔkɔkɔ, ɔluakɛ ɔnva Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ kpalɛ ɔmbɛlɛ me kɛ munzule nrɛlaleɛ ngome ala a ɔfa ɔbɛlɛ me a.”
Gyɛhɔhyafate zele ye kɛ, “Nana, mmaka ye zɔhane.”
8Na Belemgbunli Ehabe zoanle ye mbɔlɔba mgbanyinli ne mɔ ko kɛ ɔhɔva Yemela ara Maekaya ɔrɛla ndɛndɛ.
9Akee Yizilayɛ belemgbunli ne nee Dwuda Belemgbunli Gyɛhɔhyafate zieziele bɛ nwo na bɛhɔdɛnlanle aze wɔ suakpole ne anlenkɛ kpole ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Samɛlea la anloa, ɛleka mɔɔ bɛwozo ma ne la. Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma ne mɔ amuala rahanle Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ ne hilele bɛ. 10Na bɛ nuhua ko mɔɔ le Kɛneeyana ara Zɛdikaya vale bulalɛ yɛle mɛne na ɔhanle kɛ, “Ɛdɛnkɛma se, ‘Ɛbava ɛhye wɔaha Seleama wɔagua toonwo wɔabɔ bɛ bo zo bɔkɔɔ.’ ” 11Zɔhane nrɛlaleɛ ne ala a Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma mɔɔ hale la hanle a. Bɛzele ye kɛ, “Nana, kɔ Releemɔto mɔɔ wɔ Geleade la kɔli konim. Ɛdɛnkɛma baye suakpole ne amaa Nana somaa.”
12Akee ahenle mɔɔ bɛzoanle ye kɛ ɔhɔva Maekaya la zele ye kɛ, “Ayi, Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma ne mɔ amuala anloa ɛyɛ ko, bɛbɔ saleɛ bɛmaa belemgbunli ne. Ɛdawɔ noko maa ɛ nloa nee bɛ ɛdeɛ ne ɛyɛ ko.”
13Maekaya zele ye kɛ, “Meka tease Ɛdɛnkɛma kɛ, mɔɔ me Nyamenle ne kɛva kɛmaa me la, yemɔ ala yɛɛ mebaha a.”
14Maekaya radwule belemgbunli ne anyunlu ɛkɛ ne la, Belemgbunli Ehabe bizale ye kɛ, “Maekaya, yɛhɔ Releemɔto mɔɔ wɔ Geleade la yɛhɔdoa menli ne yɛ nee bɛ ɛhɔho, anzɛɛ mengyakyi?”
Maekaya buale kɛ, “Bɛhɔ na bɛhɔli konim; bɛbaye bɛ bɛamaa bɛ.”
15Belemgbunli Ehabe zele ye kɛ, “Fane nyɛ yɛɛ menga mengile wɔ kɛ ɛha nɔhalɛ ne ala ɛhile me wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma duma nu a?”
16 Na Maekaya hanle kɛ, “Menwunle kɛ Yizilayɛma amuala ɛbɔ asande wɔ awoka ne mɔ azo lɔ kɛ mboane mɔɔ ɛnlɛ neavolɛ la, na Ɛdɛnkɛma zele kɛ, ‘Ɛhye mɔ ɛnlɛ bɛ menle; yemɔti bɛmaa bɛhɔ sua nu anzonudwolɛ nu.’ ”
17Na Yizilayɛ belemgbunli ne hanle hilele Dwuda Belemgbunli Gyɛhɔhyafate kɛ, “Meanga meangile wɔ kɛ ɔnrɛva nrɛlaleɛ kpalɛ biala ɔnrɛrɛlɛ me, kɛ munzule yɛɛ ɔbabɔ yeamaa me a?”
18Maekaya zɔle ye edwɛkɛ ne azo kɛ, “Zɔhane ati tie mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma se la. Menwunle kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma de ye belemgbunli ebia nu na anwuma ɛlɔnema kɔsɔɔti gyigyi ye bɛne nee fema. 19Na Ɛdɛnkɛma bizale bɛ kɛ, ‘Nwane a kɛhɔ kɛhɔli Yizilayɛ Belemgbunli Ehabe adwenle, kɛmaa ɔkɛhɔ Releemɔto mɔɔ wɔ Geleade la, kɛmaa ɔkɛhɔ ɔkɛhɔho ɔkɛli akoatɔ a?’ Na mɔɔ ko ɛlɛka edwɛkɛ ɛhye la, ɛnee ko ɛlɛka bie gyɛne. 20Akee sunsum bie vindele ragyinlanle Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu ɛkɛ na ɔhanle kɛ, ‘Mebahɔli ye adwenle.’ Ɛdɛnkɛma bizale ye kɛ, ‘Kɛ ɛsi wɔali ye adwenle ɛ?’ 21Na ɔbuale kɛ, ‘Mekɔ na meamaa ye Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma ne mɔ amuala abɔ adalɛ.’ Na Ɛdɛnkɛma zele ye kɛ, ‘Kɔbɛlɛbɛla ye na ɛ sa baha ye; kɔ na kɔyɛ ye zɔhane.’
22“Yemɔti nea, Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛmaa adalɛ sunsum ɛradwu wɔ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma ɛhye mɔ amuala anwo zo kɛ bɛbɔ adalɛ bɛhile wɔ. Ɔdaye mumua ne yeha yedo ɛkɛ ne kɛ munzule ɛnyia wɔ.”
23Na Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ Zɛdikaya hɔnyikale Maekaya anwo zo, ɔbɔle ɔ nzo nu na ɔhanle kɛ, “Adenle boni azo a Ɛdɛnkɛma Sunsum ne luale gyakyile mame na ɔdendɛle ɔhilele wɔmɔ a?”
24Maekaya buale ye kɛ, “Kenle mɔɔ ɛbanriandi wɔahɔvea wɔ sua ne akunlu ɛkɛ ne la, kenle ne yɛɛ ɛbanwu ye a.”
25Yizilayɛ Belemgbunli Ehabe zele kɛ, “Bɛhye Maekaya na bɛva ye bɛhɔmaa Emɔn, mɔɔ le suakpole ye amɛnlado ne, nee belemgbunli ara Dwowahye; 26na bɛha bɛhile bɛ kɛ, ‘Belemgbunli se bɛva sonla ɛhye bɛdo efiade na bɛmaa ye aleɛ mɔɔ ɛnza ye di nee nzule ekyi bie, kɔdwu kɛ menwɔzia menwɔra anzonudwolɛ nu la.’ ”
27Na Maekaya buale kɛ, “Saa ɛsia ɛba anzonudwolɛ nu a, ɛnee tɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma a luale me nwo zo dendɛle a.” Na ɔzele menli mɔɔ wɔ ɛkɛ ne la kɛ, “Bɛdie na bɛyɛ mɔɔ meha la nzonlɛ!”
Ehabe ewule
(1 Arl 22.29-35)
28Akee Yizilayɛ belemgbunli ne nee Dwuda Belemgbunli Gyɛhɔhyafate zile nu hɔle Releemɔto mɔɔ wɔ Geleade la kɛ bɛkadoa menli mɔɔ wɔ zo la bɛ nee bɛ aho. 29Na Ehabe hanle hilele Gyɛhɔhyafate kɛ, “Mebahakyi me nwo na meahɔ konle ne anloa, na wɔmɔ, wula wɔ belemgbunli tɛladeɛ ne ala kɔ.” Na Yizilayɛ belemgbunli ne hakyile ɔ nwo na akee bɛhɔle konle ne anloa.
30Selea belemgbunli ne ɛze ye safohyenlema mɔɔ nea ɛlɔnema mɔɔ fa ehwili ko la kɛ, “Bɛ nee awie biala mmako, kakula o, kpanyinli o, kɛ Yizilayɛ belemgbunli ne ala.” 31Yemɔti mɔɔ safohyenlema ne nwunle Gyɛhɔhyafate la, bɛdwenlenle kɛ Yizilayɛ belemgbunli ne ɔ, na bɛhakyile bɛ nye kɛ bɛ nee ye kaho. Gyɛhɔhyafate deanle nuhua na Ɛdɛnkɛma raboale ye. Nyamenle manle menli ne mɔ hwenle bɛ nzi, 32ɔluakɛ mɔɔ safohyenlema ne nwunle kɛ tɛ Yizilayɛ belemgbunli ne a bɛdoa ye ndinlizo la, bɛgyakyile ye ɛvoanlɛ. 33Na nrenya bie mɔɔ wɔ Selea ɛlɔnema ne anu la dole ye ɛda ne ngyengyene nu bie ala, na ɔhɔwɔle Yizilayɛ belemgbunli ne wɔ ye konle tɛladeɛ ne ayia ne mɔ bie azo. Belemgbunli ne zele ahenle mɔɔ ɛlɛka ye konle ehwili ne la kɛ, “Kakyi ɛ nwo, ye me fi konle ye anloa na meboda.” 34Konle ne anu yɛle se kenle ko ne, Yizilayɛ belemgbunli ne hisale ye konle ehwili ne anu, ɔ nye hale Seleama ne anwo toonwo nɔsolɛ nu. Na mɔɔ sɛnzɛne ne kadɔ la, ɔwule.

Title: 2 EDK 19
Content:
Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ twi Gyɛhɔhyafate anyunlu
1Belemgbunli Gyɛhɔhyafate vale ɔ nwo kɔlɔnwo ziale hɔle ye sua zo Gyɛlusalɛm. 2Na Nyamenle sonla Gyihu, mɔɔ le Haneenae ara ne, hɔyiale ye na ɔbizale belemgbunli ne kɛ, “Asoo ɛnea a ɛnee ɔle kpalɛ kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ ɛboa amumuyɛma na ɛkɛhulo menli mɔɔ kyi Ɛdɛnkɛma la ɔ? Ɔlua ɛhye ati, Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛva ɛ nwo ɛya. 3Noko akee, bɛnwu kpalɛ ekyi bie wɔ wɔ nuhua, ɔluakɛ wɔzɛkye bozonle raalɛ Ahyela ne ananze ne mɔ na wɔdua bɛ ɛzonlenlɛ wɔ maanle ye anu. Eza wɔva wɔzie wɔ ahonle nu kɛ ɛsonle Ɛdɛnkɛma ala.”
Gyɛhɔhyafate kakyihakyi ninyɛne
4Belemgbunli Gyɛhɔhyafate dɛnlanle Gyɛlusalɛm, yɛɛ ɔyɛ a ɔkɔkpɔlɔkpɔla ye menli ne mɔ, ɔvi Biyɛhyiba toonwo kɔdwu Yifelaem awoka ne mɔ azo lɔ la, na ɔmanle bɛziale bɛrazonlenle Ɛdɛnkɛma, bɛ ze mɔ Nyamenle ne. 5Ɔyeyele ndɛnebuavolɛma wɔ Dwuda azuamgbole ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛbɔ nwolɛ bane la azo, suakpole biala azo ɛdeɛ, 6na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛnlea mɔɔ bɛyɛ la, ɔluakɛ bɛnyɛ bɛ gyima ne bɛmmaa sonla, bɛyɛ bɛamaa Ɛdɛnkɛma. Ɔbaboa bɛ wɔ mekɛ biala mɔɔ bɛkɛze kɛ bɛbua ndɛne la. 7Bɛzulo Ɛdɛnkɛma na bɛnlea boɛ wɔ mɔɔ bɛkɛze kɛ bɛyɛ la anwo, ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛ Nyamenle ne ɛnli mɔguazo, ɔnnea sonla nyunlu, yɛɛ ɔnlie ndoloboa.”
8Eza Gyɛhɔhyafate yeyele Livaema, nee sɛlɛvolɛma bie mɔ, yɛɛ Yizilayɛ mbusua mgbanyinli ne bie mɔ kɛ bɛyɛ ndɛnebuavolɛma wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm, bɛli menli mɔɔ kɛvo Nyamenle Mɛla ne la edwɛkɛ na bɛziezie kpolera biala mɔɔ kɛdɔ bɛ avinli la. 9Akee ɔyɛle ngyehyɛlɛ ɛhye ɔmanle bɛ kɛ, “Bɛva bɛ ahonle muala bɛyɛ ɛhye wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛzulolɛ nee nɔhalɛlilɛ nu. 10Saa bɛ mediema mɔɔ wɔ azuamgbole ne mɔ bie azo la ba na ɔ nee kɔdiawuyɛlɛ, mɛladonlɛ, mɛla anzɛɛ amaamuo ɛzɛkyelɛ edwɛkɛ bie ba bɛ nyunlu a, bɛhilehile bɛ, amaa bɛanyɛ bɛanli fɔlɛ wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu, na ye ɛya ne ara bɛdabɛ nee bɛ mra anwo zo. Mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛyɛ na bɛanli fɔlɛ wɔ Nyamenle anyunlu la ɛne. 11Akee Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli Amalaya a banlea na yeagua Nyamenlezonlenlɛ nu kpolerazulɛ biala abo a, Yehyemeeyɛle ara Zɛbadaya, Dwuda amɛnlado ne yɛɛ banlea agua maanle ye anu edwɛkɛ biala abo a, yɛɛ Livaema ne mɔ banlea amaa edwɛkɛ biala mɔɔ bɛkɛha wɔ edwɛkɛlilɛ ɛleka ne mɔ la ayɛ zɔhane, kɛmɔ bɛhanle la. Bɛzi ahonle bɛyɛ gyima ne na Ɛdɛnkɛma baboa mɔɔ di nɔhalɛ la.”

Title: 2 EDK 20
Content:
Yidɔm konle ne
1Ɛhye anzi Mowabema nee Amɔnoma, nee Mɛyunɛmma bie mɔ rale Gyɛhɔhyafate anwo zo kɛ bɛ nee ye baho. 2Na awie mɔ bie rahanle hilele Gyɛhɔhyafate kɛ, “Ɛlɔnema dɔɔnwo kpalɛ vi Yidɔm nee nyevile ne anzi lɔ ɛlɛba aradoa wɔ nee wɔ aho. Kɛkala bɔbɔ, bɛwɔ Hazazɔn Teemaa.” (Suakpole Ɛngidae duma ko noko ɛne.) 3Ɛzulolɛ hanle Gyɛhɔhyafate na ɔzɛlɛle moalɛ ɔvile Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛkɛ ne, na ɔzele kɛ Dwudama kɔsɔɔti ɛhye ɛhɔne. 4Na Dwudama amuala yiale kɛ bɛsɛlɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma moalɛ, menli vi Dwuda azuamgbole ne mɔ amuala azo rale nzɛlɛlɛ ne bie. 5Na Gyɛhɔhyafate dwazole gyinlanle Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne alie fofolɛ ne mɔɔ bɔ zo mɔɔ bɛyɛ la anwo, wɔ Dwudama nee Gyɛlusalɛmma amuala anyunlu, 6na ɔzɛlɛle kɛ, “O Ɛdɛnkɛma, yɛ ze mɔ Nyamenle, wɔmɔ a ɛle Nyamenle mɔɔ ɛwɔ anwuma na ɛsie arelemgbunli maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti mɔɔ wɔ ewiade la a. Wɔmɔ yɛɛ ɛlɛ tumi nee anwosesebɛ mɔɔ awie ɛngola ɛ nyunlu gyinla a. 7 O yɛ Nyamenle, ɛdawɔ yɛɛ ɛvoanle menli mɔɔ ɛnee de azɛlɛ ye azo la ɛvile Yizilayɛma anyunlu, na ɛvale azɛlɛ ne ɛmanle ɛ gɔnwo Ebileham abo zo amra bɔkɔɔ a. 8Bɛdɛnla zo mekɛ dɔɔnwo na bɛzi ɛleka nwuanzanwuanza bɛmaa wɔ, na bɛzɛlɛ wɔ kɛ, 9saa munzule fa yɛ aze: konle, ndeanlɛ, ewule nzane anzɛɛ ɛhɔne ba a, yɛragyinla sua ɛhye anyunlu ɛke, wɔ ɛ nyunlu, kɛmɔ wɔ duma a la sua ye azo la, na yɛlua yɛ nyane ne anu yɛdea yɛvɛlɛ wɔ na ɛkɛdie yɛ.
10 “Kɛkala, Amɔnoma, Mowabema, nee Yidɔmma ɛva yɛ aze. Mekɛ mɔɔ Yizilayɛma vi Yigyibiti ba la, wɔammaa bɛanva bɛ azɛlɛ ne azo, bɛbule bɛhoanenle bɛ, yemɔti bɛambɔ bɛ bo zo. 11Akee nea, yɛ moyɛlɛ a le kɛ bɛba bɛaravoa yɛ bɛavi azɛlɛ ye mɔɔ wɔva wɔmaa yɛ kɛ yɛdɛnla zo kpɔkpɔ la azo. 12O yɛ Nyamenle, tea bɛ maa yɛ. Ɔluakɛ menli ɛwolaa ɛhye mɔɔ ɛlɛba yɛ nwo zo la, yɛnrɛhola bɛ nyunlu gyinla. Yɛnnwu mɔɔ yɛyɛ bɔbɔ a, ɛ nyunlu ala a yɛ nye gyi a.”
13Mekɛ ne anu, ɛnee Dwudama amuala nee bɛ mraalɛ nee bɛ mra gyi nzisi wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu. 14Na Ɛdɛnkɛma Sunsum ne dwule Gyaheezeɛle anwo zo wɔ menli ne avinli. Gyaheezeɛle ɔ ze a le Zɛkalaya. Zɛkalaya ɔ ze a le Bɛnaya, Bɛnaya ɔ ze a le Gyiayɛle, Gyiayɛle ɔ ze a le Matanaya, ɔle Livaenli, ɔvi Esafe abusua nu. 15 Gyaheezeɛle zele kɛ, “Bɛdie, Dwudama amuala nee Gyɛlusalɛmma, yɛɛ Belemgbunli Gyɛhɔhyafate, bɛdie! Ɛdɛnkɛma se, ‘Bɛmmasulo, yɛɛ bɛmmamaa bɛ rɛle bɔ kɛ menli ɛwolaa ɛhye ɛlɛba bɛ nwo zo a. Ɔluakɛ konle ne ɛnle bɛ konle. Ɔle Nyamenle ɔdaye ye konle. 16Ɛhyema bɛhɔholo bɛ nwo zo. Bɛbava Zeze ademgbole nu a bɛavo bɛara a. Bɛbanwu bɛ wɔ bɔnza ne ati lɔ wɔ Gyɛluwɛle fienemgbole ne aduduleɛ. 17 Dwudama nee Gyɛlusalɛmma, ɔnrɛhyia kɛ bɛkɛho bɔbɔ wɔ konle ɛhye anu. Bɛmɛ bɛgyinla bɛ bo zo ne, bɛmmatu bɛ bo, na bɛnlea kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma bazi aho bɛ ti ali konim la.’ Bɛmmasulo, yɛɛ bɛmmamaa bɛ rɛle bɔ. Ɛhyema bɛhɔteta bɛ na Ɛdɛnkɛma nee bɛ bahɔ.”
18Akee Belemgbunli Gyɛhɔhyafate bɔle ɔ ti aze, ɔvale ɔ nyunlu ɔbutule aze, na Dwudama nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ Gyɛlusalɛm la amuala dule guale Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu na bɛzonlenle ye. 19Na Livaema mɔɔ bɔ Kohate nee Kɔla mbusua ne bie la dwazole deɛdeanle nu yele Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne ayɛlɛ.
20Bɛdwazole ndɛndɛ wɔ aleɛbahye ne ala na bɛhɔle Tɛkowa fienemgbole ne anu. Mɔɔ bɛkɔ la, Belemgbunli Gyɛhɔhyafate ragyinlanle adenle ne anloa na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Dwudama nee Gyɛlusalɛmma, bɛdie me! Bɛlie Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne bɛli, na bɛbali konim. Bɛlie Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma ne bɛli, na bɛbaho bɛadɔ zolɛ.” 21Akee ɔ nee menli ne bɛhanle bɛ ti bɛkpulale nwolɛ na ɔyele menli mɔɔ ɛwula ɛzonlenlɛ adɛladeɛ ɛli ɛlɔnema ne ati la, na ɔzele bɛ kɛ bɛdo edwɛne bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma na bɛye ye ayɛlɛ bɛze kɛ, “Bɛyɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma mo, ɔluakɛ ye ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne ɛnlɛ awieleɛ.”
22Mɔɔ bɛbɔle ɔ bo kɛ bɛto edwɛne bɛaye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ la, Ɛdɛnkɛma manle Amɔnoma, Mowabema, nee Yidɔmma mɔɔ ɛra badoa Yizilayɛma nee bɛ aho la anye zo danle bɛ, na bɛhuhunle bɛ nwo. 23Amɔnoma nee Mowabema bɔle nu hunle Yidɔm ɛlɔnema ne amuala bɔle bɛ bo zo. Bɛwiele Yidɔmma ku la, bɛdabɛ bɛ ngome bɛhakyile bɛ nye bɛbɔle ye zo na bɛpɛle bɛ nwo bɛhuhunle bɛ nwo bɔkɔɔ. 24Dwuda ɛlɔnema ne dwule fienemgbole ne anu tawa ne mɔɔ bɛgyinla zo bɛneɛnlea maanle nu la anwo la, bie mɔ vole zolɛ na bɛnwunle kɛ, menli ɛwolaa ne kɔsɔɔti ɛyɛ avunli na bɛgua azɛlɛ ne anwo. Ko bɔbɔ anvi ɛsalɛ.
25Na Gyɛhɔhyafate nee ye ɛlɔnema ne akee rale kɛ bɛbave bɛ ninyɛne. Bɛnyianle nlankɛ dɔɔnwo kpalɛ, ninyɛne, ndanlɛ, nee ninyɛne mɔɔ sonle bolɛ la. Bɛnyianle ninyɛne dɔɔnwo kpalɛ mɔɔ ɛnee akee bɔbɔ bɛngola bɛ soa a. Ninyɛne ne zonle somaa; bɛvale kenle nsa a bɛhwenle ninyɛne ne a. 26Kenle nna ne azo bɛ muala bɛrayiale “Bɛleeka” Bɔnza, na bɛyele Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ. Zɔhane ati, bɔnza zɔhane, ɛnɛ nee ɛnɛ ala bɛfɛlɛ ye Bɛleeka Bɔnza. 27Akee Dwudama o, Gyɛlusalɛmma o, bɛ muala bɛziale bɛrale Gyɛlusalɛm. Belemgbunli Gyɛhɔhyafate lile bɛ ti na bɛvale anyelielɛ bɛziale bɛrale, ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛmaa bɛli bɛ kpɔvolɛma ne mɔ anwo zo konim. 28Bɛbɔle getaa mgbole nee ngyikyi nee aweɛne ndendenle toonwo bɛrawolole Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu. 29Na maanle maanle dɔɔnwo mɔɔ dele kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma zile liele Yizilayɛma ati honle tiale bɛ kpɔvolɛma la zulole Nyamenle. 30Yemɔti Belemgbunli Gyɛhɔhyafate akee ziele maanle ne anzonudwolɛ nu, ɔluakɛ Nyamenle bɔle ɔ nwo bane.
Gyɛhɔhyafate belemgbunlililɛ ne awieleɛ
(1 Arl 22.41-50)
31Gyɛhɔhyafate lile ɛvolɛ abulasa nee nnu la yɛɛ ɔbɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɔdi belemgbunli wɔ Dwuda a. Ɔdɛnlanle Gyɛlusalɛm ɔlile ebia ne ɛvolɛ abulanwiɔ nee nnu. Ɔ nli a le Hyelebae ara raalɛ Azuba. 32Ɔvale ɔ ze Esa agyakɛ na ɔbɔle ɛbɛla mɔɔ ɔ ze bɔle la bie; yeangakyi ye nyɛleɛ, na ɔyɛle mɔɔ sɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anye la. 33Noko yeanzɛkye ɛleka ne mɔ mɔɔ menli mɔɔ ɛnze Nyamenle la sonle la, yɛɛ ɛnee menli ne ɛtɛfale bɛ ahonle muala ɛtɛmanle bɛ ze mɔ Nyamenle ne kɛ yemɔ ala a bɛkɛzonle ye a.
34Akee Gyɛhɔhyafate gyima mɔɔ ɔlile, ɔvi mɔlebɛbo ne mɔɔ kɔdwu awieleɛ ne, mɔɔ ɛnle ɛke la, bɛhɛlɛ bɛ kɔsɔɔti wɔ Haneenae ara Gyihu anwo Tetedwɛkɛ Buluku ne mɔɔ wɔ Yizilayɛ Arelemgbunli Tetedwɛkɛ Buluku ne anu la anu.
35Mekɛ bie Dwuda Belemgbunli Gyɛhɔhyafate vale ɔ nwo bɔnenle Yizilayɛ Belemgbunli Ehazaya, mɔɔ yɛle amumuyɛ kpole la na ɔ nee ye yɛle agɔnwolɛ. 36Ɔ nee Ehazaya bɔle nu bɛbobɔle meli dɔɔnwo wɔ Yizeɔngibɛ kɛ bɛfa bɛahɔ Tahyehye. 37Na Dɔdavahu mɔɔ vi Malihyaa la ara Ɛleyizɛ vale Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ ne manle Gyɛhɔhyafate kɛ, “Suzuamgba ala mɔɔ wɔva ɛ nwo wɔbɔnle Ehazaya la, Ɛdɛnkɛma bazɛkye mɔɔ wɔyɛ la.” Na meli ne mɔ hɔnlomanle adenle nu, bɛandwu Tahyehye.

Title: 2 EDK 21
Content:
1Gyɛhɔhyafate hɔle ayile nu na bɛwulale ye mrɛlatɛlɛ nu wɔ ɔ ze mɔ anwo ɛkɛ wɔ Devidi Suakpole zo na ɔ ra nrenya Gyɛhɔlam lile ebia ne.
Dwuda Belemgbunli Gyɛhɔlam
(2 Arl 8.17-24)
2Belemgbunli Gyɛhɔhyafate ara Gyɛhɔlam lɛ ɔ mediema mrenya nsia. Bɛmɛ a le Azalaya, Gyɛheɛle, Zɛkalaya, Azalayahu, Maekeɛle, yɛɛ Hyɛfataya. 3Bɛ ze manle bɛ ahyɛlɛ ninyɛne dɔɔnwo, yɛɛ Dwuda azuamgbole mɔɔ bɛbɔ nwolɛ bane la. Noko ɔvale maanle ne ɔmanle Gyɛhɔlam, ɔboalekɛ yemɔ a ɔle ralɛ nrenya kpanyinli a. 4Mɔɔ Gyɛhɔlam ralile ɔ ze ebia ne na ɔnyianle gyinlagyakɛ la, ɔmanle bɛhunle ɔ mediema mrenya ne mɔ amuala, nee Yizilayɛ mgbanyima ne bie mɔ.
5Gyɛhɔlam lile ɛvolɛ abulasa nee nwiɔ la yɛɛ ɔbɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɔdi belemgbunli a. Ɔdɛnlanle Gyɛlusalɛm ɔlile ebia ne ɛvolɛ mɔtwɛ. 6Ɔvale Yizilayɛ arelemgbunli ne mɔ agyakɛ, ɔbɔle Ehabe sua nu amra ɛbɛla ne bie, ɔluakɛ ɛnee ɔgya Ehabe ara raalɛ. Ɔyɛle ɛtane ɔtiale Ɛdɛnkɛma, 7 noko Ɛdɛnkɛma ambɔ Devidi sua nu amra abo zo, ɔboalekɛ ɛnee Ɛdɛnkɛma nee Devidi ɛyɛ ngyekyeleɛ, na yebɔ Devidi ɛwɔkɛ kɛ ɔbamaa kɛnlaneɛ ada ye nee ɔ bo zo amra sua nu dahuu.
8 Ye mekɛ zo Yidɔmma dele atua kɛ bɛnrɛzonle Dwuda belemgbunli ne bieko, na bɛdabɛ bɛziele bɛ belemgbunli ɛdeɛ. 9Yemɔti Gyɛhɔlam vale ye safohyenlema nee ye ɛlɔnema mɔɔ tɛnla ehwili nu ko la na kenle ko nɔɔzo bɛdwazole bɛhɔtetale Yidɔm. Yidɔmma bɛnrale yiale bɛ, noko bɛbɔle mɔdenle bɛwolole bɛ sa abo. 10Yemɔti ɔvi mekɛ ne toonwo mɔɔ ɛradwu ɛnɛ la, Yidɔmma di bɛ ti anwo. Mekɛ zɔhane ala anu Lebena ɔdaye ɔdele atua kɛ bɛnrɛzonle Dwuda belemgbunli ne bieko, ɔboalekɛ yegyakyi Ɛdɛnkɛma, ɔ ze mɔ Nyamenle ne anzi ɛlilɛ. 11Yeanga ɛhye angome, eza ɔyɛle ɛleka ne mɔ mɔɔ menli mɔɔ ɛnze Nyamenle la sonle la, na ɔmanle Gyɛlusalɛm amuala yɛle ɛtane tiale Ɛdɛnkɛma; ɔminlinle Dwudama bɔkɔɔ.
12Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ Yilaegya manle bɛvale kɛlata bɛrɛlɛle Belemgbunli Gyɛhɔlam kɛ, “Ɛdɛnkɛma, ɛ ze Devidi Nyamenle ne se, ‘Kɛmɔ wɔanva ɛ ze Gyɛhɔhyafate anzɛɛ Dwuda Belemgbunli Esa agyakɛ, 13na wɔva Yizilayɛ arelemgbunli agyakɛ, wɔmaa Dwudama nee Gyɛlusalɛm amra amuala ɛyɛ ɛtane, kɛmɔ Ehabe sua nu amra manle Yizilayɛma yɛle ɛtane la, na wɔhu ɛ mediema mɔɔ ɛ nee bɛ bɛ ze le ko, na bɛle kpalɛ bɛtɛla ɛdawɔ mumua ne la, 14Ɛdɛnkɛma bamaa ewule nzane aradɔ wɔ menli ne, ɛ mra nee wɔ mraalɛ anwo, na yeazɛkye wɔ agyadeɛ kɔsɔɔti. 15Ɛdawɔ mumua ne noko ɛbanyia ɛkolɛ ewule mɔɔ babɔ wɔ anwonyane mɔɔ anu bayɛ se alehyenlɛ biala la.’ ”
16Na Ɛdɛnkɛma manle Filisitiama nee Arelabema bie mɔɔ dɛnlanle ɛleka mɔɔ zua Sudanema la dwazole Gyɛhɔlam anwo zo. 17Bɛravale Dwuda aze na bɛzoale nuhua ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti mɔɔ bɛ sa hanle bɛ, mɔɔ le belemgbunli sua nu amra ɛdeɛ la bɛhɔle. Bɛhyele ɔ mra mrenya nee ye mraalɛ noko bɛhɔle, na bɛgyakyile ye ralɛ nrenya kazima Ehazaya ala.
18Ɛhye anzi, Ɛdɛnkɛma manle ɛkolɛ ewule mɔɔ awie ɛngola ye ayile yɛ la dɔle ɔ nwo. 19Ɔkadwu ɛvolɛ nwiɔ la, ɛnee akee ewule ne ɛdɛla zolɛ. Ɔ ko manle zo na ɔvale abodelɛ kpole ɔwule. Ye menli ne ambɔ sendɔlɔra anzu ye, kɛmɔ bɛyɛle arelemgbunli mɔɔ lumua la.
