Bɛtelɛhɛm - Ɛya ko abulanwiɔ nee nsa
Nɛtɔfa - Abulanlu nee nsia
Anato - Ɛya ko abulanwiɔ nee mɔtwɛ
Azemeevɛte - Abulanla nee nwiɔ
Keleate Gyealem, Kɛfaela nee Bilotu - Ɛya nsuu abulanla
nee nsa
Releema nee Giba - Ɛya nsia abulanwiɔ nee ko
Mekemahye - Ɛya ko abulanwiɔ nee nwiɔ
Bɛtɛle nee Eyae - Ɛya nwiɔ abulanwiɔ nee nsa
Nibo - Abulanlu nee nwiɔ
Magebehye - Ɛya ko abulanlu nee nsia
Yilam ɛhendeɛ ne - Apenle ko, ɛya nwiɔ abulanlu nee nna
Hɛlem - Ɛya nsa abulanwiɔ
Lɔɔdo, Heedede, yɛɛ Ono - Ɛya nsuu abulanwiɔ nee nnu
Gyɛleko - Ɛya nsa abulanla nee nnu
Sɛnaa - Apenle nsa, ɛya nsia abulasa
36-39Sɛlɛvolɛma mbusua ekpulike ekpulike mɔɔ ziale rale la ɛne:
Gyɛdaya (Gyɛhyua abo zo amra) - Ɛya ngɔnla abulasuu
nee nsa
Yemɛ - Apenle ko, abulanlu nee nwiɔ
Pahyɛ - Apenle ko, ɛya nwiɔ abulanla nee nsuu
Hɛlem - Apenle ko, bulu nee nsuu
40-42Livae mbusua ekpulike ekpulike mɔɔ ziale rale la ɛne:
Gyɛhyua nee Kademeɛle (Hodavaya abo zo amra) - Abulasuu
nee nna
Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua nu edwɛndolɛma (Esafe abo zo amra) -
Ɛya ko abulanwiɔ nee mɔtwɛ
Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne sinzavolɛma (Hyalɛm, Etɛ, Talemɔn,
Akɛbe, Hataeta, yɛɛ Hyobeeyae abo zo amra) -
Ɛya ko abulasa nee ngɔnla
43-54Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua nu sonvolɛma mbusua ekpulike ekpulike mɔɔ ziale rale la ɛne:
Zaeha, Hasufa, Tabeeyo,
Kilɔso, Sayaha, Peedɔn,
Lɛbeena, Hagaba, Akɛbe,
Heegabe, Hyamelae, Heenan,
Gedɛle, Geehaa, Riliaya,
Rilizen, Nɛkoda, Gazam,
Ɛza, Pasia, Bisae,
Asena, Mɛyunem, Nɛfesem,
Bakebɛke, Hakufa, Haahɛ,
Bazelɛte, Mɛhaeda, Haahya,
Baakɔso, Sesɛla, Tima,
Nɛzaya, yɛɛ Hataefa.
55-57Sɔlɔmɔn ngɛkɛlɛ abo zo amra mɔɔ ziale rale la ɛne:
Soteeyae, Hasofɛlɛte, Pɛluda,
Gyeeyala, Daakɔn, Gedɛle,
Hyɛfataya, Hatele, Pokɛlɛte,
Hazɛbayem, yɛɛ Emae.
58Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne sonvolɛma nee Belemgbunli Sɔlɔmɔn sonvolɛma abo zo amra mɔɔ ziale rale la le ɛya nsa abulahɔnla nee nwiɔ.
59-60Menli ɛya nsia abulanlu nee nwiɔ bie mɔɔ le Dɛlaya, Tobaya, yɛɛ Nɛkoda abo zo amra la vi azua Tɛle Mila, Tɛle Hahya, Kilɛbe, Adan, yɛɛ Yemɛ azo ziale rale, noko bɛangola bɛangile kɛ bɛle Yizilayɛma, yɛɛ bɛangola bɛangile Yizilayɛ abusua ekpunli holɛ ko mɔɔ bɛvi nuhua la.
61-62Eza sɛlɛvolɛma mbusua ekpulike ekpulike bie mɔɔ le Habaya, Hakɔzo, yɛɛ Bazeleeyae abo zo amra la rale. (Bazeleeyae Sɛlɛvolɛma abusua ekpulike ne kpanyinli ne gyale Bazeleeyae mɔɔ le Geleadenli la ara raalɛ na ɔlua zolɛ ɔvale ɔ ye ɔ ze ne duma ɔdonle ye abusua ekpulike ne.) Menli ɛhye mɔ nleɛnleanle ngɛlata ne mɔ anu la bɛannwu bɛ mbusua ne mɔ aluma wɔ sɛlɛvolɛma mbusua ekpulike ekpulike ne mɔ anu, na ɔlua zolɛ bɛyele bɛ bɛvile sɛlɛvolɛlilɛ ne anu kɛ bɛle menli mɔɔ anwo ɛnde a. 63 Amɛnlado ne zele bɛ kɛ bɛmmadi aleɛ nwuanzanwuanza ne mɔɔ bɛva bɛbɔ azu bɛmaa Nyamenle la bie kɔkpula mekɛ mɔɔ sɛlɛvolɛ bie ɛva “Yulem” nee “Tɛmem” ɛbiza Nyamenle la.
64-67Menli mɔɔ vi nlɔnu rale la amuala le apenle ngoko abulanla nee nwiɔ, ɛya nsa abulasia.
Mraalɛ nee mrenya sonvolɛma - Apenle nsuu, ɛya nsa abulasa
nee nsuu
Mraalɛ nee mrenya edwɛndolɛma - ɛya nwiɔ
Mgbɔnwɔ - Ɛya nsuu abulasa nee nsia
Mgbɔnwɔndua - Ɛya nwiɔ abulanla nee nnu
Afunlumu - Ɛya nna abulasa nee nnu
Asoaso - Apenle nsia, ɛya nsuu abulanwiɔ
68Mɔɔ nlɔnuma ne mɔ radwule Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anwo wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm la, mbusua mgbanyinli mɔɔ wɔ nu la bie mɔ vale ahunlundwolɛ ahyɛlɛ ninyɛne manle kɛ bɛva bɛzi Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne bieko wɔ ɔ bo zo ne ala. 69Kɛmɔ bɛ anwosesebɛ ne si to kɔ la, bɛvale ezukoa nvutuke mɔɔ bɛsuzu a ɔto tone nu kilo ɛya nnu, dwɛtɛ fufule kilo apenle nwiɔ, ɛya mɔtwɛ, yɛɛ sɛlɛvolɛ adɛladeɛ ɛya ko a bɛmanle a.
70 Akee sɛlɛvolɛma ne, Livaema ne, nee menli ne bie mɔ dɛnlanle Gyɛlusalɛm nee ye namunamu ne mɔ azo. Edwɛndolɛma, Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne sinzavolɛma, nee Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne sonvolɛma ne mɔ hɔle bɛ azua zo, yɛɛ Yizilayɛma mɔɔ hale la bɛdabɛ noko bɛhɔle bɛ azua zo.

Title: ƐZL 3
Content:
Bɛbɔ ɛzonlenlɛ bo bieko
1Mɔɔ Yizilayɛma akee nyianle ɛleka dɛnlanle wɔ bɛ azua ne mɔ azo la, ye siane nsuu ne azo, bɛ muala bɛ nloa yiale Gyɛlusalɛm. 2 Na Gyɛhozadake ara nrenya Dwɔhyua, nee ɔ gɔnwo mɔ sɛlɛvolɛma ne, nee Hyialeteɛle ara Zɛlɛbabɛle nee ye mbusuafoɔ zile Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne azukponle ne bieko, amaa bɛayela nane zolɛ bɛabɔ azu bɛamaa Nyamenle, kɛmɔ bɛhɛlɛ ye wɔ Nyamenle sonla Mosisi Mɛla ne anu la. 3 Ɛnee bɛsulo menli mɔɔ wɔ maanle ne anu la ɛdeɛ, noko bɛzile azukponle ne wɔ ɔ bo zo ne ala. Na bɛyelale nane wɔ zolɛ bɛbɔle azu bɛmanle Ɛdɛnkɛma nwonlomɔ nee nɔsolɛ biala. 4 Akee bɛlile Kpɔda Bo Ɛdɛnlanlɛ Ɛvoyia ne, kɛmɔ bɛhɛlɛ bɛdo ɛkɛ ne la, bɛyelale nane bɛbɔle azu dahuu biala, kɛmɔ ngyehyɛlɛ ne kile la. 5 Eza bɛyelale nane bɛbɔle azu ngakyile ngakyile ne mɔ, Siane Fofolɛ azubɔlɛ nee azu ngakyile mɔɔ ɛha mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛbɔ bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma dahuu la amuala. Eza bɛvale awie biala ɔdaye ye ahunlundwolɛ ahyɛlɛdeɛ mɔɔ ɔvale ɔrale la bɛbɔle azu bɛmanle Ɛdɛnkɛma. 6Kenle ne mɔɔ lumua siane nsuu ne anu la yɛɛ bɛbɔle ɔ bo kɛ bɛbɔ azu ne mɔ bɛamaa Ɛdɛnkɛma a, noko ɛnee bɛtɛwulale Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua mumua ne aze.
Bɛbɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne ɛzilɛ bo bieko
7Akee bɛvale ezukoa bɛmanle menli mɔɔ si sua la nee kapentama, yɛɛ bɛvale aleɛ, nza, nee nwole bɛhɔmanle menli mɔɔ wɔ Saedɛn nee Taya la, amaa bɛava sida mbaka mgbole bɛalua nyevile nye bɛvi Lɛbanɔn bɛara Dwɔpa. Pɛhyea Maanle Maanle Belemgbunli Saelɛse a manle adenle kɛ bɛyɛ ye zɔhane a. 8Menli ne vi nlɔnu rale Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anwo wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm la, ye ɛvolɛ nwiɔ, siane nwiɔ ne azo yɛɛ bɛbɔle sua ne ɛzilɛ bo a. Zɛlɛbabɛle, Dwɔhyua, nee bɛ mediema mɔɔ ɛha la, sɛlɛvolɛma nee Livaema mɔɔ ɛnee bɛ muala bɛhye bɛ bɛhɔ nlɔnu na bɛzia bɛra Gyɛlusalɛm la amuala zɔle nu kɛ bɛsi sua ne. Bɛvale Livaema mɔɔ ɛli ɛvolɛ abulanwiɔ mɔɔ kɔ la kɛ bɛnlea bɛmaa bɛzi Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne. 9Gyɛhu nee ɔ mra nee ɔ mediema, yɛɛ Kademeɛle nee ɔ mra (bɛle Hodavaya abo zo amra) bɔle nu bɛ nee Hɛneedade abo zo amra mɔɔ bɛ muala bɛle Livaema la nleanle Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne mɔɔ bɛlɛsi ye bieko la azo.
10 Mɔɔ menli ne wula sua ne aze la, sɛlɛvolɛma ne wulale bɛ adɛladeɛ na bɛvale bɛ aweɛne ndendenle ne mɔ, yɛɛ Livaema mɔɔ le Esafe abo zo amra la vale sɔnwosɔnwo na bɛyele Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ, kɛmɔ Yizilayɛ Belemgbunli Devidi hyehyɛle la. 11 Bɛdole ayɛlɛyelɛ nee moyɛlɛ edwɛne bɛmanle Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛzele kɛ,
“Ɛdɛnkɛma le kpalɛ,
ye ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne wɔ ɛkɛ maa Yizilayɛma dahuu.”
Menli ne amuala deanle nu yele Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ, ɔboalekɛ bɛbɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne adiabo ɛwulalɛ gyima ne abo. 12Na mɔɔ sɛlɛvolɛ mgbanyinli, Livaema mgbanyinli, nee mbusua mgbanyinli bie mɔ mɔɔ nwunle Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua dɛba ne la nwunle kɛ bɛlɛwula Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne aze bieko la, bɛzunle, bɛyele awolɛ, yɛɛ bie mɔ dɔɔnwo noko anye liele. 13Ɛzunlɛ nee anyelielɛ ɛdeɛdeanlɛ ne bɔle nu mɔɔ ɛnee akee awie ɛngola ɛnnwu ɛdeanlɛ mɔɔ kile ɛzunlɛ anzɛɛ anyelielɛ a, ɔboalekɛ ɛnee menli ne ɛlɛteɛdea di wulupe na bɛ ne pɛ gua.

Title: ƐZL 4
Content:
Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne ɛzilɛ bieko anwo ngyegyelɛ
1Menli mɔɔ ɛngulo Dwudama nee Bɛngyamanema edwɛkɛ la dele kɛ menli mɔɔ bɛhyele bɛ bɛhɔle nlɔnu la ɛzia ɛra na bɛlɛsi Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne. 2 Zɔhane ati bɛhɔle Zɛlɛbabɛle nee mbusua mgbanyinli ne mɔ anwo ɛkɛ ne na bɛhɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛmaa yɛboka bɛ yɛzi Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne, ɔboalekɛ yɛsonle bɛ Nyamenle ne kɛ mɔɔ bɛsonle ye la ala. Eza sumunli kɛ Aselea Maanle Maanle Belemgbunli Yisahadɛn nee yɛ rale ɛke la, mekɛ biala yɛbɔ azu yɛmaa Nyamenle.”
3Na Zɛlɛbabɛle, Dwɔhyua nee Yizilayɛ mbusua mgbanyinli ne mɔ buale bɛ kɛ, “Yɛngyia bɛ moalɛ wɔ yɛ Nyamenle ne Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne ɛzilɛ nu gyima biala anwo. Yɛdayɛ yɛbazi Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne, kɛmɔ Maanle Maanle Belemgbunli Saelɛse ɛze yɛ la.”
4Ɛhye ati menli mɔɔ wɔ maanle ne anu la bɔle ɔ bo kɛ bɛsɛkye Dwudama adwenle, na bɛhanle bɛ ɛzulolɛ mɔɔ ɛnee akee bɛkɔ gyima ne anwo bɔbɔ a bɛsulo. 5Bɛbɔle menli ɛkpa kɛ bɛdendɛ bɛtia bɛ na bɛzɛkye sua ne ɛzilɛ nwo adwenle ne. Bɛyɛle ɛhye, ɔvi Belemgbunli Saelɛse mekɛ zo toonwo ɔradwule Belemgbunli Dalayɛse mekɛ zo.
Gyɛlusalɛm ɛkyekyelɛ bieko anwo ngyegyelɛ
6 Mɔɔ bɛvale Zɛzɛse bɛziele Pɛhyea Maanle Maanle Belemgbunli la, menli mɔɔ wɔ maanle ne anu mɔɔ ɛngulo Dwudama nee Gyɛlusalɛmma edwɛkɛ la hɛlɛle kɛlata hɔdoanle bɛ.
7Eza mɔɔ Belemgbunli Atazɛzɛse ralile ebia ne la, Behyelam, Metelɛdate, Tabiile, nee menli bie mɔɔ bɛ nee bɛ ɛhɔ akpamo la hɛlɛle Yizilayɛma ati kɛlata hɔmanle belemgbunli ne. Bɛhɛlɛle kɛlata ne wɔ Arelam aneɛ nu yɛɛ bɛhilele ɔ bo bɛhilele belemgbunli ne a. 8Amɛnlado Rilihɛm nee maanzinli ne anu kɛlɛhɛlɛvolɛ ne, Hyemehyae, bɛdabɛ noko bɛhɛlɛle Gyɛlusalɛm anwo kɛlata ɛhye bɛhɔmanle Atazɛzɛse kɛ:
9“Yɛdayɛ, Amɛnlado Rilihɛm, Kɛlɛhɛlɛvolɛ Hyemehyae, nee yɛ gɔnwo mɔ ndɛnebuavolɛma, nee arane mbɔlɔba mgbanyinli mɔɔ vi Yilɛke nee Babelɔn, nee Susa mɔɔ wɔ Yilam la, 10nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ Ahyɔbanipa, sonlakpole mɔɔ lɛ duma nee tumi la dule bɛ manle bɛradɛnlanle Samɛlea nee Yufileti afoa nu la a ɛlɛkɛlɛ kɛlata ɛhye a.” 11Edwɛkɛ mɔɔ wɔ kɛlata ne anu la ɛne:
“Yɛlɛ yɛkamaa Maanle Maanle Belemgbunli Atazɛzɛse.
12“Yɛmaa Belemgbunli Atazɛzɛse ade kɛ Dwuuma mɔɔ vi wɔ maanle ɛhendeɛ ne mɔ anu lɔ rale la ɛhɔdɛnla aze wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm na bɛlɛkyekye suakpole zɔhane bieko. Ɛze kɛ menli mɔɔ wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm la ɛngyɛ na ade atua, yɛɛ bɛ ti yɛ se. Kɛkala, asɛɛ bɛwie ye bane ne mɔ boɛ yɛ yɛɛ bɛlɛyɛ ye adiabo ne mɔ boɛ. 13Yɛkulo kɛ belemgbunli te kɛ saa bɛwie suakpole ɛhye kyekye bieko na ye bane ne mɔ tɔ nuhua a, menli mɔɔ wɔ zolɛ la ɛnrɛdua gua nu adwule anzɛɛ adwule biala bieko. Na ɛhye bamaa belemgbunli gya ne adɔ sinli. 14Kɛmɔ yɛwɔ ɛke yɛmaa belemgbunli na yɛnrɛhulo kɛ ɛhye kɛzi la, yɛlɛ nzuzulɛ ɛhye yɛlɛbɛlɛ wɔ kɛ 15ɛmaa bɛnleɛnlea wɔ mgbanyinli ngɛlata ne mɔ anu. Wɔ nuhua, ɛbanwu kɛ suakpole ɛhye azo amra ɛngyɛ na ade atua. Bɛ atuadelɛ ne vi tete, na bɛyɛ ngyegyelɛ dɔɔnwo bɛmaa arelemgbunli nee maanzinli zo neavolɛma. Ɛhye ati yɛɛ bɛzɛkyele suakpole ɛhye a. 16Zɔhane ati Nana, saa ɛmaa adenle ɛmaa bɛkyekye suakpole ɛhye bieko, bɛdie ye bane ne bɛyia a, ɛbalɛ ɛ sa mgbane wɔ Yufileti Adɔleɛ.”
17Belemgbunli ne vale mualɛ ɛhye hɔmanle bɛ:
“Melɛ mekamaa Amɛnlado Rilihɛm, kɛlɛhɛlɛvolɛ Hyemehyae, nee bɛ gɔnwo mɔ mɔɔ wɔ Samɛlea nee Yufileti Adɔleɛ la. Mebiza bɛ ahye.
18“Me sa ɛha kɛlata ne mɔɔ bɛhɛlɛle me la. Bɛgenga, bɛhile ɔ bo bɛhile me.
19“Memaa bɛnleɛnlea ngɛlata mɔɔ wɔ ɛke la anu kpalɛ na menwu kɛ Gyɛlusalɛmma lɛ tetedwɛkɛ mɔɔ kile kɛ bɛmbu arelemgbunli a. Bɛngyɛ na bɛade arelemgbunli nwo atua, yɛɛ mekɛ biala bɛgyegye kpalɛ. 20Ɛnee Gyɛlusalɛm lɛ arelemgbunli anwo ɛzulolɛ mɔɔ anwo yɛ se a, na bɛziele maanle maanle mɔɔ wɔ Azule Yufileti Adɔleɛ afoa nu la amuala. Ɔlua zolɛ bɛmanle menli duale adwule manle bɛ. 21Zɔhane ati yɛ mɛla maa menli zɔhane mɔ ɛgyakyi gyima ne ndɛndɛ zo, yɛɛ eza ɔnle kɛ bɛkyekye suakpole ne bieko kɔkpula kɛ menwɔli mɛla bieko kɛ bɛkyekye suakpole ne la. 22Nea boɛ, mmabu ɛ nye ɛgua edwɛkɛ ɛhye azo. Yɛ ye ndɛndɛ na bɛanyɛ bɛanzɛkye debie.”
23Mɔɔ bɛgengale Belemgbunli Atazɛzɛse kɛlata ne bɛhilele Rilihɛm, Hyemehyae, nee bɛ gɔnwo mɔ ala la, ndɛndɛ ne ala, bɛhɔle Dwuuma mɔɔ wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm la anwo zo na bɛholole bɛ nwo zo bɛmanle bɛgyakyile suakpole ne ɛkyekyelɛ.
Bɛbɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne ɛzilɛ bo bieko
24 Ɛhye ati Nyamenle Sua ne mɔɔ wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm la ɛzilɛ hale ɛkɛ ne toonwo ɔhɔdwule kɛ bɛvale Dalayɛse bɛziele Pɛhyea Maanle Maanle belemgbunli na ye ɛvolɛ nwiɔ ne azo.

Title: ƐZL 5
Content:
1Mekɛ ne anu ɛnee Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma, Hagae nee Zɛkalaya, mɔɔ ɔ ze a le Yido la lua Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne duma nu lɛ Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ ɛlɛmaa Dwuuma mɔɔ wɔ Dwuda nee Gyɛlusalɛm la. 2 Na Hyialeteɛle ara Zɛlɛbabɛle nee Gyɛhozadake ara Dwɔhyua dwazole na bɛbɔle ɔ bo bieko kɛ bɛsi Nyamenle Sua ne wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm. Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma nwiɔ ne boale bɛ.
3Ndɛndɛ ne ala Yufileti Adɔleɛ Amɛnlado Tatenae, nee Hyita Bɔzenae, nee bɛ gɔnwo mɔ arane mbɔlɔba rale Gyɛlusalɛm rabizale bɛ kɛ, “Nwane a manle bɛ adenle kɛ bɛzɔ Nyamenle Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ye ɛzilɛ zo bieko a?” 4Eza bɛbizale bɛ bɛliele menli mɔɔ ɛlɛsi sua ne la kɔsɔɔti aluma. 5Na ɛnee Nyamenle anye wɔ Dwuu mgbanyima ne mɔ anwo zo la ati, bɛandua bɛ kɛ bɛmmasi sua ne. Bɛvale nwolɛ edwɛkɛ bɛhɔmanle Belemgbunli Dalayɛse na bɛyɛle kɛ bɛkendɛ bɛadie nwolɛ mualɛ kolaa na bɛkɛyɛ debie a bɛayɛ. 6Kɛlata mɔɔ Yufileti Adɔleɛ Amɛnlado Tatenae, Hyita Bɔzenae, nee bɛ sa zo arane mbɔlɔba vale hɔmanle Belemgbunli Dalayɛse la, edwɛkɛ mɔɔ wɔ nu la ɛne:
7“Yɛlɛ yɛkamaa Maanle Maanle Belemgbunli Dalayɛse. Wɔ belemgbunlililɛ ɛva anzonudwolɛ ɛrɛla.
8“Yɛmaa belemgbunli ade kɛ yɛhɔle Dwuda maanzinli nu na yɛhɔnwunle kɛ bɛlɛsi Nyamenle bedevinli ne Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne bieko. Menli ne mɔ lɛ awolɛ mgbole a ɛlɛsi a na bɛfa mbaka mgbole bɛwulowula ye bane ne mɔ anu. Menli ne lɛ nrɛlɛbɛ nee adwenle, bɛdo bɛ rɛle aze yɛɛ bɛlɛsi sua ne a, na ɔlɛkɔ zolɛ kpalɛ.
9“Yɛbizale bɛ mgbanyima ne mɔ kɛ bɛhile yɛ ahenle mɔɔ manle bɛ adenle kɛ bɛzi Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne la. 10Eza yɛbizale menli mɔɔ ɛlɛsi sua ne la aluma amaa yɛahɛlɛ menli mɔɔ li bɛ ti la aluma yɛarɛlɛ wɔ.
11“Na bɛbuale yɛ kɛ, ‘Yɛle Nyamenle ne mɔɔ bɔle anwuma nee aze la sonvolɛma. Yɛlɛsi Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ɛhye mɔɔ bɛzile ye mɔmoane la bieko. Ɔle sua mɔɔ Yizilayɛ belemgbunli kpole bie a zile wiele a. 12 Na kɛmɔ yɛ nlenya mɔ hanle Nyamenle mɔɔ wɔ anwuma la ɛya la ati, ɔyele bɛ ɔmanle Kyaledianli Babelonia Belemgbunli Nɛbukadenɛza. Na yemɔ yɛɛ ɔzɛkyele Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ye, na ɔhyele menli ne bie mɔ nuokɛ ɔhɔle Babelonia a. 13 Noko mɔɔ Belemgbunli Saelɛse ralile Babelonia ebia ne la, ɛvolɛ ne ala anu, ɔvale mɛla ɔrale kɛ bɛzi Nyamenle Sua ne bieko. 14Eza ezukoa nvutuke nee dwɛtɛ fufule ahyɛnze mɔɔ Belemgbunli Nɛbukadenɛza rahwenle vile Gyɛlusalɛm Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu hɔle ye belemgbunli sua nu ɛkɛ ne la, Saelɛse hwenle bɛ kɔsɔɔti vile Babelɔn awozonle sua ne anu vindele. Belemgbunli Saelɛse vale ninyɛne zɔhane mɔ manle nrenya bie mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Hyɛhyebazaa mɔɔ ɛnee yeyɛ ye amɛnlado wɔ Dwuda maanzinli nu la, 15na ɔzele ye kɛ, “Die ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ na fa kɔgua Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm, na eza bɛzi Nyamenle Sua ne wɔ ɔ bo zo ne ala.” 16Yemɔti Hyɛhyebazaa zɔhane a rawulale Nyamenle Sua ye aze wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm ɛke a, yɛɛ ɔvi mekɛ zɔhane toonwo mɔɔ yeradwu ɛnɛ la yɛtɛgua zolɛ yɛtɛsi sua ye, yɛtɛnyianle yɛtɛwiele fee.’
17“Ɛhye ati saa ɔyɛ belemgbunli ɛhulolɛ a, ɛnee
ɔmaa bɛnleɛnlea ye ngɛlata ne mɔ mɔɔ wɔ ye ngɛlata ɛzielɛ ɛleka ne mɔ la anu kɛ saa amgba Belemgbunli Saelɛse manle bɛ zɔhane mɛla ne kɛ bɛzi Nyamenle Sua ɛhye mɔɔ wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm ɛke la bieko a. Na akee belemgbunli ɛmaa yɛnwu mɔɔ ɔkulo kɛ yɛyɛ ye wɔ edwɛkɛ ɛhye anwo la.”

Title: ƐZL 6
Content:
Bɛnwu Belemgbunli Saelɛse mɛla ne
1Zɔhane ati Belemgbunli Dalayɛse lile mɛla manle bɛnleɛnleanle ye ngɛlata mɔɔ wɔ ye ngɛlata ɛzielɛ ɛleka ne mɔ mɔɔ wɔ Babelɔn la anu. 2Na bɛnwunle mɛla ne wɔ suakpole ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Ɛkebatana mɔɔ wɔ Midea maanzinli nu la kɛ bɛhɛlɛ ɛhye wɔ nu:
3“Wɔ ɛvolɛ ne ala mɔɔ bɛvale Belemgbunli Saelɛse bɛziele ebia zo la anu, belemgbunli manle bɛvale mɛla ɛhye bɛdole gua. Mɛla ne fane Nyamenle Sua ne mɔɔ wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm la anwo. Ɔse, ‘Bɛzi Nyamenle Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne bieko na ɔyɛ ɛleka mɔɔ ɛkɛ ne a bɛfa azubɔlɛ ninyɛne bɛkɔ, na bɛyela ninyɛne bɛbɔ azu a. Ɔwɔ kɛ ye anwuma ɛhɔlɛ yɛ mita abulanwiɔ nee nsuu yɛɛ ye tɛtɛlɛ noko zɔhane ala. 4Bɛva awolɛ mgbole bɛdo ye fadum ɛhonlone nsa na bɛva mbaka bɛzɔ zolɛ ɛhonlone ko. Nwolɛ kakɛ ne amuala, bɛde bɛvi belemgbunli gya ne anu. 5Akee ninyɛne mɔɔ bɛvale ezukoa nvutuke nee dwɛtɛ fufule a bɛyɛle, mɔɔ Belemgbunli Nɛbukadenɛza yeyele bɛ vile Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm rale Babelɔn la, bɛva bɛ muala bɛhɔzie bɛ bo zo ne mɔ wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm.’ ”
Dalayɛse se bɛhɔ zolɛ bɛzi sua ne
6Na Belemgbunli Dalayɛse vale mualɛ ɛhye hɔmanle bɛ. Ɔse,
“Melɛ mekamaa Yufileti Adɔleɛ Amɛnlado Tatenae, nee Hyita Bɔzenae, nee bɛdabɛ arane mbɔlɔba kɔsɔɔti mɔɔ wɔ maanzinli ne anu la. Bɛhwe bɛ nwo bɛvi Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne ɛzilɛ nwo. 7Bɛmmafa bɛ nwo bɛdielie Nyamenle Sua ɛhye ɛzilɛ nu. Bɛmaa Dwuda amɛnlado ne nee Dwuu mgbanyima ne mɔ ɛzi Nyamenle Sua ɛhye bieko wɔ ɔ bo zo ne ala. 8Akee mɛla mɔɔ mefa meamaa wɔ, mɔɔ fane mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ ɛyɛ ɛmaa Dwuu mgbanyima ne mɔ wɔ Nyamenle Sua ne ɛzilɛ nu la ɛne: Kakɛ mɔɔ menli ne kɛbɔ la, fa belemgbunli gya ne mɔɔ wɔ Yufileti la anu ezukoa tua ye ndɛndɛ, amaa sua ne ɛzilɛ amkpo ɛhɛlɛ. 9Debie biala mɔɔ bɛkpondɛ la, saa nlankɛ nyinli o, mboane o, anzɛɛ mboane mralɛ mɔɔ bɛyela bɛabɔ azu bɛamaa Nyamenle ne mɔɔ wɔ anwuma la o, hwiiti, ngyenle, nwanye, anzɛɛ nwole, kɛmɔ sɛlɛvolɛma mɔɔ wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm la kpondɛ la, fa maa bɛ kenle biala mɔɔ bɛkɛbiza la, mmamaa ɔkpa nwolɛ fee, 10amaa bɛabɔ azu mɔɔ sɔ Nyamenle ne mɔɔ wɔ anwuma la anye na bɛazɛlɛ bɛamaa belemgbunli nee ɔ mra mrenya kpalɛyɛlɛ. 11Akee meli mɛla ɛhye kɛ: Awie biala mɔɔ kɛhakyi mɛla ne mɔɔ meli la, bɛhwe ye sua ne anu mgbunla ne mɔ ko, bɛzinzi ɔ ti na bɛva bɛwɔ ɔ kunlu bɛmaa ɔvinde ɔ nzi, na akee bɛgologolo ye sua ne bɛgua. 12Yɛsɛlɛ kɛ Nyamenle mɔɔ ɔdaye yehyehyɛ kɛ ye duma ɛdɛnla ɛkɛ ne dahuu la, ɛmaa bɛdu belemgbunli anzɛɛ bɛhu maanlema mɔɔ kɛdwazo kɛ bɛsɛkye mɛla ɛhye, anzɛɛ bɛsɛkye Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne mɔɔ wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm la. Medame Dalayɛse a meyɛ mɛla ɛhye a. Bɛmaa awie biala ɛli zolɛ kpalɛ.”
Bɛdu Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne bɛwula Nyamenle asa anu
13Akee ɔlua Belemgbunli Dalayɛse mɛla ɛhye mɔɔ ɔvale ɔhɔmanle bɛ la ati, Amɛnlado Tatenae mɔɔ nea Yufileti Adɔleɛ maanzinli zo, nee Hyita Bɔzenae, nee bɛ gɔnwo mɔ arane mbɔlɔba lile mɛla ne azo kpalɛ na bɛyɛle mɔɔ belemgbunli ne kpondɛ kɛ bɛyɛ la. 14 Zɔhane ati Dwuu mgbanyima ne mɔ hɔle sua ne ɛzilɛ zo na bɛhɔle bɛ nyunlu kpalɛ. Mekɛ ne anu ɛnee Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma, Hagae nee Yido ara Zɛkalaya a ka Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ ne kile bɛ a. Bɛwiele Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne si, kɛmɔ Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne hyehyɛle la nee mɛla mɔɔ Pɛhyea Maanle Maanle arelemgbunli nsa ne, Saelɛse, Dalayɛse, nee Atazɛzɛse lile la se la. 15Bɛwiele Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne si wɔ siane ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Eda la anu, ye kenle nsa ne azo wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee Belemgbunli Dalayɛse ɛli ɛvolɛ nsia wɔ Pɛhyea ebia ne azo la. 16Na menli mɔɔ wɔ Yizilayɛ la, sɛlɛvolɛma, Livaema, nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛhyele bɛ nuokɛ bɛhɔle nlɔnu na bɛzia bɛra la vale anyelielɛ bukele Nyamenle Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne na bɛdule bɛwulale Nyamenle asa anu. 17Wɔ sua ne ɛbukelɛ nee ye ɛdulɛ mɔɔ bɛtu bɛawula Nyamenle asa anu la, bɛvale nlankɛ nyinli ɛya ko, mboane nyinli ɛya nwiɔ, yɛɛ mboane mralɛ ɛya nna a bɛbɔle azu bɛmanle Nyamenle a. Akee bɛvale mbɔnkye nyinli bulu nee nwiɔ bɛbɔle ɛtanefakyɛ azu bɛmanle Nyamenle wɔ Yizilayɛma amuala ati. Bɛbɔle abusua ekpunli ko biala ati bɛvale abɔnkye ko bɛbɔle azu. 18Akee bɛhyɛle sɛlɛvolɛma gyima ne bɛmanle bɛ. Bɛhyɛle bɛ nu ekpunli ekpunli. Bɛyɛle Livaema noko zɔhane ala, kɛmɔ bɛhɛlɛ ye wɔ Mosisi buluku ne anu mɔɔ fane Nyamenle ɛzonlenlɛ gyima ne mɔɔ wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm la anwo la.
Akpabɛnwo Ɛvoyia ne
19 Siane ne mɔɔ lumua la anu kenle mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ bulu nee nna la, bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛhyele bɛ nuokɛ bɛhɔle nlɔnu na bɛzia bɛra la lile Akpabɛnwo Ɛvoyia ne. 20Sɛlɛvolɛma nee Livaema mɔɔ wɔ nu la nluanle bɛ nwo na bɛyɛle menli mɔɔ nyamenlezonlenlɛ nu bɛ nwo ɛde a. Livaema ne a hunle Akpabɛnwo Ɛvoyia Boaneralɛ ne a, bɛbɔle azu ne wɔ bɛdabɛ mumua ne bɛ ti, bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛvi nlɔnu bɛra la ati, yɛɛ bɛ mediema sɛlɛvolɛma ne mɔ amuala ati. 21Na Yizilayɛma mɔɔ vi nlɔnu rale la nee Yizilayɛma mɔɔ wɔ maanle ne anu na bɛde bɛ nwo bɛvi bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la ɛzonlenlɛ ɛtane ɛtane nwo na bɛra bɛbazonle Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne la, lile Akpabɛnwo aleɛ ne bie. 22Bɛvale fɛlɛkolilɛ bɛlile Angye Ɛvoyia ne toonwo kenle nsuu. Bɛ nye liele, ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛmaa Aselea belemgbunli ne ɛhakyi ye nyɛleɛ na yeboa bɛ yemaa bɛzi Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne.

Title: ƐZL 7
Content:
Ɛzela ba Gyɛlusalɛm
1Ɛvolɛ dɔɔnwo anzi, wɔ Pɛhyea Belemgbunli Atazɛzɛse mekɛ zo, ɛnee nrenya bie wɔ Babelonia, bɛfɛlɛ ye Ɛzela. Ɛzela ɔ ze a le Sɛlaya, Sɛlaya ɔ ze a le Azalaya, Azalaya ɔ ze a le Helekaya, 2Helekaya ɔ ze a le Hyalɛm, Hyalɛm ɔ ze a le Zeedɔko, Zeedɔko ɔ ze a le Ahaetɛbe, 3Ahaetɛbe ɔ ze a le Amalaya, Amalaya ɔ ze a le Azalaya, Azalaya ɔ ze a le Mɛlayo, 4Mɛlayo ɔ ze a le Zɛlahaya, Zɛlahaya ɔ ze a le Ɛzae, Ɛzae ɔ ze a le Bɛkae, 5Bɛkae ɔ ze a le Abaehyua, Abaehyua ɔ ze a le Fenɛhase, yɛɛ Fenɛhase ɔ ze a le Ɛlieza, Ɛlieza ɔ ze a le Sɛlɛvolɛma Kpanyinli Aalɔn.
6-7Ɛzela le abɔlɔba mɔɔ ze Mɛla ne mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne vale manle Mosisi la kpole kpalɛ. Kɛmɔ ɛnee Ɛdɛnkɛma ye Nyamenle ne anye wɔ ɔ nwo zo la ati, belemgbunli ne vale debie biala mɔɔ ɔbizale la ɔmanle ye. Mɔɔ Belemgbunli Atazɛzɛse lile ɛvolɛ nsuu wɔ Pɛhyea ebia ne azo la, Ɛzela nee Yizilayɛma bie mɔ mɔɔ le sɛlɛvolɛma, Livaema, edwɛndolɛma, nee Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua nu sonvolɛma la zile nu vi Babelonia rale Gyɛlusalɛm. 8-9Bɛvi Babelonia bɛdule bɛ bo wɔ siane ne mɔɔ lumua la anu kenle ne mɔɔ lumua la azo, na Nyamenle duma nu nee ye moalɛ zo, bɛradwule Gyɛlusalɛm siane nnu ne anu, ye kenle ne mɔɔ lumua la azo. 10Ɛzela ɛnee ɛdu ɔ nwo ɛmaa na yeva ye mekɛ kɔsɔɔti yezukoa Ɛdɛnkɛma Mɛla ne mɔɔ yeva yemaa Yizilayɛma la kpalɛ, na yevua kɛ ɔdi zolɛ na yeahilehile Yizilayɛma noko.
Kɛlata mɔɔ Belemgbunli Atazɛzɛse vale manle Ɛzela la
11Ɛzela le sɛlɛvolɛ nee kɛlɛhɛlɛvolɛ mɔɔ ɛbe Ɛdɛnkɛma Mɛla ne anu a. Kɛlata mɔɔ Belemgbunli Atazɛzɛse hɛlɛle manle ye la ɛne:
12“Medame, Maanle Maanle Belemgbunli Atazɛzɛse a melɛkɛlɛ kɛlata ɛhye meamaa sɛlɛvolɛ Ɛzela mɔɔ le Anwuma Nyamenle ne Mɛla ne kɛlɛhɛlɛvolɛ la a.
13“Kɛkala, meyɛ ye mɛla kɛ Yizilayɛnli biala mɔɔ wɔ me maanle ye anu la, sɛlɛvolɛma anzɛɛ Livaema, mɔɔ kulo kɛ ɔsia ɔkɔ Gyɛlusalɛm la nee wɔ ɛhɔ. 14Belemgbunli nee ye mgbanyima nsuu ne mɔɔ tu ye folɛ la yɛɛ ɛzoa wɔ kɛ ɛhɔ Dwuda nee Gyɛlusalɛm ɛhɔnleɛnlea menli ne ɛbɛlabɔlɛ nu kɛ bɛlɛdi Nyamenle, wɔ Nyamenle ne Mɛla ne mɔɔ ɛlɛ la azo a. 15Eza fa dwɛtɛ fufule ne nee ezukoa nvutuke ne mɔɔ belemgbunli nee ye mgbanyima mɔɔ tu ye folɛ la ɛyeye bɛ ahonle nu ɛva ɛmaa kɛ bɛva bɛbɔ azu bɛmaa Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne mɔɔ ye Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua a wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm la noko kɔ. 16Akee fa ezukoa nvutuke nee dwɛtɛ fufule biala mɔɔ ɛkɛnyia ye wɔ Babelonia nee azubɔdeɛ biala mɔɔ Yizilayɛma nee bɛ sɛlɛvolɛma ne ɛbɔ bɛ Nyamenle ne mɔɔ wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm la Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne ati ɛyeye bɛ ahonle nu ɛva ɛmaa la amuala kɔ.
17“Saa ɛ sa ka ezukoa ɛhye a, nea na fa tɔ nlankɛ nyinli, mboane nyinli, nee mboane mralɛ, abɛlɛ nee nwanye, na fa bɛ muala bɔ azu wɔ Nyamenle ne mɔɔ wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm la Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu azukponle ne azo. 18Bɛyɛ ɛhye bɛwie a, akee ɛ nee ɛ mediema Dwuuma ne mɔ bɛyɛ mɔɔ bɛdabɛ bɛnea a ɔle kpalɛ la, kɛmɔ bɛ Nyamenle ne ɛhulolɛdeɛ de la. 19Ninyɛne mɔɔ le kɛ ahyɛnze mɔɔ bɛva bɛwula ɛ sa nu kɛ bɛva bɛhɔzonle wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu la, ye bɛ muala kɔsɔɔti maa Nyamenle ne mɔɔ wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm la. 20Akee debie biala mɔɔ ɛkɛhyia nwolɛ wɔ wɔ Nyamenle ne Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anwo mɔɔ hyia kɛ ɛkɔtɔ la, die ezukoa fi belemgbunli gya ne anu na fa kɔdɔ.
21“Akee medame, Belemgbunli Atazɛzɛse, meyɛ mɛla ɛhye na mese me gya sievolɛma mɔɔ wɔ Yufileti Adɔleɛ la amuala kɛ: Debie biala mɔɔ sɛlɛvolɛ Ɛzela, mɔɔ le Nyamenle ne mɔɔ wɔ anwuma la Mɛla kɛlɛhɛlɛvolɛ ne kɛbiza bɛ la, bɛnlea na bɛyɛ ye gyɛlɛɛnye bɛmaa ye. 22Bɛmaa ye bolɛ ɛdwu dwɛtɛ fufule mɔɔ ye ɛnlomboɛ to tone nu kilo apenle nsa, ɛya nna la, abɛlɛ mɔɔ ɛsuzu a ɔto kilo apenle bulu, nwanye litili apenle nwiɔ, nwole litili apenle nwiɔ, yɛɛ ngyenle dɔɔnwo biala mɔɔ bɛkɛhyia nwolɛ la. 23Debie biala mɔɔ Anwuma Nyamenle ne kɛhile kɛ bɛyɛ wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anwo la, bɛnlea bɛmaa bɛyɛ, amaa Nyamenle anva me nee me bo zo amra mɔɔ bali belemgbunli la anwo ɛya. 24Eza bɛnwu ye kɛ ɔnle kɛ bɛdie sɛlɛvolɛma, Livaema, edwɛndolɛma, sinzavolɛma, nee gyimayɛvoma mɔɔ wɔ Nyamenle Sua ne anwo la adwule biala.
25“Na wɔmɔ Ɛzela, dua Nyamenle nrɛlɛbɛ ne mɔɔ yeva yemaa wɔ la azo ye menli mɔɔ ze wɔ Nyamenle ne Mɛla ne la, yɛ bɛ edwɛkɛdivolɛma nee ndɛnebuavolɛma maa bɛnlea bɛmaa pɛlepɛle ɛrɛla menli mɔɔ wɔ Yufileti Adɔleɛ la avinli. Na kilehile bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnze mɛla ne la amuala. 26Awie biala mɔɔ anli wɔ Nyamenle ne mɛla zo anzɛɛ anli belemgbunli ne mɛla zo la, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛbua ye ewule fɔlɛ anzɛɛ bɛtu ye bɛfi maanle ne anu, anzɛɛ bɛsa ye bɛdie ɔ nwo ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti, anzɛɛ bɛto ye efiade.”
Ɛzela ye Nyamenle ayɛlɛ
27Na Ɛzela zele kɛ, “Ayɛlɛyelɛ ɛha Ɛdɛnkɛma, yɛ nlenya mɔ Nyamenle ne. Yemaa Maanle Maanle Belemgbunli ne ahonle kpalɛ kɛ ɔli Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne mɔɔ wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm la eni wɔ adenle zɛhae anu. 28Ɔlua Nyamenle ɛlolɛ zo, menyia me nyunlu wɔ belemgbunli nee ye mgbanyima mɔɔ tu ye folɛ la, yɛɛ ye mbɔlɔba mgbole ne mɔ anyunlu. Ɛdɛnkɛma me Nyamenle ne ɛmaa me anwosesebɛ, na ɔlua zolɛ medame noko menzile ahonle na memboɔboale Yizilayɛ mbusua mgbanyinli ne bie mɔ anloa na me nee bɛ ziale rale.”

Title: ƐZL 8
Content:
Menli mɔɔ vi nlɔnu ziale rale la
1Mbusua mgbanyinli mɔɔ ɛnee wɔ nlɔnu wɔ Babelonia mɔɔ nee me ziale rale Gyɛlusalɛm wɔ Belemgbunli Atazɛzɛse mekɛ zo la aluma ɛne:
2-14Fenɛhase abusua kpanyinli ne a le Gɛhyɔn
Yetama abusua kpanyinli ne a le Daneɛle
Devidi abusua kpanyinli ne a le Hyɛkanaya ara nrenya Hatɛhye.
Pɛlɔhye abusua kpanyinli ne a le Zɛkalaya, ɔlɛ
mrenya ɛya ko abulanlu mɔɔ bɛ aluma wɔ ngɛlata zo a
Peehate Mowabe abusua kpanyinli ne a le Zɛlahaya ara
Ɛleɛhoyinae, ɔlɛ mrenya ɛya nwiɔ
Zatu abusua kpanyinli ne a le Gyaheezeɛle ara
Hyɛkanaya, ɔlɛ mrenya ɛya nsa
Eden abusua kpanyinli ne a le Dwɔnatan ara Yibɛde,
ɔlɛ mrenya abulanlu
Yilam abusua kpanyinli ne a le Atalaya ara Gyɛhyaya,
ɔlɛ mrenya abulasuu
Hyɛfataya abusua kpanyinli ne a le Maekeɛle ara
Zɛbadaya, ɔlɛ mrenya abulatwɛ
Dwowabe abusua kpanyinli ne a le Gyɛhayɛle ara Obadaya,
ɔlɛ mrenya ɛya nwiɔ bulu nee mɔtwɛ
Beenae abusua kpanyinli ne a le Dwɔsefaya ara Hyɛlomete,
ɔlɛ mrenya ɛya ko abulasia
Bibeyae abusua kpanyinli ne a le Bibeyae ara Zɛkalaya,
ɔlɛ mrenya abulanwiɔ nee mɔtwɛ
Azegade abusua kpanyinli ne a le Hakatan ara Dwoheenan,
ɔlɛ mrenya ɛya ko nee bulu
Yilefɛlɛte, Gyɛyuwɛle, yɛɛ Hyɛmaya mɔɔ vi Adonaekam
abusua nu la bɛdabɛ bɛrale. Bɛlɛ mrenya abulasia
(nzinlii a bɛmɛ bɛrale a)
Yutae nee Zakɛ mɔɔ vi Begeveeyae abusua nu la noko
rale. Bɛ nee mrenya abulasuu a rale a.
Ɛzela kpondɛ Livaema yeamaa bɛanlea Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne
15Memboɔboale menli ne amuala anloa wɔ azule ne mɔɔ bɛdukue ye na ɔse ɔkɔ Aheeva sua zo la anloa, na yɛdɛnlanle ɛkɛ ne kenle nsa. Meneɛnleanle menli ne mɔ nee sɛlɛvolɛma ne mɔ anu la, menwunle kɛ Livaenli biala ɛnle nu. 16Zɔhane ati menvɛlɛle mgbanyima ngɔnla nee kilehilevolɛma nwiɔ. Mgbanyima ne mɔ a le Ɛlieza, Ɛleɛle, Hyɛmaya, Ɛleneetan, Gyɛlebe, Ɛleneetan, Neetan, Zɛkalaya, yɛɛ Mehyɛlam; menli ɛhye mɔ le mbusua mgbanyinli. Akee menvɛlɛle Dwɔyalebe nee Ɛleneetan kɛ bɛle kilehilevolɛma. 17Menzoanle bɛ wɔ Kasefaya wɔ Dwuuma kpanyinli ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Yedo la ɛkɛ ne. Menvale nrɛlaleɛ memanle bɛ kɛ bɛva bɛhɔmaa Yedo nee ɔ gɔnwo mɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne sonvolɛma ne kɛ bɛva sɛlɛvolɛma mɔɔ yɛ gyima wɔ yɛ Nyamenle ne Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu la bɛraboka yɛ nwo. 18Na ɔlua Nyamenle ɛlolɛ zo, bɛvale Hyɛlibaya, mɔɔ le Livae ara Malae abusua nu amra ne bie, mɔɔ lɛ adwenle na ɔle Yizilayɛnli tɛnyetɛnye la, yɛɛ ɔ mra nee ɔ mediema ne mɔ bɛrɛlɛle yɛ, bɛlua bulu nee mɔtwɛ. 19Eza bɛvale Hahyabaya nee Gyɛhyaya mɔɔ vi Mɛlɛlae abusua nu la, nee bɛ mediema nee bɛ nwo amra mɔɔ dwu abulanwiɔ la bɛrɛlɛle yɛ. 20Bɛ nee menli ɛya nwiɔ abulanwiɔ mɔɔ le Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua nu sonvolɛma la noko rale. Menli ɛhye mɔ, Belemgbunli Devidi nee ye mgbanyima a yele bɛ ziele ɛkɛ kɛ bɛboa Livaema a. Bɛhɛlɛle menli ɛhye mɔ aluma wɔ buluku nu.
Ɛzela di menli ne ati yeamaa bɛahye ɛhɔne, bɛazɛlɛ
21Aheeva azule ne anloa yɛɛ mengyehyɛle kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ yɛ muala yɛkye ɛhɔne na yɛbɛlɛ yɛ nwo aze wɔ yɛ Nyamenle ne anyunlu na yɛsɛlɛ ye kɛ ɔnlea yɛ, yɛ mra nee yɛ nwo ninyɛne zo na ɔzinza yɛ wɔ yɛ adendulɛ nu a. 22Ɔyɛle me nyiane kɛ kpɔvolɛ ti menwɔbiza belemgbunli kɛ ɔmaa ɛlɔnema ɛzinza yɛ wɔ adenle nu a, ɔluakɛ ɛnee meha mehile ye kɛ Nyamenle yila awie biala mɔɔ fa ɔ rɛle wula ye nu la. Ɔ nye ɛnlie bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛmbu ye la anwo, na ɔtea bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkakyi bɛ nzi bɛsi ye la. 23Ɛhye ati yɛhyele ɛhɔne yɛvale yɛ nzɛlɛlɛ yɛdole Nyamenle anyunlu, na ɔdiele yɛ nzɛlɛlɛ.
Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne ahyɛlɛ ninyɛne
24Akee menyele sɛlɛvolɛ mgbanyinli bulu nee nwiɔ. Bɛmɛ a le Hyɛlibaya nee Hahyabaya, nee bɛ nwo amra bulu. 25Menzuzule dwɛtɛ fufule, ezukoa nvutuke, nee azubɔlɛ ninyɛne mɔɔ Nyamenle Sua ne ati belemgbunli, ye mgbanyima mɔɔ tu ye folɛ, nee ye mbɔlɔba, nee Yizilayɛma mɔɔ wɔ maanle ne anu la ɛva ɛmaa la amuala memanle bɛ. 26-27Ninyɛne mɔɔ menzuzule memanle bɛ la ɛne:
dwɛtɛ fufule - Tɔno abulanwiɔ nee nwiɔ
dwɛtɛ fufule ahyɛnze ɛya ko - kilo abulasuu
ezukoa nvutuke - Kilo apenle nsa, ɛya nna
ezukoa nvutuke ahyɛnze akunlu kuloonwu abulanwiɔ-Kilo
mɔtwɛ nee foa ko
kɔbele ahyɛnze akunlu kuloonwu nwiɔ mɔɔ bɛhwi
nwolɛ bɛmaa bɛ kɛnlɛma ɛyɛ kɛ ezukoa nvutuke la
28Menganle mengilele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛ nwo te wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu, yɛɛ ninyɛne ne mɔ noko anwo te. Dwɛtɛ fufule ne nee ezukoa nvutuke ne le azubɔlɛ ninyɛne mɔɔ bɛfa bɛahɔbɔ azu bɛamaa Ɛdɛnkɛma, bɛ ze mɔ Nyamenle ne a. 29Bɛnlea bɛ boɛ kpalɛ kpalɛ kɔkpula kɛ bɛkɛzuzu bɛ pɛpɛ pɛpɛ wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Sua ne anu wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm bɛkɛmaa sɛlɛvolɛ mgbanyinli, Livaema, nee Yizilayɛma mbusua mgbanyinli ne mɔ la.” 30Na sɛlɛvolɛma ne nee Livaema ne liele dwɛtɛ fufule ne, ezukoa nvutuke ne, nee ninyɛne ne mɔ kɛ bɛfa bɛahɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm.
Bɛsia bɛara Gyɛlusalɛm
31Siane ne mɔɔ lumua la anu kenle bulu nee nwiɔ ne azo yɛɛ yɛvi Aheeva azokoɛleɛ ne yɛzile nu kɛ yɛkɔ Gyɛlusalɛm a. Yɛ Nyamenle ne lole yɛ na ɔzinzale yɛ, ɔbɔle yɛ nwo bane wɔ yɛ adendulɛ nu, na ɔliele yɛ ɔvile yɛ agbɔvolɛ nee nwule sa nu. 32Yemɔti yɛhɔdwule Gyɛlusalɛm na yɛliele yɛ ɛnwomenle kenle nsa. 33Ye kenle nna ne azo yɛzuzule dwɛtɛ fufule ne, ezukoa nvutuke ne, nee ninyɛne ne mɔ yɛwulale sɛlɛvolɛ Mɛlɛmo, mɔɔ le Yulaya ara ne asa anu wɔ Nyamenle Sua ne anu. Fenɛhase ara Ɛlieza yɛɛ Livaema nwiɔ, Gyɛhyua ara Dwozabade nee Benuwae ara Nowadaya wɔ ɛkɛ ne bie. 34Bɛdianle na bɛzuzule debie biala na bɛhɛlɛle debie biala wɔ buluku nu wɔ mekɛ ne anu ala.
35Akee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛhyele bɛ nuokɛ bɛhɔle nlɔnu na bɛzia bɛra la vale azubɔlɛ ninyɛne rale kɛ bɛyela bɛ bɛbɔ azu bɛmaa Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne. Bɛbɔle Yizilayɛma kɔsɔɔti ati bɛvale nlankɛ bulu nee nwiɔ, mboane nyinli abulahɔnla nee nsia, mboane mralɛ abulasuu nee nsuu, yɛɛ ɛtanefakyɛ nwo azubɔlɛ mbɔnkye nyinli bulu nee nwiɔ. Bɛyelale nane ɛhye mɔ amuala bɛbɔle azu bɛmanle Ɛdɛnkɛma. 36Eza bɛvale belemgbunli kɛlata ne mɔɔ ɔvale ɔmanle bɛ la bɛmanle mbɔlɔba mgbanyinli nee amɛnladoma mɔɔ nea maanzinli ne mɔ azo wɔ Azule Yufileti Adɔleɛ la. Bɛdabɛ noko bɛboale Yizilayɛma ne mɔ wɔ Nyamenle Sua ne ɛzilɛ nu.

Title: ƐZL 9
Content:
Ɛzela te kɛ Dwuuma bie mɔ ɛgya menli mɔɔ ɛnle Dwuuma la bie mɔ
1Yɛyɛle ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ yɛwiele la, Yizilayɛ mgbanyima ne bie mɔ rale me nwo ɛkɛ ne razele me kɛ Yizilayɛma, sɛlɛvolɛma, nee Livaema bie mɔ ɛtɛtwenle bɛ nwo ɛtɛfile menli mɔɔ wɔ azɛlɛ ne azo la munzule ɛbɛla ne mɔ anwo. Menli ɛhye mɔ a le Keenama, Hɛtema, Pɛlɛzema, Gyibɛsema, Amɔnoma, Mowabema, Yigyibitima, yɛɛ Amɔlema. 2Dwuuma bie mɔ ɛgya azɛlɛ ne azo amra bie mɔ amra mraalɛ na bɛmaa bɛ mra mrenya noko ɛgya bɛ mra mraalɛ, ɔlua zolɛ yemaa menli nwuanzanwuanza ɛhye mɔ nee azɛlɛ ne azo amra ɛli afonla. Nyɛleɛ ɛtane zɛhae, mbusua mgbanyinli ne mɔ nee mbɔlɔba ne mɔ bɔbɔ a yɛle ye kpalɛ a. 3Mendele ɛhye na ɛya mɔɔ hunle me nee me nwo mɔɔ yelɛyelale me la manle mensuosuanle me tɛladeɛ mɔɔ mewula la anu na mendudule me ti nee me kɛsa enrinli. Nyane nee arɛlebɔlɛ wiele me kyekye na mendɛnlanle aze koonwu. 4Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ ahonle dule wɔ Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ ɛha wɔ ninyɛndane ɛhye mɔ mɔɔ menli mɔɔ vi nlɔnu ɛra la ɛyɛ la anwo la bɔle yiale me, na yɛ muala yɛdɛnlanle ɛkɛ ne toonwo ɔhɔdwule nɔsolɛ azubɔlɛ mekɛ ne.
5Ɔdwule nɔsolɛ azubɔlɛ mekɛ ne la, menvile ɛleka mɔɔ ɛnee mede melɛkye ɛhɔne ne la mendwazole, menvale me tɛladeɛ suosuanlera ne ala mengotole, mendɛlɛle me sa nu na menzɛlɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma me Nyamenle ne kɛ, 6“O me Nyamenle, ɔyɛ me anyiemgba na ɔyɛ me nyiane bɔbɔ kɛ menwɔkpogya me nye zo menwɔnlea wɔ a, ɔluakɛ yɛ amumuyɛ ɛbɛla ne ɛbo zolɛ na yɛ ɛtane ne mɔ ɛdwu ɛ nyunlu. 7Ɔvi yɛ nlenya mɔ mekɛ zo toonwo mɔɔ ɛradwu ɛnɛ la, yɛvo dɔɔnwo kpalɛ. Ɔlua yɛ ɛtane ne mɔ ati, yɛdayɛ o, yɛ arelemgbunli, nee yɛ sɛlɛvolɛma o, yɛ muala yɛdɔ donvula wɔ arelemgbunli mɔɔ ɛbɔ ɛyia yɛ la asa anu. Ɔlua zolɛ bɛhu yɛ bie mɔ, bɛkpokpo yɛ, bɛhye yɛ bie mɔ nuokɛ bɛhɔ nlɔnu, bɛhile yɛ nyane, bɛgua yɛ nyunlu aze toonwo a yeradwu ɛnɛ a. 8Noko Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛ Nyamenle, wɔ mekɛ ekyi ye anu, wɔlo yɛ na wɔmaa yɛ bie mɔ ɛvi akɛlɛzonlenlɛ nu kɛ bɛradɛnla anzonudwolɛ nu wɔ ɛleka nwuanzanwuanza ɛhye. Wɔ yɛ akɛlɛzonlenlɛ nu, ɛmanle yɛ nwo kpundinle yɛ, amaa yɛabɔ ɛbɛla kpalɛ. 9Mɔɔ ɛnee yɛle ahanra la, yɛ Nyamenle ne arɛle amkpa yɛ nwo zo. Wɔmaa wɔ ɛhulolɛ ɛdenrɛ yɛ nwo zo wɔ Pɛhyea Maanle Maanle arelemgbunli anyunlu. Ɔlua zolɛ bɛbɔ yɛ ɛwɔkɛ na bɛmaa yɛ anwosesebɛ kɛ yɛzi yɛ Nyamenle ne Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne mɔɔ ɛbubu la, na yɛyɛ ye boɛ, na wɔazinza yɛ wɔ Dwuda nee Gyɛlusalɛm amuala.
10“Na kɛkala, O Nyamenle, duzu edwɛkɛ bɔbɔ yɛɛ akee yɛha wɔ ɛhye mɔ amuala anzi a? Yɛtietia wɔ mɛla ne mɔ mɔɔ 11ɛluale wɔ ngɛkɛlɛ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma anwo zo ɛvale ɛmanle yɛ kɛ, ‘Azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ bɛlɛkɔ bɛahɔva la le azɛlɛ mɔɔ menli mɔɔ wɔ zolɛ la ɛva munzule ɛbɛla ɛzɛkye ye, ɔvi ɔ ti yehɔdwu ɔ bo a. 12 Zɔhane ati bɛmmamaa bɛ mra mrenya gya ɛkɛ ne mbɛlɛra ne mɔ bie, yɛɛ bɛmmamaa bɛ mra mraalɛ gya ɛkɛ ne mgbavolɛ ne mɔ bie. Bɛmmakpondɛ bɛ nee anzonudwolɛ anzɛɛ ɛkpazilɛ, amaa bɛdabɛ Yizilayɛma bɛ nwo ayɛ se bɛadidi azɛlɛ ne azo na bɛagyakyi bɛazie bɛ mra nee bɛ nlɔnra wɔ mekɛ biala.’ 13Ndeanlɛ biala mɔɔ wɔva wɔdea yɛ nee debie biala mɔɔ ɛzi yɛ nwo zo wɔ yɛ ɛtane nee yɛ amumuyɛ ne mɔ ati la le ekyi, ɛhye ati yɛɛ kɛkala yɛdayɛ mɔɔ yɛha la yɛtɛte aze a. 14Saa ye zɛhae a ɛnee yɛbulu wɔ mɛla ne azo bieko na yɛsia yɛ nee amumuyɛma ɛhye mɔ gyigya yɛ nwo a ɔnrɛyɛ boɛ. Yɛyɛ ye zɔhane a ɛbava ɛya kpole na wɔazɛkye yɛ mɔɔ yɛ nuhua ko bɔbɔ ɛnrɛha a. 15O Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle, wɔmɔ ɛdi pɛlepɛle, noko wɔnwu yɛ anwunvɔne wɔva yɛ ɛtane ne mɔ wɔhyɛ yɛ wɔmaa yɛdayɛ ekyi mɔɔ yɛha la yɛtɛte ngoane nu. Yɛka yɛto gua kɛ yɛdi fɔlɛ na yɛnfɛta ɛ nyunlu.”

Title: ƐZL 10
Content:
Maanle gyɛne nu agyalɛ ɛdualɛ nwo ngyehyɛlɛ
1Mekɛ mɔɔ Ɛzela ɛlɛyɛ nzɛlɛlɛ ne na ɔlɛ ɛzunlɛ ɔlɛka ɛtane mɔɔ bɛyɛ, ɔweweɛ ɔ nwo aze wɔ Nyamenle Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anyunlu ɛkɛ ne la, Yizilayɛma dɔɔnwo kpalɛ, mraalɛ nee mrenya, nee ngakula, rabɔle yiale ye, na bɛdabɛ noko bɛzunle bɛmanle ɔyɛle alɔbɔlɛ. 2Na Gyɛhayɛle mɔɔ le Yilam asa azo ne mɔ ko la ara Hyɛkanaya zele Ɛzela kɛ, “Yɛyɛ ɛtane yɛtia Nyamenle kɛ yɛgya nyɛvolɛ anzɛɛ azɛlɛ ye azo mraalɛ ne bie mɔ a, noko Yizilayɛma lɛ anyelazo. 3Zɔhane ati bɛmaa yɛvua yɛhile yɛ Nyamenle ne na yɛbɔ mraalɛ ɛhye mɔ ewole na yɛvoa bɛ mra ne mɔ, na yɛlua Nyamenle mɛla ne azo yɛyɛ mɔɔ ɛdawɔ nee menli mɔɔ sulo yɛ Nyamenle ne la kɛha la. 4Dwazo na gyima ne le wɔ gyima. Yɛgyi ɛ nzi, yemɔti si wɔ ahonle yɛ.”
5Na Ɛzela dwazole na ɔmanle sɛlɛvolɛ mgbanyima, Livaema, nee Yizilayɛma ne mɔ hanle ndane kɛ bɛkɛyɛ mɔɔ Hyɛkanaya ɛzuzu la. 6Akee Ɛzela vile Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anyunlu na ɔhɔle Yilayahyebe ara Gyihoheenan sua nu. Ɔlale ɛkɛ ne kenle ko ne nɔe ne, noko yeanli debie yɛɛ yeanno nzule. Ɔluakɛ ɛnee ɔlɛdi nyane wɔ nyɛleɛ ɛtane ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛhyele bɛ nuokɛ bɛhɔle nlɔnu la yɛle la anwo.
7-8Bɛbɔle nolo wɔ Dwuda maanle ne anu amuala nee Gyɛlusalɛm kɛ mgbanyima ne mɔ ɛmaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛhyele bɛ nuokɛ bɛhɔle nlɔnu mɔɔ bɛzia bɛra la kenle nsa kɛ bɛrayia Gyɛlusalɛm. Awie biala mɔɔ kenle nsa ne azo yeamba la, mgbanyima ne mɔ ɛmaa bɛza ye bɛlie ɔ nwo ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti, na bɛdua ye wɔ maanlema avinli. 9Na bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ Dwuda nee Bɛngyaman maanzinli ne mɔ anu la amuala rayiale Gyɛlusalɛm kenle nsa ne azo. Kenle ne le siane ngɔnla ne ye kenle mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ abulanwiɔ la. Na menli ne amuala dɛnlanle aze wɔ ɛleka kpatawienyi ne mɔɔ wɔ Nyamenle Sua ne anyunlu la. Edwɛkɛ ne anwo ahunlundetelɛ nee ezule mɔɔ ɛnee ɛlɛtɔ kpole la manle bɛ nwo wozole bɛ.
10Na sɛlɛvolɛ Ɛzela dwazole na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛdo mɛla kɛ bɛgya nyɛvolɛ mraalɛ a. Bɛmaa Yizilayɛma fɔlɛlilɛ ne akee ɛyɛ kpole kpalɛ. 11Zɔhane ati bɛha bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ bɛhile Ɛdɛnkɛma, bɛ ze mɔ Nyamenle ne, na bɛyɛ mɔɔ ɔkpondɛ kɛ bɛyɛ la. Bɛhwe bɛ nwo bɛvi menli mɔɔ wɔ azɛlɛ ɛhye azo la anwo na bɛgyakyi bɛ nyɛvolɛ mraalɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛgyigya bɛ la.”
12Na menli mɔɔ wɔ ɛkɛ ne la amuala deanle nuhua kɛ, “ Ɔle zɔhane; ɔwɔ kɛ yɛyɛ mɔɔ wɔha la. 13Noko menli ne zonle, yɛɛ ezule ne ɛlɛtɔ kpole. Yɛnrɛhola nuhua gyinla zɛhae. Eza noko ɔnle kenle ko anzɛɛ kenle nwiɔ gyima. Ɔluakɛ yɛvo kpole kpalɛ. 14Bɛye mgbanyima bɛzie Gyɛlusalɛm ɛke bɛmaa bɛgyinla menli ne kɔsɔɔti agyakɛ anu na bɛhile kenle bɛmaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛgya nyɛvolɛ mraalɛ la ɛrɛla ɛranwu bɛ wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛhile la anu. Mekɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛhile sua biala azo amra la, saa bɛlɛba a ɔwɔ kɛ bɛ nee sua ne azo mgbanyima nee ndɛnebuavolɛma a ba a. Na bɛyɛ ye zɔhane kɔkpula kɛ Nyamenle ɛya kpole ne mɔɔ yeva wɔ ɛhye anwo la kɛha aze la.” 15Asahɛle ara Dwɔnatan nee Tɛkeva ara Gyɛzaya ala yɛɛ tiale nzuzulɛ ɛhye a, yɛɛ Mɛhyɛlam nee Livaenli Hyabɛtae vuale bɛ nzi.
16Akee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛhyele bɛ nuokɛ bɛhɔle nlɔnu na bɛzia bɛra la yɛle mɔɔ bɛha la. Sɛlɛvolɛ Ɛzela yele mbusua mgbanyinli vale bɛ zieziele bɛ ze mɔ awuke ne mɔ ati na bɛhɛlɛhɛlɛle bɛ aluma. Siane bulu ne anu kenle ne mɔɔ lumua la azo, bɛdɛnlanle aze kɛ bɛneɛnlea edwɛkɛ ne anu. 17Na ɔkadwu siane nsa ne azo la ɛnee bɛwie edwɛkɛ biala mɔɔ fane bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛgya nyɛvolɛ mraalɛ la anwo la ka.
Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ ɛnee bɛgya nyɛvolɛ mraalɛ la ɛne
18Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ ɛnee bɛgya nyɛvolɛ mraalɛ la ɛne: Sɛlɛvolɛma mbusua ne:
Dwɔhyua nee ɔ mediema ne mɔ abusua nu amra mɔɔ le Gyɛhozadake asa azo: Meeyasaya, Ɛleyizɛ, Gyɛlebe, yɛɛ Gɛdalaya. 19Bɛbɔle ɛwɔkɛ kɛ bɛbɔ bɛ mraalɛ ne mɔ ewole, na bɛvale boane nyinli ko kɛ bɛva bɛbɔ bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ anwo azu.
20Yemɛ abusua nu amra: Haneenae yɛɛ Zɛbadaya
21Hɛlem abusua nu amra: Meeyasaya, Yilaegya, Hyɛmaya, Gyɛhayɛle, yɛɛ Ɛzaya
22Pahyɔ abusua nu amra: Ɛleyoyinae, Meeyasaya, Yehyemeeyɛle, Nɛtanile, Dwozabade, yɛɛ Ɛleesa
23 Livaema:
Dwozabade, Hyemɛyae, Kɛlaya (mɔɔ eza bɛfɛlɛ ye Kɛlaeta la), Pɛtahaya, Dwuda, yɛɛ Ɛleyizɛ
24 Edwɛndolɛma:
Yilayahyebe
Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua sinzavolɛma:
Hyalɛm, Tilɛm, yɛɛ Yulae
25 Menli mɔɔ ɛha la:
Pɛlɔhye abusua nu amra: Relamaya, Yezaya, Malekaya, Megyamem, Ɛlieza, Malekaegya, yɛɛ Bɛnaya
26Yilam abusua nu amra: Matanaya, Zɛkalaya, Gyɛhayɛle, Abedae, Gyɛlɛmo, yɛɛ Yilaegya
27Zatu abusua nu amra: Ɛleyoyinae, Yilayahyebe, Matanaya, Gyɛlɛmo, Zeebade, yɛɛ Azaeza
28Bibeyae abusua nu amra: Gyihoheenan, Hananaya, Zabeeyae, yɛɛ Ateleeyae
29Beenae abusua nu amra: Mɛhyɛlam. Malɛke, Adaya, Gyahyɛbe, Hyiale, yɛɛ Gyɛlɛmo
30Peehate Mowabe abusua nu amra: Adena, Kilale, Bɛnaya, Meeyasaya, Matanaya, Bɛzalile, Benuwae, yɛɛ Manasɛ
31-32Hɛlem abusua nu amra: Ɛleyizɛ, Yehyaegya, Malekaegya, Hyɛmaya, Hyemɛyɔn, Bɛngyaman, Malɛke, yɛɛ Hyɛmalaya
33Hahyɛm abusua nu amra: Matinae, Matata, Zeebade, Yilefɛlɛte, Gyɛlimae, Manasɛ, yɛɛ Hyemɛyae
34-37Beenae abusua nu amra: Meeyadeeyae, Amelam, Yuwɛle, Bɛnaya, Bɛdaya, Kɛluhae, Vanaya, Mɛlɛmo, Yilayahyebe, Matanaya, Matinae, yɛɛ Gyeeyasu.
38-42Benuwae abusua nu amra: Hyemɛyae, Hyɛlimaya, Neetan, Adaya, Makenadɛbae, Hyahyae, Hyɛleeyae, Azalile, Hyɛlimaya, Hyɛmalaya, Hyalɛm, Amalaya, yɛɛ Dwosefi
43Nibo abusua nu amra: Gyiyayɛle, Matetaya, Zeebade, Zɛbaena, Gyeedae, Dwowɛle, yɛɛ Bɛnaya
44Menli ɛhye mɔ amuala ɛnee gya nyɛvolɛ mraalɛ. Bɛbɔle bɛ ewole na bɛmanle bɛ nee bɛ mra ziale hɔle.

Title: NIH MUKENYE
Content:
Mukenye
Nihɛmaya buluku ne, bɛhyɛ nuhua ekpunli nna: 1. Pɛhyea Maanle Maanle Belemgbunli yɛle Nihɛmaya amɛnlado kɛ ɔnlea Dwuda maanle ne na ɔnlea ɔmaa bɛlie Gyɛlusalɛm bane ne mɔ bieko. (Nihɛmaya eza hakyihakyile maanle ne amaamuo nee nyamenlezonlenlɛ ne ɛleka ne bie mɔ.) 2. Gyɛlusalɛm anwo banelielɛ bieko anwo edwɛkɛ. 3. Nyamenle Mɛla ne mɔ mɔɔ Ɛzela gengale nee menli ne mɔ ɛtanehanlɛ ne anwo edwɛkɛ yɛɛ 4. Nihɛmaya gyima bieko mɔɔ ɔlile kɛ ɔle amɛnlado wɔ Dwuda la.
Buluku ne debie mɔɔ ka nwolɛ edwɛkɛ ɛsesebɛ na ɔda ye ali wienyi la a le Nihɛmaya arɛle mɔɔ ɔvale ɔwulale Nyamenle anu kpole kpalɛ la nee ye dahudahu nzɛlɛlɛ.
Mɔɔ wɔ nu la
Nihɛmaya sia ahɔ Gyɛlusalɛm 1.1—2.20
Bɛyɛ Gyɛlusalɛm bane ne boɛ 3.1—7.73
Bɛgenga mɛla ne na bɛyɛ ngyekyeleɛ ne bieko 8.1—10.39
Nihɛmaya yɛ gyima ngakyile dɔɔnwo bieko 11.1—13.31

Title: NIH 1
Content:
1This be be work the Hacaliah son Nehemiah year the of word the his said the.
Nehemiah consider Jerusalem of
In ( envy cord envy) month the the, the be Artaxerxes, Persia Nation Nation King the old year twenty in throne of the, i, Nehemiah, be here i am nation the city Susa the. 2Me mediema mrenya ne mɔ ko mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Haneenae la nee menli bie vi Dwuda rale. Membizale bɛ kɛ Gyɛlusalɛm si de la, nee kɛ mediema Dwudama mɔɔ nriandile na bɛanva bɛ donvula bɛangɔ Babelonia la agbɔkɛ nu si de la. 3Na bɛzele me kɛ, “Menli mɔɔ bɛangye bɛ donvula na bɛwɔ sua nu la de nyiane nee anwongyelelɛ nu. Bɛbubu Gyɛlusalɛm bane ne mɔ, yɛɛ bɛyela ye nlenkɛ mgbole ne mɔ.”
4Mɔɔ mendele edwɛkɛ ɛhye la, mendɛnlanle aze na menzunle menyele awolɛ kpalɛ na menlile nyane kenle dɔɔnwo; mengɔle zolɛ mengyele ɛhɔne menzɛlɛle Nyamenle 5menzele kɛ, “O Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle mɔɔ wɔ anwuma, mɔɔ ɛle nwanwane, ɛle bedevinli a; wɔmɔ mɔɔ ɛsie wɔ ngyekyeleɛ ne nee wɔ ɛhulolɛ ne kpundii ɛmaa menli mɔɔ kulo wɔ na bɛdi wɔ mɛla zo la a, 6gyele ɛ nzo tie wɔ sonvolɛ ye nzɛlɛlɛ mɔɔ mefa meado ɛ nyunlu nɔɔzo nee ewiazo meamaa wɔ menli Yizilayɛma la, na nea yɛ. Ɛ mra Yizilayɛma ɛyɛ ɛtane ɛtia wɔ. Ɛhɛe, medame, me nee egya awuke nu amra bɔbɔ yɛyɛ ɛtane yɛtia wɔ. 7Yɛyɛ amumuyɛ kpole kpalɛ yɛtia wɔ, yɛɛ yɛnli wɔ mɛla ne nee wɔ ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ ɛvale ɛmanle wɔ sonvolɛ Mosisi la azo. 8 Mesɛlɛ wɔ, kakye mɔɔ ɛhanle ɛhilele wɔ sonvolɛ Mosisi la kɛ, ‘Bɛdabɛ Yizilayɛma, saa bɛanli nɔhalɛ bɛammaa me a mebabɔ bɛ asande meagua maanle maanle zo; 9 na saa bɛsia bɛdi me mɛla ne mɔ azo a, yemɔ saa kanza bɔbɔ bɛbɔle asande bɛhɔle maanle ti nee maanle bo a, mebaboɔboa bɛ nloa meava bɛ meahɔgua ɛleka ne mɔɔ medame meye mezie ɛkɛ ne memaa bɛ la, amaa me duma ne aha ɛkɛ ne dahuu.’
10“Bɛle wɔ sonvolɛma nee wɔ menli mɔɔ ɛdawɔ wɔva wɔ tumi kpole ne nee wɔ anwosesebɛ ne wɔlie bɛ a. 11O Awulae, gyele ɛ nzo tie wɔ sonvolɛ ye nzɛlɛlɛ, na tie wɔ sonvolɛma mɔɔ lɛ wɔ duma ne anwo ɛzulolɛ la nzɛlɛlɛ; maa saleɛ ɛdoa wɔ sonvolɛ na maa maanle maanle belemgbunli ne ɛnwu ye anwunvɔne ɛnɛ.”
Mekɛ ne anu ɛnee mame a mesu belemgbunli ne nza a.

Title: NIH 2
Content:
Nihɛmaya kɔ Gyɛlusalɛm
1Wɔ siane Naesan (Siane Ɛnlanle) ne anu, wɔ Belemgbunli Atazɛzɛse ye ɛvolɛ abulanwiɔ ne azo, mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee ɔlɛkpula ɔ sa la, menvale nwanye mengɔmanle ye. Ɛnee kenle ko bɔbɔ ɔtɛnwunle me kɛ melɛdi nyane ɛlɛ. 2Yemɔti ɔbizale me kɛ, “Ɛ nwo ɛtɛtole wɔ, ɛte kpɔkɛ, na duzu ati yɛɛ ɛ nyunlu ɛyɛ alɔbɔlɛ alɔbɔlɛ zɛhae a? Tɛ ɛhwee ɔ, ɛlɛdi nyane kpole kpalɛ wɔ wɔ ahonle nu.”
Ɛzulolɛ hanle me kpole 3 na membuale belemgbunli ne kɛ, “Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛmaa belemgbunli ɛnyi ɛhyɛ. Me nwo ɛyɛ alɔbɔlɛ, ɔluakɛ suakpole ne mɔɔ le nenya mɔ sɛfonle la ɛdɔ mgbane; na ye nlenkɛ mgbole ne mɔ ɛyela.”
4Na belemgbunli ne bizale me kɛ, “Duzu a menyɛ memaa wɔ a?”
Menzɛlɛle anwuma anwuma Nyamenle ne 5na menganle mengilele belemgbunli ne kɛ, “Saa medame, wɔ sonvolɛ anyunlu ɛra anyia wɔ ɛ nyunlu, na eza saa ɔyɛ belemgbunli ɛhulolɛ a, ɛnee soa me wɔ Dwuda, wɔ suakpole ne mɔɔ le nenya mɔ sɛfonle zo la azo, amaa meahɔkyekye suakpole ne bieko.”
6Na belemgbunli ne zele me kɛ (ɛnee belemgbunli raalɛ ne de ɔ nwo ɛkɛ ne), “Ɛkɔ a ɛbali kenle nyɛ, yɛɛ kenlenzu fɔɔnwo yɛɛ ɛbazia wɔara a?” Na menwunle kɛ ɔyɛ belemgbunli ahunlundwolɛ kɛ ɔkɛmaa menwɔhɔ; yemɔti mengilele ye mekɛ.
7Na menzɛlɛle belemgbunli ne kɛ, “Saa ɔyɛ belemgbunli ahunlundwolɛ a, ɛnee maa bɛhɛlɛ ngɛlata bɛmaa mengɔmaa amɛnladoma mɔɔ sie maanzinli ne mɔ mɔɔ gua Azule Yufileti adɔleɛ la, amaa bɛamaa me adenle bɛamaa meapɛ nuhua bɛ maanzinli ne mɔ anu meahɔ Dwuda. 8Eza maa bɛhɛlɛ kɛlata bɛhɔmaa Esafe mɔɔ sinza belemgbunli kpɔkɛmile ne la, amaa yeamaa me mbaka na meakpakyekpakye meayɛ mgbunla meaduodua aranemgbole ne mɔɔ zua Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne la nlenkɛ mgbole ne, bane ne nlenkɛ mgbole ne, yɛɛ sua ne mɔɔ mebadɛnla nuhua la nlenkɛ mgbole ne mɔ.” Belemgbunli ne yɛle mɔɔ membizale ye biala la manle me, ɔluakɛ ɛnee me Nyamenle ne nee me lua.
9Belemgbunli yele safohyenle mgbanyinli nee menli ekpunli mɔɔ ka mgbɔnwɔ la manle bɛ nee me hɔle. Membale amɛnladoma mɔɔ sie maanzinli ne mɔ mɔɔ gua Azule Yufileti adɔleɛ la ɛkɛ. Menvale belemgbunli ngɛlata ne mɔ memanle bɛ. 10Na mɔɔ Sanebalate mɔɔ vi Bɛte Hɔlɔn, nee Tobaya, mɔɔ le belemgbunli mbɔlɔba ne mɔ ko, mɔɔ vi Amɔn maanzinli nu la dele kɛ awie ɛra Yizilayɛma boɛyɛlɛ ti la, bɛvale ɛya kpole.
11Yemɔti membale Gyɛlusalɛm membanlile kenle nsa. 12Mendwazole nɔe ne na menvale menli ekyi bie menlile me nzi menvindele. Deɛ holɛ ko mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛva ɛwula me kɛ menyɛ memaa Gyɛlusalɛm la, meanga meangile bɛ. Yɛanva ayɛmoa biala yɛangɔ kɛ ayɛmoa ne mɔɔ mendɛnlanle zolɛ la ala. 13Menvindele nɔe ne la, menvale Bɔnza Anlenkɛ Kpole ne anu mengɔle Nane anwo ɛzulolɛ ne mɔɔ le kɛ Ɛlɛnrɛne la Nzufeanvea ne anwo na mengɔle Ewula Anlankɛ Kpole ne anloa. Meneɛnleanle Gyɛlusalɛm bane ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛbubu bɛ la nee nlenkɛ mgbole ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛyela bɛ la. 14Akee mentelele zolɛ mengɔle Nzufeanvea Anlenkɛ Kpole ne anloa na mengɔle Belemgbunli Nzubula ne anwo; na ɛnee akee adenle biala ɛnla ɛkɛ mɔɔ ayɛmoa ne mɔɔ mede zolɛ la dua nu a ɔyɛ boɛ a. 15Akee menluale bɔnza ne anloa nɔe ne na meneanle bane ne, na menvale Bɔnza Anlenkɛ Kpole ne anloa menziale me nzi.
16Sua ne azo mgbanyima ne annwu ɛleka mɔɔ mengɔle nee deɛ mɔɔ mengɔnyɛle la, yɛɛ ɛnee eza metɛkanle deɛ mɔɔ yemɔti membale la metɛkilele Dwuuma ne, sɛlɛvolɛma, menli mɔɔ di munli, mgbanyima nee menli mɔɔ ɛha mɔɔ bayɛ gyima ne la. 17Na nzinlii akee menzele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛdabɛ bɛ nye dua ngyianlɛ mɔɔ yɛwɔ nuhua la. Gyɛlusalɛm ɛyɛ suadu; bɛyela ye nlenkɛ mgbole ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti. Bɛrɛla bɛmaa yɛyɛ Gyɛlusalɛm bane ne mɔ boɛ na yɛye yɛ nwo yɛvi nyiane kpole ɛhye anu.” 18Menganle mengilele bɛ kɛ me Nyamenle ne li me nzi na menganle edwɛkɛ mɔɔ belemgbunli ne hanle hilele me la mengilele bɛ.
Na bɛzele me kɛ, “Bɛmaa yɛdwazo yɛyɛ bane ne mɔ boɛ.” Na bɛboɔboale bɛ nwo kɛ bɛbɔ gyima ne abo.
19Mɔɔ Sanebalate mɔɔ vi Hɔlɔn, Amɔnonli Tobaya mɔɔ le sonvolɛ nee Arelabenli bie mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Gihyɛm la dele gyima mɔɔ yɛhyehyɛ kɛ yɛyɛ la, bɛgolole yɛ nwo, bɛzile yɛ amgbu na bɛzele kɛ, “Duzu debie a bɛlɛyɛ a? Ɛnee bɛlɛte belemgbunli ne anwo atua ɔ?”
20Membuale bɛ kɛ, “Anwuma Nyamenle ne bakpogya yɛ sa zo amaa yɛ, ye sonvolɛma, yɛdwazo yɛayɛ bane ne mɔ boɛ. Na bɛmɛ, ɔnyɛ bɛ edwɛkɛ; bɛnlɛ agyadeɛ anzɛɛ sɛfonle biala wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm ɛke.”

Title: NIH 3
Content:
Bɛyɛ Gyɛlusalɛm bane ne mɔ boɛ
1Adenle mɔɔ bɛluale nu bɛliele Gyɛlusalɛm bane ne mɔ la ɛne: Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli Yilayahyebe nee ɔ mediema sɛlɛvolɛma ne mɔ zile Mboane Anlenkɛ Kpole ne. Bɛvale ɛbonle ne mɔ bɛduoduale bɛ, na bɛdule bɛwulale Nyamenle asa anu. Bɛyɛle ye zɔhane toonwo bɛrale Tawa Ɛya ne anwo na bɛdwule Hananile Tawa ne anwo noko.
2Gyɛleko amra yɛle bane ne mɔɔ zɔ zolɛ la boɛ. Yemelae ara Zakɛ yɛle mɔɔ doa ye la boɛ.
3Hasɛnaya sua nu amra zile Fɛlɛ Anlenkɛ Kpole ne. Bɛzile felɛmo ne, bɛduale anlenkɛ ne kɔlɔkɔlɔ, na bɛvale mbulalɛ bɛguale ɔ nzi.
4Yulaya ara Mɛlɛmo, mɔɔ le Hakɔzo anlɔnra ne yɛle mɔɔ doa ye la boɛ.
Bɛlikaya ara Mɛhyɛlam, mɔɔ le Mɛhyɛzabili anlɔnra ne yɛle mɔɔ doa ye la boɛ.
Beeyana ara Zeedɔko yɛle mɔɔ doa ye la boɛ.
5Tɛkowa sua nu amra yɛle mɔɔ zɔ zolɛ la boɛ, noko Tɛkowa ezuavolɛ mgbanyima ne anva bɛ sa anga gyima ne mɔɔ bɛ menle mɔ vale wulale bɛ sa nu la.
6Pasia ara Gyɛhɔyada nee Bisodaya ara Mɛhyɛlam a yɛle Gyɛhyana Anlenkɛ Kpole ne boɛ a. Bɛzile felɛmo ne, bɛduale ye ɛbonle, bɛvale kɔlɔkɔlɔ bɛduale ye, na bɛvale mbulalɛ bɛguale ɔ nzi.
7Mɛlataya mɔɔ vi Gebɛyɔn, Gyeedɔn mɔɔ vi Mɛlono, yɛɛ Gebɛyɔnoma nee Mezepama mɔɔ wɔ amɛnlado ne mɔɔ sie maanle ne mɔɔ wɔ Azule Yufileti anzi nehane la abo la, yɛle bane ne mɔɔ zɔ zolɛ la boɛ.
8Haahaya ara nrenya sukoadwinli ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Ɛzeɛle la, yɛle mɔɔ zɔ zolɛ la boɛ.
Hananaya, mɔɔ yɛ anatele nee sakyeɛ evuanlɛ gyima la, yɛle mɔɔ zɔ zolɛ la boɛ toonwo ɔhɔdwule Bane Tɛtɛlɛ ne anwo.
9Huule ara Relɛfaya, mɔɔ sie Gyɛlusalɛm maanzinli ne foa ko la, yɛle mɔɔ zɔ zolɛ la boɛ.
10Halumafe ara Gyɛdaya, yɛle mɔɔ nee ye sua ne anye bɔ zolɛ la boɛ.
Hahyabeenaya ara Hatɛhye, yɛle mɔɔ zua Gyɛdaya ɛdeɛ ne la boɛ.
11Hɛlem ara Malekaegya nee Hahyɛbe, mɔɔ le Peehate Mowabe ara nrenya ne, yɛle mɔɔ zɔ zolɛ la boɛ na bɛzile Fonlomo Tawa ne.
12Halohɛhye ara Hyalɛm, mɔɔ sie Gyɛlusalɛm maanzinli ne foa ko la nee ɔ mra mraalɛ yɛle mɔɔ zɔ zolɛ la boɛ.
13Heenɛn nee suakpole Zanowa ezuavolɛ ne yɛle Bɔnza Anlenkɛ Kpole ne boɛ. Bɛliele bane ne mita ɛya nna abulanla bɛhɔdwule Ewula Anlenkɛ Kpole ne anwo. Bɛduoduale nlenkɛ ne mɔ ɛbonle nee kɔlɔkɔlɔ na bɛvale mbulalɛ bɛguale bɛ nzi.
14Malekaegya mɔɔ ɔ ze a le Rilikabe, na ɔsie Bɛte Hakɛlɛm Maanzinli ne la, yɛle Ewula Anlenkɛ Kpole ne boɛ. Ɔzile ye fofolɛ, ɔduale anlenkɛ ne ɛbonle nee kɔlɔkɔlɔ na ɔvale mbulalɛ ɔguale ɔ nzi.
15Kɔlehozi ara Hyalɛm, mɔɔ sie Mezepa Maanzinli ne la, yɛle Nzufeanvea Anlenkɛ Kpole ne boɛ. Ɔbobɔle ɛbonle fofolɛ ɔduale ye, ɔduale ye kɔlɔkɔlɔ, na ɔvale mbulalɛ ɔguale ɔ nzi. Akee ɔyɛle bane ne mɔɔ vi Hyila Nzubula ne mɔɔ zua belemgbunli ne tola ne la boɛ, toonwo ɔhɔkpulale kpolike ne mɔɔ tolo kɔ Devidi suakpole ne azo la.
16Mɔɔ doa ye ɛdeɛ ne la, Azebɛke ara Nihɛmaya, mɔɔ sie Bɛtezɛ Maanzinli ne foa ko la, yɛle bane ne boɛ, toonwo ɔhɔkpulale ɛleka mɔɔ nee Devidi sɛka ne anye bɔ zolɛ, wɔ nzubula ne nee ɛlɔnema azua ne mɔ anwo la.
Livaema mɔɔ yɛle bane ne anwo gyima la
17Livaema mɔɔ yɛle bane ne mɔ dɔɔnwo boɛ zɔle zolɛ la ɛne: Rilihɛm mɔɔ le Beenae ara ne yɛle bane ne mɔɔ zɔ zolɛ la boɛ.
Hahyabaya, mɔɔ sie Kiyaela Maanzinli ne foa ko la, gyinlanle ye menli ne agyakɛ anu yɛle mɔɔ zɔ zolɛ la boɛ.
18Hɛneedade ara Beeveeyae, mɔɔ sie Kiyaela maanzinli ne foa ko la, yɛle mɔɔ zɔ zolɛ la boɛ.
19Gyɛhyua ara Yizɛ, mɔɔ sie Mezepa la, eza yɛle mɔɔ doa ye la boɛ zɔle zolɛ, ɔvi aduzielɛ ɛleka ne, toonwo ɔhɔle bane ne muleɛ zo.
20Bɛlɛke mɔɔ le Zabeeyae ara ne, yɛle bane ne mɔɔ doa ye la boɛ zɔle zolɛ hɔdwule Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli Yilayahyebe sua ne anuhɔlɛ.
21Yulaya ara Mɛlɛmo, mɔɔ le Heekɔzo anlɔnra la, yɛle bane ne mɔɔ doa ye la boɛ, ɔvi Yilayahyebe sua ne anuhɔlɛ ɔhɔdwule sua ne ati.
Sɛlɛvolɛma mɔɔ yɛle bane ne anwo gyima la
22Sɛlɛvolɛma mɔɔ yɛle bane ne bie boɛ la a le ɛhye mɔ: Sɛlɛvolɛma mɔɔ zuozua Gyɛlusalɛm la yɛle bie zɔle zolɛ.
23Bɛngyaman nee Hahyɛbe yɛle bane ne mɔɔ nee bɛ sua ne anye bɔ zolɛ la boɛ zɔle zolɛ.
Meeyasaya ara Azalaya, mɔɔ le Ananaya anlɔnra ne, ɔdaye ɔyɛle mɔɔ wɔ ye sua ne anyunlu la boɛ zɔle zolɛ.
24Hɛneedade ara Benuwae yɛle bane ne mɔɔ vi Azalaya sua ne anwo kɔdwu bane ne muleɛ zo la boɛ zɔle zolɛ.
25Peelale mɔɔ ɔ ze a le Yuzae la yɛle bane ne bie boɛ zɔle zolɛ vi ye muleɛ zo. Bane ne muleɛ zo nee belemgbunli suakunlu ɛkɛ ne tawa ne anye bɔ zolɛ. Tawa ne zua sinzavolɛma sua ne.
26Pɛlɔhye ara Pɛdaya yɛle bane ne bie boɛ zɔle zolɛ, wɔ aduduleɛ afoa nu mɔɔ bikye Nzule Anlenkɛ Kpole ne nee tawa ne mɔɔ bɛgyinla zolɛ bɛsinza Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne la. (Ɛhye bikye suakpole ne awɔdenle ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Ofɛle la. Ɛke yɛɛ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne sonvolɛma ne de a.)
Menli gyɛne mɔɔ yɛle bane ne bie la
27Tɛkowama eza yɛle bane ne ɛleka mɔɔ nee tawa kpole ne mɔɔ gyi Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne azo la anye bɔ zolɛ la boɛ, toonwo bɛhɔdwule Ofɛle bane ne anwo.
28Sɛlɛvolɛma bie yɛle bane ne bie boɛ zɔle zolɛ; bɛvale ye Ɛkpɔnwɔ Anlenkɛ Kpole ne anwo bɛhɔle ye anwuma. Awie biala yɛle ye sua nyunlu bane ɛdeɛ ne boɛ.
29Yemɛ ara Zeedɔko noko yɛle mɔɔ nee ye sua ne anye bɔ zolɛ la boɛ zɔle zolɛ.
30Hyɛlimaya ara Hananaya nee Zeelafe awoba nsia ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Heenɛn la, yɛle bane ne mɔɔ doa ye la boɛ; bɛ fane nwiɔ mɔɔ bɛyɛ bane ne bie boɛ la ɛne.
Bɛlikaya ara Mɛhyɛlam yɛle bane ne mɔɔ wɔ ye sua ne anyunlu la boɛ.
31Sukoadwinli Malekaya yɛle bie zɔle zolɛ hɔdwule sua ne mɔɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua sonvolɛma nee gualilɛma ne mɔ wɔ nu, mɔɔ nee Mefekade Anlenkɛ Kpole ne anye bɔ zolɛ, na ɔzua ekpumgbunli ne mɔɔ wɔ bane ne aduduleɛ sɔlɔ muleɛ ne azo anwuma la anwo.
32Sukoadwinlima nee gualilɛma yɛle mɔɔ li awieleɛ bɔkɔɔ la boɛ, ɔvi ekpumgbunli ne mɔɔ wɔ muleɛ ne azo anwuma la anwo bɛhɔzɔle Mboane Anlenkɛ Kpole ne.

Title: NIH 4
Content:
Nihɛmaya di menli mɔɔ ko tia ye gyima ne la anwo zo konim
1Mɔɔ Sanebalate dele kɛ yɛlɛyɛ bane ne boɛ la, ɔvale ɛya kpole na ɔbɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɔgolo Dwuuma anwo. 2Wɔ ɔ gɔnwo mɔ nee Samɛlea ɛlɔnema anyunlu, ɔzele kɛ, “Duzu a Dwuuma anwo anwunvɔne ɛhye mɔ ɛlɛyɛ a? Na bɛdwenle kɛ bɛkɛhola bɛkɛva kenle ko bɛkɛwie gyima ne yɛ ɔ? Anzɛɛ bɛdwenle kɛ awolɛ ɛhye mɔ mɔɔ ɛyelɛyela ɛyɛ ewula la bɛkɛhola bɛkɛhakyi bɛ awolɛ mɔɔ bɛfa bɛsi sua a ɔyɛ boɛ ɔ?”
3Ɛnee Amɔnonli Tobaya gyi ɔ nwo ɛkɛ. Na ɔdaye noko ɔdole zolɛ kɛ, “Duzu bane bɔbɔ yɛɛ bɛdabɛ bɛkɛhola bɛkɛlie a? Ɛzonlɛ bɔbɔ anwo ka ye mgbane a ɔbabubu yeagua.”
4Menzɛlɛle kɛ, “O yɛ Nyamenle, tie kɛ bɛlɛsi yɛ amgbu bie a! Maa bɛ amgbuzilɛ ne ɛbɔ bɛ ti. Debie biala mɔɔ bɛlɛ la, maa bɛyɛ afedeɛ, na maa bɛhye bɛ ɛkpolekɛ zo bɛ nee bɛ ɛhɔ maanle gyɛne nu. 5Mmafea bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ azo, yɛɛ mmafa bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ ɛkyɛ bɛ, ɔluakɛ bɛfutu wɔ ahonle wɔ banelielɛma ye anyunlu.”
6Yemɔti yɛyɛle bane ne kɔsɔɔti boɛ. Ye anwumahɔlɛ ne noko dwule ye avinli. Ɔluakɛ menli ne anye kpotale gyima ne anwo.
7Mɔɔ Sanebalate nee Tobaya nee Arelebiama nee Amɔnoma nee Ahyedɔdoma dele kɛ Gyɛlusalɛm bane ne boɛyɛlɛ ne ɛlɛkɔ zolɛ kpalɛ na ɛleka ne mɔ mɔɔ gologolole la kɔsɔɔti ɛlɛtɔ nuhua la, bɛvale ɛya kpole, 8na bɛ kɔsɔɔti bɛkpamonle kɛ bɛba bɛaradoa Gyɛlusalɛmma bɛ nee bɛ aho na bɛava basabasayɛlɛ bɛara suakpole ne azo. 9Yɛzɛlɛle yɛ Nyamenle ne na yɛyele sinzavolɛma yɛmanle bɛzinzale sua ne nɔɔzo nee ewiazo.
10Dwudama lɛ edwɛne bie mɔɔ bɛto a bɛse,
“Yɛ ɛnwomenle ɛwie, yɛyɛ gyima yɛvɛ,
Ewula ne tɛso kpalɛ;
Yɛangola bane ne die ala ɛne.”
11Yɛ kpɔvolɛma ne zele kɛ,
“Bɛnrɛde nganeɛ yɛɛ bɛnrɛnwu ye,
Kɔkpula kɛ yɛkɛholo bɛ nwo zo,
Yɛkɛhu bɛ na banelielɛ ne kɛpeme ɛkpa.”
12Dwuuma mɔɔ de bɛ avinli wɔ suakpole ne azo la radinle yɛ aze fane bulu kɛ, “Bɛvi ngameɛngameɛ a bɛbaradoa yɛ bɛ nee yɛ aho a.” 13Yemɔti memanle me menli ne konle ninyɛne: dadeɛ, atwɛ nee ɛda mɔ, na mengyɛle bɛ nuhua awuke awuke na memanle bɛhɔdɛle bane ne anzi ɛleka biala mɔɔ bane ne ɛtɛkɔle anwuma la.
14Na menwunle kɛ menli ne arɛle ɛbɔ. Yemɔti menzele mgbanyima ne mɔ nee mbɔlɔba mgbanyinli nee menli mɔɔ ɛha la kɛ, “Bɛmmasulo yɛ kpɔvolɛma ne mɔ. Bɛhakye kɛ Awulae a le bedevinli a; ɔ nwo yɛ ɛzulolɛ. Bɛho bɛmaa bɛ mediema, bɛ mra mrenya, bɛ mra mraalɛ, bɛ ye mɔ nee bɛ maanle.” 15Yɛ kpɔvolɛma ne dele kɛ yɛde bɛ adwenle ne mɔɔ bɛvale la anwo bie na Nyamenle ɛmaa bɛ kpɔkɛ mɔɔ bɛbɔle la ɛtulu. Akee yɛ kɔsɔɔti yɛziale yɛhɔzɔle yɛ gyima ne azo.
16Ɔvi mekɛ zɔhane menli mɔɔ nee me lua la hyɛle bɛ nwo nu nwiɔ; foa ko yɛle banelielɛ gyima ne yɛɛ foa ko noko yɛle sinzavolɛma bɛwulowulale konle mbulalɛ adɛladeɛ, bɛdedɛle atwɛ nee ɛda yɛɛ bɛ sa nu enyinlike. Mgbanyima ne mɔ bɛdabɛ bɛgyinlanle Dwudama 17mɔɔ ɛlɛyɛ bane ne boɛ la anzi kpundii. Bɛhyehyɛle ye mɔɔ menli mɔɔ ɛlɛyɛ gyima ne nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛsoɔzoa nwolɛ ninyɛne la ko biala ɛzia ɔ nwo; mɔɔ ɔ sa ko ɛlɛyɛ gyima ne la ɛnee ko lɛ konle dadeɛ ne anu.
18Menli bɔbɔ mɔɔ ɛnee ɛlɛto bane ne la biala lɛ dadeɛ zia ye foa ko. Sonla ne mɔɔ bɔ aweɛne tendenle ne la gyi me foa ko. 19Menzele mgbanyima ne mɔ, mbɔlɔba ne mɔ nee menli mɔɔ ɛha la kɛ, “Gyima ne le kpole na ɔtɛlɛ, yɛɛ yɛ avinli tete. 20Yemɔti ɛleka biala mɔɔ bɛkɛde aweɛne tendenle ne ane la, bɛ muala bɛhɔ ɛkɛ. Yɛ Nyamenle ne baho amaa yɛ.” 21Yemɔti bɛhɔle gyima ne azo, ɔvi aleɛbahye toonwo ɔkɔkpula aledwolɛ. Menli ne foa ko yɛle gyima ne yɛɛ foa ko zinzale.
22Akee menzele menli ne kɛ, “Awie biala nee ye sonla ne mɔɔ boa ye la ɛla Gyɛlusalɛm, amaa nɔɔzo yɛazinza suakpole ne na alehyenlɛ nu yɛayɛ gyima ne.” 23Yemɔti, medame o, anzɛɛ me gɔnwo mɔ o, me sonvolɛma o, anzɛɛ sinzavolɛma o, anzɛɛ sinzavolɛma mɔɔ li me nzi la o, yɛ nuhua biala anye ye tɛladeɛ ne ɛlɛ, yɛɛ yɛangua yɛ konle ninyɛne ne mɔ aze ɛlɛ; yɛ nzule bɔbɔ gyelegyela yɛ.

Title: NIH 5
Content:
1Nzinlii menli dɔɔnwo, mrenya nee mraalɛ, dendɛle tiale bɛ mediema Dwuuma. 2Ɔluakɛ bie mɔ zele kɛ, “Yɛ nee yɛ mra mrenya nee mraalɛ, yɛ nwo zonle somaa; bɛmaa yɛhɔkpondɛ aleɛ mɔɔ yɛdi yɛanyia ngoane la.”
3Bie mɔ noko zele kɛ, “Yɛva yɛ ɛya avule ne mɔ, yɛ vanye egyinli ne mɔ nee yɛ azua yɛwula awoba yɛlie abɛlɛ, amaa ɛhɔne ye mɔɔ ɛra la yɛanyia aleɛ yɛali.”
4Bie mɔ noko zele kɛ, “Yɛbizale bosea a yɛduale yɛ ɛya avule nee vanye egyinli ne mɔ anwo adwule yɛmanle belemgbunli a. 5Yɛdayɛ noko yɛlɛ nwonane kɛ yɛ mediema ne mɔ ala la, yɛɛ yɛ mra ne mɔ le kɛ bɛ mra ne mɔ ala la; noko yɛlɛkye yɛ mra mrenya nee mraalɛ ɛkpolekɛ zo yɛayɛ bɛ ahanra. Bɛ nuhua bie mɔ bɔbɔ ɛhɔ kanrazonlenlɛ nu dɛbadɛba yɛɛ yɛyɛ nwolɛ ɛhwee a ɔnyɛ boɛ, ɔluakɛ yɛ ɛya avule ne mɔ nee yɛ vanye egyinli ne mɔ ɛpɛ ɛli awie mɔ asa anu.”
6Mɔɔ mendele bɛ edwɛkɛ ne la menvale ɛya kpole. 7 Mendwenlenle nwolɛ na mendeanle mgbanyima ne mɔ nee mbɔlɔba mgbanyinli ne mɔ wɔ nwolɛ. Menzele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛlɛdi bɛ mediema ne mɔ ndunlumi.”
Menvɛlɛle maanle ayia na menzele bɛ kɛ, 8“Yɛmɛ mɔɔ yɛwɔ maanle zo la yɛlɛbɔ mɔdenle biala mɔɔ ɔkɛyɛ boɛ la, kɛ yɛkɛkpɔne yɛ mediema Dwuuma mɔɔ wɔ kanrazonlenlɛ nu la yɛ nee bɛ kɛra sua nu. Akee bɛmɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ sua nu la bɛlɛmia bɛ mediema Dwuuma bɛamaa bɛadɔne bɛ nwo bɛamaa bɛ.” Na mgbanyima ne mɔ ko bɔbɔ andɛ ɔ nloa anu.
9Yemɔti menzele bɛ kɛ, “Nyɛleɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛyɛ la ɛnle kpalɛ. Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛsulo Nyamenle na bɛbɔ ɛbɛla mɔɔ le fɔɔnwo la, amaa bɛammaa yɛ kpɔvolɛma nee menli mɔɔ ɛnze Nyamenle la adenle bɛanzi yɛ amgbu. 10Me nee agɔnwolɛma nee me sonvolɛma yɛvɛne menli ne ezukoa nee abɛlɛ. Bɛmaa yɛva debie biala mɔɔ bɛtua yɛ la yɛhyɛ bɛ. 11Ɛnɛ kenle ye, bɛva bɛ ɛya avule ne mɔ, bɛ vanye egyinli ne mɔ, bɛ ɔlivi ɛya ne mɔ, bɛ azua, ezukoa ngyɛnu ɛya ko ɛkpɔ ko ne, bɛ abɛlɛ, bɛ nwanye nee bɛ ɔlivi nwole mɔɔ bɛliele la kɔsɔɔti bɛmaa bɛ.”
12Na mgbanyima ne mɔ zele kɛ, “Yɛfa bɛ debie biala yɛamaa bɛ, yɛɛ yɛnrɛbiza bɛ ɛhwee. Yɛbayɛ ye kɛmɔ wɔha la.”
Na menvɛlɛle sɛlɛvolɛma ne mɔ na memanle mgbanyima ne mɔ hanle ndane wɔ bɛ nyunlu kɛ bɛkɛli bɛ ɛwɔkɛ ne mɔɔ bɛbɔ la azo. 13Akee menyele ɛdanlɛ kodoku ne mɔɔ hye me nze zo la na memkpokpole nuhua na menzele kɛ, “Awie biala mɔɔ yeanli ye ɛwɔkɛ mɔɔ yebɔ la azo la, Nyamenle badu ye avi ye sua nu, alie ye debie biala ɔ sa nu yeamaa yeaha ye kpoholokpo ne ala.”
Awie biala mɔɔ wɔ ɛkɛ ne la liele zolɛ, “Amen”, na bɛyele Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ. Na mgbanyima ne mɔ noko lile bɛ ɛwɔkɛ ne azo.
Nihɛmaya ɛnle angomedi
14Ɔvi mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee Belemgbunli Atazɛzɛse ɛnyia ɛvolɛ abulanwiɔ wɔ Pɛhyea ebia ne azo, toonwo mɔɔ ɔnyianle ɛvolɛ abulasa nee nwiɔ, mɔɔ ɔvale me kɛ menyɛ Dwuda amɛnlado la, medame o, anzɛɛ me sonvolɛma o, yɛ biala anlie ɛkponledolɛ ezukoa ɛlɛ wɔ ɛvolɛ bulu nee nwiɔ ne anu. 15Amɛnlado biala mɔɔ ɛnee li me nyunlu la yɛle adesoa manle menli ne. Bɛliele aleɛ nee nwanye ezukoa, akee asolo nwolɛ kenle ko dwɛtɛ fufule abulanla ne mɔɔ bɛdie la. Bɛ sonvolɛma bɔbɔ wulule gyinlanle menli ne akɔme zo. Na mame, ɔlua Nyamenle ɛzulolɛ ti meanyɛ zɔhane. 16Menvale me anwosesebɛ kɔsɔɔti menzɔle suakpole ne bane ne boɛyɛlɛ nu. Meamkpondɛ medame me ti anwo agyadeɛ biala. Me sonvolɛma ne kɔsɔɔti zɔle nuhua manle yɛyɛle bane ne boɛ. 17Me aleɛ ɛkponle ne, dahuu menli ɛya ko abulanlu a wɔ nwolɛ a, Dwuuma nee mbɔlɔba mgbanyinli, akee asolo menli mɔɔ vi maanle maanle mɔɔ zuozua yɛ la anu kɛra la. 18Kenle ko biala meku ɛnlankɛ ko, mboane nsia yɛɛ ngɔkɔlɛ, akee kenle bulu biala memaa bɛ nwanye dɔɔnwo. Na kɛmɔ meze ɛvɛlɛ bedevinli mɔɔ menli ne de nwolɛ la ati, meanlie me amɛnlado ɛkponledolɛ ezukoa ne.
19O me Nyamenle, mesɛlɛ wɔ, kakye boɛ mɔɔ meyɛ memaa menli ɛhye mɔ la na yila me wɔ nwolɛ.

Title: NIH 6
Content:
Nihɛmaya anwo akpamo ɛhɔlɛ
1Mɔɔ Sanebalate, Tobaya Arelebianli Gihyɛm nee yɛ kpɔvolɛma mɔɔ ɛha la dele kɛ mewie suakpole ne bane ne amuala boɛ yɛ na adenle biala fee ɛnla ye ɛleka biala la, (noko akee ɛnee metɛfale nlenkɛ metɛtuoduale felɛmo ne mɔ anu), 2Sanebalate nee Gihyɛm zoanle manle bɛrazele me kɛ, “Ɛ nee yɛ ɛyia Ono fiene ne anu namule ne mɔ ko azo.” Adwenle mɔɔ ɛnee bɛlɛ la a le kɛ, bɛkpondɛ kɛ bɛyɛ me debie. 3Menvale nrɛlaleɛ mengɔmanle bɛ kɛ, “Melɛyɛ gyima kpole bie, yemɔti menrɛhola ba. Menrɛhola gyima ne gyakyi ba nehane.”
4Bɛzoanle menli fane ngoko nna na medame noko membuale bɛ ko ne ala fane nna. 5Fane nnu ne azo Sanebalate zoanle ye sonvolɛ manle ɔvale kɛlata mɔɔ ɛnee ɔkpondɛ kɛ nuhua edwɛkɛ ne yɛ baguasee la ɔrɛlɛle me. 6Kɛlata ne se,
“Gihyɛm ɛmaa mede kɛ, bɛlɛkeha ye huhuhuhu wɔ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la avinli kɛ, ɛdawɔ nee Dwuuma bɛnyia adwenle kɛ bɛte belemgbunli anwo atua, ɛhye ati yɛɛ bɛlɛyɛ suakpole ne bane ne mɔ boɛ a. 7Eza ɔse bɛlɛkeha kɛ wɔdu Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma kɛ bɛbɔ ye nolo wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm kɛ wɔmɔ a ɛle belemgbunli wɔ Dwuda a. Kɛ ɔkɛyɛ biala la Maanle Maanle Belemgbunli ne bade ɛhye anwo bie. Ɛhye ati mesuzu kɛ ɛ nee me yɛkɛyia na yɛkɛva nwolɛ adwenle.”
8Medame noko menzoanle memanle bɛhɔzele ye kɛ, “Edwɛkɛ biala mɔɔ wɔha la ɛnle nɔhalɛ. Ɛdawɔ yɛɛ ɛlɛbɔ ɛ ti anu wɔaha a.”
9Ɔluakɛ ɛnee bɛkulo kɛ bɛnwunlonwunla yɛ amaa bɛaze kɛ, “Bɛ sa ɛkpa, bɛangola gyima ne yɛ.” O Nyamenle, kpogya me sa zo ɛ!
10Mekɛ ɛhye anu ala mengɔle Dɛlaya ara Hyɛmaya mɔɔ le Mɛhɛtabili anlɔnra ne mɔɔ la sua nu na ɔngola finde la sua nu, na ɔzele me kɛ, “Maa yɛhɔvea Nyamenle sua ne anu Ɛleka Nwuanzanwuanza ne na yɛtoto yɛ nwo nlenkɛ nu, ɔluakɛ bɛlɛba ɛnɛ nɔe bɛarahu wɔ.”
11Na menzele ye kɛ, “Ɛnea me a ɛnee sonla le kɛ medame, menriandi meavea? Kɛ ɛdwenle me ɛ? Menriandi mengɔnvea Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu na bɛangu me? Metua me nzo. Menrɛyɛ ye fee!”
12Na mendele ɔ bo kɛ tɛ Nyamenle a zoanle ye a, na ɔdaye a yebɔ ɔ ti anu yerabɔ me munzule ɛhye a, ɔboalekɛ Tobaya nee Sanebalate ɛbɔ ye ɛkpa. 13Bɛbɔle ye ɛkpa kɛ ɔraha ɛhye, amaa meazulo na meayɛ ɛhye, meayɛ ɛtane, na meanyia duma ɛtane, me nyunlu agua aze.
14Na menzele kɛ, “O me Nyamenle, kakye Tobaya nee Sanebalate bɛ nyɛleɛ ɛhye mɔ na tua bɛ nwolɛ kakɛ. Eza kakye Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ raalɛ Nowadaya nee Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma mɔɔ ɛha la kɔsɔɔti mɔɔ bɛlua bɛ nyɛleɛ zo bɛkpondɛ kɛ bɛka me ɛzulolɛ la noko.”
Gyima ne awieleɛ
15Yemɔti kenle abulanlu nee nwiɔ pɛpɛ, wɔ siane Yilɛle ne anu, ye kenle ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ abulanwiɔ nee nnu ne la azo yɛɛ banelielɛ ne wiele bɔkɔɔ a. 16Mɔɔ yɛ kpɔvolɛma mɔɔ wɔ maanle maanle mɔɔ zuozua yɛ la anu la dele la, bɛ ti zile aze na bɛzulole, ɔluakɛ bɛnwunle ye wienyi kɛ yɛ Nyamenle ne yɛɛ ɛboa yɛ ɛmaa yɛli gyima kpole ɛhye a.
17Mekɛ ɛhye amuala anu, Dwuu mgbanyima ne nee Tobaya hɛlɛhɛlɛle bɛ nwo ngɛlata. 18Menli dɔɔnwo mɔɔ wɔ Dwuda maanle nu la wɔ Tobaya anzi, ɔluakɛ Tobaya aye ɔ ze a le Ɛla ara Hyɛkanaya. (Hyɛkanaya le Dwuunli.) Eza Tobaya ara nrenya Gyihoheenan ɛgya Bɛlikaya ara Mɛhyɛlam ara raalɛ.
19Menli baka ninyɛne kpalɛ mɔɔ Tobaya ɛyɛ la anwo edwɛkɛ kile me na bɛahɔha mɔɔ menwɔha la bɛahile ye. Na ɔhɔle zolɛ ɔhɛlɛhɛlɛle me ngɛlata ɔbɔle me apo.

Title: NIH 7
Content:
1Akee bɛwiele bane ne kɔsɔɔti die. Menduoduale nlenkɛ mgbole ne mɔ ɛbonle, menyeyele nlenkɛ mgbole ne mɔ sinzavolɛma, edwɛndolɛma yɛɛ Livaema. 2Akee menyele me diema Haneenae nee Hananaya mɔɔ yemɔ a ɔnea aranemgbole ne azo la kɛ bɛ mu nwiɔ bɛnlea suakpole Gyɛlusalɛm, ɔluakɛ Hananaya di nɔhalɛ na ɔle sonla mɔɔ sulo Nyamenle tɛla menli dɔɔnwo a. 3Na menzele bɛ kɛ, “Aleɛ kye a bɛmmabukebuke Gyɛlusalɛm nlenkɛ mgbole ne mɔ kɔkpula kɛ sɛnzɛne ne kɛra anwuma la, yɛɛ saa nɔsolɛ sinzavolɛma ne mɔ kpɔne gyima a, bɛtoto nuhua na bɛva mbulalɛ ne mɔ bɛgua nlenkɛ ne mɔ anzi.” Eza menzele bɛ kɛ bɛye Gyɛlusalɛmma bie mɔ bɛmaa bɛ gyima, bɛmaa bie mɔ noko ɛzinza bɛdabɛ bɛ awuke ne mɔ nee awuke awuke mɔɔ zuozua bɛ la.
Menli mɔɔ vi nlɔnu rale la aluma
(Ɛzl 2.1-70)
4Gyɛlusalɛm le suakpole kpalɛ mɔɔ wale yɛɛ ɔtɛlɛ, noko menli mɔɔ wɔ zolɛ la anzo, yɛɛ azua dɔɔnwo ɛnle zolɛ. 5Nyamenle manle me adwenle na menvɛlɛle menli ne nee bɛ mgbanyima nee mbɔlɔba ne mɔ nee menli mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛkɛlɛhɛlɛ bɛ aluma wɔ bɛ mbusua ekpunli ekpunli aluma mbuluku ne mɔ anu la, na memanle bɛyiale kɛ bɛnleɛnlea bɛ aluma ne mɔ, kɛmɔ bɛhɛlɛle bɛ wɔ bɛ mbusua ekpunli ekpunli ne mɔ mbuluku ne mɔ anu la. Na menwunle mbusua mɔɔ lumuale vile akɛlɛzonlenlɛ nu rale la, na bɛmɛ ɛne:
6Nlɔnuma ne dɔɔnwo vi Babelɔn a ziale rale Gyɛlusalɛm nee Dwuda a, na ko biala ziale hɔle ɔdaye ye sua zo. Bɛ mgbanyima ne mɔ hɔdwule Babelonia mekɛ mɔɔ Belemgbunli Nɛbukadenɛza vale bɛ ɛlɔne nu donvula la. 7Menli mɔɔ lile bɛ ti nee bɛ rale la ɛne: Zɛlɛbabɛle, Dwɔhyua, Nihɛmaya, Azalaya, Releeyamaya, Neehameenae, Mɔdekae, Belehyan, Mesepɛlɛte, Begeveeyae, Nɛhum yɛɛ Beeyana.
8-25Yizilayɛ mbusua ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛ nee bɛ hɔle nlɔnu mɔɔ ziale rale la dodo ɛne:
Pɛlɔhye - Apenle nwiɔ, ɛya ko abulasuu nee nwiɔ
Hyɛfataya - Ɛya nsa abulasuu nee nwiɔ
Ɛla - Ɛya nsia abulanlu nee nwiɔ
Peehate Mowabe (Gyɛhyua nee Dwowabe abo zo amra) -
Apenle nwiɔ, ɛya mɔtwɛ bulu nee mɔtwɛ.
Yilam - Apenle ko, ɛya nwiɔ abulanlu nee nna
Zatu - Ɛya mɔtwɛ abulanla nee nnu
Zakeeyae - Ɛya nsuu abulasia
Benuwae - Ɛya nsia abulanla nee mɔtwɛ
Bibeeyae - Ɛya nsia abulanwiɔ nee mɔtwɛ
Azegade - Apenle nwiɔ, ɛya nsa abulanwiɔ nee nwiɔ
Adonaekam - Ɛya nsia abulasia nee nsuu
Begeveeyae - Apenle nwiɔ, abulasia nee nsuu
Eden - Ɛya nsia abulanlu nee nnu
Eta (mɔɔ eza bɛfɛlɛ ye Hɛzikaya la) - Abulahɔnla nee
mɔtwɛ
Hahyɛm - Ɛya nsa abulanwiɔ nee mɔtwɛ
Bizeeyae - Ɛya nsa abulanwiɔ nee nna
Hɛlefe - Ɛya ko menli bulu nee nwiɔ
Gebɛyɔn - Abulahɔnla nee nnu
26-38Menli mɔɔ bɛ mgbanyima anrɛɛ de azua ɛhye mɔ azo la noko ziale rale:
Bɛtelɛhɛm nee Nɛtɔfa - Ɛya ko abulatwɛ nee mɔtwɛ
Anato - Ɛya ko abulanwiɔ nee mɔtwɛ
Bɛte Azemeevɛte - Abulanla nee nwiɔ
Keleate Gyialem, Kɛfaela nee Biyɛlo - Ɛya nsuu abulanla nee nsa
Releema nee Giba - Ɛya nsia abulanwiɔ nee ko
Mekemahye - Ɛya ko abulanwiɔ nee nwiɔ
Bɛtɛle nee Eyae - Ɛya ko abulanwiɔ nee nsa
Nibo - Abulanlu nee nwiɔ
Yilam - Apenle ko ɛya nwiɔ abulanlu nee nna
Halem - Ɛya nsa abulanwiɔ
Gyɛleko - Ɛya nsa abulanla nee nnu
Lɔɔdo, Heedede yɛɛ Ono - Ɛya nsuu abulanwiɔ nee ko
Sɛnaa - Apenle nsa, ɛya ngɔnla abulasa
39-42Sɛlɛvolɛma mbusua ekpulike ekpulike mɔɔ vi nlɔnu ziale rale la ɛne:
Gyɛdaya (Gyɛhyua abo zo amra) - Ɛya ngɔnla
abulasuu nee nsa
Yemɛ - Apenle ko, abulanlu nee nwiɔ
Pahyɛ - Apenle ko, ɛya nwiɔ abulanla nee nsuu
Hɛlem - Apenle ko, bulu nee nsuu
43-45Livaema mbusua ekpulike ekpulike mɔɔ vi nlɔnu ziale rale la ɛne:
Gyɛhyua nee Kademeɛle (Hodavaya abo zo amra) - Abulasuu nee nna
Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua nu edwɛndolɛma (Esafe abo zo amra) - Ɛya ko abulanla nee mɔtwɛ
Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua sinzavolɛma (Hyalɛm, Etɛ, Talemɔn, Akɛbe Hataeta yɛɛ Hyobeeyae abo zo amra) - Ɛya ko abulasa nee mɔtwɛ
46-56Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua nu gyimayɛvoma mbusua ekpulike ekpulike mɔɔ vi nlɔnu ziale rale la ɛne:
Zaeha, Hasufa, Tabeeyo,
Kilɔso, Saya, Peedɔn,
Lɛbeena, Hagaba, Hyalemae,
Heenan, Gedɛle, Geehaa,
Riliaya, Rilizen, Nɛkoda,
Gazam, Ɛza, Pasia,
Bisae, Mɛyunem, Nɛfɛhyɛsem,
Bakebɛke, Hakufa, Haahɛ,
Bazelete, Mɛhaeda, Haahya,
Baakɔso, Sesɛla, Teema,
Nɛzaya, Hataefa.
57-59Sɔlɔmɔn sonvolɛma abo zo amra mbusua ekpulike ekpulike mɔɔ vi nlɔnu ziale rale la ɛne:
Soteeyae, Sofɛlɛte, Pɛlaeda,
Gyeeyala, Daakɔn, Gedɛle,
Hyɛfataya, Hatele, Pokɛlɛte,
Hazɛbeeyem yɛɛ Amɔn.
60Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua nu gyimayɛvoma nee Sɔlɔmɔn sonvolɛma abo zo amra ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti mɔɔ vi nlɔnu ziale rale la le ɛya nsa abulahɔnla nee nwiɔ.
61-62Menli ɛhye mɔ vi azua ɛhye mɔ azo rale na bɛangola bɛangile kɛ bɛ bo vi Yizilayɛ:
Tɛle Mila, Tɛle Haya, Kɛlɛbe, Adɔn, yɛɛ Yemɛ. Bɛle Dɛlaya, Tobaya yɛɛ Nɛkoda abo zo amra. Bɛlua menli ɛya nsia abulanla nee nwiɔ.
63-64Sɛlɛvolɛma mbusua ekpulike ekpulike ɛhye mɔ hɔkpondɛle bɛ nlenya mɔ aluma wɔ mbusua mbuluku ne mɔ anu na bɛannwu bɛ aluma nuhua, yemɔti bɛyele bɛ bɛvile sɛlɛvolɛlilɛ ne anu, ɔluakɛ bɛ nwo ɛnde. Bɛmɛ a le Hɔbaya, Hakɔzo yɛɛ Bazileeyae (mɔɔ gyale Bazileeyae mɔɔ vi Geleade la ara raalɛ na ɔlua zo ɔvale ɔ ye ɔ ze duma ɔdole ɔ nwo zo la). 65 Dwuu amɛnlado ne zele bɛ kɛ ɔnle kpalɛ kɛ bɛdi Nyamenle aleɛ nwuanzanwuanza ne bie kɔkpula kɛ sɛlɛvolɛ bie mɔɔ kola fa “Yulem nee Tɛmem” ne yɛ gyima la kɛra la.
66-69Menli mɔɔ bɛhyele bɛ donvula bɛhɔle nlɔnu mɔɔ ziale rale la amuala le apenle ngoko abulanla nee nwiɔ, ɛya nsa abulasia. Bɛ sonvolɛ mrenya nee mraalɛ le apenle nsuu, ɛya nsa abulasa nee nsuu:
Edwɛndolɛma, mrenya nee mraalɛ - Ɛya nwiɔ abulanla nee nnu
Mgbɔnwɔ - Ɛya nsuu abulasa nee nsia
Mgbɔnwɔndua - Ɛya nna abulasa nee nnu
Asoaso - Apenle nsia ɛya nsuu abulanwiɔ
70-72Menli ne dɔɔnwo wowɔle bɛ nwo dadeɛ boale manle bɛduale Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne gyima ne anwo kakɛ ne. Kɛ bɛzile bɛduale ye la ɛne:
Amɛnlado ne: Ezukoa nvutuke kilo mɔtwɛ
Ahyɛnze kuloonwu abulanlu
Sɛlɛvolɛma adɛladeɛ ɛya nnu abulasa
Mbusua mgbanyinli: Ezukoa nvutuke kilo ɛya ko
abulasia nee mɔtwɛ
Dwɛtɛ fufule kilo apenle ko,
ɛya nwiɔ abulanlu
Menli mɔɔ hale la: Ezukoa nvutuke kilo ɛya ko
abulasia nee mɔtwɛ
Dwɛtɛ fufule kilo ɛya ko abulanla
Sɛlɛvolɛma adɛladeɛ abulasia nee nsuu
73 Na akee Yizilayɛma kɔsɔɔti, sɛlɛvolɛma, Livaema, Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne sinzavolɛma, edwɛndolɛma, Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua nu sonvolɛma yɛɛ Yizilayɛma mɔɔ hale la amuala hɔdɛnlanle aze wɔ bɛ azua ne mɔ azo.

Title: NIH 8
Content:
Ɛzela kenga Mɛla ne ahile menli ne
1Mɔɔ ɔkadwu ye siane nsuu ne azo la, ɛnee Yizilayɛma kɔsɔɔti akee abo ɛdila wɔ bɛ azua ne mɔ azo. Yemɔti siane zɔhane kenle ne mɔɔ lumua la, bɛ muala bɛrayiale Gyɛlusalɛm ɛleka kpatawienyi ne mɔɔ wɔ Nzule Anlenkɛ Kpole ne anyunlu la. Bɛzele sɛlɛvolɛ Ɛzela, mɔɔ eza le mɛla kilehilevolɛ la kɛ ɔva Mɛla Buluku ne mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma luale Mosisi anwo zo vale manle Yizilayɛma la ɔrɛla. 2Yemɔti Ɛzela vale Mɛla Buluku ne rale ɛleka mɔɔ bɛyia la. Ɛnee bɛyia tɛɛnye, mrenya nee mraalɛ nee ngakula mɔɔ ɛnyi na bɛlɛ ndelebɛbo la amuala wɔ ɛkɛ. 3Na ɛkɛ ne, wɔ Nzule Anlenkɛ Kpole ne anyunlu kpatawienyi ne azo, Ɛzela gyinlanle manle ɔ nzi hɔle anlenkɛ ne anloa na ɔbɔle ɔ bo aleɛbahye ne ɔgengale Mɛla ne ɔhilele bɛ toonwo sɛnzɛngyinla. Na menli ne gyelele bɛ nzo diele ye kpalɛ.
4Ɛzela gyinlanle sɛlɛdwee bie mɔɔ ayia ne ati bɛva ndaboa bɛbo la azo a gengale Mɛla ne a. Matetaya, Hyima, Anaya, Yulaya, Helekaya yɛɛ Meeyasaya gyinlanle ɔ sa fema zo, yɛɛ Pɛdaya, Maehyeeyɛle, Malekaya, Hahyɛm, Hahyebadeena, Zɛkalaya, yɛɛ Mɛhyɛlam gyinlanle ye bɛne zo.
5Ɛzela gyinlanle sɛlɛdwee ne azo la ɛnee ɔ nwo zo ɛhɔ anwuma ɛdɛla bɛ. Mɔɔ ɔbukele Mɛla Buluku ne anu ala la, bɛ kɔsɔɔti bɛdwazole bɛgyinlanle. 6Na Ɛzela zele kɛ, “Bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma, Nyamenle Bedevinli ne ayɛlɛ.”
Menli ne kɔsɔɔti manle bɛ sa zo na bɛliele zolɛ, “Amen, Amen.” Akee bɛbɔle bɛ ti aze na bɛbutubutule bɛ nye aze bɛyeyɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma.
7Akee bɛdwazole bɛgyinlanle bɛ bo zo ne mɔ. Na Livaema ɛhye mɔ: Gyɛhyua, Beenae, Hyɛlibaya, Gyeemen, Akɛbe, Hyabɛtae, Hodaya, Meeyasaya, Kɛlaeta, Azalaya, Dwozabade, Heenan yɛɛ Pɛlaya hilehilele Mɛla ne mɔ anu hilele bɛ. 8Bɛgengale buluku ne mɔɔ Nyamenle Mɛla ne wɔ nu la bɛhilele menli ne; bɛhilehilele nuhua wienyi bɛhilele bɛ, amaa bɛade ɔ bo kpalɛ.
9Mɔɔ menli ne dele mɔɔ Mɛla ne se la, debie hwenle bɛ nu na bɛzunle. Na Sɛlɛvolɛ Nihɛmaya, mɔɔ le amɛnlado ne, nee mɛla kilehilevolɛ Ɛzela, nee Livaema mɔɔ hilehilele menli ne la zele bɛ kɛ, “Ɛnɛ kenle ye le nwuanzanwuanza maa Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne. Bɛmmasu yɛɛ bɛmmadi nyane biala.”
10Akee Nihɛmaya zele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛhɔ sua nu na bɛhɔlie bɛ nye; bɛli debie mɔɔ yɛ fɛ na bɛnlo nwanye fɛlɛko. Bɛmaa menli mɔɔ ɛnlɛ bie la bie. Ɔluakɛ ɛnɛ le Ɛdɛnkɛma kenle nwuanzanwuanza. Bɛmmadi nyane, ɔluakɛ fɛlɛkolilɛ ne mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma fa maa la le bɛ anwosesebɛ.”
11Na Livaema ne gogole menli ne amuala ahonle zele kɛ, “Bɛyɛ ngungoonwu, ɔluakɛ ɛnɛ kenle ye le kenle nwuanzanwuanza; bɛmmadi nyane.” 12Yemɔti menli ne kɔsɔɔti hɔle sua nu hɔlile debie na bɛnlonle nwanye. Bɛ nee menli mɔɔ ɛnlɛ bie la hyɛle mɔɔ bɛlɛ la na bɛlile fɛlɛko, ɔboalekɛ bɛdele edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ bɛgengale bɛhilele bɛ la abo.
Kpɔda Bo Ɛdɛnlanlɛ Ɛvoyia ne
13Ye kenle nwiɔ ne azo, mbusua mgbanyinli, sɛlɛvolɛma, yɛɛ Livaema bɔle nu hɔle sɛlɛvolɛ Ɛzela ɛkɛ ne kɛ bɛkazukoa mɛla ne. 14 Na bɛnwunle kɛ mɛla ne mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma luale Mosisi anwo zo vale manle bɛ la, bɛhɛlɛ ye nuhua kɛ, saa siane nsuu Ɛvoyia ne dwu a ɔwɔ kɛ Yizilayɛma tɛnlɛdɛnla kpɔda kpɔda bo, 15na bɛbɔ ye nolo wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm nee azuamgbole nee ngyikyi kɔsɔɔti azo kɛ, “Bɛhɔ awoka ne mɔ azo bɛhɔbubu ɔlivi nya, ɛbɔ nu ɔlivi nya, mbaka nya mɔɔ kola maa alubo, yɛɛ arɛlɛ nee mraalɛ kukue mrɛlakɛ bɛrasisi kpɔda kpɔda, kɛmɔ bɛhɛlɛ ye wɔ Mɛla ne anu la.”
16Yemɔti menli ne hɔpɛle mrɛlakɛ, bɛbubule nya nya bɛrasisile kpɔda kpɔda wɔ bɛ azua ne mɔ ati zo, wɔ bɛ awuke ne mɔ anu, wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne alie wienyi ne anwo yɛɛ ɛleka kpatawienyi ne mɔ mɔɔ wɔ Nzule Anlenkɛ Kpole ne nee Yifelaem Anlenkɛ Kpole ne mɔ anyunlu la. 17Bɛ kɔsɔɔti mɔɔ bɛvi nlɔnu bɛrale la sisile kpɔda dɛnlanle ɔ bo. Ɔvi Nɛn ara Dwɔhyua mekɛ zo toonwo mɔɔ radwule mekɛ zɔhane la, bɔ zo mɔɔ bɛyɛ ɛhye bie ɔ. Yemɔti awie biala anwo zandele ye na ɔ nye liele. 18Ɔvi kenle ko zɔhane, alehyenlɛ biala Ɛzela gengale Nyamenle Mɛla buluku ne hilele menli ne. Bɛlile ɛvoyia ne kenle nsuu. Ye kenle mɔtwɛ ne azo, kɛmɔ mɛla ne se la, bɛyiale bɛyɛle nzɛlɛlɛ na bɛvale ɛvoyialilɛ ne bɛrale awieleɛ.

Title: NIH 9
Content:
Menli ne ka bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ
1Siane ko ne ala anu, ye kenle abulanwiɔ nee nna ne azo, Yizilayɛma hedale ɛrele, vale mgbane wɔzale bɛ nwo, na bɛyiale nu bɛhyele ɛhɔne bɛlile bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ anwo nyane. 2Yizilayɛma ne hwenle bɛ nwo vile nyɛvolɛ ne mɔ avinli na bɛhanle bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ nee bɛ ze mɔ ninyɛndane ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti bɛdole gua. 3Bɛgyinlanle nzisi bɛgengale Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne Mɛla ne bɛhilele bɛ kɛyɛ dɔnehwele nsa. Bɛvale dɔnehwele nsa noko bɛhanle bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ na bɛyeyɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne. 4Livaema sɛlɛdwee ne, menli mɔɔ gyinlanle zolɛ la a le ɛhye mɔ: Gyɛhyua, Beenae, Kademeɛle, Hyɛbanaya, Bɛnae, Hyɛlibaya, Beenae yɛɛ Kɛneenae. Bɛvale ɛnelɛ kpole bɛzɛlɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne.
5Akee Livaema ɛhye mɔ: Gyɛhyua, Kademeɛle, Beenae, Hahyabenaya, Hodaya, Hyɛlibaya, Hyɛbanaya yɛɛ Pɛtahaya zele kɛ,
“Bɛdwazo bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne ayɛlɛ;
bɛye ye ayɛlɛ dahuu!
Kanza dasanli biala ayɛlɛyelɛ le ekyi bɔbɔ a,
awie biala ɛye ye duma nwuanzanwuanza ne ayɛlɛ.”
Ɛtanehanlɛ nzɛlɛlɛ ne
6Na Yizilayɛma amuala yɛle nzɛlɛlɛ ɛhye:
“Wɔmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma, ɛ ngomekye ala yɛɛ ɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma a;
wɔmɔ yɛɛ ɛbɔle anwuma nee anwomanyunlu nwɔlɔra a.
Wɔmɔ yɛɛ ɛbɔle azɛlɛ nee zolɛ ninyɛne, nyevile nee nuhua
ninyɛne a;
wɔmɔ yɛɛ ɛmanle bɛ kɔsɔɔti ngoane a.
Anwuma tumivolɛma kɔsɔɔti bɔ bɛ ti aze sonle wɔ.
7 Wɔmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle yɛɛ ɛyele Ebelam,
ɛyele ye ɛvile Yule mɔɔ wɔ Babelonia
na ɛhakyile ye duma ɛvɛlɛle ye Ebileham.
8 Ɛnwunle kɛ ɔdi nɔhalɛ ɔmaa wɔ,
na ɛ nee ye yɛle ngyekyeleɛ.
Ɛbɔle ye ɛwɔkɛ kɛ ɛkɛva Keenama,
Hɛtema, yɛɛ Amɔlema, Pɛlɛzema nee Gyibɛsema,
yɛɛ Gɛgahyema azɛlɛ ne mɔ ɛkɛmaa ɔ bo zo amra.
Ɛlile wɔ ɛwɔkɛ zo, ɔboalekɛ ɛdi nɔhalɛ.
9 “Ɛnwunle kɛ yɛ mgbanyinli zile nwunle amaneɛ wɔ Yigyibiti,
ɛdele bɛ ɛzunlɛ wɔ Ndɔ Nyevile ne anloa na ɛliele bɛ.
10 Ɛyɛle nwanwane ninyɛne ɛhilele Yigyibiti belemgbunli ne,
ɛyɛle bie ɛhilele ye mgbanyima nee menli mɔɔ wɔ azɛlɛ
ne azo la,
ɔboalekɛ ɛze kɛ bɛzile bɛsisile wɔ menli ne la.
Na ɛliele duma ne mɔɔ ɛnɛ nee ɛnɛ ɛtɛdɛ la.
11 Ɛkpakyele adenle ɛdole nyevile ne anu,
na ɛmanle bɛluale azɛlɛ resee zo bɛpɛle;
menli mɔɔ ɛlɛfoa bɛ la wule azule buma ne anu,
bɛnlomanle kɛ bolɛ wɔ nyevile ne mɔɔ ɛzɛkye la anu.
12 Ɛvale amungu bolomolo ɛlile bɛ nyunlu alehyenlɛ,
ɛvale senle bolonwonwo ɛhilele bɛ adenle aledwolɛ.
13 Ɛvi anwuma ɛdwule Boka Saenae azo,
ɛdendɛle ɛhilele wɔ menli ne wɔ boka ne azo;
ɛmanle bɛ nɔhalɛ mɛla nee ngyehyɛlɛ
na ɛhilehilele bɛ kɛ bɛli zo.
14Ɛhilele bɛ kɛ bɛzie Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ne nwuanzanwuanza,
na ɛluale wɔ sonvolɛ Mosisi anwo zo ɛvale mɛla ne ɛmanle bɛ.
15 “Ɛhɔne hunle bɛ, ɛmanle bɛ anwuma kpanwo,
nzuhɔne hunle bɛ, ɛmanle bɛ bolɛ nu nzukpa.
Ɛzele bɛ kɛ bɛhɔva azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ ɛhanle ndane ɛvale
ɛmanle bɛ la.
16 Noko yɛ mgbanyima yɛle mgbanyizonle nee anzosesebɛ,
na bɛkpole kɛ bɛnrɛli wɔ mɛla ne mɔ azo.
17 Bɛanyɛ tieyɛ; bɛ rɛle vile mɔɔ ɛyɛle la amuala,
bɛ rɛle vile nwanwane ninyɛne mɔɔ ɛyɛle la.
Mgbanyizonle nu, bɛyele sonla lile bɛ ti
kɛ ɔva bɛ ɔzia ɔhɔ kanrazonlenlɛ nu wɔ Yigyibiti.
Noko ɛle Nyamenle mɔɔ ɛfa ɛtane ɛkyɛ,
ɛkyɛ na wɔava ɛya; ɛle ɛlolɛ nee ɛhulolɛ.
Wɔ anwunvɔnezelɛ ne le kpole bo zo, wɔamkpo bɛ.
18 Bɛyɛle ɛnlankɛ ananze,
na bɛzele kɛ ɔle bɛ nyamenle;
kɛ yemɔ a ɔyele bɛ ɔvile Yigyibiti a.
Bɛhanle wɔ ɛya kpole!
19 Noko wɔamkpo bɛ wɔ fienemgbole ne anu,
ɔluakɛ wɔ anwunvɔnezelɛ ne le kpole,
Wɔanye amungu bolomolo ne anzɛɛ senle bolonwonwo ne
mɔɔ hilele bɛ adenle ewiazo nee nɔɔzo la.
20Wɔ kpalɛ ti ɛvale wɔ Sunsum ne ɛhilehilele bɛ,
ɛvale mana ɛlile bɛ adane, ɛmanle bɛ nzukpa bɛnlonle.
21Ɛvolɛ abulanla, wɔ fienemgbole ne anu,
ɛmanle bɛ debie biala mɔɔ bɛhyianle nwolɛ la;
bɛ ndanlɛ antete yɛɛ bɛ gyakɛ amkpomgba ɛlɛ.
22“Ɛmanle bɛlile maanle maanle mɔɔ nee bɛ bɔ ɛweɛne la
anwo zo konim,
na ɛhyɛle bɛ azɛlɛ ne mɔ ɛmanle bɛ.
Bɛhonle bɛvale Hɛhyebɔn azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ Saehɔn di zo belemgbunli la,
yɛɛ Beehyan maanle ne mɔɔ Ɔɔgo di nu belemgbunli la.
23Ɛmanle bɛ mralɛ dɔɔnwo kɛ anwomanyunlu nwɔlɔra,
na ɛmanle bɛhonle bɛvale maanle ne
mɔɔ ɛvale ɛbɔle bɛ nlenya mɔ ɛwɔkɛ la.
24 Bɛlile Keenama anwo zo konim bɛvale azɛlɛ ne,
ɛvole menli mɔɔ wɔ ɛkɛ ne la akɔme zo;
ɛmanle wɔ menli ne tumi bɛvale Keena arelemgbunli
nee menli bɛyɛle mɔɔ bɛdabɛ bɛkulo la.
25 Wɔ menli ne mɔ honle vale ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ:
azuamgbole mɔɔ bɛhye nwolɛ, azɛlɛ mɔɔ kye aleɛ,
azua mɔɔ anwonyia ɛyiyi bɛ, bula mɔɔ bɛbɔ,
ɔlivi mbaka, mbaka mɔɔ so ma, yɛɛ vanye tola.
Bɛlile debie biala mɔɔ bɛkulo la na bɛyɛle mbelane,
bɛlile ninyɛne kpalɛ mɔɔ ɛmanle bɛ la kɔsɔɔti anwo fɛlɛko.
26 “Wɔ menli ne dele ɛ nwo atua na bɛandie wɔ aneɛ,
bɛhakyile bɛ nzi bɛzile wɔ mɛla ne.
Bɛhunle Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma mɔɔ bɔle bɛ kɔkɔ,
na bɛzele bɛ kɛ bɛzia bɛdoa wɔ la;
bɛbɔle munzule kpole!
27Yemɔti ɛmanle bɛ kpɔvolɛma lile bɛ nwo zo konim,
na bɛziele bɛ.
Wɔ bɛ amaneɛnwunlɛ nu, bɛzɛlɛle wɔ moalɛ,
na ɛliele zolɛ wɔ anwuma lɔ.
Wɔ anwunvɔnezelɛ ne kpole ti,
ɛmanle bɛ mgbanyima ɛmanle bɛlile bɛ ti,
na bɛliele bɛ bɛvile bɛ kpɔvolɛma asa anu.
28Anzonudwolɛ rale, na bɛyɛle ɛtane bɛtiale wɔ bieko,
na eza ɛmanle bɛ kpɔvolɛma lile bɛ nwo zo konim.
Noko mɔɔ bɛvule bɛ nwo na bɛzɛlɛle la,
ɛdele bɛ ne wɔ anwuma lɔ, na mekɛ dɔɔnwo ne ala
ɔlua wɔ anwunvɔnezelɛ ne kpole ne ati, ɛliele bɛ.
29 Ɛbɔle bɛ kɔkɔ kɛ bɛli wɔ ngilehilelɛ ne mɔ azo,
na mgbanyizonle nu ala bɛkpole
wɔ mɛla nee wɔ ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔ;
noko wɔ mɛla zo ɛlilɛ ne a le ngoane adenle ne a.
Adubɛnwo nee anzosesebɛ nu, bɛkpole kɛ bɛnrɛli zolɛ.
30 Ɛbɔle bɛ kɔkɔ abotane nu ɛvolɛ biala,
ɛluale wɔ Sunsum ne azo
ɛmanle wɔ kpɔmanvolɛma dendɛle,
na wɔ menli ne yɛle ateakpaso;
yemɔti ɛmanle maanle maanle lile bɛ nwo zo konim.
31Noko, kɛmɔ wɔ anwunvɔnezelɛ ne le kpole la ati,
wɔamkpo bɛ yɛɛ wɔanzɛkye bɛ.
Ɛle ɛlolɛ nee anwunvɔnezelɛ Nyamenle.
32 “O Nyamenle, yɛ Nyamenle, ɛle kpole!
Ɛ nwo yɛ ɛzulolɛ, ɛle tumivolɛ!
Ɛsie wɔ ngyekyeleɛ ɛwɔkɛ ne mɔ nɔhalɛ nu.
Ɔvi mekɛ mɔɔ Aselea arelemgbunli sisile yɛ badwu ɛnɛ,
yɛnwu amaneɛ dɔɔnwo!
Yɛ arelemgbunli, yɛ mgbanyima,
yɛ sɛlɛvolɛma nee yɛ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma,
Yɛ mgbanyinli nee yɛ menli ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti ɛnwu amaneɛ.
Kakye yɛ na yɛnwu amaneɛ somaa!
33Ɛdi benle kɛ wɔhwe yɛ nzo a;
yɛyɛ ɛtane bɔbɔ ɛdeɛ, noko wɔli nɔhalɛ.
34Yɛ arelemgbunli, yɛ mgbanyima nee yɛ sɛlɛvolɛma,
yɛɛ yɛ mgbanyinli anli wɔ mɛla ne azo.
Bɛandie wɔ mɛla ne mɔ yɛɛ bɛande wɔ kɔkɔbɔlɛ ne.
35Bɛanzonle wɔ wɔ bɛ maanle ye anu.
Bɛannwu boɛ kpole ne mɔɔ ɛyɛle bɛ la,
na yeayɛ azɛlɛ kpandaanwo ne mɔɔ kye aleɛ la,
yɛɛ bɛandwe bɛ nwo bɛanvi ɛtane nwo.
36Ɛnɛ yɛyɛ ahanra wɔ maanle mɔɔ ɛvale ɛmanle yɛ nlenya
mɔ la anu,
wɔ azɛlɛ ye mɔɔ kye aleɛ maa yɛ la azo.
37Aleɛ mɔɔ azɛlɛ ne maa la kɔ arelemgbunli ne mɔ
mɔɔ sie yɛ la ɛkɛ, ɔboalekɛ yɛyɛ ɛtane.
Bɛfa yɛ nee yɛ nlankɛ bɛyɛ mɔɔ bɛdabɛ bɛkulo la,
yɛwɔ nyane nu kpole!”
Menli ne yɛ ngyehyɛlɛ
38Ɔlua ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ kɔsɔɔti mɔɔ ɛsisi la ati, yɛdayɛ Yizilayɛma, yɛyɛ ngyehyɛlɛ ɛhye, na yɛ mgbanyima, yɛ Livaema nee yɛ sɛlɛvolɛma ava bɛ sa awula ɔ bo.

Title: NIH 10
Content:
1Sonla mɔɔ lumuale vale ɔ sa wulale ngyehyɛlɛ ne abo la a le amɛnlado ne, Hakalaya ara Nihɛmaya. Akee Zɛdikaya ɔdaye ɔvale ɔ sa ɔwulale ɔ bo. Menli ɛhye mɔ noko vale bɛ sa wulale ɔ bo: 2-8Sɛlɛvolɛma:
Sɛlaya, Azalaya, Gyɛlɛmaya,
Pahyɛ, Amalaya, Malekaya,
Hatɛhye, Hyɛbanaya, Malɛke,
Hɛlem, Mɛlɛmo, Obadaya,
Daneɛle, Genɛtɔn, Bɛlɛke,
Mɛhyɛlam, Abaegya, Maegyamen,
Meeyazaya, Belegeeyae, yɛɛ Hyɛmaya.
9-13Livaema:
Gyɛhyua, Azanaya ara nrenya ne,
Benuwae mɔɔ vi Hɛneedade abusua nu la,
Kademeɛle, Hyɛbanaya, Hodaya,
Kɛlaeta, Pɛlaya, Heenan,
Maeka, Rilihɔbo, Hahyabaya,
Zakɛ, Hyɛlibaya, Hyɛbanaya,
Hodaya, Beenae yɛɛ Bɛnaenu.
14-27Mbusua mgbanyinli:
Pɛlɔhye, Peehate Mowabe,
Ɛlam, Zatu, Beenae,
Bɛnae, Azegade, Bibeeyae,
Adonaegya, Begeveeyae, Eden,
