Etɛ, Hɛzikaya, Azɛ,
Hodaya, Hahyɛm, Bizeeyae,
Hɛlefe, Anato, Nibeeyae,
Magepeahye, Mɛhyɛlam, Hizɛ,
Mɛhyɛzabɛle, Zeedɔko, Gyadua,
Pɛlataya, Heenan, Anaya,
Hohyia, Hananaya, Hahyɛbe,
Halohɛhye, Paeleha, Hyobɛke,
Rilihɛm, Hahyabena, Meeyasaya,
Ahaya, Heenan, Anan,
Malɛke, Hɛlem, yɛɛ Beeyana.
Ngyehyɛlɛ ne
28Menli ne yɛle ngyehyɛlɛ ɛhye: Yizilayɛma, sɛlɛvolɛma, Livaema, nlenkɛ mgbole sinzavolɛma, edwɛndolɛma, Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua nu sonvolɛma, yɛɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛha mɔɔ ɔlua Nyamenle Mɛla ne azolilɛ ti yɛhwe yɛ nwo yɛvi nyɛvolɛ mɔɔ de maanle ye anu la anwo la, yɛ nee yɛ mraalɛ, yɛ mra mrenya mɔɔ ɛdu zo na bɛlɛ ndelebɛbo la, 29yɛ nee yɛ mgbanyima yɛbɔ nuhua yɛdi amonle, kɛ saa yɛbulu zolɛ a munzule ɛha yɛ, na yɛse kɛ, yɛbali Nyamenle Mɛla ne mɔɔ ɔluale ye sonvolɛ Mosisi anwo zo ɔvale ɔmanle yɛ la azo; yɛbali mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma, yɛ Awulae ne kɛze yɛ biala la, yɛɛ yɛbali mɛla ne nee ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔ azo.
30 Yɛnrɛva yɛ mra mraalɛ yɛnrɛmaa awie gyɛne biala mɔɔ ɛnle Dwuunli la ara nrenya agyalɛ, yɛɛ yɛnrɛmaa yɛ mra mrenya ɛnrɛgya bɛ mra mraalɛ.
31 Saa menli zɔhane mɔ bie fa bɛ ninyɛne adɔne ba gua wɔ Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ne anzɛɛ kenle nwuanzanwuanza nu a, yɛnrɛdɔ.
Ɛvolɛ mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nsuu la biala yɛnrɛzo ɛya wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo, yɛɛ yɛbapɛ kakɛ biala mɔɔ wɔ ɛkɛ ne la anu.
32 Ɛvolɛ biala yɛ nuhua ko biala ɔwɔ kɛ tua dwɛtɛ fufule tone nu gelamo nnu, amaa bɛava bɛanlea Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne.
33Yɛbava ninyɛne yɛara yɛamaa bɛava bɛayɛ ɛhye mɔ wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu bɛamaa Nyamenle: kpanwo nwuanzanwuanza ne, dahuu aleɛ ma azubɔdeɛ ne, nane mɔɔ kenle ko biala bɛbayela bɛabɔ azu la, Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ne azubɔlɛ ninyɛne, Siane Fofolɛ ɛvoyialilɛ ninyɛne, yɛɛ azubɔlɛ nwuanzanwuanza mɔɔ ɛha la anwo ninyɛne, azubɔlɛ mɔɔ bɛfa bɛanrinzi Yizilayɛma ɛtane ne mɔ la anwo ninyɛne, yɛɛ debie biala mɔɔ bɛhyia nwolɛ wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu la.
34Ɛvolɛ biala, yɛdayɛ Yizilayɛma, sɛlɛvolɛma, yɛɛ Livaema, yɛbagua nzeleba yɛanwu mbusua mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ fa ɛyɛne ba maa bɛfa bɛyela nyɛmoa mɔɔ bɛfa bɛabɔ azu bɛamaa Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛ Nyamenle ne, kɛmɔ mɛla ne kile la.
35 Ɛvolɛ biala yɛbava abɛlɛ mɔɔ yɛkɛlumua yɛkɛbu nee ma biala mɔɔ yɛkɛlumua yɛkɛde la yɛahɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu kɛ azubɔdeɛ.
36 Belamunli ralɛ nrenya biala mɔɔ yɛkɛwo ye la, yɛbava ye yɛahɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu yɛahɔmaa sɛlɛvolɛma ne yɛamaa bɛadu ye bɛamaa Nyamenle, kɛmɔ Mɛla ne kile la. Eza yɛbadu yɛ ɛnlankɛ, boane, yɛɛ abɔnkye ralɛ biala mɔɔ bɛkɛlumua bɛkɛwo ye la yɛamaa Nyamenle.
37 Ɛvolɛ biala yɛbava abɛlɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛlumua bɛkɛbu la ɛdɔkɛ nee nwolɛ ninyɛne mɔɔ le kɛ nwanye, ɔlivi nwole yɛɛ ma ngakyile yɛahɔmaa sɛlɛvolɛma mɔɔ wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu la yɛamaa bɛava bɛabɔ azu.
Livaema mɔɔ dielie ninyɛne ngyɛnu bulu ɛkpɔ ngoko wɔ namunamu ɛya avule ne mɔ anu la, yɛbava yɛ bɛyɔba ngyɛnu bulu ɛkpɔ ngoko ne mɔ yɛahɔmaa bɛ. 38 Saa bɛlɛdielie ngyɛnu bulu ɛkpɔ ngoko ne mɔ a, ɔwɔ kɛ sɛlɛvolɛma mɔɔ le Aalɔn abo zo amra la nee Livaema dua nwolɛ, yɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ Livaema fa Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu ngyɛnu bulu ɛkpɔ ko ne kɔsie Ɛzonlenlɛ sua ne ninyɛnezielɛ ɛleka ne. 39Ɔwɔ kɛ Yizilayɛma nee Livaema fa abɛlɛ, nwanye yɛɛ ɔlivi nwole mɔɔ bɛ nee ye kɛra la kɔ ninyɛnezielɛ ɛleka ne mɔɔ bɛsie Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne ahyɛnze ne mɔ nu la nee ɛleka mɔɔ sɛlɛvolɛma mɔɔ wɔ gyima nu, Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne sinzavolɛma nee edwɛndolɛma ne mɔ wɔ la.
Yɛnrɛbu yɛ nye yɛnrɛgua yɛ Nyamenle Sua ne azo.

Title: NIH 11
Content:
Menli mɔɔ dɛnlanle Gyɛlusalɛm la
1Dwuu mgbanyima ne mɔ dɛnlanle Gyɛlusalɛm, na menli mɔɔ hale la, bɛguale nzeleba, amaa bɛahyɛ abusua biala anu ekpunli bulu bɛamaa ekpunli ko adɛnla Gyɛlusalɛm suakpole nwuanzanwuanza ne azo, na ekpunli ngɔnla ne noko adɛnlɛdɛnla azua nee namunamu mɔɔ ɛha la azo. 2Na menli ne hanvole menli mɔɔ bɛdabɛ bɛ ahonle nu bɛyele bɛ nwo bɛmanle kɛ bɛmɛ bɛtɛnla Gyɛlusalɛm la. 3 Wɔ azua nee azuamgbole ne mɔ azo, Yizilayɛma, sɛlɛvolɛma, Livaema, Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua nu gyimayɛvoma, yɛɛ Sɔlɔmɔn sonvolɛma abo zo amra ne mɔ dɛnlanle bɛdabɛ bɛ azua nee bɛ azɛlɛ zo.
Dwudama nee Bɛngyamanema bie mɔ dɛnlanle Gyɛlusalɛm.
4 Dwuda abusua ekpunli nu amra:
Ɛzaya ara Ataya, ɔle Zɛkalaya anlɔnra. Ye mgbanyima ne bie mɔ a le Amalaya, Hyɛfataya yɛɛ Mahalali. Bɛle Dwuda ara nrenya Pilɛze abo zo amra.
5Bɛlɛke ara Meeyasaya, ɔle Kɔlehozi anlɔnra. Ye mgbanyima ne bie mɔ a le Hazaya, Adaya, Dwɔyalebe, yɛɛ Zɛkalaya. Dwuda ara nrenya Hyila abo zo amra ɔ.
6Pilɛze abo zo amra ne nuhua ɛya nna abulasia nee mɔtwɛ mɔɔ lɛ gyinlabelɛ kpalɛ la dɛnlanle Gyɛlusalɛm.
7 Bɛngyaman abusua ekpunli nu amra:
Mɛhyɛlam ara Salu, ɔle Dwowabe anlɔnra. Ye mgbanyima ne bie mɔ a le Pɛdaya, Kɔlaya, Meeyasaya, Yeteɛle yɛɛ Gyɛhyaya.
8Gabeeyae nee Saleeyae le Salu anwo amra fɔɔnwo. Bɛngyaman abo zo amra mɔɔ dɛnlanle Gyɛlusalɛm la le ɛya ngɔnla abulanwiɔ nee mɔtwɛ. 9Zekelae ara Dwowɛle a le bɛ kpanyinli a, yɛɛ Dwuda mɔɔ le Hasɛnua ara nrenya ne la le suakpole ne azo neavolɛ mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nwiɔ.
10 Sɛlɛvolɛma:
Dwɔyalebe ara Gyɛdaya nee Gyeeken.
11Helekaya ara Sɛlaya, ɔle Mɛhyɛlam anlɔnra. Ye mgbanyima ne bie mɔ a le Zeedɔko, Mɛlayo yɛɛ Ahaetɛbe mɔɔ le Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli ne. 12Abusua ɛhye anu amra mɔɔ yɛle Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu gyima la amuala le ɛya mɔtwɛ abulanwiɔ nee nwiɔ. Gyɛloham ara Adaya, ɔle Pɛlalaya alɔnra. Adaya mgbanyima ne bie mɔ a le Amezae, Zɛkalaya, Pahyɔ yɛɛ Malekaya. 13Ɛfa bɛ kɔsɔɔti ɛbɔ nuhua a, menli ɛya nwiɔ nee nwiɔ a wɔ nu mɔɔ le bɛ mbusua mgbanyinli a.
Azali ara Amahyesae, ɔle Aheezae anlɔnra. Ye mgbanyima ne bie mɔ a le Mɛhyɛlɛmo nee Yemɛ. 14Abusua ɛhye anu menli ɛya ko abulanwiɔ nee mɔtwɛ le ɛlɔnema titile. Bɛ kpanyinli a le Zabedeɛle mɔɔ vi abusua titile nu la.
15 Livaema:
Hahyɛbe ara Hyɛmaya, ɔle Azelaekam anlɔnra. Ye mgbanyima ne bie mɔ a le Hahyabaya nee Bɛnae.
16Hyabɛtae nee Dwozabade le Livaema titile. Bɛmɛ a bɛnea gyima mɔɔ bɛyɛ ye wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anwo la azo a.
17Maeka ara Matanaya, ɔle Zabedae anlɔnra yɛɛ ɔle Esafe abo zo sonla. Yemɔ yɛɛ ɔlumuale ɔgyinlanle Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua nu edwɛndolɛma ati ɔmanle bɛdole moyɛlɛ nzɛlɛlɛ edwɛne ne a. Bakebukaya a ɛnee le Matanaya boavolɛ a.
Hyamua ara Abeda, ɔle Geelale anlɔnra yɛɛ Gyɛdutɛn abo zo sonla ɔ.
18Ɛka bɛ kɔsɔɔti ɛbɔ nuhua a ɛnee Livaema mɔɔ dɛnlanle Gyɛlusalɛm suakpole nwuanzanwuanza ne azo la le ɛya nwiɔ abulatwɛ nee nna.
19 Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne sinzavolɛma:
Akɛbe, Talemɔn nee bɛ nwo amra kɔsɔɔti le ɛya ko abulasuu nee nwiɔ. 20Yizilayɛma, sɛlɛvolɛma, yɛɛ Livaema mɔɔ hale la dɛnlanle bɛdabɛ bɛ azua nee bɛ azuamgbole zo wɔ Dwuda maanle nu. 21Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne gyimayɛvoma ne dɛnlanle Gyɛlusalɛm awɔdenle ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Ofɛle la azo. Zaeha nee Gehyepa a nleanle bɛ nwo zo a.
22Sonla mɔɔ nleanle Livaema mɔɔ dɛnlanle Gyɛlusalɛm la anwo zo la a le Beenae ara Ɛzae, ɔle Hahyabaya anlɔnra. Ye mgbanyima ne bie mɔ a le Matanaya nee Maeka. Ɔbɔ Esafe abusua ekpulike ne bie; bɛmɛ a Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu edwɛndolɛ nwo ngyehyɛlɛ wɔ bɛ sa nu a. 23Ɔluakɛ belemgbunli yɛle ngyehyɛlɛ mɔɔ kile kɛ mbusua ekpulike ne mɔ ɛrado edwɛne bɛ ti bɛ ti ɛboa ɛzonlenlɛ. Mekɛ biala mɔɔ bɛyɛ nzɛlɛlɛ la ɔwɔ kɛ abusua ekpulike ko bato edwɛne boa.
24Pɛtahaya, Mɛhyɛzabɛle ara ne mɔɔ vi Zila abusua ekpulike nu na ɔbɔ Dwuda abusua ekpunli ne bie la a gyinlanle Yizilayɛma agyakɛ anu wɔ Pɛhyea Maanle Maanle Belemgbunli ne suakunlu ɛkɛ a.
Menli mɔɔ wɔ azua nee azuamgbole gyɛne zo la
25Menli ne mɔ dɔɔnwo dɛnlanle ɛleka mɔɔ bɛ egyinli wɔ la. Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛvi Dwuda abusua nu la dɛnlanle Keleate Aaba, Daebɔn, yɛɛ Gyɛkabezile nee namunamu mɔɔ zuozua bɛ la azo. 26Eza bie mɔ dɛnlanle azuamgbole Gyɛhyua, Moleeda, Bɛtepilɛte, 27yɛɛ Heezahyuale nee Biyɛhyiba nee namunamu mɔɔ zuozua bɛ la azo. 28Bie mɔ dɛnlanle suakpole Zekelage, mɔɔ wɔ Mɛkona nee namunamu mɔɔ zuozua ye la azo. 29Bie mɔ eza dɛnlanle Ɛnlemɔn, Zola, yɛɛ Gyaamutu, 30Zanowa, Adɛlam nee namunamu mɔɔ zuozua bɛ la azo. Akee bie mɔ noko dɛnlanle Leekehye nee bɛ egyinli ne mɔ mɔɔ zuozua ye la anu, yɛɛ Azika nee ye namunamu ne mɔ anu. Ɛhye kile kɛ Dwudama dɛnlanle azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ la Biyɛhyiba, wɔ nyiakɛ afoa nu nee Henɔm Bɔnza, wɔ sɔlɔ afoa nu avinli la azo.
31Bɛngyaman abusua ekpunli ne anu amra dɛnlanle Giba, Mekemahye, Eyae, Bɛtɛle nee namunamu mɔɔ zuozua bɛ la azo; 32Anato, Nɔbo, Ananaya, 33Heezɔ, Releema, Geteeyem, 34Heedede, Zɛboyem, Nɛbalate, 35Lɔɔdo, yɛɛ Ono nee Dwinvolɛma Bɔnza ne anu. 36Bɛmanle Livaema ekpunli ekpunli bie mɔɔ anrɛɛ de Dwuda maanle nu la nee Bɛngyaman asa azo ne bie mɔ dɛnlanle.

Title: NIH 12
Content:
Sɛlɛvolɛma nee Livaema aluma
1Sɛlɛvolɛma nee Livaema mɔɔ nee Hyialeteɛle ara Zɛlɛbabɛle nee Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli Dwɔhyua vi nlɔnu ziale rale la ɛne:
2-7 Sɛlɛvolɛma:
Sɛlaya, Gyɛlɛmaya, Ɛzela,
Amalaya, Malɛke, Hatɛhye,
Hyɛkanaya, Rilihɛm, Mɛlɛmo,
Yedo, Genɛtowae, Abaegya,
Maegyamen, Meeyadaya, Belega,
Hyɛmaya, Dwɔyalebe, Gyɛdaya,
Salu, Emɔko, Helekaya, yɛɛ Gyɛdaya.
Menli ɛhye mɔ a le sɛlɛvolɛma ne mɔ mgbanyima wɔ Dwɔhyua mekɛ zo a.
8 Livaema:
Menli ɛhye mɔ a nea moyɛlɛ edwɛndolɛ zo a:
Gyɛhyua, Benuwae, Kademeɛle, Hyɛlibaya, Dwuda, yɛɛ Matanaya.
9Menli ɛhye mɔ a le edwɛndolɛma ekpunli ne mɔɔ die edwɛne ne mɔ azo la a; Bakebukaya, Ɛno, yɛɛ bɛ gɔnwo mɔ Livaema.
Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli Dwɔhyua abo zo amra
10Dwɔhyua le Dwɔyakem ɔ ze; Dwɔyakem le Yilayahyebe ɔ ze; Yilayahyebe le Dwɔyada ɔ ze; 11Dwɔyada le Dwɔnatan ɔ ze, yɛɛ Dwɔnatan le Gyadua ɔ ze.
Sɛlɛvolɛma mbusua mgbanyinli
12-21Mekɛ mɔɔ Dwɔyakem le Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli la ɛnee ɛhye mɔ a le sɛlɛvolɛma mbusua ekpulike ekpulike ne mɔ mgbanyinli a:
Sɛlɛvolɛ Abusua Ekpulike
Mɛlaya Sɛlaya
Hananaya Gyɛlɛmaya
Mɛhyɛlam Ɛzela
Gyihoheenan Amalaya
Dwɔnatan Malukae
Dwosefi Hyɛbanaya
Adena Hɛlem
Hɛlekeeyae Mɛlayo
Zɛkalaya Yedo
Mɛhyɛlam Genɛtɔn
Zekelae Abaegya
...s Menayamen
Peleteeyae Mowadaya
Hyamua Belega
Gyɛhɔnatan Hyɛmaya
Matinae Dwɔyalebe
Ɛzae Gyɛdaya
Kaleeyae Saleeyae
Yibɛ Emɔko
Hahyebaya Helekaya
Nɛtanile Gyɛdaya
Sɛlɛvolɛma nee Livaema mbusua mgbanyinli mɔɔ bɛhɛlɛ bɛ aluma la
22Wɔ sɛlɛvolɛ mgbanyinli Yilayahyebe, Dwɔyada, Dwɔnatan, yɛɛ Gyadua mekɛ zo, bɛhɛlɛle Livaema nee sɛlɛvolɛma mbusua mgbanyinli aluma bɛziele. Bɛyɛle ɛhye toonwo ɔhɔdwule Pɛhyea Maanle Maanle Belemgbunli Dalayɛse mekɛ zo.
23Livaema mbusua mgbanyinli aluma ɛdeɛ ne mɔ, bɛhɛlɛle bɛwulale Edwɛkɛsisilɛ Mbuluku ne mɔ anu ɔhɔkpulale Yilayahyebe anlɔnra Dwɔnatan mekɛ zo ala.
Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu gyima nwo ngyehyɛlɛ
24Livae mgbanyinli ɛhye mɔ: Hahyabaya, Hyɛlibaya, Gyɛhyua, Benuwae, yɛɛ Kademeɛle a nleanle manle bɛhyɛle Livaema anu ekpunli ekpunli a. Mekɛ ko biala ekpunli nwiɔ to ayɛlɛyelɛ nee moyɛlɛ edwɛne maa Nyamenle, kɛmɔ Nyamenle sonla Belemgbunli Devidi hyehyɛle la.
25Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne sinzavolɛma ɛhye mɔ a zinzale azua mɔɔ wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne nlenkɛ mgbole ne mɔ anloa mɔɔ bɛfa ninyɛne bɛsiezie nuhua la a: Matanaya, Bakebukaya, Obadaya, Mɛhyɛlam, Talemɔn, yɛɛ Akɛbe.
26Menli ɛhye mɔ mɔɔ bɛbobɔ bɛ aluma la ɛnee de aze wɔ Dwɔyakem, Dwɔhyua ara nrenya ne mɔɔ le Gyɛhozadake anlɔnra ne nee Amɛnlado Nihɛmaya yɛɛ sɛlɛvolɛ Ɛzela, mɔɔ le mɛla kilehilevolɛ la mekɛ zo.
Nihɛmaya tu suakpole ne bane ne amaa Nyamenle
27Mekɛ dwule mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ akee bɛbuke Gyɛlusalɛm bane ne na bɛtu bɛmaa Nyamenle la, bɛkpondɛle Livaema mɔɔ wɔ ɛleka biala la abo zo bɛ nee bɛ rale Gyɛlusalɛm, amaa bɛ kɔsɔɔti bɛava fɛlɛkolilɛ bɛabɔ nuhua bɛava sɔnwosɔnwo, getaa mgbole nee ngyikyi, moyɛlɛ, nee edwɛndolɛ bɛali ɛvoyia ne. 28Livae edwɛndolɛma mbusua mɔɔ zuozua Gyɛlusalɛm la boɔboale bɛ nloa wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm. Bɛvi Nɛtɔfa nee ye ngameɛngameɛ, 29Bɛtegelegale, Giba, yɛɛ Azemeevɛte nee bɛ ngameɛngameɛ a bɛrale a. 30Sɛlɛvolɛma nee Livaema bule amaamuo nluanle bɛ nwo, menli ne, nlenkɛ mgbole ne mɔ nee bane ne.
31Memboɔboale Dwuda mgbanyima ne mɔ anloa wɔ bane ne sinli nyunlu anwuma na menvale bɛ menziele menli ekpunli mgbole nwiɔ anloa kɛ bɛnlea bɛmaa bɛva ayɛlɛyelɛ edwɛne bɛkpɔsa suakpole ne azo na bɛyɛ Nyamenle mo.
Ekpunli ne mɔɔ lumua la luale bane ne sinli nyunlu hɔle fema zo mɔɔ di kɔ Ewula Anlenkɛ Kpole ne anwo la. 32Hohyaya a lile menli mɔɔ to edwɛne ne la anzi a, yɛɛ Dwuda mgbanyima ne foa ko noko doa ye. 33-35Sɛlɛvolɛma mɔɔ lɛ aweɛne ndendenle la bɔle bɛ aweɛne ne mɔ doale bɛ. Bɛmɛ a le: Azalaya, Ɛzela, Mɛhyɛlam, Dwuda, Bɛngyaman, Hyɛmaya, yɛɛ Gyɛlɛmaya. Sonla mɔɔ doale zolɛ bieko la a le Dwɔnatan ara Zɛkalaya. Ɔle Hyɛmaya anlɔnra. (Ye mgbanyima ne bie mɔ a le Matanaya, Maekaya, yɛɛ Zakɛ mɔɔ vi Esafe abusua nu la.)
36Akee mbusuafoɔ mɔɔ hale la doale zolɛ. Bɛmɛ a le Hyɛmaya, Azali, Melalae, Gelalae, Meeyae, Nɛtanile, Dwuda, yɛɛ Haneenae. Ɛhye mɔ ko biala lɛ agolebɔlɛ ninyɛne mɔɔ le kɛ mɔɔ ɛnee Nyamenle sonla Belemgbunli Devidi bɔ la bie. Mɛla kilehilevolɛ Ɛzela a lile ekpunli ɛhye ati a.
37Bɛdwule Nzufeanvea Anlenkɛ Kpole ne anwo la, bɛluale kpolike ne mɔ mɔɔ kɔ Devidi suakpole ne azo la azo bɛpɛle nuhua wɔ Devidi Anlenkɛ Kpole ne anwo wɔ suakpole ne aduduleɛ afoa nu.
38Ekpunli ko ne mɔɔ bɛdabɛ bɛluale bane ne sinli nyunlu anwuma na bɛvale moyɛlɛ bɛmanle Nyamenle la hɔle bɛne zo. Menvale menli ne foa ko mendoale bɛ. Yɛdole ɛlɔnwɔne yɛpenle Fonlomo Tawa ne anwo yɛhɔle Bane Tɛtɛlɛ ne anwo; 39yɛvi ɛkɛ ne yɛhɔluale Yifelaem Anlenkɛ Kpole ne (mɔɔ eza bɛfɛlɛ ye Dɛba Anlenkɛ Kpole), nee Fɛlɛ Anlenkɛ Kpole ne ati zo. Akee yɛvale Hananile Tawa ne anwo, yɛluale Tawa Ɛya ne anwo yɛhɔle Mboane Anlenkɛ Kpole ne azo. Yɛvale yɛ mgbɔlɔkabɔlɛ ne yɛrale awieleɛ wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anlenkɛ kpole ne anwo.
40Yemɔti moyɛlɛ edwɛndolɛ ekpunli nwiɔ ɛhye rale Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu. Saa ɛye mgbanyinli ne foa ko mɔɔ ɛnee nee me lua la a 41sɛlɛvolɛma ɛhye mɔ noko boka nwo: Yilayakem, Meeyasaya, Menayamen, Maekaya, Ɛleyoyinae, Zɛkalaya, yɛɛ Hanahaya; 42menli ɛhye mɔ noko doa bɛ, Meeyasaya, Hyɛmaya, Ɛlieza, Ɛzae, Gyihoheenan, Malekaegya, Yilam, yɛɛ Yizɛ. Edwɛndolɛma mɔɔ Gyɛzelahaya li bɛ ti la a dole edwɛne ne kpole kpalɛ a.
43Kenle ko ne bɛbɔle azu fane dɔɔnwo. Menli ne anye liele kpalɛ, ɔboalekɛ Nyamenle manle bɛlile fɛlɛko. Mraalɛ nee mbɛda kɔsɔɔti bokale ɛvoyialilɛ ne anwo, na anyelielɛ ne manle Gyɛlusalɛm kpudwule na ye nganeɛ dwule moa.
Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu ɛzonlenlɛ nwo ngyehyɛlɛ
44Mekɛ ne anu bɛyele menli mɔɔ nea Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne ninyɛnezielɛ azua ne mɔ azo la. Ninyɛne mɔɔ kɔ azua zɔhane mɔ anu la a le debie biala mɔɔ bɛkɛnyia ye, abɛlɛ, nee ma mɔɔ bɛkɛlumua bɛkɛde ye ɛvolɛ biala anu la, yɛɛ ngyɛnu bulu ɛkpɔ ngoko ne mɔɔ bɛkɛva bɛkɛra la. Menli ɛhye mɔ a nea dielie ninyɛne ne fi ɛyazonlɛma ne mɔ mɔɔ zuozua azuamgbole ne mɔ la ɛkɛ a. Bɛfa ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ bɛnea sɛlɛvolɛma nee Livaema, kɛmɔ mɛla ne se la. Na Dwudama kɔsɔɔti anye liele sɛlɛvolɛma nee Livaema anwo. 45 Ɔboalekɛ bɛyɛle ɛnluanlɛ gyima ne nee gyima mɔɔ hale la kɔsɔɔ, kɛmɔ Nyamenle kpondɛ la. Zɔhane ala yɛɛ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu edwɛndolɛma nee sinzavolɛma yɛle bɛ gyima ne a, kɛmɔ Belemgbunli Devidi nee ɔ ra Sɔlɔmɔn hyehyɛle la. 46Mekɛ tendenle mɔɔ ɛze ɛhɔ la, ɔvi Belemgbunli Devidi nee edwɛnekilevolɛ Esafe mekɛ zo ɛnee bɛle edwɛndolɛma mgbanyinli yɛɛ edwɛndolɛma ne ɛdo ayɛlɛyelɛ nee moyɛlɛ edwɛne ɛmaa Nyamenle toonwo a yeradwu ɛnɛ a. 47Wɔ Zɛlɛbabɛle nee Nihɛmaya mekɛ zo, Yizilayɛma kɔsɔɔti vale ahyɛlɛ ninyɛne manle bɛvale bɛnleanle Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu edwɛndolɛma nee sinzavolɛma ne mɔ. Menli vale azubɔlɛ ninyɛne mɔɔ anwo te la manle Livaema, na Livaema ne noko vale sɛlɛvolɛma ne (Aalɔn abo zo amra ne) afoa nu ɛdeɛ manle bɛ.

Title: NIH 13
Content:
Nyamenle menli ne twe bɛ nwo avi nyɛvolɛ nwo
1 Kenle ko ne mɔɔ bɛlɛkenga Mosisi Mɛla ne bɛahile menli ne la, bɛradwule kpɔkɛ bie mɔɔ se ɔnle kɛ bɛmaa Amɔnonli anzɛɛ Mowabenli biala adenle bɛmaa ɔboka Nyamenle menli ne anwo la, 2 ɔboalekɛ mekɛ mɔɔ Yizilayɛma vi Yigyibiti ɛlɛba la, Amɔnoma nee Mowabema ammaa bɛ aleɛ na yeayɛ nzule. Mɔɔ bɛyɛle la a le kɛ bɛduale ezukoa bɛmanle Beelam wale Yizilayɛma amonle, na Nyamenle manle amowa ne hakyile nyilalɛ. 3Mɔɔ Yizilayɛma dele Mɛla ɛhye la bɛhwenle bɛ nwo bɛvile menli mɔɔ ɛnle Dwuuma la anwo.
Nzenzaleɛ mɔɔ Nihɛmaya yɛle la
4Sɛlɛvolɛ Yilayahyebe mɔɔ ɛnee nea Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne ekpumgbunli ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛsie ninyɛne nuhua la azo la nee Tobaya vale ɛdulɛ la ɛhyɛ. 5Ɔlua zolɛ ɔmanle Tobaya adenle ɔmanle ɔdɛnlanle ekpumgbunli kpole ko anu. Zɔhane ekpumgbunli ne bɛfa aleɛ mɔɔ bɛfa bɛbɔ azu, ɛyɛlɛ, Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu ninyɛne, abɛlɛ ngyɛnu bulu ɛkpɔ ko ne, nwanye yɛɛ ɔlivi nwole mɔɔ bɛfa bɛmaa sɛlɛvolɛma la a bɛgua nu a. 6Mekɛ mɔɔ ɛhye mɔ ɛlɛkɔ zolɛ la, ɛnee menle Gyɛlusalɛm, ɔboalekɛ mɔɔ Atazɛzɛse lile ɛvolɛ abulasa nee nwiɔ wɔ Babelɔn belemgbunli ebia ne azo la, ɛnee mehɔ mekadu me kolakola meahile ye. Mekɛ guale nu ekyii la menzɛlɛle ye adenle menziale membale Gyɛlusalɛm. 7Na ɛkɛ ne yɛɛ menwunle munzule ɛbɛla mɔɔ Tobaya ati, Yilayahyebe ɛbɔ la, kɛ yeziezie Nyamenle Sua ne anu ekpumgbunli ko anu yemaa ye. 8Me ahonle futule kpole na menvuandinle Tobaya ninyɛne ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti menguale. 9Akee memanle bɛnluanle sua ne anu na bɛvale Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu ninyɛne ne mɔ, mɔɔ le ahyɛnze, ma azubɔdeɛ, nee ɛyɛlɛ mɔ la bɛrale nuhua.
10 Eza menwunle kɛ bɛnva aleɛ mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ Livaema asa ka ye la bɛmmaa bɛ. Ɔlua zolɛ Livaema nee edwɛndolɛma bie mɔ mɔɔ yɛ gyima ne la ɛzia ɛhɔ bɛ ɛya avule ne mɔ anu. 11Yemɔti mendwile mgbanyima ne mɔ anyunlu kɛ bɛmaa Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne ɛdɔ mgbane a. Akee memboɔboale Livaema ne nee edwɛndolɛma ne anloa na me nee bɛ rale Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu kɛ bɛrayɛ bɛ gyima ne. 12 Na menli ne kɔsɔɔti bɔle ɔ bo bieko na bɛvale bɛ abɛlɛ, nwanye nee ɔlivi nwole bɛrale Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne ninyɛnezielɛ ɛleka ne. 13Na menyele menli ɛhye mɔ kɛ bɛnlea zolɛ; Sɛlɛvolɛ Hyɛlimaya, Mɛla Kilehilevolɛ Zeedɔko yɛɛ Pɛdaya mɔɔ le Livaema ne mɔ ko la. Menyɛle Zakɛ ara nrenya Heenan, mɔɔ le Matanaya anlɔnra ne kɛ ɔyɛ bɛ boavolɛ. Ɔluakɛ bɛdi nɔhalɛ yɛɛ medie bɛ medi kɛ bɛbahyɛ ninyɛne ne mɔ sɛsɛ bɛamaa mediema ne mɔ.
14O me Nyamenle, kakye me wɔ ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ kɔsɔɔti mɔɔ meyɛ memaa wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ye nee nuhua ɛzonlenlɛ la ati.
15 Mekɛ ne anu menwunle Dwudama bie mɔ kɛ bɛlɛyɛ nwanye wɔ Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ne. Bie mɔ noko ɛlɛsoa abɛlɛ, nwanye, vanye ma, feege, yɛɛ ninyɛne ngakyile akyekye bɛ wɔ bɛ asoaso ne mɔ anzi bɛ nee bɛ ahɔ Gyɛlusalɛm, na membɔle bɛ kɔkɔ ɛsesebɛ kɛ bɛmmatɔne debie biala wɔ Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ne.
16Menli bie mɔɔ vi Taya mɔɔ bɛwɔ suakpole ne azo la vale fɛlɛ nee ninyɛne ngakyile dɔɔnwo radɔnenle bɛ wɔ Ɛnwomenlelielɛ kenle ne manle Dwudama nee Gyɛlusalɛmma.
17Na mendwile mgbanyima ne mɔ anyunlu kɛ, “Duzu munzule ɛbɛla yɛɛ bɛlɛbɔ la? Bɛlɛto Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ne mɛla ne. 18Bɛ mgbanyima yɛle ɛhye mɔ la, yɛ Nyamenle ne ɛmaa bɛzɛkye suakpole ye ɛmaa bɛ munzule ɛbɔ bɛ ti. Noko bɛtɛgua zolɛ bɛtɛyɛ, bɛlɛto Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ne mɛla ne, bɛyɛ bɛahwe ndeanlɛ bɛagua Yizilayɛma ati zo.”
19Yemɔti menlile mɛla kɛ nɔsolɛ biala mɔɔ le Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ne abobɔlɛ la, bɛmmatukuedukue Gyɛlusalɛm nlenkɛ mgbole ne mɔ kɔkpula kɛ Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ne kɛpɛ nu la. Eza memanle me sonvolɛma ne bie mɔ zinzale nlenkɛ mgbole ne mɔ, amaa bɛanva ninyɛne adɔne bɛamba suakpole ne azo Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ne. 20Akee gualilɛma ne hale Gyɛlusalɛm bane ne anzi lale fane kɛyɛ nwiɔ. 21Membɔle bɛ kɔkɔ menzele bɛ kɛ, “Duzu ati yɛɛ bɛda bane ne anzi a? Saa bɛyɛ zɔhane bieko a, mebahwi bɛ ɛza.” Na ɔvi mekɛ zɔhane mɔɔ kɔ la, bɛamba gualilɛ wɔ Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ne bieko. 22Na menzele Livaema ne kɛ bɛdu bɛ nwo bɛmaa na bɛrazinza nlenkɛ mgbole ne mɔ bɛmaa bɛzie Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ne nwuanzanwuanza.
O me Nyamenle, kakye me wɔ ɛhye noko ati na die me, kɛmɔ wɔ ɛhulolɛ kpole ne mɔɔ ɛmbɔ aze ɛlɛ la de la.
23 Mekɛ ko ne ala anu, menwunle kɛ Dwuuma bie mɔ ɛgyigya Ahyedɔdo, Amɔn yɛɛ Mowabe mraalɛ, 24na bɛ mra ne mɔ anu foa ko ka Ahyedɔdo aneɛ ne bie nee aneɛ gyɛne bie mɔ, na bɛngola Dwuda aneɛ ne ka. 25Mendwile bɛ nyunlu na menwale bɛ amonle. Membole bɛ nuhua bie mɔ na mendwewhenle bie mɔ ati enrinli mendudule ye. Memanle bɛhanle ndane kɛ kenle bie maanle nu, “Bɛnrɛva bɛ mra mraalɛ bɛnrɛmaa menli zɔhane mɔ amra mrenya agyalɛ, anzɛɛ bɛnrɛmaa bɛ mra mrenya ɛnrɛgya bɛ mra mraalɛ, yɛɛ bɛdabɛ mumua ne bɛnrɛgya menli zɔhane mɔ bie ɛlɛ.” 26 Menzele bɛ kɛ, “Nyɛvolɛ mraalɛ ɛhye mɔ ati yɛɛ Belemgbunli Sɔlɔmɔn yɛle ɛtane a. Wɔ maanle maanle dɔɔnwo avinli, belemgbunli biala ɛnle ɛkɛ mɔɔ nee ye sɛ a. Ye Nyamenle ne hulole ye na ɔyɛle ye Yizilayɛ maanle ne kɔsɔɔti belemgbunli. Noko akee maanle maanle gyɛne nu mraalɛ ɛgyalɛ manle ɔdaye bɔbɔ ɔyɛle ɛtane. 27Na mebiza bɛ kɛ, yemɔti yɛnlea bɛdabɛ bɛ ɛdeɛ ne mɔɔ bɛlɛyɛ la azo yɛyɛ bie na yɛde yɛ Nyamenle ne anwo atua, yɛgya nyɛvolɛ mraalɛ ɔ?”
28Dwɔyada le Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli Yilayahyebe ara nrenya. Dwɔyada amra mrenya ne mɔ ko gya Sanebalate mɔɔ vi Bɛte Hɔlɔn la ara raalɛ, yemɔti mendule ye menvile Gyɛlusalɛm.
29O me Nyamenle, kakye bɛ kɛ bɛgua sɛlɛvolɛlilɛ ne nee sɛlɛvolɛma nee Livaema ngyekyeleɛ ne anwo evinli a.
30Akee menuanle menli ne wɔ nyɛleɛ biala mɔɔ ɛnle yɛ maamɛla la anwo, na mengyɛle sɛlɛvolɛma nee Livaema gyima ne memanle bɛ. 31Mengyehyɛle mekɛ mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛfa bɛyela nyɛmoa bɛbɔ azu la, nee mekɛ mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ menli fa abɛlɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛlumua bɛkɛbu nee ma mɔɔ bɛkɛlumua bɛkɛde la ba la. O me Nyamenle, kakye ɛhye mɔ kɔsɔɔti na yila me.

Title: ƐST MUKENYE
Content:
Mukenye
Edwɛkɛ mɔɔ wɔ Ɛseta buluku ne anu la sisile Maanle Maanle Belemgbunli ne mɔɔ nea Pɛhyea maanle ne azo la ɛnwomenlelielɛ sua nu, yɛɛ ɔ muala gyi Dwuunli raalɛ katakyie bie mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Ɛseta la anwo zo. Ɔluale ye akɛnrasesebɛ nee ɔ nwo mɔɔ ɔdule ɔmanle ye menli ne la azo ɔpepɛle ɔliele Dwuuma; yeammaa bɛ agbɔvolɛ ambɔ bɛ bo zo. Buluku ne kile Dwuuma ɛvoyia ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye “Pulem” la abo nee kɛ ɔzile mɔɔ ɔrale la.
Mɔɔ wɔ nu la
Ɛseta yɛ belemgbunli raalɛ 1.1—2.23
Heeman maamɔlɛ adwenle ne 3.1—5.14
Bɛhu Heeman 6.1—7.10
Dwuuma di bɛ agbɔvolɛ nwo zo konim 8.1—10.3

Title: ƐST 1
Content:
Belemgbunli Raalɛ Vahyetae tu Belemgbunli Zɛzɛse anloa ado
1-2 Mekɛ mɔɔ Zɛzɛse a di Maanle Maanle belemgbunli wɔ Pɛhyea la ɛnee ye suakpole a le Susa. Ɔziele maanle maanle mɔɔ bo ɛya ko abulanwiɔ nee nsuu, ɔvi Yendea toonwo kɔkpula Yiteyopea.
3Ɔlile ɛvolɛ nsa wɔ ebia ne azo la ɔdole ye mgbanyima nee sonvolɛma, Pɛhyea nee Midea sogya mgbanyinli, menli mɔɔ di munli nee amɛnladoma mɔɔ nea maanle maanle ne mɔ azo la ɛkponle, 4na ɔvale kenle ngoko ɛya ko abulatwɛ (siane nsia) ɔyele ye anwonyia mɔɔ wɔ ye belemgbunlililɛ ne anwo la ɔhilele.
5Ɛhye anzi, belemgbunli ne dole Susa suakpole ne azo amra ɛkponle toonwo kenle kɔkɔlɛ nsuu wɔ ye suakunlu alie kpandaanwo ne anwo. Sukoavolɛma nee koahweabanema kɔsɔɔti hɔle ɛkponledolɛ ne bie. 6Bɛvale ninyɛne ngɛnlɛma ngakyile dɔɔnwo bɛzieziele suakunlu ɛkɛ ne: mgbɛnu ndanlɛ fufule nee buluwu mɔɔ bɛva lenen ndanlɛ kɔkɔlɛ ndenrɛndenra ngɛnlɛma bɛbobɔ bɛ avinli, na dwɛtɛ fufule ngɛba sosɔ bɛ nloa la hendɛhenda mpila mɔɔ bɛvale awolɛ memeamemea mɔɔ sonle bolɛ la a bɛsisile la. Mbia mɔɔ gyigyi alie nwo ɛkɛ ne la, bɛvale ezukoa nvutuke nee dwɛtɛ fufule a bɛyɛle a. Azɛlɛ ne anwo bɔbɔ, bɛvale awolɛ memeamemea mɔɔ sonle bolɛ la a bɛdole a. 7Nza mɔɔ bɛnlonle la, bɛzule ye ezukoa nvutuke ahanrɛlɛ ngakyile nu, yɛɛ belemgbunli ne ɔdaye ye ahunlunyele nu ala ɔhwenle ye nwanye kpalɛ mɔɔ ɔlɛ la ɔvindele. 8Wɔ nza ne ɛnlonlɛ nu, bɛansisi awie biala anwo zo. Awie biala nlonle mɔɔ ɔdaye ɔkola la, ɔluakɛ belemgbunli ne manle suakunlu sonvolɛma ne mɛla kɛ bɛzu awie biala mɔɔ ɔdaye ɔkɛhola ye no la.
9Mekɛ ɛhye anu ala Belemgbunli Raalɛ Vahyetae ɔdaye ɔdole mraalɛ ne mɔ ɛkponle wɔ Belemgbunli Zɛzɛse suakunlu ɛkɛ ne.
10Kenle nsuu ne azo, mɔɔ ɛnee belemgbunli ne ɛlɛno nza na ɔ nye ɛlie kpalɛ kpalɛ la, ɔzoanle ɔmanle bɛhɔvɛlɛle ɔdaye Belemgbunli Zɛzɛse ɔ ti anwo sonvolɛma nsuu ne mɔɔ di ɔ nzi la ɔmanle bɛrale. Bɛmɛ a le Mɛhuman, Bezeta, Haabona, Begeta, Abageta, Zita, yɛɛ Kaakase. 11Ɔzele bɛ kɛ bɛhɔze Belemgbunli Raalɛ Vahyetae kɛ ɔzoa ye belemgbunli kyɛlɛ ne na ɔ nee bɛ ɛlua nwolɛ ɛrɛla. Ɔyɛle ɛhye amaa saa ɔba a yeanyia adenle yeava belemgbunli raalɛ ne anwofɛlɛko ne yeadu ɔ nloa anu wɔ menli ne anyunlu, ɔluakɛ ɛnee belemgbunli raalɛ ne anwo yɛ fɛ kpole kpalɛ. 12Na Belemgbunli Raalɛ Vahyetae dule ɔ gye. Ɛhye ati belemgbunli ne ahonle futule na ɔvale ɛya.
13Belemgbunli ne lɛ mgbanyima bie mɔɔ ze mɛla, na bɛdi pɛlepɛle, na bɛtu ye folɛ la wɔ ɛkɛ. Saa edwɛkɛ mɔɔ le kɛ ɛhye la bie si a, menli ɛhye mɔ yɛɛ ɔbiza bɛ adwenle wɔ nwolɛ a. 14Mgbanyima ne mɔ a le Kaahyina, Hyita, Ademeeta, Tahyehye, Milɛse, Maasina, yɛɛ Mɛmukan. Bɛmɛ a bɛle Pɛhyea nee Midea maanle ne mɔ anu mgbanyima nsuu mɔɔ lumuale wɔ maanle ne ɛbulɛ nu a. 15Belemgbunli Zɛzɛse bizale mgbanyima ne mɔ kɛ, “Kɛ mɛla ne se ɛ, duzu a ɔwɔ kɛ bɛfa bɛyɛ Belemgbunli Raalɛ Vahyetae a? Menzoanle kɛ bɛhɔvɛlɛ ye la, ɔdule ɔ gye. Yeamba!”
16Na Mɛmukan vale dole belemgbunli nee ye mgbanyima ne mɔ anyunlu kɛ, “Debie mɔɔ Belemgbunli Raalɛ Vahyetae ɛyɛ la, tɛ belemgbunli angomekye yɛɛ yegua ɔ nyunlu aze a, na yegua mgbanyima nee menli kɔsɔɔti mɔɔ wɔ Belemgbunli Zɛzɛse maanle maanle ne mɔ anu la amuala anyunlu aze. 17Ɔluakɛ mraalɛ kɔsɔɔti bade belemgbunli raalɛ ye nyɛleɛ mɔɔ yeyɛ la na ɔlua zolɛ bɛnrɛbu bɛ hu mɔ bie. Bɛbaha kɛ, ‘Belemgbunli Zɛzɛse zoanle kɛ bɛhɔvɛlɛ Belemgbunli Raalɛ Vahyetae kɛ ɔrɛla la, yeampili ye.’ 18Ɛnɛ kenle ye, Pɛhyea nee Midea mraalɛ mɔɔ ɛde belemgbunli raalɛ ne subane mɔɔ ɛhile la anwo bie la baha ahile bɛ hu mɔ kolaa na sɛnzɛne adɔ, na ɛyavalɛ dɔɔnwo nee mgbane mgbane ɛyɛlɛ bara, ɔluakɛ mraalɛ anye ɛnrɛzɔ bɛ hu mɔ. 19Nana, saa ɛkɛkponle a anrɛɛ mese ɛmaa bɛhɛlɛ mɛla ɛhye bɛboka Pɛhyeama nee Mideama maamɛla ne anwo mɔɔ bɛngakyi ye ɛlɛ a, kɛ ɔvi ɛnɛ mɔɔ kɔ la, Vahyetae agyakɛ ba ɛnrɛtia Belemgbunli Zɛzɛse anwo ɛkɛ ne bieko ɛlɛ; na fa ye dehelɛ gyinlabelɛ ne maa raalɛ mɔɔ lɛ subane kpalɛ la. 20Saa bɛbɔ mɛla ɛhye nolo wɔ belemgbunli ne maanle maanle ne mɔ anu a, mraalɛ muala bava enililɛ amaa bɛ hu mɔ, mɔɔ ɔnva nwolɛ kɛ bɛ hu mɔ le mgbolema anzɛɛ koahweabanema a.”
21Folɛdulɛ ɛhye yɛle belemgbunli nee ye mgbanyima ne mɔ fɛ kpole na belemgbunli ne yɛle, kɛmɔ Mɛmukan zuzule la. 22Ɔhɛlɛle ngɛlata ɔhɔle ye maanle maanle ne mɔ amuala anu, maanle ko biala ɔdaye ye aneɛ nu kɛ, “Wɔ awuke biala anu, nrenya ne a le kpanyinli a, yɛɛ ɔ nloa edwɛkɛ, bɛndu bɛndo.”

Title: ƐST 2
Content:
Bɛsie Ɛseta Belemgbunli Raalɛ
1Nzinlii mɔɔ Belemgbunli Zɛzɛse ɛya ne dwole la, ɛnee ɔtɛkakye debie mɔɔ Vahyetae ɛyɛ la nee ɔdaye Zɛzɛse ye mɛla ne mɔɔ yebɔ ye nolo wɔ Vahyetae anwo wɔ ɛleka biala la. 2Yemɔti belemgbunli ne folɛdulɛma ne bie mɔ mɔɔ bikye ye kpalɛ la zuzule hilele ye kɛ, “Duzu ati a ɛmkpondɛ mbɛlɛra mɔɔ anwo yɛ fɛ kpalɛ la bie ɛ? 3Yeye mbɔlɔba wɔ maanle ye maanzinli ne mɔ anu maa bɛva mbɛlɛra mɔɔ anwo yɛ fɛ la amuala bɛrɛla Susa suakpole ye azo na fa bɛ wula Higae, mɔɔ le sonvolɛ nrenya ne mɔɔ nea wɔ mraalɛ ne mɔ anwo zo la asa anu; na bɛbɔ ɔ bo kɛ bɛkeha bɛ. 4Na akee fa bɛ nuhua ko mɔɔ ɛ nye die ɔ nwo la yɛ ye belemgbunli raalɛ sie Vahyetae agyakɛ anu.”
Nzuzulɛ ɛhye zɔle belemgbunli ne anye, zɔhane ati ɔliele ɔdole nu na ɔyɛle.
5Dwuunli bie wɔ suakpole Susa azo, bɛfɛlɛ ye Mɔdekae. Ɔ ze a le Gyeeyɛɛ, Gyeeyɛɛ ɔ ze a le Hyemɛyae, yɛɛ Hyemɛyae ɔ ze a le Kɛhye mɔɔ vi Bɛngyaman abusua ekpunli ne anu la. 6 Mekɛ mɔɔ Belemgbunli Nɛbukadenɛza hyele Dwuda Belemgbunli Gyɛhɔyaken nee menli bie nuokɛ wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm na ɔ nee bɛ hɔle Babelɔn la, Mɔdekae boka nwolɛ. 7Mɔdekae awuvuanyi ara raalɛ a le Ɛseta mɔɔ eza bɛfɛlɛ ye Hadasa wɔ Hibulu nu la. Ɛseta le raalɛ mɔɔ anwo yɛ fɛ a, yɛɛ eza ɔgyi zolɛ sengɔɔnwo. Ɔ nli nee ɔ ze wule la, Mɔdekae a lile ye adane a, na ɔvale ye ɔyɛle kɛ ɔ kunlu ralɛ.
8Mekɛ mɔɔ belemgbunli ne nolo ne dwule maanle maanle ne mɔ anu ɛleka biala na bɛ nee mbɛlɛra ne mɔ ba Susa la, bɛvale Ɛseta noko bɛbokale nwolɛ. Ɔdaye noko bɛliele ye wɔ belemgbunli sua nu ɛkɛ na bɛvale ye bɛwulale Higae, mɔɔ nea belemgbunli sua nu ɛkɛ ne mraalɛ nu la asa anu. 9Higae anye liele Ɛseta anwo kpole na ɛkɛ ne ala ɔbɔle ye ɛhehanlɛ bo. Eza ɔmanle ye nwolɛ aleɛ kpalɛ. Higae eza manle ye ɛleka kpalɛ wɔ belemgbunli sua nu ɛkɛ ne mraalɛ nu, na ɔkpale nu ɔyele mbɛlɛra nsuu wɔ suakunlu ɛkɛ ne kɛ bɛzonle Ɛseta.
10Mɔdekae bɔle Ɛseta anloa, yemɔti Ɛseta angile ɔ nwo kɛ ɔle Dwuunli. 11Na Mɔdekae lile belemgbunli sua nu ɛkɛ ne mraalɛ nu anuhɔlɛ ne anyunlu akɔneaba dahuu, kɛ ɔnea kɛ Ɛseta te kpɔkɛ nee debie mɔɔ bazi ɔ nwo zo la.
12Bɛvale siane bulu nee nwiɔ a bɛhehanle mbɛlɛra ne mɔ a. Bɛvale siane nsia bɛkpokpale bɛ aabɛya nwole yɛɛ bɛvale siane nsia bɛkpokpale bɛ sakyeɛ. Mekɛ ne dwule la, bɛvale mbɛlɛra ne mɔ bɛhɔle Belemgbunli Zɛzɛse ɛkɛ ne ngoko. 13Saa bɛlɛra ne bahɔ belemgbunli ne ɛkɛ a, ɔsiezie ɔ nwo, kɛmɔ ɔdaye ɔkulo la na ɔvi belemgbunli sua nu ɛkɛ ne mraalɛ nu yeahɔ suakunlu ɛkɛ. 14Ɔkɔ nɔsolɛ nu na ɔba nwonlomɔ a, bɛfa ye bɛkɔ ɛleka mɔɔ belemgbunli mgbɔnla ne mɔ wɔ la. Ɛleka ɛhye, sonvolɛ mɔɔ nea ɛkɛ ne la a le Hyeeyahyegaze. Saa bɛlɛra mɔɔ kɛhɔ belemgbunli ɛkɛ ne la sia ba a, ɔngɔ bieko, kyesɛ belemgbunli ne anye liele ɔ nwo. Saa ɔba ye zɔhane a belemgbunli ne soa maa bɛkɔfɛlɛ ye.
15Mekɛ dwule kɛ akee ɔwɔ kɛ Ɛseta ɔdaye ɔkɔ belemgbunli ne ɛkɛ ne. Bɛfɛlɛ Ɛseta ɔ ze Abeheli. Abeheli awozoa a le Mɔdekae mɔɔ Ɛseta ɛyɛ ɔdaye ɔ kunlu ralɛ la. Mekɛ ne dwule la, ɛnee awie biala mɔɔ anye kɛbɔ Ɛseta anwo zo la kulo ye. Higae, mɔɔ le sonvolɛ ne mɔɔ nea mbɛlɛra ne mɔ anwo zo la dule Ɛseta folɛ; yeammaa yeanziezie ɔ nwo kpalɛ biala.
16Belemgbunli Zɛzɛse lile ɛvolɛ nsuu wɔ ebia ne azo la, ye siane ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ bulu mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye “Tibɛte” la anu yɛɛ bɛvale Ɛseta bɛhɔle ye suakunlu ɛkɛ ne a. 17Belemgbunli ne hulole Ɛseta dɛlale mbɛlɛra ne mɔ amuala, na ɔhulole ye edwɛkɛ ɔdɛlale raalɛ biala mɔɔ ɛra ye suakunlu ɛkɛ ne la. Yemɔti ɔvale belemgbunli kyɛlɛ ne ɔzoale ye na ɔyɛle ye Belemgbunli Raalɛ ɔziele Vahyetae agyakɛ anu. 18Akee Belemgbunli Zɛzɛse dole ɛkponle kpole bie manle Ɛseta na ɔdole ɛsalɛ ɔvɛlɛle ye maanle mgbanyima nee ye mbɔlɔba ne mɔ amuala. Mekɛ ne anu belemgbunli ne gyakyile ye adwule mɔɔ ɔdie ɔfi ye maanle maanle ne mɔ lɔ la anu ekyii na ɔvale ahyɛlɛdeɛ dɔɔnwo ɔmanle menli.
Mɔdekae die belemgbunli ne ngoane
19Mekɛ dwule mɔɔ bɛboɔboale mbɛlɛra mɔɔ ɛnze mrenya la anloa bieko la, ɛnee Mɔdekae wɔ belemgbunli ne gyima nu, 20noko Ɛseta ɛdeɛ ɛnee ɔtɛkilele ɔ nwo yɛɛ ɔtɛkilele maanle holɛ ko nee menli mɔɔ ɔvi bɛ nuhua la. Ɔyɛle ɛhye, ɔluakɛ ɛnee Mɔdekae ɛbɔ ɔ nloa yɛɛ Ɛseta noko yɛle tieyɛ manle Mɔdekae, kɛmɔ ɔde na yeara belemgbunli sua nu la.
21Mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee Mɔdekae wɔ gyima nu la, sinzavolɛma nwiɔ mɔɔ nea nwolodo ne mɔɔ kɔ belemgbunli suakunlu ɛkɛ ne la hɔle Belemgbunli Zɛzɛse ati akpamo kɛ bɛku ye. Sinzavolɛma nwiɔ ne a le Begeteena nee Tilɛhye. 22Mɔdekae dele ɛhye anwo bie, ɔfetele zolɛ ɔhilele Belemgbunli Raalɛ Ɛseta, na Ɛseta hanle hilele belemgbunli ne. 23Belemgbunli Zɛzɛse manle bɛnleɛnleanle edwɛkɛ ne anu, na bɛnwunle kɛ amgba edwɛkɛ ne le nɔhalɛ. Zɔhane ati bɛhunle sinzavolɛma nwiɔ ne na bɛhɛlɛle mɔɔ zile la buluku nu bɛdole ɛkɛ.

Title: ƐST 3
Content:
Heeman bɔ adwenle kɛ ɔku Dwuuma
1Nzinlii Belemgbunli Zɛzɛse yɛle nrenya bie mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Heeman, mɔɔ vi Agage abusua nu na ɔ ze a le Hamɛdeeta la sonvolɛ kpanyinli ɔmanle ɔdɛlale ye suakunlu ɛkɛ ne mgbanyima ne mɔ amuala. 2Sonvolɛma mɔɔ wɔ suakunlu ɛkɛ ne la amuala bɔle bɛ ti aze manle ye, kɛmɔ belemgbunli ne hanle kɛ bɛyɛ la. Na Mɔdekae ɛdeɛ, yeangoto Heeman ɛlɛ. 3Sonvolɛma mɔɔ wɔ suakunlu ɛkɛ ne la bizale Mɔdekae kɛ, “Duzu ati a ɛnli belemgbunli ne mɛla ne azo a?” 4Bɛbizale ye nwolɛ edwɛkɛ fane dɔɔnwo, noko yeandɛne bɛ zo. Dahuu ye edwɛkɛ a le kɛ, “Mame, mele Dwuunli.” Ɛhye ati bɛbɔle Heeman amaneɛ, amaa bɛanlea kɛ saa edwɛkɛ ne kɔda Heeman anyunlu a Mɔdekae kɛva ɔ nwo dwɔɔ. 5Heeman nwunle kɛ Mɔdekae amgba ɛmbɔ ɔ ti aze ɛmmaa ye, na ɛya hunle ye kpole. 6Noko yeangulo kɛ ɔkɛhu Mɔdekae angome. Kɛmɔ bɛmaa yede kɛ Mɔdekae le Dwuunli la ati, ɔhulole kɛ ɔkɛhu Dwuuma amuala mɔɔ wɔ Belemgbunli Zɛzɛse maanle ne anu la.
7Belemgbunli Zɛzɛse lile ebia ne la, ye ɛvolɛ bulu nee nwiɔ ne azo, ye siane ne mɔɔ lumua mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye “Naesan” la anu, Heeman manle bɛhwenle adunyi. Adunyi ɛhwenlɛ ne, Hibulu nu bɛfɛlɛ ye “Pulu.” Saa bɛbahwe adunyi ne anzɛɛ “Pulu” ne a, Heeman batɛnla ye ebia nu. Siane ko biala anu, kenle ko biala bɛtwe ɔ ti adunyi; na bɛhwenle dedee la ɔkpulale siane bulu nee nwiɔ ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye “Eda” la anu kenle bulu nee nsa ne. Na kenle ɛhye yɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛfa bɛdi Dwuuma anwo gyima mɔɔ le zɛhae la a.
8Akee Heeman hanle hilele Belemgbunli Zɛzɛse kɛ, “Menli bie mɔɔ bɛdabɛ asolo bɛ amaamuo la ɛde ɛkponde wɔ maanle maanle mɔɔ ɛsie bɛ la amuala anu. Bɛnli wɔ mɛla ɛdeɛ ne azo. Ɛhye ati ɔnle kpalɛ kɛ belemgbunli kɛlie bɛ wɔ ye maanle ye anu. 9Saa ɛ nee me kɛyɛ adwenle a, anrɛɛ mese ɛyɛ ye mɛla ɛmaa bɛhu bɛ muala. Ɛkponle ɛhye azo a, mebadua dwɛtɛ fufule ‘talɛnte’ apenle bulu meamaa menli mɔɔ nea belemgbunli ne gyima zo la, amaa bɛava bɛagua wɔ gya ne anu.”
10Yemɔti belemgbunli ne yele ɔ sa kpɔdelera ne mɔɔ ɔfa ɔsi kɛlata zo ɔyɛ mɛla la ɔmanle Agagenli Heeman, mɔɔ le Hamɛdeeta ara nrenya ne mɔɔ kpɔ Dwuuma la, 11na ɔzele ye kɛ, “Menli ne wɔ ɛ sa nu. Ezukoa ne le wɔ ɛdeɛ. Mɔɔ ɛnea a ɔfɛta bɛ la, fa yɛ bɛ.”
12Wɔ siane ne mɔɔ lumua la anu, ye kenle bulu nee nsa ne azo, Heeman manle bɛyiale belemgbunli ne kɛlɛhɛlɛvolɛma ne mɔ na ɔmanle bɛhɛlɛle mɛla mɔɔ yeli la anwo ngɛlata kɛ bɛva bɛhɔmaa mgbanyima mɔɔ le kɛ safohyenlema, amɛnladoma, yɛɛ arane mbɔlɔba mgbanyima ne mɔ amuala. Maanle ko biala anu amra kɛlata ɛdeɛ ne bɛhɛlɛle ye wɔ bɛdabɛ bɛ aneɛ nee bɛ ɛhɛlɛndenle nu. Bɛhɛlɛle ngɛlata ne mɔ wɔ Belemgbunli Zɛzɛse duma nu. 13Bɛvale ngɛlata ne mɔ bɛzoanle menli mɔɔ kola nriandi kpalɛ la a hɔle a. Ngɛlata ne mɔ kile kɛ bɛhu Dwuuma, ngakula nee mgbanyinli, yɛɛ mraalɛ kɔsɔɔti na bɛbɔ bɛ bo zo, na bɛve bɛ ninyɛne. Ngɛlata ne kile kɛ bɛva kenle ko ala a bɛyɛ ɛhye mɔ a, na bɛyɛ ye wɔ siane bulu nee nwiɔ ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye “Eda” la ye kenle ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ bulu nee nsa ne la azo. 14Bɛhyehyɛle kɛ bɛbɔ mɛla ɛhye nolo wɔ maanle biala anu bɛmaa menli ne amuala ɛde, na bɛaboɔboa bɛ nwo.
15Menli mɔɔ bɛzoanle bɛ la manle bɛ nwo yɛle ndɛ bɛhɔle na eza bɛbɔle mɛla ne nolo wɔ Susa mɔɔ le maanle maanle ne suakpole la azo. Akee belemgbunli ne nee Heeman dɛnlanle aze nlonle, liele bɛ nye, noko wɔ Susa suakpole ne azo ɛdeɛ, ɛnee menli adwenle ɛzɛkye kpalɛ.

Title: ƐST 4
Content:
Mɔdekae kpondɛ Ɛseta moalɛ
1Mekɛ mɔɔ Mɔdekae dele edwɛkɛ mɔɔ ɛzi la, ɔsuosuanle ye tɛladeɛ ne mɔɔ ɔwula la anu, na ɔvale ɛrele ɔhedale, na ɔvale nzonle ɔbɔle ɔ nwo, na akee ɔvale ɛzunlɛ ɔyele awolɛ ɔdudule gua toonwo ɔhɔdwule suakpole ne avinli lɔ. 2Ɔhɔle toonwo ɔhɔle belemgbunli ne anuhɔlɛ kpole ne anloa, noko yeanwolo nu, ɔluakɛ bɛngeda ɛrele bɛngɔ suakunlu ɛkɛ ne. 3Maanle ne anu ɛleka biala mɔɔ bɛkɛde belemgbunli ne nolo ne la, Dwuuma mɔɔ wɔ ɛkɛ ne la di nyane kpalɛ, bɛdi buada, na bɛsu bɛye awolɛ. Bɛ nuhua dɔɔnwo bɔbɔ fa nzonle bɔ bɛ nwo na bɛkeda ɛrele bɛda.
4Mɔɔ Ɛseta sonvolɛ mraalɛ nee mrenya ne mɔ nwunle mɔɔ Mɔdekae ɛlɛyɛ la, bɛhanle bɛhilele ye, na ye adwenle zɛkyele. Ɛhye ati ɔvale adɛladeɛ kɛ bɛva bɛhɔmaa Mɔdekae ɛwula na ɔkpa ɛrele ne ɔgua, noko Mɔdekae anlie. 5Akee Ɛseta vɛlɛle Hatakye, mɔɔ le sonvolɛ nrenya mɔɔ belemgbunli ne ɛye ye kɛ ɔzonle Ɛseta la, na ɔzoanle ye kɛ ɔhɔbiza Mɔdekae deɛ holɛ ko mɔɔ ɔlɛyɛ la abo, nee kɛ ɔyɛle mɔɔ ɔrale ye zɔhane la. 6Hatakye hɔle Mɔdekae anwo ɛkɛ wɔ suakpole ne ɛleka wienyi ne mɔɔ bɛyia la, wɔ belemgbunli sua ne anyunlu ɛkɛ. 7Mɔdekae hanle mɔɔ ɛzi ɔ nwo zo la amuala hilele ye nee ezukoa mɔɔ Heeman ɛbɔ ɛwɔkɛ kɛ saa bɛku Dwuuma amuala a ɔkɛdua ɔkɛgua belemgbunli ne gya nu la ɔhilele ye. 8Mɔdekae eza vale nolobɔlɛ kɛlata ne mɔɔ bɛva bɛdo gua wɔ Susa mɔɔ kile kɛ bɛhu Dwuuma bɛbɔ bɛ bo zo la bie manle Hatakye kɛ ɔva ɔhɔmaa Ɛseta, na ɔhile nuhua ɔhile ye. Ɔzele Hatakye kɛ ɔze Ɛseta kɛ ɔdaye noko ɔhɔnwu belemgbunli na ɔbodo ye ɔmaa ɔnwu ye menli ne anwunvɔne. 9Hatakye yɛle ɛhye, 10na Ɛseta vale nrɛlaleɛ manle Hatakye kɛ ɔva ɔhɔmaa Mɔdekae kɛ, 11“Mɛla mɔɔ wɔ suakunlu ɛke la a le kɛ, awie biala, nrenya o, raalɛ o, mɔɔ bɛanvɛlɛ ye na ɔkɛwolo belemgbunli suakunlu ɛkɛ ne kɛ ɔkanwu ye la, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛku ye. Awie biala, ɛbɔ ye belemgbunli folɛdulɛma anwo zo toonwo badwu menli mɔɔ wɔ maanle ye maanzinli ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti anu la, ze mɛla ɛhye. Kyesɛ sonla mɔɔ belemgbunli ne kɛkpogya ye tumi nvutuke kpɔma ne zo kɛhile ye la, yɛɛ kɛnyia ɔ ti a. Na mame noko, ye siane ko ɛne, belemgbunli ɛtɛfɛlɛle me.”
12Mɔdekae dele Ɛseta nrɛlaleɛ ne la, 13ɔmanle bɛhɔbɔle ye kɔkɔ: ɔse, “Mmadwenle kɛ ɛwɔ belemgbunli sua nu la ati, mɔɔ bazi Dwuuma anwo zo la bakpa ɛ ti. 14Saa ɛyɛ koonwu wɔ mekɛ ɛhye anu a, moalɛ vi anwuma bara amaa Dwuuma anyia bɛ ti, noko wɔmɔ, ɛbawu na ɛ ze abusua ne abɔ tɔɔ. Noko akee, nwane a ze a? Bie a ɛnee edwɛkɛ mɔɔ le kɛ ɛhye mɔ la ati yɛɛ wɔrayɛ belemgbunli raalɛ a.”
15Ɛseta vale mualɛ hɔmanle Mɔdekae kɛ, 16“Kɔ na kɔboɔboa Dwuuma mɔɔ wɔ Susa ɛke la amuala anloa, maa bɛhye ɛhɔne na bɛzɛlɛ bɛmaa me. Bɛmmadi debie biala yɛɛ bɛmmano nzule toonwo kenle nsa. Me nee me sonvolɛ mraalɛ ne mɔ yɛdayɛ yɛbayɛ zɔhane ala. Ɛhye anzi, mebahɔ belemgbunli ɛkɛ. Ɛhye tia mɛla ne bɔbɔ ɛdeɛ, noko saa ɔlua ɛhye ati na ɔwɔ kɛ mewu a, menwɔwu.”
17Akee Mɔdekae hɔle na ɔhɔyɛle debie biala mɔɔ Ɛseta zele ye la.

Title: ƐST 5
Content:
Ɛseta to belemgbunli nee Heeman ɛkponle
1Kenle nsa ne dwule la, Ɛseta wulale ye belemgbunli raalɛ tɛladeɛ ne na ɔhɔgyinlanle suakunlu ɛkɛ ne alie ne anwo, ɛleka mɔɔ nee belemgbunli asalo kpole ne anye bɔ zolɛ la. Mekɛ ne anu ɛnee belemgbunli ne de ye ebia nu wɔ ye sua ne anu, ɛleka mɔɔ nee suakunlu ɛkɛ ne anuhɔlɛ ne anye bɔ zolɛ la. 2Belemgbunli ne nwunle Belemgbunli Raalɛ Ɛseta kɛ ɔgyi alie ne anwo la, ɔ nye liele, na ɔkpogyale ye tumi ezukoa nvutuke kpɔma ne ati zo ɔhilele ye. Ɛseta dudule agyakɛ hɔle ɔ nyunlu na ɔvale ɔ sa ɔhɔhanle belemgbunli tumi kpɔma ne ati. 3Belemgbunli ne bizale ye kɛ, “Belemgbunli Raalɛ Ɛseta, duzu ɔ? Duzu a ɛkpondɛ a? Saa ɛkpondɛ me maanle ye foa ko bɔbɔ a, ɛ sa baha ye.”
4Ɛseta buale ye kɛ, “Nana, mesɛlɛ wɔ, saa mekola ye ka a anrɛɛ mese saa ɛkulo a ɛ nee Heeman bɛrɛla me ɛkɛ ɛnɛ nɔsolɛ na meyɛ debie mezie wɔ na bɛrakpula bɛ sa.”
5Belemgbunli zele kɛ, “Bɛhɔvɛlɛ Heeman bɛmaa ɔrɛla ndɛndɛ, na yɛhɔ Ɛseta ɛvɛlɛlɛ ne.” Zɔhane ati belemgbunli ne nee Heeman hɔle Ɛseta ɛkponle ne mɔɔ ɔdole ɔmanle belemgbunli ne la abo. 6Mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee bɛwɔ zolɛ bɛlɛno nwanye la, belemgbunli bizale Ɛseta kɛ, “Duzu a ɛkpondɛ a? Debie mɔɔ ɛkpondɛ la, mebayɛ meamaa wɔ. Duzu a ɛkpondɛ a? Saa ɛkulo me belemgbunli maanle ye foa ko bɔbɔ a, mebava meamaa wɔ.”
7Ɛseta buale kɛ, “Debie mɔɔ mehyia nwolɛ na mekpondɛ kɛ ɛyɛ ɛmaa me la yemɔ a le kɛ 8saa me nyunlu ɛra anyia wɔ Nana anyunlu, na mɔɔ mekulo na mekpondɛ kɛ Nana yɛ maa me la ɔkɛyɛ ɛdeɛ a, ɛnee ɛhyema nɔsolɛ Nana nee Heeman bɛrɛla bɛrakpula bɛ sa wɔ ɛke na menye edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ Nana ɛbiza me la anloa.”
Heeman fa adwenle kɛ ɔku Mɔdekae
9Kenle ko zɔhane Heeman vale anyelielɛ nee fɛlɛko ngome a hɔle a. Na mɔɔ ɔkɔ na ɔnwunle Mɔdekae wɔ suakunlu ɛkɛ ne anuhɔlɛ ne, na yeandwazo, yɛɛ ye ahonle amkputi ye bɔbɔ la, ɔvale Mɔdekae anwo ɛya kpole. 10Noko Heeman zɔle ɔ nwo, yeanga edwɛkɛ biala na ɔhɔle sua nu. Ɔdwule sua nu la, ɔzoanle ɔmanle bɛhɔvɛlɛle ɔ gɔnwo mɔ nee ɔ ye Zilɛhye. 11Bɛrale la, Heeman sosɔle zolɛ hanle ɔ nwo mɔɔ yenyia ye kpole, ɔ mra dodo mɔɔ yewo bɛ, yɛɛ ɔ nyunlu mɔɔ belemgbunli ne ɛmaa yenyia wɔ gyima nu yeva yewula ɔdaye Heeman anyunlunyia la amuala ɔhilele bɛ. Eza ɔhanle kɛ belemgbunli ɛzi ɛmaa ye dibilɛ yedɛla amɛnladoma nee sonvolɛma amuala mɔɔ wɔ suakunlu ɛkɛ ne la ɔhilele bɛ. 12Akee ɔvale ɔzɔle zolɛ kɛ, “Belemgbunli Raalɛ Ɛseta ammaa awie biala adenle ammaa ɔ nee belemgbunli ne amba ɛkponledolɛ ne bie kɛ medame me ngomekye ala. Eza yedo ɛsalɛ yevɛlɛ me nee belemgbunli ne kɛ ɛhyema yɛrɛla. 13Noko ɛhye mɔ amuala biala ɛnyɛ me fɛ, ɔluakɛ Dwuunli Mɔdekae ɔdaye kɛ dahuu ɔde suakunlu anuhɔlɛ ɛkɛ ne ala ɛne.”
14Ɔ nloa penle la, ɔ ye Zilɛhye nee ɔ gɔnwo mɔ zuzule hilele ye kɛ, “Na maa bɛziezie ɛzinzelɛ ɛhuleka, mɔɔ ye anwumahɔlɛ bayɛ mita abulanwiɔ nee nwiɔ la na ɛhyema nwonlomɔ ka kile belemgbunli ne maa ɔmaa bɛzinze Mɔdekae wɔ zolɛ bɛhu ye ɛ? Ɛyɛ ɛhye ɛwie a, akee wɔava anyelielɛ wɔahɔ ɛkponledolɛ ne abo.” Heeman liele dole nuhua, na amgba noko ɔmanle bɛzieziele ɛzinzelɛ ɛhuleka ne.

Title: ƐST 6
Content:
Belemgbunli ne wula Mɔdekae anyunlunyia
1Kenle ko ne nɔe ne belemgbunli ne angola da. Yemɔti ɔzele kɛ bɛva buluku ne mɔɔ bɛhɛlɛ ninyɛne kpalɛ mɔɔ menli ɛyɛ la wɔ nuhua la bɛrɛla. Bɛvale bɛrale na bɛgengale bɛhilele ye. 2 Na bɛnwunle kɛ bɛhɛlɛ ye wɔ buluku ne anu kɛ, mekɛ mɔɔ Begeteena nee Tilɛhye mɔɔ anrɛɛ sinza nwolodo ne mɔɔ kɔ belemgbunli suakunlu ɛkɛ ne la vale adwenle kɛ bɛku belemgbunli ne la, Mɔdekae a dele nwolɛ bie mɔɔ ɔfetele zolɛ ɔhilele belemgbunli ne a. 3Na belemgbunli ne bizale kɛ, “Duzu a bɛyɛ bɛmaa Mɔdekae wɔ ɛhye anwo a?”
Belemgbunli sonvolɛma ne hanle kɛ, “Bɛtɛyɛle ɛhwee bɛtɛmanle ye.”
4Belemgbunli ne bizale kɛ, “Na nwane a wɔ ɛkɛ ne a?” Mekɛ ne anu ala ɛnee Heeman ɛra suakunlu ɛkɛ ne alie ne anwo kɛ ɔbaha Mɔdekae ɛhunlɛ nwo edwɛkɛ yeahile ye. Ɛnee Heeman ɛziezie ɛleka mɔɔ bɛbazinze Mɔdekae bɛahu ye la ɛwie. 5Sonvolɛma ne hanle hilele belemgbunli ne kɛ, “Heeman a wɔ ɛkɛ a, na ɔkulo kɛ ɔnwu wɔ.”
Belemgbunli ne zele kɛ, “Bɛze ye kɛ ɔrɛla.”
6Heeman wolole sua ne anu ala la, belemgbunli ne bizale ye kɛ, “Duzu debie yɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛyɛ bɛmaa sonla mɔɔ belemgbunli anye ɛlie ɔ nwo na ɔkulo kɛ ɔdi ye eni la a?”
Heeman hanle ye ɔ ti anu kɛ, “Ɛnee nwane ala bɔbɔ yɛɛ belemgbunli kɛli ye eni kɛdɛla me a? Medame ala ɔ!”
7-8Na Heeman hanle kɛ, “Saa belemgbunli kulo kɛ ɔwula awie anyunlunyia a, ɛnee ɔmaa bɛva belemgbunli adɛladeɛ mɔɔ ɛdawɔ wɔwula ye ɛlɛ la bɛrɛla, bɛva ɛkpɔnwɔ mɔɔ belemgbunli ɛdɛnla zolɛ na bɛzoa ye belemgbunli kyɛlɛ la bɛrɛla, 9na bɛva adɛladeɛ ne mɔ nee ɛkpɔnwɔ ne bɛmaa belemgbunli mgbanyima ne mɔ mɔɔ di munli la anu ko. Akee maa kpanyinli zɔhane ɛziezie sonla ne mɔɔ belemgbunli kulo kɛ ɔdi ye eni la, ɔva ye ɔdɛnla ɛkpɔnwɔ ne azo, na ɔva ye ɔdudu gua wɔ suakpole ye azo ɛleka wienyi ne mɔɔ bɛyia la, na ɔli ɔ nyunlu ɔbɔ nolo kɛ, ‘Kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛyɛ sonla ne mɔɔ belemgbunli kulo kɛ ɔwula ye anyunlunyia la ɛne!’ ”
10Na belemgbunli ne zele Heeman kɛ, “Ka ɛ nwo kɔva belemgbunli adɛladeɛ ne mɔ bie nee ɛkpɔnwɔ, kɛmɔ ɛdawɔ wɔha la, na yɛ mɔɔ wɔha la maa Dwuunli Mɔdekae mɔɔ de suakunlu ɛke anuhɔlɛ ne la. Debie biala mɔɔ wɔha la, mmagyakyi bie nuhua.”
11Yemɔti Heeman hɔvale adɛladeɛ ne nee ɛkpɔnwɔ ne. Ɔzieziele Mɔdekae, ɔvale ye ɔdɛnlanle ɛkpɔnwɔ ne azo na ɔvale ye ɔdudule gua wɔ suakpole ne azo ɛleka wienyi ne mɔɔ ɔyɛ a bɛyia la, ɔbɔle nolo kɛ, “Kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛyɛ sonla ne mɔɔ belemgbunli kulo kɛ ɔwula ye anyunlunyia la ɛne!”
12Akee Mɔdekae ziale hɔdɛnlanle ɔ bo zo ne wɔ belemgbunli ne anuhɔlɛ ne. Na Heeman hedale ɔ ti zo na ɔvale nyane nee nyiane ɔhɔle sua nu ndɛndɛ. 13Heeman hanle mɔɔ ɛzi ɔ nwo zo la amuala hilele ɔ ye Zilɛhye nee ɔ gɔnwo mɔ amuala. Na ye menli ne mɔɔ tu ye folɛ la nee ɔ ye Zilɛhye zele ye kɛ, “Saa Mɔdekae mɔɔ kɛkala wɔbɔ ɔ bo kɛ ɛlɛtu ɛtɔ ɔ nyunlu la le Dwuunli ɛdeɛ a, ɛnee noko ɛnrɛhola ye, ɔbali ɛ nwo zo konim.”
Bɛku Heeman
14Mɔɔ Heeman agɔnwo mɔ nee ɔ ye anloa wɔ zolɛ bɛ nee ye ɛlɛtendɛ la, yɛɛ belemgbunli ne sonvolɛma rale a, na bɛvale ye bɛ nee ye hɔle ɛkponle ne mɔɔ Ɛseta ɛdo ɛmaa belemgbunli ne la abo.

Title: ƐST 7
Content:
1Na belemgbunli ne nee Heeman hɔle Belemgbunli Raalɛ Ɛseta ɛkɛ ne kɛ bɛ nee ye kakpula bɛ sa bieko. 2Na ye kenle nwiɔ ne azo, mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee bɛlɛno nwanye la, belemgbunli ne eza bizale Ɛseta kɛ, “Belemgbunli Raalɛ Ɛseta, duzu a ɛkulo kɛ meyɛ memaa wɔ a? Duzu a ɛkpondɛ a? Debie biala mɔɔ ɛkulo la ka na mebava meamaa wɔ. Saa ɛkpondɛ me maanle ye foa ko bɔbɔ a, ɛ sa baha ye.”
3Belemgbunli Raalɛ Ɛseta yele ɔ nloa kɛ, “Nana, saa mezɔ ɛ nye na ɔyɛ Nana ɛhulolɛ kɛ ɔkɛyɛ mɔɔ mekpondɛ la amgba a ɛnee Nana, mesɛlɛ wɔ, die me nee me menli ne fi ewule nu. 4Ɔluakɛ bɛdɔne me nee me menli ne bɛmaa kɛ bɛhu yɛ bɛbɔ yɛ bo zo bɔkɔɔ. Saa bɛdɔnenle yɛ kɛ ahanra mrenya nee mraalɛ ala a, anrɛɛ ɔnvane me nwo. Ɔluakɛ yɛ kpɔvolɛ ne ɛhunlɛ mɔɔ ɔbamaa bɛahu yɛ la ɛnrɛhola ɛnrɛzie mɔɔ belemgbunli ne baminli ye la abo zo.”
5Belemgbunli Zɛzɛse bizale Belemgbunli Raalɛ Ɛseta kɛ, “Ɛnee nwane a ɔdaye yehola yeyɛ debie zɛhae a, yɛɛ ahenle wɔ nienwu?”
6Ɛseta buale ye kɛ, “Kpɔvolɛ ne mɔɔ ɛwie yɛ yɛ la a le Heeman amumuyɛ ɛhye!”
Heeman ahonle dule na ɔ nye hale belemgbunli ne nee Belemgbunli Raalɛ Ɛseta anyunlu. 7Na ɛkɛ ne ala belemgbunli ne vale ɛya, na ɔdwazole ɛkponle ne anwo, ɔhɔle suakunlu ɛkɛ ne tola ne anu. Heeman andwazo bie; ɔhale ɛkɛ ne kɛ ɔkpa Belemgbunli Raalɛ Ɛseta kyɛlɛ kɛ ɔlie ye ngoane, ɔluakɛ ɛnee yenwu kɛ belemgbunli ɛva ɛya kpole, na mɔɔ li ɔ nzi la le munzule kpole maa ye. 8Yemɔti Heeman dule dɔle ebia ne mɔɔ Ɛseta la nu la azo kɛ ɔkpa ye kyɛlɛ. Mekɛ ne anu ala yɛɛ belemgbunli ne vindele ɛkɛ ne a, na ɔzele kɛ, “Wio o! Akee eza me nyunlu ɛke ala, wɔ me gyakɛ azo ɛke yɛɛ Heeman akee bafunlofunla belemgbunli raalɛ ye a?”
Belemgbunli ne anloa ampe bɔbɔ yɛɛ sonvolɛma ne mɔ hedale Heeman ati zo a. 9Na Haabona, belemgbunli ne sonvolɛma ne mɔ ko mɔɔ ɛnee li ɔ nzi la hanle kɛ, “Ɛzinzelɛ ɛhuleka mɔɔ Heeman mumua ne manle bɛzieziele kɛ bɛbava bɛahu Mɔdekae, mɔɔ ɛkenle liele belemgbunli ne ngoane la tɛbɔ ɔdaye Heeman ye sua nu lɔ. Ye anwuma ɛhɔlɛ le mita abulanwiɔ nee nwiɔ.”
Belemgbunli ne zele kɛ, “Bɛva ye bɛhɔzinze zolɛ.”
10Na bɛvale Heeman bɛhɔzinzele ɛhuleka ne mɔɔ ɔmanle bɛzieziele kɛ ɔbava yeahu Mɔdekae la azo. Na akee belemgbunli ne akunlu dwole fɔɔnwo.

Title: ƐST 8
Content:
Bɛze Dwuuma kɛ bɛho bɛlie bɛ nwo
1Kenle ko zɔhane Belemgbunli Zɛzɛse vale Heeman mɔɔ le Dwuuma kpɔvolɛ ne la debie biala manle Belemgbunli Raalɛ Ɛseta. Akee Mɔdekae nyianle adenle wɔ belemgbunli sua nu ɛkɛ ne, ɔluakɛ ɛnee Ɛseta ɛha ɛhile belemgbunli ne kɛ ye awie a le Mɔdekae. 2Belemgbunli ne vale ye kpɔdelera ne mɔɔ ɔfa ɔsi kɛlata zo, mɔɔ ɔliele ɔvile Heeman ɛkɛ ne la manle Mɔdekae. Na Ɛseta yɛle Mɔdekae kpanyinli mɔɔ nea debie biala mɔɔ Heeman lɛ la azo.
3Akee Ɛseta dule dɔle belemgbunli ne agyakɛ anu, na ɔvale ɛzunlɛ ɔbodole ye kɛ ɔbɔ mɔdenle ɔye munzule kpole ne mɔɔ Agage anlɔnra Heeman ɛhyehyɛ ɛva Dwuuma amuala akɔme ɛwula nu la wɔ bɛ ti. 4Belemgbunli ne kpogyale ye tumi ezukoa nvutuke kpɔma ne ati zo hilele Ɛseta, 5na Ɛseta dwazole gyinlanle. Na ɔzele kɛ, “Awulae, mesɛlɛ wɔ, mmafa ɛya. Saa ɔyɛ wɔ ɛhulolɛ na mesɔ ɛ nye, na eza saa Nana ɔdaye ɔnea na ɔle kpalɛ ɛdeɛ a, ɛnee maa bɛhɛlɛ ɛ nloa edwɛkɛ bɛhɔpɛ Agage anlɔnra Heeman, mɔɔ le Hamɛdeeta ara ne ngɛlata ne mɔ mɔɔ ɔhɛlɛle kɛ ɔfa yeazɛkye Dwuuma amuala mɔɔ wɔ ɛke nee maanzinli ne mɔ amuala anu la anu. 6Ɔluakɛ menrɛhola munzule kpole ɛhye mɔɔ bazi me menli ne mɔ anwo zo la anloa gyinla, yɛɛ menrɛhola me nwo sɔ kɛ megyinla meanlea, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛku me menli ne amuala bɛabɔ bɛ bo zo la.”
7Na Belemgbunli Zɛzɛse zele Belemgbunli Raalɛ Ɛseta nee Dwuunli Mɔdekae kɛ, “Bɛdie, meva debie biala mɔɔ le Heeman ɛdeɛ la memaa Ɛseta na memaa bɛzinze Heeman bɛhu ye, wɔ ye adwenle ɛtane ne mɔɔ ɔvale kɛ ɔku Dwuuma la ati. 8Na ɛdawɔ noko ɛze kɛ kɛlata mɔɔ bɛkɛva belemgbunli ne duma bɛkɛhɛlɛ na bɛkɛva ye kpɔdelera ne bɛkɛzi zolɛ la, bɛndwe bɛnzia, yɛɛ bɛmpɛ nuhua. Zɔhane ati bɛdabɛ bɛva belemgbunli ne duma bɛhɛlɛ mɔɔ bɛdabɛ bɛnea a bɛkulo kɛ Dwuuma yɛ la, bɛva belemgbunli ne kpɔdelera ne bɛzi zolɛ na bɛva bɛhɔmaa bɛ.”
9Siane nsa ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye “Sivan” la ye kenle abulanwiɔ nee nsa ne azo, Mɔdekae vɛlɛle belemgbunli ne kɛlɛhɛlɛvolɛma ne mɔ na ɔhanle mɔɔ ɔkpondɛ kɛ bɛkɛlɛ wɔ Dwuuma anwo la ɔhilele bɛ. Bɛhɛlɛle edwɛkɛ ne bɛhɔmanle amɛnladoma, maanzinli zo neavolɛma, yɛɛ maanle maanle ɛya ko abulanwiɔ nee nsuu ne mɔɔ vi Yendea kɔkpula Yiteyopea la anu arelemgbunli. Bɛhɛlɛle kɛlata ne wɔ maanle ko biala ɔdaye ye aneɛ nee ye ɛhɛlɛndenle nu, yɛɛ akee bɛhɛlɛle Dwuuma mɔɔ wɔ maanle maanle ne mɔ anu la wɔ bɛdabɛ bɛ aneɛ nee bɛ ɛhɛlɛndenle nu. 10Mɔdekae manle bɛvale Belemgbunli Zɛzɛse duma a bɛhɛlɛle ngɛlata ne mɔ a, yɛɛ bɛvale belemgbunli ne kpɔdelera ne bɛsisile ngɛlata ne mɔ azo. Belemgbunli sonvolɛma mɔɔ tɛnla mgbɔnwɔ mɔɔ anwo yɛ ndɛ na bɛyɛne bɛ wɔ belemgbunli ne ɔdaye ye tunli nu la azo a hɔle a.
11Ngɛlata ne mɔ manle Dwuuma mɔɔ wɔ suakpole biala azo la adenle kɛ bɛboɔboa bɛ nloa na bɛho bɛlie bɛ nwo. Ɛlɔne biala mɔɔ kɛra bɛ nwo zo wɔ menli anzɛɛ maanle biala anu la, bɛhu bɛ, bɛhu bɛ mra nee bɛ mraalɛ, bɛbɔ bɛ bo zo na bɛve bɛ ninyɛne. 12Ngɛlata ne mɔ kile kɛ, siane bulu nee nwiɔ ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye “Eda” la, ye kenle bulu nee nsa ne azo, yɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ ɛhye si wɔ Belemgbunli Zɛzɛse maanle maanle ne kɔsɔɔti anu a. 13Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛyɛ kɛlata ne mɔɔ bɛ sa baha ye maanzinli ne mɔ anu la anu edwɛkɛ ne mɛla; ɔwɔ kɛ bɛbɔ edwɛkɛ ne nolo bɛkile menli ne amuala na bɛmaa Dwuuma adenle bɛmaa bɛboɔboa bɛ nwo bɛ nee kpɔvolɛma ko die bɛ nwo. 14Zɔhane ati bɛmanle belemgbunli ne sonvolɛma ne vole mgbɔnwɔ mɔɔ anwo yɛ ndɛ kpalɛ la azo a hɔle a, wɔ belemgbunli ne ɔdaye ye duma nu. Bɛbɔle mɛla ɛhye nolo wɔ Susa, mɔɔ le maanle maanle ne suakpole la azo noko.
15Akee Mɔdekae vi belemgbunli sua nu finde a ɔwula belemgbunli tɛladeɛ buluwu nee fufule, na ɔsoa belemgbunli ezukoa nvutuke kyɛlɛ, na yeava dwɛsɛ ɛdanlɛ anye nwohyee nee kɔkɔlɛ kɛnlɛma bie yeagua zolɛ. Ɔvi belemgbunli sua nu ɔfinde a ɛnee awie biala anye ɛlie. 16Dwuuma mɔɔ wɔ suakpole ne azo la anwo dɔle bɛ, bɛlile fɛlɛko, bɛ nye liele, na awie biala lile bɛ eni. 17Wɔ maanzinli biala anu anzɛɛ suakpole biala azo mɔɔ belemgbunli ne kɛlata ne nee ye mɛla ne kɛdwu la, Dwuuma anye die, bɛdi fɛlɛko, bɛsie kenle bɛdie bɛ ɛnwomenle na bɛto ɛkponle. Menli dɔɔnwo noko mɔɔ wɔ maanle ne anu la zulole Dwuuma, na ɔlua zolɛ bɛhakyile bɛyɛle Dwuuma.

Title: ƐST 9
Content:
Dwuuma sɛkye bɛ kpɔvolɛma
1Siane bulu nee nwiɔ ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye “Eda” la, ye kenle bulu nee nsa ne azo yɛɛ belemgbunli ne mɛla ne nee ye ngɛlata ne mɔ anu edwɛkɛ ne mekɛ dwule a, na mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ si la si. Kenle ko ne yɛɛ bɛhyehyɛ kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛngulo Dwuuma edwɛkɛ la dwazo bɛ nwo zo na bɛku bɛ a. Noko ɛhye anyɛ zɔhane. Ɔyɛle kenle mɔɔ Dwuuma lile bɛ kpɔvolɛma anwo zo konim a. 2Dwuuma mɔɔ wɔ azuamgbole mɔɔ wɔ maanle mɔɔ Belemgbunli Zɛzɛse sie bɛ la azo la boɔboale bɛ nloa na bɛhonle bɛliele bɛ nwo bɛvile awie biala mɔɔ rale bɛ nwo zo kɛ ɔbahu bɛ la asa anu. Na awie biala angola bɛ nyunlu gyinla, ɔluakɛ ɛnee bɛ nwo ɛzulolɛ ɛyɛ debie ɛdɔ menli ne kɔsɔɔti anwo zo. 3Arane mbɔlɔba mgbanyinli, amɛnladoma, maanzinli zo neavolɛma, yɛɛ arane mbɔlɔba kɔsɔɔti lile boale Dwuuma, ɔluakɛ ɛnee bɛsulo Mɔdekae kpole kpalɛ. 4Ɔboalekɛ ɛnee Mɔdekae ɛyɛ sonlakpole kpalɛ wɔ belemgbunli sua nu ɛkɛ ne na ye tumi ne nganeɛ ɛdende ɛhɔ maanle maanle ne mɔ amuala anu mɔɔ awie biala ze a, yɛɛ eza anwuma ala a ye tumi ne kɔ a. 5Na Dwuuma hunle bɛ kpɔvolɛma bɛzɛkyele bɛ na bɛyɛle bɛ kɛmɔ bɛdabɛ bɛkulo la.
6Wɔ suakpole Susa azo angome, Dwuuma hunle menli ɛya nnu na bɛbɔle bɛ bo zo. 7-10Hamɛdeeta ara Heeman mɔɔ kpɔ Dwuuma kɛ debie la amra bulu ne boka bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛhunle bɛ la. Bɛmɛ a le Paahyandeeta, Dalefɔn, yɛɛ Asepata; Pɔlata, Adeelea nee Aledeeta; akee Paamahyeta, Alesae, Aledae, yɛɛ Vaezata. Dwuuma hunle menli zɛhae bɔbɔ ɛdeɛ, noko bɛanva bɛ sa bɛanga awie biala debie.
11Kenle ko ne ala bɛhanle menli mɔɔ bɛhu bɛ wɔ suakpole Susa angome azo la bɛhilele belemgbunli ne. 12Na belemgbunli ne zele Belemgbunli Raalɛ Ɛseta kɛ, “Wɔ Susa sua bɔdenle ye azo angome, Dwuuma ɛhu menli ɛya nnu. Heeman amra mrenya bulu ne boka nwolɛ. Na menea a maanzinli ne mɔ anu ɛdeɛ ne kɛyɛ ɛzulolɛ. Kɛkala duzu yɛɛ akee ɛkpondɛ a? Mɔɔ ɛkpondɛ la, ɛ sa baha ye. Duzu bieko a ɛkpondɛ a? Ka, na mebayɛ meamaa wɔ.”
13Na Ɛseta buale kɛ, “Nana, mesɛlɛ wɔ, anrɛɛ mese ɛmaa Dwuuma mɔɔ wɔ Susa ɛke la adenle ɛmaa ɛhyema bɛyɛ mɔɔ ɛnɛ kenle ye bɛyɛ la bieko, na maa bɛva nyɛma bɛsosɔ Heeman amra bulu ne akɔme bɛhendɛhenda bɛ.” 14Zɔhane ati belemgbunli ne manle adenle manle bɛyɛle ɛhye, na bɛlile mɛla wɔ Susa, bɛmanle bɛhendɛhendanle Heeman amra bulu ne. 15Dwuuma mɔɔ wɔ Susa la boale bɛ nloa bieko wɔ siane “Eda” ne ye kenle bulu nee nna ne azo na bɛhunle menli ɛya nsa bieko, noko bɛanva bɛ sa bɛanga awie biala debie.
16Dwuuma mɔɔ wɔ belemgbunli ne maanzinli ne mɔ anu la bɛdabɛ bɛlile ahua na bɛhonle bɛliele bɛ nwo bɛvile bɛ kpɔvolɛma asa anu. Bɛhunle menli mɔɔ kpɔ bɛ la anu apenle ngoko abulasuu nee nnu, noko bɛanva bɛ sa bɛanga awie biala debie. 17Bɛyɛle ɛhye mɔ wɔ siane “Eda” ne ye kenle bulu nee nsa ne azo. Bɛliele bɛ ɛnwomenle wɔ kenle bulu nee nna ne azo, bɛliele bɛ nye na bɛlile fɛlɛko, bɛdole nwolɛ ɛkponle. 18Na Dwuuma mɔɔ wɔ Susa la lile ahua na bɛhonle kenle bulu nee nsa ne nee kenle bulu nee nna ne azo na bɛliele bɛ ɛnwomenle wɔ kenle bulu nee nnu ne azo, bɛlile fɛlɛko na bɛdole ɛkponle bɛlieliele bɛ nye. 19Ɛhye ati yɛɛ Dwuuma mɔɔ wɔ namunamu ne mɔ nee azua ngyikyi zo la die bɛ ɛnwomenle wɔ siane “Eda” ne ye kenle bulu nee nna ne azo la. Ɔdwu zolɛ a, bɛ nye die, bɛdi fɛlɛko na bɛto ɛkponle, bɛfa aleɛ ahyɛlɛdeɛ bɛmemaa bɛ nwo ngoko ngoko.
Pulem ɛvoyia ne
20Mɔdekae hɛlɛle ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ mɔɔ sisile la amuala wɔ ngɛlata zo na ɔvale ɔhɔmanle Dwuuma mɔɔ wɔ Belemgbunli Zɛzɛse maanle maanle ne mɔ anu la amuala. 21Wɔ ye ngɛlata ne mɔ anu, ɔzele Dwuuma kɛ bɛzie ɛvolɛ biala siane “Eda” ne ye kenle bulu nee nna nee ye kenle bulu nee nnu ne 22kɛ bɛle kenle mɔɔ bɛvale bɛnyianle bɛ ti bɛvile bɛ kpɔvolɛma asa anu a. Siane zɔhane anu yɛɛ bɛ nyane nee bɛ arɛlebɔlɛ hakyile fɛlɛkolilɛ nee anyelielɛ a. Bɛ nwo dɔle bɛ na bɛliele bɛ ɛnwomenle. Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛdie bɛ nye na bɛto ɛkponle wɔ mekɛ ɛhye anu, na bɛfa ninyɛne bɛkyɛ bɛ nwo ngoko ngoko, na bɛfa ahyɛlɛdeɛ bɛmaa ehyianvolɛma. 23Zɔhane ati Dwuuma lile Mɔdekae ngyehyɛlɛ ne azo, na bɛhɔle zolɛ bɛyɛle kenle ne ɛvoyia mɔɔ ɛvolɛ biala bɛdi a.
24 Agagenli Heeman, mɔɔ le Hamɛdeeta ara nrenya ne mɔɔ kpɔ Dwuuma kɛ debie la, vale Dwuuma amuala anwo adwenle kɛ ɔbɔ bɛ bo zo. Ɔlua zolɛ ɔhwenle nwolɛ adunyi, mɔɔ Hibulu nu bɛfɛlɛ ye “Pulu” la, kɛ ɔkpondɛ kenle mɔɔ ɔkɛva ɔkɛli zɔhane gyima ne la. 25Na Ɛseta hɔle belemgbunli ne anyunlu, na belemgbunli ne manle bɛhɛlɛle ngɛlata na ɔmanle adwenle ɛtane ne mɔɔ Heeman vale la hakyile dɔle ɔ nwo zo. Ɔlua zolɛ bɛzinzele ye nee ɔ mra mrenya bulu ne amuala bɛhunle bɛ. 26Ɛhye ati a bɛfɛlɛ zɛhae ɛnwomenlelielɛ kenle ye “Pulem” a, ɔlua adunyi anzɛɛ “Pulu” ne mɔɔ bɛhwenle la ati. Zɔhane ala yɛɛ ɔlua mɔɔ Mɔdekae hɛlɛle, nee mɔɔ sisile bɛ nwo zo, nee mɔɔ bɛnwunle ye la ati, 27Dwuuma ziele kenle ɛhye mɔ na bɛzɔle nu kɛ bɛdabɛ, bɛ nlɔnra, yɛɛ awie biala mɔɔ bokale bɛ la, kɛli ɛvoyia ɛhye ɛvolɛ biala mɔɔ ɔmkpa nwolɛ fee a, kɛmɔ bɛhɛlɛ bɛdo ɛkɛ ne la. 28Bɛbali ɛvoyia ɛhye ɛvolɛ biala wɔ awuke awuke nu, maanle biala anu, yɛɛ suakpole biala azo awolɛndoazo muala anu. Ɔnle kɛ Dwuunli biala sɛkye ɛvoyia ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye “Pulem” la, yɛɛ ɔnle kɛ bɛgyakyi ɛvoyia zɛhae ɛlilɛ wɔ bɛ abusuandoazo biala mekɛ zo ɛlɛ.
29Akee Belemgbunli Raalɛ Ɛseta mɔɔ le Abeheli ara raalɛ ne nee Dwuunli Mɔdekae hɛlɛle kɛlata hɔzile amozi kɛlata ne mɔɔ fane ɛvoyia “Pulem” ne anwo la pi. 30Bɛvale ngɛlata bɛhɔmanle Dwuuma amuala mɔɔ wɔ maanle maanle ɛya ko abulanwiɔ nee nsuu ne mɔɔ Belemgbunli Zɛzɛse sie bɛ la amuala anu, bɛhanle nɔhalɛ nee anzonudwolɛ edwɛkɛ 31kɛ ɛvoyia ɛhye mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye “Pulem” la dwu zolɛ a, bɛli, kɛmɔ Dwuunli Mɔdekae nee Belemgbunli Raalɛ Ɛseta ɛhyehyɛ ɛmaa Dwuuma kɔsɔɔti la. Bɛhyehyɛle ɛhye bɛmanle bɛdabɛ bɛ nwo nee bɛ mra nee bɛ bo zo amra amuala, kɛ bɛli zolɛ kɛmɔ bɛlile nyanelilɛ nee ɛhɔnehyelɛ ngyehyɛlɛ ne azo la. 32Belemgbunli Raalɛ Ɛseta a hyehyɛle zɛhae “Pulem” ɛvoyia ne a, yɛɛ bɛhɛlɛle bɛdole ɛkɛ a.

Title: ƐST 10
Content:
Belemgbunli Zɛzɛse nee Mɔdekae bɛ kpoleyɛlɛ ne
1Akee Belemgbunli Zɛzɛse dele adwule manle bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ maanle ne anu ɛnweazo nee ɛbɔ nu la amuala. 2Belemgbunli ne tumi nee ye ninyɛne mgbole mɔɔ ɔyɛle, nee eni mɔɔ ɔlile Mɔdekae ɔmanle ye zo wɔ ye gyima nu la, bɛhɛlɛ bɛ muala wɔ Midea nee Pɛhyea arelemgbunli edwɛkɛ mɔɔ sisile bɛ mekɛ zo la buluku ne anu. 3Ɛnee saa ɛye Belemgbunli Zɛzɛse a, Dwuunli Mɔdekae a wɔ ɛkɛ a. Mɔdekae nyianle ɔ nyunlu na Dwuuma nee ɔ gɔnwo mɔ amuala hulole ye edwɛkɛ na bɛlile ye eni. Mɔdekae eza kpondɛle Dwuuma kpalɛyɛlɛ na ɔmanle bɛ nzo nu dwole bɛ.

Title: DWO MUKENYE
Content:
Mukenye
Dwobu buluku ne le adawu mɔɔ fane sonlakpalɛ bie mɔɔ nwunle ɔ nyunlu kpole bie la anwo. Ɔ mra nee ye agyadeɛ biala vile ɔ sa; akee anwonyane kpole bie bɔle ye manle ɔhale aze bɔkɔɔ. Wɔ edwɛkɛdwɛndolɛ adwelielilɛ ndenle nsa azo, kɛlɛvolɛ ne kile nyɛleɛ mɔɔ Dwobu mumua ne nee ɔ gɔnwo mɔ yɛle wɔ anwubɛnyunlu ɛhye anwo la. Nzinlii Nyamenle mumua ne yele ɔ nwo hilele Dwobu. Kɛ Nyamenle si nee sonla dua la a le edwɛkɛ titile mɔɔ wɔ adwelielilɛ ne anu a.
Dwobu agɔnwo mɔ kile ye anwubɛnyunlu ne abo wɔ bɛdabɛ bɛ tete nyamenlezonlenlɛ ngilehilelɛ nu. Ngilehilelɛ ne kile kɛ Nyamenle yɛ ahunlunyele maa kpalɛyɛlɛma, yɛɛ ɔtea ɛtanevolɛma. Yemɔti Dwobu amaneɛnwunlɛ ne kile kɛ yeyɛ ɛtane yetia Nyamenle. Na wɔ Dwobu afoa nu, ɔnlie ɛtane kakɛdualɛ ɛhye ɔndo nu, ɔboalekɛ ɔle sonlakpalɛ bɔkɔɔ yɛɛ ɔdi pɛlepɛle. Yemɔti ɛnee ɔnde ɔ bo kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ Nyamenle maa anwubɛnyunlu ɛhye to sonla mɔɔ le kɛ ɔdaye la, na ɔzile ɔ kɛnra ɔzule Nyamenle kpolera. Dwobu amminli ye diedi ne, na ɔhulole kɛ anrɛɛ Nyamenle ɛbua ye benle na yemaa yegyinla ye gyinlabelɛ dɛba ne kɛ ɔle sonlakpalɛ.
Nyamenle ambua Dwobu kpuyia ne mɔ anwo, noko ɔliele ye diedi ne ɔdole nu, na ɔmanle ɔhilele Nyamenle tumi ne nee ye nrɛlɛbɛ wɔ edwɛkɛdwɛndolɛ nu. Wɔ mɛlɛbɛnwoaze nu, akee Dwobu die to nu kɛ Nyamenle le nrɛlɛbɛvolɛ, ɔle kpole, na ɔnlunle ɔ nwo wɔ ye ɛya nee ye mgbole ne mɔɔ ɔhehanle la anwo.
Akee edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ dwula adawu ne la kile kɛ Dwobu zile nyianle ye gyinlabelɛ dɛba ne la. Ye anwonyia ne yɛle mɔnwo mɔnwo. Nyamenle twi Dwobu agɔnwo mɔ anyunlu kɛ bɛande Dwobu amaneɛnwunlɛ ne abo. Dwobu angomekye ala a nwunle kɛ Nyamenle le kpole tɛla mɔɔ tete nyamenlezonlenlɛ kile la.
Mɔɔ wɔ nu la
Edwɛkɛ ne anye ɛbukelɛ 1.1—2.13
Dwobu nee ɔ gɔnwo mɔ 3.1—31.40

3 Adwelielilɛ mɔɔ tɔ zo nwiɔ 15.1—21.34
4 Adwelielilɛ mɔɔ tɔ zo nsa 22.1—27.23

Title: DWO 1
Content:
Seetan sɔ Dwobu anlea
1Ɛnee nrenya bie wɔ Ɛɛze maanle nu. Bɛfɛlɛ ye Dwobu. Nrenya ɛhye anwo ɛnlɛ dɛne biala yɛɛ ɔle sonla fɔɔnwo, ɔdi nɔhalɛ ɔmaa Nyamenle, yɛɛ ɔkyi ɛtane. 2Ɔwole mralɛ mrenya nsuu yɛɛ mraalɛ nsa. 3Ɔlɛ mboane apenle nsuu, afunlumu apenle nsa, nlankɛ apenle ko, asoaso ɛya nnu, yɛɛ sonvolɛma dɔɔnwo; nrenya ɛhye le sukoavolɛ kpole tɛla awie biala mɔɔ wɔ Aduduleɛ la.
4Ɔ mra ne mɔ to ɛkponle bɛ ti ngoko. Saa ko biala mekɛ ɛdeɛ ne dwu a, ɔto ɛkponle na ɔfɛlɛvɛlɛ ɔ mediema mrenya ne mɔ nee bɛ mediema mraalɛ ne mɔ na bɛ nee bɛ di, no, dielie bɛ nye. 5Saa bɛto ɛkponle ne toonwo na ɔyia bɛ ti a, Dwobu fɛlɛ bɛ na ɔnua bɛ. Ɔdwazo aleɛbahye na ɔbɔ bɛ ti ngoko ɔfa nane ɔyela ɔbɔ azu, ɔluakɛ Dwobu edwɛkɛ a le kɛ, “Wɔannea a ɛnee me mra ne mɔ ɛyɛ ɛtane wɔ bɛ ahonle nu na bɛdendɛ ɛtane bɛtia Nyamenle.” Dwobu yɛle ɛhye mekɛ biala.
6 Kenle ko Nyamenle anzɛɛ Anwuma amra hɔle Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu kɛ bɛkava bɛ nwo bɛahile ye, na Seetan ɔdaye ɔhɔle ɛkɛ ne bie. 7Ɛdɛnkɛma bizale Seetan kɛ, “Na ɛvi nienwu yɛɛ wɔra ɛke a?”
Seetan buale Ɛdɛnkɛma kɛ, “Mewɔ akpɔsa nu wɔ aleɛabo. Ewiade anu ala yɛɛ medi ye akɔneaba a.”
8Na Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Seetan kɛ, “Wɔnwu me sonvolɛ Dwobu, awie biala mɔɔ le kɛ ɔdaye la ɛnle aleɛabo, ɛtane biala ɛnle ɔ nwo yɛɛ ɔdi nɔhalɛ. Ɔsulo Nyamenle yɛɛ ɔtwe ɔ nwo ɔfi ɛtane nwo.”
9 Seetan buale Ɛdɛnkɛma kɛ, “Na mgbane ala yɛɛ Dwobu sulo Nyamenle a? 10Wɔbɔ ɔdaye, ɔ mra nee debie biala mɔɔ ɔlɛ la anwo bane. Dahuu ɛsinza ye, ye abusua ne nee debie biala mɔɔ ɔlɛ la. Wɔyila ɔ sa anloa gyima zo yɛɛ dahuu ye anwonyia ne, kpole ala a ɔyɛ a. 11Saa ɛkulo a die debie biala mɔɔ ɔlɛ la fi ɔ sa nu na ɛkɛde mgbole mɔɔ ɔkɛheha ɔkɛtietia wɔ la.”
12Na Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Seetan kɛ, “Nea, debie biala mɔɔ ɔlɛ la wɔ ɛ sa nu, noko mmafa ɛ sa ɛka Dwobu ɛleka biala fee.” Akee Seetan vi Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu ɛkɛ ne hɔle.
Dwobu amra nee ye anwonyia ɛzɛkye
13Kenle ko mɔɔ Dwobu amra ne mɔ, mrenya nee mraalɛ yiale ralɛ nrenya kpanyinli ne sua nu na bɛlɛdi, bɛno nwanye la, 14ɛbɔfoɔ rale Dwobu ɛkɛ razele ye kɛ, “Mɔɔ nlankɛ ne mɔ ɛlɛfundu azɛlɛ ne na asoaso ne mɔ noko ɛlɛdidi bɛ nwo ɛkɛ ne la, 15arɛlevilɛ nu ala, Sabima ralile yɛ nvunu hyehyele nlankɛ ne mɔ na bɛhunle sonvolɛma ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti. Me ngomekye ala a meha mɔɔ menriandi mera mebabɔ wɔ amaneɛ a.”
16Mɔɔ ɔ nloa wɔ zolɛ ɔlɛtendɛ la, ɛbɔfoɔ fofolɛ vindele ɛkɛ razele ye kɛ, “Nyamenle ɛkpakye ɛsɛnlɛmanye ɛhu mboane ne nee sonvolɛma ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti na yeyela bɛ wee. Me ngomekye ala a mevi nu mɔɔ mera mebabɔ wɔ amaneɛ a.”
17Ɔ nloa ampe ɛnee ɛbɔfoɔ bieko anyunlu ɛne. Ɔse, “Kaledima ɛhyɛ bɛ nu ekpunli nsa ɛrali yɛ nvunu, ɛhye afunlumu ne mɔ amuala ɛhɔ, na bɛhu sonvolɛma ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti. Me ngomekye ala a meha mɔɔ mera mebabɔ wɔ amaneɛ a.”
18Mɔɔ ɔ nloa wɔ zolɛ ɔlɛtendɛ la, ɛbɔfoɔ bieko vindele ɛkɛ razele ye kɛ, “Ɛ mra mrenya nee mraalɛ ne mɔ wɔ bɛ diema nrenya kpanyinli ne sua nu, bɛlɛdi, bɛno nwanye. 19Na nea, ahumu kpole bie vi fienemgbole ne anu lɔ ɛdu ɛrabu sua ne ɛgua bɛ nwo zo, ɛhu bɛ muala. Me ngomekye ala a mevi nu mɔɔ mera mebabɔ wɔ amaneɛ a.”
20Akee Dwobu dwazole, ɔsuosuanle tɛladeɛ mɔɔ ɔwula la anu, ɔkpale ɔ ti, ɔdule ɔdɔle aze na ɔyeyɛle Nyamenle. 21Ɔse, “Meanva bie meamba na mekɔ a meava bie meahɔ. Ɛdɛnkɛma a vale manle me a, yɛɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma a ɛlie ye debie a. Ayɛlɛyelɛ ɛha Ɛdɛnkɛma duma ne.”
22Anwubɛnyunlu ɛhye mɔ kɔsɔɔti anu, Dwobu anyɛ ɛtane biala yɛɛ yeanvu Nyamenle.

Title: DWO 2
Content:
Seetan sɔ Dwobu anlea bieko
1Kenle ko eza Nyamenle anzɛɛ Anwuma amra hɔle Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu kɛ bɛkava bɛ nwo bɛahile ye, na Seetan eza hɔle ɛkɛ ne bie.
2Ɛdɛnkɛma bizale Seetan kɛ, “Na wɔmɔ, ɛvi nienwu yɛɛ wɔra ɛke a?”
Seetan buale Ɛdɛnkɛma kɛ, “Mewɔ akpɔsa nu wɔ aleɛabo. Ewiade anu ala yɛɛ medi ye akɔneaba a.”
3Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Seetan kɛ, “Wɔnwu me sonvolɛ Dwobu, awie biala mɔɔ le kɛ ɔdaye la ɛnle aleɛabo, ɛtane biala ɛnle ɔ nwo, ɔdi nɔhalɛ, ɔsulo Nyamenle na ɔtwe ɔ nwo ɔfi ɛtane nwo. Wɔyɛ anrɛɛ ɛmaa meazɛkye ye, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɔtɛyɛle ɛhwee la, noko wɔnwu ye wienyi kɛ Dwobu gyi ɔ gyakɛ anu kpundii.”
4Na Seetan buale Ɛdɛnkɛma kɛ, “Ɔle zɔhane, na ye nwonane ne noko ɛ! Sonla kɛhulo kɛ ɔkɛdɛnla ngoane nu tɛla kɛ ɔkɛminli anwonyia biala mɔɔ ɔlɛ la. 5Wɔmɔ, ɛkulo a fa ɛ sa ka ye maa ɔde nyane ekyii, na ɛkɛde mgbole mɔɔ ɔkɛheha ɔkɛtietia wɔ la.”
6Na Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Seetan kɛ, “Ɔwɔ ɛ sa nu, na anrɛɛ mmafa ɛ sa ɛka ye ngoane ne.”
7Yemɔti Seetan vi Ɛdɛnkɛma anwo ɛkɛ ne hɔle na ɔhɔdele nganlɛ mgbole ɔkpondenle Dwobu anwo. Ɔvi ɔ ti zo mɔɔ dwu ɔ gyakɛ akunlu la yɛle nganlɛ ngome. 8Dwobu hɔdɛnlanle fovolɛ zo yɛɛ ɔfa foandɛkɛ ɔfonvoa ɔ nwo a. 9Na ɔ ye zele ye kɛ, “Ɛnɛ nee ɛnɛ ala ɛtɛgyi ɛ gyakɛ anu, ɛtɛtoa Nyamenle abo zo. Tendɛ ɛtane tia Nyamenle na wu ɛ.”
10Dwobu buale ye kɛ, “Ɛtendɛ kɛ mraalɛ ahɔnwɔne ne mɔ anu ko tendɛ la. Saa Nyamenle kyɛ yɛ ninyɛne kpalɛ a, yemɔ yɛdie. Na saa anwubɛnyunlu to yɛ a, ɛnee duzu ati a ɔwɔ kɛ yɛkpo ye amunli a?” Wɔ amaneɛnwunlɛ ɛhye mɔ amuala anu Dwobu anloa anvula edwɛkɛ ɛtane antia Nyamenle.
Dwobu agɔnwo mɔ ba
11Mekɛ mɔɔ Dwobu agɔnwo mɔ nsa ne, Ɛlaefaze mɔɔ vi suakpole Tima, Beledade mɔɔ vi Hyua maanle nu, yɛɛ Zofaa mɔɔ vi Neeyama maanle nu la dele ye anwubɛnyunlu ne nganeɛ la, bɛhɛlɛhɛlale bɛ nwo na bɛhilele kenle bɛrale kɛ bɛbakpɔla ye, bɛayɛ ye gyakɔ na bɛakyekye ɔ rɛle. 12Mɔɔ bɛlua adenle zo moa ekyii na bɛnwunle Dwobu la, bɛannwu ye sonla holɛ. Na bɛradole ye la, bɛzunle bɛyele awolɛ. Bɛsuosuanle bɛ adɛladeɛ mɔɔ bɛwula la anu, bɛvale nzonle bɛbɔle bɛ nwo na bɛlile nyane. 13Bɛkpofokpofole azɛlɛ nwo ɛkɛ ne bɛ nee ye dɛnlanle ewiazo nee nɔɔzo toonwo kenle nsuu. Bɛ biala ambuke ɔ nloa anga edwɛkɛkpɔkɛ ko bɔbɔ, ɔboalekɛ bɛnwunle kɛ ɛnee ɔlɛnwu amaneɛ kpole.

Title: DWO 3
Content:
Dwobu ka ye nyane edwɛkɛ ahile Nyamenle
1 Nzinlii Dwobu bukele ɔ nloa na ɔwale kenle ko ne mɔɔ bɛwole ye la amonle.
Dwobu
2Dwobu hanle kɛ,
3“O Nyamenle, maa abule ɛbu kenle ko ne mɔɔ bɛwole me la;
abule ɛbu nɔe ne mɔɔ bɛnrenzɛle me ralɛ nrenya la!
4Nyamenle, maa awozinli ɛva kenle zɔhane.
Mmakakye kenle zɔhane bieko ɛlɛ;
mmamaa wienyi ta kenle zɔhane anu ɛlɛ.
5Maa awozinli kabii nee awozinli mindomindo ɛva ye.
Maa amungu ɛheda zo;
maa alehyenlɛ ne anu awozinli ɛha ɛzulolɛ.
6Nɔɔzo zɔhane, maa awozinli kabii ɛva ye!
Mmamaa bɛtia ye bɛboka ɛvolɛ ne anu kenle ne mɔ anwo,
mmamaa bɛtia ye bɛboka siane ne mɔ anwo.
7Maa nɔɔzo zɔhane ɛyɛ diinyi,
mmamaa bɛte anyelielɛ ɛnelɛ biala.
8Maa amowama ɛbɔ kenle ne sasa, ɛwa ye amonle;
bɛmɛ yɛɛ bɛze kɛ bɛsi bɛmaa nyevizonle maa ɔ nwo zo a.
9Mmamaa ye aleɛbahye nwɔlɔra ne mɔ ta;
mmamaa nɔɔzo zɔhane mangyee si.
10Ɔluakɛ yeando ɔmɔ awodeɛ ne anu,
na ɔyele me ɔmanle nyanenwunlɛ.
11“Me kunlu a anrɛɛ menwule ɔmɔ akunlu,
anzɛɛ bɛwole me ala la mengale nzule nu.
12Duzu ati a ɔmɔ dedɛle me ɔ gyakɛ azo a?
Duzu ati a ɔmanle me nyɛfonlɛ a?
13Saa menwule a, anrɛɛ mela melie me menle koonwu;
anrɛɛ mela melie me menle bie
14kɛ ewiade arelemgbunli nee nrɛlɛbɛvoma
mɔɔ kyekyele awuke mgbole manle bɛ nwo la.
15Anrɛɛ mela kɛ arelemgbunli mralɛ mrenya
mɔɔ vale ezukoa nvutuke nee dwɛtɛ fufule yile bɛ azua
la.
16Anrɛɛ ɔmɔ ako kpɔnenle, na meanyɛ sonla,
anzɛɛ kɛ adɔma mɔɔ wule ɔ nli akunlu.
17Funli kuma nu yɛɛ amumuyɛma gyakyi ninyɛndane,
na menli mɔɔ ɛvɛ la nyia ɛnwomenlelielɛ a.
18Ɛkɛ ne yɛɛ menli mɔɔ gua efiade la anwo tɔ bɛ,
na bɛnde kpoyokpoyo bieko a.
19Mgbolema nee ahoahweabane wɔ ɛkɛ,
na kanranli nyia ɔ ti fi ɔ menle asa anu.
20“Duzu ati a ɛmaa menli mɔɔ de anwunvɔne nu la nwu wienyi a?
Duzu ati a ɛmaa menli mɔɔ te nyane la ngoane ɛ?
21 Bɛ nwo dɔ ewule, noko ewule ɛmba;
bɛkpondɛ ewule bɛtɛla anwonyia biala.
22Kenle mɔɔ bɛkɛwu na bɛkɛzie bɛ la,
ɛnee bɛ nye ɛlie.
23Duzu ati a sonla mɔɔ ɛnze ye kenlebie la,
Nyamenle ɛbɔ ɔ nwo bane a?
24Me aleɛ a le me ɛzunlɛ,
yɛɛ me nzule a le me ɛkponlenlɛ.
25Ɔluakɛ mɔɔ mesulo ye la ɛra me nwo zo,
yɛɛ mɔɔ tu me ahonle la ɛdo me.
26Menlɛ anzonudwolɛ, yɛɛ ɛdendɛlɛ ɛdɔ me nwo;
menlɛ ɛnwomenlelielɛ, yɛɛ me anwubɛnyunlu ɛnlɛ awieleɛ.”

Title: DWO 4
Content:
Alumua Adwelielilɛ ne
(4.1—14.22)
Ɛlaefaze
1Ɛlaefaze buale ye kɛ,
2“Dwobu, saa awie ka edwɛkɛ a ɛkɛva ɛya ɔ?
Sonla ɛnrɛhola ɛnrɛdɛnla ɛke koonwu zɛhae.
3Wɔhilehile menli dɔɔnwo
na wɔmaa menli mɔɔ ɛngola bɛ nwo la anwosesebɛ.
4Saa awie kpo aze, ɔ nwo golo ye na ɔfɛ a,
wɔ ɛdendɛlɛ maa ye akɛnrazilɛ maa ɔdwazo.
5Na kɛkala mɔɔ yedo wɔ la, ɛnnyia nwolɛ abotane;
yeha wɔ la, wɔ adwenle ɛbɔ nu.
6Wɔ Nyamenle ɛzulolɛ manle wɔ adwenle zile pi,
yɛɛ wɔ ndenle kpalɛ zo ɛvalɛ manle wɔ anyelazo.
7Dwenle nwo, nwane a ɛnze nwolɛ bie na ɔwule,
anzɛɛ nienwu yɛɛ bɛhunle tenlenema a?
8Mɔɔ meze la a le kɛ, menli mɔɔ so ninyɛndane ɛya,
na bɛdua amumuyɛ la bu munzule.
9Nyamenle ɛnwomenle ɛgulɛ ku bɛ,
na ye ɛya ne bɔ bɛ bo zo bɔkɔɔ.
10Amumuyɛma kpo na bɛtea kɛ awenade,
na Nyamenle tudu bɛ gye na ɔmaa bɛyɛ koonwu.
11Bɛle kɛ awenade mɔɔ ɛnnyia debie ɛngu ɛnli,
bɛwu na bɛ mra ne mɔ bɔ asande.
12“Mekɛ bie ɛnelɛ bie hanle nrɛlaleɛ hilele me,
ɛnelɛ ne dule me azukue.
13 Ɔrale kɛ ɛlalɛ ɛzulolɛ bie,
mɔɔ menli ka wɔ bɛ nafelɛ nu la.
14Ɛzulolɛ hanle me, me nwo wozole me,
na me mbowule nu wozole.
15Debie pɛle me nye zo,
na me nwo bɔle me nyee.
16Deɛ ne gyinlanle koonwu,
na meannwu ye sɔhovolɛ;
ɛnee debie gyi me nyunlu ɛkɛ;
ɛkɛ ne yɛle diinyi,
akee mendele ɛnelɛ, ɔse:
17Asoo sonla kola yɛ tenlene tɛla Nyamenle
anzɛɛ ɔ nwo kɛde kɛdɛla ye Bɔvolɛ?
18Ye sonvolɛma bɔbɔ, ɔnlie bɛ ɔnli,
yɛɛ anwuma soanvolɛma bɔbɔ, ɔnyia bɛ nwo nvonleɛ.
19Na akee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛvale ndɛtɛlɛ a bɛbɔle bɛ,
mɔɔ bɛvi ndɛtɛlɛ nu,
na bɛti bɛ kɛ ngɛkɛba la!
20Ɔvi nwonlomɔ kɔdwu aledwolɛ, bɛsɛkye bɛ,
bɛ bo zo minli bɔkɔɔ, awie ɛngakye bɛ.
21Saa bɛ ahonle nyɛma te a, ɛnee bɛwu,
bɛwu mɔɔ nrɛlɛbɛ biala ɛnle nu a.

Title: DWO 5
Content:
1“Ɛkulo a fɛlɛ, saa ɛkɛnyia awie kɛlie wɔ zo a;
anwondelɛma ne mɔ boni yɛɛ ɛfa ɛ nye wɔado ɔ nwo zo a?
2Nɔhalɛ, ɛya ku koasea,
yɛɛ anyebolo ku kɔnwɔne.
3Menwu kɛ koasea ɛzɔ ndinli,
noko arɛlevilɛ nu, membɔle ye awuke ne sasa.
4Ɔ mra nee munzule avinli anwa,
bɛku bɛ wɔ anlenkɛ kpole ne anloa,
bɛnlɛ dievolɛ biala.
5Menli mɔɔ ɛhɔne ku bɛ la di bɛ bɛyɔba ne,
kanza bɛgua mbowule nu bɔbɔ a, bɛbu,
yɛɛ anyeboloma anye bolo bɛ anwonyia.
6Anwubɛnyunlu ɛnvi azɛlɛ nwo,
yɛɛ ngyegyelɛ ɛnfifi ndɛtɛlɛ nu.
7Bɛwo sonla bɛmaa ngyegyelɛ,
ɔle kɛ senle mɔɔ tudu kɔ anwuma la.
8“Saa medame a, anrɛɛ mebadoa Nyamenle abo zo,
na meava me edwɛkɛ meawula ɔ sa nu;
9yemɔ mɔɔ ɔyɛ ninyɛne mgbole, mɔɔ ɛnlɛ nvedenu,
ye nwanwane nyɛleɛ ɛnlɛ ɔ nloa.
10Ɔmaa ezule tɔ azɛlɛ ye azo
na ɔgugua nzule wɔ ɛbɔ ne mɔ azo.
11Ɔmaa bɛlɛvoma zo,
na ɔye nyanelilɛma ɔfi nyane nu.
12Ɔsɛkye agyibatovoma mɛlɛbɛla,
na ɔmaa bɛfua asakpane.
13 Ɔkye nrɛlɛbɛvolɛma wɔ bɛdabɛ bɛ agyibadolɛ nu,
na agyibadolɛma ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔ pɛ sinli ndɛndɛ.
14Awozinli fa bɛ alehyenlɛ nu,
na bɛdi nvuovua ewiazo ketekete kɛ nɔɔzo.
15Ɔdie menli mɔɔ ɛhyia la ɔfi dadeɛ nloa,
na ɔdie bɛ ɔfi mgbolema asa anu.
16Yemɔti ehyianvolɛma lɛ anyelazo,
na menli mɔɔ ɛnli pɛlepɛle la ka bɛ nloa to nu.
17 “Nyilalɛ ɛha sonla ne mɔɔ Nyamenle twi ɔ nyunlu la,
yemɔti mmakpo Nyamenle Bɛdevinli ne ndeanlɛ.
18 Ɔluakɛ ɔbo wɔ a, ɔsia ɔdwu wɔ,
yɛɛ ɔtea wɔ a, ɔfa wɔ ɔbɔ ye ɛbolɛ.
19Ɔbaye wɔ yeavi ngyegyelɛ fane nsia anu,
nsuu ne azo, munzule biala ɛnrɛdo wɔ.
20Wɔ ɛhɔne nu, ɔbaye wɔ yeavi ewule nu;
wɔ konle nu, ɔbaye wɔ yeavi dadeɛ nloa.
21Ɔbaye wɔ yeavi dumanzɛkyelɛ nu,
yɛɛ saa ewule ba a ɛnrɛzulo.
22Ɛbazele ewule nee ɛhɔne,
yɛɛ ɛnrɛzulo aleɛabo nanemgbole biala.
23Ɔluakɛ ɛ nee ɛbɔ nu awolɛ mgbole bali ngitanwo,
na aleɛabo nanemgbole nee wɔ adɛnla anzonudwolɛ nu.
24Ɛbanwu kɛ anzonudwolɛ wɔ wɔ sua nu,
yɛɛ ɛnrɛminli debie biala wɔ wɔ mboane tunli nu.
25Eza ɛbanwu kɛ ɛ bo zo amra bada,
na ɛ kunlu mralɛ anyenle kɛ ɛbɔ nu ndile.
26Ɛbayɛ nwosonwoso kolaa na wɔawu,
kɛmɔ ɛlobɔ dwu na bɛava ma bɛahɔ ma ɛwozolɛ
ɛleka la.
27Nea, yɛvedevede ɛhye anu, na ɔle nɔhalɛ.
Yemɔti Dwobu, tie na die to nu.”

Title: DWO 6
Content:
Dwobu
1Dwobu buale ye kɛ,
2“O, anrɛɛ bɛazuzu me nyane ne,
nee me amaneɛnwunlɛ ne wɔ tone zo!
3Anrɛɛ bɛkɛnwu kɛ ɔyɛ ɛnlomboɛ ɔtɛla ɛnweazo ɛnwea,
ɛhye ati a me mgbolehanlɛ ne ɛyɛ nwanwane a.
4Tumivolɛ Nyamenle ne ɛda mbaka ne ɛwowɔ me,
na ye bɔlɔ ɛwie me wolowolo,
yɛɛ Nyamenle ɛya mgbole ne mɔ ɛra me nwo zo.
5“Asoo asoaso nyia ndile na ɔlɛdi a ɔsu,
anzɛɛ ɛnlankɛ gyi aleɛ nwo a ɔsu?
6Asoo aleɛ tatabɛ, bɛdi a ɔdi?
Asoo kolonvia aleɛ fufule ne yɛ fɛ?
7Me tiakunlu ɛmba zo bɔbɔ;
bɛle aleɛ mɔɔ ka me ya.
8“O, anrɛɛ meanyia mɔɔ mebiza la,
na Nyamenle akponle mɔɔ mekpondɛ la azo!
9Anrɛɛ ɛnee Nyamenle kɛhu me pɛneko,
na ɔkɛpɛ me ngoane zo.
10Anrɛɛ ɛhye bakyekye me rɛle;
na meali fɛlɛko wɔ me nyane nu,
ɔluakɛ metɛtule Nwuanzanwuanza Ko ne anloa.
11Duzu anwosesebɛ a melɛ, mefa mekendɛ a?
Yɛɛ kɛ menwɔwie ye mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ mesi abotane a?
12Ɛnee me anwosesebɛ le kɛ awolɛ ɔ?
Anzɛɛ me nwonane le kɔbele ɔ?
13Nɔhalɛ nu, menlɛ anwosesebɛ biala me nu,
yɛɛ menlɛ ɛleka mɔɔ moalɛ vi bara a.
14“Awie biala mɔɔ ɛnyɛ atiakunlukɛnlɛma la
ɛnzulo Tumivolɛ Nyamenle ne.
15Me mediema ne mɔ le ngunzi;
bɛle kɛ azuboazɛlɛ mɔɔ azule se zo bobobobo,
16na ezukɔtweaba kɔfea nu
yɛ azule ne anye fii, kyengye ye.
17Wuluwulu melɛ nu bɛkolo,
na bɛ bo zo minliminli bɔkɔɔ.
18Adenduvoma di ɛkɛ ne akɔneaba
bɛkɔkpondɛ nzule ne toonwo bɛwu.
19Tima adenduvoma neɛnlea,
Hyiba adenduvoma anye da.
20Bɛ anyelazo bɔ bɛ, ɔboalekɛ ɛnee bɛdie bɛdi;
bɛkɛhɔdwu la, ɛnee nzule ne ɛsesa.
21Zɛhae yɛɛ bɛle bɛmaa me a;
bɛnwu me anwubɛnyunlu la, ɛzulolɛ ɛha bɛ.
22Meha kɛ bɛhyɛ me debie ɔ?
Anzɛɛ bɛva bɛ anwonyia ne bie bɛdua me ti ndoloboa ɔ?
23Meha kɛ bɛlie me bɛvi kpɔvolɛ ne asa anu ɔ?
Anzɛɛ bɛkpɔne me bɛvi nzisima asa anu ɔ?
24“Bɛhilehile me, na menwɔyɛ koonwu;
bɛmaa menwu ɛtane mɔɔ meyɛ la.
25Nɔhalɛ edwɛkɛ nu mia!
Na bɛ ndeanlɛ ye, duzu anwo ndeanlɛ ɔ?
26Ɛnee bɛdwenle kɛ bɛkola bɛtea edwɛkɛ ɔ,
wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ sonla mɔɔ ɛnlɛ anyelazo la
edwɛkɛ ɛhanlɛ le anwoma la?
27Bɛnyia arisa a, bɛkɛgua ɔ ti nzeleba,
na bɛkɛdɔne agɔnwolɛma.
28Na kɛkala, mebodo bɛ, bɛnlea me,
ɔluakɛ menrɛbɔ adalɛ wɔ bɛ nyunlu.
29Mebodo bɛ, bɛgyakyi, bɛmmabua me mgbɔvodɛne;
bɛgyakyi, na medi benle.
30Anzɛɛ meha ɛtane ɔ?
Menze kpalɛ menze ɛtane ɔ?

Title: DWO 7
Content:
1“Sonla ɛbɛlabɔlɛ yɛ se wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo,
sonla mekɛ kɔsɔɔti le kɛ ɛkpanli.
2Ɔle kɛ kanranli mɔɔ kpondɛ alubo nu adɛnla,
ɔle kɛ ɛkpanli mɔɔ anye la ye ahatualɛ zo.
3Zɔhane ala yɛɛ bɛhyehyɛ mekɛ mgbane
nee aledwolɛ anu nyane bɛmaa me a.
4Saa meda a mebiza kɛ,
‘Kenlenzu yɛɛ mebadwazo a?’
Aledwolɛ ne wale,
mekɔsɔ mekɔ, mekɔsɔ meba,
mepe toonwo alehyenlɛ.
5Melɔ azonlɛ, me nwo ɛzi bile,
me nwo nwoma di wulate.
6Me mekɛ se ndɛndɛ
tɛla ɛdanlɛnwovolɛ agbuyiaba,
na ɔba awieleɛ mɔɔ anyelazo ɛnle nu a.
7“Kakye kɛ me ngoane le anwoma;
me nye ɛnrɛnwu debie kpalɛ bieko.
8Ɛnyelɛ mɔɔ nwu me la ɛnrɛnwu me bieko;
mɔɔ bɛ nye dua me ala la, mebado ɛbɛla ne aze.
9Kɛmɔ amungu kpa na ɔpɛ nu ɔse la,
zɔhane ala yɛɛ mɔɔ kɔ Ɛbolɔ la ɛnzia ko a.
10Ɔnzia ɔmba ye awuke nu bieko,
yɛɛ ye awuke nu amra ɛnze ye ko.
11Yemɔti menrɛmua me nloa;
mebaha mɔɔ wɔ me kunlu la;
mebaha mɔɔ wɔ me ahonle nu la.
12“Mele nyevile, anzɛɛ nyevizonle,
mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛmaa me sinzavolɛ a?
13Saa meka kɛ, ‘Me ɛkpa bakyekye me rɛle,
me ebia mɔɔ meda nu la bamaa me anwofofolɛ aha aze’ a,
14ɛnee bɛfa ɛlalɛ bɛnwunlonwunla me,
na bɛfa ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ bɛka me ɛzulolɛ.
15Yemɔti menwɔhulo kɛ bɛkɛmia me kɔmenzia bɛkɛhu me
tɛla kɛ ɔkɛha me mbowule.
16Mekpo me ngoane; menrɛhakyi bolɛ.
Bɛgyakyi me, ɔluakɛ kɛkala, me ngoane ɛnle ɛhwee.
17 “Na Nyamenle, sonla le duzu, mɔɔ ɔhyia wɔ zɛhae a,
mɔɔ ɛ nye wɔ ɔ nwo zɛhae a?
18Mɔɔ nwolomɔ biala ɛkpɔla ye,
na mekɛ biala ɛsɔ ye ɛnea ɛ?
19Kenlenzu yɛɛ ɛkɛye ɛ nye me nwo,
anzɛɛ ɛkɛgyakyi me ɛkɛmaa menwɔme nyɛlɛ a?
20Saa meyɛ ɛtane a, ɛnee duzu a meyɛ wɔ a,
wɔmɔ menli sinzavo?
Duzu ati a ɛ nye gyi me nyunlu zɛhae a?
Duzu ati a meyɛ adesoa memaa wɔ a?
21Duzu ati a ɛnrɛva me mɛladonlɛ ɛnrɛhyɛ me,
na ɛnrɛva me amumuyɛ ɛnrɛhyɛ me ɛ?
Ɔluakɛ mebala azɛlɛ ye abo;
ɛbakpondɛ me, na ɛnrɛnwu me.”

Title: DWO 8
Content:
Beledade
1Na Beledade hanle kɛ,
2“Na kenlenzu a ɛkɛwie tendɛ a?
Ɛ nloa edwɛkɛ le kɛ anwoma kpole bie la.
3Ɛnea a ɛnee Nyamenle kyi nɔhalɛ,
anzɛɛ Tumivolɛ ne kyi pɛlepɛlelilɛ ɔ?
4Saa ɛ mra ɛyɛ ɛtane ɛtia ye a,
yeye bɛ yemaa bɛdabɛ bɛ ɛtane.
5Saa ɛkɛkpondɛ Nyamenle abo zo,
na ɛkɛbodo ɛkɛzɛlɛ Tumivolɛ ne,
6saa ɛmaa ɛ nwo te na ɛbɔ ɛbɛla mɔɔ tenrɛ,
nɔhalɛ, ɔbaheha ɔ nwo na yeakyekye wɔ awuke ne bieko,
7amaa saa mɔlebɛbo ne ɛle ekyi a,
wɔ awieleɛ nu wɔayɛ sonlakpole.
8“Mesɛlɛ wɔ, biza mɔɔ ɛze ɛhɔ la,
na dwenle mɔɔ ɛ ze mɔ ɛnwu ye la anwo.
9Ɔluakɛ anoma ala a bɛwo yɛ a, yɛnze ɛhwee,
yɛ mekɛ wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo le kɛ ɛlawolɛ.
10Bɛbahilehile wɔ,
na bɛaha mɔɔ bɛnwunle ye la bɛahile wɔ.
11Asoo ndɔ fifi ɛleka mɔɔ azia ɛnle la,
anzɛɛ ɔnyi ɔtɛlɛdɛlɛ wɔ ɛleka mɔɔ nzule ɛnle la?
12Mɔɔ bɛkɛgyinla dedɛkɛɛ na bɛtɛpepɛle bɛ la,
bɛkyengye bɛwu kolaa na baka biala awu.
13Kɛ menli mɔɔ arɛle fi Nyamenle la
ndenle nu de la ɛne;
sonla mɔɔ ɛnze Nyamenle la anyelazo bawie.
14Ye adwenle ɛnzi pi,
yɛɛ ye diedi le kɛ kɛdɛba ndenda.
15Ɔtudu ɔkisia ye sua, noko sua ne golo;
ɔsɔ nuhua, noko sua ne ɛngyinla.
16“Sɛnzɛne ne ɛtɛtudule a ɔnyi ɔtoto ɔ sa,
na ɔtende ɔgua ye tola ne bane ne mɔ azo.
17Ye ndinli beba awolɛ edukue ne,
na ɔgyinla awolɛ ne mɔ avinli.
18Saa bɛtu ye bɛfi ɔ bo zo ne a,
ɔkpo ye na ɔka kɛ, ‘Metɛnwunle wɔ ɛlɛ!’
19Ɛhɛe, kɛ ye fɛlɛkolilɛ adenle ne de la ɛne;
bie mɔ noko fifi ɔ bo zo ne.
20“Noko, Nyamenle ɛnrɛkpo mɔɔ ɛnze nwolɛ bie la,
yɛɛ ɔnrɛzɔ ɛtanevolɛma asa.
21Ɔbamaa ɛ nloa anwo ayɛ ɛzelekɛ ɛzelekɛ,
na wɔava fɛlɛkolilɛ wɔadeɛdea nu.
22Menli mɔɔ kpɔ wɔ la baheda anyiemgba ɛdanlɛ,
na amumuyɛma awuke ne mɔ abɔ tɔɔ.”

Title: DWO 9
Content:
Dwobu
1Na Dwobu buale ye kɛ,
2 “Nɔhalɛ, meze kɛ ɔle zɔ.
Noko nwane a di benle wɔ Nyamenle anyunlu a?
3Saa awie se kɛ ɔ nee ye yeye ɛnloanlɛ a,
ɔnrɛhola ye kpuyia apenle ko anu ko bɔbɔ anloa ye.
4Ɔle nrɛlɛbɛvolɛ, yɛɛ ye anwosesebɛ le bedevinli;
nwane a nee ye ɛdwudwu na yenyia gyinlagyakɛ a?
5Saa ɔfa ɛya a ɔdwulu awoka,
na ɔtudu bɛ mɔɔ ɔngakye awie a.
6Ɔkpusu azɛlɛ ɔtudu ye ɔ bo zo ne,
na ɔmaa ye mpila ne mɔ kpusu.
7Ɔsisi sɛnzɛne ne anwo zo, ɔmmaa ɔndudu,
na ɔkeda nwɔlɔra nyunlu.
8Ɔdaye ɔ ngome a ɔbɔle anwomanyunlu tɛtɛlɛ ye,
na ɔtietiale nyevile azɛlɛkye zo a.
9 Ɔbɔle nwɔlɔra Ɛrelera nee ɔ mra nee Apeansa,
Nwɔlɔra Nsuu nee nyiakɛ nwɔlɔra.
10Ɔyɛ ninyɛne mgbole mɔɔ bo sonla ndelebɛbo zo,
ɔyɛ nwanwane ninyɛne mɔɔ ɛnlɛ ɔ nloa a.
11“Nea, ɔse me nwo ɛkɛ, noko mennwu ye;
ɔlɛkɔ bɔbɔ a mennwu ɔ nwo.
12Saa Nyamenle ɛlɛfa debie a, nwane a kɛhola ye aze si a?
Nwane a kɛhola kɛbiza ye kɛ, ‘Duzu a ɛlɛyɛ la?’
13Nyamenle ɛnrɛhwe ye ɛyavalɛ ne ɛnrɛzia;
Releehabe boavolɛma bɔ bɛ ti aze ɔ nyunlu.
14Ɛnee kɛ menzi membua ye ɛ,
duzu edwɛkɛkpɔkɛ a meka a?
15Menli fɔlɛ, noko menrɛhola ye bua;
ɔwɔ kɛ mesɛlɛ me ndɛnebuavolɛ ne anwunvɔnezelɛ.
16Saa menvɛlɛle ye yɛɛ ɔliele me zo a,
anrɛɛ menrɛlie menrɛli kɛ yedie me ne.
17Ɔluakɛ ɔfa ahumu ɔbɛlɛ me aze,
na mgbane ne ala ɔmaa me nwo nganlɛ yɛ dɔɔnwo.
18Ɔmmaa menlie me ɛnwomenle,
na ɔmaa ɛbɛlabɔlɛ yɛ ɛnwonle.
19Saa ɔba anwosesebɛ ɛzulɛ a, ɔle bedevinli;
saa ɔba pɛlepɛlelilɛ a, nwane a kɛhola ye a?
20Menze nwolɛ bie, medi nɔhalɛ,
noko me nloa bua me ewule fɔlɛ;
menli fɔlɛ, noko yehile kɛ menle kpalɛ.
21Menli fɔlɛ; membu me nwo;
me kunlu bɔbɔ a anrɛɛ mewu.
22Ɔ muala wie ko; yemɔti mese,
ɔsɛkye kpalɛma, ɔsɛkye amumuyɛma.
23Saa esiane fa arɛlevilɛ nu ewule ba a,
ɔsi anzenwolɛbiema anwubɛnyunlu amgbu.
24Bɛva azɛlɛ ye bɛwula amumuyɛma asa anu;
ɔkedɛheda ndɛnebuavolɛma anyunlu,
na saa tɛ ye a, ɛnee nwane ɔ?
25“Me mekɛ se waa tɛla sonla mɔɔ ɛlɛnriandi la;
ɔse ɔkɔ, ɔnnwu kpalɛ biala.
26Ɔpɛ nu ɔkɔ kɛ ndɔ mɔɔ la azule nye,
ɔto kɛ kɔleɛ ɛlɛto ahye nane.
27Saa meka kɛ, ‘Memaa me rɛle avi me nyane,
meagyakyi me nyunlu alɔbɔlɛ ɛyɛlɛ,
meamaa me nye alie’ a,
28me nyanenwunlɛ ne ka me ɛzulolɛ,
ɔluakɛ meze kɛ ɛbabua me fɔlɛ.
29Bɛbabua me ewulefɔlɛ,
duzu ati a ɔwɔ kɛ mefonla me nwo a?
30Saa mefa saminla mebia,
na mefa anatele meyɛ me sa anwo a,
31ɛbavuandi me wɔado ewula nu,
na medame me nwo ndanlɛ bɔbɔ bahyi me.
32Ɔluakɛ ɔnle sonla kɛ medame la na meabua ye,
na yɛ mu nwiɔ yɛaye ndɛne.
33Kpɔdavolɛ biala ɛngyi yɛ avinli,
mɔɔ kɛkpɔda yɛ mu nwiɔ a.
34Bɛmaa ɔva me nwo empele ne ɔhɔ,
na ɔmmafa ɔ nwo ɛzulolɛ ne ɔnwunlonwunla me.
35Amaa meanzulo ye na meandendɛ,
ɔluakɛ menle kɛ mɔɔ bɛmɛ bɛdwenle kɛ mele la.

Title: DWO 10
Content:
1“Me kunlu a anrɛɛ mewu;
akee mebaha me nyane kɔsɔɔti;
mebaha me ahonle nu nyane muala.
2Mebaze Nyamenle kɛ, mmabua me ewule fɔlɛ,
maa menwu deɛ mɔɔ yemɔti ɛ nee me ɛlɛsi la.
3Anzɛɛ ɛ kunlu dwo kɛ ɛkɛsisi me,
kɛ ɛkɛkpo ɛ sa anloa gyima,
na ɛ nye kɛlie amumuyɛma ɛbɛla nwo ɔ?
4Asoo ɛ nye le kɛ sonla ɛdeɛ ne,
na ɛnea debie kɛ sonla la?
5Asoo wɔ mekɛ le kɛ sonla ɛdeɛ ne la?
Anzɛɛ wɔ ɛvolɛ dodo le kɛ dasanli ɛdeɛ,
6mɔɔ ɛneɛnlea me nu wɔanwu me munzule mɔɔ mebɔ,
na wɔaza me ɛtane ne mɔ wɔagua zo a?
7Ɛze kɛ menli fɔlɛ,
yɛɛ awie biala ɛngola ɛnlie me ɛnvi ɛ sa nu.
8“Ɛdawɔ a ɛbɔle me ɛzieziele me a,
yɛɛ kɛkala wɔpɛ ɛ nwo kɛ ɛsɛkye me a.
9Kakye kɛ ɛvale ndɛtɛlɛ a ɛbɔle me a;
na eza ɛmaa meazia meahɔ ndɛtɛlɛ nu bieko ɔ?
10Na wɔanwola me kɛ meleke,
wɔambɔ me kunguma kɛ kyiisi ɔ?
11Ɛvale mbowule nee ndinli ɛbɔle me,
na ɛvale nwonane nee nwoma ɛhedale zo.
12Wɔmaa me ngoane nee ɛhulolɛ kpundii,
yɛɛ wɔli me sunsum ne adane.
13Noko wɔva ɛhye mɔ kɔsɔɔti wɔzie wɔ ahonle nu;
meze kɛ ɛhye a le wɔ kpɔkɛ mɔɔ ɛgyi zo a.
14Saa meyɛ ɛtane a, ɛnee wɔva wɔzie,
ɛnva me nvonleɛ ɛngyɛ me.
15Saa meyɛ amumuyɛ a, munzule doa me!
Saa medi pɛlepɛle a, mengola me ti zo ma,
ɔluakɛ menea amaneɛ mɔɔ melɛnwu ye la a,
ɛnee nyiane ɛkpɔlɔ me betaa.
16Saa memaa me nwo zo a, ɛfoa me kɛ awenade,
na ɛyɛ nwanwane ninyɛne ɛtia me.
17Dahuu ɛlɛ alasevolɛ ka tia me,
me nwo ɛya mɔɔ wɔ ɛ kunlu la dahuu yɛ kpole,
yɛɛ dahuu ɛfa ɛlɔnema fofolɛ ɛba me nwo zo.
18“Duzu ati a ɛmanle bɛwole me a?
Me kunlu a anrɛɛ menwule kolaa na ɛnyelɛ anwu me.
19Anrɛɛ mevi ɔmɔ akunlu ala la
bɛ nee me hɔle aziezo.
20Me mekɛ mɔɔ ɛha la le ezinraa.
Bɛgyakyi me, amaa me rɛle akyekye ekyii.
21Ɔnrɛhyɛ biala na meahɔ ɛleka mɔɔ
bɛkɔ a bɛnzia la,
maanle anu kisii, anu awozinli kabii ne,
22maanle anu kisii,
anu begyebegye ne,
mɔɔ ye wienyi le kɛ awozinli.”

Title: DWO 11
Content:
Zofaa
1Zofaa hanle kɛ,
2“Yemɔti ɔnle kɛ awie bua edwɛkɛ bebelebe ye anwo,
anzɛɛ ɛdendɛlɛ dɔɔnwo dɔɔnwo bua sonla benle ɔ?
3Ɛ nloa beɛbeɛ, awie mmaka bie ɔ,
yɛɛ wɔ amgbuzilɛ ne, ɛngulo kɛ bɛtwi ɛ nyunlu ɔ?
4Ɛse wɔ ngehanleɛ ne le fɔɔnwo,
yɛɛ ɛ nwo te wɔ Nyamenle anyunlu.
5Anrɛɛ Nyamenle adendɛ,
na yeabuke ɔ nloa wɔ ɛ nwo,
6anrɛɛ ɔkɛze wɔ kɛ nrɛlɛbɛ ndenle zonle;
ninyɛne dɔɔnwo wɔ ɛkɛ mɔɔ dasanli ɛnde bɛ bo a.
Nwu ye kɛ Nyamenle ɛndua wɔ kakɛ, kɛmɔ ɛfɛta la.
7“Ɛkɛhola ɛkɛnwu Nyamenle abo ɔ?
Ɛkɛhola ɛkɛnwu Tumivolɛ ne awieleɛ ɔ?
8Ye tumi ne kpole wɔ anwuma tɛla anwomanyunlu,
duzu a ɛkɛhola ɛkɛyɛ a?
Yɛɛ ɔle kuloonwu ɔtɛla Ɛbolɔ kuma,
na wɔmɔ, ɛkɛhola ɛkɛnwu ye ɔ?
9Ɔwale ɔtɛla azɛlɛ ye,
yɛɛ ɔtɛlɛ ɔtɛla nyevile.
10Saa ɔba, ɔse kɛ ɔgua menli efiade,
ɔ nee bɛ kɔ ndɛnebualɛ ɛleka a,
nwane a kɛhola ɔ nwo zo sisi a?
11Ɔluakɛ ɔze kpamgbanvolɛma ne mɔ;
saa ɔnwu ɛtane a, ɔnrɛdwenle nwo ɔ?
12Saa bɛwo asoaso kokonyinli sonla a,
ahɔnwɔne bɔbɔ bade ɔ bo.
13“Saa ɛfa wɔ ahonle ɛmaa Nyamenle a,
ɛbamaa ɛ sa zo wɔamaa ye.
14Saa ɛle ɛtanevolɛ a, gyakyi ɛtaneyɛlɛ,
mmadie amumuyɛ azie wɔ wɔ awuke nu.
15Ɛhye bamaa wɔamaa ɛ ti zo, ɛnrɛze nyiane;
bɛbabɔ ɛ nwo bane na ɛnrɛzulo.
