10Wɔ nyɛmoa nyianle ɛleka nuhua dɛnlanle;
wɔ kpalɛ ti, O Nyamenle,
ɛmanle ɛhyianvolɛma nyianle bɛ kyɛfoa.
11Awulae dendɛle tumi nu;
na menli mɔɔ vale edwɛkɛ ne hɔle la zonle.
12Bɛse, “Ɛlɔnema nee bɛ arelemgbunli ne mɔ ɛlɛnriandi,
bɛlɛnriandi!”
Mraalɛ bɔbɔ mɔɔ wɔ sua nu mɔɔ nee mboane a de la
13kyɛ konle nu afedeɛ ne fa:
abubule ndɛbalɛ mɔɔ bɛholo dwɛtɛ fufule bɛgua nwo,
yɛɛ bɛ ndɛkɛ mɔɔ bɛholo ezukoa nvutuke tagyee bɛgua nwo.
14Tumivolɛ ne bɔle arelemgbunli ne mɔ asande la,
ezukɔtweaba dɔle Zalemɔn Boka.
15O boka kpole, Beehyan boka;
O boka mɔɔ ati zonle, Beehyan Boka!
16O boka ati dɔɔnwo, duzu ati a ɛ nye ɛbolo
boka ne mɔɔ Nyamenle kulo kɛ ɔtɛnla zo la ɛ?
Ɛhɛe, ɛkɛ ne a Ɛdɛnkɛma badɛnla dahuu a.
17Ɔvale konle ehwili dɔɔnwo, apenle bulu mɔnwo,
apenle apenle kɛyɛ nyɛ,
Awulae vi Saenae rale ɛleka nwuanzanwuanza ne.
18 Ɛvole boka tendenle ne,
ɛzanle menli mɔɔ ɛhyele bɛ la nyɛma zo ɛlile ɛ nzi.
ɛliele ahyɛlɛ ninyɛne ɛvile menli ɛkɛ,
atuadelɛma bɔbɔ hyɛle wɔ bie,
amaa Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle ne adɛnla ɛkɛ ne.
19Ayɛlɛyelɛ ɛha Awulae,
mɔɔ soa yɛ adesoa ne mɔ dahuu la;
Nyamenle le yɛ ngoanelielɛ.
20Yɛ Nyamenle ne le ngoanelielɛ Nyamenle;
na yɛ Awulae Nyamenle ne ati,
yɛɛ yɛkola yɛnriandi ewule a.
21Nyamenle bagelegele ye kpɔvolɛma ati,
bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdua fɔlɛlilɛ ndenle nu la.
22Awulae se,
“Me nee bɛ vi Beehyan bazia ara,
me nee bɛ vi nyevile kunlu lɔ bazia ara,
23amaa bɛatietia mogya nu,
na bɛ ahwea ne mɔ noko anyia bɛ afoa nu ɛdeɛ
avi kpɔvolɛma ɛkɛ.”
24O Nyamenle, awie biala ɛnwu
wɔ konimlilɛ ɛlɔnwɔnedolɛ ne;
me Nyamenle, me Belemgbunli ne ɛlɔnwɔne ne
mɔɔ ɔdole ɔhɔle ye ɛleka nwuanzanwuanza ne la.
25Edwɛndolɛma ne lumua, agolehanlɛma ne li bɛ nzi;
mbɛlɛra mɔɔ wozo akɛya la li avinli.
26Bɛto edwɛne kɛ,
“Bɛye Nyamenle ayɛlɛ wɔ ye menli ɛwolaa ne ayia ne anu,
bɛyeyɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, O bɛmɛ Yizilayɛma abo zo amra!”
27Bɛngyaman, bɛ nuhua kakula ne a lumua a,
Dwuda arelemgbunli nee bɛ ɛlɔne,
Zɛbulɛn arelemgbunli, Nafetalae arelemgbunli doa zolɛ.
28O Nyamenle, kile wɔ tumi ne;
O Nyamenle mɔɔ wɔho wɔmaa yɛ,
kile wɔ anwosesebɛ ne.
29Wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne mɔɔ wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm la ati,
arelemgbunli soa ahyɛlɛ ninyɛne bɛlɛ wɔ.
30Tea nanemgbole ne mɔ mɔɔ vea ndɔ ne mɔ abo,
menli ne mɔɔ ɛyɛ bɛ nwo nlankɛ nyinli nee nlankɛ mralɛ la.
Tietia menli mɔɔ anye bolo adwulelielɛ la anwo zo;
bɔ menli mɔɔ anye die konle nwo la asande.
31Maa bɛva kɔbele bɛvi Yigyibiti bɛrɛla;
maa Sudanema ɛyɛ ndɛ ɛmaa bɛ sa zo ɛmaa Nyamenle.
32Azɛlɛ ye azo arelemgbunli maanle,
bɛdo edwɛne bɛmaa Nyamenle;
bɛdo ayɛlɛyelɛ edwɛne bɛmaa Awulae,
33bɛdo edwɛne bɛmaa mɔɔ dua anwomanyunlu la,
tete anwomanyunlu;
bɛdie, ɔlɛtendɛ, ɔ ne kpole ne dielie.
34Bɛbɔ Nyamenle kpoleyɛlɛ ne nolo,
ye belemgbunlililɛ ne keda Yizilayɛma anwo zo,
ye tumi ne wɔ anwomanyunlu.
35O Nyamenle, ɛvi wɔ ɛleka nwuanzanwuanza ne ɛfinde a
ɛ nwo yɛ ɛzulolɛ;
Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne, yemɔ yɛɛ ɔfa tumi
nee anwosesebɛ ɔmaa ye menli a.
Bɛye Nyamenle ayɛlɛ.

Title: EDW 69
Content:
Moalɛ nwo ɛzunlɛ
1O Nyamenle, die me!
ɔluakɛ azule ɛyi ɛva me.
2Memi moto kpole nu;
mennyia debie menzɔ nu.
Mehɔ azukunlu kpalɛ,
yɛɛ azuyilɛ ne se me nwo zo.
3Mevɛlɛ dedee me ɛnwomenle ɛwie;
me kɔmenzia ɛyɛ resee.
Mehendɛ me Nyamenle ne toonwo,
akee me nye ɛha adenle zo.
4 Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkpɔ me mgbane gyɛne la
zonle tɛla me ti enrinli;
menli mɔɔ kpondɛ ahu me la anwo yɛ se,
yɛɛ adalɛ ala a bɛbɔ ye me nwo a.
Debie mɔɔ meanwua la, ɔwɔ kɛ metua ɔ?
5O Nyamenle, ɛdawɔ ɛze koasea mɔɔ meyɛ la,
ɛtane biala mɔɔ meyɛ la la ɛ nyunlu.
6Mmamaa ɔdua me nwo zo bɛdabɛ mɔɔ
bɛ anyelazo wɔ wɔ nu la anyunlu gua aze,
O Tumivolɛ Awulae Nyamenle;
mmamaa ɔdua me nwo zo bɛdabɛ mɔɔ
bɛkpondɛ ɛ bo zo la anyunlu gua aze,
O Yizilayɛ Nyamenle.
7Ɔluakɛ wɔmɔ ɛ ti yɛɛ bɛbɔ me aholoba,
na nyiane ɛkpɔlɔ me betaa a.
8Meyɛ ɛyɛvolɛ wɔ me mediema avinli,
ɔmɔ akunlu mralɛ bɔbɔ ɛnze me.
9 Ɔluakɛ wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anwo ɛhulolɛ
sɔ kɛ senle wɔ me nu,
yɛɛ aholoba mɔɔ bɛbɔ wɔ la
amuala gua me nwo zo.
10Mɔɔ menzunle mengyele ɛhɔne la,
menli bɔle me nwolɛ aholoba.
11Menvale ɛrele mengedale la,
menyɛle ɛfenle memanle bɛ.
12Me nwo edwɛkɛ ala yɛɛ bɛgua a bɛka a,
yɛɛ nzabovoma fa me to edwɛne.
13Na mame, O Ɛdɛnkɛma, me nzɛlɛlɛ la ɛ nyunlu.
O Nyamenle, wɔ mekɛ kpalɛ ne dwu a,
dua wɔ ɛhulolɛ kpundii kpole ne azo bua me.
14Fa wɔ nɔhalɛ moalɛ ne die me,
mmamaa memi mekɔ moto ne abo;
die me fi me kpɔvolɛma asa anu,
nee azule buma ne anu.
15Mmamaa azuyilɛ ne fa me,
anzɛɛ menoma buma ne abo,
anzɛɛ ewule kuma keda me nwo zo.
16O Ɛdɛnkɛma, wɔ ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne di munli na bua me,
wɔ anwunvɔnezelɛ bebelebe ne ati, kakyi ɛ nye nea me.
17Mmaye ɛ nye wɔ wɔ sonvolɛ anwo zo;
ɔluakɛ melɛnwu amaneɛ na ka ɛ nwo bua me.
18Twe bikye me, kpɔne me;
maa menyia me ti wɔ kpɔvolɛma asa anu.
19Ɛdawɔ ɛze aholoba mɔɔ bɛbɔ me la,
ɛze me nyiane nee me anyiemgba;
ɛze me kpɔvolɛma amuala.
20Aholoba ne akee ɛbo me nwo zo,
akee meyɛ ɛhwee a ɔnyɛ boɛ.
Memkpondɛle anwunvɔnezelɛ, na meannyia bie;
memkpondɛle arɛlekyekyelɛ, na meannyia bie.
21 Ɛhɔne ku me la, bɛmanle me pɔyezen,
nzuhɔne ku me la, bɛmanle me nzanvinli.
22 Maa bɛ ɛkponledolɛ ɛhakyi ɛhane;
na bɛ ɛvoyialilɛ ɛyɛ ɛhane.
23Maa bɛ nye ɛzi mɔɔ bɛnnwu debie a;
na bɛ gyakɛ ɛbili dahuu kɛ atɛ.
24Wola wɔ ɛya ne gua bɛ nwo zo,
na maa wɔ ɛya ne ɛzɔ ɛyela bɛ.
25 Maa bɛ azokoɛleɛ ɛdɔ mgbane,
mmamaa awie tɛnla bɛ ndanlɛ azua ne mɔ anu.
26Ɔluakɛ bɛyɛ mɔɔ wɔdea ye la kpɔdekpɔde,
na bɛkondɔ mɔɔ wɔboda ye la nganlɛ.
27Tea bɛ molozo molozo,
mmamaa bɛfa bɛ nwo dwɔɔ.
28 Ye bɛ aluma fi teasema buluku ne anu;
mmakɛlɛ bɛ aluma ɛboka tenlenema anwo.
29Melɛnwu amaneɛ, mete nyane;
O Nyamenle, maa me zo na die me.
30Mebado edwɛne meaye Nyamenle ayɛlɛ;
mebava moyɛlɛ meabɔ ye kpoleyɛlɛ ne nolo.
31Ɛhye bazɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anye adɛla ɛnlankɛ,
anzɛɛ ɛnlankɛ nyinli mɔɔ ɛwie nyi la.
32Maa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛsisi bɛ la ɛnwu ɛhye na bɛ nye ɛlie,
bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkpondɛ Nyamenle la, bɛzi bɛ ahonle.
33Ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma te bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛhyia la ane,
yɛɛ ɔmkpo ye ɛdeɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ wɔ ngyelelɛ nu la.
34Anwuma nee aze ɛye Nyamenle ayɛlɛ,
nyevile nee mɔɔ wɔ nu la amuala ɛye ye ayɛlɛ.
35Ɔluakɛ Nyamenle balie Zayɔn,
na yeakyekye Dwuda azua ne mɔ fofolɛ;
ye sonvolɛma badɛnla ɛkɛ na bɛava azɛlɛ ne;
36bɛ bo zo amra bava ayɛ bɛ agyadeɛ,
na bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkulo ye duma ne la badɛnla ɛkɛ.

Title: EDW 70
Content:
Moalɛ nwo nzɛlɛlɛ
(Edw 40.13-17)
1O Nyamenle, mesɛlɛ wɔ, die me!
O Ɛdɛnkɛma, ka ɛ nwo baboa me!
2Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkpondɛ me bɛahu me la,
maa bɛbɔ anyiemgba na bɛ adwenle ɛha ɛbɔ nu!
Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkulo kɛ medi nyane la,
maa bɛzia bɛ nzi na bɛ nyunlu ɛzi bile!
3Maa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛgolo me nwo kɛ, “Ɛhɛe! Ɛhɛe.” la,
anyunlu ɛgua aze na bɛ rɛle ɛbɔ.
4Maa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkpondɛ ɛ bo zo la,
anye ɛlie na wɔmɔ ti bɛli fɛlɛko.
Maa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkulo wɔ ngoanelielɛ ne la
dahuu ɛha kɛ, “Nyamenle le bedevinli!”
5Na mame, mele ehyianli, menlɛ bie;
O Nyamenle, ka ɛ nwo bɛla!
Ɛle me boavolɛ nee me dievolɛ;
O Ɛdɛnkɛma, mmakyɛ!

Title: EDW 71
Content:
Akpanyima nzɛlɛlɛ
1O Ɛdɛnkɛma, ɛ kunlu yɛɛ menriandi mefea a;
mmamaa me nyunlu gua aze ɛlɛ!
2Dua wɔ tenleneyɛlɛ ne azo boa me na die me;
yɛ ɛnzonlɛ tie me, na die me!
3Yɛ me ɛvealeka bodane,
me aranemgbole ɛsesebɛ, na die me.
Ɔluakɛ ɛle me bodane nee me aranemgbole.
4O me Nyamenle, die me fi amumuyɛma asa anu,
yɛɛ sonla atisesebɛ nee mɔɔ ɛnli pɛlepɛle la asa anu.
5Ɔluakɛ O Awulae, ɛle me anyelazo,
O Ɛdɛnkɛma, me mgbavolɛ nu
yɛɛ menvale me rɛle menwulale wɔ nu a.
6Ɔvi me awolɛ nu yɛɛ mengisale wɔ a,
wɔmɔ yɛɛ ɛyele me ɛvile ɔmɔ akunlu a.
Mebaye wɔ ayɛlɛ dahuu.
7Meyɛ ndonwo memaa dɔɔnwo,
noko wɔmɔ yɛɛ ɛle me ɛvealeka ɛsesebɛ a.
8Meye wɔ ayɛlɛ mekɛ biala,
na mebɔ wɔ anyunlunyia ne nolo alehyenlɛ biala.
9Mmakpo me wɔ me mrelera nu;
saa me anwosesebɛ wie a, mmakpo me.
10Ɔluakɛ me kpɔvolɛma keha me nwo edwɛkɛ,
bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkpondɛ me bɛahu me la yia bɔ adwenle,
11na bɛka kɛ, “Nyamenle ɛkpo ye;
bɛvoa ye bɛhye ye,
ɔluakɛ awie ɛnle ɛkɛ mɔɔ die ye a.”
12O Nyamenle, mmafi me nwo ɛkɔ moa;
O me Nyamenle, ka ɛ nwo balie me!
13Maa menli mɔɔ keha me nwo edwɛkɛ ɛtane ɛtane la
anyunlu ɛgua aze na bɛhu bɛ;
maa nyiane nee anyiemgba ɛbia menli mɔɔ
kpondɛ kɛ bɛkile me nyane la.
14Na mame, me anyelazo wɔ wɔ nu dahuu,
yɛɛ mebaye wɔ ayɛlɛ kpole kpalɛ dahuu.
15Mebabɔ wɔ tenleneyɛlɛ,
nee wɔ ngoanelielɛ ne nolo alehyenlɛ biala,
ɔluakɛ bɛ somaa bo me ndelebɛbo zo.
16Mebalua Awulae Nyamenle ne nyɛleɛ mgbole zo meara;
mebaye wɔ tenleneyɛlɛ ne,
wɔ tenleneyɛlɛ ne ala ayɛlɛ.
17O Nyamenle, ɔvi me mgbavolɛ nu yɛɛ ɛvale me ɛhilehilelɛ a,
yɛɛ metɛbɔ wɔ nwanwane nyɛleɛ ne mɔ nolo.
18Yemɔti saa menyi, na me ti zo ɛyɛ nwohyee a,
O Nyamenle, mmakpo me,
kɔkpula kɛ menwɔbɔ wɔ tumi kpole ne nolo
menwɔmaa awolɛndoazo mɔɔ bara la kɛde bie.
19O Nyamenle, wɔ tumi nee wɔ kpalɛyɛlɛ dwu anwuma lɔ.
Wɔyɛ ninyɛne mgbole,
O Nyamenle, nwane a le kɛ ɛdawɔ a?
20Ɛdawɔ mɔɔ wɔmaa menwu amaneɛ mgbole ɛhye mɔ la,
ɛbakpogya me zo bieko wɔavi ɛbɛla kuma nu,
saa mewɔ azɛlɛ kuma bo bɔbɔ a,
ɛbaye me wɔavinde bieko.
21Ɛbamaa meanyia me nyunlu molozo,
na wɔakyekye me rɛle bieko.
22Medame noko mebava getaa kpole meaye wɔ ayɛlɛ,
O me Nyamenle, wɔ wɔ nɔhalɛlilɛ ne ati.
Mebava getaa ekyi meado edwɛne meaye wɔ ayɛlɛ,
O Yizilayɛ Nwuanzanwuanza Ko ne.
23Mebadea nu anyelielɛ nu,
mekɛ mɔɔ menwɔha kɛ meye wɔ ayɛlɛ la;
me ɛkɛla mɔɔ ɔdaye noko wɔlie ye la baye wɔ ayɛlɛ.
24Mebaha wɔ tenlene moalɛ ne anwo edwɛkɛ dahuu,
ɔluakɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkpondɛ me bɛahu me la
anyunlu ɛgua aze, bɛbɔ anyiemgba.

Title: EDW 72
Content:
Belemgbunli ati nzɛlɛlɛ (Sɔlɔmɔn edwɛne)
1O Nyamenle, kilehile belemgbunli ne wɔ pɛlepɛlelilɛ ne,
na kilehile ɔ ra nrenya ne wɔ tenleneyɛlɛ ne.
2Maa ɔva tenleneyɛlɛ ɔbua ye menli ne ndɛne,
na ɔva pɛlepɛle ɔbua ehyianvolɛma ndɛne.
3Maa menli mɔɔ wɔ azɛlɛ ne azo la ɛkpazi,
na awoka ne mɔ azo ɛhye aleɛ ɛmaa menli ne,
na tenleneyɛlɛ ɛyi maanle ne tɛkɛɛ.
4Maa belemgbunli ne ɛlie ehyianvolɛma ati,
ɔye mɔɔ ɛnlɛ bie la ɔvi ɛhyianlɛ nu,
na ɔbubu mɔɔ di nzisi la dwɔkɔdwɔkɔ.
5Maa wɔ menli ne ɛzonle wɔ alehyenlɛ nee aledwolɛ
ɔhɔdwu awolɛndoazo kɔsɔɔti anu.
6Maa belemgbunli ɛyɛ kɛ ezule mɔɔ tɔ doɔloa ndile,
ɔyɛ kɛ nyenyensuo, ɔzia azɛlɛ ye.
7Maa tenleneyɛlɛ ɛdende ye mekɛ zo,
na anzonudwolɛ ɛrɛla dahuu mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ.
8 Maa ye belemgbunlililɛ ɛdwu ɛnwea ɛnwea,
ɔvi Azule Yufileti ne anloa ɔhɔdwu azɛlɛ ye awieleɛ.
9Maa ɛsɛlɛ zo amra ɛbu ndwɛlɛ wɔ ɔ nyunlu,
na ye kpɔvolɛma ɛli anwea.
10Maa Sepeen nee bɔra ne mɔ arelemgbunli
ɛdua adwule ɛmaa ye,
na Areleebea nee Yiteɔpea arelemgbunli ɛhyɛ ye ninyɛne.
11Maa arelemgbunli kɔsɔɔti ɛdu ɛgua ɔ nyunlu,
na maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti ɛzonle ye.
12Ɔluakɛ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ bie la fɛlɛ a ɔdie ye zo,
ɔdie ehyianli nee mɔɔ ɛnlɛ boavolɛ la zo.
13Ɔnwu mɔɔ ɛnlɛ anwosesebɛ nee mɔɔ ɛnlɛ bie la anwunvɔne,
na ɔdie mɔɔ ɛnlɛ bie la ngoane.
14Ɔdie bɛ ɔfi nzisi nee konle nu;
bɛ mogya sonle bolɛ wɔ ɔ nye zo.
15Belemgbunli ɛnyi ɛhyɛ!
Maa bɛva Areleebea ezukoa nvutuke bɛrɛlɛ ye.
Maa bɛyɛ nzɛlɛlɛ bɛmaa belemgbunli ne,
na bɛzɛlɛ nyilalɛ bɛmaa ye dahuu.
16Maa aleɛ ɛbu azɛlɛ ne azo;
maa abɛlɛ ɛzi agole wɔ awoka ne mɔ azo,
na bɛvievia mralɛ kɛ Lɛbanɔn ɛdeɛ ne la.
Maa menli ɛyi azuamgbole ne mɔ azo gbudugbudu,
na bɛ nwo ɛzo kɛ ɛbɔ nu ndile.
17Ye duma ɛdɛnla ɛkɛ ne dahuu,
na ye anyunlunyia ɛda kɛ sɛnzɛne.
Menli kɔsɔɔti ɛva ye ɛyila bɛ nwo,
na maanle maanle ɛzuzu ye boɛ.
18Bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne ayɛlɛ,
ɔ ngomekye ala a ɔyɛ nwanwane ninyɛne a.
19Bɛye ye duma nwuanzanwuanza ne ayɛlɛ dahuu;
bɛmaa ye anyunlunyia ɛyi ewiade tɛkɛɛ!
Amen. Amen!
20Gyɛsi ara Devidi nzɛlɛlɛ ne mɔ awieleɛ ɛne.

Title: EDW 73
Content:
BULUKU MƆƆ TƆ ZO NSA
(Edwɛndolɛ 73—89)
Nyamenle pɛlepɛlelilɛ (Esafe edwɛne)
1Nɔhalɛ, Nyamenle le kpalɛ maa mɔɔ di boɛ la,
ɔle kpalɛ ɔmaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ ahonle nu te la.
2Na mame, mendule koti menwiele,
me gyakɛ ɛdudulɛ nu, ɔhale kyɛkyɛ na meatele.
3Ɔluakɛ me nye bolole adubɛnwoma,
mekɛ mɔɔ menwunle kɛ amumuyɛma ɛkpazi la.
4Ɔboalekɛ bɛnde nyane;
bɛte kpɔkɛ, bɛ nwonane tutoboo.
5Bɛ nwo ɛngyele bɛ kɛ bie mɔ la;
edwɛkɛ ɛndo bɛ kɛ bie mɔ la.
6Yemɔti bɛgua adubɛnwo ndweabane;
bɛwulowula nzisi adɛladeɛ.
7Ɛhyenlɛ ngome ɛmaa bɛ nyunlu ɛyɛ totofoo,
mgbane mgbane ɛyɛlɛ ɛyi bɛ ahonle ne mɔ.
8Bɛle agolobɛnwo, bɛka ɛtane;
bɛtu bɛ nwo na bɛbɔ adwenle kɛ bɛsisi awie mɔ.
9Bɛtendɛ bɛtia anwuma,
bɛka mgbole wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo ɛleka biala.
10Ɔlua zo menli tu toa bɛ na bɛyeyɛ bɛ;
bɛnnwu ɛtane biala wɔ bɛ nwo.
11Na bɛka kɛ, “Kɛ ɔkɛyɛ na Nyamenle anwu ye ɛ?
Asoo Anwuma Anwumanli ne lɛ nwolɛ adwenle?”
12Nea, kɛ amumuyɛma de la ɛne;
bɛnyia anwonyia dɔɔnwo, dahuu bɛ nwo tɔ bɛ.
13Meyɛ me ahonle nu bɔkɔbɔkɔ mgbane,
menrinzi me sa anwo kɛ menze nwolɛ bie mgbane.
14Ɔluakɛ alehyenlɛ muala menwu amaneɛ,
nwonlomɔ biala menyia ndeanlɛ.
15Saa menganle kɛ, “Mebaha ye zɛhae” a,
anrɛɛ meanga nɔhalɛ meangile ɛ mra
awolɛndoazo ye.
16Na mɔɔ mendwenlenle kɛ menwɔzi menwɔde ɛhye abo la,
ɔyɛle me nye zo gyima ɛsesebɛ bie,
17kɔkpula kɛ mengɔle Nyamenle Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu;
na menwunle bɛ muala bɛ awieleɛ la.
18Nɔhalɛ, ɛfa bɛ ɛsie ɛleka teteletetele;
ɛmaa bɛtu bɛgua, bɛ bo zo minli bɔkɔɔ.
19Ndɛndɛ ne ala ɛnee bɛ bo zo ɛbɔ,
bɛ bo zo ɛminli ɛzulolɛ ɛzulolɛ bie.
20Bɛle kɛ sonla mɔɔ kɛlafe kɛdunwue la ɛlalɛ,
ɔtunwue a ɛmbu ye ɛlalɛ ne bie.
21Mekɛ mɔɔ nyane hanle me,
mekɛ mɔɔ me ahonle futule la,
22menyɛle koasea anzenwolɛbie,
menyɛle kɛ nane la mentiale wɔ.
23Noko akee dahuu me nee wɔ a de a;
ɛlɛ me sa fema ne anu dahuu.
24Ɛfa wɔ ngilehilelɛ ne ɛsinza me,
na nzinlii ɛbalie me anyunlunyia nu.
25Menlɛ awie wɔ anwuma kɛ ɛdawɔ,
yɛɛ memkpondɛ ɛhwee wɔ ewiade kɛ wɔmɔ.
26Me nwonane bawie, me ahonle ayɛ bɛtɛɛ,
noko Nyamenle le me anwosesebɛ nee me kyɛfoa dahuu.
27Na nea, bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ nee wɔ bɛ avinli twe la baminli;
ɛmaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnli nɔhalɛ bɛmmaa wɔ la abo zo bɔ.
28Na mame, ɔle kpalɛ kɛ menwɔbikye Nyamenle;
meyɛ Awulae Nyamenle ne me ɛvealeka,
amaa meabɔ wɔ gyima ne mɔ nolo.

Title: EDW 74
Content:
Maanle ɛlielɛ nwo nzɛlɛlɛ (Esafe ɛdwɛkɛdwɛndolɛ)
1O Nyamenle, duzu ati a wɔpɛ yɛ wɔgua bɔkɔɔ ɛ?
Duzu ati a wɔ ɛya kpu esike
yelɛyela wɔ adidileka mboane ɛ?
2Kakye wɔ menli ne mɔɔ mɔmoane ɛvale bɛ ɛyɛle wɔ ɛdeɛ,
na wɔlie bɛ wɔyɛ bɛ wɔ agyadeɛ, abusua ekpunli la.
Kakye Zayɔn Boka mɔɔ wɔdɛnla zolɛ ɛlɛ la.
3Kpɔsa ninyɛne ne mɔɔ ɛzɛkye bɔkɔɔ la avinli;
yɛ kpɔvolɛma ɛzɛkye Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu debie biala.
4Wɔ kpɔvolɛma ɛva konimlilɛ ɛdeɛdea nu
wɔ wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu;
bɛdabɛ bɛkpɔnla bɛ sɛkɛlɛneɛ wɔ sɛkɛlɛneɛ zo.
5Bɛvale akuma bɛbubule anwuma anuhɔlɛ ne anlenkɛ ne.
6Bɛvale hamenle nee akuma bɛbubule taboa biala
mɔɔ bɛli adwinli bɛgua zo la.
7Bɛdole senle wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu;
bɛyelale wɔ Ɛleka Nwuanzanwuanza ne wee.
8Bɛhanle bɛhilele bɛ nwo kɛ,
“Yɛtɛnla bɛ kɔme zo kpalɛ kpalɛ;”
bɛyelale Nyamenle nyianu ɛleka ne mɔ
mɔɔ wɔ maanle ne anu la amuala.
9Yɛnnwu yɛ sɛkɛlɛneɛ ne mɔ;
Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ bieko ɛnle ɛkɛ,
yɛɛ awie ɛnze kenle mɔɔ ɛhye mɔ kɛze a.
10O Nyamenle, kenlenzu yɛɛ kpɔvolɛ ne kɛgyakyi
agolobɛnwo ye a?
Asoo ɔwɔ kɛ kpɔvolɛ ne sɛkye wɔ duma bɔkɔɔ?
11Duzu ati a wɔdo ɛ sa wɔbɛla nu
na wɔva ɛ sa fema ne wɔwula ɛ nvɔnlɔma anu ɛ?
12Noko ɔvi tete, ɛle Nyamenle, me Belemgbunli
mɔɔ die ngoane wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo a.
13 Ɛvale wɔ tumi ne ɛhyɛle nyevile ne anu,
na ɛgelegelele nane anwo ɛzulolɛ ne ati azule nye.
14 Ɛgelegelele Lɛveatan ati,
na ɛvale ye nane ɛmanle fienemgbole nu nanemgbole lile.
15Ɛmanle nzufeanvea nee azule mralɛ zenzenle,
na ɛmanle azudenle sesanle wele resee.
16Alehyenlɛ nee aledwolɛ ne le wɔ ɛdeɛ;
ɛdawɔ a ɛbɔle sɛnzɛne nee anwumaneamra a.
17Ɛdawɔ a ɛhyehyɛle ɛleka mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ azɛlɛ ne dwu la a;
ɛdawɔ a ɛbɔle wawaa nee fɔsɛlɛ a.
18O Ɛdɛnkɛma, kakye ɛhye, nee kpɔvolɛ ne agolobɛnwo ne,
menli mɔɔ ɛnze Nyamenle la sɛkye wɔ duma.
19Mmaye wɔ abubule ne ɛmaa ɛbɔ nu nanemgbole;
mmamaa ɛ rɛle fi wɔ menli mɔɔ ɛhyia la fee.
20Kakye wɔ ngyekyeleɛ ne,
ɔluakɛ ahɔdiawu ɛhɔ nzia
wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo ahodoka anu awozinli ne mɔ anu.
21Mmamaa mɔɔ bɛsisi ye la anyunlu gua aze;
maa ehyianli ne nee mɔɔ ɛhyia la ɛye wɔ ayɛlɛ.
22O Nyamenle, dwazo, na die wɔ duma ne sie aze.
Kakye kɛ anzenyamenlema si golo ɛ nwo dahuu la.
23Mmamaa ɛ rɛle fi wɔ kpɔvolɛma mɔɔ di wulupe,
nee bɛ alɛra mɔɔ bɛyɛ ye dahuu la.

Title: EDW 75
Content:
Ndɛnebuavolɛ Nyamenle ne (Esafe edwɛne)
1O Nyamenle, yɛyɛ wɔ mo; yɛyɛ wɔ mo;
yɛbɔ wɔ duma na yɛka wɔ nwanwane gyima ne mɔ.
2Nyamenle se, “Saa mekɛ ne mɔɔ mehile la dwu a,
mebabua ndɛne wɔ ye adenle zo.
3Saa azɛlɛ kpusu, maa abɔdeɛ muala kpusu a,
medame a mesɔ ye memaa ɔgyinla kpundii a.
4Meka mekile adubɛnwonli ne kɛ, ‘Gyakyi adubɛnwo,’
na mese amumuyɛnli ne kɛ, ‘Mmaka mgbole,
5mmaka mgbole ɛmemaa ɛ nwo zo,
anzɛɛ mmatwe ɛ kɔme ɛka mgbole’ ”
6Ɔluakɛ ndɛnebualɛ ɛnvi aduduleɛ anzɛɛ adɔleɛ,
yɛɛ ɔmkpogya ɔ nwo zo ɔnvi ɛsɛlɛ nu ɔmba;
7Nyamenle ala a bua ndɛne a,
ɔbɛlɛ bie aze, ɔmaa bie zo.
8Ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma lɛ kɔpo ɔ sa nu,
ɔlɛ nwanye mɔɔ ɛwie be na ɔlɛwu awubue la wɔ nu;
ɔbawola ekyi bie yeagua,
na azɛlɛ ye azo amumuyɛma banlo ɔ muala.
9Na mame, me nye balie dahuu,
mebado edwɛne meaye Gyekɔbo Nyamenle ne ayɛlɛ.
10Ɔbazɛkye amumuyɛma tumi ne
na tenlenema tumi ne bayɛ kpole.

Title: EDW 76
Content:
Konimnli Nyamenle (Esafe edwɛne)
1Bɛze Nyamenle wɔ Dwuda,
ye duma le kpole wɔ Yizilayɛ.
2Bɛkyekye ye tɛnlabelɛ wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm,
ye sua nu wɔ Zayɔn Boka.
3Ɛkɛ ne a ɔbubule kpɔvolɛma ne ɛda ne mɔ,
bɛ enyinlike, konle dadeɛ nee konle ninyɛne muala a.
4Wɔ anyunlunyia le kpole, wɔ belemgbunlililɛ le kpole;
ɔtɛla awoka mgbole kɔsɔɔti!
5Bɛkpokpole akɛnrasesebɛma bɛliele bɛ sa nu ninyɛne;
bɛguale aze bɛwule;
ɛlɔnema ne amuala annyia gyinlagyakɛ.
6O Gyekɔbo Nyamenle, ɛdeanle bɛ nu ala la,
ɛkpɔnwɔ nee ye kavolɛ ne dule guale.
7Na wɔmɔ, ɛ nwo yɛ ɛzulolɛ kpole!
Saa ɛfa ɛya a nwane a kɛhola kɛgyinla ɛ nyunlu a?
8Ɛwɔ anwuma lɔ yɛɛ ɛbuale ndɛne a;
azɛlɛ zulole na ɔgyinlanle diinyi,
9wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle dwazole kɛ ɔbua ndɛne
yealie menli mɔɔ bɛsisi bɛ wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo la.
10Sonla ɛyavalɛ wie Nyamenle ayɛlɛyelɛ
ɛyavalɛ nee konle ne anzi,
bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛha la bali wɔ eni.
11Maa wɔ ɛwɔkɛbɔlɛ ne ɛdwu Ɛdɛnkɛma wɔ Nyamenle ne ɛkɛ,
na ye bɛ muala;
maa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛbikye ye la ɛva bɛ ahyɛlɛdeɛ
ɛrɛlɛ ye,
yemɔ yɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛsulo ye a.
12Yemɔ yɛɛ ɔbɛlɛ arelemgbunli aze a,
ɔ nwo yɛ ɛzulolɛ maa aleɛabo arelemgbunli.

Title: EDW 77
Content:
Ngyianlɛ nu arɛlekyekyelɛ (Esafe edwɛne)
1Metea nu kpole mefɛlɛ Nyamenle,
metea nu kpole, amaa Nyamenle ade me ne.
2Mekpondɛ Awulae wɔ me amaneɛnwunlɛ mekɛ nu;
aledwolɛ nu metɛlɛdɛlɛ me sa nu mesɛlɛ, menvɛ fee;
me ɛkɛla ɛmkponle kɛ bɛkɛkyekye ɔ rɛle.
3Medwenle Nyamenle anwo a, megu ɛnwomenle,
medwenledwenle nwo nzɛlɛlɛ nu a, me rɛle bɔ.
4Ɛlɛ me nye anzi nwoma ne anu, ɛmmaa menlafe;
me rɛle ɛbɔ kpole, mengola tendɛ.
5Medwenle mekɛ mɔɔ ɛze ɛhɔ la anwo,
mekakye ɛvolɛ dɔɔnwo mɔɔ ɛze ɛhɔ la.
6Mendole edwɛne nɔɔzo wɔ me ahonle nu;
medwenledwenle nwo meneɛnlea me ahonle nu kɛ:
7“Asoo Awulae bakpo me dahuu,
mɔɔ ɔnrɛnwu me anwunvɔne ɛlɛ a?
8Asoo ye ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne ɛkpa nwo bɔkɔɔ?
Asoo ye ɛwɔkɛbɔlɛ ne ɛwie bɔkɔɔ?
9Asoo Nyamenle arɛle ɛvi kɛ ɔkɛyɛ ahunlunyele?
Asoo yeva ɛya yeminli ye anwunvɔnezelɛ ne?”
10Na mese, “Medame me nyane mɔɔ medi la
yɛɛ ɛmaa Anwuma Anwumanli ne tumi ɛhakyi a.”
11Mebahakye mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛyɛ la amuala;
ɛhɛe, mebahakye wɔ mɔmoane nwanwane gyima ne.
12Mebadwenledwenle wɔ gyima ne amuala anwo,
na meadwenle wɔ gyima mgbole ne mɔ anwo.
13O Nyamenle, wɔ adenle le nwuanzanwuanza;
nyamenle boni a le kpole kɛ yɛ Nyamenle ne a?
14Wɔmɔ a ɛle Nyamenle mɔɔ yɛ nwanwane ninyɛne,
mɔɔ wɔhile wɔ tumi ne wɔ menli avinli a.
15Ɛvale wɔ tumi ne ɛliele wɔ menli,
Gyekɔbo nee Dwosefi abo zo amra.
16O Nyamenle, mɔɔ azule ne mɔ nwunle wɔ la,
mɔɔ azule ne mɔ nwunle wɔ la, bɛzulole;
ɛhɛe, buma fonyianle.
17Nzulemungu dɔle ezule bilididi,
anwomanyunlu hulule; wɔ ɛda ne mɔ vedele ɛleka biala.
18Wɔ ɛhululɛ ne liele ahumuakyima ne anu,
wɔ ɛsɛnlɛmanye ne mɔ kpakyele dale ewiade amuala;
azɛlɛ kpusule dikyidikyi.
19Wɔ adenle la nyevile ne anu,
ɛ gyakɛ abo adenle la buma mgbole ne mɔ anu,
noko awie anwu ɛ gyakɛ abo zo.
20Ɛhanle wɔ menli ne kɛ mboane na ɛlile bɛ nyunlu,
Mosisi nee Aalɔn a nleanle bɛ nwo zo a.

Title: EDW 78
Content:
Nyamenle nee ye menli ne (Esafe edwɛkɛdwɛndolɛ)
1O me menli, bɛdie me ngilehilelɛ;
bɛyɛ ɛnzonlɛ bɛdie me nloa edwɛkɛ!
2 Mebabuke me nloa meava mrɛlɛbulɛ
meaha bɛ mɔmoane awozinli nu edwɛkɛ,
3edwɛkɛ mɔɔ yɛde na yɛze,
yɛ nlenya mɔ a ɛha ɛhile yɛ a.
4Yɛnrɛva yɛnrɛvea bɛ nlɔnra,
yɛbaha yɛahile awolɛndoazo mɔɔ bara la.
Ɛdɛnkɛma lile gyima mgbole, ɔlɛ tumi,
yɛɛ ɔyɛle nwanwane ninyɛne dɔɔnwo.
5Ɔvale ye ngyehyɛlɛ ɔmanle Gyekɔbo abo zo amra,
na ɔlile mɛla ɔmanle Yizilayɛma,
ɔzele yɛ nlenya mɔ kɛ bɛhilehile bɛ mra;
6amaa awolɛndoazo bieko anu amra
nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛtɛwole bɛ la anwu ye,
na bɛdabɛ bɛaha bɛahile bɛ mra;
7amaa bɛanyia Nyamenle nu anyelazo,
amaa bɛ rɛle anvi Nyamenle gyima ne mɔ,
na bɛali ye mɛla ne mɔ azo;
8amaa bɛanyɛ kɛ bɛ nlenya mɔ,
bɛanyɛ awolɛndoazo atuadelɛma nee anzosesebɛ;
awolɛndoazo mɔɔ ɛnnea ɛleka ko,
mɔɔ ɛnli nɔhalɛ ɛmmaa Nyamenle la.
9Yifelaemma vale ɛda,
noko konle kenle ne, bɛguale ɛbɔ nu.
10Bɛanli Nyamenle ngyekyeleɛ ne azo,
na bɛkpole kɛ bɛnrɛlua ye mɛla adenle ne anu.
11Bɛ rɛle vile mɔɔ yeyɛ,
nee nwanwane ninyɛne mɔɔ yeyɛ yehile bɛ la.
12 Ɔyɛle nwanwane ninyɛne ɔhilele bɛ nlenya mɔ
wɔ Zowan fienemgbole nu, wɔ Yigyibiti azɛlɛ zo.
13 Ɔkpakyele nyevile ne anu nwiɔ ɔmanle bɛzenle,
ɔmanle azule ne dwazole bolonwonwo yɛle kɛ bane.
14 Alehyenlɛ nu ɔyɛle amungu ɔlile bɛ nyunlu,
aledwolɛ nu ɔyɛle senle guaanye.
15 Ɔkpukele bodane wɔ fienemgbole ne anu
na ɔmanle bɛ nzule dɔɔnwo kɛ buma nu nzule la bɛnlonle.
16Ɔmanle azudenle vi bodane nu zenzenle,
na ɔmanle nzule ne zenle kɛ azule.
17Noko bɛyɛle ɛtane dɔɔnwo bɛtiale ye,
bɛdele Anwuma Anwumanli ne anwo atua wɔ ɛsɛlɛ ne azo.
18 Bɛ ahonle nu, bɛzɔle Nyamenle bɛnleanle,
na bɛbizale aleɛ mɔɔ bɛdabɛ bɛkulo la.
19Bɛdendɛle bɛtiale Nyamenle bɛhanle kɛ,
“Asoo Nyamenle kɛhola kɛmaa yɛ aleɛ wɔ ɛsɛlɛ ye azo?
20Ɔbɔle bolɛ ne ɔmanle nzule vi nu vindele,
na azudenle yile bule aze.
Asoo eza ɔkɛhola ɔkɛmaa yɛ aleɛ,
anzɛɛ ɔkɛmaa ye menli ne nane bɛkɛli?”
21Yemɔti mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma dele la, ɔvale ɛya kpole,
ye ɛya ne zɔle kɛ senle tiale Gyekɔbo abo zo amra ne,
ye ɛya ne yɛle kpole wɔ Yizilayɛma anwo zo;
22ɔboalekɛ bɛnlɛ diedi wɔ Nyamenle anu,
yɛɛ bɛanva bɛ rɛle bɛanwula
ye ngoanelielɛ tumi ne anu.
23Na ɔdendɛle ɔhilele anwomanyunlu,
na ɔbukele anwuma nlenkɛ ne mɔ;
24 ɔmanle mana dɔle kɛ ezule ɔmanle bɛ;
na ɔmanle bɛ anwuma aleɛ bɛlile.
25Menli lile anwuma soanvolɛma aleɛ;
ɔmanle aleɛ bule bɛ nwo zo.
26Ɔmanle aduduleɛ anwoma bɔle anwuma lɔ,
na ɔvale ye tumi ne ɔhwenle nyiakɛ anwoma ne ɔhɔle.
27Ɔmanle nane bule bɛ nwo zo kɛ munlutu,
nloma yɛle dɔɔnwo kɛ ɛnweazo anwea.
28Ɔmanle bɛtetele bɛguale bɛ azokoɛleɛ ɛkɛ ne,
ɛleka mɔɔ bɛde la yɛle totɔɔ.
29Bɛlile na bɛ ko yile,
ɔboalekɛ ɔmanle bɛ mɔɔ bɛkpondɛ la.
30Noko mɔɔ bɛ atiakunluwɔzo ne kaye,
mɔɔ ɛnee bɛtɛwiele aleɛ ne di la,
31Nyamenle vale bɛ nwo ɛya,
na ɔhunle bɛ nuhua mɔɔ anwo yɛ se kpalɛ la,
na ɔmanle Yizilayɛ ɛlɔnema anwo hanle aze.
32Noko ɛhye mɔ amuala anzi, bɛhɔle zo bɛyɛle ɛtane;
ye nwanwane nyɛleɛ ne mɔ anzi, bɛanlie bɛanli.
33Yemɔti ɔmanle bɛ mekɛ zenle waa kɛ ɛnwomenle,
na ɔpɛle bɛ ngoane sinli ɛzulolɛ nu.
34Ɔhunle bɛ la, bɛkpondɛle ɔ bo zo;
bɛnlunle bɛ nwo na bɛkpondɛle Nyamenle ɛsesebɛ.
35Bɛhakyele kɛ Nyamenle le bɛ bodane,
Anwuma Anwuma Nyamenle ne le bɛ dievolɛ.
36Noko bɛvale bɛ nloa bɛbɔle awuye ala;
bɛbɔle adalɛ, bɛ nee ye lile amanie.
37Bɛanva bɛ ahonle bɛammaa ye;
bɛanli nɔhalɛ wɔ ye ngyekyeleɛ ne anwo.
38Noko yemɔ, kɛmɔ ɔse anwunvɔne la ati,
ɔvale bɛ ɛtane ɔhyɛle bɛ, yɛanzɛkye bɛ;
mekɛ dɔɔnwo ɔmenle ye ɛya ne,
yeanva ye ɛya ne amuala yeangua bɛ nwo zo.
39Ɔhakyele kɛ bɛle nwonane ala,
bɛle kɛ anwoma mɔɔ se na ɔnzia ko la.
40Bɛdele ɔ nwo atua dɔɔnwo wɔ fienemgbole ne anu,
bɛmanle ɔlile nyane wɔ ɛsɛlɛ ne azo.
41Bɛzɔle ye bɛnleanle fane dɔɔnwo,
na bɛhanle Yizilayɛ Nwuanzanwuanza Ko ne ɛya.
42Bɛanva ye tumi ne anzɛɛ kenle ne mɔɔ ɔyele bɛ
ɔvile bɛ agbɔvolɛ asa nu la bɛangɔ adwenle nu bɔbɔ,
43na yeayɛ ye nwanwane sɛkɛlɛneɛ mɔɔ ɔyɛle wɔ Yigyibiti,
anzɛɛ nwanwane ninyɛne mɔɔ ɔyɛle wɔ Zowan fienemgbole nu la.
44 Ɔhakyile bɛ azule ne mɔ mogya,
mɔɔ ɛnee bɛngola nuhua nzule no a.
45 Ɔyele nrɛzenra adɔka ɔmanle bɛgyegyele bɛ,
ahɛlɛne ɔmanle bɛzɛkyele bɛ azɛlɛ ne.
46 Ɔmanle nyangomango lile bɛ ɛbɔ nu aleɛ,
ɔmanle abɛbɛ lile bɛ egyinli nu aleɛ.
47 Ɔvale ezuawolɛ ɔzɛkyele bɛ vanye egyinli,
na ɔvale nzulemungu ɔzɛkyele bɛ sekamɔ mbaka.
48Ɔdɔle ezuawolɛ ɔhunle bɛ nlankɛ,
yɛɛ ɛsɛnlɛmanye pepenle bɛ mboane nwo zo hunle bɛ.
49Ɔgyakyile ye ɛya ne anu ɔguale bɛ nwo zo,
ɔvale ɛya, abodelɛ, yɛɛ nyane ɔ rale bɛ nwo zo
kɛ anwuma soanvolɛma la ɔrazɛkyele bɛ.
50Ɔkpakyele adenle ɔmanle ye ɛya ne;
yeanlie biala yeanvi ewule nu,
na ɔmanle ewule nzane hunle bɛ muala.
51 Ɔhunle Yigyibiti belamunli mralɛ mrenya kɔsɔɔti,
Ham awuke biala anu nyianle ye ɛdeɛ.
52 Akee ɔhanle ye menli ne kɛ mboane na ɔlile bɛ nyunlu,
na ɔwowale bɛ wɔ fienemgbole ne anu.
53 Ɔbɔle bɛ nwo bane, yemɔti bɛanzulo;
na nyevile ne bule vale bɛ kpɔvolɛma ne anwo zo.
54 Ɔvale bɛ ɔrale ye azɛlɛ nwuanzanwuanza ne azo,
awoka ne mɔ mɔɔ yeva ye tumi yelie la anu.
55 Ɔvoanle maanle maanle ɔvile bɛ nye zo;
ɔhyɛle azɛlɛ ne ɔmanle bɛvale bɛyɛle bɛ ɛdeɛ,
na ɔmanle Yizilayɛma dɛnlanle bɛ azua ne mɔ anu.
56 Noko bɛzɔle Anwuma Anwuma Nyamenle ne bɛnleanle,
na bɛdele ɔ nwo atua; bɛanli ye mɛla ne mɔ azo.
57Bɛkpole ye na bɛyɛle ngunzi kɛ bɛ nlenya mɔ;
bɛhyibale bɛ nwo kɛ ɛdabaka kyealera.
58Bɛvale bɛ ɛleka mɔɔ bɛsonle la bɛhanle ye ɛya;
bɛvale bɛ ananze mɔɔ bɛguale la bɛfutule ye ahonle.
59Nyamenle nwunle ye la, ɔvale ɛya kpole,
na ɔkpole Yizilayɛma bɔkɔɔ.
60 Ɔkpole ye tɛnlabelɛ ne mɔɔ wɔ Hyaelo,
ɛleka mɔɔ ɔdɛnlanle ye menli ne avinli la.
61 Ɔmanle bɛhyele ye tumi ne nuokɛ,
ɔyele ye anyunlunyia ɔwulale kpɔvolɛma ne asa anu.
62Ɔmanle bɛhunle ye menli ne,
na ɔkpule ye ɛya ne ɔguale bɛ nwo zo.
63Bɛ mgbavolɛ ne mɔ hale esike nu,
yɛɛ bɛ mbɛlɛra ne mɔ annyia agyalɛ angɔ.
64Bɛ sɛlɛvolɛma dɔle dadeɛ nloa,
yɛɛ bɛ ahunlanvolɛ angola awolɛ ye.
65Akee Awulae dwazole kɛ asɛɛ ɔvi nafelɛ nu,
na ɔlɛtea kɛ katakyie mɔɔ nza wɔ ɔ nye zo la.
66Ɔmanle ye kpɔvolɛma guale ɛbɔ nu,
na ɔguale bɛ nyunlu aze kpɔtɔɔ.
67Ɔkpole Dwosefi awuke nu amra,
yeanva Yifelaem abusua ekpunli ne;
68ɔnleanle nu ɔyele Dwuda abusua ekpunli ne,
Zayɔn Boka mɔɔ ɔkulo ye somaa la.
69Ɔzile ye Ɛleka Nwuanzanwuanza ne
kɛ ye sua nu mɔɔ wɔ anwuma la;
ɔzile ye kpundii kɛ azɛlɛ ye mɔɔ yebɔ,
na ɔla ɛkɛ ne dahuu la.
70 Ɔnleanle nu ɔyele ye sonvolɛ Devidi,
ɔyele ye ɔvile mboane zo ɛnleanlɛ,
71ɔmanle ɔgyakyile mboane mralɛ ɛnleanlɛ, na ɔ nee ye rale kɛ ɔranlea ye menli Gyekɔbo abo zo amra,
Yizilayɛma mɔɔ le ye agyadeɛ la.
72Ɔvale ahonle kpalɛ ɔnleanle bɛ,
na ɔvale nrɛlɛbɛ kpole ɔzinzale bɛ.

Title: EDW 79
Content:
Maanle ne ɛlielɛ nwo nzɛlɛlɛ (Esafe edwɛne)
1 O Nyamenle, menli mɔɔ ɛnzonle wɔ la
ɛrawolo wɔ agyadeɛ ye anu,
bɛgua wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua nwuanzanwuanza ne anwo evinli;
bɛbɔ Gyɛlusalɛm bɔkɔbɔkɔ.
2Bɛva wɔ sonvolɛma ne mɔ avunli
bɛmaa anwomanyunlu nloma kɛ bɛli,
bɛva wɔ menli ne nwonane bɛmaa azɛlɛ ye azo nanemgbole.
3Bɛhwi bɛ mogya bɛgua kɛ nzule,
bɛkponde ye Gyɛlusalɛm amuala,
yɛɛ awie ɛnle ɛkɛ na yeazie bɛ.
4Maanle maanle mɔɔ ɛbɔ ɛyia yɛ la bɔ yɛ aholoba,
bɛsi yɛ amgbu na bɛsele yɛ.
5O Ɛdɛnkɛma, na kenlenzu?
Asoo ɛfa ɛya mɔɔ ɛnrɛgyakyi ɛlɛ?
Asoo ɛmaa wɔ ɛya kpole ne azɔ kɛ senle?
6Wola wɔ ɛya ne gua maanle maanle mɔɔ ɛnze wɔ,
nee arelemgbunli maanle mɔɔ ɛnzonle wɔ la anwo zo.
7Ɔluakɛ bɛhu Yizilayɛma amuala,
na bɛmaa bɛ tɛnlabelɛ ɛdɔ mgbane.
8Mmatea yɛ wɔ yɛ nlenya mɔ ɛtane ne mɔ ati;
maa wɔ anwunvɔnezelɛ ne ɛrɛla yɛ nwo zo ndɛndɛ,
ɔluakɛ yɛ anyelazo ɛwie.
9O yɛ ngoanelielɛ Nyamenle, boa yɛ,
wɔ wɔ duma ne anyunlunyia ti;
fa yɛ ɛtane ne mɔ kyɛ yɛ na die yɛ,
wɔ wɔ duma ne ati.
10Duzu ati yɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ maanle maanle ka kɛ,
“Bɛ Nyamenle ne wɔ nienwu?” a.
Maa wɔ sonvolɛma mɔɔ bɛha bɛ mogya bɛgua la
anwo nzenralɛ ɛrɛla maanle maanle ne mɔ
anwo zo wɔ yɛdayɛ yɛ nye zo.
11Maa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛhye bɛ nuokɛ la ɛzunlɛ ɛdwu ɛ nyunlu;
fa wɔ tumi kpole ne die bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkahu bɛ la.
12O Awulae, maanle maanle mɔɔ ɛbɔ wɔ aholoba la,
kile bɛdabɛ abodelɛ mɔnwo fane nsuu.
13Na wɔ menli, wɔ adidileka mboane,
yɛbayɛ wɔ mo dahuu;
ɔvi awolɛndoazo kɔdwu awolɛndoazo,
yɛbaye wɔ ayɛlɛ.

Title: EDW 80
Content:
Maanle ne boɛyɛlɛ bieko anwo nzɛlɛlɛ (Esafe edwɛne)
1 O Yizilayɛma anwo zo neavolɛ, tie yɛ,
wɔmɔ, ɛhanle Dwosefi abo zo amra
kɛ mboane na ɛlile bɛ nyunlu.
Wɔmɔ mɔɔ wɔ belemgbunli ebia
gyi tease abɔdeɛma azo a, ta bɛla,
2maa Yifelaem, Bɛngyaman, yɛɛ Manasɛ ɛnwu ye.
Kile wɔ tumi ne, na balie yɛ!
3O Nyamenle, fa yɛ sie yɛ gyinlabelɛ dɛba ne;
kile wɔ anwunvɔnezelɛ ne yɛ nwo zo,
amaa yɛanyia ngoane.
4O Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle,
ɛfa wɔ menli ne nzɛlɛlɛ nwo ɛya wɔahɔdwu kenlenzu?
5Wɔmaa bɛ nyane kɛ bɛli kɛ aleɛ,
wɔmaa bɛ monle kɛ nzule kɛ bɛnlo bɛmaa ɔde bɛ.
6Maanle maanle mɔɔ ɛbɔ ɛyia yɛ la zo konle doa yɛ,
yɛɛ yɛ kpɔvolɛma yia nu a bɛsele yɛ.
7O Tumivolɛ Nyamenle, fa yɛ sie yɛ gyinlabelɛ dɛba ne;
kile wɔ anwunvɔnezelɛ ne yɛ nwo zo,
amaa yɛanyia ngoane
8Ɛvale vanye baka ɛvile Yigyibiti ɛrale;
ɛvoanle maanle maanle ne mɔ na ɛluale.
9Ɛzieziele azɛlɛ ne ɛmanle ye;
ɔzɔle ndinli ɔhɔle aze kpalɛ na ɔvale azɛlɛ ne.
10Ye alubo hedale awoka ne mɔ azo,
ɔvale ye ngane ɔguale sida mbaka mgbole zo;
11ye ngane dwule Mɛdetɛlenia nyevile nu,
ɔdendenle ɔdwule Azule Yufileti ne anloa.
12Duzu ati a akee wɔbubu ye bane ne mɔ,
na bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛfa adenle ne azo la tete ye ma ɛ?
13Kɔkɔte vi kpɔkɛ nu batietia zo,
yɛɛ ɛbɔ nu debie biala di bie.
14O Tumivolɛ Nyamenle, kakyi ɛ nye bieko!
Wɔ anwuma nehane, to ɛ nye nea,
na bu vanye baka ɛhye bie,
15baka ne mɔɔ ɛvale wɔ tumi ɛluale,
ɛnleanle ɛmanle ɔyɛle kpole ɔmanle wɔ la.
16Bɛpɛ ye bɛdo aze, bɛva senle bɛdo nu;
twi bɛ nyunlu na bɔ bɛ bo zo.
17Fa ɛ sa to sonla ne mɔɔ wɔ wɔ fema zo la anwo zo,
sonla ra ne mɔɔ wɔwula ye anwosesebɛ wɔmaa ɛ nwo la!
18Yɛnrɛhakyi yɛ nzi yɛnrɛzi wɔ bieko;
maa yɛ ngoane, na yɛkɛzonle wɔ.
19O Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, fa yɛ sie yɛ gyinlabelɛ dɛba ne,
kile wɔ anwunvɔnezelɛ ne yɛ nwo zo,
amaa yɛanyia ngoane.

Title: EDW 81
Content:
Ɛvoyialilɛ nwo edwɛne (Esafe edwɛne)
1Bɛdea nu bɛdo edwɛne bɛmaa Nyamenle yɛ anwosesebɛ ne;
bɛva anyelielɛ bɛdea nu bɛmaa Gyekɔbo Nyamenle ne!
2Bɛvɛlɛ edwɛne ne, bɛbɔ akɛya ne,
bɛbɔ getaa ngyikyi ne nee mgbole ne mɔ.
3 Siane ne fi fofolɛ a bɛwu aweɛne tendenle ne anu,
siane ne yɛ mumua a bɛwu nu bɛli ɛvoyia ne.
4Ɔluakɛ ɔle mɛla ɔmaa Yizilayɛma,
ɔle Gyekɔbo Nyamenle ne mɛla.
5Ɔluale Dwosefi abo zo amra anwo zo ɔyɛle ye mɛla,
mekɛ mɔɔ ɔtetale Yigyibitima la.
Mete ɛnelɛ bie mɔɔ metɛtele ye ɛlɛ a; ɔse,
6“Menyele bɛ kɔme zo adesoa;
menliele bɛ ahɛndɛne menvile bɛ sa nu.
7 Bɛvɛlɛle me wɔ bɛ anwongyelelɛ nu, na menliele bɛ;
mewɔ me feabelɛ wɔ ahumu ne anu la, menliele bɛ zo;
menzɔle bɛ meneanle wɔ Mɛleba nzubula ne mɔ azo.
8Bɛdie, O me menli, mebɔ bɛ kɔkɔ,
O Yizilayɛ, saa bɛkɛdie me angome ɛdeɛ a!
9 Ɔnle kɛ bɛnyia nyamenle gyɛne biala bɛ avinli;
bɛmmabɔ bɛ ti aze bɛmaa nyamenle gyɛne biala.
10Medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne,
mɔɔ yele bɛ vile Yigyibiti azɛlɛ zo rale la.
Bɛbuke bɛ nloa kpalɛ, na menwɔmaa bɛ aleɛ.
11“Na me menli ne andie me ne;
Yizilayɛma ɛnva me ɛnyɛ ɛhwee.
12Yemɔti mengyakyile bɛ memanle bɛdabɛ bɛ anzosesebɛ ne,
kɛ bɛdabɛ bɛyɛ mɔɔ bɛkulo la.
13O anrɛɛ me menli ne adie me,
anrɛɛ Yizilayɛma alua me adenle ne anu!
14Ɔnrɛhyɛ biala na meali bɛ kpɔvolɛma anwo zo konim,
na meava me sa meazie menli mɔɔ kyi bɛ la anwo.
15Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkyi Ɛdɛnkɛma la baradane ye,
bɛ ndeanlɛ bo ɛnrɛdu ɛlɛ.
16Mebava hwiiti kpalɛ meadane bɛ,
na meamaa bɛ bodane nu wolɛ bɛanlo.”

Title: EDW 82
Content:
Nyamenle le Belemgbunli Bedevinli (Esafe edwɛne)
1Nyamenle ɛdɛnla ye ebia nu
wɔ ayia nwuanzanwuanza ne anu;
saa awozonle ne mɔ yia nu a ɔbua bɛ ndɛne kɛ,
2“Kenlenzu a bɛkɛgyakyi mgbɔvodɛne ɛbualɛ,
na bɛkɛgyakyi kɛ bɛdi bɛaboa amumuyɛma a?
3Bɛli pɛlepɛle bɛmaa mɔɔ ɛnlɛ anwosesebɛ nee mɔɔ ɛnlɛ ɔ ze la,
na bɛli bɛmaa mɔɔ ɛlɛnwu amaneɛ nee mɔɔ ɛnlɛ bie la.
4Die mɔɔ ɛnlɛ anwosesebɛ nee mɔɔ ɛnlɛ bie la;
die bɛ fi amumuyɛma asa anu.”
5“Bɛnlɛ adwenle yɛɛ bɛnlɛ ndelebɛbo,
bɛluolua awozinli nu;
azɛlɛ ye adiabo ne mɔ ɛkpusu.
6 Mese, ‘Bɛle nyamenle,
bɛ kɔsɔɔti bɛle Anwuma Anwumanli ne amra;’
7noko bɛbawu kɛ menli wu la,
na bɛakpo aze kɛ belemgbunli biala la.”
8Dwazo, O Nyamenle, bua ewiade ndɛne;
ɔluakɛ maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti le wɔ ɛdeɛ!

Title: EDW 83
Content:
Yizilayɛ kpɔvolɛma anwo zo konimlilɛ nzɛlɛlɛ (Esafe edwɛne)
1O Nyamenle, mmayɛ koonwu;
O Nyamenle, mmayɛ kɛnlanana!
2Nea, wɔ kpɔvolɛma ne ɛlɛtu fonyia;
bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkyi wɔ la ɛmaa bɛ ti zo.
3Bɛhɔ wɔ menli ne ati akpamo,
bɛtu bɛ nwo azukue wɔ menli ne
mɔɔ wɔbɔ bɛ nwo bane la ati.
4Bɛse, “Bɛrɛla bɛmaa yɛbɔ bɛ maanle ne bɔkɔɔ;
amaa bɛangakye duma Yizilayɛ ne bieko ɛlɛ.”
5Ɛhɛe, bɛ muala bɛbɔ nu bɛfa adwenle ko,
bɛkyekye bɛkye ɔ bo bɛtia wɔ:
6Yidɔmma nee Yehyemeeyɛlema,
Mowabema nee Hagelaema,
7Gibalema, Amɔnoma, nee Amalɛkema,
Filisitiama yɛɛ menli mɔɔ wɔ Taya la.
8Aseleama noko boka bɛ nwo;
bɛmɛ a bɛle Lɔɔto abo zo amra mɔɔ anwo yɛ se kpalɛ a.
9 Yɛ bɛ kɛ ɛyɛle Medeanema la,
kɛ ɛyɛle Sesɛla nee Gyeeben wɔ Azule Kaehyɔn anloa,
10mɔɔ bɛzɛkyele bɛ wɔ Ɛndɔ,
na bɛ avunli kpɔlɔle azɛlɛ ne azo la.
11 Yɛ bɛ mgbanyima ne mɔ kɛ ɛyɛle Ɔlɛbe nee Ziibi la;
na yɛ bɛ arelemgbunli ne mɔ kɛ ɛyɛle Ziba nee Zalemɛna,
12mɔɔ hanle kɛ, “Bɛmaa yɛhɔ Nyamenle adidileka ne
yɛhɔva ye azɛlɛ ne bie yɛyɛ yɛ ɛdeɛ” la.
13O me Nyamenle, maa bɛyɛ kɛ munlutu mɔɔ anwoma ɛlɛbɔ nu la,
bɛyɛ kɛ abonle mɔɔ luolua anwoma nu la.
14Maa bɛyɛ kɛ kpɔkɛ mɔɔ senle la nu la,
bɛyɛ kɛ awoka mɔɔ senle ɛdɔ zolɛ la.
15Zɔhane ala yɛɛ fa wɔ ahumu ne si bɛ zo,
na fa ahumu kpole tu bɛ nwo mɔra a.
16O Ɛdɛnkɛma, maa anyiemgba ɛha bɛ,
amaa bɛakpondɛ ɛ bo zo.
17Maa bɛ nyunlu ɛgua aze, bɛ rɛle ɛbɔ dahuu;
maa bɛ bo zo ɛbɔ anyiemgba nu.
18Maa bɛnwu kɛ ɛdawɔ ɛ ngomekye,
mɔɔ wɔ duma a le Ɛdɛnkɛma la a
ɛle Anwuma Anwumanli ne mɔɔ sie azɛlɛ ye a.

Title: EDW 84
Content:
Nyamenle Sua ne anwo anwoalɔlɛ (Kɔla amra mrenya ne mɔ edwɛne)
1O Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma,
Wɔ tɛnlabelɛ ne le kɛnlɛma!
2Me kunlu a anrɛɛ mewɔ ɛkɛ,
me nwo dɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu.
Me ahonle nee me nwonane to edwɛne
anyelielɛ nu maa tease Nyamenle ne.
3Ngɛsanloma bɔbɔ lɛ ye sane,
yɛɛ nyamenleakatiba lɛ ɔ ti anwo sane
mɔɔ ɔfa ɔ mra ɔgua nu,
wɔ wɔ azukponle ne anwo, O Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma,
me Belemgbunli nee me Nyamenle.
4Nyilalɛ ɛha bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛde wɔ sua nu la,
bɛto wɔ ayɛlɛyelɛ edwɛne dahuu.
5Nyilalɛ ɛha bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛfa bɛ ahonle muala
bɛkɔ Zayɔn kɛ bɛkazɛlɛ la.
6Bɛlua Beeka Bɔnza ne anu a,
bɛmaa ɛkɛ ne yɛ nzubula dɔɔnwo;
alumua ezule ne maa nzule gyinlegyinla.
7Bɛnyia anwosesebɛ kpole kpalɛ wɔ bɛ ɛhɔlɛ nu;
bɛbanwu nyamenle ne mɔ Nyamenle ne wɔ Zayɔn.
8O Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle, tie me nzɛlɛlɛ;
O Gyekɔbo Nyamenle, yɛ ɛnzonlɛ tie me.
9O Nyamenle, nea yɛ enyinlike ne;
nea sonla ne mɔɔ wɔkpa nu wɔye ye la.
10Wɔ sua nu ɛkɛ ne kenle ko ɛdɛnlanlɛ le kpalɛ
tɛla kenle apenle wɔ ɛleka gyɛne.
Menwɔhulo kɛ menwɔyɛ anlenkɛ sinzavolɛ
wɔ me Nyamenle ne sua nu
tɛla kɛ menwɔdɛnla amumuyɛma ndanlɛ sua nu.
11Ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle ne le sɛnzɛne nee enyinlike,
ɔdaye a ɔmaa ɛlolɛ nee enililɛ a.
Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛnva debie kpalɛ biala ɛnvea
bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛle tenlenema la.
12O Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma,
nyilalɛ ɛha sonla ne mɔɔ arɛle wɔ wɔ nu la.

Title: EDW 85
Content:
Maanle ne ɛkpazilɛ nwo nzɛlɛlɛ (Kɔla amra mrenya ne mɔ edwɛne)
1Ɛdɛnkɛma, ɛnwunle wɔ azɛlɛ ne anwunvɔne;
ɛmanle Yizilayɛma kpazile bieko.
2Ɛvale wɔ menli ne ɛtane ɛhyɛle bɛ,
na ɛmanle bɛnyianle bɛ ti bɔkɔɔ.
3Ɛmenle wɔ ɛya ne amuala;
ɛgyakyile ɛya biala mɔɔ ɛvale la.
4O yɛ ngoanelielɛ Nyamenle, fa yɛ sie yɛ gyinlabelɛ dɛba ne,
na maa ɛ kunlu ɛdwo yɛ nwo.
5Asoo ɛfa yɛ nwo ɛya dahuu?
Asoo wɔ ɛya ne bawa aha awolɛndoazo muala?
6Maa yɛ nwo ɛyɛ se bieko,
amaa ɛdawɔ ti wɔ menli ne ali fɛlɛko.
7O Ɛdɛnkɛma, kile wɔ ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne yɛ nwo zo,
na maa yɛ wɔ ngoanelielɛ ne.
8Maa mendie mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle ne baha la,
ɔluakɛ ɔbaha anzonudwolɛ edwɛkɛ yeahile ye menli ne,
ɔdaye ye menli ne mɔɔ ɛva bɛ ahonle ɛmaa ye la.
9Nɔhalɛ, ye ngoanelielɛ ne ɛbikye bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsulo ye la,
amaa anyunlunyia aha yɛ maanle ye.
10Ɛhulolɛ kpundii nee nɔhalɛlilɛ bayia;
tenleneyɛlɛ nee anzonudwolɛ bayɛ bɛ nwo atuu.
11Nɔhalɛlilɛ vi aze bafifi,
na tenleneyɛlɛ vi anwuma anlea aze.
12Ɛhɛe, Ɛdɛnkɛma bava mɔɔ le kpalɛ la amaa,
na yɛ azɛlɛ ye bamaa yɛ aleɛ dɔɔnwo.
13Tenleneyɛlɛ bali Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu,
na yeaziezie adenle ne yeamaa ye.

Title: EDW 86
Content:
Moalɛ nwo nzɛlɛlɛ (Devidi nzɛlɛlɛ)
1O Ɛdɛnkɛma, yɛ ɛnzonlɛ tie me, na die me zo,
ɔluakɛ meyɛ anwunvɔne yɛɛ mehyia.
2Die me fi ewule nu, ɔluakɛ mesonle wɔ;
die wɔ sonvolɛ mɔɔ ɛva ɔ rɛle ɛwula wɔ nu la.
3Wɔmɔ a ɛle me Nyamenle a, O Awulae, nwu me anwunvɔne,
ɔluakɛ wɔmɔ yɛɛ mesu mefɛlɛ wɔ alehyenlɛ muala a.
4Maa wɔ sonvolɛ ɛli fɛlɛko,
ɔluakɛ, O Awulae, wɔmɔ yɛɛ mebodo mesɛlɛ wɔ a.
5Ɔluakɛ, O Awulae, ɛle kpalɛ yɛɛ fakyɛ wɔ wɔ afoa,
ɛkile wɔ ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne
wɔ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsu bɛfɛlɛ wɔ la anwo zo.
6O Ɛdɛnkɛma, tie me nzɛlɛlɛ;
tie me modolɛ nzɛlɛlɛ.
7Kenle biala mekɔ ngyegyelɛ nu a mesu mefɛlɛ wɔ,
ɔboalekɛ mefɛlɛ wɔ a ɛdie me zo.
8O Awulae, nyamenle biala nee wɔ ɛnzɛ,
yɛɛ gyima biala ɛndɛla wɔ gyima ne mɔ.
9 Maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti mɔɔ wɔbɔ bɛ la
babɔ bɛ ti aze amaa wɔ, O Awulae,
na bɛaye wɔ duma ne ayɛlɛ.
10Ɔluakɛ ɛle kpole yɛɛ ɛyɛ nwanwane ninyɛne,
ɛ ngomekye ala yɛɛ ɛle Nyamenle a.
11O Ɛdɛnkɛma, kilehile me wɔ adenle ne,
amaa mealua wɔ nɔhalɛ adenle ne anu;
fa me ahonle beta ɛ nwo maa ɔzulo wɔ.
12O Awulae me Nyamenle, mefa me ahonle muala meyɛ wɔ mo,
yɛɛ mebaye wɔ duma ne ayɛlɛ dahuu.
13Ɔluakɛ wɔ ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne mɔɔ ɛlɛ ye me nwo la le kpole;
wɔye me ɛkɛla wɔvi Ɛbolɔ
14O Nyamenle, adubɛnwoma ɛdwazo me nwo zo;
menli amgbamgbanvolɛ kpondɛ ahu me,
bɛndwenle ɛ nwo bɔbɔ.
15Na wɔmɔ, O Awulae, ɛle ɛlolɛ nee anwunvɔnezelɛ Nyamenle,
ɛnva ɛya mgbane mgbane,
yɛɛ ɛhulolɛ kpundii nee nɔhalɛlilɛ ɛyi wɔ tɛkɛɛ.
16Kakyi ɛ nye me nwo zo na nwu me anwunvɔne;
fa wɔ anwosesebɛ ne maa wɔ akɛlɛ,
na die wɔ sonvolɛ raalɛ ne ara nrenya ye.
17Kile me wɔ kpalɛyɛlɛ ne anwo sɛkɛlɛneɛ,
amaa menli mɔɔ kyi me la anwu ye
na bɛ nyunlu agua aze,
ɔboalekɛ wɔmɔ, Ɛdɛnkɛma,
wɔboa me na wɔkyekye me rɛle.

Title: EDW 87
Content:
Gyɛlusalɛm ɛyeyɛlɛ (Kɔla amra mrenya ne mɔ edwɛne)
1Suakpole ne mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma kyekyele la
wɔ boka nwuanzanwuanza ne azo;
2Ɛdɛnkɛma kulo Zayɔn nlenkɛ mgbole ne mɔ
tɛla ɛleka biala mɔɔ wɔ Yizilayɛ la.
3O Nyamenle suakpole,
bɛka ɛ nwo edwɛkɛ ngɛnlɛma ngɛnlɛma.
4Saa meka maanle maanle mɔɔ ze me la a,
meye Yigyibiti nee Babelonia;
nea, Filisitia, Taya, yɛɛ Sudan boka nwo;
bɛse, “Ko ɛhye, bɛwole ye ɛkɛ.”
5Wɔ Zayɔn anwo, bɛbaha ye kɛ,
“Ko ɛhye nee ɛhendeɛ ne, bɛwole bɛ ɛkɛ;”
ɔluakɛ Anwuma Anwumanli ne ɔdaye ɔbamaa yeagyinla.
6Ɛdɛnkɛma kɛlɛ maanle maanle ne mɔ anluma a ɔkɛlɛ kɛ,
“Ko ɛhye, bɛwole ye ɛkɛ.”
7Edwɛndolɛma nee agolezilɛma amuala se,
“Me nyilalɛ kɔsɔɔti vi wɔ ɛkɛ.”

Title: EDW 88
Content:
Moalɛ nwo ɛzunlɛ (Kɔla amra mrenya ne mɔ edwɛne)
1O Ɛdɛnkɛma, me Nyamenle, alehyenlɛ nu mefɛlɛ wɔ kɛ ɛboa me;
aledwolɛ nu noko mesu mefɛlɛ wɔ.
2Maa me nzɛlɛlɛ ɛdwu ɛ nyunlu,
yɛ ɛnzonlɛ tie me ɛzunlɛ.
3Edwɛkɛ dɔɔnwo ɛdo me,
me ngoane ɛbikye Ɛbolɔ.
4Bɛtia me bɛboka bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ nye gyi Ewule Kuma nu la;
mele sonla mɔɔ menlɛ anwosesebɛ.
5Mele kɛ sonla mɔɔ ɛwu na bɛ rɛle ɛvi ye,
mele kɛ sonla mɔɔ bɛhu ye bɛzie ye,
mele kɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ ɛngakye bɛ bieko,
na bɛye bɛ bɛvi wɔ tumi bo la.
6Wɔva me wɔdo Ewule Kuma ne abo lɔ,
ɛleka anu kuloonwu anu awozinli ne anu.
7Wɔ ɛya ne wɔ me nwo zo kpole kpalɛ,
na ye azɛlɛkye ɛbu ɛva me nwo zo.
8Wɔmaa me gɔnwo mɔ ɛkpo me;
wɔmaa me nwo ɛha bɛ ɛzulolɛ.
Meha avinli, mengola menvi ɛsalɛ;
9nyane ngome ɛbɔ me nye.
O Ɛdɛnkɛma, alehyenlɛ biala mesu mefɛlɛ wɔ;
na memaa me sa zo mesɛlɛ wɔ.
10Asoo ɛyɛ nwanwane ninyɛne ɛmaa mɔwuamra?
Asoo bɛ nwomenle dwazo ye wɔ ayɛlɛ?
11Asoo bɛka wɔ ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne anwo edwɛkɛ wɔ ɛbolɔ,
anzɛɛ bɛka wɔ nɔhalɛlilɛ ne anwo edwɛkɛ wɔ Abadɔn?
12Asoo bɛnwu wɔ nwanwane ninyɛne ne mɔ awozinli nu,
anzɛɛ bɛka wɔ ngoanelielɛ moalɛ ne anwo edwɛkɛ
wɔ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ rɛle ɛvi bɛ la maanle nu?
13Na mame, O Ɛdɛnkɛma, mesu mefɛlɛ wɔ;
me nzɛlɛlɛ dwu ɛ nyunlu nwonlomɔ biala.
14O Ɛdɛnkɛma, duzu ati yɛɛ wɔkpo me a?
Duzu ati a wɔva ɛ nye wɔvea me a?
15Ɔvi me ngakula nu, menwu amaneɛ toonwo
asɛɛ mewu bɔbɔ,
wɔ ndeanlɛ ne mɔ ɛmaa mewie debie yɛ.
16Wɔ ɛya ne ɛbo me nwo zo;
wɔ ɛtetalɛ ɛzulolɛ ne bo me nwo zo.
17Alehyenlɛ biala bɛbɔ bɛyia me kɛ azuyilɛ;
bɛbɔ nu bɛba me nwo zo.
18Wɔmaa kulovolɛ nee agɔnwolɛ ɛkpo me;
me manivolɛ ala a le awozinli.

Title: EDW 89
Content:
Maanle ngyegyelɛ nwo edwɛne (Ɛzelanli Yitan edwɛkɛdwɛndolɛ)
1O Ɛdɛnkɛma, mebado wɔ ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne anwo edwɛne dahuu;
mebabɔ wɔ nɔhalɛlilɛ ne nolo meahile awolɛndoazo kɔsɔɔti.
2Ɔluakɛ wɔ ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne wɔ ɛkɛ ne dahuu,
wɔ nɔhalɛlilɛ ne gyi kpundii kɛ anwumaneamra.
3Ɛdawɔ wɔha kɛ, “Me nee me sonla ne mɔɔ
mekpa nu meye ye la ɛyɛ ngyekyeleɛ,
mebɔ me sonvolɛ Devidi ɛwɔkɛ kɛ,
4 ‘Mebamaa ɛ bo zo amra ali belemgbunli dahuu,
na meabɔ wɔ belemgbunlililɛ ne anwo bane
wɔ awolɛndoazo muala anu!’ ”
5O Ɛdɛnkɛma, maa anwumaneamra ɛye wɔ nwanwaneyɛlɛ ne
nee wɔ nɔhalɛlilɛ ne ayɛlɛ wɔ nwuanzanwuanzama avinli.
6Nwane a wɔ anwuma lɔ mɔɔ nee Ɛdɛnkɛma sɛ a?
Nwane a wɔ anwuma amra anu mɔɔ nee Ɛdɛnkɛma sɛ a?
7Ɔle Nyamenle mɔɔ nwuanzanwuanzama ayia ne sulo ye a;
ɔle kpole, ɔ nwo yɛ ɛzulolɛ tɛla bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛbɔ bɛyia ye la.
8O Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle,
O Ɛdɛnkɛma, nwane a le tumivolɛ kɛ ɛdawɔ,
mɔɔ nɔhalɛlilɛ ɛbɔ ɛyia wɔ a?
9Ɛlɛ tumi wɔ nyevile nwo zo;
saa ye azɛlɛkye yɛ begyebegye a ɛmaa bɛgua.
10Ɛbubule nane anwo ɛzulolɛ Releehabe, kɛ debie funli bie,
ɛvale wɔ tumi kpole ne ɛbɔle wɔ kpɔvolɛma asande.
11Anwuma le wɔ ɛdeɛ, azɛlɛ ye noko le wɔ ɛdeɛ;
ewiade nee nuhua ninyɛne muala, ɛdawɔ a ɛbɔle a.
12Ɛdawɔ yɛɛ ɛbɔle sɔlɔ nee nyiakɛ a;
Teebɔ Boka nee Hɛmɔn Boka fa anyelielɛ ye wɔ ayɛlɛ.
13Ɛlɛ tumi kpole;
ɛ nwo yɛ se, wɔ tumi le kpole.
14Tenleneyɛlɛ nee pɛlepɛlelilɛ
le wɔ belemgbunli ebia ne adiabo;
ɛhulolɛ kpundii nee nɔhalɛlilɛ a gyi ɛ nyunlu a.
15O Ɛdɛnkɛma, nyilalɛ ɛha bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛfa edwɛndolɛ bɛtea nu bɛfɛlɛ wɔ,
nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdua wɔ ahunlunyele wienyi ne anu la.
16Nyilalɛ ɛha bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛfa wɔ duma ne bɛtu bɛ nwo,
na bɛyeyɛ wɔ tenleneyɛlɛ ne la.
17Ɔluakɛ wɔmɔ a ɛle bɛ anwosesebɛ a;
wɔ moalɛ zo yɛɛ ɛmaa bɛdi konim a.
18O Ɛdɛnkɛma, ɛdawɔ a ɛyele yɛ pepɛdievolɛ ne ɛmanle yɛ a.
Yizilayɛ Nwuanzanwuanza Ko ne a
manle yɛ yɛ belemgbunli ne a.
Nyamenle ɛwɔkɛ mɔɔ ɔbɔle Devidi
19Mɔmoane, ɛdendɛle ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ nu
ɛhilele wɔ nɔhalɛ sonvolɛ ne na ɛhanle kɛ,
“Mezoa sonla mɔɔ le katakyie la belemgbunli kyɛlɛ,
memaa sonla mɔɔ bɛkpa nu bɛye ye menli ne avinli la ɛyɛ kpole.
20 Menwu me sonvolɛ Devidi;
meva me nwole nwuanzanwuanza ne mekpokpa ye;
21amaa me tumi ne awoa ye nu dahuu,
na yeamaa ye anwosesebɛ.
22Kpɔvolɛ ne ɛnrɛhola ɔ nye zo ta ɛlɛ,
amumuyɛnli ɛnrɛhola ɔ nwo zo konim di.
23Mebabubu ye kpɔvolɛma wɔ ɔ nyunlu,
na meabɔ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkyi ye la meagua.
24Me nɔhalɛlilɛ ne nee me ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne nee ye badɛnla,
na me duma nu yɛɛ ye tumi ne bayɛ kpole a.
25Mebamaa yeanyia nyevile nwo zo tumi,
na yeanyia azule muala anwo zo tumi.
26Ɔbazu yeavɛlɛ me kɛ, ‘Wɔmɔ a ɛle me Ze a;
ɛle me Nyamenle nee me ngoanelielɛ Bodane.’
27 Na mebayɛ ye me ra mɔɔ lumua,
mɔɔ le belemgbunli mɔɔ bo arelemgbunli muala anwo azo
wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo a.
28Mebahile me ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne ɔ nwo zo dahuu,
yɛɛ me ngyekyeleɛ ne bagyinla ɛkɛ ne kpundii amaa ye.
29Mebamaa ye abusua ɛlɔnwɔne ne adɛnla ɛkɛ dahuu,
na ye belemgbunlililɛ adɛnla ɛkɛ ne dahuu kɛ anwumaneamra
30“Na saa ɔ bo zo amra kpo me mɛla ne
na bɛanli me ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔ azo,
31saa bɛtietia me mɛla ne mɔ azo,
na bɛanli me mɛla ne mɔ azo a,
32mebava baka meadua bɛ kakɛ wɔ bɛ mɛladonlɛ ti,
na meava empele meabila bɛ wɔ bɛ ɛtane ti.
33Noko menrɛye me ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne ɔ nwo zo,
yɛɛ mebali nɔhalɛ meamaa ye dahuu.
34Menrɛtulu me ngyekyeleɛ ne,
yɛɛ menrɛhakyi edwɛkɛ mɔɔ vi me nloa anu vindele la.
35“Meva me nwuanzanwuanzayɛlɛ ne mebɔ ɛwɔkɛ;
menrɛbɛlɛbɛla Devidi.
36Ɔ bo zo amra bali belemgbunli dahuu,
ye belemgbunlililɛ bagyinla zo kɛ sɛnzɛne wɔ me nyunlu.
37Ɔbayɛ kɛ siane la yeadɛnla ɛkɛ dahuu;
suzuamgba ala mɔɔ anwomanyunlu wɔ ɛkɛ ne la,
ɔbagyinla ɛkɛ dahuu.”
Belemgbunli ne anwo zo konimlilɛ nwo awolɛyelɛ
38Noko wɔva wɔ belemgbunli ne mɔɔ wɔkpa nu wɔye ye la anwo ɛya,
wɔkpo ye na wɔvuandi ye wɔdo.
39Wɔtulu ngyekyeleɛ ne mɔɔ ɛ nee wɔ sonvolɛ kyekyele la;
wɔdu ye belemgbunli kyɛlɛ ne wɔdo ndɛtɛlɛ nu.
40Wɔbubu ɔ nwo bane kɔsɔɔti wɔgua;
wɔgologolo ye aranemgbole ne mɔ wɔgua.
41Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛse ɛkɛ ne la amuala wua ye;
ye agɔnwolɛma muala sele ye.
42Wɔmaa ye kpɔvolɛma ɛli konim;
wɔmaa ye kpɔvolɛma anye ɛlie.
43Ɛhɛe, wɔmaa ye konle dadeɛ ɛtili,
wɔammaa yeangola konle ne anloa gyinla.
44Wɔlie ye belemgbunli tumi ne ɔ sa nu,
wɔvuandi ye belemgbunli ebia ne wɔdo aze.
45Wɔpɛ ye kpavolɛlilɛ zo;
wɔgua ɔ nyunlu aze.
Ngoanelielɛ nwo nzɛlɛlɛ
46O Ɛdɛnkɛma, kenlenzu? Asoo ɛfa ɛ nye wɔavea yɛ dahuu?
Wɔ ɛya ne sɔ kɛ senle la ahɔdwu kenlenzu?
47O Awulae, kakye kɛ ngoane tendenle si de la,
ɔluakɛ menli mɔɔ wɔbɔ bɛ la kɔsɔɔti bawu.
48Sonla boni a badɛnla aze dahuu na ɔnrɛwu ɛlɛ a?
Nwane a kɛhola kɛlie ye ɛkɛla kɛvi Ɛbolɔ a?
49Awulae, wɔ mɔmoane ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne,
mɔɔ ɛluale zo ɛbɔle Devidi nɔhalɛ ɛwɔkɛ ne la wɔ nienwu?
50O Awulae, kakye kɛ bɛsi bɛbu wɔ sonvolɛ ne sonlamgbane la;
wɔ menli ne anwo ndeanlɛ kɔsɔɔti gua me nwo zo.
51O Ɛdɛnkɛma, yemɔ ala ati, wɔ kpɔvolɛma sele,
bɛgolo wɔ belemgbunli ne mɔɔ wɔkpa nu wɔye ye la anwo
wɔ ɔ gyakɛ biala mɔɔ ɔtu la anwo.
52Ayɛlɛyelɛ ɛha Ɛdɛnkɛma dahuu!
Amen, Amen!

Title: EDW 90
Content:
BULUKU MƆƆ TƆ ZO NNA
(Edwɛndolɛ 90—106)
Nyamenle nee sonla (Mosisi Nzɛlɛlɛ)
1O Ɛdɛnkɛma, wɔmɔ a wɔyɛ yɛ ɛvealeka
wɔ awolɛndoazo kɔsɔɔti anu a.
2Mekɛ mɔɔ ɛkabɔ awoka,
anzɛɛ azɛlɛ ye nee ewiade ye la,
ɔvi tete, mɔɔ kɔdwu mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ,
ɛle Nyamenle.
3Ɛmaa sonla sia kɔ ndɛtɛlɛ nu,
na ɛse ye kɛ, “O sonla ra, sia ɛ nzi!”
4 Ɔluakɛ ɛvolɛ apenle ko le ɛ nye zo
kɛ anoma ala mɔɔ ɛze ɛhɔ,
anzɛɛ nɔɔzo dɔnehwele bie mɔɔ ɛze la.
5Ɛkpoa menli ɛgua; bɛle kɛ ɛlalɛ,
bɛle kɛ mangyee ndile,
6nwonlomɔ ɛnee bɛyɛ dudokoo, bɛ nwo yɛ fɛ;
nɔsolɛ ɛnee bɛkpa, bɛnwoso.
7Ɛfa ɛya a ɛnee ahonle ɛdu;
wɔ ahonle futu a ɛnee yɛwie wu bɔkɔɔ.
8Yɛ ɛtane ne mɔ amuala gua ɛ nyunlu,
yɛ fealera nu ɛtane bɔbɔ ɛ nye gyi nwolɛ.
9Ɛfa ɛya a yɛ ngoane pɛ sinli,
yɛ mekɛ se kɛ ɛnwomenlegulɛ ko.
10Yɛ ngoane mekɛ le ɛvolɛ abulasuu,
saa anwosesebɛ wɔ nu a, abulatwɛ;
noko nuhua le ɛvɛlɛ nee nyane ngome;
ɔngyɛ ɛnee bɛpɛ nu, ɛnee yɛminli.
11Nwane a kɛnwu wɔ ɛya ne kpole,
anzɛɛ wɔ ahonle futu a ɔnrɛzulo wɔ a?
12Yemɔti kilehile yɛ maa yɛnwu yɛ mekɛ,
amaa yɛazukoa nrɛlɛbɛ.
13O Ɛdɛnkɛma, sia bɛla! Kenlenzu?
Nwu wɔ sonvolɛ anwunvɔne.
14Maa wɔ ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne ɛyi yɛ nwonlomɔ biala,
amaa yɛ nye alie na yɛali fɛlɛko yɛ ngoane mekɛ nu.
15Maa yɛ fɛlɛkolilɛ mekɛ ne ɛwa kɛ yɛ nyanelilɛ mekɛ ne,
nee ɛvolɛ dodo mɔɔ yɛnwu amaneɛ la.
16Maa wɔ sonvolɛ ɛnwu wɔ gyima ne,
na ye wɔ tumi kpole ne kile bɛ mra.
17Maa yɛ Awulae yɛ Nyamenle ne
anwunvɔnezelɛ ne ɛrɛla yɛ nwo zo,
na maa yɛ sa anloa gyima ɛyɛ kpalɛ ɛmaa yɛ,
ɛhɛe, maa yɛ sa anloa gyima ɛyɛ kpalɛ.

Title: EDW 91
Content:
Nyamenle le yɛ pepɛdievolɛ
1Sonla mɔɔ vea Anwuma Anwumanli ne anu,
na ɔde Tumivolɛ ne tumi ne abo la,
2kola ka kɛ, “Ɛdɛnkɛma, ɛle me ɛvealeka nee me aranemgbole;
ɛle me Nyamenle mɔɔ me rɛle wɔ wɔ nu a.”
3Ɔluakɛ ɔbaye wɔ yeavi munzuvolɛ ne ɛhane ne
nee ewule nyane kɔsɔɔti anu.
4Ɔbava ɔ ndɛba yeaheda ɛ nwo zo,
ɔ ndɛba abo yɛɛ ɛbavea a;
ye nɔhalɛlilɛ ne le enyinlike nee nwowa.
5Ɛnrɛzulo nɔɔzo anu ɛzulolɛ ne,
anzɛɛ alehyenlɛ nu ɛda ne.
6Ɛnrɛzulo nɔɔzo ewule nyane biala,
anzɛɛ ewia henlema munzule biala.
7Apenle baho adɔ wɔ foa ko,
apenle bulu baho adɔ wɔ fema zo,
noko ɔnrɛbikye wɔ ɛlɛ.
8Ɛ nye ala yɛɛ ɛbava wɔanlea bɛ a,
na wɔanwu kɛ bɛsi bɛtea amumuyɛma la.
9Kɛmɔ wɔva Ɛdɛnkɛma wɔyɛ wɔ ɛvealeka,
na ɛde Anwuma Anwumanli ne nu la,
10munzule ɛnrɛdo wɔ ɛlɛ,
senle ɛnrɛdɔ wɔ sua nu.
11 Ɔluakɛ ɔbamaa ye soanvolɛma anlea ɛ nwo zo,
azinza wɔ wɔ ndenle kɔsɔɔti anu.
12 Bɛbalɛ wɔ bɛ sa zo,
amaa ɛ gyakɛ amkpula bolɛ.
13 Ɛbatietia awenade nee bɔna nwo zo,
ɛbatietia awenade nee nwɔlɛ anwo ɛzulolɛ nwo zo.
14Kɛmɔ ɔbeta me ɛhulolɛ nu la ati, mebalie ye;
mebawowa ye, ɔboalekɛ ɔze me duma.
15Saa ɔfɛlɛ me a, mebalie ye zo;
saa ɔkɔ ngyegyelɛ nu a, mebabikye ye,
mebalie ye na meali ye eni.
16Mebamaa ye ngoane tendenle,
na meamaa yeanwu me ngoanelielɛ ne.

Title: EDW 92
Content:
Ayɛlɛyelɛ edwɛne (Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ne edwɛne)
1Ɔle kpalɛ kɛ yɛkɛyɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma mo,
yɛkɛdo edwɛne yɛkɛye wɔ duma ayɛlɛ, O Anwuma Anwumanli;
2yɛkɛbɔ wɔ ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne nolo nwonlomɔ ne,
na aledwolɛ nu yɛkɛha wɔ nɔhalɛlilɛ ne anwo edwɛkɛ;
3wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛbɔ fulutu nee getaa mgbole,
na bɛlɛbɔ getaa ngyikyi la.
4Ɔluakɛ, O Ɛdɛnkɛma, wɔ gyima ne ɛmaa me nye ɛlie;
ɛ sa anloa gyima ne mɔ maa mefa anyelielɛ meto edwɛne.
5O Ɛdɛnkɛma, wɔ gyima le mgbole!
Wɔ adwenle nu pi!
6Sonla mɔɔ ye adwenle andi la ɛnrɛnwu ye,
sonla mɔɔ le koasea la ɛnrɛde ɛhye abo:
7kɛ amumuyɛma fifi yɛ dudokoo kɛ ndile,
yɛɛ ɛtanema kpazi bɔbɔ ɛdeɛ,
noko awieleɛ ne bɛbazɛkye bɛ bɔkɔɔ,
8na wɔmɔ, Ɛdɛnkɛma, ɛle tumivolɛ dahuu.
9Na nea, O Ɛdɛnkɛma, wɔ kpɔvolɛma,
wɔ kpɔvolɛma ne amuala abo zo baminli;
bɛbabɔ ɛtanema amuala asande.
10Wɔmaa me anwosesebɛ ɛyɛ kɛ ɛnlankɛ nyinli;
wɔkpokpa me nwole fofolɛ.
11Me nye ɛnwu me kpɔvolɛma azedɔlɛ,
me nzo ɛde amumuyɛma ɛzunlɛ.
12Tenlenema bakpazi kɛ mrɛlɛ,
na bɛanyi kɛ Lɛbanɔn sida mbaka.
13Bɛlua bɛ wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma awuke nu,
bɛnyi buzubuzu wɔ Nyamenle alienwo ɛkɛ.
14Bɛyɛ mrelera bɔbɔ a, bɛso ma,
dahuu bɛle duhuduhu yɛɛ nzule wɔ bɛ nu,
15bɛkile kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma di pɛlepɛle;
ɔle me ɛvealeka, yɛɛ ɔnli mɔguazo.

Title: EDW 93
Content:
Nyamenle le Belemgbunli
1Ɛdɛnkɛma di belemgbunli; ɔde ye gunvɛɛnye;
Ɛdɛnkɛma de ye ebia nu, ɔlɛ tumi.
Ɛhɛe, ewiade ɛli munli, bɛnrɛhola ɔ bo tu ɛlɛ;
2wɔ belemgbunlililɛ vi tete;
aloa kabɔ la ɛnee ɛwɔ ɛkɛ.
3O Ɛdɛnkɛma, azuyilɛ ne mɔ ɛha bɛ nwo,
azuyilɛ ne mɔ ɛmaa bɛ ne zo,
azuyilɛ ne mɔ ɛmaa ɛhululɛ ne ɛhɔ anwuma.
4Wɔmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma mɔɔ ɛwɔ anwuma,
ɛle bedevinli ɛtɛla azule dɔɔnwo ɛhululɛ ne mɔ ane,
ɛle bedevinli ɛtɛla nyevile azɛlɛkye.
5Wɔ mɛla ne mɔ di munli;
nwuanzanwuanzayɛlɛ fɛta wɔ sua nu,
O Ɛdɛnkɛma, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ.

Title: EDW 94
Content:
Nyamenle le menli kɔsɔɔti Ndɛnebuavolɛ
1O Ɛdɛnkɛma, nzenralɛ Nyamenle,
wɔmɔ nzenralɛ Nyamenle, kile wɔ tumi!
2O azɛlɛ ye ndɛnebuavolɛ, dwazo;
ma mgbanyizonlema ɛnyia bɛ kyɛfoa!
3O Ɛdɛnkɛma, kenlenzu yɛɛ amumuyɛma
kɛgyakyi bɛ nwo zo ɛmemalɛ a?
4Bɛka mgbole, amumuyɛma ɛhye mɔ,
bɛtu bɛ nwo, bɛmemaa bɛ nwo zo.
5O Ɛdɛnkɛma, bɛfa atisesebɛ bɛsisi wɔ menli ne,
na bɛkile bɛ nyane.
6Bɛku ahunlanvolɛ nee adenduvoma,
na bɛku mɔɔ ɛnlɛ ɔ ze la;
7na bɛaha kɛ, “Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛnnwu ye;
Gyekɔbo Nyamenle ne ɛnnwu ɛhwee.”
8O menli mɔɔ bɛ adwenle ɛmpi a, bɛde ɔ bo!
Ahɔnwɔne, kenlenzu a bɛkɛnwu nrɛlɛbɛ a?
9Ahenle mɔɔ bɔle ɛnzonlɛ la, ɛnde edwɛkɛ ɔ?
Yemɔ mɔɔ ɔbɔle ɛnyelɛ la, ɛnnwu debie ɔ?
10Yemɔ mɔɔ ɔtea maanle maanle la, ɛnrɛdea bɛ ɔ?
Yemɔ a ɔkilehile menli nrɛlɛbɛ a.
11 Ɛdɛnkɛma ze menli adwenle,
ɔze kɛ bɛ adwenle le kɛ ɛnwomenle.
12O Ɛdɛnkɛma, nyilalɛ ɛha sonla ne mɔɔ ɛtea ye,
na ɛfa wɔ mɛla ne ɛkilehile ye,
13kɛ ɛfa wɔazɔ ye wɔ ngyegyelɛ nu,
kɔkpula kɛ bɛkɛpɛ amumuyɛnli ne kuma la.
14Ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma arɛle ɛnrɛvi ye menli;
ɔnrɛkpo menli ne mɔɔ le ɔdaye ye ɛdeɛ la;
15ɔluakɛ pɛlepɛlelilɛ bazia ahɔ tenlenema ɛkɛ,
na bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛle tenlene la bali zolɛ.
16Nwane a dwazo atia amumuyɛma ne amaa me a?
Nwane a gyinla atia ɛtanema amaa me a?
17Saa Ɛdɛnkɛma amboa me a,
anrɛɛ yeangyɛ biala na meahɔ mɔwuamra anu.
18Mɔɔ mendwenlenle nwo kɛ, “Metele” la,
O Ɛdɛnkɛma, wɔ ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne zɔle me.
19Saa adwenleadwenle bo me nwo zo a,
ɛkyekye me rɛle ɛmaa medi fɛlɛko.
20Asoo arelemgbunli atisesebɛ kola nee wɔ yɛ ko,
bɛmɛ mɔɔ bɛfa amumuyɛ adwenle a bɛdi bɛ mɛla la?
21Bɛbɔ kpɔkɛ bɛtia tenlenema ngoane,
na bɛbua mɔɔ ɛnze nwolɛ bie la ewule fɔlɛ.
22Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛyɛ me aranemgbole;
me Nyamenle ne le me ɛvealeka bodane.
23Ɔbamaa bɛ ɛtane abu azia bɛ,
na yeabɔ bɛ bo zo wɔ bɛ amumuyɛ ti;
Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛ Nyamenle ne babɔ bɛ bo zo.

Title: EDW 95
Content:
Ayɛlɛyelɛ edwɛne
1O bɛrɛla, bɛmaa yɛdo edwɛne yɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma;
bɛmaa yɛva anyelielɛ yɛyeyɛ yɛ ngoanelielɛ bodane ne!
2Bɛmaa yɛva moyɛlɛ yɛrɛla ɔ nyunlu;
bɛmaa yɛva anyelielɛ yɛdo ayɛlɛyelɛ edwɛne yɛmaa ye!
3Ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma le Nyamenle kpole,
yɛɛ ɔle Belemgbunli kpole ɔbo nyamenle muala anwo zo.
4Ɔ sa nu yɛɛ ewiade ye buma kɔsɔɔti wɔ a,
yɛɛ awoka ndendenle ne mɔ noko le ye ɛdeɛ.
5Nyevile ne le ye ɛdeɛ, ɔdaye yɛɛ ɔyɛle a;
ɔvale ɔ sa a ɔhyehyɛle azɛlɛ resee ne a.
6O bɛrɛla, bɛmaa yɛbɔ yɛ ti aze yɛzonle ye;
bɛmaa yɛhoto Ɛdɛnkɛma, yɛ Bɔvolɛ ne.
7 Ɔluakɛ ɔle yɛ Nyamenle,
yɛɛ yɛle ye adidileka menli, nee ɔ sa nu mboane.
O anrɛɛ ɛnee ɛnɛ bɛkɛdie ɔ ne!
8 Bɛmmayɛ anzosesebɛ, kɛmɔ bɛyɛle wɔ Mɛleba,
kɛmɔ mekɛ ne anu bɛyɛle wɔ Masa fienemgbole ne anu,
9mɔɔ bɛ nlenya mɔ zɔle me nleanle,
na bɛgyegyele me, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee bɛnwu me gyima la.
10Mengyile awolɛndoazo zɔhane ɛvolɛ abulanla,
na menganle kɛ, “Bɛle menli mɔɔ ɛsolo,
na bɛmbu me ndenle ne mɔ bie a.”
11 Yemɔti menvale ɛya na menganle ndane kɛ,
bɛ gyakɛ ba ɛnrɛtia me ɛnwomenlelielɛ ne anu.

Title: EDW 96
Content:
Nyamenle le Belemgbunli Bedevinli
(1 Edk 16.23-33)
1O bɛdo edwɛne fofolɛ bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma;
ewiade amra, bɛdo edwɛne bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma.
2Bɛdo edwɛne bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma, na bɛyeyɛ ye;
bɛbɔ ye ngoanelielɛ ne nolo alehyenlɛ biala.
3Bɛbɔ ye anyunlunyia ne nolo wɔ maanle maanle avinli,
bɛbɔ ye nwanwane gyima ne mɔ nolo bɛhile menli kɔsɔɔti.
4Ɛdɛnkɛma le bedevinli, yɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛye ye ayɛlɛ kpole;
ɔwɔ kɛ bɛsulo ye bɛtɛla nyamenle kɔsɔɔti.
5Ɔluakɛ maanle maanle nyamenle ne mɔ le mmonle;
Ɛdɛnkɛma a bɔle anwumaneamra a.
6Enililɛ nee tumi ɛbɔ ɛyia ye,
anwosesebɛ nee kɛnlɛma ɛyi ye Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne.
7 O ewiade mbusua kɔsɔɔti, bɛyeyɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma,
bɛyeyɛ ye anyunlunyia nee ye tumi ne.
8Bɛwula Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlunyia mɔɔ fɛta ye;
bɛva azubɔdeɛ bɛrɛlɛ ye,
na bɛrɛla ye Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu.
9Bɛva anwoziezielɛ nwuanzanwuanza bɛzonle Ɛdɛnkɛma;
ewiade amra, bɛzulo ye.
10Bɛha bɛhile maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti kɛ,
“Ɛdɛnkɛma le belemgbunli!
Ɛhɛe, ewiade ye gyi pi, awie ɛnrɛhola ɔ bo tu;
ɔbava pɛlepɛlelilɛ yeabua menli kɔsɔɔti ndɛne.”
11Bɛmaa anwuma amra ɛli fɛlɛko, na ewiade amra anye ɛlie;
bɛmaa nyevile ne nee mɔɔ wɔ nu la amuala ɛhulu;
12bɛmaa azɛlɛ ye nee mɔɔ wɔ zo la amuala ɛli fɛlɛko!
Akee ɛbɔ nu mbaka bava anyelielɛ ado edwɛne
13wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu, ɔluakɛ ɔlɛba,
ɔlɛba yearabua ewiade amra ndɛne.
Ɔbava tenleneyɛlɛ yeabua ewiade amra ndɛne,
ɔbabua menli kɔsɔɔti ndɛne nɔhalɛ nu.

Title: EDW 97
Content:
Nyamenle le Belemgbunli Bedevinli
1Ɛdɛnkɛma le belemgbunli; bɛmaa ewiade amra anye ɛlie;
bɛmaa maanle maanle mɔɔ gua nyevile nloa la ɛli fɛlɛko!
2Amungu nee awozinli kabii ɛbɛnra ɛyia ye;
ye belemgbunli ebia ne adiabo
a le tenleneyɛlɛ nee pɛlepɛlelilɛ.
3Senle tudu di ɔ nyunlu,
na ɔyela ye kpɔvolɛma amuala.
4Ye ɛsɛnlɛmanye ne mɔ kpakye ta ewiade ye wienyi;
ewiade amra nwu ye na bɛ nwo wozo bɛ.
5Awoka kolo kɛ ehuaba wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu,
ewiade ye amuala Awulae ne anyunlu.
6Anwumaneamra bɔ ye tenleneyɛlɛ ne nolo,
yɛɛ menli kɔsɔɔti nwu ye anyunlunyia ne.
7Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsonle ananze la anyunlu ɛgua aze;
bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛfa mmonle bɛtu bɛ nwo la anyunlu ɛgua aze;
nyamenle kɔsɔɔti bɔ bɛ ti aze maa ye.
8Zayɔnoma te na bɛdi fɛlɛko,
yɛɛ Dwudama anye die
wɔ wɔ ndɛnebualɛ ne mɔ ati, O Nyamenle.
9Ɔluakɛ wɔmɔ, Ɛdɛnkɛma, ɛle kpole ɛtɛla ewiade amuala;
ɛle bedevinli ɛtɛla nyamenle kɔsɔɔti.
10Ɛdɛnkɛma kulo bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkyi ɛtane la;
ɔbɔ ɔdaye ye menli ne anwo bane;
ɔdie bɛ ɔfi amumuyɛma asa anu.
11Wienyi ta tenlenema anwo zo,
yɛɛ mɔɔ ahonle nu te la anye die.
12O bɛmɛ tenlenema, Ɛdɛnkɛma ati, bɛli fɛlɛko,
na bɛyɛ ye duma nwuanzanwuanza ne mo.

Title: EDW 98
Content:
Nyamenle le ewiade belemgbunli
1O bɛdo edwɛne fofolɛ bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma,
ɔluakɛ yeyɛ nwanwane ninyɛne!
Yeva ye tumi kpole ne, ye tumi nwuanzanwuanza ne yeli konim.
2Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛmaa ye konimlilɛ ne ɛla ali wienyi;
yemaa maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti ɛnwu ye konimlilɛ ne.
3Yehakye ye ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne
nee ye nɔhalɛlilɛ ne mɔɔ ɔlɛ ye wɔ Yizilayɛma anwo la.
Ewiade amra amuala ɛnwu yɛ Nyamenle ne konimlilɛ ne.
4Ewiade amra, bɛva anyelielɛ bɛyeyɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma;
bɛdo anyelielɛ edwɛne bɛye ye ayɛlɛ!
5Bɛva getaa bɛdo ayɛlɛyelɛ edwɛne bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma,
bɛbɔ getaa na bɛbɔ agole!
6Bɛva aweɛne ndendenle nee ɛweɛne
bɛyeyɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, yɛ Belemgbunli ne anyelielɛ nu.
7Bɛmaa nyevile ne nee mɔɔ wɔ nu la amuala ɛhulu;
ewiade nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ nu la amuala ɛwuluwulu!
8Bɛmaa azuyilɛ ne mɔ ɛbɔ bɛ sa nu;
na awoka ne mɔ ɛbɔ nu ɛdo edwɛne anyelielɛ nu
9ɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma, ɔluakɛ ɔlɛba yearabua ewiade ndɛne.
Ɔbava tenleneyɛlɛ yeazie ewiade,
na yeava pɛlepɛlelilɛ yeabua menli ne ndɛne.

Title: EDW 99
Content:
Nyamenle le Belemgbunli Bedevinli
1 Ɛdɛnkɛma le belemgbunli;
bɛmaa menli ne anwo ɛwozo bɛ.
Ɔde belemgbunli ebia nu wɔ tease abɔdeɛ ne mɔ azo anwuma;
bɛmaa azɛlɛ ɛkpusu!
2Ɛdɛnkɛma le kpole wɔ Zayɔn;
ɔle kpole wɔ maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti anwo zo.
3Maa bɛye wɔ duma ne kpole nee ye ɛzulolɛ ayɛlɛ!
Nyamenle le nwuanzanwuanza.
4Belemgbunli bedevinli, pɛlepɛlelilɛ kulovolɛ,
wɔmaa pɛlepɛlelilɛ ɛlie ebia;
wɔmaa pɛlepɛlelilɛ nee tenleneyɛlɛ ɛra Yizilayɛ.
5Bɛhanvo Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛ Nyamenle ne;
bɛzonle ye wɔ ɔ gyakɛ abo!
Ɔle nwuanzanwuanza.
6Mosisi nee Aalɔn boka ye sɛlɛvolɛma ne,
Samoɛle boka bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛzonlenle ye la.
Bɛdeanle bɛvɛlɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma,
na ɔliele bɛ zo.
7 Ɔdendɛle amungu mpila ne anu ɔhilele bɛ;
bɛlile ye ngyehyɛlɛ nee ye mɛla mɔɔ ɔvale ɔmanle bɛ la azo.
8O Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛ Nyamenle, ɛliele bɛ zo;
ɛyɛle fakyɛ Nyamenle ɛmanle bɛ,
noko akee ɛdeanle bɛ wɔ bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ anwo.
9Bɛhanvo Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛ Nyamenle ne,
bɛzonle ye wɔ ye boka nwuanzanwuanza ne azo;
ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛ Nyamenle ne le nwuanzanwuanza.

Title: EDW 100
Content:
Ayɛlɛyelɛ edwɛne (Moyɛlɛ edwɛne)
1Ewiade amra, bɛva anyelielɛ bɛyeyɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma!
2Bɛva fɛlɛkolilɛ bɛzonle Ɛdɛnkɛma!
Bɛva edwɛndolɛ bɛrɛla ɔ nyunlu!
3Bɛnwu ye kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma le Nyamenle!
Yemɔ yɛɛ ɔbɔle yɛ a, yɛɛ yɛle ye ɛdeɛ;
yɛle ye menli, yɛle ye adidileka mboane.
4Bɛva moyɛlɛ bɛwolo ye nlenkɛ mgbole ne mɔ anu,
bɛva ayɛlɛyelɛ bɛhɔ ye alie ne anwo.
Bɛyɛ ye mo, na bɛye ye duma ne ayɛlɛ!
5 Ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma le kpalɛ;
ye ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne wɔ ɛkɛ ne dahuu,
yɛɛ ye nɔhalɛlilɛ dwu awolɛndoazo muala anwo zo. Gyɛ 33.11

Title: EDW 101
Content:
Belemgbunli ɛwɔkɛbɔlɛ
1Mebado nɔhalɛlilɛ nee pɛlepɛlelilɛ nwo edwɛne;
O Ɛdɛnkɛma, ɛdawɔ yɛɛ mebado meamaa wɔ a.
2Mebalua adenle mɔɔ ngehanleɛ ɛnle nwo la anu;
O, kenlenzu yɛɛ ɛkɛra me nwo a?
Mebava pɛlepɛlelilɛ meadɛnla me sua nu.
3Menrɛva ɛtaneyɛlɛ biala menrɛzie me nyunlu.
Mekyi bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkpo aze la gyima;
me nee bɛ ɛnrɛyɛ debie biala.
4Menrɛbikye adalɛma fee,
yɛɛ me nee ɛtanema ɛnrɛdu.
5Awie biala mɔɔ fea sɛkye ɔ gɔnwo duma la,
mebazɛkye ye.
Sonla mɔɔ tu ɔ nwo, ɔbu ɔ nwo la,
menrɛkponle ye.
6Mebava ɛnyelɛ kpalɛ meanlea
bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdi nɔhalɛ wɔ azɛlɛ ne azo la,
amaa bɛ nee me adɛnla;
sonla mɔɔ dua ndenle mɔɔ ngehanleɛ ɛnle nwolɛ la anu la,
yemɔ yɛɛ ɔbazonle me a.
7Awie biala mɔɔ bɔ adalɛ la
ɛnrɛdɛnla me sua nu ɛkɛ;
awie biala mɔɔ le nabalaba la
ɛnrɛgyinla me nyunlu bieko.
8Alehyenlɛ biala mebazɛkye amumuyɛma
mɔɔ wɔ azɛlɛ ne azo la;
mebavoa amumuyɛma kɔsɔɔti
meaye bɛ meavi Ɛdɛnkɛma suakpole ne azo.

Title: EDW 102
Content:
Kpavolɛ mɔɔ debie ɛlɛgyegye ye la nzɛlɛlɛ
1O Ɛdɛnkɛma, tie me nzɛlɛlɛ;
maa me ɛzunlɛ ɛdwu ɛ nyunlu.
2Mmafa ɛ nye ɛfea me
wɔ me ngyianlɛ mekɛ nu.
Gyele ɛ nzo tie me;
saa mefɛlɛ wɔ a die me zo ndɛndɛ.
3Ɔluakɛ me mekɛ ɛlɛse kɛ esike,
me mbowule nu dɔ kɛ fonlomo.
4Me ahonle ɛde kɛ nya, na yenwoso;
me rɛle fi bɔbɔ kɛ menwɔli aleɛ.
5Me ɛkponlenlɛ ɛyɛ kpole,
mewie nwa bɔkɔɔ.
6Meyɛ kɛ fienemgbole nu ɛkpɔtɛ,
meyɛ kɛ kpadule wɔ suadu zo.
7Meyɛ kɛ anloma mɔɔ ɔ ngome ɔgyi sua ti zo,
meda a menlafe.
8Me kpɔvolɛma twi me nyunlu dahuu,
bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsi me amgbu la
fa me duma yɛ ndonwo wa amonle.
9-10Wɔ ɛya kpole ne ati,
nzonle ɛhakyi me aleɛ.
Me nye monle twi gua me nzule nu,
ɔluakɛ wɔmaa me zo na wɔvuandi me wɔdo.
11Me mekɛ le kɛ nɔsolɛ nu ɛlawolɛ;
menwoso kɛ ndile.
12Na wɔmɔ, O Ɛdɛnkɛma, ɛle belemgbunli dahuu;
wɔ duma ne gyi ɛkɛ maa awolɛndoazo muala.
13Dwazo na nwu Zayɔn anwunvɔne;
mekɛ ɛdwu mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ ɛnwu ye anwunvɔne a;
mekɛ ne mɔɔ ɛhilele la ɛdwu.
14Ɔluakɛ ye awolɛ ne sonle bolɛ maa wɔ sonvolɛma
na ye ɛzɛkyelɛ ne maa bɛdi nyane.
15Maanle maanle bazulo Ɛdɛnkɛma duma ne,
ewiade arelemgbunli kɔsɔɔti bazulo ye anyunlunyia ne.
16Ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma bakyekye Zayɔn,
na yeavinde anyunlunyia nu.
17Ɔbadie bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnlɛ awie la nzɛlɛlɛ,
na ɔnrɛkpo bɛ modolɛ nzɛlɛlɛ.
18Bɛhɛlɛ ɛhye bɛmaa awolɛndoazo mɔɔ bara la,
amaa menli mɔɔ bɛtɛwole bɛ la aye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ kɛ:
19Ɛdɛnkɛma de ye anwuma nwuanzanwuanza lɔ,
ɔbelele ɔ nye ɔnleanle azɛlɛ ye,
20kɛ ɔtie pilizama ɛkponlenlɛ,
na yeatulu bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ nee bɛ ɛlɛkɔ ahunleɛ la;
21amaa menli abɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma duma ne nolo wɔ Zayɔn,
na bɛaye ye ayɛlɛ wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm,
22wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ menli kɛwie yia,
na maanle maanle kɛyia kɛ bɛsonle Ɛdɛnkɛma la.
23Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛmaa meyɛ bɛtɛɛ wɔ me mgbavolɛ nu,
yepɛ me ngoane zo.
24Na menganle kɛ, “O me Nyamenle,
mmaye me zo wɔ me mgbavolɛ nu.
“Wɔmɔ, wɔ ɛvolɛ gyi kpundii,
wɔ awolɛndoazo muala anu.”
25 Mɔmoane yɛɛ ɛwulale azɛlɛ ye adiabo aze a,
yɛɛ anwumaneamra le ɛ sa anloa gyima.
26Bɛ bo zo baminli, noko wɔmɔ, ɛwɔ ɛkɛ ne dahuu;
bɛ muala bɛbatete kɛ adɛladeɛ.
Ɛdi bɛ ngakyile kɛ ɛdanlɛ, na bɛse bɛkɔ,
27noko kɛ ɛde la ala a ɛde a,
wɔ mekɛ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ.
28Wɔ sonvolɛma abo zo amra anwo badɔ bɛ;
bɛ bo zo amra badɛnla ɛ nyunlu kpɔkpɔ.

Title: EDW 103
Content:
Nyamenle ɛhulolɛ ne
1O me ɛkɛla, ye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ;
mɔɔ wɔ me nu la amuala,
bɛye ye duma nwuanzanwuanza ne ayɛlɛ!
2O me ɛkɛla, ye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ,
na mmamaa ɛ rɛle fi ye ahunlunyele ne mɔ.
3Ɔfa wɔ ɛtane ne mɔ amuala ɔkyɛ wɔ,
ɔyɛ wɔ ewule kɔsɔɔti ayile.
4Ɔdie wɔ ngoane ɔfi Ewule Kuma nu,
na ɔkile ye ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne
nee ye anwunvɔnezelɛ ne ɛ nwo zo.
5Ɔmaa wɔ ɛbɛla nu ninyɛne kpalɛ,
wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛde ngoane nu la.
6Ɛdɛnkɛma di pɛlepɛle
na ɔbua mɔɔ bɛlɛsisi ye la benle.
7Ɔlale ye ndenle ne ali wienyi ɔhilele Mosisi,
ɔmanle Yizilayɛma nwunle ye nyɛleɛ ne mɔ.
8 Ɛdɛnkɛma le dovolɛ nee anwunvɔnezelɛnli,
ɛhulolɛ kpundii ɛyi ye, ɔnva ɛya mgbane mgbane.
9Ɔndwi sonla nyunlu dahuu,
yɛɛ ɔnva ɛya ɔnzie ɔ kunlu dahuu.
10Ɔ nee yɛ ɛnli ye kɛmɔ yɛ ɛtane ne mɔ si de la,
yɛɛ ɔnnea yɛ ninyɛndane nwo ɔndua yɛ kakɛ.
11Ɔluakɛ kɛ anwuma nee azɛlɛ avinli si de tendenle nee kpole la,
zɔhane ala yɛɛ ye ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne de
maa menli mɔɔ sulo ye la a.
12Kɛ aduduleɛ nee adɔleɛ avinli si twe la,
zɔhane ala yɛɛ ɔye yɛ ɛtane ne mɔ
ɔmaa yɛ nee bɛ avinli twe a.
13Kɛ selɛ si nwu ɔ mra anwunvɔne la,
zɔhane ala yɛɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma nwu bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsulo ye la anwunvɔne a.
14Ɔluakɛ ɔze kɛ yɛsi yɛde la;
ɔkakye kɛ yɛle ndɛtɛlɛ ala.
15Sonla ɛdeɛ, ye mekɛ le kɛ ndile;
ye ɛkpazilɛ le kɛ ɛbɔ nu ndotolo;
16kɛ anwoma bɔ ye la ɛnee yekpolo,
ɔ bo zo ne ɛnze ye bieko.
17Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne wɔ ɛkɛ dahuu
maa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsulo ye la,
ye tenleneyɛlɛ ne wɔ ɛkɛ maa awolɛndoazo kɔsɔɔti.
18Ɔwɔ ɛkɛ ɔmaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdi ye ngyekyeleɛ ne azo la,
na bɛkakye bɛyɛ mɔɔ ye mɛla ne mɔ se la.
19Ɛdɛnkɛma belemgbunli ebia ne wɔ anwuma,
Ɛdɛnkɛma di debie biala anwo zo belemgbunli.
20Bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ, bɛmɛ Nyamenle soanvolɛma,
bɛmɛ katakyiema mɔɔ yɛ mɔɔ ɔka,
na bɛtie ɔ nloa edwɛkɛ la.
21Bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ, bɛmɛ anwuma ɛlɔnema,
ye sonvolɛma mɔɔ yɛ mɔɔ ɔkpondɛ la.
22Abɔdeɛ biala ɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ,
wɔ ɛleka biala mɔɔ ɔdi belemgbunli la.
O me ɛkɛla, ye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ.

Title: EDW 104
Content:
Bɔvolɛ ne ayɛlɛyelɛ
1O me ɛkɛla, ye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ!
O Ɛdɛnkɛma me Nyamenle, ɛle bedevinli!
Anyunlunyia nee enililɛ ɛyi wɔ tɛkɛɛ;
2ɛfa wienyi ɛkeda kɛ ɛdanlɛ,
wɔdɛlɛ anwomanyunlu nu kɛ ndanlɛ sua,
3wɔzi wɔ sua wɔ anwuma nzule ne mɔ azo.
Wɔva amungu ne mɔ wɔyɛ wɔ ɛkpɔnwɔ ehwili,
na ɛtɛnla anwoma zo ɛkpɔsa.
4 Ɛfa anwoma ne mɔ ɛyɛ wɔ soanvolɛma,
ɛfa senle nee ɛsɛnlɛmanye ɛyɛ wɔ sonvolɛma.
5Ɛdawɔ yɛɛ ɛwulale azɛlɛ ye adiabo ne mɔ a,
amaa bɛangola ye kpusu.
6Ɛvale nzule ɛhedale ye kɛ ɛdanlɛ;
nzule ne mɔ monlanle awoka ne mɔ.
7Ɛdeanle nzule ne mɔ, na bɛnriandile;
bɛdele kɛ ɛ ne ɛlɛkulu, na bɛguale ndwɛlɛ aze.
8Awoka ne mɔ ati vindele, mbɔnza ne mɔ yele bɛ nwo,
na nzule ne mɔ hɔdedale ɛleka mɔɔ ɛhyehyɛle ɛmanle bɛ la.
9Ɛhilele nzule ne mɔ ɛweɛne mɔɔ ɔnle kɛ bɛbɔ bɛtɛla,
amaa bɛangeda azɛlɛ ye azo bieko.
10Ɛmaa nzubula finde mbɔnza ne mɔ anu;
bɛsenze bɛdua awoka ne mɔ avinli,
11bɛmaa ɛbɔ nu nane nyia bie no;
ɛbɔ nu asoaso nyia bie nua bɛ ahonle.
12Nloma yɛ bɛ sane wɔ ɔ nloa mbaka ne mɔ azo;
bɛtɛnla mbaka ngane ne mɔ anu bɛto edwɛne.
13Ɛtɔ ezule ɛfi ɛleka mɔɔ ɛde la ɛdoɔloa awoka ne mɔ;
wɔ nyilalɛ ɛyi azɛlɛ ye tɛkɛɛ.
14Ɛmaa ndile fifi maa nlankɛ,
yɛɛ mbaka fifi maa sonla nyia bie so,
amaa yeanyia aleɛ wɔ azɛlɛ ne azo;
15yeanyia nwanye yeamaa sonla nye alie,
yeanyia nwole yeamaa ɔ nyunlu ada,
na yeanyia aleɛ yeamaa sonla nwo ayɛ se.
16Bɛgugua Ɛdɛnkɛma mbaka ne mɔ azo nzule dɔɔnwo,
Lɛbanɔn sida mbaka mɔɔ ɔdaye ɔluale la.
17Nloma yɛ bɛ sane wɔ zolɛ;
bɔngɔ yɛ ye sua wɔ bolonyia mbaka ne mɔ anu.
18Awoka ndendenle ne mɔ le ɛbɔ nu mbɔnkye ɛdeɛ;
bodane ne mɔ le abotokila ne mɔ ɛvealeka.
19Wɔbɔ siane mɔɔ kile ɛlobɔ ne mɔ;
sɛnzɛne ze mekɛ mɔɔ ɔfa ɔtɔ a.
20Wɔbɔ awozinli, na ɔle aledwolɛ
mɔɔ maa ɛbɔ nu nanemgbole finde a.
21Awenade mralɛ kpo kpondɛ aleɛ,
bɛkpondɛ aleɛ bɛfi Nyamenle ɛkɛ.
22Sɛnzɛne ne tudu a, bɛwolowolo
na bɛkɔdeda bɛ mbɔne nu.
23Sonla kɔ kɔyɛ ye gyima,
ɔyɛ gyima toonwo aledwolɛ.
24O Ɛdɛnkɛma, wɔ gyima ne mɔ zonle!
Ɛvale nrɛlɛbɛ yɛɛ ɛbɔle bɛ muala a;
wɔ abɔdeɛ ɛyi azɛlɛ ye tɛkɛɛ.
25Nyevile ne a la lɔ la, ɔle kpole, ɔle faanwo,
nuhua ninyɛne bo anda,
anyewɔzo ninyɛne ngyikyi nee mgbole.
26 Meli dua nyevile zo.
yɛɛ Lɛveatan, nane anwo ɛzulolɛ ne mɔɔ wɔbɔ la
ɔdaye ɔdi ye nwɔhoa wɔ nuhua.
27Ɛhye mɔ amuala anye la ɛ nwo zo,
kɛ mekɛ dwu a ɛkɛmaa bɛ aleɛ.
28Saa ɛfa ɛmaa bɛ a, bɛboɔboa ɔ nloa;
saa ɛbuke ɛ sa nu a, bɛnyia ninyɛne kpalɛ.
29Saa ɛye ɛ nye ɛfea a, ɛnee bɛ rɛle ɛbɔ,
ɛdie bɛ ɛnwomenle ne a, bɛwu
na bɛsia bɛkɔ ndɛtɛlɛ nu.
30Saa ɛmaa bɛ ɛnwomenle a, bɛlɛ ngoane;
na ɛkakyi azɛlɛ ne anye fofolɛ.
31Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlunyia ne ɛdɛnla ɛkɛ ne dahuu,
Ɛdɛnkɛma anye ɛlie ye gyima nwo.
32Ɔto ɔ nye azɛlɛ ye azo a azɛlɛ ne kpusu,
ɔfa ɔ sa ɔka awoka a bɛkpu esike.
33Mekɛ tendenle mɔɔ mede aze la,
mebado edwɛne meamaa Ɛdɛnkɛma;
mede ngoane nu la,
mebado ayɛlɛyelɛ edwɛne meamaa me Nyamenle.
34Mesɛlɛ kɛ me nzɛlɛlɛ kɛzɔ ɔ nye,
ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ati me nye die.
35Bɛmaa ɛtanema abo ɛdu azɛlɛ ye azo,
na amumuyɛma abo ɛdu bɔkɔɔ!
O me ɛkɛla, ye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ!
Bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ!

Title: EDW 105
Content:
Nyamenle nee ye menli ne
(1 Edk 16.8-22)
1O bɛyɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma mo,
bɛbɔ ye duma ne nolo;
bɛmaa ye nyɛleɛ ɛla ali wɔ maanle maanle avinli.
2Bɛdo edwɛne bɛmaa ye, bɛdo ayɛlɛyelɛ edwɛne bɛmaa ye,
bɛbɔ ye nwanwane gyima ne mɔ amuala nolo.
3Bɛli fɛlɛko wɔ ye duma nwuanzanwuanza ne ati;
bɛmaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsonle Ɛdɛnkɛma la anye ɛlie.
4Bɛkpondɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma nee ye anwosesebɛ ne,
bɛkpondɛ ɔ nyunlu dahuu.
5-6O bɛmɛ ye sonvolɛ Ebileham abo zo amra,
Gyekɔbo abo zo amra, mɔɔ yekpa nu yeye bɛ a,
bɛhakye nwanwane gyima mɔɔ yeli la;
ye nwanwane sɛkɛlɛneɛ nee ye ndɛnebualɛ ne mɔ.
7Yemɔ a ɔle Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛ Nyamenle a;
ye ndɛnebualɛ wɔ ɛkɛ maa ewiade amuala.
8Ɔ rɛle ɛnvi ye ngyekyeleɛ ne ɛlɛ,
awolɛndoazo apenle, ɔ rɛle ɛnvi mɔɔ ɔhanle la.
9 Ye ngyekyeleɛ ne mɔɔ ɔ nee Ebileham kyekyele,
ye ɛwɔkɛ ne mɔɔ ɔhanle ndane ɔbɔle Ayezeke,
10 na ɔmoanle zolɛ kɛ ɔle mɛla ɔmaa Gyekɔbo nee Yizilayɛma,
kɛ ɔle ngyekyeleɛ mɔɔ bɛntulu ye ɛlɛ
11na ɔzele kɛ, “Mebava Keena azɛlɛ ne meamaa bɛ
kɛ ɔle bɛ ɛdeɛ bɔkɔɔ” la, ɔ rɛle ɛnrɛvi.
12Mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee bɛ nwo anzo,
na awie ɛmbu bɛ, bɛle adendulɛma wɔ Keena azɛlɛ zo,
13bɛlɛkpɔsa, bɛvi maanle ko anu bɛkɔ ko anu,
bɛvi belemgbunli ko abo bɛkɔ menli gyɛne nu la,
14yeammaa awie adenle yeammaa yeansisi bɛ;
bɛ ti, ɔdeanle arelemgbunli,
15ɔhanle kɛ, “Awie biala mmafa ɔ sa ka me menli ne
mɔɔ mekpa nu meye bɛ la;
awie biala mmagyegye me kpɔmanvolɛma ne.”
16 Ɔmanle ɛhɔne zile azɛlɛ ne azo,
ɔmanle bɛ aleɛ kɔsɔɔti wiele.
17 Ɔzoanle sonla ɔmanle ɔlumuale bɛ nyunlu,
Dwosefi, mɔɔ bɛdɔnenle ye kɛ kanranli la.
18 Bɛguale ɔ gyakɛ anga,
bɛvale bulalɛ kɛba bɛdole ɔ kɔme,
19hɔdwule kɛ mɔɔ ɔhanle la yɛle zɔhane,
Ɛdɛnkɛma edwɛkɛ ne buale ye benle.
20 Belemgbunli ne manle bɛyele ye efiade ne,
sonla ne mɔɔ sie menli ne la gyakyile ye.
21 Ɔyɛle ye kpanyinli mɔɔ nea ye sua nu ɛkɛ a,
na ɔyɛle ye ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti azo neavolɛ,
22kɛ ɔnlea belemgbunli mbɔlɔba ne mɔ anwo zo,
na ɔdu mgbanyima mɔɔ zua belemgbunli la folɛ.
23 Akee Yizilayɛ rale Yigyibiti,
Gyekɔbo hɔdɛnlanle Yigyibiti azɛlɛ zo.
24 Ɛdɛnkɛma manle ye menli ne wole mralɛ dɔɔnwo,
na bɛ nwo yɛle se dɛlale bɛ kpɔvolɛma ne.
25Ɔmanle kpɔvolɛma ne hyile ye menli ne,
na bɛyɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma sonvolɛma ne asa.
26 Ɛdɛnkɛma zoanle ye sonvolɛ Mosisi,
yɛɛ Aalɔn mɔɔ yekpa nu yeye bɛ la.
27Bɛyɛle nwanwane sɛkɛlɛneɛ wɔ bɛ avinli,
bɛyɛle nwanwane ninyɛne wɔ Yigyibiti azɛlɛ zo.
28 Ɔmanle awozinli rale, na maanle ne anu yɛle kabii,
noko Yigyibitima ne dele ye edwɛkɛ ne anwo atua.
29 Ɔmanle Yigyibitima ne nzule hakyile mogya,
ɔmanle nuhua fɛlɛ muala wule.
30 Bɛ azɛlɛ ne azo yɛle ahɛlɛne ngome,
ahɛlɛne yile bɛ arelemgbunli suakunlu.
31 Ɛdɛnkɛma dendɛle, na nrɛzenra adɔka rale,
na ngokowule vale maanle ne.
32 Ɔmanle ezuawolɛ dɔle,
na ɛsɛnlɛmanye kpakyele maanle ne anu amuala.
33Ɔhunle bɛ vanye nee feege mbaka kɔsɔɔti,
na ɔbubule maanle ne anu mbaka kɔsɔɔti.
34 Ɔdendɛle, na abɛbɛ rale,
abɛbɛ mralɛ mɔɔ awie ɛnze bɛ nloa la
35ralile azɛlɛ ne azo ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti,
na bɛlile bɛ ɛya nu nzoleɛ kɔsɔɔti.
36 Ɔhunle maanle ne anu belamunli mralɛ kɔsɔɔti,
bɛ anwosesebɛ mekɛ nu awolɛ mɔɔ lumua.
37 Akee ɔlile Yizilayɛma ati ɔyele bɛ ɔvile Yigyibiti,
ɔmanle bɛnyianle dwɛtɛ fufule nee ezukoa nvutuke,
ye mbusua ekpunli ekpunli ne mɔ anu ko bɔbɔ andu koti.
38Ɔyɛle Yigyibitima fɛ kɛ Nyamenle menli ne ɛlɛkɔ a,
ɔluakɛ ɛnee bɛ nwo ɛzulolɛ ɛdɔ bɛ nwo zo.
39 Ɛdɛnkɛma manle amungu hedale bɛ nwo zo,
nɔɔzo ɔzɔle senle ɔmanle bɛ wienyi.
40 Bɛbizale, na Ɛdɛnkɛma rɛlɛle bɛ kyelɛwele,
na ɔmanle bɛ anwuma kpanwo molozo.
41 Ɔkpukele bolɛ, na nzule vi nu vindele;
ɔzenle ɛsɛlɛ ne azo kɛ azule.
42Ɔluakɛ ɔhakyele ye ɛwɔkɛ nwuanzanwuanza ne,
yɛɛ ye sonvolɛ Ebileham.
43Yemɔti ɔlile ye menli ne anyunlu anyelielɛ nu,
ɔvale edwɛndolɛ ɔlile ye menli ne
mɔɔ yekpa nu yeye bɛ la ati.
44 Na ɔvale maanle maanle ne mɔ azɛlɛ ne ɔmanle bɛ;
na bɛvale menli ne ɛya avule kɔsɔɔti,
45amaa ye menli ne azie ye ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔ,
na bɛali ye mɛla ne mɔ azo.
Bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ!

Title: EDW 106
Content:
Ɛdɛnkɛma kpalɛ mɔɔ yɛ maa ye menli ne
1 Bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ!
O bɛyɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma mo, ɔluakɛ ɔle kpalɛ;
ye ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne wɔ ɛkɛ ne dahuu. Gyɛ 33.11
2Nwane a kɛhola kɛha ninyɛne mgbole mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛyɛ la,
anzɛɛ kɛhola kɛhile ye ayɛlɛyelɛ muala a?
3Nyilalɛ ɛha bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdi pɛlepɛle,
na bɛbɔ tenlene ɛbɛla mekɛ biala la.
4O Ɛdɛnkɛma, saa ɛyila wɔ menli ne a, kakye me;
saa ɛdie bɛ ngoane a, boa me,
5amaa meanwu wɔ menli ne
mɔɔ wɔkpa nu wɔye bɛ la ɛkpazilɛ;
amaa me nye alie wɔ maanle ne fɛlɛkolilɛ nu,
na me nee wɔ menli ne ali fɛlɛko.
6Yɛ nee yɛ nlenya mɔ yɛyɛ ɛtane;
yɛyɛ ninyɛndane, yɛyɛ amumuyɛ.
7 Yɛ nlenya mɔ wɔ Yigyibiti la,
bɛandwenle wɔ nwanwane gyima ne mɔ anwo;
bɛangakye wɔ ɛhulolɛ kpundii kpole ne
mɔɔ wɔ bɛ nwo zo la,
na bɛdele Anwuma Anwumanli ne anwo atua
wɔ Nyevile Kɔkɔlɛ ne anloa.
8Noko ye duma ne ati, ɔliele bɛ ngoane,
amaa yeamaa ye tumi kpole ne ala ali wienyi.
9 Ɔdeanle Nyevile Kɔkɔlɛ ne, na ɔwele resee;
na ɔvale bɛ ɔpɛle buma ne kɛ bɛlua azɛlɛ resee zo.
10Yemɔti ɔliele bɛ ɔvile kpɔvolɛ ne asa anu,
na ɔliele bɛ ɔvile kpɔvolɛ ne tumi bo.
11Nzule ne vale kpɔvolɛma ne;
ko bɔbɔ anga.
12 Akee bɛliele ye edwɛkɛ ne bɛlile;
bɛdole ye ayɛlɛyelɛ edwɛne.
13Noko yeangyɛ biala yɛɛ bɛ rɛle vile ye gyima ne mɔ a;
bɛangendɛ bɛandie ye folɛdulɛ.
14 Bɛnyianle atiakunluwɔzo ɛtane wɔ fienemgbole ne anu,
na bɛzɔle Nyamenle bɛnleanle wɔ ɛsɛlɛ ne azo;
15ɔvale mɔɔ bɛbizale la ɔmanle bɛ,
na ɔyele ewule ɛzulolɛ bie ɔdole bɛ nwo.
16 Mɔɔ menli mɔɔ wɔ azokoɛleɛ ne la
anye bolole Mosisi nee Aalɔn,
nwuanzanwuanza ko ne mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛye ye la,
17azɛlɛ ne kpukele menle Deetan,
na ɔhedale Abaelam nee ɔ nwo amra anwo zo.
18Eza senle dɔle bɛ avinli;
senle ne yelale amumuyɛma ne hunle bɛ.
19 Bɛyɛle ɛnlankɛ nyinli ananze wɔ Saenae,
na bɛzonlenle ananze ne mɔɔ bɛguale la.
20Bɛvale Nyamenle anyunlunyia ne
bɛmanle ɛnlankɛ mɔɔ di ndile la ananze ne.
21Bɛ rɛle vile Nyamenle bɛ Dievolɛ ne,
mɔɔ ɛyɛ ninyɛne mgbole wɔ Yigyibiti,
22ye nwanwane gyima ne mɔɔ ɔyɛle wɔ Yigyibiti
nee ninyɛne ɛzulolɛ ɛzulolɛ ne mɔ
mɔɔ ɔyɛle bɛ Nyevile Kɔkɔlɛ ne anloa la.
23Yemɔti ɔhanle kɛ ɔbɔ bɛ bo zo,
na Mosisi mɔɔ yekpa nu yeye ye la,
gyinlanle kpundii wɔ ɔ nyunlu,
ɔmanle ɔgyakyile ye ɛya ne, yeanzɛkye bɛ.
24 Akee bɛkpole azɛlɛ kɛnlɛma ne,
bɛanlie ye ɛwɔkɛ ne bɛanli.
25Bɛdendɛle bɛ nzo abo wɔ bɛ ndanlɛ azua ne mɔ anu,
bɛanyɛ tieyɛ bɛammaa Ɛdɛnkɛma.
26Yemɔti ɔmanle ɔ sa zo ɔhanle ndane
kɛ ɔmaa bɛ kɔsɔɔti bɛadɔ fienemgbole ne anu
27 na yeamaa bɛ bo zo amra akponde,
azande ahɔ maanle maanle ne mɔ anu.
28 Akee Nyamenle menli ne zonlenle bozonle Beeyale wɔ Piyɔ,
na bɛlile aleɛ mɔɔ bɛdo bɛmaa mɔwuamra la.
29Bɛvale bɛ nyɛleɛ bɛhanle Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛya,
na ewule nzane dɔle bɛ avinli.
30Na Fenɛhase ragyinlanle kpɔdale bɛ ti,
na ewule nzane ne gyakyile.
31Bɛkakye ye wɔ ɛhye anwo kɛ ɔle tenlenenli,
wɔ awolɛndoazo muala anu.
32 Bɛhanle Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛya wɔ Mɛleba nzubula ne mɔ azo,
bɛmanle bɛ ɛtane ne bule ziale Mosisi;
33ɔluakɛ bɛyɛle bɛmanle ɔdaye ɔvale ɛya,
na ɔdendɛle ɛdendɛlɛ ɛtane.
34 Bɛanzɛkye maanle maanle ne mɔ,
kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma zele bɛ la,
35na bɛ nee bɛ bɔle nu dɛnlanle,
na bɛzukoale bɛyɛle mɔɔ maanle ne anu amra yɛ la.
36Bɛzonlenle bɛ awozonle ne mɔ,
na ɔyɛle ɛhane ɔmanle bɛ.
37 Bɛvale bɛ mra mrenya nee bɛ mra mraalɛ
bɛbɔle azu bɛmanle awozonle.
38 Bɛhanle mogya mɔɔ ɛnze nwolɛ bie la bɛguale,
bɛ mra mrenya nee mraalɛ mogya,
bɛvale bɛbɔle azu bɛmanle Keena awozonle,
na bɛvale mogya bɛzɛkyele azɛlɛ ne.
39Ɛhye ati bɛ nyɛleɛ manle evinli hanle bɛ,
na bɛluale bɛ nyɛleɛ zo
bɛbɔle nyamenlezonlenlɛ nu tuutuu ɛbɛla.
40 Akee Ɛdɛnkɛma vale ye menli ne anwo ɛya,
na ɔkpole ye agyadeɛ.
41Ɔyele bɛ ɔmanle maanle maanle ne mɔ,
yemɔti menli ne mɔɔ kpɔ bɛ la ziele bɛ.
42Bɛ kpɔvolɛma ne sisile bɛ,
na bɛbɛlɛle bɛ aze wɔ bɛ tumi bo.
43Ɔliele bɛ fane dɔɔnwo,
noko bɛbɔle kpɔkɛ bɛdele ɔ nwo atua,
na bɛ ɛtane ti bɛ kpɔvolɛma lile bɛ nwo zo konim.
44Noko akee ɔdele bɛ ɛzunlɛ ne la,
ɔ kunlu yelɛyelale ye wɔ bɛ amaneɛnwunlɛ nwo.
45Bɛ ti, ɔhakyele ye ngyekyeleɛ ne,
na ye ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne ati ɔhakyile ye adwenle.
46Ɔmanle menli mɔɔ hyele bɛ nuokɛ la
zele menli mɔɔ bɛhye bɛ nuokɛ la anwunvɔne.
47 O Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛ Nyamenle, die yɛ,
na boɔboa yɛ nloa fi maanle maanle ne mɔ anu,
amaa yeayɛ wɔ mo,
na yɛali fɛlɛko yeaye wɔ duma nwuanzanwuanza ne ayɛlɛ.
48Ayɛlɛyelɛ ɛha Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne,
ɔvi tete kɔdwu mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ.
Na menli ne amuala ɛha kɛ “Amen!”
Bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ!

Title: EDW 107
Content:
BULUKU MƆƆ TƆ ZO NNU
(Edwɛndolɛ 107—150)
Nyamenle kpalɛyɛlɛ ne ayɛlɛyelɛ
1 O bɛyɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma mo, ɔluakɛ ɔle kpalɛ;
ye ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne wɔ ɛkɛ ne dahuu. 136.1; Gyɛ 33.11
2-3Bɛmaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛlie bɛ la ɛha,
bɛmɛ mɔɔ yelie bɛ yevi bɛ amaneɛnwunlɛ nu,
na yeboɔboa bɛ nloa yevi maanle maanle zo,
ɔvi aduduleɛ nee adɔleɛ,
ɛbɔ nu nee nyevile nu la ɛha ye zɔ.
4Bie mɔ luoluale ɛsɛlɛ zo,
bɛannwu adenle bɛangɔ suakpole biala azo;
5ɛhɔne hunle bɛ, nzuhɔne hunle bɛ,
bɛ nwo yɛle bɛ bɛtɛɛ.
6Bɛzunle bɛvɛlɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma wɔ bɛ amaneɛnwunlɛ nu,
na ɔliele bɛ ɔvile bɛ nyanenwunlɛ nu.
7Ɔvale bɛ ɔluale adenle fɔɔnwo zo,
toonwo bɛdwule suakpole zo na bɛdɛnlanle ɛkɛ.
8Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛyɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma mo wɔ ye ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne ati,
wɔ nwanwane gyima mɔɔ ɔdi ɔmaa menli la ati.
9Ɔluakɛ ɔmaa mɔɔ nzuhɔne ku ye la nzule,
yɛɛ mɔɔ ɛhɔne ku ye la, ɔmaa ye aleɛ.
10Bie mɔ dɛnlanle awozinli nu, arɛlebɔlɛ nu,
pilizama mɔɔ bɛgua bɛ anga na bɛlɛnwu amaneɛ,
11ɔluakɛ bɛde Nyamenle edwɛkɛ ne anwo atua,
na bɛkpo Anwuma Anwumanli ne folɛdulɛ ne.
12Gyima ɛsesebɛ manle bɛ nwo bɛlɛle bɛ;
bɛdule bɛguale, bɛannyia awie amboa bɛ.
13Bɛzunle bɛvɛlɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma wɔ bɛ amaneɛnwunlɛ nu,
na ɔliele bɛ ɔvile bɛ nyanenwunlɛ nu.
14Ɔyele bɛ ɔvile awozinli ne nee arɛlebɔlɛ ne anu,
na ɔbubule bɛ anga ne mɔ.
15Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛyɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma mo wɔ ye ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne ati,
wɔ ye nwanwane gyima mɔɔ ɔdi ɔmaa menli la ati.
16Ɔluakɛ ɔbubu kɔbele nlenkɛ mgbole,
na ɔpepɛ nlenkɛ nzi mbulalɛ nu nwiɔ nwiɔ.
17Bie mɔ ɛtane bɔle bɛ anwonyane,
na bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ manle bɛnwunle nyane dɔɔnwo;
18bɛkpole aleɛ ngakyile biala,
na bɛbikyele ewule anlenkɛ nloa.
19Bɛzunle bɛvɛlɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma wɔ bɛ amaneɛnwunlɛ nu,
na ɔliele bɛ ɔvile bɛ nyanenwunlɛ nu.
20Ɔhanle edwɛkɛ ne, na bɛ nwo zale,
na ɔliele bɛ ɔvile ewule nu.
21Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛyɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma mo
wɔ ye ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne ati,
wɔ ye nwanwane gyima mɔɔ ɔlile
ɔmanle menli ne la ati.
22Bɛbɔ ye moyɛlɛ azu,
na bɛdo anyelielɛ edwɛne bɛha ye nyɛleɛ ne mɔ.
23Bie mɔ vale meli hɔle nyevile zo,
bɛhɔlile gua wɔ azule mgbole zo.
24Bɛnwunle Ɛdɛnkɛma nyɛleɛ ne mɔ,
nee ye nwanwane gyima ne mɔ wɔ buma ne anu.
25Ɔluakɛ ɔdendɛle, na ahumu dwazole
manle nyevile azɛlɛkye bule mgbole.
26Azɛlɛkye ne manle meli ne mɔ zo,
finle bɛ buma ne mɔ anu;
bɛ anwosesebɛ minlinle
manle bɛ nzuzuguazo bɔle bɛ.
27Bɛtotɔle kɛ menli mɔɔ ɛbo nza,
na bɛ nrɛlɛbɛ muala wiele.
28Bɛzunle bɛvɛlɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma wɔ bɛ amaneɛnwunlɛ nu,
na ɔliele bɛ ɔvile bɛ nyanenwunlɛ nu;
29ɔmanle ahumu ne guale,
na azɛlɛkye ne mɔ guale diinyi.
30Bɛlile fɛlɛko, ɔboalekɛ maanle nu ɛgua,
na ɔ nee bɛ hɔdwule ahonle ne mɔɔ bɛlɛkɔ zo la azo.
31Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛyɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma mo wɔ ye ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne ati,
wɔ ye nwanwane gyima mɔɔ ɔdi ɔmaa menli la ati.
32Bɛhanvo ye wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ menli ne kɛyia la,
na bɛye ye ayɛlɛ wɔ mgbanyima ayia ne anu.
33Ɔmaa azule kakyi ɛsɛlɛ,
nzubula kakyi azɛlɛ resee;
34azɛlɛ mɔɔ kye aleɛ la kakyi ngyenle azɛlɛ,
wɔ menli ne ɛtane ne mɔ ati.
35Ɔmaa nzule bu ɛsɛlɛ zo,
azɛlɛ resee kakyi nzubula;
36ɔmaa menli mɔɔ ɛhɔne ku bɛ la tɛnla zolɛ,
na bɛkyekye suakpole bɛtɛnla zolɛ.
37Bɛso ɛya bɛdua aleɛ, bɛyɛ vanye egyinli,
na bɛnyia bɛyɔba dɔɔnwo.
38Ɔyila bɛ, ɔmaa bɛ nwo so dɔɔnwo;
ɔmmaa bɛ nlankɛ anwo ɛnyɛ ekyi.
39Saa bɛdi bɛ nwo zo konim na bɛ nwo yɛ ekyi,
bɛsisi bɛ, bɛnwu amaneɛ, na bɛdi nyane a,
40ɔmaa arelemgbunli mɔɔ sie bɛ la nwu kɛ ɔ nye ɛnlie nwo,
na ɔmaa bɛkpɔsɛkpɔsa ɛsɛlɛ zo.
41Ɔye bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛhyia la nyane nu,
na ɔmaa bɛ nwo so kɛ nyɛmoa.
42Pɛlepɛlema nwu ye na bɛdi fɛlɛko;
na amumuyɛma mua bɛ nloa.
43Mɔɔ ze nrɛlɛbɛ la ɛdwenle ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ anwo;
bɛmaa menli ɛdwenle Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne anwo.

Title: EDW 108
Content:
Moalɛ nwo nzɛlɛlɛ wɔ kpɔvolɛ asa anu
1O Nyamenle, me ahonle gyi kpundii,
me ahonle gyi kpundii!
Mebado edwɛne meaye wɔ ayɛlɛ!
Me ɛkɛla, dwazo!
2Bɛdwazo, getaa mgbole nee ngyikyi!
Mebamaa mangyee ye anu akpudwu!
3O Ɛdɛnkɛma, mebayɛ wɔ mo,
wɔ menli ngakyile kɔsɔɔti avinli,
mebaye wɔ ayɛlɛ wɔ maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti avinli.
4Ɔluakɛ wɔ ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne le kpole tɛla anwuma,
wɔ nɔhalɛlilɛ ne dwu amungu ne mɔ anu lɔ.
5O Nyamenle, maa wɔ kpoleyɛlɛ ne zo anwuma lɔ!
Maa wɔ anyunlunyia ɛda ewiade amuala!
6Amaa wɔalie menli mɔɔ ɛkulo bɛ la ngoane;
bua me, na dua wɔ tumi ne azo boa yɛ.
7Nyamenle ɛbɔ ɛwɔkɛ wɔ ye ɛleka nwuanzanwuanza ne,
ɔse, “Mebahyɛ Hyikɛm anu konimlilɛ nu,
na meahyɛ Sɛko Bɔnza meamaa me menli ne.
8Geleade le me ɛdeɛ; Manasɛ le me ɛdeɛ;
Yifelaem le me bulalɛ kyɛlɛ; Dwuda le me tumi kpɔma;
9Mowabe le me kyɛnze bonkuma;
mefuandi me mgbɔlaboa megua Yidɔm anwo zo;
metea nu konimlilɛ nu wɔ Filisitiama anwo zo.”
10Nwane a kɛva me kɛhɔ suakpole ne
mɔɔ bɛhye nwo la azo a?
Nwane a kɛva me kɛhɔ Yidɔm a?
11O Nyamenle, asoo ɛtɛkpole yɛ ɛ?
O Nyamenle, ɛ nee yɛ ɛlɔnema ne ɛngɔ.
12O boa yɛ maa yɛho yɛtia kpɔvolɛ ne,
ɔluakɛ sonla moalɛ le mgbane.
13Nyamenle wɔ yɛ afoa a yɛbaho yɛadɔ zo;
yemɔ yɛɛ ɔbaha kpɔvolɛma ne yeagua a.

Title: EDW 109
Content:
Amaneɛnwunlɛnli edwɛkɛ
1O me ayɛlɛyelɛ Nyamenle, mmayɛ koonwu!
2Ɔluakɛ amumuyɛma nee adalɛma ɛdwazo me nwo zo,
bɛlɛkeha adalɛ bɛatia me.
3Bɛfa ɛkpɔlɛ edwɛkɛ bɛyia me adenle,
na mgbane gyɛne ne ala bɛteta me.
4Mekulo bɛ, noko bɛmɛ bɛto me ɛzonle,
kanza meyɛ nzɛlɛlɛ memaa bɛ bɔbɔ a,
5bɛfa ɛtane bɛtua me kpalɛyɛlɛ kakɛ,
yɛɛ bɛfa ɛkpɔlɛ bɛtua me ɛhulolɛ kakɛ.
6Ye amumuyɛnli bie maa ɔho ɔtia me kpɔvolɛ ne,
maa awie ɛdo ye ɛzonle ɛva ye ɛhɔ edwɛkɛlilɛ.
7Saa bɛdi ye edwɛkɛ a, maa ɔli fɔlɛ,
na bɛva ye modolɛ ne kɛ ɛtaneyɛlɛ!
8 Maa ye mekɛ ɛyɛ ezinraa;
maa awie ɛza ye ɛlie ɔ nwo ninyɛne.
9Maa ɔ mra ɛyɛ nrisa,
na ɔ ye ɛyɛ kunlanvolɛ.
10Maa ɔ mra ɛluolua nu ɛzɛlɛzɛlɛ,
na bɛvoa bɛ bɛvi bɛ sua bubulera ne anu.
11Maa menli mɔɔ ɔtua bɛ kakɛ la
ɛlie ɔ nwo ninyɛne muala,
na nyɛvolɛ ɛwua ye debie biala.
12Mmamaa awie biala se ye anwunvɔne,
anzɛɛ nwu ɔ mra nrisa ne mɔ anwunvɔne.
13Maa ɔ bo zo ɛbɔ,
na ye duma ɛminli awolɛndoazo nwiɔ ne anu.
14Ɛdɛnkɛma, kakye ɔ ze mɔ ninyɛndane ne mɔ,
yɛɛ mmafa ɔ nli ɛtane ne mɔ ɛkyɛ ye.
15Ɛdɛnkɛma, kakye ye ɛtane ne mɔ dahuu;
na maa ewiade amra arɛle ɛvi ye bɔkɔɔ.
16Ɔluakɛ yeangakye kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ ɔse anwunvɔne;
