ɔyɛle menli mɔɔ ɛhyia nee ɛhyianvolɛma kpɔdekpɔde,
na ɔtinlinle mɔɔ ɛnwu ɔ nyunlu la edwɛkɛ nu
ɔhunle ye.
17Ɔhulole amowa; maa amowa ɛbu ɛzia ye!
Yeangulo nyilalɛ; maa nyilalɛ ɛbɔ ye!
18Ɔvale amowa ɔyɛle ɛdanlɛ ɔhedale,
maa ye amowa ne ɛloa ye tɔfɔɔ kɛ nzule,
na ɔyɛ kɛ nwole ɔdwu ye mbowule nu.
19Maa ɔyɛ kɛ adɛladeɛ mɔɔ ɔwula,
na ɔyɛ kɛ akyeso mɔɔ dahuu ɔkye la!
20Ɛdɛnkɛma, maa ɛhye ɛyɛ me kpɔvolɛma ahatualɛ,
ɔyɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛtendɛ ɛtane bɛtia me la
ahatualɛ.
21Na wɔmɔ, Awulae me Nyamenle,
wɔ duma ne ati, die me ti,
ɔboalekɛ wɔ ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne le kpalɛ, die me!
22Ɔluakɛ mele ehyianli, yɛɛ mehyia,
nyane ɛha me kpole.
23Mewie kɔ kɛ nɔsolɛ nu ɛlawolɛ,
bɛkpɔla me bɛto kɛ abɛbɛ.
24Ɛhɔnehyelɛ ɛmaa me gyakɛ anzi ɛtuto,
me nwonane ɛwie kɔ bɔkɔɔ.
25 Me kpɔvolɛma nwu me a bɛgolo me nwo;
bɛnwu me a bɛkpusu bɛ ti.
26O Ɛdɛnkɛma me Nyamenle, boa me!
Wɔ ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne ati, die me!
27Maa bɛnwu ye kɛ wɔ tumi zo ɔ;
na wɔmɔ, O Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛɛ wɔyɛ a.
28Maa bɛwa me amonle, na wɔmɔ yila me,
maa me kpɔvolɛma anyunlu ɛgua aze,
na wɔ sonvolɛma ɛli fɛlɛko.
29Maa nyiane ɛhu me kpɔvolɛma,
na maa bɛ anyiemgba ɛbɔ bɛ ti.
30Mebava me nloa meayɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma mo kpole kpalɛ;
mebaye ye ayɛlɛ wɔ menli ɛwolaa ne anu.
31Ɔluakɛ ɔdie anwunvɔnenli ne ati,
ɔdie ye ɔfi menli mɔɔ kulo kɛ bɛku ye la asa anu.

Title: EDW 110
Content:
Ɛdɛnkɛma nee ye belemgbunli ne mɔɔ yekpa nu yeye ye la
1 Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me Awulae kɛ,
“Tɛnla me sa fema zo,
kɔkpula kɛ menwɔva wɔ kpɔvolɛma amuala
menwɔwula ɛ gyakɛ abo.” 1 Kɔl 15.25; Ɛfɛ 1.20-22; Kɔlɔ 3.1
2Ɛdɛnkɛma bamaa wɔ belemgbunli kpɔma kpole ne
vi Zayɔn ara. Ɔse,
“Di wɔ kpɔvolɛma anwo zo belemgbunli.”
3Wɔ menli ne mɔ bava bɛ nwo amaa wɔ,
wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛkɛze kɛ ɛdi wɔ ɛlɔnema ati
wɔ boka nwuanzanwuanza ne azo la.
Wɔ mgbavolɛ ne mɔ bara ɛ nwo nwonlomɔ mangyee ne,
kɛ nwonlomɔ ɛbɔlɛ mɔɔ ɛlɛtɔ la.
4 Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛha ndane,
yɛɛ ɔnrɛhakyi ye adwenle ɛlɛ.
Ɔse, “Ɛle sɛlɛvolɛ dahuu,
kɛmɔ Mɛlekezidɛke yɛle la.”
5Awulae gyi wɔ fema zo,
ɔfa ɛya a ɔbabubu arelemgbunli.
6Ɔbadea maanle maanle ne mɔ,
na yeamaa avunli ayiyi bɛ ahonleɛ;
ɔbahu bɛ arelemgbunli
mɔɔ wɔ ewiade amuala la.
7Ɔbanlo adehane nzule ne bie;
yemɔti ɔbakpogya ɔ ti zo.

Title: EDW 111
Content:
Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛyelɛ
1Bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ!
Mebayeye me ahonle nu meayɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma mo,
wɔ fɔɔnwoma avinli, wɔ ayia kpole ne anu.
2Ɛdɛnkɛma gyima ne mɔ le mgbole,
bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ nye die nwolɛ la sukoa.
3Tumi nee enililɛ wɔ ye gyima nu,
yɛɛ ye tenleneyɛlɛ ne wɔ ɛkɛ ne dahuu.
4Ɛdɛnkɛma le dovolɛ nee anwunvɔnezelɛnli,
yemaa bɛhakye ye nwanwane gyima ne mɔ.
5Ɔmaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsulo ye la aleɛ;
ɔkakye ye ngyekyeleɛ ne dahuu.
6Yeva maanle maanle ne mɔ agyadeɛ yemaa ye menli
yehile ye menli ne tumi mɔɔ wɔ ye gyimayɛlɛ nu.
7Ɔyɛ ye debie biala nɔhalɛ nu, ɔle fɔɔnwo;
sonla fa ɔ rɛle wula mɔɔ ɔkɛha la anu a ɔyɛ boɛ.
8Bɛwɔ ɛkɛ ne mekɛ biala,
kɛ bɛyɛ bɛ gyima tenlene nee nɔhalɛ nu.
9Ɛdɛnkɛma liele ye menli ne,
na ɔ nee bɛ yɛle ngyekyeleɛ mɔɔ bɛntulu ye ɛlɛ a.
Ye duma ne le kpole, ɔle nwuanzanwuanza.
10 Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛzulolɛ le nrɛlɛbɛ bo ɛbɔlɛ;
bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛ ndelebɛbo kpalɛ la
a le bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛyɛ tieyɛ la.
Ye ayɛlɛyelɛ wɔ ɛkɛ ne dahuu.

Title: EDW 112
Content:
Sonlakpalɛ anyelielɛ
1Bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ!
Nyilalɛ ɛha sonla ne mɔɔ sulo Ɛdɛnkɛma,
na ɔ nye die ye mɛla ne mɔ anwo la.
2Ɔ bo zo amra bayɛ katakyiema wɔ maanle ne anu;
bɛbayila fɔɔnwonli ne abo zo amra.
3Ezukoa nee anwonyia wɔ ye sua nu;
ye tenleneyɛlɛ ne wɔ ɛkɛ ne dahuu.
4Wienyi kpa menli mɔɔ di boɛ la awozinli,
Ɛdɛnkɛma le dovolɛ, anwunvɔnezelɛnli nee tenlenenli.
5Ɔyɛ boɛ ɔmaa sonla mɔɔ buke ɔ sa nu bɔ bosea,
na ɔyɛ debie biala nɔhalɛ nu la.
6Ɔluakɛ pɛlepɛlenli ne abo zo ɛnrɛminli ɛlɛ;
bɛbahakye ye dahuu.
7Tenlenenli ɛnzulo amaneɛ ɛtane,
ɔgyinla kpundii na ɔfa ɔ rɛle ɔwula Ɛdɛnkɛma anu.
8Ye ahonle gyi pi, ɔnzulo,
kɔkpula kɛ ɔkɛli ye kpɔvolɛma anwo zo konim.
9 Yebuke ɔ sa nu wɔ ɛhyianvolɛma anwo zo;
ye tenleneyɛlɛ ne wɔ ɛkɛ ne dahuu;
bɛbava enililɛ bɛakpogya ye tumi ne zo.
10Amumuyɛnli nwu ye na ɔfa ɛya;
ɔdedɛ ɔ nwo bonrane nu na ɔminliminli,
amumuyɛnli adwenle yɛ mgbane.

Title: EDW 113
Content:
Ɛdɛnkɛma kpalɛyɛlɛ ne ayɛlɛyelɛ
1Bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ!
O Ɛdɛnkɛma sonvolɛma, bɛye ye ayɛlɛ,
bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma duma ne ayɛlɛ.
2Ayɛlɛyelɛ ɛha Ɛdɛnkɛma duma ne,
ɛnɛ nee dahuu!
3Ɔvi sɛnzɛne ne aduduleɛ kɔdwu ye adɔleɛ,
bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma duma ne ayɛlɛ!
4Ɛdɛnkɛma le kpole bo maanle maanle ne mɔ azo,
ye anyunlunyia wɔ anwuma tɛla anwumaneamra.
5Nwane a le kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛ Nyamenle ne,
mɔɔ de ye ebia nu wɔ anwuma lɔ,
6na ɔto ɔ nye aze
ɔnea anwumaneamra nee ewiade a?
7Ɔye ehyianli ɔfi ndɛtɛlɛ nu,
na ɔkpogya mɔɔ ɛhyia la zo ɔfi nzonle nu,
8ɔmaa bɛ nee arelemgbunli tɛnla,
ɔdaye ye menli ne arelemgbunli.
9Ɔmaa mɔɔ anwo ralɛ la nyia awuke,
ɔyɛ ngakula dɔɔnwo bɛ nli anyelielɛ nu.
Bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ!

Title: EDW 114
Content:
Akpabɛnwo Ɛvoyia edwɛne
1 Mekɛ mɔɔ Yizilayɛma vile Yigyibiti,
Gyekɔbo abo zo amra vile nyɛvolɛ avinli la,
2Dwuda maanzinli ne yɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛleka nwuanzanwuanza,
Yizilayɛ yɛle ye maanle.
3 Nyevile Kɔkɔlɛ ne nleanle na ɔnriandile;
Dwɔdan ne hwenle ziale.
4Awoka wuluwulule kɛ mboane nyinli,
awoka ngyikyi wuluwulule kɛ mboane mralɛ.
5O Nyevile, duzu a yɛle wɔ mɔɔ ɛnriandile a?
O Dwɔdan, duzu ati a ɛhwenle ɛziale a?
6O awoka, duzu ati a bɛwuluwulule kɛ mboane nyinli a?
O awoka ngyikyi, duzu ati a bɛwuluwulule kɛ mboane mralɛ a?
7O azɛlɛ, Ɛdɛnkɛma ye ɔ nyunlu a, kpusu,
saa Gyekɔbo Nyamenle ne ye ɔ nyunlu a, kpusu.
8 Yemɔ yɛɛ ɔmaa bodane yɛ azule tandane,
na ɛtwɛlɛboɔ yɛ nzubula a.

Title: EDW 115
Content:
Nɔhalɛ Nyamenle ko ne
1Tɛ yɛmɛ, O Ɛdɛnkɛma, tɛ yɛmɛ,
na wɔmɔ yɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ anyunlunyia ka wɔ,
wɔ wɔ ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne nee wɔ nɔhalɛlilɛ ne ati a.
2Duzu ati a maanle maanle ne mɔ kɛbiza kɛ,
“Bɛ Nyamenle ne wɔ nienwu” a?
3Yɛ Nyamenle ne wɔ anwuma;
ɔyɛ debie biala mɔɔ ɔdaye ɔkulo la.
4 Bɛ mmonle ne mɔ le dwɛtɛ fufule nee ezukoa nvutuke,
bɛle menli asa anloa gyima.
5Bɛlɛ ɛnloanlɛ, noko bɛndendɛ;
bɛlɛ ɛnyelɛ, noko bɛnnwu debie.
6Bɛlɛ ɛnzonlɛ, noko bɛnde edwɛkɛ;
bɛlɛ ɛbonyilɛ, noko bɛnde nvoanle.
7Bɛlɛ ɛsalɛ, noko bɛnva bɛnvua debie;
bɛlɛ egyakɛ, noko bɛndia;
yɛɛ bɛnlɛ ɛnelɛ bɛnva bɛnyɛ alɛra.
8Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛyɛ mmonle la le kɛ mmonle ne mɔ
ala la,
zɔhane ala yɛɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ rɛle wɔ bɛ nu la de a.
9O Yizilayɛma, bɛva bɛ rɛle bɛwula Ɛdɛnkɛma anu!
Ɔle bɛ boavolɛ nee bɛ enyinlike.
10O Aalɔn sua nu amra,
bɛva bɛ rɛle bɛwula Ɛdɛnkɛma anu!
Ɔle bɛ boavolɛ nee bɛ enyinlike.
11Bɛmɛ mɔɔ bɛsulo Ɛdɛnkɛma,
bɛva bɛ rɛle bɛwula ye nu!
Ɔle bɛ boavolɛ nee bɛ enyinlike.
12Ɛdɛnkɛma dwenle yɛ nwo, ɔbayila yɛ;
ɔbayila Yizilayɛma amuala;
ɔbayila Aalɔn sua nu amra;
13 ɔbayila bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsulo Ɛdɛnkɛma la,
mgbolema nee koahweabanema amuala.
14Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛmaa bɛwo dɔɔnwo,
bɛdabɛ nee bɛ bo zo amra amuala.
15Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛyila bɛ,
yemɔ mɔɔ ɔbɔle anwuma nee aze.
16Anwuma lɔ le Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛdeɛ,
yɛɛ yeva azɛlɛ ye yemaa menli.
17Mɔwuamra ɛnye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ,
zɔhane ala yɛɛ mɔɔ kɛhɔ monvonle la de a.
18Na yɛmɛ, yɛbaye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ,
ɛnɛ nee dahuu.
Bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ!

Title: EDW 116
Content:
Sonla mɔɔ bɛlie ye bɛvi ewule nu la ye Nyamenle ayɛlɛ
1Mekulo Ɛdɛnkɛma, ɔboalekɛ yede me ne
nee me modolɛ nzɛlɛlɛ.
2Kɛmɔ ɔyɛle ɛnzonlɛ ɔdiele me la ati,
mebavɛlɛ ye wɔ mekɛ tendenle mɔɔ mede ngoane nu la.
3Ewule ngane lile me bɔyia;
Ɛbolɔ mbowule sosɔle me;
menwunle nyane nee abodelɛ.
4Na menvɛlɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma kɛ,
“O Ɛdɛnkɛma, mebodo wɔ, die me!”
5Ɛdɛnkɛma le dovolɛ, ɔle pɛlepɛlenli;
yɛ Nyamenle ne se anwunvɔne.
6Ɛdɛnkɛma bɔ mɔɔ ɛnze nwolɛ bie la anwo bane,
bɛholole me nwo zo la, ɔliele me.
7O me ɛkɛla, sia balie wɔ ɛnwomenle,
ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛyɛ wɔ boɛ.
8Kɛmɔ wɔlie me ɛkɛla wɔvi ewule nu,
wɔkyikyi me nye anwo monle,
na meandu koti la ati,
9medua Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu,
wɔ teasema azɛlɛ zo.
10 Menzɔle me diedi nu boɛ, bɔbɔ mɔɔ menganle kɛ,
“Menwu amaneɛ kpole” la;
11menvale ewugyemu menganle kɛ,
“Anyelazo wɔ menli kɔsɔɔti anu le mgbane”
12Duzu yɛɛ menva memaa Ɛdɛnkɛma,
wɔ ye ahyɛlɛdeɛ ɛwolaa ye anwo a?
13Mebamaa ngoanelielɛ kɔpo ne zo,
na meabɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma duma meazonle ye.
14Mebaye me ɛwɔkɛ biala mɔɔ mebɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma la,
wɔ ye menli ne kɔsɔɔti anyunlu.
15Nyamenle menli ne ewule le debie kɛnlɛma
wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anye zo.
16O Ɛdɛnkɛma, mele wɔ sonvolɛ;
mele wɔ sonvolɛ, wɔ sonvolɛ raalɛ ara nrenya.
Wɔzianyi me nwɔnzɔnwɔnzɔ ne.
17Mebabɔ moyɛlɛ azu meamaa wɔ,
na meabɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma duma meazonle ye.
18Mebaye me ɛwɔkɛ biala mɔɔ mebɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma la,
wɔ ye menli ne kɔsɔɔti anyunlu.
19Mebaye ɛwɔkɛ ne wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne
mɔɔ wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm la anu.
Bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ!

Title: EDW 117
Content:
Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛyelɛ
1 Maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti, bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ!
Menli ngakyile kɔsɔɔti, bɛyeyɛ ye!
2Ɔluakɛ ye ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne
mɔɔ ɔlɛ ye yɛ nwo la le kpole;
yɛɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma nɔhalɛlilɛ ne wɔ ɛkɛ ne dahuu.
Bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ.

Title: EDW 118
Content:
Konimlilɛ nwo moyɛlɛ nzɛlɛlɛ
1 O bɛyɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma mo, ɔluakɛ ɔle kpalɛ;
ye ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne wɔ ɛkɛ dahuu. 136.1; Gyɛ 33.11
2Bɛmaa Yizilayɛma ɛha kɛ,
“Ye ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne wɔ ɛkɛ dahuu.”
3Bɛmaa Aalɔn abo zo amra ɛha kɛ,
“Ye ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne wɔ ɛkɛ dahuu.”
4Bɛmaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsulo Ɛdɛnkɛma la ɛha kɛ,
“Ye ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne wɔ ɛkɛ dahuu.”
5Menvɛlɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma wɔ me nyanenwunlɛ nu;
Ɛdɛnkɛma buale me na ɔyele me kɔme kpomgbolo.
6 Ɛdɛnkɛma wɔ me afoa, menzulo.
Duzu a sonla kɛhola kɛyɛ me a?
7Ɛdɛnkɛma gyi me nzi kɛ ɔboa me,
mebali bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkpɔ me la anwo zo konim.
8Ɔle kpalɛ kɛ sonla kɛvea Ɛdɛnkɛma akɛnra anu,
tɛla kɛ ɔkɛva ɔ rɛle ɔkɛwula dasanli nu.
9Ɔle kpalɛ kɛ sonla kɛvea Ɛdɛnkɛma akɛnra anu,
tɛla kɛ ɔkɛva ɔ rɛle ɔkɛwula arelemgbunli nu.
10Maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti bɔle yiale me;
Ɛdɛnkɛma duma nu, menganle bɛ menguale.
11Bɛbɔle bɛyiale me, bɛbɔle bɛyiale me wɔ adenle biala anu;
Ɛdɛnkɛma duma nu, menganle bɛ menguale.
12Bɛvɔle me kɛ wolɛ,
na bɛyelale kɛ senle yela mbowule la;
Ɛdɛnkɛma duma nu, menganle bɛ menguale.
13Bɛtiale me kpole kpalɛ, asɛɛ mendɔle aze,
noko Ɛdɛnkɛma boale me.
14 Ɛdɛnkɛma le me anwosesebɛ, me konimlilɛ edwɛne,
yelie me ngoane.
15Bɛdie, bɛlɛto konimlilɛ edwɛne fɛlɛkolilɛ nu
wɔ tenlenema ndanlɛ sua ne anu:
“Ɛdɛnkɛma tumi kpole ne ɛli gyima ne,
16Ɛdɛnkɛma tumi kpole ne ɛli konim,
Ɛdɛnkɛma tumi kpole ne ɛli gyima ne!”
17Menrɛwu, mebadɛnla ngoane nu,
na meabɔ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛyɛ la nolo.
18Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛhwi me nyunlu kpole kpalɛ,
noko ɔtɛyele me ɔtɛmanle ewule.
19Bɛbuke tenleneyɛlɛ nlenkɛ mgbole ne mɔ bɛmaa me,
amaa mealua nuhua meawolo,
na meayɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma mo.
20Ɛdɛnkɛma anlenkɛ kpole ne ɛne;
tenlenema balua nu awolo.
21Meyɛ wɔ mo kɛ wɔbua me,
na wɔlie me ngoane a.
22 Bolɛ ne mɔɔ suasivoma ne kpole la
ɛyɛ mgbɛnezo bolɛ mɔɔ anwo hyia a.
23Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛɛ ɛyɛ ɛhye a;
yɛnea a ɔyɛ nwanwane.
24Ɛdɛnkɛma kenle ne mɔɔ ɛhyehyɛ la ɛne;
bɛmaa yɛlie yɛ nye na yɛli fɛlɛko.
25 O Ɛdɛnkɛma, yɛbodo wɔ, die yɛ!
O Ɛdɛnkɛma, yɛbodo wɔ, maa yɛli konim.
26 Nyilalɛ ɛha sonla ne mɔɔ dua Ɛdɛnkɛma duma nu wolo la!
Yɛlɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma Sua nu nyilalɛ yɛyila wɔ.
27Ɛdɛnkɛma le Nyamenle,
yɛɛ yemaa yɛ wienyi.
Bɛva mbaka ngane bɛdo ɛlɔnwɔne bɛbɔ ɛvoyialilɛ ne abo,
na bɛbɔ azukponle ne mgbɔlɔka.
28Ɛle me Nyamenle, mebayɛ wɔ mo;
ɛle me Nyamenle, mebayeyɛ wɔ.
29O bɛyɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma mo, ɔluakɛ ɔle kpalɛ;
ye ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne wɔ ɛkɛ dahuu.

Title: EDW 119
Content:
Ɛdɛnkɛma mɛla ne
1Nyilalɛ ɛha bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ ndenle nu ɛnlɛ ngehanleɛ,
na bɛbɔ bɛ ɛbɛla kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma mɛla ne de la.
2Nyilalɛ ɛha bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdi ye ngyehyɛlɛ zo,
na bɛfa bɛ ahonle muala bɛkpondɛ ɔ bo zo,
3bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnyɛ ɛtane biala,
na bɛdua ye ndenle ne mɔ anu la.
4Wɔva wɔ mɛla ne mɔ wɔmaa yɛ
kɛ yɛli zolɛ kpalɛ.
5O anrɛɛ me ndenle adenrɛ fɔɔnwo
wɔ me Nyamenle ne mɛlalilɛ zo.
6Akee me nyunlu ɛnrɛgua aze ko,
kɛmɔ me nye wɔ wɔ mɛla ne mɔ azo la.
7Mebava ahonle mɔɔ nuhua te la meaye wɔ ayɛlɛ,
mekɛ mɔɔ menwɔzukoa wɔ tenleneyɛlɛ mɛla ne mɔ la.
8Mebali wɔ mɛla ne mɔ azo;
O mmakpo me bɔkɔɔ.
Ɛdɛnkɛma mɛla ne anwo tieyɛ
9Kɛ ɔkɛyɛ na kpavolɛ adenle nu ayɛ bɔkɔbɔkɔ ɛ?
Kyesɛ ɔdua wɔ edwɛkɛ zo ɔsinza ɔ nwo.
10Mebuke me ahonle nu mekpondɛ wɔ;
mmamaa metwe me nwo mefi wɔ mɛla ne mɔ anwo.
11Meva wɔ edwɛkɛ ne mezie me ahonle nu,
amaa meanyɛ ɛtane meantia wɔ.
12O Ɛdɛnkɛma, ayɛlɛyelɛ ɛha wɔ;
kilehile me wɔ mɛla ne mɔ.
13Mebabɔ wɔ mɛla ne mɔ mɔɔ wɔhyehyɛ la nolo.
14Me nye die wɔ ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔ anwo
kɛmɔ me nye die anwonyia nwo la.
15Mebadwenledwenle wɔ mɛla ne mɔ anwo,
na meamaa me nye agyinla wɔ ndenle ne mɔ anwo.
16Me nye balie wɔ mɛla ne mɔ anwo;
me rɛle ɛnrɛvi wɔ edwɛkɛ ne.
Nyamenle mɛla ne anwo fɛlɛkolilɛ
17Ɛ nee wɔ sonvolɛ ɛli ye kɛnlɛma,
amaa meanyia ngoane, na meali wɔ edwɛkɛ zo.
18Buke me nye, amaa meanwu
nwanwane ninyɛne mɔɔ wɔ wɔ mɛla ne anu la.
19Mele ɛyɛvolɛ wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo;
mmafa wɔ mɛla ne mɔ ɛfea me.
20Me ɛkɛla anwo dɔ wɔ mɛla ne mɔ mekɛ biala.
21Ɛtea mgbanyizonlema, munzuvoma ne
mɔɔ twe bɛ nwo fi wɔ mɛla ne mɔ anwo la.
22Ye bɛ ndeanlɛ ne fi me nwo zo,
ɔluakɛ meli wɔ ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔ azo.
23Arelemgbunli kɔ me nwo akpamo bɔbɔ ɛdeɛ,
noko wɔ sonvolɛ badwenledwenle wɔ mɛla ne mɔ anwo.
24Wɔ ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔ a le me anyelielɛ a,
bɛmɛ a bɛtu me folɛ a.
Ɛdɛnkɛma mɛla ne tieyɛ nwo pi ɛzilɛ
25Medɔ aze; asɛɛ mewu,
kɛmɔ wɔ edwɛkɛ ne se la, maa me anwosesebɛ.
26Menganle me edwɛkɛ la, ɛbuale me;
kilehile me wɔ mɛla ne mɔ!
27Maa mende wɔ mɛla ne mɔ abo,
na mebadwenledwenle wɔ nwanwane gyima ne mɔ anwo.
28Nyane ngome maa me ɛkɛla minli me nwo,
wɔ edwɛkɛ ne ati, maa me anwosesebɛ!
29Ye me fi ndenle ɛtane ɛtane nu,
na ɛlolɛ nu ala kilehile me wɔ mɛla ne.
30Meva nɔhalɛ adenle ne,
meva wɔ mɛla ne mɔ mezie me nyunlu.
31O Ɛdɛnkɛma, mehisa wɔ ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔ kyengye;
mmamaa me nyunlu gua aze ɛlɛ.
32Mebanriandi meava wɔ mɛla ne mɔ adenle zo,
saa ɛmaa me ndelebɛbo yɛ kpole a.
Ndelebɛbo nwo nzɛlɛlɛ
33O Ɛdɛnkɛma, kilehile me wɔ mɛla ne mɔ ndenle,
na mebalua nu meahɔ awieleɛ.
34Maa me ndelebɛbo, amaa meava wɔ mɛla ne meazie,
na meava me ahonle muala meali zo.
35Fa me dua wɔ mɛla adenle ne anu,
ɔluakɛ me nye die nwolɛ.
36Maa me ahonle ɛbikye wɔ ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔ
ɛdɛla kɛ menwɔnyia me nwo.
37Ye me nye fi ninyɛne mgbane mgbane nwo,
na maa me ngoane wɔ wɔ ndenle ne mɔ anu.
38Wɔ ɛwɔkɛ ne mɔɔ wɔbɔ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsulo wɔ la,
moa zolɛ maa wɔ sonvolɛ.
39Ye me fi ndeanlɛ ne mɔɔ mesulo ye la anu,
ɔluakɛ wɔ mɛla ne mɔ le kpalɛ.
40Nea, me nwo ɛlɛdɔ wɔ mɛla ne mɔ;
maa me ngoane wɔ wɔ tenleneyɛlɛ ne ati.
Fa ɛ rɛle wula Ɛdɛnkɛma mɛla ne anu
41O Ɛdɛnkɛma, maa wɔ ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne ɛdwu me nwo zo,
maa wɔ ngoanelielɛ ne ɛrɛla, kɛmɔ wɔ ɛwɔkɛ ne se la,
42amaa meahola meabua bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛtwi me nyunlu la,
ɔluakɛ me rɛle wɔ wɔ edwɛkɛ ne anu.
43Mmaye nɔhalɛ edwɛkɛ ɛfi me nloa,
ɔluakɛ melɛ anyelazo wɔ wɔ mɛla ne mɔ anu.
44Mebali wɔ mɛla ne azo dahuu,
wɔ melɛ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ,
45na me nwo badɔ me wɔ me ɛlualɛ nu,
ɔluakɛ meli wɔ mɛla ne azo.
46Mebabɔ wɔ mɛla ne mɔ nolo meahile arelemgbunli,
menrɛze nwolɛ nyiane,
47ɔluakɛ me nye die wɔ mɛla ne mɔ anwo;
mekulo wɔ mɛla ne mɔ.
48Medi wɔ mɛla ne mɔ eni, mekulo bɛ;
mebadwenledwenle wɔ mɛla ne mɔ anwo.
Fa ɛ rɛle wula Ɛdɛnkɛma mɛla ne anu
49Kakye wɔ ɛwɔkɛ ne mɔɔ wɔbɔ wɔ sonvolɛ,
mɔɔ ɔlua zo wɔmaa menyia anyelazo la.
50Ɛhye le me arɛlekyekyelɛ wɔ me amaneɛnwunlɛ nu,
ɔluakɛ wɔ ɛwɔkɛ ne maa me ngoane.
51Menli mɔɔ ɛnze Nyamenle la si me amgbu kpole,
noko mendwe me nwo menvi wɔ mɛla ne anwo ɛlɛ.
52Saa medwenle wɔ mɛla ne mɔɔ vi tete la anwo a,
O Ɛdɛnkɛma, ɛnee me rɛle ɛkyekye.
53Ɛya ku me kpole kpalɛ,
wɔ amumuyɛma mɔɔ kpo wɔ mɛla ne la ati.
54Meva wɔ mɛla ne mɔ meyɛ me edwɛne
wɔ me ɛbɛlabɔlɛ adendulɛ nu.
55O Ɛdɛnkɛma, aledwolɛ nu mekakye wɔ duma,
na medi wɔ mɛla ne azo.
56Nyilalɛ ɛhye ɛyɛ me ɛdeɛ,
ɔluakɛ meli wɔ mɛla ne mɔ azo.
Tu ɛ nwo maa Ɛdɛnkɛma mɛla ne
57Ɛdɛnkɛma le me kyɛfoa;
mebɔ ɛwɔkɛ kɛ mebali wɔ mɛla ne mɔ azo.
58Meyeye me ahonle nu mebiza wɔ moalɛ;
wɔ ɛwɔkɛ ne ati, nwu me anwunvɔne.
59Saa medwenle wɔ ndenle ne mɔ anwo a,
mekakyi me nye meba wɔ mɛla ne mɔ anwo.
60Meka me nwo, mensisi aze
kɛ menwɔli wɔ mɛla ne mɔ azo.
61Amumuyɛma nyɛma ɛkyekye me bɔbɔ ɛdeɛ,
me rɛle ɛnvi wɔ mɛla ne.
62Medwazo alevinli mu nwiɔ avinli meye wɔ ayɛlɛ,
wɔ wɔ mɛla tenlene ne mɔ ati.
63Me nee menli mɔɔ sulo wɔ la a tu a;
bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdi wɔ mɛla zo la a me nee bɛ tu a.
64O Ɛdɛnkɛma, wɔ ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne ɛyi azɛlɛ ye tɛkɛɛ;
kilehile me wɔ mɛla ne mɔ.
Bolɛ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma mɛla ne sonle la
65O Ɛdɛnkɛma, ɛ nee wɔ sonvolɛ ɛli ye boɛ,
kɛmɔ wɔ edwɛkɛ ne se la.
66Maa me nrɛlɛbɛ nee adwenlenubukelɛ,
ɔluakɛ medie wɔ mɛla ne mɔ medi.
67Menvonle adenle la yɛɛ menwunle me nyunlu a,
na kɛkala medi wɔ edwɛkɛ zo.
68Ɛle kpalɛ yɛɛ ɛyɛ kpalɛ;
kilehile me wɔ mɛla ne mɔ.
69Adubɛnwoma bɔ me nwo nzekue,
na mame, mefa me ahonle muala medi wɔ mɛla ne mɔ azo.
70Bɛ ahonle ɛlafe tuanwu kɛ nane ɛnlome,
na mame, me nye die wɔ mɛla ne mɔ anwo.
71Ɔle kpalɛ kɛ menwunle me nyunlu a,
amaa meazukoa wɔ mɛla ne mɔ.
72Wɔ mɛla ne mɔ le kpalɛ maa me
tɛla ezukoa nvutuke nee dwɛtɛ fufule apenle apenle.
Ɛdɛnkɛma mɛla ne pɛlepɛlelilɛ
73Ɛdawɔ yɛɛ wɔbɔ me na wɔziezie me a;
maa me ndelebɛbo, amaa meazukoa wɔ mɛla ne mɔ.
74Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsulo wɔ la banwu me na bɛ nye alie,
ɔboalekɛ menyia anyelazo wɔ wɔ edwɛkɛ ne anu.
75O Ɛdɛnkɛma, meze kɛ wɔ ndɛnebualɛ ne mɔ le fɔɔnwo,
na wɔdea me nɔhalɛ nu.
76Maa wɔ ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne ɛkyekye me rɛle,
kɛmɔ wɔ ɛwɔkɛ ne mɔɔ wɔbɔ wɔ sonvolɛ ne la de la.
77Nwu me anwunvɔne, amaa meanyia ngoane,
ɔluakɛ me nye die wɔ mɛla ne anwo.
78Maa adubɛnwoma anyunlu ɛgua aze,
ɔboalekɛ bɛva adalɛ bɛli me ɛwɔne;
na mame, mebadwenledwenle wɔ mɛla ne mɔ anwo.
79Maa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsulo wɔ la ɛrɛla me ɛkɛ,
amaa bɛanwu wɔ mɛla ne mɔ.
80Mmamaa medi fɔlɛ wɔ wɔ mɛla ne mɔ anwo,
amaa me nyunlu angua aze.
Ngoanelielɛ nwo nzɛlɛlɛ
81Me ɛkɛla anwo dɔ wɔ ngoanelielɛ;
melɛ anyelazo wɔ wɔ edwɛkɛ ne anu.
82Mehendɛ wɔ ɛwɔkɛ ne toonwo akee me nye ɛbu,
mebiza kɛ, “Kenlenzu yɛɛ ɛkɛkyekye me rɛle a?”
83Ɔluakɛ meyɛ kɛ nwanye nwoma kodoku mɔɔ la senle nu,
noko me rɛle ɛtɛfile wɔ mɛla ne mɔ.
84Wɔ sonvolɛ, mengendɛ mengɔndwu kenlenzu?
Kenlenzu a ɛkɛdea menli mɔɔ yɛ me kpɔdekpɔde la a?
85Adubɛnwoma ɛpɛ me nwo kuma,
menli mɔɔ ɛnli wɔ mɛla zo la.
86Wɔ mɛla ne amuala gyi kpundii;
bɛfa adalɛ bɛyɛ me kpɔdekpɔde; boa me!
87Asɛɛ bɛhu me ala ɛne,
noko metɛkpole wɔ mɛla ne mɔ.
88Wɔ ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne ati, die me ngoane,
amaa meali wɔ mɛla ne mɔ azo.
Ɛdɛnkɛma mɛla ne azo ɛlilɛ
89O Ɛdɛnkɛma, wɔ edwɛkɛ ne gyi kpundii
wɔ anwuma lɔ dahuu.
90Wɔ nɔhalɛ ne wɔ ɛkɛ maa awolɛndoazo muala;
ɛdawɔ a wɔbɔ ewiade ye a, yɛɛ ɔgyi kpundii.
91Kɛ ɛzile ɛhyehyɛle bɛ la yɛɛ ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti tɛde ɛnɛ a,
ɔluakɛ ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti le wɔ sonvolɛma.
92Saa me nye anlie wɔ mɛla ne mɔ anwo a,
anrɛɛ menwule wɔ me anwubɛnyunlu nu.
93Me rɛle ɛnrɛvi wɔ mɛla ne mɔ,
ɔluakɛ ɔlua bɛ nwo zo wɔmaa me ngoane.
94Mele wɔ ɛdeɛ, die me;
ɔluakɛ mebɔ mɔdenle kɛ medi wɔ mɛla ne azo.
95Amumuyɛma ɛhɔ nzia kɛ bɛku me,
na mame, medwenle wɔ mɛla ne mɔ anwo.
96Menwu ɛleka mɔɔ kpalɛ biala ɔwɔ kɛ dwu la,
noko wɔ mɛla ne mɔ tɛlɛ bo zolɛ.
Ɛdɛnkɛma mɛla ne ɛhulolɛ
97O, mekulo wɔ mɛla ne somaa!
Medwenledwenle nwolɛ alehyenlɛ biala.
98Wɔ mɛla ne maa menwu nrɛlɛbɛ metɛla me kpɔvolɛma,
ɔluakɛ ɔwɔ me nu dahuu.
99Melɛ ndelebɛbo metɛla me kilehilevolɛma amuala,
ɔluakɛ wɔ mɛla ne mɔ ala a medwenledwenle nwolɛ a.
100Melɛ ndelebɛbo metɛla mgbanyinli,
ɔluakɛ medi wɔ mɛla ne mɔ azo.
101Metwe me nwo mefi munzule adenle biala anu,
amaa meahola meali wɔ edwɛkɛ zo.
102Mendwe me nwo menvi wɔ mɛla ne mɔ anwo,
ɔluakɛ ɛdawɔ yɛɛ wɔhilehile me a.
103Wɔ edwɛkɛ ne yɛ me fɛ somaa,
ɔyɛ fɛ ɔtɛla wolɛ.
104Medua wɔ mɛla ne mɔ azo menyia ndelebɛbo,
yemɔti mekyi adalɛ adenle biala.
Wienyi mɔɔ vi Ɛdɛnkɛma mɛla ne anu
105Wɔ edwɛkɛ ne le kɛnlaneɛ maa me,
ɔle wienyi wɔ me adenle nu.
106Meha ndane na memoa zolɛ
kɛ menwɔli wɔ pɛlepɛle mɛla ne mɔ azo.
107Menwu amaneɛ kpole;
O Ɛdɛnkɛma, maa me ngoane, kɛmɔ wɔ edwɛkɛ se la.
108O Ɛdɛnkɛma, die me moyɛlɛ azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ,
na kilehile me wɔ mɛla ne mɔ.
109Me ahonle la me sa nu dahuu,
noko me rɛle ɛnvi wɔ mɛla ne mɔ.
110Amumuyɛma ɛzua me ɛhane,
noko mendwe me nwo menvi wɔ mɛla ne mɔ anwo.
111Wɔ mɛla ne mɔ le me agyadeɛ dahuu;
ɛhɛe, me ahonle la nwo.
112Meyeye me ahonle nu kɛ meyɛ mɔɔ wɔ mɛla ne se la,
wɔ melɛ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ.
Ɛdɛnkɛma mɛla ne bɔ sonla nwo bane
113Mekyi menli mɔɔ bɛ adwenle le nwiɔ nwiɔ la,
na mekulo wɔ mɛla ne.
114Ɛle me ɛvealeka nee me enyinlike;
melɛ anyelazo wɔ wɔ edwɛkɛ ne anu.
115Bɛmɛ ɛtaneyɛlɛma, bɛhwe bɛ nwo bɛvi me nwo ɛke,
amaa meali me Nyamenle ne mɛla ne mɔ azo.
116Maa me anwosesebɛ, kɛmɔ wɔ ɛwɔkɛ ne se la,
amaa meanyia ngoane;
mmamaa me anyelazo wie anyiemgba nu.
117Sɔ me nu, amaa me nwo ayɛ kɔlɔnwo,
na meali wɔ mɛla ne azo dahuu.
118Ɛkyi awie biala mɔɔ kpo wɔ mɛla ne la;
ɛhɛe, bɛ nrɛlɛbɛ adwenle biala le mgbane.
119Ɛbu ewiade ye amumuyɛma kɛ ewula,
yemɔti mekulo wɔ mɛla ne mɔ.
120Wɔ ɛzulolɛ ti me nwo wozo me,
yɛɛ mesulo wɔ ndɛnebualɛ ne mɔ.
Ɛdɛnkɛma mɛla ne anwo tieyɛ
121Meyɛ mɔɔ le pɛlepɛle na ɔtenrɛ la,
mmagyakyi me ɛmaa menli mɔɔ sisi me la.
122Die wɔ sonvolɛ ati dahuu;
mmamaa adubɛnwoma sisi me.
123Mehendɛ wɔ ngoanelielɛ ne
nee wɔ tenlene ɛwɔkɛ ne toonwo me nye ɛbu.
124Ɛ nee wɔ sonvolɛ ɛli kɛmɔ wɔ ɛhulolɛ
kpundii ne de la,
na kilehile me wɔ mɛla ne mɔ.
125Mele wɔ sonvolɛ; maa me ndelebɛbo,
amaa meanwu wɔ mɛla ne mɔ!
126Mekɛ ɛdwu mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma keha ɔ nwo a,
ɔluakɛ bɛtietia wɔ mɛla ne mɔ azo.
127Yemɔti mekulo wɔ mɛla ne mɔ metɛla ezukoa nvutuke,
metɛla nvutuke kpalɛ mɔɔ bɛdu nu la.
128Kɛmɔ wɔ mɛla ne mɔ le fɔɔnwo la ati,
mekyi adalɛ adenle biala.
Ɛdɛnkɛma mɛla ne anwo tieyɛ nwo ɛhulolɛ
129Wɔ mɛla ne mɔ yɛ nwanwane;
yemɔti mefa me ahonle muala medi zolɛ.
130Wɔ edwɛkɛ ne anu ngilehilelɛ maa wienyi;
ɔmaa mɔɔ ɛnze nwolɛ bie la nyia ndelebɛbo.
131Kɛmɔ me nwo dɔ wɔ mɛla ne mɔ somaa la ati,
me ɛnwomenle bɔbɔ ɛndɔ me kunlu.
132Kakyi ɛ nye me nwo na nwu me anwunvɔne,
kɛmɔ ɛyɛ ɛmaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkulo wɔ la.
133Wɔ ɛwɔkɛ ne ati, mmamaa mekpo aze,
yɛɛ mmamaa ɛtane di me nwo zo konim.
134Die me fi menli mɔɔ sisi me la asa anu,
amaa meali wɔ mɛla ne mɔ azo.
135Maa ɛ nyunlu ɛda wɔ sonvolɛ anwo zo,
na kilehile me wɔ mɛla ne mɔ.
136Me nye monle twi bobobobo,
ɔboalekɛ menli ɛnli wɔ mɛla ne mɔ azo. b
Ɛdɛnkɛma mɛla ne pɛlepɛlelilɛ
137O Ɛdɛnkɛma, ɛle tenlenenli,
yɛɛ wɔ ndɛnebualɛ le fɔɔnwo.
138Wɔhyehyɛ wɔ mɛla ne mɔ tenlene
nee nɔhalɛ adenle zo.
139Me nwo yelɛyela me kɛ senle,
ɔboalekɛ me kpɔvolɛma arɛle fi wɔ edwɛkɛ ne.
140Mezɔ wɔ ɛwɔkɛ ne menlea ye kpalɛ,
na wɔ sonvolɛ mekulo ye somaa.
141Mele ekyi, menli ɛmbu me,
noko me rɛle ɛnvi wɔ mɛla ne mɔ.
142Wɔ tenleneyɛlɛ le fɔɔnwo dahuu,
yɛɛ wɔ mɛla ne le nɔhalɛ.
143Melɛnwu amaneɛ nee nyane ɛdeɛ,
noko me nye die wɔ mɛla ne mɔ anwo.
144Wɔ mɛla ne mɔ le fɔɔnwo dahuu;
maa me ndelebɛbo, amaa meanyia ngoane.
Ngoanelielɛ nwo nzɛlɛlɛ
145Mefa me ahonle muala mesu mefɛlɛ wɔ;
O Ɛdɛnkɛma, bua me!
Mebali wɔ mɛla ne mɔ azo.
146Mesu mefɛlɛ wɔ; die me,
amaa meali wɔ mɛla ne mɔ azo.
147Medwazo aleɛbahye na mesu mefɛlɛ wɔ kɛ ɛboa me;
me anyelazo wɔ wɔ edwɛkɛ ne anu.
148Aledwolɛ muala me nye gyi zo,
amaa meadwenledwenle wɔ ɛwɔkɛ ne anwo.
149Wɔ ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne ati, tie me ne;
O Ɛdɛnkɛma, dua wɔ pɛlepɛleyɛlɛ ne azo die me ngoane.
150Menli mɔɔ fa adwenle ɛtane yɛ me kpɔdekpɔde la ɛbikye;
bɛnze wɔ mɛla ne fee.
151Na wɔmɔ, O Ɛdɛnkɛma, ɛbikye me,
yɛɛ wɔ mɛla ne mɔ le nɔhalɛ.
152Menwu wɔ mɛla ne mɔ anu dɛbadɛba,
kɛ wɔhyehyɛ wɔdo ɛkɛ melɛ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ.
Moalɛ nwo modolɛ
153Nea me anwubɛnyunlu na die me,
ɔluakɛ me rɛle ɛnvi wɔ mɛla ne.
154Die me ti na kpɔne me;
wɔ ɛwɔkɛ ne ati, maa me ngoane.
155Amumuyɛma ɛnrɛnyia ngoanelielɛ,
ɔluakɛ bɛmkpo wɔ mɛla ne mɔ abo zo.
156O Ɛdɛnkɛma, wɔ anwunvɔnezelɛ le kpole;
wɔ pɛlepɛlelilɛ ti, maa me ngoane.
157Me kpɔvolɛma nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛyɛ me
kpɔdekpɔde la zonle,
noko menvi wɔ mɛla ne mɔ anwo memkpɔkye me nwo.
158Menea bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnlɛ diedi la a me nwo yelɛyela me,
ɔboalekɛ bɛnli wɔ mɛla ne mɔ azo.
159Nea kɛ mesi mekulo wɔ mɛla ne mɔ la!
Wɔ ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne ati, bɔ me ngoane nwo bane.
160Wɔ edwɛkɛ ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti le kpɔkɛ ko, yemɔ a le
nɔhalɛ;
yɛɛ wɔ tenlene mɛla ne mɔ wɔ ɛkɛ ne dahuu.
Ɛdɛnkɛma mɛla ne anwo tunwomaa
161Mgbane gyɛne ala arelemgbunli yɛ me kpɔdekpɔde,
noko me ahonle tu wɔ wɔ edwɛkɛ ne ati.
162Wɔ edwɛkɛ ne maa me nye die
kɛ sonla mɔɔ ɛnyia anwonyia la.
163Mekyi yɛɛ mengulo adalɛ,
na mekulo wɔ mɛla ne.
164Meye wɔ ayɛlɛ fane nsuu kenle ko
wɔ wɔ tenlene mɛla ne mɔ ati.
165Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkulo wɔ mɛla ne la lɛ anzonudwolɛ kpole;
debie biala ɛngola ɛmmaa bɛndu koti.
166O Ɛdɛnkɛma, me nye la wɔ ngoanelielɛ ne azo,
na meyɛ mɔɔ wɔ mɛla ne mɔ se la.
167Medi wɔ mɛla ne mɔ azo;
mekulo bɛ somaa!
168Medi wɔ mɛla nee wɔ ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔ azo,
ɔluakɛ me ndenle muala la ɛ nyunlu.
Moalɛ nwo nzɛlɛlɛ
169O Ɛdɛnkɛma, maa me ɛzunlɛ ɛdwu ɛ nyunlu;
ɛ nloa edwɛkɛ ti, maa me ndelebɛbo.
170Maa me modolɛ ɛzunlɛ ɛdwu ɛ nyunlu;
ɛ nloa edwɛkɛ ti, die me.
171Mebaye wɔ ayɛlɛ
kɛ ɛkilehile me wɔ mɛla ne mɔ a.
172Mebado wɔ edwɛkɛ ne anwo edwɛne,
ɔluakɛ wɔ mɛla ne amuala le fɔɔnwo.
173Fa wɔ tumi ne boa me,
ɔluakɛ menlea nu meva wɔ mɛla ne mɔ.
174O Ɛdɛnkɛma, me nwo dɔ wɔ ngoanelielɛ ne,
me anyelielɛ a le wɔ mɛla ne.
175Maa me ngoane, amaa meaye wɔ ayɛlɛ,
na maa wɔ mɛla ne mɔ ɛboa me.
176Meminli kɛ boane; kpondɛ wɔ sonvolɛ abo zo,
ɔluakɛ me rɛle ɛnvi wɔ mɛla ne mɔ.

Title: EDW 120
Content:
Moalɛ nwo nzɛlɛlɛ
1Me anwongyelelɛ nu mesu mefɛlɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma,
amaa yeabua me;
2O Ɛdɛnkɛma, die me
fi adalɛma nee mɛlɛbɛlama asa anu.
3Duzu yɛɛ bɛva bɛmaa wɔ a?
Yɛɛ duzu bieko yɛɛ bɛyɛ wɔ a,
wɔmɔ nabalabanli?
4Kyesɛ ɛlɔnenli ɛda mbaka nlane,
nee baka ɛsesebɛ emunlike mɔɔ ɛdɔlɔ woonwu la.
5Abule ɛbu me kɛ mekɔ Mihyɛke,
na metɛnla Kidaa ndanlɛ sua nu a!
6Medɛnla bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkyi anzonudwolɛ la
sua nu mehyɛ somaa.
7Mekulo anzonudwolɛ,
noko meka anzonudwolɛ nwo edwɛkɛ a,
ɛnee yeyɛ konle.

Title: EDW 121
Content:
Ɛdɛnkɛma wowa yɛ
1Memaa me nye zo menea awoka ne mɔ.
Nienwu yɛɛ me moalɛ vi ba a?
2Me moalɛ vi Ɛdɛnkɛma,
mɔɔ bɔle anwuma nee aze la.
3Ɔnrɛmaa ɛ gyakɛ ɛnrɛhoati,
mɔɔ sinza wɔ la ɛnrɛbɔ ngɔsɔkɛ.
4Bɛnlea, mɔɔ sinza Yizilayɛ la
ɛnrɛbɔ ngɔsɔkɛ yɛɛ ɔnrɛlafe.
5Ɛdɛnkɛma le wɔ sinzavolɛ;
Ɛdɛnkɛma keda ɛ nwo zo,
na ɔmaa wɔ anwosesebɛ.
6Sɛnzɛne ne ɛnrɛyela wɔ alehyenlɛ nu,
yɛɛ siane ne ɛnrɛyela wɔ aledwolɛ nu.
7Ɛdɛnkɛma bazinza wɔ wɔ munzule muala anu;
ɔbamaa ɛ nwo ayɛ kɔlɔnwo.
8Ɛdɛnkɛma bazinza wɔ
wɔ wɔ ɛhɔlɛ nee wɔ ɛralɛ nu
ɔvi ɛnɛ nee mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ.

Title: EDW 122
Content:
Gyɛlusalɛm ɛhanvolɛ
1Ɔyɛle me fɛ, mekɛ mɔɔ bɛhanle bɛhilele me kɛ,
“Maa yɛhɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Sua nu!”
2O Gyɛlusalɛm, yɛra!
Yɛgyi wɔ nlenkɛ mgbole ne mɔ anloa.
3Gyɛlusalɛm mɔɔ bɛkyekye ye suakpole
na ɔle kpondekponde.
4Ɛkɛ ne a mbusua ekpunli ekpunli ne mɔ,
Ɛdɛnkɛma mbusua ekpunli ne mɔ kɔ,
kɛ bɛkayɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma mo,
kɛmɔ bɛhyehyɛ bɛmaa Yizilayɛma la.
5Ɛkɛ ne yɛɛ bɛzieziele arelemgbunli ndɛnebualɛ mbia ne mɔ a,
Devidi abusua ɛlɔnwɔne arelemgbunli mbia ne mɔ.
6Bɛzɛlɛ anzonudwolɛ bɛmaa Gyɛlusalɛm!
“Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkulo wɔ la ɛkpazi!
7Anzonudwolɛ ɛyi wɔ tɛkɛɛ,
na anwondɔlɛ ɛyi wɔ tawa ne mɔ.”
8Me mediema nee me gɔnwo mɔ ati,
mebaha kɛ, “Anzonudwolɛ ɛyi wɔ tɛkɛɛ!”
9Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛ Nyamenle ne sua ne ati,
mebazuzu wɔ boɛ.

Title: EDW 123
Content:
Anwunvɔnezelɛ nwo nzɛlɛlɛ
1O wɔmɔ mɔɔ ɛde wɔ belemgbunli ebia nu wɔ anwuma,
wɔmɔ yɛɛ memaa me nye zo menea wɔ a.
2Kɛmɔ sonvolɛma anye gyi bɛ menle asa anu,
yɛɛ kɛmɔ sonvolɛ raalɛ anye la ɔ menle anwo zo la,
zɔhane ala yɛɛ yɛ nye la Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛ Nyamenle ne anwo zo,
kɔkpula kɛ ɔkɛnwu yɛ anwunvɔne la.
3Nwu yɛ anwunvɔne, O Ɛdɛnkɛma, nwu yɛ anwunvɔne,
ɔluakɛ yɛnwu akpule yɛhyɛ.
4Yɛ ɛkɛla ɛli nyane ɛhyɛ
wɔ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛde boɛ la amgbuzilɛ,
nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛmemaa bɛ nwo zo la akpule ti.

Title: EDW 124
Content:
Nyamenle bɔ ye menli ne anwo bane
1Saa tɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma mɔɔ ɛnee gyi yɛ nzi la a,
bɛmaa Yizilayɛma ɛha!
2Saa tɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma mɔɔ ɛnee gyi yɛ nzi la a,
anrɛɛ mɔɔ menli dwazole yɛ nwo zo,
3na bɛvale yɛ nwo ɛya la,
anrɛɛ bɛziele yɛ anyewɔzo.
4Anrɛɛ azuyilɛ ne pianle yɛ hɔle,
anrɛɛ azule ne monlanle yɛ,
5anrɛɛ azule ne ɛzenlɛ kpole ne
hedale yɛ nwo zo.
6Ayɛlɛyelɛ ɛha Ɛdɛnkɛma
mɔɔ anye yɛ ammaa yɛ kpɔvolɛma angu yɛ la.
7Yɛvi ɛsalɛ kɛ anloma mɔɔ ɛvi ɛhane nu;
ɛhane ne ɛbubu, yɛvi ɛsalɛ!
8Yɛ moalɛ vi Ɛdɛnkɛma
mɔɔ bɔle anwuma nee aze la.

Title: EDW 125
Content:
Nyamenle menli ne anwo banebɔlɛ
1Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ rɛle wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anu la
le kɛ Boka Zayɔn mɔɔ ɛnkpusu
na ɔgyi kpundii dahuu la.
2Kɛmɔ awoka ne mɔ bɛnra yia Gyɛlusalɛm la,
zɔhane ala yɛɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma anye bɛnra yia ye menli ne anwo,
ɔvi ɛnɛ kɔdwu mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ.
3Amumuyɛma ɛnrɛli belemgbunli
wɔ tenlenema azɛlɛ zo dahuu;
anrɛɛ tenlenema kɛdwazo kɛli ɛtane.
4O Ɛdɛnkɛma, yɛ kpalɛ maa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛle kpalɛ,
nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ ahonle nu te la.
5Na bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkakyi bɛ nwo bɛyɛ ninyɛndane la
Ɛdɛnkɛma badea bɛ nee amumuyɛma amuala.
Anzonudwolɛ ɛha Yizilayɛma.

Title: EDW 126
Content:
Ngoanelielɛ nwo nzɛlɛlɛ
1Mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma manle Zayɔn kpazile bieko la,
yɛyɛle kɛ menli mɔɔ ɛlɛka ɛlalɛ la.
2Akee yɛ nloa anwo yɛle ɛzelekɛ ngome,
na yɛdeɛdeanle nu anyelielɛ nu;
na maanle maanle ne mɔ hanle kɛ,
“Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛyɛ ninyɛne mgbole ɛmaa bɛ.”
3Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛyɛ ninyɛne mgbole ɛmaa yɛ;
ɔyɛ yɛ fɛ kpole.
4O Ɛdɛnkɛma, maa yɛkpazi bieko,
kɛ azudenle ne mɔ mɔɔ gua nyiakɛ la!
5Maa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛfa monle bɛdua la,
ɛva anyelielɛ ɛdeɛdea nu ɛbu!
6Sonla ne mɔɔ fa ɛzunlɛ
soa ye ma kɛ ɔkalua la,
bava anyelielɛ adeɛdea nu,
ava ye bɛyɔba ne ara sua nu.

Title: EDW 127
Content:
Nyamenle kpalɛyɛlɛ ne ɛyeyɛlɛ (Sɔlɔmɔn edwɛne)
1Saa Ɛdɛnkɛma ɔdaye yeanzi sua ne a,
bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsi la fɛ mgbane.
Saa Ɛdɛnkɛma ɔdaye yeanzinza suakpole ne a,
sinzavolɛma solo nafelɛ mgbane.
2Ɔnle debie mgbane kɛ ɛkɛdwazo ndɛ na ɛnrɛla ndɛ,
ɛkɛva ɛ nwo amuala ɛkɛyɛ gyima ɛsesebɛ;
ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛ maa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ ɔkulo bɛ la,
wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛlafe la.
3Nea, mralɛ mrenya le agyadeɛ
mɔɔ vi Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛkɛ a;
awolɛ le nyilalɛ.
4Mgbavolɛ nu mralɛ mrenya ɛnyialɛ
le kɛ ɛda mbaka wɔ ɛlɔnenli asa anu.
5Nyilalɛ ɛha sonla ne mɔɔ ye ɛda mbaka boa ne ɛyi la.
Saa ɔ nee ye kpɔvolɛma nyia ɛdendɛlɛ
wɔ anlenkɛ kpole ne anloa a,
ɔ nyunlu ɛnrɛgua aze ɛlɛ.

Title: EDW 128
Content:
Ɛdɛnkɛma ane ɛdielɛ nwo ahatualɛ
1Nyilalɛ ɛha awie biala mɔɔ sulo Ɛdɛnkɛma,
na ɔdua ye ndenle ne mɔ anu la!
2Ɛbali ɛ sa anloa gyima aleɛ;
ɔbayɛ boɛ yeamaa wɔ na ɛ nye alie.
3Ɛ ye bayɛ kɛ vanye baka mɔɔ so la
wɔ wɔ sua nu;
ɛ mra bayɛ kɛ ɔlivi mbaka mɔɔ ɛwɔlɔwɔlɔ la
abɔ ayia wɔ ɛkponle nwo.
4Nea, zɛhae nyilalɛ yɛɛ
sonla mɔɔ sulo Ɛdɛnkɛma la banyia a.
5Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛyila wɔ ɛvi Zayɔn!
Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛmaa ɛnwu Gyɛlusalɛm ɛkpazilɛ ne,
wɔ wɔ ngoane mekɛ muala anu!
6Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛmaa ɛnwu ɛ mra amra.
Anzonudwolɛ ɛha Yizilayɛ!

Title: EDW 129
Content:
Nzɛlɛlɛ mɔɔ tia Yizilayɛ kpɔvolɛma
1“Ɔvi me ngakula nu, bɛhile me nyane kpalɛ,”
bɛmaa Yizilayɛma ɛha.
2“Ɔvi me ngakula nu, bɛhile me nyane kpalɛ,
noko bɛtɛkolale me nwo zo konim di.
3Bɛrelerelele me nzi kuma nu,
bɛpɛle ye ahuma kɛ ɛyazonlɛnli fa alua aleɛ.
4Ɛdɛnkɛma le tenlenenli;
yepepɛ amumuyɛma nyɛma ne mɔ anu.”
5Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛmaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkyi Zayɔn la
anyunlu ɛgua aze na bɛzia bɛ nzi.
6Maa bɛyɛ kɛ sua ti zo ndile,
mɔɔ fifi a ɔngyɛ na yeanwoso la.
7Mɔɔ bu bɛyɔba la ɛmbu,
anzɛɛ mɔɔ kyekye bɛ avile la ɛnkyekye bie
ɛnlɛ ye ɔ kɛnra azo ɛngɔ.
8Mmamaa menli mɔɔ se ɛkɛ ne la ka kɛ,
“Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛyila wɔ!
Yɛyila wɔ wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma duma nu!”

Title: EDW 130
Content:
Moalɛ nwo nzɛlɛlɛ
1O Ɛdɛnkɛma, mela buma ye anu
mesu mefɛlɛ wɔ!
2O Awulae, tie me ne!
Gyele ɛ nzo tie me modolɛ ɛzunlɛ!
3O Ɛdɛnkɛma, saa ɛse ɛdi ɛtane nzi a,
Awulae, anrɛɛ nwane a kɛhola kɛgyinla a?
4Na wɔmɔ, ɛlɛ fakyɛ,
amaa bɛazulo wɔ.
5Mekendɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, me ɛkɛla kendɛ,
yɛɛ me nye la ye edwɛkɛ ne azo;
6me ɛkɛla kendɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma
tɛla sinzavolɛma mɔɔ kendɛ alehyenlɛ la,
tɛla sinzavolɛma mɔɔ kendɛ alehyenlɛ la.
7O Yizilayɛma, bɛmaa bɛ nye ɛla Ɛdɛnkɛma anwo zo!
Ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma lɛ ɛhulolɛ kpundii,
na ɔlɛ ngoanelielɛ dɔɔnwo.
8 Ɔbalie Yizilayɛma
yeavi bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ anu.

Title: EDW 131
Content:
Diedi nwo nzɛlɛlɛ
1O Ɛdɛnkɛma, metɛmemanle me nwo zo,
me nye ɛtɛtɛlale me ndo;
menva ninyɛne mɔɔ le mgbole
nee mɔɔ yɛ nwanwane ɔmaa me la membɔ me ɛbolɛ.
2Na medo me rɛle azule nu, meyɛ koonwu
kɛ kakula mɔɔ la ɔ nli akɛnra nu la;
me ɛkɛla ɛyɛ koonwu kɛ kakula la.
3O Yizilayɛ, nyia anyelazo wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anu,
ɔvi ɛnɛ kɔdwu mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ.

Title: EDW 132
Content:
Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne ɛhanvolɛ
1O Ɛdɛnkɛma, kakye Devidi
nee amaneɛ kpole mɔɔ ɔnwunle ye;
2ye ɛwɔkɛ mɔɔ ɔbɔle wɔmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma
nee amonle mɔɔ ɔlile ɔhilele Gyekɔbo Tumivolɛ Nyamenle ne
3kɛ, “Menrɛhɔ me sua ne anu,
anzɛɛ menrɛla me ɛkpa ne azo;
4menrɛmuomua me nye menrɛlafe,
anzɛɛ menrɛbɔ ngɔsɔkɛ na me nye ahɔ dɔɔnwo,
5kɔkpula kɛ menwɔnyia ɛleka menwɔmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma,
ɛleka mɔɔ Gyekɔbo Tumivolɛ Nyamenle ne badɛnla la.”
6 Nea, yɛdele Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne nganeɛ wɔ Bɛtelɛhɛm,
yɛnwunle ye wɔ Keleate Gyialem ɛya nu.
7Yɛhanle kɛ, “Bɛmaa yɛhɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Sua nu;
bɛmaa yɛbutu ɔ gyakɛ abo yɛzonle ye!”
8O Ɛdɛnkɛma, dwazo kɔ wɔ sua ne anu,
ɛdawɔ yɛɛ wɔ Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne mɔɔ kile wɔ
tumi la.
9Maa wɔ sɛlɛvolɛma ɛbɔ ɛbɛla mɔɔ tenrɛ,
na maa wɔ menli ne ɛva anyelielɛ ɛdea nu.
10Wɔ sonvolɛ Devidi ati,
mmakakyi ɛ nzi ɛsi mɔɔ wɔkpokpa ye nwole la.
11 Ɛdɛnkɛma bɔle Devidi ɛwɔkɛ,
na ɔnrɛhakyi ɔ nloa ɛlɛ.
Ɔse, “Ɛ mra mrenya ne mɔ mɔɔ wɔwo bɛ la anu ko
yɛɛ mebava meazie wɔ ebia ne azo a.
12Saa ɛ mra mrenya ne mɔ di me mɛla zo,
bɛdi me ngilehilelɛ mɔɔ mebahilehile bɛ la azo a,
bɛdabɛ noko bɛ mra mrenya
badɛnla wɔ ebia ne azo mekɛ biala.”
13Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛnlea nu ɛye Zayɔn;
yehulo kɛ ɛkɛ ne a ɔtɛnla a:
14Ɔse, “Ɛke le me ɛnwomenlelielɛ ɛleka dahuu;
ɛke a mebadɛnla a, ɔluakɛ mehulo ɛke.
15Mebamaa yeanyia ninyɛne dɔɔnwo;
mebamaa ye ehyianvolɛma anyia aleɛ.
16Mebamaa ye sɛlɛvolɛma anyia ngoanelielɛ,
na meamaa me menli ne mɔɔ wɔ zo la
ava anyelielɛ adeɛdea nu.
17 Ɛke a mebamaa Devidi abo zo amra ne mɔ ko
adwazo ayɛ belemgbunli kpole a,
na mebazinza mɔɔ mekpa nu meye ye belemgbunli la.
18Mebamaa ye kpɔvolɛma abɔ anyiemgba,
na meamaa ye belemgbunlililɛ ayɛ kpole.”

Title: EDW 133
Content:
Mediema ɛhulolɛ ɛyeyɛlɛ
1Bɛnlea kɛ ɔsi ɔle kɛnlɛma nee kpalɛ,
kɛ mediema kɛbɔ nu kɛdɛnla koyɛlɛ nu!
2Ɔle kɛ nwole mɔɔ sonle bolɛ
mɔɔ bɛwola bɛgua sonla ti zo,
na ɔsonyi ɔgua ɔ kɛsa anu,
bɔbɔ kɛ Aalɔn akɛsa anu ɛdeɛ ne,
mɔɔ zonyinle guale tɛladeɛ ne akɔme ne anu la.
3Ɔle kɛ Hɛmɔn Boka zo ɛbɔlɛ,
mɔɔ tɔ gua Zayɔn awoka ne mɔ azo la!
Gyɛlusalɛm yɛɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛbɔ ɛwɔkɛ kɛ ɔbayila bɛ,
yeamaa bɛ ngoane mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ a.

Title: EDW 134
Content:
Nyamenle ayɛlɛyelɛ
1Bɛrɛla, bɛyeyɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma,
bɛmɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma sonvolɛma,
mɔɔ aledwolɛ nu bɛgyinla bɛsinza Ɛdɛnkɛma Sua ne la!
2Bɛmaa bɛ sa zo wɔ ɛleka nwuanzanwuanza ne,
na bɛyeyɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma!
3Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛyila bɛ ɛvi Zayɔn,
yemɔ mɔɔ ɔbɔle anwuma nee aze la!

Title: EDW 135
Content:
Ayɛlɛyelɛ edwɛne
1Bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ!
Bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma duma ne ayɛlɛ,
O Ɛdɛnkɛma sonvolɛma, bɛye ye ayɛlɛ,
2bɛmɛ mɔɔ bɛgyinla bɛsinza Ɛdɛnkɛma Sua ne,
wɔ yɛ Nyamenle ne Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne
alie nwo ɛkɛ ne la, bɛyeyɛ ye!
3Bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ, ɔluakɛ ɔle kpalɛ;
bɛdo edwɛne bɛmaa ye, ɔluakɛ ɔle dovolɛ!
4Ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛkpa nu ɛye Gyekɔbo ɛmaa ɔ nwo,
yeva Yizilayɛ yeyɛ ye ɛdeɛ.
5Meze kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma le kpole,
yɛɛ yɛ Awulae bo nyamenle muala anwo zo.
6Debie biala mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma kulo la yɛɛ ɔyɛ a,
wɔ anwuma nee aze, nyevile nu nee buma kɔsɔɔti anu.
7Yemɔ a ɔmaa amungu dwazo ewiade ati lɔ a;
ɔmaa ɛsɛnlɛmanye kpakye ezule nu,
na ɔtukue anwoma anlenkɛ ɔmaa ɔtu a.
8Yemɔ yɛɛ ɔhunle Yigyibiti belamunli mralɛ,
menli nee nane mɔɔ bɛlumuale bɛwole bɛ la.
9Yemɔ yɛɛ Yigyibitima avinli,
ɔyɛle nwanwane ninyɛne nee sɛkɛlɛneɛ
ɔtiale Falo ne nee ye sonvolɛma a.
10Yemɔ yɛɛ ɔzɛkyele maanle maanle
na ɔhunle arelemgbunli katakyiema a:
11Amɔle Belemgbunli Saehɔn,
yɛɛ Beehyan Belemgbunli Ɔɔgo,
na ɔzɛkyele Keena arelemgbunli maanle ne mɔ a.
12Ɔvale bɛ azɛlɛ ne mɔ ɔmanle bɛyɛle bɛ agyadeɛ,
ye menli Yizilayɛma agyadeɛ.
13O Ɛdɛnkɛma, wɔ duma ne wɔ ɛkɛ dahuu,
O Ɛdɛnkɛma, awolɛndoazo kɔsɔɔti bade wɔ nganeɛ.
14Ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma balie ye menli ne ati,
na yeanwu ye sonvolɛma anwunvɔne.
15Maanle maanle mmonle ne mɔ,
le dwɛtɛ fufule nee ezukoa nvutuke;
bɛle menli asa anloa gyima.
16Bɛlɛ ɛnloanlɛ, noko bɛndendɛ,
bɛlɛ ɛnyelɛ, noko bɛnnwu debie,
17bɛlɛ ɛnzonlɛ, noko bɛnde edwɛkɛ,
yɛɛ ɛnwomenle biala ɛnle bɛ nu.
18Maa menli mɔɔ yɛ mmonle la,
ɛhɛe, awie biala mɔɔ fa ɔ rɛle wula mmonle nu la,
ɛyɛ kɛ mmonle la.
19O Yizilayɛma, bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ!
O Aalɔn awuke nu amra, bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ!
20O Livaema, bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ!
Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsulo Ɛdɛnkɛma la, bɛye ye ayɛlɛ.
21Ayɛlɛyelɛ vi Zayɔn ɛha Ɛdɛnkɛma,
yemɔ mɔɔ ɔde Gyɛlusalɛm la.
Bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ.

Title: EDW 136
EDW 137
Content:
Yizilayɛma mɔɔ bɛhyele bɛ bɛhɔle nlɔnu la awolɛyelɛ
1Wɔ Babelɔn azule ne mɔ anloa,
yɛdɛnlanle aze yɛzunle,
wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ yɛhakyele Zayɔn la.
2Azule ne anloa mbaka ne mɔ azo,
yɛhendɛhendanle yɛ getaa ne mɔ.
3Ɔluakɛ ɛkɛ ne a menli mɔɔ hyele yɛ la
zele yɛ kɛ yɛdo edwɛne a.
Bɛhilele yɛ nyane na bɛzele yɛ kɛ,
“Bɛdo Zayɔn edwɛne ne mɔ bie bɛhile yɛ.”
4Kɛ ɔyɛ mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ yɛto Ɛdɛnkɛma edwɛne wɔ
maanɔne ɛ?
5O Gyɛlusalɛm, saa me rɛle fi wɔ a,
maa me sa fema ɛnwenwe.
6Saa me rɛle fi wɔ,
na meammaa Gyɛlusalɛm angyia me
andɛla me anyelielɛ biala a,
maa mendɔ mumule!
7O Ɛdɛnkɛma, kakye mɔɔ Yidɔmma yɛle
wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ Gyɛlusalɛm bɔle la.
Bɛzele kɛ, “Bɛbɔ ye, bɛbɔ ye tɔɔ!
Bɛgologolo ye bɛgua aze!”
8 O Babelɔn, wɔmɔ sɛkyeravolɛ!
Ahenle mɔɔ bali wɔ nzenralɛ
wɔ mɔɔ wɔva wɔyɛ yɛ la anwo la
anye balie kpole!
9Ɔ nye balie na yealielie bɛ mra ngakula
yeava bɛ ti yeakpulokpula bodane yeahu bɛ.

Title: EDW 138
Content:
Moyɛlɛ nzɛlɛlɛ
1O Ɛdɛnkɛma, mefa me ahonle muala meyɛ wɔ mo;
meto wɔ ayɛlɛyelɛ edwɛne wɔ awozonle nyunlu;
2mekakyi me nye wɔ wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua nwo lɔ,
mebutu meyɛ wɔ mo,
wɔ wɔ ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne nee wɔ nɔhalɛ ti,
ɔluakɛ wɔkpogya wɔ duma nee wɔ edwɛkɛ zo
wɔdɛla debie biala.
3Kenle mɔɔ menvɛlɛle wɔ la, ɛliele me zo,
na ɛmanle me anwosesebɛ.
4O Ɛdɛnkɛma, ewiade arelemgbunli kɔsɔɔti baye wɔ ayɛlɛ,
ɔluakɛ bɛde ɛ nloa anu edwɛkɛ.
5Bɛbado Ɛdɛnkɛma ndenle ne mɔ anwo edwɛne,
ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlunyia ne le kpole.
6Ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma wɔ anwuma bɔbɔ ɛdeɛ,
noko ɔbu mɔɔ bɛlɛ ɔ nwo aze la,
na mɔɔ memaa ɔ nwo zo la ɛmbikye ye.
7Saa melua ngyegyelɛ nu a,
ɛbɔ me ngoane nwo bane.
Ɛtenrɛ ɛ sa ɛsi me kpɔvolɛma mɔɔ ɛva ɛya la aze,
na ɛfa wɔ tumi kpole ne ɛdie me.
8Ɛdɛnkɛma bamaa mɔɔ yehyehyɛ yemaa me la ayɛ zɔ;
O Ɛdɛnkɛma, wɔ ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne wɔ ɛkɛ dahuu.
Mmakpo ɛ sa anloa gyima.

Title: EDW 139
Content:
Nyamenle ɛnleanlɛ kpalɛ
1O Ɛdɛnkɛma, wɔnleɛnlea me nu wɔnwu me!
2Ɛze me azedɛnlanlɛ nee me ɛdwazolɛ nu;
ɛze me adwenle muala.
3Ɛneɛnlea na ɛnwu me ndenle muala,
saa melɛdie me ɛnwomenle anzɛɛ melɛyɛ gyima a ɛze.
4O Ɛdɛnkɛma, mekabuke me nloa bɔbɔ la,
ɛnee ɛze mɔɔ mebaha la amuala.
5Ɛwɔ me nyunlu, ɛwɔ me nzi,
na ɛfa ɛ sa ɛto me nwo zo.
6Zɛhae adwenle ne yɛ me nwanwane;
ɔwɔ anwuma ɔbo me ndelebɛbo zo.
7Saa mekoati wɔ Sunsum ne a, nienwu yɛɛ mekɔ a?
Anzɛɛ mekoati wɔ a, nienwu yɛɛ menriandi meahɔ a?
8Saa mekɔ anwuma a, ɛwɔ ɛkɛ!
Saa mekɔda mɔwuamra maanle nu a, ɛwɔ ɛkɛ!
9Saa mefa nwonlomɔ ndɛbalɛ metu faa
mekɔ nyevile nzi moa moa lɔ a,
10ɛkɛ ne bɔbɔ, wɔ tumi ne a nee me bahɔ a,
yɛɛ wɔ tumi kpole ne a bazɔ me a.
11Saa meka kɛ, “Awozinli ɛheda me nwo zo,
na me nwo wienyi ne ɛnlu ɛyɛ aledwolɛ” a,
12awozinli ne ɛnle kisii ɛmmaa wɔ,
aledwolɛ ne ta wienyi kɛ alehyenlɛ,
ɔluakɛ ɛ nyunlu, awozinli nee wienyi le debie ko.
13Ɛdawɔ a ɛhyehyɛle debie biala mɔɔ wɔ me nu la a,
ɛdawɔ a ɛnwonle me wɔ ɔmɔ akunlu a.
14Meye wɔ ayɛlɛ, ɔluakɛ ɛ nwo yɛ ɛzulolɛ nee nwanwane.
Wɔ gyima yɛ nwanwane!
Ɛze me kpalɛ bɔkɔɔ.
15Mekɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛkyehyɛ me mbowule,
bɛava bɛasisa zo wɔ ɔmɔ akunlu,
na fealera nu ala melɛnyi la,
ɛnee ɛze kɛ mewɔ ɛkɛ.
16Mekɛ mɔɔ metɛsɔhonle ɛhwee la ɛnee ɛ nye gyi me nwo;
ɛnee bɛhɛlɛ me nwo edwɛkɛ biala wɔ wɔ buluku ne anu;
mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee bɛtɛbɔle me ɛleka biala bɔbɔ la,
ɛnee bɛhɛlɛ kenle dodo mɔɔ bɛva bɛmaa me la.
17O Nyamenle, wɔ adwenle ne mɔ sonle bolɛ maa me!
Bɛ muala bɛbɔ nu a ɔle kpole kpalɛ!
18Saa mese kɛ metia a, bɛzonle bɛtɛla ɛnwea.
Saa metunwue a,
ɛnee metɛbɔ ɛ nwo ɛkɛ ne ala.
19O Nyamenle, anrɛɛ wɔahu amumuyɛma,
na kɔdiawuma vi me nwo ahwe bɛ nwo.
20Bɛfa adwenle ɛtane bɛtendɛ bɛtia wɔ;
wɔ kpɔvolɛma ne tendɛ ɛtane tia wɔ.
21O Ɛdɛnkɛma, asoo mengyi menli mɔɔ kyi wɔ la?
Asoo memkpɔ menli mɔɔ dwazo tia wɔ la?
22Mekpɔ bɛ ɛkpɔlɛ sanlera kpalɛ;
mebu bɛ me kpɔvolɛma.
23Neɛnlea me nu, O Nyamenle, na nwu me ahonle nu!
Sɔ me nea, na nwu me adwenle!
24Nea saa amumuyɛ bie wɔ me nu a,
na fa me dua ngoane adenle ne anu dahuu.

Title: EDW 140
Content:
Ɛwowalɛ nwo nzɛlɛlɛ
1O Ɛdɛnkɛma, die me fi ɛtanema asa anu;
bɔ me nwo bane wɔ amumuyɛma asa anu.
2Bɛbɔ adwenle ɛtane wɔ bɛ ahonle nu,
na bɛka konle dahuu.
3 Bɛ nloa yɛ nla kɛ ɛwɔlɛ,
bɛ nloa nu bɔlɔ le kɛ ɛwɔbile ɛdeɛ ne.
4O Ɛdɛnkɛma, sinza me wɔ amumuyɛma asa anu;
bɔ me nwo bane wɔ kɔdiawuma asa anu;
bɛhyehyɛ kɛ bɛkpane me gyakɛ.
5Adubɛnwoma ɛzua me ɛhane ɛvea,
bɛva nyɛmanyɛma bɛdo nwowa;
bɛzuozua me ngane wɔ adehane.
6Meka mekile Ɛdɛnkɛma kɛ, “Ɛle me Nyamenle.”
O Ɛdɛnkɛma, gyele ɛ nzo tie me modolɛ ɛzunlɛ.
7O Ɛdɛnkɛma, me Awulae, me dievolɛ kpole,
wɔheda me nwo zo wɔ konle nu.
8O Ɛdɛnkɛma, mmakponle mɔɔ amumuyɛnli ne kulo kɛ ɔyɛ la azo;
mmamaa ye amumuyɛ adwenle ne di munli.
9Maa amumuyɛma mɔɔ ɛbɔ ɛyia me ɛlɛdi fɛlɛko la
fɛlɛkolilɛ ne ɛhakyi munzule.
10Maa samɛnlakɛ ɛkpomgbɔ ɛgua bɛ ti zo!
Maa bɛvuandi bɛ bɛgua kuma nu mɔɔ bɛndwazo ko ɛlɛ a.
11Mmamaa mɔɔ bɔ ɔ gɔnwo anwo nzekue la tɛnla maanle ne anu;
maa munzule ɛdu kɔdiawuma ne mgbaliko.
12Meze kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma di mɔɔ ɛlɛnwu amaneɛ la edwɛkɛ maa ye,
na ɔbua mɔɔ ɛhyia la ndɛne nɔhalɛ nu ɔmaa ye.
13Nɔhalɛ, tenlenema bayɛ wɔ mo,
yɛɛ mɔɔ ye ɛbɛla tenrɛ la badɛnla ɛ nyunlu.

Title: EDW 141
Content:
Nɔsolɛ nzɛlɛlɛ
1O Ɛdɛnkɛma, mefɛlɛ wɔ a yɛ ndɛndɛ boa me!
Saa mefɛlɛ wɔ a gyele ɛ nzo tie me ne!
2 Maa me nzɛlɛlɛ ɛyɛ kɛ ɛyɛlɛ evuanlɛ wɔ ɛ nyunlu,
na fa me sa mɔɔ memaa ye zo la kɛ nɔsolɛ azubɔlɛ.
3O Ɛdɛnkɛma, maa sinzavolɛ ɛzinza me nloa,
na ɔzinza me nloa babonle ye.
4Mmamaa me nye die ɛtane nwo,
na mepele amumuyɛ ɛyɛlɛ nwo.
Mmamaa me nee nindavoma tu,
yɛɛ mmamaa me nee bɛ to ɛsalɛ ɛyɛba ko anu.
5Maa sonlakpalɛ ɛbo me, ɔle anwunvɔnezelɛ;
maa ɔhwi me nyunlu, ɔle nwole wɔ me ti zo, memkpo,
ɔluakɛ me nzɛlɛlɛ tia amumuyɛma nyɛleɛ ne mɔ dahuu.
6Saa bɛye bɛ bɛwula menli mɔɔ babua bɛ ewule fɔlɛ la asa anu a,
yɛɛ bɛkɛnwu kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma edwɛkɛ ne le nɔhalɛ a.
7Kɛ sonla mɔɔ bɛkɛde ye bodane zo la mbowule si
sande la,
zɔhane ala yɛɛ bɛ mbowule bazande Ɛbolɔ anuhɔlɛ ne a.
8O Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle, me nye la ɛ nwo zo;
wɔ nuhua yɛɛ menriandi mefea a;
mmaye me ɛmaa.
9Mmamaa metɔ bɛ ɛhane ne mɔɔ bɛzua me la anu,
mmamaa metɔ amumuyɛma ɛhane nu.
10Maa amumuyɛma ɛgulu nu ɛgua bɛ ngane ne mɔ anu,
na maa me nwo ɛyɛ kɔlɔnwo.

Title: EDW 142
Content:
Moalɛ nwo nzɛlɛlɛ (Devidi nzɛlɛlɛ)
1Metea nu mefɛlɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma,
mefa me modolɛ nzɛlɛlɛ meto ɔ nyunlu.
2Meye me edwɛkɛ kɔsɔɔti meto ɔ nyunlu;
meka me amaneɛnwunlɛ mekile ye.
3Saa me ɛnwomenle wie a,
ɛze me ndenle kɔsɔɔti.
Adenle ne mɔɔ medua nu la,
bɛzua me ɛhane wɔ nu.
4Meto me nye fema zo menea,
na awie ɛmpili me;
ɛvealeka biala ɛnle ɛkɛ ɛmmaa me,
awie biala ɛndwenle me nwo.
5O Ɛdɛnkɛma, mesu mefɛlɛ wɔ;
mese, “Wɔmɔ a ɛle me ɛvealeka a,
ɛle me ɛdeɛ wɔ teasema azɛlɛ zo.”
6Tie me ɛzunlɛ,
ɔluakɛ me nwo ɛwie me kyele!
Die me fi bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛyɛ me kpɔdekpɔde la asa anu;
ɔluakɛ bɛ anwosesebɛ bo me nwo zo.
7Ye me fi efiade,
amaa meayɛ wɔ mo!
Tenlenema babɔ ayia me,
ɔluakɛ wɔlo me dɔɔnwo.

Title: EDW 143
Content:
Moalɛ nwo nzɛlɛlɛ
1O Ɛdɛnkɛma, tie me nzɛlɛlɛ;
tie me modolɛ nzɛlɛlɛ.
Dua wɔ nɔhalɛ ne azo bua me;
wɔ tenleneyɛlɛ ne ati, bua me.
2 Mmabua wɔ akɛlɛ ndɛne;
ɔluakɛ ɛ nyunlu, awie biala ɛnli benle.
3Kpɔvolɛ ne ɛvoa me ndinlizo;
yetinli me azɛlɛ ne anwo;
yedo me awozinli nu kɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwu dɛbadɛba la.
4Yemɔti me nwo ɛbubu me;
me ahonle ɛdu kpole kpalɛ.
5Mekakye dɛba, medwenledwenle mɔɔ wɔyɛ la anwo;
menwu mɔɔ wɔyɛ la amuala.
6Metenrɛ me sa memaa wɔ;
ɛ nwo nzuhɔne ku me kɛ azɛlɛ mɔɔ ɛwe resee la.
7O Ɛdɛnkɛma, ka ɛ nwo bua me!
Me ɛnwomenle ɛwie!
Mmafa ɛ nye ɛfea me,
anrɛɛ menwɔyɛ kɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwu la.
8Maa mende wɔ ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne anwo bie nwonlomɔ mangyee ne,
ɔluakɛ wɔ nuhua yɛɛ me rɛle wɔ a.
Kilehile me adenle mɔɔ menva zo la,
ɔluakɛ wɔmɔ ala a me nye la ɛ nwo zo a.
9O Ɛdɛnkɛma, die me fi me kpɔvolɛma asa anu!
Menriandi meravea wɔ nu.
10Kilehile me maa menyɛ mɔɔ ɛkulo la,
ɔluakɛ wɔmɔ a ɛle me Nyamenle a!
Maa wɔ Sunsum kpalɛ ne ɛli me nyunlu,
wɔ munzule adenle zo.
11O Ɛdɛnkɛma, wɔ duma ne ati, bɔ me ngoane nwo bane!
Dua wɔ tenleneyɛlɛ ne azo ye me fi ngyegyelɛ nu.
12Wɔ ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne ati, bɔ me kpɔvolɛma gua,
na sɛkye bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkyi me la amuala,
ɔluakɛ mele wɔ sonvolɛ.

Title: EDW 144
Content:
Belemgbunli yɛ Nyamenle mo kɛ yeli konim
1Ayɛlɛyelɛ ɛha Ɛdɛnkɛma, me bodane,
mɔɔ kilehile me konle nye zo,
na ɔsiezie me ɔmaa mekɔ konle la.
2Ɔle me bodane nee me ɛvealeka,
me aranemgbole nee me dievolɛ.
Ɔle me enyinlike, ye nuhua yɛɛ mefea a,
na ɔmaa medi maanle maanle nwo zo konim.
3 O Ɛdɛnkɛma, sonla le duzu, mɔɔ ɛbu ye bie zɛhae a,
anzɛɛ sonla ra le duzu, mɔɔ ɛdwenle ɔ nwo a?
4Sonla le kɛ ɛnwomenle,
ye mekɛ le kɛ ɛlawolɛ.
5O Ɛdɛnkɛma, ka anwuma aze na bɛla!
Fa ɛ sa ka awoka ne mɔ maa bɛkpu esike!
6Kpakye ɛsɛnlɛmanye bɔ bɛ asande;
to wɔ ɛda ne mɔ maa wɔ kpɔvolɛma ɛgua ɛbɔ nu.
7Tenrɛ ɛ sa fi anwuma lɔ,
sɔ me na die me fi nzule ne mɔ anu;
die me fi nyɛvolɛ asa anu.
8Bɛnga nɔhalɛ ɛlɛ,
yɛɛ bɛdi amonle bɔbɔ a bɛbɔ adalɛ.
9O Nyamenle, mebado edwɛne fofolɛ meamaa wɔ;
mebabɔ ye wɔ nyɛma bulu getaa zo meamaa wɔ,
10wɔmɔ mɔɔ ɛmaa arelemgbunli di konim,
wɔmɔ mɔɔ ɛdie wɔ sonvolɛ Devidi a,
11die me fi konle dadeɛ atisesebɛ nloa,
na die me fi nyɛvolɛ asa anu.
Bɛnga nɔhalɛ ɛlɛ,
yɛɛ bɛdi amonle bɔbɔ a bɛbɔ adalɛ.
12Maa yɛ mra mrenya mgbavolɛ nu
ɛyɛ kɛ mbaka mɔɔ ɛwie nyi;
maa yɛ mra mraalɛ ɛyɛ kɛ mgbɛnezo bolɛ mpila
mɔɔ bɛboɔboa kɛ bɛfa bɛazi belemgbunli sua la.
13Maa yɛ bonwolo ne mɔ ɛyi,
mɔɔ aleɛ ngakyile kɔsɔɔti wɔ ɛkɛ;
maa yɛ mboane ɛda,
bɛyɛ apenle apenle nee apenle bulu bulu wɔ yɛ ɛya nu.
14Maa yɛ nlankɛ ɛnrenzɛnrenzɛ;
mmamaa bɛ ko kpɔne yɛɛ mmamaa bɛdi abawuo.
Mmamaa yɛte nyane ɛzunlɛ biala wɔ yɛ kpalɛ ne mɔ azo.
15Nyilalɛ ɛha menli mɔɔ nyilalɛ ɛhye le bɛ ɛdeɛ la!
Nyilalɛ ɛha menli mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma le bɛ Nyamenle la!

Title: EDW 145
Content:
Ayɛlɛyelɛ edwɛne
1Mebayeyɛ wɔ, me Nyamenle nee me Belemgbunli,
na meayɛ wɔ mo dahuu.
2Kenle biala mebayɛ wɔ mo,
na meaye wɔ ayɛlɛ dahuu.
3Ɛdɛnkɛma le kpole, yɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛye ye ayɛlɛ kpole;
ye kpoleyɛlɛ, sonla ɛngola ɛnvedevede nu.
4Awolɛndoazo biala bahanvo wɔ,
na bɛabɔ wɔ gyima mgbole mɔɔ wɔli la nolo.
5Mebadwenledwenle wɔ belemgbunlililɛ ne anyunlunyia nwo,
na meadwenledwenle wɔ nwanwane gyima ne mɔ anwo.
6Menli babɔ wɔ tumi gyima mgbole ne mɔ nolo,
na medame mebabɔ wɔ kpoleyɛlɛ ne nolo.
7Bɛbaha wɔ kpalɛyɛlɛ dɔɔnwo ne anwo edwɛkɛ,
na bɛado wɔ tenleneyɛlɛ ne anwo edwɛne.
8Ɛdɛnkɛma le dovolɛ yɛɛ ɔse anwunvɔne,
ɔnva ɛya mgbane mgbane yɛɛ ye ɛhulolɛ le kpundii.
9Ɛdɛnkɛma le kpalɛ maa awie biala,
ye anwunvɔnezelɛ wɔ debie biala mɔɔ yebɔ la anwo zo.
10O Ɛdɛnkɛma, ɛ sa anloa gyima kɔsɔɔti bayɛ wɔ mo,
Nyamenle menli ne amuala baye wɔ ayɛlɛ!
11Bɛbaha wɔ belemgbunlililɛ ne anyunlunyia nwo edwɛkɛ,
na bɛaha wɔ tumi ne anwo edwɛkɛ.
12Bɛbamaa menli anwu wɔ tumi nyɛleɛ ne mɔ,
nee wɔ belemgbunlililɛ ne anyunlunyia ne kɛnlɛma.
13Wɔ belemgbunlililɛ ne ɛmbɔ aze ɛlɛ,
yɛɛ ɛle belemgbunli dahuu
wɔ awolɛndoazo kɔsɔɔti anu.
Ɛdɛnkɛma le nɔhalɛ wɔ ye edwɛkɛ kɔsɔɔti anu,
yɛɛ ɔle dovolɛ wɔ ye nyɛleɛ kɔsɔɔti anu.
14Ɛdɛnkɛma sɔ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛgua aze la nu,
na ɔkpogya bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛgua aze la zo.
15Ɛdɛnkɛma, menli kɔsɔɔti anye la ɛ nwo zo,
yɛɛ ɛmaa bɛ aleɛ wɔ ye mekɛ nloa.
16Ɛbuke ɛ sa nu,
ɛmaa tease abɔdeɛ biala akunlu dwo ɔ nwo.
17Ɛdɛnkɛma di pɛlepɛle wɔ ye ndenle kɔsɔɔti anu,
yɛɛ ɔ ti akunlu le kɛnlɛma wɔ ye nyɛleɛ kɔsɔɔti anu.
18Ɛdɛnkɛma bikye bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye la amuala,
ɔbikye bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye nɔhalɛ nu la.
19Ɔmaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsulo ye la nyia mɔɔ bɛkpondɛ la,
eza ɔte bɛ ɛzunlɛ na ɔdie bɛ.
20Ɛdɛnkɛma bɔ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkulo ye la anwo bane;
na amumuyɛma ɛdeɛ, ɔbazɛkye bɛ.
21Mebaye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ;
awie biala ɛye ye ayɛlɛ dahuu.

Title: EDW 146
Content:
Dievolɛ Nyamenle ne ayɛlɛyelɛ
1Bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ!
O me ɛkɛla, ye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ!
2Mekɛ tendenle mɔɔ mede ngoane nu la,
mebaye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ;
mebado ayɛlɛyelɛ edwɛne meamaa me Nyamenle
mekɛ mɔɔ ngoane wɔ me nu la.
3Mmafa ɛ rɛle ɛwula arelemgbunli anu
mmafa ɛ rɛle ɛwula sonla nu, ɔnlɛ moalɛ biala.
4Saa ye ɛnwomenle ne fi ye nu a
ɔsia ɔkɔ ye ndɛtɛlɛ ne anu;
kenle ko ne ala ɛnee ye ngyehyɛlɛ biala ɛzɛkye.
5Nyilalɛ ɛha sonla ne mɔɔ ye boavolɛ a le Gyekɔbo Nyamenle ne,
na ye anyelazo wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ye Nyamenle ne nu la,
6 yemɔ mɔɔ ɔbɔle anwuma nee aze,
nyevile nee mɔɔ wɔ nu la amuala la.
Ɔdi ye ɛwɔkɛ zo dahuu.
7Ɔbua mɔɔ bɛlɛsisi ye la ndɛne pɛlepɛle
na ɔmaa mɔɔ ɛhɔne ku ye la aleɛ.
Ɛdɛnkɛma dwula pilizama;
8ɔtukue mɔɔ anye ɛzi la anye.
Ɛdɛnkɛma dwazo bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛgua aze la;
ɔkulo bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛle tenlene la.
9Ɛdɛnkɛma sinza nyɛvolɛ,
ɔsɔ ahunlanvolɛ nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnlɛ bɛ ze la,
na ɔsɛkye amumuyɛma adenle ne.
10Ɛdɛnkɛma bali belemgbunli dahuu,
O Zayɔn, wɔ Nyamenle ne
bali awolɛndoazo kɔsɔɔti belemgbunli.
Bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ.

Title: EDW 147
Content:
Nyamenle Bedevinli ne ayɛlɛyelɛ
1Bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ!
Ɔle kpalɛ kɛ yɛkɛye yɛ Nyamenle ne ayɛlɛ,
ɔluakɛ ɔle dovolɛ yɛɛ ayɛlɛyelɛ edwɛne fɛta ye.
2Ɛdɛnkɛma kyekye Gyɛlusalɛm;
ɔboɔboa Yizilayɛma mɔɔ awie ɛmbu bɛ bie la anloa.
3Ɔkyekye mɔɔ arɛle ɛbɔ la arɛle,
na ɔyɛ mɔɔ ɛboda la ayile.
4Ɔze nwɔlɔra ne mɔ dodo,
na ɔtoto bɛ kɔsɔɔti aluma.
5Yɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle ne le kpole, yɛɛ ye tumi le kpole;
ye ndelebɛbo, bɛnzuzu.
6Ɛdɛnkɛma kpogya mɔɔ le bɛlɛvo la zo,
ɔfuandi amumuyɛnli ne ɔto aze.
7Bɛva moyɛlɛ bɛdo edwɛne bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma;
bɛva getaa bɛbɔ edwɛne bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma!
8Ɔfa amungu ɔkeda anwomanyunlu;
ɔmaa ezule tɔ azɛlɛ ye azo,
na ɔmaa ndile fifi awoka ne mɔ azo.
9Ɔmaa nanemgbole aleɛ,
na ɔmaa ahɔhɔsɛlɛ mralɛ mɔɔ su la aleɛ.
10Ɔ nye ɛnlie ɛkpɔnwɔ anwosesebɛ nwo,
yɛɛ ɔ nye ɛnlie ɛlɔnenli akɛnrasesebɛ nwo,
11na Ɛdɛnkɛma anye die bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsulo ye la anwo,
bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ anyelazo wɔ ye ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne anu la.
12O Gyɛlusalɛmma, bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ!
O Zayɔnoma, bɛye bɛ Nyamenle ne ayɛlɛ!
13Ɔluakɛ ɔmaa bɛ nlenkɛ mgbole nzi mbulalɛ nu yɛ se;
ɔyila bɛ mra mɔɔ bɛ nee bɛ de la.
14Ɔmaa anzonudwolɛ ba bɛ ɛweɛne ne mɔ azo;
ɔmaa bɛnyia aleɛ bɛ kunlu dwo bɛ nwo.
15Ɔtendɛ ɔkile azɛlɛ ye,
mɔɔ ɔkɛha la yɛ zɔ ndɛndɛ.
16Ɔmaa ezukɔtweaba tɔ yɛ tofotofo kɛ mboane ndɛkɛ,
ɔbɔ ɛbɔndwoba ɔkponde kɛ nzonle.
17Ɔtɔ ayese ɔgua kɛ awozaka;
nwane a kɛhola ye ɛyɛlɛ ne anloa gyinla a?
18Ɔ nloa edwɛkɛ maa bɛ muala bɛkolo;
ɔmaa anwoma tu na azule ne mɔ se.
19Ɔka ye edwɛkɛ ne ɔkile Gyekɔbo,
ɔfa ye mɛla nee ye ngyehyɛlɛ ɔmaa Yizilayɛma.
20Ɔtɛyɛle ɛhye ɔtɛmanle maanle biala;
bɛnze ye mɛla ne mɔ.
Bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ!

Title: EDW 148
Content:
Ewiade amra amuala, bɛye Nyamenle ayɛlɛ
1Bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ!
Anwuma amra, bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ,
bɛye ye ayɛlɛ wɔ anwuma anwuma lɔ!
2Nyamenle soanvolɛma, bɛye ye ayɛlɛ!
Nyamenle ɛlɔnema, bɛye ye ayɛlɛ!
3Sɛnzɛne nee siane, bɛye ye ayɛlɛ,
bɛmɛ nwɔlɔra mɔɔ ta, bɛye ye ayɛlɛ!
4Bɛmɛ anwumaneamra, bɛye ye ayɛlɛ,
nzule mɔɔ wɔ anwuma lɔ anwuma, bɛye ye ayɛlɛ!
5Bɛ muala bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ!
Ɔluakɛ ɔhanle, na bɛrale.
6Ɔhyehyɛle bɛ ɔziele ɛkɛ ne wɔ melɛ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ,
ɔgyale bɛ ɛweɛne mɔɔ bɛmbɔ bɛndɛla a.
7Bɛmɛ ewiadeamra, bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ!
Bɛmɛ nyevile nu ninyɛne ɛzulolɛ nee buma muala,
8senle nee ezuawolɛ, ezukɔtweaba nee ɛbɔndwoba,
ahumu mɔɔ tie ɔ ne,
9awoka mgbole nee ngyikyi,
nzoleɛ mbaka nee sida mbaka,
10nanemgbole nee nyɛmoa,
ninyɛne mɔɔ twenle bɛ kɛnra aze nee nloma mɔɔ tu,
bɛye ye ayɛlɛ.
11Ewiade arelemgbunli nee menli kɔsɔɔti,
tumivolɛma nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsie ewiade la kɔsɔɔti!
12Mgbavolɛ nee mbɛlɛra muala,
ngakula nee mgbanyinli bɛye ye ayɛlɛ.
13Bɛ muala bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ!
Ɔluakɛ ye duma bo duma biala azo;
ye anyunlunyia bo anwuma nee aze anwo zo.
14Yemaa ye menli ne anwosesebɛ,
amaa Nyamenle menli ne aye ye ayɛlɛ,
ye menli Yizilayɛma mɔɔ la ye ahonle nwo.
Bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ!

Title: EDW 149
Content:
Ayɛlɛyelɛ edwɛne
1Bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ!
Bɛdo edwɛne fofolɛ bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma;
bɛdo ye ayɛlɛyelɛ edwɛne wɔ ye nɔhalɛ menli ne ayia ne anu!
2Bɛmaa Yizilayɛma ɛli fɛlɛko wɔ bɛ Bɔvolɛ ne ati;
Zayɔnoma ɛli fɛlɛko wɔ bɛ Belemgbunli ne ati!
3Bɛzi agole bɛye ye ayɛlɛ;
bɛva ahenle nee getaa bɛye ye ayɛlɛ!
4Ɛdɛnkɛma anye die ye menli ne anwo;
ɔmaa mɔɔ le bɛlɛvo la di konim.
5Bɛmaa mɔɔ di nɔhalɛ la ɛli fɛlɛko anyunlunyia nu;
bɛde bɛ ehwili ne mɔ anu a bɛdo edwɛne anyelielɛ nu.
6Bɛmaa Nyamenle ayɛlɛyelɛ kpole ne ɛzo bɛ nloa anu
wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛ bɛ konle dadeɛ ne mɔ bɛ sa nu,
7kɛ bɛdi maanle maanle ne mɔ nzenralɛ,
na bɛadea menli ngakyile ne mɔ la.
8Bɛbava nwɔnzɔnwɔnzɔ bɛakyekye arelemgbunli,
na bɛava mbulalɛ bɛabɔ bɛ mgbanyima ne mɔ kpanwu,
9kɛ bɛbua bɛ ndɛne, kɛmɔ bɛhɛlɛ bɛdo ɛkɛ ne la.
Ɛhye le anyunlunyia maa ye menli nɔhavoma ne.
Bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ!

Title: EDW 150
MRƐ MUKENYE
Content:
Mukenye
Mrɛlɛbulɛ buluku ne le nyamenlezonlenlɛ nee ɛbɛla kpalɛ ɛbɔlɛ nu ngilehilelɛ mɔɔ bɛbubu bɛ mrɛlɛ nu a. Nuhua dɔɔnwo fane alehyenlɛ biala ɛbɛlabɔlɛ nwo. Ɔdumua ɔbɔ kɔkɔ kɛ “Adwenlenubukelɛ mɔlebɛbo a le Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛzulolɛ”, na akee ɔkɔ zolɛ ɔka edwɛkɛ dɔɔnwo mɔɔ fane nyamenlezonlenlɛ, adwenle ɛvalɛ, yɛɛ subane kpalɛ ɛhilelɛ nwo. Ye edwɛkɛ nzinrenzinra ne mɔ dɔɔnwo kile mɔmoane Yizilayɛ kilehilevolɛma adwenlenunwunlɛ mɔɔ kile kɛ sonla mɔɔ ze nrɛlɛbɛ la si yɛ ye ninyɛne wɔ gyinlabelɛ bie mɔ anu la. Edwɛkɛ ne bie mɔ fane abusua nu ngitanwolilɛ nee nyɛleɛ mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛyɛ wɔ gyimayɛlɛ nu la anwo. Bie mɔ noko kile sonla nwo enililɛ wɔ menli avinli, yɛɛ bie mɔ kile kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ sonla si komo ɔ nwo zo wɔ adenle biala anu la. Ɔka bɛlɛvoyɛlɛ, abotane, ehyianvolɛma ɛbulɛ, yɛɛ nɔhalɛ mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ sonla di maa ɔ gɔnwo mɔ la anwo edwɛkɛ dɔɔnwo.
Mɔɔ wɔ nu la
Nrɛlɛbɛ ɛhanvolɛ 1.1—9.18
Sɔlɔmɔn mrɛlɛ ne mɔ 10.1—29.27
Egɛ anloa edwɛkɛ 30.1-33
Edwɛkɛ ngakyile ngakyile 31.1-31

Title: MRƐ 1
Content:
Mrɛlɛbulɛ bolɛ mɔɔ sonle
1 Belemgbunli Devidi ara nrenya Sɔlɔmɔn, Yizilayɛ belemgbunli ne mrɛlɛ mɔɔ bule la ɛne:
2Ɔbule mrɛlɛ ne mɔ amaa menli azukoa nrɛlɛbɛ, anyia ngilehilelɛ, na bɛade edwɛkɛ mɔɔ anu pi la abo, 3bɛadie ngilehilelɛ mɔɔ fane nrɛlɛbɛ ɛbɛla, tenleneyɛlɛ, pɛlepɛlelilɛ, nee boɛlilɛ nwo, 4amaa mɔɔ ɛnze nrɛlɛbɛ la anwu nrɛlɛbɛ na mgbavolɛ adwenle nu abuke. 5Sonla mɔɔ ze nrɛlɛbɛ la bade na yeazukoa yeamaa ye adwenle adi, na mɔɔ lɛ ndelebɛbo la anyia adwenle mɔɔ anu pi, 6na yeade ɛrɛlɛbulɛ nee edwɛkɛndonwo, nrɛlɛbɛvolɛma edwɛkɛ nee bɛ abɛladolɛ ne mɔ abo.
Mgbavolɛ folɛdulɛ
7 Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛzulolɛ le adwenle nu ɛbukelɛ mɔlebɛbo, ahoasea kyi nrɛlɛbɛ edwɛkɛ nee ngilehilelɛ.
8Me ra nrenya, tie ɛ ze ngilehilelɛ, yɛɛ mmakpo ɛ nli folɛdulɛ, 9ɔluakɛ bɛle ndotolo kɔtɔlɔba abɔtile bɛmaa wɔ, yɛɛ bɛle ɛ kɔme avikpa.
10Me ra nrenya, saa ɛtanevolɛma bɛlɛbɛla wɔ ali wɔ adwenle a, mmakponle zolɛ. 11Saa bɛka bɛkile wɔ kɛ, “Maa yɛhɔ nzia wɔ adenle nu, yɛhu menli mɔɔ ɛnze nwolɛ bie; 12maa yɛyɛ yɛ nwo kɛ Ɛbolɔ, yɛme bɛ anyewɔzo, kɛ Ewule Kuma me menli mɔɔ wu la, 13na yɛbanyia ninyɛne mɔɔ sonle bolɛ la dɔɔnwo; yɛbanyia ninyɛne dɔɔnwo wɔ yɛ azua nu; 14yemɔti ɛ nee yɛ ɛyɛ ko na yɛ muala yɛ gya ɛyɛ ko” a, 15me ra nrenya, ɛ nee bɛ mmatu fee, 16ɔluakɛ bɛ gyakɛ ɛdudulɛ ne fa bɛ kɔ munzule nu, yɛɛ bɛle ahɔdiawu. 17Ɔluakɛ saa anloma anye gyi ɛ nwo na ɛgua ye asawu a, ɛgua ye mgbane. 18Menli ɛhye mɔ kɔ bɛdabɛ bɛ ngome bɛ ngoane nwo nzia, bɛdabɛ bɛ ngome bɛ mogya yɛɛ bɛkɔ nwolɛ nzia a. 19Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛfa menli ɛhunlɛ bɛkpondɛ anwonyia la adenle kɛ de la ɛne; bɛdabɛ bɛ ngome bɛ kɔdiawu anwonyia ne pɛ ɔ nwo ku bɛ.
Nrɛlɛbɛ ɛlɛfɛlɛ
20 Nrɛlɛbɛ ane la nu wɔ guabile ne mɔ azo, bɛte ɔ ne wɔ gua ne mɔ anu, 21ɔ ne dielie bane ne mɔ ati zo nee suakpole ne nlenkɛ mgbole ne mɔ anloa na ɔlɛka kɛ:
22“O bɛmɛ anzenwolɛbiema, bɛkulo kɛ bɛka bile nu toonwo ɔkɔdwu kenlenzu? Agolobɛnwoma, bɛ nye die bɛ agolobɛnwo nu toonwo yeahɔdwu kenlenzu, na ahoasea akpo adwenlenubukelɛ ahɔdwu kenlenzu? 23Saa metwi bɛ nyunlu a anrɛɛ bɛdie. Nea, mebaha me adwenle kɔsɔɔti meahile bɛ. Mebamaa bɛade me edwɛkɛ ne mɔ abo wienyi. 24Kɛmɔ mevɛlɛ bɛ na bɛkpo kɛ bɛnrɛdie me, medɛlɛ me sa nu, na awie biala ambandɔ nu, 25na bɛkpɔla bɛ nzo anzi wɔ me folɛdulɛ muala anwo, na bɛyɛ kɛ bɛnrɛva bɛ nyunlu mɔɔ metwi la bɛnrɛyɛ ɛhwee la, 26medame noko mebazele bɛ wɔ bɛ anwubɛnyunlu nu. Saa bɛ nye zo ta bɛ a, mebazi bɛ amgbu. 27Saa edwɛkɛ to bɛ maa bɛ nye zo ta bɛ kɛ menli mɔɔ ahumu ɛva bɛ, na munzule bigyi bɛ kɛ ahumuakyima, na nyane nee amaneɛnwunlɛ fa bɛ aze a, mebazele bɛ. 28Akee bɛbazu bɛavɛlɛ me, na menrɛdɛne bɛ zo, bɛbakpondɛ me kpalɛ kpalɛ, na bɛnrɛnwu me. 29Kɛmɔ bɛhyile adwenlenubukelɛ, na bɛanzulo Ɛdɛnkɛma, 30kɛmɔ bɛyɛle kɛ bɛnrɛbu me folɛdulɛ ne bie, na bɛkpole kɛ menwɔhwi bɛ nyunlu la, 31mɔɔ bɛyɛ la anwo aleɛ yɛɛ bɛbali a, na bɛdabɛ bɛ ngome bɛ adwenle ɛtane ne abɔ bɛ ti. 32Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnze nwolɛ bie la kakyi bɛ nzi si nrɛlɛbɛ na bɛwu, yɛɛ ahoasea ahunlundwolɛ sɛkye bɛ; 33na mɔɔ tie me ne la badɛnla anzonudwolɛ nu, ɔ nwo adɔ ye, mɔɔ ɔnrɛzulo munzule biala a.”

Title: MRƐ 2
Content:
Nrɛlɛbɛ ahatualɛ ne mɔ
1Me ra nrenya, saa ɛtie me edwɛkɛ ne, na ɛfa me mɛla ne mɔ ɛsie kpalɛ, 2ɛyɛ ɛnzonlɛ ɛtie nrɛlɛbɛ edwɛkɛ, na ɛfa wɔ adwenle ɛsie ndelebɛbo zo; 3ɛhɛe, saa ɛsu kɛ ɛkpondɛ adwenlenunwunlɛ, na ɛmaa ɛ ne zo kɛ ɛkpondɛ ndelebɛbo, 4saa ɛkpondɛ ye kɛ ɛkpondɛ ezukoa fufule, na ɛkpondɛ ye kpalɛ kɛ anwoneɛ mɔɔ vea la a, 5ɛbade Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛzulolɛ ne abo na wɔanyia Nyamenle anwo adwenlenubukelɛ, 6ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma maa nrɛlɛbɛ; ɔdaye yɛɛ ɔmaa adwenle nee ndelebɛbo a. 7Ɔfa nrɛlɛbɛ kpalɛ ɔmaa mɔɔ le tenlene la; ɔle enyinlike ɔmaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛze nrɛlɛbɛ la, 8ɔsinza bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdi pɛlepɛle la ɛbɛlabɔlɛ, na ɔmaa ye menli ne mɔɔ ɛdu bɛ nwo ɛmaa ye la anwo tɔ bɛ.
9Saa ɛtie me ne a, ɛbade pɛlepɛlelilɛ nee tenleneyɛlɛ, boɛlilɛ, yɛɛ adenle kpalɛ biala abo, 10ɔluakɛ ɛbanwu nrɛlɛbɛ na wɔ adwenle abuke kɛnlɛma bie. 11Ɛbava wɔ adwenle wɔabɔ ɛ nwo mgbɔlɔka, na wɔ ndelebɛbo azinza wɔ. 12Ɛbava wɔ adwenle wɔalie ɛ nwo wɔavi munzule adenle nu, nee mgbane mgbane ɛhanlɛma asa anu. 13Menli ɛhye mɔ kpo ndenle fɔɔnwo ne mɔ na bɛdua awozinli ndenle ne mɔ anu. 14Bɛ nye die ɛtaneyɛlɛ nwo, yɛɛ bɛ anyelielɛ a le ɛtanelilɛ ala. 15Bɛle menli mɔɔ bɛ ndenle nu kyeɛhyea, yɛɛ bɛle mɛlɛbɛla.
16Bɛbalie wɔ bɛavi raalɛ kpamgbanvolɛ anloa anu menlemenle ne asa anu, 17raalɛ zɛhae kpo ye mbɛlɛra nu ɔ hu, na ɔkpo ye Nyamenle ngyekyeleɛ ne, 18ɔluakɛ ye awuke bɔ bɔkɔɔ yɛɛ ye ɛbɛlabɔlɛ nu yɛ awozinli. 19Awie biala mɔɔ kɔ ye ɛkɛ ne la ɛnzia, yɛɛ ye ɛbɛla ɛnwie ye boɛ. 20Yemɔti ɛ nee menli kpalɛ ɛdu na dua tenlenema adenle nu, 21ɔluakɛ menli mɔɔ di boɛ la badɛnla azɛlɛ ne azo, yɛɛ menli mɔɔ ze nrɛlɛbɛ la baha zolɛ. 22Bɛbaye amumuyɛma bɛavi azɛlɛ ne azo, na bɛadu ngunzima bɛavi zolɛ.

Title: MRƐ 3
Content:
Mgbavolɛ folɛdulɛ
1Me ra nrenya, mmamaa ɛ rɛle fi me ngilehilelɛ ne; fa me mɛla ne mɔ sie wɔ ahonle nu, 2na bɛbamaa wɔanyi wɔahyɛ na wɔakpazi ɛbɛlabɔlɛ nu. 3Mmamaa ɛ rɛle fi kɛ ɛkɛyɛ tieyɛ na ɛkɛli nɔhalɛ; kyekye bɛ mu nwiɔ kenda ɛ kɔme na fa sie wɔ ahonle nu. 4 Ɛhye bamaa wɔazɔ ɛnyelɛ, wɔanyia dumamɔlɛ kpalɛ wɔ menli nee Nyamenle anyunlu.
5Yeye wɔ ahonle nu fa ɛ rɛle wula Ɛdɛnkɛma anu, mmafa wɔ adwenle ɛsɔ ɛ ngome wɔ nrɛlɛbɛ. 6Nwu Nyamenle wɔ wɔ ɛbɛlabɔlɛ muala anu, na ɔbamaa wɔ ndenle adenrɛ fɔɔnwo amaa wɔ. 7 Mmabu ɛ nwo kɛ ɛze nrɛlɛbɛ, sulo Ɛdɛnkɛma na twe ɛ nwo fi ɛtane nwo; 8ɔbayɛ ayileyɛlɛ yeamaa wɔ nwonane ne, na yeayɛ wɔ mbowule nu ayile. 9Fa ɛ nwo amuala di Ɛdɛnkɛma eni, na fa wɔ egyinli nu bɛyɔba mɔɔ lumua la maa ye, 10na wɔ bonwolo ne mɔ azo bayi tɛkɛɛ, na wɔ nwanye angola ne mɔ ayi abulubulu zo.
11 Me ra nrenya, saa Ɛdɛnkɛma tea wɔ adenrɛdenrɛ wɔ a, mmakpo, yɛɛ saa ɔtwi ɛ nyunlu a, mmamaa ɔyɛ wɔ ɛvɛlɛ, 12 ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma tea mɔɔ ɔkulo ye la, kɛmɔ selɛ tea ɔ ra nrenya mɔɔ ɔ nye die ɔ nwo la. 13Nyilalɛ ɛha sonla ne mɔɔ kɛnwu nrɛlɛbɛ na ɔkɛnyia ndelebɛbo la, 14ɔluakɛ mɔɔ ɔbanyia ye nu la tɛla dwɛtɛ fufule yɛɛ nvasoɛ mɔɔ ɔbanyia la tɛla ezukoa nvutuke. 15Nrɛlɛbɛ sonle bolɛ tɛla anwoneɛ yɛɛ debie biala mɔɔ sonla nye die nwolɛ la nee ye ɛnzɛ. 16Nrɛlɛbɛ lɛ ngoane tendenle wɔ ɔ sa fema ne anu, yɛɛ ɔlɛ anyiabɛnwo nee enililɛ wɔ bɛne ne anu. 17Nrɛlɛbɛ adenle nu le anyelielɛ nee anzonudwolɛ ngome. 18Ɔle ngoane baka ɔmaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsɔ nu boɛ la; bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsɔ nu boɛ la di fɛlɛko.
19Ɛdɛnkɛma vale ye nrɛlɛbɛ a bɔle ewiade a;
ɔvale ye ndelebɛbo a ɔbɔle anwumaneamra a.
20Ɔvale ye adwenle a ɔmanle buma ne mɔ rale,
na amungu ne mɔ tɔ ɛbɔlɛ gua azɛlɛ ye azo a.
21Me ra nrenya, sɔ nrɛlɛbɛ nee adwenlenunwunlɛ nu boɛ; mmamaa bɛfi ɛ sa, 22na bɛbayɛ ngoane nee ɛ kɔme ndweabane. 23Ɛhye bamaa wɔalua, ɛ nwo ayɛ kɔlɔnwo wɔ wɔ ɛlualɛ nu, yɛɛ ɛ gyakɛ ɛnrɛkpula. 24Saa ɛtɛnla aze a, ɛnrɛzulo, yɛɛ saa ɛda a, wɔ nafelɛ bayɛ wɔ fɛ. 25Anyezota ba arɛlevilɛ nu a, mmasulo, yɛɛ saa amumuyɛma ɛzɛkyelɛ mekɛ ne dwu a, mmasulo, 26ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma bamaa ɛ nwo ayɛ kɔlɔnwo; ɔnrɛmaa ɛnrɛdo ɛhane.
27Saa ɛyɛ na ɔkɛyɛ boɛ a, yɛ menli mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ ɛyɛ bɛ boɛ la boɛ. 28Mmaka ɛkile ɛ gɔnwo kɛ, “Kɔ na wɔara, ɛhyema mebava meamaa wɔ”, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ deɛ ne mɔɔ ɛfa wɔamaa ye la wɔ ɛ nwo ɛkɛ ne la. 29Mmafa ɛ gɔnwo mɔɔ ɛ nee ye zua bane, na yeva ɔ rɛle yewula wɔ nuhua la anwo adwenle ɛtane. 30Ɛ nee awie biala mɔɔ ɛtɛyɛle wɔ ɛtane la mmadi butule. 31Mmamaa ɛ nye bolo awie mɔɔ kulo konle la, yɛɛ mmayɛ mɔɔ ɔyɛ la bie, 32ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma kyi sonla mɔɔ ɛnli boɛ la, na ɔmaa mɔɔ di boɛ la nwu ye ngyehyɛlɛ ne. 33Ɛdɛnkɛma maa munzule tɔ amumuyɛma awuke nu, na ɔyila tenlenema awuke. 34Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛmbu bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛmbu debie la bie, na ɔ nye wɔ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛle bɛlɛvo la anwo zo. 35Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛze nrɛlɛbɛ la, bɛbali bɛ eni, na ahoasea anyunlu bagua aze.

Title: MRƐ 4
Content:
Nrɛlɛbɛ zo nvasoɛ
1O me mra mrenya, bɛdie bɛ ze ngilehilelɛ na bɛva bɛzie boɛ, amaa bɛanyia ndelebɛbo, 2ɔluakɛ melɛmaa bɛ mɛla kpalɛ, bɛmmakpo me ngilehilelɛ ne. 3Mekɛ mɔɔ mele kakula na me nee egya de, mele ekyi bie, na me ngome a ɔmɔ anye die me nwo la, 4egya hilehilele me, na ɔzele me kɛ, “Sɔ me nloa edwɛkɛ nu boɛ kpalɛ, di me mɛla zo na wɔanyia ngoane. 5Mmamaa ɛ rɛle fi, yɛɛ mmakpo me nloa edwɛkɛ. Nwu nrɛlɛbɛ na nyia ndelebɛbo. 6Mmakpo nrɛlɛbɛ, na ɔbazie wɔ boɛ; kulo nrɛlɛbɛ, na ɔbazinza wɔ. 7Nrɛlɛbɛnwunlɛ bo ɛbɔlɛ a le ɛhye: Nwu nrɛlɛbɛ, yɛɛ debie biala mɔɔ ɛkɛnyia ye la, nyia ndelebɛbo. 8Kulo nrɛlɛbɛ, na ɔbamaa wɔayɛ sonlakpole; die ye ɛ sa amu nwiɔ, na ɔbamaa wɔanyia ɛ nyunlu. 9Ɔbayɛ ndotolo kɔtɔlɔba abɔtile kɛnlɛma nee belemgbunli kyɛlɛ kɛnlɛma wɔ ɛ ti zo.”
10Me ra nrenya, tie na die me edwɛkɛ ne to nu, amaa wɔanyi wɔahyɛ. 11Mehile wɔ nrɛlɛbɛ ndenle ne mɔ; meva wɔ melua tenlene ndenle ne mɔ anu. 12Saa ɛlɛtia a ɛ gyakɛ ɛnrɛdo ɛnrɛbɛka nu, yɛɛ saa ɛlɛnriandi a ɛ gyakɛ ɛnrɛkpula. 13Sɔ folɛdulɛ nu boɛ, mmagyakyi nuhua, sie ye boɛ, ɔluakɛ yemɔ azo yɛɛ wɔ ngoane gyi a. 14Mmafa amumuyɛma adenle nu, yɛɛ mmafa ɛtanema adenle nu. 15Kpo zɔhane adenle ne bɔkɔɔ, mmafa zolɛ ɛlɛ. Kakyi ɛ nzi si adenle zɔhane na pɛ nuhua kɔ, 16ɔluakɛ menli mɔɔ fa zɔhane adenle zo la ɛnla kyesɛ bɛli ɛtane. Saa bɛtɛmanle awie ɛtɛtule koti a, bɛngola da, 17ɔluakɛ bɛ aleɛ mɔɔ bɛdi la a le amumuyɛ, yɛɛ bɛ nza mɔɔ bɛ nye die nwolɛ la a le konle.
18Tenlenema adenle nu le wienyi kɛ nwonlomɔ sɛnzɛne mɔɔ kɛkpuke la, ɔfi, ɔta toonwo ɔyɛ kɛ sɛnzɛngyinla ewia. 19Amumuyɛma adenle nu le awozinli kabii, bɛlua nu na bɛkpula a bɛnnwu ye.
20Me ra nrenya, tie me edwɛkɛ ne boɛ; yɛ ɛnzonlɛ tie mɔɔ meka la. 21Mmamaa bɛminli wɔ adwenle nu; fa sie wɔ ahonle nu. 22Ɔluakɛ bɛle ngoane bɛmaa sonla ne mɔɔ kɛnwu bɛ la, na bɛle ayileyɛlɛ bɛmaa ye nwonane ne. 23Nea kɛ ɛsi ɛdwenle la boɛ, ɔluakɛ nuhua yɛɛ wɔ ngoane vi ba a. 24Mmaka edwɛkɛ mɔɔ ɛnle nɔhalɛ la, yɛɛ mmamaa ɛ nloa fula adalɛ edwɛkɛ. 25Nea ɛ nyunlu fɔɔnwo, yɛɛ ɛnea debie a nea ye boɛ. 26 Nea kɛ ɛsi ɛtudu ɛ gyakɛ la, amaa wɔ adwenle azi pi wɔ wɔ ndenle nu. 27Mmatɔ ɛkɔ fema zo anzɛɛ bɛne zo; twe ɛ gyakɛ fi ɛtane adenle zo.

Title: MRƐ 5
Content:
Awuvolɛvalɛ nwo kɔkɔbɔlɛ
1Me ra nrenya, tie me nrɛlɛbɛ edwɛkɛ ne na wɔanwu kɛ me ndelebɛbo si kɔ la, 2amaa wɔanwu kɛ ɛsi wɔabɔ wɔ ɛbɛla ne kpalɛ la, na wɔ ɛdendɛlɛ ahile kɛ ɛlɛ adwenle. 3Ɔluakɛ raalɛ mgbane biala anloa anu yɛ fɛ kɛ wolɛ, yɛɛ ye ɛdendɛlɛ fie tɛla ɛdɔkɛ, 4noko awieleɛ ne ye ɛnwonle tɛla baka subo, yɛɛ ɔ nloa nlane le kɛ dadeɛ anye nwiɔ. 5Ɔ gyakɛ ɛdudulɛ twehwe sonla kɔ ewule nu; sonla fa ye adenle zo a, ɔ nee ye dwu Ɛbolɔ. 6Ɔndwenle ngoane adenle nwo; ye ndenle ɛngɔ fɔɔnwo, yɛɛ ɔlɛminli a ɔnnwu ye.
7O me mra mrenya, bɛdie me, bɛmmamaa bɛ rɛle fi me edwɛkɛ mɔɔ melɛka la. 8Bɛhwe bɛ nwo bɛvi raalɛ mɔɔ le zɛhae la anwo! Bɛmmabikye ye sua ne anuhɔlɛ bɔbɔ, 9anrɛɛ bɛkɛminli bɛ anyunlunyia bɛkɛmaa awie mɔ kɛva, na bɛ ngoane zo kɛde wɔ menli mɔɔ ɛnze anwunvɔne la asa anu; 10anrɛɛ nyɛvolɛ kɛva bɛ anwonyia, na bɛ gyima mɔɔ bɛvɛ bɛhyehyɛ la apɛ ali nyɛvolɛ asa anu. 11Akee awieleɛ ne mɔɔ bɛ anwosesebɛ kɛwie, bɛ nwonane kɛwie, na bɛ ɛbɛlabɔlɛ ne ɛlɛba awieleɛ la, ɛnee yedo bɛ nee ɛkponlenlɛ. 12Akee biala baha kɛ, “Ɛnee mekyi sonla nyunlu ɛhwilɛ, yɛɛ meangulo kɛ awie kɛdendɛ me nyunlu. 13Meandie me kilehilevolɛma ane, yɛɛ meanyɛ ɛnzonlɛ meandie folɛdulɛ. 14Mɔɔ menwunle ye la a le kɛ, menli ne yiale la, ɔhale kyɛkyɛ na me nyunlu agua aze.”
15No ɛdawɔ wɔ buakɛ nu nzule. No ɛdawɔ wɔ bula nu nzule. 16Asoo ɛbakponle wɔamaa awie aza wɔ bula nu nzule ado agua mgbane wɔ gua zo? 17Maa ɔyɛ ɛ ngome wɔ ɛdeɛ, mmamaa ɔyɛ nyɛvolɛ mɔɔ ɛ nee bɛ de la ɛdeɛ. 18Maa wɔ nzubula ne ɛyɛ nyilalɛ ɛmaa wɔ, na maa ɛ nye ɛlie ɛ ye mɔɔ ɛkɛgya ye wɔ mgbavolɛ nu la anwo, 19kɛ ɔ nwo yɛ fɛ kɛ weɛlɛ belɛ. Maa ɛ nye ɛlie ye anwofɛlɛko ne anwo mekɛ biala, na maa ye ɛhulolɛ ne ɛli ɛ ti. 20Me ra nrenya, duzu ati a ɛkɛmaa raalɛ mgbane biala ɛhulolɛ kɛli ɛ ti, na ɛkɛdɔ raalɛ wɔlɔkavolɛ akɛnra anu ɛ? 21Ɔluakɛ sonla nrenya biala ɛbɛlabɔlɛ la Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu, yɛɛ ɔneɛnlea sonla ndenle kɔsɔɔti anu. 22Amumuyɛnli biala ninyɛndane kakyi ɛhane kye ye, yɛɛ ɔkye ye wɔ ye nyɛleɛ ɛtane ne mɔ ɛyɛlɛ nu. 23Ye koasea ti, ɔminli, yɛɛ ɔnde folɛ la ati, ɔwu ndɛ.

Title: MRƐ 6
Content:
Kɔkɔbɔlɛ dɔɔnwo bieko
1Me ra nrenya, saa wɔli ɛ gɔnwo bie agyinlanu, wɔva debie wɔwula awoba wɔ ɛyɛvolɛ bie ati, 2saa ɛ nloa ɛvula edwɛkɛ bie na yehwe dwɛwɔlɛ yemaa wɔ a, 3ɛnee me ra nrenya, yɛ ɛhye die ɛ nwo, ɔluakɛ wɔva ɛ nwo wɔdo ɛ gɔnwo ne ɛhane nu: ka ɛ nwo kɔ na kɔbodo ɛ gɔnwo ne. 4Mmada ɛdafe anzɛɛ mmamuomua ɛ nye ɛbɔ ngɔsɔkɛ. 5Die ɛ nwo kɛ weɛlɛ die ɔ nwo fi bɔvolɛ sa nu la, anzɛɛ kɛ anloma die ɔ nwo fi mɔɔ sua nlomangane la asa anu la.
6O mgbovonle, kɔ ngyigyilira ɛkɛ ne, kɔnlea ye ndenle ne mɔ na sukoa nrɛlɛbɛ. 7Bɛnlɛ belemgbunli, bɛnlɛ maanle kpanyinli anzɛɛ maanlebuvolɛ biala, 8noko bɛkuohua bɛ aleɛ nloa wɔ wawaa nu, yɛɛ ɛbuhenle ne dwu a, bɛboɔboa debie biala mɔɔ kɛmaa bɛkɛnyia ngoane la anloa. 9Na wɔmɔ mgbovonle, ɛda wɔahɔdwu kenlenzu? Kenlenzu yɛɛ ɛvi nafelɛ nu ɛkɛdwazo a? 10 Nla ekyi, ngɔsɔkɛbɔlɛ ɛkyi, bɛ sa tobɛkanu ekyi kɛ ɛdie wɔ ɛnwomenle, 11ɛkanwu ye la ɛnee ehyia ɛyɛ kɛ awule, ɛva wɔ aze, na ɛ nwo ɛhyele wɔ kɛ ɛgyi konle nloa.
12Sonla mgbane, amumuyɛnli, ɔlua a ɔtendɛ mgbane mgbane, 13ɔnwosonwoso ɔ nye, ɔsisi ɔ gyakɛ aze, ɔtende ɔ sa, 14ɔbɔ adwenle ɛtane, ɔsie munzule, na ɔtwehwe manzonle ɔto menli avinli. 15Yemɔti munzule bado ye arɛlevilɛ nu; ɔkanwu ye la ɛnee bɛbubu ye kɛ abua, ɛsisia ye zolɛ a ɔnyɛ boɛ.
16-19Ninyɛne nsia a wɔ ɛkɛ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma kyi a, ninyɛne nsuu a le ye kyibadeɛ a:
Anyehoanlɛ ɛbulɛ,
adalɛ ɛbɔlɛ,
kɔdiawu ɛyɛlɛ,
amumuyɛ adwenle ɛvalɛ
kukukyɛngyɛ mɔɔ twe sonla kɔ munzule nu,
sonla mɔɔ bɔ adalɛ, di dasewia,
yɛɛ sonla nrenya mɔɔ twehwe manzonle to mediema avinli la.
Awuvolɛvalɛ nwo kɔkɔbɔlɛ
20Me ra nrenya, di ɛ ze mɛla zo, yɛɛ mmamaa ɛ rɛle fi ɛ nli ngilehilelɛ. 21Fa bɛ sie wɔ ahonle nu dahuu; kyekye bɛ kenda ɛ kɔme. 22Bɛbali ɛ nyunlu wɔ wɔ ɛhɔlɛ nu, ɛda a bɛbazinza wɔ, yɛɛ ɛdwazo a bɛbadendɛ bɛahile wɔ, 23ɔluakɛ mɛla ne le kɛnlaneɛ, ngilehilelɛ ne le wienyi, yɛɛ ahwibɛnyunlu ne kile ɛbɛlabɔlɛ adenle. 24Bɛtwe wɔ bɛfi raalɛ munzule ne, raalɛ kpamgbanvolɛ anloa anu menlemenle ne anwo. 25Mmanea ye anwofɛlɛko ne anwo ɛkulo ye, yɛɛ mmamaa ɔ nye anzi enrinli ne di wɔ adwenle, 26ɔluakɛ tuutuu biala, bɛfa kpanwo kunguma ko ala a bɛbɔ ye ɛkpa a, na awuvolɛ raalɛ ɛvalɛ kpokpo nrenya ku ye.
27Asoo sonla bahola avula samɛnlakɛ agua ɔ kɛnra azo, mɔɔ ye tɛladeɛ ne ɛnrɛyela a? 28Anzɛɛ asoo sonla bahola atietia samɛnlakɛ zo, mɔɔ ɔ gyakɛ ɛnrɛyela a? 29Zɔhane ala yɛɛ sonla mɔɔ fa ɔ gɔnwo aye la ɛnrɛva ɔ nwo dwɔɔ ɛnrɛhɔ a. 30Asoo ɛhɔne ɛlɛku sonla, na ɔkɔwua debie ɔdi a, menli ɛmkpo ye ɔ? 31Na saa bɛkye ye a asoo bɛnrɛmaa ɔnrɛdua ye mɔnwo nsuu ɔ? Ɔbahwe ye sua nu ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti yeahɔdua. 32Sonla mɔɔ fa awuvolɛ raalɛ la ɛnlɛ adwenle; sonla mɔɔ yɛ ɛhye la sɛkye ɔ nwo. 33Ɔ nyunlu bagua aze, ɔ nwo ayɛ nganlɛ, na ye anyiemgba doa ye dahuu, 34ɔluakɛ nungule maa sonla fa ɛya kpole, yɛɛ saa ɔlɛdi nzenralɛ noko a anwunvɔnezelɛ biala ɛnle nu. 35Ɔnrɛlie mgbɔdalɛ biala, yɛɛ ɛkyɛ ye ninyɛne mɔnwo mɔnwo bɔbɔ a ɔ kunlu ɛnrɛdwo.

Title: MRƐ 7
Content:
1Me ra nrenya, di me edwɛkɛ zo na fa me mɛla ne mɔ sie boɛ. 2Di me mɛla zo na nyia ngoane. Sie me ngilehilelɛ ne kɛ ɛ nye kuduarizi. 3Fa kyekye ɛ sa mrɛlɛsɛka ne mɔ, kɛlɛ bɛ wɔ wɔ ahonle zo. 4Ka kile nrɛlɛbɛ kɛ, “Ɛle me diema raalɛ,” na fɛlɛ adwenlenunwunlɛ kɛ ɔle ɛ gɔnwo kpalɛ kpalɛ; 5amaa bɛalie wɔ bɛavi raalɛ mgbane ne asa anu, raalɛ wɔlɔkavolɛ anloa anu menlemenle ne asa anu.
Raalɛ adwɔmanenli
6Kenle ko, ɛnee megyi me nvɛnzɛlɛ ne anu me nye dua alie nwo lɔ, 7na menwunle kpavolɛ bie wɔ mgbavolɛ bie mɔɔ ɛnze nwolɛ bie la avinli kɛ yemɔ ɔnze nrɛlɛbɛ fee. 8Menwunle kɛ ɛnee ɔlua kpalɛ ne azo na yeva kodoka bie mɔɔ raalɛ bie de nu la adenle zo. 9Mekɛ ne anu ɛnee aleɛ ɛlɛdwo na maanle nu ɛyɛ yɛɛnye, asɛɛ awozinli ɛra bɔbɔ. 10Na nea, raalɛ bie mɔɔ ɛheda ye ɛdanlɛ kɛ tuutuu, na yeyɛ ye adwenle kɛ ɔbɛlɛbɛla ye yeahwe ye yeahɔ la yiale ye. 11Raalɛ ne le sonla mɔɔ ɛndɛnla ye sua nu yɛɛ ɔtendɛ kpukpakpukpa. 12Ɛkanwu ye la ɛnee ɔlua guabile ne azo, ɛnwu ye bieko la ɛnee ɔlua gua nu lɔ, yɛɛ kodoka biala anu ɔkɔ atɛ. 13Ɔzɔle kpavolɛ ne, ɔvole ɔ nloa anwo, na ɔyɛle ɔ nyunlu monvoo ɔzele ye kɛ, 14“Ɛnee ɔwɔ kɛ mebɔ azu, na ɛnɛ meye me ɛwɔkɛ ne mɔ amuala; 15yemɔti kɛkala mera kɛ akee mebayia wɔ. Meyɛ kɛ mebakpondɛ wɔ yɛɛ meranwu wɔ a. 16Metoto me ɛkpa ne mewie, meva Yigyibiti lenen ɛdanlɛ kpalɛ mezɛ zolɛ. 17Meva alufuanlɛ, kolɔbo, yɛɛ baka evuanlɛ senamɔn meyɛ sua ne anu mukumuku zɛhae. 18Bɛla maa yɛlie yɛ nye, yɛhulo yɛ nwo toonwo alehyenlɛ. 19Me hu ɛnle sua nu; yedu adenle yehɔ moa. 20Ɔkɔ la ɔvale ezukoa dɔɔnwo, yɛɛ siane ye bahɔ awozinli na yeara.” 21Ɔvale anloa anu menlemenle nee ɛdendɛlɛ kɛnlɛma ɔlile ye adwenle. 22Ɛkɛ ne ala ɔlile ɔ nzi ɔ nee ye hɔle kɛ asɛɛ ɛnlankɛ mɔɔ bɛ nee ye ɛlɛkɔ ahunleɛ, anzɛɛ kɛtɛboɛ mɔɔ bɛhye ye ɛhane nu 23toonwo na ɛda kɛwɔ ye kɛtulu ye anyalɛ la. Kɛ anloma si tu faa kɔtɔ ɛhane nu la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ ɔyɛle a; yeandwenle nwolɛ kɛ mɔɔ ɔlɛyɛ la kɛwie ye ewule.
24Akee kɛkala, me mra mrenya, bɛdie me, na bɛyɛ ɛnzonlɛ bɛdie me nloa edwɛkɛ. 25Bɛmmamaa bɛ adwenle kɔ ye adwenle ngyehyɛlɛ zo, yɛɛ bɛmmaminli bɛfa ye adenle zo ɛlɛ, 26ɔluakɛ bɛdabɛ dɔɔnwo mɔɔ bɛgua ye ɛhane nu la ɛyɛ mgbane; menli mɔɔ yehu bɛ la zonle kpalɛ. 27Ɛbolɔ Adenle la ye sua nu ɛkɛ, ɔla nu kpolomgbolo ɔdwu ewule suakunlu.

Title: MRƐ 8
Content:
Nrɛlɛbɛ ayɛlɛyelɛ
1 Bɛdie, nrɛlɛbɛ ɛlɛfɛlɛ,
ndelebɛbo ɛmaa ɔ ne zo ɛlɛfɛlɛ.
2Ɔgyi adehane awoka ne mɔ azo,
ɔgyi ndenle ngyikyi ne mɔ anu ɔlɛfɛlɛ;
3ɔlɛfɛlɛ wɔ sua ne azo nlenkɛ mgbole ne mɔ anloa,
ɔtea nu kpole kpalɛ wɔ anuhɔlɛ ne mɔ anloa kɛ,
4“O menli, melɛfɛlɛ bɛ,
melɛfɛlɛ dasanli biala.
5O bɛmɛ mɔɔ bɛ adwenle ɛtɛtinle a,
bɛzukoa nrɛlɛbɛ;
O menli ahoasea, bɛyɛ ɛnzonlɛ bɛdie.
6Bɛdie, ɔluakɛ meka edwɛkɛ kɛnlɛma;
mɔɔ vi me nloa anu bavinde la le kpalɛ,
7ɔluakɛ mebaha nɔhalɛ ne;
me nloa kyi amumuyɛ edwɛkɛ ɛhehanlɛ.
8Edwɛkɛ biala mɔɔ vi me nloa anu la le tenlene edwɛkɛ;
adalɛ ɛnle nu anzɛɛ abɛladolɛ ɛnle nu.
9Ɔle fɔɔnwo ɔmaa mɔɔ te ɔ bo la,
yɛɛ ɔle kpalɛ ɔmaa mɔɔ kpondɛ adwenlenubukelɛ la.
10Fa me ngilehilelɛ ne na gyakyi dwɛtɛ fufule,
fa adwenlenubukelɛ na gyakyi ezukoa nvutuke tagyee.
11“Nrɛlɛbɛ le kpalɛ tɛla mgbɔba,
debie biala mɔɔ ɛkulo kɛ ɛnyia ye la nee ye ɛnzɛ.
12Medame nrɛlɛbɛ, menwu adwenle biala anu,
melɛ adwenlenubukelɛ yɛɛ adwenle la me ɛdendɛlɛ nwo.
13Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛzulolɛ le ɛtane ɛhyilɛ.
Mekyi adubɛnwo, mekyi mgbanyizonle,
mekyi ɛdendɛlɛ adalɛ.
14Metu folɛ, mekile nrɛlɛbɛ adenle kpalɛ,
melɛ ndelebɛbo yɛɛ me nwo yɛ se.
15Me nwo zo yɛɛ arelemgbunli dua bu maanle,
na bɛdi mɛla mɔɔ le tenlene la a.
16Me nwo zo yɛɛ maanle mgbanyinli dua bu maanle,
na amɛnladoma dua sie ewiade ye a.
17Mekulo bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkulo me la,
yɛɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ nye bolo bɛkpondɛ me la nwu me.
18Anwonyia nee enililɛ le me ɛdeɛ,
memaa ɛkpazilɛ nee bɛ nwo ɛnyianlɛ di munli.
19Meso ma a ɔsonle bolɛ ɔtɛla ezukoa nvutuke tagyee,
me nzoleɛ sonle bolɛ tɛla dwɛtɛ fufule tagyee.
20Medua tenleneyɛlɛ adenle nu,
medua pɛlepɛlelilɛ adenle nu.
21Memaa menli mɔɔ kulo me la nyia bɛ nwo,
na memaa bɛ gya nu yɛ ɛnlomboɛ.
22 “Medame a Ɛdɛnkɛma lumuale bɔle me a,
medame a mɔmoane mɔmoane mele ɔ sa anloa gyima mɔɔ
lumua a.
23Ɔbɔle me dɛbadɛba wɔ ɛvolɛ dɔɔnwo mɔɔ ɛze ɛhɔ,
kolaa na ewiade abɔ ɔ bo.
24Mekɛ mɔɔ buma ɛnle ɛkɛ ne la yɛɛ bɛwole me a,
mɔɔ nzubula ɛnle ɛkɛ la yɛɛ bɛwole me a.
25Bɛwole me kolaa na bɛabɔ awoka mgbole ne mɔ,
bɛwole me kolaa na awoka ngyikyi aragyinlegyinla bɛ bo zo ne mɔ.
26Bɛwole me kolaa na Ɛdɛnkɛma abɔ ewiade nee kpɔkɛ,
kolaa na yeabɔ azɛlɛ.
27Mekɛ mɔɔ ɔbɔ anwumaneamra,
mɔɔ ɔpɛ kondongolohwio wɔ azubuma nye la, mewɔ ɛkɛ.
28Mekɛ mɔɔ ɔkabɔ anwomanyunlu amungu ne mɔ,
mekɛ mɔɔ ɔkabɔ buma nu nzule mgbole ne mɔ,
29mekɛ mɔɔ ɔgya nyevile ne ɛweɛne,
amaa nuhua nzule ambulu ye mɛla zo,
mekɛ mɔɔ ɔwula azɛlɛ ye adiabo aze la,
30ɛnee me nee ye a lua a,
kɛ mele dwinvolɛ mɔɔ medi me ti anwo;
memaa ɔ nye die dahuu,
yɛɛ dahuu biala me nye die wɔ ɔ nyunlu.
31Me nye die ye ewiade ye mɔɔ nuhua ɛyɛ gbudugbudu,
yɛɛ me nye die menli nwo.
32“Na kɛkala, me mra mrenya, bɛdie me;
bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛfa me ndenle zo la di fɛlɛko.
33Bɛdie folɛdulɛ na bɛnwu nrɛlɛbɛ,
bɛmmakpo mɔɔ bɛkilehile bɛ la.
34Sonla mɔɔ tie me ne,
mɔɔ dahuu gyi me nlenkɛ mgbole nloa,
na ɔkendɛ me wɔ me anuhɔlɛ la bali fɛlɛko.
35Mɔɔ kpondɛ me la nyia ngoane,
yɛɛ ɔsɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anye;
36na mɔɔ asa kɛhoati me la baboda;
bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkyi me la amuala kulo ewule.”

Title: MRƐ 9
Content:
Nrɛlɛbɛ nee kɔnwɔneyɛlɛ
1Nrɛlɛbɛ ɛzi ye sua na yedwazo mpila nsuu yesosɔ ye. 2Yehu ye nane ne mɔ, yefonlɔfonla ye nwanye ne na yedo ye ɛkponle ne yewie. 3Akee yezoa ye sonvolɛ mraalɛ ne mɔ kɛ bɛhɔgyinlegyinla mgbata ne mɔ azo na bɛdea nuhua bɛvɛlɛ kɛ, 4“Menli mɔɔ ɛnze nwolɛ bie la, bɛrɛla ɛke!” Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnlɛ adwenle la, ɔse bɛ kɛ, 5“Bɛrɛla, bɛrali me aleɛ ne na bɛnlo me nwanye mɔɔ meli ye afonla la. 6Bɛ nee menli mɔɔ bɛ adwenle ɛtɛtinle la mmatu, na bɛanyia ngoane; bɛva adwenle bɛdo bɛ ɛbɛlabɔlɛ nwo.”
7Sonla mɔɔ twi sonlamgbane nyunlu la die aholoba, yɛɛ mɔɔ twi sonla mɔɔ le amumuyɛ la anyunlu la boda. 8Mmatwi sonla mɔɔ bu ɔ nwo bie la anyunlu, anrɛɛ ɔkɛhyi wɔ. Twi sonla mɔɔ ze nrɛlɛbɛ la anyunlu, na ɔbahulo wɔ edwɛkɛ. 9Tu sonla mɔɔ ze nrɛlɛbɛ la folɛ, na ye nrɛlɛbɛ bayɛ kpole; kilehile sonla mɔɔ le tenlene la, na ye adwenle badi kpalɛ.
10 Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛzulolɛ le nrɛlɛbɛ ɛzukoalɛ bo ɛbɔlɛ, yɛɛ ɛnwu Nwuanzanwuanza Ko ne a, ɛlɛ ndelebɛbo, 11ɔluakɛ ɔlua nrɛlɛbɛ zo yɛɛ wɔ mekɛ bawa na wɔanyia ɛvolɛ dɔɔnwo wɔaboka wɔ ngoane mekɛ nwo a. 12Saa ɛze nrɛlɛbɛ a, ɛze nrɛlɛbɛ ɛmaa ɛ nwo; saa ɛtendɛ mgbane mgbane a, nwolɛ ɛzonle ne zo ɛdawɔ ɛ ngome.
13Raalɛ koasea tendɛ mgbane mgbane, ɔnli ɔ nwo eni, yɛɛ ɔnze nyiane. 14Ɔdwazo a ɔtɛnla ye sua ne anlenkɛ ne anloa, yɛɛ sua ne azo mgbata ne mɔ azo, 15ɔfɛlɛvɛlɛ menli mɔɔ ɛlɛse, mɔɔ bɛdabɛ bɛlɛdwenle bɛ nwo la kɛ, 16“Sonla mɔɔ ye adwenle ɛtɛtinle la ɛrɛla ɛke!” Na yeaha yeahile mɔɔ ɛnlɛ adwenle la kɛ, 17“Awule nzule yɛ fɛ, na aleɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛvea bɛkɛli la yɛ fɛ somaa.” 18Mrenya mɔɔ kɔ ye ɛkɛ ne la ɛnze kɛ bɛkɔ ye ɛkɛ ne a bɛnzia, yɛɛ menli mɔɔ ɛhɔ ye ɛkɛ ne la wɔ Ɛbolɔ sua zo.

Title: MRƐ 10
Content:
Sɔlɔmɔn mrɛlɛ ne mɔ
1Belemgbunli Sɔlɔmɔn mrɛlɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ ɔbule la ɛne: Ralɛ nrenya mɔɔ ze nrɛlɛbɛ la maa ɔ ze anye die, yɛɛ ralɛ nrenya koasea maa ɔ nli di nyane.
2Nvasoɛ biala ɛnle anwonyia mɔɔ sonla kɛlua amumuyɛ zo kɛnyia ye la azo, tenleneyɛlɛ die sonla fi ewule nu.
3Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛmmaa ɛhɔne ɛngu sonla mɔɔ le tenlene la, na ɔsɛkye amumuyɛnli ne anyebolo anwonyia ɛkpondɛlɛ.
4Ehyia ku mgbovonle, yɛɛ gyima ɛsesebɛ ɛyɛlɛ maa sonla nyia ɔ nwo.
5Ralɛ nrenya mɔɔ kuohua ye bɛyɔba nloa wɔ wawaa nu la ze nrɛlɛbɛ, na ralɛ nrenya mɔɔ da dafe wɔ ɛbuhenle mekɛ la bɔ anyiemgba.
6Sonla mɔɔ le tenlene la nyia nyilalɛ. Amumuyɛnli anloa edwɛkɛ kedɛheda ye kɔdiawu ɛbɛla zo.
7Tenlenema ɛhakyelɛ le nyilalɛ, na amumuyɛnli duma baminli.
8Sonla mɔɔ ze nrɛlɛbɛ la di mɛla zo, na koasea ɛdendɛzoma fa ɔ nwo to munzule nu.
9Sonla mɔɔ fa nɔhalɛlilɛ dua la anwo kɔlɔnwo, na sonla mɔɔ fa adwenle ɛtane dua la anwo bala zo.
10Sonla mɔɔ bu anyehoanlɛ la twe dwɛwɔlɛ ba, na mɔɔ buke ye munli nu tendɛ la fa anzonudwolɛ ba.
11Sonlakpalɛ ɛdendɛlɛ le ngoane nzufeanvea, na amumuyɛnli anloa edwɛkɛ kedɛheda ye kɔdiawu ɛbɛla zo.
12 Ɛkpɔlɛ twehwe konle, na ɛhulolɛ kedɛheda nvonleɛ kɔsɔɔti azo.
13Nrɛlɛbɛ wɔ sonla mɔɔ lɛ ndelebɛbo la ɛdendɛlɛ nu, na sonla mɔɔ ɛnlɛ adwenle la anzi fɛta empele.
14Menli mɔɔ ze nrɛlɛbɛ la lɛ adwenle, na koasea mɔɔ tendɛ kpukpakpukpa la twe munzule ba.
15Sukoavolɛ anwonyia le ye aranemgbole mɔɔ yɛ se; ehyia sɛkye ehyianli.
16Tenlenenli ahatualɛ a le ngoane, na amumuyɛnli nvasoɛ a le ɛtane.
17Sonla mɔɔ tie folɛdulɛ la lua ngoane adenle nu, na mɔɔ kpo ahwibɛnyunlu la minli.
18Sonla biala mɔɔ fea ɛkpɔlɛ zo la le adalɛ, yɛɛ mɔɔ le ngunzi la le koasea.
19Saa ɛdendɛlɛ so somasoma a, mɛladonlɛ ɛnli mgbanwo, na mɔɔ sɔ ɔ nloa la ze nrɛlɛbɛ.
20Sonlakpalɛ ɛdendɛlɛ le dwɛtɛ fufule kpalɛ; amumuyɛnli adwenle nwo ɛnlɛ nvasoɛ biala.
21Sonlakpalɛ ɛdendɛlɛ maa menli dɔɔnwo nyia aleɛ di, na ahoasea wu, ɔluakɛ bɛnlɛ adwenle.
22Ɛdɛnkɛma nyilalɛ maa sonla nyia ɔ nwo, yɛɛ ɔnva nyanelilɛ biala ɔmboka nwolɛ.
23Koasea yɛ debie ɛtane a ɔfa ye nwɔhoalilɛ, na nrɛlɛbɛ nyɛleɛ maa sonla mɔɔ lɛ ndelebɛbo la di fɛlɛko.
24Mɔɔ amumuyɛnli sulo ye la bara ɔ nwo zo, na sonlakpalɛ biala nyia debie mɔɔ ɔkpondɛ la.
25Saa ahumu ne tu se a, amumuyɛnli ne ɛnle ɛkɛ ne bieko, na sonlakpalɛ ne wɔ ɛkɛ ne dahuu.
26Kɛ nzanvinli si nyia egyele, nee kɛ esike si dɔ ɛnyelɛ la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ mgbovonle de maa menli mɔɔ soa ye la a.
27Sonla mɔɔ sulo Ɛdɛnkɛma la lɛ ngoane tendenle, na amumuyɛma mekɛ le ezinraa.
28Sonlakpalɛ anyelazo wie fɛlɛkolilɛ nu, na amumuyɛma anyelazo le mgbane.
29Ɛdɛnkɛma le ɛvealeka kpole maa sonla mɔɔ di boɛ la, na ɔsɛkye bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛyɛ ɛtane la.
30Bɛnrɛdu tenlenema ɛlɛ, na amumuyɛma ɛnrɛdɛnla azɛlɛ ne azo ɛlɛ.
31Tenlenenli ɛdendɛlɛ fa nrɛlɛbɛ ba, na sonla mɔɔ tendɛ mgbane mgbane la bɛbaye ye zo.
32Tenlenema ze mɔɔ bɛka a menli die to nu la, na amumuyɛma ka mɔɔ futu ahonle la.

Title: MRƐ 11
Content:
1Ɛdɛnkɛma kyi tone mɔɔ bɛwua nu la, na ɔ nye die tone mɔɔ bɛnwua nu la anwo.
2Saa adubɛnwo yɛ kpole a, anyiemgba a li ɔ nzi a; na mɔɔ le bɛlɛvo la nwu nrɛlɛbɛ.
3Sonlakpalɛ biala nɔhalɛlilɛ a sinza ye a, na asiayɛ biala ngunziyɛlɛ sɛkye ye.
4Anwonyia nwo ɛnlɛ nvasoɛ wɔ ɛya kenle ne anu, na tenleneyɛlɛ die sonla fi ewule nu.
5Nɔhalɛlilɛ maa sonlakpalɛ ɛbɛlabɔlɛ toa zo fɔɔnwo, na amumuyɛnli amumuyɛ bu sia ye.
6Sonlakpalɛ tenleneyɛlɛ die ye fi munzule nu, na ngunzinli atiakunluwɔzo ɛtane kye ye nuokɛ.
7Saa amumuyɛnli wu a, ye anyelazo minli, yɛɛ sonla mɔɔ ɛnze Nyamenle la anyelazo ɛnyɛ zɔ ɛlɛ.
8Bɛdie tenlenenli ne bɛfi ngyegyelɛ nu, na amumuyɛnli ne tɔ nu.
9Sonla mɔɔ ɛnze Nyamenle la fa ɔ nloa sɛkye ɔ gɔnwo, na tenlenema fa adwenle die bɛ nwo.
10Saa ɔyɛ boɛ ɔmaa tenlenenli a, suakpole ne azo amra amuala anye die, na saa amumuyɛnli wu a, zolɛ le fɛlɛkolilɛ ngome.
11Tenlenema nyilalɛ kpogya suakpole zo, na amumuyɛma anloa bɔ suakpole.
12Sonla mɔɔ ɛmbu ɔ gɔnwo bie la ɛnlɛ adwenle, na sonla mɔɔ lɛ ndelebɛbo la ka ɔ nloa to nu.
13Sonla mɔɔ duolua nuhua toamatoama keha edwɛkɛ la fa fealera nu edwɛkɛ finde, na sonla mɔɔ bɛkola bɛfa bɛ rɛle bɛwula ye nu la fa edwɛkɛ sie.
14Maanle mɔɔ ɛnlɛ ye sinzavolɛ la ɛngyɛ na abɔ; na maanle mɔɔ folɛdulɛma dɔɔnwo wɔ nu la, anwondɔlɛ wɔ nu.
15Sonla mɔɔ di ɛyɛvolɛ agyinlanu la bavu ɔ nwo, na mɔɔ kyi agyinlanulilɛ la anwo tɔ ye.
16Raalɛ mɔɔ di ɔ nwo eni la, bɛdi ye eni, yɛɛ mrenya mɔɔ kulo konle la nyia bɛ nwo.
17Sonla mɔɔ atiakunlu le kpalɛ la nyia ye kpalɛyɛlɛ ne azo nvasoɛ, na atisesebɛnli ne boda ɔ ngome ɔ nwo.
18Amumuyɛnli ahatualɛ ɛngyinla, na sonla mɔɔ dua tenleneyɛlɛ ma la nyia ahatualɛ kpalɛ.
19Sonla mɔɔ gyi kpundii wɔ tenleneyɛlɛ nu la banyia ngoane, na mɔɔ di ɛtaneyɛlɛ nzi la bawu.
20Ɛdɛnkɛma kyi menli mɔɔ lɛ adwenle ɛtane la, na ɔ nye die bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdi boɛ la anwo.
21Nwu ye kɛ sonla mɔɔ di ɛtane la ɛnrɛva ɔ nwo dwɔɔ, na bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛbɔ tenlene ɛbɛla la anwo bavi nu.
22Raalɛ anwofɛlɛko mɔɔ ɛnlɛ adwenle la le kɛ ezukoa nvutuke kpɔdelera wɔ kpolike bonyi nu.
23Mɔɔ tenlenenli kpondɛ la wie boɛ; mɔɔ amumuyɛnli anye la zo la wie ɛya nu.
24Sonla ne bie buke ɔ sa nu fa maa, noko ɔnyia ɔ nwo; bie noko ɛnva ɛhwee ɛmmaa, noko ɔdi ehyia.
