25Sonla mɔɔ buke ye ahonle nu fa maa la banyia ɔ nwo, yɛɛ mɔɔ yɛ ahunlunyele la, bɛnwu ye anwunvɔne.
26Sonla mɔɔ fa ye abɛlɛ bɔ abokɛ la, menli wa ye amonle, na mɔɔ fa ye ma finde tɔne ye la nyia nyilalɛ.
27Sonla mɔɔ pele kpondɛ kpalɛ bo zo la nyia ɔ nyunlu, yɛɛ munzule to mɔɔ kpondɛ munzule bo zo la.
28Sonla mɔɔ fa ɔ rɛle wula ye anwonyia nu la babɔ aze, na mɔɔ le tenlene la bayɛ duhuduhu kɛ nya amolɛ.
29Sonla mɔɔ gyegye ye awuke nu amra la bali anwoma agya, yɛɛ koasea bayɛ nrɛlɛbɛvolɛ sonvolɛ.
30Ma mɔɔ tenlenenli so la le ngoane, na sonla mɔɔ to nzaka la kuhu menli.
31 Saa bɛbadua tenlenenli kakɛ wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo wɔ ye nyɛleɛ nwo a, ɛnee kɛ amumuyɛma nee ɛtanema kɛzi kɛwie ye ɛ!

Title: MRƐ 12
Content:
1Sonla mɔɔ kulo kɛ ye adwenle nu buke la kulo kɛ saa ɔfo a bɛka bɛkile ye, na mɔɔ ɛngulo kɛ bɛtendɛ ɔ nyunlu la le kɔnwɔne.
2Sonlakpalɛ biala sɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anye, na ɔtea sonla mɔɔ bɔ adwenle ɛtane la.
3Amumuyɛ sonla ɛmkpazi, na sonla tenlene sɔ ndinli, ɛtu ye a ɔndu.
4Yelɛ kpalɛ le ɔ hu kyɛlɛ zo kpɔba, na yelɛ mɔɔ bɔ ɔ hu anyiemgba la le ewule wɔ ɔ hu mbowule nu.
5Tenlenenli biala adwenle le fɔɔnwo; amumuyɛnli folɛdulɛ le mɛlɛbɛla.
6Amumuyɛnli edwɛkɛ kɔ mogyahanlɛ nwo nzia, na sonla mɔɔ le fɔɔnwo la anloa edwɛkɛ die menli ngoane.
7Amumuyɛma badu agua, bɛ bo zo aminli, na tenlenema awuke bagyinla.
8Sonla adwenle kpalɛ yɛɛ bɛfa bɛkanvo ye a, na sonla mɔɔ ye adwenle ɛnle kpalɛ la, bɛkpo ye.
9Sonla bɛlɛvo mɔɔ yɛ ɔ ti anwo gyima la le kpalɛ tɛla sonla mɔɔ memaa ɔ nwo zo na ɔ nloa anu aleɛ bɔ ye la.
10Sonla tenlene biala dwenle ye nyɛmoa nwo, na amumuyɛnli anwunvɔnezelɛ le atisesebɛyɛlɛ.
11Sonla mɔɔ so ɛya la nyia aleɛ dɔɔnwo, na mɔɔ di ninyɛne mgbane mgbane nzi la ɛnlɛ adwenle.
12Amumuyɛnli tawa mɔɔ gyi kpundii la bubu gua, na tenlenenli sɔ ndinli gyinla kpundii.
13Ɛtanenli anloa edwɛkɛ kakyi ɛhane kye ye, na tenlenenli ye ɔ nwo fi ngyegyelɛ nu.
14Sonla anloa edwɛkɛ maa ɔnyia debie kpalɛ, ɔ kunlu dwo ɔ nwo, yɛɛ sonla biala asa anloa gyima sia ba ye ɛkɛ.
15Koasea biala adenle le kpalɛ wɔ ɔdaye ɔ nye zo, na nrɛlɛbɛvolɛ biala tie folɛdulɛ.
16Koasea ɛyavalɛ da ali ndɛndɛ, na badwemafo ɛndwenle aholoba ɛbɔlɛ nwo.
17Sonla mɔɔ ka nɔhalɛ la daselɛlilɛ le fɔɔnwo, na mɔɔ di dasewia la bɔ adalɛ.
18Sonla ne bie anloa edwɛkɛ wowɔ kɛ dadeɛ, na nrɛlɛbɛvolɛ edwɛkɛ le ayile.
19Edwɛkɛ nɔhalɛ gyi kpundii mekɛ biala, edwɛkɛ adalɛ ɛngyɛ na yeaminli.
20Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛbɔ adwenle ɛtane la bɔ adalɛ, na menli mɔɔ dwenle adwenle kpalɛ la anye die.
21Munzule ɛndo tenlenenli biala, na amumuyɛnli anwo lɛ edwɛkɛ ngome.
22Ɛdɛnkɛma kyi menli mɔɔ bɔ adalɛ la, na ɔ nye die menli mɔɔ di nɔhalɛ la anwo.
23Badwemafo ɛnva mɔɔ ɔze ye la ɛndu ɔ nwo, na ahoasea bɔ bɛ koasea ne nolo.
24Sonla mɔɔ kola gyima yɛ la sie maanle, yɛɛ mgbovonle yɛ mianlera nu gyima.
25Adwenleadwenle maa sonla yɛ basaa, na edwɛkɛ kpalɛ maa sonla di fɛlɛko.
26Sonlakpalɛ biala twe ɔ nwo fi ɛtane nwo, na amumuyɛnli adenle maa ɔminli.
27Mgbovonle sonla biala ɛnrɛnyia mɔɔ ɔkpondɛ la, na mɔɔ anye bolo yɛ gyima la nyia ɔ nwo.
28Tenleneyɛlɛ le ngoane adenle, yɛɛ ɛtaneyɛlɛ adenle wie ewule.

Title: MRƐ 13
Content:
1Kakula nrɛlɛbɛvolɛ tie ɔ ze ngilehilelɛ, na mgbanyizonle biala ɛndie ahwibɛnyunlu.
2Sonlakpalɛ ɛdendɛlɛ kpalɛ maa ɔdi ninyɛne kpalɛ, na mɔɔ ngunzinli kpondɛ la a le konle.
3Sonla mɔɔ sinza ɔ nloa la sinza ye ngoane, yɛɛ mɔɔ buke ɔ nloa mgbane mgbane la yia munzule.
4Mgbovonle sonla biala akunlu anu a anrɛɛ, noko ɔnnyia ɛhwee; na mɔɔ anye bolo yɛ gyima la nyia ninyɛne dɔɔnwo.
5Tenlenenli kyi adalɛbɔlɛ, na amumuyɛnli yɛ ye ninyɛne anyiemgba nu.
6Tenleneyɛlɛ sinza mɔɔ di boɛ la, yɛɛ ɛtane bu sia amumuyɛnli.
7Sonla ne bie yɛ ɔ nwo kɛ yenyia ɔ nwo, noko ɔnlɛ ɛhwee; bie noko yɛ ɔ nwo kɛ ɔnlɛ bie, noko yenyia ɔ nwo kpole kpalɛ.
8Debie mɔɔ sonla fa kpɔne ɔ nwo fi ɛbɛlabɔlɛ awoba nu la a le ye anwonyia, na ehyianli ɛnlɛ bie mɔɔ ɔfa ɔdie ɔ nwo a.
9Tenlenenli wienyi ta kpole kpalɛ; amumuyɛnli kɛnlaneɛ ɛngyɛ na anlu.
10Sonla mɔɔ ɛnde folɛ la mgbanyizonle ne fa ye kɔ ngyegyelɛ nu, na mɔɔ te folɛ la ze nrɛlɛbɛ.
11Anyiabɛnwo ndɛndɛ wie ndɛndɛ azebɔlɛ, na mɔɔ kuohua ye ngyikyi ngyikyi la nyia bie dɔɔnwo.
12Anyelazo kyɛ a, ɔyɛ anwobubulɛ; na ɛnyia ye a ɔyɛ anyelielɛ.
13Sonla mɔɔ kpo folɛdulɛ la fa ɔ nwo to munzule nu, na mɔɔ di mɛla zo la banyia nwolɛ ahyɛlɛdeɛ.
14Nrɛlɛbɛvolɛ ngilehilelɛ le ngoane nzufeanvea, amaa mɔɔ tie la abɔ ahoane ewule ngane ne mɔ.
15Adwenle kpalɛ ɛvalɛ maa sonla sɔ ɛnyelɛ, na mɔɔ bɛfa bɛ adwenle bɛto ɔ nwo zo a ɔnyɛ boɛ la adenle kɔ munzule nu.
16Badwemafo fa adwenle yɛ ye debie biala, na koasea ye ye koasea ne kile.
17Soanvolɛ ɛtane fa menli kɔ ngyegyelɛ nu, yɛɛ ɛbɔfoɔ kpalɛ fa anzonudwolɛ ba.
18Sonla mɔɔ ɛnde folɛ la di ehyia na ɔbɔ anyiemgba, na mɔɔ kponle zo maa bɛtwi ɔ nyunlu la nyia ɔ nyunlu.
19Saa ɛkpondɛ na ɛnyia ye a ɔmaa anwondɔlɛ, na ɔle bɛkyi ɔmaa ahoasea kɛ bɛkɛhwe bɛ nwo bɛkɛvi ɛtane nwo.
20Sonla mɔɔ nee nrɛlɛbɛvolɛma tu la nwu nrɛlɛbɛ, na mɔɔ nee ahoasea tu la nwu ɔ nyunlu.
21Munzule tu ɛtanevolɛma mgbaliko, yɛɛ ɛkpazilɛ le tenlenema ahatualɛ.
22Sonlakpalɛ gyakyi ye nlɔnra agyadeɛ, na ɛtanenli anwonyia wɔ ɛkɛ ne maa tenlenema.
23Ehyianli azɛlɛ mɔɔ kɛla kɛhyɛ la maa ɔnyia aleɛ dɔɔnwo, noko amile nu ala bɛsa ye bɛdie.
24Sonla mɔɔ ɛngulo ɔ ra la kyi kɛ ɔkɛdea ye, na mɔɔ kulo ɔ ra la anye bolo tea ye.
25Tenlenenli lɛ mɔɔ sa ye di la; amumuyɛnli ako ɛnyi ɛlɛ.

Title: MRƐ 14
Content:
1Raalɛ nrɛlɛbɛvolɛ kyekye awuke, na raalɛ koasea bɔ awuke.
2Sonla mɔɔ dua pɛlepɛle adenle nu la sulo Ɛdɛnkɛma, na mɔɔ ye ndenle nu kyeɛhyea la kpo ye.
3Koasea anloa edwɛkɛ maa ɔdie mbaka, na nrɛlɛbɛvolɛ anloa sinza ye.
4Ɛleka mɔɔ nlankɛ nyinli ɛnle la, abɛlɛ ɛnle ɛkɛ, aleɛ dɔɔnwo ɛnyianlɛ vi ɛnlankɛ nyinli anwosesebɛ.
5Dasevolɛ nɔhavo ɛmbɔ adalɛ, na mɔɔ di dasewia la edwɛkɛ le adalɛ ngome.
6Adubɛnwo sonla ɛnnwu nrɛlɛbɛ ɛlɛ, na sonla mɔɔ lɛ ndelebɛbo la lɛ adwenle.
7Ɛ nee koasea mmatu, ɔluakɛ ɛnrɛde nrɛlɛbɛ edwɛkɛ biala ɛnrɛvi ye ɛkɛ.
8Badwemafo nrɛlɛbɛ maa ɔnwu ye adenle nu boɛ, na ahoasea nrɛlɛbɛ le mɛlɛbɛla.
9Nyamenle ɛmbu amumuyɛma, na mɔɔ di boɛ la sɔ ɔ nye.
10Ahonle a ze ɔdaye ye nyane mɔɔ ɔdi la a, yɛɛ ɔlɛdi fɛlɛko a awie gyɛne ɛnli bie.
11Amumuyɛnli awuke babɔ, na mɔɔ di boɛ la awuke bagyinla.
12 Adenle ne bie wɔ ɛkɛ ne a ɔle kpalɛ wɔ sonla nye zo, na ye awieleɛ wie ewule.
13Ɛzelekɛ nu bɔbɔ, ahonle ne di nyane; anyelielɛ awieleɛ wie nyanelilɛ.
14Sonla mɔɔ di ɛtane la nyɛleɛ babu azia ye, yɛɛ mɔɔ di boɛ la banyia ye nyɛleɛ kpalɛ nwo ahatualɛ.
15Sonla mɔɔ ye adwenle ɛtɛtinle la die debie biala di, na badwemafo nea ɛleka mɔɔ ɔlɛtudu ɔ gyakɛ yeahɔ la.
16Nrɛlɛbɛvolɛ nea boɛ na ɔtwe ɔ nwo ɔfi munzule nwo, na koasea ɛndwenle ɔ nwo, yɛɛ ɔle mgbaha.
17Sonla mɔɔ ye ahonle bikye ye la yɛ ye debie koasea nu, na sonla mɔɔ anye gyi ɔ ti anwo la lɛ abotane.
18Sonla mɔɔ ye adwenle ɛtɛtinle la yɛ koasea, na mɔɔ anye gyi ɔ ti anwo la lɛ adwenle.
19Ɛtanema bɔ bɛ ti aze wɔ kpalɛma anyunlu, yɛɛ amumuyɛma dwu tenlenema anyunlu a bɛtoto bɛ nwo aze.
20Ehyianli biala anwo amra bɔbɔ ɛngulo ye, noko sukoavolɛ lɛ agɔnwolɛma dɔɔnwo.
21Sonla mɔɔ kpo ɔ gɔnwo la le ɛtanevolɛ; nyilalɛ ɛha sonla ne mɔɔ se ehyianvolɛma anwunvɔne la.
22Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛbɔ adwenle ɛtane la yɛ ɛtane; bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdwenle kpalɛ la menli bu bɛ yɛɛ bɛdi nɔhalɛ bɛkile bɛ.
23Nvasoɛ wɔ gyimayɛlɛ kɔsɔɔti azo, na ɛdendɛlɛ mgbane maa bɛdi ehyia.
24Nrɛlɛbɛvolɛma abɔtile a le bɛ nrɛlɛbɛ, na ahoasea kɔme ndweabane a le bɛ koasea.
25Mɔɔ di daselɛ nɔhalɛ nu la die ngoane, na mɔɔ bɔ adalɛ la le maamɔvo.
26Sonla mɔɔ sulo Ɛdɛnkɛma la arɛle gyi pi wɔ ye nu, yɛɛ ɔ mra nyia ɛvealeka wɔ Nyamenle anu.
27Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛzulolɛ le ngoane nzufeanvea, amaa sonla abɔ ahoane ewule ngane ne mɔ.
28Belemgbunli biala anyunlunyia a le ye menli ne dɔɔnwo, belemgbunli mɔɔ ɛnlɛ menli la nwu amaneɛ.
29Sonla mɔɔ ɔkyɛ na yeava ɛya la ndelebɛbo le kpole, na mɔɔ ɛngyɛ na ye ahonle afutu la maa ye koaseayɛlɛ yɛ kpole.
30Anzonudwolɛ maa nwonane ba bɛ nwo, na nyanenwunlɛ maa bɛkakyi mbowule.
31Mɔɔ sisi ehyianli la tindi ye Bɔvolɛ ne anyunlu, na mɔɔ nwu mɔɔ ɛhyia la anwunvɔne la di ye Bɔvolɛ ne eni.
32Amumuyɛnli ninyɛndane ɛyɛlɛ maa ɔkpo aze, na tenlenenli nyia ɛvealeka wɔ ye nɔhalɛlilɛ nwo.
33Sonla mɔɔ lɛ ndelebɛbo la ze nrɛlɛbɛ, ahoasea ɛnze nrɛlɛbɛ deɛ holɛ.
34Tenleneyɛlɛ kpogya maanle zo, yɛɛ ɛtaneyɛlɛ gua maanle biala anyunlu aze.
35Sonvolɛ mɔɔ bɔ ye ɛbɛla nrɛlɛbɛ nu la sɔ belemgbunli anye, belemgbunli anyebolo wɔ mɔɔ bɔ anyiemgba ɛbɛla la anwo zo.

Title: MRƐ 15
Content:
1Nyelebɛnloa bɛtɛɛ maa ɛya dwo, na ɛdendɛlɛ katekate ka ɛya.
2Nrɛlɛbɛvolɛ anloa edwɛkɛ maa adwenle, na koasea ka ngoaseasɛm.
3Ɛdɛnkɛma anye wɔ ɛleka biala, ɔnwu mɔɔ le kpalɛ nee mɔɔ le ɛtane la amuala.
4Ɛdendɛlɛ bɛtɛɛ le ngoane baka, na amumuyɛ ɛdendɛlɛ ku sunsum.
5Koasea kpo ɔ ze ngilehilelɛ, na badwemafo kulo folɛdulɛ.
6Anwonyia dɔɔnwo wɔ tenlenenli sua nu; amumuyɛnli anwonyia nwo lɛ munzule.
7Nrɛlɛbɛvolɛma ɛdendɛlɛ maa adwenle tende. Ahoasea adwenle ɛnle zɔhane.
8Amumuyɛnli azubɔlɛ le kyibadeɛ maa Ɛdɛnkɛma; Ɛdɛnkɛma anye die sonla mɔɔ di pɛlepɛle la nzɛlɛlɛ nwo.
9Amumuyɛma adenle ne le kyibadeɛ maa Ɛdɛnkɛma, na ɔkulo mɔɔ di pɛlepɛle nzi la.
10Mɔɔ kpo adenle la, bɛtea ye kpole kpalɛ; mɔɔ kyi ndeanlɛ la bawu.
11Ɛbolɔ nee Abɛdɛn gua ɛkɛ ne wienyi wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu; mɔɔ vea ahonle nu la ɛnvea Ɛdɛnkɛma.
12Adubɛnwo sonla biala ɛngulo folɛdulɛ; ɔyɛ se kɛ ɔkɛhɔ nrɛlɛbɛvolɛ ɛkɛ.
13Fɛlɛkolilɛ maa sonla nyunlu yɛ ɛzelekɛzelekɛ, yɛɛ nyanelilɛ maa sonla nwo bubu ye.
14Sonla mɔɔ lɛ ndelebɛbo la kpondɛ adwenlenubukelɛ, na ahoasea buke bɛ nloa a ngoaseasɛm ngome.
15Mɔɔ ɛlɛnwu amaneɛ la mekɛ kɔsɔɔti le munzule, na mɔɔ ɛlɛdi fɛlɛko la mekɛ kɔsɔɔti le anyelielɛ.
16Sonla lɛ ekyi na ɔsulo Ɛdɛnkɛma a ɔle kpalɛ ɔtɛla anyiabɛnwo kpole mɔɔ nwolɛ le amaneɛ ngome la.
17Ɔle kpalɛ kɛ menli kɛva ɛhulolɛ kɛli nya nya tɛla kɛ bɛkɛva ɛkpɔlɛ bɛkɛli ɛnlankɛ dɔlera nane.
18Sonla mɔɔ ɛngyɛ na yeava ɛya la twehwe kpolera, na mɔɔ ɛnva ɛya mgbane mgbane la si kpolera aze.
19Mgbovonle adenle nu le mbowule ngome, na pɛlepɛle adenle nu le kpolomgbolo.
20Ralɛ nrenya nrɛlɛbɛvolɛ maa ɔ ze anye die, na ralɛ nrenya koasea kpo ɔ nli.
21Mɔɔ ɛnlɛ adwenle la, mgbane mgbane ɛyɛlɛ yɛ ye fɛ, na sonla mɔɔ lɛ ndelebɛbo la kɔ fɔɔnwo.
22Adwenle ngyehyɛlɛ mɔɔ folɛdulɛ ɛnle nwo la kyea, na saa folɛdulɛma dɔɔnwo wɔ nwo a ɔwie boɛ.
23Nyelebɛnloa kɛnlɛma maa sonla nye die, yɛɛ edwɛkɛ kpalɛ wɔ ye mekɛ nloa le kpalɛ somaa!
24Nrɛlɛbɛvolɛ adenle fa ye kɔ ngoane nu, amaa yeangɔ Ɛbolɔ.
25Ɛdɛnkɛma bubu mgbanyizonlema azua gua, na ɔgya ahunlanvolɛ mraalɛ ɛweɛne.
26Ɛdɛnkɛma kyi amumuyɛma adwenle ɛvalɛ, na ɔ nye die mɔɔ anwo te la edwɛkɛ ɛhanlɛ nwo.
27Sonla mɔɔ anye sɔ kpondɛ nvasoɛ amile nu la twehwe edwɛkɛ maa ye sua nu amra, na mɔɔ kyi ndoloboa la lɛ ngoane.
28Tenlenenli dwenle na yeabua edwɛkɛ nwo, na amumuyɛnli buke ɔ nloa a, munzule ngome.
29Ɛdɛnkɛma nee amumuyɛma ɛmbɔ ɛweɛne, na ɔtie tenlenema nzɛlɛlɛ.
30Fɛlɛkolilɛ maa sonla nyunlu yɛ ɛzelekɛzelekɛ, yɛɛ amaneɛ fɛlɛko maa sonla te kpɔkɛ.
31Sonla mɔɔ gyele ɔ nzo tie folɛdulɛ kpalɛ la nee nrɛlɛbɛvolɛma badɛnla.
32Sonla mɔɔ ɛndie ngilehilelɛ la kpo ɔdaye mumua ne ɔ nwo, na mɔɔ tie folɛdulɛ la nyia ndelebɛbo.
33Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛzulolɛ le nrɛlɛbɛ ɛzukoalɛ, yɛɛ mɛlɛbɛnwoaze nee enililɛ a lua a.

Title: MRƐ 16
Content:
1Adwenle ngyehyɛlɛ le sonla ɛdeɛ, na nwolɛ mualɛ ne vi Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛkɛ.
2Sonla adenle biala le fɔɔnwo wɔ ɔdaye ɔ nye zo, na Ɛdɛnkɛma, yemɔ ɔsɔ sunsum ne a ɔnea a.
3Fa wɔ gyima wula Ɛdɛnkɛma asa anu, na wɔ ngyehyɛlɛ muala bali munli.
4Debie biala mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛyɛ la gyi kpɔkɛ zo; amumuyɛnli ne bɔbɔ, ye mekɛ dwu a bɛbazɛkye ye.
5Ɛdɛnkɛma kyi sonla mɔɔ le mgbanyizonle la; nwu ye kɛ sonla zɛhae ɛnrɛva ɔ nwo dwɔɔ.
6Sonla mɔɔ di nɔhalɛ na ɔyɛ tieyɛ la, bɛdi ɔ ti mgbɔdalɛ, yɛɛ sonla mɔɔ sulo Ɛdɛnkɛma la ɛnyɛ ɛtane.
7Saa sonla ndenle mɔɔ ɔlua nu la sɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anye a, ɔmaa ye kpɔvolɛma bɔbɔ nee ye yɛ ko.
8Ɔle kpalɛ kɛ ɛkɛnyia ekyi na ɛkɛli boɛ, tɛla kɛ ɛkɛnyia ezukoa dɔɔnwo na ɛkɛli nzisi.
9Sonla fa ye adwenle suzu mɔɔ ɔbayɛ la, na Ɛdɛnkɛma a kile mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ ɔyɛ la a.
10Belemgbunli biala kpɔkɛbɔlɛ kpalɛ lua Nyamenle anwo zo, yemɔti ɔlɛbua ndɛne a ɔ nloa ɛnvula ɛtane.
11Tone kpalɛ mɔɔ nzisi ɛnle nu la le Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛdeɛ, yɛɛ ninyɛne mɔɔ wɔ kodoku ne anu la le ɔ sa anloa gyima.
12Ɔle munzule ɔmaa arelemgbunli kɛ bɛkɛyɛ ɛtane, ɔluakɛ bɛdua tenleneyɛlɛ zo a bɛdi ebia a.
13Belemgbunli biala anye die sonla mɔɔ ka nɔhalɛ la anwo, yɛɛ ɔkulo mɔɔ ka edwɛkɛ ne fɔɔnwo la.
14Belemgbunli ɛyavalɛ le ewule soanvolɛ; sonla mɔɔ ze nrɛlɛbɛ la kola gogo ye ahonle.
15Belemgbunli te ɔ nyunlu a ɔle ngoane, yɛɛ ye kpalɛyɛlɛ gugua kɛ nyenyensuo.
16Ɛze nrɛlɛbɛ a ɔle kpalɛ ɔtɛla kɛ ɛlɛ ezukoa nvutuke, yɛɛ ɛlɛ ndelebɛbo a ɔle kpalɛ ɔtɛla dwɛtɛ fufule.
17Sonlakpalɛ adenle kpolomgbolo ne ɛngyea ɛngɔ ɛleka mɔɔ munzule wɔ la; awie biala mɔɔ sinza ɔ nwo wɔ ye adenle nu la lɛ ngoane.
18Adubɛnwo sɛkye sonla, yɛɛ bɛ nwo zo ɛmemanlɛ maa sonla tu koti.
19Ɔle kpalɛ kɛ sonla kɛbɛlɛ ɔ nwo aze, ɔ nee ehyianli kɛyɛ ko, tɛla kɛ ɔ nee mgbanyizonlema kɛyɛ ko kɛhyɛ mɔɔ bɛwua la.
20Sonla mɔɔ tie folɛdulɛ la bakpazi, yɛɛ nyilalɛ ɛha sonla ne mɔɔ fa ɔ rɛle wula Ɛdɛnkɛma anu la.
21Sonla mɔɔ ze nrɛlɛbɛ la, bɛfɛlɛ ye kɛ ɔle sonla mɔɔ kola nwu kpalɛ nee ɛtane a, yɛɛ ɛdendɛlɛ kɛnlɛma di adwenle.
22Nrɛlɛbɛ le ngoane nzufeanvea maa mɔɔ lɛ bie la, na ahoasea kakɛdualɛ a le kɛ ɛkɛyɛ mgbane mgbane ɛkɛhile bɛ.
23Sonla mɔɔ ze nrɛlɛbɛ la ɛdendɛlɛ maa adwenle, yɛɛ ɔ nloa edwɛkɛ maa adwenle da.
24Ɛdendɛlɛ kɛnlɛma le kɛ wolɛ ndɛlamoa, ɔyɛ ɛkɛla ne fɛ yɛɛ ɔmaa sonla te kpɔkɛ.
25 Adenle bie wɔ ɛkɛ ne a ɔle kpalɛ wɔ sonla nye zo, na ye awieleɛ wie ewule.
26Gyimayɛvolɛ atiakunluwɔzo maa ɔyɛ gyima ɛsesebɛ, ɔboalekɛ ɔkulo kɛ ɔdi ɔmaa ɔ ko yi.
27Sonlamgbane bɔ adwenle ɛtane, yɛɛ ye ɛdendɛlɛ yela kɛ senle.
28Sonla mɔɔ ɛnlɛ adwenle kpalɛ la twehwe konle, yɛɛ azukuedulɛ kpakye agɔnwolɛma kpalɛ avinli.
29Sonla mɔɔ kulo konle la di ɔ gɔnwo adwenle na ɔfa ye ɔdua adenle mɔɔ ɛnle kpalɛ la anu.
30Sonla mɔɔ bɔ ɔ nye kile awie mɔ la bɔ ninyɛndane nwo adwenle, yɛɛ mɔɔ sɔ ɔ nloa la maa munzule ba.
31Mgbanyinli egyɛne le anyunlunyia abɔtile maa mɔɔ lɛ ye la; ɛbɛla kpalɛ ɛbɔlɛ a maa bɛnyia ye a.
32Sonla mɔɔ ɛnva ɛya mgbane mgbane la le kpalɛ tɛla katakyie, yɛɛ mɔɔ kola ɔ nwo zo komo la le kpalɛ tɛla sonla mɔɔ ko fa suakpole la.
33Menli twe adunyi kpondɛ mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛyɛ la, na Ɛdɛnkɛma ɔdaye a ɔkile mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ sonla yɛ la a.

Title: MRƐ 17
Content:
1Ɔle kpalɛ kɛ sonla kɛli mgbosawe na ɔ nzo nu kɛdwo ye tɛla kɛ ɔkɛli ye sosɔɔ wɔ awuke mɔɔ nuhua le konle ngome la anu.
2Kanranli mɔɔ bɔ ye ɛbɛla nrɛlɛbɛ nu la bazie ralɛ nrenya mɔɔ lɛ agyadeɛ na ɔbɔ anyiemgba ɛbɛla la; ɔ nee ralɛ nrenya ne bahyɛ ye agyadeɛ ne anu kɛ asɛɛ ɔle adiema nrenya la.
3Bɛfa senle a bɛsɔ dwɛtɛ fufule nee ezukoa nvutuke bɛnea a, yɛɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma a sɔ ahonle kɔsɔɔti nea a.
4Sonla mɔɔ di ɛtane la tie amumuyɛnli anloa, yɛɛ sonla mɔɔ le adalɛ la tie ngunzinli anloa.
5Sonla mɔɔ si ehyianvolɛma amgbu la tindi ye Bɔvolɛ ne anyunlu, yɛɛ mɔɔ anye die munzule nwo la ɛnrɛva ɔ nwo dwɔɔ.
6Mgbanyinli anyelielɛ a le bɛ nlɔnra, yɛɛ mralɛ mrenya anyunlunyia a le bɛ ze mɔ.
7Koasea ɛnze ɛdendɛlɛ kɛnlɛma, yɛɛ adalɛbɔlɛ ɛnfɛta belemgbunli.
8Ndoloboa ɛmanlɛ le kɛ ngonyia bolɛ wɔ mɔɔ fa maa la anye zo; ɛleka biala mɔɔ ɔkɛdo ɔ sa la, ɔkpazi.
9Sonla mɔɔ fa ɛtane kyɛ la kpondɛ ɛhulolɛ, na mɔɔ sɔ edwɛkɛ nu a ɔngyakyi la kpakye agɔnwolɛ nu.
10Saa bɛtwi sonla mɔɔ lɛ ndelebɛbo la anyunlu a ɔyɛ ye nyane ɔtɛla koasea mɔɔ bɛkɛwulowula ye ahutuku ɛya la.
11Sonlatane biala to mgbonde; bɛbazoa soanvolɛ atisesebɛ ɔ nwo zo.
12Ɔle kpalɛ kɛ sonla nee bedi belɛ mɔɔ bɛwua ɔ mra la kɛyia tɛla kɛ ɔkɛyia koasea mɔɔ ɛlɛyɛ ngoaseade la.
13Sonla mɔɔ fa ɛtane tua kpalɛ kakɛ la, munzule ɛnrɛkpa ye awuke nu ɛlɛ.
14Mgbonde bo ɛbɔlɛ le kɛ azuledukuelɛ, yemɔti twe ɛ nwo kolaa na butule ne abɔ ɔ bo.
15Sonla mɔɔ bua amumuyɛnli benle nee mɔɔ bua tenlenenli fɔlɛ la Ɛdɛnkɛma kyi bɛ mu nwiɔ.
16Duzu ati a koasea mɔɔ ɛnlɛ adwenle la kɛnyia ezukoa kɛva kɛdɔ nrɛlɛbɛ ɛ?
17Agɔnwolɛma lɛ ɛhulolɛ mekɛ biala, yɛɛ anwongyelelɛ ti a bɛwo adiema nrenya a.
18Sonla mɔɔ ɛnlɛ adwenle la bɔ ɛwɔkɛ na ɔfa ɔ nwo ɔdi ɔ gɔnwo agyinlanu.
19Sonla mɔɔ kulo mɛladonlɛ la kulo mgbonde; sonla mɔɔ buke ye anlenkɛ wanaanwo la kulo kɛ bɛsɛkye ye.
20Sonla mɔɔ ɛnlɛ adwenle kpalɛ la ɛmkpazi, yɛɛ sonla mɔɔ anloa wowɔ la fa ɔ nwo to munzule nu.
21Ralɛ nrenya tindandi mɔɔ ɛnze nrɛlɛbɛ la maa ɔ ze di nyane, yɛɛ selɛ mɔɔ kɛwo koasea la anye ɛnlie.
22Ɛzelekɛ le ayile kpalɛ, yɛɛ adwenleadwenle maa anwofofolɛ.
23Sonla mɔɔ ati yɛ se la die ndoloboa a ɔdie ye ɔ sa amu nwiɔ ɔfa ɔsɛkye pɛlepɛlelilɛ adenle.
24Sonla mɔɔ lɛ ndelebɛbo la fa sie ɔ nyunlu kɛ ɔsukoa nrɛlɛbɛ, na koasea anye deda.
25Ralɛ nrenya koasea maa ɔ ze di nyane yɛɛ ɔyɛ ɛnwonle ɔmaa ɔ nli mɔɔ wole ye la.
26Ɔnle kpalɛ kɛ bɛkɛbɔ sonla mɔɔ le tenlene la kakɛ; ɔle nvonleɛ kɛ bɛkɛbila sonla titile empele.
27Sonla mɔɔ ɛndendɛ dɔɔnwo la lɛ adwenle, yɛɛ sonla mɔɔ ye ahonle la azule nu la lɛ ndelebɛbo. 28Saa koasea bɔbɔ ka ɔ nloa to nu a, bɛfa ye kɛ ɔze nrɛlɛbɛ; saa yeambuke ɔ nloa a, bɛfa ye kɛ ye adwenle ɛdi.

Title: MRƐ 18
Content:
1Sonla mɔɔ ɛnzo menli avinli la bua ɔ nwo benle ɔfa ɔsɛkye ndɛnebualɛ kpalɛ biala.
2Koasea anye ɛnlie ndelebɛbo nu, ye ɛdeɛ mɔɔ wɔ ye adwenle nu la ala yɛɛ ɔkulo kɛ ɔka a.
3Saa amumuyɛ ye ɔ ti a, mɛladonlɛ a li ɔ nzi a, yɛɛ saa enililɛ wie a, anyiemgba a doa ye a.
4Sonla anloa edwɛkɛ le azule buma, yɛɛ nrɛlɛbɛ dɔɔnwo le kɛ azule mɔɔ ɛdukue la.
5Ɔnle kpalɛ kɛ bɛkɛhyea bɛ nzo bɛkɛli sonla mɔɔ le amumuyɛ la edwɛkɛ anzɛɛ bɛkɛbua sonla mɔɔ le tenlene la mgbɔvodɛne.
6Koasea anloa twehwe mgbonde, yɛɛ ɔ nloa edwɛkɛ twehwe ɛbolɛ.
7Koasea anwubɛnyunlu vi ɔ nloa; ɔ nloa edwɛkɛ le ɛhane maa ɔdaye mumua ne.
8Sonla mɔɔ tu azukue la anloa edwɛkɛ yɛ fɛ kɛ aleɛ fɛlɛko; ɔdwu bɛ kunlu ɛleka biala.
9Sonla mɔɔ le mgbaha wɔ gyimayɛlɛ nu la adiema nrenya a le sonla mɔɔ sɛkye ninyɛne la.
10Ɛdɛnkɛma duma ne le aranemgbole; sonla mɔɔ le tenlene la nriandi kɔfea nu a, ɔ nwo kɔlɔnwo.
11Sukoavolɛ anwonyia le ye suakpole ɛsesebɛ; ɔle kɛ bane tendenle ɔbɔ ɔ nwo bane.
12Sonla mɔɔ memaa ɔ nwo zo la sɛkye ɔ nwo, na mɔɔ bɛlɛ ɔ nwo aze la, bɛdi ye eni.
13Andeamua le koasea; ɔ nyunlu gua aze.
14Saa sonla nwo to ye a ye kpɔkɛdelɛ a le ɔdaye ye adwenle, na saa ɔngola ɔ nwo sɔ a, nwane a sɔ ye a?
15Sonla mɔɔ lɛ adwenle la nyia adwenlenubukelɛ, yɛɛ nrɛlɛbɛvolɛ buke ɔ nzo tie adwenlenubukelɛ edwɛkɛ.
16Sonla ahyɛlɛdeɛ buke adenle maa ye na ɔfa ye ɔfinde menli mgbole nyunlu.
17Sonla mɔɔ dumua ka ye tendile la, ɛnea a ɛnee ɔdi benle, kyesɛ ko ne ɔdaye ɔka ye tendile na ɔbizebiza ye kpuyia.
18Adunyi pɛ butule biala azo na ɔkpɔda menli mɔɔ ko tia bɛ nwo la.
19Saa ɛboa adiema nrenya a ɔle kɛ suakpole mɔɔ bɛbɔ nwolɛ bane la, na saa ɛ nee ye di butule a ɔle kɛ wɔdo ɛ nwo efiade la.
20Sonla anloa edwɛkɛ a maa ɔ kunlu dwo ɔ nwo a; ye ɛdendɛlɛ a maa ye anzonudwolɛ a.
21Ɛtafinlimalɛ tumi nu yɛɛ ewule nee ngoane wɔ a; bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkulo la di ye nzoleɛ.
22Nrenya mɔɔ kɛgya raalɛ la ɛkpondɛ debie kpalɛ; ɔmaa ɔsɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anye.
23Ehyianvolɛ tendɛ a ɔkpa kyɛlɛ, na sukoavolɛ bua nwolɛ a ɔka ye mgbane mgbane.
24Agɔnwolɛma bie mɔ wɔ ɛkɛ a, bɛyɛ bɛ nwo kɛ bɛle agɔnwolɛma, na agɔnwolɛ ne bie tɛla bɛ nli akunlu.

Title: MRƐ 19
Content:
1Ehyianli mɔɔ fa adwenle dua la le kpalɛ tɛla sonla mɔɔ tendɛ mgbane mgbane na ɔle koasea la.
2Ɔnle kpalɛ ɔmmaa sonla nrenya kɛ ɔkɛyɛ atianunzule, yɛɛ mɔɔ tia hyee la ɛngyɛ na avo adenle.
3Sonla bɔ ɛbɛla mgbane na ɔte ɔfa ɔ nwo zo a, ɔfa Ɛdɛnkɛma anwo ɛya.
4Sonla lɛ ezukoa a ɔlɛ agɔnwolɛma dɔɔnwo, na mɔɔ ɛnlɛ ezukoa la, ɔ gɔnwo mɔ kpo ye.
5Sonla mɔɔ di dasewia la ɛnrɛva ɔ nwo dwɔɔ, yɛɛ mɔɔ bɔ adalɛ la ɛnrɛvi ɛsalɛ.
6Menli dɔɔnwo kpondɛ kɛ bɛsɔ sonla mɔɔ asa do la anye, yɛɛ awie biala fa sonla mɔɔ kyɛ ninyɛne la agɔnwolɛ.
7Ehyianli amediema mrenya kɔsɔɔti bɔbɔ kpo ye, na kɛ ɔkɛyɛ mɔɔ akee agɔnwolɛma ɛnrɛhwe bɛ nwo ɛnrɛvi ɔ nwo ɛnrɛhɔ moa ɛ? Ɔka edwɛkɛ ɔkile bɛ bɔbɔ a bɛndɛne ye zo.
8Sonla mɔɔ kɛnwu nrɛlɛbɛ la kulo ɔ nwo; sonla mɔɔ lɛ ndelebɛbo la bakpazi.
9Sonla mɔɔ di dasewia la ɛnrɛva ɔ nwo dwɔɔ, yɛɛ mɔɔ bɔ adalɛ la bawu.
10Ɔnle kpalɛ kɛ koasea kɛdɛnla anwonyia avinli, yɛɛ ɔnle kpalɛ kɛ kanranli kɛzie alehelɛ.
11Adwenle kpalɛ ɛmmaa sonla ɛnva ɛya mgbane mgbane, yɛɛ ɔle anyunlunyia ɔmaa ye kɛ ɔkɛbu ɔ nye ɔkɛgua nvonleɛ zo.
12Belemgbunli fa ɛya a ɔle kɛ awenade mɔɔ ɛlɛkpo la, noko ye nyeleyɛlɛ le kɛ ɛbɔlɛ mɔɔ ɛdɔ ndile zo la.
13Ralɛ nrenya koasea maa ɔ ze nwu amaneɛ, yɛɛ yelɛ butulelilɛ le kɛ ezule mɔɔ ɛlɛtɔ, mɔɔ ɛmpe ɛlɛ la.
14Sua nee anwonyia le agyadeɛ mɔɔ vi selɛma ɛkɛ, na yelɛ mɔɔ anye gyi ɔ ti anwo la Ɛdɛnkɛma a fa maa a.
15Mgbovonleyɛlɛ maa bɛdafe mgbole, yɛɛ ɔmaa ɛhɔne ku bɛ.
16Sonla mɔɔ di Nyamenle mɛla ne mɔ azo la lɛ ngoane, na mɔɔ kpo Nyamenle edwɛkɛ ne la bawu.
17Sonla mɔɔ se ehyianvolɛma anwunvɔne la bɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma bosea, na ɔbadua ye kakɛ wɔ ye nyɛleɛ kpalɛ nwo.
18Tea ɛ ra nrenya wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ anyelazo wɔ ɛkɛ la; mmanea ye ɛmaa ɔsɛkye.
19Sonla mɔɔ fa ɛya mgbole la nwu ɔ bo aleɛ, ɔluakɛ saa ɛdie ye ɛfi munzule ko anu a, eza ɛbalie ye wɔavi bieko anu.
20Tie folɛdulɛ na die ngilehilelɛ to nu, amaa wɔanwu nrɛlɛbɛ na kenle bie wɔava wɔabɔ wɔ ɛbɛla.
21Sonla adwenle ngyehyɛlɛ zonle dɔɔnwo, noko mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma kɛhyehyɛ la a bali munli a.
22Debie mɔɔ bɛkpondɛ wɔ sonla ɛkɛ ne la a le nɔhalɛlilɛ; ehyianli le kpalɛ tɛla sonla mɔɔ le adalɛ la.
23Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛzulolɛ fa sonla kɔ ngoane nu, yɛɛ mɔɔ sulo Ɛdɛnkɛma la lɛ ngoane, munzule ɛnrɛdo ye.
24Mgbovonle sonla fa ɔ sa to ɛyɛba nu a ɔnye ye ɛlɛ; ɔ sa mɔɔ ɔfa yeahɔ ɔ nloa anu bɔbɔ la, ɔngola.
25Bɔ agolobɛnwonli ne, na mɔɔ ɛnlɛ adwenle la bazukoa nrɛlɛbɛ; tea sonla mɔɔ lɛ ndelebɛbo la, na ye adwenle nu babuke.
26Sonla mɔɔ fa konle toa ɔ ze na ɔfoa ɔ nli ɔto ɛbɔ nu la le ralɛ nrenya mɔɔ anwo yɛ nyiane a, ɔfɛta ndeanlɛ.
27Me ra nrenya, ɛkulo a gyakyi ngilehilelɛ ɛdielɛ na ɛbanwu kɛ wɔminli wɔvi ɛdendɛlɛ mɔɔ maa adwenle la anwo.
28Dasevolɛ mgbane si pɛlepɛlelilɛ amgbu, yɛɛ amumuyɛnli anloa ka ɛtane.
29Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛtea agolobɛnwonli biala, na bɛbila koasea biala empele.

Title: MRƐ 20
Content:
1Nwanye ɛnlonlɛ maa bɛsi sonla amgbu; nza ɛsesebɛ ɛnlonlɛ maa sonla gyibi; sonla mɔɔ kɛmaa nza kɛgya ye la ɛnze nrɛlɛbɛ.
2Belemgbunli fa ɛya a ɔle kɛ awenade mɔɔ ɛlɛkulu la; sonla mɔɔ kɛmaa belemgbunli kɛva ɛya la minli ye ngoane.
3Koasea biala di butule; sonla mɔɔ di ɔ nwo eni la twe ɔ nwo fi butule nwo.
4Ɛyazonlɛ mekɛ dwu a mgbovonle ɛnzo bie; ɛbuhenle ne dwu a ɔkpondɛ bie, na ɔnnyia bie.
5Sonla adwenle mɔɔ wɔ ɔ ti anu la le kɛ azule buma, mɔɔ lɛ ndelebɛbo la baza bie.
6Awie biala die ɔ nwo di, noko sonla mɔɔ di nɔhalɛ la bɛnnyia ye.
7Nyilalɛ ɛha mralɛ mrenya mɔɔ bɛ ze le tenlenenli na ɔfa adwenle ɔbɔ ye ɛbɛla la.
8Belemgbunli mɔɔ de ye ndɛnebualɛ ebia nu la fa ɔ nye kpɔla menli nu nwu mɔɔ ɛnle kpalɛ wɔ bɛ avinli la.
9Nwane a kɛhola kɛha kɛ, “Me ahonle nu te, ɛtane fee ɛnle me nwo” a?
10Adalɛ tone awolɛ ngakyile nee adalɛ ɛzuzudeɛ ngakyile kɔsɔɔti le Ɛdɛnkɛma kyibadeɛ.
11Kakula bɔbɔ fa ye nyɛleɛ kile ye subane, saa ɔle kpalɛ o, ɔle ɛtane o.
12Ɛnzonlɛ mɔɔ te edwɛkɛ nee ɛnyelɛ mɔɔ nwu debie, Ɛdɛnkɛma a ɛbɔ bɛ mu nwiɔ a.
13Mmakulo nafelɛ somasoma, anrɛɛ ehyia kɛhu wɔ; fede ɛ nye yɛ gyima na ɛbanyia aleɛ dɔɔnwo.
14Sonla mɔɔ tɔ debie la edwɛkɛ a le, “Ɔnle kpalɛ, ye bolɛ yɛ se”, na ɔdwu sua nu a yeadu ɔ nloa anu wɔ nwolɛ.
15Ezukoa nvutuke wɔ ɛkɛ, yɛɛ ezukoa awolɛ mɔɔ sonle bolɛ la dɔɔnwo wɔ ɛkɛ, na ɛnloanlɛ mɔɔ tendɛ a nrɛlɛbɛ wɔ nuhua la le kpɔba mɔɔ sonle bolɛ.
16Saa sonla di ɛyɛvolɛ agyinlanu a, die ye adɛladeɛ ne mɔ sie nu, yɛɛ saa ɔdi menli mɔɔ ɛnvi maanle ne anu la agyinlanu a, fa ɔdaye mumua ne sie nu awoba.
17Saa sonla fa mɛlɛbɛla di awie aleɛ a ɔbayɛ ye fɛ bɔbɔ ɛdeɛ, na nzinlii ɔbayɛ ɔ nloa anu awozaka tɛkɛɛ.
18Folɛdulɛ zo yɛɛ bɛdua bɛfa adwenle a; dua nrɛlɛbɛ folɛdulɛ zo na wɔaha konle.
19Sonla mɔɔ tendɛ somasoma la ɛngola ɛnvea edwɛkɛ zo; yemɔti ɛ nee sonla mɔɔ tendɛ somasoma la mmatu.
20Saa sonla wa ɔ ze anzɛɛ ɔ nli amonle a, ye kɛnlaneɛ banlu yeamaa awozinli kabii ava ye.
21Anyiabɛnwo ndɛndɛ awieleɛ ɛnwie nyilalɛ.
22Mmaka kɛ, “Mebali nzenralɛ;” kendɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma na ɔbaboa wɔ.
23Ɛzuzudeɛ ngakyile le Ɛdɛnkɛma kyibadeɛ, yɛɛ adalɛ tone ɛnle kpalɛ.
24Ɛdɛnkɛma a maa sonla tudu ɔ gyakɛ a; kɛ ɔkɛyɛ na sonla ade ɔdaye mumua ne ye ɛbɛlabɔlɛ bo ɛ?
25Ɔle munzule kɛ sonla kɛha ye ndɛndɛ kɛ, “Nwolɛ te,” na saa ɔbɔ ye ɛwɔkɛ ne ɔwie a akee nzinlii yeadɛnla yeadwenle nwolɛ.
26Belemgbunli mɔɔ ze nrɛlɛbɛ la kola nwu sonla mɔɔ le amumuyɛ la, na ɔtea ye mɔɔ anwunvɔnezelɛ ɛnle nu a.
27Sonla sunsum mɔɔ wɔ ye nuhua la le Ɛdɛnkɛma kɛnlaneɛ mɔɔ ɔfa ɔneɛnlea ye nuhua ɔnwu ye ɛleka biala a.
28Belemgbunli mɔɔ di nɔhalɛ nee pɛlepɛle la di ebia kyɛ, na ye tenleneyɛlɛ maa ye belemgbunlililɛ di munli.
29Mgbavolɛ anyunlunyia a le bɛ anwosesebɛ, yɛɛ mrenya mgbanyinli anwofɛlɛko a le bɛ egyɛne.
30Ahɛlɛ mɔɔ kpakye la nrinzi ɛtane, yɛɛ empele ɛlielɛ nrinzi sonla munli nu ɛtane biala.

Title: MRƐ 21
Content:
1Belemgbunli biala adwenle le kɛ azudenle wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma asa anu; ɛleka mɔɔ ɔkulo la yɛɛ ɔmaa ɔse ɔdua a.
2Sonla adenle biala le kpalɛ wɔ ɔ nye zo, na Ɛdɛnkɛma, yemɔ ɔnea ahonle nu.
3Tenlene ɛbɛla nee pɛlepɛlelilɛ sɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anye kpalɛ tɛla azubɔlɛ.
4Adubɛnwo nee mgbanyizonle ɛyɛlɛ le amumuyɛnli kɛnlaneɛ, yɛɛ bɛle ɛtane.
5Sonla mɔɔ anye bolo ye gyima nwo la adwenle ngyehyɛlɛ maa ɔnyia aleɛ dɔɔnwo, na sonla mɔɔ pe yɛ debie la ɛnnyia ɛhwee.
6Sonla mɔɔ fa adalɛ nyia anwonyia la gya le kɛ kpukpuke, yɛɛ ɔle ewule ɛhane ɔmaa ye.
7Amumuyɛma konle ɛhulolɛ bahu bɛdabɛ mumua ne, ɔboalekɛ bɛkpo kɛ bɛnrɛli boɛ.
8Sonla mɔɔ di fɔlɛ la adenle kyeɛhyea, na mɔɔ anwo te la nyɛleɛ le fɔɔnwo.
9Ɔle kpalɛ kɛ sonla kɛdɛnla anwuma ekpumgbunli kodoka bie anu tɛla kɛ ɔ nee raalɛ mɔɔ kulo butule la kɛdɛnla sua ko anu.
10Amumuyɛnli biala kulo ɛtanelilɛ; ɔnze agɔnwolɛ bɔbɔ anwunvɔne.
11Saa bɛtea agolobɛnwonli a, mɔɔ ɛnlɛ adwenle la sukoa nrɛlɛbɛ; saa bɛtu nrɛlɛbɛvolɛ folɛ a ye adwenle nu buke.
12Tenlenenli Ko Ne nwu mɔɔ ɛlɛkɔ zolɛ wɔ amumuyɛma sua nu la na ɔsɛkye bɛ.
13Sonla mɔɔ ehyianvolɛma su fɛlɛ ye a ɔtuodua ɔ nzo la, kenle bie ɔdaye ɔbazu na awie ɛnrɛdɛne ye zo.
14Fealera nu ahyɛlɛdeɛ maa ɛya dwo, na ndoloboa mɔɔ bɛsoa ye bɛ kɛnra azo la ka ɛya kpole.
15Saa pɛlepɛle yɛ gyima a, mɔɔ di boɛ la anye die, na amumuyɛma arɛle bɔ.
16Sonla mɔɔ twe ɔ nwo fi ndelebɛbo adenle nu la die ye ɛnwomenle wɔ mɔwuamra avinli.
17Sonla mɔɔ kulo anyelielɛ la bali ehyia, yɛɛ mɔɔ kulo nwanye nee nwole la ɛnrɛnyia ɔ nwo.
18Amumuyɛnli le tenlenenli ɛkpɔnedeɛ, yɛɛ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ diedi la le sonla mɔɔ di boɛ la ɛkpɔnedeɛ.
19Ɔle kpalɛ kɛ sonla kɛdɛnla ɛsɛlɛ zo tɛla kɛ ɔ nee raalɛ mɔɔ di butule na ɔ kunlu ɛndwo ɔ nwo la kɛdɛnla.
20Gyadeɛ mɔɔ sonle bolɛ la kyɛ nrɛlɛbɛvolɛ sua nu, koasea asa ka ye a ɔsɛkye ye.
21Sonla mɔɔ di tenleneyɛlɛ nee kpalɛyɛlɛ nzi la banyia ngoane, yeanyia ɔ nyunlu.
22Nrɛlɛbɛvolɛ to katakyiema suakpole sɔ nea, na ɔgologolo bɛ aranemgbole mɔɔ bɛva bɛ rɛle bɛzɔ ye la ɔgua.
23Sonla mɔɔ ka ɔ nloa to nu na ɔndendɛ dɔɔnwo la twe ɔ nwo fi ngyegyelɛ nu.
24Sonla mɔɔ memaa ɔ nwo zo, tu ɔ nloa anu, na ɔyɛ ye debie adubɛnwo nu la, ye duma a le “Agolobɛnwo!”
25Sonla mgbovonle atiakunluwɔzo a ku ye a, ɔluakɛ ɔkpo kɛ ɔnrɛyɛ gyima.
26Anyebolo tɔ amumuyɛnli anwo alehyenlɛ ne anu amuala, na tenlenenli ɛdeɛ, ɔbuke ɔ sa nu, yɛɛ ɔbuke ye ahonle nu ɔfa ɔmaa.
27Amumuyɛnli azubɔlɛ le Nyamenle kyibadeɛ, na saa akee ɔfa adwenle ɛtane ɔbɔ azu a ɛnee kɛ ɔde ɛ?
28Sonla mɔɔ di adalɛ daselɛ la ɛnrɛhyɛ, na mɔɔ te na yeabua la bagyinla kpundii.
29Sonla mɔɔ le amumuyɛ la yɛ ɔ nwo kɛ ɔle sonlakpole, na sonla mɔɔ di boɛ la dwenle ye adenle nu boɛ.
30Nrɛlɛbɛ, ndelebɛbo, yɛɛ folɛdulɛ biala ɛnle ɛkɛ mɔɔ kola gyinla Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu a.
31Bɛsiezie ɛkpɔnwɔ bɛkendɛ konle kenle ne, na konimlilɛ ne le Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛdeɛ.

Title: MRƐ 22
Content:
1Dumamɔlɛ kpalɛ le kpalɛ tɛla anwonyia, yɛɛ anyenzɔlɛ le kpalɛ tɛla dwɛtɛ fufule anzɛɛ ezukoa nvutuke.
2Sukoavolɛma nee ehyianvolɛma bɔ nu yia; Ɛdɛnkɛma a bɔle bɛ muala a.
3Sonla mɔɔ anye gyi ɔ ti anwo la nwu munzule na ɔtwe ɔ nwo ɔfea, na mɔɔ ɛnlɛ adwenle la kɔtɔ nu na ɔnwu amaneɛ.
4Mɛlɛbɛnwoaze nee Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛzulolɛ nwo ahatualɛ a le anwonyia, enililɛ, yɛɛ ngoane.
5Mbowule nee ngane wɔ sonla mɔɔ ɛnle kpalɛ la adenle nu; sonla mɔɔ sinza ɔ nwo la ɛnrɛbikye nwolɛ.
6Tete kakula wɔ adenle mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ ɔfa zo la anu na saa ɔnyi a ɔnrɛvi zolɛ.
7Sukoavolɛ sie ehyianli, yɛɛ mɔɔ biza bosea la le sonla mɔɔ bɔ ye bosea la kanranli.
8Sonla mɔɔ dua ndunlumi la babu munzule, na ye ɛya empele ne badɔ aze.
9Sonla mɔɔ asa do la banyia nyilalɛ, ɔluakɛ ɔ nee ehyianvolɛma kyɛ ye aleɛ.
10Foa agolobɛnwonli ne fi ɛ nwo, na ɛbanwu kɛ manzonle bawie, yɛɛ butule nee aholoba ɛbɔlɛ bo bagua.
11Sonla mɔɔ kulo ahonle mɔɔ anu te, na ye ɛdendɛlɛ yɛ fɛ la bayɛ belemgbunli ne agɔnwo.
12Ɛdɛnkɛma anye wɔ sonla mɔɔ lɛ adwenle la anwo zo, na ɔfuandi mɔɔ le adalɛ la edwɛkɛ ɔgua.
13Mgbovonle sonla edwɛkɛ a le kɛ, “Awenade la gua ne azo, ɔkɛhu me!”
14Raalɛ mɔɔ le mgbane la anloa le kuma belemele; nrenya mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛva ɔ nwo ɛya la badɔ nu.
15Ngoaseade yɛ kakula biala fɛ, na ndeanlɛ baka ne maa ye ngoaseade ne fi ɔ nwo.
16Sonla mɔɔ sisi ehyianli fa nyia ɔ nwo, anzɛɛ mɔɔ ɔnyia ye a ɔfa ɔmaa sukoavolɛ la bali ehyia.
Nrɛlɛbɛ edwɛkɛ abulasa ne
17Tie nrɛlɛbɛ edwɛkɛ na fa wɔ adwenle kɔ me adwenlenubukelɛ ngilehilelɛ zo, 18ɔluakɛ saa ɛfa ɛsie na dahuu ɔla ɛ nloa a, ɔbayɛ kpalɛ yeamaa wɔ. 19Meha mehile wɔ ɛnɛ, ɛdawɔ ala, amaa wɔava ɛ rɛle wɔawula Ɛdɛnkɛma anu. 20Mehɛlɛ edwɛkɛ abulasa mɔɔ kɔ adwenle nu na ɔhyia ndwenlenwo la memaa wɔ, 21mehile wɔ mɔɔ le kpalɛ nee mɔɔ le nɔhalɛ la, amaa saa menli soa wɔ a wɔava mualɛ mɔɔ le nɔhalɛ la wɔarɛlɛ bɛ.
-1-
22Mmawua ehyianli na ɔyɛ anwunvɔne, anzɛɛ mmamia mɔɔ ɛnyia edwɛkɛ na ɔgyi bagua nu la, 23ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma bali ye edwɛkɛ amaa ye na yeazɛkye bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsɛkye menli mɔɔ ehyia la ɛbɛlabɔlɛ la.
-2-
24Mmafa sonla mɔɔ ye ahonle bikye ye la agɔnwolɛ, yɛɛ ɛ nee sonla mɔɔ fa ɛya mgbane mgbane la mmatu, 25anrɛɛ ɛkɛva ɔ gyakɛ na ɛkɛva ɛ nwo ɛkɛdo ɛhane nu.
-3-
26Mmadi awie mɔɔ tua kakɛ la agyinlanu, ɛbɔ ɛwɔkɛ kɛ ɛbadua. 27Saa wɔangola ye tua a, bɛbalie ɛ nwo ninyɛne na bɛaye ɛ bo ɛkpa bɔbɔ.
-4-
28Mmatu ɛweɛne mɔɔ ɛ nlenya mɔ ɛkpɔnla la.
-5-
29Ɛze sonla mɔɔ asa anloa adwinli le kɛnlɛma la ɔ? Ɔbagyinla arelemgbunli nyunlu; ɔnrɛgyinla menli mɔɔ awie ɛmbu bɛ bie la anyunlu.

Title: MRƐ 23
Content:
-6-
1Saa ɛtɛnla aze kɛ ɛ nee kpanyinli bie di debie a, nea ahenle mɔɔ ɛ nee ye ɛlɛdi aleɛ ne la kpalɛ; 2saa kanza ɛ kɔmenzia ɛlɛme bɔbɔ a, sɔ ɛ nwo. 3Mmamaa ɛ nye bolo aleɛ sosɔɔ ne mɔɔ yeva yezie ɛ nyunlu ɛkɛ ne la, ɔkɛyɛ kɛ ɔfa yeazɔ wɔ yeanlea.
-7-
4Mmapele kɛ ɛkɛnyia ɛ nwo, bɔ mɔdenle sɔ ɛ nwo, 5ɔluakɛ ezukoa lɛ ndɛbalɛ; ɔkola ɔtu arɛlevilɛ nu kɛ kɔleɛ ɔminliminli ɛ nye zo.
-8-
6Mmadi sonla mɔɔ le abolɛ la aleɛ; mmamaa ɛ nye bolo ye aleɛ sosɔɔ ne, 7ɔluakɛ ɔbaha yeahile wɔ bɔbɔ kɛ, “Di debie, no nza ne bie!” noko tɛ ɔ kunlu anu ɔ; ɔlɛsese mɔɔ ɛlɛdi la amuala. 8Ye mekɛ dwu a ɛbave mɔɔ wɔli la amuala, yeamaa wɔ edwɛkɛ ngɛnlɛma ne ayɛ mgbane.
-9-
9Mmaka nrɛlɛbɛ edwɛkɛ ɛkile koasea, ɔluakɛ ɔnrɛva wɔ edwɛkɛ ne ɔnrɛyɛ ɛhwee.
-10-
10Mmatu ɛweɛne dɛba ɛfi ɔ bo zo ne ɛlɛ anzɛɛ mmasa menli mɔɔ ɛnlɛ bɛ ze mɔ la ɛdie bɛ ɛya, 11ɔluakɛ bɛ kpɔnevolɛ ne anwo yɛ se kpalɛ, yɛɛ ɔbali bɛ edwɛkɛ yeamaa bɛ.
-11-
12Fa wɔ adwenle kɔ mɔɔ bɛkilehile wɔ la azo na maa ɛ nzo ɛhɔ edwɛkɛ mɔɔ buke adwenle nu la azo.
-12-
13Kakula yɛ ɛtane a tea ye; ɛbo ye a ɔnwu. 14Saa ɛbila ye empele a, ɛbalie ye ngoane wɔavi ɛbolɔ.
-13-
15Me ra nrenya, saa ɛnwu nrɛlɛbɛ a, ɔbayɛ me fɛ. 16Saa mete kɛ ɛka nrɛlɛbɛ edwɛkɛ a me nye balie somaa.
-14-
17Mmamaa ɛ nye bolo menli mɔɔ di ɛtane la; kɔ zolɛ sulo Ɛdɛnkɛma alehyenlɛ biala. 18Nɔhalɛ, alehyenlɛ tɛba yɛɛ wɔ anyelazo ɛnrɛyɛ gyɛne.
-15-
19Me ra nrenya, tie, nwu nrɛlɛbɛ na dwenle wɔ ɛbɛlabɔlɛ nwo. 20Ɛ nee nzabovoma mmatu, yɛɛ ɛ nee aleɛmgbolema mmadua, 21ɔluakɛ nzabovoma nee aleɛmgbolema bali ehyia, yɛɛ nafelɛ mgbole maa sonla keda avuazinli.
-16-
22Tie ɛ ze mɔɔ wole wɔ la edwɛkɛ, yɛɛ ɛ nli yɛ ɛrelera a, mmakpo ye.
23Su ezukoa tɔ nɔhalɛ, nrɛlɛbɛ, ngilehilelɛ, yɛɛ ndelebɛbo; mmatɔne bie.
24Tenlenenli ɔ ze anye balie kpole, yɛɛ mɔɔ kɛwo kakula nrenya nrɛlɛbɛvolɛ la bali fɛlɛko.
25Maa ɛ ze nee ɛ nli ɛli fɛlɛko; maa raalɛ ne mɔɔ wole wɔ la anye ɛlie.
-17-
26Me ra nrenya, fa wɔ ahonle maa me, na fa me gyakɛ, 27ɔluakɛ raalɛ tuutuu le ewule kuma belemele, yɛɛ raalɛ gyantɛla le bula. 28Ɔkɔ nzia kɛ awule na ɔmaa mrenya bɔ adwɔmane.
-18-
29Nwane a munzule ɛdo ye a? Nwane a ɛlɛdi nyane a? Nwane a manzonle ɛdo ye a? Nwane a kulo edwɛkɛ ɛhehanlɛ a? Nwane a tudu nganlɛ mɔɔ ɔnde ɔ bo a? Nwane a anye ɛbolobolo a? 30Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛtɛnla nza bo bɛkyɛ na bɛfa nwanye ngakyile bɛfonla nu bɛno la ɔ. 31Mmamaa ɛ nye bolo nwanye mɔɔ ɛwie be, ɔ nye le kɔkɔlɛ, na ɛgua ye kɔpo nu a ɔwu awubue na ɔgua aze bɛtɛɛ la. 32Saa ɛ nye bolo ye a, nzinlii ɔbaha wɔ kɛ ɛwɔlɛ na yeafofo wɔ kɛ asɛɛ bɔna ɛha wɔ la. 33Ɛ nye banwu ninyɛne ngakyile yɛɛ wɔ ɛdendɛlɛ bayɛ mgbane mgbane. 34Ɛbayɛ kɛ sonla mɔɔ la nyevile nu la, anzɛɛ kɛ sonla mɔɔ la meli avela baka ti zo la. 35Ɛbaha kɛ, “Bɛbɔle me, na meamboda; bɛbole me, na meande ye me nwonane nu. Kenlenzu a me nye zo kɛtete me a? Mebakpondɛ nza bieko meanlo.”

Title: MRƐ 24
Content:
-19-
1Mmamaa ɛ nye bolo ɛtanema, yɛɛ mmanyia ɛhulolɛ kɛ ɛ nee bɛ kɛdɛnla, 2ɔluakɛ bɛtwehwe kpolera, yɛɛ bɛ nloa edwɛkɛ ku sunsum.
-20-
3Bɛfa nrɛlɛbɛ a bɛsi sua a, bɛfa ndelebɛbo a bɛkyekye awuke a, 4yɛɛ bɛfa adwenle na bɛahola bɛava ninyɛne ngɛnlɛma mɔɔ sonle bolɛ la bɛaziezie sua nu.
-21-
5Sonla mɔɔ ze nrɛlɛbɛ la le katakyie tɛla sonla mɔɔ anwo yɛ se la, yɛɛ sonla mɔɔ lɛ adwenle la tɛla mɔɔ lɛ anwosesebɛ la. 6Ɔluakɛ bɛfa adwenle a bɛko konle a, yɛɛ folɛdulɛ kpalɛ dɔɔnwo maa bɛdi konim.
-22-
7Nrɛlɛbɛ bo koasea nwo zo; koasea dwu bagua nu a ɔmbuke ɔ nloa.
-23-
8Sonla mɔɔ dwenle nwolɛ kɛ ɔdi ɛtane la, bɛbavɛlɛ ye munzuvolɛ. 9Ngoaseade nwo adwenle ɛbɔlɛ le ɛtane, yɛɛ sonla mɔɔ le agolobɛnwo la le menli kyibadeɛ.
-24-
10Saa edwɛkɛ to wɔ na ɛ rɛle bɔ a, ɛnee noko wɔ anwosesebɛ le ekyi.
-25-
11Die bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ nee bɛ ɛlɛkɔ ahunleɛ la. Sɔ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛpele kɛ bɛnrɛhɔ ahunleɛ la. 12Saa ɛka kɛ, “Bɛnlea, yɛnze ɛhye anwo ɛhwee” a, ɛnee ɔkile kɛ mɔɔ ze ahonle muala anu la noko ɛnze ɔ? Asoo mɔɔ nea ɛ nwo zo la ɛnze, yɛɛ ɔnrɛdua sonla kakɛ, kɛmɔ ye nyɛleɛ ne mɔ si de la ɔ?
-26-
13Me ra nrenya, no wolɛ, ɔluakɛ ɔle kpalɛ, yɛɛ kɛ wolɛ ndɛlamoa ne anu nzule mɔɔ ɛlɛpepe la si yɛ fɛ la, 14zɔhane ala yɛɛ nrɛlɛbɛ de maa wɔ ɛkɛla a; saa ɛnwu nrɛlɛbɛ a ɔbayɛ anyelazo kpole yeamaa wɔ kenle bie, yɛɛ wɔ anyelazo ɛnrɛwie ɛlɛ.
-27-
15Mmakɔ nzia wɔ ɛleka mɔɔ tenlenenli de la, kɛmɔ amumuyɛnli yɛ la; mmatwe konle ɛto ye sua nu, 16ɔluakɛ saa tenlenenli tɔ aze fane nsuu bɔbɔ a, ɔdwazo; na amumuyɛnli ne, munzule sɛkye ye.
-28-
17Saa wɔ kpɔvolɛ kpo aze a, mmadi nwolɛ fɛlɛko, yɛɛ saa ɔtu koti a, mmamaa ɛ nye die nwolɛ, 18anrɛɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma kɛnwu ye, ɔ nye ɛnrɛlie nwolɛ, na ɔkɛye ye ɛya ne ɔkɛvi ɔ nwo zo.
-29-
19Mmamaa wɔ adwenle gyegye wɔ wɔ amumuyɛma ati, yɛɛ mmamaa ɛ nye bolo bɛ; 20ɔluakɛ amumuyɛnli anye ɛnla debie zo. Bɛbanlua amumuyɛnli ne kɛnlaneɛ ne.
-30-
21Me ra nrenya, sulo Ɛdɛnkɛma na di belemgbunli eni, yɛɛ mmatu biala anloa ɛto, 22ɔluakɛ munzule kola fi bɛ ɛkɛ ne ba arɛlevilɛ nu, na nwane a ze ɛzɛkyelɛ mɔɔ bɛ mu nwiɔ bɛkɛva bɛkɛzɛkye wɔ a?
Nrɛlɛbɛ edwɛkɛ bieko
23Ɛhye mɔ noko le nrɛlɛbɛvolɛma anloa edwɛkɛ.
Ɔnle kpalɛ kɛ sonla kɛli mɔguazo. 24Sonla mɔɔ ka kile amumuyɛnli kɛ, “Ɛdi benle” la, menli kɔsɔɔti babɔ ye sasa, maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti bahyi ye. 25Na bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛtwi amumuyɛma anyunlu la anye balie, na bɛbanyia nyilalɛ dɔɔnwo.
26Sonla mɔɔ maa nyelebɛnloa kpalɛ la, bɛfo ɔ nvoka anwo.
27Boɔboa ɛ nwo sie; duolua ɛbɔ nu kpondɛ nwolɛ ninyɛne ne amuala sie kolaa na wɔarazi wɔ sua ne.
28Mmadi daselɛ ɛtia ɛ gɔnwo mgbane gyɛne ne ala, yɛɛ mmabɔ adalɛ. 29Mmaka kɛ, “Mɔɔ yeyɛ me la, medame meyɛ ye bie; metua ye kakɛ wɔ mɔɔ yeyɛ la anwo.”
30Menzenle mgbovonle sonla bie ɛya avule nu, sonla ne mɔɔ yɛle vanye egyinli ne la ɛnlɛ adwenle. 31Na nea, mbowule ngome ɛva ɛya ne; nuhua ndile ɛyɛ tesuu zɛhae, yɛɛ awolɛ mɔɔ bɛvale bɛliele ye bane ne la ɛgologolo ɛgua. 32Menwunle ye la mendwenlenle nwolɛ. Meneanle ye kpalɛ na menyianle ezukoalɛdeɛ wɔ nu. 33 Nafelɛ ekyi, ngɔsɔkɛbɔlɛ ekyi, ɛsalɛ mɔɔ bɛto bɛbɛka nu bɛdie ɛnwomenle ekyi, 34ehyia bara ɛ nwo zo arɛlevilɛ nu kɛ awule, yɛɛ ɛ nwo bahyele wɔ kɛ ɛlɔnenli lɛ etu gyi ɛ kɔme zo la.

Title: MRƐ 25
Content:
Belemgbunli Sɔlɔmɔn mrɛlɛbulɛ ne mɔ dɔɔnwo ɛne
1Ɛhye mɔ noko le Belemgbunli Sɔlɔmɔn mrɛlɛ mɔɔ ɔbule, mɔɔ Dwuda Belemgbunli Hɛzikaya mbɔlɔba ne mɔ hɛlɛle bɛ wɔ kɛlata zo la.
2Ɔle anyunlunyia ɔmaa Nyamenle kɛ ɔkɛva ninyɛne ɔkɛvea, yɛɛ ɔle anyunlunyia ɔmaa arelemgbunli kɛ bɛkɛkpondɛ ninyɛne zɔhane mɔ.
3Kɛmɔ anwomanyunlu wɔ anwuma, na azɛlɛ ye le buma la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ arelemgbunli adwenle ɛnlɛ nvedenvedenu a.
4Saa ɛtu dwɛtɛ fufule nu evinli ne a, dwinvolɛ nyia debie fa di adwinli kpalɛ. 5Saa ɛtu amumuyɛma ɛfi belemgbunli anwo a, tenleneyɛlɛ bamaa ye belemgbunlililɛ ne ali munli.
6 Mmamemaa ɛ nwo zo wɔ belemgbunli anyunlu anzɛɛ mmapele ɛkɔtɛnla mgbanyinli ɛleka. 7Ɔle kpalɛ kɛ bɛkɛze wɔ kɛ, “Badɛnla ɛke,” tɛla kɛ bɛkɛye wɔ bɛkɛvi belemgbunli anyunlu bɛkɛhɔ menli mɔɔ anwo ɛngyia la ɛleka.
8Mmapele ndɛndɛ ɛfa mɔɔ wɔnwu ye la ɛkɔ kɔɔto, ɔluakɛ saa akee ɛ gɔnwo ne gua ɛ nyunlu aze a, duzu a ɛkɛyɛ a?
9Saa ɛ nee ɛ gɔnwo nyia edwɛkɛ a, bɛ mu nwiɔ bɛziezie; mmasa ɛ gɔnwo anwo edwɛkɛ ɛgua zolɛ, 10anrɛɛ mɔɔ kɛde la kɛgua ɛ nyunlu aze, yɛɛ wɔ duma mɔɔ kɛzɛkye la ɛnlɛ awieleɛ.
11Edwɛkɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛha ye wɔ ye adenle zo la le kɛ ezukoa nvutuke ampolo mɔɔ la dwɛtɛ fufule pɛlɛte nu la.
12Saa sonla mɔɔ ze nrɛlɛbɛ la twi sonla mɔɔ le tieyɛ la anyunlu a ɔle kɛnlɛma kɛ ezukoa nvutuke kpɔdelera anzɛɛ kpɔba.
13Soanvolɛ mɔɔ di nɔhalɛ la le kɛ ɛbuhenle nu nzule yɔlɔkɔkɔ; ɔnua ɔ menle ne mɔɔ soa ye la ahonle.
14Sonla mɔɔ tu ɔ nloa anu kɛ ɔfa debie yeahyɛ a ɔnyɛ la le kɛ amungu nee anwoma mɔɔ ɛndɔ ezule la.
15Sonla mɔɔ lɛ abotane la kola ka edwɛkɛ toonwo maa belemgbunli fa; ɛdendɛlɛ bɛtɛɛ bubu mbowule nu.
16Saa ɛnyia wolɛ a, no mɔɔ ɛkɛhola ye no la ala, anrɛɛ ɔkɛbɔ wɔ kutuku ɔkɛmaa ɛkɛfefe.
17Mmayɛ twolatwola wɔ ɛ gɔnwo sua nu, anrɛɛ ɛ nwo kɛvonle ye na ɔkɛkpo wɔ.
18Sonla mɔɔ di dasewia tia ɔ gɔnwo la le kɛ konle kokolobaka anzɛɛ konle dadeɛ, anzɛɛ ɛda baka ati nlane.
19Saa edwɛkɛ to wɔ na ɛfa ɛ rɛle ɛwula sonlamgbane nu a ɔle kɛ egyele mɔɔ ɛkpɔlɔ anzɛɛ egyakɛ mɔɔ tele la.
20Saa ɛto edwɛne ɛmaa sonla mɔɔ arɛle ɛbɔ la a ɔle kɛ ɛlɛkpa sonla nwo ɛdanlɛ wɔ ɛyɛlɛ mekɛ nu anzɛɛ ɛlɛfa nzanvinli wɔado hanlɛ nu la.
21 Saa ɛhɔne ɛlɛku wɔ kpɔvolɛ a, maa ye aleɛ ɔli, yɛɛ saa nzuhɔne ɛlɛku ye a, maa ye nzule ɔnlo, 22ɔluakɛ saa ɛyɛ ye zɔhane a ɛnee ɛlɛkuohua samɛnlakɛ ɔ ti zo, na Ɛdɛnkɛma bayila wɔ.
23Sɔlɔ anwoma ne maa ezule tɔ, yɛɛ sonla mɔɔ keha ɔ gɔnwo anzi edwɛkɛ ɛtane la ka ɛya.
24Ɔle kpalɛ kɛ sonla kɛdɛnla sua zo anwuma ekpumgbunli ne kodoka bie anu tɛla kɛ ɔ nee raalɛ mɔɔ di butule la kɛdɛnla.
25Amaneɛ fɛlɛko mɔɔ vi amaanvoa la le kɛ nzule yɔlɔkɔkɔ mɔɔ nua ahonle la.
26Saa sonlakpalɛ maa adenle maa sonla mɔɔ le amumuyɛ la wolo ye a ɔle kɛ nzubula mɔɔ ɛbolo anzɛɛ nzufeanvea mɔɔ bɛzɛkye ye la.
27Ɔnle kpalɛ kɛ sonla kɛnlo wolɛ dɔɔnwo, yemɔti nea kɛ menli si kanvo wɔ la boɛ.
28Sonla mɔɔ ɛngola ɔ nwo zo komo la le kɛ suakpole mɔɔ bɛbubu nwolɛ bane ne amuala bɛgua la.

Title: MRƐ 26
Content:
1Enililɛ ɛnfɛta koasea; ɔle kɛ ezukɔtweaba mɔɔ tɔ wawaa nu anzɛɛ ezule mɔɔ tɔ ɛbuhenle nu la.
2Amowa mɔɔ ɛnlɛ ɔ bo la ɛndila. Ɔle kɛ ngɛsanoma mɔɔ di tutɛnla anzɛɛ nyamenleakatiba mɔɔ di ahyimango la.
3Ɛkpɔnwɔ fɛta empele, asoaso fɛta nyɛma, yɛɛ koasea fɛta feaba wɔ ɔ nzi kuma nu.
4Koasea biza koasea edwɛkɛ a mmaye ɔ nloa, anrɛɛ ɛkɛyɛ kɛ ɔdaye la.
5Bua koasea edwɛkɛ nwo maa ɔde ye koasea bo, anrɛɛ ɔkɛdwenle kɛ ɔze nrɛlɛbɛ.
6Kɛ ɛkɛva nrɛlaleɛ ɛkɛzoa koasea la, pɛ ɛ ngome ɛ gyakɛ, ɔluakɛ ɛnee ɛlɛtwehwe konle.
7Ahoasea avane mrɛlɛbulɛ le kɛ abubura gyakɛ, bɛle kpokpɔdwɔɔ, nvasoɛ biala ɛnle zolɛ.
8Ɛdi koasea eni a ɔle kɛ wɔva bolɛ wɔwula totoabɔ nu wɔbɔ ye kpɔkɛ la.
9Ahoasea bu mrɛlɛ a ɔle kɛ nzanli ɛlɛtu bowule mɔɔ ɛwɔ ɔ sa akunlu la.
10Sonla mɔɔ bɔ koasea anzɛɛ nzanli ɛkpa la le kɛ sonla mɔɔ to ɛda mgbane mgbane la, ɔboda awie biala mɔɔ ɛlɛpɛ nu aze la.
11Koasea kile ye koaseayɛlɛ kɛ twea la, ɔfe a ɔsia ɔdi.
12Wɔnwu sonla mɔɔ ɔ nye zo a ɔze nrɛlɛbɛ la ɔ? Koasea bɔbɔ tɛla ye ɛkpɔyɛ.
13Mgbovonle edwɛkɛ a le kɛ, “Awenade la adenle nu! Awenade luolua guabile ne mɔ azo!”
14Mgbovonle kakyihakyi ɔ nwo wɔ ye ɛkpa zo kɛmɔ ndɛla maa anlenkɛ pɛnepɛne ɔ nwo la.
15Mgbovonle fa ɔ sa to ɛyɛba nu a, ɔyɛ ye ɛvɛlɛ bɔbɔ kɛ ɔkɛye ɔkɛwula ɔ nloa anu.
16Mgbovonle anye zo a ɔze nrɛlɛbɛ ɔtɛla menli nsuu mɔɔ kola dwenle bua edwɛkɛ nwo kpalɛ la.
17Sonla mɔɔ fa ɔ nwo dielie butule mɔɔ ɛnle ye ɛdeɛ la anu la le kɛ sonla mɔɔ sɔ twea mɔɔ lua ye aze la anzo la.
18-19Sonla mɔɔ bɛlɛbɛla ɔ gɔnwo na ɔka kɛ, “Melɛbɔ nzɛmedɛ ala!” la le kɛ ɛzɛlɛ mɔɔ fuandivuandi ɛyɛzinli, ɛda mbaka, yɛɛ ninyɛne mɔɔ kola ku sonla la.
20Ɛyɛne ɛnle senle nu a ɔnu, yɛɛ ɛleka mɔɔ azukuedulɛ ɛnle la, butule ɛnle ɛkɛ.
21Kɛmɔ ɛfa emunlike ɛgua samɛnlakɛ zo a ɔsɔ, ɛfa ɛyɛne ɛwula senle nu a ɔsɔ la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ sonla mɔɔ kulo butule la twehwe konle ba a.
22Sonla mɔɔ tu azukue la anloa edwɛkɛ yɛ fɛ kɛ aleɛ fɛlɛko; ɔdwu bɛ kunlu ɛleka biala.
23Ɛdendɛlɛ bɛtɛɛ mɔɔ munzule adwenle li ɔ nzi la le kɛ ɛyɛba mɔɔ bɛyɛ nuhua nee nwolɛ tonlotonlo la.
24Kpɔvolɛ biala ka menlemenle, na ye ahonle nu, ɔle adalɛ; 25saa ɔtendɛ kɛnlɛma bɔbɔ a, mmadie ye ɛdi, ɔluakɛ bɛkyi ninyɛne dɔɔnwo wɔ ye ahonle nu. 26Ɔfa adalɛ ɔkeda ye ɛkpɔlɛ zo bɔbɔ ɛdeɛ, noko ye amumuyɛ ninyɛne ne mɔ bala ali wɔ bagua nu.
27Sonla mɔɔ pɛ ɔ gɔnwo mɔ anwo kuma la badɔ nu, yɛɛ sonla mɔɔ kundo bolɛ la, bolɛ tɔ ɔ nwo zo.
28Adalɛ biala kyi menli mɔɔ yebɛlɛbɛla bɛ la, yɛɛ adalɛ nganvolɛ sɛkye sonla.

Title: MRƐ 27
Content:
1 Mmafa ɛhyema ɛtu ɛ nwo, ɔluakɛ ɛnze mɔɔ alehyenlɛ nee ye lua a.
2Maa awie gyɛne ɛhanvo wɔ, ɛdawɔ ɛ ngome mmakanvo ɛ nwo; maa ɛyɛvolɛ ɛhanvo wɔ, mmafa ɛ nloa ɛbɔ ɛ nwo ɛhanvolɛ zo.
3Bolɛ yɛ ɛnlomboɛ yɛɛ ɛnwea yɛ ɛnlomboɛ, na koasea ahyihanlɛ yɛ ɛnlomboɛ tɛla bɛ mu nwiɔ.
4Ɛya ati yɛ se, yɛɛ ahyi yɛ ahyi, na nwane a kɛhola kɛgyinla nungule anyunlu a?
5Ɛtwi sonla nyunlu wɔ wienyi nu a ɔle kpalɛ ɔtɛla ɛhulolɛ mɔɔ vea la.
6Agɔnwolɛ bɔ wɔ hanlɛ a ɔle kpalɛ, na saa kpɔvolɛ yɛ wɔ atuu dɔɔnwo dɔɔnwo a, nea ye boɛ.
7Sonla mɔɔ ako ɛyi la, wolɛ ɛnyɛ ye fɛ, na mɔɔ ɛhɔne ɛlɛku ye la, debie ɛnwonle biala yɛ ye fɛ.
8Sonla mɔɔ kɛdu kɛvi ye sua nu la le kɛ anloma mɔɔ ɛdu ɛvi ye sane nu la.
9Nwole evuanlɛ nee anatele maa sonla nye die, na amaneɛnwunlɛ maa sonla di nyane.
10Mmamaa ɛ rɛle fi ɛ gɔnwo nee ɛ ze agɔnwo, yɛɛ saa edwɛkɛ to wɔ a, mmakɔ ɛ diema nrenya sua nu. Agɔnwolɛ mɔɔ bikye wɔ la le kpalɛ tɛla adiema nrenya mɔɔ nee wɔ bɛ avinli twe la.
11Me ra nrenya, nwu nrɛlɛbɛ na maa me nye ɛlie, amaa saa awie ka me nwo edwɛkɛ a meahola ye bua.
12Sonla mɔɔ anye gyi ɔ ti anwo la nwu munzule na ɔtwe ɔ nwo, na mɔɔ ɛnlɛ adwenle la kɔtɔ nu na ɔnwu amaneɛ.
13Saa sonla di ɛyɛvolɛ agyinlanu a, kpa ɔ nwo ɛdanlɛ sie nu; saa awie di ɛyɛvolɛ mɔɔ ɛnvi maanle ne anu la agyinlanu a, fa ɔdaye mumua ne wula awoba.
14Sonla mɔɔ kɛdwazo nwonlomɔ mangyee ne ala kɛdea nu kɛyɛ ɔ gɔnwo bie mo la, ye moyɛlɛ ne le kɛ ɔlɛwa ye amonle ala la.
15Raalɛ mɔɔ kulo butule la le kɛ alehyenlɛ nu ezule mɔɔ tɔ na ɔmpe ɛlɛ la; 16saa ɛse ɛtua ye a ɔle kɛ sonla mɔɔ ɛlɛkye anwoma, anzɛɛ sonla mɔɔ ɛlɛfa ɔ sa fema azɔ nwole nu la.
17Bulalɛ si bulalɛ maa ɔyɛ nla, yɛɛ sonla yɛ sonla maa ɔyɛ sonla.
18Sonla mɔɔ nea ye feege egyinli boɛ la di nu aleɛ, yɛɛ mɔɔ sinza ɔ menle la nyia ɔ nyunlu.
19Sonla nea nzule nu a kɛ ɔsi ɔnwu ɔ nyunlu la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ sonla adwenle kile ye sonlazule a.
20Ɛbolɔ nee Abadɔn ako ɛnyi ɛlɛ, zɔhane ala yɛɛ sonla nye de a, ɔnea ɔnea a ɔnvɛ ɛlɛ.
21Bɛfa senle bɛtu dwɛtɛ fufule nee ezukoa nvutuke nu evinli, yɛɛ bɛnea sonla subane na bɛaye ye ayɛlɛ.
22Fa koasea nee abɛlɛ gua dubua nu so nwolɛ, ye koasea ne vi ɔ nwo ɛnrɛdu.
23Ɔwɔ kɛ ɛnwu kɛ wɔ nyɛmoa ne mɔ si de la, na ɛnea wɔ nlankɛ ne mɔ boɛ, 24ɔluakɛ anyiabɛnwo ɛndɛnla ɛkɛ ne dahuu. Asoo belemgbunlililɛ tɛnla ɛkɛ ne awolɛndoazo muala anu? 25Saa ndile yela, na fofolɛ fifi, mɔɔ ɛkɛpɛ awoka ne mɔ azo ndile nee nya ne mɔ amuala la, 26mboane ne mɔ bamaa wɔ ɛdanlɛ wɔaheda, yɛɛ mbɔnkye ne mɔ bamaa wɔ ezukoa. 27Ɛbanyia mbɔnkye nyɛfonzule mɔɔ sa wɔ nee wɔ sua nu amra no la wɔ wɔ ɛkponle zo, yɛɛ ɛbanyia bie wɔanlea wɔ sonvolɛ mraalɛ.

Title: MRƐ 28
Content:
1Amumuyɛma nriandi mekɛ mɔɔ awie ɛndoa bɛ la, na tenlenema akɛnra yɛ se kɛ awenade.
2Saa maanle yɛ ɛtane a, ye arelemgbunli so dɔɔnwo; maanle mɔɔ lɛ menli mɔɔ lɛ ndelebɛbo nee adwenle la gyinla kyɛ.
3Ehyianli mɔɔ sisi ehyianli la le kɛ ezule mɔɔ tɔ bilididi sɛkye aleɛ la.
4Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkpo mɛla la yeyɛ amumuyɛma, na bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdi mɛla zo la ko tia amumuyɛma.
5Menli mɔɔ di ɛtane la ɛnde pɛlepɛlelilɛ bo, na bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsonle Ɛdɛnkɛma la te ɔ bo kpalɛ.
6Ehyianli mɔɔ fa adwenle to ye ɛbɛlabɔlɛ nwo la le kpalɛ tɛla sukoavolɛ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ subane la.
7Ralɛ nrenya mɔɔ di mɛla zo la ze nrɛlɛbɛ, na ralɛ nrenya mɔɔ nee adidikpokuma a tu la gua ɔ ze anyunlu aze.
8Sonla mɔɔ dua awie mɔ ngyianlɛ zo fa nzinwo nyia ɔ nwo la ezukoa pɛ di menli mɔɔ se ehyianvolɛma anwunvɔne la ɛkɛ.
9Saa sonla tuodua ɔ nzo kɛ ɔnrɛdie mɛla ne a, ye nzɛlɛlɛ bɔbɔ le kyibadeɛ.
10Sonla mɔɔ kɛbɛlɛbɛla sonlakpalɛ kɛmaa ɔkɛbɔ ɛbɛla ɛtane la badɔ ɔdaye ye kuma mɔɔ yevu la anu.
Sonla mɔɔ ɛnli ɛzonle la banyia agyadeɛ kpalɛ.
11Sukoavolɛ dwenle kɛ ɔze nrɛlɛbɛ, na ehyianli mɔɔ lɛ ndelebɛbo la maa ɔ nwo da zolɛ.
12Saa tenlenenli di konim a, menli di fɛlɛko kpole, na saa amumuyɛnli dwazo a, menli nriandi fea.
13Sonla mɔɔ fea ye mɛladonlɛ zo la ɛnrɛkpazi, na sonla mɔɔ ka ye ɛtane na ɔgyakyi ye ɛyɛlɛ la, bɛse ye anwunvɔne.
14Nyilalɛ ɛha sonla ne mɔɔ sulo Ɛdɛnkɛma dahuu la, na sonla mɔɔ le anzosesebɛ la badɔ munzule nu.
15Maanlebuvolɛ mɔɔ le amumuyɛ na ɔsie ehyianvolɛma la le kɛ awenade mɔɔ ɛlɛkpo anzɛɛ bedi mɔɔ ɛnwu nane na ɔlɛkye ye la.
16Maanlebuvolɛ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ ndelebɛbo la ati yɛ se yɛɛ ɔdi nzisi, na sonla mɔɔ kyi nzisi la nyi kyɛ.
17Bɛmaa sonla mɔɔ di fɔlɛ kɛ yehu sonla la ɛyɛ nriandivolɛ toonwo ɛhɔ ewule nu; awie biala mmaboa ye.
18Sonla mɔɔ fa nɔhalɛ dua la, bɛbalie ye ngoane, na mɔɔ ye adenle nu kyeɛhyea la badɔ kuma nu.
19Sonla mɔɔ so ɛya la banyia aleɛ dɔɔnwo, na mɔɔ di ninyɛne mgbane mgbane nzi la, ehyia bahu ye kpole kpalɛ.
20Nyilalɛ dɔɔnwo baha sonla mɔɔ di nɔhalɛ la, na mɔɔ pele nyia ɔ nwo ndɛndɛ la ɛnrɛva ɔ nwo dwɔɔ.
21Mɔguazolilɛ ɛnle kpalɛ, noko aleɛ duma nu ti, sonla ne bie bali mɔguazo ayɛ ɛtane.
22Sonla mɔɔ le akyɛbɛ la pele anwonyia nwo, ɔndwenle nwolɛ kɛ kenle bie ɔbahyia.
23Sonla mɔɔ twi mɔɔ kɛyɛ ɛtane la anyunlu la nzinlii sɔ ɛnyelɛ tɛla mɔɔ kanvo ye bɛ gye zo la.
24Sonla mɔɔ wua ɔ ze anzɛɛ ɔ nli na ɔka kɛ “Ɔnle mɛladonlɛ” la, le sonla mɔɔ sɛkye ninyɛne la agɔnwo.
25Sonla mɔɔ le angomedi la twehwe konle, na mɔɔ fa ɔ rɛle wula Ɛdɛnkɛma anu la banyia ɔ nwo.
26Sonla mɔɔ fa ɔ rɛle to ɔ ngome ɔ nwo zo la le koasea, na mɔɔ fa nrɛlɛbɛ dua la, bɛbalie ye ngoane.
27Sonla mɔɔ nyia ye a ɔmaa ehyianvolɛma bie la ɛnrɛli ehyia, na mɔɔ ɔnyia ye a ɔfa ɔ nye ɔfea la, menli dɔɔnwo bawa ye amonle.
28Saa amumuyɛma dwazo a, menli nriandi fea, na saa bɛ bo zo minli a, tenlenema kpazi.

Title: MRƐ 29
Content:
1Sonla mɔɔ bɛtwi ɔ nyunlu a ɛnee anzosesebɛ ala a ɔyɛ la banwu ɔ nyunlu arɛlevilɛ nu mɔɔ ɔnrɛhola ɔ nloa gyinla a.
2Saa tenlenema ɛlɛbu maanle a, menli ne anye die, na saa amumuyɛma ɛlɛbu maanle a, menli ne su bɛ kunlu.
3Sonla mɔɔ kulo nrɛlɛbɛ la maa ɔ ze di fɛlɛko, na sonla mɔɔ nee tuutuuma a tu la sɛkye ye debie biala.
4Belemgbunli mɔɔ di pɛlepɛle la fa anzonudwolɛ ba ye maanle ne anu, na mɔɔ dahuu kpondɛ ahyɛlɛdeɛ la sɛkye maanle ne.
5Sonla mɔɔ dahuu kanvo ɔ gɔnwo adalɛ nu la sua ɔ gɔnwo ne ɛhane.
6Sonla mɔɔ di ɛtane la mɛladonlɛ kakyi ɛhane kye ye, na sonla mɔɔ di boɛ la to edwɛne na ɔ nye die.
7Tenlenenli ze kpalɛ mɔɔ di wɔ ehyianvolɛma la, na mɔɔ ati yɛ se la ɛnde zɛhae adwenle ne abo.
8Agolobɛnwoma maa senle tɔ suakpole zo, na nrɛlɛbɛvolɛma maa ɛya dwo.
9Saa nrɛlɛbɛvolɛ nee koasea su kpolera a, koasea ne teɛdea nu sele mgbole mgbole; ɔmmaa bɛnnyia bɛ nzo fee.
10Menli mɔɔ ku menli mgbane mgbane la kyi sonla mɔɔ di pɛlepɛle la, na menli mɔɔ le tenlene la kpondɛ zɔhane sonla ne nee ngoane.
11Koasea fa ɛya a, ɔye ɔkile, na nrɛlɛbɛvolɛ fa ɛya a, ɔkomo ɔ nwo zo.
12Saa maanlebuvolɛ di adalɛ ngehanleɛ nzi a, ye mgbanyima yɛ amumuyɛ.
13Ehyianli nee nzisinli sɛ debie ko anwo, Ɛdɛnkɛma maa bɛ mu nwiɔ ɛnyelɛ.
14Saa belemgbunli bua ehyianvolɛma ndɛne pɛpɛ a, ɔbali ye ebia ne yeahyɛ.
15Empele nee ndeanlɛ maa kakula nwu nrɛlɛbɛ, na kakula mɔɔ bɛkɛdu ɔ nwo bɛkɛhyɛ ye la gua ɔ nli anyunlu aze.
16Saa amumuyɛma bu maanle a, mɛladonlɛ so dɔɔnwo, na tenlenema banwu bɛ azedɔlɛ nu.
17Saa ɛ ra nrenya yɛ ɛtane a tea ye, ɔbamaa ɛ nzo nu adwo wɔ na ɛ nye alie.
18Ɛleka mɔɔ bɛnga Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ la, menli yɛ debie biala mɔɔ bɛkulo la; nyilalɛ ɛha sonla ne mɔɔ di mɛla zo la.
19Bɛnva bɛ nloa mgbane bɛndea akɛlɛ, ɔluakɛ ɔbade ɔ bo bɔbɔ ɛdeɛ, noko ɔnrɛpili.
20Wɔnwu sonla mɔɔ anloa yɛ ndɛ la ɛlɛ ɔ? Koasea lɛ anyelazo dɔɔnwo tɛla ye.
21Sonla mɔɔ kɛdɛfɛdɛfɛ ye sonvolɛ vi ye ngakula nu la, ɔ nye zo katete ye la ɛnee yeli ye agya.
22Sonla mɔɔ ɛngyɛ na yeava ɛya la twehwe mgbonde nee konle, yɛɛ mɔɔ ɛya wɔ ye ahonle zo la fa mɛladonlɛ dɔɔnwo ba.
23Sonla mɔɔ tu ɔ nwo la adubɛnwo ne gua ɔ nyunlu aze, na mɔɔ le bɛlɛvo la banyia ɔ nyunlu.
24Sonla mɔɔ nee awule tu la kyi ɔdaye mumua ne ye ngoane; ɔte amowa ne, noko ɔngola ɔnga nɔhalɛ ne.
25Sonla mɔɔ le sulosulo la sua ɔ nwo ɛhane, na mɔɔ arɛle wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anu la anwo le kɔlɔnwo.
26Menli dɔɔnwo kulo kɛ bɛsɔ maanlebuvolɛ ne anye, noko Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛkɛ ne yɛɛ sonla nyia pɛlepɛlelilɛ a.
27Sonla mɔɔ le tenlene la kyibadeɛ a le sonla mɔɔ ɛnli boɛ la, yɛɛ mɔɔ ye ɛbɛlabɔlɛ ne le fɔɔnwo la le kyibadeɛ maa amumuyɛnli.

Title: MRƐ 30
Content:
Egɛ anloa edwɛkɛ
1Gyeki mɔɔ vi Masa la ara Egɛ anloa edwɛkɛ ɛne.
Nrenya ne hanle hilele Ayeteɛle,
ɛhɛe, ɔhanle ɔhilele Ayeteɛle nee Yukale kɛ:
2“Medame, nɔhalɛ, meyɛ mgbane.
Menlɛ ndelebɛbo mɔɔ sonla ɔwɔ kɛ nyia la.
3Metɛsukoale nrɛlɛbɛ,
yɛɛ menlɛ Nwuanzanwuanza Ko ne anwo adwenle.
4Nwane a ɛvo ɛhɔ anwuma ɛzia ɛra a?
Nwane a ɛhola ɛhye anwoma ɔ sa nu a?
Nwane a ɛva ye tɛladeɛ ɛkyekye nzule a?
Nwane a ɛhyehyɛ azɛlɛ ye muleɛ ne mɔ a?
Kɛ bɛfɛlɛ ye ɛ, yɛɛ kɛ bɛfɛlɛ ɔ ra ne ɛ?
Nɔhalɛ, ɛze!
5“Nyamenle anloa edwɛkɛ biala yɛ nɔhalɛ; ɔle enyinlike ɔkeda bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnriandi bɛba ye ɛkɛ ne la anwo zo. 6Mmafa edwɛkɛ ɛboka ye edwɛkɛ nwo, anrɛɛ ɔkɛdea wɔ ɔkɛmaa bɛkɛnwu kɛ ɛle adalɛ.”
Mrɛlɛbulɛ bieko
7Ninyɛne nwiɔ yɛɛ mebiza ye wɔ wɔ ɛkɛ ne a, Nyamenle, yɛ maa me kolaa na meawu: 8Ye adalɛbɔlɛ nee adalɛ ɛbɛla biala fi me nu bɔkɔɔ; mmamaa medi ehyia anzɛɛ menyia me nwo. Maa menyia aleɛ mɔɔ menwɔhyia nwolɛ la ala, 9anrɛɛ me ko yi a, menwɔkpo wɔ na menwɔbiza kɛ, “Ɛdɛnkɛma a le nwane?” Anzɛɛ anrɛɛ menwɔli ehyia, menwɔwua, na menwɔgua me Nyamenle ne duma ne anwo evinli.
10Mmatoɔdoa sonvolɛ ɛkile ɔ menle, anrɛɛ ɔkɛwa wɔ amonle ɔkɛmaa ɛkɛli fɔlɛ.
11Menli bie wɔ ɛkɛ mɔɔ bɛwa bɛ ze mɔ amonle yɛɛ bɛmbu mɔɔ bɛ nli mɔ yɛ maa bɛ la.
12Menli bie wɔ ɛkɛ mɔɔ bɛnea a bɛ nwo te, noko bɛ nwo le evinli ngome.
13Menli bie wɔ ɛkɛ, bɛ nwo yɛ fɛ, bɛ nye ma le nzenzɛɛnye, bɛtwehwe bɛ nye anzi.
14Menli bie wɔ ɛkɛ, bɛ gye le konle dadeɛ; bɛ gye nlane le kɛ dadeɛ, bɛfa bɛsɛkye menli mɔɔ yɛ anwunvɔne wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo, na bɛsɛkye menli mɔɔ ehyia na bɛwɔ menli avinli la.
15Nrenya bie mɔɔ ɛyɛ ɔ nwo mimike la lɛ ɔ mra mraalɛ nwiɔ, bɛ ɛzunlɛ a le, “Fa maa me, fa maa me!”
Ninyɛne nsa wɔ ɛkɛ mɔɔ bɛ kunlu ɛndwo bɛ nwo; mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nna la bɔbɔ ɛnga kɛ, “Yeyɛ boɛ!”
16Bɛmɛ a le: Ɛbolɔ sua zo,
raalɛ mɔɔ le mota,
azɛlɛ ye mɔɔ nzule ɛnyi ye ɛlɛ,
yɛɛ senle mɔɔ ɛlɛsɔ mɔɔ bɛnnua ye ɛlɛ.
17Awie biala mɔɔ si ɔ ze amgbu na ɔmbu ɔ nli bie la, mbɔnza nu ahɔhɔsɛlɛ badudu ɔ nye na mgbɔtɛ arali.
18Ninyɛne nsa a wɔ ɛkɛ ne mɔɔ yɛ me nwanwane a; mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nna la, mende ɔ bo.
19Bɛmɛ a le:
Kɛ kɔleɛ si tu dua anwomanyunlu,
kɛ ɛwɔlɛ si dua bodane zo,
Kɛ meli si dua nyevile kunlu,
yɛɛ kɛ nrenya nee raalɛ adwenle si yia ɛhulolɛ nu la.
20Awuvolɛ raalɛ mɔɔ to awuvolɛvalɛ mɛla ne la subane ɛne: ɔdi, ɔkyikyi ɔ nloa anwo na yeaha kɛ, “Medame, metɛyɛle nyɛleɛ ɛtane biala!”
21Ninyɛne nsa yɛɛ azɛlɛ ye zo mɔɔ ɔngola bɛ a, mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nna la maa ɔgyinla a ɔnyɛ boɛ.
22Bɛmɛ a le:
Kanranli mɔɔ kɛli ebia,
Koasea mɔɔ kɛli ɔ ko kɛyi,
23raalɛ mɔɔ awie ɛngulo ye na ɔkɛnyia ɔ hu,
yɛɛ sonvolɛ raalɛ mɔɔ kɛli ɔ menle raalɛ agya la.
24Ninyɛne nna wɔ aleɛabo mɔɔ le ngyikyi kpalɛ, na bɛze nrɛlɛbɛ kpole kpalɛ a. Bɛmɛ ɛne:
25Ngyigyilira: Bɛ nwo ɛnyɛ se, noko wawaa
nu bɛkpondɛ bɛ aleɛ biala mɔɔ bɛbahyia nwolɛ la.
26Azulenupema: Bɛnle katakyiema,
noko bɛ alaleɛ wɔ bodane ne mɔ anu.
27Abɛbɛ: Bɛnlɛ belemgbunli, noko bɛse kɛ bɛkɔ a,
bɛkɔ ye ɛhonlone ɛhonlone.
28Kekelebetile: Sonla kola kye bɛ ɔ sa nu,
noko bɛwɔ arelemgbunli azua nu.
29Ninyɛne nsa a bɛ ɛdialɛ le kɛnlɛma a, mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nna la agyakɛ ɛdudulɛ bɔbɔ le kɛnlɛma bo zolɛ.
30Bɛmɛ a le:
Awenade,
ɔle nane kɔsɔɔti bɛ katakyie.
Ɔnzulo ɛhwee.
31Abɔnkye nyinli
nee akɔlɛ nyinli mɔɔ ɛlɛtudu bɛ gyakɛ,
yɛɛ belemgbunli mɔɔ ɛlɛtudu ɔ gyakɛ wɔ
ye maanlema anyunlu la.
32Saa wɔyɛ koasea, wɔmemaa ɛ nwo zo, anzɛɛ wɔbɔ adwenle ɛtane a, ɛnee kakyi wɔ adwenle. 33Ɔluakɛ saa ɛka ɛnlankɛ nyɛfonzule nu somasoma a, ɔpɛ mgbokɛ, ɛmia ebonyile somasoma a, mogya vi nu finde, yɛɛ ɛka sonla ɛya somasoma a, ɔwie konle.

Title: MRƐ 31
Content:
Bɛtu Belemgbunli folɛ
1Edwɛkɛ mɔɔ Masa Belemgbunli Lɛmuwɛle ɔ nli vale dule ye folɛ la ɛne:
2“Duzu ɔ, me ra nrenya? Me ko ɛzɛne, duzu ɔ? Duzu ɔ, me ra nrenya mɔɔ menluale ɛwɔkɛbɔlɛ zo a menwole ye a? 3Mmasɛkye wɔ anwosesebɛ wɔ mraalɛ nwo. Mmafa wɔ adwenle ɛmaa menli mɔɔ sɛkye arelemgbunli la. 4Ɔnle kpalɛ ɔmmaa arelemgbunli, O Lɛmuwɛle. Ɔnle kpalɛ ɔmmaa arelemgbunli kɛ bɛkɛnlo nwanye anzɛɛ maanlebuvolɛma kɛ bɛ ti akunlu kɛra nza ɛsesebɛ zo, 5anrɛɛ bɛkɛbo na bɛ rɛle kɛvi mɛla ne mɔɔ bɛli bɛdo ɛkɛ la, na bɛkɛzɛkye menli mɔɔ ɛlɛnwu amaneɛ la edwɛkɛ. 6Fa nza ɛsesebɛ maa sonla mɔɔ anye gyi ewule nu la, na fa nwanye maa menli mɔɔ arɛle ɛbɔ kpole la. 7Maa bɛnlo na bɛ rɛle ɛvi bɛ ehyia, na bɛangakye bɛ anwubɛnyunlu ne bieko.
8“Ka maa menli mɔɔ le mumule la, na di menli mɔɔ ɛnlɛ bie la edwɛkɛ maa bɛ. 9Buke ɛ nloa, bua ndɛne tenlene nu, na gyinla maa ehyianvolɛma nee menli mɔɔ ɛhyia la.”
Yelɛ kpalɛ
10Yelɛ kpalɛ, nwane a kɛnyia ye a? Ɔsonle bolɛ ɔtɛla anwoneɛ.
11Ɔ hu fa ɔ rɛle wula ye nu, yɛɛ ɔnrɛhyia ɛhwee.
12Yelɛ ne yɛ ɔ hu boɛ, ɔngyegye ye wɔ mekɛ tendenle muala mɔɔ ɔde ngoane nu la.
13Ɔkpondɛ mboane enrinli nee bolɔfodɔ dwɛsɛ na ɔfa ɔnwo ninyɛne.
14Ɔle kɛ gualilɛ meli, ɔfa aleɛ ɔfi moa moa ɔba.
15Ɔdwazo ndɛ mɔɔ aleɛ ɛtɛwiele kye la ɔkpondɛ aleɛ ɔmaa ye sua nu amra, na ɔkile ye sonvolɛ mraalɛ ne mɔ gyima ɔmaa bɛyɛ.
16Ɔkpondɛ azɛlɛ ɔtɔ, na ɔfa ɔdaye ye ezukoa ɔtɔ ma ɔyɛ vanye egyinli.
17Dahuu ɔmaa ɔ nwo yɛ se na ɔyɛ gyima ɛsesebɛ.
18Ɔnea ɔnwu kɛ ye gualilɛ zo ɛra nvasoɛ. Ye kɛnlaneɛ ɛnnu nɔɔzo.
19Ɔdaye ɔbɛka ye nyɛma, ɔnwo ye ndanlɛ.
20Ɔbuke ɔ sa nu ɔmaa ehyianvolɛma, na ɔmaa ɔ sa dwu menli mɔɔ ɛhyia la anwo zo.
21Saa ezukɔtweaba ɛlɛtɔ a ɔ kunlu ɛndu wɔ ye sua nu amra ati, ɔluakɛ ye sua nu amra amuala wula mboane enrinli kɔkɔlɛ adɛladeɛ.
22Ɔnwo ɔdaye ye ɛkpa zo ndanlɛ, na ɔwula lenen adɛladeɛ nee adɛladeɛ ngɛnlɛma anye buluwu nee kɔkɔlɛ afonla.
23Ɔ hu kɔtɛnla bagua ne anu wɔ anlenkɛ kpole ne anloa a, awie biala nwu ye wɔ mgbanyima ne mɔ avinli.
24Ɔnwo lenen adɛladeɛ ɔtɔne bɛ; ɔnwo ndabule ɔtɔne bɛ ɔmaa gualilɛma.
25Ɔ nwo yɛ se, yɛɛ bɛdi ye eni; ɔnzulo mekɛ mɔɔ bara la.
26Ɔtendɛ nrɛlɛbɛ nu, yɛɛ ye ngilehilelɛ fane kpalɛyɛlɛ nwo.
27Ɔnea ye sua nu amra boɛ wɔ bɛ ɛbɛlabɔlɛ nu, yɛɛ ɔnli ɔ sa anzi aleɛ.
28Ɔ mra dwazo na bɛyileyila ye. Ɔ hu noko zɔhane ala, na ɔye ye ayɛlɛ.
29Ɔ hu ka kɛ, “Mraalɛ dɔɔnwo ɛbɔ mɔdenle kpalɛ wɔ bɛ hu mɔ anwo, na wɔmɔ, ɛtɛla bɛ kɔsɔɔti.”
30Sili le mɛlɛbɛla, yɛɛ anwofɛlɛko le debie mgbane, na raalɛ mɔɔ sulo Ɛdɛnkɛma la, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛye ye ayɛlɛ.
31Kanvo yelɛ kpalɛ wɔ ye gyima mɔɔ ɔyɛ la anwo, na maa bɛye ye ayɛlɛ bagua nu wɔ ɔ sa anloa gyima nwo.

Title: NOLO MUKENYE
Content:
Mukenye
Nɔlobɔvo buluku ne ka “Adwenle Kilevo” ne adwenle kɛ ɔle sonla mɔɔ dwenledwenlenle kɛ sonla mekɛ si de ezinraa, nee kɛ sonla dasanli ɛbɛlabɔlɛ si di ahyimango ngakyile, nee nuhua fealera nu ninyɛne mɔɔ ɛnle nɔhalɛ, nee nwolɛ adwenle ɛzɛkyelɛ, na ɔdwulale ye edwɛkɛ ne kɛ, “Ɛbɛlabɔlɛ le mgbane.” Yeangola yeande Nyamenle ne mɔɔ lɛ sonla ngoane zo tumi la ndenle ne mɔ abo. Noko ɔdule menli folɛ kɛ bɛyɛ gyima ɛsesebɛ, na bɛli Nyamenle ahyɛlɛ ninyɛne ne mɔ anwo fɛlɛko wɔ mekɛ tendenle biala mɔɔ bɛde ngoane nu la.
Adwenle Kilevo ne adwenle ne mɔ dɔɔnwo le angɔbɛnzi na bɛmaa sonla nwo bubu ye. Noko suzuamgba ala mɔɔ buluku ɛhye wɔ Baebolo ne anu la kile kɛ Baebolo nu diedi ne anu buke na ɔmaa yɛdwenle nwo kɛ debie biala le munzule yɛɛ ɔmmaa adwenle ɛngya. Menli dɔɔnwo ɛnlea ɛnwu bɛ nvoninli wɔ Nolobɔvo buluku ne anu na bɛnyia arɛlekyekyelɛ, na bɛnwu kɛ Baebolo ko ye ala mɔɔ fa adwenle ɛhye mɔ to gua la, eza maa menli anyelazo wɔ Nyamenle ne mɔɔ maa ngoane nwo ndelebɛbo kpole la anu.

Title: NOLO 1
Content:
Ɛbɛlabɔlɛ le mgbane
1Nolobɔvo ne, Devidi ara nrenya ne, mɔɔ le Gyɛlusalɛm belemgbunli ne edwɛkɛ ne ɛne.
2Nolobɔvo ne se, ɔle mgbane, mgbane, ɛbɛlabɔlɛ le mgbane, ɔ muala le mgbane. 3Duzu nvasoɛ a sonla nyia ye wɔ ɛvɛlɛ kpole ye mɔɔ ɔfɛ aleɛabo la anwo a? 4Awolɛndoazo ko kɔ, awolɛndoazo ko ba, noko kɛ ewiade ne de ala la a ɔde a. 5Sɛnzɛne ne tudu, sɛnzɛne ne tɔ, na ɔka ɔ nwo waa ɔkɔ ɛleka mɔɔ ɔtudu la. 6Anwoma ne bɔ kɔ nyiakɛ, ɔpɛne ɔ nwo ɔkɔdi sɔlɔ; ɔpɛnepɛne ɔ nwo toonwo na eza ɔbadua ɔ bo zo ne bieko. 7Azule kɔsɔɔti se gua nyevile nu, noko nyevile ne ɛnyi ɛlɛ; bɛsia bɛkɔ ɛleka mɔɔ bɛbɔ bɛ bo la, na bɛbɔ ɔ bo bɛse bieko. 8Ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti wie ɛvɛlɛ, ɛvɛlɛ mɔɔ dasanli ɛnrɛhola ye ka a. Ɛnyelɛ nea a ɔnvɛ, yɛɛ ɛnzonlɛ tie a ɔnyi. 9Mɔɔ ɛzi la yɛɛ bazi a, yɛɛ mɔɔ bɛyɛ la yɛɛ bɛbayɛ a; debie fofolɛ biala ɛnle aleɛabo. 10Asoo debie wɔ ɛkɛ ne mɔɔ bɛha kɛ, “Bɛnlea, ɛhye le fofolɛ” ɔ? Ɔwɔ ɛkɛ ne dɛbadɛba kolaa na bɛawo yɛ. 11Awie biala ɛngakye mɔɔ ɛze ɛhɔ la, yɛɛ awie biala ɛnrɛhakye ninyɛne mɔɔ nzinlii basisi menli mɔɔ bara la mekɛ zo la.
Adwenlekilevo ne anwubielɛ
12Medame Nolobɔvo, medɛnla Gyɛlusalɛm meli Yizilayɛ belemgbunli. 13Membɔle mɔdenle kɛ mefa nrɛlɛbɛ meavedevede ninyɛne nu meazukoa debie biala mɔɔ bɛyɛ ye ewiade ye anu la. Na menwunle kɛ ɔle gyima mɔɔ ye ɛyɛlɛ ɛnyɛ fɛ na Nyamenle ɛva ɛmaa menli kɛ bɛyɛ a. 14Menwu debie biala mɔɔ bɛyɛ ye aleɛabo la, na nea, ɔ muala le mgbane. Ɔle kɛ ɛlɛkye anwoma la. 15Debie mɔɔ kyea la bɛtenrɛ ye a ɔndenrɛ, yɛɛ debie mɔɔ ɛnle ɛkɛ la bɛndia.
16 Menganle mengilele me nwo kɛ, “Menwu nrɛlɛbɛ kpole kpalɛ medɛla belemgbunli biala mɔɔ ɛli ebia wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm la; yɛɛ me ti ɛdi nrɛlɛbɛ nee adwenle nu.” 17Membɔle mɔdenle kɛ menea ngakyile mɔɔ wɔ nrɛlɛbɛ, ɛzɛlɛde, yɛɛ ngoaseade nu la. Na menwunle kɛ ɛhye noko le kɛ ɛlɛkye anwoma la. 18Ɔluakɛ nrɛlɛbɛ dɔɔnwo nee abodelɛ dɔɔnwo a lua a, yɛɛ awie biala mɔɔ ye adwenle kɛbuke dɔɔnwo la twehwe nyanelilɛ dɔɔnwo maa ɔ nwo.

Title: NOLO 2
Content:
1Menganle mengilele me nwo kɛ, “Medielie me nye meanlea kɛ fɛlɛkolilɛ si de la.” Na nea, ɛhye noko le debie mgbane. 2Menganle ye wɔ ɛzelekɛ nwo kɛ, “Ɔle ɛzɛlɛde” yɛɛ menganle ye wɔ anyelielɛ noko nwo kɛ, “Duzu nvasoɛ a wɔ zolɛ a?” 3Memanle me nrɛlɛbɛ zinzale me na menvale me adwenle memkpondɛle adenle mɔɔ medua zolɛ meava nwanye mealielie me nye, na meazɔ ngoaseadeyɛlɛ nu kɔkpula kɛ menwɔnwu mɔɔ le kpalɛ maa menli, mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛyɛ wɔ aleɛabo wɔ bɛ ngoane mekɛ ekyi ye anu la.
4 Menyɛle ninyɛne mgbole; mensisile azua na menzonle me ti anwo vanye egyinli. 5Mengyele me ti anwo tola nee ma tola na menluale mbaka mɔɔ so ma ngakyile ngakyile la wɔ nu. 6Membɔle nzule bula mɔɔ mesa nuhua nzule megugua mbaka mɔɔ menwɔlua la azo. 7 Mendɔle ahanra, mrenya nee mraalɛ, na menyianle ahanra mɔɔ bɛwole bɛ medame me awuke nu la. Eza menyianle nlankɛ nee nyɛmoa mendɛlale awie biala mɔɔ ɛdɛnla Gyɛlusalɛm ɛlɛ la. 8 Memboɔboale dwɛtɛ fufule nee ezukoa nvutuke yɛɛ arelemgbunli nee maanzinli maanzinli gyadeɛ nloa. Menyianle mrenya nee mraalɛ edwɛndolɛma, yɛɛ debie mɔɔ sonla nrenya anye die nwo la, mgbɔnla dɔɔnwo.
9 Yemɔti menyɛle sonlakpole mendɛlale menli mɔɔ li me nyunlu wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm la, yɛɛ me nrɛlɛbɛ ne ammaa meamkpo aze. 10Debie biala mɔɔ mekpondɛle la, menyianle ye. Meambɔ me nwo abolɛ wɔ anyelielɛ nu. Debie biala mɔɔ menyɛle gyima menyianle ye la me nye liele nwolɛ. Ɛhye a le me ɛvɛlɛ nwo ahatualɛ a. 11Akee mendwenlenle mɔɔ meyɛ la amuala nee ɛvɛlɛ mɔɔ mevɛ bɛ ɛyɛlɛ nu la anwo, na menwunle kɛ ɛhye mɔ amuala le mgbane. Ɔle kɛ ɛlɛkye anwoma la. Debie biala anwo ɛnlɛ nvasoɛ wɔ aleɛabo.
12Yemɔti membɔle ɔ bo kɛ medwenle nrɛlɛbɛ, ɛzɛlɛde, yɛɛ ngoaseade nwo meade bɛ bo, ɔluakɛ duzu a sonla mɔɔ bali belemgbunli agya la kɛhola kɛyɛ a? Kyesɛ mɔɔ belemgbunli ne ɛyɛ ye dɛba la ala. 13Akee menwunle kɛ nrɛlɛbɛ le kpalɛ tɛla ngoaseade, kɛmɔ wienyi le kpalɛ tɛla awozinli la. 14Nrɛlɛbɛvolɛ anye gyi ɔ ti anwo, na koasea dua awozinli nu. Noko akee menwunle kɛ bɛ muala bɛ awieleɛ le ko. 15Akee menganle mengilele me nwo kɛ, “Mɔɔ si koasea nwo zo la a bazi medame noko me nwo zo a. Duzu ati yɛɛ akee menwu nrɛlɛbɛ kpole zɛhae a?” Na menganle mengilele me nwo kɛ ɛhye noko le mgbane. 16Ɔluakɛ nrɛlɛbɛvolɛ o, koasea o, bɛnrɛhakye biala dahuu. Mekɛ bara amaa bɛ rɛle avi bɛ bɔkɔɔ. Nrɛlɛbɛvolɛ wu yɛɛ koasea wu. 17Yemɔti mengyile ɛbɛlabɔlɛ, ɔboalekɛ debie biala mɔɔ bɛyɛ ye aleɛabo la twe edwɛkɛ nyane maa me, ɔluakɛ ɔ muala le mgbane, yɛɛ ɔle kɛ ɛlɛkye anwoma la.
18Mengyile me ɛvɛlɛ kɔsɔɔti mɔɔ mevɛ aleɛabo la, ɔluakɛ menwunle kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ megyakyi debie biala memaa me kɔliagya; 19na nwane a ze a, saa ɔle nrɛlɛbɛvolɛ anzɛɛ ɔle koasea a? Noko akee ɔbahendehende debie biala mɔɔ meva me nrɛlɛbɛ mevɛ mekpondɛ la azo. Ɛhye noko le mgbane. 20Yemɔti menvule me nwo kɛ mevɛ ɛvɛlɛ kpole ɛhye wɔ aleɛabo a, 21ɔboalekɛ ɔdwu mekɛ ne bie a, ɔwɔ kɛ sonla mɔɔ ɛva nrɛlɛbɛ, adwenle, nee ɔ sa anloa gyima ɛkpondɛ debie la gyakyi ɔ muala maa sonla mɔɔ anvɛ fee la maa ɔfa ɔyɛ ɔ nwo kutukɛtɛɛ. Ɛhye noko le mgbane yɛɛ ɔle munzule kpole. 22Duzu nvasoɛ yɛɛ sonla nyia ye wɔ gyima ɛsesebɛ mɔɔ ɔyɛ nee ɛvɛlɛ mɔɔ ɔfɛ aleɛabo la azo a? 23 Ɔluakɛ ye mekɛ kɔsɔɔti le nyanedelɛ ngome, yɛɛ ye gyimayɛlɛ nu le abodelɛ ngome. Nɔɔzo bɔbɔ ɔda a ye adwenle ɛnla. Ɛhye noko le mgbane.
24 Debie kpalɛ biala ɛnle ɛkɛ ɛmmaa sonla ɛndɛla kɛ ɔkɛli na ɔkɛnlo, na ɔkɛlielie ɔ nye wɔ ye ɛvɛlɛ nwo. Menwunle kɛ ɛhye noko vi Nyamenle ɛkɛ, 25ɔluakɛ saa ɛkoati yemɔ a nwane a kɛnyia ye kɛli anzɛɛ kɛhola kɛlie ɔ nye a? 26 Ɔluakɛ Nyamenle maa sonla ne mɔɔ sɔ ɔ nye la nrɛlɛbɛ, adwenle, yɛɛ anyelielɛ, na ɛtanevolɛ ne ɛdeɛ, ɔmaa ɔsesa ɔkuohua bɛ nloa ɔmaa mɔɔ sɔ Nyamenle anye la. Ɛhye noko le mgbane; ɔle kɛ ɛlɛkye anwoma la.

Title: NOLO 3
NOLO 4
Content:
1Eza menwunle nzisi mɔɔ ɔlɛkɔ zolɛ wɔ aleɛabo la. Na nea, bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛsisi bɛ la, monle ebia bɛ, yɛɛ bɛnlɛ awie ɛnkyekye bɛ rɛle. Menli mɔɔ ɛlɛsisi bɛ la lɛ tumi, yemɔti bɛnlɛ awie ɛnkyekye bɛ rɛle. 2Na mendwenlenle nwolɛ kɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwu la ɛli ye moavolɛ ɛdɛla bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛde ngoane nu la. 3Na bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnyia ye boɛ kpalɛ bɛdɛla mɔwuamra nee anyewɔzoamra la a le bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛtɛwole bɛ na bɛanwu munzule ɛbɛla mɔɔ bɛlɛbɔ ye aleɛabo la.
4Akee menwunle kɛ ɛvɛlɛ muala nee sonla asa anloa gyima kɔsɔɔti gyi sonla agɔnwo anwo anyebolo zo. Ɛhye noko le mgbane; ɔle kɛ ɛlɛkye anwoma la. 5Koasea yɛɛ fa ɔ sa sia ye ɛzɔlɛ avinli na ɔkye ɛhɔne a. 6Ɔle kpalɛ kɛ ɛkɛnyia ekyi na ɛkɛnyia anzonudwolɛ tɛla kɛ ɛkɛva ɛ sa nwiɔ ɛkɛhu ɛ nwo ɛvɛlɛ na ɛkɛpele kɛ ɛkye anwoma.
7Eza menwu kɛ debie bieko le mgbane wɔ aleɛabo. 8Sonla ne bie ɛnlɛ ye awie, ɔnlɛ ralɛ, ɔnlɛ adiema nrenya, noko ye ɛvɛlɛ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ, ɔ kunlu ɛndwo ye anwonyia nwo, yɛɛ ɔmbiza ɔ nwo kɛ, “Na nwane ati bɔbɔ yɛɛ melɛku me nwo ɛvɛlɛ na mekpo anyelielɛ a?” Ɛhye noko le debie mgbane na ɔle gyima funli.
9Menli nwiɔ le kpalɛ tɛla sonla ko, ɔboalekɛ bɛ mu nwiɔ bɛbɔ nu a bɛkola bɛyɛ gyima bɛnyia zolɛ nvasoɛ. 10Ɔluakɛ saa ko tɔ aze a, ko ne badwazo ye. Na munzule ɛha mɔɔ le baholɛ la, ɔ ngome la ati saa ɔtɔ aze a, awie bieko ɛnle ɛkɛ mɔɔ ɔboa ye yeamaa yeadwazo a. 11Bieko, saa menli nwiɔ da a bɛ nwo yɛ wuluwulu, na kɛ ɔkɛyɛ na sonla ko ahola amaa ɔ nwo ayɛ wuluwulu ɛ? 12Saa awie teta menli nwiɔ a, bɛkɛhola bɛkɛgyinla bɛ gyakɛ anu bɛkɛdɛla sonla ko. Nyɛma bɔ nwolɛ nsa a nuhua ɛdelɛ ɛnla aze.
13-14Ehyianli kola fi ye ehyia ne anu ɔbadi belemgbunli wɔ ye maanle nu, anzɛɛ awie kola fi efiade nla badi belemgbunli. Na saa ye mgbanyinli nu ɔyɛ koasea mɔɔ ɔnde folɛ la a, ɛnee kpavolɛ ehyianli mɔɔ ze nrɛlɛbɛ la tɛla ye ɛkpɔyɛɛ. 15Meneanle menli kɔsɔɔti mɔɔ wɔ aleɛabo la, na menwunle kɛ kpavolɛ egyegyebaa bie wɔ bɛ avinli mɔɔ bali belemgbunli a. 16Menli ne zonle kpalɛ, yɛɛ ɔdaye a ɔsie bɛ muala a. Noko bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛrale amozi la, biala anye anlie ɔ nwo. Nɔhalɛ, ɛhye noko le debie mgbane. Ɔle kɛ ɛlɛkye anwoma la.

Title: NOLO 5
Content:
Mmabɔ ɛwɔkɛ mɔɔ wɔandwenle nwolɛ la
1Saa ɛkɔ Nyamenle Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu a anrɛɛ nea boɛ. Ɔle kpalɛ kɛ ɛkɛhɔ ɛkɛ ɛkɛhɔdie tɛla kɛ ɛkɛbɔ azu, kɛmɔ ahoasea yɛ la, ɔluakɛ bɛnze kɛ bɛlɛyɛ ɛtane. 2Dwenle nwolɛ kolaa na wɔabuke ɛ nloa, yɛɛ mmabɔ Nyamenle ɛwɔkɛ wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛtɛdwenlenle nwolɛ la. Ɔluakɛ Nyamenle wɔ anwuma yɛɛ wɔmɔ ɛwɔ azɛlɛ ye azo, yemɔti maa wɔ edwɛkɛ ɛyɛ nzinrenzinra. 3Gyimayɛlɛ dɔɔnwo maa bɛka ɛlalɛ, yɛɛ koasea tendɛ dɔɔnwo. 4 Saa ɛbɔ Nyamenle ɛwɔkɛ a mmakyɛ na wɔaye, ɔluakɛ ɔ nye ɛnlie ahoasea nwo. Ye wɔ ɛwɔkɛ ne mɔɔ ɛkɛbɔ la. 5Ɔle kpalɛ kɛ ɛnrɛbɔ ɛwɔkɛ fee tɛla kɛ ɛkɛbɔ na ɛnrɛye. 6Mmamaa ɛ nloa fa wɔ kɔ ɛtane nu na akee wɔaha wɔahile Nyamenle soanvolɛ ne kɛ tɛ ɛ nye fuu ɔ. Duzu ati a ɛkɛyɛ ɛkɛmaa Nyamenle kɛva ɛ nwo ɛya, na ɔkɛzɛkye ɛ sa anloa gyima mɔɔ wɔyɛ la ɛ? 7Ɔluakɛ mɔɔ wɔ ɛlalɛhanlɛ ɛlɛso la, ɛnee wɔ ɛdendɛlɛ mgbane mgbane ne mɔ ɛlɛso; wɔmɔ sulo Nyamenle.
Ɛbɛlabɔlɛ le mgbane
8Saa ɛnwu kɛ maanzinli bie anu bɛlɛsisi ehyianvolɛma, bɛnli pɛlepɛle bɛmmaa bɛ, yɛɛ bɛmmaa bɛ nwo ɛndɔ bɛ a, mmamaa ɔyɛ wɔ azibɛnwo, ɔluakɛ kpanyinli biala lɛ kpanyinli mɔɔ sie ɔdaye, yɛɛ bɛ mu nwiɔ bɛlɛ mgbanyinli mɔɔ sie bɛ a.
9Noko ɛhye mɔ amuala bɔbɔ, belemgbunli ati zɔ egyinli ne mɔ anu bɛyɔba ne mɔ.
10Sonla mɔɔ anye bolo ezukoa la akunlu ɛndwo ye ezukoa nwo ɛlɛ; yɛɛ mɔɔ anye bolo anwonyia la akunlu ɛndwo mɔɔ yenyia ye la anwo. Ɛhye noko le debie mgbane. 11Saa aleɛ bu a, menli dɔɔnwo nyia bie di. Nvasoɛ mɔɔ aleɛ menle ne nyia ye la a le kɛ ɔnwu kɛ bɛlɛdi. 12Saa gyimayɛvo nyia aleɛ dɔɔnwo di anzɛɛ yeannyia ye dɔɔnwo yeanli bɔbɔ a, ɔdafe botoo; na sukoavolɛ, kanza aleɛ bu ɔ nwo zo bɔbɔ a, adwenleadwenle ɛmmaa ɔnla.
13Menwu munzule kpole bie wɔ aleɛabo: sonla fa ye ezukoa sie toonwo maa ezukoa ne kakyi ɔ kɔme nu munzule. 14Ɔyɛ ezukoa ne mgbane mgbane ɔmaa ɔ muala fi ɔ sa; ɔle selɛ, ɔlɛ ɔ ra nrenya, noko ɔ sa nu fuenyi. 15 Kɛ sonla zile vi ɔ nli akunlu rale la yɛɛ ɔbazia yeahɔ a. Ɔlɛ ɔ nwo zɔhane a ɔrale a, yɛɛ ɔnrɛva ye gyima mɔɔ yeyɛ la anu debie ɔnrɛlɛ ɔ sa nu ɔnrɛhɔ. 16Ɛhye noko le munzule kpole. Kɛ sonla zile rale la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ ɔbahɔ a. Na duzu nvasoɛ yɛɛ ɔnyia ye kɛ ɔkye anwoma a? 17Sonla bɔ ye ɛbɛla ne kɔsɔɔti wɔ awozinli nee nyane, akpule, ɛya nee anwonyane nu.
18Nea, debie mɔɔ menwu ye la a le kɛ: mekɛ ezinraa ɛhye mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛva ɛmaa sonla la, ɔle kpalɛ kɛ ɔkɛli, ɔkɛnlo na ɔkɛlielie ɔ nye wɔ ɔdaye ɔ sa anloa gyima mɔɔ yeyɛ la anwo, ɔluakɛ ɛhye a le sonla afoa nu ɛdeɛ a. 19Saa Nyamenle maa sonla anwonyia nee agyadeɛ nee tumi kɛ ɔva ɔlie ɔ nye, na ɔzɔ ye kyɛfoa nu, ɔnyia anyelielɛ wɔ ye gyima nwo a, ɛnee nwu ye kɛ ɔle Nyamenle ahyɛlɛdeɛ. 20Ɔluakɛ sonla zɛhae ɛnrɛdwenle ye ngoane mekɛ nwo dɔɔnwo, ɔboalekɛ Nyamenle bamaa yeahɔ zolɛ yealie ɔ nye.

Title: NOLO 6
Content:
1Menwu munzule bie wɔ aleɛabo, na ɔgyi menli nwo zo kpalɛ kpalɛ. 2Nyamenle maa sonla ne bie nyia anwonyia, agyadeɛ, yɛɛ enililɛ, nɔhalɛ, ɔlɛ debie biala mɔɔ ɔkpondɛ la, noko Nyamenle ɛmmaa ye tumi ɛmmaa ɔnlidi nwolɛ ɔnva ɔnlie ɔ nye. Ɛyɛvolɛ bie yɛɛ badi a. Ɛhye le debie mgbane; ɔmaa sonla edwɛkɛ yɛ nyane kpalɛ. 3Saa sonla wo mralɛ ɛya ko, ɔnyi ɔdi ɛvolɛ dɔɔnwo, ɔyɛ kpanyinli kpalɛ na yeanlie ɔ nye wɔ ɛbɛla nu ninyɛne kpalɛ nwo, na ɔwu na ye ɛzielɛ nu anyɛ kɛnlɛma a, ɛnee ralɛ mɔɔ kɛkpɔne la tɛla ye ɛkpɔyɛɛ. 4Ɔluakɛ yemɔ ɔba mgbane na ɔdua awozinli nu ɔkɔ, na awozinli ne keda ye duma zo. 5Eza yemɔ yeannwu sɛnzɛne ne anzɛɛ debie biala, noko ɔnyia ɛnwomenlelielɛ ɔtɛla sonla ne mɔɔ kɛli ɛvolɛ dɔɔnwo la. 6Saa sonla di ɛvolɛ apenle nwiɔ bɔbɔ na yeanli ɔ ti ɛlɛ a, bɛ muala bɛkɔ ɛleka ko.
7Sonla ɛvɛlɛ kɔsɔɔti wie aleɛlilɛ ko ye ala, noko ɔ ti akunlu ɛnye aleɛ zo ɛlɛ. 8Ɛnee duzu a nrɛlɛbɛvolɛ fa tɛla koasea a? Yɛɛ saa ehyianli nwu kɛ bɛsi bɛsɔ ɛbɛla sa la a, duzu a ɔnyia ye a? 9Ɔle kpalɛ kɛ ɛ kunlu kɛdwo mɔɔ ɛlɛ la anwo tɛla kɛ dahuu ɛkɛbɔ mɔdenle kɛ ɛkpondɛ fofolɛ. Ɛhye noko le debie mgbane na ɔle kɛ ɛlɛkye anwoma.
10Debie biala mɔɔ ɛzi la ɛnee bɛha bɛdo ɛkɛ dɛba, yɛɛ yɛ muala yɛze kɛ sonla si de la, bɛ nee sonla mɔɔ anwo yɛ se tɛla bɛ la ɛnli butule. 11Ɛdendɛlɛ dɔɔnwo maa bɛka mgbane mgbane, yɛɛ ɔmmaa sonla ɛbɛla ɛngakyi. 12Nwane a kɛhola kɛnwu debie mɔɔ le kpalɛ maa sonla wɔ ye ngoane mekɛ ezinraa ɛhye mɔɔ se waa kɛ ɛlawolɛ la anu a? Saa sonla wu a, kɛ ɔkɛyɛ na yeanwu mɔɔ bazi ɔ nzi wɔ aleɛabo la ɛ?

Title: NOLO 7
Content:
Ɛbɛlabɔlɛ nwo adwenleadwenle
1 Dumamɔlɛ kpalɛ le kpalɛ tɛla nwole evuanlɛ mɔɔ sonle bolɛ la; yɛɛ ewule kenle le kpalɛ tɛla awolɛ kenle.
2Ɔle kpalɛ kɛ ɛkɛhɔ awuke mɔɔ bɛlɛdi nyane nu la anu tɛla kɛ ɛkɛhɔ awuke mɔɔ bɛlɛto ɛkponle wɔ nu la anu, ɔluakɛ menli kɔsɔɔti awieleɛ ɛne, na anyewɔzoamra bava azie bɛ ti anu.
3Nyanelilɛ le kpalɛ tɛla ɛzelekɛ, ɔluakɛ ɔmaa sonla nyunlu yɛ alɔbɔlɛ ɛdeɛ, noko ɔmaa wɔ ndelebɛbo yɛ kpole.
4Nrɛlɛbɛvolɛ dwenle awuke mɔɔ nyanelilɛ wɔ nu la anwo. Koasea dwenle awuke mɔɔ fɛlɛkolilɛ wɔ nu la anwo.
5Ɔle kpalɛ kɛ sonla kɛmaa nrɛlɛbɛvolɛma kɛhwi ɔ nyunlu tɛla kɛ ɔkɛdie ahoasea edwɛndolɛ.
6Saa koasea sele a, ɔle kɛ mbowule ɛyɛne ɛlɛtite senle nu la. Ɛhye noko le debie mgbane.
7Nɔhalɛ, nzisi maa nrɛlɛbɛvolɛ yɛ koasea, yɛɛ ndoloboa ɛlielɛ sɛkye subane.
8Debie biala awieleɛ le kpalɛ tɛla ye mɔlebɛbo; yɛɛ abotanezilɛ le kpalɛ tɛla mgbanyizonleyɛlɛ.
9 Mmafa ɛya ndɛndɛ, ɔluakɛ koasea a fa ɛya sie ye nu a.
10Mmabiza kɛ, “Duzu ati a mekɛ mɔɔ ɛze ɛhɔ la le kpalɛ tɛla adwuleso mekɛ ye ɛ?” Ɔluakɛ nrɛlɛbɛ biala ɛnle nu kɛ ɛkɛbiza ɛhye.
11Ɔle kpalɛ kɛ sonla mɔɔ lɛ agyadeɛ la kɛnwu nrɛlɛbɛ; ɔle nvasoɛ ɔmaa menli mɔɔ de ngoane nu la. 12Ɔluakɛ nrɛlɛbɛ kola bɔ sonla nwo bane kɛ ezukoa la. Yɛɛ adwenlebukelɛ nwo nvasoɛ a le kɛ nrɛlɛbɛ bɔ mɔɔ lɛ ye la anwo bane.
13Dwenle mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛyɛ la anwo. Nwane a kɛhola mɔɔ yehyeɛhyea ye la tenrɛdenrɛ a? 14Wɔ ɛkpazilɛ mekɛ nu, di fɛlɛko, yɛɛ saa ehyia to wɔ a, dwenle na kakye kɛ Nyamenle a maa gyinlabelɛ nwiɔ ne ba a, amaa sonla annwu debie biala mɔɔ bazi ɔ nzi la.
15Wɔ me ɛbɛla mekɛ mgbane ɛhye anu, menwu debie biala; sonla tenlene wu ye tenleneyɛlɛ nu, yɛɛ amumuyɛnli ngoane wa wɔ ye munzule ɛbɛlabɔlɛ nu. 16Yemɔti mmayɛ kpalɛ somasoma, yɛɛ mmanwu nrɛlɛbɛ somasoma; duzu ati a ɛkɛzɛkye ɛ nwo a? 17Mmayɛ amumuyɛ somasoma, yɛɛ mmayɛ koasea. Duzu ati a ɛkɛhu ɛ nwo na wɔ ewule mekɛ adwu a? 18Saa ɛsɔ debie ɛhye anu a, mmagyakyi ko ne anu, ɔluakɛ sonla mɔɔ sulo Nyamenle la bavi ɔ muala anu.
19Nrɛlɛbɛ maa nrɛlɛbɛvolɛ anwosesebɛ tɛla menli bulu mɔɔ sie suakpole ko la.
20Nɔhalɛ, tenlenenli biala ɛnle azɛlɛ ye azo mɔɔ kpalɛ ngome ala a ɔyɛ na ɔnyɛ ɛtane ɛlɛ a.
21Mmafa wɔ adwenle ɛkɔ edwɛkɛ kɔsɔɔti mɔɔ menli ka la azo anrɛɛ ɛkɛde kɛ wɔ sonvolɛ ɛlɛbɔ wɔ sasa; 22ɛze ye wienyi kɛ mekɛ dɔɔnwo ne ala ɛdawɔ wɔbɔ menli sasa.
23Meva nrɛlɛbɛ mezɔ ɛhye mɔ amuala menlea. Menganle kɛ, “Menyɛle kɛ meyɛ nrɛlɛbɛvolɛ, noko meannwu nrɛlɛbɛ.” 24Mɔɔ wɔ ɛkɛ la, wɔ moa, yɛɛ mɔɔ le kuma la, le kuma kuloonwu; nwane a kɛhola kɛde ɔ bo a? 25Menyɛle me adwenle kɛ menea, meavedevede nu na meakpondɛ nrɛlɛbɛ yɛɛ ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti abo, na meanwu atisesebɛ mɔɔ le ngoaseadeyɛlɛ nee koaseayɛlɛ mɔɔ le ɛzɛlɛde la.
26Menwunle debie mɔɔ yɛ ɛzulolɛ tɛla ewule la; yemɔ a le raalɛ mɔɔ ye ɛhulolɛ le kɛ ɛhane anzɛɛ avonle, na ɔ sa mɔɔ ɔfa ɔbɛla ye kulovolɛ la le kɛ nwɔnzɔnwɔnzɔ la. Sonla mɔɔ sɔ Nyamenle anye la kola die ɔ nwo; na ɛtanevolɛ ɛdeɛ ɔkye ye. 27Bɛdie, kɛ Nolobɔvo ne se la ɛne, menwunle ɛhye ngyikyi ngyikyi wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee melɛkpondɛ bɛ nyelebɛnloa la. 28Mekpondɛkpondɛ nyelebɛnloa fofolɛ, noko metɛnyianle bie. Menwunle nrenya ko wɔ mrenya apenle avinli mɔɔ medi ye eni a, na wɔ mraalɛ ne mɔ avinli, meannyia bie. 29Debie mɔɔ mezukoa la ala ɛne: Nyamenle bɔle sonla fɔɔnwo, na sonla ɛbɔ adwenle dɔɔnwo ɛmaa ɛbɛla ɛyɛ kpomgbondee.

Title: NOLO 8
Content:
1Nwane a le kɛ nrɛlɛbɛvolɛ ne a, yɛɛ nwane a ze ninyɛne bo kile a? Sonla nrɛlɛbɛ maa ɔ nyunlu yɛ gyakogyako na ɔ nyunlu ɛmunlanlɛ kakyi ɛzelekɛ.
Yɛ tieyɛ maa belemgbunli
2Di edwɛkɛ mɔɔ belemgbunli kɛha la azo, na mmamaa wɔ adwenle sɛkye kɛ wɔbɔ Nyamenle ɛwɔkɛ a. 3Belemgbunli ne kola yɛ debie biala mɔɔ ɔdaye ɔkulo la, yemɔti saa edwɛkɛ mɔɔ ɛlɛba la ɛnle kpalɛ a fi ɔ nyunlu ɛkɛ ne kɔ. 4Ɔluakɛ mɔɔ belemgbunli kɛha la le tumi, yɛɛ nwane bɔbɔ a kɛhola kɛze ye kɛ, “Na duzu a ɛlɛyɛ la?” 5Awie biala mɔɔ di mɛla zo la anwo ɛnrɛbu ɛbonle, yɛɛ nrɛlɛbɛvolɛ ze mekɛ ne nee adenle mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ ɔdua nu ɔyɛ la. 6Ɔluakɛ debie biala lɛ ye mekɛ nee ye adenle noko akee sonla ɔdaye ye munzule doa ye kpalɛ kpalɛ. 7Awie biala ɛnze edwɛkɛ mɔɔ bazi la, ɔluakɛ awie biala ɛnle ɛkɛ mɔɔ ɔbaha kɛ ɔbazi yeazi la yeahile ye a. 8Awie biala ɛnlɛ tumi mɔɔ ɔkola ɔmaa ye sunsum ne tɛnla ye nu dahuu, anzɛɛ awie biala ɛnle ɛkɛ mɔɔ lɛ tumi wɔ ye ewule mekɛ zo; ɔle konle mɔɔ bɛkɔ a bɛnzia a, yɛɛ amumuyɛ ɛyɛlɛ ɛnlie bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛyɛ amumuyɛ la ɛnvi nu.
Amumuyɛma nee tenlenema
9Menwunle ɛhye mɔ amuala wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee melɛdwenle ninyɛne mɔɔ bɛyɛ wɔ aleɛabo, mekɛ mɔɔ bie mɔ lɛ tumi ɛlɛsisi bie mɔ bɛamaa bɛanwu amaneɛ la anwo la. 10Akee menwunle kɛ bɛzie amumuyɛma; ɛnee bɛdi ɛleka nwuanzanwuanza ne anu wolofinde, na menli kanvo bɛ wɔ suakpole ne azo, ɛleka mɔɔ bɛyɛle bɛ ninyɛndane ne mɔ la. Ɛhye noko le debie mgbane.
11Kɛmɔ bɛndua amumuyɛyɛlɛ nwo kakɛ ndɛndɛ la ati, menli fa sie bɛ nyunlu yɛ amumuyɛ dahuu. 12Ɛtanevolɛ yɛ ninyɛmunli fane ɛya na ye ngoane yɛ tendenle, noko meze kɛ ɔbayɛ boɛ yeamaa menli mɔɔ sulo Nyamenle la, ɔboalekɛ ɔ nyunlu, bɛsulo ye; 13na amumuyɛma ɛdeɛ, ɔnrɛyɛ boɛ ɔnrɛmaa bɛ, yɛɛ bɛ ngoane ɛnrɛwa kɛ ɛlawolɛ, ɔboalekɛ bɛnzulo Nyamenle. 14Debie mgbane bie kɔ zolɛ wɔ ewiade ye anu, tenlenema nyia amumuyɛma ndeanlɛ, yɛɛ amumuyɛma nyia tenlenema ahatualɛ. Na menganle kɛ ɛhye noko le debie mgbane.
15Yemɔti menwu ye wienyi kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ sonla dielie ɔ nye, ɔboalekɛ ye fɛlɛkolilɛ mɔɔ ɔlɛ ye wɔ ye ɛbɛlabɔlɛ nu la a le kɛ ɔkɛli, ɔkɛnlo na ɔkɛlielie ɔ nye. Yeanyɛ boɛ bɔbɔ a, mekɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛva ɛmaa ye wɔ ewiade, mɔɔ ɔlɛyɛ gyima la, ɔwɔ kɛ ɔdielie ɔ nye.
16Mekɛ biala mɔɔ mendwenlenle nwolɛ kɛ mesukoa nrɛlɛbɛ, na meanwu mɔɔ ɛlɛsisi ewiade, mɔɔ yemɔti sonla si epe nɔɔzo nee ewiazo la, 17menwunle kɛ sonla ɛnrɛde Nyamenle gyima mɔɔ ɛlɛdi wɔ ewiade la abo. Sonla babɔ mɔdenle kɛ duzu bɔbɔ ala a, ɔnrɛde ɔ bo ɛlɛ. Nrɛlɛbɛvolɛma baha kɛ bɛze, noko bɛnze.

Title: NOLO 9
Content:
1Mendwenlenle ɛhye anwo na meneɛnleanle ɔ muala anu kɛ menea kɛ Nyamenle si nea nrɛlɛbɛvolɛma nee tenlenema nee bɛ nyɛleɛ zo la, saa ɛhulolɛ o, saa ɛkpɔlɛ o, awie biala ɛnze. Debie biala mɔɔ gyi bɛ nye zo la le mgbane, 2ɔboalekɛ bɛ muala bɛ awieleɛ le ko: tenlenema nee amumuyɛma, kpalɛma nee ɛtanevolɛma, bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ nwo te nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ nwo ɛnde, yɛɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛbɔ azu nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛmbɔ azu la, bɛ muala bɛbawu. Sonla mɔɔ le kpalɛ la ɛndɛla ɛtanevolɛ; sonla mɔɔ ka ndane la ɛndɛla sonla mɔɔ ɛnga ndane la. 3Awieleɛ ko ne ala a wɔ ɛkɛ maa bɛ muala a, na ɛhye noko le munzule mɔɔ ka debie biala mɔɔ wɔ aleɛabo la. Sumunli kenle ala mɔɔ sonla de ngoane nu la, ɛtane nee ɛzɛlɛsɛm ɛyi bɛ adwenle tɛkɛɛ. Bɛyɛ ɛhye mɔ na bɛwu. 4Noko akee awie biala mɔɔ de ngoane nu la lɛ anyelazo, ɔluakɛ twea anyewɔzo tɛla awenade funli. 5Ɔluakɛ anyewɔzoamra ze kɛ bɛbawu, na mɔwuamra ɛnze ɛhwee, yɛɛ bɛnlɛ ahatualɛ bieko; awie ɛngakye bɛ bieko. 6Bɛ ɛhulolɛ, bɛ ɛkpɔlɛ, nee bɛ anyebolo muala ɛwie, yɛɛ bɛ afoa nu ɛdeɛ ɛnle debie biala mɔɔ wɔ aleɛabo la anu bieko.
7Kɔ zolɛ, di wɔ aleɛ anyelielɛ nu, na fa anyelielɛ no wɔ nza, ɔluakɛ Nyamenle ɛlie debie biala mɔɔ ɛyɛ la ɛdo nu. 8Dahuu maa wɔ adɛladeɛ anye ɛyɛ bɔkɔbɔkɔ; yɛɛ mmamaa nwole kpa ɛ ti zo ɛlɛ. 9Mekɛ tendenle biala mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛva ɛmaa wɔ, mɔɔ ɛdi ye wɔ ewiade ɛbɛlabɔlɛ mgbane ye anu la, fa ɛ ye ne mɔɔ ɛkulo ye la dielie ɛ nye, ɔboalekɛ ɛvɛlɛ totohyia ye mɔɔ ɛlɛfɛ aleɛabo la, wɔ afoa nu ɛdeɛ ne ala ɛne. 10Debie biala mɔɔ ɛkɛzɔ nu kɛ ɛyɛ la, fa wɔ anwosesebɛ yɛ, ɔluakɛ gyima anzɛɛ ndwenlenwo anzɛɛ adwenle anzɛɛ nrɛlɛbɛ biala ɛnle Ɛbolɔ mɔɔ ɛlɛkɔ la.
11Eza menwunle kɛ aleɛabo, tɛ menli mɔɔ anwo yɛ ndɛ la a dahuu di konim wɔ ɛnriandilɛ nu a, yɛɛ tɛ anwosesebɛma angome a dahuu di konim wɔ konle nu a. Tɛ nrɛlɛbɛvolɛma angome a dahuu asa kɔ bɛ nloa a, tɛ sonla mɔɔ lɛ adwenle la angome a nyia ɔ nwo a, yɛɛ tɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛze debie yɛ kpalɛ la angome a nyia gyinlabelɛ kpole a. Tɛ mekɛ ne amuala a bɛdi ye moavolɛ a. 12Sonla ɛnze ye mekɛ; kɛmɔ avonle kola yɛ munzule kye fɛlɛ, yɛɛ ɛhane kola kye anloma la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ ɛhane kola kye dasanli wɔ munzule mekɛ mɔɔ ɔ nye ɛnla la a.
Nrɛlɛbɛ nee Koaseayɛlɛ nwo adwenleadwenle
13Eza menwu nrɛlɛbɛ nwo ndonwo ɛhye wɔ aleɛabo, na ɔyɛ me azibɛnwo kpole. 14Suakpole ekyi bie wɔ ɛkɛ mɔɔ menli ekyi bie a wɔ zolɛ a. Belemgbunli kpole bie ratetale ye, ɔvale ye ɛlɔnema ɔbɛnrale ɔyiale ye na ɔboɔboale ɔ nwo kɛ ɔbubu nwolɛ bane ne yeagua. 15Na nrenya ehyianli nrɛlɛbɛvolɛ bie mɔɔ wɔ suakpole ne azo la vale ye nrɛlɛbɛ ne pepɛle liele suakpole ne. Noko awie biala angakye mɔɔ ehyianli ne yɛle la. 16Bɛanwu nrenya ehyianli ne nrɛlɛbɛ ne, yɛɛ bɛandie ye edwɛkɛ, noko mese, nrɛlɛbɛ le kpalɛ tɛla anwosesebɛ. 17Nrɛlɛbɛvolɛ edwɛkɛ mɔɔ ɔkɛha ye bɛtɛɛ la le kpalɛ tɛla belemgbunli ɛdeɛdeanlɛ wɔ ahoasea avinli. 18Nrɛlɛbɛ le kpalɛ tɛla konle adu, na ɛtanenli kokye sɛkye ninyɛne kpalɛ dɔɔnwo.

Title: NOLO 10
Content:
1Nrɛzenra avunli maa mɔɔ yɛ sakyeɛ la nwole evuanlɛ bɔ nvoanle, yɛɛ koaseayɛlɛ ekyi sɛkye nrɛlɛbɛ kpole nee enililɛ.
2Nrɛlɛbɛvolɛ adwenle tɔ fema zo, na koasea adwenle tɔ bɛne zo. 3Koasea lua adenle zo bɔbɔ a, ɔkile ɔ nwo kɛ ɔnlɛ adwenle, yɛɛ ye nyɛleɛ ka kile awie biala kɛ ɔle koasea.
4Saa wɔ belemgbunli fa ɛ nwo ɛya a, mmagyakyi gyima ɛkɛ ne ala; saa ɛsie ɛ nwo diinyi a, wɔannea a wɔ ɛtane mgbole mɔɔ wɔyɛ bɔbɔ la, bɛbava bɛahyɛ wɔ.
5Menwu munzule bie wɔ aleɛabo, kɛ ɔle nvonleɛ mɔɔ vi belemgbunli ɛkɛ a ba a. 6Bɛmaa menli mɔɔ ɛnze nrɛlɛbɛ la tumi gyinlabelɛ na bɛkpo sukuavolɛma. 7Menwu kɛ ahanra dede mgbɔnwɔ zo na menli mɔɔ le arelemgbunli la lua aze kɛ ahanra.
8 Sonla mɔɔ fu awie mɔ anwo kuma la bahoati adɔ nuhua; sonla mɔɔ bɔ bane nu finde la, ɛwɔlɛ ka ye. 9Sonla mɔɔ kpukekpuke awolɛ la, bolɛ boda ye, yɛɛ sonla mɔɔ kpakyekpakye mbaka la, bie boda ye. 10Saa akuma tili na wɔanzi a, ɛfa ɛ nwonane ɛyɛ gyima; na nrɛlɛbɛ boa sonla maa ɔko ɔtɔ zolɛ 11Saa sonla mɔɔ ze ɛwɔlɛ sili kye la maa ɛwɔlɛ dumua ka ye kolaa na yeahye ɛwɔlɛ ne sili a, ɛnee nvasoɛ biala ɛnle silikyevolɛ ne anwo zo. 12Nrɛlɛbɛvolɛ nloa edwɛkɛ maa menli di ye eni, na koasea ka edwɛkɛ a ɔsɛkye ɔdaye mumua ne ɔ nwo. 13Ɔfa ngoaseasɛm ɔbɔ ye edwɛkɛ bo na yeava amumuyɛ ɛzɛlɛsɛm yeadwula ye. 14Koasea tendɛ a ɔ nloa ɛmpe.
Awie ɛnze mɔɔ bazi a, yɛɛ awie ɛngola ɛnga mɔɔ bazi ye ewule nzi la ɛngile ye.
15Koasea ɛvɛlɛ gyegye ye adwenle, yemɔti ɔngola ɔnnwu suakpole ne adenle.
16Maanle mɔɔ ye belemgbunli ne le kakula, na ye mgbanyima to ɛkponle nɔɔzo toonwo alehyenlɛ la, ye gyakɔ! 17Na maanle mɔɔ lɛ belemgbunli mɔɔ bɛtete ye na ɔdaye ɔkola ɔfa adwenle, na ye mgbanyima to ɛkponle wɔ mekɛ kpalɛ nu nyia anwosesebɛ, na bɛnno bɛmbo la anwo le moavolɛ.
18Saa sonla yɛ mgbovonle toonwo ye sua tete a, sua ne nwu, na ɔfolo ɔgua nu.
19Aleɛ maa sonla sele, nza maa sonla nye die, na ezukoa pɛ debie biala azo.
20Mmaka ɛ ne aze ɛbɔ belemgbunli ne anwo tokule, yɛɛ mmafea wɔ suakunlu bɔbɔ ɛbɔ sukoavolɛ anwo tokule. Anloma anzɛɛ kɛkɛba biala mɔɔ lɛ ndɛbalɛ la bahola ahɔha mɔɔ wɔha la ahile bɛ.

Title: NOLO 11
Content:
Mɔɔ nrɛlɛbɛvolɛ yɛ la
1Fuandi wɔ kpanwo ne to azule ne anye, na kenle bie ɛ sa baha ye. 2Bubu bie maa menli nsuu anzɛɛ mɔtwɛ bɔbɔ, ɔluakɛ ɛnze munzule mɔɔ kenle bie bazi azɛlɛ ye azo a.
3Saa ezule munla a, ɔtɔ ɔgua azɛlɛ ye azo, yɛɛ baka tudu tɔ nyiakɛ anzɛɛ sɔlɔ a, ɛleka mɔɔ ɔkɛdɔ la, ɛkɛ ne ala a ɔbala a. 4Sonla mɔɔ dahuu nea anwoma ne la ɛnrɛlua debie biala, yɛɛ mɔɔ nea kɛ anwomanyunlu si de la, ɛnrɛbu ye bɛyɔba. 5Kɛmɔ sonla ɛnze anwoma adenle na ɔnze kɛ ɔyɛ mɔɔ mogya kakyi sonla wɔ nrenzɛvolɛ kunlu la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ sonla ɛnze Nyamenle mɔɔ yɛ debie biala la gyima a. 6Dua wɔ ma ne nwonlomɔ, na eza dua bie nɔsolɛ nu. Ɔluakɛ ɛnze mɔɔ kɛyɛ kpalɛ a, saa bɛ mu nwiɔ bɛkɛyɛ kpalɛ anzɛɛ ko kɛyɛ kpalɛ kɛdɛla ko a, ɛnze.
