7Wienyi le kɛnlɛma, yɛɛ ɔyɛ anyelielɛ kɛ sonla kɛnwu sɛnzɛne ne. 8Saa sonla tɛnla ngoane nu ali ɛvolɛ dɔɔnwo a, bɛmaa ɔlie ɔ nye wɔ ɔ muala anu; noko bɛmaa ɔhakye kɛ munzule kenle ne mɔ bazo. Mɔɔ ba la amuala le debie mgbane.
Mgbavolɛ nee mbɛlɛra folɛdulɛ
9Mgbavolɛ nee mbɛlɛra, bɛlie bɛ nye wɔ bɛ ngakula nu. Bɛli fɛlɛko wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛtɛde mgbavolɛ nee mbɛlɛra la. Bɛli bɛ atiakunluwɔzo nzi, na bɛyɛ mɔɔ bɛkulo la. Noko bɛhakye kɛ Nyamenle babua bɛ debie biala mɔɔ bɛkɛyɛ la anwo ndɛne.
10Bɛye ɛyavalɛ bɛvi bɛ adwenle nu na bɛye anwofofolɛ biala bɛvi bɛ nwonane nu, ɔluakɛ mgbavosɛm nee mbɛlɛrasɛm nee ɛbɛlabɔlɛ nu fɛlɛkolilɛ le debie mgbane.

Title: NOLO 12
Content:
1Eza mekɛ mɔɔ bɛle mgbavolɛ nee mbɛlɛra la, bɛhakye bɛ Bɔvolɛ ne kolaa na munzule mekɛ ne mɔɔ ɛnee bɛbikye mgbanyifoa la adwu, na bɛaha kɛ, “Me nye ɛnlie ɛbɛla nu.” 2Bɛhakye ye kolaa na sɛnzɛne ne, anzɛɛ wienyi ne, siane ne, yɛɛ nwɔlɔra ne mɔ ayɛ bɛ nye zo monzomonzo, mɔɔ ezule pe bɔbɔ a amungu ne mɔ ɛmpɛ nuhua ɛnze ɛlɛ la. 3Mekɛ zɔhane, ɛsalɛ ne mɔɔ sɔ awuke ne la bawozowozo, mrenya mɔɔ anwo yɛ se la bakpo. Egyele mɔɔ bɛfa bɛkposa aleɛ la badudu aha ekyi bie, yɛɛ bɛ nye bayɛ monzomonzo. 4Bɛ nzo badi mɔɔ bɛnrɛde gua ne azo alɛra biala a. Saa bɛlɛti ma bɔbɔ a bɛnrɛde melahyinli ne ane, noko anloma ɛzunlɛ badunwue bɛ avi nafelɛ nu, na menli mɔɔ kulo edwɛne la ɛnrɛde edwɛndolɛ bieko. 5Eza bɛbazulo ɛleka mɔɔ wɔ anwuma la, yɛɛ ɛzulolɛ bara bɛ adenle nu, bɛ ti enrinli bayɛ egyɛne; ɛdialɛ bɔbɔ bayɛ se amaa bɛ na bɛ atiakunluwɔzo aye, ɔboalekɛ sonla ɛlɛkɔ ye ɛkɛla nzi, na nyanelilɛma bazu akpɔsa gua bile ne mɔ azo.
6Bɛhakye Bɔvolɛ ne kolaa na bɛ dwɛtɛ fufule ndweabane ne ade, anzɛɛ bɛ ezukoa nvutuke bonkuma ne abɔ; anzɛɛ bɛ dwora abɔ nzufeanvea bula ne azo anzɛɛ nyɛma ne mɔɔ bɛfa bɛto bula ne la ade. 7Munlutu bazia ahɔ ndɛtɛlɛ nu kɛ ye dɛba ne ala la, na sunsum ne azia ahɔ Nyamenle mɔɔ vale manle la ɛkɛ.
8Nolobɔvo ne se, mgbane nu mgbane ɔ. Ɔ muala le mgbane.
Edwɛkɛ ne sikalɛ
9Ɛye kɛ Nolobɔvo ne si ze nrɛlɛbɛ la ɛsie ahane a, eza ɔhilehilele menli ne adwenle nu ɛbukelɛ, debie ɛzuzulɛ nee debie ɛzukoalɛ na ɔdɔle alagye kpalɛ ɔzieziele mrɛlɛ mɔɔ ɔbule la. 10Nolobɔvo ne bɔle mɔdenle kɛ ɔkpondɛ edwɛkɛ agbɔkɛ mɔɔ yɛ fɛ la na edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ ɔhɛlɛle la le nɔhalɛ. 11Nrɛlɛbɛvoma edwɛkɛ le kɛ mboaneneavolɛma agbɔma ati ndwondwɔɔnwo ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛfa bɛka mboane la, yɛɛ mrɛlɛ mɔɔ bɛboɔboa bɛ nloa la kyɛ kɛ agbɛlɛko mɔɔ bɛva bɛbobɔ debie nu la. Nyamenle ne mɔɔ le kɛ mboaneneavolɛ mɔɔ nea yɛ kɔsɔɔti yɛ nwo zo la a ɛva ɛmaa yɛ a.
12Me ra nrenya, nea boɛ wɔ debie bieko mɔɔ li ɛhye mɔ anzi la anwo. Mbuluku ɛhɛlɛlɛ ɛnlɛ ye awieleɛ, yɛɛ ɛzukoalɛ dɔɔnwo maa ɛvɛlɛ.
13Bɛmaa yɛdie edwɛkɛ ne adwulaleɛ: Bɛzulo Nyamenle, na bɛli ye mɛla ne mɔ azo, ɔboalekɛ sonla gyima mɔɔ la ɔ nwo zo la ala ɛne. 14Ɔluakɛ Nyamenle babua debie biala mɔɔ yɛyɛ, nee awozinli nu nyɛleɛ biala anwo ndɛne, kpalɛ o, ɛtane o.

Title: SƆL MUKENYE
Content:
Mukenye
Sɔlɔmɔn Edwɛne ne mɔ le ɛhulolɛ edwɛkɛdwɛndolɛ mɔɔ bɛboɔboa bɛ nloa, na ye ɛleka dɔɔnwo kpalɛ wɔ nuhua mɔɔ nrenya to maa raalɛ, na raalɛ noko to maa nrenya a. Kɛ bɛzi bɛhile bɛ bo wɔ aneɛ ngakyile ngakyile nu la maa bɛfɛlɛ buluku ne Sɔlɔmɔn Edwɛne, ɔboalekɛ wɔ Hibulu aneɛ nu a ɛnee bɛdu bɛzie ɛkɛ bɛto bɛmaa Sɔlɔmɔn.
Dwuuma ɛhile edwɛne ɛhye mɔ abo kɛ ɔle nvoninli bie mɔɔ kile Nyamenle nee ye menli ne ngitanwolilɛ, yɛɛ Keleseɛnema nwu nvoninli ne kɛ ɔle Kelaese nee Asɔne ne ngitanwolilɛ.
Mɔɔ wɔ nu la
Edwɛne mɔɔ lumua 1.1—2.7
Edwɛne mɔɔ tɔ zo nwiɔ 2.8—3.5
Edwɛne mɔɔ tɔ zo nsa 3.6—5.1
Edwɛne mɔɔ tɔ zo nna 5.2—6.3
Edwɛne mɔɔ tɔ zo nnu 6.4—8.4
Edwɛne mɔɔ tɔ zo nsia 8.5-14

Title: SƆL 1
Content:
1 Edwɛne nu edwɛne mɔɔ yɛ fɛ kpalɛ kpalɛ mɔɔ bɛdole bɛmanle Sɔlɔmɔn.
Edwɛne mɔɔ lumua
Raalɛ ne
2O, anrɛɛ wɔavo me nloa anwo!
Ɔluakɛ wɔ ɛhulolɛ ne le kpalɛ tɛla nwanye.
3Wɔ nwole ne mɔɔ ɛkpokpa la bɔ evuanlɛ,
Wɔ duma le kɛ nwole mɔɔ bɛlɛwola,
yemɔti mbɛlɛra ne mɔ kulo wɔ.
4Fa me bɔ ɛ nwo na maa yɛnriandi yɛhɔ.
Belemgbunli ne ɛva me ɛra ye sua kunlu.
Yɛ mu nwiɔ yɛ nye balie,
yɛbahanvo wɔ ɛhulolɛ fɛlɛko ne yɛadɛla nwanye.
Ɔnyɛ ɛzulolɛ kɛ mraalɛ kɔsɔɔti kulo wɔ a.
5Gyɛlusalɛm mraalɛ,
mele bile duhuduhu, na me nwo yɛ fɛ,
mele duhuduhu kɛ Kidaa ndanlɛ azua,
me kɛnlɛma le kɛ Sɔlɔmɔn suakunlu mgbɛnu ndanlɛ.
6Mmafa ɛ nye foa ko ɛnea me kɛ medu a,
ɔboalekɛ sɛnzɛne ne a ɛmaa melu a.
Me mediema mrenya ne mɔ vale me nwo ɛya,
bɛmanle menyɛle gyima wɔ bɛ vanye egyinli ne mɔ anu;
mengyakyile medame me vanye egyinli ɛdeɛ ne.
7Me kulovolɛ, ka kile me,
nienwu a ɛbava wɔ nyɛmoa wɔahɔ adidi a?
Ɔdwu sɛnzɛnegyinla a nienwu a bɛbalie bɛ ɛnwomenle a?
Duzu ati a ɔwɔ kɛ mekpɔsa mekpondɛ wɔ
wɔ ɛ gɔnwo mɔ nyɛmoa avinli a?
Nrenya ne
8Wɔmɔ mɔɔ ɛ nwo yɛ fɛ tɛla mraalɛ kɔsɔɔti,
ɛnze ɛleka ne ɔ?
Dua nyɛmoa ne mɔ agyakɛ abo zo ne,
na maa wɔ mbɔnkye ne mɔ ɛdidi
mboaneneavolɛma ndanlɛ azua ne mɔ anwo.
9Me kulovolɛ, mefa wɔ meto Yigyibiti belemgbunli
ɛkpɔnwɔ belɛ mɔɔ twe ye ehwili ne mɔ la anwo.
10Ɛ nzo tɛba nu nee anwoneɛ le kɛnlɛma,
ɛ kɔme nee ndweabane kɛnlɛma bɛnga.
11Yɛbayɛ ezukoa nvutuke anwoneɛ yɛamaa wɔ,
yɛava dwɛtɛ fufule yɛaduodua nu.
Raalɛ ne
12Mekɛ mɔɔ belemgbunli ne la ye ebia ne anu la,
me nwo anatele ne evuanlɛ yile sua ne tɛkɛɛ.
13Me kulovolɛ ne le kɛ alufuanlɛ kodoku
mɔɔ la me kanra anu la.
14Me kulovolɛ ne le kɛ “hɛna” ndotolo siakɛ
mɔɔ kpakye Ɛngidae vanye egyinli ne mɔ anu la.
Nrenya ne
15Nea, ɛ nwo yɛ fɛ, me kulovolɛ;
nea, ɛ nwo yɛ fɛ;
ɛ nye ma le kɛ abubule nye.
Raalɛ ne
16Nea, ɛ nwo yɛ fɛ kpole, me kulovolɛ;
nɔhalɛ nu, ɛmaa me nye die kpole!
Yɛ ɛkpa mɔɔ yɛda zo la le asuomenle.
17Yɛ sua ne aakɔ ne mɔ le sida mbaka,
yɛɛ sepelɛse mbaka a yɛva yɛzɛ ɔ nye a.

Title: SƆL 2
Content:
1Mele kɛ Hyɛlɔn wulosu ndotolo,
mbɔnza nu aloa.
Nrenya ne
2Me kulovolɛ wɔ mbɛlɛra avinli a
ɔle kɛ aloa ndotolo wɔ mbowule nu la.
Raalɛ ne
3Saa me kulovolɛ gyi mgbavolɛ avinli a,
ɔle kɛ ampolo baka gyi ɛbɔ nu mbaka avinli.
Me nye die ye alubo ne anu ɛdɛnlanlɛ,
yɛɛ ye ma ne yɛ me fɛ.
4Ɔvale me ɔhɔle ye ɛkponledolɛ sua ne anu
na ɔvale ye ɛhulolɛ fɛlɛnra ne ɔguale me nwo zo.
5Maa me vanye ma welera maa ɔmaa me anwosesebɛ,
na maa me ampolo maa ɔmaa me anwosesebɛ fofolɛ,
ɔluakɛ ɛhulolɛ ngome ɛmaa me nwo ɛdo me.
6O anrɛɛ yeamaa me ti ala ɔ sa bɛne ne azo,
na yeava ɔ sa fema yeado me nwo zo.
7O Gyɛlusalɛm mraalɛ, mese,
bɛva weɛlɛ nee ahɛtɛboɛ anwondɛne ne mɔ
bɛha ndane kɛ bɛnrɛpele ɛhulolɛ nwo,
kɔkpula kɛ ɛhulolɛ ne mekɛ kpalɛ kɛdwu la.
Edwɛne mɔɔ tɔ zo nwiɔ
Raalɛ ne
8Mete me kulovolɛ ne ane!
Ɔvi awoka ne mɔ azo ɔlɛnriandi,
yeawuluwulu awoka mgbole nee ngyikyi zo yeara.
9Me kulovolɛ ne le kɛ kɛtɛboɛ,
ɔle kɛ weɛlɛ nyinli edonraa.
Yemɔ a gyi yɛ bane ne anzi la,
ɔlɛnea nvɛnzɛlɛ ne anu,
ɔ nye gyi nvɛnzɛlɛ ne anzi neanleɛ ne anu.
Nrenya ne
10Me kulovolɛ ne tendɛ se me kɛ:
“Dwazo, me kulovolɛ,
me kulovolɛ kɛnlɛmaleɛ, maa yɛhɔ.
11Ɔluakɛ ɛyɛlɛ mekɛ ne ɛze;
ezule ne ɛwie tɔ.
12Ndotolo ɛkpakye ɛbɔ biala abo.
Edwɛndolɛ mekɛ ɛdwu;
bɛte abubule ne mɔ ɛzunlɛ
wɔ avule ne mɔ anu.
13Feege mbaka ɛbɔ ɔ bo ɛlɛso,
vanye mbaka ɛbɔ ndotolo,
bɛmaa maanle nu ɛbɔ evuanlɛ.
Dwazo, me kulovolɛ,
me kulovokpa, maa yɛhɔ.
14Ɛle kɛ abubule mɔɔ vea
bodane mɔɔ ɛkpuke la avinli.
Maa menwu ɛ nyunlu kɛnlɛma ne,
na mende ɛ ne fɛlɛko ne,
ɔluakɛ ɛ ne yɛ fɛ,
yɛɛ ɛ nyunlu le kɛnlɛma.
15Bɛhye ɛzonlɛ ne mɔ bɛmaa yɛ,
ɛzonlɛ ngyikyi ne mɔ,
mɔɔ sɛkye vanye egyinli ne mɔ la,
ɔluakɛ yɛ vanye egyinli ne mɔ ɛbɔ ndotolo.”
Raalɛ ne
16Me kulovolɛ ne le me ɛdeɛ, yɛɛ mele ye ɛdeɛ,
ɔfa ye nyɛmoa ɔkɔ adidi wɔ aloa avinli.
17Sia ɛ nzi, me kulovokpa, maa ɛ nwo ɛyɛ ndɛ
kɛ Bitɛ awoka zo kɛtɛboɛ anzɛɛ weɛlɛ,
kolaa na mangyee ne azi,
na maanle nu atete.

Title: SƆL 3
Content:
1Nɔɔzo mɔɔ mela me ɛkpa ne azo la,
menganle me kulovolɛ ne anwo ɛlalɛ.
Memkpondɛle ye, na meannwu ye,
menvɛlɛle ye, na yeambua.
2Kɛkala akee medwazo meahɔkpɔsa suakpole ye azo,
gua ne mɔ azo nee ɛleka wienyi ne mɔ,
meakpondɛ me kulovolɛ ne.
Memkpondɛle ye, na meannwu ye.
3Sinzavolɛma mɔɔ sinza suakpole ne la nwunle me,
mekɛ mɔɔ bɛbɔ suakpole ne azo mgbɔlɔka la.
Membizale bɛ, “Bɛ nye ɛbɔ me kulovolɛ ne
anwo zo ɛleka bie ɔ?”
4Mevi bɛ nwo ɛkɛ ne ala la,
menwunle me kulovolɛ ne.
Menzɔle ye kɛ menrɛmaa ɔnrɛhɔ,
kɔkpula kɛ me nee ye ɛhɔ ɔmɔ sua nu,
ekpumgbunli ne mɔɔ bɛwole me nu la anu.
5O Gyɛlusalɛm mraalɛ, mese,
bɛva weɛlɛ nee ahɛtɛboɛ anwondɛne ne mɔ
bɛha ndane kɛ bɛnrɛpele ɛhulolɛ nwo
kɔkpula kɛ ɛhulolɛ ne mekɛ kpalɛ kɛdwu la.
Edwɛne mɔɔ tɔ zo nsa
Raalɛ ne
6Duzu a vi fienemgbole ne anu ɛlɛba,
mɔɔ le bolonwonwo kɛ esike,
na ɛyɛlɛ nee alufuanlɛ evuanlɛ ɛyɛ ye mukumuku,
ɛyɛlɛ mɔɔ gualilɛma a tɔne la?
7Bɛnlea, Sɔlɔmɔn ɛlɛba,
bɛzo ye wɔ belemgbunli bonrane nu;
katakyiema abulasia a le ye sinzavoma a,
bɛle Yizilayɛ ɛlɔne nu
katakyiema ne mɔ bie.
8Bɛ kɔsɔɔti bɛdedɛ konle dadeɛ;
yɛɛ bɛze konle nye zo kpalɛ kpalɛ.
Nɔɔzo arɛlevilɛ nu ɛtetalɛ ti,
ko biala lɛ dadeɛ zia ɔ nwo.
9Belemgbunli Sɔlɔmɔn yɛle bonrane,
ɔvale Lɛbanɔn mbaka a ɔyɛle a.
10Ɔvale dwɛtɛ fufule ɔfɔlele ye mbaka ne mɔ anwo,
ɔvale ezukoa nvutuke ɔfɔlele ɔ nzi ne,
ɔvale ɛdanlɛ buluwu nee kɔkɔlɛ afonla
mɔɔ Gyɛlusalɛm mraalɛ ɛnwo nu la
ɔzɛle ɛleka mɔɔ bɛtɛnla la.
11O Zayɔn mraalɛ, bɛranlea Belemgbunli Sɔlɔmɔn,
nee ye belemgbunli kyɛlɛ mɔɔ ɔ nli vale zoale ye
kenle ko ne mɔɔ bɛdie ye atɔfolɛ la,
kenle ko ne, fɛlɛko nee anyelielɛ yile ye ahonle tɛkɛɛ.

Title: SƆL 4
Content:
Nrenya ne
1Nea, ɛ nwo yɛ fɛ, me kulovolɛ,
nea, ɛ nwo yɛ fɛ!
Ɛ nye ma le kɛ abubule ɛdeɛ ne
wɔ ɛ ti aguzo ne abo.
Wɔ enrinli dwazo senreleenyi kɛ mbɔnkye ekpunli
mɔɔ vi Geleade awoka zo ɛlɛtolo la enrinli.
2Ɛ gye le nwohyee kɛ mboane mɔɔ bɛpepɛ bɛ enrinli,
na bɛvi ɛleka mɔɔ bɛbiale bɛ la bɛra la.
Ko bɔbɔ ɛtɛtule,
bɛ muala bɛsɛ sɛsɛ.
3Ɛ nloa babonle ne bolo kɛ nyɛma kɔkɔlɛ,
yɛɛ ɛ nloa mumua ne nee ɛdendɛlɛ le kɛnlɛma.
Ɛ nvoka le kɛ akutue mɔɔ bɛkpuke nuhua
wɔ ɛ ti aguzo ne abo.
4Ɛ kɔme tendenle le kɛ Devidi tawa ne
mɔɔ bɛfa konle ninyɛne bɛsie nu,
enyinlike apenle hendɛhenda nu,
bɛ muala bɛle katakyiema enyinlike.
5Ɛ nyɛfo nwiɔ ne le kɛ weɛlɛ ngakula nwiɔ,
ahɛtɛboɛ ndalɛ mɔɔ didi aloa avinli.
6Kyesɛ aleɛ kye na awozinli ne se,
mebavo alufuanlɛ boka ye
nee ɛyɛlɛ evuanlɛ boka ekyi ye azo.
7Ɛ nwo yɛ fɛ vi wɔ anwuma dwu aze,
me kulovolɛ, ɛdi munli bɔkɔɔ.
8Fi Lɛbanɔn awoka ne mɔ azo maa yɛhɔ, me atɔfolɛ
raalɛ;
fi Lɛbanɔn maa yɛhɔ.
Ɛvi Ameena Boka ne azo dwu aze,
fi Sinɛ Boka nee Hɛmɔn Boka,
ɛleka mɔɔ awenade nee boboduma
ngome ɛva ɛyɛ bɛ ɛdeɛ la.
9Saa menea ɛ nye ma, me diema raalɛ,
me atɔfolɛ raalɛ,
nee ndweabane mɔɔ gua ɛ kɔme la a,
me ahonle di pe pe pe,
10Wɔ ɛhulolɛ yɛ fɛ
me diema raalɛ, me atɔfolɛ raalɛ.
Wɔ ɛhulolɛ yɛ fɛ tɛla nwanye;
wɔ nwole ne mɔ bɔ evuanlɛ
tɛla aledonlɛ ninyɛne evuanlɛ biala.
11Me atɔfolɛ raalɛ, ɛ nloa anwo fɛlɛko
le kɛ ndotolo nu nzule fɛlɛko,
wolɛ nee meleke wɔ ɛ tafinlima abo;
wɔ adɛladeɛ nu evuanlɛ
le kɛ evuanlɛ mɔɔ vi Lɛbanɔn.
12Me diema raalɛ, me atɔfolɛ ne
le tola mɔɔ apipi la ɔ nloa,
nzufeanvea mɔɔ bɛdo nuhua.
13Nuhua mbaka le kɛ akutue,
bɛle ngɛnlɛma, bɛ ma yɛ fɛ,
mbaka evuanlɛ hɛna nee naade,
14naade nee safolɔn, kalamɛse nee senamɔn,
nee ɛyɛlɛ evuanlɛ mbaka kɔsɔɔti,
alufuanlɛ nee kolɔbo,
nee aledonlɛ ninyɛne kpalɛ,
15nzufeanvea, ngoane nzule bula,
yɛɛ Lɛbanɔn azule se dua tola ne anu.
Raalɛ ne
16Dwazo! O Sɔlɔ Anwoma,
O Nyiakɛ Anwoma, bɔ bɛla!
Bɔ me tola ye anu maa nuhua evuanlɛ ne ɛdwu moa.
Maa me kulovolɛ ne ɛrɛla ye tola ye anu,
ɛrali nuhua ma fɛlɛko ne mɔ.

Title: SƆL 5
Content:
Nrenya ne
1Me diema raalɛ, me atɔfolɛ,
mera me tola ne anu.
Melɛboɔboa me alufuanlɛ
nee me aledonlɛ ninyɛne evuanlɛ ne mɔ anloa;
melɛdi me wolɛ ndɛlamoa nee me wolɛ ne;
melɛno me nwanye ne nee me meleke ne.
Mraalɛ ne mɔ
Agɔnwolɛma, bɛli na bɛnlo
bɛnlo bɛbo, o kulovolɛma.
Edwɛne mɔɔ tɔ zo nna
Raalɛ ne
2Mɔɔ menlale la ɛnee me ahonle ɛlɛsi.
Tie, me kulovolɛ ne ɛlɛbɔ me anlenkɛ nu!
Nrenya ne
Buke anlenkɛ ne, me diema raalɛ,
me abubule, me kulovolɛ mɔɔ di munli,
ɛbɔlɛ ɛdɔ me ti zo, na me ti enrinli ɛloa tɔfɔɔ.
Raalɛ ne
3Meye me nwo dɛbadɛba;
duzu ati a ɔwɔ kɛ mekeda me nwo bieko a?
Menrinzi me gyakɛ anwo;
duzu ati a ɔwɔ kɛ meyɛ bɛ evinli a?
4Me kulovolɛ ne zɔle anlenkɛ ne ɛlakolo ne anu,
na me kunlu dele me.
5Mendwazole kɛ mebuke me kulovolɛ ne,
na me sa anwo alufuanlɛ ne manle me sa telele;
menzɔle kɔlɔkɔlɔ ne anu la,
me sa mrɛlɛsɛka anwo alufuanlɛ ne telele.
6Membukele me kulovolɛ ne anlenkɛ ne,
na me kulovolɛ ne ɛzia ɛhɔ.
Ɛnee me ɛkɛla ɛlɛsu kɛ ɔkɛde ɔ ne.
Memkpondɛle ye, na meannwu ye;
menvɛlɛle ye, na meande ye nganeɛ.
7Suakpole ne azo sinzavoma
mɔɔ ɛnee ɛlɛtudu agyakɛ la nwunle me;
bɛbɔle me na bɛbodale me;
bɛzale me bɛliele me aguzo ne,
sinzavoma mɔɔ sinza bane ne mɔ la.
8O bɛmɛ Gyɛlusalɛm mraalɛ, mese,
saa bɛnwu me kulovolɛ ne a,
bɛha bɛhile ye kɛ
ye ɛhulolɛ ngome ɛbɔ me anwonyane.
Mraalɛ ne mɔ
9Duzu a wɔ wɔ kulovolɛ ne anwo tɛla kulovolɛ biala a,
anwofɛlɛko nu raalɛ anwofɛlɛko?
Duzu a maa wɔ kulovolɛ ne tɛla kulovolɛ biala,
mɔɔ yemɔti ɛse yɛ zɛhae ɛ?
Raalɛ ne
10Me kulovolɛ ne anwo yɛ fɛ, eza ɔte kpɔkɛ;
saa ɛye menli apenle bulu a ɔdaye ala.
11Ɔ ti sonle bolɛ kɛ ezukoa nvutuke,
ɔ ti enrinli belebele gua zo
ɔle duhuduhu kɛ kɔkɔsɛlɛ.
12Ɔ nye ma ngɛnlɛma le kɛ abubule
mɔɔ bɛbia ye meleke nu,
na ɔgyi nzubula nloa la,
ɔfɛta ye somaa.
13Ɔ nvoka le ngɛnlɛma kɛ aledonlɛ ninyɛne evuanlɛ kofie
mɔɔ zolɛ bɔ evuanlɛ la.
Ɔ nloa babonle le kɛ aloa
mɔɔ kpu alufuanlɛ nzule la.
14Ɔ sa mbaka le kɛ ezukoa nvutuke kpɔma,
mgbɔdelera mɔɔ mgbɔba duodua nu la gua ɔ sa.
Ye nwonane le tonlotonlo kɛ ɛzɛlɛ
mɔɔ ezukoa bolɛ safaya betɛbeta nu la.
15Ye ɛzɔlɛ le kɛ alabaseta adoba
mɔɔ gyigyi ezukoa nvutuke zo.
Ɔgyi zo sengɔɔnwo kɛ Lɛbanɔn
awoka nee sida mbaka.
16Ye ɛdendɛlɛ yɛ fɛ kpole,
ye debie biala twe ahonle.
Me kulovolɛ ne nee me gɔnwo ne kɛ de la ɛne,
O Gyɛlusalɛm mraalɛ.

Title: SƆL 6
Content:
Mraalɛ ne mɔ
1Anwofɛlɛko nu anwofɛlɛko,
nienwu a wɔ kulovolɛ ne ɛhɔ a?
Kile yɛ ɛleka mɔɔ ɔvale la,
amaa yɛ nee wɔ ahɔkpondɛ ye.
Raalɛ ne
2Me kulovolɛ ne ɛhɔ ye tola nu lɔ,
kofie ne mɔ mɔɔ mbaka evuanlɛ ne mɔ wɔ zo la,
kɛ ɔkamaa ye nyɛmoa adidi tola ne anu,
na yeatete aloa.
3Me kulovolɛ ne le me ɛdeɛ, yɛɛ mele ye ɛdeɛ;
ɔmaa ye nyɛmoa didi aloa ne mɔ avinli.
Edwɛne mɔɔ tɔ zo nnu
Nrenya ne
4Me kulovolɛ, ɛ nwo yɛ fɛ kɛ Gyɛlusalɛm la,
ɛ nwo yɛ anyelielɛ kɛ suakpole Tɛza la,
ɛ nwo ka ɛzulolɛ kɛ ɛlɔnema mɔɔ dedɛ avɛlɛnra la.
5Ye ɛ nye wɔ me nwo,
ɔluakɛ bɛmaa debie tɔ me nwo zo.
Wɔ enrinli dwazo senreleenyi kɛ mbɔnkye ekpunli
mɔɔ vi Geleade awoka zo ɛlɛtolo la enrinli.
6Ɛ gye le nwohyee kɛ mboane mbelɛ
mɔɔ bɛhɔbia bɛ bɛra la.
Ko bɔbɔ ɛtɛtule;
bɛ muala bɛsɛ sɛsɛ.
7Ɛ nvoka le kɛ akutue ma
mɔɔ bɛkpuke nuhua,
wɔ ɛ ti aguzo ne abo,
8Belemgbunli gya mraalɛ abulasia,
ye mgbɔnla abulatwɛ,
yɛɛ sonvolɛ mraalɛ dɔɔnwo mɔɔ bɛnze bɛ nloa.
9Me abubule ne mɔɔ di munli la le kokye.
Yemɔ a ɔ nli kulo ye kpalɛ a,
mɔɔ wole ye la anye zo a ɔ nwo ɛnlɛ dɛne.
Sonvolɛ mraalɛ ne nea ye na bɛkanvo ye;
arelemgbunli mraalɛ nee mgbɔnla ne mɔ
noko nea ye na bɛye ye ayɛlɛ.
10Nwane ɔ, mɔɔ ɔ nye pɛ kɛ aleɛbahye la?
Ɔle kɛnlɛma kɛ siane, na ɔta kɛ sɛnzɛne,
ɔ nwo ka ɛzulolɛ kɛ ɛlɔnema mɔɔ dedɛ avɛlɛnra la.
11Mengɔle mbakama egyinli ne anu,
kɛ mekanlea mbaka mɔɔ wɔ bɔnza ne anu la,
saa vanye mbaka ne mɔ ɛyeye nya,
na mbaka ne mɔ mɔɔ so ma kɛ akutue la ɛbɔ ndotolo a.
12Me nye zo katete me la
ɛnee ɛhulolɛ ngome ɛmaa meyɛ kɛ
mede belemgbunli ehwili nu wɔ ɔ nwo ɛkɛ.
Mraalɛ ne mɔ
13Sia ɛ nzi, sia ɛ nzi, wɔmɔ bɛlɛra mɔɔ ɛvi Hyulam,
sia ɛ nzi, sia ɛ nzi maa yɛnlea wɔ bie.
Raalɛ ne
Duzu ati a bɛkulo kɛ bɛnea me
kɛ bɛnea agolezilɛ wɔ ɛlɔnema nwiɔ avinli ɛ?

Title: SƆL 7
Content:
Nrenya ne
1Duzu nwanwane bɛlɛra a le wɔ,
mɔɔ ɛ gyakɛ nee mgbɔlaboa di zɛhae a?
Wɔ ɛzɔlɛ bolomolo ne mɔ le kɛ mgbɔba,
bɛ ngɛnlɛma le kɛ dwinvolɛ kpalɛ sa anloa gyima.
2Ɛ kotoa le kɛ kyɛnze bonkuma kutukpunli
mɔɔ nwanye evuanlɛ ɛmkpa nuhua ɛlɛ.
Ɛ ko ɛzɛne le hwiiti edukue
mɔɔ aloa ɛbɔ ɛyia ye.
3Wɔ mgbokua nwiɔ ne le kɛ weɛlɛ ngakula nwiɔ,
bɛle kɛ ahɛtɛboɛ ndalɛ.
4Ɛ kɔme le kɛ ɛzɛlɛ tawa.
Ɛ nye le kɛ suakpole Hɛhyebɔn nzubula ne mɔ
mɔɔ zua suakpole ne anlenkɛ kpole ne la.
Ɛ bonyi le hwɛɛnye kɛ Lɛbanɔn tawa
mɔɔ ɛ gyi zo a ɛnwu Dɛmasekɛse la.
5Ɛ ti kɛnlɛma le kɛ Kamɛle Boka.
Ɛ ti mɔɔ bɛnwa la ta kɛ selekye;
ye kɛnlɛma maa debie tɔ belemgbunli nwo zo.
6Ɛle kɛnlɛma, ɛ nwo yɛ anyelielɛ,
O kulovokpa, anyelielɛ bɛlɛra.
7Ɛgyi zo sengɔɔnwo kɛ arɛlɛ eluba,
wɔ mgbokua le kɛ ye betike ne mɔ.
8Mebavo arɛlɛ ne
na meazɔ ye mrɛlakɛ ne mɔ anu.
O, anrɛɛ wɔ mgbokua ayɛ kɛ vanye aziakɛ,
na wɔ ɛnwomenle evuanlɛ ɛyɛ kɛ ampolo,
9na ɛ nloa anwo ayɛ fɛ
kɛ nwanye kpalɛ fɛlɛko
mɔɔ kpula ɛnloanlɛ nee egyele,
na ɔdwu ɛkolɛ nu bɛtɛɛ.
Raalɛ ne
Akee maa nwanye ne ɛdwu me kulovolɛ ne ɛkɛ,
ɔze ɔ nloa anwo nee ɔ gye zo.
10Mele me kulovolɛ ne ɛdeɛ,
yɛɛ ɔkulo me ɛsesebɛ.
11Me kulovokpa, bɛla
maa yɛhɔ ɛya ne anu lɔ,
na yɛhɔli aledwolɛ ne wɔ namunamu ne mɔ anu.
12Yɛbadwazo ndɛ yɛahɔ vanye egyinli ne mɔ anu
yɛahɔnlea saa vanye mbaka ne mɔ ɛyeye nya,
saa bɛ ndotolo ne mɔ ɛkpukekpuke,
na mbaka mɔɔ le kɛ akutue la ɛbɔ ndotolo a.
Na ɛkɛ ne yɛɛ mebava me ahonle kɔsɔɔti meamaa wɔ a.
13Mandileki ne mɔ evuanlɛ ba,
ma fɛlɛko, dɛba nee fofolɛ kɔsɔɔti
wɔ yɛ sua nu ɛke.
O me kulovokpa, meva ɛhye mɔ kɔsɔɔti mezie wɔ.

Title: SƆL 8
Content:
1Me kunlu a anrɛɛ ɛle me diema nrenya,
mɔɔ ɔmɔ a nloanle wɔ nyɛfonlɛ a!
Saa me nee wɔ yiale alie nwo a,
anrɛɛ menwɔvo ɛ nloa anwo,
yɛɛ awie biala ɛnrɛdwenle nwolɛ.
2Anrɛɛ me nee wɔ kɛhɔ
ɔmɔ mɔɔ nrenzɛle wole me la sua nu,
na wɔahile me ɛhulolɛ deɛ holɛ.
Anrɛɛ menwɔmaa ɛkɛnlo nwanye
mɔɔ ninyɛne evuanlɛ wɔ nu la,
me ma ne mɔɔ le kɛ akutue la anu nza.
3O anrɛɛ yeamaa me ti ala ɔ sa bɛne ne azo,
na yeava ɔ sa fema ne yeado me nwo zo.
4O Gyɛlusalɛm mraalɛ, mese,
bɛmmapele ɛhulolɛ nwo
kɔkpula kɛ ɛhulolɛ ne mekɛ kpalɛ kɛdwu la.
Edwɛne mɔɔ to zo nsia
Mraalɛ ne mɔ
5Nwane a vi fienemgbole ne anu ɛlɛba,
mɔɔ ɔ nee ye kulovolɛ bɛdedɛ bɛ sa a?
Raalɛ ne
Mendunwuele wɔ wɔ ampolo baka ne abo,
ɛleka mɔɔ bɛwole wɔ la.
Ɛkɛ ne a mɔɔ wole wɔ la ako hanle ye a.
6Fa me yɛ ɛyɛlɛ sɔ wɔ ahonle ne anloa
yɛ me nzonlɛyɛdeɛ wɔ ɛ sa anwo.
Ɔluakɛ ɛhulolɛ yɛ se kɛ ewule,
yɛɛ nungule ati yɛ se kɛ funli kuma.
Ɔpɛ fɛlɛ a ɔle senle,
na ɔsɔ kɛ sendɔlɔra.
7Nzule ɛngola ɛhulolɛ nua,
yɛɛ azuyilɛ ɛngola ye monla.
Saa sonla fa ye sua nu anwonyia kɔsɔɔti
kɛ ɔfa yeadɔ ɛhulolɛ a,
mɔɔ ɔbanyia ye la a le amgbuzilɛ.
Raalɛ ne amediema mrenya
8Yɛlɛ yɛ diema raalɛ kakula,
ɔtɛsuozuale nyɛfonlɛ.
Saa kpavolɛ bie babiza ye agyalɛ a,
duzu a yɛkɛyɛ yɛkɛmaa adiema raalɛ ne a?
9Saa ɔle bane a,
yɛbazi dwɛtɛ fufule tawa yeamaa ye;
na saa ɔle anlenkɛ kpole a,
yɛbava sida ndaboa yɛabobɔ.
Raalɛ ne
10Mele bane,
yɛɛ me nyɛfo le ye tawa ne mɔ.
Me kulovolɛ ne anye zo a,
mele sonla mɔɔ nee anzonudwolɛ lua a.
Nrenya ne
11Sɔlɔmɔn lɛ vanye egyinli wɔ Beeyale Heemɔn.
Ɔfa egyinli ne ɔmaa menli kɛ bɛnlea zo;
ko biala fa ma ne anu ezukoa
dwɛtɛ fufule apenle ko babu mgbonda maa ye.
12Melɛ me vanye egyinli,
me ti anwo vanye egyinli.
O wɔmɔ Sɔlɔmɔn, ɛnyia dwɛtɛ fufule apenle ko a,
menli mɔɔ nea ɛya ne la biala nyia ɛya nwiɔ.
13O wɔmɔ mɔɔ ɛwɔ tola ne anu,
me gɔnwo mɔ ɛlɛkendɛ adie ɛ ne;
maa mende ɛ ne.
Raalɛ ne
14Me kulovolɛ, ka ɛ nwo bɛla,
maa ɛ nwo ɛyɛ ndɛ kɛ kɛtɛboɛ,
anzɛɛ weɛlɛ nyinli mɔɔ wɔ awoka mɔɔ
aledonlɛ ninyɛne evuanlɛ fifi zolɛ la azo.

Title: AYE MUKENYE
Content:
Mukenye
Ayezaya buluku ne bɛvale bɛdonle Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ kpole bie mɔɔ dɛnlanle Gyɛlusalɛm la. Mekɛ ne anu ɛnee yeha ɛvolɛ ɛya mɔtwɛ na bɛawo Kelaese ne. Buluku ɛhye bɛhyɛ nuhua ekpunli nsa:
1. Mgbakyelɛ 1-39 ka mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee Aselea, maanle bie mɔɔ anwo yɛ se la ɛlɛka Dwuda, Yizilayɛ nyiakɛ maanle ne ɛzulolɛ la anwo edwɛkɛ. Ayezaya nwunle kɛ tɛ Aseleama anwosesebɛ kpole ne yɛɛ ka Dwudama ɛzulolɛ a, na maanlema bɛdabɛ bɛ ɛtane mɔɔ bɛyɛ, bɛ anzosesebɛ mɔɔ bɛyɛ wɔ Nyamenle anwo, yɛɛ bɛ rɛle mɔɔ bɛnva bɛnwula Nyamenle anu la, yemɔ a ɛnee ka bɛ ɛzulolɛ a. Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ ne vale edwɛkɛ nee nyɛleɛ kpale ɛhye anwo ɛdanlɛ wienyi na ɔzele menli ne nee bɛ mgbanyima ne mɔ kɛ bɛbɔ ɛbɛla mɔɔ tenrɛ la na bɛli pɛlepɛle, na ɔbɔle bɛ kɔkɔ kɛ saa bɛandie Nyamenle ane a munzule kɛha bɛ na maanle ne abɔ. Ayezaya eza hanle mekɛ bie mɔɔ bara, mɔɔ anzonudwolɛ bara ewiade ye amuala anu, yɛɛ Belemgbunli Devidi abo zo sonla mɔɔ bara arali belemgbunli mɔɔ bɛ nye balie ɔ nwo la anwo edwɛkɛ.
2. Mgbakyelɛ 40-55 ka mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee bɛhye Dwudama nuokɛ bɛhɔ nlɔnu wɔ Babelɔn, bɛlɛnwu amaneɛ na bɛ anyelazo ɛwie la. Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ ne bɔle nolo kɛ ɔnrɛhyɛ biala na Nyamenle amaa bɛagyakyi ye menli ne na yeava bɛ yeazia yeara sua nu wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm yeamaa bɛabɔ bɛ ɛbɛla bo fofolɛ. Edwɛkɛ kpɔkɛ titile mɔɔ wɔ mgbakyelɛ ɛhye mɔ anu la a le kɛ Nyamenle le tetedwɛkɛ Awulae, na ye menli ne gyima mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ yɛ wɔ maanle maanle ne mɔ anu la boka ye ngyehyɛlɛ mɔɔ ɔhyehyɛle ɔmanle bɛ la anwo, ɔluakɛ ɔlua Yizilayɛ anwo zo yɛɛ maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti banyia nyilalɛ a. “Awulae Sonvolɛ” ne anwo edwɛkɛ dɔɔnwo mɔɔ bɛhɛlɛ la boka edwɛkɛ mɔɔ menli ze bɛ kpalɛ kpalɛ wɔ Ngyekyeleɛ Dɛba ne anu la.
3. Mgbakyelɛ 56-66 le edwɛkɛ mɔɔ bɛhanle nuhua dɔɔnwo kpalɛ bɛhilele bɛdabɛ mɔɔ ɛnee bɛwɔ Gyɛlusalɛm la a. Mekɛ ne anu ɛnee bɛhyia akɛnrazilɛ kɛ Nyamenle bali ye ɛwɔkɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ ɔbɔle maanle ne la azo. Mɔɔ ɛnee ɔwɔ kɛ bɛdwenle nwolɛ na bɛyɛ la a le kɛ bɛkɛbɔ ɛbɛla mɔɔ tenrɛ, bɛkɛli pɛlepɛle, bɛkɛzie Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ne, bɛkɛbɔ azu na bɛkɛyɛ nzɛlɛlɛ. Edwɛkɛ titile mɔɔ wɔ nu la wɔ mgbakyelɛ 61.1-2. Ɛhye a le edwɛkɛ mɔɔ Gyisɛse vale bɔle ye gyimalilɛ ne abo a.
Mɔɔ wɔ nu la
Kɔkɔbɔlɛ nee ɛwɔkɛbɔlɛ ne mɔ 1.1—12.6
Maanle maanle ne mɔ ndeanlɛ 13.1—23.18
Nyamenle bua ewiade ndɛne 24.1—27.13
Kɔkɔbɔlɛ nee ɛwɔkɛbɔlɛ ne mɔ bieko 28.1—35.10
Dwuda Belemgbunli Kɛzikaya nee Aseleama 36.1—39.8
Ɛwɔkɛbɔlɛ nee anyelazo nrɛlaleɛ ne mɔ 40.1—55.13
Kɔkɔbɔlɛ nee ɛwɔkɛbɔlɛ ne mɔ 56.1—66.24

Title: AYE 1
Content:
1 Emɔzo ara nrenya Ayezaya ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ ne mɔɔ Nyamenle yele hilele ye, mɔɔ fane Dwuda nee Gyɛlusalɛm anwo wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee Dwuda Arelemgbunli Ɛzaya, Dwotam, Ehaze, yɛɛ Hɛzikaya di ebia la ɛne.
Nyamenle twi ye menli ne anyunlu
2Ɛdɛnkɛma zele kɛ, “Anwuma amra, bɛdie, aze amra, bɛyɛ ɛnzonlɛ bɛdie, ɔluakɛ medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, mese: Metete ngakula mrenya memaa bɛnyi, na bɛde me nwo atua. 3Ɛnlankɛ ze ɔ menle, asoaso ze ɛleka mɔɔ ɔ menle maa ye aleɛ la; na Yizilayɛma, mɔɔ le medame me menli la ɛnze me, yɛɛ bɛnlɛ ndelebɛbo.”
4Aa, maanle mɔɔ ɛtane ɛyi ye tɛkɛɛ a, menli mɔɔ ninyɛndane ɛyɛlɛ ɛli bɛ ti a, esiayɛɛ mralɛ, menli mɔɔ nzisi ala a bɛdi a, bɛbɔ munzule! Bɛkpo Ɛdɛnkɛma, bɛhyi Yizilayɛ Nwuanzanwuanza Ko ne, na bɛhakyi bɛ nzi bɛzi ye bɔkɔɔ. 5Fane nyɛ yɛɛ bɛkpondɛ kɛ bɛtea bɛ kolaa na bɛagyakyi atuadelɛ a? Bɛ ti kanrɛlɛ mumua ne ɛnde kpɔkɛ, yɛɛ bɛ ahonle ɛwu. 6Ɔvi bɛ gyakɛ akunlu toonwo mɔɔ kɔdwu bɛ ti zo la ɛkpɔdekpɔde ɛyɛ nganlɛ ngome na bɛtwihwi mogya; ɛhye ati bɛnde kpɔkɛ. Bɛmɛ a, bɛmmia, yɛɛ bɛnkyekye zo, yɛɛ bɛnva nwole bɛntoto nu.
7Bɛ maanle ne ɛdɔ mgbane, bɛyela bɛ azuamgbole ne mɔ; bɛdabɛ bɛ nye zo, nyɛvolɛ ɛva bɛ azɛlɛ ne, bɛzɛkye debie biala mɔɔ wɔ zolɛ la. 8Gyɛlusalɛm ala a ɛha kɛ vanye egyinli nu kpɔda anzɛɛ ndɔlɔra avule nu kpɔda, na yeyɛ kɛ suakpole mɔɔ ɛlɔnema ɛbɛnra ɛyia ye la. 9 Saa Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma anvavi, angyakyi yɛ menli ekyi a anrɛɛ yɛyɛle kɛ Sodɔm nee Gomɔla la.
10Bɛmɛ Gyɛlusalɛmma, mɔɔ bɛyɛ kɛ Sodɔm nee Gomɔla amra la, bɛyɛ ɛnzonlɛ bɛdie Ɛdɛnkɛma edwɛkɛ ne nee ye ngilehilelɛ ne. 11 Ɔse, “Bɛ azubɔlɛ bebelebe ne ɛnzɔ me nye. Bɛ mboane ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ nee bɛ nane mɔɔ ɛlɔ la anu ɛnlome azubɔdeɛ ne mɔɔ bɛfa bɛmaa me la ɛyɛ boɛ. Me nye ɛnlie nlankɛ, mboane mralɛ anzɛɛ mbɔnkye nyinli mogya nwo bieko. 12Nwane a hanle hilele bɛ kɛ saa bɛba me nyunlu a bɛsisi bɛ gyakɛ aze wɔ me Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu a? 13Bɛmmafa azubɔdeɛ mgbane biala bɛfinde me nyunlu; mekyi bɛ ɛyɛlɛ evuanlɛ ne. Memkpondɛ kɛ menwu Siane Fofolɛ Ɛvoyialilɛ ne nee bɛ Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ɛzonlenlɛ ne mɔ. Memkpondɛ kɛ menwu ɛtanema ayia biala. 14Mekyi bɛ Siane Fofolɛ Ɛvoyialilɛ ne nee bɛ ɛvoyia mɔɔ ɛha la kɔsɔɔti. Bɛbu me kɔme, mengola bɛ soa bieko.
15“Saa bɛtɛlɛ bɛ sa nu kɛ bɛyɛ nzɛlɛlɛ a, mebaye me nye meado ɛbɔ nu. Bɛyɛ nzɛlɛlɛ dɔɔnwo kɛyɛ nyɛ bɔbɔ a, menrɛdie. Bɛ sa anwo le mogya ngome. 16Bɛbia bɛyɛ bɛ nwo bɔkɔbɔkɔ, bɛye ɛtane biala mɔɔ wɔ bɛ ɛbɛla nu la bɛvi me nye zo. Bɛgyakyi ɛtaneyɛlɛ, 17bɛzukoa boɛlilɛ, bɛkpondɛ pɛlepɛlelilɛ bo zo, bɛgyakyi nzisililɛ, bɛlie mɔɔ ɛnlɛ ɔ ze la ati, na bɛkpa ahunlanvolɛ ti kyɛlɛ bɛmaa bɛ.”
18Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Bɛrɛla bɛmaa yɛbɔ yɛ avinli, bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ ɛla zo kɛ ɛbenle bɔbɔ ɛdeɛ, noko bɛbayɛ fufule kɛ ezukɔtweaba. Bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ ɛbolo kɛ ebo bɔbɔ ɛdeɛ, noko bɛbayɛ nwohyee kɛ boane enrinli. 19Saa bɛkponle zo, bɛyɛ tieyɛ a, bɛbali debie kpalɛ biala mɔɔ wɔ azɛlɛ ne azo la bie. 20Na saa bɛkpo na bɛte atua a bɛbawu dadeɛ nloa. Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a meha a.”
Ɛtanevolɛma suakpole ne
21Nea kɛ nɔhavoma suakpole ne ɛnɛ ɛhakyi tuutuuma suakpole a. Anrɛɛ bɛdi pɛlepɛle wɔ zolɛ! Anrɛɛ tenleneyɛlɛ ɛyi ye tɛkɛɛ, na ɛnɛ, ahɔdiawu ɛyi ye tɔ. 22Bɛ dwɛtɛ fufule nwo ɛnlɛ nvasoɛ, bɛ nwanye ɛyɛ nzule nzule. 23Bɛ arelemgbunli le atuadelɛma yɛɛ bɛva nwule agɔnwolɛ. Awie biala kulo ndoloboa yɛɛ bɛpele bɛkpondɛ ahyɛlɛ ninyɛne. Bɛnlie mɔɔ ɛnlɛ ɔ ze la ati, yɛɛ bɛndwenle ahunlanvolɛ mraalɛ ne mɔ anwo.
24Yemɔti Ɛdɛnkɛma, Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Katakyie Ko ne se, “Aa, akee mebawola me ɛya ne meagua me kpɔvolɛma ne anwo zo, na meali menli mɔɔ kyi me la nzenralɛ. 25Mebava me sa meazie ɛ nwo. Mebaye evinli nee debie mgbane biala mɔɔ wɔ wɔ nuhua la. 26Mebava wɔ ndɛnebuavolɛma ne meamaa wɔ kɛ alumua ne la, na meamaa wɔ folɛdulɛma, kɛmɔ alumua ne ɔde la. Na nzinlii bɛbavɛlɛ wɔ suakpole mɔɔ tenleneyɛlɛ nee nɔhalɛlilɛ ɛyi ye tɛkɛɛ a.”
27Bɛbava pɛlepɛlelilɛ bɛalie Gyɛlusalɛm na bɛava tenleneyɛlɛ bɛalie bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛnlu bɛ nwo la. 28Bɛbazɛkye ɛtanema nee atuadelɛma, na bɛahu menli mɔɔ kpo Ɛdɛnkɛma la amuala. 29Ɔbayɛ bɛ nyiane kɛ bɛ nye liele oku mbaka nu a, yɛɛ bɛ nye banwoso wɔ tola ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛhyele la anwo. 30Ɔluakɛ bɛdabɛ mumua ne bɛbayɛ kɛ oku baka mɔɔ ye nya ɛnwoso la anzɛɛ tola azɛlɛ mɔɔ nzule ɛnle nu la. 31Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ nwo yɛ se la, bɛbahwenle bɛ aze, na bɛ nyɛleɛ bayɛ senle mgbomgbɔ ayela bɛ nee bɛ gyima, na awie ɛnrɛhola ye nua.

Title: AYE 2
Content:
Anzonudwolɛ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ
(Mae 4.1-3)
1Emɔzo ara nrenya Ayezaya edwɛkɛ mɔɔ hanle, mɔɔ fane Dwuda nee Gyɛlusalɛm anwo la ɛne:
2Ɔbara kɛ mekɛ ne mɔɔ li awieleɛ la,
boka ne mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne gyi zolɛ la
bayɛ boka mɔɔ wale tɛla boka biala;
bɛbamaa ye zo wɔ awoka kɔsɔɔti avinli,
na maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti banriandi ahɔ zo.
3Menli dɔɔnwo bara ɛkɛ na bɛaha kɛ,
“Bɛrɛla, bɛmaa yɛhɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Boka ne azo,
yɛhɔ Gyekɔbo Nyamenle ne Sua nu,
amaa yeahilehile yɛ ye ndenle ne mɔ,
na yɛalua ye ndenle ne mɔ anu.
Ɔluakɛ mɛla ne vi Zayɔn a bara a,
yɛɛ Nyamenle edwɛkɛ ne vi Gyɛlusalɛm a bara a.”
4 Ɔbabua maanle maanle ne mɔ ndɛne,
yeali menli dɔɔnwo edwɛkɛ;
na bɛbabolo bɛ konle dadeɛ ne mɔ bɛayɛ ɛyazonlɛ mbulalɛ,
na bɛabolo bɛ atwɛ ne mɔ bɛayɛ ɛdedadeɛ.
Maanle ko nee maanle ko ɛnrɛho bieko,
yɛɛ bɛnrɛzukoa konle ɛhonlɛ bieko.
5O Gyekɔbo abo zo amra, bɛrɛla bɛmaa yɛlua
Ɛdɛnkɛma wienyi ne anu.
Bɛbazɛkye mgbolehanlɛ
6O Nyamenle, wɔkpo wɔ menli ne, Gyekɔbo abo zo amra ne! Ɔboalekɛ ngonyiama mɔɔ vi aduduleɛ la ɛva azɛlɛ ne yɛɛ bɛnea menli nyunlu bɛbɔ bɛ munzule, kɛmɔ Filisitiama yɛ ye la. Bɛ sa ɛkpula nyɛvolɛ asa anzi na bɛyɛ mɔɔ nyɛvolɛ ne mɔ yɛ la bie. 7Dwɛtɛ fufule nee ezukoa nvutuke ɛyi bɛ azɛlɛ ne tɔ, awie ɛnze bɛ anwonyia nloa. Bɛ mgbɔnwɔ zonle kpalɛ yɛɛ awie ɛngola ɛndia bɛ konle ehwili ne mɔ. 8Mmonle ɛva azɛlɛ ne, yɛɛ bɛsonle bɛdabɛ bɛ sa anloa gyima mɔɔ bɛyɛ la.
9Ɛhye ati sonla ɛdo ɔ nwo aze, yebɔ ɔ nwo anyiemgba. Mmafa ɛkyɛ bɛ ɛlɛ!
10 Bɛnriandi Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛya ɛzulolɛ ne nee ye belemgbunlililɛ anyunlunyia ne, na bɛhɔvea awolɛ nu nee azɛlɛ bo. 11Bɛ adubɛnwo ne kɔsɔɔti bawie na bɛ mgbolede ne abo agua. Ɛdɛnkɛma angomekye ala yɛɛ bɛbayeyɛ ye mekɛ zɔhane anu a. 12Ɔluakɛ Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma lɛ ye mekɛ mɔɔ ɔbava ɔ nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛmemaa bɛ nwo zo bɛyɛ mgbolede, yɛɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛ tumi la bali yeaha bɛ aze fɛɛnye a. 13Mekɛ zɔhane, ɔbazɛkye Lɛbanɔn sida mbaka mɔɔ ɛnyi ɛhɔ anwuma, Beehyan oku mbaka; 14awoka mgbole mɔɔ anwo zo wɔ anwuma nee awoka ngyikyi; 15tawa tendenle biala nee nwolɛ bane biala; 16Tahyehye meli ngɛnlɛma ne mɔ, yɛɛ adwinli kɛnlɛma biala. 17Sonla adubɛnwo muala bara awieleɛ, yɛɛ mgbolede mɔɔ menli yɛ la amuala abo bagua; Ɛdɛnkɛma angomekye ala yɛɛ bɛbayeyɛ ye mekɛ zɔhane anu a. 18Na bɛbazɛkye mmonle kɔsɔɔti.
19Mekɛ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma kɛmaa ɔ nwo zo kɛ ɔ nee azɛlɛ ye azo amra di la, menli banriandi ahɔvea awolɛ mbɔne nu nee azɛlɛ bo ahuma nu, bɛavi ye ɛya kpole anu ɛzulolɛ ne nee ye belemgbunlililɛ anyunlunyia ne anwo. 20Mekɛ ne anu menli bavuandi bɛ dwɛtɛ fufule nee ezukoa nvutuke mmonle ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛyɛ bɛmaa bɛ nwo na bɛsonle bɛ la agua. Bɛbagyakyi bɛ bɛamaa abotokila nee akpanlɛ ne mɔ. 21Mekɛ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma kɛmaa ɔ nwo zo kɛ ɔ nee azɛlɛ ye azo amra di la, menli banriandi ahɔvea awolɛ nee awoka adokule nu bɛavi ye ɛya kpole anu ɛzulolɛ ne nee ye belemgbunlililɛ anyunlunyia ne anwo.
22Bɛhwe bɛ nwo bɛvi sonla mɔɔ ɛnwomenle ala a ɔdie la anwo. Duzu nvasoɛ a wɔ sonla nwo zo a?

Title: AYE 3
Content:
Basabasayɛlɛ wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm
1Bɛnlea, Awulae Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛlɛye debie biala, aleɛ nee nzule, nee awie biala mɔɔ menli ne ati zɔ ye la avi Gyɛlusalɛm nee Dwuda. 2Katakyiema, ɛlɔnema, ndɛnebuavolɛma, Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma, menli mɔɔ tendɛ nwomenle nloa azo, maanle mgbanyinli, 3safohyenlema mɔɔ nea ɛlɔnema abulanlu anwo zo nee ɛlɔne nu mgbanyima mɔɔ ɛha la amuala, menli mɔɔ tu folɛ nee ngonyiama mɔɔ ɛbe kpalɛ, nee menli mɔɔ kola kye sili kpalɛ kpalɛ la, ɔbaye bɛ kɔsɔɔti yeavi ɛkɛ. 4Akee Ɛdɛnkɛma bamaa ngakula mrenya ayɛ arelemgbunli, na ngakula ndetendete azie maanle ne. 5Menli ne basisi bɛ nwo ngoko ngoko; awie biala basisi ɔ gɔnwo anzɛɛ ɔ diema. Mgbavolɛ nee mbɛlɛra bayɛ mgbanyizonle ahile mgbanyinli, yɛɛ kpamgbanvolɛma badu bɛ nwo ahile menli mɔɔ lɛ dibilɛ la.
6Mekɛ ne anu sonla bazɔ ɔ diema mɔɔ ɔ nee ye wɔ abusua ekpulike ko anu la na yeaze ye kɛ, “Wɔmɔ, ɛlɛ ndanlɛ ɛkeda, yemɔti yɛ yɛ abusua kpanyinli na nea yɛ nwo zo wɔ yɛ ngyianlɛ nee yɛ amaneɛnwunlɛ ye anu.”
7Na adiema ne baha kɛ, “Menrɛhola menrɛli bɛ kpanyinli. Menlɛ aleɛ anzɛɛ ɛdanlɛ wɔ me sua nu. Bɛfa me bɛdi kpanyinli a ɔnyɛ boɛ.”
8Dwuda maanle ne ɛzɛkye, Gyɛlusalɛm ɛbɔ, ɔboalekɛ bɛ ɛdendɛlɛ nee bɛ nyɛleɛ muala tia Ɛdɛnkɛma. Bɛngulo kɛ bɛnwu ye anyunlunyia ne. 9Bɛ mɔguazo ne di daselɛ tia bɛ. Bɛka bɛ nyɛleɛ ɛtane ne mɔ baguasee kɛ Sodɔm la. Bɛnvea nwolɛ. Munzule ɛha bɛ! Ɔluakɛ bɛhwe munzule bɛmaa bɛ nwo.
10Maa tenlenema ɛde kɛ ɔbayɛ boɛ yeamaa bɛ, ɔluakɛ bɛbadidi bɛ gyima mɔɔ bɛyɛ la anwo. 11Munzule ɛha amumuyɛnli ne! Ɔnrɛwie boɛ ɛlɛ, ɔluakɛ mɔɔ yeyɛ la, bɛbayɛ ye bie bɛazie ɔ bo zo.
12Ngakula yɛɛ akee sisi me menli ne a, yɛɛ mraalɛ a sie bɛ a.
O me menli, bɛ mgbanyima ne mɔ ɛda bɛ nye zo, ɛminli bɛ ndenle mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛdua nu la.
Ɛdɛnkɛma bua ye menli ne ndɛne
13Ɛdɛnkɛma akee ɛrava ye gyinlabelɛ ne na yeboɔboa ɔ nwo kɛ ɔbua ye menli ne ndɛne. 14Ɛdɛnkɛma de ye ndɛnebualɛ ebia nu kɛ ɔbua ye menli ne mgbanyima ne nee bɛ arelemgbunli ne mɔ ndɛne. Ɔse, “Bɛdabɛ yɛɛ bɛzɛkye vanye egyinli ne anu ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti a. Ehyianvolɛma ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti wɔ bɛ azua nu. 15Duzu ati a bɛsisi me menli ne zɛhae, na bɛfa ehyianvolɛma anyunlu bɛkyikyi aze ɛ? Medame Tumivolɛ Awulae Nyamenle a mebiza bɛ a.”
Gyɛlusalɛm mraalɛ kɔkɔbɔlɛ
16Ɛdɛnkɛma zele kɛ, “Kɛmɔ Gyɛlusalɛm mraalɛ memaa bɛ nwo zo, bɛtia a bɛtoto bɛ kɔme, bɛtwe bɛ nye anzi bɛkile mrenya, bɛbɔ bɛ gyakɛ aze bɛtia ahulomrenya nu la, 17medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, mebamaa bɛ ti anwo atulu abonle na meakpa bɛ nwo.”
18Mekɛ ne anu Awulae bamaa bɛayeye debie biala mɔɔ le kɛnlɛma mɔɔ bɛfa bɛsiezie bɛ nwo la, bɛ gyakɛ ngɛba, bɛ duku ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛfa bɛkye bɛ ti abo nee bɛ mgbɔba ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛfa bɛbobɔ bɛ kɛnra azo; 19bɛ ndweabane ti mgbɔba ne mɔ, bɛ sa ngɛba ne mɔ nee bɛ ti duku ne mɔ; 20bɛ ti zo mgbɔba, bɛ funga ne mɔ, bɛ akyeso ne mɔ, bɛ ehuabɛtɛba, bɛ kiti ne mɔ; 21bɛ sa mgbɔdelera, bɛ bonyi nu ngɛba ne mɔ; 22bɛ ɛvoyialilɛ adɛladeɛ ngɛnlɛma ne mɔ, bɛ bubu ne mɔ, bɛ adɛladeɛ aguzo ne mɔ, yɛɛ bɛ sa nu ahodoku ne mɔ; 23bɛ leesi adɛladeɛ ne mɔ, bɛ lenen adɛladeɛ ne mɔ, bɛ abɔtile ne mɔ, yɛɛ bɛ ti zo ɛhedalɛ ndanlɛ ne mɔ, bɛbayeye bɛ muala bɛagua.
24Bɛ nwo ɛnrɛbɔ evuanlɛ, bɛ nwo babɔ ɛnyane; bɛnrɛhye falɛ, bɛbahye nyɛma; bɛ ti enrinli ngɛnlɛma ne, bɛnrɛyɛ bɛ bieko, bɛ ti zo bakpa; bɛnrɛwula adɛladeɛ ngɛnlɛma, bɛbava ɛrele bɛakyekye bɛ nwo, na bɛ anwofɛlɛko ne bahakyi anyiemgba.
25Mrenya ne mɔ badɔ dadeɛ nloa yɛɛ bɛ katakyiema bawu konle nu. 26Bɛ suakpole ne nlenkɛ mgbole ne mɔ bazu aye awolɛ; suakpole mumua ne bayɛ kɛ raalɛ mɔɔ bɛkpa ɔ nwo na ɔkpofo azɛlɛ nwo la.

Title: AYE 4
Content:
1Mekɛ zɔhane dwu a, mraalɛ nsuu bahɔzɔ nrenya ko na bɛaze ye kɛ, “Yɛdayɛ yɛbali yɛ nloa anu ndɔnie, yɛadɔ yɛ ndanlɛ yɛaheda; wɔmɔ fa wɔ duma to yɛ nwo zo ala na ye anyiemgba ne fi yɛ nwo zo.”
Gyɛlusalɛm bakpazi bieko
2Mekɛ ne anu Ɛdɛnkɛma mbaka ne mɔ ngane bayɛ mgbole ngɛnlɛma. Yizilayɛma mɔɔ baha la anye balie mbaka ne nee bɛ nzoleɛ ne mɔ anwo. 3Na awie biala mɔɔ ɛha Zayɔn na ɔde Gyɛlusalɛm na bɛhɛlɛ ye duma wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm ngoane buluku ne anu la, bɛbavɛlɛ ye sonla mɔɔ anwo te. 4Mekɛ ne anu Awulae bava ye ɛyelalɛ sunsum ne nee ye ndɛnebualɛ tumi ne abia Gyɛlusalɛmma anwo evinli ne amuala, na yeanrinzi mogya mɔɔ bɛha bɛgua Gyɛlusalɛm la amuala. 5 Akee Ɛdɛnkɛma bamaa Zayɔn Boka ɛleka biala ayɛ amungu kumɔɔnwo aheda ye menli mɔɔ ɛyia la anwo zo wɔ alehyenlɛ nu, na yeayɛ esike nee sendɔlɔra wɔ nɔɔzo. Ɔluakɛ ye anyunlunyia ne bayɛ kɛ ɛdanlɛ abo kpɔda aheda bɛ muala bɛ nwo zo. 6Ɔbayɛ alubo yeamaa bɛ alehyenlɛ nu na bɛande wuluwulu ne, yɛɛ ɔbayɛ ɛvealeka nee ebuo wɔ ezule nee ahumu mekɛ nu.

Title: AYE 5
Content:
Vanye egyinli ne anwo edwɛne
1 Bɛmaa mendo edwɛne memaa me kulovolɛ,
ye vanye egyinli ne anwo ɛhulolɛ edwɛne.
Ɛnee me kulovolɛ ne lɛ ye vanye egyinli
wɔ boka bie mɔɔ kye aleɛ la azo.
2Ɔvundunle azɛlɛ ne ɔyeyele zolɛ awolɛ ne mɔ,
na ɔluale ye vanye ma kpalɛ;
ɔzile tawa wɔ egyinli ne avinli,
na ɔvunle kuma mɔɔ ɔbahwihwi vanye ma ne nu la.
Akee ɔhendɛle kɛ ye vanye egyinli ne kɛzo ma kpalɛ,
na vanye ma ne bolole la ɛnee biala yɛ ɛnwonle.
3Yemɔti me kulovolɛ ne se, “O bɛmɛ Gyɛlusalɛmma nee bɛmɛ Dwudama, mebodo bɛ, bɛbua me nee me vanye egyinli ye edwɛkɛ ne bɛmaa me. 4Duzu debie a anrɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ meyɛ wɔ me vanye egyinli ne anu mɔɔ meanyɛ a? Ɛnee me nye la kɛ ɔkɛzo vanye ma kpalɛ, na duzu ati a ɔzole ma ɛnwonle a?
5“Akee meka meahile bɛ, mɔɔ meyɛ me vanye egyinli ne la ɛne. Mebubu ɛhane ne mɔɔ mehye ye nwolɛ la meamaa nane ali vanye ne. Bane biala mɔɔ melie ye nwolɛ la, mebubu ye meamaa bɛaratietia ma ne mɔ azo. 6Meto ye ɛkɛ ne mgbane, bɛnrɛbɔ nuhua ndile, yɛɛ bɛnrɛpepɛ vanye mbaka ne mɔ azo. Ndile nee mbowule bafifi ava ye. Eza menrɛmaa ezule ɛnrɛdɔ ɛnrɛgua zolɛ.”
7Ɔluakɛ Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma vanye egyinli ne,
yemɔ a le Yizilayɛ abo zo amra ne;
menli mɔɔ wɔ Dwuda la amuala,
bɛmɛ a bɛle ye ma ngɛnlɛma ne mɔɔ ɔluale la.
Ɛdɛnkɛma nleanle kɛ ɔkɛnwu pɛlepɛlelilɛ bɛ nu,
na ɔnwunle mogyahanlɛ;
ɔnleanle kɛ ɔkɛnwu tenleneyɛlɛ,
na nea, ɔnwunle ɛsisilɛ nee ɛzunlɛ.
Ɛtane mɔɔ menli yɛ la
8Munzule ɛha bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛfa azua bɛbɔ azua zo, bɛfa ɛya avule bɛbɔ avule zo, bɛmaa yera kɛ akee ɛleka ɛnle ɛkɛ mɔɔ sonla tɛnla a ɔyɛ boɛ a, na bɛgyakyi wɔ kɛ ɛ ngomekye ɛdɛnla azɛlɛ tɛtɛlɛ ne azo. 9Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛha ndane ɛmaa mede kɛ, “Nɔhalɛ, azua dɔɔnwo bayɛ azuadu; azua mgbole ngɛnlɛma ne mɔ, awie ɛnrɛdɛnla nuhua. 10Ɔluakɛ vanye egyinli ala mɔɔ ye kpole kɛyɛ polu bulu nee nwiɔ nee foa ko la bazo ma mɔɔ ɛtwihwi nuhua nwanye a ɔkɛyɛ litili mɔtwɛ ala; yɛɛ saa bɛdua abɛlɛ ma litili ɛya ko abulatwɛ a bɛbanyia abɛlɛ ma litili bulu nee mɔtwɛ ala.”
11Munzule ɛha bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdwazo aleɛbahye bɛno nza ɛsesebɛ, nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ nɔsolɛ nu bɛsi epe bɛno nwanye toonwo bɛtinda la. 12Getaa mgbole nee ngyikyi, fulutu nee akɛya yɛɛ bɛbɔ na bɛno nwanye wɔ bɛ ɛvoyialilɛ bo a; bɛmbu Ɛdɛnkɛma gyima mɔɔ yeli la bie, yɛɛ bɛnnwu ɔ sa anloa gyima mɔɔ yeyɛ la. 13Yemɔti kɛmɔ me menli ne ɛnlɛ adwenle la, bɛkye bɛ bɛkɔ nlɔnu; ɛhɔne ku bɛ menli titile ne mɔ toonwo bɛtɔ, yɛɛ nzuhɔne maa bɛdabɛ ɛwolaa ne mɔɔ bɛha la kete. 14Zɔhane ati ɛbolɔ ɛbuke ɔ nloa wanaanwo ɛlɛme Gyɛlusalɛm menli titile nee menli ne nee bɛ ɛdeɛdeanlɛ ne amuala.
15Sonla ti ɛzi aze, menli nyunlu ɛgua aze, yɛɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛmemaa bɛ nwo zo la anye ɛnwoso. 16Na Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma pɛlepɛlelilɛ ɛhɔ anwuma, Nwuanzanwuanza Nyamenle ne kile maa bɛnwu kɛ ɔle nwuanzanwuanza wɔ tenleneyɛlɛ nu. 17Akee mboane mralɛ ne mɔ baluolua azua bubulera ne mɔ anu adidi.
18Munzule ɛha bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛfa adalɛ bɛtwehwe dwɛwɔlɛ bɛmaa bɛ nwo, na bɛtwe ɛtane kɛ asɛɛ bɛtwe ehwili nyɛma la. 19Dahuu bɛ edwɛkɛ a le kɛ, “Bɛmaa ɔha ɔ nwo ɔyɛ ye waa, ɔyɛ ye gyima ne ndɛndɛ ɔmaa yɛnlea. Bɛmaa Yizilayɛ Nwuanzanwuanza Ko ne ɛrɛla, ɛrayɛ mɔɔ yehyehyɛ la ɔmaa yɛnlea!”
20Munzule ɛha menli mɔɔ nwu ɛtane a bɛse ɔle kpalɛ na bɛnwu kpalɛ a bɛse ɔle ɛtane la. Bɛfa wienyi bɛyɛ awozinli na bɛava awozinli bɛayɛ wienyi, ɛnwonle yɛ bɛ menlemenle, yɛɛ menlemenle yɛ bɛ ɛnwonle.
21Munzule ɛha bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdwenle kɛ bɛze nrɛlɛbɛ na bɛnea a bɛze ndɛne la.
22Munzule ɛha bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛlie duma kɛ bɛkola nza no na bɛkola bɛfa nza ngakyile bɛfonla nu bɛno la. 23Bɛdie ndoloboa na bɛgyakyi menli mɔɔ di fɔlɛ la, na bɛmaa menli mɔɔ ɛnze nwolɛ bie la anwo kyele bɛ. 24Yemɔti kɛ senle si yela ewula na ndile welera si sɔ senle nu la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ bɛ ndinli bakpɔlɔ na bɛ ndotolo akpolo azande kɛ munlutu a, ɔluakɛ bɛkpo Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma mɛla ne na bɛhyi Yizilayɛ Nwuanzanwuanza Ko ne anloa edwɛkɛ. 25Zɔhane ati Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛya ne dwazole ye menli ne anwo zo, ɔdenrɛle ɔ sa ɔzɛkyele bɛ, na awoka ne mɔ kpusule. Bɛ avunli yɛle kɛ ewula wɔ gua ne mɔ azo. Ɛhye mɔ amuala anzi, Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛya ne ɛtɛdwole, na ɔ sa ne mɔɔ yedenrɛ nu la tɛbɔ ɛkɛ.
26Ɛdɛnkɛma bamaa maanle bie mɔɔ wɔ moa moa la sɛkɛlɛneɛ, na yeabɔ nvonloma yeavɛlɛ ye, na nea, ɔbara ndɛndɛ ne ala. 27Ɛlɔnema ne mɔ biala ɛnrɛvɛ, biala ɛnrɛdu koti, biala ɛnrɛbɔ ngɔsɔkɛ na yealafe, bɛ akyeso ɛnrɛzianyi yɛɛ bɛ mgbɔlaboa nyɛma ɛnrɛde. 28Bɛ ɛda mbaka ne mɔ yɛ nla, bɛkpo bɛ ɛda ne mɔ, bɛ mgbɔnwɔ ne mɔ agyakɛ babonle ne mɔ le kɛ ɛtwɛlɛboɔ, yɛɛ bɛ konle ehwili ne mɔ anwo ndɛne le kɛ ahumuakyima. 29Bɛ ne alɛra le kɛ awenade mɔɔ ɛlɛtea la, na bɛtea kɛ awenade ngakula la. Bɛkulu bɛ bo na bɛtɔ mɔɔ bɛkye ye la anwo zo, bɛkye ye na bɛtwe ye bɛkɔ, yɛɛ awie ɛngola ɛnlie ye.
30Mekɛ ne anu, bɛbahulu kɛ nyevile. Na saa awie to ɔ nye nea maanle ne a, ɔbanwu kɛ awozinli nee nyane ɛva ye, na amungu ɛheda zo.

Title: AYE 6
Content:
Nyamenle fɛlɛ Ayezaya kɛ ɔyɛ ye kpɔmanvolɛ
1 Ɛvolɛ ne mɔɔ Belemgbunli Ɛzaya wule la ala anu, menwunle kɛ Awulae de belemgbunli ebia nu, hyeleenyi wɔ anwuma, na ye tɛladeɛ ne anloa ɛyi Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne. 2Tease abɔdeɛma mɔɔ lɛ ndɛbalɛ la ɛbɔ ɛyia ɔ ti zo anwuma. Ko biala lɛ ndɛbalɛ nsia: ɔfa nwiɔ ɔkeda ɔ nyunlu, ɔfa nwiɔ ɔkeda ɔ gyakɛ anwo, yɛɛ ɔfa nwiɔ ɔtu. 3 Na ko vɛlɛle ko na ɔhanle kɛ:
“Nwuanzanwuanza, nwuanzanwuanza!
Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma le nwuanzanwuanza!
Ye anyunlunyia ɛyi ewiade amuala tɛkɛɛ!”
4 Na mɔɔ hanle edwɛkɛ ne la ane ne manle Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne adiabo ne kpusule, na esike rayile sua ne.
5Na menganle kɛ, “Medame, mebɔ munzule! Meminli, ɔluakɛ mele sonla mɔɔ meka ɛtane, yɛɛ mede menli mɔɔ ka ɛtane la avinli. Noko akee menwu Belemgbunli ne, Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma!”
6Akee tease abɔdeɛ ne mɔ anu ko dule rale me nwo ɛkɛ, ɔlɛ samɛnlankɛ mɔɔ ɛdɔlɔ woonwu wɔ fefadeɛ ti la ɔ sa anu. Ɔvale samɛnlankɛ ne wɔ azukponle ne senle ne anu. 7Ɔvale ɔhanle me nloa na ɔzele me kɛ, “Nea, meva ɛhye meha ɛ nloa; bɛye wɔ fɔlɛlilɛ biala bɛhɔ, yɛɛ bɛva wɔ ɛtane bɛhyɛ wɔ.”
8Na mendele kɛ Awulae ɛlɛbiza kɛ, “Nwane a menzoa ye a, nwane a kɛhɔ kɛmaa yɛ a?”
Na membuale kɛ, “Mewɔ ɛke! Soa me.”
9 Na ɔzele me kɛ, “Kɔ, na kɔze menli ɛhye mɔ kɛ, ‘Bɛbadie, bɛadie, na bɛnrɛde ɔ bo; bɛbanlea, bɛanlea, na bɛnrɛnwu ɛhwee! 10Maa menli ɛhye mɔ ɛsolo, bɛ nzo ɛdi, na bɛ nye ɛzi, anrɛɛ bɛkɛva bɛ nye bɛkɛnwu debie, bɛkɛva bɛ nzo bɛkɛde edwɛkɛ na bɛkɛde edwɛkɛ bo, na bɛahakyi bɛ nyɛleɛ na bɛayɛ bɛ ayile.’ ”
11Na membizale kɛ, “O Awulae, kenlenzu?”
Ɔbuale kɛ, “Kɔkpula kɛ azuamgbole ne mɔ kɛbɔ, mɔɔ awie ɛnde zolɛ na azua mɔɔ bɛda nu la kɛyɛ azuadu mɔɔ awie ɛnde biala anu, na azɛlɛ ne kɛdɔ mgbane la. 12Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, mebamaa bɛahye menli ne bɛ nee bɛ ahɔ moa moa na meamaa azɛlɛ ne azo ɛleka dɔɔnwo ayɛ nyanyoo. 13Saa menli bulu na nuhua ko ka bɔbɔ a, bɛbayela ye kɛ oku baka mɔɔ bɛpɛ ye bɛdo na bɛyela ye dosinli ne la.”
(Ma ne mɔɔ anwo te la a le dosinli ne.)

Title: AYE 7
Content:
Belemgbunli Ehaze nrɛlaleɛ ne
1 Dwuda Belemgbunli Ehaze mekɛ zo, Selea Belemgbunli Rilizen nee Yizilayɛ Belemgbunli Pikaa vale bɛ ɛlɔnema rale Gyɛlusalɛmma anwo zo, noko bɛangola bɛ. Belemgbunli Ehaze ɔ ze a le Dwuda Belemgbunli Dwotam yɛɛ ɔ nlenya a le Belemgbunli Ɛzaya; yɛɛ Pikaa noko ɔ ze a le Relɛmalaya.
2Mɔɔ bɛhanle bɛhilele Devidi sua nu amra kɛ ɛlɔnema vi Selea ɛraboka Yifelaem anwo la, Ehaze nee ye menli ne kɔsɔɔti ahonle dule na bɛ nwo wozole bɛ kɛ ɛbɔ nu mbaka mɔɔ anwoma ɛlɛbɔ nu la.
3Na Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Ayezaya kɛ, “Kɔ na kɔyia Ehaze, ɛ nee ɛ ra nrenya Hyiyaa Gyahyɛbe bɛhɔ na ɛbahɔdo ye wɔ ɛleka mɔɔ bɛdukue sɔlɔ azule ne la adenle ne anu, ɛleka mɔɔ bɛnwo ndanlɛ ne la. 4Ka kile ye kɛ: Gyinla ɛ nwo, yɛ koonwu, mmasulo yɛɛ mmamaa wɔ ahonle tu. Ɔluakɛ Rilizen nee ye Selea ɛlɔnema ne yɛɛ Belemgbunli Pikaa ɛya mɔɔ ɛva la le kɛ senle nu ɛyɛne mɔɔ ɛlɛnu na ɔlɛkpu esike la. 5Selea nee Yizilayɛ nee Relɛmalaya ara nrenya ne ɛhɔ ɛ ti akpamo 6kɛ bɛba Dwudama anwo zo, bɛadu bɛ ahonle, bɛaho bɛava maanle ne, na bɛava Teebili ara nrenya ne bɛazie Dwuda belemgbunli.
7“ Na medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, mese ɛha ɛhile bɛ kɛ: Ɔnrɛyɛ boɛ, yɛɛ ɛhye ɛnrɛzi ɛlɛ! 8Ɔluakɛ Selea ati zɔ Dɛmasekɛse, yɛɛ Dɛmasekɛse ati zɔ Rilizen. Na Yizilayɛ ɛdeɛ, toonwo mɔɔ ɔkadwu ɛvolɛ abulasia nee nnu la ɛnee yetete bɔkɔɔ mɔɔ bɛnrɛvɛlɛ ye maanle bieko a. 9Yizilayɛ ati zɔ Samɛlea yɛɛ Samɛlea ati zɔ Belemgbunli Pikaa.
“Maa Belemgbunli Ehaze ɛde ɔ bo kɛ saa ye diedi gyi kpundii ɛdeɛ a ɛnee ɔdaye ɔgyi kpundii.”
Yimanoɛle sɛkɛlɛneɛ ne
10Eza Ɛdɛnkɛma dendɛle hilele Ehaze. Ɔse, “Biza Ɛdɛnkɛma wɔ Nyamenle ne maa ɔmaa wɔ sɛkɛlɛneɛ. 11Maa ɔyɛ kuma kɛ Ɛbolɔ anzɛɛ ɔyɛ tendenle ɔdwu anwuma.”
12Na Ehaze hanle kɛ, “Menrɛbiza, yɛɛ menrɛzɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma menrɛnlea.”
13Ayezaya buale ye kɛ, “Ɛnee bɛmɛ Devidi abo zo amra, bɛdie! Bɛdwenle kɛ ɔle nzɛmedɛ kɛ bɛkɛgyegye menli, mɔɔ yemɔti bɛlɛgyegye me Nyamenle ɔdaye noko a? 14 Yemɔti Awulae ɔdaye ɔbamaa wɔ sɛkɛlɛneɛ. Bɛnlea, kakula bɛlɛra banrenzɛ yeawo ralɛ nrenya, na yeado ye Yimanoɛle. 15Saa kakula zɔhane nyi mɔɔ ɔkola ɔkpo ɛtane, ɔfa kpalɛ la a, ɔbanlo ɛnlankɛ nyɛfonzule nee wolɛ. 16Ɔluakɛ menli banriandi avi azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ arelemgbunli nwiɔ ne mɔɔ ɛsulo bɛ la sie la azo kolaa na kakula ne anyi ayɛ mɔɔ ɔkola ɔkpo ɛtane ɔfa kpalɛ la.
17“Ɛdɛnkɛma bamaa mekɛ bie mɔɔ bie ɛtɛtole bɛ ɛlɛ, ɔvi mekɛ mɔɔ Yizilayɛma dele bɛ nwo vile Dwuda anwo la arado wɔ nee wɔ menli ne nee ɛ bo zo amra. Ɔkava Aselea belemgbunli ne yeara ɛ nwo zo.
18“Mekɛ ne anu Ɛdɛnkɛma babɔ nvonloma avɛlɛ nrɛzenra ne mɔ mɔɔ wɔ Yigyibiti azule ne mɔ abɔleɛ ne mɔ, yɛɛ wolɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ wɔ Aselea azɛlɛ zo la. 19Na bɛ muala bɛbara bɛaradɛnlɛdɛnla awoka ne mɔ avinli ahuma mgbole ne mɔ anu, awolɛ adokule ne mɔ anu, mbowule avinli nee adidileka ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti anu.
20“Saa mekɛ ne dwu a, Ɛdɛnkɛma bava dadeɛ dɛma mɔɔ yebɔ ye ɛkpa yevi Azule Yufileti ne anzi lɔ, wɔ Aselea belemgbunli ne ɛkɛ ne la akpa bɛ ti, bɛ gyakɛ anwo enrinli nee bɛ kɛsa amuala.
21“Mekɛ ne anu, sonla mɔɔ sie ɛnlankɛ edonraa ko nee mboane nwiɔ la 22banlo ɛnlankɛ nyɛfonzule, ɔboalekɛ ɔbanyia ye dɔɔnwo, yɛɛ awie biala mɔɔ baha azɛlɛ ne azo la banlo ɛnlankɛ nyɛfonzule nee wolɛ.
23“Mekɛ zɔhane, ɛleka biala mɔɔ vanye mbaka apenle mɔɔ bɛtɔ ye dwɛtɛ fufule apenle la bafifi mbowule nee kolokolonyɛma ngome. 24Menli bava ɛda nee ɛda mbaka ara ɛkɛ ne arali ɛbɔlɛ, ɔluakɛ azɛlɛ ne azo kɔsɔɔti bayɛ mbowule nee kolokolonyɛma. 25Kolokolonyɛma nee mbowule ne mɔ ati, awoka ne mɔ azo mɔɔ anrɛɛ bɛfa koanlɛ a bɛdɔ la, bɛnrɛhɔ zolɛ bieko, bɛbayɛ ɛleka mɔɔ bɛgyakyi nlankɛ nee mboane bɛmaa bɛkɔdidi a.”

Title: AYE 8
Content:
Ayezaya ara nrenya ne yɛ kɛ sɛkɛlɛneɛ amaa menli ne
1Akee Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me kɛ, “Fa bolɛ ɛdɛbaa kpole mɔɔ bɛkɛlɛ zo la, na kɛlɛ zolɛ mɔɔ awie biala kola kenga la kɛ, ‘Meehɛ Hyɛlale Hahyebaze.’ 2Na menyianle dasevolɛma kpalɛ nwiɔ lile me daselɛ. Bɛmɛ a le Sɛlɛvolɛ Yulaya nee Gyɛbɛlɛkaya ara nrenya Zɛkalaya.”
3Mekɛ guale nu la menwunle me ye (Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ raalɛ) ne, na ɔnrenzɛle na ɔwole ralɛ nrenya. Na Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me kɛ, “To ye Meehɛ Hyalale Hahyebaze, 4ɔluakɛ mɔɔ kakula ne kahola ɔ nloa buke aha ‘Egya’ anzɛɛ ‘Ɔmɔ’ la, ɛnee Aselea belemgbunli ne ɛzoa Dɛmasekɛsema nee Samɛleama anwo ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti ɛhɔ.”
Aselea belemgbunli ne ɛlɛba
5Ɛdɛnkɛma dendɛle hilele me bieko. 6Ɔse, “Kɛmɔ menli ɛhye mɔ ɛkpo nzule ne mɔɔ wɔ Azule Hyaelowa mɔɔ se bɛtɛɛ, na bɛsulo Belemgbunli Rilizen nee Relɛmalaya ara nrenya Belemgbunli Pikaa la, 7yemɔti bɛnlea, medame, melɛmaa nzule ne mɔɔ wɔ Azule kpole anwo ɛzulolɛ ne mɔɔ lɛ nzule dɔɔnwo la, Aselea belemgbunli ne nee ye ɛlɔnema amuala ara bɛ nwo zo. Ɔbayi yeabulu ye pemgbɛne ne mɔ azo, yeabu aze, 8na yearava Dwuda maanle ne, yeabu aze toonwo yeali bɛ kɔme nu. Ɔbadɛlɛ yeava maanle ne amuala.”
O Nyamenle nee yɛ de!
9Bɛmɛ maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti, munzule ɛha bɛ, bɛli nyane; bɛmɛ maanle maanle mɔɔ bɛwɔ moa moa la, bɛdie! Bɛva sulosulo bɛbɛza! Ɛhɛe, bɛva sulosulo bɛbɛza. 10Bɛyia nu bɛva adwenle, noko ɔnrɛyɛ boɛ; bɛbɔ nu bɛbɔ kpɔkɛ, noko ɔnrɛyɛ boɛ, ɔluakɛ Nyamenle nee yɛ de.
Ɛdɛnkɛma bɔ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ ne kɔkɔ
11Ɛdɛnkɛma vale ye tumi kpole ne dendɛle hilele me na ɔbɔle me kɔkɔ kɛ memmafa menli ɛhye mɔ agyakɛ. 12 Ɔse, “Mmafa ɛ nwo ɛdielie bɛ nwule nyɛleɛ ne mɔ anu, mmasulo debie mɔɔ bɛmɛ bɛsulo ye la, yɛɛ mmamaa wɔ ahonle tu. 13Kakye kɛ Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ala a le nwuanzanwuanza a. Yemɔ yɛɛ sulo ye na maa ɔdu wɔ ahonle a. 14 Na yemɔ yɛɛ ɔbayɛ ɛleka nwuanzanwuanza a. Ɔbayɛ bolɛ mɔɔ menli bava ɔ nwo ɛya, ɔbayɛ azekpolɛ bodane yeamaa Yizilayɛma nee Dwudama, yɛɛ ɔbayɛ ɛhane yeamaa Gyɛlusalɛmma. 15Menli dɔɔnwo bafofo zolɛ na bɛadu bɛagua; bɛbado ɛhane na bɛahye bɛ bɛahɔ.”
Nwomenle ɛkɛ debie ɛbizalɛ nwo kɔkɔbɔlɛ
16Bɛmɛ me ɛdoavolɛma, bɛva edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛha ɛhile me la bɛzie boɛ. 17 Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛva ɔ nye ɛvea Yizilayɛma, na mame mekendɛ ye, yɛɛ melɛ anyelazo wɔ ye nu.
18 Bɛnlea, medame yɛɛ me mra mrenya mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛva ɛmaa me la ɛyɛ sɛkɛlɛneɛ nee nwanwane nrɛlaleɛ mɔɔ Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, mɔɔ de ye ebia nu wɔ Boka Zayɔn la ɛva ɛmaa Yizilayɛma a.
19Saa menli ka kile bɛ kɛ, “Bɛhɔbiza bɛ nwo wɔ menli mɔɔ tendɛ nwomenle nloa azo anzɛɛ nyɛnema mɔɔ su peapea na bɛtendɛ bɛ nzo abo la ɛkɛ a,” ɛnee bɛkpondɛ bɛaha kɛ ɔnle kɛ menli biza edwɛkɛ wɔ bɛ Nyamenle ne ɛkɛ ɔ? Asoo ɔle kpalɛ kɛ bɛkɛbiza anyewɔzoamra ati wɔ mɔwuamra ɛkɛ ɔ?
20Bɛdie mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛlɛka la na bɛli ye ngilehilelɛ zo! Nɔhalɛ, edwɛkɛ ɛhye mɔɔ bɛka la aleɛ ɛnrɛhye zo.
Amaneɛnwunlɛ mekɛ
21Menli ne bava ɛhɔne aluolua azɛlɛ ne azo, bɛ rɛle abɔ bɛ nwo. Saa ɛhɔne ɛlɛku bɛ a bɛbava ɛya na bɛawa bɛ belemgbunli ne nee bɛ Nyamenle ne amonle. Bɛbanlea anwomanyunlu, 22bɛanlea aze, na mɔɔ bɛbanwu ye la a le arɛlebɔlɛ, awozinli, yɛɛ abodelɛ; na bɛbavuandi bɛ bɛagua awozinli kabii nu.

Title: AYE 9
Content:
1 Adenle biala ɛnrɛla ɛkɛ mɔɔ bɛdua nu bɛnriandi amaneɛnwunlɛ mekɛ ɛhye a.
Kenlebie belemgbunli ne
Kɛ Zɛbulɛn nee Nafetalae mbusua ekpunli ne mɔ azɛlɛ ne nwunle amaneɛ anyiemgba nu wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛraze ɛhɔ la ɛne. Noko nzinlii ɔbamaa bɛali bɛ eni, ɔvi Mɛdetɛlenia Nyevile ne anloa yeahɔdwu Dwɔdan ne anzi lɔ, toonwo yeahɔdwu Galeli, suakpole ne mɔɔ nyɛvolɛ de zolɛ la.
2 Menli ne mɔɔ luale awozinli nu la
ɛnwu wienyi kpole bie;
bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdɛnlanle awozinli kabii azɛlɛ zo la,
wienyi ɛda bɛ nwo zo.
3Wɔmaa maanlema anwo ɛzo,
wɔmaa bɛ anyelielɛ ɛyɛ kpole;
bɛdi fɛlɛko wɔ ɛ nyunlu
kɛ menli mɔɔ ɛbu bɛyɔba na bɛ nye ɛlie,
kɛ menli mɔɔ ɛnyia afedeɛ na bɛlɛkyɛ la.
4Ɔluakɛ wɔzokoɛ maanle ne adesoa,
wɔbubu ye gyɛnvayile nu;
wɔbubu ye sisiravolɛ ne kpɔma nu,
kɛmɔ ɛvale ɛyɛle Medeanema la.
5Akee ɛlɔnema mɔɔ ɛlɛba la mgbɔlaboa
nee bɛ adɛladeɛ mɔɔ ɛyɛ mogya ngome la,
bayɛ kɛ ɛyɛne wɔ senle nu.
6Ɔluakɛ bɛwo kakula bie bɛmaa yɛ,
bɛmaa yɛ ralɛ nrenya;
yemɔ yɛɛ maanlebulɛ ne badɔ ɔ sa zo a,
bɛbavɛlɛ ye “Nwanwane, Folɛtuvolɛ, Nyamenle Bedevinli,
Damɛnlangoate Selɛ,
Anzonudwolɛ Belemgbunli.”
7 Ye maanlebulɛ ne bahɔ zo melɛ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ;
ye maanlema anzo nu badwo bɛ dahuu.
Ɔbali ye ebia ne kɛ yeli Belemgbunli Devidi agya,
yeava nɔhalɛlilɛ nee pɛlepɛlelilɛ yeabu ye maanle ne,
ɔvi ɛnɛ mɔɔ kɔ nee mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ.
Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛbɔ kpɔkɛ kɛ ɔbayɛ ɛhye.
Ɛdɛnkɛma badea Yizilayɛma
8Awulae ɛdendɛ ɛtia Gyekɔbo abo zo amra, na ɔbaha Yizilayɛma kɔsɔɔti. 9Menli ne amuala, bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ Yifelaem nee Samɛlea la amuala banwu kɛ Awulae a ɛyɛ a. Bɛmɛ, bɛtendɛ mgbole na bɛmemaa bɛ nwo zo bɛka kɛ, 10“Belekese ne mɔ yɛɛ ɛdudu ɛgua a, na yɛbava awolɛ mɔɔ bɛze la yeazi yɛ azua ne mɔ. Bɛdudu sekamɔ baka mgbunla ne mɔ, na yɛbava sida mbaka yɛaziezie bɛ bo zo ne mɔ.”
11Yemɔti Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛmaa kpɔvolɛma ne ɛdwazo kɛ bɛrɛla bɛ nwo zo. 12Seleama mɔɔ vi aduduleɛ bara yɛɛ Filisitiama mɔɔ vi adɔleɛ bara la ɛbuke bɛ nloa anu wanaanwo kɛ bɛbahye Yizilayɛma bɛali. Ɛhye mɔ amuala anzi, Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛya ne ɛnrɛdwo; ɔbadenrɛ ɔ sa yeadea bɛ.
13Yizilayɛma annu bɛ nwo kɛ Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛdea bɛ a, yɛɛ bɛamkpondɛ ɔ bo zo. 14Yemɔti Ɛdɛnkɛma pɛle Yizilayɛma ati nee bɛ dua, mrɛlakɛ nee ndɔ kenle kokye ala. 15Sonla mɔɔ le kpanyinli nee mɔɔ bɛdi ye eni la a le Yizilayɛma ati ne, yɛɛ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ ne mɔɔ kilehile adalɛ ngilehilelɛ la a le dualɛ ne. 16Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛli menli ɛhye mɔ anyunlu bɛkile bɛ adenle la minli bɛ, yɛɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛli mgbanyinli nee Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma ɛhye mɔ anzi la noma bɔkɔɔ. 17Zɔhane ati Awulae anye ɛnlie bɛ mgbavolɛ ne mɔ anwo, yɛɛ ɔnlɛ anwunvɔnezelɛ ɔmmaa bɛ ahunlanvolɛ mraalɛ nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnlɛ bɛ ze mɔ la. Ɔluakɛ awie biala ɛnze Nyamenle na ɔbɔ munzule ɛbɛla, yɛɛ awie biala ka ɛtane. Ɔlua ɛhye mɔ ati Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛya ne ɛnrɛdwo, ɔbahɔ zolɛ yeadenrɛ ɔ sa yeadea bɛ.
18Ɔluakɛ menli ne amumuyɛ ne yela kɛ senle, ɔyela mbowunzaka nee kolokolonyɛma; ɔmaa kpɔkɛmile sɔ, ye esike dwazo bolonwonwo kɔ anwuma. 19Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛya mɔɔ ɛva la ɛzɔ ɛyela azɛlɛ ne, na menli ne ɛyɛ kɛ ɛyɛne mɔɔ wɔ senle nu la; adiema bɔbɔ ɛnze ɔ diema anwunvɔne. 20Bɛto bɛ sa fema bɛfa, noko ɛhɔne ku bɛ, yɛɛ bɛdidi bɛkɔ bɛne zo, noko bɛ ko ɛnyi, awie ko biala di ɔ gɔnwo nwonane. 21Manasɛma teta Yifelaemma yɛɛ Yifelaemma teta Manasɛma na bɛ mu nwiɔ bɛabɔ nu bɛateta Dwudama. Ɛhye mɔ amuala anzi, Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛya ne ɛnrɛdwo; ɔbahɔ zolɛ yeadenrɛ ɔ sa yeadea bɛ.

Title: AYE 10
Content:
1Munzule ɛha bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdi amumuyɛ mɛla bɛfa bɛsisi me menli ne la; nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛtɛnla aze bɛkɛlɛ nzisi mɛla la. 2Bɛyɛ ɛhye bɛfa bɛsisi menli mɔɔ ɛhyia la, yɛɛ bɛnli pɛlepɛle bɛmmaa me menli ne anu ehyianvolɛma. Bɛyɛ ɛhye amaa bɛakpokpo ahunlanvolɛ mraalɛ na bɛaza mɔɔ ɛnlɛ ɔ ze la bɛalie ye ninyɛne. 3Saa Nyamenle ndeanlɛ mekɛ ne dwu na ahumu ne mɔɔ vi moa nehane bara la dwazo a duzu a bɛkɛyɛ a? Nienwu yɛɛ bɛbabɔ bɛ ti a, yɛɛ nienwu a bɛbagyakyi bɛ anwonyia ne mɔ a? 4Bɛyɛ bɛ nwo ɛhwee a ɔnrɛyɛ boɛ, kyesɛ bɛboka menli mɔɔ bɛhye bɛ nuokɛ la anwo anzɛɛ bɛboka bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛhu bɛ la anwo. Ɛhye mɔ anzi, Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛya ne ɛnrɛdwo; ɔbahɔ zolɛ yeadenrɛ ɔ sa yeadea bɛ.
Nyamenle bava Aselea Maanle Maanle Belemgbunli ne ali gyima
5Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Aa, Aselea, ɔle me baka nee me kpɔma mɔɔ mefa ɛya a 6mefa metea maanle mɔɔ ɛnze Nyamenle la, yɛɛ eza mesoa ye wɔ menli mɔɔ menwɔva bɛ nwo ɛya la anwo zo, memaa ɔkɔbo bɛ ɔsa bɛ ɔdie bɛ nwo ninyɛne, na ɔtietia bɛ nwo zo kɛ guabile zo ndɛtɛlɛ la.”
7Noko Aselea Maanle Maanle belemgbunli ne ɛndwenle ye zɔhane, ɔdaye ɔlɛ ye adwenle ɛdeɛ. Ye adwenle a le kɛ ɔsɛkye maanle maanle ne mɔ amuala, 8ɔluakɛ ɔse, “Asoo me safohyenlema mgbanyinli ne mɔ amuala ɛnle arelemgbunli? 9Asoo metɛyɛle suakpole Kaleno kɛ menyɛle Kaakɛmehye la? Asoo metɛyɛle Heemate kɛ menyɛle Aapade la? Asoo metɛkonle metɛfale Samɛlea, kɛmɔ menvale Dɛmasekɛse la? 10Kɛ menyɛle mɔɔ me sa homonle maanle maanle mɔɔ lɛ awozonle mɔɔ bɛ ananze mɔɔ bɛgua la zonle tɛla Gyɛlusalɛm nee Samɛlea ɛdeɛ ne mɔ, 11nee kɛ menzile menyɛle Samɛlea nee ye mmonle ananze ne mɔ la, asoo tɛ zɔhane ala yɛɛ mebava meayɛ Gyɛlusalɛm nee ye mmonle ne mɔ a?”
12Na Awulae zele me kɛ, “Saa mewie me gyima muala yɛ wɔ Zayɔn Boka nee Gyɛlusalɛm a, mebadea Aselea belemgbunli ne nee ye adubɛnwo funli ne mɔɔ ɔlɛfa yeadu ɔ nloa anu nee ɔ nwo zo mɔɔ ɔlɛmemaa la.”
13Aselea belemgbunli ne tu ɔ nloa anu kɛ, “Medame me anwosesebɛ nee me nrɛlɛbɛ yɛɛ meva meyɛ ɛhye a, ɔluakɛ melɛ ndelebɛbo. Medudu maanle maanle ɛweɛne ne mɔ megua, meza bɛ melie bɛ gya nu ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti; meyɛ me nwo ɛnlankɛ nyinli meha bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdede arelemgbunli mbia zo la megua. 14Medo me sa maanle maanle mɔɔ wɔ ewiade la anwonyia nu, na ɔle kɛ me sa la anloma sane nu. Mefulovula bɛ anwonyia ne mɔ kɛ menli sesa anloma sane nu aholonvia mɔɔ anloma ne ɛdu ɛhɔ ɛgyakyi bɛ la. Meva me sa metoto maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti gya nu. Awie ɛmbuke ɔ nloa na yeayɛ ɔ nwo ɛhehanlɛ.”
15Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛlɛbiza kɛ, “Asoo akuma baha kɛ ɔ nwo yɛ se tɛla ahenle mɔɔ ɛlɛfa ye abu baka la? Asoo sɛlada bamemaa ɔ nwo zo ahile ahenle mɔɔ ɛlɛfa ye apɛ baka la? Asoo baka anzɛɛ kpɔma kola sonla zo maa? Sonla a maa baka anzɛɛ kpɔma zo a.”
16Zɔhane ati Awulae, Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma bamaa ewule adɔ ye ɛlɔnema mɔɔ te kpɔkɛ la anwo yeamaa bɛanwa, na ye anyunlunyia ne bamaa bɛ nwo adwe bɛ kɛ bɛgua senle nu. 17Yizilayɛ wienyi ne bayɛ senle; Yizilayɛ Nwuanzanwuanza Ko ne bayɛ senle tafinlima ayela mbowule nee mbowunzaka kenle kokye yeamaa bɛadɔ nzonle. 18Ye azɛlɛ kɛnlɛma ne nee zolɛ mbaka ngɛnlɛma ne mɔ, Ɛdɛnkɛma bazɛkye bɛ, ɔbazɛkye ɛkɛla nee nwonane muala. Na ɔbayɛ kɛ sonla mɔɔ anwonyane ɛbɔ ye na yenwa la. 19Mbaka mɔɔ baha ye kpɔkɛ nu la bayɛ ekyi bie mɔɔ kakula kola bɛ tia a.
Ekyi bazia ara
20Mekɛ ne anu, Yizilayɛma mɔɔ ɛha, nee Gyekɔbo sua nu amra mɔɔ vile ɛsalɛ la ɛnrɛva bɛ rɛle ɛnrɛwula mɔɔ sisile bɛ la anu, na bɛbava bɛ rɛle bɛawula Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nwuanzanwuanza Ko ne anu nɔhalɛ nu. 21Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛhale, mɔɔ le Gyekɔbo abo zo amra la anu bie mɔ bazia ara Nyamenle bedevinli ne ɛkɛ. 22 Ɔluakɛ saa wɔ menli Yizilayɛma anwo zonle kɛ ɛnweazo anwea bɔbɔ a, bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛhale la anu ekyi bie a bazia ara a. Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛbɔ kpɔkɛ kɛ ɔsɛkye bɛ, na bɛbalua pɛlepɛlelilɛ zo a bɛazɛkye bɛ a. 23Ɔluakɛ Awulae Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma bamaa ɔ muala ara awieleɛ, kɛmɔ yehyehyɛ yedo ewiade ye amuala la.
Ɛdɛnkɛma badea Aseleama
24Awulae, Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “O me menli mɔɔ de Zayɔn, saa Aseleama fa bɛ mbaka ba bɛ nwo zo, bɛlɛsisi bɛ, kɛmɔ Yigyibitima yɛle la a, bɛmmasulo. 25Ɔluakɛ ɔnrɛhyɛ biala na me ɛya ne mɔɔ meva ye bɛ nwo la adwo, na meava ɛya meadea Aseleama. 26Na medame Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, mebaheha me nwo meatia Aseleama na meabila bɛ, kɛmɔ bɛdabɛ bɛbilale Medeanema wɔ Olɛbe Bodane ne anwo la. Me baka ne badende adwu nyevile nu na meanloma bɛ, kɛmɔ menyɛle Yigyibitima la. 27Mekɛ ne anu, mebaye ye kpomgbolo ne bɛ kɔme na meabubu ye gyɛnvayile ne mɔɔ la bɛ kɔme zo la.”
Kpɔvolɛ ɛlɔnema teta Yizilayɛma
28Kpɔvolɛ ɛlɔnema vi Relemɔn ɛrava Eyae na bɛtele zolɛ bɛdwu Megelɔn. Ɛlɔnema ne ɛgyakyi bɛ ninyɛne wɔ Mekemahye; 29bɛpɛ ademgbole ne bɛhɔla Giba. Menli mɔɔ wɔ Releema la ahonle ɛdu, yɛɛ Belemgbunli Sɔɔlo sua zo Gebɛyama ɛgua ɛbɔ nu. 30O Galemma, bɛdea! Bɛdeɛdea nu! Bɛdie, O Leeyehyema! Anatoma, bɛbua ye! 31Mademinama ɛgua ndwɛlɛ aze, yɛɛ menli mɔɔ wɔ Gibem la ɛlɛnriandi alie bɛ nwo. 32Ɛnɛ kenle ye, kpɔvolɛ ɛlɔnema ne baragyinla Nɔɔbo, bɛbazua bɛ ahɛlɛ ne wɔ Zayɔn Boka, suakpole Gyɛlusalɛm anwo zo.
33Bɛnlea, Awulae, Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma bava tumi kpole aha bɛ agua kɛ bɛdwɔlɔdwɔlɔ baka ngane la. Mɔɔ ɛnyi tendenle kpalɛ la, ɔbapɛ ye yeado na yeaha mɔɔ memaa ɔ nwo zo la aze. 34Ɔbava akuma yeaha kpɔkɛmile ne yeagua, na bɛazɛkye Lɛbanɔn nee ye mbaka ngɛnlɛma ne mɔ.

Title: AYE 11
Content:
Anzonudwolɛ belemgbunli maanle ne
1 Gyɛsi dosinli ne (Belemgbunli Devidi), bakpuke ɛnyelɛ wɔ ye ndinli ne mɔ anu anyi ayɛ Baka Ɛhane.
2Ɛdɛnkɛma Sunsum ne bara ɔ nwo zo,
ɔbanwu nrɛlɛbɛ, yeanyia ndelebɛbo,
ɔbanyia anwosesebɛ, yeayɛ folɛtuvolɛ,
ɔbanyia adwenle na yeazulo Ɛdɛnkɛma.
3Ɔbava anyelielɛ yeayɛ tieyɛ yeamaa Ɛdɛnkɛma,
ɔnrɛbua ndɛne ɛnyelɛzo,
yɛɛ ɔnrɛhyea ɔ nzo ɔnrɛbua ndɛne.
4 Ɔbabua ehyianvolɛma ndɛne pɛlepɛle nu,
na yeabua awienvolɛma ndɛne pɛpɛ;
ɔbava ɔ nloa yeayɛ baka yeadea azɛlɛ ye azo ɛtanema,
yeava ɔ nloa edwɛkɛ yeahu amumuyɛma.
5 Ɔbava pɛlepɛlelilɛ yeayɛ akyeso yeahye ɔ nze zo,
na yeava nɔhalɛlilɛ yeayɛ tabule mɔɔ hye ye avinli.
6 Bedi nee boane ralɛ badɛnla,
yɛɛ boboduma nee abɔnkye ralɛ bala ɛleka ko.
Ɛnlankɛ ralɛ nee awenade babɔ nu adidi,
na kakula yɛɛ banlea bɛ nwo zo a.
7Ɛnlankɛ nee ezizile babɔ nu adidi,
bɛ mra babɔ nu ala ɛleka ko,
na awenade bali ndile kɛ ɛnlankɛ ralɛ la.
8Kakula mɔɔ la nyɛfonlɛ nloa la nee ɛwɔlɛ bali nwɔhoa,
yɛɛ kakula mɔɔ ɛdudu agyakɛ la bava ɔ sa awula bɔna bɔne nu.
9 Bɛnrɛboda anzɛɛ bɛnrɛhu awie
wɔ me boka nwuanzanwuanza ne azo,
ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma anwo adwenle bayi azɛlɛ ye tɛkɛɛ
kɛ nzule mɔɔ wɔ nyevile nu la.
Menli mɔɔ bɛhye bɛ bɛhɔ nlɔnu la bazia ara
10 Mekɛ ne anu Belemgbunli Devidi abo zo sonla ne bagyinla kɛ sɛkɛlɛneɛ la yeamaa maanle maanle. Maanle maanle bakpondɛ ye, na ɛleka mɔɔ ɔde la bayɛ anyelielɛ. 11Mekɛ ne anu Awulae badenrɛ ɔ sa bieko yealie Yizilayɛma mɔɔ ɛha la yeavi Aselea, Yigyibiti, Patelɔso, Sudan, Yilam, Babelonia, Heemate, yɛɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ ɛnweanloa la asa anu. 12Ɛdɛnkɛma bamaa maanle maanle ne mɔ sɛkɛlɛneɛ yeahile kɛ ɔlɛboɔboa Yizilayɛma mɔɔ bɛmbu bɛ bie, nee Dwudama mɔɔ ɛkponde la anloa yeavi azɛlɛ ye muleɛ nna ne mɔ azo yeara. 13Yifelaem anyebolo ne bavi ɛkɛ, bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛgyegye Dwuda la bɛbazɛkye bɛ; Yifelaem anye ɛnrɛbolo Dwuda, yɛɛ Dwuda ɛnrɛgyegye Yifelaem bieko. 14Bɛbabɔ nu bɛara Filisitiama anwo zo wɔ adɔleɛ, yɛɛ bɛbabɔ nu bɛarave menli mɔɔ wɔ aduduleɛ la ninyɛne. Bɛbaho bɛava Yidɔm nee Mowabe, yɛɛ Amɔnoma bayɛ tieyɛ amaa bɛ. 15 Ɛdɛnkɛma bazɛkye Suwɛze Ebolo ne bɔkɔɔ na yeanwɔha ɔ sa wɔ Azule Yufileti ne azo yeamaa anwoma wuluwulu arasesa ye. Ɔbahyɛ nu nsuu yeamaa menli alua azɛlɛ resee zo apɛ. 16Bɛbakpakye ademgbole bɛavi Aselea bɛahɔva Yizilayɛma mɔɔ ɛha la, kɛmɔ ɔyɛle ɔmanle bɛ nlenya mɔ Yizilayɛma wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɔyele bɛ ɔvile Yigyibiti azɛlɛ zo la.

Title: AYE 12
Content:
Moyɛlɛ edwɛne
1Mekɛ ne anu ɛbaha kɛ,
“O Ɛdɛnkɛma, mebayɛ wɔ mo,
ɔluakɛ ɛvale me nwo ɛya bɔbɔ ɛdeɛ,
noko ɛgyakyile ɛmanle ɔhale,
na ɛkyekyele me rɛle.
2 Bɛnlea, Nyamenle le me ngoanedievolɛ;
menrɛzulo, mebava me rɛle meawula ye nu,
ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle ne
le me anwosesebɛ nee me edwɛne,
na yeyɛ me ngoanedievolɛ.”
3Ɛbava fɛlɛkolilɛ wɔado nzule
wɔavi ngoanelielɛ bula ne mɔ anu.
4Mekɛ ne anu ɛbaha kɛ,
“Bɛyɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma mo,
bɛbɔ ye duma bɛlie moalɛ;
bɛmaa ye nyɛleɛ ne mɔ ɛla ali wɔ maanle maanle avinli,
bɛbɔ ye kpoleyɛlɛ ne nolo bɛhile bɛ.
5Bɛdo ayɛlɛyelɛ edwɛne bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma,
ɔluakɛ yeyɛ ninyɛne mgbole;
bɛmaa awie biala ɛde ɛhye wɔ ewiade amuala anu.
6Bɛdeɛdea nu, bɛva anyelielɛ bɛdo edwɛne, O Zayɔnoma,
ɔluakɛ Yizilayɛ Nwuanzanwuanza Ko ne
mɔɔ de bɛ avinli la le kpole.”

Title: AYE 13
Content:
Nyamenle badea Babelɔn
1Nrɛlaleɛ mɔɔ fane Babelɔn anwo, mɔɔ Nyamenle luale Emɔzo ara Ayezaya anwo zo vale dole gua la ɛne:
2“Fa sɛkɛlɛneɛ sie boka bie mɔɔ ɛhwee ɛnle zo la azo, na tea nu ka kile bɛ; nwɔha ɛ sa kile bɛ kɛ bɛwolo titilema nlenkɛ mgbole ne mɔ anu. 3Medame mumua ne yɛɛ meze me menli mɔɔ medu bɛ memaa me nwo, me katakyiema ne kɛ bɛlua me ɛyavalɛ ne azo bɛli gyima a. Bɛle konimlilɛma mɔɔ mefa bɛ metu me nwo a.”
4Bɛdie, alɛra bie wɔ awoka ne mɔ azo lɔ kɛ menli apenle apenle ɛlɛteɛdea nu! Bɛdie, arelemgbunli nee maanle maanle ɛdu ɛfonyia na bɛlɛboɔboa bɛ nloa! Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛlɛboɔboa ye ɛlɔnema anloa ahɔ konle. 5Bɛvi moa moa maanle bie anu wɔ ewiade abo lɔ a bɛlɛba a. Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛva ye ɛya konle ninyɛne ne mɔ ɛlɛba arazɛkye ewiade ye amuala.
6 Bɛzu bɛye awolɛ, ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma kenle ne ɛbikye; ɔle kenle mɔɔ Tumivolɛ ne bava azɛkye ninyɛne a. 7Ɛsalɛ biala anu bado, awie biala ahonle badu, 8na bɛ rɛle abɔ. Bɛ nwo bafofo bɛ, bɛ mbowule nu babubu bɛ na bɛade nyane kɛ raalɛ mɔɔ ɛvo awolɛ zo la. Bɛbava ɛzulolɛ bɛanleɛnlea bɛ nyunlu ngoko ngoko; bɛ nyunlu baza. 9Bɛnlea, Ɛdɛnkɛma kenle ne ɛlɛba; ɔle ɛya kenle anu ɛzulolɛ kpole kpalɛ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma bava ahakyi azɛlɛ ye ɛsɛlɛ, na yeazɛkye ɛtanema amuala yeavi zolɛ a. 10 Anwomanyunlu nwɔlɔra nee bɛ sɔsɔkɛ ne amuala, biala ɛnrɛda; sɛnzɛne ne balu wɔ ye ɛdudulɛ nu, yɛɛ siane ne ɛnrɛda.
11Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Mebadea ewiade amra amuala wɔ bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ ati, yɛɛ mebadea amumuyɛma wɔ bɛ ninyɛndane ne mɔ ati. Mebamaa mɔɔ tu ɔ nloa anu la agyakyi ye adubɛnwo ne, na meamaa mɔɔ ati yɛ se na ɔnze anwunvɔne la agyakyi ɔ nwo zo ɛmemanlɛ. 12Mebamaa nrenya nwo ahyia adɛla ezukoa nvutuke, yɛɛ sonla dasanli nwo bahyia adɛla Ofɛ ezukoa nvutuke. 13Yemɔti mebamaa anwomanyunlu awozo, na azɛlɛ akpusu adudu avi ɛleka mɔɔ ɔgyi la, wɔ medame Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma me ɛya kenle anu ɛzulolɛ ne anu.
14“Menli kɔsɔɔti bayɛ kɛ ahɛtɛboɛ mɔɔ bɛdoa bɛ bɛlɛkye bɛ, anzɛɛ mboane mɔɔ ɛbɔ asande na awie ɛnle ɛkɛ mɔɔ boɔboa bɛ nloa la. Awie biala banriandi ahɔ ye menli avinli wɔ ɔdaye ye maanle nu. 15Bɛ nuhua biala mɔɔ bɛkɛnwu ye la bɛbawɔ ye atwɛ, yɛɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛhye ye la bawu dadeɛ nloa. 16Bɛbava bɛ mra ne mɔ bɛafifi debie bɛatete bɛ wɔ bɛdabɛ bɛ nye zo, bɛbave bɛ sua nu ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti na bɛamia bɛ ye mɔ bɛ nee bɛ adeda.”
17Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Bɛnlea, melɛmaa Mideama ara Babelɔnoma anwo zo. Bɛmɛ, bɛmbu dwɛtɛ fufule yɛɛ bɛ nye ɛnlie ezukoa nvutuke nwo. 18Bɛbava bɛ ɛda ne mɔ bɛahu mgbavolɛ ne mɔ, bɛnrɛze nlɔma bɔbɔ anwunvɔne na yeayɛ ngakula. 19 Na Nyamenle bazɛkye Babelonia, maanle kɛnlɛma ne mɔɔ tɛla maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti, maanle ne mɔɔ nuhua menli fa ye tu bɛ nwo la, kɛ ɔzɛkyele Sodɔm nee Gomɔla la. 20Awie ɛnrɛdɛnla nuhua ɛlɛ wɔ awolɛndoazo muala anu. Arelabenli biala ɛnrɛzi ye ndanlɛ sua wɔ ɛkɛ ne afoa nu, yɛɛ mboaneneavolɛma ɛnrɛva bɛ mboane ɛnrɛhɔ ɛkɛ ne adidi. 21 Nanemgbole bava ɛkɛ ne ayɛ bɛ alaleɛ, yɛɛ bɛ azua ne mɔ bayɛ nyɛmoa mɔɔ kpo la dabelɛ; soholo bahɔdɛnla ɛkɛ ne bie, yɛɛ ɛkɛ ne a mɛnlamenlakɛ barazi bɛ agole a. 22Ɛrane bakpo ye tawa ne mɔ azo, yɛɛ ɛzonlɛ bava bɛ suakunlu kɛnlɛma ne mɔ. Ye mekɛ ne ɛbikye. Babelɔn mekɛ ɛwie.”

Title: AYE 14
Content:
Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛhyele bɛ bɛhɔle nlɔnu la sia ara sua nu
1Ɛdɛnkɛma banwu Yizilayɛma anwunvɔne na eza yeava bɛ bieko kɛ ye menli. Ɔbamaa bɛadɛnla bɛ azɛlɛ ne azo, nyɛvolɛ baraboka bɛ na bɛava bɛ nwo bɛabeta Yizilayɛma. 2Maanle maanle mɔɔ bɛwɔ nu la anu amra baboa Yizilayɛma bɛamaa bɛazia bɛara. Na Yizilayɛma bava nyɛvolɛ ne mɔ ayɛ bɛ ahanra mraalɛ nee mrenya wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma azɛlɛ ne azo. Bɛbahye menli mɔɔ hyele bɛ hɔle nlɔnu la nuokɛ na bɛazie menli ne mɔɔ sisile bɛ la.
Babelonia belemgbunli ne wɔ mɔwuamra maanle nu
3Saa Ɛdɛnkɛma maa bɛ nyane nee abodelɛ nee gyima ɛsesebɛ mɔɔ bɛmanle bɛyɛle la ka aze a, 4bɛbado edwɛne bɛagolo Babelonia belemgbunli ne anwo bɛaha kɛ,
“Sisiravolɛ ne asa ɛhondo aze, nzisi ɛwie! 5Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛbubu amumuyɛma kpɔma ne anu, yezɛkye arelemgbunli amumuyɛma tumi ne, 6mɔɔ bɛfa ɛya a bɛfa bɛyɛ menli amumuyɛ, na bɛwulowula bɛ ahutuku la. Bɛfa ɛya a bɛsie maanle maanle ne mɔ a na bɛyɛ menli ne kpɔdekpɔde. 7Azɛlɛ ye azo amuala ɛyɛ diinyi, anzonudwolɛ ɛra, na bɛkpakye bɛ ne nu bɛto edwɛne. 8Sepelɛse nee Lɛbanɔn sida mbaka si ɛ ti zo agole bɛka kɛ, ‘Sumunli kɛ bɛbɛlɛle wɔ aze la, awie ɛtɛbale kɛ ɔbabu yɛ yeagua.’
9“Ɛbolɔ ɛboɔboa ɔ nwo kɛ saa ɛba a ɔbarayia wɔ adenle. Azɛlɛ ye azo mgbanyima nwomenle badwazo arayɛ wɔ akoaba, yɛɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ anrɛɛ bɛle arelemgbunli wɔ maanle maanle ne mɔ anu la badwazo bɛ arelemgbunli mbia zo ayia wɔ. 10Bɛ muala bɛbadendɛ na bɛaze wɔ kɛ, ‘Ɛdawɔ noko wɔyɛ bɛtɛɛ kɛ yɛdayɛ la. Ɛ nee yɛ ɛyɛ pɛ! 11Getaa ɛbɔlɛ mgbole mɔɔ bɛvale bɛlile ɛ nzi, nee enililɛ kpole ne ɛrawie Ɛbolɔ; azonlɛ ɛyɛ wɔ ɛkpa ɛla zo, yɛɛ azone a le wɔ kundu mɔɔ gua ɛ nwo a.’
12 “O Alehyenlɛ Ɛwɔlɔra, Aleɛbahye Ralɛ Nrenya, ɛvi anwuma wɔdɔ aze kpole o! Wɔmɔ mɔɔ anrɛɛ ɛka maanle maanle aze fɛɛnye la, nea aze ko mɔɔ bɛvuandi wɔ bɛdo a! 13 Ɛvale ɛlile afua kɛ, ‘Mefo meahɔ anwuma lɔ, meadɛla Nyamenle nwɔlɔra ne mɔ. Mebava me belemgbunli ebia ne meazie anwuma lɔ; mebahɔdɛnla sɔlɔ moa moa nehane ayiama boka ne azo; 14mebavo meahɔ anwuma meadɛla amungu ne mɔ na meayɛ me nwo kɛ Anwuma Anwumanli ne.’ 15Na wɔmɔ a bɛ nee wɔ ɛra ɛbolɔ sua zo ɛke wɔ ewule kuma ye abo la.
16“Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛbanwu wɔ la banlea wɔ kpoonwu na bɛadwenledwenle ɛ nwo bɛabiza kɛ, ‘Asoo nrenya ne mɔɔ manle ewiade kpusule na ɔbutubutule arelemgbunlililɛ nye aze la ɛne? 17Asoo nrenya ne mɔɔ bɔle azuamgbole, na ɔmanle ewiade yɛle kɛ ɛsɛlɛ la ɛne? Asoo nrenya ne mɔɔ angyakyi menli mɔɔ ɔhyele bɛ nuokɛ ɛlɛ la ɛne?’ 18Maanle maanle ne mɔ arelemgbunli deda ye anyunlunyia nu; biala nee ye nla, 19na wɔmɔ, bɛvuandi wɔ bɛdo moa moa bɛvi wɔ belemgbunli bane nu kɛ ralɛ mɔɔ ye mekɛ andwu na bɛkɛwo ye la. Mɔɔ bɛvale bɛguale ɛ nwo la a le ɛlɔnema mɔɔ dɔle dadeɛ nloa la avunli mɔɔ bɛvuandi bɛ bɛgua ewule kuma bo awolɛ nu kɛ asɛɛ ɛle funli mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛtietia ɛ nwo zo a. 20Bɛnrɛzie wɔ bɛnrɛboka arelemgbunli nwo, ɔboalekɛ wɔzɛkye wɔ azɛlɛ ne na wɔhu ɛdawɔ wɔ menli mɔɔ wɔ zolɛ la. Awie ɛnrɛbɔ munzule menli ne abo zo amra aluma bieko ɛlɛ. 21Bɛhu ɔ mra mrenya ne mɔ: Bɛ ze mɔ ɛtane ne mɔ ati ɔwɔ kɛ bɛwu, anrɛɛ bɛkɛdwazo bɛkɛva ewiade ne na bɛkɛkyekye azuamgbole.”
Nyamenle bazɛkye Babelɔn
22Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Mebadwazo Babelɔn anwo zo na meazɛkye ye; menrɛvavi awie biala, ngakula nee debie biala, medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a. 23Mebamaa fuke ava azɛlɛ ne; mebamaa nzule apepɛ bula bula agyinlegyinla zolɛ, na meava ɛzɛkyelɛ sane ne meapia ye meahɔgua. Medame Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.”
Nyamenle bazɛkye Aseleama
24 Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛha ndane kɛ, “Kɛmɔ mehyehyɛ la, zɔhane ala a ɔbayɛ a, yɛɛ kɛmɔ mezuzu la, zɔhane ala a ɔbagyinla a. 25Mebazɛkye Aseleama mɔɔ wɔ me azɛlɛ ne azo, mebaye me menli ne akɔme kpomgbolo na meazokoɛ bɛ adesoa. 26Ngyehyɛlɛ mɔɔ la ɛkɛ maa ewiade amuala la ɛne, yɛɛ tumi mɔɔ mebava meadea maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti la ɛne.” 27Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma a ɛhyehyɛ ɛdo ɛkɛ a, nwane a kɛhola kɛzɛkye ye a? Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛdenrɛ ɔ sa, nwane a kɛhola kɛkpɔla ɔ sa a?
Nyamenle bazɛkye Filisitiama
28 Ɛvolɛ ne mɔɔ Belemgbunli Ehaze hɔle ayile nu la yɛɛ bɛbɔle nrɛlaleɛ ɛhye nolo a.
29 Nrɛlaleɛ ne se, “O Filisitiama amuala, bɛmmadi fɛlɛko kɛ baka ne mɔɔ bilale bɛ la ɛbubu, ɔluakɛ ɛwɔlɛ wu a, ɛwɔlɛ anwo ɛzulolɛ finde ɔ nzi, yɛɛ ɔto kolonvia a ɔbobɔ ɛwɔlɛ mɔɔ tu la. 30Ehyianli belamunli ralɛ bali aleɛ, yɛɛ mɔɔ ɛhyia la anwo badɔ ye. Na bɛmɛ, mebava ɛhɔne meabɔ bɛ menli mɔɔ hale la abo zo na meahu bɛ muala.
31“O Filisitiama, bɛ muala bɛva ɛzulolɛ bɛzu bɛye awolɛ wɔ bɛ azuamgbole zo nee bɛ nlenkɛ mgbole ne mɔ anloa. Ɔluakɛ senle vi sɔlɔ ɛlɛba; bɛle ɛlɔnema mɔɔ bɛ nuhua biala ɛnle foanvoanle a.”
32Duzu mualɛ yɛɛ sonla bava amaa maanle ne soanvolɛma a? “Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛkyekye Zayɔn, na ɛkɛ ne yɛɛ ye menli mɔɔ ɛlɛnwu amaneɛ la anwo badɔ bɛ a.”

Title: AYE 15
Content:
Nyamenle bazɛkye Mowabe
1 Nrɛlaleɛ mɔɔ fane Mowabe anwo la ɛne. Kɛmɔ kenle ko nɔɔzo yɛɛ bɛbɔle suakpole Aale, yɛɛ kenle ko nɔɔzo yɛɛ bɛbɔle suakpole Kɛɛ la, Mowabe maanle ne anu ɛyɛ diinyi. 2Daebɔnoma ɛhɔ ɛleka ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛsonle la kazu. Mowabema ɛlɛsu Niboma nee Midɛbama. Awie biala ɛkpa ɔ ti, ɛkpa ɔ kɛsa. 3Bɛheda ɛrele bɛluolua gua ne mɔ azo, bɛgyinla azua ti zo nee bɛ azuamgbole zo ɛleka wienyi ne mɔ bɛsu bɛtwi monle. 4Hɛhyebɔnoma nee Ɛlɛyalima ɛlɛsu. Bɛte bɛ ne wɔ Gyeehaze, yemɔti akee Mowabe ɛlɔnema ɛlɛsu kpole kpalɛ na bɛ nwo wozo bɛ. 5Medi Mowabema anwo nyane. Maanle ne anu amra nriandi kɔfea Zowaa nee Ɛgelate Hyɛlehyaya. Bie mɔ fo boka ne kɔ Luhete kɔsu; bɛdwu Hɛloneeyem adenle nu a bɛsu toonwo asɛɛ debie yɛ bɛ. 6Nemelem nzule ne mɔ ɛsesa, ndile ne mɔ ɛwe, mɔɔ bɔle nrɛlɛne wɔ ɔ bo la ɛyela, ndile amolɛ ko bɔbɔ ɛnle ɛkɛ. 7Zɔhane ati aleɛ dɔɔnwo mɔɔ bɛnyianle ye, nee bɛ ninyɛne mɔɔ bɛlɛ la, bɛzoale bɛ muala bɛpɛle bɛhɔle Welo Kpɔkɛ Bɔnza ne anzi lɔ. 8Ɛzunlɛ ɛde Mowabe maanle ne anu ɛleka biala. Ɛzunlɛ ne ɛdwu Yigeleeyem nee Biyɛyilem. 9Ɔluakɛ Daebɔn azule ne mɔ ɛhakyi mogya, noko mebamaa mɔɔ tɛla ɛhye la ara Daebɔn anwo zo; mebamaa awenade ahye Mowabema mɔɔ vile ɛsalɛ na bɛnriandi la ali, na meazɛkye bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛhale azɛlɛ ne azo la.

Title: AYE 16
Content:
Mowabe gyinlabelɛ ɛtane ne
1Mowabema ɛzoa menli vi Sila ɛmaa bɛva ɛsɛlɛ zo adenle ne anu bɛva mboane bɛhɔmaa Gyɛlusalɛm belemgbunli ne. 2Bɛdwu Azule Anɔn ne anloa a bɛdi tutɛnla kɛ nloma mɔɔ bɛvoa bɛ wɔ bɛ sane nu la.
3Bɛ edwɛkɛ a le kɛ, “Bɛhile yɛ mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ yɛyɛ la, bɛ nee yɛ ɛli ye pɛlepɛle zo. Bɛheda yɛ nwo zo kɛ nɔɔzo awozinli wɔ ewiazo sɛnzɛngyinla; bɛva menli ne mɔɔ awie ɛmbu bɛ bie la bɛvea, na bɛmmaye menli mɔɔ ɛlɛnriandi konle nu la bɛmaa. 4Bɛmaa yɛdayɛ Mowabema mɔɔ awie ɛmbu yɛ bie la ɛradɛnla bɛ avinli, na bɛlie yɛ kɛ nriandivolɛma wɔ sɛkyevolɛ ne asa anu.”
(Saa nzisi wie na bɛgyakyi azɛlɛ ne ɛzɛkyelɛ, na sɛkyeravolɛ ne vi azɛlɛ ne azo tu a, 5akee bɛbava ɛhulolɛ kpundii bɛazie ebia; ahenle mɔɔ badɛnla zolɛ la vi Belemgbunli Devidi abusua nu. Ɔbava nɔhalɛlilɛ yeazie menli ne, ɔbayɛ sonla mɔɔ kulo tenleneyɛlɛ, yɛɛ ɔbava pɛlepɛlelilɛ yeabua ndɛne.)
6Na Dwudama baha kɛ, “Yɛde Mowabema adubɛnwo ne nee kɛ bɛzile bɛmemanle bɛ nwo zo la; bɛ nloa anu ɛyelɛ, bɛ mgbanyizonle nee bɛ mgbole ɛhehanlɛ ne amuala. Bɛ adubɛnwo ne amuala le mgbane. 7Zɔhane ati bɛmaa Mowabema ɛzu bie. Awie biala ɛzu Mowabe. Bɛnwu amaneɛ yɛɛ nyane ɛha bɛ, ɔluakɛ bɛ Kɛɛ Hɛlɛse vanye ma welera ndɛlamoa ne mɔ ɛbɔ bɛ.”
8Hɛhyebɔn ɛya avule ne mɔ nee Sebema vanye egyinli ne mɔ ɛzɛkye. Ɛbɔ ye Sebema ɛkɛ ne mɔɔ kɔkpula Gyeezɛ, toonwo mɔɔ kɔdwu ɛsɛlɛ ne anloa lɔ, ɔpɛ nu ɛkɛ ɔkɔ toonwo ɔkɔgua ye Nyevile Wulera ne anloa la vanye egyinli ne mɔ mɔɔ manle maanle maanle arelemgbunli zile ngosi la ngane ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti ɛdwɔlɔdwɔlɔ. 9Yemɔti mefa ɛzunlɛ mɔɔ mefa mesu Gyeezɛ la meazu Sebema vanye egyinli ne mɔ. Mesu meagua Hɛhyebɔn nee Ɛlɛyali ati zo, ɔluakɛ bɛ ma nee bɛ bɛyɔba ne mɔ anwo zo a konle nu alɛrayɛlɛ ne ɛragua a. 10Fɛlɛko nee anyelielɛ ɛvi bɛ ma egyinli ne mɔ anu, awie ɛndeɛdea nu wɔ ɛkɛ. Awie ɛndwihwi nwanye ɛnvi vanye ma nu; vanye ma ɛtetelɛ nu anyelielɛ ɛdeɛdeanlɛ ne ɛwie. 11Yemɔti me ɛkɛla kulu ɔ kunlu kɛ getaa kpole la wɔ Mowabe ati, yɛɛ medi Kɛɛ Hɛlɛse anwo nyane. 12Saa Mowabema ye bɛ nyunlu, bɛfa bɛ nyane bɛkɔ ɛleka mɔɔ bɛsonle la kɛ bɛkaye ɛdɛne a, ɔnrɛyɛ boɛ ɔnrɛmaa bɛ.
13Edwɛkɛ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma hanle wɔ Mowabe anwo wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛze ɛhɔ la ɛne. 14Kɛkala Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Ɛvolɛ nsa pɛpɛ, mɔɔ le kɛ ɛkpabɔlɛ mekɛ la pɛpɛ, Mowabe maanle ne anyunlunyia badɔ aze. Menli bebelebe ne mɔɔ wɔ maanle ne anu la, ekyi bie a baha a, yɛɛ eza bɛ nwo ɛnrɛyɛ se.”

Title: AYE 17
Content:
Nyamenle badea Selea nee Yizilayɛ
1 Ɛdɛnkɛma edwɛkɛ mɔɔ fane Dɛmasekɛse anwo la ɛne. Ɔse, “Bɛnlea, Dɛmasekɛse ɛnrɛyɛ suakpole bieko; ɔbayɛ ewula edukue. 2Alowɛ azuamgbole ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti badɔ mgbane mɔɔ awie ɛnrɛdɛnla zolɛ bieko ɛlɛ a. Bɛbayɛ nyɛmoa alaleɛ. Bɛbahɔla ɛkɛ na awie ɛnrɛha bɛ ɛzulolɛ. 3Aranemgbole ne mɔ baminliminli Yifelaem, yɛɛ belemgbunlililɛ bavi Dɛmasekɛse; Seleama mɔɔ ɛha la anyunlu bagua aze kɛ Yizilayɛma la. Medame Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.
4“Mekɛ ne anu, Gyekɔbo abo zo amra anyunlu bagua aze na bɛanwa bɛayɛ nrenzenrenze. 5Ɔbayɛ kɛ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛyazonlɛnli ɛlɛbu ye bɛyɔba na ɔlɛtete ye nzoleɛ kɔsɔɔti la; ɔbayɛ kɛ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛyazonlɛnli ɛlɛte ye ma kɔsɔɔti wɔ Relɛfeeyem Bɔnza la. 6Ma ngoko ngoko bie a baha zolɛ a, kɛ ɔlivi baka mɔɔ bɛtete zolɛ ma ne amuala na yeha kɛyɛ nwiɔ anzɛɛ nsa bie wɔ baka ne ati zo nehane, anzɛɛ nna anzɛɛ nnu wɔ baka ne ngane ne mɔɔ so kpalɛ la azo la. Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle a mese a.”
7Mekɛ ne anu menli banwu bɛ Bɔvolɛ ne na bɛahakyi bɛ nye Yizilayɛ Nwuanzanwuanza Ko ne anwo. 8Bɛnrɛbu bɛ sa anloa gyima mɔɔ le bɛ azukponle ne mɔ, yɛɛ bɛnrɛnlea mɔɔ bɛdabɛ bɛva bɛ sa bɛyɛ bɔbɔ la, na yeayɛ bɛ bozonle raalɛ Ahyela ne ananze ne mɔ anzɛɛ bɛ ɛyɛlɛkpunlɛ azukponle ne mɔ.
9Mekɛ ne anu bɛ azuamgbole mɔɔ yɛ se la bayɛ kɛ Haevaema nee Amɔlema azuamgbole ne mɔ mɔɔ ɛyɛ azuadu la. Bɛvile azuamgbole ne mɔ azo bɛnriandile wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee Yizilayɛma ɛlɛba la, na azua ne mɔ badɔ mgbane.
10Ɔluakɛ Yizilayɛ arɛle ɛvi ye ngoanelielɛ Nyamenle ne, yɛɛ ɔngakye ye Ɛvealeka Bodane ne, mɔɔ le ye ɛvealeka la. Zɔhane ati bɛdua mbaka ngɛnlɛma na bɛava nyɛvolɛ awozonle bɛaziezie nu bɛazonle bɛ. 11Bɛbanlea bɛamaa bɛanyi kenle ko ne ala mɔɔ bɛkɛlua la, na bɛamaa bɛazo kenle ko ne ala nwonlomɔ ne mɔɔ bɛkɛlua la, noko bɛnrɛnyia bɛyɔba. Nyane nee amaneɛnwunlɛ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ la a bɛbanwu ye a.
Bɛli kpɔvolɛ maanle maanle ne mɔ anwo zo konim
12Aa, tie maanle maanle dɔɔnwo ane kɛ ɛlɛkulu bie a. Bɛlɛkulu kɛ nyevile mɔɔ ɛha ɔ nwo la. Aa, maanle maanle ne mɔ ɛlɛtea, bɛ ne le kɛ azule kpole bie mɔɔ lua awolɛ zo la. 13Maanle maanle ne mɔ tea, bɛ ne kulu kɛ azule mɔɔ lua awolɛ zo la. Noko ɔbahwi bɛ nyunlu, na bɛbagua ndwɛlɛ aze, bɛanriandi kɛ awoka zo abonle mɔɔ anwoma ɛlɛbɔ ye ahɔ, anzɛɛ munlutu mɔɔ ɛlɛdi akyima wɔ ahumuakyima nu la. 14Aleɛ dwo a, nea, ɛzulolɛ ngome! Mɔɔ aleɛ kahye la ɛnee biala ɛnle ɛkɛ! Menli mɔɔ sɛkye yɛ, wua yɛ nwo ninyɛne la kyɛfoa ɛ.

Title: AYE 18
Content:
Nyamenle badea Sudan
1 Sudan azule ne mɔ anzi lɔ, azɛlɛ bie wɔ ɛkɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛbɔ ndɛbalɛ nu, 2na bɛsoa ɛbɔfoɔma wɔ ndɔ ɛlɛne nu bɛmaa bɛkɔ Azule Naele ne nyiakɛ. Bɛmɛ soanvolɛma mɔɔ anwo yɛ ndɛ a, bɛhɔ maanle bie mɔɔ nuhua menli ne le ndendenle, bɛ nwo yɛ fɛ na menli mɔɔ ewiade amra amuala sulo bɛ la anu; ɔle maanle mɔɔ anwo yɛ ɛzulolɛ na ɔdi konim wɔ konle nu a, yɛɛ ye azɛlɛ ne, azule dɔɔnwo ɛgyigya nuhua.
3Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ ewiade la amuala, bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛde azɛlɛ ye azo la, saa bɛmaa sɛkɛlɛneɛ bie zo wɔ awoka ne mɔ azo lɔ a, bɛnlea. Saa bɛbɔ aweɛne tendenle nu a, bɛdie. 4Ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me kɛ, “Ɛleka mɔɔ mede la, mebado me nye meanlea bɛ koonwu kɛ ɛbuhenle nu wuluwulu ɛbɔlɛ mɔɔ tɔ nɔɔzo, meavede me nye meanlea azɛlɛ ye. 5Ɔluakɛ ɔkadwu mekɛ mɔɔ ndotolo kawie kpolo, na ndotolo ne ayɛ ma abolo, na ɛbuhenle ne adwu la, mebava dadeɛ meapepɛ nya ne mɔ mɔɔ ɛlɛfefɛ la anye, na meabubu ngane ne mɔ mɔɔ ɛdɛlɛdɛlɛ la meagua. 6Bɛbagyakyi bɛ bɛamaa awoka zo nloma nee azɛlɛ ye azo nane kɛ bɛli. Bɛbayɛ nloma aleɛ wɔ wawaa nu, na bɛayɛ azɛlɛ ye azo nane kɔsɔɔti aleɛ wɔ fɔsɛlɛ nu.”
7Mekɛ ne anu menli ndendenle anwo fɛlɛko mɔɔ ewiade amra sulo bɛ, na bɛle maanle anwo ɛzulolɛ mɔɔ di konim wɔ konle nu, mɔɔ azule dɔɔnwo ɛgyigya bɛ azɛlɛ ne anu la bava ahyɛlɛ ninyɛne arɛlɛ Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma wɔ Zayɔn Boka, ɛleka mɔɔ bɛsonle Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma la.

Title: AYE 19
Content:
Nyamenle badea Yigyibiti
1 Ɛdɛnkɛma nrɛlaleɛ mɔɔ fane Yigyibiti anwo la ɛne.
Bɛnlea, Ɛdɛnkɛma de amungu zo ɛlɛba waa zɛhae, ɔlɛba Yigyibiti. Awozonle mɔɔ wɔ Yigyibiti la nwu ye a bɛ nwo bawozo bɛ, na Yigyibitima ahonle badu. 2Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Mebamaa Yigyibitima angome adwazo atia bɛ nwo, adiema nee adiema baho, agɔnwolɛ badwazo agɔnwolɛ nwo zo, suakpole nee suakpole baho, na arelemgbunli adwazo arelemgbunli nwo zo. 3Bɛ ɛnwomenle mɔɔ wɔ bɛ nu la bawie, na mebazɛkye bɛ adwenle ngyehyɛleɛ biala. Bɛbahɔ bɛ awozonle ne mɔ, bɛ ngonyiama, menli mɔɔ tendɛ nwomenle nloa azo, yɛɛ bayivolɛma ne mɔ ɛkɛ ne abisa, 4noko mebaye Yigyibitima ne meamaa menlenlɛ bie mɔɔ ati yɛ se la, na belemgbunli anwo ɛzulolɛ bie bazie bɛ. Medame Awulae, Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, kɛ mese la ɛne.”
5Azule Naele ne basesa ayɛ resee, azɛlɛ ne akpakyekpakye; 6ye ngane ne mɔ basesa na ye ɛleka mɔɔ bɛdukue ye bɛva la abɔ nvoanvoa, na nuhua ndɔ nee ndile akpɔlɔ. 7Naele ne anloa azɛlɛ ne mɔ badɔ mgbane; aleɛ mɔɔ bɛlua bɛ ɛkɛ ne la amuala banwoso awu, na anwoma apia bɛ ahɔ. 8Fɛlɛhyelɛma mɔɔ to koba nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛto avonle wɔ Naele ne anu la anwo bavɔ, na bɛbazu bɛaye awolɛ. 9Gyimayɛvoma mɔɔ yɛ dwɛsɛ nwo gyima nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnwo ndanlɛ la arɛle babɔ. 10Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛle mandimase wɔ maanle ne anu la, bɛbaha bɛ senle dwɛɛ, na alɔbɔlɛ bahu gyimayɛvoma mɔɔ di ɛkpa la.
11Zowan mgbanyima le ahoasea kpole kpalɛ, yɛɛ Yigyibiti belemgbunli ne folɛtuvoma tu folɛ ɛtane. Duzu ati a ɔwɔ kɛ bɛka bɛkile Yigyibiti belemgbunli ne kɛ, “Mele nrɛlɛbɛvolɛ ra, mele mɔmoane arelemgbunli ne mɔ bie ara nrenya” ɛ? 12Bɛ nrɛlɛbɛvolɛma ne wɔ nienwu? Bɛmaa bɛha na bɛye debie ko mɔɔ Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛhyehyɛ mɔɔ ɔbava yeayɛ Yigyibitima la bɛhile bɛ. 13Zowan mgbanyima ɛyɛ ahoasea, yɛɛ bɛbɛlɛbɛla Mɛmefese mgbanyima. Yigyibiti titilema mɔɔ lɛ maanle ne la ɛmaa Yigyibitima anye zo ɛda bɛ. 14Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛye anyezota ɛdo Yigyibitima anwo, yemaa bɛbɔ atondo wɔ bɛ debie biala ɛyɛlɛ nu kɛ nzanli mɔɔ ɛbo ɛfefe ɛla nu la. 15Debie biala ɛnle Yigyibiti mɔɔ tile o, dualɛ o, ɛrɛlakɛ anzɛɛ ndɔ kɛhola kɛyɛ a.
Yigyibitima bazonle Ɛdɛnkɛma
16Mekɛ ne anu Yigyibitima bayɛ kɛ mralɛ. Sulosulo bamaa bɛ nwo awozo bɛ wɔ tumi ne mɔɔ Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma bamaa yeara bɛ nwo zo la abo. 17Dwuda maanle ne anwo baha Yigyibitima ɛzulolɛ. Mekɛ biala mɔɔ bɛkɛbɔ duma ne bɛkɛhile Yigyibitima la, ɛzulolɛ baha bɛ wɔ mɔɔ Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛhyehyɛ kɛ ɔfa yeayɛ bɛ la ati.
18Mekɛ ne anu azuamgbole nnu mɔɔ wɔ Yigyibiti la baha Keena anzɛɛ Hibulu aneɛ ne bie na bɛazonle Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma. Bɛbavɛlɛ azuamgbole ɛhye mɔ anu ko “Sɛnzɛne Suakpole.” 19Mekɛ ne anu bɛbazi Ɛdɛnkɛma azukponle wɔ Yigyibiti azɛlɛ zo na bɛakpɔnla Ɛdɛnkɛma mpila wɔ maanle ne ɛweɛne zo. 20Ɛhye bayɛ Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma sɛkɛlɛneɛ nee daselɛ wɔ maanle ne anu, amaa mekɛ biala mɔɔ sisiravolɛma kɛdwazo bɛ nwo zo la, saa bɛsu bɛfɛlɛ ye a yearɛlɛ bɛ dievolɛ yeamaa yearaho yealie bɛ. 21Ɛdɛnkɛma bamaa Yigyibitima anwu ye, na Yigyibitima banwu Ɛdɛnkɛma wɔ mekɛ ne anu na bɛava azubɔlɛ nee ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ bɛazonle ye; bɛbabɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛwɔkɛ na bɛaye. 22Ɛdɛnkɛma badea Yigyibitima na eza yeayɛ bɛ ayile; bɛbazia bɛara Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛkɛ, na ɔbadie bɛ modolɛ nzɛlɛlɛ na yeayɛ bɛ ayile.
23Mekɛ ne anu ademgbole bala Yigyibiti nee Aselea avinli. Aseleama bahɔ Yigyibiti, yɛɛ Yigyibitima bahɔ Aselea maanle nu, na Yigyibitima nee Aseleama babɔ nu azonle. 24Mekɛ ne anu Yizilayɛ badɔ Aselea nee Yigyibiti anwo zo bɛayɛ maanle nsa, na bɛayɛ nyilalɛ bɛamaa ewiade amra amuala. 25Bɛmɛ yɛɛ Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛha bɛ nwo edwɛkɛ kɛ, “Nyilalɛ ɛha me menli Yigyibitima, Aselea mɔɔ le me sa anloa gyima, yɛɛ Yizilayɛ, me agyadeɛ.”

Title: AYE 20
Content:
Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ ne mɔɔ lɛ ɔ nwo zɔ la anwo sɛkɛlɛneɛ
1Aselea maanle maanle Belemgbunli Sagɔn zoanle ye Safohyenlema Kpanyinli ne mɔɔ nea ye ɛlɔnema anwo zo la manle ɔvale ɛlɔnema ɔrale Ahyedɔdo ɔrahonle ɔvale suakpole ne. 2Mekɛ ne anu ɛnee Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛdendɛ ɛhile Emɔzo ara Ayezaya kɛ, “Kɔzianyi ɛrele ne mɔɔ hye ɛ nze zo la na yeye ɛ gyakɛ mgbɔlaboa ne mɔ,” na yeyɛ ye zɔ, ɔlɛ ɔ nwo zɔ, ɔ gyakɛ gua aze na ɔzo ɔlua. 3Ɛdɛnkɛma zele ye kɛ, “Me sonvolɛ Ayezaya ɛlɛ ɔ nwo zɔ, ɛgua ɔ gyakɛ aze yeluolua toonwo ɛvolɛ nsa. Ɛhye le sɛkɛlɛneɛ mɔɔ kile mɔɔ bazi Yigyibitima nee Sudanema anwo zo la. 4Yemɔti Aselea maanle maanle belemgbunli ne bahye Yigyibitima nuokɛ na yeazoa Sudanema yeahɔ nlɔnu. Ɔbahye ngakula nee mgbanyinli mɔɔ lɛ bɛ nwo zɔ, bɛ gyakɛ gua aze, na bɛ butua gua zo la yeahɔ, yeava yeagua Yigyibitima anyunlu aze. 5Akee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛva bɛ rɛle bɛdo Sudanema anwo zo na bɛfa Yigyibiti bɛtu bɛ nloa anu la arɛle babɔ na bɛ adwenle aha abɔ nu. 6Mekɛ ne anu bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛde ɛnweanloa nehae la baha kɛ, ‘Bɛnlea mɔɔ ɛzi bɛdabɛ mɔɔ yɛvale yɛ rɛle yɛwulale bɛ nu, na yɛnriandile yɛhɔdanenle bɛ kɛ bɛboa yɛ na bɛlie yɛ bɛvi Aselea belemgbunli ne asa anu la anwo zo a! Na yɛmɛ, kɛ ɔkɛyɛ na yɛavi ɛsalɛ ɛ?’ ”

Title: AYE 21
Content:
Babelɔn ɛbɔlɛ nwo ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ
1Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ mɔɔ fane Babelonia anwo la ɛne:
Ɔle kɛ ahumuakyima mɔɔ vi nyiakɛ ɛlɛtu la, ɔvi ɛsɛlɛ zo a ɔlɛba a, ɔvi maanle anwo ɛzulolɛ bie anu a ɔlɛba a. 2Ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ ɛsesebɛ kpalɛ a menwu ye la; ninyɛnevenlɛma mɔɔ fe ninyɛne nee ninyɛnezɛkyelɛma mɔɔ sɛkye ninyɛne.
Yilam ɛlɔnema, bɛhɔho! Midea ɛlɔnema, bɛhɔbɛnra azuamgbole bɛyia! Nyamenle se, “Mebazi nyanehilelɛ ne mɔɔ Babelɔn ɛhile menli la kɔsɔɔti aze.”
3Yemɔti nyane ɛwolowolo me na me nwo fofo me kɛ raalɛ mɔɔ ɛvo awolɛ zo la. Me ti ɛzi aze, yemɔti mende ɛhwee, yɛɛ me adwenle ɛha ɛbɔ nu, yemɔti mennwu ɛhwee. 4Me ti kpakye me, ɛzulolɛ ɛheda me nwo zo. Akee aledwolɛ ne mɔɔ me nwo lɔle ye la anu ɛyɛ ɛzulolɛ kpole bie ɛmaa me.
5Ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ ne anu, menwunle kɛ bɛdo ɛkponle ne, bɛziezie mbia nwolɛ na bɛlɛdi bɛno. Arɛlevilɛ nu bɛdeanle nu, “Safohyenlema, bɛdwazo bɛvɔ bɛ sa nu enyinlike ne mɔ nwole!”
6Ɔluakɛ Awulae zele me kɛ, “Kɔ, kɔva awie maa ɔgyinla ɔzinza, na mɔɔ ɔkɛnwu ye la yeava yeado gua. 7Saa ɔnwu kɛ menli dede mgbɔnwɔ zo na bɛlua ye nwiɔ nwiɔ, bie mɔ dede asoaso nee afunlumu zo a, maa ɔdie bɛ kpalɛ kpalɛ.”
8Na mɔɔ ɛlɛsinza la nwunle bɛ na ɔdeanle nuhua kɛ, “O Awulae, megyi tawa ye azo mesinza dahuu. Aledwolɛ nu amuala megyi me gyakɛ anu. 9 Na kɛkala nea, bɛmɛ a bɛlɛba la! Menli ne dede mgbɔnwɔ zo na bɛlua ye nwiɔ nwiɔ!”
Na ɔbuale bɛ kɛ, “Yebɔ! Babelɔn ɛbɔ; bɛbubu ye awozonle ananze ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti bɛgua.”
