bɛnlɛ ndelebɛbo.
Bɛbe ɛtaneyɛlɛ nu,
na kpalɛ, bɛnze ye yɛ.”
Gyɛlɛmaya ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ mɔɔ fane ɛzɛkyelɛ mɔɔ ɛlɛba la anwo
23Meneanle azɛlɛ ye azo, na nea, ɛnee yedɔ mgbane,
ɛhwee ɛnle zo;
meneanle anwuma, na anwumaneamra anda.
24Meneanle awoka ne mɔ azo,
na nea, ɛnee bɛlɛkpusu,
awoka ngyikyi ne mɔ amuala ɛlɛsi ngosi.
25Meneanle, na nea, sonla ɛnle ɛkɛ,
nloma kɔsɔɔti ɛdu ɛhɔ.
26Meneanle, na nea, azɛlɛ kɛnlɛma ne
mɔɔ kye aleɛ la ɛhakyi ɛsɛlɛ;
ye azuamgbole ne mɔ amuala ɛyɛ azuadu.
ɔlua Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛya kpole ne ati.
27Ɛdɛnkɛma se,
“Mebazɛkye azɛlɛ ne,
noko menrɛzɛkye ye bɔkɔɔ.
28Azɛlɛ baye awolɛ;
anwomanyunlu balu.
Meha, mebɔ ye kpɔkɛ, menrɛze anwunvɔne
yɛɛ menrɛhakyi me nloa.”
29Saa bɛte ɛlɔne ɛkpɔnwɔkavoma nee ɛdatovoma ane a,
suakpole biala azo amra bagua ɛbɔ nu;
bie mɔ bagua mbowule nu;
bie mɔ bavo ahɔgua awolɛ zo.
Azuamgbole ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti badɔ mgbane,
awie biala ɛnrɛdɛnla zolɛ bieko.
30O Gyɛlusalɛm, wɔdɔ mgbane!
Duzu ati a ɛheda arelemgbunli ɛdanlɛ kɔkɔlɛ ɛ?
Duzu ati a ɛfa ezukoa nvutuke anwoneɛ ɛsiezie ɛ nwo,
na ɛto ɛ nye anzi ɛ?
Ɛlɛsiezie ɛ nwo mgbane!
Wɔ kulovolɛma ɛkpo wɔ;
bɛlɛkpondɛ wɔ bɛahu wɔ.
31Mendele ɛdeanlɛ kɛ raalɛ mɔɔ ɛvo awolɛ zo,
mendele ɛkponlenlɛ kɛ raalɛ mɔɔ ɛlɛwo
ye belamunli ralɛ la.
Gyɛlusalɛm a ɛzu ɛha nu la,
yedɛlɛ ɔ sa nu, ɔse,
“Mewu O! Medɔ kɔdiawuma asa anu.”

Title: GYƐ 5
Content:
Gyɛlusalɛmma ɛtane ne
1Bɛnriandi bɛli akɔneaba
wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm kpalɛ ne mɔ azo!
Bɛtoto bɛ nye!
Bɛdabɛ bɛnlea ye bɛ nye zo!
Bɛnlea gua ne mɔ azo
saa bɛkɛnwu awie mɔɔ di pɛlepɛle
na ɔka nɔhalɛ la a,
na menva ye ɛtane mengyɛ ye.
2Bɛka ndane kɛ, “Meka Ɛdɛnkɛma” bɔbɔ ɛdeɛ,
noko bɛka ndane ne adalɛ nu.
3O Ɛdɛnkɛma, wɔmɔ ɛkulo nɔhalɛ.
Ɛdeanle bɛ, na yɛanyɛ bɛ nyane;
ɛhanle bɛ senle, noko bɛangakyi.
Bɛsolo bɔkɔɔ; bɛtɛnunle bɛ nwo.
4Yemɔti menganle kɛ, “Ɛhye mɔ yɛ anwunvɔne,
bɛnze nrɛlɛbɛ,
ɔluakɛ bɛnze Ɛdɛnkɛma adenle ne,
bɛnze bɛ Nyamenle ne mɛla ne.”
5Mebahɔ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ tumi ne wɔ bɛ sa nu la ɛkɛ
me nee bɛ ahɔdendɛ,
ɔluakɛ bɛmɛ, bɛze Ɛdɛnkɛma adenle ne,
bɛze bɛ Nyamenle ne mɛla ne.
Noko bɛ muala bɛde nyɛma, bɛdɛla anhwe,
bɛkpo kɛ bɛnrɛli ye mɛla zo.
6Yemɔti awenade vi kpɔkɛ nu barahu bɛ,
bedi vi ɛsɛlɛ zo barazɛkye bɛ.
Sobolɛ ɛhɔ bɛ azuamgbole ne mɔ anwo nzia,
awie biala mɔɔ vi biala azo kɛvinde la
bɛbatete ye nzokanzoka,
ɔboalekɛ bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ zonle somaa,
yɛɛ bɛkpo Nyamenle bɛhyɛ.
7Ɛdɛnkɛma bizale ye kɛ, “Kɛ ɔyɛ mɔɔ
ɔwɔ kɛ mefa bɛ ɛtane mekyɛ bɛ ɛ?
Bɛ menli ne ɛkpo me,
na bɛzonle nyamenle gyɛne gyɛne mɔɔ ɛnle ɛkɛ la.
Memanle bɛ aleɛ bɛlile bɛ ko yile la,
bɛdonle awuvolɛvalɛ mɛla ne,
na bɛdule bɛdoale tuutuuma.
8Bɛle kɛ mgbɔnwɔ nyinli mɔɔ evunle ɛwie yi,
na bɛ nwo ɛlɛmenlemenle bɛ la,
ko biala atiakunlu ba ɔ gɔnwo aye anwo zo.
9Asoo ɔnle kɛ metea bɛ wɔ
nyɛleɛ ɛhye mɔ anwo,
na mesenra maanle zɛhae?
10Bɛhɔzɛkye ye vanye ɛya ne,
na bɛmmasɛkye bɛ bɔkɔɔ;
bɛpepɛ ye ngane ne mɔ bɛgua,
ɔluakɛ bɛnle Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛdeɛ.
11Ɔluakɛ Yizilayɛma nee Dwudama
anli nɔhalɛ ammaa me.
Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.”
Ɛdɛnkɛma kpo Yizilayɛma
12Yizilayɛma nee Dwudama ɛbɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anwo adalɛ. Bɛse, “Ɔnrɛyɛ ɛhwee. Munzule biala ɛnrɛdo yɛ, konle ɛnrɛva yɛ aze, yɛɛ ɛhɔne ɛnrɛhu yɛ. 13Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma ne mɔ le anwoma ala; bɛnlɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma nrɛlaleɛ biala bɛnga. Kɛ bɛdabɛ noko bɛbayɛ ala la ɛne.” 14Yemɔti kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, Tumivolɛ Nyamenle ne se la ɛne, “Gyɛlɛmaya, kɛmɔ bɛha edwɛkɛ ɛhye la, memaa me edwɛkɛ ne ahakyi senle wɔ ɛ nloa anu na menli ɛhye mɔ ahakyi ɛyɛne, na senle ne ayela bɛ wee.”
15Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Yizilayɛma, memaa maanle bie anu amra arateta bɛ. Ɔle maanle dɛba yɛɛ ɔle maanle mɔɔ anwo yɛ se. Ɔle maanle mɔɔ bɛnde bɛ aneɛ, yɛɛ mɔɔ bɛka bɔbɔ la bɛnde ɔ bo. 16Bɛ ɛda mbaka boa le kɛ azie zo sɛka mɔɔ bɛbɔ bɛdo ɛkɛ ne la, yɛɛ menli ne le katakyiema. 17Bɛbali bɛ bɛyɔba ne nee bɛ aleɛ ne; bɛbahu bɛ mra mrenya nee bɛ mra mraalɛ. Bɛbahu bɛ mboane nee bɛ nlankɛ, na bɛazɛkye bɛ vanye mbaka nee bɛ feege mbaka. Bɛbabubu bɛ azuamgbole ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛbɔ nwolɛ bane na bɛ ti zɔ bɛ la.”
18Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Gyɛlɛmaya, mekɛ ne anu menrɛzɛkye me menli ne menrɛdu bɛ bo. 19Saa wɔ menli ne biza kɛ duzu ati a Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛ Nyamenle ne ɛyɛ ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ a, ka kile bɛ kɛ, ‘Bɛkpole medame, Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne na bɛzonlenle nyamenle gyɛne gyɛne wɔ bɛdabɛ bɛ maanle nu, yemɔti bɛbazonle nyɛvolɛ wɔ maanle mɔɔ ɛnle bɛ ɛdeɛ la anu.’ ”
Nyamenle bɔ ye menli ne kɔkɔ
20Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Ka kile Gyekɔbo abo zo amra nee Dwudama kɛ: 21 Bɛdie ɛhye, ahɔnwɔne mɔɔ ɛnze nrɛlɛbɛ a, mɔɔ lɛ ɛnyelɛ na bɛnnwu debie a, mɔɔ lɛ ɛnzonlɛ na bɛnde edwɛkɛ a. 22 Duzu ati a bɛnzulo me ɛ? Duzu ati a bɛgyi me nyunlu a bɛ nwo ɛnwozo bɛ a? Menvale ɛnwea mengyale nyevile ɛweɛne mɔɔ ɔngola ye bɔ tɛla ɛlɛ la. Azɛlɛkye ne mɔ bu na bɛngola bɛndɛla ɛweɛne ne, bɛkulu mgbole na bɛngola bɛnli ɛweɛne ne bɔtɛla. 23Na bɛmɛ, bɛle menli anzosesebɛ na bɛte atua; bɛhakyi bɛ nzi bɛzi me. 24Bɛnga ye bɛ ahonle nu bɔbɔ kɛ, ‘Bɛmaa yɛzulo Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛ Nyamenle ne mɔɔ tɔ ezule nee nyenyensuo wɔ bɛ ɛlobɔ nloa, na ɛbuhenle dwu a ɔmaa yɛ bɛyɔba la.’ 25Bɛ amumuyɛ nee bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ ɛmaa ninyɛne kpalɛ ɛkpa bɛ ti.
26“Amumuyɛma wɔ me menli ne avinli. Bɛkɔ nzia kɛ menli mɔɔ sua nlomangane la. Bɛsua ngane bɛkye menli. 27Bɛ azua nu ɛyɛ nwule ninyɛne ngome kɛ tunli mɔɔ nloma ɛyi ye la. Yemɔti bɛ tumi ɛyɛ kpole yɛɛ bɛnyia bɛ nwo. 28Bɛdi aleɛ kpalɛ la ati bɛle mbelane tutoboo, bɛ nwo le mɛnlaanwo. Bɛ amumuyɛ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ. Bɛnze arisa ralɛ yɛɛ bɛnze sonla mɔɔ bɛlɛsisi ye la anwunvɔne.
29“Asoo ɔnle kɛ metea bɛ wɔ ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ anwo, na mesenra maanle zɛhae ɔ? 30Debie ɛzulolɛ ɛzi azɛlɛ ne azo. 31Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma bɔ adalɛ, yɛɛ sɛlɛvolɛma yɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma kɛze bɛ la. Me menli ne die mɔɔ bɛka la to nu; bɛmkpo kɛ bɛnrɛyɛ ye zɔhane, na saa awieleɛ ne ba a duzu a bɛkɛyɛ a?”

Title: GYƐ 6
Content:
Kpɔvolɛma ɛbɔ Gyɛlusalɛm ɛyia
1O Bɛngyamanema, bɛnriandi bɛvi Gyɛlusalɛm! Bɛlie bɛ ngoane! Bɛwu aweɛne tendenle ne anu wɔ Tɛkowa na bɛkpɔnla sɛkɛlɛneɛ wɔ Bɛte Hakɛlɛm, ɔluakɛ munzule ɛkpuke sɔlɔ ɛlɛba arazɛkye ninyɛne. 2Suakpole Zayɔn ɛfifi kɛnlɛma, noko bɛbabɔ ye. 3Arelemgbunli bava bɛ ɛlɔnema ara ɛkɛ. Bɛbasisi bɛ ndanlɛ azua bɛabɔ suakpole ne bɛayia. Awie biala badɛnla ɛleka mɔɔ ɔkulo la. 4Bɛbaha kɛ “Bɛboɔboa bɛ nwo bɛhɔteta Gyɛlusalɛm; bɛteta ye ewiazo ketekete!” Menli ne babua kɛ, “Yekpa nwolɛ, aleɛ asɛɛ ɛdwo, sɛnzɛne ne ɛdɔ. 5Bɛdwazo bɛmaa yɛhɔteta bɛ ɛnɛ nɔe, na yɛbubu bɛ aranemgbole ne mɔ!”
6Kɛ Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma se la ɛne: “Bɛpepɛ ye mbaka ne mɔ na bɛhuohua anwea suakpole Gyɛlusalɛm anwo bɛbɛnra bɛyia. Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛtea suakpole ɛhye azo amra, ɔluakɛ ɛsisilɛ ala a bɛsisi menli a. 7Kɛmɔ dahuu nzule gyi bula nu la, zɔhane ala a Gyɛlusalɛm dahuu sie amumuyɛ a; konle konle nee ninyɛnezɛkyelɛ ala a mete a, anwondolɛ nee nganlɛ ɛbobɔlɛ ala a menwu bɛ a. 8Gyɛlusalɛmma, bɛva ɛhye mɔ bɛdu bɛ nwo folɛ, anrɛɛ menwɔkpo bɛ menwɔmaa bɛ suakpole ne kɛyɛ suadu.”
Yizilayɛma le atuadelɛma
9Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Bɛkpokpo Yizilayɛma mɔɔ ɛha la kɛ vanye baka mɔɔ bɛwie ye ma kpolo la. Yemɔti kpɔla ye ngane ne mɔ azo bieko, kɛmɔ matevolɛ ɛlɛtete vanye ne a ɔyɛ la.”
10Membuale kɛ, “Saa meka edwɛkɛ ɛhye mefa mebɔ kɔkɔ a, nwane bɔbɔ a kɛdie me a? Bɛduodua bɛ nzo; ɛka edwɛkɛ a bɛndie. Ɛdɛnkɛma, ɛ nloa edwɛkɛ bɔbɔ yɛ bɛ ɛzelekɛ. Bɛ nye ɛnlie ɛ nloa edwɛkɛ ne anwo fee. 11Yemɔti ɛya mɔɔ wɔva ye bɛ nwo la ɛwolowolo me, Ɛdɛnkɛma. Mengola ye me kunlu di.”
Nzinlii Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me kɛ, “Wola me ɛya ne gua ngakula mɔɔ wɔ guabile ne mɔ azo, nee mgbavolɛ mɔɔ ɛyia la anwo zo. Bɛbahye kunli nee yelɛ, mgbanyinli nee mrelera bɛahɔ. 12 Mebadea menli mɔɔ de azɛlɛ ne azo la. Yemɔti bɛbava bɛ azua, bɛ egyinli yɛɛ bɛ ye mɔ bɛamaa awie mɔ gyɛne. 13Ɔluakɛ ngakula nee mgbanyinli kɔsɔɔti ɛva ɛzie bɛ nyunlu kɛ bɛkpondɛ ezukoa awule nu. Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma nee sɛlɛvolɛma amuala sisi menli ne. 14 Bɛlɛmia me menli ne nganlɛ ne mɔ a bɛdoɔloa bɛ ala. Bɛse, ‘Yehɔ, yehɔ,’ wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ nganlɛ ne mɔ ɛtɛkɔle la. 15Asoo bɛkyi ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ ɛyɛlɛ yɛle bɛ nyiane? Kyɛkyɛ, yeanyɛ bɛ nyiane fee, bɛnze nyiane deɛ holɛ. Yemɔti bɛbawu kɛ menli mɔɔ ɛwu la. Kenle mɔɔ menwɔze kɛ metea bɛ la ɛnee bɛ awieleɛ ne ala ɛne. Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.”
Yizilayɛma kpo Nyamenle adenle ne
16Ɛdɛnkɛma zele ye menli ne kɛ, “Bɛgyinlegyinla ndenle ne mɔ azo na bɛnlea. Bɛbizebiza mɔmoane ndenle ne mɔ, ɛleka mɔɔ adenle kpalɛ kpalɛ ne la la. Bɛlua nuhua na bɛkɛnyia anzonudwolɛ.”
Na bɛbuale kɛ, “Kyɛkyɛ, yɛnrɛlua nuhua fee.” 17Memanle bɛ sinzavolɛma na menganle kɛ, “Bɛdie aweɛne tendenle ne kɔkɔbɔlɛ ne!” Na bɛhanle kɛ, “Yɛnrɛdie!”
18Yemɔti Ɛdɛnkɛma zele kɛ, “Bɛdie, bɛmɛ maanle maanle, maanlema mɔɔ ɛyia nu, na bɛnwu mɔɔ bara me menli ne anwo zo la. 19Tie, O azɛlɛ! Adwenle ɛtane ɛtane mɔɔ me menli ne bɔ la ati, melɛmaa munzule ara bɛ nwo zo, ɔboalekɛ bɛandie me ne, yɛɛ bɛkpo me mɛla ne. 20Kɛ meyɛ ɛyɛlɛ ne mɔɔ bɛ nee ye vi Hyiba ɛrɛlɛ me la ɛ? Anzɛɛ kɛ meyɛ aleɛdonlɛ ninyɛne evuanlɛ mɔɔ bɛ nee bɛ vi maanle zo moa moa ɛrɛlɛ me la ɛ? Menrɛlie bɛ ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ, yɛɛ bɛ azubɔlɛ ne mɔ ɛnzɔ me nye.” 21Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Bɛnlea, mebamaa menli ɛhye mɔ adu koti adu agua aze; selɛ o, mralɛ o, agɔnwolɛma anzɛɛ menli mɔɔ bɛ nee bɛ zuozua bane la o, bɛ kɔsɔɔti bɛ bo zo baminli.”
Sɔlɔ amra teta bɛ
22Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me kɛ, “Menli vi sɔlɔ maanle nu ɛlɛba. Maanle anwosesebɛ kpalɛ bie ɛlɛboɔboa ɔ nwo nee konle vi moa moa ara. 23Bɛdedɛ ɛda nee atwɛ mɔ; bɛ ti yɛ se yɛɛ bɛnze anwunvɔne. Saa bɛdede bɛ mgbɔnwɔ ne mɔ azo a, bɛ nganeɛ kulu kɛ nyevile. Bɛboɔboa bɛ nwo bɛwie; bɛlɛba bɛ nee Gyɛlusalɛmma araho.”
24Gyɛlusalɛmma se, “Yɛde nrɛlaleɛ ne, yɛ sa nu ɛtuto. Arɛlebɔlɛ nee nyane ɛkyekye yɛ kɛ raalɛ mɔɔ ɛvo awolɛ zo la. 25Bɛmmakɔ ɛbɔ nu yɛɛ bɛmmaduolua ademgbole ne mɔ anu, ɔluakɛ yɛ kpɔvolɛma ɛwie sia; ɛleka biala ɛyɛ ɛzulolɛ.”
26Ɛdɛnkɛma zele ye menli ne kɛ, “Bɛheda ɛrele na bɛva nzonle bɛbɔ bɛ nwo. Bɛzu bɛye awolɛ kpalɛ kɛ bɛsu ralɛ nrenya kokye mɔɔ ɛwu la, ɔboalekɛ sɛkyevolɛ ne mɔɔ bazɛkye bɛ la barateta bɛ arɛlevilɛ nu. 27Gyɛlɛmaya, meyɛ wɔ ezukoa dwinvolɛ; sɔ me menli ne nea, kɛmɔ dwinvolɛ si twi bulalɛ nwo nea ye deɛ holɛ la. Nea na nwu bɛ ndenle ne mɔ. 28Bɛ muala bɛte atua anzosesebɛ nu; bɛ nee alane asiayɛma a tu a. Bɛyɛ se kɛ kɔbele nee bulalɛ. Bɛ ɛbɛla ɛzɛkye. 29Dwinvolɛ senle ne ɛlɛsɔ kpole, senle ne ɛdɔlɔ woonwu, noko mbulalɛ ne mɔ ɛngolo na mɔɔ ɛnle kpalɛ la avi nu. Ɔle ɛvɛlɛ mgbane kɛ ɛkɛha kɛ ɛyɛ me menli ne boɛ, ɔluakɛ bɛtɛyele amumuyɛma ne bɛtɛfile bɛ avinli. 30Bɛfɛlɛ bɛ dwɛtɛ fufule ebinli, ɔluakɛ medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, mekpo bɛ.”

Title: GYƐ 7
Content:
Gyɛlɛmaya bɔ Nyamenle edwɛkɛ ne nolo wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu
1Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Gyɛlɛmaya kɛ, 2“Kɔgyinla Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anlenkɛ kpole ne anu, na bɔ edwɛkɛ ɛhye nolo kɛ: Bɛmɛ Dwudama mɔɔ dua nlenkɛ mgbole ɛhye mɔ anu ba Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ye anu basonle medame Ɛdɛnkɛma la, bɛ muala bɛdie. 3Medame Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle, mese: Bɛnlea bɛ ndenle nu boɛ na bɛhakyi bɛ nyɛleɛ ne mɔ na menwɔmaa bɛkɛdɛnla ɛke. 4Bɛmmadie mɛlɛbɛla edwɛkɛ ɛhye mɔɔ se, ‘Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne ɛne, Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne ɛne!’ la bɛdi.
5“Ɔluakɛ saa nɔhalɛ nu bɛkakyi bɛ ndenle nee bɛ nyɛleɛ, saa nɔhalɛ nu bɛdi pɛlepɛle bɛmaa bɛ nwo ngoko, 6saa bɛansisi nyɛvolɛ, bɛansisi menli mɔɔ ɛnlɛ bɛ ze anzɛɛ ahunlanvolɛ mraalɛ, anzɛɛ bɛanga mogya mɔɔ ɛnze nwolɛ bie la bɛangua ɛke, yɛɛ saa bɛangɔnzonle nyamenle gyɛne gyɛne bɛanzɛkye bɛ nwo a, 7menwɔmaa bɛkɛdɛnla ɛke, wɔ azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ menvale memanle bɛ ze mɔ bɔkɔɔ la azo.
8“Bɛmɛ, bɛdie mɛlɛbɛla edwɛkɛ bɛdi, noko bɛnnyia zolɛ nvasoɛ. 9Bɛwua, bɛku menli, bɛto awuvolɛvalɛ mɛla ne, bɛdi amonle bɛbɔ adalɛ, bɛkpu ɛyɛlɛ bɛmaa bozonle Beeyale, bɛsonle nyamenle gyɛne gyɛne mɔɔ bɛnze bɛ la, 10na bɛaragyinla me nyunlu wɔ me Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ye mɔɔ bɛfa me duma bɛfɛlɛ ye la anu, na bɛaze kɛ, ‘Bɛlie yɛ ngoane’ wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛtɛgua zolɛ bɛtɛyɛ bɛkyi ninyɛne la. 11 Bɛdwenle kɛ me Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ye mɔɔ bɛfa me duma bɛfɛlɛ ye la le awulema fealeka ɔ? Mɔɔ bɛlɛyɛ la, medame mumua ne menwu ye. 12 Bɛhɔ Hyaelo, ɛleka mɔɔ menlumuale menyɛle kɛ bɛzonle me, na bɛhɔnlea kɛ menzile menyɛle ye wɔ me menli Yizilayɛma ɛtane ne ati la. 13Kɛmɔ bɛyɛ ɛhye mɔ amuala, medendɛ mehile bɛ fane dɔɔnwo na bɛandie, na menvɛlɛle bɛ la, bɛambua la ati, medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, mese: 14Debie mɔɔ menvale menyɛle Hyaelo Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne mɔɔ bɛfa me duma bɛfɛlɛ ye la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ mebava meayɛ sua ye mɔɔ bɛfa me duma bɛfɛlɛ ye, na bɛ ti zɔ ye nee azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ menvale memanle bɛ nee bɛ ze mɔ la a. 15Mebavoa bɛ, kɛmɔ menvoanle bɛ ze mɔ Yizilayɛma amuala la. Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.”
Menli ne anyɛ tieyɛ
16Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me kɛ, “Gyɛlɛmaya, mmasɛlɛ ɛmaa menli ɛhye mɔ anzɛɛ mmasu bɛ, yɛɛ mmakpa bɛ ti kyɛlɛ, ɔluakɛ menrɛdie. 17Ɛnnwu nyɛleɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛyɛ wɔ Dwuda azuamgbole ne mɔ azo nee Gyɛlusalɛm guabile ne mɔ azo la ɔ? 18 Ngakula ne mɔ soa ɛyɛne, mrenya ne mɔ fa wuda senle, yɛɛ mraalɛ ne mɔ fɔtɔ ɛdɔkɛ fa yɛ keeki maa bozonle raalɛ ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Anwuma Belemgbunli Raalɛ ne la. Eza bɛfa nza azubɔdeɛ bɛye ɛdɛne bɛmaa nyamenle gyɛne gyɛne bɛfa bɛka me ɛya. 19Ɛnee mame a bɛka me ɛya a? Kyɛkyɛ, bɛdabɛ bɛ ngome a bɛlɛsie bɛ nwo munzule bɛagua bɛ nyunlu aze a. 20Yemɔti medame Awulae Nyamenle, mese: Mebawola me ɛya ne meagua Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ye azo. Mebawola meagua menli nee nyɛmoa nwo zo, ɛbɔ nu mbaka nee azɛlɛ ye azo bɛyɔba zo. Me ɛya ne bazɔ kpole kpalɛ mɔɔ awie ɛnrɛhola ye nua a.”
21Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne se, “Yizilayɛma, bɛva bɛ ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ bɛboka bɛ azubɔlɛ ne mɔ na bɛli nane ne. 22Ɔluakɛ me nee bɛ ze mɔ vi Yigyibiti rale la, meanga ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ nee azubɔlɛ nwo edwɛkɛ biala meangile bɛ. 23Mɔɔ menzele bɛ la ɛne, ‘Bɛdie me ne na mebayɛ bɛ Nyamenle, na bɛdabɛ bɛayɛ me menli. Eza bɛlua ndenle mɔɔ mehile bɛ la anu, amaa bɛ ɛbɛla awie bɛ boɛ.’ 24Noko bɛanli me edwɛkɛ ɛdeɛ ne mɔɔ menganle la azo, yɛɛ bɛambu ye bie; bɛdabɛ bɛlile bɛ ahonle ɛtane nzi bɛyɛle mɔɔ bɛdabɛ bɛ kunlu dwo la, na bɛzɛkyele bɔbɔ bɛdɛlale dɛba ne. 25Ɔvi kenle mɔɔ bɛ ze mɔ vi Yigyibiti azɛlɛ zo rale toonwo mɔɔ yeradwu ɛnɛ la, mezoa me sonvolɛ kpɔmanvolɛma wɔ bɛ ɛkɛ alehyenlɛ biala, 26noko bɛandie me, anzɛɛ bɛangyea bɛ nzo bɔbɔ. Akee bɔbɔ bɛyɛle anzosesebɛ kpole kpalɛ bɛdɛlale bɛ ze mɔ.
27“Yemɔti, Gyɛlɛmaya, ɛbaha edwɛkɛ ɛhye mɔ kɔsɔɔti wɔahile bɛ bɔbɔ ɛdeɛ, na bɛnrɛdie wɔ. Ɛbavɛlɛ bɛ, na bɛnrɛdɛne wɔ zo. 28Na ɛbaha wɔahile bɛ kɛ: Ɛhye a le maanle ne mɔɔ anyɛ tieyɛ ammaa Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne la. Bɛngulo kɛ bɛfo adenle a bɛtwi bɛ nyunlu. Nɔhalɛ ɛwie. Awie biala ɛnga nɔhalɛ.
Nyɛleɛ ɛtane wɔ Henɛm Bɔnza
29“Gyɛlusalɛmma, bɛye awolɛ;
bɛkpa bɛ ti
na bɛvuandi enrinli ne bɛgua.
Bɛdo ɛzɛne edwɛne wɔ awoka ne mɔ azo,
ɔboalekɛ medame, Ɛdɛnkɛma, meva ɛya,
na mekpo me menli ne.
30“Ɔluakɛ Dwudama ɛyɛ ɛtane ɛtia me. Bɛzie bɛ bɛkyi ninyɛne ne mɔ wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne mɔɔ bɛfa me duma bɛfɛlɛ ye la anu, bɛva evinli bɛha ye. 31 Wɔ Henɛm Bɔnza ne anu, bɛzi azukponle na bɛdo ye Tofɛte, amaa bɛayela bɛ mra mrenya nee bɛ mra mraalɛ bɛabɔ azu wɔ senle ne anu. Meanze bɛ kɛ bɛyɛ ɛhye, yɛɛ yeamba me adwenle nu bɔbɔ. 32Yemɔti bɛnlea, mekɛ ɛlɛba mɔɔ bɛnrɛvɛlɛ ye Tofɛte anzɛɛ Henɛm Bɔnza bieko a. Bɛbavɛlɛ ye Ahunleɛ Bɔnza, ɔluakɛ bɛbazie avunli ɛkɛ. Bɛnrɛnyia ɛleka bɛnrɛzie avunli kɛ ɛkɛ ne ala. 33Na menli ne avunli bayɛ anwomanyunlu nloma nee azɛlɛ ye azo nanemgbole aleɛ, bɛnrɛnyia awie ɛnrɛvoa bɛ. 34 Azɛlɛ ne bahakyi ɛsɛlɛ. Wɔ Dwuda azuamgbole ne mɔ azo nee Gyɛlusalɛm gua ne mɔ azo, anyelielɛ, fɛlɛkolilɛ, yɛɛ atɔfolɛ o, awie ɛnrɛde bie ɛlɛ. Azɛlɛ ne badɔ mgbane.

Title: GYƐ 8
Content:
1“Mekɛ zɔhane bɛbaza Dwuda arelemgbunli, Dwuda mgbanyima, ye sɛlɛvolɛma, ye Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma, yɛɛ Gyɛlusalɛm ezuavolɛ mbowule bɛagua zolɛ. 2Kɛ bɛkɛhuohua bɛ nloa bɛkɛzie bɛ la, bɛbado mbowule bɛazande azɛlɛ ne anwo. Bɛbagua ɛkɛ, amaa sɛnzɛne ne, siane ne, yɛɛ anwumaneamra kɔsɔɔti mɔɔ bɛhulole bɛ, bɛbɔle bɛ ti aze bɛmanle bɛ, bɛkpondɛle bɛ, bɛlile bɛ nzi na bɛzonlenle bɛ la anwu bɛ. 3Menli mɔɔ baha munzule abusua ekpulike ɛhye anu, mɔɔ wɔ ɛleka biala mɔɔ mevoa bɛ mehɔgua la bahulo kɛ bɛkɛwu tɛla kɛ bɛkɛdɛnla ngoane nu. Medame Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.”
Ɛtane nee ndeanlɛ
4Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me kɛ, “Biza menli ne kɛ saa sonla tɔ aze a, ɔndwazo ɔ? Saa sonla fo adenle a ɔnzia ɔ nzi ɔ? 5Na duzu ati a akee menli ɛhye mɔ agyakɛ ɛzia bɔkɔɔ na bɛnzia bɛmba ɛ? Bɛdi adalɛ nzi; bɛngulo kɛ bɛsia. 6Megyele me nzo medie bɛ edwɛkɛhanlɛ, na biala ɛnga nɔhalɛ. Bɛ nuhua ko bɔbɔ ɛtɛnunle ɔ nwo wɔ ye amumuyɛ ne anwo; mɔɔ ɔka la a le kɛ, ‘Duzu a meyɛ a?’ Awie biala ati ɛmi nyɛleɛ mɔɔ ɔlɛyɛ la anu kɛ ɛkpɔnwɔ mɔɔ ɛlɛkɔ konle la. 7Akoso bɔbɔ mɔɔ lua anwomanyunlu la ze ye mekɛ; yɛɛ mɔlɔnoma, nyamenleakatiba, yɛɛ azuazuanloma ze bɛ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛsia bɛba a, noko me menli ne ɛnze medame Ɛdɛnkɛma me mɛla ne. 8Kɛ bɛsi bɛkola bɛka kɛ, ‘Yɛze nrɛlɛbɛ, yɛɛ yɛze Ɛdɛnkɛma mɛla ne’ ɛ? Bɛnlea, mɛla kɛlɛhɛlɛvolɛma adalɛ ɛhakyi mɛla ne. 9Nrɛlɛbɛvolɛma anyunlu bagua aze. Bɛ adwenle baha abɔ nu na bɛahye bɛ. Nea, bɛkpo medame Ɛdɛnkɛma me nloa edwɛkɛ; na duzu nrɛlɛbɛ bɔbɔ a bɛze a? 10 Yemɔti mebava bɛ ye mɔ meamaa mrenya fofolɛ, na meava bɛ egyinli ne mɔ meamaa menli mɔɔ bali bɛ nwo zo konim la, ɔluakɛ bɛ mgbanyinli nee bɛ ngakula kɔsɔɔti ɛlɛkpondɛ ezukoa anyebolo nu. Ɔvi Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma anwo zo mɔɔ badwu sɛlɛvolɛma anwo zo la, biala ɛnli nɔhalɛ. 11 Bɛlɛmia me menli ne mɔ nganlɛ ne mɔ a bɛdoɔloa bɛ ala. Bɛse, ‘Yehɔ, yehɔ,’ wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ nganlɛ ne mɔ ɛtɛkɔle la. 12Asoo bɛkyi ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ ɛyɛlɛ yɛle bɛ nyiane? Kyɛkyɛ, yeanyɛ bɛ nyiane fee, ɔluakɛ bɛnze nyiane deɛ holɛ. Yemɔti bɛbawu kɛ menli mɔɔ ɛwu la. Kenle mɔɔ menwɔze kɛ metea bɛ la, ɛnee bɛ awieleɛ ne ala ɛne. Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.”
13Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Mengulole kɛ menwɔboɔboa bɛ nloa, na menwunle kɛ bɛle kɛ vanye baka, anzɛɛ feege baka mɔɔ ma ɛnle zolɛ la, bɛ nya ne mɔ bɔbɔ ɛnwosonwoso, yɛɛ mɔɔ menvale memanle bɛ la ɛkpa bɛ ti.”
14Nyamenle menli ne bizale kɛ, “Duzu ati a yɛtɛte ɛke a? Bɛdwazo bɛmaa yɛhɔ azuamgbole ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛbɔ nwolɛ bane la azo yɛhɔwu yɛgua ɛkɛ. Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛ Nyamenle ne ɛbua yɛ ewule fɔlɛ kɛ yɛwu; yemaa yɛ pɔezen nzule kɛ yɛnlo, ɔboalekɛ yɛyɛ ɛtane yɛtia ye. 15Yɛ nye lale anzonudwolɛ adenle, na yeanyɛ boɛ; yɛ nye lale anwonzalɛ adenle, na bɛnlea, sulosulo a rale a. 16Yɛte kpɔvolɛma mgbɔnwɔ ne mɔ abonyi nu anwoma wɔ Dan. Saa bɛ mgbɔnwɔ nyinli ne mɔ su tea nu a azɛlɛ kpusu. Yɛ kpɔvolɛma ɛra bazɛkye azɛlɛ ne nee debie biala mɔɔ wɔ zolɛ la, bɛra bɛbabɔ suakpole ne, bɛabɔ menli mɔɔ wɔ zolɛ la abo zo.
17“Bɛnlea, memaa nwɔlɛ bɔna mɔ mɔɔ awie ɛngola bɛ sili kye la arakeka bɛ. Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.”
Gyɛlɛmaya di ye menli ne anwo nyane
18Me nyanelilɛ ɛbo zo,
yemaa menyia ahonle ewule.
19Bɛdie, ɔvi maanle ti mɔɔ kɔdwu ɔ bo la,
mete kɛ me menli ne ɛlɛsu kɛ,
“Anzɛɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛnle Zayɔn ɔ?
Zayɔn belemgbunli ne ɛnle ɛkɛ ɔ?”
Ɛdɛnkɛma buale kɛ,
“Duzu ati a bɛgua ananze mmonle bɛzonle bɛ
bɛva bɛha me ɛya ɛ?
Duzu ati a bɛzonle nyamenle
gyɛne gyɛne bɛva bɛha me ɛya ɛ?”
20Me menli ne su se kɛ,
“Ɛlobɔ ne ɛze, bɛwie bɛyɔba ne bu,
noko bɛtɛdiele yɛ ngoane.”
21Me ahonle ɛhwe,
ɔboalekɛ bɛbodɛboda me menli ne;
melɛdi nyane, me adwenle ɛha ɛbɔ nu bɔkɔɔ.
22Asoo ayile biala ɛnle Geleade?
Asoo ninsinli biala ɛnle ɛkɛ?
Duzu ati a akee bɛtɛyɛle me menli ne ayile a?

Title: GYƐ 9
Content:
1Me kunlu a anrɛɛ me ti le nzubula
na me nye monle le nzufeanvea,
anrɛɛ menwɔzu me menli mɔɔ bɛhu bɛ la
alehyenlɛ nee aledwolɛ.
2O anrɛɛ meanyia nyɛvolɛ azokoɛleɛ fienemgbole nu lɔ,
amaa meahwe me nwo meavi me menli ne anwo.
Ɔluakɛ bɛ kɔsɔɔti bɛle awuvolɛvalɛ mɛlatovoma,
bɛle menli ngunzi.
3Adalɛ ɛhu bɛ kuu;
nɔhalɛ biala ɛnle azɛlɛ ne azo,
adalɛ ngome ɛyi bɛ tɛkɛɛ.
Ɛdɛnkɛma se,
“Me menli ne bɔ munzule la ɛnee bɛbɔ,
yɛɛ bɛnze me.”
4Awie biala ɛnlea ɔ gɔnwo boɛ,
ɔmmafa ɔ rɛle ɔwula ɔ diema biala nu,
ɔluakɛ adiema biala le mɛlɛbɛla sonla,
agɔnwolɛ biala yɛ ɔ gɔnwo anwo asiayɛ.
5Awie biala bɛlɛbɛla ɔ gɔnwo,
yɛɛ awie biala ɛnga nɔhalɛ;
adalɛ ɛzɔ bɛ nloa anu,
yɛɛ bɛngyakyi bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ ɛyɛlɛ.
6Nzisi doa nzisi, yɛɛ adalɛ li adalɛ nzi.
Ɛdɛnkɛma se, ye menli ne ɛkpo ye.
7Yemɔti Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma se,
“Bɛnlea, mebadu bɛ nu evinli ne na meazɔ bɛ meanlea,
ɔluakɛ duzu bieko a ɔwɔ kɛ meyɛ a?
Bɛle me menli.
8Bɛ tafinlima yɛ nla kɛ ɛda baka;
dahuu bɛbɔ adalɛ;
bɛtendɛ agɔnwolɛ nu bɛkile bɛ gɔnwo mɔ,
noko bɛ ahonle nu, bɛdi ye ɛhunlɛ busia.
9Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, mebiza kɛ:
Ɔnle kɛ metea bɛ wɔ ninyɛndane ɛhye mɔ anwo ɔ?
Ɔnle kɛ mesenra maanle mɔɔ le zɛhae la ɔ?
10“Bɛzu bɛye awoka ne mɔ awolɛ
na bɛye fienemgbole nu adidileka ne mɔ awolɛ;
ɔboalekɛ bɛwe,
yemɔti menli ɛngɔ nu.
Ɛnɛ bɛnde nlankɛ ɛzunlɛ wɔ ɛkɛ,
nloma nee ɛzonlɛ ɛnriandi ɛhɔ.
11Mebamaa Gyɛlusalɛm ahakyi ewula edukue,
ɔbahakyi ɛzonlɛ dabelɛ.
Mebamaa Dwuda azuamgbole adɔ mgbane,
awie ɛnrɛdɛnla ɛkɛ.”
12Nwane a ze nrɛlɛbɛ mɔɔ kɛhola kɛde ɛhye abo a? Nwane a Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛva ɛwula ɔ nloa kɛ ɔbɔ ye nolo a? Duzu ati a azɛlɛ ne ɛzɛkye ɛdɔ mgbane kɛ fienemgbole, mɔɔ yemɔti awie ɛmpe zolɛ a?
13Ɛdɛnkɛma buale kɛ, “Ɛhye ɛzi, ɔboalekɛ bɛkpo me mɛla mɔɔ meva memaa bɛ la, yɛɛ bɛandie me ne, bɛanli zolɛ. 14Bɛli bɛ ahonle nzi anzosesebɛ nu bɛzonle awozonle Beeyale ne mɔ, kɛmɔ bɛ ze mɔ hilele bɛ la. 15Yemɔti bɛdie mɔɔ medame, Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne mebayɛ la: Mebamaa me menli ne mbaka ɛnwonle meamaa bɛali na meamaa bɛ nzule mɔɔ le pɔezen la bɛanlo. 16Mebakponde bɛ wɔ maanle maanle mɔɔ bɛdabɛ anzɛɛ bɛ ze mɔ bɔbɔ ɛtɛtele bɛ aluma ɛlɛ la azo; mebamaa ɛlɔnema ara bɛ nwo zo toonwo kɔkpula kɛ menwɔwie bɛ bo zo bɔ la.”
Gyɛlusalɛmma su abiza moalɛ
17Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma se,
“Bɛdwenle mɔɔ ɛlɛsisi la anwo!
Bɛvɛlɛ mraalɛ mɔɔ su ye awolɛ la,
mraalɛ mɔɔ to ɛzɛne edwɛne la.”
18Menli ne hanle kɛ,
“Bɛmaa bɛrɛla ndɛndɛ, bɛrazu bɛvua yɛ,
bɛye awolɛ bɛmaa yɛhwi monle,
na yɛ nye abo ɛyɛ monle monle.”
19Ɔluakɛ ɛzunlɛ ɛde Zayɔn,
na bɛlɛka kɛ, “Yɛwu o!
Yɛbɔ anyiemgba bɔkɔɔ,
ɔboalekɛ yɛvi azɛlɛ ne azo yɛdu,
ɔboalekɛ bɛbubu yɛ azua ne mɔ.”
20Bɛmɛ mraalɛ, bɛdie Ɛdɛnkɛma edwɛkɛ ne,
bɛyɛ ɛnzonlɛ bɛdie ɔ nloa edwɛkɛ ne kpalɛ.
Bɛhilehile bɛ mra mraalɛ awolɛyelɛ,
na bɛhilehile bɛ gɔnwo mɔ ɛzɛne edwɛne.
21Ewule ɛlua yɛ nvɛnzɛlɛ ne mɔ anu
ɛra yɛ azua nu;
yehu ngakula mɔɔ wɔ awɔdenle ne mɔ azo
nee mgbavolɛ mɔɔ wɔ ɛleka kpatawienyi ne mɔ la.
22Se bɛ kɛ, Ɛdɛnkɛma se:
“Azɛlɛ ne azo bayɛ avunli ngome
kɛ nyɛmoa ebinli mɔɔ ɛyɛ totɔɔ wɔ ɛya avule ne mɔ anu la,
kɛ ma mɔɔ bɛde bɛkyekye bɛ avile bɛgua,
na menli ɛnle ɛkɛ mɔɔ soa la.”
23Ɛdɛnkɛma se,
“Nrɛlɛbɛvolɛma mmafa bɛ nrɛlɛbɛ ne tu bɛ nwo,
anwosesebɛma mmafa bɛ anwosesebɛ ne tu bɛ nwo,
yɛɛ sukoavolɛma mmafa bɛ anwonyia ne tu bɛ nwo.
24 Saa awie ɛlɛtu ɔ nwo a,
ɔdu ɔ nwo kɛ ɔze me na ɔte me edwɛkɛ bo,
kɛ mame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a.
Me ɛhulolɛ ne gyi kpundii,
yɛɛ meyɛ mɔɔ le pɛpɛ nee fɔɔnwo.
Ɛhye mɔ a sɔ me nye a.
Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.”
25-26Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Mekɛ ne ɛlɛba mɔɔ mebadea Yigyibitima, Dwudama, Yidɔmma, Amɔnoma, Mowabema, yɛɛ ɛsɛlɛ zo amra mɔɔ kpa bɛ nwoma azo enrinli la. Menli ɛhye mɔ amuala ɛyɛ bɛ mrenyanu nzonlɛ, noko bɛnli ngyekyeleɛ ne mɔɔ kile kɛ bɛyɛ bɛ mrenyanu nzonlɛ la azo. Maanle maanle ɛhye mɔ nee Yizilayɛma biala ɛnli me ngyekyeleɛ ne azo.”

Title: GYƐ 10
Content:
Mmonle ɛzonlenlɛ yɛɛ nɔhalɛ ɛzonlenlɛ
1Yizilayɛma, bɛdie edwɛkɛ mɔɔ
Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛlɛka ahile bɛ la.
2Ɔse,
“Bɛmmasukoa maanle maanle ne mɔ nyɛleɛ ne mɔ;
maanle maanle ne mɔ ahonle tu anwomanyunlu
sɛkɛlɛneɛ ne mɔ anwo,
na bɛmɛ, bɛmmamaa bɛ ahonle tu nwolɛ.
3Menli ɛhye mɔ nyamenlezonlenlɛ le mgbane.
Bɛpɛ baka ɛbɔ nu;
na dwinvolɛ fa ye mbulalɛ ne se,
4na bɛfa dwɛtɛ fufule nee ezukoa nvutuke bɛfɔle nwolɛ.
Bɛfa pɛlɛko bɛbobɔ nu
amaa bɛandudu bɛangua
noko nea, bɛsonle abaaba ɛhye mɔ.
5Abaaba ɛhye mɔ le kɛ ahule nu ananze,
bɛngola bɛndendɛ;
ɔwɔ kɛ bɛsoa bɛ,
ɔboalekɛ bɛngola bɛndia.
Bɛmmasulo bɛ,
ɔluakɛ bɛngola bɛnyɛ bɛ ɛhwee,
yɛɛ bɛngola bɛnyɛ debie kpalɛ.”
6O Ɛdɛnkɛma, awie nee wɔ ɛnzɛ;
ɛle bedevinli, wɔ duma ne le kpole, tumi wɔ nu.
7 Maanle maanle Belemgbunli, nwane a ɛnzulo wɔ a?
Enililɛ le wɔ ɛdeɛ.
Maanle maanle ne mɔ anu nrɛlɛbɛvolɛma o,
bɛ nuhua arelemgbunli o,
ko bɔbɔ nee wɔ ɛnzɛ.
8Bɛle ahɔnwɔne, bɛle ahoasea.
Abaaba ne mɔ ngilehilelɛ le mgbane.
9Bɛva dwɛtɛ fufule mɔɔ vi Sepeen la
bɛfɔle abaaba ne mɔ anwo,
bɛva ezukoa nvutuke mɔɔ
vi Ɛfaze la bɛfɔle nwo,
bɛle dwinvolɛ asa anloa gyima.
Bɛva arelemgbunli ɛdanlɛ anye buluwu nee kɔkɔlɛ
yɛɛ akɔlɛ ɛnlome nee kɔkɔlɛ bɛheda bɛ;
menli mɔɔ ze adwinli la a nwonle ɛdanlɛ ne a.
10Na wɔmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma, ɛle nɔhalɛ Nyamenle;
wɔmɔ a ɛle tease Nyamenle nee Damɛnlangoate
Belemgbunli ne a.
Saa ɔfa ɛya a azɛlɛ kpusu.
Maanle maanle ɛngola ye ɛya nloa gyinla.
11(Se bɛ kɛ, “Bɛbazɛkye awozonle ne mɔ mɔɔ tɛ bɛmɛ a bɛbɔle anwuma nee aze la. Bɛnrɛnyia ewiade ye ɛleka biala bɛnrɛdɛnla.”)
Nyamenle ayɛlɛyelɛ edwɛne
12Ɛdɛnkɛma vale ye tumi a bɔle azɛlɛ ye a,
ɔvale ye nrɛlɛbɛ a ɔbɔle ewiade a,
ɔvale ye ndelebɛbo a ɔbɔle anwomanyunlu a.
13Saa ɔtea nu a anwomanyunlu nzule yɛ begyebegye;
ɔmaa amungu kye ewiade ɛleka biala.
Ɔmaa ezule fedevede na
ɔmaa ahumu tu.
14Wɔ ɔ nyunlu, awie biala le kɔnwɔne, yɛɛ
ɔnlɛ adwenle;
ezukoa dwinvolɛ biala ananze mɔɔ ɔkɛyɛ la
gua ɔdaye mumua ne ɔ nyunlu aze,
ɔluakɛ ye ananze ne mɔ mɔɔ ɔyɛ la
le adalɛ, ngoane ɛnle bɛ nu.
15Nvasoɛ ɛnle bɛ nwo zo, bɛfa bɛto agyiba;
saa bɛ ndeanlɛ mekɛ ne dwu a bɛbazɛkye bɛ.
16Gyekɔbo Nyamenle ne ɛnle kɛ
nyamenle ɛhye mɔ,
ɔluakɛ yemɔ a ɔbɔle ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti a,
yɛɛ Yizilayɛ abusua ekpunli ne le ye agyadeɛ:
ye duma a le Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma.
Bɛbahye Yizilayɛma bɛahɔ nlɔnu
17O Yizilayɛma mɔɔ bɛva bɛ aze a, bɛhuohua bɛ nwo. 18Ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Bɛnlea, mekɛ ye anu ala mefuandi bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛde azɛlɛ ɛhye azo la kɔsɔɔti meagua. Mebamaa bɛanwu bɛ nyunlu meamaa yeade bɛ kpalɛ.”
19Yizilayɛma zunle zele kɛ,
“Abule ɛbu yɛ, ɔboalekɛ yɛboda!
Yɛ nganlɛ ne mɔ ɛlɛkile yɛ nyane,
na ɔwɔ kɛ yɛdi ye yɛ kunlu.
20Bɛzɛkye yɛ ndanlɛ azua ne mɔ,
nyɛma mɔɔ dedɛ bɛ la amuala ɛtete.
Yɛ mra ne mɔ vi yɛ nwo ɛdu,
bie ɛnle ɛke mɔɔ kɛzi yɛ
ndanlɛ azua ne mɔ bieko a,
bie ɛnle ɛke mɔɔ kɛva mgbɛnu
ndanlɛ ne mɔ kɛhendɛhenda a.”
21Membuale kɛ, “Yɛ mgbanyima
ne mɔ le ahɔnwɔne;
bɛyɛ debie a bɛmbiza Ɛdɛnkɛma moalɛ.
Yemɔti a bɛamkpazi,
na bɛbɔ yɛ menli ne asande la.
22Bɛdie! Yɛde edwɛkɛ bie!
Basabasa vi sɔlɔ maanle bie anu
ɛlɛba arabɔ Dwuda azuamgbole ne mɔ,
yeamaa bɛayɛ azuadu;
bɛbayɛ ɛzonlɛ dabelɛ.”
23O Ɛdɛnkɛma, meze kɛ sonla ɔdaye ɔnlɛ ɔ nwo;
sonla ɔdaye ɔnlɛ ye ngoane zo tumi.
24O Ɛdɛnkɛma, tea me,
noko anrɛɛ suzu,
mmafa ɛya ɛtea me,
anrɛɛ me awieleɛ ne ala ɛne.
25Wola wɔ ɛya ne gua maanle maanle mɔɔ ɛnze wɔ,
nee menli mɔɔ ɛnzonle wɔ la anwo zo;
bɛhu wɔ menli ne;
bɛbɔ Gyekɔbo abo zo amra abo zo tɔɔ;
bɛmaa bɛ maanle ne ɛdɔ mgbane.

Title: GYƐ 11
Content:
Gyɛlɛmaya nee Ngyekyeleɛ ne
1Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Gyɛlɛmaya kɛ, 2“Gyɛlɛmaya, tie ngyekyeleɛ ne anu edwɛkɛ agbɔkɛ ne mɔ na ka kile Dwudama nee Gyɛlusalɛmma. 3Ka kile bɛ kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne se: Munzule baha awie biala mɔɔ anli ngyekyeleɛ ɛhye azo la. 4Ɔle ngyekyeleɛ mɔɔ me nee bɛ ze mɔ kyekyele wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ me nee bɛ vi Yigyibiti maanle ne mɔɔ le kɛ senle tandane la anu rale la. Menzele bɛ kɛ bɛdie me ne na bɛyɛ mɔɔ menwɔze bɛ la amuala. Saa bɛyɛ ɛhye a bɛbayɛ me menli, na medame meayɛ bɛ Nyamenle. 5Na mebali ɛwɔkɛ ne mɔɔ membɔle bɛ ze mɔ kɛ mebava azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ kye aleɛ, mɔɔ kɛkala bɛde zolɛ la meamaa bɛ la azo.”
Membuale kɛ, “Ɛdɛnkɛma, maa ɔyɛ zɔhane.”
6Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me kɛ, “Kɔbɔ edwɛkɛ ɛhye nolo wɔ Dwuda azuamgbole ne mɔ nee Gyɛlusalɛm guabile ne mɔ amuala azo kɛ: Bɛdie ngyekyeleɛ ne anu edwɛkɛ na bɛli zolɛ. 7Ɔluakɛ mekɛ mɔɔ me nee bɛ ze mɔ vi Yigyibiti rale la, membɔle bɛ kɔkɔ ɛsesebɛ kɛ bɛdie me, na mehɔ zolɛ mehakye bɛ toonwo a yeradwu ɛnɛ a. 8Noko bɛandie, yɛɛ bɛanli zolɛ. Ko biala ɔdaye ɔyɛle ɛtane mɔɔ ɔ kunlu dwo nwolɛ la. Yemɔti menvale ndeanlɛ kɔsɔɔti mɔɔ bɛhile wɔ ngyekyeleɛ ne anu la mendeanle bɛ, noko bɛampili.”
9Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me bieko kɛ, “Nea, Dwudama nee Gyɛlusalɛmma ɛde atua. 10Bɛlɛyɛ bɛ ze mɔ mɔɔ kpole kɛ bɛnrɛdie me ne la ɛtane ne mɔ bie; bɛzonle nyamenle gyɛne gyɛne. Yizilayɛma nee Dwudama ɛtulu ngyekyeleɛ ne mɔɔ me nee bɛ ze mɔ kyekyele la. 11Yemɔti, medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, bɛnlea, memaa munzule ado bɛ. 12Saa munzule ɛhye to Dwudama nee Gyɛlusalɛmma a, bɛbahɔzu bɛazɛlɛ moalɛ wɔ nyamenle ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛkpu ɛyɛlɛ bɛmaa bɛ la ɛkɛ, noko bɛ nyamenle ne mɔ ɛnrɛhola bɛ die. 13Dwudama nyamenle ne mɔ ɛzo kɛ bɛ azuamgbole ne mɔ ala la, yɛɛ Gyɛlusalɛmma azukponle mɔɔ ɛsisi, mɔɔ bɛkpu ɛyɛlɛ zolɛ bɛmaa bozonle Beeyale la ɛzo kɛ bɛ awɔdenle ne mɔ la. Bɛva bɛgua bɛ nyunlu aze. 14Yemɔti Gyɛlɛmaya, mmasɛlɛ ɛmaa menli ɛhye mɔ anzɛɛ mmabodo ɛmaa bɛ wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ngyegyelɛ kɛdo bɛ la, ɔluakɛ menrɛdie bɛ.
15“Menli mɔɔ mekulo bɛ la ɛlɛyɛ amumuyɛ ninyɛne. Duzu adenle a bɛlɛ kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛba me Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu a? Bɛdwenle kɛ saa bɛbɔ ɛwɔkɛ dɔɔnwo dɔɔnwo na bɛfa nane bɛbɔ azu a ɛnee munzule ɛndo bɛ ɔ? Ɛhye kɛmaa bɛ nye kɛlie ɔ? 16Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma menvɛlɛle bɛ ‘ɔlivi baka buzuu mɔɔ lɛ ma ngɛnlɛma’ la. Na kɛkala, mekulu kokye meado senle nu meayela ye nya ne mɔ wee meamaa ye ngane ne mɔ abubu agua.
17“Medame Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma a menluale bɛ kɛ mbaka a. Noko melɛsɛkye bɛ, ɔluakɛ bɛmɛ Yizilayɛma nee Dwudama, bɛyɛ ɛtane. Bɛkpu ɛyɛlɛ bɛbɔ azu bɛmaa bozonle Beeyale bɛva bɛha me ɛya.”
Bɛbɔ adwenle bɛahu Gyɛlɛmaya
18Ɛdɛnkɛma yele hilele me kɛ me kpɔvolɛma ɛlɛbɔ me nwo adwenle ahu me. 19Ɛnee mele kɛ boane ralɛ mɔɔ ɛnze nwolɛ bie na bɛ nee ye ɛlɛkɔ ahunleɛ la. Menze kɛ mame a bɛlɛdwenle me nwo adwenle ɛtane la. Ɛnee bɛlɛka kɛ, “Bɛmaa yɛzɛkye baka ne nee ye ma ne mɔ amuala. Bɛmaa yɛpɛ ye yɛvi azɛlɛ ne azo, amaa awie angakye ye bieko.”
20Yemɔti Gyɛlɛmaya zɛlɛle kɛ, “Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, ɛle ndɛnebuavolɛ mɔɔ di pɛlepɛle a; ɛneɛnlea menli ahonle nee bɛ adwenle nu. Me edwɛkɛ ye wɔ ɛ sa nu. Senra menli ɛhye mɔ maa me.”
21Ɛnee Anato ezuavolɛ ne kulo kɛ bɛku me. Bɛduale me kɛ memmabɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma nrɛlaleɛ ne nolo, anrɛɛ bɛkɛhu me. 22Yemɔti Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Mebadea bɛ! Bɛ mgbavolɛ badɔ konle nu; bɛ mra mrenya nee bɛ mra mraalɛ bawu ɛhɔne nu. Bɛ bo zo babɔ. 23Mebamaa munzule ado Anatoma. Mekɛ ne dwu a, bɛ biala fee ɛnrɛha.”

Title: GYƐ 12
Content:
Gyɛlɛmaya biza Ɛdɛnkɛma edwɛkɛ
1O Ɛdɛnkɛma, kanza mebɔ wɔ somolɛ bɔbɔ a,
wɔmɔ, ɛdi benle.
Noko mesɛlɛ wɔ meava me edwɛkɛ meado ɛ nyunlu.
Duzu ati a amumuyɛma kpazi ɛ?
Duzu ati a menli mɔɔ ɛnli nɔhalɛ la wie boɛ ɛ?
2Ɛdua bɛ, na bɛsɔ ndinli;
bɛnyi na bɛso ma.
Bɛ nloa anu a, ɛbikye bɛ kpalɛ,
noko bɛ ahonle nu a, ɛmbikye bɛ.
3Na wɔmɔ, O Ɛdɛnkɛma, ɛze me;
ɛnwu me, yɛɛ ɛsɔ adwenle mɔɔ melɛ ye ɛ nwo la ɛnea.
Twili amumuyɛma ɛhye mɔ kɛ mboane mɔɔ bɛkahu bɛ la,
fa bɛ sie kɔdwu kenle mɔɔ bɛku bɛ la.
4Yɛ azɛlɛ ye ɛzɛkye ɛhyɛ;
ndile mɔɔ wɔ zo la kɔsɔɔti ɛyela.
Nyɛmoa nee nloma ɛlɛwu,
wɔ menli mɔɔ de zo la amumuyɛ ti,
ɔboalekɛ menli ka kɛ,
“Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛnrɛnwu mɔɔ yɛlɛyɛ la.”
5Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me kɛ,
“Gyɛlɛmaya, saa ɛ nee menli ɛzu ɛnriandilɛ na wɔangola bɛ a,
kɛ ɛsi ɛkola ɛ nee mgbɔnwɔ su ɛnriandilɛ ɛ?
Na saa ɛlua azɛlɛ wienyi zo wɔdu wɔdɔ a,
ɛnee saa ɛlua Dwɔdan kpɔkɛmile nu a, kɛ ɛkɛyɛ ɛ?
6Ɔluakɛ ɛdawɔ ɛ mediema nee ɛ ze sua nu amra
nee wɔ ɛli ye ngunzi nu,
bɛboka menli mɔɔ ɛlɛyɛ wɔ la.
Bɛ nloa anu menlemenle,
noko mmadie bɛ ɛdi.”
Ɛdɛnkɛma di ye menli ne anwo nyane
7Ɛdɛnkɛma se,
“Megyakyi Yizilayɛma anzi ɛlilɛ;
mekpo me agyadeɛ ne.
Meye menli ne mɔɔ la me ahonle nwo la
mewula bɛ kpɔvolɛma asa anu.
8Menli ne mɔɔ le me agyadeɛ la
ɛhakyi me nwo kpɔkɛmile nu awenade;
ɛkpolɛ ala a bɛkpo me a,
yemɔti mekyi bɛ.
9Menli ne mɔɔ le me agyadeɛ la
ɛyɛ kɛ anloma ndeta mɔɔ sianza dɔɔnwo ɛbɔ ɛyia ye la.
Bɛhɔ bɛhɔboɔboa nanemgbole kɔsɔɔti anloa
kɛ bɛrali aleɛ.
10Mboaneneavolɛma dɔɔnwo ɛzɛkye
me vanye egyinli ne,
bɛtietia me vanye mbaka ne mɔ azo,
bɛmaa me azɛlɛ kɛnlɛma ne ɛhakyi ɛsɛlɛ.
11Bɛzɛkye azɛlɛ ne, bɛyɛ ye mgbane bɛdo ɛkɛ;
yezɛkye ɔla ɛkɛ ɔlɛkendɛ me.
Azɛlɛ ne amuala ɛhakyi ɛsɛlɛ,
na ɔnvane awie biala anwo.
12Menli ɛra ɛsɛlɛ ne awoka ne mɔ azo,
bɛzɛkye ɛkɛ kɔsɔɔti;
ɔluakɛ medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, me dadeɛ ɛlɛdi gyima
wɔ azɛlɛ ne azo kɔsɔɔti;
awie biala ɛnlɛ anzonudwolɛ.
13Me menli ne ɛgua hwiiti, na bɛde mbowundile;
bɛvɛ toonwo, na bɛvua asakpane.
Ɔlua me ɛya kpole ne ati,
bɛ bɛyɔba bayɛ anyiemgba.”
Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛwɔkɛ mɔɔ ɔbɔle maanle maanle mɔɔ zuozua Yizilayɛ la
14Edwɛkɛ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma hanle wɔ kpɔvolɛma mɔɔ nee ye menli Yizilayɛma bɔ ɛweɛne na bɛfa bɛ sa bɛka agyadeɛ mɔɔ yeva yemaa ye menli Yizilayɛma kɛ bɛ ɛdeɛ ɔ la anwo la ɛne: Ɔse, “Bɛnlea, mebadu bɛ meavi bɛ maanle ne mɔ anu, na meaye Dwudama meavi bɛ nu. 15Saa metu bɛ zɔhane a, nzinlii mebanwu bɛ anwunvɔne, na mebava bɛ meazia meara bɛ azɛlɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ le bɛ agyadeɛ la azo. 16Na ɔbara kɛ, saa bɛbafa me menli ne agyakɛ bɛbɔ me duma bɛdi amonle kɛ, ‘Kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma de aze la.’ kɛmɔ bɛmanle Yizilayɛma vale bɛ bozonle Beeyale ne hanle ndane la a, bɛ nee me menli ne badɛnla na bɛakpazi. 17Na maanle biala mɔɔ andie me ne la, mebadu ye meabɔ ɔ bo zo. Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.”

Title: GYƐ 13
Content:
Lenen abɛlako ne
1Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me kɛ, “Kɔdɔ lenen abɛlako na mo; anrɛɛ mmawula ye nzule nu.” 2Yemɔti mendɔle abɛlako ne na memonle, kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me ala la. 3Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me bieko kɛ, 4“Ye abɛlako ne mɔɔ wɔdɔ wɔmo la kɔvea bolɛ tokule bie anu wɔ Azule Yufileti ne anloa.” 5Yemɔti menvale mengɔnveale Yufileti ne anloa, kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me la.
6Mekɛ guale nu la Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me kɛ, “Sia kɔ Yufileti ne anloa kɔye abɛlako ne mɔɔ memanle ɛvale ɛhɔveale lɔ la.” 7Mengɔle Yufileti ne anloa mengɔnvunle menyele abɛlako ne. Na nea, ɛnee yezɛkye bɔkɔɔ; ɛfa ye fee a ɔnva.
8Akee Ɛdɛnkɛma dendɛle zele me kɛ, 9“Kɛ medame Ɛdɛnkɛma mebazi meazɛkye Dwudama adubɛnwo ne nee Gyɛlusalɛmma adubɛnwo ne la ɛne. 10Amumuyɛma ɛhye mɔ ɛdu bɛ gye kɛ bɛnrɛdie me ne. Bɛli bɛ ahonle ɛtane nzi na bɛzonle nyamenle gyɛne gyɛne bɛbɔ bɛ ti aze bɛmaa bɛ. Yemɔti bɛbayɛ kɛ abɛlako ne mɔɔ ɛfa ɛyɛ ɛhwee a ɔnyɛ boɛ la. 11Kɛmɔ abɛlako kyekye sonla bo kɛnlɛma la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ mekulo kɛ Yizilayɛma nee Dwudama amuala kɛbeta me kyengye a. Menyɛle bɛ zɔhane, amaa bɛayɛ me menli, mɔɔ ɔlua bɛ nwo zo bɛbabɔ me duma, bɛayeyɛ me, na bɛawula me anyunlunyia; noko bɛandie me ne.”
Nwanye dwora ne
12Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me kɛ, “Ka kile bɛ kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne se: Bɛgua nwanye wɔ nwanye dwora ko biala anu bɛmaa ɔyi. Bɛbaha bɛahile wɔ kɛ bɛze kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛgua nwanye wɔ dwora ko biala anu bɛmaa ɔyi; 13na bua bɛ kɛ, Ɛdɛnkɛma se: Bɛnlea, mebaye nzabolɛ meado menli mɔɔ de azɛlɛ ye azo la kɔsɔɔti anwo: Arelemgbunli mɔɔ di Devidi ebia ne bie, sɛlɛvolɛma, Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma, yɛɛ Gyɛlusalɛmma amuala banlo nwanye abo. 14Na mebava bɛ ti meafifi nwo ngoko, selɛ nee mralɛ mrenya amuala, medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a. Menrɛze anwunvɔne yɛɛ menrɛvavi bie fee; yɛɛ menrɛnyia ahunluyelɛyelalɛ kɛ akee menrɛzɛkye bɛ.”
Gyɛlɛmaya bɔ adubɛnwo nwo kɔkɔ
15Yizilayɛma, bɛdie na Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛdendɛ!
Bɛmmamemaa bɛ nwo zo.
16Bɛwula Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne anyunlunyia
kolaa na yeamaa awozinli ava bɛ,
na bɛandu koti wɔ awoka ne mɔ azo,
amaa saa bɛkpondɛ wienyi a
yeangakyi awozinli kabii.
17Na saa bɛnrɛdie me ne a,
mebavea meazu wɔ bɛ adubɛnwo ne ati,
mebaye awolɛ meahwi monle kpalɛ,
ɔboalekɛ bɛhye Ɛdɛnkɛma menli ne nuokɛ.
18Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me kɛ, “Ka kile belemgbunli ne nee ɔ nli kɛ bɛvi bɛ mbia ne mɔ azo bɛdwu aze, na bɛ abɔtile ngɛnlɛma ne mɔ vi bɛ ti ɛdu ɛgua. 19Bɛtoto Dwuda nyiakɛ azuamgbole ne mɔ nlenkɛ ne mɔ anu; awie ɛngola bɛ buke. Bɛvula Dwudama amuala, bɛva bɛ kɔsɔɔti bɛhɔ nlɔnu.”
20Gyɛlusalɛmma, bɛnlea! Kɛ bɛ kpɔvolɛma vi sɔlɔ nehane ɛlɛba ɛ! Nienwu a mboane ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛvale bɛ bɛwulale bɛ sa nu la wɔ a? Bɛ mboane ngɛnlɛma ne hale nienwu? 21Saa bɛfa menli mɔɔ bɛmɛ bɛvale bɛ kɛ konle nu agɔnwolɛma la bie bɛsie bɛ kpanyinli a, bɛmɛ Yizilayɛma, duzu edwɛkɛ a bɛkɛha a? Asoo bɛ nwo ɛnrɛfofo bɛ, bɛnrɛde nyane kɛ raalɛ mɔɔ ɛvo awolɛ zo la? 22Saa bɛbiza bɛ nwo ngoko kɛ, “Duzu ati a edwɛkɛ ɛhye mɔ ɛsisi me nwo zo a,” anrɛɛ bɛbanwu kɛ bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ ɛyɛ kpole, ɛye bɛ nwo zo ɛya, na bɛdua bɛ kakɛ. 23Asoo sonla bile kola kakyi ye bile ne, anzɛɛ sobolɛ mɔɔ ɛtane ala a bɛdi la, bɛdabɛ noko bɛkola bɛdi boɛ. 24Mebabɔ bɛ asande kɛ abonle mɔɔ ɛsɛlɛ zo anwoma ɛlɛbɔ ye la. 25Mɔɔ mehyehyɛ kɛ mefa meayɛ bɛ la ɛne. Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a, ɔboalekɛ bɛkpo me na bɛhɔli adalɛ nzi. 26Medame mumua ne mebaye bɛ nwo zo ɛya meamaa nyiane ahu bɛ. 27Menwu bɛ bɛkyi ninyɛne mɔɔ bɛyɛ, bɛ awuvolɛvalɛ, nee bɛ huhunliyɛlɛ, yɛɛ bɛ tuutuulilɛ wɔ ɛbɔ nu awoka zo. Gyɛlusalɛmma, abule ɛbu bɛ! Kenlenzu bɔbɔ yɛɛ bɛkɛmaa bɛ nwo kɛde a?

Title: GYƐ 14
Content:
Nzule ɛhɔne mekɛ kpole ne
1Edwɛkɛ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma hanle wɔ nzule ɛhɔne ne anwo hilele Gyɛlɛmaya la ɛne:
2“Dwuda ɛlɛdi nyane,
ye azuamgbole ne mɔ ɛlɛbɔ,
ye menli weweɛ bɛ nwo aze ye awolɛ,
Gyɛlusalɛmma ɛlɛsu kpole.
3Menli mɔɔ de boɛ la soa bɛ ngɛkɛlɛ kɛ bɛhɔ azule;
bɛba azule ne mɔ azo a bɛnnyia nzule;
bɛfa dwora ne mɔ mgbane bɛsia.
Nyiane ku bɛ, bɛ adwenle ka bɔ nu
na bɛkeda bɛ ti zo.
4Kɛmɔ ezule ɛndɔ
na azɛlɛ nwo ɛwe resee la,
nyiane ɛlɛku ɛyazonlɛma
na ɔmaa bɛkeda bɛ ti zo.
5Ndile ɛnfifi,
yemɔti weɛlɛ mɔɔ la kpɔkɛ nu la
nriandi gyakyi ɔ ra adɔma.
6Ɛbɔ nu asoaso fo gyinla awoka ne mɔ azo,
bɛdie ɛnwomenle ndɛndɛ kɛ ɛzonlɛ,
bɛ nye zo yɛ kisii,
ɔboalekɛ bɛnnyia ndile bɛnli.
7Akee me menli ne bazu avɛlɛ me kɛ,
‘Yɛ ɛtane ne mɔ ɛbu ɛzia yɛ bɔbɔ ɛdeɛ,
O Ɛdɛnkɛma, keha ɛ nwo wɔ wɔ duma ne ati.
Yɛhakyi yɛ nzi yɛzi wɔ fane dɔɔnwo,
yɛyɛ ɛtane yɛtia wɔ.
8O Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ anyelazo a le wɔ,
wɔmɔ mɔɔ ɔkyele zo a ɛdie yɛ la,
duzu ati a wɔyɛ ɛ nwo ɛyɛvolɛ wɔ azɛlɛ ne azo
kɛ adendulɛnli bie mɔɔ makyi ala kenle ko ahɔ a?
9Duzu ati a wɔyɛ kɛ sonla mɔɔ ye adwenle ɛha ɛbɔ nu,
anzɛɛ wɔyɛ kɛ katakyie mɔɔ ɛngola ngoane die ɛ?
Noko O Ɛdɛnkɛma, ɛ nee yɛ de,
yɛɛ bɛfa wɔ duma a bɛfɛlɛ yɛ a;
mmagyakyi yɛ.’ ”
10Edwɛkɛ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma hanle wɔ menli ɛhye mɔ anwo la ɛne: “Bɛ kunlu dwo kɛ bɛkɛluolua nuhua zɔhane. Bɛtɛfule bɛ nwo, yemɔti medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, menrɛdɛne bɛ zo. Menea bɛ ɛtane nee bɛ amumuyɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛyɛ la anwo meadea bɛ.”
11Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me kɛ, “Anrɛɛ mmayɛ nzɛlɛlɛ wɔ menli ɛhye mɔ kpalɛyɛlɛ nwo. 12Saa bɛkye nwolɛ ɛhɔne bɔbɔ a, menrɛdie bɛ ɛzunlɛ, yɛɛ saa bɛfa ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ anzɛɛ ma azubɔdeɛ bɛba me nyunlu a, me nye ɛnrɛzɔ ye. Mebava mealua konle, ɛhɔne, yɛɛ anwonyane nu meayela bɛ wee.”
13Menganle kɛ, “Awulae Nyamenle, nrɛlaleɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma ka kile bɛ la a le kɛ, ‘Konle ɛnrɛdo bɛ; yɛɛ ɛhɔne ɛnrɛhu bɛ; anzonudwolɛ ala a mebava meamaa bɛ wɔ azɛlɛ ɛhye azo a.’ ”
14Na Ɛdɛnkɛma buale me kɛ, “Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma ne mɔ ɛlɛbɔ me duma aha adalɛ nrɛlaleɛ. Meanzoa bɛ, yɛɛ me nee bɛ andendɛ bɔbɔ. Adalɛ ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ, menli munzule ɛbɔlɛ mɔɔ nvasoɛ ɛnle zolɛ, yɛɛ bɛdabɛ bɛ ti anu a bɛbɔ bɛka ɛhye mɔ bɛkile bɛ a. 15Yemɔti medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, meka meahile bɛdabɛ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma mɔɔ lɛ me duma ɛlɛka nrɛlaleɛ, noko tɛ medame a menzoanle bɛ, na bɛka kɛ, ‘Konle nee ɛhɔne ɛnrɛra azɛlɛ ɛhye azo ɛlɛ,’ la kɛ konle nee ɛhɔne nu yɛɛ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma zɔhane badɔ a. 16Bɛbahu menli ne mɔɔ bɛka adalɛ nrɛlaleɛ ne bɛkile bɛ la noko wɔ konle nu, yɛɛ bie mɔ bawu ɛhɔne nu: bɛdabɛ, bɛ ye mɔ, bɛ mra mrenya, yɛɛ bɛ mra mraalɛ. Mebamaa bɛ munzule abɔ bɛ ti. Bɛbawu bɛagua Gyɛlusalɛm guabile zo. Bɛnrɛnyia awie ɛnrɛzie bɛ.”
17Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me kɛ menga me nyane mengile menli ne mɔ kɛ:
“Mesu meamaa monle abia me takaa
alehyenlɛ nee aledwolɛ.
Menrɛgyakyi ɛzunlɛ,
ɔluakɛ bɛbodɛboda me menli ne, bɛanzuzu bɛamboda bɛ.
18Saa mebɔ me ti ɛbɔkunlu a,
konle nu avunli ngome;
meba suakpole ne azo a,
ɛhɔne ɛlɛku menli ne agua bɛ lɔ.
Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma nee sɛlɛvolɛma ɛlɛyɛ bɛ gyima,
noko bɛnze mɔɔ bɛlɛyɛ la.”
Menli ne su abodo Ɛdɛnkɛma
19Ɛdɛnkɛma, yemɔti wɔye Dwudama bɔkɔɔ?
Asoo ɛkyi Zayɔnoma?
Duzu ati a wɔboda yɛ kpole zɛhae
mɔɔ yɛyɛ ayile a yɛ nwo ɛnza ɛ?
Yɛkpondɛle anzonudwolɛ, noko kpalɛ amba,
yɛkpondɛle anwonzalɛ, na nea, ɛzulolɛ a rale a.
20O Ɛdɛnkɛma, yɛnwu yɛ amumuyɛ mɔɔ yɛyɛ,
nee egya mɔ ɛtane mɔɔ yɛle tiale wɔ la,
ɔluakɛ yɛyɛ ɛtane yɛtia wɔ.
21Ɔlua wɔ duma ne ati, mmakpo yɛ;
mmasɛkye wɔ anyunlunyia belemgbunli ebia ne duma;
kakye yɛ na mmatulu wɔ ngyekyeleɛ ne
mɔɔ ɛ nee yɛ kyekyele la.
22Asoo maanle maanle ne mɔ nyamenle ne mɔ kola tɔ ezule?
Asoo anwomanyunlu angome kola tɔ ezule?
Tɛ wɔmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛ Nyamenle ne a tɔ ezule a?
Yɛ anyelazo a le wɔ,
ɔluakɛ ɛdawɔ a ɛyɛ ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ amuala a.

Title: GYƐ 15
Content:
Dwudama amaneɛnwunlɛ
1 Akee Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me kɛ, “Saa Mosisi nee Samoɛle bɔbɔ bagyinla me nyunlu kpa kyɛlɛ a, menrɛva menli ɛhye mɔ anwo edwɛkɛ menrɛhyɛ bɛ ɛlɛ. Ye bɛ fi me nye zo, 2 Saa bɛbiza wɔ kɛ nienwu ɛleka a bɛhɔ a, bua bɛ kɛ medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, mese:
Bɛ nuhua mɔɔ fɛta anwonyane la
bawu anwonyane nu,
bɛ nuhua mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ tɔ dadeɛ nloa la
badɔ dadeɛ nloa;
bɛ nuhua mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ wu ɛhɔne nu la
bawu ɛhɔne nu,
yɛɛ bɛ nuhua mɔɔ fɛta nuokɛhyelɛ la,
bɛbahye ye nuokɛ bɛahɔ.
3Mebamaa ninyɛne mgbole nna asisi bɛ nwo zo azɛkye bɛ, medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a. Bɛbahu bɛ konle nu, ahwea batete bɛ avunli, nloma basuso bɛ nwonane, yɛɛ nanemgbole bali bɛ nwonane bɔkɔɔ. 4 Mebamaa maanle maanle mɔɔ wɔ aleɛabo la kɔsɔɔti ahonle adu wɔ bɛ ti wɔ mɔɔ Hɛzikaya ara nrenya Manasɛ, Dwuda belemgbunli ne yɛle wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm la ati.”
5Ɛdɛnkɛma se,
“Gyɛlusalɛmma, nwane a banwu bɛ anwunvɔne a?
Nwane a bazu bɛ a?
Nwane bɔbɔ a bagyinla
abiza bɛ kpalɛyɛlɛ nwo edwɛkɛ a?
6Bɛkpo medame Ɛdɛnkɛma,
atua ala a bɛte a,
yemɔti a medende me sa metia bɛ
na mezɛkye bɛ a;
akee mezi bɛ nwo abotane mevɛ.
7Me menli ne anvi bɛ ninyɛndane nwo,
yemɔti mehu bɛ, mezɛkye bɛ;
meva me akegyebɛ ne mehegye bɛ
wɔ suakpole biala azo wɔ maanle ye anu.
8Memaa azɛlɛ ne azo ahunlanvolɛ mraalɛ ɛzo ɛdɛla ɛnweazo anwea.
Mezɛkye mgbavolɛ ewia henlema
memaa mrɛladane ɛyɛ anwunvɔne;
memaa bɛ ɛbolɛ ɛde, ɛzulolɛ ɛha bɛ arɛlevilɛ nu.
9Raalɛ ne mɔɔ wole mralɛ nsuu la,
nyane ngome ɛmaa ɔ nye zo ɛbulu.
Ye sɛnzɛne lunle ewia henlema,
bɛbɔ ye anyiemgba, bɛgua ɔ nyunlu aze.
Mebamaa bɛ kpɔvolɛma ahu bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛha la.
Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.”
Gyɛlɛmaya ka ye nyane edwɛkɛ ahile Ɛdɛnkɛma
10Abule ɛbu me, ɔmɔ, kɛ ɛwole me ralɛ nrenya ɛdole azɛlɛ ye mɔɔ zolɛ le konle nee kpolerazulɛ ngome la azo a. Metɛbɔle awie bosea yɛɛ awie ɛtɛbizale me bie, noko awie biala bɔ me sasa. 11Ɛdɛnkɛma, saa metɛkpale bɛ ti kyɛlɛ wɔ bɛ ɛkpazilɛ nwo, saa metɛbodole wɔ wɔ me kpɔvolɛma ati wɔ bɛ ɛmianlɛ nee ngyegyelɛ mekɛ nu a, ɛnee maa sasa mɔɔ bɛlɛbɔ me la ɛha me. 12(Asoo awie kɛhola bulalɛ, bɔbɔ bulalɛ mɔɔ bɛ nee ye vi sɔlɔ, mɔɔ bɛva kɔbele bɛfonla nu la bu?)
13Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me kɛ, “Mebamaa kpɔvolɛma arasesa me menli ne anwonyia nee bɛ ezukoa ahɔ mgbane. Meyɛ ɛhye meava meadea bɛ wɔ bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛyɛ wɔ azɛlɛ ne azo la ati. 14Mebamaa bɛahɔzonle bɛ kpɔvolɛma wɔ maanle bie mɔɔ bɛnze nu la anu. Ɔluakɛ mame, saa mefa ɛya a ɔle senle; ɔsɔ a ɔnnu ɛlɛ.”
15Menganle kɛ, “O Ɛdɛnkɛma, wɔmɔ, ɛze ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti. Kakye me na boa me. Die me ti na di menli mɔɔ yɛ me kpɔdekpɔde la nzenralɛ. Mmasi bɛ nwo abotane toonwo ɛmaa bɛku me; nwu ye kɛ ɔlua wɔmɔ ɛ ti yɛɛ bɛlɛbɔ me aholoba a. 16O Ɛdɛnkɛma, Tumivolɛ Nyamenle, ɛdendɛle ɛhilele me, na mendiele. Wɔ edwɛkɛ ne manle me nye liele na menlile fɛlɛko; ɔlua zolɛ bɛfa wɔ duma a bɛfɛlɛ me a. 17Meandɛnla menli mɔɔ akunlu ɛdwo bɛ nwo na bɛdi fɛlɛko la avinli meanga meanzele. Mendɛnlanle koonwu, ɔboalekɛ ɛnee ɛ sa la me nwo zo, yɛɛ wɔmaa ɛya ɛwolo me. 18Duzu ati a me anwofofolɛ ne ɛngyakyi ɛ? Duzu ati a me hanlɛ ye ɛyɛ kukulabi, mɔɔ meyɛ ye ayile a ɔngɔ a? Mmabɛlɛbɛla me kɛ azule mɔɔ ɛngyɛ na asesa la.”
19Yemɔti Ɛdɛnkɛma buale kɛ, “Saa ɛsia ɛ nzi a, mebalie wɔ na wɔazia wɔayɛ me sonvolɛ. Saa wɔanva ɛ nloa wɔanga mgbane mgbane, na ɛfa ɛka nrɛlɛbɛ edwɛkɛ a, mebayɛ wɔ me kpɔmanvolɛ. Menli ne bazia aradoa wɔ na tɛ wɔmɔ yɛɛ ɛbahɔdoa bɛ a. 20Mebamaa wɔayɛ kɛ bane mɔɔ bɛva kɔbele bɛdo la wɔ menli ne akɔme nu. Bɛbava konle bɛadoa wɔ, na bɛnrɛnyia gyinlagyakɛ, ɔluakɛ me nee wɔ lua kɛ medie wɔ na mealie wɔ ngoane. Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a. 21Mebalie wɔ meavi amumuyɛma nee kɔdiawuma asa anu.”

Title: GYƐ 16
Content:
Ɛdɛnkɛma kulo Gyɛlɛmaya nee ngoane
1Ɛdɛnkɛma dendɛle hilele me, ɔse, 2“Mmagya raalɛ, ɛwo mraalɛ mrenya nee mraalɛ ɛgua ɛke. 3Ɔluakɛ melɛ edwɛkɛ meka mekile wɔ wɔ mralɛ mrenya nee mralɛ mraalɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛwo bɛ ɛke nee bɛ awovolɛma ne mɔ anwo. 4Ewule ɛzulolɛ bie a bahu bɛ a. Bɛwu a bɛnrɛzu bɛ yɛɛ bɛnrɛzie bɛ; bɛ avunli bagua azɛlɛ ye azo mgbane mgbane akpɔlɔ. Bɛbahu bie mɔ konle nu, yɛɛ ɛhɔne ngome bahu bie mɔ; bɛ avunli bayɛ nloma nee nanemgbole aleɛ.
5“Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, mese: Mmakɔ awuke mɔɔ ɛzɛne ɛdɔ ɛkɛ ne la anu. Mmakɔsu awie biala, ɔluakɛ meye me anzonudwolɛ ne mɔɔ menvale memanle menli ɛhye mɔ la. Melie me anwunvɔnezelɛ ne, me ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne nee me anzonudwolɛ mevi menli ɛhye mɔ ɛkɛ. 6Menli mɔɔ lɛ bie nee mɔɔ ɛnlɛ bie, mɔɔ wɔ azɛlɛ ɛhye azo la amuala bawu. Bɛnrɛzie bɛ yɛɛ awie biala ɛnrɛzu bɛ anzɛɛ ɛnrɛbodɛboda ɔ nwo anzɛɛ ɛnrɛkpa ɔ ti ɛnrɛli nyane ɛnrɛmaa bɛ. 7Awie biala ɛnrɛva debie ɛnrɛdende sonla mɔɔ ɛlɛsu awie la anyunlu kɛ ɔfa yeakyekye ɔ rɛle, yɛɛ awie biala ɛnrɛkyekye awie arɛle kɛ yeminli ɔ ze anzɛɛ ɔ nli la.
8“Mmawolo awuke mɔɔ bɛlɛdi, bɛanlo, bɛalie bɛ nye la anu, ɛkɔtɛnla aze ɛ nee bɛ di, no. 9 Ɔluakɛ medame Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne, mese: Nea, mebadu anyelielɛ anzɛɛ fɛlɛkolilɛ bo wɔ maanle ye anu wɔ ɛdawɔ ɛ nye zo wɔ wɔ mekɛ zo. Bɛbagyakyi atɔfolɛlielɛ nee nwolɛ ɛkponledolɛ nee anyelielɛ.
10“Saa ɛka edwɛkɛ ɛhye mɔ amuala ɛkile menli ne mɔ na bɛbiza wɔ kɛ, ‘Na kɛ ɔyɛ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛdua yɛ kakɛ kpole zɛhae ɛ? Duzu ɛtane a yɛyɛ a? Duzu ɛtane yɛɛ yɛyɛ yɛtia Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛ Nyamenle ne a?’ a, 11se bɛ kɛ, medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, mese: Ɔboalekɛ bɛ ze mɔ ɛkpo me na bɛhɔzonle nyamenle gyɛne gyɛne, bɛbɔ bɛ ti aze bɛmaa bɛ, yɛɛ bɛanli me mɛla ne azo. 12Akee bɛmɛ bɔbɔ bɛyɛ bɛmaa yebo bɛ ze mɔ ɛdeɛ ne azo. Ɔluakɛ nea, awie biala lua ɔdaye ye adenle ɛtane ɛdeɛ mɔɔ ɔ kunlu dwo nwolɛ la azo, yɛɛ bɛkpo kɛ bɛnrɛdie me ne. 13Ɛhye ati mebaye bɛ azɛlɛ ɛhye azo meahɔgua azɛlɛ mɔɔ bɛmɛ anzɛɛ bɛ ze mɔ ɛnze zolɛ la azo. Ɛkɛ ne, bɛbazonle nyamenle gyɛne gyɛne alehyenlɛ nee aledwolɛ: na menrɛze bɛ anwunvɔne fee.”
Bɛvi nlɔnu bɛsia bɛara
14Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Mekɛ ɛlɛba mɔɔ menli ɛnrɛha kɛ, ‘Suzuamgba ala mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma mɔɔ yele Yizilayɛma vile Yigyibiti la de aze la.’ 15Bɛbaha kɛ, ‘Suzuamgba ala mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma mɔɔ yele Yizilayɛma vile sɔlɔ maanle ne nee maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti, mɔɔ ɔkpondenle Yizilayɛma nu la rale la de aze la.’ Ɔluakɛ mebava bɛ meazia meara bɛdabɛ bɛ maanle nu, wɔ azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ menvale memanle bɛ ze mɔ la azo.”
16Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Bɛnlea, melɛto ɛsalɛ meavɛlɛ fɛlɛkyevoma dɔɔnwo meamaa bɛarahye menli ne. Ɛhye anzi mebavɛlɛ menli mɔɔ di ɛbɔlɛ la dɔɔnwo meamaa bɛahɔhwe menli ne bɛavi awoka mgbole nee ngyikyi ne mɔ azo, yɛɛ awolɛ mgbole ne mɔ avinli bɛara. 17Menye dua bɛ nyɛleɛ ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti, bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ ɛnvea, bɛ kɔsɔɔti bɛgua me sa nu. 18Bɛva bɛ bɛkyi mmonle ninyɛne ne mɔ bɛzɛkye me azɛlɛ ne. Bɛkyi nyɛleɛ ngome a bɛyɛ ye azɛlɛ ne azo a, yemɔti mebadua bɛ amumuyɛ nee bɛ ɛtane mɔɔ bɛlɛyɛ ye ɛkɛ ne la anwo kakɛ mɔnwo.”
Nzɛlɛlɛ mɔɔ kile diedi mɔɔ Gyɛlɛmaya lɛ wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anu la
19O Ɛdɛnkɛma, ɛle me anwosesebɛ nee me aranemgbole, me ɛvealeka wɔ me anwongyelelɛ mekɛ nu. Maanle maanle vi maanle ti nee maanle bo bariandi araze wɔ kɛ, “Yɛ ze mɔ annyia agyadeɛ kpaziwɔkɛ biala kɛ adalɛ nee ninyɛne mgbane mgbane mɔɔ nvasoɛ ɛnle zolɛ la ala. 20Asoo sonla ɔdaye ɔkola ɔyɛ nyamenle ɔmaa ɔ nwo? Ninyɛne zɛhae mɔ ɛnle nyamenle!” 21Na Ɛdɛnkɛma zele kɛ, “Yemɔti bɛnlea, mebamaa maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti anwu me. Mebayɛ ko ɛhye meamaa bɛanwu me tumi nee me anwosesebɛ na bɛanwu kɛ medame, me duma a le Ɛdɛnkɛma.”

Title: GYƐ 17
Content:
Dwuda ɛtane mɔɔ ɔyɛle nee nwolɛ ndeanlɛ
1Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Bɛva bulalɛ pɛne a bɛhɛlɛ Dwudama ɛtane mɔɔ bɛyɛ la a. Bɛva pɛne mɔɔ ati le daemɔn la bɛhɛlɛ bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ wɔ bɛ ahonle nwo na bɛhɛlɛ bɛgua bɛ azukponle ne mɔ abati kpokpɔkoo ne mɔ azo. 2Bɛ bo zo amra sonle bozonle raalɛ Ahyela wɔ azukponle mɔɔ bɛhyehyɛ wɔ baka buzuu biala abo la azo, 3wɔ awoka mgbole nee ngyikyi ne mɔ azo wɔ kpɔkɛ nu. Mebamaa bɛ kpɔvolɛma arave bɛ ezukoa nee bɛ nwo ninyɛne wɔ bɛ ɛtane mɔɔ bɛyɛ ye azɛlɛ ne azo la ati. 4Azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ menvale memanle bɛ la bavi bɛ sa, na meamaa bɛazonle bɛ kpɔvolɛma wɔ azɛlɛ mɔɔ bɛnze zolɛ fee la azo, ɔboalekɛ mame, saa mefa ɛya a ɔle senle; ɔsɔ a ɔnnu ɛlɛ.”
Ɛdɛnkɛma ka edwɛkɛ ɛdodo
5Ɛdɛnkɛma se:
“Munzule ɛha sonla ne mɔɔ fa ɔ rɛle wula sonla nu,
ɔkpo me na ɔfa ɔ rɛle ɔwula sonla anwosesebɛ nu la.
6Ɔle kɛ ɛsɛlɛ zo aziakɛ mɔɔ fifi fienemgbole nu azɛlɛ
resee mɔɔ ngyenle wɔ nu na sonla ɛnle zo la.
Debie kpalɛ biala ɛnvinde ye.
7“Nyilalɛ ɛha sonla ne mɔɔ
kɛva ɔ rɛle kɛwula medame Ɛdɛnkɛma me nu la.
8 Ɔle kɛ baka mɔɔ gyi azule nloa,
ye ndinli dwu azule ne anu,
ɔnzulo wawaa mekɛ,
dahuu ye nya le duhuduhu,
ezule ɛndɔ na azɛlɛ nwo we a ɔndwenle nwo,
ɔluakɛ ɔso mekɛ biala.
9“Ahonle le mɛlɛbɛla tɛla debie biala,
yezɛkye yebo zolɛ; nwane a kɛhola kɛde ɔ bo a?
10 Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a meneɛnlea sonla adwenle nu
na meneɛnlea ye ahonle nu a.
Meboa awie biala, kɛmɔ ye ndenle ne mɔ de la,
kɛmɔ ye nyɛleɛ ne si kɔ ye la.”
11Sonla mɔɔ kpondɛ ezukoa amile nu la
le kɛ anloma mɔɔ bobɔ aholonvia mɔɔ tɛ ye a ɔdole la;
ɔndwu mgbanyifoa ɛnee yevi ɔ sa,
ye awieleɛ nu ɛnee yeyɛ koasea.
12Yɛ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne le kɛ anyunlunyia belemgbunli ebia,
ɔbɔ ɔ bo la ɔgyi boka kpole zo.
13O Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛma anyelazo,
awie biala mɔɔ kpo wɔ la anyunlu gua aze;
bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkakyi bɛ nzi bɛsi wɔ la abo zo baminli,
kɛ asɛɛ bɛhɛlɛ bɛ aluma wɔ munlutu nu,
ɔluakɛ bɛkpo wɔmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma
mɔɔ ɛle ngoane nzufeanvea la.
Gyɛlɛmaya biza Ɛdɛnkɛma moalɛ
14O Ɛdɛnkɛma, yɛ me ayile, na me nwo baza; die me, na mebanyia ngoane. Wɔmɔ a ɔwɔ kɛ meye wɔ ayɛlɛ a.
15Nea, menli ne ka kile me kɛ, “Ɛdɛnkɛma edwɛkɛ ne wɔ nienwu? Ɔva ɔrɛla ɛ!”
16Ɛdawɔ ɛze kɛ metɛkpole kɛ menrɛyɛ mboaneneavolɛ wɔ wɔ gyima nu. Edwɛkɛ biala mɔɔ vi me nloa anu vindele la vi wɔ ɛkɛ. 17Mmaka me ɛzulolɛ, ɔluakɛ wɔmɔ yɛɛ ɛle me ɛvealeka wɔ me ngyegyelɛ mekɛ nu a. 18Maa menli mɔɔ yɛ me kpɔdekpɔde la anyunlu ɛgua aze, na mmamaa me nyunlu gua aze. Maa bɛ ahonle ɛdu, na mmamaa me ahonle tu. Maa munzule ɛdo bɛ na bɔ bɛ bo zo fane nwiɔ.
Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ne ɛzielɛ
19Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me kɛ, “Kɔgyinla Bɛngyaman Anlenkɛ Kpole ne anloa, ɛleka mɔɔ Dwuda arelemgbunli pe wolo Gyɛlusalɛm na eza bɛpe bɛfinde la, nee Gyɛlusalɛm nlenkɛ mgbole ne mɔ anloa na bɔ nolo kɛ: 20Dwuda arelemgbunli nee bɛ ezuavolɛ, Gyɛlusalɛmma amuala mɔɔ dua nlenkɛ mgbole ɛhye mɔ anu kɔ suakpole ne azo la, bɛdie edwɛkɛ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛlɛka la. 21 Ɔse: Saa bɛkpondɛ bɛ ngoane a ɛnee bɛmmafa bɔlɛ bɛsie bɛ ti zo wɔ Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ne. Bɛmmasoa debie biala bɛba Gyɛlusalɛm. 22 Bɛmmasoa debie bɛfi azua nu bɛfinde, yɛɛ bɛmmayɛ gyima biala, na bɛzie Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ne nwuanzanwuanza, kɛmɔ menzele bɛ ze mɔ la. 23Noko bɛ ze mɔ andie me ne, bɛampili me. Bɛyɛle anzosesebɛ, amaa bɛandie edwɛkɛ biala na yeayɛ ngilehilelɛ.
24“Na saa bɛtie medame Ɛdɛnkɛma me ne, na bɛanzoa bɔlɛ bɛamba Gyɛlusalɛm, bɛanyɛ gyima biala wɔ Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ne, na bɛsie kenle ne nwuanzanwuanza na bɛanyɛ gyima a, 25yemɔ menli ɛnrɛkpa suakpole ye azo ɛlɛ. Bɛ arelemgbunli badɛnla ehwili nu nee mgbɔnwɔ zo, bɛmɛ yɛɛ bɛ mgbanyima banyia tumi, kɛmɔ Belemgbunli Devidi nyianle la. 26Na menli bava ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ nee azubɔlɛ, ma azubɔdeɛ, ɛyɛlɛ evuanlɛ, yɛɛ moyɛlɛ azubɔdeɛ vi Dwuda maanzinli nu azuamgbole ne mɔ, nee azua mɔɔ ɛbɔ Gyɛlusalɛm ɛyia Bɛngyaman maanzinli nu, adɔleɛ awoka ngyikyi ne mɔ azo, awoka mgbole ne mɔ azo yɛɛ Dwuda nyiakɛ arɛlɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma. 27Na saa bɛandie me, bɛanzie Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ne nwuanzanwuanza, na awie biala soa bɔlɛ ba Gyɛlusalɛm a, mebado senle wɔ suakpole ne nlenkɛ mgbole ne mɔ anu, ɔbayela Gyɛlusalɛm azua ne mɔ bɔkɔɔ, na bɛnrɛhola ye nua.”

Title: GYƐ 18
Content:
Gyɛlɛmaya wɔ buakɛnwovolɛ sua nu
1Ɛdɛnkɛma dendɛle hilele me. 2Ɔse, “Gyɛlɛmaya, dwazo kɔ buakɛnwovolɛ ne sua nu, na ɛkɛ ne a ɛbade nrɛlaleɛ mɔɔ mefa meazoa wɔ la a.” 3Yemɔti mendwazole mengɔle buakɛnwovolɛ ne sua nu. Ɛnee nwovolɛ ne ɛlɛfa ye ehwili ne ali adwinli. 4Saa nwovolɛ ne nwo buakɛ ne bie na yeanyɛ kpalɛ a, ɛnee yezɛkye ye na yeva ndɛtɛlɛ ne yenwo debie fofolɛ, kɛmɔ ɔkpondɛ ye la.
5Akee Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me kɛ, 6“O Yizilayɛma, asoo mengola menyɛ bɛ kɛmɔ buakɛnwovolɛ yɛ ye ɛva ne la ɔ? Kɛ ɛva ne si de wɔ nwovolɛ ne asa anu la, zɔhane ala a bɛde wɔ me sa nu a. 7Mekɛ biala mɔɔ menwɔze kɛ mebadu maanle bie meahakyi ye, mebagologolo ye anzɛɛ mebabɔ ye la, 8saa maanle ne anu amra twe bɛ nwo fi bɛ ɛtane mɔɔ bɛyɛ la anwo a, mebava bɛ ɛtane meahyɛ bɛ, menrɛzɛkye maanle zɔhane. 9Zɔhane ala yɛɛ saa mese kɛ meboa maanle bie meamaa yeakpazi, yeagyinla 10na maanle ɛhye anu amra yɛ ɛtane na bɛandie me ne a, mebagyakyi kpalɛ biala mɔɔ mezuzu ye bɛ nwo la meagua ɛkɛ a. 11Yemɔti ka kile Dwudama nee Gyɛlusalɛmma kɛ medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, mese: Melɛdwenle nwolɛ mearazɛkye bɛ. Awie biala ɛhwe ɔ nwo ɛvi ye nyɛleɛ ɛtane nwo na ɔhakyi ye subane nee ye nyɛleɛ. 12Na bɛbabua wɔ kɛ, ‘Yɛndie wɔ edwɛkɛ biala. Yɛyɛ mɔɔ wɔ yɛ ahonle nu la; yɛɛ awie biala babɔ ɛbɛla ɛtane mɔɔ ɔdaye ɔkulo la.’ ”
Menli ne kpo Ɛdɛnkɛma
13Zɔhane ati Ɛdɛnkɛma se,
“Biza maanle maanle ne mɔ kɛ
nwane a ɛde edwɛkɛ zɛhae bie ɛlɛ a?
Yizilayɛma ɛyɛ bɛkyi debie
ɛzulolɛ kpole kpalɛ.
14Asoo ezukɔtweaba ɛnle Lɛbanɔn
awolɛ awoka ne mɔ azo?
Asoo ye awoka ne mɔ azo
nzule yɔlɔkɔkɔ ne mɔ we resee?
15Noko me menli ne ɛkpo me,
bɛkpu ɛyɛlɛ evuanlɛ bɛmaa nyamenle gyɛne gyɛne.
Bɛdu koti wɔ bɛ ɛbɛlabɔlɛ nu,
bɛanlua dɛba ne adenle ne anu.
Bɛluolua ahane ahane,
bɛanva ademgbole nu.
16Bɛmaa bɛ maanle ne anu ɛyɛ ɛzulolɛ,
menli te ye duma a bɛkpobi ye.
Awie biala mɔɔ kɛva ɛkɛ ne la ahonle tu
na ɔkpusu ɔ ti.
17Mebakponde bɛ kɛ aduduleɛ anwoma
wɔ bɛ kpɔvolɛma anyunlu,
saa bɛkɔ ɛmianlɛ nu a menrɛye me nyunlu,
mebahakyi me nzi meazi bɛ.”
Bɛkɔ Gyɛlɛmaya ati akpamo
18Akee menli ne hanle kɛ, “Bɛmaa yɛva Gyɛlɛmaya anwo adwenle, ɔluakɛ ɔwɔ kɛ sɛlɛvolɛ a kilehile mɛla ne anu a, na nrɛlɛbɛvolɛ tu folɛ, yɛɛ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ ka Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ ne. Bɛmaa yɛdo ye ɛzonle na yɛduodua yɛ nzo wɔ ye edwɛkɛhanlɛ nwo.”
19Ɔlua ɛhye ati menyɛle nzɛlɛlɛ kɛ, “O Ɛdɛnkɛma, tie me nzɛlɛlɛ na tie me modolɛ. 20Asoo bɛfa ɛtane bɛtua kpalɛ kakɛ? Noko menli ne ɛvu me nwo kuma. Kakye kɛ menzile membale ɛ nyunlu membamkpale bɛ ti kyɛlɛ kɛ ɛye wɔ ɛya ne bɛ nwo zo la. 21Zɔhane ati, Ɛdɛnkɛma, maa ɛhɔne ngome ɛhu bɛ mra; maa bɛwu dadeɛ nloa. Maa bɛ ye mɔ ɛyɛ mota na bɛyɛ ahunlanvolɛ. Maa anwonyane ɛbɔ mrenya ne mɔ ɛhu bɛ, na mgbavolɛ ne mɔ ɛwu konle nu. 22Bɛvu kuma mɔɔ bɛmaa meadɔ nu a, yɛɛ bɛzuozua ngane mɔɔ bɛfa bɛahye me a. Yemɔti maa awie mɔ ɛrave bɛ nwo ninyɛne arɛlevilɛ nu, na maa ɛzunlɛ ɛdɔ bɛ awuke ne mɔ anu. 23O Ɛdɛnkɛma, wɔmɔ, ɛze bɛ akpamo mɔɔ bɛhɔ kɛ bɛku me la. Mmafa bɛ ɛtane ɛkyɛ bɛ na ɛye bɛ ɛtane mɔɔ bɛyɛ la ɛfi ɛ nye zo. Maa bɛho bɛdɔ ɛ nyunlu na dua wɔ ɛya ne anu ɛ nee bɛ ɛli ye kpalɛ.”

Title: GYƐ 19
Content:
Dwora bɔlera ne
1Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me kɛ, “Kɔdɔ dwora, na fa menli ne mgbanyima ne mɔ bie nee sɛlɛvolɛma mgbanyima ne mɔ bie, 2 na ɛ nee bɛ ɛpe Foandɛkɛ Anlenkɛ Kpole ne anu ɛhɔ Henɛm Bɔnza, na ka me nrɛlaleɛ ne kile bɛ. 3Ka kile bɛ kɛ: Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne se, ‘Dwuda arelemgbunli nee Gyɛlusalɛm ezuavolɛ, bɛdie. Bɛnlea, melɛmaa munzule kpole bie arado bɛ mɔɔ awie biala mɔɔ kɛde la anwo babubu ye a. 4Ɔboalekɛ menli ne ɛkpo me ɛva evinli ɛha Gyɛlusalɛm ɛke. Bɛkpu ɛyɛlɛ ɛke bɛmaa nyamenle gyɛne gyɛne mɔɔ bɛ ze mɔ o, bɛdabɛ o, Dwuda arelemgbunli o, bɛ biala ɛnze bɛ la. Eza bɛha menli mɔɔ ɛnze nwolɛ bie la mogya bɛgua ɛke, 5 bɛzi azukponle bɛmaa bɛ bozonle Beeyale ne na bɛyela bɛ mra ɛke bɛbɔ ɛyelalɛ azu bɛmaa ye. Nyɛleɛ zɛhae, tɛ me yɛɛ menzele bɛ anzɛɛ menlile ye mɛla memanle bɛ a, yɛɛ nwolɛ adwenle amba me ti anu bɔbɔ. 6Yemɔti bɛnlea, mekɛ ɛlɛba mɔɔ medame Ɛdɛnkɛma mese: Bɛnrɛvɛlɛ azɛlɛ ɛhye Tofɛte anzɛɛ Henɛm Bɔnza bieko; bɛbavɛlɛ ye Ahunleɛ Bɔnza. 7Ɛke a mebazɛkye adwenle ngyehyɛlɛ biala mɔɔ Dwudama nee Gyɛlusalɛmma ɛhyehyɛ la. Mebamaa bɛ kpɔvolɛma nee menli mɔɔ kpondɛ bɛ la asa adɔ bɛ nwo zo ahu bɛ. Mebamaa anwomanyunlu nloma nee ɛbɔ nu nanemgbole ali bɛ avunli. 8Mebazɛkye suakpole ɛhye meamaa menli azulo ɛkɛ. Awie biala mɔɔ kɛze ɛke la akunlu badu na yeahɔsɔ ɔ ti, ɔluakɛ mebazɛkye ye meamaa yeayɛ ɛzulolɛ. 9Kpɔvolɛma babɔ suakpole ne ayia na bɛateta ye ɛzulolɛ nu kpole bie. Ɛhɔne bamaa menli ne apɛ bɛ nwo ahu bɛ mra mrenya nee bɛ mra mraalɛ ali; eza bɛbahu bɛ gɔnwo mɔ bɔbɔ bɛali.’ ”
10Akee Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me kɛ membɔ dwora ne wɔ menli mɔɔ me nee bɛ hɔle la anyunlu, 11na menga mengile bɛ kɛ, “Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma se: Kɛmɔ sonla gologolo nwovolɛ dwora na bɛfa ye bieko a ɔnva la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ mebagologolo menli ɛhye mɔ nee suakpole ɛhye a. Bɛbazie avunli wɔ Tofɛte, ɔboalekɛ bɛnrɛnyia azie bɛnrɛzie avunli ne mɔ zo. 12Kɛ medame Ɛdɛnkɛma mebayɛ ɛke la ɛne, mebamaa suakpole ɛhye nee zolɛ menli ne ayɛ kɛ Tofɛte. 13Azua mɔɔ wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm, Dwuda arelemgbunli azua, yɛɛ azua mɔɔ bɛkpu ɛyɛlɛ zolɛ bɛmaa anwumaneamra na bɛva nwanye bɛgua bɛbɔ azu bɛmaa nyamenle gyɛne gyɛne la, evinli ɛha bɛ kɛ Tofɛte la.”
14Akee Gyɛlɛmaya vi Tofɛte, ɛleka mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma manle ɔhɔbɔle ye nrɛlaleɛ ne nolo la rale na ɔragyinlanle Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne alie nwo ɛkɛ na ɔhanle ɔhilele menli ne kɔsɔɔti kɛ, 15“Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne se: Melɛfa munzule biala mɔɔ mezuzu kɛ mefa meadea suakpole ɛhye nee azua mɔɔ zuozua ye la amuala wɔ bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ ati la meara, ɔboalekɛ bɛbɔ kpɔkɛ kɛ bɛnrɛdie me edwɛkɛ.”

Title: GYƐ 20
Content:
Gyɛlɛmaya nee Sɛlɛvolɛ Pahyɛ nyia kpolera
1Yimɛ ara nrenya Sɛlɛvolɛ Pahyɛ mɔɔ le kpanyinli, mɔɔ nea Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne la dele kɛ Gyɛlɛmaya ɛlɛka Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ ɛhye mɔ. 2Na Pahyɛ manle bɛbole Nyamenle Kpɔmanvolɛ Gyɛlɛmaya na bɛbɔle ye kpanwu wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne Sɔlɔ Bɛngyaman Anlenkɛ Kpole ne anwo. 3Aleɛ hyenle na Pahyɛ dule Gyɛlɛmaya kpanwu ne la, ɔhanle ɔhilele Pahyɛ kɛ, “Ɛdɛnkɛma se bɛnvɛlɛ wɔ Pahyɛ, na bɛfɛlɛ wɔ ‘Ɛzulolɛ wɔ ɛleka biala.’ 4Ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma se: Mebamaa ɛ nwo aha ɛzulolɛ amaa ɛdawɔ ɛ nwo nee ɛ gɔnwo mɔ amuala. Bɛ kpɔvolɛma bahu bɛ kɔsɔɔti wɔ ɛdawɔ ɛ nye zo. Mebaye Dwudama amuala meamaa Babelonia belemgbunli ne. Ɔbahye bie mɔ nuokɛ ɔ nee bɛ ahɔ Babelonia na yeahu bie mɔ. 5Eza mebamaa bɛ kpɔvolɛma ava anwonyia mɔɔ wɔ suakpole ye azo la ahɔ; bɛbalie menli ne anwo ninyɛne nee bɛ agyadeɛ kɔsɔɔti bɛ sa nu. Bɛbalie Dwuda arelemgbunli gya nu ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti na bɛazoa ɔ muala bɛahɔ Babelonia. 6Bɛbahye ɛdawɔ Pahyɛ nee wɔ sua nu amra amuala nuokɛ bɛazoa bɛ bɛahɔ Babelonia. Nehane yɛɛ ɛ nee wɔ sua nu amra nee ɛ gɔnwo mɔ mɔɔ ɛka adalɛ nrɛlaleɛ ne ɛkile bɛ la bawu na bɛazie bɛ a.”
Gyɛlɛmaya su ahile Ɛdɛnkɛma
7O Ɛdɛnkɛma, wɔbɛlɛbɛla me
na meannwu ɔ nzi.
Wɔbo me nwo zo, ɔluakɛ
ɛtɛla me anwosesebɛ.
Alehyenlɛ biala me nwo yɛ ɛzelekɛ;
Awie biala si me amgbu.
8Ɔluakɛ mekɛ biala metendɛ a metea nu,
metea meka kɛ, “Konle nee ɛzɛkyelɛ ɛlɛba o!”
Ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma edwɛkɛ ne
ɛmaa meyɛ mgbane alehyenlɛ biala wɔ menli nye zo.
9Saa meka kɛ, “Menrɛbɔ ye duma
anzɛɛ menrɛbɔ ye duma menrɛdeɛdea” a;
ɛnee ye edwɛkɛ ne sɔ kɛ senle yela me ahonle nu,
ɔwolowolo me mbowule nu;
akee meli ye me kunlu mevɛ, mengola.
10Ɔluakɛ mete menli azukuedulɛ ne;
ɛzulolɛ ɛva ɛleka kɔsɔɔti.
Agɔnwolɛma kpalɛ kpondɛ me azedɔlɛ,
bɛse, “Tendɛ tia ye! Bɛmaa yɛdendɛ yɛtia ye!
Wɔannea a ɔ nye zo bada ye,
ɛnee yɛ sa ɛha ye na yɛali ye nzenralɛ.”
11Na Ɛdɛnkɛma gyi me nzi,
ɔle konle nu katakyie,
yemɔti menli mɔɔ yɛ me kpɔdekpɔde la badu agua,
bɛnrɛhola me nwo zo fo.
Bɛ nzuzulɛ ɛnrɛyɛ ɛkɛ,
bɛ nyunlu bagua aze kpole,
na bɛ rɛle ɛnrɛvi bɛ anyiemgba ɛbɔlɛ ne ɛlɛ.
12O Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, mɔɔ sɔ tenlenema nea,
mɔɔ ɛnwu sonla biala ahonle nee ye adwenle nu,
maa menwu kɛ wɔli me kpɔvolɛma nzenralɛ,
ɔluakɛ meva me edwɛkɛ ne memaa wɔ.
13Bɛdo edwɛne bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma;
bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ!
Yelie anwunvɔnema ngoane
yevi amumuyɛma asa anu.
14 Munzule ɛha kenle ne mɔɔ bɛwole me la!
Munzule ɛha kenle ne mɔɔ ɔmɔ wole me la!
15Abule ɛbu sonla ne mɔɔ
rabɔle egya amaneɛ
kɛ, “Bɛwo ralɛ nrenya bɛmaa wɔ”
na ɔmanle ɔ nye liele la.
16Maa sonla zɔhane ɛyɛ kɛ azuamgbole
mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anze bɛ anwunvɔne,
na ɔbutule bɛ nye aze la.
Maa ɔde ɛzunlɛ nwonlomɔ
na ɔde ɛdeɛdeanlɛ ewiazo,
17ɔboalekɛ yeammaa meanga ɔmɔ akunlu meanwu.
anrɛɛ ɔmɔ akunlu yɛle me azie,
na ɔ ko kpole ne hale ɔ nwo.
18Duzu ati a bɛwo me,
kɛ membanwu ɛvɛlɛ nee nyane,
na me awieleɛ ɛyɛ anyiemgba ɛ?

Title: GYƐ 21
Content:
Bɛse bɛbali Gyɛlusalɛm anwo zo konim
1Dwuda Belemgbunli Zɛdikaya zoanle Malekaya ara nrenya Pahyɛ nee Sɛlɛvolɛ Zɛfanaya, Meeyasaya ara nrenya ne wɔ Gyɛlɛmaya anwo ɛkɛ bɛhɔzele ye kɛ, 2 “Babelonia Belemgbunli Nɛbukadenɛza ɛlɛfa konle aradoa yɛ. Yemɔti biza Ɛdɛnkɛma maa yɛ saa ɔkɛlua ye nwanwane adenle ne azo ɔkɛmaa ɔkɛgyakyi yɛ nwo zo ɛralɛ a.”
3Gyɛlɛmaya hanle hilele bɛ kɛ bɛhɔha bɛhile Zɛdikaya kɛ, 4“Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne se: Zɛdikaya, me nee wɔ ɛlɔnema ne mɔɔ nee Babelonia Belemgbunli Nɛbukadenɛza ɛlɔnema ɛlɛkɔ ahɔho la baho. Mebaboɔboa wɔ ɛlɔnema ne konle ninyɛne ne mɔ anloa wɔ suakpole ne avinli. 5Mebava me tumi, me anwosesebɛ, me ɛya ne, me ahonle mɔɔ ɛfutu, yɛɛ ahyi mɔɔ ɛlɛku me la me nee wɔ aho. 6Mebamaa ewulenzane adɔ menli nee nyɛmoa mɔɔ wɔ suakpole ne azo la avinli ahu bɛ muala. 7Akee mebamaa Belemgbunli Nɛbukadenɛza nee wɔ kpɔvolɛma mɔɔ kpondɛ wɔ ahu wɔ la ahye wɔ, wɔ mgbanyima yɛɛ menli mɔɔ anwu konle ne, ɛhɔne ne anzɛɛ ewulenzane ne anu la kɔsɔɔti ahu bɛ. Ɔnrɛvavi bie yɛɛ ɔnreze biala anwunvɔne yɛɛ ɔnrɛze biala alɔbɔlɛ.”
8Akee Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me kɛ, “Ka kile menli ne mɔ kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma se: Meva ngoane adenle nee ewule adenle mezie bɛ nyunlu. 9Awie biala mɔɔ kɛdɛnla suakpole ne azo la bawu konle nu anzɛɛ ɛhɔne nu anzɛɛ ewulenzane nu. Na awie biala mɔɔ kɛhɔdane Babelonia ɛlɔnema mɔɔ ɛbɛnra ɛyia suakpole ye la, bɛnrɛhu ye. Bɛbava ye donvula ala. 10Ɔluakɛ meva me nye mezie suakpole ɛhye anwo kɛ memaa munzule ado bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ zolɛ la. Menrɛmaa kpalɛ ɛnrɛdo bɛ. Mebaye bɛ meamaa Babelonia belemgbunli ne na meamaa yeado senle zolɛ yeayela ye. Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.”
Dwuda suakunlu amra ndeanlɛ
11-12Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me kɛ menga nrɛlaleɛ ɛhye mengile Dwuda suakunlu amra. Ɔse, “Bɛmɛ, Devidi abo zo amra, bɛdie Ɛdɛnkɛma edwɛkɛ ne! Ɛdɛnkɛma se: Bɛli pɛlepɛle dahuu. Bɛlie bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwua bɛ bɛkpokpo bɛ la bɛvi nzisima asa anu. Saa bɛanyɛ ye zɔhane a bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ ati, me ɛya ne bara bɛ nwo zo kɛ senle, na ɔbazɔ mɔɔ bɛnua ye a ɔnrɛnlu a. 13Na bɛnlea, bɛmɛ Gyɛlusalɛmma mɔɔ bɛvo bɛdɛnla bɔnza ne anwuma, na bɛyɛ bɛ nwo bodane mɔɔ la azɛlɛ wienyi zo, na bɛse awie ɛnrɛhola ɛnrɛva konle ɛnrɛdoa bɛ, yɛɛ awie ɛnrɛhola ɛnrɛra ɛleka mɔɔ bɛwɔ la, medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, mese, 14mebadea bɛ wɔ bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ ati. Mebado senle wɔ bɛ suakunlu ɛkɛ, na ɔbazɔ yeayela kpɔkɛ nee debie biala mɔɔ ɛbɔ bɛ ɛyia la. Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.”

Title: GYƐ 22
Content:
Nrɛlaleɛ mɔɔ Gyɛlɛmaya hanle hilele Dwuda belemgbunli suakunlu amra la
1Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me kɛ, “Kɔ Dwuda belemgbunli ne suakunlu ɛkɛ ne na ka kile awuke ne anu amra kɛ: 2Dwuda belemgbunli, mɔɔ ɛde Belemgbunli Devidi ebia zo a, ɛdawɔ, wɔ sonvolɛma nee wɔ maanlema amuala mɔɔ wɔ suakpole ye azo la, bɛdie! 3Ɛdɛnkɛma se: Bɛli pɛlepɛle na bɛyɛ mɔɔ le fɔɔnwo la, na bɛlie menli mɔɔ bɛlɛwua bɛ, bɛakpokpo bɛ la bɛvi nzisima asa anu. Bɛmmayɛ nyɛvolɛ, nrisa nee mraalɛ ne mɔ ɛtane anzɛɛ bɛmmakile bɛ nyane. Bɛmmaka awie mɔɔ ɛnze nwolɛ bie la mogya bɛgua azɛlɛ ɛhye azo. 4Ɔluakɛ saa bɛdi mɔɔ meha la azo nɔhalɛ nu a, belemgbunlililɛ ne bayɛ bɛmɛ Devidi abo zo amra ɛdeɛ dahuu. Bɛ arelemgbunli, bɛ mgbanyima nee bɛ maanlema badɛnla ehwili nu nee mgbɔnwɔ zo dahuu. 5 Na saa bɛanli me edwɛkɛ zo a, meka medame me ngome me nwo kɛ awuke ɛhye babɔ. Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.”
6Ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Me nye zo, Dwuda maanle ne, Geleade maanle ne, yɛɛ Lɛbanɔn Boka, bɛ ngɛnlɛma sɛ, noko mebazɛkye Dwuda maanle ne meayɛ ye ɛsɛlɛ na meamaa maanle ne anu azuamgbole ayɛ azuadu. 7Mebamaa menli ava konle ninyɛne arazɛkye maanle ne. Bɛbaha maanle ne anu sida mbaka ngɛnlɛma ne mɔ bɛagua na bɛayela bɛ.
8“Ɛhye anzi nyɛvolɛ dɔɔnwo vi maanle maanle zo baraze ɛkɛ na bɛbaha bɛahile bɛ nwo ngoko kɛ, ‘Duzu ati a Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛdea suakpole ɛhye zɛhae ɛ?’ 9Na bɛbabua kɛ, ‘Ɔboalekɛ bɛkpole Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne ngyekyeleɛ ne na bɛzonlenle nyamenle gyɛne gyɛne.’ ”
Nrɛlaleɛ mɔɔ Gyɛlɛmaya hanle wɔ Dwowahaze anwo la
10Dwudama, bɛmmasu mɔɔ ɛwu la,
yɛɛ bɛmmadi ɔ nwo nyane;
na bɛzu mɔɔ bɛ nee ye ɛlɛkɔ la kpalɛ,
ɔluakɛ ɔnrɛzia ɔnrɛra bieko,
ɔnrɛranwu ye maanle ye anu bieko.
11 Ɔluakɛ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ka ye wɔ Belemgbunli Dwosaya ara nrenya Dwowahaze mɔɔ lile ɔ ze agya, dɛnlanle ebia ne azo la anwo la ɛne. Ɔse, “Ɛhɔlɛ mɔɔ yehɔ la, ɔnrɛzia ɔnrɛra bieko. 12Ɔbawu ɛleka mɔɔ bɛhye ye nuokɛ bɛhɔ la, ɔ nye ɛnrɛnwu azɛlɛ ɛhye azo bieko.”
Nrɛlaleɛ mɔɔ Gyɛlɛmaya hanle wɔ Gyɛhɔyakem anwo la
13Munzule ɛha sonla ne mɔɔ ɛnlua nɔhalɛ adenle zo ɛnzi sua
na ɔfa mɔguazo adenle zo ɔsi ye anwuma ekpumgbunli ne
mɔ la;
munzule ɛha sonla ne mɔɔ maa ɔ gɔnwo mɔ yɛ agyili gyima
na ɔndua bɛ kakɛ la.
14Munzule ɛha sonla ne mɔɔ ka kɛ,
“Mesi me sua kpole ko mɔɔ lɛ anwuma ekpumgbunli
mgbole”,
na ɔkɛduodua ye nvɛnzɛlɛ
mɔɔ bɛva sida adaboa bɛbobɔ,
na ɔkɛha ye ayile kɔkɔlɛ la.
15Ɛdwenle kɛ saa ɛfa sida mbaka ɛsisi azua a,
ɛnee ɛle belemgbunli kpalɛ ɔ?
Asoo ɛ ze lile, nlonle
na ɔlile pɛlepɛle, ɔbɔle tenlene ɛbɛla?
Ɛnee noko ye debie biala hɔle zolɛ manle ye.
16Saa ɔlile pɛlepɛle ɔmanle ehyianvolɛma,
yeambua menli mɔɔ ehyia la mgbɔvondɛne a
ɛnee ɔle kpalɛ.
Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, mese, kɛ me ɛnwunlɛ de la ɛne.
17Na wɔmɔ, ɛlɛ ɛnyelɛ nee ahonle
mɔɔ ɛfa ɛwua menli ɛnyia ɛ nwo,
ɛfa ɛka menli mɔɔ ɛnze nwolɛ bie la mogya ɛgua,
na ɛfa ɛsisi wɔ menli ne, ɛyɛ bɛ amumuyɛ.
18 Zɔhane ati Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛha Dwosaya ara Gyɛhɔyakem,
Dwuda belemgbunli ne anwo edwɛkɛ kɛ,
“Awie biala ɛnrɛzu ye kɛ,
‘ayi me diema nrenya,’
anzɛɛ ‘ayi me diema raalɛ.’
Awie biala ɛnrɛye awolɛ ɛnrɛze kɛ,
‘Me menle o,’ anzɛɛ ‘me belemgbunli o!’
19Bɛbahwenle ye aze bɛahɔvuandi ye bɛado Gyɛlusalɛm kandiba
kɛmɔ bɛfuandi asoaso funli bɛto ala la.”
Gyɛlɛmaya ka mɔɔ bara Gyɛlusalɛmma anwo zo la anwo nrɛlaleɛ
20Gyɛlusalɛmma, bɛhɔ Lɛbanɔn bɛhɔzu,
bɛhɔ Beehyan azɛlɛ zo bɛhɔzu kpalɛ;
bɛhɔ Ebalem bɛhɔzu,
ɔluakɛ bɛbɔ bɛ konle nu boavolɛma abo zo.
21Bɛkpazile la mendendɛle mengilele bɛ,
na bɛhanle kɛ bɛnrɛdie.
Subane ɛhye a sumunli bɛ ngakula nu bɛhile a,
kɛ bɛnrɛdie me ne.
22Anwoma ne bapia bɛ adekilevolɛma kɔsɔɔti ahɔ,
na bɛahye bɛ konle nu boavolɛma nuokɛ bɛahɔ nlɔnu.
Bɛ nyunlu bagua aze, nyiane ahu bɛ
wɔ bɛ amumuyɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛyɛ la ati.
23O Lɛbanɔnoma,
mɔɔ bɛde sida azua nu a,
nyane to bɛ a ɛkponlenlɛ mɔɔ bɛbakponle la
bayɛ kɛ raalɛ mɔɔ ɛhɔ ahonleɛ la.
Nyamenle ndeanlɛ mɔɔ wɔ Gyɛhɔyakɛn anwo zo la
24 Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Dwuda Belemgbunli Gyɛhɔyakem ara nrenya Gyɛhɔyakɛn le me sa fema kpɔdelera zo tumi kpɔba bɔbɔ ɛdeɛ, noko sumunli kenle ala mɔɔ medame a mele tease Nyamenle la, mebakpolo wɔ meavi me sa, 25na meaye wɔ meamaa menli mɔɔ ɛlɛkpondɛ wɔ ahu wɔ na ɛsulo bɛ la. Mebava wɔ meamaa Babelonia Belemgbunli Nɛbukadenɛza nee ye ɛlɔnema ne. 26Mebavuandi wɔ nee ɛ nli ne mɔɔ wole wɔ la meahɔgua maanle bie mɔɔ tɛ ɛkɛ ne a bɛwole bɛ la anu. Ɛkɛ ne a bɛbawu a. 27Bɛ nwo balɔ bɛ maanle nu, na bɛ nye ɛnrɛnwu ɛke bieko ɛlɛ.”
28Na menganle kɛ, “Ɛnee Gyɛhɔyakɛn a ɛhakyi dwora ebule mɔɔ bɛkpo ye na awie ɛnva ye bieko la ɔ? Duzu ati a bɛvuandi ye nee ɔ mra bɛhɔgua ɛleka mɔɔ bɛnze la ɛ?”
29O azɛlɛ, azɛlɛ, azɛlɛ!
Tie Ɛdɛnkɛma ane!
30Ɛdɛnkɛma se,
“Kɛlɛ nrenya ɛhye duma kɛ yeanwo ralɛ,
ɔle sonla mɔɔ ɛnrɛyɛ kpalɛ wɔ ɛbɛla nu,
ɔluakɛ ɔ mra ne mɔ biala ɛnrɛli ye agya,
ɛnrɛdɛnla Devidi belemgbunli ebia ne azo,
ɛnrɛzie Dwuda maanle ne bieko ɛlɛ.”

Title: GYƐ 23
Content:
Kenlebie anyelazo
1Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Munzule ɛha mboaneneavolɛma mɔɔ sɛkye me mboane ne mɔ mɔɔ wɔ me adidileka ne, na bɛbɔ bɛ asande la.” 2Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne ɛha mboaneneavolɛma mɔɔ nea ye mboane ne mɔ la anwo edwɛkɛ kɛ, “Bɛnnea me mboane ne mɔ boɛ, bɛvoa bɛ, bɛmaa bɛzande. Bɛnlea, mebadea bɛ wɔ bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ ati. 3Akee mebaboɔboa me mboane ne mɔ mɔɔ ɛha azuamgbole ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti azo, ɛleka mɔɔ memanle bɛhɔguale la anloa mearagua ɛleka ko, wɔ tunli ko anu, na bɛbada, bɛ nwo azo. 4Mebamaa bɛ mboaneneavolɛma mɔɔ banlea bɛ kpalɛ la; bɛnrɛzulo bieko, bɛ ahonle ɛnrɛdu, yɛɛ kokye ɛnrɛminli. Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.
5 “Bɛnlea, mekɛ ɛlɛba mɔɔ mebamaa tenlene Ɛhane akpakye Devidi sua nu. Ɔbali belemgbunli na ɔ nee ye menli ne adɛnla nrɛlɛbɛ nu, yeali edwɛkɛ pɛlepɛle nee tenlene nu wɔ azɛlɛ ne azo. 6Wɔ ye mekɛ zo, Dwudama banyia bɛ ti na Yizilayɛma anwo adɔ bɛ. Duma mɔɔ bɛbava bɛavɛlɛ ye la a le, ‘Ɛdɛnkɛma le tenlenenli.’
7“Yemɔti bɛnlea, mekɛ ɛlɛba mɔɔ menli ɛnrɛha kɛ, ‘Tease Ɛdɛnkɛma mɔɔ yele Yizilayɛma vile Yigyibiti azɛlɛ zo la ati.’ 8Mɔɔ bɛbaha la a le ‘Tease Ɛdɛnkɛma mɔɔ yele Yizilayɛma mɔɔ ɛha la vile sɔlɔ maanle ne nee maanle ngakyile kɔsɔɔti, ɛleka mɔɔ ɔvoanle bɛ ɔhɔle la anu rale la ati.’ Na akee bɛbadɛnla bɛdabɛ bɛ azɛlɛ zo. Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.”
Gyɛlɛmaya nrɛlaleɛ ne mɔɔ fane Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma anwo la
9Me ahonle mɔɔ la me kunlu la ɛbɔndɔ,
me mbowule kɔsɔɔti ɛlɛwozo.
Meyɛ kɛ sonla mɔɔ ɛbo nza la;
ɔlua Ɛdɛnkɛma nee ye edwɛkɛ nwuanzanwuanza ne ati,
meyɛ kɛ sonla mɔɔ nza ɛgya ye la.
10Awuvolɛvalɛma ɛyi azɛlɛ ye;
bɛ nwo munzule ɛzɛkye azɛlɛ ne,
yɛɛ fienemgbole nu adidileka ɛwe.
Bɛ subane ɛnle kpalɛ,
yɛɛ bɛfa bɛ anwosesebɛ bɛsisi awie mɔ.
11Ɛdɛnkɛma se,
“Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma nee sɛlɛvolɛma ɛnze Nyamenle;
menwu kɛ bɛdi ɛtane wɔ me Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne bɔbɔ anu.
12Zɔhane ati bɛ ndenle ne mɔ anu
bayɛ siselesisele, ayɛ awozinli;
bɛbaheha bɛ bɛahɔ nuhua bɛamaa bɛadu bɛagua,
ɔluakɛ mebamaa munzule ara bɛ nwo zo
wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ metea bɛ la.
13Menwu ayahanlɛ debie bie
wɔ Samɛlea Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma anwo:
bɛdendɛle bozonle Beeyale anloa azo,
bɛvale bɛminlinle me menli Yizilayɛma.
14 Menwu debie ɛzulolɛ bie
wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma avinli:
bɛto awuvolɛvalɛ mɛla ne, bɛbɔ adalɛ,
bɛsi amumuyɛma adua,
yemɔti biala ɛngyakyi amumuyɛ ɛyɛlɛ;
bɛ kɔsɔɔti bɛyɛ kɛ Sodɔmma nee Gomɔlama wɔ me nye zo.
15“Yemɔti, medame Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma,
meka ɛhye wɔ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma anwo:
Bɛnlea, mebamaa bɛali aleɛ ɛnwonle,
meamaa bɛ nzule pɔezen bɛanlo,
ɔboalekɛ Gyɛlusalɛm Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma
ɛmmaa menli ne ɛnzonle Nyamenle wɔ maanle ne anu.”
16Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Bɛmmatie Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma nrɛlaleɛ ne mɔɔ bɛka bɛkile bɛ la. Bɛbɔ bɛ ti anu bɛka ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ edwɛkɛ bɛkile bɛ, bɛmaa bɛnyia anyelazo mɔɔ kenle bie ɛlɛ ɔnrɛyɛ zɔhane, na tɛ mame Ɛdɛnkɛma a meva mezoa bɛ la. 17Bɛka bɛkile menli mɔɔ ɛndie me ne la kɛ, ‘Debie biala bayɛ boɛ!’ yɛɛ bɛka bɛkile awie biala mɔɔ yɛ mɔɔ ɔdaye ɔ kunlu dwo nwolɛ la kɛ, ‘Munzule biala ɛnrɛdo wɔ.’ ”
18Menganle kɛ, “Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma ɛhye mɔ anu boni a nee Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛdu agyinla, ɛnwu ye na yede anzɛɛ yedie ye, na yeli ye edwɛkɛ zo a? 19Bɛnlea, Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛya ne ɛlɛtu kpole kɛ ahumuakyima. Ɔbahɔgua ye wɔ amumuyɛma ati zo. 20Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛya ne ɛnrɛdwo, kyesɛ yeyɛ mɔɔ gyi ɔ nye zo la. Kenle bie bɛbade ɔ bo kpalɛ.”
21Ɛdɛnkɛma zele kɛ, “Meanzoa Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma ne mɔ, noko bɛhɔle. Meanga edwɛkɛ biala meangile bɛ, noko bɛhɔhanle nrɛlaleɛ. 22Saa bɛ nee me dule agyinla a, anrɛɛ bɛhanle me nrɛlaleɛ ne bɛhilele me menli ne; anrɛɛ bɛmanle bɛvile ndenle ɛtane ne mɔ azo na bɛhwenle bɛ nwo bɛvile bɛ nyɛleɛ ɛtane ne mɔ anwo.
23“Bɛdwenle kɛ mele Nyamenle mɔɔ ɛbikye me a yɛɛ menwu wɔ a, na ɛwɔ moa a mennwu wɔ? 24Asoo sonla kola fea ɔ nwo mɔɔ mengola mennwu ye a? Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, mese, mewɔ ɛleka kɔsɔɔti, anwuma o, aze o. 25Mede adalɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma fa me duma bɔ, ka bɛ nrɛlaleɛ ne la. Bɛse, ‘Meha ɛlalɛ, meha ɛlalɛ’ 26Kenlenzu a Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma ɛhye mɔ kɛgyakyi adalɛ nrɛlaleɛ ɛhanlɛ a? Bɛbɔ bɛ ti anu bɛka nrɛlaleɛ biala bɛfa bɛbɛlɛbɛla bɛdabɛ bɛ ngome bɛ nwo. 27Bɛdwenle kɛ bɛfa bɛ ɛlalɛ ne mɔɔ bɛka bɛkile bɛ nwo ngoko la bɛabɛlɛbɛla me menli ne bɛamaa bɛ rɛle avi me duma ne, kɛmɔ bɛ ze mɔ arɛle vile me duma ne na bɛzonlenle bozonle Beeyale ne la. 28Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma mɔɔ ka ɛlalɛ la ɛha bɛ ɛlalɛ ne, na Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ mɔɔ ka me nrɛlaleɛ ne la ɛha me nrɛlaleɛ ne nɔhalɛ nu.” Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛlɛbiza kɛ, “Ɛhonle fa ye nienwu a nee awule sɛ a?” 29Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Me edwɛkɛ ne le senle, ɔle kɛ hamenle mɔɔ bɛfa bɛkpukekpuke bodane la. 30Yemɔti bɛnlea, mekyi Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma mɔɔ wua me edwɛkɛ ne fi bɛ gɔnwo mɔ anloa fa ka bɛ nrɛlaleɛ la. 31Mekyi Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma mɔɔ fa bɛ nloa mgbane ka kɛ, ‘Ɛdɛnkɛma se, Ɛdɛnkɛma se’ la. 32Bɛnlea, mekyi bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛka ɛlalɛ adalɛ na bɛfa bɛ adalɛ nee bɛ nloa anu ɛyelɛ bɛdi me menli ne adwenle na bɛminli bɛ wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ metɛsoanle bɛ, anzɛɛ metɛkilele bɛ debie kɛ bɛyɛ la. Menli ne ɛnnyia Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma ne mɔ nyɛleɛ ne azo nvasoɛ biala.”
Ɛdɛnkɛma adesoa ne
33Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me kɛ, “Saa menli ɛhye mɔ bie anzɛɛ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ anzɛɛ sɛlɛvolɛ bie biza wɔ kɛ, ‘Ɛdɛnkɛma adesoa ne a le duzu’ a, ka kile ye kɛ: Mese, bɛmɛ bɛdabɛ a bɛle adesoa bɛmaa me a, na mebavuandi bɛ meagua. Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a. 34Saa Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ, sɛlɛvolɛ anzɛɛ menli ne mɔ bie fa ɔ nloa fula edwɛkɛ agbɔkɛ, ‘Ɛdɛnkɛma adesoa’ a, mebadea ye nee ye sua nu amra. 35Edwɛkɛ mɔɔ bɛha bɛhile bɛ nwo ngoko nee bɛ mediema la a le, ‘Duzu mualɛ a Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛva ɛmaa a?’ anzɛɛ ‘Duzu edwɛkɛ a Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛha a?’ 36Na edwɛkɛ agbɔkɛ, ‘Ɛdɛnkɛma adesoa’ ne ɛdeɛ, bɛmmabɔ zolɛ bieko, ɔluakɛ adesoa ne a le bɛdabɛ bɛ nloa edwɛkɛ. Bɛmɛ, bɛsi tease Nyamenle ne mɔɔ le Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, yɛ Nyamenle ne la anloa edwɛkɛ ne ati aze. 37Mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛbiza Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ ne la a le kɛ, ‘Duzu mualɛ a Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛva ɛmaa a?’ anzɛɛ ‘Duzu edwɛkɛ a Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛha a?’ 38Na saa bɛka kɛ, ‘Ɛdɛnkɛma adesoa ne’, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ meze bɛ kɛ bɛmmaka kɛ, ‘Ɛdɛnkɛma adesoa’ la a, 39mebavuandi bɛ meagua meavi me nye zo. Mebazɛkye bɛ nee suakpole ne mɔɔ menvale memanle bɛ nee bɛ ze mɔ la. 40Mebamaa bɛ nyunlu agua aze, bɛabɔ anyiemgba mɔɔ bɛ rɛle ɛnrɛvi ye kenle bie ɛlɛ a.”

Title: GYƐ 24
Content:
Feege ahɛndɛne nwiɔ
1 Mɔɔ Babelonia Belemgbunli Nɛbukadenɛza hyele Gyɛhɔyakem ara nrenya Gyɛhɔyakɛn, Dwuda belemgbunli ne, maanle mgbanyinli, yɛɛ dwinvolɛma vile Gyɛlusalɛm hɔle nlɔnu wɔ Babelonia la, Ɛdɛnkɛma yele ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ ɛhye hilele me. Menwunle kɛ feege ahɛndɛne nwiɔ gyigyi Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anyunlu ɛkɛ. 2Kɛndɛne ko anu feege ne mɔ le kpalɛ, eza bɛbolo ngɛnlɛma, na kɛndɛne ko ne mɔɔ ɛha la anu feege ɛdeɛ ne ɛnle kpalɛ fee, bɛdi a ɔnyɛ boɛ. 3Ɛdɛnkɛma bizale me kɛ, “Gyɛlɛmaya, duzu a ɛnwu ye la?”
Membuale kɛ, “Feege ɔ; bie mɔ le kpalɛ, yɛɛ bie mɔ ɛnle kpalɛ fee mɔɔ bɛdi a.”
4Akee Ɛdɛnkɛma dendɛle hilele me. Ɔse, 5“Mebava Dwudama mɔɔ memaa bɛhye bɛ bɛhɔ nlɔnu wɔ Babelonia la meado feege kpalɛ ne mɔ anwo. Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle a mese a. 6Mebanwu bɛ anwunvɔne, meava bɛ meazia meara azɛlɛ ɛhye azo. Mebazɔ bɛ meamaa bɛagyinla, menrɛmaa bɛnrɛgolo bɛnrɛgua; mebalua bɛ, menrɛdudu bɛ menrɛgua. 7Mebamaa bɛ ahonle meamaa bɛanwu kɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a; bɛbayɛ me menli na meayɛ bɛ Nyamenle, ɔluakɛ bɛbava bɛ ahonle kɔsɔɔti bɛazia bɛara me ɛkɛ.”
8Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Kɛmɔ feege ɛhendeɛ ne mɔ le mgbane mgbane mɔɔ bɛdi a ɔnyɛ boɛ la, zɔhane ala a mebayɛ Dwuda Belemgbunli Zɛdikaya, ye mgbanyima nee Gyɛlusalɛmma mɔɔ ɛha azɛlɛ ɛhye azo, yɛɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛde Yigyibiti azɛlɛ zo la a. 9Mebazɛkye bɛ meamaa yeayɛ maanle maanle amuala ɛzulolɛ. Menli bazi bɛ amgbu, agolo bɛ nwo, agua bɛ nyunlu aze, ava bɛ duma apɛ ɛfenle wɔ ɛleka biala mɔɔ menwɔmaa bɛkɛhɔgua bɛ la. 10Mebava konle, ɛhɔne, yɛɛ ewule meazi bɛ zo toonwo meamaa bɛ bo zo abɔ tɔɔ wɔ azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ menvale memanle bɛ nee bɛ ze mɔ la azo.”

Title: GYƐ 25
Content:
Kpɔvolɛ ne mɔɔ vi Sɔlɔ la
1 Dwuda Belemgbunli Gyɛhɔyakem, Dwosaya ara nrenya ne dɛnlanle ebia zo la, ye ɛvolɛ nna ne anu, Ɛdɛnkɛma dendɛle hilele Gyɛlɛmaya wɔ Dwudama amuala anwo. Mekɛ ne anu ɛnee Babelonia Belemgbunli Nɛbukadenɛza ɛli ɛvolɛ ko wɔ ebia zo. 2Ɔhanle ɔhilele Gyɛlusalɛmma nee Dwudama amuala kɛ, 3“Ye ɛvolɛ abulanwiɔ nee nsa ɛne, ɔvi mekɛ mɔɔ bɛvale Emɔn ara nrenya Dwosaya bɛziele belemgbunli wɔ Dwuda la, ye ɛvolɛ bulu nee nsa ne azo, yɛɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma dendɛle hilele me a, na meha mehile bɛ toonwo a yeradwu ɛnɛ a, noko bɛandie. 4Ɛdɛnkɛma soa ye kpɔmanvolɛma la ɛnee ɔsoa bɛ, noko bɛangyea bɛ nzo kɛ bɛtie. 5Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma ne ka kile bɛ kɛ: Awie biala ɛgyakyi amumuyɛ nee ɛtane ɛyɛlɛ na ɔdɛnla azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛva ɛmaa bɛ nee bɛ ze mɔ dɛbadɛba kɛ ɔle bɛ ɛdeɛ la azo dahuu. 6Bɛmmadi nyamenle gyɛne gyɛne nzi, bɛyeyɛ bɛ, bɛsonle bɛ, yɛɛ bɛmmafa bɛ sa anloa adwinli bɛka me ɛya. Na saa bɛanyɛ ɛhye mɔ a, mebamaa bɛ nwo adɔ bɛ. 7Noko bɛmɛ, bɛandie me ne; bɛva bɛ sa anloa adwinli bɛha me ɛya bɛmaa ngyegyelɛ ɛdo bɛ.
8“Yemɔti, medame Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, mese: Kɛmɔ bɛandie me ne la, 9bɛnlea, meto me sa meavɛlɛ sɔlɔ mbusua ekpunli ne mɔ amuala nee me sonvolɛ Babelonia Belemgbunli Nɛbukadenɛza, meamaa bɛ nee azɛlɛ ɛhye azo amra nee maanle maanle mɔɔ zuozua ye la amuala anu amra araho. Mebazɛkye maanle ɛhye nee maanle maanle mɔɔ zuozua ye la bɔkɔɔ mɔɔ awie dwu nu a ɔbɔ mgbatike, na meagua bɛ nyunlu aze mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ a. 10 Eza mebamaa bɛ fɛlɛkolilɛ nee bɛ anyelielɛ abɔ bɛ, bɛnrɛlie atɔfolɛ bieko; bɛnrɛzɔ kɛnlaneɛ, yɛɛ bɛnrɛde ɛdibolɛ ne. 11 Azɛlɛ ɛhye kɔsɔɔti bazɛkye ayɛ mgbane, na maanle maanle ɛhye mɔ azonle Babelonia belemgbunli ne ɛvolɛ abulasuu. 12Ɛvolɛ abulasuu ne anzi, mebadea Babeloniama nee bɛ belemgbunli ne wɔ bɛ ɛtane ti; Babelonia maanle ne bayɛ maanle mgbane mɔɔ ɛnrɛdwazo bieko ɛlɛ a, medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a. 13Munzule edwɛkɛ biala mɔɔ melua me kpɔmanvolɛ Gyɛlɛmaya anwo zo meha, mɔɔ fane maanle maanle ɛhye mɔ anwo, na bɛhɛlɛ bɛ wɔ buluku ɛhye anu la bado bɛ. 14Mebadua Babelonia kakɛ wɔ bɛ nyɛleɛ nee bɛ sa anloa gyima ti; bɛbayɛ ngɛkɛlɛ bɛamaa maanle maanle dɔɔnwo nee arelemgbunli mgbole.”
Nyamenle ndeanlɛ mɔɔ bara maanle maanle ne mɔ anwo zo la
15Akee Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne zele me kɛ, “Gyɛlɛmaya, die nwanye dwora ɛhye, mɔɔ me ɛya ɛyi ye tɛkɛɛ la kɔmaa maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti mɔɔ menwɔzoa wɔ bɛ nwo ɛkɛ la ɛnlo. 16Bɛbanlo bɛabo, bɛayɛ tindaanwu ɔlua konle mɔɔ melɛmaa yearado bɛ la ati.”
17Yemɔti menliele dwora ne wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma asa anu menvale mengɔmanle maanle maanle mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma zoanle me bɛ nwo ɛkɛ ne la na memanle bɛnlonle Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛya ne. 18Gyɛlusalɛm nee Dwuda azuamgbole, bɛ arelemgbunli nee bɛ mgbanyima nlonle, amaa menli ne ayɛ mgbane, na azuamgbole ne mɔ ayɛ azuadu mɔɔ menli finde zolɛ a bɛbɔ mgbatike na bɛava bɛ duma bɛawa amonle, kɛmɔ ɛnɛ nee ɛnɛ ala ɔde la.
19-26Menli noko mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ no dwora ne anu bie la ɛne:
Yigyibiti belemgbunli ne nee ye mbɔlɔba nee ye mgbanyima;
Yigyibitima amuala nee nyɛvolɛ mɔɔ de Yigyibiti la amuala.
Ɛɛze arelemgbunli kɔsɔɔti;
arelemgbunli mɔɔ wɔ Filisitia azuamgbole Ahyekɛlɔn, Gaza,
Ɛkelɔn azo la amuala, yɛɛ Ahyedɔdoma mɔɔ hale la.
Yidɔmma, Mowabema, yɛɛ Amɔnoma amuala;
arelemgbunli mɔɔ wɔ Taya nee Saedɛn la amuala;
arelemgbunli mɔɔ wɔ Mɛdetɛlenia nyevile ne anloa la amuala,
azuamgbole Didan, Tima, yɛɛ Bɛɛze.
Menli ne mɔɔ pepɛ bɛ ti enrinli maa ɔka aze la amuala;
arelemgbunli mɔɔ wɔ Areleebea la amuala;
arelemgbunli mɔɔ sie mbusua ekpunli ekpunli mɔɔ wɔ ɛsɛlɛ ne azo la amuala;
arelemgbunli mɔɔ wɔ Zemelae, Yilam, yɛɛ Midea la amuala;
arelemgbunli mɔɔ wɔ sɔlɔ, bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛbikye nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ moa la amuala nlonle ye bɛ ti bɛ ti;
yɛɛ arelemgbunli mɔɔ wɔ ewiade la amuala nlonle bie.
Bɛno bɛwie a akee Babelonia belemgbunli ne ɔdaye ɔbanlo bie.
27Akee Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me kɛ, “Ka kile menli ne kɛ, medame Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne, mese: Bɛnlo, bɛbo na bɛfefe bɛ nwo toonwo bɛdu bɛgua mɔɔ bɛndwazo bieko a, ɔboalekɛ melɛmaa konle arado bɛ.
28“Saa bɛkpo kɛ bɛnrɛlie dwora ne bɛnrɛnlo me ɛya ne a, se bɛ kɛ: Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma se, ‘Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛno! 29Ɔluakɛ bɛnlea, mebɔ ɔ bo wɔ suakpole ne mɔɔ me duma la zolɛ la azo melɛsɛkye ninyɛne. Bɛdwenle kɛ bɛmɛ bɛbava bɛ nwo dwɔɔ ɔ? Kyɛkyɛ, mebadea bɛ, ɔluakɛ memaa konle adɔ ewiade amra amuala avinli. Medame Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.’
30“Gyɛlɛmaya, ka nrɛlaleɛ ɛhye kɔsɔɔti tia menli ne kɛ:
Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, mebadea nu wɔ anwuma,
mebadendɛ meavi me ɛleka nwuanzanwuanza ne;
mebadea me menli ne nu kpole kpalɛ,
kɛ sonla mɔɔ twihwi vanye ma nu nzule la
meatia aleɛabo amra kɔsɔɔti.
31Me ne badwu ewiade ɛleka biala.
Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, melɛ edwɛkɛ metia ewiade amra kɔsɔɔti.
Mebabua awie biala ndɛne,
na meahu amumuyɛma.
Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.”
32Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma se munzule ɛlɛkpɔsa vi maanle zo ahɔ maanle zo. Ahumu ɛsesebɛ bie ɛlɛtu vi azɛlɛ ye ati moa moa ara. 33Kenle zɔhane menli mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛhu bɛ la avunli bagua ye yɛlɛdɛdɛ, ɔvi maanle ti yeahɔdwu maanle bo. Bɛnrɛzu bɛ, bɛnrɛboɔboa bɛ nloa, yɛɛ bɛnrɛzie bɛ. Bɛbagua ye kɛ nyɛmoa ebinli wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo.
34Bɛmɛ mboaneneavolɛma, bɛzu bɛye awolɛ. Bɛmɛ menli ne mgbanyima, bɛzu bɛva nzonle bɛbɔ bɛ nwo, ɔluakɛ bɛ ɛhunlɛ nee bɛ ɛzɛkyelɛ mekɛ ɛdwu; yemɔti bɛbahu bɛ kɛ mboane mɔɔ ɛlɔ la. 35Mboaneneavolɛma ne ɛnrɛnyia ɛvealeka; menli ne mgbanyima ne mɔ ɛnrɛvi ɛsalɛ. 36Bɛdie, mboaneneavolɛma ne mɔ ɛlɛsu; menli ne mgbanyima ne mɔ ɛlɛsu aye awolɛ! Ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛva ɛya ɛzɛkye bɛ maanle ne, 37yezɛkye anzonudwolɛ menli ne bɔkɔɔ, ɔboalekɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛva ɛya kpole. 38Ɔlua nzisima konle konle ne mɔ ati Ɛdɛnkɛma bava ɛya kpole avinde kɛ awenade vi kpɔkɛ bo finde la yearabɔ bɛ maanle ne, na bɛ azɛlɛ ne adɔ mgbane.

Title: GYƐ 26
Content:
Bɛdi Gyɛlɛmaya edwɛkɛ
