15Na ɔzele me kɛ, “Sonla ra, asoo wɔnwu ɛhye. Ɛbanwu bɛkyi ninyɛne mgbole mɔɔ tɛla ɛhye mɔ la.” 16Akee ɔvale me ɔhɔle Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne alie ne mɔɔ wɔ ɔ kunlu lɔ la anwo. Na menwunle kɛ menli abulanwiɔ nee nnu gyigyi Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anlenkɛ ne anyunlu wɔ azukponle ne nee alie nwo nwolodo ne avinli, bɛhakyi bɛ nzi bɛzi Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne, bɛ nye kɔ aduduleɛ na bɛlɛsonle sɛnzɛne ne.
17Na Nyamenle zele me kɛ, “Sonla ra, wɔnwu ɛhye ɔ? Asoo ɔle kpalɛ kɛ Dwudama kɛbɔ munzule kpole ɛhye mɔɔ bɛbɔ ye ɛke la, na bɛkɛva kɔdiawu ɛbɛla bɛkɛkponde azɛlɛ ne azo amuala, na bɛkɛha me ɛya ɔ? Nea, bɛdabɛ bɛva baka bɛzinla bɛ bonyi. 18Yemɔti mebava ɛya me nee bɛ ali. Menrɛvavi bie yɛɛ menrɛze anwunvɔne, bɛbazu ɛzunlɛ kpole bɔbɔ bɛavɛlɛ me, noko menrɛde bɛ ne.”

Title: YIZ 9
Content:
Bɛdea Gyɛlusalɛm
1Akee mendele kɛ Nyamenle deanle nu kɛ, “Bɛdabɛ suakpole ye sinzavolɛma, bɛrɛla ɛke. Biala ɛva ye konle ninyɛne ne mɔ.” 2Na menli nsia vi anwuma lɔ anlenkɛ kpole ne anwo rale, ko biala lɛ ye konle ninyɛne mɔɔ ɔbava yeahu menli ne la ɔ sa nu. Nrenya bie mɔɔ wula lenen tɛladeɛ la nee bɛ a lua a, na ngɛlata kodoku zia ye foa ko. Na bɛwolole Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu bɛhɔgyinlanle kɔbele azukponle ne anwo.
3Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne anyunlunyia ne vi tease abɔdeɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ dede Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu la anu ɛhɔ. Ɔvɛlɛle nrenya ne mɔɔ wula lenen tɛladeɛ ne na ngɛlata kodoku ne zia ye foa ko la. 4 Na Ɛdɛnkɛma zele ye kɛ, “Kɔ Gyɛlusalɛm suakpole ne azo amuala na fa sɛkɛlɛneɛ to awie biala mɔɔ ɛlɛdi nyane wɔ munzule ɛbɛla mɔɔ bɛbɔ wɔ zolɛ la anwo la anwoma azo.”
5Na mendele kɛ ɔlɛka yeahile menli ɛhendeɛ ne mɔ kɛ, “Bɛli ɔ nzi bɛhɔ suakpole ne azo amuala, bɛhɔhu bɛ. Bɛmmafavi bie, yɛɛ bɛmmase anwunvɔne. 6Bɛhu mrenya mgbanyinli, mgbavolɛ nee mbɛlɛra, ngakula nee mraalɛ kɔsɔɔti, noko bɛmmafa bɛ sa bɛka awie biala mɔɔ lɛ nzonlɛ ne wɔ ɔ nwoma azo la. Bɛbɔ ɔ bo wɔ me ɛleka nwuanzanwuanza ne.” Yemɔti bɛbɔle ɔ bo wɔ mgbanyima ne mɔ mɔɔ gyi Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anyunlu la anwo zo.
7Na Nyamenle zele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛhɔ! Bɛhɔsesa avunli ne mɔ bɛragua Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ye anu bɛgua nwolɛ evinli.” Yemɔti bɛhɔle suakpole ne azo na bɛhunle menli ne mɔ.
8Mɔɔ bɛlɛku menli ne mɔ na ɔhale me ngome la, mendule mendɔle mutule nu na mendeanle nu kɛ, “O, Awulae Nyamenle! Ɛfa Gyɛlusalɛm anwo ɛya wɔahu Yizilayɛma mɔɔ ɛha la ɔ?”
9Na Nyamenle zele me kɛ, “Yizilayɛma nee Dwudama ɛtane ne akee ɛbo zolɛ. Mogya ɛva azɛlɛ ne, yɛɛ nzisi ɛva suakpole ye, ɔluakɛ bɛ edwɛkɛ a le kɛ, ‘Ɛdɛnkɛma arɛle ɛvi maanle ne, yɛɛ ɔnnwu ɛhwee.’ 10Mame medame, menrɛvavi yɛɛ menrɛze anwunvɔne. Mɔɔ bɛyɛ la, memaa yeabɔ bɛ ti tɔ.”
11Na nrenya ne mɔɔ wula lenen tɛladeɛ ne, na ngɛlata kodoku ne zia ye foa ko la rale na ɔrahanle kɛ, “Meyɛ debie biala kɛmɔ ɛzele me la.”

Title: YIZ 10
Content:
Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlunyia ne fi Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu
1 Akee memanle me nye zo, na menwunle kɛ, wɔ deɛ ne mɔɔ ɛdo ɛbɛnra abɔdeɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ lɛ ndɛbalɛ la ati ne mɔ anwo la azo, debie bie mɔɔ le kɛ belemgbunli ebia, mɔɔ bɛva sanyia bolɛ ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye safaya la bɛyɛ la gyi zolɛ anwuma. 2 Nyamenle zele nrenya ne mɔɔ wula lenen tɛladeɛ ne la kɛ, “Kɔwolo ehwili ne mɔ mɔɔ wɔ tease abɔdeɛ ne mɔ abo la avinli na fula samɛnlankɛ ne bie kɔzande ye wɔ suakpole ne azo.”
Ɔkɔ la me nye gyi ɔ nwo. 3Mekɛ mɔɔ nrenya ne kawolo ehwili ne anu la ɛnee tease abɔdeɛ ne mɔ gyigyi Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne nyiakɛ, na amungu ne rayile Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne akunlu alie nwo ɛkɛ. 4Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlunyia ne vi tease abɔdeɛ ne mɔ ati zo hɔle Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu. Amungu ne rayile sua ne, na Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlunyia ne yile alie nwo ɛkɛ ne manle ɔyɛle wienyi. 5Saa awie wɔ findezo alie nwo nehane na ɔte abɔdeɛ ne mɔ andɛba mɔɔ bɛlɛbɔ nu la ane a, ɔle kɛ Nyamenle Bedevinli ne ɛlɛtendɛ la.
6Nyamenle zele nrenya ne mɔɔ wula lenen tɛladeɛ ne la kɛ ɔhɔvula senle wɔ tease abɔdeɛ ne mɔ ehwili ne mɔ avinli na ɔhɔle la, ɔhɔgyinlanle ehwili ko anwo. 7Na tease abɔdeɛ ne mɔ ko vale ɔ sa bɔle senle ne mɔɔ wɔ tease abɔdeɛ nna ne mɔ avinli la anu vulale bie guale nrenya ne asa anu. Nrenya ne liele na ɔhɔle.
8Tease abɔdeɛ ne mɔ lɛ debie bie mɔɔ le kɛ sonla sa la wɔ bɛ ndɛba ne mɔ abo. 9 Meneanle la eza menwunle kɛ ehwili nna gyigyi abɔdeɛ ne mɔ anwo ɛkɛ, abɔdeɛ ko biala ehwili ko. Ehwili ne mɔ ta kɛ ezukoa bolɛ. 10Bɛ muala bɛzɔho bɛ nwo kɛ asɛɛ ehwili ko de ko noko anu. 11Saa bɛtu bɛ bo kɛ bɛlɛkɔ a, bɛkola bɛkɔ bɛ tɛbanu nna ne mɔ anu biala mɔɔ bɛngakyi anzɛɛ bɛmpɛne bɛ nwo a. 12 Ɛnyelɛ duodua ehwili kɛba ne mɔ nee nuhua mbulalɛ meɛbeanu ne mɔ amuala anwo, yɛɛ ehwili nna ne mɔɔ bɛlɛ la, biala anwo le ɛnyelɛ ngome. 13Na mendele kɛ bɛfɛlɛ ehwili ne mɔ “Akyima Ehwili.”
14 Tease abɔdeɛ ko biala anyunlu nna. Mɔɔ lumua la zɔho ɛnlankɛ nyinli, mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nwiɔ la le sonla, mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nsa la le awenade, yɛɛ mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nna la le kɔleɛ. 15(Bɛdabɛ ko ne ala a menwunle bɛ wɔ Azule Kibaa ne anloa la.) Saa tease abɔdeɛ ne mɔ maa bɛ nwo zo 16kɛ bɛlɛkɔ a, ehwili ne mɔ sianle bɛ, yɛɛ saa bɛbɔ bɛ ndɛba anu bɛtu a, ehwili ne mɔ ɛnga aze. 17Saa bɛgyinla a, ɛnee ehwili ne mɔ ɛgyinla, yɛɛ saa bɛtu bɛ bo a, ɛnee ehwili ne mɔ ɛdu bɛ bo. Ɔluakɛ tease abɔdeɛ ne mɔ sunsum ne wɔ ehwili ne mɔ anu.
18Akee Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlunyia ne vi Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anuhɔlɛ ne yele ɔ nwo hɔzinzele tease abɔdeɛ nna ne ati zo anwuma. 19Na menwunle kɛ tease abɔdeɛ ne mɔ dɛlɛle bɛ ndɛba anu na bɛdule, ehwili ne mɔ boka bɛ. Bɛhɔgyinlanle Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne aduduleɛ anlenkɛ ne anloa, na Yizilayɛ Nyamenle anyunlunyia ne ɛheda bɛ nwo zo. 20Bɛdabɛ ko ne ala a bɛle tease abɔdeɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ menwunle bɛ Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne abo wɔ Azule Kibaa ne anloa la.
21Ko biala lɛ ɔ nyunlu nna, ɔ ndɛba nna, yɛɛ debie bie mɔɔ le kɛ sonla ɛsalɛ la wɔ bɛ ndɛba ne mɔ abo. 22Bɛ nyunlu kile kɛ bɛdabɛ ko ne ala a menwunle bɛ wɔ Azule Kibaa ne anloa la. Ko biala maa ɔ nwo zo a, ɔkɔ ɔ nyunlu fɔɔnwo.

Title: YIZ 11
Content:
Bɛbua Gyɛlusalɛm fɔlɛ kɛ ɔbabɔ
1Nyamenle Sunsum ne manle membale Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne aduduleɛ anlenkɛ ne anloa. Na menwunle menli abulanwiɔ nee nnu wɔ anuhɔlɛ ne, Ezɛ ara Gyeeyazanaya nee Bɛnaya ara Pɛlataya, mɔɔ le maanle ne anu mgbanyinli la boka nwolɛ.
2Na Nyamenle zele me kɛ, “Sonla ra, menli ɛhye mɔ a bɔ maamɔvo kpɔkɛ na bɛtu suakpole ne azo amra folɛ ɛtane la. 3Bɛ edwɛkɛ se kɛ, ‘Ɔtɛdwule mekɛ mɔɔ yɛsisi azua a; suakpole ɛhye le kɛ danesɛne kpole bie, yɛɛ yɛmɛ yɛle fɛlɛ yɛwɔ nu.’ 4Yemɔti ka Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ ne tia bɛ, o sonla ra, ka Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ ne.”
5Ɛdɛnkɛma Sunsum ne wolole me na ɔzele me kɛ menga kɛ, “Ɛdɛnkɛma se, O, Yizilayɛma, kɛ bɛ adwenle yɛ bɛ la ɛhye ɔ? Meze debie biala mɔɔ wɔ bɛ adwenle nu la. 6Bɛhu menli dɔɔnwo kpalɛ wɔ suakpole ye azo, na ye kpalɛ ne mɔ amuala azo ɛyɛ avunli ngome.
7“Yemɔti kɛ medame Awulae Nyamenle ne mese la ɛne: Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛhu bɛ bɛgua kpalɛ ne mɔ azo la, bɛ avunli a le fɛlɛ ne, yɛɛ suakpole ye a le danesɛne kpole ne, na bɛmɛ, bɛbaye bɛ bɛavi suakpole ye azo bɛavinde. 8Bɛzulo dadeɛ nloa ewule; na kɛkala, mebamaa bɛawu dadeɛ nloa. Medame Awulae Nyamenle a mese a. 9Mebaye bɛ kɔsɔɔti meavinde na meaye bɛ meamaa nyɛvolɛ adea bɛ. 10Bɛbadɔ amolɛ nu wɔ konle nu; mebadea bɛ toonwo meahɔdwu Yizilayɛ ɛweɛne zo, na bɛanwu kɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a. 11Suakpole ɛhye ɛnrɛyɛ bɛ danesɛne kpole, yɛɛ bɛdabɛ noko bɛnrɛyɛ nuhua fɛlɛ. Mebadea bɛ toonwo meahɔdwu Yizilayɛ ɛweɛne zo, 12na bɛanwu kɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a. Ɔluakɛ bɛanli me mɛla ne mɔ azo, yɛɛ bɛanli me ngyehyɛlɛ zo, na bɛli maanle maanle mɔɔ zuozua bɛ la maamɛla zo.”
13Mɔɔ me nloa wɔ zolɛ melɛka Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ ne la, Pɛlataya mɔɔ ɔ ze a le Bɛnaya la wule. Ɛkɛ ne ala, membutule mutule nu, na mendeanle nuhua kpole kɛ, “O, Awulae Nyamenle, ɛbɔ Yizilayɛma ekyi mɔɔ ɛha la abo zo ɔ?”
Nyamenle ɛwɔkɛ mɔɔ ɔbɔle bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛhyele bɛ bɛhɔle nlɔnu la
14Ɛdɛnkɛma dendɛle hilele me. 15Ɔse, “Sonla ra, menli mɔɔ wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm la ɛlɛka ɛdawɔ nee ɛ gɔnwo mɔ mɔɔ wɔ nlɔnu la anwo edwɛkɛ kɛ, ‘Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛhye bɛ bɛhɔ nlɔnu la wɔ moa; bɛ nee Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ avinli ɛde; kɛkala, azɛlɛ ye ɛyɛ yɛ ɛdeɛ.’
16“Zɔhane ati ka kile bɛ kɛ, ‘Awulae Nyamenle ne se: Medame yɛɛ menvale bɛ mengɔle maanle zo moa moa na membɔle bɛ memkpondenle maanle maanle ne mɔ avinli a; noko me nee bɛ lua maanle biala mɔɔ bɛhɔ nu la anu.’ 17Yemɔti ka kile bɛ kɛ, ‘Awulae Nyamenle ne se: Mebaboɔboa bɛ nloa meavi menli ne mɔ anu, na meaye bɛ meavi maanle maanle mɔɔ me nee bɛ hɔle nu la anu, meazia meara, na meava Yizilayɛ azɛlɛ ye meamaa bɛ. 18Saa bɛsia bɛba a, bɛbayeye ninyɛne ɛtane ɛtane nee bɛkyi debie biala mɔɔ wɔ azɛlɛ ne azo la amuala.
19 “ ‘Mebamaa bɛanyia ahonle fofolɛ na meamaa bɛ sunsum fofolɛ. Mebaye bolɛ ahonle ne wɔ bɛ nuhua na meamaa bɛ tieyɛ ahonle. 20Bɛbazie me mɛla ne nee me ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔ na bɛali zolɛ; bɛbayɛ me menli na meayɛ bɛ Nyamenle. 21Na bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛse bɛkɔ zolɛ bɛayɛ ninyɛne ɛtane ɛtane na bɛabɔ bɛkyi ɛbɛla la, mebamaa bɛ nyɛleɛ ne mɔ abɔ bɛ ti tɔ. Medame, Awulae Nyamenle yɛɛ mese a.’ ”
Nyamenle anyunlunyia ne fi Gyɛlusalɛm
22 Tease abɔdeɛ ne mɔ akee bɔle bɛ ndɛba nu dule, ehwili ne mɔ li bɛ foa ko, na Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne anyunlunyia ne zinzele bɛ nwo zo. 23Na Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlunyia ne vi suakpole ne azo yele ɔ nwo na ɔhɔzinzele boka ne mɔɔ wɔ suakpole ne aduduleɛ la azo. 24Akee Nyamenle Sunsum ne vale me luale ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ ne anu ziale rale Babelonia wɔ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛhye bɛ bɛhɔ nlɔnu la avinli. Akee me nye zo tetele me. 25Na menganle mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛye ɛhile me la amuala mengilele nlɔnuma ne.

Title: YIZ 12
Content:
Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ ne yɛ nriandivolɛ
1Ɛdɛnkɛma dendɛle hilele me. 2 Ɔse, “Sonla ra, ɛde menli anzosesebɛma mɔɔ ɛngyɛ na ade atua la avinli. Bɛlɛ ɛnyelɛ, noko bɛnnwu debie; bɛlɛ ɛnzonlɛ, noko bɛnde edwɛkɛ, ɔluakɛ bɛle atuadelɛma.
3“Yemɔti, sonla ra, kyekye bɔlɛ na yɛ kɛ sonla mɔɔ bɛhye ye bɛ nee ye ɛlɛkɔ nlɔnu la. Tɔ adenle zo alehyenlɛ nu mɔɔ awie biala anye dua wɔ kɛ ɛlɛkɔ nlɔnu la. Yɛ ɛ nwo kɛ sonla mɔɔ ɛlɛkɔ nlɔnu la na ɛvi ɛleka ko kɔ ɛleka fofolɛ. Bɛ nzo yɛ se, yɛɛ bɛde atua ɛdeɛ, noko wɔannea a bɛbade ɔ bo. 4Alehyenlɛ ne anu, ɛbaboɔboa wɔ ninyɛne ne mɔ anloa wɔ bɛ nye zo, na ye nɔsolɛ nu wɔadɔ adenle zo wɔ bɛ nye zo, kɛmɔ menli mɔɔ kɔ nlɔnu la yɛ la. 5Funvu bane ne anu fiti tɔ ɔ nzi wɔ bɛ nye zo ɛkɛ ne, na dua nuhua finde. 6Bɛ nye zo ɛkɛ ne ala, maa wɔ bɔlɛ ne zo to ɛ kɔme zo na tɔ awozinli ne anu kɔ. Keda ɛ nyunlu, amaa wɔannwu ɛleka mɔɔ ɛlɛkɔ la. Ɔluakɛ meva wɔ meyɛ sɛkɛlɛneɛ memaa Yizilayɛma.”
7Menyɛle mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me la. Alehyenlɛ ne anu, menkyekyele me bɔlɛ kɛ sonla mɔɔ ɛlɛkɔ nlɔnu la; nɔsolɛ nu menvale me sa menvunvunle bane ne anu menfitile mendɔle ɔ nzi, na bɛ nye zo ɛkɛ ne ala, menvale me bɔlɛ mendole me kɔme zo na mendɔle awozinli ne anu mengɔle.
8Aleɛ hyenle la Ɛdɛnkɛma dendɛle hilele me. 9Ɔse, “Sonla ra, se Yizilayɛ atuadelɛma akee ɛbiza wɔ kɛ, ‘Duzu a ɛlɛyɛ la?’ 10Ka kile bɛ kɛ, ‘Awulae Nyamenle ne se, nyɛleɛ ɛhye fane kpanyinli ne mɔɔ ɛlɛbu Gyɛlusalɛm maanle ne nee Yizilayɛma mɔɔ wɔ zolɛ la amuala anwo.’ 11Ka kile bɛ kɛ, mɔɔ wɔyɛ la le sɛkɛlɛneɛ maa bɛ. Mɔɔ wɔyɛ la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ bɛbava bɛayɛ bɛ a. Bɛbahye bɛ nuokɛ bɛ nee bɛ ahɔ nlɔnu. 12Na belemgbunli ne mɔɔ sie bɛ la bava ye bɔlɛ ado ɔ kɔme zo nɔɔzo, na yeanriandi yeahɔ. Ɔbavunvu bane ne anu yeafiti yeadɔ ɔ nzi, na yealua nu yeahɔ. Ɔbaheda ɔ ti zo, amaa yeannwu azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ ɔlɛkɔ zolɛ la azo. 13 Na mebagua ye asawu meahye ye me ɛhane nu. Mebava ye meahɔ nlɔnu wɔ suakpole Babelɔn azo, wɔ Babelonia azɛlɛ zo, mɔɔ ɔdaye mumua ne ɔnrɛnwu ye a. Ɛkɛ ne yɛɛ ɔbawu a. 14Mebabɔ menli mɔɔ ɛbɔ ɛyia ye wɔ ye suakunlu ɛkɛ ne, mɔɔ tu ye folɛ yɛɛ ye ɛlɔnema kɔsɔɔti asande meahɔgua ɛleka kɔsɔɔti, na meamaa menli ahoto ahɔhu bɛ.
15“Saa mebɔ bɛ asande na mekponde bɛ wɔ maanle maanle avinli a, yɛɛ bɛbanwu kɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a. 16Noko mebamaa bɛ nuhua ekyi avi ɛsalɛ, mɔɔ bɛnrɛhu bɛ, yɛɛ ewulenzane nee ɛhɔne ɛnrɛmaa bɛnrɛwu, amaa bɛaha bɛ bɛkyi nyɛleɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛyɛle la bɛahile maanle maanle mɔɔ bɛkɛhɔdo bɛ la, na bɛanwu kɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a.”
Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ ne mɔɔ anwo wozo ye la anwo sɛkɛlɛneɛ
17Eza Ɛdɛnkɛma dendɛle hilele me. 18Ɔse, “Sonla ra, saa ɛdi aleɛ a fa anwowozolɛ di, yɛɛ ɛno nzule a fa anwowozolɛ nee sulosulo no. 19Ka kile maanle ne anu amra kɛ, ‘Edwɛkɛ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ka ye wɔ menli mɔɔ de Gyɛlusalɛm nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ Yizilayɛ azɛlɛ zo la anwo la ɛne: Bɛbava sulosulo bɛali aleɛ, na bɛava arɛlebɔlɛ bɛanlo nzule, ɔboalekɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛde azɛlɛ ne azo la ahɔdiawu ɛbɛla ne ati, bɛ azɛlɛ ne badɔ mgbane. 20Bɛ azuamgbole mɔɔ azo ɛyɛ gbudugbudu la amuala bayɛ azuadu, na azɛlɛ ne azo ayɛ nyanyoo, na bɛanwu kɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a!’ ”
Ɛrɛlɛ mɔɔ awie biala ze nee nrɛlaleɛ mɔɔ awie biala ɛnze
21Ɛdɛnkɛma dendɛle hilele me bieko. 22Ɔse, “Sonla ra, ɛrɛlɛ ɛhye mɔɔ Yizilayɛma ta bu la a le duzu? Bɛse, ‘Mekɛ ne ɛzenlɛ ala a se a, noko bɛ ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ ne ɛnyɛ zɔhane.’ 23Zɔhane ati ka kile bɛ kɛ, ‘Awulae Nyamenle ne se: Metua zɛhae ɛrɛlɛ ne, na bɛnrɛbu ye bieko ɛlɛ wɔ Yizilayɛ azɛlɛ zo.’ Na ka kile bɛ kɛ mekɛ ɛdwu mɔɔ ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ biala ɔwɔ kɛ yɛ zɔhane a.
24“Akee ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ mgbane mgbane nee adalɛ abisadeɛ edwɛkɛ biala ɛnrɛvinde Yizilayɛma avinli bieko. 25Medame Awulae Nyamenle, mebadendɛ, na edwɛkɛ biala mɔɔ mebaha la bayɛ zɔhane. Aze ɛzilɛ biala ɛnle ɛkɛ. Bɛmɛ atuadelɛma, mebaha me nloa edwɛkɛ, na ɔbayɛ zɔhane, yɛɛ ɔbazi bɛ mekɛ zo. Medame Awulae Nyamenle a mese a.”
26Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me kɛ, 27“Sonla ra, nea, Yizilayɛma se, ‘Debie mɔɔ bɛkɛye bɛkɛhile ye wɔ ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ nu kazi la, ɛnee yehyɛ, yɛɛ ye Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ mɔɔ ɔfa ɔbɛlɛ ye la, kayɛ zɔhane la, ɛnee yehyɛ.’ 28Yemɔti ka kile bɛ kɛ Awulae Nyamenle ne se, ‘Me edwɛkɛ ɛnrɛzi aze bieko. Edwɛkɛ biala mɔɔ medame menwɔha la bayɛ zɔhane. Medame Awulae Nyamenle a mese a.’ ”

Title: YIZ 13
Content:
Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ mɔɔ tia Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ mrenya adalɛ la
1Ɛdɛnkɛma dendɛle hilele me. Ɔse, 2“Sonla ra, ka nrɛlaleɛ ɛhye kile Yizilayɛ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma mɔɔ bɔ bɛ ti anu keha mɔɔ bɛdabɛ bɛkulo la. Ka kile bɛ maa bɛdie mɔɔ medame Ɛdɛnkɛma mese la.
3“Ka kile bɛ kɛ, Ɛdɛnkɛma se, ‘Munzule ɛha Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ ahoasea ne mɔ, mɔɔ ɛnnwu ɛhwee na bɛbɔ bɛ ti anu bɛka Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ la. 4Yizilayɛma, bɛ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma ɛyɛ kɛ fovolɛ zo ɛzonlɛ. 5Bɛtɛkɔneanle ɛleka ne mɔ mɔɔ ɛgologolo ɛgua la, yɛɛ bɛtɛdiele Yizilayɛma anwo bane, amaa Ɛdɛnkɛma kenle ne dwu na konle ba a bɛahola gyinla. 6Bɛbɔ adalɛ, yɛɛ bɛha adalɛ abisadeɛ edwɛkɛ; bɛse, “Ɛdɛnkɛma se,” wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ metɛsoanle bɛ la. Noko bɛ nye la kɛ mebamaa bɛ edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ bɛha la ayɛ zɔhane. 7Asoo tɛ ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ mgbane mgbane nee adalɛ abisadeɛ edwɛkɛ a bɛka mekɛ biala mɔɔ bɛkɛha kɛ “Ɛdɛnkɛma se,” wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ metɛkanle ɛhwee la?’
8“Yemɔti ka kile bɛ kɛ, Awulae Nyamenle ne se, ‘Kɛmɔ bɛ ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ ne mɔ ɛnle nɔhalɛ na bɛbɔ adalɛ la ati, medame Awulae Nyamenle, mekpo bɛ. 9Mebadea bɛdabɛ bɛ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛtɛnwunle debie a, ɛnee bɛse bɛnwu debie na bɛbɔ adalɛ la. Bɛnrɛdia bɛ bɛnrɛboka Yizilayɛma anwo, yɛɛ bɛ nee bɛ ɛnrɛdu agyinla bɔbɔ. Bɛnrɛzia bɛnrɛhɔ bɛ maanle nu Yizilayɛ; na bɛbanwu kɛ medame a mele Awulae Nyamenle ne a.
10 “ ‘Kɛmɔ bɛbɛlɛbɛla me menli ne, na ɛleka mɔɔ anzonudwolɛ ɛnle la ɛnee bɛse anzonudwolɛ wɔ ɛkɛ, na menli ne die bane mgbane bie a ɛnee bɛmɛ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma bɛhwi nwolɛ kalo la; 11ka kile bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛtwi kalo ne la kɛ bane ne bagolo agua. Ezule kpole badɔ, ezuawolɛ mgbole bagua, na ahumu kpole adu, 12na saa bane ne bu gua a, ɛnee bɛ kalo ne mɔɔ bɛvale bɛhwile nwolɛ la hale nienwu?’
13“Zɔhane ati kɛ Awulae Nyamenle ne se la ɛne: Mebava ɛya na meamaa ahumu kpole adu, ezule badɔ kpole bie, na ezuawolɛ adɔ abubu bane ne. 14Mebabubu bɛ bane ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛhwi nwolɛ kalo la, na meagolo bɛ meagua, meamaa ye adiabo ne bɔbɔ anwenle zolɛ. Ye ɛbulɛ ne anu, ɔbahu bɛ, na bɛanwu kɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a.
15-16“Zɛhae yɛɛ mebava meayɛ bane ne nee bɛdabɛ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛannwu ɛhwee na bɛhanle Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ bɛhilele Gyɛlusalɛmma kɛ bɛde anzonudwolɛ nu, na bɛhwile bane ne anwo kalo la. Medame Awulae Nyamenle a mese a!”
Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ mɔɔ tia Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ mraalɛ adalɛ la
17Ɛdɛnkɛma zele kɛ, “Sonla ra, akee nea mraalɛ mɔɔ wɔ wɔ menli ne avinli, na bɛbɔ bɛ ti anu bɛka Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ la. Ka nrɛlaleɛ ɛhye kile bɛ na se bɛ kɛ, 18medame Awulae Nyamenle, mese: Munzule ɛha bɛdabɛ mraalɛ mɔɔ bɛkpomgba ngonyia sɛbɛ bɛgyelegyela menli sa, na bɛbɔ bɛ nwolɛ duku, amaa bɛanyia tumi wɔ menli ngakyile nwo zo la. Asoo bɛfa bɛ ngonyia bɛahu me menli ne foa ko na bɛalie foa ko ngoane wɔ bɛdabɛ bɛ ezukoakpondɛlɛ ti? 19Bɛbɔ adalɛ bɛhile me menli ne mɔ mɔɔ kulo adalɛ la, bɛgua me nyunlu aze wɔ me menli ne anyunlu, bɛlie baale nee kpanwo, bɛhu menli mɔɔ ɔnle kɛ wu la, na bɛlie menli mɔɔ fɛta ewule la ngoane.
20“Yemɔti medame Awulae Nyamenle, mese: Mekyi ngonyia sɛbɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛfa bɛnyia menli nwo zo tumi la. Mebatete bɛ meavi bɛ sa, na meazianyizianyi menli mɔɔ bɛkyekye bɛ la meamaa bɛahɔ kɛ nloma. 21Mebadudu bɛ ti duku ne mɔ meagua, na mealie me menli ne meavi bɛ sa nu, mɔɔ ɛnee bɛnle bɛ tumi bo bieko a, na bɛanwu kɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a.
22“Bɛva bɛ adalɛ ne mɔ bɛbɔ menli mɔɔ di boɛ, na mengulo kɛ bɛ nwo bu ɛbonle la arɛle; bɛzi amumuyɛnli ne adua bɛammaa yeangakyi ye ɛbɛla ɛtane ne yeanlie ɔ nwo ngoane. 23Yemɔti bɛnrɛnwu ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ biala yɛɛ bɛnrɛbɔ adalɛ munzule biala. Mebalie me menli ne meavi bɛ sa nu, na bɛanwu kɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a.”

Title: YIZ 14
Content:
Nyamenle kyi mmonle ɛzɔlɛ
1Yizilayɛ mgbanyima bie mɔ radɛnlanle me nwo ɛkɛ. 2Na Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me kɛ, 3“Sonla ra, menli ɛhye mɔ ɛlie bɛ mmonle ne mɔ ɛdo nu kpole kpalɛ na ɔlɛmaa bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ azi bɛ nyunlu bile. Asoo ɔle kpalɛ kɛ menwɔmaa adenle menwɔmaa bɛkɛbiza me edwɛkɛ?
4“Yemɔti tendɛ kile bɛ na se bɛ kɛ: Medame Awulae Nyamenle, mese, Yizilayɛnli biala mɔɔ ɛva ye ahonle ɛmaa mmonle, yemaa ye ɛtane ɛzi ɔ nyunlu bile, na ɔkɛra Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ ne ɛkɛ ne la, medame Ɛdɛnkɛma mumua ne mebabua ye, ɔboalekɛ bɛ mmonle ne mɔ ɛzo somaa, 5amaa meado me sa mealie Yizilayɛma mɔɔ awozonlezonlenlɛ ti bɛhwe bɛ nwo bɛvi me nwo la.
6“Zɔhane ati ka kile Yizilayɛma kɛ, Awulae Nyamenle ne se: Bɛnlu bɛ nwo na bɛhwe bɛ nwo bɛvi bɛ mmonle ne mɔ nee bɛ bɛkyi nyɛleɛ ne mɔ anwo.
7“Mekɛ biala mɔɔ Yizilayɛnli anzɛɛ nyɛvolɛ mɔɔ de bɛ avinli la bie kɛde ɔ nwo kɛvi me nwo, ɔkɛhɔzonle awozonle, ɔkɛva ye ɛtane ɔkɛzi ɔ nyunlu bile, na akee ɔkɛhɔ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ bie ɛkɛ kɛ ɔkabiza ɔ nwo wɔ me ɛkɛ ne la, medame Ɛdɛnkɛma mumua ne, mebabua ye. 8Mebava me nye meawula sonla zɔhane anyunlu na meamaa yeayɛ sɛkɛlɛneɛ nee ɛfenle wɔ menli anloa anu, na meaye ye meavi me menli ne anu; na bɛbanwu kɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a.
9“Na saa mɛlɛbɛla bie ba Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ zɔhane afoa nu, na ɔbuke ɔ nloa ɔka adalɛ nrɛlaleɛ biala a, ɛnee medame, Ɛdɛnkɛma a meyɛ a. Mebadea ye na meazɛkye ye meavi me menli Yizilayɛma avinli. 10Ahenle ne mɔɔ rale babiza ɔ nwo nee Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ ne, bɛ mu nwiɔ bɛ ndeanlɛ ne bayɛ ko, na bɛdabɛ bɛbali bɛ ndeanlɛ nwo ɛzonle, 11amaa Yizilayɛma andwe bɛ nwo anvi me nwo, anluolua nu basabasa, na bɛanva mɛladonlɛ bɛanzɛkye bɛ nwo, amaa bɛayɛ me menli na medame meayɛ bɛ Nyamenle. Medame, Awulae Nyamenle a mese a.”
Nowa, Daneɛle, yɛɛ Dwobu
12Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me kɛ, 13“Sonla ra, saa maanle bie anu amra yɛ ɛtane tia me, bɛgyakyi me bɛkɔsonle nyamenle gyɛne, na meka kɛ metea maanle zɔhane, mefa ɛhɔne nee sane mebato maanle ne anu, na mɔɔ menli nee nane ɛlɛwu la, 14saa menli nsa ɛhye mɔ, Nowa, Daneɛle, yɛɛ Dwobu wɔ maanle ne anu bɔbɔ a, bɛ tenleneyɛlɛ kɛlie bɛdabɛ bɛ ngome ala ngoane. Medame Awulae Nyamenle a mese a.
15“Saa memaa nanemgbole ba azɛlɛ ne azo kɛ bɛzɛkye debie biala, memaa azɛlɛ ne tɔ mgbane, mɔɔ nanemgbole ne mɔ ati sonla biala ɛngola ɛngɔ zolɛ la a, 16meka, meka kɛ, saa menli nsa ɛhye mɔ bɔbɔ wɔ azɛlɛ ne azo a, medame Awulae Nyamenle, mese, bɛnrɛhola bɛ mra mrenya anzɛɛ bɛ mra mraalɛ ngoane die, kyesɛ bɛdabɛ bɛ ngome bɛ nwo ala. Maanle ne ɛdeɛ, ɔbadɔ mgbane.
17“Anzɛɛ saa metwe konle mebato maanle zɔhane anu, na memaa adenle kɛ bɛhu menli nee nyɛmoa mɔɔ wɔ nu la amuala a, 18meka, meka kɛ, saa menli nsa zɔhane wɔ maanle ne anu bɔbɔ a, medame Awulae Nyamenle, mese, bɛnrɛhola bɛnrɛlie bɛ mra mrenya anzɛɛ mraalɛ, kyesɛ bɛdabɛ bɛ ngome bɛ nwo ala.
19“Anzɛɛ saa mefa ewulenzane mebato maanle zɔhane anu, na mefa ɛya kɛ meku menli nee nyɛmoa mɔɔ wɔ maanle ne anu la a, meka, meka kɛ, 20saa bɔbɔ Nowa, Daneɛle, yɛɛ Dwobu wɔ maanle ne anu a, medame Awulae Nyamenle, mese, bɛ nuhua biala ɛnrɛhola ɔ ra nrenya anzɛɛ raalɛ die. Bɛ tenleneyɛlɛ ne bahola alie bɛdabɛ bɛ ngome ala ngoane.”
21 Awulae Nyamenle ne se, “Na saa akee mefa me ndeanlɛ fane nna ɛhye mɔ: konle, ɛhɔne, nanemgbole mɔɔ di menli, yɛɛ ewulenzane megua Gyɛlusalɛmma anwo zo, kɛ mefa meaminli menli nee nyɛmoa abo zo ɛ! 22Noko saa awie ka maanle ne anu na ɔfa mralɛ mrenya nee mraalɛ mɔɔ yelie bɛ la ɔba kɛ ɔfa bɛ yearahile wɔ, na ɛnea bɛ anwuma toonwo ɛdwu bɛ aze na ɛnwu bɛ nyɛleɛ a, munzule mɔɔ mefa meado Gyɛlusalɛm anwo zo la bakyekye ɛ rɛle bɔbɔ. 23Saa ɛnwu bɛ nyɛleɛ nee bɛ ndenle mɔɔ bɛlua nu la a, mɔɔ mebayɛ la bakyekye ɛ rɛle; na bɛbanwu kɛ mɔɔ meyɛ la meanyɛ ye mgbane. Medame Awulae Nyamenle a mese a.”

Title: YIZ 15
Content:
Vanye baka nwo ɛrɛlɛ
1Ɛdɛnkɛma dendɛle hilele me. 2Ɔse, “Sonla ra, vanye baka fa ye nienwu a tɛla baka biala a? Kɛ vanye baka ngane si tɛla mbaka mɔɔ wɔ ɛbɔ nu la ɛ? 3Asoo bɛfa ye baka bɛyɛ debie? Asoo menli kola kenda debie wɔ ye takola nu? 4Debie ala mɔɔ bɛkola bɛfa bɛyɛ la a le kɛ bɛfa bɛyɛ ɛyɛne. Ɛnyia ɔ ti nee ɔ ti yela ala a, ɛnee ye avinli ne ɛhakyi emunlike. Baka ɛhye, duzu nvasoɛ a wɔ ɔ nwo zo a? 5Ye amolɛ ne bɔbɔ bɛfa bɛyɛ ɛhwee a ɔnyɛ boɛ, na akee senle ka ye na ɔyɛ emunlike a yɛɛ bɛfa bɛayɛ duzu a?
6“Yemɔti medame Awulae Nyamenle, mese, mebayɛ Gyɛlusalɛm kɛ kpɔkɛ nu vanye mbaka la, mebapɛ bɛ meagua senle nu kɛ bɛyela bɛ. 7Mebava me nye meawula bɛ nyunlu kpalɛ, mɔɔ saa bɛ bie mɔ nriandi fi senle ne anu bɔbɔ a, senle ala a bayela bɛ a, na bɛanwu kɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a, na mefa me nye mewula ɛ nyunlu a ɛnee meva me nye mewula ɛ nyunlu. 8Mebamaa azɛlɛ ne adɔ mgbane, ɔboalekɛ bɛanli nɔhalɛ bɛammaa me. Medame Awulae Nyamenle a mese a.”

Title: YIZ 16
Content:
Gyɛlusalɛmma ɛnli nɔhalɛ
1Eza Ɛdɛnkɛma dendɛle hilele me. 2Ɔse, “Sonla ra, maa Gyɛlusalɛmma ɛnwu bɛ ninyɛndane mɔɔ bɛyɛ la, na ka kile bɛ kɛ, 3medame Awulae Nyamenle, meka meahile Gyɛlusalɛmma kɛ:
“Bɛwole bɛ yɛɛ bɛ bo vi Keena azɛlɛ zo. Bɛ nlenya mɔ a le Amɔlema, yɛɛ bɛ nla mɔ a le Hɛtema. 4Kenle ko ne mɔɔ bɛwole bɛ la, bɛampɛ bɛ kotoa nyɛma, bɛanva ngyenle bɛangua nzule nu bɛambia bɛ, yɛɛ bɛankyekye bɛ wɔ ɛdanlɛ nu. 5Awie annwu bɛ anwunvɔne, na ahunlunyele nu yeayɛ ɛhye mɔ bie yeamaa bɛ. Bɛwole bɛ ala la, bɛhyile bɛ, yemɔti bɛvuandinle bɛ bɛguale ɛbɔ nu.
6“Membanzenle bɛ nwo ɛkɛ, na menwunle kɛ bɛgua bɛ mogya ne anu, na menzele bɛ kɛ, 7‘Bɛnyia ngoane, na bɛnyi kɛ ɛbɔ nu baka.’ Na bɛnyinle bɛyɛle ndendenle na bɛgyinlanle zolɛ. Bɛle kɛ mraalɛ a, bɛzuozuale nyɛfonlɛ, bɛ ti enrinli yɛle ndendenle, noko ɛnee bɛlɛ bɛ nwo zɔhane.
8“Mɔɔ mese bɛ nwo ɛkɛ ne bieko na meneanle bɛ la, ɛnee yedwu mɔɔ bɛkulo bɛ a. Mengedale bɛ ndanlɛ na memkpale bɛ nyiane. Menyiale bɛ na me nee bɛ yɛle agyalɛ ngyekyeleɛ, na bɛyɛle medame Awulae Nyamenle, me ɛdeɛ.
9“Akee menvale nzule membiale bɛ, menrinzinle bɛ nwo mogya ne na memkpokpale bɛ nwole. 10Menvale ndanlɛ mɔɔ bɛnwo bɛ nloa la mengedale bɛ na menvale nwoma mgbɔlaboa menwulale bɛ. Mengedale bɛ lenen ndanlɛ kpalɛ na menvale selekye menguale bɛ nwo zo. 11Menvale anwoneɛ menzieziele bɛ, membɔle bɛ sa avikpa na menvale ndweabane menguale bɛ kɔme. 12Menvale ngɛba menwulowulale bɛ bonyi nu; menvale asomadeɛ menwulowulale bɛ nzo nu, na menzoale bɛ ahyɛlɛ ngɛnlɛma. 13Menvale ezukoa nvutuke nee dwɛtɛ fufule menzieziele bɛ; bɛhedale lenen ɛdakpa, selekye nee ɛdanlɛ mɔɔ bɛnwo ɔ nloa la, bɛlile kpanwo mɔɔ bɛva esamo kpalɛ bɛdo la, bɛnlonle wolɛ nee nwole. Bɛ anwofɛlɛko ne lale zo na bɛgyinlanle dehelɛ gyinlabelɛ. 14Bɛ anwofɛlɛko ti, bɛ nganeɛ dendenle hɔle maanle maanle zo, ɔluakɛ anwofɛlɛko mɔɔ menvale memanle bɛ la yɛle kpole. Medame Awulae Nyamenle a mese a.
15“Na bɛlile bɛ duma kpole nee bɛ anwofɛlɛko nzi bɛlile tuutuu, na bɛ nee awie biala mɔɔ ɛlɛpɛ nu aze la lale. 16Bɛvale bɛ adɛladeɛ ngɛnlɛma ne mɔ bie bɛzieziele bɛ mmonle azua nu, bɛbɔle tuutuu ɛbɛla bie mɔɔ bie ɛtɛsile, yɛɛ bie ɛnrɛzi ɛlɛ la wɔ ɛkɛ. 17Eza bɛholole bɛ ezukoa nvutuke nee dwɛtɛ fufule anwoneɛ mɔɔ medame meva memaa bɛ la bɛguale ananze mrenya, bɛvale bɛbɔle tuutuu ɛbɛla. 18Bɛvale bɛ ndanlɛ ngɛnlɛma ne mɔ bie bɛhedale bɛ na bɛvale me nwole nee ɛyɛlɛ evuanlɛ ne bie bɛzieziele bɛ nyunlu. 19Memanle bɛ aleɛ mɔɔ bɛvale esamo kpalɛ, nwole nee wolɛ a bɛyɛle la, noko bɛmɛ bɛvale bɛmanle bɛ mmonle ne mɔ. Medame Awulae Nyamenle a mese a.
20“Akee bɛvale bɛ mra mrenya nee mraalɛ mɔɔ bɛwo bɛ bɛmaa me la bɛbɔle azu bɛmanle bɛ mmonle. Asoo bɛnnwu kɛ bɛ tuutuu ɛbɔlɛ ɛhye bo zolɛ? 21Duzu ati yɛɛ bɛkɛhu me mra bɛkɛyela bɛ bɛkɛbɔ azu bɛkɛmaa bɛ mmonle ɛ? 22Mekɛ mɔɔ bɛbɔ bɛ munzule ɛbɛla ne, na bɛbɔ bɛ tuutuu ɛbɛla ne la, bɛangakye bɛ ngakula nu, mɔɔ ɛnee bɛlɛ bɛ nwo zɔ, bɛla mogya nu la.”
Gyɛlusalɛmma tuutuu ɛbɛla ne
23Awulae Nyamenle ne zele kɛ, “Bɛwie! Bɛdabɛ, bɛwie bɔkɔɔ! Bɛ amumuyɛ bebelebe ne amuala anzi, 24bɛsisi azua ekpumgbunli ekpumgbunli bɛdede nu wɔ mgbata ne mɔ azo, 25wɔ gua biala ati, bɛbɔ tuutuu ɛbɛla wɔ ɛkɛ, bɛtwenle bɛ anwofɛlɛko ne aze, bɛbu bɛ nwo bɛmaa awie biala mɔɔ ɛlɛpɛ nu aze la na bɛ nee ye bɔ tuutuu ɛbɛla. 26Eza bɛ nee bɛ gɔnwo mɔ Yigyibitima, mɔɔ adwɔmanebɔlɛ ɛgya bɛ la bɔ tuutuu ɛbɛla ka me ɛya.
27“Yemɔti bɛnlea, mendeanle bɛ, menliele bɛ debie biala na menyele bɛ memanle bɛ kpɔvolɛma, Filisitiama. Bɛ nwo nee bɛ nyɛleɛ bɔbɔ yɛle Filisitiama nyiane.
28“Eza bɛ nee Aseleama bɔle adwɔmane. Kɛmɔ bɛ nye bolo debie na bɛdi a bɛ ko ɛnyi la ati, bɛ nee bɛ bɔle tuutuu ɛbɛla, noko yeande bɛ. 29Eza bɛ nee Babelonia gualilɛma bɔle tuutuu ɛbɛla, na ɛhye noko bɔbɔ ande bɛ fee.”
30Awulae Nyamenle ne se, “Tuutuu ɛbɔlɛ ɛgya bɛ, yɛɛ bɛnze nwolɛ nyiane fee. 31Bɛsisi azua ekpumgbunli ekpumgbunli wɔ bɛ gua ne mɔ ati; bɛziezie ɛleka wɔ mgbata ne mɔ azo; noko bɛmbɔ bɛ ɛbɛla kɛ tuutuunli mɔɔ ɛlɛdi tuutuu akpondɛ ezukoa la. 32Bɛyɛ bɛ nwo kɛ awuvolɛ raalɛ mɔɔ wulowula ɔ sa aze la; ɔdie nyɛvolɛ na ɔgyakyi ɔ hu. 33Mrenya yɛɛ maa tuutuuma ahyɛlɛ ninyɛne a, na bɛmɛ, bɛmaa bɛ kulovolɛma ndoloboa amaa bɛanyia bɛ dɔɔnwo bɛ nee bɛ abɔ tuutuu ɛbɛla. 34Yemɔti bɛmɛ, bɛnle kɛ mraalɛ mɔɔ di tuutuu la. Bɛmɛ a bɛbɔ mrenya ɛkpa a, na nrenya biala ɛmbɔ bɛ ɛkpa kɛ bɛmaa bɛbɔ tuutuu ɛbɛla; yemɔti bɛle menli ngakyile bɔkɔɔ.”
Nyamenle ndeanlɛ mɔɔ wɔ Gyɛlusalɛmma anwo zo
35Zɔhane ati Gyɛlusalɛmma tuutuuma! Bɛdie Ɛdɛnkɛma.
36Kɛ Awulae Nyamenle ne se la ɛne: “Kɛmɔ bɛkpale bɛ nwo, bɛbɔle bɛ nwo anyiemgba bɛ nee bɛ kulovolɛma bɔle tuutuu ɛbɛla la ati, bɛ mmonle ne mɔ ati, yɛɛ bɛ mra ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛhunle bɛ bɛmanle bɛ mmonle ne mɔ la mogya ne ati, 37bɛnlea, mebaboɔboa bɛ kulovolɛma ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛ nee bɛ yɛle debie mɔɔ bɛ nye liele bɛ nwo nee mɔɔ bɛ nye anlie bɛ nwo la anloa, meamaa bɛabɔ bɛayia bɛ, na meakpa bɛ nwo ɛdanlɛ, amaa bɛanwu kɛ bɛlɛ bɛ nwo zɔ. 38Mebabua bɛ ewule fɔlɛ, meadea bɛ kɛ bɛle mraalɛ mɔɔ bɛdo awuvolɛvalɛ mɛla ne na bɛha mogya bɛgua a, na meava me nungule ɛhwenlɛ nee ɛya kpole ne meahu bɛ. 39Mebaye bɛ meamaa bɛ kulovolɛma ne, na bɛabubu bɛ azua nee bɛ ekpumgbunli ne mɔ. Bɛbaza bɛ bɛalie bɛ ndanlɛ nee bɛ anwoneɛ ngɛnlɛma ne mɔ, na bɛamaa bɛalɛ bɛ nwo zɔ.
40“Bɛbava menli dɔɔnwo bɛara bɛ nwo zo, bɛbazi bɛ awolɛ na bɛava bɛ dadeɛ bɛapepɛ bɛ nu nzokanzoka. 41Bɛbayela bɛ azua ne mɔ na bɛadea bɛ wɔ mraalɛ dɔɔnwo anyunlu. Mebamaa bɛagyakyi bɛ tuutuulilɛ ne, na bɛagyakyi ahyɛlɛ ninyɛne ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛfa bɛbɔ mrenya ɛkpa la. 42Ɛhye yɛɛ bamaa me ɛya kpole ne mɔɔ meva bɛ nwo la adwo, na meagyakyi bɛ nwo nungule ɛhwenlɛ ne a. Me kunlu badwo na menrɛva ɛya bieko. 43Kɛmɔ bɛngakye bɛ ngakula nu, na bɛva ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ bɛha me ɛya la, bɛnlea, mebamaa bɛ nyɛleɛ abɔ bɛ ti. Medame Awulae Nyamenle a mese a. Duzu ati a bɛvale adwɔmanebɔlɛ bɛbokale bɛ munzule ninyɛne ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛyɛle la anwo a?”
Kɛ ninli ne si de la, yɛɛ ralɛ raalɛ ne de a
44Ɛdɛnkɛma zele kɛ, “Nea, Gyɛlusalɛm, awie biala mɔɔ bu ɛrɛlɛ la babu ɛ nwo ɛrɛlɛ ɛhye: ‘Kɛ ninli ne si de la, yɛɛ ralɛ raalɛ ne de a.’ 45Ɛle ɛ nli ara raalɛ. Ɛ nli kyi ɔ hu nee ɔ kunlu mralɛ. Eza ɛle ɛ mediema mraalɛ adiema raalɛ. Ɛ mediema mraalɛ ne mɔ kyi bɛ hu mɔ nee bɛ mra. Ɛ nli le Hɛtenli yɛɛ ɛ ze le Amɔlenli.
46“Ɛ diema raalɛ kpanyinli a le Samɛlea, nee ye namunamu ne mɔ, mɔɔ gua sɔlɔ la, yɛɛ ɛ diema raalɛ kakula a le Sodɔm, nee ye namunamu ne mɔ, mɔɔ gua nyiakɛ la. 47Noko ɛ kunlu andwo bɛ nyɛleɛ ɛdeɛ ne mɔ anwo la ati, wɔanva bɛ gyakɛ, wɔanyɛ bɛ ninyɛndane ne mɔ bie. Noko mekɛ ekyi ɛhye anu ala wɔbɔ bɛ wɔdɛla ninyɛndane ɛyɛlɛ nu.”
48Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Meka, meka kɛ, ɛ diema raalɛ Sodɔm nee ye namunamu ne mɔ ambɔ ɛbɛla mɔɔ ɛ nee wɔ namunamu ne mɔ ɛbɔ la bie. 49Nea, ɛ diema raalɛ Sodɔm fɔlɛ mɔɔ lile la a le kɛ, ɔ nee ye namunamu ne mɔ dule bɛ nwo kɛ bɛlɛ mɔɔ sa bɛ di la, bɛkpazi na bɛde anzonudwolɛ nu, noko bɛamboa anwunvɔnema nee ehyianvolɛma. 50Bɛmemanle bɛ nwo zo na bɛyɛle bɛkyi ninyɛne bɛhilele me, yemɔti menwunle ye la menzɛkyele bɛ.
51“Samɛlea ambɔ munzule ɛbɛla ne mɔɔ wɔmɔ wɔbɔ la foa ko. Wɔmɔ, wɔbɔ munzule ɛbɛla kpole kpalɛ wɔdɛla Samɛlea, na wɔmaa ɛ mediema mraalɛ ɛhendeɛ ne mɔ ɛlua wɔ munzule ɛbɛla zo ɛzɔ ɛnyelɛ. 52Ɛdawɔ noko wɔ anyiemgba doa wɔ, ɔluakɛ wɔmaa ɛ mediema mraalɛ ɛhendeɛ ne mɔ ɛli benle. Kɛmɔ wɔ munzule mɔɔ wɔbɔ la tɛla bɛ ɛdeɛ ne la ati, wɔmaa bɛzɔ ɛnyelɛ bɛdɛla wɔ. Ɛdawɔ noko wɔbɔ anyiemgba, na wɔ anyiemgba ne doa wɔ, ɔluakɛ wɔmaa ɛ mediema mraalɛ ne mɔ ɛzɔ ɛnyelɛ.”
Bɛbakyekye Sodɔm nee Samɛlea bieko
53Ɛdɛnkɛma zele kɛ, “Mebamaa Sodɔm nee ye namunamu nee Samɛlea nee ye namunamu ne mɔ akpazi, na meamaa ɛdawɔ noko wɔakpazi wɔ bɛ avinli, 54amaa nyiane ahu wɔ na wɔabɔ mɔɔ wɔyɛ la anwo anyiemgba, na wɔanlea bɛ wɔava bɛ wɔakyekye ɛ rɛle. 55Ɛ mediema Sodɔm nee ye namunamu ne mɔ bazia akpazi. Samɛlea nee ye namunamu ne mɔ bazia akpazi, yɛɛ ɛdawɔ noko ɛ nee ɛ mra mraalɛ bazia akpazi. 56Asoo tɛ ɛ diema Sodɔm a ɛvale ɛpɛle ɛfenle wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee ɛgyi boɛ, mɔɔ ɛnee ɛtɛbɔle ɛ nwo anyiemgba la? 57Kɛkala, wɔyɛ kɛ ɔdaye la. Wɔyɛ agolobɛnwo debie wɔmaa Yidɔmma nee namunamu mɔɔ zuozua bɛ la, yɛɛ Filisitiama nee maanle maanle mɔɔ ɛbɔ ɛyia bɛ na bɛkpɔ bɛ la. 58Wɔ anyiemgba nee munzule ɛbɛla mɔɔ wɔbɔ la doa wɔ. Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.”
Ngyekyeleɛ mɔɔ ɛntulu ɛlɛ la
59Awulae Nyamenle ne se, “Ɛhɛe, mɔɔ wɔyɛ la mebadua wɔ nwolɛ kakɛ kɛ wɔdo ndane na wɔtulu ngyekyeleɛ ne. 60Noko akee mebahakye ngyekyeleɛ ne mɔɔ wɔ ngakula nu me nee wɔ kyekyele la, na me nee wɔ ayɛ ngyekyeleɛ mɔɔ ɛntulu ɛlɛ a. 61Ɛbahakye wɔ ndenle mɔɔ ɛluale nuhua la, na saa mefa ɛ mediema mraalɛ, ngakula nee mgbanyinli memaa wɔ kɛ bɛle ɛ mediema mraalɛ a anyiemgba aha wɔ. Mebamaa bɛayɛ ɛ mra mraalɛ, noko tɛ ngyekyeleɛ ne mɔɔ me nee wɔ kyekyele la ati ɔ. 62Me nee wɔ bayɛ ngyekyeleɛ, na wɔanwu kɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a. 63Ɛbahakye mɔɔ wɔyɛ la na ɔbayɛ wɔ nyiane, amaa saa mefa wɔ ninyɛndane mɔɔ wɔyɛ la mekyɛ wɔ a, wɔambuke ɛ nloa, ɔboalekɛ nyiane ɛbia wɔ. Medame, Awulae Nyamenle a mese a.”

Title: YIZ 17
Content:
Kɔleɛ nee vanye ɛrɛlɛ ne
1Ɛdɛnkɛma dendɛle hilele me. 2Ɔse, “Sonla ra, dwenle agyebɛ bie anwo na bu Yizilayɛma ɛrɛlɛ. 3Ka kile bɛ kɛ, Ɛdɛnkɛma se: Kɔleɛ kpole bie mɔɔ lɛ ndɛbalɛ mgbole ndendenle, na ye ndɛkɛ le ngakyile ngakyile ngɛnlɛma la rale Lɛbanɔn radɛnlanle sida baka bie azo. 4Ɔbule baka ne ati dɛkɛdɛkɛ ne na ɔvale ɔhɔle maanle bie mɔɔ bɛdi gua nu la anu, na ɔdole ye wɔ suakpole bie mɔɔ gualilɛma wɔ zolɛ la azo. 5Akee ɔvale azɛlɛ ne azo ma ne mɔ bie na ɔluale ye wɔ azɛlɛ mɔɔ nzule dɔɔnwo wɔ nu, na ɔkye aleɛ la azo. 6Ɔfifile na ɔyɛle vanye baka ɔdɛlɛdɛlɛle. Ye ndinli hɔle aze kpalɛ na ye ngane ne mɔ hyibale bɛ nwo doale kɔleɛ ne. Yemɔti ɔyɛle vanye baka, ɔkpakyele ngane dɔɔnwo na ɔyele nya dɔɔnwo.
7“Kɔleɛ kpole ko noko mɔɔ lɛ ndɛbalɛ mgbole na ɔ nwo ndɛkɛ zonle la ɔdaye ɔrale. Vanye baka ɛhye denrɛdenrɛle ye ngane nee ye ndinli ne mɔ wɔ kɔleɛ ɛhye anwo, amaa yeanyia nzule dɔɔnwo kpalɛ. 8Noko ɛnee bɛlua ye wɔ azɛlɛ kpalɛ mɔɔ nzule wɔ zolɛ la azo, amaa yeabua, yeakpakye ngane, yeazo, na yeayɛ vanye baka mɔɔ anwo yɛ fɛ a.
9“Na medame, Awulae Nyamenle, mebiza kɛ: Asoo vanye baka ɛhye bayɛ kpalɛ? Asoo alumua kɔleɛ ne ɛnrɛdu vanye baka ne ɔ bo, ɔnrɛkpolo ye ma ne mɔ amuala ɔnrɛgua, na ɔnrɛpepɛ ye ngane ne mɔ anu ɔnrɛmaa bɛnrɛgyengye? Ɔnrɛhyia anwosesebɛ kpole biala anzɛɛ maanlema dɔɔnwo na bɛadu ye bɛado. 10Eza nea, asoo saa bɛtu bɛdua bɔbɔ a, ɔbayɛ kpalɛ? Asoo aduduleɛ anwoma ne bɔ ye a ɔnrɛnwoso ɔnrɛwu wɔ ɛleka mɔɔ bɛkɛlua ye la?”
Bɛhile ɛrɛlɛ ne abo
11Akee Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me kɛ, 12 “Biza atuadelɛma ɛhye mɔ kɛ, asoo bɛte ɛrɛlɛ ne abo? Ka kile bɛ kɛ, bɛnlea, Babelonia belemgbunli rale Gyɛlusalɛm na ɔravale Dwuda belemgbunli nee ye mgbanyima ne mɔ amuala ɔhɔle Babelonia. 13Ɔvale suakunlu ɛkɛ ne alehelɛ ne mɔ ko na ɔ nee ye yɛle ngyehyɛlɛ, na ɔmanle ɔhanle ndane ɔhyele ɔ bo. Ɔhyele menli titile mɔɔ wɔ maanle ne anu la nuokɛ ɔhɔle, 14amaa maanle ne angola ɔ nwo zo kpogya bieko; na saa bɛdi ye ngyehyɛlɛ ne azo a, maanle ne agyinla. 15Noko Dwuda belemgbunli ne dele atua na ɔzoanle ɛbɔfoɔma wɔ Yigyibiti, amaa Yigyibitima amaa bɛ mgbɔnwɔ nee ɛlɔnema dɔɔnwo. Na ɛnee ɛnea a, asoo belemgbunli ɛhye bayɛ kpalɛ? Asoo sonla mɔɔ yɛ ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ la fi ɛsalɛ? Asoo ɔbahola yeatulu ngyekyeleɛ ne na yeava ɔ nwo dwɔɔ?
16“Suzuamgba ala mɔɔ medame a mele tease Awulae Nyamenle ne la, mese, ɛleka holɛ ko ne mɔɔ belemgbunli ne mɔɔ ɔdonle ye ndane ne, na ɔtulule ye ngyehyɛlɛ ne la de, wɔ Babelonia suakpole ne azo la, ɛkɛ ne yɛɛ ɔbawu a. 17Yigyibiti belemgbunli nee ye ɛlɔnema pemgbenleamgbe ne bɔbɔ ɛnrɛhola ɛnrɛboa ye wɔ konle nu, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ Babeloniama kɛrateta ye, kɛbɛnra suakpole ne kɛyia, bɛkɛpɛ ahuma bɛkɛdeda nuhua kɛ bɛku menli dɔɔnwo la. 18Kɛmɔ ɔdonle ndane ne na ɔtulule ngyehyɛlɛ ne la ati, kɛmɔ ɔkponlenle ngyehyɛlɛ ne azo na akee ɔziale ɔyɛle ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ la ati, ɔ nwo ɛnrɛvi nu.”
19Zɔhane ati Awulae Nyamenle ne se, “Suzuamgba ala mɔɔ medame a mele tease Nyamenle ne la, me ndane ne mɔɔ yedo, na yetulu me ngyekyeleɛ ne la, mebakpokpo meagua ɔ ti zo. 20Mebagua ye asawu, na meahye ye me ɛhane nu. Mebava ye meahɔ Babelonia na me nee ye ali ye pɛsɛɛ, wɔ ɛkɛ ne, wɔ ye maamɔvo ɛbɛla ne mɔɔ yebɔ yetia me la anwo. 21Bɛbahu ye ɛlɔnema kpalɛ ne mɔ amuala, na bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛvi ɛsalɛ la babɔ asande ahɔ ɛleka ɛleka, na bɛanwu kɛ medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a meha a.”
Nyamenle anyelazo ɛwɔkɛ ne
22Awulae Nyamenle ne se:
“Medame mumua ne mebahɔ sida baka bie azo,
na meahɔbu ɔ ti dɛkɛdɛkɛ ne.
Mebahɔlua ye wɔ boka tendenle bie azo,
23wɔ Yizilayɛ awoka ndendenle ne mɔ anu.
Ɔbakpakye ngane na yeazo ma,
na yeayɛ sida baka kɛnlɛma kpalɛ.
Nane ngakyile kɔsɔɔti baradɛnla ɔ bo;
nloma ngakyile kɔsɔɔti baradɛnla ye ngane ne mɔ
anu,
na bɛayɛ bɛ sane wɔ ɛkɛ.
24Mbaka mɔɔ wɔ azɛlɛ ne azo la amuala
banwu kɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a.
Meka mbaka ndendenle aze,
na memaa mbaka nzinrenzinra nyi ndendenle.
Memaa mbaka amolɛ kyengye,
na memaa mbaka wulera yɛ amolɛ.
Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a;
mebayɛ mɔɔ meha kɛ meyɛ la.”

Title: YIZ 18
Content:
Sonla ko biala ɛzonlelilɛ
1Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me kɛ, 2“Ɛrɛlɛ ɛhye mɔɔ Yizilayɛma ta bu la abo a le duzu? ‘Nenya mɔ ɛli vanye ma nyinyianlera ɛmaa nlɔnra gye ɛnyia.’ ”
3Awulae Nyamenle se, “Suzuamgba ala mɔɔ medame a mele tease Nyamenle ne la, bɛnrɛbu ɛrɛlɛ ɛhye bieko wɔ Yizilayɛ. 4Bɛnwu ye kɛ awie biala ngoane le me ɛdeɛ. Bɛ nlenya mɔ ngoane ne le me ɛdeɛ, yɛɛ ngakula ne mɔ ngoane le me ɛdeɛ. Awie biala mɔɔ kɛyɛ ɛtane la, bawu.
5“Saa sonla tenlene bie wɔ ɛkɛ, ɔyɛ mɔɔ tenrɛ na ɔkɔ mɛla nu, 6na ɔnzonle Yizilayɛma awozonle ne mɔ bie, yɛɛ ɔnli bɛ azu ne mɔɔ bɛbɔ ye awoka ne mɔ azo la bie, ɔnva awie aye, yɛɛ ɔnva raalɛ mɔɔ ɛhɔ amozi la, 7ɔnsisi awie, awie fa debie wula ye awoba a ɔye ɔmaa ye, ɔnwua, ɔmaa mɔɔ ɛhɔne ɛlɛku ye la aleɛ na ɔmaa mɔɔ ɛngeda bie la ɛdanlɛ, 8ɔbɔ awie bosea a ɔnlie nzinwo, yɛɛ ɔnlie bie ɔmboka nwolɛ, ɔnle amumuyɛ, ɔfa pɛlepɛlelilɛ ɔdi awie mɔ avinli edwɛkɛ, 9 ɔdi me mɛla zo na ɔnea ɔdi me ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti azo a, sonla zɛhae, ɔle tenlenenli, ɔbadɛnla ngoane nu, medame Awulae Nyamenle a mese a.
10“Saa sonla zɛhae wo ralɛ nrenya, na kakula ne yɛ awule, ɔyɛ kɔdiawu, 11na ɔyɛ ninyɛne zezɛhae mɔ bie, ɔdi azu mɔɔ bɛbɔ bɛmaa awozonle la aleɛ ne bie, ɔfa ɔ gɔnwo mɔ mraalɛ, 12ɔsisi ehyianvolɛma nee menli mɔɔ yɛ anwunvɔne la, ɔsonle awozonle, ɔbɔ bɛkyi ɛbɛla, 13ɔbɔ bosea ɔdie nzinwo, anzɛɛ ɔfa bie ɔgua zolɛ a, ɛnee ɛnea a ɔwɔ kɛ sonla zɛhae nyia ngoane ɔ? Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛku ye. Yebɔ munzule ɛbɛla; ɔwɔ kɛ ɔwu, yɛɛ ye mogya gua ɔdaye ɔ ti zo.
14“Saa sonla ɛhye wo ralɛ nrenya, mɔɔ nwu ɔ ze ɛtane mɔɔ yeyɛ la, na ɔsulo, na yeanyɛ ɔ ze ninyɛndane ne mɔ bie, 15ɔnli aleɛ mɔɔ bɛdo bɛmaa bozonle la yɛɛ ɔnzonle Yizilayɛ awozonle ne mɔ bie, ɔnva ɔ gɔnwo mɔ mraalɛ, 16ɔnyɛ awie ɛtane, awie fa debie wula ye lɔ awoba a ɔye ɔmaa ye, ɔnwua, ɔmaa mɔɔ ɛhɔne ɛlɛku ye la aleɛ, ɔmaa mɔɔ ɛngeda bie la ɛdanlɛ, 17ɔnle amumuyɛ, ɔmbɔ bosea ɔnlie nzinwo, yɛɛ ɔnlie bie ɔmboka nwolɛ, na ɔdi me mɛla nee me ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔ azo a, ɔnle kɛ ɔ ze ɛtane ne mɔ mɔɔ ɔyɛle la ati ɔwu. Ɔwɔ kɛ ɔnyia ngoane. 18Ɔ ze ɛdeɛ, kɛmɔ ɔlile amile, ɔwuale ɔ mediema, na ɔbɔle ɛbɛla ɛtane wɔ ye menli ne avinli la, ye ɛtane ne ati, ɔbawu.
19“Noko bɛmɛ bɛbiza kɛ, ‘Duzu ati a ɔnle kɛ ralɛ nrenya nwu amaneɛ wɔ ɔ ze ɛtane ne mɔ mɔɔ ɔkɛyɛ la anwo ɛ?’ Suzuamgba ala mɔɔ ralɛ nrenya ne ɛyɛ mɔɔ le kpalɛ na ɔkɔ mɛla nu, na yenlea boɛ yeli me mɛla ne mɔ azo la, ɔwɔ kɛ ɔnyia ngoane. 20Sonla biala mɔɔ kɛyɛ ɛtane la, bawu. Ralɛ nrenya ɛnrɛnwu amaneɛ wɔ ɔ ze ɛtane ne mɔ ati, yɛɛ selɛ ɛnrɛnwu amaneɛ wɔ ralɛ nrenya ɛtane ne mɔ ati. Sonlakpalɛ biala banyia ye kpalɛyɛlɛ nwo ahatualɛ, yɛɛ amumuyɛnli biala banyia ye amumuyɛ nwo ahatualɛ.
21“Na saa amumuyɛnli twe ɔ nwo fi ye amumuyɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ yeyɛ la anwo, ɔdi boɛ, ɔsie me mɛla ne mɔ na ɔdi zolɛ a, ɔbanyia ngoane; ɔnrɛwu. 22Bɛnrɛhakye ye mɛla ne mɔ mɔɔ yedo la biala. Ye kpalɛ mɔɔ yeyɛ la ati, ɔbanyia ngoane. 23Medame Awulae Nyamenle, me nye ɛnlie amumuyɛnli ewule nwo. Mɔɔ mekulo la a le kɛ ɔkɛvi ye ɛtane ne mɔ anwo na ɔkɛnyia ngoane.
24“Na saa tenlenenli twe ɔ nwo fi ye kpalɛ mɔɔ yeyɛ la anwo, ɔyɛ ɛtane na ɔyɛ bɛkyi ninyɛne ne mɔ mɔɔ amumuyɛnli ne yɛ la bie a, ɔbawu. Bɛnrɛhakye ye kpalɛ biala mɔɔ yeyɛ la. Munzule ne mɔɔ yebɔ la anwo fɔlɛlilɛ nee ye ɛtane ne mɔ mɔɔ yeyɛ la ati, ɔbawu.
25“Noko bɛmɛ bɛse, ‘Awulae ɛnli pɛlepɛle.’ Yizilayɛma, bɛdie! Menli pɛlepɛle ɔ? Asoo tɛ bɛmɛ yɛɛ bɛnli pɛlepɛle a? 26Saa sonlakpalɛ twe ɔ nwo fi ye kpalɛyɛlɛ nwo na ɔyɛ ɛtane a, ye ɛtane ne ati, ɔbawu. 27Bieko, saa amumuyɛnli twe ɔ nwo fi ye amumuyɛ mɔɔ yeyɛ la anwo na ɔyɛ mɔɔ le kpalɛ na ɔkɔ mɛla nu la a, ɔbalie ɔ nwo ngoane. 28Kɛmɔ ɔdwenlenle nwolɛ na ɔhwenle ɔ nwo ɔvile ye mɛladonlɛ ne mɔ anwo la ati, ɔbanyia ngoane, ɔnrɛwu. 29Noko bɛmɛ Yizilayɛma bɛse, ‘Awulae ɛnli pɛlepɛle!’ O Yizilayɛma, menli pɛlepɛle ɔ? Bɛmɛ yɛɛ bɛnli pɛlepɛle a.
30“Zɔhane ati Yizilayɛma, medame Awulae Nyamenle mese: Mebabua bɛ ndɛne, kɛmɔ sonla ko biala nyɛleɛ si de la. Bɛnlu bɛ nwo na bɛhwe bɛ nwo bɛvi bɛ mɛladonlɛ kɔsɔɔti anwo na yeanyɛ munzule wɔ bɛ adenle nu. 31Bɛgyakyi bɛ mɛladonlɛ ne mɔ na bɛnyia ahonle fofolɛ nee subane fofolɛ. Duzu ati a bɛkulo kɛ bɛwu ɛ, Yizilayɛma? 32Me nye ɛnlie awie biala ewule nwo. Yemɔti medame Awulae Nyamenle, mese, bɛhakyi na bɛnyia ngoane.”

Title: YIZ 19
Content:
Alɔbɔlɛ edwɛne
1Akee Nyamenle zele me kɛ mendo alɔbɔlɛ edwɛne ɛhye
memaa arelemgbunli mɔɔ wɔ Yizilayɛ la:
2Bɛ nli le awenade belɛ wɔ awenade avinli!
Ɔlile ɔ mra adane wɔ awenade nyinli anwo ɛzulolɛ
avinli.
3Ɔlile ɔ ra ko adane, ɔhilele ye kɛ
bɛsi bɛdi ɛbɔlɛ la, na ɔhyele menli ɔlile.
4Maanle maanle bɔle ɔ nwo twoobue,
na bɛzuale ye kuma nu ɛhane bɛhyele ye.
Bɛvale koba bɛzɔle ye
na bɛ nee ye hɔle Yigyibiti.
5Mɔɔ ɔ nli hendɛle toonwo na ye anyelazo wiele la,
ɔvale ɔ mra ne mɔ ko ɔtetele ye,
na ɔyɛle awenade anwo ɛzulolɛ kpole kpalɛ.
6Ɔwiele nyi la, ɔ nee awenade ne mɔ dule,
ɔdaye noko ɔzukoale ɛbɔlɛlilɛ na ɔlile menli.
7Ɔlile menli aranemgbole nu,
ɔmanle bɛ azuamgbole ne mɔ dɔle mgbane.
Menli mɔɔ wɔ azɛlɛ ne azo la ahonle dule,
mekɛ biala mɔɔ awenade ne deanle nu la.
8Maanle maanle boɔboale bɛ nloa zuale ye ɛhane;
bɛguale ye asawu, na bɛhyele ye wɔ bɛ ɛhane nu.
9Bɛvale koba bɛsosɔle ye bɛdole ye tunli nu,
bɛvale ye bɛhɔmanle Babelonia belemgbunli;
bɛhyele ye nuokɛ bɛziele,
amaa bɛande ɔ ne bieko
wɔ Yizilayɛ awoka ne mɔ azo.
10Ɛnee bɛ nli le kɛ vanye baka
mɔɔ bɛlua ye wɔ azule nloa.
Ɔnyia nzule dɔɔnwo la ati,
ɔwula nya dɔɔnwo, ɔso ma dɔɔnwo.
11Ye baka ɛsesebɛ ne,
rayɛle belemgbunli ɛhɔtɔlɔ.
Vanye baka ne nyinle hɔle anwuma kpalɛ;
awie biala nwunle ye tendenle nee ye buzuu.
12Noko bɛdule vanye baka ne ɛya nu.
Aduduleɛ anwoma ne manle ɔgyengyenle,
ye ma ne mɔ kpolole guale.
Ye baka ɛsesebɛ ne wule,
na bɛdole ye senle nu bɛyelale ye.
13Kɛkala akee bɛhɔlua ye ɛsɛlɛ zo,
wɔ azɛlɛ mɔɔ nzule ɛnle nu na yehwe la azo.
14Senle ɛdɔ ye baka ne anu;
yeyela ye ngane nee ye ma ne mɔ amuala.
Baka ne anwo ɛnyɛ se ko,
bɛfa bɛyɛ belemgbunli ɛhɔtɔlɔ a ɔnyɛ boɛ.
Ɛhye le nyanelilɛ edwɛne, yɛɛ bɛdo toonwo a
yeradwu ɛnɛ a.

Title: YIZ 20
Content:
Nyamenle ɛhulolɛ yɛɛ sonla anzosesebɛ
1Bɛ nee yɛ hɔle nlɔnu la, ye ɛvolɛ nsuu ne, siane nnu ne na ye kenle bulu ne azo, Yizilayɛ mgbanyima bie rale me ɛkɛ radɛnlanle aze kɛ bɛbabiza Ɛdɛnkɛma edwɛkɛ. 2Na Ɛdɛnkɛma dendɛle hilele me. 3Ɔse, “Sonla ra, ka kile Yizilayɛ mgbanyima ne mɔ kɛ, kɛ medame Awulae Nyamenle mese la ɛne: Bɛbabiza me edwɛkɛ la, yemɔti a bɛra a. Suzuamgba ala mɔɔ medame a mele tease Nyamenle ne la, bɛmbiza me edwɛkɛ biala. Medame Awulae Nyamenle a mese a.
4“Sonla ra, bua bɛ ndɛne na maa bɛnwu bɛ ze mɔ ninyɛndane mɔɔ bɛyɛle la. 5 Ka kile bɛ kɛ, medame Awulae Nyamenle mese: Kenle mɔɔ memkpale nu menyele Yizilayɛma la, menganle ndane mengilele Gyekɔbo abo zo amra ne, na mengilele bɛ kɛ mesi mede la wɔ Yigyibiti azɛlɛ zo. Menganle ndane na menganle kɛ mame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne a. 6Kenle ko zɔhane menganle ndane kɛ meye bɛ meavi Yigyibiti azɛlɛ zo na meava bɛ meahɔ azɛlɛ kpalɛ mɔɔ kye aleɛ, na ɔle azɛlɛ kpalɛ ɔtɛla azɛlɛ kɔsɔɔti, mɔɔ mekpondɛ mezie ɛkɛ memaa bɛ la azo. 7Na menganle mengilele bɛ kɛ, bɛvuandi ninyɛne ɛtane ɛtane ne mɔ mɔɔ mekyi na bɛva bɛ nye bɛzie nwolɛ la bɛgua, bɛmmasonle Yigyibiti awozonle ne mɔ bie bɛgua bɛ nwo evinli, ɔboalekɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne a. 8Noko bɛandie me edwɛkɛ ne na bɛdele me nwo atua. Bɛ nuhua ko bɔbɔ anvuandi ye bɛkyi ninyɛne ne mɔ angua, yɛɛ bɛ rɛle anvi Yigyibiti awozonle ne mɔ ɛzonlenlɛ. Menyɛle kɛ mewola me ɛya ne meagua bɛ nwo zo, na mealua me ɛya ne azo meadea bɛ wɔ Yigyibiti azɛlɛ zo. 9Noko amaa meanzɛkye me duma wɔ maanle maanle ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛde bɛ avinli la anyunlu la, mengilele bɛ kɛ mesi mede la na menyele bɛ menvile Yigyibiti.
10“Yemɔti menyele bɛ menvile Yigyibiti azɛlɛ zo na me nee bɛ rale fienemgbole ne anu. 11 Menvale me mɛla ne memanle bɛ na mengilehilele bɛ me ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ sonla di zolɛ a ɔnyia ngoane la. 12 Eza menvale me Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ne mɔ memanle bɛ, kɛ ɔle sɛkɛlɛneɛ mɔɔ la me nee bɛ avinli a, amaa bɛanwu kɛ medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mete bɛ nwo a. 13Noko Yizilayɛma dele me nwo atua wɔ fienemgbole ne anu. Bɛanli me mɛla ne mɔ azo, bɛkpole me ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛdi zolɛ a bɛkɛnyia ngoane la, yɛɛ bɛambu me Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ne mɔ bie. Menyɛle me adwenle kɛ mewola me ɛya ne meagua bɛ nwo zo wɔ fienemgbole ne anu, na meabɔ bɛ bo zo bɔkɔɔ. 14Noko me duma ne ati, mengakyile me adwenle, amaa me duma anzɛkye wɔ maanle maanle ne mɔ mɔɔ menyele bɛ menvile bɛ avinli me nee bɛ rale la anyunlu. 15 Yemɔti menganle ndane mengilele bɛ wɔ fienemgbole ne anu kɛ me nee bɛ ɛnrɛra azɛlɛ kpalɛ ne mɔɔ kye aleɛ, na ɔle azɛlɛ kpalɛ ɔtɛla azɛlɛ kɔsɔɔti, mɔɔ meva memaa bɛ la azo. 16Menganle ndane ne, ɔboalekɛ bɛkpole me ndenle ne mɔ, bɛanli me mɛla ne mɔ azo, yɛɛ bɛambu me Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ne mɔ bie, ɔluakɛ bɛlile bɛ awozonle nzi.
17“Noko akee menwunle bɛ anwunvɔne. Meanzɛkye bɛ yɛɛ meambɔ bɛ bo zo wɔ fienemgbole ne anu. 18Na menganle mengilele bɛ mra wɔ fienemgbole ne anu kɛ, ‘Bɛmmafa bɛ ze mɔ agyakɛ, bɛmmadua bɛ ndenle ne mɔ anu, yɛɛ bɛmmasonle bɛ awozonle ne mɔ na bɛgua bɛ nwo evinli. 19Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, mame a mele bɛ Nyamenle ne a. Bɛli me mɛla ne mɔ azo, na bɛnlea boɛ bɛli me ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔ azo, 20bɛde me Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ne mɔ anwo, amaa yeayɛ sɛkɛlɛneɛ yeala me nee bɛ avinli, na bɛanwu kɛ medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mele bɛ Nyamenle a.’
21“Noko bɛ awolɛndoazo zɔhane dele me nwo atua. Bɛanli me mɛla ne mɔ azo, yɛɛ bɛanli me ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛdi zolɛ a bɛkɛnyia ngoane la azo. Eza bɛambu me Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ne mɔ bie. Menyɛle me adwenle kɛ mewola me ɛya ne meagua bɛ nwo zo, na meazɛkye bɛ wɔ fienemgbole ne anu. 22Noko mendwenlenle nwolɛ bieko wɔ me duma ne ati, amaa me duma anzɛkye maanle maanle mɔɔ me nee bɛ ɛra bɛ avinli la anyunlu. 23 Yemɔti eza menganle ndane wɔ fienemgbole ne anu kɛ mebɔ bɛ asande na meakponde bɛ wɔ maanle maanle ne mɔ anu, 24ɔboalekɛ bɛanli me ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔ azo, na bɛkpo me mɛla ne mɔ yɛɛ bɛambu me Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ne mɔ bie. Bɛvale bɛ ti bɛzɔle bɛ ze mɔ mmonle ne mɔ.
25“Yemɔti memanle bɛ mɛla mɔɔ ɛnle kpalɛ nee ngyehyɛlɛ mɔɔ bɛdi zolɛ a, bɛnrɛnyia ngoane la. 26Memanle bɛvale bɛ belamunli mralɛ bɛyelale bɛ bɛbɔle azu, na bɛluale bɛ ahyɛlɛ ninyɛne zo bɛzɛkyele bɛ nwo. Menyɛle ɛhye menganle bɛ ɛzulolɛ, amaa bɛanwu kɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a.
27“Zɔhane ati, sonla ra, tendɛ kile Yizilayɛma na se bɛ kɛ Awulae Nyamenle ne se: Adenle mɔɔ bɛ ze mɔ luale nu hanle me ɛya la a le kɛ bɛanli nɔhalɛ bɛammaa me. 28Ɔluakɛ mɔɔ me nee bɛ radwule azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ menganle ndane kɛ mefa meamaa bɛ la azo la, ɛnee akee ɛleka biala mɔɔ bɛkɛnwu boka tendenle biala anzɛɛ baka buzuu biala la, ɛkɛ ne a bɛbɔ azu ne mɔ, na bɛye bɛ ahyɛlɛdeɛ ne mɔ, bɛyela bɛ azubɔlɛ ninyɛne ne mɔ na bɛgua bɛ nza ne mɔ a. 29Membizale bɛ kɛ, ‘Na ɛleka ɛhye mɔ mɔɔ bɛkɔsonle la noko ɛ?’ Yemɔti ɛnɛ nee ɛnɛ ala, bɛtɛfɛlɛ ɛkɛ ne Beema. 30Yemɔti ka kile Yizilayɛma kɛ, medame Awulae Nyamenle, melɛbiza bɛ kɛ: Bɛfa bɛ ze mɔ agyakɛ, bɛaminli adenle bɛayɛ bɛkyi ninyɛne ne mɔ bɛagua bɛ nwo evinli ɔ? 31Bɛhu bɛ mra mrenya bɛyela bɛ bɛbɔ azu bɛmaa awozonle bɛgua bɛ nwo evinli toonwo a yeradwu ɛnɛ a. Yizilayɛma, na akee mame yɛɛ bɛbabiza me bɛanwu mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛyɛ la ɔ? Suzuamgba ala mɔɔ medame a mele Awulae Nyamenle ne la, mese, menrɛmaa adenle menrɛmaa bɛnrɛbiza me edwɛkɛ biala. 32Mɔɔ wɔ bɛ adwenle nu la ɛnrɛyɛ zɔhane ɛlɛ. Bɛ adwenle a le kɛ, bɛkulo kɛ bɛyɛ kɛ maanle maanle ne mɔ, nee mbusua ekpunli ekpunli mɔɔ wɔ maanle ne mɔ anu la na bɛsonle mbaka nee awolɛ. Na ɔnrɛyɛ zɔhane ɛlɛ.
Nyamenle tea sonla na ɔfa ɔkyɛ ye
33“Suzuamgba ala mɔɔ medame a mele Awulae Nyamenle ne la, medame a mele tease Nyamenle ne a. Mebava ɛya nee tumi kpole meazie bɛ na meali bɛ belemgbunli. 34Mebaye bɛ meavi menli ngakyile kɔsɔɔti anu, na meaboɔboa bɛ nloa meavi maanle maanle mɔɔ membɔle bɛ asande menguale nu la anu. Mebava ɛya nee tumi kpole a meayɛ ɛhye a. 35Mebava bɛ meara ‘Maanle Maanle Ɛsɛlɛzo,’ na ɛkɛ ne yɛɛ mebaye me nyunlu meadea bɛ a. 36Kɛ menzile mendeanle bɛ ze mɔ wɔ Saenae Fienemgbole nu la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ mebadea bɛdabɛ noko a. Medame Awulae Nyamenle a mese a.
37“Mebanlea bɛ boɛ na meaholo bɛ nwo zo meamaa bɛali me ngyekyeleɛ ne azo. 38Mebakpa bɛ nuhua meaye atuadelɛma nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛto me mɛla ne la wɔ bɛ avinli. Mebaye bɛ meavi azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ bɛde zolɛ kɛkala la azo, noko bɛ gyakɛ ba ɛnrɛtia Yizilayɛ azɛlɛ zo. Na akee bɛbanwu kɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a.”
39Na Awulae Nyamenle ne zele kɛ, “Bɛmɛ Yizilayɛma, bɛhɔ zolɛ. Saa bɛnrɛdie me a, ɛnee awie biala ɛbɔ ɔ bo ɛnɛ nee dahuu ɔzonle ye mmonle ne mɔ. Noko bɛmmafa bɛ ahyɛlɛ ninyɛne nee bɛ mmonle ne mɔ bɛsɛkye me duma. 40Ɔluakɛ medame Awulae Nyamenle ne, mese, wɔ me boka nwuanzanwuanza ne azo, wɔ Yizilayɛ azɛlɛ zo awoka ne mɔ anu, ɛkɛ ne yɛɛ Yizilayɛma kɔsɔɔti bazonle me a. Ɛkɛ ne yɛɛ mebalie bɛ meado nu a, yɛɛ ɛkɛ ne a mebalie bɛ ahyɛlɛ ninyɛne kpalɛ ne nee bɛ azubɔlɛ ninyɛne nwuanzanwuanza ne mɔ a. 41Saa me nee bɛ vi menli ngakyile nee maanle maanle mɔɔ mendole bɛ memkpondenle nu la anu sia ba a, mebalie bɛ kɛ azubɔlɛ evuanlɛ, na meahile me nwuanzanwuanzayɛlɛ ne wɔ bɛ avinli meamaa maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti anwu ye. 42Saa mefa bɛ meba Yizilayɛ azɛlɛ zo maanle ne mɔɔ menvale membɔle bɛ ze mɔ ɛwɔkɛ la anu a, bɛbanwu kɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a. 43Bɛbahakye bɛ ndenle mɔɔ bɛluale nu nee nyɛleɛ ɛtane ɛtane mɔɔ bɛyɛle bɛvale bɛzɛkyele bɛ nwo la, na bɛavu bɛ nwo wɔ bɛ ninyɛndane mɔɔ bɛyɛle la amuala anwo. 44O Yizilayɛma, me nee bɛ ɛnrɛli kɛmɔ bɛ ninyɛndane anzɛɛ bɛ munzule ɛbɛla ne mɔ si de la, amaa bɛanwu kɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a. Medame, Awulae Nyamenle ne a mese a.”
Nyiakɛ senle ne
45Ɛdɛnkɛma dendɛle hilele me. 46Ɔse, “Sonla ra, kakyi ɛ nye wɔ nyiakɛ. Bɔ Nyamenle edwɛkɛ ne nolo kile bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ nyiakɛ la, na ka Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ ne mɔɔ tia nyiakɛ kpɔkɛ ne la. 47Ka kile nyiakɛ kpɔkɛ ne kɛ bɛdie Ɛdɛnkɛma edwɛkɛ ne: Awulae Nyamenle ne se, ‘Mebado senle wɔ bɛ avinli meamaa yeayela baka amolɛ nee baka wulera biala mɔɔ wɔ bɛ avinli la. Awie ɛnrɛhola senle ne mɔɔ ɛlɛsɔ la nua; ɔbayelɛyela awie biala anyunlu, ɔvi nyiakɛ yeahɔdwu sɔlɔ. 48Menli kɔsɔɔti banwu kɛ medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mendole senle ne a. Awie biala ɛnrɛhola ye nua.’ ”
49Na menganle kɛ, “Aa, O Awulae Nyamenle! Bɛlɛkeha ye wɔ me nwo kɛ, ‘Asoo tɛ nwɔra a ɔlɛto yeahile yɛ la?’ ”

Title: YIZ 21
Content:
Ɛdɛnkɛma dadeɛ ne
1Ɛdɛnkɛma dendɛle hilele me. 2Ɔse, “Sonla ra, kakyi ɛ nye wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm na ka Nyamenle edwɛkɛ tia ɛleka nwuanzanwuanza ne mɔ. Ka Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ ne mɔɔ tia Yizilayɛ azɛlɛ ne la 3na ka kɛ, Ɛdɛnkɛma se: Bɛnlea, mele bɛ kpɔvolɛ, mebahwe me dadeɛ ne wɔ ye boa ne anu, na meahu amumuyɛma nee tenlenema amuala. 4Mebahu awie biala, kpalɛ o, amumuyɛnli o, ɔvi nyiakɛ yeahɔdwu sɔlɔ. 5Na menli kɔsɔɔti banwu kɛ medame, Ɛdɛnkɛma a mehwe bɛ nwo dadeɛ a, menrɛva menrɛwula ye boa ne anu bieko.
6“Sonla ra, gu ɛnwomenle, kponle ɛ bo kɛ ɛlɛdi nyane kpole bie la wɔ bɛ nye zo ɛkɛ ne. 7Na saa bɛbiza wɔ kɛ, ‘Duzu ati a wɔgu ɛnwomenle kpole ɛhye’ a, ka kile bɛ kɛ nrɛlaleɛ ne mɔɔ ɛlɛba la ati ɔ. Saa nrɛlaleɛ ne ba a, awie biala ahonle badu. Bɛ sa nu batuto, bɛ nwo bagolo bɛ, na bɛ gyakɛ agbɔkɛ abili kɛ atɛ. Bɛdie, kɛ ɔlɛba ɛ, na ɔbayɛ zɔhane noko. Medame Awulae Nyamenle a mese a.”
8Ɛdɛnkɛma dendɛle hilele me. 9Ɔse, “Sonla ra, ka Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ ne kɛ,
‘Kɛ Awulae se la ɛne:
Dadeɛ, bɛzi dadeɛ na bɛhwi nwolɛ.
10Bɛzi kɛ bɛfa bɛahu menli,
bɛhwi nwolɛ, amaa yeapɛ kɛ ɛsɛnlɛmanye.
Anyelielɛ biala ɛnle ɛkɛ ne ko,
ɔluakɛ me ra nrenya ne ɛkpo me kɔkɔbɔlɛ,
nee nwolɛ ndeanlɛ ne.
11Yemɔti bɛva dadeɛ ne bɛmaa kɛ bɛhwi nwolɛ,
amaa bɛava bɛali gyima.
Bɛzi na bɛhwi nwolɛ,
amaa bɛava bɛamaa mɔɔ ku sonla la.
12Sonla ra, su ye awolɛ,
ɔluakɛ dadeɛ ne ɛlɛkɔ me menli ne
nee Yizilayɛ arelemgbunli anwo zo.
Bɛye Yizilayɛ arelemgbunli nee menli ne amuala
bɛmaa kɛ bɛhu bɛ wɔ dadeɛ nloa.
Fa nyane bɔ ɛ sa ati.
13“ ‘Ɛhye ɛnle sɔnea edwɛkɛ,
saa bɛkpo me kɔkɔbɔlɛ ne a,
ɛnee duzu a li ɔ nzi a?’
Medame Awulae Nyamenle a mebiza bɛ a.
14“Zɔhane ati sonla ra, ka Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ ne. Bɔ ɛ sa nu maa dadeɛ ne mɔɔ ku menli ne la ɛrɛla na eza ɔrɛla bieko, fane nsa bɔbɔ. Ɔle dadeɛ mɔɔ bahu menli dɔɔnwo yeaha bɛ ɛzulolɛ a, 15amaa bɛ ahonle adu na dɔɔnwo adɔ anlenkɛ kpole ne anloa. Meva dadeɛ ne mɔɔ anwo ɛlɛta la memaa; ɔfede kɛ ezule. Bɛhwi nwolɛ kɛ bɛva bɛhu menli. 16To wɔ dadeɛ ne fema zo nee bɛne zo, to ye ɛleka biala mɔɔ ɔ nye kɛli la. 17Medame noko mebabɔ me sa nu na akee me ɛya ne adwo. Medame a mese a.”
Babelonia belemgbunli ne dadeɛ ne
18Ɛdɛnkɛma dendɛle hilele me. 19Ɔse, “Sonla ra, kile ndenle nwiɔ mɔɔ Babelonia belemgbunli ne bava ye dadeɛ ne alua nuhua ara la. Ɔwɔ kɛ ndenle nwiɔ ne fi maanle ko ne ala anu a ba a. Akee yɛ sɛkɛlɛneɛ baka maa ɔhile adenle mɔɔ bɛfa nu bɛkɔ suakpole ne azo la. 20Kile adenle mɔɔ dadeɛ ne balua nuhua ara Amɔnoma sua ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Relaba la azo, maa ɔlua ɛkɛ ɔrɛla Dwuda na ɔhɔ suakpole Gyɛlusalɛm mɔɔ bɛhye nwolɛ ɛhane la azo. 21Babelonia belemgbunli ne bagyinla nwɔnda ne azo, wɔ ndenle nwiɔ ne ati, na yeabiza nwolɛ, ɔbabili ye ɛda mbaka ne mɔ, yeado yeabiza ye amonle ne, na yeanlea nane ne mɔɔ bɛhu ye la ɛvovoa. 22Ɛbizalɛ ne babɔ Gyɛlusalɛm, na ɔkile kɛ ɔhɔ na ɔhɔva konle ɔdoa Gyɛlusalɛm, ɔbɛnra ɔyia sua ne, ɔva mbaka mgbole ɔsisi Gyɛlusalɛm nlenkɛ mgbole ne mɔ na ɔvu kuma wɔ suakpole ne anwo ɔbɛnra ɔyia. 23Noko Gyɛlusalɛm amra ɛdeɛ, bɛbadwenle kɛ, kɛmɔ bɛli amonle la ati, ɛhye ɛnrɛyɛ zɔhane. Nyamenle bamaa bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ ala ali na nyɛvolɛ ɛlɔnema ali bɛ nwo zo konim. 24Yemɔti medame Awulae Nyamenle, mese: Kɛmɔ bɛmaa bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ ɛla ali, na bɛ mɛladonlɛ ne mɔ ɛza ɛgua zolɛ, na bɛ nyɛleɛ ɛtane ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti ɛla ali wienyi la, bɛbadea bɛ na bɛaye bɛ bɛamaa bɛ kpɔvolɛma.
25“Wɔmɔ Yizilayɛ belemgbunli, amumuyɛnli mɔɔ anwo ɛnde a, wɔ kɔpo ne ɛyi, na yedwu mɔɔ akee ɔwɔ kɛ bɛsɛkye wɔ bɔkɔɔ a. 26Medame Awulae Nyamenle mese: Bɛdu ɔ ti abɔtile ne, na bɛdu zolɛ kpɔba kpoonwu ne. Debie biala ɛnrɛyɛ kɛ ye dɛba ne la bieko. Debie biala bahakyi. Maa mɔɔ le bɛlɛvo la zo, na bɛlɛ mɔɔ memaa ɔ nwo zo la aze. 27Munzule o, munzule! Mebamaa munzule ado suakpole ne na meayɛ ye suadu. Noko ɛhye ɛnrɛzi, kyesɛ ahenle mɔɔ ɔle ye ɛdeɛ la ba, na yemɔ yɛɛ mebava meamaa ye a.
Amɔnoma nee dadeɛ
28 “Na wɔmɔ, sonla ra, ka Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ ne na ka mɔɔ medame Awulae Nyamenle, melɛka meahile wɔ, mɔɔ fane Amɔnoma nee bɛ ɛralɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛba Yizilayɛma anwo zo la anwo edwɛkɛ kile bɛ. Ka kile bɛ kɛ,
‘Dadeɛ, bɛhwe dadeɛ kɛ bɛku menli;
bɛhwi nwolɛ, amaa yeapɛ kɛ ɛsɛnlɛmanye.
29Ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ biala mɔɔ bɛnwu la ɛnle nɔhalɛ, yɛɛ bɛ abisadeɛ edwɛkɛ biala mɔɔ bɛka la le adalɛ, na ɔbakpomgbolo amumuyɛma mɔɔ anwo ɛnde na bɛ mekɛ ɛdwu kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛsɛkye bɛ la akɔme.
30“ ‘Bɛva bɛ dadeɛ ne bɛwula ye boa ne anu. Mebabua bɛ ndɛne wɔ ɛleka mɔɔ bɛbɔle bɛ, wɔ azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ bɛwole bɛ bɛguale zolɛ la azo. 31Mebawola me ɛya ne meagua bɛ nwo zo, na meava ɛya mɔɔ le kɛ senle la meazɛkye bɛ. Mebaye bɛ meawula menli mɔɔ ati yɛ se na bɛze menli ɛhunlɛ nye zo kpalɛ la asa anu. 32Bɛbayɛ kɛ ɛyɛne, bɛayela bɛ senle nu. Bɛbaha bɛ mogya bɛagua maanle ne anu, yɛɛ awie ɛnrɛhakye bɛ bieko, ɔluakɛ medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.’ ”

Title: YIZ 22
Content:
Gyɛlusalɛm mɛladonlɛ ne mɔ
1Eza Ɛdɛnkɛma dendɛle hilele me. 2Ɔse, “Na wɔmɔ, sonla ra, asoo ɛbabua suakpole ne mɔɔ ahɔdiawu ɛyi ye tɛkɛɛ la ndɛne? Ɛnee fa ye bɛkyi nyɛleɛ ne mɔ si ɔ nyunlu. 3Ka kile ye kɛ medame Awulae Nyamenle, mese: Ɔle suakpole mɔɔ bɛka mogya bɛgua ye awɔdenle zo, na bɛva awozonle ɛzonlenlɛ bɛzɛkye bɛ nwo a, bɛ kɔpo ne bayi! 4Bɛdi fɔlɛ wɔ mogya mɔɔ bɛha bɛgua, nee bɛ awozonle mɔɔ bɛdabɛ bɛyɛ la ɛzonlenlɛ nwo. Bɛmaa bɛ mekɛ ne ɛbikye, bɛ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛhilele la ɛdwu. Yemɔti meyɛ bɛ mɔɔ maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti bakpɔ bɛ na bɛagolo bɛ nwo. 5Maanle maanle mɔɔ bikye bɛ nee maanle maanle mɔɔ wɔ moa moa la amuala bazi bɛ amgbu. Bɛnle kpalɛ bɛdabɛ, bɛle amaanleto kpalɛ kpalɛ. 6Bɛnlea, bɛdabɛ Yizilayɛ arelemgbunli mɔɔ wɔ bɛ avinli la, nuhua ko biala ɛyɛ ye adwenle kɛ ɔfa ye tumi ne yeaha mogya yeagua. 7 Bɛmbu selɛ na yeayɛ ninli, bɛbɔ nyɛvolɛ apo bɛdie bɛ ninyɛne, yɛɛ bɛsisi mɔɔ ɛnlɛ ɔ ze nee ahunlanvolɛ mraalɛ. 8 Bɛkpo me ninyɛne nwuanzanwuanza ne mɔ, yɛɛ bɛnzie me Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ne. 9Menli wɔ bɛ avinli mɔɔ pɛ nwondomgbɔ na bɛka mogya bɛgua a; menli wɔ bɛ avinli mɔɔ bɔ azu maa awozonle na bɛdidi awoka ne mɔ azo lɔ a, yɛɛ menli wɔ bɛ avinli mɔɔ ɛnze nyiane wɔ adwɔmane ɛbɛla mgbane mgbane ɛbɔlɛ nwo a. 10 Mrenya wɔ bɛ avinli mɔɔ fa bɛ ze mɔ mraalɛ, yɛɛ bie mɔ fa mraalɛ mɔɔ ɛhɔ amozi la. 11Bie mɔ fa bɛ gɔnwo mɔ mraalɛ; bie mɔ ɛnze bɛ mra mrenya mraalɛ nyiane na bɛfa bɛ; bie fa ɔ diema raalɛ mɔɔ ɔ nee ye bɛ ze ko la. 12 Menli wɔ bɛ avinli mɔɔ die ndoloboa ku awie mɔ, bɛdie nzinwo, bɛdie bie bɛboka nwo na bɛsisi awie mɔ bɛfa bɛnyia bɛ nwo. Bɛ rɛle ɛvi me bɔkɔɔ, medame Awulae Nyamenle a mese a.
13“Yemɔti bɛnlea, meva me sa mebɔ bɛ awule nvasoɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛnyia la anu medua bɛ ahɔdiawu ɛbɛla ne mɔ. 14Asoo mekɛ dwu na mese kɛ me nee bɛ di a, bɛ sa nu kɛyɛ se, bɛkɛhola gyinla? Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a, yɛɛ mebayɛ noko. 15Mebakponde bɛ maanle maanle zo, na meazande bɛ wɔ maanle maanle ne mɔ anu, meamaa bɛagyakyi bɛ ninyɛne ɛtane ɛtane ne mɔ ɛyɛlɛ. 16Maanle maanle ne mɔ banwu kɛ bɛwie mgbane yɛ, na akee bɛanwu kɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a.”
Nyamenle debie nu evinlidulɛ fonlomo ne
17Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me kɛ, 18“Sonla ra, Yizilayɛma ɛyɛ ewula wɔ me nye zo. Bɛ kɔsɔɔti bɛyɛ kɛ dwɛtɛ fufule nee kɔbele, kyɛnze nee bulalɛ nee sumi mɔɔ bɛholo bɛ fonlomo nu toonwo bɛhakyi ewula la. 19Yemɔti medame Awulae Nyamenle, mese: Kɛmɔ bɛ muala bɛyɛ ewula la, mebahuohua bɛ kɔsɔɔti bɛ nloa wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm. 20Kɛ sonla si kuohua dwɛtɛ fufule, kɔbele, bulalɛ, sumi, yɛɛ kyɛnze nloa wula bɛ fonlomo nu, na ɔwuda nu ɔmaa bɛkolo la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ mebava ɛya meahuohua bɛ nloa, meawula bɛ senle nu meaholo bɛ a. 21Mebahuohua bɛ nloa na meawuda me ɛya senle ne bɛ bo meaholo bɛ. 22Kɛ bɛsi bɛkolo dwɛtɛ fufule wɔ fonlomo nu la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ mebaholo bɛdabɛ a, na akee bɛanwu kɛ medame Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛɛ mewola me ɛya ne megua bɛ nwo zo a.”
Ɛtane mɔɔ Yizilayɛ mgbanyima yɛle la
23Eza Ɛdɛnkɛma dendɛle hilele me. 24Ɔse, “Sonla ra, ka kile Yizilayɛ kɛ ɔle azɛlɛ mɔɔ zolɛ ɛnde a, anzɛɛ sumunli kɛ bɛvale ɛya bɛdeanle ye la zolɛ ɛtɛtele. 25Arelemgbunli mɔɔ wɔ maanle ne anu la le kɛ awenade mɔɔ ɛnyia nane na ɔlɛkpo yeatete ye la. Bɛli menli nwonane, bɛve anwoneɛ nee ninyɛne mɔɔ sonle bolɛ, yɛɛ bɛmaa ahunlanvolɛ mraalɛ ɛzo dɔɔnwo wɔ bɛ avinli. 26 Bɛ sɛlɛvolɛma ɛvuandi me mɛla ne ɛdo na bɛgua me ninyɛne nwuanzanwuanza ne mɔ anwo evinli. Bɛammaa ngakyile anla ninyɛne mɔɔ le nwuanzanwuanza nee mɔɔ ɛnle nwuanzanwuanza la avinli, yɛɛ bɛangile ngakyile mɔɔ la ninyɛne mɔɔ anwo te nee mɔɔ anwo ɛnde la avinli. Bɛambu me Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ne mɔ, yemɔti bɛgua me nwo evinli wɔ bɛ avinli. 27Arelemgbunli mɔɔ wɔ maanle ne anu la le kɛ bɛdi mɔɔ ɛlɛtete nane la. Bɛka mogya bɛgua, bɛsɛkye ngoane na bɛfa bɛnyia awule nvasoɛ. 28Bɛ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ ɛnle nɔhalɛ, bɛka adalɛ abisadeɛ edwɛkɛ na bɛava kisane bɛagua zolɛ bɛaze kɛ, ‘Kɛ Awulae Nyamenle ne se la ɛne’, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛtɛbukele ɔ nloa la. 29Menli mɔɔ wɔ maanle ne anu la ɛzukoa apobɔlɛ, yɛɛ bɛyɛ bɛ nwo nwule. Bɛsisi ehyianvolɛ nee mɔɔ ɛhyia la; bɛsisi nyɛvolɛ bɛwua bɛ, yɛɛ bɛngakyi bɛ ɛbɛla ne. 30Memkpondɛle sonla wɔ bɛ avinli mɔɔ to bane ne na yeagyinla me gyakɛ anu wɔ maanle ne anu, amaa meanzɛkye azɛlɛ ne, noko meannyia bie. 31Yemɔti mewola me ɛya ne megua bɛ nwo zo. Meva me ɛya senle ne meyela bɛ; memaa bɛ ɛbɛla ne ɛbu ɛzia bɛ, medame, Awulae Nyamenle a mese a.”

Title: YIZ 23
Content:
Mediema mraalɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ yɛle ɛtane la
1Ɛdɛnkɛma dendɛle hilele me. 2Ɔse, “Sonla ra, mraalɛ nwiɔ wɔ ɛkɛ, bɛ nli ko. 3Bɛbɔle tuutuu ɛbɛla wɔ Yigyibiti. Mekɛ ne anu ɛnee bɛle mbɛlɛra, na bɛmanle bɛmiemianle bɛ nyɛfo na bɛminlinle bɛ belamunliyɛlɛ ne. 4Bɛfɛlɛ kpanyinli ne Ɔhola, yɛɛ bɛfɛlɛ ekyi ne Ɔhɔleba. (Ɔhola gyi ɛkɛ ne maa Samɛlea, yɛɛ Ɔhɔleba gyi ɛkɛ ne maa Gyɛlusalɛm). Bɛ mu nwiɔ bɛyɛle me ɛdeɛ, na bɛwole mralɛ mrenya nee mralɛ mraalɛ. 5Mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee Ɔhola le me ɛdeɛ la, ɔbɔle tuutuu ɛbɛla na nla atiakunluwɔzo ti ɔdule ɔdoale ye kulovolɛma mɔɔ vi Aselea la. 6Bɛle sogyama mɔɔ wula adɛladeɛ kɔkɔlɛ, amɛnladoma nee safohyenlema mgbanyinli. Bɛ muala bɛle mgbavolɛ mɔɔ anwo yɛ fɛ, yɛɛ bɛka mgbɔnwɔ. 7Ɔvale ye tuutuulilɛ ne ɔbɛkabɛkale Aseleama ɛhye mɔ mɔɔ anwo yɛ fɛ la, na ɔzonlenle awie ko biala mɔɔ vale ye la bozonle mɔɔ ɔlɛ la. 8Yeangyakyi ye tuutuulilɛ ne mɔɔ ɔlile wɔ Yigyibiti la anzi ɛlilɛ, ɔluakɛ ɔvi ye mbɛlɛra nu, mrenya nee ye lale na bɛsosɔle ɔ nyɛfo, na bɛyɛle ye kɛmɔ bɛkɛyɛ tuutuunli ala la. 9Yemɔti menyele ye menwulale ye kulovolɛma, Aseleama asa anu. 10Menli ɛhye mɔ kpale ɔ nwo, bɛhyele ɔ mra mrenya nee mraalɛ ne mɔ na bɛhunle ɔdaye mumua ne. Mekɛ mɔɔ bɛduale ye kakɛ mɔɔ le zɛhae la, mraalɛ kɔsɔɔti vale ye edwɛkɛ lile adwelie.
11“ Ɔ diema Ɔhɔleba nwunle ɛhye, noko yemɔ bɔbɔ akee ɔzɛkyele ɔdɛlale ɔ diema ne. Ɔbɔle tuutuu ɛbɛla ɔdɛlale ɔ diema ne. 12Ɔtetele ɔdɔle Aseleama, amɛnladoma, safohyenlema mgbanyinli, sogyama mɔɔ wulowula adɛladeɛ kɔkɔlɛ, yɛɛ sogyama mɔɔ tɛnla mgbɔnwɔ zo la akɔme nu; bɛ kɔsɔɔti bɛle mgbavolɛ mɔɔ anwo yɛ fɛ a. 13Na menwunle kɛ yezɛkye, na bɛ mu nwiɔ bɛlua edinli ko azo.
14“Ɔhɔleba ati minle tuutuulilɛ ne anu kpalɛ. Ɔnwunle kɛ bɛdolɔdolɔ mrenya bie wɔ bane nwo, mrenya mɔ vi Babelonia la nvoninli ɔ; bɛpenti bɛ ngɛnlɛma, 15bɛva bɛlɛte bɛhyehye bɛ avinli, bɛbɔ bɛ abɔtile na ko biala zɔho sogya kpanyinli mɔɔ vi Babelonia la. 16Ɔnwunle bɛ ala la ye nla atiakunluwɔzo ne rale bɛ nwo zo, na ɔzoanle menli bɛ nwo lɔ wɔ Babelonia. 17Babeloniama rale na bɛ nee ye ralale, bɛhulole bɛ nwo; bɛvale bɛ atiakunluwɔzo ne bɛguale ɔ nwo zo. Na mɔɔ akee bɛzɛkyele ye bɛwiele la, bɛ nwo vonlonle ye na ɔgyakyile bɛ. 18Mɔɔ akee ɔyele ɔ nyunlu ɔbɔle tuutuu ɛbɛla, ɔkpale ɔ nwo ɔhilele la, ɔmanle mengyile ye na mengakyile me nzi menzile ye, kɛmɔ menyɛle ɔ diema raalɛ ne la. 19Noko ɔ ti minle tuutuulilɛ nu kpalɛ kpalɛ; ɔhakyele mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee ɔle bɛlɛra, mɔɔ ɔbɔ ye tuutuu ɛbɛla ne wɔ Yigyibiti la. 20Ɔvale nwuvolɛ mrenya mɔɔ bɛ mrenyanu mgbole le kɛ asoaso ɛdeɛ ne, na bɛ nlanzule zonle kɛ ɛkpɔnwɔ ɛdeɛ ne la. 21(Ɔhɔleba, zɛhae yɛɛ ɛyɛle ɛvale ɛhakyele wɔ mbɛlɛra nu adwɔmane ne mɔɔ ɛbɔle wɔ Yigyibiti, ɛmanle bɛmiemianle ɛ nyɛfo mgbokua ne na bɛzɛkyele wɔ la.)”
Nyamenle ndeanlɛ mɔɔ wɔ adiema raalɛ ekyi ne anwo zo la
22Zɔhane ati, Ɔhɔleba, Awulae Nyamenle ne se, “Nea, mebamaa wɔ kulovolɛma mɔɔ anwo vonlonle wɔ na ɛhakyile ɛ nzi ɛzile bɛ la adwazo ɛ nwo zo. Mebava bɛ meavi ɛleka kɔsɔɔti meara ɛ nwo zo: 23Babeloniama nee Kaledeama amuala, Pikɔdo, Hyowa, Kowa, yɛɛ Aselea mgbavolɛ mɔɔ anwo yɛ fɛ, amɛnladoma nee safohyenle mgbanyinli, sogya mgbanyinli nee sogyama mɔɔ tɛnla mgbɔnwɔ zo la amuala. 24Bɛvi sɔlɔ, bɛlɛ konle ehwili nee aleɛ ehwili nee menli dɔɔnwo kpalɛ mɔɔ dedɛ ahoholombaka nee bɛ sa nu enyinlike, na bɛzozo mbulalɛ ahyɛlɛ la bɛbara ɛ nwo zo, na mebagyakyi bɛ meamaa bɛadea wɔ, kɛmɔ ɔfɛta la. 25Mebava ɛ nwo ɛya kpole, amaa bɛ nee wɔ ali ye ɛsesebɛ kpalɛ. Bɛbapɛ ɛ bonyi nee ɛ nzo. Menli mɔɔ baha ɛ nzi la badɔ dadeɛ nloa. Bɛbahye ɛ mra mrenya nee mraalɛ, na bɛava senle bɛayela bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛha la. 26Bɛbakpa ɛ nwo ndanlɛ kɔsɔɔti na bɛava wɔ anwoneɛ ne mɔ bɛahɔ. 27Mebayɛ ɛhye meava meadua wɔ tuutuulilɛ nee wɔ adwɔmanebɔlɛ atiakunluwɔzo ne mɔɔ ɛ nee ye vi Yigyibiti rale la. Ɛnrɛhola ɛ nye zo maa nea Yigyibitima, yɛɛ ɛnrɛhakye bɛ bieko.”
28Ɔluakɛ Awulae Nyamenle ne se, “Nea, mebaye wɔ meawula bɛdabɛ mɔɔ ɛkyi bɛ la asa anu. 29Bɛ nee wɔ bali ye ɛkpɔlɛ nu, na bɛava ɛ nwo ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti, bɛagyakyi wɔ kpoholokpo bɛado ɛkɛ, na wɔ tuutuulilɛ ne ala ali. Wɔ tuutuulilɛ nee wɔ adwɔmanebɔlɛ a ɛva ɛhye ɛra ɛ nwo zo a, 30ɔboalekɛ ɛbɔle tuutuu ɛbɛla wɔ maanle maanle ne mɔ anu na ɛguale ɛ nwo evinli, ɛzonlenle bɛ mmonle ne mɔ. 31Wɔva ɛ diema raalɛ ne agyakɛ, yemɔti mebava ye nyane kɔpo ne meawula ɛ sa nu.”
32Awulae Nyamenle ne se.
“Ɛbanlo ɛ diema ralɛ ne nyane kɔpo ne anu;
ɔle kpole yɛɛ ɔ kunlu kɔ.
Bɛbazele wɔ, bɛagolo ɛ nwo,
ɔluakɛ edwɛkɛ dɔɔnwo wɔ nu.
33Nyane ngome babo wɔ nza.
Ɛ diema raalɛ Samɛlea nyane kɔpo ne,
nuhua yɛ ɛzulolɛ, ɔle ɛzɛkyelɛ ngome.
34Ɛbanlo wɔatafe nuhua,
na wɔazɔ ɛ ti enrinli wɔadudu ye,
wɔarelerele ɛ kɛnra azo;
ɔluakɛ medame Awulae Nyamenle a mese a.”
35Yemɔti Awulae Nyamenle ne se, “Kɛmɔ wɔmaa ɛ rɛle ɛvi me na wɔye me wɔdo ɛ nzi la ati, ɛdawɔ soa wɔ tuutuulilɛ nee wɔ adwɔmanebɔlɛ ne mɔ anwo ndeanlɛ ne.”
Nyamenle ndeanlɛ mɔɔ wɔ mediema mraalɛ nwiɔ ne anwo zo la
36Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me kɛ, “Sonla ra, tea Ɔhola nee Ɔhɔleba. Fa bɛ bɛkyi ninyɛne mɔɔ bɛyɛ la si bɛ nyunlu. 37Ɔluakɛ bɛdo awuvolɛvalɛ mɛla ne, yɛɛ mogya wɔ bɛ sa anwo. Bɛva bɛ awozonle ɛzonlenlɛ bɛzɛkye agyalɛ, na bɛva mralɛ mrenya mɔɔ me nee bɛ wole la bɛbɔ azu bɛmaa awozonle bɛmaa bɛdo bɛli. 38Eza bɛyɛ ɛhye noko bɛtia me: bɛva kenle ko ne bɛgua me Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anwo evinli, bɛbulu me Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle mɛla ne azo. 39Ɔluakɛ kenle ko ne ala mɔɔ bɛhunle bɛ mra ne mɔ bɛmanle bɛ awozonle ne mɔ la, bɛrale me Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu bɛraguale ɛkɛ ne evinli. Na nea, debie mɔɔ bɛyɛle la ɛne.
40“Bɛzoanle menli bɛmanle bɛhɔle moa moa bɛhɔvale mrenya. Mrenya zɔhane mɔ ati, bɛbiale bɛ nwo, bɛdole bɛ nye anzi, bɛvale bɛ anwoneɛ bɛzieziele bɛ nwo; 41bɛdɛnlanle ehwili kɛnlɛma mɔɔ bɛzie ɛkponle nu na bɛva me ɛyɛlɛ evuanlɛ ne nee me nwole ne bɛzie zolɛ la anu. 42Menli mɔɔ ɛhwee ɛnvane bɛ nwo la nee ye a lua a, yɛɛ eza menli mgbane bie, nzabovoma mɔɔ bɛ nee bɛ vi kpɔkɛ bie anu a rale la doale ye. Bɛvale ngɛba bɛguguale mraalɛ ne mɔ asa na bɛvale arelemgbunli ahyɛlɛ ngɛnlɛma bɛzoɔzoale bɛ. 43Na menganle kɛ: Asoo kɛkala, mrenya ne mɔ mɔɔ nee ye bɔ tuutuu ɛbɛla ne la ɛnnwu kɛ bɛlɛto awuvolɛvalɛ mɛla ne? 44Ɔluakɛ bɛ nee ye hɔlale na bɛvale ye kɛ mrenya fa tuutuu raalɛ la. Zɔhane ala yɛɛ bɛ nee Ɔhola nee ɔ diema Ɔhɔleba yɛle bɔle bɛ ɛbɛla mgbane mgbane ne a. 45Na menli mɔɔ di pɛlepɛle la babua bɛ ndɛne na bɛabua bɛ awuvolɛvalɛ nwo fɔlɛ. Eza bɛdi mraalɛ mɔɔ ku menli la anwo fɔlɛ, ɔboalekɛ bɛzɛkye agyalɛ yɛɛ mogya wɔ bɛ sa anwo.”
46Kɛ Awulae Nyamenle ne se la ɛne, “Bɛva menli dɔɔnwo bɛhɔ bɛ nwo zo, bɛnwunlonwunla bɛ na bɛve bɛ nwo ninyɛne. 47Bɛzi bɛ awolɛ, na bɛva dadeɛ bɛvoa bɛ. Bɛhu bɛ mra mrenya nee mraalɛ na bɛyela bɛ azua. 48Zɛhae a mebayɛ meadua adwɔmanebɔlɛ wɔ maanle ne anu a, amaa yeayɛ kɔkɔbɔlɛ yeamaa mraalɛ kɔsɔɔti na bɛambɔ adwɔmane ɛbɛla, kɛmɔ bɛmɛ bɛbɔ la. 49Bɛ adwɔmanebɔlɛ ne babɔ bɛ ti na bɛdabɛ bɛali bɛ awozonle ɛzonlenlɛ nwo ɛtane ne mɔ anwo ɛzonle, na bɛanwu kɛ medame a mele Awulae Nyamenle ne a.”

Title: YIZ 24
Content:
Danesɛne ne mɔɔ ɛlɔ nrɛnlana la
1Bɛ nee yɛ hɔle nlɔnu la, ye ɛvolɛ ngɔnla ne anu, siane bulu ne kenle bulu ne azo, Ɛdɛnkɛma dendɛle hilele me. 2 Ɔse, “Sonla ra, kɛlɛ ɛnɛ kenle ye duma. Ɛnɛ kenle ye Babelonia belemgbunli ɛva ɛlɔnema ɛbɛnra ɛyia Gyɛlusalɛm. 3Bu atuadelɛma ɛhye mɔ ɛrɛlɛ na ka kile bɛ kɛ, medame Awulae Nyamenle, mese:
Bɛva danesɛne ne bɛzie senle zo,
bɛva nzule bɛgua nu.
4Bɛva nane azinli ne mɔ bɛgua nu,
ye ɛleka biala mɔɔ le kpalɛ, ye ɛzɔlɛ nee ye
abɛsa ne mɔ;
bɛva mbowule kpalɛ ne mɔ noko bɛgua nu.
5Bɛnlea nu bɛye nyɛmoa ne mɔ anu kpalɛ ne,
bɛhua senle ɔ bo;
bɛdo nane ahunguma ahunguma ne mɔ;
bɛdo ye mbowule ne mɔ noko.”
6Awulae Nyamenle ne se, “Munzule ɛha ahɔdiawu suakpole ne, munzule ɛha zolɛ danesɛne ne mɔɔ ɛlɔ nrɛnlana na nuhua nrɛnlana ne ɛtɛtule la. Bɛyeye nuhua nane azinli ne mɔ ngoko, bɛmmakpa nu. 7Mogya ne mɔɔ yeha yegua la tɛbɔ zolɛ. Yeandwi yeangua anwea nu na anwea aheda zolɛ; ɔhwinle ɔguale bolɛ tandane zo. 8Memaa mogya ne mɔɔ yeha yegua la ɛla bolɛ ne azo, amaa yeaha me ɛya na meali nzenralɛ.”
9Awulae Nyamenle ne se, “Munzule ɛha ahɔdiawu suakpole ne. Medame noko mebahua ɛyɛne meamaa ɔ nwo zo ahɔ anwuma kpalɛ. 10Bɛhuohua ɛyɛzinli ne mɔ anloa, bɛva senle bɛgua nu, bɛmaa nane ne ɛbe kpalɛ, na akee bɛwola subue ne mɔɔ wɔ nwolɛ la, na bɛhakyi mbowule ne mɔ bɛgua senle ne anu bɛyela bɛ. 11Akee bɛva danesɛne mgbane ne bɛzie senle ne azo, bɛmaa ɔlɔ kpalɛ, ɔdɔlɔ woonwu na kɔbele ne ɛholo ɛheda evinli nee nrɛnlana biala azo. 12Medame, mevɛ mgbane. Senle ne angola kɔbele ne kolo yeammaa yeangeda nrɛnlana ne azo. 13Wɔ adwɔmane ɛbɛla mgbane mgbane ne a le nrɛnlana ne mɔɔ andu la. Kɛmɔ anrɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ metu ɛ nwo evinli ne amuala, noko ɛ nwo anvie, na ɛ nwo evinli ne bie tɛbɔ ɛkɛ ne la, ɛ nwo ɛnrɛvie ɛlɛ, kyesɛ mewola me ɛya kpole ne megua ɛ nwo zo na me kunlu adwo. 14Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a, mebayɛ mɔɔ meha la. Menrɛzia me nzi, menrɛze anwunvɔne yɛɛ menrɛvu me nwo. Mebadea bɛ, kɛmɔ bɛ nyɛleɛ nee bɛ ndenle ne mɔ si de la. Medame, Awulae Nyamenle a mese a.”
Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ ne aye ne ewule
15Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me kɛ, 16“Sonla ra, nea, mefa kɛlɛ kokye meaye ɛ ye ne mɔɔ ɛkulo ye kɛ debie la meavi ɛ nye zo, noko ɔnle kɛ ɛsu ye anzɛɛ ɛdi nyane, yɛɛ ɔnle kɛ ɛsuosua wɔ adɛladeɛ nu. 17Ɛbagu ɛnwomenle, noko ɔnle kɛ awie te, yɛɛ mmakile kɛ ɛlɛdi nyane. Fa wɔ abɔtile ne bɔ ɛ ti na fa wɔ mgbɔlaboa ne wula, mmakeda ɛ nyunlu yɛɛ mmadi aleɛ mɔɔ kile kɛ ɛlɛdi nyane la.”
18Yemɔti nwonlomɔ ne menganle mengilele menli ne, na ye nɔsolɛ nu me ye wule. Aleɛ hyenle bieko na ye nwonlomɔ ne menyɛle mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me la. 19Na menli ne bizale me kɛ, “Ɛnrɛhile ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ mɔɔ ɛlɛyɛ la abo ɛnrɛhile yɛ ɔ?”
20Na menganle mengilele bɛ kɛ, “Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛze me kɛ, menga mengile Yizilayɛma kɛ, 21Awulae Nyamenle ne se: Bɛnlea, mebagua me Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anwo evinli. Ɔle debie mɔɔ bɛfa bɛtu bɛ nwo a, bɛ nye ɛralɛ mɔɔ bɛ nye kuku nwolɛ a. Bɛ mra mrenya nee bɛ mra mraalɛ mɔɔ bɛgyakyile bɛ bɛ nzi la badɔ dadeɛ nloa. 22Na bɛbayɛ mɔɔ meyɛ la bie: bɛnrɛheda bɛ nyunlu yɛɛ bɛnrɛli aleɛ mɔɔ kile kɛ bɛlɛdi nyane la. 23Bɛbabɔ bɛ abɔtile ne mɔ, bɛawula mgbɔlaboa; bɛnrɛzu yɛɛ bɛnrɛli nyane. Bɛ ninyɛndane ne mɔ bamaa bɛanwa na bɛazu bɛ kunlu bɛakponle bɛahile bɛ nwo ngoko. 24Yizikeɛle bayɛ sɛkɛlɛneɛ amaa bɛ, na mɔɔ yeyɛ la, bie yɛɛ bɛdabɛ noko bɛbayɛ a. Na saa ɛhye mɔ sisi a, yɛɛ bɛbanwu kɛ medame a mele Awulae Nyamenle ne a.”
25Ɛdɛnkɛma zele kɛ, “Na wɔmɔ, Sonla ra, kenle ne mɔɔ mebaza bɛ mealie bɛ aranemgbole ne, bɛ anyelielɛ nee bɛ anyunlunyia, bɛ nye ɛralɛ ne, nee mɔɔ bɛ nye kuku nwolɛ, bɛ mra mrenya nee mraalɛ la, 26kenle ko zɔhane mɔɔ mebayɛ ɛhye la, awie mɔɔ vile ɛsalɛ la yɛɛ baraha ahile wɔ a. 27Kenle ko ne ɛ nloa bade na wɔadendɛ wɔahile ahenle ne mɔɔ vile ɛsalɛ la. Ɛbadendɛ, ɛnrɛdɔ mumule bieko. Yemɔti ɛbayɛ sɛkɛlɛneɛ wɔamaa bɛ, na bɛanwu kɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a.”

Title: YIZ 25
Content:
Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ mɔɔ tia Amɔn la
1 Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me kɛ, 2“Sonla ra, kakyi ɛ nye wɔ Amɔnoma anwo zo, na ka Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ ne mɔɔ tia bɛ la. 3Ka kile Amɔnoma kɛ bɛdie Awulae Nyamenle edwɛkɛ ne. Awulae Nyamenle ne se, ‘Kɛmɔ bɛdeanle nu “Mɔɔ kɛza bɛ la ɛne!” wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛvale evinli bɛhanle me ɛleka nwuanzanwuanza ne na bɛzɛkyele Yizilayɛ azɛlɛ ne bɛdole ye mgbane, bɛzɛkyele Dwuda maanle ne wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛhyele bɛ bɛhɔle nlɔnu la, 4melɛye bɛ meamaa menli ne mɔɔ wɔ Aduduleɛ la meamaa bɛava bɛ bɛayɛ bɛ ɛdeɛ bɔkɔɔ. Bɛbadɛnla bɛ avinli na bɛasisi bɛ azua wɔ bɛ avinli. Bɛbali bɛ mbaka ma ne mɔ na bɛanlo bɛ nlankɛ nyɛfonzule. 5Mebamaa Relaba ayɛ adidileka amaa afunlumu, na Amɔnoma sua ne ayɛ nyɛmoa tunli, na bɛanwu kɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a.’
6“Kɛ medame Awulae Nyamenle ne mese la ɛne: Kɛmɔ bɛbɔle bɛ sa nu, bɛzile agole na bɛ ngunzi ti bɛ nye liele bɛ nwo dɔɔnwo bɛtiale Yizilayɛma la ati, 7bɛnlea, meva bɛ nwo ɛya kpole, na mebaye bɛ meamaa maanle maanle ne mɔ, na bɛava bɛ kɛ konle nu afedeɛ. Mebaye bɛ meavi menli avinli na meaminli bɛ bo zo wɔ maanle maanle avinli. Mebazɛkye bɛ bɔkɔɔ, na bɛanwu kɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a.”
Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ mɔɔ tia Mowabe la
8 Awulae Nyamenle ne se, “Kɛmɔ Mowabe hanle kɛ, Dwudama ɛyɛ kɛ maanle maanle gyɛne ne mɔ la ati, 9mebamaa bɛaho bɛava azuamgbole mɔɔ wɔ Mowabe maanle ne ɛweɛne zo, mɔɔ bɔ maanle ne anwo bane la amuala, Bɛte Gyɛhyemo, Beeyale Mɛyɔn, yɛɛ Keleateeyem boka nwolɛ. 10Mebaye Mowabe maanle ne meaboka Amɔnoma maanle ne meamaa maanle maanle mɔɔ wɔ aduduleɛ la ayɛ bɛ ɛdeɛ, amaa bɛangakye ye bieko wɔ maanle maanle ne mɔ avinli. 11Mebadea Mowabema, na bɛanwu kɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a.”
Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ mɔɔ tia Yidɔm la
12 Awulae Nyamenle ne se, “Kɛmɔ Yidɔm vale atisesebɛ lile Dwudama nzenralɛ, na bɛvonle wɔ nzenralɛlilɛ ne anu la ati, Mal 1.2-5 13kɛ medame Awulae Nyamenle ne mese la ɛne: Mebadea Yidɔmma, na meahu menli nee nyɛmoa mɔɔ wɔ maanle ne anu la amuala, na meamaa maanle ne adɔ mgbane. Menli mɔɔ wɔ maanle ne anu la amuala, ɔvi Timan mɔɔ kɔdwu Didan la badɔ dadeɛ nloa. 14Mebamaa Yizilayɛma aha Yidɔm senle meava meali nzenralɛ. Bɛbayɛ Yidɔmma, kɛmɔ me ɛya ne kpole si de la, na bɛanwu me nzenralɛlilɛ ne deɛ holɛ, medame, Awulae Nyamenle a mese a.”
Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ mɔɔ tia Filisitia la
15 Awulae Nyamenle ne se, “Filisitiama le abolɛ yɛɛ bɛvale ɛkpɔlɛ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ la a bɛlile bɛ nzenralɛ ne a. 16Yemɔti medame Awulae Nyamenle mese, mebadea Filisitiama nee Kɛlɛtema, meabɔ bɛ bo zo bɔkɔɔ, na meazɛkye bɛ menli mɔɔ ɛha mɔɔ wɔ ɛnweanloa la. 17Mebava ɛya ndeanlɛ kpole kpalɛ a meali nzenralɛ ne a, na bɛanwu kɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a.”

Title: YIZ 26
Content:
Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ mɔɔ tia Taya la
1Bɛhyele yɛ bɛhɔle nlɔnu la, ye ɛvolɛ bulu nee ko ne anu, siane ko ne kenle ne mɔɔ lumua la azo, Ɛdɛnkɛma dendɛle hilele me. 2Ɔse, “Sonla ra, Taya ɛha Gyɛlusalɛm anwo edwɛkɛ kɛ, ‘Ɛhɛe, bɛbubu menli ne anlenkɛ kpole ne; akee yela nwolɛ wanaanwo yemaa me. Kɛkala mɔɔ yedɔ mgbane la, me sa baha mɔɔ meminlinle ye la amuala.’
3“Yemɔti medame Awulae Nyamenle mese, ɛdawɔ Taya, meyɛ wɔ kpɔvolɛ, na mebamaa maanle maanle dɔɔnwo ara ɛ nwo zo, kɛmɔ nyevile azɛlɛkye bu la. 4Bɛbazɛkye Taya bane ne mɔ, na bɛabubu ye tawa ne mɔ bɛagua aze. Mebadu ye ɛnwea ne kɔsɔɔti meagua, meamaa yeaha ye bolɛ tandane ne mɔɔ la azɛlɛ ne abo la. 5Ɔbayɛ ɛleka mɔɔ fɛlɛhyelɛma rɛlɛ bɛ avonle a, wɔ nyevile ne avinli. Medame Awulae Nyamenle a mese a. Ɔbayɛ afedeɛ yeamaa maanle maanle dɔɔnwo. 6Bɛbahu menli mɔɔ wɔ azuamgbole ne mɔ azo la, na bɛbanwu kɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a.”
7Awulae Nyamenle ne se, “Mebava belemgbunli kpole mɔɔ bo bɛ kɔsɔɔti bɛ nwo zo, Babelonia belemgbunli Nɛbukadenɛza meavi sɔlɔ nehane, meamaa yeava mgbɔnwɔ, konle ehwili, ɛlɔnema mɔɔ tɛnla mgbɔnwɔ zo nee ɛlɔnema dɔɔnwo kpalɛ yeara Taya anwo zo. 8Ɔbahu bɛ mra mraalɛ wɔ bɛ azɛlɛ ne azo; ɔbamaa ye ɛlɔnema abɛnra ayia bɛ, bɛbavunvu ahuma, bɛahuohua ɛnwea edukue edukue, na bɛava enyinlike bɛalie bɛ nwo bane bɛaho bɛatia bɛ. 9Ɔbamaa bɛava mbaka mgbole bɛasisi bɛ azuamgbole bane ne mɔ kɛ bɛbubu bɛ bɛagua, na yeamaa bɛava akuma bɛagologolo bɛ tawa ne mɔ bɛagua. 10Ye mgbɔnwɔ ne mɔ bazo dɔɔnwo kpalɛ mɔɔ bɛ nzi munlutu bɔbɔ baheda bɛ nwo zo a. Ye ɛlɔnema mɔɔ ka mgbɔnwɔ nee konle ehwili ne mɔ la agyakɛ abo nee bɛ ne bakpusu bɛ azuamgbole bane ne mɔ, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɔkɛze kɛ akee ɔfo azua ne mɔ azo kɛ sonla mɔɔ ɛli konim la. 11Ye ɛlɔnema mɔɔ ka mgbɔnwɔ la barava bɛ azuamgbole gua ne mɔ, bɛbahu bɛ menli ne mɔ, na bɛ mpila mgbole ne mɔ babubu agua. 12Ɛlɔnema ne bave bɛ nwo ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti, bɛ anwonyia nee bɛ ninyɛne adɔne, bɛbabubu bɛ azuamgbole bane ne mɔ nee bɛ azua ngɛnlɛma ne mɔ bɛagua. Bɛbavuandi bɛ awolɛ, dubinli nee ɛnwea bɛagua azule ne mɔ anu. 13 Mebamaa bɛagyakyi bɛ edwɛne mɔɔ bɛto la, na awie ɛnrɛde bɛ getaa ne mɔ ane bieko. 14Mebayɛ bɛ kɛ bodane mɔɔ ɛhwee ɛnle zolɛ la, na bɛayɛ kɛ ɛleka mɔɔ bɛrɛlɛ avonle la. Bɛnrɛkyekye bɛ azua ne mɔ bieko, ɔluakɛ medame Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛɛ meha a.”
15Awulae Nyamenle hanle ɛhye hilele Taya amra. Ɔse, “Saa bɛba kɛ bɛbahu bɛ a, bɛ menli mɔɔ ɛbodɛboda la ɛkponlenlɛ nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛho bɛgua la azedɔlɛ bakpusu bɛ ɛnweanloa azua ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti. 16 Akee arelemgbunli mɔɔ wɔ ɛnweanloa maanle maanle ne mɔ anu la vi bɛ ebia ne mɔ anu badwazo; bɛbayeye bɛ arelemgbunli adɛladeɛ ne mɔ, na bɛayeye bɛ adɛladeɛ ne mɔ nee bɛ adɛladeɛ mɔɔ bɛnwo bɛ nloa la. Bɛ nwo bawozo bɛ; bɛbakpofokpofo aze na bɛ nwo awozo mekɛ biala, na bɛ rɛle abɔ bɛmɛ bɛ nwo. 17Na bɛbado edwɛne bɛaye awolɛ wɔ bɛmɛ bɛ ti, na bɛaha kɛ:
O suakpole mɔɔ lɛ duma,
ɛ bo zo ɛbɔ bɔkɔɔ.
Ɛnee ɛle suakpole mɔɔ yɛ se, mɔɔ sie nyevile a,
ɛdawɔ nee menli mɔɔ wɔ zo la,
anwo ka ɛzulolɛ
maa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛde azɛlɛ ne azo la.
18Kenle mɔɔ bɛhonle bɛdɔle la,
mbɔra ne mɔ wozole.
Ɛhɛe, mbɔra mɔɔ wɔ nyevile nu la
arɛle bɔle wɔ bɛ ɛzɛkyelɛ nwo.”
19Awulae Nyamenle ne se, “Saa meyɛ bɛ suakpole ne suadu kɛ azuamgbole mɔɔ awie ɛnde zolɛ la, memaa nyevile ne bu fa bɛ nwo zo, na azɛlɛkye ne mɔ keda bɛ nwo zo a, 20akee meavuandi bɛ meamaa bɛahɔboka bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkɔ ewule kuma nu la anwo, mebaye bɛ meamaa bɛahɔboka mɔmoane amra anwo, meamaa bɛahɔboka bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ ɛbolɔ maanle nu na bɛde alɔbɔlɛ nu la anwo, amaa bɛannyia ɛleka bɛandɛnla anzɛɛ bɛannyia ɛleka wɔ teasema azɛlɛ zo. 21 Mebamaa bɛ awieleɛ ayɛ ɛzulolɛ na bɛ bo zo aminli bɔkɔɔ. Bɛbakpondɛ bɛ bo zo, na bɛnrɛnwu bɛ.” Awulae Nyamenle ne a se a.

Title: YIZ 27
Content:
Taya ɛzɛneyɛlɛ nwo edwɛne
1Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me kɛ, 2“Akee wɔmɔ, sonla ra, ye Taya awolɛ, na ka kile ye kɛ, 3Wɔmɔ mɔɔ bɛkyekye wɔ nyevile nloa, menli mɔɔ wɔ ɛnwea ɛnwea gualilɛ ɛleka, kɛ Awulae Nyamenle se la ɛne:
O Taya, wɔmɔ wɔha kɛ,
wɔ anwofɛlɛko di munli.
4Wɔ ɛweɛne ne mɔ wɔ nyevile kunlu lɔ;
menli mɔɔ kyekyele wɔ la kyekyele wɔ kɛnlɛma.
5Bɛvale Hɛmɔn Boka mbaka ɛsesebɛ bɛyɛle mgbunla,
bɛvale Lɛbanɔn sida mbaka
bɛyɛle wɔ meli avela mbaka.
6Beehyan mbaka ɛsesebɛ a
bɛvale bɛzele bɛ ndahoma a;
bɛvale Saepelɛse ɛnweanloa mbaka
bɛzɛle wɔ meli ne mɔ anu,
na bɛvale ɛzɛlɛ bɛduoduale nu.
7Bɛvale Yigyibiti lenen ɛdanlɛ kɛnlɛma mɔɔ bɛnwo
ɔ nloa la
bɛyɛle bɛ meli ne mɔ avela,
bɛhilele kɛ ɔle bɛ sɛkɛlɛneɛ.
Bɛvale Saepelɛse ndanlɛ kɔkɔlɛ nee buluwu
bɛbole kpɔda bɛdɛnlanle ɔ bo;
bɛbole belandane bɛ meli ne mɔ anu.
8Saedɛnema nee Avadema a hanle meli ne mɔ a;
ɛdawɔ wɔ menli mɔɔ ze nyevile nye zo la
lile bɛ ɛlɛne bo hanle meli ne mɔ.
9Bebolɔsoma mɔɔ ze adwinli kpalɛ,
duoduale bɛ meli ayiazo ne mɔ,
Nyevile nye meli nee nuhua menli kɔsɔɔti
nee bɛ ralile gua.
10“Sogyama vi Pɛhyea, Ledea, yɛɛ Lebeya rayɛle gyima wɔ wɔ ɛlɔnema anu. Bɛ nee bɛ dɛnlanle, bɛvale bɛ ahyɛlɛ nee bɛ enyinlike bɛhendɛhendanle bɛ azua nu; bɛlile konim bɛmanle bɛ, bɛmanle bɛ nyunlu rale anyia. 11Ɛlɔnema mɔɔ vi Avade nee Hilɛke la zinzale bɛ bane ne mɔ, yɛɛ ɛlɔnema mɔɔ vi Gamade la zinzale bɛ tawa ne mɔ. Bɛhendɛhendanle bɛ enyinlike ne mɔ wɔ bɛ bane ne mɔ anwo na bɛmanle bɛ anwofɛlɛko ne lile munli.
12“Wɔ ninyɛne ngɛnlɛma dɔɔnwo ne ati, Sepeenema nee wɔ lile gua na bɛvale bɛ dwɛtɛ fufule, bulalɛ, kyɛnze, yɛɛ sumi bɛmanle wɔ bɛliele ninyɛne. 13Gilikima, Tubalema, yɛɛ Mihyɛkema nee wɔ lile gua na bɛdɔnenle menli nee kɔbele ninyɛne bɛmanle wɔ bɛliele ninyɛne bɛvile wɔ ɛkɛ. 14Bɛte Togama amra dɔnenle bɛ mgbɔnwɔ, konle mgbɔnwɔ, yɛɛ mgbɔnwɔndua manle wɔ liele ninyɛne. 15Menli mɔɔ wɔ Didan la nee wɔ lile gua; menli mɔɔ de ɛnweanloa la rɛlɛle wɔ ɛzɛlɛ nee mbaka ɛsesebɛ bie mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye ɛbɔni la liele ninyɛne. 16Wɔ ninyɛne ngakyile dɔɔnwo ne mɔ ati, Yidɔmma nee wɔ lile gua na bɛdɔnenle ezukoa bolɛ anye asuomenle, ndanlɛ kɔkɔlɛ, ndanlɛ mɔɔ bɛnwo ɔ nloa nee nuhua, lenen ndanlɛ ngɛnlɛma, yɛɛ ezukoa awolɛ dɔɔnwo bɛmanle wɔ bɛliele ninyɛne. 17Dwudama nee Yizilayɛma nee wɔ lile gua. Bɛrɛlɛle wɔ hwiiti, ɔlivi, feege, wolɛ, nwole, yɛɛ ɛnlomedazia na bɛliele wɔ ninyɛne ne mɔ bie. 18Wɔ ninyɛne ngakyile dɔɔnwo ne mɔ ati, Dɛmasekɛsema nee wɔ lile gua na bɛdɔnenle Hɛlebɔn nwanye, mboane enrinli fufule, 19yɛɛ Sahɛɛ nwanye bɛmanle wɔ bɛliele wɔ ninyɛne ne mɔ bie. Bɛdɔnenle mbulalɛ mɔɔ bɛva bɛli adwinli yɛɛ aleɛdonlɛ ninyɛne evuanlɛ bɛmanle wɔ. 20Didan nee wɔ lile gua dɔnenle ɛkpɔnwɔ zo ndanlɛ manle wɔ. 21Arelebiama nee Kida arelemgbunli a le menli mɔɔ ɛ nye liele bɛ nwo kpalɛ wɔ mboane mralɛ, mboane nyinli, yɛɛ mbɔnkye gualilɛ nu a. Ninyɛne mɔɔ bɛvale bɛ nee wɔ lile gua la ɛne. 22Hyibama nee Releemama nee wɔ lile gua; bɛdɔnenle bɛ aleɛdonlɛ ninyɛne evuanlɛ kpalɛ, ezukoa awolɛ kpalɛ kpalɛ, yɛɛ ezukoa nvutuke bɛmanle wɔ bɛliele wɔ ninyɛne kpalɛ kpalɛ ne mɔ bie. 23Hɛlan, Kani, Yidɛn, Ahyɔɔ, yɛɛ Kelemade nee wɔ lile gua. 24Bɛ nee wɔ lile ndakpa gua, yɛɛ akee ndanlɛ buluwu, ninyɛne mɔɔ bɛnwo, kapɛte futufutu mɔɔ bɛva nyɛma bɛkyekye bɛmia nu la amuala. 25 Meli vi Tahyehye yɛɛ batwe wɔ ninyɛne kɔ a.
“Yemɔti ɛnee ɛle kɛ meli mɔɔ la nyevile nye,
mɔɔ ninyɛne ɛyi ye tɛkɛɛ la.
26Menli mɔɔ ka wɔ la ɛva wɔ ɛdo nyevile nye.
Aduduleɛ anwoma ɛnloma wɔ nyevile buma nu.
27Wɔ anwonyia, wɔ ninyɛne adɔne,
wɔ menli mɔɔ ka meli nee zolɛ neavolɛma,
wɔ kapentama nee adenduvoma,
ɛlɔnema mɔɔ ɛlɛ bɛ la amuala
nee menli mɔɔ ɛlɛ bɛ la amuala
banloma gbodogbodo wɔ nyevile kunlu lɔ,
wɔ kenle ne mɔɔ ɛbanwu ɛ nyunlu la.
28Wɔ menli mɔɔ nea wɔ meli ne mɔ azo la
ɛzunlɛ dielie maanle ne anu amuala.
29“Menli mɔɔ ka meli ne la fo gua ndahoma zo
weɛ azule ba ɛnweazo.
Bɛ muala bɛbagyinla ɛnwea ne anloa,
30bɛsu alɔbɔlɛ ɛzunlɛ, bɛye awolɛ.
Bɛfula anwea bɛgua bɛ ti zo,
bɛweweɛ bɛ nwo nzonle nu.
31Wɔmɔ ati, bɛkpa bɛ ti, bɛkeda ɛrele,
na bɛfa nyane bɛsu alɔbɔlɛ ɛzunlɛ.
32Bɛye awolɛ wɔ bɛ ɛzunlɛ nu,
na bɛye awolɛ kɛ:
‘Suakpole boni a wɔ nyevile avinli
mɔɔ bɛzɛkye ye bɛdɛla Taya a?
33Mekɛ mɔɔ wɔ ninyɛne adɔne vi nyevile nzi ba la,
ɛmanle menli dɔɔnwo anye liele;
wɔ anwonyia nee wɔ ninyɛne adɔne
manle azɛlɛ ye azo arelemgbunli nyianle bɛ nwo.
34Wɔmɔ a nyevile ne ɛbɔ ɛ bo zo
wɔ azule buma ne anu lɔ la;
wɔ ninyɛne adɔne nee menli mɔɔ ka meli ne la,
nee wɔ ɛnloma gbodogbodo.’
35“Wɔ anwubɛnyunlu ne ɛmaa awie biala mɔɔ de ɛnweanloa la ahonle ɛdu; na ɛzulolɛ ɛmaa bɛ arelemgbunli nyunlu ɛdo. 36Gualilɛma mɔɔ wɔ menli ne anu la ahonle dule kɛ wɔ awieleɛ ɛwie ɛzulolɛ zɛhae, na ɛnrɛkpazi bieko ɛlɛ na aloa abɔ a.”

Title: YIZ 28
Content:
Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ mɔɔ tia Taya belemgbunli ne la
