11“Yifa ne mɔɔ bɛfa bɛsuzu ninyɛne anwo resee la, ɔwɔ kɛ nee ‘baate’ ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛfa bɛsuzu nzule nee nwole la yɛ pɛpɛ. Bɛsuzu a, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛ muala bɛgyinla nzuzuleɛ ‘homɛ’ azo. Yemɔti nzuzuleɛ ne bayɛ zɛ:
Homɛ ko le yifa bulu anzɛɛ baate bulu.
12“Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛ nzuzudeɛ ne mɔ yɛ zɛhae:
Gilaa abulanwiɔ le hyikɛle ko.
Hyikɛle abulasia le mena ko.
13-15“Akee azubɔdeɛ mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛfa bɛba la ɛne:
Hwiiti: Wɔ bɛyɔba ne ngyɛnu abulasia, ɛkpɔ ko
Baale: Wɔ bɛyɔba ne ngyɛnu abulasia, ɛkpɔ ko.
Ɔlivi nwole: ngyɛnu ɛya ko, ɛkpɔ ko (Bɛva baate ne bɛzuzu: Baate bulu le homɛ ko anzɛɛ kɔɔ ko).
Mboane: mboane ɛya nwiɔ biala anu boane ko.
“Bɛ ma azubɔdeɛ, ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ, nee anzonudwolɛ azubɔdeɛ mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛfa bɛba, na bɛyɛ mgbɔdalɛ nzɛlɛlɛ bɛmaa bɛ la ɛne. Kɛ medame, Awulae Nyamenle, mese la ɛne.
16“Menli mɔɔ wɔ maanle ne anu la amuala bava azubɔdeɛ ɛhye mɔ amaa Yizilayɛ belemgbunli ne. 17Ɔle belemgbunli ne gyima kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ ɔfa ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ, ma azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ nee nza azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ ɔmaa, wɔ ɛvoyia ne mɔ ɛlilɛ nu. Ɛvoyia ne mɔ a le Siane fofolɛ nee Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ne mɔ, nee ɛvoyia mɔɔ ɛha mɔɔ Yizilayɛma di la. Ɔwɔ kɛ ɔfa ɛtane azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ, ma azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ, ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ nee anzonudwolɛ azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ ɔmaa na bɛfa bɛyɛ Yizilayɛma ati mgbɔdalɛ nzɛlɛlɛ.”
Ɛvoyia ne mɔ
(Ade 12.1-20; Sɛlɛ 23.33-43)
18Awulae Nyamenle ne se, “Siane ne mɔɔ lumua la, kenle ne mɔɔ lumua la azo, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛfa ɛnlankɛ nyinli ko mɔɔ anwo ɛnlɛ dɛne la bɛnua Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne. 19Sɛlɛvolɛ ne bava ɛtane azubɔdeɛ mogya ne bie apepe Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne nlenkɛ ne mɔ felɛmo ne mɔ anwo, azukponle ne abati kpokpɔkoo ne mɔ azo, yɛɛ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne akunlu alie nwo ɛkɛ ne anuhɔlɛ ne felɛmo ne mɔ anwo. 20Siane ne anu kenle nsuu ne azo, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛyɛ zɔhane ala bɛmaa awie biala mɔɔ ɔlua nvonleɛ zo ɔyɛle ɛtane anzɛɛ ɔ nye ɛnla nwolɛ na ɔyɛle ɛtane la. Ɛhye yɛɛ bɛbayɛ bɛayɛ mgbɔdalɛ nzɛlɛlɛ bɛamaa Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne a.
21 “Siane ne mɔɔ lumua la, ye kenle bulu nee nna ne azo yɛɛ bɛbali Akpabɛnwo Ɛvoyia ne a. Bɛnrɛli kpanwo mɔɔ mgbɔvonle wɔ nu la toonwo kenle nsuu. 22Kenle ko zɔhane, belemgbunli ne babɔ ɔdaye nee Yizilayɛma kɔsɔɔti ati ava ɛnlankɛ nyinli edonraa ko ayɛ ɛtane azubɔdeɛ. 23Kenle nsuu ne amuala mɔɔ ɛnee bɛlɛdi ɛvoyia ne la, belemgbunli ne bava nlankɛ ndonrandonra nsuu, mboane nyinli nsuu mɔɔ biala anwo ɛnlɛ dɛne la yeamaa bɛabɔ ɛyelalɛ azu. Eza kenle ko biala ɔbava abɔnkye nyinli ko yeayɛ ɛtane azubɔdeɛ. 24Ɛnlankɛ ko nee boane ko biala mɔɔ bɛbahu ye la, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛnyia nwolɛ ma azubɔdeɛ mɔɔ ɛsuzu a ɔndwu litili bulu nee nsuu nee foa ko yɛɛ nwole litili nsa.
25 “Siane nsuu ne, ye kenle bulu nee nnu ne azo mɔɔ bɛbɔ Kpɔda Bo Ɛdɛnlanlɛ Ɛvoyia ne ɛlilɛ bo la, ɔdaye noko ɔbayɛ zɔhane ala toonwo kenle nsuu ne adwu. Ɔwɔ kɛ ɔsesa ninyɛne zɔhane ala ɔmaa bɛbɔ ɛtane azu, ɛyelalɛ azu, yɛɛ ma azu ne mɔ, na ɔfa nwolɛ nwole noko ɔboka nwo.”

Title: YIZ 46
Content:
Belemgbunli ne nee ɛvoyia ne mɔ
1Awulae Nyamenle ne se, “Ɔwɔ kɛ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne akunlu lɔ alie nwo anlenkɛ kpole ne mɔɔ di kɔ aduduleɛ la boa nyinlira nu wɔ kenle nsia ne mɔɔ bɛfa bɛyɛ gyima la anu. Bɛbuke ye wɔ Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ne yɛɛ Siane Fofolɛ Ɛvoyia kenle ne. 2Belemgbunli ne bava Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne findezo alie nwo ɛkɛ, alua anlenkɛ kpole ne anu aragyinla ye sua kpandaanwo ne anu wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne akunlu lɔ alie ne anwo anlenkɛ felɛmo ne anwo, na yeanlea sɛlɛvolɛma ne wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛbɔ ye ɛyelalɛ nee anzonudwolɛ azu ne mɔ la. Ɔbayɛ ye nzɛlɛlɛ ɛdeɛ ne wɔ anlenkɛ ne anloa ɛkɛ. Ɔwie a, ɔbazia ɔ nzi yeavinde yeahɔ, noko ɔnle kɛ bɛto anlenkɛ ne anu toonwo nɔsolɛ. 3Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ne nee Siane Fofolɛ Ɛvoyia ne mɔ, menli ne amuala bazonle Ɛdɛnkɛma wɔ anlenkɛ kpole ɛhye anyunlu.
4“Ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ belemgbunli ne fa wɔ Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle biala la le mboane ndonrandonra nsia yɛɛ boane nyinli ko mɔɔ anwo ɛnlɛ dɛne la, 5yɛɛ ma azubɔdeɛ mɔɔ ɔfa yeaboka boane nyinli ne anwo la le litili bulu nee nsuu nee foa ko, yɛɛ dodo biala mɔɔ ɔkɛhola ye fa boka boane ralɛ ko biala anwo la. Ma azubɔdeɛ biala mɔɔ le zɛhae la, ɔwɔ kɛ ɔfa ɔlivi nwole litili nsa ɔboka nwolɛ. 6Saa Siane Fofolɛ Ɛvoyia ne dwu a, ɔbava ɛnlankɛ nyinli ko mɔɔ anwo ɛnlɛ dɛne la, mboane ndonrandonra nsia, yɛɛ boane nyinli ko, mɔɔ anwo ɛnlɛ dɛne la; 7ɔbava ma azubɔdeɛ mɔɔ ɛsuzu a ɔdwu litili bulu nee nsuu nee foa ko la yeaboka ɛnlankɛ nyinli ko biala anwo, yɛɛ dodo biala mɔɔ ɔdaye ɔkɛhola ye fa la yeaboka boane edonraa ko biala anwo, na yeava nwole litili nsa yeaboka azubɔdeɛ ko biala anwo. 8Saa belemgbunli ne ɛlɛkɔ nuhua a, ɔbava anuhɔlɛ ne anu yeahɔ sua kpandaanwo ne anu, ɔlɛfinde noko a, ɛkɛ ne a ɔbava a.
9“Saa menli ne ba ɛvoyialilɛ ne mɔ bie kɛ bɛbazonle Ɛdɛnkɛma a, mɔɔ kɛlua sɔlɔ anlenkɛ kpole ne anu kɛwolo la, ɔsia ɔ nzi noko a, ɔwɔ kɛ ɔdua nyiakɛ anlenkɛ kpole ne anu a ɔfinde a, yɛɛ mɔɔ kɛva nyiakɛ anlenkɛ kpole ne anu kɛwolo la, ɔwɔ kɛ ɔdua sɔlɔ anlenkɛ kpole ne anu a ɔfinde a. Ɔnle kɛ awie ko biala dua ɔ bo zo ne mɔɔ ɔvale ɔrale Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu la finde. Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛdua bɛ nyunlu fɔɔnwo a bɛfinde a. 10Saa bɛlɛkɔ ɛkɛ ne a, ɔwɔ kɛ belemgbunli ne nee bɛ a kɔ a, yɛɛ saa bɛlɛfinde a, ɔwɔ kɛ belemgbunli ne nee bɛ a finde a. 11Wɔ ɛvoyia ne mɔ ɛlilɛ nu nee ɛlobɔ ne mɔ anloa ma azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ, ɔwɔ kɛ ɔyɛ ɛnlankɛ nyinli ko biala, ma litili bulu nee nsuu nee foa ko, boane nyinli ko biala, ma litili bulu nee nsuu nee foa ko, yɛɛ mboane ndonrandonra ne mɔ, yemɔ ma dodo biala mɔɔ bɛkɛhola ye fa la, yɛɛ ma azubɔdeɛ biala, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛfa nwole litili nsa bɛboka nwolɛ.
12“Saa belemgbunli ɛlɛfa azubɔdeɛ mɔɔ ɔdaye yekpɔla ɔ kunlu yeva la arɛlɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, saa ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ o, saa anzonudwolɛ azubɔdeɛ o, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛbuke aduduleɛ anlenkɛ kpole ne bɛmaa ye. Ɔbava ye ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ ne anzɛɛ ye anzonudwolɛ azubɔdeɛ ne yeamaa, kɛmɔ ɔyɛ ye wɔ Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ne la. Ɔwie a akee yeavinde na bɛado anlenkɛ kpole ne anu.”
Dahudahu azubɔdeɛ ne
13Ɛdɛnkɛma zele kɛ, “Nwonlomɔ biala belemgbunli ne bava boane edonraa ko yeamaa bɛayela ye bɛabɔ azu bɛamaa Ɛdɛnkɛma. 14Ɔwɔ kɛ ɔfa ma azubɔdeɛ ɔboka nwolɛ, ɛsuzu a ɔwɔ kɛ ɔto kilo nwiɔ. Eza ɔwɔ kɛ ɔfa nwole litili ko ɔmaa bɛfete esamo ne kɛ ma azubɔdeɛ bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma. Ɛhye le mɛla mɔɔ bɛngakyi ye ɛlɛ wɔ ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ nwo a. 15Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛfa boane ne, ɛdɔkɛ azubɔdeɛ ne, nee nwole ne bɛbɔ azu bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma.”
Belemgbunli ne nee azɛlɛ ne
16Awulae Nyamenle ne se, “Saa belemgbunli fa ye agyadeɛ bie kyɛ ɔ mra mrenya ne mɔ bie a, ɔle ralɛ nrenya ne ɛdeɛ, ɔle ye agyadeɛ. 17 Na saa ɔfa ye agyadeɛ bie ɔmaa ye sonvolɛma ne mɔ bie a, agyadeɛ ne le ye ɛdeɛ kɔkpula Fanwodi Ɛvoyia ne kolaa na belemgbunli ne azia alie ye agyadeɛ ne. Mralɛ mrenya ne mɔ ala yɛɛ ahyɛlɛdeɛ mɔɔ vi belemgbunli ne agyadeɛ nu la le bɛ ɛdeɛ bɔkɔɔ a. 18Ɔnle kɛ belemgbunli ne fa maanlema agyadeɛ maa ɔ mra mrenya, na ɔdie agyadeɛ ne ɔfi maanlema asa anu bɔkɔɔ. Ɔmaa ɔ mra mrenya agyadeɛ a, ɔwɔ kɛ ɔfi ɔdaye ɔ ti anwo ye agyadeɛ nu, amaa yeamba ye kɛ yeza me menli ne bie yelie ye agyadeɛ.”
Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne egyaade ne mɔ
19Akee nrenya ne vale me luale anuhɔlɛ ne mɔɔ wɔ anlenkɛ kpole ne foa ko la anu, na yɛhɔle sɛlɛvolɛma ekpumgbunli nwuanzanwuanza ne mɔ mɔɔ solo sɔlɔ afoa nu, la anwo. Menwunle ɛleka bie wɔ azua zɔhane mɔ adɔleɛ kpalɛ kpalɛ, 20na ɔzele me kɛ, “Ɛke a sɛlɛvolɛma ne bado ɛtane azubɔdeɛ ne nee abozozielɛ azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ a; ɛke a bɛbado ma azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ a, amaa bɛanva bɛanvinde Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne findezo alie nwo ɛkɛ, na bɛava nwuanzanwuanzayɛlɛ bɛaha menli ne.”
21-22Akee nrenya ne vale me rale findezo alie nwo ɛkɛ na ɔvale me ɔhɔle ye muleɛ nna ne mɔ azo. Muleɛ ko biala azo bɛhyehyɛ ɛleka mɔɔ ye tendenle le mita abulanwiɔ na ye tɛtɛlɛ le mita bulu nee nnu la wɔ ɛkɛ. Bɛ muala bɛsɛ mgbole. 23Bɛlie ko biala anwo bane na bɛsisi mokyea wɔ nuhua toonwo yeyia. 24Na ɔzele me kɛ, “Ɛhye mɔ a le egyaade ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛyɛ gyima wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu la bado menli ne azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ a.”

Title: YIZ 47
Content:
Azule ne mɔɔ vi Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu senze la
1 Akee nrenya ne vale me ziale rale Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anlenkɛ kpole ne anwo. Na menwunle kɛ nzule vi anuhɔlɛ ne abo se kɔ aduduleɛ, ɔluakɛ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anye kɔne aduduleɛ afoa nu. Nzule ne vi Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anuhɔlɛ ne abo, wɔ ye nyiakɛ afoa nu, wɔ azukponle ne nyiakɛ a senze a. 2Akee ɔvale me ɔluale sɔlɔ anlenkɛ kpole ne anu ɔvindele, na ɔlile me nyunlu wɔ alie nwo nehane na yɛrale Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne findezo anlenkɛ kpole ne anloa, ɔ nye kɔne aduduleɛ yɛɛ azule ne senze vi ye nyiakɛ afoa nu. 3Nrenya ne zuzule azule ne mita ɛya nnu hɔle ye nyiakɛ, na akee ɔzele me kɛ menwudwu mempɛ; ɔlile me nyunlu, na ɛnee azule ne kuma monla me gyakɛ taboa. 4Eza ɔzuzule azule ne mita ɛya nnu bieko, na azule ne lile me gyakɛ kpɔkɛ. Eza ɔzuzule mita ɛya nnu ɔzɔle zolɛ, na azule ne lile me bo. 5Ɔzuzule mita ɛya nnu bieko la meangola azule ne wudwu pɛ, ɔluakɛ ɛnee akee azule ne ɛyi; yeyi bonrabonra mɔɔ kyesɛ bɛweɛ na bɛapɛ, bɛngola bɛnwudwu bɛmpɛ. 6Na ɔzele me kɛ, “Sonla ra, wɔnwu ɛhye ɔ?”
Akee ɔvale me ɔsianenle azule ne anloa na yɛziale yɛ nzi. 7Menziale mɔɔ mekɔ la, menwunle kɛ mbaka dɔɔnwo wɔ azule ne anloa foa ko nee foa ko. 8Na nrenya ne zele me kɛ, “Azule ɛhye se kɔ aduduleɛ maanzinli ne anu na ɔdwu Dwɔdan Bɔnza, ɔkɔgua Nyevile Wulera ne anu, ɔmaa nzule mɔɔ wɔ zɔhane azule ne anu la yɛ nzukpa. 9Saa azule ne se gua Nyevile Wulera ne anu a, ɔbamaa tease abɔdeɛ biala mɔɔ wɔ azule ne anu la anyia ngoane. Na fɛlɛ dɔɔnwo bara azule ne anu, ɔluakɛ azule ɛhye kɔ ɛkɛ, amaa azule ne ayɛ nzukpa. Yemɔti ɛleka biala mɔɔ azule ne se dwu la, ɛkɛ ne debie biala nyia ngoane. 10Fɛlɛhyelɛma bagyinla nyevile ne anloa; ɔvi Ɛngidae mɔɔ kɔdwu Ɛnɛgeleeyem la bayɛ ɛleka mɔɔ bɛto avonle a. Nuhua fɛlɛ bayɛ ngakyile dɔɔnwo kɛ Mɛdetɛlenia Nyevile ne anu ɛdeɛ ne la. 11Noko ɔ nloa azia ne mɔ anu nzule ɛnrɛyɛ nzukpa. Bɛbaha ɛkɛ na bɛanyia ngyenle bɛavi nu. 12 Mbaka ngakyile dɔɔnwo bafifi azule ne anloa foa ko nee foa ko mɔɔ bɛ nzoleɛ bayɛ aleɛ bɛdi a. Bɛ nya ɛnrɛnwoso yɛɛ bɛ nzoleɛ ɛnrɛpe. Siane biala bɛbazo ma fofolɛ, ɔboalekɛ bɛ bo nzule ne vi Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu a senze ba a. Bɛbali bɛ nzoleɛ na bɛava bɛ nya ne bɛayɛ ayile.”
Azɛlɛ ne ɛweɛne ne mɔ
13Awulae Nyamenle ne zele me kɛ, “Azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ ɛbahyɛ wɔamaa Yizilayɛ mbusua ekpunli ekpunli bulu nee nwiɔ ne mɔ kɛ ɔle bɛ agyadeɛ la, bɛ ɛweɛne ne mɔ ɛne. Dwosefi banyia ɛkpɔ nwiɔ. 14Ɔwɔ kɛ ɛkyɛ azɛlɛ ne pɛpɛ. Membɔle ɛwɔkɛ kɛ menwɔva menwɔmaa bɛ ze mɔ, na azɛlɛ ne bayɛ bɛ agyadeɛ bɔkɔɔ.
15“Azɛlɛ ne ɛweɛne ɛne: Ye ɛbɔ nu afoa nu ɛweɛne ne tenrɛ kɔ aduduleɛ, ɔvi Mɛdetɛlenia Nyevile ne anloa, ɔlua suakpole Hɛtelɔn ɔfinde Heemate Ademgbole zo ɔdwu suakpole Zidade azo, 16ɔvi ɛkɛ ɔkɔ azuamgbole Bɛlota nee Sabelaem. (Bɛnwu azuamgbole nwiɔ ɛhye wɔ Dɛmasekɛse nee Heemate arelemgbunli maanle ne mɔ anu.) Ɔtele zo ɛke ɔdwu Tekɔn (wɔ Hɔɔlan belemgbunli maanle nu.) 17Yemɔti azɛlɛ ne ɛbɔ nu afoa nu ɛweɛne ne balua Mɛdetɛlenia Nyevile ne anloa, ahɔ aduduleɛ, yeahɔdwu Yinɔn, ɛnee Dɛmasekɛse nee Heemate maanzinli ne mɔ wɔ ye anwuma. Ɛhye a le ye ɛbɔ nu afoa nu ɛweɛne ne a.
18“Aduduleɛ ɛweɛne ne wɔne ɔ ti nyiakɛ afoa nu, ɔvi Yinɔn mɔɔ wɔ Dɛmasekɛse nee Hɔɔlan maanzinli ne mɔ avinli, ɔlua Azule Dwɔdan ne anloa, mɔɔ wɔ Geleade nee Yizilayɛ azɛlɛ ne avinli ɔkɔgua ye Teema mɔɔ wɔ Nyevile Wulera ne anloa la.
19“Nyiakɛ ɛweɛne ne kɔ nyiakɛ-adɔleɛ afoa nu, ɔvi Teema ɔkɔdwu Keedɛhye mɛtɛlɛmɛtɛlɛ ne mɔ anu, na ɔwɔne ɔ ti adɔleɛ-ɛbɔnu, ɔlua Yigyibiti ɛweɛne zo ɔkɔgua ye Mɛdetɛlenia Nyevile ne anloa.
20“Adɔleɛ ɛweɛne ne a le Mɛdetɛlenia Nyevile ne ɔkɔdwu ɛleka bie mɔɔ nee Heemate Ademgbolezo bɛ nye bɔ zolɛ la. Ɛhye a le adɔleɛ ɛweɛne ne a.
21“Kyɛ azɛlɛ ɛhye maa mbusua ekpunli ekpunli ne mɔ. 22Kyɛ maa bɛ maa ɔyɛ bɛdabɛ nee nyɛvolɛ mɔɔ de bɛ avinli na bɛwo mralɛ bɛgua bɛ avinli la agyadeɛ bɔkɔɔ. Menli zɔhane bayɛ kɛ Yizilayɛma amra mɔɔ bɛwo bɛ la. Bɛ nee bɛ nee Yizilayɛ mbusua ekpunli ekpunli ne mɔ amuala ɛhyɛ azɛlɛ ne ɛva ɛyɛ bɛ agyadeɛ. 23Ɛyɛvolɛ biala mɔɔ de abusua ekpunli biala avinli la, ɔwɔ kɛ ɔnyia ɔdaye ɔ ti anwo agyadeɛ. Medame, Awulae Nyamenle a, mese a.”

Title: YIZ 48
Content:
Bɛkyɛ azɛlɛ ne bɛamaa mbusua ekpunli ekpunli ne mɔ
1-7Azɛlɛ ne sɔlɔ ɛweɛne ne tenrɛ vi Mɛdetɛlenia Nyevile ne anloa kɔ aduduleɛ afoa nu, ɔkɔ suakpole Hɛtelɔn, ɔlua Heemate Ademgbolezo ɔdwu Yinɔn, ɔkɔkpula ɛweɛne ne mɔɔ la arelemgbunli maanle Dɛmasekɛse nee Heemate avinli la. Ɔwɔ kɛ abusua ekpunli biala nyia azɛlɛ ne bie, ɔvi aduduleɛ ɛweɛne ne azo ɔkɔdwu adɔleɛ, wɔ Mɛdetɛlenia Nyevile ne anloa. Kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛsesa azɛlɛ ne, ɔvi ye sɔlɔ mɔɔ badwu ye nyiakɛ la ɛne.
Dan
Ahya
Nafetalae
Manasɛ
Yifelaem
Wulubɛn
Dwuda
Azɛlɛ nwuanzanwuanza ne mɔɔ la azɛlɛ ne avinli la
8Azɛlɛ bieko mɔɔ doa zolɛ la a le azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ bɛboɔboa bɛpɛ bɛzie ɛkɛ ne la. Ɔwɔ kɛ ye tendenle nu mɔɔ vi ye sɔlɔ ba nyiakɛ la yɛ kilomita bulu nee nwiɔ nee foa ko, yɛɛ ye tɛtɛlɛ nu mɔɔ vi aduduleɛ kɔ adɔleɛ la noko yɛ zɔhane ala. Azɛlɛ ɛhye azo yɛɛ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne bagyinla a.
9Azɛlɛ ɛhye avinli, ɛbapɛ azɛlɛ mɔɔ ye tendenle le kilomita bulu nee nwiɔ nee foa ko, na ye tɛtɛlɛ le kilomita bulu la wɔazie ɛkɛ wɔamaa Ɛdɛnkɛma. 10Akee kɛ ɛbahyɛ ɛleka nwuanzanwuanza ne la ɛne: Sɛlɛvolɛma ne banyia azɛlɛ mɔɔ ye tendenle le kilomita bulu nee nwiɔ nee foa ko, mɔɔ vi aduduleɛ kɔ adɔleɛ na ye tɛtɛlɛ le kilomita nnu, ɔvi ye sɔlɔ mɔɔ ba ye nyiakɛ la. Ɔwɔ kɛ azɛlɛ ɛhye avinli yɛɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne gyinla a. 11Azɛlɛ ɛhye bayɛ Zeedɔko abo zo amra ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛwula bɛ sɛlɛvolɛ na bɛlile me mɛla zo bɛzonlenle me nɔhalɛ nu, na bɛamkpo me wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ Yizilayɛma dele atua, na Livaema kpole me la. 12Azɛlɛ ne bayɛ bɛ ɛdeɛ bɔkɔɔ wɔ azɛlɛ nwuanzanwuanza ne avinli, yeayɛ azɛlɛ nwuanzanwuanza kpalɛ yeazua Livaema azɛlɛ ɛdeɛ ne. 13Livaema azɛlɛ ɛdeɛ ne bazua sɛlɛvolɛma ɛdeɛ ne. Ɔdaye ye tendenle bayɛ kilomita bulu nee nwiɔ nee foa ko yɛɛ ye tɛtɛlɛ bayɛ kilomita nnu. 14Ɔnle kɛ bɛtɔne azɛlɛ ɛhye bie anzɛɛ bɛfa bie bɛbɔ agyinlanu bɛdie debie. Ɔnle kɛ bɛfa bie bɛmaa awie biala, ɔluakɛ ɔle nwuanzanwuanza ɔmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma.
15Azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ baha, mɔɔ ye tendenle le kilomita bulu nee nwiɔ nee foa ko, na ye tɛtɛlɛ le kilomita nwiɔ nee foa ko la bala ɛkɛ, amaa maanlema akyekye bɛ suakpole ne, bɛabu bɛ namunamu na bɛadidi zolɛ. Suakpole ne bala azɛlɛ ne avinli. 16Suakpole ɛhye tendenle nee ye tɛtɛlɛ bazɛ. Ye tendenle bayɛ mita apenle nwiɔ, ɛya nwiɔ abulanlu, yɛɛ ye tɛtɛlɛ noko bayɛ zɔhane ala. 17Azɛlɛ kpole bala suakpole ne anwo toonwo ayia; azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ bala suakpole ne anwo la tɛtɛlɛ bayɛ mita ɛya ko abulanwiɔ nee nnu. 18Azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ baha azɛlɛ nwuanzanwuanza ne azo la bayɛ azɛlɛ mɔɔ menli mɔɔ wɔ suakpole ne azo la didi zolɛ a. Suakpole ne aduduleɛ afoa nu azɛlɛ ne tendenle le kilomita nnu yɛɛ ye tɛtɛlɛ le kilomita nwiɔ nee foa ko. Ye adɔleɛ nu noko azɛlɛ ne kpole le kɛ aduduleɛ ɛdeɛ ne la. 19Awie biala mɔɔ wɔ Yizilayɛ abusua ekpunli biala anu na ɔwɔ suakpole ne azo la kola so zolɛ ɛya.
20Azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ ɛbaboɔboa wɔapɛ wɔado ɛkɛ ne la, ɔwɔ kɛ ye tendenle yɛ kilomita bulu nee nwiɔ nee foa ko, yɛɛ ye tɛtɛlɛ noko yɛ zɔhane ala. Azɛlɛ ɛhye le nwuanzanwuanza, yɛɛ zolɛ a bɛbakyekye suakpole ne a.
21-22Azɛlɛ mɔɔ kɛha aduduleɛ nee adɔleɛ wɔ azɛlɛ ɛhye mɔɔ bɛboɔboa bɛpɛ bɛzie ɛkɛ ne, mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne gyi zolɛ, sɛlɛvolɛma nee Livaema azɛlɛ wɔ nu, na suakpole ne wɔ zolɛ la, le belemgbunli ne ɛdeɛ. Ɔtɛlɛ ɔkɔ adɔleɛ ɔkɔgua Mɛdetɛlenia Nyevile ne anloa, ye aduduleɛ kpula aduduleɛ ɛweɛne ne, ye sɔlɔ, ɔ nee Dwuda a bɔ ɛweɛne a, yɛɛ ɔ nee Bɛngyaman a bɔ ɛweɛne wɔ nyiakɛ a.
Mbusua ekpunli ekpunli mɔɔ ɛha la azɛlɛ ne
23-27Mbusua ekpunli ekpunli mɔɔ ɛha la banyia bɛ azɛlɛ ɛdeɛ wɔ azɛlɛ nwuanzanwuanza ne nyiakɛ. Ko biala ɛdeɛ tenrɛ vi aduduleɛ ɛweɛne ne anloa kɔ adɔleɛ kɔgua Mɛdetɛlenia Nyevile ne anloa. Kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛsesa azɛlɛ ne, ɔvi sɔlɔ mɔɔ ba nyiakɛ la ɛne:
Bɛngyaman
Semɛyɔn
Yesakaa
Zɛbulɛn
Gaade
28Gaade abusua ekpunli ne azɛlɛ ne nyiakɛ ɛweɛne ne wɔ nyiakɛ-adɔleɛ, ɔvi Teema ɔdwu Keedɛhye mɛtɛlɛmɛtɛlɛ ne anloa, na ɔtenrɛ ɔ nwo sɔlɔ-adɔleɛ, ɔlua Yigyibiti ɛweɛne zo ɔkɔgua ye Mɛdetɛlenia Nyevile ne anloa.
29Awulae Nyamenle ne se, “Adenle mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛdua nu bɛkyɛ azɛlɛ ne bɛmaa Yizilayɛ mbusua ekpunli ekpunli ne mɔ fa yɛ bɛ ɛdeɛ la ɛne.”
Gyɛlusalɛm nlenkɛ mgbole ne mɔ
30-34 Suakpole Gyɛlusalɛm lɛ nlenkɛ mgbole bulu nee nwiɔ. Suakpole ne bane nna ne mɔɔ bɛnra yia ye la ko biala tendenle le mita apenle nwiɔ, ɛya nwiɔ abulanlu, yɛɛ ko biala lɛ nlenkɛ mgbole nsa. Bɛva nlenkɛ ne mɔ bɛtoto Yizilayɛ mbusua ekpunli ekpunli ne mɔ. Nlenkɛ mgbole mɔɔ wɔ sɔlɔ la, bɛfɛlɛ bɛ Wulubɛn, Dwuda, yɛɛ Livae; mɔɔ wɔ aduduleɛ la, bɛfɛlɛ bɛ Dwosefi, Bɛngyaman, yɛɛ Dan. Nyiakɛ nlenkɛ ɛdeɛ ne mɔ, bɛfɛlɛ bɛ Semɛyɔn, Yesakaa, yɛɛ Zɛbulɛn, yɛɛ adɔleɛ ɛdeɛ ne mɔ a le Gaade, Ahya, yɛɛ Nafetalae. 35Bane nna ne mɔɔ bɛnra suakpole ne yia la amuala tendenle le mita apenle ngɔnla. Suakpole ne duma, ɔvi ɛnɛ mɔɔ kɔ la a le “Ɛdɛnkɛma Wɔ Ɛke.”

Title: DAN MUKENYE
Content:
Mukenye
Bɛhɛlɛle Daneɛle Buluku ne wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee belemgbunli bie mɔɔ ɛnze Nyamenle la ɛlɛkile Dwuuma nyane kpole kpalɛ na ɔlɛyɛ bɛ kpɔdekpɔde la. Kɛlɛvolɛ ne vale adawu ngakyile nee ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ edwɛkɛ hɛlɛle buluku ne manle mekɛ ne anu amra, ɔvale ɔzile bɛ ahonle kɛ bɛnyia anyelazo kɛ Nyamenle bamaa belemgbunli amumuyɛ atisesebɛ ne akpo aze na yeamaa Nyamenle menli ne anyia bɛ ti.
Bɛhyɛ buluku ne anu ekpunli nwiɔ. Mɔɔ lumua la fane Daneɛle nee ɔ gɔnwo mɔ mɔɔ bɛhyele bɛ bɛhɔle nlɔnu la bie mɔ anwo. Bɛ diedi mɔɔ bɛlɛ wɔ Nyamenle anu nee tieyɛ mɔɔ bɛyɛle bɛmanle Nyamenle la manle bɛlile bɛ kpɔvolɛma anwo zo konim. Adawu ɛhye mɔ ka edwɛkɛ mɔɔ sisile mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee Babelonia nee Pɛhyea Maanle Maanle ne mɔ gyi zolɛ la. Ekpunli ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nwiɔ la ka ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ ngakyile mɔɔ Daneɛle nwunle bɛ la. Bɛle sɛkɛlɛneɛ mɔɔ abo kile kɛ maanle maanle dɔɔnwo badwazo na bɛakpo aze, na Babelonia anwo zo a ɛhye balumua azi a. Eza ɔka ɔsie kɛ belemgbunli atisesebɛ ne mɔɔ ɛnze Nyamenle la bakpo aze na Nyamenle menli ne ali konim.
Mɔɔ wɔ nu la
Daneɛle nee ɔ gɔnwo mɔ 1.1—6.28

2. Boane nyinli ne nee abɔnkye ne 8.1—9.27

Title: DAN 1
Content:
DANEƐLE NEE Ɔ GƆNWO MƆ ANWO EDWƐKƐ
(1.1—6.28)
Mgbavolɛ ne mɔ wɔ Nɛbukadenɛza Suakunlu
1 Belemgbunli Nɛbukadenɛza mɔɔ vi Babelonia la vale ɛlɔne rabɔle yiale Gyɛlusalɛm wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee Dwuda Belemgbunli Gyɛhɔyakem ɛli ɛvolɛ nsa wɔ ebia ne azo la. 2 Na Awulae yele Belemgbunli Gyɛhɔyakem manle Nɛbukadenɛza lile ɔ nwo zo konim na ɔsesale Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu ninyɛne ne mɔ bie ɔhɔle. Ɔvale ninyɛne ne mɔ ɔhɔle Hyaenaa na ɔhɔguale bɛ ye bozonle ne abo.
3Belemgbunli Nɛbukadenɛza akee zele ye sonvolɛ kpanyinli Ahyepinaze kɛ ɔnlea na ɔye Yizilayɛ alehelɛ nee menli titile ne mɔ anu bie mɔ, 4mgbavolɛ anwo fɛlɛko mɔɔ anye gyi bɛ ti anwo, bɛze nrɛlɛbɛ, bɛsukoa debie a bɛnvɛ nwolɛ, na bɛ nwo ɛnlɛ dɛne, mɔɔ bɛkola bɛsonle belemgbunli sua nu la, na ɔhile bɛ Babelonia aneɛ ne ɛgengalɛ nee ye ɛhɛlɛlɛ. 5Belemgbunli ne hanle kɛ dahuu bɛmaa ndetelɛ menli ɛhye mɔ alehelɛ aleɛ ne nee nza ne mɔɔ bɛdi bɛno ye suakunlu ɛkɛ ne la bie. Bɛtete menli ne ɛvolɛ nsa na akee bɛava bɛ bɛavinde belemgbunli ne anyunlu. 6Menli mɔɔ bɛyele bɛ la bie mɔ a le Daneɛle, Hananaya, Maehyeeyɛle, yɛɛ Azalaya mɔɔ bɛ muala bɛvi Dwuda abusua ekpunli ne anu la. 7Sonvolɛ kpanyinli ne totonle bɛ aluma fofolɛ: ɔdonle Daneɛle, Bɛletihyazaa; ɔdonle Hananaya, Hyeedelake; ɔdonle Maehyeeyɛle, Mihyake, yɛɛ ɔdonle Azalaya, Abɛdenɛgo.
8Na Daneɛle yɛle ye adwenle kɛ ɔnrɛdoa alehelɛ aleɛ ne anzɛɛ nza ne ɔnrɛgua ɔ nwo evinli. Yemɔti ɔnwunle sonvolɛ kpanyinli ne kɛ ɔmaa ye adenle na ɔnrɛli aleɛ ne, yɛɛ ɔnrɛnlo nza ne ɔnrɛgua ɔ nwo evinli. 9Nyamenle manle sonvolɛ kpanyinli Ahyepinaze anye zɔle Daneɛle, ɔnwunle ye anwunvɔne, na ɔkponlenle ye edwɛkɛ ne azo. 10Noko ɛnee sonvolɛ kpanyinli ne sulo belemgbunli ne. Yemɔti ɔhanle ɔhilele Daneɛle kɛ, “Belemgbunli ɛhile aleɛ nee nza mɔɔ bɛva bɛmaa wɔ la. Ɛhye ati saa ɔnwu kɛ wɔmɔ wɔnwa a, me gyakɔ! Me ti ne, tɛ me ɛdeɛ ɔ.”
11Daneɛle hanle hilele neavolɛ ne mɔɔ sonvolɛ kpanyinli ne yele ye kɛ ɔnlea ɔdaye, Hananaya, Maehyeeyɛle, yɛɛ Azalaya bɛ nwo zo la kɛ, 12“Sɔ wɔ sonvolɛma nea kenle bulu. Maa bɛmaa yɛ nya nya yɛli na bɛmaa yɛ nzule yɛnlo, 13na fa yɛ to menli mɔɔ ɛlɛdi suakunlu aleɛ ne la anwo na nea, na mɔɔ ɛkɛnwu ye la akee wɔayɛ mɔɔ ɛyɛ la.”
14Sonvolɛ kpanyinli ne kponlenle nzuzulɛ ne azo na ɔzɔle bɛ ɔnleanle kenle bulu. 15Kenle bulu ne dwule la, ɛnee bɛyɛ mbelane, bɛ nwonane ɛyɛ ngɛnlɛma ɛdɛla mgbavolɛ mɔɔ lile belemgbunli ne aleɛ kpalɛ ne la. 16Ɔlua ɛhye ati neavolɛ ne ammaa bɛ aleɛ kpalɛ nee nza mɔɔ anrɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛdi na bɛno la, na ɔmanle bɛ nya nya.
17Mgbavolɛ nna ɛhye, Nyamenle manle bɛnwunle nwoma na bɛnwunle nrɛlɛbɛ kpole. Nyamenle manle Daneɛle ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ nee ɛlalɛ bo ɛhilelɛ adwenle.
18Ɛvolɛ nsa ne dwule la, Belemgbunli Nɛbukadenɛza manle sonvolɛ kpanyinli ne vale menli ne mɔ rale ɔ nyunlu. 19Belemgbunli ne bizebizale bɛ edwɛkɛ, na ɔnwunle kɛ mgbavolɛ nna ne, Daneɛle, Hananaya, Maehyeeyɛle, yɛɛ Azalaya ati ɛdi ɛdɛla awie biala. 20Menli nna ne boale belemgbunli ne wɔ edwɛkɛ biala mɔɔ kye adwenle anzɛɛ hyia ndelebɛbo na ɔkɛbiza bɛ la anu kpole kpalɛ dɛlale ngonyiama nee silihyelɛma mɔɔ wɔ maanle ne anu la amuala fane bulu. 21Yemɔti Daneɛle dɛnlanle suakunlu ɛkɛ ne toonwo Pɛhyea Maanle Maanle Belemgbunli Saelɛse honle vale Babelonia na ɔnyianle ɛvolɛ ko wɔ ebia ne azo.

Title: DAN 2
Content:
Nɛbukadenɛza ɛlalɛ ne
1Nɛbukadenɛza lile ɛvolɛ nwiɔ wɔ ebia zo la ɔhanle ɛlalɛ na ɛzulolɛ hanle ye mɔɔ ɛnee ɔda a ɔnla a. 2 Zɔhane ati ɔdole ɛsalɛ ɔvɛlɛle ngonyiama, silihyelɛma, adunyipɛlɛma, yɛɛ menli mɔɔ lɛ bɛ nye la, kɛ bɛrahile ye ɛlalɛ ne abo. Bɛ muala bɛrale belemgbunli ɛvɛlɛlɛ ne. 3Ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Meha ɛlalɛ bie, na ɛlalɛ ne ɛha me ɛzulolɛ, yemɔti meda nwolɛ a ɔnla. Mekpondɛ kɛ mete ɔ bo.”
4Bɛbuale belemgbunli ne wɔ Arelam aneɛ nu kɛ, “Nana, nyi kyɛ! Ka wɔ ɛlalɛ ne kile yɛ maa yɛhile ɔ bo.”
5Belemgbunli ne zele bɛ kɛ, “Meka nɔhalɛ ne meahile bɛ: Saa bɛangola bɛannwu ɛlalɛ ne bɛanga, bɛangile ɔ bo a, mebamaa bɛatete bɛ bɛahu bɛ, bɛabɔ bɛ awuke ne mɔ tɔɔ. 6Na saa bɛnwu ɛlalɛ ne bɛka na bɛkile ɔ bo a, mebahyɛ bɛ ninyɛne na meawula bɛ anyunlunyia. Zɔhane ati bɛha ɛlalɛ ne bɛhile me na bɛhile me ɔ bo.”
7Menli ne mɔ eza buale belemgbunli kɛ, “Nana, ka wɔ ɛlalɛ ne kile yɛ, na yɛkɛhile ɔ bo.”
8Belemgbunli ne buale bɛ kɛ, “Menwu adwenle mɔɔ bɛbɔ la. Bɛkpondɛ mekɛ, kɛmɔ bɛnwu kɛ me nye ɛbolo la ati, ɔboalekɛ bɛze kɛ mɔɔ meha la, ɔdaye ne ala ɛne; 9saa bɛannwu me ɛlalɛ ne bɛanga, bɛangile ɔ bo a, ɛza ko ala a mebava meahwi bɛ a. Bɛyɛ ko kɛ bɛbɔ adalɛ bɛahwenlehwenle bɛ bo aze bɛava bɛazɛkye mekɛ. Bɛha ɛlalɛ ne bɛhile me bɛmaa menwu kɛ bɛkɛhola ɔ bo kile.”
10Menli ne mɔ hanle hilele belemgbunli kɛ, “Awie ko ɛnle aleɛabo mɔɔ kɛhola debie mɔɔ belemgbunli ɛbiza la yɛ a, yɛɛ belemgbunli kpole biala ɛnle ɛkɛ mɔɔ ɛmaa ngonyiama, silihyelɛma, yɛɛ adunyipɛlɛma ɛyɛ debie zɛhae bie ɛlɛ a. 11Mɔɔ Nana ɛbiza la, sonla ɛnrɛhola ɛnrɛyɛ, kyesɛ awozonle ne mɔ mɔɔ ɛnle nwonane la na ahola ye yɛ.”
12Edwɛkɛ ɛhye manle belemgbunli ahonle futule kpole, yemɔti ɔmanle bɛbɔle nolo kɛ bɛhu nrɛlɛbɛvolɛma ne mɔɔ wɔ Babelɔn maanle nu la amuala. 13Nolo ne dwule maanle ne anu ɛleka biala kɛ bɛhu menli zɔhane mɔ kɔsɔɔti, na bɛkpondɛle Daneɛle nee ɔ gɔnwo mɔ abo zo kɛ bɛku bɛ.
Nyamenle kile Daneɛle ɛlalɛ ne abo
14Na Daneɛle hɔbizale Aleɔko, belemgbunli sinzavolɛma kpanyinli ne, mɔɔ bɛva menli ɛhunlɛ ne bɛwula ɔ sa nu la nrɛlɛbɛ zo nee enililɛ nu 15kɛ, “Duzu ati a belemgbunli ɛli mɛla ɛzulolɛ ɛhye a?” Na Aleɔko yele edwɛkɛ ne dole ɔ nyunlu.
16Daneɛle hɔzɛlɛle belemgbunli ne kɛ ɔmaa ye mekɛ ɔmaa ɔrahile ye ɛlalɛ ne abo ɔhile ye. 17Akee Daneɛle hɔle sua nu na ɔhɔbɔle ɔ gɔnwo mɔ, Hananaya, Maehyeeyɛle, yɛɛ Azalaya amaneɛ. 18Ɔhanle ɔhilele bɛ kɛ bɛzɛlɛ Nyamenle ne mɔɔ wɔ anwuma la anwunvɔnezelɛ wɔ ɛhye anwo na bɛangu bɛ nee Babelɔn nrɛlɛbɛvolɛma ne mɔ. 19Kenle ko ne nɔe ne Nyamenle luale ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ zo yele ɛlalɛ ne hilele Daneɛle na ɔhilele ye ɔ bo. Na Daneɛle yele Nyamenle ayɛlɛ zele kɛ,
20“Bɛye Nyamenle ayɛlɛ dahuu!
ɔle nrɛlɛbɛvolɛ, ɔlɛ tumi.
21Ɔkakyi mekɛ, ɔkakyi ɛlobɔ;
ɔtu arelemgbunli, ɔsie arelemgbunli;
ɔmaa nrɛlɛbɛvolɛ nwu nrɛlɛbɛ,
na ɔmaa mɔɔ lɛ ndelebɛbo la adwenle;
22ɔye nwanwane ninyɛne mɔɔ vea la ɔkile;
ɔze mɔɔ wɔ awozinli nu,
yɛɛ ɔ nee wienyi a de a.
23O, egya mɔ Nyamenle,
meyɛ wɔ mo, na meye wɔ ayɛlɛ,
ɔluakɛ wɔmaa me nrɛlɛbɛ, wɔmaa me anwosesebɛ,
yɛɛ wɔye mɔɔ yɛbizale la wɔhile me;
wɔmaa yɛnwu mɔɔ belemgbunli kpondɛ la.”
Daneɛle ka ɛlalɛ ne ahile belemgbunli ne, na yeahile ɔ bo
24Akee Daneɛle hɔle sinzavolɛma kpanyinli Aleɔko mɔɔ belemgbunli ɛva nrɛlɛbɛvolɛma mɔɔ bɛku bɛ wɔ Babelɔn la ɛhunlɛ ne ɛwula ɔ sa nu la ɛkɛ na ɔhanle ɔhilele ye kɛ, “Mmaku Babelɔn nrɛlɛbɛvolɛma ne; wɔmɔ fa me kɔ belemgbunli anyunlu na mebahile ye ɛlalɛ ne abo.”
25Yemɔti ndɛndɛ ne ala Aleɔko vale Daneɛle hɔle belemgbunli suakunlu ɛkɛ na ɔhanle kɛ, “Dwudama mɔɔ bɛhyele bɛ nuokɛ bɛrale la anu ko se ɔbahola yeahile belemgbunli ɛlalɛ ne abo.”
26Belemgbunli ne bizale Daneɛle mɔɔ eza bɛfɛlɛ ye Bɛletihyazaa la kɛ, “Ɛkɛhola ɛkɛha ɛlalɛ holɛ ko mɔɔ menganle la na ɛkɛhile ɔ bo ɛkɛhile me ɔ?”
27Daneɛle buale ye kɛ, “Nana, nrɛlɛbɛvolɛ, silikyevolɛ, ngonyiayelɛnli, anzɛɛ nwɔlɔra kengavolɛ biala ɛnle ewiade mɔɔ kɛhola kɛyɛ deɛ ne mɔɔ belemgbunli ɛbiza la. 28Yɛlɛ Nyamenle wɔ anwuma mɔɔ sa fealera nu ninyɛne gua zolɛ a, na yemɔ yɛɛ ɛye mɔɔ kenle bie bazi la ɛhile Nana a. Ɛlalɛ ne mɔɔ Nana hanle, nee ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ ɛnwunle bɛ wɔ nla nu la, bɛmɛ ɛne:
29“Nana, mɔɔ ɛwɔ nla nu la, ɛhanle ɛlalɛ wɔ mɔɔ kenle bie bazi la anwo; na Nyamenle mɔɔ sa fealera nu ninyɛne gua zolɛ la hilele wɔ ninyɛne mɔɔ basisi la. 30Tɛ kɛ asɛɛ mame meze nrɛlɛbɛ metɛla nrɛlɛbɛvolɛma mɔɔ ɛha la ɔ, na bɛmaa wɔanwu wɔ ɛlalɛ ne abo la ati ɔ.
31“Nana, ɛnwunle ananze totohyia anwo ɛzulolɛ bie mɔɔ ta kpole kpalɛ, mɔɔ ɛnea ye a ɔnyɛ boɛ la kɛ ɔgyi ɛ nyunlu ɛkɛ. 32Ananze ɛhye ati le ezukoa nvutuke, ɔ kɛnra nee ɔ sa ne mɔ le dwɛtɛ fufule, ɔ ko nee ye ɛzɔlɛ le kɔbele, 33ɔ gyakɛ agbɔma ne mɔ le mbulalɛ, yɛɛ ɔ gyakɛ babonle ne mɔ ko biala foa ko le bulalɛ yɛɛ foa ko le ɛva. 34Mekɛ mɔɔ ɛ nye gyi nwolɛ ɛlɛnea la, ɛnwunle kɛ bolɛ mɔɔ tɛ awie a kpukele la angomekye vi ɛleka bie rafinle ananze ne agyakɛ babonle foa ko bulalɛ, foa ko ɛva ne azo na ɔbubule ye dwɔkɔdwɔkɔ. 35Akee bulalɛ ne, ɛva ne, kɔbele ne, dwɛtɛ fufule ne, yɛɛ ezukoa nvutuke ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti bubule na bɛdinle bɛyɛle motomoto kɛ munlutu; na anwoma ne bɔle ye hɔle mɔɔ bɛnnwu ɔ bo zo a. Bolɛ ne mɔɔ rabubule ananze ne la nyinle mindomindo kɛ boka la na ɔhedale azɛlɛ ye azo.
36“Ɛlalɛ ne mɔɔ Nana hanle la ɛne, na akee mekile ɔ bo. 37Wɔmɔ a ɛle arelemgbunli nu belemgbunli a, yɛɛ Nyamenle ne mɔɔ wɔ anwuma la ɛyɛ wɔ maanle maanle belemgbunli, yemaa wɔ tumi, anwosesebɛ, yɛɛ anyunlunyia. 38Ɛ sa nu yɛɛ yeva menli kɔsɔɔti mɔɔ wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo, nane, yɛɛ nloma yewula a, kɛ ɛzie bɛ. Nana, wɔmɔ a ɛle ezukoa nvutuke etile ne a. 39Ɔvi ɛ nwo zo, belemgbunli bieko badwazo, ye tumi ne ɛnrɛdwu wɔ ɛdeɛ ne. Belemgbunli mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nsa la bara, na yemɔ a le kɔbele ne, na ɔdaye noko ɔbazie maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti. 40Akee belemgbunli mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nna, mɔɔ yɛ se kɛ bulalɛ la bara. Kɛmɔ bulalɛ de la, ɔbabubu ninyɛne muala anu, ɔboalekɛ bulalɛ bubu ninyɛne nu dwɔkɔdwɔkɔ. 41Na kɛmɔ ɛnwunle kɛ ananze ne agyakɛ babonle ne nee mrɛlɛsɛka ne mɔ foa ko le ɛva na foa ko le bulalɛ la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ maanle zɔhane bayɛ se noko eza nuhua bahyɛ nwiɔ a. 42Eza kɛmɔ egyakɛ mrɛlɛsɛka ne foa ko le ɛva, foa ko le bulalɛ la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ maanle ne foa ko bayɛ se na foa ko ado a. 43Ɛnwunle kɛ bulalɛ ne nee ɛva ne ɛli afonla; ɛhye kile kɛ maanle ne anu amra balua agyalɛ zo ali ngamɔnu, noko ɔnrɛyɛ boɛ, ɔluakɛ bulalɛ nee ɛva ɛngola ɛnfonla. 44Mekɛ mɔɔ maanle maanle ɛhye mɔ wɔ zolɛ la Nyamenle bamaa maanle ko avinde, na ɔbahomo maanle zɔhane mɔ anwo zo yeamaa bɛagolo. Maanle ɛhye badɛnla ɛkɛ ne dahuu, awie ɛnrɛhola ɛnrɛzɛkye ye kenle bie maanle nu, yɛɛ awie mɔ gyɛne ɛnrɛhola ɛnrɛlie maanle ne ɛnrɛbu, 45kɛmɔ ɛnwunle bolɛ ne mɔɔ awie ɛnlɛ nu mɔɔ vi boka bie azo radinle bulalɛ ne, kɔbele ne, ɛva ne, dwɛtɛ fufule ne, yɛɛ ezukoa nvutuke ne la. Nana, Nyamenle bedevinli yɛɛ ɛha wɔ ɛlalɛ ɛhye a. Ɛlalɛ ne ala a meha mehile wɔ la, yɛɛ ɔ bo kɔsɔɔ a mehile la. Ɔnrɛkpa nwolɛ.”
Belemgbunli yɛ Daneɛle mo
46Belemgbunli Nɛbukadenɛza butule Daneɛle anyunlu mutule nu yɛle ye mo, na ɔzele kɛ bɛva azubɔdeɛ nee ɛyɛlɛ bɛbɔ azu bɛmaa Daneɛle. 47Belemgbunli ne hanle hilele Daneɛle kɛ, “Nɔhalɛ, wɔ Nyamenle ne le nyamenle kɔsɔɔti bɛ Nyamenle, yɛɛ ɔle arelemgbunli kɔsɔɔti bɛ Awulae. Ɔle Nyamenle mɔɔ sa fealera nu ninyɛne gua zolɛ a. Ɔboalekɛ wɔhola wɔla me fealera nu edwɛkɛ ɛhye ali.” 48Akee Belemgbunli Nɛbukadenɛza lile Daneɛle eni kpole kpalɛ na ɔmanle ye gyinlabelɛ kpole, ɔhyɛle ye ninyɛne mgbole. Ɔyɛle Daneɛle Babelɔn maanle ne amɛnlado na ɔyɛle ye nrɛlɛbɛvolɛma mɔɔ wɔ Babelɔn la kɔsɔɔti kpanyinli. 49Na Daneɛle zɛlɛle belemgbunli ne manle ɔvale Babelɔn maanle ne anwo amaamuo biala ɔwulale Hyeedelake, Mihyɛke, yɛɛ Abɛdenɛgo asa anu kɛ bɛnlea zolɛ; na yemɔ Daneɛle, ɔhale belemgbunli suakunlu ɛkɛ.

Title: DAN 3
Content:
Nɛbukadenɛza maa awie biala azonle ezukoa nvutuke ananze
1Belemgbunli Nɛbukadenɛza manle bɛyɛle ezukoa nvutuke ananze bɛziele Dula azɛlɛ fɛɛnye ne azo wɔ Babelɔn maanle nu. Ananze ne tendenle le mita abulanwiɔ nee nsuu yɛɛ ye tɛtɛlɛ le asɛɛ mita nsa. 2Akee ɔmanle bɛhɔvale maanle ne anu mgbanyima: arelemgbunli, amɛnladoma, mgbanyima mɔɔ tu arane folɛ, gyazoneavolɛma, ndɛnebuavolɛma, edwɛkɛdivolɛma, yɛɛ maanle maanle ne mɔ anu mbɔlɔba mgbanyinli kɛ bɛrɛla bɛmaa bɛvinde ananze ne mɔɔ ɔdaye Nɛbukadenɛza yemaa bɛzie la. 3Yemɔti arelemgbunli, amɛnladoma, maanzinlizoneavolɛma, folɛtuvoma, gyazoneavolɛma, ndɛnebuavolɛma, edwɛkɛdivolɛma, yɛɛ maanle maanle ne mɔ anu mbɔlɔba mgbanyinli rayiale ananze ne mɔɔ belemgbunli ɛmaa bɛzie, mɔɔ bɛfinde ye la anyunlu. 4Akee nolobɔvo ne vale ɛnelɛ kpole bie bɔle nolo kɛ, “Maanlema mɔɔ ka aneɛ ngakyile mɔɔ ɛrayia ɛke la, 5saa bɛte kɛ bɛlɛbɔ aweɛne ndendenle ne mɔ, getaa ngyikyi nee mgbole, fulutu, ɛweɛne, yɛɛ agole ngakyile biala a, awie biala ɛdu ɛdɔ ɛzonle ezukoa nvutuke ananze ne mɔɔ belemgbunli Nɛbukadenɛza ɛzie la. 6Awie biala mɔɔ kɛde, na yeangoto yeanzonle ezukoa nvutuke ananze ne la, bɛhye ye bɛdo sendɔlɔra nu bɛyela ye.” 7Yemɔti, mekɛ mɔɔ maanlema mɔɔ ka aneɛ ngakyile mɔɔ rayiale la dele aweɛne ndendenle ne mɔ ane, getaa ngyikyi nee mgbole ne mɔ ane, fulutu nee ɛweɛne yɛɛ agole ngakyile ne mɔ ane la, bɛdule bɛguale bɛzonlenle ezukoa nvutuke ananze ne mɔɔ Nɛbukadenɛza ɛzie la.
Bɛdo Daneɛle agɔnwo mɔ nsa ne ɛzonle kɛ bɛanyɛ tieyɛ
8Mekɛ ɛhye anu, Babelɔnoma bie mɔ yele bɛ nyunlu kɛ bɛtoɔdoa Dwuuma ne mɔ. 9Bɛhanle bɛhilele Belemgbunli Nɛbukadenɛza kɛ, “Belemgbunli, nyi kyɛ! 10Wɔmɔ belemgbunli, wɔli mɛla kɛ awie biala mɔɔ kɛde aweɛne ndendenle ne, fulutu, getaa ngyikyi nee mgbole, nee ɛweɛne, yɛɛ agole ngakyile ne mɔ ane la ɛdu ɛdɔ ɛzonle ezukoa nvutuke ananze ne mɔɔ wɔzie la. 11Na awie biala mɔɔ kɛde na yeandu yeandɔ yeanzonle ananze ne la bɛhye ye bɛdo sendɔlɔra nu bɛyela ye. 12Wɔva Dwuuma bie wɔzie Babelɔn kɛ bɛzie maanle ne. Menli ɛhye mɔ ɛmbu wɔ; bɛnzonle wɔ awozonle ne mɔ yɛɛ bɛnzonle ezukoa nvutuke ananze ne noko mɔɔ wɔzie la. Bɛmɛ a le Hyeedelake, Mihyake, yɛɛ Abɛdenɛgo.”
13Belemgbunli ne ahonle futule kpole na ɔzele kɛ bɛva Hyeedelake, Mihyake, yɛɛ Abɛdenɛgo bɛrɛla. Bɛhɔhyele menli ɛhye mɔ bɛrale. 14Nɛbukadenɛza bizale bɛ kɛ, “Hyeedelake, Mihyake, Abɛdenɛgo, asoo ɔle nɔhalɛ kɛ bɛnzonle me awozonle ne mɔ nee me ezukoa nvutuke ananze ne mɔɔ mezie la? 15Saa mekɛ biala bɛte aweɛne ndendenle ne, fulutu, getaa ngyikyi nee mgbole, ɛweɛne, yɛɛ agole ngakyile ne mɔ ane na bɛkɛdu bɛkɛgua, bɛkɛzonle ananze ne mɔɔ memaa bɛzie la a, ɛnee bɛ kɔme doa zolɛ. Na saa bɛanli zolɛ a, bɛbavuandi bɛ bɛagua sendɔlɔra nu bɛayela bɛ. Ɛkɛ yɛɛ bɛbahile nyamenle holɛ ko mɔɔ balie bɛ la a.”
16Hyeedelake, Mihyake, yɛɛ Abɛdenɛgo buale belemgbunli ne kɛ, “O Nana, Nɛbukadenɛza, ɔngyia kɛ yɛkɛbua wɔ edwɛkɛ ɛhye anwo bie. 17Saa ɔba ye zɔhane a, Nyamenle ne mɔɔ yɛsonle ye la kola die yɛ fi sendɔlɔra ne anu, yɛɛ ɔbalie yɛ yeavi ɛ sa nu. 18Saa yeanlie yɛ bɔbɔ a yɛka ye wienyi kɛ yɛnrɛzonle wɔ awozonle ne mɔ, yɛɛ yɛnrɛdu yɛnrɛgua wɔ ezukoa nvutuke ananze ne mɔɔ wɔzie la anyunlu.”
Bɛbu Daneɛle agɔnwo mɔ nsa ne ewule fɔlɛ
19Nɛbukadenɛza vale ɛya kpole, ɔmunlanle kpole kpalɛ wɔ Hyeedelake, Mihyake, yɛɛ Abɛdenɛgo edwɛkɛ ne ati. Ɔmanle bɛhuanle sendɔlɔra kpole kpalɛ mɔɔ ye ɛzɔlɛ ne kpole tɛla dɛba ɛdeɛ ne mɔ fane nsuu la. 20Akee ɔyele ye ɛlɔnema ne anu menli kekahilii ne bie mɔ kɛ bɛkyekye Hyeedelake, Mihyake, yɛɛ Abɛdenɛgo na bɛvuandi bɛ bɛgua sendɔlɔra ne anu bɛyela bɛ. 21Zɔhane ati bɛkyekyele menli ɛhye mɔ boka bɛ adɛladeɛ mɔɔ bɛwulowula nee bɛ ahyɛlɛ mɔɔ bɛzozo la na bɛvuandinle bɛ bɛguale sendɔlɔra ne anu. 22Belemgbunli mɛla ne anu mianle, yemɔti sendɔlɔra ne dɔlɔle kpole kpalɛ manle ye wuluwulu ne dwele vuale mrenya mɔɔ lɛ Hyeedelake, Mihyake, yɛɛ Abɛdenɛgo kagua nu la na ɔhunle bɛ. 23Na bɛguale Hyeedelake, Mihyake, yɛɛ Abɛdenɛgo sendɔlɔra kpole ne anu.
24Arɛlevilɛ nu, Nɛbukadenɛza dwazole na azibɛnwo nu ɔbizale ye mgbanyima ne mɔ kɛ, “Ayi mɔ, na tɛ menli nsa a yɛkyekyele bɛ yɛvuandinle bɛ yɛguale senle ne anu a?”
Bɛbuale ye kɛ, “Nana, ɔle nɔhalɛ; yɛkyekyele menli nsa.”
25Na ɔzele kɛ, “Noko menwu menli nna mɔɔ bɛtɛkyekyele bɛ la kɛ bɛluolua senle ne anu. Bɛ nwo kɔlɔnwo. Ko ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nna la zɔho bozonle ralɛ nrenya.”
Bɛye menli nsa ne bɛmaa bɛ dibilɛ
26Belemgbunli Nɛbukadenɛza dudule agyakɛ bikyele sendɔlɔra ne na ɔzele kɛ, “Hyeedelake, Mihyake, Abɛdenɛgo, Anwuma Anwuma Nyamenle sonvolɛma, bɛvinde bɛrɛla!” Yemɔti Hyeedelake, Mihyake, yɛɛ Abɛdenɛgo vi sendɔlɔra ne anu vindele rale. 27Maanle maanle ne mɔ anu arelemgbunli, amɛnladoma, yɛɛ belemgbunli folɛtuvolɛma mɔɔ rayiale ɛkɛ la lile daselɛ kɛ menli nsa ne anwo ɛleka biala ambu ɛbonle; bɛ ti enrinli bɔbɔ, senle anga ye na yeayɛ bɛ adɛladeɛ, yɛɛ bɛ nwo ambɔnle sisikpunlike bɔbɔ.
28Belemgbunli Nɛbukadenɛza zele kɛ, “Ayɛlɛyelɛ ɛha Hyeedelake, Mihyake, yɛɛ Abɛdenɛgo Nyamenle ne. Ye sonvolɛma ne dule bɛ gye kɛ bɛnrɛli me mɛla ne azo, yɛɛ bɛnrɛdu bɛnrɛgua bɛnrɛzonle nyamenle biala kɛ bɛ Nyamenle ɛdeɛ ne ala. Bɛliele bɛ Nyamenle ne bɛlile na bɛvale bɛ nwonane bɛdole nzeleba, na amgba Nyamenle ɛzoa ye soanvolɛ yemaa yeralie bɛ.
29“Yemɔti medi mɛla kɛ maanle anzɛɛ menli biala anzɛɛ aneɛ biala mɔɔ kɛdendɛ ɛtane kɛtia Hyeedelake, Mihyake, yɛɛ Abɛdenɛgo Nyamenle ne la, bɛdudu bɛ abɛsa abɛsa na bɛyela bɛ azua ne mɔ. Ɔluakɛ nyamenle biala ɛnle ɛkɛ mɔɔ kola die ngoane kɛ bɛ Nyamenle ɛdeɛ ne la.” 30Na ɔmanle mgbavolɛ nsa ne, Hyeedelake, Mihyake, yɛɛ Abɛdenɛgo dibilɛ kpole wɔ Babelɔn maanzinli ne anu.

Title: DAN 4
Content:
Nɛbukadenɛza ɛlalɛ mɔɔ tɔ zo nwiɔ
1Belemgbunli Nɛbukadenɛza vale nrɛlaleɛ hɔmanle maanle maanle ne mɔ anu amra mɔɔ ka aneɛ ngakyile la kɛ, “Anzonudwolɛ kpole ɛha bɛ! 2Anwuma Anwuma Nyamenle ne ɛyɛ nwanwane ninyɛne, ɛye sɛkɛlɛneɛ ɛhile me, na ɔle kpalɛ kɛ menwɔha menwɔhile bɛ.
3“Ye sɛkɛlɛneɛ ne mɔ le mgbole!
Ye nwanwane ninyɛne ne mɔ yɛ ɛzulolɛ!
Ye belemgbunlililɛ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ,
ye belemgbunlililɛ vi awolɛndoazo dwu awolɛndoazo.
4“Ɛnee medame Nɛbukadenɛza, mewɔ me sua nu anzonudwolɛ nu na me nye ɛlie me ɛkpazilɛ nu wɔ me suakunlu ɛkɛ. 5Menganle ɛlalɛ bie na mɔɔ mela me ɛkpa ne azo la ɛlalɛ ne gyinlegyinlanle me nye zo, na ɛzulolɛ hanle me. 6Yemɔti menlile mɛla kɛ nrɛlɛbɛvolɛma mɔɔ wɔ Babelɔn la amuala ɛrɛla ɛrahile me ɛlalɛ ne abo. 7Na ngonyiayevoma, silikyevoma, adunyipɛvoma, yɛɛ nwɔlɔra kengavoma rayiale; menganle me ɛlalɛ ne mengilele bɛ, na bɛangola ɛlalɛ ne abo kile. 8Nzinlii Daneɛle mɔɔ Nyamenle Nwuanzanwuanza ne Sunsum ne wɔ ye nu, na menvale me bozonle Bɛletihyazaa duma mendonle ye la rale. Menganle ɛlalɛ ne mengilele ye. Mese: 9O Bɛletihyazaa, Nyamenle Nwuanzanwuanza ne Sunsum wɔ wɔ nu. Wɔmɔ, ɛle ngonyiama amuala kpanyinli, yɛɛ fealera nu debie biala ɛmbo ɛ nwo zo. Ɛlalɛ mɔɔ meha la ɛ, na kile me ɔ bo.
10“Mewɔ nla nu la, menganle ɛlalɛ menwunle kɛ baka kpole tendenle bie gyi ɛkɛ. 11Baka ne nyinle toonwo ɔyɛle kpole kpalɛ, ɔ ti dwule Nyamenle ne ako abo lɔ mɔɔ aleɛabo amra amuala nwu ye la. 12Ye nya le kpukpotoloo yɛɛ ye ma zonle dɔɔnwo mɔɔ debie biala nyia bie di a. Ɛbɔ nu nane bada ye alubo ne anu yɛɛ nloma da ye ngane ne mɔ anu; nane nee menli kpokpoti di ye ma ne bie.
13“Me nye gyi ɛhye anwo la, menwunle ye wɔ ɛlalɛ ne anu kɛ Nyamenle soanvolɛ vi anwuma ɛdwu aze. 14Ɔdeanle nuhua kpole bie kɛ, ‘Bɛdu baka ne bɛdo aze, bɛpepɛ ye ngane ne mɔ, bɛkpolo ye nya ne mɔ na bɛdo ye ma ne mɔ bɛkponde. Bɛmaa nane ne mɔ ɛvi ɔ bo ɛnriandi ɛhɔ na nloma ne mɔ vi ye ngane ne mɔ anu ɛdu. 15Bɛgyakyi ye dosinli ne nee ye ndinli ne mɔ azɛlɛ ne anwo na bɛva mbulalɛ nee kɔbele bɛnyinyi nwolɛ wɔ ndile ne anu.
“ ‘Bɛmaa ɛbɔlɛ ɛdɔ ɛgua nrenya ɛhye anwo zo, na ɔ nee ɛbɔ nu nane nee mbaka ɛva adwenle. 16Bɛmaa ye sonla adwenle kpalɛ ne ɛminli, na ɔnyia nane adwenle toonwo ɛvolɛ nsuu. 17Nyamenle soanvolɛma ne mɔɔ sinza la anloa edwɛkɛ ɛne. Ɔle kpɔkɛ mɔɔ nwuanzanwuanzama ne ɛbɔ, amaa menli kɔsɔɔti anwu kɛ Anwuma Anwumanli ne lɛ tumi wɔ ewiade belemgbunlililɛ zo, yɛɛ ɔfa ɔmaa awie biala mɔɔ ɔkulo la, ɔnvane nwolɛ kɛ ahenle le koahweabane bɔbɔ.’
18“Bɛletihyazaa, ɛlalɛ ɛhye a medame Belemgbunli Nɛbukadenɛza menganle a, kile me ɔ bo, ɔboalekɛ Anwuma Nyamenle ne Sunsum wɔ wɔ nu. Nrɛlɛbɛvolɛma mɔɔ wɔ me maanle ye anu la amuala ɛyɛ biala na bɛangola bɛangile ɔ bo.”
Daneɛle kile ɛlalɛ ne abo
19Akee Daneɛle, mɔɔ eza bɛfɛlɛ ye Bɛletihyazaa la, ahonle dule. Belemgbunli ne zele ye kɛ, “Bɛletihyazaa, mmamaa wɔ ahonle tu ɛlalɛ ne anzɛɛ ɔ bo ɛhilelɛ ne anwo.”
Bɛletihyazaa buale kɛ, “Me menle, mesɛlɛ kɛ anrɛɛ ɛlalɛ ne ɛntia wɔ na ɔtia wɔ kpɔvolɛma nee menli mɔɔ kyi wɔ la! 20Nana, baka kpole tendenle ne mɔɔ ɛnwunle kɛ ɔgyi ɛkɛ, yenyi yekpula Nyamenle ne ako abo nehane, mɔɔ bɛnwu ye aleɛabo ɛleka biala, mɔɔ ye nya le kpukpotoloo, 21ye ma le dɔɔnwo, na ɛbɔ nu nane bafea ye alubo nu, yɛɛ nloma banwo bɛ sane wɔ ye ngane ne mɔ anu, yɛɛ nane nee menli kɔsɔɔti di ye ma ne bie la, yemɔ a le ɛdawɔ.
22“Nana, ɛdawɔ a wɔnyi na wɔnyia anwosesebɛ la. Wɔ anwosesebɛ ne kpole ɛkpula anwuma yɛɛ wɔ tumi ɛdende ɛdwu ewiade ɛleka biala. 23Nana nwunle kɛ Nyamenle soanvolɛ vi anwuma ɛdwu na yearaze kɛ, ‘Bɛbu baka ne, bɛzɛkye ye na bɛgyakyi ye dosinli ne wɔ azɛlɛ ne anwo, na bɛva mbulalɛ nee kɔbele bɛnyinyi nwolɛ wɔ ndile ne anu. Bɛmaa ɛbɔlɛ ɛdɔ ɛgua ɔ nwo zo na ɔ nee ɛbɔ nu nane ɛhɔdɛnla ɛvolɛ nsuu.’
24“Nana, ɛlalɛ ne abo a le kɛ, Anwuma Anwumanli ne kpondɛ kɛ ɛnwu debie mɔɔ bazi ɛ nwo zo la. 25Bɛbavoa wɔ bɛavi menli nu bɛamaa ɛ nee ɛbɔ nu nane ahɔdɛnla; ɛbali ndile kɛ ɛnlankɛ nyinli na ɛbɔlɛ adɔ ɛ nwo zo toonwo ɛvolɛ nsuu. Ɛhye anzi ɛbanwu kɛ Anwuma Anwumanli ne a sie ewiade a, yɛɛ ɔfa ɔmaa awie biala mɔɔ ɔkulo la. 26Ɛdele kɛ Nyamenle soanvolɛ ne hanle kɛ bɛgyakyi baka dosinli ne azɛlɛ ne anwo. Ɛhye kile kɛ saa ɛ nye zo tete wɔ na ɛdie ɛto nu kɛ Nyamenle a sie ewiade a, ɛbazia wɔazie wɔ maanle ne bieko. 27Zɔhane ati, Nana, die me folɛ mɔɔ melɛtu wɔ la to nu. Gyakyi ɛtanelilɛ nee ninyɛndane ɛyɛlɛ, na bɔ ɛbɛla tenlene, nwu bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛsisi bɛ la anwunvɔne, amaa wɔahɔ zolɛ wɔakpazi.”
28Ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ amuala rale Belemgbunli Nɛbukadenɛza anwo zo. 29Ɛvolɛ ko anzi, kenle ko bie mɔɔ belemgbunli ne lua Babelɔn suakunlu ɛkɛ ne sua ne ati zo la 30ɔhanle kɛ, “Babelɔn a ɛdɛlɛ kpole zɛhae la! Meva medame me tumi kpole ne a mekyekye a. Mekyekye kɛ mefa meayɛ me maanle ne suakpole, amaa menli anwu anyunlunyia mɔɔ wɔ me belemgbunlililɛ nu a.”
31Belemgbunli ne anloa ampe yɛɛ ɛnelɛ bie dendɛle vi anwuma kɛ, “Belemgbunli Nɛbukadenɛza, tie ɛ! Bɛlie wɔ belemgbunlililɛ ne ɛ sa nu. 32Bɛbavoa wɔ bɛavi menli avinli na ɛ nee ɛbɔ nu nane ahɔdɛnla. Bɛbamaa wɔali ndile kɛ ɛnlankɛ nyinli la toonwo ɛvolɛ nsuu, kɔkpula mekɛ mɔɔ ɛkɛnwu kɛ Anwuma Anwumanli ne a sie ewiade a, yɛɛ ɔfa ɔmaa awie biala mɔɔ ɔkulo la.”
33Ɛkɛ ne ala edwɛkɛ ne yɛle zɔhane wɔ Nɛbukadenɛza anwo zo. Bɛvoanle ye bɛvile menli avinli, ɔlile ndile kɛ ɛnlankɛ nyinli la, ɛbɔlɛ dɔle loale ye toonwo ɔ ti enrinli ndendenle yɛle kɛ kɔleɛ ndɛkɛ na ye bɔweɛlɛ vile yɛle kɛ kpolakɛ asa ati la.
Nɛbukadenɛza yeyɛ Nyamenle
34“Ɛvolɛ nsuu ne dwule la, medame Nɛbukadenɛza, mendole me nye anwomanyunlu, na me nye rale me nwo zo. Menyele Anwuma Anwumanli ne ayɛlɛ na menyeyɛle teasenli ne menlile ye eni kɛ:
“Ye belemgbunlililɛ ɛnrɛbɔ aze ɛlɛ,
ye belemgbunlililɛ vi awolɛndoazo dwu awolɛndoazo.
35Aleɛabo amra amuala ɛnzɔho ɛhwee ɔ nye zo;
ɔyɛ debie biala mɔɔ ɔkulo la
wɔ anwuma amra nee aze amra avinli.
Awie ɛngola ɛndua ye
yɛɛ awie ɛngola ɛmbiza ye kɛ,
‘Duzu a ɛlɛyɛ la?’
36“Mekɛ ne anu ala me adwenle ziale rale sua nu; na me belemgbunlililɛ anyunlunyia ne, me belemgbunli tumi ne nee ye kɛnlɛma ne eza yɛle me ɛdeɛ. Menli mɔɔ tu me folɛ nee me mgbanyima kpondɛle me bo zo, na me belemgbunlililɛ ne lile munli. Eza menyɛle kpole, menyianle me nyunlu bɔbɔ mendɛlale alumua ne.
37“Akee kɛkala, medame Nɛbukadenɛza, mefa ayɛlɛyelɛ, enililɛ mewula Anwuma Belemgbunli ne anyunlunyia. Ɔluakɛ ye gyima kɔsɔɔti le kpalɛ, yɛɛ ye ndenle le fɔɔnwo, na bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛmemaa bɛ nwo zo la, ɔkola ɔbɛlɛ bɛ aze.”

Title: DAN 5
Content:
Bɛlehyaza ɛkponledolɛ ne
1Belemgbunli Bɛlehyaza dole ye mgbanyima ne mɔ apenle ko ɛkponle kpole bie na ɔ nee bɛ muala nlonle nza. 2Bɛlehyaza zɔle nza ne bie nleanle la, ɔhanle kɛ bɛhɔsesa ezukoa nvutuke ahɔpo nee dwɛtɛ fufule ahɔpo ne mɔ mɔɔ ɔ ze Nɛbukadenɛza sesale bɛ wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu la bɛrɛla bɛmaa belemgbunli nee ye maanle mgbanyima, ye mraalɛ nee ye mgbɔnla ne mɔ ɛnlo nu. 3Bɛvale ezukoa nvutuke ahɔpo nee dwɛtɛ fufule ahɔpo ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛsesale bɛ wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm Nyamenle Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu la bɛrale. Belemgbunli nee ye mgbanyima ne, ye mraalɛ nee ye mgbɔnla ne mɔ vale nlonle bɛ nza ne. 4Bɛnlonle nza ne na bɛyeyɛle ezukoa nvutuke, dwɛtɛ fufule, kɔbele, bulalɛ, baka, yɛɛ bolɛ awozonle ne mɔ.
5Ɛkɛ ne ala bɛnwunle sonla ɛsalɛ kɛ yevinde na ɔlɛkɛlɛ suakunlu ɛkɛ ne bane ne mɔɔ nee kɛnlaneɛ baka ne anye bɔ zolɛ la anwo. Belemgbunli ne nwunle ɛsalɛ ne mɔɔ ɛlɛkɛlɛ la; 6na ɔ nyunlu hunle, ye adwenle zɛkyele, ɔ nwo wozole ye na ɔ gyakɛ bɔle nwolɛ tɛtɛtɛtɛ. 7Ɔdeanle nuhua kɛ bɛvɛlɛ silikyevoma, ngonyiayevoma, yɛɛ nwɔlɔrakengavoma bɛmaa bɛrɛla. Na belemgbunli ne hanle hilele Babelɔn nrɛlɛbɛvolɛma ne mɔ kɛ, “Awie biala mɔɔ kɛhola kɛgenga ngɛlɛlera ɛhye na ɔkɛhile me ɔ bo la, bɛbawula ye belemgbunli tɛladeɛ, bɛava ezukoa nvutuke ndweabane bɛado ɔ kɔme, na meayɛ ye maanlebuvo mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nsa.” 8Nrɛlɛbɛvolɛma mɔɔ wɔ belemgbunli ne abo la amuala rale ye ɛvɛlɛlɛ ne, na bɛangola bɛangenga ngɛlɛlera ne bɛangile ɔ bo bɛangile belemgbunli ne. 9Akee ɛzulolɛ hanle Belemgbunli Bɛlehyaza na ɔ rɛle bɔle kpole kpalɛ, ɛhye ati ye mgbanyima ne mɔ adwenle zɛkyele.
10Belemgbunli raalɛ ne dele belemgbunli nee ye mgbanyima ne mɔ ane la, ɔrale ɛkponledolɛ sua ne anu na ɔzele kɛ, “Belemgbunli, nyi kyɛ! Mmamaa ɔyɛ wɔ ɛzulolɛ yɛɛ mmamaa ɛ rɛle bɔ. 11Nrenya bie wɔ wɔ maanle ye anu mɔɔ Nyamenle Nwuanzanwuanza ne Sunsum wɔ ye nu. Ɛ ze Nɛbukadenɛza mekɛ zo, bɛnwunle kɛ ɔlɛ wienyi bie li ɔ nyunlu, ɔlɛ ndelebɛbo, yɛɛ ɔze nrɛlɛbɛ kɛ awozonle ne mɔ ala la. Ɔlua ɛhye ati Nɛbukadenɛza yɛle ye ngonyiayevoma, silikyevoma, adunyipɛvoma, yɛɛ nwɔlɔrakengavoma kpanyinli. 12Nrenya ɛhye a le Daneɛle mɔɔ ɛ ze Nɛbukadenɛza donle ye Bɛletihyazaa la. Bɛnwunle kɛ Daneɛle lɛ sunsum, ɔlɛ adwenle, ɔlɛ ndelebɛbo ɔfa ɔkile ɛlalɛ bo, ɔkilehile agyiba nu, na ɔkola ɔye edwɛkɛ ɛsesebɛ biala anloa. Maa bɛhɔvɛlɛ ye na ɔkɛhile wɔ ngɛlɛlera ne mɔɔ wɔ bane ne anwo la abo.”
Daneɛle kile ngɛlɛlera ne abo
13Bɛhɔvale Daneɛle bɛrale na belemgbunli ne zele ye kɛ, “Wɔmɔ Daneɛle, se ɛle Dwudama mɔɔ egya hyele bɛ rale nlɔnu wɔ ɛke la anu ko? 14Mede kɛ Nyamenle Nwuanzanwuanza ne Sunsum wɔ wɔ nu, yɛɛ ɛlɛ wienyi bie li ɛ nyunlu, ɛlɛ ndelebɛbo, yɛɛ ɛze nrɛlɛbɛ kpole kpalɛ. 15Bɛva ngonyiayevoma nee nrɛlɛbɛvolɛma bɛra kɛ bɛgenga ngɛlɛlera ɛhye na bɛhile me ɔ bo, na bɛangola ɔ bo kile. 16Na mede kɛ ɛkola ɛkile debie bo yɛɛ ɛkola ɛgyinla edwɛkɛ ɛsesebɛ nloa. Saa ɛkola ngɛlɛlera ne kenga ɛkile ɔ bo ɛkile me a, bɛbawula wɔ belemgbunli tɛladeɛ, bɛava ezukoa nvutuke ndweabane bɛado ɛ kɔme, na wɔayɛ maanlebuvo mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nsa la.”
17Daneɛle buale belemgbunli ne kɛ, “Nana, maa wɔ ahyɛlɛdeɛ ne ɛwoa ɛkɛ; saa ɛkulo noko a fa kyɛ awie na mame, mekenga ngɛlɛlera ne meahile ɔ bo meahile wɔ.
18“Nana, Anwuma Anwuma Nyamenle ne yɛle ɛ ze Nɛbukadenɛza belemgbunli kpole na ɔnyianle ɔ nyunlu. 19Ɔlua kpole mɔɔ Nyamenle yɛle ye la ati menli nee maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti mɔɔ ka aneɛ ngakyile la dwu ɔ nyunlu a, bɛsulo na bɛ nwo wozo bɛ. Saa ɔse kɛ bɛhu awie a, bɛku ye, yɛɛ saa ɔse kɛ bɛdwula awie a, bɛdwula ye. Ɔkola ɔmaa awie gyinlabelɛ; ɔkola ɔka awie aze. 20Ɔ ti anu yɛle ye fɛ manle ɔmemanle ɔ nwo zo, ɔyɛle anzosesebɛ, yemɔti bɛliele ye belemgbunlililɛ ne wɔ ɔ sa nu na bɛyele ye anyunlunyia ne. 21Bɛvoanle ye bɛvile menli avinli, ye adwenle yɛle kɛ nane adwenle na ɔ nee nanemgbole hɔdɛnlanle. Ɔlile ndile kɛ ɛnlankɛ nyinli la, ɛbɔlɛ dɔle loale ye hɔdwule kɛ ɔnwunle kɛ Anwuma Anwuma Nyamenle ne a sie ewiade a, yɛɛ ɔfa ɔmaa sonla mɔɔ ɔkulo ye la nea zolɛ.
22“Wɔmɔ Bɛlehyaza, Nɛbukadenɛza akunlu ralɛ nrenya a le wɔ, yɛɛ ɛze ɛhye mɔ amuala ɛsie, noko wɔanga ɛ nwo aze 23na wɔhakyi ɛ nzi wɔzi Anwuma Nyamenle ne. Bɛva ahɔpo ne mɔ mɔɔ wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu la bɛrɛlɛ wɔ na ɛ nee wɔ mgbanyima, wɔ mraalɛ, yɛɛ wɔ mgbɔnla ne mɔ ɛnlo nu. Wɔye dwɛtɛ fufule, ezukoa nvutuke, kɔbele, bulalɛ, baka, yɛɛ bolɛ awozonle ne mɔ mɔɔ ɛnnwu debie, ɛnde edwɛkɛ, ɛnze ɛhwee la ayɛlɛ wɔgyakyi Nyamenle ne mɔɔ wɔ ngoane nee wɔ ndenle kɔsɔɔti wɔ ɔ sa nu la. 24Yemɔti a yezoa ɛsalɛ ne yemaa yerahɛlɛ ngɛlɛlera ɛhye la.
25“Debie mɔɔ bɛhɛlɛle la a le, ‘MINI, MINI, TIKƐLE U PASEN.’ 26Edwɛkɛ ne abo a le ɛhye: MINI, Nyamenle ɛbu wɔ belemgbunlililɛ mekɛ ne na yezɔ ɔ nloa; 27TIKƐLE, bɛzuzu wɔ wɔ tone nu bɛnwu kɛ ɛndo ɛhwee; 28U PASEN, bɛhyɛ wɔ maanle ne anu bɛmaa Midiama nee Pɛhyeama.”
29 Ɛkɛ ne ala Bɛlehyaza manle ye sonvolɛma wulale Daneɛle belemgbunli tɛladeɛ kɔkɔlɛ, bɛvale ezukoa nvutuke ndweabane bɛdole ɔ kɔme, na bɛbɔle ye nolo kɛ bɛyɛ ye maanlebuvo mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nsa. 30Kenle ko ne nɔe ne ala bɛhunle Babelonia Belemgbunli Bɛlehyaza 31na Midianli Dalayɛse vale ebia ne dɛnlanle zolɛ. Ɛnee yeli ɛvolɛ kɛyɛ abulasia nee nwiɔ.

Title: DAN 6
Content:
Daneɛle la awenade tunli nu
1Dalayɛse vale adwenle kɛ ɔye amɛnladoma ɛya ko abulanwiɔ yeamaa bɛanlea maanzinli ne mɔ azo. 2Akee ɔyele Daneɛle nee menli nwiɔ bie noko kɛ bɛmɛ nsa bɛnlea amɛnladoma ɛya ko abulanwiɔ ne mɔ anwo zo, amaa belemgbunli ne amminli debie. 3Daneɛle yɛle gyima dɛlale mgbanyima mɔɔ ɛha la nee amɛnladoma ne mɔ amuala, ɔboalekɛ sunsum kpalɛ wɔ ye nu. Yemɔti belemgbunli ne yɛle kɛ ɔmaa yeazie maanle ne kɔsɔɔti. 4Mgbanyima ne nee amɛnladoma ne mɔ bɔle kpɔkɛ kɛ bɛnea Daneɛle maamulɛ ne anu boɛ bɛakpondɛ nvonleɛ bie bɛatia ye, na bɛannyia ɛzonle biala bɛando Daneɛle anwo zo, ɔboalekɛ ɔdi nɔhalɛ; bɛannwu ɛtane anzɛɛ nvonleɛ wɔ ye maamulɛ nu. 5Akee menli ne mɔ hanle kɛ, “Daneɛle ɛhye, saa yeanlua ye Nyamenle ne ɛzonlenlɛ zo yeamkpondɛ debie yɛantia ye a, yɛnrɛnyia ɔ nwo edwɛkɛ ɛtane ɛlɛ.”
6Yemɔti mgbanyima ne nee amɛnladoma ne mɔ lile bɛ nloa rale belemgbunli ɛkɛ rahanle hilele ye kɛ, “Belemgbunli Dalayɛse, nyi kyɛ! 7Kɛkala, maanle ye anu mgbanyima, amɛnladoma, folɛdulɛma, yɛɛ maanzinli zo neavolɛma amuala ɛlie ɛdo nu kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ ɛdi mɛla, ɛkye ɔ bo kɛ, ‘Awie biala mmaye ɛdɛne maa nyamenle biala anzɛɛ biza sonla biala debie toonwo kenle kɔkɔlɛ abulasa (siane ko) na ɛ ngomekye a bɛva bɛ ti bɛzɔ wɔ a. Awie biala mɔɔ anli mɛla ɛhye azo la, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛfuandi ye bɛto awenade ne mɔ tunli ne anu.’ 8Nana, di mɛla ne fa ɛ sa wula ɔ bo kile kɛ bɛngakyi ye ɛlɛ, kɛmɔ Midiama, nee Pɛhyeama mɛla ne se la.” 9Zɔhane ati Belemgbunli Dalayɛse lile mɛla ne na ɔvale ɔ sa ɔwulale ɔ bo. 10Daneɛle nwunle kɛ bɛlie mɛla ne bɛdo nu na belemgbunli ɛva ɔ sa ɛwula ɔ bo la, ɔhɔle sua nu, ɔbukebukele ye nvɛnzɛlɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ kɔne Gyɛlusalɛm afoa nu la ɔguale nwolɛ, na kenle ko biala ɔhotole ɔzɛlɛle na ɔyɛle ye Nyamenle ne mo fane nsa, kɛmɔ ɛnee ɔyɛ ye dɛba ne la.
11Daneɛle kpɔvolɛma ne mɔ radɛle ye nwunle kɛ ɔlɛsɛlɛ yeavɛlɛ ye Nyamenle ne. 12Yemɔti bɛrale belemgbunli ɛkɛ bɛrabizale ye mɛla ne anwo bie kɛ, “Nana, ɛkɛhakye kɛ wɔli mɛla, wɔhye ɔ bo wɔmaa awie biala siane ko kɛ ɔva ɔ ti ɔzɔ wɔmɔ ala ɔyɛ nzɛlɛlɛ, na awie mɔɔ annea ɛ ngomekye na ɔkɛbiza nyamenle biala anzɛɛ sonla ɛkɛ debie la, bɛvuandi ye bɛdo awenade ne mɔ tunli ne anu?”
Belemgbunli ne buale kɛ, “Nɔhalɛ ɔ! Midiama nee Pɛhyeama mɛla ɔ, ɔgyi kpundii, bɛtulu ye a ɔntulu.”
13Akee bɛhanle bɛhilele belemgbunli ne kɛ, “Daneɛle, mɔɔ le Dwudama mɔɔ bɛhyele bɛ bɛrale nlɔnu wɔ ɛke la anu ko la ɛmbu wɔ, yɛɛ ɔmbu wɔ mɛla ne. Kenle ko biala ɔyɛ nzɛlɛlɛ fane nsa.”
14Belemgbunli dele edwɛkɛ ne la, ɔgyegyele ye adwenle dɔɔnwo. Ɛbɔ ye nwonlomɔ ne toonwo mɔɔ kɔdwu nɔsolɛ nu la ɛnee ɔlɛkpondɛ adenle yealua nu yealie Daneɛle. 15Menli ne amuala ziale razele belemgbunli ne kɛ, “Nana, mmamaa ɛ rɛle fi kɛ, Midia nee Pɛhyea maanle nu, saa belemgbunli di mɛla fa ɔ sa wula ɔ bo a bɛntulu ye.”
16Ɔlua ɛhye ati belemgbunli ne manle bɛhɔvale Daneɛle bɛrale na bɛvuandinle ye bɛdole awenade ne mɔ tunli ne anu. Belemgbunli ne zele Daneɛle kɛ, “Wɔ Nyamenle ne mɔɔ ɛsonle ye dahuu la ɛlie wɔ ngoane!” 17Bɛvale bolɛ bɛranyinle tunli ne. Akee belemgbunli vale ɔdaye mumua ne ye tumi sɛkɛlɛneɛ ne nee ye mgbanyima ne mɔ tumi sɛkɛlɛneɛ ne mɔ sosɔle bolɛ ne amaa awie angola anyɛ debie biala kɛ ɔdie Daneɛle. 18Belemgbunli ne ziale hɔle ye suakunlu ɛkɛ. Yeanva debie fee yeanga ɔ nloa, yeanlie ɔ nye, yɛɛ aledwolɛ ne anu, nafelɛ angɔ ɔ nye zo.
19Aleɛbahye ne, belemgbunli ne dwazole na ɔhanle ɔ nwo ɔhɔle awenade tunli ne anwo. 20Ɔbikyele tunli ne la ɔvale abodelɛ ɔdeanle nuhua kɛ, “Tease Nyamenle ne sonvolɛ Daneɛle! Asoo wɔ Nyamenle ne mɔɔ ɛsonle ye dahuu la ɛhola ɛlie wɔ ɛvi awenade ne mɔ asa anu?”
21Daneɛle buale belemgbunli ne kɛ, “Nana, nyi kyɛ! 22Me Nyamenle ne zoanle ye soanvolɛ manle ɔratotole awenade ne mɔ anloa anu, yemɔti bɛanva bɛ nloa bɛanga me. Ɔluakɛ medi benle wɔ me Nyamenle ne anyunlu yɛɛ medi benle wɔ ɛdawɔ noko ɛ nyunlu. Nana, metɛyɛle ɛtane biala.”
23Belemgbunli Dalayɛse lile fɛlɛko kpole na ɔzile ɔ gyakɛ aze kɛ bɛye Daneɛle wɔ tunli ne anu. Yemɔti bɛyele Daneɛle wɔ tunli ne anu, ɔ nwo kɔlɔnwo, ɔboalekɛ ɔvale ɔ rɛle ɔwulale ye Nyamenle ne nu. 24Belemgbunli manle bɛhɔhyele menli mɔɔ doanle Daneɛle la bɛrale, na bɛvuandinle bɛ nee bɛ mra nee bɛ mraalɛ bɛguale awenade tunli ne anu. Bɛandwu aze wɔ tunli ne anu bɔbɔ, awenade ne mɔ sosɔle bɛ anwuma tetele bɛ azinli lile.
25Belemgbunli Dalayɛse hɛlɛle hɔmanle maanle maanle nee menli ngakyile mɔɔ bɛ aneɛ le ngakyile la kɛ, “Anzonudwolɛ dɔɔnwo ɛha bɛ! 26Memaa bɛade kɛ meli mɛla kɛ awie biala mɔɔ wɔ me maanle ye anu la ɛzonle na ɔzulo Daneɛle Nyamenle ne.
“Ɔluakɛ ɔle Tease Nyamenle,
ɔwɔ ɛkɛ ne dahuu;
na ɔbali belemgbunli dahuu.
27Ɔdie ngoane, ɔye menli ɔfi munzule nu;
ɔyɛ sɛkɛlɛneɛ, ɔyɛ nwanwane gyima wɔ anwuma nee aze.
Yelie Daneɛle yevi awenade ne mɔ asa anu.”
28Yemɔti Daneɛle nyianle ɔ nyunlu wɔ Belemgbunli Dalayɛse nee Pɛhyeanli Belemgbunli Saelɛse mekɛ zo.

Title: DAN 7
Content:
DANEƐLE KILE KƐ YE ƐNYELƐZODEƐNWUNLƐ NE SI DE LA
(7.1—12.13)
Daneɛle nwunle nane nna wɔ ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ nu
1Daneɛle hanle ɛlalɛ na ɔnwunle ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ wɔ ɛvolɛ ko ne ala mɔɔ Babelɔn Belemgbunli Bɛlehyaza lile ebia ne la anu. Ɔhɛlɛle ɛlalɛ ne mɔɔ ɔnwunle ye la na ɔhanle ɔ muala.
2Ɔse, “Menwunle ye wɔ me ɛlalɛ ne anu wɔ nɔe ne kɛ anwoma vi aduduleɛ nee adɔleɛ, ɛbɔ nu nee nyiakɛ ɛlɛbɔ na yemaa nyevile kpole ne ɛlɛbegye. 3 Menwunle nane mgbole nna kɛ bɛvi nyevile ne anu bɛvinde, na asolo ko biala. 4 Mɔɔ lumua la zɔho awenade na ɔlɛ kɔleɛ ndɛbalɛ. Menwunle kɛ bɛdudule ɔ ndɛba ne mɔ, na bɛmanle ye zo bɛmanle ɔdwazole ɔgyinlanle ɔ gyakɛ nwiɔ azo kɛ sonla la, na bɛmanle ye sonla adwenle.
5“Nane ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nwiɔ la zɔho ezizile. Bɛzɔle ye bɛdwazole ye. Ɛnee ɔlɛ sonla nvenle mbowule nsa ɔ gye nu, na bɛzele ye kɛ, ‘Dwazo, kɔ zolɛ di nane dɔɔnwo.’
6“Ɛhye anzi memanle me nye zo na menwunle kɛ nane bieko ɛvinde, yemɔ ɔzɔho sobolɛ, ɔlɛ anloma ndɛbalɛ nna gyigyi ɔ nzi, yɛɛ ɔ ti le nna; eza bɛmanle ye tumi.
7 “Ɛhye anzi, wɔ ɛlalɛ ko ne ala anu, menwunle nane bieko. Ɛhye tɔ zolɛ nna, ɔ nwo yɛ ɛzulolɛ, yɛɛ ɔ nwo yɛ se kpole kpalɛ. Ɔlɛ mbulalɛ egyele mɔɔ ɔfa ɔtete nane nu ɔbubu ye mbowule nu, na yeava ɔ gyakɛ yeatietia mɔɔ kɛha la azo. Nane ɛhye le ngakyile bɔkɔɔ tɛla alumua ɛdeɛ ne mɔ; ɔlɛ mɛne bulu. 8 Mɔɔ melɛnea mɛne ne mɔ kpalɛ la, menwunle kɛ mɛne ekyi bie ɛlɛfinde alumua mɛne ɛdeɛ ne mɔ avinli. Ɔdudule alumua mɛne ne mɔ nsa ɔguale. Na nea, mɛne ɛhye lɛ ɛnyelɛ nee ɛnloanlɛ kɛ sonla la na ɔlɛka mgbole.
Damɛnlangoate sonla ne anwo ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ
9 “Meneanle la, menwunle kɛ bɛva arelemgbunli mbia bɛraziezie ɛkɛ. Sonla ne mɔɔ ɔvi tete ɛnee ɔwɔ ɛkɛ ne la radɛnlanle aze. Ye tɛladeɛ ne le nwohyee kɛ ezukɔtweaba, yɛɛ ɔ ti enrinli le kɛ boane enrinli. Ye ebia ne le kɛ senle mɔɔ ɛlɛsɔ gbolamgbolam la, yɛɛ ebia ne agyakɛ ehwili ne mɔ le senle. 10 Senle mɔɔ se kɛ azule la vi ebia ne anu finde. Menli apenle apenle zonlenle ye, yɛɛ menli apenle bulu mɔnwo apenle bulu gyigyi ɔ nyunlu ɛkɛ. Akee bɛdɛnlanle aze kɛ bɛdi edwɛkɛ na bɛbukebukele mbuluku ne mɔ anu.
11“Me nye gyi ɛhye anwo la, mendele mgbole mɔɔ mɛne ne ɛlɛkeha la. Mekanlea la, menwunle kɛ bɛhu nane ne bɛzɛkye ye, na bɛvuandi ye bɛdo senle nu kɛ bɛyela ye. 12Bɛangu nane ne mɔ mɔɔ hale la, bɛliele bɛ belemgbunlililɛ tumi ne bɛ sa nu na bɛmanle bɛlile kenle ko nee ebule wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo.
13 “Wɔ nɔe ne ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ ne anu, menwunle debie bie mɔɔ zɔho sonla ra la kɛ ɔlua amungu nu ɔlɛba, na ɔrale Tetenli ne anyunlu na bɛvale ye bɛhilele ye. 14 Bɛmanle ye ebialilɛ tumi, anyunlunyia, yɛɛ enililɛ, amaa aleɛabo maanle maanle mɔɔ ka aneɛ ngakyile la azonle ye. Ye belemgbunlililɛ ne ɛnlɛ awieleɛ, ɔnrɛpɛ nu ɔnrɛze ɛlɛ yɛɛ awie ɛnrɛhola ye sɛkye.
Bɛhile Ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ ne mɔ abo
15“Ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ ne mɔ yɛle me adwenleadwenle na menzulole. 16Membikyele menli mɔɔ gyigyi ɛkɛ la anu ko na membizale ye ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ abo. Yemɔti ɔhilele me ɔ bo na ɔhilehilele nu ɔhilele me. 17Ɔse, ‘Nane mgbole nna ɛhye gyi ɛkɛ maa arelemgbunli nna mɔɔ bara aleɛabo a. 18 Na Anwuma Anwumanli ne menli ne asa baha belemgbunlililɛ ne na yeayɛ bɛ ɛdeɛ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ.’
19“Ɛnee mekulo kɛ menwu deɛ mɔɔ yemɔti nane ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nna la le ngakyile bɔkɔɔ tɛla ɛhendeɛ ne mɔ la. Duzu ati a ɔ nwo yɛ ɛzulolɛ, ɔlɛ mbulalɛ egyele nee kɔbele ɛweɛlɛ mɔɔ ɔfa ɔtete nane na yeava ɔ gyakɛ yeatia mɔɔ kɛha la azo a? 20Eza mekulo kɛ mete mɛne bulu ne mɔɔ gyigyi ɔ ti zo, mɛne ne mɔ mɔɔ nsa dudule guale aze, mɛne ekyi ne mɔɔ vile na ɔlɛ ɛnyelɛ nee ɛnloanlɛ kɛ sonla, na ɔhanle mgbole la anwo edwɛkɛ. Duzu ati a yemɔ ɔlɛ tumi ɔtɛla ɛhendeɛ ne mɔ a?
21 “Mekanwu ye la ɛnee nane mɛne ɛhye nee Anwuma Anwumanli ne menli ne ɛho na yeli bɛ nwo zo konim. 22 Akee Tetenli ne rale rabuale Anwuma Anwumanli ne menli ne benle; mekɛ ne dwule la maamulɛ ne zenle lile Nyamenle menli ne asa anu.
23“Ɔhanle kɛ, ‘Nane ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nna la kile kɛ maanle mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nna la badwazo, mɔɔ bayɛ ngakyile wɔ maanle maanle mɔɔ wɔ ewiade la anu a. Ɔbali maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti anwo zo konim, na yeazɛkye bɛ. 24 Mɛne bulu ne kile kɛ arelemgbunli bulu a babu maanle ɛhye a. Nzinlii belemgbunli ko bie badwazo. Asolo belemgbunli ɛhye, na ɔbaha arelemgbunli nsa yeagua. 25 Ɔbadendɛ ɛtane ɛtane yeatietia Anwuma Anwumanli ne na yeayɛ Anwuma Anwumanli ne menli ne mɔ kpɔdekpɔde. Ɔbamia ɔ nwo kɛ ɔkakyi nyamenlezonlenlɛ mɛla ne nee nuhua ɛvoyia mekɛ ne mɔ. Yemɔ yɛɛ Nyamenle menli ne bahɔ ɔ bo ɛvolɛ nsa siane nsia a. 26Na ndɛnebuavolɛ ne baradɛnla aze, abua ndɛne alie ye belemgbunlililɛ ne ɔ sa nu, na bɛabɔ ɔ bo zo bɔkɔɔ. 27 Ewiade belemgbunlililɛ ne nee tumi kɔsɔɔti bapɛ ali Anwuma Anwumanli ne menli ne asa anu. Bɛ belemgbunlililɛ ne ɛnrɛbɔ aze ɛlɛ, yɛɛ maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti barazonle bɛ ayɛ tieyɛ amaa bɛ.’
28“Edwɛkɛ ne awieleɛ ɛne. Na mame Daneɛle, ɔmanle ɛzulolɛ hanle me, na me adwenle zɛkyele, noko menvale edwɛkɛ ne menziele me ti anu.”

Title: DAN 8
Content:
Ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ mɔɔ Daneɛle nwunle ye boane nee abɔnkye nwo la
1Mekɛ mɔɔ Belemgbunli Bɛlehyaza lile ɛvolɛ nsa wɔ ebia zo la, medame Daneɛle, menwunle ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ bieko. 2Wɔ ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ ne anu, menwunle kɛ ɛnee mewɔ Yilam maanzinli nu suakpole Susa azo, na megyi Azule Yulae anloa. 3Memanle me nye zo la, menwunle kɛ boane nyinli gyi azule ne anloa. Boane ne lɛ mɛne ndendenle nwiɔ, ko wale tɛla ko, na tendenle kpalɛ ne a nzinlii fifile a. 4Menwunle kɛ boane ne tudu kɔ adɔleɛ, sɔlɔ, yɛɛ nyiakɛ, nane biala ɛngola ɔ nyunlu gyinla, yɛɛ bie ɛnle ɛkɛ mɔɔ kola die debie fi ye tumi bo a; ɔyɛle mɔɔ ɔdaye ɔkulo la na ɔmemanle ɔ nwo zo.
5Me nye gyi ɛhye anwo melɛdwenle nwolɛ la, menwunle kɛ abɔnkye nyinli vi adɔleɛ ɛlɛba, na ɔ gyakɛ ɛnga aze; ɔlɛ mɛne ɛzulolɛ ko gyi ɔ ndo avinli. 6Ɔvale ye anwosesebɛ kɔsɔɔti nee ɛya kpole ɔdule hyee ɔrale boane nyinli ne, mɔɔ lɛ mɛne nwiɔ ne, mɔɔ menwu kɛ ɔgyi azule ne anloa la anwo zo. 7Menwunle kɛ yebikye boane nyinli ne na yeva ɛya kpole yezi ye yebubu ye mɛne nwiɔ ne. Boane nyinli ne angola abɔnkye nyinli ne anyunlu gyinla. Ɔzile ye ɔdole aze na ɔtietiale ɔ nwo zo. Nane biala angola anlie boane nyinli ne wɔ abɔnkye nyinli ne asa anu.
8Abɔnkye nyinli ne dule ɔ nloa anu kpole kpalɛ; na mɔɔ ye anwosesebɛ ne dwule aze kpole kpalɛ la, ye mɛne kpole ko ne bule na mɛne nna fifile ɔ bo zo ne. Mɛne nna ne, ko anye kɔ ɛbɔ nu, ko kɔ nyiakɛ, ko kɔ aduduleɛ, yɛɛ ko kɔ adɔleɛ. 9Mɛne ekyi bie vi mɛne ɛhye mɔ ko anu fifile; ɔfifile ɔyɛle kpole kpalɛ na ɔ nye kɔne nyiakɛ, aduduleɛ, yɛɛ anyunlunyia azɛlɛ ne anwo. 10 Ɔnyinle tendenle kpalɛ ɔdwule anwumaneamra anu, na ɔhanle nwɔlɔra ne mɔ bie ɔguale aze ɔtietiale bɛ nwo zo. 11Ɔmemanle ɔ nwo zo wɔ anwuma ɛlɔnema Safohyenle ne bɔbɔ anyunlu. Ɔliele ye dahudahu ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ ne ɔ sa nu, na ɔzɛkyele ye ɛleka nwuanzanwuanza ne. 12Kɛ menli kɛbɔ tenlene azu ɛkɛ ne la, bɛanyɛ ye zɔhane na bɛyɛle ɛtane. Bɛgyakyile nɔhalɛ ɛzonlenlɛ ne bɛdole aze na nane ne lile konim wɔ debie biala anu.
13Nzinlii mendele kɛ Nyamenle soanvolɛ ko ɛlɛtendɛ na ko ɛlɛbiza ye kɛ, “Kenlenzu, mekɛ ne boni yɛɛ dahuu ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ ne, mɛladonlɛ mɔɔ maa debie biala yɛ mgbane, yɛɛ ɛleka nwuanzanwuanza ne nee nuhua menli ne anwo zo ɛtietialɛ ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ ne kɛgua a?”
14Ɔbuale ye kɛ, “Ɔbava kenle kɔkɔlɛ apenle ko ɛya ko abulanlu na ɛleka nwuanzanwuanza ne azia agyinla ye gyinlabelɛ dɛba ne.”
Nyamenle soanvolɛ Geebeleɛle kile ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ ne abo
15Mɔɔ ɛnee medame Daneɛle melɛdwenle kɛ ɔkɛyɛ na meade ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ ne abo la, mɔɔ arɛlevilɛ nu menwunle ye la a le kɛ, debie bie mɔɔ le kɛ sonla la gyi me nyunlu ɛkɛ. 16 Na mendele ɛnelɛ bie wɔ Azule Yuleeyae ne anloa, ɔse, “Geebeleɛle, kile nrenya ɛhye ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ ne abo.” 17Yemɔti Geebeleɛle ragyinlanle me nwo ɛkɛ; ɔrale la me ahonle dule na membutule mutule nu.
Na ɔzele me kɛ, “Sonla ra, te ɔ bo kɛ ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ ne kile kɛ ewiade bazi ara awieleɛ la.” 18Mɔɔ mebutu ɔ nyunlu ɛkɛ ne mutule nu na ɔlɛtendɛ yeahile me la, meannwu ɛleka mɔɔ mengale ye bieko a. Na ɔzɔle me ɔdwazole me ɔgyinlanle. 19Ɔzele me kɛ, “Mekile wɔ ninyɛne mɔɔ basisi awieleɛ mekɛ ne, kɛmɔ ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ ne kile la.
20“Boane ne mɔɔ ɛnwunle ye kɛ ɔlɛ mɛne nwiɔ ne la gyi ɛkɛ maa Midia nee Pɛhyea arelemgbunli ne mɔ. 21Abɔnkye nyinli ne gyi ɛkɛ maa Gilisi belemgbunli ne, yɛɛ mɛne totohyia ne mɔɔ gyi ɔ ndo avinli la kile maanle ne belemgbunli ne mɔɔ lumua la. 22Mɛne nna ne mɔɔ fifile ko ne mɔɔ dule la abo zo ne la kile kɛ arelemgbunli maanle nna badwazo maanle ko ne ala anu na bɛ nwo ɛnrɛyɛ se kɛ alumua maanle ne la.
23“Saa arelemgbunli ɛhye mɔ di bɛ ebia ne toonwo na bɛ belemgbunlililɛ ne ɛlɛba awieleɛ, mɔɔ mɛladonlɛma kɔpo ne ɛwie yi la, belemgbunli bie badwazo, na yemɔ, ɔnzulo ɛhwee, yɛɛ ɔte agyiba biala abo. 24Ɔbayɛ belemgbunli mɔɔ ye tumi le kpole yɛɛ ɔbazɛkye ninyɛne dɔɔnwo. Ye debie biala bayɛ boɛ amaa ye, yɛɛ ɔbazɛkye menli mgbole nee Nyamenle menli ne. 25Kɛmɔ ɔ nwo yɛ ɛvɛlɛ la ati, ɔbamaa adalɛ alie ebia wɔ ye mekɛ zo. Ɔ ti akunlu bayɛ ye fɛ yeamaa yeamemaa ɔ nwo zo. Ɔnrɛbɔ menli kɔkɔ na yeava konle yeadoa bɛ. Ɔbamia ɔ nwo bɔbɔ yeava konle yeadoa arelemgbunli Belemgbunli ne. Noko awie ɛnrɛva ɔ sa ɛnrɛha ye bɔbɔ na yeakpo aze. 26Aledwolɛ nee alehyenlɛ ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ ɛhye mɔɔ wɔnwu ye la bayɛ zɔhane, noko mmabɔ ye nolo kɛkala na mekɛ tɛbɔ nu kpalɛ.”
27Na medame Daneɛle, debie dɔle me nwo zo, ɔyɛle me anwondolɛ mekɛ dɔɔnwo. Nzinlii mendele kpɔkɛ na mendwazole mengɔle me gyima zo wɔ belemgbunli sua nu. Na ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ ne manle me nwo bubule me, meande ɔ bo.

Title: DAN 9
Content:
Daneɛle sɛlɛ amaa ye menli ne
1Midianli Dalayɛse, Atazɛzɛse ara nrenya ne lile belemgbunli wɔ Babelonia. 2 Ɔlile ebia ne la ye ɛvolɛ ne mɔɔ lumua la ala anu, medame Daneɛle mɔɔ ɛnee melɛneɛnlea mbuluku nwuanzanwuanza ne mɔ anu na melɛdwenledwenle mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛlua Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ Gyɛlɛmaya anwo zo ɛha ɛdo ɛkɛ ne la, mendele ɔ bo kɛ Gyɛlusalɛm babɔ toonwo ɛvolɛ abulasuu. 3Mengyele ɛhɔne, mengedale ɛrele, membɔle nzonle na membodole menzɛlɛle Awulae Nyamenle. 4Menzɛlɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma me Nyamenle ne na menganle me nee me menli ne ɛtane ne mɔ mendole gua.
Mese: “O Awulae, Nyamenle Bedevinli anwo ɛzulolɛ mɔɔ di wɔ ngyekyeleɛ zo na ɛkile wɔ ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne wɔ menli mɔɔ kulo wɔ, na bɛdi wɔ mɛla nee wɔ ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔ azo la anwo zo a, 5yɛyɛ ɛtane yɛtia wɔ, yɛyɛ mɔɔ bɛnyɛ la. Yɛyɛ amumuyɛ, yɛde atua na yɛhakyi yɛ nzi yɛzi wɔ mɛla ne nee wɔ ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔ. 6Yɛandie wɔ sonvolɛ kpɔmanvolɛma ne mɔ ane. Bɛluale wɔ duma nu bɛbɔle edwɛkɛ ne nolo bɛhilele yɛ arelemgbunli, yɛ maanlebuvolɛma, yɛ ze mɔ, yɛɛ maanlema kɔsɔɔti. 7Wɔmɔ, O Awulae, dahuu ɛyɛ mɔɔ le tenlene la, na yɛmɛ, ɛnɛ nee ɛnɛ ala, yɛtɛgua yɛ nyunlu aze, yɛdayɛ mɔɔ yɛwɔ Dwuda la o, yɛdayɛ mɔɔ yɛwɔ Gyɛlusalɛm la o, bɛnye bie. Zɔhane ala yɛɛ Yizilayɛma kɔsɔɔti, bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ sua nu nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ ɔlua bɛ nyɛleɛ ɛtane mɔɔ bɛyɛ bɛtia wɔ la ati wɔkponde bɛ maanle maanle zo la de a. 8O Awulae, yɛdayɛ, yɛ arelemgbunli, yɛ maanlebuvolɛma, yɛɛ yɛ ze mɔ ɛbɔ anyiemgba, ɔboalekɛ yɛyɛ ɛtane yɛtia wɔ. 9O Awulae yɛ Nyamenle, yɛvo wɔ, yɛde ɛ nwo atua, noko wɔmɔ ala a ɛse anwunvɔne na ɛfa ɛtane ɛkyɛ a. 10Yɛanli wɔ mɛla ne mɔ mɔɔ ɛluale wɔ sonvolɛma, Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma anwo zo ɛvale ɛmanle yɛ la azo. 11Yizilayɛma kɔsɔɔti ɛdo wɔ mɛla ne, bɛhakyi bɛ nzi bɛzi wɔ, na bɛkpo kɛ bɛnrɛdie ɛ ne. Ɔlua zolɛ munzule ne nee ndane ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛhɛlɛ wɔ wɔ sonvolɛ Mosisi Mɛla ne anu la ɛha yɛ, ɔboalekɛ yɛyɛ ɛtane yɛtia wɔ. 12Ninyɛne mɔɔ ɛzele kɛ ɛbava wɔayɛ yɛ nee yɛ mgbanyima mɔɔ sie yɛ la ɛyɛ zɔhane ɛmaa munzule mɔɔ ɛdo yɛ la ɛyɛ totohyia, ɔluakɛ mɔɔ ɛzi Gyɛlusalɛmma anwo zo la, bie ɛtɛsile ewiade ye anu ɛleka biala. 13Kɛmɔ bɛhɛlɛ ye wɔ Mosisi Mɛla buluku ne anu la, munzule ɛhye mɔ amuala ɛra yɛ nwo zo, noko yɛtɛkpale Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛ Nyamenle ne kyɛlɛ, yɛtɛgyakyile ɛtane ɛyɛlɛ, yɛɛ yɛtɛkpondɛle wɔ nɔhalɛ adenle ne. 14Zɔhane ati, Ɛdɛnkɛma, wɔboɔboa wɔmaa munzule ne ɛdo yɛ, ɔluakɛ wɔmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛ Nyamenle, ɛyɛ mɔɔ le tenlene la, na yɛmɛ, yɛndie ɛ ne.
15“O Awulae yɛ Nyamenle, mɔɔ ɛvale wɔ tumi kpole ne ɛyele wɔ menli ne ɛvile Yigyibiti, na wɔlie duma wɔmaa ɛ nwo toonwo a yeradwu ɛnɛ la, yɛyɛ ɛtane, O Awulae, yɛyɛ amumuyɛ mɔɔ bɛnyɛ a. 16Dua wɔ tenlene adenle ne azo ye wɔ ɛya ne wɔ suakpole Gyɛlusalɛm, wɔ boka nwuanzanwuanza ne azo, ɔluakɛ yɛ ɛtane ne nee yɛ ze mɔ amumuyɛ ne mɔ ati, Gyɛlusalɛm nee wɔ menli ne ɛnɛ ɛyɛ ɛfenle mɔɔ la akɔlɛ nee anloma nloa a. 17Yemɔti, O yɛ Nyamenle, tie wɔ sonvolɛ, me nzɛlɛlɛ nee me modolɛ, na ɔlua wɔ duma ne ati, kakyi ɛ nye wɔ wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ye mɔɔ bɛzɛkye ye la anwo. 18O me Nyamenle, gyele ɛ nzo tie yɛ. To ɛ nye nea mgbane mɔɔ yɛyɛ, nee suakpole ye mɔɔ bɛfa wɔ duma bɛfɛlɛ ye la, ɔluakɛ tɛ yɛ tenleneyɛlɛ ti yɛɛ yɛlɛbodo yɛazɛlɛ wɔ a, na wɔ anwunvɔnezelɛ kpole ne ati ɔ. 19O Awulae, tie yɛ; O Awulae fa yɛ ɛtane kyɛ yɛ; O Awulae, tie yɛ na keha ɛ nwo. Wɔ duma ne ati, O me Nyamenle, mmasi aze, ɔboalekɛ bɛfa wɔ duma a bɛfɛlɛ wɔ suakpole ne nee wɔ menli ne a.”
Geebeleɛle kile Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ ne abo
20Mekɛ mɔɔ megua zolɛ melɛka me ɛtane nee Yizilayɛma kɔsɔɔti ɛtane, na melɛbodo meazɛlɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma me Nyamenle ne wɔ me Nyamenle ne boka nwuanzanwuanza ne ati la, 21 Geebeleɛle mɔɔ alumua ne menwunle ye wɔ me ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ ne anu la, rale me nwo ɛkɛ ne ndɛndɛ wɔ nɔsolɛ nu azubɔlɛ mekɛ ne. 22Na ɔzele me kɛ, “O Daneɛle, mera kɛ mebɛlɛ wɔ nrɛlɛbɛ nee ndelebɛbo. 23Ɛbɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɛyɛ wɔ modolɛ nzɛlɛlɛ ne ala la yɛɛ Nyamenle diele wɔ a, na mera kɛ mebaha meahile wɔ, ɔluakɛ ɔkulo wɔ kpole. Yemɔti tie na te wɔ ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ ne abo.
24“Ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ ne kile kɛ wɔ menli Yizilayɛma bava ɛvolɛ ɛya nna abulahɔnla (ɛvolɛ abulasuu fane nsuu) a alie bɛ nwo nee bɛ suakpole ne wɔ ɛtane nee munzule nu, bɛayɛ bɛ ɛtane nwo mgbɔdalɛ nzɛlɛlɛ na bɛali pɛlepɛle dahuu a, amaa ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ ne nee Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ ne ali munli, na bɛadu Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne bɛamaa Nyamenle bieko. 25Yɛ edwɛkɛ ɛhye nzonlɛ na nyia nwolɛ ndelebɛbo kɛ ɔvi mekɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛha Gyɛlusalɛm ɛkyekyelɛ bieko anwo edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ kɔdwu sonla ne, belemgbunli bie, mɔɔ bɛkpa nu bɛye ye na bɛkpokpa ye nwole la ɛralɛ mekɛ zo la, bayɛ ɛvolɛ nsuu fane nsuu. Bɛbava ɛvolɛ nsuu fane abulasia nee nwiɔ a bɛakyekye Gyɛlusalɛm fofolɛ, bɛadudu ye gua na bɛasisi ye aranemgbole ne mɔ a, na mekɛ ɛhye bayɛ amaneɛnwunlɛ mekɛ. 26Mekɛ zɔhane anzi bɛbahu sonla ne mɔɔ bɛkpokpa ye nwole la atisesebɛ nu. Na belemgbunli holɛ ko ne mɔɔ bara la ɛlɔnema ne bazɛkye suakpole ne nee ɛleka nwuanzanwuanza ne. Ye awieleɛ bara kɛ azuyilɛ na nzinlii yeawie konle. Ninyɛne dɔɔnwo bazɛkye, kɛmɔ Nyamenle ɛhyehyɛ la. 27 Ɔ nee menli dɔɔnwo bayɛ ngyekyeleɛ ketekete ɛvolɛ nsuu, na ɛvolɛ nsuu ne foa ko, ɔbadua azubɔlɛ nee azubɔdeɛ ɛvalɛ. Bɛbava ‘Munzudeɛ ne mɔɔ bɔ Maanle’ la bɛazie Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne ɛleka mɔɔ wɔ anwuma kpalɛ kpalɛ la. Ɔbawoa ɛkɛ yeahɔdwu mekɛ mɔɔ ahenle mɔɔ vale ziele ɛkɛ ne la anye kɛpe ɔ bo, kɛmɔ Nyamenle ɛhyehyɛ ɛzie ɛkɛ ɛmaa ye la.”

Title: DAN 10
Content:
Daneɛle ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ wɔ Taegelese Azule ne anloa
1(Pɛhyea Maanle Maanle Belemgbunli Saelɛse lile ɛvolɛ nsa wɔ ebia zo la, Daneɛle mɔɔ eza bɛfɛlɛ ye Bɛletihyazaa la asa hanle Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ. Nrɛlaleɛ ne le nɔhalɛ na ɔ bo ɛdelɛ ɛnla aze. Na bɛluale ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ zo bɛhilele ye ɔ bo, na ɔdele ɔ bo.)
2Mekɛ zɔhane anu ɛnee medame, Daneɛle, melɛdi nyane dapɛne nsa. 3Aleɛ kpalɛ biala angɔ me kunlu. Meanli nane yɛɛ meanno nwanye. Meamkpokpa toonwo dapɛne nsa ne dwule.
4Siane ne mɔɔ lumua la, ye kenle abulanwiɔ nee nna ne azo, ɛnee megyi Azule kpole Taegelese ne anloa. 5 Memanle me nye zo, na menwunle nrenya bie mɔɔ wula lenen tɛladeɛ na ɔhye Yufaze ezukoa nvutuke akyeso la. 6Ye sonlabaka ne ta kɛ bɛlele ezukoa bolɛ, yɛɛ ɔ nyunlu maanle ne ta kɛ ɛsɛlɛmanye, ɔ nye sɔ kɛ tɛkɛ, yɛɛ ɔ sa nee ɔ gyakɛ anwo ta kɛ kɔbele mɔɔ bɛdu nu la; ɔ ne dielie kɛ menli ɛwolaa bie ane la.
7Medame Daneɛle, me ngome ala a menwunle ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ ne a. Menli mɔɔ nee me wɔ ɛkɛ ne la annwu ɛhwee. Ɛzulolɛ kpole bie hanle bɛ manle bɛnriandile bɛhɔveale. 8Yemɔti ɔhale me ngomekye ala mɔɔ menwunle ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ ne la. Me nwo mɔra dule; ɛkɛ ne ala me nyunlu yɛle ɛzulolɛ bie mɔɔ awie mɔɔ ze me la nwunle me a anrɛɛ ɔnrɛnwu me sonla holɛ, na me nwo bɛlɛle me. 9Akee mendele ɔ ne, na mendɔle aze mutule nu na me nye zo bulule me. 10Na ɛsalɛ bie zɔle me manle membutule me sa nee me gyakɛ abonyi zo, na ɛnee me nwo tɛwozo me.
11Na ɔzele me kɛ, “O Daneɛle mɔɔ Nyamenle kulo wɔ a, dwazo gyinla ɛ gyakɛ anu na tie mɔɔ melɛka meahile wɔ la, ɔboalekɛ bɛzoa me ɛ nwo ɛke.” Mɔɔ ɔ nloa wɔ zolɛ ɔlɛka edwɛkɛ ɛhye yeahile me la, mendwazole mengyinlanle; ɛnee me nwo tɛwozo me.
12Ɔhanle ɔhilele me kɛ “Daneɛle, mmasulo, ɔluakɛ ɔvi kenle ko ne mɔɔ ɛnyianle adwenle kɛ ɛbɛlɛ ɛ nwo aze wɔamaa Nyamenle, wɔakpondɛ ndelebɛbo la yɛɛ wɔ ɛbizalɛdeɛ ne dwule Nyamenle anyunlu a, na mɔɔ wɔbiza la ati yɛɛ mera a. 13 Pɛhyea maanle ne awozinli nu soanvolɛ ne nee me dwudwule toonwo kenle abulanwiɔ nee ko. Nzinlii Nyamenle soanvolɛ mgbanyima ne mɔ ko mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Maekeɛle la raboale me, yemɔti mengyakyile ye ɛkɛ kɛ ɔ nee Pɛhyea maanle ne awozinli nu soanvolɛ ne ɛgyinla nwolɛ, 14yɛɛ mera kɛ mebaha mɔɔ kenle bie bazi wɔ menli ne anwo zo la meahile wɔ a. Ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ ɛhye kile wɔ mɔɔ kenle bie basisi la.”
15Ɔhanle edwɛkɛ ɛhye ɔhilele me la, membutule me nye aze, na mendɔle mumule. 16Na Nyamenle soanvolɛ bie mɔɔ le kɛ sonla la vale ɔ sa hanle me nloa na membukele me nloa mendendɛle. Menganle mengilele ahenle ne mɔɔ gyi me nyunlu ɛkɛ ne la kɛ, “Me menle, ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ ɛhye ɛmaa me nwo amuala ɛlɛfofo me, menlɛ anwosesebɛ biala. 17Kɛ menwɔzi menwɔyɛ na wɔ akɛlɛ, me nee me menle adendɛ ɛ? Menlɛ anwosesebɛ yɛɛ me ɛnwomenle ɛwie.”
18Eza Nyamenle soanvolɛ ne mɔɔ le kɛ sonla la vale ɔ sa hanle me, na me nwo gyinlanle me. 19Ɔzele me kɛ, “Ayi, Nyamenle kulo wɔ kpole, mmasulo. Anzonudwolɛ ɛha wɔ. Gyinla ɛ nwo na si ahonle.”
Ɔhanle zɔhane la, akee menyianle anwosesebɛ na menganle kɛ, “Me menle, tendɛ, na kɛkala, wɔmaa menyia anwosesebɛ.”
20-21Ɔbizale me kɛ, “Asoo ɛze deɛ mɔɔ yemɔti mera ɛ nwo ɛke la? Mera mebaha edwɛkɛ mɔɔ bɛhɛlɛ ye wɔ Nɔhalɛ Buluku ne anu la meahile wɔ. Kɛkala ɔwɔ kɛ mesia mekɔ me nee Pɛhyea maanle ne awozinli nu soanvolɛ ne kɔko. Ɛhye anzi Gilisi awozinli nu soanvolɛ ne ɔdaye ɔbadwazo me nwo zo. Menlɛ boavolɛ biala kɛ Yizilayɛ Nyamenle soanvolɛ Maekeɛle ala.

Title: DAN 11
Content:
1“Mɔɔ Midianli Dalayɛse lile ebia ne la, ɛvolɛ ne ala anu, mengyinlanle ɔ nzi memanle ye anwosesebɛ. 2Na kɛkala meka nɔhalɛ ne meahile wɔ.”
Yigyibiti nee Selea maanle ne mɔ
Nyamenle soanvolɛ ne hanle kɛ, “Arelemgbunli nsa bieko badwazo azie Pɛhyea maanle ne. Ko baradɔ zolɛ nna na yemɔ, ɔbanyia ezukoa yeadɛla alumua ɛdeɛ nsa ne. Kɛmɔ ɔbayɛ kpole, yeayɛ sukoavolɛ yeadɛla ɛhendeɛ ne mɔ la ati ɔbaheha ɔ nwo yeatia Gilisi maanle ne.
3“Nzinlii belemgbunli kpole bie ɔdaye ɔbara; ɔbava tumi kpole a yeazie maanle ne a, na yeayɛ debie biala mɔɔ ɔdaye ɔkulo la. 4Mekɛ mɔɔ ye tumi ne kɛyɛ kpole kpalɛ la akee ye belemgbunlililɛ ne bagua na ye maanle ne anu ahyɛ nna. Awie mɔ gyɛne mɔɔ ɛmbikye ebia ne fee la a banlea maanzinli ne mɔ azo a, yɛɛ maanle ɛbulɛ ne ɛnrɛdwu ye ɛdeɛ ne, ɔboalekɛ maanle ne anu bagyigya.
5“Akee Yigyibiti belemgbunli ne banyia tumi, noko ye safohyenlema ne mɔ ko banyia tumi adɛla ye, yɛɛ ye maanle ne bayɛ maanle kpole. 6Mekɛ bahɔ bie la Yigyibiti nee Selea arelemgbunli bayɛ konle nu agɔnwolɛyɛlɛ ngyehyɛlɛ na yeava ɔ ra raalɛ yeamaa Selea belemgbunli ne agya, amaa anzonudwolɛ arala bɛ avinli. Noko ɛhye ɛnrɛhyɛ; belemgbunli ne nee ɔ mra ne mɔ ɛnrɛli agyinla. Bɛbahu raalɛ ne, ye sonvolɛma, ɔ ra ne, yɛɛ ɔ hu. 7Ɔnrɛhyɛ biala raalɛ ne anwo sonla barali ebia ne. Ɔbahɔ Selea belemgbunli ne ɛlɔnema ne anwo zo na yeabubu bɛ aranemgbole ne, yeadua bɛ kakɛ yeali bɛ nwo zo konim. 8Ɔbazoa bɛ awozonle nee bɛ ananze ne mɔ yɛɛ ninyɛne mɔɔ bɛva ezukoa nvutuke nee dwɛtɛ fufule bɛyɛ la yeazia yeahɔ Yigyibiti. Akee mekɛ dɔɔnwo baze mɔɔ ɔnrɛva konle ɔnrɛdoa Selea belemgbunli bieko a. 9Nzinlii Selea belemgbunli bara Yigyibiti belemgbunli anwo zo, noko ɔnrɛnyia gyinlagyakɛ, ɔbazia yeahɔ ye maanle nu.
10“Selea belemgbunli ne amra baboɔboa ɛlɔnema dɔɔnwo anloa kɛ bɛ nee bɛ kɔ konle. Ɛlɔnema ne anu ekpunli ko baho toonwo ahɔdwu Yigyibiti belemgbunli ne aranemgbole ne anwo. 11Ɛhye bamaa ɛya ahu Yigyibiti belemgbunli ne na yeavinde yearadoa Selea belemgbunli ne ɔ nee ye bɛabɔ ye zo na yeali Selea belemgbunli ne ɛlɔnema pemgbenleamgbe ne anwo zo konim. 12Ɔbali fɛlɛko kɛ yeli Selea ɛlɔnema pemgbenleamgbe ne anwo zo konim na yehu menli apenle apenle bulu bulu a, noko ye konimlilɛ ne ɛnrɛhyɛ.
13“Selea belemgbunli ne bazia ahɔboɔboa ɛlɔnema dɔɔnwo kpalɛ mɔɔ tɛla alumua ɛdeɛ ne la anloa, na mekɛ bie dwu a yeava bɛ nee konle ninyɛne yeara. 14Mekɛ zɔhane mɔ anu menli dɔɔnwo badwazo atia Yigyibiti belemgbunli ne, na ɔlua ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ mɔɔ ɛdawɔ Daneɛle wɔ maanlema bie mɔ mɔɔ di mgbonde la banwu ye la ati, bɛbamia bɛ nwo kɛ bɛkile bɛ mrenya, noko bɛnrɛhola gyinla. 15Akee Selea belemgbunli ne barateta suakpole ne mɔɔ bɛbɔ nwolɛ bane la na yeava sua ne. Yigyibiti ɛlɔnema bagua adu aze; yɛɛ ye menli mɔɔ ze konle nye zo kpalɛ bɔbɔ la ɛnrɛhola gyinla, ɔluakɛ bɛnrɛnyia anwosesebɛ. 16Selea belemgbunli ne bayɛ mɔɔ ɔdaye ɔkulo la. Awie biala ɛnrɛhola ɔ nyunlu gyinla. Ɔbava azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ bɛva bɛbɔ ɛwɔkɛ la kpokpoti yeayɛ ye ɛdeɛ.
17“Selea belemgbunli ne babɔ adwenle ava ye ɛlɔnema ne kɔsɔɔti apɛ adenle ahɔ ye kpɔvolɛ ne maanle nu na ɔ nee ye ayɛ anzonudwolɛ ngyehyɛlɛ na bɛali zolɛ. Ɔbava ɔ ra raalɛ yeamaa ye kpɔvolɛ ne agya, amaa yeanyia adenle yeazɛkye ye kpɔvolɛ ne maanle ne, noko ye adwenle ngyehyɛlɛ ne ɛnrɛli munli. 18Nzinlii ɔbaluolua ɛnweanloa yeateta maanle maanle ɔ nee bɛ aho yeavo bie mɔ dɔɔnwo anwo zo. Na safohyenlema kpanyinli bie vi maanle gyɛne nu baraha ye aze. Nɔhalɛ, ɔbamaa Selea belemgbunli ne ninyɛmunli ne mɔ abu azia ye. 19Belemgbunli ne bazia ahɔ ye aranemgbole ne anu wɔ ɔdaye ye maanle nu, noko bɛbarali ɔ nwo zo konim wɔ ɛkɛ na ɔnrɛhola ɔ nwo zo ma bieko.
20“Belemgbunli ko noko badwazo ɔ nzi mɔɔ batete adwule wɔ maanle ne anu amuala a, noko ɔnrɛhyɛ biala na bɛahu ye. Bɛnrɛhu ye konle nu anzɛɛ ɛyavalɛ nu.”
Selea belemgbunli munzuvolɛ ne
21Nyamenle soanvolɛ ne hɔle zolɛ hilele nuhua kɛ, “Belemgbunli bieko mɔɔ tɛ awie a bazɔ ɔ sa ava ye azie ebia zo la bavinde azie Selea maanle ne; ɔnrɛhakye bɛ ɔnrɛzie, ɔbalua mɛlɛbɛla adenle zo a yeazie ɔ nwo belemgbunli a. 22Ɛlɔne biala ɛnrɛhola ɔ nyunlu gyinla, yɛɛ ɔnrɛdo Nyamenle Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli ne bɔbɔ sɛbe. 23Maanle mɔɔ ɔbazie la le ekyi bie, noko ɔbava mɛlɛbɛla adenle zo ɔ nee maanle maanle ayɛ ngyehyɛlɛ yeahakyi ɔ nwo belemgbunli kpole. 24Ɔbadwazo maanle maanle mɔɔ gyigyi boɛ la anwo zo arɛlevilɛ nu yeakpokpo bɛ, na yeayɛ ninyɛne mɔɔ kenle bie maanle nu ɔ ze mɔ nee ɔ nlenya mɔ anyɛ bie fee la, na ɔ nee ɔ sa zo ahyɛ ninyɛne mɔɔ bɛwua la bɛali. Ɔbabɔ adwenle yeabɔ ɔ nwo bane mɔɔ kpɔvolɛ ɛngola ɛmbikye ye la, noko ɔnrɛli agyinla.
25“Ɔbazi ahonle yeava ɛlɔne kpole yeahɔteta Yigyibiti belemgbunli ne. Yigyibiti belemgbunli ne ɔdaye ɔbava ɛlɔnema mɔɔ ze konle nye zo la dɔɔnwo nee ye ahɔbɔ ye zo, na ɔnrɛhola Selea belemgbunli ne anyunlu gyinla, ɔluakɛ Selea belemgbunli ne babɛlɛbɛla ye yeawie ye yɛ. 26Menli bɔbɔ mɔɔ nee ye di, nee ye no la a bado ye bie nu a. Bɛbahu ye ɛlɔnema ne anu dɔɔnwo na mɔɔ kɛha la agua ɛbɔ nu. 27Arelemgbunli nwiɔ ne badɛnla ɛkponle ko anwo ali adwelie, noko adalɛ ɔ, biala babɔ ye kpɔkɛ ɔ ti anu, yemɔti mɔɔ bɛbaha la biala bayɛ bɛ gye zo amanie, ɔluakɛ mekɛ ne mɔɔ bɛhyehyɛ bɛdo ɛkɛ la ɛtɛdwule. 28Selea belemgbunli ne bava ninyɛne dɔɔnwo ne mɔɔ ɔnyianle bɛ konle nu la azia ahɔ sua nu, yɛɛ ɔbava adwenle kɛ ɔsɛkye Nyamenle menli ne nyamenlezonlenlɛ ne. Ɔbayɛ mɔɔ ɔdaye ɔkulo la na yeazia yeahɔ ye maanle nu.
29“Saa mekɛ ne dwu a ɔbadwazo Yigyibiti anwo zo bieko, na mekɛ ɛhye ɛnrɛyɛ kɛ alumua mekɛ ɛdeɛ ne la. 30Ɔboalekɛ Wulomuma bava meli aradoa ye bɛ nee ye aho. Ye ahonle badu na yeagua ye ɔ nzi.
“Ɔbava ɛya kpole yeazia ɔ nzi yeara Nyamenle menli ne nyamenlezonlenlɛ ne ɛzɛkyelɛ. Ɔsia ɔba a, ɔbali menli mɔɔ ɛgyakyi Nyamenle ɛzonlenlɛ la folɛdulɛ zo. 31 Ye ɛlɔnema ne bie mɔ bagua Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anwo evinli, bɛazɛkye aranemgbole ne, na bɛadua dahuu azubɔlɛ nee ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ ɛvalɛ. Akee bɛbava ‘Munzudeɛ ne mɔɔ bɔ maanle’ la bɛazie Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu. 32Belemgbunli ne babɛlɛbɛla bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛgyakyi Nyamenle ɛzonlenlɛ la yeamaa bɛali ɔ nzi, na bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛze bɛ Nyamenle ne la bagyinla bɛ gyakɛ anu na bɛaheha bɛ nwo. 33Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛze nrɛlɛbɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ Nyamenle menli ne anu la bayɛ toonwo bɛamaa menli dɔɔnwo anyia ndelebɛbo, noko bie mɔ badɔ dadeɛ nloa, bɛbayela bie mɔ, bɛbahye bie mɔ nuokɛ, bɛawua bie mɔ anwo ninyɛne mekɛ dɔɔnwo anu. 34Saa Nyamenle menli ne kpo aze a, moalɛ ekyi bie a bɛbanyia ye a. Menli dɔɔnwo bava mɛlɛbɛla araboka bɛ. 35Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛze nrɛlɛbɛ la bie mɔ badu koti, amaa bɛahakyi bɛ subane nee bɛ nyɛleɛ na bɛ nwo ade saanwu ahɔkpula kɛ mekɛ ne kɛdwu la, ɔluakɛ mekɛ ne mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛhyehyɛ ɛdo ɛkɛ ne la ɛtɛdwule.
36 “Selea belemgbunli ne bayɛ debie biala mɔɔ ɔdaye ɔkulo la; ɔbamemaa ɔ nwo zo yeayɛ ɔ nwo kpole yeadɛla nyamenle biala, na yeaheha azibɛnwo edwɛkɛ yeatia nyamenle ne mɔ Nyamenle ne. Ɔbayɛ ɛhye yeahɔdwu mekɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle kɛhwe ɔ nzo la, ɔluakɛ ɔwɔ kɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛhyehyɛ ɛdo ɛkɛ la yɛ zɔhane. 37Belemgbunli ne bakpo nyamenle ne mɔ mɔɔ ɔ nlenya mɔ zonlenle la, yɛɛ nyamenle ne mɔɔ mraalɛ anye die nwolɛ la. Ɔbakpo nyamenle biala, ɔluakɛ ɔbamemaa ɔ nwo zo yeadɛla nyamenle kɔsɔɔti. 38Ɔbazonle aranemgbole nyamenle ɛdeɛ ne yeagyakyi ɛhye mɔ. Ɔbazonle nyamenle mɔɔ ɔ nlenya mɔ ɛnze ye la; ɔbava ezukoa nvutuke nee dwɛtɛ fufule, awolɛ mɔɔ sonle bolɛ nee ahyɛlɛ ninyɛne mɔɔ bɛ awolɛ yɛ se la yeazonle ye. 39Zɔhane ala a ɔbava yeayɛ maanle zo nyamenle mɔɔ kɛzɔ ɔ nye la wɔ aranemgbole ne mɔ anu a. Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛlie ye bɛkɛdo nu kɛ ɔle bɛ belemgbunli la, ɔbali bɛ eni kpole kpalɛ, ɔbamaa bɛ gyinlabelɛ na yeamaa bɛ azɛlɛ kɛ bɛ ahyɛlɛdeɛ ɔ.
40“Ɔka ekyii na mekɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛhile la adwu a, Yigyibiti belemgbunli ne bava konle ahɔdoa Selea belemgbunli ne. Selea belemgbunli ne bava ye anwosesebɛ muala, ye konle ehwili ne mɔ, ye mgbɔnwɔ nee ye meli dɔɔnwo ne ara ɔ nwo zo kɛ ahumuakyima. Ɔbahɔ maanle dɔɔnwo anwo zo na yeali bɛ nwo zo konim. 41Ɔbahɔvo azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛva ɛbɔ ɛwɔkɛ la azo. Menli apenle apenle badɔ, noko bɛbalie Yidɔmma nee Mowabema nee Amɔn maanle mumua ne bɛavi ɔ sa nu. 42Ɔbaho yeava maanle dɔɔnwo, na Yigyibiti ɛnrɛvi nu. 43Yigyibiti anwonyia kpokpoti: ezukoa nvutuke, dwɛtɛ fufule, yɛɛ debie biala mɔɔ sonle bolɛ la bapɛ ali ye ɛkɛ. Ɔbaho yeava Lebea nee Sudan. 44Noko nrɛlaleɛ mɔɔ ɔbade yeavi aduduleɛ nee sɔlɔ la bamaa ye ahonle adu na yeava ɛya kpole yeahɔ bɛ nwo zo yeahɔzɛkye menli dɔɔnwo. 45Ɔbazi ye arelemgbunli ndanlɛ azua ne mɔ wɔ nyevile ne nee boka ne mɔɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne gyi zolɛ la avinli, noko ɔbawu; ɔnrɛnyia awie ɛnrɛboa ye.”

Title: DAN 12
Content:
Awieleɛ mekɛ ne
1 Nyamenle soanvolɛ ne mɔɔ wula Lenen tɛladeɛ ne la hanle kɛ, “Mekɛ zɔhane Nyamenle soanvolɛ Maekeɛle mɔɔ nea wɔ menli ne mɔ anwo zo la badwazo. Mekɛ zɔhane amaneɛnwunlɛ mɔɔ bie ɛtɛsile ɛlɛ la basisi, noko bɛbalie wɔ menli ne mɔ anu biala mɔɔ bɛkɛnwu kɛ bɛhɛlɛ ye duma wɔ Nyamenle buluku ne anu la ngoane. 2 Menli mɔɔ ɛwu la anu dɔɔnwo badwazo ara ngoane nu; bie mɔ banyia ngoane mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ, bie mɔ dɔɔnwo noko babɔ anyiemgba mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ. 3Nrɛlɛbɛvolɛma mɔɔ wɔ nu la bada kɛ sɛnzɛne, yɛɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛhilehile menli kpalɛyɛlɛ adenle la bada kɛ nwɔlɔra la wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ.
4 “Na wɔmɔ, Daneɛle, to buluku ne anu na sɔ ɔ nloa, yɛɛ mɔɔ wɔde la maa ɔha ɛ ti anu, kɔkpula awieleɛ mekɛ ne. Menli banriandi ahɔ ara, na ndelebɛbo bayɛ kpole.”
5Akee medame Daneɛle mendole me nye, na menwunle menli nwiɔ kɛ bɛgyigyi azule ne anloa, ko gyi azule ne foa ko yɛɛ ko ne ɔdaye ɔgyi ɔ nzi lɔ. 6Na membizale Nyamenle soanvolɛ ne mɔɔ wula lenen tɛladeɛ ne gyi azule ne azo la kɛ, “Kenlenzu a nwanwane ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ kɔsɔɔti kɛyɛ zɔhane a?”
7 Nyamenle soanvolɛ ne kpogyale ɔ sa amu nwiɔ zo anwomanyunlu; na mendele kɛ ɔlɛfa Tease Nyamenle ne yeaha ndane kɛ, “Saa ɛvolɛ nsa siane nsia ne dwu, na bɛwie Nyamenle menli ne kpɔdekpɔde yɛ a, ɛhye mɔ amuala bayɛ zɔhane.”
8Mendele edwɛkɛ ɛhye, na meande ɔ bo. Yemɔti membizale kɛ, “O me menle, kɛ ɛhye mɔ bazi awie ye ɛ?”
9Ɔbuale me kɛ, “Daneɛle, suzu ɛ nwo na bɛzɔ edwɛkɛ ne anloa, ɔnle kɛ bɛbɔ zolɛ kɔkpula awieleɛ mekɛ ne. 10 Menli dɔɔnwo bahakyi bɛ subane nee bɛ nyɛleɛ, ade bɛ nwo saanwu na bɛayɛ menli fofolɛ. Na amumuyɛma ɛdeɛ, bɛbahɔ zolɛ bɛayɛ ninyɛndane; bɛ biala ɛnrɛde ɔ bo. Nrɛlɛbɛvolɛma mɔɔ wɔ nu la ala a bade ɔ bo a.
11 “Ɔvi mekɛ mɔɔ bɛbava bɛagyakyi dahuu azubɔlɛ nee ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ ne ɛvalɛ na bɛava ‘Munzudeɛ ne mɔɔ bɔ Maanle’ la bɛazie Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu la bayɛ kenle ngoko apenle ko ɛya nwiɔ abulahɔnla.
12“Nyilalɛ ɛha sonla ne mɔɔ kɛhendɛ toonwo ɔkɛhɔdwu kenle apenle ko ɛya nsa abulasa nee nnu ne awieleɛ la!
13“Na wɔmɔ, Daneɛle, di nɔhalɛ kɔ awieleɛ. Ɛbawu, na awieleɛ mekɛ ne dwu a, ɛbagyinla ɛleka mɔɔ bɛhyehyɛ bɛmaa wɔ la.”

Title: HOZ MUKENYE
Content:
Mukenye
Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ Hozia bɔle Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ ne nolo wɔ Yizilayɛ sɔlɔ belemgbunli maanle ne anu. Yemɔ a ɔvindele Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ Emɔzo anzi wɔ ngyegyelɛ mekɛ ne mɔ anu kolaa na Samɛlea abɔ, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee yeha ɛvolɛ ɛya nsuu abulanwiɔ nee ko na bɛawo Kelaese ne la. Debie mɔɔ hyianle ye kpole kpalɛ la a le menli ne awozonlezonlenlɛ nee diedi mɔɔ bɛnlɛ ye wɔ Nyamenle anu la. Hozia anzulo, ɔvale diedi mɔɔ menli ne ɛnlɛ ye la ɔdole ɔdaye mumua ne ye anwubɛnyunlu agyalɛ nwo, nee nɔhalɛ mɔɔ ɔ ye anli la anwo.
