Kɛmɔ ɔ ye Gomɛ anli nɔhalɛ ammaa ye la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ Nyamenle menli ne ɛkpo Awulae a. Ɛhye ati Nyamenle ndeanlɛ ne bara Yizilayɛma anwo zo. Noko akee nzinlii Nyamenle bahile ye ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne wɔ ye menli ne anwo zo, yeava maanle ne yeayɛ ye ɛdeɛ na ɔ nee menli ne bɛ avinli azɛ. Bɛhile ɛhulolɛ ɛhye wɔ arɛlekyekyelɛ edwɛkɛ agbɔkɛ ɛhye mɔ anu: “Yizilayɛ, duzu ati a ɔwɔ kɛ meye wɔ memaa ɛ? Duzu ati a ɔwɔ kɛ mekpo wɔ a? Me ahonle ɛnrɛmaa menrɛyɛ ɛhye. Me ɛhulolɛ mɔɔ melɛ ye bɛ nwo la anu yɛ se kpole kpalɛ.” (11.8)
Mɔɔ wɔ nu la
Hozia agyalɛ nee ye abusua ne 1.1—3.5
Nrɛlaleɛ mɔɔ tia Yizilayɛ 4.1—13.16
Anlubɛnwo nee ɛwɔkɛbɔlɛ nrɛlaleɛ 14.1-9

Title: HOZ 1
Content:
1 Nrɛlaleɛ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma vale manle Biyɛlae ara nrenya Hozia wɔ Dwuda arelemgbunli Ɛzaya, Dwotam, Ehaze, yɛɛ Hɛzikaya mekɛ zo la ɛne. Mekɛ ne anu ɛnee Gyɛhowahye ara nrenya Gyɛlɔbowam le Yizilayɛ belemgbunli.
Hozia aye nee ɔ mra
2Mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma dumua alua Hozia anwo zo adendɛ ahile Yizilayɛma la, ɔzele Hozia kɛ, “Kɔgya tuutuu raalɛ na wo tuutuu mralɛ. Ɔluakɛ azɛlɛ ne azo amra ɛkpo medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, na bɛlɛbɔ tuutuu ɛbɛla.”
3Yemɔti Hozia gyale Debeleeyem ara raalɛ Gomɛ. Gomɛ nrenzɛle na ɔwole ralɛ nrenya. 4 Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Hozia kɛ, “To ye ‘Gyɛzelii’ ɔboalekɛ ɔnrɛhyɛ biala na meadea Yizilayɛ belemgbunli ne wɔ mogya mɔɔ ɔ nlenya Gyɛhu hanle guale wɔ Gyɛzelii la anwo. Mefa Gyɛhu belemgbunlililɛ ne meara awieleɛ. 5Kenle zɔhane mebabubu Yizilayɛ ɛda ne anu wɔ Gyɛzelii Bɔnza.”
6Gomɛ nrenzɛle bieko na ɔwole ralɛ raalɛ. Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Hozia kɛ, “To ye ‘Bɛnzeyeanwunvɔne,’ ɔluakɛ menrɛze Yizilayɛma anwunvɔne bieko, yɛɛ menrɛva bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ menrɛhyɛ bɛ fee. 7Mebaze Dwudama anwunvɔne, medame, Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle, mebalie bɛ ngoane, na tɛ konle nu ɔ, menrɛva konle dadeɛ anzɛɛ ɛda nee ɛda mbaka anzɛɛ mgbɔnwɔ nee menli mɔɔ ka mgbɔnwɔ la.”
8Mɔɔ Gomɛ pɛle ɔ ra ne nyɛfonlɛ la, ɔnrenzɛle na ɔwole ralɛ nrenya bieko. 9Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Hozia kɛ, “To ye ‘Bɛnlememenli,’ ɔboalekɛ Yizilayɛma ɛnle me menli, yɛɛ menle bɛ Nyamenle.”
Yizilayɛ banyia ye gyinlabelɛ dɛba ne
10 Yizilayɛma bazo kɛ ɛnweazo anwea mɔɔ bɛngola bɛnzuzu anzɛɛ bɛngola bɛndia la, na ɛleka ne mɔɔ bɛzele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛnle me menli” la, ɛkɛ ne a bɛbaha bɛahile bɛ kɛ, “Bɛle tease Nyamenle ne amra” a, 11na Dwudama nee Yizilayɛ bali ngamɔnu. Bɛbaye bɛ kpanyinli ko bɛamaa yeanlea bɛ nwo zo, bɛ nwo bazo na bɛakpazi wɔ azɛlɛ ne azo. Ɔluakɛ Gyɛzelii kenle ne bayɛ kenle kpole!

Title: HOZ 2
Content:
1Yemɔti bɛvɛlɛ bɛ mediema mrenya ne mɔ “Me Menli” na bɛvɛlɛ bɛ mediema mraalɛ ne mɔ “Bɛnwubɛanwunvɔne.”
Gomɛ ɛnli nɔhalɛ, Yizilayɛ ɛnli nɔhalɛ
2Me mra, bɛ nee bɛ nli ɛdendɛ; kɛkala ɔnle me ye bieko, yɛɛ medame noko menle ɔ hu bieko, noko bɛ nee ye ɛdendɛ. Bɛzɛlɛ ye kɛ ɔgyakyi ye tuutuu ɛbɛlabɔlɛ ne nee ye awuvolɛvalɛ mɛladonlɛ ne. 3Saa yeangyakyi a, mebakpa ɔ nwo meamaa yealɛ ɔ nwo zɔ kɛ kenle mɔɔ bɛwole ye la. Mebamaa yeayɛ kɛ fienemgbole nu azɛlɛ mɔɔ ɛwe la, na meamaa nzuhɔne ngome ahu ye ado ye lɔ. 4Menrɛze ɔ mra ne mɔ anwunvɔne, ɔboalekɛ bɛle tuutuu mralɛ, 5ɔluakɛ bɛ nli le tuutuunli. Raalɛ ne mɔɔ nrenzɛle bɛ la ɛbɔ anyiemgba ɛbɛla. Ɔluakɛ ɔhanle kɛ, “Metoa me kulovolɛma mɔɔ maa me aleɛ nee nzule, mboane enrinli nee lenen, ɔlivi nwole, yɛɛ nwanye la.”
6Yemɔti mebava mbowumbaka meagya ye anyiane na mealie bane meawa ye, amaa yeannwu ye ndenle ne mɔ. 7Ɔbadu ye kulovolɛma ako na ɔnrɛdo bɛ. Ɔbakpondɛ bɛ na ɔnrɛnwu bɛ. Na akee ɔbaha kɛ, “Mesia meadoa me hu ne mɔɔ lumuale gyale me la, ɔluakɛ ɛnee ɔle kpalɛ ɔmaa me ɔtɛla kɛkala.”
8Ɔnze kɛ medame a menvale abɛlɛ, nwanye, ɔlivi nwole, dwɛtɛ fufule, yɛɛ ezukoa nvutuke memanle ye a, yɛɛ bɛvale bɛzonlenle bozonle Beeyale ne a. 9Yemɔti ɛbuhenle ne dwu a mebalie me abɛlɛ, nwanye ne mɔ nee me mboane enrinli nee lenen ne mɔ mɔɔ menvale memanle ɔyɛle ndanlɛ ɔhedale la. 10Mebakpa ɔ nwo wɔlɔnwo wɔ ye kulovolɛma anyunlu, na awie biala ɛnrɛhola ɛnrɛlie ye ɛnrɛvi me tumi bo. 11Mebamaa yeagyakyi ye anyelielɛ ne mɔ, ye ɛvoyia ne mɔ, ye siane fofolɛ ɛvoyialilɛ ne mɔ, ye Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Ɛvoyia ne mɔ, yɛɛ ye nyamenlezonlenlɛ ɛvoyialilɛ ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti. 12Mebazɛkye ye vanye mbaka nee ye feege mbaka mɔɔ ɔse ɔle ye ɛkpabɔdeɛ mɔɔ ye kulovolɛma vale manle ye la. Mebamaa ye vanye nee ye feege egyinli ne mɔ ahakyi kpɔkɛ, nanemgbole arali. 13Mebadea ye wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɔ rɛle vile me na ɔhɔkpunle ɛyɛlɛ ɔmanle ye awozonle Beeyale ne mɔ, na ɔvale anwoneɛ ɔzieziele ɔ nwo ɔdoale ye kulovolɛma la; kɛ medame Ɛdɛnkɛma mese la ɛne.
Ɛdɛnkɛma lɛ ye menli ne anwo ɛhulolɛ
14Yemɔti nea, mebali ye adwenle na meava ye meahɔ fienemgbole ne anu, na meadendɛ kɛnlɛma meahile ye. 15 Ɛkɛ ne, mebava ye vanye egyinli ne mɔ meamaa ye na meamaa Ngyegyelɛ Bɔnza ayɛ anyelazo anlenkɛ. Na ɛkɛ ne yɛɛ mefɛlɛ ye a ɔbalie zo, kɛmɔ ye mbɛlɛra nu mɔɔ ɔvi Yigyibiti ɔrale la ɔyɛle la. 16Mekɛ ne anu medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, ɛbavɛlɛ me “Me hu” na ɛnrɛvɛlɛ me, “Me Beeyale.” 17Ɔluakɛ menrɛmaa ɔnrɛbɔ Beeyale ne mɔ duma bieko, yɛɛ bɛnrɛbɔ bɛ duma bieko.
18Kenle zɔhane me nee ɛbɔ nu nanemgbole, anwomanyunlu nloma, yɛɛ debie biala mɔɔ twenle ɔ kɛnra aze la bayɛ ngyekyeleɛ; mebaye ɛda, konle dadeɛ nee konle meavi azɛlɛ ne azo, na me menli ne adɛnla bɛ nwo adɔ bɛ.
19Yizilayɛ, mebayia wɔ meava wɔ meayɛ me ye dahuu.
Mebava tenleneyɛlɛ nee pɛlepɛlelilɛ meagya wɔ,
mebava ɛhulolɛ kpundii nee anwunvɔnezelɛ meagya wɔ.
20Mebava wɔ meayɛ me ye nɔhalɛ nu,
na ɛbanwu kɛ mele Ɛdɛnkɛma.
21Mekɛ ne anu, medame Ɛdɛnkɛma mese,
mebadendɛ anwomanyunlu anwo
na anwomanyunlu badendɛ azɛlɛ ye anwo.
22Na azɛlɛ ye bamaa abɛlɛ, nwanye nee nwole
na aleɛ abu Gyɛzelii.
23 Mebalua ye azɛlɛ ne azo meamaa me nwo.
Mebaze “Bɛnzebɛanwunvɔne” anwunvɔne,
na meaze “Tɛmemenli ɔ” kɛ, “Bɛle me menli”
na ɔdaye ɔbaha kɛ, “Ɛle me Nyamenle.”

Title: HOZ 3
Content:
Hozia nee raalɛ ne mɔɔ ɛnli nɔhalɛ la
1Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me kɛ, “Kɔ bieko na kɔhulo awuvolɛ raalɛ mɔɔ ɛlɛto awuvolɛvalɛ mɛla ne na ye kulovolɛ ne le nrenya mɔɔ gya raalɛ la. Kulo ye kɛmɔ kɛkala medame Ɛdɛnkɛma mesi mekulo Yizilayɛma mɔɔ kakyi bɛ nwo kɔ nyamenle gyɛne gyɛne anwo, na bɛkulo vanye mra la.”
2Yemɔti menzule dwɛtɛ fufule bulu nee nnu nee baale nzuzuleɛ kilo ɛya ko abulanlu mengyale ye. 3Menganle mengilele ye kɛ, “Ɔwɔ kɛ ɛyɛ me ye, ɛkyɛ me sa nu; mmabɔ tuutuu ɛbɛla bieko anzɛɛ mmakɔfa nrenya fofolɛ; na medame noko mebali nɔhalɛ ko ne ala meamaa wɔ.” 4Ɔluakɛ Yizilayɛma badɛnla ahyɛ dɔɔnwo mɔɔ bɛnrɛnyia belemgbunli anzɛɛ mgbanyima; bɛnrɛbɔ azu yɛɛ bɛnrɛnyia awolɛ mpila, bɛnrɛnyia mmonle anzɛɛ ananze mɔɔ bɛfa bɛayɛ sɛkɛlɛneɛ bɛazonle nee ɛzonlenlɛ tɛladeɛ Yifɔdo. 5Ɛhye anzi Yizilayɛma bazia ara Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne, nee bɛ belemgbunli Devidi ɛkɛ. Bɛbava ɛzulolɛ bɛazia bɛara Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛkɛ wɔ ye kpalɛyɛlɛ ne ati.

Title: HOZ 4
Content:
Ɛdɛnkɛma somolɛbɔlɛ mɔɔ tia Yizilayɛ
1O Yizilayɛma, bɛdie Ɛdɛnkɛma edwɛkɛ ne, ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma lɛ edwɛkɛ tia bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛde azɛlɛ ne azo la. Ɔse, “Bɛnli nɔhalɛ anzɛɛ bɛnyɛ atiakunlukɛnlɛma yɛɛ bɛnlɛ Nyamenle anwo adwenle biala wɔ azɛlɛ ne azo. 2Bɛka ndane, bɛbɔ adalɛ, bɛku menli, bɛwua, yɛɛ bɛto awuvolɛvalɛ mɛla ne. Bɛdɛla anhwe yɛɛ menli ala a bɛku a. 3Yemɔti azɛlɛ ne bayɛ resee yɛɛ debie biala mɔɔ wɔ zolɛ la bawu. Ɛbɔ nu nane kɔsɔɔti, anwomanyunlu nloma kɔsɔɔti, nyevile nu fɛlɛ bɔbɔ, bɛ muala bɛbawu.”
Ɛdɛnkɛma bɔ sɛlɛvolɛma somolɛ
4Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Awie biala mmasu ɛhye anwo kpolera, yɛɛ awie biala mmato menli ne ɛzonle; ɔluakɛ bɛmɛ sɛlɛvolɛma bɔbɔ yɛɛ me nee bɛ lɛ edwɛkɛ a. 5Bɛbadu koti alehyenlɛ nu, yɛɛ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma ne noko nee bɛ badu koti aledwolɛ nu, na mebazɛkye bɛ nli ne. 6Me menli ne ɛnlɛ adwenle la ati bɛzɛkye bɛ; kɛmɔ bɛkpo adwenlenubukelɛ la ati, medame noko mekpo bɛ kɛ bɛnle me sɛlɛvolɛma bieko, yɛɛ kɛmɔ bɛ rɛle ɛvi bɛ Nyamenle ne mɛla ne la, medame noko me rɛle bavi bɛ mra.
7“Mekɛ mɔɔ bɛ nwo ɛlɛso la, mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee bɛlɛyɛ ɛtane dɔɔnwo bɛatia me la ɛne, yemɔti mebamaa bɛ enililɛ ahakyi anyiemgba. 8Bɛdidi me menli ne ɛtane nwo, bɛyɛ adidikpoku wɔ me menli ne ɛtaneyɛlɛ nwo. 9Mɔɔ mebava meayɛ me menli ne la, zɔhane ala a mebava meayɛ sɛlɛvolɛma ne mɔ a. Mebadea bɛ na meadua bɛ kakɛ wɔ bɛ nyɛleɛ ne mɔ anwo. 10Bɛbali, na bɛ ko ɛnrɛyi. Bɛbali awozonle ɛzonlenlɛ nu tuutuu kɛ bɛkɛwo mralɛ dɔɔnwo na bɛnrɛwo mralɛ, ɔboalekɛ bɛhakyi bɛ nzi bɛzi medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, na bɛdoɔdoa nyamenle gyɛne gyɛne.”
Ɛdɛnkɛma bua awozonlezonlenlɛma fɔlɛ
11Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Nwanye, dɛba o, fofolɛ o, sɛkye me menli ne ndelebɛbo! 12Bɛkɔ baka dosinli nwo abisa yɛɛ bɛdabɛ bɛ kpɔma bɔbɔ bɔ bɛ munzule. Ɔluakɛ tuutuulilɛ sunsum ɛva bɛ ɛminli, ɛmaa bɛgyakyi bɛ Nyamenle ne ɛzonlenlɛ na bɛlɛdi awozonlezonlenlɛ nu tuutuu. Bɛbɔ azu wɔ awoka mgbole zo na bɛfa bɛ azubɔdeɛ bɛkɔ awoka ngyikyi ne mɔ azo, yɛɛ 13mbaka ndendenle ɛsesebɛ bubuzuu bo, ɔboalekɛ bɛ alubo ne mɔ anu yɛ anyelielɛ.
“Yemɔti bɛ mra mraalɛ bɔ awozonlezonlenlɛ nu tuutuu ɛbɛla na bɛ mra mrenya aye mɔ to awuvolɛvalɛ mɛla ne. 14Noko saa bɛ mra mraalɛ ne mɔ bɔ awozonlezonlenlɛ nu tuutuu ɛbɛla na bɛ mra mrenya ne mɔ aye mɔ to awuvolɛvalɛ mɛla ne a, menrɛdea bɛ, ɔluakɛ mrenya ne mɔ bɛdabɛ bɛfa ahane bɛkɔfa tuutuuma yɛɛ bɛ nee awozonle ɛzonlenlɛ nu tuutuuma bɔ nu bɔ azu. Bɛle menli mɔɔ ɛnlɛ ndelebɛbo a, na bɛbazɛkye bɛ noko.
15“Saa bɛmɛ Yizilayɛma, bɛbɔ tuutuu ɛbɛla a, Dwudama ɛnli nwolɛ fɔlɛ. Bɛmmakɔ Gelegale anzɛɛ Bɛteevɛn kɛ bɛkazonle, yɛɛ bɛmmafa ‘Tease Ɛdɛnkɛma’ duma bɛka ndane. 16Yizilayɛma anzo yɛ se kɛ mgbɔnwɔndua. Kɛ ɔkɛyɛ na meamaa bɛ aleɛ kɛ mboane mralɛ mɔɔ wɔ adidileka mɔɔ le tɛtɛlɛ la ɛ? 17Awozonlezonlenlɛ ɛgya Yizilayɛma; bɛgyakyi bɛ. 18Nzabovoma akpolane mɔɔ anye die tuutuulilɛ nwo a. Bɛkulo anyiemgba bɛtɛla anyunlunyia. 19Anwonyia ɛpia bɛ ɛhɔ, na bɛ awozonle azubɔlɛ ne mɔ ati, anyiemgba baha bɛ.

Title: HOZ 5
Content:
1“Bɛdie edwɛkɛ ɛhye, bɛmɛ sɛlɛvolɛma! Bɛyɛ ɛnzonlɛ, bɛmɛ Yizilayɛma! Bɛdie, bɛmɛ arelemgbunli! Ɔluakɛ ndɛnebualɛ ne gyi bɛ nwo zo. Ɔluakɛ bɛyɛ bɛ nwo kɛ ngane wɔ Mezepa, bɛyɛ kɛ avonle mɔɔ bɛdo wɔ Teebɔ Boka ne azo la, 2bɛpɛ kuma kuloonwu wɔ suakpole Akasea azo, yɛɛ menli ala a bɛku a; mebadea bɛ kɔsɔɔti. 3Meze Yifelaem, yɛɛ Yizilayɛ ɛnvea me nye zo. Na kɛkala, wɔmɔ Yifelaem, wɔbɔ tuutuu ɛbɛla, evinli ɛha Yizilayɛ.”
Hozia bɔ awozonlezonlenlɛ nwo kɔkɔ
4Bɛ nyɛleɛ ɛtane ne mɔ ɛmmaa bɛngola bɛnzia bɛngɔ bɛ Nyamenle ne ɛkɛ. Ɔluakɛ tuutuulilɛ sunsum ne wɔ bɛ nu, yɛɛ bɛnze Ɛdɛnkɛma. 5Yizilayɛma mgbanyizonle ne di daselɛ tia bɛ. Bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ bamaa Yifelaem nee Yizilayɛ adu koti. Dwudama noko nee bɛ a badu koti ne a. 6Bɛbava bɛ mboane nee bɛ nlankɛ bɛabɔ azu bɛakpondɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, na bɛnrɛnwu ye, ɔluakɛ yehwe ɔ nwo yevi bɛ nwo. 7Bɛanli nɔhalɛ bɛammaa Ɛdɛnkɛma, ɔluakɛ bɛwo nyɛvolɛ mralɛ. Yemɔti siane fofolɛ ɛvoyialilɛ ne bazɛkye bɛ nee bɛ azɛlɛ ne kɔsɔɔti.
Dwuda nee Yizilayɛ konle ne
8Bɛwu konle aweɛne ndendenle ne mɔ anu wɔ Gebɛya! Bɛbɔ nolo ne wɔ Releema! Bɛbɔ bubu wɔ Bɛteevɛn. Bɛli bɛ nzi, Bɛngyaman asa azo! 9Kenle ne ɛlɛba, na bɛbazɛkye Yifelaem maanle ne. Yizilayɛma, nɔhalɛ nu, ɛhye bazi!
10Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Dwuda arelemgbunli ɛyɛ bɛ nwo menli mɔɔ di azɛlɛ zo ɛweɛne tukpɔnla a. Yemɔti mebawola me ɛya ne meagua bɛ nwo zo kɛ nzule la. 11Yifelaem ɛlɛnwu amaneɛ wɔ ndeanlɛ nu, ɔboalekɛ yebɔ kpɔkɛ kɛ debie mgbane ala yɛɛ ɔdi ɔ nzi a. 12Yemɔti mebayɛ me nwo ɛlɛtɛba meazɛkye Yizilayɛ na meayɛ kɛ nrɛnlana meamaa Dwudama ayɛ mgbane.
13“Mɔɔ Yifelaem nwunle kɛ anwonyane ɛbɔ ye na Dwuda noko nwunle kɛ ɔdaye mumua ne yedudu nganlɛ la, Yifelaem hɔle Aselea maanle maanle belemgbunli ne ɛkɛ kɛ ɔkabiza ye moalɛ, noko Aselea angola anyɛ bɛ nee bɛ nganlɛ ne mɔ ayile. 14Mebateta Yifelaem kɛ awenade na meateta Dwuda kɛ awenade ralɛ. Medame mumua ne mebatete bɛ nzokanzoka na meagyakyi bɛ meahɔ. Saa me nee bɛ ɛlɛkɔ a, awie biala ɛnrɛhola bɛ die.
15“Mebahwe me nwo meavi menli ne anwo kɔkpula mekɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛnwu bɛ ɛtane mɔɔ bɛyɛ, na wɔ bɛ amaneɛnwunlɛ ne anu, bɛkɛkpondɛ me bo zo la.”

Title: HOZ 6
Content:
Menli ne anlubɛnwo ɛnle nɔhalɛ
1Menli ne baha kɛ, “Bɛmaa yɛzia yɛdoa Ɛdɛnkɛma! Yemaa yɛnwu amaneɛ ɛdeɛ, noko ɔbayɛ yɛ ayile; yebodɛboda yɛ ɛdeɛ, noko ɔbayɛ yɛ nganlɛ ne mɔ ayile. 2Kenle nwiɔ ne azo ɔbamaa yɛabɔzɔbɔzɔ, na ye kenle nsa ne azo yeadwazo yɛ, na yɛadɛnla ngoane nu. 3Bɛmaa yɛbɔ mɔdenle yɛnwu Ɛdɛnkɛma. Nɔhalɛ, ye ɛralɛ ɛnli mgbanwo, kɛmɔ alehyenlɛ ɛnli mgbanwo la. Ɔbara kɛ nyenyensuo nyenye doɔloa azɛlɛ ye la.”
4Na Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “O Yifelaemma, kɛ menyɛ bɛ ɛ? O Dwudama, kɛ menyɛ bɛ ɛ? Me nwo ɛhulolɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛ la le kɛ nwonlomɔ amungu, ɔle kɛ nwonlomɔ ɛbɔlɛ, ɔngyɛ na yeawe. 5Yemɔti memaa me kpɔmanvolɛma ɛpɛ bɛ ɛgua. Meva me nloa edwɛkɛ mehu bɛ, yɛɛ me ndɛnebualɛ ne le wienyi; 6 ɔluakɛ mekpondɛ ɛhulolɛ kpundii, na tɛ nane azubɔlɛ ɔ. Mekulo kɛ bɛnwu Nyamenle bɛtɛla ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ.
7“Bɛle kɛ Adam la, bɛtulule ngyekyeleɛ ne mɔɔ me nee bɛ kyekyele la, bɛanli nɔhalɛ bɛammaa me. 8Geleade le suakpole mɔɔ munzulema nee ahɔdiawu ɛyi ye tɔ na mogya ɛbu zolɛ a. 9Sɛlɛvolɛma ne mɔ le kɛ nwule ekpunli mɔɔ ɛhɔ nzia kakpondɛ sonla akpokpo ye la. Bɛku menli wɔ Hyikɛm adenle zo yɛɛ bɛbɔ munzule ɛbɛla ɛhye amumuyɛ nu. 10Menwu debie ɛzulolɛ bie wɔ Yizilayɛ: Yifelaem awozonlezonlenlɛ nu tuutuu ɛbɛla ne wɔ ɛkɛ; evinli ɛha Yizilayɛ.
11“Na bɛmɛ Dwudama noko, mezie kenle mɔɔ mebava meadea bɛ wɔ mɔɔ bɛlɛyɛ la anwo a.

Title: HOZ 7
Content:
1“Mekɛ biala mɔɔ menwɔze kɛ meyɛ me menli Yizilayɛma ayile na meamaa bɛakpazi bieko la, debie mɔɔ menwu ye la ala a le Yifelaem amumuyɛ ɛbɛla ne nee Samɛlea munzule nyɛleɛ ne mɔ. Bɛdi bɛ nwo ndunlumi; bɛbubu nlenkɛ bɛwua; bɛkpokpo menli wɔ guabile ne mɔ azo. 2Bɛ ti moaba ɛnga ɛngile bɛ kɛ mebabu bɛ ɛtane ɛhye mɔ kɔsɔɔti anwo mgbonda. Bɛ nyɛleɛ ɛtane ne mɔ ɛli bɛ bɔyia, ɔ muala gua me nyunlu.”
Suakunlu ɛkɛ ne maamɔlɛ adwenlevalɛ
3Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Menli fa bɛ maamɔlɛ adwenle ne bɛlɛbɛla belemgbunli nee ye mgbanyima ne mɔ. 4Bɛ muala bɛle awuvolɛvalɛma; bɛle kɛ fonlomo mɔɔ ɛwie dɔ mɔɔ sonla ne mɔɔ to kpanwo ne la ɛnga nuhua bieko toonwo kɔkpula mekɛ mɔɔ ɔkɛwie ye kpanwo ne bɔ na ɔkɛwie tu la. 5Mekɛ mɔɔ belemgbunli ne di ye ɛvoyia ne la, ɔ nee ye mgbanyima ne mɔ nlonle nza na bɛyɛle tindaanwu na ɔbokale bɛ bɛzile amgbu. 6Bɛ ninyɛndane nwo adwenlevalɛ maa bɛ adwenle nu dɔ kɛ fonlomo; aledwolɛ nu amuala bɛ ɛya ne wu gbodogbodo kɛ ɔgyi senle zo, alehyenlɛ nu ɔsɔ kɛ sendɔlɔra.
7“Bɛ muala bɛlɔle kɛ fonlomo na bɛhunle bɛ arelemgbunli ne mɔ. Bɛ arelemgbunli ne mɔ amuala ɛwie wu yɛɛ bɛ biala anzɛlɛ ambiza me moalɛ.”
Yizilayɛ nee maanle maanle ne mɔ
8Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Yifelaem le kɛ kpanwo mɔɔ ɛtɛwiele be la. Bɛfa bɛ nye bɛto maanle maanle mɔɔ zuozua bɛ la anwo zo. 9Bɛngola bɛnnwu ye kɛ nyɛvolɛ yɛɛ ɛmaa bɛ anwosesebɛ ɛwie a. Bɛbɔ egyɛne, na bɛnnwu ye. 10Yizilayɛma mgbanyizonle ne di daselɛ tia bɛ. Noko ɛhye mɔ kɔsɔɔti anzi, bɛnzia bɛndoa medame Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne, yɛɛ bɛmkpondɛ me bo zo. 11Yifelaem di tɛnlatu kɛ abubule mɔɔ ɛnlɛ adwenle la. Bɛkɔ Yigyibiti bɛkɔbiza moalɛ, na bɛanriandi bɛahɔ Aselea bɛahɔbiza moalɛ. 12Na mɔɔ bɛlɛkɔ la, mebagua bɛ asawu meahye bɛ kɛ anwomanyunlu nloma la. Mebadea bɛ wɔ bɛ amumuyɛ ɛbɛla ne mɔ anwo.
13“Munzule ɛha bɛ, ɔluakɛ bɛde bɛ nwo bɛvi me nwo! Mebazɛkye bɛ, ɔluakɛ bɛde me nwo atua. Mekulo kɛ medie bɛ, noko bɛbɔ me nwo adalɛ. 14Bɛ nzɛlɛlɛ ne mɔ ɛnvi bɛ ahonle nu, bɛda bɛ ɛkpa ne mɔ azo a bɛye awolɛ a. Abɛlɛ nee nza ti bɛbodɛboda bɛ nwo, bɛkpo me. 15Medame a mentetele bɛ mengilele bɛ anwosesebɛ a, noko bɛfa me nwo maamɔvo adwenle. 16Bɛgyakyi me na bɛtoa bozonle Beeyale ne. Bɛle kɛ ɛda kyealera. Bɛ arelemgbunli ne mɔ bawu dadeɛ nloa wɔ bɛ mgbanyizonle ɛdendɛlɛ ti. Yigyibitima bazi bɛ ti zo agole.”

Title: HOZ 8
Content:
Ɛdɛnkɛma bua Yizilayɛ fɔlɛ wɔ mmonlezɔlɛ nwo
1Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Bɛwu aweɛne tendenle ne anu. Agbɔvolɛ ɛlɛba arali me azɛlɛ ye mutule kɛ ahɔleɛ! Ɔluakɛ menli ne ɛtulu me ngyekyeleɛ ne mɔɔ me nee bɛ kyekyele la na bɛbulu me mɛla ne azo. 2Bɛsu bɛfɛlɛ me kɛ, ‘Me Nyamenle, yɛze wɔ.’ 3Yizilayɛma ɛkpo mɔɔ le kpalɛ la. Ɛhye ati bɛ kpɔvolɛma badu bɛ mgbaliko.
4“Bɛziele arelemgbunli, noko bɛanlua me nwo zo a bɛziele a. Bɛzieziele mgbanyima mɔɔ menze nwolɛ bie. Bɛvale bɛ dwɛtɛ fufule nee bɛ ezukoa nvutuke bɛguale ananze bɛzɛkyele bɛ nwo. 5Mekyi nvutuke ɛnlankɛ ralɛ ananze ne mɔɔ suakpole Samɛlea amra zonlenle ye la. Me ahonle ɛfutu bɛ nwo. Kenlenzu yɛɛ bɛkɛgyakyi bɛ mmonlezɔlɛ ne a? 6Yizilayɛnli dwinvolɛ a yɛle ananze ne a, ɔnle Nyamenle. Bɛbagelegele Samɛlea nvutuke ɛnlankɛ ralɛ ananze ne dwɔkɔdwɔkɔ. 7Bɛdua anwoma, na bɛbabu ahumu. Ɛya avule nu abɛlɛ ɛnrɛvievia mralɛ, bɛnrɛnyia aleɛ wɔ nu, yɛɛ saa bɛfievia mralɛ bɔbɔ a, nyɛvolɛ a bali a. 8Yizilayɛ ɛli akoatɔ; kɛkala bɛhyɛ bɛ maanle maanle ne mɔ anu na bɛyɛ kɛ buakɛ mgbane bie la. 9Yizilayɛma le kɛ asoaso ahohonyinli, bɛdabɛ bɛpɛ adenle bɛhɔ kɛ bɛkabiza Aseleama moalɛ. Yifelaem ɛbɔ maanle maanle gyɛne ɛkpa kɛ bɛraboa ye. 10Saa kanza bɛluolua nu bɛbɔ maanle maanle ɛkpa a, akee mebaboɔboa bɛ nloa. Na bɛbagyakyi belemgbunli nee mgbanyima ɛzielɛ.
11“Kɛmɔ Yifelaemma ɛsisi azukponle dɔɔnwo ɛva ɛyɛ ɛtane la, bɛmaa azukponle ɛyɛ debie ɛtane me nye zo. 12Saa mekɛlɛ me mɛla apenle apenle bulu meamaa bɛ a, anrɛɛ bɛbabu bɛ debie ngakyile bie. 13Bɛkulo azubɔlɛ; bɛku nane bɛbɔ azu na bɛdi. Na medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, me nye ɛnlie nwolɛ. Akee mebahakye bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ na meadea bɛ wɔ nwolɛ, na meamaa bɛazia bɛahɔ Yigyibiti.
14“Yizilayɛma ɛsisi arelemgbunli azua na bɛ rɛle ɛvi bɛ Bɔvolɛ ne. Dwudama ɛsisi azuamgbole ɛbɔ bɛ nwo bane. Na mebakpomgbɔ senle meagua bɛ azuamgbole ne mɔ azo na ɔbayela bɛ aranemgbole ne mɔ.”

Title: HOZ 9
Content:
Hozia bɔ Yizilayɛ ndeanlɛ nwo nolo
1Yizilayɛma, bɛgyakyi fɛlɛkolilɛ! Bɛmmadi wulupe kɛ maanle maanle ne mɔ la, ɔluakɛ bɛmɛ Yizilayɛma, bɛbɔ tuutuu ɛbɛla, na bɛkpo bɛ Nyamenle. Bɛhulo kɛ bɛkɛbɔ bɛ ɛkpa kɛ tuutuuma la wɔ ma ɛwozolɛ ɛleka ne mɔ. 2Aleɛ nee nza mɔɔ bɛbanyia bɛ wɔ ma ɛwozolɛ ɛleka nee nwanyezielɛ ɛleka ne mɔ la ɛnrɛzɔ bɛ yɛɛ bɛnrɛnyia nwanye fofolɛ. 3Yizilayɛma ɛnrɛdɛnla Ɛdɛnkɛma azɛlɛ ne azo; Yifelaemma bazia ahɔ Yigyibiti na bɛali aleɛ mɔɔ nwolɛ ɛnde la wɔ Aselea. 4Wɔ maanle zɔhane mɔ anu, bɛnrɛgua nwanye aze bɛnrɛye ɛdɛne bɛnrɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma, yɛɛ bɛ azubɔlɛ ne mɔ ɛnrɛzɔ ɔ nye. Bɛ aleɛ bayɛ kɛ ɛzɛne aleɛ; awie biala mɔɔ kɛli bie la, evinli baha ye, ɔluakɛ bɛbali bɛava bɛakpɔda bɛ ko ala; bɛnrɛva bie bɛnrɛyɛ azubɔdeɛ bɛnrɛhɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu. 5Na saa mekɛ ne dwu, mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛdi ɛvoyia ne mɔ bɛwula Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlunyia a, duzu a bɛkɛyɛ a? 6Ɔluakɛ bɛnlea, anwubɛnyunlu ɛmaa bɛ nee bɛ ɛlɛkɔ Aselea, Yigyibitima baboɔboa bɛ nloa; bɛbaboɔboa bɛ nloa bɛahɔgua bɛ Mɛmefese na ɛkɛ ne a bɛbawu bɛagua a. Ndile nee mbowule bafifi ava bɛ dwɛtɛ fufule gyazielɛ ɛleka nee bɛ ndanlɛ azua ne mɔ.
7 Ndeanlɛ mekɛ ne ɛdwu, nzenralɛ mekɛ ne ɛdwu. Yizilayɛma banwu ye! Bɛlɛka kɛ, “Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ ne le koasea. Sonla ne mɔɔ sunsum ɛva ye la ɛzɛ.” Ɔboalekɛ bɛkpɔ me kpole kpalɛ, yɛɛ bɛ ɛtane ne le kpole kpalɛ. 8Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ ne le Yifelaemma, me Nyamenle ne menli ne sinzavolɛ. Noko ɛleka biala mɔɔ ɔfa la, bɛsua ye ɛhane kɛ anloma la, yɛɛ ɛkpɔlɛ ɛyi ye Nyamenle ne sua ne tɔ. 9 Bɛyɛ ɛtane wɔ debie biala mɔɔ bɛyɛ la anu, kɛmɔ bɛyɛle wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ Gebɛya la. Nyamenle bahakye bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ na yeadea bɛ wɔ nwolɛ.
Yizilayɛ ɛtane ne nee ɔ nzi edwɛkɛ
10 Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Mɔɔ mekanwu Yizilayɛ la, ɛnee ɔle kɛ vanye ma mɔɔ ɛfifi fienemgbole nu la. Mɔɔ mekanwu bɛ nlenya mɔ la, ɛnee bɛle kɛ feege mɔɔ ɛlɛdumua azo la ma mɔɔ ɛbolo la. Na mɔɔ bɛrale Piyɔ Boka la, bɛdule bɛ nwo bɛmanle bozonle Beeyale ne, na mengyile bɛ bɔkɔɔ kɛ bɛ bozonle ne mɔɔ bɛhulole ye la. 11Yifelaem anyunlunyia badu ahɔ kɛ anloma, bɛnrɛwo mralɛ, mraalɛ ɛnrɛnrenzɛ, yɛɛ bɛnrɛva ɛkolɛ. 12Saa bɛwo mralɛ bɔbɔ a, mebahu bɛ kɔsɔɔti; menrɛgyakyi ko bɔbɔ. Saa mefi bɛ avinli meye me nwo a, munzule baha bɛ!”
13Ɛdɛnkɛma, menwu kɛ bɛhyehyɛ kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛku Yifelaem amra mrenya ne mɔ. Ɔwɔ kɛ Yifelaem fa ɔ mra mrenya ne mɔ kɔ maa bɛku bɛ. 14O Ɛdɛnkɛma, duzu a ɛfa wɔayɛ menli ɛhye mɔ a? Maa bɛ mraalɛ ko ɛkpɔnekpɔne na maa bɛ nyɛfo ne mɔ ɛbɔndɔbɔndɔ.
Ɛdɛnkɛma badea Yizilayɛma
15Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti bɔle ɔ bo wɔ Gelegale. Ɛkɛ ne yɛɛ membɔle ɔ bo kɛ mekyi bɛ a. Ɔlua bɛ amumuyɛ nyɛleɛ ne mɔ ati, mebadu bɛ me sua nu ɛkɛ. Menrɛhulo bɛ bieko ɛlɛ; bɛ arelemgbunli ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti ɛde me nwo atua. 16Yifelaemma ɛyɛ kɛ baka mɔɔ ye ndinli ɛwu na ewule ɛha ye la, bɛnrɛzo ma. Saa bɛwo bɔbɔ a, mebahu bɛ mra ne mɔ mɔɔ la bɛ ahonle nwo la.”
Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ ne ka Yizilayɛ anwo edwɛkɛ
17Me Nyamenle ne bakpo ye menli ne, ɔboalekɛ bɛandie ɔ ne. Bɛbali ahyimango wɔ maanle maanle ne mɔ anu.

Title: HOZ 10
Content:
1Yizilayɛma le kɛ vanye mbaka mɔɔ so kposekpose la. Mekɛ mɔɔ bɛ nwo ɛlɛso la, ɛnee bɛlɛsisi azukponle dɔɔnwo. Mekɛ mɔɔ maanle ne ɛlɛkpazi la, ɛnee bɛlɛsisi awolɛ mpila dɔɔnwo mɔɔ bɛsonle nwolɛ la. 2Bɛnli nɔhalɛ, yemɔti ɔwɔ kɛ bɛdi bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ anwo ɛzonle. Ɛdɛnkɛma babubu bɛ azukponle ne mɔ, na yeazɛkye bɛ mpila ne mɔ.
3Akee menli ɛhye mɔ baha kɛ, “Yɛnlɛ belemgbunli, ɔluakɛ yɛanzulo Ɛdɛnkɛma. Na duzu yɛɛ belemgbunli kola yɛ maa yɛ a?” 4Bɛbuke bɛ nloa bɛkeha bie ala; bɛfa adalɛ ndane bɛkyekye ngyekyeleɛ, yemɔti ndeanlɛ fifi bɛ nwo kɛ ɛya nu ɛzezeane kuma nu ndile mɔɔ le pɔezen la.
5Menli mɔɔ de suakpole Samɛlea azo la bazulo, bɛ nwo awozo bɛ, wɔ bɛ nvutuke ɛnlankɛ ananze ne mɔɔ ɛvi Bɛtɛle la ati. Menli ne bazu ye, yɛɛ sɛlɛvolɛma ne mɔ mɔɔ sonle ananze ne la bazu aye awolɛ wɔ ye anyunlunyia ne mɔɔ ɛdɔ aze ɛbɔ la ati. 6Ɛhɛe, bɛbava ananze ne bɛayɛ adwule bɛahɔdua bɛamaa Aselea maanle maanle belemgbunli kpole ne. Anyiemgba baha Yifelaemma na nyiane ahu Yizilayɛma wɔ bɛ mmonlezɔlɛ ti. 7Samɛlea belemgbunli ne baminli kɛ taboa ebule nretee mɔɔ la azule nye la. 8 Bɛbazɛkye awoka zo ɛzonlenlɛ ɛleka ne mɔ mɔɔ wɔ Evɛn mɔɔ Yizilayɛma kɔ ɛkɛ kɔsonle na bɛyɛ ɛtane la. Mbowule nee ndile bafifi bɛ azukponle ne mɔ azo. Na bɛbaha bɛahile awoka ne mɔ kɛ, “Bɛheda yɛ nwo zo!” na bɛaha bɛahile awoka ngyikyi kɛ, “Bɛdu bɛgua yɛ nwo zo.”
Ɛdɛnkɛma bua Yizilayɛ ndɛne
9 Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Sumunli kɛ Yizilayɛma yɛle ɛtane tiale me wɔ Gebɛya la, bɛtɛgyakyile ɛtane ɛyɛlɛ ne. Yemɔti konle bava bɛ aze wɔ Gebɛya. 10Mebara menli ɛhye mɔ mɔɔ ɛde atua la anwo zo mearadea bɛ. Maanle maanle baha abɔ nu aho atia bɛ, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛdua bɛ ɛtane dɔɔnwo ne mɔ anwo kakɛ la.
11“Ɛnee Yifelaem le kɛ ɛnlankɛ belɛ mɔɔ bɛtete ye, mɔɔ hulole kɛ ɔkɛwozo ma la. Noko mebava gyɛnvayile meagyɛnva ɔ kɔme kɛnlɛma ne meamaa yeayɛ gyima ɛsesebɛ. Ɔwɔ kɛ Dwuda funduvundu azɛlɛ ne yɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ Yizilayɛ siezie azɛlɛ ne maa ɔ nwo. 12 Menganle kɛ, ‘Bɛlua tenleneyɛlɛ ma na bɛabu ɛhulolɛ kpundii. Bɛzo azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ la mgbane la, ɔluakɛ mekɛ ɛdwu mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛkpondɛ medame, Ɛdɛnkɛma me bo zo a, amaa meara na mearawola ngoanelielɛ meagua bɛ nwo zo.’ 13Bɛlua amumuyɛ, bɛbu nzisi, bɛli adalɛ ma.
“Kɛmɔ bɛva bɛ rɛle bɛwula bɛ konle ehwili ne mɔ nee bɛ ɛlɔnema dɔɔnwo ne mɔ anu la, 14konle bava bɛ menli ne aze na bɛbabubu bɛ aranemgbole ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti. Ɔbayɛ kɛ mekɛ mɔɔ Belemgbunli Hyaleman zɛkyele suakpole Bɛtabɛle la. Wɔ konle ne anu, bɛvale mrɛladane mraalɛ nee bɛ mra bɛfifinle debie bɛhunle bɛ. 15Bɛmɛ Bɛtɛlema, bɛ amumuyɛ ne ati, debie mɔɔ bɛbava bɛayɛ bɛ la ɛne. Konle ne anu bɛbahu Yizilayɛ belemgbunli ne.”

Title: HOZ 11
Content:
Nyamenle ɛhulolɛ mɔɔ wɔ ye menli mɔɔ ɛde atua la anwo la
1 Ɛdɛnkɛma se,
“Mɔɔ Yizilayɛ le kakula la, mengulole ye,
na menvɛlɛle me ra nrenya ne menvile Yigyibiti.
2Na fane dɔɔnwo mɔɔ menvɛlɛle ye la,
fane dɔɔnwo ɔhwenle ɔ nwo ɔvile me nwo.
Me menli ne bɔle azu manle awozonle Beeyale ne mɔ
na bɛkpunle ɛyɛlɛ bɛmanle mmonle.
3Noko medame yɛɛ mengilele Yifelaemma ɛdialɛ a;
mendedɛle bɛ me sa zo,
noko bɛnze kɛ medame a meneanle bɛ a.
4Menvale ahunlunyeleyɛlɛ nee ɛhulolɛ menlile bɛ ti,
menyele bɛ kɔme kpomgbolo,
na membutule memanle bɛ aleɛ.
5“Bɛkpole kɛ bɛnrɛzia bɛnrɛra me nwo bieko, yemɔti bɛbazia bɛahɔ Yigyibiti, na Aselea bazie bɛ. 6Konle bava bɛ azuamgbole ne mɔ aze, abubu bɛ azuamgbole nlenkɛ mgbole ne mɔ. 7Me menli ne gyi zolɛ ɛsesebɛ kɛ bɛte bɛ nwo bɛavi me nwo. Yemɔti bɛva kpomgbolo bɛgua bɛ kɔme, na bɛnrɛnyia awie ɛnrɛye ɛnrɛmaa bɛ.
8 “O Yifelaem, kɛ ɔyɛ mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ meye wɔ memaa ɛ?
O Yizilayɛ, kɛ ɔyɛ mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ meye wɔ memaa ɛ?
Asoo ɔwɔ kɛ mesɛkye wɔ kɛ menzɛkyele Adema la?
Kɛ ɔyɛ mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ meyɛ wɔ kɛ menyɛle Zɛboyem la ɛ?
Me ahonle ɛndie me!
Me kunlu yelɛyela me kpole wɔ ɛ nwo.
9Menrɛva me ɛya kpole ne menrɛgua ɛ nwo zo,
menrɛzɛkye Yifelaem,
ɔluakɛ mele Nyamenle, menle sonla.
Medame a mele Nwuanzanwuanza Ko ne mɔɔ nee wɔ de la,
menrɛra kɛ mebazɛkye wɔ.
10“Saa metea me menli ne kpɔvolɛma ne mɔ nu kɛ awenade a, me menli ne akee badoa me bo zo. Saa metea nu a bɛbava anwowozolɛ bɛvi adɔleɛ bɛara. 11Bɛvi Yigyibiti bɛbava anwowozolɛ bɛara ndɛndɛ kɛ nloma la, yɛɛ bɛvi Aselea bɛbara kɛ abubule. Mebava bɛ meazia meahɔ bɛ azua nu. Medame, Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.”
Bɛbu Yizilayɛ nee Dwuda ewule fɔlɛ
12Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Yifelaem ɛva adalɛ ngome ɛbɔ ɛyia me, yɛɛ Yizilayɛma noko le mɛlɛbɛla. Na Dwuda ɛdeɛ, Nyamenle ze ye, yɛɛ ɔdi nɔhalɛ ɔmaa Nwuanzanwuanza Ko ne.

Title: HOZ 12
Content:
1“Debie biala mɔɔ Yifelaem yɛ, ɔvi nwonlomɔ mɔɔ kɔdwu nɔsolɛ la le mgbane na ɔsɛkye ninyɛne. Bɛbɔ adalɛ mɔnwo na bɛka konle. Bɛ nee Aselea yɛ ngyehyɛlɛ na bɛfa nwole bɛkɔ Yigyibiti.”
2Ɛdɛnkɛma lɛ edwɛkɛ tia Dwuda; ɔbadea Gyekɔbo abo zo amra ne mɔ wɔ bɛ nyɛleɛ ne mɔ anwo. Ɔbadua bɛ kakɛ wɔ mɔɔ bɛyɛ la anwo. 3 Bɛ nlenya Gyekɔbo nee ɔ diema Yisɔ pelele wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ bɛ nli akunlu la; na Gyekɔbo zɔle ɔ diema ne agyakɛ wɔ bɛ awolɛ nu; mɔɔ Gyekɔbo nyinle la, ɔ nee Nyamenle pelele. 4 Ɔ nee Nyamenle soanvolɛ ne pelele na ɔlile konim. Ɔzunle na ɔbizale ye nyilalɛ. Ɔyiale Nyamenle wɔ Bɛtɛle na ɛkɛ ne, Nyamenle nee ye dendɛle. 5Ɛhye a le Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle ne, ye duma a le Ɛdɛnkɛma. 6Yemɔti, Gyekɔbo abo zo amra, bɛ Nyamenle ne moalɛ ti, bɛzia bɛrɛla na bɛzɔ ɛhulolɛ nee pɛlepɛlelilɛ nu kpundii na bɛhendɛ bɛ Nyamenle ne dahuu.
Ndɛnebualɛ nwo edwɛkɛ bieko
7Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Gualilɛnli mɔɔ lɛ tone ɛtane ɔ sa nu la kulo kɛ ɔdi ye ɛdɔvolɛma nzisi. 8Yifelaemma ɛha kɛ: Aa, yɛnyia yɛ nwo; yɛdu ahu! Noko bɛ anyiabɛnwo ne ɛnrɛhola ɛtane ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛyɛ la anwo kakɛ tua ɛlɛ. 9 Medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne mɔɔ menyele bɛ menvile Yigyibiti la, mebamaa bɛadɛnlɛdɛnla ndanlɛ azua nu bieko, kɛmɔ ɛvoyialilɛ ne dwu zo a bɛyɛ la.
10“Mendendɛle mengilele me kpɔmanvolɛma ne mɔ, na memanle bɛnwunle ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ dɔɔnwo, na menluale me kpɔmanvolɛma ne anwo zo membule bɛ ɛrɛlɛ. 11Saa ninyɛndane bie tɛbɔ Geleade a, zolɛ ɛnrɛra nvasoɛ biala. Saa bɛfa nlankɛ nyinli bɛbɔ azu wɔ Gelegale a, azukponle ne mɔ mɔɔ wɔ ɛkɛ la bayɛ awolɛ edukue wɔ ɛya nu kofie ne mɔ avinli.”
12 Yɛ nlenya Gyekɔbo nriandile hɔle Mɛsɔpɔteemea, na ɔyɛle gyima, na raalɛ ti ɔnleanle mboane ɔvale ɔgyale raalɛ. 13 Ɛdɛnkɛma zoanle Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ manle ɔhɔyele Yizilayɛma ɔvile Yigyibiti na ɔnleanle bɛ gyɛlɛɛnye. 14Yifelaemma ɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛva ɛya kpole kpalɛ, yemɔti Ɛdɛnkɛma bamaa bɛ munzule ɛbɛla ne abɔ bɛ ti. Ɛdɛnkɛma bamaa anyiemgba mɔɔ bɛbɔ ye la abu azia bɛ.

Title: HOZ 13
Content:
Yizilayɛ ndɛnebualɛ mɔɔ li amozi
1Dɛba ne, saa Yifelaem tendɛ a, menli nwo wozo bɛ; bɛkpogyale ye zo wɔ Yizilayɛma avinli; na ɔluale bozonle Beeyale anwo zo ɔyɛle ɛtane na ɔwule. 2Kɛkala bɛtɛkɔ zolɛ bɛtɛyɛ ɛtane; bɛfa dwɛtɛ fufule bɛgua mmonle ananze mɔɔ dwinvolɛma a ɛyɛ la, na bɛse kɛ, “Bɛbɔ azu bɛmaa bɛ.” Menli ala, bɛdabɛ bɛfo nlankɛ ananze nloa anwo! 3Yemɔti menli ɛhye mɔ abo zo baminli kɛ nwonlomɔ nzulemungu anzɛɛ ɛbɔlɛ la. Bɛbayɛ kɛ abonle mɔɔ anwoma ɛlɛbɔ ye avi ma ɛwozolɛ ɛleka, anzɛɛ esike mɔɔ lua nvɛnzɛlɛ nu la.
4Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne mɔɔ yele bɛ vile Yigyibiti la. Bɛnlɛ Nyamenle biala kɛ medame ala. Bɛye me a bɛnlɛ dievolɛ biala. 5 Medame a meneanle bɛ wɔ fienemgbole ne mɔɔ nzule biala ɛnle nu la anu a. 6Na mɔɔ bɛdwule azɛlɛ kpalɛ ne azo na bɛlile bɛ ko yile la, bɛ mgbanyizonle yɛle kpole na bɛ rɛle vile me. 7Yemɔti mebayɛ bɛ kɔme nu kɛ awenade. Mebahakyi ɛrane meazia bɛ adenle nu. 8Mebateta bɛ kɛ bedi mɔɔ bɛhye ɔ mra, na meatete bɛ nu, na ɛkɛ ne, mebali bɛ kɛ awenade di nane, na meatete bɛ nzokanzoka kɛ nanemgbole tete nane la.
9“Yizilayɛma, mebazɛkye bɛ! Na nwane a kɛhola kɛboa bɛ a? 10 Bɛbizale bɛliele belemgbunli nee mgbanyima. Bɛ belemgbunli ne mɔɔ balie bɛ la wɔ nienwu? 11 Menvale ɛya yɛɛ menvale arelemgbunli ne mɔ memanle bɛ a, yɛɛ meva ɛya meye bɛ ɛkɛ.
12“Bɛbɔ Yifelaem ninyɛndane ne mɔ kpɔkɛ, bɛva ye ɛtane ne mɔ bɛzie ɛkɛ. 13Ɔmaa ɔ nli te awolɛ ne nyane, na ɔle koasea la ati, ɔmba. Ɔle kakula mɔɔ ye awolɛ mekɛ dwu a ɔnva ɔ ti ɔndua awodeɛ ne anloa a. 14 Memkpɔne bɛ menvi Ɛbolɔ tumi bo ɔ? Menlie bɛ menvi Ewule asa anu ɔ? O Ewule, wɔ bɔlɔ ne wɔ nienwu? O Ɛbolɔ, wɔ ɛzɛkyelɛ tumi ne wɔ nienwu? Anwunvɔnezelɛ ɛnle me nye zo bieko. 15Yifelaem banyi bokoboko kɛ baka ndɔ, noko mebamaa medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, me aduduleɛ anwoma wuluwulu ne adwazo ɛsɛlɛ ne azo abɔ asesa bɛ azɛlɛ bo nzule nee bɛ bula ne mɔ; ɔbaminli debie biala mɔɔ sonle bolɛ wɔ ye gya nu la abo zo. 16Mebadua Samɛlea kakɛ kɛ yede me nwo atua a. Ye menli ne bawu konle nu; bɛbava bɛ nlɔma ne mɔ bɛafifi debie bɛatete bɛ, na bɛatulutulu nrenzɛvolɛma ako.”

Title: HOZ 14
Content:
Hozia bodo Yizilayɛma
1Yizilayɛma, bɛzia bɛrɛla Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne ɛkɛ, ɔluakɛ bɛ ninyɛndane ɛmaa bɛdu koti. 2Bɛzia bɛhɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛkɛ na bɛva nzɛlɛlɛ ɛhye bɛdo ɔ nyunlu: “Fa yɛ ɛtane kɔsɔɔti kyɛ yɛ; die mɔɔ le kpalɛ la, na yɛbaye wɔ ayɛlɛ. 3Aselea ɛnrɛhola yɛ die, yɛɛ yɛnrɛvo konle mgbɔnwɔ zo bieko. Yɛnrɛha yɛnrɛhile yɛ mmonle ne mɔ mɔɔ yɛdayɛ yɛyɛ la bieko kɛ bɛle ‘Yɛ Nyamenle.’ O Ɛdɛnkɛma, ɛse nrisa anwunvɔne.”
Ɛdɛnkɛma bɔ Yizilayɛma ɛbɛla fofolɛ nwo ɛwɔkɛ
4Ɛdɛnkɛma se,
“Mebava me menli ne mɔɔ ɛnli nɔhalɛ la anwo edwɛkɛ meahyɛ bɛ.
Mebava me ahonle muala meahulo bɛ,
ɔluakɛ meye me ɛya ne bɛ nwo zo.
5Mebayɛ kɛ ɛbɔlɛ meadɔ meagua Yizilayɛma anwo zo.
Bɛbanyi bokoboko kɛ aloa,
bɛbasosɔ ndinli kɛ Lɛbanɔn mbaka.
6Bɛ ngane badɛlɛdɛlɛ,
bɛbayɛ ngɛnlɛma kɛ ɔlivi mbaka,
na bɛabɔ evuanlɛ kɛ Lɛbanɔn sida mbaka.
7Bɛbazia bɛaradɛnla me alubo ne anu.
Bɛbakpazi kɛ tola nu aleɛ;
bɛbabua kɛ vanye mbaka,
na bɛ evuanlɛ bayɛ kɛ Lɛbanɔn nwanye evuanlɛ la.
8O Yifelaem, duzu a me nee mmonle lɛ yɛ a?
Medame a mebua bɛ nzɛlɛlɛ nwo, menea bɛ nwo zo a.
Mele kɛ sepelɛse baka dokodoko,
medame a memaa bɛso ma a.”
Adwulaleɛ
9Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛze nrɛlɛbɛ la, bɛde edwɛkɛ ɛhye mɔ abo; bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛ deɛnwunlɛ la, bɛnwu ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ. Ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ndenle ne mɔ le fɔɔnwo, tenlenema fa bɔ bɛ ɛbɛla, yɛɛ ɛtanevolɛma tu nwolɛ koti.

Title: DWW MUKENYE
Content:
Mukenye
Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ Dwowɛle anwo edwɛkɛ ekyi bie yɛɛ yɛze a, yɛɛ mekɛ mɔɔ Dwowɛle vale dɛnlanle ewiade ye anu la awie ɛnze. Na ɔzɔho kɛ buluku ne bɛhɛlɛle wɔ mɔɔ ɛnee ɔka ɛvolɛ ɛya nnu anzɛɛ ɛya nna na bɛawo Kelaese ne la, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee Pɛhyea Maanle Maanle ne gyi zo la. Dwowɛle ka kɛ abɛbɛ zile vale Palɛsetanye maanle ne nee kɛ nzule kɔsɔɔti zile sesanle Palɛsetanye maanle ne anu la.
Mɔɔ edwɛkɛ ɛhye mɔ ɛlɛsisi la, Dwowɛle nwunle kɛ bɛle Awulae ɛralɛ Kenle ne anwo sɛkɛlɛneɛ, mɔɔ kile kɛ ɔle mekɛ mɔɔ Awulae bava adea bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛtia ye tenlene ɛhulolɛdeɛ ne la. Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ ne fa Awulae nrɛlaleɛ ne mɔɔ se bɛnlu bɛ nwo, nee ye ɛwɔkɛbɔlɛ ne mɔɔ se ɔbava ye menli ne yeazie bɛ gyinlabelɛ dɛba ne na yeayila bɛ la to gua. Ye edwɛkɛ ne kɔsɔɔti, mɔɔ da ali wienyi kpalɛ kpalɛ la a le ɛwɔkɛ ne mɔɔ se Nyamenle bamaa ye sunsum ne ara menli kɔsɔɔti, mrenya nee mraalɛ, ngakula nee mgbanyinli anwo zo la.
Mɔɔ wɔ nu la
Abɛbɛ fa maanle ne 1.1—2.17
Menli ne gyinlabelɛ dɛba ne anwo ɛwɔkɛbɔlɛ 2.18-27
Awulae Kenle ne 2.28—3.21

Title: DWW 1
Content:
1Nrɛlaleɛ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma vale manle Pɛtuwɛle ara nrenya Dwowɛle la ɛne.
Menli ne di nyane wɔ bɛ bɛyɔba ɛzɛkyelɛ nwo
2Bɛdie, bɛmɛ mgbanyinli;
bɛyɛ ɛnzonlɛ, bɛmɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ azɛlɛ ne azo.
Edwɛkɛ ɛhye, asoo bie ɛzi bɛ mekɛ zo,
anzɛɛ bɛ ze mɔ mekɛ zo ɛlɛ?
3Bɛha bɛhile bɛ mra,
na bɛ mra noko ɛha ɛhile bɛ mra,
na bɛdabɛ noko bɛha bɛhile awolɛndoazo mɔɔ bara la.
4Mɔɔ abɛbɛ mɔɔ pɛ la pɛle na mɔɔ hale la,
abɛbɛ tɔka ralile.
Mɔɔ abɛbɛ tɔka ne gyakyile la,
abɛbɛ bɛnyebɛnye ne mɔ ralile,
yɛɛ mɔɔ abɛbɛ bɛnyebɛnye ne mɔ gyakyile la,
abɛbɛ sɛkyevolɛma ralile.
5Bɛdwazo na bɛzu, bɛmɛ nzabovoma;
nwanye ne fɛlɛko ti,
bɛmɛ nwanyenovoma, bɛzu bɛye awolɛ,
ɔluakɛ bɛye bɛvi bɛ nloa.
6 Ɔluakɛ abɛbɛ ɛlɔne ɛteta azɛlɛ ye;
bɛ nwo yɛ se yɛɛ bɛ nwo zonle kpalɛ
mɔɔ bɛtia bɛ a ɔnyɛ boɛ a;
bɛ gye nlane le kɛ awenade gye,
yɛɛ bɛ gye ndendenle le kɛ awenade belɛ gye.
7Bɛzɛkye yɛ vanye mbaka ne mɔ,
na bɛli yɛ feege mbaka ne mɔ.
Bɛli, bɛkeka mbaka ne anwo abonle ne mɔ bɛgua;
bɛmaa ngane ne mɔ anwo ɛyɛ nwohyee.
8Bɛzu kɛ belamunli raalɛ mɔɔ ɛheda ɛrele
ɛlɛsu nrenya mɔɔ gyale ye ye mbɛlɛra nu la.
9Ma azubɔdeɛ nee nza azubɔdeɛ
ɛwie Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu.
Sɛlɛvolɛma, Ɛdɛnkɛma sonvolɛma ne su di nyane,
(ɔboalekɛ bɛnnyia azubɔdeɛ bɛmmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma).
10Ɛya avule ne mɔ ɛdɔ mgbane;
ma ne mɔ ɛzɛkye,
ɔboalekɛ azɛlɛ ne ɛhete;
vanye ma ne mɔ ɛnwoso,
yɛɛ ɔlivi mbaka ne mɔ ɛwu.
11Bɛmɛ ɛyazonlɛma, bɛli nyane;
bɛzu, bɛmɛ vanye egyinli zo neavolɛma,
ɔboalekɛ hwiiti ne, baale ne,
ɛya ne mɔ anu bɛyɔba ne mɔ ɛzɛkye.
12Vanye mbaka ne mɔ ɛwu,
feege mbaka ne mɔ ɛdwɔlɔdwɔlɔ.
Ma mɔɔ le kɛ akutue, mrɛlɛ nee ampolo,
ɛbɔ nu mbaka kɔsɔɔti ɛwie wu.
Menli anyelielɛ ɛwie.
13O sɛlɛvolɛma, bɛheda ɛrele na bɛzu,
sonvolɛma mɔɔ sonle azukponle ne anwo, bɛzu.
Bɛhɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu, bɛheda ɛrele nɔe ne kɔsɔɔti,
O me Nyamenle ne sonvolɛma!
Ɔboalekɛ ma azubɔdeɛ nee nza azubɔdeɛ
ɛwie bɛ Nyamenle ne Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu.
14Bɛmaa menli ne ɛhye ɛhɔne;
bɛvɛlɛ Nyamenlezonlenlɛ ayia.
Bɛboɔboa mgbanyima ne mɔ
nee menli kɔsɔɔti mɔɔ wɔ azɛlɛ ne azo la anloa
wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu
na bɛzu bɛvɛlɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma.
15 Ɔbayɛ ɛzulolɛ kpole wɔ kenle ne!
Ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma kenle ne ɛbikye,
ɔle kenle mɔɔ Tumivolɛ ne bava azɛkye ninyɛne a.
16Bɛlɛsɛkye yɛ aleɛ ne mɔ,
noko yɛ nye gyi nwolɛ mgbane.
Anyelielɛ ɛnle yɛ Nyamenle ne Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu ko.
17Ma ne mɔ nwoso kofie ne mɔ anu,
ninyɛne ɛzielɛ ɛleka ne mɔ ɛdɔ mgbane;
ma ɛzielɛleka ne mɔ ɛzɛkye,
ɔboalekɛ aleɛ anyɛ kpalɛ.
18Nanemgbole ɛlɛkponle!
Nlankɛ adwenle ɛha ɛbɔ nu,
ɔboalekɛ bɛnlɛ adidileka;
mboane bɔbɔ ɛlɛnwu amaneɛ.
19Mesu mefɛlɛ wɔ, O Ɛdɛnkɛma.
Ɔluakɛ senle ɛyela fienemgbole nu adidileka ne mɔ,
yɛɛ sendɔlɔra ɛyela kpɔkɛ nu mbaka kɔsɔɔti.
20Nanemgbole bɔbɔ su fɛlɛ wɔ,
ɔboalekɛ azudenle kɔsɔɔti ɛsesa,
yɛɛ senle ɛyela fienemgbole nu adidileka ne mɔ.

Title: DWW 2
Content:
Abɛbɛ ne mɔ le Ɛdɛnkɛma Kenle ne kɔkɔbɔlɛ
1Bɛwu aweɛne tendenle ne anu wɔ Zayɔn;
bɛbɔ bubu wɔ me boka nwuanzanwuanza ne azo!
Bɛmaa menli mɔɔ wɔ azɛlɛ ne azo la kɔsɔɔti anwo ɛwozo bɛ,
ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma kenle ne ɛlɛba, yedwu bɔbɔ asɛɛ.
2Ɔbayɛ awozinli nee alɔbɔlɛ kenle,
amungu nee awozinli kabii kenle.
Abɛbɛ ɛlɔne ɛyɛ kɛ menli anwo ɛzulolɛ,
ɛheda awoka ne mɔ azo kɛ awozinli.
Ɛhye, ɔvi tete, bie ɛtɛsile ɛlɛ,
yɛɛ bieko ɛnrɛzi ɛlɛ
wɔ awolɛndoazo kɔsɔɔti mɔɔ bara la anu.
3Senle sɛkye ninyɛne mɔɔ wɔ bɛ nyunlu,
yɛɛ sendɔlɔra yela ninyɛne mɔɔ wɔ bɛ nzi la.
Azɛlɛ ne le kɛ Yidɛn Tola wɔ bɛ nyunlu,
bɛpɛ nu a bɛ nzi yɛ ɛsɛlɛ mɔɔ ɛdɔ mgbane a,
yɛɛ debie biala ɛnvi bɛ sa.
4 Ɛnwu bɛ a bɛle kɛ mgbɔnwɔ,
yɛɛ bɛnriandi kɛ konle mgbɔnwɔ.
5Saa bɛlɛwuluwulu awoka ne mɔ azo a,
bɛ nwo alɛra le kɛ konle ehwili;
bɛ nwo tetɛ kɛ senle la ndile welera nu.
Bɛsolo bɛ kɛ ɛlɔne kpole bie mɔɔ ɛlɛkɔ konle la.
6Saa bɛye bɛ ti a, bɛ nwo ɛzulolɛ tɔ awie biala anwo zo;
awie biala anyunlu to.
7Bɛteta kɛ ɛlɔnema;
bɛfo bane kɛ ɛlɔnema.
Bɛ muala bɛkɔ bɛ nyunlu fɔɔnwo.
Bɛndɔ bɛngɔ fema zo yɛɛ bɛndɔ bɛngɔ bɛne zo.
8Bɛnzuhuzuhu bɛ nwo,
biala dua ye adenle ɛdeɛ ne anu.
Bɛbɔ bɛfa adendualɛ biala anu,
yɛɛ debie biala ɛngola ɛnzi bɛ aze.
9Bɛtu twi bɛkɔ suakpole ne azo;
bɛduolua bane ne mɔ anwo;
bɛfo bɛkɔ azua ne mɔ anu,
bɛdua nvɛnzɛlɛ ne mɔ anu kɛ nwule.
10Saa bɛlɛba a azɛlɛ kpusu,
anwumaneamra anwo wozo bɛ.
Sɛnzɛne ne nee siane ne du,
na nwɔlɔra gyakyi ɛdalɛ.
11Ɛdɛnkɛma tendɛ ɛsesebɛ zo
kile ye ɛlɔne ne.
Ɔluakɛ ye ɛlɔne ne le kpole;
mɔɔ di ye mɛla zo la anwo yɛ ɛzulolɛ.
Ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma kenle ne le kpole, ɔyɛ ɛzulolɛ.
Nwane a kɛhola gyinla a?
Bɛnlu bɛ nwo
12Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Kɛkala bɔbɔ,
awie biala ɛva ɛhɔnehyelɛ, ɛzunlɛ nee nyanelilɛ,
yɛɛ ye ahonle kɔsɔɔti ɛzia ɛrɛla me nwo ɛke.
13Bɛtete bɛ ahonle nu na tɛ bɛ adɛladeɛ nu ɔ.”
Bɛzia bɛhɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne ɛkɛ,
ɔluakɛ ɔle dovolɛ nee anwunvɔnezelɛnli;
ɔnva ɛya mgbane mgbane, ye ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne le kpole,
yɛɛ dahuu ɔfa ɛtane ɔkyɛ.
14Wɔannea Ɛdɛnkɛma bahakyi ye adwenle,
yeagyakyi bɛ nyilalɛ dɔɔnwo wɔ ɛhye anzi,
amaa bɛava ma nee nza azubɔdeɛ
bɛamaa Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne.
15Bɛwu aweɛne tendenle ne anu wɔ Zayɔn;
bɛmaa menli ne ɛhye ɛhɔne;
bɛvɛlɛ Nyamenlezonlenlɛ ayia.
16Bɛboɔboa menli ne anloa.
Bɛnlua menli mɔɔ ɛyia ɛlɛsonle la;
bɛboɔboa mgbanyima ne mɔ anloa;
bɛboɔboa ngakula ne mɔ anloa,
bɛboɔboa nlɔma mɔɔ la nyɛfonlɛ nloa la anloa.
Bɛmaa atɔfolɛ nrenya ne vi ye ekpumgbunli ne anu evinde,
na atɔfolɛ raalɛ ne vi ye suakunlu ɛvinde.
17Bɛmaa sɛlɛvolɛma mɔɔ ɛlɛsonle Nyamenle
wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anuhɔlɛ ne nee azukponle ne avinli la ɛzu ɛzɛlɛ kɛ,
“O Ɛdɛnkɛma, nwu wɔ menli ne anwunvɔne.
Mmamaa maanle maanle ne mɔ
kpo yɛ, bɛsi yɛ amgbu bɛka kɛ,
‘Bɛ Nyamenle ne wɔ nienwu?’ ”
Nyamenle maa azɛlɛ ne ahye aleɛ bieko
18Akee Ɛdɛnkɛma hwenle ye azɛlɛ ne anwo nungule,
na ɔnwunle ye menli ne anwunvɔne.
19Ɛdɛnkɛma buale ye menli ne kɛ,
“Bɛnlea, melɛbɛlɛ bɛ ma, nwanye, nee nwole,
na bɛ nwo badɔ bɛ;
menrɛmaa maanle maanle ɛnrɛgolo bɛ nwo bieko.
20Mebavoa abɛbɛ ɛlɔne ne mɔɔ vi sɔlɔ rale la,
mebavoa bie mɔ meahɔgua ɛsɛlɛ ne azo lɔ.
Mebavoa bɛ ɛlɔne ne mɔɔ lumua la
meahɔgua Nyevile Wulera ne anu,
na meavoa mɔɔ li bɛ nzi la
meahɔgua Mɛdetɛlenia Nyevile ne anu.
Bɛ avunli ne mɔ babɔ,
ɔluakɛ ninyɛndane mɔɔ bɛyɛ la le kpole.
21“O azɛlɛ, mmasulo;
di fɛlɛko na maa ɛ nye ɛlie,
ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛyɛ ninyɛne mgbole!
22Bɛmmasulo, bɛmɛ ɛbɔ nu nanemgbole,
ɔluakɛ fienemgbole nu adidileka ne mɔ ɛbua;
mbaka ne mɔ so ma,
feege baka nee vanye ɛzo dɔɔnwo.
23“Bɛli fɛlɛko, O Zayɔnoma,
na bɛmaa bɛ nye ɛlie Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne anwo,
ɔluakɛ yemaa ezule ɛdɔ ndɛ ɛbua bɛ benle,
yemaa ezule ɛdɔ, nzule ɛbu bɛ nwo zo,
alumua nee amozi ezule ɛdɔ kɛ dɛba ne ala la.
24Ma bayi ma ɛwozolɛ ɛleka ne mɔ,
nwanye nee nwole bayi angola mgbole ne mɔ.
25Ɛvolɛ dodo ma mɔɔ abɛbɛ ne mɔ lile la
mebava ɔ muala meamaa bɛ.
Abɛbɛ bɛnyebɛnye, sɛkyera nee
mɔɔ pɛ ma ne mɔ la, ɛlɔne kpole ne,
medame a menzoanle ɛlɔne ɛhye bɛ nwo zo a.
26Bɛbanyia aleɛ dɔɔnwo bɛali, bɛ ko ayi,
na bɛaye Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne ayɛlɛ,
yemɔ a yeyɛ ninyɛne mgbole yemaa bɛ a.
Me menli ne anyunlu ɛnrɛgua aze bieko.
27Na Yizilayɛma banwu kɛ mede bɛ avinli,
na medame, Ɛdɛnkɛma a mele bɛ Nyamenle a,
awie bieko ɛnle ɛkɛ.
Na menli ne anyunlu ɛnrɛgua aze bieko.
Ɛdɛnkɛma Kenle ne
28 “Na ɔbara kɛ nzinlii,
mebawola me Sunsum ne meagua awie biala anwo zo:
bɛ mra mrenya nee bɛ mra mraalɛ baha me nrɛlaleɛ ne;
bɛ mgbanyinli baha ɛlalɛ,
na bɛ mgbavolɛ anwu ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ.
29Mekɛ ne anu mebawola me Sunsum ne
meagua sonvolɛ mrenya nee mraalɛ anwo zo.
30“Mebahile kenle ne anwo sɛkɛlɛneɛ wɔ anwomanyunlu
nee azɛlɛ ye azo;
bɛbaha mogya bɛagua,
senle nee esike mungumungu bavinde.
31 Sɛnzɛne ne balu kisii,
na siane ne ayɛ kɔkɔlɛ kɛ mogya
kolaa na Ɛdɛnkɛma kenle kpole
anu ɛzulolɛ ne ara.
32 Na ɔbara kɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛvɛlɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma la
bɛbalie bɛ ngoane,
ɔluakɛ wɔ Zayɔn Boka nee Gyɛlusalɛm,
bie mɔ bavi ɛsalɛ, kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛha la,
na bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛbaha la anu
yɛɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma bavɛlɛ bɛ la wɔ a.”

Title: DWW 3
Content:
Nyamenle babua maanle maanle ne mɔ ndɛne
1Ɛdɛnkɛma se,
“Mekɛ zɔhane mɔɔ mebava Dwuda
nee Gyɛlusalɛm anwonyia ne meamaa bɛ la,
2mebaboɔboa maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti anloa
na me nee bɛ ahɔ Ndɛnebualɛ Bɔnza ne anu.
Ɛkɛ ne yɛɛ mebabua bɛ ndɛne
wɔ mɔɔ bɛva bɛyɛ me menli nee me agyadeɛ
Yizilayɛma la ati.
Bɛbɔ Yizilayɛma asande bɛgua maanle maanle zo,
na bɛhyɛ me azɛlɛ ne bɛva.
3Bɛguale me menli ne ati nzeleba
kɛ nwane mɔ a me menli nuokɛma ne kɛyɛ bɛ ɛdeɛ a.
Bɛdɔnenle mralɛ mrenya bɛvale ezukoa
ne bɛbɔle tuutuu ɛbɛla,
na bɛdɔnenle mralɛ mraalɛ bɛvale
ezukoa ne bɛnlonle nwanye.
4 “Taya, Saedɛn, nee Filisitia maanzinli ne mɔ, duzu a bɛkpondɛ kɛ bɛyɛ a? Bɛkulo kɛ bɛdi me nzenralɛ wɔ debie bie ati ɔ? Saa bɛyɛ zɔhane a, menwɔdua bɛ kakɛ ndɛndɛ wɔ bɛdabɛ bɛ nyɛleɛ nwo. Zɛf 2.4-7; Zɛk 9.1-7; Mat 11.21-22; Luk 10.13-14 5Bɛva me dwɛtɛ fufule nee me ezukoa nvutuke, na bɛzoa me anwonyia kɔsɔɔti bɛhɔ bɛ mmonle azua nu. 6Bɛva Dwudama nee Gyɛlusalɛmma bɛvi bɛ maanle nu bɛhɔ moa moa, bɛdɔne bɛ bɛmaa Gilikima. 7Na kɛkala meye bɛ meavi maanle mɔɔ bɛdɔnenle bɛ bɛhɔle nu la anu. Na mɔɔ bɛva bɛyɛ bɛ la, mebayɛ bɛ bie meadua. 8Mebadɔne bɛ mra mrenya nee bɛ mra mraalɛ meamaa Dwudama; bɛdabɛ noko bɛbadɔne bɛ bɛamaa Sabema mɔɔ wɔ moa moa lɔ la. Medame, Ɛdɛnkɛma a medendɛ a.
9“Bɛbɔ nolo ɛhye wɔ maanle maanle avinli:
Bɛboɔboa bɛ nwo wɔ konle nu;
Katakyiema, bɛkpusu bɛ nwo;
bɛmaa ɛlɔnema ɛhwe ɛbikye.
10 Bɛbolo bɛ azɛlɛvudulɛ mbulalɛ ne mɔ ati bɛyɛ konle dadeɛ,
na bɛbolo bɛ ɛdedadeɛ ndendenle ne mɔ bɛyɛ atwɛ.
Bɛmaa sonla mɔɔ ɛwie tuto la ɛha ye kɛ, ‘Mele ɛlɔnenli.’
11Bɛha bɛ nwo bɛrɛla,
bɛmɛ maanle maanle mɔɔ ɛbɔ ɛyia,
na bɛboɔboa bɛ nloa wɔ bɔnza ne anu.”
O Ɛdɛnkɛma, maa wɔ ɛlɔnema ɛrateta bɛ.
12“Bɛmaa maanle maanle ne mɔ ɛboɔboa bɛ nwo,
na bɛrɛla Ndɛnebualɛ Bɔnza ne anu.
Ɛkɛ ne yɛɛ medame, Ɛdɛnkɛma, mebadɛnla
meabua maanle maanle mɔɔ ɛbɔ ɛyia bɛ la ndɛne a.
13 Bɛkpogya ɛdedadeɛ ne zo,
ɔluakɛ bɛyɔba ne ɛbolo.
Bɛhɔ, bɛhwihwi nwanye ne,
ɔluakɛ nwanye melahyinli ne ɛyi.
Angola ne mɔ ɛyiyi ɛbulu zo,
bɛ amumuyɛ le kpole.”
14Apenle apenle, apenle apenle
wɔ Ndɛnebualɛ Bɔnza ne anu.
Ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma mekɛ ne ɛbikye,
ɔbazi Ndɛnebualɛ Bɔnza ne anu.
15Sɛnzɛne ne nee siane ne balu ayɛ awozinli,
yɛɛ nwɔlɔra bagyakyi ɛdalɛ.
Nyamenle bayila ye menli ne
16 Ɛdɛnkɛma kulu wɔ Zayɔn Boka;
ɔ ne kpusu wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm,
na anwuma nee azɛlɛ kpusu.
Ɛdɛnkɛma le ye menli ne ɛvealeka,
ɔle aranemgbole ɔmaa Yizilayɛma.
17“Yemɔti bɛbanwu kɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne,
mɔɔ mede Zayɔn, me boka nwuanzanwuanza ne azo la.
Gyɛlusalɛm bayɛ nwuanzanwuanza,
na nyɛvolɛ ɛnrɛze zolɛ bieko ɛlɛ.
18“Kenle zɔhane nwanye fɛlɛko
vi awoka ne mɔ anu bazonyi,
meleke baze awoka ngyikyi ne mɔ azo,
nzule bayi Dwuda azule kɔsɔɔti;
nzufeanvea vi Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu bazenze
aze kɛ azule wɔ Akasea Bɔnza.
19“Yigyibiti bahakyi ɛsɛlɛ,
na Yidɔm adɔ mgbane,
ɔboalekɛ bɛvale konle bɛdoale Dwuda maanle ne
na bɛhunle menli mɔɔ ɛnze nwolɛ bie la.
20Na Dwuda bayɛ menli gbudugbudu dahuu,
Gyɛlusalɛm bayɛ zɔhane yeahɔdwu awolɛndoazo
kɔsɔɔti anwo zo.
21Mebali me menli ne mogya nwo nzenralɛ,
menrɛva menli mɔɔ di fɔlɛ la ɛtane menrɛhyɛ bɛ,
ɔluakɛ medame Ɛdɛnkɛma mede Zayɔn Boka.”

Title: EMƆ MUKENYE
Content:
Mukenye
Baebolo ne anu, Emɔso a le Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ mɔɔ lumua mɔɔ bɛhɛlɛle ye Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ ne amuala a. Ɔvi Dwuda sua bie azo ɛdeɛ, noko ɔbɔle ye Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ ne nolo ɔhilele menli mɔɔ wɔ Yizilayɛ sɔlɔ belemgbunli maanle ne anu, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɔka ɛvolɛ ɛya mɔtwɛ na bɛawo Kelaese ne la. Mekɛ ne anu ɛnee Yizilayɛma ɛkpazi kpole kpalɛ, Nyamenle ɛzonlenlɛ ɛlie ebia, yɛɛ menli ne de anwondɔlɛ nu. Na Emɔso nwunle kɛ sukoavolɛma angome yɛɛ ɛkpazi a, yɛɛ bɛ ɛkpazilɛ ne gyi bɛ nɔhalɛ mɔɔ bɛnli nee ɛsisilɛ mɔɔ bɛsisi ehyianvolɛma la azo. Bɛnli nɔhalɛ wɔ Nyamenlezonlenlɛ nu yɛɛ bɛ anwondɔlɛ ne le ɛnyelɛzo debie ala na ɔnli munli. Emɔso lile ɛhye anwo nyane na ɔzile ye ɛbolɛ ɔbɔle nolo kɛ Nyamenle badea maanle ne. Ɔzele kɛ bɛmaa pɛlepɛlelilɛ “ɛze kɛ azudenle,” na ɔhanle kɛ, “Wɔannea a Awulae kɛze menli mɔɔ de ngoane nu wɔ maanle ye anu la anwunvɔne.” (5.15)
Mɔɔ wɔ nu la
Maanle maanle mɔɔ zuozua Yizilayɛ la ndeanlɛ 1.1—2.5
Yizilayɛ ndeanlɛ 2.6—6.14
Ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ nnu 7.1—9.15

Title: EMƆ 1
Content:
1Edwɛkɛ mɔɔ mboaneneavolɛ Emɔso mɔɔ vi Tɛkowa la hanle la ɛne. Mɔɔ ɔhale ɛvolɛ nwiɔ na azɛlɛ ne akpusu, mɔɔ ɛnee Ɛzaya a le belemgbunli wɔ Dwuda na Gyɛhowahye ara nrenya Gyɛlɔbowam a le belemgbunli wɔ Yizilayɛ la, Nyamenle yele ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ mɔɔ fane Yizilayɛ maanle ne anwo la hilele Emɔso.
2 Emɔso hanle kɛ,
“Ɛdɛnkɛma kulu wɔ Zayɔn Boka;
ɔ ne kpusu Gyɛlusalɛm.
Mboaneneavolɛma adidileka ne mɔ ɛwe,
Kamɛle Boka ne azo ndile ne mɔ ɛwu.”
Maanle maanle mɔɔ zuozua Yizilayɛ la ndeanlɛ
Selea
3 Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Dɛmasekɛsema yɛ ɛtane la ɛnee bɛyɛ, na mebadea bɛ wɔ ɛhye anwo, ɔboalekɛ bɛva atisesebɛ amaamuo bɛbu Geleadema. 4Yemɔti mebado senle Belemgbunli Hazeeyɛle suakunlu ɛkɛ na senle ne bayela Belemgbunli Bɛneheedade aranemgbole ne mɔ. 5Mebagologolo suakpole Dɛmasekɛse nlenkɛ mgbole ne mɔ na meaye Evɛn Bɔnza ne anu amra nee Bɛteyidɛn meavi me nye zo. Bɛbahye Seleama bɛahɔ nlɔnu wɔ Kɛɛ.”
Filisitia
6 Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Gazama yɛ ɛtane la ɛnee bɛyɛ, na mebadea bɛ wɔ ɛhye anwo, ɔboalekɛ bɛhyele maanle mumua ko anu amra bɛhɔle nlɔnu na bɛdɔnenle bɛ bɛmanle Yidɔmma. 7Yemɔti mebado senle Gaza bane ne mɔ anu, na senle ne bayela ye aranemgbole ne mɔ. 8Mebahu Ahyedɔdoma nee Ahyekɛlɔn belemgbunli ne. Mebadea suakpole Ɛkelɔn, na Filisitiama mɔɔ ɛha la amuala bawu.”
Taya
9 Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Tayama yɛ ɛtane la ɛnee bɛyɛ, na mebadea bɛ wɔ ɛhye anwo, ɔboalekɛ bɛyele maanle mumua ko anu amra amuala bɛmanle Yidɔmma. Bɛangakye mediemayɛlɛ ngyekyeleɛ ne mɔɔ bɛ nee bɛ yɛle la. Luk 10.13-14 10Yemɔti mebado senle suakpole Taya bane ne mɔ anu, na senle ne bayela ye aranemgbole ne mɔ.”
Yidɔm
11 Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Yidɔmma yɛ ɛtane la ɛnee bɛyɛ, na mebadea bɛ wɔ ɛhye anwo, ɔboalekɛ bɛvale konle bɛyɛle bɛ mediema Yizilayɛma kpɔdekpɔde, bɛanze bɛ anwunvɔne. Bɛ ɛya ne andwo ɛlɛ. Oba 1-14; Mal 1.2-5 12Yemɔti mebado senle suakpole Timan azo na ɔbayela Bɔzela aranemgbole ne mɔ.”
Amɔn
13 Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Amɔnoma yɛ ɛtane la ɛnee bɛyɛ, na mebadea bɛ wɔ ɛhye anwo, ɔboalekɛ bɛko bɛakpondɛ azɛlɛ bɛaboka bɛ maanle ne anwo la, bɛhunle Geleade nrenzɛvolɛma. 14Yemɔti mebado senle suakpole Relaba bane ne mɔ anu, na senle ne bayela ye aranemgbole ne mɔ. Akee bɛbadeɛdea nu wɔ konle kenle ne, na konle ne anu bayɛ se kɛ ahumuakyima la. 15Bɛbahye bɛ belemgbunli ne nee ye mgbanyima ne mɔ bɛahɔ nlɔnu.”

Title: EMƆ 2
Content:
Mowabe
1 Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Mowabema yɛ ɛtane la ɛnee bɛyɛ, na mebadea bɛ wɔ ɛhye anwo, ɔboalekɛ bɛyelale Yidɔm belemgbunli ne mbowule bɛmanle bɛdɔle nzonle. 2Yemɔti mebado senle Mowabe azɛlɛ zo na ɔbazɔ yeayela Kɛleɔto aranemgbole ne mɔ. Mowabema bawu konle nu wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛlɔnema ne ɛlɛteɛdea nu na bɛlɛwu aweɛne ndendenle nu la. 3Mebahu Mowabe belemgbunli ne nee ye mgbanyima mɔɔ wɔ azɛlɛ ne azo la amuala.”
Dwuda
4Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Dwudama yɛ ɛtane la ɛnee bɛyɛ, na mebadea bɛ wɔ ɛhye anwo, ɔboalekɛ bɛkpo Ɛdɛnkɛma mɛla ne, yɛɛ bɛanli ye ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔ azo. Bɛli nyamenle adalɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛ mgbanyima zonlenle bɛ la anzi toonwo bɛminli. 5Yemɔti mebado senle Dwuda azɛlɛ zo na ɔbazɔ yeayela Gyɛlusalɛm aranemgbole ne mɔ.”
Nyamenle ndeanlɛ wɔ Yizilayɛma anwo zo
6Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Yizilayɛma yɛ ɛtane la ɛnee bɛyɛ, na mebadea bɛ wɔ ɛhye anwo, ɔboalekɛ bɛtɔne tenlenema bɛdie dwɛtɛ fufule, yɛɛ bɛtɔne ehyianvolɛma bɛdie mgbɔlaboa. 7Bɛtietia menli mɔɔ bɛ anwosesebɛ ɛwie nee menli mɔɔ ɛnlɛ boavolɛ la anwo zo, na bɛsuhu menli mɔɔ ɛlɛdi nyane la bɛsie ahane. Ralɛ nrenya nee ɔ ze fa raalɛ ko na bɛgua me duma nwuanzanwuanza ne anwo evinli. 8Bɛkundohundo bɛ nwo aze wɔ azukponle biala anyunlu, wɔ adɛladeɛ mɔɔ bɛva bɛwula bɛ lɔ awoba la azo, na bɛno nwanye mɔɔ bɛbɔ menli kakɛ bɛlie la wɔ bɛ Nyamenle ne ɛzonlenlɛ sua ne anu.
9 “Noko bɛmɛ bɛ ti, menzɛkyele Amɔlema, mɔɔ bɛ ndendenle le kɛ sida mbaka na bɛ anwosesebɛ le kɛ oku mbaka la bɔkɔɔ membɔle bɛ bo zo. 10Eza menyele bɛ menvile Yigyibiti azɛlɛ zo, na menlile bɛ nyunlu wɔ fienemgbole ne anu toonwo ɛvolɛ abulanla, na menvale Amɔlema azɛlɛ ne memanle bɛ, memanle bɛvale bɛyɛle bɛ ti anwo ɛdeɛ. 11 Menyele bɛ mra mrenya ne bie mɔ menyɛle bɛ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma, na memanle bɛ mgbavolɛ ne bie mɔ dule bɛ nwo ziele ahane manle Nyamenle na bɛbɔle ɛwɔkɛ kɛ bɛnrɛnlo nwanye, bɛnrɛpepɛ bɛ ti, yɛɛ bɛnrɛva bɛ sa bɛnrɛha funli. O Yizilayɛma, asoo ɛhye ɛnle nɔhalɛ? Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mebiza bɛ a.
12“Noko bɛmanle menli mɔɔ dule bɛ nwo manle Nyamenle la nlonle nwanye, na bɛduale Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma kɛ bɛmmaka me nrɛlaleɛ ne. 13Na bɛnlea, mebahomo bɛ nwo zo azɛlɛ ne anwo kɛ ehwili mɔɔ abɛlɛ ngyekyeleɛ ɛyi ye tɛkɛɛ na yemi la. 14Menli mɔɔ anwo yɛ ndɛ la ɛnrɛhola nriandi; anwosesebɛma agbɔkɛ nu batuto, yɛɛ katakyiema ɛnrɛhola bɛ nwo ngoane die. 15Menli mɔɔ to ɛda la ɛnrɛnyia gyinlagyakɛ, menli mɔɔ agyakɛ anzi kola bɛ kpalɛ kpalɛ la ɛnrɛvi ɛsalɛ, yɛɛ menli mɔɔ ka mgbɔnwɔ la ɛnrɛva bɛ nwo dwɔɔ. 16Kenle zɔhane menli mɔɔ akɛnra yɛ se wɔ katakyiema avinli bɔbɔ la bagua bɛ adu aze alɛ bɛ sa mgbane agua ndwɛlɛ aze.” Kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma se la ɛne.

Title: EMƆ 3
Content:
1O Yizilayɛma, bɛdie edwɛkɛ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛha ɛtia bɛmɛ maanle mumua ko mɔɔ ɔyele bɛ ɔvile Yigyibiti la. 2Ɔse, “Maanle maanle mɔɔ wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo la kɔsɔɔti, ɛdawɔ ɛ ngomekye ala yɛɛ meze wɔ na menlea wɔ gyɛlɛɛnye a, yemɔti mebadea wɔ, wɔ wɔ amumuyɛ ne mɔ ati.”
Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ ne gyima
3Menli nwiɔ ɛngola ɛmbɔ nu ɛndu adenle, kyesɛ bɛka bɛsie.
4Awenade ɛmkpo kpɔkɛ nu, kyesɛ yenwu nane mɔɔ ɔkye ye yeali la.
Awenade ralɛ ɛnzu mgbane wɔ ye tunli ne anu, kyesɛ yenyia debie mɔɔ ɔdi la.
5Asoo anloma to ɛhane wɔ azɛlɛ nwo, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛtɛsuale ye ɛhane la?
Asoo ɛhane fuandi, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ debie ɛtɛkanle ye la? 6Asoo bɛwu aweɛne tendenle ne anu wɔ suakpole ne azo a menli ahonle ɛndu?
Asoo munzule to suakpole, kyesɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛɛ ɛyɛ a?
7Nɔhalɛ, Awulae Nyamenle ɛnyɛ debie wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɔtɛyele ɔtɛkilele ye sonvolɛma, Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma la.
8Awenade ne ɛkpo, nwane a ɛzulolɛ ɛnga ye a?
Awulae Nyamenle ne ɛdendɛ, nwane a kɛkpo kɛ ɔnrɛha ye nrɛlaleɛ ne a?
Samɛlea ɛbɔlɛ
9Bɛbɔ ye nolo bɛhile bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ Yigyibiti nee Ahyedɔdo aranemgbole ne mɔ anu la kɛ, “Bɛboɔboa bɛ nloa wɔ Samɛlea awoka ne mɔ azo, na bɛnlea ninyɛmunli mɔɔ bɛlɛyɛ, nee nzisi mɔɔ bɛlɛdi wɔ zolɛ la.”
10Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Menli ɛhye mɔ ɛnze boɛlilɛ deɛ holɛ yɛɛ bɛva konle nee awule ninyɛne bɛyiyi bɛ aranemgbole ne mɔ. 11Yemɔti medame Awulae Nyamenle mese: Kpɔvolɛma babɔ ayia bɛ azɛlɛ ne, abubu bɛ nwo banebɔlɛ ne na bɛave bɛ aranemgbole ne mɔ anu ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti.”
12Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Kɛmɔ awenade kye boane na mboaneneavolɛ ne kɔ ye ɛlielɛ a debie mɔɔ ɔnwu ye ala la a le ye ndwɛlɛ nwiɔ anzɛɛ ɔ nzo ko la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ Yizilayɛma mɔɔ de Samɛlea la ɛlielɛ bayɛ a; bɛbanwu ebia mɔɔ bɛda nu la ebule na bɛanwu ɛkpa sinli. 13Bɛdie, na bɛbɔ Gyekɔbo abo zo amra ne kɔkɔ kɛ, kɛ medame Awulae Nyamenle, Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma mese la ɛne: 14 Kenle mɔɔ menwɔdea Yizilayɛma wɔ bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ ati la, mebazɛkye Bɛtɛle azukponle ne mɔ, na azukponle biala mgbɛne zo nna ne azo kpokpɔkoo ne mɔ babubu agua aze. 15Mebabubu bɛ fɔsɛlɛ nee wawaa mekɛ azua ne mɔ. Azua mɔɔ bɛva ɛzɛlɛ bɛziezie nuhua la bagologolo agua; azua mgbole ne mɔ abo zo baminli. Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.”

Title: EMƆ 4
Content:
1Bɛdie edwɛkɛ ɛhye, bɛmɛ Beehyan nlankɛ mbelɛ mɔɔ wɔ Samɛlea boka zo, mɔɔ sisi ehyianvolɛma, mɔɔ fa atisesebɛ amaamuo bu menli mɔɔ ehyia na bɛka bɛkile bɛ hu mɔ kɛ bɛva bɛrɛla bɛmaa bɛnlo la. 2Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛha ye nwuanzanwuanzayɛlɛ ne kɛ, “Bɛnlea na mekɛ ne mɔɔ bɛbabobɔ bɛ koba bɛahwe bɛ bɛahɔ la ɛlɛba. Ko biala bayɛ kɛ fɛlɛ mɔɔ ɛva koba la. 3Na bɛbalua bane adokule nu bɛavinde, awie biala bahɔ ɔ nyunlu fɔɔnwo na bɛavuandi bɛ bɛagua Hɛmɔn.” Kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma se la ɛne.
Yizilayɛma anzukoa anyɛ
4Awulae Nyamenle se, “Yizilayɛma, bɛhɔ Bɛtɛle ɛleka nwuanzanwuanza ne na bɛhɔdo mɛla ne mɔ. Bɛhɔ Gelegale bɛhɔtietia mɛla ne azo! Bɛhɔ zolɛ bɛbɔ azu nwonlomɔ biala, na bɛva bɛ ngyɛnu bulu ɛkpɔ ko ne bɛrɛla kenle nsa nsa. 5Bɛva kpanwo mɔɔ mgbɔvonle wɔ nu la bɛbɔ moyɛlɛ azu, na bɛbɔ ahonle fufule nu azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ nolo, ɔluakɛ bɛmɛ Yizilayɛma, ɛhye a le nyɛleɛ mɔɔ bɛkulo kɛ bɛyɛ a.”
6Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Medame a memanle ɛhɔne zile bɛ azuamgbole ne mɔ azo na aleɛ wiele bɛ azua nu a, noko bɛanzia bɛamba me ɛkɛ. 7Eza memanle ezule gyakyile ɛdɔlɛ wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ yeha siane nsa na ɛbuhenle ne adwu la. Memaa suakpole ko nyia ezule, na suakpole ko ɛnnyia bie. Memaa ɛya avule ko nyia ezule a, avule ko ɛnnyia bie, yɛɛ ɛya mɔɔ ezule andɔ nu la anu ninyɛne sɛkye. 8Yemɔti azuamgbole nwiɔ anzɛɛ nsa dule hɔle suakpole ko mɔɔ bɛ nye la kɛ bɛkɛnyia nzule bɛkɛnlua bɛ ahonle la azo, na bɛannyia nzule mɔɔ sa bɛ no la, noko bɛanzia bɛamba me ɛkɛ.
9“Memanle ewia katekate rayelale bɛ bɛyɔba ne mɔ. Memanle abɛbɛ ralile bɛ tola nee bɛ vanye avule ne mɔ anu ninyɛne, bɛ feege mbaka nee bɛ ɔlivi mbaka ne mɔ; noko bɛanzia bɛamba me ɛkɛ.
10“Memanle ewulenzane ne mɔɔ rale Yigyibiti la bie rale bɛ nwo zo. Mengunle bɛ mgbavolɛ wɔ konle nu na mengyele bɛ mgbɔnwɔ ne mɔ nuokɛ. Memanle bɛ avunli kpɔlɔlera ne mɔ nvoanle bɔnlebɔnlenle bɛ bonyi nu wɔ bɛ azokoɛleɛ ɛkɛ ne, noko bɛanzia bɛamba me nwo ɛkɛ.
11 “Menzɛkyele bɛ bie mɔ, kɛmɔ menzɛkyele azuamgbole Sodɔm nee Gomɔla la. Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛvile ɛsalɛ la le kɛ ɛyɛne mɔɔ bɛdu bɛvi senle nu la. Noko bɛanzia bɛamba me ɛkɛ. 12Yemɔti O Yizilayɛma, mɔɔ mebava meayɛ bɛ la ɛne. Kɛmɔ mebayɛ ɛhye la ati, bɛboɔboa bɛ nwo bɛrayia medame, bɛ Nyamenle ne!”
13Ɔluakɛ bɛnlea, Nyamenle ne mɔɔ bɔle awoka ne mɔ,
na ɔbɔle anwoma,
ɔda ye adwenle ali ɔkile sonla;
ɔkakyi alehyenlɛ ɔmaa ɔyɛ aledwolɛ,
na ɔtietia azɛlɛ ye azo awoka zo la,
ye duma ɛne, bɛfɛlɛ ye “Ɛdɛnkɛma, Tumivolɛ Nyamenle!”

Title: EMƆ 5
Content:
Bɛnlu bɛ nwo
1O Yizilayɛma, bɛdie awolɛyelɛ edwɛne ɛhye mɔɔ meto meagua bɛ ti zo la:
2“Belamunli Yizilayɛ ɛdɔ aze,
Ɔnrɛdwazo bieko ɛlɛ!
Bɛkpo ye, wɔ ɔdaye ye azɛlɛ zo,
Awie biala ɛnrɛkpogya ye zo.”
3Awulae Nyamenle ne se, “Suakpole mɔɔ vale ɛlɔnema apenle ko hɔle la bava ɛya ko ala a azia ara a; yɛɛ suakpole mɔɔ vale ɛya ko hɔle la, bulu ala a bazia ara Yizilayɛ a.”
4Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛlɛse Yizilayɛma kɛ, “Bɛkpondɛ me bo zo na bɛkɛnyia ngoane. 5Bɛmmakɔ Biyɛhyiba bɛkɔsonle. Bɛmmakpondɛ me wɔ Bɛtɛle, Bɛtɛle bayɛ mgbane. Bɛmmakɔ Gelegale noko, ɔluakɛ bɛbahye ye menli ne kɔsɔɔti bɛahɔ nlɔnu.”
6Bɛkpondɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma abo zo, na bɛnyia ngoane. Saa bɛamkpondɛ ɔ bo zo a, ɔbayɛ senle yeazɔ Dwosefi sua nu, yeayela Bɛtɛle, na awie ɛnrɛhola ye nua ɛlɛ. 7Bɛmɛ, bɛmaa pɛlepɛlelilɛ yɛ ɛnwonle, na bɛtietia tenleneyɛlɛ zo.
8 Mɔɔ bɔle nwɔlɔra Nsuu nee Apea Nsa,
na ɔmaa awozinli kakyi alehyenlɛ,
ɔmaa alehyenlɛ du yɛ aledwolɛ;
yemɔ mɔɔ ɔtwe nyevile nu nzule ɔkɔ
na ɔmaa ɔkakyi ezule ɔtɔ azɛlɛ ye azo la,
ye duma a le Ɛdɛnkɛma.
9Yemɔ yɛɛ ɔsɛkye anwosesebɛma
na ɔbubu bɛ aranemgbole ɔgua a.
10Bɛkyi awie biala mɔɔ twi sonla mɔɔ ɛnli pɛlepɛle la anyunlu, yɛɛ bɛngulo awie biala mɔɔ ka nɔhalɛ la edwɛkɛ. 11Yemɔti, kɛmɔ bɛsisi ehyianvolɛma na bɛwua bɛ hwiiti ne mɔ la ati bɛva awolɛ bɛsisi azua ngɛnlɛma, noko bɛnrɛla nuhua, yɛɛ bɛyɛ vanye egyinli ngɛnlɛma, noko bɛnrɛnlo bɛ ma ne mɔ anu nwanye. 12Ɔluakɛ meze bɛ mɛladonlɛ mgbole ne mɔ nee kɛ bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ mgbole si de la. Bɛkile tenlenema nyane, bɛdie ndoloboa, na bɛdi bɛtia ehyianvolɛma. 13Yemɔti mɔɔ ze nrɛlɛbɛ la bayɛ koonwu wɔ mekɛ zɛhae anu, ɔluakɛ ɔle munzule mekɛ.
14Yɛ mɔɔ le kpalɛ la, mmayɛ mɔɔ le ɛtane la, amaa wɔadɛnla ngoane nu, na Ɛdɛnkɛma, Tumivolɛ Nyamenle ne nee wɔ alua, kɛmɔ ɛdawɔ wɔha la. 15Kyi mɔɔ le ɛtane la, na kulo mɔɔ le kpalɛ la, na nea maa nɔhalɛlilɛ ɛrɛla edwɛkɛlilɛ ɛleka ne mɔ; wɔannea a Ɛdɛnkɛma, Tumivolɛ Nyamenle ne kɛnwu Dwosefi abo zo amra ne mɔɔ ɛha la anwunvɔne.
16Yemɔti Ɛdɛnkɛma, Tumivolɛ Nyamenle ne, Awulae se, “Menli bazu, aye awolɛ wɔ suakpole ne ɛleka kpatawienyi ne nee guabile ne mɔ azo. Bɛbavɛlɛ ɛyazonlɛma kɛ bɛboka menli mɔɔ ze awolɛ ye kpalɛ kpalɛ la anwo bɛmaa bɛzu mɔwuamra. 17Ɛzunlɛ bade vanye egyinli ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti anu, ɔboalekɛ melɛba mearadea bɛ.” Ɛdɛnkɛma a ɛdendɛ la.
18Munzule ɛha bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ kunlu a anrɛɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma kenle ne ɛdwu la! Duzu nvasoɛ a kenle zɔhane bayɛ amaa bɛ a? Ɔluakɛ ɔle awozinli kenle, ɔnle kenle mɔɔ anu te a. 19Ɔbayɛ kɛ sonla mɔɔ ɛnriandi awenade na yehɔyia bedi la! Anzɛɛ sonla mɔɔ ɛhɔ ye sua nu, ɔhisa bane ne na yeva ɔ sa yedo bane ne azo na ɛwɔlɛ ɛha ye la! 20Ɛdɛnkɛma kenle ne le awozinli, ɔnle wienyi; ɔle kabii, nuhua ɛnde.
21Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Mekyi yɛɛ mekpo bɛ nyamenlezonlenlɛ ɛvoyia ne mɔ; yɛɛ me nye ɛnlie bɛ ɛzonlenlɛ ne mɔ anwo. 22Bɛfa bɛ ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ nee bɛ ma azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ bɛba bɔbɔ ɛdeɛ, noko menrɛlie, yɛɛ menrɛnlea bɛ nane dɔlera anzonudwolɛ azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ bɔbɔ. 23Bɛva bɛ alɛra edwɛne ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛlɛto la bɛhɔ nehane; mengulo kɛ mete bɛ getaa ne mɔ ane bɔbɔ. 24Kɛ bɛkɛyɛ ɛhye mɔ la, bɛmaa pɛlepɛlelilɛ ɛze kɛ azudenle, na tenleneyɛlɛ ɛze kɛ azule mɔɔ ɛnsesa ɛlɛ la.
25“Yizilayɛma, ɛvolɛ abulanla ne mɔɔ menlile bɛ ti wɔ fienemgbole ne anu la, bɛbɔle azu bɛmanle me anzɛɛ bɛvale azubɔdeɛ bɛrɛlɛle me ɔ? 26Na kɛkala, kɛmɔ bɛsonle bɛ Bozonle Belemgbunli Sakɛte, nee bɛ Ɛwɔlɔra Bozonle Kaewan ne mɔ ananze ne mɔ, mɔɔ bɛdabɛ bɛyɛ la, 27mebava bɛ meahɔ nlɔnu wɔ Dɛmasekɛse anzi lɔ,” kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, mɔɔ ye duma a le Tumivolɛ Nyamenle la se la ɛne.

Title: EMƆ 6
Content:
Yizilayɛ Ɛzɛkyelɛ
1Munzule ɛha bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ nwo ɛdɔ bɛ wɔ Zayɔn, nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdwenle kɛ bɛ nwo le kɔlɔnwo wɔ Samɛlea la, bɛmɛ mgbolema mɔɔ bɛwɔ Yizilayɛ, mɔɔ menli ba bɛ ɛkɛ babiza moalɛ la! 2Bɛhɔnlea suakpole Kaleni. Akee bɛhɔ suakpole Heemate maanzinli ne anu na bɛtele zolɛ bɛhɔ Filisitia suakpole Gate azo. Ɛnee bɛle kpalɛ bɛtɛla Dwuda nee Yizilayɛ arelemgbunli maanle ne mɔ ɔ? Ɛnee bɛ maanzinli ne le kpalɛ tɛla bɛ maanzinli ɛdeɛ ne ɔ? 3Bɛnlie bɛndo nu kɛ munzule kenle ne ɛbikye, na konle ala a bɛtwe bɛba ɔ? 4Munzule ɛha bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛda ɛzɛlɛ ɛkpa zo na bɛtenrɛdenrɛ bɛ nwo wɔ mbia ndendenle nu bɛdi mboane nee nlankɛ la. 5Bɛkulo kɛ bɛyɛ edwɛne, kɛmɔ Devidi yɛle la, na bɛbɔ wɔ bɛ getaa ne mɔ azo. 6Bɛno nwanye wɔ ahyɛnze bonkuma nu na bɛgua anatele evuanlɛ, na bɛnzu Yizilayɛ nee ye ɛzɛkyelɛ. 7Yemɔti bɛdabɛ a bɛbalumua bɛahye bɛ bɛahɔ nlɔnu a. Bɛ ɛvoyialilɛ nee bɛ ɛkponledolɛ ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti bara awieleɛ.
8Ɛdɛnkɛma, Tumivolɛ Nyamenle ne se, “Medame Awulae Nyamenle, meka me ngome me nwo kɛ: Mekyi Yizilayɛma mgbanyizonleyɛlɛ ne, mekpo bɛ azua mgbole ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛbɔ nwolɛ bane la. Mebava bɛ suakpole ne nee zolɛ debie biala meamaa kpɔvolɛma!”
9Saa menli bulu ka awuke ko anu a bɛbawu. 10Awie mɔɔ kɛwu la anwo sonla, ahenle ne mɔɔ ɛlɛnea yeamaa bɛayela funli ne la baye funli ne wɔ sua ne anu avinde, na yeadea nu yeavɛlɛ awie mɔɔ wɔ sua ne anu la kɛ, “Awie bieko tɛbɔ ɛkɛ ɔ?”
Ahenle babua kɛ, “Kyɛkyɛ!”
Akee funli ne anwo sonla ne baha kɛ, “Yɛ koonwu! Ɔnle kɛ yɛbɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma duma bɔbɔ.”
11Saa Ɛdɛnkɛma ka ye tumi edwɛkɛ ne a, azua mgbole nee ngyikyi kɔsɔɔti badwulu agua. 12Asoo mgbɔnwɔ kola wuluwulu bodane zo? Asoo menli kola fa nlankɛ nyinli so ɛya wɔ nyevile nye? Noko bɛmɛ, bɛmaa pɛlepɛlelilɛ ɛhakyi pɔezen, yɛɛ bɛmaa tenleneyɛlɛ ɛyɛ ɛnwonle.
13Bɛfa bɛtu bɛ nwo kɛ bɛva sua Lodɛbaa aze. Bɛfa bɛtu bɛ nwo kɛ, “Yɛlua yɛdayɛ yɛ anwosesebɛ zo yɛva Kaaneeyem yɛyɛ yɛ ɛdeɛ.”
14Ɛdɛnkɛma, Tumivolɛ Nyamenle ne se, “Yizilayɛma, bɛnlea, mebamaa maanle gyɛne arava bɛ aze. Bɛbasisi bɛ, ɔvi Heemate Ademgbolezo mɔɔ wɔ sɔlɔ la toonwo yeahɔdwu Alaba Bɔnza wɔ nyiakɛ.”

Title: EMƆ 7
Content:
Abɛbɛ nwo ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ
1Awulae Nyamenle ne yele ninyɛne hilele me wɔ ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ nu. Wɔ ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ ne anu, menwunle kɛ mɔɔ bɛpɛle belemgbunli ne ndile ne mɔɔ nyɛmoa di la bɛwiele la, Ɛdɛnkɛma yele abɛbɛ tɔka wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee bɔ zo mɔɔ ndile ne ɛbɔ ɔ bo kɛ ɔfifi bieko la. 2Wɔ me ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ ne anu, menwunle kɛ abɛbɛ ne mɔ ɛli nya nee ndile amolɛ biala mɔɔ wɔ azɛlɛ ne azo la, na menganle kɛ, “O Awulae Nyamenle, mebodo wɔ, fa wɔ menli ne mɔ ɛtane kyɛ bɛ! Kɛ ɔkɛyɛ na Yizilayɛma adɛnla ngoane nu ɛ? Bɛ nwo anzo!”
3Ɛdɛnkɛma hakyile ye adwenle na ɔhanle kɛ, “Mɔɔ ɛnwunle ye la ɛnrɛyɛ zɔhane.”
Senle nwo ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ
4Eza Awulae Nyamenle ne yele ɛhye hilele me. Menwunle kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛlɛboɔboa ɔ nwo ava senle adea ye menli ne. Senle ne yelale nyevile ne na ɔbɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɔyela azɛlɛ ne. 5Na menganle kɛ, “O Awulae Nyamenle, mebodo wɔ, gyakyi! Kɛ ɔkɛyɛ na Yizilayɛma adɛnla ngoane nu ɛ? Bɛ nwo anzo!”
6Ɛdɛnkɛma hakyile ye adwenle na ɔhanle kɛ, “Ɛhye noko ɛnrɛyɛ zɔhane.”
Ɛzuzunyɛma nwo ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ
7Awulae yele debie bieko hilele me. Menwunle kɛ Awulae gyi bane bie mɔɔ bɛvale ɛzuzunyɛma bɛdole nwo a bɛdole la anwo, na ɔlɛ ɛzuzunyɛma ne ɔ sa nu. 8Na Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me kɛ, “Emɔso, duzu a ɛnwu ye a?”
Membuale ye kɛ, “Menwu ɛzuzunyɛma”
Na ɔzele me kɛ, “Melɛfa ɛhye meahile kɛ me menli ne le kɛ bane mɔɔ ɛndenrɛ la. Me adwenle mɔɔ meva kɛ metea bɛ la, menrɛhakyi ye bieko. 9Ɛleka ne mɔ mɔɔ Ayezeke zonlenle la, mebazɛkye bɛ. Mebazɛkye Yizilayɛ ɛleka nwuanzanwuanza ne mɔ. Mebamaa belemgbunli Gyɛlɔbowam abo zo amra amuala awu dadeɛ nloa.”
Emɔso nee Amazaya
10Amazaya, Bɛtɛle sɛlɛvolɛ ne hɔdoanle Emɔso hilele Yizilayɛ Belemgbunli Gyɛlɔbowam kɛ, “Emɔso ɛlɛmaa menli ne ɛ nwo adwenle ɛtane. Ye ngehanleɛ ne mɔ ɛbo maanle ne anwo zo. 11Ye edwɛkɛ mɔɔ ɔka la ɛne: ‘Gyɛlɔbowam bawu dadeɛ nloa, yɛɛ bɛbahye Yizilayɛma bɛavi bɛ maanle nu bɛ nee bɛ ahɔ nlɔnu.’ ”
12Akee Amazaya hanle hilele Emɔso kɛ, “Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ, wɔha bie a yeyɛ boɛ! Sia kɔ Dwuda, kɔbɔ wɔ Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ ne nolo wɔ nehane na di nwolɛ aleɛ. 13Mmaka Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ bieko wɔ Bɛtɛle ɛke. Ɛke a le belemgbunli ne ɛleka nwuanzanwuanza ne a, yɛɛ ɔle maanle ne ɛzonlenlɛ sua.”
14Na Emɔso buale Amazaya kɛ, “Menle Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ, yɛɛ menle Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ ra. Meka mboane, yɛɛ feege mbaka ɛnleanlɛ gyima a meyɛ a. 15Na Ɛdɛnkɛma manle mengyakyile mboaneneavolɛ gyima ne, na ɔzoanle me kɛ mengɔnga mɔɔ kenle bie bazi la anwo edwɛkɛ mengile ye menli Yizilayɛma. 16Yemɔti bɛdie mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛlɛka la. Bɛdua me kɛ memmaka Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ ne mɔɔ tia Yizilayɛma la, yɛɛ memmabɔ Nyamenle edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ tia Ayezeke abo zo amra la nolo mekile bɛ. 17Yemɔti, Amazaya, Ɛdɛnkɛma se menga mengile wɔ kɛ, ‘Ɛ ye bayɛ tuutuu ala suakpole ye azo, yɛɛ ɛ mra mrenya nee ɛ mra mraalɛ badɔ dadeɛ nloa. Bɛbahyɛ wɔ azɛlɛ ne bɛamaa awie mɔ, yɛɛ ɛdawɔ mumua ne ɛbawu menli mɔɔ ɛnze Nyamenle la maanle nu. Na Yizilayɛma ɛdeɛ, bɛbahye bɛ bɛ nee bɛ avi bɛ maanle ye anu ahɔ nlɔnu.’ ”

Title: EMƆ 8
Content:
Mbakama kɛndɛne ko nwo ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ
1Eza Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma yele ɛhye hilele me. Menwunle kɛndɛne mɔɔ mbakama wɔ nu la. 2Ɛdɛnkɛma bizale me kɛ, “Emɔso, duzu a ɛnwu ye la?”
Membuale ye kɛ, “Menwu mbakama kɛndɛne ko.”
Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me kɛ, “Me menli Yizilayɛma awieleɛ kenle ne ɛdwu. Menrɛhakyi me adwenle, ɛdeanlɛ ne ala a metea bɛ a. 3Kenle zɔhane edwɛne mɔɔ bɛto wɔ suakunlu ɛkɛ ne la amuala bahakyi awolɛyelɛ. Ɛleka biala bayɛ avunli ngome, bɛbayɛ koonwu bɛavuandi bɛ bɛagua.”
Yizilayɛ ɛbɔlɛ
4Bɛdie, bɛmɛ mɔɔ bɛmbu menli mɔɔ ɛhyia, na bɛmaa ehyianvolɛma mɔɔ wɔ maanle ye anu la anwo ɛwie bɛ kyele, 5na bɛka kɛ, “Kenlenzu a siane fofolɛ ɛvoyialilɛ ne kɛwie na yɛanyia adenle yɛadɔne yɛ abɛlɛ a? Kenlenzu yɛɛ Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ne kɛze na yɛanyia adenle yɛadɔne yɛ hwiiti, yɛanyia adenle yɛazi yɛ ‘yifa’ ɛzuzudeɛ ne abo na yɛawodo yɛ ‘hyikɛle’ ɛzuzudeɛ ne anu, na yɛawua mɔɔ yɛfa tone yɛazuzu la anu, 6amaa yɛava dwɛtɛ fufule yɛadɔ ehyianvolɛma, yɛava mgbɔlaboa yɛadɔ menli mɔɔ anwo ɛhyele bɛ, na yɛadɔne yɛ hwiiti mɔɔ ɛnle kpalɛ la a?”
7Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne ɛha ndane kɛ, “Me rɛle ɛnrɛvi bɛ nyɛleɛ ne mɔ. 8Yemɔti azɛlɛ ne bakpusu, na awie biala mɔɔ wɔ maanle ne anu la banwu nyane. Maanle ne anu bapi na yeabɔ kɛ Yigyibiti Azule Naele ne di yitwe la. 9Kenle zɔhane mebamaa sɛnzɛne ne adɔ ewiazo ketekete, na aleɛ adwo na awozinli ava ewia henlema ne. Medame, Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a. 10Mebamaa bɛ ɛvoyialilɛ ne mɔ ahakyi ɛzɛneyɛlɛ na meamaa bɛ edwɛne fɛlɛko ne mɔ ahakyi awolɛyelɛ. Mebamaa bɛakpa bɛ ti, bɛaheda ɛrele, na bɛayɛ kɛ awovolɛ mɔɔ ɛlɛsu bɛ ra nrenya kokye mɔɔ ɛwu la. Kenle zɔhane bayɛ ɛnwonle ɛnwonle toonwo ahɔ ye awieleɛ.
11“Bɛnlea, mekɛ ne ɛlɛba mɔɔ mebamaa ɛhɔne azi azɛlɛ ne azo a. Tɛ aleɛ ɛhɔne anzɛɛ nzule ɛhɔne ɔ. Ɛdɛnkɛma edwɛkɛ ne anwo ɛhɔne nee nzuhɔne a bahu bɛ a. Medame, Awulae Nyamenle a mese a. 12Menli bakpɔsa ɛnwea ɛnwea, bɛvi sɔlɔ bɛahɔ nyiakɛ na bɛvi aduduleɛ bɛahɔ adɔleɛ. Bɛbanriandi bɛahɔ bɛara ɛleka biala kɛ bɛkakpondɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma edwɛkɛ ne, na bɛnrɛnyia ye. 13Kenle zɔhane nzuhɔne bamaa mgbavolɛ yɛɛ mbɛlɛra mɔɔ anwo yɛ fɛ na bɛnze nrenya fee la anye zo abulu bɛ. 14Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛfa Samɛlea awozonle ananze ne mɔ bɛka ndane kɛ, ‘Meka Dan bozonle ne’, anzɛɛ ‘Meka Biyɛhyiba bozonle ne’ la amuala bagua aze, yɛɛ bɛnrɛdwazo bieko.”

Title: EMƆ 9
Content:
Awulae ndeanlɛ ne mɔ
1Menwunle kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma gyi azukponle ne anwo, na ɔzele me kɛ: “Si Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne mpila ndendenle ne mɔ ati ne mɔ ɛsesebɛ maa nwolodo ne mɔ ɛkpusu. Bubu bɛ maa bɛha bɛgua menli ne amuala ati zo. Mebava dadeɛ meahu menli mɔɔ kɛha la; ko bɔbɔ ɛnrɛhola nriandi; kokye bɔbɔ ɛnrɛvi ɛsalɛ. 2Saa bɛnriandi bɛkɔfea Ɛbolɔ a, mebahwe bɛ meara. Saa bɛfo bɛkɔ anwuma a, mebadwula bɛ aze. 3Saa bɛnriandi bɛkɔfea Kamɛle Boka ne azo a, mebakpondɛ bɛ meahye bɛ. Saa bɛnriandi bɛkɔfea nyevile ne abo lɔ a, mebamaa ɛwɔlɛ akeka bɛ. 4Saa bɛ kpɔvolɛma kye bɛ nuokɛ a, mebamaa bɛahu bɛ. Mezi pi kɛ mesɛkye bɛ, tɛ kɛ meboa bɛ ɔ.”
5Awulae, Tumivolɛ Nyamenle ne
mɔɔ fa ɔ sa ka azɛlɛ ye a ɔkpusu,
na menli kɔsɔɔti mɔɔ de zolɛ la di nyane,
na maanle ne anu pi na ɔbɔ,
kɛ Yigyibiti Azule Naele ne di yitwe la;
6yemɔ mɔɔ ɔsi ye azua wɔ anwuma,
na ɔsi ye ninyɛnezielɛ ɛleka wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo;
yemɔ mɔɔ ɔtwe nyevile nu nzule,
na ɔmaa ɔtɔ ezule ɔgua azɛlɛ ye azo la,
ye duma a le Ɛdɛnkɛma.
7Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Yizilayɛma, kɛ mesi medwenle Sudanema anwo la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ medwenle bɛdabɛ noko bɛ nwo a. Menyele Filisitiama menvile Kiliti na menyele Seleama menvile Kɛɛ, kɛmɔ menyele bɛdabɛ noko menvile Yigyibiti azɛlɛ zo la. 8Medame, Awulae Nyamenle, melɛnea ɛtane belemgbunli maanle Yizilayɛ, na mebazɛkye ye, meaye ye meavi azɛlɛ ye azo. Noko menrɛzɛkye Gyekɔbo abo zo amra ne amuala.
9“Mebaha tumi edwɛkɛ ne na meahegye Yizilayɛma kɛ bɛkɛgye ma la. Mebahegye bɛ meavi maanle maanle avinli na meaye mɔɔ ɛnle kpalɛ la meavi nuhua. 10Bɛdabɛ ɛtanevolɛma mɔɔ bɛwɔ me menli ne avinli mɔɔ bɛka kɛ, ‘Nyamenle ɛnrɛmaa munzule biala ɛnrɛdo yɛ’ la badɔ dadeɛ nloa.”
Kenlebie Yizilayɛ banyia ye gyinlabelɛ dɛba ne
11 Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Mekɛ ɛlɛba mɔɔ mebava Devidi belemgbunli maanle ne mɔɔ ɛtete kɛ sua mɔɔ ɛyɛ kpasakpasa la gyinlabelɛ ne meamaa ye bieko. Mebalie ye bane ne mɔ fofolɛ meazie bɛ bo zo ne mɔ, na meakyekye maanle ne fofolɛ meayɛ ye kɛ ye dɛba ne ala la. 12Yemɔti Yizilayɛma bava Yidɔm azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ ɛha, nee maanle maanle mɔɔ le me ɛdeɛ la kɔsɔɔti ayɛ bɛ ɛdeɛ.” Kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma mɔɔ bamaa ɛhye azi la se la ɛne.
13“Bɛnlea, mekɛ ne ɛlɛba, ” Ɛdɛnkɛma a se a,
“abɛlɛ bavievia mralɛ dɔɔnwo abo menli mɔɔ bu la anwo zo,
yɛɛ vanye ma bazo abo nwanyeyɛlɛ zo.
Nwanye fɛlɛko bazonyi avi awoka ne mɔ azo,
na yeaze awoka ngyikyi ne mɔ azo.
14Mebamaa me menli Yizilayɛma eza akpazi,
bɛbakyekye bɛ azuadu ne mɔ na bɛadɛnla zolɛ;
bɛbayɛ vanye egyinli na bɛanlo nuhua nwanye ne;
bɛbayɛ tola na bɛali nuhua ninyɛne.
15Mebava me menli ne meazie bɛ azɛlɛ ne azo,
na bɛnrɛdu bɛ bieko ɛlɛ;
bɛnrɛvi azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ meva memaa bɛ la azo.”
Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne a se a.

Title: OBA MUKENYE
Content:
Mukenye
Dwuda maanle ne anwo ɛlɔne ko mɔɔ vi tete, wɔ ye nyiakɛ mɔɔ di kɔ aduduleɛ la a le Yidɔmma. Mɔɔ ɔhale ɛvolɛ ɛya nnu abulatwɛ nee nsia (586) na bɛawo Kelaese ne la yɛɛ ɛlɔne vale Gyɛlusalɛm mɔɔ le Dwuda maanle ne suakpole la a. Yidɔmma lile ɛhye anwo fɛlɛko kpole na bɛhɔle suakpole ne azo bɛhɔboale ɛlɔnema mɔɔ ɛrava suakpole ne la na bɛvenle zolɛ ninyɛne ne amuala. Obadaya vale Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ ɛhye dole gua kɛ Nyamenle badea Yidɔmma, nee maanle maanle mɔɔ le Yizilayɛma anwo ɛlɔne la amuala na Yizilayɛma aho ava bɛ.
Mɔɔ wɔ nu la
Yidɔmma ndeanlɛ 1-14
Awulae kenle ne 15-21

Title: OBA 1
Content:
1 Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ ne mɔɔ Obadaya vale dole gua la ɛne. Ɔfane edwɛkɛ mɔɔ Awulae Nyamenle ne hanle wɔ Yidɔm maanle ne anwo la anwo. Mal 1.2-5
Awulae badea Yidɔmma
Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛzoa sonla wɔ maanle maanle ne mɔ anu.
na yɛde ye nrɛlaleɛ ne. Ɔse:
“Bɛdwazo! Bɛmaa yɛ nee Yidɔmma ɛhɔho!”
2Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛze Yidɔmma kɛ,
“Nea, mebabɛlɛ bɛ aze
wɔ maanle maanle ne mɔ anyunlu,
awie biala bakpo bɛ bɔkɔɔ.
3Bɛ adubɛnwo ne ɛbɛlɛbɛla bɛ.
Bɛ mgbole ne mɔɔ bɛlua a bɛka kɛ,
kɛmɔ bɛkyekye bɛ suakpole ne bodane zo,
na bɛwɔ awoka zo la ati,
‘Awie ɛnrɛhola yɛ ɛhwee yɛ’ la,
4nea, saa bɛtu bɛkɔ anwuma kɛ kɔleɛ,
na bɛyɛ bɛ sane wɔ nwɔlɔra ne mɔ azo bɔbɔ a,
mebadwula bɛ aze.
5“Saa nwule ba bɛ nwo zo nɔɔzo a,
bɛfa ninyɛne mɔɔ bɛkulo la.
Saa menli tete vanye ma a,
dahuu bɛgyakyi ekyi.
Na bɛmɛ, bɛ kpɔvolɛma ɛkpokpo bɛ bɔkɔɔ.
6Bɛwie Yisɔ abo zo amra wua bɔkɔɔ,
bɛve bɛ anwonyia ne amuala.
7Bɛ ɛlɔne nu agɔnwolɛma ɛbɛlɛbɛla bɛ,
ɛdu bɛ ɛvi bɛdabɛ bɛ maanle nu.
Menli mɔɔ anrɛɛ nee bɛ le ko la
ɛdwazo ɛtia bɛ ɛli bɛ nwo zo konim.
Bɛdabɛ bɛ gɔnwo mɔ kpalɛ kpalɛ ɛvua bɛ ti,
na bɛnrɛde ɔ bo ɛlɛ.”
8Ɛdɛnkɛma se,
“Kenle mɔɔ metea Yidɔmma la,
mebazɛkye nrɛlɛbɛvolɛma mɔɔ wɔ Yidɔm la
na meaminliminli ndelebɛbo bo zo wɔ Yisɔ Boka.
9Katakyiema mɔɔ wɔ Timan la ahonle badu,
na bɛbahu awie biala mɔɔ wɔ Yidɔm la.
Deɛ mɔɔ yemɔti bɛtea Yidɔmma la
10“Mɔɔ bɛvale bɛyɛle bɛ mediema Gyekɔbo abo zo amra la ati,
bɛbagua bɛdabɛ bɛ nyunlu aze na bɛabɔ bɛ bo zo bɔkɔɔ.
11Suzuamgba ala mɔɔ kenle ko ne bɛgyinlanle ɛkɛ ne
bɛmanle nyɛvolɛ vole Gyɛlusalɛm
sesale zolɛ anwonyia hɔle,
na bɛguale nwolɛ nzeleba bɛhyɛle la,
ɛnee bɛdabɛ bɛboka menli ne anwo ala ɛne.
12Saa bɛ mediema ɛnwu bɛ nyunlu a,
ɛnee ɔnle kɛ bɛsi bɛ amgbu.
Saa bɛlɛsɛkye Dwudama bɛbɔ bɛ bo zo a,
ɔnle kɛ bɛgyinla ahane bɛsele bɛ,
anzɛɛ bɛtu bɛ nloa anu wɔ bɛ amaneɛnwunlɛ nwo.
13Saa me menli ne ɛnwu bɛ nyunlu bɔbɔ a,
anrɛɛ ɔnle kɛ bɛfa ɛlɔnema bɛfo suakpole ne azo,
bɛsele bɛ na bɛgolo bɛ nwo,
na bɛwua bɛ ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti.
14Anrɛɛ ɔnle kɛ bɛsia bɛ adenle nu,
bɛtua menli mɔɔ nriandi la adenle.
Anrɛɛ ɔnle kɛ bɛye bɛ bɛmaa
na bɛmaa bɛnwu amaneɛ.
Nyamenle badea maanle maanle ne mɔ
15“Mekɛ ne asɛɛ ɛdwu mɔɔ medame, Ɛdɛnkɛma,
mebadea maanle omaanle ne mɔ a.
Mɔɔ bɛdabɛ Yidɔmma bɛyɛle la, bɛbayɛ bɛ bie bɛadua,
bɛ munzule babɔ bɛ ti.
16Bɛhilele me menli ne mɔ nyane
wɔ me boka nwuanzanwuanza ne azo
Zɔhane ati bɛbahile maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti nyane ne bie;
bɛbanwu amaneɛ kpalɛ na bɛ bo zo aminli.
Yizilayɛma bali konim
17“Noko Zayɔn Boka azo menli ne bie mɔ bavi ɛsalɛ
na ɛkɛ ne bayɛ ɛleka nwuanzanwuanza.
Na Gyekɔbo abo zo amra bazia arava bɛ agyadeɛ.
18“Gyekɔbo abo zo amra badɔlɔ kɛ samɛnlakɛ,
na Dwosefi abo zo amra azɔ kɛ senle tafinlima.
Bɛbayela Yisɔ abo zo amra kɛ mbaka alosinli.
Awie ko bɔbɔ ɛnrɛha Yisɔ sua nu.
Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.
19“Dwuda nyiakɛ amra barava Yisɔ Boka,
na menli mɔɔ wɔ adɔleɛ la arava Filisitia maanle ne.
Bɛbava Yifelaem nee Samɛlea azɛlɛ ne,
na Bɛngyaman abo zo amra ava Geleade.
20Yizilayɛma mɔɔ bɛhyele bɛ nuokɛ
wɔ maanle ye sɔlɔ bɛhɔle nlɔnu la
bazia arava azɛlɛ ye,
ɔvi Fonehyea ahɔkpula Zalɛfate.
Nlɔnuma mɔɔ vi Gyɛlusalɛm na bɛwɔ Sadese la
baraho ava azua mɔɔ wɔ Dwuda nyiakɛ la.
21Katakyiema bahɔyia Zayɔn Boka,
na bɛaho bɛava Yisɔ Boka.
Na medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, mebali bɛ nwo zo belemgbunli.”

Title: DWN MUKENYE
Content:
Mukenye
Dwona Buluku ne bɛangɛlɛ ye kɛ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma mbuluku ne mɔ mɔɔ wɔ Baebolo ne anu la. Bɛhɛlɛle ye kɛ ɔle adawu mɔɔ ka Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ bie mɔɔ bɔle mɔdenle kɛ ɔtu Nyamenle anloa edwɛkɛ yeado la anwo edwɛkɛ. Nyamenle zele Dwona kɛ ɔhɔ Nenɛvɛ mɔɔ le Aselea maanle kpole ne suakpole la azo. Aseleama le Yizilayɛma anwo ɛlɔne kpole kpalɛ. Zɔhane ati Dwona angulo kɛ ɔkɛva Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ ne ɔkɛhɔ Nenɛvɛ, ɔboalekɛ ɛnee ɔdie ɔdi kɛ Nyamenle nwunlonwunla bɛ ala na ɔnrɛzɛkye suakpole ne. Na ɔlua ninyɛne ɛzulolɛ bie mɔɔ sisile la azo Dwona akunlu andwo bɔbɔ ɛdeɛ, noko ɔyɛle tieyɛ na ɔhɔle. Nzinlii Dwona vale ɛya kɛ ye nrɛlaleɛ ne mɔɔ ɔ nee ye hɔle la anzi zɔhane a.
Buluku ne kile Nyamenle tumi kpole ne mɔɔ ɔlɛ wɔ ye abɔdeɛ muala anwo zo la. Saa ɛye ɛhye nu a ɛnee mɔɔ bo zolɛ bɔbɔ la a le kɛ, buluku ne ye Nyamenle kile kɛ ɔle ɛhulolɛ nee anwunvɔnezelɛ Nyamenle, mɔɔ kulo kɛ ɔfa ɛtane ɔkyɛ na ɔdie bɛdabɛ bɔbɔ mɔɔ bɛkpɔ ye menli ne la ngoane, tɛla kɛ ɔkɛdea bɛ na ɔkɛminli bɛ bo zo la.
Mɔɔ wɔ nu la
Dwona ɛvɛlɛlɛ ne nee ye anzosesebɛyɛlɛ 1.1-17
Dwona nu ɔ nwo na bɛalie ye ngoane 2.1-10
Nrɛlaleɛ mɔɔ Dwona vale hɔle Nenɛvɛ la 3.1-10
Nyamenle nwu Nenɛvɛma anwunvɔne 4.1-11

Title: DWN 1
Content:
Dwona tu Nyamenle anloa ado
1 Kenle ko Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Ametayi ara Dwona kɛ, 2“Dwona, kɔ suakpole Nenɛvɛ mɔɔ ɛlie duma kpole la azo na kɔbɔ nolo, bɔ bɛ ɛrele zo kɛ menwu bɛ amumuyɛ mɔɔ bɛyɛ la amuala.” 3Noko Dwona dwazole la ɔyɛle ye adwenle kɛ ɔnriandi Nyamenle yeahɔ Sepeen. Yemɔti ɔhɔle Dwɔpa na ɔnyianle meli bie mɔɔ ɛlɛkɔ Sepeen la. Ɔduale ye ɛlɛne kakɛ ne na ɔhɔvole meli ne anu kɛ ɔ nee menli mɔɔ wɔ meli ne anu la kɔ Sepeen, yeaye ɔ nwo wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anye zo. 4Na Ɛdɛnkɛma manle anwoma kpole bie dwazole nyevile ne anye. Ahumu ne dule kpole kpalɛ mɔɔ ɛnee asɛɛ azudulɛ ne ɛbubu meli ne ɛwie a. 5Menli mɔɔ ka meli ne la ahonle dule kpalɛ na awie biala bɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɔtea yeavɛlɛ ye nyamenle ne kɛ ɔlie ye. Bɛvuandinle meli ne anu ninyɛne ne mɔ bɛguale azule nu, amaa meli ne ayɛ felafela. Mekɛ mɔɔ ɛhye mɔ ɛlɛkɔ zolɛ la, ɛnee Dwona ɛwolo ɛhɔ meli ne abo lɔ na yelafe.
6Yemɔti kpanyinli ne mɔɔ nea meli ne azo la hɔdunwuele ye na ɔzele ye kɛ, “Duzu ati a wɔmɔ wɔlafe a? Dwazo na fɛlɛ wɔ nyamenle ne mɔɔ ɛsonle ye la. Wɔannea a ɔkɛyɛ kɛ wɔmɔ wɔ nyamenle ɛdeɛ ne se anwunvɔne. Fɛlɛ ye maa ɔlie yɛ na yɛwie wu!”
7Na bɛhanle bɛhilele bɛ nwo ngoko ngoko kɛ, “Bɛrɛla bɛmaa yɛgua nzeleba yɛkpondɛ sonla holɛ ko ne mɔɔ ɔlua ɔ ti munzule kpole ɛhye ɛdo yɛ la.” Bɛguale nzeleba ne la, ɔbɔle Dwona. 8Na bɛbizale Dwona kɛ, “Yemɔti, wɔmɔ ɛ ti yɛɛ munzule kpole ɛhye ɛdo yɛ a? Ka maa yɛdie! Duzu gyima a ɛyɛ a? Ɛvi nienwu? Ɛvi maanle boni anu? Menli boni a ɛvi bɛ nuhua a?”
9Dwona buale kɛ, “Mele Hibulunli. Mesonle Ɛdɛnkɛma, Nyamenle ne mɔɔ wɔ anwuma la. Yemɔ a ɔbɔle nyevile nee azɛlɛ a.” 10Na Dwona vale zɔle zolɛ kɛ ɔlɛnriandi Ɛdɛnkɛma.
Ɛzulolɛ kpole hanle bɛ na bɛzele ye kɛ, “Duzu debie a wɔyɛ la?” 11Mekɛ ne anu ɛnee akee ahumu ne ɛlɛtu kpole kpalɛ. Na bɛbizale Dwona kɛ, “Duzu debie a yɛva yɛyɛ wɔ na ahumu ye agua amaa yɛ a?”
12Dwona zele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛmaa me zo, bɛvuandi me bɛdo nyevile nu na nyevile ne bagua amaa bɛ, ɔluakɛ meze kɛ medame me ti yɛɛ ahumu kpole ɛhye ɛdwazo a.”
13Na menli ne bɔle mɔdenle kɛ bɛka meli ne bɛahɔ aze, noko yeanyɛ boɛ, ɔluakɛ ɛnee akee ahumu ne anu ɛza na ɔtia bɛ. 14Zɔhane ati bɛvɛlɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛzele kɛ, “O Ɛdɛnkɛma, yɛsɛlɛ wɔ kpalɛ kpalɛ, mmamaa yɛwu kɛ nrenya ɛhye kɛwu a, yɛɛ mmamaa ye mogya gua yɛ ti zo. Ɔluakɛ, wɔmɔ, O Ɛdɛnkɛma, yɛɛ wɔhyehyɛ wɔyɛ mɔɔ ɛdawɔ ɛkulo la a.”
15Na bɛmanle Dwona zo bɛvuandinle ye bɛdole nyevile ne anu, na ɛkɛ ne ala nyevile ne guale diinyi. 16Menli ne mɔ zulole Ɛdɛnkɛma kpole na bɛbɔle azu bɛmanle ye. Na bɛhanle ndane kɛ bɛkɛzonle Ɛdɛnkɛma.
17 Na Ɛdɛnkɛma manle fɛlɛ kpole bie ramenle Dwona. Dwona lile kenle kɔkɔlɛ nsa wɔ fɛlɛ ne akunlu.

Title: DWN 2
Content:
Dwona nzɛlɛlɛ ne
1Mekɛ mɔɔ Dwona wɔ fɛlɛ ne akunlu la, ɔzunle ɔvɛlɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma ye Nyamenle ne; ɔzele kɛ,
2“Munzule kpole dole me,
na menzunle menvɛlɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma,
na ɔdiele me.
Mela ewule kuma nu la,
menzunle menvɛlɛle wɔ
na ɛdele me ne.
3Ɔluakɛ ɛdawɔ yɛɛ ɛvuandinle me ɛdole buma ne anu,
wɔ nyevile kunlu nehane a;
mengɔle azule bo na elonra
nee azelɛkye mgbole bule vale me ti zo.
4Na menganle kɛ,
‘Akee meminli ɛ nye zo ala ɛne,
na menrɛnwu wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua Nwuanzanwuanza ne bieko!’
5Azule ne monlanle me,
meminlinle buma ne anu bɔkɔɔ,
na nyevile bo ndile bɛkɛbɛkale me.
6Menomanle azule kuma ne abo kpalɛ,
wɔ awoka ne mɔ abo lɔ,
ɛleka mɔɔ bɛto sonla anlenkɛ nu a
bɛndukue ye ɛlɛ la.
Noko wɔmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma, me Nyamenle,
ɛyele me ɛvile Kuma ne anu ɛrale ngoane nu.
7Mɔɔ ɛnee me nye zo ɛbulu la,
mengakyele, na menzɛlɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma;
me nzɛlɛlɛ dwule ɛ nyunlu wɔ
wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua Nwuanzanwuanza ne anu.
8Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ amonle ala a bɛsɔ la,
bɛmbu wɔ yɛɛ bɛnzonle wɔ.
9Na mame, mebado edwɛne meaye wɔ ayɛlɛ,
mebabɔ azu meamaa wɔ
na meali me ɛwɔkɛ mɔɔ mebɔ la azo.
Wɔmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ala a ɛdie ngoane a.”
10Na Ɛdɛnkɛma manle fɛlɛ ne hɔkpule Dwona dole file zo.

Title: DWN 3
Content:
Dwona yɛ tieyɛ amaa Ɛdɛnkɛma
1Eza Ɛdɛnkɛma edwɛkɛ ne dwule Dwona anwo zo bieko 2na ɔzele ye kɛ, “Dwona, dwazo kɔ Nenɛvɛ, suakpole ne mɔɔ ɛlie duma kpole la azo, na kɔbɔ me edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ meva mewula ɛ nloa la nolo.” 3Na Dwona hɔle Nenɛvɛ, kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma hanle hilele ye la. Nenɛvɛ le suakpole kpalɛ mɔɔ sonla fa kenle nsa a fi ɔ ti kɔ ɔ bo a. 4 Na Dwona bɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɔkɔ sua bɔdenle ne azo. Ɔdiale kenle ko ala na ɔbɔle nolo kɛ, “Yeha kenle abulanla na bɛazɛkye Nenɛvɛ!”
5Menli mɔɔ wɔ Nenɛvɛ la liele Nyamenle lile. Bɛ muala bɛliele bɛdole nuhua kɛ bɛkeda ɛrele, bɛahye ɛhɔne, mgbolema nee ahoahweabane, bɛ muala bɛhyele ɛhɔne bɛvale bɛhilele kɛ bɛnlu bɛ nwo.
6Nenɛvɛ belemgbunli ne dele edwɛkɛ ne la, ɔvi ye belemgbunli ebia ne azo ɔdwazole, ɔkpale ye belemgbunli tɛladeɛ ne ɔguale, ɔvale ɛrele ɔhedale, na ɔvale nzonle ɔbɔle ɔ nwo. 7Akee ɔmanle bɛbɔle nolo wɔ suakpole ne azo kɛ, “Kɛ Nenɛvɛ belemgbunli nee ye mgbanyima se la ɛne: awie biala mɔɔ wɔ suakpole ye azo la mmadi debie yɛɛ ɔmmano nzule. Akee bɛmmamaa nlankɛ yɛɛ mboane anzɛɛ nyɛmoa biala fa bɛ nloa ka debie biala. 8Awie biala ɛva ɛrele ɛheda, ɔva bie ɔhedɛheda ye nyɛmoa, na akee awie biala ɛyeye ye ahonle nu ɛzɛlɛ Nyamenle. Awie biala ɛgyakyi amumuyɛ nee ɛtane ɛyɛlɛ. 9Awie ɛnze; bie a ɛnee Nyamenle ɛnwu yɛ anwunvɔne, yehakyi ye adwenle na yegyakyi ye ɛya kpole ne, amaa yɛanwu.”
10Nyamenle nwunle mɔɔ bɛyɛle la. Ɔnwunle kɛ bɛnlu bɛ nwo na bɛgyakyi bɛ nyɛleɛ ɛtane ne nee bɛ amumuyɛ ne mɔ ɛyɛlɛ. Yemɔti ɔhakyile ye adwenle, na yeammaa munzule kpole ne mɔɔ anrɛɛ ɔmaa yeara bɛ nwo zo la amba.

Title: DWN 4
Content:
Dwona ɛyavalɛ nee Nyamenle anwunvɔnezelɛ
1Ɔrale ye zɛhae la, yeanyɛ Dwona fɛ fee na ɔvale ɛya. 2 Na ɔzɛlɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma kɛ, “Ɛdɛnkɛma, mesɛlɛ wɔ, edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ mewɔ me sua zo lɔ mɔɔ menganle la, yemɔ a ɛyɛ zɔhane la. Na ɛhye ati noko yɛɛ anrɛɛ menriandi meahɔ Sepeen la. Ɔluakɛ meze kɛ wɔmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma, ɛle ɛlolɛ Nyamenle mɔɔ se anwunvɔne a. Ɛlɛ abotane, ɛlɛ ɛhulolɛ kpole, yɛɛ ɛ nye ɛnlie munzule nwo. 3Zɔhane ati, O Ɛdɛnkɛma, mesɛlɛ wɔ, maa menwu, ɔluakɛ ɔle kpalɛ kɛ menwɔwu tɛla kɛ menwɔdɛnla aze a.”
4Na Ɛdɛnkɛma bizale ye kɛ, “Dwona, asoo ɛya kpalɛ a wɔva la?”
5Dwona hɔle suakpole ne kandiba mɔɔ di kɔ aduduleɛ la. Ɔyɛle kpato ɔdɛnlanle ɔ bo na ɔyɛle kɛ ɔnea mɔɔ bazi suakpole ne azo la. 6Na Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle manle baka fifile hedale Dwona anwo zo, ɔmanle ye alubo, amaa ɔ nwo adɔ ye. Na Dwona anye liele baka ne anwo kpalɛ. 7Na aleɛbahye ne, Nyamenle manle nvuba ralile baka ne, na baka ne nwosonle na ɔwule. 8Sɛnzɛne ne kpogyale ɔ nwo zo la, Nyamenle manle aduduleɛ anwoma wuluwulu bie bɔle. Na ewia katekate bie vile bɔle Dwona ati mgbandanlama ne azo manle ɔ nwo yɛle ye bɛtɛɛ. Ɛnee akee Dwona akunlu a anrɛɛ yewu. Na ɔhanle kɛ, “Saa menwule bɔbɔ a anrɛɛ ɔle kpalɛ.”
9Nyamenle bizale Dwona kɛ, “Asoo ɛya kpalɛ a baka ye mɔɔ ɛwu la ati wɔva la?”
Dwona buale kɛ, “Saa menwule bɔbɔ a anrɛɛ mewu.”
10Na Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Dwona kɛ, “Baka ye, mɔɔ wɔmɔ wɔanyɛ nwolɛ ɛhwee biala, tɛ wɔmɔ yɛɛ ɛluale a; ɔfifile kenle ko nɔɔzo, na ye alehyenlɛ nu yewu la, yemɔ ɔyɛ wɔ nyane. 11Duzu ati yɛɛ mame, suakpole mɔɔ le kɛ Nenɛvɛ, mɔɔ ɛlie duma na menli mɔɔ bo apenle ngoko ɛya ko abulanwiɔ mɔɔ bɛnze bɛ bɛne a bɛnze bɛ fema, nee nyɛmoa wɔ zolɛ la, menrɛze bɛ anwunvɔne a?”

Title: MAE MUKENYE
Content:
Mukenye
Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ Maeka yɛle ye gyima ne wɔ mekɛ ko ne ala mɔɔ ɛnee Ayezaya ɛlɛyɛ ye Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ gyima ne la. Maeka vi sua bie azo namule nu wɔ Dwuda nyiakɛ belemgbunli maanle ne anu.
Ɛnee Maeka die to nu kɛ anwubɛnyunlu ne mɔɔ ɛdo sɔlɔ belemgbunli maanle ne, kɛmɔ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ Emɔso hanle la bie bado Dwuda maanle ne, yɛɛ bɛ ngilenu le ko. Nyamenle badea menli ne kɛ bɛnli pɛlepɛle. Noko eza Maeka nrɛlaleɛ ne, kenle bie anyelazo nwo sɛkɛlɛneɛ mɔɔ hyia la, la ali wienyi wɔ nu.
Edwɛkɛ mɔɔ wɔ buluku ne anu mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ sonla nea ye kpalɛ la a le ewiade amuala anu anzonudwolɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle banlea yeamaa yeara la (4.1-4); belemgbunli kpole bie mɔɔ vi Belemgbunli Devidi abusua nu mɔɔ bava anzonudwolɛ ara maanle ne anu la anwo edwɛkɛ mɔɔ Maeka hanle dole ɛkɛ (5.2-5), yɛɛ mgbakyelɛ nsia, ngyehyɛnu mɔtwɛ ne mɔɔ fa Yizilayɛ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma amuala edwɛkɛ bɔ ye kpɔkɛ ko kɛ, “Mɔɔ Nyamenle kpondɛ wɔ yɛ ɛkɛ ne la a le ɛhye: Bɛyɛ mɔɔ le pɛlepɛle la, bɛhile ɛhulolɛ kpundii na bɛva mɛlɛbɛnwoaze bɛ nee Nyamenle ɛlua.”
Mɔɔ wɔ nu la
Yizilayɛ nee Dwuda Ndeanlɛ 1.1—3.12
Maanle ne boɛyɛlɛ bieko nee anzonudwolɛ 4.1—5.15
Kɔkɔbɔlɛ nee anyelazo nwo nrɛlaleɛ 6.1—7.20

Title: MAE 1
Content:
1Wɔ Dwuda arelemgbunli Dwɔtam, Ehaze, yɛɛ Hɛzikaya mekɛ zo, Ɛdɛnkɛma dendɛle hilele Maeka mɔɔ vi Molɛhyɛte la. Edwɛkɛ ne fane Samɛlea nee Gyɛlusalɛm anwo.
Samɛlea nee Gyɛlusalɛm anwo ɛzunlɛ nee awolɛyelɛ
2Maanle maanle, bɛ muala bɛdie;
bɛdie, O azɛlɛ ye nee zolɛ ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti;
Awulae Nyamenle badendɛ atia bɛ,
Awulae badendɛ avi ye anwuma lɔ sua nwuanzanwuanza ne anu.
3Ɔluakɛ bɛnlea, Ɛdɛnkɛma vi ɛleka mɔɔ ɔde la ɔlɛba,
ɔbara yearaluolua ewiade awoka mgbole ne mɔ azo.
4Awoka ne mɔ baholo ɔ gyakɛ abo,
mbɔnza ne mɔ anu badudu ahuma mgbole;
bɛbaholo kɛ ɛyɛlɛ mɔɔ ɛha senle la,
na bɛaze kɛ azule mɔɔ vi boka kyengye zo ɛlɛwola la.
