Bɛbanriandi, kɛmɔ bɛ nlenya mɔ nriandile azɛlɛkpusulɛ mekɛ ne anu wɔ Dwuda Belemgbunli Ɛzaya mekɛ zo la. Akee Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne bara, na ɔ nee Nyamenle menli ne mɔ amuala ara.
6Kenle zɔhane, wuluwulu ɛnrɛra yɛɛ ɛyɛlɛ ɛnrɛra. 7Ɔbayɛ kenle mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɔdaye ala a ɔze a. Aleɛ ɛnrɛdwo na aleɛ ahye, ɔluakɛ aledwolɛ bayɛ wienyi kɛ alehyenlɛ la.
8 Mekɛ ne anu, ngoane nzule bazenze avi Gyɛlusalɛm, foa ko bazenze ahɔgua aduduleɛ nyevile ne anu na foa ko noko ahɔgua adɔleɛ nyevile ne anu. Fɔsɛlɛ nu o, wawaa nu o, kɛ ɔsi ɔsenze la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ ɔbazenze mekɛ biala a. 9Ɛdɛnkɛma bali azɛlɛ ye kɔsɔɔti azo belemgbunli; mekɛ ne anu awie biala bazonle Ɛdɛnkɛma kɛ yemɔ a ɔle Nyamenle kokye ne a yɛɛ ye duma ko.
10Azɛlɛ ne kpokpoti, ɔvi Giba mɔɔ kɔdwu Relemɔn mɔɔ wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm nyiakɛ la bayɛ fienemgbole. Na Gyɛlusalɛm bagyinla kpundii wɔ ɔ bo zo ne wɔ boka zo, ɔvi Bɛngyaman Anlenkɛ Kpole nloa yeahɔ anlenkɛ kpole dɛba ne anwo, yeahɔdwu Muleɛ Anlenkɛ Kpole ne anloa, na ɔvi Hananili Tawa ne anwo yeahɔdwu belemgbunli ne nwanyeyɛlɛ ɛleka ne mɔ. 11 Menli bayi zo gbudugbudu, ɔluakɛ munzule biala ɛnrɛra zolɛ. Gyɛlusalɛmma badɛnla mɔɔ awie ɛngyegye bɛ a.
12Akee ewule mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma bava ado maanle maanle mɔɔ kɛva konle kɛdoa Gyɛlusalɛm la anwo la ɛne: bɛ nwonane bakpɔlɔ wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛde ngoane nu la, bɛ nye bakpɔlɔ bɛ nye mbɔne ne mɔ anu, yɛɛ bɛ tafinlima bakpɔlɔ bɛ nloa anu.
13Mekɛ ne anu Ɛdɛnkɛma bamaa sulosulo adɔ bɛ nwo na bɛ nye zo ada bɛ, amaa bɛadwazo bɛdabɛ bɛ ngome bɛ nwo zo ngoko ngoko. 14Dwudama bɔbɔ baho atia Gyɛlusalɛmma. Bɛbave anwonyia mɔɔ wɔ aleɛabo la amuala; ezukoa nvutuke, dwɛtɛ fufule, yɛɛ adɛladeɛ ngɛnlɛma dɔɔnwo mɔɔ zonle bo zolɛ.
15Ewulenzane badɔ mgbɔnwɔ, mgbɔnwɔndua, afunlumu, asoaso, yɛɛ nane biala mɔɔ wɔ kpɔvolɛ ne azokoɛleɛ la avinli.
16Akee awie biala mɔɔ wɔ maanle maanle ne mɔ mɔɔ ɛra Gyɛlusalɛm anwo zo ɛlɛ la anu, mɔɔ kɛvi ɛsalɛ la bahɔ Gyɛlusalɛm ɛvolɛ biala ahɔzonle Belemgbunli ne, Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, na yeali ye Kpɔda Bo Ɛdɛnlanlɛ Ɛvoyia ne. 17Na saa azɛlɛ ye azo abusua ekpulike bie wɔ ɛkɛ na yeangɔ Gyɛlusalɛm yeangɔnzonle Belemgbunli ne, Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma a, ezule ɛnrɛdɔ bɛ azɛlɛ ne azo. 18Saa Yigyibitima kpo na bɛangɔnva bɛ nwo bɛangile a, ewulenzane ne mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma fa to maanle maanle mɔɔ angɔnli Kpɔda Bo Ɛdɛnlanlɛ Ɛvoyia ne bie la anwo la ado bɛ avinli. 19Ɛhye a bayɛ Yigyibitima nee maanle maanle ne mɔ mɔɔ kɛkpo na bɛangɔnli Kpɔda Bo Ɛdɛnlanlɛ Ɛvoyia ne la ndeanlɛ a. 20Mekɛ ne anu bɛbahɛlɛ ɛhye wɔ mgbɔnwɔ ne mɔ dɔne ne mɔ anwo kɛ, “Bɛdu bɛzie ahane bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma.” Siase mɔɔ wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu la bayɛ kɛ azukponle ne azo dwora; 21yɛɛ siase biala mɔɔ wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm nee Dwuda la, bɛbadu bɛazie ahane bɛamaa Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, amaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛra kɛ bɛbabɔ azu la ava ado bɛ azubɔlɛ aleɛ ne. Awie ɛnrɛli gua wɔ Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu wɔ mekɛ ne anu.

Title: MAL MUKENYE
Content:
Mukenye
Malakae buluku ne vindele mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee ɔka ɛvolɛ ɛya nnu na bɛawo Kelaese ne la anu, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee bɛzi Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne mɔɔ wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm la bieko la anzi. Mɔɔ ɛnee gyi Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ ne anyunlu la a le kɛ ɔfɛlɛ sɛlɛvolɛma nee menli ne yeamaa bɛazia bɛ nzi bɛali nɔhalɛ bɛamaa ngyekyeleɛ ne mɔɔ la bɛ nee Nyamenle avinli la. Ɛnee ɔla ali wienyi kɛ Nyamenle menli ne ɛbɛlabɔlɛ ne ka bie, yɛɛ nɔhalɛlilɛ ɛnle bɛ Nyamenle ɛzonlenlɛ nu. Sɛlɛvolɛma ne nee menli ne wua Nyamenle; bɛnva azubɔlɛ mɔɔ fɛta la bɛmmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛɛ bɛnli ye ngilehilelɛ zo. Na Awulae barabua ye menli ne ndɛne na yeade bɛ nwo. Ɔbamaa ye soanvolɛ alumua ɔ nyunlu yearaziezie adenle ne anu yeamaa ye na yeabɔ ye ngyekyeleɛ ne nolo.
Mɔɔ wɔ nu la
Yizilayɛma ɛtane ne mɔ 1.1—2.16
Nyamenle ndeanlɛ nee ye anwunvɔnezelɛ ne 2.17—4.6

Title: MAL 1
Content:
1Ɛdɛnkɛma nrɛlaleɛ ne mɔɔ ɔluale Malakae anwo zo ɔvale ɔmanle Yizilayɛma la ɛne:
Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛhulolɛ mɔɔ ɔkulo Yizilayɛma la
2 Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Mehulo bɛ.”
Noko bɛmɛ bɛse, “Kɛ wɔzi wɔhulo yɛ ɛ?”
Ɛdɛnkɛma biza bɛ kɛ, “Asoo tɛ Yisɔ adiema a le Gyekɔbo? Noko mehulo Gyekɔbo, Emɔ 1.11-12; Oba 1-14 3na mekpɔ Yisɔ. Memaa ye awoka zo azɛlɛ ɛhakyi ɛsɛlɛ na meva ye agyadeɛ muala mewula ɛsɛlɛ zo boboduma ne mɔ asa anu.”
4Saa Yidɔmma ka kɛ, “Bɛzɛkye yɛ maanle ye bɔbɔ ɛdeɛ, noko yɛbazia yɛakyekye ye fofolɛ” a, ɛnee kɛ Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma se la ɛne, “Bɛbakyekye bɛ azua ne mɔ, na mebagologolo bɛ meagua. Bɛbavɛlɛ bɛ azɛlɛ ne ‘Amumuyɛ Azɛlɛ’ na bɛavɛlɛ bɛdabɛ mumua ne ‘Menli mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛva bɛ nwo ɛya mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ a.’ ”
5Bɛdabɛ bɛbanwu ye bɛ nye zo na bɛaha kɛ, “Ɛdɛnkɛma anwo yɛ ɛzulolɛ wɔ Yizilayɛ anzi lɔ!”
Ɛdɛnkɛma twi sɛlɛvolɛma anyunlu
6Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma biza bɛ kɛ, “Ralɛ di ɔ ze eni yɛɛ akɛlɛ di ɔ menle eni. Na saa mele bɛ ze a, ɛnee eni mɔɔ bɛdi me la a le boni? Yɛɛ saa mele bɛ menle a, ɛnee ɛzulolɛ mɔɔ bɛsulo me la wɔ nienwu? Bɛmɛ sɛlɛvolɛma bɔbɔ yɛɛ bɛsɛkye me duma a. Noko bɛmɛ bɛbiza kɛ, ‘Ɛnee kɛ yɛzi yɛzɛkye wɔ duma ɛ?’ 7Bɛfa aleɛ mɔɔ nwolɛ ɛnde la bɛgua me azukponle zo. Noko bɛbiza kɛ, ‘Kɛ yɛzi yɛgua ɛ nwo evinli ɛ?’ Bɛ adwenle a le kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma azukponle ne bɔbɔ, ɔnle kɛ bɛdi ye eni. 8 Asoo saa bɛfa nane mɔɔ anye ɛzi la bɛba kɛ bɛva bɛbɔ azu bɛmaa me a, ɛnee bɛdabɛ bɛnea a bɛtɛbɔle munzule? Yɛɛ saa bɛfa nane mɔɔ ɛbubu anzɛɛ ewule ɛha ye la bɛba kɛ bɛva bɛbɔ azu bɛmaa me a, asoo ɛnee bɛtɛbɔle munzule? Bɛva ninyɛne zɔhane mɔ bɛhɔhyɛ bɛ amɛnlado ne. Asoo bɛnea a ɔ kunlu kɛdwo bɛ nwo anzɛɛ ɔ nye kɛlie bɛ nwo?”
9Bɛmɛ sɛlɛvolɛma, bɛzɛlɛ Nyamenle bɛmaa ɔ nye ɛlie yɛ nwo na ɔlo yɛ. Asoo bɛnea a ɔkɛlie bɛ sa nu azubɔdeɛ mɔɔ le zɛhae la? 10Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Anrɛɛ bɛ nuhua ko ahɔtoto Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne nlenkɛ ne mɔ anu amaa bɛanzɔ senle wɔ me azukponle ne azo mgbane mgbane. Me kunlu ɛndwo bɛ nwo yɛɛ menrɛlie bɛ sa nu azubɔdeɛ biala. 11Me duma le kpole wɔ maanle maanle avinli ɔvi sɛnzɛne aduduleɛ kɔdwu adɔleɛ. Ɛleka biala bɛkpu ɛyɛlɛ evuanlɛ na bɛfa azubɔdeɛ mɔɔ anwo te la bɛmaa me, ɔluakɛ me duma ne le kpole wɔ maanle maanle avinli. 12Na bɛmɛ, saa bɛka kɛ ‘Ɛdɛnkɛma azukponle ne anwo ɛnde yɛɛ kpanwo ne ɛnle kpalɛ’ a ɛnee bɛgua azukponle ne anwo evinli. 13Bɛmɛ, bɛ edwɛkɛ a le kɛ, ‘Duzu ɛvɛlɛ a le ɛhye?’ Bɛka ɛhye na bɛakpobi bɛ nloa.
“Saa bɛbabɔ azu a bɛfa nane mɔɔ bɛwuale, anzɛɛ ɛbubu anzɛɛ ewule ɛha ye la a bɛyɛ azubɔdeɛ bɛbɛlɛ me a. Asoo medie ɛhye a ɔyɛ boɛ? 14Munzule ɛha nzisi sonla ne mɔɔ lɛ boane nyinli wɔ ye nyɛmoa nu, ɔkɛva ɔkɛbɔ ɛwɔkɛ, na akee ɔkɛva ɛtane bie ɔkɛrabɔ azu ɔkɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma la, ɔluakɛ mele belemgbunli kpole, yɛɛ maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti sulo me.”

Title: MAL 2
Content:
1Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Akee bɛmɛ sɛlɛvolɛma, bɛ mɛla a le ɛhye: 2Saa bɛnrɛdie me edwɛkɛ, bɛnrɛva bɛnrɛzie bɛ ahonle nu kɛ bɛwula me duma ne anyunlunyia a, mebamaa munzule ara bɛ nwo zo na meamaa bɛ nyilalɛ ahakyi munzule. Nɔhalɛ, memaa bɛ nyilalɛ ɛhakyi munzule dɛbadɛba, ɔboalekɛ bɛambu me edwɛkɛ ne bie. 3Mebahwi bɛ bo zo amra anyunlu, na meava bɛ azubɔlɛ nane ne mɔ ebinli meakpuda bɛ nyunlu, na meaye bɛ meavi me nye zo. 4 Ɛhye yɛɛ bamaa bɛanwu kɛ medame yɛɛ meva mɛla ɛhye memaa bɛ a, amaa ngyekyeleɛ mɔɔ me nee Livae yɛkyekyele la anzɛkye.
5 “Ngyekyeleɛ ne mɔɔ me nee ye yɛle la le ngoane nee anzonudwolɛ ngyekyeleɛ, yɛɛ menvale memanle ye amaa yeazulo, yɛɛ ɔzulole me noko. Ɔte me duma a, ɔ nwo wozo ye. 6Ye ngilehilelɛ le fɔɔnwo yɛɛ yeambɔ adalɛ biala. Ɔ nee me luale anzonudwolɛ nu na ɔbɔle ɛbɛla mɔɔ tenrɛ la, na ɔmanle menli dɔɔnwo gyakyile ɛtaneyɛlɛ. 7Ɔluakɛ ɔwɔ kɛ ndelebɛbo finde sɛlɛvolɛ biala anloa edwɛkɛ nu, yɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ menli fa ɛzukoalɛdeɛ wɔ ye ɛdendɛlɛ nu, ɔboalekɛ ɔle Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma soanvolɛ.
8“Noko bɛmɛ, bɛvi adenle ɛhye azo bɛye bɛ nwo yɛɛ bɛva bɛ ngilehilelɛ bɛmaa menli dɔɔnwo ɛdu koti; bɛtulu ngyekyeleɛ ne mɔɔ me nee Livae kyekyele la. 9Zɔhane ati medame Ɛdɛnkɛma mese, meye bɛ nyunlu nwoma mɔɔ awie biala ɛmbu bɛ a, amaa bɛagua bɛ nyunlu aze wɔ menli nu, ɔboalekɛ bɛanlua me adenle ne anu bɛangilehile; bɛnea sonla nyunlu na bɛahilehile.”
Menli ne anli nɔhalɛ ammaa Nyamenle
10Yɛ muala yɛ ze ɛnle ko ɔ? Tɛ Nyamenle ko ne ala a bɔle yɛ muala ɔ? Duzu ati a yɛnli nɔhalɛ yɛmmaa yɛ nwo, na ɔlua zo yɛgua yɛ ze mɔ ngyekyeleɛ ne mɔɔ bɛ nee Nyamenle yɛle la anwo evinli a? 11Dwudama anli nɔhalɛ, bɛbɔ munzule wɔ Yizilayɛ amuala nee Gyɛlusalɛm. Dwudama ɛva evinli ɛha Ɛleka Nwuanzanwuanza ne mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anye die ɛkɛ ne la. Bɛhɔgya mraalɛ mɔɔ sonle nyamenle gyɛne la. 12Sonla mɔɔ yɛ ɛhye mɔ la, saa yemɔ a ɔdi nwolɛ ɛzonle, anzɛɛ ɔdi daselɛ, anzɛɛ saa ɔfa nwolɛ azubɔdeɛ ɔba Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu bɔbɔ a, Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛye ye ɛvi Gyɛkɔbo sua nu.
13Debie bieko mɔɔ eza bɛyɛ la ɛne: Bɛtwi monle wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma azukponle ne azo. Bɛsu na bɛdi nyane bɛ nuhua kɛ ɛnɛ ɔnlie bɛ azubɔlɛ ninyɛne ne mɔ, yɛɛ ɔ nye ɛnlie nwolɛ. 14Bɛbiza kɛ, “Duzu ati a ɔnlie ɛ?” Ɔboalekɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma di ngyekyeleɛ mɔɔ bɛ nee bɛ mraalɛ mɔɔ bɛgyale bɛ bɛ mgbavolɛ nu la yɛle la anwo daselɛ. Bɛanli nɔhalɛ bɛammaa bɛ, noko bɛ mraalɛ ɔ, yɛɛ ngyekyeleɛ ne kile kɛ bɛle bɛ ye mɔ. 15Asoo Ɛdɛnkɛma anga bɛ ambɔ nu anyɛ bɛ ko wɔ sunsum nee nwonane nu? Na duzu a ɛnee ɔkpondɛ a? Ɔkpondɛ Nyamenle nu mralɛ. Yemɔti bɛnlea bɛ nwo boɛ kpalɛ na bɛmmabɔ bɛ mraalɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛgya bɛ bɛ mgbavolɛ nu la ewole. 16Yizilayɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle ne se, “Mekyi ewolebɔlɛ, yɛɛ mekyi nrenya mɔɔ fa anyebolo bɔ ɔ ye ewole la. Medame Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a. Yemɔti bɛnlea bɛ nwo boɛ na bɛli nɔhalɛ bɛmaa bɛ ye mɔ.”
Ndɛnebualɛ Kenle ne ɛbikye
17Bɛva bɛ ɛdendɛlɛ bɛgyegye Ɛdɛnkɛma, na akee bɛbiza kɛ, “Kɛ yɛzi yɛgyegye ye ɛ?” Bɛ edwɛkɛ mɔɔ bɛka la a le kɛ, “Awie biala mɔɔ di ɛtane la le kpalɛ wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anye zo, yɛɛ ɔ nye die bɛ nwo.” Eza bɛbiza kɛ, “Na Nyamenle ne mɔɔ di pɛlepɛle la wɔ nienwu?”

Title: MAL 3
Content:
1 Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Nea, mebazoa me ɛbɔfoɔ meamaa yeahɔziezie adenle ne anu yeamaa me. Na arɛlevilɛ nu ala bɛbanwu Awulae ne mɔɔ bɛlɛkpondɛ ye la kɛ ɔlɛkɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu. Ngyekyeleɛ ne anwo ɛbɔfoɔ ne mɔɔ bɛ nye la ye ade la ɛlɛba.”
2 Kenle mɔɔ ɔkɛra la, nwane a kɛhola gyinla a, yɛɛ saa ɔye ɔ nyunlu a, nwane a kɛnyia gyinlagyakɛ a? Ɔluakɛ ɔbayɛ kɛ dwinvolɛ senle mɔɔ ɔfa ɔtu ninyɛne nu anzɛɛ saminla anloa ɛsesebɛ mɔɔ bɛfa bɛkpo ninyɛne la. 3Ɔbadɛnla aze kɛ dwinvolɛ mɔɔ tu dwɛtɛ fufule nu la. Ɔbadu Livaema anu na yeabolo bɛ nwo kɛ ezukoa nvutuke anzɛɛ yeahwi bɛ nwo kɛ dwɛtɛ fufule, kɔdwu mekɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛva nɔhalɛ azubɔlɛ ninyɛne bɛkɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma la. 4Ɛhye bamaa Dwudama nee Gyɛlusalɛmma azubɔlɛ ninyɛne ayɛ anyenzɔlɛ amaa Ɛdɛnkɛma, kɛmɔ ɛnee ɔde wɔ ɛvolɛ dɔɔnwo mɔɔ ɛraze ɛhɔ la.
5Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Mebahwe meabikye bɛ na meabua bɛ ndɛne. Mebadea ngonyiama, awuvolɛvalɛma nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛka ndane mgbane mgbane la ndɛndɛ zo. Mebadea bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsisi gyimayɛvoma wɔ bɛ kakɛdualɛ nu, bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsisi ahunlanvolɛ nee nrisa, bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛmbu nyɛvolɛ yɛɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnzulo me la.”
Ngyɛnu bulu ɛkpɔ ko ɛdualɛ ne
6Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, mengakyi ɛlɛ. Yemɔti bɛmɛ Gyekɔbo abo zo amra, bɛ bo zo ɛtɛbɔle bɔkɔɔ. 7Sumunli bɛ nlenya mɔ mekɛ zo yɛɛ bɛvale me mɛla zo ɛtietialɛ a, yɛɛ bɛnli zolɛ. Bɛzia bɛrɛla me ɛkɛ ne, na medame noko menwɔra bɛ nwo ɛkɛ. Noko bɛbiza kɛ, ‘Ɛnee kɛ yɛyɛ yɛzia yɛ nzi ɛ?’ 8Asoo sonla kola wua Nyamenle? Noko bɛmɛ, ɛwualɛ ala a bɛwua me a. Na bɛbiza kɛ, ‘Ɛnee kɛ yɛsi yɛwua wɔ ɛ?’ Bɛwua me wɔ bɛ azubɔlɛ nu nee ninyɛne ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛkyɛ nu bulu bɛtu ɛkpɔ ngoko bɛmaa me la anu. 9Bɛbɔ munzule, bɛdabɛ maanlema amuala, ɔluakɛ bɛlɛwua me. 10 Ɛkpɔ ne mɔ mɔɔ le me ɛdeɛ la, bɛva bɛ kɔsɔɔti bɛrɛla bɛragua ɛleka mɔɔ mesie me ninyɛne ne la, amaa aleɛ ara me sua nu. Bɛzɔ me bɛnlea wɔ ɛhye anwo na bɛnlea saa menrɛbuke anwuma nlenkɛ menrɛgua nwolɛ menrɛmaa bɛnrɛnyia nyilalɛ dɔɔnwo a. 11Menrɛmaa ngɛkɛba ɛnrɛli bɛ aleɛ, yɛɛ bɛ vanye mbaka ɛnrɛkpolo bɛ ndotolo nee ma ɛnrɛgua. 12Na maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti baha kɛ Nyamenle ɛlo bɛ, ɔluakɛ bɛ maanle nu bayɛ anyelielɛ.”
Nyamenle anwunvɔnezelɛ ne anwo ɛwɔkɛ
13Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Bɛheha ɛtane ɛtane bɛtietia me! Noko bɛbiza kɛ, ‘Duzu edwɛkɛ a yɛha yɛtia wɔ a?’ 14Bɛha kɛ, ‘Nyamenle ɛzonlenlɛ le debie mgbane. Duzu nvasoɛ yɛɛ yɛnyia ye wɔ ye ɛhulolɛdeɛ zo ɛlilɛ nwo, nee yɛ nwo alɔbɔlɛ alɔbɔlɛ mɔɔ yɛyɛ wɔ Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu, kɛ asɛɛ nyane bie ɛdo yɛ la anwo a? 15Noko nea, ɛnɛ, yɛfa sonla mɔɔ le mgbanyizonle la kɛ Nyamenle ɛyila ye. Menli mɔɔ di ɛtane la kpazi, yɛɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛfa bɛ ɛtane bɛsɔ Nyamenle bɛnea la anwo dwɔɔ.’ ”
16Na bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsulo Ɛdɛnkɛma la dule bɛ nwo azukue. Ɛdɛnkɛma diele bie, yɛɛ ɔdele ɔ muala. Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsulo Ɛdɛnkɛma na bɛdwenle ɔ nwo la, bɛhɛlɛle bɛ muala aluma wɔ ngakyelɛ buluku nu, ɔla Nyamenle anyunlu. 17Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Bɛbayɛ me ɛdeɛ. Bɛbayɛ me agyadeɛ mɔɔ anwo hyia a, wɔ kenle mɔɔ menwɔha me nwo la. Mebanwu bɛ anwunvɔne, kɛmɔ sonla nwu ɔ ra mɔɔ sonle ye la anwunvɔne la. 18Na akee bɛbanwu ngakyile mɔɔ wɔ sonla mɔɔ di pɛlepɛle nee mɔɔ yɛ amumuyɛ la avinli la, nee ngakyile mɔɔ wɔ sonla mɔɔ sonle Nyamenle nee mɔɔ ɛnzonle Nyamenle la avinli la.”

Title: MAL 4
Content:
Ɛdɛnkɛma Kenle ne ɛlɛba
1Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Bɛnlea, kenle ne ɛlɛba; ɔbazɔ kɛ fonlomo senle. Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛmemaa bɛ nwo zo nee amumuyɛma bayela kɛ ewula. Bɛ ndinli bɔbɔ ɛnrɛha na yeayɛ bɛ ngane. 2Na bɛmɛ mɔɔ bɛsulo me la, pɛlepɛle sɛnzɛne mɔɔ le ayile la badudu bɛ nwo zo. Na bɛbavinde wienyi nu na bɛawuluwulu kɛ nlankɛ mralɛ mɔɔ bɛye bɛ bɛvi tunli nu la. 3Na bɛbatietia amumuyɛma anwo zo. Amumuyɛma bayɛ kɛ nzonle wɔ bɛ gyakɛ abo wɔ kenle mɔɔ mebaha me nwo la. 4Bɛhakye me mɛla nee me ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ menvale memanle me sonvolɛ Mosisi wɔ Hɔlɛbe kɛ ɔva ɔmaa Yizilayɛma amuala la.
5 “Mebazoa Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ Yilaegya bɛ nwo kolaa na Ɛdɛnkɛma kenle kpole anu ɛzulolɛ ne ara. 6Ɔbamaa selɛma ahulo bɛ mra na mralɛ ahulo bɛ ze mɔ; saa tɛ ye zɔhane a, anrɛɛ mebara na meamaa munzule ava azɛlɛ ye.”

Title: MAT MUKENYE
Content:
Mukenye
Mateyu Edwɛkpa ne ka edwɛkɛ fɛlɛko ne mɔɔ kile kɛ Gyisɛse a le Dievolɛ ne mɔɔ bɛvale bɛbɔle ɛwɔkɛ, na ɔ nwo zo a Nyamenle luale yele ye ɛwɔkɛ ne mɔɔ ɔbɔle ye menli ne wɔ Ngyekyeleɛ Dɛba ne anu la. Edwɛkɛ fɛlɛko ɛhye ɛnle Dwuuma mɔɔ bɛ avinli a bɛwole Gyisɛse na bɛtetele ye la angome ɛdeɛ, ɔle ewiade amra amuala ɛdeɛ.
Bɛboale a bɛhyehyɛle Mateyu nwoma ne a. Ɔbɔ ɔ bo wɔ Gyisɛse awolɛ nu, ɔka ye ɛzɔnenlɛ ne nee ye sɔnea ne anwo edwɛkɛ, na akee ɔka ye ɛzonlenlɛ ne mɔɔ fane ye nolobɔlɛ, ngilehilelɛ nee ye ayileyɛlɛ wɔ Galeli la anwo edwɛkɛ. Ɛhye anzi Edwɛkpa ne ka Gyisɛse adendulɛ ne mɔɔ ɔdule ɔvi Galeli ɔhɔle Gyɛlusalɛm la anwo edwɛkɛ, yɛɛ mɔɔ sisile Gyisɛse anwo zo wɔ dapɛne ne mɔɔ li amozi la anu, na ɔrawiele ye meanubaka ne azo ɛhunlɛ nee ye ewudwazo nwo la anwo edwɛkɛ.
Edwɛkpa ne kile kɛ Gyisɛse le kilehilevolɛ kpole mɔɔ lɛ tumi na ɔkola ɔkilehile mɛla ne abo, na eza ɔkilehile Nyamenle Belemgbunlililɛ ne anu a. Ye ngilehilelɛ ne gua ngakyile nnu na bɛboɔboa ɔ nloa zɛhae: (1) Boka ne azo Edwɛkpa ne nolobɔlɛ ne mɔɔ fane Anwuma Belemgbunlililɛ ne menli ne subane, bɛ gyima mɔɔ la bɛ nwo zo, nvasoɛ mɔɔ bɛnyia ye, yɛɛ kɛ bɛ awieleɛ bazi awie bɛ la. (Mgbakyelɛ 5-7); (2) Ɛdoavolɛma bulu nee nwiɔ ne ɛhilehilelɛ mɔɔ fane bɛ gyima nwo (Mgbakyelɛ 10); (3) Anwuma Belemgbunlililɛ ne anwo mrɛlɛ (Mgbakyelɛ 13); (4) Ɛdoavolɛyɛlɛ nwo ngilehilelɛ (Mgbakyelɛ 18); yɛɛ (5) Ewiade ɛhye awieleɛ nee Anwuma Belemgbunlililɛ ne ɛralɛ (Mgbakyelɛ 24-25).
Mɔɔ wɔ nu la
Gyisɛse Kelaese abusua nee ye awolɛ 1.1—2.23
Dwɔn Sɔnevolɛ ne ɛzonlenlɛ 3.1-12
Gyisɛse ɛzɔnenlɛ nee ye sɔnea 3.13—4.11
Gyisɛse bagua nu ɛzonlenlɛ wɔ Galeli 4.12—18.35
Gyisɛse vi Galeli kɔ Gyɛlusalɛm 19.1—20.34
Dapɛne ne mɔɔ li amozi la anu wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm nee ye namunamu ne mɔ azo 21.1—27.66
Awulae ewudwazo ne nee ɔ nwo mɔɔ ɔyele ɔhilele la 28.1-20

Title: MAT 1
Content:
Gyisɛse Kelaese abusua ɛlɔnwɔne ne
(Luk 3.23-38)
1 Gyisɛse Kelaese abusua ɛlɔnwɔne ne ɛne. Gyisɛse le Devidi angabɛnzo yɛɛ Devidi le Ebileham alɔnra.
2Ebileham wole Ayezeke, Ayezeke wole Gyekɔbo, Gyekɔbo wole Dwuda nee ɔ mediema ne mɔ. 3Dwuda wole Pɛlɛze nee Zila (bɛfɛlɛ bɛ nli Teemaa), Pɛlɛze wole Hɛzelɔn, Hɛzelɔn wole Relam, 4Relam wole Amenadabe, Amenadabe wole Nahyɔn, Nahyɔn wole Salemɔn, 5Salemɔn wole Bowaze, (bɛfɛlɛ ɔ nli Releehabe); Bowaze wole Obɛde (bɛfɛlɛ ɔ nli Wulutu), Obɛde wole Gyɛsi, yɛɛ 6Gyɛsi wole Belemgbunli Devidi.
Devidi wole Sɔlɔmɔn (ɔ nli a le raalɛ ne mɔɔ Yulaya gyale ye bie la), 7Sɔlɔmɔn wole Rilihɔbowam; Rilihɔbowam wole Abaegya, Abaegya wole Esa, 8Esa wole Gyɛhɔhyafate, Gyɛhɔhyafate wole Gyɛholam, Gyɛholam wole Ɛzaya, 9Ɛzaya wole Dwotam, Dwotam wole Ehaze, Ehaze wole Hɛzikaya, 10Hɛzikaya wole Manasɛ, Manasɛ wole Amɔn, Amɔn wole Dwosaya, 11Dwosaya wole Gyɛhɔyakɛn nee ɔ mediema ne mɔ. Mekɛ ɛhye anu yɛɛ Babelɔnoma hyele Dwuda maanlema dɔɔnwo hɔle nlɔnu a.
12Bɛvale bɛ bɛhɔle Babelɔn la nzinlii Gyɛhɔyakɛn wole Hyealeteɛle, Hyealeteɛle wole Zɛlɛbabɛle, 13Zɛlɛbabɛle wole Abayude, Abayude wole Yilayakem, Yilayakem wole Ezɔ, 14Ezɔ wole Zeedɔko, Zeedɔko wole Ekem, Ekem wole Yilayɛde, 15Yilayɛde wole Ɛlieza, Ɛlieza wole Matan, Matan wole Gyekɔbo, 16Gyekɔbo wole Dwosefi, mɔɔ ɔ ye a le Mɛle mɔɔ wole Gyisɛse, mɔɔ le Kelaese ne la.
17Zɔhane ati, ɔvi Ebileham anwo zo toonwo mɔɔ badwu Devidi anwo zo la le awolɛndoazo bulu nee nna, yɛɛ ɔvi Devidi anwo zo toonwo mɔɔ badwu mekɛ mɔɔ bɛhyele Dwuda maanlema bɛhɔle Babelɔn la le awolɛndoazo bulu nee nna, yɛɛ ɔvi mekɛ zɔhane mɔɔ badwu Kelaese ne awolɛ nu la le awolɛndoazo bulu nee nna.
Gyisɛse Kelaese awolɛ ne
(Luk 2.1-7)
18 Kɛ Gyisɛse Kelaese awolɛ ne yɛle la ɛne. Mekɛ mɔɔ Dwosefi yiale Mɛle, mɔɔ le Gyisɛse ɔ nli ne, na ɔtɛnyianle ɔtɛyɛle ɔ nwo debie la bɛnwunle kɛ Mɛle lua Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne anwo zo ɛva ɛkolɛ. 19Kɛmɔ ɛnee Dwosefi le sonla mɔɔ di pɛlepɛle na yeangulo kɛ ɔkɛbɔ ye anyiemgba la, ɔdwenlenle nwolɛ kɛ ɔfa ahane yeahɔye ɔ nloa wɔ ɔ nwo. 20Na mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee Dwosefi ɛlɛdwenledwenle ɛhye anwo la, Awulae soanvolɛ yele ɔ nwo hilele ye wɔ ɛlalɛ nu na ɔzele ye kɛ, “Dwosefi, Devidi alɔnra, mmasulo kɛ ɛkɛva Mɛle ɛkɛyɛ ɛ ye, ɔluakɛ ɔlua Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne anwo zo a yenrenzɛ a. 21 Ɔbawo ralɛ nrenya na wɔado ye duma Gyisɛse, ɔboalekɛ ɔbalie ye menli ne yeavi bɛ ɛtane nu.”
22Ɛhye mɔ amuala zile amaa mɔɔ Awulae luale ye kpɔmanvolɛ ne anwo zo hanle la ayɛ nɔhalɛ kɛ, 23 “Bɛlɛra mɔɔ ɛnze nrenya la banrenzɛ awo ralɛ nrenya na bɛbavɛlɛ ye Yemanoɛle.” (Ɔ bo a le “Nyamenle nee yɛ de.”)
24Ɛhye ati mɔɔ Dwosefi vi nla nu dwazole la, ɔyɛle ye kɛmɔ Awulae soanvolɛ ne zele ye la na ɔgyale Mɛle. 25 Noko yeanva ɔ nwo yeanga Mɛle toonwo ɔhɔkpulale mekɛ mɔɔ ɔwole ye belamunli ralɛ nrenya ne la. Na Dwosefi donle ye Gyisɛse.

Title: MAT 2
Content:
Nrɛlɛbɛvolɛma nsa ne
1Bɛwole Gyisɛse wɔ sua ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Bɛtelɛhɛm la azo, wɔ Dwudiya maanzinli nu, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee Hɛlɔdo a di belemgbunli la. Nrɛlɛbɛvolɛma bie vi aduduleɛ rale Gyɛlusalɛm 2rabizale kɛ, “Nienwu a yɛkɛnwu Dwuuma belemgbunli ne mɔɔ bɛwo ye la a? Ɔluakɛ yɛnwunle ye ɛwɔlɔra ne mɔɔ dule la wɔ aduduleɛ nehane, na yɛra kɛ yɛbazonle ye.”
3Belemgbunli Hɛlɔdo dele ɛhye la ye adwenle zɛkyele, na Gyɛlusalɛm amra amuala noko atiakunlu zɛkyele. 4Ɔyieyiale sɛlɛvolɛ mgbanyinli ne nee mɛla kilehilevolɛma ne mɔ amuala na ɔbizale bɛ kɛ, “Nienwu a ɔwɔ kɛ bɛwo Kelaese ne a?”
5Bɛbuale ye kɛ, “Wɔ Bɛtelɛhɛm mɔɔ wɔ Dwudiya la. Zɔhane yɛɛ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ ne hɛlɛle a. Ɔse,
6 ‘Na wɔmɔ Bɛtelɛhɛm, mɔɔ wɔ Dwuda maanle nu,
ɛnle ekyi wɔ Dwuda maanle nu azuamgbole avinli;
ɔluakɛ wɔ ɛkɛ ne yɛɛ mɔɔ barali Yizilayɛma ati
anlea me menli ne anwo zo la vi bara a.’ ”
7Yemɔti Belemgbunli Hɛlɔdo vɛlɛle nrɛlɛbɛvolɛma ne mɔ ahane na ɔbizebizale bɛ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛwɔlɔra ne vindele la. 8Ɔwiele la ɔhilele bɛ kɛ bɛhɔ Bɛtelɛhɛm, na ɔvale ɔzɔle zo kɛ, “Bɛhɔ na bɛhɔdɔ alagye bɛkpondɛ kakula ne, saa bɛnwu ye a bɛrabɔ me amaneɛ, amaa medame noko meahɔzonle ye bie.”
9Bɛdiele belemgbunli ne edwɛkɛ ne bɛwiele la bɛhɔle. Bɛkɔ la bɛnwunle ɛwɔlɔra ne mɔɔ bɛnwunle ye wɔ aduduleɛ la bieko; ɔlile bɛ nyunlu toonwo ɔhɔgyinlanle ɛleka mɔɔ kakula ne wɔ la anwuma. 10Bɛnwunle ɛwɔlɔra ne la bɛlile fɛlɛko kpole. 11Bɛwolole sua ne anu na bɛnwunle kakula ne nee ɔ nli Mɛle, na bɛbutule bɛzonlenle ye. Akee bɛzianyinli bɛ awɔlɛ ne mɔ anu na bɛhyɛle ye ezukoa nvutuke, ɛyɛlɛ, yɛɛ alufuanlɛ.
12Na Nyamenle hanle bɛ ɛlalɛ kɛ bɛmmasia bɛkɔ Belemgbunli Hɛlɔdo anwo lɔ bieko, yemɔti bɛvale adenle gyɛne zo bɛziale bɛhɔle bɛ maanle nu.
Bɛfa Gyisɛse bɛanriandi bɛahɔ Yigyibiti maanle nu
13Mɔɔ bɛhɔle la, Awulae soanvolɛ yele ɔ nwo hilele Dwosefi wɔ ɛlalɛ nu na ɔzele ye kɛ, “Belemgbunli Hɛlɔdo barakpondɛ kakula ye ahu ye, yemɔti dwazo na fa ye nee ɔ nli nriandi kɔ Yigyibiti maanle nu kɔdɛnla ɛkɛ ne kɔkpula mekɛ mɔɔ menwɔze wɔ kɛ akee ɛvi ɛkɛ ne la.”
14Dwosefi dunwuele la ɔvale kakula ne nee ɔ nli na nɔe ne ala ɔzile nu ɔhɔle Yigyibiti; 15 ɔdɛnlanle ɛkɛ ne toonwo ɔhɔkpulale mekɛ mɔɔ Hɛlɔdo wule la. Ɛhye zile amaa edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ Awulae luale ye kpɔmanvolɛ ne anwo zo hanle la ayɛ nɔhalɛ kɛ, “Menvɛlɛle me ra ne menvile Yigyibiti.”
Ngakula ne mɔ ɛhunlɛ
16Mɔɔ Belemgbunli Hɛlɔdo nwunle kɛ nrɛlɛbɛvolɛma ne mɔ ɛbɛlɛbɛla ye la, ɔvale ɛya kpole, na ɔvale ye adwenle ɔbubule ɔvile mekɛ mɔɔ nrɛlɛbɛvolɛma ne rahanle edwɛkɛ ne hilele ye la, na ɔmanle bɛhɔhunle ngakula mrenya ngyikyi ngyikyi mɔɔ wɔ Bɛtelɛhɛm nee azua mɔɔ zuozua Bɛtelɛhɛm, na bɛli ɛvolɛ nwiɔ nee mɔɔ ɛtɛdwule ɛvolɛ nwiɔ la amuala, kɛmɔ nrɛlɛbɛvolɛma ne zile hilele mekɛ ne la.
17Ɛhye manle edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ Gyɛlɛmaya hanle la yɛle nɔhalɛ kɛ:
18 “Bɛdele menli ne wɔ Releema
kɛ bɛlɛsu bɛaye awolɛ.
Relahyɛle ɛlɛsu ɔ mra, bɛkpɔda ye a ɔndie,
ɔluakɛ ɔ mra ne mɔ ɛwie wu.”
Bɛvi Yigyibiti maanle nu bɛzia
19Mɔɔ Belemgbunli Hɛlɔdo wule la, Awulae soanvolɛ hanle Dwosefi ɛlalɛ wɔ Yigyibiti na 20ɔzele ye kɛ, “Dwosefi, fa kakula ne nee ɔ nli sia kɔ Yizilayɛ azɛlɛ zo, ɔluakɛ menli mɔɔ kpondɛ kakula ne ahu ye la ɛwu.” 21Yemɔti Dwosefi dwazole vale kakula ne nee ɔ nli rale Yizilayɛ.
22Na mɔɔ Dwosefi dele kɛ Aakɛleeyɛse a ɛli ɔ ze Hɛlɔdo agya na yemɔ a ɔdi belemgbunli wɔ Dwudiya la, ɔzulole kɛ ɔkɛhɔ ɛkɛ ne. Bɛhakyele ye ɛhye wɔ ɛlalɛ nu, zɔhane ati ɔhɔle Galeli maanzinli nu, 23 na ɔhɔdɛnlanle sua ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Nazalɛte la azo. Ɛhye manle mɔɔ Nyamenle luale ye kpɔmanvolɛma ne mɔ anwo zo hanle la yɛle nɔhalɛ kɛ, “Bɛbavɛlɛ ye Nazalɛtenli.”

Title: MAT 3
Content:
Dwɔn Sɔnevolɛ ne bɔ nolo
(Mak 1.1-8; Luk 3.1-18; Dw 1.19-28)
1Mekɛ ne anu Dwɔn Sɔnevolɛ ne rale Dwudiya fienemgbole ne anu na ɔbɔle nolo kɛ, 2 “Bɛnlu bɛ nwo na Anwuma Belemgbunlililɛ ne ɛbikye!” 3 Dwɔn ɛhye a Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ Ayezaya hanle ɔ nwo edwɛkɛ kɛ,
“Awie ɛlɛtea nu wɔ fienemgbole ne anu kɛ,
‘Bɛziezie Awulae adenle ne,
bɛdenrɛdenrɛ ye ndenle ne mɔ.’ ”
4 Dwɔn wula tɛladeɛ mɔɔ bɛva afunlumu enrinli a bɛnwo la, na yeva nwoma akyeso yehye ɔ nze zo, yɛɛ ye aleɛ a le abɛbɛ nee wolɛ. 5Menli dɔɔnwo vi suakpole Gyɛlusalɛm azo, nee Dwudiya maanzinli ne anu amuala, yɛɛ azua mɔɔ gua Azule Dwɔdan ne anloa la amuala azo rale Dwɔn anwo ɛkɛ ne; 6bɛrahanle bɛ ɛtane na ɔzɔnenle bɛ wɔ Azule Dwɔdan ne anu.
7 Dwɔn nwunle kɛ menli dɔɔnwo vi Falasiima nee Sadusiima fane ne mɔ anu ɛlɛba bɛamaa bɛazɔne bɛ la, ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛmɛ nwɔlɛ! Nwane a zele bɛ kɛ bɛnriandi bɛvi Nyamenle ndeanlɛ ne mɔɔ bara la anwo ɛ? 8Bɛbɔ ɛbɛla kpalɛ mɔɔ kile kɛ bɛnlu bɛ nwo la. 9 Bɛmmadwenle bɛka kɛ, ‘Yɛmɛ yɛ nlenya a le Ebileham.’ Meka meahile bɛ kɛ Nyamenle kola maa awolɛ ɛhye mɔ dwazo yɛ Ebileham nlɔnra. 10 Bɛzi akuma mɔɔ bɛfa bɛadudu mbaka wɔ bɛ ndinli bo a. Ɛhye ati baka biala mɔɔ anzo ma kpalɛ la bɛkɛdu ye bɛkɛdo na bɛkɛvuandi ye bɛkɛdo senle nu. 11Mame mefa nzule a mesɔne bɛ a, amaa bɛanwu kɛ bɛnlu bɛ nwo, na awie bie vi me nzi ɛlɛba mɔɔ yemɔ ɔle kpole ɔtɛla me a. Menfɛta kɛ menwɔzoa ye mgbɔlaboa bɔbɔ. Na yemɔ, ɔbava Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne nee ndɛnebualɛ senle ne a yeazɔne a. 12Ɔlɛ ye akegyebɛ ɔ sa nu; ɔbava yeahegye ma ne amuala; ɔbaboɔboa kpalɛ ne anloa yeahɔgua ye bonwolo ne azo na yeayela abonle ne wɔ senle mɔɔ ɛnnu ɛlɛ la anu.”
Gyisɛse ɛzɔnenlɛ ne
(Mak 1.9-11; Luk 3.21-22)
13Gyisɛse vi Galeli maanzinli nu rale Azule Dwɔdan ne anloa wɔ Dwɔn anwo ɛkɛ ne kɛ ɔzɔne ye. 14Na Dwɔn hanle kɛ, “Menfɛta kɛ menwɔzɔne wɔ. Wɔmɔ a ɔwɔ kɛ ɛsɔne me a, na duzu ati a wɔra kɛ menzɔne wɔ ɛ?”
15Gyisɛse buale kɛ, “Maa ɔyɛ zɔhane kɛkala. Ɔluakɛ ɔle kpalɛ kɛ yɛfa zɛhae adenle zo yɛyɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle kpondɛ kɛ yɛyɛ la.” Zɔhane ati Dwɔn kponlenle zolɛ na ɔzɔnenle ye.
16Mɔɔ bɛzɔnenle Gyisɛse bɛwiele la, ɔvi azule ne anu ɔvole file zo ndɛndɛ ne ala. Anwuma bukele na ɔnwunle kɛ Nyamenle Sunsum ne ɛlɛdwu kɛ abubule la na ɔrazinzele ɔ nwo zo. 17 Na ɛnelɛ bie vi anwuma zele kɛ, “Ɛhye a le me Ra mɔɔ mekulo ye la. Me nye die ɔ nwo kpole.”

Title: MAT 4
Content:
Gyisɛse sɔnea ne
(Mak 1.12-13; Luk 4.1-13)
1 Akee Sunsum ne vale Gyisɛse hɔle fienemgbole ne anu kɛ abɔnsam ɛzɔ ye ɛnlea. 2Gyisɛse hyele ɛhɔne alehyenlɛ nee aledwolɛ kenle abulanla na ɛhɔne hunle ye. 3Abɔnsam bikyele ye na ɔzele ye kɛ, “Saa wɔmɔ a ɛle Nyamenle Ara ne a, ɛnee maa awolɛ ɛhye mɔ ɛhakyi kpanwo.”
4 Gyisɛse buale kɛ, “Bɛhɛlɛ ye kɛ, ‘Tɛ aleɛ ngome a sonla di a ɔnyia ngoane a, na Nyamenle anloa edwɛkɛ biala maa ngoane.’ ”
5Abɔnsam vale Gyisɛse hɔle suakpole nwuanzanwuanza Gyɛlusalɛm azo, ɔvale ye ɔziele Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne ati zo twɔɔnwo ne azo anwuma, 6 na ɔzele ye kɛ, “Saa wɔmɔ a ɛle Nyamenle Ara ne a, ɛnee gyakyi ɛ nwo te aze, ɔluakɛ bɛhɛlɛ ye kɛ,
‘Nyamenle bamaa ye anwuma soanvolɛma arabɔ ayia wɔ,
bɛbazɔ wɔ bɛ sa nu gyɛlɛɛnye, amaa ɛ gyakɛ amkpula bolɛ.’ ”
7 Gyisɛse buale ye kɛ, “Eza bɛhɛlɛ kɛ, ‘Mmasɔ Awulae wɔ Nyamenle ne ɛnea.’ ”
8Eza abɔnsam vale Gyisɛse hɔle boka tendenle bie azo na ɔvale aleɛabo arelemgbunli maanle maanle ne mɔ amuala nee bɛ anyunlunyia ɔhilele ye, 9na ɔzele ye kɛ, “Saa ɛkoto me, ɛsonle me a, menwɔva ɛhye mɔ amuala menwɔmaa wɔ.”
10 Gyisɛse buale kɛ, “Seetan, dwazo ɛkɛ ne kɔ! Ɔluakɛ bɛhɛlɛ kɛ, ‘Yeyɛ Awulae wɔ Nyamenle ne na sonle ɔdaye ɔ ngome ala!’ ”
11Abɔnsam akee gyakyile Gyisɛse hɔle, na nea, Nyamenle soanvolɛma raboale ye.
Gyisɛse bɔ ye gyima bo wɔ Galeli
(Mak 1.14-15; Luk 4.14-15)
12 Mɔɔ Gyisɛse dele kɛ bɛhye Dwɔn la ɔhwenle ɔ nwo ɔhɔle Galeli. 13 Yeandɛnla Nazalɛte na ɔhɔdɛnlanle Kapɛnayɛm mɔɔ wɔ Galeli tandane ne anloa, mɔɔ bikye Zɛbulɛn nee Nafetalae afoa nu la. 14Ɛhye manle mɔɔ Nyamenle luale ye kpɔmanvolɛ Ayezaya anwo zo hanle la yɛle nɔhalɛ kɛ,
15 “Zɛbulɛn nee Nafetalae maanlema,
mɔɔ wɔ nyiakɛ, wɔ Azule Dwɔdan ne anzi,
Galelima mɔɔ ɛmboka Dwuuma awo a!
16Bɛmɛ mɔɔ bɛde awozinli nu la,
bɛbanwu wienyi kpole bie!
Bɛmɛ mɔɔ bɛde ewule alubo nu la,
wienyi bada bɛ nwo zo.”
17 Ɔvi mekɛ zɔhane Gyisɛse bɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɔbɔ nolo kɛ, “Bɛnlu bɛ nwo na Anwuma Belemgbunlililɛ ne ɛbikye!”
Gyisɛse fɛlɛ fɛlɛhyelɛma nna
(Mak 1.16-20; Luk 5.1-11)
18Gyisɛse lua Galeli Tandane ne anloa la, ɔnwunle mediema nwiɔ kɛ bɛlɛgua asawu wɔ tandane ne anu. Bɛmɛ a le Saemɔn mɔɔ eza bɛfɛlɛ ye Pita la nee ɔ diema Andelu. 19Gyisɛse zele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛrɛla bɛmaa yɛhɔ na mebahilehile bɛ meamaa bɛahye menli kɛ bɛkye fɛlɛ la.” 20Na ɛkɛ ne ala bɛgyakyile bɛ asawu ne mɔ na bɛdoale ye.
21Ɔhɔle ɔ nyunlu ekyii la ɔnwunle mediema nwiɔ bieko. Bɛmɛ a le Gyemise nee ɔ diema Dwɔn mɔɔ le Zɛbɛdi amra ne mɔ. Ɛnee bɛ nee bɛ ze Zɛbɛdi wɔ ɛlɛne nu bɛlɛsa bɛ avonle. Gyisɛse vɛlɛle bɛ, 22na ɛkɛ ne ala bɛgyakyile ɛlɛne ne nee bɛ ze na bɛdoale ye.
Gyisɛse kilehile, bɔ nolo, yɛ ayile
(Luk 6.17-19)
23 Gyisɛse hɔkpɔsale Galeli maanzinli ne anu amuala na ɔhilehilele wɔ bɛ nyianu azua ne mɔ anu, ɔhanle Anwuma Belemgbunlililɛ ne anwo Edwɛkpa ne, na ɔmanle menli mɔɔ ewule nee anwondolɛ ngakyile ɛha bɛ la anwo zale. 24Ye nganeɛ dendenle hɔle Selea maanle ne anu amuala, na bɛvale bɛdabɛ mɔɔ ewule ngakyile ɛha bɛ na bɛlɛnwu amaneɛ: mɔɔ ɛbubu, mɔɔ awozonle ɛva bɛ, yɛɛ mɔɔ tɔ mgbutike la amuala bɛrɛlɛle ye, na ɔyɛle bɛ muala ayile. 25Akee menli dɔɔnwo ne ala mɔɔ vi Galeli nee Azuamgbole Bulu ne azo, Gyɛlusalɛm nee Dwudiya maanzinli nu nee Azule Dwɔdan ne anzi lɔ la amuala doale ye.

Title: MAT 5
Content:
Boka ne azo Edwɛkpa ne nolobɔlɛ ne
1Mɔɔ Gyisɛse nwunle menli dɔɔnwo ne la ɔhɔle boka bie azo na ɔdɛnlanle aze. Ye ɛdoavolɛma ne rale ɔ nwo ɛkɛ ne, 2na ɔbɔle ɔ bo ɔhilehilele bɛ kɛ:
Nyilalɛ mɔɔ di munli
(Luk 6.20-23)
3“Nyilalɛ ɛha bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛze kɛ bɛdi Nyamenle
Sunsum ne anwo ehyia la,
Ɔluakɛ bɛbanwu Anwuma Belemgbunlililɛ ne!
4 “Nyilalɛ ɛha bɛdabɛ mɔɔ nyane ɛha bɛ la;
Nyamenle bakyekye bɛ rɛle!
5 “Nyilalɛ ɛha bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛle bɛlɛvo la;
Azɛlɛ ye bayɛ bɛ ɛdeɛ!
6 “Nyilalɛ ɛha bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ kunlu anu a anrɛɛ
bɛkola bɛyɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle kpondɛ la;
Nyamenle bamaa bɛ kunlu adwo bɛ nwo!
7“Nyilalɛ ɛha bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛse anwunvɔne la;
Nyamenle baze bɛdabɛ noko anwunvɔne!
8 “Nyilalɛ ɛha bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ ahonle nu te la;
Bɛbanwu Nyamenle!
9“Nyilalɛ ɛha bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛpele bɛkpondɛ
anzonudwolɛ la; Nyamenle bavɛlɛ bɛ ɔ mra!
10 “Nyilalɛ ɛha bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛyɛ bɛ kpɔdekpɔde kɛ
bɛbɔ mɔdenle bɛyɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle kpondɛ la;
Anwuma Belemgbunlililɛ ne le bɛ ɛdeɛ!
11 “Nyilalɛ ɛha bɛ kɛ bɛle me ɛdoavolɛma la ati bɛbɔ bɛ aholoba, bɛyɛ bɛ kpɔdekpɔde na bɛsoa ɛzonle ngakyile muala bɛgua bɛ nwo zo la. 12 Bɛmaa bɛ nye ɛlie na bɛli fɛlɛko, ɔluakɛ bɛlɛ nwolɛ ahatualɛ kpole wɔ anwuma. Zɔhane ala yɛɛ bɛyɛle Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma ne mɔ mɔɔ lumua la a.
Ngyenle nee kɛnlaneɛ
(Mak 9.50; Luk 14.34-35)
13“Bɛmɛ a bɛle azɛlɛ ye azo ngyenle a. Ngyenle mɔɔ kɛda la bɛyɛ ye menlemenle bieko a ɔnyɛ boɛ. Bɛfa bɛyɛ ɛhwee a ɔnyɛ boɛ. Bɛto bɛgua na menli tietia zolɛ.
14 “Bɛmɛ a bɛle ewiade ye kɛnlaneɛ a. Suakpole mɔɔ bɛhye ye boka zo la ɛnvea. 15 Awie ɛnzɔ kɛnlaneɛ na ɔnva bondo ɔmbutu zolɛ; ɔsɔ ɔsie ye debie zo anwuma, amaa yeada yeamaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ sua ne anu la amuala. 16 Zɔhane ala yɛɛ bɛmaa bɛ ɛbɛla kpalɛ ne ɛyɛ kɛ kɛnlaneɛ na ɔda wɔ menli nu a, amaa bɛanwu bɛ gyima kpalɛ ne mɔɔ bɛyɛ la na bɛaye bɛ Ze mɔɔ wɔ anwuma la ayɛlɛ.
Mosisi mɛla ne anwo ngilehilelɛ
17“Bɛmmadwenle kɛ mera kɛ mebazɛkye Mosisi mɛla ne nee Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma ngilehilelɛ ne mɔ. Meamba bɛ ɛzɛkyelɛ; mera kɛ meba meamaa bɛali munli. 18 Nɔhalɛ, meka meahile bɛ kɛ anwuma nee aze baze ahɔ na mɛla ne anu kpɔkɛ nretee ko bɔbɔ ɛnrɛkpɔkye ɛnrɛdɔ kyesɛ mɔɔ wɔ nu la amuala ɛli munli. 19Awie biala mɔɔ kɛbu ɔ nye kɛgua mɛla ɛhye mɔ biala anu nretee ko azo na ɔkɛhilehile awie mɔ zɔhane la kɛyɛ ekyi wɔ Anwuma Belemgbunlililɛ nu. 20Meka meahile bɛ, kyesɛ bɛ tenleneyɛlɛ tɛla mɛla kilehilevolɛma nee Falasiima ne mɔ, anrɛɛ bɛnrɛnwu Anwuma Belemgbunlililɛ ne ɛlɛ.
Ɛyavalɛ nwo ngilehilelɛ
21 “Bɛde kɛ bɛhanle bɛhilele mɔmoane amra kɛ, ‘Bɛmmayɛ kɔdiawu na awie biala mɔɔ kɛyɛ kɔdiawu la bɛkɛbua ye ewule fɔlɛ.’ 22Mame, mese: Awie biala mɔɔ kɛva ɔ diema anwo ɛya la bɛkɛbua ye ewule fɔlɛ. Mɔɔ kɛyɛ ɔ diema aholoba la bɛ nee ye kɛhɔ nyianu sua nu mgbanyima ayia ne anyunlu; na mɔɔ kɛze ɔ diema kɛ, ‘Ɛle koasea!’ la, ɛva ɔ nwo ɛdo ɛbolɔ senle nu. 23Zɔhane ati saa ɛkɔ kɛ ɛkabɔ azu na ɛkakye ye wɔ azu ɛkponle ne anyunlu ɛkɛ ne kɛ ɛ nee ɛ diema bie lɛ edwɛkɛ a, 24gyakyi wɔ azubɔdeɛ ne wɔ azukponle ne anyunlu ɛkɛ ne; dumua kɔ ɛ nee ɛ diema ne bɛbɔ bɛ avinli, na akee sia babɔ wɔ azu ne maa Nyamenle.
25“Saa awie sɛma wɔ a, ɛ nee ye bɛziezie edwɛkɛ ne ndɛndɛ kolaa na bɛadwu ndɛnebualɛ ɛleka ne, amaa yeanye wɔ yeammaa ndɛnebuavolɛ ne na ndɛnebuavolɛ ne ava wɔ amaa sinzavolɛma kɛ bɛdo wɔ efiade. 26Nɔhalɛ, meka meahile bɛ, bɛnrɛgyakyi wɔ ɛlɛ kyesɛ ɛtua kakɛ biala mɔɔ ɛha la.
Awuvolɛvalɛ nwo ngilehilelɛ
27 “Bɛde kɛ bɛha kɛ, ‘Mmafa awuvolɛ.’ 28Noko mame, mese: saa nrenya nea raalɛ maa ɔ nwo dɔ ye a ɛnee yeva ye wɔ ye ahonle nu. 29 Zɔhane ati saa ɛ nye fema ne yɛɛ twehwe wɔ ahɔ ɛtane nu a, tu ye to ye lɔ. Ɔle kpalɛ kɛ ɛ nye kɛyɛ ko, kɛdɛla kɛ bɛkɛva wɔ sonlabaka ne amuala bɛkɛhɔdo ɛbolɔ senle nu a. 30 Saa ɛ sa fema noko yɛɛ tenda ɛ gyakɛ anu ahwe wɔ ahɔ ɛtane nu a, pɛ ye to. Ɔle kpalɛ kɛ ɛ sa ko kɛminli tɛla kɛ bɛkɛva wɔ sonlabaka ne amuala bɛkɛdo ɛbolɔ senle nu a.
Ewolebɔlɛ nwo ngilehilelɛ
(Mat 19.9; Mak 10.11-12; Luk 16.18)
31 “Bɛha ye bieko kɛ, ‘Awie mɔɔ bɔ ɔ ye ewole la ɔhɛlɛ ewolebɔlɛ kɛlata ɔmaa ye.’ 32 Noko mame, mese: Ɔnle kɛ awie biala bɔ ɔ ye ewole kyesɛ raalɛ ne ɛva nrenya fofolɛ. Saa tɛ ye zɔhane a ɛnee nrenya ne bamaa raalɛ ne ado awuvolɛvalɛ mɛla ne, yɛɛ nrenya noko mɔɔ kɛgya raalɛ mɔɔ ɛbɔ ewole la to awuvolɛvalɛ mɛla ne.
Ndanehanlɛ nwo ngilehilelɛ
33 “Bɛde ye bieko kɛ bɛhanle bɛhilele mɔmoane amra kɛ, ‘Mmaka ndandɛla, na di ndane mɔɔ wɔha wɔ Awulae anyunlu la azo.’ 34 Noko mame, mese: Bɛmmaka ndane fee. Bɛmmaka anwuma, ɔluakɛ ɔle Nyamenle belemgbunli ebia; 35 bɛmmaka azɛlɛ ye noko, ɔluakɛ ɔle ɔ gyakɛ abo ebia; anzɛɛ Gyɛlusalɛm, ɔluakɛ ɔle Belemgbunli kpole ne suakpole. 36Mmaka ɛdawɔ mumua ne ɛ ti, ɔluakɛ ɛnrɛhola ɛnrɛhakyi enrinli ko fufule anzɛɛ bile. 37Bɛmaa bɛ edwɛkɛ ɛyɛ ko, ‘ɛhɛe’ a ‘ɛhɛe’; ‘kyɛkyɛ’ a ‘kyɛkyɛ’. Edwɛkɛ ngakyile biala vi abɔnsam ɛkɛ ne a ba a.
Nzenralɛ nwo ngilehilelɛ
(Luk 6.29-30)
38 “Bɛde kɛ bɛha kɛ, ‘Bɛva ɛnyelɛ bɛzie ɛnyelɛ bo zo’, yɛɛ ‘bɛva egyele bɛzie egyele bo zo’. 39Noko mame, mese: Saa awie yɛ wɔ ɛtane a, mmasenra ye. Saa awie bɔ ɛ nzo fema ne anu a, kakyi bɛne ne ɔdaye maa ye. 40Saa awie nee wɔ twe manzonle alie wɔ anwuma tɛladeɛ ne a, maa ɔva wɔ bubu ne ɔdaye, 41yɛɛ saa awie dua ye tumi zo ahye wɔ mialera nu kɛ ɛ nee ye ɛhɔ adenle kilomita ko a, ɛ nee ye ɛhɔ nwiɔ. 42Awie sɛlɛ wɔ debie a, maa ye bie, yɛɛ mmakakyi ɛ nzi ɛsi mɔɔ kpondɛ kɛ ɔfɛne debie wɔ wɔ ɛkɛ ne la.
Kpɔvolɛma ɛhulolɛ
(Luk 6.27-28,32-36)
43 “Bɛde kɛ bɛhanle kɛ, ‘Kulo ɛ gɔnwo mɔ na kpɔ wɔ kpɔvolɛma.’ 44Noko mame, mese: Bɛhulo bɛ kpɔvolɛma na bɛzɛlɛ bɛmaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛyɛ bɛ kpɔdekpɔde la, 45amaa bɛayɛ bɛ Ze mɔɔ wɔ anwuma la amra. Ɔluakɛ yemɔ, ɔmaa ye ezule tɔ na ye ewia fi maa ɛtanevolɛma nee kpalɛyɛlɛma amuala. 46Saa bɛkulo menli mɔɔ kulo bɛ la angome a, ɛnee duzu ahatualɛ a bɛnyia ye wɔ Nyamenle ɛkɛ a? Anzɛɛ tɛ mɔɔ adwuledievolɛma yɛ la ala ɛne? 47Na saa bɛbiza bɛ gɔnwo mɔ angome ahye a, ɛnee duzu debie ngakyile a bɛyɛ bɛmaa yebo zo a? Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnze Nyamenle bɔbɔ la noko yɛ ye zɔhane ala. 48 Zɔhane ati, kɛmɔ bɛ Ze mɔɔ wɔ anwuma la anwo te la, bɛmaa bɛdabɛ noko bɛ nwo ɛde bɔkɔɔ.

Title: MAT 6
Content:
Ahunlunyele nwo ngilehilelɛ
1 “Bɛnlea boɛ na bɛanyɛ bɛ Nyamenle ɛzonlenlɛ gyima ne ɛnyelɛ zo. Saa bɛyɛ ye zɔ a bɛnrɛnyia ahatualɛ wɔ bɛ anwuma Selɛ ne ɛkɛ.
2“Zɔhane ati saa bɛfa debie bɛahyɛ a bɛmmabɔ nwolɛ awuye, kɛmɔ nabalabama ne mɔ yɛ ye wɔ nyianu azua ne mɔ anu nee awɔdenle ne mɔ azo la. Bɛyɛ ye zɔhane amaa bɛanyia bɛ nyunlu wɔ menli nyunlu. Nɔhalɛ, meka meahile bɛ kɛ bɛnyia bɛ ahatualɛ bɛwie. 3Na bɛmɛ, saa bɛfa debie bɛahyɛ a, bɛmmamaa bɛ sa bɛne ne nwu mɔɔ fema ne ɛlɛyɛ la, 4amaa bɛ nyɛleɛ kpalɛ ne ayɛ fealera nu debie na bɛ Ze mɔɔ wɔ anwuma mɔɔ nwu fealera nu debie biala la ayila bɛ.
Nzɛlɛlɛ nwo ngilehilelɛ
(Luk 11.2-4)
5 “Saa bɛyɛ nzɛlɛlɛ a, bɛmmayɛ ye kɛ nabalabama ne mɔ yɛ ye la. Menli zɔhane mɔ kulo kɛ bɛgyinla nyianu azua ne mɔ anu nee mgbata ne mɔ azo bɛyɛ bɛmaa menli kɔsɔɔti nwu bɛ kɛ bɛlɛyɛ nzɛlɛlɛ. Nɔhalɛ, meka meahile bɛ kɛ bɛnyia bɛ ahatualɛ bɛwie. 6Na bɛmɛ, saa bɛyɛ nzɛlɛlɛ a, bɛhɔvea bɛ sua kunlu ɛkɛ ne, bɛdo anlenkɛ ne anu na bɛyɛ nzɛlɛlɛ bɛvɛlɛ bɛ Ze mɔɔ wɔ anwuma mɔɔ bɛnnwu ye la, na bɛ Ze mɔɔ wɔ anwuma na ɔnwu fealera nu edwɛkɛ la bayila bɛ.
7“Wɔ bɛ nzɛlɛlɛ nu, bɛmmaka edwɛkɛ dɔɔnwo kɛmɔ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnze Nyamenle la yɛ ye la. Ɔluakɛ bɛmɛ, bɛdwenle kɛ saa bɛka edwɛkɛ dɔɔnwo a yɛɛ Nyamenle kɛdie bɛ a. 8Bɛmmayɛ ye kɛ menli zɔhane mɔ yɛ ye la, ɔluakɛ bɛ Ze mɔɔ wɔ anwuma la ze mɔɔ bɛhyia nwolɛ la amuala kolaa na bɛabiza ye. 9Zɔhane ati, bɛmɛ, bɛyɛ nzɛlɛlɛ a bɛyɛ ye zɛhae:
‘Yɛ Ze mɔɔ wɔ anwuma:
Wɔ duma nwo ɛde;
10Wɔ belemgbunlililɛ ɛrɛla;
Bɛyɛ Wɔ ɛhulolɛdeɛ wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo,
Kɛmɔ bɛyɛ ye wɔ anwuma lɔ la.
11Maa yɛ ɛnɛ yɛ dahuu aleɛ,
12Na fa yɛ ɛtane kyɛ yɛ,
Kɛmɔ yɛfa yɛkyɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛfo yɛ la;
13Mmamaa yɛkɔ ngyegyelɛ nu,
Ye yɛ fi munzule nu.’
14 “Ɔluakɛ saa bɛfa menli mɔɔ ɛvo bɛ la ɛtane bɛkyɛ bɛ a, yɛɛ bɛ anwuma Selɛ ne ɔdaye ɔkɛva bɛ ɛtane ɛdeɛ ne mɔ ɔkɛhyɛ bɛ a. 15Na saa bɛanva menli mɔɔ ɛvo bɛ la ɛtane ne mɔ bɛangyɛ bɛ a, bɛ Ze mɔɔ wɔ anwuma la ɔdaye ɔnrɛva bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ ɔnrɛhyɛ bɛ.
Ɛhɔnehyelɛ nwo ngilehilelɛ
16“Saa bɛkye ɛhɔne a, bɛmmayɛ bɛ nyunlu alɔbɔlɛ alɔbɔlɛ, kɛmɔ nabalabama ne mɔ yɛ la. Bɛsie bɛ nwo evinli bɛfa bɛkile bɛmaa awie biala nwu kɛ bɛlɛkye ɛhɔne. Bɛnwu ye kɛ bɛdua bɛ nwolɛ kakɛ bɛwie. 17Na bɛmɛ, saa bɛkye ɛhɔne a anrɛɛ bɛnrinzi bɛ nwo, na bɛziezie bɛ nwo, 18amaa awie mɔ annwu kɛ bɛlɛkye ɛhɔne. Na bɛ Ze mɔɔ wɔ anwuma na ɔze fealera nu debie biala la bayila bɛ.
Anwonyia wɔ anwuma
(Luk 12.33-34)
19 “Bɛmmakpondɛ bɛ anwonyia bɛsie azɛlɛ ye azo, anrɛɛ ɛlɛtɛba nee nrɛnlana kɛzɛkye ye, na nwule noko kola wua. 20Bɛkpondɛ bɛ anwonyia bɛzie anwuma maanle ne anu na ɛlɛtɛba nee nrɛnlana anzɛkye ye, na nwule noko angɔnwua. 21Bɛnwu ye kɛ ɛleka mɔɔ bɛ anwonyia wɔ la, ɛkɛ ne yɛɛ bɛ ahonle noko wɔ a.
Sonlabaka ne kɛnlaneɛ
(Luk 11.34-36)
22“Ɛnyelɛ a le sonlabaka ne kɛnlaneɛ a. Saa ɛ nye le kpalɛ a, wɔ sonlabaka ne anu le wienyi. 23Na saa ɛ nye ɛnle kpalɛ a, wɔ sonlabaka ne anu le awozinli. Na saa wienyi ne mɔɔ wɔ wɔ nu la le awozinli a, ɛnee noko ye awozinli ne kɛyɛ kabii kpalɛ.
Nyamenle nee anwonyia
(Luk 16.13; 12.22-31)
24“Awie biala ɛnrɛhola ɛnrɛzonle menlenlɛ nwiɔ, ɔluakɛ saa ɔyɛ ye zɔhane a ɔbahulo ko na yeakpɔ ko, anzɛɛ ɔbali ko eni na yeakpo ko. Zɔhane ala yɛɛ bɛnrɛhola Nyamenle nee ezukoa sonle a.
25“Ɛhye ati meka meahile bɛ, bɛmmadwenle mɔɔ bɛbali anzɛɛ mɔɔ bɛbanlo bɛanyia ngoane, anzɛɛ ɛdanlɛ mɔɔ bɛbaheda la anwo. Asoo ngoane ɛngyia ɛndɛla aleɛ, anzɛɛ nwonane ye ɛngyia ɛndɛla ɛdanlɛ? 26Bɛnlea nloma mɔɔ luolua anwomanyunlu la. Bɛnlua, bɛmbu, yɛɛ bɛnlɛ bonwolo; Selɛ ne mɔɔ wɔ anwuma la a yɛne bɛ a. Na asoo bɛ nwo ɛngyia ɛndɛla nloma? 27Bɛ nuhua boni yɛɛ kɛhola kɛlua ye adwenleadwenle zo kɛva mekɛ ekyi kɛboka ye mekɛ nwo a, anzɛɛ kɛva waa ko kɛdo ye tendenle zo a?
28“Duzu ati bɔbɔ yɛɛ bɛdwenle ndanlɛ nwo ɛ? Bɛnlea ɛhoayelɛ nu aloa, bɛnyɛ gyima yɛɛ bɛnwo ndanlɛ. 29 Noko meka meahile bɛ, Belemgbunli Sɔlɔmɔn bɔbɔ, wɔ ye anwonyia mekɛ ne anu, yeangeda ɛdanlɛ anzɛɛ bɛanziezie ye bɛandɛla aloa ɛhye mɔ anu ko. 30Na saa Nyamenle siezie ndile, mɔɔ nyi ɛnɛ na ɛhyema bɛpɛ bɛwuda la zɛhae a, ɛnee fane nyɛ yɛɛ akee bɛmɛ, Nyamenle ɛnrɛhola bɛ ɛdanlɛ keda ɛ? Bɛ diedi le ekyi somaa!
31“Yemɔti bɛmmadwenle kɛ, ‘Duzu yɛɛ yɛbali a’, anzɛɛ ‘Duzu a yɛbanlo a’, anzɛɛ ‘Duzu a yɛbaheda a’, 32(Ɛhye mɔ le ninyɛne mɔɔ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnze Nyamenle la a dwenle nwolɛ a.) Bɛ Ze mɔɔ wɔ anwuma la ze kɛ bɛhyia ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ amuala anwo. 33Bɛbɔ mɔdenle bɛdwenle Nyamenle belemgbunlililɛ ne nee mɔɔ Nyamenle kpondɛ kɛ bɛyɛ la anwo kpalɛ, na ɔkɛva mɔɔ bɛhyia nwolɛ la ɔkɛmaa bɛ. 34Ɛhye ati bɛmmadwenle ɛhyema anwo; ɛhyema ɔdaye ɔ nee ɔ ti anwo adwenleadwenle ɛdeɛ lua. Ɔngyia kɛ bɛkɛva kenle ko anwo adwenleadwenle ɛdeɛ bɛkɛboka ko ɛdeɛ nwo.

Title: MAT 7
Content:
Awie mɔ ndɛne ɛbualɛ
(Luk 6.37-38,41-42)
1“Bɛmmabua awie mɔ ndɛne na Nyamenle ambua bɛ ndɛne, 2 ɔboalekɛ ndɛne mɔɔ bɛkɛva bɛkɛbua awie mɔ la yɛɛ Nyamenle bava abua bɛdabɛ noko a, yɛɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛzuzu bɛkɛmaa awie la yɛɛ bɛbanyia ye a. 3Duzu ati a ɛnwu mumunli mɔɔ la ɛ diema anye zo, na ɛndwenle dubinli ne mɔɔ la ɛ nye zo la anwo ɛ? 4Anzɛɛ duzu ati yɛɛ ɛse ɛ diema kɛ, ‘Mebodo wɔ, maa menye ɛ nye zo mumunli ne’, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ dubinli la ɛdawɔ mumua ne ɛ nye zo la ɛ? 5Wɔmɔ nabalabanli! Dumua ye dubinli ne mɔɔ la ɛ nye zo la na wɔanwu debie kpalɛ, na wɔahola wɔaye mumunli ne mɔɔ la ɛ diema ne anye zo la.
6“Bɛmmafa debie mɔɔ anwo te la bɛmaa ahwea, na bɛkɛpɛ bɛ nwo bɛkɛkeka bɛ; bɛmmafa bɛ anwoneɛ bɛgua agbolike nyunlu, na bɛkɛtietia zolɛ bɛkɛzɛkye bɛ mgbane.
Biza, kpondɛ, bɔ nu
(Luk 11.9-13)
7“Bɛbiza na bɛ sa kɛha ye; bɛkpondɛ na bɛkɛnwu ye; bɛbɔ nu na bɛkɛbuke bɛ. 8Ɔluakɛ awie biala mɔɔ biza la asa ka ye; mɔɔ kpondɛ la nwu ye, yɛɛ mɔɔ bɔ nu la, bɛbuke ye. 9Bɛ nuhua boni yɛɛ saa ɔ ra biza ye kpanwo a ɔkɛva bolɛ ɔkɛmaa ye a? 10Anzɛɛ saa ɔbiza ye fɛlɛ a ɔkɛmaa ye ɛwɔlɛ a? 11Na saa bɛmɛ mɔɔ bɛle ɛtanevolɛma la bɛze kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛfa ninyɛne kpalɛ bɛmaa bɛ mra a, ɛnee fane nyɛ yɛɛ bɛ Ze mɔɔ wɔ anwuma la ɛnrɛva ninyɛne kpalɛ ɛnrɛmaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛbiza ye la ɛ?
12 “Zɔhane ati mɔɔ bɛkpondɛ kɛ menli yɛ maa bɛ la, bɛdabɛ noko bɛyɛ zɔhane ala bɛmaa bɛ. Mosisi mɛla ne nee Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma ngilehilelɛ ne kɛ kɔ ye la ɛne.
Anuhɔlɛ ɛdenraa ne
(Luk 13.24)
13“Bɛva anuhɔlɛ ɛdenraa ne anu bɛwolo, ɔluakɛ anuhɔlɛ kpolomgbolo ne kɔ abɔnsam sua zo yɛɛ ye adenle ne anu ɛvalɛ ɛnyɛ se, yemɔti menli dɔɔnwo kpalɛ a fa zɔhane anuhɔlɛ ne anu a. 14Na anuhɔlɛ ne mɔɔ kɔ ngoane mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ la anu la le ɛdenraa, ye adenle ne anu ɛvalɛ ɛnla aze, yɛɛ menli ekyi bie a nwu ye a.
Baka nee ye ma
(Luk 6.43-44)
15“Bɛnlea bɛ nwo boɛ wɔ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma alanema anwo; bɛle menli bie mɔɔ bɛyɛ bɛ nwo kɛ asɛɛ bɛnze nwolɛ bie, noko bɛ kunlu le bile. 16Menli zɔhane mɔ nyɛleɛ yɛɛ bɛbava bɛanwu bɛ a. Kolokolonyɛma ɛnzo ‘vanye’ ma, yɛɛ evileni ɛnzo ‘feege’ ma. 17Baka kpalɛ biala so ma kpalɛ, yɛɛ baka ɛtane so ma ɛtane. 18Baka kpalɛ ɛnzo ma ɛtane, yɛɛ baka ɛtane ɛnzo ma kpalɛ. 19 Baka biala mɔɔ ɛnzo ma kpalɛ la bɛpɛ ye bɛto na bɛfa bɛwuda senle. 20 Zɔhane ala yɛɛ bɛbalua Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma alanema nyɛleɛ zo bɛanwu bɛ a.
Menze bɛ
(Luk 13.25-27)
21“Tɛ awie biala mɔɔ kɛvɛlɛ me kɛ, ‘Awulae, Awulae’ la a banyia Anwuma Belemgbunlililɛ ne a, na bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛyɛ mɔɔ Egya mɔɔ wɔ anwuma la kpondɛ kɛ bɛyɛ la a banyia ye a. 22Saa Ndɛnebualɛ Kenle ne dwu a, dɔɔnwo ne ala baha ahile me kɛ, ‘Awulae, Awulae! Yɛluale wɔ duma nu yɛbɔle Edwɛkpa ne nolo, yɛluale wɔ duma nu yɛdudule mbɔnsam dɔɔnwo na yɛyɛle nwanwane ninyɛne!’ 23 Na mebaze bɛ kɛ, ‘Menze bɛ. Bɛvi ɛkɛ ne bɛhɔ. Nindavoma!’
Suazilɛma nwiɔ ne
(Luk 6.47-49)
24“Zɔhane ati awie biala mɔɔ tie me edwɛkɛ ne na ɔdi zolɛ la le kɛ nrɛlɛbɛvolɛ bie mɔɔ zile ye sua wɔ bodane zo la. 25Ezule kpole dɔle na azule yile bule aze, na ahumu kpole dule bɔle sua ne, noko yeambu, ɔboalekɛ ɔgyi bodane zo.
26“Awie noko mɔɔ tie me edwɛkɛ ne na ɔnli zolɛ la le kɛ kɔnwɔne bie mɔɔ zile ye sua wɔ ɛnwea nu la. 27Ezule dɔle, azule yile bule aze, ahumu dule kpole bɔle sua ne, na ɔbule ɔguale aze. Na ye azedɔlɛ ne yɛle ɛzulolɛ!”
Gyisɛse tumi ne
28 Mɔɔ Gyisɛse wiele ɛhye mɔ ka la, ye ngilehilelɛ ne zinle menli dɔɔnwo ne anwo, 29ɔluakɛ ɔngilehile kɛ bɛ mɛla kilehilevolɛma ne mɔ la; ɔkilehile kɛ sonla mɔɔ lɛ tumi la.

Title: MAT 8
Content:
Gyisɛse yɛ nrenya bie ayile
(Mak 1.40-45; Luk 5.12-16)
1Gyisɛse vi boka ne azo dwule la, menli dɔɔnwo doale ye. 2Na nea, kokobɛvolɛ bie rahotole ɔ nyunlu ɛkɛ ne na ɔzele ye kɛ, “Yɛmenle, saa ɔyɛ wɔ ɛhulolɛ a, ɛkola ɛmaa me nwo sa.”
3Gyisɛse denrɛle ɔ sa zɔle ye na ɔbuale ye kɛ, “Mekulo! Ɛ nwo ɛza!” Na ɛkɛ ne ala ye kokobɛ ne hɔle bɔkɔɔ. 4 Na Gyisɛse bɔle ɔ nloa kɛ, “Nea, mmabɔ zo ɛkile awie biala. Kɔ na kɔva ɛ nwo kile sɛlɛvolɛ ne maa ɔnleɛnlea ɛ nwo, na bɔ azu ne mɔɔ Mosisi hyehyɛle dole ɛkɛ ne la maa awie biala ɛnwu kɛ ɛ nwo ɛza.”
Gyisɛse yɛ Wulomu sogya kpanyinli bie sonvolɛ ayile
(Luk 7.1-10)
5Mɔɔ Gyisɛse dwule Kapɛnayɛm la, Wulomu sogya kpanyinli bie rayiale ye na ɔbodole ye kɛ ɔboa ye. Ɔse, 6“Yɛmenle, me sonvolɛ ko la ɛkpa zo mɔɔ ye ewule ne yɛ se kpalɛ a. Yedwidwe na ɔlɛnwu amaneɛ somaa.”
7Gyisɛse zele ye kɛ, “Mebara mearayɛ ye ayile.”
8Sogya kpanyinli ne buale ye kɛ, “Yɛmenle, kyɛkyɛ! Menfɛta kɛ ɛkɛra me sua nu. Wɔmɔ ka ɛ nloa edwɛkɛ ne ala na me sonvolɛ ne kɛde kpɔkɛ. 9Melɛ ɛlɔnema wɔ me bo suzuamgba, meka mekile bie kɛ, ‘kɔ’ a, ɔkɔ; meka mekile bie noko kɛ, ‘bɛla’ a, ɔba; yɛɛ meka mekile me akɛlɛ kɛ, ‘yɛ ɛhye’ a, ɔyɛ. Noko medame mele sonla mɔɔ mewɔ menlenlɛ bo a.”
10Gyisɛse dele ɛhye la ɔzinle ɔ nwo, na ɔzele bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdoa ye la kɛ, “Nɔhalɛ, metɛnwunle awie mɔɔ lɛ diedi zɛhae bie la ɛlɛ, bɔbɔ wɔ Yizilayɛma avinli. 11 Bɛhakye ɛhye: Menli dɔɔnwo vi aduduleɛ nee adɔleɛ bara bɛ nee bɛ nlenya mɔ Ebileham nee Ayezeke nee Gyekɔbo aradɛnla ɛkponle nwo wɔ Anwuma Belemgbunlililɛ nu. 12 Na bɛbavuandi bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ bɛ nwo kɛ bɛle Anwuma Belemgbunlililɛ ne anwo nlɔnra la bɛagua awozinli ne anu; na ɛkɛ ne, bɛbazu bɛadedɛ bɛ nwo bonrane nu.” 13Akee Gyisɛse zele sogya kpanyinli ne kɛ, “Kɔ sua nu na wɔ diedi ne mɔɔ ɛlɛ la ɛyɛ zɔhane ɛmaa wɔ.”
Na sogya kpanyinli ne sonvolɛ ne dele kpɔkɛ wɔ mekɛ ne anu ala.
Gyisɛse yɛ menli dɔɔnwo ayile
(Mak 1.29-34; Luk 4.38-41)
14Gyisɛse hɔle Pita sua nu, na ɔhɔdole kɛ Pita aye ne ɔ nli ne anwo ɛdo ye na ɛyɛlɛyɛlɛ gyi ɔ nwo. 15Ɔzɔle ɔ sa, na ɛkɛ ne ala ɔdele kpɔkɛ, na ɔdwazole ɔkpondɛle debie ɔmanle bɛ.
16Ye nɔsolɛ nu, bɛvale menli dɔɔnwo mɔɔ sunsum ɛtane ɛva bɛ la bɛrɛlɛle ye na ɔvale ɔ nloa edwɛkɛ ɔdudule bɛ, na ɔyɛle wuleravolɛma dɔɔnwo noko ayile. 17 Ɔyɛle ɛhye amaa mɔɔ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ Ayezaya hanle la ayɛ nɔhalɛ kɛ, “Ɔdaye mumua ne ɔzoale yɛ anwondolɛ nee yɛ nwo ewule ɔhɔle.”
Menli mɔɔ bayɛ Gyisɛse ɛdoavolɛma la
(Luk 9.57-62)
18Gyisɛse nwunle kɛ menli dɔɔnwo ɛbɔ ɛyia ye, na ɔzele ye ɛdoavolɛma ne kɛ bɛmaa bɛpɛ bɛhɔ tandane ne anzi lɔ. 19Mɛla kilehilevolɛ bie rale ɔ nwo ɛkɛ ne razele ye kɛ, “Kilehilevolɛ, ɛleka biala mɔɔ ɛkɔ la me nee wɔ kɛhɔ.”
20Gyisɛse zele ye kɛ, “Ɛzonlɛ lɛ bɛ mbɔne, yɛɛ nloma lɛ bɛ sane, na mame, Sonla Ra, menlɛ ɛleka mɔɔ meto me ti a.”
21Ɛdoavolɛma ne mɔ ko zele Gyisɛse kɛ, “Awulae, maa menlumua mengɔnzie egya kolaa na meara.”
22Gyisɛse zele ye kɛ, “Wɔmɔ maa yɛhɔ, na gyakyi bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwu la maa bɛzie bɛ avunli.”
Gyisɛse maa ahumu agua
(Mak 4.35-41; Luk 8.22-25)
23Gyisɛse vole ɛlɛne nu, na ye ɛdoavolɛma ne mɔ vole bie na bɛzile nu kɛ bɛkɔ. 24Ahumu kpole bie dule tandane ne anye manle azɛlɛkye ne hedale ɛlɛne ne azo; na ɛnee Gyisɛse ɛlafe. 25Ɛdoavolɛma ne hɔdunwuele ye na bɛzele kɛ, “Awulae, die yɛ na yɛwie wu!”
26Gyisɛse zele bɛ kɛ, “Duzu ati a bɛle avoanvoanle zɛhae ɛ? Bɛ diedi le ekyi somaa!” Akee ɔdwazole na ɔdeanle anwoma ne nee azɛlɛkye ne mɔ nu na bɛguale diinyi.
27Ɛhye zinle menli ne mɔ anwo na bɛzele kɛ, “Duzu sonla a le ɛhye, mɔɔ anwoma nee nyevile bɔbɔ tie ye a?”
Gyisɛse tu menli nwiɔ anwo sunsum ɛtane
(Mak 5.1-20; Luk 8.26-39)
28Mɔɔ Gyisɛse dwule tandane ne anzi lɔ wɔ Gadala maanzinli nu la, menli nwiɔ mɔɔ sunsum ɛtane ɛva bɛ la vi azie ne azo rayiale ye. Sunsum ɛtane ne mɔ ɛmaa menli ɛhye mɔ ɛbɔ ɛlane, na awie biala ɛngola ɛmpɛ nu adenle ne anu. 29Na bɛdeanle nu kɛ, “Wɔmɔ Nyamenle Ara, duzu yɛɛ ɛkpondɛ wɔ yɛ ɛkɛ ne a? Wɔra kɛ ɛbadea yɛ kolaa na kenle ne adwu ɔ?”
30Ɛnee agbolike kpolane bie bikye ɛkɛ ne na bɛlɛdidi, 31yemɔti sunsum ɛtane ne mɔ bodole Gyisɛse kɛ, “Saa ɛtu yɛ a, ɛnee maa yɛhɔwolo agbolike ne mɔ.”
32Gyisɛse zele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛhɔ ɛ!” Na sunsum ɛtane ne mɔ vile menli ne mɔ anwo dule na bɛhɔwolole agbolike ne mɔ. Na agbolike kpolane ne amuala dule twi hɔguale tandane ne anu na bɛwule.
33Menli mɔɔ ɛlɛnea agbolike ne mɔ la nriandile hɔle suakpole ne azo hɔhanle mɔɔ ɛzi la amuala, nee mɔɔ ɛzi menli ne mɔɔ sunsum ɛtane ne mɔ vale bɛ la anwo zo la noko. 34Yemɔti suakpole ne azo amra amuala rayiale Gyisɛse; na mɔɔ bɛnwunle ye la bɛzɛlɛle ye kɛ ɔvi bɛ maanle ne anu ɔhɔ.

Title: MAT 9
Content:
Gyisɛse yɛ nrenya bie mɔɔ ɛdwidwe la ayile
(Mak 2.1-12; Luk 5.17-26)
1Gyisɛse ziale hɔdɛnlanle ɛlɛne ne anu na ɔpɛle tandane ne ɔrale ɔdaye ye sua zo. 2Menli bie vale awie mɔɔ ɛdwidwe na ɔla ɛkpa zo la rɛlɛle ye kɛ ɔyɛ ye ayile. Mɔɔ Gyisɛse nwunle bɛ diedi ne la, ɔzele nrenya ne kɛ, “Me ra nrenya, to ɛ rɛle azule nu! Bɛva wɔ ɛtane ne mɔ bɛhyɛ wɔ.”
3Mɛla kilehilevolɛma bie mɔɔ wɔ ɛkɛ ne la hanle ye bɛ ti anu kɛ, “Nrenya ye ɛdindi Nyamenle anyunlu!”
4Gyisɛse nwunle bɛ adwenle, yemɔti ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Duzu ati a bɛ adwenle le ɛtane zɛhae a? 5Boni a ye ɛhanlɛ ɛnyɛ se a, kɛ ɛse awie kɛ, ‘Bɛva wɔ ɛtane ne mɔ bɛhyɛ wɔ’, anzɛɛ ‘Dwazo na tia?’ 6Akee memaa bɛanwu kɛ medame, Sonla Ra, melɛ tumi wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo kɛ mefa ɛtane mekyɛ.” Yemɔti ɔzele nrenya ne mɔɔ ɛdwidwe la kɛ, “Dwazo, nyenya wɔ ɛkpa ne, na kɔ sua nu!”
7Nrenya ne dwazole na ɔhɔle sua nu. 8Menli ne mɔ nwunle ye zɛhae la, ɛzulolɛ hanle bɛ, na bɛyele Nyamenle ayɛlɛ kɛ yeva tumi mɔɔ le zɛhae la yemaa sonla a.
Gyisɛse fɛlɛ Mateyu
(Mak 2.13-17; Luk 5.27-32)
9Gyisɛse vi ɛkɛ ne na ɔkɔ la, ɔnwunle adwuledievolɛ bie mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Mateyu la kɛ ɔde adwulelielɛ sua ne anu. Gyisɛse zele ye kɛ, “Bɛla maa yɛhɔ.”
Mateyu dwazole na ɔdoale ye.
10 Mɔɔ Gyisɛse kpula ɔ sa wɔ Mateyu sua nu ɛkɛ ne la, adwuledievolɛma dɔɔnwo nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ awie ɛmbu bɛ la rabokale Gyisɛse nee ye ɛdoavolɛma ne mɔ na bɛ muala bɛkpulale bɛ sa. 11Falasiima bie mɔ nwunle ye na bɛzele Gyisɛse ɛdoavolɛma ne kɛ, “Duzu ati a bɛ menle nee adwuledievolɛma nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ awie ɛmbu bɛ la to bɛ sa ɛyɛba ko anu ɛ?”
12Gyisɛse dele na ɔbuale bɛ kɛ, “Menli mɔɔ te kpɔkɛ la ɛngyia ninsinli nwo kɛ wuleravolɛma. 13 Bɛhɔ bɛhɔkpondɛ Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ɛhye abo: ‘Mekulo anwunvɔnezelɛ, na tɛ nane azubɔlɛ ɔ.’ Meamba menli mɔɔ ɛkpazi la ɛvɛlɛlɛ; membale bɛdabɛ mɔɔ awie ɛmbu bɛ bie la ɛvɛlɛlɛ!”
Ɛhɔnehyelɛ nwo kpuyia
(Mak 2.18-22; Luk 5.33-39)
14Dwɔn Sɔnevolɛ ne ɛdoavolɛma ne rale Gyisɛse ɛkɛ ne rabizale ye kɛ, “Duzu ati a yɛmɛ yɛɛ Falasiima yɛkye ɛhɔne dahudahu na wɔ ɛdoavolɛma ne ɛngye bie fee ɛ?”
15Gyisɛse buale bɛ kɛ, “Bɛdwenle kɛ saa atɔfolɛ nrenya ne wɔ ɛkɛ a, ɔ gɔnwo mɔ mɔɔ ɛra atɔfolɛlielɛ ne abo la kɛli nyane ɔ? Kyɛkyɛ! Noko saa mekɛ dwu na bɛbaye atɔfolɛ nrenya ne wɔ bɛ avinli bɛkɔ a, ɛnee bɔ zo mɔɔ yedwu mɔɔ bɛkye ɛhɔne a.
16“Awie ɛnva ɛdanlɛ fofolɛ mɔɔ bɛtɛwulale ye nzule nu ɛlɛ la ɛnda ɛdanlɛ dɛba nu; saa ɔyɛ ye zɔhane a, ɛdanlɛ fofolɛ ne kɛde dɛba ne na ɔkɛmaa tokule ne akee kɛyɛ kpole.” 17Ɔvale ɔzɔle zo kɛ, “Awie ɛnva nwanye ndokuma ɛngua nwanye nwoma kodoku dɛba nu. Saa ɔyɛ ye zɔhane na nwanye ne anu yɛ ɛsesebɛ a, nwoma kodoku dɛba ne bakpuke yeamaa nwanye ne agua aze, na nwoma ne noko azɛkye. Mɔɔ bɛyɛ la a le kɛ bɛfa nwanye ndokuma bɛgua nwoma kodoku fofolɛ nu, ɛnee bɛ mu nwiɔ bɛgyinla boɛ.”
Nyianu sua ne neavolɛ kpanyinli ne ara raalɛ ne nee raalɛ ne mɔɔ vale ɔ sa hanle Gyisɛse tɛladeɛ ne la
(Mak 5.21-43; Luk 8.40-56)
18Mɔɔ Gyisɛse anloa wɔ zo ɔlɛtendɛ yeahile bɛ la, nyianu sua ne neavolɛ kpanyinli ne rale na ɔrahotole Gyisɛse anyunlu ɛkɛ na ɔzɛlɛle ye kɛ, “Me ra raalɛ ɛwu kɛkala; noko bɛla bava ɛ sa to ɔ nwo zo maa ɔnyia ngoane.”
19Yemɔti Gyisɛse dwazole na ɔ nee ye ɛdoavolɛma ne nee nrenya ne hɔle.
20Raalɛ bie mɔɔ mogya ɛdudu ye toonwo ɛvolɛ bulu nee nwiɔ la ralile Gyisɛse anzi na ɔvale ɔ sa ɔhanle ye tɛladeɛ ne anloa. 21Ɔhanle ye ɔ ti anu kɛ, “Saa mefa me sa meka ye tɛladeɛ ne bɔbɔ a, me nwo kɛza.”
22Gyisɛse hakyile ɔ nye na ɔnwunle ye la, ɔzele raalɛ ne kɛ, “Ralɛ raalɛ, maa ɛ rɛle ɛdɔ wɔ azule nu. Wɔ diedi ɛmaa ɛ nwo ɛza.” Na ɛkɛ ne ala raalɛ ne anwo zale.
23Gyisɛse dwule nyianu sua ne kpanyinli ne sua nu la, ɔnwunle agolehanlɛma, nee menli dɔɔnwo mɔɔ ɛra bayɛ ɛzɛne ne la. 24Ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛhwe bɛ nwo! Bɛlɛra ne ɛtɛwule; ɔlɛdafe ala!” Na bɛzelele ye bɛzile ye amgbu. 25Mɔɔ bɛyele menli ne mɔ bɛvindele la, Gyisɛse wolole sua ne anu na ɔzɔle bɛlɛra ne asa, na bɛlɛra ne dwazole. 26Gyima ɛhye mɔɔ ɔlile la nganeɛ hɔle maanzinli ne anu ɛleka biala.
Gyisɛse yɛ anyenzinliravolɛma nwiɔ ayile
27Gyisɛse vi ɛkɛ ne na ɔkɔ la, anyenzinliravolɛma nwiɔ doale ye na bɛdeɛdeanle nu bɛzele kɛ, “Gyisɛse, Devidi ara, nwu yɛ anwunvɔne!”
28Nzinlii mɔɔ Gyisɛse hɔle sua nu la, bɛrale ɔ nwo ɛkɛ ne. Na Gyisɛse bizale bɛ kɛ, “Bɛdie bɛdi kɛ menwɔhola bɛ ayile yɛ ɔ?”
Bɛzele ye kɛ, “Ɛhɛe, Yɛmenle!”
29Yemɔti Gyisɛse vale ɔ sa hehanle bɛ nye ne mɔ na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Ɔyɛ zɔ ɔmaa bɛ, kɛmɔ bɛ diedi ne de la.” 30Na bɛ nye ne mɔ dukuedukuele. Gyisɛse bɔle bɛ nloa kɛ, “Bɛmmabɔ zo bɛmaa awie biala te.”
31Noko bɛvile ɛkɛ ne la, bɛvale Gyisɛse gyima kpalɛ nwo edwɛkɛ bɛhɔle maanzinli ne anu amuala.
Gyisɛse yɛ mumule ayile
32Mɔɔ menli ne mɔ finde ahɔ la, menli bie vale mumule bie mɔɔ sunsum ɛtane ɛva ye la rɛlɛle Gyisɛse. 33Ɔdule sunsum ɛtane ne la, mumule ne dendɛle. Na ɔyɛle menli dɔɔnwo ne nwanwane na bɛzele kɛ, “Yɛtɛnwunle ɛhye bie ɛlɛ wɔ Yizilayɛ!” 34 Noko Falasiima ne mɔ zele kɛ, “Ɔdua mbɔnsam kpanyinli ne tumi zo a ɔtu mbɔnsam ne mɔ a.”
Gyisɛse se menli anwunvɔne
35 Gyisɛse hɔkpɔsale maanzinli ne anu azua nee namunamu ne mɔ amuala azo, ɔhilehilele wɔ nyianu azua ne mɔ anu, ɔhanle Edwɛkpa ne mɔɔ fane Anwuma Belemgbunlililɛ ne anwo la ɔhilele menli ne. Ɔmanle menli mɔɔ ewule ngakyile ɛha bɛ nee mɔɔ anwonyane ɛbɔ bɛ la amuala anwo zale. 36 Ɔnwunle menli somaa ne la, alɔbɔlɛ hunle ye, ɔluakɛ bɛbɔ asande na bɛluolua nu mgbane mgbane kɛ mboane mɔɔ ɛnlɛ neavolɛ la. 37 Na ɔzele ye ɛdoavolɛma ne kɛ, “Nɔhalɛ, Nyamenle bɛyɔba ne ɛbolo kpole, na menli mɔɔ bu la le ekyi. 38Zɔhane ati bɛzɛlɛ egyinli menle ne kɛ ɔkɛva gyimayɛvoma dɔɔnwo ɔkɛmaa bɛkɛhɔbu bɛyɔba ne.”

Title: MAT 10
Content:
Ɛzoanvolɛma bulu nee nwiɔ ne
(Mak 3.13-19; Luk 6.12-16)
1Gyisɛse vɛlɛle ye ɛdoavolɛma bulu nee nwiɔ ne na ɔmanle bɛ tumi kɛ bɛdu sunsum ɛtane, na bɛyɛ ewule nee anwonyane biala ayile. 2Ɛzoanvolɛma bulu nee nwiɔ ne aluma ɛne: mɔɔ lumua la a le Saemɔn, mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Pita la nee ɔ diema Andelu; Gyemise nee ɔ diema Dwɔn, mɔɔ bɛ ze a le Zɛbɛdi la; 3Felepe nee Baatɔlomiyu; Tɔmase nee Mateyu mɔɔ le adwuledievolɛ ne; Afeɛse ara Gyemise nee Tadease; 4Saemɔn mɔɔ le Keenanli ne, nee Dwudase Yesekaleɔto mɔɔ yele Gyisɛse manle la.
Bulu nee nwiɔ ne gyima
(Mak 6.7-13; Luk 9.1-6)
5Gyisɛse zoanle bɛdabɛ bulu nee nwiɔ ɛhye na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛmmakɔ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la anu anzɛɛ Samɛlea azua ne mɔ azo; 6bɛhɔ Yizilayɛma mɔɔ ɛminli la ɛkɛ ne. 7 Saa bɛkɔ a, bɛhɔbɔ nolo kɛ, ‘Anwuma Belemgbunlililɛ ne ɛbikye.’ 8Bɛyɛ wuleravolɛma ayile, bɛdunwue mɔɔ ɛwu la, bɛmaa kokobɛvolɛma ɛde kpɔkɛ, na bɛdu sunsum ɛtane ne mɔ. Bɛnyia tumi ɛhye mgbane mɔɔ bɛandua nwolɛ ɛhwee a, yemɔti bɛva bɛmaa mgbane mɔɔ bɛnlie ɛhwee a. 9Bɛmmafa ezukoa nvutuke anzɛɛ dwɛtɛ fufule anzɛɛ ezukoa kɔbele bɛbɔ bɛ nwo; 10 bɛmmafa aleɛ kodoku wɔ bɛ adendulɛ nu. Bɛmmafa anwuma adɛladeɛ nwiɔ, mgbɔlaboa anzɛɛ kpɔma, ɔluakɛ soamɛlɛkɛ didi mgbane.
11“Saa bɛkɔ sua bie anzɛɛ namule bie azo a, bɛbiza bɛnwu sonla mɔɔ kɛlie bɛ la na bɛhɔzokoɛ ye, na bɛdɛnla ɔ nwo ɛkɛ ne ɔhɔdwu mekɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛvi sua ne anzɛɛ namule ne azo la. 12Saa bɛwolo awuke nu a, bɛze ɛkɛ ne amra kɛ, ‘Anzonudwolɛ ɛha bɛ.’ 13Saa awuke ne anu amra die bɛ a, bɛmaa bɛ anzonudwolɛ ne ɛha ɛkɛ; saa bɛanlie bɛ noko a, bɛva bɛ anzonudwolɛ ne bɛzia bɛhɔ. 14 Eza awuke anzɛɛ sua biala mɔɔ anlie bɛ anzɛɛ andie mɔɔ bɛka la, saa bɛlɛfi ɛkɛ ne a bɛkpɔlɔkpɔla bɛ gyakɛ abo anwea ne bɛgua zolɛ. 15 Na nɔhalɛ, mese, wɔ Ndɛnebualɛ Kenle ne, Nyamenle baze Sodɔm nee Gomɔla amra anwunvɔne dɔɔnwo adɛla menli mɔɔ wɔ zɔhane sua ne azo la.
Bɛbayɛ bɛ kpɔdekpɔde
(Mak 13.9-13; Luk 21.12-17)
16 “Bɛdie! Melɛsoa bɛ kɛ mboane la wɔ bedi avinli. Bɛmaa bɛ nye ɛla bɛ nwo zo kɛ nwɔlɛ, noko bɛyɛ bɛlɛvo kɛ abubule. 17 Bɛnlea bɛ nwo boɛ wɔ menli sa nu, ɔluakɛ bɛbahye bɛ bɛ nee bɛ ahɔ kɔɔto; bɛbabila bɛ empele wɔ bɛ nyianu azua ne mɔ anu, 18yɛɛ eza bɛbahwe bɛ bɛahɔ maanle mgbanyima nee arelemgbunli nyunlu wɔ me ti, na bɛabɔ Edwɛkpa ne nolo bɛahile bɛ nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la. 19Saa bɛfa bɛ bɛkɔ kɛ bɛli bɛ edwɛkɛ a, bɛmmadwenle mɔɔ bɛbaha la anwo anzɛɛ kɛ bɛbazi bɛaha ye la anwo; saa mekɛ ne dwu a, bɛbava mɔɔ bɛbaha la bɛamaa bɛ. 20Ɔluakɛ tɛ bɛmɛ a bɛbadendɛ a; bɛ Ze mɔɔ wɔ anwuma la Sunsum ne balua bɛ nwo zo adendɛ.
21 “Adiema baye adiema amaa kɛ bɛhu ye. Selɛ baye ralɛ amaa, mralɛ badwazo bɛ awovolɛma anwo zo na bɛaye bɛ bɛamaa bɛahu bɛ. 22 Me ti, menli kɔsɔɔti bakpɔ bɛ. Noko mɔɔ kɛgyinla kpundii kɛhɔ awieleɛ la, Nyamenle kɛlie ye ngoane. 23Saa bɛyɛ bɛ kpɔdekpɔde wɔ sua ko azo a, bɛnriandi bɛhɔ mɔɔ doa ye la azo. Na meka meahile bɛ kɛ bɛnrɛwie Yizilayɛ azua ne mɔ amuala azo kɔ na Sonla Ra ne ara.
24 “Ɛdoavolɛ biala ɛndɛla ye kilehilevolɛ, yɛɛ akɛlɛ ɛndɛla ɔ menle. 25 Ɔwɔ kɛ ɛdoavolɛ biala yɛ kɛ ɔ menle la, yɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ akɛlɛ yɛ kɛ ɔ menle la. Saa bɛvɛlɛ sua menle ne Biyɛlezɛbɛle a, ɛnee ye sua nu ɛkɛ ne amra ɛdeɛ bɛkɛvɛlɛ bɛ aluma dɔɔnwo kpalɛ.
Mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛsulo ye la
(Luk 12.2-7)
26 “Yemɔti bɛmmasulo awie biala, ɔluakɛ debie biala ɛnle ɛkɛ mɔɔ bɛheda zolɛ mɔɔ bɛnrɛdukue zolɛ a, yɛɛ debie biala ɛnle fealera nu mɔɔ ɛnrɛla ali a. 27Mɔɔ menwɔha menwɔhile bɛ wɔ awozinli nu la, bɛha ye bagua nu, yɛɛ mɔɔ bɛde ye azukue nu la, bɛbɔ ye nolo wɔ azua ti zo. 28Bɛmmasulo bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkola bɛku nwonane ne na bɛngola ɛkɛla ne ku la; bɛzulo Nyamenle mɔɔ kola nwonane ne nee ɛkɛla ne amuala ku, na ɔsɛkye bɛ wɔ ɛbolɔ senle nu la. 29Bɛtɔ nyamenleakatiba nwiɔ ɛkpɔsɛba ko, noko akee ko bɔbɔ ɛndɔ aze wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛ Ze mɔɔ wɔ anwuma la ɛnze nu a. 30Na bɛmɛ, bɛ ti zo enrinli bɔbɔ bɛdia. 31Zɔhane ati bɛmmasulo, ɔluakɛ bɛsonle bolɛ kpole bɛtɛla nyamenleakatiba dɔɔnwo.
Kelaese ɛlielɛ nee ye ɛkpolɛ
(Luk 12.8-9)
32“Awie biala mɔɔ kɛha ye baguase kɛ ɔle me ɛdeɛ la, medame menwɔyɛ ye zɔhane ala menwɔmaa ye wɔ Egya mɔɔ wɔ anwuma la anyunlu. 33 Na awie biala mɔɔ kɛkpo me wɔ bagua nu la, medame noko menwɔkpo ye wɔ Egya mɔɔ wɔ anwuma la anyunlu.
Tɛ anzonudwolɛ ɔ, konle ɔ
(Luk 12.51-53; 14.26-27)
34“Bɛmmadwenle kɛ me nee anzonudwolɛ a rale ewiade a; kyɛkyɛ, meanva anzonudwolɛ meamba. Me nee konle a rale a. 35 Membale kɛ mebamaa mralɛ mrenya adwazo atia bɛ ze mɔ, mralɛ mraalɛ adwazo atia bɛ nli mɔ, nwuvolɛ mraalɛ adwazo atia bɛ hu mɔ bɛ nli mɔ; 36sonla biala kpɔvolɛma kpalɛ vi ɔdaye ye sua nu.
37“Mɔɔ kulo ɔ ze anzɛɛ ɔ nli tɛla me la ɛnfɛta kɛ ɔkɛyɛ me ɛdoavolɛ, yɛɛ mɔɔ kulo ɔ ra nrenya anzɛɛ ɔ ra raalɛ tɛla me la ɛnfɛta kɛ ɔkɛyɛ me ɛdoavolɛ. 38 Awie biala mɔɔ anva ye meanubaka ne ando ɔ kɔme zo antietia me gyakɛ abo zo la ɛnfɛta kɛ ɔkɛyɛ me ɛdoavolɛ. 39 Mɔɔ kɛpele ye ngoane nwo la kɛminli ye; na mɔɔ kɛminli ye ngoane wɔ me ti la kɛnyia ngoane mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ.
Ahatualɛ
(Mak 9.41)
40 “Awie mɔɔ kɛlie bɛ la ɛlie medame; mɔɔ kɛlie me noko la ɛlie mɔɔ zoanle me la. 41Mɔɔ kɛlie Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ kɛ ɔle Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ la, kɛnyia Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ nwo ahyɛlɛdeɛ, yɛɛ mɔɔ kɛlie sonlakpalɛ wɔ sonlakpalɛ duma nu la, kɛnyia sonlakpalɛ nwo ahatualɛ. 42Na bɛhakye ɛhye: Awie biala mɔɔ kɛmaa ngakula ngyikyi ɛhye mɔ anu ko nzule fɔlɔdɔdɔ kanrɛlɛ ko bɔbɔ kɛnlo, kɛ ɔle me ɛdoavolɛ la, kɛnyia nwolɛ ahatualɛ somaa!”

Title: MAT 11
Content:
Menli mɔɔ Dwɔn Sɔnevolɛ ne zoanle bɛ la
(Luk 7.18-35)
1Mɔɔ Gyisɛse wiele ye ɛdoavolɛma bulu nee nwiɔ ne folɛ tu la, ɔvi ɛkɛ ne ɔhɔle na ɔhɔhilehilele, ɔhanle Edwɛkpa ne wɔ azua mɔɔ zuozua ɛkɛ ne la azo.
2Gyisɛse gyima mɔɔ ɛnee ɔlɛdi la nganeɛ dwule Dwɔn Sɔnevolɛ ne anzo nu wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee ɔla efiade la. Yemɔti ɔzoanle ye ɛdoavolɛma ne bie mɔ wɔ Gyisɛse ɛkɛ ne; 3bɛhɔbizale ye kɛ, “Ɛnee wɔmɔ a ɛle ahenle ne mɔɔ Dwɔn zele kɛ ɔbara la anzɛɛ yɛmaa yɛ nye ɛla sonla fofolɛ ade ɔ?”
4Gyisɛse buale kɛ, “Bɛzia bɛhɔha mɔɔ bɛde nee mɔɔ bɛnwu ye la bɛhile Dwɔn: 5 anyenzinliravolɛma nwu debie, abuburama tia, kokobɛvolɛma anwo sa, anzondiliravolɛma te edwɛkɛ, bɛdwazo mɔwuamra bɛba ngoane nu bieko, yɛɛ bɛka Edwɛkpa ne bɛkile ehyianvolɛma. 6Nyilalɛ ɛha bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ ti anu ɛnyɛ bɛ kesee wɔ me nwo la.”
7Mɔɔ Dwɔn ɛdoavolɛma ne ziale kɛ bɛkɔ la, Gyisɛse bɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɔka Dwɔn anwo edwɛkɛ yeahile menli dɔɔnwo ne. Ɔse, “Mɔɔ bɛhɔle Dwɔn anwo lɔ wɔ fienemgbole ne anu la, duzu a ɛnee bɛ nye la kɛ bɛkɛnwu ye a? Ɛhonle mɔɔ anwoma ɛlɛkpusu ye la ɔ? 8Na duzu a bɛhɔle ye ɛnleanlɛ a? Awie mɔɔ heda ɛdakpa la ɔ? Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛheda ɛdakpa la dede arelemgbunli azua nu. 9Bɛha bɛhile me ɛ; ɛnee akee duzu a bɛhɔle ye ɛnleanlɛ a? Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ ɔ? Ɛhɛe, na meka meahile bɛ kɛ bɛnwunle awie mɔɔ tɛla Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ bɔbɔ la. 10 Ɔluakɛ Dwɔn a Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne ka ye ɔ nwo kɛ: ‘Nyamenle se, mebazoa me ɛbɔfoɔ meamaa yealumua ɛ nyunlu na yeahɔziezie adenle ne anu yeamaa wɔ’ la. 11Nɔhalɛ, meka meahile bɛ, wɔ menli mɔɔ bɛwo bɛ bɛgua ɛbɛla azɛlɛ ɛhye azo la anu, awie ɛtɛdwazole mɔɔ le kpole tɛla Dwɔn Sɔnevolɛ ne a. Noko akee awie mɔɔ le ekyi wɔ Anwuma Belemgbunlililɛ nu la le kpole tɛla ye. 12 Ɔvi mekɛ mɔɔ Dwɔn Sɔnevolɛ ne bɔle ye nolobɔlɛ bo mɔɔ ɛradwu ɛnɛ la, ngyegyelɛ dɔɔnwo ɛra Anwuma Belemgbunlililɛ ne anwo ɛsesebɛ, na menli mɔɔ di mgbonde la ɛlɛbɔ mɔdenle kɛ bɛkɛpemgbe bɛkɛnyia ye. 13Ɔluakɛ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma ne mɔ amuala nee Mosisi mɛla ne hanle Belemgbunlililɛ ne anwo edwɛkɛ dole ɛkɛ kolaa na Dwɔn ara; 14 na saa bɛkɛlie bɛkɛli a, anrɛɛ mese, Dwɔn a le Yilaegya ne mɔɔ bɛhanle ye edwɛkɛ kɛ ɔbara la. 15Mɔɔ lɛ ɛnzonlɛ la ɛdie.
16“Ɛnee akee duzu a menva adwuleso amra ɛhye mendo nwo a? Bɛle kɛ ngakula mɔɔ ɛlɛdi nwɔhoa wɔ gua zo la. Bɛdede ye ekpunli ekpunli, na ekpunli ko tea nu se ko ne kɛ, 17‘Yɛbɔle anyelielɛ edwɛne yɛmanle bɛ, noko bɛanzi. Yɛdole ɛzɛne edwɛne la, bɛanzu.’ 18Dwɔn Sɔnevolɛ ne rale na ɔhyele ɛhɔne dahuu, ɔhyile nza la, awie biala se, ‘Ɔlɛ ayɛne!’ 19Medame, Sonla Ra noko mera, na melɛdi meanlo a, awie biala se, ‘Bɛnlea ɛhye! Adidikpoku, nzanli, adwuledievolɛma nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ awie ɛmbu bɛ la agɔnwo!’ Noko Nyamenle nrɛlɛbɛ ne amra ne mɔ nyɛleɛ maa bɛnwu kɛ ɔle nɔhalɛ.”
Azua mɔɔ ɛnlɛ diedi la
(Luk 10.13-15)
20Akee Gyisɛse bɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɔtea menli mɔɔ wɔ azua mɔɔ yeyɛ nwanwane gyima dɔɔnwo wɔ zo la azo amra, ɔluakɛ bɛannu bɛ nwo. 21 “Munzule ɛha bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ Koleezen la! Munzule ɛha bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ Bɛteseeyeda la! Nwanwane gyima mgbole mɔɔ bɛyɛle wɔ bɛ azua ne mɔ azo la, saa bɛyɛle bie wɔ Taya nee Saedɛn a, anrɛɛ menli mɔɔ wɔ zo la hedale ɛrele, bɔle nzonle, bɛvale bɛhilele kɛ bɛnlu bɛ nwo wɔ bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ anwo. 22Meka meahile bɛ, Ndɛnebualɛ Kenle ne, Nyamenle baze Tayama nee Saedɛnema anwunvɔne dɔɔnwo adɛla bɛ. 23 Na bɛmɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ Kapɛnayɛm la, bɛkpondɛ kɛ bɛkɔ Nyamenle maanle ne anu ɔ? Kyɛkyɛ! Bɛbavuandi bɛ bɛagua ɛbolɔ senle nu. Nwanwane gyima mɔɔ bɛyɛle wɔ bɛ sua zo la, saa bɛyɛle bie wɔ Sodɔm a, anrɛɛ ɛnɛ nee ɛnɛ ala sua zɔhane tɛbɔ ɛkɛ. 24 Bɛnwu ye kɛ, Ndɛnebualɛ Kenle ne, Nyamenle baze Sodɔm amra anwunvɔne dɔɔnwo adɛla bɛ!”
Bɛrɛla me ɛkɛ bɛralie bɛ ɛnwomenle
(Luk 10.21-22)
25Mekɛ ne anu Gyisɛse zele kɛ, “Egya, anwuma nee aze Awulae, meyɛ wɔ mo kɛ ninyɛne mɔɔ wɔva wɔvea nrɛlɛbɛvolɛma nee nwomama la wɔye wɔhile menli mɔɔ ɛnze nwolɛ bie la. 26Ɛhɛe, Egya, ɛnee kɛ ɛkpondɛ kɛ ɔba ye la ɛne.
27 “Egya ɛva ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti ɛmaa me. Awie biala ɛnze Ralɛ ne sonla holɛ kɛ Selɛ ne ala, yɛɛ awie biala ɛnze Selɛ ne sonla holɛ kɛ Ralɛ ne nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ Ralɛ ne kulo kɛ ɔye ye ɔkile bɛ la ala.
28“Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛzo ɛnlomboɛ na bɛvɛ la, bɛ muala bɛrɛla me nwo ɛke, na menwɔmaa bɛ ɛnwomenlelielɛ. 29 Bɛva me gyɛnvayile ne bɛdo bɛ kɔme zo na bɛzukoa mɔɔ meyɛ la, ɔluakɛ mele bɛtɛɛ, yɛɛ memmemaa me nwo zo, na bɛ ɛkɛla ne mɔ anwo kɛdɔ bɛ. 30Ɔluakɛ me gyɛnvayile ne le felafela, yɛɛ bɔlɛ mɔɔ mebava meazoa bɛ la ɛnyɛ ɛnlomboɛ.”

Title: MAT 12
Content:
Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ne anwo kpuyia
(Mak 2.23-28; Luk 6.1-5)
1 Mekɛ ekyi guale nu la, ɛnee Gyisɛse lua abɛlɛ ɛya bie anu wɔ Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ne. Ɛhɔne hunle ye ɛdoavolɛma ne, yemɔti bɛbubule bie bɛlile. 2Falasiima bie mɔ nwunle ɛhye la bɛzele Gyisɛse kɛ, “Nea, kɛ wɔ ɛdoavolɛma ne ɛlɛyɛ mɔɔ bɛnyɛ la wɔ Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ɛ; ɔtia yɛ mɛla ne!”
3 Gyisɛse buale bɛ kɛ, “Asoo bɛtɛkengale mɔɔ Devidi yɛle, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee ɛhɔne ɛlɛku ye nee ye menli mɔɔ ɔ nee bɛ lua la? 4 Se Devidi hɔle Nyamenle Sua ne anu na ɔhɔvale azu kpanwo ne bie ɔlile, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ adenle ɛnla ɛkɛ kɛ awie di bie kyesɛ sɛlɛvolɛma ala la. 5 Anzɛɛ bɛtɛkengale ye wɔ Mosisi mɛla ne anu kɛ sɛlɛvolɛma mɔɔ wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu la to Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle mɛla ne mekɛ biala, noko akee bɛnli fɔlɛ ɔ? 6Meka meahile bɛ, awie mɔɔ le kpole tɛla Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne la wɔ ɛke. 7 Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se, ‘Mekpondɛ anwunvɔnezelɛ na tɛ nane azubɔlɛ ɔ.’ Saa bɛte ɛhye abo kpalɛ a, anrɛɛ bɛmbu bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnze nwolɛ bie la fɔlɛ. 8Ɔluakɛ medame, Sonla Ra, melɛ tumi wɔ Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ne azo noko.”
Nrenya ne mɔɔ asa ko ɛdwe la
(Mak 3.1-6; Luk 6.6-11)
9Gyisɛse vi ɛkɛ ne la, ɔhɔle bɛ nyianu sua ne anu. 10Nrenya bie wɔ ɛkɛ ne mɔɔ ɔ sa ko ɛdwe a. Menli bie noko bɛdabɛ bɛra ɛkɛ ne kɛ bɛtɛ Gyisɛse na bɛahɔdoa ye. Yemɔti bɛbizale ye kɛ, “Asoo ɔtia yɛ mɛla ne kɛ bɛkɛyɛ ayile wɔ Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle?”
11 Gyisɛse buale bɛ kɛ, “Bɛ nuhua boni yɛɛ saa ɔlɛ ye boane na ɔtɔ kuma nu Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle a, ɔnrɛye ye a? 12Sonla noko sonle bolɛ tɛla nane! Yemɔti yɛ mɛla ne ɛndua kɛ yɛmmaboa awie wɔ Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle.” 13Akee ɔzele nrenya ne kɛ, “Tenrɛ ɛ sa nu.”
Nrenya ne denrɛle ɔ sa ne anu, na ɔyɛle kpalɛ kɛ ɔ sa ɛhendeɛ ne ala la. 14Yemɔti Falasiima ne vindele na bɛhɔbɔle kpɔkɛ kɛ bɛku Gyisɛse.
Nyamenle sonvolɛ mɔɔ yekpa nu yeye ye la
15Mɔɔ Gyisɛse nwunle kɛ bɛhɔ ɔ ti akpamo la, ɔvi ɛkɛ ne ɔyele ɔ nwo; na menli dɔɔnwo doale ye. Ɔyɛle bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnde kpɔkɛ la ayile 16na ɔbɔle bɛ nloa kɛ bɛmmaka bɛmaa bɛte ye nganeɛ. 17Ɔyɛle ɛhye amaa mɔɔ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ Ayezaya hanle la ayɛ nɔhalɛ kɛ:
18 “Bɛnlea, me sonvolɛ ne mɔɔ mekpa nu meye ye la ɛne,
yemɔ a ɔle sonla mɔɔ mekulo ye na me nye die ɔ nwo a.
Mebava me Sunsum meawula ye, na yeabɔ me
ndɛnebualɛ ne nolo yeahile maanle maanle muala.
19Ɔnrɛzu kpolera, yɛɛ ɔnrɛdeɛdea nu;
awie ɛnrɛde ɔ ne wɔ gua zo.
20Ɔnrɛbu baka mɔɔ bɛkposo ye la,
yɛɛ ɔnrɛgua nzule senle mɔɔ asɛɛ ɛnlu la anu,
kɔkpula kɛ ɔkɛmaa pɛlepɛlelilɛ kɛli konim,
21na menli muala kɛnyia anyelazo wɔ ye nu.”
Gyisɛse nee Biyɛlezɛbɛle
(Mak 3.20-30; Luk 11.14-23)
22Menli bie vale nrenya bie mɔɔ sunsum ɛtane wɔ ɔ nwo na eza ɔle anyenzinliravolɛ nee mumule la rɛlɛle Gyisɛse. Gyisɛse yɛle ye ayile na nrenya ne dendɛle na ɔnwunle debie. 23Ɛhye zinle menli ne anwo, na bɛbizale kɛ, “Asoo tɛ Devidi Ara ne ɛne?”
24 Noko mɔɔ Falasiima ne dele ɛhye la bɛzele kɛ, “Mbɔnsam kpanyinli ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Biyɛlezɛbɛle la ala a maa ye tumi mɔɔ ɔfa ɔtu mbɔnsam a.”
25Gyisɛse nwunle bɛ adwenle la, ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Maanle biala mɔɔ anu kɛhyɛ nwiɔ na bɛko bɛtia bɛ nwo la ɛngyinla, yɛɛ sua anzɛɛ abusua biala mɔɔ anu kɛhyɛ nwiɔ na bɛko bɛtia bɛ nwo la ɛngyɛ na yeabɔ. 26Yemɔti saa Seetan ɔdaye noko ye belemgbunlililɛ ne anu ɛhyɛ nwiɔ, na bɛlɛko bɛatia bɛ nwo a, ɛnee ɔkile kɛ ɔnrɛgyinla. 27Na saa mame, medua Biyɛlezɛbɛle anwo zo a metu mbɔnsam a, ɛnee nwane anwo zo a bɛ ɛdoavolɛma ne dua tu bɛ a? Mɔɔ bɛdabɛ bɛ ɛdoavolɛma ne yɛ la kile kɛ bɛvo. 28Na saa medua Nyamenle Sunsum ne tumi zo a metu mbɔnsam a, ɛnee noko Anwuma Belemgbunlililɛ ne ɛdwu bɛ nwo ɛke dɛbadɛba.
29“Awie biala ɛnrɛhola ɛnrɛwolo sonla mɔɔ anwo yɛ se la sua nu ɛnrɛva ye ninyɛne mɔɔ ɔlɛ la, kyesɛ ɔdumua ɔkyekye ye na yeahola yeawua ye.
30 “Awie biala mɔɔ ɛmboka me nwo la tia me, yɛɛ mɔɔ nee me ɛnguohua la sande nu. 31Zɔhane ati meka meahile bɛ, bɛbava ɛtane mɔɔ menli yɛ, nee mgbane mgbane mɔɔ bɛkeha la bɛahyɛ bɛ; na mɔɔ kɛha ɛtane kɛtia Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne la, bɛnrɛva bɛnrɛhyɛ ye. 32 Awie biala mɔɔ tendɛ tia medame, Sonla Ra la, bɛbava bɛahyɛ ye, na mɔɔ kɛdendɛ kɛtia Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne la, bɛnrɛva bɛnrɛhyɛ ye wɔ ɛnɛ anzɛɛ kenle bie.
Baka nee ye ma
(Luk 6.43-45)
33 “Baka kpalɛ biala so ma kpalɛ, yɛɛ baka ɛtane biala so ma ɛtane. Baka ne ma a kile ye baka holɛ a. 34 Bɛmɛ ɛkyelebenle mralɛ! Bɛnle kpalɛ la ati bɛngola bɛnga edwɛkɛ kpalɛ. Ɔluakɛ mɔɔ ɛyi ɛbulu zo wɔ bɛ ahonle ne mɔ anu la a finde bɛ nloa a. 35Sonlakpalɛ biala yɛ debie kpalɛ, yɛɛ sonlatane biala yɛ ninyɛndane.
36“Meka meahile bɛ: Edwɛkɛ mgbane mgbane biala mɔɔ awie biala kɛha la ɔbabu nwolɛ mgbonda wɔ Ndɛnebualɛ Kenle ne. 37Ɔluakɛ Nyamenle balua bɛdabɛ bɛ nloa edwɛkɛ zo a yeabua bɛ benle anzɛɛ yeabua bɛ ewule fɔlɛ a.”
Menli ne bizale nwanwane sɛkɛlɛneɛ
(Mak 8.11-12; Luk 11.29-32)
38 Mɛla kilehilevolɛma bie mɔ nee Falasiima bie zele Gyisɛse kɛ, “Kilehilevolɛ, yɛkulo kɛ ɛyɛ nwanwane sɛkɛlɛneɛ bie ɛmaa yɛnea.”
39 Gyisɛse buale bɛ kɛ, “Adwuleso amra ye le munzule menli, bɛnze Nyamenle! Bɛbiza bɛanlea nwanwane sɛkɛlɛneɛ? Bɛnrɛnwu bie, kyesɛ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ Dwona ɛdeɛ ne ala. 40 Kɛmɔ Dwona lile ewiazo nee nɔɔzo kenle nsa wɔ nyevizonle ne akunlu la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ medame, Sonla Ra, mebali ewiazo nee nɔɔzo kenle nsa wɔ azɛlɛ ti anu a. 41 Wɔ Ndɛnebualɛ Kenle ne Nenɛvɛma badwazo adoa bɛmɛ adwuleso amra, ɔboalekɛ Dwona edwɛkɛ ne manle bɛnlunle bɛ nwo; noko meka meahile bɛ, awie mɔɔ le kpole tɛla Dwona la wɔ ɛke! 42 Ndɛnebualɛ Kenle ne, Hyiba maanle nu belemgbunli raalɛ ne badwazo adoa bɛmɛ adwuleso amra, ɔboalekɛ ɔvi ye maanle nu wɔ nyiakɛ nehane ɔdiale dedee ɔradiele nrɛlɛbɛ ngilehilelɛ ɔvile Belemgbunli Sɔlɔmɔn ɛkɛ; noko meka meahile bɛ, awie mɔɔ le kpole tɛla Sɔlɔmɔn la wɔ ɛke!
Sunsum ɛtane ne sia
(Luk 11.24-26)
43“Saa sunsum ɛtane fi sonla nwo tu a, ɔkɔduolua ɛleka reresee kɛ ɔkpondɛ ɛleka yeabɔ ye nzeseɛ. Na saa yeannyia bie a, 44ɔka ɔkile ɔ nwo kɛ, ‘Mesia meahɔ me sua dɛba ne mɔɔ mevi nu menvindele la anu.’ Ɔsia ɔba na ɔbanwu kɛ ɛhwee ɛnle nu, bɛkpoɔkpoa nu bɛyɛ nu bɔkɔbɔkɔ a, 45akee ɔfinde na ɔkɔfa sunsum ɛtane nsuu mɔɔ le amumuyɛ tɛla ɔdaye mumua ne la ɔba na bɛbatɛnla ɛkɛ ne. Nzinlii sonla ɛhye akee sɛkye kpalɛ bɔkɔɔ tɛla alumua ne. Zɔhane ala yɛɛ ɔbazi adwuleso amra munzule anwo zo a.”
Gyisɛse ɔ nli nee ɔ mediema
(Mak 3.31-35; Luk 8.19-21)
46Mɔɔ Gyisɛse anloa wɔ zo ɔlɛtendɛ yeahile menli ne mɔ la, ɔ nli nee ɔ mediema mrenya ne mɔ rale alie nwo ɛkɛ ne na bɛhanle kɛ bɛkpondɛ ye bɛ nee ye adendɛ. 47Yemɔti menli ne mɔ ko zele Gyisɛse kɛ, “Nea, ɛ nli nee ɛ mediema mrenya ne mɔ gyi alie nwo lɔ, na bɛkulo kɛ bɛ nee wɔ tendɛ.”
48Gyisɛse buale kɛ, “Me nli a le nwane? Me mediema mrenya a le nwane mɔ?” 49Akee ɔdendenle ɔ sa wɔ ye ɛdoavolɛma ne mɔ anwo na ɔhanle kɛ, “Bɛnlea, me nli nee me mediema ɛne. 50Awie biala mɔɔ yɛ mɔɔ me Ze mɔɔ wɔ anwuma la kpondɛ la le me diema nrenya, me diema raalɛ, nee me nli.”

Title: MAT 13
Content:
Ma ɛlualɛ nwo ɛrɛlɛ
(Mak 4.1-9; Luk 8.4-8)
1Kenle ko ne ala Gyisɛse vile sua nu ɛkɛ hɔle tandane ne anloa na ɔdɛnlanle aze kɛ ɔyɛ ngilehilelɛ. 2 Kɛmɔ menli mɔɔ yiale ɔ nwo ɛkɛ ne la zonle la ati ɔhɔdɛnlanle ɛlɛne nu, na menli ne gyinlanle tandane ne anloa diele ye. 3Ɔvale mrɛlɛbulɛ ɔhanle edwɛkɛ dɔɔnwo ɔhilele bɛ.
Ɔse, “Ɛyazonlɛnli bie hɔle kɛ ɔkagua ma. 4Mɔɔ ɔgua ma ne la, bie guale adenle nu, na nloma rasusole. 5Bie guale azɛlɛ mɔɔ awolɛ dɔɔnwo wɔ nu la azo, ɛleka mɔɔ ndɛtɛlɛ anzo la, na ma ne fifile ndɛndɛ, ɔluakɛ azɛlɛ ne ɛmpi. 6Na mɔɔ ewia bɔle la, bɛyelale, ɔluakɛ bɛ ndinli ne mɔ andwu azɛlɛ bo kpalɛ. 7Ma ne bie noko guale mbowule nu, na mbowule ne nyinle hedale bɛ nwo zo, 8yɛɛ ma ne bie guale azɛlɛ kpalɛ zo, na bɛfifile bɛzole ma, bie mɔnwo ɛya, bie mɔnwo abulasia, yɛɛ bie mɔnwo abulasa.”
9Gyisɛse dwulale ye edwɛkɛ ne zɛhae, “Mɔɔ lɛ ɛnzonlɛ la ɛdie!”
Deɛ mɔɔ yemɔti Gyisɛse bu mrɛlɛ la
(Mak 4.10-12; Luk 8.9-10)
10Nzinlii ɛdoavolɛma ne rale Gyisɛse anwo ɛkɛ ne rabizale ye kɛ, “Duzu ati a saa ɛtendɛ wɔahile menli ne mɔ a ɛbu ye mrɛlɛ nu ɛ?”
11Gyisɛse buale kɛ, “Anwuma Belemgbunlililɛ ne anwo edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ vea la, bɛmɛ yɛɛ bɛmaa bɛ nwolɛ adenle kɛ bɛde ɔ bo a, na ɔnle zɔhane ɔmmaa menli mɔɔ ɛha la. 12 Ɔluakɛ mɔɔ lɛ bie la bɛkɛmaa ye bie dɔɔnwo bɛkɛboka nwolɛ, na mɔɔ ɛnlɛ bie la bɛkɛlie ekyi ne bɔbɔ mɔɔ ɔlɛ la ɔ sa nu. 13Metendɛ mekile menli ne mɔ wɔ mrɛlɛ nu, ɔboalekɛ bɛnea, noko bɛnnwu debie, bɛtie, noko bɛnde ɔ bo. 14 Yemɔti mɔɔ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ Ayezaya hanle la ɛmkpa bɛ nwo ɛlɛ kɛ:
‘Bɛbadie, noko bɛnrɛde ɔ bo;
bɛbanlea, noko bɛnrɛnwu ɛhwee.
15Ɔluakɛ menli ɛhye mɔ ɛsolo,
bɛduodua bɛ nzo yɛɛ bɛmuomua bɛ nye.
Saa tɛ ye zɔhane a, anrɛɛ bɛ nye kɛnwu debie,
bɛ nzo kɛde edwɛkɛ, bɛ adwenle kɛde edwɛkɛ bo,
na bɛkɛzia bɛkɛra bɛkɛmaa menwɔyɛ bɛ ayile.’
16 “Na bɛmɛ, bɛ ti ɛyɛ boɛ kpole! Bɛ nye nwu debie, yɛɛ bɛ nzo te edwɛkɛ. 17Meka meahile bɛ: Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma dɔɔnwo nee Nyamenle menli ne dɔɔnwo hulole kɛ anrɛɛ bɛkɛnwu ninyɛne mɔɔ bɛmɛ bɛnwu bɛ la, noko bɛannwu bɛ; anzɛɛ anrɛɛ bɛkɛde mɔɔ bɛmɛ bɛte la, noko bɛande.
Gyisɛse kile ma ɛlualɛ ɛrɛlɛ ne abo
(Mak 4.13-20; Luk 8.11-15)
18“Akee bɛdie ma ɛlualɛ nwo ɛrɛlɛ ne abo. 19Saa awie te Belemgbunlililɛ ne anwo edwɛkɛ na yeande ɔ bo a, ɔle kɛ ma ne mɔɔ guale adenle ne anu la. Amumuyɛnli ne ba na ɔbaye mɔɔ bɛlua ye wɔ ye adwenle nu la ɔkɔ. 20Ma ne mɔɔ guale azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ awolɛ wɔ nu la azo la gyi ɛkɛ maa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛte edwɛkɛ ne a ɛkɛ ne ala bɛfa fɛlɛkolilɛ bɛdie la. 21Noko edwɛkɛ ne ɛnzɔ ndinli wɔ bɛ nu la ati, ɔngyinla ɔngyɛ. Saa ɔlua edwɛkɛ ne ati bɛyɛ bɛ kpɔdekpɔde anzɛɛ bɛnwu amaneɛ a, ɛnee ɛkɛ ne ala bɛkpo aze. 22Ma ne mɔɔ guale mbowule nu la gyi ɛkɛ maa menli mɔɔ tie edwɛkɛ ne noko aleɛabo ɛbɛlabɔlɛ nwo adwenleadwenle nee anwonyia ɛhulolɛ nwo adwenle fo edwɛkɛ ne azo, na bɛnzo ma la. 23Na ma ne mɔɔ guale azɛlɛ kpalɛ zo la a le bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛtie edwɛkɛ ne na bɛte ɔ bo la. Nɔhalɛ, ɛhye mɔ so ma: bie mɔnwo ɛya, bie mɔnwo abulasia yɛɛ bie mɔnwo abulasa.”
Ndile nwo ɛrɛlɛ
24Gyisɛse eza bule bɛ ɛrɛlɛ bieko kɛ, “Anwuma Belemgbunlililɛ ne le kɛ nrenya bie mɔɔ luale ma kpalɛ wɔ ye ɛya nu la. 25Nɔe ne mɔɔ ɛnee menli ɛdeda la, kpɔvolɛ raluale ndile wɔ ɛya ne anu na ɔhɔle. 26Mɔɔ bɛfifile na bɛvieviale mralɛ la, ndile ne yele ɔ nwo. 27Ɛya menle ne gyimayɛvoma ne mɔ ko zele ye kɛ, ‘Yɛmenle, ma kpalɛ a yɛluale bɛ wɔ ɛya ye anu a, na ndile ye noko vi nienwu?’ 28Na ɔbuale kɛ, ‘Kpɔvolɛ a ɛrayɛ ɛhye a.’ Ye sonvolɛma ne mɔ zele ye kɛ, ‘Ɛnee maa yɛhɔdudu bɛ yɛgua.’ Ɔbuale bɛ kɛ, 29‘Kyɛkyɛ, ɔluakɛ saa bɛannea ye boɛ a, mɔɔ bɛlɛtudu ndile ne la, bɛbadudu ma kpalɛ ne noko. 30Bɛgyakyi bɛ bɛmaa bɛbɔ nu bɛnyi ɔhɔdwu ɛbuhenle ne, na mebaze menli mɔɔ bu la kɛ: Bɛlumua bɛdudu ndile ne na bɛkyekye bɛ avile bɛyela bɛ, na bɛbu abɛlɛ ne bɛgua me bonwolo ne azo.’ ”
Ma ekyi ne anwo ɛrɛlɛ
(Mak 4.30-32; Luk 13.18-19)
31Gyisɛse bule bɛ ɛrɛlɛ bieko kɛ, “Anwuma Belemgbunlililɛ ne le kɛ ma ekyi bie mɔɔ nrenya bie luale wɔ ye ɛya nu la. 32Mekɛ mɔɔ ɔdua la ɛnee ɔle ma nretee kpalɛ kpalɛ, noko ɔnyinle ɔyɛle baka kpole ɔdɛlale mbaka dɔɔnwo, na nloma rayɛle bɛ sane wɔ ye ngane ne mɔ anu.”
Mgbɔvonle nwo ɛrɛlɛ
(Luk 13.20-21)
33Gyisɛse bule ɛrɛlɛ bieko kɛ, “Anwuma Belemgbunlililɛ ne le kɛ mgbɔvonle mɔɔ raalɛ fa wula ɛdɔkɛ nu fɔtɔ la. Ɔmaa ɛdɔkɛ ne amuala tu.”
Gyisɛse mrɛlɛbulɛ ne
(Mak 4.33-34)
34Gyisɛse hanle ɛhye mɔ amuala wɔ mrɛlɛ nu a hilele menli ne a. Na yeangoati mrɛlɛ nwo yeandendɛ yeangile bɛ ɛlɛ. 35 Ɔyɛle ye zɔhane amaa mɔɔ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ ne hanle la ayɛ nɔhalɛ kɛ,
“Mebadendɛ meahile bɛ wɔ mrɛlɛ nu.
Mebaha ninyɛne mɔɔ sumunli kɛ aleɛ ye bɔle ɔ bo la
bɛtɛtele bie la anwo edwɛkɛ meahile bɛ.”
Gyisɛse kile ndile ɛrɛlɛ ne abo
36Gyisɛse gyakyile menli dɔɔnwo ne manle bɛhɔle sua nu. Ye ɛdoavolɛma ne rale ɔ nwo ɛkɛ ne razele ye kɛ, “Kile yɛ ɛya ne anu ndile ne ɛrɛlɛ ne abo.”
37Gyisɛse buale bɛ kɛ, “Ma kpalɛ duavolɛ ne a le Sonla Ra ne; 38ɛya ne a le ewiade; ma kpalɛ ne a le Belemgbunlililɛ ne amra; ndile ne a le Amumuyɛnli ne amra. 39Kpɔvolɛ ne mɔɔ luale bɛ la a le Abɔnsam. Ɛbuhenle ne a le ewiade awieleɛ, yɛɛ menli mɔɔ bu bɛyɔba ne la a le Nyamenle soanvolɛma. 40Kɛmɔ bɛdudule ndile ne na bɛyelale bɛ senle nu la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ ewiade awieleɛ bayɛ a. 41Sonla Ra ne bamaa ye soanvolɛma araboɔboa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛtwehwe menli bɛkɔ ɛtane nu nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛyɛ amumuyɛ la kɔsɔɔti anloa, 42na bɛavuandi bɛ bɛagua sendɔlɔra ne anu, ɛkɛ ne yɛɛ menli bazu adedɛ bɛ nwo bonrane nu a. 43Na Nyamenle menli ne bada kɛ sɛnzɛne wɔ bɛ Ze mɔɔ wɔ anwuma la Belemgbunlililɛ ne abo. Mɔɔ lɛ ɛnzonlɛ la ɛdie!
Kpɔba ne mɔɔ vea la anwo ɛrɛlɛ
44“Anwuma Belemgbunlililɛ ne le kɛ kpɔba bie mɔɔ vea azɛlɛ bie abo la. Saa awie kɔnwu ye a, ɔkeda zolɛ na ɔfa fɛlɛkolilɛ ɔkɔtɔne ɔ nwo ninyɛne kpokpoti na ɔfa ezukoa ne mɔɔ ɔkɛnyia ye la ɔbatɔ azɛlɛ ne.
Ezukoa bolɛ nwo ɛrɛlɛ
45“Bieko, Anwuma Belemgbunlililɛ ne le kɛ gualilɛnli mɔɔ ɛlɛkpondɛ ezukoa awolɛ mɔɔ sonle bolɛ la adɔ la. 46Mekɛ mɔɔ ɔkɛnwu bie mɔɔ sonle bolɛ kpalɛ la, ɔkɔtɔne ɔ nwo ninyɛne kpokpoti na ɔfa ezukoa mɔɔ ɔkɛnyia ye la ɔbatɔ bolɛ ne.
Avonle nwo ɛrɛlɛ
47“Anwuma Belemgbunlililɛ ne le kɛ avonle mɔɔ bɛdo ye wɔ tandane ne anu la. Ɔkye fɛlɛ ngakyile dɔɔnwo. 48Saa avonle ne kye bie a menli ne twehwe ba aze, bɛkpa fɛlɛ mɔɔ bɛhye bɛ la anu, bɛgua kpalɛ ne wɔ bɛ bokiti ne anu, na bɛfuandi mɔɔ anwo ɛngyia bɛ la bɛgua. 49Zɔhane ala yɛɛ ewiade awieleɛ bayɛ a; Nyamenle soanvolɛma barakpa amumuyɛma avi kpalɛma anu, 50na bɛavuandi amumuyɛma ne bɛagua sendɔlɔra ne anu. Ɛkɛ ne yɛɛ menli bazu adedɛ bɛ nwo bonrane nu a.”
Nɔhalɛ fofolɛ nee dɛba
51Gyisɛse bizale ye ɛdoavolɛma ne kɛ, “Asoo bɛte ɛhye mɔ amuala abo?” Bɛbuale kɛ, “Ɛhɛe.”
52Na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Zɔhane ati mɛla kilehilevolɛ biala mɔɔ bɛtete ye wɔ Anwuma Belemgbunlililɛ ne anwo la le kɛ awuke zo neavolɛ mɔɔ ye ninyɛne fofolɛ nee dɛba fi ye gya nu finde la.”
Bɛkpo Gyisɛse wɔ Nazalɛte
(Mak 6.1-6; Luk 4.16-30)
53Mɔɔ Gyisɛse wiele mrɛlɛ ne mɔ bu la ɔvile ɛkɛ ne, 54na ɔrale ɔdaye ye sua zo. Ɔhilehilele wɔ bɛ nyianu sua ne anu, na ɔzinle bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdiele ye la anwo. Na bɛbizale kɛ, “Nienwu a nrenya ye zukoale ye nrɛlɛbɛ ɛhye nee nwanwane gyima ye ɛyɛlɛ a? 55Tɛ kapentanli ne ara nrenya ne ɛ? Tɛ ɔ nli a le Mɛle, yɛɛ tɛ ɔ mediema mrenya a le Gyemise, Dwosefi, Saemɔn, yɛɛ Dwudase? 56Tɛ ɔ mediema mraalɛ a yɛ nee bɛ wɔ ɛke la? Ɛnee nienwu a ɔzukoale ɛhye mɔ amuala a?” 57 Yemɔti bɛkpole ye.
Gyisɛse zele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛdi Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ biala eni wɔ ɛleka biala, kyesɛ ɔdaye ye sua zo nee ye abusua nu ala.” 58Na yeanyɛ nwanwane gyima kpaziwɔkɛ biala wɔ ɛkɛ ne, ɔboalekɛ bɛanlie ye bɛanli.

Title: MAT 14
Content:
Dwɔn Sɔnevolɛ ne ewule
(Mak 6.14-29; Luk 9.7-9)
1Mekɛ ne anu ala Hɛlɔdo mɔɔ ɛnee le amɛnlado mɔɔ sie Galeli maanle ne la dele Gyisɛse nganeɛ, 2na ɔzele ye sonvolɛma ne kɛ, “Dwɔn Sɔnevolɛ ne ala a ɛzia ɛra ngoane nu bieko la, yemɔti a ɔlɛdi tumi gyima mgbole ɛhye mɔ a.”
3 Na yemɔ a le kɛ, Hɛlɔdo manle bɛhyele Dwɔn, bɛguale ye nwɔnzɔnwɔnzɔ na bɛdole ye efiade. Ɔ diema Felepe aye Hɛlɔdease ati a ɔyɛle ɛhye a, 4 ɔluakɛ Dwɔn hanle hilele ye fane dɔɔnwo kɛ, “Ɔnle amaamuo kpalɛ kɛ ɛkɛgya Hɛlɔdease.” 5Yemɔti Hɛlɔdo dwenlenle nwo kɛ ɔku Dwɔn, noko ɛnee ɔsulo Dwuuma ne, ɔluakɛ ɛnee bɛva Dwɔn kɛ ɔle Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ.
6Kenle ko Hɛlɔdo awolɛ kenle dwule na ɔdi ye ɛvoyia la, Hɛlɔdease ara raalɛ ne razile agole lieliele menli ne anye. Hɛlɔdo anye liele ye agolezilɛ ne anwo kpole, 7na ɔhanle ndane ɔbɔle ye ɛwɔkɛ kɛ debie biala mɔɔ ɔkɛbiza la ɔkɛva ɔkɛmaa ye.
8Kakula raalɛ ne hɔbizale ɔ nli Hɛlɔdease adwenle la, ɔzele ye kɛ ɔbiza ɔlie Dwɔn Sɔnevolɛ ne ati. Na kakula ne hɔhanle hilele Hɛlɔdo kɛ, “Medie Dwɔn Sɔnevolɛ ne ati wɔ apawa nu ɛke kɛkala.”
9Nyane hanle belemgbunli ne, noko kɛmɔ yeha ndane wɔ ye nyɛvolɛ ne mɔ anyunlu la ati, ɔhanle kɛ bɛyɛ mɔɔ kakula raalɛ ne kpondɛ la bɛmaa ye. 10Yemɔti Hɛlɔdo manle bɛhɔpɛle Dwɔn ati wɔ efiade ne. 11Bɛvale tile ne bɛdole apawa nu bɛrɛlɛle kakula raalɛ ne, na ɔdaye noko ɔvale ɔhɔmanle ɔ nli. 12Dwɔn ɛdoavolɛma ne raliele funli ne hɔziele ye, na bɛhɔbɔle Gyisɛse amaneɛ.
Gyisɛse maa menli apenle nnu aleɛ
(Mak 6.30-44; Luk 9.10-17; Dw 6.1-14)
13Mɔɔ Gyisɛse dele Dwɔn Sɔnevolɛ ne ewule amaneɛ la, ɔvole ɛlɛne nu ɔvile ɛkɛ ne, ɔ ngomekye ɔhɔle ɛleka bie mɔɔ ɛkɛ ne le sulokoko la. Menli ne dele la, bɛvi bɛ azua ne mɔ azo bɛvale aze bɛdoale ye. 14Gyisɛse tolole rale azule ne anloa na ɔnwunle menli dɔɔnwo ne la, ɔlile bɛ nwo nyane na ɔyɛle wuleravolɛma mɔɔ wɔ nu la ayile ɔmanle bɛdele kpɔkɛ.
15Ɔdwule nɔsolɛ nu la, ye ɛdoavolɛma ne rahanle hilele ye kɛ, “Aleɛ asɛɛ ɛdwo, yɛɛ ɛke noko ɛmbikye sua zo; yemɔti maa menli ne adenle maa bɛhɔ namunamu ne mɔ azo bɛhɔkpondɛ debie bɛli.”
16Gyisɛse zele bɛ kɛ, “Ɔngyia kɛ bɛkɛhɔ; bɛdabɛ bɛmaa bɛ debie bɛli.”
17Bɛbuale ye kɛ, “Yɛnlɛ debie biala wɔ ɛke kɛ kpanwo mumua nnu yɛɛ fɛlɛ nwiɔ ala.”
18Gyisɛse zele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛva bɛrɛlɛ me.” 19Akee ɔmanle menli ne mɔ dɛnlanle aze wɔ ndile ne azo, ɔvale kpanwo mumua nnu ne nee fɛlɛ nwiɔ ne; ɔnleanle anwuma na ɔyɛle Nyamenle mo. Ɔbubule nuhua na ɔvale ɔmanle ye ɛdoavolɛma ne, na ɛdoavolɛma ne vale manle menli ne. 20Na bɛ muala bɛlile na bɛ ko yile. Nzinlii ɛdoavolɛma ne sesale ɔ bo zo ne ahɛndɛne bulu nee nwiɔ. 21Na bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛlile la, saa ɛye mraalɛ nee ngakula ne mɔ nu a, bɛlua mrenya kɛyɛ apenle nnu.
Gyisɛse tia azule nye
(Mak 6.45-52; Dw 6.15-21)
22Akee Gyisɛse manle ye ɛdoavolɛma ne vole ɛlɛne nu na bɛlumuale ɔ nyunlu wɔ tandane ne anzi lɔ, na yemɔ ɔnleanle ɔmanle menli ne zandele. 23Mɔɔ menli ne hɔle la, ɔdaye ɔ ngome ɔhɔle boka ne azo kɛ ɔkazɛlɛ. Aleɛ muanle nwo la, ɛnee yeha ɔdaye ɔ ngome ala wɔ ɛkɛ ne; 24zɛhae mekɛ ne anu ɛnee ɛlɛne ne ɛhɔ moa na azudulɛ ne bɔ ye mgbaka, ɔluakɛ ɛnee anwoma ne bɔ tia ye.
25Mɔɔ ɔdwule akɔlɛmɔleɛ la, Gyisɛse diale azule ne anye na ɔrale bɛ nwo ɛkɛ ne. 26Mɔɔ ɛdoavolɛma ne nwunle ye kɛ ɔlɛtia azule ne anye yeara la, ɛzulolɛ hanle bɛ na bɛdeɛdeanle nu bɛzele kɛ, “Nwomenle o, nwomenle o!”
27Na ɛkɛ ne ala Gyisɛse zele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛmmasulo, bɛha bɛ ahonle bɛdo azule nu na medame ɔ.”
28Pita hanle kɛ, “Awulae, saa ɛdawɔ amgba a, ɛnee maa adenle maa medame mendia azule ye anye membɛla ɛ nwo ɛkɛ.”
29Gyisɛse zele ye kɛ, “Bɛla!” Yemɔti Pita vi ɛlɛne ne anu dwule na ɔbɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɔtia azule ne anye yeahɔ Gyisɛse anwo lɔ. 30Na mɔɔ ɔnwunle kɛ anwoma ne anloa yɛ se la, ye ahonle dule, na ɔbɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɔnoma. Na ɔdeanle nu kɛ, “Awulae, die me!”
31Ɛkɛ ne ala Gyisɛse denrɛle ɔ sa zɔle ye na ɔzele ye kɛ, “O nrenyakpa, wɔ diedi le ekyi! Duzu ati a ɛ ti anu yɛle wɔ kesee ɛ?”
32Bɛ mu nwiɔ bɛvole ɛlɛne ne anu, na anwoma ne gyinlanle. 33Na ɛdoavolɛma ne mɔɔ wɔ ɛlɛne ne anu la rayeyɛle Gyisɛse zele kɛ, “Nɔhalɛ, wɔmɔ a ɛle Nyamenle Ara ne!”
Gyisɛse yɛ wuleravolɛma ayile wɔ Gɛnɛzalɛte
(Mak 6.53-56)
34Gyisɛse nee ye ɛdoavolɛma ne pɛle tandane ne hɔle Gɛnɛzalɛte, 35na menli mɔɔ wɔ ɛkɛ ne la nwunle ye. Yemɔti bɛmanle bɛhɔvale wuleravolɛma mɔɔ wɔ namunamu nee azua mɔɔ bikye ɛkɛ ne la azo la bɛrale na 36bɛzɛlɛle Gyisɛse kɛ ɔmaa wuleravolɛma ne adenle ɔmaa bɛva bɛ sa bɛha ye tɛladeɛ ne anloa bɔbɔ ala.
