Gyisɛse fɛlɛ fɛlɛkyevoma nna
(Mat 4.12-22; Luk 4.14-15; 5.1-11)
14Nzinlii mɔɔ bɛhyele Dwɔn bɛdole efiade la, Gyisɛse hɔle Galeli hɔbɔle Edwɛkpa ne nolo kɛ, 15 “Mekɛ ne ɛdwu, Nyamenle Belemgbunlililɛ ne ɛbikye. Bɛnlu bɛ nwo na bɛlie Edwɛkpa ne bɛli.”
16Gyisɛse lua Galeli Tandane ne anloa la, ɔnwunle fɛlɛkyevoma nwiɔ kɛ bɛlɛgua asawu. Bɛmɛ a le Saemɔn nee ɔ diema Andelu. 17Gyisɛse zele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛrɛla bɛmaa yɛhɔ na mebahilehile bɛ meamaa bɛahye menli kɛ bɛkye fɛlɛ la.” 18Na bɛgyakyile bɛ asawu ne mɔ ɛkɛ ne na bɛ nee ye hɔle.
19Ɔhɔle ɔ nyunlu ekyii la, ɔnwunle mediema nwiɔ bieko, Gyemise nee Dwɔn, nrenya Zɛbɛdi amra ne mɔ kɛ bɛwɔ ɛlɛne nu bɛlɛsa bɛ avonle. 20Gyisɛse vɛlɛle bɛ, na bɛgyakyile bɛ ze Zɛbɛdi nee ye ɛkpama ne mɔ wɔ ɛlɛne ne anu na bɛdoale ye.
Nrenya bie mɔɔ sunsum ɛtane wɔ ɔ nwo la
(Luk 4.31-37)
21Gyisɛse nee ye ɛdoavolɛma ne dwule Kapɛnayɛm sua zo la, bɛhɔle nyianu sua ne anu wɔ Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ne, na Gyisɛse bɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɔkilehile. 22 Ye ngilehilelɛ ne zinle menli mɔɔ diele ye la anwo, ɔboalekɛ ɔngilehile kɛ mɛla kilehilevolɛma ne mɔ la. Ɔkilehile kɛ sonla mɔɔ lɛ tumi la.
23Mekɛ ne anu ala, nrenya bie mɔɔ sunsum ɛtane wɔ ɔ nwo la vindele nyianu sua ne anu na ɔdeanle nu ɔzele kɛ, 24“Gyisɛse mɔɔ vi Nazalɛte, kɛ yɛze wɔ ɛ? Wɔra kɛ ɛbazɛkye yɛ ɔ? Meze wɔ sonlazule: Wɔmɔ a ɛle Nyamenle Sonla ne mɔɔ anwo te la!”
25Gyisɛse deanle sunsum ɛtane ne nu zele kɛ, “Yɛ koonwu na ɛvi ɔ nwo tu!”
26Sunsum ɛtane ne kpusule nrenya ne kpole kpalɛ, na ɔdeanle nu kpole ko, na ɔvi ɔ nwo ɔdule. 27Ɛhye yɛle menli ne amuala azibɛnwo kpole na bɛbizale bɛ nwo ngoko kɛ, “Duzu edwɛkɛ ɛ? Ngilehilelɛ fofolɛ boni ɛ? Nrenya ye lɛ tumi mɔɔ ɔtendɛ ɔkile sunsum ɛtane ne mɔ bɔbɔ a, bɛtie ye!”
28Na Gyisɛse nganeɛ dendenle hɔle Galeli maanzinli ne anu amuala.
Gyisɛse yɛ menli dɔɔnwo ayile
(Mat 8.14-17; Luk 4.38-41)
29Gyisɛse nee ye ɛdoavolɛma ne yɛɛ Gyemise nee Dwɔn vile nyianu sua ne anu na bɛhɔle Saemɔn nee Andelu sua nu. 30Bɛhɔle la ɛnee ɛyɛlɛyɛlɛ gyi Saemɔn aye ne ɔ nli ne anwo, na ɔla ɛkpa zo. Gyisɛse dwule ɛkɛ ne ala la, bɛbɔle ye amaneɛ 31na ɔhɔle ɔ nwo ɛkɛ. Ɔzɔle raalɛ ne asa ɔboale ye ɔmanle ɔkpogyale ɔ nwo zo ɔdɛnlanle aze. Na ɛkɛ ne ala ye ɛyɛlɛyɛlɛ ne dule, na ɔdwazole ɔkpondɛle debie ɔmanle bɛ.
32Ɔdwule nɔsolɛ nu mɔɔ ɛnee sɛnzɛne ne ɛdɔ la, menli vale bɛ wuleravolɛma nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ mbɔnsam wɔ bɛ nwo la rɛlɛle Gyisɛse. 33Sua ne azo amra amuala rayile anuhɔlɛ ne. 34Na Gyisɛse yɛle menli ne mɔ ewule ngakyile ne mɔ ayile na ɔdule mbɔnsam dɔɔnwo. Yeammaa adenle yeammaa mbɔnsam ne mɔ andendɛ, ɔluakɛ bɛze ye sonlazule.
Gyisɛse bɔ Edwɛkpa ne nolo wɔ Galeli
(Luk 4.42-44)
35Aleɛbahye ne ala, Gyisɛse dwazole vile sua ne azo na ɔhɔveale ɛleka bie ɔzɛlɛle. 36Saemɔn nee ɔ gɔnwo mɔ hɔle ye ɛkpondɛlɛ; 37bɛnwunle ye la bɛzele kɛ, “Bɛlɛkpondɛ wɔ kpole.”
38Gyisɛse buale kɛ, “Bɛmaa yɛhɔ namunamu mɔɔ bikye ɛke la azo. Ɔwɔ kɛ mebɔ Edwɛkpa ne nolo wɔ ɛkɛ ne mɔ noko, ɔluakɛ ɛhye mɔ ati a membale a.”
39 Zɔhane ati ɔhɔkpɔsale Galeli maanzinli ne anu amuala ɔbɔle Edwɛkpa ne nolo wɔ nyianu azua ne mɔ anu na ɔdudule mbɔnsam.
Gyisɛse yɛ nrenya bie ayile
(Mat 8.1-4; Luk 5.12-16)
40Kokobɛvolɛ bie rahotole bodole Gyisɛse kɛ, “Saa ɔyɛ wɔ ɛhulolɛ a, ɛkola ɛmaa me nwo sa.”
41Gyisɛse nwunle ye anwunvɔne na ɔvale ɔ sa ɔhanle ye ɔzele kɛ, “Mekulo, ɛ nwo ɛza!”
42Ɛkɛ ne ala nrenya ne kokobɛ ne hɔle na ɔ nwo zale. 43Gyisɛse bɔle ɔ nloa na ɔyele ye ali ndɛndɛ kɛ ɔhɔ, 44 na ɔzele ye kɛ, “Nea, mmabɔ mɔɔ ɛzi la azo ɛkile awie biala. Maa ɔyɛ ndɛ kɔva ɛ nwo kile sɛlɛvolɛ ne na bɔ anwonzalɛ azu ne mɔɔ Mosisi hyehyɛle dole ɛkɛ ne la fa kile kɛ ɛ nwo ɛza.”
45Noko nrenya ne hɔbɔle mɔɔ zile la nolo wɔ ɛleka biala ɔmanle ɔlua zo Gyisɛse ɛnee akee ɛngola ɔ nyunlu ye wɔ bagua nu. Ɔhwenle ɔ nwo ɔvile sua zo, noko menli vi ɛleka ɛleka rale ɔ nwo.

Title: MAK 2
Content:
Gyisɛse yɛ nrenya bie mɔɔ ɛdwidwe la ayile
(Mat 9.1-8; Luk 5.17-26)
1Kenle ekyi guale nu la, Gyisɛse rale Kapɛnayɛm bieko, na menli dele kɛ yera sua nu. 2Yemɔti bɛ dɔɔnwo ne ala rayiale ɛkɛ ne mɔɔ ɛnee bɛnnyia adenle bɔbɔ wɔ anuhɔlɛ ne a. Ɔgua zolɛ ɔlɛka Nyamenle edwɛkɛ ne yeahile bɛ la, 3mrenya nna bie zoale nrenya bie mɔɔ ɛdwidwe la rale. 4Menli ne kɛ si zonle la ati, bɛannyia adenle bɛangɔ Gyisɛse anwo ɛkɛ ne. Zɔhane ati bɛhɔpɛle tokule wɔ sua ne ati zo, ɛleka mɔɔ Gyisɛse de la, na bɛdwulale nrenya ne ɛkpa nu wɔ ɛkɛ. 5Gyisɛse nwunle menli ne mɔ diedi la, ɔzele nrenya ne mɔɔ ɛdwidwe la kɛ, “Me ra, bɛva wɔ ɛtane ne mɔ bɛhyɛ wɔ.”
6Mɛla kilehilevolɛma ne bie mɔ mɔɔ dede ɛkɛ ne la dwenlenle ye bɛ ti anu kɛ, 7“Duzu munzule edwɛkɛ a sonla ye ɛlɛka atia Nyamenle la? Nyamenle ala a fa ɛtane kyɛ a!”
8Ndɛndɛ ne ala Gyisɛse nwunle bɛ ti anu edwɛkɛ, na ɔbizale bɛ kɛ, “Duzu ati a bɛdwenle ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ ɛ? 9Boni a ye ɛhanlɛ ɛnyɛ se kpalɛ a, kɛ ɛka wɔahile nrenya ye mɔɔ ɛdwidwe la kɛ, ‘Bɛva wɔ ɛtane ne mɔ bɛhyɛ wɔ’, anzɛɛ ‘Dwazo, nyenya wɔ ɛkpa ne na kɔ?’ 10Akee memaa bɛanwu kɛ medame Sonla Ra, melɛ tumi wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo kɛ mefa ɛtane mekyɛ.” Na ɔhanle ɔhilele nrenya ne mɔɔ ɛdwidwe la kɛ, 11“Mese, dwazo, nyenya wɔ ɛkpa ne na kɔ sua nu!”
12Menli ne mɔ anye zo ɛkɛ ne ala, nrenya ne mɔɔ ɛdwidwe la dwazole, ɔnyenyanle ye ɛkpa ne na ɔhɔle ndɛndɛ. Ɛhye yɛle menli ne amuala nwanwane kpole na bɛyele Nyamenle ayɛlɛ bɛzele kɛ, “Yɛtɛnwunle debie mɔɔ le zɛhae la bie ɛlɛ.”
Gyisɛse fɛlɛ Livae
(Mat 9.9-13; Luk 5.27-32)
13Gyisɛse ziale hɔle Galeli Tandane ne anloa bieko. Menli dɔɔnwo rale ɔ nwo ɛkɛ ne na ɔhilehilele bɛ. 14Wɔ ye ɛkpɔsalɛ ne anu, ɔnwunle Alefiyɛse ara Livae, adwuledievolɛ ne kɛ ɔde ɛkponle nwo wɔ ye gyima nu. Gyisɛse zele ye kɛ, “Bɛla maa yɛhɔ” Na Livae dwazole doale ye.
15Nzinlii Livae dole Gyisɛse ɛkponle. Adwuledievolɛma nee menli mɔɔ bɛdabɛ noko awie ɛmbu bɛ bie la dɔɔnwo mɔɔ ɛnee doa Gyisɛse la anu bie mɔ nee ɛdoavolɛma ne wɔ ɛkponledolɛ ne abo bie. 16Mɛla kilehilevolɛma ne bie mɔ mɔɔ le Falasiima la nwunle kɛ ɔ nee menli zɛhae mɔ ɛlɛdi debie la, bɛbizale ye ɛdoavolɛma ne kɛ, “Duzu ati a ɔ nee menli zɛhae mɔ to bɛ sa ɛyɛba ko anu ɛ?”
17Gyisɛse dele mɔɔ bɛhanle la na ɔbuale kɛ, “Menli mɔɔ te kpɔkɛ la ɛngyia ninsinli nwo kɛ wuleravolɛma. Meamba kɛ mebavɛlɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkpazi la. Membale menli mɔɔ awie ɛmbu bɛ bie la ɛvɛlɛlɛ.”
Ɛhɔnehyelɛ nwo kpuyia
(Mat 9.14-17; Luk 5.33-39)
18Kenle ko bie ɛnee Dwɔn Sɔnevolɛ ne ɛdoavolɛma nee Falasiima ne mɔ ɛlɛkye ɛhɔne. Na menli bie rale rabizale Gyisɛse kɛ, “Duzu ati a Dwɔn Sɔnevolɛ ne ɛdoavolɛma nee Falasiima ɛdoavolɛma ne mɔ kye ɛhɔne, na wɔmɔ wɔ ɛdoavolɛma ne mɔ ɛngye ɛhɔne ne bie ɛ?”
19Gyisɛse buale bɛ kɛ, “Asoo bɛnwu kɛ atɔfolɛ nrenya ne agɔnwo mɔ mɔɔ ɛra ye atɔfolɛlielɛ ne abo la ɛlɛ bɛ ko mgbane ɛlɛ? Bɛyɛ ye zɔhane a ɔnrɛyɛ boɛ! 20Noko saa mekɛ dwu na bɛbaye atɔfolɛ nrenya ne wɔ bɛ nu a, ɛnee bɔ zo mɔɔ yedwu mɔɔ bɛbua bɛda a.”
21Akee ɔhanle ɔzɔle zolɛ kɛ, “Awie ɛnva ɛdanlɛ fofolɛ mɔɔ bɛtɛkpole ye ɛlɛ la ɛnda ɛdanlɛ dɛba nu. Saa ɔyɛ ye zɔhane na ɔwula ye nzule nu a fofolɛ ne nwenwe na ɔtete dɛba ne, na ɔmaa tokule ne yɛ kpole. 22Zɔhane ala yɛɛ awie ɛnva nwanye ndokuma ɛngua nwoma kodoku dɛba nu a. Saa ɔyɛ ye zɔhane na nwanye ne anu yɛ ɛsesebɛ a, ɔkpuke nwoma ne na nwanye ne nee nwoma ne sɛkye. Nɔhalɛ, bɛfa nwanye ndokuma bɛgua nwoma kodoku fofolɛ nu.”
Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ne anwo kpuyia
(Mat 12.1-8; Luk 6.1-5)
23 Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ko bie ɛnee Gyisɛse lua abɛlɛ ɛya bie anu; ye ɛdoavolɛma ne mɔ mɔɔ nee ye lua la bubule abɛlɛ ne bie. 24Na Falasiima ne zele Gyisɛse kɛ, “Nea, ɔtia yɛ mɛla ne kɛ wɔ ɛdoavolɛma ne mɔ kɛyɛ zɛhae debie wɔ Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ye a!”
25 Gyisɛse buale bɛ kɛ, “Asoo bɛtɛkengale mɔɔ Devidi yɛle wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee ɛhɔne ɛlɛku ye nee menli mɔɔ doa ye, na bɛnlɛ debie biala mɔɔ bɛdi la? 26 Wɔ Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli Abayata mekɛ zo, Devidi hɔle Nyamenle sua ne anu na ɔ nee ye menli ne mɔ lile kpanwo ne mɔɔ bɛva bɛbɔ azu bɛmaa Nyamenle la. Yɛ mɛla ne kile kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ sɛlɛvolɛma angome ala a di zɛhae kpanwo ne a. Noko Devidi lile bie, eza ɔvale bie ɔmanle menli mɔɔ ɔ nee bɛ lua la lile. Asoo bɛtɛtele ɛhye?”
27Gyisɛse hanle zɔle zolɛ kɛ, “Nyamenle hyehyɛle Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ne dole ɛkɛ manle sonla ye ɛkpazilɛ; na tɛ Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ne ati a bɛbɔle sonla a. 28Zɔhane ati medame Sonla Ra, melɛ tumi wɔ Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ne azo noko.”

Title: MAK 3
Content:
Nrenya ne mɔɔ asa ko ɛdwe la
(Mat 12.9-14; Luk 6.6-11)
1Gyisɛse ziale hɔle nyianu sua ne anu bieko. Nrenya bie mɔɔ asa ko ɛdwe la wɔ ɛkɛ ne. 2Menli bie dɛle Gyisɛse nleanle saa ɔkɛyɛ nrenya ne ayile wɔ Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ne a ɛnee bɛahɔdoa ye. 3Gyisɛse zele nrenya ne mɔɔ asa ko ɛdwe la kɛ, “Dwazo bagyinla yɛ nyunlu ɛke.” 4Akee ɔbizale menli ne kɛ, “Duzu yɛɛ yɛ mɛla ne maa nwolɛ adenle kɛ yɛyɛ wɔ Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ne a? Ɔmaa adenle kɛ yɛyɛ nyele anzɛɛ yɛli ɛtane? Yɛlie sonla ngoane anzɛɛ yɛzɛkye ye?”
Na bɛambuke bɛ nloa. 5Gyisɛse vale ɛya na ɔnleanle bɛ nyunlu ɔyiale, noko eza ɔlile bɛ nwo nyane, ɔluakɛ bɛle menli mɔɔ ɛzua anyetele na bɛ ti yɛ se a. Yemɔti ɔzele nrenya ne kɛ, “Tenrɛ ɛ sa ne anu.” Nrenya ne denrɛle ɔ sa ne mɔɔ ɛdwe la anu, na ɔyɛle kpalɛ bieko. 6Zɔhane ati Falasiima ne vile nyianu sua ne anu vindele, na ndɛndɛ ne ala bɛ nee Belemgbunli Hɛlɔdo eku ne anu amra ne mɔ hɔvale adwenle kɛ bɛku ye.
Menli dɔɔnwo ne mɔɔ yiale tandane ne anloa la
7Gyisɛse nee ye ɛdoavolɛma ne hwenle bɛ nwo hɔle Galeli Tandane ne anloa, na menli dɔɔnwo kpalɛ doale ye. Bɛvi Galeli nee Dwudiya, 8Gyɛlusalɛm nee azua mɔɔ wɔ Ayedumia maanzinli nu nee Dwɔdan sunvoa mɔɔ di kɔ aduduleɛ la, nee ɛleka ɛleka mɔɔ bikye azuamgbole Taya nee Saedɛn la. Menli dɔɔnwo ɛhye rale Gyisɛse ɛkɛ, ɔluakɛ bɛde ninyɛne mɔɔ ɔlɛyɛ la nganeɛ. 9 Menli mɔɔ hɔle la zonle bo zo; yemɔti Gyisɛse zele ye ɛdoavolɛma ne mɔ kɛ bɛkpondɛ ɛlɛne bɛmaa ye, amaa menli ne anfofo ɔ nwo zo. 10Ɛnee yeyɛ menli dɔɔnwo ne ala ayile, zɔhane ati bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnde kpɔkɛ la pelele kɛ bɛkɛbikye ye na bɛkɛva bɛ sa bɛkɛha ye bɔbɔ. 11Sunsum ɛtane ne mɔ nwu Gyisɛse a, bɛtu bɛgua ɔ nyunlu na bɛtea nu kɛ, “Wɔmɔ a ɛle Nyamenle Ara ne a!”
12Gyisɛse duale bɛ kpunli kɛ bɛmmaka zɔhane edwɛkɛ ne bɛkile ye sonlazule.
Gyisɛse kpa nu aye ɛzoanvolɛma bulu nee nwiɔ
(Mat 10.1-4; Luk 6.12-16)
13Akee Gyisɛse hɔle boka bie azo na ɔvɛlɛle menli mɔɔ ɔkpondɛ bɛ la. Bɛrale la 14ɔkpale nu ɔyele bɛ nuhua bulu nee nwiɔ na ɔvɛlɛle bɛ ye ɛzoanvolɛma na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Mekpa nu meye bɛ kɛ bɛ nee me ɛdɛnla. Mebazoa bɛ meamaa bɛahɔbɔ Edwɛkpa ne nolo, 15na mebamaa bɛ tumi meamaa bɛahola bɛadu mbɔnsam.”
16Menli bulu nee nwiɔ ne mɔɔ Gyisɛse vɛlɛle bɛ la a le ɛhye mɔ: Saemɔn mɔɔ Gyisɛse manle ye duma bieko kɛ bɛfɛlɛ ye Pita la, 17Gyemise nee ɔ diema Dwɔn, mɔɔ le Zɛbɛdi amra ne mɔ mɔɔ Gyisɛse vɛlɛle bɛ “Bowanɛgyize” la, (Bowanɛgyize abo a le Ɛsɛnlɛmanye Mralɛ.) 18Andelu, Felepe, Baatɔlomiyu, Mateyu, Tɔmase, Alefiyɛse ara Gyemise, Tadease, Saemɔn mɔɔ le Maanle Kulovolɛ ne, 19yɛɛ Dwudase Yesekaleɔto mɔɔ yele Gyisɛse manle la.
Gyisɛse nee Biyɛlezɛbɛle
(Mat 12.22-32; Luk 11.14-23; 12.10)
20Akee Gyisɛse hɔle sua nu na menli dɔɔnwo rayiale ye ɛkɛ ne bieko mɔɔ ɛnee akee ɔ nee ye ɛdoavolɛma ne mɔ bɛnnyia adenle bɛnli debie bɔbɔ a. 21Ɔ nli nee ɔ mediema ne mɔ dele la, bɛrale kɛ bɛbava ye bɛahɔ, ɔluakɛ menli ɛlɛkeha kɛ, “Yezɛ!”
22 Mɛla kilehilevolɛma bie mɔɔ vi Gyɛlusalɛm rale la hanle kɛ, “Mbɔnsam kpanyinli ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Biyɛlezɛbɛle la wɔ ɔ nwo, na yemɔ yɛɛ ɔmaa ye tumi mɔɔ ɔfa ɔtu mbɔnsam a.”
23Ɛhye ati Gyisɛse vɛlɛle menli ne mɔ, na ɔbule bɛ mrɛlɛ ɛhye mɔ kɛ, “Asoo Seetan kola tu Seetan? 24Saa maanle ko anu amra kyɛ bɛ nwo nu na bɛko bɛtia bɛ nwo a, maanle ne ɛngyinla, 25yɛɛ saa awuke ko anu amra kyɛ bɛ nwo nu na bɛko bɛtia bɛ nwo a, awuke ne ɛngyinla. 26Yemɔti saa Seetan ɛdwazo ɔ ngome ɔ nwo zo na ye nuhua ɛhyɛ nwiɔ a, ɛnee ɔnrɛhola gyinla, na ye awieleɛ ɛbikye.
27“Awie biala ɛngola ɛmbu katakyie sua, ɔnwua ye, kyesɛ ɔdumua ɔkyekye katakyie ne kolaa na yeahola yeasesa ye sua ne anu ninyɛne.
28“Bɛhakye ɛhye! Ɛtane biala ɛnle ɛkɛ mɔɔ sonla kɛyɛ anzɛɛ munzule edwɛkɛ biala ɛnle ɛkɛ mɔɔ sonla kɛha, mɔɔ bɛnrɛva bɛnrɛhyɛ ye a. 29 Noko awie biala mɔɔ kɛdendɛ ɛtane kɛtia Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne la ɛnrɛnyia fakyɛ ɛlɛ, ɔluakɛ yeyɛ ɛtane mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ.” 30(Gyisɛse hanle ɛhye, ɔluakɛ bie mɔ hanle kɛ, “Sunsum ɛtane wɔ ɔ nwo.”)
Gyisɛse ɔ nli nee ɔ mediema
(Mat 12.46-50; Luk 8.19-21)
31Gyisɛse ɔ nli nee ɔ mediema ne mɔ rale ragyinlanle sua ne anzi na bɛzoanle kɛ bɛvɛlɛ ye bɛmaa bɛ. 32Ɛnee menli dɔɔnwo dede ɔ nwo ɛkɛ ne, na bɛzele ye kɛ, “Yɛmenle, ɛ nli nee ɛ mediema mraalɛ nee mrenya ne mɔ gyi sua ye anzi lɔ, bɛse bɛkpondɛ wɔ.”
33Gyisɛse buale bɛ kɛ, “Me nli a le nwane? Me mediema a le nwane mɔ?” 34Na ɔnleanle bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdede ɔ nwo ɛkɛ ne la ɔyiale na ɔhanle kɛ, “Me nli nee me mediema a le bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛyia ɛke la. 35Me diema nrenya nee me diema raalɛ nee me nli a le awie biala mɔɔ yɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle kpondɛ la.”

Title: MAK 4
Content:
Ma ɛlualɛ nwo ɛrɛlɛ
(Mat 13.1-9; Luk 8.4-8)
1 Gyisɛse eza bɔle ɔ bo bieko hilehilele wɔ Galeli Tandane ne anloa. Menli dɔɔnwo rayiale ɔ nwo ɛkɛ. Bɛzonle somaa la ati ɔhɔdɛnlanle ɛlɛne nu wɔ azule ne anye, yɛɛ menli ne noko dede azule ne anloa. 2Ɔvale mrɛlɛbulɛ ɔhilehilele bɛ ninyɛne dɔɔnwo, na ye ngilehilelɛ ne anu ɔzele bɛ kɛ:
3“Bɛdie! Nrenya bie hɔle kɛ ɔkagua ma. 4Ɔgua la, ma ne bie guale adenle nu, na nloma rasusole. 5Bie guale awolɛ nu, ɛleka mɔɔ anwea anzo la, na ndɛndɛ ne ala bɛfifile, ɔluakɛ azɛlɛ ne ɛmpi; 6na mɔɔ ewia ne vile hanle bɛ la, bɛyelale, ɔluakɛ bɛ ndinli ne andwu azɛlɛ bo. 7Bie mɔ guale mbowule nu, na mbowule ne nyinle hedale bɛ nwo zo, yemɔti bɛanzo ma. 8Akee ma ne bie noko guale azɛlɛ kpalɛ zo, na bɛfifile, bɛnyinle, na bɛzole ma: bie mɔnwo abulasa, bie mɔnwo abulasia, yɛɛ bie mɔnwo ɛya.”
9Gyisɛse hanle zɔle zolɛ kɛ, “Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛ ɛnzonlɛ la, bɛdie!”
Deɛ mɔɔ yemɔti Gyisɛse bu mrɛlɛ la
(Mat 13.10-17; Luk 8.9-10)
10Akee mɔɔ ɔhale Gyisɛse angome la, menli mɔɔ li ɔ nzi la bie mɔ mɔɔ dele ye edwɛkɛ ne la nee ye ɛdoavolɛma bulu nee nwiɔ ne rabizale ye ɛrɛlɛ ne abo. 11Ɔbuale bɛ kɛ, “Bɛmɛ, Nyamenle ɛla ye belemgbunlililɛ ne anwo edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ vea la ali wienyi ɛhile bɛ, na bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛmbikye me la, bɛte ye wɔ mrɛlɛ nu, 12 amaa
‘Bɛnea, bɛnea a, bɛannwu ye,
bɛtie, bɛtie a, bɛande ɔ bo.
Anrɛɛ bɛkɛzia bɛkɛra Nyamenle ɛkɛ,
na ɔkɛva bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ ɔkɛhyɛ bɛ.’ ”
Gyisɛse kile ma ɛlualɛ nwo ɛrɛlɛ ne abo
(Mat 13.18-23; Luk 8.11-15)
13Akee Gyisɛse bizale bɛ kɛ, “Bɛnde ɛrɛlɛ ɛhye abo ɔ? Ɛnee kɛ ɔkɛyɛ na bɛade ɛrɛlɛ biala abo ɛ? 14Nrenya ne gua Nyamenle edwɛkɛ ne. 15Menli ne bie mɔ le kɛ ma ne mɔɔ gua adenle nu la; menli ɛhye mɔ te edwɛkɛ ne a, ndɛndɛ ne ala Seetan baye fi bɛ adwenle nu. 16Zɔhane ala yɛɛ menli ne bie mɔ le kɛ ma ne mɔɔ gua awolɛ nu la a. Menli ɛhye mɔ te edwɛkɛ ne a, ndɛndɛ ne ala bɛfa fɛlɛko bɛdie bɛto nu. 17Na kɛmɔ edwɛkɛ ne ɛnnyia debie mɔɔ le kɛ ndinli wɔ bɛ nu la ati, bɛngyinla bɛngyɛ. Saa anwongyelelɛ ba anzɛɛ edwɛkɛ ne ati aleɛabo amra yɛ bɛ kpɔdekpɔde a, ɛnee bɛkpo aze. 18Menli ne bie mɔ le kɛ ma ne mɔɔ gua mbowule nu la, menli ɛhye mɔ te edwɛkɛ ne, 19na ɛbɛlabɔlɛ ye anwo adwenleadwenle, anyiabɛnwo ɛhulolɛ, nee ninyɛne mgbane mgbane nwo atiakunluwɔzo fo keda edwɛkɛ ne azo, ɛhye ati bɛnzo ma. 20Akee menli ne bie mɔ noko le kɛ ma ne mɔɔ gua azɛlɛ kpalɛ zo la. Menli ɛhye mɔ te edwɛkɛ ne, bɛdie bɛto nu, na bɛso ma: bie mɔnwo abulasa, bie mɔnwo abulasia, yɛɛ bie mɔnwo ɛya.”
Bɛnzɔ kɛnlaneɛ bɛnzie bondo bo
(Luk 8.16-18)
21 Gyisɛse bizale bɛ kɛ, “Nwane a sɔ kɛnlaneɛ na ɔfa bondo ɔbutu zolɛ anzɛɛ ɔfa ɔsie mgba bo na ɔnva ɔnzie debie zo anwuma a? 22 Debie biala mɔɔ vea la bala ali wienyi, yɛɛ mɔɔ bɛheda zolɛ la anwo bala zo. 23Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛ ɛnzonlɛ la, bɛdie!”
24 Eza ɔzele bɛ kɛ. “Bɛdie ye boɛ! Mɔɔ ɛsuzu ɛmaa awie mɔ la yɛɛ Nyamenle banlea zolɛ azuzu amaa wɔ a, na wɔmɔ bɔbɔ ɛbanyia ye molozo. 25 Ɔluakɛ mɔɔ lɛ bie la bɛbamaa ye bie yeaboka nwo, yɛɛ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ bie la, ekyi ne bɔbɔ mɔɔ ɔlɛ la, bɛbalie bɛavi ɔ sa nu.”
Gyisɛse bu ma ɛfifilɛ nwo ɛrɛlɛ
26Gyisɛse hɔle zolɛ zele bɛ kɛ, “Nyamenle belemgbunlililɛ ne le kɛ nrenya bie mɔɔ gua ma wɔ ye ɛya nu la. 27Aledwolɛ nu ɛnee yela. Aleɛ kye noko a ɔdwazo ɔduolua, na ɛnee ye ma ne mɔ mɔɔ yegua la ɛlɛfifi na bɛlɛnyi, noko ɔnze kɛ bɛyɛ bɛnyi a. 28Azɛlɛ ne maa mbaka ne nyi na bɛso ma. Saa awule a, ɔbalumua yeawɔlɔ, yeanrenzɛ na nzinlii yeatulu mralɛ. 29 Awule ne bolo a nrenya ne kɔte, ɔluakɛ ɛnee ɛbuhenle ne ɛdwu.”
Ma ekyi ne anwo ɛrɛlɛ
(Mat 13.31-32,34; Luk 13.18-19)
30Akee Gyisɛse bizale bɛ kɛ, “Duzu a yɛva yɛdo Nyamenle Belemgbunlililɛ ne anwo a? Duzu ɛrɛlɛ a yɛva yɛhile nu a? 31Ɔle kɛ baka ma nretee bie. Mekɛ mɔɔ bɛdua la ɛnee ɔle ma muala anu nretee kpalɛ kpalɛ, 32noko nzinlii ɔfifi, ɔnyi, na ɔyɛ baka kpole ɔtɛla mbaka muala, ɔkpakye ngane mgbole na nloma bayɛ bɛ sane wɔ zolɛ.”
33Gyisɛse vale mrɛlɛ mɔɔ le kɛ ɛhye mɔ la dɔɔnwo mɔɔ menli ne adwenle so nu la bɔle edwɛkɛ ne nolo hilele bɛ. 34Mrɛlɛ nu ngome a ɔdendɛle ɔhilele bɛ a, na saa ɔka ɔdaye nee ye ɛdoavolɛma ne mɔ angome a akee yeahilehile bɛ mrɛlɛ ne mɔ abo.
Gyisɛse maa ahumu agua
(Mat 8.23-27; Luk 8.22-25)
35Kenle ko ne nɔsolɛ nu, Gyisɛse zele ye ɛdoavolɛma ne mɔ kɛ, “Bɛmaa yɛpɛ yɛhɔ tandane ne anzi lɔ.” 36Yemɔti bɛgyakyile menli dɔɔnwo ne ɛkɛ ne na bɛvole ɛlɛne ne mɔɔ Gyisɛse dɛnlanle nu la anu kɛ bɛkɔ. Nlɛne gyɛne noko bokale bɛ nwo. 37Yeangyɛ biala yɛɛ ahumu kpole bie dwazole a, azɛlɛkye bule guale ɛlɛne ne anu, mɔɔ ɛnee ɔkpondɛ yeazia a. 38Mekɛ ne anu ɛnee Gyisɛse la ɛlɛne ne abo lɔ, ɔ ti zɔ esumi na yelafe. Ye ɛdoavolɛma ne hɔdunwuele ye zele kɛ, “Kilehilevolɛ, ɔnvane ɛ nwo kɛ yɛwie wu ɔ?”
39Gyisɛse dwazole na ɔdeanle ahumu ne nu na ɔzele azɛlɛkye ne mɔ kɛ, “Bɛgua diinyi!” Ɛkɛ ne ala ahumu ne gyakyile ɛdulɛ na maanle nu gyinlanle diinyi. 40Na Gyisɛse bizale ye ɛdoavolɛma ne mɔ kɛ, “Duzu ati a bɛ ahonle ɛdu zɛhae ɛ? Ɛnɛ nee ɛnɛ ala bɛnlɛ diedi ɔ?”
41Na ɛzulolɛ kpole hanle bɛ manle bɛbizale bɛ nwo ngoko kɛ, “Duzu sonla bɔbɔ a le ɛhye, mɔɔ anwoma nee nyevile tie ye a?”

Title: MAK 5
Content:
Gyisɛse tu nrenya bie anwo mbɔnsam
(Mat 8.28-34; Luk 8.26-39)
1Gyisɛse nee ye ɛdoavolɛma ne dwule aze wɔ Galeli Tandane ne anzi wɔ Gɛlasa maanle nu. 2Gyisɛse vi ɛlɛne ne anu dwule la, nrenya bie mɔɔ sunsum ɛtane wɔ ɔ nwo la vi azie ne azo rayiale ye. 3Nrenya ɛhye ɛva azie ne azo ɛyɛ ye sua nu; awie biala ɛngola ɛngua ye nwɔnzɔnwɔnzɔ. 4Mekɛ dɔɔnwo ne ala menli ɛzɔ ye ɛbɔ ye kpanwu, noko yedu kpanwu ne na yetete nwɔnzɔnwɔnzɔ ne mɔɔ gua ɔ sa nee ɔ gyakɛ la amuala; awie biala ɛngola ye sɔ. 5Alehyenlɛ nee aledwolɛ muala ɛnee ɔluolua azie ne nee awoka ne mɔ azo ɔteɛdea nuhua na ɔfa awolɛ ɔpepɛ ɔ nwo.
6Ɔnwunle Gyisɛse kɛ ɔlua moa moa lɔ ɔlɛba la, ɔnriandile ɔrahotole ɔ nyunlu ɛkɛ ne 7na ɔhanle ye kpole kɛ, “Anwuma Anwuma Nyamenle Ara Gyisɛse, ɛ nee me lɛ bie ɔ? Mefa Nyamenle mekpa wɔ kyɛlɛ, mmatea me!” 8(Ɔhanle ɛhye, ɔluakɛ ɛnee Gyisɛse ɛlɛka kɛ, “Sunsum ɛtane, ɛvi nrenya ye anwo tu!”)
9Gyisɛse bizale ye kɛ, “Kɛ bɛfɛlɛ wɔ ɛ?”
Nrenya ne buale ye kɛ, “Bɛfɛlɛ me ɛlɔne, ɔluakɛ yɛ nwo zonle.” 10Na ɔbodole Gyisɛse kɛ ɔmmatu bɛ ɔfi maanle ne anu.
11Mekɛ ne anu ɛnee agbolike dɔɔnwo bie ɛlɛdidi boka bie anye anwo wɔ ɛkɛ ne afoa nu. 12Sunsum ɛtane ne mɔ bodole Gyisɛse kɛ, “Maa yɛ adenle maa yɛhɔwolo agbolike ne mɔ nu.” 13Gyisɛse manle bɛ adenle. Sunsum ɛtane ne mɔ vile nrenya ne anwo, na bɛhɔwolole agbolike ne mɔ. Agbolike ne mɔ mɔɔ bo apenle nwiɔ la dule twi pianle bɛ nwo wɔ boka ne anye anwo na bɛhɔguale tandane ne anu bɛwule.
14Menli mɔɔ ɛlɛnea agbolike ne mɔ la nriandile hɔbɔle suakpole ne nee namunamu ne mɔ azo amra amaneɛ. Menli rale kɛ bɛbanlea mɔɔ ɛzi la. 15Bɛradwule la, ɛnee nrenya bɔnavolɛ ne mɔɔ anrɛɛ mbɔnsam dɔɔnwo wɔ ɔ nwo la anye zo ɛtete ye, na ɔheda ɛdanlɛ ɔde Gyisɛse anwo ɛkɛ. Ɛhye yɛle bɛ ɛzulolɛ kpole. 16Menli mɔɔ nwunle mɔɔ zile la hanle kɛ ɔyɛle mɔɔ nrenya ne anye zo zile tetele ye nee mɔɔ zile agbolike ne mɔ anwo zo la amuala hilele bɛ.
17Ɛhye ati bɛzele Gyisɛse kɛ ɔvi bɛ maanle ne anu ɔhɔ.
18Gyisɛse kɔ ahɔvo ɛlɛne nu la, nrenya ne mɔɔ anrɛɛ mbɔnsam ne mɔ wɔ ɔ nwo la razɛlɛle ye kɛ, “Maa me nee wɔ ɛlua!” 19Na Gyisɛse amkponle zo. Ɔzele ye kɛ, “Sia kɔ sua nu na kɔha debie mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛyɛ ɛmaa wɔ nee anwunvɔne mɔɔ yeze wɔ la kile ɛ gɔnwo mɔ.”
20Yemɔti nrenya ne ziale hɔle na ɔbɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɔbɔ mɔɔ Gyisɛse ɛyɛ ɛmaa ye la nolo wɔ Azuamgbole Bulu ne mɔ azo. Na ɔyɛle bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdele la amuala azibɛnwo.
Gyeeyaelɛse ara raalɛ ne nee raalɛ ne mɔɔ vale ɔ sa hanle Gyisɛse tɛladeɛ ne la
(Mat 9.18-26; Luk 8.40-56)
21Gyisɛse ziale pɛle rale azule nzi nehae bieko, na menli dɔɔnwo rayiale ye wɔ ɛnwea ne anloa. 22Gyeeyaelɛse mɔɔ le sua ne azo nyianu sua ne mgbanyima ne mɔ ko la radule dɔle ɔ gyakɛ anu 23na ɔbodole ye kɛ, “Me ra raalɛ ekyi ne ɛlɛdie ewule awu. Mebodo wɔ, bɛla bava ɛ sa to ɔ nwo zo maa ɔde kpɔkɛ na ɔnyia ngoane.”
24Na Gyisɛse nee ye hɔle. Menli dɔɔnwo kpalɛ doale ye na bɛhyelele ɔ nwo zo.
25Raalɛ bie wɔ ɛkɛ, yedudu mogya toonwo ɛvolɛ bulu nee nwiɔ, 26na yenwu amaneɛ dɔɔnwo wɔ ninsinlima asa anu. Ɔ nwo ezukoa muala ɛwie, noko ɔnde kpɔkɛ; ye ewule ne, ɔ nyunlu ala a ɔkɔ a. 27Ɛnee yede Gyisɛse nganeɛ, yemɔti ɔralile ɔ nzi wɔ menli ne anu, 28na ɔhanle ye ɔ ti anu kɛ, “Saa mefa me sa meka ye tɛladeɛ ne bɔbɔ a, me nwo kɛza.”
Ɛhye ati ɔvale ɔ sa ɔhanle Gyisɛse tɛladeɛ ne, 29na ɛkɛ ne ala mogya ne mɔɔ ɛlɛtu ye la pɛle, na ɔdele ye wɔ ye nu kɛ yede kpɔkɛ. 30Ɛkɛ ne ala Gyisɛse dele ye wɔ ye nu kɛ tumi vi ye nuhua ɛhɔ. Ɔhakyile ɔ nwo na ɔbizale kɛ, “Nwane a vale ɔ sa hanle me tɛladeɛ ne a?”
31Ye ɛdoavolɛma ne mɔ buale ye kɛ, “Nea kɛ menli ɛhyele ɛ nwo zo bie a; duzu ati a ɛlɛbiza kɛ, ‘Nwane a vale ɔ sa hanle me a?’ ”
32Na Gyisɛse vale ɔ nye kpɔlale nu kɛ ɔnea ahenle mɔɔ vale ɔ sa hanle ye la. 33Raalɛ ne nwunle mɔɔ ɛzi ye nu la, ɔvale ɛzulolɛ nee anwowozolɛ ɔrahotole Gyisɛse agyakɛ anu, na ɔhanle ye edwɛkɛ nɔhalɛ nu ɔhilele ye. 34Gyisɛse zele ye kɛ, “Me ra raalɛ, wɔ diedi ɛlie wɔ ngoane. Fa anzonudwolɛ kɔ na wɔ ewule ne ɛhɔ bɔkɔɔ.”
35Gyisɛse anloa wɔ zo ɔlɛtendɛ la, ɛbɔfoɔ vi Gyeeyaelɛse sua nu razele ye kɛ, “Ɛ ra raalɛ ne ati ɛbɔ aze na mmagyegye kilehilevolɛ ne bieko.”
36Gyisɛse dele mɔɔ bɛhanle la, noko ɔzile nyianu sua ne kpanyinli ne ahonle na ɔzele ye kɛ, “Mmasulo, wɔmɔ die di ala.” 37Yeammaa adenle yeammaa awie biala nee ye angɔ kɛ Pita nee Gyemise nee ɔ diema Dwɔn ala. 38Bɛdwule Gyeeyaelɛse awuke ne anu la, Gyisɛse nwunle menli dɔɔnwo wɔ ɛkɛ ne na bɛlɛsu bɛye awolɛ. 39Ɔhɔle sua ne anu na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Na ɛzunlɛ bebelebe ye ɛ? Kakula ne ɛtɛwule; ɔlɛdafe ala!”
40Menli ne mɔ zelele ye. Yemɔti ɔdule bɛ muala ɔvile sua ne anu na ɔvale kakula raalɛ ne ɔ ze nee ɔ nli yɛɛ ye ɛdoavolɛma nsa ne na ɔ nee bɛ hɔle ɛleka mɔɔ bɛdeda kakula ne la. 41Ɔzɔle kakula raalɛ ne asa na ɔzele ye kɛ, “Talita, Kumi!” Ɔ bo a le “Kakula raalɛ, mese, dwazo!”
42Ɛkɛ ne ala ɔdwazole na ɔkpɔsale sua ne anu. (Ɛnee yeli ɛvolɛ bulu nee nwiɔ.) Ɛhye yɛle menli ne nwanwane kpole. 43Na Gyisɛse bɔle bɛ nloa kɛ bɛmmaka bɛkile awie biala, na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛmaa ye debie ɔli.”

Title: MAK 6
Content:
Nazalɛtema kpole Gyisɛse
(Mat 13.53-58; Luk 4.16-30)
1Gyisɛse vi ɛkɛ ne la ɔ nee ye ɛdoavolɛma ne ziale rale ye sua zo. 2Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ne dwule la, ɔbɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɔyɛ ngilehilelɛ wɔ nyianu sua ne anu. Ɛnee menli dɔɔnwo kpalɛ wɔ ɛkɛ; bɛdiele ye bɛwiele la, ɔzinle bɛ nwo na bɛbizale kɛ, “Nienwu a nrenya ye nee ɛhye vi a? Ɔzukoale ye nrɛlɛbɛ ɛhye wɔ nienwu? Adenle boni anu a ɔfa ɔyɛ ye nwanwane ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ a? 3Na tɛ Mɛle ara kapenta ye ɛ? Tɛ ɔ mediema mrenya a le Gyemise, Dwosefi, Dwudase, yɛɛ Saemɔn? Tɛ ɔ mediema mraalɛ noko a yɛ nee bɛ gua sua ye azo la ɔ?” Na bɛkpole ye.
4 Gyisɛse zele bɛ kɛ, “Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ biala lɛ ɔ nyunlu wɔ ɛleka biala, kyesɛ ɔdaye ye sua zo, ye mbusua nu anzɛɛ ye sua nu ala.”
5Yeangola yeanyɛ nwanwane debie wɔ ɛkɛ ne kɛ ɔ sa mɔɔ ɔvale ɔguale wuleravolɛma ekyi bie anwo zo ɔyɛle bɛ ayile la ala. 6Na ɔyɛle ye azibɛnwo kpole kɛ menli ne ɛnlɛ diedi a.
Gyisɛse soa ɛdoavolɛma bulu nee nwiɔ ne
(Mat 10.5-15; Luk 9.1-6)
Akee Gyisɛse hɔkpɔsale namunamu ne mɔ mɔɔ zuozua ɛkɛ ne la azo hilehilele menli ne. 7Ɔvɛlɛle Bulu nee Nwiɔ ne na ɔzoanle bɛ nwiɔ nwiɔ, na ɔmanle bɛ tumi wɔ sunsum ɛtane nwo zo, 8 na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛmmafa debie biala bɛtu adenle ne kɛ kpɔma ala; bɛmmafa aleɛ anzɛɛ kodoku, yɛɛ bɛmmafa ezukoa bɛbɔ bɛ nwo. 9Bɛwula mgbɔlaboa, noko bɛmmafa tɛladeɛ bieko bɛboka mɔɔ bɛwula la anwo.” 10Eza ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Awuke biala mɔɔ bɛkɛlie bɛ nu la, bɛdɛnla ɛkɛ ne ala bɛmaa ɔhɔkpula kenle mɔɔ bɛkɛvi sua ne azo la. 11 Saa bɛkɔ sua bie azo noko na menli ne anlie bɛ anzɛɛ ɛnrɛdie bɛ a, bɛvi ɛkɛ ne bɛhɔ na bɛkpɔlɔkpɔla bɛ gyakɛ anwo munlutu bɛgua, bɛva bɛhile kɛ menli ne di ɛzonle.”
12Yemɔti bɛzile nu bɛhɔle na bɛbɔle nolo kɛ menli ɛnlu bɛ nwo. 13 Bɛdule mbɔnsam dɔɔnwo, na bɛvale nwole bɛkpokpale wuleravolɛma dɔɔnwo bɛyɛle bɛ ayile.
Dwɔn Sɔnevolɛ ne ewule
(Mat 14.1-12; Luk 9.7-9)
14 Belemgbunli Hɛlɔdo dele ɛhye mɔ anwo bie, ɔluakɛ Gyisɛse nganeɛ ɛdwu ɛleka biala, na menli ɛlɛkeha kɛ, “Dwɔn Sɔnevolɛ ne ɛzia ɛra ngoane nu bieko, yemɔti a ɔkola ɔyɛ nwanwane ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ a.”
15Bie mɔ se, “Yilaegya ɔ.”
Bie mɔ noko hanle kɛ, “Ɔle Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ, kɛ mɔmoane Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma ne mɔ anu ko la.”
16Mɔɔ Hɛlɔdo dele ɛhye la ɔhanle kɛ, “Dwɔn Sɔnevolɛ ne mɔɔ memanle bɛpɛle ɔ ti la a ɛzia ɛra ngoane nu bieko la.” 17 Hɛlɔdo manle bɛhyele Dwɔn bɛguale ye nwɔnzɔnwɔnzɔ na bɛdole ye efiade wɔ ɔ diema Felepe aye Hɛlɔdease mɔɔ ɔdaye Hɛlɔdo ɔgyale ye la ati, 18ɔluakɛ Dwɔn vale zile Hɛlɔdo anyunlu dahuu kɛ, “Ɔnle amaamuo kpalɛ kɛ ɛkɛgya ɛ diema ne aye ne.”
19Ɛhye ati Dwɔn anwo yɛle Hɛlɔdease ɛya kpole na ɔbɔle kpɔkɛ kɛ ɔnyia ye a ɔkɛhu ye, noko Hɛlɔdo ammaa ye adenle. 20Hɛlɔdo zulole, ɔboalekɛ Dwɔn le sonla mɔɔ ye ɛbɛla tenrɛ na ɔ nwo te a, yemɔti ɔvale ye ɔziele kpalɛ. Ɔhulole kɛ ɔkɛdie Dwɔn anloa edwɛkɛ, noko kenle mɔɔ ɔkɛdie ye la ɛnee ɔ ti akunlu ɛzɛkye bɔkɔɔ.
21Nzinlii Hɛlɔdease asa hanle Dwɔn wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee Hɛlɔdo ɛlɛdi ye awolɛ kenle ɛvoyia la. Hɛlɔdo dole ɛkponle na ɔvɛlɛvɛlɛle arane mbɔlɔba mgbanyinli, ye safohyenlema nee Galeli mgbanyima ne mɔ amuala. 22Wɔ ɛkponledolɛ ne abo, Hɛlɔdease ara raalɛ ne razile agole manle ɔzɔle Hɛlɔdo nee mgbanyima ne mɔ anye. Na belemgbunli ne zele ye kɛ, “Biza me debie biala mɔɔ ɛkulo la na menwɔva menwɔmaa wɔ.” 23Akee ɔhanle ndane kɛ, “Debie biala mɔɔ ɛkulo la, biza, saa me belemgbunli maanle ye foa ko bɔbɔ a, menwɔva menwɔmaa wɔ.”
24Bɛlɛra ne vindele hɔbizale ɔ nli kɛ, “Duzu a membiza a?”
Ɔ nli buale kɛ, “Biza die Dwɔn Sɔnevolɛ ne ati.”
25Na ndɛndɛ ne ala bɛlɛra ne razele belemgbunli ne kɛ, “Mekpondɛ kɛ ɛfa Dwɔn Sɔnevolɛ ne ati ɛto apawa nu ɛmaa me kɛkala.”
26Ɛhye yɛle belemgbunli ne nyane somaa, noko akee yeha ndane, yɛɛ wɔ ye mgbanyima ne mɔ nee ye nyɛvolɛ ne mɔ anyunlu, yeangulo kɛ ɔkɛdo ye ndane ne. 27Ɛhye ati ɔzoanle sinzavolɛ ko ɔmanle ɔhɔle efiade ne ɔhɔpɛle Dwɔn ati, 28ɔvale ɔdole apawa nu ɔrɛlɛle bɛlɛra ne, na ɔvale ɔhɔmanle ɔ nli. 29Dwɔn ɛdoavolɛma ne mɔ dele, bɛhɔliele ye funli ne na bɛhɔziele ye.
Gyisɛse maa menli apenle nnu aleɛ
(Mat 14.13-21; Luk 9.10-17; Dw 6.1-14)
30Ɛzoanvolɛma ne ziale rale na bɛrahanle ninyɛne mɔɔ bɛyɛle nee mɔɔ bɛhilehilele la amuala bɛhilele Gyisɛse. 31Kɛmɔ ɛnee menli dɔɔnwo si kɔ na bɛba Gyisɛse anwo ɛkɛ ne la, ɔ nee ye ɛdoavolɛma ne mɔ annyia adenle bɔbɔ na bɛade aleɛ bɛawula bɛ nloa anu. Yemɔti ɔzele ye ɛdoavolɛma ne mɔ kɛ, “Bɛrɛla bɛmaa yɛhɔvea ɛleka bie koonwu na bɛlie bɛ ɛnwomenle ekyii.” 32Na bɛdabɛ bɛ ngome bɛvale ɛlɛne bɛzile nu kɛ bɛkɔ bɛahɔvea ɛleka bie koonwu.
33Noko menli dɔɔnwo ze bɛ, yemɔti mɔɔ bɛnwunle kɛ bɛlɛkɔ la bɛvale ɛnriandilɛ bɛvi azua ne mɔ azo bɛbule bɛ nyunlu. 34 Gyisɛse vi ɛlɛne ne anu dwule aze la, ɔnwunle menli dɔɔnwo ne na ɔ kunlu yelɛyelale ye kpole, ɔluakɛ bɛle kɛ mboane mɔɔ ɛnlɛ neavolɛ la. Zɔhane ati ɔbɔle ɔ bo ɔhilehilele bɛ ninyɛne dɔɔnwo. 35Mɔɔ aleɛ ne hɔle bie la, ye ɛdoavolɛma ne mɔ razele ye kɛ, “Aleɛ ne anloa ɛbɔ aze, yɛɛ ɛke noko ɛmbikye sua zo. 36Yemɔti maa menli ye adenle maa bɛhɔ azua nee namunamu ne mɔ azo na bɛhɔdɔ debie bɛli.”
37Gyisɛse buale bɛ kɛ, “Bɛdabɛ bɛmaa bɛ debie bɛli.”
Bɛbizale ye kɛ, “Ɛnee yɛhɔdɔ kpanwo etaku nna nna ɛya nwiɔ yɛmaa bɛ ɔ?”
38Gyisɛse zele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛhɔnlea kɛ bɛlɛ kpanwo nyɛ?”
Bɛhɔnleanle na bɛrazele ye kɛ, “Kpanwo nnu yɛɛ fɛlɛ nwiɔ.”
39Gyisɛse zele ye ɛdoavolɛma ne mɔ kɛ bɛmaa menli ne mɔ ɛdɛnlɛdɛnla aze ekpunli ekpunli wɔ ndile ne azo.
40Menli ne mɔ dɛnlɛdɛnlanle aze ekpunli ekpunli, ekpunli ne bie anu amra le ɛya, bie noko le abulanlu. 41Na Gyisɛse vale kpanwo nnu ne nee fɛlɛ nwiɔ ne na ɔnleanle anwomanyunlu, ɔyɛle Nyamenle mo, ɔbubule kpanwo ne ɔmanle ye ɛdoavolɛma ne mɔ kɛ bɛva bɛmaa menli ne mɔ. Eza ɔhyɛle fɛlɛ nwiɔ ne ɔmanle bɛ muala. 42Awie biala nyianle bie lile manle ɔ ko yile tɛkɛɛ. 43Na ɛdoavolɛma ne sesale kpanwo nee fɛlɛ ne abo zo ne ahɛndɛne bulu nee nwiɔ.
44Menli mɔɔ lile kpanwo ne la, saa ɛye mraalɛ nee ngakula ne mɔ nu a bɛlua mrenya apenle nnu.
Gyisɛse tia azule nye
(Mat 14.22-33; Dw 6.15-21)
45Ndɛndɛ ne ala Gyisɛse manle ye ɛdoavolɛma ne vale ɛlɛne ne lumuale ɔ nyunlu wɔ sunvoa lɔ, wɔ Bɛteseeyeda sua zo na ɔyɛle ɛ ɔnea yeagyakyi menli ne adenle. 46Ɔ nee menli ne wiele nrɛlaleɛ di la, akee ɔhɔle boka bie azo kɛ ɔkazɛlɛ.
47Aleɛ ne muanle nwo la, ɛnee ɛlɛne ne la tandane ne buma ne anu lɔ na yeha Gyisɛse angome wɔ ɛnwea ne anloa. 48Ɔnwunle kɛ ye ɛdoavolɛma ne anwo ɛhyele bɛ wɔ azule ne anye lɔ, ɔluakɛ ɛnee anwoma ne ɛlɛbɔ atia bɛ. Zɔhane ati aleɛbahye ne kɛyɛ akɔlɛmɔleɛ, ɔdiale azule ne anye ɔrale bɛ nwo ɛkɛ ne na ɔyɛle kɛ ɔse bɛ nwo. 49Mɔɔ ɛdoavolɛma ne mɔ nwunle ye la, bɛdwenlenle kɛ nwomenle ɔ, yemɔti bɛdeɛdeanle nu, 50ɔluakɛ ɛnee bɛ ahonle ɛdu kpole kpalɛ.
Ndɛndɛ ne ala Gyisɛse zele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛdo bɛ ahonle azule nu! Medame ɔ, bɛmmasulo!” 51Na ɔvole ɛlɛne ne anu la, ɛkɛ ne ala anwoma ne gyakyile ɛdulɛ. Ɛhye yɛle ɛdoavolɛma ne nwanwane kpole, 52ɔluakɛ ɛnee bɛtɛtele ɔ bo kɛ ɔzile ɔyɛle mɔɔ Gyisɛse holale manle menli apenle nnu ne aleɛ la; nɔhalɛ, ɛnee bɛ adwenle ɛnzo nu fee.
Gyisɛse yɛ wuleravolɛma ayile wɔ Gɛnɛzalɛte
(Mat 14.34-36)
53Bɛpɛle tandane ne bɛrale sua bie mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Gɛnɛzalɛte la azo na bɛhendanle bɛ ɛlɛne ne wɔ ɛvoleɛ ne. 54Bɛvi ɛlɛne ne anu bɛdwule aze ala la yɛɛ menli ne nwunle Gyisɛse a. 55Zɔhane ati bɛhanle bɛ nwo bɛwolole maanzinli ne anu ɛleka biala; bɛhɔzoale bɛ wuleravolɛma wɔ ɛkpa nu bɛrɛlɛle Gyisɛse wɔ ɛleka biala mɔɔ bɛkɛde kɛ ɔwɔ la. 56Ɛleka biala mɔɔ ɔhɔle la, saa namule nu o, saa suakpole zo o, anzɛɛ ɛya nu bɔbɔ a, menli vale bɛ wuleravolɛma raguale gua ne mɔ azo na bɛbodole ye kɛ ɔmaa adenle ɔmaa bɛva bɛ sa bɛha ye tɛladeɛ ne anloa ala, na bɛdabɛ noko mɔɔ bɛyɛle ye zɔhane la amuala dele kpɔkɛ bɔkɔɔ.

Title: MAK 7
Content:
Mɔmoane amra ngilehilelɛ ne
(Mat 15.1-9)
1Falasiima bie nee mɛla kilehilevolɛma mɔɔ vi Gyɛlusalɛm la rayiale Gyisɛse. 2Na bɛnwunle kɛ ye ɛdoavolɛma ne bie mɔ lɛ bɛ sa anwo evinli ɛlɛdi debie, yemɔ a le kɛ, bɛanrinzi bɛ sa anwo wɔ adenle mɔɔ Falasiima ne kile kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛyɛ ye la anu.
( 3Falasiima nee Dwuuma mɔɔ ɛha la amuala di bɛ mɔmoane amra ngilehilelɛ ne azo la ati, bɛnli debie biala, kyesɛ bɛnrinzi bɛ sa anwo, kɛmɔ bɛ ngilehilelɛ ne se la. 4Eza bɛnli debie biala mɔɔ vi gua nu la, kyesɛ bɛdumua bɛnrinzi nwolɛ, yɛɛ bɛlɛ ngilehilelɛ dɔɔnwo mɔɔ fane kɛ bɛsi bɛnrinzi ahɔpo, ahyɛnze yɛɛ kɔbele mbuakɛ nee mgba nwo la.)
5Zɔhane ati Falasiima ne nee mɛla kilehilevolɛma ne mɔ bizale Gyisɛse kɛ, “Duzu ati a wɔ ɛdoavolɛma ne mɔ ɛnli ngilehilelɛ ne mɔɔ yɛ nlenya mɔ ɛva ɛgyakyi yɛ la azo na bɛfa bɛ sa anwo evinli bɛdi debie ɛ?”
6 Gyisɛse buale bɛ kɛ, “Ayezaya nwunle bɛ bɔkɔɔ yɛɛ ɔhanle a. Bɛle nabalabama kpalɛ kpalɛ, kɛmɔ ɔhɛlɛle ɔdole ɛkɛ ne la; ɔse,
‘Nyamenle se,
Menli ɛhye mɔ fa bɛ nloa babonle mgbane a kanvo me a,
na bɛ ahonle ɛdeɛ, ɔmbikye me.
7Bɛsonle me mgbane,
ɔluakɛ bɛkilehile mɔɔ menli ɛhyehyɛ la kɛ asɛɛ
me mɛla ɔ!’
8“Bɛmɛ, bɛva Nyamenle mɛla ne bɛzie ahane na bɛdi bɛ mɔmoane amra ngilehilelɛ ne mɔ azo.”
9Gyisɛse vale zɔle zolɛ kɛ, “Bɛmɛ, bɛbɔ nrɛlɛbɛ adenle mɔɔ bɛfa zolɛ bɛtulu Nyamenle mɛla ne mɔ na bɛdi bɛdabɛ bɛ ngilehilelɛ zo a. 10 Mosisi hanle kɛ, ‘Di ɛ ze nee ɛ nli eni’, na ‘Awie biala mɔɔ kɛyɛ ɔ ze anzɛɛ ɔ nli aholoba la, bɛhu ye.’ 11Na bɛmɛ, bɛkilehile kɛ saa awie lɛ debie mɔɔ ɔkola ɔfa ɔnea ɔ ze anzɛɛ ɔ nli a ɔyɛ boɛ la na saa ɔka kɛ, ‘Ɛhye le Kɔban’ a, (ɔ bo a le, ‘Ɔle Nyamenle ɛdeɛ’) 12ɛnee bɛmɛ bɛlie bɛdo nu kɛ moalɛ mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ ɔfa ɔboa ɔ ze nee ɔ nli la ɛwie. 13Bɛlua zɛhae adenle zo bɛva bɛ ngilehilelɛ mɔɔ le zɛhae la bɛtia Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne azo; yɛɛ ninyɛne dɔɔnwo mɔɔ le kɛ ɛhye mɔ la angome a bɛyɛ a.”
Ninyɛne mɔɔ gua sonla nwo evinli la
(Mat 15.10-20)
14Gyisɛse akee vɛlɛle menli dɔɔnwo ne wɔ ɔ nwo ɛkɛ ne bieko na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛ muala bɛdie mɔɔ meka la na bɛde ɔ bo kɛ, 15debie biala ɛnle ɛkɛ mɔɔ kɔ sonla kunlu a ɔgua ɔ nwo evinli a, na mɔɔ vi sonla kunlu finde la a gua ɔ nwo evinli a. [ 16Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛ ɛnzonlɛ la, bɛdie!”]
17Nzinlii mɔɔ ɔvile menli ne anu ɔhɔle sua nu la, ye ɛdoavolɛma ne bizale ye mɔɔ ɔhanle la abo. 18Gyisɛse bizale bɛ kɛ, “Yemɔti bɛdabɛ noko bɛnde ɛhye abo? Debie biala mɔɔ wɔ findezo na ɔkɛhɔ sonla kunlu la ɛngua ɔ nwo evinli, 19ɔluakɛ ɔngɔ ye ahonle nu na ɔkɔgua ɔ kunlu na ɔfa ye aze ɔse.” (Ɛhye mɔɔ Gyisɛse hanle la kile kɛ aleɛ biala bɛdi.)
20Na ɔzɔle zolɛ ɔzele kɛ, “Mɔɔ vi sonla kunlu finde la a gua ɔ nwo evinli a. 21Ɔluakɛ wɔ sonla kunlu, bɔbɔ wɔ ye ahonle nu yɛɛ adwenle ɛtane vi finde na ɔmaa ɔbɔ adwɔmane, ɔwua, ɔyɛ kɔdiawu, 22ɔfa nwuvolɛ, ɔyɛ anyebolo, ɔyɛ amumuyɛ, ɔbɔ adalɛ, ɔyɛ ahulomrenya anzɛɛ ahulomraalɛ, ɔdi nzisi, ɔyɛ ngunzi, ɔtu ɔ nwo na ɔyɛ ngoaseade a. 23Ninyɛne ɛtane ɛhye mɔ amuala vi sonla kunlu a finde a na bɛgua ɔ nwo evinli.”
Raalɛ bie diedi
(Mat 15.21-28)
24Gyisɛse vile ɛkɛ ne na ɔhɔle maanzinli ne mɔɔ bikye suakpole ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Taya la azo. Ɔhɔwolole awuke bie anu, na ɔyɛle kɛ ɔnrɛmaa awie ɛnrɛnwu kɛ ɔwɔ ɛkɛ ne, noko akee yeangola fea kyɛ. 25-26Raalɛ bie mɔɔ ɛnle Dwuunli na bɛwole ye wɔ Fonehyea maanzinli nu wɔ Selea maanle nu la rale Gyisɛse anwo ɛkɛ. Raalɛ ɛhye, sunsum ɛtane wɔ ɔ ra raalɛ anwo. Ɔdele Gyisɛse nganeɛ la, ɔrale ɔradule ɔdɔle ɔ gyakɛ anu na ɔbodole ye kɛ ɔdu sunsum ɛtane ne wɔ ɔ ra ne anwo. 27Gyisɛse buale ye kɛ, “Maa yɛlumua yɛmaa ngakula ne mɔ ɛli debie na bɛ ko ɛyi; ɔnle kpalɛ kɛ yɛkɛva ngakula ne mɔ aleɛ ne yɛkɛmaa ahwea mralɛ.”
28Raalɛ ne hanle kɛ, “Ɔle zɔhane, Yɛmenle, noko akee ahwea mralɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ gua ɛkponle ne abo la, ɔyɛ a tafetafe ngakula ne mɔ aleɛ ne abo zo ne.”
29Gyisɛse zele ye kɛ, “Wɔ edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ wɔha la ati, kɔ sua nu na sunsum ɛtane ne ɛvi ɛ ra raalɛ ne anwo.”
30Raalɛ ne hɔle sua nu na ɔhɔnwunle kɛ ɔ ra raalɛ ne la ɛkpa zo, na sunsum ɛtane ne ɛvi ɔ nwo amgba.
Gyisɛse yɛ mumule ayile
31Akee Gyisɛse vile Taya afoa nu na ɔluale Saedɛn sua zo nee Azuamgbole Bulu ne mɔ maanzinli ne anu ɔrale Galeli Tandane ne anloa. 32Menli bie vale nrenya bie mɔɔ anzo ɛdi na ɔle mumule la rɛlɛle ye na bɛbodole ye kɛ ɔva ɔ sa ɔdo ɔ nwo zo. 33Gyisɛse vale nrenya ne vile ɛlɔne ne anu hɔle ahane na ɔvale ɔ sa mrɛlɛsɛka ɔwulowulale nrenya ne anzo nu, ɔdole nyɛlɛ, na ɔvale ɔ sa ɔhanle nrenya ne atafinlima. 34Akee Gyisɛse nleanle anwuma, ɔgule ɛnwomenle kpole ko na ɔzele nrenya ne kɛ, “Ɛfata!” Ɔ bo a le, “Bɛbuke!”
35Ɛkɛ ne ala nrenya ne anzo bukele, ɔ tafinlima zianyinle na ɔdendɛle kpalɛ. 36Na Gyisɛse bɔle menli ne mɔ anloa kɛ bɛmmabɔ mɔɔ ɛzi la azo bɛkile awie biala, noko bɛamkponle na bɛhanle ye dɔɔnwo kpalɛ. 37Ɔyɛle bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdele la amuala azibɛnwo kpole na bɛbɔle nu bɛhanle kɛ, “Ɔyɛ debie biala boɛ! Ɔmaa anzondilira te edwɛkɛ na mumule tendɛ.”

Title: MAK 8
Content:
Gyisɛse maa menli apenle nna aleɛ
(Mat 15.32-39)
1Yeangyɛ biala yɛɛ menli dɔɔnwo bieko rayiale ɔ nwo ɛkɛ a. Bɛ aleɛ mɔɔ bɛdi la wiele la, Gyisɛse vɛlɛle ye ɛdoavolɛma ne mɔ na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, 2“Me kunlu yelɛyela me wɔ menli ɛhye mɔ anwo, ɔluakɛ bɛ nee me ɛradɛnla kenle nsa, yɛɛ bɛnlɛ debie biala mɔɔ bɛdi ye kɛkala a. 3Saa meammaa bɛ debie bɛanli na mese bɛ kɛ bɛhɔ sua nu a, bɛ nye zo kɛbulu bɛ wɔ adenle nu, ɔluakɛ bie mɔ vi moa a ɛra a.”
4Ye ɛdoavolɛma ne mɔ bizale ye kɛ, “Ɛnee nienwu, wɔ fienemgbole ye anu, yɛɛ yɛkɛnyia aleɛ mɔɔ kɛza menli ɛhye mɔ di a?”
5Gyisɛse bizale bɛ kɛ, “Kpanwo nyɛ a bɛlɛ a?”
Bɛbuale kɛ, “Kpanwo mumua nsuu.”
6Gyisɛse manle menli ne dɛnlanle aze na ɔvale kpanwo nsuu ne, ɔyɛle Nyamenle mo, na ɔbubule nu ɔmanle ye ɛdoavolɛma ne mɔ kɛ bɛhyɛ bɛmaa menli ne, na bɛyɛle ye zɔhane. 7Eza bɛlɛ fɛlɛ ekyi bie wɔ ɛkɛ ne. Gyisɛse vale na ɔyɛle Nyamenle mo, na ɔhanle ɔhilele ye ɛdoavolɛma ne mɔ kɛ bɛhyɛ bɛmaa menli ne. 8-9Awie biala lile bie manle ɔ ko yile, na menli ne, saa ɛye mraalɛ nee ngakula nu a, bɛlua menli kɛyɛ apenle nna. Ɛdoavolɛma ne wulowulale aleɛ ne abo zo ne ahɛndɛne tetɛkɛɛ nsuu. Na Gyisɛse gyakyile menli ne mɔ adenle, 10na ndɛndɛ ne ala ɔ nee ye ɛdoavolɛma ne mɔ vole ɛlɛne nu hɔle Dalemanuta maanzinli nu.
Falasiima kpondɛ sɛkɛlɛneɛ
(Mat 16.1-4)
11 Falasiima bie rale Gyisɛse ɛkɛ nee ye razule kpolera. Ɛnee bɛkpondɛ kɛ bɛsɔ ye bɛnea la ati, bɛzele ye kɛ ɔyɛ nwanwane sɛkɛlɛneɛ ɔmaa bɛnlea, ɔva ɔhile kɛ Nyamenle die mɔɔ ɔlɛyɛ la to nu. 12 Gyisɛse gule ɛnwomenle na ɔbizale kɛ, “Duzu ati a bɛmɛ adwuleso amra bɛkpondɛ sɛkɛlɛneɛ ɛ? Nɔhalɛ, bɛnrɛyɛ sɛkɛlɛneɛ biala bɛnrɛhile bɛdabɛ menli ɛhye mɔ ɛlɛ!”
13Na ɔgyakyile bɛ ɛkɛ ne ɔvale ɛlɛne ɔpɛle ɔhɔle tandane ne anzi lɔ.
Gyisɛse ka Hɛlɔdo nee Falasiima ngilehilelɛ ne anwo edwɛkɛ
(Mat 16.5-12)
14Ɛdoavolɛma ne mɔ arɛle vile kɛ bɛkɛva aleɛ bɛkɛzia bɛ nwo, yemɔti kpanwo mumua ko ala a ɛnee wɔ bɛ bɔlɛ nu a. 15 Gyisɛse hakyele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛnlea bɛ nwo boɛ wɔ Falasiima mgbɔvonle ne nee Hɛlɔdo mgbɔvonle ne anwo.”
16Bɛdwenledwenlenle nwolɛ kɛ, “Ɛnee kpanwo mɔɔ yɛnlɛ ye la ati a ɔlɛka ɛhye a?”
17Gyisɛse nwunle mɔɔ bɛlɛkeha la na ɔbizale bɛ kɛ, “Duzu ati a bɛlɛdwenle kpanwo mɔɔ bɛnlɛ ye la anwo ɛ? Yemɔti bɛnze anzɛɛ bɛnde ɔ bo ɔ? Bɛ adwenle ɛnzo nu ɔ? 18 Bɛlɛ ɛnyelɛ, na bɛnnwu debie ɔ? Anzɛɛ bɛlɛ ɛnzonlɛ na bɛnde edwɛkɛ ɔ? Yemɔti bɛngakye? 19Mekɛ mɔɔ membubule kpanwo nnu ne anu memanle menli apenle nnu ne la, ahɛndɛne nyɛ yɛɛ bɛsesale ɔ bo zo mgbokpoloka ne la bɛnyianle a?”
Bɛbuale kɛ, “Bulu nee nwiɔ.”
20Eza Gyisɛse bizale bɛ kɛ, “Na membubule kpanwo nsuu ne memanle menli apenle nna ne noko la, ahɛndɛne nyɛ a ɔ bo zo mgbokpoloka ne yɛle a?”
Bɛbuale kɛ, “Nsuu.”
21Na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Yɛɛ akee ɛnɛ nee ɛnɛ ala bɛnnyia ndelebɛbo a?”
Gyisɛse yɛ anyenzinliravolɛ bie ayile wɔ Bɛteseeyeda
22Gyisɛse nee ye ɛdoavolɛma ne rale Bɛteseeyeda na menli bie vale nrenya bie mɔɔ anye ɛzi la rɛlɛle ye na bɛbodole ye kɛ ɔyɛ ye ayile. 23Gyisɛse zɔle nrenya ne asa na ɔvale ye ɔhɔle namule ne kandiba. Ɔseanle nyɛlɛ ɔguale ɔ sa nu na ɔvale ɔhanle nrenya ne anye, ɔvale ɔ sa ɔguale ɔ nwo zo na akee ɔbizale ye kɛ, “Ɛnwu debie ɔ?”
24Nrenya ne manle ɔ nye zo na ɔhanle kɛ, “Ɛhɛe, menwu menli, na bɛle kɛ mbaka mɔɔ ɛlɛtiedia la.”
25Gyisɛse eza vale ɔ sa hanle nrenya ne anye na zolɛ dele kpalɛ na ɔnwunle debie bɔkɔɔ. 26Gyisɛse zele ye kɛ, “Kɔ sua nu, mmasia ɛ nzi ɛkɔ namule ne azo bieko.”
Pita se Gyisɛse le Mɛzaya
(Mat 16.13-20; Luk 9.18-21)
27Gyisɛse nee ye ɛdoavolɛma ne hɔle namunamu ne mɔ mɔɔ zuozua suakpole ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Felepe Sizalia la azo. Bɛlua adenle zo bɛlɛkɔ la ɔbizale bɛ kɛ, “Menli se mame a le nwane? Bɛha bɛhile me.”
28 Bɛbuale ye kɛ, “Bie mɔ se wɔmɔ a ɛle Dwɔn Sɔnevolɛ ne; bie mɔ noko se wɔmɔ a ɛle Yilaegya, yɛɛ eza bie mɔ se ɛle Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma ne mɔ ko.”
29 Na ɔbizale bɛ kɛ, “Na bɛdabɛ noko ɛ? Bɛse mame a le nwane?”
Pita buale kɛ, “Wɔmɔ a ɛle Kelaese ne.”
30Na Gyisɛse bɔle bɛ nloa kɛ, “Bɛmmaka mɔɔ bɛha ye wɔ me nwo la bɛkile awie biala.”
Gyisɛse ka ye amaneɛnwunlɛ nee ye ewule nwo edwɛkɛ
(Mat 16.21-28; Luk 9.22-27)
31Akee Gyisɛse bɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɔkilehile ye ɛdoavolɛma ne kɛ, “Ɔwɔ kɛ Medame Sonla Ra, menwu amaneɛ somaa na mgbanyima ne nee sɛlɛvolɛ mgbanyinli nee mɛla kilehilevolɛma ne mɔ kpo me. Bɛbahu me na kenle nsa ne anzi mebadwazo meara ngoane nu bieko.” 32Ɔkpale ɛhye anwo ɛdanlɛ wienyi ɔhilele bɛ. Yemɔti Pita vale Gyisɛse hɔle ahane na ɔhwile ɔ nyunlu. 33Na Gyisɛse hakyile ɔ nwo na ɔnwunle ye ɛdoavolɛma ne mɔ la, ɔdeanle Pita ɔzele kɛ, “Seetan, twe ɛ nwo fi ɛkɛ ne. Ɛndu folɛ kpalɛ! Wɔ adwenle ne ɛnvi Nyamenle, ɔle sonla adwenle.”
34 Akee Gyisɛse vɛlɛle menli dɔɔnwo ne nee ye ɛdoavolɛma ne wɔ ɔ nwo ɛkɛ ne na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Saa awie biala kpondɛ kɛ ɔ nee me dua a, ɛnee ɔkpo ɔ nwo na ɔva ye amaneɛnwunlɛ meanubaka ne ɔdo ɔ kɔme zo na ɔdoa me. 35 Awie biala mɔɔ pele ye ngoane nwo la minli ye; na awie biala mɔɔ kɛminli ye ngoane wɔ mame nee Edwɛkpa ne ati la kɛlie ye ɛkɛla ngoane. 36Saa sonla nyia ewiade ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti na ɔminli ye ngoane a, ɛnee duzu nvasoɛ a ɔnyia a? Ɔnnyia ɛhwee. 37Na duzu bɔbɔ yɛɛ sonla kɛhola kɛva kɛzenza ye ɛkɛla a? Bɛhakye kɛ bɛ nee amumuyɛma mɔɔ ɛnlie me ɛnli la a de a. 38Yemɔti saa awie annea boɛ na ɔmaa me nwo nee me ngilehilelɛ ne yɛ ye nyiane wɔ ɛtane nee amumuyɛ mekɛ ye anu a, ɛnee noko ahenle ɛnwu ye kɛ, ɔdaye noko ɔ nwo bayɛ Medame Sonla Ra nyiane wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ me nee me anwuma soanvolɛma nwuanzanwuanza ne yɛkɛra Egya anyunlunyia ne anu la.”

Title: MAK 9
Content:
1Na ɔhanle ɔzɔle zolɛ kɛ, “Bɛhakye ɛhye! Bie mɔ gyi bɛ avinli ɛke mɔɔ bɛnrɛwu kɔkpula kɛ bɛkɛnwu Nyamenle belemgbunlililɛ ne kɛ yera zo wɔ tumi nu.”
Gyisɛse hakyile
(Mat 17.1-13; Luk 9.28-36)
2 Kenle nsia pɛle nu la, Gyisɛse vale Pita, Gyemise, yɛɛ Dwɔn hɔle boka tendenle bie azo, bɛ ngome ala a bɛwɔ ɛkɛ a. Na bɛnwunle kɛ Gyisɛse ɛhakyi bɛ nye zo, 3na ye tɛladeɛ ne ɛyɛ nwohyee mɔɔ awie biala mɔɔ wɔ aleɛabo la ɛnrɛhola ɛnrɛkpo ɛnrɛmaa ɔnrɛyɛ zɔhane a. 4Ɛdoavolɛma nsa ne nwunle Mosisi nee Yilaegya kɛ bɛ nee Gyisɛse ɛlɛtendɛ. 5Na Pita hanle hilele Gyisɛse kɛ, “Kilehilevolɛ, ɔle kpalɛ kɛ yɛwɔ ɛke a. Yɛbabɔ nzeseɛ nsa, wɔ ɛdeɛ ko, Mosisi ɛdeɛ ko, yɛɛ Yilaegya ɛdeɛ ko.” 6Ɛnee ɔdaye mumua ne ɔnnwu edwɛkɛ ko mɔɔ ɔha a, ɔboalekɛ ɛnee ɛzulolɛ kpole ɛha ye nee ɔ gɔnwo mɔ.
7 Amungu rahedale bɛ nwo zo, na ɛnelɛ bie dendɛle amungu ne anu zele kɛ, “Me ra mɔɔ mekulo ye la ɛne, bɛdie ye!” 8Ɛkɛ ne ala bɛtotole bɛ nye, noko bɛannwu awie biala kɛ Gyisɛse angome mɔɔ bɛ nee ye gyi ɛkɛ ne la ala.
9Na bɛvi boka ne azo bɛlɛdwu la, Gyisɛse bɔle ye ɛdoavolɛma ne anloa kɛ, “Bɛmmaka mɔɔ bɛnwu ye la bɛkile awie biala, kɔkpula mekɛ mɔɔ Sonla Ra ne vi ewule nu kɛdwazo la.”
10Bɛlile ye edwɛkɛ ne azo, na bɛdabɛ ngome bɛdwenledwenlenle mɔɔ zile la anwo kɛ, “Ɛnee ewudwazo ɛhye a le duzu?” 11 Na bɛbizale Gyisɛse kɛ, “Duzu ati a mɛla kilehilevolɛma ne mɔ se ɔwɔ kɛ Yilaegya dumua ba ɛ?”
12Ɔbuale bɛ kɛ, “Ɔwɔ kɛ amgba Yilaegya dumua ba batoto ninyɛne muala boɛ. Na duzu ati a Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne ka kɛ Sonla Ra ne banwu amaneɛ somaa, na menli akpo ye ɛ? 13Memaa bɛade kɛ Yilaegya zɔhane ɛra dɛbadɛba, noko menli ambu ye, bɛyɛle ye mgbane mgbane, kɛmɔ Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne ka ye wɔ ɔ nwo la.”
Gyisɛse yɛ kakula nrenya mɔɔ sunsum ɛtane wɔ ɔ nwo la ayile
(Mat 17.14-21; Luk 9.37-43)
14Mɔɔ bɛradole ɛdoavolɛma mɔɔ ɛha la, bɛnwunle kɛ menli somaa ɛbɔ ɛyia bɛ, na mɛla kilehilevolɛma nee bɛ ɛlɛsu kpolera. 15Menli ne mɔ nwunle Gyisɛse la ɔzinle bɛ nwo na bɛnriandile bɛhɔzomanle ye bie. 16Gyisɛse bizale ɛdoavolɛma ne kɛ, “Duzu anwo kpolera a bɛ nee menli ne mɔ ɛlɛsu a?”
17Nrenya ko mɔɔ wɔ menli ne anu la zele kɛ, “Kilehilevolɛ, menvale me ra nrenya membale, ɔluakɛ sunsum ɛtane mɔɔ ɔmmaa ɔngola tendɛ la wɔ ɔ nwo. 18Kenle biala mɔɔ sunsum ɛtane ne kɛdwu aze la, ɔmaa kakula ne pɛ fi, ɔ nloa wu awubue, ɔtwi ɔ gye na ɔsa ketee. Menzele wɔ ɛdoavolɛma ne mɔ kɛ bɛdu sunsum ɛtane ne wɔ ɔ nwo, na bɛangola.”
19Gyisɛse zele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛmɛ mɔɔ bɛnlɛ diedi a! Me nee bɛ ɛdɛnla ɔhɔkpula kenlenzu? Menyia bɛ nwo abotane ɔhɔkpula kenlenzu? Bɛva kakula ne bɛrɛlɛ me!” 20Na bɛvale ye bɛrale. Sunsum ɛtane ne nwunle Gyisɛse ala la yɛɛ ɔmanle kakula ne dɔle mgbutike a. Ɔhundohundole ɔ nwo aze na ɔ nloa wule awubue. 21Na Gyisɛse bizale kakula ne ɔ ze kɛ, “Ɔvale zɛhae ɛyɛlɛ la yehyɛ ɔ?”
Nrenya ne buale kɛ, “Ye nretee ne anu ala yɛɛ ɔvale ye a. 22Mekɛ dɔɔnwo, yevuandi ye yedo nzule nee senle nu, mɔɔ anrɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ ɔwu a. Na saa ɛkola debie biala yɛ a, ɛnee nwu yɛ anwunvɔne na boa yɛ.”
23Gyisɛse zele ye kɛ, “Saa ɛkola a? Sonla mɔɔ lɛ diedi la kola yɛ debie biala.”
24Na ndɛndɛ ne ala kakula ne ɔ ze hanle kɛ, “Melɛ diedi, na ɔle ekyi. Boa me maa me diedi ɛnyi.”
25Gyisɛse nwunle kɛ menli dɔɔnwo ɛlɛba arahyele bɛ nwo zo la, ɔdeanle sunsum ɛtane ne nu na ɔzele ye kɛ, “Sunsum mumule, ɛvi kakula nrenya ye anwo tu, mmabawolo ye bieko!”
26Na sunsum ɛtane ne deɛdeanle nuhua maanle kakula ne dɔle mgbutike bieko, na ɔvi ɔ nwo ɔdule. Kakula ne yɛle kɛ sonla mɔɔ ɛwu la, na awie biala hanle kɛ, “Yewu!” 27Na Gyisɛse zɔle ɔ sa manle ye zo na ɔdwazole ɔgyinlanle.
28Gyisɛse hɔle sua nu la ye ɛdoavolɛma ne bizale ye kɛ, “Duzu ati a yɛangola sunsum ɛtane ne tu ɛ?”
29Ɔbuale bɛ kɛ, “Debie biala ɛngola sunsum ɛtane ɛhye tu, kyesɛ nzɛlɛlɛ ala.”
Gyisɛse ka ye ewule nwo edwɛkɛ bieko
(Mat 17.22-23; Luk 9.43-45)
30Gyisɛse nee ye ɛdoavolɛma ne vile ɛkɛ ne na bɛhɔvale Galeli bɛhɔle. Yeangulo kɛ awie biala kɛnwu ɛleka mɔɔ ɔwɔ la, 31ɔboalekɛ ɛnee ɔlɛkilehile ye ɛdoavolɛma ne kɛ, “Bɛbaye Medame Sonla Ra bɛawula menli sa nu bɛamaa bɛahu me, na ye kenle nsa ne anzi mebadwazo meara ngoane nu.”
32Ɛdoavolɛma ne ande ngilehilelɛ ɛhye abo, noko akee bɛzulole kɛ bɛkɛbiza ye ɔ bo.
Nwane a le kpole a?
(Mat 18.1-5; Luk 9.46-48)
33Nzinlii bɛrale Kapɛnayɛm, na bɛhɔle sua nu la Gyisɛse bizale ye ɛdoavolɛma ne kɛ, “Duzu a bɛzule nwolɛ kpolera wɔ adenle nu la?”
34 Na bɛanye ye ɔ nloa, ɔluakɛ bɛlua adenle ne anu la ɛnee bɛlɛsu kpolera kɛ bɛ nuhua boni a le kpole wɔ bɛ avinli a. 35 Yemɔti Gyisɛse dɛnlanle aze, ɔvɛlɛle ye ɛdoavolɛma bulu nee nwiɔ ne na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Awie biala mɔɔ kpondɛ menli ti ali la ɛli bɛ nzi na ɔzonle awie biala.” 36Akee ɔvale kakula ko ɔziele bɛ nyunlu ɛkɛ, ɔvale ɔ sa ɔdole ɔ kɔme na ɔzele kɛ, 37 “Awie biala mɔɔ ɔlua me ti ɔkɛlie ɛhye mɔ ko la, ɛlie me, na mɔɔ kɛlie me la, ɛtɛdiele me ngome, ɛnee yelie ahenle ne mɔɔ zoanle me la noko.”
Mɔɔ ɛngyi yɛ la wɔ yɛ afoa
(Luk 9.49-50)
38Dwɔn zele Gyisɛse kɛ, “Kilehilevolɛ, yɛnwunle nrenya bie kɛ ɔlɛ wɔ duma ɔlɛtu mbɔnsam, na yɛduale ye, ɔluakɛ ɔmboka yɛ nwo.”
39Gyisɛse zele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛmmatua ye, ɔluakɛ awie biala ɛnrɛhola ɛnrɛyɛ nwanwane debie wɔ me duma nu na nzinlii yeaha me nwo edwɛkɛ ɛtane. 40 Awie biala mɔɔ ɛngyi yɛ la wɔ yɛ afoa. 41 Bɛhakye ɛhye! Awie biala mɔɔ ɔluakɛ bɛle Kelaese ne ɛdeɛ la ati ɔkɛmaa bɛ nzule bɛkɛnlo la kɛnyia ahatualɛ wɔ nwolɛ.
Sɔnea mɔɔ twe sonla kɔ ɛtane nu la
(Mat 18.6-9; Luk 17.1-2)
42“Awie biala mɔɔ kɛgyegye menli mɔɔ bɛ diedi mɔɔ wɔ me nu la le kɛ ngakula ɛhye mɔ anu ko, na ɔkɛmaa ɔkɛminli ye diedi ne la, ɛnee noko ɔle kpalɛ kɛ anrɛɛ bɛdwele ɛdibolɛ ɛnlomboɛ kpalɛ bɛhendanle ɔ kɔme na bɛvuandinle ye bɛdole nyevile nu. 43 Yemɔti saa ɛ sa ko twehwe wɔ ahɔ ɛtane nu a, pɛ ye to! Ɔle kpalɛ kɛ ɛ sa ko na ɛkɛnyia ngoane tɛla kɛ ɛ sa nwiɔ na ɛkɛhɔ senle ne mɔɔ ɛnnu ɛlɛ la anu. [ 44Ɛkɛ ne azonlɛ ɛnwu ɛlɛ, yɛɛ ye ndeanlɛ senle ne ɛnnu ɛlɛ.] 45Saa ɛ gyakɛ gyegye wɔ ahwe wɔ ahɔ ɛtane nu a, pɛ ye to! Ɔle kpalɛ kɛ ɛ gyakɛ ko na ɛkɛnyia ngoane tɛla kɛ ɛ gyakɛ nwiɔ na bɛkɛvuandi wɔ bɛkɛdo senle ne mɔɔ ɛnnu ɛlɛ la anu a. [ 46Ɛkɛ ne azonlɛ ɛnwu ɛlɛ, yɛɛ ye ndeanlɛ senle ne ɛnnu ɛlɛ.] 47 Saa ɛ nye noko a twehwe wɔ ahɔ ɛtane nu a, tu ye to! Ɔle kpalɛ kɛ ɛ nye ko na ɛkɛnyia Nyamenle belemgbunlililɛ ne tɛla kɛ ɛ nye nwiɔ na bɛkɛvuandi wɔ bɛkɛdo senle ne mɔɔ ɛnnu ɛlɛ la anu a. 48 Ɛkɛ ne azonlɛ ɛnwu ɛlɛ, yɛɛ ye ndeanlɛ senle ne ɛnnu ɛlɛ.
49“Bɛbava ndɛnebualɛ senle ne bɛade awie biala anwo kɛ bɛfa ngyenle bɛte azubɔdeɛ nwo la.
50 “Ngyenle le kpalɛ; na saa ɔta a, kɛ ɛkɛzi ɛkɛyɛ na yeayɛ menlemenle bieko ɛ?
“Bɛmaa bɛ ɛbɛlabɔlɛ ne ɛyɛ kɛ ngyenle, ɛde bɛ, na bɛ nee menli kɔsɔɔti ɛdɛnla anzonudwolɛ nu.”

Title: MAK 10
Content:
Ewolebɔlɛ nwo ngilehilelɛ
(Mat 19.1-12; Luk 16.18)
1Gyisɛse vile ɛkɛ ne rale Dwudiya maanzinli nu na ɔpɛle ɔdɔle Azule Dwɔdan ne anzi. Menli dɔɔnwo rayiale ye bieko, na kɛmɔ ɔta ɔyɛ la, ɔhilehilele bɛ.
2Falasiima bie rale kɛ bɛbazɔ ye bɛanlea, na bɛbizale ye kɛ, “Asoo yɛ mɛla ne maa nrenya adenle maa ɔbɔ ɔ ye ewole? Ka maa yɛdie.”
3Gyisɛse bizale bɛ kɛ, “Duzu mɛla a Mosisi vale manle bɛ a?”
4 Bɛbuale kɛ, “Mosisi manle adenle kɛ nrenya ne ɛhɛlɛ ewolebɔlɛ kɛlata ɛmaa ɔ ye na ɔgyakyi ye.”
5Gyisɛse zele bɛ kɛ, “Ɔlua bɛ anzosesebɛ ti yɛɛ Mosisi hɛlɛle mɛla ɛhye manle bɛ a. 6 Na aloa kabɔ ɔ bo la, Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se, ‘Nyamenle bɔle bɛ nrenya nee raalɛ. 7 Ɛhye ati nrenya ne bade ɔ nwo avi ɔ ze nee ɔ nli bɛ nwo na ɔ nee ɔ ye ahɔdɛnla, 8na bɛ mu nwiɔ bɛayɛ nwonane ko.’ Yemɔti ɛnee bɛnle nwiɔ bieko na bɛle nwonane ko. 9Zɔhane ati mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛha ɛbɔ nu la, awie biala mmakpakye nu.”
10Bɛziale bɛhɔle sua nu la, ɛdoavolɛma ne bizale Gyisɛse ewolebɔlɛ ne anwo edwɛkɛ bieko. 11 Na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Saa nrenya bɔ ɔ ye ewole na ɔgya fofolɛ a, ɛnee yeyɛ ɛtane. 12Zɔhane ala yɛɛ saa raalɛ gyakyi ɔ hu ɔkɔ agyalɛ fofolɛ a, ɛnee ɔdaye noko yeyɛ ɛtane a.”
Gyisɛse yila ngakula
(Mat 19.13-15; Luk 18.15-17)
13Menli bie vale ngakula rale kɛ Gyisɛse ɛva ɔ sa ɛgua bɛ nwo zo, na ye ɛdoavolɛma ne duale bɛ kɛ bɛmmagyegye ye. 14Mɔɔ Gyisɛse nwunle ye la, ɔvale ɛya na ɔzele ye ɛdoavolɛma ne mɔ kɛ, “Bɛgyakyi ngakula ne mɔ bɛmaa bɛrɛla me nwo, bɛmmatua bɛ, na bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛle kɛ ɛhye mɔ zɛhae la yɛɛ Nyamenle Belemgbunlililɛ ne le bɛ ɛdeɛ a. 15 Bɛhakye ɛhye! Awie biala mɔɔ anyɛ ɔ nwo kɛ kakula, anlie Nyamenle Belemgbunlililɛ ne ando nu la ɛnrɛnwu Nyamenle Belemgbunlililɛ ne.” 16Na ɔmanle ngakula ne mɔ zo ngoko ngoko ɔziele ɔ gyakɛ azo, ɔvale ɔ sa ɔguale bɛ nwo zo na ɔyilale bɛ.
Sukoavolɛ ne mɔɔ rale Gyisɛse ɛkɛ ne la
(Mat 19.16-30; Luk 18.18-30)
17Gyisɛse zile nu bieko kɛ ɔkɔ la, nrenya bie lɛ ɛnriandilɛ rahotole ɔ nyunlu ɛkɛ ne na ɔzele ye kɛ, “Kilehilevolɛ kpalɛ, duzu a menyɛ na meanyia ngoane mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ a?”
18Gyisɛse bizale ye kɛ, “Duzu ati a ɛse mele kpalɛ ɛ? Awie biala ɛnle kpalɛ kɛ Nyamenle angomekye. 19 Ɛze mɛla ne mɔ: ‘Mmayɛ kɔdiawu, mmafa awuvolɛ, mmawua, mmadi daselɛ adalɛ, mmadi nzisi, di ɛ ze nee ɛ nli eni.’ ”
20Nrenya ne buale kɛ, “Kilehilevolɛ, sumunli me ngakula nu yɛɛ menvale ɛhye mɔ azo ɛlilɛ a.”
21Gyisɛse nleanle ye koonwu, ɔhulole ye na ɔzele ye kɛ, “Yeha wɔ debie ko. Kɔ na kɔdɔne ninyɛne mɔɔ ɛlɛ la amuala, na kyɛ ezukoa ne maa ehyianvolɛma na ɛkɛnyia anwonyia wɔ anwuma, na akee bɛla badoa me bo zo.” 22Nrenya ne dele edwɛkɛ ɛhye la, ɔ nyunlu zale, na ɔvale nyane ɔhɔle, ɔluakɛ ɔle sukoavolɛ kpole.
23Gyisɛse hakyile ɔ nye nleanle ye ɛdoavolɛma ne mɔ na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Ɔbayɛ se yeamaa sukoavolɛma kɛ bɛkɛnyia Nyamenle Belemgbunlililɛ ne a.”
24Edwɛkɛ ɛhye hwenle ɛdoavolɛma ne nu kpalɛ, na Gyisɛse hɔle zolɛ zele kɛ, “Ayi mɔ, Nyamenle Belemgbunlililɛ ne ɛnyianlɛ yɛ se kpalɛ! 25Na ɔyɛ se noko kpalɛ ɔmaa sukoavolɛ kɛ ɔkɛnyia Nyamenle Belemgbunlililɛ ne, tɛla kɛ afunlumu kɛwolo agbuyia nye nu a.”
26Edwɛkɛ ne zinle ɛdoavolɛma ne mɔ anwo kpole na bɛbizale bɛ nwo ngoko ngoko kɛ, “Ɛnee nwane bɔbɔ a kɛnyia ngoane a?”
27Gyisɛse nleanle bɛ koonwu na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Mɔɔ yɛ se bo sonla nwo zo la ɛnyɛ se ɛmmaa Nyamenle, ɔluakɛ Nyamenle kola yɛ debie biala.”
28Pita hanle kɛ, “Nea o, na yɛgyakyi debie biala yɛɛ yɛdoa wɔ o!”
29Gyisɛse zele bɛ kɛ, “Ɔle zɔhane, noko bɛdie! Awie biala mɔɔ me ti, nee Edwɛkpa ne ati yegyakyi sua, mediema mrenya anzɛɛ mediema mraalɛ, ninli anzɛɛ selɛ, mralɛ anzɛɛ azɛlɛ la 30banyia bɛ molozo wɔ kɛkala mekɛ ye anu. Ɔbanyia azua, mediema mrenya nee mraalɛ, ninlima nee mralɛ nee azɛlɛ mɔnwo mɔnwo. Bɛbayɛ ye kpɔdekpɔde ɛdeɛ, noko kenle bie ɔkɛnyia ngoane mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ. 31 Bɛdabɛ dɔɔnwo ne ala mɔɔ ɛnɛ lumua la bali amozi, na amozi amra alumua.”
Gyisɛse ka ye ewule nwo edwɛkɛ mɔɔ tɔ zo nsa
(Mat 20.17-19; Luk 18.31-34)
32Akee Gyisɛse nee ye ɛdoavolɛma ne dɔle adenle zo kɛ bɛkɔ Gyɛlusalɛm, na ɛnee Gyisɛse lumua bɛ nyunlu. Ɛdoavolɛma ne akunlu ɛdu kpalɛ, yɛɛ ɛzulolɛ noko ɛha menli mɔɔ doa bɛ la. Na Gyisɛse eza vale ye ɛdoavolɛma bulu nee nwiɔ ne hɔle ahane na ɔhanle ninyɛne mɔɔ bɛbava bɛayɛ ye la amuala ɔhilele bɛ. 33Ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛdie, yɛlɛkɔ Gyɛlusalɛm, na bɛbaye medame Sonla Ra bɛawula sɛlɛvolɛ mgbanyinli nee mɛla kilehilevolɛma ne mɔ asa anu. Bɛbabua me fɔlɛ kɛ bɛhu me na bɛaye me bɛawula bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la asa anu. 34Menli ɛhye mɔ noko bagolo me nwo, atoto me nwo nyɛlɛ, abila me mbaka na bɛahu me. Na ye kenle nsa ne anzi, mebadwazo meara ngoane nu.”
Gyemise nee Dwɔn bɛ ɛbizalɛdeɛ
(Mat 20.20-28)
35Gyemise nee Dwɔn, mɔɔ le Zɛbɛdi amra ne mɔ rale Gyisɛse ɛkɛ rahanle kɛ, “Kilehilevolɛ, yɛkulo kɛ yɛsɛlɛ wɔ debie ko.”
36Gyisɛse bizale bɛ kɛ, “Duzu a bɛkpondɛ kɛ meyɛ memaa bɛ a?”
37Bɛbuale kɛ, “Anrɛɛ ɛnee kenle mɔɔ ɛkɛdɛnla wɔ anyunlunyia belemgbunli ebia ne anu la, wɔamaa yɛ nee wɔ adɛnla, ko adɛnla wɔ fema zo na ko noko adɛnla wɔ bɛne zo.”
38 Gyisɛse zele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛnze mɔɔ bɛlɛbiza bɛalie la. Asoo bɛkɛhola amaneɛnwunlɛ dwora ne mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ meno nu la anu no, anzɛɛ bɛkɛhola ewule ɛzɔnenlɛ ne mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛfa bɛsɔne me la die?”
39Bɛbuale kɛ, “Yɛkɛhola.”
Gyisɛse zele bɛ kɛ, “Amgba, bɛkɛhola amaneɛnwunlɛ dwora ne mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ meno nu la anu no, bɛkɛlie ewule ɛzɔnenlɛ ne mɔɔ bɛfa bɛazɔne me la die, 40noko me sa fema nee bɛne zo ɛdɛnlanlɛ ɛdeɛ, tɛ me a mekpa nu meye menli mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ tɛnla la a. Selɛ ne a bava amaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ yeziezie yemaa bɛ la a.”
41Mɔɔ ɛdoavolɛma ne mɔ mɔɔ hale la dele ɛhye anwo bie la, bɛvale Gyemise nee Dwɔn anwo ɛya kpole. 42 Yemɔti Gyisɛse vɛlɛle bɛ muala ɔ nwo ɛkɛ ne na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛze kɛ maanle maanle arelemgbunli si yɛ bɛ menli kpɔdekpɔde la, yɛɛ kɛ bɛ mgbanyima noko si di bɛ nwo zo tumi la. 43 Ɛhye ɛnle zɔhane wɔ bɛ nu. Saa bɛ nuhua bie kpondɛ kɛ ɔyɛ kpole wɔ bɛ avinli a, ɔyɛ bɛ muala bɛ sonvolɛ 44yɛɛ saa bɛ nuhua bie kpondɛ bɛ ti ali a, ɔyɛ bɛ muala bɛ akɛlɛ. 45Medame Sonla Ra bɔbɔ, meamba kɛ bɛzonle me; membale kɛ mebazonle na meava me ngoane meado aze meakpɔne menli dɔɔnwo.”
Gyisɛse yɛ anyenzinliravolɛ Baatemeɛse ayile
(Mat 20.29-34; Luk 18.35-43)
46Bɛrale Gyɛleko, na mɔɔ Gyisɛse nee ye ɛdoavolɛma ne mɔ nee menli dɔɔnwo vi sua ne azo bɛlɛkɔ la, ɛnee nrenya anyenzinliravolɛ bie mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Baatemeɛse, mɔɔ le nrenya Temeɛse ara ne, de adehane ne ɛlɛsɛlɛzɛlɛ ninyɛne. 47Mɔɔ ɔdele kɛ Gyisɛse mɔɔ vi Nazalɛte la a ɛlɛse la, ɔdeanle nu kɛ, “Devidi Ara Gyisɛse! Nwu me anwunvɔne!”
48Menli ne mɔ dɔɔnwo deanle ye na bɛzele ye kɛ ɔyɛ koonwu. Noko ɔdeanle nu kpalɛ kɛ, “Devidi Ara, nwu me anwunvɔne!”
49Gyisɛse gyinlanle na ɔzele kɛ, “Bɛvɛlɛ ye bɛmaa me.”
Bɛvɛlɛle nrenya anyenzinliravolɛ ne na bɛzele ye kɛ, “Ka wɔ ahonle to azule nu; dwazo na ɔlɛfɛlɛ wɔ.”
50Nrenya ne dwazole, ɔvuandinle ye ɛdanlɛ ne ɔguale, na ɔrale Gyisɛse anwo ɛkɛ ne.
51Gyisɛse bizale ye kɛ, “Duzu a ɛkulo kɛ meyɛ memaa wɔ a?”
Nrenya ne buale kɛ, “Kilehilevolɛ, mekulo kɛ menwu debie bieko.” 52Gyisɛse zele ye kɛ, “Kɔ, wɔ diedi ɛyɛ wɔ ayile.”
Na ɛkɛ ne ala ɔnwunle debie na ɔdoale Gyisɛse.

Title: MAK 11
Content:
Gyisɛse kɔ Gyɛlusalɛm konimlilɛ nu
(Mat 21.1-11; Luk 19.28-40; Dw 12.12-19)
1Bɛbikyele Gyɛlusalɛm, mɔɔ ɛnee asɛɛ bɛdwu Bɛtefagye nee Bɛtani la, bɛradwule Ɔlivi Boka ne abo. Na Gyisɛse zoanle ye ɛdoavolɛma ne mɔ nwiɔ manle bɛlumuale ɔ nyunlu, 2na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛhɔ namule ne mɔɔ wɔ bɛ nyunlu lɔ la azo, na bɛdwu ɛkɛ ne ala a bɛkɛnwu asoaso ralɛ mɔɔ awie ɛtɛtɛnlanle zolɛ ɛlɛ la kɛ ɔhenda ɛkɛ ne. Bɛzianyi ye bɛrɛla. 3Saa awie biza bɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛyɛ la abo a, bɛze ye kɛ, ‘Yɛ menle ne ɛhyia nwolɛ’ na ɔbamaa bɛ nee ye ara.”
4Ɛdoavolɛma nwiɔ ne hɔle na bɛhɔnwunle kɛ asoaso ne henda sua bie anuhɔlɛ wɔ gua ne azo. Mɔɔ bɛlɛsianyi ye la, 5menli mɔɔ gyigyi ɛkɛ ne la bie bizale bɛ kɛ, “Kɛ bɛyɛ asoaso ne mɔɔ bɛlɛsianyi ye ɛ?”
6Ɛdoavolɛma nwiɔ ne yele bɛ ɔ nloa, kɛmɔ Gyisɛse zele bɛ la, na menli ne mɔ gyakyile bɛ manle bɛ nee ye hɔle. 7Bɛvale asoaso ralɛ ne bɛrɛlɛle Gyisɛse, bɛvale bɛ ndanlɛ bɛguale zolɛ na Gyisɛse vole dɛnlanle zolɛ. 8Menli dɔɔnwo vale bɛ ndanlɛ sesɛle adenle ne anu, yɛɛ bie mɔ noko bubule nya guguale adenle ne anu. 9 Na menli mɔɔ li ɔ nyunlu nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛli ɔ nzi la deɛdeanle nu hanle kɛ, “Ayɛlɛyelɛ ɛha Nyamenle! Nyamenle ɛyila mɔɔ lua Awulae duma nu ɛlɛba la! 10Nyamenle ɛyila yɛ ze Devidi Belemgbunlililɛ ne mɔɔ ɛlɛba la. Ayɛlɛyelɛ ɛha Nyamenle!”
11Gyisɛse dwule Gyɛlusalɛm la, ɔhɔwolole Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu, na ɔnleɛnleanle nuhua ninyɛne ɔyiale. Na kɛmɔ ɛnee aleɛ asɛɛ ɛdwo la ati, ɔ nee ye ɛdoavolɛma bulu nee nwiɔ ne ziale hɔle Bɛtani.
Gyisɛse wa feege baka ne amonle
(Mat 21.18-19)
12Aleɛ hyenle na bɛvi Bɛtani bɛsia la, ɛhɔne hunle Gyisɛse. 13Ɔnwunle feege baka bie mɔɔ ɛwula buzuu la wɔ moa moa lɔ, na ɔhɔle nwolɛ saa ɔkɛnyia ma bie wɔ zolɛ a. Ɔhɔdwule nwolɛ la, nya ala a ɔnwunle ye wɔ zolɛ a, ɔluakɛ ɛnee mekɛ ɛtɛdwule mɔɔ zɔhane mbaka ne mɔ so a. 14Gyisɛse zele feege baka ne kɛ, “Awie ɛnrɛli wɔ ma bieko ɛlɛ!”
Na ye ɛdoavolɛma ne dele mɔɔ ɔhanle la.
Gyisɛse kɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu
(Mat 21.12-17; Luk 19.45-48; Dw 2.13-22)
15Bɛdwule Gyɛlusalɛm la, Gyisɛse hɔle Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu na ɔvoanle bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛdi gua wɔ nu la amuala. Ɔbutubutule bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛsenza ezukoa la ɛkponle ne mɔ nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛtɔne mɔlɔnoma la mbia ne mɔ, 16na yeammaa adenle yeammaa awie biala anzoa debie ampɛ nu wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu. 17 Akee ɔhilehilele menli ne na ɔzele kɛ, “Bɛhɛlɛ ye Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne anu kɛ Nyamenle se, ‘Bɛbavɛlɛ me Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne maanle maanle nzɛlɛlɛ sua’; na bɛmɛ bɛhakyi ye awulema fealeka.”
18Sɛlɛvolɛ mgbanyinli nee mɛla kilehilevolɛma ne mɔ dele ɛhye la, bɛbɔle ɔ bo kɛ bɛkpondɛ adenle bɛalua zolɛ bɛahu Gyisɛse. Noko bɛzulole, ɔluakɛ ye ngilehilelɛ ne zinle menli dɔɔnwo ne amuala anwo.
19Ye nɔsolɛ nu, Gyisɛse nee ye ɛdoavolɛma ne vile suakpole ne azo hɔle.
Feege baka ne anwo ɛzukoalɛdeɛ
(Mat 21.20-22)
20Nwonlomɔ mangyee ne mɔɔ bɛlua adenle ne anu la, bɛnwunle kɛ feege baka ne ɛwu bɔkɔɔ. 21Na Pita hakyele mɔɔ zile la na ɔhanle ɔhilele Gyisɛse kɛ, “Kilehilevolɛ, nea, feege baka ne mɔɔ ɛwale ye amonle la ɛwu.”
22Gyisɛse buale kɛ, “Bɛlie Nyamenle bɛli. 23 Bɛhakye ɛhye: saa bɛdie Nyamenle bɛdi, na bɛanzu kpolera wɔ bɛ ahonle nu, na bɛdie bɛdi bɔkɔɔ kɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛha la kɛyɛ ɛkɛ a, bɛbahola bɛaze boka ɛhye kɛ, ‘Tudu kɔdɔ nyevile nu,’ na ɔkɛyɛ zɔhane. 24Ɛhye ati meka meahile bɛ, saa bɛsɛlɛ bɛabiza debie a, bɛlie bɛli kɛ bɛ sa ɛha ye, na debie biala mɔɔ bɛkɛbiza la, Nyamenle kɛva kɛmaa bɛ. 25 Na saa bɛgyi bɛlɛsɛlɛ, na awie ɛvo bɛ a, bɛva bɛhyɛ ye na bɛ Ze mɔɔ wɔ anwuma la ava bɛ ɛtane ahyɛ bɛ. [ 26Na saa bɛanva bɛ gɔnwo mɔ ɛtane bɛangyɛ bɛ a, bɛ Ze mɔɔ wɔ anwuma la ɛnrɛva bɛ nyɛleɛ ɛtane ne mɔ ɛnrɛhyɛ bɛ.”]
Gyisɛse tumi ne anwo kpuyia
(Mat 21.23-27; Luk 20.1-8)
27Bɛradwule Gyɛlusalɛm bieko na Gyisɛse lua Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu la, sɛlɛvolɛ mgbanyinli ne nee mɛla kilehilevolɛma ne nee mgbanyima ne mɔ rale ɔ nwo ɛkɛ 28na bɛbizale ye kɛ, “Duzu tumi a ɛlɛ ye kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ ɛyɛ ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ a? Nwane a manle wɔ tumi ɛhye a?”
29Gyisɛse buale bɛ kɛ, “Medame noko mebiza bɛ edwɛkɛ ko, na saa bɛye me ɔ nloa a, menwɔha tumi holɛ ko mɔɔ mefa meyɛ ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ la menwɔhile bɛ. 30Nienwu a Dwɔn tumi ne mɔɔ ɔvale ɔzɔnenle la vi a, ɔvi sonla anzɛɛ ɔvi Nyamenle ɛkɛ ɔ? Bɛha bɛhile me.”
31Bɛ ngome bɛzule ɛhye anwo kpolera na bɛzele kɛ, “Duzu edwɛkɛ a yɛha a? Saa yɛbua kɛ, ‘Ɔvi Nyamenle ɛkɛ’ a, ɔkɛbiza kɛ, ‘Ɛnee duzu ati a bɛanlie Dwɔn bɛanli ɛ?’ 32Saa yɛka noko kɛ, ‘Ɔvi sonla a…’ ” (Bɛzulole menli ne mɔ, ɔluakɛ ɛnee awie biala ɛlie ɛdo nu kɛ Dwɔn le Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ.) 33Na bɛbuale kɛ, “Yɛnze.”
Gyisɛse zele bɛ kɛ, “Medame noko menrɛha ahenle holɛ ko mɔɔ manle me tumi kɛ menyɛ ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ la menrɛhile bɛ.”

Title: MAK 12
Content:
Ɛrɛlɛ ne mɔɔ fane vanye egyinli ne abunsama ne anwo la
(Mat 21.33-46; Luk 20.9-19)
1 Gyisɛse akee dendɛle hilele bɛ wɔ mrɛlɛ nu zele kɛ, “Nrenya bie zonle ye ɛya, ɔluale vanye ma wɔ nu na ɔhyele nwolɛ, ɔdule kuma mɔɔ bɛbahwihwi vanye ma ne anu nzule bɛagua nu la, na ɔzile tawa mɔɔ bɛfo zo bɛsinza egyinli ne la wɔ nu. Akee ɔvale egyinli ne ɔwulale abunsama asa anu na ɔdule ye adenle. 2Ɛbuhenle ne dwule la, ɔzoanle ye akɛlɛ ko wɔ abunsama ne ɛkɛ kɛ ɔhɔlie ye ɛkpɔ ɛdeɛ ne ɔrɛlɛ ye. 3Abunsama ne zɔle akɛlɛ ne nu, bɛbole ye na bɛmanle ɔvale ɔ sa mgbane ɔziale ɔhɔle. 4Egyinli menle ne zoanle akɛlɛ fofolɛ, na ɔdaye noko bɛbole ye, bɛbobɔle ɔ ti anwo mbaka na bɛzale ye. 5Eza ɔzoanle akɛlɛ bieko, na abunsama ne hunle ye, zɔhane ala yɛɛ bɛyɛle ngɛkɛlɛ dɔɔnwo ne ala a; bɛbole bie mɔ yɛɛ bɛhunle bie mɔ. 6Akee ɔhale egyinli menle ne ara kokye ne mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ ɔsoa ye a. Na nzinlii ɔzoanle ye wɔ abunsama ne ɛkɛ, ɔse, ‘Medie medi kɛ bɛkɛli me ra ye eni.’ 7Na abunsama ne hanle hilele bɛ nwo kɛ, ‘Kɔliagya ne ɛne; bɛmaa yɛyɛ ko yɛhu ye, na ye agyadeɛ ne ɛyɛ yɛ ɛdeɛ.’ 8Na bɛhyele ye bɛhunle ye, na bɛvuandinle ye bɛdole egyinli ne bane ne anzi lɔ.”
9Gyisɛse bizale kɛ, “Ɛnee bɛdabɛ bɛnea a, duzu a vanye egyinli menle ne kɛyɛ a? Ɔkɛra na ɔkɛrahu menli zɔhane mɔ na ɔkɛva egyinli ne ɔkɛwula abunsama fofolɛ asa anu. 10 Meze kɛ bɛgenga Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ɛhye:
‘Bolɛ ko ne ala mɔɔ suasivoma ne kpole la
ɛrayɛ bolɛ mɔɔ anwo hyia kpole kpalɛ
kɛ sua mgbɛnezo sika la.
11Ɛhye, Awulae a yɛle a;
na yɛnea a ɔyɛ nwanwane kpole!’ ”
12Dwuu mgbanyima ne yɛle kɛ bɛkye ye, ɔluakɛ bɛnwunle kɛ ɔbule ɛrɛlɛ ne ɔtiale bɛ. Noko bɛzulole menli dɔɔnwo ne, yemɔti bɛgyakyile ye na bɛhɔle.
Adwuledualɛ nwo kpuyia
(Mat 22.15-22; Luk 20.20-26)
13Bɛzoanle Falasiima nee Hɛlɔdo asa zo ne bie mɔ wɔ Gyisɛse anwo ɛkɛ ne kɛ bɛhɔdo ye abɛla bɛhye ye wɔ edwɛkɛ ɛhanlɛ nu. 14Bɛrale la bɛbizale ye kɛ, “Kilehilevolɛ, yɛze kɛ wɔmɔ ɛnnea sonla nyunlu, yɛɛ ɛndie menli ngehanleɛ, na ɛkilehile Nyamenle ɛhulolɛdeɛ ne nɔhalɛ nu. Na ɛnea a, ɛnee ɔtia yɛ mɛla ne kɛ yɛkɛdua adwule yɛkɛmaa Maanle Maanle Belemgbunli ne ɔ? Ɔwɔ kɛ yɛtua anzɛɛ ɔnle kɛ yɛtua? Ka kile yɛ.”
15Gyisɛse nwunle bɛ nzi na ɔbizale bɛ kɛ, “Duzu ati a bɛra bɛbado me abɛla ɛ? Bɛva dwɛtɛ ne mɔɔ bɛdi la ko bɛrɛla bɛmaa menea.”
16Bɛvale bie bɛmanle ye, na ɔbizale bɛ kɛ, “Nwane nvoninli nee ye duma a le ɛhye mɔ?”
Bɛbuale kɛ, “Siza ɔ.” 17Na Gyisɛse zele bɛ kɛ, “Aa, ɛnee noko bɛva mɔɔ le Siza ɛdeɛ la bɛmaa ye ɛ, na bɛva mɔɔ le Nyamenle ɛdeɛ la bɛmaa ye.”
Na Gyisɛse anwo yɛle bɛ ɛzulolɛ kpole.
Ewudwazo nwo kpuyia
(Mat 22.23-33; Luk 20.27-40)
18 Mgbanyinli bie mɔɔ boka Sadusiima fane ne anwo la rale Gyisɛse ɛkɛ ne. Menli ɛhye mɔ se saa sonla wu a Nyamenle ɛnrɛdwazo ye. 19 Bɛbizale Gyisɛse kɛ, “Kilehilevolɛ, Mosisi hɛlɛle mɛla ɛhye manle yɛ, ɔse, ‘Saa nrenya wu na ɔgyakyi ɔ ye mɔɔ ɔ nee ye anwo la a, ɔwɔ kɛ ɔ diema gya kunlanvolɛ raalɛ ne na ɔ nee ye wo mralɛ maa ɔ diema ne mɔɔ ɛwu la.’ 20Na ɛnee mediema nsuu bie wɔ ɛkɛ. Bɛ nuhua kpanyinli ne gyale raalɛ na ɔ nee ye anwo na yeawu. 21Adiema ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nwiɔ la gyale raalɛ ne, na ɔdaye noko ɔ nee ye anwo na yeawu. 22Zɔhane ala yɛɛ adiema ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nsa nee mediema mɔɔ hale la amuala gyale raalɛ ne a, noko biala nee ye anwo na yeawu. 23Ɛnee akee saa mɔwuamra dwazo ba ngoane nu wɔ ewudwazo kenle ne a, nwane aye a le raalɛ ye mɔɔ mediema nsuu ne amuala gyale ye bie la?”
24Gyisɛse buale bɛ kɛ, “Bɛvo kpole! Na bɛze ɔ bo ɔ? Yemɔ a le kɛ bɛnze Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne, yɛɛ bɛnze ye tumi ne. 25Ɔluakɛ saa mɔwuamra dwazo ba ngoane nu a, bɛbayɛ kɛ anwuma soanvolɛma la, agyalɛ biala ɛnle ɛkɛ. 26 Akee mɔɔ fane mɔwuamra ɛdwazolɛ ne, asoo bɛtɛkengale ye Mosisi buluku ne anu kɛ Nyamenle hanle hilele ye wɔ ɛbɔ ne anu kɛ, ‘Mame a mele Ebileham nee Ayezeke nee Gyekɔbo Nyamenle ne a?’ 27Ɛhye kile kɛ ɔle teasema Nyamenle, na ɔnle bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwu la Nyamenle. Bɛvo kpole kpalɛ.”
Mɛla ne anu titile ne
(Mat 22.34-40; Luk 10.25-28)
28 Ɛnee mɛla kilehilevolɛ ko bie wɔ ɛkɛ. Ɔdele edwɛkɛbizalɛ ne na ɔnwunle kɛ Gyisɛse ɛmaa Sadusiima mualɛ kɛnlɛma gyɛlɛɛnye, yemɔti ɔbizale ye kɛ, “Mɛla ne anu boni a le titile kpalɛ kpalɛ a?”
29 Gyisɛse buale kɛ, “Ɛhye a le mɛla ne anu titile kpalɛ kpalɛ a: ‘Yizilayɛma, bɛdie! Awulae yɛ Nyamenle ne a le Awulae kokye ne a. 30Fa wɔ ahonle muala, wɔ ɛkɛla muala, wɔ adwenle muala, nee wɔ anwosesebɛ muala kulo Awulae wɔ Nyamenle ne.’ 31 Mɛla ne anu titile kpalɛ kpalɛ mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nwiɔ la a le ɛhye: ‘Kulo ɛ gɔnwo sonla kɛ ɛdawɔ ɛ nwo la.’ Mɛla bieko ɛnle ɛkɛ mɔɔ le titile kpalɛ kpalɛ tɛla nwiɔ ɛhye mɔ a.”
32 Mɛla kilehilevolɛ ne zele Gyisɛse kɛ, “Kilehilevolɛ, mo! Ɔle nɔhalɛ, kɛmɔ ɛlɛka la, Awulae angome a le Nyamenle a, nyamenle bieko ɛnle ɛkɛ. 33 Na ɔwɔ kɛ sonla biala fa ye ahonle muala, ye adwenle muala, nee ye anwosesebɛ muala kulo Nyamenle, na ɔkulo ɔ gɔnwo sonla kɛ ɔdaye ɔ nwo la. Ɔhyia kpalɛ kɛ ɛkɛli mɛla nwiɔ ɛhye azo tɛla kɛ ɛkɛva nane nee ninyɛne ɛkɛbɔ azu ɛkɛmaa Nyamenle.”
34Gyisɛse nwunle kɛ yeye edwɛkɛ ne anloa nrɛlɛbɛ nu, yemɔti ɔzele ye kɛ, “Ɛ nee Nyamenle Belemgbunlililɛ ne avinli anwa.”
Ɔvi ɛhye azo awie biala angola anzi ye ahonle ambiza Gyisɛse edwɛkɛ bieko.
Mɛzaya ne anwo kpuyia
(Mat 22.41-46; Luk 20.41-44)
35Gyisɛse kilehile wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu la, ɔbizale kɛ, “Kɛ ɔyɛ mɔɔ mɛla kilehilevolɛma ne ka kɛ Mɛzaya ne le Devidi anlɔnra ɛ? 36 Devidi luale Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne azo hanle kɛ,
‘Awulae zele me Awulae kɛ,
tɛnla me fema zo ɛke,
kɔkpula kɛ menwɔva wɔ agbɔvolɛ
menwɔwula ɛ gyakɛ abo.’
37“Na saa Devidi ɔdaye mumua ne ɔvɛlɛle ye ‘Awulae’ a, ɛnee kɛ ɔyɛ mɔɔ Mɛzaya ne yɛ ye anlɔnra ɛ?”
Gyisɛse bɔ kɔkɔ wɔ Mɛla kilehilevolɛma anwo
(Mat 23.1-36; Luk 20.45-47)
Ɛnee menli dɔɔnwo lɛ fɛlɛko ɛlɛtie Gyisɛse. 38Na mɔɔ ɔlɛkilehile la ɔhanle kɛ, “Bɛnlea boɛ wɔ mɛla kilehilevolɛma anwo. Ninyɛne mɔɔ bɛkulo la a le adɛladeɛ ndendenle ɛwulalɛ nee gua zo ɛkpɔsalɛ, amaa menli abɔ bɛ ti aze abiza bɛ ahye. 39Kenle biala bɛkulo kɛ bɛkɛnyia nyianu azua ne mɔ anu mbia kpalɛ ne mɔ azo bɛkɛdɛnla. 40Bɛbɛlɛbɛla ahunlanvolɛ mraalɛ bɛbɔ bɛ awuke ne mɔ na bɛakpati bɛayɛ nwolɛ nzɛlɛlɛ ndendenle. Bɛ ndeanlɛ bayɛ kpole kpalɛ!”
Raalɛ kunlanvolɛ ne azubɔdeɛ ne
(Luk 21.1-4)
41Gyisɛse dɛnlanle Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu ɛleka mɔɔ gya nlɛka ne mɔ gyigyi la, na ɔnleanle menli mɔɔ lɛ ezukoa ɛlɛgua gya ne anu la. Sukoavolɛma dɔɔnwo vale ezukoa mgbole raguale nu, 42akee raalɛ kunlanvolɛ ehyianli bie ɔdaye ɔvale ɛkpɔsɛba nwiɔ ɔraguale nu. 43Gyisɛse vɛlɛle ye ɛdoavolɛma ne amuala na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Nɔhalɛ, raalɛ kunlanvolɛ ehyianli ɛhye ɛva mɔɔ le kpole tɛla awie biala ɛdeɛ ne la ɛgua gya ne anu. 44Ɔluakɛ bɛdabɛ kɔsɔɔti, mɔɔ bɛlɛ ye la anwo nvasoɛ ne bie a bɛvale bɛraguale gya ne anu a, na raalɛ kunlanvolɛ ne, yemɔ ye kpokpoti ne ala a yeva yeragua nu la.”

Title: MAK 13
Content:
Gyisɛse ka Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne ɛzɛkyelɛ nwo edwɛkɛ
(Mat 24.1-2; Luk 21.5-6)
1Mɔɔ Gyisɛse vi Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu finde la, ye ɛdoavolɛma ne mɔ ko hanle kɛ, “Kilehilevolɛ! Nea awolɛ mgbole ngɛnlɛma bie mɔɔ bɛvale bɛzile azua mgbole ɛhye mɔ a!”
2Gyisɛse buale ye kɛ, “Wɔnwu azua mgbole ɛhye mɔ? Bolɛ ko bɔbɔ ɛnrɛla bolɛ zo mɔɔ bɛnrɛdwula ye aze a.”
Ngyegyelɛ nee kpɔdekpɔdeyɛlɛ
(Mat 24.3-14; Luk 21.7-19)
3Gyisɛse hɔdɛnlanle Ɔlivi Boka ne azo, ɛleka mɔɔ ɔnwu Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne la. Pita, Gyemise, Dwɔn, yɛɛ Andelu rahanle hilele ye kɛ, 4“Ka kenle mɔɔ ɛhye mɔ kɛzi la kile yɛ, na ka debie mɔɔ bazi ahile kɛ mekɛ ɛdwu mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ sisi la noko kile yɛ.”
5Gyisɛse zele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛnlea boɛ na awie ambɛlɛbɛla bɛ. 6Menli dɔɔnwo balua me duma nu ara, na bɛaraha kɛ, ‘Mame a mele Mɛzaya ne!’ na bɛabɛlɛbɛla dɔɔnwo ne ala. 7Noko saa konle si na ɔbikye bɛ, anzɛɛ bɛte kɛ konle ɛzi moa moa maanle bie anu a, bɛmmamaa bɛ ahonle tu. Ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ bazi, noko ɛnee awieleɛ ne ɛtɛdwule ɛkɛ. 8Maanle nee maanle baho, na arelemgbunli adwazo atia bɛ nwo. Azɛlɛ bakpusu ɛleka biala, yɛɛ ɛhɔne bara, noko ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ le kɛ awolɛ nyane la.
9 “Na bɛmɛ, bɛnlea bɛ nwo boɛ kpalɛ. Bɛbahye bɛ bɛahɔ kɔɔto. Bɛbabo bɛ wɔ nyianu azua ne mɔ anu; ɔlua me ti, bɛbagyinla mgbanyima nee arelemgbunli nyunlu na bɛaha Edwɛkpa ne bɛahile bɛ. 10Na saa ɔkɛra ye zɔhane bɔbɔ a, kyesɛ bɛdumua bɛbɔ Edwɛkpa ne nolo bɛkile maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti. 11Saa bɛkye bɛ bɛ nee bɛ kɔ kɔɔto a, bɛmmadumua bɛdwenledwenle edwɛkɛ mɔɔ bɛbaha la anwo. Mekɛ ne dwu a bɛdendɛ, ɔluakɛ edwɛkɛ mɔɔ bɛbaha la vi Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne. 12Mediema baye mediema amaa kɛ bɛhu bɛ, yɛɛ selɛma baye bɛ mra amaa. Ngakula badwazo bɛ awovolɛma anwo zo na bɛaye bɛ bɛamaa bɛahu bɛ. 13 Ɔlua me ti, awie biala bakpɔ bɛ. Na mɔɔ kɛgyinla kpundii kɛhɔ awieleɛ la kɛnyia ngoane mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ.
Munzudeɛ mɔɔ bɔ maanle
(Mat 24.15-28; Luk 21.20-24)
14 “Saa bɛnwu ‘Munzudeɛ ne mɔɔ bɔ maanle la’ kɛ ɔgyi ɛleka mɔɔ ɔnle kɛ ɔgyinla la a, (Kengavolɛ, te ɛhye abo!) ɛnee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ Dwudiya la, bɛnriandi bɛhɔ awoka ne mɔ azo. 15 Awie mɔɔ gyi ye sua ti zo la mmaka kɛ ɔdwu aze yeahɔ ye sua ne anu kɛ ɔkava debie. 16Mɔɔ ɛhɔ ɛbɔ nu noko la mmasia ba sua zo kɛ ɔbava ye tɛladeɛ. 17Mekɛ ne anu, mraalɛ mɔɔ ɛva ɛkolɛ nee mrɛladane mraalɛ mɔɔ bɛ mra no nyɛfonlɛ la, bɛ gyakɔ! 18Bɛzɛlɛ Nyamenle na anwongyelelɛ ɛhye amba fɔsɛlɛ nu. 19 Ɔluakɛ mekɛ ne anu anwongyelelɛ ne bayɛ ɛzulolɛ kpalɛ mɔɔ sumunli kɛ Nyamenle bɔle ewiade toonwo mɔɔ yeradwu bekezɛ la, bie ɛtɛsile ɛlɛ, yɛɛ bie noko ɛnrɛzi ɛlɛ. 20Na Awulae ɛnlea ye menli ne mɔɔ yekpa nu yeye bɛ la ati yede mekɛ ne azo, anrɛɛ sonla ko bɔbɔ ɛnrɛha.
21“Saa awie biala se bɛ kɛ, ‘Nea, Mɛzaya ne wɔ ɛke’ anzɛɛ ‘Nea, yemɔ a wɔ nehane la’ a, bɛmmadie ye bɛdi. 22Ɔluakɛ Mɛzayama nee Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma alane dɔɔnwo bara. Bɛbaye ngonyia, bɛayɛ nwanwane ninyɛne mgbole kɛ bɛfa bɛabɛlɛbɛla Nyamenle menli ne mɔɔ yekpa nu yeye bɛ la saa ɔkɛyɛ boɛ a. 23Bɛnlea bɛ nwo boɛ! Kɛ meha debie biala mehile bɛ kolaa na ɛhye mɔ azi ɛ!
Sonla Ra ne ɛralɛ
(Mat 24.29-31; Luk 21.25-28)
24 “Mekɛ ne anu, wɔ anwongyelelɛ ne anzi, awozinli baheda sɛnzɛne ne azo, siane ɛnrɛda bieko, 25 nwɔlɔra badudu agua aze, yɛɛ bɛbadudu anwumaneamra bɛavi bɛ ndenle ne mɔ azo. 26 Akee bɛbanwu medame Sonla Ra kɛ melua amungu nu melɛba wɔ tumi bedevinli nee anyunlunyia nu. 27Mebamaa anwuma soanvolɛma ahɔ ewiade muleɛ ne amuala azo ahɔhuohua Nyamenle menli ne mɔɔ yekpa nu yeye bɛ la anloa, ɔvi ewiade ye ati yeahɔkpula ɔ bo.
Feege baka ne anwo ɛzukoalɛdeɛ
(Mat 24.32-35; Luk 21.29-33)
28“Bɛnlea feege baka ne na bɛzukoa nrɛlɛbɛ wɔ nwolɛ. Mekɛ mɔɔ ɔkɛbolo na ye ngane ne kɛze kɛ bɛfefɛ nya la, ɛnee bɛze kɛ wawaa ɛbikye. 29Zɔhane ala yɛɛ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛnwu kɛ ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ ɛbɔ ɔ bo ɛlɛsisi la, ɛnee bɛhakye kɛ Mɛzaya ne ɛralɛ ɛbikye a. 30Bɛhakye ɛhye! Ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ basisi wɔ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ kɛkala bɛde aze la dɔɔnwo ne ala anye zo. 31Anwuma nee aze bapɛ nu aze, na me nloa edwɛkɛ ɛdeɛ, ɔnrɛpɛ nu ɛlɛ.
Awie biala ɛnze kenle ne anzɛɛ mekɛ ne
(Mat 24.36-44)
32 “Awie biala ɛnze kenle ne anzɛɛ dɔnehwele ko ne. Anwuma soanvolɛma yɛɛ Ralɛ ne bɔbɔ ɛnze. Selɛ ne angome ala a ze a. 33Bɛzinza na bɛnlea boɛ, ɔluakɛ bɛnze kenle ne mɔɔ mekɛ ne kɛdwu la. 34 Ɛhye le kɛ nrenya bie mɔɔ ɛlɛtu adenle na yeva ye awuke yewula ye sonvolɛma asa nu la. Biala nee ye gyima, na ɔse mɔɔ nea anlenkɛ kpole ne la kɛ ɔzinza. 35Zɔhane ati bɛzinza, ɔluakɛ bɛnze mekɛ mɔɔ awuke menle ne bara la, saa nɔsolɛ nu anzɛɛ alevinli mu nwiɔ avinli o, saa akɔlɛmɔleɛ anzɛɛ sɛnzɛnduduleɛ o. 36Saa ɔba arɛlevilɛ nu a, ɔnle kɛ ɔbato bɛ kɛ bɛdeda. 37Mɔɔ meka meahile bɛ la, meka meahile awie biala: Bɛzinza!”

Title: MAK 14
Content:
Bɛkɔ Gyisɛse ati akpamo
(Mat 26.1-5; Luk 22.1-2; Dw 11.45-53)
1 Mɔɔ ɔhale kenle nwiɔ na Akpabɛnwo nee Angye Ɛvoyia ne adwu la, sɛlɛvolɛ mgbanyinli ne nee mɛla kilehilevolɛma ne mɔ kpondɛle adenle mɔɔ bɛdua zo bɛahye Gyisɛse ahane ɛleka bie bɛahu ye la, ɔluakɛ bɛse, 2“Ɔnle kɛ yɛyɛ ye zɔhane wɔ ɛvoyialilɛ ne anu, anrɛɛ menli ne kɛli nzaka.”
Bɛgua Gyisɛse anatele wɔ Bɛtani
(Mat 26.6-13; Dw 12.1-8)
3 Ɛnee Gyisɛse wɔ Saemɔn mɔɔ anrɛɛ le kokobɛvolɛ la sua nu wɔ Bɛtani. Mɔɔ ɛnee Gyisɛse ɛlɛkpula ɔ sa la, raalɛ bie vale anatele evuanlɛ bie mɔɔ ye bolɛ yɛ se kpalɛ na bɛvale “naade” a bɛyɛle la wɔ “alabaseta” bolɛ toba nu rabɔle ye guale Gyisɛse ati zo. 4Menli mɔɔ wɔ ɛkɛ ne la bie mɔ vale ɛya na bɛhanle kɛ, “Na duzu ati a bɛzɛkye anatele evuanlɛ ye ɛ? 5Anrɛɛ bɛkola bɛtɔne ye bɛdie ezukoa ala mɔɔ bo etaku nna nna ɛya nsa la na bɛfa bɛnea ehyianvolɛma!” Na bɛdendɛle raalɛ ne kpalɛ.
6Gyisɛse zele kɛ, “Bɛgyakyi ye! Bɛmmagyegye ye. Yeli gyima kɛnlɛma yemaa me. 7 Bɛmɛ, bɛ nee ehyianvolɛma de dahuu, yɛɛ mekɛ biala mɔɔ bɛkulo la, bɛkola bɛboa bɛ; na mame, me nee bɛ ɛnrɛdɛnla dahuu. 8Yeyɛ mɔɔ ɔkɛhola la; yewola anatele ye yegua me sonlabaka ye anwo yeva yeziezie ye kolaa na bɛazie ye. 9Bɛhakye ɛhye! Ewiade ye anu ɛleka biala mɔɔ menli kɛbɔ Edwɛkpa ne nolo la, bɛkɛha debie mɔɔ raalɛ ye ɛyɛ la bɛkɛva bɛkɛhakye ye.”
Dwudase kponle zo kɛ ɔkɛye Gyisɛse ɔkɛmaa
(Mat 26.14-16; Luk 22.3-6)
10Dwudase Yesekaleɔto mɔɔ le ɛdoavolɛma bulu nee nwiɔ ne mɔ anu ko la hɔle sɛlɛvolɛ mgbanyinli ne mɔ ɛkɛ ne kɛ ɔkaye Gyisɛse yeamaa bɛ. 11Ɛhye yɛle sɛlɛvolɛ mgbanyinli ne mɔ fɛ kpole, na bɛbɔle ye ɛwɔkɛ kɛ bɛkɛmaa ye nwolɛ ezukoa. Na ɔvi mekɛ ne anu Dwudase bɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɔkpondɛ adenle yealua zolɛ yeaye Gyisɛse yeamaa.
Gyisɛse nee ye ɛdoavolɛma di Akpabɛnwo Ɛvoyia aleɛ ne
(Mat 26.17-25; Luk 22.7-14,21-23; Dw 13.21-30)
12Angye Ɛvoyia kenle ne mɔɔ lumua la yɛɛ bɛku mboane mralɛ bɛto Akpabɛnwo Ɛvoyia aleɛ ne a. Kenle zɔhane dwule la Gyisɛse ɛdoavolɛma ne mɔ bizale ye kɛ, “Nienwu a ɛkulo kɛ yɛkɔsiezie Akpabɛnwo Ɛvoyia aleɛ ne a?”
13Na Gyisɛse zoanle bɛ nuhua nwiɔ kɛ, “Bɛhɔ suakpole ne azo na bɛ nee nrenya bie mɔɔ zo dwora mɔɔ nzule wɔ nu la bayia. Bɛdoa ye, 14bɛ nee ye ɛhɔ sua mɔɔ ɔkɛhɔ nu la anu na bɛze sua menle ne kɛ, ‘Kilehilevolɛ ne se: Ekpumgbunli ne mɔɔ me nee me ɛdoavolɛma ne bali Akpabɛnwo Ɛvoyia aleɛ ne wɔ nu la wɔ nienwu?’ 15Na ɔbahile bɛ anwuma ekpumgbunli kpole bie mɔɔ bɛziezie nu dɛba la. Bɛdo Akpabɛnwo Ɛvoyia aleɛ ɛkponle ne wɔ ɛkɛ.”
16Ɛdoavolɛma ne zile nu hɔle suakpole ne azo, na bɛhɔnwunle debie biala, kɛmɔ Gyisɛse hanle hilele bɛ ala la, na bɛdole Akpabɛnwo Ɛvoyia aleɛ ɛkponle ne.
17Aleɛ muanle nwolɛ la, Gyisɛse nee ye ɛdoavolɛma bulu nee nwiɔ ne rale. 18 Na mɔɔ bɛde ɛkponle ne anwo bɛlɛdi debie la, Gyisɛse zele bɛ kɛ, “Nɔhalɛ, meka meahile bɛ kɛ, bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ nee me yɛ sa wɔ ɛyɛba ye anu la, bɛ nuhua ko baye me amaa.”
19Ɛhye yɛle ɛdoavolɛma ne mɔ nyane na bɛbizale ye ngoko ngoko kɛ, “Ɛnee mame ɔ?”
20Gyisɛse buale kɛ, “Bɛdabɛ bulu nee nwiɔ ye anu ko ala ɔ. 21Na mame Sonla Ra, mebawu, kɛmɔ Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se la, na ahenle mɔɔ baye me amaa la, ye gyakɔ. Ɔle kpalɛ kɛ anrɛɛ bɛanwo ye!”
Awulae aleɛ ne
(Mat 26.26-30; Luk 22.14-20; 1 Kɔl 11.23-25)
22Mɔɔ bɛgua zolɛ bɛlɛdi aleɛ ne la, Gyisɛse vale kpanwo, ɔyɛle Nyamenle mo, ɔbubule nu ɔvale ɔmanle ye ɛdoavolɛma ne na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛlie bɛli, ɛhye a le me nwonane ne a.”
23Akee ɔvale dwora ne mɔɔ nwanye ne wɔ nu la, ɔyɛle Nyamenle mo, ɔvale ɔmanle ye ɛdoavolɛma ne mɔ amuala nlonle bie 24 na ɔzele kɛ, “Ɛhye a le me mogya ne mɔɔ bɛbahwi bɛamaa menli dɔɔnwo na ɔsɔ Nyamenle ngyekyeleɛ ne anloa la. 25Nɔhalɛ, menrɛnlo nwanye ɛhye bieko, kyesɛ Nyamenle Belemgbunlililɛ nu na meanlo nwanye bieko.”
26Akee bɛdole ayɛlɛyelɛ edwɛne na bɛvindele bɛhɔle Ɔlivi Boka ne azo.
Gyisɛse se Pita bakpo ye
(Mat 26.31-35; Luk 22.31-34; Dw 13.36-38)
27 Akee Gyisɛse zele ye ɛdoavolɛma ne mɔ kɛ, “Bɛ muala bɛbanriandi me, ɔluakɛ Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se, ‘Nyamenle bahu mboaneneavolɛ ne, na mboane ne mɔ amuala babɔ asande.’ 28 Noko Nyamenle badwazo me ara ngoane nu na mealumua bɛ nyunlu wɔ Galeli.”
29Pita buale kɛ, “Saa bɛ muala bɛnriandi wɔ a, me ngome ɛdeɛ, menrɛnriandi wɔ ɛlɛ.”
30Gyisɛse zele Pita kɛ, “Kakye ɛhye, ɔ nee mɔɔ akɔlɛ kabɔ fane nwiɔ la, ɛnee ɛdawɔ, wɔha ye fane nsa ɛnɛ nɔe kɛ ɛnze me.”
31Pita vuale kɛ, “Ewule nu bɔbɔ a, menrɛha kɛ menze wɔ!”
Na ɛdoavolɛma mɔɔ hale la noko vuale zɔhane ala.
Gyisɛse yɛ nzɛlɛlɛ wɔ Gɛtesɛmani
(Mat 26.36-46; Luk 22.39-46)
32Gyisɛse nee ye ɛdoavolɛma ne hɔle ɛleka bie mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Gɛtesɛmani la, na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛdɛnla ɛke na mekazɛlɛ.” 33Ɔvale Pita, Gyemise, yɛɛ Dwɔn kɛ bɛhɔzɔho ye. Nyane nee alɔbɔlɛ hanle Gyisɛse somaa, 34na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Nyane ɛha me dedee yeha me ɛkɛla mɔɔ wɔ me nu la. Bɛdɛnla ɛke na bɛzinza.”
35Akee ɔhɔle ɔ nyunlu ekyii, ɔdule ɔdɔle na ɔzɛlɛle kɛ, saa ɔyɛ na ɔkɛyɛ boɛ a, anrɛɛ ɛnee amaneɛnwunlɛ ɛhye akpa ɔ ti. 36Na ɔzɛlɛle kɛ, “Egya! Me Papa, ɛkola debie biala yɛ; ye amaneɛnwunlɛ kɔpo ɛhye ɛkɛ ne maa me; noko akee, tɛ kɛmɔ mame mekulo la ɔ, na kɛmɔ wɔ ɛhulolɛdeɛ ne de la ɔ.”
37Ɔziale ɔrale na ɔranwunle kɛ ɛdoavolɛma nsa ne ɛlafe. Ɔbizale Pita kɛ, “Saemɔn, wɔlafe? Wɔangola wɔanzinza dɔnehwele ko bɔbɔ?” 38Na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛzinza, bɛzɛlɛ na bɛangɔndɔ munzule nu. Sunsum ne kulo na nwonane ne ɛngola.”
39Ɔhɔle bieko na ɔhɔzɛlɛle ɔhanle edwɛkɛ ko ne ala. 40Ɔziale ɔrale na eza ɔranwunle kɛ ɛdoavolɛma ne ɛdeda; bɛte bɛ nye a ɔnde, yɛɛ bɛnnwu edwɛkɛ mɔɔ bɛka bɛahile ye a.
41Ɔziale ɔ nzi mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ fane nsa ne la, ɔbizale bɛ kɛ, “Bɛtɛda? Yeyɛ boɛ! Mekɛ ne ɛdwu! Bɛnlea, kɛkala bɛye Sonla Ra ne bɛwula ɛtanevolɛma asa anu. 42Bɛdwazo bɛmaa yɛhɔ. Bɛnlea, sonla ne mɔɔ ɛye me ɛmaa la ɛne!”
Gyisɛse ɛhyelɛ ne
(Mat 26.47-56; Luk 22.47-53; Dw 18.3-12)
43Gyisɛse anloa wɔ zo ɔlɛtendɛ la yɛɛ Dwudase, mɔɔ le ɛdoavolɛma ne mɔ anu ko la nee ɛlɔne mɔɔ dedɛ dadeɛ nee ahoholombaka la rale a. Sɛlɛvolɛ mgbanyinli ne nee mɛla kilehilevolɛma ne yɛɛ mgbanyima ne mɔ a zoanle bɛ a. 44Mɔɔ yele ye manle la ɛmaa ɛlɔne ne ɛde ɔ bo kɛ, “Sonla ne mɔɔ menwɔvo ɔ nloa anwo la a le ahenle ne mɔɔ bɛkpondɛ ye la. Bɛhye ye na bɛnlea ye boɛ bɛva ye bɛhɔ.”
45Dwudase dwule ɛkɛ ne ala la, ɔhɔle Gyisɛse anwo ɛkɛ ne na ɔhɔzele ye kɛ, “Kilehilevolɛ!” na ɔvole ɔ nloa anwo. 46Ɛkɛ ne ala ɛlɔne ne zɔle Gyisɛse nu. 47Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛgyigyi ɛkɛ ne la ko hwenle dadeɛ na ɔpɛle Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli ne akɛlɛ ne anzo. 48Gyisɛse bizale ɛlɔne ne kɛ, “Ɛnee bɛnea a mele awule ati a bɛdedɛ ahoholombaka nee dadeɛ bɛra bɛbahye me a? 49 Mekɛ dɔɔnwo mɔɔ ɛnee me nee bɛ wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu melɛkilehile la, duzu ati a bɛangye me ɛ? Noko ɔwɔ kɛ mɔɔ bɛha ye wɔ Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne anu la yɛ zɔhane.”
50Ɛkɛ ne ala ɛdoavolɛma ne amuala nriandile gyakyile Gyisɛse.
51Kpavolɛ bie mɔɔ heda kisane ala la a ɛnee doa Gyisɛse a. Ɛlɔne ne yɛle kɛ bɛkye ye la, 52ɔdaye noko ɔkpale ye ɛdanlɛ ne ɔmanle bɛ na ɔnriandile ɔhɔle.
Gyisɛse gyi mgbanyima ayia ne anyunlu
(Mat 26.57-68; Luk 22.54-55,63-71; Dw 18.13-14,19-24)
53Bɛvale Gyisɛse bɛhɔle Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli ne sua nu. Sɛlɛvolɛ mgbanyinli ne, mgbanyima ne, yɛɛ mɛla kilehilevolɛma ne mɔ rayiale ɛkɛ. 54Pita doale bɛ nanamogya toonwo ɔhɔle Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli ne alie ne anwo, na ɔdɛnlanle sinzavolɛma ne mɔ anwo ɛkɛ ɔdele senle. 55Sɛlɛvolɛ mgbanyinli ne nee ayiama ne mɔ amuala bɔle mɔdenle kɛ bɛkɛnyia edwɛkɛ bɛkɛtia Gyisɛse na bɛahu ye, noko bɛannyia bie. 56Menli dɔɔnwo lile daselɛ adalɛ tiale ye, noko bɛ nuhua nwiɔ bɔbɔ anloa anyɛ ko.
57Akee menli bie dwazole lile daselɛ adalɛ ɛhye tiale Gyisɛse. Bɛse, 58 “Yɛdele kɛ ɔlɛka kɛ, ‘Mebabubu Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ɛhye mɔɔ menli ɛzi la, na ye kenle nsa ne anzi meazi bie mɔɔ tɛ menli a zile la.’ ” 59Noko bɔbɔ, bɛdabɛ bɛ nloa anyɛ ko.
60Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli ne dwazole gyinlanle na ɔbizale Gyisɛse kɛ, “Ɛnlɛ edwɛkɛ biala ɛnga wɔ ɛzonle ye mɔɔ bɛlɛto wɔ la anwo ɔ?”
61Na Gyisɛse andɛ ɔ nloa anu. Eza Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli ne bizale ye kɛ, “Wɔmɔ a ɛle Saleɛnli Nyamenle Ara Mɛzaya ne la ɔ?”
62 Gyisɛse buale ye kɛ, “Medame ɛne! Akee bɛ muala bɛbanwu medame, Sonla Ra, kɛ mede Tumivolɛ Nyamenle ne asa fema zo na melua amungu ne mɔ anu melɛba!”
63Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli ne suosuanle ɔdaye mumua ne ye tɛladeɛ mɔɔ ɔwula la anu na ɔhanle kɛ, “Yɛngyia alasevolɛ bieko! 64 Bɛde ye munzule edwɛkɛ ne. Kɛ bɛse ɛ?”
Na bɛ muala bɛbuale ye ewule fɔlɛ kɛ bɛhu ye.
65Sinzavolɛma ne mɔ bobɔle ɔ nzo nu. Bie mɔ totole nyɛlɛ ɔ nyunlu, bɛkyekyele ɔ nye, bɛwulowulale ye ahutuku na bɛbizale ye kɛ, “Nwane a bɔle wɔ a?”
Pita se ɔnze Gyisɛse
(Mat 26.69-75; Luk 22.56-62; Dw 18.15-18,25-27)
66Pita de alie ne anwo la Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli ne sonvolɛ bɛlɛra ko rale ɛkɛ. 67Ɔnwunle Pita kɛ ɔlɛte senle wɔ ɛkɛ ne la, ɔnleanle ye koonwu na ɔzele kɛ, “Wɔmɔ, ɛ nee Gyisɛse mɔɔ vi Nazalɛte la a lua a?”
68Pita zale kɛ, “Menze ye. Mende mɔɔ ɛlɛka bɔbɔ la abo.” Na ɔdwazole ɔbɔle ɔ ti anuhɔlɛ lɔ. Mekɛ ne anu ala yɛɛ akɔlɛ bɔle a.
69Sonvolɛ bɛlɛra ne nwunle ye ɛkɛ ne na ɔhanle ɔhilele menli mɔɔ gyigyi ɛkɛ ne la kɛ, “Nrenya ɛhye boka bɛ!” 70Na Pita zale bieko.
Ɔyɛle ekyii la, menli mɔɔ gyigyi ɛkɛ ne la zele Pita kɛ, “Nɔhalɛ, ɛboka bɛ, ɔluakɛ ɛdawɔ noko ɛvi Galeli.”
71Pita bɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɔka ndane yeali amonle, na ɔvale ɔzɔle zolɛ kɛ, “Menze nrenya ne mɔɔ bɛlɛka ye edwɛkɛ la!”
72Ɛkɛ ne ala akɔlɛ bɔle bieko, na Pita hakyele mɔɔ Gyisɛse hanle hilele ye la kɛ, “Ɔ nee mɔɔ akɔlɛ kabɔ fane nwiɔ la, ɛnee wɔha ye fane nsa kɛ ɛnze me.” Na ɔdukuele nu ɔzunle.

Title: MAK 15
Content:
Gyisɛse gyi Paelɛte anyunlu
(Mat 27.1-2,11-14; Luk 23.1-5; Dw 18.28-38)
1Nwonlomɔ mangyee ne ala, sɛlɛvolɛ mgbanyinli ne mɔ yiale Dwuu mgbanyima ne, mɛla kilehilevolɛma ne, yɛɛ ayiama ne mɔ amuala na ndɛndɛ ne ala bɛvale adwenle. Bɛguale Gyisɛse nwɔnzɔnwɔnzɔ na bɛvale ye bɛhɔmanle Wulomu Amɛnlado Paelɛte. 2Na Paelɛte bizale ye kɛ, “Wɔmɔ a ɛle Dwuuma belemgbunli ne la ɔ?”
Gyisɛse buale kɛ, “Ɔdaye ne ala a wɔha la.”
3Sɛlɛvolɛ mgbanyinli ne mɔ doɔdoanle Gyisɛse dɔɔnwo kpalɛ, 4yemɔti Paelɛte bizale ye bieko kɛ, “Ɛnrɛbua nwolɛ bie ɔ? Tie edwɛkɛ dɔɔnwo mɔɔ bɛlɛkeha bɛagua ɛ nwo zo la!”
5Noko Gyisɛse andɛ ɔ nloa anu, na ɔyɛle Paelɛte azibɛnwo.
Paelɛte bua Gyisɛse ewule fɔlɛ
(Mat 27.15-26; Luk 23.13-25; Dw 18.39—19.16)
