41Awulae buale ye kɛ, “Maata, Maata! Ninyɛne dɔɔnwo gyegye wɔ sɛkye wɔ adwenle. 42Debie ko ala a hyia a, na Mɛle ɛkpa nu ɛva mɔɔ le kpalɛ la, na bɛnrɛlie ye ɔ sa nu ɛlɛ.”

Title: LUK 11
Content:
Gyisɛse ngilehilelɛ wɔ nzɛlɛlɛ nwo
(Mat 6.9-13; 7.7-11)
1Kenle ko Gyisɛse hɔle ɛleka bie kɛ ɔkayɛ nzɛlɛlɛ. Ɔwiele la, ye ɛdoavolɛma ne anu ko hanle hilele ye kɛ, “Awulae, kile yɛ kɛ bɛsi bɛyɛ nzɛlɛlɛ la, kɛmɔ Dwɔn hilele ye ɛdoavolɛma ne mɔ la.”
2Gyisɛse zele bɛ kɛ, “Saa bɛyɛ nzɛlɛlɛ a bɛha ɛhye:
‘Egya,
Wɔ duma ne anwo ɛde;
wɔ belemgbunlililɛ ɛrɛla.
3Maa yɛ kenle biala yɛ dahuu aleɛ.
4Na fa yɛ ɛtane ne mɔ kyɛ yɛ,
ɔluakɛ awie mɔɔ fo yɛ la, yɛfa yɛkyɛ ye.
Na mmamaa yɛkɔ sɔnea nu.’ ”
5Na Gyisɛse zele ye ɛdoavolɛma ne kɛ, “Saa bɛ nuhua bie lɛ ɔ gɔnwo na ɔkɔ ɔ nwo ɛkɛ ne alevinli mu nwiɔ avinli ɔkɔse ye kɛ, ‘Agɔnwolɛ, fɛne me kpanwo ahunguma nsa, 6ɔluakɛ me gɔnwo bie vi adenle zo ɛra; menlɛ debie biala mɔɔ mefa meamaa ye a’ 7na ɔ gɔnwo ne fea ye sua ne anu bua ye kɛ, ‘Mmagyegye me! Bɛdo anlenkɛ ne anu dɛbadɛba, yɛɛ me nee me mra yɛla; menrɛhola dwazo na meamaa wɔ debie biala.’ 8Meka meahile bɛ: Saa anrɛɛ ɔnrɛdwazo ɔnrɛmaa wɔ kpanwo ne bie kɛmɔ ɛle agɔnwolɛ la ati bɔbɔ a, saa wɔanze ɛvɛlɛ na ɛkɔ zo ɛbiza ye a, ɔbadwazo yeamaa wɔ debie biala mɔɔ ɛhyia nwolɛ la.
9“Yemɔti meka meahile bɛ: Bɛbiza, na bɛ sa kɛha ye; bɛkpondɛ, na bɛkɛnwu ye; bɛbɔ nu, na bɛkɛbuke anlenkɛ ne bɛkɛmaa bɛ. 10Ɔluakɛ awie biala mɔɔ biza la asa ka ye, mɔɔ kpondɛ la nwu ye, yɛɛ bɛkɛdukue anlenkɛ ne bɛkɛmaa awie biala mɔɔ kɛbɔ nu la. 11Bɛ nuhua boni yɛɛ saa ɔ ra biza ye fɛlɛ a, ɔkɛmaa ye ɛwɔlɛ a? 12Anzɛɛ saa ɔbiza ye kolonvia a, ɔkɛmaa ye nyamenleakɛlɛ a? 13Na saa bɛmɛ bɔbɔ mɔɔ bɛle ɛtanevolɛma la, bɛze kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛfa ninyɛne kpalɛ bɛmaa bɛ mra a, ɛnee fane nyɛ yɛɛ Selɛ ne mɔɔ wɔ anwuma la ɛnrɛva Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne ɛnrɛmaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛbiza ye la ɛ?”
Gyisɛse nee Biyɛlezɛbɛle
(Mat 12.22-30; Mak 3.20-27)
14Mekɛ ne anu ɛnee Gyisɛse ɛlɛtu sunsum ɛtane bie mɔɔ le mumule la avi nrenya bie anwo. Ɔdule sunsum ɛtane ne la nrenya ne bɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɔtendɛ, na ɛhye zinle menli ɛwolaa ne anwo kpole, 15 na bɛ nuhua bie mɔ zele kɛ, “Ɔdua mbɔnsam kpanyinli ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Biyɛlezɛbɛle la anwo zo a ɔtu mbɔnsam ne mɔ a.”
16 Menli ne bie mɔ noko mɔɔ ɛnee kpondɛ kɛ bɛsɔ Gyisɛse bɛnea la hanle kɛ ɔyɛ nwanwane sɛkɛlɛneɛ mɔɔ kile kɛ Nyamenle die ye to nu la ɔhile bɛ. 17Na Gyisɛse nwunle bɛ adwenle, na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Maanle biala mɔɔ anu kɛhyɛ nwiɔ la bɔ. 18Yemɔti saa Seetan ɔdaye noko ye belemgbunlililɛ ne anu gyigya na bɛko bɛtia bɛ nwo a, ɛnee kɛ ɔkɛyɛ na yeagyinla ɛ? Bɛse medua Biyɛlezɛbɛle anwo zo a metu mbɔnsam a; 19na saa adenle ɛhye azo a medua metu mbɔnsam a, ɛnee bɛmɛ, kɛ bɛ mra si tu bɛ mbɔnsam ɛ? Bɛdabɛ bɛ mra ne mɔ kile kɛ bɛvo! 20Na saa medua Nyamenle tumi ne azo a metu mbɔnsam a, ɛnee ɛhye kile kɛ Nyamenle Belemgbunlililɛ ne ɛdwu bɛ nwo ɛke dɛbadɛba.
21“Saa katakyie siezie ɔ nwo kɛ ɔsinza ye sua a, ɛnee ye ninyɛne mɔɔ ɔlɛ la amuala anwo le kɔlɔnwo. 22Na saa awie mɔɔ anwo yɛ se tɛla ye la ba na ɔ nee ye bɛko na ɔfo ɔ nwo zo a, ɔsesa ye konle ninyɛne ne mɔɔ le ye nzuzuguazo la ɔkɔ na ɔ nee ye ɛlɔnema bɛkyɛ ninyɛne ne mɔɔ ɔwuale la.
23 “Awie mɔɔ ɛnle me afoa la tia me, yɛɛ mɔɔ ɛmboa ɛmmaa yɛnguohua la bɔ bɛ asande.”
Sunsum ɛtane ne sia
(Mat 12.43-45)
24Gyisɛse zɔle zolɛ hanle kɛ, “Saa sunsum ɛtane fi sonla nwo tu a, ɔduolua ɛleka reresee kɛ ɔkpondɛ ɛleka yealie ye ɛnwomenle, na saa yeannyia bie a, ɔka ɔkile ɔ nwo kɛ, ‘Mesia meahɔ me sua ne mɔɔ mevi nu menvindele la anu.’ 25Ɔsia ɔba na ɔbanwu kɛ bɛkpoɔkpoa nuhua bɛziezie nuhua, noko awie ɛnle nu a, 26akee ɔfinde ɔkɔ na ɔkɔfa sunsum ɛtane nsuu mɔɔ le amumuyɛ tɛla ɔdaye mumua ne la ɔba na bɛbatɛnla ɛkɛ ne, na nzinlii sonla zɔhane gyinlabelɛ sɛkye kpalɛ tɛla alumua ne.”
Nyilalɛ kpalɛ
27Mɔɔ Gyisɛse hanle edwɛkɛ ɛhye la, raalɛ bie manle ɔ ne zo wɔ menli ne anu na ɔhanle kɛ, “Nyilalɛ ɛha raalɛ ne mɔɔ wole wɔ na ɔlile wɔ adane la!”
28Na Gyisɛse buale kɛ, “Bɔbɔ, nyilalɛ ɛha bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛtie Nyamenle edwɛkɛ ne na bɛdi zolɛ la!”
Menli ne biza nwanwane sɛkɛlɛneɛ
(Mat 12.38-42)
29 Akee mɔɔ menli ne rabɔle yiale Gyisɛse la, ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Adwuleso amra ye le ɛtanevolɛma! Bɛkpondɛ nyamenlezo sɛkɛlɛneɛ bɛanlea, na bɛnrɛnyia bie kyesɛ Dwona sɛkɛlɛneɛ ɛdeɛ ne ala. 30 Kɛmɔ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ Dwona yɛle sɛkɛlɛneɛ manle Nenɛvɛma la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ medame Sonla Ra, mebayɛ sɛkɛlɛneɛ meamaa adwuleso amra noko a. 31 Ndɛnebualɛ Kenle ne Hyiba maanle nu Belemgbunli Raalɛ ne badwazo adoɔdoa adwuleso amra, ɔboalekɛ ɔvi ye maanle nu moa moa lɔ ɔdiale asɛɛ azɛlɛ ye foa ko na ɔradiele Sɔlɔmɔn nrɛlɛbɛ ngilehilelɛ ne; noko meka meahile bɛ, awie mɔɔ le kpole tɛla Sɔlɔmɔn la wɔ ɛke. 32 Ndɛnebualɛ Kenle ne, Nenɛvɛma badwazo adoɔdoa bɛmɛ adwuleso amra, ɔluakɛ mɔɔ bɛdele kɛ Dwona ɛlɛbɔ Nyamenle edwɛkɛ ne nolo la, bɛnlunle bɛ nwo wɔ bɛ ɛtane nwo; noko meka meahile bɛ, awie mɔɔ le kpole tɛla Dwona la wɔ ɛke!
Nwonane ne anu wienyi ne
(Mat 5.15; 6.22-23)
33 “Awie biala ɛnzɔ kɛnlaneɛ na ɔnva bondo ɔmbutu zolɛ; ɔfa ɔsie kɛnlaneɛbaka zo anwuma, amaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛba sua ne anu la bɛanwu aze. 34Ɛnyelɛ le sonlabaka ne kɛnlaneɛ. Saa zolɛ te nwaanye a, sonlabaka ne anu le wienyi, yɛɛ saa zolɛ le kisii a, sonlabaka ne anu le awozinli. 35Zɔhane ati bɛnlea boɛ na mɔɔ maa wienyi wɔ bɛ nu la annu, na awozinli anva bɛ. 36Ɔluakɛ saa bɛ sonlabaka ne anu le wienyi, mɔɔ awozinli ɛnle ye kodoka biala anu la a, yɛɛ ɔbada kɛ kɛnlaneɛ la a.”
Gyisɛse twi Falasiima nee mɛla kilehilevolɛma anyunlu
(Mat 23.1-36; Mak 12.38-40)
37Gyisɛse wiele tendɛ la, Falasiima bie dole ɛsalɛ vɛlɛle ye kɛ ɔrɛla ɔmaa bɛkpula bɛ sa. Yemɔti Gyisɛse hɔle na ɔhɔdɛnlanle ɛkponle ne anwo kɛ ɔdi debie. 38Falasiinli ne nwunle kɛ Gyisɛse annrinzi ɔ sa anwo, kɛmɔ bɛ mɛla ne kile la na yeabɔ ɔ bo kɛ ɔdi debie, yemɔti ɔzinle ɔ nwo. 39Na Awulae zele ye kɛ, “Bɛmɛ Falasiima, bɛkpuda bɛ kanrɛlɛ nee bɛ ɛyɛba nwo, noko bɛ ahonle ne mɔ anu, atisesebɛ nee ɛtane ngome ɛyi bɛ tetɛkɛɛ. 40Ahɔnwɔne! Asoo tɛ Nyamenle mɔɔ yɛle nwolɛ ne la a yɛle ɔ kunlu ne noko a? 41Bɛva mɔɔ ɛyi bɛ kanrɛlɛ ne mɔ nee bɛ ɛyɛba ne mɔ la bɛmaa ehyianvolɛma na debie biala anwo kɛde kɛmaa bɛ.
42 “Munzule ɛha bɛdabɛ Falasiima, ɔluakɛ bɛmɛ, bɛkyɛ aledonlɛ nya nya evuanlɛ mɔɔ le kɛ kabɛle nee nya nya evuanlɛ mɔɔ ɛha, mɔɔ bɛfa bɛto aleɛ la anu bulu bɛtu ko bɛmaa Nyamenle, na bɛbu bɛ nye bɛgua pɛlepɛlelilɛ nee Nyamenle anwo ɛhulolɛ zo. Ninyɛne nwiɔ ɛhye yɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛyɛ a, yɛɛ eza ɔnle kɛ bɛbu bɛ nye bɛgua alumua ɛdeɛ ne mɔ azo.
43“Munzule ɛha bɛdabɛ Falasiima! Bɛmɛ, bɛkulo nyianu azua ne mɔ anu mbia ne mɔ mɔɔ wɔ ɔ nyunlu la azo ɛdɛnlanlɛ nee gua zo ahyebizalɛ mɔɔ menli bɔ bɛ ti aze abiza bɛ ahye la. 44Munzule ɛha bɛ, ɔluakɛ bɛle kɛ aziezo sɛka mɔɔ bɛanyɛ ye nzonlɛ la, menli ɛnze la ati bɛtietia zolɛ na bɛmaa evinli ka bɛ.”
45Mɛla kilehilevolɛma ne mɔ anu ko zele ye kɛ, “Kilehilevolɛ, saa ɛka ɛhye a, ɛnee wɔtia yɛ o!”
46Gyisɛse buale kɛ, “Munzule ɛha bɛdabɛ mɛla kilehilevolɛma noko! Bɛmɛ, bɛkyekye adesoa ɛnlomboɛ mɔɔ bɛngola bɛ la bɛsoa menli, noko bɛndenrɛ bɛ sa ɛrɛlɛsɛka ko bɔbɔ bɛnzɔ nu bɛmmaa menli ne ɛnzoa adesoa zɔhane mɔ. 47Munzule ɛha bɛ! Bɛmɛ, bɛyɛ sɛka ngɛnlɛma bɛmaa Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma ne mɔɔ bɛ nlenya mɔ hunle bɛ la. 48Yemɔti bɛdi daselɛ, yɛɛ bɛ kunlu dwo mɔɔ bɛ nlenya mɔ yɛle la anwo, ɔluakɛ bɛ nlenya mɔ hunle Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma ne mɔ, yɛɛ bɛmɛ bɛdole bɛ nla ne mɔ. 49Ɛhye ati a Nyamenle Nrɛlɛbɛ ne hanle la, ɔse: ‘Bɛbayɛ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ mebazoa bɛ wɔ bɛ nwo la kpɔdekpɔde na bɛahu bie mɔ.’ 50Zɔhane ati bɛbadea adwuleso amra noko wɔ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma kɔsɔɔti mɔɔ sumunli kɛ bɛbɔle ewiade la bɛhu bɛ la anwo, 51 ɔvi mekɛ mɔɔ bɛhunle Ebulu, bakpula Zɛkalaya, mɔɔ bɛhunle ye wɔ azukponle ne nee Ɛleka Nwuanzanwuanza ne avinli la anwo zo. Ɛhɛe, mese, bɛbadea adwuleso amra wɔ ɛhye mɔ amuala anwo.
52“Munzule ɛha bɛdabɛ mɛla kilehilevolɛma! Bɛmɛ, bɛdo nrɛlɛbɛ sua ne anlenkɛ ne anu, bɛva ye sanvɛ ne bɛvea; bɛmɛ a bɛnrɛwolo nu, yɛɛ bɛnrɛmaa awie noko ɛnrɛwolo nu!”
53Mɔɔ Gyisɛse vile ɛkɛ ne la, mɛla kilehilevolɛma ne nee Falasiima ne mɔ vale edwɛkɛbizalɛ zɔle ye na bɛgyegyele ye dɔɔnwo, 54kɛ saa ɔ nloa kɛhoati a bɛazɔ ye nu.

Title: LUK 12
Content:
Kɔkɔbɔlɛ wɔ adalɛ nabalaba nwo
(Mat 10.26-27)
1 Menli dɔɔnwo rabɔle yiale ye, mɔɔ ɛnee akee asɛɛ bɛlɛtietia bɛ nwo zo la, Gyisɛse lumuale dendɛle hilele ye ɛdoavolɛma ne mɔ kɛ, “Bɛnlea bɛ nwo boɛ wɔ Falasiima mgbɔvonle ne anwo, meka bɛ adalɛ nabalaba ngilehilelɛ ne 2 Debie biala mɔɔ bɛheda zolɛ la, bɛbadukue zolɛ, yɛɛ debie biala mɔɔ vea la bala ali. 3Yemɔti, edwɛkɛ biala mɔɔ bɛha ye wɔ awozinli nu la, bɛbade ye ewia henlema, yɛɛ edwɛkɛ biala mɔɔ bɛdu ye azukue wɔ sua kunlu la, bɛbabɔ ye nolo wɔ sua ti zo.”
Mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛsulo ye la
(Mat 10.28-31)
4Akee ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Me gɔnwo mɔ, meka meahile bɛ, bɛmmasulo bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkola bɛku nwonane ye ala, na bɛngola bɛnzɛkye ɛkɛla ne la. 5Mekile bɛ mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛsulo ye la; bɛzulo Nyamenle, yemɔ yɛɛ ɔku sonla a ɔlɛ tumi ɔfuandi ye ɛkɛla ɔto senle ne mɔɔ ɛnnu ɛlɛ la anu a. Nɔhalɛ, meka meahile bɛ kɛ bɛzulo yemɔ.
6“Bɛtɔne nyamenleakatiba nnu ɛkpɔsɛba nwiɔ! Noko Nyamenle anye ɛnvo nuhua ko bɔbɔ ɛlɛ. 7Na bɛmɛ, bɛ ti enrinli bɔbɔ bɛdia ɔ muala. Yemɔti bɛmmasulo, ɔluakɛ bɛmɛ, bɛsonle bolɛ kpole bɛtɛla nyamenleakatiba kpolane!
Kelaese ɛlielɛ nee ye ɛkpolɛ
(Mat 10.32-33; 12.32; 10.19-20)
8“Meka meahile bɛ, awie biala mɔɔ kɛbɔ ye te wɔ bagua nu kɛ ɔle me ɛdeɛ la, medame Sonla Ra, mebayɛ ye zɔhane ala meamaa ye wɔ Nyamenle soanvolɛma anyunlu. 9Zɔhane ala yɛɛ mɔɔ kɛhakyi ɔ nzi kɛzi me wɔ bagua nu la, medame Sonla Ra noko menwɔhakyi me nzi menwɔzi ye wɔ Nyamenle soanvolɛma anyunlu a.
10 “Awie biala mɔɔ kɛdendɛ kɛtia Sonla Ra ne la bɛkɛva ye ɛtane bɛkɛhyɛ ye. Na mɔɔ kɛha ɛtane kɛtia Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne la bɛnrɛva bɛnrɛhyɛ ye.
11 “Saa bɛfa bɛ bɛkɔ kɛ bɛkali bɛ edwɛkɛ wɔ nyianu azua ne mɔ anu anzɛɛ amɛnladoma nee arelemgbunli nyunlu a, bɛmmadwenle mɔɔ bɛbaha anzɛɛ kɛ ɔkɛyɛ na bɛalie bɛ nwo la anwo. 12Ɔluakɛ mekɛ ne anu, Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne bahilehile bɛ mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛka la.”
Sukoavolɛ koasea ne anwo ɛrɛlɛ
13Nrenya ko mɔɔ wɔ menli dɔɔnwo ne anu la hanle hilele Gyisɛse kɛ, “Kilehilevolɛ, ka kile me diema ne maa ɔ nee me ɛhyɛ agya ninyɛne ne mɔɔ yɛ ze gyakyile yɛ la.”
14Gyisɛse buale ye kɛ, “Me gɔnwo, nwane a manle me tumi kɛ membua ndɛne anzɛɛ mengyɛ bɛ mu nwiɔ bɛ agya ninyɛne memaa bɛ a?” 15Na ɔzɔle zolɛ ɔzele menli ne amuala kɛ, “Bɛmmayɛ anyebolo wɔ adenle biala anu, ɔboalekɛ sonla ngoane ɛnle ye anwonyia anzɛɛ ye ezukoa kpole mɔɔ ɔlɛ la anu.”
16Na Gyisɛse bule bɛ ɛrɛlɛ ɛhye: “Sukoavolɛ bie woale ɛkɛ mɔɔ ye egyinli nu aleɛ hyenle kpole kpalɛ a. 17Na ɔbɔle ɔ bo ɔdwenlenle nwolɛ kɛ, ‘Menlɛ ɛleka mɔɔ mesie me aleɛ ɛwolaa ɛhye a. Duzu a menyɛ a?’ 18Na ɔzele ɔ nwo kɛ, ‘Ɛhye yɛɛ meyɛ a; megolo me bonwolo dɛba ne mɔ na measisi bie mgbole, na meava me aleɛ nee me ninyɛne ne mɔ amuala meagugua zolɛ. 19Na akee meaze me nwo kɛ, Me ɛkɛla, ɛ ti ɛyɛ boɛ! Wɔnyia ninyɛne kpalɛ dɔɔnwo mɔɔ nee wɔ badwu ɛvolɛ dɔɔnwo a. Die wɔ ɛnwomenle, di, no, na die ɛ nye!’ 20Na Nyamenle zele ye kɛ, ‘Ɛle kɔnwɔne! Ɛnɛ nɔe ala bɛbaye wɔ ngoane ne bɛavi wɔ nuhua; na nwane a bava ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ amuala mɔɔ wɔva wɔzie wɔmaa ɛ nwo la a?’ ”
21Na Gyisɛse dwulale ye edwɛkɛ ne kɛ, “Kɛ menli mɔɔ kuohua anwonyia maa bɛ nwo na bɛnle sukoavolɛma wɔ Nyamenle anyunlu la de la ɛne.”
Fa ɛ rɛle wula Nyamenle anu
(Mat 6.25-34)
22Akee Gyisɛse zele ye ɛdoavolɛma ne kɛ, “Ɛhye ati meka meahile bɛ, bɛmmadwenle aleɛ mɔɔ bɛdi bɛanyia ngoane anzɛɛ ɛdanlɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛheda la anwo. 23Ngoane hyia kpole kpalɛ tɛla aleɛ, yɛɛ sonlabaka hyia kpole kpalɛ tɛla ndanlɛ. 24Bɛnlea ahɔhɔsɛlɛ: bɛnlua yɛɛ bɛmbu; bɛnlɛ bonwolo anzɛɛ ɛleka mɔɔ bɛsie bɛ ninyɛne a; Nyamenle a yɛne bɛ a. Bɛmɛ, bɛsonle bolɛ bɛtɛla nloma! 25Bɛ nuhua boni a saa ɔdwenle dɔɔnwo wɔ ye ngoane nwo a, ɔkɛhola ɔkɛva kenle ekyi bɔbɔ ɔkɛgua ye ngoane mekɛ zo a? 26Na saa nretee ɛhye bɔbɔ bɛngola ye yɛ a, ɛnee duzu ati a bɛdwenle ninyɛne mɔɔ ɛha la anwo ɛ? 27 Bɛnlea kɛ ɛhoayelɛ nu aloa si nyi la: bɛnyɛ gyima yɛɛ bɛnnwo ndanlɛ. Noko meka meahile bɛ kɛ Belemgbunli Sɔlɔmɔn, wɔ ye anyunlunyia mekɛ ne amuala anu, yeannyia ndanlɛ mɔɔ le ngɛnlɛma kɛ ndotolo ɛhye mɔ la anu ko bɔbɔ. 28Nyamenle a keda ndile mɔɔ wɔ ɛbɔ nu, mɔɔ ɛnɛ fifi a, ɛhyema ɛnee bɛyela bɛ wɔ fonlomo nu la ndanlɛ a. Ɛnee bɛnea a ɔnrɛhola ɔnrɛheda bɛ ndanlɛ ɔ? Bɛ diedi le ekyi somaa!
29“Yemɔti bɛmmamaa bɛ adwenle sɛkye wɔ mɔɔ bɛkɛli nee mɔɔ bɛkɛnlo la anwo. 30(Ɔluakɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnze Nyamenle la a dwenledwenle ɛhye mɔ anwo a.) Bɛ Ze mɔɔ wɔ anwuma la ze kɛ bɛhyia ɛhye mɔ anwo. 31Zɔhane ati, bɛmaa Nyamenle Belemgbunlililɛ ne ɛhyia bɛ, na ɔdaye noko ɔkɛva ɛhye mɔ ɔkɛmaa bɛ.
Anwonyia wɔ anwuma
(Mat 6.19-21)
32“Me mboane ekpunli ekyi, bɛmmasulo, ɔluakɛ bɛ Ze mɔɔ wɔ anwuma la kulo kɛ bɛnyia Belemgbunlililɛ ne. 33Bɛdɔne mɔɔ bɛlɛ la amuala na bɛva ezukoa ne bɛmaa ehyianvolɛma. Bɛyɛ gya ahodoku mɔɔ ɛnzɛkye ɛlɛ la bɛmaa bɛ nwo, na bɛva bɛ anwonyia bɛzie ɛleka mɔɔ ɔnrɛminli ɛlɛ la, ɔboalekɛ awule asa ɛnrɛha ye, yɛɛ ɛlɛtɛba ɛnrɛhola ɛnrɛzɛkye ye. 34Ɛleka mɔɔ bɛ anwonyia ne wɔ la, ɛkɛ ne yɛɛ bɛ ahonle noko wɔ a.
Sonvolɛma mɔɔ sinza la
35 “Bɛziezie bɛ nwo bɛmaa debie biala mɔɔ kɛzi bɛ adenle nu la, na bɛmaa bɛ ahɛnlaneɛ ɛda 36 kɛ sonvolɛma mɔɔ ɛlɛkendɛ bɛ menle mɔɔ vi atɔfolɛlielɛ bo ɛlɛba la, amaa saa ɔba na ɔbabɔ anlenkɛ ne anu a, bɛadukue ye ndɛndɛ. 37Nyilalɛ ɛha sonvolɛma mɔɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛ menle kɛra la ɔkɛrado bɛ kɛ bɛ nye gyi zo na bɛlɛkendɛ ye la. Nɔhalɛ, meka meahile bɛ kɛ ɔkɛmaa bɛkɛdɛnlɛdɛnla aze, ɔkɛkpa ɔkɛgua, na ɔkɛmaa bɛ debie. 38Na saa ɔsia ɔba alevinli mu nwiɔ avinli o, anzɛɛ akɔlɛmɔleɛ o, na ɔbato bɛ zɔhane ala a, bɛ nyilalɛ le kpole. 39 Na bɛhakye ɛhye! Saa awuke menle ze mekɛ holɛ ko mɔɔ awule ne kɛva kɛra la a, anrɛɛ ɔnrɛmaa ye adenle ɔnrɛmaa ɔnrɛbu ɔnrɛra ye sua ne anu. 40Zɔhane ala yɛɛ bɛdabɛ noko bɛziezie bɛ nwo a, ɔboalekɛ medame Sonla Ra, mebara bieko wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛ nye ɛnla la.”
Sonvolɛ ne mɔɔ di nɔhalɛ anzɛɛ sonvolɛ ne mɔɔ ɛnli nɔhalɛ
(Mat 24.45-51)
41Pita bizale Gyisɛse kɛ, “Awulae, ɛbu ɛrɛlɛ ɛhye wɔamaa yɛdayɛ yɛ ngome anzɛɛ awie biala ɔ?”
42Awulae buale kɛ, “Ɛnee nwane a le sonvolɛ mɔɔ di nɔhalɛ na ɔle nrɛlɛbɛvolɛ la? Yemɔ a le sonla ne mɔɔ ɔ menle kɛyɛ ye kpanyinli wɔ ye awuke ne anu kɛ ɔmaa sonvolɛma mɔɔ ɛha la aleɛ wɔ mekɛ ne anloa la. 43Nyilalɛ ɛha sonvolɛ ne mɔɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɔ menle kɛra sua nu la ɔkɛrado ye kɛ ɔlɛyɛ ɛhye la. 44Nɔhalɛ, meka meahile bɛ kɛ, ɔ menle ne kɛmaa ɔkɛnlea ye ninyɛne kpokpoti azo. 45Na saa sonvolɛ zɔhane ka kɛ, ‘Me menle bahyɛ na yeara,’ na ɔbɔ ɔ bo kɛ ɔbo sonvolɛma mɔɔ ɛha la, mrenya nee mraalɛ, na ɔdi, ɔno na ɔbo a, 46ɔ menle ne bara wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɔnze na ɔ nye ɛnla la. Na ɔ menle ne kɛye ye ali kɛmaa ɔkɛhɔboka anzosesebɛma anwo.
47“Sonvolɛ mɔɔ ze deɛ mɔɔ ɔ menle kpondɛ kɛ ɔyɛ, noko ɔnziezie ɔ nwo kɛ ɔyɛ mɔɔ ɔ menle kpondɛ la, bɛkɛbila ye empele kpalɛ kpalɛ. 48Na sonvolɛ mɔɔ ɛnze mɔɔ ɔ menle kpondɛ, na ɔyɛ debie mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛbila ye empele a, yemɔ bɛkɛbila ye ekyii bie ala. Sonla mɔɔ bɛkɛmaa ye ninyɛne dɔɔnwo la, bɛkɛlie ninyɛne dɔɔnwo wɔ ye ɛkɛ ne, yɛɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛva dɔɔnwo kpalɛ bɛkɛwula ɔ sa nu la, bɛkɛbiza ye bɛkɛlie dɔɔnwo kpalɛ bɛkɛvi ye ɛkɛ.
Gyisɛse maa mgbakyemgbakye ba
(Mat 10.34-36)
49“Membale kɛ mebado senle wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo, yɛɛ me kunlu a anrɛɛ yezɔ dɛbadɛba. 50 Noko akee ɔwɔ kɛ mesɔ amaneɛnwunlɛ sa, na saa ɛhye ɛtɛsenle a me ti akunlu ɛtɛgyale! 51Bɛdwenle kɛ menvale anzonudwolɛ membale ewiade ɔ? Meka meahile bɛ, tɛ anzonudwolɛ ɔ, na mgbakyemgbakye ɔ. 52Ɔvi ɛnɛ mɔɔ kɔ la abusua ko mɔɔ menli nnu a wɔ nu la anu babu nwiɔ, na nwiɔ ne atia nsa ne. 53 Selɛma batia bɛ mra mrenya, yɛɛ mralɛ mrenya batia bɛ ze mɔ; ninlima batia bɛ mra mraalɛ, yɛɛ mralɛ mraalɛ batia bɛ nli mɔ; azebɛla batia ahileni na ahileni atia azebɛla.”
Mekɛ ne anwo ndelebɛbo
(Mat 16.2-3)
54Gyisɛse eza zele menli ne kɛ, “Saa bɛnwu kɛ maanle nu ɛmunla sɛnzɛne adɔleɛ na ɔlɛfo yeara a, ɛnee bɛse, ‘Ezule badɔ’, na ɔyɛ zɔhane. 55Mekɛ mɔɔ nyiakɛ anwoma ne kɛze kɛ ɔbɔ noko la, ɛnee bɛse, ‘Wuluwulu bara’, na ɔyɛ zɔhane. 56Adalɛ nabalabama! Bɛkola bɛnwu azɛlɛ ye azo nee anwomanyunlu sɛkɛlɛneɛ ne mɔ abo bɛkile, na kɛmɔti a bɛngola bɛngile mekɛ ɛhye mɔɔ yɛwɔ nu la abo ɛ?
Ɛ nee wɔ kpɔvolɛ bɛbɔ nu
(Mat 5.25-26)
57“Kɛmɔti a bɛdabɛ bɛ ngome bɛngola bɛmbua bɛ nwo ndɛne fɔɔnwo ɛ? 58Saa sonla nee wɔ lɛ edwɛkɛ na ɔfa wɔ ɔkɔ suakunlu a, bɔ mɔdenle kɛ mɔɔ bɛtɛnyianle bɛtɛkɔle edwɛkɛ ne azo la, ɛ nee ye bɛkɛziezie edwɛkɛ ne wɔ adenle nu kolaa na bɛadwu lɔ, amaa yeanva wɔ yeangɔmaa ndɛnebuavolɛ ne, na ndɛnebuavolɛ ne aye wɔ awula kpolisima asa anu, na kpolisima ahɔdo wɔ efiade. 59Na meka meahile bɛ, anrɛɛ bɛnrɛvi nu ɛlɛ, kyesɛ bɛtua bɛ kakɛ ne mɔɔ ndɛnebuavolɛ ne bule dole bɛ nwo zo la amuala mɔɔ ɛkpɔsɛba bɔbɔ ɛnga nu a.”

Title: LUK 13
Content:
Bɛgyakyi bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ anrɛɛ bɛkɛwu
1Mekɛ ne anu menli bie rahanle Galelima bie mɔɔ Paelɛte ɛmaa bɛhu bɛ wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee bɛlɛbɔ azu bɛamaa Nyamenle la anwo edwɛkɛ hilele Gyisɛse. 2Gyisɛse buale bɛ kɛ, “Kɛmɔ bɛhunle Galelima zɔhane mɔ wɔ adenle zɔhane anu la, ɛnee bɛdabɛ bɛnea a ɔkile kɛ bɛle ɛtanevolɛma kpole bɛtɛla Galelima mɔɔ ɛha la amuala ɔ? 3Ɔnle zɔhane. Meka meahile bɛ, saa bɛdabɛ noko bɛanzia bɛanvi bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ anwo a, bɛ muala bɛbawu kɛ menli zɔhane mɔ ala la. 4Na menli bulu nee mɔtwɛ ne mɔɔ sua tendenle ne bule guale bɛ nwo zo hunle bɛ wɔ Saelowam la noko ɛ? Bɛdabɛ bɛnea a, ɛnee ɛhye kile kɛ menli zɔhane mɔ le ɛtanevolɛma kpole tɛla menli mɔɔ wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm la ɔ? 5Ɔnle zɔhane. Na meka meahile bɛ, saa bɛdabɛ noko bɛanzia bɛanvi bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ anwo a, bɛ muala bɛbawu kɛ menli zɔhane mɔ ala la.”
Feege baka ne mɔɔ ɛnzo ma la anwo ɛrɛlɛ
6Akee Gyisɛse bule bɛ ɛrɛlɛ ɛhye. Ɔse, “Ɛnee nrenya bie lɛ feege baka wɔ ye vanye tola bie anu. Na ɔhɔle kɛ ɔkakpondɛ ma wɔ zolɛ na yeannyia bie. 7Yemɔti ɔzele ye tola ne azo neavolɛ ne kɛ, ‘Nea, mekpɔla feege baka ye azo ɛvolɛ nsa kɛ mekpondɛ ma wɔ zolɛ na mennyia bie. Pɛ ye to aze! Ɔnle kɛ ɔgyinla ɛkɛ ne ɔsɛkye azɛlɛ ne mgbane!’ 8Na tola neavolɛ ne buale ye kɛ, ‘Yɛmenle, maa ɔgyinla ɛkɛ ne na yɛnlea ye ɛvolɛ ye noko; mebavuduvudu ɔ bo na meagugua ewula ɔ bo. 9Na saa ɛvolɛ ne kadwu na ɔso a, ɔle kpalɛ; yeanzo noko a, yɛkɛpɛ ye yɛkɛdo.’ ”
Gyisɛse yɛ raalɛ abubura bie ayile wɔ Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ne
10Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ko bie ɛnee Gyisɛse ɛlɛkilehile wɔ nyianu sua bie anu. 11Raalɛ ko wɔ ɛkɛ ne mɔɔ sunsum ɛtane vale ye la yedwu ɛvolɛ bulu nee mɔtwɛ, na yemaa ewule ɛdɔ ɔ nwo, yekpo kondokondo mɔɔ ɔngola ɔ nwo tenrɛ fee a. 12Mɔɔ Gyisɛse nwunle ye la, ɔvɛlɛle ye na ɔzele ye kɛ, “Ɔmɔ, bɛye wɔ bɛvi wɔ anwonyane ne anu!” 13Akee ɔvale ɔ sa ɔguale raalɛ ne anwo zo, na ɛkɛ ne ala ɔdenrɛle ɔ nwo fɔɔnwo na ɔyele Nyamenle ayɛlɛ.
14 Nyianu sua ne kpanyinli ne vale ɛya kɛ Gyisɛse ɛyɛ ayile wɔ Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ne a, na ɔzele menli mɔɔ wɔ ɛkɛ ne la kɛ, “Yɛlɛ kenle nsia mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ yɛfa yɛyɛ gyima a; yemɔti bɛrɛla kenle zɔhane mɔ bɛmaa bɛyɛ bɛ ayile, na bɛgyakyi Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ne bɛmaa ɔla ɛkɛ ne.”
15Awulae buale ye kɛ, “Bɛmɛ nabalabama! Saa ɔdwu Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle a bɛ biala sianyi ye ɛnlankɛ anzɛɛ asoaso ɔfa ye ɔkɔmaa ye nzule. 16Na raalɛ ɛhye mɔɔ le Ebileham abo zo sonla, na Seetan ɛva ewule ɛkyekye ye toonwo ɛvolɛ bulu nee mɔtwɛ la, yɛɛ ɔnle kɛ bɛsianyi ye wɔ Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle a?” 17Ye mualɛ ne manle ye agbɔvolɛ ne mɔ amuala anyunlu guale aze, na menli ne amuala lile fɛlɛko wɔ nwanwane ninyɛne mgbole mɔɔ ɔyɛle la anwo.
Mɛsetade baka ma nwo ɛrɛlɛ
(Mat 13.31-32; Mak 4.30-32)
18Gyisɛse bizale kɛ, “Kɛ Nyamenle Belemgbunlililɛ ne si de ɛ? Duzu a menva mendo nwolɛ a? 19Ɔle kɛ mɛsetade baka ma nretee bie mɔɔ awie vale luale ye tola nu la; ɔfifile, ɔnyinle ɔyɛle baka, na nloma yɛle bɛ sane wɔ ye ngane ne mɔ anu.”
Mgbɔvonle nwo ɛrɛlɛ
(Mat 13.33)
20Gyisɛse bizale bɛ bieko kɛ, “Duzu a menva Nyamenle Belemgbunlililɛ ne mendo nwolɛ a? 21Ɔle kɛ mgbɔvonle mɔɔ raalɛ fa wula ɛdɔkɛ nu la. Ɔmaa ɛdɔkɛ ne amuala tu.”
Anlenkɛ ekyi ne
(Mat 7.13-14,21-23)
22Gyisɛse kpɔsale azua nee namunamu zo hilehilele menli ne, na ɛnee ɔlua zo ɔlɛkɔ Gyɛlusalɛm. 23Awie bie bizale ye kɛ, “Yɛmenle, asoo ɔle nɔhalɛ kɛ menli ekyi bie ala a bɛbalie bɛ ngoane a?”
Gyisɛse buale bɛ kɛ, 24“Bɛbɔ mɔdenle bɛva anlenkɛ ekyi ne anu, ɔboalekɛ menli dɔɔnwo babɔ mɔdenle kɛ bɛfa nu, noko bɛnrɛhola. 25Sua menle ne badwazo ado anlenkɛ ne anu, na saa bɛka alie nwo na bɛbɔ anlenkɛ ne anu bɛse kɛ, ‘Yɛmenle, tukue yɛ anlenkɛ ne!’ a, ɔkɛbua bɛ kɛ, ‘Menze ɛleka mɔɔ bɛvi a!’ 26Na bɛmɛ bɛbabua kɛ, ‘Yɛ nee wɔ lile, nlonle; ɛhilehilele wɔ yɛ sua zo.’ 27 Na ɔbaze bɛ bieko kɛ, ‘Menze ɛleka mɔɔ bɛvi a. Bɛvi ɛkɛ ne bɛhɔ, amumuyɛma!’ 28-29 Na akee mɔɔ bɛkɛnwu bɛ nlenya mɔ Ebileham, Ayezeke nee Gyekɔbo nee Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛfa bɛ bɛtu bɛ nloa nu la amuala wɔ Nyamenle Belemgbunlililɛ ne anu, na menli vi aduduleɛ nee adɔleɛ, ɛbɔ nu nee nyevile nu ɛra ɛvoyia ne abo, na akee bɛye bɛmɛ bɛgua alie nwo nehane la, ɛkɛ ne yɛɛ bɛbazu na bɛadedɛ bɛ nwo bonrane nu a. 30 Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ kɛkala bɛli amozi la baralumua, na bɛdabɛ mɔɔ kɛkala bɛlumua la arali amozi.”
Gyisɛse kulo Gyɛlusalɛm
(Mat 23.37-39)
31Mekɛ ne anu Falasiima bie rale Gyisɛse anwo ɛkɛ ne razele ye kɛ, “Ye ɛ nwo ɛke na kɔ ɛleka fofolɛ, ɔluakɛ Hɛlɔdo kpondɛ wɔ ahu wɔ.”
32Gyisɛse buale bɛ kɛ, “Bɛhɔ na bɛhɔze musuofoɔ ne kɛ, melɛtu mbɔnsam, meayɛ ayile ɛnɛ nee ɛhyema, na ye kenle nsa ne azo menwɔwie me gyima ne. 33Noko ɔwɔ kɛ mesɔ me adendulɛ ne azo ɛnɛ nee ɛhyema nee ye alehyenlɛ nu. Ɔnle kpalɛ kɛ bɛkɛhu Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ wɔ ɛleka gyɛne biala kyesɛ Gyɛlusalɛm ala.
34“Gyɛlusalɛm, O Gyɛlusalɛm! Wɔhu Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma ne, wɔzi menli mɔɔ Nyamenle zoanle bɛ ɛ nwo la awolɛ! Fane dɔɔnwo yɛɛ mehulo kɛ anrɛɛ menwɔva me sa menwɔbɛla bɛmɛ Gyɛlusalɛmma kɛ akɔlɛ ɛdane fa ɔ mra fea ɔ ndɛba abo la; na bɛammaa me adenle. 35 Yemɔti bɛ sua ye badɔ mgbane. Meka meahile bɛ kɛ bɛnrɛnwu me, kɔkpula kɛ mekɛ ne kɛdwu mɔɔ bɛbadeɛdea nu bɛaze kɛ, ‘Nyilalɛ ɛha mɔɔ lua Awulae duma nu ɛlɛba la.’ ”

Title: LUK 14
Content:
Gyisɛse yɛ nrenya wuleravolɛ bie ayile
1Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ko Gyisɛse hɔle kɛ ɔkakpula ɔ sa wɔ Falasii mgbanyima ne mɔ ko sua nu. Mekɛ ne anu ɛnee menli ɛlɛtɛ ye kpalɛ. 2Nrenya bie mɔɔ mutulemutule ɛyɛ ye la rale Gyisɛse anwo ɛkɛ ne, 3na Gyisɛse bizale mɛla kilehilevolɛma ne nee Falasiima ne mɔ kɛ, “Asoo yɛ mɛla ne tua ayileyɛlɛ wɔ Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ne, anzɛɛ ɔndua?”
4Na bɛandɛ bɛ nloa anu. Yemɔti Gyisɛse vale nrenya ne na ɔyɛle ye ayile ɔmanle ɔhɔle. 5 Akee ɔbizale bɛ kɛ, “Bɛ nuhua boni yɛɛ saa ɔ ra nrenya anzɛɛ ye ɛnlankɛ tɔ bula nu Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ne a, ɛkɛ ne ala ɔnrɛye ye a?”
6Na bɛangola ɛhye noko anloa ye.
Mɛlɛbɛnwoaze nee nyɛvolɛlielɛ
7Gyisɛse nwunle bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdole ɛsalɛ bɛvɛlɛle bɛ la kɛ bie mɔ anye ɛbolo ɛlɛkpondɛ ɛleka kpalɛ adɛnla, yemɔti ɔbule bɛ muala ɛrɛlɛ ɛhye: 8 “Saa awie to ɔ sa fɛlɛ wɔ wɔ atɔfolɛlielɛ bo a, mmakɔtɛnla ɛleka kpalɛ ne. Ɔkɛyɛ kɛ bie a ɛnee bɛvɛlɛ awie mɔɔ lɛ dibile tɛla wɔ la, 9na ahenle mɔɔ vɛlɛle yemɔ nee wɔmɔ la ɔwɔ kɛ ba na ɔbase wɔ kɛ, ‘Dwazo, fa ɛ bo zo ne maa sonla ɛhye.’ Ɛnee akee ɛlɛ nyiane ɛbahɔdɛnla bɛ nzi lɔ ebia zo. 10Yemɔti saa bɛto ɛsalɛ bɛfɛlɛ wɔ a, kɔdɛnla bɛ nzi lɔ ɛleka bie, na saa mɔɔ vɛlɛle wɔ la ba a, yeaze wɔ kɛ, ‘Me gɔnwo, bɛla badɛnla ɛleka kpalɛ.’ Ɛhye kɛyɛ anyunlunyia kɛmaa wɔ wɔ menli mɔɔ nee wɔ de ɛkponle ne anwo la anyunlu. 11 Ɔluakɛ mɔɔ memaa ɔ nwo zo la Nyamenle bɛlɛ ye aze, yɛɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛ ɔ nwo aze la Nyamenle kpogya ye zo.”
12Akee Gyisɛse zele nrenya ne mɔɔ dole ɛkponle ne la kɛ, “Saa ɛto ɛkponle ewiazo anzɛɛ nɔsolɛ nu a, mmafɛlɛvɛlɛ ɛ gɔnwo mɔ anzɛɛ ɛ mediema anzɛɛ wɔ mbusuafoɔ anzɛɛ wɔ kpalɛzo sukoavolɛma angome, ɔluakɛ bɛdabɛ noko bɛbavɛlɛ wɔ bie bɛazie wɔ ɛdeɛ ne abo zo. 13Na saa ɛto ɛkponle a, fɛlɛvɛlɛ ehyianvolɛma, abuburama, bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ sa anzɛɛ bɛ gyakɛ le azinli, yɛɛ anyenzinliravolɛma, 14na Nyamenle kɛyila wɔ. Ɔluakɛ bɛmɛ, bɛdabɛ bɛnrɛhola bɛnrɛzie wɔ ɛdeɛ ne abo zo. Nyamenle ala a bazie ɔ bo zo amaa wɔ wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ menli kpalɛ ne mɔ vi ewule nu kɛdwazo la a.”
Ɛkponledolɛ kpole ne anwo ɛrɛlɛ
(Mat 22.1-10)
15Menli mɔɔ de ɛkponle ne anwo la anu ko mɔɔ dele ɛhye la hanle hilele Gyisɛse kɛ, “Nyilalɛ ɛha bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛbadɛnla ɛkponledolɛ kpole ne abo wɔ Nyamenle Belemgbunlililɛ ne anu la!”
16Gyisɛse zele ye kɛ, “Nrenya bie dole ɛkponle na ɔvɛlɛle menli dɔɔnwo. 17Mɔɔ mekɛ ne dwule la, ɔzoanle ye sonvolɛma kɛ bɛhɔze bɛdabɛ mɔɔ yedo ɛsalɛ yevɛlɛ bɛ la kɛ, ‘Bɛrɛla na mewie debie biala yɛ.’ 18Na bɛ muala bɛbɔle ɔ bo kɛ bɛtwenlehwenle bɛ bo aze. Mɔɔ lumua la zele kɛ, ‘Medɔ me azɛlɛ bie na ɔwɔ kɛ mekɔnea. Yemɔti mmanyia ɛya.’ 19Ko noko ɔdaye ɔhanle kɛ, ‘Medɔ nlankɛ nwiɔ nwiɔ fane nnu na mekɔ meahɔnlea bɛ. Yemɔti mebodo wɔ mmanyia ɛya.’ 20Bieko noko zele kɛ, ‘Megya raalɛ, zɔhane ati menrɛhola ba.’
21“Sonvolɛ ne ziale hɔbɔle ɔ menle ne amaneɛ. Awuke menle ne vale ɛya kpole na ɔzele ye sonvolɛ ne kɛ, ‘Maa ɔyɛ ndɛ, kɔ sua ye azo kpalɛ ne mɔ azo nee awɔdenle ne mɔ anu kɔsesa ehyianvolɛma, abuburama, anyenzinliravolɛma, yɛɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ sa nee bɛ gyakɛ le azinli la ɛ nee bɛ ɛrɛla.’ 22Yeangyɛ biala yɛɛ sonvolɛ ne ziale rale a na ɔrahanle ɔhilele ɔ menle ne kɛ, ‘Yɛmenle, mɔɔ ɛhanle la meyɛ ye zɔhane, noko ɛleka tɛbɔ ɛkɛ ne.’ 23Yemɔti awuke menle ne zele ye sonvolɛ ne kɛ, ‘Kɔ ademgbole ne mɔ nee ndenle ngyikyi ne mɔ anu na twe menli maa bɛrɛla bɛrayi me sua ye. 24Na meka meahile bɛ, bɛdabɛ mɔɔ menlumuale menvɛlɛle bɛ a bɛamba la, me aleɛ ne nretee bɔbɔ ɛnrɛtia biala agye zo.’ ”
Ɛdoavolɛ ɛyɛlɛ
(Mat 10.37-38)
25Kenle ko menli dɔɔnwo bie nee Gyisɛse lua bɛlɛkɔ la, ɔhakyile ɔ nwo ɔzele bɛ kɛ, 26 “Awie biala mɔɔ ba me nwo arayɛ me ɛdoavolɛ, na yeangulo me edwɛkɛ yeandɛla ɔ ze nee ɔ nli, ɔ ye nee ɔ mra, ɔ mediema mrenya nee mraalɛ nee ɔdaye mumua ne ɔ nwo la ɛnrɛhola ɛnrɛyɛ me ɛdoavolɛ. 27 Awie biala mɔɔ anzoa ye meanubaka ne anli me nzi la ɛnrɛhola ɛnrɛyɛ me ɛdoavolɛ.
28“Saa bɛ nuhua bie kpondɛ kɛ ɔsi sua a, ɔdumua ɔtɛnla aze, ɔsese ye bolɛ, na ɔnea saa ɔlɛ ezukoa mɔɔ sa ye si la a. 29Saa yeanyɛ ye zɔhane na ɔwula sua ne aze a, bie a ɛnee yeangola ye si. Saa bɛnwu ye zɛhae noko a bɛbazi ye amgbu kɛ 30‘Nea, nrenya ɛhye sua ko mɔɔ ɔbɔle ɔ bo la, yeanwie ye si ɛlɛ!’
31“Saa belemgbunli bie fa menli apenle bulu kɛ ɔ nee belemgbunli ko mɔɔ lɛ menli apenle abulanwiɔ la kaho a, ɔbalumua yeadɛnla aze yeadwenle nwolɛ saa ɔkɛhola ɔkɛgyinla belemgbunli zɔhane anyunlu wɔ konle nu a. 32Saa ɔnea na ɔnrɛhola ye a, ɛnee mɔɔ belemgbunli zɔhane yɛ la a le kɛ, mɔɔ kpɔvolɛ ne wɔ moa moa, na ɔtɛnyianle ɔtɛdwule ɛkɛ ne la, ɔsoa ye kpɔmanvolɛ ɔmaa bɛkɔka bɛyɛ anzonudwolɛ ngyehyɛlɛ.” 33Na Gyisɛse dwulale ye edwɛkɛ ne kɛ, “Zɔhane ala yɛɛ saa bɛ nuhua ko biala angyakyi debie biala mɔɔ ɔlɛ la anzi ɛlilɛ a, ɔnrɛhola ɔnrɛyɛ me ɛdoavolɛ a.
Ngyenle mɔɔ ɛda la
(Mat 5.13; Mak 9.50)
34“Ngyenle sonle bolɛ, na saa ɔta a bɛngola bɛnyɛ ye menlemenle. 35Bɛfa bɛyɛ debie biala a ɔnyɛ boɛ; bɛgua ye lɔ. Yemɔti mɔɔ lɛ ɛnzonlɛ la ɛdie!”

Title: LUK 15
Content:
Boane ne mɔɔ minlinle la
(Mat 18.12-14)
1 Kenle ko bie adwuledievolɛma dɔɔnwo nee menli mɔɔ awie ɛmbu bɛ la rale kɛ bɛbadie Gyisɛse anloa edwɛkɛ. 2Na Falasiima ne nee mɛla kilehilevolɛma ne mɔ dendɛle bɛ nzo abo kɛ, “Nrenya ɛhye nee ɛtanevolɛma tu na ɔ nee bɛ to bɛ sa ɛyɛba ko anu.” 3Yemɔti Gyisɛse bule bɛ ɛrɛlɛ ɛhye:
4“Bɛ nuhua boni, yɛɛ saa ɔlɛ mboane ɛya, na ko minli a, ɔnrɛgyakyi abulahɔnla nee ngɔnla ne wɔ fienemgbole ne anu, na ɔnrɛhɔkpondɛ ko ne toonwo kɔkpula kɛ ɔkɛnwu ye la a? 5Saa ɔnwu ye a, ɔdi fɛlɛko, na ɔfa ye ɔto ɔ kɔme zo, 6ɔfa ye ɔba sua nu. Akee ɔfɛlɛvɛlɛ ɔ gɔnwo mɔ nee ye kpalɛzo amra, na ɔse bɛ kɛ, ‘Ɔyɛ me fɛ kɛ menwu me boane ne mɔɔ minlinle la. Bɛmaa yɛlie yɛ nye!’ 7Meka meahile bɛ kɛ zɔhane ala yɛɛ anyelielɛ kɛra anwuma lɔ wɔ ɛtanevolɛ ko mɔɔ kɛnlu ɔ nwo la anwo kɛdɛla menli abulahɔnla nee ngɔnla mɔɔ di boɛ na bɛngyia anlubɛnwo la a.
Dwɛtɛ fufule ne mɔɔ minlinle la
8“Anzɛɛ saa raalɛ lɛ dwɛtɛ fufule bulu na ko minli a, duzu a ɔyɛ a? Ɔsɔ kɛnlaneɛ, ɔkpoɔkpoa ye sua ne anu, na ɔka ɔ nye aze ɔkpondɛ dedee kɔkpula kɛ ɔkɛnwu ye la. 9Saa ɔnwu ye a, ɔfɛlɛvɛlɛ ɔ gɔnwo mɔ nee ye kpalɛzo amra, na ɔse bɛ kɛ, ‘Ɔyɛ me fɛ kɛ menwu me kpɔba ne mɔɔ minlinle la. Bɛmaa yɛlie yɛ nye!’ 10Meka meahile bɛ kɛ, zɔhane ala yɛɛ Nyamenle soanvolɛma di fɛlɛko wɔ ɛtanenli ko mɔɔ kɛnlu ɔ nwo la anwo a.”
Ralɛ nrenya ne mɔɔ dele atua la
11Gyisɛse hɔle zolɛ hanle kɛ, “Nrenya ko wɔ ɛkɛ. Ɔlɛ mralɛ mrenya nwiɔ. 12Bɛ nuhua ekyi ne hanle hilele ɔ ze kɛ, ‘Egya, fa me agyadeɛ ɛdeɛ maa me.’ Yemɔti ɔ ze hyɛle mɔɔ ɔlɛ la amuala anu nwiɔ manle ɔ mra nwiɔ ne. 13Kenle ekyi guale nu la ralɛ nrenya kakula ne dɔnenle ye ninyɛne ɛdeɛ ne kɔsɔɔti na ɔvale ezukoa ne ɔbɔle ɔ nwo ɔhɔle maanle zo. Ɔhɔle la, ɔbɔle ɛbɛla mgbane mgbane na ɔzɛkyele ye ezukoa ne amuala. 14Mɔɔ ɔwiele ye ezukoa ne di la ɛhɔne kpole bie zile maanle ne mɔɔ ɔwɔ nu la anu, na ɛnee akee noko ɛhwee ɛnle ɔ nwo. 15Yemɔti ɔvale ɔ nwo ɔhɔbetanle mandimasema ne mɔ anu ko, na sonla zɔhane vale ye kɛ ɔhɔnlea agbolike wɔ ye ɛya nu. 16Ɛhɔne hunle ye mɔɔ saa ɔnyianle agbolike ne mɔ aleɛ ne bie bɔbɔ a anrɛɛ ɔkɛli, noko yeannyia awie ammaa ye bie. 17Nzinlii ye adwenle rale ɔ nwo na ɔzele kɛ, ‘Gyimayɛvoma mɔɔ wɔ egya gyima nu la di aleɛ maa ɔbo bɛ nwo zo, mame a mela ɛke mɔɔ ɛhɔne ɛlɛku me la! 18Medwazo meahɔ egya anwo lɔ meahɔze ye kɛ, Egya, meyɛ ɛtane metia Nyamenle nee ɛdawɔ. 19Menfɛta kɛ ɛkɛvɛlɛ me ɛ ra bɔbɔ; fa me yɛ wɔ ɛkpama ne mɔ anu ko.’ 20Yemɔti ɔdwazole na ɔzile nu kɛ ɔkɔ ɔ ze anwo lɔ.
“Mɔɔ ɔkpukele moa moa lɔ mɔɔ ɔlɛba la ɔ ze nwunle ye, alɔbɔlɛ hunle ye kpole, na ɔnriandile ɔhɔyiale ye, ɔbɛkale ye, na ɔvole ɔ nloa anwo. 21Ralɛ nrenya kakula ne hanle hilele ɔ ze kɛ, ‘Egya, meyɛ ɛtane metia Nyamenle nee ɛdawɔ. Kɛkala, menfɛta kɛ ɛkɛvɛlɛ me ɛ ra bieko.’ 22Na ɔ ze vɛlɛle ye sonvolɛma ne mɔ na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, ‘Bɛha bɛ nwo na bɛhɔva tɛladeɛ kpalɛ bɛrawula ye. Bɛva kpɔdelera bɛwula ɔ sa, na bɛva mgbɔlaboa bɛwula ye. 23Akee bɛhɔva ɛnlankɛ ralɛ mɔɔ ɛlɔ kpalɛ la bɛrahu ye bɛmaa yɛlie yɛ nye. 24Ɔluakɛ me ra ɛhye, mefa ye kɛ ɔwule, na kɛkala yera ngoane nu; ɔminlinle, na kɛkala menwu ye.’ Na bɛbɔle ɔ bo kɛ bɛdie bɛ nye.
25“Mekɛ ne anu ɛnee ralɛ nrenya kpanyinli ne ɛhɔ ye ɛya nu. Na mɔɔ ɔlɛba na ɔbikyele ɔ ze awuke ne la, ɔdele edwɛne nee agolehanlɛ ne. 26Yemɔti ɔvɛlɛle ɔ ze sonvolɛma ne mɔ mɔɔ wɔ sua nu ɛkɛ ne la anu ko na ɔbizale ye kɛ, ‘Duzu edwɛkɛ ɔ?’ 27Na ɔbuale ye kɛ, ‘Ɛ diema ne ɛzia ɛra sua nu, na ɛ ze ɛmaa bɛhu ɛnlankɛ ralɛ kyenlera ne mɔɔ ɛwie dɔ la yɛɛ bɛlɛdie bɛ nye a, ɔboalekɛ ɔ sa ɛha ye, ɔ nwo kɔlɔnwo, ɔte kpɔkɛ.’
28“Ralɛ nrenya kpanyinli ne vale ɛya kpole, yemɔti yeangulo kɛ ɔkɛwolo awuke ne anu. Zɔhane ati ɔ ze vindele rabodole ye kɛ ɔrɛla sua nu. 29Na ɔbuale ɔ ze kɛ, ‘Egya, mezonle wɔ kɛ akɛlɛ la toonwo a yeradwu ɛnɛ a, yɛɛ metɛtule ɛ nloa edwɛkɛ metɛtole ɛlɛ. Duzu a wɔva wɔmaa me a? Ɛtɛfale abɔnkye ralɛ nretee ko bɔbɔ ɛtɛmanle me kɛ menva me nee me gɔnwo mɔ yɛva yɛlie yɛ nye. 30Na ɛ ra ɛhye mɔɔ ɛzɛkye wɔ agyadeɛ ne amuala wɔ tuutuuma anwo, na yezia yera sua nu la, wɔhu ɛnlankɛ ralɛ kyenlera ne mɔɔ ɛwie dɔ la wɔmaa ye.’ 31Na ɔ ze buale ye kɛ, ‘Me ra, wɔmɔ ɛ nee me a de ɛke dahuu a, yɛɛ debie biala mɔɔ melɛ la le wɔ ɛdeɛ. 32Noko ɔwɔ kɛ yɛdie yɛ nye na yɛdi fɛlɛko ala, ɔboalekɛ, ɛ diema ye, ɔwule, yɛɛ yezia yera ngoane nu bieko a; ɔminlinle, yɛɛ yɛnwu ye a.’ ”

Title: LUK 16
Content:
Gyaneavolɛ anyebolo ne
1Gyisɛse zele ye ɛdoavolɛma ne mɔ kɛ, “Sukoavolɛ bie mɔɔ lɛ sonla mɔɔ nea ye gya zo la woale ɛkɛ. Bɛdoanle gyaneavolɛ ne bɛhilele ɔ menle ne kɛ ɔlɛsɛkye ye ezukoa ne. 2Yemɔti nrenya sukoavolɛ ne vɛlɛle ye na ɔzele ye kɛ, ‘Duzu edwɛkɛ a metete ye ɛ nwo la? Bɛla babu me ninyɛne mɔɔ wɔ ɛ sa nu la anwo mgbonda kile me, ɔluakɛ ɔvi ɛnɛ mɔɔ kɔ la ɛnle me gyaneavolɛ bieko.’ 3Na gyaneavolɛ ne hanle ye ɔ ti akunlu kɛ, ‘Duzu a menyɛ a, ɔluakɛ me menle ɛlɛdie me gyima ye avi me sa nu? Ɛyazonlɛ a, menlɛ nwolɛ anwosesebɛ, asɛlɛ noko yɛ me nyiane. 4Meze mɔɔ mebayɛ a, amaa saa bɛdie gyima ye wɔ me sa nu a me gɔnwo mɔ alie me wɔ bɛ azua nu.’
5“Zɔhane ati ɔvɛlɛvɛlɛle ɔ menle ne kavolɛma ne mɔ ngoko ngoko na ɔbizale mɔɔ lumua la kɛ, ‘Wɔmɔ, ɛtua me menle ɛzɛ?’ 6Ɔbuale kɛ, ‘Nwole angola ɛya ko.’ Gyaneavolɛ ne hanle kɛ, ‘Wɔ mgbonda ne ɛne, tɛnla aze na kɛlɛ abulanlu.’ 7Akee ɔbizale ko noko kɛ, ‘Na ɛdawɔ noko ɛ, ɛtua ɛzɛ?’ Ɔbuale kɛ, ‘Abɛlɛ ahodoku apenle ko.’ Gyaneavolɛ ne hanle hilele ye kɛ, ‘Wɔ mgbonda ne ɛne, kɛlɛ ɛya mɔtwɛ.’
8“Na nrenya sukoavolɛ ne hanvole gyaneavolɛ anyebolo ne wɔ ye nrɛlɛbɛ mɔɔ ɔbɔle ɔyɛle ye alane gyima ne la anwo, ɔluakɛ ɔnwunle kɛ ɛtane ewiade ye anu amra ze awule nwo nrɛlɛbɛ fa yɛ nwule ninyɛne nea bɛ nwo tɛla wienyi nu amra.”
9Na Gyisɛse hɔle zo zele kɛ, “Yemɔti meka meahile bɛ, ezukoa ɛnle kpalɛ ɛdeɛ, noko anrɛɛ bɛva bɛ ezukoa nee bɛ anwonyia bɛdila agɔnwolɛ, amaa saa bɛkpo aze a, bɛalie bɛ wɔ awuke mɔɔ ɛmbɔ ɛlɛ la anu. 10Sonla biala mɔɔ di nɔhalɛ wɔ debie nretee biala anwo la di nɔhalɛ noko wɔ ninyɛne mgbole nwo, yɛɛ sonla biala mɔɔ le awule wɔ debie nretee nwo la le awule wɔ ninyɛne mgbole nwo. 11Na saa bɛngola bɛnli nɔhalɛ wɔ ewiade ye anyiabɛnwo nwo a, ɛnee kɛ ɔkɛyɛ na bɛava nɔhalɛ anwonyia ne bɛawula bɛ sa nu ɛ? 12Saa bɛnli nɔhalɛ wɔ awie debie nwo a ɛnee nwane a kɛva mɔɔ le bɛdabɛ noko bɛ ɛdeɛ la kɛmaa bɛ a?
13 “Sonvolɛ biala ɛnrɛhola ɛmenlenlɛ nwiɔ sonle, ɔluakɛ ɔbakpɔ ko na yeahulo ko; ɔbali nɔhalɛ yeamaa ko na yeakpɔ ko. Zɔhane ala noko yɛɛ ɔde ɔmaa bɛ a, bɛnrɛhola Nyamenle nee ezukoa sonle.”
Gyisɛse anloa edwɛkɛ ne bie mɔ
(Mat 11.12-13; 5.31-32; Mak 10.11-12)
14Falasiima ne mɔ dele ɛhye amuala la, bɛgolole Gyisɛse anwo, ɔboalekɛ bɛkulo ezukoa kpalɛ. 15Gyisɛse zele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛmɛ, bɛle menli bie mɔɔ bu bɛ nwo wɔ menli nyunlu kɛ asɛɛ bɛdi pɛlepɛle, noko Nyamenle ze bɛ ahonle ne mɔ anu. Ɔluakɛ mɔɔ menli dwenle a ɔsonle bolɛ wɔ bɛ nye zo la le debie mgbane wɔ Nyamenle anye zo.
16 “Ɛnee Mosisi mɛla ne nee mɔɔ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma hɛlɛle la gyi kpundii hɔkpulale mekɛ mɔɔ Dwɔn Sɔnevolɛ ne rale la; ɔvi mekɛ ne anu toonwo mɔɔ ɛrakpula ɛnɛ, mɔɔ bɛvale Edwɛkpa ne mɔɔ fane Nyamenle Belemgbunlililɛ ne anwo la nolobɔlɛ la, awie biala ɛlɛpele kɛ ɔkɛnyia ye. 17 Na ɔnyɛ se kɛ anwuma nee aze kɛpɛ nu kɛze, tɛla kɛ mɛla ne anu edwɛkɛkpɔkɛ nretee ko kɛminli a.
18 “Nrenya biala mɔɔ kɛbɔ ɔ ye ewole na ɔkɛgya raalɛ fofolɛ la ɛdo awuvolɛvalɛ mɛla ne; yɛɛ nrenya mɔɔ kɛgya raalɛ mɔɔ ɔ hu ɛbɔ ye ewole la ɛdo awuvolɛvalɛ mɛla ne.
Nrenya sukoavolɛ ne nee Lazalɛse
19“Nrenya sukoavolɛ bie woale ɛkɛ; ɔhedale ndanlɛ ngɛnlɛma mɔɔ awolɛ yɛ se la na ɔlile ɔ ti dahuu. 20Nrenya ehyianli bie noko ɔdaye ɔwoale ɛkɛ, bɛfɛlɛ ye Lazalɛse. Nganlɛ ɛdudu ye, na bɛfa ye bɛbatɛnla sukoavolɛ ne anuhɔlɛ dahuu, 21saa ɔkɛnyia mgbokpoloka ne mɔɔ vi sukoavolɛ ne ɛkponle ne azo gua aze la bie ɔkɛli a; na dahuu ahwea ne mɔ batafe ye nganlɛ ne mɔ anu.
22“Nrenya ehyianli ne wule na anwuma soanvolɛma ravale ye ɛkɛla anyelielɛ nu hɔdole Ebileham akɛnra anu. Nzinlii, sukoavolɛ ne ɔdaye ɔwule na bɛziele ye. 23Ɛbolɔ nehane, mɔɔ ɛnee ɔlɛnwu amaneɛ la, ɔmanle ɔ nye zo na ɔnwunle Ebileham wɔ moa moa lɔ na Lazalɛse de ɔ nwo ɛkɛ ne. 24Yemɔti ɔdeanle nu ɔhanle kɛ, ‘Egya Ebileham, nwu me anwunvɔne, na soa Lazalɛse maa ɔva ɔ sa ɛrɛlɛsɛka ko ɔbɔ nzule nu na ɔva ɔrape me tafinlima azo, ɔluakɛ me ɛbolɛ ɛlɛte wɔ sendɔlɔra ye anu!’
25“Na Ebileham zele ye kɛ, ‘Me ra, kakye kɛ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛde aze la ɛnyianle ɛbɛla nu ninyɛne kpalɛ ngome, yɛɛ Lazalɛse nyianle ninyɛne ɛtane ngome. Na kɛkala, wɔ ɛke, ɔ rɛle ɛkyekye, yɛɛ wɔmɔ ɛlɛnwu amaneɛ a. 26Saa ɛtu ɛhye bɔbɔ ɛsie ahane a, eza kuma kpole bie la wɔ nee yɛ avinli, amaa awie angola anvi ɛke amba ɛ nwo lɔ, na awie noko vi nehane ara ɛke.’ 27Nrenya sukoavolɛ ne hanle kɛ, ‘Saa zɔhane ɛdeɛ a, ɛnee mesɛlɛ wɔ, soa Lazalɛse wɔ me sua nu ɛkɛ. 28Melɛ mediema nnu wɔ ɛkɛ ne, maa ɔhɔbɔ bɛ kɔkɔ, amaa bɛdabɛ noko bɛamba abodelɛ ɛleka ɛhye.’
29“Ebileham zele ye kɛ, ‘Bɛlɛ menli wɔ bɛ nwo lɔ ɛlɛkakyehakye bɛ Mosisi mɛla ne nee Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma ngilehilelɛ ne mɔ, na ɔwɔ kɛ ɛ mediema ne mɔ tie bɛ.’ 30Nrenya sukoavolɛ ne buale kɛ, ‘Egya Ebileham, ɔle kpalɛ ɛdeɛ, noko saa awie vi mɔwuamra anu dwazo kɔ kɔbɔ bɛ amaneɛ a, yɛɛ bɛkɛnlu bɛ nwo a.’ 31Na Ebileham zele kɛ, ‘Saa bɛnrɛdie menli mɔɔ ɛlɛkilehile bɛ Mosisi mɛla ne nee mɔɔ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma ne hanle la a, ɛnee saa awie vi mɔwuamra anu dwazo kɔ bɔbɔ a, bɛnrɛdie ye.’ ”

Title: LUK 17
Content:
Ɛtane
(Mat 18.6-7,21-22; Mak 9.42)
1Gyisɛse zele ye ɛdoavolɛma ne kɛ, “Ɔwɔ kɛ ninyɛne mɔɔ twehwe sonla kɔ ɛtane nu la sisi, na mɔɔ ɔkɛlua ɔ nwo zo ɔkɛzi la, ye gyakɔ. 2Ɔle kpalɛ kɛ anrɛɛ bɛkɛdwe ɛdibolɛ kpole bɛkɛhenda ɔ kɔme na bɛkɛhɔdo ye nyevile nu tɛla kɛ ɔkɛmaa awie mɔɔ ye diedi wɔ me nu kɛ ngakula ɛhye mɔ la ko kɛyɛ ɛtane. 3 Yemɔti bɛnlea mɔɔ bɛyɛ la.
“Saa ɛ diema fo wɔ a, tea ye, na saa ɔnu ɔ nwo a, fa ye ɛtane kyɛ ye. 4Saa kenle ko bɔbɔ ɔfo wɔ fane nsuu, na ɔsia ɔba fane nsuu ɔbaka ɔkile wɔ kɛ, ‘Menlu me nwo’ a, ɔwɔ kɛ ɛfa ye ɛtane ɛkyɛ ye.”
Diedi
5Ɛzoanvolɛma ne hanle hilele Awulae kɛ, “Maa yɛ diedi ɛnyi.”
6Awulae buale bɛ kɛ, “Saa bɛlɛ diedi mɔɔ ye kpole le kɛ ‘mɛsetade’ baka ma ekyi bie bɔbɔ la a, anrɛɛ bɛkɛhola bɛkɛha bɛkɛhile baka kpole ɛhye mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye ‘sekamɔ’ la kɛ, ‘Tu kɔgyinla nyevile nu lɔ’ a, ɔkɛyɛ zɔhane.”
Sonvolɛ Gyima
7“Saa bɛ nuhua bie lɛ ye sonvolɛ wɔ ye egyinli nu anzɛɛ mɔɔ ka ye mboane na saa ɔvi ɛbɔ nu ɔba a, asoo ɔkɛze ye kɛ, ‘Ka ɛ nwo bɛla badɛnla aze di debie’ ɔ? 8Kyɛkyɛ! Ɔbaze ye kɛ, ‘Siezie me aleɛ ne na kendɛ maa menli debie na mewie a wɔahɔli wɔ ɛdeɛ ne.’ 9Sonvolɛ ɛnfɛta moyɛlɛ wɔ mɔɔ ɔ menle kɛze ye kɛ ɔyɛ na yeyɛ la anwo. 10Zɔhane ala yɛɛ bɛdabɛ noko saa bɛyɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛze bɛ kɛ bɛyɛ la amuala bɛwie a, bɛha kɛ, ‘Yɛle sonvolɛma mɔɔ yɛ nwo ɛnlɛ nvasoɛ a; yɛyɛ yɛ gyima mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ yɛyɛ la.’ ”
Gyisɛse yɛ menli bulu ayile
11Mɔɔ Gyisɛse kɔ Gyɛlusalɛm la, ɔpenle Samɛlea nee Galeli ɛweɛne zo. 12Na mɔɔ ɔka ekyii ɔdwu namule bie azo la, mrenya bulu mɔɔ le kokobɛvolɛma la yiale ye. Bɛgyinlanle moa moa 13na bɛdeanle nu bɛzele kɛ, “Gyisɛse! Awulae! Nwu yɛ anwunvɔne.”
14 Gyisɛse nwunle bɛ la ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛhɔ na bɛva bɛ nwo bɛhɔhile sɛlɛvolɛma ne mɔ.”
Mɔɔ bɛlua adenle zo bɛlɛkɔ la, bɛ nwo zale. 15Na bɛ nuhua ko nwunle kɛ ɔ nwo ɛza, yemɔti ɔziale ɔ nzi, ɔyele Nyamenle ayɛlɛ. 16na ɔradule ɔdɔle Gyisɛse agyakɛ anu mutule nu na ɔyɛle ye mo somaa. Nrenya ɛhye le Samɛleanli. 17Gyisɛse hanle kɛ, “Menli bulu a menyɛle bɛ ayile a, na ngɔnla ne wɔ nienwu? 18Duzu ati a ɛyɛvolɛ ye ala a ɛzia ɛra bayɛ Nyamenle mo a?” 19Na Gyisɛse zele nrenya ne kɛ, “Dwazo kɔ; wɔ diedi ɛyɛ wɔ ayile.”
Belemgbunlililɛ ne ɛralɛ
(Mat 24.23-28,37-41)
20Falasiima bie bizale Gyisɛse kenle mɔɔ Nyamenle Belemgbunlililɛ ne kɛra la. Gyisɛse buale kɛ, “Nyamenle Belemgbunlililɛ ne ɛnrɛra ye mɔɔ awie anye dua ye a. 21Awie ɛnrɛha kɛ, ‘Nea, yemɔ ɛne!’ anzɛɛ ‘Yemɔ a wɔ lɔ la!’ ɔboalekɛ Nyamenle Belemgbunlililɛ ne ɛra na ɔde bɛ ahonle nu.”
22Akee ɔzele ye ɛdoavolɛma ne kɛ, “Mekɛ bara mɔɔ bɛ kunlu a anrɛɛ bɛkɛnwu Sonla Ra ne mekɛ ne anu kenle ko bɔbɔ, na bɛnrɛnwu ye. 23Bie mɔ baze bɛ kɛ, ‘Nea, ɔwɔ nehane’ anzɛɛ ‘Nea, ɔwɔ ɛke!’ Noko bɛmmafinde kɛ bɛkanlea. 24Kɛ ɛsɛlɛmanye si kpakye wienyi ta anwomanyunlu vi ɔ ti kɔkpula ɔ bo la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ medame Sonla Ra, mebara wɔ mekɛ ne anu a. 25Noko ɔwɔ kɛ medumua menwu amaneɛ dɔɔnwo na adwuleso amra kpo me. 26 Kɛmɔ Nowa mekɛ zo ɔyɛle la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ medame Sonla Ra, me mekɛ zo ɔbayɛ a. 27 Awie biala hɔle zolɛ lile, nlonle; mraalɛ ɛgyalɛ nee agyalɛ ɛhɔlɛ liele ebia hɔkpulale kenle mɔɔ Nowa hɔvole ɛlɛne ne anu na ezule ne dɔle bule aze na ɔhunle bɛ muala la. 28Ɔbayɛ kɛ Lɔɔto mekɛ zo ala la. Menli hɔle zolɛ lile, nlonle, bɛlile gua, bɛyɛle egyinli na bɛsisile azua. 29Na kenle ko ne mɔɔ Lɔɔto vile Sodɔm la, Nyamenle manle senle nee sɔlefe vi anwuma dɔle kɛ ezule la rahunle bɛ muala. 30Zɔhane ala yɛɛ kenle mɔɔ medame Sonla Ra, mebara la ɔbayɛ a.
31 “Kenle zɔhane, awie mɔɔ wɔ ye sua ti zo la mmadwu aze kɛ ɔkɔ ye sua ne anu yeahɔva ye ninyɛne; zɔhane ala yɛɛ mɔɔ wɔ ye ɛya nu la mmasia ba sua zo a. 32 Bɛhakye mɔɔ zile Lɔɔto aye ne anwo zo la! 33 Awie biala mɔɔ pele ye ngoane nwo la minli ye; na mɔɔ kɛminli ye ngoane wɔ mame me ti la kɛnyia ngoane mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ. 34Meka meahile bɛ, kenle ko ne nɔe ne, menli nwiɔ mɔɔ la ɛkpa ko azo la, bɛbava ko bɛahɔ bɛagyakyi ko. 35Mraalɛ nwiɔ bahɔ abɛlɛ ɛdinlɛ wɔ ɛleka ko, bɛbava ko bɛahɔ bɛagyakyi ko. [36Menli nwiɔ bahɔ ɛya nu, bɛbava ko bɛahɔ bɛagyakyi ko.”]
37Ɛdoavolɛma ne bizale ye kɛ, “Awulae, ɛnee nienwu ɔ?”
Gyisɛse buale kɛ, “Ɛleka mɔɔ debie funli la la, ɛkɛ ne a mgbɔtɛ kuohua bɛ nloa a.”

Title: LUK 18
Content:
Kunlanvolɛ raalɛ ne nee ndɛnebuavolɛ ne anwo ɛrɛlɛ
1Akee Gyisɛse bule ɛrɛlɛ ɛhye hilele ye ɛdoavolɛma ne mɔ vale hilele kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛyɛ nzɛlɛlɛ dahuu na ɔnle kɛ bɛkpo aze. 2Ɔse, “Ndɛnebuavolɛ bie woale suakpole bie azo. Ndɛnebuavolɛ ɛhye ɛnzulo Nyamenle yɛɛ ɔmbu sonla biala. 3Kunlanvolɛ raalɛ bie noko wɔ sua ne azo; dahuu ɔkɔ ndɛnebuavolɛ ne ɛkɛ ɔfa ye edwɛkɛ ɔkɔto ɔ nyunlu kɛ, ‘Awie ɛlɛgyegye me, di me edwɛkɛ ye maa me.’ 4Mekɛ dɔɔnwo ne ala ɛnee ɔngulo kɛ ɔkɛboa raalɛ ne, na nzinlii ɔhanle ɔhilele ɔ nwo kɛ, ‘Menzulo Nyamenle, yɛɛ membu sonla bɔbɔ ɛdeɛ, 5noko kɛ raalɛ kunlanvolɛ ɛhye ɛlɛsi agyegye me la, mebanlea ye edwɛkɛ ne meamaa ye, anrɛɛ ɔnrɛmaa me nwo ɛnrɛdɔ me.’ ”
6Na Awulae vale zɔle zolɛ kɛ, “Bɛdie mɔɔ ndɛnebuavolɛ alane ne hanle a. 7Asoo Nyamenle ɛnrɛli ɔdaye ye menli ne mɔɔ kpondɛ moalɛ na bɛtea bɛfɛlɛ ye nɔɔzo nee ewiazo la ati edwɛkɛ? Asoo ɔkɛhwenlehwenle ɔ bo aze wɔ bɛ moalɛ nwo? 8Meka meahile bɛ, ɔkɛli bɛ edwɛkɛ ɔkɛmaa bɛ ndɛndɛ zo somaa. Na asoo saa medame Sonla Ra meba a, menwɔnwu awie mɔɔ ɔ rɛle wɔ Nyamenle anu la?”
Falasiinli ne nee adwuledievolɛ ne anwo ɛrɛlɛ
9Eza Gyisɛse bule ɛrɛlɛ ɛhye hilele bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛbu bɛ nwo na bɛmbu awie biala la. 10Ɔse, “Menli nwiɔ bie hɔle Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu kɛ bɛkazɛlɛ; ko le Falasiinli yɛɛ ko le adwuledievolɛ.
11“Falasiinli ne gyinlanle nzisi na ɔzɛlɛle kɛ, ‘Nyamenle, meyɛ wɔ mo kɛ membɔ apo, menli nzisi yɛɛ mendo awuvolɛvalɛ mɛla ne kɛ awie biala de la; meyɛ wɔ mo kɛ menle kɛ adwuledievolɛ ɛhye bɔbɔ mɔɔ wɔ lɔ la. 12Dapɛne ko anu mekye ɛhɔne fane nwiɔ, yɛɛ mebu me ezukoa mɔɔ menyia ye la anu bulu metu ko memaa wɔ.’
13“Na adwuledievolɛ ne gyinlanle ahane ɛleka bie, yeangulo kɛ ɔkɛkpogya ɔ ti zo bɔbɔ. Ɔvale ɔ sa ɔguale ye ɛbolɛ zo na ɔzele kɛ, ‘O Awulae Nyamenle, nwu me anwunvɔne na mele ɛtanevolɛ!’ ” 14 Na Gyisɛse vale zɔle zolɛ kɛ, “Meka meahile bɛ, adwuledievolɛ ne zɔle Nyamenle anye wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɔlɛkɔ sua nu la dɛlale Falasiinli ne. Ɔluakɛ awie biala mɔɔ memaa ɔ nwo zo la Nyamenle bɛlɛ ye aze, yɛɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛ ɔ nwo aze la Nyamenle kpogya ye zo.”
Gyisɛse yila ngakula
(Mat 19.13-15; Mak 10.13-16)
15Menli bie vale bɛ mra rale kɛ Gyisɛse ɛva ɔ sa ɛgua bɛ nwo zo na ɔyila bɛ. Ɛdoavolɛma ne nwunle bɛ la bɛdendɛle bɛ. 16Na Gyisɛse vɛlɛle ngakula ne mɔ wɔ ɔ nwo ɛkɛ ne na ɔzele kɛ, “Bɛgyakyi ngakula ne mɔ bɛmaa bɛrɛla me nwo, bɛmmatua bɛ, ɔboalekɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛle kɛ ɛhye mɔ zɛhae la yɛɛ Nyamenle Belemgbunlililɛ ne le bɛ ɛdeɛ a. 17Bɛhakye ɛhye, awie biala mɔɔ anyɛ ɔ nwo kɛ kakula anlie Nyamenle Belemgbunlililɛ ne ando nu la ɛnrɛnyia ye.”
Sukoavolɛ ne nee Gyisɛse
(Mat 19.16-30; Mak 10.17-31)
18Dwuu kpanyinli bie bizale Gyisɛse kɛ, “Kilehilevolɛ kpalɛ, duzu a menyɛ na meanyia ngoane mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ a?”
19Gyisɛse bizale ye kɛ, “Duzu ati a ɛse mele kpalɛ a? Awie biala ɛnle kpalɛ kɛ Nyamenle angomekye. 20 Ɛze mɛla ne mɔ: mmato awuvolɛvalɛ mɛla ne, mmayɛ kɔdiawu, mmadi daselɛ adalɛ, mmawua, di ɛ ze nee ɛ nli eni.”
21Nrenya ne buale kɛ, “Sumunli me nretee ne ala yɛɛ menvale mɛla ɛhye mɔ azo ɛlilɛ a.”
22Gyisɛse dele ɛhye la, ɔzele ye kɛ, “Yeha wɔ debie ko. Tɔne debie biala mɔɔ ɛlɛ la amuala na kyɛ ezukoa ne maa ehyianvolɛma, na ɛkɛnyia anwonyia wɔ Nyamenle anwo lɔ, na akee bɛla badoa me bo zo.” 23Nrenya ne dele ɛhye la nyane hunle ye kpole, ɔluakɛ ɔle sukoavolɛ kpole.
24Gyisɛse nleanle ye koonwu na ɔzele kɛ, “Ɔyɛ se ɔmaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnyia bɛ nwo la kɛ bɛkɛnyia Nyamenle Belemgbunlililɛ ne a. 25Ɔluakɛ ɔnyɛ se kɛ afunlumu kɛwolo agbuyia tokule nu tɛla kɛ sukoavolɛ kɛnyia Nyamenle Belemgbunlililɛ ne a.”
26Menli mɔɔ dele mɔɔ Gyisɛse hanle la bizale kɛ, “Ɛnee nwane bɔbɔ a kɛnyia ngoane a?”
27Gyisɛse buale kɛ, “Mɔɔ yɛ se maa sonla la ɛnyɛ se ɛmmaa Nyamenle.”
28Na Pita zele kɛ, “Nea o, yɛgyakyi debie biala yɛɛ yɛdoa ɛbo zo o!”
29Gyisɛse zele bɛ kɛ, “Ɛhɛe, ɔle zɔhane, noko bɛdie: Awie biala mɔɔ ɛgyakyi ye sua, ɔ ye nee ɔ mediema, ye awovolɛ anzɛɛ ɔ mra wɔ Nyamenle Belemgbunlililɛ ne ati la 30banyia ye mɔnwo wɔ mekɛ ɛhye ala anu nee ngoane mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bara la anu.”
Gyisɛse ka ye ewule nwo edwɛkɛ mɔɔ tɔ zo nsa
(Mat 20.17-19; Mak 10.32-34)
31Gyisɛse vale ɛdoavolɛma bulu nee nwiɔ ne hɔle ahane na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛdie! Yɛlɛkɔ Gyɛlusalɛm, na ɛkɛ ne yɛɛ debie biala mɔɔ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma hɛlɛle wɔ medame Sonla Ra me nwo la bayɛ zɔhane a. 32Bɛbaye me bɛawula menli mɔɔ ɛnle Dwuuma la asa anu, na bɛbazi me amgbu, bɛayɛ me aholoba na bɛatoto nyɛlɛ me nyunlu. 33Bɛbabila me mbaka na bɛahu me, na ye kenle nsa ne anzi, mebadwazo meara ngoane nu.”
34Ɛdoavolɛma ne ande ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ biala abo; bɛvale edwɛkɛ ne anwo ndelebɛbo bɛveale bɛ, yemɔti bɛannwu mɔɔ Gyisɛse ɛlɛka la anzi.
Gyisɛse yɛ anyenzinliravolɛ bie ayile
(Mat 20.29-34; Mak 10.46-52)
35Mɔɔ Gyisɛse bikyele Gyɛleko la, ɛnee anyenzinliravolɛ bie de adehane ne ɛlɛsɛlɛzɛlɛ ninyɛne, 36na ɔdele menli dɔɔnwo ne mɔɔ ɛlɛse la ane la, ɔbizale kɛ, “Duzu ɔ?”
37Bɛbuale ye kɛ, “Gyisɛse mɔɔ vi Nazalɛte la a ɛlɛse a.”
38Na ɔdeanle nu ɔzele kɛ, “Gyisɛse, Devidi ara! Nwu me anwunvɔne!”
39Menli mɔɔ lumua la deɛdeanle ye nu na bɛzele ye kɛ ɔyɛ koonwu; na akee ɔdeanle nu kpole kpalɛ kɛ, “Devidi ara, nwu me anwunvɔne!”
40Yemɔti Gyisɛse gyinlanle na ɔzele kɛ, “Bɛva nrenya anyenzinliravolɛ ne bɛrɛla.” Mɔɔ ɔrale la, Gyisɛse bizale ye kɛ, 41“Duzu a ɛkulo kɛ meyɛ memaa wɔ a?”
Na ɔbuale kɛ, “Yɛmenle, mekulo kɛ menwu debie bieko.”
42Na Gyisɛse zele ye kɛ, “Nwu debie! Wɔ diedi ɛyɛ wɔ ayile.”
43Na ɛkɛ ne ala ɔnwunle debie, na ɔdoale Gyisɛse ɔyele Nyamenle ayɛlɛ. Mɔɔ menli dɔɔnwo ne nwunle ɛhye la, bɛ muala bɛyele Nyamenle ayɛlɛ.

Title: LUK 19
Content:
Gyisɛse nee Zakeɛse
1Gyisɛse hɔle Gyɛleko na ɔlɛpɛ nu sua ne azo. 2Adwuledievolɛ kpanyinli bie noko wɔ sua ne azo mɔɔ ɛnyia ɔ nwo kpole a; bɛfɛlɛ ye Zakeɛse. 3Nrenya ɛhye bɔle mɔdenle kɛ ɔkɛnwu Gyisɛse sonla holɛ na kɛmɔ ɔle adwola na menli ne zonle la ati ɛnee ɔnnwu ye. 4Yemɔti ɔnriandile ɔlumuale ɛlɔne ne anyunlu na ɔhɔvole baka bie mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye “sekamɔ” la azo saa ɔkɛnwu ye a, ɔluakɛ ɛkɛ ne ala a Gyisɛse bape a. 5Gyisɛse dwule ɛkɛ ne la, ɔdole ɔ nye anwuma na ɔzele Zakeɛse kɛ, “Zakeɛse, ka ɛ nwo dwu aze, na ɛnɛ mebazokoɛ wɔ.”
6Ndɛndɛ ne ala Zakeɛse dwule aze na ɔvale fɛlɛkolilɛ kpole ɔliele Gyisɛse. 7Menli mɔɔ nwunle ye la amuala dendɛle bɛ nzo abo kɛ, “Akee ɛtanenli ɛhye sua nu a nrenya ye ɛhɔ kazokoɛ a!”
8Na Zakeɛse dwazole na ɔhanle ɔhilele Awulae kɛ, “Awulae, mebabu me ninyɛne mɔɔ melɛ la anu nwiɔ na meava ko meamaa ehyianvolɛma, na saa meli awie ndunlumi a, mebadua ye kakɛ mɔnwo nna.”
9Gyisɛse zele ye kɛ, “Ɛnɛ kenle ye, bɛlie wɔ ngoane, ɛdawɔ noko ɛle Ebileham anlɔnra. 10 Ɛhye ala ati yɛɛ medame Sonla Ra membale a. Membale kɛ mebakpondɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛminli la na mealie bɛ ngoane.”
Ezukoa nwo ɛrɛlɛ
(Mat 25.14-30)
11 Menli mɔɔ ɛnee ɛlɛtie edwɛkɛ ɛhye mɔ la zuzule ye bɛ ti anu kɛ, kɛmɔ bɛbikye Gyɛlusalɛm la, Nyamenle Belemgbunlililɛ ne asɛɛ ɛra ɛwie. Yemɔti Gyisɛse bule bɛ ɛrɛlɛ ɛhye. 12Ɔse, “Nrenya bie mɔɔ lɛ duma la yɛle kɛ ɔkɔ maanle zo moa moa yeamaa bɛazie ye belemgbunli na akee yeazia yeara sua nu. 13Mɔɔ ɔbanyia nwo la, ɔvɛlɛle ye sonvolɛma bulu ne, ɔmanle ko biala sɔnvɛlɛ ko na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, ‘Menle ɛke, yemɔti bɛva ezukoa ɛhye bɛli gua bɛnlea mɔɔ bɛkɛnyia ye nwolɛ la.’ 14Kɛmɔ ɔdaye ye maanle ne anu amra kpɔ ye la ati, bɛdule menli bɛmanle bɛhɔzele kɛ, ‘Yɛngulo kɛ nrenya ɛhye di yɛ belemgbunli.’
15“Noko bɛziele nrenya ne belemgbunli na ɔziale ɔrale sua nu. Ɔradwule ala la, ɔmanle bɛvɛlɛvɛlɛle ye sonvolɛma ne kɛ bɛrabu bɛ mgbonda bɛmaa ɔnwu nvasoɛ mɔɔ bɛnyianle ye la. 16Mɔɔ lumua la rale rahanle kɛ, ‘Yɛmenle, menyia sɔnvɛlɛ bulu meboka wɔ ɛdeɛ ko ne mɔɔ ɛvale ɛmanle me la anwo.’ 17Belemgbunli ne zele ye kɛ, ‘Mo, ɛle sonvolɛ kpalɛ! Kɛmɔ wɔli nɔhalɛ wɔ ninyɛne ngyikyi nwo la, mebamaa wɔanlea azuamgbole bulu azo.’ 18Mɔɔ tɔ zo nwiɔ la rahanle kɛ, ‘Yɛmenle, menyia sɔnvɛlɛ nnu meboka ko ne mɔɔ ɛvale ɛmanle me la anwo.’ 19Belemgbunli ne zele ye kɛ, ‘Ɛdawɔ noko ɛbanlea azuamgbole nnu azo.’
20“Sonvolɛ ko noko rale na ɔrahanle kɛ, ‘Yɛmenle, wɔ sɔnvɛlɛ ko ne ɛne; membɔle ye duku nloa menziele. 21Mesulo wɔ, ɔboalekɛ ɛle sonla mɔɔ ɛ ti yɛ se; ɛfa mɔɔ ɛnle wɔ ɛdeɛ la yɛɛ ɛbu mɔɔ wɔanlua la.’ 22Belemgbunli ne zele ye kɛ, ‘Wɔmɔ sonvolɛ ɛhye, ɛnle kpalɛ! Mefa ɛdawɔ ɛ nloa edwɛkɛ meabua wɔ ndɛne. Ɛse me kɛ me ti yɛ se, mefa mɔɔ ɛnle me ɛdeɛ yɛɛ mebu mɔɔ tɛ me a menluale la. 23Duzu ati a wɔanva me ezukoa ne wɔangɔndo bange ɛ? Anrɛɛ mera la, mehɔlie me ezukoa ne boka nwolɛ nzinwo ne amuala.’
24“Na ɔzele menli mɔɔ gyigyi ɛkɛ ne la kɛ, ‘Bɛlie sɔnvɛlɛ ko ne wɔ ɔ sa nu bɛva bɛmaa mɔɔ lɛ bulu ne la.’ 25Bɛzele ye kɛ, ‘Yɛmenle, yemɔ, ɔlɛ sɔnvɛlɛ bulu dɛba.’ 26 Na ɔbuale bɛ kɛ, ‘Meka meahile bɛ: Mɔɔ lɛ bie la, bɛmaa ye bie dɔɔnwo bɛboka mɔɔ ɔlɛ la anwo; na mɔɔ ɛnlɛ bie la, ekyi ne bɔbɔ mɔɔ ɔlɛ la, bɛdie ye wɔ ɔ sa nu. 27Akee me agbɔvolɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ se bɛngulo kɛ medi bɛ belemgbunli la, bɛva bɛ bɛrɛla bɛrahu bɛ wɔ me nyunlu ɛke!’ ”
Gyisɛse kɔ Gyɛlusalɛm konimlilɛ nu
(Mat 21.1-11; Mak 11.1-11; Dw 12.12-19)
28Gyisɛse hanle ɛhye na akee ɔlumuale bɛ nyunlu kɛ ɔkɔ Gyɛlusalɛm. 29Ɔbikyele Bɛtefagyi nee Bɛtani, wɔ Ɔlivi Boka ne azo la, ɔzoanle ye ɛdoavolɛma ne nwiɔ ɔmanle bɛlumuale ɔ nyunlu, 30na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛhɔ namule ne mɔɔ wɔ bɛ nyunlu lɔ la azo. Saa bɛdwu ɛkɛ ne a, bɛkɛnwu asoaso ralɛ mɔɔ awie ɛtɛtɛnlanle zo ɛlɛ la kɛ ɔhenda ɛkɛ; bɛzianyi ye bɛrɛla. 31Saa awie biza bɛ kɛ duzu ati a bɛlɛsianyi ye a, bɛze ye kɛ, ‘Awulae ɛhyia nwolɛ.’ ”
32Bɛhɔle na bɛhɔnwunle debie biala, kɛmɔ Gyisɛse hanle hilele bɛ la. 33Mɔɔ bɛlɛsianyi asoaso ne la, ɔ menle mɔ bizale bɛ kɛ, “Duzu ati a bɛlɛsianyi asoaso ne ɛ?”
34Ɛdoavolɛma ne buale kɛ, “Awulae ɛhyia nwolɛ.” 35Na bɛvale asoaso ne bɛrɛlɛle Gyisɛse. Akee bɛsesɛle bɛ ndanlɛ wɔ asoaso ne azo na bɛmanle Gyisɛse dɛnlanle zolɛ. 36Na mɔɔ ɔlɛkɔ la, bɛsesɛle ndanlɛ azɛlɛ nwo bɛmanle ɔluale zolɛ.
37Ɔbikyele Gyɛlusalɛm wɔ Ɔlivi Boka ne ndololeɛ nu la, ye ɛdoavolɛma bebelebe ne bɔle ɔ bo vale fɛlɛkolilɛ yɛle Nyamenle mo yele ye ayɛlɛ wɔ ninyɛne mgbole ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛnwunle bɛ la ati, 38 na bɛzele kɛ, “Nyamenle ɛyila belemgbunli ne mɔɔ lua Awulae duma nu ɛlɛba la! Anzonudwolɛ wɔ anwuma na anyunlunyia ɛha Nyamenle!”
39Falasiima mɔɔ wɔ menli ne anu la bie mɔ zele Gyisɛse kɛ, “Kilehilevolɛ, maa wɔ ɛdoavolɛma ne ɛmua bɛ nloa!”
40Gyisɛse buale kɛ, “Meka meahile bɛ, saa bɛmua bɛ nloa bɔbɔ a, awolɛ bɔbɔ kɛdeɛdea nuhua.”
Gyisɛse su Gyɛlusalɛm
41Gyisɛse bikyele Gyɛlusalɛm na ɔnwunle sua ne la, ɔzunle, 42na ɔzele kɛ, “Anrɛɛ ɛnɛ kenle ye bɔbɔ wɔahola wɔanwu deɛ mɔɔ maa anzonudwolɛ la! Na kɛkala ɛdeɛ, ɛnrɛhola ɛnrɛnwu ye! 43Mekɛ bara mɔɔ wɔ kpɔvolɛma bapɛ ɛ bo kuma ayia; bɛbadua wɔ adenle, na bɛvi ɛbɔ nu nee ɛnweazo bɛaraholo ɛ nwo zo. 44Bɛbagologolo wɔ bɛagua na bɛazɛkye menli mɔɔ wɔ zolɛ la amuala; bɛnrɛgyakyi bolɛ ko bɔbɔ wɔ ɔ bo zo ne, ɔboalekɛ wɔannwu mekɛ ne mɔɔ Nyamenle rale kɛ ɔbalie wɔ ngoane la.”
Gyisɛse kɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu
(Mat 21.12-17; Mak 11.15-19; Dw 2.13-22)
45Akee Gyisɛse wolole Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu, na ɔbɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɔfoa gualilɛma ne mɔ, 46 na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛhɛlɛ ye wɔ Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne anu kɛ, Nyamenle se, ‘Bɛbavɛlɛ me Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne Nzɛlɛlɛ Sua!’ Na bɛmɛ, bɛhakyi ye nwule fealeka.”
47 Kenle biala Gyisɛse kilehile wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu. Sɛlɛvolɛ mgbanyinli ne, mɛla kilehilevolɛma ne, yɛɛ mgbanyima ne mɔ kpondɛle kɛ bɛkɛhu ye, 48na bɛannyia nwolɛ adenle, ɔboalekɛ ɛnee menli ne amuala kulo kɛ bɛtie ye, amaa ye edwɛkɛ ne kpɔkɛ ko bɔbɔ andɛla bɛ nzo.

Title: LUK 20
Content:
Gyisɛse tumi ne anwo kpuyia
(Mat 21.23-27; Mak 11.27-33)
1Kenle ko Gyisɛse wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu ɔlɛkilehile na ɔbɔ Edwɛkpa ne nolo la, sɛlɛvolɛ mgbanyinli ne, mɛla kilehilevolɛma ne, yɛɛ mgbanyima ne mɔ 2rabizale ye kɛ, “Ka kile yɛ, duzu tumi a ɛlɛ, kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ ɛyɛ ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ a? Nwane a manle wɔ tumi ne a?”
3Gyisɛse buale bɛ kɛ, “Bɛmaa medame noko membiza bɛ edwɛkɛ ko. Bɛha bɛhile me, 4Dwɔn Sɔnevolɛ ne tumi ne mɔɔ ɔvale ɔzɔnenle menli la, ɔvi Nyamenle anzɛɛ sonla?”
5Bɛbɔle ɔ bo kɛ bɛsu bɛ nwo kpolera kɛ, “Duzu edwɛkɛ a yɛha a? Saa yɛka kɛ, ‘Ɔvi Nyamenle’ a, ɔkɛha kɛ, ‘Ɛnee duzu ati a bɛanlie Dwɔn bɛanli a?’ 6Saa yɛka noko kɛ, ‘Ɔvi sonla’ a, menli ɛwolaa ye mɔɔ wɔ ɛke la amuala kɛzi yɛ awolɛ, ɔboalekɛ bɛdie bɛto nu kɛ Dwɔn le Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ.” 7Yemɔti bɛbuale ye kɛ, “Yɛnze ɛleka mɔɔ ye tumi ne vi a.”
8Na Gyisɛse zele bɛ kɛ, “Ɛnee medame noko menrɛha tumi holɛ ko mɔɔ mefa meyɛ ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ la menrɛhile bɛ.”
Abunsama mɔɔ wɔ vanye tola ne anu la anwo ɛrɛlɛ
(Mat 21.33-46; Mak 12.1-12)
9 Akee Gyisɛse bule menli ne ɛrɛlɛ ɛhye kɛ, “Nrenya bie hyele ye tola na ɔluale vanye ma wɔ nu. Ɔvale ɔmanle abunsama na ɔhɔle maanle zo ɔhɔhyɛle kpalɛ. 10Ɛbuhenle ne dwule la, ɔzoanle ye sonvolɛ ko ɔmanle ɔhɔzele abunsama ne kɛ bɛva ye ɛkpɔ ɛdeɛ bɛmaa ɔrɛlɛ ye. Na abunsama ne bole ye na bɛmanle ɔlɛle ɔ sa mgbane ɔhɔle. 11Yemɔti ɔzoanle sonvolɛ fofolɛ, na ɔdaye noko bɛbole ye, bɛzale ye, na bɛmanle ɔlɛle ɔ sa mgbane ɔhɔle. 12Akee ɔzoanle ye sonvolɛ ne mɔɔ tɔ zo nsa la, na abunsama ne bodɛbodale ye, na bɛvuandinle ye bɛdole tola ne anzi lɔ. 13Na tola menle ne zele kɛ, ‘Duzu a menyɛ a? Mesoa medame me ra ye mɔɔ mekulo ye la; medie medi kɛ bɛkɛli ye eni!’ 14Na mɔɔ abunsama ne nwunle ye la, bɛhanle bɛhilele bɛ nwo ngoko kɛ, ‘Ɛya menle ne ara ne ɛne. Bɛmaa yɛhu ye na ye agyadeɛ ne ɛyɛ yɛ ɛdeɛ.’ 15Yemɔti bɛvuandinle ye bɛdole ɛya ne anzi lɔ na bɛhunle ye.”
Gyisɛse bizale bɛ kɛ, “Ɛnee akee duzu a tola menle ne kɛyɛ abunsama ne ɛ? 16Ɔkɛrahu abunsama ne mɔ amuala, na ɔkɛva ɛya ne ɔkɛwula abunsama fofolɛ asa anu.”
Menli ne mɔ dele ɛhye la, bɛzele kɛ, “Kyɛkyɛ, ɔnrɛyɛ ye zɔhane.”
17 Gyisɛse nleanle bɛ koonwu na ɔbizale bɛ kɛ, “Ɛnee akee kɛ Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ɛhye abo se ɛ?
‘Bolɛ ne mɔɔ suasivoma ne kpole la,
ɛrayɛ bolɛ mɔɔ anwo hyia kpole kpalɛ a.’
18“Awie biala mɔɔ kɛdɔ bolɛ zɔhane azo la, ɔbatete nzokanzoka; yɛɛ saa ɔtɔ awie anwo zo a, ɔbabɛtɛ ye kɛ tata.”
Adwuledualɛ nwo kpuyia
(Mat 22.15-22; Mak 12.13-17)
19Mɛla kilehilevolɛma ne nee sɛlɛvolɛ mgbanyinli ne mɔ yɛle kɛ bɛkye Gyisɛse ɛkɛ ne ala, ɔboalekɛ bɛze kɛ ɔbule ɛrɛlɛ ne ɔtiale bɛ; noko akee bɛzulole menli ne anye. 20Yemɔti bɛtetɛle ye. Bɛmanle menli bie ndoloboa bɛmanle bɛyɛle bɛ nwo kɛ asɛɛ bɛdi nɔhalɛ, na bɛzoanle bɛ kɛ bɛhɔdo Gyisɛse abɛla bɛbizebiza ye edwɛkɛ, amaa saa ɔ nloa fo a bɛahye ye na bɛava ye bɛahɔmaa Wulomu Amɛnlado ne ali ye edwɛkɛ. 21Menli ɛhye mɔ zele Gyisɛse kɛ, “Kilehilevolɛ, yɛze kɛ mɔɔ ɛka nee mɔɔ ɛkilehile la le fɔɔnwo. Yɛze kɛ wɔmɔ ɛnnea sonla nyunlu yɛɛ ɛndie menli ngehaleɛ, na ɛkilehile Nyamenle ɛhulolɛdeɛ ne nɔhalɛ nu. 22Ka kile yɛ, asoo yɛ mɛla ne tua kɛ yɛmmatua adwule yɛmaa Wulomu Maanle Maanle Belemgbunli ne anzɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ yɛtua?”
23Na Gyisɛse nwunle bɛ agyiba ne anzi na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, 24“Bɛva dwɛtɛ fufule bɛrɛla bɛmaa menea. Nwane nvoninli nee ye duma a wɔ zolɛ la?”
Bɛzele ye kɛ, “Wulomu Maanle Maanle Belemgbunli ne ɔ.”
25Yemɔti Gyisɛse zele bɛ kɛ, “Ɛnee mɔɔ le Wulomu Maanle Maanle Belemgbunli ne ɛdeɛ la, bɛdua bɛmaa ye, na bɛdua mɔɔ le Nyamenle noko ɛdeɛ la bɛmaa ye.”
26Gyisɛse nyelebɛnloa ne zinle bɛ nwo, yemɔti bɛ sa anga ye wɔ debie biala anu wɔ menli ne anyunlu ɛkɛ ne, na bɛhanle bɛ nloa bɛdole nu.
Ewudwazo nwo kpuyia
(Mat 22.23-33; Mak 12.18-27)
27 Akee Sadusiima bie noko rale Gyisɛse ɛkɛ ne. Menli ɛhye mɔ se sonla wu a bɛnrɛdwazo ye bɛnrɛra ngoane nu. Bɛbizale Gyisɛse kɛ, 28 “Kilehilevolɛ, Mosisi hɛlɛle mɛla ɛhye manle yɛ, ɔse: ‘Saa nrenya wu na ɔgyakyi ɔ ye mɔɔ ɔ nee ye anwo la a, ɔwɔ kɛ ɔ diema gya kunlanvolɛ raalɛ ne, na ɔ nee ye wo mralɛ maa ɔ diema ne mɔɔ ɛwu la.’ 29Na mediema nsuu bie ɛnee wɔ ɛkɛ. Bɛ nuhua kpanyinli ne gyale raalɛ na ɔ nee ye anwo yɛɛ ɔwule a. 30Adiema ne mɔɔ tɔ zo nwiɔ la gyale raalɛ ne, 31eza mɔɔ tɔ zo nsa la gyale ye. Zɔhane ala yɛɛ bɛdabɛ nsuu ne amuala bɛyɛle a. Bɛ biala nee ye anwo na yeawu. 32Nzinlii raalɛ ne ɔdaye ɔwule. 33Ɛnee akee kenle mɔɔ mɔwuamra kɛdwazo kɛra ngoane nu la, boni aye ɔ? Bɛdabɛ nsuu ne amuala bɛgyale ye bie.”
34Gyisɛse buale bɛ kɛ, “Adwuleso mrenya nee mraalɛ gya bɛ nwo, 35na mrenya nee mraalɛ mɔɔ anwo fɛta Nyamenle Belemgbunlililɛ ne la, saa mekɛ ne dwu na bɛdwazo bɛ bɛfi ewule nu a bɛngya bɛ nwo. 36Bɛbayɛ kɛ anwuma soanvolɛma la na bɛnrɛwu ɛlɛ. Bɛle Nyamenle amra, ɔboalekɛ bɛdwazo bɛ bɛvi ewule nu. 37 Mosisi noko kile nu wienyi kɛ bɛdwazo mɔwuamra bɛba ngoane nu. Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ fane ɛbɔ ne mɔɔ ɛnee ɛlɛsɔ la anwo la, Mosisi ka kɛ Awulae le ‘Ebileham Nyamenle, Ayezeke Nyamenle, yɛɛ Gyekɔbo Nyamenle.’ 38Ɛhye kile kɛ ɔle teasema Nyamenle, ɔnle bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwu la Nyamenle; ɔluakɛ ɔ nye zo a bɛ muala bɛde ngoane nu.”
39Mɛla kilehilevolɛma ne bie mɔ zele kɛ, “Kilehilevolɛ, wɔ nyelebɛnloa ne le kpalɛ bɔkɔɔ!” 40Na ɔvi kenle ko ne bɛangola ye kpuyia bieko biza.
Mɛzaya ne anwo kpuyia
(Mat 22.41-46; Mak 12.35-37)
41Gyisɛse bizale bɛ kɛ, “Kɛmɔti a bɛka kɛ Mɛzaya ne bayɛ Devidi anlɔnra ɛ? 42 Ɔluakɛ Devidi mumua ne ka ye wɔ Edwɛndolɛ Buluku ne anu kɛ,
‘Awulae zele me Awulae kɛ,
tɛnla me fema zo ɛke,
43kɔkpula kɛ menwɔva wɔ kpɔvolɛma
menwɔyɛ ɛ gyakɛ abo ebia.’
44Saa Devidi vɛlɛle ye ‘Awulae’ a, ɛnee kɛ ɔsi mɔɔ Mɛzaya ne yɛ ye anlɔnra ɛ?”
Gyisɛse bɔ kɔkɔ wɔ mɛla kilehilevolɛma anwo
(Mat 23.1-36; Mak 12.38-40)
45Gyisɛse akee zele ye ɛdoavolɛma ne mɔ wɔ menli ne amuala anyunlu ɛkɛ ne kɛ, 46“Bɛnlea boɛ wɔ mɛla kilehilevolɛma ne anwo; bɛmɛ, mɔɔ bɛkulo la a le adɛladeɛ ndendenle ɛwulalɛ, gua zo ɛkpɔsalɛ nee menli mɔɔ bɔ bɛ ti aze abiza bɛ ahye wɔ gua nu la; bɛkulo nyianu azua nu mgbanyinli ɛleka nee ɛkponledolɛ bo ɛleka kpalɛ ne mɔ ɛdɛnlanlɛ. 47Bɛbɛlɛbɛla ahunlanvolɛ mraalɛ bɛbɔ bɛ awuke ne mɔ, na akee bɛakpati bɛayɛ nwolɛ nzɛlɛlɛ ndendenle. Bɛ ndeanlɛ bayɛ kpole kpalɛ!”

Title: LUK 21
Content:
Kunlanvolɛ raalɛ ne azubɔdeɛ ne
(Mak 12.41-44)
1Gyisɛse dole ɔ nye na ɔnwunle kɛ sukoavolɛma lɛ bɛ ahyɛlɛ ninyɛne ɛlɛgua Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne gya ɛlɛka ne anu. 2Eza ɔnwunle kɛ kunlanvolɛ raalɛ ehyianli ko noko lɛ ɛkpɔsɛba nwiɔ ɛlɛgua gya ne anu. 3Gyisɛse zele kɛ, “Meka meahile bɛ, kunlanvolɛ raalɛ ehyianli ne ɛva mɔɔ le kpole la ɛgua gya ne anu ɛdɛla bɛ kɔsɔɔti. 4Ɔluakɛ bɛdabɛ kɔsɔɔti, mɔɔ bɛlɛ la anwo nvasoɛ ne bie a bɛvale bɛraguale nu a, na raalɛ kunlanvolɛ ne, yemɔ, ye kpokpoti ne ala a yeva yeragua nu la.”
Gyisɛse ka Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne ɛzɛkyelɛ nwo edwɛkɛ
(Mat 24.1-2; Mak 13.1-2)
5Ɛdoavolɛma ne bie mɔ hanle Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anwo edwɛkɛ, ye kɛnlɛma, awolɛ ngɛnlɛma mɔɔ bɛvale bɛzile nee azubɔdeɛ mɔɔ bɛvale bɛmanle Nyamenle la. Na Gyisɛse zele kɛ, 6“Ɛhye mɔ amuala mɔɔ bɛnwu bɛ la, mekɛ bara mɔɔ bolɛ ko bɔbɔ ɛnrɛla bolɛ zo a; bɛbagologolo bɛ muala bɛagua aze.”
Ngyegyelɛ nee anwongyelelɛ
(Mat 24.3-14; Mak 13.3-13)
7Bɛbizale ye kɛ, “Kilehilevolɛ, kenlenzu a ɛhye mɔ bazi a? Duzu debie a bazi ahile kɛ mekɛ ɛdwu mɔɔ ɛhye mɔ si a?”
8Gyisɛse zele kɛ, “Bɛnlea boɛ; bɛmmamaa bɛbɛlɛbɛla bɛ. Ɔluakɛ menli dɔɔnwo balua me duma nu ara na bɛaraze bɛ kɛ, ‘Mame a mele Kelaese ne a,’ na eza bɛaha kɛ, ‘Mekɛ ne ɛbikye.’ Na bɛmmatoa bɛ. 9Saa bɛte konle nee nzakadolɛ nganeɛ a, bɛmmasulo; ɔwɔ kɛ ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ dumua sisi, na bɛngile kɛ awieleɛ ne ɛbikye.”
10Ɔzɔle zolɛ ɔhanle kɛ, “Maanle maanle baho atia bɛ nwo, yɛɛ arelemgbunli badwazo arelemgbunli nwo zo. 11Azɛlɛ bakpusu, ɛhɔne nee ewule ngakyile bara ɛleka dɔɔnwo, sɛkɛlɛneɛ mgbole nee ninyɛne ɛzulolɛ ngakyile basisi anwomanyunlu. 12Bɛbahyehye bɛ, bɛayɛ bɛ kpɔdekpɔde, bɛbaye bɛ bɛamaa bɛali bɛ edwɛkɛ wɔ bɛ nyianu azua ne mɔ anu na bɛagua bɛ efiade; bɛbava bɛ bɛahɔgyinla arelemgbunli nee maanle mgbanyima nyunlu wɔ me ti kolaa na ɛhye mɔ asisi. 13Mekɛ ne anu yɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ akee bɛbɔ Edwɛkpa ne nolo a. 14 Bɛzie bɛ adwenle koonwu, bɛmmadwenle mɔɔ bɛbaha bɛalie bɛ nwo la anwo; 15ɔboalekɛ mebamaa bɛ nrɛlɛbɛ nee edwɛkɛ agbɔkɛ meamaa bɛaha na bɛ kpɔvolɛma biala ɛnrɛhola bɛ nyunlu gyinla yeye bɛ nloa azo. 16Bɛ awovolɛma nee bɛ mediema, bɛ mbusuafoɔ nee bɛ gɔnwo mɔ baye bɛ amaa, yɛɛ bɛbahu bɛ bie mɔ. 17Ɔlua me ti, awie biala bakpɔ bɛ. 18Na bɛ ti enrinli ko bɔbɔ ɛnrɛminli. 19Bɛgyinla kpundii, na bɛkɛnyia ngoane.”
Gyisɛse ka Gyɛlusalɛm ɛzɛkyelɛ nwo edwɛkɛ
(Mat 24.15-21; Mak 13.14-19)
20“Na saa bɛnwu kɛ ɛlɔnema ɛbɔ ɛyia Gyɛlusalɛm a, ɛnee bɛnwu ye kɛ ɔnrɛhyɛ biala na bɛazɛkye ye. 21Saa ɔba ye zɛhae a, bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ Dwudiya la ɛnriandi ɛhɔ awoka ne mɔ azo lɔ; bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ suakpole ne azo la ɔwɔ kɛ fi ɛkɛ, yɛɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛhɔ namule nu la mmaba suakpole ne azo. 22 Ɔluakɛ mekɛ ne le ‘Ndeanlɛ Mekɛ’ mɔɔ bamaa mɔɔ Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne ka la ayɛ nɔhalɛ a. 23Mekɛ ne anu, mraalɛ mɔɔ ɛva ɛkolɛ nee mɔɔ via mraalɛ la, bɛ gyakɔ! Nyanenwunlɛ ɛzulolɛ kpole kpalɛ bara azɛlɛ ye azo, na Nyamenle ndeanlɛ ne bara menli ɛhye mɔ anwo zo. 24Bie mɔ badɔ dadeɛ nloa, bɛbahye bie mɔ nuokɛ bɛ nee bɛ ahɔ maanɔne; menli mɔɔ ɛnze Nyamenle la barava Gyɛlusalɛm azɛlɛ ye adɛnla zo kɔkpula kɛ bɛ mekɛ kɛdwu la.
Sonla Ra ne ɛralɛ
(Mat 24.29-31; Mak 13.24-27)
25 “Sɛkɛlɛneɛ ɛzulolɛ basisi sɛnzɛne ne, siane ne nee nwɔlɔra ne mɔ anyunlu. Maanle maanle arɛle babɔ, na bɛ ti akunlu azɛkye nyevile ne ɛzɛkyelɛ nee ye ɛhululɛ nwo. 26Ɛzulolɛ ngome bamaa menli nye zo abulu wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛkendɛ mɔɔ bazi aleɛabo amra anwo zo la, ɔluakɛ bɛbadudu anwumaneamra bɛavi bɛ ndenle ne mɔ azo. 27 Na akee bɛbanwu medame, Sonla Ra kɛ melua amungu ne anu, melɛ tumi nee anyunlunyia kpole melɛba. 28Mɔɔ ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ kɛbɔ ɔ bo kɛ bɛsisi la, anrɛɛ bɛmaa bɛ nye zo bɛnlea maanle nu, ɔboalekɛ ɛnee bɛ ngoanelielɛ ne ɛbikye.”
Feege baka ne anwo ɛzukoalɛdeɛ
(Mat 24.32-35; Mak 13.28-31)
29Akee Gyisɛse bule bɛ ɛrɛlɛ ɛhye: “Bɛnlea feege baka ne nee mbaka mɔɔ ɛha la kɔsɔɔti. 30Mekɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛbɔ ɔ bo kɛ bɛyeye nya fofolɛ la ɛnee bɛze kɛ wawaa ɛbikye. 31Zɔhane ala yɛɛ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛnwu kɛ ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ ɛlɛsisi la, ɛnee bɛnwu ye kɛ Nyamenle Belemgbunlililɛ ne ɛbikye a.
32“Bɛhakye kɛ ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ basisi kolaa na menli mɔɔ kɛkala de aze la amuala awie wu. 33Anwuma nee aze bapɛ nu aze, na me nloa edwɛkɛ ɛdeɛ ɔnrɛpɛ nu ɛlɛ.”
Ɔhyia kɛ bɛsinza
34“Bɛnlea bɛ nwo boɛ! Bɛmmamaa anyelielɛ dɔɔnwo, nza ɛbolɛ nee ɛbɛla ye anu ɛvɛlɛvɛlɛ di bɛ adwenle somaa, anrɛɛ Ndɛnebualɛ Kenle ne ɛralɛ kɛli bɛ nvunu kɛhye bɛ kɛ ɛhane; 35ɔluakɛ ɔbara awie biala mɔɔ wɔ aleɛabo la anwo zo. 36Zɔhane ati bɛzinza na bɛzɛlɛ dahuu na bɛanyia anwosesebɛ bɛali ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ mɔɔ basisi la anwo zo konim, na bɛahola medame Sonla Ra, me nyunlu gyinla.”
37 Gyisɛse vale mekɛ ɛhye hilehilele wɔ nyianu sua ne anu, na ye nɔsolɛ nu yeahɔla Ɔlivi Boka ne azo. 38Nwonlomɔ biala menli ne amuala yia ye wɔ nyianu sua ne anu kɛ bɛbadie ye edwɛkɛ.

Title: LUK 22
Content:
Bɛbɔ Gyisɛse anwo tokule
(Mat 26.1-5; Mak 14.1-2; Dw 11.45-53)
1 Mɔɔ Angye Ɛvoyia ne, mɔɔ ye ko ne ala a le Akpabɛnwo Ɛvoyia ne la bikyele la, 2sɛlɛvolɛ mgbanyinli ne nee mɛla kilehilevolɛma ne mɔ bɔle adwenle kɛ bɛfa adenle bie azo kɛ bɛ sa kɛha Gyisɛse bɛkɛhu ye bɛkɛvea, ɔluakɛ bɛsulo menli ne.
Dwudase kponle zolɛ kɛ ɔye Gyisɛse yeamaa
(Mat 26.14-16; Mak 14.10-11)
3Seetan wolole Dwudase, mɔɔ eza bɛfɛlɛ ye Yesekaleɔto na ɔle ɛdoavolɛma bulu nee nwiɔ ne anu ko la. 4Yemɔti ɔhɔle na ɔ nee sɛlɛvolɛ mgbanyinli ne nee Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne sinzavolɛma mgbanyinli ne mɔ hɔdwenlenle nwolɛ kɛ ɔkɛzi ɔkɛyɛ na yeaye Gyisɛse yeamaa bɛ la. 5Ɛhye yɛle bɛ fɛ, na bɛbɔle ɛwɔkɛ kɛ bɛkɛmaa ye ezukoa. 6Dwudase kponlenle zolɛ na ɔbɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɔkpondɛ mekɛ kpalɛ yeaye Gyisɛse yeamaa bɛ mɔɔ menli ne ɛnrɛde nwolɛ bie a.
Gyisɛse siezie ɔ nwo ali Akpabɛnwo Ɛvoyia aleɛ ne
(Mat 26.17-25; Mak 14.12-21; Dw 13.21-30)
7Angye Ɛvoyia ne dwule na ɔwɔ kɛ bɛku mboane mɔɔ bɛfa bɛado Akpabɛnwo Ɛvoyia aleɛ ne la, 8Gyisɛse zoanle Pita nee Dwɔn kɛ, “Bɛhɔ bɛhɔziezie yɛ Akpabɛnwo Ɛvoyia aleɛ ne bɛmaa yɛli.”
9Bɛbizale ye kɛ, “Nienwu a ɛkulo kɛ yɛsiezie ye a?”
10Ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛhɔ suakpole ne azo na bɛ nee nrenya bie mɔɔ zo nzule wɔ buakɛ nu la bayia. Bɛdoa ye bɛ nee ye ɛhɔ awuke ne mɔɔ ɔkɛwolo nu la anu, 11na bɛze awuke menle ne kɛ, ‘Kilehilevolɛ ne se, ekpumgbunli ne boni anu a me nee me ɛdoavolɛma ne bali Akpabɛnwo Ɛvoyia aleɛ ne a?’ 12Na ɔkɛhile bɛ ekpumgbunli kpole bie wɔ ɛbolɔnsam ne azo mɔɔ bɛziezie nuhua a, na ɛkɛ ne yɛɛ bɛziezie aleɛ ne a.”
13Na ɛdoavolɛma ne hɔle na bɛhɔnwunle ye, kɛmɔ Gyisɛse hanle hilele bɛ ala la, na bɛzieziele Akpabɛnwo Ɛvoyia aleɛ ne.
Awulae aleɛ ne
(Mat 26.26-30; Mak 14.22-26; 1 Kɔl 11.23-25)
14Mekɛ ne dwule la, Gyisɛse nee ye ɛdoavolɛma ne dɛnlanle aze wɔ ɛkponle nwo, 15na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Mɔɔ mekpondɛ ye ɛsesebɛ ɛsesebɛ a le kɛ me nee bɛ kɛli Akpabɛnwo Ɛvoyia aleɛ ɛhye kolaa na meazɔ me nyanenwunlɛ sa! 16Ɔluakɛ meka meahile bɛ kɛ, menrɛli ye bieko kɔkpula kɛ ye kpɔkɛ mɔɔ ɔgyi zo la ɛli munli wɔ Nyamenle Belemgbunlililɛ nu.”
17Akee Gyisɛse vale dwora ne, ɔyɛle Nyamenle mo, na ɔzele kɛ, “Bɛlie ɛhye bɛnlo. 18Ɔluakɛ meka meahile bɛ, ɔvi ɛnɛ mɔɔ kɔ la menrɛnlo vanye ma nu nzule bieko kɔkpula kɛ Nyamenle Belemgbunlililɛ ne kɛra la.”
19Akee ɔvale kpanwo, ɔyɛle Nyamenle mo, ɔbubule nuhua, ɔvale ɔmanle bɛ na ɔzele kɛ, “Ɛhye a le me nwonane ne [mɔɔ bɛva bɛmaa bɛ la. Anrɛɛ bɛyɛ ɛhye bɛva bɛhakye me.” 20 Zɔhane ala noko yɛɛ mɔɔ bɛwiele debie di la, ɔvale dwora ne ɔmanle bɛ na ɔhanle kɛ, “Dwora ɛhye mɔɔ bɛlɛno nu la a le Nyamenle ngyekyeleɛ fofolɛ ne mɔɔ bɛva me mogya ne bɛzɔ ɔ nloa la; bɛlie bɛnlo.]
21 “Na bɛnlea, sonla ne mɔɔ ye me amaa la nee me de ɛkponle ye anwo ɛke! 22Na medame Sonla Ra mebawu, kɛmɔ Nyamenle ɛhyehyɛ ala la, na munzule doa sonla ne mɔɔ ye me amaa la!”
23Yemɔti bɛbɔle ɔ bo kɛ bɛbizebiza bɛ nwo kɛ bɛ nuhua boni a bayɛ deɛ ɛhye a.
Kpoleyɛlɛ nwo kpolerazulɛ
24 Kpolerazulɛ dɔle ɛdoavolɛma ne avinli mɔɔ fane bɛ nuhua mɔɔ le kpole kpalɛ wɔ bɛ nu la anwo. 25 Na Gyisɛse zele bɛ kɛ, “Aleɛabo arelemgbunli kile tumi wɔ bɛ menli nwo zo, yɛɛ menli mɔɔ lɛ dibile la maa bɛfɛlɛ bɛ ‘nyeleyɛvolɛma.’ 26 Na bɛmɛ, asolo bɛ, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛ nuhua kpole kpalɛ ne yɛ ɔ nwo kakula nretee, yɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ mɔɔ gyi bɛ ti la yɛ ɔ nwo kɛ sonvolɛ. 27 Mɔɔ tɛnla aze di debie, yɛɛ mɔɔ sonle mɔɔ ɛlɛdi debie la, boni a le kpole a? Mɔɔ tɛnla aze la ɔ. Na mame, me nee bɛ de kɛ mesonle bɛ.
28“Bɛ nee me ɛdɛnla ɛhyɛ wɔ me sɔnea ne mɔ anu; 29yemɔti kɛmɔ Egya ɛmaa me tumi kɛ menli belemgbunli la, zɔhane ala noko yɛɛ bɛbayɛ a. 30 Bɛ nee me badɛnla me ɛkponle nwo, bɛali debie na bɛanlo wɔ me Belemgbunlililɛ ne anu, na bɛbadɛnlɛdɛnla arelemgbunli mbia zo bɛabua mbusua bulu nee nwiɔ ne ndɛne.”
Gyisɛse se Pita bakpo ye
(Mat 26.31-35; Mak 14.27-31; Dw 13.36-38)
31Akee Gyisɛse zele Pita kɛ, “Saemɔn, Saemɔn! Tie! Seetan ɛnyia adenle kɛ ɔsɔ bɛ muala yeanlea, na yeakpa bɛ nu yeaye kpalɛ ne yeavi ɛtane ne anu kɛ ɛyazonlɛnli kpa abɛlɛ nu la. 32Na mezɛlɛ memaa wɔmɔ Saemɔn, amaa wɔ diedi amkpo aze. Na saa ɛsia ɛba me nwo bieko a, si ɛ mediema ne mɔ ahonle.”
33Pita buale kɛ, “Awulae, meziezie me nwo kɛ saa ewule nu o, efiade nla nu o, me nee wɔ kɛhɔ!”
34Gyisɛse zele ye kɛ, “Pita, meka meahile wɔ, ɛnɛ nɔe, mɔɔ akɔlɛ kabɔ la ɛnee wɔha ye fane nsa kɛ ɛnze me.”
Ezukoa kodoku, adendulɛ kodoku, yɛɛ dadeɛ
35 Akee Gyisɛse bizale ye ɛdoavolɛma ne kɛ, “Ɛkenle mɔɔ menzoanle bɛ mɔɔ bɛanva ezukoa kodoku, adendulɛ kodoku, anzɛɛ mgbɔlaboa la, asoo bɛhyianle debie nwo?”
Bɛbuale kɛ, “Kyɛkyɛ, yeangyia ɛhwee nwo.”
36Gyisɛse zele bɛ kɛ, “Na kɛkala, mɔɔ lɛ ezukoa kodoku anzɛɛ adendulɛ kodoku la ɛva; yɛɛ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ dadeɛ la ɛdɔne ye tɛladeɛ ne na ɔdɔ bie. 37 Ɔluakɛ meka meahile bɛ, ɔwɔ kɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne ɛha ye wɔ me nwo la yɛ nɔhalɛ. Ɔse, ‘Bɛdianle ye bɛbokale maamɔvoma anwo,’ ɔboalekɛ mɔɔ bɛhɛlɛle mɔɔ fane me nwo la ɛlɛba arape zolɛ.”
38Ɛdoavolɛma ne zele ye kɛ, “Awulae, nea, yɛlɛ dadeɛ nwiɔ wɔ ɛke!”
Ɔbuale bɛ kɛ, “Yeyɛ boɛ!”
Gyisɛse sɛlɛ wɔ Ɔlivi Boka ne azo
(Mat 26.36-46; Mak 14.32-42)
39Gyisɛse vile suakpole ne azo na ɔhɔle Ɔlivi Boka ne azo, kɛmɔ ɔyɛ ye dɛba ne ala la, na ye ɛdoavolɛma ne doale ye. 40Ɔdwule ɛkɛ ne la, ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛzɛlɛ na bɛangɔ ngyegyelɛ nu.”
41Akee ɔvile bɛ nwo ɛkɛ ne ɔhɔle ɔ nyunlu ekyii na ɔhotole ɔzɛlɛle kɛ, 42“Egya, saa ɔyɛ wɔ ɛhulolɛ a, ye nyanenwunlɛ dwora ɛhye fi me nloa; tɛ me ɛhulolɛdeɛ ɔ, na wɔ ɛhulolɛdeɛ ɛyɛ ɛkɛ.”
[43Nyamenle soanvolɛma vi anwuma rale na bɛramanle ye anwosesebɛ. 44Ɔvale nyane kpole kpalɛ ɔzɛlɛle ɛsesebɛ ɛsesebɛ, na ɛhɛlɛnra mɔɔ dule ye la le kɛ mogya ndɔkɛ tetele guale aze.]
45Ɔwiele nzɛlɛlɛ ne yɛ la, ɔdwazole ɔrale ye ɛdoavolɛma ne mɔ anwo ɛkɛ na ɔnwunle kɛ nyane dɔɔnwo mɔɔ ɛlɛku bɛ la ɛmaa bɛlafe. 46Na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Duzu ati a bɛlɛdafe ɛ? Bɛdwazo na bɛzɛlɛ na bɛangɔ ngyegyelɛ nu.”
Bɛhye Gyisɛse
(Mat 26.47-56; Mak 14.43-50; Dw 18.3-11)
47Gyisɛse anloa wɔ zo ɔlɛtendɛ la yɛɛ ɛlɔne vindele ɛkɛ ne a. Dwudase mɔɔ le bulu nee nwiɔ ne anu ko la li bɛ nyunlu. Ɔbikyele Gyisɛse na ɔvole ɔ nloa anwo. 48Na Gyisɛse bizale ye kɛ, “Dwudase, ɛfo me nloa anwo wɔaye medame Sonla Ra wɔamaa ɔ?”
49Ɛdoavolɛma mɔɔ wɔ Gyisɛse anwo ɛkɛ ne la nwunle mɔɔ ɛlɛba arazi la, bɛzele kɛ, “Awulae, yɛva yɛ dadeɛ ne yɛho ɔ?” 50Ɛkɛ ne ala bɛ nuhua ko hwenle dadeɛ pɛle sɛlɛvolɛ kpanyinli ne sonvolɛ ne anzo fema ne.
51Na Gyisɛse zele bɛ kɛ, “Yeyɛ boɛ!” Na ɔvale ɔ sa ɔhanle nrenya ne anzo ɔyɛle ye ayile.
52Akee Gyisɛse zele sɛlɛvolɛ mgbanyinli ne nee Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne neavolɛ mgbanyinli ne nee mgbanyima ne mɔ mɔɔ hɔle kɛ bɛkahye ye la kɛ, “Na ɔhyia kɛ bɛkɛva dadeɛ nee ahoholombaka bɛkɛra me ɛhyelɛ ɔ? 53 Dahuu me nee bɛ a wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu a, na bɛangola bɛangye me. Na awozinli nu tumi ne ɛdwazo, yemɔti bɛ mekɛ ne ala ɛne!”
Pita kpo Gyisɛse
(Mat 26.57-58,69-75; Mak 14.53-54,66-72; Dw 18.12-18,25-27)
54Bɛhyele Gyisɛse bɛ nee ye hɔle Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli ne sua nu; na Pita doale bɛ nanamogya. 55Ɛnee menli bie ɛwuda senle wɔ suakunlu ɛkɛ ne na bɛde nwolɛ, na Pita hɔdɛnlanle bɛ nwo ɛkɛ ne. 56Mɔɔ sonvolɛ mbɛlɛra ne mɔ anu ko nwunle ye kɛ ɔde senle ne anwo la, ɔnleanle ye koonwu na ɔzele kɛ, “Nrenya ɛhye noko nee Gyisɛse a lua a!”
57Pita zale na ɔzele kɛ, “Ɔmɔ, menze ye bɔbɔ!”
58Ɔ nzi hyɛle ekyii la, nrenya bie ɔdaye ɔranwunle Pita na ɔzele kɛ, “Ɛdawɔ noko ɛboka bɛ nwo!”
Pita zele kɛ, “Ayi, memboka nwo!”
59Kɛyɛ dɔnehwele ko anzi nrenya ko ɔdaye ɔrahanle ye ndinlizo kɛ, “Ɔle nɔhalɛ bɔkɔɔ kɛ nrenya ɛhye nee Gyisɛse a lua a; ɔle Galelinli!”
60Na Pita buale kɛ, “Yɛmenle, menze mɔɔ ɛlɛka la anwo bie fee!”
Na ɛkɛ ne ala, mɔɔ ɛnee ɔ nloa wɔ zolɛ ɔlɛtendɛ la, akɔlɛ bɔle. 61Awulae hakyile ɔ nye nleanle Pita, na Pita hakyele Awulae edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ ɔhanle kɛ, “Mɔɔ akɔlɛ kabɔ la, ɛnee wɔha ye fane nsa kɛ ɛnze me” la. 62Na Pita vindele hɔzunle alɔbɔlɛ ɛzunlɛ.
Bɛzile Gyisɛse amgbu na bɛbole ye
(Mat 26.67-68; Mak 14.65)
63Menli mɔɔ ɛnee ɛlɛsinza Gyisɛse la zile ye amgbu na bɛbole ye. 64Bɛkyekyele ɔ nye na bɛlile ye ahodomgbole. Bɛbɔ ye na bɛabiza ye kɛ, “Nwane a bɔle wɔ a? Ye ahenle!” 65Na bɛhanle edwɛkɛ ɛtane ɛtane dɔɔnwo bɛtietiale ye.
Bɛ nee Gyisɛse ɛhɔ ayia ne anyunlu
(Mat 26.59-66; Mak 14.55-64; Dw 18.19-24)
66Mɔɔ maanle nu tetele la, mgbanyima ne, sɛlɛvolɛ mgbanyinli ne, yɛɛ mɛla kilehilevolɛma ne mɔ yiale nu na bɛvale Gyisɛse bɛraziele ayia ne anyunlu. 67Bɛbizale ye kɛ, “Ka maa yɛdie bie, wɔmɔ a ɛle Mɛzaya ne ɔ?”
Gyisɛse buale kɛ, “Saa meka a, bɛnrɛlie me bɛnrɛli, 68yɛɛ mebiza bɛ edwɛkɛ a, bɛnrɛye me ɔ nloa. 69Na ɔvi ɛnɛ mɔɔ kɔ la medame Sonla Ra, mebadɛnla Tumivolɛ Nyamenle ne asa fema zo.”
70Bɛ muala bɛhanle kɛ, “Ɛnee wɔmɔ a ɛle Nyamenle Ara ne a?”
Ɔbuale bɛ kɛ, “Ɛhɛe, yemɔ ala a bɛdabɛ bɛha la.”
71Na bɛhanle kɛ, “Yɛngyia alasevolɛ biala! Yɛdayɛ mumua ne yɛde ɔ nloa edwɛkɛ!”

Title: LUK 23
Content:
Bɛva Gyisɛse bɛhɔ Paelɛte anyunlu
(Mat 27.1-2,11-14; Mak 15.1-5; Dw 18.28-38)
1Menli ne amuala dwazole na bɛvale Gyisɛse bɛhɔle Paelɛte anyunlu, 2na bɛbɔle ɔ bo kɛ bɛtoɔdoa ye kɛ, “Yɛhyele nrenya ɛhye kɛ ɔlɛsɛkye yɛ menli ne mɔ adwenle, ɔse bɛmmatua adwule bɛmaa Maanle Maanle Belemgbunli ne na eza ɔkilehile kɛ ɔdaye mumua ne ɔle Kelaese, belemgbunli bie.”
3Na Paelɛte bizale ye kɛ, “Wɔmɔ a ɛle Dwuuma belemgbunli ne la ɔ?”
Gyisɛse buale kɛ, “Yemɔ ala a wɔha la.”
4Paelɛte zele sɛlɛvolɛ mgbanyinli ne nee menli dɔɔnwo ne kɛ, “Mennwu ɛtane biala mɔɔ nrenya ye ɛyɛ a.”
5Na bɛ nye bolole ɛsesebɛ bɛzele kɛ, “Ɔlɛfa ye ngilehilelɛ ne yeamaa menli ne ado nzaka wɔ Dwudiya amuala. Ɔbɔle ɔ bo wɔ Galeli yɛɛ yeradwu ɛke a.”
Bɛva Gyisɛse bɛhɔ Hɛlɔdo anyunlu
6Paelɛte dele ɛhye la, ɔbizale kɛ, “Na nrenya ɛhye le Galelinli ɔ?” 7Na mɔɔ ɔdele ɔ bo kɛ Gyisɛse vi maanzinli ne mɔɔ Hɛlɔdo a nea zo la anu la, ɔmanle bɛvale ye bɛhɔmanle Hɛlɔdo; mekɛ ne anu ɛnee Hɛlɔdo ɔdaye yera Gyɛlusalɛm. 8Hɛlɔdo nwunle Gyisɛse la ɔlile fɛlɛko kpole, ɔluakɛ ɛnee yede ye nganeɛ na dɛba dɛba ye amuala ɔkpondɛ kɛ ɔnwu ye. Eza ɔ nye la kɛ ɔkɛnwu Gyisɛse kɛ ɔlɛyɛ nwanwane debie. 9Yemɔti Hɛlɔdo bizebizale Gyisɛse edwɛkɛ dɔɔnwo, na Gyisɛse ambua ye. 10Sɛlɛvolɛ mgbanyinli ne nee mɛla kilehilevolɛma ne mɔ zile gyinlanle, bɔle bɛ nyunlu bile, totonle Gyisɛse ɛzonle mgbole. 11Hɛlɔdo nee ye ɛlɔnema ne noko golole Gyisɛse anwo na bɛzile ye amgbu. Bɛvale tɛladeɛ kɛnlɛma bie mɔɔ arelemgbunli ala a wula la bie bɛwulale ye, na ɔzianenle ye ɔhɔmanle Paelɛte. 12Ɔvi kenle ko ne ala Paelɛte nee Hɛlɔdo yɛle agɔnwolɛ, ɔluakɛ ɛnee bɛ mu nwiɔ bɛnga.
Bɛbu Gyisɛse ewule fɔlɛ
(Mat 27.15-26; Mak 15.6-15; Dw 18.39—19.16)
13Paelɛte vɛlɛle sɛlɛvolɛ mgbanyinli ne, mgbanyima ne mɔ yɛɛ ɛlɔne ne amuala manle bɛyiale, 14na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛvale nrenya ɛhye bɛrɛlɛle me kɛ ɔlɛsɛkye menli adwenle. Kɛkala, mebizebiza ye edwɛkɛ wɔ bɛ nyunlu ɛke, na mennwu debie biala mɔɔ tia ye wɔ edwɛkɛ mɔɔ bɛha bɛdo ɔ nwo zo la anwo a. 15Hɛlɔdo ɔdaye yeambua ye fɔlɛ, ɔluakɛ yeziane ye yerɛlɛ yɛ. Ɔtɛyɛle debie biala mɔɔ fɛta ewule a. 16Yemɔti memaa bɛabila ye mbaka na meagyakyi ye meamaa yeahɔ.”
[ 17Akpabɛnwo Ɛvoyia ne dwu a ɔwɔ kɛ Paelɛte gyakyi sonla ko mɔɔ bɛdo ye efiade la maa bɛ.]
18Menli ne amuala deɛdeanle nuhua zele kɛ, “Ku ye! Ye Balabase maa yɛ!” 19(Balabase, ɔlua nzaka mɔɔ bɛdole wɔ suakpole ne azo, nee ye kɔdiawu ti yɛɛ bɛhyele ye bɛdole efiade a.)
20Ɛnee Paelɛte kpondɛ kɛ ɔgyakyi Gyisɛse, yemɔti ɔdendɛle ɔhilele menli ne bieko. 21Na bɛdeɛdeanle nuhua bieko kɛ, “Bɔ ye meanubaka nu! Bɔ ye meanubaka nu!”
22Paelɛte hanle ye fane nsa ne azo hilele bɛ kɛ, “Na duzu ɛtane a nrenya ye ɛyɛ a? Mennwu debie biala mɔɔ yeyɛ mɔɔ fɛta ewule a. Yemɔti memaa bɛabila ye mbaka na meagyakyi ye.”
23Na bɛhɔle zolɛ bɛdeɛdeanle nuhua ɛsesebɛ kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛbɔ Gyisɛse meanubaka nu, na nzinlii bɛlile konim. 24Yemɔti Paelɛte buale Gyisɛse ndɛne, kɛmɔ bɛkpondɛ la. 25Ɔyele sonla ne mɔɔ ɔlua ye kɔdiawu nee ye maamɔlɛ nzakadolɛ zo bɛdole ye efiade na bɛse bɛkpondɛ ye la ɔmanle bɛ, na ɔvale Gyisɛse ɔmanle bɛ kɛ mɔɔ bɛkulo la, bɛyɛ.
Bɛbɔ Gyisɛse meanubaka nu
(Mat 27.32-44; Mak 15.21-32; Dw 19.17-27)
26Sogyama ne vale Gyisɛse hɔle. Mɔɔ bɛkɔ la, bɛ nee nrenya bie mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Saemɔn mɔɔ vi Saelin la yiale kɛ ɔvi ye namule zo ɔlɛba suakpole ne azo. Bɛhyele ye nuokɛ na bɛvale meanubaka ne bɛzoale ye kɛ ɔli Gyisɛse anzi.
27Menli dɔɔnwo kpalɛ doale Gyisɛse. Mraalɛ mɔɔ ɛnee ɛlɛsu ye ye ye awolɛ la noko boka nwo. 28Na Gyisɛse hakyile ɔ nye wɔ bɛ nwo na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Gyɛlusalɛm mraalɛ! Bɛmmasu me, bɛzu bɛ nwo nee bɛ mra. 29Ɔluakɛ mekɛ ɛlɛba mɔɔ menli baze kɛ, ‘Mraalɛ mɔɔ le mota, mɔɔ anwo mralɛ, yɛɛ bɛtɛnoanle ngakula nyɛfolɛ ɛlɛ la ati ɛyɛ boɛ!’ 30 Mekɛ ne anu, menli baze awoka mgbole kɛ, ‘Bɛdu bɛgua yɛ nwo zo!’ Na bɛaze awoka ngyikyi kɛ, ‘Bɛva yɛ bɛvea!’ 31Ɔluakɛ saa bɛyɛ ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ baka ne le amolɛ la a, ɛnee saa baka ne wu a, duzu a bɛkɛyɛ a?”
32Bɛvale menli nwiɔ mɔɔ le maamɔvoma la bɛbokale Gyisɛse anwo bɛhɔle kɛ bɛkahu bɛ. 33Mɔɔ bɛdwule ɛleka bie mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye “Etile Kanrɛlɛ” la, bɛbɔle Gyisɛse meanubaka nu wɔ ɛkɛ ne, yemɔ yɛɛ maamɔvoma nwiɔ ne, ko wɔ ye fema zo yɛɛ ko noko wɔ ye bɛne zo.
34 Na Gyisɛse zele kɛ, “Egya, fa bɛ ɛtane kyɛ bɛ! Bɛnze mɔɔ bɛlɛyɛ la.”
Bɛguale ye adɛladeɛ ne mɔ anwo nzeleba na bɛhyɛle. 35 Mekɛ mɔɔ menli ne gyi ɛkɛ ne ɛlɛnea la ɛnee Dwuu mgbanyima ne mɔ mɔɔ wɔ bɛ nu la ɛlɛsi ye amgbu kɛ, “Se ɔliele awie mɔ ngoane o; saa yemɔ a ɔle Mɛzaya ne mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛkpa nu ɛye ye la amgba a, bɛmaa ɔlie ɔ nwo ngoane ɔmaa yɛnlea!”
36 Sogyama ne bɛdabɛ bɛzile ye amgbu; bɛhɔle ɔ nwo ɛkɛ ne na bɛvale nwanye ɛnwonle bie bɛmanle ye, 37na bɛzele kɛ, “Saa wɔmɔ a ɛle Dwuuma belemgbunli ne a ɛnee die ɛ nwo ɛ!”
38Bɛhɛlɛle debie bɛbɔle ɔ ti zo anwuma kɛ, “Dwuuma belemgbunli ne ɛne.”
39Maamɔvoma ne mɔ mɔɔ ɛnee bɛbɔ bɛ meanubaka nu la anu ko dendɛle tiale Gyisɛse kɛ, “Tɛ wɔmɔ a ɛle Kelaese ne la ɔ? Die ɛ nwo na die yɛdayɛ noko ɛ!”
40Na ko ne hwile ɔ nyunlu zele kɛ, “Wɔmɔ ɛnzulo Nyamenle? Bɛbua wɔ ewule fɔlɛ kɛ ɔdaye ala la. 41Na yɛmɛ yɛ ɛdeɛ ne le fɔɔnwo, ɔboalekɛ mɔɔ yɛyɛ la yɛɛ bɛlɛtua yɛ nwolɛ kakɛ a; na yemɔ, ɔtɛyɛle ɛtane biala.” 42Akee ɔhanle ɔhilele Gyisɛse kɛ, “Yɛmenle Gyisɛse, saa ɛdi wɔ belemgbunli ne a kakye me.”
43Gyisɛse zele ye kɛ, “Mebɔ wɔ ɛwɔkɛ kɛ, ɛnɛ kenle ye, me nee wɔ bahɔ Paladaese.”
Gyisɛse ewule
(Mat 27.45-56; Mak 15.33-41; Dw 19.28-30)
44-45 Kɛyɛ sɛnzɛngyinla yɛɛ ewia ne nlunle a, na awozinli hedale maanle ne amuala azo toonwo ewiazo dɔne nsa. Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu mgbɛnu ɛdanlɛ ne dele sinli nwiɔ. 46 Na Gyisɛse deanle nu kpole kɛ, “Egya! Me ɛkɛla wɔ ɛ sa nu!” Ɔhanle ɛhye na ɔwule.
47Sogya kpanyinli ne nwunle mɔɔ ɛzi la, na ɔyele Nyamenle ayɛlɛ ɔhanle kɛ, “Amgba, nrenya ne ati anu fufule!”
48Menli dɔɔnwo ne mɔɔ rale ɛkɛ ne kɛ bɛbanlea bie la nwunle mɔɔ zile la, bɛbɔle bɛ sa ati na bɛziale bɛhɔle. 49 Manivolɛma mɔɔ ze Gyisɛse, nee mraalɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ doale ye vi Galeli rale la gyinlanle ahane moa moa nleanle mɔɔ ɛlɛkɔ zolɛ la.
Gyisɛse ɛzielɛ
(Mat 27.57-61; Mak 15.42-47; Dw 19.38-42)
50-51Nrenya bie wɔ ɛkɛ, bɛfɛlɛ ye Dwosefi. Ɔvi Arelematia mɔɔ wɔ Dwudiya maanzinli nu la. Nrenya ne le sonlakpalɛ, ɔdi nɔhalɛ na ɔlɛkendɛ Nyamenle Belemgbunlililɛ ne ɛralɛ. Ɔboka Ayiama ne anwo, noko yeanlie bɛ kpɔkɛbɔlɛ ne nee mɔɔ bɛyɛle la yeando nu. 52Ɔhɔle Paelɛte ɛkɛ ne na ɔhɔzɛlɛle ye Gyisɛse funli ne. 53Ɔdwulale funli ne aze, ɔvale lenen ɛdanlɛ ɔkyekyele funli ne na ɔvale ye ɔdole nla bie mɔɔ bɛpɛ ye wɔ bolɛ bie anu na bɛtɛsiele awie biala nu la anu. 54Kenle ne le Yalɛ, na Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ne ɛbikye.
55Mraalɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ nee Gyisɛse vi Galeli rale la nee Dwosefi hɔle hɔnwunle sɛka ne nee kɛ bɛzile bɛziele ye la. 56 Akee bɛziale bɛhɔle sua nu bɛhɔkpondɛle alufuanlɛ nee sakyeɛ evuanlɛ mɔɔ bɛfa bɛakpokpa funli ne la.
Akee bɛliele bɛ ɛnwomenle wɔ Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ne, kɛmɔ mɛla ne se la.

Title: LUK 24
Content:
Ewudwazo ne
(Mat 28.1-10; Mak 16.1-8; Dw 20.1-10)
1Molɛ nwonlomɔ mangyee ne ala mraalɛ ne mɔ vale bɛ alufuanlɛ ne mɔɔ bɛyɛle la hɔle sɛka ne azo. 2Bɛnwunle kɛ bɛhundo bolɛ ne bɛvi nla ne anloa, 3yemɔti bɛwolole nuhua, na bɛannwu Awulae Gyisɛse funli ne. 4Bɛ adwenle yɛle bɛ kpomgbondee, na arɛlevilɛ nu ala mrenya nwiɔ mɔɔ wula adɛladeɛ nwohyee la ragyinlanle bɛ nwo ɛkɛ ne. 5Ɛzulolɛ hanle bɛ la ati, bɛbutubutule bɛ nye aze, na menli ne mɔ bizale bɛ kɛ, “Duzu ati a bɛlɛkpondɛ mɔɔ de aze la wɔ mɔwuamra anu ɛ? 6 Ɔnle ɛke, bɛdwazo ye. Bɛhakye mɔɔ ɔhanle ɔhilele bɛ wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee ɔwɔ Galeli la. Ɔhanle kɛ, Luk 9.22; 18.31-33 7‘Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛye Sonla Ra ne bɛwula ɛtanevolɛma asa anu, na bɛbɔ ye meanubaka nu bɛku ye; na ye kenle nsa ne anzi ɔdwazo ɔba ngoane nu.’ ”
8Mraalɛ ne mɔ hakyele ye edwɛkɛ ne, 9bɛvi sɛka ne azo bɛziale bɛhɔle, na bɛhɔhanle edwɛkɛ ne bɛhilele bulu nee ko ne nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛha la amuala. 10Mraalɛ ne mɔ a le Mɛle mɔɔ vi Magedala la, Dwowana, yɛɛ Gyemise ɔ nli Mɛle. Bɛmɛ yɛɛ mraalɛ ɛhendeɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ nee bɛ lua la a hanle edwɛkɛ ne hilele ɛzoanvolɛma ne mɔ a. 11Na ɛzoanvolɛma ne dwenlenle kɛ mɔɔ mraalɛ ne mɔ hanle la le adalɛ, yemɔti bɛanlie bɛ bɛanli.
[ 12Na Pita dwazole na ɔnriandile ɔhɔle sɛka ne azo. Ɔbutule ɔnleanle nla ne anu, na ɔnwunle kɛ lenen ndanlɛ ne mɔɔ bɛvale bɛkyekyele funli ne la gua nu na yeannwu debie gyɛne bieko. Mɔɔ ɛzi la yɛle ye azibɛnwo kpole na ɔziale ɔhɔle sua nu.]
Gyisɛse ye ɔ nwo ahile ye ɛdoavolɛma nwiɔ wɔ Ɛmeeyɛse adevinli
(Mak 16.12-13)
13Kenle ko ne ala ɛnee Gyisɛse ɛdoavolɛma nwiɔ bie ɛlɛkɔ sua bie mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Ɛmeeyɛse la azo; ɔ nee Gyɛlusalɛm bɛ avinli kɛyɛ kilomita bulu nee ko, 14na ɛnee bɛlɛdi bɛ adwelie wɔ ninyɛne mɔɔ ɛsisi la anwo. 15Mɔɔ bɛ nloa wɔ zo na bɛlɛsuzu mɔɔ ɛzi la anwo la, Gyisɛse ɔdaye mumua ne ɔbikyele bɛ na ɔ nee bɛ luale nwolɛ. 16Bɛnwunle ye, noko bɛannwu ye sonla holɛ. 17Na Gyisɛse zele bɛ kɛ, “Duzu a bɛlɛka nwolɛ edwɛkɛ wɔ adenle ye anu la?”
Alɔbɔlɛ ngome manle bɛgyinlanle, 18na bɛ nuhua ko mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Kiliopase la bizale ye kɛ, “Ɛ ngomekye ala yɛɛ ɛle ɛyɛvolɛ wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm a, mɔɔ ɛnze edwɛkɛ mɔɔ ɛzi nehane kenle nsa ye la ɔ?”
19Ɔbizale bɛ kɛ, “Duzu edwɛkɛ?”
