Bɛbuale ye kɛ, “Edwɛkɛ mɔɔ ɛzi Gyisɛse mɔɔ vi Nazalɛte la anwo zo la.” Akee bɛvale bɛzɔle zolɛ kɛ, “Nrenya ɛhye le Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ, yɛɛ wɔ Nyamenle nee menli kɔsɔɔti anyunlu, ɔhilele kɛ tumi wɔ ye edwɛkɛhanlɛ nee ye nyɛleɛ nu. 20Yɛ sɛlɛvolɛ mgbanyinli nee mgbanyima ne mɔ yele ye manle bɛbule ye ewule fɔlɛ, na bɛbɔle ye meanubaka nu. 21Ɛnee yɛ nye la kɛ yemɔ yɛɛ ɔbarakpɔne Yizilayɛma a! Yeanga ɛhye angome, edwɛkɛ ne zile la ɛnɛ le kenle nsa. 22Mraalɛ bie noko mɔɔ wɔ yɛ avinli la yɛɛ akee dule yɛ kunlu bɔbɔ a. Bɛhɔle sɛka ne azo nwonlomɔ mangyee ne, 23na bɛannwu ye funli ne. Bɛziale bɛrahanle kɛ bɛnwunle anwuma soanvolɛ bie mɔɔ ɛha ɛhile bɛ kɛ ɔde ngoane nu a. 24Yɛ bie mɔ noko hɔle sɛka ne azo la bɛhɔnwunle ye, kɛmɔ mraalɛ ne mɔ hanle la, na ɔdaye mumua ne ɛdeɛ, bɛannwu ye.”
25Na Gyisɛse zele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛdabɛ, bɛle ahɔnwɔne kpalɛ. Duzu ati a bɛngola bɛnlie mɔɔ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma ɛha nwolɛ edwɛkɛ la amuala bɛnli ɛ? 26Asoo bɛnnwu ye kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ Mɛzaya ne nwu amaneɛ ɛhye mɔ amuala na yeahɔ ye anyunlunyia ne anu?” 27Akee Gyisɛse bɔle ɔ bo vile Mosisi mbuluku ne mɔ nee mɔɔ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma ɛha na bɛhɛlɛ wɔ Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne anu wɔ ɔ nwo la azo na ɔhilehilele nu ɔhilele bɛ.
28Bɛbikyele sua ne mɔɔ bɛkɔ zo la azo la, Gyisɛse yɛle kɛ ɔpɛ nuhua yeahɔ; 29na bɛzele ye kɛ, “Maa yɛhɔla na mekɛ ne ɛhɔ, aleɛ ɛlɛdwo.” Yemɔti Gyisɛse nee bɛ hɔle sua nu. 30Ɔ nee bɛ dɛnlanle aze kɛ bɛdi debie la, ɔvale kpanwo ne, ɔyilale zolɛ, ɔbubule nuhua na ɔvale ɔmanle bɛ. 31Ɛkɛ ne ala bɛ nye zo dele na bɛnwunle ye sonla holɛ, na eza ɛkɛ ne ala ɔminliminlinle bɛ nye zo. 32Na bɛhanle bɛhilele bɛ nwo ngoko kɛ, “Mekɛ mɔɔ ɔlɛtendɛ wɔ adenle ne anu na ɔlɛkilehile yɛ Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne anu la ɛnee ɔle kɛ asɛɛ bɛwuda senle yɛ ahonle nu la.”
33Na ɛkɛ ne ala bɛdwazole na bɛziale bɛhɔle Gyɛlusalɛm. Bɛhɔdwule la ɛnee ɛdoavolɛma bulu nee ko ne nee menli mɔɔ nee bɛ wɔ ɛkɛ ne la ɛyia nu 34na bɛlɛka kɛ, “Amgba, Awulae ɛdwazo! Yeye ɔ nwo yehile Saemɔn!”
35Na menli nwiɔ ne mɔɔ vi Ɛmeeyɛse la noko hanle edwɛkɛ mɔɔ zile adenle ne anu, nee kɛ bɛzile bɛnwunle Awulae sonla holɛ wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɔbubule kpanwo ne ɔmanle bɛ la hilele ɛdoavolɛma ne mɔ.
Gyisɛse ye ɔ nwo ahile ye ɛdoavolɛma ne
(Mat 28.16-20; Mak 16.14-18; Dw 20.19-23; Gyi 1.6-8)
36Mɔɔ bɛ nloa wɔ zolɛ bɛlɛka ɛhye mɔ anwo bie la, Awulae mumua ne ragyinlanle bɛ avinli [na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Anzonudwolɛ ɛha bɛ.”]
37Ɛzulolɛ kpole hanle bɛ na bɛdwenlenle kɛ bɛnwu nwomenle. 38Na Gyisɛse zele bɛ kɛ, “Duzu ati a ɛzulolɛ ɛha bɛ a? Duzu ati a bɛ ti akunlu ɛyɛ bɛ kesee ɛ? 39Bɛnlea me sa nee me gyakɛ, na bɛnwu ye kɛ medame mumua ne ɛne. Bɛsosɔ me na bɛnlea, ɔluakɛ nwomenle ɛnlɛ nwonane nee mbowule, kɛmɔ bɛnwu me kɛ melɛ la.”
[ 40Mɔɔ ɔhanle ɛhye ɔwiele la, ɔvale ɔ sa nee ɔ gyakɛ ɔhilele bɛ.] 41Noko fɛlɛko kpole nee azibɛnwo ammaa bɛanlie bɛanli. Yemɔti ɔbizale bɛ kɛ, “Bɛlɛ aleɛ wɔ ɛke ɔ?” 42Na bɛmanle ye fɛlɛ sinli mɔɔ bɛze la, 43na ɔlile ye bɛ nyunlu ɛkɛ ne.
44Akee ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Ɛhye mɔ a le ninyɛne mɔɔ menganle nwolɛ edwɛkɛ mengilele bɛ wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee me nee bɛ de la: debie biala mɔɔ bɛhɛlɛ ye wɔ Mosisi mɛla ne anu, nee mɔɔ wɔ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma, nee Edwɛndolɛ mbuluku ne mɔ anu mɔɔ fane me nwo la kpokpoti ɔwɔ kɛ yɛ nɔhalɛ.”
45Akee ɔbukele bɛ adwenle ɔmanle bɛdele Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne abo, 46na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Mɔɔ bɛhɛlɛ bɛdo ɛkɛ ne la ɛne: Ɔwɔ kɛ Mɛzaya ne nwu amaneɛ na ye kenle nsa ne anzi bɛdwazo ye bɛfi mɔwuamra anu. 47Akee bɛbɔ ɔ bo wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm ɛke bɛva me duma bɛbɔ anlubɛnwo nolo bɛhile maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti, na saa bɛdie bɛdi a, Nyamenle ava bɛ ɛtane ahyɛ bɛ. 48Bɛmɛ a bɛdi ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ anwo daselɛ a. 49 Medame mumua ne mebazoa deɛ mɔɔ Egya vale bɔle ɛwɔkɛ la wɔ bɛ nwo. Bɛdɛnla suakpole ɛhye azo ɛke kɔkpula kɛ tumi vi anwuma kɛra bɛ nwo zo la.”
Bɛva Gyisɛse bɛhɔ anwuma
(Mak 16.19-20; Gyi 1.9-11)
50 Akee Gyisɛse nee bɛ vi suakpole ne azo hɔle mɔɔ asɛɛ bɛdwu Bɛtani la, na ɔmanle ɔ sa zo ɔyilale bɛ. 51Mɔɔ ɔyila bɛ la, ɔdele ɔ nwo ɔvile bɛ nwo [na bɛvale ye bɛhɔle anwuma.] 52Ɛzoanvolɛma ne mɔ zonlenle ye na bɛvale fɛlɛkolilɛ kpole bɛziale bɛhɔle Gyɛlusalɛm, 53na bɛhɔle Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu dahuu bɛhɔyɛle Nyamenle mo.

Title: DW MUKENYE
Content:
Mukenye
Dwɔn Edwɛkpa ne ye Gyisɛse kile kɛ yemɔ a ɔle Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ ɛmbɔ aze ɛlɛ, na “ɔrayɛle sonla na ɔ nee yɛ dɛnlanle” la. Kɛmɔ buluku ne ɔdaye ɔka la, bɛhɛlɛle Edwɛkpa ɛhye amaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkenga la bɛalie bɛali kɛ Gyisɛse a le Ngoanedievolɛ ne, mɔɔ le Nyamenle Ara ne mɔɔ bɛvale bɛbɔle ɛwɔkɛ la, amaa ɔlua bɛ diedi mɔɔ bɛlɛ ye wɔ ye nuhua la azo bɛanyia ngoane. (20.31)
Saa Edwɛkpa ne kilehile Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ ɛmbɔ aze ɛlɛ la anu kɛ yemɔ a ɔle Gyisɛse na ɔwie a, ɔfa nwanwane gyima mgbole mɔɔ Gyisɛse yɛle la ɔto gua ɔkile kɛ yemɔ a ɔle Ngoanedievolɛ ne, mɔɔ le Nyamenle Ara ne mɔɔ bɛvale bɛbɔle ɛwɔkɛ la. Adwelie mɔɔ kilehile nwanwane gyima ne mɔ anu la doa zo. Buluku ne foa ko ɛhye ka kɛ ɔzile ɔyɛle mɔɔ menli ne bie mɔ liele Gyisɛse lile na bɛdoale ɔ bo zo, na bie mɔ noko tiale ye na bɛkpole kɛ bɛnrɛlie ye bɛnrɛli la anwo edwɛkɛ. Mgbakyelɛ bulu nee nsa ne mɔɔ kɔ bulu nee nsuu ne azo la ka Gyisɛse nee ye ɛdoavolɛma ne ahualilɛ wɔ kenle ko ne nɔe ne mɔɔ bɛbahye ye, nee ye akɛnrazilɛ nee bɛ nwo zo ɛlalɛ nwo edwɛkɛ mɔɔ ɔvale ɔmanle bɛ wɔ nɔe ne mɔɔ aleɛ kye a bɛkɛbɔ ye meanubaka nu la anwo edwɛkɛ. Buluku ne awieleɛ ka Gyisɛse ɛhyelɛ nee ye edwɛkɛlilɛ, ye meanubaka nu ɛbɔlɛ nee ye ewudwazo, yɛɛ ɔ nwo mɔɔ ɔyele ɔhilele ye ɛdoavolɛma wɔ ye ewudwazo ne anzi la anwo edwɛkɛ.
Raalɛ ne mɔɔ bɛhyele ye kɛ ɔlɛto awuvolɛvalɛ mɛla ne la edwɛkɛ ne (8.1-11), mbuluku dɔɔnwo gyakyi ye nu, yɛɛ bie mɔ noko fa wulowula nu wɔ ɛleka gyɛne gyɛne.
Dwɔn ka ngoane mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ ahyɛlɛdeɛ ne mɔɔ bɛdua Kelaese anwo zo a bɛnyia ye la edwɛkɛ ne si zo, na ɔkile kɛ ɔle ahyɛlɛdeɛ mɔɔ bɔ ɔ bo kɛkala, na bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdie Gyisɛse bɛdi kɛ yemɔ a ɔle adenle ne, nɔhalɛ ne nee ngoane ne la a asa ka ye a. Debie ko mɔɔ yɛnwu ye wɔ Dwɔn Edwɛkpa ne anu la a le kɛ ɔfa ninyɛne mɔɔ le kɛ nzule, aleɛ, wienyi, mboaneneavolɛ nee ye mboane, nee vanye ɛya nee vanye ma mɔɔ sonla nye dua bɛ dahuu wɔ ɛbɛlabɔlɛ nu la a ɔkilehile sunsum nu ninyɛne mɔɔ wɔ ɛkɛ ne la anu a.
Edwɛkɛ Mɔɔ wɔ nu la
Ngilenu 1.1-18
Dwɔn Sɔnevolɛ ne nee Gyisɛse ɛdoavolɛma mɔɔ lumua 1.19-51
Gyisɛse bagua nu gyimayɛlɛ 2.1—12.50
Mekɛ mɔɔ li awieleɛ wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm nee ye ngameɛ ngameɛ 13.1—19.42
Awulae ewudwazo ne nee ɔ nwo mɔɔ ɔyele ɔhilele la 20.1-31
Adwulaleɛ: Gyisɛse yele ɔ nwo hilele bieko wɔ Galeli 21.1-25

Title: DW 1
Content:
Ngoane edwɛkɛ ne
1Mekɛ mɔɔ bɛkabɔ ewiade la, ɛnee Edwɛkɛ ne wɔ ɛkɛ; Edwɛkɛ ne nee Nyamenle a wɔ ɛkɛ a, na Edwɛkɛ ne le Nyamenle. 2Mɔlebɛbo ne amuala ɛnee Edwɛkɛ ne nee Nyamenle a wɔ ɛkɛ a. 3Ɔ nwo zo yɛɛ Nyamenle luale yɛle ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti a; bɛangoati ye bɛanyɛ debie biala mɔɔ wɔ aleɛabo amuala la. 4Ngoane kɔsɔɔti vi Edwɛkɛ ne anu a ba a, na ngoane ɛhye a le menli wienyi ne a. 5Wienyi ne ta awozinli nu, na awozinli ɛngola ɛngye ye.
6 Nyamenle zoanle nrenya bie mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Dwɔn la, 7manle ɔrahanle wienyi ne anwo edwɛkɛ ɔhilele menli, amaa bɛ kɔsɔɔti bɛade nrɛlaleɛ ne na bɛalie bɛali. 8Tɛ yemɔ a ɔle wienyi ne; ɔrale kɛ ɔbaha wienyi ne anwo edwɛkɛ. 9Edwɛkɛ ne a le nɔhalɛ wienyi ne mɔɔ ta menli kɔsɔɔti anwo zo na ɔba ewiade la.
10Ɛnee Edwɛkɛ ne wɔ ewiade ye. Nyamenle luale ɔ nwo zo a bɔle ewiade a, noko ewiade amra ɛnze ye. 11Ɔrale ɔdaye ye maanle nu, na ye menli ne anlie ye. 12Bie mɔ dɔɔnwo liele ye na bɛliele ye bɛlile; ɛhye ati ɔmanle bɛ adenle kɛ bɛyɛ Nyamenle amra, 13mɔɔ bɛanlua nwonane nee mogya ngyehyɛlɛ zo a bɛwole bɛ na bɛarayɛ Nyamenle amra a, ɔluakɛ Nyamenle ɔdaye a ɔle bɛ ze a.
14Edwɛkɛ ne rayɛle sonla mɔɔ ɛlolɛ nee nɔhalɛ ɛyi ye tɛkɛɛ a, na ɔ nee yɛ dɛnlanle. Yɛnwunle ye anyunlunyia mɔɔ ɔnyianle ye kɛ ɔle Selɛ ne Ara kokye la.
15Dwɔn hanle ɔ nwo edwɛkɛ. Ɔse, “Ɛhye a le mɔɔ menganle ɔ nwo edwɛkɛ kɛ, ‘Ɔli me nzi ɔlɛba, na ɔle sonlakpole ɔtɛla me la, ɔboalekɛ bɛkawo me la ɛnee ɔwɔ ɛkɛ.’ ”
16Ye ɛlolɛ bebelebe ne ati, yeyila yɛ muala kɔsɔɔti, na ɔyila yɛ dahuu. 17Nyamenle luale Mosisi anwo zo vale mɛla ne rɛlɛle yɛ, na ɛlolɛ nee nɔhalɛ luale Gyisɛse Kelaese anwo zo a rale a. 18Awie biala ɛtɛnwunle Nyamenle ɛlɛ. Ralɛ ne ala mɔɔ ɔdaye ko ne ala a ɔle Nyamenle, na ɔde Selɛ ne anwo ɛkɛ ne la, yemɔ yɛɛ ɛmaa yɛnwu ye a.
Dwɔn Sɔnevolɛ ne nrɛlaleɛ ne
(Mat 3.1-12; Mak 1.1-8; Luk 3.1-18)
19Dwuu mgbanyima mɔɔ wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm la zoanle sɛlɛvolɛma nee Livaema bie mɔ wɔ Dwɔn ɛkɛ kɛ bɛhɔbiza ye kɛ, “Wɔmɔ a le nwane?”
20Dwɔn anva anvea bɛ na ɔkpale nwolɛ ɛdanlɛ wienyi kɛ, “Tɛ mame a mele Mɛzaya ne a.”
21 Bɛbizale ye kɛ, “Ɛnee wɔmɔ a le nwane? Wɔmɔ a ɛle Yilaegya ɔ?”
Dwɔn buale bɛ kɛ, “Kyɛkyɛ, tɛ yemɔ a le me.”
Bɛbizale ye kɛ, “Wɔmɔ a ɛle Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ ne ɔ?”
Ɔbuale kɛ, “Kyɛkyɛ.”
22Bɛzele ye kɛ, “Ɛnee kile yɛ wɔ sonlazule. Ɔluakɛ ɔwɔ kɛ yɛfa mualɛ yɛkɔmaa menli mɔɔ zoanle yɛ la. Duzu a ɛka ye wɔ ɛ nwo a?”
23 Dwɔn buale kɛmɔ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ Ayezaya hanle la:
“Mame a mele ɛnelɛ ne mɔɔ ɛlɛtea nu wɔ ɛsɛlɛ ne anu,
‘Bɛdenrɛdenrɛ adenle ne bɛmaa Awulae ɛlua nu!’ la.”
24Menli mɔɔ rale la, Falasiima a zoanle bɛ a. 25Bɛbizale Dwɔn kɛ, “Saa tɛ wɔ a ɛle Mɛzaya ne, Yilaegya anzɛɛ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ ne a, ɛnee duzu ati a ɛsɔne menli a?”
26Dwɔn buale kɛ, “Mame mefa nzule a mesɔne a, na ko bie gyi bɛ avinli ɛkɛ ne mɔɔ bɛnze ye a. 27Yemɔ, ɔli me nzi ɔlɛba, na menfɛta kɛ menwɔzianyi ye mgbɔlaboa zo nyɛma bɔbɔ.”
28Ɛhye mɔ amuala zile Bɛtani, Azule Dwɔdan ne anloa mɔɔ di kɔ aduduleɛ, ɛleka mɔɔ Dwɔn ɛlɛsɔne menli la.
Nyamenle Boaneralɛ ne
29Aleɛ hyenle la Dwɔn nwunle kɛ Gyisɛse ɛlɛba ɛleka mɔɔ ɔwɔ la na ɔhanle kɛ, “Bɛnlea, Nyamenle Boaneralɛ ne mɔɔ ɔbava yeabɔ azu yeaye ewiade amra ɛtane yeahɔ la ɛne! 30Ɛhye a ɛnee melɛka ye edwɛkɛ mɔɔ menganle kɛ ‘Nrenya bie li me nzi ɛlɛba na ɔle sonlakpole ɔtɛla me la, ɔboalekɛ mɔɔ bɛkawo me la ɛnee ɔwɔ ɛkɛ.’ 31Ɛnee menze ye sonlazule, noko membale kɛ mebava nzule meazɔne menli amaa Yizilayɛma anwu ye.”
32Daselɛ mɔɔ Dwɔn lile la ɛne. Ɔse, “Menwunle kɛ Sunsum ne vi anwuma ɛlɛdwu ɔ nwo zo kɛ abubule la, na ɔrazinzele ɔ nwo zo. 33Ɛnee menze kɛ yemɔ ɔ; noko Nyamenle ne mɔɔ zoanle me kɛ menva nzule menzɔne la zele me kɛ, ‘Ɛbanwu kɛ Sunsum ne ɛrazinze nrenya bie anwo zo; sonla zɔhane a le sonla ne mɔɔ ɔbava Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne yeazɔne la.’ 34Na mese, menwu ye, na meka meahile bɛ kɛ, nrenya ɛhye, yemɔ a ɔle Nyamenle Ara ne a.”
Gyisɛse ɛdoavolɛma mɔɔ lumua
35Ye alehyenlɛ nu ɛnee Dwɔn nee ye ɛdoavolɛma nwiɔ gyi ɛkɛ ne ko ne ala, 36na bɛnwunle kɛ Gyisɛse ɛlɛse. Na Dwɔn hanle kɛ, “Bɛnlea, Nyamenle Boaneralɛ ne ɛne!”
37Ɛdoavolɛma nwiɔ ne dele la bɛgyakyile ye ɛkɛ bɛdoale Gyisɛse. 38Gyisɛse dole ɔ nye na ɔnwunle kɛ bɛdoa ye la, ɔbizale bɛ kɛ, “Bɛkpondɛ duzu?”
Bɛbuale kɛ, “Relabae, nienwu ɛleka yɛɛ ɛde a?” (Relabae abo a le “Kilehilevolɛ”)
39Ɔbuale bɛ kɛ, “Bɛrɛla bɛranlea.” Yemɔti bɛ nee ye hɔle sua nu na bɛhɔnwunle ɛleka mɔɔ ɔde la, na bɛ nee ye dɛnlanle kenle ko ne. (Mekɛ ne anu ɛnee bɛbɔ nɔsolɛ dɔne nna.)
40Bɛ mu nwiɔ mɔɔ bɛdele Dwɔn edwɛkɛ ne, na bɛdoale Gyisɛse la anu ko a le Andelu, mɔɔ le Saemɔn Pita adiema ne. 41Na ndɛndɛ ne ala Andelu hɔkpondɛle ɔ diema Saemɔn na ɔzele ye kɛ, “Yɛnwu Mɛzaya ne.” (Mɛzaya abo a le Kelaese.) 42Na ɔ nee Saemɔn bɛrale Gyisɛse ɛkɛ.
Gyisɛse nleanle Pita koonwu na ɔzele ye kɛ, “Wɔmɔ a ɛle Saemɔn, mɔɔ le Dwɔn ara ne. Bɛbavɛlɛ wɔ Sifase.” (“Sifase” yemɔ ala a le “Pita” na ɔ bo a le “Bodane”.)
Gyisɛse fɛlɛ Felepe nee Natanayɛle
43Aleɛ hyenle la Gyisɛse yɛle kɛ ɔkɔ Galeli. Ɔnwunle Felepe na ɔzele ye kɛ, “Bɛla maa yɛhɔ!” 44(Felepe vi Bɛteseeyeda, Andelu nee Pita sua zo.) 45Felepe hɔkpondɛle Natanayɛle na ɔzele ye kɛ, “Yɛnwu sonla ne mɔɔ Mosisi hɛlɛle ɔ nwo edwɛkɛ wɔ mɛla ne anu, na Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma noko hɛlɛle ɔ nwo edwɛkɛ la. Yemɔ a le Gyisɛse, Dwosefi mɔɔ vi Nazalɛte la ara ne.”
46Natanayɛle bizale ye kɛ, “Asoo debie kpalɛ bie kola fi Nazalɛte finde?”
Felepe buale kɛ, “Bɛla banlea.”
47Mɔɔ Gyisɛse nwunle kɛ Natanayɛle ɛlɛba la, ɔzele kɛ, “Bɛnlea, Yizilayɛnli kpalɛ mɔɔ ɛnze adalɛ bɔ la ɛne!”
48Natanayɛle bizale ye kɛ, “Na ɛze me nienwu?”
Gyisɛse buale kɛ, “Menwunle wɔ wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee ɛde feege baka ne abo la kolaa na Felepe aravɛlɛ wɔ.”
49Natanayɛle hanle kɛ, “Kilehilevolɛ, wɔmɔ a ɛle Nyamenle Ara ne. Wɔmɔ a ɛle Yizilayɛ Belemgbunli ne a!”
50Gyisɛse buale ye kɛ, “Kɛmɔ meha kɛ menwunle wɔ wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee ɛde feege baka ne abo la ati yɛɛ wɔlie wɔli a. Ɛbanwu nwanwane ninyɛne mgbole mɔɔ tɛla ɛhye a!” 51 Na ɔhanle ɔhilele bɛ muala kɛ, “Meka nɔhalɛ ne meahile bɛ: bɛbanwu kɛ anwuma ɛbuke na Sonla Ra ne ati, Nyamenle soanvolɛma ɛlɛfo dwu.”

Title: DW 2
Content:
Kana atɔfolɛ ne abo
1Ye kenle nwiɔ ne anzi bɛliele atɔfolɛ bie wɔ Kana sua zo, wɔ Galeli maanzinli nu. Gyisɛse ɔ nli wɔ ɛkɛ ne bie, 2yɛɛ bɛdole ɛsalɛ bɛvɛlɛle Gyisɛse nee ye ɛdoavolɛma ne mɔ noko. 3Mɔɔ bɛnlonle nwanye ne na ɔwiele la, Gyisɛse ɔ nli zele ye kɛ, “Bɛ nwanye ɛwie.”
4Gyisɛse buale ye kɛ, “Ɔmɔ, mmaka mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ meyɛ la ɛkile me, me mekɛ ɛtɛdwule.”
5Gyisɛse ɔ nli zele sonvolɛma ne mɔ kɛ, “Mɔɔ ɔkɛha ɔkɛhile bɛ biala la, bɛyɛ.”
6Dwuuma lɛ ɛzonlenlɛ nu ngyehyɛlɛ bie mɔɔ fane ɛnluanlɛ nwo. Debie zɛhae ati bolɛ dwora nsia wɔ awuke ne anu, ko biala kola di nzule litili ɛya ko. 7Gyisɛse zele soanvolɛma ne mɔ kɛ, “Bɛsesa nzule bɛgua dwora ne mɔ anu bɛmaa bɛyi tetɛkɛɛ.” Na bɛyɛle ye zɔhane. 8Ɔhanle ɔhilele bɛ kɛ, “Akee bɛza nzule ne bie bɛhɔmaa mɔɔ ɛlɛnea atɔfolɛlielɛ ne azo la.” Bɛzale bie bɛhɔle, 9na ɔzɔle nzule ne mɔɔ ɛnee ɛhakyi nwanye la bie ɔnleanle la, ɛnee ɔngola ɔnnwu ɛleka mɔɔ nwanye ne vi a (sonvolɛma ne mɔ mɔɔ sesale nzule ne la bɛmɛ bɛze); yemɔti ɔvɛlɛle atɔfolɛ nrenya ne 10na ɔzele ye kɛ, “Awie biala die atɔfolɛ a, ɔdumua ɔye ye nwanye kpalɛ ne ɔfinde, na mɔɔ bɛkɛbo ekyii la akee yeava nwanye mɔɔ anwo ɛngyia la yeara. Na wɔ ɛdeɛ ne, yeanyɛ zɔhane. Wɔva kpalɛ ne wɔzie dedee yeradwu bekezɛ!”
11Gyisɛse yɛle nwanwane gyima ɛhye mɔɔ lumua la wɔ Kana mɔɔ wɔ Galeli la; ɛkɛ ne yɛɛ ɔyele ye anyunlunyia ne ɔhilele a, na ye ɛdoavolɛma ne mɔ liele ye lile.
12 Ɛhye anzi, Gyisɛse nee ɔ nli, ɔ mediema ne mɔ, yɛɛ ye ɛdoavolɛma ne mɔ hɔle Kapɛnayɛm hɔdɛnlanle ɛkɛ ne mekɛ ekyi.
Gyisɛse hɔle Ɛzonlenlɛ sua ne anu
(Mat 21.12-13; Mak 11.15-17; Luk 19.45-46)
13 Ɛnee Dwuuma Akpabɛnwo Ɛvoyia ne asɛɛ ɛdwu, yemɔti Gyisɛse hɔle Gyɛlusalɛm. 14Ɔhɔdole kɛ menli ɛlɛdi nlankɛ, mboane, yɛɛ mɔlɔnoma gua wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu, na eza menli dede ɛkponle nwo ɛlɛsenza ezukoa. 15Gyisɛse vale nyɛma yɛle empele na ɔvale ɔvoanle nane ne mɔ, mboane nee nlankɛ kɔsɔɔti, ɔvile Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu; akee ɔbutubutule ɛkponle ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛlɛfa bɛazenza ezukoa la ɔmanle ezukoa ne zandele sua ne anu, 16na ɔzele bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛtɔne mɔlɔnoma ne la kɛ, “Bɛva bɛ bɛvinde! Bɛmmafa Egya sua ne bɛyɛ gua nu!” 17 Ye ɛdoavolɛma ne hakyele kɛ Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne ɛha ɛdo ɛkɛ ne kɛ, “Nyamenle, wɔ sua ne anwo ɛhulolɛ sɔ kɛ senle la wɔ me nu.”
18Dwuu mgbanyima ne mɔ ziale rale na bɛrabizale ye kɛ, “Duzu nwanwane nyɛleɛ yɛɛ ɛkɛhola ɛkɛyɛ ɛkɛhile kɛ ɛlɛ adenle ɛyɛ ɛhye mɔ a?”
19 Gyisɛse buale kɛ, “Bɛbubu Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ɛhye bɛgua na mebava kenle nsa meazi ye bieko.”
20Bɛbizale ye kɛ, “Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ɛhye mɔɔ yɛvale ɛvolɛ abulanla nee nsia a yɛzile la, wɔmɔ ɛfa kenle nsa wɔazi?”
21Na Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne mɔɔ ɛnee Gyisɛse ɛlɛka nwolɛ edwɛkɛ la a le ɔdaye mumua ne ye sonlabaka ne. 22Yemɔti mɔɔ bɛdwazole ye bɛvile ewule nu la, ye ɛdoavolɛma ne hakyele kɛ yeha ɛhye ɛlɛ, na bɛliele Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne nee mɔɔ Gyisɛse hanle la noko bɛlile.
Gyisɛse ze sonla deɛ holɛ
23Akpabɛnwo Ɛvoyia ne anu ɛnee Gyisɛse wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm, na bɛdabɛ dɔɔnwo mɔɔ bɛnwunle gyima mgbole mɔɔ ɔlile la liele ye lile. 24Na Gyisɛse anva ɔ nwo ando awie biala anwo zo, ɔboalekɛ ɔze bɛ kɔsɔɔti kpalɛ. 25Yeangyia kɛ awie kɛha sonla nwo edwɛkɛ kɛhile ye, ɔboalekɛ ɔdaye mumua ne ɔze mɔɔ wɔ sonla biala ahonle nu la.

Title: DW 3
Content:
Gyisɛse nee Nekɔdimɛse
1Nrenya bie wɔ ɛkɛ, bɛfɛlɛ ye Nekɔdimɛse. Ɔle Dwuu mgbanyima ne mɔ ko yɛɛ ɔboka fane ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Falasii la anwo. 2Kenle ko nɔɔzo ɔhɔle Gyisɛse ɛkɛ ne na ɔzele ye kɛ, “Relabae, yɛze kɛ wɔmɔ a ɛle kilehilevolɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛzoa wɔ a. Awie biala ɛnrɛhola nwanwane ninyɛne mgbole mɔɔ ɛlɛyɛ la bie yɛ kyesɛ Nyamenle nee ye lua.”
3Gyisɛse buale ye kɛ, “Meka nɔhalɛ meahile wɔ: awie biala ɛnrɛnwu Nyamenle Belemgbunlililɛ ne kyesɛ bɛwo ye fofolɛ.”
4Nekɔdimɛse bizale ye kɛ, “Kɛ ɔkɛyɛ na sonla mɔɔ ɛwie nyi la bɛawo ye fofolɛ ɛ? Ɔnrɛhola ɔ nli akunlu wolo ɔnrɛmaa bɛnrɛwo ye fofolɛ!”
5Gyisɛse buale kɛ, “Meka nɔhalɛ ne meahile wɔ: kyesɛ bɛfa nzule nee Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne bɛsɔne sonla anrɛɛ ɔnrɛnwu Nyamenle Belemgbunlililɛ ne ɛlɛ. 6Mɔɔ bɛkɛlua nwonane ne azo bɛkɛwo ye la le nwonane, yɛɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛlua Sunsum ne azo bɛkɛwo ye la le sunsum. 7Mmamaa ɔyɛ wɔ ɛzulolɛ kɛ meha kɛ, ‘Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛwo wɔ fofolɛ’ a. 8Anwoma ne bɔ kɔ ɛleka mɔɔ ɔkulo la; ɛte ɔ ne, na ɛnze ɛleka mɔɔ ɔvi ɔba a, yɛɛ ɛnze ɛleka mɔɔ ɔkɔ a. Zɔhane ala yɛɛ awie biala mɔɔ bɛkɛwo ye Sunsum nu la de a.”
9Nekɔdimɛse bizale ye kɛ, “Kɛ ɔkɛyɛ na ɛhye ayɛ zɔhane ɛ?”
10Gyisɛse buale ye kɛ, “Ɛle Yizilayɛ kilehilevolɛ kpole zɛhae, noko ɛnze ɛhye? 11Meka nɔhalɛ meahile wɔ: yɛka mɔɔ yɛnwu ye na yɛbɔ mɔɔ yɛde la nolo, noko bɛ biala ɛnlie yɛ edwɛkɛ ne ɛndo nuhua. 12Saa meka ninyɛne mɔɔ wɔ ewiade ye anu la anwo edwɛkɛ mekile bɛ na bɛnlie bɛnli a, ɛnee saa meka anwuma lɔ edwɛkɛ mekile bɛ a kɛ ɔkɛyɛ na bɛalie bɛali ɛ? 13Awie biala noko ɛtɛkɔle anwuma lɔ kɛ Sonla Ra ne mɔɔ vi anwuma lɔ rale la ala.”
14 Kɛmɔ Mosisi manle kɔbele ɛwɔlɛ ne zo wɔ baka zo wɔ ɛsɛlɛ ne anu la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ bɛbamaa Sonla Ra ne zo a, 15amaa awie biala mɔɔ kɛlie ye kɛli la anwu na yeanyia ngoane mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ. 16Ɔluakɛ Nyamenle hulole ewiade amra kpole kpalɛ la ati yɛɛ ɔvale Ɔ Ra kokye ne ɔmanle a, amaa awie biala mɔɔ kɛlie ye kɛli la anwu na yeanyia ngoane mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ. 17Ɔluakɛ Nyamenle anzoa Ɔ Ra ne wɔ ewiade ye kɛ ɔrabua menli mɔɔ wɔ nu la ndɛne, na ɔralie ewiade amra ngoane.
18Mɔɔ kɛlie Ralɛ ne kɛli la bɛnrɛbua ye ndɛne, na mɔɔ anlie ye anli la, bɛbua ye ndɛne dɛbadɛba, ɔboalekɛ yeanlie Nyamenle Ara kokye ne yeanli. 19Kɛ ndɛnebualɛ ne de la ɛne: wienyi ne ɛra ewiade ye na bɛ ninyɛndane ti, menli kulo awozinli tɛla wienyi ne. 20Awie biala mɔɔ yɛ ninyɛndane la kyi wienyi ne yɛɛ ɔnrɛlua nu ɛlɛ, ɔboalekɛ ɔnrɛhulo kɛ ɔkɛye ye nyɛleɛ ɛtane ne mɔ ɔkɛhile. 21Na mɔɔ di nɔhalɛ la kɔ wienyi ne anu, amaa wienyi ne ada agua ye gyima kpalɛ mɔɔ ɔlile la azo ahile kɛ ɔbɛlɛle ɔ nwo aze ɔmanle Nyamenle.
Gyisɛse nee Dwɔn
22Ɛhye anzi, Gyisɛse nee ye ɛdoavolɛma ne hɔle Dwudiya maanzinli nu. Ɔlile kenle ekyi wɔ ɛkɛ ne na ɔzɔnenle menli. 23Mekɛ ne anu ɛnee Dwɔn noko ɛlɛsɔne menli wɔ Enɔn mɔɔ bikye Salem la, ɔboalekɛ nzule dɔɔnwo wɔ ɛkɛ, na menli dɔɔnwo hɔle ɔ nwo ɛkɛ manle ɔzɔnenle bɛ. 24 (Mekɛ ne anu ɛnee bɛtɛtole Dwɔn efiade.)
25Dwɔn ɛdoavolɛma ne bie mɔ bɔle ɔ bo kɛ bɛ nee Dwuuma bie mɔ su kpolera wɔ ɛzonlenlɛ nu ɛnluanlɛ nwo. 26Yemɔti bɛhɔle Dwɔn ɛkɛ ne na bɛbizale ye kɛ, “Kilehilevolɛ, ɛkakye nrenya ne mɔɔ ɛnee nee wɔ wɔ azule Dwɔdan ne anzi lɔ, mɔɔ ɛhanle ɔ nwo edwɛkɛ la ɔ? Kɛkala ɔlɛsɔne menli, na awie biala asɛɛ ɛlɛkɔ ye ɛkɛ.”
27Dwɔn buale kɛ, “Awie biala ɛnrɛnyia ɛhwee kyesɛ Nyamenle fa maa ye. 28 Bɛdabɛ bɛdi daselɛ kɛ menganle kɛ, ‘Tɛ me a mele Mɛzaya ne, na bɛzoanle me kɛ menlumua ɔ nyunlu.’ 29Atɔfolɛ nrenya ne a le mɔɔ gya atɔfolɛ ne la, saa atɔfolɛ nrenya ne agɔnwo ne mɔɔ gyi ahane la te atɔfolɛ nrenya ne ane a, ɔ nye die. Me fɛlɛkolilɛ ne, ye munlililɛ kɛ de la ɛne. 30Ɔwɔ kɛ ɔyɛ sonlakpole ɔtɛla me, na meyɛ ekyi.”
Mɔɔ vi anwuma ba la
31Sonla mɔɔ vi anwuma ba la le sonlakpole tɛla bɛ muala; mɔɔ vi ewiade ye anu la le ewiade ɛdeɛ yɛɛ ɔka ewiade edwɛkɛ, na sonla mɔɔ vi anwuma la bo ɔ muala azo. 32Ɔka mɔɔ yenwu ye nee mɔɔ yede la, noko awie biala ɛndie ye edwɛkɛ. 33Mɔɔ die ye edwɛkɛ ne to nu la kile maa bɛnwu kɛ Nyamenle le nɔhalɛ. 34Mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛzoa ye la ka Nyamenle anloa edwɛkɛ, ɔboalekɛ Nyamenle maa ye Sunsum ne yi ye tɛkɛɛ. 35 Selɛ ne kulo Ɔ Ra ne, na yeva ninyɛne muala yewula ɔ sa nu. 36Awie biala mɔɔ die Ralɛ ne di la lɛ ngoane mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ, na mɔɔ kɛkpo kɛ ɔnrɛlie Ralɛ ne ɔnrɛli la ɛnrɛnyia ngoane mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ la ɛlɛ, Nyamenle ndeanlɛ ne wɔ ɔ nwo zo dahuu.

Title: DW 4
Content:
Gyisɛse nee Samɛlea raalɛ ne
1Falasiima ne dele kɛ Gyisɛse ɛlɛnyia menli dɔɔnwo azɔne bɛ, yeava bɛ yeayɛ ɛdoavolɛma adɛla Dwɔn. 2(Nɔhalɛ mɔɔ wɔ nu la a le kɛ Gyisɛse ɔdaye mumua ne yeanzɔne awie biala; ye ɛdoavolɛma ne mɔ a zɔnenle menli a.) 3Yemɔti mɔɔ Gyisɛse dele mɔɔ bɛlɛkeha la, ɔvile Dwudiya ɔziale ɔhɔle Galeli. 4Ɔkɔ la ɔvale Samɛlea maanzinli nu.
5 Ɔradwule Samɛlea sua bie mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Saekaa la azo. Ɛkɛ ne nee ɛleka mɔɔ Gyekɔbo vale ye azɛlɛ ne manle ɔ ra Dwosefi la anwa biala. 6Gyekɔbo bula ne wɔ ɛkɛ ne ala, na kɛmɔ ɛnee Gyisɛse ɛvɛ la ati, ɔdɛnlanle bula ne azo. Mekɛ ne kɛyɛ sɛnzɛngyinla.
7Samɛlea raalɛ bie rale kɛ ɔbado bula ne bie, na Gyisɛse zele ye kɛ, “Maa me nzule ne bie meno.” 8(Mekɛ ne anu ɛnee ye ɛdoavolɛma ne ɛhɔ sua zo kadɔ aleɛ.)
9 Raalɛ ne buale ye kɛ, “Ɛle Dwuunli, mele Samɛleanli. Kɛ ɔyɛ mɔɔ ɛlɛsɛlɛ me nzule ɛ?” (Dwuunli ɛnrɛva ɔ sa ɛnrɛha ɛyɛba anzɛɛ dwora mɔɔ Samɛleanli ɛli nu anzɛɛ ɛnlo nu la ɛlɛ.)
10Gyisɛse buale kɛ, “Saa ɛze kɛ Nyamenle ahyɛlɛdeɛ ne si de, nee ahenle mɔɔ ɛlɛsɛlɛ wɔ nzule ne la a, anrɛɛ wɔbiza ye wɔmaa yemaa wɔ ngoane nzule.”
11Raalɛ ne zele kɛ, “Yɛmenle, na ɛnlɛ bokiti, yɛɛ bula ye noko anu kɔ. Na ɛnee nienwu yɛɛ ɛnyia ngoane nzule ne a? 12Yɛ nlenya Gyekɔbo a manle yɛ bula ɛhye a, yɛɛ yemɔ, ɔ mra yɛɛ ye nyɛmoa nlonle nuhua nzule. Na ɛkpondɛ wɔaha kɛ wɔmɔ ɛle sonlakpole ɛtɛla Gyekɔbo ɔ?”
13Gyisɛse buale kɛ, “Awie biala mɔɔ no nzule ɛhye bie la, nzuhɔne bahu ye bieko, 14na mɔɔ kɛnlo nzule ne mɔɔ mebava meamaa ye la bie la, nzuhɔne ɛnrɛhu ye ɛlɛ. Nzule ne mɔɔ mebava meamaa ye la bahakyi nzubula wɔ ye nu mɔɔ bamaa ye ngoane nzule nee ngoane mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ a.”
15Raalɛ ne buale kɛ, “Yɛmenle, maa me nzule ɛhye bie maa meno na nzuhɔne angu me bieko na eza meara ɛke kɛ mebaza nzule.”
16Gyisɛse zele ye kɛ, “Kɔvɛlɛ ɛ hu na ɛ nee ye bɛrɛla.”
17Raalɛ ne buale kɛ, “Mengya nrenya.”
Gyisɛse zele ye kɛ, “Saa ɛse ɛngya nrenya a ɛnee ɛle nɔhalɛ. 18Ɔluakɛ ɛdawɔ mumua ne wɔhɔ agyalɛ nnu, yɛɛ nrenya ne bɔbɔ mɔɔ ɛ nee ye de kɛkala la, tɛ ɛ hu ɔ. Wɔha nɔhalɛ bɔkɔɔ.”
19Raalɛ ne zele kɛ, “Yɛmenle, menea wɔ a ɛle Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ. 20Me nlenya mɔ Samɛleama zonlenle Nyamenle wɔ boka ye azo, na bɛmɛ Dwuuma bɛse Gyɛlusalɛm ala a le ɛleka mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛsonle Nyamenle a.”
21Gyisɛse zele ye kɛ, “Ɔmɔ, die me di, mekɛ bara mɔɔ menli ɛnrɛzonle Selɛ ne wɔ boka ye azo anzɛɛ wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm a. 22Nɔhalɛ, bɛmɛ Samɛleama, bɛnze mɔɔ bɛsonle ye la, na yɛmɛ Dwuuma, yɛze mɔɔ yɛsonle ye la. Ɔboalekɛ ngoanelielɛ kɛra a ɔvi Dwuuma. 23Na mekɛ ne ɛlɛba, yɛɛ yedwu bɔbɔ, mɔɔ ɛzonlenlɛma kpalɛ ne bazonle Selɛ ne wɔ sunsum nu nee nɔhalɛ nu a. Ɔluakɛ kɛ Selɛ ne kpondɛ kɛ bɛsonle ye la ɛne. 24Nyamenle le Sunsum, yemɔti ɔwɔ kɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsonle ye la bɛsonle ye wɔ sunsum nu nee nɔhalɛ nu.”
25Raalɛ ne hanle kɛ, “Meze kɛ Mɛzaya ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Kelaese ne la bara. Saa ɔba a, ɔbaha mɔɔ ɔwɔ ɛkɛ ne la amuala yeahile yɛ.”
26Gyisɛse buale ye kɛ, “Medame a me nee wɔ ɛlɛtendɛ la.”
27Mekɛ ne anu ala yɛɛ Gyisɛse ɛdoavolɛma ne ziale rale a, na ɔyɛle bɛ azibɛnwo kpole kɛ ɔ nee raalɛ ɛlɛtendɛ a. Na bɛ nuhua biala angola ambiza raalɛ ne kɛ, “Duzu yɛɛ ɛkpondɛ a?” na bɛabiza Gyisɛse kɛ, “Duzu ati a ɛ nee raalɛ ne ɛlɛtendɛ a?”
28Na raalɛ ne gyakyile ye nzule buakɛ ne ɛkɛ, ɔziale ɔhɔle na ɔhɔhanle ɔhilele sua ne azo amra kɛ, 29“Bɛrɛla bɛranlea awie bie mɔɔ ɛha debie biala mɔɔ meyɛ la ɛhile me a. Asoo tɛ yemɔ a ɔle Mɛzaya ne?” 30Yemɔti menli dule twi, bɛvi sua ne azo bɛrale ɛleka mɔɔ Gyisɛse wɔ la.
31Mekɛ ne anu ɛnee ɛdoavolɛma ne gua zo ɛlɛkpa Gyisɛse kyɛlɛ kɛ, “Kilehilevolɛ, bakpula ɛ sa!”
32Na ɔbuale bɛ kɛ, “Melɛ aleɛ medi mɔɔ bɛnze a.”
33Yemɔti ɛdoavolɛma ne mɔ bɔle ɔ bo kɛ bɛbizebiza bɛ nwo kɛ, “Ɛnee awie ɛrɛlɛ ye aleɛ ɔ?”
34Gyisɛse zele bɛ kɛ, “Me aleɛ a le kɛ menwɔli mɔɔ zoanle me la ɛhulolɛdeɛ zo na menwɔwie gyima mɔɔ ɔvale ɔmanle me kɛ menyɛ la yɛ. 35Bɛmɛ bɛse, ‘Yeha siane nna na ɛbuhenle ne adwu.’ Na meka meahile bɛ kɛ bɛdo bɛ nye bɛnlea ɛya nu lɔ boɛ; nzoleɛ ɛbolo, na yedwu mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛbu a. 36Mɔɔ bu bɛyɔba ne la bɛtua ye kakɛ na ɔsoa nzoleɛ ne ɔkɔ ngoane mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ la anu, amaa mɔɔ dua nee mɔɔ bu la abɔ nu ali fɛlɛko. 37Ɛrɛlɛ ne le nɔhalɛ bɔkɔɔ, ‘Ko dua na ko bu.’ 38Mezoa bɛ kɛ bɛhɔva bɛyɔba wɔ ɛya mɔɔ bɛanyɛ nuhua gyima la anu; awie mɔ gyɛne a yɛle nuhua gyima a, na bɛmɛ, bɛnyia menli zɔhane mɔ anwo nvasoɛ.”
39Samɛleama dɔɔnwo mɔɔ wɔ sua ne azo la liele Gyisɛse lile, ɔboalekɛ raalɛ ne lile daselɛ kɛ, “Yeha debie biala mɔɔ meyɛ la yehile me.” 40Yemɔti mɔɔ Samɛleama rale Gyisɛse anwo ɛkɛ ne la, bɛzɛlɛle ye kɛ ɔ nee bɛ ɛradɛnla, na ɔ nee bɛ dɛnlanle kenle nwiɔ.
41Bie mɔ dɔɔnwo noko liele ye lile wɔ ɔ nloa edwɛkɛ ti, 42na bɛhanle bɛhilele raalɛ ne kɛ, “Kɛkala, tɛ mɔɔ ɛhanle la ati yɛɛ ɛmaa yɛlie ye yɛli a. Yɛlie ye yɛli, ɔluakɛ yɛdayɛ noko yɛde ɔ nloa edwɛkɛ yɛ nzo nu na yɛnwu kɛ amgba yemɔ a ɔle ewiade Ngoanedievolɛ ne a.”
Gyisɛse yɛ arane abɔlɔba ko ara nrenya ayile
43Gyisɛse lile kenle nwiɔ wɔ ɛkɛ ne la, ɔvile ɛkɛ ne na ɔhɔle Galeli, 44 ɔluakɛ Gyisɛse ɔdaye mumua ne yeha ye ɛlɛ kɛ, “Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ biala ɛnlɛ ɔ nyunlu wɔ ɔdaye ye maanle nu.” 45 Na mɔɔ ɔdwule Galeli la, menli mɔɔ wɔ ɛkɛ ne la liele ye gyɛlɛɛnye, ɔluakɛ Akpabɛnwo Ɛvoyia ne mɔɔ bɛlile wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm la, bɛhɔle bie na bɛnwunle debie biala mɔɔ ɔyɛle wɔ ɛvoyia ne abo la.
46 Akee Gyisɛse ziale hɔle Galeli sua ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Kana la azo bieko, ɛleka mɔɔ ɔhakyile nzule ne nwanye la. Arane abɔlɔba bie wɔ ɛkɛ mɔɔ ɔ ra wɔ Kapɛnayɛm na ɔnde kpɔkɛ a. 47Ɔdele kɛ Gyisɛse vi Dwudiya ɛra Galeli la ɔhɔle ɔ nwo ɛkɛ ne na ɔzɛlɛle ye kɛ ɔmaa bɛhɔ Kapɛnayɛm na ɔhɔyɛ ɔ ra ne ayile, ɔluakɛ asɛɛ yewu. 48Gyisɛse zele ye kɛ, “Bɛmɛ, bɛ biala ɛnrɛlie ɛnrɛli ɛlɛ kyesɛ bɛnwu nwanwane sɛkɛlɛneɛ mgbole bie.”
49Abɔlɔba ne hanle kɛ, “Yɛmenle, mesɛlɛ wɔ, maa yɛhɔ na me ra ne kɛwu.”
50Gyisɛse zele ye kɛ, “Kɔ na ɛ ra ne ɛde kpɔkɛ.”
Nrenya ne liele Gyisɛse edwɛkɛ ne lile, na ɔhɔle.
51Ɔlua adenle zo mɔɔ ɔlɛkɔ la, ye sonvolɛma nee ye yiale na bɛhanle kɛ, “Ɛ ra ne ɛde kpɔkɛ.”
52Ɔbizale bɛ mekɛ mɔɔ ɔ ra ne dele kpɔkɛ la, na bɛhanle kɛ, “Anoma ewiazo dɔne ko yɛɛ ɛyɛlɛyɛlɛ ne dule a.” 53Nrenya ne hakyele kɛ zɔhane mekɛ ne anu ala yɛɛ Gyisɛse hanle hilele ye kɛ, “Ɛ ra ne ɛde kpɔkɛ” a. Yemɔti ɔ nee ye sua nu amra amuala liele lile.
54Ɛhye a le nwanwane gyima kpole mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nwiɔ mɔɔ Gyisɛse vi Dwudiya rale Galeli la ɔyɛle a.

Title: DW 5
Content:
Gyisɛse yɛ ayile wɔ nzubula ne anloa
1Ɛhye anzi Gyisɛse hɔle Gyɛlusalɛm wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee Dwuuma ɛlɛdi bɛ Nyamenle ɛzonlenlɛ ɛvoyia bie la. 2Wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm “Mboane Anuhɔlɛ” ne anloa, nzubula bie wɔ ɛkɛ ne, ɔlɛ kpɔda nnu wɔ nwolɛ, bɛfɛlɛ nzubula ne wɔ Hibulu aneɛ nu “Bɛtezata.” 3Menli dɔɔnwo mɔɔ ɛnde kpɔkɛ la gugua kpɔda ne mɔ abo, anyenzinliravolɛma, abuburama, yɛɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ foa ko ɛdwe la amuala. [Bɛlɛkendɛ bɛamaa bɛakpoto azule ne, 4ɔboalekɛ ɔdwu mekɛ ne bie a, Nyamenle soanvolɛ dwu azule ne anu kpoto ye. Saa ɔyɛ ye zɔhane a, wuleravolɛ biala mɔɔ kɛlumua kɛhɔdɔ nuhua la anwo sa bɔkɔɔ.] 5Nrenya bie wɔ nzubula ne anloa mɔɔ ye ewule ne hanle ye la ye ɛvolɛ abulasa nee mɔtwɛ ɛ. 6Gyisɛse nwunle ye la, ɛnee yenwu kɛ ɔ nwo dole ye la ɛhyɛ kpalɛ; yemɔti ɔbizale ye kɛ, “Ɛkulo kɛ ɛte kpɔkɛ ɔ?”
7Nrenya ne buale kɛ, “Yɛmenle, menlɛ awie wɔ ɛke mɔɔ saa bɛkpoto azule ne a ɔfa me ɔto nu a; mekɛ biala mɔɔ menwɔbɔ mɔdenle kɛ mekadɔ nu la, ɛnee sonla fofolɛ ɛlumua me nyunlu ɛhɔdɔ nu.” 8Gyisɛse zele ye kɛ, “Dwazo, fa wɔ ɛkpa ne na kɔ.” 9Ɛkɛ ne ala nrenya ne dele kpɔkɛ; ɔvale ye ɛkpa ne na ɔhɔle.
Kenle mɔɔ ɛhye zile la le Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle. 10 Yemɔti Dwuu mgbanyima ne zɔle nrenya ne mɔɔ bɛyɛ ye ayile la nu na bɛzele ye kɛ, “Ɛnɛ le Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle, yemɔti ɔtia yɛ mɛla ne kɛ ɛkɛzoa wɔ ɛkpa ne.”
11Nrenya ne buale kɛ, “Sonla ne mɔɔ yɛle me ayile la a zele me kɛ, ‘Fa wɔ ɛkpa ne na kɔ’ a.”
12Bɛbizale ye kɛ, “Ɛnee nwane a ɔdaye yeze wɔ kɛ ɛva wɔ ɛkpa ne na ɛhɔ a?”
13Na nrenya ne mɔɔ bɛyɛ ye ayile ne la ɛnze Gyisɛse sonla holɛ, ɔluakɛ ɛnee menli dɔɔnwo wɔ ɛkɛ, yɛɛ Gyisɛse noko ɛvinde ɛhɔ.
14Nzinlii, Gyisɛse nwunle nrenya ne wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu na ɔzele ye kɛ, “Nea o, kɛkala wɔde kpɔkɛ. Gyakyi wɔ ɛtane ne mɔ anzi ɛlilɛ, anrɛɛ mɔɔ kɛzi ɛ nwo zo la kɛbo zolɛ.”
15Nrenya ne hɔle na ɔhɔhanle ɔhilele Dwuu mgbanyima ne mɔ kɛ Gyisɛse a yɛle ye ayile a. 16Ɛhye ati bɛbɔle ɔ bo kɛ bɛyɛ Gyisɛse kpɔdekpɔde kɛ yeyɛ ayile wɔ Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle a. 17Gyisɛse buale bɛ kɛ, “Egya yɛ gyima kenle biala, yemɔti ɔwɔ kɛ medame noko meyɛ gyima.”
18Edwɛkɛ ɛhye akee manle Dwuu mgbanyima ne nyianle adwenle kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛku ye bɛye ye ɛkɛ, ɔluakɛ tɛ kɛ yetia Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ne mɛla ne angome ɔ, na eza ɔse Nyamenle le Ɔ Ze, na ɔlua adenle ɛhye azo yehile kɛ ɔ nee Nyamenle bɛsɛ.
Ralɛ ne lɛ tumi
19Yemɔti Gyisɛse zele bɛ kɛ, “Meka nɔhalɛ ne meahile bɛ: Ralɛ ne angome ɛnli ɔ ti anwo ɛnyɛ debie biala; ɔyɛ mɔɔ ɔkɛnwu kɛ Selɛ ne ɛlɛyɛ la ala angome. Mɔɔ Selɛ ne yɛ la, yɛɛ Ralɛ ne ɔdaye ɔyɛ a. 20Ɔluakɛ Selɛ ne kulo Ralɛ ne, yɛɛ ɔkile ye mɔɔ ɔdaye mumua ne ɔlɛyɛ la amuala. Ɔbahile ye ninyɛne mgbole bɔbɔ mɔɔ tɛla ɛhye mɔ la yeamaa yeayɛ, na ɔbayɛ bɛ muala azibɛnwo. 21Kɛmɔ Selɛ ne dwazo mɔwuamra na ɔmaa bɛ ngoane la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ Ralɛ ne ɔdaye ɔmaa awie biala mɔɔ ɔkulo kɛ ɔmaa ye ngoane la ngoane a. 22Selɛ ne ɔdaye mumua ne ɔmbua awie ndɛne. Yemaa Ralɛ ne tumi biala kɛ ɔbua ndɛne, 23amaa menli kɔsɔɔti ali Ralɛ ne eni, kɛmɔ bɛdi Selɛ ne eni la. Awie biala mɔɔ ɛnli Ralɛ ne eni la, ɛnli Selɛ ne mɔɔ zoanle ye la eni.
24“Meka nɔhalɛ ne meahile bɛ: Mɔɔ kɛdie me edwɛkɛ na ɔkɛlie mɔɔ zoanle me la kɛli la lɛ ngoane mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ. Bɛnrɛbua ye ndɛne, na ɔvi ewule nu yera ngoane nu. 25Meka nɔhalɛ ne meahile bɛ: mekɛ ɛlɛba, yɛɛ yera bɔbɔ, mɔɔ mɔwuamra bade Nyamenle Ara ne ane, na bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛde la bɛbadwazo bɛ bɛara ngoane nu. 26Kɛmɔ Selɛ ne a le ngoanemaavolɛ la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ yeyɛ Ralɛ ne ngoanemaavolɛ a. 27Eza yemaa Ralɛ ne tumi kɛ ɔbua ndɛne, ɔboalekɛ yemɔ a ɔle Sonla Ra ne a. 28Bɛmmamaa ɛhye yɛ bɛ azibɛnwo; mekɛ ɛlɛba mɔɔ mɔwuamra amuala bade ɔ ne wɔ bɛ nla ne mɔ anu, 29 na bɛvi bɛ nla ne mɔ anu bɛbavinde: bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛlile boɛ la badwazo na bɛanyia ngoane mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ, na bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛlile ɛtane la badwazo na bɛabua bɛ ewule fɔlɛ.”
Gyisɛse dasevolɛma
30“Menva me tumi menyɛ debie biala; mebua me ndɛne kɛmɔ Nyamenle kɛze me la, yemɔti me ndɛnebualɛ ne le fɔɔnwo, ɔboalekɛ mempele menyɛ mɔɔ medame mekulo la, na meyɛ mɔɔ ahenle mɔɔ zoanle me la kpondɛ la.
31“Saa me ngome medi me nwo daselɛ a, mɔɔ menwɔha la bɛdie bɛto nu a ɔnyɛ boɛ. 32Na awie ko wɔ ɛkɛ ne mɔɔ di me nwo daselɛ a, yɛɛ meze kɛ mɔɔ ɔka ye me nwo la le nɔhalɛ. 33 Bɛzoanle menli bɛmanle bɛhɔle Dwɔn anwo ɛkɛ ne, na ɔhanle nɔhalɛ ne anwo edwɛkɛ ɔhilele bɛ. 34Tɛ kɛ asɛɛ mekpondɛ sonla daselɛ la ati ɔ; meka ɛhye amaa bɛalie bɛ ngoane. 35Dwɔn le kɛ kɛnlaneɛ la, ɔzɔle na ɔdale, noko bɛ nye liele ye wienyi ne anu mekɛ ekyi bie ala. 36Melɛ dasevolɛ kpole bie mɔɔ ka me nwo edwɛkɛ kpalɛ tɛla mɔɔ Dwɔn hanle la. Gyima ne mɔɔ meyɛ, gyima ne mɔɔ Selɛ ne ɛva ɛmaa me kɛ menyɛ la, yemɔ a di me daselɛ kpalɛ na ɔkile kɛ Selɛ ne a zoanle me a. 37 Eza Selɛ ne mɔɔ zoanle me la ɔdaye ɔdi me daselɛ. Bɛtɛtele ɔ ne ɛlɛ, yɛɛ bɛtɛnwunle ɔ nyunlu ɛlɛ. 38Bɛnva ye edwɛkɛ ne bɛnzie bɛ ahonle nu, ɔluakɛ bɛnlie mɔɔ zoanle ye la bɛnli. 39Bɛmɛ, bɛsukoa Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne, ɔluakɛ bɛdwenle kɛ nuhua yɛɛ bɛkɛnwu ngoane mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ ne a. Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ mumua ne ɔdaye ɔka me nwo edwɛkɛ. 40Noko akee bɛkpo kɛ bɛnrɛra me nwo ɛkɛ na bɛanyia ngoane.
41“Tɛ menli ayɛlɛyelɛ yɛɛ mekpondɛ a. 42Bɛmɛ, meze bɛ, meze kɛ bɛnlɛ Nyamenle anwo ɛhulolɛ nretee zɛhae wɔ bɛ ahonle nu. 43Egya tumi nu yɛɛ melua mɔɔ membale a, na bɛmɛ, bɛanlie me; na saa awie gyɛne ɔdaye ɔfa ye tumi ɔba a, bɛbalie ye. 44Bɛkpondɛ kɛ bɛkanvo bɛ ngome bɛ nwo ngoko ngoko, na bɛmpele bɛnlie nganvolɛ bɛnvi Nyamenle kokye ne ɛkɛ ne, na ɛnee kɛ ɔkɛyɛ na bɛalie me bɛali ɛ? 45Bɛmmadwenle nwolɛ kɛ mame a mebadoa bɛ meahile Egya a. Mosisi mɔɔ bɛ nye la ɔ nwo zo la a badoa bɛ a. 46Saa bɛliele Mosisi bɛlile a anrɛɛ bɛlie medame noko bɛli; ɔboalekɛ ɔhɛlɛle me nwo edwɛkɛ. 47Na kɛmɔ bɛnlie mɔɔ ɔhɛlɛle la bɛanli la, kɛ ɔkɛyɛ na bɛalie mɔɔ meka la bɛali ɛ?”

Title: DW 6
Content:
Gyisɛse maa menli apenle nnu aleɛ
(Mat 14.13-21; Mak 6.30-44; Luk 9.10-17)
1Ɛhye anzi Gyisɛse pɛle hɔle Galeli Tandane ne, mɔɔ eza bɛfɛlɛ ye Taebilease Tandane la anzi lɔ. 2Menli dɔɔnwo doale ye, ɔluakɛ bɛnwu kɛ ye ayileyɛlɛ si de nwanwane la. 3Gyisɛse nee ye ɛdoavolɛma ne hɔle boka bie azo na bɛdɛnlanle aze. 4Mekɛ ne anu ɛnee Dwuuma Akpabɛnwo Ɛvoyia ne ɛbikye. 5Gyisɛse manle ɔ nye zo na ɔnwunle kɛ menli dɔɔnwo ɛlɛba ɔ nwo ɛkɛ ne, yemɔti ɔzele Felepe kɛ, “Nienwu a yɛkɛnyia aleɛ yɛkɛdɔ yɛkɛmaa menli ɛwolaa ɛhye a?” 6(Ɔhanle ɛhye ɔvale ɔzɔle Felepe ɔnleanle; na ɛnee ɔze mɔɔ ɔdaye mumua ne ɔbayɛ la.)
7Felepe buale kɛ, “Amaa awie biala anyia ekyi bɔbɔ ali la, ɔwɔ kɛ yɛnyia kpanwo mɔɔ bo dwɛtɛ fufule ɛya nwiɔ.”
8Ye ɛdoavolɛma ne mɔ anu ko, Saemɔn Pita adiema Andelu hanle kɛ, 9“Kakula nrenya ko wɔ ɛke mɔɔ lɛ abɛlɛ kpanwo ngunguma nnu nee fɛlɛ nwiɔ a. Na ɛhye ɛnrɛdwu bɛ ɛleka bie.”
10Gyisɛse zele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛmaa menli ne mɔ ɛdɛnlɛdɛnla aze.” (Ndile mondonloo dɔɔnwo bie wɔ ɛkɛ.) Yemɔti bɛmanle menli ne amuala dɛnlɛdɛnlanle aze; bɛ nloa dwu menli kɛyɛ apenle nnu. 11Gyisɛse vale kpanwo ne, ɔyɛle Nyamenle mo, na ɔhyɛle ɔmanle menli ne mɔ. Ɔvale fɛlɛ ne na ɔyɛle zɔhane ala, na awie biala nyianle bie lile manle ɔ ko yile. 12Mɔɔ awie biala ako yile la, Gyisɛse zele ye ɛdoavolɛma ne mɔ kɛ, “Bɛsesa ɔ bo zo ne mɔɔ ɛha la, bɛmmamaa yɛsɛkye ye.” 13Yemɔti bɛsesale, na kpanwo nnu ne mɔɔ menli ne lile la, ɔ bo zo ne mɔɔ hale la yile ahɛndɛne bulu nee nwiɔ.
14Mɔɔ menli ne nwunle nwanwane gyima kpole ɛhye mɔɔ Gyisɛse ɛli la bɛhanle kɛ, “Nɔhalɛ, ɛhye a le Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ ne mɔɔ bara ewiade la!” 15Gyisɛse nwunle kɛ bɛkpondɛ bɛahye ye ɛkɛ ne ala bɛazie belemgbunli la ati, ɔhwenle ɔ nwo na ɔdaye ɔ ngome ɔhɔle awoka ne mɔ azo lɔ bieko.
Gyisɛse tia azule nye
(Mat 14.22-33; Mak 6.45-52)
16Mɔɔ aleɛ ne ɛlɛmua nwo la, Gyisɛse ɛdoavolɛma ne tolole rale tandane ne anloa, 17bɛvole ɛlɛne nu na bɛziale bɛ nzi kɛ bɛpɛ bɛadɔ Kapɛnayɛm. Aleɛ dwole kpalɛ la, ɛnee Gyisɛse ɛtɛbale. 18Mekɛ ne anu ɛnee anwoma kpole bie ɛdwazo na azule ne ɛlɛtu ɛsesebɛ. 19Ɛdoavolɛma ne hanle ɛlɛne ne hɔle kilomita kɛyɛ nnu anzɛɛ nsia la yɛɛ bɛnwunle kɛ Gyisɛse ɛlɛtia azule ne anye ara ɛlɛne ne anwo a. Bɛ ahonle dule kpole 20na Gyisɛse zele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛmmasulo, na medame ɔ!” 21Bɛmanle ɔvole ɛlɛne ne anu, na ɛkɛ ne ala ɛlɛne ne hɔnwenle aze wɔ ɛleka mɔɔ ɛnee bɛ nye gyi kɛ bɛkɔ la.
Menli ne kpondɛ Gyisɛse
22Aleɛ hyenle la menli dɔɔnwo ne mɔɔ Gyisɛse ati bɛhale tandane ne anzi lɔ la nwunle kɛ ɛlɛne ko pɛ a ɛnee wɔ ɛkɛ ne a. Bɛze noko kɛ Gyisɛse anvo ɛdoavolɛma ne mɔ ɛlɛne ne anu, na bɛdule bɛgyakyile ye. 23Nzinlii nlɛne gyɛne vi Taebilease rale ɛleka mɔɔ Gyisɛse vale kpanwo ne na ɔyɛle mo ɔvale ɔmanle menli ne lile la. 24Yemɔti mɔɔ menli ne nwunle kɛ Gyisɛse ɛnle ɛkɛ, yɛɛ ye ɛdoavolɛma ne noko ɛhɔ la, bɛdabɛ noko bɛvale nlɛne mɔɔ rale la na bɛpɛle bɛrale Kapɛnayɛm kɛ bɛkakpondɛ ye.
Gyisɛse a le ngoane kpanwo ne a
25Menli ne nwunle Gyisɛse wɔ tandane ne anzi nehae la, bɛbizale ye kɛ, “Kilehilevolɛ, na kenlenzu a ɛrale ɛke a?”
26Gyisɛse buale bɛ kɛ, “Meka nɔhalɛ ne meahile bɛ: Bɛlile kpanwo ne na bɛ ko yile la ati yɛɛ bɛlɛkpondɛ me bo zo a, na tɛ kɛ asɛɛ bɛdele me nwanwane gyima mgbole mɔɔ menyɛle la abo la ati ɔ. 27Bɛmmayɛ gyima bɛkpondɛ aleɛ mɔɔ ɛngyɛ na azɛkye la; bɛyɛ gyima bɛkpondɛ aleɛ mɔɔ fa bɛ kɔ ngoane mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ la anu la. Aleɛ ɛhye yɛɛ medame Sonla Ra, mebava meamaa bɛ a, ɔboalekɛ Nyamenle Selɛ ne ɛlie me ɛdo nu na yemaa me tumi kɛ menyɛ ye zɔhane.”
28Bɛbizale ye kɛ, “Duzu yɛɛ yɛyɛ na yɛahola yɛayɛ gyima mɔɔ Nyamenle kpondɛ la a?”
29Gyisɛse zele bɛ kɛ, “Gyima mɔɔ Nyamenle kpondɛ kɛ bɛyɛ la a le kɛ bɛkɛlie mɔɔ ɔzoanle ye la bɛkɛli.”
30Bɛbizale ye kɛ, “Duzu nwanwane gyima yɛɛ ɛkɛyɛ ɛkɛhile yɛ na yɛalie wɔ yɛali a? Duzu debie a ɛkɛyɛ a? 31 Yɛ nlenya mɔ lile aleɛ ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye mana la wɔ ɛsɛlɛ ne azo, kɛmɔ Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se la, ‘Ɔmanle bɛ aleɛ mɔɔ vi anwuma la bɛlile.’ ”
32Gyisɛse zele bɛ kɛ, “Meka nɔhalɛ ne meahile bɛ: tɛ Mosisi a vale aleɛ ne mɔɔ vi anwuma la manle bɛ a; Egya a maa bɛ aleɛ kpalɛ mɔɔ vi anwuma la a. 33Ɔluakɛ aleɛ ne mɔɔ Nyamenle fa maa bɛ la a le sonla ne mɔɔ vi anwuma ɛdwu aze na ɔmaa ewiade amra ngoane mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ la.”
34Bɛzele ye kɛ, “Yɛmenle, maa yɛ aleɛ ɛhye bie kenle biala.”
35Gyisɛse buale bɛ kɛ, “Mame a mele ngoane kpanwo ne a. Mɔɔ kɛra me nwo la, ɛhɔne ɛnrɛhu ye ɛlɛ, yɛɛ mɔɔ kɛlie me kɛli la, nzuhɔne ɛnrɛhu ye ɛlɛ. 36Kɛkala, meka meahile bɛ kɛ bɛnwu me, noko bɛnrɛlie bɛnrɛli. 37Awie biala mɔɔ Egya bava ye amaa me la bara me nwo. Awie biala mɔɔ kɛra me nwo la menrɛvoa ye, 38ɔboalekɛ mevi anwuma membale kɛ mebayɛ mɔɔ zoanle me la ɛhulolɛdeɛ, na meamba kɛ mebali me ti anwo. 39Mɔɔ zoanle me la kpondɛ kɛ meyɛ ɛhye, amaa meamminli mɔɔ yeva yemaa me la bie, na meava bɛ muala meara ngoane nu wɔ mekɛ ne mɔɔ li awieleɛ la. 40Ɔluakɛ mɔɔ Egya kpondɛ la a le kɛ, bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛnwu Ralɛ ne na bɛkɛlie ye bɛkɛli la kɛnyia ngoane mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ; na mebadwazo bɛ meara ngoane nu wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ li awieleɛ la.”
41Dwuuma ne mɔ bɔle ɔ bo kɛ bɛtendɛ Gyisɛse bɛ nzo abo, ɔboalekɛ yeha kɛ, “Mame a mele kpanwo ne mɔɔ vi anwuma rale la.” 42Na bɛhanle kɛ, “Tɛ Dwosefi ara Gyisɛse ɛhye ɔ? Yɛze ɔ ze nee ɔ nli. Adenle boni azo a ɔlua mɔɔ ɔka kɛ ɔvi anwuma a yera a?”
43Gyisɛse zele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛgyakyi bɛ nzo abo ɛdendɛlɛ ne. 44Awie biala ɛnrɛhola ɛnrɛra me nwo, kyesɛ Selɛ ne mɔɔ zoanle me la twe ye bɛlɛ me; na mebadwazo ye meara ngoane nu wɔ mekɛ ne mɔɔ li awieleɛ la. 45 Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma hɛlɛle kɛ, ‘Nyamenle a kilehile menli kɔsɔɔti a.’ Awie biala mɔɔ te Selɛ ne ane na ɔtietia ɔ gyakɛ abo zo la ba me ɛkɛ. 46Ɛhye ɛngile kɛ awie biala ɛnwu Selɛ ne; mɔɔ vi Nyamenle ɛkɛ ne rale la a le sonla mɔɔ ɛnwu Selɛ ne a. 47Meka nɔhalɛ ne meahile bɛ: Mɔɔ kɛlie kɛli la lɛ ngoane mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ. 48Mame a mele ngoane kpanwo ne a. 49Bɛ nlenya mɔ lile mana wɔ ɛsɛlɛ ne azo, na bɛwule. 50Kpanwo ne mɔɔ vi anwuma ba la le aleɛ mɔɔ awie biala mɔɔ kɛli bie la ɛnrɛwu ɛlɛ a. 51Mame a mele ngoane kpanwo ne mɔɔ vi anwuma rale la. Mɔɔ kɛli kpanwo ɛhye bie la badɛnla ngoane nu dahuu. Kpanwo ne mɔɔ mefa meamaa ye la a le me nwonane ye mɔɔ meva memaa la, amaa ewiade anyia ngoane.”
52Ɛhye vale kpolera kpole radole Dwuuma ne mɔ avinli na bɛbizale kɛ, “Kɛ sonla ɛhye si ava ye nwonane amaa yɛali ɛ?”
53Gyisɛse zele bɛ kɛ, “Meka nɔhalɛ ne meahile bɛ: Saa bɛanli medame Sonla Ra me nwonane, bɛanno me mogya a bɛnrɛnyia ngoane mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ. 54Mɔɔ kɛli me nwonane ne bie na ɔkɛnlo me mogya ne bie la lɛ ngoane mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ, na mebadwazo ye meara ngoane nu wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ li awieleɛ la. 55Ɔluakɛ me nwonane ne a le aleɛ kpalɛ ne a, yɛɛ me mogya ne a le nzule kpalɛ ne a. 56Sonla mɔɔ di me nwonane na ɔno me mogya la de me nu, yɛɛ medame mede ye nu. 57Egya mɔɔ zoanle me la de aze, yɛɛ ɔdaye ɔ ti melɛ ngoane. Zɔhane ala yɛɛ mɔɔ kɛva me kɛli la, medame me ti ɔkɛnyia ngoane a. 58Ɛhye a le kpanwo ne mɔɔ vi anwuma rale la; ɔnle kɛ mana ne mɔɔ bɛ nlenya mɔ lile a nzinlii bɛwule la. Mɔɔ kɛli kpanwo ɛhye bie la kenyia ngoane mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ.”
59Gyisɛse hanle ɛhye wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee ɔlɛkilehile wɔ Kapɛnayɛm nyianu sua ne anu la.
Ngoane mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ edwɛkɛ
60Menli ne mɔɔ doa ye la anu dɔɔnwo dele ɛhye mɔɔ ɔhanle la na bɛhanle kɛ, “Ngilehilelɛ ɛhye yɛ se. Nwane a kɛhola ɛhye azo di a?”
61Awie anga angile Gyisɛse, noko ɔnwunle mɔɔ menli mɔɔ doa ye la ɛlɛka ye bɛ nzo abo wɔ ɛhye anwo la; yemɔti ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Ɛhye kpondɛ amaa bɛakpo aze ɔ? 62Na saa akee bɛnwu Sonla Ra ne kɛ ɔlɛkɔ anwuma, ɛleka mɔɔ ɔvi ɔrale la ɛ? 63Mɔɔ maa ngoane la a le Nyamenle Sunsum ne; sonla anwosesebɛ ɛngola ɛnyɛ ɛhwee. Edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ meha mehile bɛ la a le Nyamenle Sunsum mɔɔ maa ngoane la. 64Noko bɛ bie mɔ ɛnlie ɛnli.” (Mɔlebɛbo ne amuala ɛnee Gyisɛse ze bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnrɛlie bɛnrɛli, nee sonla mɔɔ baye ye amaa la.) 65Na ɔvale ɔzɔle zolɛ kɛ, “Ɛhye ati a menganle mengilele bɛ kɛ awie biala ɛnrɛhola ɛnrɛra me nwo kyesɛ Selɛ ne ɛva ye ɛrɛlɛ me la.”
66Ɛhye ati, menli mɔɔ doa ye la anu dɔɔnwo ziale bɛ nzi na bɛangola bɛ nee ye anlua bieko. 67Zɔhane ati Gyisɛse bizale ye ɛdoavolɛma bulu nee nwiɔ ne kɛ, “Na bɛdabɛ noko ɛ, bɛkɛhulo kɛ bɛkɛhɔ ɔ?”
68 Saemɔn Pita buale ye kɛ, “Awulae, nwane ɛkɛ a yɛkɔ a? Wɔmɔ a ɛlɛ edwɛkɛ mɔɔ maa ngoane mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ a. 69Kɛkala yɛlie yɛli, na yɛze kɛ wɔmɔ a ɛle Nwuanzanwuanza Ko ne mɔɔ vi Nyamenle ɛkɛ ɛra a.”
70Gyisɛse buale kɛ, “Bɛmɛ bulu nee nwiɔ ye, se memkpale nu menyele bɛ o? Noko bɛ nuhua ko le musuɔfoɔ!” 71Ɛnee ɔlɛka Dwudase mɔɔ le Saemɔn Yesekaleɔto ara ne edwɛkɛ. Ɔluakɛ ɛnee Dwudase le bulu nee nwiɔ ne anu ko bɔbɔ ɛdeɛ, noko ɔdaye ala a ɔbaye ye yeamaa a.

Title: DW 7
Content:
Gyisɛse nee ɔ mediema mrenya ne mɔ
1Ɛhye anzi, Gyisɛse hɔle akpɔsa wɔ Galeli maanzinli nu. Yeangulo kɛ ɔkɛhɔ Dwudiya, ɔluakɛ ɛnee Dwuu mgbanyima ne mɔ ɛlɛtɛ ye wɔ ɛkɛ ne ahu ye. 2 Mɔɔ Dwuuma Belandane Bo Ɛdɛnlanlɛ Ɛvoyia ne bikyele la, 3Gyisɛse amediema mrenya ne mɔ zele ye kɛ, “Kɔ Dwudiya ɛ, amaa menli mɔɔ doa wɔ la anwu wɔ nwanwane gyima mɔɔ ɛlɛdi la. 4Awie biala mɔɔ kpondɛ kɛ menli nwu ye kpalɛ la ɛnvea ye ninyɛne ɛyɛlɛ nwo. Kɛmɔ ɛlɛyɛ ɛhye mɔ la, ɛnee ɛbɔneko ɛngɔ ɛmaa ewiade amra amuala ɛnwu wɔ!” 5(Nea, ɔ mediema ne mɔ bɔbɔ ɛnlie ye ɛnli.)
6Gyisɛse zele bɛ kɛ, “Me mekɛ kpalɛ ne ɛtɛdwule. Bɛmɛ, mekɛ biala le kpalɛ maa bɛ. 7Ɛtane ewiade ye ɛmkpɔ bɛ, na mame, ɔkpɔ me, ɔluakɛ meka mekile ye dahuu kɛ ye ndenle ne mɔ ɛnle kpalɛ. 8Bɛmɛ bɛhɔ bɛ ɛvoyialilɛ ne. Na mame, menrɛhɔ, ɔboalekɛ me mekɛ kpalɛ ne ɛtɛdwule.” 9Ɔhanle ɛhye na ɔdɛnlanle Galeli.
Gyisɛse hɔle ɛvoyialilɛ ne
10Mɔɔ Gyisɛse amediema ne mɔ hɔle ɛvoyialilɛ ne la, nzinlii ɔdaye noko ɔhɔle, noko yeanye ɔ nwo yeangile, ɔveale ɔ nwo. 11Mekɛ ne anu ɛnee Dwuu mgbanyima ne mɔ ɛlɛkpondɛ ye ɛsesebɛ wɔ ɛvoyia ne abo, na bɛbizale kɛ, “Ɔwɔ nienwu?”
12Menli dɔɔnwo mɔɔ rale ɛvoyialilɛ ne bie la hanle ɔ nwo edwɛkɛ huhuhuhu dɔɔnwo. Bie mɔ se, “Ɔle sonla kpalɛ.” Bie mɔ noko se, “Ɔnle sonlakpalɛ, ɔlɛyɛ menli ne koasea.” 13Noko biala angola anye ɔ nyunlu anga ɔ nwo edwɛkɛ baguase, ɔboalekɛ bɛsulo Dwuu mgbanyima ne mɔ.
14Mɔɔ bɛlile ɛvoyia ne dedee na ɔhɔdwule ye avinli bie la, Gyisɛse hɔle Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu, na ɔbɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɔkilehile. 15Ye ngilehilelɛ ne zinle Dwuu mgbanyima ne mɔ anwo kpole manle bɛhanle kɛ, “Na kenlenzu a sonla ɛhye zukoale ye nwoma ye, mɔɔ ɔtɛkɔle sukulu ɛlɛ, noko ɔze debie kpole zɛhae a?”
16Gyisɛse buale bɛ kɛ, “Mɔɔ melɛkilehile la ɛnle me ti anwo ngilehilelɛ. Ɔvi Nyamenle ne mɔɔ zoanle me la ɛkɛ. 17Mɔɔ kɛboɔboa ɔ nwo kɛ ɔyɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle kpondɛ la banwu kɛ mɔɔ melɛkilehile la vi Nyamenle ɛkɛ anzɛɛ medame me ti anwo ngilehilelɛ ɔ. 18Awie mɔɔ di ɔ ti anwo kilehile la kpondɛ ɔdaye ɔ ngome ɔ nyunlu. Mɔɔ kpondɛ anyunlunyia maa mɔɔ zoanle ye la ka nɔhalɛ ne, yɛɛ nvonleɛ biala ɛnle ye nu. 19Tɛ Mosisi a vale mɛla ne rɛlɛle bɛ la ɔ? Noko bɛ nuhua ko biala ɛnli mɛla ne azo. Duzu ati a bɛkpondɛ kɛ bɛku me ɛ?”
20Ɛlɔne ne buale kɛ, “Ɛnlɛ ɛ sa! Nwane a ɛlɛkpondɛ wɔ ahu wɔ a?”
21Gyisɛse buale kɛ, “Nwanwane gyima kpole ko pɛ mɔɔ menyɛle la ɛzi bɛ muala bɛ nwo. 22 Se Mosisi hanle kɛ bɛyɛ bɛ mra mrenyanu nzonlɛ la ati, (noko tɛ Mosisi bɔbɔ a bɔle ɔ bo a, bɛ nlenya mɔ a bɔle ɔ bo a) saa ɔdwu Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle bɔbɔ a, bɛyɛ. 23 Na saa bɛyɛ kakula nrenya mrenyanu nzonlɛ wɔ Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle na bɛndo Mosisi mɛla ne a, ɛnee duzu ati yɛɛ bɛva me nwo ɛya kɛ meyɛ sonla ayile memaa ɔ nwo ɛza wɔ Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ɛ? 24Anrɛɛ bɛmmanea sonla nyunlu bɛbua ye ndɛne, bɛbua ndɛne wɔ ye adenle zo.”
Ɛnee yemɔ a ɔle Mɛzaya ne a?
25Menli mɔɔ vi Gyɛlusalɛm ɛkɛ ne la bie mɔ hanle kɛ, “Asoo tɛ nrenya ne mɔɔ bɛlɛkpondɛ ye bɛahu ye la ɛne? 26Nea! ɔlɛtendɛ bagua nu, noko awie biala ɛngola ɛnga edwɛkɛ biala ɛntia ye! Ɛnee mgbanyima ne mɔ akee ɛlie ɛdo nu kɛ yemɔ a ɔle Mɛzaya ne ɔ? 27Saa Mɛzaya ne ba a, awie biala ɛnrɛnwu ɛleka mɔɔ ɔvi a. Noko nrenya ɛhye, yɛze ɛleka mɔɔ ɔvi la.”
28Mɔɔ Gyisɛse ɛlɛkilehile wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu la ɔhanle ye kpole kpalɛ kɛ, “Asoo amgba bɛze me yɛɛ bɛze ɛleka mɔɔ mevi la? Meamba me ti anwo adenle. Mɔɔ zoanle me la le nɔhalɛ. Bɛmɛ bɛnze ye, 29na mame meze ye, ɔboalekɛ mevi ɔ nwo lɔ a membale a yɛɛ ɔdaye a ɔzoanle me a.”
30Yemɔti bɛyɛle kɛ bɛkye ye, noko awie angola anzɔ ye nu, ɔboalekɛ ɛnee ye mekɛ ne ɛtɛdwule. 31Menli dɔɔnwo mɔɔ wɔ ɛlɔne ne anu la liele ye lile na bɛhanle kɛ, “Asoo Mɛzaya ne ba a, ɔbayɛ nwanwane gyima mgbole yeadɛla mɔɔ nrenya ɛhye ɛyɛ la?”
Bɛzoa kɛ behɔhye Gyisɛse
32Falasiima dele mɔɔ menli ne ɛlɛka ye huhuhuhu wɔ Gyisɛse anwo la, yemɔti bɛ nee sɛlɛvolɛ mgbanyinli ne mɔ yɛle adwenle na bɛzoanle kɛ bɛhɔhye ye bɛrɛla. 33Gyisɛse zele bɛ kɛ, “Me nee bɛ badɛnla mekɛ ekyi bie ala na akee meahɔ mɔɔ zoanle me la anwo lɔ. 34Bɛbakpondɛ me, na bɛnrɛnwu me, ɔluakɛ ɛleka mɔɔ mekɔ la bɛnrɛhola ɛkɛ ne kɔ.”
35Dwuu mgbanyima ne hanle ye wɔ bɛ nwo ɛkɛ ne kɛ, “Ɛnee nienwu ɛleka a ɔkɔ mɔɔ yɛkpondɛ ye a yɛnrɛnwu ye a? Ɛnee ɔkɔ Giliki azuamgbole ne mɔ bie azo ɛleka mɔɔ Dwuuma bie mɔ wɔ la yeahɔhilehile Gilikima ɔ? 36Ɔse, ‘Bɛbakpondɛ me, na bɛnrɛnwu me’, yɛɛ eza ɔse, ‘Bɛnrɛhola ɛleka mɔɔ melɛkɔ la kɔ.’ Ɛnee duzu edwɛkɛ a ɔkpondɛ yeaha a?”
Ngoane azudenle
37Kenle mɔɔ li awieleɛ wɔ ɛvoyia ne ɛlilɛ nu la hyia kpole. Kenle ko zɔhane Gyisɛse dwazole na ɔhanle ye kpole kpalɛ kɛ, “Mɔɔ nzuhɔne ɛlɛku ye la ɛrɛla me ɛkɛ ɛranlo nzule. 38 Kɛmɔ Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se la, ‘Mɔɔ die me di la, ngoane azudenle vi ye ahonle nu baze.’ ” 39Gyisɛse hanle ɛhye wɔ Sunsum ne mɔɔ menli mɔɔ die ye di la banyia ye la anwo. Mekɛ ne anu ɛnee bɛtɛfale Sunsum ne bɛtɛmanle, ɔboalekɛ ɛnee bɛtɛdwazole Gyisɛse bɛtɛbale ye anyunlunyia ne anu.
Menli ne avinli ɛkpakye
40Menli mɔɔ wɔ ɛlɔne ne anu la anu dɔɔnwo dele mɔɔ ɔhanle la, na bɛzele kɛ, “Amgba, nrenya ɛhye a le Nyamenle Kpɔmanvolɛ ne!”
41Bie mɔ noko se, “Yemɔ a ɔle Mɛzaya ne.”
Eza bie mɔ noko se, “Mɛzaya ne vi Galeli ɛnrɛra. 42 Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se Mɛzaya ne bayɛ Belemgbunli Devidi dehelɛ, yɛɛ bɛbawo ye wɔ Bɛtelɛhɛm, ɛleka mɔɔ Devidi dɛnlanle la.” 43Ɛhye ati mgbakyelɛ ralale menli ne avinli wɔ Gyisɛse ati. 44Bie mɔ yɛle kɛ bɛkye ye, noko awie biala angola anzɔ ye nu.
Dwuu mgbanyima ne ɛnlie ɛnli
45Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne sinzavolɛma mɔɔ sɛlɛvolɛ mgbanyinli nee Falasiima ne mɔ zoanle bɛ kɛ bɛhɔhye Gyisɛse la ziale rale, na bɛbizale bɛ kɛ, “Duzu ati a bɛangye ye bɛamba ɛ?”
46Bɛbuale bɛ kɛ, “Awie biala ɛtɛtendɛle kɛ nrenya ɛhye tendɛ la.”
47Falasiima ne bizale bɛ kɛ, “Bɛmaa yeyɛ bɛdabɛ noko koasea ɔ? 48Asoo bɛnwu kɛ mgbanyima ne mɔ bie anzɛɛ Falasiima bie bɔbɔ ɛlie ye ɛli? 49Na ɛlɔne ne die ye di, ɔboalekɛ bɛ nuhua ko bɔbɔ ɛnze Mosisi mɛla ne, yemɔti abule kpalɛ a ɛbu bɛ a!”
50 Nekɔdimɛse ɛnee wɔ ɛkɛ ne bie, ɔle sonla mɔɔ ɛhɔ Gyisɛse anwo ɛlɛ a. Ɔzele bɛ kɛ, 51“Yɛ mɛla ne kile kɛ saa yɛtɛtele sonla anloa anu edwɛkɛ, yɛtɛnwunle mɔɔ yeyɛ la a, yɛmbu ye ewule fɔlɛ.”
52Bɛbizale ye kɛ, “Ɛnee ɛdawɔ noko ɛvi Galeli ɔ? Kɔvedevede Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne anu kpalɛ nea kɛ saa ɛkɛnwu kɛ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ ko bɔbɔ vi Galeli ɛvinde a!”

Title: DW 8
Content:
Raalɛ ne mɔɔ bɛhyele ye kɛ ɔlɛto awuvolɛvalɛ mɛla ne la
[ 1Akee awie biala hɔle sua nu, na Gyisɛse hɔle Ɔlivi Boka ne azo. 2Aleɛ hyenle nwonlomɔ mangyee ne la, ɔziale ɔhɔle Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu. Menli ne amuala rabɔle yiale ye na ɔdɛnlanle aze kɛ ɔkilehile bɛ. 3Mɛla kilehilevolɛma ne nee Falasiima vale raalɛ bie mɔɔ bɛhɔhye ye kɛ ɔlɛto awuvolɛvalɛ mɛla ne la rale na bɛvale ye bɛziele bɛ avinli ɛkɛ ne. 4Bɛzele Gyisɛse kɛ, “Kilehilevolɛ, raalɛ ɛhye, yɛhyele ye kɛ nrenya ɛlɛfa ye awuvolɛ. 5 Wɔ yɛ mɛla ne anu, Mosisi ɛhile kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛsi raalɛ zɔhane awolɛ dedee bɛmaa ɔwu. Na kɛ ɛse ɛ?” 6Bɛhanle ɛhye bɛdole ye abɛla, amaa bɛanyia bie bɛagyinla zolɛ bɛahɔdoa ye. Na Gyisɛse hanle ɔ nwo aze na ɔvale ɔ sa ɔhɛlɛhɛlɛle azɛlɛ ne anwo.
7Bɛhɔle zolɛ bɛbizebizale Gyisɛse kpuyia, na ɔdenrɛle ɔ nwo na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛ nuhua biala mɔɔ ɔnea a ɔtɛyɛle ɛtane ɛlɛ la ɛlumua ɛdo bolɛ ɛbɔ raalɛ ye.” 8Ɔhanle ɛhye la eza ɔhanle ɔ nwo aze na ɔhɛlɛhɛlɛle azɛlɛ ne anwo. 9Menli ne dele ɛhye la, bɛbɔle ɔ bo, ɔvi bɛ mgbanyinli ne mɔ anwo zo, bɛhɔle ngoko ngoko dedee bɛwiele kɔ bɔkɔɔ. Ɔhale Gyisɛse nee raalɛ ne angome wɔ ɛkɛ ne. 10Gyisɛse denrɛle ɔ nwo na ɔbizale raalɛ ne kɛ, “Ɔmɔ, na menli ne mɔ wɔ nienwu? Ko bɔbɔ anga ambua wɔ ewule fɔlɛ ɔ?”
11Raalɛ ne buale kɛ, “Yɛmenle, ko bɔbɔ anga o!”
Gyisɛse zele ye kɛ, “Ɛnee medame noko membua wɔ ewule fɔlɛ. Kɔ, na mmayɛ ɛtane bieko.”]
Gyisɛse a le ewiade wienyi ne a
12 Gyisɛse dendɛle hilele Falasiima ne bieko kɛ, “Mame a mele ewiade wienyi ne a. Awie biala mɔɔ kɛdoa me bo zo la kɛnyia ngoane nu wienyi ne, ɔnrɛlua awozinli nu ɛlɛ.”
13 Falasiima ne zele ye kɛ, “Kɛkala, akee ɛlɛdi ɛ nwo daselɛ, mɔɔ wɔha la ɛndo ɛhwee.”
14Gyisɛse buale kɛ, “Saa medi me nwo daselɛ bɔbɔ a, mɔɔ meka la le nɔhalɛ, ɔboalekɛ meze ɛleka mɔɔ mevi membale a, yɛɛ meze ɛleka mɔɔ melɛkɔ la. Bɛmɛ, bɛnze ɛleka mɔɔ mevi membale a yɛɛ bɛnze ɛleka mɔɔ melɛkɔ a. 15Bɛmɛ bɛnea sonla nyunlu na bɛabua ye ndɛne, na mame membua ndɛne. 16Na saa mebua ndɛne bɔbɔ a anrɛɛ me ndɛnebualɛ bayɛ fɔɔnwo, ɔluakɛ tɛ me ngome a melua a; Selɛ ne mɔɔ zoanle me la boka me nwo. 17 Bɛhɛlɛ ye wɔ bɛ mɛla ne anu kɛ saa dasevolɛma nwiɔ anloa yɛ ko a, ɛnee mɔɔ bɛkɛha la le nɔhalɛ. 18Medi me nwo daselɛ yɛɛ Selɛ ne mɔɔ zoanle me la di me nwo daselɛ.”
19Bɛbizale ye kɛ, “Ɛ ze ne wɔ nienwu?”
Gyisɛse buale bɛ kɛ, “Bɛnze me, yemɔti bɛnze Egya. Saa bɛze me a anrɛɛ bɛze Egya noko.”
20Gyisɛse hanle ɛhye mɔ amuala wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee ɔlɛkilehile wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu, wɔ ɛleka mɔɔ azubɔlɛ nlɛka ne mɔ gyigyi la. Na awie biala angola ye kye, ɔboalekɛ ɛnee ye mekɛ ɛtɛdwule.
Bɛnrɛhola ɛleka mɔɔ melɛkɔ la kɔ
21Gyisɛse hanle hilele bɛ bieko kɛ, “Mebahɔ; bɛbakpondɛ me, na bɛbawu bɛala bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ anu. Bɛnrɛhola ɛleka mɔɔ melɛkɔ la kɔ.” 22Yemɔti Dwuu mgbanyima ne mɔ hanle kɛ, “Ɔse, ‘Bɛnrɛhola ɛleka mɔɔ melɛkɔ la kɔ.’ Ɛnee ɔkpondɛ yeaze kɛ ɔkahu ɔ nwo ɔ?”
23Gyisɛse buale kɛ, “Bɛmɛ bɛvi azɛlɛ ye azo, na mame mevi anwuma. Bɛvi ewiade ɛhye anu, na mame menvi ewiade ye anu. 24Ɛhye ati yɛɛ meha mehile bɛ kɛ bɛbawu bɛala bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ anu la. Saa bɛanlie bɛanli kɛ, ‘Medame a le Medame’ a bɛbawu bɛala bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ anu bɔkɔɔ.”
25Bɛbizale ye kɛ, “Ɛdawɔ a le nwane?”
Gyisɛse buale kɛ, “Kɛmɔ melumua meha mehile bɛ ala la. 26Melɛ edwɛkɛ dɔɔnwo meka ye bɛ nwo, yɛɛ melɛ dɔɔnwo mebua bɛ nwolɛ ndɛne. Mɔɔ zoanle me la le nɔhalɛ yɛɛ mɔɔ menwɔde menwɔvi ye ɛkɛ ne la a meka mekile ewiade a.”
27Bɛande ɔ bo kɛ Selɛ ne anwo edwɛkɛ a Gyisɛse ɛlɛka ahile bɛ a. 28Yemɔti Gyisɛse zele bɛ kɛ, “Saa bɛmaa medame Sonla Ra zo wɔ meanubaka ne azo anwuma a yɛɛ bɛkɛnwu kɛ ‘Medame a le Medame’ a; na bɛanwu kɛ menva me ngome me tumi menyɛ debie, na meka mɔɔ Selɛ ne kɛhilehile me la ala. 29Eza mɔɔ zoanle me la nee me lua. Ɔtɛgyakyile me, ɔluakɛ dahuu meyɛ mɔɔ ɔkpondɛ la.”
30Bɛdabɛ dɔɔnwo mɔɔ bɛdele kɛ Gyisɛse ɛlɛka ɛhye mɔ la liele ye lile.
Alehelɛ nee ngɛkɛlɛ
31Yemɔti Gyisɛse zele Dwuuma mɔɔ liele ye lile la kɛ, “Saa bɛkɔ zolɛ bɛdi me ngilehilelɛ zo a, ɛnee bɛle me ɛdoavolɛma amgba; 32bɛbanwu nɔhalɛ ne, na nɔhalɛ ne bamaa bɛanyia bɛ ti.”
33 Bɛbuale ye kɛ, “Yɛle Ebileham abo zo amra, yɛɛ yɛtɛyɛle awie biala ngɛkɛlɛ ɛlɛ. Na kɛ ɔyɛ mɔɔ ɛse yɛkɛnyia yɛ ti ɛ? Duzu edwɛkɛ a ɛkpondɛ wɔaha a?”
34Gyisɛse zele bɛ kɛ, “Meka nɔhalɛ ne meahile bɛ: Awie biala mɔɔ kɛyɛ ɛtane la le ɛtane akɛlɛ. 35Akɛlɛ ɛmbɔ abusua ne bie dahuu, na dehelɛ boka abusua ne anwo dahuu. 36Saa Ralɛ ne yɛ bɛ alehelɛ a, ɛnee bɛle alehelɛ amgba. 37Meze kɛ bɛle Ebileham abo zo amra. Noko kɛmɔ bɛnlie me ngilehilelɛ ne bɛndo nu la ati, bɛkpondɛ kɛ bɛku me. 38Meka mɔɔ Egya ɛhilehile me la, yɛɛ bɛdabɛ bɛyɛ mɔɔ bɛ ze ɛha ɛhile bɛ la.”
39Bɛbuale ye kɛ, “Yɛ ze a le Ebileham.”
Gyisɛse zele bɛ kɛ, “Saa amgba ala bɛ ze a le Ebileham a, anrɛɛ bɛyɛ mɔɔ bɛ ze yɛle la bie. 40Mɔɔ meyɛ la amuala a le kɛ menwɔha nɔhalɛ ne mɔɔ mede mevi Nyamenle ɛkɛ ne la menwɔhile bɛ. Noko bɛkpondɛ me bɛahu me. Ebileham anyɛ ɛhye! 41Bɛlɛyɛ mɔɔ bɛ ze kpalɛ ne yɛle la bie!”
Bɛbuale ye kɛ, “Yɛnle arelazinli mralɛ; yɛ ze ala a le Nyamenle. Yɛle ɔ mra kpalɛ kpalɛ.”
42Gyisɛse zele bɛ kɛ, “Saa amgba bɛ ze a le Nyamenle a, anrɛɛ bɛkulo me, ɔboalekɛ mevi Nyamenle anwo lɔ a membale a. Meamba me ti anwo adenle. Ɔdaye a ɔzoanle me a. 43Duzu ati a bɛnde mɔɔ melɛka la abo ɛ? Ɔboalekɛ bɛngulo kɛ bɛtie me nrɛlaleɛ ne la ati ɔ. 44Bɛ ze kpalɛ ne a le Abɔnsam. Ɔ mra a le bɛ, yɛɛ bɛlɛyɛ mɔɔ bɛ ze kpalɛ ne kulo la. Ɔbɔ ɔ bo amuala la ɛnee ɔle kɔdiawu. Yeanli nɔhalɛ ɛlɛ, ɔboalekɛ nɔhalɛ nretee zɛhae ɛnle ye nu. Saa ɔbɔ adalɛ a ɛnee ɔlɛyɛ mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ ɔyɛ la, ɔboalekɛ ɔle alane, yɛɛ ɔle adalɛ kɔsɔɔti bɛ ze. 45Mame meka nɔhalɛ ne, na ɛhye ati noko yɛɛ bɛnlie me bɛnli a. 46Bɛ nuhua boni a kɛzi ɔ kɛnra kɛha kɛ medi ɛtane nwo fɔlɛ a? 47Mɔɔ vi Nyamenle ɛkɛ ne la tie Nyamenle edwɛkɛ ne. Bɛmɛ, bɛnvi Nyamenle ɛkɛ, na ɛhye ati yɛɛ bɛduodua bɛ nzo kɛ bɛnrɛdie Nyamenle edwɛkɛ ne a.”
Gyisɛse nee Ebileham
48Dwuuma ne zele Gyisɛse kɛ, “Saa yɛka kɛ ɛle Samɛleanli na ɛlɛ ayɛne a ɛnee yɛbɔ adalɛ ɔ?”
49Gyisɛse buale kɛ “Menlɛ ayɛne. Medi Egya eni, na bɛmɛ bɛngulo kɛ bɛdi me eni. 50Memkpondɛ anyunlunyia memmaa me nwo. Awie wɔ ɛkɛ ne mɔɔ yemɔ a anyunlunyia ne le ye ɛdeɛ a, na yemɔ a bua me benle a. 51Meka nɔhalɛ ne meahile bɛ: Mɔɔ kɛli me edwɛkɛ zo la ɛnrɛwu ɛlɛ.”
52Dwuuma ne zele ye kɛ, “Akee yɛnwu ye bɔkɔɔ kɛ ɛlɛ ayɛne kpole kpalɛ! Ebileham wule, yɛɛ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma wule, noko wɔmɔ ɛse, ‘Mɔɔ kɛli me edwɛkɛ zo la ɛnrɛwu ɛlɛ.’ 53Yɛ ze Ebileham bɔbɔ wule; ɛngola ɛnga kɛ ɛle kpole ɛtɛla Ebileham, na kɛ ɛse ɛ? Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma noko wule. Na ɛdwenle kɛ ɛle duzu?”
54Gyisɛse buale kɛ, “Saa me ngome mewula me nwo anyunlunyia a, ɛnee me anyunlunyia ɛndo ɛhwee. Ahenle mɔɔ wula me anyunlunyia la a le Egya, mɔɔ yemɔ a bɛse ɔle bɛ Nyamenle la. 55Bɛtɛnwunle ye ɛlɛ, na mame meze ye. Saa meka kɛ menze ye a, ɛnee mebɔ adalɛ kɛ bɛdabɛ la. Meze ye, yɛɛ medi ye edwɛkɛ zo. 56Bɛ ze Ebileham lile fɛlɛko kɛ ɔkɛnwu me ɛralɛ kenle ne, yɛɛ ɔnwunle ye na ɔlile nwolɛ fɛlɛko.”
57Dwuuma ne zele ye kɛ, “Ɛdawɔ mumua ne ɛtɛdile ɛvolɛ abulanlu bɔbɔ, noko ɛse ɛnwunle Ebileham?”
58Gyisɛse buale bɛ kɛ, “Meka nɔhalɛ ne meahile bɛ: Mɔɔ bɛkawo Ebileham la, ɛnee bɛfɛlɛ me ɛtease.”
59Bɛsesale awolɛ kɛ bɛto bɛazi ye, na Gyisɛse veale ɔ nwo na ɔvile Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu ɔhɔle.

Title: DW 9
Content:
Gyisɛse yɛ nrenya bie mɔɔ bɛwole ye anyenzinliravolɛ la ayile
1Gyisɛse kpɔsa kpɔsa la, ɔnwunle nrenya bie mɔɔ bɛkawo ye la ɛnee ɔ nye ɛzi la. 2Ye ɛdoavolɛma ne bizale ye kɛ, “Kilehilevolɛ, nwane ɛtane ti a bɛwole nrenya ɛhye anyenzinliravolɛ a? Ɔdaye mumua ne ye ɛtane ti anzɛɛ ye awovolɛ ɛtane ti ɔ?”
3Gyisɛse buale kɛ, “Ye anyenzinlira ne ɛnvane ɔdaye ye ɛtane anzɛɛ ye awovolɛ ɛtane mɔɔ bɛyɛ la anwo. Bɛwole ye anyenzinlira amaa menli anwu kɛ Nyamenle tumi ne ɛlɛyɛ gyima wɔ ye nu. 4Alehyenlɛ ye wɔ zo la, ɔwɔ kɛ yɛkɔ zolɛ yɛyɛ mɔɔ zoanle me la gyima ne; aledwolɛ ɛlɛba mɔɔ awie ɛngola ɛnyɛ gyima a. 5 Mewɔ ewiade ye anu ala la, medame a mele ewiade ye wienyi ne a.”
6Gyisɛse hanle ɛhye la, ɔdole nyɛlɛ azɛlɛ nwo, ɔvale ɔfɔtɔle ndɛtɛlɛ, ɔvale ndɛtɛlɛ ne ɔkpudale nrenya ne anye 7na ɔzele ye kɛ, “Kɔ kɔnrinzi ɛ nyunlu wɔ nzubula ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Saelowam la anu.” (Saelowam abo a le “Ɛzoanlɛ”.) Nrenya ne hɔle hɔnrinzinle ɔ nyunlu wɔ nzubula ne anu, na ɔkara la ɛnee ɔnwu debie.
8Ye kpalɛ zo amra nee menli mɔɔ ɛnwu ye ɛlɛ kɛ ɔde ɔlɛsɛlɛzɛlɛ la bizale kɛ, “Asoo tɛ nrenya ne mɔɔ tɛnla sɛlɛzɛlɛ la ɛne?”
9Bie mɔ zele kɛ, “Ɔdaye ɔ,” Bie mɔ noko hanle kɛ, “Kyɛkyɛ, tɛ ye ɔ, ɔzɔho ye ala.”
Nrenya mumua ne hanle kɛ, “Medame ɔ.”
10Bɛbizale ye kɛ, “Kɛ ɔyɛle mɔɔ ɛ nye ne dukuele ɛ?”
11Ɔbuale kɛ, “Nrenya ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Gyisɛse la fɔtɔle ndɛtɛlɛ vale kpudale me nye na ɔzele me kɛ, ‘Kɔnrinzi ɛ nyunlu wɔ Saelowam ne anu’; na mengɔnyɛle ye zɔhane yɛɛ me nye ne dukuele a.”
12Bɛbizale ye kɛ, “Na nrenya zɔhane wɔ nienwu?”
Ɔbuale kɛ, “Menze.”
Falasiima kpondɛ ayileyɛlɛ ne anu
13Bɛvale nrenya ne mɔɔ ɛnee ɔ nye ɛzi la bɛhɔmanle Falasiima ne. 14Kenle ko ne mɔɔ Gyisɛse fɔtɔle ndɛtɛlɛ ne vale dukuele nrenya ne anye la le Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle. 15Falasiima ne eza bizale nrenya ne adenle mɔɔ ɔlua zo mɔɔ ɔ nye ne dukuele la. Ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Ɔvale ndɛtɛlɛ ɔyɛle me nye, na menrinzinle la yɛɛ menwunle debie a.”
16Falasiima ne bie mɔ hanle kɛ, “Sonla mɔɔ yɛle ɛhye la ɛnvi Nyamenle ɛkɛ, ɔboalekɛ ɔnli Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle mɛla ne azo.”
Bie mɔ noko hanle kɛ, “Na kɛ ɔkɛyɛ na sonla mɔɔ le ɛtanenli la ayɛ nwanwane gyima mɔɔ le zɛhae ɛ?” Na menli ne lile abunwiɔ.
17Yemɔti Falasiima ne bizale nrenya ne bieko kɛ, “Ɛse ɔdaye yɛɛ ɔdukuele ɛ nye a, ɛnee duzu edwɛkɛ a ɛka ye wɔ ɔ nwo a?”
Ɔbuale kɛ, “Ɔle Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ.”
18Dwuu mgbanyima ne mɔ anlie ando nu kɛ ɛnee ɔle anyenzinliravolɛ yɛɛ bɛdukue ɔ nye a. Yemɔti bɛvɛlɛle ye awovolɛ 19na bɛbizale bɛ kɛ, “Asoo bɛ ra nrenya ne mɔɔ bɛse bɛwole ye la ɛnee ɔ nye ɛzi la ɛne, na kɛ ɔyɛle mɔɔ ɛnɛ ɔnwu debie ɛ?”
20Ye awovolɛ ne buale kɛ, “Yɛmɛ yɛze kɛ yɛ ra nrenya ne ɛne, yɛɛ yɛze kɛ yɛwole ye la ɛnee ɔ nye ɛzi. 21Na yɛnze kɛ ɔyɛle mɔɔ ɛnɛ ɔkola ɔnwu debie a, yɛɛ yɛnze ahenle mɔɔ dukuele ɔ nye a. Ɔdaye yenyi; bɛbiza ye, na ɔkola ɔye ɔ nloa.” 22Ye awovolɛ ne hanle ɛhye, ɔluakɛ bɛsulo Dwuu mgbanyima ne mɔ. Dwuu mgbanyima ne mɔ ɛbɔ kpɔkɛ kɛ awie biala mɔɔ kɛha kɛ Gyisɛse le Mɛzaya la, bɛkɛye ye bɛkɛvi nyianu sua ne anu. 23Ɛhye ati a ye awovolɛ ne hanle kɛ, “Yenyi na bɛbiza ye” la.
24Eza bɛvɛlɛle nrenya ne mɔɔ bɛwole ye anyenzinliravolɛ la bieko na bɛzele ye kɛ, “Nea Nyamenle anyunlu na ka nɔhalɛ ne! Yɛze kɛ nrenya ɛhye mɔɔ dukuele ɛ nye ne la le ɛtanenli.”
25Nrenya ne buale kɛ, “Saa ɔle ɛtanenli o, saa ɔnle ɛtanenli o, menze. Debie ko ala yɛɛ meze a; yemɔ a le kɛ, ɛnee me nye ɛzi, na kɛkala menwu debie.”
26Bɛbizale ye kɛ, “Kɛ ɔzile ɔdukuele ɛ nye ne ɛ?”
27Ɔbuale bɛ kɛ, “Se meha mehile bɛ dɛba, na bɛande. Duzu ati a bɛkpondɛ kɛ meka ye bieko ɛ? anzɛɛ bɛkulo kɛ bɛyɛ ye ɛdoavolɛma ɔ?”
28Bɛbɔle nrenya ne aholoba kɛ, “Wɔmɔ a ɛle ye ɛdoavolɛ a, na yɛmɛ yɛle Mosisi ɛdoavolɛma. 29Yɛze kɛ Nyamenle dendɛle hilele Mosisi; sonla ɛhye, yɛnze ɛleka mɔɔ ɔvi a.”
30Nrenya ne buale kɛ, “Edwɛkɛ ɛzulolɛ kpalɛ! Bɛnze ɛleka mɔɔ ɔvi a, noko yehola yedukue me nye. 31Yɛze kɛ Nyamenle ɛndie ɛtanevolɛma, ɔtie bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛbu ye bie na bɛyɛ mɔɔ ɔkpondɛ kɛ bɛyɛ la. 32Sumunli kɛ aloa bɔle la yɛtɛtele kɛ awie ɛdukue sonla mɔɔ bɛwole ye anyenzinliravolɛ la anye ɛlɛ. 33Saa nrenya ɛhye ɛnvi Nyamenle ɛkɛ ne a, anrɛɛ ɔnrɛhola ɔnrɛli gyima mɔɔ le zɛhae la ɛlɛ.”
34Bɛbuale ye kɛ, “Ɛdawɔ mɔɔ bɛwole wɔ na bɛtetele wɔ wɔ ɛtane nu la, ɛkulo kɛ ɛkilehile yɛmɛ ɔ?” Na bɛvoanle ye bɛvile nyianu sua ne anu.
Sunsum nu anyenzinlira
35Gyisɛse dele kɛ bɛvoa nrenya ne bɛvi nyianu sua ne anu la, ɔkpondɛle ye ɔnwunle ye na ɔbizale ye kɛ, “Asoo ɛdie Sonla Ra ne ɛdi?”
36Nrenya ne buale ye kɛ, “Yɛmenle, na yemɔ a le nwane, amaa mealie ye meali?”
37Gyisɛse zele ye kɛ, “Wɔnwu ye dɛbadɛba, na yemɔ ala a nee wɔ ɛlɛtendɛ la.”
38Nrenya ne zele kɛ, “Awulae, medie medi somaa!” Akee ɔhotole Gyisɛse agyakɛ anu ɛkɛ na ɔzonlenle ye.
39Na Gyisɛse zele ye kɛ, “Membale ewiade kɛ mebabua ndɛne, amaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ nye ɛzi la anwu debie, na bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnwu debie la anye azi.”
40Falasiima bie mɔ mɔɔ ɛnee wɔ ɛkɛ ne la dele mɔɔ ɔhanle la na bɛbizale ye kɛ, “Ɛnee ɛkpondɛ wɔaze kɛ yɛdayɛ noko yɛ nye ɛzi ɔ?”
41Gyisɛse buale kɛ, “Saa bɛ nye ɛzi a, anrɛɛ bɛnli fɔlɛ, na kɛmɔ bɛdabɛ bɛse bɛnwu debie la, bɛ fɔlɛlilɛ doa bɛ.”

Title: DW 10
Content:
Mboaneneavolɛ ne anwo ɛrɛlɛ
1Gyisɛse zele bɛ kɛ, “Meka nɔhalɛ ne meahile bɛ: Awie mɔɔ ɛlɛkɔ mboane tunli ne anu na yeanlua anlenkɛ ne anu, na ɔkɛvo bane ne la le awule, ɔle kɔdiawu. 2Sonla ne mɔɔ fa anlenkɛ ne anu kɔ nuhua la a le mboaneneavolɛ ne a. 3Anlenkɛ sinzavolɛ ne tukue ye anlenkɛ ne; mboane ne mɔ te ɔ ne, ɔfa boane ko biala duma ɔfɛlɛ ye na ɔfa bɛ ɔfinde ɔkɔ adidi. 4Saa ɔfa bɛ ɔfinde a ɔdi bɛ nyunlu na mboane ne adoa ye, ɔluakɛ bɛze ɔ ne. 5Bɛnrɛdoa awie gyɛne biala; bɛnriandi ye, ɔluakɛ bɛnze ɔ ne.” 6Gyisɛse bule ɛrɛlɛ ɛhye, na bɛande mɔɔ ɔlɛka yeahile bɛ la abo.
Gyisɛse a le mboaneneavolɛ kpalɛ ne a
7Yemɔti Gyisɛse hanle ye bieko kɛ, “Meka nɔhalɛ ne meahile bɛ: Mame a mele anlenkɛ ne mɔɔ bɛfa nu bɛkɔ mboane tunli ne anu la. 8Awie mɔ gyɛne mɔɔ lumuale me nyunlu rale la le nwule nee ahɔdiawu, na mboane ne mɔ andie bɛ ne. 9Mame a mele anlenkɛ ne; mɔɔ kɛlua me nwo zo kɛhɔ nu la kɛnyia ngoane mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ. Ɔbawolo nu na yeavinde yeahɔkpondɛ aleɛ. 10Awule sonla biala ba kɛ ɔbawua, yeahu, na yeazɛkye mboane ne mɔ. Mera amaa bɛanyia ngoane, na bɛanyia ye molozo.
11“Mame a mele mboaneneavolɛ kpalɛ ne a. Mboaneneavolɛ kpalɛ ne fa ye ngoane to aze maa ye mboane ne. 12Awie mɔɔ bɛkɛbɔ ye ɛkpa, mɔɔ mboane ne ɛnle ye ɛdeɛ, na ɔnle mboaneneavolɛ kpalɛ la, saa ɔnwu nane kpole anwo ɛzulolɛ bie mɔɔ le kɛ bedi la a, ɔnriandi ɔgyakyi mboane ne mɔ, yemɔti bɛdi ne babɔ mboane ne anu na ɔbɔ bɛ asande. 13Ɛkpanli ne nriandi kɔ, ɔluakɛ yemɔ, bɛbɔle ye ɛkpa ala, mboane ne mɔ edwɛkɛ ɛnyɛ ye edwɛkɛ. 14-15 Mame a mele mboaneneavolɛ kpalɛ ne a. Kɛmɔ Selɛ ne ze me na meze Selɛ ne la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ meze me mboane ne na bɛdabɛ noko bɛze me a; yɛɛ mekponle zolɛ kɛ menwɔwu menwɔmaa bɛ. 16Me mboane ne mɔ bie ɛnle mboane tunli ye anu. Ɔwɔ kɛ mekpondɛ bɛ bo zo; bɛbade me ne, na bɛ muala bɛbayɛ mboane ekpunli ko mɔɔ bɛ neavolɛ ko a.
17“Selɛ ne kulo me, ɔluakɛ mekponle zolɛ kɛ menwɔva me ngoane menwɔdo aze, amaa meazia meava ye bieko. 18Awie ɛngola ɛnye me ngoane. Medame me ngome a mekola megyakyi nu a. Melɛ adenle mekola mefa memaa, yɛɛ melɛ adenle mefa me debie bieko. Mɔɔ Egya ɛhyehyɛ ɛmaa me kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ meyɛ la ɛne.”
19Edwɛkɛ ɛhye manle Dwuuma ne lile abunwiɔ. 20Bɛ nuhua dɔɔnwo hanle kɛ, “Ɔlɛ ayɛne! Ɔlɛsɛ; duzu ati a bɛkɛdie ye ɛ?”
21Bie mɔ noko hanle kɛ “Sonla mɔɔ lɛ ayɛne la ɛnrɛdendɛ kɛmɔ ɔlɛtendɛ la. Kɛ sonla zɛhae si yɛ tukue anyenzinliravolɛma anye ɛ?”
Dwuuma ɛkpo Gyisɛse
22Ɛyɛlɛ mekɛ ne dwule la ɛnee bɛlɛdi Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne Ɛnluanlɛ Ɛvoyia ne wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm. 23Gyisɛse ɛnee lua Sɔlɔmɔn Kpɔda ne abo wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu. 24Dwuuma bɔle yiale ye na bɛbizale ye kɛ, “Na ɛmaa yɛ nye agyinla ahɔdwu kenlenzu? Saa wɔmɔ a ɛle Mɛzaya ne a ɛnee ka ye wienyi kile yɛ.”
25Gyisɛse buale bɛ kɛ, “Meha mehile bɛ dɛba, na bɛanlie me bɛanli, Gyima mɔɔ Egya maa meyɛ la di me daselɛ, 26na bɛnlie bɛnli, ɔboalekɛ bɛmboka me mboane ne anwo. 27Me mboane ne tie me ne; meze bɛ, yɛɛ bɛtoa me bo zo. 28Memaa bɛ ngoane mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ, yemɔti bɛnrɛwu ɛlɛ, yɛɛ awie ɛnrɛhola ɛnrɛlie bɛ ɛnrɛvi me sa nu. 29Egya mɔɔ vale bɛ manle me la le kpole tɛla awie biala, yemɔti awie biala ɛnrɛhola ɛnrɛlie bɛ ɛnrɛvi Egya asa anu. 30Selɛ ne nee medame yɛle ko.”
31Dwuuma ne eza sesale awolɛ kɛ bɛtoto bɛazi ye. 32Gyisɛse bizale bɛ kɛ, “Selɛ ne ɛmaa meli gyima kpalɛ dɔɔnwo memaa bɛ; na nuhua ne boni ati yɛɛ bɛkpondɛ kɛ bɛsi me nwolɛ awolɛ a?”
33 Dwuuma ne buale kɛ, “Yɛnzi wɔ awolɛ kɛ wɔyɛ gyima kpalɛ la ati ɔ, yɛsi wɔ awolɛ kɛ wɔha munzule edwɛkɛ! Ɛle sonla ala, noko ɛlɛyɛ ɛ nwo Nyamenle!”
34 Gyisɛse buale kɛ, “Bɛhɛlɛ ye wɔ bɛdabɛ bɛ mɛla ne anu kɛ Nyamenle se, ‘Bɛdabɛ, bɛle nyamenlema!’ 35Yɛze kɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne ka la le nɔhalɛ dahuu, na saa Nyamenle ɛvɛlɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛhanle ye edwɛkɛ ne bɛhilele bɛ la kɛ bɛle nyamenlema a, 36ɛnee mame mɔɔ Selɛ ne ɛnlea nu ɛye me, na yezoa me wɔ ewiade ye anu la, saa meka kɛ mele Nyamenle Ara a, ɛnee munzule ne mɔɔ mebɔ la a le boni? 37Saa menyɛ Selɛ ne gyima a ɛnee bɛmmadie me bɛdi ɛ! 38Na saa meyɛ Selɛ ne gyima ne na bɛnlie me bɛnli bɔbɔ a, bɛlie me gyima ne bɛdo nu, amaa bɛanwu ye wienyi kɛ Egya de me nu yɛɛ medame mede Egya nu.”
39Bɛyɛle ye bieko kɛ bɛkye ye, na ɔvile bɛ sa.
40 Gyisɛse eza pɛle hɔle Azule Dwɔdan ne anzi lɔ, ɛleka mɔɔ Dwɔn lumuale zɔnenle menli la na ɔdɛnlanle ɛkɛ. 41Menli dɔɔnwo hɔle ɔ nwo ɛkɛ. Bɛse, “Dwɔn anyɛ nwanwane gyima mgbole biala, noko edwɛkɛ biala mɔɔ ɔhanle wɔ nrenya ɛhye anwo la le nɔhalɛ.” 42Na bɛdabɛ dɔɔnwo mɔɔ bɛwɔ ɛkɛ ne la liele ye lile.

Title: DW 11
Content:
Lazalɛse ewule
1 Nrenya bie anwo dole ye wɔ Bɛtani. Bɛfɛlɛ ye Lazalɛse. Mɛle nee ɔ diema raalɛ Maata bɛ sua zo a le Bɛtani. 2 (Mɛle ɛhye a wolale nwole evuanlɛ ne guale Awulae agyakɛ anwo na ɔvale ɔ ti enrinli ɔkyikyile la, yɛɛ ɔ diema nrenya a le Lazalɛse ɛhye mɔɔ ɛnde kpɔkɛ la.) 3Mediema mraalɛ ne mɔ zoanle manle bɛhɔzele Gyisɛse kɛ, “Awulae, ɛ gɔnwo kpalɛ ne ɛnde kpɔkɛ.”
4Mɔɔ Gyisɛse asa hanle nrɛlaleɛ ne la ɔhanle kɛ, “Anwondolɛ ɛhye ɛnrɛmaa Lazalɛse ɛnrɛwu. Nyamenle anyunlunyia ti yɛɛ ɛhye ɛzi a, na ɔbayɛ debie mɔɔ ɔlua zolɛ Nyamenle Ara ne ɔdaye ɔbanyia anyunlunyia a.”
5Gyisɛse kulo Maata nee ɔ diema Mɛle nee Lazalɛse edwɛkɛ kpole. 6Noko mɔɔ ɔdele Lazalɛse anwondolɛ nrɛlaleɛ ne la, ɔzile aze kenle nwiɔ wɔ ɛleka mɔɔ ɔwɔ la. 7Na akee ɔhanle ɔhilele ye ɛdoavolɛma ne kɛ, “Bɛmaa yɛzia yɛ nzi yɛhɔ Dwudiya.”
8Ɛdoavolɛma ne zele ye kɛ, “Kilehilevolɛ, ɔtɛkyɛle biala yɛɛ Dwuuma ne yɛle kɛ bɛsi wɔ awolɛ a; na eza wɔyɛ wɔ adwenle kɛ ɛkɔ lɔ bieko ɔ?”
9Gyisɛse buale bɛ kɛ, “Dɔnehwele bulu nee nwiɔ a wɔ alehyenlɛ ko anu a. Yemɔti saa sonla tudu agyakɛ wɔ alehyenlɛ nu a ɔmkpula, ɔboalekɛ maanle nu le wienyi. 10Na saa ɔtudu agyakɛ wɔ aledwolɛ nu a ɔkpulokpula, ɔboalekɛ awozinli ne ɛmmaa ɔnnwu aze.” 11Gyisɛse hanle ɛhye na ɔvale ɔzɔle zolɛ kɛ, “Yɛ gɔnwo Lazalɛse ɛlafe, na mekɔ meahɔdunwue ye.”
12Ɛdoavolɛma ne buale kɛ, “Awulae, saa yelafe a, ɛnee ɔbadunwue!”
13Gyisɛse ɛnee kpondɛ aze kɛ Lazalɛse ɛwu, na bɛmɛ bɛdwenlenle nafelɛ kpalɛ nwo. 14Yemɔti Gyisɛse hanle ye wienyi hilele bɛ kɛ, “Lazalɛse ɛwu, 15na bɛmɛ ti, ɔyɛ me fɛ kɛ menle lɔ a, amaa bɛalie bɛali. Bɛmaa yɛhɔ ɛleka mɔɔ ɔwɔ la.”
16Tɔmase (mɔɔ eza bɛfɛlɛ ye Nda la) zele ɔ gɔnwo mɔ ɛdoavolɛma ne mɔ kɛ, “Bɛmaa yɛ nee Kilehilevolɛ ne ɛhɔ na saa ewule bɔbɔ a yɛ nee ye ɛhɔwu.”
Gyisɛse a le ewudwazo ne nee ngoane ne a
17Mɔɔ Gyisɛse radwule la, ɔnwunle kɛ Lazalɛse ɛwu, bɛzie ye na yeli kenle nna. 18Bɛtani mɔɔ kɔ Gyɛlusalɛm la le “kilomita” kɛyɛ nsa, 19yemɔti Dwuuma dɔɔnwo ɛra kɛ bɛbakyekye Maata nee ɔ diema Mɛle arɛle wɔ bɛ diema nrenya ne ewule ne anwo.
20Maata dele kɛ Gyisɛse ɛlɛba la, ɔhɔle ɔhɔyiale ye adenle. Mɛle angɔ bie. 21Maata hanle hilele Gyisɛse kɛ, “Awulae, saa ɛwɔ ɛke a, anrɛɛ me diema nrenya ne anwu! 22Na eza meze kɛ, kɛkala bɔbɔ, debie biala mɔɔ ɛkɛbiza Nyamenle la, ɔkɛyɛ ɔkɛmaa wɔ.”
23Gyisɛse zele ye kɛ, “Ɛ diema nrenya ne badwazo ara ngoane nu.”
24Maata buale kɛ, “Meze kɛ ɔbadwazo yeara ngoane nu wɔ mekɛ ne mɔɔ li awieleɛ la anu.”
25Gyisɛse zele ye kɛ, “Mame a mele ewudwazo ne nee ngoane ne a. Mɔɔ kɛlie me kɛli la, saa ɔwu bɔbɔ a ɔkɛnyia ngoane; 26yɛɛ mɔɔ de aze na ɔdie me ɔdi la ɛnrɛwu ɛlɛ. Ɛdie ɛhye ɛdi ɔ?”
27Maata buale kɛ, “Ɛhɛe, Awulae! Medie medi kɛ wɔmɔ a ɛle Mɛzaya ne, Nyamenle Ara ne mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ ba ewiade la.”
Gyisɛse zunle
28Maata hanle ɛhye la, ɔziale ɔhɔle na ɔhɔdule ɔ diema Mɛle azukue kɛ, “Kilehilevolɛ ne ɛra na yebiza wɔ.” 29Mɛle dele la, ɔdwazole na ɔnriandile ɔhɔyiale Gyisɛse. 30(Ɛnee Gyisɛse ɛtɛdwule sua ne azo, na ɔtɛbɔ ɛleka mɔɔ Maata hɔyiale ye la.) 31Dwuuma mɔɔ ɛnee wɔ sua nu ɛkɛ ne ɛlɛkyekye Mɛle arɛle la nwunle kɛ yezi yemaa ɔ nwo zo na ɔlɛnriandi yeahɔ la, bɛdwenlenle kɛ ɔlɛkɔ ɔ diema ne sɛka zo lɔ yeahɔzu. Yemɔti bɛdoale ye.
32Mɛle dwule ɛleka mɔɔ Gyisɛse wɔ na ɔnwunle ye la, ɔdule ɔdɔle ɔ gyakɛ anu na ɔzele kɛ, “Awulae, saa ɛwɔ ɛke a, anrɛɛ me diema nrenya ne anwu.”
33Gyisɛse nwunle kɛ Mɛle ɛlɛsi azu, na Dwuuma mɔɔ nee ye ɛra la ɛlɛsu la, nyane kpole hanle ye manle alɔbɔlɛ hunle ye. 34Ɔbizale bɛ kɛ, “Nienwu a bɛdole ye a?”
Bɛzele ye kɛ, “Awulae, bɛla banlea.”
35Gyisɛse zunle. 36Yemɔti menli mɔɔ wɔ ɛkɛ ne la hanle kɛ, “Nea, amgba ɔkulo ye edwɛkɛ kpalɛ!”
37Na bie mɔ hanle kɛ, “Se anrɛɛ ɔtukuedukue anyenzinliravolɛma anye o! Duzu ati a yeanlie Lazalɛse yeanvi ewule nu a?”
Gyisɛse dwazo Lazalɛse ara ngoane nu
38Gyisɛse lile nyane kpole bieko na ɔhɔle nla ne anwo. Nla ne le bolɛ bɔne yɛɛ bɛvale bolɛ bɛnyinle ɔ nloa. 39Gyisɛse zele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛye bolɛ ne!”
Maata, mɔɔ le nrenya ne mɔɔ ɛwu la adiema raalɛ ne zele kɛ, “Awulae, yebɔ! Bɛziele ye la ɛnɛ le kenle nna!”
40Gyisɛse zele ye kɛ, “Metɛkanle metɛkilele wɔ kɛ saa ɛdie ɛdi a ɛkɛnwu kɛ Nyamenle anyunlunyia ne si de la ɔ?” 41Bɛhundole bolɛ ne bɛyele ye ɛkɛ. Gyisɛse nleanle anwuma na ɔhanle kɛ, “Egya, meyɛ wɔ mo somaa kɛ wɔdie me a. 42Meze kɛ dahuu ɛtie me edwɛkɛ, na melɛka ɛhye wɔ menli mɔɔ kɛkala wɔ ɛke la ati, amaa bɛalie bɛali kɛ ɛdawɔ a ɛzoanle me a.” 43Ɔhanle ɛhye la, ɔdeanle nu kpole ɔzele kɛ, “Lazalɛse, dwazo bɛla!” 44Nrenya ne mɔɔ ɛwu la vindele rale, na ndanlɛ mɔɔ bɛvale bɛkyekyele ye funli ne la kyekye ɔ sa, ɔ gyakɛ nee ɔ da. Gyisɛse zele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛzianyizianyi ye na bɛmaa ɔhɔ.”
Gyisɛse ati akpamohɔlɛ
(Mat 26.1-5; Mak 14.1-2; Luk 22.1-2)
45Dwuuma dɔɔnwo mɔɔ rale Mɛle ɛkpɔlalɛ la nwunle mɔɔ Gyisɛse ɛyɛ la, na bɛliele ye bɛlile. 46Na bie mɔ ziale hɔle Falasiima ɛkɛ ne na bɛhɔhanle mɔɔ Gyisɛse ɛyɛ la bɛhilele bɛ. 47Yemɔti Falasiima ne nee sɛlɛvolɛ mgbanyima ne mɔ yiale Ayiama ne na bɛhanle kɛ, “Duzu bɔbɔ yɛɛ akee yɛyɛ a? Nea nwanwane gyima mɔɔ akee nrenya ne ɛlɛyɛ la! 48Saa yɛmaa ɔkɔ zolɛ ɔyɛ a, awie biala balie ye ali, na Wulomu arane ne bava ɛya na yearazɛkye yɛ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ye nee yɛ maanle ye amuala.”
49Ɛvolɛ ne anu Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli ne, mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Kayafase la zele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛdabɛ, bɛnze ɛhwee! 50Yemɔti bɛnze kɛ ɔle kpalɛ kɛ sonla ko kɛwu kɛmaa maanle ne tɛla kɛ yɛ maanle ne amuala kɛbɔ ɔ?” 51Nɔhalɛ, ɔ nye ɛnla nwo yɛɛ ɔhanle ɛhye a, na kɛmɔ yemɔ a ɛvolɛ ne anu ɔle Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli la, ɛnee ɔlɛka mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛye ɛhile ye la kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ Gyisɛse wu maa Dwuuma amuala, 52yɛɛ tɛ Dwuuma angome bɔbɔ, na kɛ ɔkɛva Nyamenle amra mɔɔ ɛde ɛkponde ewiade amuala la kɔsɔɔti ɔkarabɔ nu ɔkɛyɛ bɛ menli ko.
53Ɔvi kenle ko zɔhane, Dwuu mgbanyima ne mɔ yɛle ngyehyɛlɛ kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛku Gyisɛse. 54Yemɔti Gyisɛse anye ɔ nwo anlua Dwudiya maanzinli ne anu, na ɔvile ɛkɛ ne ɔhɔle ɛleka bie mɔɔ bikye ɛsɛlɛ ne azo la, wɔ sua bie mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Yifelaem la azo; ɛkɛ ne yɛɛ ɔ nee ye ɛdoavolɛma ne dɛnlanle a.
55Dwuuma Akpabɛnwo Ɛvoyia ne ɛbikye, na menli dɔɔnwo vi namunamu ne mɔ azo ɛra Gyɛlusalɛm kɛ bɛbanlua bɛ nwo kolaa na ɛvoyia ne adwu. 56Mekɛ ne anu ɛnee bɛlɛkpondɛ Gyisɛse, yemɔti mɔɔ bɛyiale Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu la, bɛbizebizale bɛ nwo kɛ, “Kɛ ɔde ɛ? Asoo ɔkɛhola ɛvoyia ye bie ba ɔ?” 57Sɛlɛvolɛ mgbanyima ne nee Falasiima ɛva ɛdo gua kɛ saa awie biala ze ɛleka mɔɔ Gyisɛse vea la a, ɔraha, amaa bɛahɔhye ye.

Title: DW 12
Content:
Bɛkpokpa Gyisɛse nwole wɔ Bɛtani
(Mat 26.6-13; Mak 14.3-9)
1Mɔɔ ɔhale kenle nsia na Akpabɛnwo Ɛvoyia ne adwu la, Gyisɛse hɔle Bɛtani. Bɛtani a Lazalɛse vi a. Lazalɛse ɛhye a wule mɔɔ Gyisɛse dunwuele ye la. 2Bɛdole Gyisɛse ɛkponle wɔ ɛkɛ ne, na Maata boka bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛzonlenle la anwo, yɛɛ Lazalɛse noko nee Gyisɛse a de ɛkponle ne anwo a. 3 Mɛle vale nwole evuanlɛ bie mɔɔ ye bolɛ yɛ se kpalɛ na bɛfɛlɛ ye “naade” la toba kpole ko mɔɔ kɛyɛ litili ko la rawolale guale Gyisɛse agyakɛ anwo, na ɔvale ɔ ti enrinli ɔkyikyile. Nwole ne evuanlɛ vale sua ne anu amuala. 4Gyisɛse ɛdoavolɛma ne anu ko, mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Dwudase Yesekaleɔto mɔɔ yele Gyisɛse manle la hanle kɛ, 5“Duzu ati a bɛandɔne nwole ye kɛyɛ dwɛtɛ fufule ɛya nsa na bɛanva ezukoa ne bɛamboa ehyianvolɛma ɛ?” 6Tɛ kɛ asɛɛ ɔdwenle ehyianvolɛma anwo somaa la ati a ɔhanle ɛhye a, na ɔle awule, eza kɛmɔ ɔdaye a ɔsie bɛ gya ne la, ɔyɛ a ɔto ɔ sa nu.
7Na Gyisɛse zele kɛ, “Bɛgyakyi raalɛ ne! Me ɛzielɛ ti a yeyɛ ɛhye a. 8 Bɛmɛ bɛ nee ehyianvolɛma de dahuu, na mame bɛ nee me ɛnrɛdɛnla dahuu.”
Lazalɛse ati akpamohɔlɛ
9Dwuuma dɔɔnwo kpalɛ dele kɛ Gyisɛse wɔ Bɛtani la, bɛhɔle ɛkɛ ne. Tɛ Gyisɛse angome ati a bɛhɔle a, na eza bɛhɔle kɛ bɛkanlea Lazalɛse mɔɔ Gyisɛse dwazole ye vile ewule nu la. 10Zɔhane ati sɛlɛvolɛ mgbanyinli ne mɔ vale adwenle kɛ bɛku Lazalɛse noko, 11ɔluakɛ ɔdaye ɔ ti yɛɛ Dwuuma dɔɔnwo ɛlɛgyakyi bɛ mgbanyima dɛba ne anzi ɛlilɛ na bɛalie Gyisɛse bɛali a.
Gyisɛse kɔ Gyɛlusalɛm konimlilɛ nu
(Mat 21.1-11; Mak 11.1-11; Luk 19.28-40)
12Aleɛ hyenle la menli dɔɔnwo mɔɔ rale Akpabɛnwo Ɛvoyia ne ɛlilɛ ne bie la dele kɛ Gyisɛse ɛlɛba Gyɛlusalɛm. 13 Yemɔti bɛvale mrɛlakɛ bɛhɔyiale ye adenle, bɛdeɛdeanle nu kɛ, “Bɛye Nyamenle ayɛlɛ! Nyamenle ɛyila mɔɔ lua Awulae duma nu ɛlɛba la! Nyamenle ɛyila Yizilayɛ belemgbunli ne!”
14Gyisɛse dɛnlanle asoaso zo, kɛmɔ Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se la. Ɔse,
15 “Suakpole Zayɔn, mmasulo!
Wɔ belemgbunli ne de asoaso zo ɛlɛba.”
16Mekɛ ne anu ye ɛdoavolɛma ne ande ɛhye abo; na mɔɔ bɛdwazole Gyisɛse anyunlunyia nu bɛvile ewule nu la, bɛhakyele kɛ Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne ɛha ɛhye wɔ ɔ nwo, na bɛmɛ yɛɛ bɛyɛle ɛhye bɛmanle ye a.
17Menli mɔɔ ɛnee wɔ ɛkɛ ne a Gyisɛse vɛlɛle Lazalɛse vile ye nla ne anu, na ɔdwazole ye ɔvile ewule nu la hɔhanle mɔɔ bɛnwunle ye la. 18Ɛhye ati menli dɔɔnwo rayiale ye adenle, ɔboalekɛ bɛdele kɛ ɔdaye a yeyɛ nwanwane sɛkɛlɛneɛ mɔɔ le zɛhae la a. 19Na Falasiima ne hanle hilele bɛ nwo kɛ, “Bɛnwu kɛ yɛangola ɛhwee yɛ ɛ! Nea kɛ ewiade amuala ɛdu doa ye ɛ!”
Gilikima bie kpondɛ Gyisɛse
20Gilikima bie boka menli mɔɔ hɔle Gyɛlusalɛm kɛ bɛkazonle la anwo wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛdi ɛvoyia ne la. 21Bɛrale Felepe anwo ɛkɛ ne na bɛzele ye kɛ, “Yɛmenle, yɛkulo kɛ yɛnwu Gyisɛse.” (Felepe vi Bɛteseeyeda mɔɔ wɔ Galeli maanzinli nu la.)
22Felepe hɔhanle hilele Andelu, na bɛ mu nwiɔ bɛhɔhanle bɛhilele Gyisɛse. 23Gyisɛse buale kɛ, “Mekɛ akee ɛdwu kɛ bɛkɛwula medame Sonla Ra anyunlunyia kpole a. 24Meka nɔhalɛ ne meahile bɛ: Abɛlɛ ma ko anwo ɛnrɛzo dɔɔnwo kyesɛ bɛdua na ɔkpɔlɔ. Saa ɔkpɔlɔ a, ɔfifi na ɔso ma dɔɔnwo. 25 Mɔɔ ye ngoane hyia ye la baminli ye, na mɔɔ ye ngoane ɛngyia ye wɔ ewiade ɛhye anu la banyia ngoane mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ. 26Awie mɔɔ kpondɛ kɛ ɔsonle me la ɔwɔ kɛ toa me bo zo, amaa ɛleka mɔɔ mewɔ la, me sonvolɛ ne ɔdaye yeara ɛkɛ ne, yɛɛ Egya bawula mɔɔ sonle me la anyunlunyia.
Gyisɛse ka ye ewule nwo edwɛkɛ
27“Nyane ɛha me kpole; na duzu edwɛkɛ a menga a? Asoo menga ye kɛ, ‘Egya, mmamaa mekɛ zɔhane to me’ ɔ? Kyɛkyɛ, ɛhye ala ati a membale a; membale kɛ meba mearazɔ nyane sa wɔ zɔhane mekɛ ne anu. 28Egya, maa anyunlunyia ɛha wɔ duma ne.”
Ɔhanle ɛhye la, ɛnelɛ bie vi anwuma zele kɛ, “Mewula ye anyunlunyia dɛba, na mebawula ye bieko.”
29Ɛlɔne mɔɔ gyi ɛkɛ ne la dele ɛnelɛ ne na bɛhanle kɛ, “Ɔhulule kɛ ezule!” Bie mɔ noko hanle kɛ, “Nyamenle soanvolɛ ɛdendɛ ɛhile ye!”
30Na Gyisɛse zele bɛ kɛ, “Tɛ me ti a ɛnelɛ ɛhye rale a, na bɛdabɛ bɛ ti ɔ. 31Mekɛ ɛdwu mɔɔ akee ɔwɔ kɛ bɛbua ewiade ndɛne a; akee bɛbadu Seetan mɔɔ sie ɛtane ewiade ɛhye la bɛavi ɛkɛ. 32Na mame, saa bɛmaa me zo wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo a, mebahwe menli kɔsɔɔti meamaa me nwo.” 33(Ɔhanle ɛhye ɔvale ɔhilele ewule holɛ ko mɔɔ ɔbawu la.)
34 Ɛlɔne ne bizale ye kɛ, “Yɛ mɛla ne ka kile yɛ kɛ Mɛzaya ne ɛnrɛwu ɛlɛ. Na duzu ati a ɛse ɔwɔ kɛ bɛmaa Sonla Ra ne zo a? Nwane a le Sonla Ra ɛhye?”
35Gyisɛse buale kɛ, “Wienyi ne nee bɛ badɛnla mekɛ ekyi. Yemɔti bɛva wienyi ne bɛhɔdwu, amaa awozinli anva bɛ, ɔluakɛ mɔɔ dua awozinli nu la ɛnnwu ɛleka mɔɔ ɔlɛkɔ la. 36Zɔhane ati bɛlie wienyi ne bɛli wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɔ nee bɛ de la, amaa bɛayɛ wienyi nu menli.”
Dwuuma ɛnlie ɛnli
Gyisɛse hanle ɛhye la, ɔhɔveale. 37Ɔluakɛ yeyɛ nwanwane sɛkɛlɛneɛ dɔɔnwo ɛhye mɔ yemaa bɛnwu bɛ ɛdeɛ, noko bɛanlie ye bɛanli, 38 amaa mɔɔ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ Ayezaya hanle la ayɛ nɔhalɛ kɛ,
“Awulae, na awie liele wɔ edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ yɛhanle
la lile ɔ?
Na Awulae yele ye tumi ne hilele awie ɔ?”
39Yemɔti bɛangola bɛanlie Gyisɛse bɛanli, ɔboalekɛ Ayezaya eza hanle kɛ,
40 “Nyamenle ɛzi bɛ nye na yemaa bɛsolo,
amaa bɛ nye annwu debie na bɛ nzo ade edwɛkɛ,
na bɛahakyi bɛara me nwo kɛ menyɛ bɛ ayile.”
41Ayezaya hanle ɛhye, ɔluakɛ ɔnwunle Gyisɛse anyunlunyia ne dɛba yɛɛ ɔhanle ɔ nwo edwɛkɛ a.
42Noko bɔbɔ, Dwuu mgbanyima ne mɔ anu dɔɔnwo liele Gyisɛse lile; na Falasiima ati bɛangola nwolɛ edwɛkɛ ka bagua nu anrɛɛ bɛkɛye bɛ ali bɛkɛvi nyianu sua ne anu. 43Bɛkulo menli nganvolɛ bɛtɛla Nyamenle nganvolɛ.
Gyisɛse anloa edwɛkɛ bua ndɛne
44Gyisɛse manle ɔ ne zo hanle kɛ, “Sonla mɔɔ die me di la ɛnlie me ngome ɛnli na ɔdie mɔɔ zoanle me la noko ɔdi. 45Mɔɔ ɛnwu me la ɛnwu mɔɔ zoanle me la. 46Mera kɛ mame a mele ewiade wienyi ne a, amaa mɔɔ kɛlie me kɛli la anga awozinli nu. 47Sonla mɔɔ kɛde me edwɛkɛ ne na yeanli zolɛ la, menrɛbua ye ewule fɔlɛ. Meamba kɛ mebabua ewiade ewule fɔlɛ; membale kɛ mebalie ye. 48Na mɔɔ kɛkpo me na yeanlie me edwɛkɛ ne la lɛ mɔɔ babua ye ewule fɔlɛ a. Edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ meha la yɛɛ babua ye ewule fɔlɛ wɔ mekɛ ne mɔɔ li awieleɛ la a. 49Ɔle zɔhane, ɔboalekɛ tɛ medame me tumi zo a medua metendɛ a. Selɛ ne mɔɔ zoanle me la a kile me mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ meka la a; 50yɛɛ meze kɛ ye edwɛkɛ ne maa sonla ngoane mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ. Yemɔti mɔɔ Selɛ ne ɛha ɛhile me la, yemɔ yɛɛ meka a.”

Title: DW 13
Content:
Gyisɛse nrinzi ye ɛdoavolɛma agyakɛ anwo
1Gyisɛse nwunle kɛ akee mekɛ ɛdwu mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ ɔfi ewiade ɛhye anu na ɔkɔ Selɛ ne anwo lɔ a. Mekɛ ne anu ɛnee aleɛ kye a bɛkɛli Akpabɛnwo Ɛvoyia ne. Yehulo bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛle ye ɛdeɛ wɔ ewiade ye anu la dahuu, yɛɛ yehulo bɛ yehɔ awieleɛ.
2Gyisɛse nee ye ɛdoavolɛma ne dɛnlanle aze nɔsolɛ nu kɛ bɛdi debie. Abɔnsam noko ɛbɔ kpɔkɛ ɛwie kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ Dwudase, Saemɔn Yesekaleɔto ara ne ye Gyisɛse maa. 3Gyisɛse ze kɛ Selɛ ne ɛmaa ye tumi bɔkɔɔ; ɔze kɛ ɔdaye Gyisɛse, ɔvi Nyamenle anwo lɔ a ɔrale a na eza ɔbazia yeahɔ Nyamenle anwo lɔ. 4Yemɔti ɔvile ɛkponle ne anwo ɔdwazole, ɔkpale ɔguale, na ɔvale tohulu ɔpɛle ɔ bo. 5Akee ɔvale nzule ɔguale kyɛnze kpole bie anu na ɔbɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɔnrinzi ye ɛdoavolɛma ne agyakɛ anwo. Ɔnrinzi ɔwie a ɛnee yeva tohulu ne mɔɔ pɛ ɔ bo la yekyikyi. 6Ɔradwule Saemɔn Pita anwo zo la, Pita bizale Gyisɛse kɛ, “Awulae, na akee wɔmɔ yɛɛ ɛnrinzi me gyakɛ anwo a?”
7Gyisɛse buale ye kɛ, “Ɛnrɛde mɔɔ melɛyɛ la abo kɛkala, na nzinlii ɛbade ɔ bo.”
8Pita zele ye kɛ, “Menrɛmaa ɛnrɛnrinzi me gyakɛ anwo kenle bie maanle nu!”
Gyisɛse buale ye kɛ, “Saa meanrinzi ɛ gyakɛ anwo a ɛnee ɛnle me ɛdoavolɛ bieko.”
9Saemɔn Pita zele ye kɛ, “Awulae, ɛnee noko mmanrinzi me gyakɛ anwo ala! Nrinzi me sa anwo nee me ti zo amuala noko!”
10Gyisɛse zele ye kɛ, “Mɔɔ ɛbia la anwo le bɔkɔbɔkɔ na ɔngyia kɛ ɔkɛbia bieko. Debie mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ ɔyɛ la a le kɛ ɔnrinzi ɔ gyakɛ anwo ala. Bɛ muala bɛ nwo le bɔkɔbɔkɔ. Sonla ko ala yɛɛ anwo ɛnle bɔkɔbɔkɔ a.” 11Ɛnee Gyisɛse ze sonla mɔɔ baye ye amaa la, ɛhye ati a ɔhanle kɛ, “Bɛ muala bɛ nwo le bɔkɔbɔkɔ, sonla ko ala a anwo ɛnle bɔkɔbɔkɔ a.”
12 Gyisɛse wiele bɛ gyakɛ anwo nrinzi la, ɔwulale ye tɛladeɛ ne na ɔziale ɔhɔdɛnlanle ɔ bo zo ne wɔ ɛkponle ne anwo, na ɔbizale bɛ kɛ, “Asoo bɛte mɔɔ meyɛ ye kɛkala la abo? 13Bɛfɛlɛ me Kilehilevolɛ nee Awulae, na ɔle kpalɛ kɛ bɛkɛvɛlɛ me zɔhane a, ɔluakɛ mele zɔhane. 14Mele bɛ Awulae nee bɛ Kilehilevolɛ, noko menrinzinrinzi bɛ gyakɛ anwo. Bɛdabɛ noko bɛnrinzinrinzi bɛ gyakɛ anwo ngoko ngoko. 15Meyɛ ndonwo ɛhye mehile bɛ, amaa bɛdabɛ noko bɛayɛ ye zɔhane ala. 16 Meka nɔhalɛ meahile bɛ: Akɛlɛ biala ɛnle kpole ɛndɛla ɔ menle; soanvolɛ biala ɛnle kpole ɛndɛla ahenle mɔɔ zoanle ye la, 17Kɛkala mɔɔ bɛnwu nɔhalɛ ɛhye la, saa bɛfa bɛyɛ gyima a bɛkɛli fɛlɛko kpole!
18 “Tɛ bɛ muala bɛ nwo edwɛkɛ a melɛka a; meze mɔɔ mekpa nu meye bɛ la. Na Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ se, ‘Sonla ne mɔɔ nee me di nee me no la hakyile ɔ nzi zile me’ la ɔwɔ kɛ yɛ zɔhane. 19Meka ɛhye meahile bɛ kɛkala kolaa na yeazi, amaa saa ɔsi a, bɛalie bɛali kɛ ‘Medame a le Medame’, 20 Meka nɔhalɛ ne meahile bɛ: Awie mɔɔ kɛlie awie biala mɔɔ menwɔzoa ye la ɛlie medame noko, yɛɛ mɔɔ kɛlie me la ɛlie ahenle mɔɔ zoanle me la.”
Gyisɛse se bɛbaye ye bɛamaa
(Mat 26.20-25; Mak 14.17-21; Luk 22.21-23)
21Gyisɛse hanle ɛhye la, ɛnee akee nyane ɛha ye kpole kpalɛ, na ɔhanle ɔdole gua kɛ, “Meka nɔhalɛ ne meahile bɛ: Bɛdabɛ, bɛ nuhua ko baye me amaa.”
22Ɛhye yɛle ɛdoavolɛma ne azibɛnwo kpole na bɛnleɛnleanle bɛ nyunlu. 23Ɛnee ɛdoavolɛ ne mɔɔ Gyisɛse kulo ye edwɛkɛ la de Gyisɛse anwo ɛkɛ ne. 24Yemɔti Saemɔn Pita bɔle ɔ nye hilele ye kɛ, “Biza ye ahenle mɔɔ ɔlɛka ɔ nwo edwɛkɛ la.”
25Ɛdoavolɛ ne hwenle bikyele Gyisɛse na ɔbizale ye kɛ, “Awulae, ɛnee nwane ɔ?”
26Gyisɛse buale kɛ, “Saa mebu kpanwo ne mebɔ subue ne anu na mɔɔ menwɔva menwɔmaa ye la, yemɔ ɔ.” Yemɔti Gyisɛse bule kpanwo ne ekyi, ɔvale ɔbɔle subue ne anu na ɔvale ɔmanle Dwudase, Saemɔn Yesekaleɔto ara ne. 27Dwudase liele kpanwo ne la yɛɛ Seetan wolole ye a. Gyisɛse zele ye kɛ, “Ka ɛ nwo yɛ mɔɔ ɛyɛ la.” 28Awie biala mɔɔ de ɛkponle ne anwo la ande mɔɔ Gyisɛse hanle hilele Dwudase la abo. 29Kɛmɔ Dwudase a ɛnee nea bɛ gya zo la ati, ɛdoavolɛma ne bie mɔ dwenlenle kɛ Gyisɛse ɛzoa ye kɛ ɔhɔtotɔ ninyɛne mɔɔ bɛbahyia nwolɛ wɔ ɛvoyia ne ɛlilɛ nu la, anzɛɛ yeha yehile ye kɛ ɔva debie ɔhɔmaa ehyianvolɛma.
30Dwudase liele kpanwo ne la, ndɛndɛ ne ala ɔvindele; na ɛnee aleɛ ɛdwo.
Mɛla fofolɛ ne
