31Dwudase vindele la, Gyisɛse hanle kɛ, “Akee bɔ zo mɔɔ medame Sonla Ra, me anyunlunyia ne ɛla ali a; bɛbalua me nwo zo bɛaye Nyamenle anyunlunyia ne bɛahile. 32Na saa bɛdua me nwo zo bɛye Nyamenle anyunlunyia ne bɛkile a, Nyamenle ɔdaye ɔbaye medame Sonla Ra ne noko, me anyunlunyia ne yeahile, na ɔbayɛ ɛhye ndɛndɛ ne ala. 33 Me mra, me nee bɛ ɛnrɛdɛnla ɛnrɛhyɛ. Bɛbakpondɛ me, na mɔɔ menganle mengilele Dwuu mgbanyima ne mɔ la yɛɛ meka meahile bɛdabɛ noko a. ‘Bɛnrɛhola ɛleka mɔɔ melɛkɔ la kɔ’. 34 Memaa bɛ mɛla fofolɛ: Bɛhulo bɛ nwo ngoko ngoko. Kɛ mezi mehulo bɛ la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ bɛhulo bɛ nwo ngoko ngoko a. 35Saa bɛkulo bɛ nwo ngoko ngoko a yɛɛ awie biala kɛnwu kɛ bɛle me ɛdoavolɛma a.”
Gyisɛse se Pita bakpo ye
(Mat 26.31-35; Mak 14.27-31; Luk 22.31-34)
36Saemɔn Pita bizale ye kɛ, “Awulae, na nienwu a ɛkɔ a?”
Gyisɛse buale ye kɛ, “Kɛkala, ɛleka mɔɔ melɛkɔ la, ɛnrɛhola me toa, na nzinlii ɛbadoa me lɔ.”
37Pita bizale ye kɛ, “Awulae, duzu ati a menrɛhola wɔ toa kɛkala ɛ? Meziezie me nwo kɛ saa ewule bɔbɔ a menwɔwu menwɔmaa wɔ.”
38Gyisɛse buale ye kɛ, “Amgba wɔboɔboa ɛ nwo kɛ ɛkɛwu ɛkɛmaa me ɔ? Meka nɔhalɛ ne meahile wɔ: Akɔlɛ kabɔ la ɛnee wɔha ye fane nsa kɛ ɛnze me.”

Title: DW 14
Content:
Gyisɛse a le adenle ne mɔɔ kɔ Selɛ ne anwo lɔ la
1Gyisɛse zele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛmmamaa bɛ rɛle bɔ na bɛdi nyane. Bɛlie Nyamenle bɛli na bɛlie medame noko bɛli. 2Egya awuke nu ɛkɛ ne, azua ngome; mekɔ meahɔziezie ɛleka meamaa bɛ. Saa ɔnle zɔhane a anrɛɛ menrɛha menrɛhile bɛ. 3Saa mekɔ na mesiezie ɛleka memaa bɛ a, mebara bieko na mearava bɛ meahɔ me nwo lɔ, amaa bɛadɛnla ɛleka mɔɔ mewɔ la. 4Bɛdabɛ bɛze adenle ne mɔɔ kɔ ɛleka mɔɔ melɛkɔ la.”
5Tɔmase bizale ye kɛ, “Awulae, yɛnze ɛleka mɔɔ ɛlɛkɔ la; na kɛ ɔkɛyɛ na yɛanwu adenle ne mɔɔ kɔ ɛkɛ ne la ɛ?”
6Gyisɛse buale ye kɛ, “Mame a mele adenle ne, nɔhalɛ ne, nee ngoane ne a; awie biala ɛnrɛhola Selɛ ne ɛkɛ ne kɔ kyesɛ ɔdua me nwo zo.” 7Ɔvale ɔzɔle zo kɛ, “Saa bɛze me a anrɛɛ bɛze Egya noko, yɛɛ ɔvi ɛnɛ mɔɔ kɔ la, bɛnwu ye yɛɛ bɛze ye.”
8Felepe hanle kɛ, “Awulae, kile yɛ Selɛ ne; mɔɔ yɛkpondɛ la ala ɛne.”
9Gyisɛse buale ye kɛ, “Felepe, yemɔti mekɛ tendenle ye mɔɔ me nee bɛ muala ɛdɛnla la bɛnze me? Awie mɔɔ ɛnwu me la ɛnwu Selɛ ne. Duzu ati a akee ɛbiza me kɛ, ‘Kile yɛ Selɛ ne ɛ?’ 10Felepe, na ɛnlie ɛnli kɛ mede Selɛ ne nu yɛɛ Selɛ ne de me nu ɔ?” Gyisɛse akee hanle hilele ye ɛdoavolɛma ne amuala kɛ, “Edwɛkɛ mɔɔ meha mehile bɛ la ɛnle me ti anwo edwɛkɛ. Selɛ ne mɔɔ de me nu la a yɛ ye gyima a. 11Bɛlie me bɛli kɛ mede Selɛ ne nu yɛɛ Selɛ ne de me nu. Saa tɛ ye zɔhane a, ɛnee gyima mɔɔ meyɛ la ati, bɛlie me bɛli. 12Meka nɔhalɛ ne meahile bɛ: Awie mɔɔ kɛlie me kɛli la kɛyɛ gyima mɔɔ meyɛ la bie, yɛɛ ɔbayɛ mɔɔ tɛla ɛhye mɔ la bɔbɔ, ɔluakɛ melɛkɔ Selɛ ne anwo lɔ, 13yɛɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛbiza ye biala wɔ me duma nu la, mebayɛ, amaa bɛalua Ralɛ ne anwo zo bɛaye Selɛ ne anyunlunyia bɛahile. 14Saa bɛbiza debie biala wɔ me duma nu a, mebayɛ.
Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne anwo ɛwɔkɛ
15“Saa bɛkulo me a, bɛbali me mɛla ne mɔ azo. 16Mebabiza Selɛ ne meamaa yeamaa bɛ Boavolɛ fofolɛ, na ɔ nee bɛ aradɛnla dahuu. 17Boavolɛ zɔhane, yemɔ a le Sunsum ne mɔɔ baye nɔhalɛ ne mɔɔ fane Nyamenle anwo la ahile bɛ la. Ewiade ɛnrɛhola ɛnrɛlie ye, ɔboalekɛ ɔnrɛnwu ye yɛɛ ɔnze ye. Na bɛmɛ bɛze ye, ɔluakɛ ɔ nee bɛ a de a yɛɛ ɔde bɛ nu.
18“Saa mekɔ a, menrɛgyakyi bɛ nrisa; mebara bɛ nwo bieko. 19Ɔnrɛhyɛ biala ɛnee ewiade ɛnnwu me bieko, na bɛmɛ, bɛbanwu me, na kɛmɔ mede ngoane nu la, bɛdabɛ noko bɛbadɛnla ngoane nu. 20Saa mekɛ zɔhane dwu a bɛkɛnwu kɛ mede Egya nu na bɛdabɛ noko bɛde me nu, na medame mede bɛ nu la.
21“Awie biala mɔɔ kɛlie me mɛla ne mɔ na ɔkɛli zolɛ la, yemɔ a kulo me a. Egya bahulo awie biala mɔɔ kulo me la, na medame noko mebahulo ye na meaye me nwo meahile ye.”
22Dwudase (tɛ Dwudase Yesekaleɔto ɔ) bizale ye kɛ, “Awulae, duzu ati a ɛye ɛ nwo wɔahile yɛ na ɛnrɛye ɛ nwo ɛnrɛhile ewiade ɛ?”
23Gyisɛse buale ye kɛ, “Awie biala mɔɔ kulo me la bali me ngilehilelɛ zo. Egya bahulo ye, na me nee Egya yɛbara ɔ nwo ɛkɛ yɛ nee ye aradɛnla. 24Mɔɔ ɛngulo me la ɛnli me ngilehilelɛ zo. Edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ bɛde la ɛnvi me ɛkɛ ne, ɔvi Selɛ ne mɔɔ zoanle me la ɛkɛ.
25“Mekɛ mɔɔ me nee bɛ de ala ye yɛɛ meha ɛhye mehile bɛ la o! 26Boavolɛ ne, mɔɔ le Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne, mɔɔ Selɛ ne bazoa ye wɔ me duma nu la, barahilehile bɛ debie biala, na yeamaa bɛahakye mɔɔ meha mehile bɛ la amuala.
27“Anzonudwolɛ a mefa megyakyi bɛ a; medame me anzonudwolɛ a mefa megyakyi bɛ a. Menva memmaa bɛ kɛmɔ ewiade fa maa la. Bɛmmamaa bɛ rɛle bɔ na bɛdi nyane; bɛmmasulo noko. 28Bɛdele kɛ meha kɛ, ‘Melɛkɔ na mebara bieko.’ Saa bɛhulole me a, anrɛɛ bɛ nye ɛlie kɛ melɛkɔ Selɛ ne anwo lɔ a, ɔboalekɛ yemɔ, ɔle kpole ɔtɛla me. 29Kɛkala meha ɛhye mehile bɛ, kolaa na yeazi, amaa saa ɔsi a, bɛalie bɛali. 30Menrɛhola me nee bɛ ɛnrɛdendɛ ɛnrɛhyɛ dɔɔnwo biala, ɔboalekɛ mɔɔ sie ɛtane ewiade ɛhye la ɛlɛba. Ɔnlɛ me nwo zo tumi ɛdeɛ, 31noko ɔwɔ kɛ ewiade nwu kɛ mekulo Selɛ ne; yemɔti meyɛ debie biala mɔɔ ɔkɛze me la.
“Bɛdwazo bɛmaa yɛhɔ.”

Title: DW 15
Content:
Gyisɛse a le vanye baka kpalɛ ne a
1“Mame a mele vanye baka kpalɛ ne a, yɛɛ Egya a le tola ne amenle a. 2Me sa ngane biala mɔɔ ɛnzo ma la, ɔkpane ye ɔto, na ɔsiezie ngane ne mɔ mɔɔ so ma la, amaa bɛazo ma dɔɔnwo. 3Ngilehilelɛ mɔɔ meva memaa bɛ la ɛziezie bɛ ɛwie. 4Bɛhɔ zolɛ bɛdɛnla me nu, na medame mendɛnla bɛ nu. Baka ɛhane ngome ɛngola ɛnzo ma; saa ɔwɔ vanye baka ne anwo a yɛɛ ɔso ma a. Zɔhane ala yɛɛ bɛdabɛ noko bɛnrɛhola bɛnrɛyɛ Nyamenle ɛhulolɛdeɛ ne a, kyesɛ bɛmeta me nwo kɛ baka ngane la.
5“Mame a mele vanye baka ne a, yɛɛ bɛmɛ a bɛle ye ngane ne mɔ a. Mɔɔ kɛdɛnla me nu na menwɔdɛnla ye nu la bazo ma dɔɔnwo; ɔluakɛ saa menle nu a bɛ ngome bɛnrɛhola ɛhwee yɛ. 6Awie biala mɔɔ andɛnla me nu la bɛfuandi ye bɛto kɛ baka ɛhane mɔɔ bɛpɛ la; ɔwe na ɔkyengye. Mbaka ngane mɔɔ le zɛhae la, bɛboɔboa bɛ nloa na bɛfuandi bɛ bɛgua senle nu bɛyela bɛ. 7Saa bɛde me nu na me edwɛkɛ ne de bɛ nu a, ɛnee bɛbiza debie biala mɔɔ bɛkulo la, na bɛ sa kɛha ye. 8Saa bɛyɛ Nyamenle ɛhulolɛdeɛ a, ɛnee bɛlɛye Egya anyunlunyia bɛahile; na ye zɛhae azo a bɛlua a bɛkɛhile kɛ bɛle me ɛdoavolɛma a. 9Mekulo bɛ kɛ mɔɔ Selɛ ne kulo me la; bɛdɛnla me ɛhulolɛ ne anu. 10Saa bɛdi me mɛla ne mɔ azo a ɛnee bɛde me ɛhulolɛ ne anu, kɛmɔ meli Selɛ ne mɛla zo na mede ye ɛhulolɛ ne anu la.
11“Meha ɛhye mehile bɛ, amaa me fɛlɛkolilɛ adɛnla bɛ nu na bɛdabɛ noko bɛ fɛlɛkolilɛ ne ali munli. 12 Me mɛla ne a le ɛhye: Bɛhulo bɛ nwo ngoko ngoko, kɛmɔ mehulo bɛ la. 13Ɛhulolɛ kpalɛ mɔɔ sonla kɛnyia ye wɔ ɔ gɔnwo mɔ anwo la a le kɛ ɔkɛva ye ngoane ɔkɛdo aze ɔkɛmaa bɛ. 14Saa bɛyɛ mɔɔ meha mehile bɛ la a, ɛnee bɛle me gɔnwo mɔ. 15Menvɛlɛ bɛ sonvolɛma bieko, ɔboalekɛ sonvolɛ biala ɛnze mɔɔ ɔ menle ne ɛlɛyɛ la. Mefɛlɛ bɛ me gɔnwo mɔ, ɔboalekɛ mɔɔ mendele ye wɔ Egya ɛkɛ ne la meha ye kpokpoti mehile bɛ. 16Tɛ bɛmɛ a bɛnleanle bɛyele me a; medame a memkpale nu menyele bɛ a, yɛɛ mezoa bɛ kɛ bɛhɔlua Nyamenle edwɛkɛ ne bɛmaa ɔzo ma dɔɔnwo kpalɛ mɔɔ ɛmkpɔlɔ ɛlɛ la a. Yemɔti Selɛ ne bava debie biala mɔɔ bɛkɛbiza ye wɔ me duma nu la amaa bɛ. 17Ɛhye ati, mɔɔ meka meahile bɛ la a le kɛ; bɛhulo bɛ nwo ngoko ngoko.
Ewiade ɛkpɔlɛ
18“Bɛhakye kɛ saa ɛtane ewiade ye kpɔ bɛ a, ɛnee bɛnwu ye kɛ yelumua yekpɔ me. 19Saa bɛle ewiade ɛdeɛ a ɛnee ewiade bahulo bɛ kɛ ɔ ti anwo ɛdeɛ la. Na mekpa nu meye bɛ mevi ɛtane ewiade ɛhye anu amra avinli, yemɔti bɛnle ɛtane ewiade ɛdeɛ. Ɛhye ati ɛtane ewiade ɛhye anu amra kpɔ bɛ. 20 Bɛhakye mɔɔ meha mehile bɛ la; ‘Akɛlɛ ɛnle kpole ɛndɛla ɔ menle.’ Saa bɛyɛle me kpɔdekpɔde a ɛnee bɛbayɛ bɛdabɛ noko kpɔdekpɔde; saa bɛlile me ngilehilelɛ zo a, ɛnee bɛbali bɛdabɛ noko bɛ ngilehilelɛ zo. 21Bɛbayɛ bɛ ɛhye mɔ amuala ɔboalekɛ bɛmɛ, bɛle me ɛdeɛ, na ɛtane ewiade ɛnze mɔɔ zoanle me la. 22Saa meamba meammanga edwɛkɛ ne meangile bɛ a anrɛɛ bɛnli ɛtane nwo fɔlɛ; kɛkala, bɛnlɛ bɛ ɛtane nwo nyelebɛnloa biala. 23Awie mɔɔ kpɔ me la kpɔ Egya. 24Saa meambanyɛ nwanwane gyima ɛhye mɔ mɔɔ awie ɛtɛyɛle bie ɛlɛ la wɔ bɛ avinli a, anrɛɛ bɛnli ɛtane nwo fɔlɛ; na kɛkala, bɛnwu mɔɔ menyɛle la yɛɛ bɛkpɔ me nee Egya a. 25 Na kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ ɔba ye noko ala la ɛne, amaa mɔɔ bɛhɛlɛ ye wɔ bɛ mɛla ne anu la ayɛ nɔhalɛ kɛ, ‘Mgbane gyɛne ne ala yɛɛ bɛkpɔle me a.’
26“Boavolɛ ne mɔɔ le Sunsum ne, mɔɔ ye nɔhalɛ ne mɔɔ fane Nyamenle anwo la finde, na ɔvi Selɛ ne ɛkɛ ne la bara. Mebazoa ye wɔ bɛ nwo meamaa ɔvi Selɛ ne ɛkɛ yearaha me nwo edwɛkɛ yeahile bɛ. 27Na bɛdabɛ noko bɛbaha me nwo edwɛkɛ, ɔboalekɛ ɔvi mɔlebɛbo ne amuala, bɛ nee me a lua a.

Title: DW 16
Content:
1“Meha ɛhye mehile bɛ, amaa bɛangyakyi bɛ diedi ne anu. 2Bɛbaye bɛ ali bɛavi bɛ nyianu azua ne mɔ anu. Mekɛ bara mɔɔ awie biala mɔɔ kɛhu bɛ nuhua bie la badwenle kɛ ɔlɛyɛ ye Nyamenle gyima. 3Bɛbayɛ ɛhye mɔ amuala, ɔluakɛ bɛnze Selɛ ne yɛɛ bɛnze me. 4Na meha ɛhye mɔ mehile bɛ, amaa saa mekɛ ne dwu na bɛlɛfa bɛayɛ bɛ a, bɛahakye kɛ menganle mengilele bɛ.
Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne gyima
“Meanga ɛhye mɔ meangile bɛ alumua ne, ɔboalekɛ ɛnee me nee bɛ a de a. 5Na kɛkala, melɛkɔ mɔɔ zoanle me la anwo lɔ, noko bɛ biala ɛmbiza me kɛ, ‘Ɛkɔ nienwu?’ 6Kɛkala mɔɔ meha ɛhye mehile bɛ la, nyane ɛyi bɛ ahonle tɛkɛɛ. 7Na meka nɔhalɛ ne meahile bɛ: Ɔle kpalɛ ɔmaa bɛ kɛ melɛkɔ a, ɔboalekɛ saa meangɔ a Boavolɛ ne ɛnrɛra bɛ nwo. Na saa mekɔ a, mebazoa ye wɔ bɛ nwo. 8Na ɔba a, ɔbahile yeamaa ewiade amra anwu kɛ bɛvo kpole wɔ bɛ adwenle mɔɔ bɛlɛ ye wɔ ɛtane nwo nee mɔɔ bɛlɛ ye wɔ kpalɛ nwo, nee Nyamenle ndɛnebualɛ ne anwo la anwo. 9Bɛvo wɔ bɛ adwenle mɔɔ bɛlɛ ye wɔ ɛtaneyɛlɛ nwo la, ɔboalekɛ bɛnlie me bɛnli; 10bɛvo wɔ pɛlepɛlelilɛ nwo, ɔboalekɛ melɛkɔ Selɛ ne anwo lɔ, na bɛnrɛnwu me bieko; 11yɛɛ bɛvo wɔ Nyamenle ndɛnebualɛ ne anwo, ɔboalekɛ mɔɔ sie ɛtane ewiade ɛhye la bɛbua ye ndɛne dɛbadɛba.
12“Melɛ edwɛkɛ dɔɔnwo meka mekile bɛ, noko kɛkala, bɛnrɛhola ɔ muala anu sɔ. 13Na saa Sunsum ne mɔɔ baye nɔhalɛ ne mɔɔ fane Nyamenle anwo la ba a, ɔbamaa bɛanwu nɔhalɛ ne amuala. Ɔnrɛva ɔdaye ye tumi ɔnrɛdendɛ, na ɔbaha mɔɔ ɔkɛde, na yeaha ninyɛne mɔɔ bara la anwo edwɛkɛ yeahile bɛ. 14Ɔbawula me anyunlunyia, ɔboalekɛ ɔbaha mɔɔ meka la yeahile bɛ. 15Mɔɔ Egya lɛ bɛ la amuala le me ɛdeɛ; ɛhye ati yɛɛ meha kɛ Sunsum ne baha mɔɔ menwɔva menwɔmaa ye la ahile bɛ a.
Nyanelilɛ nee fɛlɛkolilɛ
16“Ɔnrɛhyɛ biala ɛnee bɛnnwu me bieko, yɛɛ ɔnrɛhyɛ biala, bɛbanwu me.”
17Ye ɛdoavolɛma ne bie mɔ bizebizale bɛ nwo kɛ, “Ɛnee ɛhye abo a le duzu? Ɔse, ‘Ɔnrɛhyɛ biala ɛnee bɛnnwu me bieko, yɛɛ ɔnrɛhyɛ biala bɛbanwu me’; eza ɔse, ‘ɔboalekɛ melɛkɔ Selɛ ne anwo lɔ.’ 18Ɛnee ‘Ɔnrɛhyɛ biala’ ɛhye abo a le duzu? Yɛnnwu mɔɔ ɔlɛka la anu.”
19Gyisɛse nwunle mɔɔ bɛkpondɛ bɛabiza ye la, yemɔti ɔhanle ɔhilele bɛ kɛ, “Menganle kɛ, ‘Ɔnrɛhyɛ biala, bɛnrɛnwu me, yɛɛ eza ɔnrɛhyɛ biala, bɛbanwu me.’ Se mɔɔ bɛlɛbizebiza bɛ nwo la ɛne? 20Meka nɔhalɛ ne meahile bɛ: Bɛbazu bɛayi, na ɛtane ewiade ye bali fɛlɛko; bɛbali nyane, na bɛ nyanelilɛ ne bahakyi fɛlɛkolilɛ. 21Saa raalɛ fo awolɛ zo a, ye adwenle sɛkye, ɔboalekɛ ye nyanedelɛ mekɛ ɛdwu; na saa ɔwo a, ɔ rɛle fi ye nyane ne, ɔboalekɛ ɛnee ɔlɛdi fɛlɛko kɛ yewo ralɛ yedo ewiade a. 22Zɔhane ala yɛɛ ɔle ɔmaa bɛ a; kɛkala alɔbɔlɛ ɛha bɛ, na mebaranwu bɛ bieko na fɛlɛkolilɛ bayi bɛ ahonle nu tɛkɛɛ, fɛlɛkolilɛ mɔɔ awie biala ɛnrɛhola bɛ sa die ɛlɛ a.
23“Saa mekɛ zɔhane dwu a, bɛnrɛbiza me bɛnrɛlie debie biala. Meka nɔhalɛ ne meahile bɛ: Debie biala mɔɔ bɛkɛbiza Selɛ ne wɔ me duma nu la, ɔkɛva ɔkɛmaa bɛ. 24Toonwo mɔɔ yeradwu bekezɛ la, bɛtɛbizale debie biala wɔ me duma nu; bɛbiza na bɛ sa kɛha ye, amaa bɛ fɛlɛkolilɛ ne ali munli.
Ewiade anwo zo konimlilɛ
25“Mebubu ɛhye mɔ mrɛlɛ nu mehile bɛ. Na mekɛ bara mɔɔ menrɛbu bɛ mrɛlɛ nu bieko a, mebaha Selɛ ne anwo edwɛkɛ wienyi meahile bɛ. 26Saa mekɛ zɔhane dwu a, bɛbabiza ye wɔ me duma nu; menga kɛ mebabiza meamaa bɛ, 27ɔluakɛ Selɛ ne ɔdaye ɔkulo bɛ. Ɔkulo bɛ ɔluakɛ bɛkulo me na bɛlie bɛli kɛ mevi Nyamenle anwo lɔ a membale a. 28Mevi Selɛ ne anwo lɔ a membale ewiade a; yɛɛ kɛkala melɛfi ewiade meahɔ Selɛ ne anwo lɔ.”
29Ye ɛdoavolɛma ne zele ye kɛ, “Awulae, wɔ edwɛkɛ ne akee ɛkpa nwolɛ ɛdanlɛ wienyi, ɛmbu ye mrɛlɛ nu bieko. 30Kɛkala yɛnwu kɛ ɛkola ɛnwu debie biala; ɔngyia kɛ awie kɛbiza wɔ kpuyia bɔbɔ. Ɛhye maa yɛdie yɛdi kɛ ɛvi Nyamenle anwo lɔ a ɛrale a.”
31Gyisɛse buale kɛ, “Akee bɛlie bɛli ɔ? 32Mekɛ ɛlɛba, na yedwu bɔbɔ, bɛbabɔ bɛ kɔsɔɔti asande, na awie biala ahɔ ɔdaye ye sua nu, na yeaha me ngomekye. Noko ɔnrɛha me ngome, ɔboalekɛ Selɛ ne nee me lua. 33Meha ɛhye mehile bɛ amaa saa bɛmeta me nwo a bɛanyia anzonudwolɛ. Ɛtane ewiade ɛhye bamaa bɛali nyane, noko bɛgyinla kpundii. Meli ɛtane ewiade ɛhye anwo zo konim!”

Title: DW 17
Content:
Gyisɛse sɛlɛ amaa ye ɛdoavolɛma ne
1Gyisɛse wiele ɛhye ka la, ɔnleanle anwuma na ɔhanle kɛ, “Egya, mekɛ ne ɛdwu. Wula Ɛ Ra anyunlunyia na maa Ralɛ ne ɛwula wɔ anyunlunyia. 2Ɔluakɛ wɔmaa ye menli kɔsɔɔti anwo zo tumi, amaa yeava ngoane mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ la yeamaa menli mɔɔ wɔva bɛ wɔmaa ye la. 3Ngoane mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ la a le kɛ bɛkɛnwu kɛ wɔmɔ a ɛle nɔhalɛ Nyamenle kokye ne a, na bɛkɛnwu Gyisɛse Kelaese, mɔɔ wɔzoa ye la. 4Mehile wɔ anyunlunyia ne wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo; mewie gyima mɔɔ ɛvale ɛmanle me la di. 5Egya, fa me anyunlunyia maa me, anyunlunyia ne mɔɔ bɛkabɔ ewiade ye la ɛnee melɛ ye la, fa maa me wɔ ɛ nyunlu ɛke kɛkala.
6“Mela wɔ ali mehile menli mɔɔ ɛvale bɛ ɛvile ɛtane ewiade ye anu ɛmanle me la. Ɛnee bɛle wɔ ɛdeɛ, yɛɛ ɛvale bɛ ɛmanle me a. Bɛli wɔ edwɛkɛ ne azo, 7na kɛkala bɛnwu kɛ debie biala mɔɔ ɛvale ɛmanle me la vi wɔ ɛkɛ. 8Nrɛlaleɛ mɔɔ ɛvale ɛmanle me la, meva memaa bɛ, yɛɛ bɛzɔ nu noko; bɛze kɛ ɔle nɔhalɛ kɛ mevi ɛ nwo lɔ a membale a, yɛɛ bɛdie bɛdi kɛ ɛdawɔ a ɛzoanle me a.
9“Mesɛlɛ meamaa bɛ. Menzɛlɛ memmaa ɛtane ewiade ye. Mesɛlɛ meamaa menli mɔɔ ɛvale bɛ ɛmanle me la, ɔboalekɛ bɛle wɔ ɛdeɛ. 10Mɔɔ melɛ la le wɔ ɛdeɛ, yɛɛ mɔɔ ɛlɛ la amuala le me ɛdeɛ; na bɛ nwo zo yɛɛ me anyunlunyia dua da ali a. 11Kɛkala melɛba ɛ nwo lɔ; menle ewiade ye anu bieko, na bɛmɛ bɛwɔ ewiade ye anu. Selɛ Nwuanzanwuanza, wɔ duma ne mɔɔ ɛvale ɛmanle me la tumi nu ti, fa bɛ sie gyɛlɛɛnye, amaa bɛayɛ ko kɛ ɛdawɔ nee medame yɛle la. 12 Mɔɔ ɛnee me nee bɛ de la, menziele bɛ gyɛlɛɛnye wɔ wɔ duma ne mɔɔ ɛvale ɛmanle me la tumi nu. Membɔle bɛ nwo bane, na ko bɔbɔ amminli, kyesɛ kokye ne, Dwudase musuofoɔ ala mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ minli la, amaa Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne ayɛ nɔhalɛ. 13Kɛkala melɛba ɛ nwo lɔ, yɛɛ melɛka ɛhye mɔ noko wɔ ewiade ye anu, amaa bɛ nye alie me nwo kpole wɔ bɛ ahonle nu. 14Meha wɔ nrɛlaleɛ ne mehile bɛ, yemɔti ɛtane ewiade ɛhye kpɔ bɛ, ɔboalekɛ bɛnle ɛtane ewiade ye ɛdeɛ, kɛmɔ menle ɛtane ewiade ye ɛdeɛ la. 15Membiza kɛ ɛye bɛ ɛvi ewiade ye anu, mesɛlɛ kɛ ɛkɛzie bɛ gyɛlɛɛnye ɛkɛvi amumuyɛnli Seetan asa anu. 16Kɛmɔ menle ɛtane ewiade ɛdeɛ la, bɛdabɛ noko bɛnle ye ɛdeɛ. 17Dua nɔhalɛ ne azo te bɛ nwo na fa bɛ yɛ wɔ ɛdeɛ; wɔ edwɛkɛ ne a le nɔhalɛ ne. 18Mezoa bɛ wɔ ewiade ye anu, kɛmɔ ɛzoanle me wɔ ewiade ye anu la; 19yɛɛ ɔlua bɛ ti medu me nwo memaa wɔ, amaa bɛdabɛ noko bɛadu bɛ nwo nɔhalɛ nu bɛamaa wɔ.
20“Menzɛlɛ memmaa bɛ ngome. Mesɛlɛ meamaa bɛdabɛ noko mɔɔ wɔ edwɛkɛ ne ati bɛdie me bɛdi la. 21Mesɛlɛ kɛ bɛ muala bɛkɛyɛ ko. Egya! Maa bɛdɛnla yɛ nu, kɛmɔ ɛde me nu na medame mede wɔ nu la. Maa bɛyɛ ko, amaa ewiade amra alie ali kɛ amgba ɛdawɔ a ɛzoanle me a. 22Anyunlunyia ne mɔɔ ɛvale ɛmanle me la meva zɔhane ala bie memaa bɛ, amaa bɛayɛ ko, kɛmɔ ɛdawɔ nee medame yɛle ko la; 23maa mendɛnla bɛ nu, na ɛdawɔ noko tɛnla me nu, amaa bɛayɛ ko kpalɛ kpalɛ, na ewiade amra anwu kɛ ɛdawɔ a ɛzoanle me a, na ɛkulo bɛ kɛmɔ ɛkulo me la.
24“Egya! Wɔva bɛ wɔmaa me, na mekpondɛ kɛ bɛ nee me tɛnla ɛleka mɔɔ mewɔ la, amaa bɛanwu me anyunlunyia ne mɔɔ ɛvale ɛmanle me la, ɔluakɛ ɛhulole me kolaa na bɛabɔ ewiade ye. 25Pɛlepɛlelilɛ Egya! Ɛtane ewiade ye ɛnze wɔ, na mame meze wɔ, yɛɛ ɛhye mɔ ze kɛ ɛdawɔ a ɛzoanle me a. 26Mela wɔ ali mehile bɛ na mebahɔ zo meayɛ ye zɔhane, amaa ɛhulolɛ ne mɔɔ ɛlɛ ye me nwo la adɛnla bɛ nu, na medame noko meadɛnla bɛ nu.”

Title: DW 18
Content:
Gyisɛse ɛhyelɛ
(Mat 26.47-56; Mak 14.43-50; Luk 22.47-53)
1Gyisɛse wiele nzɛlɛlɛ ɛhye yɛ la, ɔ nee ye ɛdoavolɛma ne hɔpɛle hɔle azule ekyi bie mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Kedelɔn la anzi. Tola bie wɔ azule ne anzi na Gyisɛse nee ye ɛdoavolɛma ne hɔle nu. 2Ɔyɛ a Gyisɛse nee ye ɛdoavolɛma ne ta yia tola ɛhye anu. Yemɔti Dwudase mɔɔ yele Gyisɛse manle la ze ɛkɛ ne. 3Ɛhye ati Dwudase vale Wulomu sogyama nee Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne sinzavolɛma mɔɔ sɛlɛvolɛ mgbanyima ne nee Falasiima zoanle bɛ la rale tola ne anu. Bɛkɔ la bɛdedɛ ahoholombaka nee dadeɛ, tɛkɛ, yɛɛ tayia. 4Gyisɛse ze mɔɔ bazi ɔ nwo zo la ati, ɔrale ɔ nyunlu na ɔbizale bɛ kɛ, “Nwane a bɛkpondɛ ye a?”
5Bɛbuale ye kɛ, “Yɛkpondɛ Gyisɛse mɔɔ vi Nazalɛte la.”
Gyisɛse zele bɛ kɛ, “Medame ɛne.”
Mekɛ ne anu ɛnee Dwudase mɔɔ yele Gyisɛse manle la gyi ɛlɔne ne anu. 6Mɔɔ Gyisɛse hanle kɛ, “Medame ɛne” la, ɛlɔne ne dule hɔle bɛ nzi na bɛdule bɛguale aze. 7Gyisɛse eza bizale bɛ kɛ, “Nwane a bɛkpondɛ ye a?”
Bɛhanle kɛ, “Yɛkpondɛ Gyisɛse mɔɔ vi Nazalɛte la.”
8Gyisɛse zele bɛ kɛ, “Se meha mehile bɛ kɛ medame ɛne. Saa medame yɛɛ bɛkpondɛ me a, ɛnee bɛmaa ɛhye mɔ ɛhɔ.” 9(Ɔhanle ɛhye amaa ye edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ ɔhanle kɛ, “Egya, meamminli bɛdabɛ mɔɔ ɛvale bɛ ɛmanle me la anu ko bɔbɔ” la ayɛ nɔhalɛ.)
10Saemɔn Pita ɛnee lɛ dadeɛ, na ɔhwenle ɔpɛle Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli ne akɛlɛ ne anzo fema ne. Akɛlɛ ne bɛfɛlɛ ye Malekɛse. 11 Gyisɛse zele Pita kɛ, “Fa wɔ dadeɛ ne wula ye boa ne anu. Ɛdwenle kɛ menrɛnlo nyane kɔpo ne mɔɔ Egya ɛva ɛmaa me la anu ɔ?”
Gyisɛse gyi Anase anyunlu
12Akee Wulomu sogyama ne nee bɛ kpanyinli ne nee Dwuu sinzavolɛma ne mɔ hyele Gyisɛse, bɛkyekyele ye, 13na bɛlumuale bɛvale ye bɛhɔle Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli Anase ɛkɛ. Anase le Kayafase, mɔɔ le ɛvolɛ ne anu Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli la aye ne ɔ ze. 14 Kayafase ɛhye a dule Dwuuma ne folɛ kɛ ɔle kpalɛ kɛ sonla ko kɛwu kɛmaa menli ne amuala la.
Pita kpo Gyisɛse
(Mat 26.69-70; Mak 14.66-68; Luk 22.55-57)
15Saemɔn Pita nee ɛdoavolɛ ko noko doale Gyisɛse nanamogya. Ɛdoavolɛ zɔhane Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli ne ze ye kpalɛ kpalɛ, yemɔti ɔwolole ɔdoale Gyisɛse wɔ Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli ne alie nwo lɔ. 16Pita hale anuhɔlɛ ɛkɛ ne anlenkɛ kpole ne anzi. Yemɔti ɛdoavolɛ ne mɔɔ Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli ne ze ye kpalɛ la ziale ɔ nzi hɔdendɛle hilele bɛlɛra ne mɔɔ gyi anuhɔlɛ ɛkɛ ne la na ɔvale Pita ɔwolole. 17Bɛlɛra ne mɔɔ gyi anuhɔlɛ ɛkɛ ne la zele Pita kɛ, “Wɔmɔ, se ɛle nrenya ne ɛdoavolɛma ne mɔ anu ko.”
Pita buale kɛ, “Kyɛkyɛ, memboka nwo.”
18Ɛnee maanle nu yɛ ɛyɛlɛ kpalɛ la ati, sonvolɛma nee sinzavolɛma ne ɛhua senle na bɛgyigyi nwo bɛlɛte. Pita ɔdaye noko ɔhɔgyinlanle bɛ nwo ɛkɛ ne kɛ ɔte senle ne bie.
Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli ne bizebiza Gyisɛse edwɛkɛ
(Mat 26.59-66; Mak 14.55-64; Luk 22.66-71)
19Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli ne bizebizale Gyisɛse edwɛkɛ mɔɔ fane ye ɛdoavolɛma ne nee ye ngilehilelɛ ne anwo. 20Gyisɛse buale ye kɛ, “Dahuu metendɛ baguase, meyɛ me ngilehilelɛ ne wɔ nyianu azua ne mɔ anu nee Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu, ɛleka mɔɔ Dwuuma yia nu mekɛ biala la. Metɛkanle edwɛkɛ biala wɔ fealera nu. 21Na duzu ati a akee ɛlɛbizebiza me kpuyia ɛhye mɔ ɛ? Biza menli mɔɔ diele me la. Biza bɛ maa bɛha mɔɔ menganle la bɛhile wɔ; bɛze mɔɔ menganle la amuala.”
22Gyisɛse hanle ɛhye la, sinzavolɛma ne mɔ anu ko bɔle ɔ nzo nu na ɔzele ye kɛ, “Ɛ nye ɛnzɔ sonla; ɛtendɛ wɔahile Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli ne a, anrɛɛ dwenle nwolɛ!”
23Gyisɛse buale ye kɛ, “Saa meha ɛtane a, ɛnee ka mɔɔ ɛdele la maa awie biala mɔɔ wɔ ɛke la ɛde bie. Na saa mɔɔ meha la le nɔhalɛ a, ɛnee duzu ati a ɛbɔle me a?”
24Anase akee manle bɛvale ye, kɛmɔ bɛkyekyele ye bɛ nee ye rale ala la, bɛhɔmanle Kayafase, mɔɔ ɛvolɛ ne anu ɔle Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli la.
Pita kpo Gyisɛse bieko
(Mat 26.71-75; Mak 14.69-72; Luk 22.58-62)
25Pita gyi senle ne anwo ɛlɛte la, menli ne mɔ ko bizale ye kɛ, “Na wɔmɔ, tɛ nrenya ne ɛdoavolɛma ne ko a le wɔ ɔ?”
Na Pita zale na ɔhanle kɛ, “Kyɛkyɛ, memboka bɛ.”
26Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli ne akɛlɛ ko mɔɔ ye awie a le nrenya ne mɔɔ Pita pɛle ɔ nzo la zele kɛ, “Na tɛ wɔmɔ a menwunle wɔ kɛ ɛ nee ye wɔ tola ne anu la ɔ?”
27Pita buale kɛ, “Medame? Kosoɛ, tɛ me ɔ!” Na ɛkɛ ne ala akɔlɛ bɔle.
Gyisɛse gyi Paelɛte anyunlu
(Mat 27.1-2,11-14; Mak 15.1-5; Luk 23.1-5)
28Bɛvale Gyisɛse bɛvile Kayafase sua nu na bɛ nee ye hɔle Wulomu amɛnlado ne suakunlu; ɛnee asɛɛ maanle nu ɛtete. Dwuuma ne angɔ amɛnlado ne suakunlu ɛkɛ ne bie, ɔboalekɛ ɛnee bɛkulo kɛ bɛsie bɛ nwo bɔkɔbɔkɔ, kɛmɔ bɛ ɛzonlenlɛ ne kile la, amaa bɛanyia adenle bɛali Akpabɛnwo Ɛvoyia aleɛ ne bie. 29Paelɛte vindele rabizale bɛ kɛ, “Duzu ɛtane a sonla ɛhye ɛyɛ a?”
30Bɛbuale ye kɛ, “Saa ɔtɛtonle mɛla a anrɛɛ yɛnrɛva ye yɛnrɛrɛlɛ wɔ.”
31Paelɛte zele bɛ kɛ, “Ɛnee bɛdabɛ bɛva ye bɛhɔ bɛhɔli ye edwɛkɛ, kɛmɔ bɛ mɛla ne se la!”
Dwuuma ne buale kɛ, “Bɛmɛ Wulomuma bɛ mɛla ne ɛmmaa yɛ adenle yɛmbua awie fɔlɛ yɛngu ye.” 32 (Ɛhye zile, amaa Gyisɛse edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ ɔhanle wɔ ye ewule nwo la ayɛ nɔhalɛ.)
33Paelɛte ziale hɔle ɛleka mɔɔ Gyisɛse wɔ la na ɔbizale ye kɛ, “Wɔmɔ a ɛle Dwuuma belemgbunli ne la ɔ?”
34Gyisɛse buale ye kɛ, “Ɛnee kpuyia ɛhye vi ɛdawɔ wɔ ɛkɛ ne anzɛɛ awie mɔ yɛɛ ɛha ye me nwo ɛhile wɔ a?”
35Paelɛte buale ye kɛ, “Ɛdwenle kɛ mele Dwuunli ɔ? Ɛdawɔ wɔ menli ne nee bɛ sɛlɛvolɛ mgbanyinli yɛɛ ɛva wɔ ɛrɛlɛ me a. Duzu debie a wɔyɛ a?”
36Gyisɛse buale ye kɛ, “Me belemgbunlililɛ ne ɛnle ewiade ɛhye anu; saa me belemgbunlililɛ ne wɔ ewiade ye anu a, anrɛɛ me ɛlɔnema kɛho kɛmaa me na bɛnrɛmaa bɛnrɛva me bɛnrɛmaa Dwuu mgbanyima ne mɔ. Kyɛkyɛ, me belemgbunlililɛ ne ɛnle ɛke.”
37Paelɛte zele ye kɛ, “Se ɛnee ɛle belemgbunli o!”
Gyisɛse buale ye kɛ, “Ɛdawɔ ɛse mele belemgbunli. Na ɛhye ala ati yɛɛ bɛwole me bɛmanle membale ewiade ye anu a, kɛ membanli nɔhalɛ ne anwo daselɛ. Mɔɔ le nɔhalɛ ne ɛdeɛ la tie mɔɔ meka la.”
38Paelɛte bizale kɛ, “Duzu a le nɔhalɛ ne?”
Bɛbua Gyisɛse ewule fɔlɛ
(Mat 27.15-31; Mak 15.6-20; Luk 23.13-25)
Paelɛte eza vindele doale Dwuuma ne wɔ gua ne azo nehane na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Mennwu debie mɔɔ yemɔti ɔwɔ kɛ mebu sonla ne ewule fɔlɛ a. 39Na bɛ amaamuo ne kile kɛ, saa bɛbali bɛ Akpabɛnwo Ɛvoyia ne a ɔwɔ kɛ medwula pilizanli ko memaa bɛ. Bɛkɛhulo kɛ menwɔdwula Dwuuma Belemgbunli ne menwɔmaa bɛ ɔ?”
40Bɛdeɛdeanle nu bɛbuale kɛ, “Kyɛkyɛ! Yɛmkpondɛ ye! Yɛkpondɛ Balabase.” (Balabase le maamɔvo.)

Title: DW 19
Content:
1Paelɛte manle bɛbilale Gyisɛse empele. 2Sogyama ne vale evileni nwonle abɔtile na bɛvale bɛkpolole Gyisɛse ati; bɛwulale ye tɛladeɛ kɔkɔlɛ bie mɔɔ arelemgbunli ala a wula la 3na bɛrahotole ye bɛgolole ɔ nwo bɛzele kɛ, “Dwuuma Belemgbunli, nyi kyɛ!” Bɛka ye zɛhae a ɛnee bɛhɔ ɔ nwo ɛkɛ ne bɛhɔbɔ ɔ nzo nu.
4Paelɛte eza ziale doale Dwuuma ne wɔ gua ne azo lɔ na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛdie, me nee ye ba ɛke meamaa bɛanwu kɛ mennwu nvonleɛ biala wɔ ɔ nwo mɔɔ medua zolɛ mebu ye ewule fɔlɛ a.” 5Yemɔti ɔmanle bɛvale Gyisɛse bɛvindele, ɔbɔ ye evileni abɔtile ne na ɔwula ye arelemgbunli tɛladeɛ kɔkɔlɛ ne. Paelɛte zele kɛ, “Bɛnlea! Sonla ne ɛne!”
6Sɛlɛvolɛ mgbanyinli ne nee sinzavolɛma ne mɔ nwunle ye la bɛdeɛdeanle nu kɛ, “Bɔ ye meanubaka nu! Bɔ ye meanubaka nu!”
Paelɛte zele bɛ kɛ, “Ɛnee bɛdabɛ bɛrava ye bɛhɔbɔ ye meanubaka nu. Mennwu debie mɔɔ yemɔti ɔwɔ kɛ mebu ye ewule fɔlɛ a!”
7Dwuuma ne buale ye kɛ, “Yɛlɛ mɛla, na mɛla ne kile kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ ɔwu, ɔboalekɛ ɔyɛ ɔ nwo kɛ ɔle Nyamenle Ara.”
8Paelɛte dele ɛhye la, ɛzulolɛ kpole hanle ye. 9Ɔwolole ɔhɔle ye suakunlu ɛkɛ ne na ɔbizale Gyisɛse kɛ, “Ɛvi nienwu?”
Na Gyisɛse andɛ ɔ nloa anu. 10Paelɛte zele ye kɛ, “Ɛnrɛdɛne me zo? Kakye kɛ melɛ tumi mekola megyakyi wɔ anzɛɛ memaa bɛbɔ wɔ meanubaka nu bɛku wɔ.”
11Gyisɛse buale ye kɛ, “Ɛlɛ me nwo zo tumi, ɔluakɛ Nyamenle yɛɛ ɛva ɛmaa wɔ a. Yemɔti sonla ne mɔɔ vale me rawulale ɛ sa nu la a di ɛzonle kpole kpalɛ a.”
12Paelɛte dele ɛhye la, akee ɔbɔle nwolɛ mɔdenle biala kɛ ɔkpondɛ adenle yealua zolɛ yeagyakyi Gyisɛse. Na Dwuuma ne hanle ye anyebolo zo kɛ, “Saa ɛgyakyi ye a ɛnee ɛnle Wulomu Maanle Maanle Belemgbunli ne agɔnwo! Awie biala mɔɔ ɔdaye ɔfɛlɛ ɔ nwo belemgbunli la le Wulomu Maanle Maanle Belemgbunli ne kpɔvolɛ!”
13Paelɛte dele edwɛkɛ ɛhye la, ɔvale Gyisɛse ɔvindele na ɔradɛnlanle ndɛnebualɛ ebia ne anu wɔ ɛleka bie mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Hibulu aneɛ nu Gabata la. (Gabata abo a le “Bolɛ Bama”) 14Ɛnee akee asɛɛ yedwu sɛnzɛngyinla, wɔ Akpabɛnwo Ɛvoyia kenle ne anu. Paelɛte hanle hilele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛ Belemgbunli ne ɛne!”
15Dwuuma ne hanle ye kpole kpalɛ kɛ, “Ku ye! Ku ye! Bɔ ye meanubaka nu!”
Paelɛte bizale bɛ kɛ, “Bɛkpondɛ kɛ mebɔ bɛ belemgbunli ne meanubaka nu ɔ?”
Sɛlɛvolɛ mgbanyinli ne mɔ buale ye kɛ, “Yɛ belemgbunli ala a le Siza!”
16Na Paelɛte yele Gyisɛse manle bɛ kɛ bɛhɔbɔ ye meanubaka nu.
Bɛbɔ Gyisɛse meanubaka nu
(Mat 27.32-44; Mak 15.21-32; Luk 23.26-43)
Bɛvale Gyisɛse bɛhɔle. 17Bɛmanle ɔzoale ye meanubaka ne na ɔrale ɛleka bie mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye wɔ Hibulu aneɛ nu “Gɔlogɔta” la. (Gɔlogɔta abo a le Etile Kanrɛlɛ Ɛleka) 18Ɛkɛ ne yɛɛ bɛbɔle ye meanubaka nu a; bɛbɔle menli nwiɔ noko meanubaka nu wɔ ɛkɛ ne, ko wɔ Gyisɛse fema zo yɛɛ ko wɔ ye bɛne zo na Gyisɛse wɔ avinli. 19Paelɛte hɛlɛle edwɛkɛ bɔle Gyisɛse meanubaka ne ati zo kɛ, “Nazalɛtenli Gyisɛse, Dwuuma Belemgbunli.” 20Dwuuma dɔɔnwo gengale, ɔboalekɛ ɛleka mɔɔ bɛbɔle Gyisɛse meanubaka nu la nee sua zo anwa biala. Edwɛkɛ ne, bɛhɛlɛle ye wɔ Hibulu, Laten, yɛɛ Giliki aneɛ ne mɔ anu. 21Dwuuma sɛlɛvolɛ mgbanyinli ne mɔ zele Paelɛte kɛ, “Mmakɛlɛ kɛ, ‘Ɔle Dwuuma Belemgbunli’, na kɛlɛ kɛ, ‘Nrenya ɛhye se: Mele Dwuuma Belemgbunli!’ ”
22Paelɛte buale kɛ, “Mɔɔ mehɛlɛ la a mehɛlɛ a!”
23Sogyama ne bɔle Gyisɛse meanubaka nu wiele la, bɛhyɛle ye adɛladeɛ ne mɔ anu nna; sogyanli ko biala ɛdeɛ ko. Akee ɔhale ye bubu ne mɔɔ bɛnwonle ye woladapi la, 24 sogyama ne zele bɛ nwo kɛ, “Bɛmmamaa yɛsuosua nu; bɛmaa yɛgua nwolɛ nzeleba yɛnlea ahenle mɔɔ ɔkɛyɛ ye ɛdeɛ la.” Ɛhye zile amaa Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne ayɛ nɔhalɛ kɛ,
“Bɛhyɛle me adɛladeɛ ne mɔ bɛvale,
na me bubu ne, bɛguale nwolɛ nzeleba.”
Mɔɔ sogyama ne mɔ yɛle la ɛne.
25Menli mɔɔ ɛnee gyigyi Gyisɛse meanubaka ne anwo la a le Gyisɛse ɔ nli nee ɔ nli adiema Mɛle, Kulopase aye ne, yɛɛ Mɛle ne mɔɔ vi Magedala la. 26Gyisɛse nwunle kɛ ɔ nli nee ɛdoavolɛ ne mɔɔ ɔkulo ye edwɛkɛ la gyi ɛkɛ ne la ɔhanle ɔhilele ɔ nli kɛ, “Ɔmɔ, nea, ɛ ra nrenya ɛne.”
27Akee ɔzele ɛdoavolɛ ne kɛ, “Ayi, ɛ nli ɛne.” Ɔvi mekɛ zɔhane, ɛdoavolɛ ne vale Gyisɛse ɔ li na ɔ nee ye hɔdɛnlanle.
Gyisɛse ewule
(Mat 27.45-56; Mak 15.33-41; Luk 23.44-49)
28 Gyisɛse nwunle kɛ akee debie biala ɛli munli ɛwie. Yemɔti amaa Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne ayɛ nɔhalɛ la, ɔhanle kɛ, “Nzuhɔne ɛlɛku me.”
29Buakɛ bie mɔɔ nwanye bisii bie wɔ nu la gyi ɛkɛ: bɛvale emiane bɛbɔle nu, bɛvale bɛzianle nyinlanyinla baka ti, na bɛmanle ye zo bɛkpulale Gyisɛse anloa. 30Gyisɛse liele nwanye ne na ɔhanle kɛ, “Yewie!”
Akee ɔbɔle ɔ ti aze na ɔwule.
Bɛwɔ Gyisɛse anvenle atwɛ
31Akee Dwuu mgbanyima ne zɛlɛle Paelɛte kɛ ɔmaa bɛ adenle ɔmaa bɛhɔbubu menli mɔɔ bɛbɔ bɛ meanubaka nu la agyakɛ bɛmaa bɛwu ndɛndɛ na bɛdwula bɛ aze bɛvi meanubaka ne mɔ azo. Bɛzɛlɛle ɛhye, ɔluakɛ ɛnee kenle ne le Yalɛ na aleɛ kye a ɔle Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle. Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ɛhye le kenle nwuanzanwuanza kpalɛ kpalɛ maa bɛ la ati, bɛangulo kɛ avunli ne mɔ kɛhendɛhenda meanubaka ne mɔ azo zɔhane kenle ne. 32Zɔhane ati sogyama ne hɔle na bɛhɔbubule sonla ne mɔɔ lumua nee ko ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nsa la agyakɛ. 33Bɛdwule Gyisɛse anwo ɛkɛ ne la, bɛnwunle kɛ yewu dɛbadɛba; yemɔti bɛambubu ɔ gyakɛ. 34Na sogyama ne mɔ anu ko wɔle Gyisɛse anvenle atwɛ, na ɛkɛ ne ala mogyanzule hwinle guale. 35(Ahenle mɔɔ nwunle kɛ ɛhye ɛzi la a ɛdendɛ la, amaa wɔalie wɔali. Mɔɔ ɔhanle la le nɔhalɛ, yɛɛ ɔze noko kɛ ɔlɛka nɔhalɛ ne.) 36Bɛyɛle ɛhye amaa Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne ayɛ nɔhalɛ kɛ, “Bɛambu ye bowule ko bɔbɔ.” 37 Eza Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne ko noko se, “Menli anye banwu mɔɔ bɛwɔle ɔ nvenle atwɛ la.”
Gyisɛse ɛzielɛ
(Mat 27.57-61; Mak 15.42-47; Luk 23.50-56)
38Ɛhye anzi, Dwosefi, mɔɔ vi Arelematia la hɔzɛlɛle Paelɛte kɛ ɔva Gyisɛse funli ne ɔmaa ye. (Dwosefi le Gyisɛse ɛdoavolɛ, noko yeanye ɔ nyunlu, ɔluakɛ ɔsulo Dwuu mgbanyima ne mɔ.) Paelɛte kponlenle zolɛ manle ye, yemɔti Dwosefi hɔvale Gyisɛse funli ne. 39 Nekɔdimɛse mɔɔ kenle ko nɔɔzo bie hɔnwunle Gyisɛse la nee Dwosefi a hɔle a; bɛkɔ la bɛlɛ ayile evuanlɛ mɔɔ le kɛ alufuanlɛ nee aabɛya mɔɔ kɛdo tone nu kɛyɛ kilo abulanlu la a hɔle a. 40Bɛdabɛ mu nwiɔ bɛvale ayile evuanlɛ ne bɛyɛle Gyisɛse anwo na bɛkyekyele ye wɔ kisane nu, ɔluakɛ kɛ Dwuuma yɛ bɛ funli la ɛne. 41Tola bie zua ɛleka mɔɔ bɛbɔle Gyisɛse meanubaka nu la, nla fofolɛ bie mɔɔ bɛtɛtole sonla nu ɛlɛ la wɔ ɛkɛ ne. 42Kɛmɔ aleɛ kye a ɔle Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle, na eza nla ne bikye la ati, bɛdole Gyisɛse nu.

Title: DW 20
Content:
Nla mgbane ne
(Mat 28.1-8; Mak 16.1-8; Luk 24.1-12)
1Molɛ nwonlomɔ mangyee ne ala mɔɔ maanle nu ɛtɛwiele tete la, Mɛle mɔɔ vi Magedala la hɔle sɛka ne azo na ɔnwunle kɛ bɛye bolɛ ne mɔɔ bɛvale bɛnyinle nla ne anloa la. 2Ɔnriandile ɔhɔbɔle Saemɔn Pita nee ɛdoavolɛ ne mɔɔ Gyisɛse kulo ye edwɛkɛ la amaneɛ kɛ, “Bɛye Awulae wɔ nla ne anu bɛhɔ, na yɛnnwu ɛleka mɔɔ bɛhɔdo ye a.”
3Pita nee ɛdoavolɛ ko ne hɔle hɔnleanle nla ne. 4Bɛ mu nwiɔ bɛlɛkɔ la bɛlɛ ɛnriandilɛ, na ɛdoavolɛ ɛhendeɛ ne nriandile ndɛndɛ dɛlale Pita na ɔhɔdwule sɛka ne azo. 5Ɔhanle ɔ nwo aze ɔnleanle nla ne anu la ɔnwunle kɛ kisane ne mɔ gua nu, na yeandwu nu. 6Saemɔn Pita vi amozi rale, na ɛkɛ ne ala ɔdwule nla ne anu. Ɔnwunle kɛ kisane ne 7yɛɛ ɛdanlɛ ne mɔɔ bɛvale bɛzɔle Gyisɛse ada la gua ɛkɛ. Bɛ muala bɛngua ɛleka ko. Bɛbubu ɛdanlɛ ne bɛgua ɔ ngome. 8Akee ɛdoavolɛ ne mɔɔ lumuale dwule sɛka ne azo la ɔdaye ɔdwule nla ne anu; ɔnwunle ɛhye mɔ na ɔliele ɔlile. 9(Ɛnee bɛtɛtele Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne abo kɛ ɔse ɔwɔ kɛ ɔdwazo ɔfi ewule nu.) 10Na ɛdoavolɛma nwiɔ ne hɔle sua nu.
Gyisɛse ye ɔ nwo ahile Mɛle mɔɔ vi Magedala la
(Mat 28.9-10; Mak 16.9-11)
11Mɛle hale sɛka ne azo zunle. Mɔɔ ɔsu la, ɔnleanle nla ne anu. 12Na ɔnwunle Nyamenle soanvolɛma nwiɔ mɔɔ wula adɛladeɛ fufule la kɛ bɛde ɛleka mɔɔ anrɛɛ Gyisɛse funli ne la la, ko de ɔ ti sɔlɔ yɛɛ ko de ɔ gyakɛ anu. 13Bɛbizale ye kɛ, “Ɔmɔ, duzu ati a ɛlɛsu a?”
Ɔbuale bɛ kɛ, “Bɛrava me Awulae bɛhɔ, na mennwu ɛleka mɔɔ bɛhɔdo ye a.”
14Ɔhanle ɛhye la ɔhakyile ɔ nwo na ɔnwunle kɛ Gyisɛse gyi ɛkɛ, noko yeannwu ye sonla holɛ. 15Gyisɛse bizale ye kɛ, “Ɔmɔ, duzu ati a ɛlɛsu a? Nwane a ɛkpondɛ ye a?”
Ɛnee Mɛle dwenle kɛ ahenle ne mɔɔ gyi ɔ nyunlu ɛkɛ ne la a le sonla ne mɔɔ nea tola ne azo la ati, ɔzele ye kɛ, “Yɛmenle, saa ɛdawɔ yɛɛ ɛrayele ye ɛhɔle a, ka na kile me ɛleka mɔɔ ɛhɔdole ye la maa mengɔnva.”
16Gyisɛse vɛlɛle ye, “Mɛle!”
Ɔhakyile ɔ nye wɔ ɔ nwo ɛkɛ ne na ɔhanle ye Hibulu nu kɛ, “Labonae!” (Ɔ bo a le “Kilehilevolɛ”)
17Gyisɛse zele ye kɛ, “Mmasɔ me, ɔboalekɛ metɛkɔle Selɛ ne anwo lɔ. Na wɔmɔ kɔ na kɔze me mediema ne mɔ kɛ, ‘Melɛkɔ Egya nee bɛ Ze ne, me Nyamenle nee bɛ Nyamenle ne anwo lɔ.’ ”
18Zɔhane ati Mɛle mɔɔ vi Magedala la hɔle na ɔhɔhanle ɔhilele ɛdoavolɛma ne kɛ yenwu Awulae na yeva zɛhae nrɛlaleɛ yemaa ye.
Gyisɛse ye ɔ nwo ahile ye ɛdoavolɛma ne
(Mat 28.16-20; Mak 16.14-18; Luk 24.36-49)
19Molɛ kenle ko ne ala mɔɔ ɛnee aleɛ ɛdwo kpalɛ la, ɛnee ɛdoavolɛma ne ɛhuohua bɛ nloa na bɛdo bɛ nwo anlenkɛ nu, ɔboalekɛ bɛsulo Dwuu mgbanyima ne mɔ. Gyisɛse ragyinlanle bɛ avinli na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Anzonudwolɛ ɛha bɛ.” 20Ɔhanle ɛhye la, ɔvale ɔ sa nee ɔ nvenle ɔhilele bɛ. Ɛdoavolɛma ne anye liele kpole kɛ bɛnwu Awulae a. 21Na Gyisɛse zele bɛ bieko kɛ, “Anzonudwolɛ ɛha bɛ. Kɛmɔ Selɛ ne zoanle me la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ medame noko mesoa bɛ a.” 22Akee ɔliele ɛnwomenle ɔguale bɛ nwo zo na ɔhanle kɛ, “Bɛlie Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne. 23 Saa bɛfa awie ɛtane bɛkyɛ ye a, ɛnee bɛva bɛhyɛ ye; saa bɛanva bɛangyɛ ahenle a, bɛnrɛva bɛnrɛhyɛ ye.”
Gyisɛse nee Tɔmase
24Ɛdoavolɛma bulu nee nwiɔ ne anu ko mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Tɔmase (mɔɔ eza bɛfɛlɛ ye Nda) la, ɛnle ɛkɛ ne a Gyisɛse rale a. 25Yemɔti ɛdoavolɛma mɔɔ hale la hanle hilele ye kɛ, “Yɛnwu Awulae!”
Tɔmase zele bɛ kɛ, “Saa metɛnwunle ɔ sa nu pɛlɛko ne mɔɔ bɛbɔle ye la abo zo kapenle ne, metɛfale me sa metɛfuale kapenle ne, na metɛfale me sa metɛkanle ɔ nvenle kapenle ne a, menrɛlie menrɛli.”
26Ɔlile dapɛne ko la ɛdoavolɛma ne mɔ eza huohuanle bɛ nloa na bɛdole bɛ nwo anlenkɛ nu bieko, mekɛ ne anu ɛnee Tɔmase boka bɛ nwo. Bɛtotole nlenkɛ ne mɔ anu ɛdeɛ, noko Gyisɛse ragyinlanle bɛ avinli na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Anzonudwolɛ ɛha bɛ.” 27Akee ɔzele Tɔmase kɛ, “Tɔmase, fa ɛ sa bɛla ɛke na nea me sa nu; tenrɛ ɛ sa fua me nvenle. Gyakyi wɔ kpolerazulɛ ne na die di!”
28Tɔmase buale kɛ, “Me Awulae nee me Nyamenle!”
29Gyisɛse zele ye kɛ, “Wɔnwu me la ati yɛɛ wɔlie wɔli a? Nyilalɛ ɛha bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛtɛnwunle me na bɛlie bɛli la!”
Kpɔkɛ mɔɔ Buluku ɛhye gyi zolɛ la
30Gyisɛse yɛle nwanwane ninyɛne dɔɔnwo mɔɔ ye ɛdoavolɛma ne mɔ nwunle bɛ, mɔɔ bɛangɛlɛ bɛ wɔ buluku ɛhye anu a. 31Mɔɔ bɛhɛlɛ ye wɔ ɛke la, bɛhɛlɛ amaa bɛalie bɛali kɛ Gyisɛse a le Mɛzaya ne mɔɔ le Nyamenle Ara ne la, na ɔlua bɛ diedi mɔɔ bɛlɛ ye wɔ ye nu la azo bɛanyia ngoane.

Title: DW 21
Content:
Gyisɛse ye ɔ nwo ahile ɛdoavolɛma nsuu
1Ɛhye anzi, Gyisɛse eza yele ɔ nwo hilele ɛdoavolɛma ne wɔ Taebilease Tandane ne anloa. Kɛ ɔyɛle la ɛne: 2Saemɔn Pita, Tɔmase, mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Nda, Natanayɛle, mɔɔ vi Kana mɔɔ wɔ Galeli maanzinli nu la, Zɛbɛdi amra ne mɔ, yɛɛ Gyisɛse ɛdoavolɛma gyɛne nwiɔ, bɛ muala bɛwɔ ɛkɛ. 3 Saemɔn Pita zele bɛ kɛ, “Mekɔ azule zo.”
Bɛzele ye kɛ, “Yɛ nee wɔ kɔ.” Zɔhane ati bɛ muala bɛhɔvale ɛlɛne na bɛhɔle, na nɔe ne amuala bɛyɛle biala na bɛangye fɛlɛ. 4Mɔɔ sɛnzɛne ne ɛlɛba aradudu la, Gyisɛse ragyinlanle tandane ne anloa, noko ɛdoavolɛma ne annwu kɛ ɔdaye ɔ. 5Na ɔbizale bɛ kɛ, “Mgbavolɛ ye mɔ, bɛhyele fɛlɛ ɔ?”
Bɛbuale ye kɛ, “Yɛannyia debie!”
6 Gyisɛse zele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛdo bɛ avonle ne wɔ bɛ sa fema zo ɛkɛ ne, na bɛkɛhye bie.” Amgba bɛdole avonle ne bɛ fema zo, na fɛlɛ ngome mɔɔ bɛhyele la ammaa bɛangola avonle ne twehwe gua ɛlɛne ne anu.
7Ɛdoavolɛ ne mɔɔ Gyisɛse kulo ye edwɛkɛ la hanle hilele Pita kɛ, “Awulae ɔ.” Saemɔn Pita dele kɛ Awulae la, ɔvale ye anwuma tɛladeɛ ne ɔwulale (ɔluakɛ ɛnee yekpa yegua) na ɔwulule ɔdɔle azule ne anu ɔweɛle ɔrale file zo. 8Ɛdoavolɛma ne mɔ mɔɔ hale la vale ɛlɛne ne radwule aze, bɛhwenle avonle ne mɔɔ fɛlɛ ɛyi ye tɔ la bɛrale. Ɛnee bɛ nee aze anwa biala, ɔkɛyɛ abɛsamu abulanlu. 9Mɔɔ bɛdwule aze la, bɛnwunle kɛ bɛva emunlike bɛwuda senle na fɛlɛ gua zo yɛɛ kpanwo noko wɔ ɛkɛ. 10Gyisɛse zele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛva fɛlɛ ne mɔɔ bɛhye bɛ kɛkala la bie bɛrɛla.”
11Saemɔn Pita hɔle ɛlɛne ne anu na ɔhɔhwehwenle avonle ne ɔrale file zo, fɛlɛ mgbole ɛya ko abulanlu nee nsa ɛyi ye tɛkɛɛ! Bɛhyele fɛlɛ dɔɔnwo, noko avonle ne anye ko bɔbɔ ande.
12Gyisɛse zele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛrɛla bɛrali debie.” Ɛdoavolɛma ne anu biala angola ambiza ye kɛ, “Na ɛdawɔ a le nwane?” Ɔluakɛ bɛze kɛ Awulae ɔ. 13Na Gyisɛse hɔvale kpanwo ne, na ɔbubule ɔmanle bɛ; eza ɔhɔvale fɛlɛ ne, na ɔyɛle ye zɔhane ala.
14Ɛhye a tɔ zolɛ nsa mɔɔ Gyisɛse yele ɔ nwo hilele ye ɛdoavolɛma ne mɔ wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛdwazole ye bɛvile ewule nu la a.
Gyisɛse nee Pita
15Bɛwiele debie di la, Gyisɛse zele Saemɔn Pita kɛ, “Dwɔn ara Saemɔn, asoo ɛkulo me kpalɛ ɛtɛla ɛhye mɔ?”
Pita buale ye kɛ, “Ɛhɛe, Awulae, ɛze kɛ mekulo wɔ.”
Gyisɛse zele ye kɛ, “Nea me mboane mralɛ ne mɔ boɛ.” 16Gyisɛse eza bizale Pita kɛ, “Dwɔn ara Saemɔn, asoo ɛkulo me?”
Pita buale kɛ, “Ɛhɛe, Awulae, ɛze kɛ mekulo wɔ.”
Gyisɛse zele ye kɛ, “Nea me mboane ne mɔ boɛ.” 17Fane nsa ne azo eza Gyisɛse bizale Pita kɛ, “Dwɔn ara Saemɔn, asoo ɛkulo me?”
Nyane hanle Pita kɛ Gyisɛse ɛbiza ye fane nsa kɛ, “Asoo ɛkulo me?” a, na ɔbuale ye kɛ, “Awulae ɛze debie biala; ɛze kɛ mekulo wɔ.”
Gyisɛse zele ye kɛ, “Nea me mboane ne mɔ boɛ. 18Meka nɔhalɛ ne meahile wɔ: Mekɛ mɔɔ ɛle kpavolɛ la, ɛnee ɛdawɔ ɛkola ɛmaa ɛ nwo zo ɛkɔ ɛleka biala mɔɔ ɛkulo la, na saa ɛyɛ kpanyinli a, ɛbadenrɛ ɛ sa na awie akyekye bɛ na yeava wɔ yeahɔ ɛleka mɔɔ ɛngulo kɛ ɛkɔ la.” 19(Gyisɛse hanle ɛhye hilele adenle holɛ ko mɔɔ Pita balua zo awu awula Nyamenle anyunlunyia la.) Akee Gyisɛse zele Pita kɛ, “Bɛla maa yɛhɔ!”
Gyisɛse nee ɛdoavolɛ ko ne
20Pita hakyile ɔ nwo na ɔnwunle kɛ ɛdoavolɛ ko ne mɔɔ Gyisɛse kulo ye edwɛkɛ la doa bɛ. Ɛdoavolɛ ɛhye ala a mekɛ mɔɔ bɛdi aleɛ ne la, ɔhwenle ɔbikyele Gyisɛse na ɔbizale ye kɛ, “Awulae, nwane a baye wɔ amaa?” la. 21Pita nwunle ye la ɔbizale Gyisɛse kɛ, “Awulae, na nrenya ɛhye ɛ?”
22Gyisɛse buale ye kɛ, “Saa mekulo kɛ ɔtɛnla aze kɔkpula kɛ menwɔra la a, ɔle wɔ edwɛkɛ ɔ? Wɔmɔ baze maa yɛhɔ!”
23Yemɔti edwɛkɛ ne dendenle dwule Gyisɛse ɛdoavolɛma ne mɔ amuala anzo nu kɛ ɛdoavolɛ ɛhye ɛnrɛwu ɛlɛ. Noko Gyisɛse anga ye zɔhane. Ɔse, “Saa mekulo kɛ ɔtɛnla aze kɔkpula kɛ menwɔra la a, ɔle wɔ edwɛkɛ ɔ?”
24Ɛdoavolɛ zɔhane a le ɛdoavolɛ ne mɔɔ ɛlɛka edwɛkɛ ɛhye mɔ la, yemɔ noko ala a eza hɛlɛle a, na yɛze kɛ mɔɔ yeha la le nɔhalɛ.
Adwulaleɛ
25Akee ninyɛne dɔɔnwo wɔ ɛkɛ ne mɔɔ Gyisɛse yɛle a. Saa bɛhɛlɛle bɛ muala ngoko ngoko a anrɛɛ menea a nwolɛ mbuluku ɛnrɛzo ewiade ye amuala anu.

Title: GYI MUKENYE
Content:
Mukenye
Ɛzoanvolɛma Gyima ne le Luku Edwɛkpa ne nzɔzo. Mɔɔ buluku ne gyi zolɛ ɛsesebɛ la a le kɛ Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne zile manle Gyisɛse ɛdoavolɛma mɔɔ lumua la bɔle Gyisɛse anwo Edwɛkpa ne nolo “wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm nee Dwudiya amuala nee Samɛlea bɛhɔdwule aleɛabo ɛleka biala” la (1.8). Ɔle Keleseɛn fane ne abobɔlɛ wɔ Dwuuma avinli na ɔkile kɛ ɔzile ɔhɔle zolɛ na ɔrayɛle ewiade amra amuala diedi la anwo edwɛkɛ. Ahenle mɔɔ hɛlɛle la eza kulo kɛ ye kengavolɛma nwu kɛ Keleseɛnema anyɛ Wulomu maanle maanle ne anwo asiayɛ, yɛɛ bɛanyɛ bɛ nwo maanyɛlɛ fane bie mɔɔ kulo kɛ ɔdidi Wulomu maanle maanle ne mɔ abo a, na bɛkile kɛ Keleseɛn diedi ne si Dwuuma nyamenlezonlenlɛ ne pi.
Ɛzoanvolɛma Gyima ne gua ekpunli nsa, na ɔkile kɛ Edwɛkpa ne mɔɔ fane Gyisɛse anwo la anwo nolo zile dɛlɛle na ɔrayɛle asɔne la: (1) Keleseɛn fane ne abobɔlɛ wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ Gyisɛse hɔle anwuma la, (2) ye ɛdɛlɛlɛ mɔɔ ɔdɛlɛle ɔhɔdwule Palɛsetanye afoa nu; nee (3) ye ɛdɛlɛlɛ bieko mɔɔ ɔdɛlɛle ɔhɔdwule Mɛdetɛlenia maanle maanle ne mɔ anu toonwo ɔhɔdwule Wulomu sua zo la.
Debie ko mɔɔ hyia Ɛzoanvolɛma Gyima ne anu la a le Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne gyima kpole mɔɔ di la; bɛhile ɛhye wɔ ndenle ngakyile dɔɔnwo anu wɔ buluku ne anu. Ɔvale tumi ɔrɛlɛle diedima ne wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm wɔ Pɛntekɔso kenle ne na ɔzinzale bɛ ɔmanle bɛ nee bɛ asɔne mgbanyima ne mɔ anwosesebɛ wɔ bɛ gyimalilɛ nu. Keleseɛnema mɔɔ lumua la nrɛlaleɛ ne bɛhɛlɛ ye sikalɛ wɔ Nyamenle edwɛkɛ ne nolobɔlɛ dɔɔnwo anu, na mɔɔ bɛhɛlɛ ye wɔ Ɛzoanvolɛma Gyima ne anu la kile tumi mɔɔ wɔ nrɛlaleɛ ne anu wɔ diedima ne ɛbɛlabɔlɛ nee asɔne ne koyɛlɛ nu la.
Mɔɔ wɔ nu la
Anwomoalɛ wɔ edwɛkɛ ne ɛhanlɛ nu 1.1-26
1. Gyisɛse edwɛkɛ mɔɔ li amozi nee ye ɛwɔkɛ ne 1.1-14
2 Dwudase Kɔliagya 1.15-26
Edwɛkɛ ne ɛhanlɛ wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm 2.1—8.3
Edwɛkɛ ne ɛhanlɛ wɔ Dwudiya nee Samɛlea 8.4—12.25
Pɔɔlo ɛzonlenlɛ nwo edwɛkɛ 13.1—28.31
1. Edwɛkpa ne anwo adendulɛ mɔɔ lumua 13.1—14.28
2. Gyɛlusalɛm ayia kpole ne 15.1-35
3. Edwɛkpa ne anwo adendulɛ mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nwiɔ 15.36—18.22
4. Edwɛkpa ne anwo adendulɛ mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nsa 18.23—21.16
5. Pɔɔlo efiadelalɛ wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm, Sizalia yɛɛ Wulomu 21.17—28.31

Title: GYI 1
Content:
1 Nana Tiyɔfelɛse:
Wɔ me alumua buluku ne anu, menganle ninyɛne mɔɔ Gyisɛse yɛle nee mɔɔ ɔhilehilele la anwo edwɛkɛ 2ɔhɔdwule mekɛ mɔɔ bɛvale ye bɛhɔle anwuma la. Mɔɔ bɛbava ye bɛahɔ anwuma la, ɔluale Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne azo ɔhilehilele ye ɛzoanvolɛma ne mɔɔ yekpa nu yeye bɛ la debie mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛyɛ la amuala. 3Bɛdwazole ye bɛvile ewule nu la, ɔyele ɔ nwo ɔhilele bɛ wɔ ndenle dɔɔnwo anu kenle abulanla ɔmanle bɛnwunle ye wienyi kɛ ɔde aze, na ɔhanle Nyamenle Belemgbunlililɛ ne anwo edwɛkɛ ɔhilele bɛ. 4 Mekɛ mɔɔ ɔ nee bɛ yiale la ɔhanle ɔhilele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛmmatu bɛ bo bɛfi Gyɛlusalɛm, na bɛhendɛ Egya ahyɛlɛdeɛ ne mɔɔ yeva yebɔ bɛ ɛwɔkɛ na meha nwolɛ edwɛkɛ mehile bɛ la. 5 Dwɔn vale nzule a zɔnenle a, na bɛmɛ, ɔnrɛhyɛ biala, bɛbava Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne a bɛazɔne bɛ a.”
Bɛva Gyisɛse bɛhɔ Anwuma
6Mɔɔ ɛzoanvolɛma ne nee Gyisɛse yiale nu la bɛbizale ye kɛ, “Awulae, akee mekɛ ɛdwu mɔɔ ɛbava Belemgbunlililɛ ne wɔamaa Yizilayɛma bieko ɔ?”
7Gyisɛse buale bɛ kɛ, “Egya a kyehyɛ mekɛ nee ɛlobɔ muala a, yemɔti ɔngyia kɛ bɛkɛnwu kenle mɔɔ ɛhye mɔ kɛzi la. 8 Na saa Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne ba bɛ nwo zo a bɛbanyia tumi, na bɛali me nwo daselɛ wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm, nee Dwudiya amuala nee Samɛlea bɛahɔdwu aleɛabo ɛleka biala.” 9 Mɔɔ ɔhanle ɛhye la, bɛmanle ye zo anwuma, na mɔɔ bɛ nye gyi ɔ nwo ala la amungu liele ye vile bɛ nye zo.
10Bɛ nye hale anwomanyunlu, na arɛlevilɛ nu ala mrenya nwiɔ mɔɔ wula adɛladeɛ fufule la ragyinlanle bɛ nwo ɛkɛ ne na bɛzele ɛzoanvolɛma ne kɛ, 11“Galelima, duzu ati a bɛgyi ɛke na bɛ nye ɛha anwuma ɛ? Gyisɛse ɛhye mɔɔ bɛrava ye wɔ bɛ avinli ɛke bɛhɔ anwuma la bazia alua adenle zɔhane ala azo ara bieko, kɛmɔ bɛnwu ye kɛ ɔlɛkɔ la.”
Dwudase kɔliagya
12Ɛzoanvolɛma ne vi boka ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Ɔlivi la azo ziale rale Gyɛlusalɛm; adenle ne kɛyɛ kilomita ko. 13 Bɛdwule la, bɛhɔle anwuma sua ne mɔɔ ɛnee bɛwɔ nu la anu. Bɛmɛ a le: Pita, Dwɔn, Gyemise yɛɛ Andelu; Saemɔn mɔɔ le Maanle Kulovolɛ ne yɛɛ Felepe nee Tɔmase; Baatɔlomiyu, Mateyu, Afeɛse ara Gyemise, yɛɛ Dwudase mɔɔ le Gyemise ara ne. 14Bɛ muala bɛyia nu dahuu na bɛfa koyɛlɛ bɛ nee mraalɛ ne mɔ yɛɛ Mɛle mɔɔ le Gyisɛse ɔ nli ne nee ɔ mediema mrenya ne mɔ yɛ nzɛlɛlɛ.
15Mekɛ ne anu diedima ne yiale nu. Bɛ nloa kɛyɛ ɛya ko abulanwiɔ. Pita dwazole zele bɛ kɛ, 16“Ayi mɔ, ɔwɔ kɛ Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne luale Belemgbunli Devidi anwo zo hanle dole ɛkɛ ne, mɔɔ fane Dwudase mɔɔ lile menli mɔɔ rahyele Gyisɛse la anyunlu la anwo la yɛ nɔhalɛ. 17Ɔluakɛ ɛnee Dwudase boka yɛ nwo wɔ gyima ɛhye anu.”
18 (Ezukoa ne mɔɔ Dwudase luale ye ninyɛndane zo liele la, ɔvale ɔdɔle azɛlɛ, na ɛkɛ ne a ɔvuandinle ɔ nwo ɔdele, ɔ ko kpukele na ɔ kunlu anyalɛ muala tulule guale na ɔwule a. 19Awie biala mɔɔ de Gyɛlusalɛm la dele ɛhye. Yemɔti bɛvɛlɛle azɛlɛ ne wɔ Hibulu aneɛ nu “Akɛledɛma.” Ɔ bo a le “Mogya azɛlɛ.”)
20 “Ɔluakɛ bɛhɛlɛ ye wɔ Edwɛndolɛ Buluku ne anu kɛ,
‘Bɛmaa ye awuke ɛbɔ;
awie mmatɛnla nu ɛlɛ.’
Eza bɛhɛlɛ ye kɛ,
‘Bɛmaa awie fofolɛ ɛli ɔ gyakɛ anu.’
21-22 “Zɔhane ati, bɛdabɛ mɔɔ ɛnee bɛboka yɛ nwo, ɔvi mekɛ mɔɔ Dwɔn bɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɔsɔne menli nee mekɛ mɔɔ Gyisɛse yɛ ye gyima ne, bakpula mekɛ mɔɔ bɛvale Awulae bɛhɔle anwuma la amuala, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛ nuhua ko baboka yɛ nwo maa yɛdi Awulae ewudwazo ne anwo daselɛ.”
23Yemɔti bɛzuzule menli nwiɔ, Dwosefi mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Baasabase (na eza ɔyɛ a bɛfɛlɛ ye Gyɛsetɛse la) nee Matayase. 24Bɛyɛle nzɛlɛlɛ bɛzele kɛ, “Awulae, wɔmɔ yɛɛ ɛze menli kɔsɔɔti ahonle nu a. Zɔhane ati Awulae, ɛdawɔ kilehile yɛ maa yɛye menli nwiɔ ye anu ko mɔɔ wɔvɛlɛ ye la, 25maa ɔrayɛ wɔ ɛzoanvolɛ, ɔli gyima ne mɔɔ Dwudase gyakyile ziele ahane hɔle ye ɛdeɛ nu la.” 26Na bɛguale menli nwiɔ ne ati nzeleba la ɔbɔle Matayase. Yemɔti bɛvale ye bɛbokale ɛzoanvolɛma bulu nee ko ne anwo.

Title: GYI 2
Content:
Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne ɛralɛ
1 Mɔɔ Pɛntekɔso kenle ne dwule la, ɛnee diedima ne amuala ɛboa bɛ nloa ɛleka ko. 2Na arɛlevilɛ nu ala alɛra bie vi anwuma kɛ ahumu kpole bie la rayile sua ne mɔɔ bɛwɔ nu la. 3Na bɛnwunle kɛ debie mɔɔ le kɛ senle ndafinlima la zandele na bɛzinzele bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ ɛkɛ ne la ati zo ngoko ngoko. 4Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne rayile bɛ tɛkɛɛ na bɛbɔle ɔ bo kɛ bɛka aneɛ ngakyile, kɛmɔ Sunsum ne vale manle bɛ kɛ bɛha la.
5Dwuuma mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛzonlenlɛ ti bɛvi maanle gyɛne gyɛne nu bɛrale la tɛbɔ Gyɛlusalɛm. 6Mɔɔ bɛdele ɛnelɛ ɛhye la, bɛ nuhua dɔɔnwo kpalɛ rale ɛkɛ, na ɔyɛle bɛ ɛzulolɛ kpole; ɔluakɛ bɛ nuhua ko biala dele kɛ diedima ne ɛlɛka ye sua zo aneɛ ne bie. 7Ɔyɛle bɛ nwanwane ɔmanle bɛhanle kɛ, “Na menli ɛhye mɔ, se bɛ muala bɛle Galelima o? 8Na kɛ ɔyɛ mɔɔ akee yɛte kɛ bɛlɛka yɛdayɛ yɛ maanle nu aneɛ ɛ? 9Yɛdayɛ mɔɔ yɛvi Patea, Medea, yɛɛ Yilam, Mɛsɔpɔteemea, Dwudiya, yɛɛ Kapadosea, Pɔntɛse, yɛɛ Ehyea, 10Felegyea, Pamefelea, Yigyibiti nee Lebea maanzinli ne mɔɔ bikye Saelin. Yɛ bie mɔ noko vi Wulomu, 11Dwuuma nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma na bɛhakyi bɛsonle Dwuuma Nyamenle ne la, Kilitima nee Areleebeama, noko yɛ muala yɛte kɛ bɛlɛfa yɛ maanle nu aneɛ bɛaha ninyɛne mgbole mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛyɛ la.” 12Na azibɛnwo nu ala, bɛbizale kɛ, “Ɛnee ɛhye abo a le duzu?”
13Na bie mɔ golole bɛ nwo na bɛzele kɛ, “Menli ɛhye mɔ ɛbo nza.”
Pita tendɛ ahile menli ne
14Na Pita nee ɛzoanvolɛma bulu nee ko ne mɔɔ hale la dwazole na ɔmanle ɔ ne zo ɔzele ɛlɔne ne kɛ, “Ebiamɔ Dwuuma nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ Gyɛlusalɛm ɛke la amuala, bɛdie bɛmaa mengile bɛ ɛhye mɔ abo. 15Menli ɛhye mɔ ɛtɛbole nza, kɛmɔ bɛ adwenle yɛ bɛ la, ɔluakɛ aleɛ hyenle la bɔ zo mɔɔ dɔne ngɔnla ɛbɔ a. 16Na ɛhye a le mɔɔ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ Dwowɛle hanle dole ɛkɛ ne la. Ɔse,
17 ‘Nyamenle se, mɔɔ mebayɛ wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ li awieleɛ
la ɛne.
Mebamaa me Sunsum ne ara menli muala anwo zo.
Na bɛ mra mrenya nee mraalɛ baha Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ.
Bɛ mgbavolɛ banwu ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ,
na bɛ mrenya mgbanyinli aha ɛlalɛ.
18Ɛhɛe, mebamaa me Sunsum ne ara me ngɛkɛlɛ
mrenya nee mraalɛ anwo zo,
na bɛaha Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ ne.
19Mebayɛ nwanwane ninyɛne wɔ anwomanyunlu
na meayɛ sɛkɛlɛneɛ wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo.
Bɛbanwu mogya, senle, yɛɛ esike mungumungu.
20Sɛnzɛne ne bayɛ awozinli,
na siane ne ayɛ yɔɔnwo kɛ mogya,
kolaa na Awulae anyunlunyia kenle kpole ne adwu.
21Na ɔbara kɛ awie biala mɔɔ kɛbɔ Awulae duma
la bɛkɛlie ye ngoane.’
22“Yizilayɛma, bɛdie! Gyisɛse mɔɔ vi Nazalɛte la le sonla mɔɔ Nyamenle yele ye manle bɛ a; ɔluale ɔ nwo zo ɔlile gyima mgbole, ɔyɛle nwanwane ninyɛne nee sɛkɛlɛneɛ wɔ bɛdabɛ bɛ nye zo, mɔɔ bɛdabɛ bɛze a. 23 Nyamenle ɔdaye ye ɛhulolɛ zo, ɔliele ɔdole nu kɛ bɛkɛye Gyisɛse bɛkɛmaa bɛ; yɛɛ bɛdabɛ noko bɛmanle menli mɔɔ ɛnze Nyamenle la bɔle ye meanubaka nu hunle ye a. 24 Na Nyamenle dwazole ye vile mɔwuamra anu na ɔyele ye ɔvile ewule asa nu; ɔluakɛ ɔnle kɛ ewule di ɔ nwo zo konim. 25 Devidi ɛha ɔ nwo edwɛkɛ kɛ,
‘Menwu Awulae dahuu kɛ ɔgyi me sa fema zo, yemɔti
menzulo.
26Ɛhye ati medi fɛlɛko me ahonle nu,
na me nwo sande me wɔ me ɛdendɛlɛ nu,
kɛ medame zɛhae ala, mɔɔ ewule a fɛta me la mede
anyelazo nu;
27Ɔluakɛ wɔmɔ Nyamenle,
ɛnrɛgyakyi me ɛkɛla wɔ mɔwuamra anu,
yɛɛ ɛnrɛmaa wɔ Nwuanzanwuanza Ko ne nwonane
ɛnrɛkpɔlɔ.
28Wɔhile me ngoane adenle ne,
na medi fɛlɛko kɛ ɛ nee me lua.’
29“Mediema, bɛmaa menga ye wienyi mengile bɛ kɛ yɛ ze Devidi wule na bɛziele ye, na ye sɛka wɔ ɛkɛ kɛkala. 30 Ɔle Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ yɛɛ ɔze ɛwɔkɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛbɔ ye a: Nyamenle hanle ndane dole zolɛ kɛ ɔbamaa Devidi abo zo amra ne bie ali belemgbunli kɛ ɔdaye Devidi la. 31Devidi noko nwunle mɔɔ Nyamenle bayɛ la, yemɔti a ɔhanle Mɛzaya ne ewudwazo ne anwo edwɛkɛ kɛ,
‘Bɛangyakyi ye wɔ mɔwuamra anu,
yɛɛ ye nwonane amkpɔlɔ.’
32Nyamenle ɛdwazo Gyisɛse ɛhye ɛvi mɔwuamra anu, kɛmɔ yɛ muala yɛdi nwolɛ daselɛ la. 33Bɛmaa ye zo bɛzie Nyamenle asa fema zo, na yenyia Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne, kɛmɔ ɔze vale bɔle ye ɛwɔkɛ la; na mɔɔ bɛnwu ye nee mɔɔ kɛkala bɛte la a le ye ahyɛlɛdeɛ mɔɔ yeva yemaa yɛ la a. 34 Ɔluakɛ Devidi ɔdaye mumua ne yeangɔ anwuma, noko ɔhanle ɔdole ɛkɛ ne kɛ,
‘Awulae Nyamenle ne zele me Awulae kɛ,
tɛnla me sa fema zo ɛke,
35kɔkpula kɛ menwɔva wɔ agbɔvolɛ muala
menwɔwula ɛ gyakɛ abo.’
36“Zɔhane ati, bɛmaa Yizilayɛma amuala ɛnwu ye wienyi kɛ, Gyisɛse ɛhye mɔɔ bɛbɔle ye meanubaka nu la, yemɔ ala yɛɛ Nyamenle ɛyɛ ye Awulae nee Mɛzaya a.”
37Mɔɔ menli ne dele ɛhye la, ɛzulolɛ kpole hanle bɛ na bɛbizale Pita nee ɛzoanvolɛma ne mɔ kɛ, “Ayi mɔ, duzu a ɔwɔ kɛ yɛyɛ a?”
38Pita zele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛnlu bɛ nwo na bɛgyakyi ɛtane ɛyɛlɛ, na bɛmaa bɛzɔne bɛ wɔ Gyisɛse Kelaese duma nu, amaa bɛava bɛ ɛtane bɛahyɛ bɛ na bɛanyia Nyamenle ahyɛlɛdeɛ ne, mɔɔ le Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne. 39Ɔluakɛ Nyamenle ɛwɔkɛ ne le bɛ nee bɛ mra nee menli mɔɔ wɔ ɛleka muala, mɔɔ yɛ Awulae Nyamenle ne kɛvɛlɛ bɛ la ɛdeɛ.”
40Na Pita hɔle zolɛ hanle edwɛkɛ dɔɔnwo hilele bɛ na ɔdule bɛ folɛ kɛ, “Bɛhwe bɛ nwo bɛvi amaneɛ mɔɔ amumuyɛma ɛhye mɔ banwu ye la anu.” 41Bie mɔ dɔɔnwo liele lile na bɛmanle bɛzɔnenle bɛ. Na kenle ko ne menli kɛyɛ apenle nsa rabokale ekpunli ne anwo. 42Na bɛdule bɛ nwo bɛmanle ɛzoanvolɛma ne ngilehilelɛ ne, bɛ nee bɛ zonlenle, na bɛbɔle nu bɛlile debie wɔ mediema ɛyɛlɛ nu.
Diedima ne ɛdɛnlalɛ
43Ɛzoanvolɛma ne mɔ yɛle nwanwane ninyɛne dɔɔnwo manle ɔyɛle awie biala ɛzulolɛ nee azibɛnwo. 44 Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛliele Gyisɛse bɛlile la lile ahua na bɛhyɛle ninyɛne mɔɔ bɛlɛ la bɛmanle bɛ nwo. 45Bɛdɔnedɔnenle bɛ nwo ninyɛne nee bɛ agyadeɛ ne mɔ na bɛhyɛle ezukoa ne bɛmanle bɛ muala, kɛmɔ biala ɛhyianlɛ de la. 46Kenle biala bɛyia nu wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu bɛyɛ nzɛlɛlɛ, bɛbɔ nu bɛdi debie wɔ koyɛlɛ nu, 47na bɛye Nyamenle ayɛlɛ. Bɛnyianle bɛ nyunlu wɔ menli kɔsɔɔti avinli, na dahuu Awulae fa menli mɔɔ bɛlɛdie bɛ ngoane la baboka bɛ nwo.

Title: GYI 3
Content:
Bɛyɛ abubura bie ayile
1Kenle ko Pita nee Dwɔn kɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu wɔ ewiazo dɔne nsa nzɛlɛlɛ mekɛ ne anu la, 2bɛhɔdole nrenya bie mɔɔ bɛwole ye abubura la. Dahuu bɛsoa ye bɛba Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anuhɔlɛ ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye “Anlenkɛ Kɛnlɛma” la anloa bɛmaa ɔsɛlɛzɛlɛ menli mɔɔ ɛlɛkɔ nu la ninyɛne. 3Ɔnwunle Pita nee Dwɔn kɛ bɛlɛkɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu la, ɔzɛlɛle bɛ kɛ bɛhyɛ ye debie. 4Bɛnleanle ye koonwu, na Pita zele ye kɛ, “Nea yɛ!” 5Ɔnleanle bɛ, na ɔdwenlenle kɛ bɛbahyɛ ye debie. 6Na Pita zele ye kɛ, “Menlɛ ezukoa fee, na mɔɔ melɛ ye la a mefa meamaa wɔ la. Ɔlua Gyisɛse Kelaese mɔɔ vi Nazalɛte la duma nu, mese wɔ kɛ, dwazo tia!” 7Ɔzɔle ɔ sa fema ne ɔdwazole ye, na ɛkɛ ne ala ɔ gyakɛ nee ye adwongu ne mɔ anu mianle, 8ɔwulule ɔpenle na ɔbɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɔtia. Ɔ nee bɛ hɔle Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu, na ɔwuluwulule ɔyele Nyamenle ayɛlɛ. 9Menli ne amuala nwunle kɛ ɔlɛwuluwulu ɔye Nyamenle ayɛlɛ, 10na nzinlii mɔɔ akee bɛnwunle kɛ sonla ne mɔɔ anrɛɛ tɛnla sɛlɛzɛlɛ ninyɛne wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anuhɔlɛ ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye “Anlenkɛ Kɛnlɛma” la anloa la, ɔyɛle bɛ azibɛnwo, na mobolɛ kpole bole bɛ wɔ mɔɔ ɛzi la anwo.
Pita tendɛ ahile menli mɔɔ wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu la
11Mɔɔ nrenya ne doa Pita nee Dwɔn la, ɔyɛle menli ne nwanwane ɔmanle dɔɔnwo nriandile hɔyiale bɛ wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne “Sɔlɔmɔn Kpɔda” ne abo. 12Pita nwunle bɛ la ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Yizilayɛma, duzu ati a ɛhye ɛyɛ bɛ azibɛnwo na bɛ nye ɛha yɛ nwo ɛ? Anzɛɛ bɛdwenle kɛ yɛdayɛ yɛ anwosesebɛ nee yɛ ɛzonlenlɛ kpalɛ zo, yɛɛ yɛlua mɔɔ yɛmaa nrenya ɛhye ɛdia a? 13 Ebileham, Ayezeke nee Gyekɔbo bɛ Nyamenle ne, nee yɛ nlenya mɔ Nyamenle ne yɛɛ ɛwula ye Sonvolɛ Gyisɛse anyunlunyia a. Bɛyele ye bɛmanle mgbanyima ne mɔ na bɛkpole ye wɔ Paelɛte anyunlu, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee Paelɛte mumua ne kulo kɛ ɔgyakyi ye la. 14 Ɔle sonlakpalɛ mɔɔ anwo te a, noko bɛkpole ye, na bɛkpale Paelɛte kyɛlɛ kɛ ɔdwula kɔdiawu ne ɔmaa bɛ. 15Bɛhunle sonla ne mɔɔ maa ngoane la, na Nyamenle dwazole ye vile mɔwuamra anu; yɛ muala yɛdi ɛhye anwo daselɛ. 16Gyisɛse ɛhye duma nu nee ye tumi zo nee diedi wɔ ye duma ne anu yɛɛ nrenya ɛhye ɛnɛ gyi bɛ nyunlu ɛke kɛ yede kpɔkɛ bɔkɔɔ a.
17“Na mediema, meze kɛ mɔɔ bɛ nee bɛ mgbanyima ne mɔ yɛle Gyisɛse la, tɛ bɛ ɔ. 18Nyamenle luale ye kpɔmanvolɛma anwo zo hanle dole ɛkɛ ne dɛba, kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ Mɛzaya ne nwu amaneɛ, yemɔti a ɔmanle ɔrale ye zɔhane a. 19Zɔhane ati bɛnlu bɛ nwo na bɛzia bɛrɛla Nyamenle ɛkɛ, amaa yeava bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ amuala yeahyɛ bɛ, 20na mekɛ dwu a Awulae arɛlɛ bɛ Sunsum nu anwosesebɛ, na yeava Mɛzaya ne, mɔɔ le Gyisɛse, mɔɔ yeye ye dɛba yemaa bɛ la yɛarɛlɛ bɛ. 21Ɔwɔ kɛ ɔtɛnla anwuma lɔ kɔkpula kɛ bɛkɛyɛ ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti fofolɛ, kɛmɔ Nyamenle ɛlua ye kpɔmanvolɛma nwuanzanwuanza ne mɔ anwo zo ɛha ye dɛba la. 22 Mosisi hanle kɛ, ‘Awulae bɛ Nyamenle ne baye kpɔmanvolɛ avi bɛ avinli na yeazoa ye wɔ bɛ nwo ɛkɛ, kɛmɔ yezoa me la, na ɔwɔ kɛ bɛtie ye na bɛdi mɔɔ ɔkɛha ɔkɛhile bɛ la amuala azo. 23 Awie biala mɔɔ andie kpɔmanvolɛ zɔhane la, bɛbaye ye bɛavi Nyamenle menli ne avinli na bɛazɛkye ye.’ 24Eza Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma, Samoɛle nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛli ɔ nzi la amuala, biala hanle mekɛ ɛhye anwo edwɛkɛ. 25 Nyamenle ɛwɔkɛ ne mɔɔ ɔluale ye kpɔmanvolɛma anwo zo ɔbɔle la le bɛ ɛdeɛ, yɛɛ ngyekyeleɛ ne mɔɔ Nyamenle nee bɛ nlenya mɔ kyekyele la, bɛwɔ nu bie, ɔluakɛ ɔhanle ɔhilele Ebileham kɛ, ‘Ɛ bo zo amra anwo zo yɛɛ mebalua meayila maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti a.’ 26Yemɔti Nyamenle yele ye Sonvolɛ ne na ɔzoanle ye ɔmanle ɔlumuale ɔrale bɛ ɛkɛ kɛ ɔmaa awie biala ɛhwe ɔ nwo ɛvi ɛtane nwo na ɔyila bɛ.”

Title: GYI 4
Content:
Pita nee Dwɔn gyi mgbanyima ayia ne anyunlu
1Mɔɔ Pita nee Dwɔn anloa wɔ zolɛ bɛlɛtendɛ bɛahile menli ne mɔ la, sɛlɛvolɛma bie nee Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne neavolɛ kpanyinli ne nee Sadusiima fane ne anu amra bie mɔ ravindele bɛ nwo zo. 2Bɛvale ɛya kpole, ɔluakɛ ɛnee ɛzoanvolɛma ne ɛlɛkilehile menli ne mɔ kɛ Gyisɛse ɛdwazo ɛvi ewule nu, na ɔle sɛkɛlɛneɛ mɔɔ kile kɛ mɔwuamra badwazo ara ngoane nu bieko a. 3Ɛhye ati bɛhyele bɛ bɛhɔguale efiade kɛ aleɛ kye a bɛ nee bɛ kɛli, ɔluakɛ ɛnee aleɛ ɛdwo. 4Na bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdele edwɛkɛ ne la anu dɔɔnwo liele lile na bɛkɛyɛ mrenya apenle nnu.
5Aleɛ hyenle la Dwuu mgbanyima ne nee asɔne ne anu adile adile ne mɔ nee mɛla kilehilevolɛma ne yiale Gyɛlusalɛm. 6Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ ɛnee bɛwɔ ɛkɛ ne bie la a le Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli Anase nee Kayafase, Dwɔn, Alɛzanda, yɛɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛvi Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli ne abusua nu la. 7Bɛmanle ɛzoanvolɛma nwiɔ ne ragyinlanle bɛ nyunlu ɛkɛ ne na bɛbizale bɛ kɛ, “Kɛ bɛzile bɛyɛle nrenya ye ayile ɛ? Tumi boni azo anzɛɛ duma boni anu a bɛluale bɛyɛle zɛhae gyima a?”
8Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne vale Pita nyinle, na ɔbuale bɛ kɛ, “Nana mɔ nee egya mɔ, 9saa ɛnɛ kenle ye bɛlɛbiza yɛ kpalɛ mɔɔ yɛyɛ yɛmaa nrenya abubura ye nee kɛ yɛzile yɛyɛle ye ayile la a, 10ɛnee bɛdie bɛmaa ɔdo Yizilayɛma kɔsɔɔti kɛ, ɔlua Gyisɛse Kelaese mɔɔ vi Nazalɛte, mɔɔ bɛmɛ bɛbɔle ye meanubaka nu bɛhunle ye, na Nyamenle dwazole ye vile ewule nu la duma nu a ɛnɛ nrenya ɛhye gyi bɛ nyunlu ɛke kɛ yede kpɔkɛ bɔkɔɔ a. 11 Gyisɛse a le mɔɔ Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne ka ye ɔ nwo kɛ,
‘Bolɛ ne mɔɔ bɛmɛ suasivoma bɛkpole la
ɛrayɛ bolɛ mɔɔ anwo hyia kpole kpalɛ
kɛ sua mgbɛnezo sika la.’
12Ɔ nwo zo yɛɛ yɛlua a yɛkɛnyia ngoane a, ɔluakɛ awie bieko ɛnle aleɛabo mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛva ye duma ɛmaa mɔɔ yɛdua ɔ nwo zo a yɛkɛnyia ngoane a.”
13Ɔyɛle ayiama ne azibɛnwo kɛ Pita nee Dwɔn ɛnyia akɛnrasesebɛ mɔɔ le zɛhae a, ɔluakɛ bɛze kɛ bɛle menli mɔɔ ɛnze nwoma a, na bɛliele bɛdole nu kɛ bɛ nee Gyisɛse a anrɛɛ lua a. 14Eza noko bɛnnwu mɔɔ bɛka a, ɔluakɛ nrenya ne mɔɔ bɛyɛle ye ayile la gyi bɛ nwo ɛkɛ. 15Ɛhye ati bɛvale bɛ bɛziele ahane ekyii, na bɛbɔle ɔ bo kɛ bɛdwenledwenle nwolɛ. 16Bɛbizale bɛ nwo kɛ, “Menli ɛhye mɔ kɛ yɛyɛ bɛ ɛ? Awie biala mɔɔ de Gyɛlusalɛm ɛke la ze kɛ bɛmɛ a bɛyɛ nwanwane gyima mɔɔ le zɛhae a, yɛɛ yɛngola yɛnga kɛ ɔnle zɔhane. 17Na amaa edwɛkɛ ne andende la bɛmaa yɛdua bɛ kɛ bɛmmabɔ Gyisɛse duma bɛka edwɛkɛ bɛkile awie biala bieko.”
18Yemɔti bɛvɛlɛle bɛ na bɛduale bɛ kɛ bɛmmatendɛ menli nu anzɛɛ bɛmmabɔ Gyisɛse duma bɛkilehile menli. 19Na Pita nee Dwɔn buale bɛ kɛ, “Saa ɔle kpalɛ wɔ Nyamenle anyunlu kɛ yɛkɛdie bɛmɛ na yɛkɛgyakyi Nyamenle a ɛnee bɛdabɛ bɛbua; 20na yɛmɛ, mɔɔ yɛde nee mɔɔ yɛnwu ye la, yɛnrɛhola yɛnrɛgyakyi ye ɛhanlɛ!” 21Ayiama ne bɔle bɛ kɔkɔ ɛsesebɛ na bɛgyakyile bɛ kɛ bɛhɔ, ɔluakɛ bɛnlɛ edwɛkɛ kpaziwɔkɛ biala mɔɔ bɛgyinla zolɛ bɛtwe bɛ nzo a ɔyɛ boɛ a, yɛɛ eza menli ne amuala ɛlɛyeyɛ Nyamenle wɔ mɔɔ ɛzi la anwo. 22Nrenya ne mɔɔ ɔlua ɔ nwo zo bɛyɛle nwanwane gyima kpole zɛhae la ɛnee ɛli ɛvolɛ mɔɔ bo abulanla.
Diedima ne sɛlɛ akɛnrasesebɛ avi Nyamenle ɛkɛ
23Mɔɔ bɛgyakyile bɛ la, Pita nee Dwɔn ziale hɔle bɛ gɔnwo mɔ anwo ɛkɛ na bɛhanle mɔɔ sɛlɛvolɛ mgbanyinli nee maanle mgbanyinli ne mɔ hanle la amuala bɛhilele bɛ. 24 Bɛdele edwɛkɛ ne la, bɛ muala bɛbɔle nu bɛzɛlɛle, “O Tumivolɛ Awulae mɔɔ bɔle anwuma nee azɛlɛ, nyevile nee mɔɔ wɔ nu la amuala, 25 ɛluale wɔ Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne anwo zo ɛmanle yɛ nlenya Devidi, wɔ akɛlɛ ne dendɛle zele kɛ,
‘Duzu ati a maanle maanle ɛva ɛya kpole zɛhae a
na menli dwenle adwenle ɛtane zɛhae ɛ?
26Azɛlɛ ye azo arelemgbunli ɛboɔboa bɛ nloa,
maanle mgbanyinli ɛva adwenle ko
na bɛtia Nyamenle nee ye Mɛzaya ne.’
27 Hɛlɔdo nee Pɔnteɛse Paelɛte, nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la, nee menli mɔɔ wɔ Yizilayɛ la amuala yiale nu wɔ suakpole ɛhye azo na bɛvale adwenle bɛtiale wɔ Sonvolɛ Nwuanzanwuanza Gyisɛse mɔɔ wɔyɛ ye Mɛzaya la. 28Bɛyiale nu bɛvale adwenle bɛyɛle debie biala, kɛmɔ ɛdawɔ wɔ tumi ɛhulolɛ ngyehyɛlɛ ne de la. 29Na Awulae, akee nea kɛ bɛlɛsi bɛanwunlonwunla yɛ a. Maa yɛ, wɔ ɛzoanvolɛma, akɛnrasesebɛ maa yɛhola yɛha wɔ Edwɛkpa ne. 30Kile wɔ tumi wɔ ayileyɛlɛ nu, na boa maa yɛlua wɔ Sonvolɛ Nwuanzanwuanza Gyisɛse duma nu yɛyɛ nwanwane ninyɛne.”
31Mɔɔ bɛwiele nzɛlɛlɛ ne yɛ la, ɛleka mɔɔ bɛyiale nu la kpusule. Na Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne rawolole bɛ na bɛnyianle akɛnrasesebɛ kɛ akee bɛka Nyamenle edwɛkɛ ne kpalɛ.
Diedima ne kyɛ bɛ nwo ninyɛne
32 Diedima ne amuala lile ahua wɔ ahonle nee adwenle nu. Bɛ nuhua biala anva ye debie biala ambɔ ye ɛbolɛ na bɛ nee bɛ gɔnwo mɔ hyɛle debie biala mɔɔ ko lɛ ye la. 33Na ɛzoanvolɛma ne vale tumi kpole lile Awulae Gyisɛse ewudwazo ne anwo daselɛ, na Nyamenle lole bɛ nyilalɛ dɔɔnwo. 34Bɛ nuhua biala angyia, ɔluakɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛ ninyɛne mɔɔ le kɛ azɛlɛ anzɛɛ azua la dɔnedɔnenle bɛ, bɛvale ezukoa mɔɔ bɛnyianle ye wɔ nu la 35bɛrɛlɛle ɛzoanvolɛma ne na bɛhyɛle bɛmanle awie biala nyianle bie, kɛmɔ bɛ ɛhyianlɛ ngakyile ne mɔ de la.
36Zɔhane ala yɛɛ Dwosefi ɔdaye noko ɔyɛle a. Nrenya ɛhye boka Livae abusua ne anwo. Bɛwole ye wɔ bɔra ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Saepelɛse la azo na ɛzoanvolɛma ne donle ye Baanabase. (Wɔ Hibulu aneɛ ne anu a duma ne abo a le “Sonla mɔɔ maa akɛnrasesebɛ la.”) 37Dwosefi hɔdɔnenle ye azɛlɛ mɔɔ ɔlɛ la na ɔvale ezukoa mɔɔ ɔnyianle ye wɔ nu la amuala ɔrɛlɛle ɛzoanvolɛma ne.

Title: GYI 5
Content:
Ananayase nee Safaela
1Nrenya ko wɔ ɛkɛ, bɛfɛlɛ ye Ananayase. Ɔ ye bɛfɛlɛ ye Safaela. Bɛdabɛ noko bɛdɔnenle bɛ agyadeɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛ la; 2ɔ nee ɔ ye yɛle adwenle ko, ɔdele ezukoa mɔɔ bɛnyianle ye la bie ɔziele, na ɔvale mɔɔ hale la ɔradole ɛzoanvolɛma ne anyunlu. 3Pita zele ye kɛ, “Ananayase, duzu ati a wɔmaa Seetan ɛvo ɛ nwo zo na yemaa wɔbɛlɛbɛla Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne na wɔde ezukoa mɔɔ ɛnyianle ye la bie wɔvea ɛ? 4Mɔɔ ɛtɛtɔnenle wɔ agyadeɛ ne la, ɛnee ɔle wɔ ɛdeɛ, yɛɛ mɔɔ ɛdɔnenle wɔ agyadeɛ ne la, ɛnee ɔle wɔ ɛdeɛ, yɛɛ mɔɔ ɛdɔnenle ye la, ɛnee ezukoa ne noko le wɔ ɛdeɛ. Na duzu yɛɛ hanle wɔ manle ɛvale adwenle ɛhye a? Adalɛ ɛhye wɔambɔ wɔangile sonla; wɔbɔ wɔhile Nyamenle!” 5Ananayase dele edwɛkɛ ɛhye la, ɔpɛle ɔfinle na ɔwule ɛkɛ ne ala; na ɛzulolɛ kpole hanle bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdele edwɛkɛ ne la amuala. 6Mgbavolɛ ne mɔ dwazole, bɛyɛle ɔ nwo boɛ na bɛhɔziele ye.
7Nzinlii, kɛyɛ dɔnehwele nsa anzi, ɔ ye noko rale; na ɛnee ɔtɛtele mɔɔ ɛzi la anwo bie fee. 8Pita bizale ye kɛ, “Ka nɔhalɛ kile me, ɛ nee ɛ hu bɛ agyadeɛ ne mɔɔ bɛdɔnenle ye la mɔɔ bɛnyianle ye la amuala a le ɛhye ɔ?”
Raalɛ ne buale ye kɛ, “Ɛhɛe, ɔ muala ɔ.”
9Na Pita zele ye kɛ, “Duzu ati a ɛ nee ɛ hu bɛyɛ adwenle ko kɛ bɛbazɔ Awulae Sunsum ne bɛanlea ɛ? Nea, menli mɔɔ hɔziele ɛ hu la agyakɛ abo a ɛte ye wɔ anuhɔlɛ lɔ la, na bɛ nee ɛdawɔ noko bahɔ.” 10Ɛkɛ ne ala ɔdaye noko ɔpɛle ɔfinle Pita anyunlu ɛkɛ na ɔwule. Mɔɔ mgbavolɛ ne mɔ ziale rale la, bɛranwunle kɛ ɔdaye noko yewu, na bɛvale ye bɛhɔziele ye ɔ hu anwo ɛkɛ ne. 11Na ɛzulolɛ kpole hanle diedima ne nee menli mɔɔ dele edwɛkɛ ne la amuala.
Nwanwane ninyɛne nee sɛkɛlɛneɛ ngakyile
12Ɛzoanvolɛma ne yɛle sɛkɛlɛneɛ ngakyile nee nwanwane ninyɛne dɔɔnwo wɔ menli ne avinli. Ɛleka mɔɔ diedima ne amuala bɔ nu yia la a le Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne kpɔda ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye “Sɔlɔmɔn Kpɔda” la abo. 13Awie mɔɔ ɛmboka diedima ne anwo la ɛnwolo bɛ nu, noko menli kɔsɔɔti hanle bɛ nwo edwɛkɛ kpalɛ. 14Menli dɔɔnwo kpalɛ, mraalɛ nee mrenya mɔɔ liele Awulae lile la rabokale bɛ nwo. 15Na ɔlua ɛzoanvolɛma ne gyima zo, nzinlii ɛnee akee bɛsoa wuleravolɛma bɛbagua ɛkpa zo wɔ awɔdenle ne mɔ azo, amaa ngyengyene nu bie ala Pita se ɛkɛ a ye ɛlawolɛ adɔ bie anwo zo na ɔ nwo aza. 16Na menli mɔɔ wɔ azua mɔɔ bikye Gyɛlusalɛm la amuala vale bɛ awuleravolɛ nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ sunsum ɛtane gyegye bɛ la amuala rale manle bɛyɛle bɛ ayile.
Bɛyɛ ɛzoanvolɛma ne kpɔdekpɔde
17Ɛzoanvolɛma ne anwo anyebolo dɔle Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli ne nee ɔ sa zo ne mɔ, mɔɔ le fane ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Sadusii la anu amra anwo, na bɛvale adwenle kɛ bɛyɛ nwolɛ bie. 18Yemɔti bɛdwazole ɛzoanvolɛma ne anwo zo na bɛhyele bɛ bɛguale efiade. 19Na kenle ko ne nɔe ne, Awulae soanvolɛ rabukele efiade ne nlenkɛ ne mɔ na ɔvale bɛ ɔvindele na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, 20“Bɛhɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu na bɛhɔha ngoane fofolɛ ɛhye anwo edwɛkɛ bɛhile menli kɔsɔɔti.” 21Aleɛ hyenle nwonlomɔ mangyee ne la, ɛzoanvolɛma ne hɔle Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu na bɛbɔle ɔ bo kɛ bɛkilehile.
Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli ne nee ɔ sa zo ne mɔ manle bɛvɛlɛle mgbanyima ayia, na bɛdule menli kɛ bɛhɔye ɛzoanvolɛma ne wɔ efiade ne bɛrɛla. 22Na mɔɔ menli ne mɔ hɔle la bɛannwu ɛzoanvolɛma ne mɔ na bɛziale bɛrabɔle amaneɛ kɛ, 23“Yɛhɔle la ɛnee efiade ne nlenkɛ ne mɔ wɔ nyinlira nu, yɛɛ sinzavolɛma ne noko amuala gyigyi nlenkɛ ne mɔ anloa; noko yɛbukele nlenkɛ ne mɔ la, yɛannwu awie biala wɔ ɛkɛ.” 24Ɛhye yɛle kpanyinli ne mɔɔ nea Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne sinzavolɛma ne anwo zo, nee sɛlɛvolɛ mgbanyinli ne mɔ naa ekyii, na bɛdwenlenle nwo kɛ kabezɛ edwɛkɛ bie ɛzi ɛzoanvolɛma ne anwo zo. 25Na yeangyɛ yɛɛ nrenya ko rabɔle bɛ amaneɛ kɛ, “Bɛnlea, menli ne mɔɔ bɛguale bɛ efiade la wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua nu lɔ ɛlɛkilehile menli.” 26Yemɔti sinzavolɛ kpanyinli ne vale ye ɛlɔnema ne na bɛhɔvale ɛzoanvolɛma ne mɔ bɛrale, noko bɛanyɛ bɛ mgbane mgbane biala, ɔluakɛ ɛnee bɛsulo kɛ saa bɛyɛ ye kikilikikili a ɛlɔne ne kɛzi bɛ awolɛ.
27Bɛvale bɛ gyɛlɛɛnye bɛragyinlanle ayiama ne anyunlu, na Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli ne bizale bɛ kɛ, 28 “Bɛmɛ, yɛbɔ bɛ kɔkɔ kɛ bɛmmabɔ sonla zɔhane duma bɛkilehile menli wɔ ɛleka biala, noko nea mɔɔ akee bɛlɛyɛ a. Bɛva bɛ ngilehilelɛ ne bɛkponde Gyɛlusalɛm amuala; bɛyɛ bɛamaa yɛmɛ yɛali ɛzonle wɔ sonla ne ewule nwo!”
29Na Pita nee ɛzoanvolɛma ne buale kɛ, “Ɔwɔ kɛ yɛtie Nyamenle yɛtɛla sonla. 30Yɛ nlenya mɔ Nyamenle ne dwazole Gyisɛse mɔɔ bɛmɛ bɛbɔle ye meanubaka nu bɛhunle ye la vile ewule nu. 31Na yemɔ yɛɛ Nyamenle ɛmaa ye zo ɛzie ye ye fema zo ɛyɛ ye Adenlekilevolɛ nee Dievolɛ kɛ ɔhile Yizilayɛma adenle ɔmaa bɛnlu bɛ nwo na bɛanyia ɛtanefakyɛ a. 32Na yɛmɛ yɛɛ Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne mɔɔ le Nyamenle ahyɛlɛdeɛ ne mɔɔ ɔfa ɔmaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛtie ye la, yɛdi ɛhye anwo daselɛ.”
33Ɛhye yelale ayiama ne kpole manle bɛyɛle kɛ bɛku ɛzoanvolɛma ne. 34Na bɛ nuhua ko dwazole. Ɔle Falasiinli, bɛfɛlɛ ye Gameeleɛle. Ɔle mɛla kilehilevolɛ yɛɛ maanlema bu ye kpole kpalɛ. Ɔmanle bɛvale ɛzoanvolɛma ne mɔ bɛvindele, 35na ɔzele ayiama ne kɛ, “Yizilayɛ mgbanyima, bɛnlea boɛ wɔ mɔɔ bɛkpondɛ bɛayɛ menli ɛhye mɔ la anwo. 36Mekɛ bie mɔɔ ɛraze ɛhɔ la, Tiyudase dwazole na ɔyɛle ɔ nwo kɛ ɔle sonlakpole bie, na ɔhwenle menli ala kɛyɛ ɛya nna ɔlile ɔ nzi. Na nzinlii bɛhunle ye, na ye ɛdoavolɛma ne bɔle asande manle ye fane ne gule. 37Ɛhye anzi, wɔ menli ɛdianlɛ mekɛ ne anu, Dwudase mɔɔ vi Galeli la ɔdaye ɔdwazole. Ɔdaye ɔhwenle menli dɔɔnwo ɔlile ɔ nzi. Na ɔdaye bɛhunle ye na menli mɔɔ li ɔ nzi la amuala zandele. 38Yemɔti mɔɔ meka meahile bɛ wɔ ɛhye anwo la a le kɛ, bɛgyakyi bɛ, bɛmmayɛ bɛ ɛhwee. Na saa mɔɔ bɛlɛyɛ la le sonla ngyehyɛlɛ a, ɔbazɛkye. 39Saa ɔvi Nyamenle noko a, yemɔ ɔyɛ se kɛ bɛkɛhola ye sɛkye, yɛɛ eza noko bɛannea boɛ a, bɛbaho bɛatia Nyamenle.”
Ayiama ne vale Gameeleɛle folɛdulɛ ne. 40Bɛvale ɛzoanvolɛma ne bɛrale ayiama ne anyunlu bieko, bɛbilale bɛ empele, na bɛduale bɛ kɛ bɛmmabɔ Gyisɛse duma bieko ɛlɛ ɛleka biala; na bɛgyakyile bɛ. 41Ɛzoanvolɛma ne vale fɛlɛkolilɛ vile ayia sua ne anu hɔle, kɛ bɛdabɛ bɔbɔ Nyamenle ɛbu bɛ bie, na ɔlua Gyisɛse duma ne ati bɛnwu amaneɛ a. 42Yemɔti dahuu bɛhɔle Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu nee azua nu bɛhilehilele na bɛbɔle Edwɛkpa ne mɔɔ fane Gyisɛse anwo la nolo kɛ yemɔ a ɔle Mɛzaya ne a.

Title: GYI 6
Content:
Boavolɛma nsuu ne
1Nzinlii, mɔɔ ɛnee akee ɛdoavolɛma ne anwo ɛlɛso la, ɛdendɛlɛ radɔle Dwuuma mɔɔ ka Giliki nee Dwuuma mɔɔ wɔ maanle ne anu la avinli. Dwuuma mɔɔ ka Giliki la se bɛbu bɛ nye bɛgua bɛ ahunlanvolɛ mraalɛ ne mɔ anwo zo wɔ dahuu ndɔnielilɛ nu. 2Zɔhane ati ɛzoanvolɛma bulu nee nwiɔ ne vɛlɛle ɛdoavolɛma ne amuala na bɛzele bɛ kɛ, “Ɔnle kpalɛ kɛ ndɔnielilɛ ti yɛkɛbu yɛ nye yɛkɛgua Nyamenle edwɛkɛ ne ɛhanlɛ zo. 3Yemɔti, ayi mɔ, bɛnlea na bɛye bɛ nuhua nsuu mɔɔ menli bu bɛ, mɔɔ Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne wɔ bɛ nwo zo na bɛze nrɛlɛbɛ la bɛmaa yɛ, na yɛva bɛ yɛzie zɛhae gyima ye anloa, 4amaa yɛdayɛ noko yɛanyia mekɛ yɛayɛ nzɛlɛlɛ nee Edwɛkpa ne ɛhanlɛ gyima ne.”
5Ɛzoanvolɛma ne mɔ nzuzulɛ ne zɔle bɛ kɔsɔɔti bɛ nye, na bɛyele Sitivin, mɔɔ lɛ diedi ne anu kpundii na Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne ɛyi ye tɛkɛɛ la, Felepe, Polɔkɔlɛse, Nekanɔ, Taemɔn, Paamɛnase, yɛɛ Nekɔlɔso mɔɔ vi Anteɔko, mɔɔ ɛnle Dwuunli na yehakyi ɔsonle Dwuuma Nyamenle ne la. 6Bɛvale bɛ bɛmanle ɛzoanvolɛma ne, ɛzoanvolɛma ne vale bɛ sa guale bɛ ti zo na bɛyɛle nzɛlɛlɛ bɛmanle bɛ.
7Na Nyamenle edwɛkɛ ne akee nyinle kpole manle menli somaa rabokale bɛ nwo, na bɛyɛle dɔɔnwo wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm, yɛɛ eza sɛlɛvolɛma dɔɔnwo liele Edwɛkpa ne lile.
Sitivin ɛhyelɛ
8Nyamenle lole Sitivin dɔɔnwo na ɔmanle ye tumi kpole ɔmanle ɔyɛle nwanwane ninyɛne mgbole ɔhilele menli. 9Yemɔti menli bie mɔɔ fɛlɛ bɛ nwo “Fanwodi Sukuluma” na bɛvi Saelin nee Alɛzandelea, nee bie mɔ mɔɔ vi Selesea nee Ehyea la bɔle ɔ bo kɛ bɛ nee Sitivin su kpolera.
10Na Sunsum ne manle Sitivin nrɛlɛbɛ dɔɔnwo, yemɔti bɛangola ye fee. 11Ɛhye ati bɛwulowulale menli bie abo bɛmanle bɛhanle kɛ, “Yɛdele kɛ ɔlɛka munzule edwɛkɛ yeatia Mosisi nee Nyamenle.” 12Na bɛluale adenle ɛhye azo bɛmanle maanlema nee asɔne mgbanyima ne nee mɛla kilehilevolɛma ne mɔ vale ɛya na bɛhyele Sitivin bɛ nee ye hɔle ayiama ne anyunlu. 13Bɛmanle menli ralile dasewia kɛ, “Nrenya ɛhye, dahuu ɔtendɛ ɔtia yɛ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua nwuanzanwuanza ye nee Mosisi mɛla ne. 14Yɛdele kɛ ɔlɛka kɛ Gyisɛse ne mɔɔ vi Nazalɛte la barazɛkye Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ye, na yeahakyi maamɛla biala mɔɔ Mosisi hyehyɛle manle yɛ la!” 15Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ ayia ne abo la amuala anye hale Sitivin anwo, na bɛnwunle kɛ ɛnee ɔ nyunlu ɛyɛ kɛ Nyamenle soanvolɛ nyunlu la.

Title: GYI 7
Content:
Sitivin sa ɔ ne
1Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli ne bizale Sitivin kɛ, “Asoo ɛhye mɔ le zɔhane?”
2 Sitivin buale kɛ, “Mediema mrenya nee egya mɔ, bɛdie me! Anyunlunyia Nyamenle ne yele ɔ nwo hilele yɛ nlenya Ebileham wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee ɔwɔ Mɛsɔpɔteemea la, kolaa na yeadu yeahɔdɛnla Hɛlan. 3Ɔzele ye kɛ, ‘Ɛvi wɔ abusua nee wɔ maanle ye anu tu na kɔ azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ mebahile wɔ la azo.’ 4 Ɛhye ati yɛɛ ɔvi Kaledea mɔɔ le ɔdaye ye maanle nu la ɔdule ɔhɔdɛnlanle Hɛlan a. Nzinlii mɔɔ Ebileham ɔ ze wule la, Nyamenle manle ɔradɛnlanle azɛlɛ ɛhye mɔɔ ɛnɛ bɛmɛ bɛde zolɛ la azo. 5 Ɛnee Nyamenle ɛtɛfale azɛlɛ ne ɛleka biala ɛtɛmanle Ebileham kɛ ɔle ɔdaye ye ɛdeɛ. Azɛlɛ waa ko bɔbɔ bɔle ye, noko ɛnee Nyamenle ɛva ɛbɔ ye ɛwɔkɛ kɛ ɔbava yeamaa ye nee ɔ bo zo amra, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee Ebileham mumua ne ɛnlɛ ralɛ la. 6 Kɛ Nyamenle zele ye la ɛne, ‘Ɛ bo zo amra bahɔ maanɔne ahɔyɛ ahanra, bɛahile bɛ nyane toonwo ɛvolɛ ɛya nna. 7Nzinlii mebadea menli zɔhane mɔɔ bɛbahɔzonle bɛ la, na bɛvi maanle zɔhane anu bɛbaye bɛ nwo na bɛarazonle me wɔ ɛke ala.’ 8 Na Nyamenle manle Ebileham ngyekyeleɛ ɛhye anwo sɛkɛlɛneɛ, yemɔ a le mrenyanu nzonlɛyɛlɛ. Yemɔti Ebileham wole Ayezeke la ye kenle mɔtwɛ ne azo ɔyɛle ye mrenyanu nzonlɛ. Ayezeke wole Gyekɔbo na ɔyɛle ye mrenyanu nzonlɛ, yɛɛ Gyekɔbo wole mralɛ mrenya bulu nee nwiɔ ne, mɔɔ le yɛ nlenya mɔ titile ne, na ɔyɛle bɛ mrenyanu nzonlɛ.
9 “Dwosefi anwo yɛle ɔ mediema ne mɔ ɛya na ɔlua zolɛ bɛdɔnenle ye kɛ kanra bɛmanle bɛ nee ye hɔle Yigyibiti, na Nyamenle lile ɔ nzi, 10 na ɔyele ye ɔvile ye amaneɛnwunlɛ muala anu. Mɔɔ Dwosefi dwule Yigyibiti belemgbunli ne (Falo) anyunlu la, Nyamenle manle ye nrɛlɛbɛ na ɔlua zo ɔnyianle ɔ nyunlu. Na Yigyibiti belemgbunli yɛle ye amɛnlado wɔ ye maanle ne anu nee ye suakunlu ɛkɛ ne neavolɛ. 11 Mekɛ ne anu, sane nee ɛhɔne rale Yigyibiti nee Keena maanle ne mɔ anu, manle ɔyɛle abodelɛ kpalɛ, mɔɔ ɛnee yɛ nlenya mɔ ɛnnyia aleɛ wɔ ɛleka biala a. 12Yemɔti mɔɔ Gyekɔbo dele kɛ aleɛ wɔ Yigyibiti la, ɔzoanle ɔ mra mrenya ne mɔ, mɔɔ le yɛ nlenya mɔ wɔ ɛkɛ. 13 Bɛhɔle mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nwiɔ ne la, Dwosefi yele ɔ nwo hilele ɔ mediema ne mɔ, na ɔlua zolɛ Yigyibiti belemgbunli ne nwunle Dwosefi abusua ne. 14 Dwosefi vale nrɛlaleɛ hɔmanle ɔ ze Gyekɔbo kɛ ɔ nee ye sua nu amra amuala ɛrɛla Yigyibiti. Bɛle menli abulasuu nee nnu. 15 Yemɔti Gyekɔbo hɔle Yigyibiti, na ɛkɛ ne yɛɛ ɔwule na yɛ nlenya mɔ noko wule a. 16 Bɛdule bɛ avunli ne mɔ bɛrale Hyikɛm na bɛziele bɛ wɔ sɛka ne mɔɔ Ebileham dɔle vile Heemɔ abusua ne lɔ la anu.
17 “Mɔɔ mekɛ ne bikyele mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ Nyamenle akee ye ye ɛwɔkɛ ne mɔɔ ɔbɔle yɛ nlenya Ebileham la, ɛnee yɛ nlenya mɔ mɔɔ wɔ Yigyibiti la anwo ɛzo kpalɛ. 18Nzinlii belemgbunli fofolɛ bie mɔɔ ɛnze Dwosefi anwo edwɛkɛ biala la rale ebia ne azo. 19 Ɔvale nrɛlɛbɛ adenle zo ɔbɔle yɛ mgbanyima ne mɔ abolɛ ɔmanle bɛvuandinle bɛ nlɔma bɛguale bɛmanle bɛwule. 20 Mekɛ ɛhye anu ala yɛɛ bɛwole Mosisi a, ɔle kakula kɛnlɛma kpalɛ! Na bɛvale ye bɛveale sua nu bɛnleanle ye toonwo ɔlile siane nsa. 21 Nzinlii mɔɔ bɛyele ye bɛdole ye lɔ la, Yigyibiti belemgbunli ne ara raalɛ hɔvale ye yɛle ɔ ra na ɔhɔtetele ye wɔ ye sua nu ɛkɛ. 22Bɛhilehilele ye Yigyibiti nrɛlɛbɛ nee ye amaamuo ne amuala. Na ɔnyinle ɔyɛle sonlakpole wɔ edwɛkɛhanlɛ nee nyɛleɛ nu.
23“Mɔɔ Mosisi lile ɛvolɛ abulanla la, ɔyɛle ye adwenle kɛ ɔkakpɔla ɔ mediema Yizilayɛma, yeanlea bɛ tɛnlabelɛ nu nee kɛ bɛsi bɛyɛ bɛ la. 24Ɔnwunle bɛ nuhua ko kɛ Yigyibitinli bie ɛlɛyɛ ye asa, na ɔhɔliele ɔ ti na ɔbɔle Yigyibitinli ne ɔmanle ɔwule. 25(Ɛnee ye adwenle a le kɛ ye menli ne kɛnwu kɛ Nyamenle balua ɔ nwo zo araye bɛ, na bɛannyia zɔhane ndelebɛbo ne.) 26Ye alehyenlɛ nu ɔnwunle kɛ Yizilayɛma nwiɔ ɛlɛko, ɔhɔle kɛ ɔkakpɔda, na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, ‘O, ebiamɔ! Bɛle mediema; duzu ati a bɛlɛko bɛayɛ bɛ nwo asa ɛ?’ 27Na ko ne mɔɔ ɛnee ɛlɛyɛ ɔ gɔnwo asa la zuhunle Mosisi ziele ahane na ɔzele ye kɛ, ‘Nwane a dule wɔ kɛ ɛrali yɛ nwo zo belemgbunli na ɛyɛ yɛ ndɛnebuavolɛ a? 28Anzɛɛ ɛkpondɛ kɛ ɛku medame noko, kɛmɔ anoma ɛhunle Yigyibitinli ne la ɔ?’ 29 Mɔɔ Mosisi dele ɛhye la, ɔvi Yigyibiti ɔnriandile ɔhɔle Medea azɛlɛ zo. Ɔwole mralɛ mrenya nwiɔ wɔ ɛkɛ.
30 “Ɛvolɛ abulanla pɛle nu la, Nyamenle soanvolɛ yele ɔ nwo hilele Mosisi wɔ sendɔlɔra nu wɔ fienemgbole ne mɔɔ zua Boka Saenae la anu. 31Mosisi nwunle ɛhye la ɔyɛle ye azibɛnwo na ɔbikyele nwolɛ kɛ ɔkanlea ye boɛ. Na ɔdele Awulae ane, ɔse, 32‘Mame a mele ɛ nlenya mɔ Nyamenle ne, Ebileham, Ayezeke, yɛɛ Gyekɔbo Nyamenle ne a.’ Mosisi ahonle dule kpole na yeangulo kɛ ɔkɛmaa ɔ nye zo ɔkɛnlea deɛ ne bieko. 33Na Awulae zele ye kɛ, ‘Yeye ɛ gyakɛ mgbɔlaboa ne, ɔluakɛ ɛleka mɔɔ ɛgyi la azɛlɛ ne le nwuanzanwuanza. 34Menwu kɛ bɛlɛsi bɛayɛ me menli mɔɔ wɔ Yigyibiti la amumuyɛ la, yɛɛ mede bɛ ɛzunlɛ noko, na mera kɛ mebalie bɛ. Yemɔti bɛla na mesoa wɔ wɔ Yigyibiti.’
35 “Mosisi ɛhye mɔɔ bɛkpole ye, na bɛzele ye kɛ, ‘Nwane a yɛle wɔ belemgbunli nee ndɛnebuavolɛ wɔ yɛ nwo zo’ la, yemɔ ala a Nyamenle luale soanvolɛ ne mɔɔ vindele sendɔlɔra ne anu wɔ ɛsɛlɛ ne azo la anwo zo zoanle ye kɛ ɔli bɛ nwo zo belemgbunli na ɔlie bɛ a. 36 Ɔvale ɛvolɛ abulanla ɔyɛle nwanwane ninyɛne nee sɛkɛlɛneɛ wɔ Yigyibiti nee Nyevile Kɔkɔlɛ ne anloa, yɛɛ fienemgbole ne anu na ɔyele menli ne ɔvile Yigyibiti. 37 Mosisi ɛhye ala a zele Yizilayɛma kɛ, ‘Nyamenle baye ye kpɔmanvolɛ avi bɛ avinli yeazoa ye bɛ nwo, kɛmɔ ɔzoanle me la.’ 38 Yemɔ yɛɛ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛyiale ɛsɛlɛ ne azo la ɔ nee Nyamenle soanvolɛ ne dendɛle wɔ Boka Saenae azo, na ɔliele Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ ne mɔɔ ɛnɛ ɛradwu yɛ nwo zo la ɔrɛlɛle yɛ nlenya mɔ a.
39“Na yɛ nlenya mɔ kpole kɛ bɛnrɛdie ye; bɛvale ye bɛziele ahane na bɛhulole kɛ anrɛɛ bɛkɛzia bɛkɛhɔ Yigyibiti. 40 Yemɔti bɛzele Sɛlɛvolɛ Aalɔn kɛ, ‘Yɛ awozonle maa bɛli yɛ nyunlu, na Mosisi ɛhye mɔɔ yele yɛ vile Yigyibiti la yɛnze mɔɔ ɛzi ɔ nwo zo a.’ 41 Mekɛ ne anu bɛyɛle ɛnlankɛ ralɛ ananze na bɛvale bɛyɛle amonle bɛzɔle, bɛlile nwolɛ nwɔhoa na bɛyeyɛle deɛ ne mɔɔ bɛdabɛ bɛva bɛ sa bɛyɛ la. 42 Yemɔti Nyamenle hwenle ɔ nwo vile bɛ nwo na ɔyele bɛ ɔmanle kɛ bɛzonle anwomanyunlu ninyɛne, kɛmɔ bɛhɛlɛ ye wɔ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma mbuluku ne mɔ anu la. Ɔse,
‘Yizilayɛma, ɛvolɛ abulanla ne mɔɔ bɛlile wɔ ɛsɛlɛ
ne azo la,
bɛhunle nane bɛbɔle azu bɛmanle me ɔ?
43Bɛzoale bɛ bozonle Molɛke ɛdanlɛ sua ne,
yɛɛ bɛzoale bɛ ɛwɔlɔra bozonle Relɛfaa ɛdanlɛ
sua ne noko; bɛdabɛ a bɛnwonle bɛ yɛɛ bɛzonlenle bɛ a.
Yemɔti mebava bɛ meahɔ nlɔnu wɔ Babelɔn anzi lɔ.’
44 “Ɛsɛlɛ ne azo yɛɛ yɛ nlenya mɔ nyianle Ɛdanlɛ Sua ne mɔɔ kile kɛ Nyamenle de bɛ avinli la a. Bɛyɛle ye kɛmɔ Nyamenle zele Mosisi ala la, nzonlɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle vale hilele Mosisi la azo a ɔnleanle ɔzile a. 45 Nzinlii yɛ nlenya mɔ vale Ɛdanlɛ Sua ne mɔɔ bɛliele ye bɛ ze mɔ ɛkɛ ne la lile bɛ nyunlu na bɛ nee Dwɔhyua hɔle bɛhɔhonle bɛvale maanle maanle mɔɔ Nyamenle manle bɛlile bɛ nwo zo konim la. Na ɔwoale bɛ nwo ɛkɛ ne toonwo ɔradwule Devidi mekɛ zo. 46 Nyamenle anye zɔle Devidi na Devidi zɛlɛle Nyamenle kɛ ɔmaa ye adenle ɔmaa ɔzi sua ɔmaa Gyekɔbo Nyamenle ne. 47 Noko Sɔlɔmɔn a zile sua ne a.
48“Noko akee Anwuma Anwuma Nyamenle ne ɛndɛnla sua mɔɔ menli ɛzi la anu. Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma ɛha kɛ,
49 ‘Awulae se,
Anwuma le me belemgbunli ebia,
yɛɛ azɛlɛ ye le me gyakɛ abo ebia.
Duzu sua a bɛsi bɛamaa me a?
Nienwu ɛleka a metɛnla mealie me ɛnwomenle a?
50Anzɛɛ tɛ mame medame a
menyɛle ɛhye mɔ amuala ɔ?’ ”
51 Sitivin hɔle zolɛ zele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛdabɛ, bɛ nzo yɛ se kpalɛ! Bɛnlie Nyamenle bɛnli fee; bɛkpɔla bɛ nzo anzi wɔ Nyamenle edwɛkɛ ne anwo! Bɛva bɛ nlenya mɔ agyakɛ, dahuu bɛko bɛtia Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne! 52Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ ko bɔbɔ ɛnle ɛkɛ mɔɔ bɛ mgbanyima andwazo ɔ nwo zo a. Bɛhunle menli mɔɔ Nyamenle zoanle bɛ kɛ bɛrabɔ ye Sonvolɛ Nwuanzanwuanza ne anwo nolo la amuala, na eza bɛye ɔdaye mumua ne bɛmaa bɛhu ye. 53Bɛmɛ a bɛliele Nyamenle mɛla ne mɔɔ ye soanvolɛma nee ye rale la a; noko bɛanli zolɛ!”
Sitivin awolɛ ɛzilɛ
54Mekɛ mɔɔ ayiama ne ɛlɛtie Sitivin la ɛnee ɛya ɛwie bɛ wolowolo na bɛ nwo ndinli ɛlɛtwehwe bɛ kikilikikili zɛhae. 55Na ɛnee Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne ɛyi Sitivin tɛkɛɛ la ati, ɔdole ɔ nye anwuma na ɔnwunle Nyamenle anyunlunyia ne na Gyisɛse gyi Nyamenle asa fema zo. 56Na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛnlea, menwu kɛ anwuma ɛbuke, na menwu kɛ Sonla Ra ne gyi Nyamenle asa fema zo.”
57Ɛkɛ ne ala bɛduoduale bɛ nzo, na bɛdeanle nu kokye la ɛnee bɛwɔ Sitivin anwo zo, nwee! 58Bɛhwenle ye bɛ nee ye hɔle suakpole ne kandiba, na bɛzile ye awolɛ. Dasevolɛma ne mɔ yeyele bɛ adɛladeɛ manle kpavolɛ bie mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Sɔɔlo la lɛle. 59Mɔɔ bɛlɛsi Sitivin awolɛ la ɛnee ɔ ne la nu ɔlɛtea ɔfɛlɛ Awulae kɛ, “Awulae Gyisɛse, die me ɛkɛla!” 60Akee ɔhotole na ɔdeanle nu kpole kɛ, “Awulae, fa ɛtane ɛhye kyɛ bɛ!” Ɔhanle ɛhye la, ɔwule.

Title: GYI 8
Content:
1Na Sɔɔlo liele ye ɛhunlɛ ne dole nu.
Sɔɔlo yɛ Asɔne ne kpɔdekpɔde
Ɔvi kenle ko ne ala bɛbɔle ɔ bo kɛ bɛyɛ diedima mɔɔ wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm la kpɔdekpɔde. Yemɔti diedima ne amuala zandele; bie mɔ hɔle Dwudiya nee Samɛlea maanzinli ne mɔ anu, na ɔhale ɛzoanvolɛma ne ala. 2Na Nyamenlezonlenlɛma bie mɔ hɔvale Sitivin hɔziele ye na bɛzunle ye kpole kpalɛ.
3 Na Sɔɔlo bɔle mɔdenle ala kɛ ɔkɛzɛkye Asɔne ne. Ɔwolowolole azua nu ɔhɔhwenle mraalɛ nee mrenya mɔɔ ɛzɔ diedi ne anu la na ɔvale bɛ ɔvindele ɔmanle bɛguale bɛ efiade.
Bɛka Edwɛkpa ne wɔ Samɛlea
4Diedima ne bɔle asande la bɛnriandile bɛhɔle azua azua zo na bɛhɔhanle Edwɛkpa ne. 5Felepe hɔle Samɛlea suakpole bie azo hɔhanle Mɛzaya ne anwo edwɛkɛ hilele menli mɔɔ wɔ ɛkɛ ne la. 6Mɔɔ menli ne diele na bɛnwunle nwanwane ninyɛne mɔɔ ɔyɛle la, bɛ muala bɛliele bɛlile, 7ɔluakɛ ɔmanle sunsum ɛtane dɔɔnwo deɛdeanle nu na bɛvile menli somaa ne ala anwo. Menli mɔɔ ɛdwidwe nee abuburama dele kpɔkɛ, 8na suakpole ne azo amra lile fɛlɛko kpole.
9Nrenya bie wɔ suakpole ne azo; bɛfɛlɛ ye Saemɔn. Nrenya ɛhye ɛva ngonyiayelɛ ɛha Samɛlea maanlema ne ɛzulolɛ, na ɔka kɛ ɔdaye ɔle sonlakpole. 10Awie biala mɔɔ wɔ maanle ne anu, mgbanyinli nee ngakula muala tie ye. Bɛse, “Sonla ɛhye a le Nyamenle tumi ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye ‘Tumi Bedevinli’ la.” 11Ɔvale ngonyia ɔdanle bɛ nye zo na ɔmanle bɛzulole ye kpalɛ na bɛliele ye bɛlile. 12Na mɔɔ bɛdele Edwɛkpa ne mɔɔ fane Nyamenle Belemgbunlililɛ ne anwo nee Gyisɛse Kelaese duma ne mɔɔ Felepe hanle nwolɛ edwɛkɛ la, mraalɛ nee mrenya kɔsɔɔti liele lile na bɛmanle bɛzɔnenle bɛ. 13Saemɔn ɔdaye ɔliele ɔlile na bɛzɔnenle ye. Nzinlii ɔvale ɔ nwo ɔbɔnenle Felepe, na ɔ nee ye luale. Mɔɔ ɔnwunle sɛkɛlɛneɛ nee nwanwane ninyɛne mɔɔ Felepe yɛle la, ɔyɛle ye azibɛnwo kpole.
14Ɛzoanvolɛma ne dele wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm kɛ menli mɔɔ wɔ Samɛlea la ɛzɔ Nyamenle edwɛkɛ ne anu la bɛzoanle Pita nee Dwɔn wɔ lɔ. 15Bɛhɔle la bɛzɛlɛle Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne bɛmanle diedima ne mɔ. 16Ɔluakɛ ɛnee bɛzɔne bɛ wɔ Awulae Gyisɛse duma nu ɛdeɛ, noko Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne ɛtɛbale bɛ nwo zo. 17Pita nee Dwɔn vale bɛ sa guale menli ne mɔ ati zo zɛlɛle, na bɛnyianle Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne.
18-19Mɔɔ Saemɔn nwunle kɛ ɛzoanvolɛma ne fa bɛ sa gua menli ti zo a bɛnyia Nyamenle Sunsum ne la, ɔhanle kɛ, “Bɛlie ezukoa na bɛmaa medame noko tumi ɛhye bie, amaa awie biala mɔɔ menwɔva me sa menwɔgua ɔ ti zo la anyia Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne bie.”
20Na Pita buale ye kɛ, “Abule ɛbu wɔ nee wɔ ezukoa ne amuala, kɛ ɛkɛdwenle kɛ bɛfa ezukoa a bɛtɔ Nyamenle ahyɛlɛdeɛ a! 21Ɛyɛ yɛ gyima ɛhye bie a ɔnrɛyɛ boɛ, ɔluakɛ ɛnli nɔhalɛ wɔ Nyamenle anyunlu. 22Zɔhane ati, nu ɛ nwo wɔ wɔ amumuyɛ adwenle ɛhye anwo, na sɛlɛ Awulae kɛ saa ɔyɛ na ɔkɛyɛ boɛ a, ɔva wɔ ɛtane ɔhyɛ wɔ kɛ wɔdwenle zɔhane a. 23Ɔluakɛ menwu kɛ ɛle anyebolo kpole kpalɛ na ɛtane ɛbɔ wɔ kpanwu.”
24Saemɔn zele Pita nee Dwɔn kɛ, “Mekpa bɛ kyɛlɛ, bɛzɛlɛ Awulae bɛmaa me, amaa mɔɔ bɛha la biala anzi me nwo zo.”
25Nzinlii Pita nee Dwɔn hanle Edwɛkpa ne, lile Awulae anwo daselɛ, na bɛziale bɛhɔle Gyɛlusalɛm. Bɛkɔ la bɛvale Samɛlea namunamu ne mɔ dɔɔnwo azo bɛhanle Edwɛkpa ne.
Felepe nee Yiteyopeanli kpanyinli ne
26Awulae soanvolɛ dendɛle zele Felepe kɛ, “Kɔ nyiakɛ nehane, wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm nee Gaza adenle ne azo.” (Adenle ɛhye la ɛsɛlɛ zo; ɛnɛ bɛnva zolɛ.) 27-28Na Felepe zile nu hɔle. Ɛnee Yiteyopeanli kpanyinli bie mɔɔ le abɔlɔba kpanyinli mɔɔ nea Yiteyopea Belemgbunli Raalɛ ne gya zo la ɔdaye ɔlua adenle ne azo. Ɔhɔle Nyamenle ɛzonlenlɛ wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm na ɔde ye ehwili nu yezia ɔlɛkɔ ye sua zo. Mɔɔ ɔde ehwili ne anu la ɛnee ɔlɛkenga Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ Ayezaya nwoma ne. 29Sunsum ne zele Felepe kɛ, “Twe bikye ehwili ne.” 30Yemɔti Felepe nriandile hɔle ehwili ne anwo, na ɔdele kɛ ɔlɛkenga Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ Ayezaya nwoma ne, na ɔbizale ye kɛ, “Asoo ɛte mɔɔ ɛlɛkenga la abo?”
31Nrenya ne buale ye kɛ, “Na kɛ mesi meyɛ mete ɔ bo ɛ? Kyesɛ awie kilehile nu kile me.” Na ɔmanle Felepe radɛnlanle ehwili ne anu wɔ ɔ nwo ɛkɛ ne. 32 Ɛleka mɔɔ ɛnee ɔlɛkenga la se,
“Ɔle kɛ boane mɔɔ bɛ nee ye ɛhɔ ahunleɛ,
anzɛɛ boaneralɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛpepɛ ye enrinli la,
yeambuke ɔ nloa.
33Bɛgolole ɔ nwo, bɛbuale ye mgbɔvondɛne,
awie ɛnrɛhola ɔ bo zo amra kile,
ɔluakɛ bɛpɛle ye ɛbɛla ne sinli wɔ ewiade ye anu.”
34Na abɔlɔba ne bizale Felepe kɛ, “Kile ɛhye anu kile me. Nwane anwo edwɛkɛ a Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ ne ɛlɛka a, ɔdaye ɔ nwo edwɛkɛ yɛɛ ɔlɛka a anzɛɛ awie gyɛne ɔ?” 35Na Felepe bɔle ɔ bo wɔ Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ɛhye azo, na ɔhanle Edwɛkpa ne mɔɔ fane Gyisɛse anwo la ɔhilele ye. 36Mɔɔ bɛlua adenle zo bɛlɛkɔ la, bɛrale azule bie anloa, na nrenya ne zele Felepe kɛ, “Nea, nzule ɛ! Duzu a si wɔ adenle mɔɔ ɔmaa ɛsɔne me a ɔnyɛ boɛ a?”
[ 37Felepe zele ye kɛ, “Saa ɛdie ɛdi bɔkɔɔ wɔ wɔ ahonle nu a, bɛsɔne wɔ a ɔyɛ boɛ.”
Ɔbuale ye kɛ, “Ɛhɛe, medie medi kɛ Gyisɛse Kelaese a le Nyamenle Ara ne a.”]
38Nrenya ne manle ehwili ne gyinlanle, ɔ nee Felepe bɛhɔle azule ne anu na ɔmanle Felepe zɔnenle ye. 39Mɔɔ bɛvi azule ne anu bɛvole file zo la, Sunsum ne vale Felepe minliminlinle. Nrenya ne annwu ye bieko, na ɔvale fɛlɛko ɔhɔle. 40Felepe hɔvindele Azotɛse na ɔhɔkpɔsale namunamu ne mɔ anu ɔhanle Edwɛkpa ne toonwo ɔradwule Sizalia.

Title: GYI 9
Content:
Sɔɔlo die Edwɛkpa ne ali
(Gyi 22.6-16; 26.12-18)
1Mekɛ ne anu ɛnee Sɔɔlo lɛ ye kɔdiawu adwenle ne tɛgyegye Awulae ɛdoavolɛma ne. Ɔhɔle Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli ne ɛkɛ 2na ɔhɔliele tumi ngɛlɛta kɛ ɔkɔ Dɛmasekɛse nyianu azua ne mɔ anu yeahɔhye bɛdabɛ mraalɛ nee mrenya mɔɔ bɛlua Awulae Adenle ne azo la, yeakyekye bɛ, ɔ nee bɛ ara Gyɛlusalɛm.
3Mɔɔ ɔlua adenle zo na ɔka ekyii ɔdwu Dɛmasekɛse la, wienyi kpole bie vi anwomanyunlu rabɔle yiale ye. 4Ɔpɛle ɔfinle na ɔdele kɛ ɛnelɛ bie se, “Sɔɔlo! Sɔɔlo! Duzu ati a ɛlɛyɛ me kpɔdekpɔde zɛhae ɛ?”
5Na ɔbizale kɛ, “Awulae, ɛdawɔ nwane ɔ?”
Ɛnelɛ ne buale ye kɛ, “Medame a mele Gyisɛse mɔɔ ɛlɛyɛ me kpɔdekpɔde la. 6Dwazo kɔ suakpole ne azo na bɛbahile wɔ debie mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ ɛyɛ la.”
7Menli mɔɔ nee Sɔɔlo lua la dɔle mumule, bɛandɛ bɛ nloa anu, ɔluakɛ bɛdele ɛnelɛ ne, na bɛannwu awie biala. 8Sɔɔlo vi azɛlɛ ne anwo dwazole la ɛnee ɔ nye ɛzi. Yemɔti bɛsosɔle ɔ sa bɛ nee ye hɔle Dɛmasekɛse. 9Kenle nsa, ɛnee ɔnnwu debie, yɛɛ ɔnli debie na yeanlo nzule.
10Kelaese ɛdoavolɛ bie wɔ Dɛmasekɛse, bɛfɛlɛ ye Ananayase. Wɔ ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ nu, ɔdele kɛ Awulae se, “Ananayase!” Ɔliele zolɛ kɛ, “Awulae, medame ɛ.”
