11Na Awulae zele ye kɛ, “Kɔ kpalɛ ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye ‘Fɔɔnwo’ la azo, na kɔ Dwudase sua nu, na biza awie bie mɔɔ vi Taasɛse na bɛfɛlɛ ye Sɔɔlo la. Ɔgua zolɛ ɔlɛyɛ nzɛlɛlɛ, 12na wɔ ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ nu yenwu nrenya bie mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Ananayase la kɛ yera ɔ nwo ɛkɛ yerava ɔ sa yegua ɔ ti zo yemaa yenwu debie bieko.”
13Ananayase zele kɛ, “Awulae, menli dɔɔnwo ɛha sonla ɛhye anwo edwɛkɛ nee debie mɔɔ yeva yehile wɔ menli ne mɔɔ wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm la ɛhile me. 14Na yera ɛke kɛ ɔlɛ tumi ngɛlɛta vi sɛlɛvolɛ mgbanyinli ne mɔ ɛkɛ kɛ ɔbahye bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsonle wɔ la amuala.”
15Awulae zele ye kɛ, “Wɔmɔ kɔ, na meye ye kɛ ɔrayɛ me sonvolɛ, ɔva me duma ɔhɔ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la anu nee arelemgbunli nee Yizilayɛma kɔsɔɔti anwo zo. 16Na medame mebahile ye amaneɛ mɔɔ ɔbanwu ye wɔ me duma nu la.”
17Yemɔti Ananayase hɔle sua nu ɛkɛ, ɔvale ɔ sa ɔguale Sɔɔlo ati zo na ɔzele ye kɛ, “Adiema Sɔɔlo, Awulae Gyisɛse, mɔɔ ɛlua adenle zo ɛlɛba ɛke mɔɔ ɔyele ɔ nwo ɔhilele wɔ la ɛzoa me ɛ nwo ɛke, amaa wɔanwu debie bieko na Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne ara ɛ nwo zo.” 18Ɛkɛ ne ala debie bie mɔɔ le kɛ fɛlɛ nwo abonle la vi Sɔɔlo anye zo guale aze, na ɔnwunle debie bieko; na ɔdwazole ɔmanle bɛzɔnenle ye. 19Akee ɔlile debie na ɔ nwo gyinlanle ye.
Sɔɔlo bɔ Edwɛkpa ne nolo wɔ Dɛmasekɛse
Sɔɔlo nee ɛdoavolɛma ne dɛnlanle mekɛ ekyi wɔ Dɛmasekɛse, 20na ɔhɔle nyianu azua ne mɔ anu ɔhɔbɔle nolo kɛ Gyisɛse, “Yemɔ a ɔle Nyamenle Ara ne a.” 21Ɔyɛle bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdele ye edwɛkɛ ne la azibɛnwo kpole na bɛbizale kɛ, “Na tɛ sonla ɛhye a ɛlɛkuhu menli mɔɔ bɔ Gyisɛse duma wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm la ɔ? Anzɛɛ yeamba ɛke kɛ ɔbahye bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛbɔ Gyisɛse duma la yeahɔmaa sɛlɛvolɛ mgbanyinli ne mɔ ɔ?”
22Na Sɔɔlo nyianle anwosesebɛ kpalɛ wɔ ye edwɛkɛhanlɛ nu na ɔholale ɔhilehilele nu kɛ Gyisɛse a le Mɛzaya ne, ɔmanle ɔrale kɛ Dwuuma bɔbɔ mɔɔ wɔ Dɛmasekɛse la dɔle mumule wɔ nwolɛ.
23 Kenle guale nu ekyii la, Dwuuma ne hɔle akpamo kɛ bɛku ye, 24na Sɔɔlo dele. Dwuuma ne dɛle ye wɔ sua ne azo nlenkɛ mgbole ne mɔ anloa nɔɔzo nee ewiazo kɛ bɛ sa kɛha ye bɛkɛhu ye. 25Na kenle ko nɔɔzo Sɔɔlo ɛdoavolɛma ne vale ye dɛnlanle kɛndɛne nu, vale ye wulale suakpole ne bane ne tokule bie anu, na bɛliele ye bɛtɛɛ bɛdwulale ye aze wɔ suakpole ne bane ne anzi lɔ.
Sɔɔlo kɔ Gyɛlusalɛm
26Sɔɔlo hɔle Gyɛlusalɛm na ɔyɛle kɛ ɔlɛ ɔ nwo ɔkabɔ ɛdoavolɛma ne anwo la bɛanlie ye bɛanli, na bɛzulole ye. 27Zɔhane ati Baanabase raboale ye na ɔ nee ye hɔle ɛzoanvolɛma ne ɛkɛ. Ɔhilehilele kɛ Sɔɔlo zile nwunle Awulae wɔ adevinli ne na Awulae dendɛle hilele ye, nee Sɔɔlo ahonle mɔɔ zile na ɔvale Gyisɛse duma ɔbɔle Edwɛkpa ne nolo wɔ Dɛmasekɛse la amuala ɔhilele bɛ. 28Yemɔti akee bɛmanle Sɔɔlo nee bɛ luale, na ɔyele ɔ nyunlu wienyi ɔvale Awulae duma ɔbɔle Edwɛkpa ne nolo wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm amuala. 29Eza ɔ nee Dwuuma mɔɔ ka Giliki la zule kpolera ɔmanle bɛnyianle adwenle kɛ bɛku ye. 30Mɔɔ diedima ne bie mɔ dele ɛhye la, bɛvale Sɔɔlo bɛhɔle Sizalia na bɛmanle ɔhɔle Taasɛse.
31Ɔlua Sɔɔlo ɛhakyilɛ zo akee Asɔne ne mɔɔ wɔ Dwudiya, Galeli, yɛɛ Samɛlea la nyianle anzonudwolɛ na ɔnyinle. Na ɔlua Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne moalɛ zo Asɔne ne nyianle anwosesebɛ, menli dɔɔnwo rale nu na bɛvale Nyamenlezulolɛ bɛluale.
Pita wɔ Leda nee Dwɔpa
32Pita hɔle ɛleka dɔɔnwo, na kenle ko ɔhɔkpɔlale Nyamenle menli ne mɔɔ wɔ Leda la. 33Ɛkɛ ne yɛɛ ɔhɔnwunle nrenya bie mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Yiniase la kɛ yedwidwe na yela ɛleka ko toonwo ɛvolɛ mɔtwɛ. 34Na Pita zele ye kɛ, “Yiniase, Gyisɛse Kelaese ɛyɛ wɔ ayile. Dwazo na nyenya wɔ ɛkpa ne.” Na ɛkɛ ne ala Yiniase dwazole. 35Menli mɔɔ wɔ Leda nee Hyɛlɔn la nwunle nrenya ne na bɛhakyile bɛdoale Awulae.
36Dwɔpa noko, raalɛ bie wɔ ɛkɛ, bɛfɛlɛ ye Tabeta. (Ye duma ne Giliki nu a le Dɔkase.) Ɔle ɛdoavolɛ. Raalɛ ɛhye vale ye mekɛ yɛle ahunlunyele gyima na ɔboale ehyianvolɛma. 37Mekɛ ne anu ɔ nwo dole ye na ɔwule. Bɛbiale ye na bɛdedale ye wɔ ɛbolɔnsane zo ekpumgbunli ne mɔ bie anu. 38Dwɔpa nee Leda anwa biala. Yemɔti mɔɔ diedima ne mɔɔ wɔ Dwɔpa la dele kɛ Pita wɔ Leda la, bɛzoanle menli nwiɔ bɛmanle bɛhɔvale nrɛlaleɛ bɛhɔmanle ye kɛ. “Yɛsɛlɛ wɔ, bɔ mɔdenle ka ɛ nwo bɛla.” 39Pita noko anzi aze na ɔ nee bɛ hɔle. Ɔhɔdwule la, bɛ nee ye hɔle ɛbolɔnsane ne azo ɛleka mɔɔ bɛdeda ye la. Ahunlanvolɛ mraalɛ mɔɔ Dɔkase ɛyɛ bɛ nyele ɛlɛ la vale ɛzunlɛ rabɔle yiale Pita na bɛvale adɛladeɛ mɔɔ Dɔkase kpomgbale hyɛle bɛ, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɔde aze la bɛhilele ye. 40Pita vindele bɛ, na ɔhotole ɔzɛlɛle; ɔhakyile ɔ nye funli ne anwo na ɔzele kɛ, “Tabeta, dwazo!” Raalɛ ne bukele ɔ nye na ɔnwunle Pita la, ɔmanle ɔ nwo zo ɔdɛnlanle aze. 41Pita zɔle ye manle ɔdwazole ɔgyinlanle. Akee ɔvɛlɛle diedima ne nee ahunlanvolɛ mraalɛ ne mɔ na ɔvale ye ɔmanle bɛ. 42Edwɛkɛ ɛhye kpondenle Dwɔpa amuala, na menli somaa ne ala liele Awulae lile. 43Pita dɛnlanle Dwɔpa hyɛle dɔɔnwo wɔ nrenya bie mɔɔ yɛ nwoma nwo gyima mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Saemɔn la sua nu.

Title: GYI 10
Content:
Pita nee Kɔnileɛse
1Nrenya bie wɔ Sizalia, bɛfɛlɛ ye Kɔnileɛse. Ɔle Wulomu Ɛlɔne ekpunli ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye “Yetalea” la safohyenle. 2Ɔle sonla mɔɔ sulo Nyamenle a, yɛɛ ɔ nee ye sua nu amra amuala bɛsonle Nyamenle. Ɔ sa do Dwuuma ehyianvolɛma anwo zo, yɛɛ ɔnva ye nzɛlɛlɛ wɔ Nyamenle anyunlu ɔndo aze. 3Kenle ko ewiazo kɛyɛ dɔne nsa ɔhɔle nzɛlɛlɛ ɛyɛlɛ la ɔnwunle ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ. Nyamenle soanvolɛ ragyinlanle ɔ nyunlu ɛkɛ na ɔvɛlɛle ye kɛ, “Kɔnileɛse!”
4Ɔnwunle Nyamenle soanvolɛ ne la, ɛzulolɛ hanle ye na ɔhanle kɛ, “Yɛmenle, duzu edwɛkɛ ɔ?”
Nyamenle soanvolɛ ne buale ye kɛ, “Nyamenle ɛde wɔ nzɛlɛlɛ na yenwu wɔ ahunlunyele gyima ne amuala. 5Yemɔti soa maa bɛhɔ Dwɔpa bɛhɔva nrenya bie mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Saemɔn Pita la. 6Ɔde nrenya bie mɔɔ yɛ nwoma nwo gyima mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Saemɔn la sua nu, wɔ nyevile ne anloa ɛkɛ ne ala.” 7Mɔɔ Nyamenle soanvolɛ ne wiele la ɔhɔle. Kɔnileɛse vɛlɛle ye sua nu ɛkɛ ne ngɛkɛlɛ ne mɔ nwiɔ yɛɛ sogyanli ko mɔɔ sulo Nyamenle na ɔboka menli mɔɔ sinza ɔdaye Kɔnileɛse la anwo la, 8ɔhanle mɔɔ ɛzi la amuala ɔhilele bɛ na ɔzoanle bɛ wɔ Dwɔpa.
9Aleɛ hyenle, na mɔɔ bɛlua adenle zo na ɔka ekyii bɛdwu Dwɔpa la, ɛnee Pita ɔdaye yevo yehɔ sua ne mɔɔ ɔwɔ nu la ati zo anwuma kɛ ɔkayɛ ewiazo nzɛlɛlɛ. 10Ɛhɔne hunle ye na mɔɔ ɔlɛkendɛ aleɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛto bɛamaa ye la, ɔ nye hɔle dɔɔnwo na ɔnwunle 11kɛ anwuma ɛbuke, na bɛlɛdwula debie bie mɔɔ le kɛ ɛdanlɛ mɔɔ bɛsosɔ ɔ nloa nna ne amuala anu la aze. 12Wɔ deɛ ne anu, ɔnwunle nane, nwɔlɛ, yɛɛ nloma ngakyile dɔɔnwo. 13Na ɛnelɛ bie zele ye kɛ, “Pita, dwazo na ku bie di!”
14Na Pita zele kɛ, “Kyɛkyɛ, Awulae, debie mɔɔ nwolɛ ɛnde na ɔle kyibadeɛ la, metɛdile bie ɛlɛ.”
15Ɛnelɛ ne eza zele ye kɛ, “Debie mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛde nwolɛ la, mmaka kɛ nwolɛ ɛnde.” 16Ɛhye zile fane nsa, na bɛhwenle deɛ ne bɛhɔle anwuma.
17Mɔɔ Pita ɛlɛdwenle mɔɔ yenwu ye la anwo la, ɛnee menli mɔɔ Kɔnileɛse zoanle bɛ la noko ɛbizebiza dedee bɛnwu Saemɔn sua nu na bɛra, bɛwɔ anuhɔlɛ ɛkɛ ne. 18Bɛvɛlɛle na bɛbizale kɛ, “Ɛyɛvolɛ bie wɔ ɛke mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Saemɔn Pita ɔ?”
19Mɔɔ Pita gua zolɛ tɛdwenle mɔɔ yenwu ye la anwo na ɔkulo kɛ ɔte ɔ bo la, Nyamenle Sunsum ne zele ye kɛ, “Nea, menli nsa ɛra ɛke bakpondɛ wɔ. 20Yemɔti dwu aze kɔyia bɛ; mmadwenle nwolɛ, ɛ nee bɛ ɛhɔ. Ɔluakɛ medame a mezoa bɛ a.” 21Pita dwule aze na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Ahenle mɔɔ bɛkpondɛ ye la a le medame. Na bɛ ɛdialɛ nu ɛ?”
22Bɛbuale ye kɛ, “Safohyenle Kɔnileɛse a ɛzoa yɛ a. Ɔle sonlakpalɛ somaa, ɔsulo Nyamenle, yɛɛ Dwuuma amuala bu ye bie kpalɛ. Ɛkenle Nyamenle soanvolɛ bie zele ye kɛ ɔrava wɔ ɔhɔ ye sua nu, na ɔdie mɔɔ ɛlɛ ye ɛka wɔahile ye la.” 23Na Pita vale bɛ hɔle sua nu na ɔmanle bɛ ɛleka bɛlale.
Aleɛ hyenle la ɔboɔboale ɔ nwo na ɔ nee bɛ hɔle; diedima bie mɔ mɔɔ wɔ Dwɔpa la nee ye hɔle. 24Bɛzile nu la ye alehyenlɛ nu yɛɛ bɛdwule Sizalia a, na bɛhɔdole kɛ Kɔnileɛse nee ye sua nu amra, nee ɔ gɔnwo mɔ mɔɔ yedo ɛsalɛ yevɛlɛ bɛ la ɛwie yia na bɛlɛkendɛ ye. 25Kɔnileɛse yiale Pita wɔ anlenkɛ ne anloa, ɔdule ɔdɔle ɔ gyakɛ anu na ɔzonlenle ye. 26Na Pita manle ɔdwazole na ɔzele ye kɛ, “Dwazo na medame mele sonla.” 27Mɔɔ Pita anloa wɔ zolɛ ɔlɛtendɛ yeahile Kɔnileɛse la, bɛhɔwolole sua ne anu, na ɔnwunle kɛ menli dɔɔnwo kpalɛ ɛrayia. 28Na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛdabɛ bɛze ye wienyi kɛ wɔ Dwuu ɛzonlenlɛ ne anu, bɛmmaa adenle bɛmmaa yɛ nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la ɛnfonla. Noko Nyamenle ɛye ɛhile me kɛ memmabu awie biala kɛ ɔ nwo ɛnde. 29Ɛhye ati yɛɛ bɛzoanle kɛ bɛrava me la meandwenlehwenle me bo aze na mera a. Yemɔti mebiza bɛ kɛ duzu ati a bɛravale me a?”
30Kɔnileɛse zele ye kɛ, “Ɛnɛ le kenle nna, kɛyɛ bekezɛ ala, ɛnee melɛyɛ ewiazo dɔne nsa nzɛlɛlɛ wɔ me sua ye anu, na nrenya bie mɔɔ wula tɛladeɛ fufule la ragyinlanle me nyunlu ɛkɛ 31na ɔzele me kɛ, ‘Kɔnileɛse! Wɔ nzɛlɛlɛ ɛdwu Nyamenle anyunlu na yenwu wɔ ahunlunyele gyima ne amuala. 32Yemɔti soa awie wɔ Dwɔpa maa ɔhɔva nrenya ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Saemɔn Pita la. Ɔ nee Saemɔn mɔɔ yɛ nwoma nwo gyima la a de a, wɔ nyevilenloa ɛkɛ.’ 33Ɛhye ati a menzoanle kɛ bɛrava wɔ a, yɛɛ ɛdawɔ noko wɔandwenlehwenle ɛ bo aze na wɔra a. Yemɔti yɛ muala yɛyia wɔ Nyamenle anyunlu ɛke kɛ yɛtie mɔɔ Awulae ɛva ɛmaa wɔ kɛ ɛraha ɛhile yɛ la.”
Pita tendɛ ahile menli ne
34 Na Pita zele bɛ kɛ, “Nɔhalɛ, menwu ye wienyi kɛ Nyamenle bu menli kɔsɔɔti kɛ bɛsɛ. 35Awie biala mɔɔ sulo ye na ɔdi boɛ la ɔdie ye ɔto nu, yɛɛ ɔnnea ɛleka mɔɔ ɔvi nee maanle holɛ ko mɔɔ ɔvi nu la. 36Bɛdabɛ bɛze kɛ ɔzile mɔɔ ɔlua Gyisɛse Kelaese, mɔɔ le menli kɔsɔɔti Awulae la anwo zo Nyamenle vale anzonudwolɛ nwo Edwɛkpa ne rɛlɛle Yizilayɛma la. 37Bɛbɔle Edwɛkpa ɛhye nolobɔlɛ bo wɔ Galeli, na bɛbɔle ye Dwudiya amuala wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ Dwɔn bɔle ɛzɔnenlɛ nwo nolo wiele la. 38Bɛze Gyisɛse mɔɔ vi Nazalɛte la anwo edwɛkɛ nee kɛ Nyamenle zile vale Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne wulale ye na ɔmanle ye tumi la amuala. Gyisɛse kpɔsale ɛleka dɔɔnwo yɛle ahunlunyele gyima, na ɔyɛle bɛdabɛ mɔɔ Abɔnsam ɛlɛfa ye tumi ne agyegye bɛ la ayile, ɔluakɛ Nyamenle nee ye lua. 39Yɛdi mɔɔ ɔyɛle ye wɔ Yizilayɛ maanle ne anu nee Gyɛlusalɛm la amuala anwo daselɛ. Bɛbɔle ye meanubaka nu bɛhunle ye. 40Na ye kenle nsa ne azo Nyamenle dwazole ye vile mɔwuamra anu na ɔmanle ɔyele ɔ nwo ɔhilele 41yɛmɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛye yɛ kɛ yɛli daselɛ la. Yɛ nee ye lile, nlonle, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɔdwazole ɔvile ewule nu la, 42na ɔzele yɛ kɛ yɛha ɔ nwo Edwɛkpa ne yɛhile menli kɔsɔɔti, na yɛli ɔ nwo daselɛ kɛ yemɔ yɛɛ Nyamenle ɛyɛ ye mɔwuamra nee anyewɔzoamra ndɛnebuavolɛ a. 43Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma amuala ka ɔ nwo edwɛkɛ kɛ awie biala mɔɔ kɛlie ye kɛli la, ɔlua ye duma ne tumi zo bɛkɛva ye ɛtane bɛkɛhyɛ ye.”
Menli mɔɔ ɛnle Dwuuma la nyianle Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne
44Mɔɔ Pita anloa wɔ zolɛ ɛlɛtendɛ la, Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne rawolole bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛtie edwɛkɛ ne la. 45Ɛhye yɛle Dwuuma mɔɔ ɛlie Edwɛkpa ne ɛli na bɛ nee Pita vi Dwɔpa rale la azibɛnwo kpole kɛ Nyamenle Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ahyɛlɛdeɛ ne ɛra menli mɔɔ ɛnle Dwuuma la noko anwo zo a. 46Ɔluakɛ bɛdele kɛ ɛnee bɛlɛka ɛdendɛlɛ ngakyile bɛahanvo Nyamenle ye bedevinli mɔɔ ɔde la. Na Pita manle ɔ ne zo zele kɛ, 47“Menli ɛhye mɔ ɛnyia Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne, kɛmɔ yɛnyianle ye ala la. Anzɛɛ awie kɛhola kɛze kɛ ɔnle kɛ yɛfa nzule yɛsɔne bɛ ɔ?” 48Yemɔti ɔmanle bɛzɔnenle bɛ wɔ Gyisɛse Kelaese duma nu. Na bɛzɛlɛle ye bɛ nee ye dɛnlanle mekɛ ekyi.

Title: GYI 11
Content:
Pita bɔ ye amaneɛ ahile Gyɛlusalɛm Asɔne ne
1Ɛzoanvolɛma ne nee diedima mɔɔ wɔ Dwudiya la dele kɛ menli mɔɔ ɛnle Dwuuma la noko ɛlie Nyamenle edwɛkɛ ne ɛli. 2Yemɔti mɔɔ Pita hɔle Gyɛlusalɛm la, bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛmɛ bɛ adwenle wɔ mrenyanu nzonlɛyɛlɛ zo la dendɛle ye nwolɛ, 3na bɛbizale ye kɛ, “Kɛ ɔyɛle mɔɔ ɛhɔle menli mɔɔ ɛtɛyɛle bɛ mrenyanu nzonlɛ la sua nu na ɛ nee bɛ dole bɛ sa ɛyɛba ko anu ɛ?” 4Na Pita bɔle ɔ bo hanle edwɛkɛ ne nee mɔɔ zile la amuala hilele bɛ.
5Ɔse, “Ɛnee mewɔ suakpole ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Dwɔpa la azo melɛyɛ nzɛlɛlɛ, na me nye hɔle dɔɔnwo, na menwunle debie bie mɔɔ le kɛ ɛdanlɛ mɔɔ bɛdedɛ ɔ nloa nna ne amuala anu la kɛ ɔvi anwuma na bɛlɛdwula ye aze, na ɔradwule me nyunlu ɛkɛ ne la, ɔgyinlanle. 6Mɔɔ meneanle nuhua la menwunle nane, nwɔlɛ, yɛɛ nloma ngakyile wɔ nuhua. 7Na mendele kɛ ɛnelɛ bie se, ‘Pita, dwazo na ku bie di!’ 8Na menganle kɛ, ‘Kyɛkyɛ, Awulae, debie mɔɔ le kyibadeɛ anzɛɛ nwolɛ ɛnde la metɛdile bie ɛlɛ.’ 9Na ɛnelɛ ne vi anwuma rale bieko kɛ, ‘Debie biala mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛde nwolɛ la mmabu ye kɛ nwolɛ ɛnde!’ 10Ɛhye zile fane nsa, na nzinlii bɛhwenle ye bɛhɔle anwuma. 11Mekɛ ne anu ala yɛɛ menli nsa mɔɔ ɛnee bɛzoa bɛ vi Sizalia wɔ me nwo ɛkɛ ne la rale sua nu ɛkɛ a. 12Na Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne zele me kɛ me nee bɛ ɛhɔ, memmasi aze. Mediema nsia ɛhye mɔ mɔɔ vi Dwɔpa la bokale me nwo manle yɛ muala yɛhɔle Sizalia wɔ Kɔnileɛse sua nu. 13Kɔnileɛse hanle kɛ ɔzile ɔnwunle Nyamenle soanvolɛ bie wɔ sua ne anu na ɔzele ye kɛ, ‘Soa maa bɛhɔ Dwɔpa bɛhɔva nrenya bie mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Saemɔn Pita la, 14na ɔbaha edwɛkɛ mɔɔ kɛmaa ɛ nee wɔ sua nu amra kɛnyia ngoane la.’ 15Na membɔle ɔ bo kɛ metendɛ ala la yɛɛ Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne rale bɛ nwo zo, kɛmɔ mɔlebɛbo ne ɔrale yɛ nwo zo la a. 16 Na mengakyele mɔɔ Awulae hanle la, ɔse, ‘Dwɔn vale nzule a zɔnenle a, na bɛmɛ, bɛbava Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne a bɛazɔne bɛ a.’ 17Na saa Nyamenle ɛmaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la ahyɛlɛdeɛ, kɛmɔ mɔlebɛbo ne ɔvale ɔhyɛle yɛ kɛ yɛlie Awulae Gyisɛse Kelaese yɛli la a, ɛnee mame a le nwane, mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ metua Nyamenle adenle a!”
18Bɛdele ɛhye la, bɛgyakyile bɛ nvefenu ne na bɛyeyɛle Nyamenle bɛzele kɛ, “Nyamenle ɛmaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la noko adenle kɛ bɛnlu bɛ nwo na bɛnyia ngoane mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ.”
Anteɔko asɔne ne
19 Sitivin ɛhunlɛ ne anzi, kpɔdekpɔde mɔɔ bɛyɛle diedima ne la manle bɛbɔle asande, bie mɔ hɔvindele Fonehyea, Saepelɛse nee Anteɔko bɛhɔhanle Edwɛkpa ne bɛhilele Dwuuma mɔɔ wɔ lɔ la ala. 20Diedima ne bie mɔ mɔɔ vi Saepelɛse nee Saelin la noko hɔhanle Edwɛkpa ne wɔ Anteɔko hilele bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la. 21Awulae lile bɛ nzi manle menli dɔɔnwo liele lile na bɛhakyile bɛrale Awulae ɛkɛ.
22Gyɛlusalɛm asɔne ne dele ɛhye, na bɛzoanle Baanabase wɔ Anteɔko. 23Mɔɔ ɔhɔdwule na ɔnwunle kɛ Nyamenle ɛzi ɛlo menli ne la, ɔlile fɛlɛko na ɔzile bɛ kɛnra kɛ bɛva bɛ ahonle muala bɛzɔ diedi ne anu kpalɛ na bɛli nɔhalɛ bɛmaa Awulae. 24Baanabase mumua ne le sonlakpalɛ mɔɔ diedi nee Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne ɛyi ye tɛkɛɛ la ati, ɔhwenle menli dɔɔnwo ɔrale Awulae ɛkɛ.
25Baanabase akee hɔle Taasɛse kɛ ɔkakpondɛ Sɔɔlo. 26Mɔɔ ɔnwunle ye la ɔ nee ye rale Anteɔko. Bɛ mu nwiɔ bɛ nee asɔnema ne dɛnlanle ɛvolɛ ko na bɛhilehilele bɛ. Na Anteɔko ɛkɛ yɛɛ bɛlumuale bɛvɛlɛle ɛdoavolɛma ne Keleseɛnema a.
27Mekɛ ne anu ala Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma bie vi Gyɛlusalɛm rale Anteɔko. 28 Bɛ nuhua ko mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Agabɛse la dwazole luale Sunsum ne tumi ne azo hanle dole ɛkɛ kɛ ɛhɔne kpole bie bara ewiade amuala. (Ɛhye yɛle zɔhane wɔ Maanle Maanle Belemgbunli Kolɔdeɛse mekɛ zo.) 29Yemɔti diedima ne bɔle kpɔkɛ kɛ bɛkeha bɛ sa aze na mɔɔ bɛkɛnyia ye la bɛava bɛahɔboa mediema mɔɔ wɔ Dwudiya la. 30Bɛyɛle ɛhye na bɛvale mɔɔ bɛnyianle ye la bɛmanle Baanabase nee Sɔɔlo hɔmanle mgbanyima ne mɔ wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm.

Title: GYI 12
Content:
Bɛyɛ diedima ne kpɔdekpɔde
1Mekɛ ɛhye anu ala Belemgbunli Hɛlɔdo vale ɔ nye wulale diedima ne bie mɔ anyunlu. 2Ɔmanle bɛpɛle Dwɔn adiema Gyemise ati. 3Na mɔɔ ɔnwunle kɛ ɛhye ɛyɛ Dwuuma fɛ la, ɔdoale zo na ɔhyele Pita ɔdaye. (Ɛhye zile Angye Ɛvoyia ne anu.) 4 Mɔɔ bɛhyele Pita la, ɔdole ye efiade na ɔyele sogyama nna-nna ekpunli nna kɛ bɛzinza ye. Hɛlɔdo yɛle kɛ saa bɛdi Akpabɛnwo Ɛvoyia ne bɛwie a yɛɛ ɔkɛli ye edwɛkɛ a. 5Yemɔti Pita lale efiade ne, na diedima ne noko anye bolole yɛle nzɛlɛlɛ ɛsesebɛ kpalɛ manle ye.
Bɛye Pita efiade ne
6Nɔe ne mɔɔ ɛnee aleɛ kye a Hɛlɔdo kɛye Pita kɛmaa menli ne la, ɛnee Pita la sogyama nwiɔ mɔɔ ɛlɛsinza ye la avinli, na bɛva nwɔnzɔnwɔnzɔ nwiɔ bɛgua ye, na bɛva bɛsosɔ sogyama nwiɔ ne, yɛɛ eza sogyama bie mɔ noko gyigyi anlenkɛ ne anloa ɛlɛsinza. 7Arɛlevilɛ nu ala Nyamenle soanvolɛ rale ɛkɛ na wienyi kpole bie dale efiade ne. Nyamenle soanvolɛ ne bɔle Pita abati dunwuele ye na ɔzele ye kɛ, “Maa ɔyɛ ndɛ dwazo!” Na ɛkɛ ne ala nwɔnzɔnwɔnzɔ ne vi ɔ sa wɔlɔle guale. 8Na Nyamenle soanvolɛ ne zele ye kɛ, “Fa wɔ tɛladeɛ ne nee wɔ mgbɔlaboa ne wula.” Pita yɛle ye zɔhane na Nyamenle soanvolɛ ne eza zele ye kɛ, “Akee fa wɔ tabule ne kye na toa me.” 9Pita lile ɔ nzi na bɛvi efiade ne bɛvindele. Noko akee ɛnee ɔnnwu ye kpalɛ saa mɔɔ Nyamenle soanvolɛ ne ɛlɛyɛ la le amgba o; ɔdwenlenle kɛ ɛlalɛ ɔ. 10Bɛdɛlale sinzavolɛma ekpunli ne mɔɔ lumua nee mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nwiɔ, na bɛdwule mbulalɛ anlenkɛ ne mɔɔ bɛfa nu bɛfinde suakpole ne azo la anwo la, anlenkɛ ne angome bukele manle bɛ, na bɛvindele. Bɛhɔle ekyii la, Nyamenle soanvolɛ ne gyakyile Pita na ɔhɔle.
11Pita anye zo tetele ye la ɔzele kɛ, “Akee bɔ zo mɔɔ menwu kɛ debie biala mɔɔ ɛlɛkɔ zolɛ la le nɔhalɛ a. Awulae ɛzoa ɛmaa bɛraye me bɛvi Hɛlɔdo asa anu, nee ninyɛne mɔɔ Dwuuma anye la kɛ bɛkɛyɛ me la amuala anu.”
12Mɔɔ ɔnwunle ye zɛhae la, Pita luale zolɛ hɔle Dwɔn Maake ɔ nli Mɛle sua nu, ɛnee menli dɔɔnwo ɛyia ɛkɛ na bɛlɛyɛ nzɛlɛlɛ. 13Pita bɔle anuhɔlɛ lɔ anlenkɛ ne anu, na sonvolɛ bɛlɛra bie mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Wuloda la rale kɛ ɔbanlea ahenle holɛ. 14Mɔɔ ɔdele Pita ane kɛ yemɔ a ɔlɛfɛlɛ la, fɛlɛko ngome ti, kɛ ɔkɛdukue anlenkɛ ne la, ɔziale ɔhɔbɔle amaneɛ kɛ Pita ɛra na ɔgyi anlenkɛ ne anzi lɔ. 15Bɛzele ye kɛ, “Debie ɛlɛyɛ wɔ.” Na ɔtinlinle zolɛ ɔhanle ye anyebololɛ nu kɛ ɔle nɔhalɛ, yemɔti bɛhanle kɛ, “Ɛnee noko ye nwomenle ɔ.”
16Pita bɔle anlenkɛ ne anu ndinlizo; nzinlii bɛrabukele ye, na bɛnwunle ye la, ɔyɛle bɛ azibɛnwo. 17Ɔmanle ɔ sa zo kɛ bɛyɛ koonwu, na ɔhanle kɛ Awulae zile yele ye wɔ efiade ne la ɔhilele bɛ. Ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛha bɛhile Gyemise nee mediema mɔɔ ɛha la amuala,” na ɔvindele ɔhɔle.
18Mɔɔ aleɛ hyenle la, sinzavolɛma ne adwenle zɛkyele kpalɛ, ɔluakɛ ɛnee bɛngola bɛnnwu mɔɔ ɛzi Pita anwo zo a. 19Hɛlɔdo manle bɛkpondɛle ye biala, na bɛannwu ye. Yemɔti ɔmanle bɛhyele sinzavolɛma ne nuokɛ na ɔzele kɛ bɛhu bɛ bɛdua.
Ɛhye anzi, Hɛlɔdo vi Dwudiya hɔle Sizalia hɔlile mekɛ ekyi wɔ ɛkɛ.
Hɛlɔdo ewule nu
20Hɛlɔdo vale menli mɔɔ wɔ Taya nee Saedɛn la anwo ɛya, ɛhye ati bɛdule menli kɛ bɛhɔnwu ye. Bɛlumuale bɛ sa hanle Belasetɛse mɔɔ nea belemgbunli suakunlu ɛkɛ ne la moalɛ, na akee bɛhɔle Hɛlɔdo anyunlu bɛhɔkpɔdale ye. Ɔluakɛ bɛ aleɛ mɔɔ bɛnyia ye la amuala vi belemgbunli ne maanle nu.
21Kenle mɔɔ bɛhilele la dwule la, Hɛlɔdo wulale ye belemgbunli tɛladeɛ ne na ɔhɔdɛnlanle ye ebia nu na ɔdendɛle ɔhilele menli ne mɔ. 22Menli ne mɔ bɔle ɔse zele kɛ, “Ɛhye, yemɔ nyamenle bie ane ɔ, na tɛ sonla ne ɔ.” 23Na arɛlevilɛ nu ala Awulae soanvolɛ rabɔle Hɛlɔdo dole aze manle ɔ nwo dole ye, ɔlɔle azonlɛ na ɔwule, ɔluakɛ yeanva anyunlunyia yeammaa Nyamenle.
24Nyamenle edwɛkɛ ne hɔle zolɛ dɛlɛle.
25Baanabase nee Sɔɔlo wiele bɛ gyima ne di la, bɛvi Gyɛlusalɛm bɛhɔle, na bɛvale Dwɔn Maake bɛbokale bɛ nwo.

Title: GYI 13
Content:
Bɛsoa Baanabase nee Sɔɔlo
1Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma nee kilehilevolɛma wɔ Anteɔko asɔne ne anu, bɛmɛ a le Baanabase, Semɛyɔn (mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Bile), Luseɛse (mɔɔ vi Saelin), Maneeyen (mɔɔ bɛtetele ye nee Amɛnlado Hɛlɔdo), yɛɛ Sɔɔlo. 2Mɔɔ ɛnee bɛlɛyɛ nzɛlɛlɛ na bɛlɛkye ɛhɔne la, Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne zele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛdu Baanabase nee Sɔɔlo bɛzie ahane bɛmaa me na memaa bɛhɔyɛ gyima mɔɔ yemɔti menvɛlɛle bɛ la.”
3Bɛhyele ɛhɔne bɛyɛle nzɛlɛlɛ, bɛvale bɛ sa bɛguale bɛ ti zo na bɛguale bɛ adenle.
Pɔɔlo nee Baanabase wɔ Saepelɛse
4Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne vale Baanabase nee Sɔɔlo hɔle Sɛlusea na bɛvale ɛlɛne bɛhɔle bɔra ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Saepelɛse la azo. 5Mɔɔ bɛdwule Salamese la, bɛhanle Nyamenle edwɛkɛ ne wɔ Dwuuma nyianu sua ne anu. Bɛ nee Dwɔn Maake a hɔle a na ɔboale bɛ wɔ gyima ne ɛyɛlɛ nu.
6Bɛkpɔsale bɔra ne azo na bɛrale Peefɔso bɛradole Dwuunli bie mɔɔ ye ngonyia la. Bɛfɛlɛ ye Baa-Gyisɛse, yɛɛ ɔdaye mumua ne ɔfɛlɛ ɔ nwo Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ. 7Ɔle bɔra ne azo amɛnlado ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Sɛgyeɛse Pɔɔlɛse la agɔnwo. Amɛnlado ɛhye ze nrɛlɛbɛ yɛɛ ɔ nye ɛde. Ɔzoanle ɔmanle bɛhɔvɛlɛle Baanabase nee Sɔɔlo kɛ bɛrɛla na ɔkulo kɛ ɔtie Nyamenle edwɛkɛ ne. 8Na Ɛlemase (Ngonyianli ne duma wɔ Giliki nu ɛne) ammaa bɛ adenle, na ɔyɛle kɛ ɔkakyi Amɛnlado ne adwenle, amaa yeanlie ɛzonlenlɛ fofolɛ ɛhye yeanli. 9Na Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne rawolole Sɔɔlo, mɔɔ ɛnee akee bɛfɛlɛ ye Pɔɔlo la, ɔnleanle Ɛlemase koonwu 10na ɔzele ye kɛ, “Wɔmɔ Abɔnsam ara, ɛle debie kpalɛ biala kpɔvolɛ. Amumuyɛ ɛyi wɔ tɛkɛɛ, yɛɛ dahuu ɛbɔ adalɛ wɔ Awulae adenle kpalɛ ne anwo. 11Awulae ɛdua wɔ kakɛ, ɔmaa ɛ nye ɛzi ɔhɔkpula mekɛ ekyi bie mɔɔ ɛnnwu debie biala a.”
Na ɛkɛ ne ala awozinli vale Ɛlemase manle ɔlile nvuovua na ɔzɛlɛle kɛ awie ɛzɔ ɔ sa ɛhile ye adenle. 12Mɔɔ Amɛnlado ne nwunle mɔɔ ɛzi la, ɔliele ɔlile na Awulae anwo ngilehilelɛ ne yɛle ye azibɛnwo kpole.
Pɔɔlo nee ɔ gɔnwo mɔ wɔ Anteɔko mɔɔ wɔ Paesedea maanzinli nu la
13Pɔɔlo nee ɔ gɔnwo mɔ vi Peefɔso la bɛvale ɛlɛne bɛrale Pɛga, wɔ Pamefelea maanzinli nu, na Dwɔn Maake gyakyile bɛ ɛkɛ ne ziale hɔle Gyɛlusalɛm. 14Bɛvi Pɛga la bɛbɔle hwii bɛhɔle Anteɔko mɔɔ wɔ Paesedea la. Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ne dwule la, bɛhɔle nyianu sua ne anu na bɛhɔdɛnlanle aze. 15Bɛwiele Mosisi mɛla ne nee Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma edwɛkɛ ne kenga la, nyianu sua ne mgbanyima ne dole ɛsalɛ vɛlɛle bɛ kɛ, “Mediema, saa bɛlɛ edwɛkɛ fɛlɛko bie mɔɔ maa anwosesebɛ la a ɛnee bɛha bɛmaa menli ne ɛdie bie.” 16Pɔɔlo dwazole manle ɔ sa zo na ɔzele bɛ kɛ,
“Ayi mɔ Yizilayɛma nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma mɔɔ bɛwɔ ɛke na bɛsulo Nyamenle la, bɛdie me! 17 Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne kpale nu yele yɛ nlenya mɔ na ɔyɛle bɛ ɛlɔne kpole wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee bɛle nyɛvolɛ bɔbɔ wɔ Yigyibiti azɛlɛ zo la. Nyamenle vale ye tumi kpole ne yele bɛ vile Yigyibiti azɛlɛ zo, 18 na ɔnyianle bɛ nwo abotane ɔnleanle bɛ gyɛlɛɛnye wɔ ɛsɛlɛ ne azo ɛvolɛ abulanla. 19 Wɔ Keena noko, Nyamenle zɛkyele maanle maanle nsuu na ɔvale bɛ azɛlɛ ne ɔmanle ye menli ne mɔ.
20 “Ɛvolɛ asɛɛ ɛya nna abulanla anzi, ɔmanle bɛ ndɛnebuavolɛma toonwo ɔradwule Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ Samoɛle anwo zo. 21 Akee bɛbizale kɛ Nyamenle ɛmaa bɛ belemgbunli, yemɔti Nyamenle manle bɛvale Sɔɔlo mɔɔ le Kehye ara nrenya ne mɔɔ vi Bɛngyaman abusua nu la bɛyɛle bɛ belemgbunli ɛvolɛ abulanla. 22 Mɔɔ Nyamenle yele ye ɛkɛ ne la, ɔyɛle Devidi bɛ belemgbunli. Na Nyamenle hanle ɔ nwo edwɛkɛ kɛ, ‘Menwu Gyɛsi ara Devidi kɛ yemɔ a ɔle sonla mɔɔ sɔ me nye a, na yemɔ a ɔbali gyima mɔɔ mekpondɛ la amuala a.’ 23Devidi ɛhye alɔnra a le Gyisɛse mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛyɛ ye Yizilayɛma Ngoanedievolɛ, kɛmɔ ye ɛwɔkɛ ne se la. 24 Gyisɛse babɔ ye gyimalilɛ ne abo la, Dwɔn lumuale rabɔle nolo zele Yizilayɛma kɛ bɛnlu bɛ nwo wɔ bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ anwo na bɛmaa bɛzɔne bɛ. 25 Na mɔɔ Dwɔn bawie ye gyima ne la, ɔbizale menli ne kɛ, ‘Bɛdwenle kɛ mame a le nwane? Tɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛkendɛ ye la a le me. Na nea, ɔli me nzi ɔlɛba, na ye mgbɔlaboa bɔbɔ menfɛta kɛ menwɔyeye.’
26“Me mediema, Ebileham nlɔnra nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma na bɛsulo Nyamenle mɔɔ bɛwɔ ɛke la amuala, yɛmɛ yɛ ti yɛɛ bɛvale ngoanelielɛ nwo Edwɛkpa ɛhye bɛzoanle a! 27Menli mɔɔ wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm nee bɛ mgbanyima ne mɔ annwu kɛ yemɔ a ɔle Ngoanedievolɛ ne a, yɛɛ bɛande Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ bɛkenga ye dahuu wɔ Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ne la abo. Noko bɛbule Gyisɛse ewule fɔlɛ bɛmanle Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ hanle la yɛle nɔhalɛ. 28 Bɛannyia kpɔkɛ biala bɛangyinla zolɛ bɛambua ye ewule fɔlɛ, noko bɛzele Paelɛte kɛ ɔmaa bɛhu ye. 29 Bɛwiele debie biala mɔɔ Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne kile ye wɔ ɔ nwo la amuala yɛ la, bɛyele ye wɔ meanubaka ne azo na bɛziele ye. 30Na Nyamenle dwazole ye vile mɔwuamra anu, 31 na ɔyele ɔ nwo ɔhilele bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ nee ye vi Galeli rale Gyɛlusalɛm la, na ɔmanle bɛnwunle ye fane dɔɔnwo. Na bɛmɛ yɛɛ kɛkala bɛdi ɔ nwo daselɛ bɛkile Yizilayɛma a. 32-33 Na yɛdayɛ noko yɛra ɛke kɛ yɛfa Edwɛkpa ne yɛarɛlɛ bɛ kɛ, Nyamenle ɛwɔkɛ ne mɔɔ ɔbɔle yɛ nlenya mɔ la, yelua Gyisɛse mɔɔ yedwazo ye yera ngoane nu la anwo zo yeyɛ yemaa yɛmɛ mɔɔ yɛle bɛ nlɔnra la. Edwɛndolɛ ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nwiɔ la se,
‘Wɔmɔ, ɛle me ra;
ɛnɛ merayɛ ɛ ze.’
34 Mɔɔ fane ye mɔwuamra anu ɛdwazolɛ mɔɔ kile kɛ ɔnrɛkpɔlɔ ɛlɛ la, kɛ Nyamenle se la ɛne,
‘Mebava me nyilalɛ ne mɔɔ sonle bolɛ
mɔɔ menvale membɔle Devidi ɛwɔkɛ la meamaa wɔ.’
35 Eza yeha ye wɔ ɛleka fofolɛ kɛ,
‘Ɛnrɛmaa wɔ sonvolɛ ne mɔɔ
ɛdu ɔ nwo ɛmaa wɔ la ɛnrɛkpɔlɔ.’
36Devidi zonlenle ye Nyamenle wɔ ye mekɛ zo na ɔwule, bɛziele ye wɔ ɔ nlenya mɔ avinli, na ɔkpɔlɔle. 37Na sonla ne mɔɔ Nyamenle dwazole ye vile mɔwuamra anu la amkpɔlɔ. 38-39Zɔhane ati mediema, bɛ muala bɛnwu ye kɛ ɔlua Gyisɛse anwo zo yɛɛ bɛlɛka ɛtanefakyɛ nwo edwɛkɛ bɛahile bɛ a; awie biala mɔɔ kɛlie ye kɛli la bɛbalie ye bɛavi ye ɛtane ne mɔ mɔɔ Mosisi mɛla ne angola anye ye anvi nu la anu. 40Ɛhye ati, bɛnlea boɛ na mɔɔ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma hanle la anzi bɛ nwo zo. Ɔse,
41 ‘Bɛnlea, bɛmɛ agolobɛnwoma! Akpule ku bɛ agua bɛ lɔ!
Ɔluakɛ, gyima mɔɔ melɛdi wɔ bɛ mekɛ zo la ɛnle
debie mɔɔ awie kile nu kile bɛ bɔbɔ a bɛkɛlie bɛkɛli a!’ ”
42Mɔɔ Pɔɔlo nee Baanabase vi nyianu sua ne anu finde ahɔ la menli ne zɛlɛle bɛ kɛ Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle bieko bɛbɔ mɔdenle bɛraha edwɛkɛ ne kpalɛ bɛhile bɛ. 43Nzinlii mɔɔ bɛkpɔnenle la, Dwuuma nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma mɔɔ boka Dwuuma Nyamenlezonlenlɛ ne anwo la dɔɔnwo doale Pɔɔlo nee Baanabase, na ɛzoanvolɛma ne zile bɛ ahonle kɛ bɛzɔ Nyamenle ɛlolɛ ne anu kpundii.
44Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle bieko dwule la, asɛɛ suakpole ne azo amra amuala dule rale kɛ bɛbadie Awulae edwɛkɛ ne. 45Mɔɔ Dwuuma ne nwunle menli dɔɔnwo ne la, anyebolo dɔle bɛ nwo; bɛdendɛle bɛtiale mɔɔ Pɔɔlo ɛlɛka la, na bɛbɔle bɛ aholoba. 46Noko Pɔɔlo nee Baanabase dendɛle akɛnrasesebɛ zo zele bɛ kɛ, “Anrɛɛ ɔhyia kɛ bɛkɛlumua bɛkɛha Nyamenle edwɛkɛ ne bɛkɛhile bɛmɛ Dwuuma. Na saa bɛnyia bɛkpo kɛ bɛnrɛdie na bɛhile kɛ bɛ nwo ɛnfɛta ngoane mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ la a, ɛnee ɔwɔ kɛ yɛgyakyi bɛ na yɛkɔka edwɛkɛ ne yɛkile bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la. 47 Ɔluakɛ Awulae zele yɛ kɛ,
‘Meyɛ bɛ kɛ kɛnlaneɛ memaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle
Dwuuma la,
amaa aleɛabo amra amuala anyia ngoane.’ ”
48Mɔɔ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la dele ɛhye la, bɛlile fɛlɛko na bɛyeyɛle Nyamenle wɔ ye edwɛkɛ ne anwo, na bɛ nuhua mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ Nyamenle maa bɛ ngoane mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ la liele lile.
49Awulae edwɛkɛ ne dɛlɛle hɔle maanzinli ne anu amuala. 50Na Dwuuma ne lile mgbanyima mɔɔ wɔ suakpole ne azo nee mraalɛ mgbanyinli mɔɔ gyi boɛ na bɛsulo Nyamenle na bɛnle Dwuuma la anzo. Bɛmanle bɛbɔle ɔ bo bɛyɛle Pɔɔlo nee Baanabase kpɔdekpɔde toonwo bɛdule bɛ maanzinli ne anu. 51 Ɛzoanvolɛma ne kpɔlɔkpɔlale bɛ gyakɛ abo munlutu guale sua ne azo amra ati zo na bɛzile nu bɛhɔle Ayekoneɛm. 52Na diedima mɔɔ wɔ Anteɔko la lile fɛlɛko kpole na Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne yile bɛ tɛkɛɛ.

Title: GYI 14
Content:
Pɔɔlo nee Baanabase wɔ Ayekoneɛm
1Wɔ Ayekoneɛm noko, edwɛkɛ ko ne ala bie zile. Pɔɔlo nee Baanabase hɔle Dwuuma nyianu sua ne anu hɔdendɛle manle Dwuuma nee Gilikima dɔɔnwo liele lile. 2Na Dwuuma bie mɔ mɔɔ anlie anli la lile wulale bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la bie mɔ manle bɛvale diedima ne mɔ ɛkpɔlɛ. 3Noko ɛzoanvolɛma ne dɛnlanle ɛkɛ hyɛle, bɛhanle Awulae anwo edwɛkɛ ne akɛnrasesebɛ zo na Awulae hilele nɔhalɛ mɔɔ wɔ ye ɛlolɛ nwo nolo ne mɔɔ bɛlɛbɔ la anu na ɔmanle bɛ tumi ɔmanle bɛyɛle sɛkɛlɛneɛ nee nwanwane ninyɛne dɔɔnwo. 4Na menli mɔɔ wɔ suakpole ne azo la anloa anzɛ bɛ nwo; foa ko hɔle Dwuuma anzi, yɛɛ foa ko hɔle ɛzoanvolɛma ne anzi.
5Nzinlii bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la bie mɔ nee Dwuuma bɔle nu bɛ nee bɛ mgbanyima yɛle adwenle kɛ bɛkɔ ɛzoanvolɛma ne mɔ anwo zo bɛahɔzi bɛ awolɛ. 6Mɔɔ ɛzoanvolɛma ne dele la, bɛyele bɛ nwo zo na bɛhɔle Lesetela nee Dɛbi mɔɔ wɔ Laekewonea maanzinli nu la nee namunamu mɔɔ zuozua ɛkɛ ne la azo 7bɛhɔhanle Edwɛkpa ne wɔ ɛkɛ.
Pɔɔlo nee Baanabase wɔ Lesetela nee Dɛbi
8Nrenya bie wɔ Lesetela, bɛwole ye abubura, yemɔti ɔtɛtiale ɛlɛ. 9Ɛnee nrenya ɛhye ɛlɛtie Pɔɔlo kpalɛ. Na Pɔɔlo nwunle kɛ nrenya ne ɛnyia diedi mɔɔ kola yɛ ye ayile la, ɔnleanle ye koonwu 10na ɔdeanle nu ɔzele ye kɛ, “Dwazo gyinla!” Nrenya ne wulule gyinlanle na ɔbɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɔtia. 11Mɔɔ menli ne mɔ nwunle mɔɔ Pɔɔlo ɛyɛ la, bɛdeɛdeanle nu wɔ Laekewonea aneɛ ne anu kɛ, “Awozonle ne mɔ ɛhakyi bɛ nwo menli ɛra yɛ avinli!” 12Na bɛvɛlɛle Baanabase, Ziyɛse, na bɛvɛlɛle Pɔɔlo, Hɛmɛse, ɔluakɛ bɛse Pɔɔlo a tendɛ maa bɛ a. 13Na kɔmenle ne mɔɔ tendɛ Ziyɛse anloa azo, na ye amonle sua ne gyi sua ne kandiba ɛkɛ ne ala la vale nlankɛ nee ndotolo kɔtɔlɔba rale suakpole ne bane ne anlenkɛ kpole ne anloa kɛ ɔ nee menli ne mɔ bɛbabɔ azu bɛamaa ɛzoanvolɛma ne.
14Mɔɔ Baanabase nee Pɔɔlo dele mɔɔ menli ne mɔ kpondɛ ayɛ la, ɔyɛle bɛ azibɛnwo. Yemɔti bɛsuosuanle bɛ adɛladeɛ ne mɔ anu na bɛnriandile bɛhɔle menli ne avinli na bɛzele bɛ kɛ, 15 “Ayi mɔ, duzu ati a bɛlɛyɛ ɛhye mɔ ɛ? Yɛdayɛ noko yɛle menli kɛ bɛdabɛ la. Yɛrale kɛ yɛbabɔ Edwɛkpa ne nolo yeahile bɛ, amaa bɛahwe bɛ nwo bɛavi ninyɛne mgbane mgbane ɛhye mɔ mɔɔ anwo ɛnlɛ nvasoɛ la anwo, na bɛazonle tease Nyamenle ne mɔɔ bɔle anwuma, azɛlɛ, nyevile nee mɔɔ wɔ nuhua la amuala la. 16Mɔmoane ɔmanle menli muala adenle ɔmanle bɛyɛle mɔɔ bɛdabɛ bɛkulo la. 17Noko dahuu ɔdua ye ninyɛne kpalɛ mɔɔ ɔyɛ la azo ɔkile ɔ nwo ɔkile bɛ: ɔmaa bɛ ezule, yɛɛ ɛbuhenle ne dwu a ɔmaa bɛ aleɛ na ɔmaa bɛ nye die.” 18Noko ɛhye mɔ amuala anzi, ɔhale kyɛkyɛ mɔɔ ɛnee bɛngola bɛnzi menli ne mɔ aze wɔ bɛ azu ɛbɔlɛ ne anwo a.
19Nzinlii Dwuuma bie vi Anteɔko mɔɔ wɔ Paesedea maanzinli nu nee Ayekoneɛm la rale, bɛralile menli ne anzo bɛhɔle bɛ afoa na bɛzile Pɔɔlo awolɛ bɛmanle ɔ nye zo bulule; bɛhwenle ye bɛhɔdole sua ne kandiba, ɛnee bɛdwenle kɛ yewu. 20Na mɔɔ diedima ne rabɔle yiale ye la, ɔ nye rale zolɛ na ɔdwazole ɔ nee bɛ hɔle sua nu. Aleɛ hyenle la ɔ nee Baanabase bɛhɔle Dɛbi.
Pɔɔlo nee Baanabase ziale rale Anteɔko mɔɔ wɔ Selea la
21Pɔɔlo nee Baanabase hanle Edwɛkpa ne wɔ Dɛbi la, bɛnyianle ɛdoavolɛma gyɛlɛɛnye. Bɛvi ɛkɛ ne bɛziale bɛhɔle Lesetela nee Ayekoneɛm, yɛɛ Anteɔko mɔɔ wɔ Paesedea maanzinli nu la. 22Bɛmanle diedima ne mɔ anwosesebɛ na bɛzele bɛ kɛ bɛzɔ diedi ne anu kpundii. Bɛhilehilele bɛ kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ yɛnwu amaneɛ dɔɔnwo na yɛanwu Nyamenle Belemgbunlililɛ ne. 23Bɛzieziele mgbanyima bɛmanle bɛ, na bɛvale ɛhɔnehyelɛ nee nzɛlɛlɛ bɛdule bɛ bɛwulale Awulae ne mɔɔ bɛva bɛ rɛle bɛwule ye nu la asa anu.
24Akee bɛhɔkpɔsale Paesedea maanzinli ne anu na bɛrale Pamefelea maanzinli nu. 25Bɛhanle Edwɛkpa ne wɔ Pɛga na bɛhɔle Ateelea. 26Bɛvi ɛkɛ ne la bɛvale ɛlɛne bɛziale bɛrale Anteɔko. Ɛke a bɛdule bɛ bɛwulale Nyamenle ɛlolɛ ne abo kolaa na bɛabɔ bɛ gyima ɛhye mɔɔ bɛwie ye di la abo a.
27Mɔɔ bɛradwule Anteɔko la, bɛyiale asɔnema ne amuala na bɛhanle mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛva bɛ ɛyɛ la amuala bɛhilele bɛ, nee kɛ yezi yebuke diedi adenle yemaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la. 28Na bɛ nee diedima ne dɛnlanle ɛkɛ ne hyɛle dɔɔnwo.

Title: GYI 15
Content:
Gyɛlusalɛm ayia ne
1 Menli bie vi Dwudiya rale Anteɔko na bɛbɔle ɔ bo kɛ bɛkilehile diedima ne kɛ, “Saa bɛanyɛ bɛ mrenyanu nzonlɛ, kɛmɔ Mosisi mɛla ne kile la a bɛnrɛnyia ngoane.” 2Pɔɔlo nee Baanabase nee bɛ zule ɛhye anwo kpolera kpole kpalɛ. Zɔhane ati bɛdule menli kɛ bɛboka Pɔɔlo nee Baanabase anwo bɛhɔ Gyɛlusalɛm bɛhɔnwu ɛzoanvolɛma ne nee mgbanyima ne mɔ wɔ nwolɛ.
3Asɔnema ne guale bɛ adenle, na bɛkɔ la bɛvale Fonehyea nee Samɛlea, na bɛhanle kɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la ɛzi ɛhakyi, na bɛlie Nyamenle bɛli la anwo edwɛkɛ bɛhilele bɛ. Na diedima ne lile nwolɛ fɛlɛko somaa. 4Mɔɔ bɛdwule Gyɛlusalɛm la, bɛvale mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛva bɛ ɛyɛ la amuala bɛbɔle amaneɛ bɛhilele bɛ, na asɔnema ne, ɛzoanvolɛma ne, yɛɛ mgbanyima ne mɔ liele bɛ gyɛlɛɛnye. 5Na diedima ne bie mɔ mɔɔ boka Falasii fane ne anwo la dwazole na bɛhanle kɛ, “Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la yɛ bɛ mrenyanu nzonlɛ na eza bɛdi Mosisi mɛla ne azo.”
6Ɛdoavolɛma ne nee mgbanyima ne mɔ yiale nu vale edwɛkɛ ɛhye anwo adwenle. 7 Na bɛhehanle nwolɛ bie dedee la, Pita dwazole na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Ayi mɔ, bɛze kɛ mekɛ bie mɔɔ ɛraze ɛhɔ la, Nyamenle yele me bɛ avinli manle mengɔmbɔle Edwɛkpa ne nolo mengilele bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la, amaa bɛdabɛ noko bɛade edwɛkɛ ne na bɛalie bɛali. 8 Na Nyamenle mɔɔ ze sonla ahonle nu la hilele kɛ yelie bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la noko, na ɔmanle bɛ Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne bie, kɛmɔ ɔvale ɔmanle yɛdayɛ ala la. 9Yeangile kɛ asolo yɛmɛ nee bɛmɛ. Ɔluale bɛ diedi zo yɛɛ ɔvale bɛ ɛtane ɔhyɛle bɛ a. 10Duzu ati yɛɛ akee bɛkɛzɔ Nyamenle bɛkɛnlea, na bɛkɛva kpomgbolo kpole bɛkɛgyela diedima ne akɔme, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ yɛ nee yɛ nlenya mɔ yɛangola ye soa la ɛ? 11Kyɛkyɛ! Kɛmɔ yɛdie yɛdi na ɔlua Awulae Gyisɛse ɛlolɛ zo bɛbalie yɛ ngoane la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ bɛdabɛ noko bɛ ɛdeɛ ne de a.”
12Ɔhanle ɛhye la bɛ muala bɛyɛle koonwu na akee bɛdiele Baanabase nee Pɔɔlo kolakola ne, nee sɛkɛlɛneɛ nee nwanwane gyima mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛlua bɛ nwo zo ɛyɛ wɔ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la avinli la amuala. 13Mɔɔ bɛ nloa penle la, Gyemise dendɛle na ɔzele kɛ, “Mediema, bɛdie me. 14Saemɔn ɛha ɛhile nu kɛkala kɛ ɔzile ɔyɛle mɔɔ Nyamenle anye hɔle bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la anwo zo na ɔyele menli wɔ bɛ avinli ɔrayɛle ye ɛdeɛ bɔkɔɔ la. 15Ɛhye nee Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma edwɛkɛ ne le ko. Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se,
16 ‘Awulae se, ɛhye anzi mebazia meara,
na meamaa Devidi belemgbunlililɛ ne mɔɔ dɔle aze la zo.
Mebayɛ ye fofolɛ na meamaa ye zo meazie ɔ gyakɛ anu,
17amaa ewiade amra mɔɔ ɛha la ara me ɛkɛ,
na bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma na mevɛlɛ bɛ la arayɛ me ɛdeɛ.
18Awulae a vale ɛhye dole gua dɛbadɛba ne a.’ ”
19Gyemise hɔle zolɛ zele kɛ, “Me adwenle a le kɛ, ɔnle kɛ yɛta bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma na bɛhakyi bɛlɛba Nyamenle ɛkɛ ne la anye zo. 20 Bɛmaa yɛhɛlɛ kɛlata yehɔmaa bɛ kɛ bɛhwe bɛ nwo bɛvi ninyɛne mɔɔ anwo ɛnde, mɔɔ le kɛ aleɛ mɔɔ bɛva bɛkpa munzule anzɛɛ bɛva bɛzɔ amonle la anwo, nee ninyɛne mɔɔ le kɛ adwɔmane ɛbɔlɛ nee nane mɔɔ bɛlofo ye bɛhu ye na bɛampɛ ɔ kɔme la ɛlilɛ nee mogya nwo. 21Ɔluakɛ Mosisi mɛla ne, bɛkenga ye Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle biala wɔ nyianu azua ne mɔ anu, yɛɛ ɔ nloa edwɛkɛ noko bɛbɔ ye nolo wɔ sua biala azo.”
Kɛlata mɔɔ bɛhɛlɛle bɛhɔmanle diedima mɔɔ ɛnle Dwuuma la
22Ɛzoanvolɛma ne nee mgbanyima ne mɔ, nee asɔnema ne mɔ amuala akee bɔle kpɔkɛ kɛ bɛsoa menli bɛamaa bɛ nee Pɔɔlo nee Baanabase ahɔ Anteɔko. Bɛdule menli nwiɔ mɔɔ bɛbu bɛ kpalɛ la bɛmanle bɛ nee bɛ hɔle. Bɛmɛ a le Dwudase mɔɔ eza bɛfɛlɛ ye Baasabase la, yɛɛ Saelase. 23Na bɛvale kɛlata ɛhye bɛmanle bɛ kɛ bɛva bɛhɔ:
“Yɛdayɛ bɛ mediema ɛzoanvolɛma nee asɔne mgbanyima, yɛlɛ
mediema ɛhulolɛ yɛbiza mediema mɔɔ ɛnle Dwuuma mɔɔ wɔ
Anteɔko, Selesea, yɛɛ Selea la amuala ahye.
24Yɛde kɛ yɛ bie mɔ mɔɔ yɛanzoa bɛ la ɛra bagyegye bɛ aha edwɛkɛ azɛkye bɛ adwenle. 25-26Zɔhane ati yɛyia nu yɛbɔ kpɔkɛ na yɛdu menli kɛ bɛ nee Pɔɔlo nee Baanabase, mɔɔ ɛva bɛ ngoane ɛdo nzeleba wɔ yɛ Awulae Gyisɛse ɛzonlenlɛ ti la ɛrɛla. 27Bɛmɛ a le Dwudase nee Saelase, bɛ nloa edwɛkɛ bamoa mɔɔ yɛhɛlɛ ye wɔ kɛlata ye anu la azo. 28Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne nee yɛdayɛ yɛdie yɛto nu kɛ yɛnrɛva kpomgbolo kpole biala yɛnrɛkpolo bɛ kɔme kɛ ngyehyɛlɛ ɛhye mɔ mɔɔ hyia la ala. 29Bɛmmadi aleɛ mɔɔ bɛva bɛkpa munzule anzɛɛ bɛva bɛzɔ amonle la; bɛmmadi mogya; bɛmmadi nane mɔɔ bɛlofo ye na bɛampɛ ɔ kɔme la, na bɛhwe bɛ nwo bɛvi adwɔmane ɛbɔlɛ nwo. Saa bɛtwe bɛ nwo bɛfi ɛhye mɔ anwo a ɛnee bɛlua adenle fɔɔnwo ne anu. Yɛbiza bɛ ahye.”
30Menli mɔɔ bɛzoanle bɛ la hɔdwule Anteɔko la, bɛboɔboale diedima ne kɔsɔɔti anloa na bɛyele kɛlata ne bɛmanle bɛ. 31Mɔɔ diedima ne gengale kɛlata ne la, bɛlile fɛlɛko kpole wɔ akɛnrazilɛ mɔɔ kɛlata ne ɛva ɛrɛlɛ bɛ la anwo. 32Dwudase nee Saelase, mɔɔ bɛdabɛ mumua ne bɛle Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma la dendɛle dɔɔnwo hilele bɛ manle bɛnyianle anwosesebɛ. 33Bɛlile kenle ekyi wɔ ɛkɛ ne la, diedima ne akee gyakyile bɛ adenle kɛ bɛzia bɛhɔ menli mɔɔ zoanle bɛ la anwo lɔ. [ 34Na Saelase ɛdeɛ, ɔhulole kɛ ɔkɛdɛnla ɛkɛ ne.]
35Pɔɔlo nee Baanabase dɛnlanle Anteɔko hyɛle ekyii; bɛ nee diedima ne bie mɔ hilehilele na bɛbɔle Awulae edwɛkɛ ne nolo.
Pɔɔlo nee Baanabase avinli ɛtetelɛ
36Mekɛ guale nu la Pɔɔlo zele Baanabase kɛ, “Maa yɛzia yɛhɔkpɔla azua mɔɔ yɛha Awulae edwɛkɛ ne wɔ zo la, na yɛhɔnlea kɛ mediema ne mɔ si kɔ la.” 37Baanabase hulole kɛ bɛkɛva Dwɔn Maake bɛkɛboka bɛ nwo, 38 noko Pɔɔlo adwenle a le kɛ suzuamgba ala mɔɔ Maake kpole bɛ wɔ Pamefelea, ɔgyakyile bɛ ɛkɛ ne na ɔ nee bɛ anyɛ gyima ne anwie la, ɔngyia kɛ bɛ nee ye kɛhɔ. 39Ɛhye anwo kpolerazulɛ yɛle kyengye kpalɛ manle bɛ mu nwiɔ bɛ avinli tetele. Baanabase vale Maake na ɔ nee ye pɛle azule hɔle Saepelɛse. 40Pɔɔlo noko vale Saelɛse hɔle, na mediema ne mɔ vale Pɔɔlo wulale Awulae ɛlolɛ ne abo. 41Ɔhɔle Selea nee Selesea ɔhɔmanle diedima mɔɔ wɔ asɔne ne mɔ anu la anwosesebɛ.

Title: GYI 16
Content:
Temɔte nee Pɔɔlo nee Saelase kɔ
1Pɔɔlo eza rale Dɛbi nee Lesetela noko. Ɛdoavolɛ bie wɔ ɛkɛ, bɛfɛlɛ ye Temɔte. Ɔ nli le Dwuunli mɔɔ ɛlie Edwɛkpa ne ɛli a, yɛɛ ɔ ze le Gilikinli. 2Mediema mɔɔ wɔ Lesetela nee Ayekoneɛm la kanvo Temɔte kpole kpalɛ. 3Ɔlua zolɛ Pɔɔlo hulole kɛ ɔkɛva Temɔte ɔkɛhɔ. Ɛhye ati ɔmanle bɛyɛle ye mrenyanu nzonlɛ. Pɔɔlo yɛle ɛhye, ɔboalekɛ Dwuuma mɔɔ wɔ sua ne azo la amuala ze kɛ Temɔte ɔ ze le Gilikinli. 4Wɔ bɛ akpɔsa ne anu, sua biala mɔɔ bɛkɛdwu zo la bɛye ɛzoanvolɛma nee mgbanyima mɔɔ wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm la ngyehyɛlɛ ne bɛto diedima ne anyunlu, na bɛse bɛ kɛ bɛli zolɛ. 5Ɛhye manle asɔne ne mɔ anwo yɛle se wɔ diedi nu na menli dɔɔnwo rabokale bɛ nwo dahuu.
Pɔɔlo ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ wɔ Tulowase
6Bɛhɔle Felegyea nee Galeehyea maanzinli ne mɔ anu, ɔluakɛ Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne ammaa adenle ammaa bɛanga Edwɛkpa ne wɔ Ehyea maanzinli ne anu. 7Mɔɔ bɛdwule Mesea maanzinli ne ɛweɛne zo la bɛbɔle mɔdenle kɛ bɛkɛhɔ Baetenea maanzinli nu, na Gyisɛse Sunsum ne ammaa bɛ adenle. 8Ɛhye ati bɛpɛle nu bɛhɔluale Mesea maanzinli nu na bɛhɔle Tulowase. 9Nɔe ne Pɔɔlo nwunle ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ kɛ nrenya bie vi Masidonea ɛragyinla ɔ nyunlu ɛkɛ ne na ɔlɛkpa ye kyɛlɛ kɛ, “Bɛla Masidonea maanzinli nu na baboa yɛ!” 10Mɔɔ Pɔɔlo nwunle zɛhae debie la, yɛbɔle kpɔkɛ kɛ Nyamenle yɛɛ ɛvɛlɛ yɛ kɛ yɛhɔbɔ Edwɛkpa ne nolo yɛhile menli mɔɔ wɔ ɛkɛ ne la a, ɛhye ati yɛhuohuanle yɛ nwo na yɛhɔle Masidonea maanzinli nu.
Ledea yɛ diedinli
11Yɛvale ɛlɛne yɛvile Tulowase yɛdole ye zo yɛhɔle Samotelase, ye alehyenlɛ nu ɛnee yɛwɔ Niapɔlese. 12Yɛvi ɛkɛ ne la yɛhɔle Felepae, mɔɔ le suakpole wɔ Masidonea maanzinli nu la. Suakpole ɛhye Wulomu Maanle Maanle belemgbunli ne a bɔle ye nzeseɛ a. Yɛlile kenle dɔɔnwo wɔ sua ne azo. 13Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ne dwule la, yɛhɔle bɛ azule ne anloa wɔ suakpole ne kandiba. Yɛ adwenle a le kɛ kabezɛ ɛkɛ ne a Dwuuma ɔyɛ a yia yɛ nzɛlɛlɛ a. 14Mraalɛ mɔɔ diele yɛ edwɛkɛ ne la ko a le Ledea mɔɔ vi Tayataela na ɔtɔnedɔne arelemgbunli ndanlɛ la. Ɔle raalɛ mɔɔ Nyamenlezonlenlɛ wɔ ye nu a. Na Awulae bukele ye adwenle nu manle ɔdiele mɔɔ Pɔɔlo ɛlɛka la kpalɛ. 15Na ɔmanle bɛzɔnenle ye nee ye sua nu amra amuala, na ɔzele yɛ kɛ, “Saa bɛbu me kɛ melɛ diedi wɔ Awulae anu a, ɛnee bɛ nee me ɛradɛnla me sua nu.” Ɔtinlinle zolɛ na ɔ nee yɛ hɔle.
Bɛgua Pɔɔlo nee Saelɛse efiade wɔ Felepae
16Kenle ko yɛlɛkɔ ɛleka mɔɔ bɛyɛ nzɛlɛlɛ la, yɛyiale kanranli bɛlɛra bie mɔɔ di ahɔne na ɔlua ye munzule ɛbɔlɛ zo ɔ menle mɔ ɛnyia bɛ nwo ninyɛne nee ezukoa la. 17Ɔdoale yɛ nee Pɔɔlo na ɔlile yɛ nzi ɔdeɛdeanle nu kɛ, “Anwuma Anwuma Nyamenle ne sonvolɛma, mɔɔ bɔ ngoanelielɛ adenle ne anwo nolo la ɛne!” 18Ɔyɛle ɛhye alehyenlɛ dɔɔnwo ɔmanle akee ɔyɛle Pɔɔlo abodelɛ, na ɔhakyile ɔ nye ɔzele sunsum ɛtane ne mɔɔ wɔ bɛlɛra ne anwo la kɛ, “Ɔlua Gyisɛse Kelaese duma nu, mese wɔ kɛ, ɛvi ɔ nwo tu!” Na sunsum ɛtane ne vi bɛlɛra ne anwo dule ɛkɛ ne ala.
19Mɔɔ kakula raalɛ ne amenle mɔ nwunle kɛ bɛ ezukoa ɛnyialɛ adenle ne ɛdua la, bɛhɔhyele Pɔɔlo nee Saelase bɛhwenlenle bɛ aze bɛ nee bɛ hɔle mgbanyinli nyunlu wɔ bɛ gua ne anu. 20Bɛdoanle bɛ bɛhilele Wulomu arane mgbanyima ne mɔ kɛ, “Menli ɛhye mɔ le Dwuuma bie mɔɔ ɛva ngyegyelɛ ɛra suakpole ye azo a. 21Bɛlɛfa amaamuo mɔɔ nee yɛ ɛdeɛ ne ɛnle ko la bɛarahilehile yɛ. Yɛmɛ yɛle Wulomuma mɔɔ yɛdie bɛ ngilehilelɛ ne yɛto nu a ɔnyɛ boɛ a.” 22Na menli ne mɔ amuala bokale menli mɔɔ hɔdoanle ɛzoanvolɛma ne la anwo.
Na edwɛkɛdivolɛma ne tetele Pɔɔlo nee Saelase adɛladeɛ mɔɔ bɛwula la na bɛmanle bɛbilale bɛ empele. 23Mɔɔ bɛbole bɛ bɛwiele la, bɛguale bɛ efiade, na bɛzele mɔɔ nea efiade ne azo la kɛ ɔzɔ bɛ nu boɛ. 24Ɔlua zo ɔvale bɛ ɔhɔle efiade ne akunlu lɔ na ɔbɔle bɛ kpanwu.
25Nɔe ne, kɛyɛ alevinli mu nwiɔ avinli, ɛnee Pɔɔlo nee Saelase ɛlɛyɛ nzɛlɛlɛ na bɛlɛto edwɛne bɛaye Nyamenle ayɛlɛ, na menli mɔɔ bɛdabɛ noko bɛgua efiade ne bie la ɛlɛtie bɛ. 26Arɛlevilɛ nu ala azɛlɛ kpusule kpole bie na efiade ne adiabo ne kpusule. Na ɛkɛ ne ala efiade ne nlenkɛ ne mɔ amuala bukebukele na nwɔnzɔnwɔnzɔ mɔɔ dedɛ bɛ la amuala kpolokpolole guale. 27Mɔɔ pilizama sinzavolɛ ne vi nafelɛ nu dunwuele na ɔnwunle kɛ efiade ne nlenkɛ ne mɔ deda nwolɛ la, ɔdwenlenle kɛ menli mɔɔ bɛguale bɛ efiade ne la ɛwie nriandi kɔ, ɛhye ati ɔhwenle ye dadeɛ ne kɛ ɔku ɔ nwo. 28Na Pɔɔlo deanle nu kɛ, “Mmaku ɛ nwo! Yɛ muala yɛwɔ ɛke!”
29Pilizama sinzavolɛ ne manle bɛvale kɛnlaneɛ bɛrale, na ɔvale sulosulo ɔhɔdule ɔdɔle Pɔɔlo nee Saelase agyakɛ anu. 30Ɔvale bɛ ɔvindele na ɔbizale bɛ kɛ, “Yɛmenle mɔ, duzu yɛɛ menyɛ na meanyia ngoane a?”
31Bɛzele ye kɛ, “Die Awulae Gyisɛse di, na ɛdawɔ nee wɔ sua nu amra kɛnyia ngoane.” 32Akee bɛhanle Awulae anwo Edwɛkpa ne bɛhilele ye nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ ye sua nu ɛkɛ ne la amuala. 33Dɔnehwele ne anu ala, pilizama sinzavolɛ ne miemianle bɛ nganlɛ ne mɔ, na ɔvale nwole ɔtotole nu, na ɔmanle bɛzɔnenle ye nee ye sua nu amra amuala. 34Akee ɔvale bɛ ɔhɔle sua nu na ɔmanle bɛ debie bɛlile, na ɔ nee ye sua nu amra lile fɛlɛko kɛ bɛnyia diedi wɔ Nyamenle anu a.
35Aleɛ hyenle la, Wulomu arane mgbanyima ne mɔ zoanle kpolisi mgbanyinli manle bɛhɔzele pilizama sinzavolɛ ne kɛ, “Gyakyi menli ne mɔ maa bɛhɔ.”
36Pilizama sinzavolɛ ne hanle hilele Pɔɔlo kɛ, “Mgbanyima ne mɔ ɛzoa kɛ bɛgyakyi ɛdawɔ nee Saelase. Yemɔti bɛhɔ anzonudwolɛ nu.” 37Na Pɔɔlo zele kpolisi mgbanyinli mɔɔ rale la kɛ, “Bɛdabɛ, mgbane gyɛne ne ala, bɛbo yɛ bagua nu, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ yɛle Wulomuma la, bɛgua yɛ efiade na akee bɛkpondɛ kɛ bɛye yɛ ahane nyaa bɛmaa yɛkɔ? Yɛnrɛhɔ! Maa Wulomu mgbanyima ne mɔ bɛdabɛ bɛraye yɛ.”
38Kpolisi mgbanyinli ne mɔ hɔhanle edwɛkɛ ɛhye hilele Wulomu mgbanyima ne mɔ. Na mɔɔ bɛdele kɛ Pɔɔlo nee Saelase le Wulomuma la, bɛ ahonle dule. 39Ɛhye ati bɛrale bɛrakpale bɛ kyɛlɛ; bɛyele bɛ efiade ne na bɛzele bɛ kɛ bɛvi suakpole ne azo bɛhɔ. 40Pɔɔlo nee Saelase vi efiade ɛkɛ ne la, bɛhɔle Ledea sua nu. Bɛhɔdole mediema ne bie mɔ wɔ ɛkɛ, bɛdendɛle bɛhilele bɛ, bɛzile bɛ ahonle, na akee bɛhɔle.

Title: GYI 17
Content:
Pɔɔlo nee Saelase wɔ Tɛsalonaeka
1Pɔɔlo nee Saelase kpɔsale hɔle Amfepɔlese nee Apɔlonea na bɛrale Tɛsalonaeka. Dwuuma lɛ nyianu sua wɔ ɛkɛ. 2Kɛmɔ Pɔɔlo yɛ ye ala la, ɔhɔle nyianu sua ne anu na ɔ nee bɛ lile Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne anwo adwelie Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle fane nsa. 3Ɔhilehilele nu ɔmanle bɛnwunle kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ Mɛzaya ne nwu amaneɛ na bɛdwazo ye bɛfi ewule nu, na ɔvale ɔzɔle zolɛ kɛ, “Gyisɛse ɛhye mɔɔ melɛka ɔ nwo edwɛkɛ meahile bɛ la, yemɔ a le Mɛzaya ne.” 4Bɛ nuhua bie mɔ liele lile na bɛhakyile bɛdoale Pɔɔlo nee Saelase; zɔhane ala yɛɛ Gilikima mɔɔ sonle Nyamenle nee mraalɛ mgbanyinli dɔɔnwo ne ala yɛle a.
5Ɛhye anwo akpule hunle Dwuuma ne mɔ. Yemɔti bɛsesale kpamgbanvolɛma bie bɛboɔboale bɛ nloa. Bɛmanle bɛdole nzaka wɔ suakpole ne azo toonwo bɛrale Gyeesen sua nu ɛkɛ kɛ bɛbakpondɛ Pɔɔlo nee Saelase bɛahwe bɛ bɛavinde bagua nu. 6Bɛannwu bɛ la, bɛhwenlenle Gyeesen nee mediema ne bie mɔ bɛvale bɛ bɛhɔmanle mgbanyima ne mɔ kɛ, “Menli ɛhye mɔ mɔɔ ɛbutu ewiade amuala anye aze la ɛra yɛ sua ye azo noko, 7na Gyeesen ɛlie bɛ azie. Bɛ muala bɛlɛbulu Maanle Maanle belemgbunli ne mɛla zo, na bɛkile kɛ belemgbunli bieko eza wɔ ɛkɛ, bɛfɛlɛ ye Gyisɛse.” 8Bɛvale edwɛkɛ ɛhye bɛmanle menli ne nyakanle bɛmanle ɔhanle mgbanyima ne mɔ noko. 9Na nzinlii mgbanyima ne mɔ manle Gyeesen nee mediema ne mɔ duale ezukoa lile bɛ nwo agyinlanu, na bɛgyakyile bɛ bɛmanle bɛhɔle.
Pɔɔlo nee Saelase wɔ Bɛlia
10Mɔɔ maanle nu muanle la, mediema ne mɔ manle Pɔɔlo nee Saelase hɔle Bɛlia. Bɛhɔdwule la, bɛhɔle Dwuuma nyianu sua ne anu. 11Dwuuma mɔɔ wɔ ɛkɛ ne la adwenle nu ɛbuke ɛdɛla bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ Tɛsalonaeka la. Zɔhane ati bɛliele Edwɛkpa ne na dahuu bɛnleɛnleanle Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne anu kpalɛ kɛ saa mɔɔ Pɔɔlo ɛlɛka la le nɔhalɛ a. 12Bɛ dɔɔnwo ne ala liele lile, yɛɛ Giliki mraalɛ nee mrenya dɔɔnwo mɔɔ lɛ duma la noko liele lile. 13Na mɔɔ Dwuuma mɔɔ wɔ Tɛsalonaeka la dele kɛ Pɔɔlo ɛhɔha Nyamenle edwɛkɛ ne wɔ Bɛlia la, bɛrale ɛkɛ ne na bɛrafutule menli ne mɔ ahonle. 14Na ndɛndɛ ne ala mediema ne mɔ manle Pɔɔlo adenle bɛmanle ɔhɔle; na Saelase nee Temɔte hale Bɛlia. 15Menli mɔɔ hɔle Pɔɔlo ɛzɔhonlɛ la vale ye toonwo bɛ nee ye hɔdwule Atɛnse na bɛazia. Na Pɔɔlo vale nrɛlaleɛ manle bɛhɔmanle Saelase nee Temɔte kɛ bɛrɛla waa bɛraboa ye.
Pɔɔlo wɔ Atɛnse
16Mɔɔ Pɔɔlo ɛlɛkendɛ Saelase nee Temɔte wɔ Atɛnse la, ɔnwunle kɛ awozonle ɛzonlenlɛ ɛva sua ne, yemɔti ɔlile nyane dɔɔnwo. 17Zɔhane ati ɔhɔle nyianu sua ne anu ɔ nee Dwuuma nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma na bɛsulo Nyamenle la hɔdendɛle. Dahuu ɔkɔgyinla mgbata ne mɔ azo na ɔ nee menli mɔɔ se la tendɛ nwolɛ. 18Eku nwiɔ bie mɔɔ Ɛpekulɛse nee Zɛno a dele la anu kilehilevolɛma rale na bɛ nee Pɔɔlo razule kpolera na bɛzele kɛ, “Na sonlamgbane ɛhye, duzu edwɛkɛ yɛɛ ɔkpondɛ yeaha a?”
Bie mɔ noko se, “Ɔzɔho kɛ ɔlɛbɔ ɛzonlenlɛ fofolɛ bie anwo nolo.” Bɛhanle ɛhye, ɔluakɛ Pɔɔlo hanle Gyisɛse nee ewudwazo nwo edwɛkɛ. 19Yemɔti bɛvale Pɔɔlo bɛrale Alɛyɔpagɛse azo bagua ne anu na bɛzele ye kɛ, “Yɛkulo kɛ ɛmaa yɛnwu ngilehilelɛ fofolɛ ɛhye mɔɔ ɛlɛka nwolɛ edwɛkɛ la anu kpalɛ. 20Wɔ edwɛkɛ ne bie mɔ yɛ yɛ nzo nu ngakyile, na yɛkulo kɛ yɛte ɔ bo.” 21(Ɔluakɛ menli mɔɔ wɔ Atɛnse nee nyɛvolɛ mɔɔ wɔ sua ne azo la le menli bie mɔɔ dahuu kulo kɛ bɛnyia mekɛ bɛtie anzɛɛ bɛka debie fofolɛ biala anwo edwɛkɛ a.)
22Pɔɔlo dwazole gyinlanle ayiama ne anyunlu na ɔhanle kɛ, “Atɛnsema, menwu kɛ adenle biala anu, bɛkulo nyamenlezonlenlɛ kpalɛ. 23Mekpɔsa suakpole ye azo dɔɔnwo, na mɔɔ menwu ye la a le kɛ ɛleka biala mɔɔ bɛsonle la ɛdɛneyelɛ ninyɛne wɔ ɛkɛ ne, yɛɛ eza bɛlɛ azubɔlɛ mokyea ko mɔɔ bɛhɛlɛ nwolɛ ‘Ɛhye le Nyamenle ne mɔɔ yɛnze ye la ɛdeɛ’ la wɔ ɛkɛ. Na mɔɔ bɛsonle ye, noko bɛnze ye la, yemɔ yɛɛ mebaha ɔ nwo edwɛkɛ meahile bɛ kɛkala la. 24 Nyamenle ne, mɔɔ bɔle ewiade nee mɔɔ wɔ nuhua la amuala la le anwuma nee aze Awulae, na ɔndɛnla sua mɔɔ menli ɛva bɛ sa ɛzi la anu. 25Eza ɔngyia debie biala anwo na sonla ava ɔ sa anloa gyima akpondɛ debie amaa ye, ɔluakɛ ɔdaye a ɔmaa sonla biala ngoane nee ɛnwomenle nee debie biala a. 26Nyamenle bɔle sonla na ɔluale ɔ nwo zo ɔmanle menli ngakyile kɔsɔɔti mɔɔ wɔ aleɛabo la amuala rale. Ɔdaye yɛɛ ɔhyehyɛle ɛleka mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛtɛnla nee maanle biala ɛkpazilɛ nee ye azedɔlɛ a. 27Ɔyɛle ɛhye amaa bɛakpondɛ ye kɛ bɛ sa kɛha ye na bɛanwu ye. Noko Nyamenle nee yɛ nuhua biala avinli ande biala, 28ɔluakɛ,
‘Ye nuhua yɛɛ yɛde na yɛkɔ, yɛba, na yɛnyia ngoane a.’
Ɔle kɛ mɔɔ bɛdabɛ bɛ edwɛkɛdwɛndolɛma bie mɔ hanle la.
‘Yɛdayɛ noko yɛle ɔ mra.’
29Saa yɛle ɔ mra a, ɛnee ɔnle kɛ yɛdwenle kɛ Nyamenle le abɔdeɛ bie mɔɔ le kɛ ezukoa nvutuke anzɛɛ dwɛtɛ fufule anzɛɛ bolɛ ananze bie mɔɔ sonla ɔdaye yeva ye adwenle yehyehyɛ na yeyɛ la. 30Nyamenle bule ɔ nye guale zo wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee menli ɛnze la. Kɛkala, ɔlɛka yeahile menli kɔsɔɔti mɔɔ wɔ ɛleka biala la kɛ bɛnlu bɛ nwo wɔ bɛ ninyɛndane nwo. 31Ɔluakɛ yehile kenle mɔɔ ɔbalua sonla ne mɔɔ yedu ye yezie ɛkɛ ne la anwo zo yeabua aleɛabo amra kɔsɔɔti ndɛne a. Ɔdwazole sonla zɔhane ɔvile ewule nu ɔvale ɔzile edwɛkɛ ɛhye dawua ɔmanle awie biala.”
32Mɔɔ bɛdele kɛ Pɔɔlo ɛlɛka ewudwazo nwo edwɛkɛ la, bie mɔ golole ɔ nwo, yɛɛ bie mɔ noko zele kɛ, “Yɛkulo kɛ ɛsi edwɛkɛ ɛhye azo na ɛka ye bieko ɛkile yɛ wɔ kenle fofolɛ.” 33Na Pɔɔlo vi ayiama ne anyunlu hɔle. 34Noko menli ne bie mɔ liele lile na bɛhɔbokale ɔ nwo. Bie mɔ a le Dayoneseɛse, mɔɔ boka Alɛyɔpagɛse ayiama ne anwo, nee raalɛ bie mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Damalese la, yɛɛ bie mɔ dɔɔnwo.

Title: GYI 18
Content:
Pɔɔlo bɔ Edwɛkpa ne nolo wɔ Kɔlente
1Ɛhye anzi, Pɔɔlo vile Atɛnse hɔle Kɔlente. 2Ɔhɔdole Dwuunli bie mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Akoyela na bɛwole ye wɔ Pɔntɛse maanzinli nu la kɛ bɔ zo mɔɔ ɔ nee ɔ ye Pelesela bɛvi Yetale bɛra a, ɔluakɛ ɛnee Belemgbunli Kolɔdeɛse ɛha kɛ Dwuuma mɔɔ wɔ Wulomu la amuala vi maanle ne anu ɛdu. Pɔɔlo hɔle bɛ nwo, 3na kɛmɔ bɛ muala bɛ gyima mɔɔ bɛyɛ bɛdi aleɛ la a le ɛdanlɛ sua ɛyɛlɛ la ati, ɔ nee ye dɛnlanle na ɔ nee bɛ yɛle gyima. 4Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle biala ɔkɔ nyianu sua ne anu ɔ nee bɛ kɔtendɛ, kɛ ɔbɔ mɔdenle yeali Dwuuma nee Gilikima ne mɔ adwenle.
5Mɔɔ Saelase nee Temɔte vi Masidonea rale la ɛnee Pɔɔlo ɛva ye mekɛ muala ɛlɛka Edwɛkpa ne ali daselɛ ahile Dwuuma ne kɛ, Mɛzaya ne a le Gyisɛse. 6Nzinlii mɔɔ bɛtiale mɔɔ ɔlɛka la, bɛhehanle ɛtane dɔɔnwo bɛhilele ye. Ɛhye ati Pɔɔlo kpokpole ye tɛladeɛ ne anu munlutu guale na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Saa bɛminli a, nwolɛ ɛzonle ɛnzo me. Bɛdabɛ bɛ ɛminlinlɛ nwo ɛzonle zo bɛ! Ɔvi ɛnɛ mɔɔ kɔ la mebahɔ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la anu meahɔha Edwɛkpa ne.” 7Na Pɔɔlo vi ɛleka mɔɔ ɔde la dule na ɔhɔle nrenya bie mɔɔ ɛnle Dwuunli, na ɔsonle Nyamenle la sua nu. Nrenya ne bɛfɛlɛ ye Taeteɛse Gyɛsetɛse; ye sua nu bikye Dwuuma nyianu sua ne. 8Kelesepɛse mɔɔ nea nyianu sua ne azo la nee ye sua nu amra liele Awulae lile, yɛɛ Kɔlentema dɔɔnwo mɔɔ dele Edwɛkpa ne la liele lile na bɛmanle bɛzɔnenle bɛ.
9Kenle ko nɔɔzo Pɔɔlo nwunle Awulae wɔ ɛlalɛ nu kɛ ɔlɛka yeahile ye kɛ, “Pɔɔlo, mmasulo; kɔ zolɛ ka Edwɛkpa ne, mmagyakyi 10na mezua ɛ nzi. Awie biala ɛnrɛhola wɔ ɛhwee yɛ, ɔluakɛ menli dɔɔnwo wɔ sua ye azo mɔɔ bɛle me ɛdeɛ a.” 11Na Pɔɔlo dɛnlanle ɛkɛ ne toonwo ɛvolɛ ko nee foa, ɔhanle Nyamenle edwɛkɛ ne ɔhilele menli ne mɔ.
12Na mɔɔ bɛvale Galeyo bɛyɛle Wulomu amɛnlado mɔɔ nea Giliki maanzinli ne azo la, Dwuuma ne mɔ yɛle ko na bɛhwenle Pɔɔlo bɛhɔle kɛ ɔli ye edwɛkɛ. 13Bɛ ɛzonle mɔɔ bɛdonle ye la a le kɛ, “Sonla ɛhye ɛlɛbɔ mɔdenle yeamaa menli azonle Nyamenle wɔ adenle bie mɔɔ tia yɛ Dwuuma mɛla ne la azo.”
14Pɔɔlo yɛle kɛ ɔsa ɔ ne la, Galeyo zele Dwuuma ne mɔ kɛ, “Saa edwɛkɛ ɛhye yɛle debie mɔɔ tia mɛla anzɛɛ fane nyɛleɛ ɛtane bie anwo a anrɛɛ menwɔdie. 15Na kɛmɔ yehɔyɛ edwɛkɛ nu ngilehilelɛ nee duma yɛɛ bɛdabɛ Dwuuma bɛ mɛla nwo edwɛkɛ la, ɛnee bɛdabɛ bɛhɔnlea na bɛziezie. Edwɛkɛ zɛhae mɔ menrɛdɛnla menrɛli.” 16Na ɔyele bɛ ali wɔ kɔɔto ɛkɛ ne. 17Bɛvindele la, bɛhɔle Sɔsotɛnize mɔɔ nea nyianu sua ne azo la anwo zo na bɛbole ye dwɛɛ wɔ kɔɔto sua ne anyunlu ɛkɛ ne, noko ɛhye anvane Galeyo anwo nretee zɛhae bɔbɔ.
Pɔɔlo sia ara Anteɔko
18 Pɔɔlo lile mekɛ ekyi wɔ diedima ne mɔ anwo ɛkɛ ne la, nzinlii ɔ nee Pelesela nee Akoyela bɛvile ɛkɛ bɛvale azule nye kɛ bɛkɔ Selea. Bɛdwule Sɛnkilia la Pɔɔlo bɔle ɛwɔkɛ manle Nyamenle, yemɔti ɔmanle bɛkpale ɔ ti. 19Bɛdwule Ɛfɛsɛse la, Pɔɔlo gyakyile Pelesela nee Akoyela. Ɔhɔle Dwuuma nyianu sua ne anu ɔ nee bɛ hɔdendɛle. 20Menli mɔɔ liele lile la bodole ye kɛ ɔ nee bɛ ɛdɛnla ɛhyɛ, na yeamkponle. 21Ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Saa ɔyɛ Nyamenle ɛhulolɛ a mebazia meara.” Na ɔvi Ɛfɛsɛse ɔvale ɛlɛne ɔhɔle.
22Ɔradwule Sizalia la ɔbɔle hwii ɔhɔle Gyɛlusalɛm ɔhɔkpɔlale asɔnema ne mɔ na ɔpɛle nu ɔhɔle Anteɔko. 23Ɔlile mekɛ ekyi wɔ ɛkɛ ne la, ɔvile ɛkɛ ne na ɔhɔkpɔsale Galeehyea nee Felegyea maanzinli ne mɔ anu ɔmanle diedima ne mɔ anwosesebɛ.
Apɔlɔso bɔ Edwɛkpa ne nolo wɔ Ɛfɛsɛse nee Kɔlente
24Dwuunli bie mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Apɔlɔso, mɔɔ bɛwole ye Alɛzandelea, na ɔ nloa ɛde, eza ɔze Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne kpalɛ la rale Ɛfɛsɛse. 25Bɛtete ye wɔ Awulae Adenle ne anu, yemɔti ɔkola ɔka Gyisɛse anwo edwɛkɛ ne fɔɔnwo kpalɛ. Noko Dwɔn ɛzɔnenlɛ ɛdeɛ ne ala a ɔze a. 26Ɔdendɛle akɛnrasesebɛ zo kpalɛ wɔ Dwuuma nyianu sua ne anu. Pelesela nee Akoyela nwunle ye la, bɛvɛlɛle ye bɛ sua nu na bɛhilehilele ye Awulae Adenle ne anwo edwɛkɛ fɔɔnwo. 27Apɔlɔso yɛle ye adwenle kɛ ɔkaluolua Akaya (Giliki maanle nu) yeaha Nyamenle edwɛkɛ ne, zɔhane ati mediema ne mɔ boale ye na bɛhɛlɛle kɛlata bɛmanle ɔhɔmanle mediema mɔɔ wɔ nehane la, kɛ bɛlie ye kɛnlɛma gyɛlɛɛnye. Ɔhɔdwule la ɔyɛle moalɛ kpole ɔmanle bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛlua Nyamenle ɛlolɛ zo bɛrayɛ diedima la. 28Ɔluakɛ ɔka Dwuuma ne mɔ ɔgua mekɛ biala mɔɔ bɛkɛyia kɛ bɛyɛ ngilehilelɛ la na ɔfa Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne ɔkilehile nu wienyi kɛ Mɛzaya ne a le Gyisɛse.

Title: GYI 19
Content:
Pɔɔlo ka Edwɛkpa ne wɔ Ɛfɛsɛse
1Mɔɔ Apɔlɔso wɔ Kɔlente la, Pɔɔlo hɔle maanzinli ne anu akpɔsa toonwo ɔravindele Ɛfɛsɛse, na ɔranwunle ɛdoavolɛma bie wɔ ɛkɛ. 2Ɔbizale bɛ kɛ, “Bɛliele bɛlile la, bɛnyianle Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne ɔ?”
Bɛzele ye kɛ, “Yɛtɛtele bɔbɔ kɛ Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza bie wɔ ɛkɛ.” 3Ɔbizale bɛ kɛ, “Ɛnee ɛzɔnenlɛ ne boni a bɛnyianle a?”
Bɛbuale kɛ, “Dwɔn ɛzɔnenlɛ ne ɔ.” 4 Na Pɔɔlo zele bɛ kɛ, “Dwɔn zɔnenle menli mɔɔ nlunle bɛ nwo wɔ bɛ ɛtane nwo la; na ɔzele Yizilayɛma kɛ bɛva bɛ rɛle bɛwula mɔɔ ɔli ɔ nzi ɛlɛba la anu. Na sonla zɔhane a le Gyisɛse.”
5Bɛdele ɛhye la, bɛmanle bɛzɔnenle bɛ wɔ Awulae Gyisɛse duma nu. 6Pɔɔlo vale ɔ sa guale bɛ nwo zo, bɛnyianle Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne na bɛhanle ɛdendɛlɛ ngakyile bɛhanle Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ ne. 7Bɛ muala bɛkɛyɛ bulu nee nwiɔ.
8Pɔɔlo hɔle nyianu sua ne anu na ɔdendɛle akɛnrasesebɛ zo ɔhilele Dwuuma ne mɔ toonwo siane nsa kɛ ɔmaa bɛanwu Nyamenle Belemgbunlililɛ ne. 9Na kɛmɔ bie mɔ ahonle ɛsolo la ati, bɛ muala bɛanlie bɛanli. Bie mɔ dendɛle ɛtane tiale Awulae Adenle ne wɔ menli somaa ne anyunlu. Zɔhane ati Pɔɔlo gyakyile bɛ na ɔ nee diedima ne mɔ akee kɔtendɛ na ɔkilehile bɛ wɔ Taelanɛse sukulu sua ne anu alehyenlɛ biala. 10Ɛhye hɔle zolɛ ɛvolɛ nwiɔ. Yemɔti ɔmanle bɛdabɛ mɔɔ ɛnee bɛwɔ Ehyea maanzinli ne anu la, Dwuuma nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la, amuala dele Awulae anwo Edwɛkpa ne.
Siva amra mrenya ne mɔ
11Nyamenle luale Pɔɔlo anwo zo yɛle nwanwane ninyɛne mɔɔ yɛ ɛzulolɛ a. 12Saa bɛfa ye hameteduku anzɛɛ ahedazo bɛkɔgua awuleravolɛ nwo zo a, bɛte kpɔkɛ, na sunsum ɛtane ne mɔ fi bɛ nwo nriandi. 13Dwuuma bie mɔ noko mɔɔ bɛdabɛ bɛluolua nu bɛtu sunsum ɛtane la yɛle kɛ bɛfa Awulae Gyisɛse duma bɛayɛ bie. Bɛzele sunsum ɛtane ko kɛ, “Melua Gyisɛse ne mɔɔ Pɔɔlo bɔ ɔ nwo nolo la duma nu mese wɔ kɛ ɛvi ɔ nwo tu.” 14Debie zɛhae, Dwuunli sɛlɛvolɛ kpanyinli bie mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Siva la amra mrenya nsuu a yɛle a.
15Na sunsum ɛtane ne zele bɛ kɛ, “Meze Gyisɛse, yɛɛ meze Pɔɔlo, na bɛmɛ noko ɛ?” 16Na sonla ne mɔɔ sunsum ɛtane ne gyi ɔ nwo la dele dɔle bɛ nwo zo na ɔhanle bɛ senle dwɛɛ ɔmanle bɛlɛle bɛ nwo zɔhane bɛnriandile bɛvile sua ne anu bɛhɔle, bɛbodɛboda zɛhae ala. 17Dwuuma nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma, mɔɔ wɔ Ɛfɛsɛse la amuala dele mɔɔ zile la; bɛ muala bɛzulole, na ɔmanle bɛlile Awulae Gyisɛse duma ne eni kpole kpalɛ. 18Na menli somaa ne ala mɔɔ liele lile la rale bagua nu rahanle ɛtane mɔɔ bɛyɛ bɛvea la amuala. 19Ngonyiama dɔɔnwo ne ala vale bɛ mbuluku mɔɔ bɛfa bɛyɛ bɛ gyima la rale manle bɛyelale bɛ wɔ bagua nu. Bɛsesenle mbuluku ne mɔ awolɛ la, bɛ muala bɛ nloa dole dwɛtɛ fufule apenle ngoko abulanlu. 20Na ɔlua zɛhae adenle zo Awulae edwɛkɛ ne dɛlɛle na ɔlile konim dɔɔnwo.
Ɛfɛsɛsema di nzaka
21Ɛhye anzi, akee Pɔɔlo yɛle ye adwenle kɛ ɔkɔ Masidonea nee Akaya (Giliki maanle nu) na yeava lɔ yeahɔ Gyɛlusalɛm, na ɔhanle ɔzɔle zolɛ kɛ, “Saa mevi ɛkɛ a mebahɔ Wulomu noko.” 22Zɔhane ati ɔmanle ye boavolɛma ne mɔ nwiɔ, Temɔte nee Yilasetɛse lumuale Masidonea, na yemɔ ɔdɛnlanle Ehyea maanzinli ne anu ekyii.
23Mekɛ ɛhye anu ala Awulae Adenle ne ngilehilelɛ ne ati nzaka zile Ɛfɛsɛse. 24Dwɛtɛ dwinvolɛ bie wɔ ɛkɛ, bɛfɛlɛ ye Dimiteleɛse. Ɔfa dwɛtɛ fufule ɔyɛ bozonle raalɛ Aatɛmese ananze ɔtɔne ye. Zɛhae gyima maa dwinvolɛma nyia ezukoa kpalɛ. 25Kenle ko Dimiteleɛse vɛlɛle ɔ gɔnwo dwinvolɛma manle bɛyiale na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Ayi mɔ, bɛdabɛ bɛze kɛ yɛ ɛkpazilɛ gyi yɛ gyima ye azo. 26Na bɛdabɛ bɛnwu ye yɛɛ eza bɛde nyɛleɛ mɔɔ Pɔɔlo ye ɛlɛyɛ la; asɛɛ yehakyi bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ Ɛfɛsɛse ɛke, nee Ehyea maanzinli ye anu la amuala adwenle kɛ ananze mɔɔ sonla ɛva ɔ sa ɛyɛ la ɛnle nyamenle fee. 27Ɛhye kile kɛ yɛ gyima bazɛkye na bozonle raalɛ kpole Aatɛmese ɛzonlenlɛ sua kpole ne adɔ mgbane, mɔɔ ɔnrɛhyɛ biala na ye ɛzonlenlɛ wɔ Ehyea maanzinli ye anu nee ewiade amuala abɔ aze a.”
28Mɔɔ dwinvolɛma ne mɔ dele Dimiteleɛse edwɛkɛ ne la, bɛ muala bɛvale ɛya na bɛdeɛdeanle nuhua kɛ, “Aatɛmese, Ɛfɛsɛsema bozonle raalɛ ne le kpole!” 29He-e-e ko mɔɔ bɛyɛle la pɛle sua bɔdenle ne. Na nzakama ne mɔ dule twi kokye la ɛnee bɛwɔ Masidoneama nwiɔ, Gayɛse nee Alesetaakɛse mɔɔ nee Pɔɔlo a lua la anwo zo nwee. Bɛhwenle bɛ bɛ nee bɛ hɔle ɛleka mɔɔ ɔyɛ a bɛyia la. 30Pɔɔlo yɛle kɛ ɔkɔ bagua ne anu yeahɔdendɛ yeahile bɛ, na diedima ne mɔ amkponle ye. 31Maanzinli ne anu mgbanyima ne bie mɔ, mɔɔ le Pɔɔlo agɔnwo mɔ la noko zoanle manle bɛhɔzele ye kɛ ɔmmaye ɔ nyunlu wɔ ɛlɔne ne anu. 32Mekɛ ne anu ɛnee ɛwudolɛ ala a ɛlɔne ne ɛlɛwudo a. Bie mɔ ɛlɛka edwɛkɛ ko la, ɛnee bie mɔ noko ɛlɛka edwɛkɛ fofolɛ, na ayia sua ne anu yɛle wadawada zɛhae ala, ɔluakɛ bie mɔ dɔɔnwo mɔɔ rale ɛkɛ ne la ɛngola ɛnnwu deɛ holɛ ko mɔɔ ɔlua zolɛ bɛrayia la. 33Bɛ nuhua bie mɔ dwenlenle kɛ Alɛzanda a di nzakadolɛ ne anwo ɛzonle a, ɔluakɛ Dwuuma bie mɔ mɔɔ wɔ ɛkɛ ne la ɛzuhuzuhu ye dedee bɛmaa yeragyinla ɛlɔne ne anyunlu. Alɛzanda bobole bɛ kɛ bɛyɛ koonwu, na ɔyɛle kɛ ɔtendɛ yeahile bɛ. 34Na mɔɔ bɛnwunle kɛ ɔle Dwuunli la, bɛ muala bɛdeɛdeanle nuhua bɛwudole dedee asɛɛ dɔnehwele nwiɔ bɛhanle kɛ, “Aatɛmese, Ɛfɛsɛsema bozonle raalɛ ne le kpole!”
35Nzinlii, maanle abɔlɔba ne nleanle manle ɛlɔne ne yɛle koonwu na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Ɛfɛsɛsema, awie biala ze kɛ suakpole Ɛfɛsɛse a nea bozonle raalɛ kpole Aatɛmese amonle sua ne nee ye dehelɛ bolɛ ne mɔɔ vi anwuma radɔle aze la azo a. 36Awie biala ɛnzu ɛhye anwo kpolera kɛ yemɔ ɔnze. Yemɔti, bɛha bɛ ahonle bɛgua azule nu, na bɛmmayɛ bɛsɛkye debie. 37Bɛva menli ɛhye mɔ bɛra ɛke wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛtɛwuale bozonle debie yɛɛ bɛtɛkanle munzule edwɛkɛ biala bɛtɛtiale yɛ bozonle raalɛ ne la. 38Saa Dimiteleɛse nee ɔ gɔnwo mɔ lɛ edwɛkɛ bie tia awie a, kɔɔto wɔ ɛkɛ yɛɛ edwɛkɛdivolɛma ne noko wɔ ɛkɛ mekɛ biala. Bɛkola bɛ nee bɛ kɔ lɔ. 39Na saa bɛnea na debie gyɛne bieko wɔ nu mɔɔ yemɔti ɔwɔ kɛ bɛdi ye baguafutu a, ɛnee ɔwɔ kɛ bɛyɛ ye kɛmɔ ngyehyɛlɛ ne kile la. 40Ɔluakɛ saa yɛannea boɛ a yɛbali ɛzonle wɔ nzakadolɛ ɛhye mɔɔ ɛra ɛnɛ la anwo, ɔboalekɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛyɛ la ɛnlɛ ngilenu biala.” 41Ɔhanle ɛhye la ɔmanle bɛzandele.

Title: GYI 20
Content:
Pɔɔlo kɔ Masidonea nee Akaya
1Nzinlii mɔɔ nzakadolɛ ne guale la, Pɔɔlo vɛlɛle ɛdoavolɛma ne na ɔmanle bɛ akɛnrazilɛ, ɔ nee bɛ lile nrɛlaleɛ na ɔhɔle Masidonea. 2Ɔvale maanzinli ne mɔ anu na ɔhɔdendɛle ɔzile ɛdoavolɛma ne mɔ ahonle na akee ɔrale Akaya. 3Ɔlile siane nsa wɔ Akaya. Na mɔɔ ɔhuohuanle ɔ nwo kɛ ɔkɔ Selea la, ɔnwunle kɛ Dwuuma ne ɛhɔ ɔ ti akpamo. Yemɔti ɛkɛ ne ala ɔyɛle ye adwenle kɛ ɔpe aze yealua Masidonea yeazia. 4Na Sosepatɛ, mɔɔ le Pelɛse ara nrenya ne mɔɔ vi Bɛlia, yɛɛ Alesetaakɛse nee Sɛkɛndɛse, mɔɔ vi Tɛsalonaeka, Gayɛse mɔɔ vi Dɛbi, yɛɛ Temɔte, akee Tekekɛse nee Tulofemɛse mɔɔ vi Ehyea maanzinli nu la nee ye a hɔle a. 5Menli ɛhye mɔ lumuale yɛ nyunlu hɔhendɛle yɛ wɔ Tulowase. 6Na mɔɔ Angye Ɛvoyia ne pɛle nu la, yɛvale ɛlɛne yɛvile Felepae; ye kenle nnu ne azo yɛhɔdole bɛ wɔ Tulowase na yɛlile dapɛne ko wɔ ɛkɛ.
Pɔɔlo kakpɔla diedima mɔɔ wɔ Tulowase la
7Dapɛne ne anu kenle ne mɔɔ lumua la nɔsolɛ nu, yɛyiale nu yɛlile Awulae aleɛ ne, na Pɔɔlo dendɛle hilele diedima ne mɔ, ɔluakɛ ɛnee ye alehyenlɛ nu ɔbahɔ, na ɔhɔle zolɛ ɔdendɛle dedee alevinli mu nwiɔ avinli. 8Ahɛnlaneɛ dɔɔnwo wɔ esanwu ne ekpumgbunli ne mɔɔ yɛwɔ nu la anu. 9Na kpavolɛ bie mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Yutekɛse, mɔɔ ɛnee de nvɛnzɛlɛ ne mɔ ko azo la bɔle ngɔsɔkɛ, na nzinlii ɔlafele kpole na ɔvi esanwu nzɛzo nsa ne azo ɔdɔle aze. Bɛhɔmanle ye zo la, ɛnee yewu bɔkɔɔ. 10Pɔɔlo dwule aze hɔbutule ɔ nwo zo, ɔbɛlale ye na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛgyakyi mɔɔ bɛlɛyɛ la na ɔtɛwule.” 11Pɔɔlo ziale hɔle esanwu ne azo bieko na ɔhɔlile debie. Nzinlii eza Pɔɔlo dendɛle hilele menli ne toonwo alehyenlɛ, akee ɔhɛlale bɛ na ɔhɔle. 12Na bɛ nee kpavolɛ ne hɔle sua nu arɛlekyekyelɛ nu mɔɔ ɛnee ɔte kpɔkɛ bɔkɔɔ a.
Pɔɔlo vi Tulowase kɔ Maelitɛse
13Na yɛmɛ yɛvale ɛlɛne yɛlumuale Asɔso kɛ yɛkava Pɔɔlo wɔ ɛkɛ; ɔluakɛ ɛnee ɔ nee yɛ ɛhyehyɛ kɛ ɔpe aze yealumua lɔ. 14Mɔɔ ɔ nee yɛ yiale Asɔso la, ɔravole ɛlɛne ne anu na yɛtelele zolɛ yɛhɔle Metelin. 15Yɛvi ɛkɛ ne la ye alehyenlɛ nu yɛradwule Kayɔso. Aleɛ hyenle bieko la yɛrale Seemɔso, ye alehyenlɛ nu ɛnee yɛwɔ Maelitɛse. 16Pɔɔlo yɛle ye adwenle kɛ ɔnrɛgyinla Ɛfɛsɛse na ɔpɛ nu yeahɔ, amaa yeanzɛkye mekɛ dɔɔnwo wɔ Ehyea maanle ne anu na ɔ nwo ayɛ ndɛ, amaa saa ɔyɛ na ɔkɛyɛ boɛ a, yeadwu Gyɛlusalɛm wɔ Pɛntekɔso kenle ne.
Pɔɔlo nee Ɛfɛsɛse asɔne mgbanyima di nrɛlaleɛ
17Pɔɔlo dole Ɛfɛsɛse asɔne mgbanyima ne mɔ nrɛlaleɛ kɛ bɛyia ye wɔ Maelitɛse. 18Bɛrale la ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛdabɛ bɛnwu kɛ mezi mebɔ me ɛbɛla, ɔvi kenle mɔɔ membandwule Ehyea maanle ye anu toonwo mɔɔ ɛradwu ɛnɛ la. 19Wɔ Dwuuma akpamo ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛvale wɔ me ti la amuala anu, mendole me nwo aze menvale monle nee amaneɛnwunlɛ menyɛle me gyima kɛ Awulae akɛlɛ. 20Bɛze kɛ meanva debie biala mɔɔ kɛyɛ moalɛ kɛmaa bɛ la meanvea bɛ, na menzile me ahonle mengilehilele bɛ wɔ bagua nu nee bɛ azua nu. 21Mengakyele Dwuuma nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la amuala kɛ bɛnlu bɛ nwo wɔ bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛyɛ bɛtia Nyamenle la anwo na bɛlie yɛ Awulae Gyisɛse bɛli. 22Kɛkala melɛkɔ Gyɛlusalɛm, kɛmɔ Sunsum ne ɛhile la. Menze mɔɔ bazi me nwo zo wɔ ɛkɛ ne a, 23mɔɔ meze la a le kɛ Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne ɛhakye me wɔ sua biala azo kɛ efiadedolɛ nee esiane yɛɛ ɛlɛkendɛ me a. 24 Noko me ngoane ɛdeɛ, mendwenle nwolɛ, amaa meahola meawie Awulae Gyisɛse gyima ne mɔɔ yeva yemaa me kɛ membɔ Edwɛkpa ne mɔɔ fane Nyamenle ɛlolɛ ne anwo la nolo.
25“Mekpɔsa bɛ nwo zo meha Nyamenle Belemgbunlililɛ ne anwo edwɛkɛ mehile bɛ. Kɛkala, bɛ biala ɛnrɛnwu me nyunlu bieko. 26Ɛhye ati memaa bɛade ɔ bo wienyi ɛnɛ kenle ye kɛ saa bɛ nuhua biala minli a, menli nwolɛ ɛzonle. 27Ɔluakɛ meanva debie biala mɔɔ fane Nyamenle ngyehyɛlɛ ne anwo la meanvea bɛ. 28Bɛnlea bɛ nwo boɛ na bɛnlea mboane ne mɔ mɔɔ Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne ɛva bɛ ɛwula bɛ sa nu la boɛ. Bɛnlea Nyamenle asɔne ne mɔɔ yeva ɔ Ra ne mogya a yekpondɛ la azo boɛ. 29Meze kɛ saa mekɔ a, bɛdi anwo ɛzulolɛ baragua mboane ne mɔ avinli, na bɛnrɛze bɛ anwunvɔne fee. 30Mekɛ bara mɔɔ menli vi bɛ avinli badwazo araha edwɛkɛ adalɛ ahwe diedima ne bie mɔ ahɔli bɛ nzi a. 31Yemɔti bɛnlea boɛ, na bɛhakye kɛ mendwinle monle ɛvolɛ nsa a mengilehilele bɛ wɔ nɔɔzo nee ewiazo a.
32“Kɛkala mefa bɛ mewula Nyamenle nee ye edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ ɛlolɛ wɔ nu la asa anu. Ɔdo bɛ ngoane nu na ɔva ye nyilalɛ ne mɔɔ yeva yezie ye menli ne ɛkɛ ne la ɔmaa bɛ. 33Me nye ambolo awie biala ezukoa nvutuke, dwɛtɛ fufule anzɛɛ ndanlɛ. 34Bɛdabɛ bɛze kɛ medame me sa anloa gyima mɔɔ meyɛ la yɛɛ meva menlea me nwo nee me gɔnwo mɔ a. 35Mehilehile bɛ wɔ debie biala anu kɛ ɔlua gyima ɛsesebɛ ɛyɛlɛ zo yɛɛ bɛkɛhola bɛkɛboa menli mɔɔ ɛnlɛ anwosesebɛ la a. Bɛhakye Awulae Gyisɛse edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ ɔhanle la. Ɔse, ‘Nyilalɛ dɔɔnwo wɔ ɛmanlɛ nu tɛla ɛlielɛ.’ ”
36Mɔɔ Pɔɔlo wiele la, ɔ nee bɛ bɛ muala bɛhotole na bɛyɛle nzɛlɛlɛ. 37Mɔɔ bɛlɛfua ye, bɛlɛfo ɔ nvoka anwo bɛayɛ ye tia boɛ la, ɛnee biala ɛlɛsu. 38Debie mɔɔ manle bɛ nwo bubule bɛ kpalɛ bɔbɔ la a le ye edwɛkɛ kpɔkɛ ne mɔɔ ɔhanle kɛ bɛnrɛnwu ye bieko la. Na bɛhɔzɔhonle ye wɔ ɛlɛne ne anwo.

Title: GYI 21
Content:
Pɔɔlo kɔ Gyɛlusalɛm
1Yɛ nee bɛ lile nrɛlaleɛ wiele la yɛvi ɛkɛ ne yɛdule yɛluale zo yɛhɔle Kɔɔso; aleɛ hyenle la ɛnee yɛ nyunlu a le Wulodise. Yɛvi ɛkɛ ne la yɛhɔle Patala. 2Ɛkɛ ne yɛɛ yɛvale ɛlɛne mɔɔ ɛlɛkɔ Fonehyea la yɛhɔle a. 3Yɛradwule ɛleka bie mɔɔ ɛnee yɛ nye dua Saepelɛse la yɛwɔnenle yɛ ti nyiakɛ yɛpɛle yɛdɔle Selea. Yɛradwule Taya, na kɛmɔ ɛkɛ ne yɛɛ ɛlɛne ne tu ye ninyɛne ne agua la ati, yɛdwule aze yɛhɔle sua zo. 4Yɛnwunle diedima ne bie mɔ wɔ ɛkɛ, na yɛ nee bɛ hɔdɛnlanle dapɛne ko. Na bɛluale Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne anwo zo bɛzele Pɔɔlo kɛ ɔmmakɔ Gyɛlusalɛm. 5Noko yɛ mekɛ mɔɔ yɛdi ye bɛ nwo ɛkɛ ne la wiele la, yɛvile ɛkɛ ne na yɛzɔle yɛ adendulɛ ne azo. Bɛ muala bɛ nee bɛ ye mɔ nee bɛ mra bɛhɔzɔhonle yɛ wɔ suakpole ne kandiba, na yɛ muala yɛhotole ɛnwea ne azo yɛyɛle nzɛlɛlɛ. 6Akee yɛlile nrɛlaleɛ na yɛhɔvole ɛlɛne ne anu, na bɛdabɛ noko bɛziale bɛhɔle sua nu.
7Yɛzɔle yɛ adendulɛ ne azo, yɛvi Taya yɛhɔle Tɔlɛmeeyese, yɛhɔkpɔlale diedima mɔɔ wɔ ɛkɛ ne la na yɛlale ɛkɛ ne. 8 Ye alehyenlɛ nu yɛvi ɛkɛ ne yɛrale Sizalia. Yɛhɔzokoɛle Felepe mɔɔ kpɔsa bɔ Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne nolo la sua nu na yɛ nee ye dɛnlanle. Felepe boka menli nsuu ne mɔɔ bɛkpale nu bɛyele bɛ wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm la anwo. 9Ɔlɛ mralɛ mraalɛ nna mɔɔ ɛtɛkɔle agyalɛ ɛlɛ la wɔ ɛkɛ, bɛle Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma. 10Yɛlile kenle ekyi ɛkɛ ne la, Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ bie mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Agabɛse la vi Dwudiya rale. 11Ɔrale yɛ nwo ɛkɛ ne na ɔvale Pɔɔlo akyeso ne ɔkyekyele ɔdaye ɔ ngome ɔ sa nee ɔ gyakɛ na ɔhanle kɛ, “Kɛ Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne se la ɛne: Sonla ne mɔɔ lɛ akyeso ɛhye la, Dwuuma bakyekye ye zɛhae wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm, na bɛava ye bɛawula bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la asa anu.”
12Yɛdele ɛhye la, yɛ nee menli mɔɔ wɔ ɛkɛ ne la amuala yɛkpale Pɔɔlo kyɛlɛ kɛ ɔmmakɔ Gyɛlusalɛm. 13Na ɔbizale yɛ kɛ, “Na ɛzunlɛ ye abo ɛ? Duzu ati a bɛyɛ bɛabɔ me rɛle ɛ? Meziezie me nwo kɛ tɛ ɛkyekyelɛ mɔɔ bɛkyekye me la angome, na kɛ menwɔwu wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm wɔ Awulae Gyisɛse duma ne ati.”
14Yɛyɛle biala, na yeamkponle, yemɔti yɛgyakyile ye na yɛzele kɛ, “Awulae ɛhulolɛdeɛ ɛyɛ ɛkɛ.”
15Yɛlile mekɛ ekyi wɔ ɛkɛ ne la, yɛhuohuanle yɛ nwo na yɛhɔle Gyɛlusalɛm. 16Na ɛdoavolɛma bie mɔɔ wɔ Sizalia la nee yɛ hɔle, na yɛhɔzokoɛle diedinli Meneesen mɔɔ vi Saepelɛse mɔɔ mɔlebɛbo ne ala ɔliele Gyisɛse ɔlile la sua nu.
Pɔɔlo kakpɔla Gyemise
17Yɛradwule Gyɛlusalɛm la, mediema diedima ne mɔ liele yɛ anyelielɛ nu. 18Aleɛ hyenle la Pɔɔlo nee yɛ hɔle Gyemise ɛkɛ ne kɛ yɛ nee ye kadendɛ; yɛhɔle la ɛnee asɔne mgbanyima ne mɔ amuala wɔ ɛkɛ. 19Pɔɔlo bizale ahye na ɔhanle gyima mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛlua ɔ nwo zo ɛli wɔ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la avinli la amuala ɔhilele bɛ. 20Mɔɔ bɛdiele ye bɛwiele la, bɛyɛle Nyamenle mo na bɛzele Pɔɔlo kɛ, “Adiema Pɔɔlo, tie yɛ ɛ! Yɛlɛ Dwuuma apenle apenle mɔɔ ɛlie Edwɛkpa ne ɛli, noko bɛli Mosisi mɛla ne anzi kpalɛ kpalɛ a. 21Bɛha bɛhile bɛ kɛ ɛlɛkilehile Dwuuma mɔɔ wɔ maanle zo la kɛ bɛgyakyi Mosisi mɛla ne anzi ɛlilɛ, na wɔze bɛ kɛ bɛmmayɛ bɛ mrenyanu nzonlɛ anzɛɛ bɛmmadi Dwuuma maamɛla ne mɔ azo. 22Kɛ ɔkɛyɛ biala la bɛbade kɛ wɔra. Zɔhane ati ɛnee kɛ yɛkɛyɛ ye ɛ? 23Mɔɔ yɛkpondɛ kɛ ɛyɛ la ɛne. Yɛlɛ mgbavolɛ nna mɔɔ ɛbɔ ɛwɔkɛ wɔ Nyamenle anyunlu la wɔ ɛke. 24Ɛ nee bɛ ɛhɔ maa bɛhɔkpa bɛ ti, bɛdu bɛ nwo evinli na tua bɛ ti kakɛ biala maa bɛ. Ɛhye a kɛmaa awie biala kɛnwu kɛ edwɛkɛ mɔɔ bɛhanle wɔ ɛ nwo la amuala ɛnle nɔhalɛ a, na ɛdawɔ mumua ne, ɛdi Dwuu maamɛla ne nee Mosisi mɛla ne mɔ azo. 25 Mɔɔ fane bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma, na bɛlie bɛli la anwo, yɛhɛlɛ kɛlata yɛhɔmaa bɛ kɛ bɛmmadi debie biala mɔɔ bɛva bɛkpa munzule bɛmaa bozonle nee nane mɔɔ bɛlofo ye bɛhu ye la; eza bɛmmadi mogya, na bɛhwe bɛ nwo bɛvi adwɔmane ɛbɔlɛ nwo.”
26Yemɔti Pɔɔlo vale menli ne, na aleɛ hyenle la ɔ nee bɛ hɔle bɛhɔnluanle bɛ nwo. Akee ɔhɔle Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu ɔhɔhilele kenle mɔɔ evinli ɛdulɛ ne kɛwie na bɛabɔ awie ko biala ati azu ne la.
Bɛhye Pɔɔlo wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu
27Mɔɔ ɔka ekyii na kenle nsuu ne adwu la, Dwuuma bie mɔɔ vi Ehyea maanle nu rale la nwunle Pɔɔlo wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu. Bɛzɛkyele menli dɔɔnwo adwenle wɔ Pɔɔlo anwo na bɛmanle bɛhɔnwinwinle ye wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu, 28bɛdeɛdeanle nu kɛ, “Yizilayɛma e, bɛrɛla o na sonla ne mɔɔ luolua nuhua ɛlɛkilehile menli atia Yizilayɛma nee Mosisi mɛla ne nee Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ye la, yemɔ ɛne! Eza noko yehɔva menli bie mɔɔ ɛnle Dwuuma la yera Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ye anu yemaa evinli ɛha ɛleka nwuanzanwuanza ɛhye.” 29(Bɛhanle ɛhye, ɔluakɛ ɛnee bɛnwu ye dɛba kɛ Tulofemɛse mɔɔ vi Ɛfɛsɛse la nee Pɔɔlo lua nwo wɔ sua ne azo. Yemɔti ɛnee bɛdwenle kɛ Pɔɔlo nee ye a hɔle Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu a.)
30Suakpole ne azo fonyianle, na menli ne mɔ razɔle Pɔɔlo hwenle ye vile Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu vindele, na ɛkɛ ne ala bɛtotole Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne nlenkɛ ne mɔ amuala anu. 31Menli ne mɔ akee nyianle adwenle kɛ bɛku Pɔɔlo. Na nrɛlaleɛ hɔdole Wulomu sogyama kpanyinli ne kɛ nzaka ɛzi Gyɛlusalɛm. 32Yemɔti sogyama kpanyinli ne vale ye sogya mgbanyinli ne bie mɔ nee sogyama hanle bɛ nwo waa hɔle ɛlɔne ne anu. Mɔɔ menli ne mɔ nwunle sogyama kpanyinli ne nee sogyama mɔɔ doa ye la, bɛgyakyile Pɔɔlo ɛbolɛ. 33Sogyama kpanyinli ne hɔzɔle Pɔɔlo, na ɔmanle bɛvale nwɔnzɔnwɔnzɔ nwiɔ bɛguale ye. Akee ɔbizale kɛ, “Na nwane a le ɛhye, yɛɛ duzu ɛtane a yeyɛ a?” 34Na menli ne mɔ annwu mɔɔ bɛka a. Bie mɔ ɛlɛka edwɛkɛ ɛhye la, ɛnee bie mɔ noko ɛlɛka edwɛkɛ ngakyile. Yemɔti ɛnee sogyama kpanyinli ne ɛngola ɛnnwu edwɛkɛ kpɔkɛ mɔɔ ɛmaa ɛhye ɛzi la. Yemɔti ɔzele bɛ kɛ bɛva Pɔɔlo bɛhɔ aranemgbole ne anu lɔ. 35Bɛ nee ye hɔle hɔdwule aranemgbole ne kpolike ne anloa la, ɛnee akee ɔwɔ kɛ sogyama ne soa ye bɛ kɔme zo na bɛava ye bɛahɔ, ɔluakɛ ɛnee akee menli ne mɔ anye ɛbolo kpalɛ. 36Bɛ muala bɛdoale bɛ ndinlizo na bɛdeɛdeanle nuhua kɛ, “Bɛhu ye bɛye ye ɛkɛ ne!”
Pɔɔlo sa ɔ ne
37Bɛ nee Pɔɔlo kɔ ahɔwolo aranemgbole ne anu la, ɔzele sogyama kpanyinli ne kɛ, “Maa me adenle maa menga edwɛkɛ mengile wɔ.”
Na sogyama kpanyinli ne zele kɛ, “Hwio, ɛdawɔ mumua ne ɛka Giliki. 38Ɛnee noko tɛ wɔmɔ a ɛle Yigyibitinli ne mɔɔ mekɛ bie mɔɔ ɛze ɛhɔ la vale ngyegyelɛ rale, na ɔvale menli maamɔvo apenle nna ɔhɔle fienemgbole ne azo lɔ la?”
39Pɔɔlo buale ye kɛ, “Mele Dwuunli. Bɛwole me wɔ Taasɛse mɔɔ wɔ Selesea la. Mevi suakpole kpalɛ zo. Mekpa wɔ kyɛlɛ, maa mendendɛ ekyii mengile menli ne mɔ.”
40Na sogyama kpanyinli ne manle ye adenle kɛ ɔdendɛ. Na Pɔɔlo gyinlanle kpolike ne azo, ɔmanle ɔ sa zo ɔbobole menli ne. Mɔɔ bɛ muala bɛyɛle koonwu kpalɛ la, Pɔɔlo dendɛle Hibulu aneɛ nu hilele bɛ zele kɛ,

Title: GYI 22
Content:
1“Ayi mɔ, mediema nee egya mɔ, bɛyɛ ɛnzonlɛ bɛdie me bɛmaa menza me ne mengile bɛ!” 2Mɔɔ bɛdele kɛ ɔlɛtendɛ yeahile bɛ wɔ Hibulu aneɛ nu la, bɛ muala akee bɛyɛle koonwu. Na Pɔɔlo hɔle zolɛ hanle kɛ,
3 “Mele Dwuunli, bɛwole me wɔ Taasɛse mɔɔ wɔ Selesea maanle nu la. Bɛtetele me wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm ɛke wɔ nwomanli Gameeleɛle sukulu ne anu. Menzukoale yɛ nlenya mɔ mɛla ne nee amaamuo ne kpalɛ, na mendule me nwo memanle Nyamenle, kɛmɔ kɛkala bɛde la. 4 Mengyele menli mɔɔ lua Adenle ɛhye azo la dɔɔnwo, mraalɛ nee mrenya, memanle bɛguale bɛ efiade na bɛhunle bɛ. 5Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli ne nee ayia mgbanyima ne mɔ amuala di daselɛ kɛ mɔɔ melɛka la le nɔhalɛ. Menliele ngɛlata wɔ bɛ lɔ kɛ melɛ mekamaa mediema Dwuuma mɔɔ wɔ Dɛmasekɛse la. Na menzile nu kɛ mekahye menli ɛhye mɔ meagua bɛ anga na meava bɛ meara Gyɛlusalɛm, amaa bɛadea bɛ, kɛmɔ ɔfɛta la.
Pɔɔlo ka kɛ ɔzile ɔrayɛle diedinli la
(Gyi 9.1-19; 26.12-18)
6“Mɔɔ melua adenle zo melɛkɔ na ɔka ekyii medwu Dɛmasekɛse la, kɛyɛ sɛnzɛngyinla mekɛ nu, arɛlevilɛ nu ala wienyi kpole bie vi anwuma dale bɛnrale yiale me. 7Mempɛle menfinle na mendele kɛ ɛnelɛ bie se, ‘Sɔɔlo, Sɔɔlo! Duzu ati a ɛyɛ me kpɔdekpɔde zɛhae ɛ?’ 8Na membizale kɛ, ‘Awulae, ɛdawɔ nwane ɔ?’ Na ɔzele me kɛ, ‘Medame a mele Gyisɛse mɔɔ vi Nazalɛte, mɔɔ wɔdu ɛ nye wɔzie me nyunlu ɛlɛyɛ me kpɔdekpɔde la.’ 9Menli mɔɔ nee me lua la nwunle wienyi ne, na bɛande ɛnelɛ ne mɔɔ dendɛle hilele me la. 10Na membizale kɛ, ‘Awulae, duzu a menyɛ a?’ Na Awulae zele me kɛ, ‘Dwazo na kɔ Dɛmasekɛse, na ɛkɛ ne yɛɛ bɛbaha debie mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛhyehyɛ kɛ ɔmaa wɔayɛ la bɛahile wɔ a.’ 11Wienyi ne kɛ zile dale la manle me nye zinle. Ɛhye ati me gɔnwo mɔ mɔɔ nee me lua la sosɔle me sa vale me hɔle Dɛmasekɛse.
12“Nrenya bie wɔ Dɛmasekɛse ɛkɛ, bɛfɛlɛ ye Ananayase, ɔdi mɛla ne azo kpalɛ, yɛɛ Dwuuma mɔɔ wɔ Dɛmasekɛse la amuala bu ye. 13Ɔrale ɛleka mɔɔ mewɔ la, ɔragyinlanle me nwo ɛkɛ na ɔzele me kɛ, ‘Adiema Sɔɔlo, nwu debie bieko.’ Na ɛkɛ ne ala me nye zo dele na menwunle debie bieko na meneanle ɔ nyunlu. 14Na ɔhanle kɛ, ‘Yɛ nlenya mɔ Nyamenle ne ɛye wɔ ɛzie ɛkɛ kɛ ɛnwu ye ɛhulolɛdeɛ na ɛnwu ye Fɔɔnwonli sonvolɛ ko ne, na ɛde ɔ ne. 15Ɔluakɛ ɛbali ɔ nwo daselɛ wɔaha mɔɔ wɔde nee mɔɔ wɔnwu ye la wɔahile ewiade amra amuala. 16Na duzu ati a akee ɛlɛkendɛ bieko ɛ? Dwazo na sɛlɛ maa bɛzɔne wɔ bɛnrinzi wɔ ɛtane ne mɔ bɛgua.’
Ɔwɔ kɛ Pɔɔlo bɔ Edwɛkpa ne nolo kile bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la
17“Menziale mengɔle Gyɛlusalɛm na mɔɔ mewɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu melɛyɛ nzɛlɛlɛ la, me nye hɔle dɔɔnwo, 18na menwunle Awulae kɛ ɔlɛtendɛ yeaze me kɛ, ‘Maa ɛ nwo ɛyɛ ndɛ fi Gyɛlusalɛm. Ɔluakɛ menli mɔɔ wɔ ɛke la ɛnrɛdie daselɛ ne mɔɔ ɛlɛdi ye me nwo la.’ 19Na menganle kɛ, ‘Awulae, bɛdabɛ bɛze ye wienyi kɛ medame a anrɛɛ ɛnee mekye menli mɔɔ die wɔ di la, mebo bɛ, metwenle bɛ aze wɔ nyianu azua ne mɔ anu a. 20 Mekɛ mɔɔ bɛku wɔ dasevolɛ Sitivin la, ɛnee medame mewɔ ɛkɛ, me kunlu dwole ye ɛhunlɛ nwo na menliele menli mɔɔ hunle ye la ndanlɛ menlɛle bɛ.’ 21Na Awulae zele me kɛ, ‘Kɔ, mesoa wɔ wɔ maanle zo moa moa wɔ menli mɔɔ ɛnle Dwuuma la avinli.’ ”
22Menli ne mɔ diele Pɔɔlo toonwo na mɔɔ ɔhanle edwɛkɛ kpɔkɛ ɛhye la bɛ muala bɛ ahonle futule na bɛdeɛdeanle nu kɛ, “Bɛye ye wɔ ɛkɛ ne! Bɛhu ye! Ɔle musuofoɔ!” 23Bɛtea la ɛnee bɛlɛfuandivuandi bɛ ndanlɛ anwuma, na bɛfula anwea bɛsande ye anwomanyunlu, kɛ bɛndie edwɛkɛ biala. 24Zɔhane ati Wulomu sogyama kpanyinli ne zele ye menli ne mɔ kɛ bɛva Pɔɔlo bɛwolo aranemgbole ne anu, na bɛbila ye empele bɛmaa ɔha deɛ holɛ ko mɔɔ ɔlua zo a Dwuuma doa ye ɛlɛwudo la. 25Na mɔɔ bɛkyekyele ye kɛ bɛbila ye empele ne la, Pɔɔlo bizale sogya kpanyinli ko mɔɔ gyi ɔ nwo ɛkɛ ne la kɛ, “Asoo ɔfa mɛla adenle zo kɛ bɛkɛbo Wulomunli mgbane wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛtɛdile ye edwɛkɛ bɛtɛbuale ye fɔlɛ kɛ yedo mɛla la ɔ?”
26Sogya kpanyinli ne dele ɛhye la, ɔhɔle sogyama kpanyinli ne ɛkɛ ne na ɔhɔbizale ye kɛ, “Duzu debie a ɛlɛyɛ la? Nea, sonla ne le Wulomunli.” 27Na sogyama kpanyinli ne rale Pɔɔlo anwo ɛkɛ rabizale ye kɛ, “Na ɛle Wulomunli ɔ?”
Pɔɔlo buale ye kɛ, “Ɛhɛe.” 28Na sogyama kpanyinli ne zele ye kɛ, “Mame, menduale ezukoa kpole kpalɛ yɛɛ menyianle zɔhane gyinlabelɛ a.” Pɔɔlo buale ye kɛ, “Mame, bɛwole me Wulomunli.”
29Na ɛkɛ ne ala menli mɔɔ rale kɛ bɛbabizebiza Pɔɔlo edwɛkɛ la vi ɔ nwo ɛkɛ hwenle bɛ nwo. Mɔɔ sogyama kpanyinli ne nwunle kɛ Pɔɔlo le Wulomunli na yegua ye nwɔnzɔnwɔnzɔ la ye ahonle dule.
Pɔɔlo gyi ayia ne anyunlu
30Ɛnee sogyama kpanyinli ne kpondɛ kɛ ɔnwu deɛ holɛ ko mɔɔ yemɔti Dwuuma ne ɛlɛto Pɔɔlo ɛzonle la ati, aleɛ hyenle la ɔmanle bɛyele Pɔɔlo nwɔnzɔnwɔnzɔ ne na ɔmanle sɛlɛvolɛ mgbanyinli ne nee ayiama ne mɔ amuala yiale na ɔvale Pɔɔlo ɔragyinlanle bɛ nyunlu ɛkɛ.

Title: GYI 23
Content:
1Pɔɔlo nleanle bagua ne na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Mediema Yizilayɛma, me adwenle ɛmbu me fɔlɛ wɔ me ɛbɛlabɔlɛ nu wɔ Nyamenle anyunlu toonwo a yeradwu ɛnɛ a.” 2Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli Ananayase dele ɛhye la ɔhanle kɛ bɛbɔ ɔ nloa ne azo. 3 Pɔɔlo zele ye kɛ, “Ɛ kunlu le bile, Nyamenle babɔ wɔ bie adua, kɛ ɛde ɛkɛ ne kɛ ɛfa mɛla wɔali me edwɛkɛ, noko wɔbulu mɛla ne azo ɛse bɛbɔ me la.”
4Menli mɔɔ gyi Pɔɔlo anwo ɛkɛ ne la zele ye kɛ, “Hɛe, ɛyɛ Nyamenle Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli ne aholoba ɔ?”
5 Pɔɔlo buale bɛ kɛ, “Mediema Yizilayɛma, menze kɛ ɔle Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli. Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se, ‘Mmaka wɔ kpanyinli mɔɔ nea wɔ menli nwo zo la anwo edwɛkɛ ɛtane.’ ”
6 Mɔɔ Pɔɔlo nwunle kɛ menli mɔɔ ɛrayia la bie mɔ boka Sadusiima fane ne anwo na foa ko dɔɔnwo noko boka Falasiima fane ne anwo la, ɔdeanle nu ɔzele kɛ, “Mediema Yizilayɛma! Mele Falasiinli, yɛɛ Falasiinli a wole me a. Bɛ nee me ɛra ɛke kɛ bɛbali me edwɛkɛ, ɔboalekɛ melɛ anyelazo kɛ bɛbadwazo mɔwuamra bɛara ngoane nu bieko.”
7Ɔhanle ɛhye ala la, Falasiima ne nee Sadusiima ne mɔ bɔle ɔ bo kɛ bɛdi butule, na ɛlɔne ne lile abunwiɔ. 8 (Ɔluakɛ Sadusiima se bɛnrɛdwazo mɔwuamra bɛnrɛvi ewule nu yɛɛ, eza Nyamenle soanvolɛ anzɛɛ sunsum biala ɛnle ɛkɛ. Noko Falasiima, bɛmɛ bɛdie edwɛkɛ nsa ɛhye mɔ bɛto nu.) 9Bɛdeanle kpalɛ, na mɛla kilehilevolɛma bie mɔ mɔɔ boka Falasiima fane ne anwo la dwazole hanle kɛ, “Yɛnnwu ɛtane biala wɔ sonla ne anwo! Ɔkɛyɛ zɔhane kɛ Nyamenle soanvolɛ bie anzɛɛ sunsum bie ɛdendɛ ɛhile ye amgba.”
10Nzinlii akee ɛdeanlɛ ne bole zolɛ na sogyama kpanyinli ne zulole kɛ bɛkɛhu Pɔɔlo la ati, ɔmanle sogyama ne mɔ dwule aze hɔle bagua ne anu hɔyele Pɔɔlo wɔ ayiama ne avinli bɛ nee ye hɔle aranemgbole ne anu bieko.
11Kenle ko ne nɔe ne, Awulae ragyinlanle Pɔɔlo anwo ɛkɛ ne na ɔzele ye kɛ, “Gyinla kpundii! Wɔli me nwo daselɛ bɔkɔɔ wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm ɛke, na ɔwɔ kɛ ɛyɛ ye zɔhane noko wɔ Wulomu.”
Bɛkɔ Pɔɔlo ati akpamo
12Aleɛ hyenle la, Dwuuma bie yɛle ko vale adwenle na bɛlile amonle kɛ saa bɛtɛkunle Pɔɔlo a bɛnrɛli aleɛ yɛɛ bɛnrɛnlo nzule. 13Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛvale adwenle ɛhye la bo abulanla. 14Na bɛhɔle Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli ne nee mgbanyima ne mɔ ɛkɛ, na bɛzele bɛ kɛ, “Yɛli amonle kɛ yɛnrɛli aleɛ yɛɛ yɛnrɛnlo nzule kyesɛ yɛku Pɔɔlo kolaa. 15Yemɔti, bɛ nee ayiama ne ɛbɔ nu na bɛzoa bɛmaa bɛhɔze Wulomu sogyama kpanyinli ne kɛ ɔmaa bɛva Pɔɔlo bɛrɛla na bɛkpondɛ kɛ bɛbizebiza ye edwɛkɛ ne anu kpalɛ. Na kɛ ɔkɛyɛ biala la toonwo mɔɔ ɔkadwu ɛke la ɛnee yɛhu ye.”
16Pɔɔlo awozoa nrenya ne dele ɛhye anwo bie. Zɔhane ati ɔhɔle aranemgbole ne anu ɔhɔfetele zolɛ ɔhilele Pɔɔlo. 17Na Pɔɔlo vɛlɛle sogya kpanyinli ko na ɔzele ye kɛ, “Fa kpavolɛ ye kɔ sogyama kpanyinli ne ɛkɛ na ɔlɛ edwɛkɛ ɔka yeahile ye.” 18Sogya ne vale kpavolɛ ne hɔle bɛ kpanyinli ne ɛkɛ ne na ɔzele kɛ, “Pilizanli Pɔɔlo vɛlɛle me na ɔzele me kɛ menva kpavolɛ ye membɛlɛ wɔ na ɔlɛ edwɛkɛ ɔka yeahile wɔ.”
19Na sogyama kpanyinli ne zɔle kpavolɛ ne asa, ɔvale ye ɔhɔle ahane, na ɔbizale ye kɛ, “Duzu edwɛkɛ a ɛ nee ye rale a?”
20Kpavolɛ ne zele ye kɛ, “Dwuu mgbanyima ne ɛli bɛ nloa kɛ ɛhyema bɛbaraha bɛahile wɔ kɛ ɛva Pɔɔlo ɛrɛla bagua ne anyunlu ɛmaa bɛdie ye edwɛkɛ ne kpalɛ. 21Na bɛba a mmatɛne bɛ zo, ɔluakɛ bɛ nuhua mɔɔ bo abulanla la barazia adenle nu. Menli ɛhye mɔ ɛli amonle kɛ saa bɛtɛkunle Pɔɔlo a bɛnrɛli aleɛ yɛɛ bɛnrɛnlo nzule. Yemɔti kɛkala bɛwie bɛ nwo boɔboa, wɔmɔ ala a bɛlɛkendɛ kɛ ɛkɛkponle zolɛ a.”
22Na sogyama kpanyinli ne zele ye kɛ, “Mede. Mmabɔ zolɛ ɛkile awie biala kɛ wɔraha ɛhye wɔhile me.” Na ɔmanle ɔhɔle.
Bɛva Pɔɔlo bɛhɔmaa Amɛnlado Filekese
23Sogyama kpanyinli ne vɛlɛle sogya mgbanyinli nwiɔ na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛmaa ɔyɛ ndɛ bɛhɔva sogyama mɔɔ dua aze la ɛya nwiɔ yɛɛ atwɛdolɛ sogyama ɛya nwiɔ na bɛ nee sogyama mɔɔ tɛnla ɛkpɔnwɔ zo la abulasuu bɛhɔ toonwo bɛhɔdwu Sizalia. Bɛha bɛ nwo na bɛdu bɛ bo ɛke ɛnɛ nɔsolɛ dɔne ngɔnla. 24Bɛziezie ɛkpɔnwɔ ko noko bɛmaa Pɔɔlo ɛdɛnla zolɛ na bɛva ye gyɛlɛɛnye bɛhɔmaa amɛnlado Filekese.” 25Na sogyama kpanyinli ne hɛlɛle kɛlata ɛhye manle bɛhɔle:
26“Medame Kolɔdeɛse Lesease a melɛkɛlɛ kɛlata ɛhye mearɛlɛ Amɛnlado Filekese a, mebiza wɔ ahye. 27Dwuuma zɔle nrenya ɛhye nu mɔɔ anrɛɛ bɛku ye a. Na mendele kɛ ɔle Wulomunli la ati menvale sogyama mengɔnliele ye. 28Memkpondɛle kɛ menwɔnwu ye nvoleɛ, yemɔti menvale ye mengɔle bɛ ayia ne anyunlu kɛ mekadie nu kpalɛ. 29Na menwunle kɛ ɔtɛyɛle debie mɔɔ fɛta ɛhunlɛ anzɛɛ efiade ɛdolɛ bɔbɔ a. Bɛ ɛzonledonlɛ ne fane bɛdabɛ bɛ mɛla nwo. 30Eza mede kɛ bɛvua kɛ bɛnyia ye a bɛkɛhu ye, yemɔti meyɛ kɛ bɛva ye bɛrɛlɛ wɔ. Meze menli mɔɔ donle ye ɛzonle la noko kɛ bɛva bɛ edwɛkɛ ne bɛrado ɛ nyunlu.”
31Sogyama ne yɛle bɛ gyima ne kɛmɔ bɛhilele bɛ la na nɔe ne ala bɛvale Pɔɔlo bɛ nee ye hɔle toonwo bɛhɔdwule Antepatelese. 32Aleɛ hyenle la sogyama ne mɔɔ dua aze la ziale rale aranemgbole ne anu na sogyama ne mɔɔ tɛnla ɛkpɔnwɔ zo la vale Pɔɔlo hɔle. 33Bɛ nee ye hɔdwule Sizalia la bɛyele kɛlata ne bɛmanle amɛnlado ne na bɛvale Pɔɔlo noko bɛwulale ɔ sa nu. 34Amɛnlado ne gengale kɛlata ne wiele la, ɔbizale Pɔɔlo maanzinli mɔɔ ɔvi nu la. Mɔɔ ɔdele kɛ ɔvi Selesea la 35ɔzele ye kɛ, “Saa menli mɔɔ ɛdo wɔ ɛzonle la ba a mebanlea wɔ edwɛkɛ ne anu.” Na ɔzele kɛ bɛva Pɔɔlo bɛhɔzie Hɛlɔdo aranemgbole ne anu ɛleka mɔɔ ɔdaye amɛnlado ye gyima ne abo wɔ la na bɛzinza ye.

Title: GYI 24
Content:
Dwuuma to Pɔɔlo ɛzonle
1Ɛhye anzi kenle nnu Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli Ananayase nee mgbanyima ne bie mɔ yɛɛ bɛ kamaavolɛ ko mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Tɛtɛlɛse la rale Sizalia. Bɛvale ɛzonle mɔɔ bɛvale bɛdole Pɔɔlo anwo zo la bɛradole amɛnlado ne anyunlu. 2Bɛvale Pɔɔlo bɛragyinlanle ɛkɛ, na Tɛtɛlɛse bɔle Pɔɔlo ɛzonledonlɛ ne abo zɛhae.
“Nana, ɛle kpanyinli nrɛlɛbɛvolɛ la ati, yɛ nzo nu ɛdwo yɛ toonwo yeradwu ɛnɛ. Na ɔlua zolɛ maanzinli ye ɛnyia anyunluhɔlɛ. 3Yɛ nye sɔ mɔɔ wɔyɛ la amuala, yɛyɛ wɔ mo somaa. 4Mengulo kɛ mesɛkye wɔ mekɛ biala, yemɔti mesɛlɛ wɔ, tie yɛ edwɛkɛ sikalɛ ɛhye. 5Yɛnwu kɛ sonla ɛhye le agyegyeamra kpalɛ, ɔlɛtwehwe manzonle yeado Dwuuma mɔɔ wɔ aleɛabo la amuala avinli. Ɔli fane ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Nazalin la ati. 6Eza noko ɔbɔle mɔdenle kɛ ɔfa evinli yeaha yɛ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne yɛɛ yɛhyele ye a. [Na anrɛɛ yɛkpondɛ kɛ yɛdua yɛdayɛ yɛ mɛla ne azo yɛdi ye edwɛkɛ. 7Na sogyama kpanyinli Lesease vale ɛlɔnema razale yɛ liele ye yɛ sa nu, 8na ɔhanle kɛ saa yɛlɛ edwɛkɛ bie a ɛnee yɛrɛla ɛ nyunlu.] Saa ɛdawɔ ɛbizebiza sonla ye edwɛkɛ ne anu a ɛkɛnwu kɛ mɔɔ yɛlɛka la le nɔhalɛ.” 9Dwuuma ne mɔ amuala nee ye yɛle adwenle na bɛhanle kɛ mɔɔ yeha la amuala le nɔhalɛ.
Pɔɔlo sa ɔ ne wɔ Filekese anyunlu
10Amɛnlado ne yɛle kɛ Pɔɔlo ɛdendɛ, na Pɔɔlo hanle kɛ,
