“Meze kɛ ɛvale edwɛkɛlilɛ wɔ maanle ɛhye anu la ɛhyɛ, yemɔti menzulo kɛ menwɔha me edwɛkɛ menwɔhile wɔ. 11Kɛmɔ ɛdawɔ ɛkola ɛnwu ye la, kenle bulu nee nwiɔ ɛne yɛɛ mengɔle Gyɛlusalɛm kɛ mekayɛ nzɛlɛlɛ a. 12Dwuuma ye annwu me wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu kɛ me nee awie ɛlɛdi butule, anzɛɛ melɛkilehile menli debie ɛtane wɔ bɛ nyianu sua ne anu, anzɛɛ ɛleka biala wɔ suakpole ne azo. 13Bɛngola bɛnzi bɛ ɛzonledonlɛ ne pi bɔbɔ. 14Ko mɔɔ medie meto nu la a le kɛ melua Awulae Adenle ye mɔɔ bɛmɛ bɛse ɔnle nɔhalɛ la azo yɛɛ mesonle yɛ nlenya mɔ Nyamenle ne a. Noko eza medie mɔɔ bɛhɛlɛ ye wɔ Mosisi mɛla ne anu, nee Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma mbuluku ne mɔ anu la medi. 15Me anyelazo mɔɔ melɛ wɔ Nyamenle anu la le kɛ mɔɔ bɛdabɛ bɛlɛ ye ala la, kɛ menli kɔsɔɔti, ɛtanevolɛma nee kpalɛyɛlɛma badwazo ara ngoane nu. 16Ɛhye ati yɛɛ mebɔ mɔdenle kɛ menwɔnyia adwenle mɔɔ nuhua te la wɔ Nyamenle nee menli nyunlu a.
17 “Kɛmɔ menvile Gyɛlusalɛm la ɛvolɛ dɔɔnwo ɛze la ati, mengɔle ɛkɛ ne kɛ melɛ ezukoa nee azubɔlɛ ninyɛne mekamaa me menli ne mɔ. 18Mɔɔ mewɔ ɛhye azo la yɛɛ bɛnwunle me wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu a, mekɛ ne anu ɛnee melɛtu me nwo evinli. Menli dɔɔnwo biala ɛnle ɛkɛ yɛɛ basabasa biala anzi. 19Na Dwuuma bie mɔ bɔbɔ mɔɔ vi Ehyea maanle nu na bɛwɔ ɛkɛ ne bie la, bɛmɛ yɛɛ saa bɛlɛ edwɛkɛ bɛka bɛtia me a ɛnee ɔwɔ kɛ bɛba ɛ nyunlu na bɛbaka bɛ edwɛkɛ mɔɔ bɛ nee me lɛ ye la a. 20Anzɛɛ maa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ ɛke kɛkala la bie ɛha ɛtane holɛ ko mɔɔ bɛnwunle ye me nwo wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ megyi bagua ne anyunlu la. 21 Bɛannwu ɛhwee kɛ edwɛkɛ kpɔkɛ ko ne ala mɔɔ menganle wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ megyi bɛ nyunlu wɔ bagua ne anu la kɛ, ‘Bɛva me bɛra bɛ nyunlu ɛke, ɔluakɛ medie medi kɛ bɛbadwazo mɔwuamra bɛara ngoane nu bieko.’ ”
22Filekese ze Awulae Adenle ɛhye anwo bie kpalɛ, yemɔti ɔdule edwɛkɛ ne ɔziele na ɔzele kɛ, “Saa sogyama kpanyinli Lesease ba a mebanwu mɔɔ meka ye wɔ bɛ edwɛkɛ ne anwo a ɔkɛyɛ boɛ la.” 23Akee ɔzele sogya kpanyinli ne mɔɔ Pɔɔlo wɔ ɔ sa nu la kɛ ɔnlea ye boɛ, na ɔmaa ɔnyia adenle ɔkpundi ɔ nwo, na ɔmaa ɔ gɔnwo mɔ adenle ɔmaa bɛva ninyɛne mɔɔ ɔhyia nwo la bɛrɛlɛ ye.
Pɔɔlo gyi Filekese nee Dulusela anyunlu
24Kenle ekyi guale nu la Filekese nee ɔ ye Dulusela mɔɔ le Dwuunli la rale. Ɔzoanle ɔmanle bɛhɔvale Pɔɔlo na ɔmanle ɔhanle diedi wɔ Gyisɛse Kelaese anu anwo edwɛkɛ ɔmanle ɔdiele bie. 25Pɔɔlo noko hɔle zolɛ, na mɔɔ ɔka boɛlilɛ, bɛ nwo zo ɛhomonlɛ, yɛɛ Ndɛnebualɛ Kenle ne mɔɔ bara la anwo edwɛkɛ la, Filekese ahonle dule na ɔzele kɛ, “Yeyɛ boɛ, kɔ. Saa menyia alagye a mebazoa meamaa bɛarava wɔ bieko.” 26Na ɛnee eza ye adwenle ko noko a le kɛ Pɔɔlo kɛmaa ye ezukoa. Ɛhye ati ɔmanle bɛhɔle ye ɛvalɛ wazowazo ɔ nee ye dendɛle.
27Mɔɔ ɛvolɛ nwiɔ pɛle nu la, Pɔseɛse Fɛsetɛse ralile amɛnlado Filekese agyakɛ anu. Na kɛmɔ ɛnee Filekese kulo kɛ ɔnyia ɔ nyunlu wɔ Dwuuma anyunlu la ati, ɔmanle Pɔɔlo hale efiade ne.

Title: GYI 25
Content:
Pɔɔlo bɔ ye edwɛkɛ ne atua amaa Maanle Maanle Belemgbunli ne
1Mɔɔ Fɛsetɛse radwule maanzinli ne anu la, ye kenle nsa yɛɛ eza ɔvi Sizalia ɔhɔle Gyɛlusalɛm a. 2Sɛlɛvolɛ mgbanyinli ne mɔ nee Dwuu mgbanyima ne mɔ radonle Pɔɔlo ɛzonle bieko wɔ ɛkɛ ne. Bɛkpale Fɛsetɛse kyɛlɛ kɛ 3ɔli ɔboa bɛ na ɔva Pɔɔlo ɔrɛla Gyɛlusalɛm, ɔluakɛ ɛnee bɛlɛ adwenle kɛ bɛtɛ ye wɔ adenle nu bɛahu ye. 4Na Fɛsetɛse buale bɛ kɛ, “Pɔɔlo la efiade wɔ Sizalia, yɛɛ medame mumua ne ɔnrɛhyɛ na meazia meahɔ ɛkɛ. 5Yemɔti saa bɛnea na yeyɛ bɛ ɛtane bie a ɛnee bɛmaa bɛ menli mɔɔ li bɛ ti la nee me ɛhɔ Sizalia na bɛhɔha bɛ edwɛkɛ ne.”
6Fɛsetɛse lile kenle kɛyɛ mɔtwɛ mɔɔ kɔ bulu la wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm kolaa na yeazia yeahɔ Sizalia. Aleɛ hyenle ala la ɔhɔdɛnlanle ye ebia nu kɛ bɛva Pɔɔlo bɛrɛla ɔ nyunlu. 7Mɔɔ Pɔɔlo rale la, Dwuuma mɔɔ vi Gyɛlusalɛm rale la radonle ye ɛzonle mgbole bie mɔɔ akee bɛdabɛ bɔbɔ bɛngola bɛngilehile nu a. 8Pɔɔlo zale ɔ ne kɛ, “Metɛyɛle ɛtane biala metɛtiale Dwuuma mɛla ne anzɛɛ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne na yeayɛ Wulomu Maanle Maanle belemgbunli ne.”
9Na kɛmɔ Fɛsetɛse kpondɛ ɔ nyunlu wɔ Dwuuma anyunlu la ati, ɔbizale Pɔɔlo kɛ, “Ɛkɛhulo kɛ ɛkɛhɔ Gyɛlusalɛm na ɛkɔhɔye ɛzonledonlɛ ɛhye mɔ anloa wɔ me nyunlu ɔ?”
10Pɔɔlo buale ye kɛ, “Megyi Wulomu Maanle Maanle belemgbunli ɔdaye ye ndɛnebualɛ ebia nyunlu, yɛɛ ɛke a ɔwɔ kɛ bɛdi me edwɛkɛ a. Metɛyɛle Dwuuma ɛtane biala, kɛmɔ ɛdawɔ wɔnwu ye la. 11Saa medo mɛla bie mɔɔ maa mefɛta ewule a menzulo kɛ bɛkɛhu me. Na saa nɔhalɛ biala ɛnle bɛ ɛzonledonlɛ ne anu ɛdeɛ a, ɛnee noko ɔnle kɛ awie biala ye me maa bɛ. Zɔhane ati medo me edwɛkɛ ne memaa Maanle Maanle belemgbunli ne.” 12Fɛsetɛse nee ye mgbanyima ne mɔ hanle bɛ ti kpulale nwolɛ, na Fɛsetɛse buale Pɔɔlo kɛ, “Saa wɔdo wɔ edwɛkɛ ne wɔmaa Maanle Maanle belemgbunli ne a ɛnee ɛkɛ ne ala a ɛkɛhɔ a.”
Pɔɔlo gyi Agelepa nee Bɛnaesi anyunlu
13Mekɛ guale nu la Belemgbunli Agelepa mɔɔ tɔ zo nwiɔ la nee ɔ ye Bɛnaesi rale Sizalia kɛ bɛbakpɔla Fɛsetɛse bɛayɛ ye akoaba. 14Na nzinlii mɔɔ bɛlile kenle ekyi wɔ ɛkɛ ne la Fɛsetɛse hanle Pɔɔlo edwɛkɛ ne hilele belemgbunli ne kɛ, “Filekese gyakyile awie bie wɔ efiade ɛkɛ. 15Na mekɛ mɔɔ mengɔle Gyɛlusalɛm la, Dwuuma sɛlɛvolɛ mgbanyinli nee Dwuu mgbanyima ne mɔ radonle ye ɛzonle hilele me kɛ menli ye edwɛkɛ membua ye ewule fɔlɛ. 16Na menzele bɛ kɛ ɔnle Wulomu mɛla kɛ bɛkɛye awie biala mɔɔ bɛkɛdo ye ɛzonle kɛ yedo mɛla la bɛkɛmaa kyesɛ ɔ nee menli mɔɔ donle ye ɛzonle ne la yia nu bɛka bɛmaa ɔdaye ɔnyia adenle ɔsa ɔ ne wɔ nwolɛ. 17Yemɔti bɛ muala bɛrale ɛke, na meanva meando aze. Ye alehyenlɛ nu ala yɛɛ mendɛnlanle aze kɛ medi edwɛkɛ ne a. 18Menli ne mɔ dwazole la, bɛangola bɛanga edwɛkɛ kpaziwɔkɛ biala bɛando ɔ nwo zo kɛ yedo mɛla kpole bie, kɛmɔ mendwenlenle la. 19Mɔɔ bɛyɛle ala la a le bɛ nyamenlezonlenlɛ nwo kpolerazulɛ yɛɛ awie bie mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Gyisɛse, mɔɔ ɛwu, na Pɔɔlo kile kɛ ɔde aze la anwo kpolerazulɛ. 20Kɛmɔ ɛnee mengola mennwu adenle mɔɔ mefa zolɛ a menwɔnwu edwɛkɛ ɛhye anu kpalɛ la, membizale Pɔɔlo saa ɔkɛhulo kɛ ɔkɛhɔ Gyɛlusalɛm na bɛahɔli edwɛkɛ ɛhye wɔ ɛkɛ a. 21Na Pɔɔlo buale kɛ memaa bɛva edwɛkɛ ne bɛhɔ Maanle Maanle belemgbunli ne ɔdaye ɔ nyunlu. Yemɔti memaa bɛva ye bɛzie kɔkpula mekɛ mɔɔ bɛ nee ye kɛhɔ la.”
22Na Belemgbunli Agelepa zele Fɛsetɛse kɛ, “Mekulo kɛ metie sonla ɛhye edwɛkɛ ne bie.”
Fɛsetɛse buale kɛ, “Ɛhyema ɛkɛdie ye.”
23Yemɔti aleɛ hyenle la Agelepa nee Bɛnaesi zieziele bɛ nwo kpalɛ na bɛ nee sogya mgbanyinli nee suakpole ne azo adile adile hɔle ɛleka mɔɔ bɛdi edwɛkɛ la, na Fɛsetɛse manle bɛhɔvale Pɔɔlo bɛrale. 24Fɛsetɛse zele kɛ, “Belemgbunli Agelepa, nee bɛdabɛ mgbanyima mɔɔ bɛ nee yɛ wɔ ɛke la amuala, nrenya ɛhye, Dwuuma amuala mɔɔ wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm nee ɛke la ɛrado ye ɛzonle ɛhile me, na bɛkile kɛ ɔnle kɛ ɔtɛnla ngoane nu bieko. 25Me afoa nu ɛdeɛ, menleɛnlea edwɛkɛ ne anu la menwu kɛ ɔtɛyɛle debie mɔɔ maa ɔfɛta ewule a. Na kɛmɔ ɔdaye mumua ne ɔse ɔfa ye edwɛkɛ ne yeahɔ Maanle Maanle belemgbunli ne anyunlu la, meyɛ kɛ memaa bɛava ye bɛahɔ. 26Noko mennwu edwɛkɛ kpaziwɔkɛ mɔɔ megyinla zolɛ meahɛlɛ meahɔmaa Maanle Maanle belemgbunli ne a. Yemɔti me nee ye ɛra bɛ nyunlu ɛke, bɔbɔ wɔmɔ Belemgbunli Agelepa, amaa wɔanleɛnlea ye edwɛkɛ ne anu boɛ, na meanyia edwɛkɛ kpalɛ meahɛlɛ meahɔ. 27Ɔluakɛ menea a ɔnwie nrɛlɛbɛ yɛ kɛ melɛ pilizanli melɛkɔ na menlɛ ɔ nwo ɛzonledonlɛ kpalɛ biala a.”

Title: GYI 26
Content:
Pɔɔlo sa ɔ ne ahile Agelepa
1Belemgbunli Agelepa zele Pɔɔlo kɛ, “Ɛlɛ adenle ɛsa ɛ ne.” Na Pɔɔlo manle ɔ sa zo na ɔzale ɔ ne kɛ:
2“Belemgbunli Agelepa, ɔyɛ me fɛ kpole kɛ mesa me ne wɔ ɛ nyunlu ɛnɛ wɔ ɛzonle mɔɔ Dwuuma ɛva ɛdo me nwo zo la anwo a. 3Ɔluakɛ wɔmɔ, ɛze Dwuuma maamɛla ne kpalɛ. Yemɔti, mesɛlɛ wɔ, nyia abotane na tie me.
4“Ɔvi me ngakula nu, Dwuuma amuala ze kɛ mezi mebɔ me ɛbɛla la. Bɛze kɛ membɔle me ɛbɛla bo wɔ me maanle ye anu, nee Gyɛlusalɛm. 5 Bɛze, yɛɛ saa bɛdi nɔhalɛ a, anrɛɛ bɛkola bɛdi daselɛ kɛ mɔlebɛbo ne amuala ɛnee meboka ɛzonlenlɛ fane ɛsesebɛ ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Falasii la anwo. 6Kɛkala megyi ɛke kɛ bɛdi me edwɛkɛ, ɔluakɛ melɛ anyelazo wɔ Nyamenle ɛwɔkɛ ne mɔɔ ɔbɔle yɛ nlenya mɔ la anu. 7Ɛwɔkɛ ne ati yɛɛ yɛ mbusua ekpunli bulu nee nwiɔ ye gua ɛzonlenlɛ zo alehyenlɛ nee aledwolɛ, kɛ saa bɛkɛnyia ye a. Na anyelazo ɛhye ala ati, Nana, yɛɛ Dwuuma ɛlɛto me ɛzonle zɛhae a. 8Na duzu ati yɛɛ bɛmɛ Dwuuma bɛnlie bɛnli kɛ Nyamenle badwazo mɔwuamra ɛ?
9 “Medame, ɛnee medwenle kɛ ɔle me gyima kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ mebɔ mɔdenle meyɛ debie biala metia Gyisɛse ɛhye mɔɔ vi Nazalɛte la duma ne, 10yɛɛ mɔɔ menyɛle ye wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm la ɛne. Menliele tumi wɔ sɛlɛvolɛ mgbanyinli ne mɔ ɛkɛ ne na menguale Nyamenle menli ne dɔɔnwo efiade. Eza saa bɛbua bɛ ewule fɔlɛ a, meto me ɛma mefua zolɛ. 11Mekɛ dɔɔnwo ne ala memanle bɛdeanle bɛ wɔ nyianu azua ne mɔ anu, na membɔle mɔdenle kɛ memaa bɛ ngome bɛaha ɛtane bɛatia bɛ ɛzonlenlɛ ne. Me nye bolole bɛ nwo kpalɛ manle ɔrale kɛ akee mekɔ azuamgbole zo wɔ maanle maanle zo yɛɛ mekɔkye bɛ meba a.
Pɔɔlo ka kɛ ɔzile ɔrayɛle diedinli la
(Gyi 9.1-19; 22.6-16)
12“Ɛhye ala anwo bie yɛɛ sɛlɛvolɛ mgbanyinli ne mɔ manle me tumi kɛlata manle mengɔle Dɛmasekɛse a. 13Na wɔ adevinli ne, kɛyɛ sɛnzɛngyinla, Nana, yɛɛ menwunle kɛ wienyi mɔɔ ta tɛla sɛnzɛne la, vi anwuma ɛrabɛnra ɛyia me nee menli mɔɔ me nee bɛ lua la a. 14Yɛ muala yɛpɛle yɛfinle, na mendele ɛnelɛ bie kɛ ɔlɛtendɛ yeahile me wɔ Hibulu aneɛ nu kɛ, ‘Sɔɔlo, Sɔɔlo! Duzu ati a ɛlɛyɛ me kpɔdekpɔde ɛ? Ɛto ɛ gyakɛ ɛwɔ evileni bowule a, ɛboda ɛ nwo o!’ 15Na membizale ye kɛ, ‘Awulae, na ɛdawɔ nwane ɔ?’ Na Awulae zele kɛ, ‘Mame a mele Gyisɛse mɔɔ ɛlɛyɛ me kpɔdekpɔde la. 16Na dwazo gyinla ɛ gyakɛ anu. Meye me nwo mehile wɔ, amaa meayɛ wɔ me sonvolɛ na wɔali me nwo daselɛ wɔ mɔɔ wɔnwu ye ɛnɛ, nee mɔɔ nzinlii mebaye meahile wɔ la amuala anwo. 17Mebalie wɔ meavi Dwuuma nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma mɔɔ mebazoa wɔ bɛ avinli la asa anu. 18Mesoa wɔ, amaa wɔahɔbuke bɛ nye na wɔahwe bɛ wɔavi awozinli nu nee Seetan tumi ne abo wɔara wienyi nu nee Nyamenle ɛkɛ, amaa ɔlua bɛ diedi mɔɔ wɔ me nu la azo bɛanyia ɛtanefakyɛ na bɛanyia ɛleka wɔ Nyamenle menli ne mɔɔ yekpa nu yeye bɛ la avinli.’
Pɔɔlo ka ye gyimayɛlɛ nwo edwɛkɛ
19“Ɛhye ati, Belemgbunli Agelepa, meanyɛ anzosesebɛ wɔ anwuma ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ ɛhye anwo. 20 Na menlumuale menganle ye wɔ Dɛmasekɛse nee Gyɛlusalɛm yɛɛ Dwudiya maanle ne mɔ amuala anu, nee maanle maanle mɔɔ ɛmboka Dwuuma anwo la anu, kɛ bɛnlu bɛ nwo na bɛzia bɛrɛla Nyamenle ɛkɛ, na bɛbɔ ɛbɛla mɔɔ kile kɛ bɛnlu bɛ nwo la. 21Na ɔlua ɛhye ala ati yɛɛ Dwuuma rahyele me wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu mɔɔ anrɛɛ bɛku me a. 22Noko Nyamenle moalɛ ti, ɛnɛ megyi ɛke metɛdi daselɛ metɛkile bɛ mgbanyinli nee bɛ ngakula muala. Mɔɔ Mosisi nee Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma hanle dole ɛkɛ ne kɛ ɔbazi la, yemɔ ala a le mɔɔ melɛka la. 23 Ɔwɔ kɛ Mɛzaya ne nwu amaneɛ na ɔyɛ sonla mɔɔ lumua mɔɔ badwazo avi mɔwuamra anu, na yeabɔ wienyi nwo nolo yeahile Dwuuma nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la amuala.”
24Mɔɔ Pɔɔlo anloa wɔ zolɛ ɔlɛka edwɛkɛ ne la, Fɛsetɛse deanle ye nu zele kɛ, “Pɔɔlo, wɔzɛ! Ɛdoa nwomazukoalɛ dedee ɛlɛbɔ ɛlane.”
25Pɔɔlo buale ye kɛ, “Nana Fɛsetɛse, metɛsɛle. Nɔhalɛ komii ne a melɛka la. 26Belemgbunli Agelepa, mekpa edwɛkɛ ne anwo ɛdanlɛ mɔɔ menzulo ɔ nzi a, ɔluakɛ ɛdawɔ ɛze ɛhye mɔ amuala. Meze noko kɛ ɛyɛle bɛ nzonlɛ kpalɛ kpalɛ, ɔluakɛ ɛhye mɔ biala anzi fealera nu. 27Belemgbunli Agelepa, asoo ɛdie Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma edwɛkɛ ne ɛdi? Meze kɛ ɛdie ɛdi somaa!”
28Agelepa bizale Pɔɔlo kɛ, “Ɛnee ɛdwenle kɛ mekɛ ekyi ɛhye ala anu ɛmaa meayɛ Keleseɛnenli ɔ?”
29Pɔɔlo buale ye kɛ, “Saa mekɛ ekyi nu o, saa mekɛ tendenle nu o, me nzɛlɛlɛ a le kɛ anrɛɛ Nyamenle amaa ɛdawɔ nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛtie me ɛnɛ la amuala ayɛ ye sonvolɛma kɛ medame la, mɔɔ nwɔnzɔnwɔnzɔ ye ɛmboka nwolɛ a.”
30Na belemgbunli ne, amɛnlado ne, yɛɛ Bɛnaesi nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛha la amuala dwazole. 31Bɛvindele la, bɛhanle bɛhilele bɛ nwo kɛ, “Sonla ɛhye ɛtɛyɛle debie mɔɔ fɛta kɛ bɛku ye anzɛɛ bɛto ye efiade bɔbɔ a.” 32Na Agelepa zele Fɛsetɛse kɛ, “Saa sonla ye ambɔ ye edwɛkɛ ne atua ammaa Maanle Maanle belemgbunli ne a anrɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛgyakyi ye bɛmaa ɔkɔ.”

Title: GYI 27
Content:
Pɔɔlo dua nyevile nye ahɔ Wulomu
1Nzinlii mɔɔ bɛyɛle adwenle kɛ akee ɔwɔ kɛ yɛkɔ Yetale la, bɛvale Pɔɔlo nee pilizama bie mɔ mɔɔ boka nwolɛ la bɛwulale Dwuleɛse mɔɔ le sogya kpanyinli wɔ Wulomu Maanle Maanle belemgbunli ne sogyama ne anu la asa anu. 2Yɛhɔvole ɛlɛne bie mɔɔ vi Adelameteɛm, mɔɔ ɛlɛkɔ Ehyea maanzinli nu la anu na yɛdule. Alesetaakɛse, mɔɔ le Masidoneanli na ɔvi Tɛsalonaeka la boka yɛ nwo. 3Aleɛ hyenle la yɛradwule Saedɛn. Dwuleɛse hilele ye ahunlunyele wɔ Pɔɔlo anwo. Ɔmanle ye adenle ɔmanle ɔhɔle ɔ gɔnwo mɔ anwo kɛ ɔhɔkpondɛ ninyɛne mɔɔ ɔbahyia nwolɛ la. 4Yɛvi Saedɛn yɛdule la ɛnee anwoma ne ɛlɛbɔ atia yɛ. Yemɔti yɛwɔle yɛ ti aze yɛsianenle Saepelɛse aze. 5Yɛluale Selesea nee Pamefelea anwuma yɛrale Maela mɔɔ wɔ Lesea maanzinli nu la. 6Ɛkɛ yɛɛ sogya kpanyinli ne nyianle ɛlɛne bie mɔɔ vi Alɛzandelea ɛlɛkɔ Yetale la, na ɔvale yɛ ɔhɔvole nuhua.
7Yɛdule la ɛnee yɛngola kɔ kpalɛ biala, yemɔti yɛlile kenle dɔɔnwo wɔ adenle nu. Yɛ nwo hyelele yɛ kpalɛ na yɛaradwu Kenaedɛse. Kɛmɔ ɛnee anwoma ne tɛtu tɛtia yɛ la ati, yɛdɛlale bɔra ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Salemoni ala la yɛɛ yɛsianenle Kiliti bɔra ne aze a. 8Yɛsianenle aze kpalɛ kpalɛ, yɛvɛle dedee na yɛrale ɛleka bie mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye “Ahonle Kɛnlɛmazo” mɔɔ ɔ nee Lasia sua zo anwa biala la.
9Yɛhyɛle ɛkɛ kpalɛ na ɔrale kɛ akee yɛkɔ a ɔngɔ, ɔluakɛ mekɛ ne anu ɛnee azule nye ɛvalɛ akee ɛyɛ ɛzulolɛ na eza Buada Ɛvoyia ne ɛpɛ nu. Ɛhye ati, Pɔɔlo dule folɛ ɛhye: 10“Yɛmenle mɔ, menwu kɛ yɛ adendulɛ ye ɛlɛba arayɛ ɛzulolɛ amaa yɛ. Yɛbaminli ninyɛne dɔɔnwo. Ɛlɛne ye bazɛkye, yɛ ninyɛne bahɔ, yɛɛ yɛdayɛ noko yɛbawu.” 11Na sogya kpanyinli ne adwenle hɔle ɛlɛne menle ne nee mɔɔ nea zo la ɛdeɛ ne mɔɔ bɛhanle la anu, na ɔgyakyile mɔɔ Pɔɔlo hanle la. 12Eza ahonle ne azo bɔbɔ ɛnle kpalɛ biala mɔɔ bɛdi fɔsɛlɛ ɛkɛ ne a ɔyɛ boɛ a. Ɛhye ati bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ ɛlɛne ne anu la anu somaa ne ala hulole kɛ bɛkɛdu bɛkɛdɔ azule nye bieko na bɛkɛbɔ mɔdenle bɛkɛdwu Fonekese mɔɔ lɛ ahonle kpalɛ wɔ Kiliti na ɔ nye wɔ nyiakɛ adɔleɛ nee ɛbɔ nu adɔleɛ la, na bɛkɔdi fɔsɛlɛ ne wɔ ɛkɛ.
Nyevile nye ahumu ne
13Nyiakɛ anwoma bɛtɛɛ bie vɛlɛle, na menli ne dwenlenle kɛ akee ɔwɔ kɛ bɛyɛ, kɛmɔ bɛzuzule ala la. Bɛdule sɛkɛ na bɛsianenle Kiliti bɔra ne aze kpalɛ kpalɛ. 14Noko bɛandwu ɛleka biala yɛɛ anwoma ɛsesebɛ bie mɔɔ vi ɛbɔ nu la dwazole a. 15Ɔkpale yɛ ɛlɛne ne kpalɛ, na kɛmɔ ɛnee yɛyɛ nwolɛ biala a ɔnyɛ boɛ la, yɛgyakyile nu yɛmanle ye kɛ ɔkpa yɛ ɔhɔ ɛleka biala mɔɔ ɔbɔ yɛ yeahɔ la. 16Ɔkpale yɛ ɔhɔluale bɔra ekyi bie mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Kɔda la aze, na yɛbɔle mɔdenle yɛziele ɛlɛne ekyi ne mɔɔ wɔ ɛlɛnemgbole ne anu la boɛ. 17Bɛkpogyale ye na bɛsosɔle ye nyɛma. Bɛzulole kɛ bɛkɛhɔnwe Lebea ese ne azo la ati, bɛdwulale avela ne mɔ na bɛgyakyile nu kɛ anwoma ne ɛkpa ye ɛhɔ ɛleka biala mɔɔ ɔkulo la. 18Aleɛ hyenle la ɛnee kɛ maanle nu ɛzi ɛmunla, na ahumu ne tɛsa la ati, bɛbɔle ɔ bo kɛ bɛyeye ɛlɛne ne anu ninyɛne ne bie bɛagua nyevile nu. 19Ye kenle nsa ne azo bɛvuandinle ɛlɛne ne anwo ninyɛne ne bie noko bɛguale nyevile nu. 20Kenle dɔɔnwo pɛle nu mɔɔ ɛnee yɛ nye ɛnnwu sɛnzɛne na yeayɛ ɛwɔlɔra a, yɛɛ kɛ ahumu ne noko gyi zo ala ɛne. Yemɔti yɛ nwo vɔle bɔkɔɔ kɛ yeannyia yɛanyɛ boɛ, yɛbawu.
21Menli ne anloa nu dole, yemɔti mekɛ dɔɔnwo ne ala ɛnee bɛnli debie. Na kenle ko Pɔɔlo dwazole gyinlanle bɛ avinli na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Ebiamɔ, anrɛɛ bɛvale mɔɔ menganle la, na yɛvi Kiliti yɛandu; anrɛɛ munzule kpole ɛhye kpale yɛ ti na yɛamminli ninyɛne dɔɔnwo ɛhye mɔ. 22Noko kɛkala, mesɛlɛ bɛ, bɛzi ahonle na awie biala ɛnrɛminli ye ngoane; ɛlɛne ye ala a bazɛkye a. 23Nɔe, Nyamenle ne mɔɔ mele ye ɛdeɛ na mesonle ye la soanvolɛ rale me nwo ɛke, 24na ɔzele me kɛ, ‘Pɔɔlo, mmasulo, na ɔwɔ kɛ ɛgyinla Maanle Maanle belemgbunli ne anyunlu. Ɔlua zo Nyamenle ɛva bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ nee wɔ lua nyevile ye anye la amuala ngoane ɛhyɛ wɔ.’ 25Ɛhye ati ayi mɔ, bɛzi ahonle. Medie Nyamenle medi kɛ mɔɔ bɛha bɛhile me la bayɛ zɔhane. 26Noko akee ahumu ne bakpa yɛ ahɔnwe bɔra bie ɛnweanloa.”
27Asɛɛ kenle bulu nee nna ɛnee ahumu ne tɛkpa yɛ wɔ Mɛdetɛlenia nyevile nye. 28Kenle ko ne nɔe ne, kɛyɛ alevinli mu nwiɔ avinli, gyimayɛvoma mɔɔ wɔ ɛlɛne ne anu la nwunle kɛ yɛbikye bɔra bie anwo. 29Bɛzulole kɛ yɛ ɛlɛne ne kɛhɔfofo bolɛ bie azo la ati, bɛdwulale sɛkɛ nna azule nu na yɛzɛlɛle alehyenlɛ. 30Ɛnee gyimayɛvoma ne kpondɛ avi ɛlɛne ne anu anriandi la ati, bɛdwulale ɛlɛne ekyi ne na bɛyɛle kɛ asɛɛ bɛkado sɛkɛ ne bie wɔ ɛlɛnemgbole ne anyunlu lɔ la. 31Pɔɔlo hanle hilele sogya kpanyinli ne kɛ, “Saa gyimayɛvoma ne mɔ andɛnla ɛlɛne ye anu a yɛ nuhua ko bɔbɔ ɛnrɛha.” 32Zɔhane ati sogyama ne pɛle nyɛma ne mɔɔ lɛ ɛlɛne ekyi ne la anu na bɛmanle ɔhɔle.
33Aleɛbahye ne, Pɔɔlo bodole bɛ kɛ bɛ muala bɛli debie. Ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Ɛnɛ le kenle bulu nee nna ɛne, ahunlundetelɛ ɛmaa bɛlɛ bɛ ko mgbane. 34Yemɔti mesɛlɛ bɛ, bɛli debie ekyi bɛmaa bɛ nwo ɛgyinla bɛ, na bɛ biala ati enrinli ko bɔbɔ ɛnrɛminli.” 35Pɔɔlo hanle ɛhye la, ɔvale kpanwo, ɔyɛle nzɛlɛlɛ, ɔyɛle Nyamenle mo na ɔbɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɔbubu yeali wɔ bɛ nyunlu ɛkɛ. 36Bɛ muala akee bɛzile ahonle, na awie biala lile debie. 37Yɛdayɛ mɔɔ ɛnee yɛwɔ ɛlɛne ne anu la yɛlua ɛya nwiɔ abulasuu nee nsia. 38Akee mɔɔ awie biala ako yile la bɛdule abɛlɛ mɔɔ wɔ ɛlɛne ne anu la bie bɛguale nyevile nu, amaa ɛlɛne ne ayɛ felafela.
Ɛlɛne ne ɛzialɛ
39Mɔɔ aleɛ hyenle la ɛnee bɛnnwu azɛlɛ holɛ ko mɔɔ bɛra zolɛ la ɛdeɛ, noko bɛnwunle ɛnwea wɔ ye ebolo bie anu, na bɛyɛle kɛ bɛbɔ mɔdenle bɛahɔnwe ɛlɛne ne wɔ ɛkɛ. 40Yemɔti bɛpɛle sɛkɛ ne mɔ amuala anu na bɛzianyinle nyɛma ne mɔɔ lɛ ɛlɛne ne kotogyampa ne anu la. Bɛvolale avela ne mɔɔ wɔ ɛlɛne ne ati la bɛmanle anwoma ne vale ye hɔle aze. 41Na ɛlɛne ne hɔdɔle ɛsa nu; ɔ ti ne minle ɛnwea ne anu mɔɔ bɛtu ye a ɔnyɛ boɛ fee a, na nyevile azɛlɛkye ne bule zile ɔ bo ne bubule ye.
42Sogyama ne yɛle kɛ bɛku pilizama mɔɔ wɔ ɛlɛne ne anu la amuala, amaa bie anweɛ anvo file zo na yeanriandi. 43Na kɛmɔ ɛnee sogya kpanyinli ne kulo kɛ ɔdie Pɔɔlo ngoane la ati, yeamkponle zolɛ. Ɔzele bɛ kɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛze weɛ la ɛweɛ ɛhɔ file zo. 44Menli noko mɔɔ hale la bie mɔ sesale ndaboa mɔɔ wɔ ɛlɛne ne anu, mɔɔ ɛlɛtudu ahɔ la bie, bie mɔ noko sosɔle ɛlɛne ne abɛta abɛta ne mɔɔ ɛdudu la anu bɛvole bɛbutubutule zolɛ. Ɛnee kɛ yɛyɛle mɔɔ yɛ muala yɛholale aze dwu la ɛne.

Title: GYI 28
Content:
Wɔ Mɔleta
1Mɔɔ yɛradwule aze la yɛdele kɛ bɔra ne mɔɔ yɛra zo la bɛfɛlɛ ye Mɔleta. 2Bɔra ne azo amra lɛ ahunlunyele kpalɛ. Ɛnee ezule ne ɛlɛtɔ na ɛyɛlɛ wɔ nu la ati, bɛhuanle senle bɛmanle yɛ muala yɛdɛnlanle nwolɛ. 3Pɔɔlo sesale ngeleka bie guale senle ne anu. Na senle ne wuluwulu ne hanle ɛyɛne ne la, ɛwɔlɛ bɔna vi nu vindele na ɔbebale Pɔɔlo asa. 4Mɔɔ bɔra ne azo amra nwunle kɛ ɛwɔlɛ ne beba Pɔɔlo asa la, bɛdule bɛ nwo azukue kɛ, “Sonla ɛhye kɛyɛ kɔdiawu. Yemɔti yevi nyevile ye anu kɔlɔnwo bɔbɔ ɛdeɛ, noko ɔyɛ biala a ɔbawu.” 5Na Pɔɔlo kpondenle ɛwɔlɛ ne guale senle ne anu na ɛhwee anyɛ ɔdaye mumua ne. 6Mɔɔ ɔyɛle zɔhane la ɛnee menli ne mɔ anye la kɛ Pɔɔlo asa banwu anzɛɛ ɔbapɛ yeafi yeawu. Na bɛnleanle dedee mɔɔ ɛhwee anyɛ ye la, bɛhakyile bɛ adwenle na bɛhanle kɛ, “Ɔle bozonle!”
7Bɔra ne azo kpanyinli ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Pɛbeleɛse la ɛleka mɔɔ de la nee ɛleka mɔɔ yɛwɔ la anwa. Ɔ nee yɛ hɔle ye sua nu na ɔliele yɛ kɛnlɛma gyɛlɛɛnye, ɔlieliele yɛ nye kenle nsa. 8Mekɛ ne anu ɛnee ebunlu ɛhye Pɛbeleɛse ɔ ze na eza ɔkɔ baka zo, yemɔti ɔla sua nu. Pɔɔlo hɔle ɔ nwo ɛkɛ, ɔzɛlɛle ɔmanle ye na ɔvale ɔ sa ɔguale ɔ nwo zo ɔmanle ɔdele kpɔkɛ. 9Mɔɔ ɛhye zile la, awuleravolɛ mɔɔ wɔ bɔra ne azo la amuala rale manle ɔyɛle bɛ ayile. 10Bɛlile yɛ eni dɔɔnwo, yɛɛ kenle mɔɔ yɛbahɔ la, bɛvale ninyɛne mɔɔ yɛbahyia nwolɛ wɔ yɛ adendulɛ ne anu la bɛhɔguale ɛlɛne ne anu bɛmanle yɛ.
Yɛvi Mɔleta yɛkɔ Wulomu
11Siane nsa pɛle nu la yɛvale ɛlɛne bie mɔɔ vi Alɛzandelea mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye “Bozonle Ndalɛ,” mɔɔ ralile fɔsɛlɛ ne wɔ bɔra ne azo la yɛzɔle yɛ adendulɛ ne azo. 12Yɛradwule aze wɔ Saelekusu na yɛlile kenle nsa wɔ ɛkɛ. 13Yɛvi ɛkɛ ne la yɛrale Riligeɛm. Aleɛ hyenle la nyevile nu anwoma ne dwazole. Yemɔti yɛlile kenle nwiɔ yɛɛ yɛdwule Putiyɔle sua zo a. 14Yɛnwunle diedima ne bie mɔ wɔ ɛkɛ, na bɛzɛlɛle yɛ bɛmanle yɛlile dapɛne wɔ bɛ nwo ɛkɛ. Nzinlii yɛradwule Wulomu. 15Ɛnee diedima mɔɔ wɔ Wulomu la ɛde yɛ nganeɛ dɛbadɛba, yemɔti bɛvi ɛkɛ ne toonwo bɛrayiale yɛ wɔ Apeɛse Gua nu nee “Dabelɛ Nsa.” Mɔɔ Pɔɔlo nwunle bɛ la, ye ahonle gyinlanle na ɔyɛle Nyamenle mo.
Wɔ Wulomu
16Mɔɔ yɛdwule Wulomu la, bɛmanle Pɔɔlo adenle kɛ ɔdaye ɔ ngome ɔhɔdɛnla, na bɛyele sogyanli ko kɛ ɔ nee ye ɛhɔdɛnla na ɔzinza ye.
17Ɔlile kenle nsa la Pɔɔlo vɛlɛle Dwuu mgbanyima mɔɔ wɔ sua ne azo la, ɔ nee bɛ yiale nu na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Me mediema Yizilayɛma, meanyɛ ɛtane biala meantia me menli anzɛɛ yɛ amaamuo ne mɔɔ yɛnyianle yɛvile yɛ nlenya mɔ lɔ la, noko bɛhyele me piliza bɛyele me bɛmanle Wulomuma wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm. 18Bɛnleɛnleanle me edwɛkɛ ne anu la ɛnee bɛnnwu debie biala mɔɔ meyɛ mɔɔ fɛta ɛhunlɛ a. 19 Na kɛmɔ Dwuuma amkponle la ati, ɛnee ɔhyia kɛ mebɔ me edwɛkɛ ne atua memaa Maanle Maanle belemgbunli ne. Menlɛ bɛ nwo adwenle ɛtane biala, yɛɛ meamba kɛ mebadoa bɛ. 20Ɛhye ati yɛɛ mevɛlɛ bɛ kɛ me nee bɛ badendɛ a. Ɔluakɛ, ɔlua sonla ne mɔɔ Yizilayɛma lɛ anyelazo wɔ ye nu la ati yɛɛ bɛgua me nwɔnzɔnwɔnzɔ a.”
21Bɛzele ye kɛ, “Yɛmɛ yɛtɛnyianle ɛ nwo kɛlata biala vi Dwudiya, yɛɛ mediema ne mɔ biala ɛtɛbale ɛtɛbabɔle yɛ nehane amaneɛ biala mɔɔ le ɛtane wɔ ɛ nwo a. 22Na yɛkulo kɛ yɛtie wɔ adwenle. Mɔɔ yɛze ye ɛke la a le kɛ, zɛhae fane ye mɔɔ ɛwɔ nu la, awie biala tendɛ tia ye.”
23Na bɛ nee Pɔɔlo hilele kenle. Kenle ne dwule la, menli dɔɔnwo rayiale ɛleka mɔɔ Pɔɔlo de la. Na ɔhanle Nyamenle Belemgbunlililɛ ne anwo edwɛkɛ ɔhilehilele nu ɔhilele bɛ, na ɔbɔle mɔdenle kɛ ɔmaa bɛalie Gyisɛse anwo edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma nee Mosisi mɛla ne ka la bɛali. Ɔdendɛle ɛhye anwo ɔvi nwonlomɔ mangyee ne toonwo aledwolɛ. 24Bie mɔ liele lile, na bie mɔ anlie anli. 25Na bɛ adwenle anzɛ yɛɛ bɛzandele a. Na mɔɔ bɛbahɔ la Pɔɔlo hanle edwɛkɛ ko ɛhye kɛ, “Mɔɔ Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne luale Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ Ayezaya anwo zo hanle hilele yɛ nlenya mɔ la le nɔhalɛ somaa! 26 Ɔluakɛ ɔzele kɛ,
‘Kɔze menli ɛhye mɔ kɛ,
bɛbadie, bɛadie, na bɛnrɛde ɔ bo;
bɛbanlea, bɛanlea, na bɛnrɛnwu debie,
27ɔboalekɛ Nyamenle se, menli ɛhye mɔ ɛsolo,
bɛduodua bɛ nzo yɛɛ bɛmuomua bɛ nye.
Anrɛɛ bɛ nye kɛnwu debie,
bɛ nzo kɛde edwɛkɛ, bɛkɛnyia ndelebɛbo,
na bɛkɛzia bɛkɛra me ɛkɛ, na meayɛ bɛ ayile.’ ”
28Akee Pɔɔlo dwulale ye edwɛkɛ ne zɛhae, “Yemɔti bɛnwu ye kɛ bɛlɛ Nyamenle ngoanelielɛ nwo nrɛlaleɛ ne bɛkamaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la, na bɛbadie!”
[ 29Mɔɔ Pɔɔlo hanle ɛhye la, Dwuuma ne vale kpolerazulɛ kpole kpalɛ dwazole hɔle.]
30Na Pɔɔlo dɛnlanle sua mɔɔ ɔde nu na ɔdaye a ɔtua ye kakɛ la anu toonwo ɛvolɛ nwiɔ. Ɔliele menli mɔɔ rale ɔ nwo ɛkɛ ne la amuala. 31Ɔhanle Nyamenle Belemgbunlililɛ ne anwo edwɛkɛ na ɔhilehilele menli ninyɛne mɔɔ fane Awulae Gyisɛse Kelaese anwo la, na awie biala andenda ɔ gyakɛ anu.

Title: WULO MUKENYE
Content:
Mukenye
Pɔɔlo kɛlata ne mɔɔ ɔhɛlɛle ɔhɔmanle Wulomuma la, ɔhɛlɛle ɔvale ɔkpakyele adenle wɔ ɔdaye Pɔɔlo ye akpɔsa mɔɔ yehyehyɛ kɛ ɔbahɔ wɔ Wulomu yeahɔkpɔla asɔnema mɔɔ wɔ ɛkɛ ne la. Pɔɔlo adwenle a le kɛ ɔ nee Kelaese ɛdoavolɛma mɔɔ wɔ ɛkɛ ne la kayɛ gyima mekɛ ekyi bie, na akee ɔlua bɛ moalɛ zo yeahɔ Sepeen. Ɔhɛlɛle ɔhilele ye ndelebɛbo wɔ Kelease ɛdoavolɛma diedi ne anwo nee kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ ɔsi ɔfinde Kelease ɛdoavolɛ biala ɛbɛla ɛbɔlɛ nu la. Pɔɔlo edwɛkɛ kpɔkɛ mɔɔ di munli bɔkɔɔ wɔ ye nolobɔlɛ ne anwo la wɔ buluku ne anu.
Pɔɔlo bizale asɔnema mɔɔ wɔ Wulomu la ahye, na ɔhanle kɛ ɔsi ɔsɛlɛ ɔmaa bɛ la anwo edwɛkɛ ɔwiele la, akee ɔhanle deɛ mɔɔ gyi ɔ nyunlu mɔɔ yemɔti ɔhɛlɛle kɛlata ne la kɛ, “Edwɛkpa ne kile kɛ Nyamenle si maa menli sɔ ɔ nye la; ɔlua diedi zo, ɔvi mɔlebɛbo ne kɔdwu awieleɛ” (1.17).
Pɔɔlo akee kilehile kpɔkɛ ɛhye anu zɛhae: Aleɛabo amra amuala, Dwuuma o, bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la o, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛmaa bɛsɔ Nyamenle anye, ɔluakɛ bɛ muala bɛwɔ ɛtane tumi ne abo. Menli dua bɛ diedi mɔɔ wɔ Gyisɛse Kelaese anu la azo a sɔ Nyamenle anye a. Pɔɔlo eza kilehile ɛbɛla ɛbɔlɛ fofolɛ ne mɔɔ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ nee Kelaese le ko la bɔ wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛnwu Nyamenle la. Nyamenle Sunsum ne kpɔne diedinli ne fi ɛtane nee ewule tumi bo na ɔmaa ɔ nzo nu dwo ye kɛ yenwu Nyamenle a. Wɔ mgbakyelɛ 5-8 ne mɔ anu, Pɔɔlo eza kilehile Nyamenle Mɛla ne deɛ mɔɔ ɔgyi zolɛ la anu, nee kɛ Nyamenle Sunsum ne si di gyima wɔ diedinli ne ɛbɛla nu la. Akee ɛzoanvolɛ ne ka Dwuuma nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la edwɛkɛ, nee kɛ ko biala si ba Nyamenle ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔɔ ɔlɛ ɔmaa aleɛabo amra amuala la anu la. Awieleɛ ne, ɛzoanvolɛ ne kile nu kɛ Dwuuma ɛkpolɛ mɔɔ kpole Gyisɛse Kelaese la le Nyamenle ngyehyɛlɛ mɔɔ ɔfa yealua zolɛ yeava aleɛabo amra amuala yeara Nyamenle ɛlolɛ ne abo wɔ Gyisɛse Kelease ati na ɔdie ɔdi kɛ Dwuuma ɛnrɛhɔ zolɛ ɛnrɛkpo Gyisɛse dahuu. Akee Pɔɔlo kilehile kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ Kelaese ɛdoavolɛ biala si bɔ ye ɛbɛla la, bɔbɔ mɔɔ fane bɛ nwo ngoko ɛhulolɛ la anwo. Akee ɔvale ninyɛne mɔɔ le kɛ Nyamenle ɛzonlenlɛ, Kelaese ɛdoavolɛma gyima mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ di maa maanle ne nee bɛ nwo ngoko, yɛɛ adwenle nu wienyi ɛyɛlɛ nwo edwɛkɛ ɔhanle. Akee ɔvale ɔdaye ye nrɛlaleɛ nee Nyamenle ayɛlɛyelɛ ɔwiele kɛlata ne.
Mɔɔ wɔ nu la
Ngilenu nee kɛlata ne kpɔkɛ mɔɔ gyi zolɛ la 1.1-17
Sonla hyia ngoanelielɛ 1.18—3.20
Nyamenle ngoanelielɛ nwo adenle 3.21—4.25
Kelaese anu ɛbɛla ɛbɔlɛ fofolɛ 5.1—8.39
Yizilayɛma nee Nyamenle ngyehyɛlɛ ne 9.1—11.36
Kelaese ɛdoavolɛma nyɛleɛ 12.1—15.13
Ahyebizalɛ nee adwulaleɛ 15.14—16.27

Title: WULO 1
Content:
1Medame Pɔɔlo, mɔɔ mele Kelaese Gyisɛse akɛlɛ, na Nyamenle ɛvɛlɛ me kɛ membanyɛ ɛzoanvolɛ na yeze me kɛ membɔ ye Edwɛkpa ne nolo la a melɛkɛlɛ kɛlata ɛhye a.
2Nyamenle luale ye kpɔmanvolɛma anwo zo vale Edwɛkpa ɛhye bɔle ɛwɔkɛ wɔ mɔmoane kpalɛ ne, kɛmɔ bɛhɛlɛ ye wɔ Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ Nwuanzanwuanza ne mɔ anu la. 3Edwɛkpa ɛhye fane ɔ Ra ne, mɔɔ le yɛ Awulae Gyisɛse Kelaese, mɔɔ saa nwonane nu a ɔle Devidi anlɔnra, 4noko wɔ Nyamenle nu nwuanzanwuanzayɛlɛ nu a, bɛva tumi kpole bɛdwazo ye bɛvi ewule nu bɛhile kɛ ɔle Nyamenle Ara la anwo. 5Ɔ nwo zo yɛɛ ɔlua mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛlo yɛ ɛmaa merayɛ ɛzoanvolɛ a, amaa menli kɔsɔɔti alie ye duma ne ali na bɛadie ye. 6Bɛdabɛ noko mɔɔ bɛwɔ Wulomu la boka ɛhye anwo, ɔluakɛ Nyamenle ɛvɛlɛ bɛ kɛ bɛrayɛ Gyisɛse Kelaese ɛdeɛ.
7Zɔhane ati melɛkɛlɛ kɛlata ɛhye mearɛlɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle kulo bɛ na yevɛlɛ bɛ kɛ bɛrayɛ ye menli na bɛwɔ Wulomu la amuala.
Yɛ Ze Nyamenle ne nee Awulae Gyisɛse Kelaese ɛlo bɛ na ɔmaa bɛ anzonudwolɛ.
Moyɛlɛ nzɛlɛlɛ
8Medumua mealua Gyisɛse Kelaese anwo zo meayɛ Nyamenle mo wɔ bɛ kɔsɔɔti bɛ ti, ɔluakɛ bɛ diedi nganeɛ ɛdwu ewiade amra amuala anzo nu. 9Nyamenle ne mɔɔ medua ɔ Ra ne anwo Edwɛkɛ Kpalɛ ne nolobɔlɛ zo mefa me ahonle muala mesonle ye la di me daselɛ kɛ mɔɔ melɛka la le nɔhalɛ. Nyamenle ze kɛ dahuu mekakye bɛ 10wɔ me nzɛlɛlɛ nu. Mesɛlɛ kɛ ɔlua ɔdaye Nyamenle ye ɛhulolɛ zo ɔmaa adenle ɔmaa membamkpɔla bɛ. 11Ɔluakɛ mekulo kɛ mebakpɔla bɛ, amaa yɛanyia Nyamenle Sunsum nu ahyɛlɛdeɛ ne na bɛ nwo ayɛ se. 12Mɔɔ mekpondɛ meaha la a le kɛ, saa yɛ muala yɛyia nu a bɛ diedi bamaa me anwosesebɛ, yɛɛ me diedi bamaa bɛ diedi anyi.
13 Me mediema, mekpondɛ kɛ bɛnwu kɛ mekɛ dɔɔnwo anu mehyehyɛ kɛ anrɛɛ menwɔrakpɔla bɛ, amaa meahola meahakyi bɛ bie mɔ dɔɔnwo, kɛmɔ meyɛ ye wɔ maanle maanle dɔɔnwo zo la, noko ɔyɛ a ɛnee debie fofolɛ ɛzi me aze. 14Ɔluakɛ ɛzonlelilɛ la me nwo zo kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ mebɔ edwɛkɛ ne nolo mekile menli ngakyile kɔsɔɔti, bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ nye ɛde nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ nye ɛtɛtele, mɔɔ ze bie nee mɔɔ ɛnze bie la amuala. 15Ɛhye ati yɛɛ mekulo kɛ meka Edwɛkpa ne mekile bɛdabɛ noko mɔɔ bɛwɔ Wulomu la a.
Tumi wɔ Edwɛkpa ne anu
16 Menze Edwɛkpa ne anwo nyiane. Ɔle Nyamenle tumi mɔɔ ɔfa ɔdie bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdie bɛdi la amuala a, mɔɔ lumua la a le bɛdabɛ Dwuuma yɛɛ akee bɛdabɛ noko mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la. 17 Ɔluakɛ ɔvi mɔlebɛbo ne kɔdwu awieleɛ ne amuala, Nyamenle dua diedi zo a maa menli sɔ ɔ nye a. Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se, “Mɔɔ bɛkɛlua ye diedi zo bɛkɛmaa ɔkɛzɔ Nyamenle anye la banyia ngoane.”
Sonla azedɔlɛ
18Bɛhile bɛmaa yɛnwu kɛ Nyamenle ɛya ne vi anwuma bara bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛmbu Nyamenle na bɛfa bɛ ngunziyɛlɛ bɛkeda nɔhalɛ ne azo la anwo zo. 19Nyamenle badea bɛ, ɔluakɛ bɛze mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ sonla nwu ye wɔ Nyamenle anwo la. Nyamenle ɔdaye a ɔyele ɔhilele bɛ a. 20Sumunli kɛ Nyamenle bɔle ewiade la yɛɛ ɔbɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɔye ye su kpalɛ ne mɔɔ yɛ nye ɛnnwu ye la wienyi yeahile sonla a. Ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ a le ye damɛnlangoate tumi ne nee ye nyamenleyɛlɛ ne. Menli nwu ɛhye wɔ ninyɛne mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛbɔ la anu. Yemɔti bɛnlɛ nyelebɛnloa fee! 21 Bɛze Nyamenle, noko bɛnva enililɛ mɔɔ fɛta la bɛmmaa ye kɛ ɔle Nyamenle, yɛɛ bɛnva moyɛlɛ bɛmmaa ye. Adwenle mgbane mgbane yɛɛ bɛfa a, yɛɛ awozinli ɛyi bɛ adwenle ne mɔ mɔɔ nrɛlɛbɛ ɛnle nu la tetɛkɛɛ. 22Bɛse bɛze nrɛlɛbɛ, noko bɛle ahɔnwɔne; 23 kɛ bɛkɛzonle damɛnlangoate Nyamenle ne la, bɛsonle ninyɛne mɔɔ bɛdabɛ bɛnwo, mɔɔ le kɛ sonla, nloma, nane anzɛɛ nwɔlɛ la.
24Kɛmɔ menli ɛyɛ bɛ nwo ahɔnwɔne zɛhae la ati, Nyamenle ɛye bɛ ɛmaa bɛdabɛ bɛ atiakunluwɔzo mgbane mgbane ne mɔ, na ɔlua zolɛ mraalɛ fa mraalɛ na mrenya fa mrenya. 25Bɛgyakyile kɛ bɛkɛlie nɔhalɛ ne mɔɔ fane Nyamenle anwo la bɛkɛli. Zɔhane ati bɛdie adalɛ ne bɛdi na bɛsonle ninyɛne mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛbɔ bɛ la, na bɛgyakyi Bɔvolɛ Nyamenle mumua ne, yemɔ yɛɛ ayɛlɛyelɛ ɛha ye dahuu a. Amen.
26Kɛmɔ menli yɛ nyɛleɛ ɛhye mɔ la ati, Nyamenle ɛgyakyi bɛ ɛmaa bɛ anyiemgba ɛbɛla ne. Bɔbɔ mraalɛ fa bɛ nwo gyakyi mrenya. 27Zɔhane ala yɛɛ mrenya noko gyakyi mraalɛ na bɛmaa bɛ ti akunlu ba bɛ gɔnwo mɔ mrenya nwo zo na bɛfa bɛ a. Nzinlii bɛnyia bɛ ninyɛndane ɛhye mɔ anwo ndeanlɛ, bɛte ye bɛ nwonane nu kpalɛ kpalɛ kɛmɔ ɔfɛta la.
28Kɛmɔ menli kpole kɛ bɛnrɛnwu Nyamenle la ati, ɔgyakyile bɛ ɔmanle bɛ adwenle ne mɔ mɔɔ ɛkpɔlɔ la, amaa ɔlua zolɛ bɛyɛle ninyɛne mɔɔ ɔnle kɛ bɛyɛ la. 29Ninyɛne mɔɔ le kɛ amumuyɛ, asiayɛ, anyebolo, ngunzi, nungule, kɔdiawu, konle, adalɛ nee nwondomgbɔ la ɛyi bɛ tɛkɛɛ. Bɛye ndɛne, 30bɛka bɛ gɔnwo mɔ anwo edwɛkɛ ɛtane ɛtane, bɛkyi Nyamenle, bɛtu bɛ nwo, bɛyɛ mgbanyizonle, bɛkile bɛ nwo, bɛboɔboa bɛdwenle ɛtane nwo bɛyɛ, yɛɛ bɛndie bɛ awovolɛma; 31bɛle ahɔnwɔne, bɛnlɛ diedi, bɛnze ahunlunyele yɛɛ bɛ ti yɛ se kpalɛ kpalɛ. 32Bɛze noko kɛ Nyamenle mɛla ne kile kɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛbɔ ɛbɛla zɛhae mɔ la fɛta ewule, noko bɛyɛ, yɛɛ bɛsi awie mɔ adua bɛmaa bɛyɛ bie.

Title: WULO 2
Content:
Nyamenle ndɛnebualɛ ne
1 Zɔhane ati ayi, wɔmɔ a ɛle nwane bɔbɔ a, ɛnlɛ adenle ɛmbua awie mɔ ndɛne hweledede. Saa ɛbua awie ndɛne wɔ ye nyɛleɛ nwo a, ɛnee ɛlɛbua ɛ nwo fɔlɛ, ɔboalekɛ ɛdawɔ mumua ne mɔɔ ɛlɛbua ndɛne ne la ɛyɛ nyɛleɛ ko ne ala mɔɔ ahenle mɔɔ ɛlɛbua ye ndɛne la yɛ la bie. 2Yɛze kɛ saa Nyamenle tea bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛbɔ zezɛhae ɛbɛla la a ɛnee ɔfɛta. 3Na ayi, ɛdawɔ mumua ne ɛyɛ nyɛleɛ mɔɔ ɛbua awie mɔ nwolɛ fɔlɛ la bie. Ɛnee ɛdwenle kɛ ɛkɛvi nu wɔ Nyamenle ndɛnebualɛ ne anu ɔ? 4Anzɛɛ ɛmbu ye kpalɛyɛlɛ totohyia ne nee ye abotane ne bie ɔ? Ɛnze kɛ Nyamenle atiakunlukɛnlɛmayɛlɛ ne wɔ ɛkɛ ne, ɔlɛkile wɔ yeamaa wɔanlu ɛ nwo ɔ? 5Noko bɛmɛ bɛ nzo yɛ se kpalɛ, yɛɛ bɛsolo. Zɔhane ati bɛlɛmaa bɛ ndeanlɛ ayɛ kpole wɔ Kenle ne mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛya ne nee ye ndɛnebualɛ fɔɔnwo ne kɛdwu la. 6 Ɔluakɛ Nyamenle badua awie biala kakɛ, kɛmɔ ye gyima de la. 7Menli bie wɔ ɛkɛ mɔɔ bɛmɛ, abotane nee kpalɛyɛlɛ ala a bɛli ɔ nzi a, na bɛkpondɛ anyunlunyia, enililɛ nee ngoane mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ la. Na bɛmɛ noko ala yɛɛ Nyamenle bamaa bɛ ngoane mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ a. 8Bie mɔ noko le angomedi, bɛkpo mɔɔ le nɔhalɛ la na bɛdi ɛtane nzi. Bɛ nwo zo yɛɛ Nyamenle bawola ye ɛya kpole ne agua a. 9Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛyɛ amumuyɛ la amuala banwu amaneɛ nee abodelɛ, Dwuuma lumua yɛɛ bɛdabɛ noko mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la doa bɛ. 10Nyamenle bava anyunlunyia, enililɛ nee anzonudwolɛ amaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdi boɛ la, Dwuuma lumua yɛɛ bɛdabɛ noko mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la doa bɛ. 11 Ɔluakɛ Nyamenle bua menli kɔsɔɔti ndɛne wɔ adenle ko ne ala azo.
12Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la ɛnlɛ Mosisi mɛla ne; yemɔti bɛyɛ ɛtane a bɛminli bɔbɔ ɛdeɛ, noko tɛ mɛla ne abo ɔ. Dwuuma a lɛ mɛla ne a, yemɔti bɛyɛ ɛtane a bɛnea mɛla ne azo a bɛbua bɛ ndɛne a. 13Ɔluakɛ tɛ mɛla ne ɛdielɛ a maa sonla sɔ Nyamenle anye a, kyesɛ ɔyɛ mɔɔ mɛla ne se la. 14Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la ɛnlɛ Mosisi mɛla ne suzuamgba ɛdeɛ, noko kenle biala mɔɔ bɛkɛyɛ mɔɔ mɛla ne se la bie la, ɛnee bɛyɛ Mosisi mɛla ne bɛmaa bɛ nwo. 15Bɛ nyɛleɛ ne kile kɛ mɔɔ Mosisi mɛla ne kpondɛ la, bɛhɛlɛ ye wɔ bɛ ahonle nu, yɛɛ bɛ adwenle die to nu kɛ ɔle nɔhalɛ, ɔluakɛ ɔyɛ a bɛ adwenle nu yɛ bɛ kesee kɛ bɛbali fɔlɛ anzɛɛ bɛbali benle wɔ Kenle ne anu, 16kɛmɔ Edwɛkpa ne mɔɔ mebɔ ye nolo la kile la. Na yemɔ a le kɛ, Nyamenle dua Gyisɛse Kelaese anwo zo bua menli kɔsɔɔti ndɛne wɔ adwenle biala mɔɔ bɛfa ye fealera nu la anwo.
Dwuuma nee Mosisi mɛla ne
17Na saa ɛfɛlɛ ɛ nwo Dwuunli, ɛgyi Mosisi mɛla ne azo, ɛfa Nyamenle ɛtu ɛ nwo, 18ɛze mɔɔ Nyamenle kpondɛ kɛ ɛyɛ la, yɛɛ wɔzukoa mɛla ne la ati, ɛze mɔɔ le kpalɛ mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ ɛyɛ la, 19ɛze ye wienyi kɛ wɔmɔ a ɛle anyenzinliravolɛma adekilevolɛ a, ɛle kɛnlaneɛ ɛmaa menli mɔɔ lua awozinli nu la, 20ɛle fotuvo ɛmaa mɔɔ ɛnze nrɛlɛbɛ la, ɛle ngakula kilehilevolɛ, ɛze ye wienyi kɛ mɛla ne ɛbuke wɔ adwenle nu ɛmaa wɔnwu nɔhalɛ ne, 21ɛkilehile ɛ gɔnwo mɔ a, ɛnee duzu ati a ɛngilehile ɛ nwo ɛ? Ɛka kɛ, “Bɛmmawua”, na asoo ɛnle awule? 22Ɛse, “Bɛmmato awuvolɛvalɛ mɛla ne”, na asoo ɛnva awuvolɛ? Ɛkyi amonle anzɛɛ bozonle, na asoo ɛngɔ amonle nu anzɛɛ bozonle zo ɛngɔnwua? 23Ɛtu ɛ nwo kɛ ɛlɛ mɛla ne, na asoo ɛntietia zolɛ, ɛngua Nyamenle anyunlu aze? 24 Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se, “Bɛmɛ Dwuuma bɛ ti, bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la tendɛ tia Nyamenle.”
25Saa bɛdi mɛla ne azo a, ɛnee bɛ mrenyanu nzonlɛyɛlɛ ne le nvasoɛ, na saa bɛnli mɛla ne azo a, ɛnee noko anrɛɛ bɛanyɛ bɛ mrenyanu nzonlɛ bɔbɔ. 26Na saa awie mɔɔ ɛnle Dwuunli, mɔɔ ɛtɛyɛle ye mrenyanu nzonlɛ la yɛ mɔɔ mɛla ne kpondɛ la a, ɛnee ɛnea a asoo Nyamenle ɛnrɛva sonla zɔhane kɛ asɛɛ yeyɛ ye mrenyanu nzonlɛ? 27Zɔhane ati menli mɔɔ nwonane nu bɛtɛyɛle bɛ mrenyanu nzonlɛ, noko bɛdi mɛla ne azo la babua bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛyɛ bɛ mrenyanu nzonlɛ na bɛlɛ mɛla ne bɛ sa nu, na bɛtietia zolɛ la ndɛne. 28Nwane a le Dwuunli kpalɛ ne mɔɔ ɛyɛ ye mrenyanu nzonlɛ la a? Dwuunli kpalɛ ne, tɛ yemɔ a le sonla ne mɔɔ nwonane nu yeyɛ ye mrenyanu nzonlɛ la, yɛɛ mrenyanu nzonlɛyɛlɛ kpalɛ ɛnle nwonane nu debie. 29 Dwuunli kpalɛ ne a le sonla ne mɔɔ sunsum nu yeyɛ ye ahonle nu mrenyanu nzonlɛ na ɔnyɛ ye nwonane nu debie la. Sonla ɛhye nyia ye nganvolɛ fi Nyamenle ɛkɛ, ɔnnyia ye ɔnvi menli lɔ.

Title: WULO 3
Content:
1Asoo Dwuuma gyi boɛ tɛla bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la? Anzɛɛ nvasoɛ bie wɔ mrenyanu nzonlɛyɛlɛ zo ɔ? 2Nɔhalɛ bɔkɔɔ, wɔ adenle biala azo! Ɔboalekɛ alumua ne, bɛmɛ yɛɛ Nyamenle vale ye ngilehilelɛ ne wulale bɛ sa nu a. 3Na saa yera kɛ menli ne bie mɔ anli nɔhalɛ a, ɛnee ɔkile kɛ Nyamenle ɔdaye ɔnrɛli nɔhalɛ ɔ? 4 Kyɛkyɛ, ɔnle zɔhane fee. Saa menli ɛnli nɔhalɛ bɔbɔ a Nyamenle bahɔ zolɛ ali nɔhalɛ dahuu. Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se,
“Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛkile wɔ bɛmaa ɛka nɔhalɛ;
na bɛdi wɔ edwɛkɛ a wɔali benle.”
5Saa yɛ nyɛleɛ ɛtane ɛtane ne mɔ maa yɛnwu Nyamenle pɛlepɛlelilɛ ne wienyi a, ɛnee kɛ yɛse ɛ? Saa yɛyɛ ɛtane na Nyamenle tea yɛ a, ɛnee Nyamenle ɔdaye yeyɛ ɛtane ɔ? (Melɛtendɛ kɛ sonla ala la.) 6Ɔnle nɔhalɛ! Saa Nyamenle ɛnli pɛlepɛle a, ɛnee kɛ ɔkɛzi ɔkɛbua ewiade ndɛne ɛ?
7Saa me adalɛ mɔɔ mele la kile maa Nyamenle anyunlunyia ne nee ye nɔhalɛ ne da ali wienyi a, ɛnee duzu ati yɛɛ bɛbua me fɔlɛ kɛ mele ɛtanenli ɛ? 8Duzu ati yɛɛ bɛnga kɛ, “Bɛmaa yɛli ɛtane amaa kpalɛ ara ɛ?” Nɔhalɛ, ɛzonle mɔɔ menli ne bie mɔ ɛva ɛdo yɛ nwo zo la ɛne. Na bɛdabɛ bɛ munzule doa bɛ!
Sonla biala ɛnle tenlenenli
9Saa ye zɛhae a, ɛnee yɛdayɛ Dwuuma yɛgyi boɛ yɛtɛla bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la ɔ? Kyɛkyɛ, ɔnle zɔhane fee. Mehile nuhua dɛba kɛ Dwuuma nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la amuala zo ɛtane. 10 Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se,
“Awie biala ɛnle ɛkɛ mɔɔ le tenlenenli a,
Kyɛkyɛ ko bɔbɔ ɛnle ɛkɛ.
11Biala ɛnlɛ ndelebɛbo,
biala ɛmkpondɛ Nyamenle abo zo.
12Menli kɔsɔɔti ɛde Nyamenle anwo atua;
biala ɛvo, yɛɛ biala ɛnli boɛ,
kyɛkyɛ, ko bɔbɔ ɛnle ɛkɛ.
13 Bɛ nloa deda nwolɛ kɛ sɛka mɔɔ ɛbubu,
adalɛ yɛɛ vi bɛ nloa anu finde a.
Bɛ nloa edwɛkɛ yɛ nla tɛla ɛwɔlɛ gye.
14Amowa nee nzɛnvunli wɔ bɛ nloa anu.
15Bɛle ahɔdiawu,
16ɛleka biala mɔɔ bɛkɛhɔ la
bɛtwehwe amaneɛnwunlɛ nee nyanelilɛ bɛmaa.
17Bɛnze anzonudwolɛ adenle ne
18yɛɛ Nyamenle ɛzulolɛ biala ɛnle bɛ nu.”
19Mɔɔ yɛnwu ye la a le kɛ, debie biala mɔɔ wɔ mɛla ne anu la wɔ ɛkɛ ne maa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ mɛla ne abo la, amaa menli muala aha bɛ nloa ado nuhua kɛ bɛdi fɔlɛ wɔ Nyamenle ndɛnebualɛ ne anu. 20Ɔluakɛ awie biala mɔɔ di Mosisi mɛla ne azo la ɛngola ɛnzɔ Nyamenle anye. Mɛla ne gyima a le kɛ, ɔmaa sonla nwu ye ɛtane mɔɔ yeyɛ la.
Kɛ Nyamenle si maa menli sɔ ɔ nye la
21Kɛkala, adenle mɔɔ Nyamenle dua zo maa menli sɔ ɔ nye la ɛrala ɛkɛ wienyi, yɛɛ ɔnvane mɛla ne anwo hweledede. Mɛla mumua ne nee Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma di ɛhye anwo daselɛ. 22 Nyamenle dua menli diedi mɔɔ lɛ ye wɔ Gyisɛse Kelaese anu la azo a maa bɛsɔ ɔ nye a. Nyamenle yɛ ɛhye maa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdie Kelaese bɛdi la amuala, ɔboalekɛ ngakyile fee ɛnle nuhua; 23menli kɔsɔɔti ɛyɛ ɛtane na bɛnfɛta Nyamenle anyunlunyia ne. 24Ɔlua mgbɔdalɛ mɔɔ Gyisɛse Kelaese ɛva ɔ nwo ɛli la azo, Nyamenle ɛlolɛ ne mɔɔ ɔfa ɔkyɛ mgbane la maa menli muala sɔ ɔ nye. 25Nyamenle ɔdaye ɔvale Gyisɛse ɔmanle, amaa ɔlua ye ewule ne azo yeayɛ menli ɛtane nwo mgbɔdalɛ boane, wɔ bɛ diedi mɔɔ bɛkɛnyia ye wɔ ye nu la azo. Nyamenle yɛle ɛhye vale hilele ye tenleneyɛlɛ ne. Mɔmoane, ɔzile abotane na ɔbule ɔ nye ɔguale menli ɛtane zo; 26na kɛkala ɔ nee menli di wɔ bɛ ɛtane nwo, ɔfa ɔkile ye tenleneyɛlɛ ne. Nyamenle dua adenle ɛhye azo kile kɛ ɔle tenlenenli na ɔmaa awie biala mɔɔ die Gyisɛse di la sɔ ɔ nye.
27Ɛnee akee duzu a yɛfa yɛtu yɛ nwo a? Yɛnlɛ ɛhwee! Na ɛnee akee duzu ati ɔ? Ɛnee yɛ gyima kpalɛ nwo anzɛɛ? Kyɛkyɛ. Na yɛdie yɛdi la ati ɔ. 28Ɔluakɛ yɛnwu kɛ sonla mɔɔ die Nyamenle di la yɛɛ Nyamenle maa ɔsɔ ɔ nye a, na tɛ mɔɔ di mɛla ne azo la ɔ. 29Na Nyamenle le Dwuuma angome Nyamenle ɔ? Anzɛɛ ɔnle bɛdabɛ noko mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la Nyamenle ɔ? Kɛmɔti ɛ, ɔle bɛdabɛ noko bɛ Nyamenle! 30 Nyamenle le kokye yɛɛ ɔbalua diedi zo a yeamaa Dwuuma azɔ ɔ nye a; zɔhane ala yɛɛ ɔbalua bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la noko diedi zo yeamaa bɛazɔ ɔ nye a. 31Na ɛnee ɛhye kile kɛ yɛdua diedi zo yɛavuandi mɛla ne yɛagua ɔ? Kyɛkyɛ! Ɔnle zɔhane fee. Yɛdua yɛ diedi zo yɛkpogya mɛla ne zo.

Title: WULO 4
Content:
Ebileham ndonwo ne
1Ɛnee akee Ebileham, mɔɔ le azɛlɛ ye azo yɛ nlenya la, duzu a yɛka ye wɔ ɔ nwo a? Ye ɛbɛla ɛbɔlɛ ne a le boni? 2Saa ye nyɛleɛ a manle ɔzɔle Nyamenle anye a, anrɛɛ ɛnee ɔlɛ debie ɔfa ɔtu ɔ nwo wɔ nwolɛ. Noko ɔngola ɔndu ɔ nwo wɔ Nyamenle anyunlu. 3 Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se, “Ebileham liele Nyamenle lile, na ye diedi ne ati Nyamenle liele ye dole nu kɛ ɔle tenlenenli.” 4Sonla mɔɔ yɛ gyima la bɛtua ye nwolɛ kakɛ, ye ahatualɛ ne ɛnle ahyɛlɛdeɛ, ɔle debie mɔɔ yehwi ɔ ti anwo a yenyia ye a. 5Na mɔɔ ɛnyɛ gyima na ɔdie Nyamenle ne mɔɔ bua ɛtanevolɛma benle la di la, ye diedi zo yɛɛ Nyamenle nea na ɔmaa ɔsɔ ɔ nye a. 6Zɔhane ala yɛɛ Belemgbunli Devidi ka ye wɔ sonla ne mɔɔ saa ɛye ye gyimayɛlɛ ɛsie ahane a ɛnee Nyamenle die ye to nu kɛ ɔle tenlenenli la anwo a. Ɔse:
7 “Nyilalɛ ɛha bɛdabɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛva bɛ ɛtane ɛhyɛ bɛ
na yeheda bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ azo la!
8Nyilalɛ ɛha sonla ne mɔɔ
Awulae ɛmbu ye ɛtane nwo mgbonda la!”
9Anzɛɛ nyilalɛ ɛhye mɔɔ Devidi ka nwolɛ edwɛkɛ la wɔ ɛkɛ maa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛyɛ bɛ mrenyanu nzonlɛ la angome ɔ? Kyɛkyɛ. Ɔwɔ ɛkɛ ɔmaa bɛdabɛ noko mɔɔ bɛtɛyɛle bɛ mrenyanu nzonlɛ la. Ɔluakɛ Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se, “Ebileham liele Nyamenle lile, na ye diedi ti, Nyamenle liele ye dole nu kɛ ɔle tenlenenli.” 10Mekɛ boni anu a ɛhye zile a? Ɔzile na Ebileham ayɛ ye mrenyanu nzonlɛ anzɛɛ ɔyɛle ye mrenyanu nzonlɛ kolaa na yeazi? Ɔzile kolaa na yeayɛ. 11 Nzinlii a Ebileham manle bɛyɛle ye mrenyanu nzonlɛ, ɔvale ɔyɛle sɛkɛlɛneɛ anzɛɛ nzonlɛ mɔɔ kile kɛ Nyamenle ɛlua ye diedi zo ɛmaa yezɔ ɔ nye a. Yemɔti Sunsum nu a, ɛnee Ebileham le bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdie Nyamenle bɛdi na yelie bɛ kɛ bɛsɔ ɔ nye, noko bɛtɛyɛle bɛ mrenyanu nzonlɛ la bɛ ze. 12Eza ɔle bɛdabɛ noko mɔɔ bɛyɛ bɛ mrenyanu nzonlɛ, na tɛ kɛ asɛɛ bɛyɛ bɛ mrenyanu nzonlɛ la ati ɔ, na bɛva ɔ gyakɛ na bɛ diedi le kɛ ɔdaye Ebileham ɛdeɛ ne kolaa na yeayɛ ye mrenyanu nzonlɛ la bɛ ze.
Bɛdua diedi zo a bɛnyia Nyamenle ɛwɔkɛ ne a
13Nyamenle bɔle Ebileham ɛwɔkɛ kɛ azɛlɛ ne bayɛ ye nee ɔ bo zo amra ɛdeɛ. Nyamenle bɔle ɛwɔkɛ ɛhye, tɛ kɛ Ebileham lile mɛla ne azo la ati ɔ, na ɔliele Nyamenle ɔlile, na ɔlua zolɛ Nyamenle manle ɔzɔle ɔ nye. 14Ɔluakɛ saa Nyamenle ɛwɔkɛ ne mɔɔ fane agyalilɛ nwo la wɔ ɛkɛ maa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdi Mosisi mɛla ne azo la angome a, ɛnee noko sonla diedi mɔɔ wɔ Nyamenle anu la le mgbane, yɛɛ nvasoɛ biala ɛnle Nyamenle ɛwɔkɛ ne azo. 15Mɛla ne azo ɛlilɛ bɔbɔ, yɛka Nyamenle ɛya; na ɛleka noko mɔɔ mɛla ɛnle la, menli ɛndo mɛla.
16Ɛwɔkɛ ne gyi diedi zo, amaa yɛanyɛ Nyamenle ɛlolɛ ahyɛlɛdeɛ yeammaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdi Mosisi mɛla ne azo la angome, na yeayɛ ɛlolɛ mɔɔ ka Ebileham abo zo amra amuala mɔɔ lɛ diedi kɛ ɔdaye Ebileham la. Ɔluakɛ Ebileham le yɛ muala yɛ ze wɔ sunsum nu. 17Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se, “Meyɛ wɔ maanle maanle dɔɔnwo bɛ ze.” Nyamenle ɛhye mɔɔ Ebileham liele ye lile la a bɔle Ebileham ɛwɔkɛ ne a. Nyamenle ɛhye a maa mɔɔ ɛwu la dwazo ba ngoane nu na ɔ nloa edwɛkɛ maa mɔɔ ɛnle ɛkɛ la ba a. 18 Ebileham liele Nyamenle ɛwɔkɛ ne lile na ɔmanle ɔ nye lale zo ɛsesebɛ, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee anyelazo ɛwie la, kɛ ɔbayɛ “maanle maanle bɛ ze.” 19 Ɛnee yeli ɛvolɛ asɛɛ ɛya, noko ye diedi andɔ sinli, kɛmɔ ɔnea a ɛnee asɛɛ yewu, na ɔ ye Sɛla le mota la. 20Ye diedi ne anga aze wɔ Nyamenle ɛwɔkɛ ne anwo, na ye diedi ne manle ye anwosesebɛ na ɔyele Nyamenle ayɛlɛ. 21Ɔliele ɔlile bɔkɔɔ kɛ Nyamenle kola yɛ mɔɔ yeha la maa ɔbo zolɛ. 22Ɛhye ati yɛɛ Nyamenle luale ye diedi ne azo “liele ye kɛ ɔle tenlenenli” a. 23Edwɛkɛ agbɔkɛ “bɛliele ye kɛ ɔle tenlenenli” ne, bɛangɛlɛ bɛammaa ɔ ngome kye. 24Bɛhɛlɛle bɛmanle yɛdayɛ noko mɔɔ yɛdie mɔɔ dwazole yɛ Awulae Gyisɛse vile ewule nu la yɛdi la. 25 Bɛyele Gyisɛse bɛmanle ɔwule wɔ yɛ ɛtane ti na bɛdwazole ye bɛrale ngoane nu, amaa bɛalie yɛ kɛ yɛsɔ Nyamenle anye.

Title: WULO 5
Content:
Nyamenle anye ɛzɔlɛ
1Kɛmɔ ɔlua diedi zo yɛzɔ Nyamenle anye la, yɛlua Awulae Gyisɛse Kelaese anwo zo yɛnyia yɛ ti wɔ Nyamenle ɛkɛ.
2Gyisɛse lua yɛ diedi zo ɛva yɛ ɛra Nyamenle ɛlolɛ ne mɔɔ ɛnɛ yɛde nu la abo. Yemɔti yɛdi fɛlɛko anyelazo nu kɛ yɛbanyia Nyamenle anyunlunyia ne. 3Bɔbɔ wɔ amaneɛnwunlɛ nu yɛbali fɛlɛko, ɔboalekɛ yɛze kɛ nyanelilɛ maa sonla nyia abotane, 4abotanezilɛ wɔ amaneɛnwunlɛ nu maa sonla nyia subane kpalɛ mɔɔ gyi kpundii, yɛɛ subane kpalɛ zɛhae maa ye anyelazo. 5Anyelazo ɛhye ɛnye yɛ anrinli ɛndo yɛ sa nu, ɔluakɛ Nyamenle ɛlua Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne, mɔɔ le Nyamenle ahyɛlɛdeɛ ne azo ɛva ye ɛhulolɛ ɛyi yɛ ahonle ne mɔ tɛkɛɛ.
6Mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee moalɛ ɛwie bɔkɔɔ la, Kelaese wule manle bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnze Nyamenle la wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle ɔdaye ɔhyehyɛle la anu. 7Ɔyɛ se kɛ awie kɛwu kɛmaa tenlenenli. Ɔyɛ a bie kɛhulo kɛ ɔkɛwu ɔkɛmaa sonlakpalɛ bɔbɔ ɛdeɛ, 8noko Nyamenle ɛhile kɛ ɔsi ɔkulo yɛ la, na yemɔ a le kɛ, mɔɔ ɛnee yɛtɛda nwo yɛtɛde ɛtaneyɛlɛma la, Kelaese wule manle yɛ! 9Nyamenle ɛlua Kelaese ewule zo ɛmaa yɛzɔ ɔ nye; fane nyɛ yɛɛ akee ɔnrɛlua Kelaese anwo zo ɔnrɛlie yɛ ɔnrɛvi ye ɛya ne anu ɛ? 10Mɔɔ ɛnee yɛle Nyamenle kpɔvolɛma la, yelua ɔ Ra ne ewule zo ɔ nee yɛ ɛli ngamɔnu na yeyɛ yɛ ɔ gɔnwo mɔ a, ɛnee fane nyɛ yɛɛ akee ɔnrɛlua tease Kelaese ne ati ɔnrɛlie yɛ ngoane ɛ? 11Noko tɛ ɔ muala ɛ. Yɛdua Awulae Gyisɛse Kelaese anwo zo yɛdi fɛlɛko wɔ Nyamenle anu, ɔluakɛ yeyɛ yɛ Nyamenle agɔnwo mɔ.
Adam nee Kelaese
12 Yemɔti kɛmɔ ɛtane luale sonla ko anwo zo a rale ewiade, na sonla ko ne ɛtane ne vale ewule rale la, yɛɛ ewule dele kpondenle aleɛabo amra anwo zo a, ɔluakɛ menli kɔsɔɔti ɛyɛ ɛtane. 13Ɛtane rale ewiade kolaa na bɛava mɛla ne bɛamaa, yɛɛ mɔɔ ɛnee mɛla ɛnle ɛkɛ la, bɛmbu ɛtane nwo mgbonda bɛntia awie biala. 14Noko ɔvi Adam anwo zo toonwo mɔɔ radwule Mosisi anwo zo la, ewule nyianle sonla nwo zo tumi, bɔbɔ menli mɔɔ bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ ɛnle kɛ Adam mɛladonlɛ ɛdeɛ ne la.
Adam le sonla ko ne mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ ɔba la sɔhovolɛ. 15Noko bɛ mu nwiɔ bɛnle ko, ɔluakɛ Nyamenle ɛlolɛ ahyɛlɛdeɛ ne ɛnle kɛ Adam ɛtane ne la. Ɔle nɔhalɛ kɛ sonla ko ne ɛtane ti menli dɔɔnwo wule ɛdeɛ, noko Nyamenle ɛlolɛ ahyɛlɛdeɛ ne mɔɔ ɔlua sonla ko ne, mɔɔ le Gyisɛse Kelaese ɛlolɛ zo ɔfa ɔkyɛ mgbane la wɔ ɛkɛ maa menli somaa. 16Ngakyile wɔ Nyamenle ahyɛlɛdeɛ ne nee mɔɔ sonla ko ne ɛtane ne kola yɛ la anu. Ɔluakɛ sonla ko ne ɛtane ti yɛɛ Nyamenle buale sonla fɔlɛ a; na ɛtaneyɛlɛ somaa ne anzi, ye ɛlolɛ ahyɛlɛdeɛ ne ɛbua yɛ benle. 17Sonla ko ne, Adam ɛtane ti yɛɛ ɛtane luale ranyianle sonla nwo zo tumi a. Zɔhane ala yɛɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛbalua sonla ko ne, Gyisɛse Kelaese anwo zo bɛanyia ɛlolɛ ne molozo nee pɛlepɛlelilɛ ahyɛlɛdeɛ ne mɔɔ bɛfa bɛmaa mgbane la anwo bazo kpalɛ, na bɛalua ɔ nwo zo bɛali arelemgbunli wɔ bɛ ɛbɛlabɔlɛ nu a.
18Zɔhane ati, kɛmɔ sonla ko mɛladonlɛ hwenle menli kɔsɔɔti hɔle ewule nu la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ sonla ko tenleneyɛlɛ babua menli kɔsɔɔti benle na yeamaa bɛ ngoane a. 19Kɛmɔ sonla ko anzosesebɛ ti menli muala yɛle ɛtanevolɛma la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ ɔlua sonla ko anzomɛlɛkɛ zo menli somaa bazɔ Nyamenle anye a.
20Bɛvale mɛla ne bɛrale ala la yɛɛ mɛladonlɛ liele ebia a; noko ɛleka mɔɔ ɛtaneyɛlɛ ne zonle la, Nyamenle ɛlolɛ ne yɛle dɔɔnwo bole zolɛ. 21Zɔhane ati, kɛmɔ ɛtane vale ewule a lile belemgbunli la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ Nyamenle ɛlolɛ ne fa kpalɛyɛlɛ di belemgbunli na ɔfa yɛ ɔdua Gyisɛse Kelaese, yɛ Awulae ne anwo zo ɔkɔ ngoane mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ la anu a.

Title: WULO 6
Content:
Kelaese ati yɛlɛ ngoane
1Ɛnee akee kɛ yɛha yɛze ɛ? Yɛhɔ zo yɛyɛ ɛtane amaa Nyamenle ɛlolɛ ne azo ɔ? 2Kyɛkyɛ! Saa ɛtane maa yɛwu a, ɛnee kɛ yɛsi yɛtɛnla ɛtane nu bieko ɛ? 3Bɛdabɛ bɛze kɛ mɔɔ bɛzɔnenle yɛ bɛmanle Kelaese Gyisɛse la, ɛnee bɛzɔne yɛ bɛmaa ye ewule ne. 4 Zɔhane ati yɛlua ɛzɔnenlɛ ne azo bɛziele yɛ bɛbokale ɔ nwo wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɔwule la, amaa kɛmɔ Selɛ ne vale anyunlunyia tumi ne dwazole ye vile ewule nu la, yɛdayɛ noko yɛabɔ yɛ ɛbɛla ne fofolɛ.
5Ɔluakɛ saa yɛ nee Kelaese a hɔle ewule nu a, ɛnee bɛbadwazo yɛdayɛ noko bɛavi ewule nu bɛara ngoane nu, kɛmɔ bɛdwazole ye la. 6Yɛze kɛ yɛ su dɛba ne bɛhunle ye bɛbokale Kelaese anwo wɔ meanubaka ne azo, amaa bɛazɛkye yɛ su ɛtane ne tumi ne na yɛanyɛ ɛtane ngɛkɛlɛ bieko. 7Ɔluakɛ sonla wu a, ɛnee ɔnle ɛtane tumi bo bieko. 8Saa yɛ nee Kelaese ɛwu a, ɛnee yɛdie yɛdi kɛ yɛ nee ye badɛnla ngoane nu. 9Yɛze kɛ bɛdwazo Kelaese bɛvi ewule nu na ɔnrɛwu bieko; ewule ɛnlɛ ɔ nwo zo tumi bieko. 10Ye ewule ne mɔɔ ɔwule la, ɔwule kokye ala ɔyele ɔ nwo wɔ ɛtane asa anu, na ngoane nu mɔɔ kɛkala ɔde la, ɔde ɔmaa Nyamenle. 11Zɔhane ala yɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛdabɛ noko bɛdwenle bɛmaa bɛ nwo kɛ bɛwu bɛvi ɛtane tumi ne abo, na ɔlua Kelaese Gyisɛse ati bɛde aze bɛmaa Nyamenle.
12Zɔhane ati ɔnle kɛ ɛtane nyia bɛ nwo zo tumi bieko na ɔmaa bɛdi ye atiakunluwɔzo nzi. 13Eza ɔnle kɛ bɛtu bɛ sonlabaka ne ɛleka biala bɛmaa ɛtane kɛ bɛva bɛyɛ ninyɛndane biala. Bɛva bɛ nwo bɛmaa Nyamenle kɛ menli mɔɔ bɛye bɛ bɛvi ewule nu bɛra ngoane nu, na bɛdu bɛ nwo ɛleka biala bɛmaa Nyamenle kɛ ɔva ɔyɛ gyima mɔɔ sɔ ɔ nye la. 14Ɔluakɛ ɔnle kɛ ɛtane yɛ bɛ menle bieko; bɛnle mɛla ne abo, bɛwɔ Nyamenle ɛlolɛ ne abo.
Tenleneyɛlɛ nwo ngɛkɛlɛ
15Duzu bieko? Ɛnee kɛmɔ yɛwɔ Nyamenle ɛlolɛ ne abo na yɛnle mɛla ne abo la ati, ɔwɔ kɛ yɛkɔ zolɛ yɛyɛ ɛtane ɔ? Kyɛkyɛ, ɔnle zɔhane! 16Bɛdabɛ bɛze ye wienyi kɛ saa bɛbu bɛ nwo bɛmaa awie kɛ bɛsonle ye kɛ bɛle ahanra a, ɛnee bɛle ahanra bɛmaa ahenle ne mɔɔ bɛsonle ye la. Saa ɛtane a le bɛ menle a, bɛbanyia nwolɛ ewule, saa bɛtie Nyamenle noko a, bɛbalie bɛ bɛamaa bɛazɔ Nyamenle anye. 17Yɛyɛ Nyamenle mo, ɔluakɛ mekɛ bie, ɛnee bɛle ahanra bɛmaa ɛtane, na kɛmɔ bɛvale bɛ ahonle muala bɛyɛle tieyɛ bɛmanle nɔhalɛ ne mɔɔ bɛnwunle ye wɔ ngilehilelɛ mɔɔ bɛnyianle ye la anu la ati 18bɛliele bɛ bɛvile ɛtane nu na bɛrayɛle ahanra bɛmanle tenleneyɛlɛ. 19Bɛmaa menga edwɛkɛ ne sikalɛ mɔɔ bɛ adwenle so nu la. Kɛmɔ mekɛ bie bɛyɛle bɛ nwo ahanra bɛmanle ɛtane nee amumuyɛ na bɛyɛle ninyɛndane la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ kɛkala ɔwɔ kɛ bɛyɛ bɛ nwo ahanra bɔkɔɔ bɛmaa tenleneyɛlɛ a, amaa bɛ nwo ade nwuanzaanwu.
20Mekɛ mɔɔ bɛle ɛtane ahanra la, ɛnee bɛnle tenlenema. 21Na duzu nvasoɛ yɛɛ bɛnyianle ye wɔ ninyɛne mɔɔ bɛyɛle na ɛnɛ bɛse nwolɛ nyiane la anwo a? Nyɛleɛ ɛhendeɛ ne mɔ awieleɛ a le ewule! 22Na kɛkala, bɛye bɛ bɛvi ɛtane nu na bɛrayɛ Nyamenle ahanra, bɛ nvasoɛ a le bɛ ɛbɛla mɔɔ bɛte nwolɛ na bɛadu bɛ nwo bɔkɔɔ bɛamaa ye, na ɔlua zo bɛanyia ngoane mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ la. 23Ɔluakɛ ɛtane ahatualɛ a le ewule, na Nyamenle ahyɛlɛdeɛ ne mɔɔ ɔfa ɔmaa mgbane la a le ngoane mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ wɔ yɛ Awulae Kelaese Gyisɛse ati.

Title: WULO 7
Content:
Ndonwo
1Me mediema, melɛtendɛ meahile bɛ kɛ bɛle menli mɔɔ ze mɛla deɛ holɛ a. Se bɛze kɛ mɛla kyekye sonla wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɔde aze la? 2Bɛnlea kɛ, raalɛ mɔɔ wɔ agyalɛ la, mɛla kyekye ye beta ɔ hu anwo wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɔ hu de ngoane nu la; na saa ɔ hu wu a, mɛla ɛnkyekye ye bieko. 3Mekɛ mɔɔ ɔ hu de aze la saa ɔkɔ nrenya gyɛne nwo a, ɛnee yedo awuvolɛvalɛ mɛla ne; noko saa ɔ hu wu a, zɔhane mɛla ne ɛnkyekye ye bieko, yemɔti saa ɔkɔ agyalɛ fofolɛ a ɔndo awuvolɛvalɛ mɛla ne. 4Mediema, kɛ bɛ edwɛkɛ ne de la ɛne. Kɛmɔ ɔlua Kelaese anwo zo yɛwu la, Mosisi mɛla ne ɛnlɛ yɛ nwo zo tumi bieko, na yɛle Kelaese mɔɔ bɛdwazo ye bɛvi ewule nu la ɛdeɛ, amaa yɛ nwo ara nvasoɛ amaa Nyamenle. 5Ɔluakɛ mɔɔ ɛnee yɛde yɛmaa yɛ nwo la, yɛ atiakunluwɔzo ɛtane ne mɔ manle mɛla ne dwazole yɛle gyima wɔ yɛ nu, na ɔlua zolɛ yɛ nwo rale nvasoɛ manle ewule. 6Na kɛkala mɔɔ yɛnle mɛla ne tumi bo, na yɛwu yɛvi mɔɔ bɔle yɛ kpanwu la asa anu la, yɛnzonle kɛmɔ ɛnee yɛwɔ mɛla ne abo la. Yɛsonle wɔ adenle fofolɛ ne mɔɔ Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne kile la anu.
Mɛla nee ɛtane
7 Ɛnee kɛ yɛha yɛze ɛ? Kɛ mɛla ne le ɛtane ɔ? Kyɛkyɛ, ɔnle zɔhane. Mɛla ne a manle menwunle kɛ ɛtane si de la a. Saa mɛla ne anga kɛ “Mmayɛ anyebolo” a, anrɛɛ menze kɛ bɛsi bɛyɛ anyebolo la. 8Ɛtane nyianle adenle wɔ mɛla ne anu na ɔvale anyebolo ngakyile muala ɔluale ndenle ngakyile nu ɔwulale me nu. Ɛtane mumua ne, saa ɛye mɛla ne ɛsie ahane a, ɔle debie wulera. 9Mekɛ bie mɔɔ ɛnee menze mɛla deɛ holɛ la ɛnee melɛ ngoane, na mɔɔ mɛla rale la, ɛtane dwazole gyinlanle, 10na menwule. Na mɛla ko ne ala mɔɔ anrɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛlɛ me ngoane la, rayɛle ewule manle me. 11 Ɛtane nyianle adenle vale mɛla bɛlɛbɛlale me, na ɔluale zolɛ ɔhunle me.
12Zɔhane ati, Mosisi mɛla mumua ne le nwuanzanwuanza, yɛɛ ngyehyɛlɛ ne le nwuanzanwuanza, ɔle kpalɛ, ɔtenrɛ. 13Na ɛnee ɛhye kile kɛ debie kpalɛ a hunle me la ɔ? Kyɛkyɛ! Ɛtane a hunle me a. Ɔvale kpalɛ ɔlile ɔ nyunlu ɔhunle me, amaa ye su dɛba ne avinde kɛ ɔle ɛtane. Yemɔti, bɛlua mɛla ne azo bɛhile kɛ ɛtane le kakadane kpalɛ kpalɛ.
Sonla nu mgbeleralilɛ
14Yɛze kɛ mɛla ne le sunsum nu debie; mame, mele nwonane nu debie mɔɔ bɛdɔne me kɛ kanranli bɛmaa ɛtane a. 15 Debie mɔɔ meyɛ la mende ɔ bo, ɔluakɛ mɔɔ mekpondɛ kɛ meyɛ la, mengola menyɛ, na meyɛ deɛ ko ne ala mɔɔ mengulo kɛ meyɛ la. 16Na saa meyɛ mɔɔ ɔnle kɛ meyɛ la a, ɛnee ɔkile kɛ medie meto nu kɛ mɛla ne le kpalɛ. 17Yemɔti tɛ me nye fuu yɛɛ meyɛ a, na ɛtane ne mɔɔ de me nu la a maa meyɛ a. 18Meze kɛ kpalɛ biala ɛnle me sonlabaka ye anu. Ɔluakɛ me kunlu a anrɛɛ meyɛ kpalɛ, noko mengola menyɛ. 19Mengola menyɛ kpalɛ ne mɔɔ mekulo kɛ meyɛ la, na ɛtane ne mɔɔ mengulo kɛ meyɛ la yɛɛ meyɛ a. 20Na saa meyɛ mɔɔ mengulo kɛ meyɛ la a, ɛnee ɔkile kɛ tɛ me nye fuu ɔ, na ɛtane ne mɔɔ de me nu la ɔ.
21Yemɔti ɛnee menwu kɛ mɛla ɛhye ɛlɛyɛ gyima wɔ me nu. Mɔɔ mekulo kɛ meyɛ kpalɛ la, ɛnee ɛtane ala a gyi me nye zo a. 22Wɔ me nuhua a ɛnee me nye die Nyamenle mɛla ne anwo kpalɛ. 23Na menwu mɛla fofolɛ bie wɔ me sonlabaka ye nvɛyeba ne mɔ amuala anu. Mɛla ɛhye ko tia mɔɔ me adwenle kulo kɛ ɔyɛ la, na ɔmaa meyɛ kanranli memaa ɛtane mɛla ne mɔɔ ɛlɛdi gyima wɔ me sonlabaka ne anu la. 24Me nwo yɛ anwunvɔne kpole! Na nwane a kɛlie me kɛvi nwonane ɛhye asa nu, mɔɔ ɔ nee me ɛlɛkɔ ewule nu a? 25Melua yɛ Awulae Gyisɛse Kelaese anwo zo meyɛ Nyamenle mo.
Ɛhye yɛɛ megyi nwo a; mefa me adwenle muala medi Nyamenle mɛla ne azo mesonle ye, na me sonlabaka ye anu a, ɛnee meli ɛtane mɛla nzi.

Title: WULO 8
Content:
Sunsum nu ngoane
1Zɔhane ati bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ nee Kelaese Gyisɛse le ko la ɛnlɛ ndeanlɛ biala. 2Ɔluakɛ Sunsum ne mɛla ne mɔɔ Kelaese Gyisɛse ati ɔmaa yɛ ngoane la ɛye me ɛvi ɛtane nee ewule mɛla ne abo. 3Mɔɔ nwonane ne bɛtɛɛyɛlɛ ti mɛla ne angola anyɛ la, Nyamenle ɛyɛ. Yemɔ a le kɛ, ɔzoanle ɔdaye ɔ Ra ne ɔmanle ɔvale sonla nwonane ɛtane ɛhye bie ɔrale na ɔradeanle ɛtane ne mɔɔ de sonla nu la. 4Nyamenle yɛle ɛhye, amaa yɛdayɛ mɔɔ yɛde Nyamenle Sunsum ne anu na yɛnde nwonane nu la, mɛla ne ngyehyɛlɛ fɔɔnwo ne ali munli wɔ yɛ nu. 5Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛde nwonane nu la adwenle wɔ nwonane nu ninyɛne ɛyɛlɛ zo. Bɛdabɛ noko mɔɔ bɛtɛnla kɛmɔ Sunsum ne kile bɛ la adwenle wɔ Sunsum nu nyɛleɛ zo. 6Saa ɛmaa nwonane nu adwenleadwenle keda ɛ nwo zo a, ɔwie ewule; yɛɛ saa ɛmaa Sunsum nu adwenleadwenle keda ɛ nwo zo a, ɔwie ngoane nee anzonudwolɛ. 7Yemɔti mɔɔ maa nwonane nu adwenleadwenle keda ɔ nwo zo la le Nyamenle kpɔvolɛ; ɔluakɛ ɔnli Nyamenle mɛla ne azo, yɛɛ ɔdi zo bɔbɔ a ɔnrɛyɛ boɛ; 8ɔboalekɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdi bɛ sonlabaka ne atiakunluwɔzo nzi la ɛngola ɛnzɔ Nyamenle anye.
9Na bɛmɛ, bɛnde bɛmmaa bɛ sonlabaka ne, na saa Nyamenle Sunsum ne wɔ bɛ nu a, ɛnee noko bɛde bɛmaa Sunsum ne. Mɔɔ ɛnlɛ Kelaese Sunsum ne bie wɔ ye nu la ɛnle Kelaese ɛdeɛ. 10Na saa Kelaese de bɛ nu a, ɛnee saa ɛtane ti bɛwu nwonane nu bɔbɔ a, Sunsum ne anu bɛlɛ ngoane, ɔboalekɛ bɛlie bɛ bɛmaa bɛzɔ Nyamenle anye. 11 Na saa Nyamenle Sunsum ne, mɔɔ dwazole Gyisɛse vile ewule nu la de bɛ nu a, ɛnee noko mɔɔ dwazole Gyisɛse vile ewule nu la bamaa bɛdabɛ noko bɛ sonlabaka ye mɔɔ wu la ngoane wɔ ye Sunsum ne mɔɔ wɔ bɛ nu la ati.
12Zɔhane ati, me mediema, ɛzonle la yɛ nwo zo kɛ ɔnle kɛ yɛtɛnla yɛmaa yɛ sonlabaka ne. 13Ɔluakɛ saa bɛtɛnla bɛmaa bɛ sonlabaka ne a, bɛbawu; na saa bɛtɛnla bɛmaa Sunsum ne a, bɛbahu nyɛleɛ ɛtane ne mɔɔ wɔ bɛ nu la, na bɛanyia ngoane. 14Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle Sunsum ne yɛ bɛ tataa la le Nyamenle amra. 15 Ɔluakɛ Sunsum ne mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛva ɛmaa bɛ la ɛnyɛ bɛ ahanra, na ɔmmaa bɛnyɛ avoanvoanle. Sunsum ne maa bɛyɛ Nyamenle amra, na ɔlua Sunsum ne tumi zo yɛkola yɛfɛlɛ Nyamenle kɛ, “Egya! Me Papa.” 16Nyamenle Sunsum ne nee yɛ ɛdeɛ ne bɔ nu maa yɛkola yɛka kɛ yɛle Nyamenle amra. 17Na saa yɛle ɔ mra a, ɛnee yɛdi agya, yɛɛ ye ɛlolɛ ne mɔɔ yeva yezie ɛkɛ yemaa ɔ mra la yɛbanyia bie, na yɛ nee Kelaese ava mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛva ɛzie ɛkɛ ɛmaa ye la, ɔluakɛ saa yɛ nee Kelaese di nyane a yɛ nee ye kɛnyia ye anyunlunyia ne.
Kenlebie anyunlunyia
18Menea a amaneɛ mɔɔ yɛlɛnwu ye ɛke la kpole ɛnrɛdo kenlebie anyunlunyia mɔɔ yɛbanyia ye la. 19Abɔdeɛ muala ɛlɛkendɛ anwolɔlɛ kpole nu kɛ Nyamenle kɛye ɔ mra kɛhile. 20Ɔluakɛ abɔdeɛ muala mgbane mɔɔ ɛyɛ la, tɛ ɔdaye ye ɛhulolɛ zo ɔ, na Nyamenle ngyehyɛlɛ ɔ. Noko anyelazo ɛhye wɔ ɛkɛ ne kɛ 21kenle ko dedee bɛbaye abɔdeɛ muala bɛavi ɛkpɔlɔlɛ akɛlɛzonlenlɛ nu na yeanyia anyunlunyia fanwodi ne mɔɔ Nyamenle amra lɛ ye la. 22Ɔluakɛ yɛze kɛ toonwo mɔɔ yeradwu ɛnɛ la abɔdeɛ muala ɛlɛte nyane kɛ asɛɛ yevo awolɛ zo. 23 Na tɛ abɔdeɛ ngome; yɛdayɛ noko mɔɔ yɛnyia Sunsum ne kɛ Nyamenle ahyɛlɛdeɛ mɔɔ lumua la, yɛte nyane wɔ yɛ nu, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ yɛlɛkendɛ Nyamenle kɛ ɔkɛyɛ yɛ ɔ mra na ɔkɛlie yɛ sonlabaka ne la. 24Anyelazo ɛhye azo yɛɛ ɔlua mɔɔ bɛlie yɛ ngoane a. Na yemɔ a le kɛ, awie ɛmmaa ɔ nye ɛnla debie mɔɔ ɔ nye gyi nwolɛ la azo. Na nwane bɔbɔ yɛɛ kɛmaa ɔ nye kɛla debie mɔɔ ɔ nye gyi nwolɛ la azo a? 25Saa yɛmaa yɛ nye da debie mɔɔ yɛ nye ɛngyi nwolɛ la azo a, yɛɛ yɛfa abotane yɛkendɛ ye ɛnyianlɛ a.
26Zɔhane ala yɛɛ kɛmɔ yɛnlɛ anwosesebɛ la, Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne baboa yɛ a. Ɔluakɛ yɛnze nzɛlɛlɛ yɛ, kɛmɔ ɔwɔ kɛ yɛyɛ la. Sunsum ne ɔdaye a ɔsɛlɛ Nyamenle ɔmaa yɛ wɔ nyanedelɛ nee ɛkponlenlɛ mɔɔ ɛnloanlɛ ɛnrɛhola ye ka la anu a. 27Nyamenle mɔɔ neɛnlea menli kɔsɔɔti ahonle nu la ze sunsum nu adwenleadwenle biala kɛ si de la, ɔluakɛ Sunsum ne kpa ye menli ti kyɛlɛ, ɔsɛlɛ, kɛmɔ Nyamenle ɛhulolɛdeɛ ne de la.
28Yɛze kɛ wɔ debie biala anu, Nyamenle maa debie biala yɛ kpalɛ maa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkulo ye la, meka bɛdabɛ mɔɔ yevɛlɛ bɛ, kɛmɔ ye ngyehyɛlɛ ne de la. 29Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛkpa nu ɛye bɛ la, yeva bɛ yezie ahane kɛ bɛbayɛ kɛ ɔ Ra ne la, amaa Ralɛ ne ayɛ mediema dɔɔnwo adiema kpanyinli. 30Yemɔti bɛdabɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛkpa nu ɛye bɛ la yɛɛ ɔfɛlɛ bɛ na ɔdielie bɛ ɔmaa bɛsɔ ɔ nye, na ɔ nee bɛ tɛnla anyunlunyia nu a.
Nyamenle ɛhulolɛ wɔ Kelaese Gyisɛse ati
31Saa ɔle zɛhae ɛdeɛ a, ɛnee akee kɛ yɛzi yɛha ye ɛ? Saa Nyamenle gyi yɛ nzi a nwane a kɛhola yɛ a? 32Nea, yeanva ɔ Ra ne yeanyɛ yɛ abokɛ na yeva ye yebɔ azu wɔ yɛ muala yɛ ti! Na saa yeva ɔ Ra ne yemaa wɔ yɛ ti a, ɛnee fane nyɛ yɛɛ akee ɔnrɛva ninyɛne muala ɔnrɛboka ɔ Ra ne anwo ɔnrɛmaa yɛ a? 33Nwane a kɛhola kɛdo Nyamenle menli ne mɔɔ yekpa nu yeye bɛ la ɛzonle a? Nyamenle ɔdaye yebua bɛ benle! 34Nwane a kɛhola kɛbua bɛ fɔlɛ a? Asoo Kelaese Gyisɛse, mɔɔ wule, na bɛdwazole ye bɛrale ngoane nu, na ɔde Nyamenle asa fema zo ɛlɛsɛlɛ Nyamenle amaa yɛ la ɔ? 35Nwane a kɛhola kɛhwe yɛ kɛvi Kelaese ɛhulolɛ ne anwo a? Amaneɛnwunlɛ anzɛɛ anwongyelelɛ, kpɔdekpɔdeyɛlɛ anzɛɛ ɛhɔne, ehyia, anwubɛnyunlu anzɛɛ ewule? 36 Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se,
“Bɛdabɛ bɛ ti yɛgyi ewule avinli
alehyenlɛ muala;
na bɛyɛ yɛ kɛ mboane mɔɔ
bɛ nee bɛ ɛlɛkɔ ahunleɛ.”
37Kyɛkyɛ, wɔ ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ kɔsɔɔti anu, yɛlua mɔɔ hulole yɛ la anwo zo yɛdi konim! 38Ɔluakɛ meze ye wienyi kɛ debie biala ɛnrɛhola ɛnrɛkpɔkye yɛ ɛnrɛvi Kelaese ɛhulolɛ ne anwo; ewule o, ngoane o, Nyamenle soanvolɛma o, anzɛɛ awozinli nu tumivolɛma biala, wɔ ɛnɛ edwɛkɛ mɔɔ bazi anzɛɛ kenlebie ɛdeɛ mɔɔ bara la anu, 39yɛɛ tumi anzɛɛ debie biala ɛnle ewiade ye anu, anwuma anzɛɛ azɛlɛ ti anu, anzɛɛ ewiade ye anu debie biala ɛnle ɛkɛ mɔɔ kɛhola kɛkpɔkye yɛ kɛvi Nyamenle ɛhulolɛ ne mɔɔ ɔlua yɛ Awulae Kelaese Gyisɛse anwo zo yɛnyia ye la anwo.

Title: WULO 9
Content:
Nyamenle nee ye menli
1Kelaese ati nɔhalɛ kpalɛ a melɛka meahile bɛ la, membɔ adalɛ. Me adwenle nu wienyi, Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne ɔdaye ɔze kɛ membɔ adalɛ, 2yɛɛ ɔze nyane mɔɔ melɛdi wɔ me ahonle nu 3meamaa medame me mbusuafo Dwuuma la. Bɛ ti me kunlu a anrɛɛ Nyamenle ɛdua me kakɛ na yekpɔkye me yevi Kelaese anwo. 4 Bɛle Yizilayɛma mɔɔ le Nyamenle ɔdaye ye menli mɔɔ yeyɛ bɛ ɔ mra, yeye ye anyunlunyia yehile bɛ, ɔ nee bɛ ɛyɛ ngyekyeleɛ, na yeva ye mɛla yemaa bɛ a; bɛlɛ nɔhalɛ ɛzonlenlɛ kpalɛ ne; bɛnyia Nyamenle ɛwɔkɛ ne. 5Bɛ bo vi Hibulu abusua mgbole ne mɔ anu, yɛɛ Kelaese ne bayɛ sonla la, ɔvi bɛ nu. Ayɛlɛyelɛ ɛha Nyamenle mɔɔ di ɔ muala azo belemgbunli la dahuu. Amen.
6Na menga kɛ Nyamenle ɛwɔkɛ ne ɛkpo aze, ɔboalekɛ tɛ Yizilayɛma amuala a Nyamenle kpale nu yele bɛ kɛ bɛle ye menli a; 7 yɛɛ tɛ bɛmɛ mɔɔ bɛle Ebileham nlɔnra la amuala a le Nyamenle amra a. Nyamenle zele Ebileham kɛ, “Ɔlua Ayezeke anwo zo a ɛbanyia nlɔnra dɔɔnwo a.” 8Ɛhye kile kɛ tɛ ngakula mɔɔ bɛwo bɛ wɔ nwonane nu ngyehyɛlɛ zo la amuala a le Nyamenle amra a, na ngakula mɔɔ ɔlua Nyamenle ɛwɔkɛ ne ati bɛwole bɛ la a le bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛfa bɛ kɛ bɛle nlɔnra kpalɛ kpalɛ ne a. 9 Ɔluakɛ Nyamenle ɛwɔkɛ ne kɛ ɔbɔle ye la ɛne, “Saa mekɛ ne dwu a mebazia meara na Sɛla bawo ralɛ nrenya.”
10Tɛ ɔ muala noko ɛne. Ɔluakɛ Relebɛka amra mrenya nwiɔ ne bɛ ze a le yɛ nlenya Ayezeke. 11-12 Na amaa bɛ nuhua ko ɛvɛlɛlɛ ɛdeɛ ne ali munli, kɛmɔ Nyamenle hyehyɛle la, Nyamenle zele Relebɛka kɛ, “Kpanyinli ne bazonle kakula ne.” Ɔhanle ɛhye kolaa na bɛawo bɛ, na bɛanwu kpalɛ anzɛɛ ɛtane; ɛhye kile kɛ Nyamenle ɛvɛlɛlɛ ne gyi ye ɛhulolɛdeɛ zo na tɛ nyɛleɛ biala mɔɔ bɛyɛle la ati ɔ. 13 Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se, “Mengulole Gyekɔbo, na memkpɔle Yisɔ.”
14Ɛnee kɛ yɛka yɛse ɛ? Yɛha ye kɛ ɛhye ati, ɛnee Nyamenle le amile ɔ? Kyɛkyɛ, ɔnle zɔhane fee. 15 Ɔluakɛ ɔhanle ɔhilele Mosisi kɛ, “Mɔɔ mekulo kɛ mese ye anwunvɔne la yɛɛ mebaze ye anwunvɔne a, yɛɛ mɔɔ mekulo kɛ medi ɔ nwo nyane la, mebali ɔ nwo nyane.” 16Yemɔti, Nyamenle anwunvɔnezelɛ ne ɛngyi mɔɔ sonla kpondɛ la, anzɛɛ mɔɔ ɔkɛyele ɔ nwo kɛ ɔyɛ la azo. 17 Ɔluakɛ Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne zele Yigyibiti belemgbunli kɛ, “Menyɛle wɔ belemgbunli kɛ mefa wɔ meahile me tumi mɔɔ melɛ ye, na meamaa me duma adɛlɛ azɛlɛ ye azo amuala.” 18Yemɔti, Nyamenle ɔdaye ye ɛhulolɛdeɛ zo ɔse bie anwunvɔne yɛɛ ɔmaa bie noko yɛ anzosesebɛ.
Nyamenle ɛya nee ye anwunvɔnezelɛ
19Bie babiza me kɛ, “Saa ɔle zɛhae a, ɛnee kɛ ɔyɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle tɛnwu nvonleɛ wɔ sonla nwo ɛ? Nwane yɛɛ kɛhola kɛzi Nyamenle ɛhulolɛdeɛ ne aze a?” 20 Na ayi, ɛdawɔ bɔbɔ a le nwane na wɔayeye Nyamenle anloa azo? Buakɛ ɛngola ɛmbiza mɔɔ nwonle ye la kɛ, “Duzu ati a ɛnwonle me zɛhae ɛ?” 21Mɔɔ nwo buakɛ la lɛ adenle fa ndɛtɛlɛ ne yɛ debie biala mɔɔ ɔdaye ɔkulo la, ɔkola ɔfa ndɛtɛlɛ ɛdɔkɛ ko ne ala ɔnwo mbuakɛ nwiɔ, ɔfa ko ɔyɛ ye debie mɔɔ le kɛnlɛma na ɔhyia ye la, na ɔfa ko ne noko ɔyɛ debie mɔɔ ɛnle kɛnlɛma na ɔ nwo ɛngyia kpalɛ biala la.
22Zɔhane ala yɛɛ Nyamenle ɛyɛ a. Ɔkpondɛ kɛ ye ɛya ne nee ye tumi ne da ali wienyi. Yemɔti ɔsi abotane kpole kpalɛ ɔnea bɛdabɛ mɔɔ ye ɛya ne wɔ bɛ nwo zo na ɔbazɛkye bɛ la. 23Eza noko ɔkulo kɛ ye anyunlunyia ne da ɛkɛ, na ɔwola ɔgua yɛdayɛ mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ ɔnwu yɛ anwunvɔne, na yeziezie yɛ kɛ yɛnyia ye anyunlunyia ne la anwo zo. 24Ɔluakɛ yɛmɛ yɛɛ yevɛlɛ yɛ yevi Dwuuma nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la avinli a. 25 Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ bɛhɛlɛ ye wɔ Hozia buluku ne anu la se:
“Menli ne mɔɔ anrɛɛ ɛnle me menli la,
mebavɛlɛ bɛ ‘Me menli’.
Maanle ne mɔɔ meangulo ye la
mebavɛlɛ ye ‘Me ɛhulolɛ maanle’.
26 Na ɛleka mɔɔ bɛwɔ a bɛzele bɛ kɛ,
‘Bɛnle me menli’ la,
ɛkɛ ne ko ne ala yɛɛ bɛbavɛlɛ bɛ
tease Nyamenle ne amra a.”
27 Ayezaya hanle ye wɔ Yizilayɛma anwo kɛ, “Saa Yizilayɛma zonle kɛ ɛnweazo anwea bɔbɔ a, ekyi bie yɛɛ bɛbalie bɛ ngoane a, 28ɔluakɛ Awulae babu ɔdaye nee ewiade ye bɛ avinli mgbonda ne fenlefenle ndɛndɛ.” 29 Ayezaya hanle dole ɛkɛ ne bieko kɛ, “Saa Tumivolɛ Awulae angyakyi menli wɔ yɛ nzi a, yɛbayɛ kɛ Sodɔm nee Gomɔla la.”
Pɔɔlo sɛlɛ amaa Yizilayɛma
30Ɛnee akee kɛ yɛha yɛze ɛ? Yɛka ɛhye, kɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma, na bɛandwenle nwolɛ ɛlɛ kɛ bɛkɛzɔ Nyamenle anye la, ɛlua diedi zo ɛzɔ ɔ nye. 31Na Yizilayɛma mɔɔ ɛlɛkpondɛ mɛla mɔɔ kɛva bɛ kɛbikye Nyamenle la, annwu ye wɔ mɛla ne azolilɛ nu. 32Duzu ati ɔ? Ɔboalekɛ mɔɔ bɛyɛle la ɛngyi diedi zo, bɛyɛle ye kɛ asɛɛ ɔgyi nyɛleɛ zo la. Ɛhye ati bɛdu koti. 33Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se,
“Nea, melɛfa bolɛ meado Zayɔn
mɔɔ bamaa menli akpulokpula a,
ɔbayɛ bodane mɔɔ bamaa bɛadu bɛagua a.
Na mɔɔ kɛlie ye kɛli la arɛle ɛnrɛbɔ.”

Title: WULO 10
Content:
1Me mediema, me kunlu a anrɛɛ bɛlie me menli ne kɔsɔɔti ngoane. Na ɛhye ati mefa me ahonle muala mesɛlɛ Nyamenle wɔ nwolɛ dahuu. 2Mekola medi daselɛ kɛ me menli ne lɛ Nyamenle anwo ɛhulolɛ kpole kpalɛ; noko bɛ ɛhulolɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛ ye wɔ Nyamenle anwo la ɛngyi nɔhalɛ ndelebɛbo kpalɛ zo. 3Ɔluakɛ bɛgyakyi fɔɔnwoyɛlɛ adenle ne mɔɔ Nyamenle dua zolɛ maa menli sɔ ɔ nye la, na bɛpele bɛva bɛ ngome bɛ fɔɔnwoyɛlɛ adenle ɛdeɛ zo; bɛanva nɔhalɛ fɔɔnwoyɛlɛ adenle ne mɔɔ Nyamenle dua zolɛ maa menli sɔ ɔ nye la azo. 4Ɔluakɛ Kelaese rale la yɛɛ mɛla ne tumi bɔle aze a, amaa mɔɔ kɛlie kɛli la azɔ Nyamenle anye.
Ngoanelielɛ wɔ ɛkɛ maa awie biala
5 Wɔ mɛla ne azolilɛ nu, Mosisi hanle kɛ sonla mɔɔ kɛyɛ mɔɔ mɛla ne kpondɛ la balua zolɛ anyia ngoane. 6 Na bɛdabɛ mɔɔ ɔlua diedi zo bɛsɔ Nyamenle anye la, kɛ Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se la ɛne, “Ɔnle kɛ ɛka ɛkile ɛ nwo kɛ, ‘Nwane bɔbɔ a kɛhɔ nyamenlezo a?’ ” (Kɛ ɔkava Kelaese yeadwu aze.) 7“Anzɛɛ ɔnle kɛ ɛbiza kɛ, ‘Nwane a kɛdwu kɛhɔ ɛbolɔ maanle nu a?’ ” (Kɛ ɔkava Kelaese yeavi mɔwuamra anu yeara.) 8Mɔɔ ɔka la a le ɛhye, “Nyamenle edwɛkɛ ne ɛbikye bɛ, ɔla bɛ nloa na ɔwɔ bɛ ahonle nu,” na yemɔ a le diedi nwo edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ yɛbɔ ye nolo yɛkile bɛ la. 9Ɔboalekɛ, saa bɛdie bɛto nu na bɛka ye bɛ nloa kɛ, “Gyisɛse le Awulae” na bɛdie bɛdi wɔ bɛ ahonle nu kɛ Nyamenle dwazole ye vile mɔwuamra anu a, bɛbanyia ngoane. 10Ɔluakɛ saa sonla fa ye ahonle die di a yɛɛ ɔka ye diedi ne ɔ nloa na ɔnyia ngoane a. 11 Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se, “Awie biala mɔɔ kɛlie ye kɛli la anyunlu ɛnrɛgua aze.” 12Awie biala boka ɛhye anwo, ɔboalekɛ ngakyile biala ɛnle Dwuuma nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la avinli. Nyamenle le bɛ kɔsɔɔti bɛ Awulae ko ne ala, na ɔyila bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsu bɛfɛlɛ ye la. 13 Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se, “Awie biala mɔɔ kɛbɔ Awulae duma kɛzu kɛvɛlɛ ye la kɛnyia ngoane.”
14Na kɛ menli kɛyɛ na bɛazu bɛavɛlɛ ye wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛnlie ye bɛnli la ɛ? Na kɛ ɔkɛyɛ na bɛalie mɔɔ bɛtɛtele ɔ nwo edwɛkɛ ɛlɛ la bɛali ɛ? Saa bɛannyia mɔɔ ka maa bɛtie noko la a, kɛ ɔkɛyɛ na bɛade ɛ? 15 Na kɛ ɔkɛyɛ na bɛabɔ nolo ne wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛtɛsoanle menli kɛ bɛhɔbɔ nolo la ɛ? Mɔɔ Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne ka ye wɔ nwolɛ la ɛne, “Soanvolɛma ne mɔɔ fa edwɛkɛ kpalɛ ne ara la ɛralɛ nu le kɛnlɛma na ɔyɛ nwanwane!” 16 Noko tɛ bɛ muala a bɛlie Edwɛkpa ne bɛli a, ɔluakɛ Ayezaya hanle ye bɛ nwo kɛ, “Awulae, edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ bɛdele bɛvile yɛ ɛkɛ ne la, nwane a liele lile a?” 17Yemɔti, saa yɛte edwɛkɛ ne a yɛɛ yɛnyia diedi a, yɛɛ edwɛkɛ ne a le Kelaese ne anwo Edwɛkpa ne nolobɔlɛ ne.
18 Na mebiza kɛ, asoo ɔle nɔhalɛ kɛ bɛtɛtele Edwɛkpa ne? Bɛde ye bɔkɔɔ, ɔluakɛ Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se,
“Bɛ ne ɛdwu ewiade muleɛ muala azo;
bɛ edwɛkɛ ɛdwu azɛlɛ ye kodoka biala anu.”
19 Eza mebiza bieko kɛ, ɛnee Yizilayɛma ande ɔ bo ɔ? Dumua tie mɔɔ Mosisi hanle la; ɔse,
“Mebamaa bɛ nye abolo menli bie mɔɔ ɛnfɛta
maanle bɔbɔ la;
na mebalua kɔnwɔnema bie maanle zo meamaa
bɛava ɛya.”
20 Ayezaya noko si ɔ kɛnra ka kɛ,
“Menli mɔɔ ɛnee ɛmkpondɛ me la ɛnwu me;
meye me nwo mehile menli mɔɔ ɛmbiza me bo zo la.”
21 Noko mɔɔ fane Yizilayɛma anwo la Ayezaya hanle kɛ, “Mendenrɛle me sa alehyenlɛ muala kɛ medie menli ne mɔɔ ɛde atua na bɛ nzo yɛ se la, na ɔyɛle mgbane.”

Title: WULO 11
Content:
Nyamenle anwunvɔnezelɛ wɔ Yizilayɛma anwo zo
1 Ɛnee akee mebiza kɛ, se ɛnee Nyamenle ɛkpo ye menli ne o? Ɔnle zɔhane fee! Medame, mele Yizilayɛnli, Ebileham anlɔnra mɔɔ vi Bɛngyaman abusua nu. 2Nyamenle ɛtɛkpole ye menli ne mɔɔ mɔlebɛbo ne amuala ɔkpale nu ɔyele bɛ la. Se bɛze Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne ɛleka mɔɔ kile kɛ ɛnee Yelaegya ɛlɛsɛlɛ Nyamenle atia Yizilayɛma la? 3 Ɔse, “Awulae, bɛhu wɔ kpɔmanvolɛma ne mɔ amuala, na bɛbubu wɔ azukponle ne mɔ amuala; me ngomekye ala yɛɛ meha a, yɛɛ bɛ nye ɛbolo noko kɛ bɛkpondɛ me bɛahu me.” 4 Duzu mualɛ a Nyamenle vale manle ye a? Ɔse, “Meva menli apenle nsuu mɔɔ ɛtɛbule ndwɛlɛ wɔ bozonle Beeyale anyunlu ɛlɛ la mezie ɛkɛ memaa me nwo.” 5Zɔhane ala yɛɛ kɛkala noko ɔde a; ye ɛlolɛ ne ati, Nyamenle ɛkpa nu ɛye menli ekyi bie ɛzie ɛkɛ. 6Saa ɛlolɛ zo ala yɛɛ ɔlua a, ɛnee tɛ nyɛleɛ ti ɔ. Ɔluakɛ saa Nyamenle kpa nu aye sonla amaa ɔ nwo wɔ ahenle ne mɔdenlebɔ ti a, ɛnee Nyamenle ɛlolɛ ne ɛnle ɛlolɛ.
7Duzu bieko? Yizilayɛma annyia mɔɔ bɛkpondɛ la. Menli ekyi bie mɔɔ Nyamenle kpale nu yele bɛ la a nyianle ye a. Mɔɔ hale la yɛle anzosesebɛ. 8 Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se, “Nyamenle manle bɛsolole ɔmanle ɛnɛ nee ɛnɛ ala bɛ nye ɛnnwu debie, yɛɛ bɛ nzo ɛnde edwɛkɛ.” 9 Devidi noko hanle kɛ,
“Bɛ ɛkponledolɛ kɛbɔ bɛ ti tɔɔ,
ɔkɛyɛ kuma nee ndeanlɛ ɔkɛmaa bɛ.
10Bɛ nye kɛzi amaa bɛannwu debie,
bɛkɛnwu bɛ nyunlu dahuu.”
11Ɛnee akee mebiza kɛ, mɔɔ Dwuuma dule koti la, se ɛnee bɛminli bɔkɔɔ? Ɔnle zɔ. Ɔlua bɛ ɛtane ti, ngoanelielɛ vi bɛ ɛkɛ ɛhɔ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la ɛkɛ, amaa Dwuuma anye abolo bɛ. 12Dwuuma ɛtane mɔɔ ɛyɛ la ɛva nyilalɛ dɔɔnwo ɛra ewiade, na bɛ sunsum nu ehyia ɛlilɛ ɛva nyilalɛ ɛrɛlɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la. Yemɔti saa Dwuuma amuala baraboka nwo a anrɛɛ nyilalɛ ne bayɛ kpole kpalɛ!
Menli mɔɔ ɛnle Dwuuma la ngoanelielɛ
13Akee metendɛ meahile bɛmɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la, kɛ suzuamgba ala mɔɔ mele ɛzoanvolɛ memaa bɛ la, me nye die me gyima nwo kpalɛ, 14amaa meawula me gɔnwo mɔ Dwuuma anyebolo, na ɔlua zo bɛalie bie mɔ ngoane. 15Ɔluakɛ bɛkpole bɛ la ati dasanli rayɛle Nyamenle agɔnwo, na saa akee bɛdie bɛ bɛto nu a bɛ fɛlɛkolilɛ bayɛ kɛ asɛɛ bɛvi ewule nu bɛdwazo bɛra ngoane nu la. 16Saa bɛfa alumua kpanwo ebule ekyi ne bɛmaa Nyamenle a, ɛnee noko kpanwo kunguma ko ne amuala le ye ɛdeɛ; yɛɛ saa baka bie ndinli anwo te na bɛfa bɛbɔ azu bɛmaa Nyamenle a ɔyɛ boɛ a, ɛnee ye ngane ne mɔ amuala noko anwo te. 17Kɛkala ɛdeɛ Dwuuma le kɛ baka belɛ mɔɔ bɛpepɛ ye ngane ne mɔ bie bɛgua na bɛva bɛmɛ mɔɔ bɛle kɛ baka nyinli la ngane bɛrasisa zolɛ, kɛ bɛnyia nyilalɛ ne mɔɔ vi baka ne anu ba la bie. 18Yemɔti, ɔnle kɛ bɛtu bɛ nwo bɛkile bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛpɛ bɛ bɛgua kɛ baka ngane la. Duzu ati a bɛmemaa bɛ nwo zo ɛ? Bɛle ngane ala; tɛ bɛmɛ a bɛsɔ ndinli ne a, ndinli ne a sɔ bɛ a.
19Ɛbaha kɛ, “Ɛhɛe, noko bɛpepɛle ngane zɔhane mɔ bɛguale na bɛvale yɛ bɛsisiale zolɛ.” 20Ɔle nɔhalɛ bɔkɔɔ. Bɛpepɛle bɛ bɛguale, ɔluakɛ bɛanlie bɛanli, na bɛmɛ bɛlie bɛli yemɔti bɛgyi ye kpundii. Noko akee bɛmmafa bɛtu bɛ nwo; anrɛɛ bɛzulo Nyamenle. 21Ɔluakɛ saa Nyamenle anvavi Dwuuma ne mɔɔ le kɛ baka ne ɔdaye ye ngane ne mɔ la a, ɛnee ɔnrɛvavi bɛdabɛ noko. 22Ɛhye maa yɛnwu kɛ Nyamenle si se anwunvɔne na eza ɔ sa yɛ ɛnlomboɛ la. Ɔ sa yɛ ɛnlomboɛ maa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkpo aze la, noko saa bɛtɛnla ye kpalɛyɛlɛ ne abo dahuu a, anrɛɛ ɔkɛze bɛ anwunvɔne. Na saa bɛanyɛ ye zɔhane a ɔbakpanekpane bɛdabɛ noko yeagua. 23Saa Dwuuma gyakyi bɛ anzosesebɛyɛlɛ ne, na bɛdie bɛdi a bɛbava bɛ bɛazia bɛarazie bɛ bo zo ne, ɔluakɛ Nyamenle lɛ tumi, ɔkola ɔyɛ ye zɔhane bieko. 24Bɛmɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la, bɛle kɛ ɛhoayelɛ nu baka nyinli ngane mɔɔ bɛpepɛ bɛ na bɛva bɛ bɛsisia egyinli nu baka belɛ zo la. Dwuuma le kɛ egyinli nu baka belɛ; yemɔti ɔnyɛ se ɔmmaa Nyamenle kɛ ɔkɛva ngane ne mɔ mɔɔ yepepɛ yevi ɛkɛ ne la ɔkɛziezie bɛ bo zo ne mɔ.
Nyamenle se awie biala anwunvɔne
25Me mediema, nɔhalɛ bie vea ɛkɛ mɔɔ mekulo kɛ bɛnwu ye a, amaa bɛagyakyi kɛ bɛkɛdwenle kɛ asɛɛ bɛze nrɛlɛbɛ somaa. Yemɔ a le kɛ Yizilayɛma anzosesebɛ ne ɛnrɛhɔ zolɛ dahuu; saa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la dodo mɔɔ ba Nyamenle ɛkɛ ne la nyia ba a, anzosesebɛ ne babɔ aze. 26 Na ɛhye bamaa Yizilayɛma amuala anyia ngoane, kɛmɔ Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se la. Ɔse,
“Ngoanedievolɛ ne vi Zayɔn bara,
na yearaye amumuyɛ muala yeavi
Gyekɔbo nlɔnra ne mɔ anu.
27 Ngyekyeleɛ ɛhye a saa mefa bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ mekyɛ bɛ a
me nee bɛ bayɛ a.”
28Dwuuma kpole Edwɛkpa ne la ati, Nyamenle ɛyɛ kpɔvolɛ wɔ bɛmɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la ati. Noko kɛmɔ Nyamenle ɛkpa nu ɛye bɛ la ati, bɛle ɔ gɔnwo mɔ wɔ bɛ nlenya mɔ ati. 29Ɔluakɛ Nyamenle ɛngakyi ye adwenle ɛlɛ wɔ menli mɔɔ yekpa nu yeye bɛ na yeyila bɛ la anwo. 30Bɛmɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la, bɛkpole Nyamenle wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛze ɛhɔ la, na ɛnɛ bɛnyia Nyamenle ɛlolɛ ne, ɔluakɛ Dwuuma ɛyɛ anzosesebɛ. 31Zɔhane ala yɛɛ Dwuuma ɛyɛ Nyamenle anwo anzosesebɛ, amaa ɔlua bɛmɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la anwunvɔne mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛze bɛ la azo, yeaze bɛdabɛ Dwuuma anwunvɔne ne bie. 32Ɔluakɛ Nyamenle ɛva ye kɛ menli kɔsɔɔti ɛyɛ anzosesebɛ, amaa yeanwu bɛ muala anwunvɔne.
Ayɛlɛyelɛ ɛha Nyamenle
33 Nyamenle anwonyia le kpole. Ye nrɛlɛbɛ nee ye adwenle le kpole bo zolɛ. Nwane a kɛhola kɛde ye kpɔkɛ mɔɔ ɔkɛbɔ la abo a? 34 Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se,
“Nwane a ze Awulae adwenle a?
Nwane a kɛhola kɛdu ye folɛ a?
35Nwane a ɛhola ɛhyɛ ye debie
mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ ɔsie ɔ bo zo a?”
36 Ɔdaye a ɔbɔle ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti a, debie biala lua ɔ nwo zo, yɛɛ bɛwɔ ɛkɛ ne bɛmaa ye. Anyunlunyia ɛha Nyamenle dahuu! Amen.

Title: WULO 12
Content:
Nyamenle ɛzonlenlɛ nu ɛbɛlabɔlɛ
1Zɔhane ati me mediema, Nyamenle anwunvɔnezelɛ bebelebe ne mɔɔ ɔse yɛ la ati, mesɛlɛ bɛ, bɛva bɛ sonlabaka ne mɔ bɛbɔ azu mɔɔ anwo te na ɔsɔ ɛnyelɛ la bɛmaa Nyamenle. Ɛhye a le sunsum nu ɛzonlenlɛ kpalɛ mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛfa bɛsonle ye a. 2Bɛmmamaa ewiade amaamuo di bɛ adwenle. Bɛmaa Nyamenle ɛhakyi bɛ adwenle bɔkɔɔ, na bɛahola bɛanwu Nyamenle ɛhulolɛdeɛ kpalɛ ne mɔɔ le kpalɛ, ɔsɔ ɛnyelɛ, na ɔdi munli la.
3Melua Nyamenle ɛlolɛ ahyɛlɛdeɛ ne mɔɔ yeva yemaa me la azo mese bɛ muala kɛ bɛmmamemaa bɛ nwo zo. Bɛdwenle kpalɛ na bɛbua bɛ nwo ndɛne ngoko wɔ diedi dodo mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛva ɛmaa bɛ la anu. 4 Kɛmɔ sonlabaka lɛ ye nvɛyeba dɔɔnwo na nvɛyeba ko biala lɛ ye gyima mɔɔ ɔdi la, 5zɔhane ala yɛɛ saa yɛzonle bɔbɔ a yɛ muala yɛbɔ nu a yɛle sonlabaka ko wɔ Kelaese anu, na yɛsosɔ yɛ nwo ngoko kɛ sonlabaka nvɛyeba ne mɔ sosɔ bɛ nwo la a. 6 Ɛhye ati ɔwɔ kɛ yɛfa yɛ ahyɛlɛdeɛ ngakyile ne mɔ mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛlolɛ zo yɛnyia bɛ la yɛyɛ gyima. Saa yɛ bie mɔ ahyɛlɛdeɛ a le Nyamenle anloa azo ɛdendɛlɛ a, ɔwɔ kɛ yɛyɛ ye zɔhane, kɛmɔ yɛ diedi ne de la. 7Saa ɛzonlenlɛ nu noko a, ɔwɔ kɛ yɛsonle. Saa ngilehilelɛ nu a, ɔwɔ kɛ yɛkilehile. 8Mɔɔ lɛ folɛdulɛ ahyɛlɛdeɛ la ɛva ɛdu ɔ gɔnwo mɔ folɛ. Mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ asa dwu awie mɔ anwo zo la, ɛyeye ɔ kunlu ɛyɛ. Mɔɔ yɛ ahunlunyele gyima la, ɔwɔ kɛ yɛ ye anyelielɛ nu; yɛɛ mɔɔ lɛ moalɛ la ɛva fɛlɛkolilɛ ɛboa.
9Bɛmaa bɛ ɛhulolɛ ɛyɛ nɔhalɛ ɛhulolɛ; bɛhyi mɔɔ le ɛtane la na bɛzɔ mɔɔ le kpalɛ la anu. 10Bɛva mediema ɛhulolɛ bɛhulo bɛ nwo ngoko kɛ bɛle Kelaese ɛdoavolɛma, na bɛbɔ mɔdenle bɛpele bɛbu bɛ gɔnwo mɔ kpalɛ kpalɛ. 11Bɛyɛ gyima ɛsesebɛ, bɛmmayɛ mgbovonle, na bɛva bɛ ahonle muala bɛzonle Nyamenle. 12Bɛmaa bɛ anyelazo ɛmaa bɛ nye ɛlie, bɛzi abotane wɔ bɛ amaneɛnwunlɛ nu, na bɛyɛ nzɛlɛlɛ dahuu. 13Bɛmaa bɛ sa ɛdwu mediema Kelaese ɛdoavolɛma mɔɔ ɛhyia la anwo zo, na bɛlie nyɛvolɛ wɔ bɛ azua nu.
14 Bɛzɛlɛ Nyamenle nyilalɛ bɛmaa menli mɔɔ yɛ bɛ kpɔdekpɔde la; ɛhɛe, bɛzɛlɛ nyilalɛ bɛmaa bɛ, bɛmmasɛlɛ ndeanlɛ. 15Bɛ nee mɔɔ di fɛlɛko la ɛli fɛlɛko na bɛ nee mɔ su la ɛzu. 16 Bɛmaa bɛ muala bɛ adwenle ɛyɛ ko. Bɛmmayɛ mgbanyizonle, bɛ nee ahoahweabane ɛdu. Bɛmmabu bɛ nwo kɛ bɛle nrɛlɛbɛvolɛma.
17Saa awie yɛ bɛ ɛtane a, bɛmmadi ye nzenralɛ. Bɛbɔ mɔdenle bɛyɛ mɔɔ awie biala nea a ɛnee nwolɛ te la. 18Bɛbɔ mɔdenle kɛ bɛ nee menli kɔsɔɔti kɛdɛnla anzonudwolɛ nu. 19 Ayi mɔ, bɛmmafa ɛtane bɛtua ɛtane kakɛ ɛlɛ, bɛgyakyi debie biala anu bɛmaa Nyamenle ɛya ne. Ɔluakɛ Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se, “Nzenralɛ le me ɛdeɛ, mebadua ɛtane kakɛ, Awulae a se a.” 20 Yemɔti, kɛmɔ Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se la, “Saa ɛhɔne ɛlɛku wɔ kpɔvolɛ a, maa ye aleɛ ɔli; saa nzuhɔne ɛlɛku ye a, maa ye nzule ɔnlo; ɔluakɛ saa ɛyɛ ye zɔhane a, ɛnee ɛlɛkuohua senle samɛnlakɛ ɔ ti zo.” 21Bɛmmamaa ɛtane fo bɛ nwo zo; bɛva kpalɛyɛlɛ bɛli ɛtane nwo zo konim.

Title: WULO 13
Content:
Maanle mgbanyima nwo ɛzonlelilɛ
1Ɔwɔ kɛ awie biala bu mgbanyima mɔɔ ɛlɛbu maanle ne la, ɔboalekɛ tumi biala ɛnle ɛkɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛnze nu a, yɛɛ mgbanyima mɔɔ wɔ zo kɛkala la, Nyamenle a ɛva bɛ ɛzie ɛkɛ a. 2Zɔhane ati mɔɔ kɛtia mgbanyima mɔɔ wɔ zo la, ɛtia menli mɔɔ Nyamenle ɔdaye yeye bɛ kɛ bɛbu maanle ne la, na mɔɔ kɛyɛ ye zɔ noko la twe ndeanlɛ maa ɔ nwo. 3Ɔluakɛ ɔnle kɛ awie biala mɔɔ di boɛ la sulo menli mɔɔ maanlebulɛ ne wɔ bɛ sa nu la kyesɛ menli mɔɔ di ɛtane la ala. Bɛmkpondɛ kɛ bɛsulo sonla mɔɔ tumi wɔ ɔ sa nu la ɔ? Ɛnee bɛbɔ ɛbɛla kpalɛ, na ɔkɛhanvo bɛ. 4Ɔluakɛ ɔle Nyamenle sonvolɛ mɔɔ ɛlɛyɛ ye gyima wɔ bɛ kpalɛ ti a. Noko saa ɛdi ɛtane ɛdeɛ a, ɛnee sulo ye, ɔluakɛ ɔlɛ tumi, yɛɛ kɛmɔ ɔle sonvolɛ mɔɔ ɛlɛyɛ ye Nyamenle gyima la, ɔkola ɔtea menli mɔɔ di ɛtane la. 5Ɛhye ati ɔwɔ kɛ bɛtie na bɛyɛ mɔɔ menli mɔɔ tumi anzɛɛ maanlebulɛ ne wɔ bɛ sa nu la kɛze bɛ la, tɛ kɛ Nyamenle kɛdea bɛ la ati ɔ, na bɛ adwenle nu te wienyi la ati ɔ.
6 Zɔhane ati yɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛtua bɛ maanle adwule noko a, ɔluakɛ saa mgbanyima ne mɔ mɔɔ di zɛhae gyima la yɛ bɛ gyima ne adenle kpalɛ zo a, ɛnee bɛlɛyɛ bɛ Nyamenle gyima. 7Yemɔti, mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛtua la, bɛdua; bɛdua bɛ maanle adwule ngakyile ne mɔ amuala, bɛbu mgbanyima ne mɔ na bɛli bɛ muala eni.
Gyima mɔɔ yɛyɛ yɛmaa yɛ nwo ngoko la
8Bɛmmadi awie biala anwo ɛzonle, ɛzonle mɔɔ yɛdi la a le kɛ yɛkɛhulo yɛ nwo ngoko ngoko. Mɔɔ kulo ɔ gɔnwo dasanli la ɛli Mosisi mɛla ne azo ɛwie. 9 Mɛla ne mɔɔ se, “Mmafa awuvolɛ, mmayɛ kɔdiawu, mmawua, mmayɛ anyebolo” nee mɔɔ ɛha la amuala, bɛbɔ ye kpɔkɛ ko kɛ, “Kulo ɛ gɔnwo kɛ ɛdawɔ ɛ nwo la.” 10Saa ɛlɛ ɛhulolɛ a, ɛnrɛyɛ ɛ gɔnwo ɛtane. Yemɔti ɛhulolɛ a sɔ Mosisi mɛla ne amuala anloa a.
11Ɛhye mɔ amuala anzi, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛnwu kɛ mekɛ ɛdwu mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛfi nafelɛ nu bɛdwazo a. Ɔluakɛ ngoanelielɛ mekɛ ne ɛbikye ɛdɛla kɛmɔ yɛzuzule ye wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ yɛlumuale yɛnyianle diedi ne la. 12Aledwolɛ ne asɛɛ ɛze, alehyenlɛ ɛbikye; zɔhane ati bɛmaa yɛgyakyi awozinli nu nyɛleɛ ne mɔ, na yɛva wienyi nu konle tɛladeɛ mɔɔ bamaa yɛahola ko la yɛwula. 13Bɛmaa yɛli yɛ nwo eni, na yɛbɔ yɛ ɛbɛla kpalɛ kɛ menli mɔɔ wɔ alehyenlɛ nu la, mɔɔ anwondɛlɛ mgbane mgbane, nzabolɛ, adwɔmanebɔlɛ, anzɛɛ huhunli ɛbɛla ɛbɔlɛ, konle anzɛɛ nungule ɛhwenlɛ biala ɛnle nu a. 14Na bɛva Awulae Kelaese bɛyɛ konle tɛladeɛ bɛwula, na bɛzi nwonane nu adwenle ɛvalɛ nee ye atiakunluwɔzo aze.

Title: WULO 14
Content:
Mmabua ɛ diema ndɛne
1 Mɔɔ ye diedi le ekyi la, bɛlie ye wɔ bɛ avinli, noko bɛ nee ye mmasu ye adwenle nu nzuzulɛ biala anwo kpolera. 2Bie diedi maa ɔdi debie biala, na mɔɔ ye diedi le ekyi la di nya nya nee mbakama ala. 3Mɔɔ di debie biala la mmakpo mɔɔ ɛnli debie biala la, yɛɛ mɔɔ di nya nya nee mbakama ala la mmabua mɔɔ di debie biala la ndɛne, ɔluakɛ Nyamenle ɛlie ye ɛdo nu. 4Na ɛdawɔ a le nwane mɔɔ ɛbua awie akɛlɛ ndɛne a? Saa ɔyɛ ye boɛ o, ɔnyɛ ye boɛ o, ɔ menle ala a kola ka a, yɛɛ ɔbayɛ boɛ yeamaa ye noko, ɔboalekɛ Awulae kola maa ɔyɛ boɛ ɔmaa ye.
5Sonla ne bie adwenle a le kɛ kenle ne bie hyia tɛla kenle mɔɔ ɛha la amuala. Bie noko dwenle nwolɛ kɛ kenle ne amuala sɛ. Ɔwɔ kɛ biala dwenle nwolɛ kpalɛ na ɔmaa ye adwenle si pi wɔ nwolɛ. 6Mɔɔ dwenle nwolɛ sie kenle ko kɛ ɔhyia ɔtɛla kenle mɔɔ ɛha la yɛ ye zɔhane wɔ Awulae anyunlunyia ti; mɔɔ di debie biala la yɛ ye zɔhane wɔ Awulae anyunlunyia ti, ɔboalekɛ ɔyɛ Nyamenle mo wɔ aleɛ biala mɔɔ ɔbali la anwo. Mɔɔ kpo kɛ ɔnrɛli debie biala la yɛ ye zɔhane wɔ Awulae anyunlunyia ti, ɔluakɛ ɔdaye noko ɔyɛ Nyamenle mo wɔ nwolɛ. 7Yɛ nuhua ko biala ɛnde aze ɛmmaa ɔ nwo, yɛɛ yɛ biala ɛnwu ɛmmaa ɔ nwo. 8Saa yɛde aze a, yɛde yɛmaa Awulae, yɛɛ saa yɛwu a, yɛwu yɛmaa Awulae. Yemɔti saa yɛde aze o, yɛwu o, yɛle Awulae ɛdeɛ. 9Ɔluakɛ ɛhye ati a Kelaese wule na bɛdwazole ye bɛrale ngoane nu a, amaa yeayɛ anyewɔzo amra nee mɔwuamra Awulae. 10 Saa ye zɔhane a ɛnee wɔmɔ, duzu ati a ɛkɛbua ɛ gɔnwo ndɛne a? Ɛdawɔ noko, duzu ati a ɛkɛtoto ɛ gɔnwo anwo nyɛlɛ ɛ? Yɛ muala yɛbagyinla Nyamenle ndɛnebualɛ ebia ne anyunlu. 11 Ɔluakɛ Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se,
“Awulae se, suzuamgba ala
mɔɔ mame a mele tease Nyamenle ne la,
awie biala babu ndwɛlɛ wɔ me nyunlu,
yɛɛ menli muala bayeyɛ me kɛ mele Nyamenle.”
12Zɔhane ati yɛ nuhua ko biala babu ye mgbonda ahile Nyamenle.
Mmamaa ɛ diema kpo aze
13Zɔhane ati, bɛmaa yɛgyakyi yɛ gɔnwo mɔ ndɛne ɛbualɛ, na yɛbɔ kpɔkɛ kɛ yɛnrɛyɛ debie biala mɔɔ kɛmaa adiema bie kɛhɔ ɛtane nu anzɛɛ kɛkpo aze a. 14Sumunli kɛ me nee Awulae Gyisɛse lile ngamɔnu la menwu ye kɔsɔɔ kɛ aleɛ biala ɛnle ɛkɛ mɔɔ anwo ɛnde a. Na saa awie dwenle kɛ bie anwo ɛnde a, ɛnee nwolɛ ɛnde ɛmmaa ɔdaye ɔ ngome, 15yɛɛ saa ɛmaa aleɛ mɔɔ ɛdi la amaa ɛ gɔnwo ali nyane a ɛnee ɛngulo ye. Mmamaa wɔ aleɛ mɔɔ ɛdi la sɛkye sonla mɔɔ Kelaese ɛwu ɛlie ye ngoane la. 16Mmamaa debie mɔɔ ɛdwenle kɛ ɔle kpalɛ ɔmaa wɔ la nyia duma ɛtane. 17Ɔluakɛ Nyamenle Belemgbunlililɛ ne, tɛ yemɔ a le nlidi nlidi anzɛɛ nono nono, na yemɔ a le pɛlepɛlelilɛ, anzonudwolɛ nee anyelielɛ ne mɔɔ Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne fa maa la. 18Awie biala mɔɔ sonle Kelaese wɔ zɛhae adenle zo la yɛɛ Nyamenle anye die ɔ nwo na ɔsɔ menli nye a.
19Zɔhane ati, ɔwɔ kɛ kenle biala yɛyɛ ninyɛne mɔɔ fa anzonudwolɛ ba na ɔboa yɛ nee yɛ gɔnwo mɔ na ɔmaa yɛ anwosesebɛ la. 20Bɛmmatoa aleɛlilɛ bɛsɛkye Nyamenle gyima ne. Debie biala anwo te, noko ɔle ɛtane kɛ ɛkɛli debie mɔɔ kɛmaa ɛ gɔnwo kɛhɔ ɛtane nu la. 21Debie kpalɛ mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛyɛ la a le kɛ bɛkɛgyakyi nane ɛlilɛ, nza ɛnlonlɛ, anzɛɛ debie mɔɔ bɛyɛ a ɔkɛmaa bɛ gɔnwo kɛkpo aze la ɛyɛlɛ. 22Diedi biala mɔɔ ɛlɛ ye wɔ ɛhye anwo la, maa ɔli ɛdawɔ nee wɔ Nyamenle bɛ avinli. Nyilalɛ ɛha sonla ne mɔɔ kɛyɛ debie mɔɔ ɔnea a ye adenle zo ɔ na nzinlii ɔnrɛli nwolɛ nyane la. 23Na saa wɔ adwenle yɛ wɔ kesee wɔ debie mɔɔ ɛdi la anwo na ɛdi a, ɛbali fɔlɛ kɛ ɛlile a, ɔluakɛ wɔanlua diedi zo a ɛlile a. Debie biala mɔɔ ye ɛyɛlɛ ɛngyi diedi zo la le ɛtaneyɛlɛ.

Title: WULO 15
Content:
Dwenle ɛ gɔnwo mɔ anwo
1Ɔwɔ kɛ yɛdayɛ mɔɔ yɛ diedi nu yɛ se la yɛboa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ diedi nu ɛnyɛ se la wɔ bɛ debie biala anu. Ɔnle kɛ yɛmaa yɛ nye die yɛ ngome yɛ nwo ala. 2Mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ yɛyɛ la a le kɛ yɛkɛmaa yɛ gɔnwo mɔ anye kɛlie bɛ nwo wɔ bɛ boɛlilɛ ti, amaa bɛ diedi anyi. 3 Ɔluakɛ Kelaese andwenle ɔdaye mumua ne ɔ nwo. Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se, “Aholoba mɔɔ menli bɔle wɔ la ɛragua me nwo zo.” 4Debie biala mɔɔ bɛhɛlɛ ye wɔ Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne anu la wɔ ɛkɛ ne kilehile yɛ, amaa yɛagyinla kpundii, yɛazi yɛ ahonle yɛalua mɔɔ Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne fa maa yɛ la azo yɛanyia anyelazo. 5Nyamenle mɔɔ maa yɛgyinla kpundii na ɔmaa yɛ akɛnrazilɛ la, ɛboa bɛ ɛmaa bɛ muala bɛdɛnla anloanzɛlɛ nu, na bɛva Kelaese Gyisɛse agyakɛ, 6amaa bɛ muala kɔsɔɔti bɛava ɛnelɛ ko bɛaye yɛ Awulae Gyisɛse Kelaese ɔ ze Nyamenle ne ayɛlɛ.
Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la ɛnyia Edwɛkpa ne
