Ɔmmaa bɛnnwu wienyi ne mɔɔ ɛlɛta fi Edwɛkpa ne mɔɔ fane Kelaese, mɔɔ le Nyamenle sɔhovolɛ kpalɛ ne anyunlunyia ne anwo la. 5Yɛmbɔ yɛdayɛ yɛ ngome yɛ nwo nolo; yɛbɔ Gyisɛse Kelaese anwo nolo kɛ ɔle Awulae, yɛɛ Gyisɛse ati yɛmɛ yɛle bɛmɛ bɛ sonvolɛma. 6 Nyamenle ne mɔɔ zele kɛ, “Wienyi vi awozinli nu ɛda” la a le Nyamenle ko ne ala mɔɔ manle ye wienyi ne dale yɛ ahonle nu la, amaa yɛanwu Nyamenle anyunlunyia ne mɔɔ ɛlɛta Kelaese anyunlu la.
7Noko yɛmɛ mɔɔ yɛlɛ Sunsum nu anwonyia ɛhye la yɛle kɛ mbuakɛ ala, amaa yeala ali kɛ tumi bedevinli ne le Nyamenle ɛdeɛ, na ɔnle yɛ ɛdeɛ. 8Ndenle dɔɔnwo anu bɛgyegye yɛ, na bɛngola bɛnzɛkye yɛ; bɛmaa yɛ adwenle nu yɛ kpomgbondee, noko yɛ agbɔkɛ nu ɛntuto; 9bɛyɛ yɛ kpɔdekpɔde, noko yɛtɛkyianle agɔnwolɛ nwo ɛlɛ; yɛɛ ɔdwu mekɛ ne bie bɔbɔ a bɛbobɔ yɛ, noko yɛtɛwule. 10Dahuu yɛte Gyisɛse ewule ne nyane wɔ yɛ sonlabaka ye anu, amaa menli anwu ye ngoane ne noko wɔ yɛ sonlabaka ye anu. 11Yɛ ngoane mekɛ nu amuala ewule sianle yɛ wɔ Kelaese ati, amaa menli anwu ye ngoane ne wɔ yɛ sonlabaka ɛhye ala anu. 12Ɛhye kile kɛ ewule di gyima wɔ yɛ nu, noko ngoane di gyima wɔ bɛmɛ bɛ nu.
13 Kɛmɔ yɛ diedi ne le kɛ Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ se, “Mendendɛle, ɔluakɛ menliele menlile” la, yɛdayɛ noko yɛtendɛ, ɔboalekɛ yɛdie yɛdi. 14Yɛze kɛ Nyamenle mɔɔ dwazole Awulae Gyisɛse rale ngoane nu la badwazo yɛ aboka Gyisɛse anwo, na yeava yɛ nee bɛ yeahɔ ɔ nyunlu ɛkɛ. 15Ɛhye mɔ amuala lua bɛmɛ bɛ ti, amaa mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛlolɛ ne ɛlɛtɛlɛ ahɔ menli dɔɔnwo anwo zo la, bɛava moyɛlɛ bɛawula Nyamenle anyunlunyia.
Yɛde aze wɔ diedi nu
16Ɔlua ɛhye ati yɛmkpo aze. Saa yɛ nwonane ɛlɛwie bɔbɔ a, Nyamenle kakyi yɛ sunsum nu nwonane ne alehyenlɛ biala. 17Nyane sikalɛ ekyi ɛhye mɔɔ yɛlɛnwu ye la bava anyunlunyia mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ na ɔle kpole kpalɛ ɔtɛla nyane ɛhye la arɛlɛ yɛ. 18Ɛhye ati yɛ nye ɛnla ninyɛne mɔɔ ɛnyelɛ nwu bɛ la azo; yɛ nye la ninyɛne mɔɔ ɛnyelɛ ɛnnwu bɛ la azo. Ninyɛne mɔɔ ɛnyelɛ nwu bɛ la ɛngyɛ na apɛ nu aze, na mɔɔ ɛnyelɛ ɛnnwu bɛ la wɔ ɛkɛ ne dahuu.

Title: 2 KƆL 5
Content:
1Yɛze kɛ saa bɛgolo yɛ nwonane sua ye mɔɔ yɛde nu la bɛgua aze kɛ ndanlɛ sua wɔ ewiade ye anu a, Nyamenle bamaa yɛ sua mɔɔ bɛanva ɛsalɛ bɛanzi, na ɔwɔ ɛkɛ ne dahuu la wɔ anwuma. 2Yɛsu yɛ kunlu, ɔluakɛ yɛkulo kɛ bɛfa yɛ anwuma nwonane sua ne bɛkpolo yɛ wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ yɛwɔ aze ɛke la, 3amaa saa yɛfa yɛkpolo a bɛanwu kɛ yɛnlɛ yɛ nwo zɔ. 4Mekɛ mɔɔ yɛde ndanlɛ sua ɛhye anu la, yɛsu yɛ kunlu kpalɛ wɔ anwongyelelɛ nu; tɛ kɛ asɛɛ bɛkpa yɛ azɛlɛ ye azo ndanlɛ sua bɛvi yɛ nwo ɔ, na yemɔ a le kɛ, yɛkpondɛ kɛ bɛfa anwuma ndanlɛ sua ɛdeɛ fofolɛ ne bɛkpolo yɛ, amaa ngoane aheda mɔɔ wu la azo. 5Nyamenle a ɛziezie yɛ ɛmaa ngakyile ɛhye a, na yeva ye Sunsum ne yeli ninyɛne mɔɔ ɔbava yeamaa yɛ la anwo agyinlanu.
6Zɔhane ati yɛlɛ akɛnrasesebɛ dahuu. Yɛze kɛ mekɛ mɔɔ yɛde nwonane sua ɛhye anu ala la, ɛnee yɛ nee Awulae yɛ avinli twe. 7Ɔluakɛ yɛfa diedi a yɛbɔ yɛ ɛbɛla a, na tɛ deɛ mɔɔ ɛnyelɛ nwu ye la ɔ. 8Yɛlɛ akɛnrasesebɛ na yɛkɛhulo ye kpalɛ kɛ yɛkɛvi nwonane sua ɛhye anu na yɛ nee Awulae kɛhɔdɛnla. 9Debie mɔɔ hyia kpalɛ la a le kɛ, saa yɛwɔ yɛ sua nu ɛke o, anzɛɛ nehane o, yɛkɛzɔ ɔ nye. 10 Ɔluakɛ ɔwɔ kɛ yɛ muala yɛfinde Kelaese anyunlu na ɔbua yɛ ndɛne, amaa yɛ nuhua ko biala asa aha ahatualɛ mɔɔ ɔfɛta la, kpalɛ o, ɛtane o, kɛmɔ ye ɛbɛla mɔɔ ɔdaye ɔlua ye sonlabaka ye azo yebɔ la de la.
Yɛdua Kelaese anwo zo yɛfa Nyamenle agɔnwolɛ
11Kɛmɔ yɛze kɛ Nyamenlezulolɛ si de la ati, yɛbɔ mɔdenle kɛ yɛkɛmaa menli kɛzulo Nyamenle; na kɛ yɛmɛ yɛde la, Nyamenle ɔdaye ɔze, yɛɛ meze kɛ bɛdabɛ bɛze ye wɔ bɛ adwenle nu. 12Tɛ kɛ asɛɛ yɛkulo kɛ yɛkanvo yɛ nwo yɛkile bɛ bieko ɔ, na yɛlɛbɔ mɔdenle kɛ bɛkɛva yɛ bɛkɛdu bɛ nwo, na bɛahola bɛanyia edwɛkɛ bɛaha bɛahile bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛfa menli gyinlabelɛ a bɛtu bɛ nloa anu na bɛnva bɛ subane a bɛtu bɛ nloa anu la. 13Asoo yɛzɛ? Saa yɛzɛ a, ɛnee Nyamenle ati ɔ, yɛɛ saa yɛ adwenle la ɛkɛ ne a, ɛnee ɔla ɛkɛ ɔmaa bɛmɛ. 14Ɔluakɛ Kelaese ɛhulolɛ ne a sie yɛ a, ɔboalekɛ yɛdie yɛto nu kɛ sonla ko wule manle menli kɔsɔɔti, na ye zɔhane ati menli kɔsɔɔti ɛwu. 15Ɔwule ɔmanle menli muala, amaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛde ngoane nu la andɛnla ammaa bɛ ngome bɛ nwo, na bɛadɛnla bɛamaa sonla ne mɔɔ bɛ ti a ɔwule na bɛdwazole ye bɛrale ngoane nu la.
16Ɛhye ati, ɔvi ɛnɛ mɔɔ kɔ la, yɛnnea awie biala anyunlu yɛmbua ndɛne. Saa mekɛ bie mɔɔ ɛze ɛhɔ la yɛbuale Kelaese ndɛne wɔ zɔhane adenle zo bɔbɔ a, ɛnɛ yɛnyɛ ye zɔhane bieko. 17Zɔhane ati awie biala mɔɔ le Kelaese ɛdeɛ la le abɔdeɛ fofolɛ; dɛba ne ɛpɛ nu ɛhɔ, fofolɛ ɛra. 18Nyamenle a ɛyɛ ɛhye amuala a, na yelua Kelaese anwo zo yeyɛ yɛ ɔ gɔnwo mɔ, yɛɛ yemaa yɛ gyima kɛ yɛdayɛ noko yɛhwe menli yɛrayɛ bɛ ɔ gɔnwo mɔ. 19Yemɔ a le kɛ, Nyamenle lua Kelaese anwo zo ɛlɛtwe menli muala ayɛ bɛ ɔ gɔnwo mɔ. Nyamenle ambu bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ anwo mgbonda antia bɛ na yeva edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ fane kɛ menli si yɛ ɔ gɔnwo mɔ la yewula yɛ sa nu.
20Yɛle Kelaese agyakɛ anu gyinlavolɛma, na ɔlua yɛ nwo zo Nyamenle ɛlɛtu folɛ. Zɔhane ati yɛgyi Kelaese agyakɛ anu yɛbodo yɛsɛlɛ bɛ kɛ bɛmaa Nyamenle adenle bɛmaa ɔhakyi bɛ kɛ bɛnle agbɔvolɛ na bɛle ɔ gɔnwo mɔ. 21Kelaese anyɛ ɛtane, noko ɔlua yɛmɛ yɛ ti Nyamenle vale ye yɛle ɛtane mumua ne, amaa ɔlua ɔ nwo zo yɛanyia Nyamenle kpalɛyɛlɛ ne.

Title: 2 KƆL 6
Content:
1Kɛmɔ yɛ nee Kelaese bɔ nu yɛ gyima la, yɛbodo yɛsɛlɛ bɛ kɛ bɛmmamaa Nyamenle ɛlolɛ ne mɔɔ bɛ sa ɛha ye la yɛ mgbane. 2 Bɛdie mɔɔ Nyamenle se la; ɔse,
“Mekɛ ne dwule mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ mese bɛ anwunvɔne la,
mendiele bɛ.
Mekɛ ne dwule mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ medie bɛ ngoane la,
memboale bɛ.”
Bɛdie ɛ! Nyamenle ɛlolɛ mekɛ ne a le ɛnɛ. Ɛnɛ a le ngoanelielɛ kenle ne a.
3Yɛmkpondɛ kɛ yɛtenda awie agyakɛ anu na awie anyia yɛ gyima ne anwo edwɛkɛ ɛtane aha. 4Wɔ yɛ nyɛleɛ biala anu yɛfa abotane yɛgyinla ngyegyelɛ, anwongyelelɛ nee abodelɛ biala anloa, yɛkile kɛ yɛle Nyamenle sonvolɛma. 5 Bɛbila yɛ mbaka, bɛgua yɛ efiade na bɛwudo yɛ bagua nu; bɛmaa yɛyɛ gyima ɛsesebɛ, yɛsi epe, yɛɛ bɛkye yɛ ɛhɔne. 6Noko ɔlua yɛ anwondelɛ, nrɛlɛbɛ, abotane, atiakunlukpalɛ nee Nyamenle Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne nee yɛ nɔhalɛ ɛhulolɛ, 7yɛ nɔhalɛ nrɛlaleɛ ne, nee Nyamenle tumi ne azo yɛla yɛ nwo ali yɛhile kɛ yɛle Nyamenle sonvolɛma. Pɛlepɛlelilɛ a le yɛ konle dadeɛ mɔɔ yɛfa yɛko na yɛfa yɛpepɛ yɛdie yɛ nwo a. 8Bɛdi yɛ eni yɛɛ bɛgua yɛ nyunlu aze; bɛbɔ yɛ aholoba yɛɛ bɛye yɛ ayɛlɛ. Bɛbu yɛ alanema, noko yɛdi nɔhalɛ; 9bɛyɛ kɛ bɛnze yɛ, noko bɛ muala bɛze yɛ; bɛfa yɛ kɛ yɛwu bɔbɔ a, bɛnlea, yɛtɛte aze. Saa bɛtwi yɛ nyunlu a, bɛtɛkunle yɛ. 10Saa bɛbɔ yɛ rɛle a, yɛ nye die yɛ nwo dahuu; ɔzɔho kɛ yɛle ehyianvolɛma, noko yɛyɛ menli dɔɔnwo sukoavolɛma; ɔzɔho kɛ yɛnlɛ bie, noko nɔhalɛ, yɛlɛ debie biala.
11Me gɔnwo mɔ Kɔlentema! Yɛbuke yɛ munli nu a yɛlɛtendɛ yɛahile bɛ a. 12Yɛnzi bɛ aze; saa azezilɛ bie wɔ ɛkɛ a ɛnee ɔvi bɛdabɛ bɛ atiakunluwɔzo. 13Melɛtendɛ meahile bɛ kɛ metendɛ mekile me mra la. Yemɔti bɛbuke bɛ munli nu, kɛmɔ yɛyɛ yɛmaa bɛ la.
Kɔkɔbɔlɛ wɔ bozonle ɛzonlenlɛma anwo
14Bɛ nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnlie Kelaese bɛnli la mmatu. Kɛ ɔkɛyɛ na kpalɛ nee ɛtane adila agɔnwolɛ ɛ? Kɛ ɔkɛyɛ na wienyi nee awozinli abɔ nu adɛnla ɛ? 15Kɛ ɔkɛyɛ na Kelaese nee Abɔnsam anloa azɛ bɛ nwo ɛ? Duzu a diedinli nee bozonle ɛzonlenlɛnli lɛ ye yɛ a? 16 Duzu ngitanwo a wɔ Nyamenle Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua nee awozonle ɛzonlenlɛ sua avinli a? Yɛle tease Nyamenle ne ɛzonlenlɛ sua! Kɛ ɔdaye Nyamenle mumua ne yeha la ɛne. Ɔse,
“Mebabu me awuke wɔ me maanlema avinli
na me nee bɛ adɛnla;
Mebayɛ bɛ Nyamenle
na bɛayɛ me menli.”
17 Yemɔti kɛ Awulae se la ɛne,
“Bɛgyakyi bɛ na bɛhwe bɛ nwo bɛvi bɛ nwo.
Bɛmmafa bɛ sa bɛka debie mɔɔ anwo ɛnde la,
na menwɔlie bɛ.
18 Mebayɛ bɛ ze,
na bɛayɛ me mra mrenya nee mraalɛ,
kɛ Tumivolɛ Awulae se la ɛne!”

Title: 2 KƆL 7
Content:
1Ayi mɔ, ɛwɔkɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛbɔ yɛ la ɛne. Yemɔti, bɛmaa yɛwowo debie biala mɔɔ wɔ yɛ nwo mɔɔ gua yɛ sonlabaka ye anzɛɛ yɛ ɛkɛla ne mɔ anwo evinli la yɛgua, yɛzulo Nyamenle, na yɛmaa yɛ ɛbɛlabɔlɛ nwo ɛde bɔkɔɔ.
Pɔɔlo di fɛlɛko
2Bɛbuke bɛ munli nu bɛmaa yɛ; yɛtɛyɛle awie biala ɛtane, yɛtɛsɛkyele awie biala, yɛɛ yɛtɛdile awie biala amile. 3Menga ɛhye membu bɛ fɔlɛ, na kɛmɔ meha ye dɛba la, saa yɛde ngoane nu o, yɛwu o, yɛlɛ bɛ nwo ɛhulolɛ kpalɛ mɔɔ kile kɛ dahuu yɛle ko a. 4Medie bɛ medi, mefa bɛ metu me nwo! Me nwo tɔ me, yɛɛ wɔ yɛ anwongyelelɛ muala anu medi fɛlɛko kpole.
5 Mɔɔ yɛrale Masidonea la, yɛ nwo andɔ yɛ kpalɛ biala, ɔluakɛ ɛnee ɛleka biala mɔɔ yɛkɛhɔ la yɛyia ngyegyelɛ; gua zo a, konle; sua nu a, ɛzulolɛ ngome. 6Noko Nyamenle mɔɔ kyekye bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ rɛle ɛbɔ la arɛle la, luale Taetɛse ɛralɛ ne azo kyekyele yɛ rɛle, 7yɛɛ tɛ ye ɛralɛ ne angome, na ye amaneɛ bɔbɔ mɔɔ ɔrabɔle mɔɔ fane kɛ bɛzile bɛkyekyele ɔ rɛle, bɛ nwo mɔɔ dɔ me, me nwo nyane mɔɔ bɛlɛdi, nee bɛ nye mɔɔ ɛbolo kɛ bɛpepɛ bɛalie me la ɛmaa kɛkala me nye ɛlie kpole kpalɛ.
8Na saa me kɛlata ne manle bɛ rɛle bɔle bɔbɔ a, menli nwolɛ nyane kɛ mengɛlɛle a. Noko akee menlile nyane wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ menwunle kɛ kɛlata ne ɛbɔ bɛ rɛle mekɛ ekyi bie la. 9Kɛkala ɛdeɛ, medi fɛlɛko, tɛ kɛ membɔle bɛ rɛle la ati ɔ, na kɛ bɛ rɛle ɛbɔlɛ ne manle bɛnlunle bɛ nwo. Nyamenle luale bɛ rɛle ɛbɔlɛ ne azo lile gyima, yemɔti yɛanyɛ bɛ ɛtane. 10Ɔluakɛ nyanelilɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle ze nuhua la maa sonla nu ɔ nwo na ɔnyia ngoane, ɔmmaa ɔnvu ɔ nwo; ewiade ye anu nyanelilɛ maa ewule. 11Bɛnlea gyima mɔɔ Nyamenle vale bɛ rɛle ne mɔɔ bɔle la lile a: bɛ nye bolole edwɛkɛ ne anwo manle bɛhilele kɛ bɛ nwo ɛnle nu! Nea bɛ ɛya mɔɔ bɛvale, ɛzulolɛ mɔɔ bɛnyianle ye bɛ nu, bɛ nwo mɔɔ dɔ me kɛ bɛ kunlu a anrɛɛ mewɔ lɔ, bɛ nwo mɔɔ bɛyelele kɛ bɛkɛbɔ ɛbɛla kpalɛ, nee kɛ bɛzile bɛdeanle bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛlile ɛtane la. Adenle biala anu bɛyɛle bɛhilele kɛ bɛnli fɔlɛ fee wɔ edwɛkɛ ne anwo.
12Yemɔti, saa mengɛlɛle bɛ kɛlata ne a, ɛnee tɛ ahenle mɔɔ yɛle ɛtane ne la ati ɔ, anzɛɛ ahenle mɔɔ bɛyɛle ye ɛtane ne la ati ɔ; mengɛlɛle, amaa bɛ ɛhulolɛ ne mɔɔ bɛlɛ ye wɔ me nwo la ala ali amaa bɛ wɔ Nyamenle anyunlu. 13Zɔhane ati yɛ rɛle ɛkyekye.
Tɛ yɛ rɛle mɔɔ ɛkyekye la angome, na yɛ nye liele kpole wɔ Taetɛse anyelielɛ mɔɔ ɔnyianle ye, nee ɔ rɛle mɔɔ bɛ muala bɛboale bɛkyekyele la anwo. 14Saa mendule me nloa anu mengilele ye wɔ bɛ nwo a, bɛangua me nyunlu aze. Debie biala anu yɛka nɔhalɛ ne yɛkile bɛ, na ɛhye ati yɛɛ yɛ nloa anu mɔɔ yɛdule yɛhilele Taetɛse la ɛyɛ nɔhalɛ a. 15Yemɔti ɔlɛ bɛ nwo ɛhulolɛ kpole, na ɔkakye bɛ muala bɛ tieyɛ nee kɛ bɛzile bɛvale ɛzulolɛ nee anwowozolɛ bɛyɛle ye akɔaba la. 16Medi fɛlɛko kɛ mekola medie bɛ medi bɔkɔɔ a.

Title: 2 KƆL 8
Content:
Kelaese ɛdoavolɛ debie ɛhyɛlɛ
1 Mediema, yɛkpondɛ kɛ bɛnwu gyima mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛlolɛ ne ɛli wɔ asɔne ne mɔ mɔɔ wɔ Masidonea la anu la. 2Bɛhɔle sɔnea nu kpole wɔ ndenle dɔɔnwo anu, noko bɛlile fɛlɛko kpole. Ɛnee bɛnlɛ bie suzuamgba ɛdeɛ, noko bɛluale bɛ amaneɛnwunlɛ ne anu bɛvale ninyɛne bɛhyɛle, bɛhilele bɛ atiakunlukɛnlɛma. 3Medi daselɛ kɛ bɛmanle ahyɛlɛdeɛ, kɛmɔ bɛkɛhola ala la, na bɛboale bɔbɔ bɛmanle ɔbole zolɛ. Bɛvale ɛhulolɛ 4bɛtinlinle zo bɛkpale yɛ kyɛlɛ kɛ yɛmaa bɛ adenle yɛmaa bɛboa Nyamenle menli ne mɔɔ wɔ ɛhyianlɛ nu la. 5Yɛ nye anla fee. Bɛlumuale bɛvale bɛ nwo bɛmanle Awulae, na akee ɔlua Nyamenle ɛhulolɛ zo bɛava bɛ nwo bɛamaa yɛdayɛ noko. 6Zɔhane ati yɛzɛlɛ Taetɛse mɔɔ lumuale bɔle gyima ɛhye abo la kɛ ɔrazɔ zolɛ wɔ bɛ nwo lɔ na ɔboa bɛ ɔmaa bɛwie ɛhulolɛ ɛzonlenlɛ ɛhye. 7Kɛmɔ debie biala anu bɛdi munli, wɔ diedi nu, ɛdendɛlɛ nu, adwenlenubukelɛ nu, bɛ nye mɔɔ ɛkpota bɛ ti anwo kɛ bɛboa, nee ɛhulolɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛ ye wɔ yɛ nwo la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ yɛ nye la kɛ bɛkɛhile bɛ atiakunlukɛnlɛma noko wɔ ɛlolɛ ɛzonlenlɛ ɛhye anu bɛkɛmaa ɔkɛbo zolɛ a.
8Mengyehyɛ mɛla memmaa bɛ. Melɛ moalɛ mɔɔ awie mɔ anye ɛbolo ɛlɛboa la menea kɛ bɛ ɛhulolɛ si to kɔ la. 9Ɔluakɛ bɛze kɛ Awulae Gyisɛse Kelaese ɛlolɛ ne si de la; ɔle sukoavolɛ, noko ɔlua bɛ ti ɔyɛle ɔ nwo ehyianli, amaa yealua ye ehyia ne azo yeayɛ bɛ sukoavolɛma.
10Me folɛ mɔɔ metu bɛ wɔ edwɛkɛ ɛhye anwo la a le kɛ, ɔle kpalɛ kɛ bɛkɛwie gyima mɔɔ ɛvolɛ ko mɔɔ ɛraze ɛhɔ la anu bɛhulole kɛ bɛkɛyɛ la yɛ kɛkala. Bɛmɛ a bɛlumuale bɛnyianle nwolɛ ɛhulolɛ kɛ bɛkɛyɛ a, yɛɛ bɛdabɛ noko a bɛlumuale bɛbɔle ɔ bo a. 11Bɛhɔ zo bɛli gyima ne bɛhɔ awieleɛ, amaa mɔdenle mɔɔ bɛbɔle bɛhyehyɛle la awie kɛnlɛma kɛ bɛvale mɔɔ bɛlɛ ye la bɛwiele gyima ne. 12Ɔluakɛ saa ɔwɔ bɛ nuhua kɛ bɛkɛmaa debie a, ɛnee mɔɔ bɛlɛ ye la azo a Nyamenle balua alie bɛ ahyɛlɛdeɛ ne a. Ɔnrɛnlea mɔɔ bɛnlɛ ye la azo ɔnrɛlie.
13-14Menzoa bɛ adesoa kpole memmaa awie mɔ anwo ɛndɔ bɛ; na ɔle kpalɛ kɛ ɛnɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛ ye dɔɔnwo la, bɛkɛboa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnlɛ bie la, amaa mekɛ mɔɔ bɛdabɛ noko bɛkɛhyia la menli mɔɔ lɛ bie dɔɔnwo la aboa bɛ. Ɔba ye zɛhae a ɛnee moalɛ ne ɛyɛ sɛsɛ. 15 Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se,
“Sonla mɔɔ sesale bɛ dɔɔnwo la annyia bɛ molozo,
yɛɛ sonla mɔɔ sesale ekyi la angyia.”
Taetɛse nee ɔ gɔnwo mɔ
16Yɛyɛ Nyamenle mo somaa kɛ yemaa Taetɛse noko ɛnyia ɛhulolɛ kɛ yɛdayɛ la, kɛ ɔba yearaboa bɛ a. 17Tɛ kɛ yekponle mɔɔ yɛbizale ye la azo angome ɔ, na ɔlɛba bɛ nwo lɔ kɛ sonla mɔɔ ɔdaye ɔlɛtu ɔ ti anwo adenle la. 18Yɛlɛsoa ye nee adiema ne mɔɔ asɔne ne mɔ amuala di ye eni wɔ Edwɛkpa ne nolobɔlɛ nwo la. 19Yeanga ye zɔhane, asɔnema ne ɛnlea nu ɛye ye na bɛyɛ ye kɛ ɔ nee yɛ ɛkpɔsa ɛyɛ ɛhulolɛ ɛzonlenlɛ gyima ɛhye, yɛva yɛde Awulae anyunlu, na yɛhile kɛ yɛkulo kɛ yɛboa.
20Yɛlɛbɔ mɔdenle kɛ awie ɛnrɛnyia edwɛkɛ ɛtane biala ɛnrɛha wɔ kɛ yɛsi yɛnea ahyɛlɛdeɛ kɛnlɛma ye azo la. 21 Debie titile mɔɔ gyi yɛ nye zo la a le kɛ yɛkɛyɛ mɔɔ tenrɛ wɔ Nyamenle nee menli nyunlu la.
22Yemɔti yɛlɛsoa bɛ nee yɛ muala yɛ diema ne mɔɔ mekɛ dɔɔnwo ne ala yɛzɔ ye yɛnlea na yɛnwu kɛ ɔkulo kɛ dahuu ɔboa la bɛ nwo lɔ. Kɛkala yelie bɛ yeli, yɛɛ yenyia ɛhulolɛ kpole kɛ ɔboa. 23Taetɛse ɛdeɛ, ɔle me gɔnwo mɔɔ yɛbɔ nu yɛyɛ gyima yɛboa bɛ a; mediema mɔɔ nee ye ɛlɛba la gyigyi asɔne ne mɔ agyakɛ anu, yɛɛ bɛte Kelaese anyunlu. 24Zɔhane ati bɛhile bɛ ɛhulolɛ, amaa asɔne ne mɔ ali nwolɛ daselɛ, na bɛanwu kɛ yɛanva bɛ yɛandu yɛ nwo mgbane.

Title: 2 KƆL 9
Content:
Keleseɛnema boa bɛ nwo
1Ɔngyia biala kɛ menwɔhɛlɛ bɛ wɔ moalɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛ bɛkamaa Nyamenle menli ne la anwo. 2Meze kɛ bɛkulo kɛ bɛboa, yɛɛ meva bɛ medu me nloa anu mehile Masidoneama. Menganle kɛ, “Sumunli ɛkenle ɛvolɛ ne yɛɛ mediema mɔɔ wɔ Akaya (Giliki) maanzinli nu la boɔboale bɛ nwo kɛ bɛboa a.” Zɛhae mɔdenlebɔlɛ ne ɛmaa menli dɔɔnwo ne ala akee anye ɛbolo. 3Kɛkala melɛsoa mediema ɛhye mɔ, amaa yɛ nloa anu mɔɔ yɛvale bɛ yɛdule wɔ edwɛkɛ ɛhye anwo la anyɛ mgbane, na kɛmɔ menganle la bɛaboɔboa bɛ nwo pɛneko. 4Yeamba ye zɔ na saa Masidoneama bie mɔ nee me ba na bɛbanwu kɛ bɛtɛboɔboale bɛ nwo a, yɛ nee bɛ yɛ muala yɛ nyunlu bagua aze kpole kɛ yɛvale yɛ nye yɛdole bɛ nwo zo a. 5Zɔhane ati medwenle nwolɛ kɛ ɔhyia kɛ metu mediema ɛhye mɔ kɛ bɛlumua me nyunlu wɔ bɛ nwo lɔ, na bɛaboɔboa ahyɛlɛdeɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛvale bɛbɔle ɛwɔkɛ la anloa bɛado ɛkɛ, amaa saa meba a yeanyɛ kɛ asɛɛ awie yɛɛ ɛhye bɛ mialeranu kɛ bɛyɛ a, na bɛdabɛ bɛkulo kɛ bɛboa la ati ɔ.
6Bɛhakye ɛhye: sonla mɔɔ dua ma ekyi la bu ekyi, yɛɛ mɔɔ dua dɔɔnwo la bu dɔɔnwo. 7Awie biala ɛva mɔɔ yezuzu nwo wɔ ye ahonle nu la ɛmaa. Ɔmmatwenlehwenle ɔ bo aze anzɛɛ ɔyɛ ye kɛ asɛɛ yemia la ati ɔ, ɔluakɛ Nyamenle kulo sonla mɔɔ te ɔ nyunlu kyɛ debie la. 8Nyamenle kola maa bɛ ninyɛne mɔɔ bɛhyia nwolɛ la maa ɔbo zolɛ, amaa dahuu bɛanyia mɔɔ sa bɛ la na bɛava bie bɛayɛ nyele. 9 Nyamenle edwɛkɛ ne se,
“Ɔ sa dwu ehyianvolɛma anwo zo,
ye atiakunlukpalɛ ne wɔ ɛkɛ dahuu.”
10 Nyamenle mɔɔ maa ɛyazonlɛnli ma maa ɔdua na ɔmaa ye aleɛ ɔdi la, kɛmaa bɛ ɛbɛlabɔlɛ nu ma mɔɔ bɛhyia nwolɛ la dɔɔnwo bɛkɛlua, na bɛ atiakunlukɛnlɛmayɛlɛ bɛyɔba ne azo dɔɔnwo. 11Wɔ debie biala anu, Nyamenle bamaa bɛanyia bie, amaa bɛ ti akunlu ayɛ kɛnlɛma na menli dɔɔnwo ayɛ Nyamenle mo kɛ ɔlua yɛ nwo zo bɛnyia ahyɛlɛdeɛ bɛvi bɛ ɛkɛ ne a. 12Ɔluakɛ bɛ ɛzonlenlɛ gyima ɛhye ɛmmaa Nyamenle menli ne ɛnnyia mɔɔ bɛkpondɛ la angome, na eza ɔmaa menli buke bɛ ahonle nu yɛ Nyamenle mo. 13Bɛ ɛzonlenlɛ gyima ɛhye kile bɛ diedi mɔɔ bɛlɛ la. Ɔlua zo menli dɔɔnwo ye Nyamenle ayɛlɛ kɛ bɛdi Kelaese anwo Edwɛkpa ne mɔɔ bɛlie bɛdo bɛ nwo zo la azo, na bɛ nee awie biala kyɛ nyilalɛ mɔɔ bɛnyia ye la. 14Zɔhane ati bɛbava anwolɔlɛ ɛhulolɛ kpalɛ bɛazɛlɛ bɛamaa bɛ wɔ ɛlolɛ molozo ne mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛva ɛlo bɛ la ati. 15Bɛmaa yɛyɛ Nyamenle mo wɔ ye nwanwane ahyɛlɛdeɛ ne ati.

Title: 2 KƆL 10
Content:
Pɔɔlo die ye ɛzonlenlɛ ne ati
1Medame Pɔɔlo, mesɛlɛ bɛ, bɛse mewɔ bɛ nwo lɔ a menle awie, na saa menle bɛ nwo lɔ a, ɛnee me nloa yɛ se wɔ bɛ nwo. Kelaese ati, melɛ bɛtɛɛyɛlɛ nee atiakunlukɛnlɛma mebodo bɛ, 2bɛmmayɛ bɛmaa saa meba bɛ nwo lɔ a me nee bɛ bie badi ye ɛsesebɛ, ɔboalekɛ medie me nwo medi kɛ mekola mekile bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛse yɛfa ewiade adwenle a yɛbɔ yɛ ɛbɛla la kɛ meyɛ se. 3Ɔle nɔhalɛ kɛ yɛde ewiade ye anu ɛdeɛ, noko tɛ ewiade ye konle a yɛlɛko a. 4Tɛ ewiade konle ninyɛne a yɛfa yɛko a; Nyamenle konle ninyɛne mɔɔ tumi wɔ nu la a yɛfa yɛbubu aranemgbole ne mɔ a. Yɛsɛkye kpolerazulɛ mgbane mgbane; 5yɛgologolo debie biala mɔɔ bɛkɛmaa ye zo adubɛnwo nu bɛkɛtia Nyamenle anwo adwenlenubukelɛ la, yɛɛ yɛkye adwenle biala nuokɛ yɛbele ye yɛmaa ɔtie Kelaese. 6Na saa akee bɛkile kɛ bɛva bɛ nwo bɛmaa Kelaese bɔkɔɔ a, yɛadua awie biala mɔɔ anwo yɛ se la kakɛ wɔ ye nyɛleɛ nwo.
7Anrɛɛ bɛnlea ye boɛ na bɛabua. Awie wɔ ɛkɛ ne mɔɔ ɔbu ɔ nwo kɛ ɔle Kelaese ɛdeɛ a, ɛnee bɛmaa ɔdwenle nwolɛ ɔhakye kɛ saa ɔle Kelaese ɛdeɛ a, ɛnee yɛdayɛ noko yɛle Kelaese ɛdeɛ. 8Ɔnyɛ me nyiane kɛ metu me nwo somaa wɔ tumi ne mɔɔ Awulae ɛva ɛmaa yɛ la anwo a, ɔluakɛ Awulae anva ammaa yɛ kɛ yɛva yɛzɛkye bɛ, ɔse yɛva yɛnlea yɛmaa bɛkpazi. 9Mengulo kɛ ɔyɛ kɛ asɛɛ mefa me ngɛlata ne mɔ meanwunlonwunla bɛ. 10Ɔluakɛ bie baha kɛ, “Pɔɔlo yɛ se wɔ ngɛlata zo, na saa ɔwɔ ɛke a, ɔnle awie, yɛɛ ye edwɛkɛ ɛngyinla kpɔkɛ zo!” 11Bɛmaa menli zɔhane mɔ ɛde ɔ bo kɛ mɔɔ yɛkɛlɛ ye wɔ ngɛlata ne mɔ anu, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ yɛnle bɛ nwo lɔ la, yemɔ ala yɛɛ anrɛɛ yɛkɛha wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ yɛwɔ bɛ nwo lɔ la a.
12Yɛnzi yɛ kɛnra yɛmbu yɛ nwo bie anzɛɛ yɛnva yɛ nwo yɛndo menli mɔɔ bɛdabɛ bɛ ngome bɛkanvo bɛ nwo la anwo. Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛfa bɛ nwo bɛto awie mɔ anwo, na bɛnea awie mɔ bɛfa bɛ bɛto bɛ nwo la ɛnze nrɛlɛbɛ. 13Na yɛmɛ, yɛnrɛmemaa yɛ nwo zo yɛnrɛmaa ɔnrɛbo zolɛ. Yɛmemaa yɛ nwo zo a, yɛmemaa ye wɔ gyima ne mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛva ɛzie yɛ nyunlu la anwo, kɛ yɛrali ye gyima wɔ bɛ nu. 14Yɛdayɛ a yɛlumuale yɛvale Kelaese anwo Edwɛkpa ne yɛrɛlɛle bɛ a, yemɔti saa yɛfa bɛ yɛtu yɛ nwo a, ɛnee yɛtɛyɛle yɛtɛmanle ɔtɛbole zolɛ. 15Yɛnva awie mɔ gyima mɔɔ bɛyɛ wɔ ɛleka mɔɔ Nyamenle anva ammaa yɛ la yɛndu yɛ nwo. Yɛ nye la kɛ saa bɛ diedi nyi a yɛɛ yɛ gyimayɛlɛ ne badɛlɛ kpole kpalɛ wɔ bɛ avinli a, 16amaa yɛahola yɛahɔbɔ Edwɛkpa ne nolo wɔ maanle maanle fofolɛ zo na yɛanva awie gyima mɔɔ yeyɛ ye dɛba la yɛandu yɛ nwo.
17 Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se, “Awie biala mɔɔ kpondɛ kɛ ɔmemaa ɔ nwo zo la ɛyɛ ye zɔ wɔ debie mɔɔ Awulae ɛyɛ la anwo.” 18Ɔluakɛ tɛ sonla mɔɔ kanvo ɔ ngome ɔ nwo la a sɔ Nyamenle anye a, na sonla mɔɔ Awulae kanvo ye la a sɔ Nyamenle anye a.

Title: 2 KƆL 11
Content:
Pɔɔlo nee ɛzoanvolɛma alane
1Me kunlu a anrɛɛ saa mele kɔnwɔne bɔbɔ a, bɛkɛva me zɔ. Mebodo bɛ, bɛyɛ ye zɔhane. 2Metwe bɛ nwo nungule, kɛmɔ Nyamenle yɛ ye ala la. Bɛle kɛ bɛlɛra mɔɔ ɛnze nrenya mɔɔ meyia ye kɛ megya ye meamaa nrenya kokye, Kelaese mumua ne. 3 Noko mesulo kɛ, kɛmɔ ɛwɔlɛ ne vale adalɛ nrɛlɛbɛ bɛlɛbɛlale Yivi la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ bɛbazɛkye bɛ adwenle a, amaa bɛahwe bɛ nwo bɛavi Kelaese ɛzonlenlɛ kpalɛ ne mɔɔ di munli la anwo. 4Ɔluakɛ bɛ nye die awie biala mɔɔ ba bɛ nwo nehane na ɔbabɔ Gyisɛse fofolɛ bie, mɔɔ tɛ yemɔ a ɔle Gyisɛse ne mɔɔ yɛbɔle ye nolo yɛhilele bɛ la anwo edwɛkɛ la anwo. Eza bɛdie sunsum nee edwɛkpa bie mɔɔ asolo bɛ na tɛ Nyamenle Sunsum ne nee Kelaese anwo Edwɛkpa ne mɔɔ bɛnyianle ye bɛvile yɛ lɔ la bɛto nu.
5Menlie menli kɛ bɛ “ɛzoanvolɛma kpalɛ” ne mɔ tɛla me. 6Saa me nloa yɛɛ ɛtɛtele bɔbɔ a, tɛ nwoma nu ɔ; yɛɛ yɛla ɛhye ali wienyi yɛhile bɛ wɔ ndenle dɔɔnwo nee debie biala anu.
7Yemɔti kɛmɔ membɔle Nyamenle Edwɛkpa ne nolo mengilele bɛ mɔɔ meanlie bɛ ɛhwee, na menganle me nwo aze, amaa meamaa bɛ zo la, se ɛnee me ɛtane mɔɔ meyɛ la ɛne? 8Mekɛ mɔɔ meyɛ gyima ne wɔ bɛ avinli la, ɛnee asɔne ne bie mɔ a nea me a, yɛɛ saa meka ye kpalɛ a, ɛnee melɛwua asɔne ne mɔ, amaa meaboa bɛmɛ. 9 Mekɛ mɔɔ me nee bɛ de la, saa mekyia a mengyegye bɛ kɛ bɛboa me; mediema mɔɔ vi Masidonea rale la a rɛlɛle me debie biala mɔɔ mengyianle nwolɛ la a. Na kɛmɔ meanyɛ ye dɛba la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ menrɛva kpomgbolo biala menrɛkpolo bɛ kɔme a. 10Meka Kelaese anwo edwɛkɛ nɔhalɛ ne mɔɔ wɔ me nu la kɛ, me nwo ɛdulɛ ɛhye awie biala ɛnrɛhola ɛnrɛdua me wɔ ɛleka biala wɔ Akaya (Giliki) maanzinli ye anu! 11Duzu ati a melɛka ɛhye a? Mengulo bɛ edwɛkɛ ɔ? Nyamenle ze kɛ mekulo bɛ.
12Mebahɔ zolɛ meayɛ mɔɔ melɛyɛ ye kɛkala la, amaa ɛzoanvolɛma zɔhane mɔ annyia kpɔkɛ angyinla zolɛ andu bɛ nwo kɛ bɛyɛ bɛ gyima, kɛmɔ yɛyɛ ye la. 13Menli zɔhane mɔ le ɛzoanvolɛma alane mɔɔ adalɛ gyima a bɛyɛ a; bɛhakyi bɛ nwo kɛ asɛɛ bɛle Kelaese ɛzoanvolɛma! 14Na ɔnyɛ nwanwane. Seetan bɔbɔ kola kakyi ɔ nwo yɛ kɛ ɔle wienyi nu soanvolɛ. 15Yemɔti ɔnyɛ ɛzulolɛ kɛ Seetan sonvolɛma kɛhakyi bɛ nwo kɛ bɛle Nyamenle sonvolɛma kpalɛ a. Bɛbanyia ninyɛne mɔɔ bɛyɛ la anwo ahatualɛ mɔɔ fɛta la wɔ awieleɛ ne.
Ɛzoanvolɛ Pɔɔlo anwubɛnyunlu
16Mesi zolɛ bieko: bɛ nuhua biala mmadwenle kɛ mele kɔnwɔne; na saa bɛbu me zɔhane bɔbɔ a, ɛnee eza noko bɛlie me kɛ kɔnwɔne, amaa meanyia bie meadu me nwo ekyii. 17Mɔɔ melɛka ye kɛkala la ɛnle edwɛkɛ mɔɔ melua Awulae Tumi zo a melɛka a, ɔluakɛ melɛtendɛ adubɛnwo nu kɛ mele kɔnwɔne. 18Kɛmɔ dɔɔnwo ne ala fa ewiade ye anu ninyɛne tu bɛ nwo la, medame noko metu me nwo bie. 19Bɛmɛ bɛdabɛ, bɛ nrɛlɛbɛ somasoma ti, bɛ nye die kɔnwɔnema anwo. 20Bɛ nye die awie biala mɔɔ yɛ bɛ kɛ ahanra, awie mɔɔ sisi bɛ, awie mɔɔ tu ɔ nloa anu na ɔkpakyekpakye bɛ nye zo la anwo. 21Ɔyɛ me nyiane kɛ melɛka kɛ yɛyɛle foanvoanle na yɛangola ɛhye mɔ bie yɛ a.
Na saa awie kola fa debie tu ɔ nwo a ɛnee kɛmɔ melɛtendɛ kɛ kɔnwɔne la, medame noko mekola bie yɛ. 22Saa bɛle Hibuluma a, medame mele Hibulunli. Saa bɛle Yizilayɛma a, medame mele Yizilayɛnli. Saa bɛle Ebileham nlɔnra a, medame mele Ebileham anlɔnra. 23 Saa bɛle Kelaese sonvolɛma a, ɛnee ɔkɛyɛ kɛ mezɛ bɔbɔ ɛdeɛ, noko mele sonvolɛ kpalɛ metɛla bɛ. Meyɛ gyima ɛsesebɛ kpalɛ, mela efiade fane dɔɔnwo medɛla bɛ, bɛbila me empele fane kɛyɛ nyɛ, yɛɛ mekɛ dɔɔnwo ne ala, ɔhale me nee ewule. 24 Dwuuma ɛbila me mbaka abulasa nee ngɔnla ne fane nnu. 25 Wulomuma ɛbila me empele fane nsa; bɛzi me awolɛ ko, mebutu nyevile nu fane nsa, yɛɛ meminli nyevile nye ko dɔnehwele abulanwiɔ nee nna. 26 Wɔ me adendulɛ dɔɔnwo ne mɔ anu, meyia esiane dɔɔnwo mɔɔ le kɛ azuyilɛ, ahɔdiawu, yɛɛ medame me gɔnwo mɔ Dwuuma, nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la asa anu esiane; meyia azua mgbole zo esiane, esiane wɔ fienemgbole nu, yɛɛ meyia agɔnwolɛma adalɛ asa anu esiane. 27Meli gyima nee mgbelera dɔɔnwo; aleɛ dwo a nafelɛ ɛngɔ me nye zo; ɛhɔne nee nzuhɔne ku me; mekye ɛhɔne, ɛyɛlɛ ku me yɛɛ melɛ me nwo zɔ ɛlɛ. 28Yeanga ɛhye mɔ angome, asɔne asɔne ne mɔ anwo adwenleadwenle le adesoa kpole mɔɔ mezo ye dahuu a. 29Saa awie yɛ bɛtɛɛ a, ɛnee medame me nwo ɛgolo me; yɛɛ saa bɛtwe awie bɛkɔ ɛtane nu a, ɛnee me kunlu yelɛyela me.
30Saa ɔwɔ kɛ metu me nwo a, menwɔyɛ ye zɔhane wɔ ninyɛne mɔɔ kile kɛ mele bɛtɛɛ la anwo. 31Nyamenle mɔɔ le Awulae Gyisɛse ɔ Ze ne, yemɔ yɛɛ nyilalɛ ɛha ye duma ne dahuu a, ɔluakɛ ɔze kɛ membɔ adalɛ. 32 Mekɛ mɔɔ mewɔ Dɛmasekɛse la, Belemgbunli Alɛtase amɛnlado ne vale sinzavolɛma gyinlegyinlanle suakpole ne nlenkɛ mgbole ne mɔ anloa kɛ bɛhye me. 33Na bɛdɛnlanle me kɛndɛne nu bɛwulale me suakpole ne bane ne tokule ne mɔ bie anu bɛdwulale me aze, na menvile ɔ sa.

Title: 2 KƆL 12
Content:
Pɔɔlo ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ nee yekile
1Ɔwɔ kɛ metu me nwo, saa nvasoɛ ɛnle zolɛ bɔbɔ a, ɔwɔ kɛ metu me nwo. Noko meka ninyɛne mɔɔ Awulae ɛlolɛ zo yemaa menwu bɛ nee mɔɔ yeye yehile me la. 2Meze Kelaese ɛdoavolɛ bie mɔɔ ɛvolɛ bulu nee nna mɔɔ ɛraze ɛhɔ la, bɛvale ye bɛhɔle anwuma wɔ Nyamenle anwo lɔ la; (saa nwonane nu o, saa sunsum nu o, menze, Nyamenle a ze a.) 3Mɔɔ meze la a le kɛ bɛvale nrenya ɛhye bɛhɔle Paladaese, (menze saa bɛvale ye nwonane nu o, saa sunsum nu o, Nyamenle a ze a) 4na ɛkɛ ne yɛɛ ɔdele edwɛkɛ mɔɔ bɛka a ɔnga, yɛɛ dasanli biala ɛnlɛ nwolɛ adenle kɛ ɔkɛha a. 5Sonla zɛhae ati yɛɛ metu me nwo a, na ɔhale medame me ngome a, anrɛɛ menrɛdu me nwo ɛlɛ, kyesɛ wɔ ninyɛne mɔɔ kile kɛ mele bɛtɛɛ la anwo. 6Saa mekulo kɛ metu me nwo a anrɛɛ menle kɔnwɔne wɔ nwolɛ, ɔluakɛ menwɔha nɔhalɛ ne. Noko menrɛdu me nwo, ɔboalekɛ memkpondɛ kɛ awie bu me bie maa ɔtɛla mɔɔ yenwu kɛ meyɛ nee mɔɔ yede kɛ meka la, anwo.
7Amaa me ti anu anyɛ me fɛ na meadu me nwo wɔ nwanwane ninyɛne dɔɔnwo ne mɔ mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛye ɛhile me la anwo la, bɛwulale debie me nwonane ye anu, Seetan soanvolɛ bie ɔ, ɔgyegye me na ɔbɛlɛ me aze, amaa meandu me nwo. 8Ɛhye ati menzɛlɛle Nyamenle fane nsa wɔ ɛhye anwo kɛ ɔye zɔhane ewule ne me nwo. 9Na ɔbuale me kɛ, “Me ɛlolɛ ne le kpalɛ maa wɔ, ɔluakɛ me tumi ne anu yɛ se maa wɔ kpalɛ kpalɛ wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛkɛyɛ bɛtɛɛ la.” Yemɔti medi fɛlɛko kpole kpalɛ na metu me nwo wɔ me bɛtɛɛyɛlɛ nwo, amaa Kelaese tumi ne aheda me nwo zo. 10Kelaese ati, me kunlu dwo me nwo wɔ me bɛtɛɛyɛlɛ, aholoba ɛbɔlɛ, ngyegyelɛ, kpɔdekpɔdeyɛlɛ, yɛɛ munzule nu, ɔluakɛ mɔɔ menwɔyɛ bɛtɛɛ la ɛnee me nwo ɛyɛ se kpalɛ.
Kɔlentema anwo hyia Pɔɔlo
11Se bɛnwu kɛ meyɛ kɔnwɔne, noko bɛdabɛ a bɛmaa meyɛ a. Bɛmɛ a bɛle menli mɔɔ anrɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛdie me bɛto nuhua a, ɔluakɛ saa mendo awie biala bɔbɔ a, bɛ “ɛzoanvolɛma zɔhane mɔ” ɛndɛla me wɔ adenle biala anu. 12Menvale abotane kpole a menyɛle ninyɛne mɔɔ kile kɛ mele ɛzoanvolɛ la wɔ bɛ nu a; bɛnwunle sɛkɛlɛneɛ nee nwanwane ninyɛne nee gyima mɔɔ kile Nyamenle tumi ne la amuala. 13Saa ɛye kɛ meangakyi kpomgbolo meamkpolo bɛ kɔme la ɛsie ahane a, ɛnee duzu debie kpalɛ a bɛyɛle bɛmanle asɔne ne mɔ mɔɔ ɛha, mɔɔ bɛanyɛ bɛammaa bɛmɛ a? Saa mevo bɛ wɔ ɛhye anu a, ɛnee bɛva bɛhyɛ me.
14Ye fane nsa mɔɔ meboɔboa me nwo kɛ mebakpɔla bɛ la ɛne; saa meba a menrɛrakpolo bɛ kɔme, ɔluakɛ bɛdabɛ mumua ne a mekpondɛ bɛ a, na tɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛ ye la ɔ. Tɛ mralɛ a kpondɛ sie awovolɛma a, awovolɛma a kpondɛ sie mralɛ a. 15Ɔkɛyɛ me kɛnlɛma kɛ menwɔva mɔɔ melɛ la amuala, nee medame me sonlabaka ne menwɔboa bɛ. Na saa mekulo bɛ edwɛkɛ kpole zɛhae a, ɛnee kɛmɔti yɛɛ bɛmɛ bɛngulo me edwɛkɛ fee ɛ?
16Bɛdabɛ bɛze kɛ meanyɛ kpomgbolo meamkpolo bɛ kɔme, noko bɛmɛ bɛse mele kɛdɛba, na menvale mɛlɛbɛla a mengyele bɛ a. 17Asoo menluale menli mɔɔ menzoanle bɛ la bie anwo zo mensisile bɛ? 18Menzɛlɛle Taetɛse, na menzoanle ye nee adiema nrenya ko wɔ bɛ nwo lɔ, na ɛnee Taetɛse a rasisile bɛ a? Asoo ɔ nee me yɛ adwenle anyɛ ko, yɛɛ yɛmbɔ yɛ ɛbɛla ko?
19Wɔannea a bɛkɛdwenle kɛ yɛbɔ mɔdenle yɛaza yɛ ne wɔ bɛ nyunlu. Ɔnle zɔhane fee! Yɛtendɛ, kɛmɔ Kelaese kulo kɛ yɛtendɛ wɔ Nyamenle anyunlu la. Ayi mɔ, debie biala mɔɔ yɛyɛ la, bɛdabɛ bɛ kpalɛ ti ɔ. 20Mesulo ɔ nzi kɛ meba a menwɔrado bɛ wɔ adenle bie anu mɔɔ menrɛhulo a, anzɛɛ bɛdabɛ noko bɛkɛnwu me wɔ adenle bie anu mɔɔ bɛnrɛhulo a. Mesulo kɛ mebarado bɛ nee butulelilɛ, nungule ɛhwenlɛ, ɛya mgbole ɛvalɛ, angomedi, aholoba ɛbɔlɛ, nzekuebɔlɛ, mgbanyizonle ɛyɛlɛ, yɛɛ basabasayɛlɛ nu. 21Ɔyɛ me kɛ meba bieko a me Nyamenle ne baha me aze wɔ bɛ nyunlu, na meazu meagua bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛyɛle ɛtane na bɛtɛnunle bɛ nwo wɔ bɛ nyɛleɛ mgbane mgbane mɔɔ anwo ɛnde, nee adwɔmanebɔlɛ nwo la ati zo.

Title: 2 KƆL 13
Content:
Pɔɔlo bɔ kɔkɔ na ɔbiza ahye
1 Ɛhye a tɔ zolɛ fane nsa mɔɔ melɛba mearakpɔla bɛ a. Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se, “Ɔwɔ kɛ menli nwiɔ anzɛɛ nsa foa ɛzonle biala mɔɔ bɛkɛdo awie la azo di daselɛ.” 2Mekakye bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛyɛ ɛtane dɛba, nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛha la amuala kɛ, meha ye dɛba wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ membamkpɔlale bɛ mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nwiɔ la, yɛɛ melɛka ye bieko kɛkala mɔɔ menle bɛ nwo lɔ la kɛ, saa meba a bɛ nuhua biala mɔɔ ɛyɛ ɛtane la ɛnrɛva ɔ nwo dwɔɔ. 3Bɛkɛnwu kɛ amgba Kelaese dua me nwo zo tendɛ. Ɔ nee bɛ bali ye ɛsesebɛ na bɛanwu kɛ ɔnle bɛtɛɛ na ɔlɛ tumi. 4Na saa ɔyɛle bɛtɛɛ ɔwule meanubaka ne azo bɔbɔ a, ɔlua Nyamenle tumi zo ɔde ngoane nu. Yɛdayɛ noko yɛle bɛtɛɛ wɔ Kelaese ati, na ɔlua Nyamenle tumi ne azo yɛ nee ye badɛnla na yɛ nee bɛ ali.
5Bɛnleɛnlea bɛ ahonle nu, na bɛnlea kɛ bɛtɛdɛ bɛ diedi ne anu. Bɛzɔ bɛ nwo bɛnlea; asoo bɛnnwu kɛ Kelaese Gyisɛse wɔ bɛ nu? Ɛnee kyesɛ bɛangola sɔnea ne anloa gyinla. 6Me nye la kɛ bɛkɛnwu kɛ yɛnle menli mɔɔ ɛkpo aze a. 7Yɛsɛlɛ Nyamenle kɛ bɛnrɛyɛ ɛtane, tɛ kɛ amaa bɛanwu kɛ yɛho yɛdɔ zolɛ ɔ, na amaa yɛmɛ, saa ɔzɔho kɛ yɛkpo aze bɔbɔ a, bɛmɛ bɛayɛ mɔɔ le fɔɔnwo la. 8Yɛngola yɛnyɛ debie biala yɛntia nɔhalɛ ne. Mɔɔ yɛkola ye yɛ la, yɛyɛ yɛboa nɔhalɛ ne. 9Yɛdi fɛlɛko kɛ bɛkɛyɛ se na yɛmɛ yɛkɛyɛ bɛtɛɛ. Yɛsɛlɛ kɛ bɛkɛli munli. 10Ɛhye ati yɛɛ kɛmɔ menle bɛ nwo lɔ la, melɛkɛlɛ bɛ kɛlata ɛhye a, amaa saa meba a me nee bɛ anli ye ɛsesebɛ, kɛmɔ tumi ne mɔɔ Awulae ɛva ɛmaa me la de la. Bɛ boɛyɛlɛ ti yɛɛ bɛvale tumi ne bɛmanle me a, na tɛ bɛ ɛzɛkyelɛ ti ɔ.
11Mediema, akee mewie, mebiza bɛ ahye. Bɛhakyi bɛ subane; bɛli me folɛdulɛ ne mɔ azo, bɛmaa bɛ nloa ɛzɛ bɛ nwo na bɛdɛnla anzonudwolɛ nu. Na ɛhulolɛ nee anzonudwolɛ Nyamenle ne nee bɛ badɛnla.
12Bɛva mediema ɛhulolɛ bɛyɛ bɛ nwo atuu.
Nyamenle menli ne kɔsɔɔti biza bɛ ahye.
13Awulae Gyisɛse Kelaese ɛlolɛ ne, Nyamenle ɛhulolɛ ne, nee Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza agɔnwolɛyɛlɛ ne nee bɛ muala ɛdɛnla.

Title: GAL MUKENYE
Content:
Mukenye
Mɔɔ bɛbɔle ɔ bo kɛ bɛbɔ Edwɛkpa ne mɔɔ fane Gyisɛse anwo la nolo bɛahile bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma, na bɛyɛle kɛ bɛsɔ nu la, debie ko mɔɔ ragyegyele adwenle la a le kɛ saa ɔhyia kɛ sonla kɛli Mosisi mɛla ne azo kolaa na yeayɛ Kelaese ɛdoavoalɛ kpalɛ a. Pɔɔlo ɛzu ɛhye anwo kpolera kɛ ɔngyia, ɔka ɔsi zolɛ kɛ ngoane mɔɔ ɔlua Kelaese anwo zo bɛnyia ye la gyi diedi zo, na yemɔ ala a menli kɔsɔɔti dua zolɛ sɔ Nyamenle anye a. Noko menli rale Wulomu maanzinli ne mɔɔ wɔ Ehyea la asɔne ne mɔɔ wɔ Galeehyea la anu na bɛratiale Pɔɔlo bɛhanle kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛdi Mosisi mɛla ne azo kolaa na bɛazɔ Nyamenle anye.
Pɔɔlo kɛlata ne mɔɔ ɔhɛlɛle ɔhɔmanle Galeehyeama la, ɔhɛlɛle, amaa yeahwe menli mɔɔ bɛlɛ ngilehilelɛ ɛtane bɛlɛtwe bɛ bɛahɔminli bɛ la yeara nɔhalɛ diedi ne anu. Pɔɔlo bɔ ɔ bo kile kɛ ɔle Gyisɛse Kelaese ɛzoanvolɛ. Ɔsi ye pi kɛ Nyamenle ɔdaye a ɔvɛlɛle ye kɛ ɔrayɛ ɛzoanvolɛ a, na ɔnlua sonla tumi zo, yɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ ɔyɛ ye gyima ne wɔ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la avinli. Akee ɔkɔ zolɛ ɔkilehile nu kɛ diedi ala a saa sonla nyia ye a ɔkɛzɔ Nyamenle anye a. Wɔ mgbakyelɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ li awieleɛ la anu Pɔɔlo kile nu kɛ Kelaese ɛdoavolɛ biala nyɛleɛ lua ɛhulolɛ mɔɔ gyi ye diedi mɔɔ wɔ Kelaese anu la azo.
Mɔɔ wɔ nu la
Ngilenu 1.1-10
Pɔɔlo tumi kɛ ɔle ɛzoanvolɛ 1.11—2.21
Nyamenle ɛlolɛ nwo Edwɛkpa ne 3.1—4.31
Kelaese ɛdoavolɛma fanwodi nee ɛzonlenlɛ 5.1—6.10
Adwulaleɛ 6.11-18

Title: GAL 1
Content:
1Medame Pɔɔlo, mɔɔ Gyisɛse Kelaese nee Nyamenle Selɛ ne mɔɔ dwazole ye vile mɔwuamra anu la ɛvɛlɛ me kɛ menyɛ ɛzoanvolɛ, na tɛ menli a ɛhyehyɛ ɛyɛ me bɛ ɛzoanvolɛ la a melɛkɛlɛ kɛlata ɛhye a. 2Me nee mediema mɔɔ wɔ ɛke la amuala yɛbiza bɛdabɛ asɔnema mɔɔ bɛwɔ Galeehyea maanzinli nu la amuala ahye.
3Nyamenle Selɛ ne nee Awulae Gyisɛse Kelaese ɛlo bɛ na ɔmaa bɛ anzonudwolɛ.
4Gyisɛse Kelaese wule manle yɛ, ɔliele yɛ ɔvile yɛ ɛtane nu, amaa yeaye yɛ yeavi munzule mekɛ ɛhye anu; ɔyɛle ɛhye, ɔluakɛ mɔɔ yɛ Ze Nyamenle ne kpondɛ kɛ ɔyɛ la ɛne. 5Anyunlunyia ɛha Nyamenle dahuu! Amen.
Edwɛkpa ne le kokye
6Ɔyɛ me azibɛnwo kɛ kɛkala angome bɛlɛnriandi bɛavi Nyamenle ne mɔɔ ɔlua Gyisɛse Kelaese ati yelo bɛ na yevɛlɛ bɛ la anwo bɛahɔli edwɛkpa fofolɛ nzi a. 7Nɔhalɛ, Edwɛkpa fofolɛ bieko ɛnle ɛkɛ mɔɔ vi Nyamenle ɛkɛ, kɛ mɔɔ meha mehile bɛ la ala. Menwu kɛ awie mɔ ɛlɛgyegye bɛ azɛkye bɛ adwenle, na bɛahakyi Edwɛkpa ne mɔɔ fane Kelaese anwo la. 8Noko awie biala, saa yɛdayɛ o anzɛɛ Nyamenle soanvolɛma o, mɔɔ bɔ edwɛkpa gyɛne bie nolo ahile bɛ atia mɔɔ yɛha yɛhile bɛ dɛba la, munzule ɛha ye. 9Yɛha, na eza mesi zolɛ bieko kɛ awie biala mɔɔ kɛbɔ edwɛkpa gyɛne bie nolo kɛhile bɛ kɛtia mɔɔ bɛde na bɛlie bɛli la, munzule ɛha ye. 10Ɛnee ɔyɛ bɛ kɛ kɛkala akee mekpondɛ menli nganvolɛ, anzɛɛ Nyamenle nganvolɛ ɔ? Anzɛɛ mekpondɛ me nyunlu wɔ menli nu ɔ? Kyɛkyɛ! Saa mekpondɛ me nyunlu wɔ menli nu a, ɛnee menle Kelaese akɛlɛ.
Kɛ Pɔɔlo zile yɛle Kelaese ɛzoanvolɛ la
11Ayi mɔ, mekakye bɛ adwenle kɛ Edwɛkpa ne mɔɔ mebɔ ye nolo la ɛnvi sonla ɛkɛ. 12Meanlie meanvi awie lɔ, yɛɛ tɛ awie a hilehilele me a. Gyisɛse Kelaese ɔdaye mumua ne a yele hilele me a.
13 Bɛdabɛ bɛde mɔɔ menyɛle wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee meli Dwuuma Nyamenlezonlenlɛ maamɛla ne anzi la. Menyɛle Nyamenle menli ne kpɔdekpɔde memanle ɔbole zolɛ na membɔle mɔdenle kɛ megu asɔne ne. 14 Wɔ me tipɛne ne mɔ anu, biala ɛnle ɛkɛ mɔɔ nee me sɛ wɔ Dwuuma maamɛla ne azo ɛlilɛ nu a, yɛɛ eza me nye bolo yɛ nlenya mɔ ngilehilelɛ ne mɔɔ bɛgyakyile yɛ la anwo ɛsesebɛ kpalɛ.
15 Na amuanrɛɛ wɔ ɛhye mɔ amuala anu, ɛnee Nyamenle ɛye me ɛzie ɛkɛ dɛba ɛmaa ɔ nwo, bɔbɔ kolaa na bɛawo me, yɛɛ akee yelua ye ɛlolɛ zo yevɛlɛ me kɛ mendoa ɔ bo zo na menyɛ ye gyima a. Yemɔti mɔɔ mekɛ ne dwule na ɔbɔle kpɔkɛ 16ɔyele ɔ ra ne ɔhilele me kɛ akee menga Edwɛkpa ne mɔɔ fane Kelaese anwo mengile bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la amuala mɔɔ ɛtɛtele la, meangɔmbiza sonla biala adwenle, 17yɛɛ meangɔ Gyɛlusalɛm bɔbɔ kɛ mekanwu bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛle Kelaese ɛzoanvolɛma mɔɔ bɛli me nyunlu la. Ɛleka mɔɔ mengɔle la a le Areleebea, yɛɛ nzinlii menziale membale Dɛmasekɛse a. 18 Ɛvolɛ nsa anzi yɛɛ akee mengɔle Gyɛlusalɛm mengɔnlile dapɛne nwiɔ mengɔmkpɔlale Pita a. 19Meangɔnwu ɛzoanvolɛ gyɛne bieko kɛ Gyemise mɔɔ le Awulae adiema nrenya ne ala.
20(Nyamenle anyunlu, mɔɔ melɛka la amuala, adalɛ fee ɛnle nu.)
21Nzinlii mengɔle akpɔsa wɔ Selea nee Selesea maanzinli ne mɔ anu. 22Mekɛ ne anu ɛnee asɔnema mɔɔ wɔ Dwudiya la biala ɛnze me. 23Mɔɔ ɛnee bɛze la a le mɔɔ awie mɔ ɛha na bɛde wɔ me nwo la kɛ, “Sonla ne mɔɔ yɛle yɛ kpɔdekpɔde kɛ ɔsɛkye Keleseɛn ɛzonlenlɛ ne la a ɛnɛ ɛlɛbɔ diedi ko ne ala nolo yeahile maanlema kɛ bɛlie Gyisɛse bɛli la!” 24Na ɔlua me ti bɛyele Nyamenle ayɛlɛ.

Title: GAL 2
Content:
Pɔɔlo nee ɛzoanvolɛma ɛhendeɛ ne mɔ
1 Ɛvolɛ bulu nee nna pɛle nu la me nee Banabase yɛhɔle Gyɛlusalɛm bieko. Menvale Taetɛse membokale yɛ nwo yɛhɔle. 2Mengɔle, ɔluakɛ ɛnee Nyamenle ɛye ɛhile me kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ mekɔ. Mengɔndwule la me nee mgbanyima ne mɔ yiale nu ahane na mengilehilele Edwɛkpa ne mɔɔ mebɔ ye nolo mekile bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la anu mengilele bɛ, amaa gyima ɛhye mɔɔ melɛyɛ nee mɔɔ meyɛ ye dɛba la anyɛ gyɛne. 3Na Taetɛse bɔbɔ mɔɔ le Gilikinli na ɔ nee yɛ a hɔle la, bɛanga kɛ ɔyɛ ye mrenyanu nzonlɛ. 4Ɛnee adalɛma bie mɔɔ ɛyɛ bɛ nwo kɛ bɛdie Kelaese bɛdi la ɛpele ɛpe adenle bie azo ɛra ayia ne bie. Menli ɛhye mɔ rale kɛ bɛbanlea kɛ yɛmɛ mɔɔ yɛdie Kelaese Gyisɛse yɛdi la yɛ nwo ɛzi ɛdɔ yɛ la. Bɛ adwenle a le kɛ bɛmaa yɛazia yɛayɛ ahanra wɔ Dwuuma mɛla ne abo, 5na yɛammaa bɛ adenle fee, amaa yɛazie nɔhalɛ ne mɔɔ fane Edwɛkpa ne anwo, kɛmɔ kɛkala ɔde la gyɛlɛɛnye yɛamaa bɛ.
6 Mengilehilele Edwɛkpa ne mɔɔ mebɔ ye nolo la anu menwiele la, menli zɛhae mɔ, mɔɔ bɛse bɛle mgbanyima la anga kɛ debie bieko wɔ ɛkɛ mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ meyɛ a. Bɛle duzu menli bɔbɔ a, ɔnvane me nwo, ɔboalekɛ menli kɔsɔɔti sɛ wɔ Nyamenle anyunlu. 7Mɔɔ bɛnwunle ye la a le kɛ amgba Nyamenle ɛva ye Edwɛkpa ne ɛwula me nloa na yezoa me kɛ membɔ ye nolo mengile bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la, kɛmɔ yeva yewula Pita anloa kɛ ɔbɔ ye nolo ɔhile Dwuuma la. 8Bɛnwunle ye wienyi kɛ Nyamenle ko ne ala mɔɔ manle Pita rayɛle ɛzoanvolɛ wɔ Dwuuma ati la, ye ko ne ala yɛɛ ɛyɛ me ye ɛzoanvolɛ ɛmaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la a. 9Gyemise, Pita, yɛɛ Dwɔn mɔɔ diedima ne bu bɛ kɛ bɛle mgbanyima la liele dole nu kɛ, nɔhalɛ, mame a Nyamenle ɛva ɛlolɛ gyima ɛhye ɛwula me sa nu a. Yemɔti bɛzomanle me nee Banabase, bɛyɛle yɛ mo nee yɛ, bɛhilele kɛ bɛlie yɛ bɛdo nu. Akee yɛ muala yɛliele yɛdole nu kɛ yɛmɛ yɛhɔbɔ nolo ne wɔ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la anu na bɛdabɛ noko bɛhɔ Dwuuma anu. 10Mɔɔ bɛzele yɛ la a le kɛ anrɛɛ yɛhakye na yɛboa mediema mɔɔ le ehyianvolɛma la, na ɛhye a le debie titile mɔɔ me nye bolole nwolɛ kɛ meyɛ a.
Pɔɔlo hwile Pita anyunlu wɔ Anteɔko
11Na mɔɔ Pita rale Anteɔko la, ɔmanle mendwile ɔ nyunlu, ɔluakɛ ɛnee mɔɔ ɔlɛyɛ la ɛnle kpalɛ. 12Alumua ne mɔɔ ɛnee menli bie mɔɔ Gyemise zoanle bɛ la ɛtɛbale la, ɛnee Pita nee mediema mɔɔ ɛnle Dwuuma la a di debie a. Na mɔɔ menli ne mɔ dwule ala la yɛɛ Pita hwenle ɔ nwo a, kɛ akee ɔ nee bɛ ɛnrɛdo ɛsalɛ bieko, ɔboalekɛ ɔsulo bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ adwenle a le kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛyɛ bɛ mrenyanu nzonlɛ la. 13Mediema Dwuuma mɔɔ ɔradole bɛ la, bɛdabɛ noko bɛyɛle bɛ nwo avoanvoanle kɛ Pita la, bɛmanle Banabase bɔbɔ ɔdaye ɔbɔle bɛ foanvoanle ɛbɛla ɛhye bie. 14Na menwunle kɛ bɛnlua nɔhalɛ adenle ne azo, kɛmɔ Edwɛkpa ne kile la, menzele Pita wɔ bɛ kɔsɔɔti bɛ nyunlu ɛkɛ ne kɛ, “Ɛle Dwuunli, noko wɔ ɛbɛla ne ɛngile kɛ ɛle Dwuunli. Na duzu ati a akee ɛkpondɛ kɛ bɛmɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la bɛkakyi bɛyɛ Dwuuma mgbemgbene nu ɛ?”
Diedi a die Dwuuma nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la ngoane a
15Ɔle nɔhalɛ kɛ bɛwole yɛ Dwuuma, na yɛnle kɛ menli mɔɔ ɛnle Dwuuma mɔɔ ɛnze Nyamenle la. 16 Noko mɔɔ yɛnwu ye la a le kɛ, tɛ mɛla ne azo ɛlilɛ yɛɛ maa sonla sɔ Nyamenle anye a, kyesɛ yɛdie Gyisɛse Kelaese yɛdi kolaa na yɛazɔ Nyamenle anye. Yɛdayɛ bɔbɔ, yɛliele Kelaese Gyisɛse yɛlile kolaa na Nyamenle alua zolɛ yeamaa yɛazɔ ɔ nye, na tɛ mɛla ne mɔɔ yɛlile zolɛ la ati ɔ. Ɔluakɛ sonla biala mɔɔ di mɛla ne azo la ɛnrɛzɔ Nyamenle anye ɛlɛ. 17Saa yɛdayɛ mɔɔ yɛdie Kelaese Gyisɛse yɛali na yɛazɔ Nyamenle anye la eza yɛdi fɔlɛ a, se ɛnee Kelaese a twehwe yɛ kɔ ɛtane nu a? Egya ɛkpa ɛgua! 18Saa mekpo mɛla adenle ne na eza mesia me nzi kɛ akee medi mɛla ne azo a, ɛnee mehile kɛ medi fɔlɛ na medo mɛla ne. 19Mame, mɛla ne anyunlu a, mewu; mɛla ne a hunle me a, amaa meadɛnla ngoane nu meamaa Nyamenle. 20Me nee Kelaese a bɛhunle yɛ wɔ meanubaka ne azo a, yemɔti saa mede ngoane nu a ɛnee tɛ medame ɔ, na Kelaese mɔɔ de me nu la ɔ. Ngoane ɛhye mɔɔ mede nu la, mede ye kɛ medie Nyamenle Ara ne mɔɔ hulole me na ɔdole ye ngoane aze ɔmanle me la medi la ati ɔ. 21Nyamenle ɛlo me kpole, yemɔti menrɛkpo ye amunli. Ɔluakɛ saa sonla di mɛla ne azo kolaa na yeazɔ Nyamenle anye a, ɛnee noko Kelaese wule ewule mgbane.

Title: GAL 3
Content:
Mɛla anzɛɛ diedi
1O Galeehyeama ahɔnwɔne! Nwane a ɛhye bɛ sili a? Asoo bɛngakye mɔɔ bɛhanle bɛhilele bɛ, mɔɔ fane kɛ ɔzile ɔyɛle mɔɔ bɛhunle Gyisɛse Kelaese wɔ meanubaka ne azo la? 2Bɛha ko ɛhye bɛmaa mendie, asoo mɛla ne mɔɔ bɛlile zo la ati a Nyamenle vale ye Sunsum ne manle bɛ a, anzɛɛ bɛdiele Edwɛkpa ne na bɛliele bɛlile la ati ɔ? 3Duzu ati a bɛde bɛ nwo bɛdo zɛhae ɛ? Bɛbɔle ɔ bo kɛnlɛma wɔ Nyamenle Sunsum ne anu, na kɛ ɔyɛle mɔɔ bɛlɛwie ye nwonane nu ɛ? 4Anzɛɛ bɛkpondɛ kɛ mɔɔ bɛnwu ye nee mɔɔ bɛnyia ye la amuala yɛ mgbane ɔ? Ɔnle kɛ ɔba ye zɔhane fee! 5Yemɔti bɛdwenle kɛ Nyamenle fa ye Sunsum ne amaa bɛ, yeava bɛ yeayɛ nwanwane ninyɛne yeahile kɛ bɛlile mɛla ne azo, anzɛɛ bɛdie Edwɛkpa ne na bɛlie bɛli la ati ɔ?
6 Bɛhɛlɛ ye wɔ Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne anu kɛ, “Ebileham liele Nyamenle lile, na ɔlua ye diedi ti ɔzɔle Nyamenle anye.” 7 Ɛhye ati bɛkola bɛnwu kɛ Ebileham nlɔnra kpalɛ ne a le bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdie Nyamenle bɛdi la. 8 Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se, “Nyamenle balua bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la diedi zo yeamaa bɛazɔ ɔ nye.” Ɛhye kile kɛ Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne lumuale nwunle ye, na ɔbɔle Edwɛkpa ne nolo ɔhilele Ebileham kɛ, “Ɛ nwo zo yɛɛ Nyamenle balua ayila maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti a.” 9Ebileham liele lile na bɛyilale ye. Zɔhane ala yɛɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdie bɛdi la amuala nyia nyilalɛ a.
10 Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdwenle kɛ bɛdi mɛla ne azo na bɛazɔ Nyamenle anye la ɛnwu amaneɛ. Ɔluakɛ Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se, “Awie biala mɔɔ anli mɛla ne ngyehyɛlɛ ne amuala azo, kɛmɔ bɛhɛlɛ ye wɔ Nyamenle Mɛla buluku ne anu la, munzule ɛha ye.” 11 Kɛkala, yɛnwu ye wienyi kɛ awie ko biala ɛnrɛhola ɛnrɛli mɛla ne amuala azo na yeazɔ Nyamenle anye, ɔluakɛ Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se, “Sonla ne mɔɔ kɛlie Nyamenle kɛli na ɔkɛzɔ ɔ nye la a banyia ngoane a.” 12 Noko mɛla ne azo ɛlilɛ nee Nyamenle mɔɔ ɛdie ye wɔali la ɛnle ko. Ɔluakɛ, Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se, “Awie mɔɔ di mɛla ne amuala azo la a banyia ngoane a.”
13 Kelaese ɛralie ndeanlɛ muala, na yelie yɛ yevi munzule mɔɔ anrɛɛ mɛla ne fa yɛ ahɔ nu la anu, ɔluakɛ Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se, “Mɔɔ bɛkɛhenda ye wɔ baka zo la munzule ɛha ye.” 14Bɛhendanle Kelaese wɔ baka zo wɔ yɛmɛ yɛ ti, amaa ɔlua ɔ nwo zo bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la bɛanyia nyilalɛ ne mɔɔ Nyamenle vale bɔle Ebileham ɛwɔkɛ la bie, na kɛmɔ yɛdie Kelaese yɛdi la ati yɛ muala yɛ sa aha ye Sunsum ne mɔɔ ɔvale ɔbɔle yɛ ɛwɔkɛ la.
Mɛla ne nee ɛwɔkɛ ne
15Mediema, memaa bɛ ndonwo ko na bɛnlea: Saa menli nwiɔ kponle ngyehyɛlɛ bie azo na bɛkye ɔ bo a, awie ɛngola ɛnzɛkye ye anzɛɛ ɛnva bie ɛmboka nwolɛ. 16 Nyamenle bɔle ɛwɔkɛ ne manle Ebileham nee ye anlɔnra. Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne ɛnga kɛ “ye nlɔnra,” mɔɔ kile kɛ nlɔnra ne mɔ zonle a. Ɔse “ye anlɔnra,” mɔɔ kile anlɔnra kokye, na anlɔnra ɛhye, yemɔ a le Kelaese. 17 Mɔɔ meka la a le kɛ, Nyamenle nee Ebileham yɛle ngyehyɛlɛ ne na bɛhyele ɔ bo la, ɔ nzi ɛvolɛ ɛya nna abulasa yɛɛ bɛvale mɛla ne bɛmanle Dwuuma a. Ɛhye ati mɛla ne ɛngola ɛntulu ngyekyeleɛ ne na ɔnzɛkye Nyamenle ɛwɔkɛ ne. 18 Ɔluakɛ saa Nyamenle ahyɛlɛdeɛ ne gyi mɛla ne azo ɛlilɛ zo a ɛnee noko ɔnle ahyɛlɛdeɛ mɔɔ gyi ye ɛwɔkɛ ne azo a. Na ɔle nɔhalɛ kɛ ye ɛwɔkɛ ne mɔɔ ɔbɔle Ebileham la ati a Nyamenle ɛmaa ahyɛlɛdeɛ mɔɔ le zɛhae la a.
19Saa ɔle zɛhae a ɛnee mɛla ne kpɔkɛ mɔɔ gyi zolɛ la a le boni? Nyamenle vale mɛla ne manle, amaa sonla anwu ɛtane deɛ holɛ. Mɛla ne hilehilele yɛ ekyii hɔdwule kɛ Ebileham anlɔnra ne mɔɔ yemɔti bɛbɔle ɛwɔkɛ ne la rale la. Nyamenle manle ye soanvolɛma a vale mɛla ne luale sonla nwo zo rale a. 20Ɛwɔkɛ ne ɛdeɛ, ɔdaye Nyamenle mumua ne yɛɛ ɔbɔle a, yeanva yeanlua awie anwo zo.
Mɛla ne gyima
21Ɛnee ɛhye kile kɛ mɛla ne tia Nyamenle ɛwɔkɛ ne mɔ ɔ? Kyɛkyɛ, ɔnle zɔhane fee. Saa mɛla bie wɔ ɛkɛ mɔɔ zolɛ ɛlilɛ maa menli ngoane a, anrɛɛ awie mɔɔ kɛli zolɛ la kɛzɔ Nyamenle anye. 22Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se ɛtane gyale ewiade amuala; ɛhye ati bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdie Gyisɛse Kelaese bɛdi la angome a Nyamenle bava ye ɛwɔkɛ ne mɔɔ ɔbɔle la yeamaa bɛ a.
23Mɔɔ ɛnee bɛtɛbukele diedi adenle ne la, mɛla ne bɔle yɛ kpanwu hɔdwule kɛ bɛbukele diedi adenle ne la. 24Mɛla ne dɛnlanle yɛ nwo zo kpalɛ hɔdwule mekɛ mɔɔ Kelaese rale la, amaa saa yɛdie ye yɛdi a, yɛazɔ Nyamenle anye. 25Kɛkala mɔɔ diedi mekɛ ne ɛra la, saa yɛdie Kelaese yɛdi a mɛla ne ɛnrɛdɛnla yɛ nwo zo bieko.
26Bɛhakye ɛhye: Bɛlie Gyisɛse bɛli la ati bɛ kɔsɔɔti bɛ nee Gyisɛse Kelaese ɛbɔ nu ɛyɛ Nyamenle amra. 27Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛzɔne bɛ wɔ Kelaese duma nu la ɛva Kelaese agyakɛ. 28Zɔhane ati ngakyile biala ɛnle Dwuuma nee sonla mɔɔ ɛnle Dwuunli la avinli, akɛlɛ nee dehelɛ, anzɛɛ nrenya nee raalɛ avinli. Ɔluakɛ Kelaese ati bɛ muala bɛle menli ko. 29 Saa bɛle Kelaese ɛdeɛ a, ɛnee bɛle Ebileham nlɔnra mɔɔ asa baha Nyamenle ahyɛlɛdeɛ ne mɔɔ ɔvale ɔbɔle ɛwɔkɛ ne la a.

Title: GAL 4
Content:
1Na bɛmaa mengile ɛhye anu bieko; ɔle kɛ kakula mɔɔ ɛli agya la. Mekɛ mɔɔ ɔle kakula la, ɔde ye kɛ asɛɛ ɔle akɛlɛ la wɔ sua nu ɛkɛ, noko ɔdaye a ɔlɛ debie biala mɔɔ wɔ awuke ne anu la a. 2Ye ngakula nu, ɔlɛ sonla mɔɔ nea ye nee ye ninyɛne ne mɔ azo a, kɔkpula mekɛ mɔɔ ɔ ze ne mɔɔ ɔlile ye agya la hilele la. 3Zɔhane ala yɛɛ yɛdayɛ noko yɛde a; mɔɔ ɛnee yɛle ngakula wɔ sunsum nu la yɛyɛle ngakula yɛmanle ewiade ye anu tumi muala. 4Na mɔɔ mekɛ ne dwule la, Nyamenle zoanle ɔ Ra ne manle ɔrale ewiade. Raalɛ a nrenzɛle Ralɛ ɛhye a, na ɔwole ye ɔdole Dwuuma maamɛla ne anu, 5 kɛ ɔralie bɛdabɛ mɔɔ mɛla ne ɛlɛbu bɛ kɔme la, amaa bɛarayɛ Nyamenle amra.
6Kɛmɔ bɛle ɔ mra la, Nyamenle ɛzoa ɔ Ra ne Sunsum ne yemaa yerayi yɛ ahonle ne mɔ tɛkɛɛ, yemɔti yɛkola yɛka kɛ, “Egya! Me Papa!” 7Ɛhye kile kɛ bɛnle ngɛkɛlɛ bieko, na bɛle Selɛ ne amra. Na saa bɛle ɔ mra a, ɛnee bɛdi agya.
Pɔɔlo dwenle Galeehyeama anwo
8Dɛba ne mɔɔ bɛnze Nyamenle la, ɛnee bɛle ngɛkɛlɛ bɛmaa ninyɛne mgbane mgbane mɔɔ ɔnle kɛ bɛsonle bɛ la. 9Kɛkala mɔɔ bɛnwu Nyamenle la anzɛɛ bɛmaa menga kɛ, kɛkala mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛkpondɛ bɛ bo zo la, duzu ati a eza bɛkulo kɛ bɛsia bɛkɔsonle sunsum ɛtane ɛtane, anwo anwunvɔne ɛhye mɔ bieko ɛ? Duzu ati a eza bɛkulo kɛ bɛsia bɛyɛ bɛ nwo ngɛkɛlɛ bɛmaa bɛ ɛ? 10Bɛsie kenle, siane, ɛlobɔ, yɛɛ ɛvolɛ mɔɔ ko biala ɛvoyia dwu a bɛdi na bɛkyi ɔ nloa a. 11Ɔyɛ me kɛ bɛmaa mevɛ mgbane!
12Me mediema, mesɛlɛ bɛ, bɛva me gyakɛ, ɔluakɛ mele kɛ bɛdabɛ la. Bɛtɛyɛle me ɛtane biala. 13Bɛdabɛ bɛze kɛ me nwo mɔɔ dole me la ati a menyianle adenle membɔle Edwɛkpa ne nolo mengilele bɛ a. 14Noko mekɛ ne anu bɔbɔ mɔɔ ɛnee me anwondolɛ ne kpondɛ ayɛ dwɛwɔlɛ amaa bɛ la, bɛamkpo me. Bɛliele me kɛmɔ bɛkɛlie Nyamenle soanvolɛ anzɛɛ Kelaese Gyisɛse ɔdaye mumua ne la. 15Na kɛkala, bɛ atiakunlukɛnlɛma ne wɔ nienwu? Ɛnee medi daselɛ kɛ saa bɛyɛ na ɔkɛyɛ boɛ bɔbɔ a, anrɛɛ bɛdudule bɛ nye bɛmanle me. 16Na kɛ ɔyɛ mɔɔ kɛkala angome bɛmaa meyɛ bɛ kpɔvolɛ kɛ meha nɔhalɛ ne mehile bɛ la ɛ?
17Menli zɔhane mɔ yɛ kɛ asɛɛ bɛ nye die bɛ nwo, noko tɛ adenle kpalɛ zo a bɛ nee bɛ lua la! Mɔɔ menli zɔhane mɔ kpondɛ la a le kɛ bɛkɛhwe bɛ bɛkɛvi me nwo, amaa bɛdabɛ noko bɛ nye alie bɛmɛ bɛ nwo. 18Ɔle kpalɛ kɛ menli kɛnyia bɛ nwo ɛhulolɛ, noko bɛmaa ɔyɛ zɔhane wɔ adenle kpalɛ nu, na bɛyɛ ye zɔhane dahuu, bɔbɔ wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ me nee bɛ ɛnde la. 19O me mra ngakula, medi bɛ nwo nyane, na mete ye wɔ me nwonane nu kɛ raalɛ mɔɔ ɛvo awolɛ zo la, na ɔbahɔ zo zɔhane kɔkpula mekɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛnyia Kelaese su ne wɔ bɛ nu la. 20Me kunlu a anrɛɛ me nee bɛ a wɔ lɔ a, na meanwu mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ meka la. Medwenle bɛ nwo somaa!
Heega nee Sɛla
21Bɛmaa membiza bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkulo kɛ bɛboa mɛla ne abo la kɛ, asoo bɛnde mɔɔ mɛla mumua ne se la? 22 Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se Ebileham wole mralɛ mrenya nwiɔ. Ko ɔ nli le akɛlɛ yɛɛ ko ɔ nli le dehelɛ. 23Ebileham nee ɔ ye akɛlɛ ne bɛ ra ne, bɛwole ye kɛ bɛwo ralɛ biala la, na ɔ nee dehelɛ ne bɛ ra ne, yemɔ bɛluale Nyamenle ɛwɔkɛ zo a bɛwole ye a. 24Debie zɛhae ka yɛ edwɛkɛ mɔɔ ndelebɛbo wɔ nu a: mraalɛ nwiɔ ne gyi ɛkɛ maa ngyekyeleɛ nwiɔ. Raalɛ ne mɔɔ wole ɔ mra ɛdeɛ ne wɔ akɛlɛ ɛzonlenlɛ nu la a le Heega; ɔgyi ɛkɛ ɔmaa ngyekyeleɛ ne mɔɔ bɛyɛle ye wɔ Boka Saenae azo la. 25Yemɔti Heega gyi ɛkɛ maa Boka Saenae mɔɔ wɔ Areleebea la, na yemɔ a le ɛnɛ mekɛ ye suakpole Gyɛlusalɛm. Ɔ nee menli mɔɔ wɔ zolɛ la amuala wɔ akɛlɛ ɛzonlenlɛ bo. 26Na suakpole Gyɛlusalɛm kpalɛ ne mɔɔ wɔ anwuma la ɛnle akɛlɛ ɛzonlenlɛ bo. Yemɔ ɔle dehelɛ, na ɔle yɛ sua zo kpalɛ nee yɛ nli. 27 Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se,
“Wɔmɔ raalɛ mɔɔ ɛtɛwole ɛlɛ a,
wɔmɔ mɔɔ ɛtɛtele awolɛ nyane ɛlɛ a,
di fɛlɛko, maa ɛ nye ɛlie,
ɔluakɛ raalɛ ne mɔɔ bɛkpole ye la,
lɛ mralɛ dɔɔnwo tɛla raalɛ ne mɔɔ
lɛ agyalɛ mumua ne la.”
28Mediema, ɛwɔkɛ ne mɔɔ Nyamenle bɔle Ebileham la ati, yɛle ɔdaye Nyamenle ɔ mra, kɛmɔ Ayezeke de la. 29 Mekɛ ne anu ralɛ ne mɔɔ bɛwole ye kɛ bɛwo ralɛ biala la yɛle mɔɔ bɛluale Nyamenle Sunsum ne tumi zo bɛwole ye la kpɔdekpɔde. Zɔhane ala noko yɛɛ kɛkala ɔde a. 30 Na Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se duzu? Ɔse, “To akɛlɛ ne nee ɔ ra ne adenle zo, ɔluakɛ akɛlɛ ralɛ nee dehelɛ ralɛ ɛmbɔ nu ɛnli agya.” 31Yemɔti, mediema, bɛnwu ye kɛ yɛnle akɛlɛ ne amra na yɛle dehelɛ ne amra.

Title: GAL 5
Content:
Bɛzɔ bɛ fanwodi ne anu boɛ
1Yɛlɛ fanwodi; Kelaese ɛraye yɛ kɔme kpomgbolo. Yemɔti, bɛgyinla kpundii kɛ bɛdi bɛ ti anwo, na bɛmmamaa adenle bɛmaa bɛyɛ bɛ ngɛkɛlɛ bieko.
2Bɛdie! Medame Pɔɔlo yɛɛ melɛka meahile bɛ a. Saa bɛmaa adenle bɛmaa bɛyɛ bɛ mrenyanu nzonlɛ a, ɛnee bɛhile kɛ Kelaese anwo ɛnlɛ nvasoɛ ɛmmaa bɛ. 3Mekakye bɛ bieko, mɔɔ kɛmaa adenle kɛmaa bɛkɛyɛ ye mrenyanu nzonlɛ la ɛmaa adenle kɛ mɛla ne ɛkyekye ye, na ɔwɔ kɛ ɔdi mɛla ne amuala azo. 4Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdwenle kɛ bɛdi mɛla ne azo a bɛkɛzɔ Nyamenle anye la ɛhwe bɛ nwo ɛvi Kelaese anwo, na bɛnrɛnyia Nyamenle ɛlolɛ ne bie. 5Yɛmɛ, ɔlua Nyamenle Sunsum ne azo, kɛmɔ yɛdie Kelaese Gyisɛse yɛdi la ati, yɛ nye la kɛ Nyamenle ɔdaye ɔbamaa yɛazɔ ɔ nye. 6Ɔluakɛ saa yɛ nee Kelaese Gyisɛse yɛ ko a, yɛyɛ yɛ mrenyanu nzonlɛ o, yɛanyɛ o, ɔngyia. Mɔɔ hyia la a le kɛ yɛkɛnyia diedi mɔɔ fa ɛhulolɛ yɛ gyima la.
7Alumua ne ɛnee bɛlɛbɔ mɔdenle kpalɛ! Na nwane a ɛze bɛ kɛ bɛmmadie nɔhalɛ ne bɛdi a? 8Tɛ Nyamenle mɔɔ ɛvɛlɛ bɛ la a eza ɛze bɛ kɛ bɛyɛ ɛhye a. 9 Amgba, ɔle kɛ mɔɔ bɛka la, “Fɛlɛ ko dɔ sonlɛ na ɔla fɛlɛ dɔɔnwo avinli a, ɔsɛkye bɛ muala.” 10Melɛ diedi wɔ Awulae anu kɛ bɛnrɛnyia adwenle fofolɛ biala kɛ me ɛdeɛ ne ala. Na ahenle holɛ ko mɔɔ ɔdaye ɔse ɔkɛgyegye bɛ la, Nyamenle badua ye kakɛ!
11Na mediema, asoo medame, saa mrenyanu nzonlɛyɛlɛ yɛɛ mebɔ nwolɛ nolo a anrɛɛ ɛnee duzu ati a bɛlɛyɛ me kpɔdekpɔde ɛ? Anrɛɛ Kelaese meanubaka ne mɔɔ mebɔ nwolɛ nolo la ɛnyɛ ngyegyelɛ biala ɛmmaa awie biala. 12Me kunlu a anrɛɛ menli mɔɔ ɛlɛgyegye bɛ la kɛhɔ zo zɛhae ala na bɛkɛza bɛ nwo bɔbɔ.
13Na bɛmɛ me mediema, Nyamenle ɛvɛlɛ bɛ, ɛye bɛ kɔme kpomgbolo. Yemɔti bɛmmadi bɛ atiakunluwɔzo nzi na bɛfa bɛ fanwodi ne bɛyɛ mɔɔ bɛdabɛ bɛkulo la. Bɛva ɛhulolɛ bɛzonle bɛ nwo ngoko. 14 Ɔluakɛ mɛla ne amuala, bɛbɔ ye kpɔkɛ ko bɛmaa yɛ kɛ, “Kulo ɛ gɔnwo kɛ ɛdawɔ mumua ne ɛ nwo.” 15Na saa bɛyɛ bɛ nwo kɛ ɛbɔ nu nane, bɛkeka bɛ nwo, na bɛyɛ bɛ nwo anwula a, ɛnee noko bɛnlea boɛ na bɛanguhu bɛ nwo.
Nyamenle Sunsum ne nee sonla su ne
16Mɔɔ meka meahile bɛ la a le kɛ, bɛmaa Nyamenle Sunsum ne ɛhilehile bɛ adenle na bɛmmadi bɛ nwonane ne atiakunluwɔzo nzi. 17 Ɔluakɛ sonla atiakunluwɔzo ne ko tia Nyamenle Sunsum ne, yɛɛ Nyamenle Sunsum ne ɛhulolɛdeɛ ne ko tia sonla atiakunluwɔzo ne. Bɛ mu nwiɔ bɛnga fee, amaa bɛdabɛ noko bɛanyɛ mɔɔ bɛkulo kɛ bɛyɛ la. 18Saa bɛmaa Nyamenle Sunsum ne kile bɛ adenle a, mɛla ne ɛngola ɛnkyekye bɛ bieko.
19Sonla su ne gyima mɔɔ di la da ali wienyi. Bɛmɛ a le adwɔmane, ɛbɛla mgbane mgbane mɔɔ anwo ɛnde la ɛbɔlɛ, 20bozonle ɛzonlenlɛ nee ayɛne ɛbɛla. Ɛkpɔlɛ, konle, nungule, ɛya, angomedi, ngyehyɛnu nee ngilehilenu, 21anyebolo, kɔdiawuyɛlɛ, nza ɛbolɛ, anyelielɛ mgbane mgbane nee ninyɛne mɔɔ le zɛhae mɔ la. Meha mehile bɛ dɛba, na eza mekakye bɛ bieko kɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛyɛ ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ la ɛnrɛnwu Nyamenle Belemgbunlililɛ ne.
22Nyamenle Sunsum ne ma a le ɛhye mɔ: ɛhulolɛ, anyelielɛ, anzonudwolɛ, abotane, atiakunlukɛnlɛmayɛlɛ, kpalɛyɛlɛ, nɔhalɛlilɛ, 23mɛlɛbɛnwoaze, yɛɛ bɛ nwo zo ɛhomolɛ. Ɛhye mɔ, mɛla biala ɛnle ɛkɛ mɔɔ tia bɛ a. 24Bɛmɛ mɔɔ bɛle Kelaese Gyisɛse ɛdeɛ la, ɛbɔ bɛ su dɛba ne nee bɛ nwonane ne atiakunluwɔzo mgbane mgbane ne mɔ amuala meanubaka nu. 25Saa Nyamenle Sunsum ne ɛmaa yɛ ngoane a, ɛnee bɛmaa Sunsum ne ɛli yɛ nyunlu wɔ yɛ ɛbɛlabɔlɛ nu. 26Ɔnle kɛ yɛmemaa yɛ nwo zo, yɛka yɛ gɔnwo mɔ ɛya, na yɛ nye bolo bɛ.

Title: GAL 6
Content:
Bɛsosɔ bɛ nwo ngoko
1Mediema, saa bɛnwu awie mɔɔ ɛlɛyɛ ɛtane a, bɛdabɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle Sunsum ne wɔ bɛ nu la ɛdenrɛ ye, noko anrɛɛ bɛyɛ ye bɛtɛɛ wɔ adenle kɛnlɛma nu. Bɛdabɛ noko bɛnlea bɛ nwo boɛ na bɛanyɛ mɔɔ ahenle yɛle la bie. 2Bɛsosɔ bɛ nwo ngoko, na bɛyɛ ye zɔhane a ɛnee bɛlɛdi Kelaese mɛla ne azo. 3Saa awie bu ɔ nwo noko ɔndo ɛhwee a, ɛnee ɔlɛbɛlɛbɛla ɔ nwo. 4Awie biala ɔdaye ɔwɔ kɛ ɔbua ye nyɛleɛ nwo ndɛne, na saa ɔle kpalɛ a yeava mɔɔ yeyɛ la yeadu ɔ nwo; ɔmmafa awie ɛdeɛ mɔɔ ɛyɛ la ɔto ye ɛdeɛ ne anwo. 5Ɔluakɛ awie biala ɔdaye ɔbazoa ye adesoa.
6Bɛmaa awie mɔɔ bɛlɛmaa ye Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ nwo ngilehilelɛ la ɛmaa ye kilehilevolɛ ne debie kpalɛ biala mɔɔ ɔkɛnyia ye la bie.
7Bɛmmabɛlɛbɛla bɛ nwo; bɛnzi Nyamenle amgbu, ɔluakɛ mɔɔ sonla kɛlua la yɛɛ ɔbu a; 8ɔluakɛ, mɔɔ kɛli ye nwonane ne atiakunluwɔzo nzi la banyia ewule. Na mɔɔ di Nyamenle Sunsum ne anzi la balua Sunsum ne azo anyia ngoane mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ. 9Bɛmaa yɛhɔ zolɛ yɛyɛ kpalɛ; ɔluakɛ saa yɛangyakyi nyele ɛyɛlɛ a, kenle bie yɛbanwu ɔ bo aleɛ. 10Zɔhane ati, kenle biala mɔɔ mekɛ kɛra kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ yɛyɛ nyele la, bɛmaa yɛyɛ yɛmaa awie biala, bɔbɔ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ yɛ nee bɛ yɛ muala yɛlɛ diedi ko la.
Kɔkɔbɔlɛ nee ahyebizalɛ
11Bɛnlea kɛ mezi meva me sa anloa mgbole ye melɛkɛlɛ bɛ la. 12Menli mɔɔ ɛlɛka ye ndinlizo kɛ bɛyɛ bɛ mrenyanu nzonlɛ la kulo kɛ bɛkile bɛ nwo ala kɛ bɛze amaamuo. Bɛyɛ bie zɔhane ala, amaa awie anyɛ bɛ kpɔdekpɔde kɛ bɛlɛka Kelaese ewule mɔɔ ɔwule meanubaka ne azo la anwo edwɛkɛ. 13Bɛdabɛ mumua ne mɔɔ bɛ nye ɛbolo mrenyanu nzonlɛyɛlɛ nwo bɔbɔ la, bɛnli mɛla ne azo nretee zɛhae. Bɛkulo kɛ bɛmɛ Galeehyeama bɛyɛ bɛ mrenyanu nzonlɛ, amaa bɛanyia bie bɛadu bɛ nloa anu kɛ bɛmɛ a bɛmaa bɛlɛdi zɛhae mɛla ne azo a. 14Na mame, ɔkɛbɔ me tɔ kɛ menwɔdu me nloa anu a kyesɛ debie ko anwo ala, yemɔ a le Awulae Kelaese Gyisɛse meanubaka ne. Ɔluakɛ ye meanubaka ne ati, ewiade le debie funli maa me, yɛɛ medame mumua ne mewu memaa ewiade. 15Saa ɔwɔ kɛ awie yɛ ye mrenyanu nzonlɛ o, saa ɔnle kɛ ɔyɛ o, ɔle debie mɔɔ ɛngyia fee a. Mɔɔ hyia la a le kɛ yɛkɛyɛ menli fofolɛ bɔkɔɔ. 16Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdi zɛhae ngyehyɛlɛ fofolɛ ne azo la, bɛmɛ nee Nyamenle menli kɔsɔɔti, yɛɛ yɛsɛlɛ kɛ ɔdaye Nyamenle ɔnwu bɛ anwunvɔne na ɔmaa bɛdɛnla anzonudwolɛ nu a.
17Ɔvi ɛnɛ mɔɔ kɔ la awie biala mmagyegye me bieko, ɔboalekɛ ahapenle mɔɔ wɔ me nwo la kile kɛ mele Kelaese Gyisɛse akɛlɛ.
18Me mediema, yɛ Awulae Gyisɛse Kelaese ɛlo bɛ na ɔ nee bɛ muala ɛdɛnla! Amen.

Title: ƐFƐ MUKENYE
Content:
Mukenye
Pɔɔlo kɛlata ne mɔɔ ɔhɛlɛle ɔhɔmanle Ɛfɛsɛsema la gyi “Nyamenle ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔɔ kile kɛ ɔfa ewiade amuala, debie biala mɔɔ wɔ anwuma nee aze la, yeabɔ nu na yeava Kelaese yeazie ɔ ti” la azo ɛsesebɛ (1.10). Eza ɔle nzɛlɛlɛ ɔvale ɔhɔmanle Nyamenle menli ne kɛ bɛdɛnla, kɛmɔ ngyehyɛlɛ ɛhye de la. Ngyehyɛlɛ ne a le kɛ aleɛabo amra amuala kɛli ahua na bɛ nee Gyisɛse Kelaese kɛyɛ ko.
Ɛfɛsɛsema kɛlata ne abobɔlɛ, kɛlɛvolɛ ne luale adenle mɔɔ Nyamenle Selɛ ne ɛlua zolɛ ɛkpa nu ɛye menli la azo hanle ahualilɛ nwo edwɛkɛ nee kɛ Nyamenle si dua Gyisɛse Kelaese, Ralɛ ne anwo zo fa bɛ ɛtane kyɛ bɛ na ɔdie bɛ ɔfi bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ anu la anwo edwɛkɛ. Eza ɔhilele kɛ Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne si si Nyamenle ɛwɔkɛ ne dawua la. Mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nwiɔ la, ɔzɛlɛle ye kengavolɛma kɛ Kelaese ati bɛdɛnla adenle mɔɔ kɛmaa bɛ koyɛlɛ kɛli munli na ɔkɛvinde bɛ ɛbɛla nu la azo.
Ɛdendɛlɛ ndonwo dɔɔnwo wɔ kɛlata ne anu mɔɔ kile kɛ Kelaese ati Nyamenle menli ne le ko a. Bie mɔ a le ɛhye mɔ; asɔne ne le kɛ sonlabaka, ɔ ti a le Kelaese; anzɛɛ ɔle kɛ sua, na Kelaese a le ye mgbɛnezo sika ne mɔɔ anwo hyia la, anzɛɛ ɔle kɛ yelɛ la, ɔ hu a le Kelaese. Nyamenle ɛlolɛ ne mɔɔ Kelaese ati ɔfa ɔmaa la anwo adwenle wolole mɔɔ hɛlɛle kɛlata ne la kpalɛ manle ɔhanle edwɛkɛ kpalɛ kpalɛ. Ɔnwunle debie biala wɔ Kelaese ɛhulolɛ, azubɔlɛ, ɛtanefakyɛ, ɛlolɛ, nee anwondelɛ nu.
Mɔɔ wɔ nu la
Ngilenu 1.1-2
Kelaese nee asɔne ne 1.3—3.21
Ɛbɛlabɔlɛ fofolɛ wɔ Kelaese ati 4.1—6.20
Adwulaleɛ 6.21-24

Title: ƐFƐ 1
Content:
1 Pɔɔlo mɔɔ ɔlua Nyamenle ɛhulolɛ zo yeyɛ Kelaese Gyisɛse ɛzoanvolɛ la yɛɛ ɛlɛkɛlɛ kɛlata ɛhye a.
Ɔlɛ ɔkamaa Nyamenle menli ne mɔɔ wɔ Ɛfɛsɛse mɔɔ Kelaese Gyisɛse ati bɛdi nɔhalɛ wɔ bɛ ɛbɛlabɔlɛ nu la.
2Yɛ Ze Nyamenle nee Awulae Gyisɛse Kelaese ɛlo bɛ na ɔmaa bɛ anzonudwolɛ.
Sunsum nu nyilalɛ mɔɔ Kelaese ati sonla nyia ye la
3Yɛyɛ Nyamenle mɔɔ le yɛ Awulae Gyisɛse Kelaese ɔ Ze ne mo. Ɔluakɛ yelua yɛ koyɛlɛ ne mɔɔ yɛ nee Kelaese ɛyɛ la azo yeyila yɛ na yeva anwuma Sunsum nu ahyɛlɛdeɛ muala yemaa yɛ. 4Nyamenle kpale nu yele yɛ ziele ɛkɛ manle Kelaese kolaa na yeabɔ ewiade, amaa yɛ nwo ade nwuanzaanwu mɔɔ fɔlɛlilɛ biala ɛnle yɛ nu wɔ ɔ nyunlu a.
Ɔlua ye ɛhulolɛ ne ati 5Nyamenle bɔle kpɔkɛ dɛba kɛ, ɔlua Gyisɛse Kelaese anwo zo, ɔbamaa yɛayɛ ɔ mra, kɛmɔ ye ɛhulolɛdeɛ ne mɔɔ gyi ɔ nyunlu la de la. 6Bɛmaa yɛye Nyamenle ayɛlɛ wɔ ye nwanwane ɛlolɛ kpole nee ye ahyɛlɛdeɛ ne mɔɔ yelua ɔ Ra ne mɔɔ ɔkulo ye la anwo zo yeva yemaa yɛ la ati. 7 Ɔluakɛ Kelaese ewule ne ati bɛva yɛ ɛtane ne mɔ bɛhyɛ yɛ na yɛnyia yɛ ti. Nyamenle ɛlolɛ ne 8mɔɔ ɔvale ɔmanle yɛ la le kpole mɔɔ bɛngola bɛnzuzu a!
Ɔlua nrɛlɛbɛ nee adwenlenunwunlɛ zo 9Nyamenle yɛle mɔɔ yehyehyɛ la, na yelua Kelaese anwo zo yemaa yɛnwu ye ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔɔ yedwenle nwolɛ dɛba yedo ɛkɛ ne na ɔvea la. 10Ngyehyɛlɛ ɛhye, mɔɔ ye mekɛ dwu a Nyamenle bamaa yeali munli la a le kɛ, ɔkuohua abɔdeɛ muala mɔɔ wɔ anwuma nee aze la anloa, na yeava Kelaese yeazie bɛ ti. 11Debie biala mɔɔ Nyamenle yɛ la gyi ɔdaye ye ngyehyɛlɛ nee ye kpɔkɛ mɔɔ yebɔ la azo, na kɛmɔ mɔlebɛbo ne ɔdaye ɔhyehyɛle la, yelua yɛ nee Kelaese yɛ koyɛlɛ ne azo yekpa nu yeye yɛ kɛ yɛle ye ɛdeɛ. 12Yemɔti bɛmaa yɛdayɛ mɔɔ yɛlumuale yɛnyianle anyelazo wɔ Kelaese anu la yɛye Nyamenle anyunlunyia ne ayɛlɛ.
13Bɛdabɛ noko, kɛmɔ bɛdele nɔhalɛ edwɛkɛ ne, mɔɔ le Edwɛkpa ne mɔɔ vale ngoanelielɛ rɛlɛle bɛ, na bɛliele Kelaese bɛlile la ati, Nyamenle vale ye Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne, mɔɔ ɔvale ɔbɔle ɛwɔkɛ la ɔmanle bɛ, ɔvale ɔyɛle bɛ nzonlɛ kɛ bɛle ye menli. 14Sunsum ne di agyinlanu kɛ yɛbanyia mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛva ɛbɔ ye menli ɛwɔkɛ la; eza ɔmaa yɛsi pi kɛ Nyamenle bamaa menli mɔɔ le ye ɛdeɛ la anyia bɛ ti bɔkɔɔ. Bɛmaa yɛye ye anyunlunyia ne ayɛlɛ!
Pɔɔlo nzɛlɛlɛ
15Zɔhane ati sumunli kɛ mendele bɛ nganeɛ kɛ bɛlie Awulae Gyisɛse bɛli, nee bɛ ɛhulolɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛ ye wɔ Nyamenle menli muala anwo la, 16dahuu meyɛ Nyamenle mo wɔ bɛ ti. Mekakye bɛ wɔ me nzɛlɛlɛ nu, 17na mesɛlɛ yɛ Awulae Gyisɛse Kelaese Nyamenle ne mɔɔ le anyunlunyia Selɛ ne kɛ ɔmaa bɛ Sunsum nu nrɛlɛbɛ nee ndelebɛbo mɔɔ kɛmaa bɛkɛnwu ɔdaye Nyamenle kpalɛ la. 18Mesɛlɛ kɛ bɛ adwenle nu kɛbuke, amaa bɛanwu anyelazo ne mɔɔ yevɛlɛ bɛ wɔ nu, ye nwanwane nyilalɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ ɔfa ɔbɔ ye menli ɛwɔkɛ la anu anwonyia ne 19nee kɛ ye tumi ne kpole si de la. Tumi ɛhye mɔɔ ɛlɛdi gyima wɔ yɛmɛ mɔɔ yɛdie ye yɛdi la anu la, yemɔ ala a le anwosesebɛ bedevinli ne 20 mɔɔ Nyamenle vale dwazole Kelaese vile ewule nu, na ɔvale ye ɔdɛnlanle ɔ sa fema zo wɔ anwuma la. 21Ɛkɛ ne yɛɛ Kelaese di belemgbunli wɔ arelemgbunli, tumivolɛma, mgbolema nee awulae mɔ anwo zo a. Ɔbo duma biala mɔɔ wɔ ewiade ɛhye nee ewiade fofolɛ ne mɔɔ bara la azo. 22 Nyamenle ɛva ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti ɛwula Kelaese agyakɛ abo, na yeva Kelaese yemaa asɔne ne kɛ ye Awulae mɔɔ bo ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti azo. 23Asɔne ne a le Kelaese sonlabaka ne yɛɛ Kelaese a maa asɔne ne di munli kɛ ɔdaye Kelaese la a; ɔdaye ala a eza ɔmaa debie biala mɔɔ wɔ aleɛabo la di munli a.

Title: ƐFƐ 2
Content:
Yɛfi ewule nu yɛba ngoane nu
1 Dɛba ne, bɛ mɛladonlɛ nee bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ manle bɛwule sunsum nu. 2Mekɛ ne anu bɛlile ewiade ye ɛbɛla mgbane mgbane ne mɔ anzi; bɛdiele anwomanyunlu tumivolɛma mɔɔ kɛkala sie bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnzonle Nyamenle la edwɛkɛ. 3Nɔhalɛ, ɛnee yɛdayɛ noko yɛle kɛ bɛdabɛ ala la; yɛbɔle ɛbɛla mɔɔ yɛdayɛ yɛkulo la, yɛyɛle mɔɔ yɛ nwonane ne atiakunluwɔzo nee yɛ adwenle zele yɛ la, na ɔlua zo yɛhanle Nyamenle ɛya kɛ awie biala la.
4Noko Nyamenle anwunvɔnezelɛ ne zonle, yɛɛ ye ɛhulolɛ mɔɔ wɔ yɛ nwo zo la le kpole bo zolɛ, 5yemɔti mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee yɛwu sunsum nu wɔ yɛ mɛladonlɛ ti la, ɔvale yɛ nee Kelaese ɔrale ngoane nu. Ɔlua Nyamenle ɛlolɛ ti yɛɛ bɛlie bɛ ngoane a. 6Yɛ nee Kelaese Gyisɛse ɛyɛ ko la ati, Nyamenle ɛdwazo yɛ nee Kelaese kɛ yɛ nee ye ɛhɔli belemgbunli wɔ anwuma. 7Ɔyɛle ɛhye amuala ɔhilele ye ɛlolɛ totohyia ne mɔɔ bɛngola bɛnzuzu la nee atiakunlukɛnlɛma mɔɔ ɔlua Kelaese Gyisɛse ati dahuu ɔlɛ ye wɔ yɛ nwo la. 8Ɔluakɛ Nyamenle ɛlolɛ zo yɛɛ bɛ diedi ti yelie bɛ ngoane a. 9Tɛ bɛ nyɛleɛ nwo ɔ. Ɔle Nyamenle ahyɛlɛdeɛ ala, amaa awie biala andu ɔ nwo wɔ nwolɛ. 10Yɛle Nyamenle asa anloa gyima, yɛɛ yelua yɛ nee Kelaese Gyisɛse yɛ koyɛlɛ ne azo yebɔ yɛ yemaa ɛbɛla kpalɛ ne mɔɔ ɔhyehyɛle ɔdole yɛ ɛkɛ ne dɛba kɛ yɛbɔ la.
Bɛ nee Kelaese le ko
11Bɛmɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la, bɛhakye kɛ dɛba ne ɛnee Dwuuma fɛlɛ bɛ kɛ bɛle menli mɔɔ ɛnze Nyamenle a. Ɔluakɛ Dwuuma yɛ bɛ mrenyanu nzonlɛ na bɛmɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la bɛnyɛ bɛ mrenyanu nzonlɛ. 12Bɛhakye kɛ mekɛ ne anu ɛnee bɛ nee Kelaese avinli twe, ɛnee bɛle nyɛvolɛ mɔɔ bɛmboka Yizilayɛ maanlema ne anwo a, ɛnee bɛnze ngyekyeleɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ ɔlua zo a Nyamenle bɔle ye menli ne ɛwɔkɛ la anwo bie. Bɛdɛnlanle ewiade ye anu kɛ menli mɔɔ ɛnlɛ anyelazo na bɛnze Nyamenle la. 13Kɛkala, bɛ nee Kelaese Gyisɛse ɛyɛ ko, amaa ɔlua zo bɛmɛ mɔɔ anrɛɛ bɛwɔ moa moa la, bɛlua Kelaese mogya ne mɔɔ ɔhwinle ɔguale la azo bɛhwe bɛ bɛbikye Nyamenle. 14Kelaese a le yɛ anzonudwolɛmaavolɛ a. Ɔluakɛ yeva Dwuuma nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la yebɔ nu yeyɛ bɛ menli ko, na yegologolo bane ne mɔɔ gya bɛ ɛweɛne mɔɔ maa bɛyɛ bɛ nwo agbɔvolɛ la yegua. 15 Ɔluale ye sonlabaka ne azo ɔpɛle Dwuuma mɛla ne nee nwolɛ ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔ anu na ɔlua Kelaese ati ɔmanle menli ekpunli nwiɔ ɛhye yɛle menli fofolɛ ko na yɛnyianle anzonudwolɛ. 16 Kelaese luale ye ewule mɔɔ ɔwule meanubaka ne azo la yele ɛkpɔlɛ wɔ bɛ avinli na ɔhanle Dwuuma nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la ɔbɔle nu ɔmanle Nyamenle. 17 Yemɔti Kelaese rabɔle anzonudwolɛ nwo Edwɛkpa nolo ne hilele menli kɔsɔɔti; ɔbɔle ɔhilele bɛmɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma, mɔɔ bɛwɔ moa moa la yɛɛ Dwuuma mɔɔ bikye ye la. 18Ɔlua Gyisɛse anwo zo yɛɛ yɛ muala, Dwuuma nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la yɛkola yɛdua Sunsum ko ne ala azo yɛkɔ Selɛ ne anyunlu a.
19Yemɔti, bɛmɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la bɛnle nyɛvolɛ anzɛɛ maanle zo amra bieko; kɛkala bɛle mandimase wɔ Nyamenle menli ne avinli na bɛbɔ Nyamenle abusua eku ne bie. 20Bɛdabɛ noko a bɛle sua mɔɔ bɛlɛsi ye wɔ ɛzoanvolɛma nee Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma adiabo ne mɔɔ bɛwula la azo a, na Kelaese ɔdaye mumua ne a ɔle sua ne mgbɛnezo sika ne mɔɔ hyia kpole kpalɛ la a. 21Kelaese a sɔ sua mumua ne maa ɔgyinla ɔyɛ ɛzonlenlɛ sua nwuanzanwuanza ɔmaa Awulae a. 22Kɛmɔ bɛ nee Kelaese ɛyɛ ko la, bɛdabɛ noko bɛlua Nyamenle Sunsum ne azo bɛlɛsi bɛ nee menli kɔsɔɔti kɛ sua la na Nyamenle adɛnla nu.

Title: ƐFƐ 3
Content:
Gyima mɔɔ Pɔɔlo di maa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la
1Ɔlua ɛhye ati medame Pɔɔlo, mɔɔ bɛmɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la ati bɛhye me nuokɛ bɛmaa Kelaese Gyisɛse la, mesɛlɛ dahuu memaa bɛ. 2Medie medi kɛ bɛde kɛ Nyamenle ɛlolɛ zo ala yɛɛ yeva gyima ɛhye yemaa me kɛ menyɛ a, wɔ bɛ kpalɛ ti. 3Nyamenle yele ye ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔɔ vea la hilele me. (Mehɛlɛ ɛhye anwo edwɛkɛ sikalɛ, 4 na saa bɛkenga mɔɔ mehɛlɛ la a anrɛɛ bɛkɛnwu me ndelebɛbo ne mɔɔ fane Kelaese anwo edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ vea la anu.) 5Dɛba dɛba ne bɛanga edwɛkɛ ɛhye mɔ mɔɔ vea la bɛangile sonla biala, noko kɛkala, Nyamenle lua Sunsum ne azo ɛye ɛhile ye ɛzoanvolɛma nwuanzanwuanza ne nee Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma. 6Edwɛkɛ mɔɔ ɛnee vea ɛkɛ ne la a le kɛ, ɔlua Edwɛkpa ne azo, bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma nee Dwuuma bɔ nu nyia Nyamenle nyilalɛ ne mɔ; bɛyɛ menli ko na bɛnyia Nyamenle ɛwɔkɛ ne mɔɔ Kelaese Gyisɛse ati ɔbɔle la.
7Nyamenle ɛlua ye tumi ne gyimalilɛ zo ɛmaa me ahyɛlɛdeɛ mɔɔ sonle bolɛ, kɛ menyɛ Edwɛkpa ne anwo sonvolɛ. 8Mele Nyamenle menli ne anu kakula bɔkɔɔ, noko Nyamenle ɛmaa me adenle ɛhye kɛ membɔ Edwɛkpa ne mɔɔ fane Kelaese anwonyia ne mɔɔ ɛnlɛ neɛnleanu la anwo nolo mengile bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la, 9na memaa menli kɔsɔɔti ɛnwu kɛ nwanwane ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔɔ vea la bazi ahɔ zolɛ la. Nyamenle mɔɔ yemɔ a ɔbɔle ninyɛne muala la vale ngyehyɛlɛ ɛhye veale mekɛ dɔɔnwo mɔɔ ɛraze ɛhɔ la, 10amaa mekɛ ɛhye anu ala ɔlua Asɔne ne azo anwuma tumivolɛma nee mgbolema anwu Nyamenle nrɛlɛbɛ kpole ne. 11Nyamenle yɛle ɛhye kɛmɔ ye damɛnlangoate ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔɔ ɔlua Kelaese Gyisɛse yɛ Awulae ne anwo zo ɔmanle ɔlile munli la de la. 12Yɛ nee Kelaese yɛ koyɛlɛ ne, nee diedi mɔɔ yɛlɛ ye wɔ ye nuhua la ati, yɛkola yɛbɔ kpɔkɛ na yɛsi yɛ kɛnra yɛfinde Nyamenle anyunlu. 13Yemɔti, mesɛlɛ bɛ kɛ bɛmmamaa amaneɛ mɔɔ melɛnwu ye wɔ bɛ ti la bɔ bɛ rɛle; ɔle kpalɛ ɔmaa bɛ.
Kelaese ɛhulolɛ ne
14Kɛmɔ ɛnee melɛka la, ɛhye ala ati yɛɛ mekoto mesɛlɛ Selɛ ne 15mɔɔ ye nehane a abusua biala mɔɔ wɔ anwuma nee aze la nyia ye nɔhalɛ duma la, 16kɛ ye anyunlunyia ne kpole ti, ɔlua ye Sunsum ne azo ɔmaa bɛ anwosesebɛ ɔmaa bɛgyinla kpundii wɔ adwenle nu, 17na ɔlua bɛ diedi zo ɔmaa Kelaese ɛdɛnla bɛ ahonle nu. Mesɛlɛ kɛ bɛkɛgyinla kpundii wɔ ɛhulolɛ nu, 18amaa bɛahola bɛ nee Nyamenle menli ne anyia anwosesebɛ ade kɛ Kelaese ɛhulolɛ ne tɛtɛlɛ nee ye tendenle, ye anwumahɔlɛ nee ye kuma si de la abo. 19Mesɛlɛ kɛ anrɛɛ bɛanwu ye ɛhulolɛ ne mɔɔ bo sonla adwenle zo la, na Nyamenle su ne mɔɔ maa sonla sɔ Nyamenle anye la ayi bɛ tɛkɛɛ.
20-21Anyunlunyia ɛlua asɔne ne nee Kelaese Gyisɛse anwo zo ɛha Nyamenle mɔɔ dua tumi ne mɔɔ yɛ gyima yɛ nu la azo maa ɔbo mɔɔ yɛbiza nee mɔɔ yɛdwenle nwo la azo la, wɔ ɛnɛ nee mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ! Amen.

Title: ƐFƐ 4
Content:
Asɔne ne koyɛlɛ
1Zɔhane ati, mesɛlɛ bɛ, meze kɛ Awulae ɛzonlenlɛ ne ati mela efiade bɔbɔ ɛdeɛ, noko bɛbɔ ɛbɛla mɔɔ fɛta Nyamenle ɛvɛlɛlɛ ne mɔɔ yemɔti yevɛlɛ bɛ la. 2 Dahuu bɛbɛlɛ bɛ nwo aze, bɛyɛ bɛtɛɛ na bɛnyia abotane. Bɛde bɛmaa bɛ gɔnwo mɔ ngoko ngoko wɔ ɛhulolɛ nu. 3Bɛbɔ mɔdenle kɛ bɛkɛdɛnla anzonudwolɛ nu na bɛmaa koyɛlɛ ne mɔɔ Sunsum ne ɛva ɛmaa bɛ la ɛwoa ɛkɛ ne dahuu. 4Asɔne ko yɛɛ Sunsum ko a wɔ ɛkɛ a, yɛɛ anyelazo ko anu a Nyamenle ɛvɛlɛ bɛ a; 5Awulae ko, diedi ko, yɛɛ ɛzɔnenlɛ kokye ala a wɔ ɛkɛ a. 6Nyamenle kokye mɔɔ le menli kɔsɔɔti yɛ Ze na ɔle abɔdeɛ muala bɛ Awulae na ɔyɛ gyima wɔ bɛ muala bɛ nu la a de bɛ muala bɛ nu a.
7Bɛmaa yɛ nuhua ko biala ahyɛlɛdeɛ mɔɔ sonle bolɛ na ɔla mɔɔ Kelaese ɛzuzu ɛva ɛmaa ye la anwo. 8 Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se,
“Mekɛ mɔɔ ɔvole ɔhɔle anwuma la,
ɔhyele menli dɔɔnwo nuokɛ ɔ nee bɛ hɔle;
na ɔvale ahyɛlɛdeɛ ɔmanle aleɛabo amra.”
9Akee “ɔhɔle anwuma” ne abo a le duzu? Yemɔ a le kɛ saa ɔvole a ɛnee noko alumua ne ɔdwule ɔhɔle azɛlɛ ti anu. 10Yemɔti ahenle mɔɔ dwule la ɔdaye ko ne ala a ɔhɔle anwuma wɔ anwumaneamra anzi lɔ a, amaa ewiade kpokpoti anwu ye. 11Ye ahyɛlɛdeɛ a le kɛ ɔmaa bie mɔ yɛ ɛzoanvolɛma, bie mɔ yɛ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma, bie mɔ yɛ Edwɛkpa ne nolobɔlɛma, yɛɛ bie mɔ noko yɛ sɛlɛvolɛma nee kilehilevolɛma. 12Ɔyɛle ɛhye ɔvale ɔzieziele Nyamenle menli kɔsɔɔti ɔmanle Keleseɛn ɛzonlenlɛ gyima ne, amaa bɛayɛ Kelaese asɔnema 13kɔdwu kɛ awieleɛ ne, kɛmɔ yɛdie yɛdi na yɛze Nyamenle Ara ne la ati, yɛkɛbɔ nu yɛkɛyɛ ko na yɛayɛ kɛ menli mɔɔ bɛ adwenle ɛdi na bɛ nee Kelaese ɛzɛ atipɛne la. 14Ɛnee akee yɛnle ngakula bieko mɔɔ adalɛma fa bɛ ngilehilelɛ nee agyiba ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛfa bɛtwe menli bɛkɔ ɛtane nu la bɔ yɛ kɔ ba kɛ selɛkye nee anwoma la. 15Saa yɛfa ɛhulolɛ yɛka nɔhalɛ ne a, Kelaese ati yɛbanyi wɔ adenle biala anu. Kelaese a gyi yɛ ti 16 mɔɔ yɛ nwonane ye nvɛyeba ne mɔ amuala sosɔ ye na ɔmaa biala yɛ ye gyima kɛmɔ ɔfɛta la, na nwonane ne nyi ɛhulolɛ nu a.
Ɛbɛla ɛbɔlɛ fofolɛ wɔ Kelaese ati
17Mekakye bɛ wɔ Awulae duma nu; bɛmmabɔ bɛ ɛbɛla kɛ awozonle ɛzonlenlɛma la bieko mɔɔ bɛndwenle adwenle kpalɛ a. 18Menli zɔhane mɔ adwenle nu le awozinli, bɛnlɛ ndelebɛbo yɛɛ bɛmboka ngoane ne mɔɔ Nyamenle fa maa la anwo, ɔluakɛ bɛnze ɛhwee yɛɛ eza bɛ nzo yɛ se. 19Nyiane ɛnle bɛ nye zo, bɛyɛ ninyɛndane yɛɛ bɛkulo ɛbɛla mgbane mgbane ɛbɔlɛ.
20Na bɛmɛ, tɛ mɔɔ bɛzukoale ye wɔ Kelaese ɛkɛ ne la ɛne. 21Nɔhalɛ, bɛde ɔ nwo edwɛkɛ yɛɛ bɛhilehile bɛ nɔhalɛ ne, kɛmɔ ɔwɔ Gyisɛse anu la. 22 Zɔhane ati, bɛdu bɛ su dɛba ne mɔɔ manle bɛbɔle ɛbɛla mɔɔ bɛdabɛ bɛkulo na ɔvale ye atiakunluwɔzo ɛtane ne ɔzɛkyele bɛ la bɛgua. 23Bɛnyia subane fofolɛ. 24 Bɛva bɛ su fofolɛ ne mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛbɔ ye kɛ ɔdaye ye ɛsaso na ɔkile ɔ nwo wɔ nɔhalɛ ɛbɛla mɔɔ tenrɛ na ɔle nwuanzaanwu la anu la bɛwula.
25 Zɔhane ati, bɛmmabɔ adalɛ bieko; awie biala ɛha nɔhalɛ ɛhile ɔ gɔnwo, ɔboalekɛ yɛ muala yɛle menli ko. 26 Saa ɛfa ɛya a, mmamaa ɔfa wɔ ɔkɔ ɛtane nu; eza mmamaa sɛnzɛne ne tɔ wɔ ɛya zo. 27Bɛmmamaa Abɔnsam adenle. 28Mɔɔ le awule la ɛgyakyi ye awule ne na ɔyɛ gyima, amaa yeanyia bie yeanlea ɔ nwo na eza yeanyia bie yeaboa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛhyia la. 29Bɛmmamaa edwɛkɛ ɛtane fi bɛ nloa anu finde; bɛdendɛ kɛnlɛma mɔɔ maa sonla nyia ngɔzo na ɔnyia mɔɔ ɔkpondɛ la, amaa mɔɔ bɛkɛha la biala azo ara nvasoɛ amaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛtie la. 30Bɛmmabɔ Nyamenle Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne arɛle, ɔluakɛ Sunsum ne a le Nyamenle nzonlɛ mɔɔ yeyɛ ye bɛ nwo mɔɔ kile kɛ bɛle ye ɛdeɛ a; sɛkɛlɛneɛ ɛhye kile kɛ Kenle ne dwu a Nyamenle bakpɔne bɛ. 31Bɛye sipe nee ɛkpɔlɛ nee ɛya biala bɛgua. Bɛmmadi butule anzɛɛ bɛmmayɛ aholoba. Bɛye atiakunlu ɛtane biala bɛgua. 32 Bɛyɛ atiakunlukɛnlɛma na bɛze anwunvɔne, bɛva bɛ gɔnwo mɔ ɛtane bɛhyɛ bɛ, kɛmɔ Nyamenle ɛlua Kelaese anwo zo ɛva bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ ɛhyɛ bɛ la.

Title: ƐFƐ 5
Content:
Wienyi nu ɛdɛnlanlɛ
1Bɛle Nyamenle amra mɔɔ ɔkulo bɛ a, yemɔti bɛbɔ mɔdenle kɛ bɛkɛyɛ kɛ ɔdaye ala la. 2 Bɛmaa ɛhulolɛ ɛvinde bɛ ɛbɛlabɔlɛ nu, kɛmɔ Kelaese hulole yɛ na ɔdole ye ngoane aze ɔmanle yɛ ɔvale ɔyɛle azubɔlɛ evuanlɛ mɔɔ sɔ Nyamenle anye la.
3Bɛle Nyamenle menli, zɔhane ati bɛye adwɔmanebɔlɛ anzɛɛ nyɛleɛ ɛtane ɛtane anzɛɛ anyebolo wɔ bɛ nu bɔkɔɔ. 4Bɛmmaka anyiemgba edwɛkɛ biala, bɛmmatendɛ ɛdendɛlɛ ɛtane yɛɛ bɛmmabɔ ngoayɛ mgbane mgbane. Mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛyɛ la a le kɛ bɛkɛyɛ Nyamenle mo. 5Bɛde ɛhye abo kpalɛ, awie biala mɔɔ bɔ adwɔmane anzɛɛ ye ɛbɛla nwo ɛnde anzɛɛ ɔle anyebolo (anyebolo le awozonlezonlenlɛ) la ɛnrɛnyia agyadeɛ wɔ Kelaese nee Nyamenle Belemgbunlililɛ ne anu.
6Bɛmmamaa awie fa adubɛnloanu bɛlɛbɛla bɛ; ɔboalekɛ ɔlua ninyɛne zɛhae mɔ ati yɛɛ Nyamenle ɛya ne ba menli mɔɔ ɛndie ye edwɛkɛ la anwo zo a. 7Yemɔti bɛ nee menli zɔhane mɔ mmatu wɔ adenle biala anu. 8Dɛba ne ɛnee bɛwɔ awozinli nu, na ɛnɛ bɛyɛ Awulae menli; ɛhye ati bɛwɔ wienyi nu. Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛbɔ bɛ ɛbɛla kɛ menli mɔɔ wɔ wienyi nu la. 9Ɔluakɛ wienyi nu yɛɛ kpalɛyɛlɛ, pɛlepɛlelilɛ nee nɔhalɛlilɛ dɔɔnwo vi ba a. 10Bɛbɔ mɔdenle bɛzukoa mɔɔ bɛyɛ a ɔsɔ Awulae anye la. 11Bɛmmayɛ awozinli nu nyɛleɛ mgbane mgbane ne mɔ mɔɔ menli yɛ na nvasoɛ ɛnle zolɛ la bie. Bɛnwu bie a anrɛɛ bɛha bɛdo gua. 12Ɔyɛ nyiane kpole bɔbɔ kɛ bɛkɛha bɛ ninyɛndane mɔɔ bɛyɛ ye fealera nu la anwo edwɛkɛ a. 13Na saa ninyɛne muala finde wienyi nu a, ɛnee bɛ nɔhalɛ ɛsaso ne ɛla ɛkɛ ne wienyi; 14ɔluakɛ debie biala mɔɔ kɛla ali la, ɛnee yeyɛ wienyi. Yemɔti a bɛha ye kɛ,
“Wɔmɔ mɔɔ wɔlafe a, tunwue
na ɛvi mɔwuamra anu dwazo!
Na Kelaese wienyi ne kɛda ɛ nwo.”
15Zɔhane ati bɛnlea bɛ nwo boɛ wɔ bɛ ɛbɛlabɔlɛ nu. Bɛmmayɛ bɛ nwo kɛ menli mɔɔ ɛnze debie la; bɛbɔ bɛ ɛbɛla kɛ bɛle nrɛlɛbɛvolɛma. 16 Bɛbɔ ɛbɛla kpalɛ wɔ adenle biala anu, ɔboalekɛ mekɛ ye mɔɔ yɛwɔ nu la le ɛtanelilɛ mekɛ. 17Zɔhane ati, bɛmmayɛ bɛ nwo ahɔnwɔne, na bɛbɔ mɔdenle kɛ bɛkɛnwu mɔɔ Awulae kpondɛ kɛ bɛyɛ la.
18Bɛgyakyi nza ɛbolɛ na ɔsɛkye bɛ; bɛmaa Sunsum ne ɛyi bɛ tɛkɛɛ. 19 Bɛva ayɛlɛyelɛ edwɛne, anyelielɛ edwɛne nee sunsum nu edwɛne bɛli bɛ nwo adwelie; na bɛdo ayɛlɛyelɛ edwɛne wɔ bɛ ahonle nu bɛmaa Awulae. 20Bɛlua yɛ Awulae Gyisɛse Kelaese duma nu bɛyɛ Nyamenle Selɛ ne mo dahuu wɔ debie biala anu.
Yelɛma nee kunlima
21Kɛmɔ bɛdi Kelaese eni la, bɛha bɛ nwo aze bɛmaa bɛ nwo ngoko ngoko.
22 Yelɛma, bɛha bɛ nwo aze bɛmaa bɛ hu mɔ, kɛmɔ bɛyɛ bɛmaa Awulae la. 23Ɔluakɛ kunli ne a lɛ tumi wɔ ɔ ye anwo zo a, kɛmɔ Kelaese lɛ Asɔne ne azo tumi la; asɔne ne a le Kelaese sonlabaka ne yɛɛ Kelaese a le asɔne ne Ngoanedievolɛ a. 24Zɔhane ati yelɛma ɛha bɛ nwo aze bɔkɔɔ ɛmaa bɛ hu mɔ, kɛmɔ asɔne ne yɛ maa Kelaese la.
25 Kunlima, bɛhulo bɛ ye mɔ kɛmɔ Kelaese hulole Asɔne ne na ɔdole ye ngoane aze wɔ ɔ ti la. 26Ɔyɛle ɛhye na ɔvale ɔ nloa edwɛkɛ nee nzule ɔnrinzinle nwolɛ bɔkɔɔ na ɔdele nwolɛ; 27amaa yeava asɔne ne kɛnlɛma gyɛlɛɛnye yeamaa ɔ nwo, mɔɔ nwolɛ ɛtɛkpɔdele, evinli biala ɛnle nwolɛ, yɛɛ nvonleɛ biala ɛnle nwolɛ na nwolɛ te nwuanzaanwu a. 28Zɔhane ala yɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ kunlima kulo bɛ ye mɔ kɛ bɛ nwo la. Nrenya mɔɔ kulo ɔ ye la kulo ɔdaye mumua ne ɔ nwo. 29Awie ɛnrɛkpɔ ɔdaye ɔ nwo ɛlɛ; mɔɔ ɔyɛ la a le kɛ ɔdi ɔ nwo adane na ɔnea ye sonlabaka ne boɛ, kɛmɔ Kelaese noko yɛ Asɔne ne la, 30ɔluakɛ yɛle ye sonlabaka ne nvɛyeba ne mɔ bie. 31 Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se, “Ɛhye ati nrenya bagyakyi ɔ ze nee ɔ nli na yeava ɔ nwo yeabeta ɔ ye anwo, na bɛ mu nwiɔ bɛayɛ menli nwiɔ mɔɔ le nwonane ko a.” 32Nɔhalɛ kpole bie mɔɔ vea la wɔ Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ɛhye anu, na mete ɔ bo kɛ ɔfane Kelaese nee asɔne ne anwo. 33Noko ɔwɔ kɛ kunli biala kulo ɔ ye kɛ ɔdaye ɔ nwo, na yelɛ biala noko di ɔ hu eni.

Title: ƐFƐ 6
Content:
Ngakula nee awovolɛma
1 Ngakula, bɛdie bɛ awovolɛma wɔ Awulae ati, ɔluakɛ ɛhye a le debie kpalɛ mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛyɛ a. 2 “Di ɛ ze nee ɛ nli eni” a le Nyamenle mɛla mɔɔ lumua mɔɔ ɛwɔkɛ wɔ nwolɛ a. 3Ɛwɔkɛ ne a le “amaa wɔayɛ kpalɛ na wɔahyɛ azɛlɛ ye azo.”
4 Selɛma, bɛmmaka bɛ mra ɛya; bɛtete bɛ na bɛhilehile bɛ, kɛmɔ Awulae kpondɛ la.
Ngɛkɛlɛ nee menlenlɛma
5 Ngɛkɛlɛ, bɛva ɛzulolɛ nee anwowozolɛ bɛdie bɛ menle mɔ mɔɔ wɔ ewiade ye anu la kɛ asɛɛ bɛlɛsonle Awulae la. 6Tɛ ɛnyelɛ zo yɛkile nu ɔ, na bɛva ahonle kpalɛ bɛyɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle kpondɛ la; bɛyɛ ye kɛ bɛle Kelaese ngɛkɛlɛ, 7na bɛva adwenle kpalɛ bɛzonle kɛ asɛɛ bɛyɛ bɛamaa Awulae na tɛ menli ɔ. 8Bɛhakye kɛ gyima kpalɛ mɔɔ awie biala kɛyɛ la, saa akɛlɛ o, saa dehelɛ o, Awulae bamaa ye nwolɛ ahatualɛ.
9 Menlenlɛma, bɛdabɛ noko bɛyɛ zɔhane ala bɛmaa bɛ ngɛkɛlɛ ne mɔ, na bɛmmanwunlonwunla bɛ anzɛɛ bɛmmasisi bɛ. Bɛhakye kɛ bɛ nee bɛ ngɛkɛlɛ ne mɔ amuala wɔ Menlenlɛ ko ne ala mɔɔ wɔ anwuma la abo. Yemɔ, ɔnli mɔguazo wɔ ye ndɛnebualɛ nu.
Nyamenle konle tɛladeɛ ne
10Awieleɛ ne, bɛlua Awulae tumi bedevinli ne azo bɛmaa bɛ nwo ɛyɛ se. 11Bɛwula Nyamenle konle tɛladeɛ ne mɔ amuala na bɛahola bɛagyinla Abɔnsam agyiba ne mɔ anloa. 12Ɔluakɛ, tɛ menli a yɛ nee bɛ ɛlɛko a; sunsum nu tumivolɛma, ewiade arelemgbunli anzɛɛ maanlebuvoma, ewiade amra mɔɔ sie ɛnɛ mekɛ ye awozinli nu amra, yɛɛ sunsum nu anwuma ɛlɔnema amumuyɛ yɛɛ yɛ nee bɛ ɛlɛko a. 13Zɔhane ati bɛwula Nyamenle konle tɛladeɛ ne amuala, amaa saa kenle ɛtane ne ba a, bɛahola bɛagyinla kpɔvolɛ ne anyunlu, amaa mɔɔ konle ne kawie la ɛnee bɛgyi bɛ gyakɛ anu kpundii.
14 Zɔhane ati bɛziezie bɛ nwo bɛzie, bɛva nɔhalɛ bɛyɛ akyeso bɛhye; bɛva pɛlepɛlelilɛ bɛyɛ bulalɛ enyinlike bɛbutu bɛ kɛnra azo 15 na bɛva anzonudwolɛ Edwɛkpa ne bɛyɛ mgbɔlaboa bɛwula. 16Mekɛ biala bɛva diedi bɛyɛ bɛ sa nu enyinlike, ɔluakɛ yemɔ a bɛbava bɛalie Abɔnsam senle ɛda ne mɔɔ ɔkɛdo la amuala bɛanlua bɛ a. 17 Bɛva ngoanelielɛ ahyɛlɛdeɛ ne bɛyɛ bulalɛ kyɛlɛ bɛzoa na bɛva Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne kɛ konle dadeɛ mɔɔ Sunsum ne fa maa la. 18Bɛva nzɛlɛlɛ bɛyɛ ɛhye mɔ amuala na bɛbiza Nyamenle moalɛ. Mekɛ biala bɛzɛlɛ kɛmɔ sunsum ne kile la. Zɔhane ati bɛmaa bɛ nye ɛbolo bɛbodo bɛzɛlɛ kpalɛ wɔ Sunsum ne anu dahuu. Bɛyɛ bɛ nye gyɛlɛmgbɛɛnye na bɛmmamaa bɛ sa kpa; bɛzɛlɛ dahuu bɛmaa Nyamenle menli ne noko, 19na bɛzɛlɛ bɛmaa medame noko kɛ saa menyia nwo mebadendɛ a, Nyamenle kɛmaa me edwɛkɛ mɔɔ mebaha la, amaa meahola meadendɛ akɛnrasesebɛ zo meabɔ mɔɔ vea Edwɛkpa ne anu la nolo. 20Edwɛkpa ne ati a mela efiade a, noko mele nwolɛ ɛbɔfoɔ. Bɛzɛlɛ kɛ menwɔva akɛnrasesebɛ menwɔha Edwɛkpa ne kɛmɔ ɔfɛta la.
Adwulaleɛ nee moyɛlɛ
21Tekekɛse mɔɔ le adiema kulovolɛ nee sonvolɛ mɔɔ di nɔhalɛ maa Awulae gyima ne la bamaa bɛade me nwo edwɛkɛ muala, amaa bɛanwu kɛ me nwo si de la. 22Yemɔti yɛɛ melɛsoa ye bɛ nwo lɔ a, amaa bɛanwu kɛ yɛ muala yɛ nwo si de la na eza yeamaa bɛ anwosesebɛ.
23Nyamenle Selɛ ne, nee Awulae Gyisɛse Kelaese ɛmaa mediema ne mɔ amuala anzonudwolɛ nee diedi nu ɛhulolɛ. 24Nyamenle ɛlolɛ ne nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkulo yɛ Awulae Gyisɛse Kelaese ɛhulolɛ mɔɔ ɛmbɔ aze ɛlɛ la ɛdɛnla.

Title: FEL MUKENYE
Content:
Mukenye
Pɔɔlo kɛlata ne mɔɔ ɔhɛlɛle ɔhɔmanle Felepaema la, ɔhɛlɛle ɔhɔmanle ɔdaye Pɔɔlo ye asɔne ne mɔɔ ɔlumuale ɔdele wɔ Abolokyi azɛlɛ zo, wɔ Wulomu maanzinli ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Masidonea la anu amra. Mekɛ mɔɔ ɛzoanvolɛ ne kɛlɛ kɛlata ɛhye la, ɛnee ɔla efiade, na eza ye adwenle ɛzɛkye na ɔlɛdi nyane wɔ Kelaese ɛdoavolɛma bie mɔɔ nee ye ɛnli na bɛlɛ ngilehilelɛ ɛtane bɛlɛkilehile Felepae asɔnema ne la anwo. Noko eza kɛlata ne kile anyelielɛ nee adwenle nlane mɔɔ Pɔɔlo lɛ ye, na kyesɛ ɔdaye ye diedi kpole ne mɔɔ wɔ Gyisɛse Kelaese anu la angome na ahola nu kile la.
Debie mɔɔ yemɔti Pɔɔlo hɛlɛle kɛlata ne la a le kɛ, ɔkulo kɛ ɔyɛ Felepae Keleseɛnema ne mɔ mo somaa wɔ ninyɛne mɔɔ bɛvale bɛrahyɛle ye wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee yehyia kpole la anwo. Ɔluale ɛhye azo ɔzile bɛ ahonle, amaa bɛanyia akɛnrasesebɛ nee adwenle nlane wɔ ye nee bɛ amaneɛnwunlɛ nwo. Ɔzɛlɛle bɛ kɛ bɛzukoa Kelaese bɛtɛɛyɛlɛ ne, na bɛye adubɛnwo nee anyebolo wɔ bɛ ɛbɛlabɔlɛ nu. Ɔhakyele bɛ kɛ bɛ ɛbɛlabɔlɛ ne mɔɔ Kelaese ati bɛlɛbɔ la le Nyamenle ɛlolɛ ahyɛlɛdeɛ mɔɔ bɛlua diedi zo a bɛnyia ye a, na tɛ kɛ asɛɛ bɛlile Dwuuma mɛla ne azo na bɛyɛle mɔɔ mɛla ne se la ati ɔ. Ɔhɛlɛle kɛ ɔsi mɔɔ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ nee Kelaese lua la anye die la, nee anzonudwolɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle fa maa bɛ la anwo edwɛkɛ.
Debie mɔɔ bɛfa ye kɛlata ɛhye anwo la a le anyelielɛ, adwenle nlane, koyɛlɛ nee mɔdenlebɔlɛ wɔ Kelaese ɛdoavolɛma diedi nee ɛbɛlabɔlɛ nu la dawua ɛzilɛ. Eza ɔkile kɛ Pɔɔlo si kulo Felepae asɔne ne la.
Mɔɔ wɔ nu la
Ngilenu 1.1-11
Pɔɔlo gyinlabelɛ 1.12-26
Ɛbɛlabɔlɛ wɔ Kelaese ati 1.27—2.18
Temɔte nee Ɛpafulodaetɛse anwo ngyehyɛlɛ 2.19-30
Agbɔvolɛ nee munzule nwo kɔkɔbɔlɛ 3.1—4.9
Pɔɔlo nee ɔ gɔnwo mɔ Felepaema 4.10-20
Adwulaleɛ 4.21-23

Title: FEL 1
Content:
1 Medame Pɔɔlo nee Temɔte, mɔɔ yɛle Kelaese Gyisɛse ngɛkɛlɛ la, yɛɛ yɛlɛkɛlɛ kɛlata ɛhye yɛahɔmaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ Kelaese Gyisɛse ati bɛyɛ Nyamenle menli nee asɔne neavolɛma nee asɔne boavolɛma mɔɔ wɔ Felepae suakpole ne azo la amuala a.
2Yɛ Ze Nyamenle ne nee Awulae Gyisɛse Kelaese ɛlo bɛ na ɔmaa bɛ anzonudwolɛ.
Pɔɔlo sɛlɛ amaa diedima
3Meyɛ Nyamenle mo kɛ dahuu mekakye bɛ a. 4Eza kenle biala mefa fɛlɛkolilɛ mesɛlɛ memaa bɛ muala, 5wɔ moalɛ mɔɔ bɛva bɛboa me wɔ Edwɛkpa ne anwo gyimalilɛ nu, ɔvi mɔlebɛbo ne amuala toonwo mɔɔ ɛradwu ɛnɛ la. 6Zɔhane ati medie medi kɛ Nyamenle mɔɔ bɔle gyima kpalɛ ɛhye abo wɔ bɛ nu la kɛzɔ zolɛ kɛmaa ɔkɛli munli wɔ Kenle ne mɔɔ Kelaese Gyisɛse kɛra la. 7Medwenle bɛ nwo somaa! Na ɔle kpalɛ noko kɛ melɛ bɛ nwo adwenle zɛhae a, ɔluakɛ wɔ me efiadenla nu nee Edwɛkpa ne nolobɔlɛ nee ye ɛgyinlalɛ nu, me nee bɛ yɛ muala a yɛnyia Nyamenle ɛlolɛ ne a. 8Nyamenle di me daselɛ kɛ me nwo mɔɔ dɔ bɛ la amuala vi Gyisɛse Kelaese ɔdaye mumua ne ahonle nu.
9Mesɛlɛ kɛ Nyamenle ɛdo bɛ ɛhulolɛ nu, ɔmaa bɛ nɔhalɛ adwenle nee ndelebɛbo mɔɔ di munli la, 10amaa bɛnwu mɔɔ le kpalɛ la a bɛanwu ye, na bɛ nwo ade saanwu na bɛanli fɔlɛ wɔ Kenle ne mɔɔ Kelaese kɛra la. 11Bɛzo nɔhalɛ ma kpalɛ ne mɔɔ Gyisɛse Kelaese ala a fa maa la na bɛmaa anyunlunyia nee ayɛlɛyelɛ ɛha Nyamenle.
Sonla ngoane vi Kelaese
12Me mediema, mekulo kɛ bɛnwu kɛ, mɔɔ ɛzi me nwo zo biala la ɛboa ɛmaa Edwɛkpa ne ɛhɔ zo, 13 ɛmaa ɔlua zo suakunlu sinzavolɛma ne mɔ amuala nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ ɛha la amuala ɛnwu ye kɛ Kelaese ati a mela efiade a. 14Na me efiadenla ɛhye ɛmaa mediema ne mɔ dɔɔnwo ɛzi pi wɔ Awulae anu na bɛlɛbɔ Edwɛkpa ne nolo mɔɔ bɛnzulo ɛhwee a.
15Ɔle nɔhalɛ kɛ bie mɔ fa akpule nee aholazilɛ a bɔ Kelaese anwo nolo ne a, yɛɛ bie mɔ noko lɛ adwenle kpalɛ. 16Menli mɔɔ lɛ adwenle kpalɛ la fa ɛhulolɛ a bɔ nolo ne a, ɔluakɛ bɛze kɛ medame yɛɛ Nyamenle ɛva gyima ɛhye ɛmaa me kɛ mengyinla Edwɛkpa ne anzi na mengilehile nu a. 17Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛha la, bɛmbɔ Kelaese anwo nolo ne nɔhalɛ nu, bɛbɔ ye manzonlehwenlɛ nu, na bɛdwenle kɛ bɛyɛ ye zɔhane na bɛamaa me nwo ahyele me wɔ efiade ɛke.
18Ɔnle debie! Medi nwolɛ fɛlɛko, ɔluakɛ saa bɛlɛ adwenle kpalɛ o, saa ɛtane o, Kelaese anwo nolo ala a bɛbɔ a. Ɛhɛe, yɛɛ eza mebahɔ zolɛ meali fɛlɛko, 19ɔluakɛ meze kɛ ɔlua bɛmɛ bɛ nzɛlɛlɛ nee Gyisɛse Kelaese Sunsum ne moalɛ zo mebavi efiade ɛke. 20Mɔɔ hyia me ɛsesebɛ na me nye la la a le kɛ menrɛze me gyima ne anwo nyiane ɛlɛ, na wɔ ewule nu o, ngoane nu o, menwɔnyia akɛnrasesebɛ menwɔva me nwo amuala menwɔli gyima menwɔwula Kelaese anyunlunyia. 21Na mame, mese ngoane a le Kelaese, yɛɛ ewule le nvasoɛ. 22Saa metɛnla ewiade ye anu a anrɛɛ mebali gyima kpalɛ bie. Noko mennwu mɔɔ memkpa nu menva a. 23Megyi ninyɛne nwiɔ avinli. Me kunlu a anrɛɛ mevi ewiade ɛhye anu na me nee Kelaese ɛhɔdɛnla, ɛhye le debie kpalɛ totohyia. 24Na bɛmɛ bɛ ti ɔhyia kpole kpalɛ kɛ menwɔdɛnla ewiade ye anu. 25Mesi pi wɔ ɛhye anwo, na meze kɛ metɛnyianle metɛwule. Meze kɛ me nee bɛ yɛ muala yɛbadɛnla, na bɛanyia ngɔzo na bɛ nye alie wɔ diedi nu, 26amaa saa meba bɛ nwo lɔ bieko a bɛanyia anwosesebɛ bɛava me bɛadu bɛ nwo wɔ bɛ ɛbɛla mɔɔ Kelaese ati bɛlɛbɔ la anwo.
27Bɛmaa bɛ ɛbɛlabɔlɛ wɔ menli nu ɛfɛta mɔɔ Kelaese anwo Edwɛkpa ne kilehile la, amaa saa meba bɛ nwo lɔ o, menle lɔ o, meade kɛ bɛlɛ koyɛlɛ nee adwenle ko bɛgyi kpundii kɛ menli mɔɔ wɔ afoa na bɛlɛko kɛ menli kɛzɔ diedi ne anu. 28Bɛmmasulo bɛ agbɔvolɛ ne mɔ; bɛnyia akɛnrasesebɛ, na ɛhye bahile amaa bɛanwu kɛ bɛmɛ bɛli konim na bɛ agbɔvolɛ ne mɔ ɛho ɛdɔ. Ɔluakɛ bɛ ngoane a le Nyamenle. 29Nyamenle a ɛmaa adenle kɛ bɛlie Kelaese bɛli na bɛnwu amaneɛ wɔ ɔ ti a. 30 Kɛmɔ mekɛ bie bɛnwunle kɛ ɛnee melɛko wɔ diedi nu la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ kɛkala noko bɛte kɛ megua zolɛ a. Bɛhakye kɛ bɛdabɛ bɛrazɔ konle ko ne ala anu.

Title: FEL 2
Content:
Kelaese bɛtɛɛyɛlɛ nee ye kpoleyɛlɛ
1Bɛdie Kelaese bɛdi la ati bɛ nwo yɛ se. Ye ɛhulolɛ ne kyekye bɛ rɛle. Sunsum ne maa bɛdi ahua, ɔmaa bɛyɛ atiakunlukɛnlɛma bɛmaa bɛ nwo ngoko ngoko, na bɛse bɛ nwo anwunvɔne. 2Akee mesɛlɛ bɛ kɛ bɛhye bɛ nwo file, bɛnyia adwenle ko, bɛhulo bɛ nwo ngoko ngoko na bɛmaa me fɛlɛkolilɛ ne ɛli munli. 3Bɛmmayɛ debie biala angomedi nu anzɛɛ adubɛnwo nu; dahuu bɛva anwoazehanlɛ bɛbu bɛ gɔnwo mɔ bɛdɛla bɛ nwo bɔbɔ. 4Awie biala mmadwenle ɔ ngomekye ye boɛyɛlɛ nwo, na ɔdwenle ɔ gɔnwo mɔ noko ɛdeɛ nwo. 5Bɛmaa zɛhae subane ne mɔɔ ɛnee Kelaese Gyisɛse lɛ la ɛvinde bɛ ɛbɛla nu.
6Yemɔ bɔbɔ mɔɔ ɔ nee Nyamenle bɛ su le ko la,
yeandwenle nwo yeampele kɛ ɔ nee Nyamenle kɛzɛ.
7Ɔkpɔlale ɔ kunlu ɔyɛle ɔ nwo akɛlɛ na bɛwole ye kɛ
sonla biala la,
Ɔrale kɛ ɔle sonla,
8ɔbɛlɛle ɔ nwo aze ɔyɛle tieyɛ ɔhɔle ewule nu,
na ɔwule meanubaka zo bɔbɔ.
9Ɔlua zo Nyamenle ɛkpogya ye zo
