na yemaa ye duma fofolɛ mɔɔ tɛla aluma muala.
10 Ɛhye ati, anwuma nee aze nee ɛbolɔ amra amuala
bahoto Gyisɛse na bɛali ye duma ne eni,
11na awie biala aha ye baguase kɛ,
Gyisɛse Kelaese le Awulae,
bɛava bɛawula Nyamenle Selɛ ne anyunlunyia.
Bɛda kɛ bɛle ewiade ahɛnlaneɛ
12Zɔhane ati ayi mɔ, kɛmɔ bɛlile me edwɛkɛ zo wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee me nee bɛ de la, ɔhyia ɛsesebɛ kɛ akee bɛkɛyɛ ye zɔhane kɛkala mɔɔ me nee bɛ ɛnde la. Bɛva ɛzulolɛ nee anwowozolɛ bɛli bɛ ngoanelielɛ ne anwo gyima bɛhɔ awieleɛ, 13ɔluakɛ Nyamenle ɛlɛdi gyima wɔ bɛ nu dahuu, amaa bɛanyia ɛhulolɛ na bɛahola bɛayɛ mɔɔ ɔkpondɛ la.
14Bɛmmatendɛ bɛ nzo abo na bɛsu kpolera wɔ bɛ debie biala ɛyɛlɛ nu, 15 amaa awie annwu nvonleɛ biala wɔ bɛ nwo anzɛɛ anzu bɛ nɔhalɛlilɛ nwo kpolera kɛ bɛle Nyamenle amra mɔɔ evinli fee ɛnle bɛ nwo, wɔ adalɛ nee ɛtane ewiade ye anu a. Saa bɛwɔ bɛ avinli a bɛda kɛ bɛmɛ a bɛle ewiade ahɛnlaneɛ a, 16na bɛzɔ ngoane edwɛkɛ ne anu boɛ, amaa Kenle mɔɔ Kelaese kɛra la meanyia bie meadu me nwo kɛ meanzu ɛnriandilɛ ne mgbane anzɛɛ meanyɛ me gyima ne mgbane.
17Saa bɔbɔ ɔba ye kɛ bɛfa me mogya bɛaye ɛdɛne bɛagua bɛ diedi azubɔlɛ zo bɛamaa Nyamenle a, anrɛɛ me nye die nwolɛ kpole na me nee bɛ di fɛlɛko. 18Zɔhane ala yɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛdabɛ noko bɛ nye die na bɛ nee me di fɛlɛko a.
Temɔte nee Ɛpafulodaetɛse
19Me nye la kɛ saa ɔyɛ Awulae Gyisɛse ɛhulolɛ a ɔnrɛhyɛ biala na meazoa Temɔte wɔ bɛ nwo lɔ, amaa meade bɛ nganeɛ na me nye alie. 20Menlɛ awie mɔɔ kɛdwenle bɛ nwo kpalɛ kɛ medame la, kyesɛ Temɔte ala, yɛɛ yemɔ noko ala a kɛdwenle bɛ nwo a. 21Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛha la biala ɛlɛbɔ ye ɛbɛla mɔɔ hyia ye la, na yegyakyi mɔɔ Gyisɛse Kelaese kpondɛ kɛ ɔyɛ la. 22Bɛdabɛ bɛze Temɔte bolɛ mɔɔ sonle a. Bɛze gyima kpalɛ mɔɔ ɔyɛle ɔ nwo kɛ ralɛ na ɔ nee me yɛlile wɔ Edwɛkpa ne anwo a. 23Yemɔ yɛɛ me nye la kɛ saa menyia menwu kɛ ninyɛne ɛlɛsi ahɔ ye wɔ ɛke la a ɛnee menwɔzoa ye wɔ bɛ nwo lɔ a. 24Me rɛle wɔ Awulae anu kɛ ɔnrɛhyɛ biala na medame mumua ne meara bɛ nwo lɔ.
25Medwenle nwo kɛ eza ɔwɔ kɛ mesoa adiema Ɛpafulodaetɛse noko wɔ bɛ nwo nehane, ɔ nee me a yɛdi gyima ye a, yɛɛ yegyinla me nzi yeho kpalɛ kɛ me gɔnwo sogyanli, eza yezonle na yeboa me kɛ ɔle bɛ soanvolɛ wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ mengɔle ɛhyianlɛ nu la. 26Ɔ nwo ɛlɛdɔ bɛ muala, na ɔlɛdi nyane kɛ bɛdele ye anwonyane nganeɛ a. 27Nɔhalɛ, ɔwule ɔwiele. Na Nyamenle a ɛnwu ye anwunvɔne a, na tɛ yemɔ a yenwu ye anwunvɔne a na mame bɔbɔ ɔ, anrɛɛ me nyanelilɛ ne kɛbo zolɛ. 28Zɔhane ati, memaa yeazia yeara bɛ nwo lɔ bieko ndɛndɛ, amaa bɛnwu ye a bɛ nye alie na medame noko meapɛ me adwenleadwenle ne azo. 29Bɛva fɛlɛkolilɛ bɛlie ye kɛ bɛ diema wɔ Awulae ati. Bɛli menli mɔɔ le kɛ ɔdaye la eni, 30ɔboalekɛ Kelaese gyima ne yɛɛ bɛ moalɛ mɔɔ ɔlua me ti ɔliele kɛ ɔfa yearɛlɛ me la ati a ɔvale ye ngoane ɔdole nzeleba a.

Title: FEL 3
Content:
Tenleneyɛlɛ fɔɔnwo
1Awieleɛ ne, mediema, bɛmaa bɛ nye ɛlie kɛ bɛra Awulae ɛkɛ a. Ɔnyɛ me ɛvɛlɛ kɛ mesi mɔɔ mehɛlɛ ye dɛba la azo wɔ bɛ kpalɛyɛlɛ ti a.
2Bɛnlea boɛ wɔ nindavoma anwo; menli ɛhye mɔ ɛhakyi ahwea mɔɔ nganlɛ ala a bɛkulo kɛ bɛbɔ bɛ nwo a. 3Yɛmɛ a yɛnyia nɔhalɛ mrenyanu nzonlɛyɛlɛ ne a, na tɛ bɛmɛ ɔ, ɔluakɛ yɛdua Nyamenle Sunsum ne azo a yɛsonle a, na yɛdi fɛlɛko kɛ yɛnyia Kelaese Gyisɛse wɔ yɛ ɛbɛla nu. Yɛnva yɛ rɛle yɛnwula ewiade amaamuo nu. 4Saa mekulo a, mekola mefa me rɛle mewula ewiade ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ anu, yɛɛ saa awie dwenle kɛ ɔze ewiade amaamuo mɔɔ ɔkola ɔfa ɔ rɛle ɔwula nu a, anrɛɛ mame bɔbɔ yɛɛ melɛ ye kpole a. 5 Menlile dapɛne ko ala la yɛɛ bɛyɛle me mrenyanu nzonlɛ a. Bɛwole me Yizilayɛnli, mevi Bɛngyaman abusua nu yɛɛ mele Hibulunli tɛnyetɛnye, egya nee ɔmɔ le Hibuluma, yɛɛ ɔba mɛla ne anwo edwɛkɛ a, mele Falasiinli. 6 Mɔdenlebɔlɛ nu a menyɛle diedima ne kpɔdekpɔde, yɛɛ saa ɔhale kɛ sonla di mɛla ne azo na yeazɔ Nyamenle anye a, anrɛɛ menli fɔlɛ hweledede. 7Noko ɔlua Kelaese ati, ninyɛne mɔɔ anrɛɛ anwo lɛ nvasoɛ maa me la ɛnɛ ɛnzɔ me nye bieko. 8Tɛ ɛhye mɔ angome, na ɛnwunlɛ mumua ne mɔɔ menwu Awulae Gyisɛse Kelaese la sonle bolɛ maa me tɛla debie biala. Ɔlua ɔ ti mevuandi debie biala megua; mebu bɛ kɛ fovolɛ zo ewula la, amaa Kelaese ayɛ me ɛdeɛ, 9na bɛanwu kɛ me nee ye lua. Medame mumua ne menlɛ tenleneyɛlɛ biala menyɛ kɛ medi mɛla ne azo la ati ɔ. Me tenleneyɛlɛ lua kɛ medie Kelaese medi la ati ɔ. Tenleneyɛlɛ ɛhye vi Nyamenle ɛkɛ na ɔdua yɛ diedi zo a ɔfa ɔmaa a. 10Mɔɔ mekpondɛ la a le kɛ menwɔnwu Kelaese na menwɔde ye ewudwazo tumi ne me nu, na me nee ye yɛkɛnwu amaneɛ na menwɔyɛ kɛ ɔdaye wɔ ye ewule nu, 11amaa me nye ala kɛ Nyamenle badwazo medame noko avi ewule nu ara ngoane mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ la anu.
Ɛnriandilɛ kpalɛ ne
12Menga kɛ meho medɔ zo anzɛɛ meli munli. Metɛbɔ mɔdenle kɛ me sa kɛha ahyɛlɛdeɛ ne mɔɔ yemɔti Kelaese Gyisɛse ɛva ɔ sa ɛdo me nwo zo la. 13Mediema, nɔhalɛ, menva ye kɛ me sa ɛha ahyɛlɛdeɛ ne; debie ko yɛɛ meyɛ a, na yemɔ a le kɛ me rɛle kɛvi mɔɔ ɛze me nzi la na menwɔbɔ mɔdenle kɛ menwɔdwu mɔɔ wɔ me nyunlu la anwo. 14Yemɔti memia me nwo kɛ menriandi meahɔ awieleɛ, amaa me sa aha ahyɛlɛdeɛ ne mɔɔ le anwuma ngoane ne mɔɔ Nyamenle lua Kelaese anwo zo ɛlɛfɛlɛ yɛ ahɔ nu la.
15Bɛmaa yɛmɛ mɔɔ yɛnyi sunsum nu la yɛnyia subane zɛhae, na saa bɛ bie mɔ noko lɛ subane ngakyile bie a, Nyamenle ɔdaye ɔbahilehile bɛ yeamaa bɛade ɔ bo. 16Noko kɛ ɔde biala la, bɛmaa yɛhɔ yɛ nyunlu yɛzɔ mɔɔ yɛlɛ la anu boɛ.
17 Me mediema, bɛ muala bɛva me gyakɛ. Yɛmaa bɛ ndonwo kpalɛ, yemɔti bɛnlea bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdi zolɛ la boɛ. 18Ɔluakɛ dahuu meka, yɛɛ ɛnɛ noko melɛ nyanelilɛ melɛsi zolɛ a: menli dɔɔnwo wɔ ɛkɛ mɔɔ bɛ ɛbɛlabɔlɛ ne ɛmaa bɛyɛ Kelaese meanubaka ne azo ewule ne anwo agbɔvolɛ a. 19Menli ɛhye mɔ, bɛ awieleɛ a le kɛ Nyamenle bazɛkye bɛ, ɔluakɛ bɛ nyamenle a le bɛ ko. Mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛse nwolɛ nyiane la bɛfa bɛtu bɛ nwo, yɛɛ bɛ adwenle muala gyi ewiade ninyɛne zo. 20Yɛmɛ, yɛ nzi maanle wɔ anwuma. Ɛkɛ ne yɛɛ yɛ nye la kɛ yɛ Dievolɛ Awulae Gyisɛse Kelaese vi bara a. 21Na ɔbalua tumi ne mɔɔ maa ɔkola ɔfa ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti ɔbawula ɔ bo la azo yeahakyi yɛ nwonane wulera ɛhye yeayɛ ye kɛ ye anyunlunyia nwonane ɛdeɛ ne la.

Title: FEL 4
Content:
Ngilehilelɛ
1Zɔhane ati, me mediema kulovolɛma, mɔɔ me nwo dɔ bɛ a, me ahyɛlɛdeɛ mɔɔ me nye die bɛ nwo, na mefa bɛ metu me nwo a! Mediema kpalɛ, bɛgyinla kpundii kɛ bɛle Kelaese ɛdeɛ.
2Mebodo mesɛlɛ Yiwodea nee Senteki kɛ bɛmaa bɛ nloa ɛzɛ bɛ nwo kɛ mediema mraalɛ mɔɔ nee Awulae a lua a. 3Akee wɔmɔ noko, me boavolɛ kpalɛ, mekpondɛ kɛ ɛboa mraalɛ ɛhye mɔ; ɔluakɛ bɛ nee me nee Kelɛmɛnte nee me gɔnwo mɔ gyimayɛvoma mɔɔ ɛha la amuala, mɔɔ bɛ aluma wɔ Nyamenle ngoane buluku ne anu la a lile Edwɛkpa ne ɛkpondenlɛ nwo gyima a.
4Bɛmaa bɛ nye ɛlie dahuu kɛ bɛle Awulae ɛdeɛ a; mesi zo bieko: bɛmaa bɛ nye ɛlie!
5Bɛmaa awie biala ɛnwu kɛ bɛlɛ abotane molozo. Awulae ɛbikye. 6Bɛmmadwenle debie biala anwo. Wɔ debie biala anu bɛyɛ moyɛlɛ nzɛlɛlɛ na bɛva mɔɔ bɛhyia nwolɛ la bɛdo Nyamenle anyunlu. 7Na Nyamenle anzonudwolɛ ne mɔɔ bo sonla ndelebɛbo muala azo la bazie bɛ ahonle nee bɛ adwenle gyɛlɛɛnye wɔ Kelaese ati.
8Me mediema, mɔɔ meka meadwula me edwɛkɛ ne la a le kɛ, bɛdwenle ninyɛne mɔɔ le nɔhalɛ, mɔɔ lɛ duma, ninyɛne mɔɔ le fɔɔnwo, mɔɔ anwo te, mɔɔ le kɛnlɛma, mɔɔ sɔ ɛnyelɛ, nee mɔɔ di munli na ayɛlɛyelɛ wɔ nwolɛ la anwo. 9Bɛyɛ ninyɛne mɔɔ bɛzukoa na bɛlie bɛdo nu bɛvi me ɛdendɛlɛ nee me nyɛleɛ nu la, na Nyamenle ne mɔɔ maa yɛ anzonudwolɛ la nee bɛ badɛnla.
Moyɛlɛ
10Medi fɛlɛko kpole wɔ Awulae ati kɛ mekɛ tendenle ye anzi, eza bɛnyia adenle bɛlɛkile kɛ bɛdwenle me nwo a. Menga kɛ bɛgyakyi me nwo ɛdwenlenlɛ, na ɛnee bɛnnyia adenle. 11Mɔɔ melɛka la ɛngile kɛ me nwo ɛhyele me, ɔluakɛ mezukoa kɛ me kunlu kɛdwo me nwo mekɛ biala wɔ gyinlabelɛ biala mɔɔ mewɔ nu la anu. 12Meze ehyia di, meze ezukoa di. Mezukoa ɛhye mɔ ɛyɛlɛ, amaa ɛleka biala nee mekɛ biala anu, saa menyia ye medi o, meannyia ye meanli o, saa melɛ bie o, menlɛ bie o, me kunlu adwo me nwo. 13Ɔlua anwosesebɛ ne mɔɔ Kelaese fa maa me la ati, mekola megyinla ninyɛne muala anloa.
14Noko bɛyɛle ye boɛ kɛ bɛboale me wɔ me anwongyelelɛ ne anu a. 15 Bɛmɛ Felepaema, bɛdabɛ bɛze ye wienyi kɛ mɔɔ medumua meabɔ Edwɛkpa ne nolo, mɔɔ menvile Masidonea la, bɛmɛ ala a bɛle asɔnema mɔɔ boale me, nleɛnleanle me nvasoɛ nee me kakɛ nu a. 16 Fane dɔɔnwo ne ala bɛnwanle me wɔ mekɛ biala mɔɔ me nwo kɛhyele me wɔ Tɛsalonaeka la. 17Tɛ kɛ asɛɛ mekpondɛ nwanle la ati ɔ, na mekpondɛ kɛ mɔɔ bɛyɛ la anwo ba nvasoɛ dɔɔnwo. 18 Ahyɛlɛdeɛ biala mɔɔ bɛva bɛnwa me la me sa ɛha ye, ɔzonle somaa! Kɛkala mɔɔ me sa ɛha bɛ nwanle mɔɔ Ɛpafulodaetɛse ɛva ɛrɛlɛ me la, mengyia debie biala anwo bieko. Bɛ ahyɛlɛdeɛ ne le kɛ azubɔlɛ evuanlɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle kulo na ɔ nye sɔ ye la. 19Me Nyamenle ne balua Kelaese Gyisɛse anyunlunyia nu anwonyia kpole ne azo ayɛ bɛ ɛhyianlɛdeɛ amaa bɛ. 20Anyunlunyia ɛha yɛ Ze Nyamenle ne dahuu! Amen.
Ahyebizalɛ
21Yɛbiza Nyamenle menli ne mɔɔ le Kelaese Gyisɛse ɛdeɛ la kɔsɔɔti ahye. Mediema mɔɔ nee me wɔ ɛke la biza bɛ ahye. 22Nyamenle menli ne mɔɔ wɔ ɛke la amuala, bɔbɔ Maanle Maanle belemgbunli ne suakunlu amra ne mɔ biza bɛ ahye.
23Awulae Gyisɛse Kelaese ɛlo bɛ na ɔ nee bɛ muala ɛdɛnla.

Title: KƆLƆ MUKENYE
Content:
Mukenye
Pɔɔlo kɛlata ne mɔɔ ɔhɛlɛle Kɔlɔsaema la, ɔvale ɔhɔmanle ɛkɛ ne asɔne ne anu amra. Kɔlɔsae le sua wɔ Ehyea Maena, wɔ Ɛfɛsɛse afoa nu mɔɔ di kɔ sɛnzɛne aduduleɛ la. Tɛ Pɔɔlo a dele asɔne ɛhye a, na kɛmɔ ɛnee ɔwɔ ɛleka mɔɔ bikye ye la ati, ɛnee ɔnea a ɔdaye Pɔɔlo a ɔdi nwolɛ ɛzonle a, ɔluakɛ ɛnee ɔwɔ Ɛfɛsɛse. Ɛfɛsɛse le Wulomu maanzinli ne mɔɔ wɔ Ehyea la suakpole. Mekɛ ne anu ɛnee Pɔɔlo a soɔzoa menli maa bɛkɔkpɔla asɔne ne mɔ mɔɔ wɔ maanzinli ne anu la a. Pɔɔlo ɛde kɛ kilehilevolɛma alane bie ɛragua Kɔlɔsae asɔne ne anu na bɛlɛkilehile kɛ amaa sonla anwu Nyamenle na yeanyia ngoane la, ɔwɔ kɛ ɔfa ɔ nwo ɔwula “sunsum nu arelemgbunli nee tumivolɛma” bie abo. Eza bɛse kilehilevolɛma ɛhye mɔ se ɔwɔ kɛ sonla di amaamuo mɔɔ le kɛ mrenyanu nzonlɛyɛlɛ la azo na bɛdi aleɛ nwo ngyehyɛlɛ nee ngyehyɛlɛ bie mɔɔ veɛvea ɛkɛ la azo.
Pɔɔlo hɛlɛle Kelaese anwo edwɛkɛ kpalɛ ne hɔtiale ngilehilelɛ ɛhye mɔ. Ye edwɛkɛ titile mɔɔ ɔvale ɔhɔmanle bɛ la a le kɛ Gyisɛse Kelaese kola die ngoane na ninyɛne ngakyile ɛhye mɔ ɛyɛlɛ te sonla fi Gyisɛse anwo. Kelaese anwo zo yɛɛ Nyamenle luale bɔle ewiade a, yɛɛ ɔ nwo zo a ɔlua ɔlɛtwe ewiade yeamaa ɔ nwo a. Kelaese angome ala anu a aleɛabo amra lɛ anyelazo kɛ bɛkɛnyia ngoane a. Akee Pɔɔlo hilehilele ngilehilelɛ kpole ɛhye anu kpomgbondee ne mɔ anu wienyi wɔ diedima ne ngoane ti.
Debie ko mɔɔ hyia nzonlɛyɛlɛ la a le kɛ, Onɛsemɛse mɔɔ le kanranli ne mɔɔ yemɔ ɔ ti a Pɔɔlo hɛlɛle “Faelimɔn” la nee Tekekɛse a vale Kɔlɔsaema kɛlata ne hɔle a.
Mɔɔ wɔ nu la
Ngilenu 1.1-8
Kelaese su ne nee ye gyima 1.9—2.19
Ɛbɛlabɔlɛ fofolɛ ne wɔ Kelaese ati 2.20—4.6
Adwulaleɛ 4.7-18

Title: KƆLƆ 1
Content:
1Kɛlata ɛhye vi Pɔɔlo mɔɔ ɔlua Nyamenle ɛhulolɛ zo yeyɛ Kelaese Gyisɛse ɛzoanvolɛ la nee yɛ diema Temɔte ɛkɛ ne. 2Yɛfa yɛahɔmaa Nyamenle menli ne mɔɔ wɔ Kɔlɔsae na bɛle yɛ mediema nɔhavoma kpalɛ mɔɔ die Kelaese di nɔhalɛ nu la.
Yɛ Ze Nyamenle ɛlo bɛ na ɔmaa bɛ anzonudwolɛ.
Moyɛlɛ nzɛlɛlɛ
3Dahuu yɛsɛlɛ yɛmaa bɛ, yɛyɛ Gyisɛse Kelaese ɔ Ze Nyamenle ne mo. 4Ɔluakɛ yɛde kɛ bɛliele Kelaese Gyisɛse bɛlile la, bɛnyia ɛhulolɛ wɔ Nyamenle menli ne anwo, 5ɔboalekɛ bɛlɛ anyelazo bie mɔɔ bɛ sa baha ye wɔ anwuma a. Anyelazo ɛhye a bɛdele nwolɛ edwɛkɛ alumua ne, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛvale Edwɛkpa ne bɛrɛlɛle bɛ la. 6Edwɛkpa ne ɛlɛso ma yɛɛ ɔlɛnyi wɔ ewiade ɛleka kɔsɔɔti, kɛmɔ ɔzile la pɛpɛ wɔ bɛ nuhua wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛlumuale bɛdele Nyamenle ɛlolɛ ɛhye anwo edwɛkɛ ne na bɛdele ɔ bo bɛnwunle ye deɛ holɛ la. 7 Ɛpafelase a hilehilele bɛ Nyamenle ɛlolɛ ɛhye anwo edwɛkɛ a. Ɔle yɛ diema sonvolɛ kpalɛ kpalɛ mɔɔ sonle Kelaese nɔhalɛ nu a; ɔgyi yɛ gyakɛ anu wɔ lɔ. 8Ɔdaye yɛɛ eza yeha ɛhulolɛ ne mɔɔ Sunsum ne ɛva ɛmaa bɛ la anwo edwɛkɛ yehile yɛ a.
9Ɔlua ɛhye ati, sumunli kɛ yɛdele bɛ nganeɛ la, dahuu yɛsɛlɛ yɛmaa bɛ. Yɛsɛlɛ Nyamenle kɛ ɔva sunsum nu nrɛlɛbɛ nee ndelebɛbo muala ɔyi bɛ tɛkɛɛ, amaa bɛanyia Nyamenle ɛhulolɛdeɛ ne anwo ndelebɛbo, 10bɛabɔ bɛ ɛbɛla ne bɛamaa yeafɛta Awulae, dahuu bɛayɛ mɔɔ ɔkulo la, na bɛ ɛbɛlabɔlɛ ne anwo ara nvasoɛ wɔ gyima kpalɛ biala mɔɔ bɛyɛ la anu, na bɛade Nyamenle edwɛkɛ ne abo kpalɛ. 11Yɛsɛlɛ kɛ Nyamenle ɛva ye anyunlunyia tumi ne ɛwula bɛ anwosesebɛ, amaa bɛava abotane nee anyelielɛ bɛagyinla debie biala anloa, 12na bɛava fɛlɛkolilɛ bɛayɛ Selɛ ne mɔɔ ɛmaa bɛfɛta kɛ bɛ nee ye menli ne kɛbɔ nu kɛdɛnla ye wienyi ne anu la mo. 13Nyamenle ɛlie yɛ ɛvi awozinli nu tumi ne mɔ abo, yeva yɛ yera ɔ Ra kulovolɛ ne belemgbunlililɛ ne abo, 14 na yelua ɔ nwo zo yekpɔne yɛ, yeva yɛ ɛtane yehyɛ yɛ.
Kelaese su ne nee ye gyima
15Kelaese le Nyamenle ne mɔɔ ɛnyelɛ ɛnnwu ye la sɔhovolɛ. Yemɔ a ɔle abɔdeɛ muala anu belamunli Ralɛ a. 16Ɔ nwo zo a Nyamenle luale bɔle ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti a: mɔɔ wɔ anwuma o nee mɔɔ wɔ aze o, mɔɔ bɛnwu bɛ nee mɔɔ bɛnnwu bɛ la amuala, ewiade ye anu tumima nee arelemgbunli nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsie ɛnɛ mekɛ ye anu awozinli ewiade ye nee sunsum nu ɛlɔnema; Nyamenle luale Kelaese anwo zo a bɔle ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti a, yɛɛ Kelaese ati a ɔbɔle bɛ a. 17Kelaese wɔ ɛkɛ ne kolaa na ɛhye mɔ amuala ara, na yemɔ a ɔsɔ ewiade ye ɔmaa ɔyɛ ewiade a. 18 Yemɔ a ɔle ye sonlabaka ne, mɔɔ le Asɔne ne ati a, yemɔ a ɔle debie biala mɔlebɛbo a, yɛɛ yemɔ a ɔle bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdwazole bɛ bɛvile ewule nu la kpanyinli a, amaa debie biala anu yealumua. 19Ɔluakɛ Nyamenle ɔdaye ɔhulole yɛɛ ɔvale ye su ne amuala ɔwulale Ralɛ ne nu a. 20 Ɛhye ati, ɔlua Ralɛ ne anwo zo, Nyamenle ɛbɔ kpɔkɛ kɛ ɔdie aleɛabo ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti mɔɔ wɔ anwuma nee aze la yeamaa ɔ nwo na yealua ɔ Ra ne ewule mɔɔ ɔwule meanubaka ne azo la azo ɔ nee bɛ ayɛ ko.
21Dɛba ne ɔlua bɛ ninyɛndane mɔɔ bɛyɛle nee bɛ adwenle ɛtane mɔɔ bɛlɛ ye la ati, ɛnee bɛ nee Nyamenle bɛ avinli twe, na bɛle ye agbɔvolɛ. 22Na kɛkala, ɔlua Kelaese ewule ne azo bɛyɛ Nyamenle agɔnwo mɔ, amaa yeava bɛ yeara ɔ nyunlu kɛ bɛ nwo te nwuanzaanwu mɔɔ fɔlɛlilɛ biala ɛnle bɛ nu a. 23Zɔhane ati, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛkɔ zolɛ bɛsɔ bɛ diedi ne anu ɛsesebɛ, bɛgyinla bɛ ti na bɛgyinla kpundii. Saa bɛyɛ ye zɔhane a yɛɛ awie ɛnrɛhola ɛnrɛzɛkye bɛ anyelazo ne mɔɔ bɛnyianle ye wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛdele Edwɛkpa ne la a. Edwɛkpa ɛhye, bɛbɔ ye nolo bɛhile abɔdeɛ muala mɔɔ wɔ aleɛabo la, yɛɛ medame, Pɔɔlo a bɛyɛ me nwolɛ sonvolɛ a.
Pɔɔlo gyima kɛ ɔle Asɔne ne sonvolɛ
24Kɛkala, bɛdabɛ bɛ ti ɔyɛ me fɛ kɛ melɛnwu amaneɛ a, ɔluakɛ melua me nwonane nu amaneɛnwunlɛ ye azo melɛboa meamaa Kelaese amaneɛnwunlɛ wɔ ye Asɔne ne ati ali munli. 25Ɛhye ati yɛɛ Nyamenle ɛyɛ me asɔne ne sonvolɛ, na yeva gyima ɛhye yemaa me kɛ menyɛ wɔ bɛ ti a. Gyima ne a le Nyamenle edwɛkɛ ne nolobɔlɛ. 26Ɔle fealera nu debie mɔɔ Nyamenle vale veale aleɛabo amra ɛvolɛ dɔɔnwo mɔɔ ɛraze ɛhɔ la, na kɛkala yeye yehile ye menli ne a. 27Nyamenle ngyehyɛlɛ ne a le kɛ ɔkɛye ye fealera nu kpɔkɛ ne mɔɔ ɔbɔle, mɔɔ anyunlunyia nee anwonyia ɛyi ye tɛkɛɛ, na ɔwɔ ɛkɛ ɔmaa maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti la ɔkɛhile ye menli ne. Fealera nu kpɔkɛ ɛhye a le kɛ Kelaese ne de bɛ nu, na ɔbamaa bɛanyia anyelazo kɛ kenle bie bɛbanyia Nyamenle anyunlunyia ne bie. 28Yemɔti yɛbɔ Kelaese ɛhye anwo nolo yɛkile awie biala, yɛkilehile bɛ na yɛbɔ bɛ kɔkɔ nrɛlɛbɛ nu, amaa yɛava ko biala yɛara Nyamenle anyunlu kɛ sonla mɔɔ di munli, na ɔ nee Kelaese a lua a. 29Na ɛhye yɛɛ melɛ anwosesebɛ kpole ne mɔɔ Kelaese fa maa na ɔyɛ gyima ɛsesebɛ wɔ me nu la mepele meyɛ a.

Title: KƆLƆ 2
Content:
1Bɛmaa menga gyima ɛsesebɛ mɔɔ meyɛ memaa bɛ nee menli mɔɔ wɔ Lawɔdesia, nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛtɛnwunle me nyunlu ɛlɛ la mengile bɛ. 2Meka ɛhye meamaa bɛ akɛnrazilɛ na bɛali ahua wɔ ɛhulolɛ nu, amaa bɛanyia diedi nu anwonyia ne mɔɔ ndelebɛbo kpalɛ fa maa la. Zɛhae adenle zo yɛɛ bɛlua a bɛkɛnwu deɛ ne mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛva ɛvea la a; deɛ ne mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛva ɛvea la a le Kelaese ɔdaye mumua ne. 3Kelaese anu a Nyamenle nrɛlɛbɛ ne mɔɔ anwonyia ɛyi ye tɛkɛɛ nee adwenlenubukelɛ vea a.
4Meka ɛhye meahile bɛ: bɛmmamaa awie fa ɔ nloa anu menlemenle yɛ bɛ koasea. 5Ɔluakɛ menle bɛ nwo lɔ ɛdeɛ, noko me nee bɛ de wɔ sunsum nu, na ɔyɛ me fɛ kɛ menwu kɛ bɛsi bɛdi bɛ nwo eni nee kɛ bɛ diedi wɔ Kelaese anu si de kpundii la.
Ɛbɛlabɔlɛ munli wɔ Kelaese anu
6Kɛmɔ bɛlie Kelaese Gyisɛse bɛdo nu kɛ ɔle Awulae la, bɛ nee ye ɛdɛnla. 7Bɛyɛ kɛ menli mɔɔ ɛsosɔ ndinli kpalɛ wɔ Kelaese anu la, bɛlua ɔ nwo zo bɛbɔ bɛ ɛbɛla, bɛmaa bɛ diedi ɛgyinla kpundii, kɛmɔ bɛhilehilele bɛ la, na bɛyɛ ye mo dahuu.
8Bɛnlea boɛ na awie anva mɛlɛbɛla nee adalɛ nrɛlɛbɛ mɔɔ bɛlua ewiade amaamuo zo bɛhyehyɛ, nee mɔɔ vi awozinli ewiade ye sunsum nu tumima ɛkɛ ne na ɔnvi Kelaese ɛkɛ ne la anyɛ bɛ ngɛkɛlɛ. 9Ɔluakɛ Nyamenle su ne de Kelaese sonlabaka ne nu, 10na kɛmɔ yemɔ a ɔbo sunsum nu arelemgbunli nee tumivolɛma anwo zo la, bɛ nee ye ɛyɛ ko na bɛli munli.
11Bɛ nee Kelaese yɛle ko ala la yɛɛ bɛyɛle bɛ mrenyanu nzonlɛ a, tɛ nwonane nu, kɛmɔ menli yɛ la ɔ, ɛhye le Kelaese ɔdaye ye nzonlɛyɛlɛ mɔɔ ɔyɛ yɛ ɔfi nwonane ɛtane ɛhye mɔ tumi ne abo a. 12 Ɔluakɛ mɔɔ bɛzɔnenle bɛ ala la, ɛnee bɛzie bɛ su ɛtane ne nee Kelaese. Eza wɔ ɛzɔnenlɛ ne anu ala bɛluale bɛ diedi mɔɔ wɔ Nyamenle tumi ne mɔɔ dwazole Kelaese vile ewule nu la azo bɛdwazole bɛdabɛ noko. 13 Mekɛ bie mɔɔ ɛraze ɛhɔ la ɛnee ɔlua bɛ ɛtane ti, nee kɛmɔ bɛnle Dwuuma na bɛnle Mosisi mɛla ne abo la ati, ɛnee bɛwu sunsum nu, na kɛkala Nyamenle ɛva bɛ nee Kelaese ɛra ngoane nu, na yeva yɛ ɛtane ne mɔ amuala yehyɛ yɛ. 14 Ɔpɛle yɛ ɛtane nwo kakɛ biala mɔɔ maa mɛla ne kyekye yɛ la anu, ɔyele ye ɛkɛ ne na ɔvale ɔbɔle meanubaka ne azo. 15Kelaese liele ɔ nwo wɔ meanubaka ne azo wɔ awozinli ewiade ye sunsum nu tumima asa anu, ɔguale bɛ nyunlu aze wɔ bagua nu na ɔzinlanle bɛ nyɛma zo wɔ ye konimlilɛ ɛlɔnwɔnedolɛ ne anu.
16 Yemɔti bɛmmamaa awie bua bɛ ndɛne wɔ mɔɔ bɛdi nee mɔɔ bɛno, anzɛɛ ɛvoyialilɛ nwo, anzɛɛ Siane Fofolɛ nee Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle nwo. 17Ɛhye mɔ amuala le ninyɛne mɔɔ bara la ɛlawolɛ; bɛ kpalɛ kpalɛ ne a le Kelaese. 18Menli bie wɔ ɛkɛ mɔɔ bɛdie bɛdabɛ bɛ ngome bɛ nwo bɛdi, bɛdwenle anwoazehanlɛ nee anwuma soanvolɛma ɛzonlenlɛ nwo, na bɛfa ye kɛ ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ le debie mɔɔ hyia tɛla zolɛ; menli zɛhae mɔ fa bɛ ewiade adwenle ne tu bɛ nwo mɔɔ ndelebɛbo biala ɛnle nu a. Bɛmmamaa menli zɛhae mɔ adenle bɛmaa bɛsɛkye bɛ adwenle, kɛ asɛɛ mɔɔ bɛmɛ bɛlɛyɛ la bɛnyɛ ye boɛ. 19 Menli zɔhane mɔ ɛkpo kɛ bɛnrɛdoa Kelaese mɔɔ le Asɔne ne ati la. Kelaese a le Asɔne ne, mɔɔ le ye sonlabaka ne. Ɔdi ye adane, ɔkuohua ye ɔmaa ɔnyi, kɛmɔ Nyamenle kpondɛ ye ala la.
Yɛ nee Kelaese wu, yɛ nee ye tɛnla ngoane nu
20Saa bɛ nee Kelaese ɛwu na bɛnyia bɛ ti wɔ awozinli ewiade ye sunsum nu tumima ne mɔ asa anu a, ɛnee akee duzu ati a bɛbɔ bɛ ɛbɛla kɛ asɛɛ bɛde aze bɛmaa ewiade ɛ? Duzu ati a bɛdi mɛla anzɛɛ ngyehyɛlɛ mɔɔ le kɛ, 21“Mmafa ɛ sa ɛka ɛhye”, “Mmafa ɛhendeɛ ne ɛka ɛ nloa”, “Mmasɔ ɛhendeɛ ne anu” azo ɛ? 22Ngyehyɛlɛ ɛhye mɔ kɔsɔɔti fane ninyɛne mɔɔ saa ɛnyia bɛfa bɛyɛ debie ko a, bɛfa bɛyɛ debie bieko a ɔnyɛ boɛ la anwo. Bɛle menli ngilehilelɛ nee ngyehyɛlɛ. 23Ngyehyɛlɛ zɛhae mɔ ɔyɛ a zɔho kɛ gyi nrɛlɛbɛ zo wɔ bɛ anwuma soanvolɛma ɛzonlenlɛ nu, bɛ adalɛ anyelielɛ ne mɔɔ bɛnyia ye wɔ bɛ ngome bɛ nwo, nee nwonane ne nyanehilelɛ nwo la anu; na ɔmboa sonla ɔmmaa ɔngomo ɔ nwo zo. Bɛ nwonane nu atiakunluwɔzo ne bɔbɔ akee yɛ kpole.

Title: KƆLƆ 3
Content:
1 Bɛdwazo bɛ nee Kelaese bɛra ngoane nu. Yemɔti bɛmaa bɛ ahonle ɛdoa ninyɛne mɔɔ wɔ anwuma lɔ, ɛleka mɔɔ Kelaese de ye belemgbunli ebia nu wɔ Nyamenle asa fema zo la abo zo. 2Bɛdwenle ninyɛne mɔɔ wɔ anwuma lɔ la anwo na bɛgyakyi mɔɔ wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo la. 3Ɔluakɛ bɛwu na bɛva bɛ ngoane bɛboka Kelaese ɛdeɛ ne bɛvea Nyamenle anu. 4Yɛ ngoane a le Kelaese, yemɔti mekɛ mɔɔ Kelaese kɛra la bɛdabɛ noko bɛ nee ye kɛra anyunlunyia nu.
Ɛbɛla dɛba ne nee fofolɛ ne ɛbɔlɛ
5Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛku nwonane nu atiakunluwɔzo ne mɔ mɔɔ wɔ bɛ nu, mɔɔ le kɛ adwɔmane, ɛbɛla mgbane mgbane ɛbɔlɛ, ɛhulolɛ ɛtane, atiakunluwɔzo ɛtane, yɛɛ anyebolo, ɔluakɛ ɛhye mɔ ɛyɛlɛ le awozonle ɛzonlenlɛ. 6Ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ ati Nyamenle ɛya ne bara bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛandie ɔ ne la anwo zo. 7Bɛdabɛ noko, mekɛ bie mɔɔ ɛraze ɛhɔ la ɛnee bɛ atiakunluwɔzo kɛ de la ɛne.
8Na kɛkala ɔwɔ kɛ bɛgua ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ amuala lɔ: ninyɛne mɔɔ le kɛ ɛya ɛvalɛ, ahonle kpole, ɛkpɔlɛ, yɛɛ dumanzɛkyelɛ. Bɛmmamaa aholoba anzɛɛ edwɛkɛ ɛtane fi bɛ nloa anu finde. 9 Bɛmmabɔ adalɛ bɛkile bɛ nwo, ɔluakɛ bɛye bɛ su dɛba ne nee ye nyɛleɛ ne mɔ wɔ bɛ nu bɛgua. 10 Bɛva su fofolɛ ne, mɔɔ Nyamenle ne mɔɔ bɔle ye la nea ye ɛsaso zo kakyihakyi ye dahuu la bɛwula, amaa bɛanwu kɛ ɔdaye mumua ne ɔsi ɔde la. 11Zɔhane ati, ansolo bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la nee Dwuuma, ansolo menli mɔɔ bɛyɛ bɛ mrenyanu nzonlɛ nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛtɛyɛle bɛ bie la, ansolo nyɛvolɛ, ansolo menli mɔɔ anye ɛtɛtele, ansolo ahanra, yɛɛ ansolo alehelɛ. Kelaese a le ninyɛne kpokpoti a. Kelaese wɔ ye kpokpoti anu.
12 Bɛle Nyamenle menli mɔɔ yehulo bɛ na yekpa nu yeye bɛ kɛ ɔdaye ye ɛdeɛ na bɛ nwo te a. Yemɔti bɛze anwunvɔne, bɛyɛ atiakunlukɛnlɛma, bɛbɛlɛ bɛ nwo aze, bɛyɛ bɛtɛɛ na bɛzi abotane wɔ debie biala anu. 13 Bɛsosɔ bɛ nwo ngoko ngoko, na saa bie lɛ ɔ gɔnwo anwo ɛya a ɔva ɔhyɛ ye. Bɛva ɛtane bɛhyɛ, kɛmɔ Awulae ɛva bɛ nwo edwɛkɛ ɛhyɛ bɛ la. 14Na bɛva ɛhulolɛ bɛboka ɛhye mɔ anwo, na yemɔ yɛɛ kɛmaa bɛkɛli munli a. 15Bɛmaa Kelaese anzonudwolɛ ne mɔɔ ɔmaa bɛ la ɛvinde bɛ kpɔkɛbɔlɛ nu, ɔluakɛ Nyamenle ɛvɛlɛ bɛ muala wɔ asɔne ye anu kɛ bɛdɛnla anzonudwolɛ nu. Bɛnwu nyele.
16 Bɛmaa Kelaese edwɛkɛ ne nee nwolɛ nvasoɛ muala ɛdɛnla bɛ nu kpalɛ. Bɛva nrɛlɛbɛ bɛhilehile bɛ nwo na bɛdu bɛ nwo folɛ. Bɛdo edwɛne, anyelielɛ edwɛne, na bɛdo sunsum nu edwɛne bɛboka moyɛlɛ mɔɔ vi ahonle nu la bɛmaa Nyamenle. 17Debie biala mɔɔ bɛyɛ, edwɛkɛ biala mɔɔ bɛka, nyɛleɛ biala anu, bɛyɛ ye wɔ Awulae Gyisɛse duma nu, na bɛlua ɔ nwo zo bɛyɛ Nyamenle Selɛ ne mo.
Ɛbɛlabɔlɛ fofolɛ ne
18 Yelɛma, bɛha bɛ nwo aze bɛmaa bɛ hu mɔ, na mɔɔ Kelaese ɛdoavolɛ biala ɔwɔ kɛ yɛ la ɛne.
19 Kunlima, bɛhulo bɛ ye mɔ, bɛmmayɛ bɛ nwo zo kengɛndɛɛnye.
20 Ngakula, bɛdie bɛ awovolɛma edwɛkɛ wɔ debie biala anu, ɔboalekɛ yemɔ a Nyamenle anye die nwolɛ a.
21 Awovolɛma, bɛmmatu bɛ mra anwo mɔra, anrɛɛ bɛ rɛle kɛbɔ.
22 Ngɛkɛlɛ, bɛdie bɛ ewiade ye anu menlenlɛma edwɛkɛ wɔ debie biala anu, bɛmmayɛ ye wɔ ɛnyelɛ zo kɛ bɛyɛ bɛahile ala na bɛayɛ bɛ mo; bɛva Nyamenle ɛzulolɛ bɛyeye bɛ ahonle nu bɛyɛ. 23Debie biala mɔɔ bɛyɛ la bɛva ahonle kpalɛ bɛyɛ, kɛ asɛɛ bɛyɛ bɛamaa Awulae, na bɛnyɛ bɛmmaa sonla. 24Bɛhakye kɛ Awulae a bamaa bɛ nwolɛ ahatualɛ ne mɔɔ yeva yezie ɛkɛ yemaa ye menli la a. Ɔluakɛ Awulae Kelaese a le Menlenlɛ ne mɔɔ bɛsonle ye la. 25 Ɛtanevolɛ biala noko banyia ye ɛtane ne mɔ anwo ahatualɛ, Nyamenle bua sonla ko biala ndɛne, kɛmɔ ɔfɛta la, ɔnli mɔguazo. mɔguazo.

Title: KƆLƆ 4
Content:
1 Menlenlɛma, bɛnlea bɛ ngɛkɛlɛ ne mɔ boɛ gyɛlɛɛnye. Bɛhakye kɛ bɛdabɛ noko bɛlɛ bɛ Menle wɔ anwuma.
Folɛdulɛ
2Bɛyɛ nzɛlɛlɛ dahuu, bɛzie bɛ adwenle koonwu wɔ bɛ nzɛlɛlɛ nu, na bɛyɛ Nyamenle mo. 3Eza bɛzɛlɛ bɛmaa yɛdayɛ noko kɛ Nyamenle ɛmaa yɛ mekɛ kpalɛ ɔmaa yɛbɔ fealera nu Edwɛkpa ne mɔɔ fane Kelaese anwo la nolo. Ɔluakɛ ɛhye ala ati yɛɛ kɛkala mela efiade a. 4Yemɔti bɛzɛlɛ kɛ menwɔdendɛ menwɔhile nu wienyi, kɛmɔ ɔwɔ kɛ meyɛ ye ala la.
5 Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnlɛ diedi la, bɛ nee bɛ ɛzia nrɛlɛbɛ nu, na bɛdendɛ bɛhile bɛ wɔ mekɛ biala mɔɔ bɛkɛnyia nuhua adenle la. 6Bɛmaa bɛ nloa edwɛkɛ ɛyɛ fɛ na ɔyɛ anyelielɛ, na bɛnwu nyelebɛnloa kpalɛ mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛfa bɛye awie biala edwɛkɛ nloa la.
Awieleɛ nrɛlaleɛ
7 Adiema kulovolɛ Tekekɛse, mɔɔ le nɔhalɛ gyimayɛvolɛ nee sonvolɛ wɔ Awulae gyima nu la babɔ me nwo edwɛkɛ ahile bɛ. 8Ɛhye ati a melɛsoa ye wɔ bɛ nwo lɔ a, amaa yeaha kɛ yɛ agbɔkɛ nu si de la yeahile bɛ na bɛ nye alie. 9 Ɔ nee Onɛsemɛse mɔɔ le yɛ diema kulovolɛ nɔhalɛ ne, mɔɔ le bɛdabɛ bɛ nuhua bie la a bara a. Bɛbaha debie biala mɔɔ ɛlɛkɔ zolɛ wɔ ɛke la bɛahile bɛ.
10 Alesetaakɛse mɔɔ nee me a la efiade ye la yɛɛ Maake mɔɔ le Baanabase adiema ne biza bɛ ahye. (Memaa bɛde ye dɛba kɛ saa bɛnwu Maake a bɛlie ye gyɛlɛɛnye.) 11Gyisɛse ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Gyɛsetɛse la biza bɛ ahye. Menli nsa ɛhye a le Dwuuma mɔɔ ɛlie ɛli na bɛ nee me yɛlɛdi Nyamenle Belemgbunlililɛ ne anwo gyima a, yɛɛ bɛboa me kpole kpalɛ.
12Ɛpafelase, mɔɔ le bɛdabɛ bɛ bie, na eza ɔle Kelaese Gyisɛse sonvolɛ la biza bɛ ahye. Dahuu ɔkakye bɛ wɔ ye nzɛlɛlɛ nu, kɛ Nyamenle ɛmaa bɛgyinla kpundii, bɛyɛ Kelaese ɛdoavolɛma mɔɔ ati ɛdi, na bɛyɛ tieyɛ bɛmaa Nyamenle ɛhulolɛdeɛ ne. 13Mekola medi daselɛ kɛ yeyɛ gyima kpole yemaa bɛ nee menli mɔɔ wɔ Lawɔdesia nee Hayɛleepɔlese la. 14Luku mɔɔ le yɛ ninsinli kulovolɛ ne, nee Dimase biza bɛ ahye.
15Yɛbiza mediema mɔɔ wɔ Lawɔdesia la ahye, eza yɛbiza Nemefa nee asɔnema ne mɔɔ yia nu wɔ ye sua nu ɛkɛ ne la ahye. 16Saa bɛkenga kɛlata ɛhye bɛwie a, bɛnlea bɛmaa bɛgenga ye wɔ Lawɔdesiama asɔne ne anu noko. Eza anrɛɛ bɛgenga kɛlata mɔɔ vi Lawɔdesia kɛra la. 17Na bɛha bɛhile Aakepɛse kɛ ɔnlea ɔmaa Awulae gyima ne mɔɔ yezɔ nu la ɛli munli.
18Medame Pɔɔlo, me sa anloa ɛne: Mebiza bɛ ahye. Bɛmmamaa bɛ rɛle fi kɛ mela kpanwu nu!
Nyamenle ɛlo bɛ na ɔ nee bɛ ɛdɛnla.

Title: 1 TƐS MUKENYE
Content:
Mukenye
Tɛsalonaeka a le Wulomu maanzinli ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Masidonea la suakpole a. Pɔɔlo vile Felepae la ɔhɔdele asɔne wɔ ɛkɛ. Yeangyɛ biala yɛɛ Dwuuma vale mgbonde radole asɔne ne anu a. Mgbonde ɛhye vi anyebolo mɔɔ dɔle Dwuuma ne anwo wɔ ngɔzo mɔɔ Pɔɔlo nolobɔlɛ ne mɔɔ fane Kelaese ɛdoalɛ nwo la ɛlɛnyia ye wɔ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma, na bɛ nye die Dwuuma nyamenlezonlenlɛ nwo la anwo. Ɔrale ye zɛhae la, ɔhyianle kɛ ɛnee Pɔɔlo fi Tɛsalonaeka na ɔkɔ Bɛlea. Nzinlii, mɔɔ Pɔɔlo dwule Kɔlente la, ɔ gɔnwo Temɔte mɔɔ nee ye a yɛ Nyamenle gyima ne la hanle mɔɔ ɛsisi asɔne ne anu wɔ Tɛsalonaeka la amuala hilele ye.
Ɛhye ati Pɔɔlo kɛlata ne mɔɔ ɔlumuale ɔhɛlɛle la, ɔvale ɔhɔzile Kelaese ɛdoavolɛma mɔɔ wɔ Tɛsalonaeka la ahonle. Ɔyɛle Nyamenle mo wɔ mɔɔ ɔdele, mɔɔ fane bɛ diedi nee bɛ ɛhulolɛ nwo la anwo; ɔhakyele bɛ adwenle wɔ ɛbɛla mɔɔ ɔbɔle wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɔ nee bɛ de la anwo, na akee ɔyeyele kpuyia mɔɔ gyegye bɛ adwenle wɔ asɔne ne anu la anloa. Kpuyia ne mɔ fane Kelaese ɛralɛ bieko anwo. Bie mɔ a le: Asoo diedinli mɔɔ wule kolaa na Gyisɛse azia ara la banyia ngoane mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ ne mɔɔ Kelaese ɛralɛ ne nee ye bara la? Kenlenzu yɛɛ Kelaese bazia ara a? Pɔɔlo vale mekɛ ɛhye zele bɛ kɛ, bɛhɔ zolɛ bɛyɛ gyima ne wɔ koonwuyɛlɛ nu wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛkendɛ Kelaese ɛralɛ ne anyelazo nu la.
Mɔɔ wɔ nu la
Ngilenu 1.1
Moyɛlɛ nee ayɛlɛyelɛ 1.2—3.13
Kelaese ɛdoavolɛma nyɛleɛ nwo folɛdulɛ 4.1-12
Kelaese ɛralɛ nwo ngilehilelɛ 4.13—5.11
Folɛdulɛ mɔɔ li amozi 5.12-22
Adwulaleɛ 5.23-28

Title: 1 TƐS 1
Content:
1 Kɛlata ɛhye vi Pɔɔlo, Saelase, yɛɛ Temɔte ɛkɛ. Yɛfa yɛahɔmaa Tɛsalonaeka asɔne ne anu amra mɔɔ le Nyamenle Selɛ ne nee Awulae Gyisɛse Kelaese ɛdeɛ la.
Nyamenle ɛlo bɛ na ɔmaa bɛ anzonudwolɛ.
Tɛsalonaekama ɛbɛlabɔlɛ nee diedi
2Dahuu yɛyɛ nzɛlɛlɛ a, yɛbɔ bɛ duma yɛyɛ Nyamenle mo wɔ bɛ muala bɛ ti. 3Ɔluakɛ saa yɛkɔ yɛ Nyamenle ne nee yɛ Ze ne anyunlu a, yɛkakye kɛ bɛzile bɛhilele bɛ diedi na bɛ ɛhulolɛ manle bɛyɛle gyima ɛsesebɛ, nee kɛ bɛ anyelazo mɔɔ wɔ yɛ Awulae Gyisɛse Kelaese anu la si gyi kpundii la. 4Mediema, yɛze kɛ Nyamenle lɛ bɛ nwo ɛhulolɛ na yekpa nu yeye bɛ yemaa ɔ nwo. 5Ɔluakɛ yɛanva yɛ nloa mgbane a yɛvale Edwɛkpa ne yɛrɛlɛle bɛ a, yɛvale tumi nee Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne nee ye nɔhalɛ ne anwo adwenle mɔɔ si pi la a yɛrale a. Bɛdabɛ bɛze kɛ yɛzile yɛbɔle yɛ ɛbɛla wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ yɛ nee bɛ de la; yɛyɛle ɛhye wɔ bɛdabɛ bɛ kpalɛ ti. 6 Bɛzukoale yɛ nee Awulae; yemɔti bɛnwunle amaneɛ dɔɔnwo, na bɛvale anyelielɛ ne mɔɔ vi Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne anu ba la bɛliele nrɛlaleɛ ne. 7Ɛhye ati bɛyɛle ndonwo kpalɛ bɛmanle diedima mɔɔ wɔ Masidonea nee Giliki (Akaya) maanzinli ne mɔ anu la. 8Ɔluakɛ tɛ Awulae anwo nrɛlaleɛ ne angome yɛɛ vi bɛ ɛkɛ ne dwule Masidonea nee Akaya a, na eza bɛ diedi mɔɔ wɔ Nyamenle anu la noko ɛdwu menli mɔɔ wɔ ɛleka muala la anzo nu. Ɛhye ati, ɔngyia kɛ yɛkɛha nwolɛ edwɛkɛ bɔbɔ. 9Menli zɔhane mɔ ka kɛ bɛzile bɛliele yɛ wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ yɛrale bɛ nwo lɔ la. Bɛka kɛ bɛzile bɛhwenle bɛ nwo bɛvile bɛ mmonle ngakyile ne mɔ anwo, bɛhɔle Nyamenle ɛkɛ na bɛzonlenle nɔhalɛ nee tease Nyamenle ne la. 10Bɛkile kɛ kɛkala bɛlɛkendɛ ɔ Ra Gyisɛse kɛ ɔvi anwuma ɔbara. Yemɔ yɛɛ Nyamenle dwazole ye vile ewule nu, na ɔdie yɛ ɔfi Nyamenle ɛya kpole ne mɔɔ bara la anu a.

Title: 1 TƐS 2
Content:
Pɔɔlo gyimayɛlɛ wɔ Tɛsalonaeka
1Mediema, bɛdabɛ bɛnwu kɛ yɛ ɛralɛ mɔɔ yɛrale bɛ nwo lɔ la anyɛ mgbane. 2 Bɛdabɛ bɛze amaneɛ mɔɔ yɛnwunle ye nee aholoba mɔɔ bɛbɔle yɛ wɔ Felepae kolaa na yɛara Tɛsalonaeka la. Noko yɛ Nyamenle ne manle yɛ akɛnrasesebɛ manle yɛhanle Edwɛkpa ne mɔɔ vi ye ɛkɛ ne la yɛhilele bɛ wɔ mekɛ bɔbɔ mɔɔ ɛnee menli dɔɔnwo tia yɛ la. 3Ɔluakɛ mɔɔ yɛvale yɛdole bɛ nyunlu la ɛngyi nvonleɛ bie anzɛɛ adwenle ɛtane biala azo, yɛɛ yɛando awie biala abɛla. 4Mɔɔ yɛyɛle la a le kɛ dahuu yɛtendɛ, kɛmɔ Nyamenle kpondɛ kɛ yɛtendɛ la, ɔboalekɛ yemaa yɛzɔ ɔ nye na yeva ye Edwɛkpa ne yewula yɛ sa nu. Ɛhye ati yɛmbɔ mɔdenle kɛ yɛsɔ menli nye. Nyamenle mɔɔ ze yɛ ahonle nu la yɛɛ yɛkulo kɛ yɛsɔ ɔ nye a. 5Bɛdabɛ bɛze ye wienyi kɛ yɛanva huhudi ɛdendɛlɛ kɛnlɛma yɛangeda anyebolo zo, Nyamenle di yɛ daselɛ wɔ ɛhye anwo. 6Yɛambɔ mɔdenle kɛ yɛkpondɛ menli nganvolɛ, saa ɔvi bɛ ɛkɛ ne anzɛɛ ɔvi awie mɔ lɔ o, 7noko kɛmɔ yɛle Kelaese ɛzoanvolɛma la, anrɛɛ yɛkola yɛka kɛ bɛyɛ ye zɔhane. Noko yɛbɛlɛle yɛ nwo aze, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee yɛ nee bɛ de la, na yɛdɛfɛdɛfɛle bɛ kɛ ɛrɛladane mɔɔ ɛlɛdi ɔ mra adane la. 8Ɔlua bɛ nwo ɛhulolɛ mɔɔ yɛlɛ la ati yɛanga Edwɛkpa ne mɔɔ vi Nyamenle ɛkɛ ne la angome ala yɛangile bɛ; yɛvale yɛ ɛbɛlabɔlɛ noko yɛbokale nwo. Bɛ nwo hyia yɛ somaa! 9Nɔhalɛ, mediema, bɛkakye kɛ yɛzile yɛyɛle gyima yɛvɛle la. Yɛyɛle gyima nɔɔzo nee ewiazo, amaa yɛanyɛ kpomgbolo yɛamkpolo bɛ kɔme wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ yɛka Edwɛkpa ne mɔɔ vi Nyamenle ɛkɛ ne la yɛahile bɛ la.
10Bɛ nee Nyamenle bɛdi yɛ daselɛ kɛ yɛ subane mɔɔ yɛhilele yɛhilele bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛliele bɛlile la le bɔkɔbɔkɔ, ɔle fɔɔnwo mɔɔ evinli biala ɛnle nwo a. 11Bɛdabɛ bɛnwunle kɛ yɛyɛle bɛ nuhua ko biala kɛ selɛ kɛyɛ ɔ ra la. 12Yɛzile yɛ ahonle, yɛkyekyele bɛ rɛle, na yɛhɔle zolɛ yɛmanle bɛ anwosesebɛ kɛ bɛbɔ ɛbɛla mɔɔ fɛta Nyamenle ne mɔɔ fɛlɛ bɛ kɛ bɛrɛla ye anyunlunyia Belemgbunlililɛ ne anu la.
13Debie bieko mɔɔ yemɔti dahuu yɛyɛ Nyamenle mo la a le kɛ, mɔɔ yɛvale Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ ne yɛrɛlɛle bɛ la, bɛdiele na bɛzɔle nu kɛ ɔnle edwɛkɛ mɔɔ vi sonla ɛkɛ a, na ɔvi Nyamenle ɛkɛ, yɛɛ ɔle zɔhane noko. Ɔluakɛ Nyamenle ɛlɛyɛ ye gyima wɔ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdie bɛdi la anu. 14 Ayi mɔ, mɔɔ zile asɔnema mɔɔ le Kelaese ɛdeɛ la anwo zo wɔ Dwudiya la, yemɔ ala a zile bɛdabɛ noko bɛ nwo zo a. Bɛnwunle amaneɛ wɔ bɛdabɛ bɛ menli asa anu, kɛmɔ Dwuuma yɛle ala la. 15 Dwuuma hunle Awulae Gyisɛse nee kpɔmanvolɛma ne mɔ, bɛyɛle yɛ kpɔdekpɔde bɛmanle yɛnriandile. Bɛha Nyamenle ɛya kpole! Bɛkyi awie biala. 16Bɛbɔle mɔdenle kɛ bɛtua yɛ mɔɔ yɛnga Edwɛkpa ne yɛngile bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la, amaa bɛtie a bɛanyia ngoane. Bɛyɛle ɛhye bɛmanle bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ akee yɛle kpole. Na kɛkala, Nyamenle ɛya ne wɔ bɛ nwo zo.
Pɔɔlo anwo dɔ Tɛsalonaekama
17Mediema, yɛmɛ, yɛvile bɛ nwo ɛkɛ ne mekɛ ekyi bie wɔ nwonane nu na tɛ sunsum nu ɔ, yemɔti yɛ nwo dɔ bɛ kpole, na yɛ kunlu a anrɛɛ yɛnwu bɛ nyunlu bieko. 18Kɛmɔ yɛkpondɛ kɛ yɛsia yɛba bɛ nwo lɔ bieko la ati, medame Pɔɔlo, menyɛle biala kɛ anrɛɛ menwɔzia menwɔra, noko Seetan ammaa yɛ adenle. 19Na ɛnee yɛ anyelazo, yɛ anyelielɛ anzɛɛ abɔtile mɔɔ yɛfa yɛtu yɛ nloa anu wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ yɛ Awulae kɛra la a le boni? Tɛ yemɔ a le bɛdabɛ ɔ? 20Nɔhalɛ, bɛmɛ a bɛle yɛ anyunlunyia nee yɛ anyelielɛ a.

Title: 1 TƐS 3
Content:
1 Nzinlii ɛnee akee yɛngola nu sɔ. Yemɔti yɛyɛle kɛ yɛmɛ yɛkɛha Atɛnse 2na yɛazoa adiema Temɔte mɔɔ nee yɛ yɛ Nyamenle gyima ye, yɛka Edwɛkpa ne mɔɔ fane Kelaese anwo la. Yɛzoanle ye kɛ ɔramaa bɛ anwosesebɛ na ɔboa bɛ wɔ bɛ diedi nu, 3amaa bɛ biala andoa nyane mɔɔ bɛlɛkile bɛ la ati yeamkpo aze. Bɛdabɛ bɛze ye wienyi kɛ ɔyɛ Nyamenle ɛhulolɛ kɛ bɛkɛhile yɛ abodelɛ ɛhye mɔ amuala. 4Ɔluakɛ mɔɔ yɛwɔ bɛ nwo lɔ la yɛhanle yɛhilele bɛ kɛ bɛbahile yɛ nyane, yɛɛ mɔɔ ɛzi la ɛmaa bɛnwu mɔɔ yɛhanle la nɔhalɛ. 5Ɛnee akee mengola ye me kunlu di bieko, ɛhye ati menzoanle Temɔte kɛ ɔranlea kɛ bɛ diedi ne si gyi la. Ɔnrɛyɛ nɔhalɛ kɛ Abɔnsam kɛhola kɛzɔ bɛ muala kɛnlea dedee kɛmaa yɛ gyima mɔɔ yɛyɛle la amuala kɛyɛ mgbane!
6 Kɛkala, Temɔte vi bɛ nwo lɔ ɛzia ɛra yɛ nwo ɛke, na yeva amaneɛ fɛlɛko mɔɔ fane bɛ diedi nee ɛhulolɛ nwo la yerabɔ yɛ. Yeha yehile yɛ kɛ dahuu bɛdwenle yɛ nwo adwenle kpalɛ, yɛɛ bɛ nwo dɔ yɛ, kɛmɔ yɛdayɛ yɛ nwo dɔ bɛ la. 7Yemɔti, mediema, wɔ yɛ anwongyelelɛ nee amaneɛnwunlɛ ne mɔ anu, bɛmɛ a bɛzi yɛ ahonle a. Bɛ diedi yɛɛ ɛmaa yɛ anwosesebɛ a, 8ɔboalekɛ saa bɛgyinla kpundii wɔ Awulae anu a, ɛnee yɛlɛ ngoane. 9Kɛkala yɛkola yɛyɛ Nyamenle mo wɔ bɛ ti. Yɛyɛ Nyamenle mo wɔ anyelielɛ mɔɔ bɛmɛ bɛ ti yɛlɛ ye wɔ ɔ nyunlu la. 10Alehyenlɛ nee aledwolɛ kɔsɔɔti yɛfa yɛ ahonle muala yɛsɛlɛ kɛ yɛkɛnwu bɛ nyunlu na mɔɔ bɛhyia nwo wɔ bɛ diedi nu la yɛayɛ yɛamaa bɛ.
11Yɛsɛlɛ yɛ Nyamenle Selɛ mumua ne nee yɛ Awulae Gyisɛse kɛ ɔbuke adenle ɔmaa yɛnyia mekɛ yɛrɛla bɛ nwo lɔ. 12Awulae ɛmaa bɛnyia bɛ nwo ɛhulolɛ ngoko na ɔmaa bɛ ɛhulolɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛ ye wɔ menli nwo la ɛnyi ɛyɛ kpole kpalɛ kɛ ɛhulolɛ mɔɔ yɛlɛ ye wɔ bɛ nwo la. 13Zɛhae adenle zo yɛɛ ɔbamaa bɛ nwo ayɛ se, na bɛali munli, bɛ nwo ade wɔ yɛ Nyamenle Selɛ ne anyunlu, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ yɛ Awulae Gyisɛse nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛle ye ɛdeɛ la kɛra la a. ɛra la a.

Title: 1 TƐS 4
Content:
Ɛbɛlabɔlɛ mɔɔ sɔ Nyamenle anye la
1Awieleɛ ne, mediema, kɛmɔ bɛzukoale kɛ bɛkɛzi bɛkɛbɔ ɛbɛla kpalɛ mɔɔ sɔ Nyamenle anye la bɛvile yɛ ɛkɛ ne la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ bɛyɛ a. Na kɛkala yɛlua Awulae Gyisɛse duma nu yɛsɛlɛ bɛ kɛ bɛyɛ ye molozo. 2Ɔluakɛ bɛdabɛ bɛze ngilehilelɛ mɔɔ ɔlua Awulae Gyisɛse tumi zo yɛvale yɛmanle bɛ la. 3Nyamenle ɛhulolɛdeɛ a le kɛ bɛ nwo kɛde na bɛkɛhwe bɛ nwo bɛkɛvi adwɔmane ɛbɔlɛ nwo. 4Bɛdabɛ mrenya mɔɔ bɛwɔ nu la ɔwɔ kɛ nwu raalɛ gya wɔ anwondelɛ nee enililɛ nu, 5tɛ wɔ atiakunluwɔzo ɛtane nu, kɛmɔ menli mɔɔ ɛnze Nyamenle la yɛ ye la. 6Wɔ ɛhye ɛyɛlɛ nu, ɔnle kɛ awie biala yɛ ɔ diema bie ɛtane anzɛɛ sisi ye. Yɛha ɛhye yɛhile bɛ ɛlɛ, yɛɛ yɛbɔ bɛ nwolɛ kɔkɔ, kɛ Nyamenle badea bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛyɛ zɔhane ɛtane ne la. 7Nyamenle anvɛlɛ yɛ kɛ yɛrabɔ ɛbɛla mgbane mgbane, ɔvɛlɛle yɛ kɛ yɛrayɛ menli mɔɔ anwo te a. 8Zɔhane ati, mɔɔ kɛkpo ngilehilelɛ ɛhye la ɛmkpo sonla, na yekpo Nyamenle ne mɔɔ ɛva ye Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne ɛmaa bɛ la.
9Ɔngyia kɛ awie kɛhɛlɛ bɛ kɛ anrɛɛ bɛhulo bɛ gɔnwo mɔ diedima, ɔluakɛ Nyamenle ɔdaye yehilehile bɛ kɛ bɛzi bɛhulo bɛ nwo ngoko la. 10Nɔhalɛ, zɛhae subane ne ala a bɛhile bɛmaa mediema mɔɔ wɔ Masidonea maanzinli nu la amuala a. Yemɔti yɛsɛlɛ bɛ, mediema, bɛyɛ ye zɔhane kpalɛ dahuu. 11Bɛva bɛzie bɛ nyunlu kɛ bɛkɛbɔ ɛbɛla mɔɔ le bɛtɛɛ a, bɛdwenle bɛ nwo na bɛbɔ ɛbɛla mɔɔ kɛmaa bɛkɛhola bɛ nwo nea a, kɛmɔ yɛhanle yɛhilele bɛ la. 12Saa bɛyɛ ye zɔhane na bɛanva bɛ rɛle bɛanzɔ awie a, bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ amozi na bɛnle diedima la kɛbu bɛ bie.
Awulae ɛralɛ ne
13Mediema, yɛkulo kɛ bɛnwu nɔhalɛ ne mɔɔ fane bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwu la anwo la, amaa bɛdabɛ noko bɛanli nyane kɛ menli mɔɔ ɛnlɛ anyelazo la. 14Yɛdie yɛdi kɛ Gyisɛse wule na eza ɔdwazole ɔrale ngoane nu, zɔhane ala yɛɛ Nyamenle balua Gyisɛse anwo zo ava bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdie ye bɛdi na bɛwu la azia ara ngoane nu a.
15 Wɔ ɛhye anwo, yɛka mɔɔ Awulae ɔdaye ye ngilehilelɛ ne se la: yɛdayɛ mɔɔ saa ɔdwu Awulae ɛralɛ ne a ɛnee yɛtɛte ngoane nu la ɛnrɛlumua bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwu la anyunlu. 16Yɛbade kɛ bɛha tumi edwɛkɛ ne wɔ anwuma lɔ, yɛbade Nyamenle soanvolɛ kpanyinli ne ane, bɛbabɔ Nyamenle aweɛne tendenle ne anu, na Awulae ɔdaye mumua ne ɔvi anwuma lɔ ɔbadwu aze. Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdie Kelaese bɛdi na bɛwu la balumua adwazo avi ewule nu; 17na akee yɛdayɛ mɔɔ mekɛ ne anu yɛtɛte aze anzɛɛ yɛtɛwule la bɛakpogya yɛ zo anwuma na yɛ nee bɛ yɛ muala yɛahuohua yɛ nloa wɔ amungu ne anu, na yɛahɔyia Awulae wɔ anwomanyunlu. Na akee yɛ nee Awulae adɛnla dahuu. 18Yemɔti, bɛva ɛhye mɔ bɛkyekye bɛ rɛle ng bɛkyekye bɛ rɛle ng

Title: 1 TƐS 5
Content:
Bɛziezie bɛ nwo bɛhendɛ Awulae ɛralɛ ne
1Mediema, ɔngyia kɛ yɛkɛhɛlɛ bɛ wɔ mekɛ nee ɛlobɔ holɛ ko mɔɔ ɛhye mɔ bazi la anwo. 2 Ɔluakɛ bɛdabɛ bɛze kɛ Awulae Kenle ne bara kɛ awule ba bawua nɔɔzo la. 3Mekɛ mɔɔ menli kɛdwenle kɛ akee “Debie biala ɛla boɛ” la, mekɛ ne anu ala yɛɛ munzule ne bazi a. Biala ɛnrɛvi ɛsalɛ, ɔbayɛ arɛlevilɛ nu kɛ raalɛ mɔɔ ako ɛha ye la. 4Noko ayi mɔ, bɛmɛ bɛnde awozinli nu na Kenle ne ali bɛ nvunu kɛ awule la. 5Bɛ muala bɛle wienyi nu menli, mɔɔ kile kɛ bɛle alehyenlɛ nu menli. 6Yemɔti, bɛmmamaa yɛdafe kɛ ebia mɔ la; ɔwɔ kɛ yɛmaa yɛ nye gyinla zolɛ na yɛyɛ yɛ nye gyɛlɛmgbɛɛnye. 7Ɔluakɛ menli mɔɔ dafe la da nɔɔzo, yɛɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛno nza bɛbo la tinda nɔɔzo. 8 Na yɛmɛ, yɛle alehyenlɛ nu amra, yemɔti bɛmaa yɛzie yɛ nye gyɛlɛmgbɛɛnye na yɛva diedi nee ɛhulolɛ yɛyɛ bulalɛ enyinlike yɛbutu yɛ kɛnra azo, na yɛva yɛ ngoane ɛnyianlɛ nwo anyelazo yɛhakyi bulalɛ kyɛlɛ yɛzoa. 9Nyamenle angyehyɛ kɛ yɛranwu amaneɛ wɔ ye ɛya ne anu. Yevɛlɛ yɛ kɛ yɛralua yɛ Awulae Gyisɛse Kelaese anwo zo yɛnyia ngoane. 10Gyisɛse wule manle yɛ amaa ɔba a, saa yɛwu o, yɛde ngoane nu o, yɛ nee ye adɛnla. 11Zɔhane ati bɛboa bɛ nwo ngoko, kɛmɔ kɛkala bɛlɛyɛ ye la na bɛmaa bɛ nwo anwosesebɛ.
Folɛdulɛ mɔɔ li amozi nee ahyebizalɛ
12Mediema, yɛsɛlɛ bɛ kɛ bɛli menli mɔɔ bɛ nee bɛ sonle na bɛyɛ bɛ mgbanyinli mɔɔ tu bɛ folɛ, na bɛkilehile bɛ Awulae adenle ne la eni. 13Bɛli bɛ eni kpole kpalɛ na bɛhulo bɛ wɔ bɛ gyima ne mɔɔ bɛyɛ la ati. Bɛmaa bɛ muala bɛ nloa ɛzɛ bɛ nwo.
14Yɛkakye bɛ, bɛbɔ mɔɔ le mgbovonle la kɔkɔ, bɛzi mɔɔ le foanvoanle la ahonle, bɛboa mɔɔ ɛnlɛ anwosesebɛ la, na bɛnyia biala anwo abotane. 15Bɛnlea kɛ awie ɛnrɛva ɛtane ɛnrɛdua ɛtane kakɛ. Dahuu bɛyɛ bɛ adwenle kɛ bɛkɛyɛ kpalɛ bɛkɛmaa bɛ nwo ngoko nee awie mɔ gyɛne.
16Dahuu bɛmaa bɛ nye ɛlie, 17bɛyɛ nzɛlɛlɛ dahuu, 18na bɛyɛ Nyamenle mo wɔ gyinlabelɛ biala anu. Mɔɔ Nyamenle kpondɛ kɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ nee Kelaese Gyisɛse lua la yɛ la ɛne.
19Bɛmmanua Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne, 20bɛmmakpo Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ kpalɛ biala. 21Bɛzɔ ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti bɛnlea, bɛva mɔɔ le kpalɛ la bɛzie, 22na bɛhyi ɛtane ngakyile biala.
23Nyamenle ne mɔɔ maa anzonudwolɛ la ɛde bɛ nwo wɔ adenle biala anu, na ɔva bɛ sonla mumua ne ɔzie: bɛ ɛkɛla, bɛ sunsum, yɛɛ bɛ sonlabaka ne amuala, ɔye bɛ ɔvi nvonleɛ biala anu, ɔde bɛ nwo wɔ Kenle ne mɔɔ Awulae Gyisɛse Kelaese bara la. 24Bɛkola bɛfa bɛ rɛle bɛwula Nyamenle ne mɔɔ fɛlɛ bɛ la anu, ɔluakɛ ɔkola ɔyɛ.
25Mediema, anrɛɛ bɛzɛlɛ bɛmaa yɛ.
26Bɛva atuu ɛyɛlɛ kpalɛ bɛbizebiza mediema ne mɔ ahye.
27Mese bɛ wɔ Awulae duma nu kɛ bɛgenga kɛlata ɛhye bɛhile mediema ne mɔ amuala.
28Yɛ Awulae Gyisɛse Kelaese ɛlo bɛ na ɔ nee bɛ ɛdɛnla.

Title: 2 TƐS MUKENYE
Content:
Mukenye
Kelaese ɛralɛ mɔɔ ɔbazia yeara bieko la anwo adwenle vale mgbonde nee ngyegyelɛ dɔɔnwo radole Tɛsalonaeka asɔne ne anu. Pɔɔlo kɛlata ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nwiɔ mɔɔ ɔhɛlɛle ɔhɔmanle Tɛsalonaeka asɔnema la ka diedi ne mɔɔ bie mɔ lɛ ye kɛ Awulae ɛralɛ mekɛ ne ɛdwu ɛpɛ nu dɛbadɛba la anwo edwɛkɛ. Pɔɔlo denrɛle bɛ adwenle wɔ ɛhye anwo na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, saa ɔdwu Kelaese ɛralɛ ne a, ɛtane nee amumuyɛ balie ebia ahɔdwu kɛ anyelazo muala kɛwie, na awie anwo ɛzulolɛ bie mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye “Amumuyɛnli,” na ɔtia Kelaese la avinde ayɛ ɔ nwo kɛ ɔle katakyie.
Ɛzoanvolɛ ne zile zo hanle ɛhyianlɛ mɔɔ ɔhyia kɛ ye kengavolɛma kɛgyinla kpundii wɔ bɛ diedi nu wɔ abodelɛ nee nyane nu, bɛkɛyɛ gyima mɔɔ kɛmaa bɛ sa kɛhɔ bɛ nloa, kɛmɔ Pɔɔlo nee ɔ gɔnwo mɔ mɔɔ ɔ nee bɛ yɛ Nyamenle gyima ne la yɛle la na eza bɛkɛhɔ zo bɛkɛyɛ kpalɛ.
Mɔɔ wɔ nu la
Ngilenu 1.1-2
Ayɛlɛyelɛ nee nganvolɛ 1.3-12
Kelaese ɛralɛ ne anwo ngilehilelɛ 2.1-17
Kelaese ɛdoavolɛma nyɛleɛ nee folɛdulɛ 3.1-15
Adwulaleɛ 3.16-18

Title: 2 TƐS 1
Content:
1 Kɛlata ɛhye vi Pɔɔlo, Saelase, yɛɛ Temɔte ɛkɛ. Yɛfa yɛahɔmaa Tɛsalonaeka asɔnema mɔɔ le yɛ Ze Nyamenle ne nee Awulae Gyisɛse Kelaese ɛdeɛ la.
2Yɛ Ze Nyamenle ne nee Awulae Gyisɛse Kelaese ɛlo bɛ na ɔmaa bɛ anzonudwolɛ.
Kelaese ɛralɛ nee ndɛnebualɛ ne
3Mediema, ɔwɔ kɛ yɛyɛ Nyamenle mo dahuu wɔ bɛ ti. Ɔle kpalɛ ɔmaa yɛ kɛ yɛkɛyɛ ye zɔhane, ɔboalekɛ bɛ diedi ɛlɛnyi, yɛɛ bɛ ɛhulolɛ mɔɔ bɛ nuhua ko biala lɛ ye wɔ ɔ gɔnwo mɔ diedima anwo la ɛlɛyɛ kpole. 4Zɔhane ati yɛfa bɛ yɛpɛ Nyamenle menli mɔɔ ɛha la anye zo. Yɛfa bɛ diedi nu kpundii mɔɔ bɛgyi wɔ nyanenwunlɛ nee abodelɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛnwu ye la anu la yɛtu yɛ nloa anu kpole.
5Ɛhye mɔ amuala kile kɛ Nyamenle ndɛnebualɛ ne le fɔɔnwo, amaa bɛafɛta Nyamenle Belemgbunlililɛ ne, mɔɔ yemɔti bɛlɛnwu amaneɛ la. 6Ɛhye ati Nyamenle badua menli mɔɔ ɛlɛmaa bɛanwu nyane la amuala kakɛ, 7yeaye nyane mɔɔ bɛlɛnwu ye la bɛ kɔme zo, na nwolɛ nyilalɛ ne bie aha yɛdayɛ noko. Ɔbayɛ ɛhye wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ Awulae Gyisɛse vi anwuma, ɔ nee ye soanvolɛma mɔɔ lɛ tumi la lua sendɔlɔra nu kɛra 8kɛ ɔbadua bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnze Nyamenle, nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnli Edwɛkpa ne mɔɔ fane yɛ Awulae Gyisɛse anwo la azo la kakɛ la. 9 Bɛbadea menli zɔhane mɔ na bɛaye bɛ bɛavi Awulae anye zo nee ye anyunlunyia tumi ne abo, na bɛazɛkye bɛ ɛzɛkyelɛ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ la. 10Ɛhye bazi mekɛ mɔɔ Kenle ne kɛdwu na Kelaese kɛra kɛ ɔbalie ye anyunlunyia nee enililɛ yeavi ye menli ne nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdie ye bɛdi la ɛkɛ ne la. Bɛdabɛ noko bɛbaboka Nyamenle menli ne anwo, ɔboalekɛ bɛlie ye edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ yɛhanle yɛhilele bɛ la bɛli.
11Ɛhye ati dahuu yɛsɛlɛ yɛmaa bɛ, yɛbiza yɛ Nyamenle ne kɛ ɔmaa bɛ nwo ɛfɛta ye ɛvɛlɛlɛ ne. Yɛsɛlɛ kɛ ɔlua ye tumi ne azo ɔmaa bɛhola bɛyɛ kpalɛ biala mɔɔ bɛkpondɛ kɛ bɛyɛ la na ɔmaa bɛ diedi nu gyima muala ɛli munli, 12amaa ɔlua zo bɛali yɛ Awulae Gyisɛse duma ne eni, na bɛdabɛ noko ɔlua yɛ Nyamenle ne nee Awulae Gyisɛse Kelaese ɛlolɛ zo bɛali bɛ eni.

Title: 2 TƐS 2
Content:
Amumuyɛnli ne
1 Mediema, mɔɔ fane yɛ Awulae Gyisɛse Kelaese ɛralɛ ne nee yɛ nloa mɔɔ bɛbahuohua na yɛ nee ye ahɔyia la anwo, mesɛlɛ bɛ, 2bɛmmamaa bɛ adwenle yɛ bɛ kpomgbondee anzɛɛ bɛmmadi nyane wɔ nwolɛ na bɛdwenle kɛ asɛɛ Awulae Kenle zɔhane ɛraze dɛbadɛba. Ɔkɛyɛ kɛ bekezɛ ɔvindele Sunsum nu edwɛkɛ bie anu anzɛɛ Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne nolobɔlɛ nu, anzɛɛ yɛhɛlɛ ye wɔ yɛ ngɛlata mɔɔ yɛva yɛrɛlɛ bɛ la bie anu. 3Bɛmmamaa awie biala bɛlɛbɛla bɛ wɔ adenle biala anu. Ɔluakɛ Kenle ne ɛnrɛra kyesɛ “Atuadelɛ” ɛra zolɛ kpalɛ na mɛladonlɛ ɛhakyi ɔ nwo “Amumuyɛnli” ne mɔɔ bɛbabua ye ewule fɔlɛ la ɛra. 4 Saa ɔba a ɔbatia debie biala nee nyamenle biala mɔɔ menli sonle la. Ɔbavo yeagyinlegyinla bɛ bati, yeahɔdɛnla aze wɔ Nyamenle Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu na yeavɛlɛ ɔ nwo kɛ ɔdaye a ɔle Nyamenle a.
5Bɛngakye ɔ? Mɔɔ mewɔ bɛ nwo lɔ la menganle ɛhye mengilele bɛ. 6Debie ti yɛɛ kɛkala ɛhye ɛtɛsile a, yɛɛ bɛze deɛ holɛ ko ne noko. Saa mekɛ kpalɛ ne dwu a, Amumuyɛnli ne bara.
7Kɛkala, menli somaa ɛlɛyɛ ninyɛndane atia mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛhyehyɛ la, noko mɔɔ bazi la ɛnrɛzi kɔkpula mekɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛye ahenle ne mɔɔ si ye aze la ɛkɛ ne la, 8 kolaa na akee Amumuyɛnli ne ara. Na saa Awulae Gyisɛse ba a, ɔbava ɔ nloa anu anwoma mgbane yeahu ye na yeava ɔ nyunlu ɛdalɛ wienyi kpole ne yeazɛkye ye bɔkɔɔ. 9 Amumuyɛnli ne bava Seetan tumi a ara a, na yearayɛ adalɛ nwanwane ninyɛne mgbole, yeaye ngonyia, 10na yeava adalɛ nee amumuyɛ adenle zo yeahwe bɛdabɛ mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛminli la. Menli ɛhye mɔ baminli, ɔluakɛ bɛangulo nɔhalɛ ne mɔɔ kɛlie bɛ ngoane la. 11Ɔlua ɛhye ati, Nyamenle bazoa nvonleɛ tumi ne yeamaa yearayɛ gyima wɔ bɛ nu, amaa bɛalie mɔɔ le adalɛ la bɛali. 12Ye awieleɛ a le kɛ, bɛbazɛkye bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛanlie nɔhalɛ ne bɛanli na bɛ nye die ɛtane nwo la amuala.
Bɛkpa nu bɛye bɛ kɛ bɛnyia ngoane
13Nyamenle kulo bɛ, yemɔti mediema, ɔwɔ kɛ dahuu yɛyɛ Nyamenle mo wɔ bɛ ti. Ɔluakɛ mɔlebɛbo ne ala yɛɛ Nyamenle kpale nu yele bɛ kɛ bɛlie bɛ ngoane a, wɔ bɛ diedi mɔɔ wɔ nɔhalɛ ne anu nee Sunsum ne tumi ne mɔɔ ɛyɛ bɛ Nyamenle menli mɔɔ anwo te la ati. 14Nyamenle luale Edwɛkpa ne mɔɔ yɛhanle yɛhilele bɛ la azo a vɛlɛle bɛ a, amaa bɛanyia Awulae Gyisɛse Kelaese anyunlunyia ne bie. 15Yemɔti mediema, bɛgyinla kpundii na bɛzɔ nɔhalɛ ne mɔɔ yɛha nwolɛ edwɛkɛ wɔ yɛ nolobɔlɛ nu nee ngɛlata zo yɛhile bɛ la anu ɛsesebɛ.
16Yɛ Awulae Gyisɛse Kelaese mumua ne nee yɛ Ze Nyamenle ne, mɔɔ hulole yɛ na ye ɛlolɛ ti yemaa yɛ anwosesebɛ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ nee anyelazo kpalɛ la, 17ɛmaa bɛ akɛnrasesebɛ na ɔmaa bɛyɛ se, bɛyɛ nla, bɛha na bɛyɛ mɔɔ le kpalɛ la amuala. la amuala.

Title: 2 TƐS 3
Content:
Bɛzɛlɛ bɛmaa yɛ
1Mediema, edwɛkɛ mɔɔ li amozi la a le kɛ, bɛzɛlɛ bɛmaa yɛ kɛ Awulae edwɛkɛ ne kɛdɛlɛ ndɛndɛ na ɔkɛli konim, kɛmɔ ɔyɛle ye wɔ bɛ nu la. 2Bɛzɛlɛ kɛ Nyamenle kɛlie yɛ kɛvi menli munzule atisesebɛma asa anu; ɔluakɛ tɛ menli ne amuala a die edwɛkɛ ne di a.
3Bɛkola bɛfa bɛ rɛle bɛwula Awulae anu. Ɔbamaa bɛ nwo ayɛ se na yealie bɛ gyɛlɛɛnye yeavi Ɛtanenli ne asa anu. 4Awulae ɛmaa yɛ adwenle ɛzi pi wɔ bɛ nwo, yemɔti yɛze kɛ bɛlɛyɛ mɔɔ yɛhanle yɛhilele bɛ la, na eza bɛbahɔ zolɛ bɛayɛ ye zɔhane dahuu.
5Yɛsɛlɛ kɛ Awulae ɛha bɛ ahonle ɛmaa bɛnyia Nyamenle ɛhulolɛ ne anwo ndelebɛbo kpalɛ na bɛgyinla kpundii wɔ Kelaese anwo ngilehilelɛ ne anu.
Gyimayɛlɛ nwo ɛzonlelilɛ
6Mediema, yɛlua Awulae Gyisɛse Kelaese duma nu, yɛka yɛahile bɛ kɛ bɛhwe bɛ nwo bɛvi mediema mɔɔ ɛlɛyɛ mgbovonle na bɛngulo kɛ bɛdi folɛ mɔɔ yɛdule bɛ la azo la anwo. 7Bɛdabɛ bɛze kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛyɛ kɛ mɔɔ yɛyɛle la. Yɛanyɛ mgbovonle wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ yɛ nee bɛ de la. 8Yɛanli awie biala debie mɔɔ yɛandua a. Yɛyɛle gyima, yɛhwinle yɛ ti anwo alehyenlɛ nee aledwolɛ, amaa yɛanyɛ kpomgbolo yɛamkpolo awie biala akɔme. 9Tɛ kɛ asɛɛ yɛnlɛ adenle kɛ yɛbiza awie debie ɔ, na yɛyɛle ye zɔhane amaa bɛdabɛ noko bɛanlea zolɛ bɛayɛ bie. 10Mɔɔ yɛwɔ bɛ nwo lɔ la, ɛnee yɛta yɛka yɛkile bɛ kɛ, “Mɔɔ ɛngulo kɛ ɔyɛ gyima la, ɔnle kɛ ɔdi aleɛ.”
11Yɛka ɛhye ɔboalekɛ yɛde kɛ bɛ bie mɔ ɛlɛbɔ mgbovonle ɛbɛla, mɔɔ bɛnyɛ ɛhwee kɛ awie mɔ edwɛkɛ nu yɛɛ bɛyɛ ye nwotonlonwotonlo a. 12Yɛka yɛahile menli mɔɔ le zɛhae la kɛ yɛlua Awulae Gyisɛse Kelaese duma nu, yɛbɔ bɛ kɔkɔ anzɛɛ yɛkakye bɛ kɛ, bɛbɔ ɛbɛla mɔɔ maa anzonudwolɛ la na bɛyɛ gyima mɔɔ kɛmaa bɛ sa kɛhɔ bɛ nloa dahuu la.
13Mediema, bɛmmagyakyi kpalɛyɛlɛ. 14Saa awie wɔ ɛkɛ ne mɔɔ ɔnrɛli mɔɔ yɛhɛlɛ ye wɔ kɛlata ɛhye anu la azo a, bɛmɛ bɛyɛ ahenle zɔhane nzonlɛ, bɛmmayɛ ye ɛhwee, na ɔdaye ɔ ngome ɔ nyunlu bagua aze. 15Bɛmmayɛ ye kɛ ɔle kpɔvolɛ; bɛbɔ ye kɔkɔ kɛ adiema.
Folɛdulɛ mɔɔ li amozi
16Yɛsɛlɛ kɛ Awulae mumua ne, mɔɔ le anzonudwolɛ maavolɛ la ɛmaa bɛ nzo nu ɛdwo bɛ mekɛ biala nee adenle biala anu. Awulae nee bɛ ɛdɛnla.
17Medame Pɔɔlo, me sa anloa ɛ. Mebiza bɛ ahye. Kɛ medwula me kɛlata biala mɔɔ menwɔhɛlɛ la ɛne; kɛ mekɛlɛ ye ala la ɛne.
18Yɛ Awulae Gyisɛse Kelaese ɛlo bɛ na ɔ nee bɛ ɛdɛnla.

Title: 1 TEM MUKENYE
Content:
Mukenye
Temɔte le kpavolɛ egyegyebaa mɔɔ doa Kelaese abo zo a. Ɔvi Ehyea Maena (Ehyea Ekyi). Ɔ nli le Dwuunli yɛɛ ɔ ze le Gilikinli. Ɔrayɛle Pɔɔlo agɔnwo mɔɔ boale ye wɔ ye asɔne gyimayɛlɛ ne anu a. Pɔɔlo kɛlata ne mɔɔ ɔlumuale ɔhɛlɛle ɔhɔmanle Temɔte la ka ninyɛne titile nsa anwo edwɛkɛ.
Mɔɔ lumua la a le kɛ kɛlata ne le kɔkɔbɔlɛ mɔɔ fane ngilehilelɛ adalɛ mɔɔ wɔ asɔne ne anu la anwo. Ngilehilelɛ ɛhye le Dwuuma amaamuo ne nee amaamuo bie mɔɔ ɛnle Dwuuma ɛdeɛ la afonla. Ɔgyi diedi bie mɔɔ kile kɛ ewiade ɛhye le munzule ewiade la azo, na ɔkile kɛ kyesɛ sonla di fealera nu ngilehilelɛ bie mɔ azo, ɔkyi aleɛ bie mɔ na ɔkpo agyalɛ kolaa na yeanyia ngoane. Kɛlata ne eza kilehile asɔne ne anu ngyehyɛlɛ nee ɛzonlenlɛ nu na ɔkile subane mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ asɔne mgbanyima mɔɔ le kɛ adenlekilevolɛma, nee boavolɛma nyia ye la. Awieleɛ ne, kɛlata ne tu Temɔte folɛ kile ye kɛ ɔkɛzi ɔkɛyɛ na yeayɛ Gyisɛse Kelaese sonvolɛ kpalɛ, nee ye ɛzonle mɔɔ ɔdi wɔ diedima ekpunli ne mɔ anwo la.
Mɔɔ wɔ nu la
Ngilenu 1.1-2
Asɔne ne nee ye mgbanyima nwo ngyehyɛlɛ 1.3—3.16
Temɔte gyimayɛlɛ nwo folɛdulɛ 4.1—6.21

Title: 1 TEM 1
Content:
1Medame Pɔɔlo, mɔɔ Nyamenle yɛ Ngoanedievolɛ ne nee Kelaese Gyisɛse yɛ anyelazo ne manle bɛyɛle me Kelaese ɛzoanvolɛ la a melɛkɛlɛ kɛlata ɛhye a.
2 Mefa meahɔmaa Temɔte, mɔɔ le me ra kpalɛ wɔ diedi ne anu la. Nyamenle Selɛ ne nee Kelaese Gyisɛse yɛ Awulae ne ɛlo wɔ, ɛnwu wɔ anwunvɔne na ɔmaa wɔ anzonudwolɛ.
Ngilehilelɛ adalɛ nwo kɔkɔbɔlɛ
3Mekpondɛ kɛ ɛtɛnla Ɛfɛsɛse, kɛmɔ mesia meahɔ Masidonea mɔɔ menganle mengilele wɔ la. Menli bie wɔ ɛkɛ ne ɛlɛkilehile ngilehilelɛ mɔɔ ɛnle nɔhalɛ a, na tua bɛ. 4Ka kile bɛ maa bɛgyakyi bɛ nla mɔ anwo nwɔra ɛdolɛ ne nee mbusua nu ɛhilehilelɛ somasoma ne. Ɛhye mɔ wie kpolerazulɛ ala, na ɔnvane Nyamenle ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔɔ bɛdua diedi zo bɛnwu ye la anwo. 5Bodane mɔɔ yɛ ngilehilelɛ ɛdeɛ ne gyi zolɛ la a le ɛhulolɛ mɔɔ vi ahonle mɔɔ ɛtane ɛnle nu, adwenle mɔɔ nuhua te wienyi, nee diedi mɔɔ di munli la. 6Menli bie ɛhwe bɛ nwo ɛvi ngilehilelɛ ɛhye mɔ anwo na bɛhɔdoa ngoasea edwɛkɛ ngehanleɛ bo zo bɛminli. 7Bɛkpondɛ kɛ bɛkilehile Nyamenle mɛla ne anu, noko bɛdabɛ mumua ne bɛ edwɛkɛ mɔɔ bɛka la bɛnde ɔ bo na bɛade ninyɛne mɔɔ bɛka nwolɛ mgbole la abo.
8Yɛze kɛ Mɛla ne le kpalɛ, saa menli di zolɛ, kɛmɔ ɔfɛta la a. 9Ɔwɔ kɛ yɛnwu kɛ tɛ menli mɔɔ di boɛ la ati a mɛla ne wɔ ɛkɛ a, mɛla ne wɔ ɛkɛ maa atuadelɛma, anzosesebɛma, bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnze Nyamenle nee ɛtanevolɛma, bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ nwo ɛnde, menli mɔɔ ku bɛ ze mɔ anzɛɛ bɛ nli mɔ, ahɔdiawu, 10menli mɔɔ bɔ ɛbɛla funli, mrenya mɔɔ fa mrenya anzɛɛ mraalɛ mɔɔ fa mraalɛ, bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwua menli, adalɛma, bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdi dasewia anzɛɛ menli mɔɔ ɛnli nɔhalɛ ngilehilelɛ ne azo la. 11Ngilehilelɛ ɛhye mɔ wɔ Edwɛkpa ne mɔɔ anyunlunyia nee saleɛ Nyamenle ne ɛva ɛwula me sa nu kɛ membɔ ye nolo la anu.
Nyamenle anwunvɔnezelɛ ne anwo moyɛlɛ
12Meyɛ yɛ Awulae Kelaese Gyisɛse mɔɔ ɛmaa me anwosesebɛ wɔ me gyima ne anwo la mo. Meyɛ ye mo kɛ yebu me bie na yeva me wɔ ye gyima nu a. 13 Mekɛ bie mɔɔ ɛraze ɛhɔ la menganle munzule edwɛkɛ mentiale ye, menyɛle ye kpɔdekpɔde na menguale ɔ nyunlu aze. Na Nyamenle nwunle me anwunvɔne, ɔluakɛ ɛnee menlɛ diedi, yemɔti ɛnee menze mɔɔ melɛyɛ la. 14Awulae noko lole me totohyia, na ɔmanle me diedi nee ɛhulolɛ mɔɔ le yɛ ɛdeɛ la wɔ Kelaese Gyisɛse ati. 15Ɛhye le nɔhalɛ edwɛkɛ bɔkɔɔ mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛdie bɛto nu na bɛdie bɛdi a; Kelaese Gyisɛse rale ewiade ye anu kɛ ɔbalie ɛtanevolɛma, mɔɔ medame a mele bɛ nuhua kpanyinli la ngoane. 16Ɔlua ɛhye ati yɛɛ Nyamenle nwunle me anwunvɔne a, amaa Kelaese Gyisɛse abotane kpole ne mɔɔ ɔnyianle ye wɔ medame, ɛtanevolɛma kpanyinli me nwo la, ala ali na yeayɛ ndonwo yeamaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ nzinlii bɛbalie ye bɛali na bɛanyia ngoane mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ la. 17Na tete Belemgbunli ne, Damɛnlangoate Nyamenle kokye ne, mɔɔ ɛnyelɛ ɛnnwu ye la, yemɔ yɛɛ enililɛ nee anyunlunyia ɛha ye dahuu a. Amen
18Me ra Temɔte, melɛ mɛla ɛhye, kɛmɔ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ bɛhanle ye wɔ ɛ nwo dɛbadɛba la se la, mewula ɛ sa nu. Maa edwɛkɛ ne ɛyɛ wɔ konle ninyɛne na fa ko konle kpalɛ ne, 19na nyia diedi nee adwenle kpalɛ mɔɔ anu te la. Menli ne bie mɔ ɛminli bɛ diedi, ɔluakɛ bɛnlɛ adwenle kpalɛ mɔɔ anu te a. 20Menli zɛhae bie mɔ a le Haemɛneeyɛse nee Alɛzanda, mɔɔ meva bɛ mewula Seetan tumi ne abo la, amaa bɛahile bɛ kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛgyakyi Nyamenle anwo edwɛkɛ ɛtane ɛhanlɛ.

Title: 1 TEM 2
Content:
Asɔne nu ɛzonlenlɛ
1Zɔhane ati, edwɛkɛ mɔɔ lumua la a le kɛ, anrɛɛ bodo, sɛlɛ maa ɛ nwo nee awie mɔ na yɛ Nyamenle mo wɔ menli kɔsɔɔti ati. 2Yɛ nzɛlɛlɛ ne bie maa arelemgbunli nee menli mɔɔ tumi wɔ bɛ sa nu la amuala, amaa yɛ nwo adɔ yɛ na yɛanyia anzonudwolɛ yɛabɔ yɛ ɛbɛla, na yɛanyia adenle yɛazonle yɛ Nyamenle ne, yɛali ye eni, kɛmɔ ɔfɛta la. 3Zɛhae nzɛlɛlɛ le kpalɛ na ɔsɔ Nyamenle yɛ Ngoanedievolɛ ne anye. 4Ɔluakɛ ɛkpondɛ kɛ menli kɔsɔɔti nwu nɔhalɛ ne na bɛnyia ngoane. 5Nyamenle kokye a wɔ ɛkɛ a, yɛɛ pepɛdievolɛ kpɔdavolɛ ko a gyi Nyamenle nee sonla avinli a, yemɔ a le Kelaese Gyisɛse 6mɔɔ vale ɔ nwo manle kɛ ɔkpɔne menli kɔsɔɔti yeavi bɛ ɛtane nu la. Mekɛ kpalɛ ne dwule la ɔhilele kɛ Nyamenle kpondɛ kɛ menli kɔsɔɔti nyia ngoane. 7 Ɛhye ati yɛɛ ɔyɛle me ɛzoanvolɛ kɛ menga na mengilehile bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la nɔhalɛ diedi ne a. Membɔ adalɛ, nɔhalɛ ne a melɛka la!
8Saa bɛyia nuhua kɛ bɛsonle a, mekpondɛ kɛ mrenya ala a yɛ nzɛlɛlɛ a. Ɔwɔ kɛ mrenya zɛhae mɔ yɛ menli mɔɔ bɛdu bɛ nwo bɛmaa Nyamenle na bɛkola bɛmaa bɛ sa zo bɛsɛlɛ mɔɔ ɛya anzɛɛ kpolerazulɛ biala ɛnle nu a. 9 Eza mekpondɛ kɛ mraalɛ ne mɔ noko siezie bɛ nwo kɛnlɛma wɔ adenle mɔɔ kile kɛ bɛze deɛ na nyiane wɔ bɛ nye zo la azo; tɛ tileyɛlɛ mɔɔ bie ɛtɛbale ewiade ɛlɛ anzɛɛ avikpa nee mgbɔba mɔɔ bɛfa bɛayɛ bɛ nwo sɔɔnwo, bɛawula adɛladeɛ anzɛɛ bɛaheda ndanlɛ awolɛ ɛsesebɛ la yɛɛ melɛka a. 10Meka ɛbɛla kpalɛ ɛbɔlɛ mɔɔ fɛta mraalɛ mɔɔ sonle Nyamenle la. 11Mraalɛ ɛyɛ koonwu, ɛbɛlɛ bɛ nwo aze ɛzukoa. 12Memmaa adenle kɛ mraalɛ ɛhilehile anzɛɛ ɛnyia mrenya nwo zo tumi; ɔwɔ kɛ bɛka bɛ nloa bɛto nu. 13 Ɔluakɛ bɛlumuale bɛbɔle Adam kolaa na bɛabɔ Yivi; 14 yɛɛ tɛ Adam a ɛwɔlɛ ne bɛlɛbɛlale ye a. Raalɛ ne a ɛwɔlɛ ne bɛlɛbɛlale ye mɔɔ ɔdonle Nyamenle mɛla ne a. 15Noko saa raalɛ ka ɔ nwo aze, ɔbɔ mɔdenle ɔtɛnla diedi, ɛhulolɛ nee anwondelɛ nu a, ɔlua mralɛ ɛwolɛ ti bɛkɛlie ye ngoane.

Title: 1 TEM 3
Content:
Asɔne ne anu mgbanyima
1Ɛhye le nɔhalɛ edwɛkɛ bɔkɔɔ: Saa awie anye bolo kɛ ɔyɛ asɔne kpanyinli a, ɛnee yeva gyima kpalɛ. 2 Ɔwɔ kɛ asɔne kpanyinli biala yɛ sonla mɔɔ ngehanleɛ biala ɛnle ɔ nwo, ɔ ye kokye, ɔ nye gyi ɔ ti anwo, ɔkola ɔsɔ ɔ nwo, ɔ nye ka aze, ɔdie nyɛvolɛ na ɔkola ɔkilehile; 3ɔnle kɛ ɔyɛ nzanli anzɛɛ ɔdi mgbonde; ɔwɔ kɛ ɔyɛ sonla bɛtɛɛ mɔɔ kyi manzonle; ɔnle kɛ ɔ nye bolo ezukoa. 4Ɔwɔ kɛ ɔyɛ sonla mɔɔ kola bu ɔdaye ye awuke ne kpalɛ na ɔ mra fa enililɛ tie ye edwɛkɛ a. 5Awie mɔɔ ɛngola ɛmbu ɔdaye ye awuke la, kɛ ɔkɛyɛ na yeahola yeanlea Nyamenle asɔne ne azo ɛ? 6Ɔnle kɛ ɔyɛ sonla mɔɔ rale asɔne ne anu la ɛtɛkyɛle a, anrɛɛ ɔkɛmemaa ɔ nwo zo ɔkɛmaa bɛkɛbua ye fɔlɛ kɛ bɛbua Abɔnsam la. 7Ɔwɔ kɛ ɔyɛ sonla mɔɔ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛngɔ asɔne la di ye eni, amaa yeangua ɔ nyunlu aze, yeangɔndɔ Abɔnsam ɛhane nu.
Asɔne nu boavolɛma
8Zɔhane ala yɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ asɔne nu boavolɛma yɛ menli mɔɔ lɛ subane kpalɛ na bɛdi nɔhalɛ a; ɔnle kɛ bɛyɛ nzama anzɛɛ bɛyɛ ezukoa nwo anyebolo. 9Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛfa adwenle mɔɔ anu te la bɛsɔ diedi ne mɔɔ bɛye bɛhile bɛ la anu nɔhalɛ nu. 10Bɛzɔ menli zɛhae mɔ bɛnlea kolaa na saa edwɛkɛ ɛnle bɛ nwo a, bɛazonle asɔne ne kɛ bɛle boavolɛma. 11Zɔhane ala yɛɛ bɛ ye mɔ noko ɔwɔ kɛ yɛ mraalɛ mɔɔ bɛ nye gyi bɛ ti anwo na bɛdi nɔhalɛ wɔ debie biala anu a. 12Sonla mɔɔ le asɔne nu boavolɛ la ɔwɔ kɛ gya raalɛ ko, na ɔkola ɔ mra nwo zo nee ye awuke zo nea kpalɛ. 13Ɔluakɛ bɛdabɛ boavolɛma mɔɔ bɛkɛyɛ bɛ gyima kpalɛ la nyia bɛ nyunlu na bɛkola bɛka bɛ diedi mɔɔ wɔ Kelaese Gyisɛse anu la anwo edwɛkɛ mɔɔ bɛnzulo a.
Fealera nu edwɛkɛ kpole ne
14Melɛkɛlɛ wɔ kɛlata ɛhye, noko me nye la kɛ ɔnrɛhyɛ biala na meara lɔ. 15Na saa mekyɛ ɛralɛ nu a, kɛlata ɛhye bamaa wɔanwu kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ ɛsi ɛbɔ wɔ ɛbɛla wɔ Nyamenle sua nu la, meka tease Nyamenle ne asɔne ne mɔɔ le nɔhalɛ ne sika nee ye bodane la. 16Yɛka yɛto gua kɛ nɔhalɛ, awozinli nu debie mɔɔ wɔ yɛ nyamenlezonlenlɛ ne anu la yɛ nwanwane:
Ɔrale ewiade kɛ sonla,
noko Sunsum nu a ɔle saanwu.
Nyamenle soanvolɛma nwunle ye,
bɛbɔle ɔ nwo nolo wɔ maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti anu.
Ewiade amra amuala liele ye lile,
na bɛvale ye bɛhɔle anwuma anyu

Title: 1 TEM 4
Content:
Kilehilevolɛma adalɛ
1Nyamenle Sunsum ne ka ye wienyi kɛ menli ne bie mɔ bakpo bɛ diedi ne kenle bie; bɛbadie sunsum adalɛma edwɛkɛ na bɛali mbɔnsam ngilehilelɛ ne mɔ azo. 2Menli alane bie mɔɔ bɛ adwenle ɛwu kɛ asɛɛ bɛva bulalɛ mɔɔ ɛdɔlɔ woonwu la bɛwula nu la a yɛ ngilehilelɛ ɛhye a. 3Zɛhae menli ne kilehile kɛ ɔnle kpalɛ kɛ menli kɛgya bɛ nwo, yɛɛ ɔnle kɛ bɛdi aleɛ bie mɔ. Noko Nyamenle bɔle aleɛ kɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdie bɛdi na bɛnwu nɔhalɛ ne la ɛva moyɛlɛ nzɛlɛlɛ ɛli. 4Debie biala mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛbɔ la le kpalɛ. Ɔnle kɛ yɛkpo biala. Ɔwɔ kɛ yɛfa moyɛlɛ yɛdie ɔ muala, 5ɔluakɛ Nyamenle edwɛkɛ ne nee nzɛlɛlɛ ne te nwolɛ.
Kelaese Gyisɛse sonvolɛ kpalɛ ne
6Saa ɛfa ngilehilelɛ ɛhye mɔ ɛkilehile mediema ne mɔ a, ɛbayɛ Kelaese Gyisɛse sonvolɛ kpalɛ, na diedi nu ngilehilelɛ ne nee ngilehilelɛ kpalɛ ne mɔɔ dahuu ɛli ɔ nzi la aboa amaa wɔanyi sunsum nu. 7Twe ɛ nwo fi yɛ nlenya mɔ anwo koasea nwɔra mgbane mgbane ne mɔ mɔɔ ɛnle nyamenlezonlenlɛ la anwo, na mia ɛ nwo sonle Nyamenle kpalɛ. 8Nwonane agbɔkɛ nu ɛkpundinlɛ hyia kpalɛ, noko sunsum nu ɛdeɛ ne hyia kpole kpalɛ, ɔluakɛ ɔmaa yɛ kɛkala nee kenle bie ngoane mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ. 9Ɛhye le nɔhalɛ edwɛkɛ mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛdie bɛto nu bɔkɔɔ a. 10Ɛhye ati yɛɛ yɛpele yɛyɛ gyima ɛsesebɛ a, ɔluakɛ yɛva yɛ nye yɛdo tease Nyamenle ne anwo zo. Yemɔ yɛɛ ɔle menli kɔsɔɔti bɛ Ngoanedievolɛ a, bɔbɔ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdie bɛdi la.
11Fa ɛhye mɔ tu bɛ folɛ na kilehile bɛ. 12Mmamaa awie bu wɔ kakula; maa wɔ ɛdendɛlɛ nee wɔ nyɛleɛ, wɔ ɛhulolɛ, wɔ diedi nee wɔ anwondelɛ ɛyɛ ndonwo ɛmaa diedima ne amuala. 13Maa ɛ nye ɛbolo Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne ɛgengalɛ wɔ bagua nu, ye nolobɔlɛ nee ye ngilehilelɛ nwo kɔkpula kɛ menwɔra la. 14Mmakpo sunsum nu ahyɛlɛdeɛ ne mɔɔ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma hanle a ɛ sa hanle ye wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ mgbanyima ne mɔ vale bɛ sa guale ɛ ti zo la. 15Bɔ mɔdenle yɛ ɛhye mɔ na tu ɛ nwo maa bɔkɔɔ, amaa wɔ anyunluhɔlɛ ne ala ali wɔ menli kɔsɔɔti anyunlu. 16Nea ɛ nwo boɛ na nea wɔ ngilehilelɛ ne boɛ. Kɔ zolɛ yɛ ɛhye mɔ, ɔluakɛ saa ɛyɛ ye zɔhane a, ɛkɛlie ɛ nwo nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛtie wɔ la ngoane.

Title: 1 TEM 5
Content:
Diedima anwo ɛzonlelilɛ
1Mmatwi kpanyinli biala anyunlu. Dielie bɛ kɛ ɛ ze mɔ la. Yɛ mgbavolɛ ne mɔ kɛ ɛ mediema mrenya; 2mraalɛ mgbanyinli ne mɔ, tendɛ kile bɛ kɛ ɛ nli mɔ, yɛɛ mbɛlɛra ne mɔ noko, yɛ bɛ kɛ ɛ mediema mraalɛ, wɔ adenle mɔɔ nuhua te la anu.
3Di ahunlanvolɛ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ neavolɛ la eni. 4Na saa kunlanvolɛ bie wɔ ɛkɛ ne mɔɔ lɛ mralɛ anzɛɛ nlɔnra a, maa ngakula zɔhane mɔ ɛzukoa bɛ nyamenlezonlenlɛ gyima ne mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛdi bɛmaa bɛ awovolɛ la, bɛva bɛdua bɛ awovolɛ kakɛ, ɔluakɛ ɛhye a sɔ Nyamenle anye a. 5Kunlanvolɛ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awie ɛnnea ye la, ɛva ɔ nye ɛdo Nyamenle anwo zo, na ɔhɔ zolɛ ɔbodo ɔzɛlɛ na ɔbiza moalɛ aledwolɛ nee alehyenlɛ. 6Na kunlanvolɛ mɔɔ ɛlɛdi ɔ ti la, kanzɛ ɔde ngoane nu bɔbɔ a yewu dɛbadɛba. 7Fa folɛdulɛ ɛhye maa bɛ, amaa awie annyia edwɛkɛ ɛtane biala anga wɔ bɛ nwo. 8Saa awie ɛngola ye mbusua nea, bɔbɔ ɔngola ye awovolɛ boɛ nea a, ɛnee yekpo diedi ne na yezɛkye yedɛla sonla mɔɔ ɛnlɛ diedi la.
9Mmakɛlɛ kunlanvolɛ biala duma ɛboka ahunlanvolɛ ne mɔ anwo kyesɛ yeli ɛvolɛ abulasia nee ɔ nzi, na eza ɔhɔle agyalɛ ko ala, 10yɛɛ ye nyɛleɛ kpalɛ ti bɛbɔ ye duma kpalɛ kɛ ɔle raalɛ mɔɔ tetele ɔ mra kpalɛ, ɔliele nyɛvolɛ, ɔwowole anwondelɛma agyakɛ anwo, ɔboale bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ nwo hyelele bɛ, na ɔdule ɔ nwo ɔmanle gyima kpalɛ biala ɛyɛlɛ la.
11Mmafa kunlanvolɛ bɛlɛra biala ɛboka kunlanvolɛma aluma ne anwo, ɔluakɛ saa bɛ atiakunluwɔzo ne dwazo a, ɛnee bɛkulo kɛ bɛkɔ agyalɛ na bɛtwe bɛ nwo bɛfi Kelaese anwo, 12na bɛdi bɛ ɛwɔkɛ ne mɔɔ bɛlumuale bɛbɔle la anwo fɔlɛ. 13Eza bɛsɛkye mekɛ bɛduolua ye mgbovonle nu bɛwolowolo azua nu, yɛɛ tɛ ɛhye angome, bɛbɔ nzekue, bɛfa bɛ nloa bɛwulowula awie mɔ edwɛkɛ nu, na bɛkeha edwɛkɛ mɔɔ ɔnle kɛ bɛka la. 14Zɔhane ati menwɔhulo kɛ ahunlanvolɛ mbɛlɛra ne mɔ kɛhɔ agyalɛ, bɛkɛwo mralɛ, na bɛkɛbu bɛ awuke, amaa yɛ kpɔvolɛma annyia adenle anga edwɛkɛ ɛtane antia yɛ. 15Ɔluakɛ ahunlanvolɛ ne bie mɔ kɛkala angome ɛpɛ bɛ nwo ɛhɔ kali Seetan anzi. 16Saa diedinli raalɛ bie lɛ ahunlanvolɛ wɔ ye abusua nu a, ɔboa bɛ, na ɔmmafa bɛ nwo ɛzonle ɔsoa asɔne ne, amaa asɔne ne ahola aboa ahunlanvolɛ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ bɛ awie mɔ la.
17Nwu ye kɛ mgbanyinli mɔɔ yɛ gyima kpalɛ la fɛta ahatualɛ mɔnwo, titile, bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛbɔ Edwɛkpa ne nolo na eza bɛkilehile la; 18 ɔluakɛ Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se, “Bɛmmakyekye ɛnlankɛ ne mɔɔ wozo awule la anloa,” yɛɛ “Sonla yɛ gyima die ahatualɛ.” 19 Saa awie toa asɔne kpanyinli bie kile wɔ a, mmadie ɛto nu ɛkɛ ne ala kyesɛ wɔde ye wɔ alasevolɛ nwiɔ anzɛɛ nsa anloa. 20Twi bɛdabɛ mɔɔ ɛtane ala a bɛyɛ la anyunlu wɔ bagua nu, amaa menli mɔɔ ɛha la azulo.
21Megyi Nyamenle nee Kelaese Gyisɛse nee anwuma soanvolɛma nwuanzanwuanza ne mɔ anyunlu meka meahile wɔ kɛ, di ngyehyɛlɛ ɛhye mɔ azo, na mmanea menli nyunlu anzɛɛ ɛdi mɔguazo wɔ debie biala anu. 22Mmapele ndɛ ɛfa ɛ sa ɛgua awie biala ati zo kɛ ɔrayɛ Awulae gyima. Mmafa ɛ nwo ɛdielie awie mɔ nyɛleɛ ɛtane ɛtane nu; nea maa ɛ nwo ɛde.
23Mmano nzule ngome ala, ɛ ko ne nee ɛ nwo ne mɔɔ toto wɔ wazowazo la ati, anrɛɛ no nwanye ekyi.
24Menli ne bie mɔ ɛtane ne mɔ la ali wienyi, na ɔdi bɛ nyunlu ɔ nee bɛ kɔ ndɛnebualɛ nu, na bie mɔ ɛtane ɛdeɛ kyɛ na yeavinde. 25Zɔhane ala yɛɛ nyɛleɛ kpalɛ biala la ali wienyi a, yɛɛ mɔɔ ɛnla ali bɔbɔ la, bɛngola bɛnvea zolɛ.

Title: 1 TEM 6
Content:
1Maa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛle ngɛkɛlɛ la ɛbu bɛ menle mɔ kɛ bɛfɛta enililɛ wɔ adenle biala anu, amaa awie biala annyia edwɛkɛ ɛtane anga wɔ Nyamenle duma ne nee yɛ ngilehilelɛ ne anwo. 2Ahanra mɔɔ bɛ menle mɔ le diedima la mmakpo kɛ bɛnrɛli bɛ menle mɔ eni, kɛmɔ bɛle bɛ mediema la ati. Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛsonle bɛ kpalɛ, ɔboalekɛ bɛ gyimayɛlɛ nwo nvasoɛ ne kɔ diedima mɔɔ bɛkulo bɛ edwɛkɛ la lɔ.
Ngilehilelɛ adalɛ nee anwonyia kpalɛ
Kilehile na bɔ ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ nolo. 3Awie biala mɔɔ kilehile ngilehilelɛ fofolɛ bie na ɔnlie yɛ Awulae Gyisɛse Kelaese nɔhalɛ edwɛkɛ ne nee yɛ nyamenlezonlenlɛ ngilehilelɛ ne ɔndo nu la 4memaa ɔ nwo zo ala na ɔnze debie biala. Kpolerazulɛ nee edwɛkɛ kpɔkɛ nwo butulelilɛ ɛyɛ ye subane; na ɛhye noko nee nungunlehwenlɛ, manzonle, aholoba ɛbɔlɛ nee menli nwo adwenle ɛtane ɛvalɛ a lua a. 5Eza bɛ nee menli mɔɔ bɛ adwenle ɛzɛkye na nɔhalɛ ne ɛvi bɛ sa la su kpolera dahuu. Bɛ adwenle a le kɛ bɛdua nyamenlezonlenlɛ zo bɛanyia bɛ nwo.
6Saa sonla maa ɔ kunlu adwo mɔɔ ɔlɛ la anwo a, anrɛɛ nyamenlezonlenlɛ le anwonyia kpole. 7Ɔluakɛ yɛanva ɛhwee yɛamba ewiade ye, yɛɛ yɛnrɛva bie yɛnrɛhɔ. 8Ɛhye ati, saa yɛlɛ mɔɔ yɛdi nee mɔɔ yɛkeda la a, bɛmaa yɛ nye ɛzɔ yɛ nwo. 9Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkpondɛ bɛ nwo bɛanyia la tɔ ngyegyelɛ nu, na munzule atiakunluwɔzo mgbane mgbane mɔɔ sɛkye menli, minli bɛ bo zo la kye bɛ wɔ ye ɛhane nu. 10Ɔluakɛ ezukoa nwo anyebolo le munzule muala abo ndinli; bie mɔ anye ɛbolo ye ɛkpondɛlɛ somaa yemaa bɛvi diedi ne anwo mɔɔ akee nyane ala a bɛdi a.
Pɔɔlo tu folɛ
11Na wɔmɔ, Nyamenle sonla, twe ɛ nwo fi ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ anwo, na pele kpondɛ pɛlepɛlelilɛ, anwondelɛ, diedi, ɛhulolɛ, abotane yɛɛ bɛtɛɛyɛlɛ bo zo. 12Bɔ mɔdenle ko diedi nu konle kpalɛ ne na ɛ sa aha ngoane mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ la, ɔluakɛ ngoane ɛhye ati yɛɛ Nyamenle vɛlɛle wɔ wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛlale wɔ diedi ne ali wɔ dasevolɛma dɔɔnwo ne anyunlu la a. 13Megyi Nyamenle mɔɔ maa ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti ngoane, nee Kelaese Gyisɛse mɔɔ gyinlanle Pɔntɛse Paelɛte anyunlu lile ye diedi nwo daselɛ la anyunlu, meka meahile wɔ kɛ 14di ngyehyɛlɛ ne azo na maa nwolɛ ɛde bɔkɔɔ ɔhɔkpula Kenle mɔɔ yɛ Awulae Gyisɛse Kelaese kɛra bieko la. 15Ye ɛralɛ bieko mekɛ kpalɛ ne wɔ Nyamenle Tumivolɛ Saleɛnli Kokye ne mɔɔ le arelemgbunli Belemgbunli nee awulae mɔ Awulae la asa anu. 16Ɔdaye ala a ɔle damɛnlangoate na ɔde wienyi ne mɔɔ awie ɛngola ɛmbikye ye la anu a. Awie biala ɛtɛnwunle ye ɛlɛ, yɛɛ awie ɛnrɛhola ɛnrɛnwu ye ɛlɛ. Enililɛ nee belemgbunlililɛ mɔɔ ɛmbɔ aze ɛlɛ la le ye ɛdeɛ dahuu! Amen.
17Tendɛ kile bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛ ngoane ɛhye anu anwonyia la kɛ bɛmmamemaa bɛ nwo zo, yɛɛ bɛmmafa bɛ nye bɛto ninyɛne mɔɔ pɛ nu se kɛ anwonyia la azo, bɛmaa bɛ nye ɛla Nyamenle mɔɔ maa yɛ debie biala molozo mɔɔ yɛfa yɛdie yɛ nye la anwo zo. 18Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛyɛ nyele, bɛkɔ zolɛ bɛyɛ nyɛleɛ kpalɛ, bɛfa atiakunlukɛnlɛma nee ɛhulolɛ bɛkyɛ debie. 19Ye zɛhae ɛnee bɛlɛkuohua bɛ agyadeɛ nloa mɔɔ bayɛ sua bo ɛdolɛ amaa bɛ wɔ kenle bie, amaa bɛ sa aha ngoane ne mɔɔ le nɔhalɛ ngoane ne la.
20Temɔte, nea mɔɔ bɛva bɛwula ɛ sa nu la boɛ. Twe ɛ nwo fi munzule edwɛkɛ ɛhehanlɛ nee kpolerazulɛ mgbane mgbane ne mɔ mɔɔ bie mɔ fo fɛlɛ ye “Adwenlenubukelɛ” la anwo. 21Ɔluakɛ bie mɔ ɛha kɛ bɛlɛ ɛhye na ɔlua ɔ ti bɛminli diedi adenle ne.
Nyamenle ɛlo bɛ muala.

Title: 2 TEM MUKENYE
Content:
Mukenye
Edwɛkɛ titile mɔɔ wɔ Pɔɔlo Kɛlata ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nwiɔ, mɔɔ ɔhɛlɛle ɔhɔmanle Temɔte la anu la le folɛdulɛ. Ɔhɛlɛle ɔhɔmanle Temɔte kɛ ɔle agɔnwolɛ kakula nee boavolɛ. Edwɛkɛ kpɔkɛ mɔɔ ɔgyi zolɛ la a le abotanezilɛ. Ɔtu Temɔte folɛ kɛ saa kanza awie mɔ tia ye, na ɔlɛnwu amaneɛ a, ɔzi ahonle ɔha Gyisɛse Kelaese anwo edwɛkɛ ne nɔhalɛ nu, ɔzɔ Edwɛkpa ne nee Ngyekyeleɛ Dɛba ne anwo ngilehilelɛ ne anu ɛsesebɛ, na ɔyɛ ye gyima kɛ ɔle kilehilevolɛ nee sonla mɔɔ kpɔsa bɔ Nyamenle Edwɛkpa ne nolo a.
Ɔhakyele Temɔte ɛsesebɛ kɛ munzule wɔ “koasea kpolerazulɛ mɔɔ ɛngɔ adenle nu” la anu, na ɔbɔle ye kɔkɔ kɛ ɔmmafa ɔ nwo ɔwulowula edwɛkɛ mɔɔ le zɛhae mɔ la anu, yɛɛ ɔmmatie bie bɔbɔ, ɔboalekɛ ɔnva awie biala ɔnzie boɛ, na ɔtwe menli mɔɔ tie la ɔkɔ munzule nu.
Wɔ ɛhye mɔ amuala anu, ɔhwenle Temɔte adwenle ɔhɔziele ɔdaye Pɔɔlo ye ɛbɛlabɔlɛ nee ye bodane ne: ye diedi, ye abotane, ye ɛhulolɛ, ɔ nwo zo ɛhomolɛ, yɛɛ anwubɛnyunlu muala azo.
Mɔɔ wɔ nu la
Ngilenu 1.1-2
Ɛyeyɛlɛ nee folɛdulɛ 1.3—2.13
Ngilehilelɛ nee kɔkɔbɔlɛ 2.14—4.5
Pɔɔlo ɔdaye ye gyinlabelɛ 4.6-18
Adwulaleɛ 4.19-22

Title: 2 TEM 1
Content:
1Medame Pɔɔlo, mɔɔ ɔlua Nyamenle ɛhulolɛ zo merayɛ Kelaese Gyisɛse ɛzoanvolɛ, na yezoa me kɛ membɔ ngoane ne mɔɔ Kelaese ati bɛvale bɛbɔle yɛ ɛwɔkɛ la nolo la, yɛɛ melɛkɛlɛ kɛlata ɛhye a.
2 Mefa meahɔmaa me ra Temɔte mɔɔ la me ahonle nwo la.
Nyamenle Selɛ ne nee yɛ Awulae Kelaese Gyisɛse ɛlo wɔ, ɔnwu wɔ anwunvɔne na ɔmaa wɔ anzonudwolɛ.
Moyɛlɛ nee akɛnrazilɛ
3Meyɛ Nyamenle ne mɔɔ mesonle ye nɔhalɛ nu, kɛmɔ me nlenya mɔ yɛle la mo kɛ mekakye wɔ wɔ me nzɛlɛlɛ nu alehyenlɛ nee aledwolɛ biala a. 4Kɛmɔ mekakye monle mɔɔ ɛhwinle la ati, me nwo dɔ wɔ nɔɔzo nee ewiazo amuala, na me kunlu a anrɛɛ menwu wɔ, amaa me nye alie. 5 Mekakye nɔhalɛ diedi ne mɔɔ ɛlɛ ye, diedi ne mɔɔ ɛnee ɛ nla Loyese nee ɛ nli Yunaesi lɛ ye la bie, na medie medi kɛ ɛdawɔ noko ɛlɛ zɔhane diedi ne. 6Zɔhane ati meka meahile wɔ kɛ fa ahyɛlɛdeɛ ne mɔɔ Nyamenle manle wɔ, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ menvale me sa menguale ɛ ti zo la yɛ gyima. 7Ɔluakɛ Nyamenle ammaa yɛ sunsum mɔɔ le foanvoanle a; Nyamenle manle yɛ Sunsum mɔɔ lɛ tumi nee ɛhulolɛ na ɔmaa yɛkola yɛkomo yɛ nwo zo la.
8Mmamaa Awulae anwo daselɛlilɛ yɛ wɔ nyiane; yɛɛ mmamaa medame noko mɔɔ Kelaese ati mela efiade la me nwo yɛ wɔ nyiane. Ɛdawɔ dua anwosesebɛ ne mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛva ɛmaa wɔ la azo nwu Edwɛkpa ne anwo amaneɛ ne bie. 9Ɔliele yɛ ngoane na ɔvɛlɛle yɛ kɛ yɛrayɛ ye menli, tɛ yɛ gyima mɔɔ yɛyɛ la ati ɔ, na ɔlua ɔdaye ye bodane nee ye ɛlolɛ ti. Ɔluale Kelaese Gyisɛse anwo zo ɔvale ɛlolɛ ɛhye ɔmanle yɛ ɔvi aloamɔleɛ, 10yɛɛ ɛnɛ bɛlua yɛ ngoanedievolɛ Kelaese Gyisɛse ɛralɛ ne ati bɛla ye ali a. Ɔpɛle ewule tumi ne anu na ɔluale Edwɛkpa ne azo ɔlale ngoane mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ la ali ɔhilele yɛ.
11 Edwɛkpa ɛhye yɛɛ Nyamenle ɛyɛ kɛ membɔ ye nolo, menyɛ ɛzoanvolɛ na mengilehile a. 12Zɔhane ati yɛɛ menwu amaneɛ ɛhye mɔ a. Noko ɔnyɛ me nyiane, ɔluakɛ meze mɔɔ meva me rɛle mewula ye nu la, na medie medi kɛ ɔkɛhola ɔkɛzie mɔɔ meva mewula ɔ sa nu la gyɛlɛɛnye ɔkɛhɔkpula Awulae Kenle ne. 13Sɔ nɔhalɛ ne mɔɔ ɛdele ɛvile me ɛkɛ ne la anu boɛ, fa yɛ ndonwo di zo, na tɛnla diedi nee ɛhulolɛ ne mɔɔ Kelaese Gyisɛse ati ɔle yɛ ɛdeɛ la anu. 14Sɔ nɔhalɛ ne mɔɔ ɔlua Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne mɔɔ wɔ yɛ nu la tumi zo bɛva bɛwula ɛ sa nu la anu boɛ.
15Ɛze kɛ awie biala mɔɔ wɔ Ehyea maanzinli ne anu la ɛnriandi me; Fegyɛlɛse nee Hɛmɔgyɛnize bɛdabɛ bɛboka bɛ. 16Awulae ɛnwu Onɛsefɔlɛse awuke nu amra anwunvɔne, ɔboalekɛ ɔkyekyele me rɛle mekɛ dɔɔnwo ne ala. Yeanyɛ ye nyiane kɛ mela efiade a. 17Ɔdwule Wulomu ala la yɛɛ ɔbɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɔkpondɛ me a, na ɔkpondɛle me toonwo ɔnwunle me. 18Awulae ɛnwu ye anwunvɔne wɔ Awulae Kenle ne anu! Ɛdawɔ ɛze dɔɔnwo mɔɔ ɔyɛle ɔmanle me wɔ Ɛfɛsɛse a.

Title: 2 TEM 2
Content:
Kelaese Gyisɛse sogyanli mɔɔ di nɔhalɛ
1Me ra, wɔmɔ maa ɛ nwo ɛyɛ se wɔ ɛlolɛ ne mɔɔ Kelaese Gyisɛse ati ɔle yɛ ɛdeɛ la anu. 2Fa ngilehilelɛ ne mɔɔ ɛdele ɛvile me ɛkɛ ne wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee melɛkilehile menli dɔɔnwo la wula bɛdabɛ mɔɔ ɛdie bɛ ɛdi kɛ bɛkɛhola ye kilehile la asa anu.
3Ɛdawɔ noko nwu wɔ afoa nu amaneɛ ɛdeɛ, kɛ ɛle Kelaese Gyisɛse sogyanli kpalɛ mɔɔ di nɔhalɛ a. 4Sogyanli mɔɔ gyi konle nloa la kpondɛ kɛ ɔsɔ ye safohyenle ne anye. Yemɔti ɔnva ɔ nwo ɔnwulowula maanlema ɛbɛlabɔlɛ nu. 5Awie biala mɔɔ su ɛnriandilɛ la ɛngola ɛnnyia ahyɛlɛdeɛ kyesɛ ɔdi nwolɛ mɛla ne mɔ azo. 6Ɛyazonlɛnli ne mɔɔ ɛyɛ gyima ɛsesebɛ la yɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ dumua di avule ne anu aleɛ ne bie a. 7Dwenle mɔɔ melɛka la anwo, ɔluakɛ Awulae baboa wɔ yeamaa wɔade ɔ muala abo.
8Kakye Gyisɛse Kelaese, kakye ye ewudwazo ne na kakye kɛ ɔle Devidi anlɔnra. Edwɛkpa ne mɔɔ mebɔ ye nolo la ɛne. 9Na Edwɛkpa ɛhye ati yɛɛ melɛnwu amaneɛ na bɛgua me nwɔnzɔnwɔnzɔ kɛ asɛɛ medo mɛla bie la. Nyamenle edwɛkɛ ne ɛdeɛ bɛtɛguale ye nwɔnzɔnwɔnzɔ. 10Ɛhye ati medi debie biala me kunlu wɔ Nyamenle menli ne mɔɔ yekpa nu yeye bɛ la ati, amaa bɛdabɛ noko Kelaese Gyisɛse ati bɛanyia ngoanelielɛ ne nee anyunlunyia ne mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ la bie. 11Edwɛkɛ ne le nɔhalɛ, ɔse:
“Saa yɛ nee ye ɛwu a,
ɛnee yɛ nee ye badɛnla ngoane nu.
12 Saa yɛgyinla kpundii a,
yɛ nee ye bali belemgbunli.
Saa yɛkpo ye a,
ɔdaye ɔkɛkpo yɛ.
13Saa yɛnli nɔhalɛ a,
yemɔ, ɔdi nɔhalɛ dahuu.
Ɔluakɛ ɔngola ɔmbɛlɛbɛla ɔ nwo.”
Gyimayɛvolɛ mɔɔ sɔ Nyamenle anye la
14Kakyehakye wɔ menli ne mɔ wɔ ɛhye anwo, na bɔ bɛ kɔkɔ wɔ Nyamenle anyunlu kɛ bɛmmadi edwɛkɛ agbɔkɛ nwo butule. Ɔnle kpalɛ, yɛɛ ɔsɛkye menli mɔɔ tie la adwenle. 15Bɔ mɔdenle ɛsesebɛ kɛ ɛkɛzɔ Nyamenle anye, kɛ gyimayɛvolɛ mɔɔ ɛnze ye gyima nwo nyiane na ɔkilehile Nyamenle nɔhalɛ edwɛkɛ ne kpalɛ la. 16Twe ɛ nwo fi bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsu zɛhae munzule nee koasea kpolera la anwo. Ɛhye te menli fi Nyamenle anwo. 17Zɛhae ngilehilelɛ le kɛ hanlɛ mɔɔ ɛdidi nwonane ne abo la. Kilehilevolɛma zɛhae anu nwiɔ a le Haemɛneeyɛse nee Faelitɛse; 18bɛgyakyi nɔhalɛ adenle ne na bɛlɛsɛkye diedima ne mɔ adwenle kɛ ewudwazo mekɛ ne ɛpɛ nu ɛze dɛbadɛba. 19 Noko adiabo ne mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛwula la gyi kpundii, na bɛhɛlɛ nwolɛ kɛ, “Awulae ze bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛle ye ɛdeɛ la,” yɛɛ “Ɔwɔ kɛ awie biala mɔɔ bɔ Awulae duma kɛ ɔle Awulae la twe ɔ nwo fi ɛtane nwo.”
20Wɔ awuke kpole biala anu, nyɛba nee dwora ngakyile dɔɔnwo wɔ ɛkɛ: bie mɔ wɔ nu mɔɔ bɛvale ezukoa nvutuke anzɛɛ dwɛtɛ fufule a bɛyɛle a, yɛɛ bie mɔ noko bɛvale baka anzɛɛ ɛva a bɛyɛle a; bie mɔ anwo hyia kpalɛ yɛɛ bie mɔ noko anwo ɛngyia biala. 21Saa awie twe ɔ nwo fi ninyɛne evinli nwo a, ɔkɛyɛ kɛ ɛyɛba mɔɔ anwo hyia na bɛde nwolɛ bɛmaa Nyamenle, na ɔ nwo ɛra nvasoɛ ɛmaa ɔ menle na bɛziezie ye kɛ bɛfa bɛayɛ gyima kpalɛ la. 22Yemɔti kpo wɔ mgbavolɛ nu atiakunluwɔzo ne mɔ na ɛ nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛfa ahonle mɔɔ nuhua te bɛfɛlɛ Awulae la ɛpele ɛkpondɛ pɛlepɛlelilɛ, diedi, ɛhulolɛ, nee anzonudwolɛ bo zo. 23Twe ɛ nwo fi koasea kpolerazulɛ mgbane mgbane ne mɔ anwo, ɔluakɛ ɛze kɛ bɛwie butulelilɛ. 24Ɔnle kɛ Awulae sonvolɛ biala di butule. Ɔwɔ kɛ ɔyɛ atiakunlukɛnlɛma ɔmaa awie biala, na ɔyɛ kilehilevolɛ kpalɛ mɔɔ lɛ abotane a. 25Ɔwɔ kɛ ɔto ɔ rɛle azule nu ɔkilehile bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ nee ye ɛnga la, ɔluakɛ saa ɔyɛ Nyamenle ɛhulolɛ a ɔbamaa bɛ mekɛ kpalɛ yeamaa bɛanlu bɛ nwo na bɛaranwu nɔhalɛ ne. 26Na saa bɛ nye zo tete bɛ a bɛanriandi bɛavi Abɔnsam mɔɔ hyele bɛ manle bɛkpole Nyamenle ɛhulolɛdeɛ ne la ɛhane ne anu.

Title: 2 TEM 3
Content:
Awieleɛ mekɛ ne
1Mekpondɛ kɛ ɛnwu ye kɛ, awieleɛ mekɛ ne anu, anwongyelelɛ dɔɔnwo bara. 2Menli bayɛ angomedi nee ezukoa nwo anyebolo, bɛbamemaa bɛ nwo zo na bɛazua anyetele; bɛbabɔ aholoba, bɛnrɛdie bɛ awovolɛma, bɛbakpo amunli, bɛnrɛzonle Nyamenle; 3bɛ ti bayɛ se, bɛnrɛze anwunvɔne, bɛbabɔ nzekue, bɛbali mgbonde, bɛbava ɛya mgbane mgbane na bɛahyi kpalɛ, 4bɛbaye bɛ gɔnwo mɔ bɛamaa, bɛbayɛ mgbaha na bɛ ti anu ayɛ bɛ fɛ; bɛbahulo anyelielɛ bɛadɛla Nyamenle, 5bɛbazɔ nyamenlezonlenlɛ nu, na bɛnrɛlie ye tumi kpalɛ ne bɛnrɛdo nu. Twe ɛ nwo fi menli zɛhae mɔ anwo. 6Menli ɛhye bie mɔ luolua nu wolowolo azua di mraalɛ mɔɔ anwo ɛhyele bɛ na bɛ nwo yɛ anwunvɔne, na bɛ ɛtane nwo fɔlɛlilɛ ɛyɛ adesoa ɛlɛbu bɛ kɔme, na nwonane nu atiakunluwɔzo ngakyile ɛndie bɛ la anzo. 7Mraalɛ zɛhae mɔ dahuu bɔ mɔdenle kɛ bɛkɛzukoa noko bɛngola bɛnnwu nɔhalɛ ne ɛlɛ. 8Kɛmɔ Gyanize nee Gyambilize dwazole tiale Mosisi la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ menli ɛhye mɔ tia nɔhalɛ ne a. Bɛle menli mɔɔ bɛ adwenle ɛnli munli na bɛ diedi tɔ sinli a. 9Na bɛnrɛdwu moa biala, ɔluakɛ awie biala banwu kɛ bɛle agbamgbanvolɛ. Gyanize nee Gyambilize kɛ hɔwiele ye la ɛne.
Ngilehilelɛ mɔɔ li awieleɛ
10Na wɔmɔ, wɔli me ngilehilelɛ, me nyɛleɛ nee me ɛbɛlabɔlɛ nu bodane ne anzi; wɔnwu me diedi, me abotane, me ɛhulolɛ, nee me kpundii mɔɔ megyi, 11 me amaneɛnwunlɛ nee kpɔdekpɔde mɔɔ bɛyɛ me, ɛze mɔɔ zile me nwo zo wɔ Anteɔko, Ayekoneɛm yɛɛ Lesetela la amuala, ɛzulolɛ mɔɔ menwunle ye la le kpole. Noko Awulae yele me vile ɔ muala anu. 12Nɔhalɛ, awie biala mɔɔ kpondɛ kɛ ɔbɔ ɛbɛla kpalɛ na ɔ nee Kelaese Gyisɛse dua la, bɛbayɛ ye kpɔdekpɔde. 13Amumuyɛma nee adalɛma bahɔ zolɛ amaa bɛ ti ayɛ se kpalɛ, bɛbabɛlɛbɛla awie mɔ na bɛabɛlɛbɛla bɛdabɛ bɛ ngome bɛ nwo. 14Na wɔmɔ, kɔ zolɛ sɔ nɔhalɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛhilehile wɔ na ɛdie ɛdi ɛsesebɛ la anu. Ɛze wɔ kilehilevolɛma ne mɔ, 15yɛɛ ɛkakye kɛ sumunli wɔ ngakula nu yɛɛ ɛzukoale Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ maa wɔ nrɛlɛbɛ mɔɔ saa ɛdie Kelaese Gyisɛse ɛdi a, ɔkola ɔmaa wɔ ngoanelielɛ la. 16Bɛfa Nyamenle Sunsum a bɛkɛlɛ Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne a, na ɔle kpalɛ ɔmaa nɔhalɛ ne ɛhilehilelɛ, sonla nyunlu ɛhwilɛ, folɛdulɛ, yɛɛ menli ɛtetelɛ wɔ ɛbɛla kpalɛ ɛbɔlɛ nu, 17amaa sonla ne mɔɔ sonle Nyamenle la ali munli na bɛaziezie ye bɛamaa yeayɛ gyima kpalɛ.

Title: 2 TEM 4
Content:
1Megyi Nyamenle nee Kelaese Gyisɛse mɔɔ babua anyewɔzo amra nee mɔwuamra ndɛne la anyunlu, meka ye ɛralɛ bieko nee ye belemgbunlililɛ ne na mese wɔ kɛ: 2Bɔ edwɛkɛ ne nolo na si zolɛ mɔɔ ɛndwenle mɔɔ kɛzi ɔ nzi a, kpalɛ o, ɛtane o! Di menli ne adwenle maa bɛlie Edwɛkpa ne bɛdo nu, twi bɛ nyunlu, tu bɛ folɛ na fa abotane kilehile bɛ. 3Mekɛ bie bara mɔɔ menli ɛnrɛdie ngilehilelɛ kpalɛ a. Bɛbali bɛdabɛ bɛ atiakunluwɔzo nzi, na bɛaboɔboa kilehilevolɛma dɔɔnwo mɔɔ kɛha mɔɔ bɛkulo kɛ bɛte la anloa bɛamaa bɛ nwo. 4Bɛbaduodua bɛ nzo wɔ nɔhalɛ ne anwo, na bɛadie nwɔra. 5Na wɔmɔ, sie ɛ ti koonwu, mia ɛ nye te nyane, kpɔsa bɔ Edwɛkpa ne nolo, na yɛ Nyamenle gyima ne kɛ ɛle sonvolɛ.
6Mame, mekɛ ne ɛdwu mɔɔ bɛfa me bɛabɔ azu a, mekɛ mɔɔ mefa meavi ewiade ɛhye anu la ɛbikye. 7Meho konle kpalɛ ne, mewie ɛnriandilɛ ne su, meli me ɛwɔkɛ zo. 8Na kɛkala konimlilɛ ahyɛlɛdeɛ ne, mɔɔ le fɔɔnwoma abɔtile ne, mɔɔ Awulae, Pɛlepɛle Ndɛnebuavolɛ ne bava amaa me wɔ Awulae Kenle ne la, wɔ ɛkɛ ne maa me, yɛɛ ɔnle ɛkɛ ɔmmaa me ngome, ɔwɔ ɛkɛ ne ɔmaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛ ɛhulolɛ bɛlɛkendɛ ye ɛralɛ bieko la amuala.
Nrɛlaleɛ
9Bɔ mɔdenle bakpɔla me ndɛndɛ. 10 Dimase ɛhulo kɛkala ewiade ye na yekpo me, yehɔ Tɛsalonaeka. Kelɛsɛnze ɛhɔ Galeehyea, yɛɛ Taetɛse ɛhɔ Dalemeehyea. 11 Yeha Luku angomekye ala wɔ me nwo ɛke. Nea kɛ ɛ sa kɛha Maake na ɛ nee ye bɛrɛla, ɔluakɛ ɔkɛhola ɔkɛboa me. 12 Mezoa Tekekɛse wɔ Ɛfɛsɛse. 13 Saa ɛba a fa me anwuma tɛladeɛ ne mɔɔ mengyakyile ye wɔ Kaapɛse anwo ɛkɛ ne wɔ Tulowase la bɛla; anrɛɛ fa mbuluku ne mɔ noko, bɔbɔ me nwoma mbuluku mralɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ mekɛlɛ nu la bɛla.
14 Alɛzanda mɔɔ le kɔbele dwinvolɛ ne ɛyɛ me ɛtane kpole, na Awulae badua ye nwolɛ kakɛ noko, kɛmɔ ɔfɛta la. 15Anrɛɛ nea ɛ nwo boɛ wɔ ɔ nwo, ɔluakɛ ɔtia yɛ edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ yɛzo yɛlua la kpole.
16Awie biala angyinla me nzi wɔ alumua ne mɔɔ mekaza me ne wɔ edwɛkɛlilɛ ne anu la. Bɛ muala bɛkpole me. Mesɛlɛ kɛ Nyamenle ɛva ɛhyɛ bɛ. 17Awulae gyinlanle me nzi, na ɔmanle me anwosesebɛ. Zɔhane ati mengolale membɔle Edwɛkpa ne nolo memanle bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la amuala dele bie; na Nyamenle yele me vile awenade ne anloa anu. 18Na Awulae balie me gyɛlɛɛnye avi munzule muala anu na ɔ nee me ahɔ ye anwuma Belemgbunlililɛ ne abo. Anyunlunyia ɛha ye dahuu! Amen.
Ahyebizalɛ
19 Mebiza Pelesela nee Akoyela, yɛɛ Onɛsefɔlɛse awuke nu amra ahye. 20Yilasetɛse hale Kɔlente yɛɛ mengyakyile Tulofemɛse wɔ Maelitɛse, ɔluakɛ ɛnee ɔnde kpɔkɛ. 21Bɔ mɔdenle bɛla na fɔsɛlɛ ne ara.
Yubulɛse, Pudɛnse, Laenɛse, yɛɛ Kolɔdea nee mediema mɔɔ ɛha la amuala biza wɔ ahye.
22Awulae nee wɔ sunsum ɛdɛnla.
Nyamenle ɛlo bɛ muala.

Title: TAE MUKENYE
Content:
Mukenye
Taetɛse ɛnle Dwuunli. Yelie Kelaese yeli na yerayɛ ye ɛdoavolɛ. Nzinlii ɔrayɛle Kelaese ɛzonlenlɛ nu gyimayɛvolɛ mɔɔ nee Pɔɔlo kpɔsale yɛle Nyamenle gyima ne a. Mɔɔ ɔle kpavolɛ egyegyebaa la, Pɔɔlo nee ye hɔle Kiliti na ɔgyakyile ye ɛkɛ ne kɛ ɔnlea asɔne ne mɔɔ wɔ bɔra ne azo la azo. Pɔɔlo hɛlɛle kɛlata ɛhye hɔmanle ye wɔ ninyɛne titile nsa anwo.
Mɔɔ lumua, Pɔɔlo hakyele Taetɛse wɔ subane mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ asɔne mgbanyima ne mɔ nyia ye la anwo, ɔluakɛ subane ɛtane bie wɔ Kilitima dɔɔnwo anwo. Mɔɔ doa ye la le folɛdulɛ mɔɔ kile kɛ Taetɛse ɛzi ɛhilehile menli ekpunli ko biala mɔɔ wɔ asɔne ne anu la: mrenya mgbanyinli, mraalɛ mgbanyinli (mɔɔ bɛdabɛ noko ɔwɔ kɛ bɛkilehile mbɛlɛra ne mɔ la), mgbavolɛ ne mɔ, yɛɛ akee ahanra noko. Mɔɔ li awieleɛ la a le Taetɛse folɛdulɛ wɔ Kelaese ɛdoavolɛma nyɛleɛ nwo, bɔbɔ ɛhyianlɛ mɔɔ ɔhyia kɛ bɛkɛzukoa agɔnwolɛyɛlɛ na bɛkɛmaa anzonudwolɛ kɛra la. Ɔnle kɛ bɛdi butule, bɛkpo bɛ gɔnwo mɔ na bɛyɛ ngyehyɛnu wɔ asɔne ne anu.
Mɔɔ wɔ nu la
Ngilenu 1.1-4
Asɔne mgbanyima 1.5-16
Asɔne ne anu ekpunli ekpunli ne mɔ gyima 2.1-15
Folɛdulɛ nee kɔkɔbɔlɛ 3.1-11
Adwulaleɛ 3.12-15

Title: TAE 1
Content:
1Medame Pɔɔlo, mɔɔ mele Nyamenle sonvolɛ nee Gyisɛse Kelaese ɛzoanvolɛ la yɛɛ melɛkɛlɛ kɛlata ɛhye a.
Bɛyele me na bɛzoanle me kɛ mengɔmboa Nyamenle menli ne mɔɔ yekpa nu yeye bɛ la wɔ bɛ diedi nu, na mengilehile bɛ memaa bɛnwu nɔhalɛ ne mɔɔ wɔ yɛ nyamenlezonlenlɛ ne anu la. 2Yɛ nyamenlezonlenlɛ ne gyi anyelazo zo kɛ kenle bie yɛbanyia ngoane mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ la. Nyamenle, mɔɔ ɔmbɔ adalɛ ɛlɛ la, vale ngoane ɛhye bɔle yɛ ɛwɔkɛ kolaa na yeabɔ ewiade. 3Mekɛ ne dwule la ɔvale nrɛlaleɛ ne ɔdole gua, na ɛhye yɛɛ yɛ Ngoanedievolɛ Nyamenle ne, ɛva ɛwula me sa nu kɛ membɔ ye nolo a.
4 Melɛkɛlɛ wɔ, Taetɛse, mɔɔ ɛle me ra kpalɛ la wɔ diedi ne mɔɔ yɛlɛ nu la ati.
Egya Nyamenle nee Kelaese Gyisɛse, yɛ Ngoanedievolɛ ne ɛlo wɔ na ɔmaa wɔ anzonudwolɛ.
Taetɛse gyimalilɛ wɔ Kiliti
5Mengyakyile wɔ wɔ Kiliti kɛ ɛnlea ɛmaa debie biala mɔɔ tɔ sinli la ɛyɛ boɛ, na ɛye mgbanyima ɛmaa bɛnlea asɔne ne mɔ mɔɔ wɔ sua biala azo la azo, kɛmɔ mengilehilele wɔ la. 6 Ɔnle kɛ asɔne neavolɛ biala di ɛzonle; ɔwɔ kɛ ɔgya raalɛ ko ala; ɔwɔ kɛ ɔ mra nyia diedi yɛɛ ɔnle kɛ bɛdie duma kɛ bɛle wowawowa anzɛɛ anzosesebɛ. 7Ɔluakɛ, kɛmɔ asɔne neavolɛ ne gyi Nyamenle gyima ne ati la, ɔnle kɛ ɔ nwo nyia ngehanleɛ, ɔnle kɛ ɔmemaa ɔ nwo zo anzɛɛ ɔnyia ahonle kpole. Ɔnle kɛ ɔyɛ nzanli anzɛɛ ɔ sa yɛ kpokpo, ɔnle kɛ ɔ nye bolo ezukoa. 8Ɔwɔ kɛ awie biala kola wolo ye na ɔkulo kpalɛyɛlɛ, ɔwɔ kɛ ɔkola ɔsɔ ɔ nwo, ɔyɛ sonla mɔɔ ye subane le kpalɛ, ɔ nwo te na ɔdi ɔ nwo eni. 9Ɔwɔ kɛ ɔsɔ Nyamenle edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ bɛkola bɛfa bɛ rɛle bɛto zo na eza ɔ nee yɛ ngilehilelɛ ne kɔ zolɛ la anu kyengye. Adenle ɛhye azo yɛɛ ɔbamaa yeahola yeamaa menli anwosesebɛ na yeahilehile bɛ na eza yeamaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛtia ngilehilelɛ ne la anwu bɛ nvonleɛ a.
10Menli mɔɔ anzo yɛ se la dɔɔnwo wɔ ɛkɛ mɔɔ ko tia ngilehilelɛ ɛhye a. Bɛ nuhua titile a le bɛdabɛ mɔɔ ɛnee bɛli Dwuuma nyamenlezonlenlɛ ne anzi na bɛhakyi bɛrayɛ Kelaese ɛdoavolɛma la. Bɛka mgbole na bɛbɛlɛbɛla awie mɔ. 11Ɔwɔ kɛ ɛtua bɛ, ɔboalekɛ ɔlua ezukoakpondɛlɛ ti bɛlɛkilehile mɔɔ ɔnle kɛ bɛkilehile la, na bɛlɛsɛkye mbusua dɔɔnwo bɛabɔ bɛ awuke. 12Kilitinli bie mɔɔ bɛdabɛ bɛse ɔle bɛ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ la ɛha kɛ, “Kilitima dahuu bɔ adalɛ, bɛle nane amumuyɛ, bɛle mgbovonle adidikpokuma.” 13Na mɔɔ ɔhanle la le nɔhalɛ. Ɔlua ɛhye ati ɔwɔ kɛ ɛtwi bɛ nyunlu kpalɛ, amaa bɛanyia diedi mɔɔ yɛ nla la, 14na bɛandoa Dwuuma amaamuo dɛba ne nee bɛ mɛla ne mɔ mɔɔ vi menli mɔɔ ɛkpo nɔhalɛ ne la ɛkɛ ne la abo zo. 15Debie biala anwo te maa menli mɔɔ anwo te la, na ɛtanevolɛma nee menli mɔɔ ɛnlɛ diedi la, debie biala anwo ɛnde, ɔboalekɛ bɛ adwenle nee bɛ ti anu kɛkɛba ne ɛkpɔlɔ. 16Bɛdabɛ bɛse bɛze Nyamenle, noko bɛ nyɛleɛ ɛngile zɔhane. Ɛkpɔlɛ nee anzosesebɛ ɛyi bɛ tɛkɛɛ, yɛɛ bɛnze debie kpalɛ biala yɛ.

Title: TAE 2
Content:
Diedi nee ngilehilelɛ saanwu
1Na wɔmɔ, ɔwɔ kɛ ɛkilehile diedi ne mɔɔ le saanwu la. 2Kilehile mrenya mgbanyinli ne mɔ maa bɛyɛ bɛ nye gyɛlɛmgbɛɛnye, bɛdwenle, bɛzie bɛ nwo diinyi, bɛmaa bɛ diedi ɛyɛ nla, na bɛnyia ɛhulolɛ nee abotane. 3Zɔhane ala noko yɛɛ maa mraalɛ mgbanyinli ne mɔ ɛnwu ye na bɛbɔ ɛbɛla mɔɔ kile kɛ bɛze Nyamenle la a. Bɛmmayɛ ngunzi anzɛɛ bɛmmayɛ bɛ nwo akɛlɛ bɛmaa nza. Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛkilehile mɔɔ le kpalɛ la, 4amaa bɛahola bɛatete mbɛlɛra ne mɔ bɛamaa bɛahulo bɛ hu mɔ nee bɛ mra. 5amaa bɛanwu nrɛlɛbɛ, bɛazie bɛ nwo diinyi, bɛayɛ atiakunlukɛnlɛma, bɛ nwo ade saanwu, na bɛayɛ yelɛma kpalɛ mɔɔ tie bɛ hu mɔ ane a, amaa awie anga Nyamenle edwɛkɛ ne anwo edwɛkɛ ɛtane.
6Zɔhane ala yɛɛ ka kile mgbavolɛ ne mɔ maa bɛzɔ bɛ nwo a. 7Wɔ ninyɛne muala anu, ɛdawɔ mumua ne pɛ kelemunli kpalɛ wɔ gyima kpalɛ ɛyɛlɛ nu to ɛkɛ. Maa ɛ nye ɛbolo wɔ ngilehilelɛ ne anwo na di nɔhalɛ. 8Fa ɛdendɛlɛ kpalɛ mɔɔ menli ɛnrɛha nwolɛ edwɛkɛ la kilehile, amaa wɔ agbɔvolɛ asa aha bɛ gye nu, na bɛannyia edwɛkɛ ɛtane bɛanga wɔ yɛ nwo.
9Kilehile bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛle ahanra la maa bɛdie bɛ menle mɔ edwɛkɛ na bɛmaa bɛ menle mɔ akunlu ɛdwo bɛ nwo wɔ ninyɛne muala anu. Saa bɛ menle mɔ tendɛ bɛ nyunlu a, bɛmmayeye bɛ nloa azo. 10Bɛmmayɛ awule ndɛbandɛba biala.
