Ɔwɔ kɛ dahuu bɛkile kɛ bɛle kpalɛ, bɛdi nɔhalɛ, amaa ngilehilelɛ ne mɔɔ fane Nyamenle yɛ Ngoanedievolɛ ne anwo la ayɛ nvasoɛ wɔ debie biala mɔɔ bɛyɛ la anu.
11Ɔluakɛ Nyamenle ɛye ye ɛlolɛ ne ɛhile wɔ menli kɔsɔɔti bɛ ngoanelielɛ ti. 12Zɔhane ɛlolɛ ne kilehile yɛ kɛ yɛvuandi ɛbɛla mgbane mgbane nee ewiade atiakunluwɔzo ne mɔ yɛgua, na yɛyɛ yɛ nye gyɛlɛmgbɛɛnye, yɛnlea boɛ na yɛbɔ Nyamenlezulolɛ ɛbɛla fɔɔnwo ne wɔ ewiade ye anu, 13yɛva yɛhendɛ saleɛ Kenle ne mɔɔ yɛ nye la ye adenle wɔ melɛ mɔɔ yɛ Nyamenle bedevinli ne nee Ngoanedievolɛ Gyisɛse Kelaese bɛ anyunlunyia ne kɛra la. 14 Gyisɛse Kelaese vale ɔ nwo manle wɔ yɛ ti kɛ ɔbaye yɛ yeavi amumuyɛ muala anu, na yeayɛ yɛ ye menli mɔɔ anwo te na yɛle ɔ ngomekye ye ɛdeɛ la, amaa yɛ nye abolo kɛ yɛkɛyɛ kpalɛ.
15Kilehile ɛhye mɔ amuala na fa wɔ tumi ne kpokpoti wula wɔ ngilehilelɛ nee bɛ nyunlu ɛhwilɛ nu. Mmamaa awie biala fa ɛ nyunlu kyikyi aze.

Title: TAE 3
Content:
Kelaese ɛdoavolɛ ɛbɛlabɔlɛ
1Kakye wɔ menli ne kɛ bɛha bɛ nwo aze bɛmaa arelemgbunli nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ tumi wɔ bɛ sa nu la, bɛdie bɛ edwɛkɛ na bɛbɔ ɛbɛla kpalɛ wɔ adenle biala anu. 2Ka kile bɛ kɛ bɛmmaka awie anwo edwɛkɛ ɛtane anzɛɛ bɛmmadi butule, na bɛva anzonudwolɛ nee agɔnwolɛyɛlɛ bɛdɛnla na bɛli awie biala eni. 3Ɔluakɛ ɛnee anrɛɛ yɛdayɛ noko yɛle ahɔnwɔne, tufoande, yɛɛ yɛminlinle. Yɛyɛle ngɛkɛlɛ yɛmanle nwonane nu atiakunluwɔzo nee anyelielɛ ngakyile kɔsɔɔti; yɛbɔle yɛ ɛbɛla ne atiakunlutane nee anyebolo nu; menli kpɔle yɛ yɛɛ yɛdayɛ noko yɛkpɔle yɛ nwo ngoko ngoko. 4Na mɔɔ yɛ Ngoanelielɛ Nyamenle ne lale ye atiakunlukɛnlɛma nee ye ɛhulolɛ ne ali la, 5ɔliele yɛ ngoane. Tɛ gyima kpalɛ mɔɔ yɛyɛle la ati ɔ, na ɔse anwunvɔne la ati ɔ. Ɔluale nzule awolɛ fofolɛ ne, mɔɔ le ɛbɛlabɔlɛ fofolɛ ne mɔɔ Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne fa maa la azo a ɔwole yɛ bieko a. 6Ɔluakɛ Nyamenle luale yɛ Ngoanedievolɛ Gyisɛse Kelaese anwo zo wolale Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne guale yɛ nwo zo, 7amaa ɔlua ye ɛlolɛ zo yɛazɔ Nyamenle anye na yɛanyia ngoane ne mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ mɔɔ yɛ nye la zolɛ la. 8Edwɛkɛ ɛhye le nɔhalɛ.
Mekulo kɛ ɛka edwɛkɛ ɛhye mɔ na ɛsi zo ɛsesebɛ, amaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdie Nyamenle bɛdi la anlea zolɛ abɔ ɛbɛla kpalɛ dahuu. Ɔluakɛ ɛhye mɔ le kpalɛ na eza ɔhyia ɔmaa sonla biala. 9Tua ɛhye mɔ: kpolerazulɛ mɔɔ nrɛlɛbɛ ɛnle nu, yɛ nlenya mɔ aluma ngilehilenu, butulelilɛ nee mɛla nwo kpolerazulɛ. Ɛhye mɔ anwo ɛnlɛ nvasoɛ yɛɛ eza bɛle debie mgbane. 10Sonla mɔɔ fa mgbakyemgbakye ara la, bɔ ye kɔkɔ fane kɛyɛ nwiɔ, na gyakyi ye maa ɔva ɔ nwo. 11Ɛkola ɛnwu ye kɛ sonla zɛhae ɛzɛkye, na ye ɛtane ne bua ye fɔlɛ.
Ngilehilelɛ mɔɔ li awieleɛ
12Saa mesoa Aatɛmase anzɛɛ Tekekɛse wɔ ɛ nwo lɔ a, bɔ mɔdenle kɛ ɛkɛra me nwo wɔ Nekɔpɔlese, ɔboalekɛ meyɛ me adwenle kɛ ɛkɛ ne a mekali fɔsɛlɛ ne a. 13Bɔ mɔdenle kɛ ɛkɛmaa Zinase mɔɔ le lɔyanli ne nee Apolɔso kɛbɔ bɛ adendulɛ ne abo, na nea kɛ bɛnyia debie biala mɔɔ bɛhyia nwolɛ la. 14Maa yɛ menli ne mɔ ɛzukoa ɛyɛ gyima kpalɛ, amaa saa edwɛkɛ bie mɔɔ hyia la si a bɛahola bɛaboa. Ɔnle kɛ bɛbɔ ɛbɛla mɔɔ nvasoɛ biala ɛnle zolɛ la.
15Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ nee me wɔ ɛke la amuala biza wɔ ahye. Yɛbiza yɛ gɔnwo mɔ mɔɔ yɛ muala yɛlɛ diedi ko la ahye.
Nyamenle ɛlo bɛ na ɔ nee bɛ ɛdɛnla.

Title: FAE MUKENYE
Content:
Mukenye
Faelimɔn le Kelaese ɛdoavolɛ mɔɔ ɛnee di munli kpalɛ a, na ɔkɛyɛ kɛ ɔle asɔne ne mɔɔ wɔ Kɔlɔsae la anu amra ne mɔ ko. Ɔdaye a ɔlɛ kanranli ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Onɛsemɛse la. Kanranli ɛhye nriandile ɔ menle, na ɔhɔle dedee la ɔrawiele Pɔɔlo asa azo. Mekɛ ne anu ɛnee Pɔɔlo la efiade. Nzinlii ɔlua Pɔɔlo anwo zo, Onɛsemɛse rayɛle Kelaese ɛdoavolɛ. Pɔɔlo hɛlɛle kɛlata ɛhye hɔmanle Faelimɔn na ɔkpale ye kyɛlɛ kɛ ɔlɛsiane ye yeamaa yeara, na ɔlie ye kɛ kanranli mɔɔ bɛva ye ɛtane bɛhyɛ ye na eza ɔle adiema Kelaese ɛdoavolɛ la.
Mɔɔ wɔ nu la
Ngilenu 1-3
Faelimɔn ɛyeyɛlɛ 4-7
Onɛsemɛse ati kyɛlɛkpalɛ 8-22
Adwulaleɛ 23-25

Title: FAE 1
Content:
1Kɛlata ɛhye vi medame Pɔɔlo, mɔɔ ɔlua Kelaese Gyisɛse ati mela efiade nee adiema Temɔte ɛkɛ.
Ɔdwu yɛ gɔnwo Faelimɔn, mɔɔ le yɛ diema gyimayɛvolɛ wɔ Nyamenle ɛzonlenlɛ ye anu la ɛkɛ; 2 ɔdwu asɔnema mɔɔ yia wɔ sua nu ɛkɛ ne, yɛɛ adiema raalɛ Afea nee Aakepɛse mɔɔ le yɛ gɔnwo sogyanli ne la ɛkɛ:
3Egya Nyamenle nee yɛ Awulae Gyisɛse Kelaese ɛlo bɛ na ɔmaa bɛ anzonudwolɛ.
Faelimɔn ɛhulolɛ nee ye diedi
4Adiema Faelimɔn, mekɛ biala mesɛlɛ a, mebɔ wɔ duma na meyɛ Nyamenle mo. 5Ɔluakɛ mete wɔ ɛhulolɛ mɔɔ ɛlɛ ye wɔ Nyamenle menli ne anwo nee diedi mɔɔ ɛlɛ ye wɔ Awulae Gyisɛse anu la nganeɛ. 6Me nzɛlɛlɛ a le kɛ, wɔ diedi nu mediemayɛlɛ ne kɛva ndelebɛbo mɔɔ nuhua pi wɔ debie kpalɛ biala mɔɔ Kelaese ati ɔle yɛ ɛdeɛ la kɛra. 7Adiema kulovolɛ, medi fɛlɛko kpole wɔ wɔ ɛhulolɛ mɔɔ ɛlɛ ye la anwo, na yemaa me akɛnrazilɛ! Wɔmaa Nyamenle menli muala anye ɛlie.
Onɛsemɛse ati kyɛlɛkpalɛ
8Ɔlua ɛhye ati kɛmɔ Kelaese ati ɛle adiema la anrɛɛ mekola mese wɔ memaa ɛyɛ debie mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ ɛyɛ la, 9na ɛ nwo ɛhulolɛ ti, mebazɛlɛ wɔ. Mame a mele Pɔɔlo mɔɔ megyi Kelaese Gyisɛse agyakɛ anu, na kɛkala ɔlua ɔ ti mela efiade la, noko akee mebiza ɛhye. 10 Mesɛlɛ wɔ meamaa me ra Onɛsemɛse. Ɔlua Kelaese ati, Onɛsemɛse ɛrayɛ me ra wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ mela efiade ye ala la. 11Mekɛ bie mɔɔ ɛraze ɛhɔ la ɛnee ɔ nwo ɛnlɛ nvasoɛ ɛmmaa wɔ; na kɛkala, ɔ nwo lɛ nvasoɛ maa wɔ nee medame.
12Melɛsiane ye meamaa yeara ɛ nwo lɔ bieko, na fa ye kɛ medame ɔ. 13Anrɛɛ menwɔhulo kɛ ɔkɛdɛnla me nwo ɛke, na yeagyinla ɛ gyakɛ anu yeaboa me wɔ Edwɛkpa ne ɛkpondenlɛ nu, kɛmɔ mela efiade la. 14Noko menrɛhulo kɛ menwɔyɛ debie mɔɔ ɛnze nu la wɔ ɛhye anwo, amaa yeanyɛ kɛ asɛɛ wɔ moalɛ ne ɛyɛ mialeranu debie; mekulo kɛ ɛdawɔ ɛfa wɔ ɛhulolɛ ɛyɛ.
15Ɔkɛyɛ kɛ ɛhye ati a Onɛsemɛse vile ɛ nwo ɛkɛ ne mekɛ ekyi a, amaa saa ɔsia ɔba a yeaha ɛkɛ bɔkɔɔ, 16tɛ kɛ ɔle wɔ kanranli angome ɔ, na kɛ Kelaese ati ɔle adiema kulovolɛ mɔɔ anwo hyia me kpole a. Na wɔ wɔ afoa nu, kɛmɔ ɔle kanranli nee adiema wɔ Kelaese ati la, wɔ ɛhulolɛ ɛdeɛ ne bo zolɛ.
17Yemɔti saa ɛdie ɛto nu kɛ ɛ nee me a lua ɛdeɛ a, ɛnee die ye kɛ ɛkɛlie me ala la. 18Saa yeyɛ ɛtane yetia wɔ anzɛɛ ɔtua wɔ kakɛ a, nea me ti na fa kyɛ ye. 19Medame Pɔɔlo, me sa anloa a melɛ melɛkɛlɛ ɛhye a. MEDAME PƆƆLO, MEBADUA KAKƐ NE MEAMAA WƆ. Mengulo kɛ mekakye wɔ kɛ ɛdawɔ mumua ne ɛwɔ me sa nu. 20Yemɔti, me diema, ɔlua Awulae ati, gyakyi ɛhye anu maa me, kɛmɔ Kelaese ati ɛle me diema la, na maa me nye ɛlie.
21Melɛkɛlɛ kɛlata ɛhye, ɔluakɛ medie medi kɛ ɛkɛyɛ mɔɔ melɛbiza la. Nɔhalɛ, meze kɛ ɛkola ɛyɛ ɛmaa ɔbo zolɛ. 22Eza kpondɛ dabelɛ sie me, ɔboalekɛ melɛ anyelazo kɛ Nyamenle badie bɛ muala bɛ nzɛlɛlɛ amaa meazia me nee bɛ aradɛnla.
Ahyebizalɛ
23 Ɛpafelase mɔɔ nee me yɛla efiade ɛke wɔ Kelaese Gyisɛse ati la biza wɔ ahye. 24 Zɔhane ala yɛɛ me gɔnwo mɔ gyimayɛvoma Maake, Alesetaakɛse, Dimase, yɛɛ Luku bɛdabɛ bɛbiza wɔ ahye a.
25Awulae Gyisɛse Kelaese ɛlo wɔ na ɔ nee wɔ ɛdɛnla.

Title: HIB MUKENYE
Content:
Mukenye
Kɛlata ne mɔɔ bɛhɛlɛle bɛhɔmanle Hibuluma la, bɛhɛlɛle bɛhɔmanle Kelaese ɛdoavolɛma ekpunli bie mɔɔ ɛnee ɛyia ngyegyelɛ kpole bie, na ɔrale kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛgyakyi Kelaese ɛzonlenlɛ ne anzi ɛlilɛ la. Ahenle mɔɔ hɛlɛle kɛlata ne la manle bɛ akɛnrazilɛ wɔ bɛ diedi ne anu, na ɔhilele nu ɔmanle bɛ kɛ Gyisɛse Kelaese a le Nyamenle nɔhalɛ sɔhovolɛ mɔɔ bɛye bɛhile a. Wɔ ɛhye ɛyɛlɛ nu ahenle mɔɔ hɛlɛle kɛlata ne la zile nɔhalɛ edwɛkɛ agbɔkɛ nsa dawua: (1) Gyisɛse a le Nyamenle Ara ne mɔɔ vi tete mɔɔ luale ye amaneɛnwunlɛ zo hanle ɔ nwo aze nɔhalɛ nu manle Selɛ ne la. Ɔkile kɛ Gyisɛse le Nyamenle Ara, na ɔle kpole ɔtɛla Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma mɔɔ wɔ Ngyekyeleɛ Dɛba ne anu la, Nyamenle soanvolɛma, yɛɛ Mosisi bɔbɔ. (2) Nyamenle ɛha ɛdo ɛkɛ ne kɛ Gyisɛse le sɛlɛvolɛ dahuu mɔɔ tɛla sɛlɛvolɛma mɔɔ wɔ Ngyekyeleɛ Dɛba ne anu la. (3) Ɔlua Gyisɛse anwo zo, bɛdie mɔɔ lɛ diedi la bɛfi ɛtane nee ɛzulolɛ nee ewule nu; yɛɛ Gyisɛse, kɛmɔ ɔle Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli la, ɔmaa nɔhalɛ ngoanelielɛ ne, mɔɔ Hibuluma nyamenlezonlenlɛ nu nyɛleɛ nee nane azubɔlɛ ne kile la.
Kɛlɛvolɛ ne vale menli mgbole mɔɔ ɛze ɛhɔ wɔ Yizilayɛ tetedwɛkɛ nu la bie mɔ yɛle ndonwo wɔ bɛ diedi nwo (nea mgbakyelɛ 11); na ɔzɛlɛle ye kengavolɛma kɛ bɛhɔ zolɛ bɛzɔ diedi ne anu. Mgbakyelɛ 12 ne anu noko ɔzile bɛ ahonle kɛ bɛzɔ diedi ne anu bɛhɔ awieleɛ, bɛva bɛ nye bɛdo Kelaese anwo zo, na bɛgyinla kpundii wɔ ngyegyelɛ nee amaneɛnwunlɛ biala mɔɔ kɛra bɛ nwo zo la anu. Buluku ne awieleɛ le folɛdulɛ na eza ɔbɔ kɔkɔ.
Mɔɔ wɔ nu la
Kelaese le Nyamenle sɔhovolɛ 1.1-3
Kelaese bo Nyamenle soanvolɛma anwo zo 1.4—2.18
Kelaese bo Mosisi nee Dwɔhyua anwo zo 3.1—4.13
Kelaese le Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpole 4.14—7.28
Kelaese Ngyekyeleɛ ne bo ngyekyeleɛ biala azo 8.1—9.28
Kelaese azubɔlɛ ne le bedevinli 10.1-39
Diedi hyia kpalɛ 11.1—12.29
Folɛdulɛ nee adwulaleɛ 13.1-25

Title: HIB 1
Content:
Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne lua ɔ Ra ne anwo zo
1Mɔmoane ne, Nyamenle vale ndenle dɔɔnwo azo luale ye kpɔmanvolɛma anwo zo dendɛle hilele yɛ nlenya mɔ wɔ mekɛ dɔɔnwo ne ala, 2na kenle nsa ye ɛdeɛ, yelua ɔ Ra ne anwo zo a yedendɛ yehile yɛ a. Ɔ Ra ne anwo zo a ɔluale ɔbɔle ewiade a, na yemɔ yɛɛ Nyamenle ɛkpa nu ɛye ye kɛ awieleɛ ne debie biala le ye ɛdeɛ a. 3Gyisɛse kile kɛ Nyamenle anyunlunyia ne wienyi kpole si de la. Ɔle Nyamenle ɛsaso bɔkɔɔ, yɛɛ ɔfa ye tumi edwɛkɛ ne a ɔsɔ ewiade a. Ɔliele ɛtanefakyɛ ɔmanle sonla na ɔwiele la, ɔhɔle anwuma ɔhɔdɛnlanle Tumivolɛ Nyamenle Bedevinli ne asa fema zo.
Nyamenle Ara ne le kpole
4Nyamenle manle Ralɛ ne yɛle kpole dɛlale Nyamenle soanvolɛma amuala, yɛɛ duma mɔɔ ɔvale ɔmanle ye la tɛla bɛ ɛdeɛ ne amuala. 5 Ɔluakɛ Nyamenle anga angile ye soanvolɛma ne mɔ bie kɛ,
“Ɛle Me Ra;
ɛnɛ a mewo wɔ a.”
Nyamenle anga wɔ ye soanvolɛma ne bie anwo kɛ,
“Mebayɛ ɛ Ze,
na wɔayɛ me Ra.”
6 Noko mɔɔ Nyamenle bazoa ye belamunli Ralɛ ne wɔ ewiade la, ɔhanle kɛ,
“Ɔwɔ kɛ Nyamenle soanvolɛma amuala sonle ye.”
7 Wɔ ye soanvolɛma ne anwo, Nyamenle hanle kɛ,
“Nyamenle yɛ ye soanvolɛma kɛ anwoma,
na ɔyɛ ye sonvolɛma kɛ senle tafinlima.”
8 Wɔ Ralɛ ne anwo, Nyamenle hanle kɛ,
“O Nyamenle, wɔ belemgbunlililɛ ɛnrɛbɔ aze ɛlɛ!
Ɛfa nɔhalɛlilɛ a ɛsie wɔ menli mɔɔ ɛnea bɛ nwo zo la a.
9Ɛkulo mɔɔ le fɔɔnwo la na ɛkyi mɔɔ ɛnli mɛla zo la.
Ɛhye ati yɛɛ Nyamenle, wɔ Nyamenle ne,
ɛkpa nu ɛye wɔ na yemaa wɔ nidi nu anyelielɛ kpole
mɔɔ tɛla mɔɔ yeva yemaa ɛ gɔnwo mɔ amuala la a.”
10 Eza ɔhanle kɛ,
“Awulae, wɔmɔ yɛɛ mɔlebɛbo ne ɛbɔle ewiade a,
yɛɛ ɛ sa anloa gyima a le anwumaneamra.
11Bɛ muala bɛbaminli, ɛnee wɔmɔ ɛwɔ ɛkɛ;
bɛ muala bɛbatete kɛ ɛdanlɛ.
12Ɛbanyenya bɛ kɛ ɛkpa,
na wɔali bɛ kedayegua kɛ ɛdanlɛ.
Na wɔmɔ dahuu kɛ ɛde ala la yɛɛ ɛde a,
yɛɛ wɔ ngoane ɛnlɛ awieleɛ.”
13 Nyamenle anga angile ye soanvolɛma ne mɔ bie kɛ,
“Tɛnla me sa fema zo ɛke
kɔkpula kɛ menwɔva wɔ agbɔvolɛ menwɔwula
ɛ gyakɛ abo.”
14Ɛnee Nyamenle soanvolɛma a le nwane mɔ? Bɛmɛ a le sunsum bie mɔ mɔɔ sonle Nyamenle na ɔsoɔzoa bɛ ɔmaa bɛkɔboa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛnyia ngoane la.

Title: HIB 2
Content:
Ngoanelielɛ kpole ne
1Zɔhane ati ɔwɔ kɛ yɛsɔ nɔhalɛ edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ yɛde la anu ɛsesebɛ, amaa yɛamminli. 2Edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ Nyamenle soanvolɛma vale rɛlɛle yɛ nlenya mɔ la ɛrayɛ nɔhalɛ, yemɔti mɔɔ anli zo la banyia nwolɛ ndeanlɛ mɔɔ ɔfɛta la. 3Na saa yɛanzɔ ngoanelielɛ kpole mɔɔ le zɛhae la anu a, ɛnee kɛ ɔkɛyɛ na yɛavi ɛsalɛ ɛ? Awulae mumua ne lumuale bɔle ngoanelielɛ ɛhye anwo nolo, yɛɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdiele ye la ɛhile ɛmaa yɛnwu kɛ ɔle nɔhalɛ. 4Mekɛ ko ne ala Nyamenle ɔdaye ɔlile daselɛ ɔvoale bɛ ɛdeɛ ne azo, na ɔvale Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza nu ahyɛlɛdeɛ ɔmanle bɛ, ɔmanle bɛyɛle nwanwane ninyɛne, kɛmɔ ye ɛhulolɛdeɛ ne de la.
Sonla mɔɔ die yɛ kɔ ngoane nu la
5Nyamenle ɛtɛfale ye soanvolɛma kɛ bɛzie ewiade fofolɛ ne mɔɔ yɛka nwolɛ edwɛkɛ kɛ ɔbara la. 6 Bɛha ye wɔ Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne anu ɛleka bie kɛ,
“Sonla le duzu,
mɔɔ ɛdwenle ɔ nwo zɛhae a?
Anzɛɛ sonla ra mɔɔ ɛ nye wɔ ɔ nwo zo zɛhae a?
7Ɛbɔle ye ɛmanle wɔ soanvolɛma dɛlale ye mekɛ ekyi bie ala anu,
ɛwulale ye anyunlunyia na ɛmanle bɛlile ye eni,
8na ɛvale ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti ɛwulale ɔ bo.”
Saa ɔvale “ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti ɔwulale ɔ bo” a, ɛnee ɔkile kɛ debie biala boka nwolɛ. Noko mɔɔ kɛkala yɛnwu ye la a le kɛ sonla ɛnzie ninyɛne muala. 9Na yɛnwu Gyisɛse mɔɔ mekɛ ekyi bie anu ɔdaye noko bɛyɛle ye ekyi bɛdɛlale Nyamenle soanvolɛma la, kɛ bɛwula ye anyunlunyia na bɛdi ye eni wɔ nyane ewule mɔɔ ɔwule la ati. Nyamenle luale ɔdaye ye ɛlolɛ zo yɛɛ ɔmanle ɔwule wɔ awie biala ati a. 10Ɔle kpalɛ kɛ Nyamenle, mɔɔ ɔdaye yɛɛ ɔbɔle ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti na bɛle ye ɛdeɛ la, kɛmaa Gyisɛse kɛnwu amaneɛ kolaa na yeali munli, amaa yeahola yeava mralɛ somaa yeahɔ Nyamenle anyunlunyia ne anu.
11Ɔte menli nwo ɔfi bɛ ɛtane nwo na ɔ nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ yede bɛ nwo la nyia Selɛ ko. Ɛhye ati Gyisɛse ɛnze nyiane kɛ ɔkɛvɛlɛ bɛ ɔ mediema. 12 Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se,
“Mebabɔ wɔ duma meahile me mediema ne mɔ;
mebado edwɛne meaye wɔ ayɛlɛ mekɛ biala mɔɔ yɛkɛyia la.”
13 Eza ɔse, “Mebava me rɛle meawula Nyamenle anu.” Eza ɔhanle ye bieko kɛ, “Me nee ngakula mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛva bɛ ɛmaa me la ɛra.”
14Zɔhane ati kɛmɔ ngakula ne mɔ le nwonane nee mogya la, Gyisɛse ɔdaye ɔyɛle ɔ nwo kɛ bɛdabɛ la na ɔnyianle bɛ nwonane ne bie, amaa yealua ye ewule zo yeazɛkye Abɔnsam, mɔɔ ɛnee lɛ tumi wɔ ewule nwo zo la, 15na yealie bɛdabɛ mɔɔ ɔlua kɛ bɛsulo ewule la ati bɛyɛle ahanra wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛde ngoane nu la. 16Ɔluakɛ ɔla ɛkɛ wienyi kɛ tɛ Nyamenle soanvolɛma yɛɛ ɔrale bɛ ɛboalɛ a na ɔrale ɔbaboa Ebileham abo zo amra. 17Ɛhye kile kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ ɔyɛ kɛ ɔ mediema ne mɔ la wɔ adenle biala anu, amaa yeayɛ bɛ Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli mɔɔ di nɔhalɛ na ɔse anwunvɔne wɔ ye Nyamenle gyimayɛlɛ nu, na yeali bɛ ti mgbɔdalɛ, amaa bɛava menli ɛtane bɛahyɛ bɛ. 18Kɛkala ɔkola ɔboa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ sɔnea nu la, ɔboalekɛ bɛzɔ ɔdaye bɛnlea ɛlɛ, yɛɛ yenwu amaneɛ ɛlɛ.

Title: HIB 3
Content:
Gyisɛse le kpole tɛla Mosisi
1Me mediema Keleseɛnema, mɔɔ bɛdabɛ noko Nyamenle ɛvɛlɛ bɛ a! Bɛdwenle Gyisɛse, mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛzoa ye kɛ ɔrayɛ Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli wɔ diedi ye mɔɔ yɛlɛ nu la anwo. 2 Ɔlile nɔhalɛ ɔmanle Nyamenle mɔɔ zoanle ye la, kɛmɔ Mosisi lile nɔhalɛ wɔ ye gyimayɛlɛ nu wɔ Nyamenle sua nu la. 3Sonla mɔɔ si sua la lɛ ɔ nyunlu tɛla sua ne mɔɔ ɔkɛzi la. Zɔhane ala yɛɛ Gyisɛse lɛ ɔ nyunlu tɛla Mosisi a. 4Sonla ala a si sua a, yɛɛ Nyamenle noko a ɛyɛ ninyɛne muala a. 5Mosisi lile nɔhalɛ kɛ ɔle akɛlɛ wɔ Nyamenle sua nu, na ɔlile ninyɛne mɔɔ Nyamenle baha nwolɛ bie wɔ kenle bie la anwo daselɛ. 6Na Kelaese ɛdeɛ ɔlile nɔhalɛ kɛ ɔle Ralɛ mɔɔ nea Nyamenle sua nu ɛkɛ a. Saa yɛgyinla akɛnrasesebɛ zo na yɛsi pi wɔ anyelazo nu a, yɛkɛnwu kɛ yɛle ye sua.
Nyamenle menli ne ɛnwomenlelielɛ
7 Yemɔti, kɛ Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne se la ɛne,
“Saa ɛnɛ bɛte Nyamenle ane a,
8bɛmmayɛ anzosesebɛ, kɛmɔ bɛ nlenya mɔ yɛle
na bɛdele Nyamenle anwo atua,
na mekɛ ne anu bɛzɔle ye bɛnleanle wɔ ɛsɛlɛ ne azo la.
9Bɛ nlenya mɔ nwunle gyima kpalɛ
mɔɔ menlile memanle bɛ ɛvolɛ abulanla anu la,
noko bɛgyegyele me na bɛzɔle me bɛnleanle.
10Ɛhye ati menvale menli zɔhane mɔ
anwo ɛya na menganle kɛ,
‘Bɛle menli mɔɔ bɛsolo na bɛkpo kɛ
bɛnrɛli me mɛla zo a.’
11Menvale ɛya na menganle ndane kɛ,
‘Bɛ gyakɛ ba ɛnrɛtia ɛleka mɔɔ meyɛ kɛ
memaa bɛaralie bɛ ɛnwomenle la!’ ”
12Me mediema diedima, bɛnlea boɛ na bɛ bie mɔ ansolo, na bɛande bɛ nwo bɛanvi tease Nyamenle ne anwo. 13Zɔhane ati, amaa ɛtane ambɛlɛbɛla bɛ biala na yeakpunli ye ahonle la, bɛboa bɛ nwo ngoko alehyenlɛ biala, kɛmɔ “Ɛnɛ” gyi ɛkɛ ne maa yɛ alehyenlɛ biala mɔɔ kɛhye yɛ nyunlu la. 14Ɔluakɛ alumua diedi ne mɔɔ yɛnyianle la, saa yɛsɔ nu ɛsesebɛ yɛkɔ awieleɛ a yɛɛ yɛ nee Kelaese kɛli agya a.
15 Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se,
“Saa ɛnɛ bɛte Nyamenle ane a,
bɛmmayɛ anzosesebɛ, kɛmɔ bɛ nlenya mɔ yɛle
na bɛdele Nyamenle anwo atua la.”
16 Nwane mɔ a dele Nyamenle ane noko bɛdele atua la? Bɛdabɛ kɔsɔɔti mɔɔ Mosisi hɔyele bɛ vile Yigyibiti la ɔ. 17Nwane mɔ a Nyamenle vale bɛ nwo ɛya ɛvolɛ abulanla la? Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛyɛle ɛtane na bɛdɔle amolɛ nu wɔ ɛsɛlɛ ne azo la ɔ. 18Mɔɔ Nyamenle ka ye ndane ne kɛ, “Bɛ gyakɛ ba ɛnrɛtia ɛleka mɔɔ meyɛ kɛ memaa bɛaralie bɛ ɛnwomenle la” ɛnee ɔ nee nwane mɔ? Ɔ nee menli mɔɔ dele atua la. 19Ɛhye maa yɛnwu kɛ bɛandwu ɛleka ne, ɔboalekɛ bɛanlie bɛanli.

Title: HIB 4
Content:
1Kɛkala mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛwɔkɛ ne mɔɔ fane ɛnwomenlelielɛ nwo la tɛbɔ ɛkɛ ne la, bɛmaa yɛnlea boɛ na bɛanze yɛ bie mɔ kɛ bɛdɔ sinli na bɛnrɛdwu ɛnwomenlelielɛ ɛleka ne. 2Ɔluakɛ yɛdayɛ noko yɛde Edwɛkpa ne, kɛmɔ bɛdele la. Bɛdele edwɛkɛ ne, na kɛmɔ bɛanlie bɛanli la ati, yeanyɛ nvasoɛ yeammaa bɛ. 3 Ɛhye ati yɛdayɛ mɔɔ yɛdie yɛdi la angome a banyia ɛnwomenlelielɛ ne mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛva ɛbɔ ɛwɔkɛ la a. Ɔle kɛmɔ ɔhanle la. Ɔse,
“Menvale ɛya na menganle ndane kɛ,
‘Bɛ gyakɛ ba ɛnrɛtia ɛleka mɔɔ meyɛ kɛ
memaa bɛaralie bɛ ɛnwomenle la.’ ”
Ɔhanle ɛhye, noko ɛnee yewie ye gyima yɛ dɛba, ɔvi ewiade mɔlebɛbo ne amuala. 4 Wɔ Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne anu, bɛka ɛhye wɔ kenle ne mɔɔ tɔ zo nsuu la anwo kɛ, “Nyamenle liele ye ɛnwomenle wɔ ye gyima nwo wɔ kenle ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nsuu la azo.” 5 Edwɛkɛ ɛhye ala noko a bɛha nwolɛ bie bieko kɛ, “Bɛ gyakɛ ba ɛnrɛtia ɛleka mɔɔ meyɛ kɛ memaa bɛaralie bɛ ɛnwomenle la.” 6Kɛmɔ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛlumuale bɛdele Edwɛkpa ne la bie mɔ yɛle anzosesebɛ la, bɛannyia Nyamenle ɛnwomenlelielɛ ne, ɔboalekɛ bɛanlie bɛanli. Ɛhye kile kɛ ɛnee bie mɔ wɔ ɛkɛ mɔɔ bɛbanyia ɛwɔkɛ ne a. 7 Ɛhye ati Nyamenle ɛzie kenle fofolɛ mɔɔ le “Ɛnɛ”. Ɛvolɛ dɔɔnwo pɛle nu la, ɔluale Devidi anwo zo ɔhanle, kɛmɔ Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se la:
“Saa ɛnɛ bɛte Nyamenle ane a,
bɛmmayɛ anzosesebɛ.”
8 Ɔluakɛ saa Dwɔhyua holale manle menli ne liele bɛ ɛnwomenle a, anrɛɛ Nyamenle eza ɛnrɛha kenle fofolɛ nwo edwɛkɛ bieko. 9Ɛhye ati Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle tɛbɔ ɛkɛ ne tɛmaa Nyamenle menli ne, kɛmɔ Nyamenle liele ye ɛnwomenle wɔ kenle ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nsuu la azo la. 10 Ɔluakɛ awie mɔɔ kɛnyia ɛnwomenlelielɛ ne mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛva ɛbɔ ɛwɔkɛ la die ye ɛnwomenle wɔ ɔdaye ye gyima nwo, kɛmɔ Nyamenle liele ye ɛnwomenle wɔ ye gyima nwo la. 11Zɔhane ati, bɛmaa yɛbɔ mɔdenle kɛ yɛkɛnyia ɛnwomenlelielɛ ne, amaa yɛanlea boɛ na yɛ nuhua biala anyɛ anzosesebɛ, kɛmɔ yɛ nlenya mɔ yɛle la.
12Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne gyi zo na ɔyɛ se, ɔyɛ nla ɔtɛla dadeɛ anye nwiɔ biala. Ɔpɛ to, ɔdua ɛkɛla nee sunsum ayia zo, ɔgya mbowule agbɔkɛ nee mbowule ɛnlome ɛweɛne na ɔfede adwenle nee ahonle nu ɔnwu bɛ nzuzulɛ muala. 13Wɔ Nyamenle anyunlu, debie biala ɛnvea; debie biala mɔɔ wɔ aleɛabo la la ɔ nyunlu wienyi, na yemɔ yɛɛ yɛbabu yɛ mgbonda yɛahile ye a.
Gyisɛse le Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli kpole kpalɛ
14Yemɔti, bɛmaa yɛzɔ diedi ne mɔɔ yɛnyia ye la anu ɛsesebɛ. Ɔluakɛ yɛlɛ Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli Kpole Kpalɛ mɔɔ ɛhɔ toonwo ɛhɔdwu Nyamenle anyunlu a; yemɔ a le Gyisɛse, mɔɔ le Nyamenle Ara ne. 15Yɛ Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli ɛhye le sonla mɔɔ se yɛ anwunvɔne wɔ yɛ sinlidɔlɛ nwo a. Yɛlɛ Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli mɔɔ bɛzɔle ye bɛnleanle kɛ yɛdayɛ la, noko yeanyɛ ɛtane biala. 16Zɔhane ati bɛmaa yɛzi ahonle na yɛbikye Nyamenle belemgbunli ebia ne mɔɔ ɛlolɛ ɛyi ye tɛkɛɛ la anwo. Ɛkɛ ne yɛɛ bɛbanwu yɛ anwunvɔne na ye ɛlolɛ ti yɛanyia moalɛ wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ yɛkɛhyia la a.

Title: HIB 5
Content:
1Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli biala, bɛye ye bɛfi menli avinli na bɛtu ye kɛ ɔgyinla bɛ gyakɛ anu wɔ Nyamenle anyunlu na ɔva bɛ ahyɛlɛdeɛ ne mɔ ɔbɔ azu ɔzɛlɛ ɛtanefakyɛ ɔmaa bɛ. 2Kɛmɔ ɔdaye mumua ne ɔtɔ sinli wɔ ndenle dɔɔnwo anu la ati, ɔmaa ɔ nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnze nwolɛ bie na bɛvo la di ye bɛtɛɛ. 3 Eza kɛmɔ ɔtɔ sinli la ati, saa ɔbɔ azu a ɔwɔ kɛ ɔdumua ɔbɔ ye ɛtane nwo azu kolaa na akee yeabɔ bie yeamaa menli kɔsɔɔti wɔ bɛ ɛtane nwo. 4 Awie ko ɔdaye ɔngola ɔnyɛ ɔ nwo sɛlɛvolɛ kpanyinli. Bɛdua Nyamenle ɛvɛlɛlɛ zo a bɛyɛ sonla sɛlɛvolɛ kpanyinli a, kɛmɔ bɛyɛle Aalɔn la.
5 Zɔhane ala yɛɛ Kelaese ɔdaye yeanyɛ ɔ nwo sɛlɛvolɛ kpanyinli a. Nyamenle ɔdaye mumua ne a ɔzele ye kɛ,
“Ɛle me Ra; ɛnɛ merayɛ ɛ Ze.”
6 Eza yeha ye wɔ ɛleka gyɛne kɛ,
“Ɛbayɛ sɛlɛvolɛ dahuu,
kɛ Mɛlekezidɛke la.”
7 Mekɛ mɔɔ Gyisɛse wɔ ewiade ye anu la, ɔvale ɛzunlɛ nee nyane ɔdeɛdeanle nu ɔvale ye nzɛlɛlɛ ɔdole Nyamenle mɔɔ yemɔ ala a kɛhola kɛye ye kɛvi ewule nu la anyunlu. Kɛmɔ ɔhanle ɔ nwo aze na ɔvale ɔ nwo amuala ɔmanle la ati, Nyamenle diele ye. 8Ɔle Nyamenle Ara bɔbɔ ɛdeɛ, noko ɔluale ye amaneɛnwunlɛ zo ɔzukoale ɔyɛle tieyɛ. 9Mɔɔ bɛmanle ɔlile munli la, akee ɔrayɛle ngoanelielɛ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ la ɔmanle bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛtie ye la, 10na Nyamenle yɛle ye Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli kɛ Mɛlekezidɛke la.
Azekpolɛ nwo kɔkɔbɔlɛ
11Yɛlɛ dɔɔnwo yɛka wɔ edwɛkɛ ɛhye anwo, noko nuhua ngilenu bayɛ se amaa bɛ, ɔboalekɛ bɛ ndelebɛbo le ekyi. 12 Ɔluakɛ mekɛ ɛdwu mɔɔ saa bɛle kilehilevolɛma bɔbɔ a anrɛɛ ɔmbɔ nzonle a, noko kɛkala bɛtɛkpondɛ awie mɔɔ bɔ ɔ bo yeahilehile bɛ Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne ɛzukoalɛdeɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ lumua la. Bɛngola aleɛ mɔɔ anu yɛ se la di. Ɛhye ati bɛkpondɛ nyɛfonzule bɛanlo. 13Awie mɔɔ no nyɛfonzule la tɛde adɔma; ɔnlɛ adwenle biala wɔ ɛtane nee kpalɛ nwo. 14Aleɛ mɔɔ anu yɛ ɛnlomboɛ la wɔ ɛkɛ maa mgbanyinli, ɔluakɛ bɛzukoa na bɛkola bɛnwu ngakyile mɔɔ wɔ kpalɛ nee ɛtane nu la.

Title: HIB 6
Content:
1Zɔhane ati, bɛmaa yɛhɔ zolɛ yɛzukoa yɛyɛ mgbanyinli na yɛgyakyi Kelaese ɛdoavolɛ nwo ɛzukoalɛdeɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ lumua la. Tɛ bɔ zo mɔɔ eza yɛbɔ ɔ bo yɛazukoa kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ yɛfi ninyɛndane nwo na yɛdie Nyamenle yɛdi ɔ, anzɛɛ ngilehilelɛ mɔɔ fane ɛzɔnenlɛ ngakyile nwo, 2ɛsalɛ mɔɔ bɛfa bɛgua bɛ nwo zo, ewudwazo ne nee ndɛnebualɛ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ la anwo ɔ. Bɛmaa yɛzukoa yɛhɔ yɛ nyunlu, 3na ɛhye yɛɛ saa Nyamenle maa adenle a ɔwɔ kɛ yɛyɛ a.
4Ɔluakɛ ɔyɛ se ɔmaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ anrɛɛ bɛlɛ diedi na bɛgyakyi nu la kɛ bɛkɛzia bɛkɛnlu bɛ nwo bieko. Ɛnee anrɛɛ bɛwɔ Nyamenle wienyi ne anu, bɛnyia Nyamenle nu ahyɛlɛdeɛ, na bɛnyia Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne bie; 5bɛze ye bɔkɔɔ kɛ Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne le kpalɛ, yɛɛ bɛnwu kɛ tumi ne mɔɔ bara la ɛzulolɛ si de la, noko bɛgyakyi bɛ diedi ne anu. 6Ɔyɛ se kɛ awie kɛhola kɛmaa bɛkɛnlu bɛ nwo bieko a, ɔboalekɛ bɛbɔ Nyamenle Ara ne meanubaka nu dahuu na bɛgua ɔ nyunlu aze wɔ menli nu.
7Nyamenle yila azɛlɛ mɔɔ meme nzule mɔɔ kɛdɔ zo la na ɔmaa zolɛ aleɛ yɛ kpalɛ maa menli mɔɔ yɛ zolɛ egyinli la. 8 Na saa azɛlɛ zɛhae azo fifi mbowule nee ndile a, nvasoɛ biala ɛnle zo; ɔle kɛ asɛɛ Nyamenle ɛwa ye amonle ɛwie na bɛbava senle bɛazɛkye ye la.
9Noko ayi mɔ, saa yɛtendɛ zɛhae bɔbɔ a, yɛ adwenle si pi wɔ bɛ nwo. Yɛze kɛ nyilalɛ kpalɛ bie wɔ ɛkɛ mɔɔ beta ngoanelielɛ nwo a. 10Nyamenle ɛnli nzisi. Ɔ rɛle ɛnrɛvi gyima mɔɔ bɛyɛle nee ɛhulolɛ mɔɔ bɛhile wɔ ɔ nwo nee nyele mɔɔ kɛkala bɛtɛbɔ nwo bɛtɛkile bɛtɛmaa bɛ mediema mɔɔ doa Kelaese abo zo la. 11Yɛ kunlu a anrɛɛ bɛ nuhua ko biala bagyinla kpundii ahɔ awieleɛ, amaa mɔɔ bɛ nye la zolɛ la bɛ sa aha ye. 12Yɛngulo kɛ bɛkɛyɛ mgbovonle. Yɛkulo kɛ bɛsukoa menli mɔɔ bɛlua bɛ diedi nee abotane zo bɛnyia mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛva ɛbɔ ɛwɔkɛ la.
Nyamenle ɛwɔkɛ ne gyi pi
13Mekɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle bɔle Ebileham ɛwɔkɛ ne la, ɔvuale ɔhilele ye kɛ ɔbali ɛwɔkɛ ne azo. Kɛmɔ awie biala ɛnle ɛkɛ mɔɔ le kpole tɛla ye la ati, Nyamenle vale ɔdaye ɔ ngome ye duma a vuale a. 14 Ɔse, “Mebɔ wɔ ɛwɔkɛ kɛ mebayila wɔ na meamaa ɛ bo zo amra ayɛ dɔɔnwo.” 15Ebileham zile abotane, na ɔnyianle ɛwɔkɛ ne mɔɔ Nyamenle bɔle ye la. 16Saa sonla ka ndane a, ɔfa awie mɔɔ tɛla ye la duma a ɔka ndane ne a, yɛɛ ndane ne pɛ kpolerazulɛ biala azo. 17Nyamenle kpondɛ kɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛnyia ɛwɔkɛ ne bie la nwu kɛ ɔnrɛhakyi ye adwenle ɛlɛ; ɛhye ati ɔvale ndane ɔbokale ye ɛwɔkɛ ne anwo. 18Ɛhye ati, ninyɛne nwiɔ ɛhye mɔ a wɔ ɛkɛ mɔɔ ɛngakyi na ɔkile kɛ Nyamenle ɛnrɛbɔ adalɛ ɛlɛ a, amaa yɛdayɛ mɔɔ yɛnriandi yɛahɔvea ye nu la yɛanyia akɛnrasesebɛ yɛazɔ anyelazo ɛhye mɔɔ bɛva bɛzie yɛ nyunlu la anu kpalɛ. 19 Anyelazo ɛhye le kɛ sɛkɛ maa yɛ ɛkɛla. Ɔgyi pi, na ɔgyi ye kpundii ɔkɔpe anwuma lɔ ɛzonlenlɛ sua ne mgbɛnu ɛdanlɛ ne anu na ɔkɔdua ɔ nwo wɔ ɛleka nwuanzanwuanza ne. 20 Ɛleka ɛhye yɛɛ Gyisɛse, ɔlua yɛdayɛ yɛ ti, yelumua lɔ, yehɔyɛ Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli, kɛmɔ Mɛlekezidɛke la a.

Title: HIB 7
Content:
Sɛlɛvolɛ Mɛlekezidɛke
1 Mɛlekezidɛke ɛhye, anrɛɛ ɔle belemgbunli wɔ Salɛm, eza ɔle Anwuma Anwuma Nyamenle ne Sɛlɛvolɛ. Mɔɔ Ebileham vi konle ne mɔɔ ɔlile arelemgbunli nna bie anwo zo konim la anloa ɛlɛba la, Mɛlekezidɛke yiale ye na ɔyilale ye, 2na Ebileham hyɛle mɔɔ ɔnyianle ye wɔ konle ne anu la amuala anu bulu na ɔdule ɛkpɔ ko ɔmanle ye. (Mɛlekezidɛke duma ne abo ngilenu mɔɔ lumua la a le “Pɛlepɛlelilɛ Belemgbunli” yɛɛ kɛmɔ ɛnee ɔle belemgbunli wɔ Salɛm la, ye duma ne abo eza kile “Anzonudwolɛ Belemgbunli.”) 3Mɛlekezidɛke ɛhye, debie biala ɛnle ɛkɛ mɔɔ kile yɛ ɔ ze anzɛɛ ɔ nli a, na yeayɛ ye abusua. Zɔhane ala yɛɛ debie ɛnle ɛkɛ mɔɔ kile yɛ ye awolɛ kenle anzɛɛ ye ewule kenle a. Ɔle kɛ Nyamenle Ara ne ala la; ɔle Sɛlɛvolɛ dahuu.
4Bɛdabɛ bɛkola bɛnwu kɛ ɛnee ɔle sonlakpole kpalɛ. Ebileham, yɛ nlenya kpanyinli ne, hyɛle ye ninyɛne mɔɔ ɔnyianle bɛ konle nu la anu bulu na ɔdule ɛkpɔ ko ɔmanle ye. 5 Livae abo zo amra noko mɔɔ le sɛlɛvolɛma la, mɛla ne kile kɛ Yizilayɛma ɛhyɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛnyia ye biala la anu bulu na bɛdu ɛkpɔ ko bɛmaa bɛ. Ɛhye kile kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ sɛlɛvolɛma ne die zɛhae debie fi bɛdabɛ bɛ maanle nu amra lɔ, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛ muala bɛle Ebileham abo zo amra la. 6Mɛlekezidɛke ɛnle Livae anlɔnra, noko ɔliele Ebileham, mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛbɔ ye ɛwɔkɛ la ninyɛne ne mɔɔ ɔhyɛle nu bulu na ɔdule ko ɔmanle ye la na ɔyilale ye. 7Kpolerazulɛ biala ɛnle nwo kɛ mɔɔ maa nyilalɛ la le kpole tɛla mɔɔ die nyilalɛ ne la. 8Ewiade ye anu, bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdie ngyɛnu bulu ne anu ɛkpɔ ko la le menli mɔɔ wu a, na anwuma lɔ, sonla mɔɔ die ngyɛnu bulu ne anu ɛkpɔ ko ne la de aze dahuu. 9Eza saa yɛka ye kpalɛ a, yɛkɛze kɛ mekɛ mɔɔ Ebileham duale ye ngyɛnu bulu ne anu ɛkpɔ ko ne la, ɛnee ɔkile kɛ Livae, (mɔɔ ɔ bo zo amra a die zɛhae ngyɛnu bulu ye anu ɛkpɔ ko ne la) ɔdaye yedua. 10Ɔluakɛ saa bɔbɔ bɛtɛwole Livae a, ɛnee ɔwɔ ɔ nlenya Ebileham akunlu wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ Mɛlekezidɛke yiale ye la.
11Ɔlua Livae abusua ne sɛlɛvolɛlilɛ gyima ngyehyɛlɛ ne azo yɛɛ bɛvale mɛla ne bɛrɛlɛle Yizilayɛma a. Na saa Livae abusua ne sɛlɛvolɛlilɛ gyima ne lile munli a, anrɛɛ Aalɔn yɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛsie ɔ gyakɛ anu a, na ɔnrɛhyia kɛ eza bɛkɛva sɛlɛvolɛ ngakyile bie bɛkɛzie Mɛlekezidɛke agyakɛ anu. 12Ɔluakɛ saa bɛkakyi sɛlɛvolɛlilɛ ne a, ɛnee ɔwɔ kɛ eza bɛkakyi mɛla ne noko. 13Yɛ Awulae ne mɔɔ ɔ nwo edwɛkɛ a bɛka la, vi abusua gyɛne nu; ye busuanli bie ɛtɛdile sɛlɛvolɛ ɛlɛ. 14Yɛze kɛ bɛwole ye wɔ Dwuda abusua nu, yɛɛ Mosisi noko ambɔ abusua ɛhye duma wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɔyɛ sɛlɛvolɛma ngyehyɛlɛ ne la.
Sɛlɛvolɛ fofolɛ mɔɔ le kɛ Mɛlekezidɛke la
15Edwɛkɛ ne anye la ɛkɛ ne wienyi, kɛ sɛlɛvolɛ fofolɛ mɔɔ le kɛ Mɛlekezidɛke la ɛvinde. 16Tɛ sonla ngyehyɛlɛ nee amaamuo zo a ɔlua mɔɔ bɛyɛle Mɛlekezidɛke sɛlɛvolɛ a, na ɔlua tumi mɔɔ ngoane mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ la lɛ ye la azo a bɛwulale ye sɛlɛvolɛ a. 17 Ɔluakɛ Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se, “Ɛle sɛlɛvolɛ dahuu kɛ Mɛlekezidɛke la.” 18Ɛhye kile kɛ ɛnee bɛzie ngyehyɛlɛ dɛba ne ahane, ɔboalekɛ ɔnli munli yɛɛ nvasoɛ biala ɛnle zolɛ. 19Ɔluakɛ Mosisi Mɛla ne angola ammaa ɛhwee anli munli. Na kɛkala, bɛva anyelazo kpalɛ bie bɛra, mɔɔ yɛlua zo a yɛbikye Nyamenle a. 20Bieko, Nyamenle ndane ne wɔ ɛkɛ. Ndane zɛhae, ɛnee bie ɛnle ɛkɛ ɛmmaa menli mɔɔ bɛlumuale bɛwulale bɛ sɛlɛvolɛ la. 21 Na Gyisɛse sɛlɛvolɛlilɛ ɛdeɛ ne ndane wɔ nwolɛ. Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se,
“Awulae ɛha ndane
na ɔnrɛhakyi ye adwenle ɛlɛ:
‘Ɛle sɛlɛvolɛ dahuu.’ ”
22Ngakyile ɛhye maa Gyisɛse yɛ ngyekyeleɛ kpalɛ bie agyinlanudivolɛ.
23Ngakyile bieko wɔ ɛkɛ: sɛlɛvolɛ ɛhendeɛ ne mɔ zonle, ɔluakɛ bɛwule na bɛangola bɛanyɛ bɛ gyima ne. 24Noko Gyisɛse de aze dahuu, yɛɛ ye sɛlɛvolɛ gyima ne ɛngakyi ɛngɔ awie lɔ. 25Ɛhye ati ɔkola kɛkala nee mekɛ biala ɔdie bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdua ɔ nwo zo bɛba Nyamenle ɛkɛ ne la ngoane, ɔluakɛ ɔde aze na ɔdi bɛ ti mgbɔdalɛ wɔ Nyamenle ɛkɛ ne dahuu.
26Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli mɔɔ le zɛhae la yɛɛ kola sɔ yɛ wɔ yɛ ɛhyianlɛ biala anu a, ɔluakɛ ɔle nwuanzanwuanza; ɛtane biala ɛnle ɔ nwo anzɛɛ ye nu. Bɛye ye bɛzie ahane bɛvi ɛtanevolɛma anu na bɛmaa ye zo bɛhɔ anwuma. 27 Ɔnle kɛ sɛlɛvolɛ mgbanyinli ɛhendeɛ ne mɔ, mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ kɔ azukponle nwo kenle biala, kɛ bɛkabɔ bɛ ɛtane nwo azu na bɛabɔ bie bɛamaa awie mɔ la. Ɔvale ɔ nwo ɔbɔle azu ne kokye ala. 28Mosisi Mɛla ne maa adenle maa bɛyɛ menli mɔɔ ɛndenrɛ la sɛlɛvolɛ mgbanyinli. Na Nyamenle ɛwɔkɛ ne mɔɔ ndane ne wɔ nu, na ɔrale nzinlii la, yɛɛ ɛye Ralɛ ne mɔɔ di munli dahuu la kɛ ɔyɛ Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli a.

Title: HIB 8
Content:
Gyisɛse le yɛ Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli
1 Mɔɔ yɛlɛka la amuala, saa yɛbɔ ye kpɔkɛ ko a, yemɔ a le ɛhye: yɛlɛ Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli zɛhae, mɔɔ de Nyamenle Bedevinli ne Belemgbunli Ebia ne fema zo wɔ anwuma. 2Ɔyɛ ye Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli gyima ne wɔ anwuma lɔ Nwuanzanwuanza Ɛleka ne, wɔ ndanlɛ sua ne mɔɔ tɛ sonla a zile na Nyamenle ɔdaye a yezi la anu.
3Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli biala mɔɔ bɛkɛye ye la fa ahyɛlɛ ninyɛne nee nane bɔ azu maa Nyamenle. Zɔhane ati ɔwɔ kɛ yɛ Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli ne ɔdaye ɔnyia debie ɔbɔ azu. 4Saa ɔwɔ ewiade ye anu a anrɛɛ ɔnrɛyɛ sɛlɛvolɛ ɛlɛ, ɔluakɛ sɛlɛvolɛma mɔɔ dua Mosisi mɛla ne azo fa ninyɛne bɔ azu la zonle. 5 Na mɔɔ bɛyɛ la le gyima mɔɔ bɛyɛ ye wɔ anwuma lɔ la sɔhovolɛ. Ɔluakɛ mɔɔ Mosisi bazi ndanlɛ sua ne la, Nyamenle zele ye kɛ, “Bɔ mɔdenle kɛ ɛkɛyɛ debie biala ɛkɛmaa ɔkɛzɔho mɔɔ bɛvale bɛhilele wɔ wɔ boka ne azo lɔ la.” 6Na kɛ ɔde la a le kɛ bɛmaa Gyisɛse sɛlɛvolɛ gyima mɔɔ sonle bolɛ kpole tɛla dɛba ne la. Ɔboalekɛ ɔgyi ninyɛne kpalɛ nwo ɛwɔkɛ zo.
7Saa alumua ngyekyeleɛ ne lile munli a, anrɛɛ yeangyia kɛ eza bɛkɛkyekye fofolɛ. 8 Ɔluakɛ Nyamenle nwu nvonleɛ dɔɔnwo wɔ ye menli nwo, yemɔti ɔse,
“Medame Awulae mese,
mekɛ bara mɔɔ me nee Yizilayɛma
nee Dwuda abusua ekpunli ne
bakyekye ngyekyeleɛ fofolɛ a.
9Ɔnrɛyɛ kɛ ngyekyeleɛ ne mɔɔ
me nee bɛ nlenya mɔ kyekyele
wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ menyele bɛ
menvile Yigyibiti azɛlɛ zo la.
Bɛanli nɔhalɛ wɔ zɔhane ngyekyeleɛ ne
mɔɔ me nee bɛ kyekyele la anwo,
yemɔti meandɛne bɛ zo,
Medame Awulae a mese a.
10Akee ngyekyeleɛ fofolɛ mɔɔ me nee
Yizilayɛma bakyekye wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bara la ɛne:
Mebava me mɛla meawula bɛ adwenle nu, na
meahɛlɛ ye bɛ ahonle zo.
Mebayɛ bɛ Nyamenle, na bɛayɛ me menli.
11Ɔnrɛhyia kɛ bɛ nuhua biala kɛhilehile ɔ gɔnwo,
anzɛɛ kɛze ɔ diema kɛ ‘Nwu Awulae.’
Ɔluakɛ ngakula nee mgbanyinli banwu me.
12Mebava bɛ ɛtane meahyɛ bɛ
na menrɛhakye bɛ nvonleɛ ne mɔ bieko.”
13Saa Nyamenle ɛlɛka ngyekyeleɛ fofolɛ nwo edwɛkɛ a, ɛnee ɔkile kɛ yemaa alumua ngyekyeleɛ ne ɛyɛ mgbane. Debie biala mɔɔ kɛkpa nwolɛ la ɛngyɛ biala na yeaminli.

Title: HIB 9
Content:
Aze ɛke nee anwuma lɔ ɛzonlenlɛ
1Ɛnee alumua ngyekyeleɛ ne lɛ ɛzonlenlɛ nwo ngyehyɛlɛ yɛɛ ɛleka mɔɔ bɛhyehyɛ kɛ ɔle nwuanzanwuanza na ɔwɔ kɛ bɛsonle ɛkɛ ne la. 2 Bɛzile ndanlɛ sua ko, ye findezo mgbɛnu ne bɛfɛlɛ ye Ɛleka Nwuanzanwuanza. Ɛkɛ a kɛnlaneɛ baka ne, ɛkponle ne nee kpanwo ne mɔɔ bɛfa bɛbɔ azu bɛmaa Nyamenle la wɔ a. 3 Wɔ mgbɛnu ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nwiɔ la anzi, ndanlɛ sua ko noko wɔ ɛkɛ; bɛfɛlɛ ɛkɛ ne Nwuanzanwuanza nu Nwuanzaanwu Ɛleka. 4 Ɛke yɛɛ ezukoa azukponle ne mɔɔ bɛkpu ɛyɛlɛ zo yɛɛ Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne mɔɔ bɛva ezukoa nvutuke bɛyɛ ye sɔɔnwo la wɔ a. Ezukoa dwora ne mɔɔ mana wɔ nu la gyi Ɛlɛka ne anu. Aalɔn baka ne mɔɔ kpakyele nya, nee awolɛ ndɛbandɛba nwiɔ ne mɔɔ bɛhɛlɛ mɛla ne zolɛ la wɔ Ɛlɛka ne anu. 5 Akee anyunlunyia abɔdeɛ mɔɔ lɛ ndɛbalɛ la zinze Ɛlɛka ne azo anwuma na bɛdɛlɛdɛlɛ bɛ ndɛba anu wɔ anwunvɔnezelɛ ebia ne azo, bɛlɛkile kɛ Nyamenle wɔ ɛkɛ. Na kɛkala, mekɛ ɛtɛdwule mɔɔ yɛkilehile debie biala mɔɔ wɔ ɛkɛ ne la anu ngoko ngoko a.
6 Kɛ bɛhyehyɛ ninyɛne mɔɔ wɔ ɛkɛ ne la ɛne. Alehyenlɛ biala sɛlɛvolɛma kɔ ndanlɛ sua ne findezo mgbɛnu ne anu kɔyɛ bɛ gyima; 7 noko Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli ne ala yɛɛ kɔ ndanlɛ sua ne mɔɔ wɔ sua ne mgbɛnu ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nwiɔ la anzi la anu a, yɛɛ ɔkɔ ɛkɛ ne ɛvolɛ ɛvolɛ. Ɔlɛkɔ ɛkɛ a ɔfa mogya ɔkɔbɔ azu ɔmaa Nyamenle wɔ ɔdaye Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli ne nee menli kɔsɔɔti bɛ ɛtane mɔɔ bɛyɛ la ati. 8Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne ngilehilelɛ mɔɔ wɔ ngyekyeleɛ ɛhye anwo la kile kɛ suzuamgba ala mɔɔ findezo ndanlɛ sua ne ɛtɛyele ɛkɛ ne la, adenle biala ɛnle ɛkɛ mɔɔ bɛfa nu bɛkɔ Nwuanzanwuanza nu Nwuanzaanwu Ɛleka ne a. 9Ɛhye le ɛzukoalɛdeɛ maa yɛ ɛnɛ mekɛ ye. Ɔkile kɛ ahyɛlɛdeɛ nee nane azubɔlɛ ne mɔɔ bɛbɔ bɛmaa Nyamenle la ɛngola ɛmmaa sonvolɛma ahonle nu ɛnde. 10Aleɛ nee nza nee bɛ nwo ɛnluanlɛ ngakyile nwo nyɛleɛ yɛɛ bɛyɛ a. Na ɛhye noko le ɛnyelɛ zo debie mɔɔ wɔ ɛkɛ a, kɔkpula mekɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle kɛhakyi ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti fofolɛ la.
11Na Kelaese ɛra kɛ ninyɛne kpalɛ kɔsɔɔti anwo Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli. Ndanlɛ sua ne mɔɔ ɔyɛ gyima nu la le kpole, ɔdi munli ɔtɛla biala; tɛ sonla a zile a, yɛɛ ɔmboka ewiade ɛhye anwo a bɛbɔle a. 12Mɔɔ Kelaese wolole ndanlɛ sua ɛhye anu kokye ne ala na ɔhɔle Nwuanzanwuanza nu Nwuanzaanwu Ɛleka ne la, yeanva mbɔnkye nee nlankɛ mogya a ɔbɔle azu ne a; ɔvale ɔdaye mumua ne ye mogya a ɔbɔle azu ɔvale ngoanelielɛ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ la ɔrɛlɛle yɛ a. 13 Bɛkponde nlankɛ nee mbɔnkye mogya nee ɛnlankɛ ralɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛyela ye la nzonle wɔ menli nwo na bɛfa ye kɛ ɔkola ɔnrinzi bɛ nwo evinli muala. 14Kɛmɔ ɛhye le nɔhalɛ la, ɛnee ɛnea a ɛkɛnwu kɛ Kelaese mogya ne kola di gyima kpole maa ɔbo zolɛ. Yelua Sunsum ne mɔɔ ɛnwu ɛlɛ la azo yeva ɔ nwo yebɔ azu mɔɔ di munli la yemaa Nyamenle. Ye mogya ne bade yɛ adwenle nu avi nyɛleɛ mgbane mgbane mɔɔ fa yɛ kɔ ewule nu la anwo na yɛazonle tease Nyamenle ne.
15Ɛhye ati Kelaese a le sonla mɔɔ de ngyekyeleɛ fofolɛ ne abo a, amaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛvɛlɛ bɛ la anyia ye nyilalɛ ne mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ mɔɔ ɔvale ɔbɔle ɛwɔkɛ la bie. Ɛhye kola yɛ zɔhane, ɔboalekɛ bɛha mogya bɛgua, bɛva bɛye menli kɔsɔɔti bɛvi bɛ ɛtane mɔɔ bɛyɛle wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ alumua ngyekyeleɛ ne abo la anu.
16Saa awie yɛ “wele” na saa ɔwɔ kɛ bɛtulu nu a, kyesɛ bɛkile kɛ ahenle mɔɔ yɛle zɔhane kɛlata ne la ɛwu. 17Ɔluakɛ saa ahenle mɔɔ yɛle “wele” ne la de aze a, nvasoɛ biala ɛnle mɔɔ yeyɛ la azo; saa ɔwu a yɛɛ ɛnee nvasoɛ ɛra zolɛ a. 18Ɛhye ati alumua ngyekyeleɛ ne bɛvale mogya a bɛhyele ɔ bo a. 19 Mɔɔ Mosisi gengale mɛla ne amuala hilele menli ne na ɔwiele la, akee ɔvale ɛnlankɛ nee abɔnkye mogya ɔkpotole nzule nu, ɔvale nyinlanyinla nee boane kɔkɔlɛ ndɛkɛ ɔkyekyele na ɔvale ɔbɔle mogya ne anu ɔkpondenle Mɛla Buluku ne nee menli ne amuala anwo, 20na ɔhanle kɛ, “Ɛhye a le mogya ne mɔɔ sɔ ngyekyeleɛ ne mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛyɛ kɛ bɛli zolɛ la anloa a”. 21 Zɔhane ala yɛɛ Mosisi eza kpondenle mogya ne wɔ Ndanlɛ Sua ne nee ninyɛne mɔɔ bɛfa bɛyɛ ɛzonlenlɛ la anwo a. 22 Nɔhalɛ, mɛla ne kile kɛ mogya ala a bɛfa bɛte debie biala anwo a, yɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛtwi mogya na bɛava bɛali ɛtane nwo mgbɔdalɛ.
Kelaese azubɔlɛ ne nunu ɛtane muala
23Ninyɛne zɛhae mɔ, mɔɔ le anwuma lɔ ɛdeɛ kpalɛ ne sɔhovolɛ la, yɛɛ bɛte nwolɛ wɔ adenle zɛhae anu a. Anwuma lɔ ninyɛne ɛdeɛ kpalɛ ne hyia azubɔlɛ kpalɛ mɔɔ tɛla ɛhye a. 24Ɔluakɛ Kelaese angɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua mɔɔ menli a ɛzi na ɔle anwuma lɔ ɛdeɛ ne sɔhovolɛ la anu. Yehɔ anwuma lɔ, na ɛkɛ ne yɛɛ ɔfinde Nyamenle anyunlu dahuu ɔkpa yɛ ti kyɛlɛ a. 25Dwuuma Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli ne fa mogya kɔ Nwuanzanwuanza nu Nwuanzaanwu Ɛleka ne ɛvolɛ ɛvolɛ. Na Kelaese ɛdeɛ yeangɔ fane dɔɔnwo kɛ ɔfa ɔ nwo yeahɔbɔ azu ne, 26ɔluakɛ saa ɔle zɔhane a, anrɛɛ ɔkile kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ Kelaese nwu amaneɛ fane dɔɔnwo, ɔvi ewiade mɔlebɛbo ne. Noko ɔrale kokye wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti ɛlɛkɔ awieleɛ la, na ɔvale ye mogya ɔbɔle azu ne ɔnununle ɛtane muala. 27Bɛhyehyɛ bɛmaa sonla biala kɛ ɔwu kokye, na ewule ne anzi Nyamenle abua ye ndɛne. 28 Zɔhane ala yɛɛ bɛvale Kelaese ɔdaye noko bɛbɔle azu kokye ala kɛ ɔranunu menli dɔɔnwo ɛtane ne mɔ a. Ɔbara bieko, na tɛ kɛ ɔ nee ɛtane bali ɔ, na ɔbalie menli ne mɔɔ ɛlɛkendɛ ye la ngoane.

Title: HIB 10
Content:
1Dwuuma mɛla ne ɛnle ninyɛne fɔɔnwo ne mɔɔ wɔ ɛkɛ ne la nɔhalɛ sɔhovolɛ. Ɔle ninyɛne kpalɛ mɔɔ bara la sɔhovolɛ ekyi bie. Azu ko ne ala yɛɛ ɛvolɛ biala bɛbɔ a. Ɛhye ati bɛnrɛhola bɛnrɛlua mɛla ne azo bɛnrɛmaa menli mɔɔ kpondɛ Nyamenle la ɛnrɛlua dahuu azubɔlɛ ko ne ala azo ɛnrɛzɔ Nyamenle anye. 2Saa azubɔlɛ ne te menli mɔɔ sonle Nyamenle la anwo bɔkɔɔ a, anrɛɛ bɛ adwenle ɛnyɛ bɛ kesee kɛ bɛnli ɛtane nwo fɔlɛ bieko, yɛɛ eza anrɛɛ bɛgyakyi azu ne ɛbɔlɛ. 3Na kɛ ɔde la a le kɛ, ɛvolɛ biala azubɔlɛ ne kakye bɛ ɛtane mɔɔ mekɛ biala bɛyɛ la. 4Ɔluakɛ ɔyɛ se kɛ mbɔnkye nee nlankɛ mogya kɛhola kɛnunu ɛtane mɔɔ mekɛ biala bɛyɛ la abo zo.
5 Ɔlua ɛhye ati mɔɔ Kelaese bara ewiade la, ɔzele Nyamenle kɛ,
“Ɛmkpondɛ azubɔlɛ nee azubɔdeɛ
noko wɔmaa me nwolɛ nwonane.
6Ɛ nye ɛnlie nane mumua ɛyelalɛ
anzɛɛ ɛtanefakyɛ azubɔlɛ nwo.
7Ɛhye ati menganle kɛ, ‘O Nyamenle, mera
kɛ mebayɛ mɔɔ ɛkpondɛ la,
kɛmɔ bɛhɛlɛ ye wɔ me nwo wɔ mɛla buluku ne anu la.’ ”
8Alumua ne ɔhanle kɛ, “Ɛmkpondɛ, yɛɛ ɛ nye ɛnlie azubɔdeɛ anzɛɛ nane ɛyelalɛ nee ɛtanefakyɛ azubɔlɛ nwo.” Ɔhanle ɛhye, noko mɛla ne maa adenle maa bɛbɔ azu mɔɔ le kɛ ɛhye mɔ la amuala. 9Eza ɔhanle kɛ, “O Nyamenle, mera kɛ mebayɛ mɔɔ ɛkpondɛ la.” Yemɔti Nyamenle kpole dɛba ne azubɔlɛ ne na ɔvale Kelaese azubɔlɛ ɛdeɛ ne ɔziele ɔ bo zo. 10Ɔlua ɛhye ati, kɛmɔ Gyisɛse Kelaese yɛle mɔɔ Nyamenle kpondɛ la, ye azu ne mɔɔ ɔvale ɔ nwo ɔyɛle azubɔdeɛ ɔbɔle ye kokye ne ala la ɛde yɛ nwo bɔkɔɔ ɛvi ɛtane nwo.
11 Dwuuma sɛlɛvolɛ biala bɔ azu dahuu yɛɛ ɔbɔ zɔhane azu ne ala wɔ mekɛ dɔɔnwo, noko azubɔlɛ ɛhye mɔ ɛngola ɛnye yɛ ɛnvi yɛ ɛtane ne mɔ anu. 12 Kelaese bɔle ɛtanefakyɛ nwo azu kpalɛ ne mɔɔ yɛ nla la kokye, na ɔhɔdɛnlanle Nyamenle asa fema zo. 13Ɛkɛ ne yɛɛ ɔlɛkendɛ kɔkpula mekɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle kɛva ye kpɔvolɛma kɛwula ɔ gyakɛ abo la. 14Ɔluakɛ yeva azubɔlɛ kokye yemaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ yede bɛ nwo la ɛli munli dahuu.
15Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne di daselɛ kile yɛ, ɔluakɛ alumua ne ɔhanle kɛ,
16 “Awulae se,
Saa kenle zɔhane pɛ nu a
ngyekyeleɛ mɔɔ me nee bɛ bakyekye la ɛne:
Mebava me mɛla meawula bɛ ahonle nu,
na meahɛlɛ ye wɔ bɛ adwenle nu.”
17 Akee ɔvale ɔzɔle zolɛ kɛ, “Menrɛhakye bɛ ɛtane ne nee bɛ amumuyɛ ne mɔ bieko.” 18Ɔluakɛ ɛleka mɔɔ fakyɛ wɔ la, ɛtanefakyɛ nwo azubɔlɛ ɛngyia bieko.
Bɛmaa yɛhwe yɛbikye Nyamenle
19Zɔhane ati, mediema, yɛlɛ adenle bɔkɔɔ kɛ yɛdua Gyisɛse ewule ne azo yɛfa mgbɛnu ɛdanlɛ ne anu yɛkɔ Nwuanzanwuanza nu Nwuanzaanwu Ɛleka ne. 20Gyisɛse ɛlua mgbɛnu ɛdanlɛ ne, mɔɔ le ɔdaye ye nwonane ne anu ɛkpakye ngoane adenle fofolɛ ɛmaa yɛ. 21Kɛmɔ yɛlɛ sɛlɛvolɛ kpole mɔɔ nea Nyamenle sua ne azo la, 22 bɛmaa yɛva ahonle kpalɛ nee diedi mɔɔ si pi, ahonle mɔɔ bɛde nwolɛ bɛvi adwenle nu fɔlɛlilɛ nwo, nee sonlabaka mɔɔ bɛva nzule anye komikomi bɛbia ye la yɛhwe yɛbikye Nyamenle. 23Bɛmaa yɛzɔ anyelazo ne mɔɔ yɛlɛ ye la anu kpalɛ, ɔboalekɛ Nyamenle ne mɔɔ bɔle yɛ ɛwɔkɛ ne la le nɔhalɛ. 24Bɛmaa yɛdwenle yɛkpondɛ adenle mɔɔ yɛdua zolɛ a yɛkɛhulo yɛ nwo ngoko ngoko, na yɛkɛyɛ gyima kpalɛ la. 25Bɛmmamaa yɛgyakyi kɛ yɛkɛhɔ yɛ nyianu ne, kɛmɔ bie mɔ yɛ la. Bɛdabɛ bɛkola bɛnwu kɛ Awulae Kenle ne ɛbikye, yemɔti bɛmaa yɛsosɔ yɛ nwo ngoko ngoko.
26Ɔluakɛ kɛkala mɔɔ yɛnwu nɔhalɛ ne la, saa yɛ nye fuu yɛkɔ zolɛ yɛyɛ ɛtane a, azubɔlɛ bieko ɛnle ɛkɛ mɔɔ kɛhola kɛye yɛ ɛtane ne mɔ a. 27 Ɛnee mɔɔ ɛha la a le kɛ yɛkɛva anwowozolɛ yɛkɛhendɛ Nyamenle Ndɛnebualɛ ne nee ye ɛya ne mɔɔ sɔ hulenyi kɛ senle mɔɔ bazɛkye bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛtia Nyamenle la. 28 Awie mɔɔ kɛdo Mosisi Mɛla ne la, saa bɛnyia alasevolɛ nwiɔ anzɛɛ nsa di daselɛ tia ye na ɔdi fɔlɛ a, bɛku ye mɔɔ anwunvɔnezelɛ biala ɛnle nu a. 29 Ɛnee ɛdawɔ fa ɛ nye to na nea sonla mɔɔ kɛkpo Nyamenle Ara ne, na yeambu mogya ne mɔɔ bɛlua zo a bɛ nwo te na Nyamenle vale zɔle ngyekyeleɛ ne anloa, na ɔkɛva Nyamenle ɛlolɛ Sunsum ne anyunlu ɔkɛkyikyi aze la ɛ? Ye ndeanlɛ mɔɔ ɔbanyia ye la le kpole kpalɛ. 30 Ɔluakɛ yɛze ahenle mɔɔ hanle kɛ, “Nzenralɛlilɛ le me ɛdeɛ, mebadua ɛtane kakɛ” la; yɛɛ eza yɛze Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ se, “Nyamenle babua ye menli ndɛne” la. 31Ɔkɛyɛ ɛzulolɛ ɛdeɛ, kɛ ɛkɛdɔ tease Nyamenle ne ɛhane nu a!
32Bɛhakye mɔɔ zile bɛ nwo zo wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle wienyi ne dale bɛ nwo zo la. Bɛnwunle amaneɛ dɔɔnwo, noko abodelɛ ne ambo bɛ nwo zo ɛlɛ. 33Ɔdwule mekɛ ne bie la, bɛguale bɛ nyunlu aze wɔ bagua nu, bɛhilele bɛ nyane, yɛɛ ɔdwule mekɛ ne bie noko la, ɛnee akee bɛ nuhua ko biala bɔbɔ kpondɛ kɛ ɔdaye ɔnwu amaneɛ ne bie. 34Bɛ nee menli mɔɔ bɛguale bɛ efiade la lile nyane, yɛɛ mɔɔ bɛzale bɛ bɛliele bɛ nwo ninyɛne bɔbɔ la, yeanvane bɛ nwo fee, ɔboalekɛ ɛnee bɛze kɛ bɛlɛ ninyɛne kpalɛ mɔɔ ɛnzɛkye ɛlɛ la wɔ ɛkɛ. 35Zɔhane ati bɛmmakpo aze fee, ɔluakɛ ɛhye mɔ amuala, ahatualɛ kpole bie li ɔ nzi. 36Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛnyia abotane, amaa bɛahola bɛayɛ Nyamenle ɛhulolɛdeɛ na bɛanyia ye ɛwɔkɛ ne.
37 Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se,
“Ɔnrɛhyɛ biala na sonla ne mɔɔ ba la ara,
ɔnrɛzi aze fee.
38Diedi zo yɛɛ sonla ne mɔɔ sɔ me nye la
balua anyia ngoane a.
Saa ɔsia ɔ nzi a, me nye ɛnrɛlie ɔ nwo.”
39Yɛnle menli mɔɔ yɛsia yɛ nzi na yɛminli a. Yɛlɛ diedi, yemɔti yɛlɛ ngoane.

Title: HIB 11
Content:
Diedi
1Diedi a le kɛ yɛkɛzi pi wɔ ninyɛne mɔɔ yɛ nye la zolɛ la anwo, na yɛkɛlie ninyɛne mɔɔ ɛnyelɛ ɛnnwu bɛ la yɛkɛdo nu kɛ bɛwɔ ɛkɛ. 2Ɔluakɛ bɛ diedi ti yɛɛ mɔmoane amra dɔɔnwo mɔɔ ɛhɔ la zɔle Nyamenle anye a.
3 Ɔlua diedi zo yɛɛ yɛnyia ndelebɛbo kɛ Nyamenle vale ɔ nloa edwɛkɛ ala a bɔle ewiade a, na mɔɔ ɛnɛ yɛnwu ye la vi mɔɔ yɛnnwu ye la anu a rale a.
4 Diedi yɛɛ manle Ebulu bɔle azu kpalɛ mɔɔ sɔ ɛnyelɛ la manle Nyamenle dɛlale Keen a. Ɔlua ye diedi ti Ebulu zɔle Nyamenle anye kɛ ɔle sonla tenlene, ɔluakɛ ye ahyɛlɛdeɛ ne zɔle ɔ nye. Ebulu ɛwu bɔbɔ ɛdeɛ, noko kɛkala ɔlua ye diedi zo ɔtendɛ ɔkile yɛ.
5 Ɔlua ye diedi ti Yinɔko anwu; bɛvale ye anyewɔzo bɛhɔle anwuma wɔ Nyamenle anwo lɔ. Awie kpondɛle ye a, yeannwu ye, ɔluakɛ Nyamenle ɛva ye ɛhɔ anwuma lɔ. Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne kile kɛ Yinɔko zɔle Nyamenle anye kolaa na bɛava ye bɛahɔ. 6Ɔyɛ se kɛ awie mɔɔ ɛnlɛ diedi la kɛhola kɛzɔ Nyamenle anye. Ɔluakɛ ɔwɔ kɛ awie mɔɔ ba Nyamenle ɛkɛ ne la die di kɛ Nyamenle wɔ ɛkɛ na ɔyila bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkpondɛ ɔ bo zo la.
7 Diedi zo yɛɛ Nowa luale mɔɔ ɔdele Nyamenle kɔkɔbɔlɛ ne mɔɔ fane ninyɛne mɔɔ kenle bie bazi la anwo a. Ɔdiele Nyamenle ane na ɔbobɔle ɛlɛnemgbole ɔvale ɔliele ɔ nwo nee ye sua nu amra ngoane. Ɔluale zɛhae adenle zo ɔbule ewiade ye kɛ ɔle debie mgbane, na ɔ sa hanle Nyamenle nu fɔɔnwoyɛlɛ ne mɔɔ bɛdua diedi zo bɛ sa ka ye la.
8 Diedi zo yɛɛ ɔlua mɔɔ Ebileham diele Nyamenle ɛvɛlɛlɛ ne na ɔdule ɔhɔle maanle mɔɔ Nyamenle hilele ye kɛ ɔle ye ɛdeɛ la anu a. Ɔvi ye maanle ne anu ɔdule la, ɛnee ɔdaye mumua ne ɔnze ɛleka mɔɔ ɔlɛkɔ la. 9 Ye diedi ti, ɔdɛnlanle maanle ne mɔɔ Nyamenle vale bɔle ye ɛwɔkɛ la anu kɛ ɛyɛvolɛ. Ɔdɛnlanle ndanlɛ sua nu, kɛmɔ Ayezeke nee Gyekɔbo, mɔɔ bɛdabɛ noko bɛboka nwo a Nyamenle bɔle bɛ ɛwɔkɛ ne la yɛle la. 10Ɔluakɛ ɛnee Ebileham ɛlɛkendɛ Nyamenle ɔdaye ye Suakpole ne mɔɔ yehyehyɛ, yewula ye aze na yekyekye la.
11 Ɔlua diedi zo yɛɛ Sɛla, mɔɔ ɛnee yeyɛ ɛrelera na yebo awolɛ zo bɔbɔ la, nrenzɛle wole a, ɔluakɛ ɔliele ɔlile kɛ Nyamenle mɔɔ bɔle ɛwɔkɛ ne la le nɔhalɛ na ɔkola ɔyɛ. 12 Yemɔti ɔlua sonla ko mɔɔ le Ebileham, mɔɔ ɛnee ɔle kɛ asɛɛ yewu, noko ɔtɛwole ralɛ ɛlɛ la anwo zo yɛɛ ɛnɛ nlɔnra dɔɔnwo mɔɔ le kɛ anwuma nwɔlɔra nee ɛnweazo anwea la ɛra a.
13 Diedi nu yɛɛ menli ɛhye mɔ amuala wule a. Bɛ sa anga ɛwɔkɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ Nyamenle bɔle bɛ la, noko bɛnwunle ye bɛ adwenle nu wɔ moa moa na bɛliele bɛdole nu kɛ bɛle nyɛvolɛ mɔɔ ɛra nlɔnu wɔ azɛlɛ ɛhye azo a. 14Menli mɔɔ ka zɛhae edwɛkɛ la kile kɛ bɛlɛkpondɛ bɛ sua zo kpalɛ ne. 15Bɛandwenle maanle ne mɔɔ ɛnee bɛlɛgyakyi ye bɛ nzi bɛahɔ la anwo. Saa bɛdwenlenle nwolɛ a, anrɛɛ bɛziale bɛrale. 16Ɛleka mɔɔ ɛnee bɛ nwo ɛlɛdɔ ye la a le anwuma maanle kpalɛ ne. Yemɔti noko yeanyɛ Nyamenle nyiane kɛ bɛkɛvɛlɛ ye bɛ Nyamenle, ɔboalekɛ yekyekye suakpole yezie ɛkɛ ne yemaa bɛ.
17 Diedi a manle Ebileham, mɔɔ ɛnee Nyamenle ɛbɔ ye ɛwɔkɛ la, vale ɔ ra nrenya kokye Ayezeke kɛ ɔfa yeabɔ azu yeamaa Nyamenle wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle zɔle ye nleanle la. 18 Ɛnee Nyamenle ɛha ɛhile Ebileham kɛ, “Ɔlua Ayezeke anwo zo a ɛbanyia wɔ nlɔnra dɔɔnwo ne, kɛmɔ menvale membɔle wɔ ɛwɔkɛ la a.” 19Ebileham nyianle adwenle kɛ Nyamenle kola dwazo mɔwuamra fi ewule nu, na amgba noko, Ebileham asa hanle Ayezeke vile ewule nu.
20 Diedi zo yɛɛ ɔlua mɔɔ Ayezeke yileyilale Gyekɔbo nee Yisɔ a.
21 Diedi zo yɛɛ ɔlua mɔɔ Ayezeke yileyilale Dwosefi amra ne mɔ kolaa na yeawu a. Mekɛ ne anu ɛnee yeyɛ ɛrelera kondokondo na ɔlɛ kpɔma nu yɛɛ ɔzɛlɛle Nyamenle a.
22 Diedi yɛɛ manle Dwosefi, mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee ɔla ewule ɛkpa zo la, hanle kɛ Nyamenle baye Yizilayɛma avi Yigyibiti, na ɔhilele kɛ bɛzi bɛyɛ ye mbowule ne mɔ la a.
23 Diedi zo yɛɛ ɔlua, mɔɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛwole Mosisi la, ye awovolɛ vale ye veale toonwo siane nsa a. Bɛnwunle kɛ ɔ nwo yɛ fɛ, ɛhye ati bɛanzulo na bɛbulule belemgbunli ne mɛla ne azo.
24 Diedi zo yɛɛ ɔlua mɔɔ Mosisi dule zo la, ɔkpole kɛ bɛkɛvɛlɛ ye Yigyibiti belemgbunli ne ara raalɛ ne ara a. 25Ɔhulole kɛ ɔ nee Nyamenle menli ne kɛli nyane tɛla kɛ ɔ nye kɛlie ɛtane nwo mekɛ ekyi bie a. 26Ɔdwenlenle nwo kɛ saa sonla doa Kelaese ne abo zo na ɔnwu amaneɛ a, ɔle kpalɛ ɔtɛla kɛ ɔkɛnyia Yigyibiti anwonyia kɔsɔɔti a, ɔluakɛ ɛnee ɔ nye la ahyɛlɛdeɛ mɔɔ kenle bie Nyamenle bava amaa ye la azo.
27Diedi zo yɛɛ ɔlua mɔɔ Mosisi anzulo belemgbunli ne ɛya mɔɔ ɔkɛva la na ɔdule ɔvile Yigyibiti a. Yeanzia ɔ nzi, ɔgyinlanle kpundii kɛ sonla mɔɔ ɛnwu Nyamenle ne mɔɔ bɛnnwu ye la. 28 Diedi zo yɛɛ ɔluale ɔhyehyɛle Akpabɛnwo ne na ɔmanle Yizilayɛma vale mogya kpondenle bɛ nlenkɛ nloa a, amaa saa Nyamenle Ewule Soanvolɛ ne ba a yeangu Yizilayɛma belamunli mralɛ ne mɔ.
29 Diedi zo yɛɛ Yizilayɛma luale mɔɔ bɛpɛle Ndɔ Nyevile ne kɛ asɛɛ bɛlua azɛlɛ resee zo la a; mɔɔ Yigyibitima yɛle kɛ bɛdabɛ noko bɛpɛ la, azule ne vale bɛ.
30 Diedi zo yɛɛ Yizilayɛma luale bɔle suakpole Gyɛleko bane ne mgbɔlɔka dedee kenle nsuu manle ɔgolole ɔguale a. 31 Diedi zo yɛɛ ɔlua mɔɔ bɛangu tuutuunli Releehabe kɛ menli anzosesebɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ kpole Nyamenle la a, ɔluakɛ ɔliele Yizilayɛma mɔɔ rale banleɛnlea maanle ne anu na bɛahɔha la azie, na ɔnleanle bɛ gyɛlɛɛnye.
32 Boni bieko a menga a? Ɔluakɛ saa meka kɛ mekɔ zolɛ meaha menli mɔɔ le kɛ Gedɛyɔn, Bɛlake, Samesɛn, Gyɛfeta, Devidi, Samoɛle, yɛɛ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma ne mɔ anwo edwɛkɛ a mekɛ kɛbɔ me. 1 Arl 2.11; 1 Sam 1.1—25.1 33 Bɛluale diedi zo bɛhonle na bɛlile maanle dɔɔnwo anwo zo konim. Bɛnleanle bɛmanle pɛlepɛlelilɛ yɛle gyima na bɛnyianle Nyamenle ɛwɔkɛ ne mɔ. Bɛluale diedi zo bɛhanle awenade nloa bɛdole nu, 34 bɛnluanle sendɔlɔra, yɛɛ bɛango bɛandɔ. Ɛnee bɛle bɛtɛɛ, noko bɛ nwo yɛle se; bɛ nwo yɛle ɛzulolɛ wɔ konle nu na bɛmanle nyɛvolɛ ɛlɔnema guale ndwɛlɛ aze. 35 Diedi zo yɛɛ ɔlua mɔɔ mraalɛ mɔɔ bɛ mra wule la bɛdwazole bɛ bɛrale ngoane nu a.
Bie mɔ noko mɔɔ kpole ewiade ye anu fanwodi biala la, bɛyɛle bɛ asa na bɛwule, amaa Nyamenle adwazo bɛ ahɔ ngoane kpalɛ nu. 36 Bɛzile bie mɔ amgbu, bɛbole bɛ, yɛɛ bɛguale bie mɔ anga na bɛguale bɛ efiade. 37 Bɛzile bie mɔ awolɛ, bɛvale sɛlada bɛkpakyekpakyele bie mɔ anu nwiɔ nwiɔ, [bɛzɔle dɔɔnwo bɛnleanle,] bɛvale dadeɛ bɛpepɛle bie mɔ akɔme. Bɛhedale mboane nee mbɔnkye nwoma, bɛlile ehyia, bɛlile nyane, yɛɛ bɛyɛle bɛ amumuyɛ. 38Ewiade anyɛ fɛ fee ammaa bɛ! Bɛluoluale nuhua kɛ nyɛvolɛ wɔ ɛsɛlɛ nee awoka zo na bɛdɛnlanle awolɛ mbɔne nee adokule nu wɔ azɛlɛ bo.
39Nea duma mɔɔ menli zɛhae mɔ lua diedi zo ɛnyia ye a! Noko bɛannyia mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛva ɛbɔ ɛwɔkɛ la, 40ɔboalekɛ Nyamenle ɛbɔ gyinlabelɛ kpalɛ mɔɔ ɔfa yeamaa yɛ la anwo kpɔkɛ. Ye ngyehyɛlɛ ne titile a le kɛ saa yɛboka bɛ nwo a yɛɛ bɛkɛli munli a.

Title: HIB 12
Content:
Nyamenle le yɛ ze
1Zɔhane ati, kɛmɔ yɛlɛ dasevolɛma pemgbenleamgbe ɛhye mɔ mɔɔ ɛbɔ yɛ nwo mgbɔlɔka ɛyia la, bɛmaa yɛye debie biala mɔɔ si yɛ aze, nee ɛtane mɔɔ ɛgya yɛ la ali, na yɛmia yɛ nwo kpalɛ yɛnlea ɛnriandilɛ ne mɔɔ gyi yɛ nyunlu la. 2Bɛmaa yɛnlea Gyisɛse angome ala, yemɔ yɛɛ ɔli yɛ nyunlu wɔ diedi nu na ɔmaa yɛ diedi di munli a. Ɔlua anyelielɛ mɔɔ ɛnee la ɔ nyunlu la ati, yeandwenle anyiemgba ewule ne mɔɔ ɔbawu meanubaka ne azo la anwo, na kɛkala ɔde Nyamenle belemgbunli ebia ne fema zo.
3Bɛdwenle ɛkpɔlɛ mɔɔ Gyisɛse nyianle ye, nee kɛ ɔzile ɔgyinlanle kpundii wɔ ɛkpɔlɛ bebelebe ne anloa, wɔ ɛtanevolɛma asa nu la anwo, na bɛmmamaa bɛ rɛle bɔ anzɛɛ bɛ gyakɛ anzi tuto. 4Bɛ nee ɛtane bɛ konle ye anu, bɛtɛdwule ye kpɔmgbɔse ne mɔɔ ɛhunlɛ bɔbɔ finde nu a. 5 Anzɛɛ bɛ rɛle ɛvi akɛnrazilɛ edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ Nyamenle ka kile bɛ kɛ bɛle ɔ mra la ɔ? Ɔse,
“Me ra, saa Awulae tea wɔ a
die ye fɛlɛko nu,
yɛɛ saa ɔtwi ɛ nyunlu a
mmamaa ɛ rɛle bɔ.
6Ɔluakɛ Awulae tea mɔɔ ɔkulo ye la,
na ɔtwi ɔ ra biala mɔɔ ɔdie ye la anyunlu.”
7Bɛlie nyane biala mɔɔ kɛdo bɛ la kɛ ɔle Nyamenle Selɛ ne ndeanlɛ, na bɛ nyanenwunlɛ ne kile kɛ Nyamenle ɛlɛyɛ bɛ kɛ ɔkɛyɛ ɔ mra la. Asoo ralɛ bie wɔ ɛkɛ mɔɔ ɔ ze ɛnrɛdea ye kenle ko bɔbɔ ɛlɛ? 8Saa bɛandea bɛ kɛ mralɛ ɛhendeɛ ne mɔ la a, ɛnee ɔkile kɛ bɛnle mralɛ kpalɛ, na bɛle arelazinli mralɛ. 9Saa yɛ ze mɔ mɔɔ wole yɛ la tea yɛ a, yɛdi bɛ eni. Fane nyɛ yɛɛ akee yɛnrɛli yɛ sunsum nu Selɛ ne eni na yɛnrɛnyia ngoane a? 10Yɛ ze mɔ mɔɔ wole yɛ la tea yɛ mekɛ ekyi bie ala, kɛmɔ bɛdabɛ bɛnea a ɔle kpalɛ la, na Nyamenle tea yɛ wɔ yɛdayɛ yɛ kpalɛ ti, amaa kenle bie yɛanyia ye nwuanzanwuanzayɛlɛ ne bie. 11Kɛkala, ndeanlɛ biala ɛnyɛ fɛ, ɔyɛ nyane, noko nzinlii bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛzɔ bɛ ndeanlɛ nu na bɛkɛva nu ma la sɔ ɛnyelɛ na bɛnyia anzonudwolɛ wɔ bɛ ɛbɛlabɔlɛ nu.
Folɛdulɛ nee kɔkɔbɔlɛ
12 Zɔhane ati bɛ sa ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛyɛ bɛ dwɔlɔmgbɔɔnwo la, bɛmaa bɛ zo na bɛmiemia bɛ gyakɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ ɛtuto la anu! 13 Bɛlua ndenle kpalɛ nu, amaa bɛ agbɔkɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ ɛtuto la andwɔlɔdwɔlɔ, na bɛazianyizianyi.
14Bɛbɔ mɔdenle kɛ bɛ nee menli kɔsɔɔti kɛdɛnla anzonudwolɛ nu na bɛmaa bɛ ɛbɛla nwo ɛde nwuanzaanwu, ɔboalekɛ mɔɔ anyɛ ye zɔhane la ɔyɛ se kɛ ɔkɛnwu Nyamenle. 15 Bɛnlea boɛ na bɛ bie ande anvi Nyamenle ɛlolɛ ne anwo. Bɛnlea boɛ na bɛ bie angakyi ɔ nwo “baka gyangoyi” ambɛkɛbɛka mbaka gyɛne nwo anguhu ɔ gɔnwo mɔ. 16 Bɛnlea boɛ na bɛ bie annyia subane ɛtane anzɛɛ anyɛ kɛ Yisɔ mɔɔ nyamenlezonlenlɛ ɛnle ye nu la ati, yeangola ɔ nwo sɔ na aleɛ ti ɔdɔnenle ye kpanyinli la. 17 Bɛdabɛ bɛze kɛ nzinlii, ɛnee akee ɔkpondɛ ɔ ze nyilalɛ, na ɔzunle ɔhwinle monle, noko ɔ sa anga ye, ɔluakɛ yeannwu adenle mɔɔ ɔfa zolɛ a mɔɔ yeyɛ la ɔkɛhola ɔkɛhakyi ye a.
18 Ɔluakɛ bɛtɛbadwule Boka Saenae azo, ɛleka mɔɔ Yizilayɛma dwule la, na bɛanwu sendɔlɔra ne, awozinli kabikabi ne nee ye kumɔɔnwo ne, nee ahumu ne, 19na bɛade aweɛne tendenle ne ane yɛɛ ɛnelɛ totohyia ne, mɔɔ Yizilayɛma dele a bɛzele kɛ akee yebo zo, na bɛzɛlɛle kɛ edwɛkɛ ne ɛyɛ boɛ la. 20 Ɔboalekɛ ɛnee mɛla ne mɔɔ bɛvale bɛmanle bɛ kɛ, “Saa nane bɔbɔ agyakɛ tia boka ne anwo a, bɛzi ye awolɛ bɛhu ye” la, bɛngola nu sɔ. 21 Nɔhalɛ, ɛkɛ ne yɛle ɛzulolɛ kpalɛ, manle Mosisi bɔbɔ hanle kɛ, “Mesulo, megyinla a ɔngyinla!”
22Na bɛmɛ bɛra Boka Zayɔn, wɔ tease Nyamenle ne suakpole ne mɔɔ le anwuma lɔ Gyɛlusalɛm ne, mɔɔ Nyamenle soanvolɛma apenle apenle mɔɔ bɛnze bɛ nloa la ɛyi ye tɛkɛɛ la azo. 23Bɛra anyelielɛ ayia ne mɔɔ Nyamenle amra mgbanyinli ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛhɛlɛ bɛ aluma wɔ anwuma lɔ la a kɔ la bie. Bɛra Nyamenle mɔɔ le menli kɔsɔɔti ndɛnebuavolɛ la ɛkɛ, yɛɛ bɛra fɔɔnwoma mɔɔ bɛmaa bɛ sunsum ɛli munli la ɛkɛ. 24 Bɛra Gyisɛse, mɔɔ kyekyele Ngyekyeleɛ Fofolɛ ne abo, nee mogya ne mɔɔ bɛhwinle bɛguale na ɔtendɛ kpalɛ ɔkile yɛ ɔtɛla Ebulu ɛdeɛ ne la ɛkɛ.
25 Zɔhane ati, bɛnlea boɛ, na bɛamkpo kɛ bɛnrɛdie mɔɔ ɛlɛtendɛ la. Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkpole kɛ bɛnrɛdie mɔɔ hanle Nyamenle anloa edwɛkɛ ne hilele bɛ wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo la, anvi ɛsalɛ. Na saa akee yɛmɛ yɛkpo kɛ yɛnrɛdie mɔɔ tendɛ fi anwuma lɔ kile yɛ la a, kɛ ɔkɛyɛ na yɛavi ɛsalɛ ɛ? 26 Mekɛ ne anu ɔ ne manle azɛlɛ kpusule, na ɛnɛ noko yevua kɛ, “Eza mebakpusu ye bieko. Tɛ azɛlɛ ye angome, na mebakpusu anwuma noko.” 27Edwɛkɛ kpɔkɛ ɛhye, “eza bieko” ne kile kɛ abɔdeɛ muala bakpusu na bɛadudu bɛ bɛavi ɛkɛ, na mɔɔ kɛhola kɛgyinla na ɔ bo andu la baha ɛkɛ.
28Zɔhane ati, bɛmaa yɛyɛ Nyamenle mo kɛ yemaa yɛ belemgbunlililɛ kpalɛ mɔɔ abo ɛmkpusu ɛlɛ, na yɛva ɛzulolɛ, enililɛ yɛɛ moyɛlɛ yɛzonle ye yɛmaa ɔzɔ ɔ nye, 29 ɔluakɛ yɛ Nyamenle ne le sendɔlɔra.

Title: HIB 13
Content:
Kɛ yɛsi yɛsɔ Nyamenle anye la
1Bɛhɔ zo bɛhulo bɛ nwo ngoko ngoko kɛ mediema mɔɔ nee Kelaese a lua la. 2 Bɛhakye kɛ bɛkɛlie nyɛvolɛ wɔ bɛ azua nu. Bie mɔ ɛyɛ bie zɔhane na bɛlie Nyamenle soanvolɛma wɔ bɛ azua nu mɔɔ bɛnze a. 3Bɛhakye bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛgua bɛ efiade la, na bɛdwenle bɛ nwo kɛ asɛɛ bɛ nee bɛ a gua efiade ne a. Bɛhakye menli mɔɔ ɛlɛnwu amaneɛ la, na bɛdwenle bɛ nwo kɛ bɛdabɛ noko bɛlɛnwu nyane ne bie.
4Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛbu agyalɛ bie kpalɛ kpalɛ, na kunli nee yelɛ di nɔhalɛ maa bɛ nwo. Nyamenle badea bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛle adwɔmane nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛdo awuvolɛvalɛ mɛla ne la.
5 Bɛye ezukoa nwo anyebolo bɛvi bɛ ɛbɛla nu, na bɛmaa bɛ kunlu ɛdwo mɔɔ bɛlɛ ye la anwo. Ɔluakɛ Nyamenle ɛha ye kɛ, “Menrɛgyakyi bɛ ɛlɛ, yɛɛ me rɛle ɛnrɛvi bɛ fee.” 6 Zɔhane ati, yɛkola yɛsi yɛ kɛnra yɛka kɛ,
“Awulae le me boavolɛ,
menrɛzulo ɛhwee.
Duzu yɛɛ sonla kola yɛ me a?”
7Bɛhakye bɛ mgbanyima ne mɔ, mɔɔ hanle Nyamenle edwɛkɛ ne hilele bɛ la. Bɛdwenle bɛnwu kɛ bɛzile bɛbɔle bɛ ɛbɛla ne la, nee bɛ ewule nu, na bɛzukoa bɛ diedi ne mɔɔ ɛnee bɛlɛ la. 8Kɛ Gyisɛse Kelaese si de anoma la, ɔle zɔhane ɛnɛ nee kenle biala. 9Bɛmmamaa ngilehilelɛ ngakyile biala twe bɛ fi adenle kpalɛ ne mɔɔ bɛlua zo la azo. Ɔle kpalɛ kɛ yɛkɛmaa Nyamenle ɛlolɛ ne kɛmaa yɛ ɛkɛla nwo kɛyɛ se tɛla kɛ yɛkɛli aleɛ nwo ngyehyɛlɛ zo la, ɔluakɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛlile ngyehyɛlɛ zɛhae mɔ anzi la, yeamboa bɛ.
10Yɛlɛ azukponle mɔɔ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛyɛ gyima wɔ ndanlɛ sua ne anu la ɛnlɛ adenle kɛ bɛkɛli zolɛ a. 11 Ɔluakɛ saa Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli ne fa nane ne mɔɔ bɛfa bɛabɔ ɛtanefakyɛ azu ne la mogya ba Nwuanzanwuanza nu Nwuanzaanwu Ɛleka ne baye ɛdɛne a, nane mumua ne, bɛyela ye wɔ nzeseɛ ne anzi lɔ. 12Zɔhane ala yɛɛ Gyisɛse wule suakpole ne kandiba lɔ, amaa yeava ye mogya ne yeanrinzi menli ne ɛtane ne mɔ. 13Zɔhane ati, bɛmaa yɛvinde yɛdoa ye wɔ kandiba lɔ, na ye nyiane ne ɛha yɛ muala. 14Ɔluakɛ wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo, yɛnlɛ suakpole biala mɔɔ gyi ɛkɛ ne kpɔkpɔ a; yɛ nye la suakpole kpalɛ bie mɔɔ bara la ade. 15Yemɔti, bɛmaa yɛva ayɛlɛyelɛ yɛlua Gyisɛse anwo zo yɛmaa Nyamenle. Ɛhye a le azubɔlɛ kpalɛ mɔɔ ɛnloanlɛ mɔɔ bɔ ye duma kɛ ɔle Awulae la kola bɔ a. 16Bɛmmamaa bɛ rɛle fi kɛ bɛkɛyɛ kpalɛ na bɛkɛboa bɛ nwo ngoko ngoko, ɔboalekɛ ɛhye a le azubɔlɛ mɔɔ sɔ Nyamenle anye a.
17Bɛdie bɛ mgbanyima ne mɔ na bɛli bɛ mɛla zo. Mgbanyima zɛhae mɔ a dahuu nea bɛ ɛkɛla zo a, ɔboalekɛ bɛbabu bɛ gyima nwo mgbonda bɛahile Nyamenle. Saa bɛtie bɛ nloa edwɛkɛ a, bɛdabɛ noko bɛbava fɛlɛkolilɛ bɛayɛ bɛ gyima. Saa tɛ ye zɔhane ɛdeɛ a, bɛbava nyanelilɛ a bɛayɛ a, na ɛhye noko ɛnrɛboa bɛ kpalɛ biala.
18Bɛhɔ zolɛ bɛzɛlɛ bɛmaa yɛ. Yɛsi pi kɛ yɛ adwenle nu le wienyi, ɔboalekɛ yɛkpondɛ kɛ dahuu yɛyɛ mɔɔ le kpalɛ la. 19Mesɛlɛ bɛ kɛ anrɛɛ bɛyɛ nzɛlɛlɛ kɛ Nyamenle kɛmaa menwɔzia menwɔra bɛ nwo lɔ bieko ndɛndɛ.
Nzɛlɛlɛ
20Anzonudwolɛ Nyamenle ne mɔɔ dwazole yɛ Awulae Gyisɛse, mɔɔ le Mboaneneavolɛ Kpole ne, mɔɔ luale ye ewule azubɔlɛ zo zɔle ngyekyeleɛ ne mɔɔ bɛntulu ye ɛlɛ la anloa la vile ewule nu la, 21ɛmaa bɛ sa ɛha debie biala mɔɔ le kpalɛ la. Nyamenle ɛmaa bɛhola bɛyɛ mɔɔ ɔkulo la, na ɔlua Gyisɛse Kelaese anwo zo ɔva bɛ ɔyɛ gyima mɔɔ sɔ ɔ nye la. Anyunlunyia ɛha Kelaese dahuu! Amen.
Nrɛlaleɛ mɔɔ li amozi
22Mebodo bɛ, me mediema, bɛzi abotane bɛdie akɛnrazilɛ nrɛlaleɛ ɛhye, ɔluakɛ kɛlata ɛhye mɔɔ mehɛlɛ bɛ la anwa biala. 23Memaa bɛade kɛ bɛye adiema nrenya Temɔte bɛvi efiade. Saa ɔba ɛke ndɛndɛ a, me nee ye yɛbarakpɔla bɛ.
24Yɛbiza bɛ mgbanyima ne nee Nyamenle menli ne mɔ amuala ahye. Mediema mɔɔ vi Yetale ɛra ɛke la se bɛbiza bɛ ahye.
25Nyamenle ɛlo bɛ na ɔ nee bɛ muala ɛdɛnla! Amen.

Title: GYE MUKENYE
Content:
Mukenye
Kɛlata ne mɔɔ Gyemise hɛlɛle la le ɛbɛlabɔlɛ nu ngilehilelɛ ngyikyi ngyikyi bie mɔɔ bɛboɔboale ɔ nloa, na bɛhɛlɛle bɛhɔmanle “Nyamenle menli ne mɔ mɔɔ ɛde ɛkponde ewiade la amuala” a. Mɔɔ hɛlɛle la vale mrɛlɛbulɛ hilehilele ninyɛne mɔɔ fane Keleseɛnema nrɛlɛbɛ ɛvalɛ wɔ bɛ ɛbɛla nu nee bɛ nwo boɛnleanlɛ wɔ bɛ nyɛleɛ nwo. Ɔvale Kelaese menli ne gyinlabelɛ ne ɔdole ninyɛne dɔɔnwo mɔɔ le kɛ anwonyia nee ehyia, sɔnea, ɛbɛla kpalɛ ɛbɔlɛ, suzuka, diedi nee nyɛleɛ, ɛdendɛlɛ, nrɛlɛbɛ, butulelilɛ, adubɛnwo nee mɛlɛbɛnwoaze, awie mɔ ndɛnebualɛ, adubɛnloanu, abotane yɛɛ nzɛlɛlɛ nwo ɔhanle edwɛkɛ.
Kɛlata ne si zo ka kɛ wɔ Keleseɛnema ɛzonlenlɛ ne anu, ɔhyia kɛ nyɛleɛ nee diedi kɛhɔ ko.
Mɔɔ wɔ nu la
Ngilenu 1.1
Diedi nee nrɛlɛbɛ 1.2-8
Ehyia nee anwonyia 1.9-11
Sɔnea nee ngyegyelɛ 1.12-18
Ɛdielɛ nee ɛyɛlɛ 1.19-27
Ngilehilenu nwo kɔkɔbɔlɛ 2.1-13
Diedi nee gyima 2.14-26
Keleseɛnenli nee ye ɛdendɛlɛ 3.1-18
Keleseɛnenli nee ewiade 4.1—5.6
Ngilehilelɛ ɛdodo 5.7-20

Title: GYE 1
Content:
1Kɛlata ɛhye vi Gyemise, Nyamenle nee Awulae Gyisɛse Kelaese akɛlɛ ne ɛkɛ.
Mebiza Nyamenle menli ne mɔɔ ɛde ɛkponde aleɛabo la amuala kɔsɔɔti ahye.
Diedi nee nrɛlɛbɛ
2Me mediema, saa sɔnea ngakyile dɔɔnwo ba bɛ nwo zo a bɛli nwolɛ fɛlɛko; 3ɔluakɛ bɛze kɛ saa bɛ diedi maa bɛkola sɔnea ɛhye mɔ anloa gyinla a ɛnee ɔkile kɛ bɛlɛ diedi nu anwosesebɛ. 4Bɛzi pi wɔ anwosesebɛ ɛhye anu na bɛgyinla kpundii mɔɔ bɛmkpo aze ɛlɛ, amaa bɛali munli bɔkɔɔ mɔɔ bɛngyia debie biala anwo a. 5Saa bɛ nuhua bie hyia nrɛlɛbɛ a, ɔzɛlɛ Nyamenle na ɔkɛva ɔkɛmaa ye; ɔboalekɛ Nyamenle ati akunlu le kɛnlɛma na ɔyila bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛbiza ye debie la. 6Noko anrɛɛ bɛva diedi mɔɔ bɛ ti anu keseeyɛlɛ anzɛɛ kpolerazulɛ biala ɛnle nu la bɛbiza. Mɔɔ ye adwenle ɛngyinla la le kɛ nyevile sɛlɛkye mɔɔ anwoma bɔ ye kɔ ba la. 7-8Sonla mɔɔ le zɛhae, mɔɔ ɛngola ɛnzi ye adwenle pi wɔ debie biala mɔɔ ɔyɛ la anwo la mmadwenle kɛ ɔkɛnyia debie ɔkɛvi Awulae ɛkɛ.
Ehyea nee anwonyia
9Keleseɛnenli biala mɔɔ anrɛɛ di ehyia na Nyamenle ɛmaa ye zo la ɛli fɛlɛko, 10 yɛɛ Keleseɛnenli biala mɔɔ le sukoavolɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle kɛha ye aze la ɛmaa ɔ nye ɛlie. Ɔluakɛ sukoavolɛma bakpolo agua kɛ ɛhoayelɛ nu ndotolo. 11Sɛnzɛne ne tudu a ɔfi ye ewia wuluwulu ne ɔbɔ ndile ɔmaa ɔkyengye, ye ndotolo ne kpolo gua, na ɔminle ye kɛnlɛma ne. Zɔhane ala yɛɛ sukoavolɛ mɔɔ anye wɔ ye gyima nwo ala la baminli a.
Sɔnea nee ngyegyelɛ
12Nyilalɛ ɛha sonla ne mɔɔ kɛgyinla kpundii wɔ sɔnea nu la, ɔboalekɛ saa ɔko ɔtɔ zolɛ a ye ahatualɛ a le ngoane ne mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛva ɛbɔ menli mɔɔ kulo ye la ɛwɔkɛ la. 13Saa awie kɔ ngyegyelɛ nu a ɔmmaka kɛ, “Nyamenle ɛlɛsɔ me anlea.” Ɔluakɛ ɛtane ɛngola ɛnzɔ Nyamenle ɛnnea yɛɛ Nyamenle mumua ne ɛnzɔ awie biala ɛnnea. 14Sonla ɔdaye ye atiakunluwɔzo ɛtane ne a sɔ ye nea na ɔtwe ye ɔfi Nyamenle anwo a. 15Saa ye munzule atiakunluwɔzo ne nrenzɛ a ɔwo ɛtane, yɛɛ ɛtane wie nyi a ɔwie ewule.
16Me mediema kulovolɛma, bɛmmamaa bɛbɛlɛbɛla bɛ! 17Ɛlolɛdeɛ kpalɛ biala nee ahyɛlɛdeɛ biala mɔɔ di munli la vi anwuma; ɔvi Nyamenle Selɛ ne mɔɔ bɔle anwuma ahɛnlaneɛ ne mɔ la ɛkɛ a ɔba a. Nyamenle ɛnli ngakyile, anzɛɛ ɔmboa ɔngakyi wienyi awozinli. 18Ɔdaye ye ɛhulolɛ zo yɛɛ ɔluale nɔhalɛ edwɛkɛ ne azo ɔwole yɛ a, amaa yɛayɛ ye abɔdeɛ nu alumuama.
Ɛdielɛ nee ɛyɛlɛ
19Mediema kulovolɛma, bɛhakye ɛhye. Ɔwɔ kɛ awie biala tie ɔ nzo anwo, ɔmmatendɛ dɔɔnwo yɛɛ ɔmmafa ɛya. 20Ɛyavalɛ ɛmmaa sonla ɛnzɔ Nyamenle anye. 21Yemɔti bɛvuandi subane ɛtane nee nyɛleɛ ɛtane kɔsɔɔti bɛgua na bɛdo bɛ nwo aze bɛmaa Nyamenle, bɛlie edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ yelua ye wɔ bɛ ahonle nu la bɛdo nu, na yemɔ yɛɛ ɔkola ɔdie bɛ ngoane a.
22Bɛmmabɛlɛbɛla bɛ nwo bɛyɛ mɔɔ asɛɛ bɛtie ye edwɛkɛ ne ala a; bɛyɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛde la. 23Mɔɔ kɛdie edwɛkɛ ne na yeanva yeambɔ ye ɛbɛla la le kɛ sonla mɔɔ nea ɔ nyunlu wɔ neanleɛ nu la. 24Ɔnea ɔ nyunlu ɔwie na ɔkɔ a ɛkɛ ne ala ɔ rɛle fi ɔdaye ye sonla holɛ mɔɔ ɔzɔho ye la. 25Na awie mɔɔ neɛnlea fanwodi mɛla ne mɔɔ di munli la anu, na ɔsɔ nu dwaa ɔfa ɔbɔ ye ɛbɛla, na ɔndie ye mgbane ala ɔmmaa ɔ rɛle ɛnvi, na ɔyɛ gyima mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ ɔyɛ la, yemɔ yɛɛ Nyamenle kɛyila ye wɔ ye ɛbɛlabɔlɛ nu a.
26Saa awie dwenle kɛ ɔsonle Nyamenle na ɔmmua ɔ nloa azo a, ye Nyamenlezonlenlɛ ne le mgbane, na ɔbɛlɛbɛla ɔdaye ye ɛkɛla. 27Nyamenlezonlenlɛ kpalɛ mɔɔ evinli biala ɛnle nwolɛ wɔ Nyamenle Selɛ ne anyunlu la a le kɛ ɛkɛkpɔla nrisa nee ahunlanvolɛ wɔ bɛ anwongyelelɛ nu, ɛkɛboa bɛ na ɛkɛzie ɛ nwo gyɛlɛɛnye mɔɔ ewiade amra ɛnnyia ɛ nwo ngehanleɛ biala la.

Title: GYE 2
Content:
Suzuka nwo kɔkɔbɔlɛ
1Me mediema, kɛmɔ bɛlɛ diedi wɔ yɛ Awulae Gyisɛse Kelaese, mɔɔ le anyunlunyia Awulae ne la anu la ati, bɛmmanea sonla nyunlu na bɛabu ye bie. 2Saa ngyengyene nu bie sukoavolɛ mɔɔ ezukoa nvutuke mgbɔdelera gua ɔ sa na ɔheda ɛdakpa la ba bɛ nyianu ne bie, na ehyianli mɔɔ heda ɛdanlɛ mgbane bie la ɔdaye noko ɔba bie, na 3saa bɛkile anyenzɔlɛ bɛmaa mɔɔ heda ɛdanlɛ kɛnlɛma ne la, na bɛse ye kɛ, “Mesɛlɛ wɔ, tɛnla ebia kpalɛ ɛhye azo.” na bɛse ehyianli ne kɛ, “Gyinla nehane, anzɛɛ tɛnla aze wɔ me gyakɛ abo ɛke” a, 4ɛnee bɛdi ngilehilenu nwo fɔlɛ na bɛlua adwenle ɛtane zo bɛbua ndɛne mɔɔ ɛngɔ adenle nu a.
5Me mediema kulovolɛma, bɛdie! Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛle ehyianvolɛma wɔ aleɛabo la, bɛmɛ a Nyamenle ɛkpa nu ɛye bɛ, ɛyɛ bɛ diedi nu sukoavolɛma na bɛnyia Nyamenle belemgbunlililɛ ne, mɔɔ yeva yebɔ ɛwɔkɛ yemaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkulo ye la a. 6Na bɛmɛ bɛmbu ehyianvolɛma bie. Asoo tɛ sukoavolɛma a sisi bɛ na bɛtwili bɛ bɛkɔ ndɛnebuavolɛma anyunlu la? 7Asoo tɛ sukoavolɛma a ka duma kpalɛ ne mɔɔ bɛfa bɛfɛlɛ bɛ la anwo edwɛkɛ ɛtane ɛtane la?
8 Saa bɛdi Belemgbunlililɛ ne anwo mɛla ne, mɔɔ Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se la kɛ, “Kulo ɛ gɔnwo kɛ ɛdawɔ ɛ nwo” la azo a, ɛnee bɛlua nɔhalɛ adenle ne anu. 9Na saa bɛnea sonla nyunlu na bɛabu ye bie a, ɛnee bɛyɛ ɛtane, na mɛla ne bu bɛ fɔlɛ. 10Ɔluakɛ awie biala mɔɔ se ɔdi mɛla ne amuala azo na ɔkɛvo nuhua edwɛkɛ kpɔkɛ ko la ɛdo mɛla ne amuala. 11 Ɔluakɛ sonla ko ne ala mɔɔ hanle kɛ, “Mmafa awuvolɛ” la yɛɛ hanle kɛ, “Mmaku sonla” a. Yemɔti saa wɔanva awuvolɛ na ɛku sonla a ɛnee wɔdo mɛla. 12Bɛdendɛ na bɛbɔ bɛ ɛbɛla kɛ menli mɔɔ bɛbava fanwodi mɛla ne bɛabua bɛ ndɛne la. 13Sonla mɔɔ ɛnze anwunvɔne la, Nyamenle ɛnrɛze ye anwunvɔne wɔ ye ndɛnebualɛ nu; anwunvɔnezelɛ fo keda ndɛnebualɛ zo.
Diedi nee nyɛleɛ
14Me mediema, saa awie ka ye kɛ, “Melɛ diedi” na ye nyɛleɛ ɛngile zɔhane a, ɛnee duzu nvasoɛ yɛɛ ɔnyia a? Asoo ye diedi zɔhane kɛhola kɛlie ye ngoane? 15Saa adiema nrenya bie anzɛɛ adiema raalɛ bie ɛnlɛ ɛdanlɛ ɛngeda yɛɛ ɔhyia aleɛ nwo, 16na ɛse ye kɛ, “Nyamenle ɛyila wɔ. Ɛ nwo ɛyɛ wɔ wuluwulu na di aleɛ maa ɛ ko ɛyi” na saa wɔammaa ye ninyɛne mɔɔ hyia maa ngoane la a ɛnee duzu nvasoɛ a wɔ mɔɔ ɛka la azo a? 17Zɔhane ati diedi mɔɔ gyimayɛlɛ ɛmboka nwo la le wulera.
18Awie baze kɛ, “Sonla ne bie lɛ diedi yɛɛ ko noko kola yɛ gyima.” Me mualɛ a le kɛ, kile me kɛ sonla si nyia diedi mɔɔ gyimayɛlɛ ɛmboka nwo la, na medame noko menwɔva me gyimayɛlɛ menwɔhile wɔ me diedi. 19Bɛdie bɛdi kɛ Nyamenle kokye a wɔ ɛkɛ a. Ɔdaye ne ala ɛne! Mbɔnsam noko die di, na ɛzulolɛ maa bɛ nwo wozo bɛ. 20Kɔnwɔne! Ɛkulo kɛ bɛkile wɔ kɛ diedi mɔɔ gyimayɛlɛ ɛmboka nwo la ɛnzo ma ɔ? 21Kɛ Ebileham zile zɔle Nyamenle anye ɛ? Ɔluale gyimayɛlɛ zo wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɔvale ɔ ra Ayezeke ɔhɔle kɛ ɔlɛ ye ɔkabɔ azu yeamaa Nyamenle la. 22Ɛkola ɛnwu kɛ ye diedi nee ye gyimayɛlɛ bɔle nuhua yɛle gyima; ye gyimayɛlɛ ne manle ye diedi ne lile munli. 23 Ɛhye maa Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne yɛ nɔhalɛ kɛ, “Ebileham liele Nyamenle lile, na ɔlua ye diedi ti Nyamenle liele ye kɛ ɔle sonla tenlene.” Na ɔlua zolɛ bɛvɛlɛle Ebileham Nyamenle agɔnwo. 24Yemɔti ɛkola ɛnwu ye kɛ sonla gyimayɛlɛ a maa ɔsɔ Nyamenle anye a, na tɛ ye diedi ngome ɔ.
25 Kɛ tuutuunli Releehabe ɔdaye ɔyɛle ala la ɛne. Ɔliele Dwuu soanvolɛma ne mɔɔ rale banleɛnlea maanle ne anu ahɔ la azie na ɔboale bɛ ɔmanle bɛluale adenle fofolɛ nu bɛhɔle. Ye gyima ɛhye manle ɔzɔle Nyamenle anye.
26Yemɔti, kɛmɔ nwonane mɔɔ sunsum ɛnle nu la le funli la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ diedi mɔɔ gyimayɛlɛ ɛmboka nwolɛ la le wulera a.

Title: GYE 3
Content:
Ɛtafinlimalɛ
1Me mediema! Ɔnle kɛ bɛ nuhua dɔɔnwo yɛ kilehilevolɛma, ɔboalekɛ bɛze kɛ yɛmɛ kilehilevolɛma bɛbabua yɛ ndɛne fenlefenle bɛadɛla menli mɔɔ ɛha la. 2Yɛ muala yɛfo wɔ ninyɛne dɔɔnwo anu. Sonla mɔɔ ɛnvo wɔ ye edwɛkɛ ɛhanlɛ nu la di munli na ɔkola ɔsɔ ɔ nwo. 3Yɛfa bulalɛ yɛwula ɛkpɔnwɔ nloa anu, amaa yeadie yɛ ne, na yɛahola yɛamaa ɔ nee yɛ ahɔ ɛleka biala mɔɔ yɛkulo la. 4Bɛnlea amɛle: ɔle kpole yɛɛ anwoma mɔɔ anu yɛ se la a pia ye a; noko bulalɛ ekyi bie a maa ahenle mɔɔ ka amɛle ne la kakyihakyi ɔ nye na ɔmaa ɔkɔ ɛleka biala mɔɔ ɔkulo la a. 5Zɔhane ala yɛɛ ɛtafinlimalɛ de a: ɔle sonlabaka ne nvɛyeba ekyi bie, noko ɔkola ɔfa ninyɛne mgbole ɔtu ɔ nwo.
Bɛdabɛ bɛnlea kɛ senle ekyi si yela, sɛkye ɛbɔ nu mbaka la. 6Ɛtafinlimalɛ le senle. Ɔboa ɔle munzule ewiade ekyi kpalɛ wɔ yɛ sonlabaka ne nvɛyeba ne mɔ avinli na ɔfa ɛtane ɔsalo yɛ sonlabaka ne kpokpoti. Ɔle ɛbolɔ senle kpalɛ mɔɔ fa senle to yɛ ɛbɛlabɔlɛ nu a. 7Sonla kola tete nyɛmoa mɔɔ le kɛ nane, nloma, nwɔlɛ yɛɛ nyevile nu fɛlɛ ɔmaa bɛtie ye. 8Noko ɛtanfinlimalɛ ɛdeɛ sonla biala ɛngola ɛmbele ye. Ɔle munzule debie mɔɔ ewule bɔlɔ ɛyi ye tɛkɛɛ a. 9 Ɛtafinlimalɛ ye ala yɛɛ yɛfa yɛyɛ Awulae nee yɛ Ze Nyamenle ne mo a, yɛɛ ɔdaye ko ne ala a yɛfa yɛwa menli mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛbɔ bɛ kɛ ɔdaye ye ɛsaso la amonle a. 10Ɛnloanlɛ ko ye ala anu yɛɛ nyilalɛ nee amowa vi ba a. Me mediema! Ɔnle kɛ ɔba ye zɔhane. 11Nzule fɛlɛko nee nzule tondɔtondɔ ɛnvi nzubula ko anu ɛmba. 12Me mediema! Feege baka ɛngola ɛnzo ɔlivi ma, yɛɛ vanye baka ɛnzo feege ma. Zɔhane ala yɛɛ nzule tondɔtondɔ ɛngola ɛngakyi nzukpa a.
Anwuma nrɛlɛbɛ
13Bɛ nuhua boni a ze nrɛlɛbɛ na ɔlɛ ndelebɛbo a? Bɛmaa ɔva ye ɛbɛlabɔlɛ kpalɛ ɔpɛ kilemunli ɔhile nyɛleɛ kpalɛ mɔɔ bɛfa mɛlɛbɛnwoaze nee nrɛlɛbɛ bɛyɛ la. 14Na saa bɛ ahonle nu bɛle anyebolo, bɛle angomedi a, ɛnee bɛmmatu bɛ nloa anu kɛ bɛze nrɛlɛbɛ na bɛyɛ ɛtane bɛtia nɔhalɛ ne. 15Nrɛlɛbɛ zɛhae ɛnvi anwuma lɔ a ba a; ɔle ewiade nrɛlɛbɛ yɛɛ Nyamenle Sunsum ɛnle sonla ne mɔɔ lɛ ye la nu; sonla zɔhane le abɔnsam. 16Ɛleka mɔɔ anyebolo nee angomedi wɔ la, ɛkɛ ne yɛɛ mgbonde nee munzule ngakyile biala wɔ a. 17Nrɛlɛbɛ ne mɔɔ vi anwuma lɔ la anwo te, mɔɔ lumua la ɛne. Eza ɔle anzonudwolɛ, ɔka ɔ nwo aze, ɔlɛ ndelebɛbo; anwunvɔnezelɛ ɛyi ye tɛkɛɛ yɛɛ ɔso nyɛleɛ kpalɛ biala ma. Ɔndwenle adwenle ɛtane, yɛɛ ɔmbɔ adalɛ. 18Menli mɔɔ kpondɛ anzonudwolɛ na bɛdua anzonudwolɛ nu la bu tenleneyɛlɛ bɛyɔba.

Title: GYE 4
Content:
Ewiade agɔnwolɛvalɛ
1Duzu a twehwe konle ba a, yɛɛ duzu a fa butule ba bɛ avinli a? Asoo tɛ bɛdabɛ bɛ angomedi atiakunluwɔzo ne mɔ a dahuu nee bɛ ko bɛ nuhua la? 2Bɛkpondɛ ninyɛne bie, noko bɛnnyia bie, yemɔti bɛkuhu bɛ nwo; bɛ nye bolo ninyɛne nwo ɛsesebɛ kɛ bɛ kunlu a anrɛɛ, noko bɛnnyia bɛ ɛlɛ, yemɔti bɛdi butule na bɛko. Bɛ sa ɛnga deɛ ne mɔɔ bɛhyia nwo la, ɔluakɛ bɛmbiza Nyamenle. 3Bɛbiza noko a bɛ sa ɛnga ye, ɔboalekɛ bɛnva adwenle kpalɛ bɛmbiza; bɛbiza ninyɛne mɔɔ kɛmaa bɛ ngome bɛ nye kɛlie la. 4Boniayɛma! Bɛnze kɛ saa bɛ nee ewiade tila agɔnwolɛ a ɛnee bɛyɛ Nyamenle agbɔvolɛ ɔ? Sonla mɔɔ fa ewiade ye agɔnwolɛ la kile kɛ ɔle Nyamenle kpɔvolɛ. 5Bɛmmadwenle kɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne ka la le mgbane. Ɔse, “Nyamenle twe ye Sunsum ne mɔɔ yeva yewula yɛ nu la anwo nungule.” 6 Noko Nyamenle ɛlolɛ ne mɔɔ ɔfa ɔmaa la le kpole. Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se, “Nyamenle bɛlɛ mɔɔ le mgbanyizonle la aze, na ɔmaa mɔɔ bɛlɛ ɔ nwo aze la zo.”
7Yemɔti bɛdu bɛ nwo bɛmaa Nyamenle. Bɛmmamaa Abɔnsam adenle, na ɔvi bɛ nwo ɔbanriandi. 8Bɛhwe bɛbikye Nyamenle, na ɔdaye noko ɔkɛbikye bɛ. Bɛmɛ ɛtanevolɛma, bɛhakyi bɛ subane! Bɛde bɛ ahonle nu, bɛmɛ nabalabama! 9Bɛli nyane na bɛzu; bɛmaa bɛ ɛzelekɛ ɛyɛ ɛzunlɛ na bɛ fɛlɛkolilɛ ɛyɛ alɔbɔlɛ. 10Bɛbɛlɛ bɛ nwo aze wɔ Awulae anyunlu, na ɔkɛmaa bɛ zo.
Adiema Keleseɛnenli ndɛnebualɛ nwo kɔkɔbɔlɛ
11Mediema Keleseɛnema, bɛmmakeha bɛ gɔnwo mɔ anwo edwɛkɛ ɛtane ɛtane. Mɔɔ ka ɔ diema anwo edwɛkɛ ɛtane anzɛɛ bua ye ndɛne la tia mɛla ne na eza ɔbua mɛla ne ndɛne. Na saa ɛbua mɛla ne ndɛne a, ɛnee ɔkile kɛ ɛnli mɛla ne azo bieko, na ɛle ye ndɛnebuavolɛ. 12Nyamenle angomekye a kola die ngoane na ɔkola ɔsɛkye ye a. Yemɔ ala a ɔmaa mɛla na ɔle ndɛnebuavolɛ a. Na wɔmɔ, ɛdawɔ a le nwane, mɔɔ ɛbua ɛ gɔnwo ndɛne a?
Adubɛnwo nwo kɔkɔbɔlɛ
13 Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛka kɛ, “Ɛnɛ anzɛɛ ɛhyema yɛbahɔ suakpole ɛhye anzɛɛ ɛhendeɛ ne azo, yeahɔli ɛvolɛ ko, yɛayɛ gyima yeakpondɛ ezukoa dɔɔnwo” la, bɛdie! 14Bɛnze mɔɔ bazi bɛ nwo zo ɛhyema a. Bɛdabɛ mumua ne, bɛ ngoane tendenle le nyɛ? Bɛ ngoane le kɛ nwonlomɔ ɛbɔlɛ la, ɔngyɛ na yeawe na ɔ bo zo aminli. 15Mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛka la a le kɛ, “Saa ɔyɛ Awulae ɛhulolɛ na yɛde ngoane nu a, yɛbayɛ ɛhye anzɛɛ ɛhendeɛ ne.” 16Na bɛmɛ, bɛmemaa bɛ nwo zo, bɛtu bɛ nloa anu; na adubɛnwo ɛhye mɔ amuala le ɛtaneyɛlɛ.
17Yemɔti, sonla ne mɔɔ ze debie kpalɛ mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ ɔyɛ na yeanyɛ la, ɔle ɛtane ɔmaa ye.

Title: GYE 5
Content:
Sukoavolɛma kɔkɔbɔlɛ
1Bɛmɛ sukoavolɛma, bɛdie! Bɛbɔ ɔ bo kɛkala bɛzu bɛye awolɛ wɔ munzule mɔɔ ɛlɛba bɛ nwo zo la ati. 2 Bɛ anwonyia ne ɛkpɔlɔ, yɛɛ nvɔlekɛ ɛli bɛ ndanlɛ ne mɔ. 3Bɛ ezukoa nvutuke nee dwɛtɛ fufule muala ɛlɔ nrɛnlana, na bɛ nrɛnlana mɔɔ bɛlɔ la bayɛ daselɛ atia bɛ na yeali bɛ nwonane ne kɛ senle. Bɛboɔboa anwonyia nloa wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ewiade ye ɛlɛba awieleɛ la. 4 Bɛtɛtuale bɛ gyimayɛvoma ne mɔ mɔɔ yɛ gyima wɔ bɛ ɛya ne mɔ anu la kakɛ. Bɛdie, bɛ ahatualɛ ne mɔɔ bɛ nye fuu bɛanva bɛammaa bɛ la ati, bɛlɛsu, yɛɛ menli mɔɔ boɔboale aleɛ nloa manle bɛ la ɛzunlɛ ne ɛdwu Tumivolɛ Awulae ne anzo nu. 5Bɛ ɛbɛlabɔlɛ wɔ ewiade ye anu ɛyɛ anyelielɛ nee fɛlɛkolilɛ ngome; bɛli bɛ nwo adane, bɛyɛ mbelane kɛ nlankɛ mɔɔ bɛ mekɛ ɛdwu mɔɔ bɛ nee bɛ ɛlɛkɔ ahunleɛ la. 6Bɛbua sonla mɔɔ ɛnli fɔlɛ la ewule fɔlɛ bɛku ye; noko ɔndɛ ɔ nloa anu!
Abotane nee nzɛlɛlɛ
7Yemɔti, mediema, bɛzi abotane bɛhɔkpula Kenle ne mɔɔ Awulae kɛra la. Bɛnlea ɛyazonlɛnli ne, ɔkendɛ ɔmaa azɛlɛ ye maa ye nzoleɛ ngɛnlɛma, ɔsi abotane ɔkendɛ ɔmaa fɔsɛlɛ ne nee bokile ne tɔ zolɛ. 8Bɛdabɛ noko ɔwɔ kɛ bɛsi abotane. Bɛmaa bɛ nye ɛla, ɔluakɛ Awulae ɛralɛ ne ɛbikye.
9Mediema, bɛmmatendɛ bɛ gɔnwo mɔ bɛ nzo abo, amaa bɛambua bɛdabɛ noko bɛ ndɛne. Ndɛnebuavolɛ ne ɛbikye, ɔgyi bɛ nlenkɛ ne mɔ anloa. 10Mediema, bɛhakye Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma ne mɔ mɔɔ luale Awulae duma nu dendɛle la. Bɛva bɛ abotane ne mɔɔ bɛnyianle ye bɛgyinlanle kpundii wɔ nyane nu la bɛyɛ ndonwo. 11 Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛgyinlanle kpundii, bɛvale abotane bɛzɔle nyane bɛhɔle awieleɛ la yɛɛ yɛka kɛ Nyamenle ɛyila bɛ a. Se bɛde Dwobu ɔdaye ye abotane ɛdeɛ ne mɔɔ ɔnyianle ɔvale ɔgyinlanle kpundii ɔzɔle ye nyane ne la anwo bie, yɛɛ eza bɛze kɛ awieleɛ ne Nyamenle zile lole ye la. Nyamenle se anwunvɔne yɛɛ ɔ kunlu yelɛyela ye.
12 Me mediema, mɔɔ hyia kpole kpalɛ la a le kɛ, bɛmmaka ndane hweledede; bɛmmaka anwuma anzɛɛ aze anzɛɛ debie gyɛne biala bɔbɔ. Bɛmaa bɛ “Ɛhɛe” ɛyɛ ɛhɛe, bɛ “Kyɛkyɛ” ɛyɛ kyɛkyɛ, amaa Nyamenle andea bɛ.
13Bɛ nuhua bie wɔ ngyegyelɛ nu ɔ? Bɛmaa ɔzɛlɛ. Bie ɛlɛdi fɛlɛko ɔ? Bɛmaa ɔdo ayɛlɛyelɛ edwɛne. 14Bɛ nuhua bie ɛnde kpɔkɛ ɔ? Bɛmaa ɔvɛlɛ asɔne mgbanyima ne mɔ na bɛzɛlɛ bɛmaa ye, na bɛkpokpa ye nwole wɔ Awulae duma nu. 15Saa bɛfa diedi bɛyɛ nzɛlɛlɛ ɛhye a, wuleravolɛ ne anwo baza; Awulae badwazo ye, na saa yeyɛ ɛtane a yeava ye ɛtane yeahyɛ ye. 16Yemɔti, bɛha bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ bɛhile bɛ nwo ngoko ngoko, na bɛzɛlɛ bɛmaa bɛ nwo ngoko ngoko, na bɛkɛde kpɔkɛ. Sonla tenlene biala nzɛlɛlɛ yɛ nla eza tumi wɔ nu. 17 Yilaegya le sonla kɛ yɛdayɛ ala la; noko ɔzɛlɛle kɛ ezule mmatɔ la, ezule andɔ azɛlɛ ye azo dedee ɛvolɛ nsa siane nsia. 18 Na eza ɔzɛlɛle bieko, na ezule dɔle kpole manle aleɛ bule.
19Mediema, saa bɛ nuhua bie kpɔkye fi nɔhalɛ ne anwo na ɔlɛminli, na bɛ nuhua bie kɔfa ye ba a, 20bɛmaa ɔhakye kɛ: sonla mɔɔ kɛlie ɛtanevolɛ kɛvi ye ɛtane nu la ɛlie ɛtanevolɛ ne ɛkɛla ɛvi ewule nu na yeheda ɛtane dɔɔnwo azo.

Title: 1 PIT MUKENYE
Content:
Mukenye
Pita Kɛlata ne mɔɔ lumua la, ɔhɛlɛle ɔhɔmanle Kelaese ɛdoavolɛma mɔɔ yevɛlɛ bɛ “Nyamenle menli mɔɔ yekpa nu yeye bɛ,” na bɛde bɛkponde Ehyea Maena sɔlɔ afoa nu la amuala. Debie titile mɔɔ kɛlata ne gyi zolɛ la a le akɛnrazilɛ mɔɔ ɔfa yeamaa kengavolɛma mɔɔ ɔlua bɛ diedi ne ati bɛlɛyɛ bɛ kpɔdekpɔde na bɛlɛnwu amaneɛ la. Kɛlɛvolɛ ne hakyele bɛ adwenle wɔ Edwɛkpa ne mɔɔ fane Gyisɛse Kelaese anwo la na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, ɔwɔ kɛ ye ewule, ye ewudwazo nee ye ɛralɛ bieko mɔɔ ɔbara la maa bɛ anyelazo. Ɛhye ati ɔle kpalɛ kɛ bɛkɛzɔ amaneɛnwunlɛ sa na bɛkɛzi abotane, bɛkɛgyinla kpundii, na bɛkɛnwu kɛ bɛlɛ bɛlɛsɔ bɛ diedi bɛanlea saa ɔdi munli a, amaa “Kenle mɔɔ Gyisɛse Kelaese kɛra la” bɛanyia nwolɛ ahatualɛ kpalɛ.
Eza kɛlɛvolɛ ne si ye kengavolɛma ne adua kɛ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛ diedi ti bɛlɛnwu nyane la, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛbɔ mɔdenle kɛ bɛkɛdɛnla kɛ bɛle Kelaese ɛdeɛ.
Mɔɔ wɔ nu la
Ngilenu 1.1-2
Nyamenle ngoanelielɛ nwo ngakyelɛ 1.3-12
Ɛbɛlabɔlɛ kpalɛ nwo folɛdulɛ 1.13—2.10
Keleseɛnenli nyɛleɛ wɔ amaneɛnwunlɛ nu 2.11—4.19
Keleseɛnenli mɛlɛbɛnwoazeyɛlɛ nee ɛzonlenlɛ 5.1-11
Adwulaleɛ 5.12-14

Title: 1 PIT 1
Content:
1Kɛlata ɛhye vi medame Pita, mɔɔ mele Gyisɛse Kelaese ɛzoanvolɛ la ɛkɛ.
Melɛ mekamaa Nyamenle menli ne mɔɔ yekpa nu yeye bɛ na bɛha maanɔne wɔ Pɔntɛse, Galeehyea, Kapɛdosea, Ehyea, yɛɛ Baetenea maanzinli ne mɔ anu la amuala. 2Nyamenle Selɛ ne luale ye bodane ne azo kpale nu yele bɛ na ɔluale ye Sunsum ne azo ɔyɛle bɛ menli mɔɔ anwo te la, kɛ bɛyɛ tieyɛ bɛmaa Gyisɛse Kelaese na ye mogya ne ade bɛ nwo.
Nyamenle ɛlo bɛ na ɔmaa bɛ anzonudwolɛ molozo.
Anyelazo mɔɔ ɛnwu ɛlɛ
3Ayɛlɛyelɛ ɛha Nyamenle, yɛ Awulae Gyisɛse Kelaese ɔ Ze ne! Yelua ye ɛlolɛ kpole ne azo yedwazo Gyisɛse Kelaese yevi ewule nu na yemaa yɛnyia ngoane fofolɛ nwo anyelazo mɔɔ ɛnwu ɛlɛ a. 4Ɔlua zolɛ yɛ nye la nyilalɛ bebelebe ne mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛva ɛzie ye menli ne la azo. Bɛmɛ bɛ ti, yeva nyilalɛ ɛhye mɔɔ ɛmkpɔlɔ, ɔnzɛkye, yɛɛ ɔndu anzɛɛ ɔmkpa la yezie anwuma lɔ yemaa bɛ. 5Zɛhae nyilalɛ ne le bɛdabɛ mɔɔ ɔlua bɛ diedi ti Nyamenle tumi ne dielie bɛ gyɛlɛɛnye na bɛbaye ngoanelielɛ ne bɛahile bɛ wɔ mekɛ ne mɔɔ li amozi la ɛdeɛ.
6Ɛhye ati saa yera kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛdi nyane wɔ mekɛ ekyi ye anu wɔ sɔnea nee amaneɛnwunlɛ ngakyile nu a, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛdi fɛlɛko wɔ ɛhye anwo. 7Ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ wɔ ɛkɛ kɛ bɛfa bɛazɔ bɛ diedi bɛanlea saa ɔgyi kpundii a. Ezukoa nvutuke bɔbɔ mɔɔ sɛkye la, bɛfa senle a bɛnea kɛ ɔle kpalɛ a; zɔhane ala yɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛ diedi ne mɔɔ hyia tɛla ezukoa nvutuke la bɛsɔ ye bɛnea a, amaa yeava ayɛlɛyelɛ, anyunlunyia, yɛɛ enililɛ yearɛlɛ bɛ wɔ Kenle ne mɔɔ Gyisɛse bara la. 8Bɛtɛnwunle Gyisɛse ɛlɛ, noko bɛkulo ye. Kɛkala bɔbɔ bɛnnwu ye, noko bɛdie ye bɛdi, na ɔlua zo bɛ nye die na bɛdi fɛlɛko kpole mɔɔ ɛnloanlɛ ɛngola ɛnga a, 9ɔboalekɛ bɛlua bɛ diedi mɔɔ wɔ ye nu la azo bɛlɛdie bɛ ɛkɛla ngoane.
10Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma mɔɔ hanle ɛlolɛ ɛhye mɔɔ le bɛ ɛdeɛ la anwo edwɛkɛ dole ɛkɛ ne la nleɛnleanle nu, na bɛkpondɛle ngoanelielɛ ɛhye mɔɔ Nyamenle bava amaa bɛ la anu. 11Bɛbɔle mɔdenle kɛ bɛkɛnwu sonla holɛ ko ne mɔɔ bara nee mekɛ holɛ ko ne mɔɔ ɔbava yeara la. Ɛhye a le mɔɔ ɛnee Kelaese Sunsum ne mɔɔ wɔ bɛ nu la ɛlɛkilehile bɛ na ɔka nyane mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ Kelaese nwu ye nee anyunlunyia mɔɔ li ɔ nzi la anwo bie ɔkile bɛ a. 12Nyamenle yele hilele ye kpɔmanvolɛma mɔɔ luale Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne mɔɔ bɛzoanle ye vi anwuma rale la azo bɔle Edwɛkpa ɛhye nolo hilele bɛ, kɛ tɛ bɛdabɛ kpɔmanvolɛma bɛ ti yɛɛ bɛyɛle zɔhane gyima ne a, na bɛmɛ Kelaese ɛdoavolɛma bɛ ti ɔ. Ɛhye mɔ le ninyɛne mɔɔ Nyamenle soanvolɛma akunlu a anrɛɛ bɛde ɔ bo a.
Bɛdɛnla nwuanzanwuanza nu
13Zɔhane ati, bɛzie bɛ adwenle koonwu, bɛyɛ bɛ nye gyɛlɛmgbɛɛnye na bɛmaa bɛ nye ɛla nyilalɛ ne mɔɔ bɛbanyia ye wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ Gyisɛse Kelaese kɛra la azo. 14Bɛyɛ tieyɛ bɛmaa Nyamenle na bɛmmamaa bɛ atiakunluwɔzo sie bɛ kɛ dɛba ne mɔɔ ɛnee bɛnze nwolɛ bie la. 15Nyamenle ne mɔɔ ɛvɛlɛ bɛ la anwo te, yemɔti bɛmaa bɛ nwo ɛde wɔ nyɛleɛ biala anu. 16 Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se, “Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛmaa bɛ nwo te, ɔboalekɛ mele nwuanzanwuanza.”
17Bɛyɛ nzɛlɛlɛ a bɛfɛlɛ Nyamenle ne mɔɔ ɔnnea sonla nyunlu na ɔbua menli kɔsɔɔti ndɛne, kɛmɔ biala nyɛleɛ si de la bɛ Ze. Zɔhane ati, bɛva Nyamenlezulolɛ bɛbɔ bɛ ɛbɛla wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ nlɔnu la. 18Bɛdabɛ bɛze mɔɔ bɛduale ye wɔ bɛ ti na bɛahola bɛakpɔne bɛ bɛavi bɛ nlenya mɔ ɛbɛla mgbane mgbane ɛbɔlɛ ne anu la. Bɛanva debie mɔɔ ɛngyɛ na yeazɛkye, mɔɔ le kɛ ezukoa nvutuke anzɛɛ dwɛtɛ fufule, 19bɛvale Gyisɛse, mɔɔ le boaneralɛ mɔɔ anwo ɛnlɛ dɛne biala la mogya ne mɔɔ sonle bolɛ la a bɛkpɔnenle bɛ a. 20Nyamenle vale ye ziele ɛkɛ dɛba kolaa na bɛabɔ ewiade, yɛɛ bɛmɛ bɛ ti bɛye ye bɛhile wɔ mekɛ ye mɔɔ li amozi la anu a. 21Ɔlua ɔ nwo zo yɛɛ bɛlie Nyamenle ne mɔɔ dwazole ye vile ewule nu na ɔmanle ye anyunlunyia la bɛli, na kɛkala bɛ diedi nee bɛ anyelazo ɛragyinla Nyamenle anwo zo a.
22Kɛkala mɔɔ ɔlua bɛ tieyɛ wɔ nɔhalɛ ne anwo bɛde bɛ nwo bɛvi ninyɛndane nwo na bɛnyia ɛhulolɛ bɛmaa bɛ mediema diedima la, bɛmaa bɛ ɛhulolɛ ne ɛyɛ nɔhalɛ ɛhulolɛ mɔɔ vi bɛ ahonle nu a. 23Ɔluakɛ bɛlua tease Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle ne edwɛkɛ zo bɛwo bɛ fofolɛ kɛ bɛle mralɛ mɔɔ ɛnwu ɛlɛ la na bɛnle menli mɔɔ wu la amra.
24 Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se,
“Menli kɔsɔɔti le kɛ ndile,
bɛ anyunlunyia le kɛ ndotolo.
Ndile ne nwoso na ndotolo ne kpolo,
25noko Awulae edwɛkɛ ne wɔ ɛkɛ ne dahuu.”
Edwɛkɛ ɛhye a le Edwɛkpa ne mɔɔ bɛbɔle ye nolo bɛhilele bɛ la.

Title: 1 PIT 2
Content:
Tease Bolɛ ne nee Maanle Nwuanzanwuanza ne
1Zɔhane ati, bɛhwe bɛ nwo bɛvi ɛtane muala anwo; bɛmmabɔ adalɛ, bɛmmayɛ ngunzi, bɛmmatwe nungule, bɛmmayɛ aholoba. 2Bɛyɛ bɛ nwo kɛ nlɔma mɔɔ sunsum nu nyɛfonzule ɛhɔne ɛlɛku bɛ la, amaa saa bɛnyia ye bɛno a bɛanyi na bɛanyia ngoane. 3 Ɔluakɛ Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se, “Bɛdabɛ bɛhola bɛnwu kɛ Awulae atiakunlu le kɛnlɛma.”
4Bɛrɛla Awulae ɛkɛ. Yemɔ a ɔle Tease Bolɛ ne mɔɔ ewiade amra kpole ye kɛ ɔle debie mgbane na Nyamenle noko ɛkpa nu ɛye ye kɛ ɔle bolɛ mɔɔ anwo hyia la a. 5Bɛrɛla kɛ bɛle tease awolɛ na bɛmaa bɛva bɛ bɛzi sunsum nu ɛzonlenlɛ sua mɔɔ bɛsonle nu, kɛ bɛle sɛlɛvolɛma nwuanzanwuanza na bɛlua Gyisɛse Kelaese anwo zo bɛbɔ sunsum nu azu mɔɔ sɔ ɛnyelɛ la bɛmaa Nyamenle. 6 Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se,
“Mekpa nu meye bolɛ mɔɔ sonle bolɛ,
kɛ mefa meayɛ bolɛ mɔɔ anwo hyia wɔ Zayɔn;
mɔɔ kɛlie ye kɛli la anyunlu ɛnrɛgua aze ɛlɛ.”
7 Bolɛ ɛhye sonle bolɛ kpole kpalɛ maa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdie bɛdi la, na bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnlie bɛnli la, Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se,
“Bolɛ ko ne ala mɔɔ suatovoma ne kpole kɛ ɔle
debie mgbane la,
yemɔ ala a ɔrayɛle bolɛ mɔɔ anwo hyia kpalɛ la a.”
8 Eza Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne bie se,
“Ɛhye le bolɛ mɔɔ bamaa menli adu koti a;
ɔle bodane mɔɔ bamaa bɛadu bɛagua a.”
Bɛtu koti, ɔboalekɛ bɛnlie edwɛkɛ ne bɛnli; Nyamenle ngyehyɛlɛ ne kɛ de la ɛne.
9 Bɛmɛ a bɛle menli mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛkpa nu ɛye bɛ a. Bɛle Belemgbunli ne sɛlɛvolɛma, maanle nwuanzanwuanza, Nyamenle ɔdaye ye menli mɔɔ yeboɔboa yekpondɛ bɛ bo zo na yevɛlɛ bɛ kɛ bɛvi awozinli nu bɛrɛla ye wienyi ne anu na bɛbɔ ye nwanwane gyima ne nolo a. 10Mekɛ bie ɛnee bɛnzɔho menli bɔbɔ, na ɛnɛ bɛle Nyamenle menli. Mekɛ bie ɛnee bɛnze Nyamenle anwunvɔnezelɛ ne deɛ holɛ, na ɛnɛ bɛ sa ɛha ye anwunvɔnezelɛ ne.
Nyamenle ngɛkɛlɛ
11Ayi mɔ, mesɛlɛ bɛ, bɛle nyɛvolɛ nee adendulɛma wɔ ewiade! Bɛmmadi nwonane atiakunluwɔzo ne mɔ mɔɔ dahuu nee bɛ ɛkɛla ko la anzi fee. 12Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛmaa bɛ nyɛleɛ wɔ maanlema avinli yɛ kɛnlɛma, amaa saa bɛsi bɛ amgbu kɛ bɛnle kpalɛ bɔbɔ a, ɛnee kɛmɔ bɛnwu bɛ nyɛleɛ kpalɛ ne la ati bɛaye Nyamenle ayɛlɛ wɔ Kenle ne mɔɔ Awulae bara la.
13Awulae ati bɛha bɛ nwo aze bɛmaa menli mɔɔ lɛ tumi wɔ bɛ sa nu mɔɔ le kɛ Maanle Maanle Belemgbunli ne, mɔɔ yemɔ a maanle ne anu tumi wɔ ɔ sa nu la, 14nee amɛnladoma, mɔɔ le kɛ ɛzoanlɛ bie a bɛzoa bɛ kɛ bɛradea maamɔvoma, na bɛhanvo bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdi boɛ la. 15Ɔluakɛ Nyamenle ɛhulolɛ a le kɛ bɛkɛva bɛ nyɛleɛ kpalɛ ne mɔ bɛkɛmaa ahɔnwɔne kɛgyakyi mgbane mgbane ɛhehanlɛ. 16Bɛdɛnla kɛ bɛdi bɛ ti anwo, noko bɛmmafa bɛ ti anwo ɛlilɛ ne bɛkedɛheda ɛtane zo. Bɛdɛnla kɛ bɛle Nyamenle ngɛkɛlɛ. 17Bɛli menli kɔsɔɔti eni. Bɛhulo bɛ gɔnwo mɔ diedima. Bɛzulo Nyamenle na bɛli Maanle Maanle Belemgbunli ne eni.
Kelaese amaneɛnwunlɛ nwo ndonwo
18Bɛmɛ ngɛkɛlɛ, bɛbɛlɛ bɛ nwo aze bɛmaa bɛ menle mɔ; bɛmmabu mɔɔ atiakunlu le kɛnlɛma la angome, na bɛbu mɔɔ ati yɛ se la noko. 19Saa bɛfa Nyamenle ɛhulolɛ bɛsie bɛ nyunlu, na ɔlua yemɔti bɛnwu amaneɛ mɔɔ ɛnfɛta la, na bɛsi nwolɛ abotane a, ɔbayila bɛ. 20Ɔluakɛ duzu nvasoɛ yɛɛ bɛkɛnyia ye kɛ bɛkɛyɛ ɛtane na bɛkɛnyia nwolɛ ndeanlɛ a? Na saa bɛdi boɛ la ati bɛnwu nwolɛ amaneɛ na bɛsi nwolɛ abotane a, Nyamenle bayila bɛ. 21Bɛdabɛ bɛ ti Kelaese mumua ne nwunle amaneɛ vale yɛle ndonwo manle bɛ. Na ɛhye noko ala ati yɛɛ Nyamenle ɛvɛlɛ bɛ a, amaa bɛava ɔ gyakɛ. 22 Yeanyɛ ɛtane biala, yɛɛ yeambɔ adalɛ yeangile awie biala. 23 Noko mɔɔ bɛbɔ ye aholoba la, yeambɔ bɛ bie, bɛgolo ɔ nwo la, yeandɛ ɔ nloa anu; mɔɔ ɔnwu amaneɛ bɔbɔ la, yeanwunlonwunla awie, na ɔvale ye anyelazo kɔsɔɔti ɔdole Nyamenle anwo zo kɛ yemɔ a ɔle pɛlepɛle Ndɛnebuavolɛ ne a. 24Kelaese ɔdaye mumua ne ɔliele yɛ ɛtane ne mɔ wɔ ye sonlabaka ne anu ɔhɔle meanubaka ne azo, amaa yɛawu yɛamaa ɛtane na yɛadɛnla yɛamaa pɛlepɛlelilɛ. Bɛlua ye ɛbodalɛ nganlɛ ne mɔ azo a bɛyɛ bɛ ayile a. 25Ɛnee bɛle kɛ mboane mɔɔ ɛminli la, na kɛkala bɛva bɛ bɛzia bɛra kɛ bɛrali Mboaneneavolɛ ne nee bɛ ɛkɛla sinzavolɛ ne anzi.

Title: 1 PIT 3
Content:
Agyalɛ nwo folɛdulɛ
1 Bɛmɛ nwuvolɛ mraalɛ, bɛbɛlɛ bɛ nwo aze bɛmaa bɛ hu mɔ, amaa nuhua mɔɔ ɔ hu ɛnlie Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne ɛnli la, bɛalua bɛ nyɛleɛ zo bɛahwe ye bɛarɛlɛ Nyamenle, mɔɔ ɔnrɛhyia kɛ bɛkɛha edwɛkɛ kpɔkɛ ko bɔbɔ a, 2ɔboalekɛ bɛbanwu bɛ nwo enililɛ nee bɛ anwondelɛ wɔ bɛ nyɛleɛ nu. 3 Bɛmmafa ninyɛne mɔɔ le kɛ bɛ ti ɛyɛlɛ, mgbɔba, agudeɛ anzɛɛ ndanlɛ ngɛnlɛma ɛhedalɛ bɛsiezie bɛ nwo kɛ bɛfa bɛamaa bɛ nwo ayɛ fɛ. 4Bɛmaa bɛ nyamenlezo anwofɛlɛko ne mɔɔ wɔ bɛ nu la ɛvinde. Nyamenlezo anwofɛlɛko ɛhye vea bɛ ahonle ne mɔ anu, na yemɔ a le bɛ bɛtɛɛyɛlɛ nee bɛ koonwuyɛlɛ subane ne.
